All the property's accommodations will make even the most demanding guests feel completely at ease, offering a space that combines modern and practical features such as complimentary wireless Internet access with a classic touch displayed in the elegant Ottoman-style furniture. Guests can take a refreshing swim in the outdoor pool, enjoy a delicious cocktail at the on-site bar, or try exquisite specialties at the hotel's restaurant.

2839.description: This pleasant hotel is located in Kumköy, within 200 m of Side's most beautiful sandy beach. It is 60 km to the airport, while the centre of Side, where guests will discover a selection of shopping and entertainment venues, is about 5 km away. Links to the public transport network and an abundance of restaurants and bars are within a few paces of the hotel and it is about 250 m to the nearest nightclubs. Renovated in 2002, this hotel comprises a 5-storey main building and a 2-storey annexe block offering a total of 151 units. Leisure facilities include an indoor swimming pool and an outdoor pool with children's area, a poolside snack bar and a sun terrace with parasols and sun loungers laid out for guests. There is also a SPA area with a sauna and massage offerings as well as steam baths and Turkish baths. Sports options are available to more active guests.

2840.description: This charming hotel is located by a beautiful long sandy beach, within wonderful green grounds. The town centre with its many shops, cafés, bars and restaurants is just 3. 8 km away where Side's spectacular amphitheatre, museum and the Temple of Apollo can also be found. Manavgat Waterfalls are 10 km away. There are public transportation links and a taxi station in front of the hotel.

2841.description: This pleasant hotel is situated just outside of Side, only five kilometres from the old town centre and beautiful Roman ruins, including a Temple of Apollo and amphitheatre. A long stretch of sandy beach dotted with sun loungers and parasols is just steps from the hotel, and guests can spend lazy afternoons lounging in the sun by the outdoor pool, which features three waterslides and a separate children's pool. The onsite spa offers rest and relaxation with its services including massages, Turkish bath, and sauna, while the kids' club provides entertainment for children ages 4 to 12 as well as a ‘mini-disco' in the evenings. The hotel also offers an animation programme and volleyball, tennis and basketball courts for guest leisure. Whether visiting Side for a fun-filled family holiday or a couple's relaxing weekend away, this hotel provides all the services and facilities needs to enjoy a carefree stay.

2842.description: Located by the beach and only 3 km from the centre of Side, this family-friendly hotel comprises a total of 379 units spread over 3-4 floors. Set in spacious grounds which feature a large outdoor pool and landscaped gardens, the hotel has many facilities including its own beach, on-site shops and entertainment programme.

2843.description: This hotel is located across the road from Cleopatra beach and public transportation is a minute's walk away. There are shops, bars and restaurants nearby, and the nearest nightclub is also within walking distance, at Alanya harbour. The hotel is just steps away from the city's numerous attractions such as Alanya Castle, Alanya Dockyard and Arsenal, the Red Tower, Alanya Archaeological Museum and Damlatas Cave. Wİ-fi (internet) is for Halfboard Guests Extra and for All inclusive Guests free of charge.

2844.description: This elegant and luxurious hotel is situated in the centre of Istanbul just a stone's throw from the Grand Bazaar and a short walk from Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque. Rooms are spacious and beautifully decorated in Ottoman style, featuring air-conditioning, free WIFI and double-glazed windows to ensure a good night's rest. In the morning, guests may wake up to a wholesome buffet breakfast with stunning views of the sea in the hotel's breakfast room, and in the evening delight in a romantic meal with spectacular views of the historic city and its shimmering lights in the hotel's own restaurant. Professional and friendly staff are happy to help plan excursions and city tours, and guests will appreciate the hotel's superior services including free onsite private parking, currency exchange, airport shuttle, and room service. This hotel offers luxury and comfort in the centre of Istanbul, making it ideal for couples and families alike, as well as for business travel.

2845.description: This modern, understated establishment is situated in the Chamberí district, offering a convenient location at only 1. 2 kilometres from the centre of Madrid, and around a 25 minute drive from the airport. The property has excellent access to public transport links, and lies within around a 12 minute walking distance from the famous Plaza de España, and the popular Gran Vía street, where travellers can find some of the most important boutiques. Facilites in the hotel include a modern and stylish dining room providing guests every morning with a succulent breakfast buffet, which includes a wide selection of sweet and savoury options. After a busy day of work or sightseeing, visitors may want to unwind at the hotels elegant lobby-bar, while sipping a refreshing beverage. The modern spacious rooms feature stylish décor with unique themes, slick furniture and a luxurious private bathroom with a hair dryer. All the rooms are thoughtfully designed and beautifully finished to ensure guests enjoy perfect comfort and convenience during their stay.

2856.description: Hotel themed around Denominations of Origin of Spanish wines. Completely renovated in 2012, the hotel comprises a total of 46 rooms spread over 7 floors. Located in the Golden Triangle of Art, a few meters from the Prado, Thyssen and Reina Sofia and railway station Atocha-AVE. The hotel has free WIFI in all rooms and public areas, 24 hour reception, business corner as well.

2912.description: This hotel, housed in an 1842 building, is situated in the very centre of Barcelona, right in the heart of the cultural and historical area of the city and very close to the renowned Las Ramblas. Guests will be able to find within the area a great variety of shopping sites and boutiques, cafes, bars and restaurants. Convenient public transport located at the hotel door provides direct access to the local beach, which is around 1km away. This is a perfect place to relax after a long day exploring this magnificent city.

2913.address: Gran Via De Les Corts Catalanes, 668
2913.description:
Located in Barcelona’s elegant Eixample district, El Palace Barcelona offers timeless luxury just five minutes from Passeig de Gràcia and Gaudí’s Casa Batlló. Originally opened in 1919 as the former Ritz of Barcelona, the hotel blends historic charm with modern comfort and exceptional service. 

The property features 120 classically styled rooms equipped with all the amenities needed for a comfortable stay. 

Dining options include the Hall, serving traditional tapas, seasonal dishes, and Afternoon Tea, and the Rooftop Garden, an urban oasis with panoramic city views. Amar Barcelona, led by Chef Rafa Zafra, specializes in Mediterranean cuisine and Catalan flavors. 

The Mayan Luxury Spa offers a wide range of treatments, a traditional Temazcal, and a fully equipped gym. 

With 24-hour concierge, butler service, and a dedicated, attentive team, El Palace Barcelona ensures an exclusive and personalized stay.

2914.description: The hotel is superbly situated in the center of the renowned commercial, financial and touristic area of Barcelona. It is beautifully nestled on the corner of Rosselló with Passeig de Gràcia, one of the most shopping avenues in the city. The hotel offers beautiful views to La Pedrera and other fantastic building in the area. The underground and bus stops are only 20 meters away. Within the area guests will be able to visit other sites of touristic and cultural interest worthwhile visiting. This is definitely a perfect hotel for those guests wishing to discover Barcelona from within.

2933.description: With a stay at InterContinental Lisbon, an IHG Hotel, you'll be centrally located in Lisbon, within a 10-minute walk of Marquis of Pombal Square and El Corte Ingles Mall. This luxury hotel is 1 mi (1. 6 km) from Gulbenkian Museum and 1. 4 mi (2. 2 km) from Rossio Square. Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include wedding services, discounted use of a nearby fitness facility, and a banquet hall. Make yourself at home in one of the 331 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Akla Restaurant, a restaurant which specializes in Portuguese cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Eduardo VII Park - 0. 1 km / 0.

2942.description: This charming city hotel lies in the tourist centre of the lively city of Madrid. Guests will find themselves just a few minutes' walking distance away from the centre of the city. A host of bars, boutiques, shopping opportunities and restaurants are to be found just a few steps away. Links to the public transport network are situated nearby, offering ease of access to other areas of the city. This charming hotel enjoys a chic style, bathing guests in sophistication and elegance. The guest rooms are superbly designed, and come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests can enjoy a delectable breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

2944.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an outdoor pool, a spa tub, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Lisbon? This hotel has 17222 square feet (1600 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 12 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 369 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions.

name.content: Pestana Palace Lisboa - Hotel & National Monument

2974.description: This luxury hotel occupies a 19th century palace, is classified as a national monument and boasts stunning interiors and lush gardens. It is located near some of the most important monuments in the city, such as Centro Cultural de Belém, Mosteiro dos Jerónimos and the Congress Centre. A wide array of shopping facilities, bars, restaurants and nightclubs can be found within a 7 km radius of the hotel. This luxury hotel is around 5 km from the city centre and public transportation links are within 1 km of the hotel.

2976.description: This 4-star hotel, established in 2002, is located in Lisbon, a short drive from Campo Pequeno and near the Entre Campos station. The VIP Executive Entrecampos Hotel & Conference offers 171 soundproofed rooms, including five suites, each equipped with sprinklers. Dining options include two restaurants: the Jardim Buffet, serving breakfast by the indoor garden, and Ouro Preto, offering Portuguese and international cuisine for weekend lunch and dinner. Guests can also enjoy the News Café coffee shop and a piano bar. Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, including guest rooms and meeting rooms. The hotel features nine meeting rooms totaling 725 square meters. A pool and gymnasium are also available. Please note: the Turkish bath, Jacuzzi, and sauna pool are currently closed, and access to locker rooms is restricted. Use of the gym is unsupervised and at the user's own risk. Children must be accompanied by an adult.

2992.description: Meliá Barcelona Sarrià combines elegant design, comfort, and exclusive services in the heart of Les Corts. Located just steps from Avenida Diagonal, the hotel is surrounded by shops, restaurants, and some of Barcelona’s most iconic attractions, including Gaudí’s masterpieces and Camp Nou. With modern rooms, the Serena Spa, Prezzemolo Restaurant, and the exclusive The Level service, it offers the perfect balance of relaxation, style, and convenience for both leisure and business stays.

2993.description: This hotel lies just 5 km away from the nearest beach in Barcelona. The hotel is located on Diagonal Avenue, lying at the heart of the city's most important business and commercial district. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from a diverse selection of shops, restaurants, bars and nightclubs, as well as the city's most prominent attractions. This wonderful hotel is sure to impress, featuring a delightful design and welcoming visitors with warm hospitality. This hotel features beautifully-appointed guest rooms, which come complete with modern amenities. Guests will be pleased to find a wide range of excellent amenities at this wonderful hotel.

3020.description: The Hotel Regente, located in the heart of Madrid's Gran Via, offers a prime location for exploring the Spanish capital. Just a short walk from Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor, and the historic Habsburg district, the hotel is surrounded by theaters, cinemas, department stores, and restaurants, with excellent metro and bus connections. This makes the Hotel Regente a perfect choice for both business and leisure travelers.

3087.description: Situated in the rural countryside of Cardona, the upscale Parador de Cardona hotel is within a 15-minute walk of the Castle of Cardona and the Church of Sant Vicente. This hotel offers a variety of amenities for guests to enjoy, including a fitness center, sauna, restaurant, coffee shop, and bar/lounge. Room service is also available during limited hours. Each of the 54 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, LED television with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, safe, and desk. Private bathrooms are stocked with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, free self-parking, gift shops, and tour/ticket assistance. The Parador de Cardona is approximately 31 miles from Montserrat Monastery and a convenient 61 miles from Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN).

3092.description: This hotel is situated in the heart of Chinchon, some 21 km from Aranjuez and 45 km from Madrid. Madrid Airport is around 65 km away. Renovated in 2007, the historical city hotel is housed in a 17th Century building which was previously an Augustine monastery. It comprises a total of 39 rooms and offers guests air conditioning, a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility, lift access, a café, a restaurant, WLAN/Internet access, room and laundry services and a garage. The interiors of the rooms are in Elizabethan (Spanish Renaissance style), in blue with floral decoration, painted by hand, vaulted ceilings, clay floors and Castilian style. They come with a private bathroom with a bathtub as well as a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, a TV, a safe, Internet access, a minibar, a double bed, individually adjustable air conditioning and either a balcony or a terrace. The hotel features an open air pool with sun loungers. Guests are offered excellent Castilian dishes, including meat stews in winter. Guests may select their breakfast from a continental buffet and the midday meal is also available in buffet form as well as from a set menu. The evening meal may be enjoyed à la carte or from a set menu. Guests coming from Madrid should take the A4 towards Andalucia (Cordoba), and exit at junction 29 in Ciempozuelos. Turn off towards Tutulcia and Chinchón, some 23 km from this junction. Coming from Madrid on the A3, drive towards Valencia leaving at junction 21 for Morata de Tajuña and Chinchón. From here, it is some 24 km to Chinchón.

3151.description: The Petit Palace Preciados is a fantastic city hotel built in 1920 and renovated in 2026 located in the centre of Madrid, recently renovated in 2026, a very convenient location from where guests can easily reach many touristic and cultural sites of general interest, such as, Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor, the Royal Palace. Within the area guests will also find a wide selection of shops, boutiques, cafes, bars and restaurants. Public transport links are located at approximately 50 metres away. The hotel boasts comfortable and modern rooms and features excellent facilities that will satisfy the needs of corporate travellers. The historic building, dating back to 1920, underwent a complete renovation in mid-2026, ensuring all its facilities are fully up to date. Amenities available upon request.

3152.description: Situated directly in the city centre, opposite the Madrid Opera House and just a 5-minute walk from the fantastic Palacio Real, this small, family-run hotel occupies a century-old historical building and is the perfect setting for a truly unforgettable stay in the Spanish capital. In addition to providing modern, spacious and elegant accommodation, where guests can truly relax after a day of exploring the fantastic attractions of Madrid, the hotel is an attraction in itself, with musical evenings featuring Spanish opera singers organized regularly in the hotel's restaurant, and an in-house piano bar.

3153.description: The combination of an excellent location, spacious guest rooms and an outstanding service, makes this friendly hotel a popular choice for travellers seeking a comfortable accommodation close to the main attractions of the Spanish capital. The establishment is located in the centre of Madrid, close to the Plaza Mayor, the Teatro Mayor and the Gran Vía Avenue, where travellers can find an array of the best designer boutiques as well as many restaurants and bars offering typical Mediterranean cuisine. After a busy day out, guests may relax in their comfortable rooms, featuring a modern and elegant design as well as excellent amenities to ensure a fully enjoyable stay. The hotel's dining room will be pleased to welcome guests every morning to offer a rich breakfast buffet, which includes mouth-watering sweet and savoury options. Meeting facilities are also available for those travelling on business purposes and the bar is the perfect place to enjoy a refreshing drink after a busy day of work or sightseeing.

3160.address: Paraje el Bac de Sau | Ctra. de Tavèrnoles km 10, s/n
3160.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, gift shops/newsstands, and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 38 guestrooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is available. Private bathrooms with bathtubs feature bidets and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Sau Reservoir - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Sant Pere de Casserres - 3. 7 km / 2.

3195.description: Located in central Lisbon, with easy access to transport, the Novotel hotel is convenient for family vacations or business trips. It is located 500 yards from Lisbon Zoo, near the Gulbenkian Foundation. The restaurant and bar are perfect for relaxing and socializing. After a gym workout, why not head to the outdoor pool if the weather is nice? There are also 10 meeting rooms with plenty of natural light.

3197.description: Nestled in Madrid's distinguished Salamanca district, the 5-star Hotel Wellington offers a blend of classic design and modern touches within a historic limestone building. Steps from Retiro Park, Alcalá Gate, Colón Square, and the Art Triangle (Prado, Thyssen, and Reina Sofía museums), it's ideal for exploring the city's cultural treasures and indulging in luxury shopping and dining. The hotel boasts 251 elegant guestrooms with tailored linens and high ceilings, a variety of restaurants including the Michelin-starred Kabuki and Goizeko Wellington (serving Basque cuisine), and a rooftop garden providing fresh ingredients. Exclusive amenities include a seasonal outdoor pool, solarium, jacuzzi, English bar, coffee shop, and a wellness center with spa and fitness facilities. Thirteen meeting rooms cater to business needs. Please note: The hotel is closed for renovations until October 30, 2020. For the cleanliness policy, visit the property page on Preferredhotels. com.

3204.description: The Senator Barajas is a comfortable and modern 4-star hotel conveniently located near Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas Airport, the IFEMA trade fair, and the Wanda Metropolitano football stadium (5 minutes by car). Ideal for business travelers, tourists, and those on a stopover in Madrid, the hotel offers a range of amenities, including a breakfast and group buffet, event rooms, private parking (subject to availability), a 24-hour swimming pool and gym, and a complimentary airport shuttle service. All exterior rooms feature air-conditioning/heating, a bathroom with hairdryer and toiletries, a direct telephone line, an LCD TV, a desk, free Wi-Fi, and a wake-up service. Most rooms also include a terrace. Excellent transport links connect the hotel to central Madrid; the Alameda de Osuna metro station (Line 5) is a 10-minute walk away, providing access to Gran Vía in approximately 30 minutes. Enhanced health and safety measures are currently in place.

3257.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Barcelona and was established in 2003. It is a short drive away from the Port Olimpic and the nearest station is Bogatell. The Hotel has 2 restaurants, a bar, a rooftop terrace, conference rooms, an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 195 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer and air conditioning.

3313.description: Mercure Lisboa is the perfect getaway from the hustle and bustle of the city. The hotel is convenient and practical for business or leisure trips. Next to Lisbon Zoo, Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation and El Corte Ingles. The 104 air-conditioned rooms have double windows and a seating area. Recharge in the covered, outdoor, heated pool on the top floor. Also on site a restaurant, bar and 5 meeting rooms.

3314.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Lisbon, within easy walking distance from downtown Lisbon, where there are shops, monuments, and museums. The hotel is next to the Anjos metro station, allowing for quick and easy access to the whole city. Bairro Alto, with all its restaurants and bars, is only a few metro stations away. Within 20 minutes, guests can arrive at Parque das Nações, where they can visit the Oceanarium, the Lisbon International Exhibit (FIL), the Vasco da Gama shopping centre, and the Lisbon Casino, on the western bank of the Tagus River.

3315.description: The hotel is conveniently located in the Campo Grande district, less than 2 km from Portela International Airport. The nearby, Campo Grande Metro Station offers easy access to Lisbon's historic downtown area, including trendy Bairro Alto, Chiado, Rossio, Commerce Square and even Avenida da Liberdade. The comfortable rooms and suites at this hotel have modern amenities and wooden flooring. They include cable TV, a tea/coffee maker and seating area and marble bathroom with amenities. Lunch and dinner are available at the restaurant, with a focus on Mediterranean cuisine and à la carte or buffet options. Guests can relax at the bar sipping cocktails while enjoying live piano music on select nights and has a big screen TV, broadcasting football and other sports.

3317.address: Avenida Antonio Jose De Almeida, 28 A
3317.description: Holiday Inn® Lisbon is located near the main business and tourism spots of the Portuguese capital, less than 15 minutes drive from Lisbon Airport. Whether you are travelling on business or leisure, our wide rooms offer a stay with maximum comfort and all the conditions you need, such as a working desk, LCD TV, complimentary tea, coffee, pillow menu and free Wi-fi. This family-friendly hotel makes a great base for exploring the city. There are three metro stations (Saldanha, Alameda and Campo Pequeno) and several bus stops within a 10-minute walk. Discover the historic quarters such as Alfama, explore Sao George's Castle and visit the Belem Tower, all less than 20 minutes drive away, or hop on, for unbeatable city views. Explore the Caloustre Gulbenkian Museum with several artworks. At Holiday Inn hotels, kids Stay and Eat Free. Start your day with an American buffet breakfast and later enjoy Mediterranean cuisine in Lounge 28. Come and make yourself comfortable in the hotel's open lobby and enjoy a delicious cocktail when your day winds down. For those who need to schedule meetings or organise events, our hotel offers seven renovated meeting rooms . Our pool is temporarily closed for maintenance. It is scheduled to reopen on 2027. We apologize for the inconvenience.

3318.description: This charming family-run hotel is excellently situated just off the Avenida da Liberdade with its elegant shopping facilities and the Avenida Metro Station. The historic centre with its famous attractions such as Praça do Rossio, Praça do Comércio, elevator of Santa Justa, Castle of São Jorge and the river banks of the Tagus are within walking distance. The international airport of Lisbon can be reached within a short drive.

3319.description: Hotel do Chiado is located in Chiado, Lisbon's historic district, near Bairro Alto, Rossio Square and Avenida da Liberdade. The hotel was built in the historic building of Armazéns do Chiado, nowadays a shopping centre, which was completely restored by the famous architect Siza Vieira after the tragic fire of 1988. Situated in Chiado, the trendiest, most elegant and chic meeting point in Lisbon, this is the only hotel in town that offers rooms with private terraces and panoramic views of the Castle and the Tagus River. The subway station Baixa-Chiado is located beneath the building and guests can easily find a taxi service next to the hotel. The Entretanto Rooftop Bar, located on the 7th floor, is well-known for having the best view of Lisbon. It's the perfect place for a romantic dinner, a gathering with friends, an informal meeting or just to relax at the end of a working day.

3320.description: Set in the heart of the Baixa, this hotel is a creative renovation of an historic building. The nearest metro station is Rossio, just 300 metres away. The Chiado and San Jorge's Castle are 15 minutes' walk away. Rooms at the hotel are decorated in deep blues, with Baroque-style armchairs and wooden headboards. The hotel provides a 24-hour front desk, offering luggage storage and daily newspapers, and for guests arriving by car there is public parking available nearby at a charge.

3321.description: This hotel is located in the most prestigious quarter of central Lisbon – Avenida da Liberdade. Marquês de Pombal Metro Station is 20 m away. The hotel is close to the Cathedral, S. Jorge Castle, Bairro Alto quarter, Jerónimos Monastery and Edward VII Park. Less than 1 km away guests will reach a variety of shopping venues, bars, pubs, nightclubs and links to the public transport network. It is at only 7 km from Lisbon Airport. The hotel offers soundproofed and air-conditioned rooms, fitted with work desk, ihome, safe, minibar, cable and satellite TV and bathroom with hairdryer and make-up mirror. Guests can enjoy at the onsite restaurant & bar which serves a wide selection of Portuguese and International Traditional Cuisine, overlooking the Avenida da Liberdade.

3322.description: Retreat to an urban oasis with the Avani Avenida Liberdade Lisbon Hotel in the heart of Lisbon. Located near the Portuguese Capital's famed Baixa and Chiado districts, you'll be minutes away from shops, bars, restaurants – plus many of the city's best attractions. Visit the São Pedro de Alcântara viewpoint, take a walk around the Castelo São Jorge, or explore the greenery of the Parque Eduardo VII. Our 119 rooms bring the outside in with views over the subtropical garden, or Lisbon itself from private balconies. With Nespresso machines, Sky TV, Wi-Fi and more, our standard, Premier, Deluxe and Family rooms provide everything you need to relax. Escape the city bustle in our outdoor pool, complete with a pool bar, or work out in the AVANIFIT 24-hour fitness centre. Dine on some of the best food Lisbon has to offer at our Olivier Avenida restaurant, serving dishes designed by famed Portuguese chef Olivier da Costa and open all day. Just 20 minutes from Lisbon airport, our Palacete Conference and Events Centre can host congresses, parties or weddings. Our experienced team will help you run an unforgettable event from start to finish.

3323.description: Experience a piece of history when you stay at the first-ever Tivoli Hotel in Lisbon. Tivoli Avenida Liberdade Lisboa Hotel first opened its doors in 1933 and is famous for being the home of late Portuguese actress and icon, Beatriz Costa, for over 30 years. Located in the heart of the Portuguese capital, on the city's most luxurious avenues, you'll be within walking distance of the city's hotspots. Visit the majestic Castelo de São Jorge, take the Glória Funicular up to the São Pedro de Alcântara viewpoint, or spend a day exploring stylish shops, bars and restaurants. Our newly refurbished rooms offer an oasis of calm and views of Avenida da Liberdade, the Tagus River or the secluded patio. Our room amenities include Nespresso machines and Wi-Fi. Suites and connecting rooms are available for families, with the Anantara Spa and exclusive outdoor pool perfecting the mood of relaxation. Dine in style at SEEN Lisboa rooftop restaurant, serving signature cocktails and delicious food – from Wagyu beef to locally sourced oysters. The more traditional Cervejaria Liberdade, known for its fish and seafood, is open all day. Just a 15-minute drive from the airport, our congress center is the perfect place to host your event. Our experienced conference and events team will ensure everything runs smoothly.

3324.description: Featuring a prime situation in the heart of Lisbon, this hotel is just 199 m from Picoas metro station. Shopping lovers will appreciate its convenient location in the main shopping area of the city, and culture enthusiasts will find the historic centre of the city, dominated by the ancient Castelo, just a 10-minute walking distance away. Lisbon Airport is some 6. 4 km from the hotel. This hotel provides comfortable guest rooms, equipped with air-conditioning, a private bathroom, satellite TV and a minibar. As for the onsite services and facilities, guests will appreciate the breakfast buffet served each morning at the onsite restaurant. A great selection of Portuguese and international food is also served for lunch and dinner, with local wines available from the cellar.

3343.description: This modern hotel lies just 2 km from the mesmerising city of Barcelona. Guests will find themselves within easy walking distance of a number of shopping opportunities, entertainment venues, dining options and attractions. Guests can enjoy ease of access to the centre of this captivating city. This delightful hotel features beautifully-appointed guest rooms, which provide a haven of peace and serenity in which to escape the bustle of the city. The rooms come complete with modern amenities, for added comfort and convenience. Guests are invited to enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a deposit.

3356.description: This charming hotel is situated in the suburbs of Barcelona. It lies close to Sarria Station, which offers ease of access to other areas of the city to be explored. The hotel is situated within easy access of the many intriguing attractions that this captivating city has to offer. El Prat Airport can be found just a short driving distance away. Guests can explore the countless shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities nearby. This hotel appeals to every type of traveller visiting Barcelona. The guest rooms offer functional space and modern amenities. The hotel features a delightful restaurant, where delectable dishes can be enjoyed. The hotel also offers a bar, where guests can sit back and unwind with a refreshing drink. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a pet deposit.

3360.description: This city hotel enjoys a wonderful location at the centre of Montijo just 2 kms from the bridge over the spectacular Tejo River. The hotel is located just a 30 minutes' drive from the centre of the enchanting city of Lisbon, where guests can explore the captivating cultural and historical attractions it has to offer. A beach can be found in close proximity to the hotel, offering guests the best of both worlds. This modern hotel enjoys a contemporary style, welcoming guests into charming surroundings. The guest rooms are inviting and bright, offering modern amenities and a tranquil atmosphere in which to relax and unwind in comfort at the end of the day. Guests are invited to sample the delights of the breakfast buffet, ensuring that they are set up for a long day of exploration.

3361.description: Near to Marquês de Pombal and within walking distance of the famous Avenida da Liberdade, the SANA Rex Hotel has a privileged location, with metro, bus and taxis at the doorstep. The perfect starting point to discover Lisbon's historical and cultural landmarks, explore El Corte Inglês and the luxury shops nearby. The spacious rooms and suites offer complete comfort and, for the most part, provide stunning views that stretch over the Parque Eduardo VII. Delicious breakfast served in the historic D'El Rei restaurant. Upon request, group lunches and dinners are also served. In the Lobby Bar Lounge, guests can relax and order a drink or a light snack, or work on their laptop. The perfect hotel for those looking to stay in lisbon city centre.

3362.description: In the center of Lisbon, within walking distance of the Gulbenkian Museum, Parque Eduardo VII and El Corte Inglés, the SANA Reno is the perfect hotel for those looking to stay in lisbon city centre for business or leisure. The metro at the doorstep allows you to reach the airport in just 10 minutes and have easy access to the business areas, the historic center and the city's main attractions. Rooms are spacious and comfortable. The hotel has connecting rooms available for families. The sauna and rooftop pool are a pleasant and unexpected surprise, worth discovering. At breakfast, delicious fresh local products are served as a buffet. The comfortable Lobby Bar allows you to relax with a cocktail or snack.

3364.description: This Art Déco hotel is conveniently situated in the business district, just a few steps from the delightful park Eduardo VII, the Gulbenkian Museum and the popular El Corte Inglés Shopping Centre. The metro stations São Sebastião and Saldanha provide easy access to all areas of the city such as the historic centre with its famous attractions or the new area of Parque das Nações with the Lisbon Casino.

3366.description: Located in the heart of the charming village of Sesimbra, between the lush green of the Arrábida Natural Park and the Atlantic Ocean and only 30 minutes from Lisbon, SANA Sesimbra is over the California Beach and is the perfect hotel for romance, birthdays and anniversaries, and adventure vacations. Rooms are wide and comfortable, most offering a balcony with a breathtaking sea view. At the Espadarte Restaurant, enjoy the best flavours of Portuguese cuisine where fresh fish and seafood stand out. And for a truly unforgettable stay, the SANA Sesimbra Hotel offers a heated swimming pool at the top of the hotel, a bar with outdoor area, and the Caravela Sky Lounge has one Jacuzzi, with a fantastic panoramic view of the mountains and the sea.

3370.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Make yourself at home in one of the 64 guestrooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Tivoli Theatre - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Portal de l'Angel - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Plaça de Catalunya - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- El Corte Ingles - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- La Rambla - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Palau de la Música Catalana - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Rambla de Catalunya - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Santa Caterina Market - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- University of Barcelona - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Barcelona Cathedral - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Placa Universitat - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Casa Amatller - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Barcelona History Museum - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Casa Batllo - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Passeig de Gràcia - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi. The preferred airport for BYPILLOW Mothern is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 17. 4 km / 10. 8 mi With a stay at BYPILLOW Mothern, you'll be centrally located in Barcelona, within a 5-minute walk of Plaça de Catalunya and La Rambla. This hotel is 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from Barcelona Cathedral and 0. 3 mi (0. 4 km) from Palau de la Música Catalana.

3373.description: The AC Hotel Som by Marriott, located in the El Port area of L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, is a convenient base for exploring Barcelona. A short drive takes you to the Port de Barcelona (4 minutes) and Plaça de Catalunya (7 minutes). This upscale hotel offers a fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a communal living room. Each of the 102 guestrooms features a minibar, LCD television with satellite programming, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combination, deep soaking bathtub, and designer toiletries. Safes, desks, and irons/ironing boards are also available. Guests can enjoy the on-site coffee shop/cafe, 24-hour room service, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is served daily (fees apply). Additional amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The hotel also offers 700 square feet of meeting and conference space. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Gran Via 2 and Fira Barcelona.

3374.description: This sophisticated hotel is perfect for those who appreciate privacy and personalized service. Located on Barcelona's emblematic Paseo de Gracia, it's surrounded by luxury shops and Gaudí's most celebrated architecture, including Casa Batlló and La Pedrera. Built in 1897, The Sixtytwo beautifully blends its preserved modernist façade and interiors with designer furnishings. Guests enjoy complimentary cava and homemade chips daily at the Sixtytwo Cocktail Lounge, along with Nespresso coffees, teas, and infused waters available in the Sixtytwo Lounge. Free Wi-Fi is also provided.

3425.description: Located in the heart of Porto, this hotel offering panoramic views over the city is just steps away from Rua Santa Catarina, the main shopping zone of the city. Theatres, the old town which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the Douro River and the bars of the Rua da Galeria de Paris can be reached within a short stroll. The Trindade Metro Station providing direct access to the airport is only 250 m away.

3435.description: This elegant hotel boasts a wonderful location, in the tourist resort of Peso de Regua. The hotel lies just a few minutes' walking distance away from the centre of the city. Guests will discover a number of shopping areas, bars, entertainment venues and restaurants nearby. The sandy beach is just 12 km away. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. The hotel comprises stunningly-designed guest rooms, which provide the utmost in serenity and comfort. The hotel offers an endless range of facilities and services. Guests can indulge in the ultimate relaxation with a massage. The hotel also offers a varied entertainment programme, ensuring that there is never a dull moment. The half board supplement does not include drinks. Extra beds are only available on request.

3442.description: This attractive city hotel enjoys a central setting in the vibrant tourist district of Lamego. The hotel is located just a few minutes away from the centre of the city, where guests can explore a treasure trove of shops, restaurants, bars and entertainment venues. The hotel enjoys a contemporary design and guests will appreciate the elegantly styled, relaxing surroundings. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed and come complete with modern amenities for visitors' convenience. Guests are afforded a selection of exemplary facilities and services, which cater to their leisure and recreational needs to the highest degree of excellence. A delightful restaurant serves a host of delectable delights which are sure to tempt even the most discerning palate. Children and young people up to 12 years old can use our indoor swimming pool daily, between 9:30 am and 4:00 pm.

3443.description: This hotel is ideally located in on Batalha Square, in Oporto. This Oporto hotel is minutes from popular attractions like the University of Oporto, and the Crystal Palace Garden, the Music Hall. The area is known for Port wine, one of Portugal's most internationally appreciated products. This beautiful city is full of great monuments, and friendly people. A variety of restaurants, cafes and cocktail lounges are located in the surrounding area.

name.content: Pestana Vintage Porto-Hotel & World Heritage Site

3446.description: Situated in a historic building which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and with a modern interior design, this unique hotel is located in the heart of the city of Porto and enjoys fantastic views over the river Douro to the southern river banks and the famous bridge. A large variety of restaurants, bars, cafés and shops are in the historic centre, the international airport of Porto can be reached within 20 minutes.

3449.address: Calle De Agustin De Foxa, S/N
3449.description: The Hotel Chamartin is conveniently situated in a main business and industrial area of Madrid, right at the bustling Chamartin station. The Madrid Barajas airport, the city's Trade Fair and the cultural attractions of the city centre are all easily accessible by public transport, as Chamartin station provides direct trains as well as metro connections. Castellana Avenue can be reached in a short walk, and Santiago Bernabeu Stadium is only three kilometres away. The hotel provides 378 spacious, well-lit rooms with a handy Wi-Fi internet connection and specializes in meetings and conventions, offering various open spaces with plenty of daylight and equipped with the latest in audio-visual technology. Guests can dine in the onsite cafeteria, relax with a newspaper in the lobby, or get some work done in the business centre, all during a high-powered business trip in Madrid.

3450.description: Featuring an outdoor swimming pool, this 5-star hotel offers a rooftop bar with Porto and Douro River views. The HF Ipanema Park is 1 km from Serralves Museum and Garden. The hotel provides a variety of rooms and suites, all with cable channels and Sport TV. A mini-bar, 24-hour room service and free WiFi are also featured in all air-conditioned rooms. Guests can enjoy their meals at the Jardim d'Inverno Restaurant or have a snack at the Twin Trees snack bar. The seaside area of Foz do Douro, with its restaurants, bars and cafes, is a 5-minute drive. After a session at the gym, guests can enjoy a relaxing massage in our spa for an additional fee. Babysitting services are available. The Ribeira UNESCO World Heritage site is a 10-minute drive from the Ipanema Park, and Francisco Sá Carneiro International Airport is 12 km away. *The hotel does not allow name changes in bookings.

3455.description: This modern hotel is conveniently situated on Avenida da Boavista in Porto, the “Capital of the North”. The city centre with its large variety of shops, restaurants and bars is just a few steps away, attractions such as Jardim do Palácio de Cristal, Casa da Música, Museum of Port Wine, the old stock exchange or Porto University are within easy reach. Porto International Airport can be reached within a short drive.

3458.description:
Where Barcelona Happens

Nestled beside the Gran Teatre del Liceu, on Barcelona's iconic Las Ramblas and just moments from the legendary La Boqueria Market, Hotel España is a four-star landmark and one of the finest expressions of Catalan Modernism. Originally opened as Fonda España in 1859 and later reimagined by renowned architect Lluís Domènech i Montaner alongside celebrated artists such as Eusebi Arnau and Ramon Casas, the hotel has witnessed the evolution of Barcelona and the countless stories that have shaped its unique character. 

Today, a new vision by acclaimed interior designer Lázaro Rosa-Violán brings this remarkable heritage into the present. A thoughtful reinterpretation where Modernism meets Neo-Deco, elegance embraces intrigue, and every space invites guests to experience a different side of Barcelona—more authentic, more intimate, and vibrantly alive. 

The hotel's 82 rooms are the final chapter of this journey: peaceful sanctuaries designed for rest after a day immersed in the city. Meanwhile, signature spaces including Fonda España, Dorita Cocktail Bar, Dorita Club, and the Sky Bar extend the experience through exceptional gastronomy, crafted cocktails, music, and Barcelona's vibrant nightlife. 

Hotel España is more than a place to stay. It is a gateway into Barcelona—a way to discover it, embrace it, and, for a moment, become part of its story. 

Gastronomy with Identity

Fonda España, our signature restaurant, pays tribute to the great traditional *fonda* of Spain through a culinary concept led by renowned chef Martín Berasategui. Under the direction of Executive Chef Edu Rodas, the restaurant celebrates ingredient-led cuisine with contemporary sensibility, refined technique, and deep respect for the finest local produce.

3464.description: The Mercure Porto Centro hotel offers a perfect blend of historic and modern design, ideally located for exploring Porto's top attractions, including Ribeira, Casa da Música, Torre dos Clérigos, and the iconic Café Majestic. Relax in one of the 147 rooms with city views, or enjoy a drink at the modern Moliere bar. For events and business meetings, the hotel provides four fully equipped meeting rooms.

3465.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy Portuguese cuisine at Varanda Restaurant, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Lisbon? This hotel has 19278 square feet (1791 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available on request).

3466.description: This comfort hotel is located on Rossio Square, right by Praça dos Restauradores and close to Rossio train station in the heart of the city. The hotel offers a wonderful view of the nearby São Jorge castle complex and the old town quarter, Alfama. It is located just a few steps from public transport as well as plenty of sightseeing attractions. Lisbon airport is located 15 minutes driving distance from the property. Housed in a building dating back to 1892, each modern room is fully soundproofed and well-equipped with amenities added for guest's comfort and convenience. The hotel features a bar, a breakfast room and conference facilities. For guests' relaxation, the hotel offers massage service and library with a wide range of leisure reading in several languages.

3468.address: Rua Varandinha N-1 Praia Azul-Santa Cruz, 1
3468.description: Superbly situated overlooking the Praia Azul, this apartment hotel is located in the tourist centre of Silveria only a few meters from the town centre. Shops, cafés, boutiques, bars, restaurants as well as nightlife venues are to be found here and links to the public transport network can be reached in a few minutes on foot. Renovated in 2002, the hotel comprises a total of 38 apartments spread over 3 floors. Facilities include a bar, a reception desk with a hotel safe, an Internet terminal and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant. In addition, there are also room and laundry services to round off the facilities on offer. A garage and a car park are on offer to guests arriving by car. The welcoming apartments come with a bathroom, a hairdryer, satellite/ cable TV, a direct dial telephone, a kitchenette, an Internet connection and a separate bedroom. Further fittings include a balcony, a hire safe and central heating. In the hotel grounds there is a swimming pool and a sun terrace. Sports enthusiasts may make use of the gym. Guests may select their breakfast from a buffet. Guests are also able to book half-board stays.

3500.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Enjoy recreational amenities including two outdoor swimming pools, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also offers complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy a meal at Enoteca Paco Pérez, one of the hotel's six restaurants, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (8:30 AM to 11:00 AM) for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in/check-out, conference space, and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself at home in one of the 483 individually decorated guestrooms, each featuring a minibar and an LCD television. Complimentary wired internet access is also available. Private bathrooms offer separate bathtubs and showers, deep soaking bathtubs, and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. The hotel is conveniently located near Casino Barcelona, Port Olimpic, and several beaches, including Nova Icaria, Barceloneta, Bogatell, and San Sebastian. The preferred airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN).

3503.description: This charming city hotel, renovated in 2002, is conveniently located near Plaza Catalunya and the renowned Las Ramblas promenade, just a short walk from the Plaza Universidad, the cathedral, and the Gothic Quarter. A variety of shops, bars, nightclubs, and restaurants are within easy walking distance, and public transport is readily accessible. The hotel offers 57 well-equipped rooms across five floors, each featuring an en-suite bathroom and a king-size bed. Guests can also enjoy a pleasant garden and make use of the TV room, car park, garage, and laundry service.

3517.description: The Praga Hotel is ideally located ten minutes from Atocha train station and Madrid's cultural center, home to the Prado, Reina Sofia, Thyssen-Bornemisza museums, and Caixa Forum. Just a short walk from the Vicente Calderón Stadium and Caja Mágica sports complex, it's a perfect choice for your Madrid stay. Easily accessible from the M-30 and M-40 motorways and well-connected by public transport, with the number 23 bus stopping right outside the hotel, providing direct access to Plaza Mayor. Marques de Vadillo metro station (Line 5) is also nearby, whisking you away to the city's shopping and leisure district, Gran Via. The hotel's 420 guest rooms feature air conditioning, heating, interactive satellite TV with pay-per-view channels, direct-dial telephones, safes, minibars, Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms. Guests can also enjoy the hotel's restaurant, cafeteria, and nine fully equipped meeting rooms with audiovisual facilities, accommodating up to 380 people. Private parking is available.

3549.description: This heritage hotel lies at the heart of the wonderful city of Madrid. Guests will find themselves just a few steps away from the Gran Via and the King's Palace. The hotel is located in close proximity to a wide range of shops, restaurants, bars and entertainment venues. The hotel offers the perfect setting from which to explore the city's main attractions. This wonderful hotel occupies a classical building, which dates back to the early 20th century. The hotel has beautifully retained the glory of a bygone era in its design, blending it effortlessly with contemporary elements. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, bathing visitors in peace and serenity. The hotel features a wide range of excellent facilities, meeting the needs of every type of traveller.

3550.description: This upscale hotel is situated amidst the bustle and energy of the intriguing city of Madrid. It is conveniently situated close to a wide range of attractions in the city, including the Plaza Mayor. The nearest train station, Tirso de Molina, offers ease of access to other areas to be explored. Guests can enjoy many shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities nearby. The hotel provides a wonderful restaurant, where guests can savour the delights of local and international cuisines. The hotel also features a conference room, for those travelling for work purposes. Guests are assured of a stay rich in comfort, enjoyment and relaxation at this wonderful hotel. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a deposit.

3554.description: This hotel sits close to La Vega shopping centre, in Madrid. It is located in close proximity to the many attractions that this vibrant city has to offer. Bernabeu stadium is a 10 minutes' drive away. Barajas International Airport is just a short distance from the hotel. This wonderful property appeals to business and leisure travellers alike. The guest rooms are modern in style, featuring neutral tones. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

3566.description: This hotel is located in a privileged area of Lisbon's city centre, near Marquês de Pombal, Park Edward VII and the Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation. The hotel is only 4 metro stations from the historic city centre of Baixa-Chiado, Bairro Alto, Rossio and Restauradores. The hotel is also close Avenida da Liberdade and the El Corte Ingles department store. The São Sebastião metro station (Blue and Red lines) is opposite the hotel.

3588.description: Zenit Conde de Orgaz is located in Madrid, in the residential area of Plaza del Liceo. It is next to the IFEMA Fairground. It is a Madrid hotel that is well connected with the Adolfo Suárez Madrid-BarajasAirport (5 km) and the city centre (6. 5 km). With its excellent location in Madrid, it will suit trips that are both for business and for pleasure. The Hotel has 89 modern and comfortable rooms, all with a contemporary design. All of them are fully equipped and offer all of the services and facilities that the customer requires for a comfortable and satisfactory stay. The hotel also has a private car park an gym for its guests.

3599.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center, terrace, and garden at this Barcelona hotel. Stay connected with complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and benefit from tour/ticket assistance. Dine at the on-site restaurant, with 24-hour room service also available, and unwind at the bar/lounge. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies). Each of the 66 guestrooms provides MP3 docking stations, minibars, and plasma televisions with satellite programming. Bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and bidets. 3600.description: This hotel enjoys a peaceful location near Madrid Barajas Airport and the IFEMA convention center. Partially renovated in 2017, this hotel provides excellent personal service and fantastic facilities in a prime location. The air-conditioned building features 14 conference rooms, a restaurant, and a pool bar. Rooms include private bathrooms, direct-dial telephones, Wi-Fi, satellite TV, minibars, air conditioning, central heating, and safes. Guests can also enjoy a fantastic seasonal outdoor swimming pool, typically open from June to September (weather permitting).

3613.description: The 4-star Motel One Madrid-Plaza de España is located in the heart of Madrid, close to Plaza de España and Gran Vía, near the Royal Palace and La Almudena Cathedral. 3677.description: ÓLEO Cancún Playa is a 4-star resort, with an all-inclusive plan that includes a handmade gastronomic experience offering two specialty restaurants, an international buffet and a snack bar, two bars and premium drinks. The welcoming rooms each come with a bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, a TV, individually regulated air conditioning, central heating and a hire safe. 3800.description: This welcoming hotel is situated in Esposende, next to the Foz do Rio Cávado. The airport is about 45 km away and Praia Suave Mar is roughly 1 km from the hotel. The beach is easily reached along the slip road, which runs directly beside the hotel. Links to the public transport network lie about 1 km away. Bars, taverns and the nearest nightclub are to be found within 5 km of the hotel. Renovated in 2001, this hotel comprises a total of 84 rooms spread over 3 floors, of which 10 are suites. Facilities within the air-conditioned building include a foyer with 24-hour reception desk, a safe and lifts. Furthermore, there is a bar, a games room, a TV room and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with highchairs for infants. Moreover, there is a conference room and a public Internet terminal, ideal for business guests. Those arriving by car may take advantage of the car park or garage facilities. The laundry service rounds off the diverse range of offers. The playground for younger guests and bicycle rental in the hotel grounds round up the facilities on offer. The comfortable rooms feature a bathroom, a direct dial telephone, satellite cable TV, a radio, an Internet connection, a minibar, air conditioning (centrally regulated), carpeting, central heating, a hire safe and a balcony or terrace. There is a swimming pool available for use in the hotel grounds with children's pools, as well as sun loungers and parasols. There is also an entertainment programme with live music twice a week, to provide some variation for guests.

3810.description: Amazónia Jamor Hotel is a 4-star hotel located directly in front Lisbon’s National Stadium. It features indoor and outdoor pools, and a tennis court. Free parking is available. The air-conditioned rooms at the Amazónia Jamor Hotel have modern amenities, including cable TV and a spacious work desk. Some rooms have been renovated. The hotel is located 25 minutes from Lisbon Airport by car.

3817.description: Right in the heart of Parque das Nações, the Hotel Tryp Lisboa Oriente was recently refurbished with “Expo 98” and the Oceans as its background. At the entrance, visitors are met by a series of ocean aquariums together with a canvas, in the reception area, representing the great architectural landmarks. The rooms emphasise elegance, modernity and comfort, and lend a view of the heart of the city. They have free Wi-Fi access, a Television with satellite channels, a lounge area, telephone with a direct line and air conditioning. The “Bistrô&Tapas” Restaurant, which extends out to a pleasant esplanade, displays the most iconic symbol of Expo 98: panels which reflect the universality of the event and convey the popular Exhibition passport. The restaurant serves international breakfasts and offers an à la carte service and a dish of the day, based on the “Bistrô&Tapas” concept.

3818.description: Combining fin de siècle charm of days past with modern design, this city hotel is conveniently situated in a pedestrian zone in the historic centre of Porto. Famous attractions such as Porto Cathedral, Sandeman Cellars, Museum of Port Wine and Casa da Musica are within easy reach. The nearest metro station is Bolhão, São Bento Train Station is only 500 m away. The international airport can be easily reached.

3847.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a spa tub, a sauna, and a fitness center. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. 3850.description: With its privileged location close to the Cathedral of Braga and the well-known Bom Jesus do Monte Sanctuary, Mercure Braga Centro is perfect for leisure or business trips. Take a stroll through the Retiro Park, which is less than 2km away, or hop on the metro at Avenida America and Nuñez de Balboa stations and visit the rest of Madrid's attractions. The 111 rooms at NH Madrid Balboa are light and airy and feature hardwood floors. 13 of the rooms come with a private terrace with views over Madrid. A fresh breakfast buffet is served daily and offers a variety of sweet and savory dishes, including made-to-order eggs on weekdays and churros with chocolate - a local favorite. You can also catch up on the latest news by reading the newspapers on one of the comfy sofas. On Sundays, sleep in and enjoy breakfast until noon and the complimentary late check-out. The hotel has a gym for fitness fanatics, outdoor parking, and free Wi-Fi, as well as a restaurant, Saona, offering delicious dishes with a creative touch.

3879.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Hotel Gran Versalles, located in the heart of Madrid. The 137 guestrooms feature Smart TVs with satellite programming, minibars, private bathrooms with bidets, and laptop-compatible safes. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Free bicycle hire is available at reception, making it easy to discover the historic centre of Madrid at your own pace. With its unbeatable location near Gran Vía, contemporary design and attentive service, Petit Palace Cliper Gran Vía is the perfect base for a city break in the Spanish capital.

3969.description: Adhara Express is conveniently located in Cancun Downtown with exceptional accessibility to Corporations, entertainment areas, beaches, malls, discotheques, bars, pharmacies, banks and local hospitals. This fully renovated 100% non-smoking facility offers services for Corporate and Leisure Travelers with Restaurant, Bar, Lounge, Gym, Concierge, Executive Floor, Outdoor Pool and Travel Agent Desk. The Business Center offers complimentary use of computers, copy and fax, secretarial service and Coffee Breaks. For your convenience, High Speed Wireless Internet Access service is available in all public areas. If you like a quick break on the Beach, our complimentary Shuttle Service will take you in and out from the Facility in a Breeze. Welcome to Adhara Express Cancun City. Extra Person Charge is 150 Pesos.

3988.description: This large and wonderful hotel boasts an excellent location, just a few minutes from the Atocha Station and in the proximity of the cultural area of Madrid's most important and famous museums. After exploring the city, guests might rest in the luminous and spacious rooms that have been designed with guests' comfort in mind and are equipped with all kinds of amenities to ensure a pleasant stay. For those who are seeking a little bit more of luxury, the hotel features some suites with a relaxing hot tub. The contemporary restaurant offers a trendy Mediterranean menu which will delight all palates. Guests can also enjoy a cup of coffee or delicious meals on its terrace which is open all-year-round. For business travellers, the hotel offers several meeting rooms with the latest technology to cover all needs, as well as different events rooms and a beautiful indoor garden for special celebrations.

name.content: Wyndham Grand Cancun All Inclusive Resort & Villas

3999.description: Experience a unique family vacation at the upscale Wyndham Grand Cancun All Inclusive Resort and Villas. Located in Cancun, this resort offers a paradise getaway for families and couples alike. Choose from 343 thoughtfully appointed rooms and villas with lagoon or ocean views, accommodating up to six guests. Enjoy six restaurants and bars, including a pool bar and an adults-only Jacuzzi bar. Additional amenities include an outdoor pool, spa, fitness center, kids' club, and various activities.

name.content: Grand Fiesta Americana Coral Beach All Inclusive

4000.address: Blvd. Kukulcán Km. 9.5 Cancún, Q. Roo (Hotel Zone)
4000.description: The luxury Grand Fiesta Americana Coral Beach Cancún- All Inclusive is located on a long stretch of beach on the Mexican Caribbean coast, ideal for sunbathing and swimming. The hotel lies in the tourist centre of Cancún, just a few minutes' walk from the town centre where guests will discover shops, boutiques, cafés, bars, restaurants and nightlife venues. All rooms have amazing sea views.

4001.description: This charming hotel boasts a prime location in Cancun's main tourist area, providing easy access to marinas, business centers, and the beautiful Playa Linda. Cancun International Airport is a 30-minute drive away, while the city center and Pok-Ta-Pok golf course are easily accessible by bus. The hotel offers various cozy accommodations, each featuring a private balcony or terrace with stunning Caribbean Sea views and air conditioning. Guests can enjoy an array of amenities, including live evening entertainment and a swimming pool with a swim-up bar. A New Year's Eve event is available for an additional fee (adults: $50 USD, children 7-12: $25 USD, children 0-6: free). This charge is applied directly at the hotel and attendance is optional.

4013.description: Welcome to the Grand Hyatt Barcelona, a prestigious 5-star hotel located on the renowned Avenida Diagonal, in the heart of Barcelona's most exclusive district, Alta Barcelona!Discover the utmost luxury and essence of Barcelona in one place, where the Grand Hyatt has chosen to make its home. Sophisticated design and an unparalleled gastronomic experience come together in a vibrant and exclusive atmosphere, making it the destination of choice. With 465 rooms, including 49 suites and a Penthouse, as well as 5 dining spaces, a Wellness Spa area, an outdoor pool, and 22 meeting spaces, including ZUU, our nightclub for private events, the Grand Hyatt Barcelona offers the luxurious and unforgettable getaway you seek. Experience culinary authenticity in our 5 distinctive restaurants, from the cozy atmosphere of Sofia Bar Tapas to the exquisite creations awaiting you at Maymanta and Leña by Dani García (coming soon).

4015.description: This complex is situated in the tourist resort of Costa Alanya, only a few minutes' walk from the beach and the centre of Konakli. Guests will find restaurants, shops, bars and nightspots here. It is some 125 km to the airport. The hotel, with its total of 158 rooms offers guests a high standard of service and amenities. It comprises a lobby area with 24-hour reception, a safe, a currency exchange facility, a cloakroom, lift access, a café, a newspaper stand, a restaurant and a TV lounge. A laundry service (for an additional fee), bicycle rental, a garage and a playground are also on hand. All rooms come with an en suite bath/ shower, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, a satellite/ cable TV, a radio, a safe, a double bed and either a balcony or a terrace. The air conditioning is individually adjustable. In the outdoor complex there is a swimming pool with a children's area as well as a poolside snack bar and sun loungers and parasols laid out ready for use. Furthermore, guests may try their hand at volleyball, table tennis, billiards (charges apply), or mountain biking or relax with a massage (for an additional fee). This hotel offers all-inclusive stays. Guests may select their breakfast, midday and evening meals from varied buffets. Drinks are included with all meals.

4016.description: The Botanik Hotel, nestled within a unique historical area, boasts 90, 000 m² of grounds and 617 rooms. Located 90 km from Antalya Airport, 30 km from Side, and 32 km from Alanya, this 5-star hotel, established in 1988, features a three-story main building and three annexes. Guests can enjoy multiple facilities, including three outdoor pools (one large), three children's pools, a pool with eight water slides, and a complimentary Luna Park with limited hours of operation. Several bars offer refreshments, from the Lobby Bar and Pool Bar to the Beach Bar and Vitamin Bar, serving freshly squeezed fruit juices. Families with infants can borrow strollers from reception (deposit required).

4017.description:
The hotel is situated on a lovely coast road, surrounded by impressive gardens in the resort of Alanya, 50 m from Kekybat Beach and 50 m from the city centre. Here there are shops, boutiques, cafes, bars, restaurants and thriving nightlife. The beach is accessible via a pedestrian underpass and a minibus leaves from just outside the hotel. Alanya Airport is just some 120 km away.

This attractive hotel was renovated in 2002. The hotel consists of 5 floors and 96 double rooms in total. The facilities include a spacious lobby with a lift, a 24-hour reception, a safe, a currency exchange facility, a games room, a TV room and Internet access. There is also a restaurant. Further services include laundry and room services (charges apply) as well as medical assistance. Outside, the hotel offers a playground with a kids' club, as well as parking facilities.

All of the rooms are tastefully furnished and come fitted with individually adjustable air conditioning, an en suite bathroom and a hairdryer. They additionally come equipped with a television, a safe and a balcony.

A swimming pool with a children's paddling area and poolside bar is located in the hotel grounds. The hotel offers its guests table tennis, a gym and a pool table (charges apply).

Guests are offered breakfast and dinner in the form of a buffet.

4018.description: Located along the sandy shore of Belek, approximately 35km from Antalya airport, this hotel complex is a water paradise featuring connected pools with hot tub, waterslides and waterfalls. The hotel consists of a main building and a private villa section. The stylish accommodations feature a bright design with vibrant colours, and many rooms come with panoramic sea views. Those travelling on business might make use of the separate convention centre, and children will delight in the kids' club, children's disco and onsite bowling facility. The main buffet-style restaurant, five a la carte restaurants offering Turkish, Italian, French and pan-Asian dishes, and eight bars amount to a 24-hour food and beverage service, and the hotel organizes nightly entertainment for both children and adults with music and dancing, all for a wonderful, fun-filled family holiday.

4019.description: Nestled between a picturesque palm beach and vibrant floral landscapes, our 5-star hotel offers an exceptional holiday experience. Located 90 km from Antalya Airport and 32 km from both Alanya and Side, our property features a six-story main building with 416 standard rooms and a seven-story annex with 79 family rooms and 3 standard rooms. Four panoramic elevators service the main building and three elevators are available in the annex. The lobby level houses the reception, a piano bar with live music, the Delphin Cafe & Bar, and various shops. The hotel boasts a total area of 50, 000 m² and was originally constructed in 2001.

4020.description: This exclusive beach complex comprises a 5-storey main building, as well as a number of 2 to 3-storey annexe blocks, and offers a total of 454 rooms. Guests are welcomed in a stylish lobby where they will find a game and TV room, a nightclub and 5 air-conditioned restaurants with highchairs for children. All rooms are tastefully designed and include an en-suite bathroom and a balcony or terrace. A swimming pool with children's area, waterfalls and waterslides is set in the garden, and a sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols is at guest's disposal. The complex additionally offers a SPA and health centre with a hot tub and massage service, for those who would like to relax.

4021.address: Calle De Juan Ignacio Luca De Tena, 36
4021.description: Located in Madrid's San Blas-Canillejas district, the upscale Meliá Avenida América is within a 10-minute drive of Santiago Bernabéu Stadium and El Retiro Park. This hotel offers 308 guestrooms featuring minibars, flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy a workout in the 24-hour fitness center, relax in the communal living room, or take advantage of concierge services. Dining options include two restaurants, one featuring Mediterranean cuisine, a coffee shop/café, and room service. A buffet breakfast is available (fee applies). The hotel also boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, totaling 53, 820 square feet. A complimentary airport shuttle is available upon request.

4022.description:
Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy body treatments and facials. After dipping into one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional features at this property include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Enjoy international cuisine at La Noblesse, one of the property's 6 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 4 bars/lounges.

Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Event facilities at this property consist of conference space and meeting rooms.

4023.description: With a backdrop of the Taurus Mountains and located on extensive land, the marvellous hotel is beautifully situated directly on the beach of Kiriş, about 5 km away from the popular holiday resort of Kemer with its numerous shopping possibilities. The hotel with its distinctive architecture is surrounded by lush green gardens with orange trees and boasts a fantastic pool with stunning landscape. Families with children will love the children's club and the playgrounds, while older guests will appreciate the diverse sports facilities – especially during winter, the hotel is a favourite amongst professional sports teams for their training camps. There is a fully-equipped fitness centre and a first-class spa and wellness area. Guests may choose between 7 exquisite restaurants and 6 cosy bars to wrap up the day. The hotel is a great choice for couples, families with children and especially active guests. Between January 11, 2019 - March 15, 2019, a renovation will be carried out in our indoor pool. Service will continue to be served in our other indoor pool on the specified dates.

4024.description: Stop at Titanic Deluxe Lara Hotel to discover the wonders of Antalya. The hotel offers a wide range of amenities and perks to ensure you have a great time. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, daily housekeeping, fax machine, gift/souvenir shop, photocopying are on the list of things guests can enjoy. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer television LCD/plasma screen, carpeting, slippers, sofa, closet to ensure a restful night. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include badminton court, bowling alley, canoe, dart board, watersports equipment rentals. Convenience and comfort makes Titanic Deluxe Lara Hotel the perfect choice for your stay in Antalya. ****************** KIDS CLUB ********************Baby Room (1-3 Age)Junior (4-7 Age)Maxi (8-12 Age)Teenage Club (13-17 Age)17 Hours of Service Each Day(09:00 - 02:00)Child Development Specialised Tutors for BabiesAged 1-3 YearsChanging RoomBreastfeeding RoomSleeping RoomSpecial Outdoor Playground for BabiesFree Baby DiapersHipp Baby FormulaBaby Spa-Certified Therapists with Baby Spa Training-2 Heated Jacuzzi Specially Designed for Babies-2 Pieces Baby Massage Bed

4025.description:
Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 3 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional features at this property include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Enjoy international cuisine at Steakhouse Restaurant, one of the property's 6 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Need to unwind? Take a break at the bar/lounge, the beach bar, or the poolside bar for a tasty beverage.
