Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff.

4046.description: Located in El Prat de Llobregat, the Hotel Barcelona Aeropuerto, Affiliated by Meliá, is a short drive from both Fira Barcelona and the Port of Barcelona. This upscale hotel offers a fitness center, a terrace with scenic views, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. A shuttle service is available to nearby destinations (surcharge). The 410 air-conditioned guest rooms feature private bathrooms, designer toiletries, and convenient amenities such as in-room safes and work desks. Guests can dine at the hotel's Mediterraneo Restaurant, enjoy room service (limited hours), or relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel also provides complimentary wired internet access, a business center, express check-in, and a scheduled airport shuttle.

4049.description:
Hotel Mediodía is located directly opposite Atocha Station, with immediate access to the AVE high‑speed train, metro, commuter trains and the main transport connections in Madrid. 
The hotel is next to the Art Triangle, within walking distance of the Reina Sofía Museum, the Prado Museum, the Thyssen‑Bornemisza Museum, the Paseo del Prado, Retiro Park and the Botanical Garden. 
The property occupies a historic 1914 building in Plaza del Emperador Carlos V and preserves original features such as stained‑glass windows and a classical main staircase. 
Rooms include air conditioning, free Wi‑Fi, TV and a private bathroom. The hotel offers a 24‑hour reception. 
It is a practical option for guests seeking accommodation opposite Atocha, close to Madrid’s main museums and well connected to the rest of the city.

4050.description: This cozy, elegant hotel is ideally located in the Eixample district, allowing you to explore Barcelona on foot. The rooftop terrace offers stunning views of the Sagrada Familia, just steps away. Other attractions, including Passeig de Gràcia, Gaudí's Casa Batlló, Arc de Triomf, Plaça de Catalunya, Las Ramblas, and the Gothic Quarter, are within a short stroll. A metro station is a mere two-minute walk, and Barcelona El Prat Airport is 16 km away. The hotel's 84 modern guest rooms feature air conditioning, heating, flat-screen TVs with international channels, safes, desks, telephones, free Wi-Fi, minibars, and bathrooms with baths or showers, hairdryers, and toiletries. A meeting room and business area are also available for exclusive business needs.

4052.description: With a stay at Hotel Travel Park Lisboa, you'll be centrally located in Lisbon, within a 5-minute drive of Rossio Square and Avenida da Liberdade. This hotel is 6 mi (9. 6 km) from Belém Tower and 1. 5 mi (2. 4 km) from Marquis of Pombal Square. Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and a television in a common area. Make yourself at home in one of the 61 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include desks and blackout drapes/curtains, and housekeeping is provided daily. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Avenida Almirante Reis - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Hospital Dona Estefania - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Torel Garden - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Martim Moniz Square - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Hospital Sao Jose - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Rua das Portas de Santo Antão - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Avenida da Liberdade - 1. 5 km / 0.

4072.description: This upscale hotel is located in the city centre of Terrassa. The hotel lies just 18 km away from Barcelona. Guests will find themselves within easy driving distance of a wide range of cultural, historical and artistic attractions. A wide range of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can also be found nearby. This hotel enjoys an attractive design, welcoming visitors with warm hospitality and friendly service. The guest rooms offer a haven of peace and serenity, in which to completely relax and unwind. Guests can enjoy an energetic workout in the gym, followed by relaxation amidst the tranquillity of the surroundings. The hotel offers a conference room, as well as a restaurant and a bar.

4073.description: Located in Terrassa, just 20 minutes from Barcelona, 30 minutes from the Montserrat rack railway, and 32 minutes from El Prat Airport, this hotel offers modern, air-conditioned rooms with parquet floors, wooden furniture, and work desks. Amenities include Wi-Fi, a minibar, room service, and a large private bathroom with a bathtub and hairdryer. Executive, family, and accessible rooms are available. The hotel's restaurant serves a daily menu, including vegetarian and seasonal options, from 1 p. m. to 11 p. m. A buffet breakfast is available from 7 a. m. to 10:30 a. m. in the Tibidabo Room, which boasts terraces with panoramic city views. Free parking is available in front of the hotel, and private garage parking is also offered for a nightly fee. Vallparadis Park, ideal for nature walks, is a five-minute walk away, and the Parc Valles leisure center, with its shops, restaurants and entertainment options, is just 500 meters from the hotel. Guests also enjoy discounted access to a nearby gym.

4077.description: This elegant hotel lies just across the road from the beach in the tourist village of Caminha. Many shops, boutiques, cafés, bars, restaurants and lively nighttime venues are to be found in the near vicinity. Renovated in 2010, this 5-storey hotel comprises 113 rooms. Facilities include a reception desk and SPA, in addition to a bar, an air-conditioned restaurant and a public Internet terminal. Those arriving by car may make use of the car park and garage facilities, room and laundry services may be taken advantage of. The tastefully decorated rooms each come with an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, Internet access, a minibar/ fridge, air conditioning (centrally controlled), central heating, a balcony or terrace and a hire safe. Leisure options include an indoor pool, and outdoor pool, a sauna, tennis courts and an in-house gym. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample buffet.

4088.description: The Westin Madrid Cuzco offers a comfortable stay with convenient access to Madrid's Paseo de la Castellana and the Azca Financial District. This hotel features a fitness center, restaurant, snack bar/deli, and bar/lounge. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and daily buffet breakfast (fee applies). The 318 guest rooms are equipped with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and private bathrooms. For business travelers, the hotel offers a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and ample meeting space. Self-parking is available (subject to charges).

4092.description: This classic city hotel enjoys a fabulous setting in the heart of Barcelona, just a stone's throw from the famous La Boqueria market and a three-minute walk from the city's most celebrated promenade, La Rambla.   Liceu metro station is 250 metres away, providing easy access to other parts of the city such as Montjuic and Gaudís stunning Parc Guell.   Set in a building dating back to 1866, this cosy, family-run hotel combines modern interior design with beautiful historic details. It features a rooftop terrace with a seasonal swimming pool, enjoying great views over the city and a 24-hour reception for added convenience.   Guests might also make use of the Wi-Fi internet connection offered throughout the hotel and wake up to a daily breakfast with both hot and cold options.

4094.description: The family-run Best Western Plus Hotel Alfa Aeropuerto in Barcelona welcomes you. Whether traveling for business or leisure, our friendly staff ensures a relaxed and comfortable stay. Minutes from Barcelona-El Prat Airport, the cruise pier, the international exhibition center, and the city center, our convenient location offers easy access to public transport. Choose from 100 well-appointed rooms, ranging from spacious suites to cozy singles and comfortable doubles and triples. Each features a modern bathroom with a rainfall shower, free Wi-Fi, tea and coffee making facilities, and satellite TV. Savor delicious traditional Catalan and Mediterranean cuisine at our Gran Mercat Restaurant or relax with a pre-dinner drink in our comfortable Mercabar lounge and cafe. Before heading to the airport, enjoy our affordable buffet or express breakfast options. Guests can also take advantage of our newly refurbished meeting rooms, complimentary airport shuttle, on-site parking, a well-equipped gym with an indoor pool and sauna. Our aim is to make your pre or post-flight, or pre/post-cruise experience truly exceptional. Complimentary shuttle service from 5:00–10:15 and 18:15–00:30

4096.description: The NH Madrid Paseo de la Habana hotel is set in a quiet area that provides easy access to Madrid's business and leisure attractions. The Paseo de la Castellana business district is just steps away, while the famous Santiago Bernabéu Stadium is also close-by. To shop for Spain's best brands head to the Moda Shopping mall and El Corte Inglés store near the hotel. Getting to the center of the city is easy from Colombia metro station. The rooms at NH Madrid Paseo de la Habana have been designed with your comfort in mind, with neutral color schemes, comfy mattresses, and pillow menus. You will also feel at home with a flat screen TV and free Wi-Fi. For a little more luxury, stay in one of our Superior rooms and enjoy freshly brewed coffee from the Nespresso machines. Breakfast will be the highlight of your morning, with the varied spread of excellent fresh products and local favorites like churros with hot chocolate. The NH Madrid Paseo de la Habana Restaurant serves up delectable Mediterranean dishes and tapas, using only the freshest local ingredients. In the afternoons, you can catch up on some sports at our lobby El Malecon Bar, while sipping local wine.

4144.description: This hotel is located in the centre of Lisbon, a short walk from Eduardo VII Park and Marquês de Pombal Square. Guests can walk down Avenida da Liberdade and visit the many shops and restaurants. The hotel is also a 10-minute walk from the Anjos and Picoas Metro Stations. Countless shops and restaurants are to be found in the vicinity. Bars and nightclubs are close to the hotel.

4165.description: Located in Lisbon's main square, Praça Dom Pedro IV, this boutique hotel is a perfect starting point for exploring the city. Situated in the historic center, guests are close to traditional districts like Chiado and São Jorge Castle. The hotel offers contemporary accommodation across four distinct styles: urban, tribe, zen, and pop. Each tastefully decorated room features modern amenities, including LCD TVs, and coffee makers. The on-site restaurant serves traditional Portuguese cuisine with a modern twist.

4166.description: The 3-star Flag Hotel Braga offers a strategic location near Braga, ideal for exploring the city and its surroundings. Situated near the A3 motorway exit, 400 meters from Ferreiros train station, and 40 km from Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport, the hotel provides easy access to key transportation hubs. The historic city center and Braga Business Centre are just 2. 5 km away. The hotel's 75 air-conditioned rooms feature simple, brightly decorated interiors, each equipped with a private bathroom (including a hairdryer), telephone, TV, and complimentary Wi-Fi. A daily buffet breakfast is available in the dining area, and the bar offers snacks and drinks throughout the day. The hotel also provides free Wi-Fi, a 24-hour reception, and a 52m² meeting room suitable for groups, events, and banquets. Guests can easily reach historical attractions such as the Cathedral and the Biscainhos Museum, both within 3km of the hotel. Other key attractions, including the Bom Jesus do Monte Sanctuary and São Vicente Church, are a short drive away. For nature lovers, the Peneda-Gerês National Park is an hour's drive from the hotel.

4171.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include a television in a common area and a reception hall. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at St Gallen Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 3 meeting rooms available for events. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 91 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

4172.description: This heritage hotel enjoys a prime setting in Barcelona, lying in Rambla Cataluña. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from Paseo de Gracia and a host of shops and entertainment venues. This hotel makes up part of the iconic La Casa Evarist Juncosa, boasting a long, rich history, dating back to the early 20th century. This wonderful hotel welcomes guests into a world where contemporary style meets that of a bygone era. This charming hotel comprises beautifully-appointed guest rooms, which are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are invited to enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings. Those travelling for work purposes are sure to appreciate the conference and business facilities that the hotel has to offer.

4173.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as a seasonal outdoor pool and complimentary wireless Internet access. This Barcelona hotel also features concierge services, wedding services, and a banquet hall. Savor Mediterranean cuisine at El Raco del Montblanc, the onsite restaurant with a bar/lounge, or enjoy room service (during limited hours). Relax with your favorite drink at the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily, from 7 AM to 11 AM, for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event? The hotel offers 3, 552 square feet (330 square meters) of space, including a conference center and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself at home in one of the 157 air-conditioned guest rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming. Complimentary wireless Internet access is provided. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers offer complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Nearby attractions include Palau de la Música Catalana (0. 2 mi), El Corte Ingles (0. 2 mi), and Tivoli Theatre (0. 2 mi).

4174.description: Centrally located in Barcelona, Hotel HCC Taber is a short walk from Passeig de Gràcia and Casa Batlló. This eco-certified hotel offers 92 guestrooms with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy amenities like a snack bar, room service (limited hours), bar/lounge, and buffet breakfast (fee applies). Business services, dry cleaning/laundry, and meeting rooms are also available. Nearby attractions include Plaça de Catalunya and La Rambla, both within a 0. 5-mile radius. Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) is 10. 9 miles away.

4175.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting at the heart of Barcelona's tourist centre. The hotel is located on Avenida Diagonal, lying within easy access of a host of shops, restaurants, bars and attractions such as Plaza Catalunya , Sagrada Familia and Vincci Mae. Guests will appreciate the central location and ease of access to the main points of interest of this mesmerising city. This delightful hotel enjoys an attractive architectural design, blending effortlessly with its historical and artistic surroundings. The hotel features a wide range of exemplary facilities and services, such as free Wi-Fi, roof terrace with city views and Plunge Pool; the spacious modern rooms sumptuously designed; featuring refreshing tones and a relaxing ambience, they include refrigerator, Satellite TV and individual air conditioning. You can discover the excitement of ensuring that each traveller enjoys a memorable stay.

4194.description: Close to Arrábida Bridge, this city hotel is located in the city centre. There is a plethora of shops, bars, restaurants and nightclubs and public transportation links within walking distance. The river is a few minutes away, as well as Oporto's downtown and the Serralves Foundation. A few steps away are Casa da Música, Pavilhão Rosa Mota and its surrounding gardens. In the evening guests will find excellent restaurant offers and an exciting nightlife.

4198.description: This upscale hotel is situated in the city centre of Setubal. The hotel lies just 15 km away from the Arrabida Hills. The nearest station, Setubal, offers ease of access to other areas to be explored. The hotel comprises elegantly-styled guest rooms, which offer a calm environment, perfectly conducive to work and rest. The hotel also features a bar and a coffee shops. A conference room is available for the convenience of those travelling for work purposes. This hotel offers a prime choice for business and leisure travellers alike.

4200.description: This comfortable city hotel is situated at the pulsating heart of Madrid's tourist centre. The hotel is located just a few minutes' walking distance away from the city centre, where boundless shops, entertainment venues and restaurants abound. The airport lies a mere 15 minutes away via the public transport system. This hotel enjoys an attractive contemporary style, greeting guests with the promise of warm hospitality, excellent service and a relaxing environment. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, enjoying soothing tones which create a tranquil atmosphere in which to relax and unwind in comfort. Guests can enjoy a delicious meal in the attractive surroundings of the restaurant, where delectable delights are the order of the day.

4201.city: SAN ANDRES DE LA BARCA, Barcelona
4201.description: This hotel is situated at the heart of San Anderu de la Barca in Barcelona. Guests will find themselves just a few metres away from a wide range of shopping opportunities, dining options, bars and nightclubs. This delightful hotel lies just a few steps away from links to the public transport network. The beach is situated just 15 km away from the hotel. This delightful hotel greets guests with warm hospitality and charm, welcoming them into the relaxing surroundings of the interior. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated, featuring refreshing tones and a relaxing ambience. The rooms offer a haven in which to completely relax at the end of the day. Guests are sure to be impressed by the wide range of facilities that the hotel has to offer. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a deposit.

4208.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include wedding services, a banquet hall, and a vending machine. Satisfy your appetite at Restaurante Don José, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 9:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and 5 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 68 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Parque Europa - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Oasiz Shopping Center - 2. 3 km / 1. 5 mi- Parque Corredor Shopping Center - 3. 5 km / 2. 2 mi- La Garena Plaza Shopping Center - 7. 4 km / 4. 6 mi- Aquopolis - 8. 4 km / 5. 2 mi- Puerta de Madrid - 9. 2 km / 5. 7 mi- Antiguo Hospital de Santa María la Rica - 10. 5 km / 6. 5 mi- Monastery of San Bernardo - 10. 8 km / 6. 7 mi- Cathedral of Justo Gallego Martinez - 10. 9 km / 6. 8 mi- Convent of Las Clarisas de San Diego - 11 km / 6. 8 mi- Colegio de San Ildefonso - 12. 1 km / 7. 5 mi- University of Alcala - 12. 2 km / 7. 6 mi- Plaza Cervantes - 12. 2 km / 7. 6 mi- Cervantes Birthplace Museum - 12. 4 km / 7. 7 mi- El Capricho Park - 13. 9 km / 8. 6 mi. The preferred airport for Hotel Aida is Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD) - 16. 9 km / 10.

4222.description: Mercure Madrid Centro Hotel is in an exceptional location in the center of Madrid, just 5 minutes walk from Prado museum, Thyssen-Bornemisza and Reina Sofia, the Madrid AVE Atocha station is also nearby. It's a 20-minute drive from the airport. This hotel has modern, comfortable and functional rooms with free Wi-Fi. It's ideal to come for work, with 3 meeting rooms and a photocopying service.

4224.description: This upscale hotel enjoys a prime location in the heart of Barcelona's tourist district, just 5 km from the city center. Guests will appreciate the proximity to a variety of shops, restaurants, bars, and nightclubs. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, this sophisticated hotel offers warm hospitality, meticulous attention to detail, and impeccable service. The guest rooms provide functional space and a relaxing ambiance perfect for work or rest. Guests are invited to take advantage of the hotel's wide range of exemplary facilities.

4225.description: The hotel is located in the tourist center of Madrid, between Arturo Soria Street and Calle de Alcalá, just 50 meters from Ciudad Lineal, making it the most popular sites in Madrid available in just 10 minutes. You can walk to a multitude of shops, including a shopping center, delightful restaurants and bars and nightclubs (the nearest pub is right next to the hotel). Alcalá street is one of the main shopping areas of Madrid and is easily accessible from the hotel. Last but not least, this hotel is close to the IFEMA exhibition center and the airport. This is ideal for business travelers and families. Business travelers will appreciate the 3 meeting rooms. There is a golf course and a fitness center nearby. Since the beginning of the season spring to late summer, dinner is served on the terrace of La Pergola

4227.address: Gran Via De Les Corts Catalanes, 605
4227.description:
Located in the very heart of Barcelona, at the junction of Gran Via de les Corts Catalanes and Passeig de Gràcia and just steps from Las Ramblas, El Avenida Palace is a listed heritage hotel with over 70 years of history. Since its opening, it has remained in the hands of the same family, preserving a legacy of hospitality and style. Built on the site once occupied by the renowned Casa Llibre confectionery, a favourite meeting place of Barcelona’s high society, the hotel combines the character of a historic building with the comfort of rooms in continuous renovation. Over the decades, it has welcomed distinguished guests, including The Beatles. 
Guests can enjoy a spectacular rooftop with panoramic city views, a bar open until midnight in an iconic historic hall, and Batea, our seafood restaurant with a subtle French touch. The property also offers meeting rooms with natural light.

4228.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. For lunch or dinner, stop by AC Lounge, a bar/lounge that specializes in Mediterranean cuisine. You can also grab snacks at the coffee shop/cafe. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 103 guestrooms featuring minibars and espresso makers. Your memory foam bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

4231.description: This cozy hotel is located near Avenida Diagonal in Barcelona's upscale Sarrià neighborhood. The Maria Cristina station on metro line L3 (green line) offers a direct connection to the city center, providing easy access to shops, restaurants, and entertainment. Bonanova Park is just 4 km from the nearest beach. Enjoy our buffet breakfast in the hotel cafeteria or explore nearby cafes and the tranquil neighborhood park. Our reception staff is available to assist you throughout your stay.

4240.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and wedding services. This hotel also offers a TV in the common area and a banquet hall. Dine at AC Lounge, a bar/lounge specializing in international cuisine, or grab snacks at the coffee shop/cafe. Buffet breakfast is available weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM (for a fee, children 11 and under eat free). For business travelers, there's a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event? The hotel boasts over 20, 000 square feet of conference and meeting space. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Relax in one of the 90 guestrooms featuring minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and bidets, phones, safes, and desks. Located near attractions such as Palacio Laredo (1. 2 mi), Capilla de las Santas Formas (1. 5 mi), and the University of Alcala (1. 6 mi).

4241.description: Located on the A-6 motorway, facing the Zarzuela Clinic, Hotel Aravaca Village offers easy access both to the centre of Madrid and to the business and residential areas to the northwest of the city. Air-conditioned and heated, all rooms include a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, minibar, and wardrobe. The private bathroom comes with a bath, hairdryer, and free toiletries. Free WiFi is available throughout the hotel and guests have access to gym (surcharge) with a Turkish bath. The hotel offers meeting and banquet facilities, available for a surcharge. Guests will find restaurants in the same building. Barrial Train Station is 3 km from the hotel and Madrid Airport is 22 km away. Madrid city centre can be reached in 15 minutes by car.

4285.description: This charming hotel fully refurbished lies in the lively neighbourhood of Chueca. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the Gran Via, and in the ideal setting from which to explore the city's most prominent attractions. The hotel lies just a short distance away from the Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor, Palacio Real and Plaza de España. The hotel is situated just a 5 minutes' walking distance from the Museo del Prado and the Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum. This wonderful hotel enjoys a charming architectural design, welcoming guests into the relaxing surroundings of the interior. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, and come complete with modern amenities. Guests will be impressed by the wide range of facilities that this delightful hotel has to offer.

4288.description: This hotel is located in Oporto. The hotel is located in the historical centre of the city, surrounded by the many attractions that Porto has to offer. The hotel is located just 200 metres away from Sao Bento Train Station and Aliados Metro Station. Guests can enjoy close proximity to Francisco Sa Carneiro Airport. This wonderful hotel enjoys an attractive design. The hotel features traditional Portuguese decor, exuding elegance and character. Guests can enjoy delectable dining in the elegant surroundings of the award-winning restaurant. A wide range of leisure, dining and business facilities are available at this hotel. Guests will appreciate the friendly service and high level of excellence that they are afforded.

4303.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, gift shops/newsstands, and wedding services. If you'd like to spend the day shopping, you can hop on the complimentary shuttle. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Madrid? This hotel has 22077 square feet (2051 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 56 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary at scheduled times.

4307.description: The hotel is located in the industrial area of Arganda del Rey, close to different bars and restaurants, as well as public transport stops. The hotel is 22 km from the city centre of Madrid. It has an attractive design, with magnificent rooms that have modern amenities to ensure maximum comfort for visitors, with a minibar for a fee, LED screen TV and free wifi. The bathrooms are equipped with different toiletries. For breakfast, you can enjoy a complete and varied buffet with hot food (bacon, scrambled eggs, potato omelette. . . etc), cold food, pastries, cereals, juices, yoghurts and everything you need to start a good day. The hotel also offers a free parking area until full capacity is reached, and underground parking at a cost of 15€, access to the fitness room with sauna, included in the price.

4309.description: This hotel is located in Boavista, with immediate access to public transportation, and very close to Casa da Música, Rosa Mota Pavilion, Soares dos Reis Museum, and a plethora of restaurants and several nightlife spots. In the vicinity, there are shopping venues, nightclubs, bars and restaurants. The popular Península shopping centre is a 5-minute walk away. The hotel is a 10-minute walk from River Douro and 5 km from the Atlantic beaches.

4311.description: This chic and contemporary hotel is nestled in Rivas-Vaciamadrid, just 15 km away from the city centre of Madrid and its most emblematic highlights as Puerta del Sol, numerous museums, the best shopping options and entertainment venues such as the popular theme parks. It is well-connected to the capital, offering easy access to A3 road and only 900 metres from Rivas Futura metro station. Visitors will be impressed by smart design, cutting-edge facilities and host of on-site services. The luminous and ample rooms and suites offer a modern design and state-of-the-art comforts to provide everything one may need to feel at home. Guests may enjoy a wholesome breakfast and dine on refined dishes at the hotel restaurant. Those coming for business purposes may take advantage of conference facilities and all guests may make use of Turkish bath and well-equipped gym. The garage and laundry service are also on offer.

4315.description: The Golden Tulip Porto-Gaia, steeped in history, sits beside the stunning Atlantic Ocean on Lavadores Beach, near the Douro River estuary. Porto's historic center is just 15 minutes away. The hotel's 57 rooms feature air conditioning, Wi-Fi, TVs, telephones, safes, minibars, hairdryers, and balconies/terraces. Guests can enjoy extensive spa facilities, including an indoor pool and sauna, book massages, or visit the fully equipped gym. After a workout, the hotel's restaurant, Casa Branca, awaits, offering a refined wine cellar, stunning sea views, and gourmet Portuguese cuisine.

name.content: São Félix Hotel Hillside and Nature

4316.description:
Situated atop Mount Felix, this hotel offers panoramic views of Póvoa de Varzim and the Atlantic Ocean. There is an outdoor swimming pool and terrace. 

The spacious and air-conditioned rooms at São Félix Hotel have satellite TV, telephone and a hairdryer. The rooms are warmly decorated and provide views across the countryside of northern Portugal. 

Guests can dine in the São Félix restaurant, which has large windows overlooking the region and serves a fusion of local and international cuisines. Other after-dinner entertainment includes a bar. 

São Félix Hotel Hillside & Nature is optimally situated for those who enjoy the outdoors. The 24-hour reception will be happy to recommend hiking trips and take care of car- and bike rentals. For fishing, the Atlantic coast is just 6 km away. 

Porto International Airport is just 30 minutes’ drive from the hotel.

4317.description: This welcoming city hotel is situated in the tourist district of Guimaraes. The hotel is located in close proximity to a choice of shops, boutiques, restaurants and entertainment venues, ensuring that guests have a truly enjoyable experience. Links to the public transport network lie just 300 metres away from the hotel, while the beach is 50 kms from the hotel. This charming hotel enjoys an attractive style, inviting guests into relaxing, hospitable surroundings. The guest rooms offer comfort and convenience, and come complete with modern amenities. They offer the perfect haven in which to relax and unwind at the end of the day.

4325.description: This hotel is nestled on a quiet side street near “Gran Via', right in the heart of Spain's capital. It is the ideal starting point for exploring everything that the city has to offers, as it is just minutes away from Plaza Mayor, Puerta Del Sol, the Royal Palace and Chueca. The surrounding area is home to a number of restaurants and typical tapas-bars- perfect for enjoying a relaxed dinner at the end of the exciting day. The 5-storey venue itself houses a small coffee-shop where guests can sip a cup of the refreshing beverage and have a small snack, it is also where the continental breakfast is served each morning. The comfortable rooms are harmoniously decorated and include an ensuite bathroom, cosy beds, double-glazed windows for extra comfort and pretty much everything needed for hassle-free stay.

4336.description: Conveniently situated in Madrid, this modern and stylish establishment is an optimal option for a leisure trip, romantic gateway or a business travel. It is surrounded by numerous metro and bus stops which will allow travellers to explore the city, while the local attractions such as Santiago Bernabeu Stadium, the home of FC Real Madrid, and the famous Paseo de la Castellana may be easily reached on foot. The self-catering apartments offer spacious and beautifully appointed surroundings, making it a perfect place for a short visit or a prolonged stay in Madrid. Each air-conditioned unit comes with private bathroom, commodious furniture and top-notch amenities to ensure a pleasant and homely atmosphere. Guests may avail laundry service and in case of any doubt or query turn to friendly and professional staff at the 24-hour reception.

4337.description: This appealing city apartment hotel is located in the tourist centre of Madrid. The complex is situated just a few minutes' walking distance from the centre of the town, offering guests the perfect setting from which to explore the myriad of attractions, restaurants, entertainment venues and shopping opportunities it has to offer. Guests will appreciate the prime setting of the hotel, which allows them to explore the captivating surroundings with ease. The rooms and apartment enjoy a sleek, city style, providing the perfect environment in which to relax and unwind in comfort at the end of the day. The accommodation options providing a tranquil home away from home in this spectacular city. ADDED VALUE: All the apartments have a fully functional kitchenette that will certainly help our guests to make their daily routines easier in case they prefer to cook and eat inside the property.

4338.description: This attractive aparthotel provides a central location in Madrid. Guests will appreciate the prime setting from which they can explore the spectacular sights and sounds this mesmerising city has to offer. The hotel provides the perfect location from which to discover the city's attractions including the Royal Palace and the Plaza de Espana. Guests will find themselves in a home away from home, with comfortable accommodation and excellent services and facilities. The guest suites and apartments are tastefully appointed and provide a cocoon of tranquility and serenity seemingly miles away from the bustle of the city which lies just outside. The accommodation options come complete with modern amenities for guests' convenience. ADDED VALUE: All the apartments have a fully functional kitchenette that will certainly help our guests to make their daily routines easier in case they prefer to cook and eat inside the property.

4339.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of recreational amenities such as a health club and sauna. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can reach nearby destinations using the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy dining at one of the hotel's two restaurants or 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at one of the two bars/lounges. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily (7 AM to 11 AM, for a fee). Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in/check-out, and event facilities including conference space and nine meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (24 hours, surcharge), and self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Each of the 154 guestrooms features minibars, espresso makers, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with designer toiletries and bidets, phones, safes, and desks. Located near Paseo de la Castellana, the hotel is a short distance from attractions like the Golden Mile and El Corte Inglés. The preferred airport is Adolfo Suárez Madrid–Barajas Airport (MAD).

4341.description: The Flag Hotel Guimarães Fafe is ideally situated in Fafe, in the heart of Minho, a region in northern Portugal renowned for its gastronomy and vinho verde. Guimarães, the birthplace of Portugal, is just a ten-minute drive away. Explore its historic center, castle, and Palace of the Dukes of Braganza. Braga, known as 'the Portuguese Rome, ' is also easily accessible. Visit the sanctuaries of Bom Jesus, Sameiro, and Falperra, and discover Braga's historic center with its many beautiful churches. Nature lovers will appreciate the proximity to Peneda-Gerês National Park with its unforgettable landscapes, as well as ten pedestrian trails around Fafe.

4357.description: This hotel is located 15 minutes from the centre of Barcelona, in the tourist area of Sant Just Desvern. The fairground, the Congress Center, and a thriving university area are all close by, making the hotel ideal for business and pleasure travelers alike. Facilities include a foyer with a 24-hour reception, a safe, currency exchange, lift, café, bar, TV room, an à-la-carte restaurant, Wi-Fi in public areas, and a conference room. Room and laundry services, a car park and a garage are also available.

4358.description: What distinguishes us is our personalized service and privileged location for those visiting Lisbon for leisure or business. More than a Hotel, we offer an experience that you will want to repeat and recommend. Designed especially for you, our rooms offer an elegant, sober and modern design, providing all the comfort and tranquility to your stay. Ideal for solo travellers, for business or tourism. Enjoy all services designed to make your stay memorable, including private parking for your convenience. Combining safety and convenience, we have private parking available to our guests. Enjoy our Happy Hour with breathtaking views over Lisbon on our exclusive rooftop. A relaxing end of the day, with a glass of wine and delicious snacks. Start your day savoring our delicious buffet breakfast on the top floor, accompanied by an unforgettable panoramic view overlooking Lisbon and the Tagus River. End your day with an explosion of the senses at Hotel Dah, with a selection of carefully prepared ingredients and make your stay in Lisbon even more special. Enjoy the convenient and exclusive transfer service from the Airport to the Hotel and back home. The perfect, customized solution for all your events, including conferences, social, business and religious events, fashion shows, film crew support, trainings and many more.

4367.description: Centrally located in the Portuguese capital of Lisbon, this contemporary style hotel is just a few steps from the Praça do Marquês de Pombal Square and the Avenida da Liberdade with its elegant shopping facilities. The vibrant area of Bairro Alto with its large variety of restaurants, bars, art galleries and Fado houses is within easy reach. The international airport of Lisbon is just a short drive away. The hotel offers 57 fully equipped apartments with elegant decoration. They are fitted with kitchenette, LCD TV, air conditioning, coffee facilities and bathroom with shower and hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a delicious breakfast buffet every morning and drinks in the lounge bar.

4368.description: The Travelodge Barcelona del Vallés is a 3-star hotel located in the heart of the business area of Vallés, on the outskirts of Barcelona. The hotel is perfect for business trips or family getaways thanks to its friendly and welcoming atmosphere and 212 comfortable rooms. The hotel has its own parking, 4 meeting rooms, a bar and a restaurant with a terrace where you can enjoy delicious Mediterranean cuisine. You can also bring your pet with you for a surcharge of 20 euros per stay. At the Travelodge Barcelona del Vallés, we would love to offer you and your pet the best possible experience. Located on the outskirts of Barcelona, it is strategically located on the AP-7 motorway providing access to the centre of Barcelona in just 15 minutes by car. The hotel is located in the heart of the commercial district of Vallés, where you can visit the shopping centres and leisure areas of the neighbourhood on foot.

4370.description: This smart design hotel is located in a prime residential area in Lisbon, close to the popular Avenida de Roma. Guests will find Rossio square and the city centre just a short metro ride away, making this establishment an ideal base for those travellers wishing to explore this vibrant city. Spread over 9 themed floors, the tastefully decorated guest rooms boast panoramic views over the city and offer an array of modern conveniences to guarantee a truly memorable stay, such as air conditioning and satellite television. Guests will appreciate the fusion restaurant serving a wide choice of Portuguese dishes as well as Indian specialities. Five meeting rooms are available to meet all business travellers' needs.

4375.description: This hotel lies just a 10 minutes' driving distance away from the centre of Martorell. It is located just 30 km from Barcelona. The beach is just 30 km away. Shopping venues, bars and restaurants can also be found nearby. Links to the public transport network are located in the area. This wonderful hotel is sure to appeal to discerning business and leisure travellers alike. The guest rooms are superbly styled, oozing serenity and tranquillity. The property features 3 conference rooms, which are sure to impress those travelling for work purposes. The hotel offers a wonderful breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

4390.description: This luxury hotel is located in the peaceful district of Puerta de Hierro, within a short drive from downtown Madrid. It enjoys a convenient setting within ease of access to verdant golf courses and is well-connected to the city by means of numerous links of public transport and M30 ring road. This boutique establishment offers large and carefully designed rooms, where to kick back and completely rest after all day of meetings or leisure. The units feature beautiful combination of crisp-white bed linens and chocolate brown parquet floors, minimalistic furnishings and complemented with modern amenities. Travellers may dine on delicious dishes at the hotel restaurant overlooking the lavish garden. They may also balance body and soul at the impressive wellness centre and modern gym or have a drink in a carefree atmosphere of the inviting bar.

4391.description: This 4 star hotel is located close to the airport of Madrid and was established in 1970. It is a short drive away from the Old city and the nearest station is Canillejas. The Hotel has a restaurant, a bar, a conference room, a coffee shop and an outdoor swimming pool. All 168 rooms are equipped with hairdryer, safe and air conditioning.

4397.description: Situated in a peaceful neighborhood of Alcalá de Henares, this popular hotel offers convenient access to Madrid's historical and cultural center. A bus stop directly in front of the hotel provides easy connections to the bus and underground stations, allowing guests to reach the airport and exhibition centers within 15 minutes. Built in 1995, the hotel features 42 double rooms across two floors, a charming garden area, a café with a terrace, a cozy bar, and the splendid 'El Cardenal' restaurant. Business travelers can utilize the conference facilities, and room and laundry services are available. Guests can park their cars in the hotel's car park or garage. Each stylish room is fully equipped and features an en-suite bathroom.

4398.description: This attractive, luxury hotel is located between the Molina Street, Serrano and Claudio Coello in the financial, diplomatic, shopping and culture centre of Madrid. It's only minutes away from the Paseo de la Castellana, with ideal access to the N-2 motorway. The hotel was originally student halls and around 1900 became the home a famous Spanish author. It is an ideal choice for business and tourist guests. The hotel offers a cosy bar as well as a café and a delightful restaurant. There is an elegant conference room with enough space for up to 20 people. Those arriving by car may make use of the car parking. The tastefully designed rooms are all named after one of the streets in the neighborhood of Salamanca, with a balcony and a separate seating area which creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

4413.description: This hotel enjoys a strategic setting, close to the centre of Madrid. It lies close to a wide range of attractions in the area. Located in a residential area of the city, the hotel is set amidst the prominent Madrid Torrejon de Ardoz business and industrial area. Madrid Airport is just 20 km away. Many shops, restaurants and entertainment opportunities can be found nearby. This hotel offers quality and professionalism, which is sure to impress. The guest rooms are superbly styled, featuring functional space and modern amenities. The hotel offers a range of excellent facilities and services, attending to the needs of every type of traveller.

4427.description: Set in 25, 000sqm of beautiful historical gardens, offering fantastic views of Barcelona, Torre Melina, a Gran Meliá Hotel is a luxury hotel set on Diagonal Avenue. With unique experiences that will make this accommodations a benchmark in the Catalan capital, with access to the Palau de Congressos de Catalunya, the gardens of Torre Melina, and signature restaurants such as Erre Errechu, Grand Café, Beso Pedralbes, Poolbar Terrasse (seasonal), Entre Cielos rooftop. Spacious, air-conditioned rooms include a flat-screen TV, a mini-bar, private bathroom with hairdryer and free toiletries. Torre Melina, a Gran Meliá Hotel is 15 minutes walk from FC Barcelona Camp Nou stadium. Zona Universitaria Metro Stop is 1476 feet away, connecting you with the city center in under 20 minutes. In the BESO pool, you must reserve a sunbed/Balinese bed for an additional charge. For more information, please inquire at the hotel.

4432.description: Featuring a restaurant, bar and views of city, Hotel do Elevador is set in Braga, 5 km from University of Minho - Braga Campus. Featuring a garden, the 4-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. The accommodation offers room service, a 24-hour front desk and currency exchange for guests. At the hotel, each room has a desk and a flat-screen TV. At Hotel do Elevador all rooms come with bed linen and towels. Braga Se Cathedral is 7. 8 km from the accommodation, while Guimarães Castle is 20 km away. The nearest airport is Francisco Sá Carneiro, 62 km from Hotel do Elevador

4433.description:
History, tradition, nature and spirituality come hand-in-hand in the Hotel do Parque Bom Jesus, located in one of the most stunning sacred mountains of Europe. A recently built hotel that keeps the charm of its origins in 1870. 

This hotel near the sanctuary of Bom Jesus, Braga, stands out for its artistic, religious and natural richness, as well as for its suggestive services, like sauna, Turkish bathroom, bar, free wifi. . . The objective is to offer you health, wellness and nature.

4435.description: The newly opened NH Collection Madrid Gran Vía is in the heart of one of Madrid's most iconic streets. This city center hotel is in an ideal location for shopping at designer boutiques, as well as exploring Gran Vía's restaurants, coffee shops, book stores and cocktail bars. The hotel is within walking distance of Madrid's central attractions, including La Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor, Plaza España, Plaza de Cibeles and the Prado museum. It's also near Gran Vía underground station and around one hour from the airport. The hotel's 94 elegantly decorated rooms each have Nespresso machines and free Wi-Fi. Accommodation includes Superior rooms, Premium rooms and Junior suites. Guests will enjoy a refreshing night's sleep on new mattresses with a choice of pillows. Start the day with our a la carte breakfast, featuring international favorites including breads, pastries, fruit and hot dishes, as well as local specialties like Spanish sausage. One of the highlights of this Madrid city center hotel is the 8th floor roof terrace with spectacular views over Gran Vía, and watched over by the Titan god Atlas. Here you'll find the restaurant, Picalagartos, with a menu of Spanish classics with a twist. Bar service includes snacks and cocktails designed by top bartenders.

4449.description: Situated in Lisbon, this hotel is in the historical district and close to Lisboa Congress Centre, 25th of April Bridge, and Jeronimos Monastery. Being located by the lively dockland area of Lisbon, the hotel enjoys excellent views of the Tagus River, Belém tower and the Jerónimos Monastery. Rossio, in the centre of Lisbon, is roughly 5 km away. Public transportation departs from stops just 200 m from the hotel. The surrounding area is filled with bars, pubs, restaurants and nightclubs.

4463.description: The NH Madrid Ventas hotel, formerly known as NH Parque Avenidas, is in a convenient location in the upscale Salamanca neighborhood. The famous Las Ventas bullring is five minutes away on foot and the Parque Avenidas metro stop is steps away. Madrid's city center is only 10 minutes away on the subway. NH Madrid Ventas has 199 warm contemporary rooms. The decor is neutral and relaxing, with sleek hardwood floors and each room has air-conditioning and free Wi-Fi. For breakfast, we serve a delicious assortment of options including fresh pastries and breads, jams, fruit, cold cuts, cheeses, and much more. Guests can later enjoy a meal from our innovative Mediterranean menu at the NH Ventas Restaurant or on the outdoor terrace. For something more casual, have a light meal with your favorite drink at the Park Avenue Bar Terraza, our stylish whiskey bar and terrace. To unwind, take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool surrounded by a large green garden. Guests wishing to keep up with their workout routine can use our gym. For functions, the hotel has 9 meeting rooms for up to 1000 people and our staff will happily organize coffee breaks and set up technical equipment for your event upon request.

4464.description: This hostel, located in Madrid's bustling tourist center, is just a short walk from the city center with its countless shops, boutiques, cafés, bars, restaurants, and vibrant nightlife. It offers 16 cozy rooms, a currency exchange, an elevator, a café, a hair salon, and a TV room. Reception is open from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. For check-in outside these hours, please contact the property in advance at +34 915 21 87 80 or +34 644 58 58 56. Each functional room features a bathroom, a direct-dial telephone, central heating, a balcony, and a safe for rent.

4468.description: Set in down town Madrid in the Moncloa Argüelles area, Boutique Hotel Indigo Madrid Princesa is within a 10 minute walk of Torre de Madrid and Plaza de Espana. The hotel is ideally situated within 2km of other top attractions that Madrid has to offer such as Plaza Mayor and Royal Palace and Hotel Indigo Madrid Princesa is only 1 minute walk from Arguelles Metro Station making it a great location to explore the city and to reach Madrid Barajas International Airport. Complimentary Wi-Fi, upscale bedding. After a day exploring nearby attractions, sit back and enjoy at the bar lounge with a local Spanish wine. At night, order locally sourced tapas in our restaurant or explore Madrid’s city-centre theaters, bars and gourmet eateries.

name.content: Ramada by Wyndham Madrid Tres Cantos

4469.description: This wonderful hotel enjoys a quiet yet convenient location in Tres Cantos, a 22-minute drive from downtown Madrid and a short stroll from the Tres Cantos business district, home to numerous international companies. Located just 500 meters from the railway station, the hotel provides easy access to Madrid's main attractions. This stylish establishment enchants visitors with its convenient location, charming decor, and attentive customer service. Accommodations range from rooms to more spacious suites, each tastefully decorated and equipped with modern amenities for a comfortable stay. Guests can enjoy a delicious continental breakfast and drinks from the inviting bar. Business facilities and on-site parking are also available.

4470.description: This property sits proudly amidst the rich culture and beauty of the city of Madrid. The property is located just a short distance away from the bustling city centre, where a host of attractions, restaurants and entertainment venues can be found. Links to the public transport network are situated nearby.

4471.description: Ilunion Les Corts Spa is a 4-star hotel with a spa center, gym, swimming pool and restaurant located in the Les Corts neighbourhood, just 15 minutes from the historic center of the city. The hotel is perfect for resting, enjoying a tourist or business trip in Barcelona, ​​even as a base from which to enjoy the beaches of the city and the province, opting for a quieter accommodation for it.

4477.description: Located in a peaceful area and very close to the AP7 highway, this hotel is just 20 minutes by car from Barcelona and 5 minutes from La Roca Village shopping outlet. Moreover, the property is situated opposite the Circuit de Catalunya and a mere 10 minutes from a golf course. Thus, this is a great option to rest and visit the area or stay on a business trip. The hotel offers a full range of leisure activities, including an outdoor swimming pool, a fitness centre, a free parking and a restaurant. With six meeting rooms, the hotel is perfect for organizing meetings and celebrations. All guest rooms and suites are beautifully appointed and boast a modern look. They include all the necessary amenities for a good night’s sleep.

4481.description: The city hotel lies at the heart of the old town of Alcala de Henares. Guests are offered a charming view of the old Cisneria University, which is to be found at the centre of the commercial and entertainment district. A variety of shopping venues, bars, boutiques and restaurants are to be found in the vicinity, as are links to the public transport network. The closest nightclub is located only 5 km away. This popular hotel occupies a classical building and was completely renovated in the year 2000. The hotel comprises 50 rooms spread over 3 floors. Guests are welcomed in the foyer with 24-hour reception desk, safe and lift. Additionally, a bar, a café a hairdresser's salon and an air-conditioned restaurant count amongst the hotel facilities. A conference room and a public Internet terminal are also on offer. Guests arriving by car may use car parking and garage facilities. Room service, laundry services and medical assistance round off the facilities on offer. The cosy rooms come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a radio, a minibar/ fridge, Internet access, a king-sized bed, a hire safe and central heating. The nearest golf course is 5 km away.

4482.description: This upmarket hotel lies in the Salamanca district of Madrid. The establishment is situated in an exclusive area of the city, between the Paseo de la Castellana and the Calle Serrano. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. Guests can enjoy close proximity to a number of restaurants and shops in the area. This hotel enjoys an attractive design. The guest rooms are stylish, comfortable and equipped with modern amenities. The hotel features a number of facilities and services, including a cafeteria. Business and leisure travellers alike will appreciate the comfort and convenience that this hotel has to offer.

4484.description: Located on the well-known Calle Alcalá, a mere 15 minutes by metro from the city center, the Elba Madrid Alcalá 4-star Hotel offers ideal accommodations for all types of guests—tourists, film buffs, shopaholics, and business clients—thanks to the services and facilities available, as well as its convenient access to different parts of the city. Taxis and buses stop in front of the hotel, and two metro stations are just a 5-minute walk away. The hotel has spacious, light, and fully equipped rooms with carefully selected decor and personalized attention to make you feel at home. The hotel's services are complemented by an à la carte restaurant with a cozy ambiance, large windows, and outside access, where you can savor high-quality dishes, and a café and covered terrace for drinks or snacks. With 15 fully equipped meeting rooms, free high-speed Wi-Fi, and ample parking, it's the perfect place for events, celebrations, and business trips.

4491.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at the AC Hotel Los Vascos by Marriott. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a common area television. Dine at the snack bar/deli or unwind at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available (fee applies). Business amenities include a center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Host events in the hotel's meeting room and conference space (237 sq ft). Self-parking is available (charges apply). The 51 guest rooms feature minibars, plasma TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms (shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, hair dryers), safes, and coffee/tea makers. Daily housekeeping is provided. Located near the Azca Financial District and University City of Madrid, the hotel is approximately 14. 8 km from Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD).

4492.description: Sercotel Madrid Aeropuerto is located 5 minutes away from Barajas airport, very close to IFEMA, the Madrid Conference Center and just 300 meters from the Alameda de Osuna metro station, with a direct line to Madrid city center in about 20 minutes. This design hotel has an outdoor swimming pool and terrace, a gym and a shuttle service to the airport. It also has 3 meeting rooms with Internet connection, a cafeteria and room service in limited hours.

4514.description: This upscale city hotel boasts an enviable location between Barcelona's Ciutadella Park and the Olympic Marina Harbour. Just 100 meters from the nearest metro station, it offers easy access to shops, restaurants, bars, and the city's vibrant nightlife, all within 500 meters. The hotel exudes style and elegance, providing an ideal setting for both business and leisure travelers. Its extensive, first-class facilities include a spa (reservations highly recommended due to limited availability; €16 per person for a 90-minute water circuit), a delightful restaurant, and a relaxing bar. Guest rooms are beautifully designed, offering functional spaces and modern amenities for optimal comfort and convenience.

4569.description: Located in the area open to the sea, “Diagonal Mar”. Next to the city's Congress Palace (CCIB) and a few meters from the “Mar Bella” beach and the “Diagonal Mar” shopping center, With avant-garde architecture and decoration, its façade, all made of glass, allows the hotel to have great luminosity. Its 144 rooms are spacious and modern, all exterior and with natural light. With views of the street or the garden. Full bathroom with welcome products. At the Jardí de Mar restaurant you will find a fresh and original menu with seasonal products and nuances of local gastronomy, healthy dishes with international touches. It is worth highlighting the Jardí de Mar Terrace, ideal for relaxing after a day of work. The hotel has rooms for business meetings, work meals and banquets.

4572.description: The Hyatt Regency Hesperia Madrid graces the Paseo de la Castellana, Madrid's most exclusive boulevard. Situated in the heart of the city's cultural center, the location is ideal for exploring the finest shops and offers easy access to the airport, exhibition halls, and numerous tourist attractions. The hotel boasts 169 guest rooms and 32 suites, each fully equipped for a comfortable stay. The Hyatt Regency Hesperia Madrid also presents a unique culinary experience with its diverse dining options. From the acclaimed Michelin-starred restaurant, Santceloni, to La Manzana restaurant and the sophisticated Scotch Bar, the hotel offers some of the city's finest gastronomic delights.

4616.description: This hotel enjoys a charming setting in Lisbon, nestled near Rossio Square with stunning views of Castelo de Sao Jorge, the Dona Maria II National Theatre, and the Alfama and Baixa districts. A short walk leads to the heart of Rossio, offering a wealth of shopping, dining, and entertainment. Lisbon Airport is just 6. 8 km away. This classically designed hotel features beautifully appointed guest rooms with original furnishings and a graceful ambiance, complemented by a range of excellent facilities and services.

4651.description: Set in a 16th century manor in the heart of Amarante, this boutique hotel offers sweeping views over the Tâmega River. Guests are invited to unwind with both indoor and outdoor pools, a serene spa, nearby golf facilities, and complimentary parking. The sophisticated guestrooms at Casa da Calçada Relais & Châteaux blend timeless elegance with contemporary comfort. Renovated in 2025, each space fosters a seamless connection between the surrounding landscape and the charm of the city, offering bespoke amenities designed to elevate each stay to a unique and customized experience. Culinary excellence awaits at the hotel’s restaurants, where local flavors are reimagined with an international flair. The bar features a curated selection of wines from the nearby Douro Valley, complemented by house-produced champagne.

4652.description: With a stay at Hotel Best Auto Hogar, you'll be centrally located in Barcelona, within a 5-minute drive of Plaça de Catalunya and La Rambla. This hotel is 2. 2 mi (3. 5 km) from Barceloneta Beach and 2. 5 mi (4 km) from Port de Barcelona. Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including a spa tub, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Stay in one of 153 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Enjoy Spanish cuisine at Cafe Espanol, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Avenida del Paralelo - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi- Sala Apolo - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Rambla del Raval - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Maritime Museum - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Palau Güell - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- La Rambla - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Gran Teatre del Liceu - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Barcelona Wax Museum - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Columbus Monument - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Port Vell - 0. 9 km/0. 5 mi- Plaça Reial - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Sant Antoni Market - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Boqueria Market - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Rambla de Mar - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi- Pompeu Fabra University - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi. The preferred airport for Hotel Best Auto Hogar is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 16. 6 km/10. 3 mi.

4668.description: This delightful hotel lies just a few steps away from the Museo Del Prado in the mesmerizing city of Madrid. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a host of shopping and entertainment venues, as well as the Thyssen and the Reina Sofia museums. The international airport is located just 10 km away from the hotel. This charming hotel enjoys a delightful architectural design, blending effortlessly with its historical, city surroundings. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, providing a haven of peace and serenity in which to escape the bustle of the city. The modern rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and minibars. Some rooms have city views, while upgraded rooms add Espresso coffee machines and kettles. Suites add separate living rooms and private terraces. Room service is available. This-charming hotel offers a delightful breakfast buffet in the mornings, for a great start to the day. Guests can enjoy a drink in the lounge bar, where there is a selection of national and international newspapers. Private parking is available for an additional cost at a location nearby.

4674.description: This stylish hotel enjoys a great setting at the heart of the city of Sabadell. It lies just a short driving distance from the city centre. Catalans station is just a short distance away. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a range of attractions in the area. The lively, culturally-rich city of Barcelona can be found just a short driving distance away. Guests are extended a warm, friendly welcome upon arrival. The guest rooms are well-appointed and tastefully designed. Guests are invited to dine in style in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant. The hotel also features a bar and a conference room. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a deposit.

4690.description: This sober, comfortable hotel is in a great location in the heart of Madrid, close to all the major attractions, with excellent public transportation links, perfect for exploring the whole Spanish capital. The hotel has 9 meeting rooms with a total 650 m2. Facilities include free Wi-Fi, public parking, café, bar and a restaurant, room service, laundry services.

4702.description: Located in the heart of Madrid’s commercial district, NH Collection Madrid Abascal is ideal for both the business and the leisure traveler. Gregorio Marañón and Alonso Cano metro stations are within a short walk, providing guests easy access to the city’s top attractions such as the Art Triangle, as well as the airport and the IFEMA complex. Salesas and Salamanca neighborhoods offer guests boutique shopping, while Madrid’s gastronomical variety is also nearby at Chamberí’s trendy restaurants and tapas bars. For those in Madrid on business, Paseo de la Castellana is a short distance away. NH Collection Madrid Abascal is housed in a historical building that was previously home to some of Madrid’s wealthiest families. Recently renovated and redesigned, it features 183 rooms, each equipped with Nespresso machines, free Wi-Fi and 24-hour room service for your comfort. Many rooms have a living area and some enjoy access to a terrace and spectacular city views. Guests can enjoy the delicious breakfast served daily with a variety of healthy homemade options. The DOMO Abascal restaurant offers local fare and delicacies and guests may also relax with a drink at the lobby bar or on the cozy indoor terrace. There is a gym on-site.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Madrid Principe de Vergara

4703.description: The DoubleTree Madrid Príncipe de Vergara hotel ( NEW OPENING IN NOVEMBER) is close to some of Madrid's top shopping areas, as it is set in the high-end Salamanca neighborhood. The Avenida de America metro stop is a few minutes away, providing excellent access to sightseeing and the city's airport. The rooms at DoubleTree Madrid Principe de Vergara are stylishly decorated with a contemporary color palette. Some offer excellent views of the city and there are Nespresso machines in all of our Superior rooms. Every guest will enjoy the comfort of thick mattresses, a choice of pillows, toiletries, and free Wi-Fi in their room. The hotel restaurant serves market-fresh Mediterranean dishes in a cozy tasteful space. Meanwhile, if you prefer a light snack with a drink, head to our Bar Cafeteria, which is both modern and comfortable. The hotel has an on-site gym, where you can work out and stay fit. For meetings and events, there are 12 fully-equipped function rooms.

4704.description: When staying at the NH Madrid Nacional hotel, you will be in a privileged location on Paseo del Prado and steps away from Madrid's Art Triangle. The Prado, Thyssen and Reina Sofia museums are right by the hotel. The 1920s building was designed by the famous architect Modesto López Otero and is located across the street from the Atocha train station. This means it provides excellent links to everywhere in the city, including the airport. NH Madrid Nacional has 206 rooms with a choice of classic or contemporary designs. Each features sleek wooden floors and free Wi-Fi. Some of the rooms come with views of the Atocha Plaza or the Botanical Gardens, while Superior rooms have Nespresso machines, among other extras. The Tablafina restaurant serves up light bites and Mediterranean and Spanish dishes, which you can enjoy along with the lovely city view. Breakfast is also served and includes a wide variety of fresh fare including cooked-to-order eggs. A gym is available on-site. For meetings, there are 6 function rooms for up to 150 people, where catering can be arranged. On Sundays, sleep in and enjoy our free late checkout and breakfast served till noon.

4705.description: InterContinental Barcelona is the perfect base for enjoying all the culture the city offers. Elegant interiors and sophisticated design details matched with unparalleled hospitality. Nestled in the heart of Montjuic, we are the closest hotel to the stadium. Easily connected to the airport and walking distance to city center Enjoy a drink in our signature bar Gebre, dine at our exclusive Quirat restaurant or take in the magnificent views from our 173 Rooftop Terrace.

4706.description: This luxurious city and business hotel boasts a sough-after location in Madrid. The hotel is located at the heart of this mesmerising city within easy access of the captivating attractions and entertainment venues it has to offer. The hotel is situated in the north part of the city next to the IFEMA Exhibition Centre and a metro station lies directly in front of the hotel offering ease of access to other areas of this intriguing metropolis. The hotel exudes style and sophistication with its modern architecture and decor. The hotel is perfectly equipped for business travellers, providing a host of first-class facilities and meeting and conference spaces. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed and provide functional space and relaxing surroundings which are perfectly conducive to work or relaxation.

name.content: MADRID ALAMEDA AEROPUERTO AFFILIATED BY MELIA

4712.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting in Madrid. The hotel is situated within easy access of Madrid Barajas Airport, making this a great option for travellers seeking a relaxing setting in which to unwind before or after a long flight. The hotel is situated within easy access of the Juan Carlos I convention and exhibition centre. Appealing to business and leisure travellers alike, this upscale hotel provides a strategic location and the promise of a relaxing stay. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, featuring functional space and a relaxing setting in which to work and rest in comfort. The hotel offers a range of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of even the most discerning traveller.

name.content: Royal Solaris Cancun Resort All Inclusive

4718.address: Kukulcan Km. 20.5. Lote. 64 2a etapa. Secci¢n A, Z
4718.description:
All-inclusive family resort with a mini water park on the beachfront in Cancún
Royal Solaris Cancún is a charming beachfront resort, located just 13 kilometers from Cancún International Airport, ideal for enjoying an unforgettable family vacation in the Mexican Caribbean. 
Its 302 rooms are designed to provide comfort and functionality, equipped with a safe, minibar, coffee maker, and private bathroom with shower and hairdryer, creating the perfect environment for rest. 
The resort offers a wide variety of experiences for all ages, including a spa with massage services, daytime activities, and daily evening entertainment. It also features an outdoor swimming pool, a jacuzzi with ocean views, family areas, and a children’s water park, ideal for the little ones. 
In terms of dining, it offers 4 restaurants and 2 bars. Las Fuentes restaurant serves buffet breakfasts with beautiful views, Rosmarinus offers buffet-style lunches, Marco Polo presents international specialties for dinner, and Tavo features an oriental cuisine concept. During the day, you can also enjoy pizzas, snacks, and light options. 
As added value, the hotel has a private marina in front of the property, where you can go kayaking in the lagoon and participate in yoga and stretching sessions on the dock. Guests also enjoy access to an exclusive speakeasy-style sports bar located at the adjacent GR Solaris Caribe hotel, further enhancing the dining and entertainment experience.

4759.description: This charming city hotel boasts a stunning setting in the captivating city of Barcelona. The hotel is located at Ramblas, lying just a short distance away from Placa Cataluña. Nestled amidst the cultural, historical and tourist centre of the city, this hotel offers the ideal setting from which to explore the delights that Barcelona has to offer. Guests will find themselves within easy walking distance of Paseo de Gracia, Museo Picasso, Museo Macba, Liceu Opera, the Boqueria market, Marina Olympic, the Gothic quarter and Sagrada Familia cathedral. The hotel enjoys a charming blend of traditional and contemporary designs. The rooms are sumptuously designed, offering an oasis of peace and serenity. The rooms feature a stunning Spanish style, with wooden and marble elements.

4770.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at Citrus, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Make yourself at home in one of the 577 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Rooms have private balconies. Wireless internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

4771.description:
The dream of a hotel in the Eixample of Barcelona with the glamor of the 50s
Welcome to the Hotel chic & basic Velvet. The show is about to begin: a completely renovated facility with an air of cabaret and black and white classics.
Velvets, golden lamps, wooden details, cinema and theater signs ... there is no lack of detail for you to let yourself be transported to our particular universe in the Eixample of Barcelona.
Relive the most bohemian Barcelona in our hotel in the heart of Eixample and near Plaza España
Sympathetic, personable and a bit of a hooligan. That is the spirit of the chic & basic Velvet Hotel in which we invite you to relive the most bohemian Barcelona, ​​whether you are traveling for pleasure or for business.

4772.description: Located in one of the longest avenues in the city center, Ibis Budget Braga Centro puts modern and functional rooms at your disposal, with air conditioning, TV and Wi-Fi, for 2 to 3 people at economical prices. In addition to our complete breakfast buffet (optional), there are automatic 24/24 drinks, snacks and hygiene-product dispensers available. Small pets are welcome (additional charge).

4798.description: Situated in a charming domed townhouse in the heart of Madrid, this hotel offers easy access to the city's main attractions. The Royal Palace and Plaza España are within a short walk, offering guests ample opportunities for sightseeing and relaxation. The hotel features a restaurant and bar, with a buffet breakfast and à la carte lunch and dinner options.
