Rooms are decorated in a classic Spanish style, providing a comfortable atmosphere with modern amenities, including spacious layouts, stylish furniture, and private bathrooms with hair dryers. The hotel's central location and convenient access to public transport, just a 27-minute drive from Madrid airport, make it an ideal base for exploring the city's delights.

4849.description: This city hotel is located in Barcelona's leisure area just a few minutes' walking distance from the heart of the entertainment. Guests will find lively bars, restaurants and a vivid nightlife scene within easy access of the hotel, while numerous shopping opportunities and cultural attractions can be found close by. The nearest metro station is just a 2 minutes' walking distance away from the hotel. The hotel welcomes guests with comfortable surroundings, warm hospitality and friendly service. The guest rooms offer comfort and convenience and a relaxing ambience in which to unwind and enjoy restful slumber. Guests are invited to sample the culinary delights the breakfast buffet has to offer, setting them up for a long day's sightseeing.

4852.description: This hotel is located in close proximity to the centre of Barcelona. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the beautiful Sagrada Familia cathedral and Gaudi Avenue. The hotel is situated within easy access of a host of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. The hotel lies just a 2 minutes' walking distance away from the metro station. This modern hotel greets guests with style and charm. The guest rooms are sumptuously designed, combining chic city style with traditional elegance. The hotel affords guests a range of excellent facilities, ensuring a truly enjoyable stay and a memorable city break.

4853.description: Centrally located in Barcelona, Hotel Monegal is steps from La Rambla and a short walk from Plaça de Catalunya. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. The 53 guestrooms provide complimentary Wi-Fi and other amenities. Nearby attractions include Barcelona Cathedral (0. 7 km) and Boqueria Market (0. 6 km). The preferred airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN).

4854.description: This city hotel boasts a convenient location in the city centre of Barcelona, between Avinguda Diagonal, one of the main streets in the city, and the Trade Fair area, in Les Corts neighbourhood. Guests will find a host of shops, restaurants, bars and entertainment venues close to this charming property. The hotel is also next to Sants railway station, the capital's most important transport hub. The rooms have been tastefully decorated and come complete with a spacious private bathroom and complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection. Ideal for business travellers wishing to enjoy a comfortable stay in a privileged location, this establishment is also the perfect base from which to explore this wonderful city.

name.content: Dreams La Romana Resort & Spa - All Inclusive

4868.description: Stay at the all-inclusive Dreams La Romana Resort in San Rafael del Yuma, and enjoy a beachfront location just a short drive from Bayahibe Beach and Monumento Natural Punta Bayahibe. This luxury resort offers 418 air-conditioned rooms with minibars, LED TVs, premium bedding, and private balconies or patios. Indulge in international cuisine at one of the five restaurants, including the Spices Market buffet, or order from the 24-hour room service. Unwind at the spa with massages and body treatments, take a dip in one of the two outdoor pools, or enjoy the waterslide and sauna. Complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge) are also available. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. For business travelers, the resort features a business center and meeting rooms. Free valet parking is provided.

4875.description: Sofitel Lisbon Liberdade is a luxury hotel where supreme style reigns. Located in downtown Lisbon, on the prestigious Avenue of the same name, its 163 luxurious rooms will live up to your expectations. Near Lisbon's convention center and business district, and bordering historic neighbourhoods, our hotel combines business and relaxation but won't mix the two. Add our Matiz restaurant and bar, where heritage meets modernity, our guests can enjoy a contemporary take on an authentic Portuguese cuisine.

4894.address: Boulevard Kukulcan, Retorno Chac L-41, Zona Hotele
4894.description: Enjoy recreational amenities including a health club, an outdoor pool, and a lazy river. This property also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. This is an all-inclusive property. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may apply for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Enjoy seafood at Cevichería, one of the property's 10 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the two bars/lounges. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Cancun? This property has 125 square feet (12 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 450 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Rooms have private balconies or patios. 32-inch LCD televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Aquaworld - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi; Ballenas Beach - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi; Oasis Arena - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi; San Miguelito - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi; Maya Museum of Cancun - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi; Iberostar Cancun Golf Course - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi; Luxury Avenue Shopping Mall - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi; Kukulcan Plaza Shopping Mall - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi; Marlin Beach - 2. 5 km / 1. 5 mi; Hotel Zone Beaches - 2. 5 km / 1. 5 mi; El Sol de Cancun - 3 km / 1. 9 mi; Cinemex La Isla Cancun - 3 [Distance information incomplete in original text].

4895.description: Indulge in a rejuvenating experience at the full-service spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. This resort boasts three outdoor swimming pools, a tennis court, and a sauna for recreation. Enjoy convenient amenities such as concierge services, gift shops, and a hair salon. Dine at one of the resort's four restaurants, including Bravio, or order from the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at the poolside bar or one of the three other bars/lounges. Buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Business travelers will appreciate the business center, express check-in/check-out, and conference facilities. The resort provides airport shuttle service (surcharge) and free valet parking. Each of the 447 guest rooms features a private balcony, minibar, LED television with cable channels, and a bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hair dryer. Located near Ballenas Beach, Aquaworld, and the Hotel Zone Beaches, the JW Marriott Cancun Resort & Spa offers easy access to Cancun's key attractions. Cancun International Airport (CUN) is the preferred airport.

4911.description: Hotel Oasis offers a relaxing stay in the heart of Barcelona, featuring a seasonal outdoor pool and a terrace with city views. Each of the 101 guestrooms provides complimentary wired and wireless internet access, a minibar, and an LCD television. Amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a snack bar/deli. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel is conveniently located within a 10-minute walk of Port de Barcelona and Barcelona Cathedral, placing you near popular attractions like Barceloneta Beach and La Rambla.

4928.description: This city hotel is located in Madrid's prestigious Salamanca district just a few metres from the city centre and its lively bars, restaurants and nightlife. The Salamanca area is popular for shopping. Retiro Park and the Las Ventas Bullring are within 20 minutes' walk. The hotel is 300 metres from Diego León Metro Station, providing easy access to the whole city. This is the perfect hotel to enjoy holidays in the enchanting Spanish capital.

4929.description: 'Located in San Sebastian de los Reyes, the Sercotel de los Reyes Hotel is a convenient base for exploring Madrid. A short drive takes you to IFEMA and Real Madrid City, while the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium and WiZink Center are within easy reach. The hotel offers 72 guestrooms equipped with minibars, flat-screen televisions, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Guests can enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at the on-site restaurant, or grab a coffee and a quick bite at the café. Room service is also available during limited hours. Additional amenities include a bar/lounge, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and self-parking (subject to charges). '

4949.description: This comfortable and chic hotel is superbly located in the heart of Barcelona city, and is only a few minutes on foot from the historic centre. Within the area, guests will be able to find numerous bars, restaurants and shops, suitable for all tastes. This is the perfect location for those who wish to explore and discover the numerous touristic and historic attractions of the city.

4979.description: Centrally located in Madrid, Hotel Francisco I is a 5-minute walk from Plaza Mayor and Puerta del Sol, and close to Gran Via and the Royal Palace. The hotel offers 79 air-conditioned rooms with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and premium bedding. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with showers, and hair dryers. Hotel amenities include a bar/lounge, banquet hall, concierge services, and daily buffet breakfast (fee applies). Additional services such as dry cleaning/laundry, express check-out, and a 24-hour airport shuttle (surcharge) are also available.

name.content: AC Santo Mauro Autograph Collection by Marriott

5044.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as bicycle rentals, a terrace, and a garden at this Madrid hotel. Dine at La Biblioteca Restaurante, specializing in Mediterranean cuisine, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. A bar/lounge and full breakfast (fee applies) are also available. The hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services, a business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Meeting and conference space is available. Self-parking is available (surcharge). Each of the 49 individually decorated guestrooms features an iPod docking station, minibar, plasma TV with satellite programming, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combination, deep soaking bathtub, and designer toiletries. Safes, desks, and phones are also provided. Nearby attractions include Paseo de la Castellana (0. 1 mi), Sorolla Museum (0. 3 mi), and El Corte Inglés (0. 5 mi).

5084.description: This charming hotel, conveniently located just 15 km from Barcelona's El Prat Airport, offers an ideal base for exploring the city's captivating attractions. Guests enjoy easy access to Las Ramblas, the Gothic Quarter, and La Sagrada Familia. The tastefully appointed rooms feature modern amenities for a comfortable stay. Start your day with a delightful breakfast at the hotel. Special conditions and supplements may apply for bookings exceeding five rooms.

5110.description: Enjoy modern comforts at the AC Hotel Irla by Marriott in Barcelona, located near Avinguda Diagonal. This hotel offers a variety of amenities, including a health club, complimentary Wi-Fi, a snack bar, and 24-hour room service. Guests can unwind at the bar/lounge or start their day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies). Business travelers will appreciate the business center and meeting facilities. Each of the 36 guestrooms features a minibar, flat-screen TV, and private bathroom. Conveniently located near Francesc Macia Plaza and various attractions, this hotel provides a comfortable base for exploring the city.

5111.description: An iconic property, with elegant rooms and luxurious décor, reflecting Madrid itself with its perfect combination of classic and contemporary elements. The InterContinental Madrid is a haven of comfort. Explore Madrid, named Europe's top luxury destination with InterContinental Madrid. Situated in the heart of Paseo de la Castellana, the most elegant avenue, every corner is at easy reach from the hotel: sophisticated shopping in Barrio Salamanca, museums, historic center, live concerts and sports events. From a romantic getaway to a family break, this iconic hotel offers a unique experience featuring InterContinental Club lounge, pet friendly rooms and Wellness Center. Guests can also enjoy the most exquisite gastronomy at El Jardin Restaurant, relax at Bar 49, enjoy ambiance at the open-air terrace or discover its amazing Sunday Brunch.

5120.description: This welcoming city hotel lies at the entrance to the Avenida de America on the corner of Calle Cartagena and Maria de Molina in the Salamanca district of Madrid. The hotel is just a few minutes' driving distance from Barajas airport and enjoys excellent links to the IFEMA exhibition centre and the Juan Carlos I congress centre. The Famous Prado Museum is situated just a short distance away. Both business and leisure travellers alike will appreciate the hotel's prime location. This wonderful hotel enjoys an attractive architectural style, allowing it to blend seamlessly with its surroundings. The guest rooms are spacious and soundproofed, providing a relaxing haven in which to enjoy restful, undisturbed slumber. Guests can enjoy an energetic workout in the gym, and sample the delectable delights the restaurant has to offer.

name.content: Casa de Campo Resort and Villas

5134.description: THE ULTIMATE IN CARIBBEAN ELEGANCE & ADVENTURE Located in the vibrant paradise of the Dominican Republic, Casa de Campo® Resort & Villas is a destination teeming with culture, natural beauty and genuine hospitality. Featuring a wide variety of accommodations including the new Premier Suites, spacious hotel rooms and private villa homes, each accommodation comes equipped with a golf cart to explore the tropical scenery. Eight restaurants and seven bars and lounges make it possible to sample a mix of truly innovative cuisines from around the world. From expertly prepared Mediterranean dishes to Dominican cuisine with an international flair, the culinary offerings at Casa de Campo are fresh, sophisticated, and unique. The resort is filled with unmatched recreational options to keep everyone entertained. Choose a round of golf on one of three Pete Dye-designed courses including Teeth of the Dog, the #1 course in the Caribbean. Be immersed in relaxation at the new 18, 000 square foot Spa & Wellness Center. Play a game of tennis or paddle ball at La Terraza Tennis Center. Explore the countryside by horseback at the Equestrian/Polo Center, or take a shot at some sporting clays at the Shooting Center. In addition, guests enjoy beautiful beaches and pools, gourmet cuisine, shopping, a full service Marina, and the extraordinary Altos de Chavon artists’ village.

5178.description: The comfortable and practical Imperial Laguna Cancun is located in a peaceful residential area of Cancun, in the hotel zone. In the vicinity, guests will find Plaza Caracol, a large shopping center as well as a number of nightclubs and restaurants, as well as the Cancun Convention Centre. The hotel is a 15-minute drive from the City of Cancún and 25 minutes from Cancún International Airport.

5183.description: This hotel is situated in the leisure district of Cancún, just a short walk to the town centre, where guests will discover countless restaurants, shops and nightlife venues. Links to the public transport network are to be found directly outside of the hotel. This accommodation establishment comprises a total of 410 rooms and features a number of in-house facilities. The comfortable rooms come with an en-suite bathroom and are well-appointed with amenities to ensure a pleasant stay. In the outdoor complex, guests can enjoy a freshwater swimming pool and relax on a sun terrace. Sports enthusiasts may make use of the in-house gym and tennis facilitiesSMOKE FREE PROPERTY

5185.description: The luxury couples-only hotel Sun Palace offers an exclusive oceanfront location, only a short drive from popular Cancun attractions, and provides state-of-the-art accommodations and exceptional on-site facilities and amenities. It is just a few minutes walk to the town centre where guests will discover many bars, restaurants and nightlife venues. Guests can easily discover top-rated golfing at the nearby golf clubs. Stunning Mayan archaeological sites along with an endless variety of water sports are also easily accessible. SMOKE FREE PROPERTY

5186.description: The 4. 5-star Moon Palace Cancun - All Inclusive offers comfort and convenience whether you're on business or holiday in Cancun. The property offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Facilities like free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour room service, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, ticket service are readily available for you to enjoy. All rooms are designed and decorated to make guests feel right at home, and some rooms come with linens, towels, whirlpool bathtub, air conditioning, alarm clock. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Convenience and comfort make Moon Palace Cancun - All Inclusive the perfect choice for your stay in Cancun.

5263.description: Boasting a convenient position, this modern and elegant hotel is ideal when visitors come for business at Alcobendas or Madrid's city centre. The property is easily accessible by car and sits a mere 15 minutes from the international airport, being the ideal choice of accommodation for business people or anyone visiting Madrid for leisure. In the surrounding area, visitors will find a popular commercial area and several golf courses. Guests can choose between several accommodation types, ranging from comfortable guest rooms to luxurious suites . All the accommodation units enjoy a warm and bright decoration in soothing tones and superior materials. The hotel offers a free shuttle service to Alcobendas and the international airport. Visitors can also relax at the heated pool at the hotel's terrace.

5271.description: Your Hotel in Madrid. It is located in a privileged place in the Spanish capital, in the heart of the Gran Via and just a few minutes walk from the Puerta del Sol, the Plaza Mayor and the old Hadsburg Madrid. The hotel has a stylish interior design and guests have a variety of services at their disposition. It is surrounded by theatres, cinemas, department stores and restaurants, as well as being magnificently communicated with the metro and bus network. The airport is 13 kilometers away.

5279.description: The Pullman Madrid Airport & Feria hotel is just a few steps away from the IFEMA - Feria de Madrid exhibition center and opposite the Palacio de Congresos conference center. Its privileged location and airport transfer service make it ideal for business trips in the capital. Take advantage of relaxation areas such as the terrace or the pool and enjoy excellent cuisine at the gourmet restaurant, El Patio, or specialty cocktails at Cosmopolitan Bar. Book now and raise a toast with us in this upscale hotel.

5281.description:
Set on a pedestrian street in Madrid's lively Puerta del Sol district, Petit Palace Arenal is just a 2-minute walk from Sol and Ópera Metro Stations. The Royal Palace and the Teatro Real are within 650 metres, and Plaza Mayor is only steps away in the historic centre of Madrid. Museums, theatres and a wide range of bars, cafés and restaurants are all within a 2-minute walk. 

The hotel occupies a historic building that preserves original features such as its French windows and marble reception. The bright rooms have contemporary décor and a flat-screen TV, and free WiFi is available throughout the hotel. 

A buffet breakfast with healthy products is served each morning in the hotel restaurant, beneath its original vaulted ceiling. The 24-hour reception offers free bicycle rental, subject to availability, as well as reduced parking rates at the nearby Plaza de las Descalzas car park. Madrid-Barajas Airport can be reached in around 45 minutes by Metro or bus. With its location and its distinctive historic building, Petit Palace Arenal is the perfect base for exploring the enchanting Spanish capital.

5282.description: This charming hotel enjoys a convenient location in Lisbon, just a two-minute walk from Intendente metro station and 15 minutes from Avenida da Liberdade, with its plentiful entertainment, shopping, and dining options. Marquês de Pombal Square and Eduardo VII Park are two kilometers from the hotel, and Lisbon International Airport is about a 15-minute drive away. The air-conditioned guest rooms are decorated in various styles, yet each offers amenities for a comfortable stay, including a private bathroom with a hairdryer, a flat-screen TV, and a safe. Guests can enjoy a delicious continental breakfast buffet daily, and complimentary on-site parking is available. A TV lounge provides a relaxing space at the end of the day.

5300.description: Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including a health club, a sauna, and a seasonal outdoor pool. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at Made in Athens, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Palaio Faliro? This hotel has 11496 square feet (1068 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. A shuttle from the airport to the hotel is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.

5301.description: The Rio Athens Hotel, housed in a neoclassical building on a quiet pedestrian street in central Athens, offers a blend of modern and classic styles. Close to both the Plaka district and the Acropolis, this fully restored hotel provides comfortable rooms equipped with air conditioning, private bathrooms, satellite TV, minibars, and direct telephones. The nearby Metaxourghio metro station ensures easy access to the rest of the city. Guests can enjoy Greek specialties and drinks in the hotel's tranquil restaurant, while a spacious meeting room caters to business travelers.

5327.description: Immerse yourself in the world of art at Pol & Grace Hotel by enjoying a unique room, where the walls capture the essence of the artists and designers who have participated in artistic residencies in our facilities, creating an atmosphere full of inspiration and originality'. Pol & Grace Hotel is located just 100 metres from Barcelona's Plaça Molina and Sant Gervasi train stations. It offers spacious, air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen satellite TV, free Wi-Fi and a working area with unlimited coffee and tea from 10:30 am. All rooms at Pol & Grace Hotel include a minibar, a free safe and the bathrooms are fully equipped with toiletries. The property serves a buffet breakfast with fresh, seasonal regional produce. Vegetarian and gluten-free options are available daily. There is also a 24-hour reception with taxi service, tourist information and private parking. Fontana Metro Station is 600 metres away and offers direct connections to Plaza Catalunya Square, Las Ramblas and Park Güell. The property is a 2-minute walk from the famous Gracia district, where guests can find numerous shops, restaurants and bars.

5366.description: Located in Madrid's vibrant Chamberí district, this charming hotel is just a short walk from the city center and a plethora of bars, restaurants, and nightclubs. The Iglesia metro station is a mere 140 meters away, providing easy access to the city's public transport network. Completely renovated in 2011, the hotel boasts a modern and stylish design. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a reception area, daily newspapers, and complimentary Wi-Fi. The cozy, comfortably furnished rooms offer a perfect retreat and feature en-suite bathrooms with hairdryers and central heating. A safe, internet access, and a minibar/refrigerator are also provided.

5370.description: This modern hotel enjoys a convenient location in Cerdanyola, surrounded by the university, the Parc Tecnològic del Vallès, and stunning natural scenery. Barcelona is a 20-minute drive away, and the Cerdanyola Del Vallès railway station is less than 2. 5 kilometers from the hotel. This elegant establishment boasts state-of-the-art facilities and a wide array of high-quality services. Guests can relax in spacious, elegant rooms appointed with comfortable furniture and top-notch amenities for a thoroughly enjoyable stay. A varied and wholesome buffet breakfast is available, and the on-site café serves delicious meals. The hotel also offers meeting facilities and an outdoor pool for refreshment on warm days. Guests arriving by car can use the outdoor parking.

5390.description: Apartments in the peaceful outskirts of Barcelona, well connected to the centre and the airport, only ten minutes by car, as well as some of the main attractions in the north-east of the capital such as the Camp Nou stadium, Conference Centre and Cervantes Park within easy reach, as well as the tram that connects it to the historic quarter just five minutes away on foot. With apartments that accommodate up to 4 guests, it offers facilities and services that are ideal for families, groups of friends or long stays, such as a swimming pool, sauna, gym, restaurant and parking to make car trips easy. In the apartments we offer a complete cleaning service, including change of bed linen and sheets, every 6 nights of stay. For stays of less than 6 days, or if you wish to increase the cleaning frequency, you can hire an additional service for only €20 vat included per service. Following our policy of optimizing resources and caring for the environment, we will change your towels every 3 days during your stay. If you wish, you can hire an additional towel change service for €8 vat included per change. Reception will be open from 12h to 20h every day, out of those times clients can auto check-in themselves through a kiosk.

5401.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in Sant Just Desvern, just a 10-minute drive from the airport and a 20-minute tram ride from the city center. A wide range of excellent facilities and services are easily accessible. The inviting hotel has a charming design, and the refined guest rooms offer comfort and excellent amenities. For business travelers, there's a conference room, while a café and bar provide spaces to relax. Guests can enjoy a workout in the gym or a game of squash, followed by relaxation in the sauna. A wonderful breakfast is served each morning.

name.content: Crown Paradise Club Cancun All Inclusive

5403.description: Crown Paradise Club Hotel is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Cancun. The hotel offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. 24-hour room service, Wi-Fi in public areas, car park, room service, babysitting are there for guest's enjoyment. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer whirlpool bathtub, non smoking rooms, air conditioning, heating, mini bar to ensure a restful night. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include hot tub, fitness center, sauna, golf course (within 3 km), outdoor pool. Discover all Cancun has to offer by making Crown Paradise Club Hotel your base.

5425.description: NH Barcelona Eixample, formerly known as NH Máster, is set in the residential Eixample district. The lively Passeig de Gracia with designer shops and trendy restaurants is only a 15-minute walk away, as are Gaudi's famous Casa Batlló and Casa Milà. Close to the Hospital Clínic metro stop, guests have direct links to the Sagrada Familia Church, Plaza España and the Fira de Barcelona exhibition center. The Sants train station is only two stops away, with direct access to the airport and city surrounding areas. NH Barcelona Eixample has 81 modern soundproof rooms all equipped with air-conditioning and free Wi-Fi. There are three superior rooms and a Junior Suite that has a large terrace and street view. A large breakfast is offered daily with a varied selection of local and international goods. For fresh snacks, a quick drink or some ice-cream, guests can use the self-service 24/7 Open Bar. Around the hotel, guests can find some of the best gastronomical offerings in the city, including lively tapas bars, a-la-carte restaurants and lovely lunch spots. For meetings, there are 2 meeting rooms with capacity for up to 100 people. Coffee breaks and snacks can be arranged by NH Barcelona Eixample staff.

5445.description: The Tesoro Manzanillo All Inclusive is a great family-friendly hotel which enjoys a great beachfront location in the renowned area of Manzanillo, on the southern coast of Mexico and boasts a private access to its own secluded beach in La Audiencia. The hotel provides unlimited services and great facilities, such as a pool bar with ocean views. Within a few minutes' walk guests will reach the centre where a good selection of nightclubs, bars and restaurants can be found. Backed by Sierra Madres Mountains, this idyllic setting will guarantee its guests a delightful stay.

5463.description: Located on top of the highest of Lisbon’s 7 hills, Senhora do Monte offers a panoramic bar with wide views of Lisbon, the Tagus River and the São Jorge Castle. The air-conditioned rooms of Albergaria Senhora are light and spacious. Each include a TV and a private bathroom with bath and shower. Some rooms include a balcony. After a good night’s sleep, guests can have breakfast on the charming terrace and enjoy the views of Lisbon while sipping from their coffee. Albergaria is located in the Graça district of old Lisbon, a 15-minute walk from the Martim Moniz Metro Station.

5517.description: Located in the most representative sector of Barcelona's commercial life, the GUITART Grand Passage is a cosy Boutique Hotel that offers generous rooms and suites, and familiar treatment, in the centre of Barcelona. The ideal hotel for the organisation of exclusive corporate events, it has a modern convention room equipped with the latest audiovisual technology.

5558.description: The NH Collection Lisboa Liberdade, an elegant and newly renovated hotel, is directly situated on Avenida de Liberdade. Conveniently located in the Tivoli Forum area, Lisbon Airport is just 5 km away. For guests seeking local tourist attractions, São Jorge Castle is only 2 km away, while the Chiado Museum and the Santa Maria Maior de Lisboa cathedral are a short walk from NH Collection Lisboa Liberdade. The 83 modern rooms decorated with bright colors and hardwood floors feature luxurious mattresses and a choice of pillows. Some rooms offer amazing views of the São Jorge Castle and the Tagus River. Guests can enjoy a healthy and balanced breakfast buffet including fruits, yogurts and breads. The hotel's Restaurante Do Teatro offers a selection of international, local and Mediterranean cuisine and a cozy lobby bar invites guests to cocktails, wine and light meals. For a panoramic view during the warmer season the Ático by NH bar is located on the 11th floor and has a rooftop pool with lounge chairs, towels and a bar that serves drinks and light meals. The hotel's multi-function room can accommodate up to 40 people and is fully equipped for business events as well as private parties.

5560.description: This modern city hotel enjoys a spectacular contemporary design and is conveniently located close to Lisboa's Saldanha Square less than five minutes' walk from two metro stations, thus providing easy access to the historic centre and its famous attractions. The Gulbenkian Museum, the Centre for Modern Art and the beautiful park of Eduardo VII are within walking distance and the international airport can be reached within a 10-minute drive. The luminous guest rooms feature a trendy, modern décor with hardwood floors and private en suite bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Guests might take advantage of in-room Wi-Fi internet access or venture down to the bar to unwind after a busy day. The hotel also offers 24-hour reception, room service and a business centre, all for a pleasant stay in Lisbon.

5707.description: Relax and unwind with massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at Gio’s Restaurant, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Venice? This hotel has 1378 square feet (128 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 169 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and espresso makers.

5708.description: The Hotel Papadopoli Mgallery, a member of the MGallery Collection, is located in the historic city center, close to the Grand Canal and Constitution Bridge, which leads to Piazzale Roma and the train station. 100 rooms and suites with furnishings reflecting the elegance and splendor of the 18th century, and views of the Tolentini Canal and Papadopoli Gardens.

5709.description: This upscale hotel revels in its stunning setting, lying at the heart of the captivating city of Venice. The hotel is located on the exclusive shopping street, Via XXII Marzo, lying just a short distance away from St. Marco Square. This wonderful hotel is located within easy access of a host of bars, shops and entertainment venues, as well as the many attractions that this impressive city has to offer. Links to the public transport network are to be found just 100 metres away. This early 19th-century hotel enjoys a long history, featuring a stunning architectural design, which blends effortlessly with its culturally-rich surroundings. This family-owned hotel greets guests with warm hospitality and unrivalled service, tempting them into a world of luxury and style. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, featuring modern amenities for the utmost in convenience. The Gym & Spa area offers a MINI POOL JACUZZI equipped with a double water/air massage system, a TURKISH BATH decorated with Bisazza mosaics, embellished with silver leaf tesserae and for fitness enthusiasts a GYM equipped with special wooden tools With hydraulic mechanism including rowing machines, shoulder-rests, benches and dumbbells. The access, for a fee, will be allowed only to the guests of the hotel reservation. The Gym & SPA is open daily from 9 to 22.

5711.description: This establishment is located in the city centre of Venice and was established in 1630. The property is close to the San Marco Square and the nearest station is S. Lucia. The Hotel has a bar and a conference room. Rooms feature 18th-century Venetian-style furnishings. All 50 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning. The bathrooms are in marble and hard stone.

5713.description: The Royal San Marco undoubtedly has a perfect location, set in the very heart of the world's most romantic city. Housed in an ancient building, the classic décor and the vintage furniture create a warm, cosy atmosphere reflecting the city's ambiance. Just crossing a bridge, guests are already on world-famous St. Mark's Square with the beautiful Campanile, the St. Mark's Basilica and the Doge's Palace. Other attractions such as the Rialto Bridge are within a 5-minute walk. An ideal romantic getaway for couples and those about to be.

5714.description: Overlooking the Venetian lagoon and just steps from San Marco, Hotel Danieli Venice is a 5-star property with elegant and spacious accommodations. The rooftop restaurant, Terrazza Danieli, offers spectacular lagoon views. This historic hotel showcases majestic Venetian architecture dating back to the 14th century. All rooms and suites feature an LCD satellite TV, air conditioning, and an Italian-marble bathroom with a bathrobe and slippers. Some rooms offer views of the lagoon.

5715.description: This luxurious hotel boasts an enviable setting in the unique, romantic city of Venice. The hotel is centrally situated close to La Fenice Theatre and is just a few minutes walking distance from the renowned St Marco's Square. Guests can enjoy a romantic Gondola ride through the waterways of the city and enjoy an exclusive tour of the famous attractions and sights. Guests can enjoy a delectable traditional meal in one of the city's exquisite restaurants, followed by a 'gelato' or sumptuous Italian coffee. Marco Polo Airport is conveniently situated a mere 6 kms from the hotel. The hotel enjoys an attractive architectural style, alluring guests into the elegant surroundings of the lobby. The glorious guest rooms are beautifully designed, providing a cocoon of peace and serenity in which to enjoy restful slumber at the end of the day.

5716.description: With a stay at All'Angelo Art Hotel in Venice (Venice City Center), you'll be steps from St. Mark's Square and St. Mark's Basilica. This 4-star hotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from Doge's Palace and 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from Rialto Bridge. Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Make yourself at home in one of the 56 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. A cruise ship terminal shuttle is available for a surcharge. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. San Teodoro - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi- St. Mark's Square - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi- St. Mark's Basilica - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- St Mark's Campanile - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Bridge of Sighs - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Church of San Zaccaria - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Museo Correr - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- San Zaccaria Waterbus - 0. 4 km/0. 2 mi- Riva degli Schiavoni - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- Marco Polo's Home - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- T Fondaco Dei Tedeschi - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Rialto Bridge - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Doge's Palace - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Teatro Malibran - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Basilica di San Giovanni e Paolo - 0. 6 km/0. 3 mi. The nearest major airport is Marco Polo Airport (VCE) - 13. 7 km/8. 5 mi.

5717.description: Our enchanting five-star hotel is located on Venice Lido, a sun-kissed island surrounded by turquoise waters and golden beaches, just a 15-minute complimentary boat ride from St. Mark's Square. Relax in splendid rooms or suites, unwind by the pool, or enjoy golf at a nearby course. This luxurious retreat is ideal for family holidays, romantic getaways, conferences, weddings, and special events. The hotel features two restaurants, a bar, a conference center, and a pool and wellness center. The 196 rooms are equipped with luxury bathrooms, coffee-making facilities, minibars, safes, complimentary Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and bathrobes and slippers.

5720.description: This elegant venue enjoys a quiet location in a small plaza, right in the heart of Venice. It is just 50 metres from St. Mark's Square and a 5-minute walk from the Vallaresso stop of the water bus. Teatro Goldoni, La Fenice, the Bridge of Sights, the Ducal Palace and many of the other landmarks that attract millions of visitors are all within 5 minutes on foot. The historic building of the venue welcomes you to the perfect spot from where one can let himself/herself be seduced by the captivating atmosphere of the city. With its traditional Venetian style and elegance, the hotel will make each and every stay unforgettable. Guests can relax with a refreshing beverage in hand at the flowery terrace on the top floor, where they can also start their day with a hearty breakfast during the hottest months of the year. Please consider: Our hotel is located inside an ancient building, so there is no elevator.

name.content: Hotel Savoia e Jolanda, WorldHotels Elite

5724.description: Just 200 metres from Saint Mark's Square in Venice, Savoia & Jolanda is on the waterfront of Riva degli Schiavoni. It offers an elegant restaurant, a well equipped gym and free Wi-Fi throughout. Venetian-style rooms at the Savoia & Jolanda include air conditioning, wood-beamed ceilings, Murano glass lamps, and satellite TV. The private bathroom has soft bathrobes plus slippers. Some rooms have lagoon views. The hotel is composed of two wings, the Savoia wing is set on the waterfront, and the Jolanda wing faces Campo San Zaccaria. Breakfast is buffet style while the Terrazza Principessa restaurant serves Italian cuisine in its spacious dining hall or out on the terrace overlooking San Giorgio Island. The property is well serviced by the vaporetto water bus lines 41 and 51, which connect with the Piazzale Roma car park and Santa Lucia Train Station in 25 minutes. The nearest water bus stop is San Zaccaria. Castello is a great choice for travellers interested in museums, Old Town exploring and culture.

5726.description: Located in Venice's vibrant San Marco district, Hotel Diana, housed in two buildings, one a renovated 15th-century Venetian residence, offers an elegant and sophisticated retreat just steps from Piazza San Marco. Its twenty-seven soundproof rooms, spread across four floors with elevator access, feature cozy Venetian-style furnishings and modern amenities. Attention to detail and a passion for Venetian tradition are evident throughout, creating a memorable Venetian experience.

5749.description: The Hilton Milan hotel is just 200m from Milan Central railway station and the city's airport links. This elegant Milan hotel boasts an Executive Lounge with an outdoor terrace and features wireless internet access throughout the hotel. Do business in one of our 13 meeting rooms for 2-200 people, exercise in the well-equipped fitness room or enjoy the hotel's Italian cuisine. Exciting cultural attractions such as the shopping district, Duomo Cathedral, the La Scala Opera, Sforza Castle and Art Gallery are all located approximately 2km from this Milan hotel. Explore the peaceful surroundings of Lake Como, only an hour away by train and find peace away from the bustling streets of the city. Make your stay special by selecting an Executive Room and enjoy access to the exclusive Executive Lounge. Indulge in appetizers at the cosmopolitan Lobby Bar & Lounge or dine on freshly prepared local favorites at the Pacific Milano Restaurant. The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Business Center, Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently **not available**: Complimentary Evening Social, Executive Lounge

5752.description: The NH Collection Milano Touring hotel is centrally located in Milan, right next to the lush green Montanelli Public Park. The Milano Centrale train station is only 10 minutes away, while you can reach the historic city center within 15 minutes. You can enjoy Milan's boutique shopping and delicious Italian meals at restaurants near the hotel. The Repubblica metro station is close by and offers guests easy links to the rest of the city. The 279 rooms at NH Collection Milano Touring feature either classic or contemporary decor. They are spacious and each comes with free Wi-Fi. Additionally, some of the rooms have spectacular views of the Piazza della Repubblica and Milan's skyline. Both hot and cold dishes, including fresh pastries and delicious Italian cold cuts, are served on our breakfast buffet and can be enjoyed with a cup of fragrant brewed coffee or tea. Lunch and dinner are served at the Camelia's Yard Restaurant. Sip on a cocktail at our stylish hotel bar or have an authentic Italian espresso. Guests can cycle around Milan by using our bike rental service. There are also 8 meeting rooms for up to 100 people.

5753.description: Perfectly positioned in Largo Augusto, in the heart of Milan’s iconic Golden District, between Via Montenapoleone and Via della Spiga, Tivoli President Milano offers privileged access to the city’s most renowned attractions, including the Duomo, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele and La Scala Theatre. Designed to provide a unique sense of place, the hotel features 239 elegantly refurbished rooms, including 60 bright suites and junior suites with balconies. Each space blends refined materials, contemporary design and generous layouts. The highlight is the 150 sqm Presidential Suite, overlooking the Duomo and featuring a private rooftop terrace—an ideal setting for events and special occasions. Guests unwind in a wellness spa focused on longevity, a peaceful retreat dedicated to relaxation in the vibrant city center. The hotel now operates under the Tivoli Hotels & Resorts brand, with new services gradually being introduced. Some of the renovated rooms are already available for booking and stays.

5754.description: A modern homage to a legendary name, The Carlton reveals Milan's more soulful rhythms, softened to your pace. Fulvio Pierangelini’s classic dishes expressing joy in every bite in the fine-dining restaurant. Cocktails with a twist in The Carlton Bar as aperitivo hour turns golden. Instant radiance and results-driven rituals at the Irene Forte Spa. Interiors that pair Milanese style with the warmth and intimacy of a private residence. An iconic address. An ode to Milan.

5755.description: The Sina De La Ville, located in the heart of Milan in the fashion and cultural district, now unveils a brand new look in its common areas, capturing the dynamic yet refined spirit of the city. The lobby, the lounge bar and the library have been transformed with a sophisticated contemporary style. The restaurant Il Vizio, also brand new renovated, has been awarded as fine gourmet restaurant in Milan.

5756.description: Steeped in history, this opulent hotel, opened in 1863, retains the charm of a classic Milanese residence. A favorite among prominent figures from culture, entertainment, fashion, and business, it's located in the heart of the city, steps from the financial district, La Scala Opera House, and the Fashion District. The Duomo Cathedral is a short nine-minute walk away. With its celebrated bars and restaurants, the hotel offers a luxurious and discreet retreat, perfect for both leisure and business travelers. Guests will appreciate the cozy, retro atmosphere of this aristocratic 'old Milan' building, featuring refined and unique rooms.

name.content: Excelsior Hotel Gallia, a Luxury Collection Hotel

5757.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of recreational amenities such as an indoor pool, sauna, and 24-hour fitness center. This Belle Époque hotel also provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. Savor Mediterranean cuisine at Terrazza Gallia Bar, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at one of the two bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (6:30 AM to 11:00 AM) for a fee. The hotel offers complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Milan? This hotel boasts 18, 299 square feet (1, 700 square meters) of event space, including a conference center and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Relax in one of the 235 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your bed includes down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is provided, along with satellite programming. Bathrooms feature rainfall showers and complimentary toiletries. The hotel is conveniently located near Piazza della Repubblica (0. 6 mi), Piazza Lima (0. 6 mi), and Corso Buenos Aires (0. 7 mi).

5758.description: Enjoy garden views and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. This hotel also features discounted access to a nearby fitness facility and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite at Clotilde Bistrot, a bar/lounge specializing in Italian cuisine, or enjoy room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary daily reception. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (7:00 AM to 10:30 AM) for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and express check-out. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself at home in one of the 99 guestrooms featuring free minibar items and flat-screen televisions with digital programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer: Piazza della Repubblica - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi; Indro Montanelli Public Gardens - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi; Corso Como - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi; Piazza Gae Aulenti - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi; 10 Corso Como - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi; Via Montenapoleone Fashion District - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi; and more. The nearest airports are Linate (LIN), Milan Malpensa (MXP), and Bergamo Orio al Serio (BGY). The preferred airport is Linate (LIN).

5759.description: The iH Hotels Milano Ambasciatori is a 4-star hotel located in the heart of Milan, a few steps from the Duomo and the main shopping streets. 103 large and welcoming rooms, mainly furnished in a classic and elegant style, while on the top floors you can find rooms with a very modern design and recently renovated. Some rooms offer a suggestive and unforgettable view of the spiers of the Cathedral, others of Piazza Cesare Beccaria and the historic center of the Milanese city. It also has a panoramic bar open all year round. In triple room with child, child must share the bed.

5760.description:
This luxury hotel lies on the outskirts of the centre of Milan. Public transport connections may be found only 30 m away and bars and pubs are also within 300 m of the hotel. The airport is approximately 38 km away.

Built in 1984, this conference hotel offers a total of 315 rooms spread over 6 floors. There is a garden, a lobby, a 24-hour reception, a currency exchange facility directly in front of the hotel, a safe, a lift, a cloakroom, a TV room, a café and a lobby bar as well as a car park available for guests' use. The inviting air-conditioned à la carte restaurant has a separate non-smoking area. Business guests may make use of the conference room and the public Internet terminal. Room and laundry services as well as well as medical assistance are all available.

The bedrooms are fitted with an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, a telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a radio, a stereo, a minibar, Internet access, central heating and a safe.

name.content: Duo Milan Porta Nuova, A Tribute Portfolio Hote

5761.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from the garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a meal at Duo Bistrot or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary daily reception. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily (6:30 AM to 10:30 AM) for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Milan? This hotel has 883 square feet (82 square meters) of space, consisting of a conference center and five meeting rooms. An airport shuttle is available 24 hours a day (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 239 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions.

5762.description: Starhotels Tourist has recently renovated its accommodations, boasting the refined and elegant atmosphere that Starhotels always guarantees. The numerous modern amenities present in each room include air conditioning, mini-bar, satellite TV, safety box and free WiFi internet access. The Starhotels' Starbed (a soft feather bed) providing a goodnight's sleep, will guarantee you a pleasant stay with Starhotels. The hotel is located in the business district in the north-east of Milan, just a few steps from the new Arcimboldi Theatre and Milano Central Train Station is approximately 5km from the hotel, a 20 minutes' ride by taxi. The hotel provides a convention complex with 7 meeting rooms, equipped with the most modern technology. The new fitness room and the American bar L'Agora provide a relaxing break. The bar is open until midnight and it serves delicious cocktails. Starhotels Tourist's restaurant La Cuccagnina reopens after a thorough renovation, with a new ambience and a new menu including local and international delicacies. Parking is also available at an extra cost. *It is mandatory for all our guests to show a valid ID card with photograph at the time of check-in.

5763.description: The ibis Milano Centro hotel is located in the center of Milan, a stone's throw from the Milano Centrale train station and the Repubblica metro stop. An ideal base for exploring the cathedral, Milan's La Scala opera house and the fashion district. The rooms are soundproofed and air conditioned and all have free WIFI. Comfortable meeting rooms also make this the perfect place for conferences and meetings. The bar is open 24 hours a day, and the Lineauno Bistro' restaurant serves lunch and dinner.

5765.description: The a&o Milano Ca Granda is now the third location of the a&o hostels in Italy – after the a&o Venezia Mestre, the affordable hostel in Venice, and the a&o Firenze Campo di Marte, the inexpensive hostel in Florence! Here you can stay overnight in a convenient location at a favourable price without having to compromise on service and comfort. Cleanliness and safety are part of our standards, so you can feel completely at ease from your arrival to your departure, whether in your hotel room, at the cosy bar or in the large lobby. Whether you are staying in a single or double room – the a&o Hostel Milano Ca Granda offers you the right accommodation category and in all rooms a private bathroom with shower/WC as well as toiletries such as shower gel and hand soap. Extras at the a&o Milano Ca Granda that are subject to a charge include, for example, the breakfast buffet, early check-in, late check-out, taking pets into the room or car parking (all subject to availability). If you're interested, it's best to book these services when you make your reservation. The team at the a&o Hotel and Hostel is looking forward to your visit to Milan!

5767.description: An ideal place for both business and leisure clients, UNA Hotels Century Milano features a spacious office-lounge in all its 144 junior suites. Some rooms are equipped with special features. There are 4 meeting rooms with natural light, accommodating up to 70 people. The hotel includes a bar, a restaurant with patio, and a garage nearby. The UNA Hotels Century Milano is just 200m from the Metro Station, the Milano Centrale main railway station, and from the Bus terminals for the Malpensa and Linate Orio al Serio Airports.

5768.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). For lunch or dinner, stop by La Brasserie de Milan, a restaurant that specializes in Mediterranean cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Milan? This hotel has 28729 square feet (2669 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 17 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 323 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions.

5769.description: The Hotel Blaise & Francis has an excellent location just 10 minutes from the Fiera Milano Exhibition Centre. We are just 1. 5 kilometers from Picanhas Churrascaria, two kilometers from Duomo Cathedral, Brera Gallery and La Scala Theatre and only three kilometers from Via Montenapoleone. Our hotel is characterized by a breathtaking panoramic view of the city. Comfortable and spacious rooms, conference and meeting facilities are featured. We have an on-site restaurant, bar/lounge, concierge, safe deposit box at reception. Our guest rooms have cable or satellite television, mini bar and hair dryer. This property has joined the Stay for the Planet project. It undertakes to manage the hotel activities in a sustainable manner by monitoring consumptions, reducing the presence of disposable plastic, taking energy efficiency actions for a positive impact on the environment.

5770.description: This elegant hotel lies just 400 metres from the historical old town of Milan. The hotel is situated just 200 metres from the Repubblica underground station, enjoying ease of access to other areas of the city. This modern hotel offers guests a great location from which to explore the attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. The hotel dates back to the late 19th century, retaining elements of classical style and elegance. The guest rooms and apartments are beautifully designed, bathing visitors in peace and serenity. The hotel features a wide range of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of discerning business and leisure travellers alike.

5771.description: Its favourable location and the precious details of its furnishings make UNA Hotel Scandinavia a place to satisfy the expectations of the most demanding business customers. It offers 153 rooms, fitness center with sauna, and 6 meeting rooms accommodating up to 170 people. The restaurant provides an excellent cuisine and its lush garden is ideal for business lunches, dinners and outdoor events. A large garage is available for customers and free WiFi connection.

5773.description: UNAHOTELS Mediterraneo Milano is a modern and comfortable hotel located in a neighbourhood built in the early twentieth century called 'Old Milan Style', near the ancient Roman Gate of the city. Newly restyled, this elegant 4-star hotel is ideally situated in a lively part of the city, just moments away from various transport links and within a short walk of Milan's most treasured attractions. With contemporary and refined rooms and suites, a popular Mediterranean-inspired restaurant, three functional meeting rooms and an extensive selection of tailored services, UNAHOTELS Mediterraneo Milano offers warm Italian hospitality and urban practicality for business and leisure travellers alike. The hotel has been recently refurbished with using the best brands of Italian design. The 4 star hotel is close to the main hospital Policlinico, and only 50 meters away from the yellow subway line of Porta Romana that reaches the historic Milan center in a few minutes. Few subway stops separate the UNA Hotel Mediterraneo from the Duomo of Milan, the Vittorio Emanuele Gallery, the fashion district of Monte Napoleone Street where you can spend a day shopping or window shopping.

5774.description:
CityLife Hotel Poliziano is an elegant 4-star hotel located in one of Milan’s most lively and well-connected areas. Its strategic position, just a short walk from Fiera Milano City, makes it an ideal choice for both business and leisure travellers. The Duomo, the city’s main cultural landmarks, and Milan’s best shopping streets can all be reached in just a few minutes by car or metro. 

The hotel offers bright and comfortable rooms, with views over the Milan skyline or the peaceful greenery of the inner courtyards. Designed to combine style and functionality, the property provides a welcoming atmosphere, modern comforts, and easy access to the city’s main attractions, making it a perfect base for discovering Milan.

5775.description: With a stay at Melia Milano in Milan (Fiera), you'll be within a 15-minute walk of Milan Convention Centre and Casa Milan. This luxury hotel is 1. 1 mi (1. 8 km) from Piazza Portello and 3. 3 mi (5. 3 km) from Piazza del Duomo. Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features babysitting (surcharge) and a television in a common area. Make yourself at home in one of the 291 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and designer toiletries. Enjoy a meal at Mamì or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and a 24-hour front desk. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Milan Convention Centre - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- San Siro Clinical Institute - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- CityLife Shopping District - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Casa Milan - 1. 1 km / 0.

5776.description: The NH Milano Machiavelli hotel is housed in a modern building in the heart of Milan. Just across the street there is a swimming pool, while the Giardini di Porta Venezia Park is within a five-minute walk. For some more traditional attractions, you can walk to the Duomo di Milano in 20 minutes and Corso Buenos Aires, a popular shopping street, is just two blocks away. The Porta Venezia station is also close by, connecting guests to everywhere in the city. NH Milano Machiavelli has 103 spacious rooms that are decorated in a natural color scheme and feature sleek hardwood floors. For families, we can provide cots or a third bed, otherwise, for more comfort, book one of Junior Suites that has two bathrooms and a separate sitting area. We serve a hearty and varied breakfast buffet every morning which includes healthy options. Enjoy your lunch or dinner in the contemporary atmosphere of Caffè Niccolò that offers an impressive local and international menu. Here, you will also find a laid-back bar. During the warmer months, relax in the outdoors Green Lounge. We offer extra services such as bike rentals and a complimentary ironing room. The hotel also has six meeting rooms for up to 80 people.

5777.description: Discover B&B Hotel Milano Aosta, a modern 3-star hotel located in Piazza Duca D’Aosta, right in front of Milano Central Station. Thanks to its strategic location, you can reach the Duomo and Milan’s historic center in just 4 metro stops (M2/M3 lines). Corso Buenos Aires, famous for shopping and the best fashion boutiques, is just a 10-minute walk away.

5787.description: Situated in Amsterdam's vibrant heart, this hotel seamlessly blends architectural design with unparalleled convenience. Nestled within the Dam pedestrian area, guests enjoy prime access to iconic attractions such as the Royal Palace, Madame Tussauds, and the picturesque canals. A plethora of restaurants, shops, and galleries lie within easy reach, complemented by excellent transport links. Schiphol International Airport is less than 20 km away. Each thoughtfully appointed room offers a comfortable retreat after a day of exploration, boasting modern amenities and distinctive character.

name.content: Sheraton Amsterdam Airp Htl And Conference Center

5788.description: Located near Schiphol Airport, this hotel offers 417 guestrooms with private bathrooms, LED TVs, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, two restaurants (including Commune), 24-hour room service, and a bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel also features a conference center, 30 meeting rooms, and concierge services. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include the World Trade Center Schiphol Airport and the Rijksmuseum Amsterdam Schiphol.

5789.description: The Avenue Hotel enjoys an ideal location in the historical centre of Amsterdam, just a few steps from Dam Square, the very centre of the Dutch capital. It features comfortable rooms and is the perfect starting point to explore this fascinating city. The Royal Palace and Madame Tussaud's are only a 5-minute walk away; the hotel is surrounded by numerous restaurants, bars and pubs. Attractions such as the Red Light District, the State Museum, the van Gogh Museum, the Begijnhof or Rembrandt Square are within walking distance. Amsterdam Central Station can be reached within a few minutes' walk.

5790.description: This hotel is located beside the Singel Canal, only steps from the train station, the Royal Palace, the Koepel Church and Anne Frank's House. Shops and entertainment options lie within walking distance of the hotel. The hotel is 100 m from the nearest links to the public transport network. This elegant 5-storey city hotel was built in the 17th century and comprises a total of 32 rooms. Various facilities include a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk and a bar serving up light snacks and drinks. All our rooms have a private bathroom with hairdryer, cable TV, direct dial telephone, heating, radio/alarm clock and wake up service. A safety deposit box is available in every room. Some of the rooms have a view on the canal (on request).

5791.description: With a stay at Radisson Blu Hotel Amsterdam Airport Schiphol in Schiphol-Rijk, you'll be in the business district, within a 15-minute drive of Vondelpark and Business Park Schiphol-Rijk. This upscale hotel is 11. 8 mi (19 km) from Van Gogh Museum and 11. 9 mi (19. 1 km) from Leidseplein. Don't miss out on recreational opportunities including a 24-hour fitness center and bicycles to rent. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Make yourself at home in one of the 281 guestrooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Grab a bite to eat at OTIUM Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). To-go breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Schiphol-Rijk? This hotel has 12572 square feet (1168 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 15 meeting rooms. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle at scheduled times and a train station pick-up service.

5792.description: The Albus is a luxury Dutch family-run 4* boutique hotel. In addition to its modern and contemporary design, the hotel offers a warm, welcoming atmosphere with genuine and personalized service. The hotel is located in the heart of Amsterdam, in the middle of the canal district, within walking distance of all highlights such as museums, canal tours, restaurants, bars, and terraces. With a Green Key Gold certification, this eco-friendly hotel offers 72 stylish rooms, all equipped with designer furniture and featuring Smart TVs. The rooms boast super comfortable beds, a bathroom with a walk-in rain shower, a coffee machine, individually controlled air conditioning for heating and cooling, laptop safes, and free Wi-Fi. For families, the hotel offers Sweet Family Suites, suitable for 2 adults and 2 children under 9 years old, or a 'Connecting Family Room'; these 2 rooms are connected and each has a double bed. Breakfast at Senses consists of a buffet with local and organic products. Start your day with a varied selection of small sweet and savory pastries. Then, choose from egg options, overnight oats with fresh fruit, Eggs Benedict, English muffins, savory or sweet waffles, chickpea salad, and a wide range of hot and cold drinks. The award-winning Senses Restaurant, part of The Albus, is a top fine-dining restaurant inspired by Japanese cuisine with a French flair. Senses offers a chef's menu focused on vegetables, fish, and shellfish from local suppliers, making it the go-to spot for modern food lovers. Looking for more privacy to enjoy a birthday, anniversary, or another special occasion with a small group? Senses has a beautiful private dining room for this purpose. This private space can also be used for meetings, brainstorming sessions, or presentations for up to 8 people. Exclusive events for up to 30 people are also possible.

5794.description: Located near Amsterdam's city center, bordering Oosterpark, this hotel seamlessly blends history with modern design. Original details like the wooden staircase and restored chapel complement the contemporary rooms, café-restaurant, meeting studios, salon, and unique chapel event space. Guests can enjoy a range of experiences, from dining and drinks to work and relaxation. Cozy, modern rooms offer all the amenities and furnishings needed for a restful stay. Room layouts vary within each category; some include a mezzanine level with sleeping quarters upstairs and a seating area below. Please note that while we welcome your preferences at booking, these are subject to availability.

5845.description: Make yourself at home at Mercure, just a stone's throw away from Schiphol. The 4-star Mercure Hotel Amsterdam West is comfortable and easy to access, making it ideal for both business travels and weekend getaways. At the hotel you can find a bar to unwind, restaurant for lunch and dinner and 24 meeting rooms. A delicious breakfast buffet is served daily and the reception is at your service 24/7. All rooms are equipped with a comfortable bed, work desk, TV, safe, air-conditioning and free WiFi.

name.content: Crowne Plaza Berlin City Centre Ku'damm

5846.description: Located in Berlin's Charlottenburg district, the Crowne Plaza Berlin City Centre, an IHG Hotel, is just a short walk from the Berlin Zoo and the Kurfürstendamm. This upscale hotel offers 423 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and private bathrooms. Guests can enjoy a range of amenities, including an indoor pool, sauna, fitness center, and spa treatments. A buffet breakfast is available for a fee, and 24-hour room service is also offered. For business travelers, the hotel provides a business center and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite for a charge. Nearby attractions include the Europa Center and Kaufhaus des Westens.

5848.description: Overlooking Los Angeles Plaza, our hotel is less than five minutes' walk of the luxury boutiques, restaurants, and showrooms of Kurfurstendamm. Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church and Berlin Zoological Garden are also within walking distance. Just 15 minutes from the city center, our 11 meeting rooms offer flexible event space for up to 500 guests.

5849.description: The privately run Hotel Palace Berlin enjoys a prime location in City West, between the Kurfürstendamm, Zoological Garden, and KaDeWe, and sits next to the renowned Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church. Potsdamer Platz and the Brandenburg Gate are just a short train ride away. A Leading Hotel of the World since 2005, this sophisticated hotel offers 278 rooms and suites, a club lounge with skyline views, the House of Gin boasting 150 gins, the boutique restaurant Beef 45, and an 800 sq m spa and fitness center with a pool, sauna, and massage services. The hotel also features 2, 600 sq m of convention space with 18 meeting rooms, 16 of which offer natural daylight. Free Wi-Fi is available in guest rooms and the lobby area.

5851.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center and bicycle rentals. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and on-site shopping. Dine at one of the two restaurants, including Ellipse Lounge, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (surcharge applies). Business travelers appreciate amenities such as complimentary wired internet, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in Berlin? This hotel features 4, 822 square feet (448 square meters) of event space, including a conference center and 12 meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (surcharge applies). Stay in one of the 394 guestrooms featuring LED televisions with cable programming, and complimentary wired and wireless internet. Private bathrooms with showers offer designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Located near the Bauhaus Archive, Tiergarten Park and Nollendorfplatz, the Sheraton Berlin Grand Hotel Esplanade offers convenient access to Berlin's attractions. The preferred airport is Berlin (BER-Brandenburg).

5854.description: This first-class Berlin hotel, conveniently located near the renowned Unter den Linden boulevard, offers easy access to the city's main attractions. Just 300 meters from the underground and 10 km from Tegel Airport, it provides comfortable rooms featuring flat-screen TVs with internet access, in-room safes, and elegant marble bathrooms. Guests can enjoy the hotel's swimming pool, sauna, steam room, fitness center, and restaurants serving international cuisine, along with a bar offering a selection of cocktails. Bookings of more than 5 rooms may be subject to separate policies and additional charges.

5855.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a 24-hour fitness center and bicycles to rent. This Beaux Arts hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy a satisfying meal at Relish Restaurant serving guests of The Westin Grand Berlin. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Berlin? This hotel has 9225 square feet (857 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 10 meeting rooms. Guests may use a bus station shuttle for a surcharge, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 400 guestrooms featuring LED televisions.

5858.description: This wonderful hotel in Berlin's Neukölln district is part of a large convention and entertainment centre. Concerts and Musical Shows are on-site. There are several public transportation links in the surrounding area, bringing guests closer to Berlin's numerous sightseeing attractions. A glass-covered atrium with trees, a terrace and a bridge are all included throughout the four buildings of the hotel. The BER Airport is within a short driving distance. This largest hotel in Berlin offers 1125 rooms and suites, decorated with bright and natural tones. Each room is fitted with satellite TV, desk, air-conditioning, minibar and hair dryer. This hotel offers a variety of restaurants and bars for guests to enjoy international dishes and drinks.

5862.description: NH Collection Berlin Mitte Friedrichstrasse, formerly known as NH Collection Berlin Friedrichstrasse, is located in one of Berlin's most premium locations. Nearby, guests will find the city's top attractions, including Brandenburg Gate, Checkpoint Charlie and the Unter den Linden boulevard. For access to the rest of the city, Friedrichstrasse metro is steps away. The 268 rooms at NH Collection Berlin Mitte Friedrichstrasse welcome guests with a warm contemporary design. Each is outfitted with a Nespresso machine, flat-screen TV and a professional hairdryer, to make guests feel at home. Suites come with separate sitting rooms and dining areas. In the mornings, enjoy a lavish breakfast, with our specialty pancakes and waffles, accompanied by freshly brewed coffee or tea. This is served in a wonderful breakfast room with natural light, high ceilings and bright modern design. The TASTE! Bar and Restaurant offers a varied selection of mouthwatering dishes, from elevated street-food to haute cuisine. To relax and invigorate your body, head to the plunge pool and sauna. Meanwhile, for business meetings, the hotel has 10 function rooms accommodating up to 320 people.

5880.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an indoor pool, a spa tub, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy international cuisine at Ciel Bleu Restaurant, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Need to unwind?
