Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Amsterdam? This hotel has 29063 square feet (2700 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 20 meeting rooms.

5881.description: Set in a historic building that dates back to 1855, Anantara Grand Hotel Krasnapolsky Amsterdam, formerly known as NH Collection Amsterdam Grand Hotel Krasnapolsky, is a landmark in Amsterdam. It is situated right on the main square and enjoys a privileged location overlooking the Royal Palace. Reach many of the city's attractions on foot, such as the Van Gogh Museum, the Anne Frank House and the Rijksmuseum. Amsterdam Central Station is only seven minutes away. Recently renovated, Anantara Grand Hotel Krasnapolsky Amsterdam has 402 spacious contemporary rooms. There are 8 family rooms, 35 apartments with canal views and 10 premium triple rooms. Each has individually controlled air-conditioning, Nespresso machines, rain-effect showers and ultra-comfortable mattresses. The height of luxury is the Royal Suite, spread over two floors. A delectable breakfast is served daily in the grand 19th century Winter Garden. A perfect setting for a wedding, the hotel has 16 meeting rooms for up to 1500 people. Opened in April 2016, Michelin starred The White Room is a true gastronomic delight where Jacob Jan Boerma heads the kitchen. Grand Café Krasnapolsky is ideal for business lunches, enjoying views of the Dam Square. To unwind, head to Bar The Tailor and enjoy a cocktail.

5882.description: The 4-star Novotel Amsterdam City is located in the south of Amsterdam, at an ideal location for both business and leisure travels. The hotel is modern and spacious, offering everything you will need during your stay in the city. Enjoy our delicious daily breakfast, appetizing lunch or dinner in the restaurant or take a moment to unwind at the bar. All rooms are equipped with a minibar, safe, work desk, air conditioning and free WiFi. Take a moment to relax in the sauna or get active in the gym.

5883.description:
Die Port van Cleve is a 4-star hotel located in the heart of Amsterdam, just steps away from Dam Square and within walking distance of the city’s main attractions. Housed in 6 historic buildings dating back to 1870, the hotel combines traditional Dutch charm with modern comfort, making it an excellent choice for leisure and business travelers. 
The rooms are air-conditioned and equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TV, and tea and coffee making facilities. 
Thanks to its prime central location museums, shopping areas and public transport connections are easily accessible, making Die Port van Cleve an ideal base for discovering Amsterdam. 
On-site restaurant Bouillon d’Amsterdam offers a cosy atmosphere with traditional French comfort dishes at affordable prices while Cocktail bar De Blauwe Parade, combines the charm of a traditional Amsterdam pub with a modern cocktail bar.

5884.description: Perfect for de-stressing after a productive meeting or a full day of travelling, the Active Club at Park Plaza Victoria Amsterdam boasts a modern fitness centre, an indoor pool and a Finnish sauna. A solarium and a beauty salon are also available for additional fees. After pampering yourself in the Active Club, settle into your room or suite with free Wi-Fi and order from the 24-hour room service menu. When it's time to explore area attractions, stop by the concierge desk and let the hotel's professional team help you plan the perfect trip.

5885.description: Situated in the heart of Amsterdam, this hotel places you steps from the vibrant Leidse Square and less than 11 km from Schiphol Airport. It's an ideal starting point for exploring the city's cultural treasures, from the nearby Museum Square to Amsterdam's renowned theaters. The Leidse Square itself offers a wealth of shopping and dining experiences. Rooms feature internet access, air conditioning, and various amenities, including home appliances. Select rooms boast canal or Leidseplein views.

5886.description: Located on the foundations of the city wall, this iconic Amsterdam landmark is set on the banks of the river Amstel, Schiphol Airport is less than 12 km away. Experience original Amsterdam luxury at this complex. Since establishing itself as an independent luxury hotel, it has evolved from exclusive hotel in the heart of Amsterdam into a guardian of local culture and craftmanship. The hotel offers a selection of the finest haute cuisine in Amsterdam. Consider as the custodian of Amsterdam's essence, a sophisticated guide into its free-spirited culture and the personal liaison into the world of luxury and comfort. The stylish rooms and suites embrace local heritage with special attention to design detail and modern technology.

5887.description: This hotel enjoys a stunning setting in Amsterdam, lying close to the old centre of the city. Guests can enjoy stunning views over the breathtaking Princes Canal. This wonderful hotel lies within easy access of the main attractions that the city has to offer. The hotel is situated just 500 metres away from links to the public transport network, which offer ease of access to other areas of the city. The hotel enjoys a long history, dating back to the early 18th century. Guests will find themselves bathed in the rich history and culture of the surroundings. The guest rooms enjoy a style of classical elegance, offering a haven of peace and serenity. Guests are invited to take advantage of the range of facilities that this wonderful hotel has to offer.

5888.description: The NH Amsterdam Schiphol Airport hotel is centrally located and a swift 7-minute journey by car from the Amsterdam Airport Schiphol. There are many popular attractions not far from the hotel. The Anne Frank House, the Van Gogh Museum, the Heineken Brewery, and Canal Boats are within 20km and easily accessible by car, taxi, or bus. The light and spacious NH Schiphol Airport hotel provides guests with a wide selection of 419 comfortable rooms. Modern features in all of the rooms include free Wi-Fi, flat screen TVs, and coffeemakers. Our Suites are designed to accommodate guests needing larger rooms and include separate living rooms with dining tables. A compact gym, heated pool, and spa are additional amenities provided free of charge for guests. Every morning we serve a delectable breakfast buffet and made-to-order hot dishes upon request. For breakfast, lunch, or dinner, Gusto opens its doors to serve a variety of international dishes, or try The Greenhouse, a cozy dining space, perfect for a relaxed dinner. Business and leisure guests will enjoy our relaxed lobby restaurant, Meeting Point, which serves tasty international selections for lunch and dinner. Our helpful staff is always available to ensure that guests have the best possible stay. Onsite parking and an EV charging station are also available.

5889.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a spa tub, a 24-hour fitness center, and bicycles to rent. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy international cuisine at Bowery Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Schiphol? This hotel has 21528 square feet (2000 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 27 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 433 guestrooms featuring minibars.

5890.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 6 meeting rooms available for events. Make yourself at home in one of the 111 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. The preferred airport for The Hoxton, Amsterdam is Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS) - 17. 7 km / 11 miWith a stay at The Hoxton, Amsterdam, you'll be centrally located in Amsterdam, steps from The 9 Streets and 6 minutes by foot from Dam Square. This eco-certified hotel is 0. 4 mi (0. 6 km) from Anne Frank House and 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from Amsterdam Museum.

5891.description: Nestled in the heart of Amsterdam’s thriving City Centre, our hotel inspires you to imagine, explore, create, and find a comfortable place to relax. We invite you to live like locals. With one foot in Amsterdam’s rich past and another in its thriving present, our exciting City Centre location celebrates Dutch culture, art, and modern urban energy. And located right next to Amsterdam Central Station. From the central Kimpton De Witt address, there’s something for everyone. For outdoor lovers, biking and walking are rites of passage. Art lovers will feast their eyes on contemporary Dutch works and famed masterpieces by native Old Masters such as Johannes Vermeer, Rembrandt van Rijn and Jan Steen. History connoisseurs will revel in the wealth of monumental landmarks like the Anne Frank House and Van Gogh Museum. Culinary and drink enthusiasts will devour craft breweries, hip cafés, amazing boutique shopping and discerning fine dining. The lively pulse of Amsterdam’s City Centre also beats inside Kimpton De Witt. Whether work or play, the hotel offers plenty of extra amenities and special perks to enhance your stay. Drop by the modern fitness center or retreat to the refined restaurant Celia Amsterdam, which celebrates modern-American cuisine, bringing a touch of Californian sunshine right to the heart of Amsterdam. Go for after dinner drinks in cocktail bar Super Lyan, an award-winning bar by Mr. Lyan. Don’t forget their nightly hosted social hours.

5892.description: One of Amsterdam's most prestigious hotels, the NH Amsterdam Schiller hotel, is conveniently located in Amsterdam's city center and within the Canal Ring. Local points of interest which are easily accessible by foot include Rembrandt Square and Dam Square. Each of our 92 light and tastefully decorated guest rooms has a distinct piece of artwork designed by former owner Fritz Schiller. Modern amenities such as free Wi-Fi, flat screen TVs, and premium TV channels offer exceptional comforts. Upgraded rooms provide spacious sitting areas, sofas with sofa beds, and private terraces. A delicious breakfast buffet is prepared and served fresh each day. Made-to-order hot dishes and an early bird breakfast are available upon request.

5893.description: Spread over nineteen 17th century houses, NH Collection Amsterdam Barbizon Palace offers stunning architecture. Situated right in the center of Amsterdam, the Royal Palace, shops and restaurants are only steps away. For the Van Gogh Museum, take a 10-minute tram ride. It is also opposite Central Station, providing direct links to the airport and the rest of the city. With 268 rooms, NH Collection Amsterdam Barbizon Palace features classic décor. The rooms are spacious and many have a beautiful city view. Connecting rooms and apartments are available, and climate control comes as standard throughout. Luxurious breakfasts are served at Hudson's Terrace & Restaurant, where guests can also enjoy an à-la-carte menu in the afternoon and evening. The true culinary highlight of the hotel is Restaurant Vermeer which is led by Chef de Cuisine Chris Naylor. For something special, the hotel also has a private boat dock and can organize boat tours and floating dining. There is also a bar, gym and wellness area including sauna and steambath. NH Collection Amsterdam Barbizon Palace is the perfect venue for weddings, meetings and special events. The conference center is unique, situated in St. Olaf's 15th century chapel. There are dedicated event planners and 12 meeting rooms.

5894.description: A stay at Radisson Blu Hotel, Amsterdam City Center places you in the heart of Amsterdam, within a 10-minute walk of Dam Square and Flower Market. This upscale hotel is 0. 4 mi (0. 6 km) from Rembrandt Square and 0. 4 mi (0. 6 km) from Amsterdam Museum. Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities, including a sauna, a fitness center, and bicycles to rent. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 252 guestrooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, De Palmboom, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. To-go breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Amsterdam? This hotel has 7449 square feet (692 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 9 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Nes - 0. 2 km / 0.

5895.description: Guests at the NH Amsterdam Leidseplein, formerly known as NH Amsterdam Centre, can enjoy some of Amsterdam's top sights right on their doorstep. It is easy to reach the Leidseplein Square, the Stadsschouwburg Theatre and the P. C. Hooftstraat shopping area within a short walk. Just across the canal from the hotel, guests have access to trendy shops, cafes and restaurants. Convenient transportation is also only a few steps away, including a tram to the Amsterdam Central Station and a bus to the Anne Frank House. Built in 1928 for the Olympic Games, the hotel building features a classic Amsterdamse School-style façade. The rooms at NH Amsterdam Centre are finished with a warm design and hardwood flooring. There are 25 rooms that feature wonderful city views , while all rooms are equipped with air-conditioning and free Wi-Fi. Some rooms are connecting and are perfect for families. Guests can indulge in the daily fresh breakfast that offers a variety of pastries, cold cuts and fresh juices. For a snack, light meal, or a variety of coffees and drinks visit the bar and unwind on our patio garden in the summer months. For those in Amsterdam on business, some rooms feature extra-large desks and the hotel has 5 meeting rooms.

5899.description: This hotel is located in Berlin's vibrant city center, a 5-minute walk from the renowned KaDeWe department store. The Memorial Church is a short drive away, and the nearest station is Nollendorfplatz. The popular Kurfürstendamm shopping street and Berlin Zoo are easily accessible by a 5-minute underground ride. Established in 1958, this hotel features a restaurant and bar where guests can enjoy nutritious meals and delicious beverages. Business travelers can utilize the conference rooms, and a fitness center/gym and spa offer opportunities for relaxation and rejuvenation. All modern guest rooms are equipped with a minibar, a private bathroom with a hairdryer, and air conditioning.

5950.description: Positioned along Berlin's storied Kurfürstendamm, Bristol Berlin, Vignette Collection sits where grand architecture meets vibrant City West energy. The hotel rests comfortably amid world-class shopping, cultural landmarks, and a boulevard that has quietly drawn thinkers, creatives, and travellers for generations. Step outside to find KaDeWe, the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, and Zoo Berlin, all within easy reach. Gallery-lined streets unfold into refined cafés and boutiques throughout Charlottenburg, a district where culture, confidence, and a distinctly local pace define the experience. Inside, heritage meets modernity. Spacious rooms and suites provide a calm retreat, while just a pop-up, invites leisurely moments over thoughtfully prepared cuisine and curated wines. Guests can unwind in the historic indoor pool and spa or gather in elegant event spaces designed for both business and celebration. At Bristol Berlin, Vignette Collection, every stay is thoughtfully enriched by personal service, quiet sophistication, and a sense of place that feels unmistakably Berlin.

5951.description: Berlin's most spacious hotel awaits. The newly renovated InterContinental® Berlin offers modern travelers the luxury of space – to unwind, work, and be inspired. Dive into our inviting pool, rejuvenate at SPA InterContinental, impress clients on our dedicated meeting floor, or host unforgettable events in the grand ballroom. After work, sip cocktails and savor delicious dishes at Marlene, or experience panoramic cityscapes with Michelin-starred cuisine on the 14th floor.

6008.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services and a banquet hall. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a 24-hour front desk. Stay in one of 29 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. 6010.description: Boasting a strategic position in the wonderful city of Paris, this luxurious and magnificent hotel is an ideal accommodation option both for business and leisure travellers. The property is set on the Rive Gauche of the Seine, being within easy reach from numerous sightseeing attractions. All guest rooms are lavishly appointed and completely equipped with a wide range of modern amenities for the utmost wellbeing of all hotel's visitors. Some of them also include a private terrace with panoramic views and all of them are decorated in a classical but comfortable style. Guests can pamper themselves at the on-site bar with a refreshing drink or a tasty snack and every morning enjoy a delicious, comprehensive breakfast buffet.

name.content: Mercure Paris Opera Garnier Hotel & Spa

6011.description: In the business district, close to Gare Saint-Lazare and the department stores, we have created a bucolic walk at the Mercure Paris Opera Garnier. Built around an inner courtyard, enhanced by an exceptional vegetable wall, punctuated with wooden frames, imitating garden pergolas, the lobby plays with the interior and exterior borders. The rooms, like Parisian apartments, invite you to extend your walk.

6012.description: In Art Nouveau style with a contemporary twist, the 4-star L'Echiquier Opéra Paris hotel in central Paris is close to the theaters and cabarets of the Grands Boulevards and Opéra, the epicenter of French culture and art of living. Newly renovated, the hotel embodies its Belle Epoque heritage through wood detailing, mosaic floors and decorative painting. Our rooms and suites are ready to welcome you in a setting which is contemporary, yet which captures the one-of-a-kind ambiance of a Parisian apartment.

6014.description: The Hyatt Paris Madeleine offers 85 rooms, including 14 elegant Parisian suites, in central Paris. It's within walking distance of the Opera Garnier and premier shopping destinations like Printemps and Galeries Lafayette. Discover the hotel's magnificent glass dome, which illuminates the lounge with natural daylight, and enjoy breathtaking views of the Eiffel Tower, Sacré-Coeur Basilica, and Opera House.

6015.description: Nestled in the heart of the Latin Quarter, this hotel is within walking distance of iconic attractions such as rue Mouffetard, the Pantheon, the Botanical Gardens, the National History Museum, and Notre Dame Cathedral. Its 37 modern guest rooms, renovated in 2006, feature air conditioning, en suite bathrooms with either a bathtub or shower and hairdryer, cable TV, direct-dial phones, alarm clocks, and Wi-Fi. The hotel is easily accessible by Metro (Place Monge or Cardinal Lemoine), bus lines 47, 67, and 89, and is convenient to both Gare d'Austerlitz and Gare de Lyon.

6016.description: This stunning hotel is strategically situated in central Paris, within easy reach of numerous points of interest, such as the Stock Exchange, the Louvre, and Place des Victoires. Close to several chic department stores and the city's main business districts, it's the perfect choice of accommodation for business or leisure travelers. Boasting classic decor, all accommodations are well-appointed with modern amenities for a memorable stay. They feature a large bed for a truly restful night's sleep and a private bathroom with a shower or bathtub. Guests can also enjoy a delicious daily breakfast buffet. A complimentary snack basket is also available each afternoon in the lobby.

6017.description: A stay at Pullman Paris Centre-Bercy places you in the heart of Paris, a 9-minute drive from Paris Expo and 12 minutes from Louvre Museum. This upscale hotel is 4. 4 mi (7. 1 km) from Champs-Élysées and 4. 5 mi (7. 3 km) from Palais Garnier. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Make yourself at home in one of the 392 air-conditioned rooms featuring Smart televisions. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Enjoy French cuisine at Ariette Restaurant & Bar, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in Paris? This hotel has 19375 square feet (1800 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 26 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

name.content: Hotel Litteraire Le Swann, BW Premier Collection

6018.description: The Hôtel Littéraire Le Swann, BW Premier Collection has been fully refurbished in 2013 in a contemporary style in memory of Marcel Proust. The Best Western Premier Le Swann is ideally located in the heart of the historic Luthier district, just minutes from the Gare Saint Lazare train station, the main department stores and the Garnier Opera house. You'll enjoy the hotel's magnificent 19th century architecture, which won an award in the 1898 World's Fair. Fully air-conditioned, our hotel boasts 81 rooms and a lovely lobby under an Art Deco glass ceiling. Quick, direct access to the La Defense business district, the western suburbs and many main tourist attractions including the Eiffel tower, Arc de Triomphe and Versailles. The Hôtel Littéraire Le Swann, BW Premier Collection staff is on hand to make your stay as pleasant as possible and smooth your stopover at Paris.

6022.description: The modern hotel is located at the heart of Paris, just 100 m from the nearest links to the transport network. Gare du Nord station is roughly 200m away. It is some 25 km to Charles de Gaulle airport and Paris Orly airport is 35 km away. Renovated in 2005, this hotel comprises two 6-storey buildings offering a total of 64 rooms. Facilities include a 24-hour reception desk, a breakfast room and Internet access (fees apply). The tasteful rooms each come with an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a hire safe and a balcony. A hearty breakfast buffet is on offer to guests each morning.

6024.description: The Hotel Le Montmartre Saint Pierre, decorated in a classic Parisian style with fireplaces and ornate cornices, offers guests 48 rooms featuring luxury bedding, individual climate control, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Each room includes an open bathroom with a rain shower, hairdryer, heated anti-fog mirror, and a range of additional amenities. Located in the picturesque and vibrant Montmartre district, the hotel is near Sacré-Cœur Basilica, Place du Tertre with its renowned artists, and the Dalí Museum. It also offers convenient access to the Gare du Nord, providing connections via Eurostar, Thalys, and RER to Charles de Gaulle Airport, as well as easy access eastward via Metro line 4. Perfectly connected by metro and bus, guests can directly reach the Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe, Saint-Michel Notre-Dame, the Louvre Museum, and the Eiffel Tower. The OpenTour bus stop is conveniently located just 200 meters from the hotel.

6028.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at La Villa des Ternes Hotel, an upscale establishment in Paris's 17th Arrondissement. Located just steps from the Palais des Congrès de Paris and a short walk from the Champs-Élysées, this hotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a bar/lounge. Each of the 39 guestrooms features a minibar, espresso maker, and LCD television with satellite programming. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies), and additional services include dry cleaning/laundry and a 24-hour front desk.

6029.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available on request). Make yourself at home in one of the 40 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have hair dryers and bathrobes. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Palais Royal - 0. 2 km / 0.

6030.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Paris and was established in 2001. It is close to the Musee Picasso and the nearest station is Temple/Republique. The Hotel has a restaurant. All 36 rooms are equipped with hairdryer, safe and air conditioning.

6033.description: The Hotel Marais Bastille, nestled in the heart of Paris's City Center, offers a convenient location just a short drive from iconic landmarks like the Centre Pompidou and Notre Dame. Guests can enjoy breathtaking views from the terrace and garden, and stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. Each of the 36 air-conditioned rooms features a flat-screen television with satellite programming, a safe, a desk, and a bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee, and room service is offered during limited hours. Additional amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services.

6034.description: Located near the Grand Bibliothèque (XVIIème arrondissement), this hotel has the most modern fittings and stylised décor. Its 39 rooms have a full bathroom, hair-drier, television and radio, and there are also 6 duplexes. The Villa Lutece Port Royale is a contemporary hotel with a creative, and unique décor, located near the Latin Quarter. The Villa has managed to harmoniously combine contemporary services and amenities with an imaginative artistic surroundings. The comfortable rooms have air-conditioning and for those who enjoy a little privacy, it is possible to order room service meals.

6035.description: A 6 story hotel offering 155 spacious guest and suites, a fitness center and spa complete with the latest cardiovascular and weights exercise equipment. Park Hyatt Paris-Vendome Spa, offers the pinnacle of relaxation in a peaceful space decorated with Paris stone, mahogany and an onyx water wall, featuring four treatment rooms including one solely for couples treatments. A variety of spa treatments and massages are available, including the exclusive Miracle Broth facial using La Mer cosmetic products. Guests of Park Hyatt Paris-Vendome are able to enjoy complimentary access to the Spas saunas, steam rooms, and whirlpool baths, as well as a fitness center outfitted with cardiovascular and strength training equipment.

6039.description: This hotel enjoys a central setting in the magical city of Paris. The hotel is located within easy access of a host of restaurants, bars and shops. Guests will find themselves just 150 metres from the Grands Boulevards metro station, which offers ease of access to the heart of the city. The hotel is located within easy access of the Gare du Nord train station, and is just 20 km away from Orly and Charles de Gaulle airports. This delightful hotel welcomes guests with elegance and sophistication. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, and come complete with modern amenities. Guests are invited to enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day. They will also find a snack bar for relaxing moments in the afternoon.

6040.description: This traditional Parisian hotel boasts a prime location near the opera and a shopping center. Guests are within easy reach of the Gare du Nord train station and the vibrant Montmartre district, both about 800 meters away. Bars and pubs are just steps from the hotel, and the city center, with its myriad shops, is within 500 meters. Orly and Charles de Gaulle Airports are approximately a 30-minute drive. The air-conditioned hotel offers a selection of elegant rooms decorated in soothing tones, creating a charming atmosphere perfect for relaxation. Onsite amenities include a car park and a cozy lobby.

6041.description: Just 200 metres from the famous Champs-Elysees and Arc de Triomphe, the 4-star Hotel Bradford Elysees is situated in one of the most elegant districts of Paris. This charming hotel offers large, air conditioned, comfortable rooms that are tastefully decorated. Ideal for both shopping and sightseeing, guests don't have to venture far from the hotel to find the highlights of this wonderful city. An excellent variety of restaurants and cafes, offering dining for all tastes, can also be found close to the hotel. Guests are also just a short walk from the Louvre Museum, Opera, and Madeline. Guests should note that local city tax is not included in the rate booked. This will be charged directly to guests by the hotel and payable at check in/out.

6042.description: This hotel boasts a stunning setting in Paris, lying between the opera house and the Place del la Republique. Guests will find themselves amidst the vibrant theatre district, within easy access of an abundance of shops, restaurants and entertainment venues. The hotel is within easy access of the main attractions that the city has to offer, lying just a short distance away from links to the public transport network. This wonderful hotel welcomes guests with the promise of a memorable stay. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, and feature modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. The hotel provides a range of excellent facilities and services, meeting the needs of every type of traveller.

6043.description: Situated in Paris's vibrant Batignolles district, this hotel offers a prime location near Pont-Cardinet station and Rome and Brochant metro stations. Guests are within walking distance of charming restaurants, shops, entertainment, and local attractions. The hotel features spacious double and superior rooms, each adorned with elegant Napoleon III-inspired decor, including plush damask quilts. Modern amenities and en-suite bathrooms with marble vanities are standard. A complimentary breakfast is served daily, and a functional meeting room is available for business travelers.

6044.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at this centrally located Paris hotel. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) at the on-site café, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge after a busy day. The hotel offers 42 guestrooms equipped with LED TVs, satellite programming, safes, and coffee/tea makers. Business amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self-parking is available (charges apply). Located near Parc Monceau, the hotel is a short drive from iconic landmarks like the Palais Garnier and the Arc de Triomphe, and within easy reach of the Champs-Élysées and the Louvre Museum. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

6045.description: The Best Western Hotel Le Montparnasse is a 5-minute walk from the Paris-Montparnasse TGV (high-speed train) station and the Air France terminal, with direct links to the Roissy Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports. Nearby is the Tour Eiffel, the Jardin du Luxembourg, the Rue de Rennes and many restaurants and shops where you can stroll at your leisure. Not far from St Germain des prés and Eiffel Tower area. The Best Western Hotel Le Montparnasse was fully refurbished in 2010 so you can enjoy the new design and high-end services: individual air-conditioning, free Wi-Fi access throughout the hotel, soft quilts for a refreshing night's sleep. You will also enjoy the 'extras': Espresso machines, iPod dock and 32-inch LED TV. The bathrooms feature: relaxing 'rain' showers, handy hairdryers and anti-steam mirrors to save time. You will be welcomed by a dedicated team attentive to your needs, so you can taste Parisian life and fully enjoy your stay on the Left Bank, in a district with a multitude of great restaurants and shops. The Best Western Hotel Le Montparnasse is at your service for business trips or tourism breaks to the French capital. Nearby: the Montparnasse Tower, the Rue de Rennes, Saint Germain des Prés, Les Invalides, the Eiffel Tower, etc.

6060.description: The Hôtel Le Rocroy, located in the heart of Paris’s 10th arrondissement, just steps from Gare du Nord, combines contemporary elegance with comfort. Recently renovated, the hotel features 48 modern, soundproof rooms, a full breakfast buffet, a coworking space, and a meeting room ideal for business travelers. Its chic and welcoming atmosphere, strategic location, and accessible premium services make it a perfect choice for both business and leisure guests.

6062.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. For recreation, you'll find an indoor pool and a fitness center. This palace also provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Explore nearby attractions easily with the area shuttle (surcharge). Savor French cuisine at L'Ecrin, one of the two onsite restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Full breakfasts are served weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fee applies). Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available 24 hours (surcharge). The 124 individually decorated guest rooms offer minibars, espresso makers, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Safes, desks, and phones are also provided. Located near Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore, Place de la Concorde, and the Champs-Élysées.

6063.description:
Since its opening in 1913, the Hôtel Plaza Athénée has welcomed the world's elite seeking to fully experience the energy and elegance of the unique city of Paris. 

Awarded the renowned “palace” distinction, the Plaza Athénée Hotel is truly the city's Haute Couture address, ideally located on the prestigious Avenue Montaigne, just a few steps from the banks of the Seine, the Eiffel Tower, and the Champs-Élysées. 

The hotel embodies the legend of Parisian couture, particularly through its history with the House of Christian Dior. The Plaza Athénée also houses a Dior Spa within its walls which offers a deeply restorative approach to wellbeing. 

The hotel's 154 rooms and 54 suites are true Parisian apartments in classic or Art Deco style, offering the latest in comfort and breathtaking views of the capital. The hotel offers 24-hour services, including room service and concierge services. 

From the lively rhythm of La Galerie to evenings at Le Bar, the hotel has a natural social energy. At La Grande Table du Plaza Athénée, France’s culinary heritage is celebrated with generosity and contemporary spirit. 

More than a legendary palace, Hôtel Plaza Athénée is a distinctly Parisian way of life, vibrant, assured and wonderfully alive.

6064.description:
Ideally located close to the Champs-Elysées and the Arc de Triomphe, Hotel Napoleon offers the experience of a private Parisian house. Its reveal 96 air-conditioned elegant and welcoming rooms and suites. 40 connecting rooms. Exquisite Parisian views from the terraces and balconies of certain rooms and suites, including the elegant Imperial Suite with views of the Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower. Pamper yourself with onsite massages or enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, tea/coffee maker and free minibar items. Golden Key concierge services. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 7 meeting rooms available for events. 
30-cm flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature hair dryers and bathrobes. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Champs-Élysées - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Place Charles de Gaulle - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Arc de Triomphe - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Avenue Georges V - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Salle Pleyel - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Boulevard Haussmann - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Parc Monceau - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Bois de Boulogne - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Avenue Montaigne - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Grand Palais - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Palais des Congrès de Paris - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Seine - 1. 5 km / 1 mi- Place du Trocadéro - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Champ de Mars - 2 km / 1. 2 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 23. 4 km / 14. 5 miParis Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 33. 6 km / 20.

6065.description: 'Centrally located in Paris, The Westin Paris - Vendôme places you steps from Rue de Rivoli and a short 9-minute walk from the Champs-Élysées. This upscale hotel offers 428 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring a minibar, Smart TV, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant, relax with room service (limited hours), or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A 24-hour health club, a garden, and a ballroom provide further opportunities for recreation and relaxation. Additional amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel is conveniently located 0. 6 miles from Palais Garnier and 0. 8 miles from the Louvre Museum. '

6066.description: Don't miss out on recreational opportunities including a sauna and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Grab a bite at La Terrasse, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge and a garden view. You can also stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 98 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

6067.description: A bubble of serenity, the 4-star Mercure Paris La Défense contrasts with the sparkling atmosphere of the business district. Near Les 4 Temps shopping mall, relax in this urban oasis. After a day of shopping, meetings or seminars in one of our meeting rooms, celebrate your success at the rooftop bar with panoramic view of Paris. Hungry? Enjoy seasonal cuisine at Vingko, a gourmet restaurant in La Défense.

6069.description: Welcome to the Hotel Astra Opera, a 4-star hotel of 73 rooms, ideally located at 29 rue de Caumartin, in the 9th arrondissement of Paris, close to the Opera Garnier, the Grands Magasins and Place Vendôme. Our wellness area is open from 7:00AM to 10:00PM with a 4x10m swimming pool, fitness room, sauna and hammam. For our business customers, our seminar rooms are available for your meetings, conferences or workshops. A buffet breakfast is served every morning under the glass roof of the dining room (7:00AM to 10:30AM on weekdays, 7:00AM to 11:00AM at weekends). Continental breakfast can be enjoyed in the privacy of your room (7:30AM to 10:30AM). After a day of sightseeing, you can relax in the hotel lounge and enjoy our 'Open Bar Soft', available free of charge every afternoon and evening, offering a selection of hot and cold non-alcoholic drinks accompanied by sweet and savoury treats.

6072.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at this upscale Paris hotel in the Montparnasse district, a 15-minute walk from the Luxembourg Gardens and Montparnasse Tower. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) at the hotel's bar/lounge. Each of the 38 guestrooms features a refrigerator, minibar, and flat-screen TV with satellite programming. Bathrooms include a bathtub or shower and a hairdryer. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, dry cleaning/laundry services, and express check-in. Nearby attractions include the Paris Catacombs (0. 9 km) and Le Bon Marche (1. 1 km). The nearest airport is Paris Orly Airport (ORY), 14. 1 km from the hotel.

6073.description: Just 10 minutes by public transport from the Champs‑Élysées and historic Paris monuments, our hotel sits in the Westfield CNIT building near shopping and the La Défense open‑air museum. Next to the Grande Arche and transit links, we offer access to central Paris, attractions, and airports. Our 153 rooms are inspired by French Glamour of the 1960s.

6075.description: Located just steps from the Sacré Coeur and Moulin Rouge, this hotel offers a restful retreat after a thrilling day exploring Paris. Several metro stations, including Pigalle and Anvers, as well as the Nord Train Station, are within easy walking distance. Both Orly and Charles de Gaulle airports are about an hour's drive away. The hotel's 106 air-conditioned rooms provide comfort and tranquility in an Art Deco building designed to create a relaxing atmosphere. Guests can also enjoy exceptional panoramic views of Paris from the terrace. The surrounding area is a vibrant hub of art galleries, fashion boutiques, music shops, and Parisian lifestyle.

6076.description: This hotel, nestled on the left bank of the river Seine, is situated in the 15th arrondissement. The Eiffel Tower and the Porte de Versailles exhibition centre are within walking distance from the hotel. Within the area guests will be able to find various shopping venues, such as the Rue du Commerce centre and public transport links are located a few metres away. The nearest underground station is within walking distance of the hotel. This is a perfect place to disconnect after a nice day exploring the capital.

6077.description: In a privileged location, just 15 minutes from central Paris, the ReMix Hôtel la Villette is the ideal place to stay in the City of Lights. This hotel offers air-conditioned rooms equipped with modern conveniences for your well-being, including satellite television, CANAL+, and hair dryers in each bathroom. Its Music Bar provides a relaxed meeting point in the heart of the hotel. It's the perfect place to unwind and enjoy a rhythmic show with a colorful array of cocktails. The hotel also features a concierge service, paid parking, and room service. Pets are allowed with a €20 supplement per animal, per night. A €100 deposit (by credit card only) is required upon arrival and will be released upon departure.

6078.description: This hotel is nestled in the city centre, very close to Champs Elysée and Porte Maillot. Its location will allow guests to move quickly and comfortably with convenient public transport, located 500 metres from the hotel, which links with the main tourist attractions of Paris. Galleries La Fayette is located just 3 km from the hotel. This is an ideal place from where to start knowing this magnificent city.

6080.description: This hotel is located at the heart of Paris, lying just a short distance away from the Champs Elysees. Guests will find themselves just 100 metres away from the nearest metro station, which offers ease of access to other areas of the city. This charming hotel lies in close proximity to the main attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. This delightful hotel dates back to the late 19th century, bathing visitors in culture and history. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, exuding classical sophistication. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests are invited to enjoy the host of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

6082.description: This hotel, nestled in the 17th arrondissement, is located very close to the charming Parc Monceau, in the west of Paris. In 15 minutes, guests will be able to reach a number of touristic and historic sites, such as Champs-Élysées, Montmartre district, Sacré-Coeur and the opera house. The closest underground station lies approximately 200 m away. Orly Airport as well as Paris-Charles de Gaulle Airport are around 30 minutes from the hotel.

6085.description: This vibrant city hotel is set in a 19th-century building in the heart of the trendy Latin Quarter and Saint-Germain des Prés. Guests will find a variety of famous city sights within a ten-minute walk and the Maubert-Mutualite metro station provides easy access to the rest of the city. The sleek, ultra-modern guest rooms are decked out in vivid colours for a hip and trendy atmosphere. Each comes with the modern amenities that every seasoned traveller seeks, including air-conditioning, a hairdryer in the en suite bathroom and coffee facilities. Guests can wake up to breakfast in the cheerful and fun breakfast room.

6088.description: This hotel is ideally located, within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower, very close to Arch du Triomphe, the Champs Elysées, and the ultra-chic Victor Hugo Avenue. The hotel has excellent public transportation connections, with taxis, the metro and the trains nearby. The hotel has been fully refurbished by designer Michel Jouannet, resembling the chic Parisian mansions.

6089.description: Located in the heart of Paris, on the left Bank of the Seine, between the Montparnasse district and the Latin Quartier. It is housed in a beautiful building dating back to Baron Haussmann's mid-19th century renovation of the capital and a 7-minute walk from Le Jardin du Luxembourg. Its warm and intimate ambience, where even the portraits of illustrious personalities seem to welcome guests with opens arms, makes it a very special place. It is a place for relaxation but also encourages discovery. The rooms are comfortable, they feature classic decoration include TVs, Wi-Fi and minibars, tea and coffeemaking facilities. Suites add additional living space.

6090.description: Stay at the eco-certified Hotel ibis Paris Bastille Opera in the 11th arrondissement, steps from Canal Saint-Martin and a 7-minute walk from Place de la Bastille. This hotel offers a terrace, garden, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Additional amenities include concierge services, a game room, and a picnic area. The 305 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs with cable programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and desks. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, room service, or drinks at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel also offers complimentary newspapers, dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, conference space, and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (fee applies).

6093.description: The latest property from the family-owned hotel group Leitmotiv, La Fantaisie has been welcoming Parisians and travelers since July 1st. Designed as a lush retreat in the midst of the city, La Fantaisie strikes a harmonious balance where nature and lifestyle blend seamlessly. Decorated by designer Martin Brudnizki, the venue has 63 rooms and 10 suites, providing stunning views of the lush garden or Paris. At Restaurant of La Fantaisie, on the plate, cosmopolitan cuisine, regressive and deliciously in tune with today’s expectations. Caesar- style lobster salad, fillet of beef with pepper sauce, fresh pasta with black truffles or a juicy rum baba are just some of the dishes on the menu. Seasonal, local and sourced products for a menu in tune with today's dynamics. A street-side Café and a Rooftop Bar with greenery complement this Eden in the bustling Faubourg Montmartre. Offering a true invitation to disconnect, the hotel is equipped with a multi-pool spa in partnership with the Parisian brand Holidermie, which brings its vision of holistic, nurturing, and responsible beauty.

6095.description: Enjoy a stay at the New Hotel Roblin La Madeleine, located in Paris's 8th Arrondissement, just a short walk from Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore and Boulevard Haussmann. This hotel offers convenient access to the Champs-Élysées and Palais Garnier, both within a half-mile radius. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy amenities such as a fitness center, concierge services, and a bar/lounge. Start your day with a full breakfast (fee applies) or grab a quick bite from the snack bar. Room service is also available during limited hours. Each of the 77 guestrooms features a shower with a rainfall showerhead, designer toiletries, a safe, and a desk. For business needs, a business center and complimentary newspapers are available in the lobby. Dry cleaning/laundry services are also provided.

name.content: Hôtel La Bourdonnais by Inwood Hotels

6096.description: Discover this charming boutique hotel located in the heart of the city of lights only a few steps from the Eiffel Tower, the Champ de Mars and the Esplanade des Invalides. La Bourdonnais is the perfect place for curious adventurers and a pied-à-terre for travelers looking for amazement in vibrant Paris. Hotel de La Bourdonnais takes freedom lovers to the art of travel, an atmosphere where time stands still in the heart of the Parisian turmoil. You will discover a blend of relaxation and elegance.

6097.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Paris and was established in 1850. It is a short drive away from the Opera and the nearest station is Grands Boulevards (line 8,9). The Hotel has a restaurant. All 128 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning.

6098.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Hôtel Nude Paris - Color Vision, an eco-certified hotel in the heart of Paris. Located within a 15-minute walk of the Luxembourg Gardens and the Paris Catacombs, and just a kilometer from the Montparnasse Tower, our hotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a snack bar/deli. Guests can also enjoy room service during limited hours and unwind with a drink at our bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Each of our 27 guestrooms features a minibar, LCD television with satellite programming, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer, a safe, and a desk. Housekeeping is provided daily.

6100.description: Located in the heart of Paris, La Demeure Montaigne offers a luxurious 5-star experience just a short walk from the Champs-Élysées and the Arc de Triomphe. This elegant hotel features 92 guestrooms equipped with espresso makers, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with hair dryers and bathrobes. Guests can indulge in a variety of treatments at the on-site spa, enjoy a meal at L'Envolée restaurant, and take advantage of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee.

6101.description: This hotel is situated at the heart of the golden triangle. The hotel is located within easy access of the main attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the Place de l'Etoile, the Arc de Triomphe, the Avenue des Champs Elysees and the business district, La Defence. This wonderful hotel tempts guests with the promise of elegance and luxury. Appealing to business and leisure travellers alike, this hotel is sure to impress. The hotel enjoys a charming architectural design, occupying a striking 19th-century building. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, exuding refined elegance. The hotel features a charming English-style bar, where guests can sit back and relax with a refreshing drink, for the perfect end to the day. City Tax per pax, per night is not included and is paid on the spot. Check in at 3. 00 p. m. , check out at noon.

6102.description: This delightful city hotel boasts a prime setting in the captivating city of Paris. The hotel lies just 50 metres away from the renowned Champs Elysees. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a host of attractions, shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. The hotel is situated just a few steps away from a metro station, enjoying ease of access to other areas of the city. This charming hotel greets guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, providing a haven of peace and serenity in which to escape the rest of the world. The hotel features a range of modern facilities, catering for the needs of every type of traveller. Guests can indulge in the ultimate invigoration in the spa centre, and completely relax and unwind. Check in at 3. 00 p. m. , check out at noon. City Tax is not included to be paid on spot

6104.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and take advantage of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Grab a bite at the snack bar/deli or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (6:30 AM to 10:00 AM) for a fee. The hotel also offers dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Make yourself at home in one of the 76 guest rooms featuring minibars and espresso makers. Flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, and complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Hotel Duminy Vendome is centrally located in Paris, a 4-minute walk from Tuileries Garden and 7 minutes from Place de la Concorde Urban Park. This upscale hotel is 0. 9 miles from Palais Garnier and 1. 5 miles from Notre-Dame.

6105.description: This charming hotel is located within easy access of the centre of Paris. The hotel is situated just a short distance away from a host of restaurants, bars, pubs and nightclubs, as well as the main attractions that the city has to offer. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to Montmartre, the Louvre, the Galeries Lafayette shopping centre and the Poissonniere metro station. This wonderful hotel enjoys a charming architectural design. The guest rooms offer an oasis of peace and serenity, providing the ideal setting in which to relax and unwind at the end of the day. The hotel offers a range of excellent facilities and services, ensuring the utmost in comfort and convenience.

6106.description: This hotel is ideally located at the heart of the romantic city of Paris. The hotel is situated within easy access of a number of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. The most prominent city attractions are all to be found within easy access of this charming hotel. The hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and charm. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, providing a haven of serenity in which to relax and unwind at the end of the day. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are invited to enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

6107.description: This hotel boasts a central location at the heart of the captivating city of Paris. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from the Louvre Museum and the Jardin des Tuileries. The hotel is situated within easy access of numerous shopping and entertainment venues. The nearest metro station is to be found just 100 metres away, offering ease of access to other areas of the city. The Champs Elysees is located just a short distance away from the hotel. This chic city hotel enjoys an attractive architectural design. The guest rooms are beautifully decorated, providing an oasis of serenity in which to unwind at the end of the day. Guests are sure to appreciate the range of facilities that the hotel has to offer.

6108.description: This historical hotel enjoys a central location in Paris. The hotel is situated close to the Louvre and the opera house. Bourse metro station is 200 metres away from the hotel, offering ease of access to other areas of the city. Many of the city's intriguing attractions are within easy reach. A myriad of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found nearby. The hotel enjoys a charming design and a long history, dating back to the early 20th century. The hotel combines traditional, class and grace with modern convenience. The guest rooms are comfortable and spacious, offering modern amenities. The hotel features a wonderful restaurant, where delectable dishes are served

6109.description: This hotel enjoys a central location in Paris. The hotel is located close to the Gare du Nord, lying just 1 km away from the chic, Parisian district of Montmartre. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from convenient links to the public transport network, which provide ease of access to other areas of the city to be discovered. The hotel offers a great location from which to explore this wonderful city. This charming hotel comprises tastefully-appointed guest rooms, which are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are invited to enjoy delightful dining in the restaurant, where delectable dishes are served.

6110.description: This elegant city hotel, built in 1853, is situated near the Elysée Palace and the magnificent Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré. Just a short stroll from Place de la Concorde, La Madeleine, and the Champs-Élysées, it offers easy access to the heart of Paris with the Miromesnil metro station a mere 200 meters away. The hotel features a cozy air-conditioned restaurant with an enticing menu, and a charming outdoor veranda where breakfast is served during the summer months. In winter, breakfast is served in the dining room. Guest rooms are pleasantly appointed with en suite bathrooms, hairdryers, and direct dial telephones.

6111.description: This stylish hotel enjoys an enviable location in the intriguing city of Paris. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from Les Rennes shopping street, as well as a host of attractions. The hotel lies just a short distance away from the Gare du Nord and the Gare de L'Est, enjoying ease of access to other areas of the city. This charming hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated, offering a relaxing setting in which to unwind after a long day's sightseeing. This delightful hotel offers a host of facilities and services, ensuring a relaxing stay. Guests are invited to dine in style in the relaxing surroundings of the restaurant.

6116.description: The Hôtel des Métallos Paris enjoys a strategic location in one of Paris's trendiest areas. Its modern, uncluttered design, featuring neutral shades brightened with touches of color, creates a cozy atmosphere, a welcome respite from the Parisian bustle. The attentive team at the Hôtel des Métallos is dedicated to making your stay a pleasant experience. *No pets allowed.

name.content: Four Seasons Hotel George V Paris

6117.description: The Four Seasons Hotel George V, a landmark eight-story building dating back to 1928, offers 244 luxurious guest rooms and suites, many with private terraces overlooking Paris. Located mere steps from the Champs-Élysées, the hotel is within walking distance of the Golden Triangle, the Eiffel Tower, and the Arc de Triomphe. Recently named the Best Business Hotel in Western Europe by Business Traveller Magazine, it boasts an exquisite art collection and decadent fine dining options. Guests can enjoy the Pop-Up Spa by Jeff Leatham, featuring four treatment rooms and a salon, as well as a fitness center. Please note: the swimming pool, sauna, and hammam are currently under renovation and scheduled to reopen in June 2018.

6161.description: A stone's throw from the Eiffel Tower and Trocadéro, the 4-star Mercure Paris Centre Eiffel Tower hotel is just waiting to be discovered in the heart of Paris. An ideal starting point for your visit, you will appreciate the proximity to public transport and our tips for visiting the City of Light. If you need a setting that combines pleasure and work on a business trip, discover our meeting rooms and relax in our fitness center with a view of the Eiffel Tower or on the restaurant terrace.

6163.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour health club or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Paris? This hotel has 34983 square feet (3250 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 27 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 1025 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected.

6164.description: The Pullman Paris Montparnasse Hotel, located in Paris's 14th Arrondissement, is a short drive from Luxembourg Gardens and Paris Expo Porte de Versailles. This upscale hotel is conveniently located within 2 miles of the Louvre Museum and the Eiffel Tower. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour fitness center, bicycle rentals, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). The hotel offers 957 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring a minibar, flat-screen television with satellite programming, private bathroom with hairdryer and bathrobes, in-room safe, and desk. Savor Italian cuisine at FI LIA, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Two bars/lounges offer a relaxing atmosphere for a drink. Buffet breakfast is available weekdays from 6:00 AM to 10:30 AM and weekends from 6:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fee applies). Additional amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, express check-in, and on-site self-parking (subject to charges).

6167.description: Centrally located in Paris, the luxurious Sofitel Paris Arc de Triomphe is steps from Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré and a short walk from Salle Pleyel. This hotel offers 124 guestrooms featuring minibars, Smart TVs, and pillowtop beds with premium bedding. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen televisions with pay movies, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Take advantage of the 24-hour fitness center, bicycle rentals, and concierge services. Dine at Cocottes Arc de Triomphe, specializing in French cuisine, or enjoy 24-hour room service. A bar/lounge, full breakfasts (for a fee), and wedding services are also available. The hotel provides wired internet access (surcharge), a business center, express check-in, 5 meeting rooms, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge). Limited onsite parking is available. Nearby attractions include Parc Monceau, the Champs-Élysées, and the Arc de Triomphe.

6168.description: With a stay at Hotel Astoria - Astotel, you'll be centrally located in Paris, within a 5-minute drive of La Machine du Moulin Rouge and Palais Garnier. This hotel is 1. 3 mi (2. 2 km) from Champs-Élysées and 1. 9 mi (3 km) from Arc de Triomphe. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Make yourself at home in one of the 86 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Place de Clichy - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Moulin Rouge - 1 km/0. 6 mi- La Machine du Moulin Rouge - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Theatre Mogador - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Parc Monceau - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Boulevard Haussmann - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi- Printemps Department Store - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi- Galeries Lafayette - 1. 2 km/0. 7 mi- Grands Boulevards - 1. 4 km/0. 9 mi- Palais Garnier - 1. 4 km/0. 9 mi- Paris Olympia - 1. 5 km/1 mi- Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore - 1. 6 km/1 mi- Place de la Madeleine - 1. 6 km/1 mi- Place de l'Opéra - 1. 7 km/1 mi- Rue de Rivoli - 1. 8 km/1. 1 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 27. 3 km/17 mi Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 29. 6 km/18. 4 mi The preferred airport for Hotel Astoria - Astotel is Paris Orly Airport (ORY).

6169.description: Enjoy a central Paris stay at the Hotel Royal Saint Honoré, within a 15-minute walk of the Palais Garnier and Champs-Élysées. This hotel offers 68 guestrooms equipped with minibars, LCD TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) at Maison Ô, our on-site restaurant and bar/lounge. Room service is also available during limited hours. Additional amenities include concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), a computer station, and express check-in/out. Nearby attractions include the Louvre Museum (1. 7 mi) and Notre-Dame (1. 5 mi). The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY), Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG), and Paris Beauvais (BVA).

6170.description: The ibis Paris Porte de Bagnolet hotel to the east of Paris is ideal for your business and leisure trips. All our rooms are equipped with air conditioning and free WIFI. Our bar has an ibis Kitchen lounge area serving simple and tasty cuisine. Our market-style breakfast, an unlimited hot and cold continental buffet, is served from 6:30am in our large room on the 1st floor.

name.content: The Harmonie Vienna, BW Premier Collectio

6226.description: The family-owned The Harmonie Vienna, BW Premier Collection returns fresh and unique. The newly designed boutique hotel is centrally and yet quietly located in the authentic Serviten Quarter off the beaten tourist tracks. Enjoy the lively and authentic neighborhood with trendy restaurants, bars and boutiques! The Ringstrasse and its iconic buildings are within walking distance, as is St. Stephen’s Cathedral. Tram and subway stations are located very close to the hotel. Reserved parking spaces for guests are available at a fee. The new The Harmonie Vienna, BW Premier Collection offers 66 rooms with modern facilities and natural Viennese elegance in a classical Otto Wagner building. An individual touch is given to the rooms thanks to the paintings by the artist Luis Casanova Sorolla. They show the traces of a dance performance and transform each room of the boutique hotel into a unique art experience. The rooms are equipped with very comfortable beds, a large desk, wireless internet, mini bar, tea and coffee set, a flat screen television, an ironing board and iron and a laptop suitable safe. Some rooms are allergy-friendly according to ECARF standards. Guests of our hotel can enjoy a nutritious breakfast buffet with regional and organic products. The heart of our boutique hotel is the cozy lounge area with bar and library. Here you can read the paper, relax with a cup of tea and recharge your batteries. A small fitness studio and a 24-hour shop are also available for our guests. The Harmonie Vienna, BW Premier Collection stands for a responsible lifestyle. Sustainability, quality and eco-friendly services are guaranteed by the Austrian Ecolabel. Enjoy your stay.

6227.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Vienna and was established in 1918. It is close to the St Stephans Cathedral and the nearest station is U1 Stephansplatz. The Hotel has a restaurant and a conference room. All 56 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, ironing set and air conditioning.

6229.description: NH Danube City is in the ideal location for business and pleasure. The hotel is right by the UN Building and the Vienna International Center. You can reach Vienna's city center by public transportation, and the Kaisermühlen-Vienna International Center station is very close to the hotel. Guests can shop at the nearby Donauzentrum shopping center or enjoy the recreational activities available on Danube Island, for example yachting and tennis. The comfortable and modern rooms at NH Danube City are equipped with free Wi-Fi and tea and coffee facilities. Some of the rooms have spectacular views of the Danube River. From the 18th floor you will get an amazing outlook over the city. Breakfast will give you energy for the day with a varied spread of delicious foods and beverages. Enjoy your lunch and dinner at Tarragona restaurant, which serves both à-la-carte and buffet-style meals. Accompany your dinner with a great wine from our extensive list, or enjoy a drink at the bar, which you will also find a restaurant at one end. For business travelers, there are 10 meeting rooms. There is also a gym at the hotel and guests enjoy special rates at a nearby spa.

6231.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a sauna and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, gift shops/newsstands, and a television in a common area. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy international cuisine at At the Park Bar Cafe, a bar/lounge where you can take in the garden view, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Baden? This hotel has 2200 square feet (204 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 6 meeting rooms.

6232.description: This appealing castle hotel, built in 1233 and fully renovated, is nestled in Doblhoff Park within the Rosarium, close to Baden's city center, thermal springs, and health spas. Public transport is easily accessible, just a short 300-meter walk away. The hotel offers 100 rooms across four floors, featuring a bar, the Rosenkavalier restaurant, and a historic castle cellar. Each tastefully appointed room includes an en-suite bathroom with a hairdryer, a direct-dial telephone, an answering machine, a radio, high-speed internet access, a minibar, and an electronic safe. Guests can enjoy the hotel's 1, 000 sq m spa with a swimming pool, sauna, cardio fitness area, beauty treatments, and massages. A bowling alley is also available. The Rosenkavalier restaurant offers a culinary journey through regional flavors, while traditional Austrian specialties are served in the castle cellar. Guests can also enjoy cocktails in the Lipizzaner Bar. The glass-roofed Renaissance courtyard provides an impressive venue for events. Housekeeping is provided every three days, with daily service available for an additional fee.

6247.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including a 24-hour fitness center and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Enjoy Modern European cuisine at Pentalounge, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Brussels? This hotel has 3261 square feet (303 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 202 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and Smart televisions.

6249.description: Hotel Indigo Brussels City is centrally located within walking distance of major tourist attractions and the business district. Inspired by the nearby Botanical Gardens, our hotel features 284 uniquely designed rooms and suites that embrace tropical, herbal, and floral themes. Guests enjoy complimentary access to our fitness area, which includes a fully equipped gym and sauna. On the ground floor, SERRA serves as a tranquil oasis in the bustling city, featuring Urban Picnic for all-day dining and the Garden Kitchen restaurant offering a seasonal, eco-conscious menu focused on innovative, plant-based cuisine made from locally sourced organic ingredients.

6250.description: Located in the heart of Brussels, just steps from Grand Place and City Hall, the Rocco Forte Hotel Amigo offers an array of amenities for both leisure and business travelers. This hotel features a fitness center, on-site shopping, a ballroom, bike storage, and several meeting rooms. Guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant, 24-hour room service, or a drink at the bar/lounge. Each of the 173 guestrooms includes a minibar, flat-screen TV with cable, complimentary Wi-Fi, designer toiletries, and a bidet. A full breakfast is available for a fee, and an airport shuttle service is offered for a surcharge.

6251.description: The Hotel Van Belle is a 65 rooms family-owned hotel since 1906 located within walking distance of the city center and Brussels Midi/Zuid (Brussels South) train station, 800 metres from Lemonnier Metro Station and less than 5 minutes' walk from Musée Bruxellois de la Gueuze. The Manneken Pis Statue is only 15 minutes' walk from the hotel. The rooms at Van Belle Hotel are designed and functional with high performance soundproofing walls and a large walk-in shower. The guests can daily enjoy a generous buffet breakfast. The intimate hotel restaurant serves home-style French cuisine and the retro-style bar offers a range of International drinks and local Belgian beers. There is also a 24-hour reception. The city tax is 4, 24€ per person and night, direct payment at the hotel. The underground parking is available for 20€/night/car (by reservation). For conferences and other events, a multi-purpose conference room is available. Whether you are planning a city trip to Brussels or whether you are in Europe’s capital for business, Hotel Van Belle offers you a good value comfortable stay.

6252.description: Set right in the beating heart of Brussels, this elegant hotel welcomes its guests at just a 2-minute walk from the Grand-Place and Brussels Central Station. It is also at less than 150 metres from the Square Congress Centre and the surrounding area houses some of the most prestigious restaurants the city has to offer. The inhouse restaurant serves delicious International and local dishes, while for a chilled cocktail with a beautiful view of the Grand Palace guests can head to the terrace bar. In the evenings guests can relax in the piano bar with a few drinks and some delightful music as a background. The recently refurbished classic rooms come with new furniture, decoration, bedding and refreshed bathrooms.
