6256.description: Only a 5 minute walk from the city's main Grand Place, NH Brussels Grand Place Arenberg is set right in the heart of Brussels. Perfect for either the leisure or business traveler, the hotel is close to both historical and commercial highlights of the city. The Royal Palace, Magritte Museum and the Fine Arts Museum are a few steps away. Rue Neuve, one of the best shopping streets, is also close-by. For quick access to the rest of the city, the airport and international trains, take a short walk to Central Station. NH Brussels Grand Place Arenberg has 155 stylish rooms. All have the highest quality bedding for guests' comfort and sleep. You can also stay connected with free Wi-Fi. For some more luxury, stay in one of our Executive Rooms, which were recently refurbished in 2014 and are bright, spacious rooms with light-wood furniture and parquet flooring. The breakfast is the pride of the hotel with a large buffet that offers fresh products, including local cheeses, cold cuts, fresh fruit and juices. On Sundays, sleep in and enjoy breakfast until noon. In the lobby you will find a 24/7 self-service Open Bar, and there's also an on-site gym.

6257.description: The Citybox Brussels hotel is conveniently located right next to the prestigious Avenue Louise shopping street in the heart of the uptown center of Brussels, with many restaurants and bars nearby. The hotel is within 15 minutes of the European Commission and Grand-Place, and you can walk to many major sites and attractions in just 15 minutes, including famous museums, the Midi Station, Parc de Bruxelles, Royal Palace and Place du Grand Sablon. The historical Palais de Justice, where there is a beautiful view over the city of Brussels, is five minutes walking from the Citybox Brussels.

6258.description: The iStay by NH Brussels Stéphanie hotel, formerly know as NH Brussels Stéphanie, is situated on a quiet and peaceful side street, yet right in the heart of the upscale Louise shopping district. Just steps away, guests can find luxurious boutiques and fine dining. Meanwhile, Brussels historic city center is only 25 minutes away on foot. Alternatively, Louise metro station is 300 meters away from the hotel and will connect guests to the rest of the city. iStay by NH Brussels Stéphanie has 67 contemporary rooms. Each one comes with tea and coffee making facilities and free Wi-Fi. Guests staying on the 6th floor will enjoy the lovely views over the rooftops of Brussels. Each morning, we serve a delicious breakfast buffet. There is something for every taste including fresh breads and pastries, cold cuts, cheeses, fruit, and yogurt. Guests can also wind down with an authentic Belgian beer or their favorite cocktail at our comfy lobby bar with armchairs and booths. If you need a snack any time of the day, there is a 24/7 self-service Open Bar, where you can find hot and cold sandwiches, confectionary, and various beverages. Our staff will be happy to recommend top dining options just steps away from the hotel.

6259.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include babysitting (surcharge), wedding services, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Brussels? This hotel has facilities measuring 3229 square feet (300 square meters), including conference space. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 282 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LED televisions.

6261.description:
Maxhotel is a conceptual hotel with design furnishings, at one of Brussels' central avenues. It features a lounge with 24/7 self-service food and drink facilities with free Danish pastries starting from 07:00. Free WiFi is available in the rooms. The rooms at Maxhotel feature a minimalistic design and luxury bedding.
The check-in and check-out kiosks can be used to enter and leave the hotel quickly. Drinks, breakfast, snacks and other things that can make the stay more pleasant, can be bought from the vending machines in the lounge area.
Maxhotel is located 200 metres from the Rogier Metro Station and the City2 Shopping Mall. Guests can reach the Brussels North Station and Grand Place in 10 minutes on foot.

6262.description: This hotel is situated on the renowned Avenue Louise, Brussels' famous commercial and business street. The hotel is located just a short walking distance away from the main train station, a myriad of tourist attractions and exemplary shopping opportunities. Links to the public transport network are to be found just 500 metres away from the hotel. This luxurious hotel exudes elegance and charm. The interior is beautifully designed, bathing guests in splendour and decadence. The guest rooms offer a cocoon of luxury and elegance, in which to escape the rest of the world. The hotel offers an impressive array of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of even the most discerning traveller. Additional services: - Get a Romance Package for you loved one including a bottle of Champagne, Rose petals a delicious box of belgian chocolates (€180 fee) - Our Pet friends are welcome (€50 fee) - The Aspria Spa is an adults-only sanctuary featuring a swimming pool, sauna and jacuzzi. Hotel guests enjoy a special daily access rate of EUR 45 per person, with reservations required 24 hours in advance.

name.content: Stanhope Hotel Brussels by Thon Hotels

6263.description: Situated in Brussels' European Quarter, the Stanhope Hotel offers a luxurious escape. Near the prestigious Avenue Toison d'Or and Avenue Louise, known for their designer boutiques, the hotel is also conveniently located 15 minutes from Schuman Station, providing access to Brussels International Airport in 16 minutes. Enjoy the elegant lounge, Library Bar, the Brighton Restaurant, and a beautiful interior garden. Awarded the Green Key Label in 2012 and certified as an Enterprise Eco-Dynamique, the Stanhope Hotel is also committed to sustainability. Its Brighton Restaurant focuses on healthy, sustainable gastronomy and boasts the SIIN label (Scientific Institute for Intelligent Nutrition).

6264.description: Enjoy a stay at this hotel, featuring a health club, indoor pool, and sauna. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, or take advantage of the concierge and wedding services. The onsite restaurant, The Poet, offers international cuisine and a bar/lounge, with room service available during limited hours. Buffet breakfast is served daily for a fee. The hotel offers 262 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary wired and wireless internet, and satellite programming. Each room includes a private bathroom with a shower/tub combination, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. For added convenience, laptop-compatible safes and desks are provided, along with daily housekeeping. Business amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities are available, featuring conference space and meeting rooms, as well as self-parking (subject to charges). Located near the Parlamentarium, Place du Luxembourg, and the European Union Parliament Building. The closest airport is Brussels Airport (BRU).

6265.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center and bicycle rentals. Hotel Hubert Grand Place also offers complimentary Wi-Fi and bike parking. Dine at the on-site restaurant or grab a snack at the deli. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel provides express check-in/check-out and a 24-hour front desk. Each of the 100 air-conditioned guest rooms features an espresso maker, a flat-screen TV with cable programming, complimentary wired and wireless internet, and a safe. Bathrooms include showers and complimentary toiletries. The hotel is conveniently located near Galeries Royales Saint-Hubert (0. 1 km), Rue des Bouchers (0. 2 km), and St. Michael and St. Gudula Cathedral (0. 2 km).

name.content: Hotel Avenue Louise Brussels Trademark Collection

6269.description: This hotel enjoys a prime location in Brussels, just 60 meters from the fashionable Avenue Louise and 350 meters from the Stephanie tram stop. A short walk from the Horta Museum and a 20-minute walk from Brussels South train station and the Eurostar terminal, it offers easy access to the city's attractions. The hotel features an inviting English-style bar with a fireplace, perfect for unwinding after a day exploring Brussels. Guests can indulge in a selection of fine Belgian chocolates and coffees, or enjoy a moonlit evening with cocktails on the patio. The beautifully appointed guest rooms offer modern amenities, including comfortable beds and private bathrooms with both a bathtub and a shower. Free Wi-Fi is available in every room, allowing guests to stay connected. A 24-hour front desk ensures attentive service throughout your stay, complemented by convenient access to public transportation.

6280.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Cradled by the Danube with unparalleled views of the river, Hilton Vienna Waterfront is an urban oasis in a historical building located 20 minutes from the international airport and the city centre. It allows guests to experience a different taste of the city deeply connected to its riverside lifestyle, while boasting vibrant outdoor spaces, relaxing wellness and fitness facilities including an outdoor pool, an authentic and sociable waterfront restaurant and bar, the most spacious guest rooms in town and versatile meeting and event spaces. With an easy and contemporary approach, the hotel seamlessly blends work and lifestyle, providing an enjoyable, laid-back yet curated experience for those looking for an escape as well as business guests and companies with a progressive mindset. Showcasing its love for nature, OXBO Vienna Waterfront offers lovingly crafted dishes and drinks from carefully selected regional, natural and seasonal ingredients. Guests visit OXBO day-through-night, to experience the heart and soul of authentic food and drinks, in the warm, relaxed and sociable atmosphere of the restaurant, bar, and terrace.

6313.description: This delightful hotel revels in its peaceful setting, lying close to a park, Schonbrunn Castle and the zoo. The hotel is situated just a 10 minutes' underground ride from the heart of Vienna. Vienna Airport is about 30 km away. Guests will find themselves in the ideal setting from which to explore the rich history and culture of this mesmerising city. The hotel itself enjoys a long history, dating back to the early 20th century featuring a beautiful combination of Viennese style and regal splendour. The beautifully-appointed guest rooms provide a peaceful setting and come equipped with convenient amenities. Guests can get a perfect start with exclusive breakfast then enjoy Viennese coffee and homemade cakes at the onsite cafe during the day.

6314.description: This hotel offers a bespoke family experience for travelers under 12. Children enjoy a kids' welcome and a dedicated kids' breakfast experience. Select dishes from the kids' menu for your family meals. A range of kids' amenities is available upon request. Home to Vienna's premier conference center, the Hilton Vienna Hotel features 3, 000 sq. m. of meeting space for 2–1, 800 participants with a choice of 21 meeting rooms. Set in the heart of Vienna, the hotel is just 16 minutes by direct train from Vienna International Airport. Try Austrian cuisine with a modern twist in LENZ Social Dining restaurant, or enjoy a drink in our urban bar, Selleny's. Work out in the well-equipped gym or unwind with the sauna, steam bath, and relaxation area. All 663 guest rooms feature park or city views and Wi-Fi. Executive Rooms offer access to the Executive Lounge with complimentary continental breakfast, snacks, and drinks.

6315.description: The Hotel Europa, ideally situated in Vienna's city center, is mere steps from St. Stephen's Cathedral and the renowned Kärntner Straße pedestrian precinct. Perfect for both sightseeing and business, the hotel offers convenient access to public transit and nearby parking. This modern business-class hotel boasts 160 comfortable rooms and suites, along with the elegant Europa Bar, a favorite among locals and international visitors. All rooms are non-smoking. Please note that breakfast offerings may be adjusted in accordance with current government guidelines regarding the COVID-19 pandemic.

6317.description: Enjoy the fascinating ambience you only find here in the heart of Vienna. Hotel Astoria Vienna, Curio Collection by Hilton stands in the Kärntner Strasse pedestrian precinct, where traffic noise is reduced to an absolute minimum. You are just a few minutes' walk from the city's most prominent historic sight and from the public transportation system. We are also glad to offer our guests valet parking at nearby public parking garage. Hotel Astoria Vienna, Curio Collection by Hilton has been synonymous with exclusive hotels since 1912. This traditional hotel is right in the heart of Vienna on the elegant Kärntner Strasse pedestrian zone. 125 rooms and suites with all comforts invite you to stay in a classical atmosphere, located between St. Stephen's Cathedral and Vienna Opera House. For seminars with up to 230 people, four modern function rooms and lounges are available here. Non smoking hotel. „In connection with the government's measures to curb the spread of the Corona virus, there may be an adjusted breakfast offer during this period. “

6318.description: This charming city hotel enjoys a strategic setting in the embassy quarter of Vienna. The hotel provides the perfect setting from which to explore the spectacular sights this enchanting city has to offer including the renowned Belvedere Castle. Guests will find themselves within easy access of links to the public transport network, which place other attractions and areas within easy reach. This splendid hotel boasts a stunning architectural style, complementing its surroundings with sophistication and elegance. Guests are welcomed into the spacious, elegant surrounds of the lobby, where timeless elegance and classical designs abound. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated and offer a haven of peace and tranquility in which to relax and unwind in comfort. Guests will appreciate the hotel's selection of excellent facilities which have been designed with comfort and convenience in mind.

6319.description: The Hotel Bellevue, a unique architectural landmark near the Liechtenstein Palais and the city center, offers excellent public transport connections. Reach Schönbrunn Palace or the Hofburg Palace in minutes. Following renovations in 2016, the hotel now offers 160 classically designed rooms and suites featuring modern comforts and amenities. The restaurant and bar provide a superb selection of Viennese and international cuisine, a wide range of drinks, and a stunning venue for celebrations, corporate events, and weddings for up to 80 guests. A fitness center, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and on-site parking are also available (for a fee - spaces limited - subject to availability).

6320.description:
Experience a relaxing stay at the Holiday Inn Vienna City, your 4-star hotel in Vienna with a central location. Just a few minutes’ walk from the Naschmarkt, the hotel combines urban flair with a peaceful atmosphere, making it ideal for city travelers, business guests, and families. 
Thanks to excellent transport connections, you can reach your destination in Vienna with ease: Bus line 13A takes you directly to the main train station. From Vienna International Airport, it is approximately 30 minutes by taxi or about 40 minutes conveniently by public transport. 
A special highlight is our green courtyard garden in the center of the city. In summer, start your day with breakfast outdoors, enjoy a cozy coffee in the afternoon, and end the evening with a drink under atmospheric lighting. 
Our rooms, inspired by the Viennese Modern style, offer everything you need for a comfortable and pleasant stay. 
As a business hotel in Vienna, the property features modern conference rooms with natural light and Wi-Fi, ideal for meetings and seminars. At the same time, families and leisure travelers benefit from a lively neighborhood with cafés, restaurants, and cultural attractions right on the doorstep. 
Look forward to warm hospitality, personalized service, and a location that makes your stay in Vienna truly special.

6321.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center and garden views. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting services (surcharge). Savor international cuisine at Cafe Imperial Wien, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Airport shuttle service (24 hours) and train station pick-up service are available for a surcharge. Make yourself at home in one of the 138 guest rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access will keep you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature bidets and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near the Vienna Music Society, Karlsplatz, and Ringstraßen Galerien. The preferred airport is Vienna International Airport (VIE).

6323.description: This luxurious hotel is located in the historic city centre of Vienna and was established in 1898. The establishment is close to St. Stephen's Cathedral, the State Opera and more sights. The nearest subway station is Stephansplatz while Vienna Airport is at 23 km from the property. Each of the spacious and individually designed rooms is equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, air conditioning and cable-TV. Guests can start their day with breakfast, served in the restaurant with winter garden, offering a modern ambience overlooking famous Neuer Markt. Guests can also enjoy a Viennese coffee, an aperitif at the impressive bar.

6324.description: Hotel Royal offers 4 star comfort in the heart of Vienna next to Kärntner Straße and St. Stephen's Cathedral, just a few minutes away from Vienna State Opera. Enjoy a delicious Italian dish in a one of the 2 hotel's own restaurants. Hotel Royal enjoys a prime inner city location directly next to Vienna's Stephansdom (cathedral), at the beginning of the pedestrian zone and the famous shopping streets Graben and Kaerntnerstraße. All of the 88 elegant rooms, including 70 Superior double rooms and 14 Deluxe double rooms, have been extensively refurbished in recent years and therefore guarantee an unforgettable stay directly in the heart of Vienna. Because of its central location, the Hotel Royal is perfectly suited as starting point for sightseeing tours and for visits to the opera and the various theatres downtown. Additionally, most of the city's top sights are reachable within walking distance. Due to the excellent access to public transportation our guests can easily visit other parts of our beautiful city. As the whole inner city is a non-parking zone, the hotel has a cooperation with a nearby public garage. Hotel Royal comprises two excellent Italian restaurants: Ristorante Firenze Enoteca is located on the ground floor and offers you the city's most extensive selection of Chianti-Classico wine. The roof top terrace restaurant Ristorante Settimo Cielo is located on the 10th floor of the hotel and, along with the exquisite cuisine, also offers a breathtaking panorama view over the rooftops of Vienna all the way to the mountains of Schneeberg.

6325.description: A stylish haven in the bustle of Old Town, Palais Rudolf is located on historic Rudolfsplatz square near the Danube River, overlooking lush Rudolfspark. As part of the vibrant 1st District, our boutique hotel is surrounded by many of Vienna’s most exceptional attractions, including grand palaces, art museums, and luxury boutiques. Named after Austria-Hungary’s Crown Prince Rudolf, the fin de siècle building is woven into the rich heritage and historicist charms of the Innere Stadt neighbourhood. Palais Rudolf breathes new life into the traditional Altbau, creating a timeless retreat where travellers and locals can gather.

6329.description: The four-star Hotel Kaiserin Elisabeth enjoys a prime location in Vienna's city center, just steps from St. Stephen's Cathedral and the renowned Kärntner Straße and Graben shopping districts. The U1 subway line is easily accessible from nearby Stephansplatz. Built in 1809, this historic hotel offers 63 non-smoking rooms across four floors. Many major attractions, including the Vienna State Opera, Hofburg Palace, Albertina Museum, and Burgtheater, are within walking distance. All rooms feature a private bath, telephone, radio, safe, cable TV, minibar, complimentary internet access, and air conditioning. After a busy day exploring Vienna, relax in our inviting lobby. Triple rooms are available upon request with extra beds or baby cots for an additional nightly fee.

6330.description: Offering typical Austrian atmosphere combined with comfort and first-class service, this urban hotel is located by the Naschmarkt market on Ringstraße within a 15-minute walk from a selection of coffee houses and architecture landmarks such as the Hundertwasserhaus. Vienna Airport is 25 km from the property. The hotel offers bright rooms in warm tones, equipped with air-conditioning, flat-screen TV, safe and bathroom with bath amenities. The elegant spacious on-site restaurant serves fantastic á la carte meals for lunch and dinner, but the hotel's fantastic locations means a wide variety of other dining options as well. Guests arriving by car, or even larger groups travelling by coach, can use the garage facilities available on the premises.

6331.description:
Friendly budget hotel, open to everyone

International flair & Viennese charm: ibis Wien Mariahilf is perfectly located for sightseeing (BIG BUS, Blue Line), shopping, business trips, and musicals. Centrally located right next to Vienna West Station (Westbahnhof) and close to numerous U-Bahn and tram lines, you can quickly reach all of the Danube metropolis’ key destinations. Six conference rooms—two of them on the 13th floor with a spectacular view—provide the perfect setting for your events. 

ibis Wien Mariahilf is a modern hotel in an ideal location near Westbahnhof and the popular shopping street Mariahilfer Straße. It offers comfortable rooms, efficient service, and facilities for both business and leisure travelers. 

“Welcome to ibis Wien Mariahilf, in the city of Mozart, Sisi and the croissant! Feel at home, relax, and enjoy Vienna. We’re delighted to have you with us—with good vibes, comfort, and genuine warmth. ”

Cédric Schiller, Hotel Management

Good to know

Join our “Good For Kids” program. We offer our guests the opportunity to support the organization Mécénat Chirurgie Cardiaque, which provides surgery and treatment for children with heart conditions. For stays of more than one night, you can voluntarily contribute to this initiative by choosing not to have your room cleaned every day; in return, our hotel donates a contribution to the organization.

6332.description: The 4-star Hotel Regina, a family-run Viennese establishment now in its fourth generation, offers a completely non-smoking environment. Centrally located near a park on the Ringstraße and Vienna University, it boasts 165 stylish rooms decorated with original Italian period furniture. Each room features a bath or shower, WC, telephone, minibar, safe, free satellite TV, radio, air conditioning, hairdryer, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy Viennese and Austrian cuisine in the hotel restaurant, and eight banquet and seminar rooms are also available. A 24-hour business center is provided free of charge on a fair-use basis. Check-in begins at 3 p. m. , with luggage storage available for early arrivals. Check-out is at 11:00 a. m. . The hotel's central location in the University Quarter provides easy access to Vienna's most famous sights and shopping streets. The U2 Schottentor underground station is just a few hundred meters away.

6333.description: This 5 star hotel is located in the city centre of Vienna and was established in 1872. It is close to the St Stephens Cathedral and the nearest station is Stadtpark / U4, Stubentor / U3. The Hotel has 2 restaurants, a bar, a conference room, a coffee shop and a fitness centre/gym. All 247 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, trouser press, ironing set and air conditioning.

6334.description: Hotel Mercure Wien Westbahnhof is situated next to the train station City West, in an impressive location near Mariahilfer Strasse with a fantastic range of shops to choose from. It is also close to Wiener Stadthalle, a venue for international artists, just around the corner from Vienna's top musical stage - Raimund Theater. The Naschmarkt, Schönbrunn Palace, Art History Museum, the new Stadtsaal Theater and Vienna's historical old town are easy to visit by metro and tram.

6335.description: Infused with a lively spirit, Miiro Spittelberg is a new hotel in Vienna located on tranquil Kirchberggasse, just moments from MuseumsQuartier and the famous Ringstrasse. Named after Vienna’s most characterful neighbourhood, once home to a thriving community of artisan ateliers, Spittelberg is part of the new wave of creativity enlivening the historic cobbled streets in the 7th District.

6336.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Beautifully located on Ringstrasse, Hilton Vienna Plaza is within walking distance of St. Stephen's Cathedral, Burgtheater, the State Opera and Hofburg Imperial Palace. You'll find exclusive amenities and unique service in this designer hotel, just 20 minutes' drive from the airport. Sample French- and Austrian-inspired cuisine at Brasserie, EMILE – the winner of a toque from Gault Millau in 2015. The restaurant guide's inspectors awarded the brasserie with 14 points, a fine rating for high quality food. Enjoy specialties prepared with fresh seasonal ingredients and an excellent selection of Austrian and international wines. During the day and well into the night, relax with Martini specials, absinthe and other delicious drinks at our hotel bar. Conveniently located in Vienna's commercial center, Hilton Vienna Plaza provides a Lobby Lounge connectivity station with both PC and Mac computers. Before arrival and through departure, your Plaza host will reach out to ensure your experience is everything you want it to be. Business meetings are easy using our flexible function rooms for 2-150 guests. WiFi is available throughout the hotel and all meeting rooms offer natural daylight. A/V and videoconferencing equipment are available for rent. Our timeless guest rooms offer a range of thoughtful amenities, such as a work desk and a marble bathroom. Upgrade to a suite for a separate living room. Executive rooms and suites include exclusive Executive Lounge access with complimentary breakfast, snacks and drinks. The hotel's exterior complements the architectural and ornamental features of the street and the city, including its facade, building height and golden brass railings.

6357.description: Our ibis Geneva Centre Lac hotel in downtown Geneva is a 2-minutes walk from the Cornavin main train station, the Leman lake and all city bus and streetcar routes. Discover easy living in a cozy, inviting setting with exceptionally comfortable rooms. Order simple, effective and deliciously prepared snacks from our bar. Start a perfect weekend with breakfast served until 11AM on Saturdays and Sundays.

6358.description: The hotel is right at the heart of Geneva, only meters from numerous shopping and entertainment venues. Close by, guests will find the flower clock, the Jet d'Eau and the headquarters for the UN. The old town is around 2 km away as is the Natural History Museum. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, lifts, safes, cloakroom, currency exchange. There is a café, a cosy bar and a restaurant, a business centre and Wi-Fi in public areas. For added fees, guests can use the room and laundry services, as well as the bicycle hire and car parking.

6359.description: Experience the enhanced comfort of our newly renovated rooms, featuring dynamic, technologically advanced windows that automatically tint with the daylight. The Warwick Geneva boasts a prime city-center location directly across from Cornavin Railway Station and a quick 7-minute train ride from Geneva International Airport. We're within easy walking distance of international organizations, Geneva's historical center, and numerous museums. Enjoy delicious meals and refreshments throughout the day at our Teseo Bar and Restaurant. A variety of other dining options are also available both on-site and nearby. Take a scenic stroll along Lake Geneva to the iconic Jet d'Eau fountain and explore the charming historic center, museums, and diverse shopping streets. Guests enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, in-room coffee and tea facilities, access to the Silhouette Sports Club, and a free public transportation pass.

6360.description: 'Overlooking Lake Geneva and the iconic Jet d'Eau, Hotel Metropole Genève enjoys a prime location in the heart of Geneva's business and shopping district, just a five-minute walk from the Old City. Built in 1854 on the city's ancient fortifications, this distinguished hotel is the only deluxe hotel on the left bank of Lake Geneva. Its 127 renovated rooms and suites offer modern amenities, including Nespresso coffee machines, Wi-Fi, and iPod docking stations. Each air-conditioned accommodation is tastefully decorated, and many boast stunning lake views. Guests can enjoy the fitness center and business center, as well as Wi-Fi in all public areas. Savor modern Italian cuisine in the elegant and inviting Gusto restaurant, or meet for cocktails and light meals at the renowned Mirror Bar. With over 150 years of tradition and a recent ambitious renovation, Hotel Metropole Genève is the perfect destination for both business and leisure travelers. '

6361.description: A stone's throw from Lake Geneva, discover the Novotel Genève Centre. For a business trip, family vacation or a romantic weekend break, relax and unwind in our spacious and comfortable rooms. Extremely convenient for business travelers, this 4-star hotel is close to a number of prestigious institutions and boasts 5 meeting rooms. Take a relaxing break in the steam room or work up a sweat in the fitness center. Sample healthy cuisine in the restaurant. Life is good at Novotel. Car park (max. height 5 ft. 7 in)

6362.description: Nestled near Geneva International Airport, Crowne Plaza Geneva is a 4-star haven with a free airport shuttle and easy connection to the railway station. Guests also receive free public transport passes. Ideal for business travellers, our hotel features a 24-hour business centre, free Wi-Fi, and 16 versatile venues for up to 500 guests. Take a 15-minute drive to explore attractions like historic Old Town, Lakeside Promenade, and the iconic water fountain. Savour delicious dining at our on-site restaurants, unwind on the garden terrace or lobby bar, and stay active in our 24-hour fitness centre. Experience contemporary comfort in our guest rooms with premium bedding and thoughtful amenities. Embrace modernity in the heart of Geneva.

name.content: Ritz-Carlton Hotel de la Paix, Geneva

6363.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy international cuisine at Living Room Bar & Kitchen, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Geneva? This hotel has 1130 square feet (105 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 4 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours).

6364.description: Urban, stylish, calm, the Auteuil hotel is located just a few minutes from Geneva's main train station. In the lobby, a collection of original photos of stars from the 1960s - from Sofia Loren to Sean Connery - gives the place its personality. With the elegant, modern design of the rooms and the fitness centre, you're sure to find relaxation.

6365.description: This hotel is situated at the heart of the city. Beautiful Lake Geneva and the wonderful, picturesque old town are both within walking distance of the property. The nearest public transport links are conveniently close to the hotel, while Lausanne can be reached in 45 minutes by car. This establishment was built in 1974 and consists of 156 double rooms spread over 7 floors in the main building. Various facilities are available to guests, including a vast foyer with a currency exchange desk and a conference room. The tastefully furnished and stylishly decorated rooms all come with an en-suite bathroom and feature satellite/ cable TV and Internet access.

6367.description: Mandarin Oriental, Geneva is situated in an ideal location on the banks of the Rhône River, nestled in the heart of the city, close to luxury boutiques, the business district, and the historic centre. The hotel comprises 178 spacious rooms and suites, offering spectacular views of the Rhône River, the Old Town, and the mountains in the background. Mandarin Oriental, Geneva features two restaurants and a bar, each with a unique atmosphere and exceptional culinary experience. The gastronomic Japanese restaurant SACHI, from the Nobu Group, offers an intimate 10-seat Omakase bar, a unique experience in Geneva. Ottolenghi, the hotel’s newest vibrant mediterranean concept inspired by the ethos of the chef Yotam Ottolenghi and his London-based restaurant ROVI, celebrates vegetables from root to tip, with a fresh focus on fermentation and cooking over fire. MO Bar is a contemporary lounge bar with modern and elegant decor. Open every day for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, it offers a diverse menu of dishes, as well as a selection of cocktails and mocktails, highlighting ingredients with international flavors. Nestled in the heart of the city, Mandarin Oriental, Geneva enjoys a privileged location along the banks of the Rhône River, just steps away from the historic centre, luxury boutiques, and the financial district of Geneva.

name.content: Four Seasons Hotel des Bergues Geneva

6368.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages and facials. Recreational amenities include an indoor pool, steam room, and 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Savor Italian cuisine at Il Lago, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily (7:00 AM to 10:30 AM) for a fee. Business amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (24 hours, surcharge). The 115 air-conditioned rooms feature refrigerators, flat-screen televisions, memory foam beds with premium bedding, and double sofa beds. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access, DVD players, and digital programming are provided. Private bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Rousseau Island, Mont Blanc Bridge, Cité du Temps, and the City Center Shopping Area, just a short distance from Geneva International Airport (GVA).

6370.description: Located in the heart of Geneva, this seven-story hotel offers easy access to the city's main attractions, the lake, and public transportation. Guest rooms feature soundproof windows and complimentary Wi-Fi, ensuring a comfortable night's sleep. Modern amenities provide added convenience. Hotel facilities include a restaurant, meeting room, breakfast room with panoramic views, and laundry service. The Congress Center and the airport are easily accessible within 20 minutes.

6372.description: Opt for a convenient location near Geneva International Airport and complimentary public transport to city centre when you stay at Mövenpick Hotel Geneva. Business travellers enjoy close proximity to the Palexpo convention centre, while leisure guests love the Lake Geneva and the Alps nearby. Elegant interiors, soundproof windows & free Wi-Fi can be found in our 350 rooms and suites. Dine on delectable specialities from Switzerland and Japanese delicacies in two restaurants and a bar.

6375.description: Nestled adjacent to GVA, Geneva Cointrin International Airport, the NH Geneva Airport hotel offers convenience to downtown Geneva, Switzerland and idyllic Lake Geneva for the business and leisure traveler. The hotel is a short walk from the Meyrin, Jardin-Alpin-Vivarium bus and tram stop, connecting to Geneva's city center, Manor Geneva, the Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art and other top sites. A stone's throw from the Switzerland-France border, the hotel also serves as a springboard to picturesque villages and skiing in the Swiss and French Alps. NH Geneva Airport's 190 rooms feature hardwood floors, deep, plush mattresses and coffee and tea facilities. We also offer room service and different room types: standard, Junior Suites and superior. Business travelers can host meetings in one of our four event rooms, with space for up to 60 people. On-site dining options include an ample breakfast buffet, and for dinner, Le Pavillon Restaurant, offering international fare with a focus on French and Mediterranean dishes. After a busy day, unwind with cocktails at the B4 lobby bar. Or retreat to your room after selecting a snack from the 24-hour open bar, with grab-and-go sandwiches, ice cream and hot beverages. Parking and an electric vehicle charging station is also available.

6376.description: Located in downtown Geneva, close to the shopping district, this hotel provides easy access to the city's tourist attractions within minutes. Very close to the Cornavin Train Station, and only a few metres from other convenient public transportation links. This hotel offers a unique experience, partly thanks to its architecture. Renovated in a very modern style, the hotel features 164 rooms with air-conditioned and standard amenities. The hotel also offers a restaurant with panoramic views of the city on the 8th floor.

6377.description: This six-story, smoke-free hotel offers discounted nearby parking and convenient access to Segway and bicycle rentals. Enjoy room service during limited hours, and a buffet breakfast (for a fee) served weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. The hotel features a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Each of the 62 air-conditioned rooms includes a flat-screen television with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a safe, a desk, and a bathroom with a bathtub or shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. Daily housekeeping is provided. Centrally located in Geneva, Hotel Suisse is within a short walk of Notre Dame Basilica and the City Center Shopping Area. The hotel is also a 5-minute drive from the Jet d'Eau Fountain and the United Nations European Headquarters, and conveniently located near other key attractions. Geneva International Airport (GVA) is 5 km (3. 1 mi) away.

6414.description: This hotel enjoys a great location in Geneva. The hotel is situated within easy access of a host of attractions, including bars, restaurants, shops and entertainment venues. Links to the public transport network are easily accessible from this hotel. This hotel features a beautiful blend of traditional and contemporary styles. The hotel showcases a stunning, neoclassical architectural design, tempting guests into the elegant surroundings of the lobby. The guest rooms are sumptuously designed, bathing visitors in luxury and the utmost in comfort and convenience. The hotel features a first-class restaurant, where delectable culinary delights are sure to tempt even the most discerning palate. The hotel offers a range of exceptional facilities, which are sure to impress all the travellers.

6417.description: Right in the heart of Zurich business district, Mama is taking its first steps in Switzerland. With its lively streets, quiet spots and trendy districts, come and discover Zurich his unique charm. Close to the city centre and train station, Mama will be your ideal base during your stay. 178 rooms that don’t skimp on comfort: fluffy, super comfortable beds mamamoji, a wide selection of free movies mamamoji, and organic toiletries mamamoji in the bathroom. Of course, the city of Zurich mamamoji is also reflected in the decor: wooden alcoves above the bed, seats reminiscent of logs, carpet in the pattern of a chocolate bar… Everything you need for a wonderful stay in Zurich!

6418.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Airport Shuttle, Executive Lounge, Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s). The following services and amenities are currently not available: Room Service, Spa. Your business and events Hotel located between the city of Zurich and the airport The Hilton Zurich Airport is situated just five minutes from Zurich international airport, The Circle and 15 minutes from downtown with its popular lakeside promenade, the famous town and many cultural attractions. Direct access to the highway, the proximity to public transportation, the business district, the trade show venue and to the Hallenstadion make the Hilton Zurich Airport the ideal starting point for your business or leisure trips. Enjoy a relaxing stay in one of the 323 modernly furnished rooms and suites. 25 bright meeting and event rooms equipped with state-of-the-art technology and capacities ranging up to 260 people are also available to you. With a flexible conference area of 1360 m2 and a range of business facilities, the hotel is the ideal location that allows you to efficiently and effectively host different events regardless of whether they are for business or pleasure. A special highlight is the panorama ballroom with an area of 268 m2. Boasting a breathtaking 180° panorama view that spans from the airport to the Swiss Alps, the Horizon10 restaurant will treat you to international, regional and Swiss specialties from the show kitchen. In the lobby bar guests can enjoy a variety of cocktails, specialty coffees or a freshly tapped beer. We also provide for our Hilton Honors Guests an executive lounge. For your service: hotel airport shuttle service and 250 parking spaces.

6419.description: This upscale hotel is ideally situated in the centre of Zurich. The hotel lies just a short driving distance away from the historical centre of the city. The nearest train station is Zurich. This hotel offers visitors close proximity to a number of attractions, as well as a wide range of shopping, dining and entertainment venues. This hotel enjoys a sophisticated design. The guest rooms are elegantly styled, offering modern amenities for added convenience. The hotel provides a delightful restaurant, where delicious dishes can be enjoyed. The hotel also offers a conference room, for the convenience of business travellers.

6420.description: The Glockenhof hotel is located in the commercial area of the city of Zurich, just a few meters from the central railway station and the famous Zürisee lake. It has two restaurants serving traditional food and vegetarian dishes. Rooms have air conditioning, Nespresso machine, free Internet and a well-equipped bathroom.

6421.description: Enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center and garden views. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and wedding services. Savor regional cuisine at eCHo Restaurant, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (6:30 AM to 11 AM) for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Zurich? This hotel offers 15, 198 square feet (1, 412 square meters) of event space, including conference space and 16 meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself at home in one of the 266 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed includes down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary Wi-Fi and satellite programming are provided for your entertainment. Bathrooms include designer toiletries and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Platzpromenade (0. 1 mi), Flussbad Oberer Letten (0. 3 mi), and the Museum of Design (0. 3 mi). The preferred airport is Zurich Airport (ZRH), 6. 2 mi from the hotel.

6424.description: This first-class hotel boasts a strategic setting at the heart of Zurich. The hotel is situated on the renowned Bahnhofstrasse, lying opposite the central railway station. The hotel is located a mere 15 minutes' train ride away from Zurich Airport. This wonderful hotel offers a great setting from which to explore the abundance of attractions that this charming city has to offer. This traditional hotel enjoys a stunning architectural design, dating back to the late 19th century. The hotel tempts guests with the promise of unrivalled luxury and comfort. The guest rooms are sumptuously appointed, featuring functional space and a refreshing ambience, in which to rest and work in comfort. The hotel offers a seemingly boundless array of exemplary facilities, which are sure to impress even the most discerning traveller.

6426.description: Centrally located in Zurich, Hotel Montana Zürich is a 5-minute walk from the Swiss National Museum and 12 minutes on foot from Bahnhofstrasse. This hotel offers 74 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant and coffee shop/cafe, with buffet breakfast available daily (fee applies). Amenities include a business center, express check-in/check-out, concierge services, on-site shopping, and self-parking (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Kunsthaus Zurich and ETH Zurich, both 1. 3 miles away. Zurich Airport (ZRH) is 7. 1 miles from the hotel.

6427.description: Enjoy garden views at this centrally located Zurich hotel, offering concierge services and a hair salon. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge after a day exploring the city. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel features a 24-hour business center, express check-in/out, and airport shuttle (surcharge). Self-parking is available onsite (fee applies). Each of the 60 individually furnished guestrooms offers espresso makers, flat-screen TVs with satellite channels, and private bathrooms with rainfall showers. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes, desks, and phones with free local calls. Located a short walk from ETH Zurich and Bahnhofstrasse, the hotel is also close to the Central Library, Swiss Craft Center, and Polybahn Funicular. Zurich Airport (ZRH) is approximately 11. 1 km away.

6431.description: The ibis Zurich City West is located in a stylish district of Zurich, close to the motorway and 100m from the Technopark business center. It's a mere 9km from the airport and 10 minutes from the main railway station. The hotel offers 155 air-cooled rooms, including five accessible rooms. Guests can enjoy an onsite restaurant, a terrace, and a bar serving light meals and snacks 24 hours a day. Private undercover parking is available (fees apply), as is Wi-Fi access.

6454.description: ibis Styles Zurich City Center is an affordable 3-star hotel just minutes from the main train station and Zurich's highlights. This design hotel featuring geometric elements and optical illusions by artist M. C. Escher has 202 rooms and 5 meeting rooms with modern equipment. Relax in the wellness area with sauna, enjoy a meal in the restaurant or immerse yourself in the hustle and bustle of the city. ibis Styles Zurich City Center design hotel welcomes you in the heart of the picturesque metropolis. Swiss hospitality surrounded by modern design make for an unforgettable stay. The Limmat River and medieval old town with the Swiss National Museum are just a short walk away. The Opera House, Grossmünster Church and Lake Zurich are also close by.

6515.description: Ideally located on the beautiful Avenue Mohammed VI, in the city center, near the Medina and just 4km away from the international airport, the Movenpick Hotel Mansour Eddahbi Marrakech offers outstanding facilities. Located in Marrakech city center, L Hivernage district Contemporary oasis setting Three restaurants and bars Direct access to the Palais des Congres Marrakech Spa, swimming pool, one heated in winter, Yoga Studio, Fitness and Kids club.

6522.description: Conveniently located near the International Convention Centre, National Indoor Arena, National Exhibition Centre (NEC), Edgbaston Cricket Grounds, and major business centers, this hotel offers easy access to the M5 and M6 motorways, Birmingham International Airport, and the NEC. The hotel features 126 bedrooms and extensive meeting and function facilities, along with free Wi-Fi and ample free parking. A £100 security deposit is required upon check-in, either as a pre-authorization on a card or as a cash deposit.

6531.description: From Robert Burns to Sir Walter Scott, our landmark hotel has hosted the bold and curious for over 200 years. Now, it’s your turn to experience our warm Edinburgh welcome. Our iconic building on one of the capital’s most prestigious streets offers the perfect location for exploring the city. With our insider knowledge, you’ll take in spectacular views and cultural curiosities. Set the scene for remarkable memories in our luxurious suites, world-class restaurant and other unique spaces.

6532.description: Nestled perfectly between Edinburgh's Old and New Towns, Hotel Indigo Edinburgh - Princes Street offers guests the best of both worlds. Explore the unparalleled historic attractions of Old Edinburgh, then step into the heart of the world-famous New Town, renowned for its unique shops, champagne bars, designer boutiques, and independent retailers showcasing Scottish produce. The hotel's design draws inspiration from Edinburgh's rich history as a meeting place for great thinkers, literary pioneers, poets, and authors—a legacy that continues to inspire artists and creators today. Hotel Indigo Edinburgh - Princes Street aims to ignite your imagination with thoughtfully designed rooms reflecting the city's vibrant spirit. Our stylish bedrooms feature air conditioning, a 40' LCD TV, an invigorating rainfall shower, luxurious toiletries, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Many rooms offer perfectly framed views of Edinburgh Castle, a majestic landmark dominating the skyline since the 12th century. Savor Scotland's finest meat and seafood at our multi-award-winning restaurant, Twenty Princes Street, and enjoy handcrafted cocktails, wines, and coffees in the Juniper cocktail lounge.

6534.description: Relax in the full-service spa, enjoying massages, body treatments, and facials. For recreation, you'll find a health club, indoor pool, and sauna. This hotel also offers complimentary wireless and wired internet access, concierge and wedding services, and a 24-hour business center. Dine at One Square restaurant and bar/lounge, or enjoy room service (limited hours). Full breakfasts are served weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fee applies). For events, the hotel boasts 16, 641 square feet (1546 square meters) of space, including conference areas and 14 meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (fee applies). The 269 guest rooms feature minibars and LCD televisions.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel, Edinburgh City Centre

6535.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at the Radisson Blu Hotel in Edinburgh City Centre, steps from the Royal Mile. Indulge in the full-service spa with body treatments and facials, or take advantage of the health club, indoor pool, and sauna. Savor a meal at the restaurant, a snack in the cafe, or a drink at the bar/lounge. 24-hour room service is also available. The hotel's 238 guestrooms feature LCD TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms. Business amenities include a business center and conference space. Self-parking is available (charges apply). Nearby attractions include Edinburgh Castle, St. Giles' Cathedral, and the Edinburgh Dungeon.

6536.description: Nestled in the beautiful Victorian district of Edinburgh, this charming hotel is just over a 10-minute walk from the city centre and the main entertainment areas. Its guests will be a short 15-minute stroll away from the old town, the Royal Mile and the famous castle, and there are convenient links to the public transport in the immediate vicinity. The small, friendly and independent hotel hides a modern interior behind its Victorian façade. The designer furniture, modern bathrooms with Parisien Metro tiles and Hansgrohe power showers are just part of the comforts which make it the perfect place for relaxing. Those who need to escape from the noise of the city can enjoy a beautiful courtyard garden, while the modern lounge is a great place where to sip a chilled drink at the end of the day. For its perfect start guests can savour the cooked-to-order daily full Scottish breakfast.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh - City West

6537.description: Welcome to Holiday Inn Express® Edinburgh City West. Just off the A90 and a quick taxi from Haymarket Station. Edinburgh Waverley Station is a 15-minute drive away for catching trains to Glasgow and Newcastle. Edinburgh Airport is a 10-kilometre drive from the hotel. Explore the history of Edinburgh Castle, a 15-minute drive away and enjoy panoramic views of the city. Catch a rugby match at Scottish Gas Murrayfield Stadium and cheer on your favourite team, just a 5-minute drive away. Discover over 200 species at Edinburgh Zoo, from giant pandas to penguins or enjoy a fun day out at Camera Obscura’s World of Illusions, both a 10-minute drive. Dive into modern and contemporary art at National Galleries of Scotland: Modern One, a 20-minute walk from the hotel. Shop for souvenirs and grab a bite to eat in the luxury St James Quarter or stroll through Princes Street and Edinburgh’s Old Town. Take a hike up Arthur’s Seat for breath-taking views of Edinburgh’s skyline and wander through the Royal Botanical Gardens, a short drive from our hotel. Relax after a busy day in your room with a flat-screen TV and en-suite with shower. Enjoy a free buffet breakfast each morning before heading out for the day. Order light bites and coffees throughout the day and grab a bite to eat in the evening from our snack menu. Relax with drinks from the bar in our Great Room and catch up with free Wi-Fi.

6538.description: Enjoy a central Edinburgh stay at the eco-certified Apex City of Edinburgh Hotel, steps from Grassmarket and a short walk from Edinburgh Castle. This hotel offers 122 guestrooms equipped with LED TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, designer toiletries, and in-room safes. Start your day with a full breakfast (available for a fee), and utilize convenient amenities such as concierge and wedding services, dry cleaning/laundry, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The hotel is also conveniently located near Princes Street and the Royal Mile.

6539.description: This 3 star hotel is located within the city of Edinburgh and was established in 1998. It is a short drive away from the Edinburgh Castle. The Hotel has a restaurant, a bar, a conference room and a coffee shop. All 66 rooms are equipped with hairdryer, safe, trouser press and ironing set.

6547.description: One of London’s most iconic hotels, The Royal Horseguards features over 280 bedrooms and suites with stunning views over the River Thames. Walking distance from Charing Cross, Westminster & Embankment stations. The hotel is only 43 minutes from Heathrow. Perfectly located close to Westminster, the London Eye & Trafalgar Square. After a busy day enjoy dinner at One Twenty One Two Restaurant or a drink at the Equus Bar. In the summer, the outdoor terrace can be booked for private events. This impressive building is also home to 16 meeting rooms including One Whitehall Place, which is one of the most unique banquet and conference venues in West London. TripAdvisor Traveller’s Choice 2024 & Greenage ECOSmart 2023 Gold Accreditation.

name.content: Millennium Ht & Conference Ctr. Gloucester London

6548.description: Located in stylish Kensington, the Hotel London is 350 feet from Gloucester Road Tube Station and just a short walk from the Victoria and Albert Museum. Feel free to expand this box if requiredIdeally located in the beautiful neighbourhood of Kensington, just minutes away from Gloucester Road station, Millennium Gloucester Hotel is the perfect place from which to explore London. With 611 bedrooms, our hotel offers a seamless blend of personalised service with unrivalled comfort. Enjoy Korean cuisine at Korean Grill Kensington (KGK) or grab a bite to eat throughout the day at Humphrey's Bar. Take a stroll to nearby Kensington Palace Gardens and Hyde Park or explore London's iconic museums from The Natural History Museum and The Victoria and Albert Museum all within walking distance from the hotel. London Heathrow Airport is only 45 minutes away and is easily accessible via the London underground.

6550.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestClose to Olympia Exhibition Centre and the fashionable Kensington High Street, Hilton London Olympia is the perfect base for business or leisure. For those looking to host conferences and events, our dedicated events team will work closely with you to understand your needs. Kensington has many nice destinations to visit and things to do for all ages. From historic architecture and stunning art to hands-on activities for kids, we are in the perfect place to see it all. With excellent bus, train and airport connections close by, traveling further afield will not be a problem, which makes us a go-to destination for your next family break. Our rooms are designed with your comfort and convenience in mind, providing a place to unwind or catch up on work. Whether you are here on business or for a city break, we are here to help you make the most of your stay by offering fantastic dining and first-class services. We have everything you need for a truly memorable stay in the capital. Hilton London Olympia Hotel rates are now inclusive of all taxes.

6553.description: The hotel is surrounded by the best London has to offer. Set in the heart of London, the hotel is a mere moment from Covent Garden, Trafalgar Square and the Thames, making it the perfect location for discovering cultural icons and for those travelling on business. With so much to do right on the hotel's doorstep and excellent transport connections to whisk across the city or further afield, a stay at the hotel puts guests at the centre of the action. The nearest Airport is London City Airport, located about 17 km away. With that in mind, all rooms are fully furnished to ensure downtime is as comfortable as possible. In-room amenities include air-conditioning, a minibar, a large HD TV, coffee facilities and toiletries. The hotel offers a guest service centre and gym for guest use. The hotel has launched its brand new in-house restaurant and bar which is the perfect place to enjoy great food, cocktails and more in the heart of London. Guests can enjoy British-inspired cuisine with modern art deco décor throughout the restaurant, bar, afternoon tearoom and private dining room.

6554.description: Central stay within a mile of Hyde Park and Paddington Station. Enjoy onsite bars and restaurants, a gym, executive lounge, and a range of room types. 'Located in the heart of London, Hilton London Metropole offers everything you need under one roof. Our 1, 100 bedrooms include a range of room types, from suites and executive rooms to king deluxe rooms with views of the London skyline. We offer four uniquely themed bars and restaurants. Tyburn Kitchen, our neighborhood restaurant, kicks the day off with a grazing-style breakfast and concludes with dinner, where our show-stopping Josper Charcoal grill takes center stage. Experience our East London inspired Bow Bar for unique cocktails created by our expert mixologists. Grab and go or sit and enjoy ready-to-eat dishes from Tyburn Market. Lastly, enjoy our relaxed, family friendly atmosphere at Tyburn Kitchen Bar. Did we mention our fully equipped gym or our refurbished executive lounge yet? Our prime London location means you’re centre to all the action, just a short stroll from Hyde Park and Oxford Street, and only 15 minutes from Heathrow Airport via the Heathrow Express. We also have four tube lines right on our doorstep at Edgware Road underground station. All of this walks hand in hand with our spacious and versatile event space. We offer more than 35 event rooms, including three huge ballrooms, and have received three sustainability accreditations. Our event services include bespoke catering menu options, tech and audiovisual equipment, and room blocks for your attendees.

6555.description: This hotel offers guests a convenient location, near some of the city's best known attractions, such as Madame Tussaud's, Paddington, and King's Cross railway stations. This luxury city hotel is located some 35 km from both Heathrow and Gatwick international airports. The property was built in 1936 and comprises a total of 581 rooms on 8 floors. Guests will find a unique ambience and a number of facilities in the establishment. Dining options include an inviting bar and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with a separate non-smoking area and highchairs for infants. The modish, debonair rooms come with an en-suite bathroom, satellite and cable TV and Internet access.

6556.description:
This refined city hotel revels in its prime setting at the heart of London. The hotel is located just a short distance away from Piccadilly Circus and the underground station. This charming hotel offers guests a great location from which to explore the exciting sights and sounds that this vibrant city has to offer. The hotel features an attractive architectural design, tempting guests into the relaxing surroundings of the lobby. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, and come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests will appreciate the wide range of facilities and services that this wonderful hotel has to offer. 

You may also wish to note that, as we approach our 120th year, The Dilly is delighted to announce the beginning of an extensive renovation programme that will restore our hotel as one of Piccadilly’s most iconic landmarks. 

Our new entrance and lobby is now open and we have now started phase 1 of our major bedroom refurbishment. We appreciate your cooperation and understanding whilst we undergo this exciting transformation. 

We remain fully committed to ensuring every stay feels seamless and memorable, and we look forward to unveiling our beautifully transformed spaces and sharing this exciting journey with you.

name.content: The Marble Arch Hotel, by Thistle

6557.description:
Located at the west end of Oxford Street and just a 2‑minute walk from the green open spaces of Hyde Park, The Marble Arch Hotel offers a prime London base in the heart of the city. The hotel is exceptionally well‑connected, situated only a 2‑minute walk from Marble Arch Station and a 10‑minute walk from Bond Street Station, making it effortless to explore London’s top attractions. 
Perfectly positioned close to the elegant Park Lane district and moments from the world‑famous Selfridges, the hotel is ideal for guests looking to experience London’s best shopping, dining and sightseeing. 
Inspired by its prestigious location, the hotel welcomes guests with newly unveiled Italian marble flooring and a refreshed atmosphere designed to help you unlock your London adventure. Each room features a stylish and supremely comfortable Hypnos bed for a restful night’s sleep, along with thoughtful amenities for a relaxing stay. Guests can enjoy tea and coffee making facilities, complimentary bottled water and bathroom toiletries, fast free unlimited Wi‑Fi, and an HD‑ready TV with Freesat. Rooms also include a full-length mirror, professional hairdryer, and convenient USB and international plug sockets. 
Overlooking the vibrant energy of Oxford Street, Archy’s Bar & Lounge is the perfect place to unwind after a day of shopping, sightseeing or meetings, serving cocktails, wines, mocktails and a menu of small plates and hearty favourites. Cucina by Archy’s brings the flavours of Italy with simple ingredients, bold dishes and regional wines, while The Deli offers Starbucks Coffee, Yarde Farm ice cream and light grab‑and‑go meals.

6558.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite to eat at JW Steakhouse, a steakhouse which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 5449 square feet (506 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 23 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 496 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed.

6559.description: At Kimpton Fitzroy London, we have stories galore to tell. From the outside, the palatial 19th-century landmark building, which occupies a full block in Bloomsbury, looks the part of grande dame. Inside are contemporary creature comforts like roomy, art-filled suites with views over Russell Square, and destinations restaurants and bars that'll take your breath away. Fitz's, a glamorous drinking den that keeps the cocktails flowing; Burr & Co. , a casually cool coffee shop; the light-filled, foliage-adorned Palm Court; and Galvin Bar & Grill, a modern British restaurant by Michelin-starred brothers Chris and Jeff Galvin. All of these details beckon modern travelers to settle in, and stay a while.

6560.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Expect a warm welcome the moment you arrive at Hilton London Kensington. We’re located in the leafy district of Holland Park, 30 minutes from Heathrow Airport, with excellent transport links into Central London. Each spacious guest room at the Hilton London Kensington hotel is light and modern, with a coffee maker, flat-screen TVs, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Guests can also make use of daily newspapers and magazines in the room. Enjoy your time at the WestEleven Restaurant, serving a breakfast buffet every morning in a setting decorated with modern art. Our Avenue Bar & Lounge is in the lobby and offers an á la carte menu, a wide selection of drinks, and computer terminals with internet access. Our London Kensington hotel has everything you need for a remarkable stay in the capital.

name.content: St James Court A Taj Hotel

6561.description: St. James' Court, a Taj Hotel, epitomizes classic English charm. A short walk from St. James Park Tube Station, this Victorian masterpiece, with its renowned Shakespearean courtyard, is nestled between Buckingham Palace and the Houses of Parliament. Nearby attractions include Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, and the London Eye. Guests enjoy proximity to premier shopping destinations such as Harrods, Selfridges, and Harvey Nichols. The hotel offers 'Tajness, ' a commitment to authentic Indian hospitality with enhanced safety and hygiene measures. The attentive staff strives to exceed expectations, creating memorable experiences in this blend of historic elegance and contemporary comfort.

6564.description: Located in the heart of London's vibrant Bloomsbury district, known for its distinctive architecture and cultural attractions, The Bloomsbury offers a luxurious stay just steps from Covent Garden, Soho, and the British Museum. This beautifully restored neo-Georgian hotel boasts modern amenities including the elegant Coral Room, the stylish Bloomsbury Club Bar with its all-season terrace, and a sophisticated restaurant. Guest rooms range from elegantly appointed Classic and Deluxe options to lavish Studio Suites featuring chic, earthy tones, parquet floors, and Italian marble bathrooms with freestanding baths. All accommodations include free high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a Nespresso machine, a 55-inch TV with Chromecast, and tea and coffee-making facilities. Guests also enjoy complimentary access to the fitness suite and the highly Instagrammable Dalloway Terrace, offering all-day dining and a sumptuous afternoon tea.

6565.description: This sophisticated and elegant hotel is located in Vauxhall Bridge Road in London. The hotel is ideally located near many tourist attractions including the West End Theatres, Hyde Park, Buckingham Palace, and Big Ben. The hotel is situated just two minutes from Victoria railway station with fast links to London Gatwick Airport, and the London Underground network, and bus terminals. This is the perfect starting point to explore this extraordinary and unforgettable city. This hotel offers 299 air-conditioned rooms with contemporary design and modern amenities. Each room comes with free Wi-Fi, 49-inch TVs with complimentary Sky channels, and coffee and tea facilities to suit the needs for both leisure and business travellers. Guests can also relax at the sauna and steam room to eliminate the tiredness after a long day.

6566.description: This ultra-luxury hotel on High Holborn combines English heritage with contemporary sophistication in the heart of London. Nestled in the very centre of English capital, near Covent Garden, the City and West End theatres, it is perfect for business and sightseeing in London. Visitors will be impressed by imposing Edwardian architectural design, opulent interiors and high quality service with attention to detail. This stunning establishment boasts a variety of accommodation options including fabulous individually designed rooms and suites. Each unit offers spacious and peaceful surroundings, where guests may completely unwind and recharge batteries. The unique dining venues deliver exceptional cuisine and service. After a long day of work or touring into the city, patrons may balance body and soul at the spa and fitness centre. The younger guests may revel in the varied on-site entertainment programme. The hotel is pet friendly and offers a business centre.

6567.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Wedgewood Hotel, located within a 10-minute walk of both Kensington Gardens and the vibrant Portobello Road Market. This hotel offers 60 guestrooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi and cable TV. Guests can also take advantage of amenities such as a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and room service. Tea and coffee making facilities are provided in each room, and housekeeping is offered weekly. Irons and ironing boards are available upon request. Nearby attractions include Kensington Palace (0. 7 mi) and Kensington High Street (1 mi). Heathrow Airport (LHR) is the preferred airport for the hotel.

6573.description:
Set in the heart of central London at Marble Arch, where Oxford Street meets Park Lane and Hyde Park is just a few steps away, The Cumberland puts you right at the lively end of the city. We are also home to the Gordon Ramsay Hell’s Kitchen, bringing one of the world’s most iconic dining experiences under our roof. 
With museums, landmarks and the Tube on your doorstep, it’s the perfect starting point for exploring London. Inside, contemporary design and calming spaces give you room to breathe, reset and shake off the day. Whether you’re here for business, exploring or a mix of both, everything clicks into place the moment you arrive. 
Start your day with our fresh and generous breakfast. Coffee lovers can count on our baristas for fast, expertly brewed drinks. Lirica brings Mediterranean flavour to life with bold tapas dishes and a relaxed rhythm from day to night. Come evening, Sound Bar turns up the energy with cocktails and colourful beats – a brilliant spot to unwind before or after an unforgettable dining experience at Gordon Ramsay Hell’s Kitchen.  
The Cumberland isn’t just a hotel. It’s an icon of London life – where the city’s heart beats, and where icons belong.

6587.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. You can enjoy a meal at Cast Iron Bar & Grill serving the guests of Sheraton Heathrow Hotel, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a bus station shuttle. Stay in one of 426 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

name.content: Sheraton Cairo Hotel Towers And Casino

6601.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages and facials. Before a night out at the casino, the 2 outdoor swimming pools are a perfect way to relax and recharge. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Giza? This hotel has 2713 square feet (252 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 7 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

6602.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Set on the banks of the River Nile right in the heart of Cairo, the Ramses Hilton hotel is the perfect base for exploring all that Egypt's capital has to offer. Take in breathtaking views of the Nile or the majestic city of Cairo from the private balconies of its 811 guest rooms and suites. The Ramses Hilton hotel boasts a range of dining venues and facilities to meet the needs of the discerning traveler: including a British-style pub ''Sherlock Holmes'', an authentic Indian restaurant ''Namaste'', a Mediterranean Grill ''Citadel'', an airy café ''Garden Court'', an all-day dining restaurant ''Terrace Café'', Breezes lounge & grill, Opia rooftop lounge & Bar located on the 36th floors, a heated outdoor pool with river views, an onsite casino, a fitness center, a shopping Galleria with 250 shops and an exclusive Executive or Ramses Lounge. We also offer evening receptions every night. Only 45 minutes from Cairo International Airport, the Ramses Hilton hotel is 5 minutes from the Egyptian Museum and within easy reach of famous Cairo attractions. Let the staff at this Cairo hotel arrange a day trip or organize transport to the surrounding region. Do business in one of 7 meeting rooms or celebrate in the ballroom for up to 500 guests.

6605.description: Royal Lancaster London stands proudly on the border of Hyde Park, featuring 411 guestrooms impeccably designed to combine style, comfort and breathtaking views of the famous London skyline. Restaurants and bars include the award-winning Nipa Thai, serving the most authentic Thai food outside of Bangkok and Hyde Cafe, serving an indulgent Afternoon Tea. Breakfast is served in the beautiful Park Restaurant alongside floor to ceiling views of Hyde Park and in the afternoon; enjoy cocktails and relaxed dining in the cosy Park Lounge Bar.
