The hotel is conveniently located adjacent to Lancaster Gate Station with Paddington Station just a 5 minute walk away, offering easy access to Heathrow Airport and the newly-opened Elizabeth line. ***A 5% discretionary accommodation service fee will be added to your room bill. ***

6607.description: This modern hotel is centrally located within walking distance from attractions such as the British Museum, Covent Garden, Oxford Street, Piccadilly Circus or Regent's Park. It is the largest hotel in the centre of London, offering more than 1, 600 rooms. In addition there are 3 restaurants, a bar and a cosy London pub. Russell Square underground station is just 2 minutes away, offering access to all areas of the city.

6609.description: Located in one of London's most sought-after districts, the hotel London Kensington is a short walk from the boutique shops of Kensington High Street and the natural beauty of Kensington Gardens. Guests can dine on site in the Artist Corner, offering modern British and European cuisine. The property also features a brasserie with Asian-style dishes and the Cafexpress cafe. Olympia exhibition centre is within walking distance and so are Hyde Park, the Royal Albert Hall and the world-famous museums on Cromwell Road.

6611.description: This hotel, nestled in the middle of Bloomsbury, enjoys a great location with views to Russell Square. Guests will be able to find, within the area a number of touristic sites and cultural attractions, including the British Museum, Covent Garden and the West End. The closest underground stations can be reached on foot, Euston, St Pancras and Kings Cross stations are all close to Russell Square.

6612.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy local and international cuisine at Pavillion Grill, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 6265 square feet (582 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 10 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 360 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions.

6613.description: The Savoy is the only luxury hotel on the River Thames, perfectly located in the heart of all that London has to offer, just steps away from vibrant Covent Garden. At the forefront of the luxury hotel scene for over 130 years, The Savoy boasts 267 rooms and suites accompanied by some of the best restaurants and bars in London, welcoming guests for an experience that continuously evolves to meet the desires of the modern traveller.

6614.description: This hotel enjoys a delightful location, lying close to Oxford Street in London's West End. The hotel is situated just 200 metres away from Paddington Underground Station. This charming hotel is surrounded by an abundance of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. Guests will find themselves in a great location from which to explore the attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. The hotel is located just 25 km from Heathrow Airport and 50 km from Gatwick Airport. This Victorian-style hotel boasts a delightful architectural design. The guest rooms are superbly appointed, and feature modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests are assured of an enjoyable stay at this hotel.

6615.description: Designed by James Thomas Knowles and opened in 1862, this is our beautiful and historic Grade II listed railway hotel in Victoria station. It boasts direct access to Victoria Station from the concourse and links to the Circle, District and Victoria underground lines. You can get to Gatwick on the express in half an hour. The Apollo Victoria Theatre by foot in just seconds. And London's most famous landmarks including Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park, Big Ben, Houses of Parliament and Westminster Abbey in mere minutes. Our restaurant, the Soak, is now open. The Clermont Restaurant & Bar is open for breakfast and afternoon tea is served in the Tea Lounge.

6616.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestConnected by footbridge to Paddington station, Hilton London Paddington is just a 15-minute roof to roof connection to Heathrow Airport via Heathrow Express. Hilton London Paddington offers a wide range of 422 guest rooms from standard to executive rooms and suites, including 59 premium rooms in the GWR Tower which includes executive lounge access. All bedrooms have free WiFi. The hotel also features fully equipped gym. Connected with Paddington Station and with four London Underground lines on the doorstep, the hotel is the ideal point to explore London. Head to Oxford Street and the West End just 10 minutes away. See Buckingham palace and stroll through nearby Hyde Park.

6617.description: Situated in the heart of Kensington, this elegant 19th-century townhouse hotel offers luxurious accommodations mere steps from Gloucester Road Tube Station. The property is conveniently located near Kensington High Street, Knightsbridge, and South Kensington's shopping districts, with Harrods a short 15-minute walk or tube ride away. Guests are within a 10-minute walk of Kensington Gardens, Hyde Park, the Royal Albert Hall, and renowned museums such as the Natural History Museum, the Science Museum, and the Victoria and Albert Museum. Stylishly restored in 2016, the hotel retains its original Victorian charm, from the grand staircase to the stained-glass windows. The spacious and inviting rooms feature flat-screen TVs and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and slippers. Guests also enjoy complimentary bottled water, coffee, tea, and biscuits, replenished daily.

6618.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at Cedric Grolet or snacks in the 2 coffee shops/cafes. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. English breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to noon for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and limo/town car service. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours).

6619.description: This elegant hotel is situated on Sloane Street at the heart of London. The hotel is situated just a short distance away from the many attractions that this impressive city has to offer. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park and Knightsbridge underground station, which offers ease of access to other areas of the city. This wonderful hotel enjoys a charming architectural design, blending effortlessly with its refined surroundings. The guest rooms are superbly designed, oozing character and charm. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Business and leisure travellers will appreciate the host of facilities that the hotel has to offer. Heathrow Airport from Knightsbridge is 44-minute drive away from the hotel.

6620.description:
This modern, luxury hotel is pleasantly situated overlooking the Thames. Links to the public transport network nearby enable easy access to the plentiful tourist attractions as well as numerous shops and entertainment venues that the city of London has to offer. The nearest underground station is Temple and is just across the road from the hotel.

The hotel was renovated in 2002 and has a number of facilities. It offers it's guests an elegant foyer with lifts, a cloakroom, a safe and a 24-hour reception. Additional facilities include a bar and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant, which overlooks the lovely garden courtyard. Conference rooms with Internet access are also included within the facilities.

All 189 elegant rooms include an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, as well as a telephone, satellite TV, Internet access, minibar, central heating, a safe and an espresso machine.

Jaan Restaurant is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

6621.description: This stylish hotel enjoys a central location in Bayswater. Paddington underground station is to be found just 150 metres away from the hotel. This charming hotel is located within easy access of the most famous attractions for which this city is renowned. The hotel enjoys a charming architectural design, blending effortlessly with its refined surroundings. The guest rooms offer a haven of peace and serenity, in which to work and rest in comfort. Guests are invited to enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore the sights and sounds of the city.

6622.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at The Park Tower Knightsbridge, a Luxury Collection Hotel, situated near Hyde Park. This hotel offers a fitness center, bicycle rentals, and a variety of dining options, including a restaurant and 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or enjoy a full breakfast for a fee (7 AM - 11 AM daily). The hotel also provides concierge and babysitting services (surcharge), a business center, limo service, and express check-in. Event facilities include conference space and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (surcharge). Each of the 280 guestrooms features an iPod docking station, a minibar, a 49-inch LCD TV with satellite programming, Wi-Fi (surcharge), a private bathroom with separate bathtub and shower, complimentary toiletries, a hairdryer, a phone, a safe, and a desk. Nearby attractions include Harrods, Hyde Park Corner, Park Lane, Green Park, Piccadilly, and Sloane Square. The closest airports are London City (LCY), Heathrow (LHR), Gatwick (LGW), Luton (LTN), and Farnborough (FAB), with Heathrow (LHR) recommended.

6623.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Grab a bite to eat at Mercante Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 305 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and plasma televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

6625.description: A London landmark, this luxurious property has been home to thousands of discerning guests since 1906. It features a prime position on Piccadilly, in the heart of the city. This outstanding hotel offers the ideal accommodation for those travellers wishing to enjoy the ultimate in style, service and sophistication. The beautiful bedrooms and suites feature fully restored period interiors and whichever room guests choose, they will experience the best in luxury accommodation and attention to detail. To dine at the hotel’s restaurant is to experience some of the best cuisine available anywhere in the world, at one of the most beautiful dining rooms in London. The menu utilizes the best of British seasonal produce prepared with the finest classical French culinary techniques, and of course the service is exemplary. Afternoon tea in London at this property is an institution in itself, served in the spectacular Palm Court to a soundtrack of soft piano music, this is an unforgettable experience.

6626.description: This elegant city hotel lies at the heart of London in one of the city's most exclusive districts. Green Park and Piccadilly Circus underground stations lie just a few minutes walk away and various sights including Trafalgar Square, the national art gallery, Buckingham Palace and Hyde Park are all to be found in the vicinity. This hotel comprises 15 floors with a total of 228 rooms including 3 suites. Facilities include a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a lift, 2 bars and a restaurant with a non-smoking area. It is possible to take advantage of the car parking facilities (additional fees apply). The welcoming rooms each come with a bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, a TV, a minibar/ fridge, tea and coffee making facilities and a hire safe.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel, London South Kensington

6627.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center and complimentary wireless internet access. The hotel also offers concierge services for added convenience. Savor British cuisine at Scoff and Banter, a restaurant with a bar/lounge, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. The hotel boasts a conference center and 12 meeting rooms, making it ideal for events. The 215 guest rooms feature espresso makers, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include designer toiletries and hair dryers. Additional conveniences comprise phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. The hotel is located near the Natural History Museum, Imperial College London, and other popular attractions.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel, London Tottenham Court Road

6628.description: Radisson Blu Edwardian Kenilworth, part of Edwardian Hotels London, is a luxurious hotel in Bloomsbury opposite the British Museum, one of London's most popular attraction. Situated within minutes of the stylish shopping districts of Oxford St, Regent St, Bond St and Covent Garden, and within a short walk of Soho and the West End Theatre. The hotel's light, airy lobby makes guests feel instantly relaxed and at home, while the 24 hour fitness room is perfect for relaxing and revitalising. Guests in need of a private space can choose from 8 meeting rooms, able to host up 110 people. From comfortable singles and doubles to spacious family rooms, all 186 of The Kenilworth's stylish bedrooms feature modern comforts, such as 350 thread count Egyptian cotton bedding, down pillows, REN toiletries and Italian marble bathrooms. Cutting-edge in-room technology is perfect for work or play, including free high speed Wi-Fi up to 150 mbps on unlimited devices and international sockets. For an extra dose of luxury and spectacular views across London's skyline, guests can book one of the hotel's four studio suites. Scoff and Banter serves a superb menu of traditional Modern European cuisine using only the finest locally sourced, seasonal produce. Guest-favourites range from tasty classics like beer-battered fish and chips, shepherd's pie and Eton mess, to indulgent afternoon teas, all of which can be washed down with a superb selection of wines and cocktails. The nearest tube station is Tottenham Court Road on the Central and Northern Lines. Holborn Tube station is minutes away giving direct access to the City Financial District, and nearby Eurostar at King's Cross St Pancras. Please provide a valid credit card upon arrival at the hotel.

6630.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include wedding services and a banquet hall. Enjoy Mexican cuisine at Madera, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Make yourself at home in one of the 95 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

6634.description:
This friendly hotel is excellently situated in London overlooking lovely Russell Square and just a few steps from the British Museum. It features a restaurant, a bar and a café. The River Thames, Regents Park and Hyde Park are reachable within a short stroll; Russell Square underground station is within two minutes, offering easy access to all parts of the city. Kings Cross train station is within walking distance. 

The renovation works are ongoing at our sister hotel next to the President Hotel from 08:00 AM to 05:00 PM. Some noise may be heard during these hours. The works are expected to finish by late July or early August 2026

6635.description: This city hotel nestled in the centre of London offers its guests a strategic location very close to many touristic sites of cultural and historic interest. Guests will also find within the immediate vicinity a wide range of shopping and entertainment venues, as well as restaurants and bars. Convenient public transport, both underground and bus, is easily reachable on foot, and Heathrow Airport is about 19 kilometres from the hotel. The accommodation units are spacious and have been decorated in a functional and simple style, but also very comfortable. They all come with a private bathroom with bathtub of shower and include tea and coffee making facilities for guests’ convenience. The onsite facilities and services include free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, a full English breakfast served every morning and a meeting room which can accommodate up to 150 people. (Refurbishment until 2025)

name.content: Thistle London Hyde Park Kensington Gardens

6636.description: This stylish hotel enjoys a strategic setting in the captivating city of London. The hotel is situated on Bayswater Road, lying just a short distance away from Hyde Park. The hotel boasts stunning views over Palace Gardens and the park. The renowned district of Notting Hill is to be found just a short distance away. Oxford street is also easily accessible from this hotel. Guests will find themselves in the perfect setting from which to explore the attractions that this wonderful hotel has to offer. This charming hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and style. The guest rooms are elegantly designed, featuring classical beauty and refined sophistication. The hotel features a wide range of excellent facilities, ensuring that each and every traveller enjoys a truly memorable stay.

6638.description: This first-class hotel enjoys a prime setting on Regent Street in London. The hotel is located close to Oxford and Bond streets, enjoying a great setting from which to explore the host of attractions, shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues that this vibrant city has to offer. This charming hotel enjoys a long history, dating back to the mid-19th century. The hotel enjoys a charming architectural design, blending in seamlessly with its refined surroundings. The guest rooms are luxuriously appointed, offering a peaceful setting in which to escape the bustle of the city which lies just outside. The hotel features a host of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of discerning travellers to the highest level of excellence.

6639.description: Chic and central, Hilton London Euston is ideally located in the heart of the capital. Set in a stunning restored Victorian building, the hotel boasts seven meeting rooms, a bar and a restaurant set in a beautiful Victorian conservatory. Euston station is just 5 minute walk away and the Eurostar service at St Pancras Station is only a 10-minute walk away. Start the day with breakfast at Mulberry's Restaurant. Hire a bicycle at Waterloo and ride along the Thames to London attractions such as the Tate Modern. See the lights come up over the city from the London Eye before dinner at the hotel's Woburn Place Dining Room. Experience our enticing outlets, host a banquet on the Woburn terrace and finish with a nightcap at the hotel's bar. Book a modern Hilton Room at Hilton London Euston hotel or upgrade to a spacious Deluxe Room. All rooms offer wireless internet access.

6640.description: The Landmark London, a five-star hotel in Marylebone, offers a luxurious escape in the heart of London. Steps from vibrant Marylebone High Street, Chiltern Street, and Bond Street, this hotel is ideal for exploring the city's best shopping, dining, and cultural attractions. The Landmark London boasts spacious rooms (40-70 sq m), a spa with an indoor pool and gym, and multiple restaurants and bars serving British and European cuisine. Enjoy a classic afternoon tea in the stunning eight-story Winter Garden atrium. Families are welcome, with interconnecting rooms and suites available. The hotel has enhanced health and safety procedures for a safe and enjoyable stay.

6641.description: Thistle Holborn is perfectly situated for exploring the city, whether your stay is for business or pleasure. Just a stone’s throw away from Covent Garden, Soho, and Oxford Street, you’re also within easy walking distance of a plethora of London Underground stations, making your journey to, from, and around London, a breeze. The hotel itself offers comfortable boutique-style bedrooms, a relaxed bar, and an all-day restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, dinner, and afternoon tea. The rooms offer plenty of space with ensuite bathrooms, comfortable beds, air-conditioning, and sleek furnishings, with fast & free Wi-Fi available throughout. Each room also comes equipped with a flat screen TV, tea & coffee making facilities, work desk, hair dryer, iron & ironing board, complimentary toiletries, and room safe. The in-house restaurant, Kingsley Two Brasserie, opens at 7am with an impressive breakfast buffet of continental and full-English options. From 12pm, enjoy delicious international cuisine from our all-day dining menu. The relaxed Kingsley Bar opens from 11am offering a morning coffee & brunch menu. Afterwards, an informal dining and drinks menu is available until 11pm, perfect for a pre-theatre dinner, or nightcap before bed. Thistle Holborn also offers a selection of impressive meeting & event spaces, please contact the hotel directly if you would like to enquire about booking one of these spaces.

6642.description: Nestled in the heart of London's vibrant West End, this boutique hotel offers a warm, traditional welcome. Enjoy complimentary broadband internet, mood lighting, and a choice of standard, queen, or king-sized beds with crisp cotton linens. Amenities include international plug access, interactive satellite TV, 24-hour room service, and a daily newspaper. An in-room safe, coffee/tea service, iron, hairdryer, and telephone with voicemail are also provided. Most rooms feature climate control, bathroom televisions, and heated mirrors. Complimentary toiletries are included, and bathrobes and slippers are available upon request. A mini-fridge and electronic door locks add to your comfort and security. Payment is taken upon arrival, with a pre-authorization for the first night's stay applied 48 hours prior. The hotel is conveniently located within the London Congestion Charge zone (applicable Monday-Friday, 7 am-6:30 pm).

6643.description: Situated in London's city centre, the Phoenix Hotel is a short walk from Kensington Gardens and Portobello Road Market. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a shared TV area. The 125 guestrooms feature private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. Guests can dine at the hotel restaurant or enjoy a snack at the deli. A bar/lounge is also available. Additional amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Nearby attractions include Kensington Palace and Hyde Park.

6645.description: A stunning boutique hotel, Mercure London Hyde Park has recently undergone a major refurbishment and boasts 72 well-appointed guest rooms with original Victorian windows, high ceilings, and a welcoming townhouse feel throughout. Tucked away in a peaceful garden square, the hotel perfectly encapsulates traditional English charm with a modern twist. Each room is brimming with technology and style, including free Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy several amenities, such as an on-site bar and restaurant and a 24-hour fitness center. Just a stone's throw from the hotel, you'll discover London's largest Royal Park, Hyde Park, home to attractions like the Serpentine Gallery, the Boating Lake, and the Albert Memorial. Oxford Street, with its designer outlets and prestigious flagship department stores, is also nearby.

6646.description: The Marylebone Hotel offers a superb location in central London, nestled in the heart of Marylebone Village, a bustling neighborhood brimming with fashionable boutiques and eateries. Guests enjoy easy access to London's best attractions, with Selfridges and Liberty a short 5-10 minute walk away, and the elegant green spaces of Regent's Park and Hyde Park within a 15-minute stroll. A luxury lifestyle hotel, The Marylebone boasts an array of on-site amenities. Discover the local charm of 108 Brasserie, explore a world of gin and wines at 108 Bar, or indulge in exciting cocktails at the hotel's glamorous cocktail bar. Guests also enjoy complimentary access to the exclusive on-site Third Space gym, featuring an 18-meter swimming pool (a rarity in central London), a state-of-the-art gym, and expert trainers. Accommodation options range from elegantly appointed classic and deluxe rooms to luxurious studio and rooftop terrace suites, some with retractable roofs. Spacious family rooms comfortably accommodate two adults and two children up to 12 years old.

6647.description: Just a 2-minute walk from Earls Court Station, Ellen Kensington blends stylish, eclectic design with warm Asian hospitality. Inspired by legendary British actress Ellen Terry, the hotel features artwork and cultural accents throughout. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout, a terrace for views, and easy access to Kensington's museums, shops, and parks. Ideal for leisure or business stays in one of London's most affluent areas.

6649.description: Perfectly located in London, this property offers ease of access to Hyde Park, Oxford Street, Marble Arch and Kensington Gardens. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby, at Paddington train station, Bayswater and Queensway underground station. This property offers the utmost in luxury and comfort. The stylish guest rooms place an emphasis on relaxation and convenience. Guests are invited to avail of the seemingly boundless range of first-class facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. This property delivers an unrivalled level of comfort and convenience, complemented by exemplary service.

6650.description: Located in London's Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, this boutique-style hotel is near iconic attractions, including Kensington Palace, the Victoria and Albert Museum, the Royal Albert Hall, the Design Museum, Hyde Park, and the Knightsbridge shopping district, home to Harrods and Harvey Nichols. The hotel blends Victorian grandeur with contemporary comfort. High ceilings, open fireplaces, and heritage décor create an elegant atmosphere. Accommodation options range from classic and deluxe rooms to luxurious studio, signature, Brompton, and Knightsbridge suites. All rooms and suites offer complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, fine linens, TVs, and marble bathrooms. The Town House restaurant serves fresh, seasonal dishes and a renowned afternoon tea. A discreet cocktail bar provides a sophisticated setting for drinks.

name.content: Premier Inn London Hammersmith - Ravenscourt Park

6651.description: Get a bird's eye view of the capital from Premier Inn London Hammersmith, with incredible views across the Thames to the Shard and Southbank. Just hop on a tube and the city's at your feet, from Hyde Park to Oxford Street, with direct public transport links via the District Line. And you needn't venture far from your nest to see Hammersmith's own bright lights - the Apollo, Westfield Shopping Centre, Olympia and Earl's Court are minutes away. Based just outside of the capital's congestion zone, near the M4, with limited parking on site, we're extra-easy to get to. And once you've arrived, you'll find everything you need for a dream stay: a tasty restaurant, peaceful rooms and oh sso-comfyeds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

6652.description: This hotel is located close to Hyde Park, in London. The Heathrow Express terminal at Paddington Station, Oxford Street, Marble Arch and Queensway are also situated close by. This property is ideally situated from which to explore the host of intriguing attractions and points of interest that this mesmerising city has to offer. This modern hotel offers luxury and style, in a convenient setting. Beautifully-designed guest rooms ooze grace and classical elegance. The property offers complimentary internet access for the convenience of business and leisure travellers alike. The hotel's staff are on hand to ensure that the needs of every type of traveller are fully met.

name.content: Queens Park Premier London Hyde Park Hotel

6653.description: Welcome to the Queens Park Hotel our stunning Victorian building, dating back to the 1900's is set on the tranquil street of Queensborough Terrace. We are superbly located near Paddington Station, Queensway and Bayswater Tube Stations in Central London. We are easily accessible through the District, Central and Circle lines. Queensway is a bustling cosmopolitan street in Bayswater. An area of west London with many restaurants cafés, pubs, souvenir shops and a few high-street retail chains.

6656.description: Enjoy your stay at the Garden View Hotel, located in the heart of London, a short drive from the Natural History and Victoria and Albert Museums. The hotel offers 61 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, safes, and coffee/tea makers. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and tour/ticket assistance. The Science Museum and Kensington Palace are also within easy reach.

6658.description: This wonderful hotel is conveniently located just about 10-minute car ride away from the centre of Venice and from the Venice Marco Polo Airport. Near the property, there are stops of public transport. Some places that visitors cannot miss while being in this beautiful city are Piazza San Marco, the Church of San Giorgio Maggiore and the Palazzo Ducale (Doge's Palace) and Bridge of Sighs just to mention some of them. In the city centre, visitors will find several local and international restaurants, lovely cafes and bars with a great atmosphere. There are also many shopping opportunities for the ones who look for souvenirs. After a busy day exploring the city, guests may like to have a drink and small aperitifs in the on-site bar. The rooms have been nicely decorated with a combination of light and warm tones to create a comfortable space and make travellers feel cosy. They are also equipped with all the essential amenities to offer a pleasant and memorable stay.

6659.description: This hotel is located in the historical centre of Venice, lying just a short distance away from the train station and the wide range of attractions that this stunning city has to offer. The Rialto Bridge and St. Marco Square are situated just a short distance away. Marco Polo airport is to be found just 15 km from the hotel. This hotel enjoys a long history, dating back to the early 19th century. It features a stunning architectural design, blending in effortlessly with its refined surroundings. The rooms are a combination of classic Venetian style graced with a minimalist and contemporary flair, equipped with AC, minibar, TV, safe and bathroom with hairdryer and bath amenities. Guests can enjoy a delicious breakfast either in the garden or in a breakfast room.

6660.description: This hotel is situated in Favaro Veneto, lying just 3 km away from Venice's Marco Polo Airport. The hotel is located just 6 km from the city's Roma Square and 4 km from the Venice Casino. This wonderful hotel offers a great setting, lying within easy access of the many attractions that this impressive city has to offer. This refined hotel enjoys a charming architectural design, showcasing the elegance and sophistication of Italian style. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, and come complete with modern amenities. The hotel features a wide range of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of every type of traveller. Guests are invited to enjoy delectable dining in the restaurant, where mouth-watering Italian dishes are the order of the day.

6665.description: NH Venezia Laguna Palace is located on the Venice mainland approximately 12 km from Venice Marco Polo International Airport and 1 km from Venezia-Mestre train station. This sleek hotel sits on the waterfront in the urban center of Mestre. As such, guests will find plenty of local attractions within walking distance, or by taxi, water taxi or bus. From NH Venezia Laguna Palace, guests can reach the Canal Grande or Palazzo Ducale, both 10 km away. For lunch and dinner our elegant on-site restaurant Laguna serves quite the delicious selection of gastronomic delights consisting of both international and local cuisine In the morning, our friendly staff offer guests a full breakfast buffet that includes made-to-order hot dishes upon request. Each of the contemporary rooms provides free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, desks and mini fridges. NH Venezia Laguna Palace has a conference center with the best technology and 25 rooms that can hold up to 750 guests. Our special events services can assist in planning the perfect menu. Further optimized amenities include a compact gym, and, for airline crew members, an exclusive 24-hour crew lounge.

6666.description: This hotel is located in Malcontenta, lying close to the stunning Palladio villas for which the area is renowned. The hotel is situated at the end of the Riviera del Brenta, lying within easy access of a host of attractions. The hotel is situated just a few steps away from links to the public transport network. Fusina Pier is located just a short distance from the hotel, where guests can take a waterbus to the heart of Venice. This wonderful city hotel enjoys a charming architectural design. The guest rooms are superbly appointed, featuring refreshing tones and a relaxing ambience. Guests are invited to take advantage of the many facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. We serve every morning a very various buffet breakfast in our restaurant (€ 9. 50 per person, € 5. 00 for children from 4 to 7. 99 y. o. )

6667.description: CIN CODE: IT027042A19K7JHX3F This modern hotel is situated at the heart of Mestre, lying just a short distance away from the centre of Venice. The hotel is located just a few steps away from a bus stop, which offers ease of access to the centre of the city. Shopping venues and bars can be found nearby. Marco Polo Airport is 10 km from the property. This delightful hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and the promise of a memorable stay. The 126 rooms are elegantly appointed, offering a haven of peace and serenity in which to enjoy a relaxing break. They come equipped with satellite TV, refrigerator, air conditioning and bathroom with shower and hairdryer. Guests can have a taste of Italian cuisine and a seasonal menu at the nearby hotel or enjoy cocktails and aperitifs at the onsite bar.

6668.description: With a stunning location in the inviting city of Venice, this welcoming hotel is the best point of departure to start discovering the main treasures that await the visitor. From these cosy premises, visitors will be delighted by the breath-taking views to the Canal Grande that can be admired. Apart from being close to a great number of typical restaurants and elegant shops, guests will find themselves within easy reach from some of the most popular sightseeing attractions. All guest rooms are tastefully appointed in an enchanting style and are decorated with prime quality materials. They come fully equipped with a wide array of modern amenities and unconventional features such as a marble private bathroom, a ceiling with antique beams and refined curtains. Among the hotel's facilities, visitors may truly appreciate the “altana” or rooftop terrace where they can taste a delicious breakfast.

6669.description: Duodo Palace is an elegant historic building with a beautiful canal entrance in a quiet area of Venice city centre. It is near Saint Mark's Square and La Fenice Theatre. The Rialto Bridge is a 10-minute walk from the Duodo. Free Wi-Fi internet access is available throughout the Hotel Duodo Palace. Friendly staff will assist you during your stay with tours and information on the city. Rooms feature marble bathrooms and satellite TV. Some rooms have canal views or a view over Venice's rooftops. .

6705.description: On the historic Semiramis hotel site, guests can enjoy modern luxury by the river Nile. Semiramis InterContinental Cairo is located in the heart of downtown Cairo, next to the Egyptian Museum and Khan el Khalili. After a day of exploration, guests can unwind with a swim in our rooftop pool, indulge in wellness at Semiramis Spa, experience exquisite cuisine at our nine distinct signature restaurants, and take in extraordinary sunset views over the Nile.

6707.address: Al Dokki St, Ad Doqi A, 60
6707.description: Boasting a unique location in the centre of Cairo, this luxurious property is the perfect base from which to explore all the magic of this beautiful region. It boasts a prime situation just a few minutes' walk from the Opera house and a 5-minute drive from the Egyptian Museum. The world renowned Giza pyramids are a 30-minute drive while the popular Khan El Khalili Bazaar is some 4 kilometres from this unique establishment. The accommodation units range from the standard room with views over the city or to the pool area to the luxurious suites featuring a separate living room with a sofa bed and dining area as well as Nile views. Business travellers will appreciate the meeting facilities offering the latest technology and the different dining options, including a piano bar, a cosy café serving beverages and light snacks as well as an elegant à la carte restaurant serving a choice of international specialities.

6708.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. For recreation, you'll find a health club, an outdoor pool, and a spa tub. This Colonial hotel also features complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy international cuisine at 139 Pavillion, one of the hotel's three restaurants, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the two bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Giza? This hotel has 15, 070 square feet (1, 400 square meters) of space, consisting of a conference center and seven meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

6710.description: Set within 25 acres of lush gardens, Pyramids Park Resort Cairo is just a 5-minute drive from the magnificent Pyramids. This 3-star resort boasts a sprawling 1, 750 square meter pool and offers rooms with private balconies. All rooms feature air conditioning and cable TV. Guests can enjoy dining at one of four on-site restaurants, including poolside service. For evening entertainment, the hotel offers a piano bar with live music and a discotheque. The resort's information center can assist with arranging local tours and activities. Please note: Egyptian nationals sharing a room must provide a marriage certificate.

6711.address: Abou Hazem Street Of, Pyramids Rd, 29
6711.description: Hotel Amarante Pyramids is a unique 5-star luxury hotel within a paradise-like setting. Located in the heart of the Giza district in Cairo, a journey full of fun and entertainment awaits you. It offers the ideal starting point to explore Cairo and to discover more of Egypt's great civilization and warm hospitality. *** Customers with Egyptian nationality who stay in the hotel sharing a room must provide a marriage certificate

6760.address: 3 El Thawra Council St Zamalek, El Cairo
6760.description: The iconic 5-star Sofitel Cairo Nile El Gezirah hotel in Zamalek, Downtown Cairo. A favoured venue for important business events and a prime location for tourism, the hotel offers the ultimate in classic French hospitality, dazzling contem porary décor, and state-of-the-art meeting facilities for up to 500 attendees. Just a few steps away lies Cairo's upscale business district on quiet El Gezirah island, and it's only minutes to the centre of Cairo, via the Metro at our doorstep.

6807.description: Located on the prestigious Al Maktoum Street close to Jumeirah Beach, at the heart of the Deira business district of Dubai, this hotel is perfectly positioned for exploring the city. It is a short 10-minute walk from the creek and links to the public transport can be found directly in front of the venue. Business travellers can utilize the modern conference facilities and they will also have the convenience of internet access. Since it is not all work guests will be able to find plenty of opportunities to relax and have a good time. They can refresh with a swim in rooftop pool or work on their tan on the sun loungers around it. Those who require little extra pampering can opt for a combination of a sauna, hot tub and steam baths, and the gym is quite well-equipped for maintaining ones' workout schedule.

6809.description: Ideally located on Baniya street, a few minutes from Murshid Bazaar, the Gold and Spice Souk and the Dubai museum, this hotel defines itself by its location. Congress and exhibition centres are only a 15 minutes' drive from the hotel, whilst transfer time to the airport is a mere 10 minutes. This idyllic hotel is both comfortable and modern. Guests can explore the culture and tastes of Dubai by wandering around its meandering streets. For guests wishing to fully unwind, they can have a peaceful lie-in in the hotels spacious and endearing guest rooms. Each room comes with a part view of Dubai's bay, where beautiful sunsets can be enjoyed. The hotel features a buffet style breakfast and lunch in Al Dana restaurant. Hana restaurant offers international cuisine such as Japanese, Chinese and Indonesian dishes. Guests will be taken on an epic journey of culture and innovation during their stay here.

6810.address: Al Muteena Street P.O. BOX 5772, N/A
6810.description: Ideally located in the heart of the city, this elegant property is the perfect starting point to discover all the bustling city of Dubai has to offer. Travellers will find themselves just a few minutes from the international airport, and within easy reach from the exclusive shopping malls and Dubai Exhibition Centre. After a day of sightseeing, the comfortable guest rooms offer the ideal retreat where to relax and recharge batteries. They all have been decorated in warm, soothing tones and come with a generous working desk and spacious ensuite bathrooms. The onsite dining options are innumerable, ranging from an all-day dining restaurant serving international cuisines to an informal café which includes light snacks and teas. Those travelling on business will appreciate the helpful meeting and events rooms equipped with the latest technology, ideal for large functions or exhibitions.

6811.address: Damascus Street, Al Qusais, P.O. BOX 34150
6811.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a nightclub, a health club, and an outdoor pool. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy Indian cuisine at Desi Dhaba, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 3 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.

6814.description: Located next to the monastery, it is an historic building built in the same space dedicated to the welcome of pilgrims since medieval times. The hotel has 82 rooms with bath or shower, satellite television, telephone, parquet floor and heating. Its total capacity for 153 guests.

6825.description: This city and business hotel is located approximately 1. 5 km from the center of Vila Franca de Xira, where a variety of restaurants, bars, and pubs await. Public transportation, including a train station, is easily accessible. Lisbon Portela Airport is just 25 km away. This conference hotel features modern architecture and a tranquil atmosphere. Guests can enjoy the on-site bar and restaurant, as well as six meeting rooms and a business center. Parking is available nearby. The modern rooms and suites are tastefully decorated and include balconies or terraces and private bathrooms. For leisure, the Ribagolf course is a 30-minute drive away. A breakfast buffet is served daily, while lunch and dinner are offered à la carte.

6828.description: This hotel complex is ideally located in the leisure resort of Sabadell. The complex is located close to a number of shops. Many restaurants, bars and nightclubs can be found just 2 km away. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. The hotel lies within driving distance of Barcelona, where a wealth of attractions can be found. This wonderful complex comprises tastefully-designed apartments and rooms, which come well equipped with modern amenities. The complex features a restaurant, as well as a cafe and a bar. Guests can enjoy an ample buffet-style breakfast.

6831.description: This wonderful beach hotel is situated in the recreational area of Manzanillo. The hotel is located just a short distance away from the town centre, allowing for ease of access to the many attractions, shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues that it has to offer. The stunning beach, with its pristine sand and turquoise-blue sea is situated just 1 km away. This wonderful hotel enjoys a stunning Mediterranean style, featuring stunning villas and rooms, which are elegantly appointed and well equipped with modern amenities. The complex features an impressive selection restaurants, as well as leisure and recreational facilities. This complex is sure to impress even the most discerning traveller.

6865.description: This charming city hotel enjoys a peaceful setting in the Pinto District of Madrid. The hotel is situated just 15 kms away from the centre of the city and is within easy reach of public transport options which provide quick and efficient access to a host of attractions and entertainment venues. Movie Warner Parks is located close to the hotel. This delightful hotel greets guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are tastefully furnished, providing a cocoon of peace and serenity seemingly miles away from the city which lies just outside. The hotel provide excellent facilities and services for guests' convenience.

name.content: Sandos Cancun All Inclusive - Adults Only

6880.address: Retorno del Rey Mza 53 Lote 37 1 Sec A, Km 14
6880.description:
Indulge in the allure of a tropical haven at Sandos Cancun, where the stresses of daily life dissolve the moment you step onto the shores of this beachfront paradise. Nestled between the Nichupte Lagoon and the Caribbean Sea in the heart of the Cancun Hotel Zone, this boutique-style resort offers a seamless and sophisticated experience tailored to the desires of every adult (18+) traveler. Sandos Cancun ensures an exclusive vacation like no other, boasting endless white sand beaches adorned with inviting canopies, three-layered infinity pools, and breathtaking views of the turquoise waters of the Caribbean. Whether you crave exhilarating activities, premium spa treatments, a state-of-the-art gym, or health-conscious dining options, Sandos Cancun caters to your every need for a truly relaxing getaway. This destination epitomizes the perfect blend of sophistication and leisure, inviting you to unwind and immerse yourself in a world where every detail is designed for your utmost comfort and enjoyment. Welcome to a retreat that transcends expectations –welcome to Sandos Cancun. 
*The operating hours of restaurants, bars, and activities are subject to change without prior notice.

6881.description: Located in Cancun's Hotel Zone, the Grand Park Royal Cancun offers a luxurious base for exploration. The hotel provides exceptional service and amenities catering to every traveler's needs. Some rooms feature private pool and whirlpool bathtub. Guests can also enjoy a variety of recreational activities. The Grand Park Royal Cancun combines warm hospitality with an elegant ambiance, promising an unforgettable Cancun experience. Please note that all restaurants adhere to a dress code; inquiries can be made at reception or in the restaurants directly. The Grand Prime Rib House is for adults only. Wet or synthetic clothing is not permitted.

6885.description: Located in the leisure district of Cancún, between the Nichupte Lagoon and the Caribbean Sea, this hotel is a great choice for an exciting holiday. Its guests will be just a 20-minute walk from the city centre where they can find the most popular clubs, restaurants and shops. The biggest drawing point of the resort - its famous beach is just 100 metres away. Guests who are looking for a little bit more peaceful venue where to enjoy the sun will appreciate the freshwater onsite pool. In the venue they can also find a cocktail lounge that is a great choice for a refreshing cocktail prior to going out in the city or for a quieter night with friends. There is also a restaurant serving delicious traditional dishes in an unsophisticated surroundings. Cancun International Airport is 20 minutes away from the hotel.

6888.description: This charming hotel is located centrally, close to the tourist area and around 10 km from the beach. Shopping facilities and links to the public transport network are located directly in front of the hotel. The closest nightclub is located just 2 km away. Renovated in 2003, this hotel comprises a total of 24 double rooms and 2 suites spread over 6 floors. Guests have access to a 15 m² garden Guests may make use of the foyer with 24-hour reception desk, a safe, a currency exchange desk, a lift and a cloakroom. There is also a TV room and a hairdresser's salon available for use A public Internet terminal is available for use and those arriving by car may take advantage of the car parking and garage facilities. Room and laundry services round up the offerings. The comfortable rooms come with a bathroom with hairdryer, direct dial telephone, Internet connection, minibar/ fridge and central heating. The nearest golf course is about 25 km away. Breakfast may be selected from a buffet service.

6894.description: This up-scale hotel is a great accommodation option, thanks to its good location in Las Matas, just 2 minutes on foot from the railway station and next to good road connections. In close proximity to the hotel, visitors will find plenty of entertainment, shopping and dining opportunities, including Las Rozas Village shopping centre or Sierra de Guadarrama mountain range to enjoy a healthy stroll. The clean and bright rooms are well appointed and include superior amenities such as air-conditioning and complimentary wireless Internet connection so that guests can keep updated during their stay. Apart from other useful services and facilities, this establishment boasts a large meeting room for up to 60 people.

6899.description: This hotel is located in the leisure district of Barcelona, lying just a short distance away from the town centre. The hotel is situated within easy access of an abundance of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. This charming hotel affords guests a great location from which to explore the many attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. This charming hotel enjoys an attractive architectural design. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, featuring classical elements and decor. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities, for added comfort and convenience. This wonderful hotel appeals to business and leisure travellers alike.

6931.description: Located in the heart of Barcelona, this boutique hotel offers luxury and elegance just a 5-minute walk from Las Ramblas' charming markets. Plaza Cataluña and Paseo de Gracia, home to Casa Batlló and Casa Milà, are also nearby. The hotel is a short distance from the harbor and a 25-minute drive from the airport. The superbly designed guest rooms feature modern amenities and a wide range of services.

6957.description: This modern hotel enjoys a strategic setting in the business district of Madrid. The hotel is located close to Retiro Park, just a few minutes' walking distance away from the Puerta de Alcala. The Plaza de Cibeles and Calle Serrano can also be found nearby. Many prominent Madrid attractions can be found within easy access of the hotel. A host of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found nearby. This hotel features elegantly-styled guest rooms, where focus is placed on comfort and convenience. The hotel provides well-equipped conference space and modern technical equipment, for the convenience of business travellers. The restaurant offers delectable culinary delights, which are sure to tempt even the most discerning palate.

6973.description: This elegant hotel is located in the Aranjuez district of Madrid. The hotel is located just 35 km from the centre of the city, and is within easy access of the main attractions that it has to offer. Guests will find themselves within easy access of convenient links to the public transport network, as well as an abundance of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. This wonderful hotel comprises beautifully-appointed guest rooms, which feature refreshing tones and exude an air of peace and serenity. The hotel features a range of facilities and services, ensuring the utmost in comfort and convenience. Guests are invited to enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, for the perfect start to the day.

6974.description: This attractive hotel is located in the entertainment area of Fuenlabrada. It lies just 15 km away from Madrid's city centre, where guests can find a wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities, as well as a host of intriguing attractions. Links to the public transport network are within easy walking distance of the hotel. The hotel offers cosy, relaxing guest rooms, which come complete with up-to-date amenities. The hotel provides guests with access to a host of excellent facilities and services, delivering a high level of comfort and convenience. Business and leisure travellers are sure to appreciate the excellent service that this hotel offers.

6975.description: This pleasant hotel is conveniently situated in the peaceful district of Pinto and offers easy access to the centre of Madrid and the Parque Warner, which is about 7 km distance. Links to the public transport network can be reached within walking distance and it takes only a 30-minute drive to the city centre. After spending an exciting day with the whole family, guests can relax in the hotel's comfortable rooms, which are elegantly appointed in a traditional style and offer modern amenities like free Wi-Fi access and a flat-screen TV for guests' entertainment. The on-site restaurant invites travellers to sample delicious seasonal cuisine and indulge their palates with home-made desserts. Several meeting rooms are available for those travelling on business purposes and the hotel's bar is a great place to relax and meet up with friends. Other facilities include a 24-hour reception and a laundry service.

6976.description: This great city hotel is strategically situated in the new residential area of Carabanchel Alto, close to Parque Tecnológico of Leganés and next to “Aguacate” business area. The hotel enjoys a convenient location for business affair travellers and boasts great facilities for conventions and business meetings. The hotel is well connected to the city centre by bus and underground, which allows guests to reach the centre within minutes. Rooms are spacious and feature an elegant and sober decoration where guests will be able to disconnect after a long working day.

6981.description: Indulge in a massage at the hotel's spa. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and on-site shopping. Dine at the restaurant or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (7:30 AM - 11 AM) for a fee. The hotel also offers a business center, limo service, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge). The 32 guestrooms feature minibars, plasma TVs, private bathrooms with jetted bathtubs, complimentary toiletries, phones, safes, and desks. Located in the heart of Madrid, Relais & Châteaux Hotel Orfila is within a 5-minute drive of Plaza de Colon and the Thyssen-Bornemisza National Museum, and a short drive from Prado Museum and Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía.

6982.description: This attractive city and business hotel is situated close to the conference and Exponor exhibition centre of Porto. The hotel is located just 8 kms away from the centre of the city, while the international airport is situated just a few minutes' drive away. The beach and a selection of bars and entertainment venues can be found within 2 kms from the hotel. This modern hotel greets guests with contemporary style and a welcoming environment. The guest rooms are stylishly appointed, offering the perfect surroundings in which to relax and unwind in comfort. Guests will be pleasantly surprised by the hotel's range of excellent facilities, which cater to the needs of business and leisure guests.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Lisbon Principe Real, by IHG

6983.description: The Holiday Inn Express & Suites Lisbon Príncipe Real is located in the upscale Príncipe Real area, near the Amoreiras shopping center and 900 meters from the Marquês de Pombal metro station. Guests can easily explore the city's main attractions and nearby scenic viewpoints. The hotel offers 184 modern, air-conditioned rooms with free high-speed Wi-Fi, a work desk with USB connections, an espresso machine, a full-length mirror, an iron and ironing board, an invigorating power shower, extra soft and firm pillows, and a smart TV with international channels. Guests booking suites will enjoy a more spacious accommodation option with additional amenities, including a dining area, a microwave, and a mini-fridge. Hotel facilities include a gym, a 24-hour lobby lounge bar, a street-view bar, and a restaurant serving lunch and dinner featuring fine Mediterranean flavors. Paid indoor parking with EV charging spots is also available.

6984.description: This attractive city hotel enjoys an exceptional location in an area famous for its excellent shopping, just off of Barcelona's Avenida Diagonal. Gaudi's Casa Batllo and La Pedrera are both within a 15-minute walk, and the Placa de Catalunya, Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art, and Barcelona Cathedral are all within walking distance. Meanwhile, nearby Passeig de Gracia and Diagonal metro stations provide easy access to the rest of the city. The hotel's guest rooms are tastefully decorated and equipped with comforts such as air-conditioning, 32-inch flat screen televisions and free Wi-Fi internet access. Guests might choose to dine on delicious Spanish dishes in the onsite restaurant or simply relax with some tapas on the tranquil garden terrace. The hotel also offers a gym, onsite parking and bicycle rental service, all for an exciting sightseeing holiday or productive business trip to Barcelona.

6985.description: This city hotel is very nicely located in a quiet but centric street in the famous L'Eixample of Barcelona. It is within easy reach from the main shopping area in Paseo de Gracias and most touristic sites of historic and cultural interest can also be reached on foot after a nice stroll through the most interesting streets of the city. This is a perfect hotel for friends or couples wishing to discover this wonderful city from a strategic location.

7004.description: This hotel is located close to the city centre of Barcelona. The city's entertainment centre surrounds the hotel, with many shops located close by. A host of bars and restaurants are situated in close proximity to the hotel. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the myriad of attractions that this cultural and artistically-rich city has to offer. Links to the public transport network can be found just 50 metres away, offering ease of access to other areas to be explored. This charming hotel combines rustic elegance and modern convenience, blending effortlessly with its surroundings. The stylish rooms provide everything that guests will need for a comfortable stay. A wide range of facilities and services are available for guests' convenience.

7024.description: Enjoy a refreshing dip in one of two outdoor swimming pools or work out in the fitness center. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services. Savor Spanish cuisine at La Terrassa del Duquesa, a beachfront bar/lounge with alfresco dining, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Mingle with other guests at the daily complimentary reception, or relax with a drink at the poolside bar. Buffet breakfast is available daily (7 AM to 11 AM) for a fee. The hotel provides a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities include conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available 24 hours a day (surcharge). Each of the 59 guest rooms features a minibar, flat-screen TV, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences such as phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks are also provided. Located near Port de Barcelona, Plaça Reial, and the Basilica de Santa Maria del Mar, the hotel is within a short distance of many attractions. Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) is approximately 16 km away.

7028.description: The 1 star Hotel Barbara is a good and basic hotel with friendly and helpful staff. The hotel has a fantastic central location, only two minutes walk from La Ramblas and the Gothic quarter. Rooms have satellite television, safe, heating and en-suite bathroom with bath and shower. The hotel is an ideal base to discover one of Europe's most vibrant cities with lots of sightseeing to do, a vibrant nightlife and many restaurants.

7031.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as bicycle rentals, along with complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also offers babysitting services (surcharge) and a banquet hall. Dine at the hotel's restaurant, Café Varela, for lunch or dinner, or grab a quick bite at the coffee shop/café. Room service is also available during limited hours. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee from 8:00 AM to 11:30 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself at home in one of the 100 guestrooms featuring complimentary minibar items and flat-screen televisions with satellite channels. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. The Hotel Preciados is located in the heart of Madrid (Madrid Centro), within a 5-minute walk of Gran Via and Plaza de España-Princesa. This hotel is also 0. 4 miles from Puerta del Sol and 0. 4 miles from Plaza Mayor.

name.content: Brown Acropol, a member of Brown Hotels

7036.description: Brown Acropol is a fully renovated design hotel, inspired by the cosmopolitan vibes of the 60s. The hotel's philosophy is based on a retro aesthetic, seasoned with a contemporary take on upscale leisure and lifestyle coolness. The hotel is situated in Omonia Square, the capital's commercial and business district, with direct access to the central metro station and within walking distance to some of Athens' iconic attractions. Famous Athenian locations and landmarks such as Syntagma, Ermou Street, the Acropolis and the Acropolis Museum can be found just a stone's throw away from the hotel premises, while many of the city's hip bars and restaurants are also conveniently close. With Athens International Airport “Eleftherios Venizelos” and the Port of Piraeus, the main Athenian gateway to the Aegean islands, being only 40 and 30 minutes away respectively, transportation to and from Brown Acropol is delightfully easy. The hotel features 165 high-end design rooms, with king size and twin beds and fully renovated luxurious bathrooms available. Within the air-conditioned rooms you may find a mini bar, a modern Vinyl music player and a complimentary Nespresso coffee machine, along with other luxurious amenities such as a trolley bar. Brown Acropol is the ideal place to organise your business meetings, with conference facilities that can host up to 450 persons. At the main restaurant you may enjoy a rich breakfast buffet, while the Lobby bar offers a variety of spirits in an elegant and cozy area, by the iconic library of the Brown Hotels Collection. During the summer, the open-air rooftop bar-restaurant with breath-taking view to the Acropolis and Lycabettus Hill is expected to evolve into your go-to place and one of the hottest meeting spots in the city! The hotel offers free WiFi in all areas, a 24h reception, concierge service, spa service (upon request).

name.content: NYX Esperia Palace Athens by Leonardo Hotels

7037.description: The NYX Esperia Palace Hotel Athens by Leonardo Hotels is a 5-star hotel located in the heart of Athens just 500m from Ermou Street-Shopping Area, offering an unforgettable experience. The hotel boasts a restaurant, bar, terrace, seasonal rooftop pool, indoor pool, fully equipped spa, conference rooms and co-working spaces. The air-conditioned rooms come equipped with a desk, coffee machine, minibar, safety deposit box, flat-screen TV, and private bathroom with a shower. The hotel offers free Wi-Fi, 24-hour front desk, and room service. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast and use the fitness center, sauna, and shared lounge. The hotel provides a paid airport shuttle service and is located close to popular tourist spots such as Syntagma Metro Station, Syntagma Square and Acropolis.

name.content: Grande Bretagne, A Luxury Collection Hotel

7038.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor and indoor pool and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). GB Roof Garden Restaurant specializes in Mediterranean cuisine, and the coffee shop/cafe offers lighter fare. Twenty-four-hour room service is also available. Unwind with a drink from the poolside bar or one of the two lounges. Full breakfasts are served daily (7:00 AM to 11:00 AM) for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in/check-out, and self-parking (subject to charges). The 320 guest rooms offer minibars, LED TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Hellenic Parliament, Athens National Garden, Ermou Street, and Syntagma Square. The preferred airport is Athens International Airport (ATH).

7039.description: This comfortable city hotel enjoys a fabulous location in the heart of Athens, right under the cliffs of the Acropolis, in one of the most significant archaeological sites in the world. The Acropolis museum and metro station are just a two-minute walk from the hotel, and visitors will enjoy easy access to all this celebrated city has to offer, from restaurants and shops to fascinating museums and stunning architecture ranging from ancient to modern day. The hotel's air-conditioned rooms are cosy and contemporary with free Wi-Fi and in-room coffee and tea facilities. Guests can start the day with a delicious Greek breakfast buffet, and sample authentic Greek dishes in the restaurant. The hotel also provides a conference centre for business events, banquets and conferences, making this the ideal base from which to explore this ancient city whether travelling for business or leisure.

name.content: Dorian Inn Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western

7040.description: The centrally located Dorian Inn hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western is the ideal choice whether you travel for business or for exploring the historic city of Athens. Quality services, modern amenities, rich buffet breakfast, a top floor swimming pool and a bar restaurant with great Acropolis views await you. You can choose from six different accommodation choices to suit your budget and style. The Dorian Inn hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western is centrally located in Athens, Greece, near Omonia square. The Athens underground station is only 210 meters away from the hotel entrance, making both the Piraeus port and Athens International Airport easily accessible by public transport. Most sites of interest are within walking distance and there is an open-air parking space (charges apply) just opposite the hotel.

7041.description: This hotel revels in its central location in Athens, just opposite to the Zeus Temple and Hadrian's Arch and within easy walking distance of the Plaka district and the Acropolis, as well as the Royal Palace. The National Museum, Syntagma Square, the National Gardens and the Old Town are also within an easy reach. Athens Airport is some 30 km away. This hotel enjoys an air of elegance and sophistication, beautifully blending contemporary and traditional elements. The guest rooms are superbly designed, featuring refreshing tones for a relaxing ambience. This hotel features a range of exemplary facilities, ensuring the utmost in comfort and convenience. . Also the hotel provides a seasonal pool with access from the 01st of May until the end of September

7042.description: At the epicenter of Athens, Conrad Athens The Ilisian offers a front-row seat to the city’s cultural and social energy. Located near landmarks, galleries, and vibrant city life, it blends urban exploration with resort-style living. Discover wellness, gastronomy, and curated experiences in one dynamic destination. Among the largest guest rooms in Athens, rooms and suites are designed with generous proportions, natural light, curated artworks, and many private balconies overlooking the city, the Acropolis, and the sea. Wellness at Conrad Athens The Ilisian is performance-led, restorative, and deeply connected to lifestyle. Guests enjoy access to advanced fitness and recovery spaces, indoor and outdoor pools, a private running track wrapping around the building, and curated treatments designed to elevate both body and mind. Dining unfolds as a vibrant expression of The Ilisian, where a mosaic of cosmopolitan flavours brings together distinctive concepts and international brands. From relaxed moments to lively gatherings, each experience reflects the energy of Athens and invites guests to connect through food, atmosphere, and shared moments.

7043.description: This hotel is set amidst a peaceful park area in the impressive city of Athens. The National Archaeological Museum and Victoria underground station are located within easy walking distance of the hotel. The bustling city centre is situated just 3 km away. The hotel is located just 35 km away from the international airport. This wonderful hotel enjoys a charming architectural design, combining elements of traditional and contemporary styles. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, bathing visitors in luxury and elegance. The hotel features a seemingly boundless array of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of every type of traveller, and delivering the utmost in comfort and convenience.

7044.address: Vasilleos Georgiou A Street, Syntagma Square, 2
7044.description: This modern luxury hotel has a wonderful location on Syntagma Square. All the important sightseeing attractions as well as the famous shopping and entertainment quarter, Plaka, are within walking distance. Convenient public transport links may be found 10 m from the hotel. This upper-class establishment was built in 1980 and consists of a total of 177 rooms on 9 floors. It is the perfect residence for business and leisure travellers alike, combining modern luxury in a central location. The hotel's facilities include a lounge bar and an air-conditioned restaurant with a non-smoking area. The beautifully furnished, top-class rooms come with every essential comfort.

7045.description: One of Athens’ most emblematic hotels, Divani Caravel combines upscale style with elegant urban living, excellent facilities, and top-class service. Voted multiple times as Greece’s Leading City Hotel by the World Travel Awards, it is located just minutes away from Syntagma Square and the fashionable Kolonaki, rendering the ideal base for sightseeing. Dine at JuJu Bar & Restaurant, a sophisticated, modern venue with art deco environment during winter and an unmatched city panorama during summer. Finally, work out at the rooftop Fitness Center, the only one in Athens with a cityscape view, next to the swimming pool, where you may relish snacks & drinks at the Thea Poolside Bar.

7047.description: Situated just opposite the Temple of the Olympian Zeus and the Arch of Hadrian, the elegant and modern hotel The Athens Gate enjoys a privileged position in the historic heart of Athens. The breathtaking view from its rooftop restaurant is considered one of the best rooftop views of the world, overlooking the city and the famous Acropolis, which is only 500 m away from the hotel. The new Acropolis Museum is within a minute's walk; Syntagma Square and the commercial centre are at a distance of 500 m. This hotel is an ideal place to discover the Greek capital in an unparalleled setting.

7048.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Athens. Numerous museums and galleries are within easy reach, and attractions such as the Plaka, Syntagma Square with its boutiques, and world-famous monuments like the Acropolis, Parthenon, and Temple of Olympian Zeus are just a short stroll away. Athens Airport is 30 km from the property. The bright, airy rooms are excellently appointed and decorated in a cool, minimalist style with vivid colors. They are soundproofed and feature satellite TV; many also have a balcony. Guests can work out in the fitness center or relax in the sauna and hammam. The rooftop terrace offers an outdoor pool and a lounge bar, boasting panoramic views of the city skyline and the Acropolis.

7049.description: With a stay at Grand Hyatt Athens in Athens (Neos Kosmos), you'll be steps from Onassis Cultural Centre and a 2-minute drive from Acropolis Museum. This luxury hotel is 1. 9 mi (3 km) from Syntagma Square and 2. 4 mi (3. 9 km) from Monastiraki Flea Market. Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an indoor pool, a fitness center, and a seasonal outdoor pool. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 548 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at The Grand (Rooftop), a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 8 meeting rooms available for events. Limited parking is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Onassis Cultural Centre - 0. 1 km / 0.

7050.description: The Plaka Hotel, nestled in the heart of Athens, is a short walk from the Ancient Agora and the Hellenic Parliament. This family-friendly hotel offers 67 guestrooms equipped with refrigerators, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast, dine at the on-site restaurant, grab a snack at the coffee shop/cafe, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include a terrace with city views, concierge services, a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.
