Nearby attractions include the Acropolis Museum and Panathenaic Stadium.

7051.description: This newly renovated hotel (May 2019) is located on a quiet side street at the heart of Athens. Close by are many of the city's top tourist attractions including Syntagma Square, the parliament buildings and the National Gardens. Within walking distance are the Acropolis, many museums and the national gallery. Links to the public transport network are to be found directly in front of the hotel. This welcoming city residence was built in 1960 and fully renovated in May 2019 and offers a total of 35 rooms spread over 6 floors. All units are pleasantly decorated and come equipped with an en-suite bathroom and a mini-fridge. The hotel combines comfortable accommodation with a convenient location, to become a smart choice for business and leisure travellers alike.

7052.description: The all new Athens Tiare by Mage Hotels is situated in the heart of Athens, the European City that never sleeps. Our newly renovated and redesigned guest rooms, suites, and public spaces feature bold accent colours, custom furnishings and state of the art technologies. Our experienced staff will offer you unmatched experiences and will fulfill your requests at any hour. Our executive chef Nikos Voulougouris together with our world awarded sommelier Nikos Giannopoulos will offer you a culinary experience you will not forget. Whether it is for business or pleasure, you will find that our high quality facilities will satisfy all your needs and even more. If you want to feel the pulse of the city, the Athens Tiare by Mage Hotels is the place to stay.

7053.description: Located in Spata-Artemida, the 5-star Sofitel Athens Airport is connected to the airport and just a 4-minute drive from Metropolitan Expo and 6 minutes from Factory Outlet Airport. This luxurious hotel is also conveniently close to several attractions, including the Attica Zoological Park (8. 9 km) and McArthurGlen Designer Outlet (9. 9 km). Guests can indulge in massages, body treatments, and facials, or enjoy the recreational amenities, including an indoor pool and a fitness center. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and wedding services. The 345 air-conditioned rooms feature espresso makers and Smart TVs, along with memory foam beds with premium bedding. Complimentary wired and wireless Internet access is provided, as well as satellite programming. Private bathrooms boast rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Dining options include two restaurants, including Mesoghaia Restaurant, and 24-hour room service. Guests can also grab snacks at the coffee shop/cafe or relax with a drink at one of the two bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (for a fee). For business travelers, the hotel offers a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The hotel also has extensive conference space, measuring 1, 566 square meters. Free valet parking is available on-site.

7104.description: Located at the heart of the iconic Saint Germain des Prés, the Hotel Lutetia is opening its doors on May 15th, 2018. Founded in 1910, the hotel has been the crossroad of the greatest artists of the 20th century such as Ernest Hemingway, Joséphine Baker, Pablo Picasso… and many more. After four years of renovation driven by the international architect Jean Michel Wilmotte, the new Lutetia will combine heritage and modernity with 184 rooms including 47 suites and 7 signature suites. The hotel also features a 700 sqm spa, the dining areas the Salon Saint Germain and the Orangerie, an exclusive cigar area as well as the spectacular Bar Aristide.

7110.description: This 5 star hotel is located in the city centre of Paris and was established in 1898. It is close to the Louvre, Opera House, Pl Vendom and the nearest station is Opera, Madeleine, Concorde. The Hotel has 3 restaurants, 3 bars, a conference room, an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 142 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, trouser press, ironing set and air conditioning.

7112.description:
Located in the heart of historic Paris, Le Meurice enjoys an unrivalled setting — with the Louvre, the Eiffel Tower, and the prestigious Place Vendôme close at hand. A legendary address and proud member of Dorchester Collection, Le Meurice embodies all the richness and diversity of the French capital. Its interiors elegantly blend 18th-century grandeur with contemporary touches, reflecting the perfect harmony of timeless style and Parisian creativity. 

Each of the 121 rooms and 39 suites has been individually designed, all sharing the same dedication to refined comfort and the French art de vivre. Spacious marble bathrooms, exceptional craftsmanship and noble materials reflect the highest standards of French luxury. Thanks to large windows and private balconies, Le Meurice offers superb views — from Paris’s grand boulevards to the magnificent Tuileries Garden just opposite.

7116.description: Recently renovated, the hotel has 108 rooms including 14 suites in two wings: the wing Rivoli and the Opera wing. The rooms and suites of the Opera wing, decorated with beautiful silk drapes and neo-classical details, evoke baroque Italy. Rivoli wing, contemporary and refined atmosphere recalls the Paris of the 1930s, increased by using a palette of black, white and beige, and photographs by Robert Doisneau. Also offers free wi-fi The hotel also has a gym recently renovated.

7117.description: The 5-star Hotel Marignan Champs-Elysées, welcomes you in a historic house with 45 rooms and 5 suites completely redesigned by Pierre Yovanovitch. Centrally located in the 8th arrondissement, between Avenue Montaigne, the Champs-Elysées and Avenue George V, it is the quintessence of Parisian elegance. The hotel lies just a 2 minutes' walking distance away from links to the public transport network, enjoying ease of access to the main attractions that this captivating city has to offer. This elegant hotel features a stunning architectural design, tempting guests into the sumptuously-designed lobby. This magnificent hotel is sure to impress even the most discerning traveller. The guest rooms are splendidly-appointed, bathing visitors in elegance and decadence. The hotel features a boundless array of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of every type of traveller.

7118.description:
NH Paris Champs-Elysées is located in the 8th arrondissement. You’ll find 87 guest rooms of various sizes. 
Das NH Paris Champs-Elysées befindet sich im 8. Arrondissement. Es bietet 87 Gästezimmer unterschiedlicher Größe. 
Le NH Paris Champs-Elysées est situé dans le 8e arrondissement. Il propose 87 chambres de différentes tailles. 
El NH Paris Champs-Elysées se encuentra en el distrito 8. Encontrará 87 habitaciones de diferentes tamaños. 
L'NH Paris Champs-Elysées si trova nell'VIII arrondissement. Dispone di 87 camere di varie dimensioni. 
O NH Paris Champs-Elysées está localizado no 8º arrondissement. Você encontrará 87 quartos de vários tamanhos. 
NH Paris Champs-Elysées ligt in het 8e arrondissement en beschikt over 87 kamers van verschillende groottes.

7121.description: NH Paris Opéra Faubourg is located on Rue La Fayette in the 9th arrondissement of Paris. Thanks to its excellent location, many tourist attractions such as Opéra Garnier, Galeries Lafayette, Boulevard Haussmann, the Louvre, Place Vendôme and Sacré-Cœur are within a 30-minute walk. Additionally, Rue La Fayette is on the northern edge of the so-called ‘Silicon Sentier’, where many big corporations, including tech giants, have their head offices. The hotel is situated within a six-story Haussmann-style building that dates back to 1880. Within, it contains 103 guest rooms and suites of various sizes, as well as connecting rooms. The décor in these spaces is either inspired by the cult TV show series The Avengers, Pop-Art and the British style of ‘Chapeau Melon’, or by the retro tradition of the 1950s. Many guest rooms also feature a balcony that provides a stunning view of the city. It’s thought that the same views inspired Edvard Munch to paint ‘Rue Lafayette’ in 1891. Elsewhere, guests love the hotel’s outdoor terrace area, its breakfast room and its relaxing lounge bar.

7122.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center, or take advantage of complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities include babysitting services (surcharge) and a banquet hall. A nearby area shuttle is available (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite at La Cuisine de l’E7, specializing in French cuisine, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (surcharge). Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. This Paris hotel offers 592 square feet (55 square meters) of event space, including conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 69 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming. Complimentary wireless internet access is provided. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers offer complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes, desks, and phones with free local calls. The hotel is conveniently located near Grands Boulevards, Place de l’Opéra, and other attractions.

7125.description: This luxurious hotel boasts a stunning setting in Vienna. The hotel is located opposite the State Opera and Kärntner Street, lying just a 2 minutes' walking distance away from Karlsplatz underground station. The Hofburg imperial apartments, the Spanish Riding School and the renowned Ringstrasse are also located within easy walking distance from this hotel. This spectacular hotel is sure to impress, featuring a wonderful architectural design, and tempting guests into a world of luxury, decadence and opulence. The guest rooms feature lavish furnishings, oozing character and charm. Guests are invited to enjoy delectable dining in the Anna Sacher restaurant, where sumptuous culinary delights are the order of the day.

7126.description: Our hotel is located on the southern edge of Vienna, near the business and recreation area of Wienerberg. Hallmann Dome event center and scenic nature spots including Kastanienteich are within minutes. Vienna International Airport is half an hour away. Enjoy sunlit meeting rooms, a 24-hour fitness center, free parking, and a driving range. The elegant furnished guest room features comfortable beds. Wake up with a cup of tea/coffee or choose one of the many refreshments available from the mini-bar and watch movies on the HDTV. The rooms benefits from complete furnitshed bathrooms.

7128.description: The non-smoking arte Hotel Wien Stadthalle is only a 1-minute walk from the Stadthalle, the city's premier exhibition and concert hall. The Burggasse/Stadthalle U6 Underground Station and trams 6 and 18 are only 130 metres away. Free unlimited WiFi, a 24-hour front desk and bar are available. arte Hotel Wien Stadthalle offers bright, soundproof and air-conditioned rooms with cable TV, a work desk, a minibar and parquet flooring. The private bathrooms have a hairdryer and some rooms are facing the inner courtyard. The buffet breakfast at the arte Hotel consists of various sweet and savoury dishes, as well as fresh coffee and juices. Guests can enjoy a drink at the stylish bar or the in the fancy courtyard, decorated with a graffiti showing famous music artists. Billiards can be played as well. The Lugner City shopping and entertainment centre is next to the hotel. The Mariahilfer-Straße Shopping Boulevard is 1 metro stop away, while the März Park is next to the hotel. By public transport, the hotel is 15 minutes from the city centre. The Westbahnhof Train Station is a 10-minute walk away.

7129.description: The Boutique Hotel Gilbert & flora in the center of Vienna is located right next to the Ringstrasse in the trendy 7th district and is therefore the ideal starting point for a stay in Vienna. All downtown attractions are within easy walking distance. The reception is open 24 hours a day and can organize transfers and excursions for you. The modern rooms with many nice details are air-conditioned and equipped with a desk, a kettle, a safe and a flat-screen TV as well as high-quality cosmetic products. In the house is the multi-award-winning &flora restaurant, where breakfast is also served. The art history and natural history museums as well as the Leopold Museum, the town hall, the parliament and the Hofburg are in the immediate vicinity of the hotel. The nearest international airport, Vienna, is 18 km away from the Hotel Gilbert.

7130.description: Hundreds of handmade porcelain leaves in white and gold hanging from a delicate glass pearl string sparkle in the light. They seem to dance as they tell their story of mystique and magic. The Niagara Dorado chandelier is a lighting design by Lladró – and it is the first thing that will welcome you in our hotel. Continue through the silently sliding glass door and enter another world. Nothing is left to chance here, nothing is replaceable. With a touch of luxury. Not as a statement. Luxury as a matter of course. Unpretentious. Sophisticated iconic art meets contemporary art and creates a unique atmosphere. Everything here breathes art…Urban spirit in a sensational locationHistoric Vienna and the hip scene in the Museumsquartier. This is Das Tyrol. Individual, personal, stylish, and charming. A 4-star hotel with 5-star amenities that has been the best rated 4-star hotel throughout Vienna for many years. Experience this special mélange of art, culture, and charming hospitality. We look forward to seeing you!Helena Ramsbacher and the entire team at Das Tyrol

7144.description: This unique, art-themed hotel is set in the lively Botanique area of Brussels next to the Botanique concert venue and the Botanical Gardens. It's 15 minutes from Brussels Airport, Brussels North Station and the city's historic center. Convenient for public transport, the nhow Brussels Bloom! also has indoor parking on site. The hotel's 305 spacious rooms include some of the largest in the city. Spread across eight floors, each is decorated with hand-painted frescos by different artists. Rooms have free Wi-Fi, flat screen televisions and tea and coffee making facilities. Family rooms are available, as are three rooms for guests with reduced mobility. One of the hotel's highlights is its own waffle van, where you can order the waffle of your choice. It's situated in the OO! restaurant, where the generous buffet breakfast, featuring fresh fruit, pastries, breads and hot dishes is also served. For lunch and dinner, the Smoods restaurant and bar serves fusion food and cocktails. With 12 meeting rooms, the hotel has capacity for up to 320 people. Meetings and interviews can also be held in the Experience Room on the eighth floor. For guests who want to work out, there is a gym equipped with treadmills, elliptical machines, and stationary bikes.

7146.description: This luxurious hotel enjoys a prominent setting in Brussels. The property lies close to many of the renowned attractions that this wonderful city has to offer. The guest rooms are superbly styled, recently renovated and offering up-to-date amenities for the utmost in convenience. Guests can enjoy a leisurely stroll through the property's interior garden, which is hailed as one of the most spectacular in the city. The restaurant serves delectable dishes, that are sure to tempt even the most discerning palate. The hotel boasts 3 meeting rooms, which are sure to impress those travelling for work purposes.

7148.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a ballroom. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Rotisse, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 221 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Satellite television is provided for your entertainment. Partially open bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. The nearest airports are: Brussels Airport (BRU) - 17. 7 km / 11 miAntwerp (ANR-Antwerp Intl. ) - 46. 1 km / 28. 6 miCharleroi (CRL-Brussels South Charleroi) - 55. 5 km / 34. 5 miThe preferred airport for Brussels Marriott Hotel Grand Place is Brussels Airport (BRU).

7178.description: Located near the Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe, the charming 4-star Hotel Plaza Tour Eiffel enjoys the tranquility of a residential area while benefiting from a vibrant atmosphere. Monuments, museums, restaurants, and boutiques are within walking distance. Fully renovated, the hotel combines modern amenities with contemporary, elegant design. The inviting, comfortable rooms feature king-sized beds, private bathrooms, and all the expected four-star amenities. A buffet breakfast is served daily in the naturally lit breakfast room. Guests can also enjoy drinks in the hotel's lounge bar. For those looking to stay active, the hotel provides a modern fitness center with state-of-the-art equipment. High-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Convenient public transportation provides direct access to major cultural and business centers. Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports are approximately 40 minutes away.

7179.description: 'A warm welcome awaits you at the Libertel Canal Saint Martin, where our multilingual team is ready to make your Paris stay comfortable and enjoyable. This modern, stylish hotel offers 69 warm and inviting rooms. Ideally situated between Canal Saint Martin, Buttes-Chaumont, and Parc de la Villette, it's just two metro stops from Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est. Discover the charm of the vibrant, bohemian east side of Paris. Please note: one of the hotel buildings will be closed for refurbishment from January 4th to April 6th, 2023. '

7188.description: Location This hotel is located in the 16th arrondissement of Paris close to the Eiffel Tower. It is located between the Mirabeau Bridge and the bank of the River Seine, which the Maison de la Radio towers over. Links to the public transport network are 100 m away, Gare du Nord is around 7. 5 km away and Charles de Gaulle airport is 30 km away from the hotel.

7191.description: This lovely and charming hotel will welcome its guests in a quiet street of Batignolles in the 17eme arrondissement of Paris, close to “la Butte Montmartre” and the famous Moulin Rouge cabaret. The nearest metro station of Place de Clichy is located at a mere 150 m, lines 2 and 13, and permits to easily access many different areas of Paris. This cosy establishment boasts a total of 28 rooms on 5 floors, and offers useful amenities and facilities such as complimentary Internet access and a beautiful historical arched basement for breakfast to start the day the best possible way. All rooms are equally comfortable, count with a private bathroom (bath or shower) and boast lively and original colours, so that visitors enjoy a pleasant and relaxing stay. The multilingual front desk team will be at guests’ disposal at any time around the clock.

7192.description: Enjoy convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli or enjoy room service (limited hours). Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fee applies). Amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A 24-hour airport shuttle is available (surcharge). Relax in one of the 33 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and LED TVs. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks.

7195.description: Just off the top of the Champs Elysées, the Château des Fleurs is a brand new boutique-hotel installed in a picturesque 1900 mansion, characteristic of the exclusive Right bank, directly next to the famous Golden Triangle and Arc de Triomphe. Imagined by Quintana Partners, it exudes the sparkly flair of Paris. At Château des Fleurs, the lobby and living room have been designed for Parisians and travelers from afar to gather for a drink or to taste the generous Korean-inspired cuisine of Oma. Behind the curves of their doors, the 37 rooms unveil a cozy and sophisticated atmosphere, on one or two stories, with many details thought as a tribute to Paris. For a romantic break with a special other, for single travelers or for a family vacation on the Champs Elysées, Château des Fleurs is the quintessential Paris hideaway.

7199.description: Innovative design and a family welcome in Paris’s Latin Quarter. Best Western Plus® La Demeure is housed in an elegant Haussmannian building in Paris’s legendary Latin Quarter and has been entirely redecorated by two young designers, Flavie Papin and Paul Jouan. Their innovative approach created unusual, pleasing spaces that are practical, beautiful and full of light. This family-run 4-Star establishment offers you a warm welcome and a totally unique experience, particularly in the remarkable themed suitesOver the next few weeks, we will be renovating the hotel’s roof and facades to enhance your future experiences. Rest assured, we are committed to minimizing any inconvenience during this process so that you can fully enjoy your stay at La Demeure.

7271.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestHilton Berlin, located in the center of the city and only a short drive from the main airports, is also on historic Gendarmenmarkt and within walking distance of attractions such as the Berlin Wall, Brandenburg Gate, Humboldt Forum, Checkpoint Charlie and the Reichstag. Discover excellent shopping at Mall of Berlin and Friedrichsstrasse, only steps away. Hilton Berlin is the perfect location to discover the rich culture and entertainment landscape of this metropolitan city. The hotel provides 601 beautifully furnished guest rooms including 29 individually designed executive suites. All suites overlook the Gendarmenmarkt and come with access to the Executive Lounge. The spacious 360 square meter Executive Lounge offers complimentary breakfast and free WiFi. Additional on-property restaurants are breakfast restaurant Beletage and Listo, featuring regional and international specialties. Listo also serves freshly brewed coffee, tasty pastries and selected wines and spirits. Unwind in the 800 square meter wellness and fitness center featuring a heated indoor pool, massage center and air conditioned 24-hour gym.

7272.description: Conveniently located on Berlin's Joachimsthaler Strasse, Park Plaza Berlin Kudamm places guests at the heart of one of Europe's most inspiring cities. Iconic attractions such as the Berlin Zoological Garden and the KaDeWe department store are nearby, and the famous shopping street Kurfürstendamm is within walking distance. Culture vultures can immerse themselves in Berlin's plethora of galleries and museums, marvel at the modern architecture and soak up the wealth of live entertainment on offer. The hotel is also surrounded by examples of Berlin's rich history, including the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church and the famous former royal hunting grounds, the Tiergarten, home to the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. With 133 Double Rooms and Executive Rooms, the hotel offers a combination of style, comfort and convenience. All rooms feature the latest in-room amenities such as air cooling, flatscreen TV and minibar, while free Wi-Fi enables guests to stay connected. The hotel's Bar Vostell is known for its cool décor, relaxing ambience and impeccably shaken cocktails, all of which can be accompanied by a variety of delicious snacks. The Garden Salon serves fresh buffet breakfast, the Garden Terrace is perfect for an al-fresco bite and in-room dining is available from 18:00 to 22:30.

7273.description: Situated in the heart of the upscale Grunewald residential area, Schlosshotel Berlin offers a refined sanctuary for discerning business and leisure travelers seeking to escape the downtown hustle and bustle. The hotel's artworks and interior design by Patrick Hellmann, combined with the elegance of its 100 years of history and exceptional service, provide each guest with an experience unrivalled in Germany. Built in 1911 in the 18th century Renaissance style of the French palaces, this architectural masterpiece boasts breath-taking views of an idyllic garden from individually styled guest rooms and suites. Recharge yourself by taking a plunge in the large indoor pool, relax in the hot tub, eliminate toxins in the Finnish sauna and spoil yourself with a restoring massage in the comfort of on one of our treatment rooms. Delight your senses with exceptional dining at the restaurant. Enjoy cocktails or champagne in the GQ bar, alternatively in the newly designed Champagne Lounge. From the hotel, it's easy to experience the vibrant pulse of Berlin, from the culture and shopping on the legendary Avenue Kurfürstendamm to the luxury boutiques and restaurants just ten minutes away on Kudamm. World-class art galleries, museums, theatres and more beckon from just outside our doors. Schlosshotel Berlin is a hotel that feels worlds apart from modern times yet is just moments away from everything there is to see and experience in cosmopolitan Berlin.

7274.description: Ideally situated at Pariser Platz in the heart of Berlin, Hotel Adlon Kempinski Berlin is located steps from Brandenburg Gate, Tiergarten Park and iconic cultural landmarks. Each of the 385 individually designed guestrooms and suites features bespoke furnishings, minibars, espresso machines and complimentary Wi-Fi. Marble bathrooms offer separate bathtubs, showers and premium toiletries. Guests can savour exquisite culinary creations across three restaurants, including refined French dining at Brasserie Quarré, or take advantage of 24-hour in-room dining. Two elegant bars and a café provide ideal settings for evening cocktails or light refreshments. A tranquil spa offers tailored body treatments, facials and massages. Additional services include a dedicated concierge team, babysitting (surcharge), a business centre and town car service. For executive gatherings and private events, the hotel offers 497 sq m (5, 350 sq ft) of versatile conference space. Four-legged companions are welcomed at Hotel Adlon Kempinski Berlin for a fee of EUR 150 per stay, with a maximum of one dog per guestroom weighing up to 25 kg and measuring up to 50 cm at shoulder height. To ensure comfort and tranquillity for all guests, dogs must not be left unattended in guestrooms and are not permitted in restaurants, bars, terraces, breakfast areas, or the spa and wellness centre. Certified guide and assistance dogs are exempt from these restrictions and stay free of charge.

7276.description:
Find all the advantages of a Berlin hotel combined at ibis Styles Berlin Treptow: 126 quietly located hotel rooms that offer an idyllic view of the river Spree and are yet within short distance to Berlin's most popular touristic hotspots. 

The hotel also features two meeting rooms with state-of-the-art conference technology. This diverse offer makes the hotel the first choice for leisure and business travellers alike. The whole hotel was renovated in 2022.

name.content: Vienna House Easy by Wyndham Berlin PrenzlauerBerg

7277.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as bicycles to rent, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include a banquet hall and a vending machine. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 152 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and complimentary newspapers, and housekeeping is provided on request.

7292.description: Set down your bags and relax at Swissotel Amsterdam. The hotel is located just off Dam Square, next to the Royal Palace in the heart of the city centre. Easily accessible by public transport, only 7 minutes walking distance to Amsterdam Central train station. Our hotel is perfectly located for both business and leisure. Meet up with your business partners or enjoy the city's attractions. A rich breakfast buffet is served for a great start to your day. We will guarantee you a pleasant stay.

7326.description: The Rosa Grand Milano - Starhotels Collezione, an elegant hotel overlooking Piazza Fontana, is one of the largest in Milan's city center. Located in the historic heart of Milan, it's steps from the Duomo. Its 330 rooms embody luxury and Starhotels' renowned hospitality. The striking facade blends architectural and urban design elements, creating a unique style. Guests can unwind in the VIP and Club Lounges, complete with a Turkish bath and solarium. A state-of-the-art wellness center on the top floor offers a comprehensive workout experience. Free WiFi is available in common areas. Please note: Non-refundable rates require prepayment at booking. The wellness center is open daily from 7 am to 11 pm, with personal trainers available by reservation. Small/medium pets are welcome (fees apply; please notify at booking). A valid photo ID is required at check-in.

7329.description: This hotel is situated at the historical and artistic district of Milan. The hotel is located just a 15 minutes' walking distance from the cathedral, offering guests a great location from which to explore the rich culture and history of this vibrant city. An abundance of shops, restaurants, bars and entertainment venues are to be found nearby. Moscova underground station is located just a short distance away. This wonderful hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, and come complete with modern amenities. Guests are assured of a relaxing stay at this hotel.

7330.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include babysitting (surcharge), wedding services, and discounted use of a nearby fitness facility. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. This hotel has 6 meeting rooms available for events. Make yourself at home in one of the 133 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.
