7331.description: The Gruppo Mini Hotels' Hotel Portello is conveniently located near Milan's key business districts. Situated opposite the Fieramilanocity exhibition center and just steps from the MIC - Milan Convention Centre, it offers excellent access to the Rho-Pero exhibition complex. Despite its proximity to bustling commercial areas, the hotel provides a tranquil retreat. Behind it lies the elegant residential neighborhood of Via Monte Rosa, known for its historic villas and gardens. The nearby 'Il Portello' shopping center offers a variety of fashionable shops, and Via Marghera, with its renowned restaurants, is a short walk away.

7332.description: The Park Hyatt Milano, a 5-star luxury hotel, is situated in Milan's historic heart, near the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II. This elegant hotel offers guests an ideal location for exploring the city's fashion and design scene, with Via Montenapoleone and Via della Spiga just a short walk away. Recently refurbished rooms, dining establishments, and a stunning suite collection designed by Flaviano Capriotti add to the hotel's splendor. The 108 guest rooms offer a luxurious experience with Milanese architectural details and a neutral color palette inspired by the Duomo Cathedral. The hotel's Terrace, Montenapoleone, and Duomo Suites boast panoramic terraces with city views, while the Brera Suite overlooks La Cupola Restaurant. The Solferino and Fiori Chiari suites can be combined to create a two-bedroom suite.

7333.description: Located at the heart of the business area of Milan, this hotel is just 550 metres away from the central station. The world-famous Dome and the trade fair centre are just a 10 minutes' walking distance away. Links to the public transport network are readily accessible nearby, offering ease of access to other areas of the city. The Piazza della Repubblica, Grattacielo Pirelli and the Public Gardens are within easy walking distance. This property offers comfortable, spacious guest rooms, which are well appointed and enjoy a calming ambiance. Guests are invited to avail of the many excellent facilities and services that the property has to offer.

7378.description: The 4-star Hotel Plaza boasts a prime location directly opposite Mestre Train Station, offering convenient access to Venice Island (10 minutes by train/bus) and Marco Polo Airport (20 minutes by shuttle). Its 211 air-conditioned ensuite rooms range from doubles for single use to family rooms, available in classic, superior, deluxe, or executive categories. All rooms feature satellite TV, a telephone, and a safe. Bathrooms are equipped with either a shower or bathtub, a hairdryer, and complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy 24-hour reception service, luggage storage, an ATM, and room service. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The 'Soul Kitchen' restaurant serves regional Italian cuisine, and a buffet breakfast is offered daily. Meeting rooms with video projectors are available for business needs.

7381.description: Located on Venice's Lido Island, a short 10-minute boat ride from St. Mark's Square with 24-hour public boat service, this hotel offers convenient access to both shopping and the beach, just 300 meters away. Set within a large garden, the property comprises three buildings housing 63 comfortably furnished, modern rooms, some with lagoon views and balconies. Guests enjoy a range of amenities including a 24-hour reception, bar, restaurant, meeting room, central heating, and air conditioning. A rich breakfast buffet is served daily. The hotel's renowned restaurant offers a diverse menu featuring fresh, local produce, seafood specialties, and classic Italian and international dishes. Half-board options are available upon request. During the summer, enjoy candlelit dinners and live piano music on the lagoon-facing terrace. Free parking and paid beach service with umbrellas and sunbeds are also available. As a bonus, guests receive a complimentary excursion to Murano.

7382.description: CIN code: IT027042A1R95JGJ9N Boasting a prime location close to the Piazza San Marco, this hotel enjoys an enviable location in Venice, just footsteps from the Palazzo Reale and Basilica di San Marco and is also conveniently close to a range of famous boutiques and top quality restaurants. Marco Polo airport is just 19 minutes' drive. This establishment welcomes guests with traditional hospitality and attention to detail, offering a choice of cosy rooms featuring elegant furniture and Murano chandeliers. The interiors of the hotel are decorated in white and red marble. A daily continental buffet is served in the breakfast room, located in the main building.

7384.description: This elegant hotel enjoys a convenient situation in Venice, right next to the beautiful Campo San Zaccaria. Travellers will find themselves within ease of access to all this beautiful city has to offer: numerous restaurants, shops, rich historical heritage and stunning views over the impressive Venetian Lagoon. The seafront is within a few steps from the property and the majestic Doge's Palace, Saint Mark's Basilica and the famous square bearing the same name lie within just 500 metres. This attractive establishment offers spacious and delightfully decorated rooms. All of them feature elegant surroundings, fitted with neoclassical furniture, beautiful flock walls and plush bed-linens. Each unit comes complete with modern amenities to cater for needs of even the most demanding guests. The friendly and professional staff will assist patrons in every need they may have.

7385.description: Welcome to the sacred sanctuary on the doorstep of Venice. San Clemente Palace immerses guests in 900-year-old landmark in drama, glamour and heritage of the Renaissance, with a series of beautifully restored monastery buildings, 12th century historical church and nearly 78, 000 square meters of ancient gardens.

7386.description: This recently renovated hotel near Mestre's center is a 10-minute drive from Venice. It offers 107 spacious rooms and furnished apartments equipped with kitchenettes, living rooms with sofa beds, and private bathrooms with baths or showers, some with balconies. Guests can enjoy bar service, private parking (fee applies), a garden, and a TV room. The hotel also features the VITA SPA, offering Finnish saunas, Turkish baths, a heated pool with hydromassage, chromatic showers, a relaxation area, and a terrace-garden. Beauty treatments are available by reservation. The current city tax is €3. 10 per adult per night, payable at the hotel (children under 2 stay free). Please note: the restaurant is temporarily closed. 27 newly renovated rooms are currently available. The spa is open from 9 am to 9 pm (reservations required), with daily access for adults at €25 (€30 on weekends). Bathrobes, caps, and slippers are mandatory (rentals available).

7387.description:
This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Venice and was established in 1430. It is a short drive away from the St Mark's Square and the nearest station is Venezia Santa Lucia. The Hotel has a restaurant, a bar and a coffee shop. All 16 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning. 
For any kind of support contact: +39 0662290200
The guests must arrive up to 4 pm - reception is open until 4 pm

7438.description: Ideally located just 10 minutes from the airport and city center, between Geneva Stadium and La Praille shopping and leisure center, the hotel benefits from convenient public transport access. Guests enjoy complimentary use of trams, buses, and trains throughout their stay, connecting them directly to all parts of the city. The hotel is also easily accessible by car via the Carouge/La Praille highway exit, located just in front of the hotel. This modern 3-star establishment features warm colors and a pleasant design. Its 154 spacious and well-equipped rooms offer great comfort and include Standard (Encore), Superior (Business), and Junior Suites (Lounge). All rooms feature air conditioning, Wi-Fi, TV, pay-TV, and a large desk. Non-smoking rooms and accessible rooms for guests with disabilities are available. The in-house restaurant, The Hub, serves local and international cuisine, while the adjoining bar offers a wide selection of drinks, including wines from Geneva's vineyards. Additional international restaurants are located in the adjacent shopping mall. The hotel provides six seminar rooms with natural daylight and air conditioning, accommodating up to 240 guests. Its Event Center can host events for up to 1, 000 people. Further amenities include indoor parking, laundry service, a fitness and wellness center, Switzerland's largest bowling alley, and access to over 80 shops in the connected La Praille shopping mall. Nearby attractions include the charming Carouge suburb, Lake Geneva, Geneva's old town, the UN Palace, the Olympic Museum, the Patek Philippe Museum, Mont Blanc, Gruyères Castle, Chillon Castle, the Alps, Lausanne, local vineyards, and much more.

7461.description: This charming hotel is centrally situated in Zurich. The hotel is located just a short distance away from the main attractions that this sophisticated city has to offer. The hotel is situated within easy access of a wealth of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. This wonderful hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, bathing visitors in the utmost in comfort and luxury. The hotel features a range of exemplary facilities and services. Guests can enjoy delightful dining in the restaurant, where Mediterranean cuisine is sure to tempt the taste buds.

7462.description: The 4-star Novotel Zurich City West has everything for an ideal stay with its renovated Scandinavian style rooms. Direct connections to the airport and downtown, within 15min. Sports lovers will get their money's worth in the hotel's fitness & pool area or Limmat. The hotel's restaurant & bar offer culinary specialties. The courtyard terrace is a hidden jewel of peace in the hubbub of Zurich.

7499.description: Nestled in the heart of Marrakesh's trendy L'Hivernage district, this stylish hotel offers easy access to the city's captivating attractions. Surrounded by lush greenery, the hotel's sophisticated architecture hints at the opulent interiors within. A blend of contemporary and traditional Moroccan design elements creates a charming atmosphere. Beautifully appointed guest rooms provide a refined and relaxing retreat. Guests can also enjoy a range of excellent leisure facilities.

7501.description: This popular city hotel enjoys a prime location in the suburbs of Marrakesh. The hotel is located just a few minutes' walking distance from the centre of the city where a diverse range of shopping and entertainment venues, as well as cultural and historical attractions can be found. Menara - Marrakech Airport is just 5. 2 km away. The hotel provides the ideal setting from which to explore the wonders of this enchanting city. Guests will be impressed by the hotel's elegant surroundings, immersing them in the rich culture of this mesmerising city. The hotel provides an array of exemplary facilities. The guest rooms are beautifully designed offering an oasis of peace and tranquility in which to relax and unwind at the end of the day.

7504.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. This Marrakech hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Le Doyen restaurant serves international cuisine for lunch and dinner, and 24-hour room service is available. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is offered daily (fee applies). Business amenities include a business center and express check-in/check-out. Event space totals 215 square feet (20 square meters) and includes conference space and a meeting room. Free self-parking is available. The 51 guest rooms feature minibars, LED TVs with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include Carré Eden Shopping Center (0. 1 km), Grand Poste Gueliz (0. 5 km), and Marrakech Plaza (0. 6 km). The preferred airport is Menara Airport (RAK), 6. 9 km away.

7505.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, an outdoor tennis court, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy barbecue at Le Palmier Restaurant, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Marrakech? This hotel has 1776 square feet (165 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 4 meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 277 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and minibars. 32-inch plasma televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature spring water baths and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Menara Mall - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Avenue Mohamed VI - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Place of Youth - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Palais des Congrès - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Casino de Marrakech - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Menara Gardens - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Bab El Djedid - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Ksar Char-Bagh Hammam - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Royal Tennis Harti - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Harti Garden - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Theatre Royal - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Cyber Park - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Koutoubia Mosque - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Place du 16 November - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Grand Poste Gueliz - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi.

7506.address: Avenue Hassan Ii Place De La Gare
7506.description: In its red ochre colored building with touches of blue, ibis Marrakech Centre Gare offers 109 air-conditioned and comfortable rooms with private bathroom, desk area, flat-screen TV and unlimited free WiFi. Its international restaurant serves an all-you-can-eat breakfast buffet, and its 24-hour bar and sunny garden with terrace and swimming pool promise savory moments of relaxation close to the tourist sites of the Red City.

7512.description: Stylish hotel and restaurant in central Birmingham, steps from Grand Central train station and the ICC. Crowne Plaza® Birmingham City Centre hotel boasts a prime location in central Birmingham, just five minutes’ walk from Grand central train station and a three minute walk from the International Conference Centre (ICC). The hotel is a 10 minute train journey from Birmingham Airport (BHX) and 45 minutes by car from East Midlands Airport (EMA). Business guests appreciate the complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, as well as the handy business centre. Planning a meeting or wedding? Our dedicated conference floor has 11 naturally lit meeting rooms for up to 300 delegates. Our Crowne Plaza Meetings Director will assist with any catering packages and audio visual requests – and after work, you can relax over cocktails in the sleek b1 Bar. Visiting Birmingham with your family? The city's art museums, shops and cultural venues, including the Birmingham Hippodrome, are on the hotel's doorstep. You can stroll to the upscale Mailbox shopping centre, IKON gallery and National Sea Life Centre. Children up to the age of 12 eat free from our Kids menu. Enjoy sophisticated cuisine and city views at b1 Restaurant, with its seasonal à la carte menu and daily specials. Our well-equipped Fitness Centre helps you keep up with your exercise routine. All our 312 bedrooms have been refurbished boasting a modern and contemporary style.

7513.description: Located just off the M42, our hotel is connected to the NEC complex and a short 5-minute walk from BP pulse Arena. Birmingham International Rail Station, offering services to Birmingham International Airport, is a 12-minute walk or a 5-minute drive away. For leisure, Peppa Peg Space Adventure is within a 5-minute walk, and Birmingham City Centre is a quick 10-minute train ride. On-site, enjoy three unique restaurants and the LivingWell Health Club, featuring a fitness center, sauna, steam room and pool.

name.content: Britannia Hotel Birmingham New Street Station

7515.description: The hotel is in the city centre, surrounded by all the major stores and some of the finest shopping arcades. The nightlife is on the doorstep and the hotel is only a short distance from the International Convention Centre. The hotel is also 200 yards from New St Train Station and a bus stop is just around the corner. Many attractions can be found close to the hotel. The hotel offers 241 en-suite bedrooms, equipped with convenient amenities, including FREE WIFI.

7516.description: Set in the heart of Birmingham city centre, this modern 4-star Novotel Birmingham Centre hotel is ideal for guests wanting to blend style with convenience. Situated on the renowned Broad Street, the Bullring Shopping Centre is just a 20-minute walk away, while those looking further afield will find solace in the tranquil settings of Winterbourne House and Garden. Back at the hotel, guests can enjoy the comforts of home with spacious rooms and the onsite gym.

7517.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace at Westmead Hotel in Birmingham, and take advantage of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and wedding services. Savor regional cuisine at Blakes Brasserie, featuring a bar/lounge, or enjoy 24-hour room service. English breakfasts are available daily (fee applies). The hotel offers 56 guestrooms with private bathrooms, digital programming, and laptop-compatible safes. Free self-parking, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services are also available. Nearby attractions include Lickey Hills Country Park and Cadbury World.

7518.description: This hotel is situated at the heart of Birmingham. The hotel is located just a short distance away from an abundance of shopping opportunities, entertainment venues and dining options. Links to the public transport network are available nearby, offering ease of access to other areas of the city. The hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and charm. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, exuding refined elegance and classical beauty. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests are invited to enjoy wonderful dining in the restaurant, where delectable culinary delights are just waiting to be savoured.

7528.description: This luxurious and charming hotel is ideally located in Edinburgh's old town, within walking distance of the Royal Mile and close to the main sightseeing attractions and points of interest. All bedrooms are elegantly fitted with large comfortable beds for a restful night's sleep, 42' widescreen LCD TV and a private bathroom with superior toiletries and a power shower. The hotel's exclusive leisure facilities include a gym with the latest equipment and an indoor swimming pool and sauna where guests can rest and relax. At the on-site bar and restaurant, visitors can enjoy informal dining and something for every taste as they take in iconic views of Edinburgh's famous Grassmarket and Edinburgh Castle.

7540.description: Located in the heart of London, St. Ermin's Hotel, Autograph Collection, is within a 10-minute walk of Buckingham Palace and Westminster Abbey. This upscale hotel offers 331 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring a refrigerator, minibar, and a 50-inch LED TV with satellite programming. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is provided. Bathrooms include showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy the fitness center, terrace, and garden, or dine at the Caxton Grill, which offers alfresco dining and a bar/lounge. A full breakfast is available for a fee. Additional amenities include 24-hour room service, concierge and wedding services, a business center, and limo/town car service. Self-parking is available (subject to charges).

name.content: The May Fair Hotel, Mayfair, London

7541.description: The May Fair Hotel, Mayfair London is an iconic hotel with a rich history, set in one of London’s most sought-after locations. Buckingham Palace, Bond Street’s exclusive shops. Green Park station is nearby, ensuring seamless travel across the city. Since opening in 1927, The May Fair Hotel, Mayfair London has blended modern design with its glamorous heritage. Rooms feature luxury Vispring beds with down pillows, 400 thread count, sateen finish, 100% cotton, high-speed WiFi for unlimited devices, Samsung TVs with 300+ international channels, Italian marble bathrooms, and sustainable Noble Isle skincare products. Guests can savour an intimate Japanese izakaya and Italian menu at May Fair Kitchen, while May Fair Bar offers global cuisine and signature cocktails. The hotel also boasts stunning event spaces, including a Crystal Ballroom, screening room, tranquil spa, and gym.

7542.description: A modern hotel near central London's attractions, with free Wi-Fi and smart event facilities. Holiday Inn® London - Regent's Park hotel offers easy access to central London's major attractions, with Great Portland Street and Regent's Park Tube stations just a few minutes away. The hotel is near A501 and a 45-minute drive from Heathrow Airport. You can head to the leafy grounds of Regent's Park or hit the shops on buzzy Oxford Street, both an easy walk from the hotel. Family-friendly attractions like Madame Tussauds, the Sherlock Holmes Museum & London Zoo are all a stone's throw from the hotel. You can discover ancient treasures and learn about cultures from around the world at the British Museum, less than a mile away, or see an exhibition at the British Library. Theatre lovers can reach the West End in 15 minutes on foot, along with the bars & restaurants of vibrant Soho. Planning your next training day or conference? The Academy is a modern events centre fitted with the latest technology and high-speed Wi-Fi. There's a dedicated reception and banquet kitchen, plus an operations team to help plan your event. Training packages are available. Unwind and choose from our extensive rate of wine, beers and spirits on our comfortable range of seating. Chill or catch up on the day’s emails with complimentary WiFi. Afterwards, tuck into hearty meals in the newly renovated open lobby. Kids Stay and Eat Free.

7543.description:
Opened in 1955, The Hotel is primely located on Bond Street, in the heart of Mayfair's fashion and arts district. The only hotel to occupy such a prized address, it shares its illustrious position with prestigious boutiques, arts institutions and city landmarks, offering an ideal base from which to explore the individuality and authentic personality of the neighbourhood.Built in an era when American glamour prevailed, the hotel is styled from white Portland stone, dark marble and architectural brass detailing that renders it both notable and distinctive in character. Classic styling permeates throughout the property which has been indelibly influenced by its proximity to the high-end world of design, tailoring and the arts. The story of fashion through the decades is showcased in black and white photographic detail on each floor, while intriguing and evolving snapshots of British design are routinely placed throughout the lobby.
With an ample inventory of suites, The Westbury Mayfair, offers an enriching choice of distinctively styled spaces, with a variety of inter-connecting options, where warm, discreet and personalised service is a given. Guests staying in select suites also benefit from the unrivalled Butler service that is tailored to individual wishes and needs. The distinguished Berkeley and Hanover Suites, located on the 7th floor and the distinctive top floor St George's Penthouse, boast spacious outside terraces that overlook the Mayfair skyline.Awarded one Michelin star, Alyn Williams at The Westbury brings inspired dining to Mayfair with a creative culinary menu that extends to lunch, dinner and a tasting menu. Gastronomes can choose to dine in the main restaurant or in the privacy of the Wine Room, flanked with 600 bottles of wine, or the larger, Aspen Room, with its hand-blown glass fixtures, that seats 20 guests. Sushi devotees will find crafted Japanese cuisine in Tsukiji Sushi, an intimate space with a refined ambience, where traditional recipes

7544.description: The Tower Hotel sits adjacent to the iconic Tower Bridge, offering excellent connections to Canary Wharf, the Excel Centre, the O2 Arena, and central London, all within a 5-minute walk. For meetings and events, the hotel's dedicated 12th-floor conference level provides a fantastic view of the city. Guests can enjoy delicious dishes and cocktails at Vicinity or escape the bustling streets below at VU from the Tower, savoring expertly crafted cocktails in a sophisticated atmosphere. London City Airport is just 45 minutes away. The hotel also holds the Greenage ECOSmart 2023 Gold Accreditation.

7545.description: Hyatt Regency London Churchill is an international five-star business hotel nestled on the picturesque gardens of Portman Square, London W1, just 100 metres north of Marble Arch. The hotel is ideally situated in London's West End, close to many of London's main attractions and exclusive shopping areas, plus Hyatt Regency London - The Churchill is perfectly placed for easy access to the City. The hotel is also just minutes from Paddington Station where the Heathrow Express train takes a mere 15 minutes directly from London's Heathrow Airport. Hyatt Regency London - The Churchill's 440 well-appointed hotel guest rooms and suites offer complete comfort and luxury. Regency Club, Hyatt's 'hotel within a hotel' concept, is designed for hotel guests looking for a higher level of personalised service and a more intimate atmosphere. Hyatt Regency London - The Churchill offers guests a dining experiences at The Montagu where British and European comfort foods are prepared in a striking open kitchen, and hotel guests can also enjoy a large selection of cocktails and whiskies in The Churchill Bar.

7546.description: Whether you choose our 4-star hotel for business or leisure, Novotel London West is the perfect place to stay for comfort and location. Situated in the bustling heart of Hammersmith, West London, discover the amazing sights the capital has to offer thanks to the nearby tube station. Whatever your reason for visiting—a weekend city break, family holiday, or business trip—you can be confident we have the perfect room or event space for you.

7547.description:
Situated on the prestigious Grosvenor Square in Mayfair, The Biltmore Mayfair offers a refined London stay surrounded by some of the city’s most iconic landmarks, including Hyde Park, Buckingham Palace, Bond Street, and the West End. With its central location, the hotel provides convenient access to London’s leading shopping, cultural, and business destinations. 

The hotel features beautifully designed rooms and suites with contemporary interiors, calming colour palettes, and thoughtful amenities. Guests can enjoy spacious accommodation with marble bathrooms, premium toiletries, and views overlooking Grosvenor Square or the hotel’s landscaped courtyard. The property also offers a fully equipped fitness centre, concierge services, and Free WiFi throughout the hotel. 

Guests can experience a variety of dining options, including Café Biltmore Restaurant & Terrace, serving all-day dining with globally inspired cuisine in a relaxed setting. The Foliage Lounge offers a traditional Afternoon Tea experience, while The Pine Bar provides a welcoming space for cocktails, and Grill 88 offers a refined dining experience featuring premium steaks and seafood, ideal for intimate dinner, and special occasions. 

Combining elegant accommodation, exceptional service, and a sought-after Mayfair location, The Biltmore Mayfair provides a comfortable and convenient base for discovering London.

7548.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an indoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy Japanese cuisine at The Aubrey, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. English breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, a computer station, and express check-in. Make yourself at home in one of the 181 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Satellite programming and DVD players are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

7549.description: An icon of British hospitality since 1963, London Hilton on Park Lane was the first Hilton hotel to open in the UK — and we’ve been purveyors of excellence ever since. Located in the heart of Mayfair, our hotel is the perfect getaway to explore London by foot or bike. You can walk to West End in 25 minutes, go shopping at Harrods in under 20 minutes or explore the Royal Parks and Buckingham Palace only a 15 minute walk away from the hotel. Hire a Santander Cycle, in front of the hotel, and cycle along the Thames to the Tower of London and the famous Tower Bridge all in just 25 minutes. Step inside the hotel and find elegant rooms with magnificent views, world-class dining, and modern facilities for business and relaxation — everything you need for a memorable stay in the capital. London's magnificent city and park views await you from a Guest Room or Suite. Our Deluxe Rooms offer more space while Executive Rooms provide Executive Lounge access. For something extra special, select a spacious Suite with sweeping views of Hyde Park, Mayfair or the city. Guests are also invited to sample our Chocoholic Afternoon Tea designed and created by our winners of The Bake Off: The Professionals 2018. Or discover London's pre-eminent sky bar, 10 Degrees, for signature cocktails, whilst enjoying stunning views across London and indulge into a culinary experience at our award-winning restaurant, Galvin at Windows with 360-degree views on the 28th floor. For a tropical escape, taste a little bit of paradise in the home of Mai Tai’s and luscious dishes in the midst of authentic artefacts at our Polynesian restaurant Trader Vic’s.

7550.description:
Wake up in the centre of the action, Thistle Trafalgar Square is steps away from London’s iconic Trafalgar Square – home of history, culture, and family fun. Situated in the middle of the West End and the famous Theatreland area, the hotel is only a 2-minute stroll to the famous Chinatown, 10 minutes to Covent Garden and just a 5-minute walk to Piccadilly Circus. The perfect base to explore London, less than 10 minutes from Charing Cross train station, Leicester Square and Piccadilly Tube stops, enabling guests to easily access all that London has to offer.  
Thistle Trafalgar Square offers a welcoming retreat in the centre of it all, with everything you need to explore the city’s landmarks, theatres, and vibrant dining scene.

7552.description: Flemings Mayfair is one of the few remaining independent privately owned hotels in London that has been in the same family for over 40 years. It is also one of the capital’s oldest established, having opened its doors in 1851. Part of Small Luxury Hotels of the World, the award-winning hotel offers unrivalled luxury accommodation in the heart of Mayfair just moments from Green Park, Piccadilly, and a short walk from Buckingham Palace. Comprising thirteen townhouses that date from 1734, Flemings’ interiors are a chic blend of modern Art Deco style and Georgian elegance with an intimacy that belies the hotel’s 129 sumptuous guest rooms and luxury suites, including ten fully serviced apartments of either one, two or three bedrooms. It is the perfect base for a leisure escape with the very best that London has to offer literally right on its doorstep. Home to highly acclaimed One-Michelin-starred restaurant Ormer Mayfair by Executive chef Sofian Msetfi and consistently ranked as one of the finest dining experiences in London. Sofian and his team offer a simpler and yet inspired dining experience with cooking suffused with creativity and originality. The dining experience is for you to take your time to savour a sublime food journey in an atmosphere that is as polished and sophisticated as it is relaxed. And the intimate Manetta’s Bar that offers an ambiance redolent of the glamorous 1930's.

7553.description: The hotel is conveniently situated in the heart of London's Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, overlooking Kensington Palace, in the west part of the metropolis. Just a short drive from the M40, M4 and M25 motorways, the hotel is also just minutes from Earls Court and the Olympia Exhibition Halls, and is within a short drive of London's financial district. The hotel offers contemporary accommodation with a choice of 3 bars and two restaurants. The Tenth is the fine-dining, award-winning restaurant, which has stunning views of the London skyline. This combines with conference and banqueting facilities, and a business centre open 24 hours a day. There are 396 guest rooms in total. All of the spacious guest rooms offer a work area with a desk, a comfy chair and a coffee table, in which to either work or relax. A private en suite bathroom, personal safe, minibar and many additional comforts are included in the room. A large proportion of bedrooms are designated non-smoking. Single occupancy rooms feature a double bed and have views of either Kensington Palace and Gardens and the Royal Household Mews, or look out over a buzzing Kensington High Street and the neighbourhood's quaint 'Mary Poppins' rooftops. Other rooms, which are for double occupancy, feature either a twin or king-size bed. Like the single rooms, views include the green vistas of Kensington Gardens, or the city's rooftops. North-facing rooms overlook the quiet Royal Household Mews. To help guests relax after a busy day, the hotel provides a health spa, featuring state-of-the-art exercise equipment, a sauna and a steam room. Other services provided at an additional charge include massage and physiotherapy treatments. An exquisite, extensive breakfast buffet is on offer to guests on a daily basis. In addition to this, it is possible to pay a visit to the excellent hotel restaurants where the finest wines and dishes are available.

7555.description: A landmark itself, Charing Cross opened in 1865 and remains one of the most well-places hotels. A few steps to Trafalgar Square. A minute's stroll to London's West End, A stone's throw away from The National Gallery and so much more. And when exploring more of the city, Charing Cross station is right next door. Our rooms, along with some handy extras, are all set up to send you soundly off to sleep. The Clermont Restaurant & Bar serves an all-day menu of fresh, seasonal British cuisine. The menu in our Charing Cross restaurant is inspired by the classics with a modern twist, created from fresh, locally sourced produce wherever possible. So, whether it's a breakfast to set you up for the day, a three-course meal, or an evening of cocktails, our restaurant and bar have you covered. Hotel residents receive complimentary use of the hotel's fitness centre which features a full range of cardiovascular fitness equipment and weights.

7556.description:
Situated at one of London’s most prestigious addresses, InterContinental London Park Lane embodies the epitome of refined luxury and timeless elegance. Overlooking the iconic Royal Parks and set in the heart of Mayfair, our hotel seamlessly blends classic heritage with contemporary sophistication. From award-winning seasonal cuisine to our tranquil spa, every detail is crafted to deliver an unparalleled experience. 

Dear guest, from early October 2026, we will be undertaking a thoughtfully planned enhancement of selected guest rooms on the 5th and 6th floors, alongside the rolling refurbishment of our guest lifts. Both programmes reflect our commitment to excellence and are carefully managed to minimise disruption and ensure seamless guest experience. Works are expected to be completed by June 2027.

7557.description: ibis London Earls Court is a 12-storey three-star hotel with breathtaking views of the London skyline. With 226 guestrooms, including suites, family, triple and accessible rooms, a business centre, bespoke Food and Beverage outlets and on-site parking, it offers an ideal base for both business and leisure travellers. We offer a 24-hour reception and information desk and 24-hour snack service.

7558.description: Holiday Inn London Bloomsbury offers a prime central London location with dining, excellent meeting facilities, and complimentary Wi Fi. Located just steps from Russell Square Tube station on the Piccadilly Line, the hotel provides quick access to major transport hubs King's Cross St. Pancras and Euston stations are both under a mile away and accessible within five minutes by bus or taxi. Heathrow Airport 'LHR' is a convenient 40 minute drive. Guests are close to popular attractions, with Oxford Street's bustling shops just a 10 minute taxi ride away, and the British Museum's world class collections only half a mile from the hotel. Leicester Square and the West End's nightlife are just an 11 minute tube ride, while family fun at London Zoo is a quick 10 minute cab ride. The hotel's Academy Conference and Training Suites are ideal for conferences, weddings, or celebrations, accommodating up to 300 guests. A dedicated host, video conferencing capabilities, and included refreshments make planning smooth and stress free. Guests can dine at the Junction Restaurant for breakfast, lunch, or dinner and unwind with a Starbucks coffee or a drink at the Junction Bar. Callaghan's Bar offers live sports viewing, a hearty pub menu, and an outdoor terrace. Plus, kids stay and eat for free.

7559.description: There's more to Hampstead than its world-famous heath. You'll find shops, bars and restaurants galore, lovely parks, and amazing views across the city skyline. And, while Hampstead has that laid-back village feel, it's all just minutes from central London. Go bargain hunting at nearby Camden Town Market. Watch wickets tumble at Lords Cricket Ground. Or catch the big match or must-see show at Wembley. Then return to some well-earned R&R - your chance to enjoy the friendliest service, tasty food, and extra-comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

7560.description: The Mayfair Townhouse, comprised of seven listed Georgian buildings, offers a discreet address in the heart of Mayfair. Steps from Green Park tube station and upscale shopping, this hotel, opened in December 2020, features 172 rooms and suites, the Dandy Bar, a private gym, and event spaces. Inspired by a whimsical past, this stylish hotel overlooks Green Park and delivers high-end service in a warm setting.

7562.description: Convenient & Comfortable Hotel Near Wembley StadiumA contemporary London hotel located steps away from the electric atmosphere of Wembley Park, with both the iconic Wembley Stadium and The SSE Arena on our doorstep. With 336 guest rooms and 7 flexible meeting and events spaces accommodating up to 700 guests, Holiday Inn London - Wembley hotel is perfect for both business and leisure guests alike. Next door you’ll find London Designer Outlet, Cineworld and the latest addition to the area, Troubadour Wembley Park Theatre. With both Wembley Park and Wembley Central Station’s a short walk away, you can be transported into central London with ease or conjure up some magic at Warner Bros. Studio Tour, the home of Harry Potter, a 40-minute drive away. As well as a fantastic location, our Wembley Stadium hotel provides all the amenities you need to ensure a relaxing and comfortable stay. Free Wi-Fi, power showers, satellite TV and a choice of pillows to ensure a great night’s sleep come as standard. Suites come with extra living space and our family rooms with sofa beds means children under 13 stay and dine for free. Breakfast and all-day dining are served in The Arch Restaurant or grab a coffee to go from our 24/7 coffee shop.

7563.description: Welcome to the a&o London Docklands Riverside, located along the River Thames with stunning views of Canary Wharf – perfect for travelers looking to make the most out of London. This former 17th century Wharf Building boasts exposed brickwork and London’s last dry dock for shipbuilding. The hotel’s complimentary ferry provides access to Canary Wharf and a connection to the Thames Clippers for an unforgettable voyage into central London. The nearby Underground station and Docklands Light Railway also offer links to the city. Your memorable stay at our Docklands hotel begins with a warm chocolate chip cookie at check-in. Guest rooms feature a flat-screen LCD TV, opening windows and tea/coffee facilities. Most guest rooms also boast city and river views. Business travelers will appreciate the laptop-sized safe, large desk and 24-hour room service. Choose a suite for a separate living area with sofa bed – perfect for families. WiFi is complimentary in all guest rooms and public areas. Discover our Columbia Restaurant, and savor seasonal produce and individual barbecues on the outdoor terrace. For private dining, visit The Library or The Snug – exceptional places to celebrate special occasions. With 9, 286 sq. ft. of event space, our Riverside hotel is ideal for your next function. Host a conference for up to 350 guests in one of 15 meeting rooms. Wedding receptions are stylish in the Millennium Suite, which opens to the terrace for spectacular London views.

7564.description: Thistle Bloomsbury Park is an Edwardian hotel, set right in the heart of the West End. A prime location in London, whether you want to do a spot of shopping on Oxford Street, visit cultural locations including St Paul’s Cathedral and the British Museum, or experience the vibrant atmosphere of Covent Garden and Soho. Plus, in close proximity to great transport links with Euston and Holborn tube stations just a short walk away. No matter if you’re here for business or a bit of fun, the 95 en-suite rooms have what you need to make your trip easy and enjoyable. There are a range of rooms to choose from, take your pick from twin to family rooms. The rooms include fast, free and unlimited Wi-Fi, a flat screen LCD TV with Freeview, tea/coffee facilities and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. Kick-start your day with some seriously tasty treats. Our breakfast is filled with modern spins on that classic British cuisine we all love. Visit our self-service counter in the reception area for a selection of alcoholic beverages, soft drinks, and snacks. Simply pick your favourites and pay at the reception—quick and easy!Please note this property does not have air conditioning, portable fans are available.

7565.description: This elegant hotel enjoys a delightful setting at the heart of London, lying between Piccadilly Circus and Leicester Square. The hotel is situated within easy access to a host of attractions in the city, as well as delightful shopping, entertainment and dining venues. Convenient links to the public transport network are available nearby. This charming hotel dates back to the early 20th century, welcoming guests into the elegant surroundings of the lobby. The guest rooms offer a haven of peace and serenity, in which to completely relax and unwind at the end of the day. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities, for the utmost in comfort and convenience.

7566.description: Children up to 18 stay free (with existing bedding) when sharing a room with a paying adult on a room-only rate. Children 12 and under enjoy complimentary breakfast from the buffet. The purpose-built Coburg Court Hotel, first opened in 1907 and later renamed the Coburg Hotel in the early 1960s, was created by D. Joseph, the architect behind several London Underground stations. Now occupying this iconic, Grade II listed Edwardian townhouse, the Hilton London Hyde Park boasts a prime location overlooking Hyde Park and Kensington Palace. Guest rooms are elegantly designed with the modern traveler in mind, blending classic style with contemporary amenities. Whether you're visiting London for shopping, sightseeing, or business, the hotel offers a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Conveniently located in Bayswater on Queensway, the hotel is adjacent to two Underground stations—Queensway and Bayswater—servicing the Central, Circle, and District lines, placing all of London's key destinations within 20 minutes. With Hyde Park right at your doorstep, enjoy a jog or a relaxing stroll. Explore nearby Kensington Palace, Serpentine Lake, and the Diana Memorial Fountain. The shopping district of Oxford Street is within easy reach, and the hotel is within walking distance of Portobello Road Market and Harrods. Enjoy relaxed dining in the hotel's Library Lounge. The bustling Bayswater district, bordered by Edgware Road, Kensington, and Notting Hill, is known for its diverse culinary scene.

7567.description:
Feel at home in Fulham, one of London’s most vibrant neighbourhoods. Located at Stamford Bridge on Fulham Road, lyf Chelsea London is ideal for city explorers, football fans, families, and business travellers. Choose from cosy double rooms or spacious family rooms for up to 2 adults and 2 children. 

Enjoy easy access to London’s top attractions, from the West End and South Kensington to Oxford Street. With excellent transport links nearby, explore the city at your own pace. From matchday excitement at Stamford Bridge to shopping and dining on King’s Road, London is right on your doorstep. 

Start your day with breakfast at 55 Bar & Dining, then relax in our vibrant bar-lounge, perfect for meeting friends, socialising, or enjoying lunch, dinner, and drinks.

7568.description: The Hilton London Angel Islington, situated in the heart of fashionable Islington in North London, offers convenient access to Kings Cross and Central London. A short walk from Angel Tube Station, the hotel is also next door to the British Design Center. The area boasts a wide selection of restaurants and bars, perfect for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel features elegantly designed rooms and suites, with upgrades to Executive Rooms and Suites providing Executive Lounge access. Following a recent renovation, the hotel offers a modern lobby, a grab-and-go facility, and the stylish Halo Bar and Restaurant, serving breakfast and an all-day menu featuring international dishes and signature cocktails. The hotel also provides a 24-hour fitness room and a small meeting space, the Angel Suite, equipped with state-of-the-art technology. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available for Hilton Honors members.

7570.description: Centrally located in London, Park Avenue Bayswater Inn Hyde Park is within a 10-minute walk of Kensington Gardens and Portobello Road Market. This hotel offers 148 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant, or take advantage of room service (limited hours). A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Hyde Park is 1 mi (1. 7 km) and Kensington Palace is 1. 3 mi (2. 1 km) away.

7571.description: This comfortable Art Deco hotel overlooks Tavistock Square Gardens, a perfect location for exploring London. Offering stunning views and remarkable value, this historic Bloomsbury hotel is a short stroll from attractions like the British Museum, Covent Garden, Theatreland, Regent's Park, Tottenham Court Road, and Oxford Street's elegant shops. Russell Square and Euston stations provide easy access to the city, and Heathrow Airport is less than 25km away. The hotel features a spacious 24-hour reception and a bar for enjoying a beverage. The contemporary rooms are classically decorated, each bright and boasting a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries.

7572.description: The Pullman London St Pancras hotel is ideally located just a few minutes' walk from three of the city's major railway stations: King's Cross, Euston and St Pancras International. Guests arriving on business will find this the perfect destination, with 17 contemporary meeting rooms capable of holding conferences and functions. The hotel is one of the city's premier upscale destinations, with a host of luxury amenities and offerings such as tranquil rain showers and more.

name.content: Doubletree By Hilton Angel Kings Cross

7573.description: The DoubleTree by Hilton London Angel Kings Cross offers convenient access to key London destinations. A short walk from Angel tube station, it's just 15 minutes from King's Cross and St. Pancras International rail stations. Explore nearby attractions like Sadler's Wells Theatre, the West End Theatre District, the British Museum, and Camden Market. This hotel features 381 newly refurbished guest rooms and suites, each equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, a 40-inch LCD TV, a spacious bathroom with complimentary toiletries, and a well-lit work desk. Guests can enjoy 24-hour room service and complimentary gym access. Upgrade to an executive room for Executive Lounge access with complimentary breakfast, drinks, and snacks, or select a suite with a separate living area. For a unique experience, try a Five Feet to Fitness room, featuring over 11 different fitness equipment and accessory options for private in-room workouts. The hotel also offers six modern meeting rooms with natural daylight and state-of-the-art AV equipment, suitable for various events. Dining options include the Marco Pierre White Steakhouse & Grill and Bar 60, specializing in London gins. Please note that some services, including the Business Center, breakfast, and room service, may have reduced availability, while the Executive Lounge, Fitness Center, and on-site restaurants are currently unavailable.

7576.description: Explore the best of London from Holiday Inn Express London – Hammersmith, a modern and comfortable hotel located in the vibrant district of Hammersmith, West London. Parking is available for £45 per day. Hammersmith tube station is just a few minutes' walk away, providing access to the District, Piccadilly, Hammersmith &City, and Circle lines, which can take you to all the major attractions in London. Heathrow Airport is a 30-minute drive away and London Euston Station is seven miles away. The Lyric Theatre and Eventim Apollo are both within walking distance, and are popular venues for live music, comedy shows and plays. Ravenscourt Park, a beautiful green space with tennis courts, a children's playground, is also nearby, providing a peaceful escape from the hustle and bustle of the city. For shopping, head to Westfield London, Knightsbridge or Oxford Street. For sports fans, Craven Cottage, the home ground of Fulham Football Club, is just a short distance away, and is a great place to catch a game. Kew Palace, a historic royal palace and gardens, is also nearby, offering a glimpse into the lives of British monarchs throughout history. Exhibitions and events at Olympia London are less than 10 minutes’ drive away. After busy days sightseeing, relax in your room with free Wi-Fi and bedside charging. Pizzas are available 24/7 if you fancy a late-night snack. Before you head out for the day, tuck into an Express Start buffet breakfast, always included.

7578.description: With a stay at Sofitel London St James in London (London City Centre), you'll be steps from Regent Street and 3 minutes by foot from Piccadilly Circus. This luxury hotel is 0. 2 mi (0. 3 km) from Trafalgar Square and 0. 2 mi (0. 4 km) from Leicester Square. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Make yourself at home in one of the 183 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. For lunch or dinner, stop by Wild Honey St James, a restaurant that specializes in French cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are served on weekdays for a fee. Featured amenities include wired internet access (surcharge), a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 6501 square feet (604 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 12 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

7580.description: The Crowne Plaza London - Ealing offers stylish accommodation in West London, with excellent transport links. Located adjacent to Hanger Lane Tube station, Central London is just a 25-minute ride away. Heathrow Airport is easily accessible by car via the nearby A40. The hotel features five meeting rooms, a business center, and a 24-hour gym. Guests can enjoy the sophisticated West 5 Brasserie and Bar, along with the convenience of room service and the Sleep Advantage® program for a restful night. Its location makes it an ideal choice for attending events at Wembley Stadium and the SSE Arena.

7602.description: Thistle Heathrow situated at Terminal 5, is the perfect choice if you need a hotel near London Heathrow Airport or before heading off on your holidays. We’ve got everything you need to make you feel at home, including a comfortable lounge and bar, 266 en-suite rooms, and 450 on-site parking spaces. Get in the holiday spirit and relax in our brand-new Aviator Sports Bar & Restaurant. Watch live Sports with an ice cold beer and a top flight burger. The Heathrow Pods next to us can take you directly from the hotel across to Terminal 5 in just 5 minutes, which run from 04:00am to 12:15 am, making your pre-flight experience a relaxed one! If you have some time to kill before jetting off, why not visit some local attractions? You can do some sightseeing around Heathrow and easily reach Wimbledon, Windsor, Ascot and the Warner Bros Harry Potter Studio Tour for a day out from Thistle Heathrow. If you require parking while you're away, contact the hotel Reservations team directly to check availability. Please be aware that this hotel does not have a lift, therefore the rooms and restaurants on the upper floors need to be accessed by the stairs.

7603.description: The Holiday Inn London - Heathrow M4, Jct. 4 offers a welcoming stay near Heathrow Airport. Our newly refurbished hotel provide comfortable spaces to sleep, dine, work, or relax. The Hotel Hoppa service facilitates quick airport transfers, and Park, Stay & Go packages are available. Central London is easily accessible via the nearby M4 or the Elizabeth Line and Heathrow Express, making day trips convenient. The hotel features 14 well-equipped meeting rooms suitable for various events, free WiFi, and a fitness center. Families will appreciate the spacious guest rooms with comfortable bedding, and kids stay and eat free. Enjoy Sky Sports at the T6 Restaurant & Bar.

7606.description: Touch down in 4-star comfort at Novotel Cairo Airport hotel, a 5-minute ride from the terminals on the free 24-hour shuttle. Relax under the palms in the courtyard, or re-energise with a dip in the pool. All-day dining means you won't fly hungry. Your mod ern soundproofed room lets you stretch out and enjoy a restful night at Novotel. Just 5 minutes from the airport and 22 KM from downtown Cairo, the 4-star Novotel Cairo Airport hotel offers a beautiful balance of convenience and comfort.

7607.description: With a stay at Conrad Cairo, you'll be centrally located in Cairo, within a 5-minute drive of Tahrir Square and Egyptian Museum. This luxury hotel is 10. 6 mi (17. 1 km) from Giza Pyramid Complex and 11 mi (17. 7 km) from Great Sphinx of Giza. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After enjoying recreational amenities such as a nightclub and a 24-hour fitness center, a lucky night at the casino is the perfect end to the day. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 614 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Rooms have private furnished balconies. Satellite programming and MP3 docking stations are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and designer toiletries. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at Solana Restaurant, one of the hotel's 7 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 4 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and limo/town car service.

7608.address: Ring Road, Mirage City Cairo, Egypt
7608.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. When the sun is out, a round of golf or a day at the private beach are two great options for taking advantage of the fine weather. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. If you'd like to spend the day shopping, you can hop on the complimentary shuttle. Enjoy international cuisine at Mirage Cafe, one of the hotel's 11 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 3 coffee shops/cafes. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge, the beach bar, or the poolside bar. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out.

7650.address: Casablanca Street, Po Box 30880 Dubai Airport
7650.description: Situated on Casablanca Road in Al Garhoud, this hotel offers convenient access to Dubai International Airport (5 minutes) and the Dubai Creek Golf and Yacht Club. A variety of dining options await, with award-winning chefs preparing Thai, Italian, and Lebanese cuisine. Guests can enjoy the nightclub, café, and bar, as well as excellent conference facilities. Spacious rooms and suites each include an en suite bathroom and are well-equipped for a comfortable stay. Recreational amenities include a swimming pool, paddling pool, hot tub, gym, tennis courts, and golf and squash facilities. On-site parking is also available.

name.content: Le Meridien Dubai Hotel & Conference Centre

7651.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 5 outdoor swimming pools, a health club, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. The complimentary beach shuttle makes getting to the surf and sand a breeze. Enjoy international cuisine at Yalumba, one of the hotel's 18 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wind down with a drink at one of the 3 bars/lounges or 4 poolside bars. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 16272 square feet (1512 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 24 meeting rooms.

7652.address: Al Sufouh Road, Po Box 53567, Beach - Jumeirah
7652.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can soak up the sun at the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the complimentary area shuttle. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Palm Garden Restaurant &, a restaurant which specializes in international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.

name.content: The Apartments Dubai World Trade Centre

7654.address: Sheikh Zayed Road, Trade Centre 2, P.O. Box 9229
7654.description: The Apartments Dubai World Trade Centre, a landmark of tradition, is ideally situated at the beginning of Sheikh Zayed Road's skyscraper corridor. Located within the Dubai World Trade Centre complex, adjacent to the Dubai International Convention and Exhibition Centre, its welcoming atmosphere and professional service will let you make the most of your visit to Dubai, whether for business or leisure. Ideally situated next to the World Trade Centre metro station, providing convenient connections to Dubai's most popular shopping malls and tourist attractions. Just steps away from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) and only a few minutes' drive from the world-famous Burj Khalifa Downtown district, with spectacular sights such as the world's tallest tower, largest mall, and biggest dancing fountain, we offer marvelous opportunities to explore Dubai.

7655.description: Located in Deira, Dubai, on Abu Hail Road near the Galadari roundabout, this palatial hotel offers 192 contemporary rooms and a variety of dining and entertainment options. Guests can enjoy diverse cuisines at the cricketer sports bar, Sam's café, Atrium garden club, Blues and Cues pool bar, Al Khan nightclub, Tamasha (Indian), Silla (Korean), and Pathumuri (South Indian) restaurants. The hotel also boasts the Voodoo nightclub and modern conference facilities. Rooms are air-conditioned and include a bathroom, while suites offer additional comforts. Guests have access to a well-equipped gym. Dubai International Airport is a short 10-minute drive away.

7656.description:
Situated on Jumeirah Beach Road, overlooking the beach and the iconic Burj Al Arab Jumeirah, this 5-star luxury Dubai hotel offers a private beach, over 19 restaurants, cafes, and bars, six pools, and a climbing wall. Guests enjoy free unlimited access to the on-site Wild Wadi Waterpark. Spacious rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Arabian Gulf and free WiFi. A wide variety of international cuisine is available, including Lebanese, Argentinian, and Italian options, with many restaurants offering children's menus. Facilities include tennis courts, a PADI-certified dive center, a state-of-the-art gym, aerobics classes, and a full-service spa. Sinbad's Kids Club provides a daily activity program. A complimentary shuttle service operates to Wild Wadi Waterpark, Madinat Jumeirah, Burj Khalifa/Dubai Downtown, and DIFC. Mall of the Emirates is a 10-minute drive away, and Souk Madinat Jumeirah is a 10-minute stroll. Dubai International Airport is 20 km from the hotel. All rooms are non-smoking; smoking is permitted on balconies and in designated areas. 
Please note planned enhancements to be completed by mid -October 2026 :
• Kitchen Connection will feature updated interiors, an improved terrace, and a newly repositioned bar to provide a seamless dining experience. 
• The Club Lounge will be upgraded with contemporary design and refined dining and social spaces for adults and children alike . 
In addition, Wild Wadi Waterpark will remain closed until further notice, and Nuska Beach will undergo its annual summer elevation program from 01 June until 15 September 2026.

7657.address: City Centre, Po Box 72127 Sheikh Zayed Road
7657.description: The Jumeirah Emirates Towers Dubai is ideally situated on Sheikh Zayed Road, between the Dubai International Financial Centre and the Dubai Convention Centre. It's a short five-minute drive to the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Downtown area, and just a two-minute walk from the Emirates Towers Metro Station. Dubai International Airport is conveniently located 10km away. This hotel seamlessly blends high-tech efficiency with unparalleled luxury, redefining the business travel experience. Guests also enjoy access to The Boulevard, a prestigious shopping destination with world-class dining and nightlife. The hotel's 400 spacious, newly furnished rooms and suites, combined with state-of-the-art meeting and business facilities, make it a popular choice for corporate travellers and one of the finest business hotels in Dubai.

7658.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a health club, outdoor pool, and sauna. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall. Dine at The Boston Bar, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the daily complimentary reception. Unwind at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel provides express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Roundtrip airport shuttle service is available (surcharge applies). The 125 guest rooms feature minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, and bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and bidets. Safes, desks, and phones are also provided. Nearby attractions include Al Hana Shopping Centre (0. 5 mi), Jumeirah Mosque (1 mi), and Dubai World Trade Centre (1. 9 mi). The nearest airport is Dubai International Airport (DXB), 6. 7 mi away.

7659.address: Sheikh Zayed Road P O Box 30430
7659.description: Located on Dubai's prominent Sheikh Zayed Road, this 4-star hotel offers stunning views of the Arabian Sea and easy access to major attractions. Minutes from Dubai International Financial Centre and Dubai Mall, it's also a short drive from Burj Khalifa, Jumeirah Beach, and Dubai International Airport. The hotel features award-winning dining options, including an all-day dining restaurant, a luxurious lobby lounge, a relaxing pool bar and the longest bar in the Middle East. Business travelers will appreciate the contemporary facilities and four modern meeting rooms. For recreation, guests can enjoy the top-floor outdoor pool, sun terrace, fitness center, steam room, sauna, and jacuzzi overlooking Jumeirah Beach.

7660.description: Located in Dubai (Umm Suqeim), Jumeirah Burj Al Arab Dubai is a 3-minute walk from Wild Wadi Water Park and 10 minutes by foot from Souk Madinat Jumeirah. This luxury hotel is 2. 6 mi (4. 1 km) from Mall of the Emirates and 9. 5 mi (15. 3 km) from Dubai Mall. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. After making a splash in one of the 2 indoor and 2 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can get to nearby shops on the shuttle (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 198 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and microwaves. Your bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Computers and complimentary wireless internet access are provided, along with plasma televisions. Bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature jetted bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Enjoy international cuisine at Gilt, one of the hotel's 8 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.

7661.address: Riyadh Street, Sheikh Rashid Road, Dubai
7661.description: Grand Hyatt Dubai offers a unique 5-star city resort experience in the heart of Dubai, where guests can enjoy an unbeatable mix of luxury, adventure, and relaxation whilst having the city’s major attractions at its doorstep. Blending family-friendly facilities with authentic Arabian charm, this iconic, 37-acre property, with lush, landscaped gardens, offers a peaceful oasis in the global metropolis of Dubai. The hotel features 710 spacious and beautifully designed rooms and suites, 12 fantastic dining options, 2 outdoor temperature-controlled swimming pools, an indoor lap pool, and a state-of-the art indoor playground. Make the most of your stay with plenty of activities and facilities available for the whole family. Unwind in the tranquil gardens, where a leisurely stroll or a quiet moment of reflection awaits, or enter our 24/7 fitness center and get lost in the world of fitness. Grand Hyatt Dubai is extending and elevating its guest experience with the Grand Hyatt Dubai Waterpark opening in 2025, featuring 20’000 m2 of fun-filled waterslides, the city’s largest urban beach and wavepool and a lush crazy river going through the entire park. The facility will position Grand Hyatt Dubai as the world’s most unique urban resort and provide guest a holiday experience in the heart of Dubai like no other. Whether you're looking for excitement, top notch dining, or just a peaceful break, this unique urban city resort will make you feel right at home, creating the perfect family getaway for creating special memories.

7662.description: This appealing hotel is situated on Shomali Street in Frij Murar, around 5 km away from the centre of Dubai. Guests will reach Goldsouk commercial quarter in a number of minutes. The city's congress centre and exhibition halls are around a 15-minute drive from the hotel and the airport is a 10-minute drive. This modern hotel comprises 120 rooms. The hotel welcomes guests in a lobby with a 24-hour reception, hotel safe, 3 lifts, a cloakroom and a currency exchange counter. Guests may enjoy the cuisine at the café and Milano restaurant. Additionally a car park is available for those arriving by car. The functional rooms come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a minibar, Internet access, air conditioning, ironing facilities, a double bed as well as a hire safe. There is a swimming pool and a sun terrace on offer to guests and sports enthusiasts may make use of the in-house gym.

7668.description: The Occidental Atenea Mar, an adults-only hotel, enjoys a prime beachfront location beside Barcelona's International Convention Centre (CCIB), the zoo, and the Diagonal Mar shopping centre with over 150 shops. This modern hotel offers easy access to various city attractions, with the metro station a mere 10 minutes away and the international airport only 20 minutes away. Ideal for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel sits just 150 meters from Nova Mar Bella beach and a short walk from the CCIB and Diagonal Mar. A bus stop is conveniently located opposite the hotel, while a nearby metro station connects guests to the city's main attractions. The hotel's 191 spacious, modern rooms are all outward-facing and bright, offering views of either the sea or the city. Each room features complimentary Wi-Fi and luxurious amenities. Additional services include paid parking, a free fitness studio, a sauna, and free Wi-Fi throughout the property.

7681.address: Avenue Du Marechal De Lattre De Tassigny, 40
7681.description: This hotel is located in the mesmerising city of Paris, lying just a short distance away from Velizy, Clamart and Orsay. The harbours of Saint Cloud and Versailles are situated just a 10 minutes' walking distance away. Links to the public transport network are to be found within easy access of this hotel. Paris Orly Airport lies a mere 4 km away from this hotel. This wonderful hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, oozing character and charm. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy an energetic workout at this hotel, followed by a refreshing swim in the pool.

7740.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. 7811.description: This welcoming hotel is situated in Ponte de Lima's leisure area, just 2km from the town center and 50km from the airport. Public transport is conveniently located 500 meters away. Relaxing communal spaces are also available within the hotel.

7839.description: Nudging the Spanish border and situated within Portugal’s only National Park, Peneda-Gerês, Hotel Universal features an internal courtyard with hanging gardens. It also offers an outdoor pool. Hotel Universal’s bright rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and a private bathroom with bathtub. Each is air conditioned and includes a satellite TV and a radio. Guests can play tennis at the hotel’s outdoor court or swim in the pool on the grounds surrounding the hotel. The poolside deck with plenty of lounge chairs is a nice place to soak up the sun. Universal serves a daily breakfast buffet. Traditional food from Portugal’s Norte Region is offered at the restaurant, while the Jardim Bar offers lunch snacks and a fine selection of local wines. The Albufeira Da Caniçada Reservoir is just 3 miles away and the hotel provides a mountain shuttle service.

It has 4 different restaurants & Bars where you will find a great variety of national and international food and drinks, a snack bar at the main pool, a lobby bar and a pizzeria-bar. 7856.description:
Tribu Malasaña is an elegant accommodation located in the heart of Madrid, in the vibrant neighborhood of Malasaña, one of the city’s most iconic and characterful areas. Perfect for both leisure and business travelers, Tribu Malasaña offers a unique experience combining design, comfort, and a prime location. Its modern rooms and apartments are carefully decorated to create a cozy, functional, and relaxing atmosphere, equipped with all the amenities needed to guarantee an unforgettable stay. 

Surrounded by restaurants, shops, theaters, terraces, and cultural life, Tribu Malasaña is the ideal choice for those looking to stay in central Madrid and experience the authentic essence of the city in a modern, dynamic, and charming environment.

7864.description: The new 5-star SANA EPIC MARQUÊS is located on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, between the lush green of Parque Eduardo VII and the impressive Marquês de Pombal Square, close to the city's most vibrant avenues, luxury stores and shopping centers. At the top of the building, the Sky Pool Lounge for guests only, offers a heated infinity poolwith a panoramic view over downtown Lisbon and the Tagus River. The bar serves signature, special or classic cocktails and there is also a menu of delicious snacks. Suites and rooms are elegant, spacious and with a contemporary design, offering a luxuryexperience in an atmosphere of extraordinary quality and comfort. They all have privatebathrooms, with a bathtub and shower. Suites include a living room with a workstation. Somerooms offer exceptional views. Facilities include LCD TV with cable channels, free WI-FI, minibar, and luxury and well-being amenities by Aromatherapy Associates. In the morning, you can enjoy a splendid breakfast in your room or in The Garden buffetrestaurant. The KOJI Bar and Restaurant is located on the 12th floor of the hotel and offers superb cityviews and a relaxed atmosphere. With 700 m2, includes 3private treatment rooms, 1 double spa suite, with its own jacuzzi and Turkish bath; 1 wet areawith sauna and sensorial showers. It also has a gym.

7865.description: Located next to the business center of Lisbon and 5 minutes away from the El Corte Inglés Shopping Centre, the SANA Malhoa Hotel is perfect for both leisure and business travelers. 7873.description: This boutique hotel is situated in a peaceful road alongside the cosmopolitan Avenida da Liberdade, a genuine Art Deco boutique hotel in the historic centre of Lisbon. 7907.description: Located next to Arrábida Bridge in Vila Nova de Gaia, the Mercure Porto Gaia Hotel is ideal for exploring the city and the famous Port Wine Cellars!
