Savor delicious meals at our restaurant or grab a quick bite at the snack bar/deli. Unwind with your favorite drink at our bar/lounge or beach bar. For your convenience, we offer dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Airport shuttle service is available for a surcharge. Our 195 guestrooms feature refrigerators, LCD televisions, private balconies, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. The private bathrooms are equipped with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. We're located just a short stroll from Kleopatra Beach (0. 3 mi), close to Alanya Lunapark (0. 5 mi) and other local attractions.

8071.address: Alara Turizm Merkezi Okurcalar Kasabası, S/N
8071.description: Nestled within fabulous gardens atop a picturesque cliff overlooking the sea in Karaburun, this hotel offers convenient access to both a beautiful sand and pebble beach and the vibrant center of Incekum. Just a short walk from the beach, and a 9km journey from Incekum's diverse shops, restaurants, bars, nightclubs, and boutiques, the hotel also boasts easy access to Alanya (35km) and Side (40km). Antalya Airport is approximately a 2-hour transfer (90km), with excellent bus links and a stop directly outside the hotel. Renovated in 2005, this hotel complex comprises 291 accommodation units spread across several two and three-story buildings. Guests enjoy a wide array of amenities, including a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, newspaper stand, mini-market, shops, hairdresser, game room, TV room, and lounge. Dining options include a Turkish café, several bars, a buffet restaurant, and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with a non-smoking area and highchairs. Children can enjoy the playground and kids' club (ages 4-12), while additional entertainment is provided by a small theater and open-air nightclub. Laundry services, medical assistance, bicycle hire, and public internet access (fees apply) are also available, along with on-site parking. The tastefully decorated rooms feature en suite bathrooms with hairdryers, king-sized beds, balconies, direct dial telephones, satellite TV, minibars, safes, and individually controlled air conditioning.

8072.description: This charming beach hotel enjoys a stunning setting in Alanya. The hotel is located a mere 50 metres away from the stunning Keykubat Beach and is a mere 800 metres from he heart of Alanya. Guests will appreciate the enviable setting which offers all the peace and serenity of an indulgent beach holiday yet is within easy access of the town for guests who are seeking a more lively experience. The hotel enjoys an attractive architectural style, exuding a sense of calm and tranquility with its crisp-white exterior. The interior of the hotel enjoys a refined elegance, and guests will experience warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, offering a welcoming escape away from the bustle of daily life. Guests will appreciate the hotel's excellent facilities which have been designed to cater to the needs of each individual visitor.

8074.address: Belek Mah. Kongre Cad. No:122/1 Serik/Antalya
8074.description: This luxurious beach resort boasts an enviable location in Belek. The complex is located directly beside a sand and shingle beach, affording guests the opportunity to enjoy a refreshing swim, leisurely strolls or to simply lie back and relish the stunning beauty of the surroundings from the azure blue sea to the golden sands of the beach. The vibrant heart of Belek lies just 4 kms away from the hotel, where guests can immerse themselves in the rich cultural heritage of the area. This exclusive hotel will leave guests breathless with the stunning architectural style which allures them into the elegant surroundings of the lobby. The lobby enjoys a sleek, attractive style with high ceilings giving the impression of expansive space. The guest rooms are luxuriously appointed, featuring rich Turkish influences in elements of the design.

8075.description: The hotel has a convenient location very close to Cleopatra Beach, and within easy reach of to the city centre via public transportation. Guests can shop at Alanya Shopping district, explore Alanya's nightlife with an array of pubs, nightclubs and bars. The hotel is close to all major tourist attractions and landmarks, which include Alanya Castle, Alanya Dockyard and Arsenal, the Red Tower, Alanya Archaeological Museum and Damlatas Cave.

8077.address: Tekirova, Şht. Er Hasan Yılmaz Cd. No:16, 07995, S/N
8077.description:
Whether you want to unwind and relax or stay active, it’s the ideal place for both. 
An international cuisine that will excite your taste buds, water slides that will bring out your inner child, and a sports center that will reveal your inner champion await you. 
Enjoy a delightful dinner at one of the four themed restaurants and end the night with vibrant entertainment.

8078.address: Guzeloba Mh. Yasar Sobutay Blv. Muratpasa, Lara, 34
8078.description: This exclusive beach hotel is perfectly situated in the stunning Turkish resort area of Antalya Lara, right next to the renowned Lara Beach and just 11 km from Antalya's center. It offers an idyllic setting for travelers seeking relaxation away from the hustle of daily life, yet close to the entertainment. This magnificent hotel welcomes guests to a world of refined elegance blended with Turkish luxury. The sumptuously designed rooms provide a haven of luxury and style for restful slumber. A seemingly boundless array of first-class facilities caters to every guest's needs. A la carte restaurants are available for a fee of €20 per person, with Italian, Mexican, Seafood & Fish, and Turkish cuisine options.

8089.description: The conference-oriented Hotel Barcelona Princess stands out as one of the most emblematic buildings in Barcelona, its contemporary, avant-garde design making a significant contribution to the architectural grandeur of the city. The top events hotel in Barcelona, Hotel Barcelona Princess, is located at number 1. Avinguda Diagonal, opposite the Barcelona International Convention Centre, the Parc del Fòrum, Port Fòrum, and Barcelona beach, next to the Diagonal Shopping Centre. Our exclusive 4-star business hotel in Barcelona features 363 fully-equipped rooms, function and meeting rooms for all kinds of events, a pool/solarium on the 23rd floor with stunning sea views from 85 metres above sea level, and an infinity pool on the 3rd floor. It is also home to the Dagma Restaurant and terrace as well as a solarium, gymnasium and sauna.

8148.address: Meltem Mh. 100 Yil Blv Sakıp Sabancı Blv No: 12
8148.description: Situated opposite Atatürk Culture Park, Glass Pyramid Congress & Exhibition Center, and Antalya Tennis Club, our hotel offers a prime city-center location. Konyaaltı Beach, Antalya Archeological Museum, and other attractions are within walking distance. Enjoy our semi-Olympic pool, six clay tennis courts, fitness center, and lush garden. This modern, family-friendly hotel is just five minutes from Antalya's city center, ideal for a relaxing beach holiday. Our 100 spacious, air-conditioned rooms provide comfort, while our fully equipped conference center and theater can host up to 250 guests. Restaurants, shops, and entertainment venues are nearby, including the city's largest shopping center. A complimentary shuttle whisks you to Konyaaltı Beach, where you can relax on sun loungers and take in stunning mountain views. Explore the historic old town, home to the 14th-century Yivli Minare Mosque. Whether for business or leisure, our hotel offers a perfect Antalya experience.

8152.description: Perfectly situated on the soft, white sand beaches of Cancún, this exclusive beach resort provides the perfect accommodations for your vacation getaway. Paradisus Cancún offers guests a chance to experience the stunning beauty of this international destination from the comfort of a luxury resort, upholding the highest standards of excellence. This commitment to quality has earned Paradisus Cancún Four Diamond honors from AAA since 2006. Luxurious, spacious, and elegantly decorated rooms await on a pristine beach just 15 minutes from the airport. Whether relaxing on the beach, by one of the four lagoon-inspired pools, or dining in one of the nine on-site restaurants, guest satisfaction is the hotel's ultimate goal. Elevate your experience with The Reserve, offering exclusive upgraded services for adults, including skilled concierge service, private areas, and a comprehensive list of enhanced amenities. Rejuvenate at the YHI Spa with authentic wellness activities and treatments, or embrace romance with one of six meticulously designed Romance by Paradisus packages, crafted to fulfill every dream. Have fun playing one of the trendiest sports in one of the four courts, with all the equipments included.

8190.description: This city hotel is situated in the tourist area of Chinchon. The hotel lies close to the centre of the town. Aranjuez is located just a 20 minutes' driving distance away. Warner Bros theme park and the bustling city of Madrid can be found 35 km away. Links to the public transport network are just a short distance away from the hotel. This modern hotel extends a warm, friendly welcome to guests upon arrival. The elegant guest rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. The hotel features a number of excellent facilities, including a relaxing courtyard, a conference room and a cafe. The hotel's 24-hour reception offers visitors the utmost in comfort and convenience.

8202.description: This hostel is located in the centre of Lisbon, only 10 minutes from downtown Lisbon and Parque das Nações. Nearby places of interest include the famous bullfighting arena of Campo Pequeno, the city zoo, and historic sites like Jerónimos Monastery and Belém Tower. There is a metro station close to the hostel, providing easy access to all of Lisbon, including the historical centre, Bairro Alto, St. George Castle, and Lisbon's beautiful shopping centres.

8203.description: The hotel is located close to Parque Eduardo VII, in a quiet quarter at the very heart of Lisbon. Many shopping venues, bars, nightclubs and restaurants are to be found in the vicinity and links to the public transport network can easily be reached on foot. Lisbon Airport is within a short drive. The hotel offers 147 rooms with a combination of classic and contemporary style. Each room comes with air-conditioning, TV, minibar and bathroom with bath amenities as standard. Guests can enjoy a great time at the onsite restaurant with traditional Portuguese cuisine or at the Real Sports Bar with a more informal ambiance and a variety of snacks and craft beers. For a moment of relaxation, the hotel features a gym and welness facilities including sauna, jacuzzi and steam room.

8211.description: The Hotel Ciudad de Alcala is a pleasant walk from the center of charming Alcalá de Henares. It offers free Wi-Fi and private parking (for a fee). The short route into Alcalá’s historic center takes you past the nearby Parque O’Donell, a lovely green space near the old city walls. Explore the ancient university, one of the oldest in Europe, and the monuments dedicated to Cervantes, including the museum in his former house. The nearby train station offers easy access to Madrid and Alcalá de Henares’s new leisure and business center. The hotel features bright, air-conditioned rooms with modern or classic décor.

8222.description: Situated in the resort of Caldas do Gerês, this hotel is surrounded by a nature protection reserve that covers some 70, 000 hectares. The surrounding scenery is characterised by lakes and mountains. The next public transport stop is 50 m away and the nearest beach is some 65 km from the hotel. Opened in 2002, this modern hotel comprises a total of 51 rooms and 2 suites spread over 4 floors. Facilities include a hairdressing salon, a bar, an air-conditioned restaurant as well as a public Internet terminal (for an additional fee). Those arriving by car may take advantage of the car park or garage facilities. Room and laundry services round off the facilities on offer. The welcoming rooms come with a bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, air conditioning and an Internet connection. There is a swimming pool in the outdoor complex and a tennis court is also available. The nearest golf course is 65 km away. Guests may select their breakfast from a buffet.

8242.description: Surrounded by white sand and crystal-clear Caribbean waters, InterContinental Presidente Cancun Resort is a five-star luxury resort located on the best beach in Cancun. Enjoy breathtaking views of the water, five dining and beverage venues, a kid’s club for children, and convenient location close to Cancun’s vibrant nightlife. Unwind with a spa treatment, or simply relax in your room and enjoy the tranquility of the calming sea.

8266.description: This hotel is located halfway between the centre of the city and the airport. The modern architecture and décor reflect the hotel's contemporary comforts and facilities. The Metro station Suanzes is a few short steps from the hotel and, in the vicinity, there is a plethora of shops, restaurants, bars, and nightclubs. It takes just 10 minutes by car to Barajas Airport. This is the perfect business hotel close to the Palacio de Congresos de Madrid and close to the most attractive touristic and business areas of the Spanish capital.

8271.description: This superb city hotel is situated near the town of Setubal in Portugal. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the town's variety of attractions, entertainment venues and shopping opportunities. The beach is located just 5 kms away and the nearest public transport stop is just 1 km from the hotel, offering guests ease of access to other areas and attractions. Guests will find a golf course just 15 kms away. This modern hotel welcomes guests with an air of peace and serenity, warm hospitality and elegant surroundings. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, featuring luxurious furnishings and soothing tones. The rooms offer a welcoming escape from the bustle and routine of daily life.

8272.description: Offering a convenient location in the heart of the Eixample district, just a few minutes from the popular Plaza Cataluña square, this modern urban hotel is the perfect base from which to explore all this vibrant city has to offer. Barcelona-El Prat airport is some 11 kilometres away and the Barceloneta beach is a short driving distance away. The spacious guest rooms have been designed with travellers' comfort in mind and provide a choice of modern conveniences for guests to feel right at home. Business travellers may appreciate the Wi-Fi internet connection available in all the accommodation units. As for the onsite facilities, this establishment provides a cosy café-bar where to share moments with the family or friends, parking and meeting rooms ideal for banquets or conferences.

8301.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Hotel Posada Del Mar, a beachfront hotel in Isla Mujeres (Centro - Supmza 001), just a short walk from North Beach and a 7-minute drive from Garrafon Natural Reef Park. Indulge in massages, body treatments, and facials at the full-service spa. The hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and tour/ticket assistance. Savor a meal at the on-site restaurant, grab a snack at the deli, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Continental breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The 99 air-conditioned guest rooms feature minibars, private balconies, and cable TV. Bathrooms include showers and complimentary toiletries. Free self-parking is available. Cancun International Airport (CUN) is approximately 21 miles from the hotel.

8306.description: Located in Barcelona's prestigious Golden Square, this hotel offers guests a prime location just a 3-minute walk from Paseo de Gracia's luxury boutiques. Its 55 spacious, naturally lit rooms feature amenities such as air conditioning, LCD TVs, safes, minibars, high-speed Wi-Fi, hair dryers, and laundry service. The hotel also boasts meeting rooms for up to 120 people, private parking, a bar, and a newly renovated, light-filled restaurant serving a breakfast buffet and open for continuous dining from 1 p. m. to 11 p. m. , with a skilled chef ready to assist discerning palates.

8325.description: This outstanding property is situated in Lisbon’s downtown area, just a few steps from Marques de Pombal square and Eduardo VII park. The airport is to be found just a 15-minute driving distance away, whilst guests can take advantage of the extensive public transport network. Families travelling with children will appreciate its prime situation close to the zoo, and art enthusiasts will find the Basilica da Estrela church in the surrounding area. The comfortable and spacious rooms have been elegantly designed and include complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection. Ideal for those travelling on business, this hotel includes 4 meeting rooms equipped with the latest technology to guarantee the success of any event, as well as a restaurant and bar where to share nice moments with friends.

8326.description: This exclusive aparthotel is strategically located in Lisbon's historical centre, in the popular Restauradores Square, close to some of the most important tourist attractions of the area. Lisbon Airport is 8 km from the hotel. This building was fully renovated to the last detail and to the modern standards that travellers demand. It is very appreciated by the quality of its equipment and architecture, as well as its location. This luxurious aparthotel provides a choice of studios and apartments including separate work areas and wide range of services to guarantee both a comfortable and productive stay. Guests can also enjoy a dip in the swimming pool and share nice moments with friends in the terrace bar, featuring one of the best panoramic views over Lisbon.

8352.description: Nestled on a golden sandy beach in Side, this hotel offers a tranquil escape just a short stroll from the town's vibrant center with its array of restaurants, bars, shops, and historical sites. Set within lush gardens, the hotel features a large swimming pool, a relaxing spa center, and diverse dining options. Guests can savor buffet-style meals at the main restaurant, featuring indoor and outdoor seating and themed nights, or indulge in à la carte experiences at the Italian, international, and seafood restaurants. A lobby bar and beach bar provide refreshing drinks. The 250 contemporary rooms, including swim-up rooms and penthouse suites, are designed for comfort and relaxation, promising an unforgettable holiday experience complemented by traditional Barut hospitality.

name.content: Nílu Cancún Zona Hotelera by Selina

8362.description:
Nílu Hotel Zone is a place to reconnect, get inspired, and experience the best of Cancun. This isn’t just a place to stay—it’s a space designed to give you the full experience. Start your day with intention and energy on our wellness deck overlooking the Nichupté Lagoon, keep your creativity flowing in our CoWork, or relax in the outdoor pool. Take a stroll through our tropical garden or savor local and international flavors at our restaurant. 

Nílu Hotel Zone is a meeting point for curious, creative, and free-spirited travelers. A space where inspiration, joy, and conscious living come together.

8367.description: Nestled in the picturesque Tras-os-Montes region, an hour from Porto and 15 minutes from Chaves, the iconic Vidago Palace Hotel graces a magnificent woodland park in the Douro Valley. Its spectacular setting makes it a truly remarkable destination. Considered one of Portugal's most celebrated historic luxury hotels, the Vidago Palace offers an impressive yet intimate experience, blending palatial grandeur with the warmth of a country estate. Surrounded by mountains and 100 acres of woodland, the hotel is an oasis of tranquility, ideal for a relaxing getaway. Fresh country air, a magnificent park, and ornately decorated halls enhance the experience. The hotel's 70 rooms and suites, complemented by a professional golf course, a modern spa, and 5-star amenities, promise a unique stay for even the most discerning guest. *Cots available upon request (double superior rooms only).

8376.description: Nestled in the heart of the Douro Valley's UNESCO World Heritage-listed wine region, the Vintage House Hotel sits on the banks of the Douro River. From your private balcony, soak in the breathtaking views of the river and surrounding landscape. Enjoy lunch on the restaurant's esplanade, savoring the scenery. After dinner at the award-winning Rabelo Restaurant, unwind with a glass of port wine in the Library Bar. All rooms feature air conditioning, private telephones, hair dryers, LCD televisions, and complimentary safe deposit boxes. Please note that the restaurant is popular; reservations are recommended. Special requests are subject to availability and may incur additional charges. The outdoor swimming pool is open from April 1st to October 31st. Pets are not allowed.

8382.description: The 3-star Plaza Caribe Cancun Hotel, conveniently located in Cancun's city center, offers a comfortable stay for both business and leisure travelers. Our 134 rooms range from simple accommodations for overnight stays to luxurious suites equipped with premium amenities. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a year-round outdoor pool, and an à la carte Mexican restaurant. The hotel's prime location provides easy access to public transportation, shops, restaurants, and pharmacies. Nearby beaches are just a 15-minute bus ride away, and popular destinations like Playa del Carmen and Puerto Juarez (ferry to Isla Mujeres) are easily accessible. We're situated directly across from the ADO bus terminal and only 30 minutes from the airport.

8384.description: Situated on a pristine 22. 5 km stretch of beachfront in Cancun's hotel zone, NYX Hotel Cancun offers an infinity pool overlooking the Caribbean Sea. Some rooms boast views of the sea or Nichupté Lagoon. The surrounding beaches are popular for water sports, including scuba diving at two nearby coral reefs. Guests can also explore ancient Mayan sites located a short distance from the hotel. Cancun Airport is a convenient 20-minute drive away. The new restaurant, Tacos Villanos, offers a wide variety of tacos and specialty cocktails, though it is not included in the all-inclusive package. Guests of the hotel, however, receive a special discount.

name.content: Mia Reef Isla Mujeres All Inclusive Resort

8385.description: Nestled in Quintana Roo, surrounded by the most beautiful beach in Mexico and one of the best in the World - Award TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice Awards 2017 - and in an exclusive private island, with stunning soft white sand beaches and turquoise, lies MIA REEF ISLA MUJERES where you can live unique views, exquisite cuisine and activities for the most discerning traveler. MIA Reef Isla Mujeres offers an all-inclusive ecologically responsible concept where you can swim in an open ocean aquarium gracefully molded on its reef, or simply walk on the soft white sands while an endless sunset you are seduces you. The hotel design combines the most avant-garde trends of modern Mexican art. Its spaces offer a minimalistic influence along with large open corridors allowing natural light to fashion a perfect atmosphere to escapefrom everyday hectic life in an awe of absolute tranquility.

8387.description: Situated on a stretch of white-sand beachfront offering breathtaking views of the unbelievably blue Caribbean, Krystal Grand Cancun invites friends, families, and couples to a vibrant getaway. Krystal Grand Cancun is located near bustling Cancun and a mere 25 minutes from Cancun International Airport. Guests are treated to with Luxury where every meal or snack at six dining options and each delicious cocktail poured at five bars and lounges is includedwithout any required reservations. Adults-only and kid-friendly pool options cater to the needs of any and all travelerswhile endless activities provide perfect entertainment.

8388.address: Caminho Padre Manuel de SA¡ Pereira S/N, S/N
8388.description:
Located in the north of Portugal, this comfortable hotel is surrounded by aromatic pines and is situated just 40 km from the town of Porto. Ofir Beach that lies beside the Atlantic Ocean is a mere 250 m away and it is about 100 m to the nearest links to the public transport network.

Lying close to the River Cávado, this beachside hotel is surrounded by 9,900 m² of sprawling gardens and comprises 4 floors with a total of 36 rooms. Facilities on offer include a bar and a restaurant as well as a car park and garage facilities.

Each of the pleasant rooms comes with an en suite bathroom, heating, a direct dial telephone and a balcony.

In the outdoor complex are two swimming pools, a sun terrace and a poolside snack bar. Sports enthusiasts may make use of the tennis court and golfers may enjoy a round of golf on the course that lies some 8 km from the hotel.

8390.description: The PraiaGolfe Hotel enjoys a prime location in the vibrant city of Espinho, directly facing Baía Beach and the seafront promenade. Situated next to the Casino, renowned for its international shows, and surrounded by Porto's finest golf courses, the hotel offers an ideal base for leisure and entertainment. This non-smoking hotel features 133 comfortably furnished rooms across eight floors, some of which have been recently refurbished. Guests can enjoy the hotel's three meeting rooms and two panoramic restaurants, all bathed in natural light and capable of hosting events from 10 to 400 people. Espinho, part of the Porto metropolitan area, is just 15 minutes from the historic city of Porto, a designated World Heritage site, and easily accessible via the A1 freeway.

8410.description: Enjoying a prime location in the first line of Cancun's beach, one of the most famous tourist destinations of the world, this charming hotel welcomes all types of guests, from single travellers to families. The property is a short drive away from the city centre, where visitors can find numerous shops, restaurants and other entertainment venues. The city is also well-known for its vibrant nightlife which offers a wide range of bars and night clubs. The rooms are nicely decorated in Mexican style and feature comfortable amenities to make guests feel at home. The on-site restaurant offers a wide range of local and international cuisine that will satisfy all palates. During the day, travellers may choose between enjoying a relaxing time at the private beach or take a dip into the swimming pool. The large terrace, equipped with sun loungers, offers a stunning view over the ocean.

8415.description: This popular city hotel enjoys a prime setting on the Rio Ave waterside in Vila Do Conde. The centre of the town is located just 4 kms away, where guests will find themselves immersed in the rich cultural heritage of the historical surroundings. Within 2 kms of the hotel guests will find an abundance of shopping facilities, bars, restaurants and entertainment venues, while the pristine beach lies just 1 km from the hotel tempting guests with the promise of dreamy relaxation. The hotel boasts an attractive architectural style, alluring guests into the stunning interior. The hotel lobby enjoys a stunning contemporary style, harmoniously fused with traditional elements that reflect the culture of the surroundings. The guest rooms are sumptuously appointed, offering a haven of relaxation and serenity. The hotel affords guests a seemingly endless array of first-class facilities.

name.content: GRANDE HOTEL PARIS by STAY HOTELS

8427.description: A true treasure located in the historic city centre of Porto. With 78 rooms, the Grande Hotel Paris by Stay Hotels combines the elegance of the Belle Époque style with the culture of the undefeated city, in an atmosphere full of history and personality. Inaugurated in 1877, it is considered the oldest hotel in the city of Porto and hosted great personalities of Portuguese culture of the 19th century, such as Camilo Castelo Branco, Eça de Queirós, Guerra Junqueiro and Rafael Bordalo Pinheiro. The historical relevance of the building in the city of Porto is evident in every detail. The Art Nouveau-inspired entrance and exquisite decor are just some of the elements that transport visitors to the Belle Époque period in Portugal. The Grande Hotel Paris by STAY HOTELS is located next to Avenida dos Aliados, with a privileged view of the Clérigos Tower, and inserted in the famous Galerias de Paris, where bars and restaurants, bookshops and cultural spaces thrive. All the hotel's rooms have a private bathroom, television, a minibar, air conditioning, hairdryer, amenities, wardrobe, telephone, work space, Welcome Offer: free water and teas. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast served in the Belle Époque lounge, which on sunny days opens onto a unique outdoor garden. The hotel bar and reception are available 24 hours a day. Free Wi-Fi access is available in all areas of the hotel.

8431.description:
Le Jardin Resort, which operates with an Ultra All Inclusive concept, welcomes guests in the Kiriş area of Kemer, one of Antalya’s most popular holiday destinations. The property is located directly by the sea and features its own private beach. Sunbeds and umbrellas on the beach are provided free of charge for guests. 

The spacious and comfortable rooms of the resort include a balcony, minibar, LCD TV, satellite broadcast, air conditioning, and a safety deposit box. A 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, laundry, and dry-cleaning services are also available to guests. 

Le Jardin Resort is located 7 km from the center of Kemer. 

The Tulip Bar and Lobby Bar areas have been completely renovated, and the indoor playground of the mini club has been expanded. The tables and chairs in the main restaurant have also been renewed.

8455.description: The hotel is located close to the charming neighbourhood Eixample giving guests a genuinely Catalan feel of the city. Located near Plaza de Espana and just a mere stroll away from the high-speed rail and conference center Fira de Barcelona guests have also quick access to Montjuic Olympic area the cruise ship terminal and International El Prat Airport. Most points of interest in the city can be reached within 10 minutes by car.

8470.description: Es establecimiento acepta VISA, American Express, Mastercard, Maestro y Dinner's Club. No admite mascotas. Habitaciones para no fumadores.

8502.description: This hotel lies at the heart of Porto. The hotel is situated close to the city hall. A number of attractions can be found nearby. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from the Rio Douro, where they will find the historical Ribeira old town and many port wine cellars. A number of shopping, dining and entertainment venues can be found nearby. Sao Bento main train station is just 500 metres away. Francisco Sa Carneiro is just 11 km from the hotel. This wonderful hotel enjoys an attractive design. The guest rooms offer a high level of comfort and convenience. The hotel features facilities and services to meet the individual needs of every type of traveller.

8503.address: Av. Yaxchil n 31 Mz 18 Lt 18 SM 22
8503.description: This wonderful hotel enjoys a convenient situation in the city centre of the popular tourist destination of Cancun. Its privileged situation offers easy reach of many local places of interest as well as ease of access to the pristine gold-sandy beach. Visitors will have the opportunity to completely recharge their batteries in comfortable accommodations and impressive onsite facilities including spa and a nightclub. The complex features a fabulous blend of elegance and Mayan architecture and elements of its mythology. The rooms and suites are decorated in soothing natural tones to offer peaceful surroundings and superior comfort. Guests may indulge in Mexican and Yucatan cuisine's specialities and Italian culinary delights served at the on-site restaurants. Guests may also have a drink from the bar and business people may avail for meeting facilities.

8538.description: This attractive award-winning hotel is in a prime location near IFEMA and Barajas airport, surrounded by the main Madrid business areas, next to La Moraleja, Alcobendas, and San Sebastián de los Reyes business parks. In the vicinity, there is a wide selection of restaurants, shops, and entertainment venues. La Moraleja metro station is just 200 metres from the hotel, providing easy access to the whole city. This is the perfect hotel for a trip to the enchanting Spanish capital.

name.content: Beachscape Kin Ha Villas and Suites

8540.description: Located directly beside the beach, within a tropical garden, this hotel is a 3-minute drive from Pok-ta-Pok Golf course, in northern Cancún. The beach opposite the hotel is popular for snorkelling and swimming. Countless shopping venues, nightclubs, bars and restaurants can be reached within a few minutes. The central location allows guests the opportunity to comfortably view the archaeological Maya ruins. By car, Cancún city centre is just a 5-minute drive away, and the airport 12 minutes away.

8545.description: When you stay at the Hotel Casa Maya - Near Langosta Beach in Cancún (Zona Hotelera), you'll be just a one-minute drive from Langosta Beach and six minutes from the Cancún Convention Center. This beach aparthotel is 4. 9 miles (7. 9 kilometers) from La Isla Shopping Mall and 5. 6 miles (9. 1 km) from Ultramar Ferry Puerto Juárez. Take a dip in one of the two outdoor pools or enjoy other recreational amenities, including a water park (additional fee) and a health club. A newly opened spa is now available featuring three treatment rooms and the prestigious "Wellness for Cancer" certification. The hotel also offers a state-of-the-art gym with digital trainer technology, open 24 hours a day. Additional features include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting services for an additional fee. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle for an additional fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 321 guest rooms, each featuring a microwave and a flat-screen television. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, safes, and minibars. For lunch or dinner, stop by La Veranda, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. You can also dine at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service is provided during limited hours. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, poolside bar, or one of two bars/lounges. Daily buffet breakfasts are available from 7:00 a. m. to 11:00 a. m. for an additional fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. An airport shuttle is available upon request for an additional fee, and free self-parking is available onsite. 1 private pickleball court within the resort’s sports facilities.

8549.address: Avenida das Forças Armadas Rotunda Lavrador nr 9

Ibis Bragança is very advantageous for visits to the city, as well as being close to the historic center, with excellent access to the highway and the Montesinho natural park. Make the most of this opportunity to appreciate the fantastic view of the new City Park.

8550.description: Located in the city center, the ibis hotel in Guimarães is ideal for guests looking to explore the natural and historical delights of Portugal's founding city, offering easy access to monuments, shopping centers and highways. Guests can relax in our magni ficent, comfortable, air-conditioned rooms and enjoy WIFI access, and a 24-hour snack service.

8567.description: This magnificent beachfront resort is conveniently located in the centre of Cancun's Caribben shoreline, just a stone's throw from Kukulcan Plaza shopping mall and a short walk from La Isla Shopping Village, offering its guests a peaceful setting in which to unwind and many leisure options for the more active ones. All 340 luxury villas have a unique architectural design and breath-taking ocean views of white sandy beaches with turquoise waters for added comfort. Visitors may relax at the on-site spa, have a refreshing swim by the swimming pool, play tennis and enjoy an impressive array of glamorous services, including themed nights and live entertainment shows with something different every night.

8578.description: With a stay at Hotel Barcelona House, you'll be centrally located in Barcelona, steps from La Rambla and 11 minutes by foot from Port de Barcelona. This hotel is 0. 4 mi (0. 6 km) from Barcelona Cathedral and 0. 8 mi (1. 3 km) from Plaça de Catalunya. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Stay in one of 57 guestrooms featuring plasma televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. 8581.description: The Riu Palace Las Americas All Inclusive is a luxury hotel located in Cancun surrounded by sugar-white sands and crystal-clear waters which provides fabulous views out over the sea and the nearby area. Guests will be able to find shopping centres and public transport networks stops in the vicinity. The hotel delivers the finest dining, entertainment and leisure activities in unlimited amounts. Guests will love the elegant atmosphere of this beachfront resort located in the heart of Cancun's exclusive hotel zone.

8599.address: Pau de Bandeira Street, n.º 4 1249-021 Lisboa, 4
8599.description: Enhanced cleaning and safety standards in place including Clean and Safe and Safe Travels facility accreditation. Visit hotel website for more details. Set in a beautiful subtropical garden in the city's diplomatic quarter, this truly luxurious and elegant hotel from the 19th century enjoys magnificent views over the city and the Tagus River from its hilltop position. The area of Belém with the famous Torre de Belém and the historic centre with its famous attractions such as Praça do Comércio Square are within easy reach, the international airport can be reached within 20-30 minutes.

8605.description: This apartment hotel is located on Via Augusta, in an upscale residential area of Barcelona. The hotel is situated close to Muntaner Street and Diagonal Avenue, nestled amidst the commercial and financial heart of this mesmerising city. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from the many attractions that this magical city has to offer. A myriad of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues are to be found nearby. This wonderful complex features beautifully-appointed apartments, which are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are sure to enjoy a comfortable, memorable stay at this hotel.

8615.description: Porto, one of Europe's oldest tourist destinations, boasts rich heritage, renowned Port wine, and vast leisure, culinary, cultural, and artistic offerings. The WOT Porto Hotel is nestled in Porto's historic center, an 8-minute walk from Avenida dos Aliados and the iconic Clérigos Tower. Art galleries on Rua Miguel Bombarda are a 10-minute stroll away, while the Crystal Palace Gardens are within a 17-minute walk. Serralves Park is easily accessible by car. The hotel's surroundings offer a diverse selection of restaurants and bars. Public transport is readily available, with Trindade and Aliados metro stations an 8-minute walk away, and São Bento Railway Station just 10 minutes from the hotel. Buses, bicycles, scooters, and taxis are also easily accessible. Porto Airport is a 20-minute drive or a 35-minute metro ride away. The hotel features a communal lounge, breakfast room, 24-hour reception, an elevator, and a rooftop terrace offering magnificent views of the Clérigos Tower. All rooms have private bathrooms, air conditioning, Wi-Fi, a desk, a mirror, and a wardrobe.

8617.description: This splendid hotel enjoys a fantastic situation in Eixample, the heart of modern Barcelona, the ideal base for discovering the city and its iconic buildings on Passeig de Gràcia. Situated within a few minutes' strolls from Plaza de Catalunya, this wonderful hotel takes advantage of enchanting rooms which are very luminous, fully soundproofed, with air-conditioning and top-notch comforts. In addition there are disability-friendly rooms for guests' added convenience. Patrons may tone up at the well-equipped fitness centre and enjoy the delicious dishes in the charming ambience of the buffet-style restaurant. After a long day of sightseeing, visitors may sip a refreshing drink and catch-up with friends in the welcoming hotel bar. Guests may make use of Wi-Fi connection and laundry service, while those arriving by car may make use of the on-site parking.

8774.description:
Located on Vienna’s famous Ringstraße, just a few steps from the Vienna State Opera and Kärntner Straße, the Eurostars Grand Hotel Wien combines historic charm with timeless luxury. Since its opening in 1870, the hotel has been one of the city’s most prestigious addresses, welcoming international guests with elegant interiors, refined service and a true sense of Viennese hospitality. 

The hotel offers 205 beautifully appointed rooms and suites, blending classic style with modern comfort. Guests can enjoy a variety of culinary experiences, from Japanese cuisine at UNKAI and sophisticated dining at 1870 – Restaurant to Austrian and international breakfast classics at the Grand Brasserie and relaxed moments at the Rosengarten Café. 

With its central location, elegant atmosphere and excellent facilities, including meeting and event spaces as well as the Grand Spa No605, the Grand Hotel Wien is an ideal choice for leisure and business travellers seeking a luxurious stay in the heart of Vienna.

8775.description: Centrally located in Vienna, Hotel Josefine is a 5-minute walk from Haus des Meeres and 15 minutes from the MuseumsQuartier. This hotel offers 49 air-conditioned guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads, and safes. Enjoy a complimentary full breakfast, weekdays from 7:00 AM to noon and weekends until 1:00 PM. Amenities include a bar/lounge, terrace, bicycle rentals, concierge services, dry cleaning, and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle and self-parking are available (surcharges apply). Nearby attractions include Mariahilfer Street (0. 1 mi), Naschmarkt (0. 6 mi), and Vienna International Airport (VIE) is 13. 3 mi away.

8776.description: The Bedford is a fantastic city hotel built in 1920, situated in the centre of Brussels, a convenient location quite close to Anneessens underground station. The hotel provides a hospitable service and a warm welcome and features gracious and well-appointed rooms with comfortable amenities. Personality and charm combined with all modern facilities is a guarantee. This comfortable and stylish business hotel is perfect for business and holiday makers alike.

8777.description: Set your bags down and unwind at Novotel. Novotel Brussels City Centre is a family friendly hotel, overlooking Saint Catherine's church and is situated in a neighbourhood famous for its seafood restaurants. Natural light and minimalist design make your comfortable room a haven for working or relaxing. Full-length windows and delicious choices at Novotel's breakfast buffet get your day off to a bright start. You will immediately feel at home at Novotel.

8797.description: Located in the heart of the 17th arrondissement's Batignolles eco-district, the hotel offers convenient access to the Champs-Élysées, Eiffel Tower, and Les Invalides. Perfect for families, friends, or seminars, guests can unwind in the fitness center, swimming pool, and games area. The hotel's buffet and à la carte restaurants offer a variety of delicious dishes. For a memorable aperitif, visit 'Le 17' lounge bar and enjoy a unique evening.

8804.description: Make your way to one of the calmest spots in Paris. Head sideways along the edge of Trocadéro, not far from the Champs-Élysées. Enjoy discovering the Hotel L'Ormaie, a new Right Bank boutique-hotel with a natural elegance. Set on the Chaillot hillside in the heart of the 16th arrondissement, Hotel L'Ormaie unveils its Parisian roots to evoke a perfect, tranquil atmosphere. From its welcoming entry door to its top floor rooms, everything has a luxurious, calm personality, buoyed by a whiff of generous plants and minerals décor.

8818.description:
Experience five-star luxury at Grand Hyatt Berlin, ideally located in the vibrant Potsdamer Platz district, just a short walk from Berlin’s most iconic sights. 

This elegant hotel features a rooftop spa and indoor pool with panoramic views of the city skyline, offering the perfect retreat after a day of exploring or meetings. Guests enjoy complimentary access to Club Olympus Spa & Fitness, which includes a pool, whirlpool, modern gym, and a variety of saunas. Massages and beauty treatments are available for an additional fee. 

The spacious rooms and suites combine contemporary design with comfort, featuring 55-inch flat-screen TVs, marble bathrooms with bathtubs, showers, and integrated TVs, as well as free high-speed WiFi and hot drink facilities. A complimentary bottle of mineral water is provided upon arrival. 

Dining options include the renowned Vox Restaurant, serving modern cuisine & authentic sushi, a cozy deli for light snacks, and a stylish bar/lounge for evening drinks. Guests can also enjoy 24-hour room service for added convenience. A daily breakfast buffet is available for a fee. 

Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center, concierge services, and 1, 700 square meters of flexible event space, including a grand ballroom and multiple meeting rooms. Additional amenities include complimentary wired internet, limousine service (charges apply), and on-site parking (charges apply). 

Whether you're visiting for business or leisure, Grand Hyatt Berlin offers a refined stay where urban energy meets personal calm.

name.content: NH Collection Berlin Mitte am Checkpoint Charlie

8819.description: NH Collection Berlin Mitte am Checkpoint Charlie, formerly known as NH Berlin Mitte Leipziger Strasse, is in the lively Mitte district, steps away from the Friedrichstrasse shopping street. Some of the city's famous attractions, like Checkpoint Charlie and the Potsdamer Platz square are 10 minutes away on foot. Walk further and you will find yourself at the Gendarmenmarkt Square. For connections to the airport and other Berlin attractions, guests can catch the train at the nearby Stadtmitte U-Bahn metro station. NH Collection Berlin Mitte am Checkpoint Charlie features 392 rooms for every type of traveler, including connecting and family rooms. The décor is contemporary with a neutral palette highlighted by bright pops of color. For those who have trouble sleeping, there are ultra-quiet rooms. Every morning, guests may enjoy our delicious breakfast buffet. During lunch or dinner, NH Collection Berlin Mitte am Checkpoint Charlie Restaurant offers a comfortable atmosphere and a selection of international dishes. Or relax with a drink at the Grissini Bar, which features a Spanish Jamonería and an extensive wine list, all of which can be enjoyed on a terrace. There is also a wellness center with a gym and relaxation room. For business travelers, 15 conference rooms are available and feature SMART Room Systems for videoconferencing.

name.content: Lindner Hotel Berlin Ku'damm, part of JdV by Hyatt

8821.description: The modern business hotel in the Kranzler Eck CityQuartier. At the very heart of the city, where visitors from all over the world enjoy the unmistakable atmosphere of the german metropolis. The ambience sophisticated, modern, elegant. Situated in the immediate vicinity of the Memorial Church and Berlin zoo, the CityLounge on the Kurfuerstendamm is the ideal starting point for a voyage of discovery through Berlin.

8825.description: Right in the city center, NH Collection Amsterdam Flower Market, formerly known as NH Carlton Amsterdam, is within a short walk to Amsterdam's main attractions. It overlooks the famous floating Flower Market and is steps away from the Kalverstraat shopping area. You will find Rembrandt Square and other major sites within walking distance as well. Take the tram at Rembrandtplein or Rokin to Amsterdam Centraal train station, giving you easy access to the rest of the city. NH Collection Amsterdam Flower Market is set in a traditional Amsterdam building, originally constructed in 1926 for the Olympic Games. The rooms at the hotel are spacious and finished with traditional décor. Each one is soundproof and features new mattresses and hairdryers, satellite TVs and free Wi-Fi. Rooms on the top 3 floors have balconies and overlook the lively Munt Square and Munttoren (Mint Tower). Some connecting rooms are available. A freshly prepared breakfast spread is served daily, including fresh juices and coffees, and Ter Marsch & Co Amsterdam on the ground floor serve burgers daily from 11. 00 am. There's also a gym onsite to help you stay in shape.

8826.description: A 4-star luxury lifestyle hotel in the city center of Amsterdam INK Hotel Amsterdam owes its name to the rich history of the building in which, as former home of the Dutch newspaper 'De Tijd', stories were conceived, written and brought to life in ink. INK Hotel Amsterdam is the place 'where stories are yet to be written'. Personalized service stands central within our experienced team and it will guarantee you a memorable stay in the beautiful capital city of the Netherlands. Visit our top-rated Restaurant & Bar PRESSROOM Amsterdam, where our team will ensure you the best breakfast, lunch and dining experience you could think of. Our mixologists at the PRESSROOM Amsterdam Bar will create works of art for you to indulge in, such as our signature cocktail with drops of ink, the INKredible. Yearning for serenity in bustling Amsterdam? Our courtyard is inspired by the gardens you find in central Amsterdam, “de Jordaan”, and it is the perfect place to relax. Looking for an excellent spot for your business meeting? Our Library Lounge and the Garden Room will bring your meeting or event to the next level. Work out whenever you want in our fitness center, accessible 24 hours a day for your ultimate convenience. Immerse yourself in the heart of Amsterdam at our ideally located hotel. Just steps away from iconic landmarks like Dam Square and the Anne Frank House, you will enjoy seamless access to the city's vibrant energy. Unwind in sophisticated comfort while being perfectly positioned for exploration. Amsterdam Central Station, a mere five-minute stroll away, whisks you to exciting destinations, while the Nieuwezijds Kolk tram stop, a convenient two-minute walk, provides frequent connections to renowned attractions like the Van Gogh Museum. With trams departing every five minutes and trains to Schiphol Airport leaving every fifteen minutes from Central Station, your adventures are effortlessly within reach.

8842.description: The Hotel Principe di Savoia, located in Piazza della Repubblica, offers convenient access to Milan's historical center, the Porta Nuova district, and the luxury shops of Montenapoleone. A short walk from the Corso Como nightlife and Brera's cultural attractions, this 1927 landmark hotel remains a favorite of discerning travelers. Enjoy its full-service spa with panoramic city views, indoor pool and hot tub, and ample meeting space. Acanto Restaurant provides diverse dining options, while the Principe Bar becomes a Milan hotspot during fashion week. The hotel's 257 guestrooms and 44 suites offer luxurious amenities and elegant, 19th-century Italian-inspired decor.

8843.description: The NH Milano Congress Centre hotel, formerly known as NH Milanofiori, was recently refurbished in 2015 and is located 4 metro stops away from the lively Navigli neighborhood of Milan. The Milan Assago Forum is a short walk from the hotel and hosts international concerts and shows on a regular basis. For access to Milan's top sights and boutique shops, hop on the metro at Assago Milanofiori Forum station and be there in just 15 minutes. NH Milano Congress Centre has 255 rooms, each offering free Wi-Fi. The hotel's Superior rooms come with extras such as tea and coffee makers, bathrobes and slippers. A delicious fresh breakfast is offered at the cozy Quadrifoglio restaurant which also serves a varied international menu as well as excellent classic Italian dishes. Enjoy breakfast until noon along with complimentary late check-out when you stay on a Sunday. If you prefer to unwind with a drink and a snack, sink back into one of our cozy sofas in the hotel bar. Stay on top of your workouts at the gym, and for those in Milan on business, the hotel has 31 meeting rooms and offers conference facilities for up to 1, 800 people. Catering services and technical equipment are available upon request. Stay on top of your workouts at the gym.

8844.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting. Enjoy Italian cuisine at hclub>diana Restaurant, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Milan? This hotel has 10764 square feet (1000 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 106 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars.

8855.description: Located in the heart of Venice, overlooking the Grand Canal, a very short distance from Train Station and water bus stop, the hotel welcomes its guests in sumptuous elegance, enhanced by modern comforts and impeccable services. Guests can easily take a tour around the city on foot to enjoy beautiful views and absorb the age of history. Venice Marco Polo Airport is about 13 km from the property. The hotel offers classic and elegant rooms with Venetian atmosphere. They all have air-conditioning, sat-TV, mini-bar, safe and bathroom with a shower or bathtub and hairdryer. The hotel also features conference rooms and romantic terrace make it an ideal setting for pleasure or business trips in the heart of Venice.

8856.description: With a stay at Hotel Monaco & Grand Canal, you'll be centrally located in Venice, within a 5-minute walk of Doge's Palace and St. Mark's Basilica. This 4-star hotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from St. Mark's Square and 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from Rialto Bridge. Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and wedding services. Make yourself at home in one of the 99 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Enjoy international cuisine at Ristorante Grand Canal, a beachfront fine-dining restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired Internet access, a 24-hour business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Venice? This hotel has facilities measuring 7427 square feet (690 square meters), including a conference center. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Bacino San Marco - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Riva degli Schiavoni - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Museo Correr - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- St Mark's Campanile - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Doge's Palace - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- St. Mark's Basilica - 0. 4 km/0. 2 mi- San Teodoro - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- Teatro La Fenice - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- San Zaccaria Waterbus - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Bridge of Sighs - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Palazzo Contarini del Bovolo - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- St. Mark's Square - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Santa Maria del Giglio - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Teatro Goldoni - 0. 6 km/0.

8857.description: Enjoy garden views at Hotel Ariston in Mestre, near the airport. Benefit from free Wi-Fi, a common area TV, and tour/ticket assistance. The snack bar offers convenient dining. The 49 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, and safes. Cribs are available upon request. The hotel is a short drive from Piazzale Roma, the Port of Venice, and the Grand Canal.

8870.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including a fitness center and bicycles to rent. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy Swiss and International cuisine at Rivage Cafe restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, and limo/town car service. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport limousine (available 24 hours) and a train station pick-up service. We are delighted to inform you that the hotel is embarking on a remarkable transformation, marking an exciting new chapter in its rich history, one that we are proud to have you be a part of. Throughout this journey, we remain fully committed to ensuring your comfort, preserving the Beau-Rivage experience and ensuring seamless service at the highest level.

8874.description: Situated in the heart of Athens, the 5-star St. George Lycabettus Hotel is just a short drive from Syntagma Square and the Acropolis Museum. Indulge in a rejuvenating experience at the on-site spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Maintain your fitness routine at the 24-hour health club or unwind in the spa tub and sauna. The hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (for a surcharge). Each of the 152 air-conditioned rooms provides a minibar, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences comprise phones, safes, and desks. Savor Mediterranean cuisine at La Suite Lounge for lunch, dinner, or brunch. A coffee shop/café and room service (during limited hours) offer additional dining options. Unwind with a refreshing drink at the poolside bar or one of the two hotel lounges. A buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee). For business travelers, the hotel offers a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Self-parking is available on-site (subject to charges).

8875.description: This charming city hotel enjoys an ideal setting in the Psiri quarter of the enchanting Greek capital. The hotel is located just 2 streets away from the Monastiraki Square in Plaka, providing the perfect setting for travellers who are eager to explore the captivating sights and sounds of this intriguing city. Guests will find themselves within easy reach of Athens' renowned points of interests which include the Acropolis, the Herodes Atticus Theatre, the Parliament building, the Temple of the Olympic Zeus and the nearby flea market where local treasures lie waiting to be discovered. Guests are welcomed into the relaxing, elegant surroundings of the hotel where contemporary design has been embraced and blended with warm elements of traditional influences. The guest rooms are perfectly appointed, creating an aura of peace and tranquility. Acropolis view from roof terrace

8876.description: The comfortable and cosy Hotel Marina is ideally located in the Omonia area, the heart of Athens. Guests will appreciate the warm and friendly atmosphere of the family-run hotel. All of the major attractions of the Greek capital such as the archaeological sites including the world-famous Acropolis or the Tower of Winds, the old town Plaka, Syntagma Square and the commercial centre are within walking distance. Public transport connections are only a few steps away from the hotel, providing easy access to all areas of the city. A great place for guests who are looking for a central location.

8895.description: Set amongst 1, 000 acres of beautiful parkland with two 18-hole golf courses, this elegant country hotel offers luxurious spa and leisure facilities and an award-winning restaurant. All of the spacious rooms at the Dalmahoy Hotel & Country Club offer 32-inch flat-screen TVs and private en suite bathrooms. Rooms also include luxury bedding, tea/coffee facilities, and a mini-fridge. As well as an impressive 18-hole golf course, Dalmahoy also includes both a championship golf-course and a PGA-approved golf academy within its expansive and scenic grounds. Freshly prepared cuisine can be enjoyed at The Pentland, the hotel's award-winning restaurant, alongside panoramic views of Dalmahoy's green parkland. The Zest Restaurant and James Braid Bar also offer informal dining. The Dalmahoy Hotel & Country Club also boasts a leisure club, featuring modern gym equipment and complimentary fitness classes. Guests can make use of the indoor swimming pool, sauna, whirlpool, and tennis facilities.

8896.description: 'Indulge in a spa treatment at our Edinburgh hotel, featuring massages, body treatments, and facials. Maintain your routine at our health club, indoor pool, and sauna. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and event planning in our conference and meeting spaces. Savor local cuisine at Surf & Turf or 24-hour room service. Unwind at our bar/lounge. The 157 air-conditioned guestrooms offer cable TV, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, and conveniences such as safes and coffee/tea makers. Nearby attractions include Dynamic Earth, the Museum of Edinburgh, and the Scottish Parliament. '

name.content: Radisson Blu Edwardian Mercer Street Hotel London

8898.description: The Radisson Blu Edwardian Mercer Street, nestled in London's vibrant Covent Garden district, offers a stylish boutique experience. Surrounded by charming shops, cafes, and restaurants, the hotel reflects the area's unique village atmosphere. Its classic and contemporary artwork celebrates the rich cultural heritage of Seven Dials. Guests enjoy easy access to Covent Garden's Piazza and the bustling streets of Bond Street, Oxford Street, and Soho. The hotel features 137 comfortable rooms and suites, decorated in calming, muted shades with tactile fabrics and original artwork. Amenities include premium REN toiletries and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi. Deluxe rooms offer additional workspace and a spacious seating area. The hotel also provides four meeting rooms equipped with cutting-edge technology, accommodating 2 to 60 guests. For dining, Monmouth Kitchen offers a sophisticated setting with exposed brickwork and contemporary furnishings. The menu features Peruvian and Italian sharing plates, including signature smoked lamb cutlets and fresh sea bass ceviche. The hotel is a TripAdvisor Hall of Fame recipient (2015-2017). A valid credit card is required upon arrival.

8899.description: Nestled in London's fashionable Belgravia village, the Lowndes London Hotel offers a stylish retreat amidst exclusive boutiques and charming cobbled streets. Moments from Harrods, Harvey Nichols, and the embassies of Belgrave Square, the hotel provides easy access to London's airports, the City, and its finest attractions. Each contemporary room and suite is beautifully appointed and features amenities such as a Nespresso coffee machine, complimentary internet access, and Temple Spa products. Some rooms overlook the tranquil Lowndes Square. The vibrant Lowndes Restaurant and Bar serves breakfast and all-day dining. Guests typically enjoy access to The Peak Health Club & Spa at our sister hotel, Jumeirah Carlton Tower.

name.content: The Welbeck Hotel London, an IHG Hotel

8900.description: The Welbeck Hotel is a stunning Edwardian gem offering contemporary luxury in the heart of Marylebone. Located on iconic Welbeck Street, rich in medical history, the hotel blends historic charm with modern elegance. Our motto is Stay Well, Be Well, Travel Well, providing a seamless, refined experience in one of London’s most fashionable neighbourhoods. Start your day at The Welbecker Bar and Lounge, with coffee and pastries, and enjoy free breakfast for children under 12. The hotel also features a restaurant, bar, new meeting rooms, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a mini-gym with complimentary water to stay refreshed during their workout. The Welbeck Hotel is a 5-minute walk from Bond Street tube station, with easy access to Oxford Street, West End theatres, and London Paddington Station, offering fast rail service to Heathrow. Gatwick is easily reachable via the Gatwick Express from Victoria Station. Nearby, you’ll find attractions like Wigmore Hall, The Wallace Collection, and Selfridges, as well as the British Museum, West End theatres, and Madame Tussauds. Hyde Park is just under a mile away. The hotel features six new, air-conditioned conference rooms, accommodating up to 35 guests. With the US Embassy, BBC headquarters, and the University of London all within a 20-minute walk, The Welbeck Hotel is ideal for both business and leisure.

name.content: The Chelsea Harbour Hotel & Spa London

8901.description: The Chelsea Harbour Hotel, a five-star all-suite hotel, offers a tranquil harborside haven within easy reach of London's city center. Overlooking Chelsea Harbour, it's one of the few hotels in London with a river view. Located near the Saatchi Gallery, home to contemporary artworks from Charles Saatchi's private collection, and a short walk from the shops of King's Road, the hotel combines urban convenience with a peaceful retreat. Imperial Wharf Station, a two-minute walk away, provides direct access to Kensington Olympia in just five minutes.

8903.description: Enjoy amenities like a sauna and fitness center at the London Marriott Hotel Maida Vale. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, or make use of the concierge and babysitting services (surcharge). Dine at Carluccio's, the hotel's restaurant, for lunch or dinner, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (surcharge). The hotel offers a business center, express check-in/check-out, and four meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (surcharge). Each of the 239 guestrooms features a flat-screen TV, pillowtop bed with premium bedding, Wi-Fi (surcharge), and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Lord's Cricket Ground, Regent's Park, and Paddington Central, with easy access to Heathrow Airport.

8906.description: This pretty hotel with Spanish and Mediterranean architecture offers comfort, value and first class facilities. The fabulous courtyard with a fountain and landscaped gardens are the perfect place to sit and relax. The warm and inviting reception is spacious and has a mezzanine floor where the restaurant is situated. The on-site bar is cosy, with a feature fireplace and houses a modern snack menu, and leads out onto the courtyard. All 211 traditional styled bedrooms are en-suite. There is a health and leisure club where visitors can make the most of their stay. The 13 conference rooms have first-class facilities and can hold up to 132 people. WIFI is free to all guests and available in all public areas around the hotel.

8907.description: Less than a 10-minute drive from the airport, Best Western London Heathrow Ariel Hotel provides the ideal stopover for holidaymakers and business travelers alike. This unique ring-shaped hotel – the first to be built at Heathrow – was opened by the Her Majesty The Queen in December 1960. There's short and long-stay onsite parking available with Park, Stay and Go options, and you can catch the Hoppa Bus airport shuttle service from outside the hotel. All our 184 modern air-conditioned rooms come with double glazing and blackout curtains to help you get a good night's sleep before your flight or meeting. They also have invigorating power showers, free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs with satellite channels and on-demand movies. Some rooms also come with runway views and our executive rooms have bathrobes, slippers and Bluetooth sound systems. We have spaces for meetings and training sessions, and you can relax in the contemporary bar and restaurant while watching the spectacular sight of planes coming in to land. If you have some spare time for sightseeing or entertainment, there's plenty to see and do in the area within a 30-minute drive. Thorpe Park and Legoland Windsor are brilliant fun for families, while at Windsor Castle you can have a nosy around the state apartments. At Twickenham Stadium, just 5 miles away, revel in the atmosphere of an international rugby match or take a stadium tour. If you're heading into Central London, hop on the Heathrow Express.

8908.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features shopping on site, wedding services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy Indian cuisine at Madhus Heathrow, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Hayes? This hotel has 18148 square feet (1686 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 17 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 350 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

8919.address: Po Box 14703, Al Mankhool Road, Bur Dubai
8919.description: This 2 star hotel is located in the city centre of Dubai and was established in 1992. It is a short drive away from the Burjuman Mall and the nearest station is Al Fahidi. The Hotel has 2 restaurants, 2 bars and a coffee shop. All 60 rooms are equipped with hairdryer, safe and air conditioning.

name.content: The Gritti Palace, a Luxury Collection Hotel

8929.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Club del Doge, a restaurant which specializes in Italian cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Venice? This hotel has 1291 square feet (120 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Make yourself at home in one of the 82 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment.

8933.description: A comfortable Birmingham hotel with a conference centre, a gym, and an indoor pool. Set in a pretty garden, Holiday Inn® Birmingham M6, Jct. 7 hotel is only six miles from Birmingham city centre. Close to the M6 motorway, our hotel is a great jumping-off point for family holidays to the Midlands and the South West via the M5 and M42. You can drive to Birmingham Airpor (BHX) in 20 minutes. Nearby Birmingham New Street station has regular direct trains to Leeds, Manchester, and London. Big-name gigs at the Arena Birmingham are within easy reach. You can go underwater without getting wet at the National SEA LIFE Centre or indulge your sweet tooth at the Cadbury World chocolate factory, a short drive away. If you’re planning a conference or a wedding, you can host up to 340 guests in our 16 air-conditioned, naturally lit meeting rooms. At this hotel you can enjoy: Free Wi-Fi, free parking, 24-hour room service and Kids Stay and Eat Free!Our smart rooms and suites all have high-quality bedding and a choice of pillows for your comfort. Tuck into a buffet breakfast or international dishes for dinner at Traders Restaurant, work out or swim laps at our You Fit Health & Fitness Club, or wind down in the sauna. Enjoy a pint with friends in the Open Lobby Bar & Lounge, or sip a latte in the garden.

8937.description: A stylish Edinburgh hotel next to Edinburgh Zoo, with an indoor pool and a fitness centreNear the M8 motorway, Holiday Inn® Edinburgh hotel is handy for the city centre and all its attractions. You can take a tour of the 16th-century, antique-furnished rooms at Holyrood Palace, official Scottish residence of the Queen, just a 20-minute bus ride from the hotel, or cheer on a game at Murrayfield Stadium, which hosts Scotland's rugby union home matches. The high street shops of the modern Gyle Shopping Centre are 10 minutes away by bus, from the stop just outside the hotel. Haymarket train station, also a short bus ride away, is served by trains across Scotland and the north of England. Here for work? You're a 10-minute drive from Edinburgh Park–based companies, or you can host meetings at the hotel in 14 flexible conference spaces with panoramic views. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- Limited free on-site parking- 24-hour room service- Kids stay and eat freeEach welcoming room has a flat-screen TV and a pillow menu. Look forward to an invigorating power shower in the morning, or get energised with a visit to the well-equipped fitness room or indoor pool. Relax at day's end in the spa or sauna, then dine on European cuisine in the hotel's casual restaurant and chat over drinks in the relaxed lounge bar.

8938.description: voco™ Edinburgh - Royal Terrace is nestled within historic gardens at the edge of Edinburgh's New Town. The voco™ Edinburgh - Royal Terrace is a 10-minute walk from Edinburgh Waverly station, and a 25-minute taxi ride from Edinburgh Airport. You'll be just a 20-minute walk from Edinburgh Castle. The National Museum of Scotland, the Palace of Holyrood house and the city's main shopping streets are on our doorstep, along with the new St. James Quarter. Captivating exteriors & stylish interiors, our warm and genuine hosts offer true Scottish hospitality; making our hotel your ‘home away from home’ with unique spaces to share and connect. The hotel is home to the Terrace Restaurant and Garden, where guests can take in a piece of nature in the city. Additionally, showing off Scotland's whisky scene, The Nook, showcases boutique cocktails and an extensive whisky menu.

8941.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in London. The hotel is situated close to the British Museum, lying between the West End and Covent Garden. Guests will find themselves surrounded by a wealth of attractions, as well as shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. Links to the public transport network are available nearby, offering ease of access to other areas of the city. This charming hotel enjoys a delightful architectural design, blending effortlessly with its historical surroundings. The guest rooms are elegantly designed and offer a peaceful setting in which to work and rest in comfort. Guests can enjoy traditional dishes in the relaxing surroundings of the restaurant. This hotel offers a wide range of facilities, for guests' comfort and convenience.

8957.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Grab a bite at Elstar, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Vienna? This hotel has 13681 square feet (1271 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 10 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

8958.description: This luxurious hotel is situated at the heart of Brussels, lying close to the Parc du Cinquantenaire. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the many attractions that the city has to offer, as well as a wealth of museums and exhibitions. This wonderful hotel lies just a short distance away from Montgomery train station. This modern hotel greets guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, and come complete with modern amenities. This first-class hotel fails to disappoint, featuring a boundless choice of exemplary facilities and services. Those travelling for work purposes will appreciate the business facilities that the hotel has to offer. A damage deposit of EUR 150 is required on arrival. This will be collected as a cash payment. You should be reimbursed on check-out. Your deposit will be refunded in full in cash, subject to an inspection of the property. Please, keep in mind that some services as the restaurant and bar, wil be closed until further information.

8959.description: This luxurious hotel is located in the centre of Brussels, lying just a short distance away from the Grand Place. The hotel offers guests an elegant setting from which to explore the rich culture of the city. The hotel is located just 100 metres away from Rogier train station.
