This wonderful hotel exudes elegance and sophistication. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, oozing character and poise, and offering the ideal setting in which to work and rest in comfort. Those travelling for work purposes can avail of the hotel's 9 conference rooms. Guests can revel in the delightful dining options that the restaurant has to offer.

8960.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center and in-room fitness. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, an arcade/game room, and a fireplace in the lobby. Enjoy local and international cuisine at Pentalounge, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Machelen? This hotel has 3767 square feet (350 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 87 guestrooms featuring Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

8982.description: The Four Seasons Hotel Milan is nestled in Milan's famed golden triangle, between Via Monte Napoleone, Via Della Spiga, and Sant'Andrea. The hotel's entrance is discreetly located on Via Gesu, an exclusive side street. Just steps away are the Teatro alla Scala, the Duomo, the Galleria, designer shops and boutiques, the financial district, and the public gardens. Housed in a restored 15th-century monastery, the hotel features original architecture, including cloister columns and frescoes.

8988.description: This elegant, luxurious hotel basks in its prime setting, lying on the renowned St. Marco area close to the Giardini in Venice. The hotel is located just a short distance away from St. Marco Square, offering guests the ideal setting from which to explore the rich history and culture of this mesmerising city. The hotel lies within easy reach of the main attractions of the city. This charming hotel boasts a stunning architectural design, blending seamlessly with its historical surroundings. The guest rooms are classically designed, oozing character and elegance. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, for the perfect start to the day.

name.content: NH Collection Venezia Grand Hotel Palazzo dei Dogi

8991.description: The 5* NH Collection Venezia Grand Hotel Palazzo dei Dogi is located in the calm residential quarter of Sestiere Cannaregio, Venice. The hotel has close proximity to local artisanal shops and transport links, with access to a private pier with views of the island of Murano. The hotel is close to Venice's local attractions, such as the Rialto Bridge and Piazza San Marco. It offers 64 classic rooms with a range of suites to choose from. Complimentary Wi-Fi is included as standard. Guests can enjoy local and traditional Italian cuisine with a menu of gourmet dishes and Italian truffles served in the hotel's restaurant Il Giardino Segreto. The hotel's La Voga Bar offers lighter dishes with a range of paired drinks. Business events and wedding receptions can be held in the hotel's well-equipped events spaces, with capacity of up to 100 guests. An on-site event planner is also available to help organize any event.

8992.description: Located on the Grand Canal, between the Rialto Bridge and the Academy, Palazzo Sant'Angelo offers guests both a pedestrian entrance and a private boat wharf—a rare comfort in Venice. This elegant and aristocratic palazzo sits majestically on the canal. A patrician residence with a luxurious ambiance, it provides a unique, vibrant, and romantic Venetian experience.

8993.description: Set directly on the Grand Canal, the hotel Antiche Figure housed in a fabulous 15th century palazzo overlooks the most famous waterway of Venice and is situated adjacent to an ancient Gondola workshop. Attractions such as the Basilica dei Friari, Scuola Grande di San Rocco and the Jewish Ghetto are only steps away; the Rialto Bridge can be reached within a 10-minute walk. World-famous Saint Markus Square is within a leisurely 30-minute walk. The hotel is set opposite Santa Lucia train station and very close to Piazzale Roma. Guests are welcomed in an ambience of timeless elegance and traditional Venetian hospitality. The beautifully appointed rooms reflect the style and splendour of days past with elegant Murano chandeliers and superb silk tapestries and at the same time feature modern amenities such as air-conditioning or internet access. Guests can sip on a delicious cocktail while overlooking the Grand Canal in the Garden Cafeteria. This historic hotel is a perfect place for a romantic getaway.

8994.description: The Orion Hotel is the perfect starting point for experiencing Venice. Located near St. Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge, it offers easy access to transportation, excursions, and the city's main attractions. Recently renovated, the hotel provides modern comforts including private bathrooms with showers, color TVs, minibars, direct-dial telephones, and air conditioning. For those seeking privacy and tranquility, we also offer an apartment near St. Mark's Square, a five-minute walk from the Rialto Bridge. The apartment features a dining room, kitchenette, bathroom, and bedroom.

9001.description: The Movenpick Hotel Zurich Airport is located in Glattbrugg, just five minutes from Zurich Airport. The 305 spacious rooms with free WIFI ensure a relaxed feel-good atmosphere for business and leisure travelers. The hotel is also ideal for meetings and conferences with up to 400 participants. The hotels two restaurants offer a wide range of international and seasonal dishes, and the bar invites you to enjoy a drink in a relaxed atmosphere.

9013.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestExplore London's West End from the iconic Waldorf Hilton hotel in Theatreland, five minutes' walk from fantastic shopping in Covent Garden. Savor modern European cuisine in stylish surroundings at the Homage Grand Salon restaurant, enjoy afternoon tea in Homage Private Bar, or sip a cocktail in Good Godfrey's bar. Visit top London attractions within a mile radius of this central London hotel, including the London Eye and Trafalgar Square, or enjoy a play or musical at the theater. Situated 2 miles from London's financial centre, The Waldorf Hilton hotel has an Executive Lounge, a 24-hour business centre and 7 meeting rooms for up to 400 with wireless internet access. All guest rooms have high-speed internet access. Upgrade to a Deluxe Room or choose an Executive Room for Executive Lounge access.

9014.description: Located close to the West End, this upscale hotel sits proudly in London, surrounded by stylish shopping districts, leafy Royal parks and thriving business centres. The city's wealth of intriguing attractions can be found close by. This elegant hotel greets visitors with the promise of a comfortable, enjoyable stay. Rich in grandeur and timeless elegance, the guest rooms come complete with first-class amenities. Guests are invited to dine in style in the restaurant, or enjoy the property's renowned afternoon tea. Guests can indulge in the ultimate relaxation in the health centre and spa. This luxurious hotel also offers the perfect setting for conferences and events.

9015.description: Indulge in a relaxing experience at the full-service spa, offering a variety of massages. Take advantage of the hotel's recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. This hotel also provides complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy lunch or dinner at Carluccio's, the hotel's restaurant, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11 AM and on weekends from 7 AM to 11 AM (for a fee). Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel offers 5, 231 square feet (486 square meters) of space, including conference space and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself comfortable in one of the 311 guest rooms, each featuring a minibar and a flat-screen television. Your pillowtop bed includes premium bedding, and rooms have private balconies or patios. Wireless internet access is available (surcharge), along with satellite programming. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Primrose Hill, Regent's Park, and ZSL London Zoo. The nearest airport is London City Airport (LCY).

name.content: Radisson Blu Edwardian Hampshire Hotel London

9016.description: The Radisson Blu Edwardian Hampshire Hotel, part of Edwardian Hotels London, is located in the heart of the city's iconic film and theatreland. The building itself is a striking combination of classic red-brick architecture and a sleek, contemporary interior. Guests can enjoy incredible views from their rooms, taking in the London Eye, Nelson's Column, and Leicester Square Gardens—a fabulous vantage point during movie premiere nights. A 24-hour fitness room and six private meeting spaces (hosting between 2 and 120 people) complete the hotel's outstanding facilities. The 127 bedrooms include doubles, family rooms, and suites, featuring luxurious 350-thread-count Egyptian cotton bedding, down pillows, REN toiletries, Italian marble bathrooms, elegant decor, and cutting-edge technology. Samsung TVs offer up to 300 channels in multiple languages, and free high-speed Wi-Fi (up to 150mbps) is available on an unlimited number of devices. For a real treat, book one of the hotel's stunning square-facing rooms or suites and feel as if you are floating above the bustling Leicester Square. Leicester Square Kitchen offers superb food in effortlessly cool surroundings. Contemporary furnishings and a relaxed atmosphere provide the backdrop to a fabulous fusion of Peruvian-Mexican sharing plates, all prepared on-site. The Hampshire Lounge Bar and al fresco terrace offer afternoon tea and light snacks. Always on trend, the Lounge Bar also regularly collaborates with some of the world's finest food and drink brands. Famous sights and attractions, such as Soho, Piccadilly Circus, Chinatown, Covent Garden, Mayfair, Regent Street, Trafalgar Square's National Gallery and National Portrait Gallery, Fortnum & Mason, and the Embankment, are all minutes away, as is Leicester Square Underground station (linking to London Waterloo). Please provide a valid credit card upon arrival.

9018.description: This charming property is located just off Cromwell Road, in London. Guests can explore the nearby Natural History Museum, the Science Museum and the Victoria and Albert Museum. Kensington Gardens are located nearby. This property offers close proximity to public transport links, which provide ease of access to many of the city's renowned attractions. This charming hotel welcomes visitors with warm hospitality and the promise of a memorable stay. Stylish, comfortable guest rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Excellent facilities are available to ensure that the needs of every type of traveller are fully catered for.

9020.description: This hotel enjoys close proximity to the M23, in London. Just a few minutes' driving distance away from Gatwick Airport, this hotel offers convenience to suit business and leisure travellers. This stunning property boasts a magnificent architectural design, dating back to 1600. Beautifully retaining its heritage style, this former country manor is sure to impress. Stunningly-designed rooms respect the grace and classical grandeur of the building. An extensive range of first-class facilities and services can be availed of onsite. The property features a health centre, as well as many sports options. Guests can dine in style in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant. Conference rooms and a public internet terminal will assist visitors with their business needs.

9021.description: Travel stress-free at Sofitel London Gatwick with direct corridor access straight from the hotel lobby to Gatwicks North Terminal. Savour culinary delights as you choose from 4 delicious restaurants and refreshing hot buffet breakfast is served daily in Le petit reveur. Club Millesime rooms boast runway views and access to the exclusive Club Lounge with all-inclusive bites and drinks. The Park and Fly package offers stress-free travel with the ability to park, stay, travel and return home in style.

9022.address: West Park Road Copthorne, West Sussex
9022.description: Built around a historic and charming country house, the Copthorne Hotel Effingham Gatwick is a 4 star hotel set amidst a picturesque parkland estate that dates back to 1841. It's distinct character sets it apart from many of the local hotels, yet we are a very convenient 10-min drive away from Gatwick International Airport. Very close to The Hawth Theatre, The Bluebell Railway, The British Wildlife Centre and local hiking trails, we are also within easy reach of the South Coast, meaning there is plenty to do and see during your stay with us. Enjoy a round of foot golf, floodlit tennis courts, and a well-equipped gym too - a perfect balance of activities and relaxation. Those staying before setting off to the airport or in transit will have a perfect base to refresh, rest and prepare - making their trip even more relaxing and convenient.

9040.description: A smart central Birmingham hotel with a restaurant and extensive meeting spaceThe Holiday Inn® Birmingham City Centre hotel is a two-minute stroll from Birmingham New Street station. We’re steps away from the theatre district and the city’s vibrant Chinatown, and only 10 minutes by car from the M6 motorway. Shoppers are spoiled for choice with the high-end Mailbox, the vast Bullring and the Grand Central shopping centre within a short walk. For business guests, the cutting-edge Birmingham Conference & Events Centre is right next door, the International Convention Centre (ICC) is a 5-minute drive away, and you can host up to 600 people in our flexible meeting rooms. Catch a live show at the O2 Academy, just down the road, or enjoy exhibitions at nearby Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery. For a night out, head to the bars on buzzing Broad Street. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- Parking at daily rates- All Day Dining- Kids stay and eat free Step into our multifaceted social space, the Lobby on Hill Street, to sip Starbucks coffee in a comfy retro chair, watch a movie in the Media Lounge or hold an informal meeting. The E-Bar provides power sockets for your devices, and laptop work space. Our welcoming guest rooms and suites all have desks and Smart TVs, blackout shades and a choice of pillows to help you sleep.

name.content: Four Seasons Hotel Cairo at The First Residence

9048.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Gambling sorts can try their luck at the casino, while others may prefer a health club or an outdoor pool. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite at Seasons, one of the hotel's 6 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Giza? This hotel has 4112 square feet (382 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 4 meeting rooms. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a train station pick-up service.

9056.description: The hotel enjoys an outstanding location near the Champs-Elysées, two steps from the Avenue Montaigne fine boutiques and the Grand Palais. The unique atmosphere of this former 19th century private mansion together with the gorgeous decor, emphasize the authentic aspect of a home away from home. Each of the bedrooms and suites is individually designed, the exquisite fabrics matching with the works of art and the beautiful marble bathrooms. The restaurant and the bar lounges, nestled under a magnificent glass-roof, provide guests with a refined and contemporary environment.

9058.description: With spacious suites ideal for families, Mercure Paris Porte d'Orléans immerses you in its retro-vintage decor inspired by the Draeger Brothers printing house. With 150 m² of versatile meeting spaces and a secure covered car park with electric charging stations, our hotel also features a French restaurant offering seasonal dishes and vegetarian options. Experience our generous breakfast, which you can enjoy on our terrace during summer months.

9059.description: The Mercure Paris 19 Philharmonie La Villette hotel is opposite the largest urban cultural center in Europe, with direct access from the private car park. The hotel has 182 spacious rooms and 1, 000 m² of conference space. Start your day with a quality breakfast buffet, followed by a workout in the fitness area, and then take time to relax. Families will love our large rooms with two double beds.

9060.description: This hotel, ideally situated near the Champs-Élysées and Congress Palace, offers convenient access to metro line 1, connecting you to the city center. Orly Airport is 20 km away, while Charles de Gaulle Airport is 30 km. Designed by Rena Dumas, the architect behind Hermès stores worldwide, the hotel boasts unique interiors. A welcoming, multilingual staff at the 24/7 reception can recommend restaurants and shows. The elegant guest rooms feature air conditioning, telephone, radio, flat-screen satellite TV, iPod dock, safe, minibar, desk, and tea & coffee facilities.

9061.description: Experience the world of fashion in the heart of Paris, between the elegant rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore and the legendary avenue des Champs-Elysees. Let yourself be seduced by the style of Didier Gomez, his sublime vision of Parisian chic and the 148 Haute Couture-inspired rooms and suites. The elegant bar, the new chic, natural restaurant, the garden and terraces will help you discover a variety of new experiences.

name.content: ibis Paris Nord Porte de Saint Ouen

9062.description: This stylish and modern hotel is conveniently located just a few minutes from Paris, as there is a metro station just 5 minutes away. Thanks to its great position and useful amenities, this is a fantastic hotel for both all those leisure travellers wanting to spend some relaxing days discovering the City of Love. It is also perfect for business travellers seeking a profitable business trip, as it is near several business districts. All of the guest rooms are soundproof to guarantee a restful night’s sleep and include complimentary wireless Internet connection to help guests stay connected. At the on-site gourmet restaurant guests will live the experience of their lives, thanks to the delicious and tasty dishes that are served to the rhythm of live music.

9070.description: Set in Berlin's hip artistic district of Friedrichshain, NH Berlin Alexanderplatz is well-connected to all of the city's top attractions. Across the street, guests will find the Volkspark Friedrichshain Park, while coffee shops and beer gardens are just down the street. Take a 10-minute tram ride to Alexanderplatz square from the Klinikum im Friedrichshain stop. The Strausberger Platz metro station is only a short walk away. If driving, the hotel has an underground parking garage. NH Berlin Alexanderplatz also has a lot of surprises for its guests, such as the 50, 000 bees that the hotel keeps on the roof who produce honey for the daily fresh breakfast. There are 225 modern stylish rooms that are equipped with free Wi-Fi and were renovated in 2018. Some have a lovely view of the Frankfurter Tor Square or the TV tower. For lunch and dinner, head to the hotel's restaurant, which features international cuisine. During good weather, enjoy your meal on the summer terrace. Otherwise, relax on a cozy sofa in front of the fireplace, with a great German beer and light bites at our bar. The hotel also has luxurious spa facilities, with a steam room, sauna, infrared sauna, wellness showers, fitness area and foot-bath. For meetings, there are 12 function rooms.

9071.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and shopping on site. Enjoy German cuisine at POTS, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Berlin? This hotel has 19375 square feet (1800 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

9072.description: Stay at the Berlin Marriott Hotel, conveniently located near Tiergarten Park and the Mall of Berlin. Enjoy amenities such as an indoor pool, sauna, 24-hour fitness center, two restaurants, and 24-hour room service. The 379 guest rooms feature LCD televisions, pillowtop beds with down comforters, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. For business travelers, a 24-hour business center and 12 meeting rooms are available. Self-parking is available for a fee.

9073.description: Enjoy a stay at the Renaissance Amsterdam Hotel, a luxury hotel in the heart of Amsterdam. Located within a 10-minute walk of Dam Square and The 9 Streets, this hotel offers a variety of amenities, including a 24-hour fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. The hotel features 402 guestrooms equipped with refrigerators, LCD televisions, and private bathrooms. Guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant, snacks at the coffee shop, or 24-hour room service. For events, the hotel offers over 10, 000 square feet of meeting space. Nearby attractions include the Anne Frank House and the Amsterdam Museum.

name.content: Park Centraal Amsterdam, part of Sircle Collection

9074.description: Situated in Amsterdam's upscale Oud-Zuid district, this hotel offers contemporary design and elegant cuisine for culture-seeking travelers. Minutes away from the Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum, Vondelpark, and Leidseplein, it's ideal for exploring the city's cultural heart. Schiphol Airport is a mere 10 km away. Guests enjoy modern amenities, a fitness center, on-site parking, and versatile meeting rooms suitable for various business needs. The stylishly appointed rooms feature all the essentials for a comfortable stay, with some boasting large windows and bright Amsterdam vistas.

9075.description: Jan Luyken is a townhouse in the heart of Amsterdam, where the Museum Quarter meets the city's most elegant shopping street. At Jan Luyken, we offer more than just a hotel room. Our elegant rooms offer a tranquil place to rest, thoughtfully designed for you to enjoy. We invite you to enjoy our spaces as if they were your own, and everything you need for a comfortable stay is included.

9076.description: Relax at the ibis Amsterdam Airport Hotel. Our free shuttle runs from Schiphol Airport between 4:30 a. m. and 1:30 a. m. Unwind after a long day in our cozy bar, open from 5:00 p. m. to 1:00 a. m. Enjoy a delicious breakfast spread with Dutch specialties, pastries, and more, served from 4:00 a. m. to 12:00 p. m. Missed breakfast? Brunch is available from 12:00 p. m. to 4:00 p. m. Savor American burgers, Dutch dishes, and more at our second-floor Burger Bar, open from 4:00 p. m. to 11:00 p. m. A varied dinner buffet, including meat, vegetarian options, and desserts, is served on the fourth floor from 6:00 p. m. to 10:00 p. m. For 24/7 convenience, grab snacks and drinks at our first-floor Take Away outlet. We also cater to dietary restrictions (gluten-free, lactose-free, etc. ). All rooms feature comfortable Sweet Beds, a work desk, and a fully-stocked bathroom. Our reception is open 24/7. Please note: we do not accept cash payments between 11:00 p. m. and 7:00 a. m.

9079.description: The Highlander Hotel, centrally located in Amsterdam, is a 5-minute walk from Dam Square and 6 minutes from Madame Tussauds. This eco-certified hotel offers convenient access to several attractions: 0. 6 miles from Anne Frank House and 1. 7 miles from Vondelpark. Guests can enjoy bike rentals, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. An area shuttle is also available (surcharge). The 31 individually decorated guestrooms feature tablet computers, minibars, down comforters, Egyptian cotton sheets, and LED TVs with cable programming. Private bathrooms include rainfall showers and complimentary toiletries. The hotel offers a restaurant, a coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service. Guests can also unwind at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (7:00 AM to 10:30 AM, for a fee). Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge, 24 hours).

9111.description: This hotel is set within easy access of the Acropolis, in the charming city of Athens. Guests will find themselves surrounded by one of the most exclusive shopping and commercial areas of the city. The ruins of the Parthenon are located just a few minutes' walking distance away. Links to the public transport network within easy access of the hotel. Guests can explore the many attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. This wonderful hotel enjoys a beautiful blend of traditional and contemporary designs. The guest rooms are elegantly presented, showcasing luxury and decadence. The hotel features a boundless choice of facilities and services, meeting the needs of discerning business and leisure travellers alike.

9112.description: At Athenaeum InterContinental Athens, discover contemporary design and impeccable service. Our award-winning conference centre sets the stage for exceptional business events, complemented by elegant dining experiences that exude understated luxury. Explore the city's ancient sites, such as the amazing Acropolis, or take in the breathtaking views from Lycabettus Hill. Return to the hotel for a delightful evening, where champagne cocktails add a touch of opulence to your Athens experience.

9113.description: This attractive hotel enjoys a superb location in Athens near Syntagma Square and the celebrated Plaka neighbourhood. The Acropolis and Parthenon, parliament, National Garden, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and a wealth of museums are all easily within walking distance, and numerous shops, restaurants, taverns and public transport links can be found in the immediate vicinity of the hotel. The guest rooms are both functional and stylish with hardwood floors, handy mini-fridge, and room service. Guests can start a busy day of sightseeing with a rich breakfast buffet, and take advantage of the excellent services offered by the hotel, including free Wi-Fi and a convenient public computer in the lobby, a travel desk, and a delightful playroom for children as well as babysitting services. With its central location, comfortable rooms and outstanding service, this hotel is the perfect Athens base for a sightseeing holiday.

9125.description: Overlooking one of Edinburgh’s prettiest private garden squares, Kimpton Charlotte Square Hotel consists of seven interconnected Georgian townhouses. Outside is where you’ll find the New Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that’s delightfully removed from the city’s tourist hubs. But it’s inside where things really get interesting. The interior blends handsome woods, plush fabrics, and rich pops of color—and, yes, just a touch of tartan—to luxurious effect. And with a magnetic inner courtyard, an acclaimed Middle Eastern restaurant and award-winning Scottish restaurant , it’s no wonder the hotel has become a natural meeting point.

9131.description: A convenient Heathrow Airport hotel with meeting rooms, a leisure club and a choice of restaurantsCrowne Plaza® London - Heathrow hotel is a quick taxi ride from Heathrow Airport (LHR). We’re just off the M4, and Park, Stay & Go packages let you leave your car onsite and travel to the airport on the Hotel Hoppa bus. We’re only 15 miles from central London, and if you don’t want to drive, the Heathrow Express train gets you there in 20 minutes. Our 21 conference rooms can host up to 200 guests, and our Crowne Plaza Meetings Director is on hand to help arrange everything. A free shuttle runs to the business parks at Stockley Park and Bedfont Lakes. If you have time off, explore Windsor Castle or take the kids to LEGOLAND® Windsor Resort, both a short drive away. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Complimentary WiFi- 24-hour room service- Club Rooms with access to a private loungeOur welcoming bedrooms are designed with comfort in mind, and our Sleep Advantage® programme provides quiet zones and premium bedding. While you’re waiting for a flight, you can work out in the gym or relax in the pool, steam room and sauna. Savour sophisticated Indian cuisine in ERIKI Restaurant or modern British dishes in Orwell's Brasserie, and relax with a pint in Dr. O'Driscoll's Irish Bar.

9143.description: Located on one of the seven hills of Edinburgh, only 8 km from the city centre and close to the airport, this hotel provides spectacular panoramic views of the area. Public transport links are easily accessible, a mere 40 metres from the hotel doorstep. Offering refreshing, rejuvenating interiors, this hotel boasts quintessential Scottish style. Guests are sure to enjoy traditional architecture, coupled with modern comforts. The hotel guest rooms are spacious and endearing, inviting guests to fully relax and enjoy their stay. Rejuvenating facilities include a top of the range fitness centre, swimming pool and golf course, a mere 1 km from the hotel. The Westview restaurant provides delectable dishes sure to please even the most discerning guest. Guests are invited to sit back and enjoy the lavish surroundings which this hotel has to offer.

9148.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour health club or take in the view from a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy international cuisine at Market Garden Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. English breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Hounslow? This hotel has 18665 square feet (1734 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge at scheduled times, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

9155.description: Situated just 4 miles from London Gatwick Airport, Sandman Signature London Gatwick Hotel is also just 30 minutes from central London via the Gatwick Express train. With free Wi-Fi throughout, the Sandman Signature offers a discounted fixed price taxi service to both airport terminals for guests, when booked at reception. Each of the 151 bedrooms at the hotel near Gatwick airport has air conditioning, an en-suite bathroom, microwave and fridge on request. Additional benefits include a flat-screen LCD TV featuring Freeview channels. The hotel has parking available at an overnight charge. There is a choice of 12 meeting rooms, the largest of which has a capacity of 200. Guests can also make use of a 24-hour front desk. Contemporary, modern food is served in the stylish Brasserie Restaurant and in the relaxed Club Bar. There is also an on-site gym, a pool and a steam room. Crawley is a 5-minute drive from the Sandman Signature. The seaside town of Brighton is 25 miles away and features beaches, shops and a Sea Life aquarium.

9179.description: The NH Milano 2 hotel is located in an upscale residential area only 7km from Milan's city center. This relaxing neighborhood has a village feel and there is a park surrounding the hotel which is set on the banks of a lake. Milan's center can be reached in 30 minutes by car, while restaurants and shopping are within walking distance. NH Milano 2 has 143 bright and airy rooms. These feature a contemporary decor with shades of cream and plum. Each room has a satellite TV, minibar, and free Wi-Fi, while many also come with lovely views over the lake. Our large breakfast buffet will surely get you going for the day and includes favorites like eggs and bacon and healthier options such as fruit and yogurt. Later in the day, enjoy wonderful views of the lake while savoring local and national dishes offered by the Al Laghetto restaurant. You can also opt to take your meal on the outdoor terrace in the warmer months. For a casual drink and a snack, head to the La Serra bar and sink back into its comfortable sofas. There is an on-site gym for guests. The hotel also has 11 meeting rooms.

9180.description: Situated in central Milan, opposite the Centrale Train Station and 2 km from the Fiera Milano exhibition center, this hotel offers convenient access to business, shopping, and transport links to Malpensa Airport. Refurbished in 2004, the hotel features 106 well-equipped rooms with a television, telephone, and minibar. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant and bar, and benefit from car rental services and free WiFi. Small to medium-sized pets are welcome with prior notification at the time of booking, subject to applicable fees. All guests are required to present a valid photo ID upon check-in.

9186.description: CIN: IT027042A1RL5EW2B5 This prestigious and elegant hotel enjoys a prime location along the lagoon promenade. Guests can step outside to experience the vibrant energy of Venice, while appreciating the hotel's serene and peaceful atmosphere. Major attractions are within easy reach, and a public transport stop is just steps away. Originally built in 1853, the hotel boasts 52 rooms and suites across five floors. The inviting lobby features a 24-hour reception, a lift, and a stylish bar. Guests can also enjoy dining at our LPV Bistrot or Restaurant or relaxing in the lounge sipping a drink prepared by our bartenders of the LPV Bar. Each elegantly designed room offers a private bathroom with a hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, minibar, air conditioning, and a safe. The junior suites additionally include a comfortable seating area with stunning views of the lagoon.

9187.description: CIN CODE: IT027042A1HAM7MZLM This hotel enjoys a great location right in the heart of Venice, by the Grand Canal. Close to the railway station of Santa Lucia and the Cruise Terminal/Maritime Station, guests will also be able to reach many cities attractions on foot. Venice Marco Polo Airport can be reached in 20 minutes by car. This elegant hotel boasts 145 spacious and bright rooms with views to the Canal and features comfortable facilities and amenities. All rooms are equipped with air-conditioning, flat-screen TV, safe, minibar and private bathroom with hairdryer. Guests are invited to an onsite restaurant which serves typically Venetian menus, cooked with seasonal and local ingredients. This is the perfect place from where to discover this wonderful place and experience a unique holiday.

9188.description: This 3-star hotel, established in the 1970s, is conveniently located in Venice's suburbs, a short 10-minute bus or car ride from Venice's city center. Venice Mestre train station is a mere 300 meters away, and the Venice Motorway exit is just 3 kilometers from the hotel. Venice Marco Polo Airport is easily accessible, only a 20-minute drive. The hotel features a restaurant serving both Italian and Oriental cuisine, a bar, and a coffee shop. All 63 rooms are equipped with private bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, hairdryers, and central air conditioning. Guests can also enjoy Wi-Fi, independent electrical devices, and soundproofed rooms, all thanks to cutting-edge technology. Nearby shopping areas are within walking distance or a short bus ride.

9190.description: With a stay at Locanda Casa Querini, you'll be centrally located in Venice, within a 5-minute walk of St. Mark's Square and Bridge of Sighs. This townhouse accommodation is 0. 2 mi (0. 4 km) from St. Mark's Basilica and 0. 4 mi (0. 6 km) from Grand Canal. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and tour/ticket assistance. The front desk is staffed during limited hours. Make yourself at home in one of the 6 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

name.content: Radisson Blu Edwardian Bloomsbury Street London

9221.description: -A neighbourhood boutique hotel located in the capital's literary heritage quarter, this Bloomsbury hideaway is next to The British Museum, within walking distance of Oxford Street, Tottenham Court Road and Covent Garden. -Social spaces are available for work and relaxation, featuring designer furniture and beautifully crafted Assouline books. -Its proximity to the life of London is contrasted by tranquil, comfortable bedrooms and suites featuring complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi up to 150Mbps, handcrafted Vispring mattresses and plush bedding, as well as award-winning amenities from REN Clean Skincare. -Discover a distinguished sunrise to sunset destination at Bloomsbury Street Kitchen, serving an exquisite selection of contemporary Mediterranean and Japanese small plates, complemented by a diverse variety of wines, sake and signature cocktails. - Nine private meeting rooms can host anything from an intimate meeting to a large-scale event for 300 people. Radisson Blu Edwardian Bloomsbury Street has a prime location in the heart of Bloomsbury, the literary district of London. Set just 50 metres from the famous British Museum, the hotel is also within easy walking distance of Oxford Street, Covent Garden, Fitzrovia and Soho. The nearest tube station is Tottenham Court Road on the Central and Northern Lines. Holborn tube station is minutes away giving direct access to the financial district, and nearby Eurostar at King's Cross St Pancras station connects you to Paris and Brussels.

name.content: Four Seasons Hotel London at Park Lane

9222.description: Situated in the heart of Mayfair, Four Seasons Hotel London at Park Lane offers a tranquil escape on a quiet street, yet is moments from Hyde Park, Green Park, and St. James's Park. World-class shopping on Bond Street and Knightsbridge, along with the West End theatres and Buckingham Palace, are just a short stroll away. This five-star hotel boasts 193 luxurious guest rooms and suites, some with fireplaces and private terraces offering stunning park and city views. The chic, contemporary design by Pierre-Yves Rochon blends classic British elegance with modern sophistication. Guests can enjoy high-style dining, a skilled concierge team, and a glass-walled rooftop spa and lounge with a state-of-the-art fitness centre. The tenth-floor spa sanctuary features nine treatment rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows and private relaxation pods, creating a haven for total relaxation and well-being.

9223.description: Indulge in a luxurious spa experience with massages, body treatments, and facials. Maintain your fitness routine at the indoor pool, steam room, and fitness center. This hotel offers complimentary wired and wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Savor French cuisine at Helene Darroze, one of the hotel's three restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Lighter fare is available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind with a drink at one of the four bars/lounges. English breakfasts are served daily (7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee). For business travelers, the hotel provides express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and four meeting rooms. Each of the 122 individually decorated guestrooms features iPod docking stations, minibars (stocked with some free items), private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, bidets, phones, safes, and desks. Located near Selfridges, Hyde Park, and Bond Street, the hotel offers convenient access to London's premier shopping and entertainment districts. Nearby airports include London City (LCY), Heathrow (LHR), Gatwick (LGW), and Luton (LTN).

9224.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy French cuisine at Alain Ducasse, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Make yourself at home in one of the 250 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Flat-screen televisions with premium TV channels are provided, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel, London Euston Square

9225.description: The Grafton, part of Edwardian Hotels London, is the perfect base from which to explore famous London attractions, such as Regents Park, London Zoo, Madame Tussauds, Oxford St, Charlotte St, and the British Museum all of which are minutes away. The hotel itself merges incredible history - it was the home of the Aston Martin Owners Club - with a stylish, contemporary look and feel. The Grafton's 330 bedrooms include elegant single, double and family rooms, as well as 10 deluxe suites. Thanks to the building's 19th century heritage, no two rooms are the same but they all feature luxurious furnishings, Italian marble bathrooms, premium branded complimentary REN toiletries, 350 thread count Egyptian cotton bedding and down pillows. Cutting edge in-room technology is available, including free high-speed WiFi up to 150mbps on unlimited devices. A 24 hour fitness room is available for guests needing to revitalise while 11 meeting rooms provide a range of spaces to suit anything from 2-150 guests. Steak and Lobster delivers the finest steak and freshest lobster to your plate. We believe simplicity is key and let the food speak for itself. With freshly caught lobster and steak from County Antrim in Northern Ireland, we understand the importance of provenance and quality. Celebrating the finest from land and sea, our signature cuts and lobsters can be enjoyed in their purest form straight from the charcoal grill, on a baked brioche roll or through other exquisite combinations. It is also a few minutes' walk to Euston mainline station and prestigious London academic institutions UCL, LSE and Royal Academy of Dramatic Arts. The Wellcome Trust biomedical research facility, British Library and Fitzrovia's many media companies, are nearby, as is Kings Cross St Pancras' Eurostar link to Paris and Brussels. Please provide a valid credit card upon arrival at the hotel.

9227.description: CHARM & COMFORT IN A COSMOPOLITAN SETTINGThe Victorian splendour of the 19th century townhouse has been incorporated into the contemporary design of the 21st century to create an intimate atmosphere while retaining its elegance. The Queen's Gate London Hotel is ideally situated at the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Surrounded by several places of interest like the Royal Albert Hall, Hyde Park, Natural History Museum, Science Museum, Victoria & Albert Museum, Kensington Palace, Imperial College and the famous shopping area of Knightsbridge. All 90 bedrooms have been designed to offer the maximum in comfort and relaxation and to create a unique experience. The recently re-designed bar/restaurant offers a selection of food & drinks throughout the day and it is the ideal place to relax after a busy day in London. While the hotel's two meeting rooms can accommodate up to 30 people each. A fully equipped fitness centre is also at our guests disposal.

9228.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast, Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Business Center, On-site Restaurant(s). Feel welcome the moment you arrive at DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel London – Chelsea with a warm, chocolate chip cookie at check-in. Enjoy an attractive location moments from the banks of the River Thames, in the heart of Chelsea's prestigious Imperial Wharf. Take advantage of easy access to the Chelsea and Fulham Football Clubs and London's most popular attractions, including Kensington Palace and the Victoria and Albert Museum. From our contemporary hotel in Chelsea, guests can easily discover the stylish restaurants and bars, independent shops and designer boutiques of Kings Road. The Imperial Wharf Train Station is located just across the road from our stylish Chelsea hotel; Fulham Broadway tube station is 15 minutes' walk away and the River Bus can be taken from nearby Chelsea Harbour. All of the inviting guest rooms at this Chelsea hotel feature beautiful Laura Ashley décor and contemporary amenities designed to help you relax and stay productive. Watch Freeview channels on the 26-inch flat-screen TV, check emails with complimentary WiFi at the large, well-lit desk and refresh in the spacious bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Upgrade to a bright and comfortable suite, offering additional living space and wonderful city views. Start your day with a delicious breakfast in our stylish onsite restaurant and recharge with your favorite hot drink and a sweet treat in the coffee bar. After a busy day, unwind with a glass of wine and a tasty snack in our relaxed bar.

name.content: Le Meridien Mina Seyahi Beach Resort & Marina

9234.description:
Spend the day on the private beach or dip into one of the 3 outdoor swimming pools. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. All-inclusive rates are available at this hotel. Meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments are included in all-inclusive rates. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the beach bar or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee.

Featured amenities include wired internet access (surcharge), a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 220 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations and flat-screen televisions.

9240.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an indoor pool and a steam room. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Birmingham? This hotel has 9688 square feet (900 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 14 meeting rooms. A train station pick-up service is provided at no charge, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 241 guestrooms featuring Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and toothbrushes and toothpaste. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and coffee/tea makers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. National Exhibition Centre - 3. 5 km / 2. 2 mi- National Motorcycle Museum - 3. 8 km / 2. 3 mi- Birmingham Business Park - 4. 9 km / 3 mi- Resorts World Birmingham - 4. 1 km / 2. 6 mi- Santai Spa - 4. 2 km / 2. 6 mi- The Vox Conference Centre - 4. 3 km / 2. 7 mi- Pendigo Lake - 4. 4 km / 2. 8 mi- Resorts World Arena - 4. 5 km / 2. 8 mi- The Bear Grylls Adventure - 5 km / 3. 1 mi- Touchwood Shopping Center - 5. 5 km / 3. 4 mi- Tudor Grange Park - 6. 1 km / 3. 8 mi- Acocks Green Bowl - 6. 5 km / 4 mi- O2 Institute - 10. 8 km / 6. 7 mi- Shopping District - 11 km / 6. 9 mi- Birmingham City University - 11. 1 km / 6. 9 mi. The nearest airports are: Birmingham Airport (BHX) - 3. 9 km / 2. 4 mi Coventry (CVT) - 26. 1 km / 16.

9244.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and wedding services. Guests can get around on the complimentary shuttle, which operates within 2 km. Enjoy Italian cuisine at Charlie's, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 2702 square feet (251 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 115 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Your Select Comfort bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets.

9247.description: The Pharaohs Hotel, located in the Al Duqqi district of Giza, offers stunning views from its terrace and convenient access to the Giza Pyramid Complex, just a 15-minute drive away. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and on-site dining at the restaurant and coffee shop/cafe. The 96 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs, and private balconies or patios, with 24-hour room service also available. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge. The hotel is conveniently located near attractions such as the Nile River (0. 2 miles), Al-Ahly Sports Club (9 miles), and the Giza Zoo (14 miles). Cairo International Airport (CAI) is the preferred airport for the hotel.

name.content: Novotel Paris Est Centre De Conference

9258.description:
Whether you are travelling for business, enjoying a family holiday or planning a city break in Paris, Novotel Paris Est Centre de Conférence welcomes you in a convenient location close to the French capital. Our 609 comfortable and spacious rooms are designed to suit all types of stays, whether you are travelling for work, with family or exploring Paris. 

For dining and relaxing, discover La Manufacture MEB, our restaurant offering a welcoming dining experience, and La Fabrik, our bar, where you can enjoy a drink, a light meal or a snack during your stay. 

With 18 meeting rooms, a dedicated conference centre and an amphitheatre accommodating up to 600 people, the hotel is an ideal venue for business meetings, seminars, conferences, conventions and corporate events in Paris. 

To make the most of your stay, guests can also enjoy our fitness room. Whether you are visiting Paris for business, leisure or a family getaway, Novotel Paris Est combines comfort, dining, relaxation and convenient event facilities under one roof.

9259.description: Your fully renovated luxury hotel in downtown Paris, near Place Vendôme and Opera GarnierLocated between the historic Opera Garnier and Place Vendome on the famed Rue De la Paix, The Hôtel Westminster Paris with its 102 rooms including 20 suites, is a shimmering gem among city centre hotels. Framed by classic Haussmannian architecture for nearly 200 years, this luxury hotel with its timeless character and design aesthetic has been the preferred place to stay in the heart of Paris among discerning travellers as well as royalty like the Duke of Westminster, whom we honour with our name. The Hôtel Westminster is within walking distance of the city’s most renowned museums, monuments, and attractions in the refined shopping, fashion and entertainment district. This rich history and legacy are preserved today with the engaging, fully personalised service we offer each guest.

9260.description: The Mercure Paris Montmartre Sacré Coeur places you in the heart of Paris, a short walk from the Moulin Rouge and Montmartre Cemetery. This upscale hotel offers a fitness center, rooftop terrace, and garden for your enjoyment. Guest rooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) or grab a bite at the 18. 75 Bar Lounge overlooking the garden. Room service is also available during limited hours. Additional amenities include a 24-hour business center, concierge services, and express check-in/out. Nearby attractions include the Casino de Paris (0. 9 mi) and Le Trianon (1. 4 mi).

9261.address: Rue Du Val De Marne Gentilly, 13
9261.description: In the heart of Gentilly, the ibis Paris Porte d'Italie hotel is ideal for tourist visits (close to Tolbiac, Chinatown, and Butte-aux-Cailles, or direct access to the city center and Notre Dame de Paris with the RER B metro) and sports events (Stade Charl éty). The hotel is located opposite the 13th and 14th arrondissements. Close to the A6 highway and ring road, we have direct access by tram to the Porte de Versailles exhibition center, and also an undercover car park.

9262.description: Enjoy a central Paris location at Hotel Brighton, just a 7-minute walk from Palais Royal and 10 minutes from the Champs-Élysées. This hotel offers 61 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) and make use of convenient amenities like room service (limited hours), a 24-hour front desk, concierge services, and bicycle rentals. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Galeries Lafayette and Palais Garnier, both within 0. 7 miles. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

9263.description: This 5 star hotel is located in the city centre of Paris and was established in 1923. It is close to the Musee D'Orsay and the nearest station is Rue du Bac. The Hotel has 2 restaurants, a bar, a conference room and a fitness centre/gym. All 75 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning.

9264.description: The Huatian Chinagora Hotel is a luxury four stars hotel managed by the Huatian group, a leading tourist company based in the Hunan province of China. The Huatian Hotel Group is listed on the Shenzhen stock exchange. The Huatian Chinagora Hotel is located at the confluence of the Seine and Marne rivers, in the city of Alfortville (Paris) in the department of Val-de-Marne. The Hotel is about twenty minutes from Paris tourist center, about forty minutes from the Paris-Charles de Gaulle airport and fifteen minutes from the Paris-Orly airport. The hotel was built in 1989 and covers an area of 46 000 square meters. The architecture of the building is inspired by the Chinese Imperial Palace and Gardens. Originally named 'Sino-French Centre for Economic and Cultural Exchange', the hotel has played an important role between France and China in promoting economic, trade and cultural exchanges. The hotel helped encourage Chinese enterprises to penetrate the European market to enhance their international competitiveness. Huatian Hotel Chinagora offers 187 comfortable rooms each with a private balcony offering a spectacular view of the Seine River or the central courtyard garden. The hotel provides a gastronomic experience in a Chinese Hunan-style restaurant, multifunctional banquet rooms and private dining rooms with two luxury terraces, in a very comfortable and stylish environment. The hotel has a secure underground garage with 500 parking spaces.

9266.description: The ibis Paris Alésia Montparnasse hotel, located in the heart of Paris, offers convenient access to key attractions: Porte de Versailles (3 km), the Eiffel Tower (5 km), and the airport (15 km). This fully renovated hotel features 264 air-conditioned rooms with Wi-Fi, including seven accessible rooms. Guests can enjoy the 'Le Jardin des Plantes' restaurant, 'Le49' bar (serving snacks 24/7), and private covered parking. Pets are welcome. The hotel also offers eight meeting rooms.

name.content: Hotel Inn Design Paris Place d'Italie(Ex Timhotel)

9267.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall at this convenient Paris hotel. Start your day with a continental breakfast (fee applies) at the on-site café and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge in the evening. Each of the 70 air-conditioned rooms features an LCD TV with digital programming, a safe, a desk, and a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower and a hairdryer. Dry cleaning/laundry services and complimentary newspapers in the lobby are also available. Located in the 13th Arrondissement, a 3-minute walk from Place d'Italie, the hotel is within easy reach of popular attractions. Rue Mouffetard, Parc Montsouris, and the Paris Catacombs are all within a short distance. The closest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

name.content: Hotel Litteraire Marcel Ayme, BW Premier Collectio

9268.description: Immerse yourself in the literary charm of Montmartre at the 4-star Best Western Plus Hotel Literary Marcel Ayme. Inspired by the novels of Marcel Aymé, this hotel boasts a retro 1950s decor. Located just steps from the Moulin de la Galette and the Moulin Rouge, it's the perfect starting point for exploring this vibrant artistic district. Conveniently situated near the Abbesses and Blanche metro stations, and with easy access to bus lines and major train stations, the hotel offers seamless connectivity to the city. All rooms and suites feature free high-speed internet, air conditioning, and a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Enjoy en suite bathrooms with showers, hairdryers, and complimentary toiletries. Select rooms offer breathtaking Eiffel Tower views. Start your day with a generous buffet breakfast, featuring hot and cold dishes, pastries, and fresh juices. The multilingual staff is available 24/7 to cater to your needs.

9269.description: Centrally located in Paris's Latin Quarter, Hotel Des Nations Saint Germain is a 10-minute walk from the Panthéon and 14 minutes from Notre-Dame. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Each of the 36 guestrooms features a minibar, a flat-screen television with satellite programming, and a private bathroom with a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. A safe and coffee/tea maker are also provided, and housekeeping is daily. Buffet breakfast is available each morning for a fee. Additional amenities include a business center and express check-in.

9274.description: This elegant city hotel is located on the Spree near the Berlin Cathedral in the Mitte district. It is an ideal base for exploring the cultural and historical highlights of this fascinating city. The nearest S-Bahn station is only 100 meters away and offers easy access to other districts and attractions of the city. It features sophisticated architecture and sophisticated, elegant interior designs. Guests will be particularly impressed by the luxurious style of the rooms. Guests can sip a beer or cocktail at the on-site bar while admiring the grandeur of the lobby and then head over to the on-site restaurant for an eclectic and unforgettable culinary experience. Guests can keep up their fitness routine at the on-site fitness centre, or relax in the Bio-Sauna.

9275.description: Situated in the very centre of Amsterdam, directly on Rembrandtplein square, the modern hotel NH Caransa finds itself in the heart of the city's nightlife area. Attractions such as the famous Flower Market, Anne Frank House, Heineken Brewery, Damplein square or the RAI Conference Centre can be reached within a short stroll. A plethora of bars and nightclubs can be found in the surrounding area. The elegant hotel rooms are bright and decorated in friendly colours. They are well-appointed and features include internet access, flat-screen satellite TV and soundproof windows. Business guests will appreciate the free WIFI connection in the lobby area as well as the meeting rooms. Guests can have lunch and dinner at the restaurant of the sister hotel, located just across. There is a lobby bar and a nice rooftop terrace overlooking Rembrandtplein. Other services and amenities include an airport shuttle service. A great choice for business and leisure travellers alike.

name.content: Apollo Hotel Amsterdam, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel

9276.description: Centrally located in Amsterdam, the upscale Apollo Hotel Amsterdam, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, is within a 15-minute walk of Albert Cuyp Market and Museum Square. This hotel is 0. 9 miles (1. 4 km) from the Rijksmuseum and 0. 9 miles (1. 5 km) from the Van Gogh Museum. Take advantage of the hotel's fitness center and bicycle rentals. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands are also available. The hotel's 223 guest rooms feature minibars and LCD televisions. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, while conveniences such as phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Enjoy barbecue at The Harbour Club restaurant and bar/lounge, or take advantage of room service during limited hours. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 am to 10:30 am and on weekends from 7:00 am to 11:00 am for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center and limo/town car service. For events, the hotel offers 2, 164 square feet (201 square meters) of conference space and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

9304.description: Centrally located in Edinburgh, The Balmoral Hotel is steps from Princes Street and a short walk from Calton Hill. This luxury hotel is 0. 4 miles (0. 7 km) from Edinburgh Playhouse Theatre and 0. 5 miles (0. 8 km) from the Royal Mile. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Guests can also enjoy the indoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. This Edwardian hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and wedding services. The 187 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars and Smart televisions with satellite programming. Private bathrooms include showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Dine at Number One, one of the hotel's three restaurants, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a drink at one of the two bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are served on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (for a fee). Express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk are available. The hotel also offers ten meeting rooms for events.

9305.description: Enjoy a stay at the Delta Hotels by Marriott Edinburgh, featuring a health club, indoor pool, and spa tub. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services, and an on-site restaurant, Cast Iron Grill, plus a coffee shop/cafe and 24-hour room service. Unwind at the bar/lounge, and start your day with a continental breakfast (fee applies). Business amenities include a business center, express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel boasts over 7, 000 square feet of event space, including 12 meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (charges apply). The 245 guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Located near the Gyle Shopping Centre, Edinburgh Park, and Edinburgh Zoo, the hotel is a convenient base for exploring the city. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is just a short drive away.

9307.description: This hotel is located in Edinburgh's Old Town, just off the famous Royal Mile and just a short walk away from Edinburgh Castle. The Edinburgh Zoo, the Palace of Holyrood, St Giles' Cathedral, the National Museum of Scotland and the Scottish Whisky Heritage Centre are some of the attractions in the area. Edinburgh Airport is approximately 13 km from the hotel. The hotel offers elegant guestrooms, beautifully appointed and equipped with all the necessary amenities to provide a pleasant stay. Business guests will appreciate the well-equipped conference rooms and the hotel's proximity to the International Convention Centre. Dining options include a restaurant and bar serving international dishes and a coffee bar.

9308.description: Set in a desirable location on North Bridge, The 4 star Scotsman Hotel is nestled between the hustle and bustle of the New Town and the historical Old Town, the hotel is perfectly located to explore Edinburgh. Just off the famous Royal Mile, Waverley Train Station and Princess Street are within 2 minutes' walk from the hotel. Tourist attractions, entertainment venues, restaurants, bars and shopping are all conveniently near-by, making The Scotsman Hotel the ideal base to explore the our great city. Many of the original features and layout remain intact from the former national newspaper of Scotland printing house, bringing historical character to this luxury boutique hotel. The Marble staircase, now the centre of the hotel, retains its imposing stained glass window and glows magnificently by candle light each evening. Within the heart of the historic and iconic building is our comfortable bar and lounge area which serves a wide variety of drinks to suit all tastes, a luxurious afternoon tea and a great range of bar snacks. A high quality Scottish breakfast with superb service is served daily in our dedicated breakfast restaurant. With discounted parking at local secure car park, complimentary Wi-Fi and all the little extras you would expect from a 4 star boutique hotel, we look forward to welcoming you soon to The Scotsman Hotel.

name.content: Radisson Hotel & Conference Centre London Heathrow

9312.description: Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite at Filini Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge at scheduled times, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 637 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Stockley Park - 4. 2 km / 2.

9313.address: Dreamland El Wahat Road Cairo, Egypt
9313.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Airport Shuttle, Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Pool. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Executive Lounge, Spa, Valet Parking. Located on outskirts of Cairo in the cosmopolitan 6th of October City, The Hilton Pyramids Golf hotel is just 15 minutes from Smart Village and the magnificent pyramids of Giza, one of the seven wonders of the world. Enjoy golf course views at Hilton Pyramids Golf as you lunch at Fairway Restaurant or sip a cocktail at the swim-up island bar. Choose from seven bars and restaurant at this Egyptian golf hotel or visit nearby Cairo attractions including DreamPark amusement park, just five minutes away. Do business in one of seven meeting rooms for 10-600 people and keep in touch with WiFi, available in public areas and meeting rooms at this Egyptian golf hotel. From guest rooms to suites, all Hilton Pyramids Golf accommodations offer golf course or pool views from the balcony.

9337.description: The InterContinental Vienna hotel places you moments away from the world-renowned Vienna State Opera and stylish shopping on pedestrianised Karntner Strasse. Behind its functionalist exterior, the hotel's magnificent wood-panelled lobby is hung with chandeliers, while our grand ballroom is ideal for hosting elegant events. You can also work out in the state-of-the-art Fitness Center, experience typical Viennese coffee house culture, or savor classic cocktails in the refined Intermezzo Bar.

9338.description: A warm welcome from the Mercure Grand Hotel Biedermeier! This centrally located 4-star hotel is situated in an authentically styled Old Vienna arcade, with all the charm and comfort of modern Biedermeier. Ideal for taking a quick stroll and exploring the city's highlights including St. Stephen's cathedral, Belvedere palace and the Ringstrasse with its historical buildings and museums. The hotel offers 198 air-conditioned rooms, two restaurants, a café, bar and the RelaxClub with sauna.

9339.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a 24-hour health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Parkring Restaurant, for dinner or brunch. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service is provided. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Vienna? This hotel has 15608 square feet (1450 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 328 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

9340.description: Enjoy a stay at the Renaissance Wien Hotel, conveniently located near Mariahilfer Street and Schönbrunn Palace. This hotel offers 305 guestrooms equipped with refrigerators, LCD TVs, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Bathrooms feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour health club, sauna, and on-site restaurant, WUNDERKAMMER, serving international cuisine with a bar/lounge and 24-hour room service. A buffet breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel also boasts 6340 square feet of event space and provides concierge services, gift shops, and self-parking (subject to charges).

9341.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services, wedding services, and a ballroom. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Vienna? This hotel has 9860 square feet (916 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 10 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 294 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

9343.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestExperience modern luxury in Brussels at Hilton Brussels Grand Place. Our hotel combines contemporary comfort with the city's historic charm, making it the perfect choice for your stay. With 236 rooms and suites, you'll find accommodations tailored to your needs, each designed for cozy relaxation after a day of exploration. Our prime location puts you between two incredible attractions, the stunning Grand Place and the convenient Square Meeting and Convention Center. Whether you're here for business or leisure, you'll find our hotel to be the ideal starting point for exploring all that Brussels has to offer. Indulge in delicious cuisine at Sentro, our on-site restaurant and bar, offering a mix of local flavors and international dishes. And don't miss the chance to unwind in our fitness center, making sure you stay refreshed and energized during your stay. For an extra level of comfort, our Executive Lounge offers a retreat where you can relax, work, or simply enjoy some quiet time. And if you're interested in art and culture, explore our in-house exhibition, a unique feature that sets us apart. Brussels' culture, shopping, and historic sites are right at your doorstep. Take a stroll through the streets to discover unique shops and art galleries. Back at the hotel, unwind in the welcoming atmosphere of our lobby. When planning an event, our flexible meeting spaces are equipped with everything you need for a successful gathering. From corporate meetings to special celebrations, we've got you covered. At Hilton Brussels Grand Place, we're dedicated to making your stay memorable.

9362.description: Le Bristol Paris, an icon of French elegance and art de vivre, is located on rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré, near the Élysée Palace, the Grand Palais, and the Louvre. Its 190 newly renovated rooms and suites, among the largest in Paris, offer stunning views. Some overlook Parisian rooftops, stretching to the Eiffel Tower and Montmartre, while others face a lush 13, 000-square-foot courtyard garden, freshly designed by Lady Arabella. Renowned for its exceptional dining, Le Bristol boasts a three-Michelin-starred restaurant, Epicure, and the Michelin-starred 114 Faubourg, a classic brasserie. Café Antonia provides a tranquil setting for afternoon tea, while Le Bar du Bristol transforms into the vibrant B. A. D. (Bristol After Dark) in the evenings. The hotel also features a rooftop pool, sun terrace, fitness center, steam room, and the award-winning Spa Le Bristol by La Mer, offering luxurious wellness experiences. Younger guests can even indulge in spa treatments designed in collaboration with Bonpoint. Le Bristol has epitomized Parisian elegance since 1925.

9364.description: The ibis Styles Paris Bercy hotel wishes you a warm welcome! A hotel with an unorthodox, Street Art design created by world-renowned artists and, in even better news, breakfast, WIFI and a great atmosphere are included in the price! Perfect for business travel, tourism or concerts at the AccorHotels Arena. Don't forget to enjoy our terrace overlooking Parc de Bercy and our Le Backstage bar, and savor our chef's recipes in our Le B restaurant.

9366.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a vending machine. You can enjoy a meal at Le BaRestO serving the guests of ibis Paris Porte De Bercy, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 7 meeting rooms available for events. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 156 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

9367.description: Whether here for business or leisure, you will love the modern, cosy setting of Novotel Paris Pont de Sèvres. Inspired by the industrial character of the town, the decor combines wood and metal to create a comfortable, casual atmosphere. Come and relax by the fireplace in the bar or on the terrace of the restaurant. Our hotel in Sèvres has 11 versatile, naturally lit function rooms for meetings and other events. In your downtime, explore the communal areas with its video games and foosball table.

9368.description: Please note that because of Covid-19 and the sanitary pass, breakfast will be served in the bedroom. This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Paris and was established in 1991. It is close to the Opera Bastille and the nearest station is Bastille. The Hotel has a restaurant and a bar. All 25 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, ironing set and air conditioning.
