9369.description: Lying a stone's throw away from the Champs Élysées, right in the business centre of Paris, you will find the Hotel Chateaubriand, a traditional establishment, which, in addition to meticulous decoration, is equipped with fabulous facilities and offers excellent services. It combines to perfection the finest of 19th century luxury with the comfort sought after by a traveller in such an establishment. The Hotel Chateaubriand has 28 rooms situated in the six floors of the hotel. The rooms reflect quintessentially French interior design, combining delicate materials with soft, warm tones, fine lines and quality textures. In the rooms you will come across classic Parisian style-furniture in the form of wooden frames on the walls, large attractive curtains and a host of pastel colours.

9370.description: For your utmost comfort, the hotel rooms and shared areas at the ibis Paris Porte de Montreuil are fully refurbished. There are triple and adjoining rooms for families and friends. Check out our breakfast room with a view over the rooftops of Paris! For your professional meetings and events, there are 2 well-lit and fully equipped seminar rooms available.

9374.description: This elegant boutique hotel is located in the center of Paris, between the Opéra Garnier, Place de la Madeleine, Place Vendôme and Place de la Concorde, next to the excellent shopping area of Boulevard Haussmann. The reception is available to guests 24 hours a day. The kind and dedicated multilingual staff is at the service of the traveller to offer personalized attention. The hotel does everything possible to make the stay in Paris as carefree, relaxed and as pleasant as possible. The hotel staff will help you make the most of your stay and organize visits or book evenings.

9377.description: This hotel is located in the city centre of downtown Paris and was established in 1900. It is close to the Opera/Madeleine and the nearest station is St Augustin which offers a direct access to explore the city and surroundings. It is less than 10-minute walk to Printemps and Galeries Lafayette department stores. The nearest airport is Paris Orly, situated 20 km away from the property. The hotel is welcoming guests with its typical Haussmannien type of architecture and modern decoration. Each guest room is well-equipped with security box, minibar, tea & coffee facilities, TV with satellite channels, hair dryer and a selection of toiletries. The hotel serves continental buffet breakfast with a wide selection of hot bakery for both to dine in the breakfast room or in the guest rooms.

9391.description: Marble walls and floors glisten with the reflection of crystal chandeliers. Underneath, guests linger, settling onto fringed ottomans, their likenesses caught in gilded mirrors. Outside, Gendarmenmarkt Square evokes another, more romantic era. Hear the vibrato of violins fill the air as tempos rise and fall in the nearby Konzerthaus concert hall, flanked by eighteenth-century German and French cathedrals, their domes stretching skyward in reverence.

9394.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Business Center, Concierge, Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Executive Lounge. Famous for John Lennon and Yoko Ono's 1969 'bed-in for peace', the monumental Hilton Amsterdam is a short walk from the old city centre, Vondelpark, the Concert Hall, Amsterdam's world-famous Van Gogh Museum and the renowned Rijks museum. Hilton Amsterdam, with its waterside garden, is located in the striking center of 'Zuid'. Sip a cocktail in the Half Moon Lounge overlooking the marina or enjoy fine Italian dining in Roberto's Restaurant, regarded as one of the best in Holland. Only 15 minutes from Amsterdam Schiphol Airport, the hotel has a business center and 21 meeting rooms with modern equipment. Enjoy wireless internet throughout the hotel. Experience the comfort of our newly restyled rooms and suites featuring city or canal views. Relax in one of our deluxe rooms and enjoy convenience of various amenities. Choose for an Executive room to enjoy exclusive top floor access to the Executive Lounge with panoramic view of Amsterdam or treat yourself to one of our luxurious suites to enjoy more space.

9395.description: One of Amsterdam's oldest and finest 5-star hotels, Tivoli Doelen Amsterdam Hotel was recently renovated in 2015. During the past three centuries, Empress Elisabeth of Austria and the Beatles have taken rooms here. Located in the heart of the city, the hotel is close to Dam Square, the Anne Frank House, canal boats, the Heineken Brewery and the Van Gogh Museum. It is also only a short walk to the shopping district, bars and restaurants. The 81 refurbished rooms are designed in classical tones with red and gold accents. They let in natural light through large windows and many look out over the Amstel river. For guests' comfort, there are premium mattresses, pillow menus, rain-effect showers and Nespresso machines in each room. Fresh breakfast is served daily, featuring a large spread that includes local specialty dishes, gluten-free options and dishes made-to-order. If you prefer to stay in, you may also use the 24-hour room service. The hotel has free Wi-Fi.

9396.description: Set in a traditional Art Deco building dating back to the 1950s, NH City Centre Amsterdam is close to all of the main attractions in Amsterdam. Walk to Singel canal, Dam Square, the Royal Palace, the Flower Market and the Anne Frank house. There are plenty of shops, bars and restaurants near the hotel as well. Central Station is only 3 tram stops away and you can reach it from Spui station. For direct access to the airport, there is a shuttle bus. The 213 rooms at NH City Centre Amsterdam enjoy a fresh and contemporary décor. Many have canal views or features such as split floors and high ceilings. For your comfort, rooms are have large comfy beds and flat-screen TVs and come equipped with free Wi-Fi and air-conditioning. Guests have access to a gym and free Wi-Fi. In the morning, guests are invited to enjoy a large and varied buffet breakfast.

9397.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Bastion Hotel Amsterdam Amstel, conveniently located in Duivendrecht's business district, just a short drive from the Ziggo Dome and RAI Exhibition and Congress Centre. This eco-certified hotel offers 192 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a refrigerator, LCD TV, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a continental breakfast (available for a fee) and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge after a satisfying meal in the hotel restaurant. Guests also have access to a fitness center, computer station, and free self-parking.

9402.description: This stunning eco-friendly hotel in Milan reopened in September 2011 after complete renovations. Located next to the Central railway station, it's just minutes from the city center and approximately 50 km (a one-hour drive) from Milan Malpensa Airport. The innovative, green design features low energy consumption while maintaining a natural, elegant aesthetic. Ample windows, terraces, and other outdoor spaces maximize natural light. The hotel offers contemporary rooms and suites, five fully-equipped meeting rooms, and a fitness center. Its bar and restaurant provide a bright, theatrical space enhanced by large windows and backlit murals that shift in color to evoke sunrise, noon, and sunset. Each contemporary, air-conditioned room and suite includes a private bathroom with toiletries.

9403.description: Situated in a key business district east of the city, this hotel offers convenient access to the city center (5km), exhibition center (8km), and Linate Airport (7km) via a dedicated minibus service. Its 248 well-equipped rooms feature amenities such as televisions, minibars, hairdryers, and complimentary toiletries. Guests can also enjoy various facilities including lounges, a restaurant, a fitness center, free Wi-Fi, and a billiard room. Gluten-free options are available upon request. Family rooms accommodate up to four people with a double bed, sofa bed, and rollaway bed. Small to medium-sized pets are welcome with prior notification and applicable fees.

9410.description: Intimate and welcoming hotel on the Lido of Venice, the 4-star Russo Palace Hotel awaits near the historic center of Venice with well-maintained and comfortable rooms, managed by a cordial and expert staff that will transform your holiday into an unforgettable, pleasant and relaxing experience. With lovely views of the lagoon, the Russo Palace Hotel is the perfect place for those who want to spend a romantic weekend in Venice, home of a historic villa in the perfect location to reach the beach, the golf club and the main public transportation hubs.

9442.description: A four-star hotel in trendy Zurich West with free Wi-Fi, meeting facilities and easy access to the city centre. Crowne Plaza Zurich by IHG offers four-star accommodation in the trendy Zurich West district, with fast routes to the heart of the city. Stroll five minutes to the nearby tram stop and reach Zurich Old Town in 10 minutes, or walk 15 minutes to Hardbruecke train station. Drivers enjoy easy access to the A1, A2 and A3 motorways, as well as secure hotel parking, while Zurich Airport is only a 15-minute drive away. Start your day with a swim at Holmes Place Health Club, then head to central Zurich to explore historic Lindenhof, Grossmuenster Church and Bahnhofstrasse. Later, have a drink in our chic bar before attending a match at Letzigrund Stadium, only three minutes' walk from the hotel. Zurich West's lively nightlife scene and concerts at MAAG Halle are less than two kilometers away. Business travellers stay Completely Connected with fast Wi-Fi and a 24-hour Business Centre. Meet colleagues over a delicious meal in our restaurant. For larger events, 11 high-tech meeting rooms suit every sort of function, while our ballroom can host up to 450 people. Allow our dedicated Crowne Plaza Meeting Director to handle the details. When the day is done, sink into premium bedding, order fresh food with 24-hour room service, switch on the TV and relax.

9466.description: This hotel is located in Edinburgh's Princes Street, lying just a short distance away from a number of restaurants, bars, pubs and entertainment venues. The hotel is set opposite the Princes Street exit of Waverly station, enjoying ease of access to other areas of the city. The hotel offers a great setting from which to explore the many attractions that this wonderful city has to offer, including Princes Street Gardens and Edinburgh Castle. This historical hotel tempts visitors into a world where traditional and contemporary designs are combined. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, featuring a style of classical elegance. Guests can enjoy delightful dining in the restaurant, where delectable dishes are sure to impress.

name.content: Holmes Hotel, London - A Park Plaza Hotel

9471.description: This hotel has been created for curious minds. This delightfully original hotel is the ideal home from which to investigate the rest of the city. Comprised of four beautifully restored Georgian buildings, the hotel is inspired by Baker Street's most famous resident – Sherlock Holmes. It boasts an enviable location in London's Marylebone Village, surrounded by high-end fashion boutiques, cafés and restaurants. Nearby highlights include Regent's Park and The Wallace Collection, while Marylebone and Baker Street stations, just a few minutes' walk away and is well connected by Tube. The hotel is a witty blend of heritage and playfulness, with 118 guest rooms and luxurious loft suites, a sumptuous lounge, tranquil library and a gym. All-day casual dining is enjoyed at Kitchen at Holmes, where London's melting pot of culinary cultures can be explored. Holmes is filled with a mix of antiques, curiosities and artefacts, nestled alongside contemporary furniture by leading luxury designers.

9472.description: Situated in the heart of Knightsbridge, one of London’s most exclusive neighbourhoods, and towering high over world-class shopping destination Sloane Street, The Carlton Tower Jumeirah is a beacon of sophistication where heritage meets contemporary luxury. The hotel has been completely reinvented late for a new generation of discerning guests with elegant, timeless interiors complemented by the most spectacular views. The 186 beautifully appointed guest rooms have all been renovated to the highest standard with classic and timeless décor, designed to offer a sense of tranquillity with an emphasis on light and space. 87 of the rooms and suites have the fantastic benefit of a balcony, taking advantage of the stunning views across London. All bedrooms and suites have floor to ceiling marble bathrooms with toiletries by Grown Alchemist and cutting edge in-room technology. The hotel’s flagship restaurant ‘Al Mare’ offers a sophisticated yet informal dining experience. Al Mare, which translated from Italian means ‘at the sea’ offers light and modern Mediterranean dishes alongside a carefully curated wine list and artisanal cocktails. Al Mare allows a convivial, gastronomic experience, taking guests on a journey around Italy and features a theatre kitchen, private dining room and al fresco dining. The Peak Fitness Club & Spa is spread over two floors. Occupying a stunning double height glazed space, the 20 meter pool is bathed in natural light and the spa offers five elegant treatment rooms and a relaxation area as well as a dedicated consultation room. The Peak Fitness Club located on the 9th floor is an equally light filled space benefitting from panoramic London views and Technogym equipment. In addition, hotel guests and members have access to the private Cadogan Gardens and its two all-weather macadam tennis courts.

name.content: Radisson Blu Edwardian Bond Street Hotel

9474.description: Radisson Blu Edwardian, Bond Street is the perfect place to relax after a day of culture, shopping and sightseeing in central London. Our contemporary bedrooms and suites complete with handcrafted Vispring beds and luxury bathroom amenities, while further opportunities to relax are offered on the refurbished ground and first floors. Enter through the refurbished lobby and take a seat in the elegant Bond St. Lounge Bar.  Furnished with comfortable sofas, armchairs and social seating, the Lounge Bar serves an Italian menu of cicchetti, antipasti, pasta and secondi, as well as a refreshing selection of aperitivi and wines.  Alternatively, if you are looking for a moment of indulgence,  we invite you upstairs to enjoy a British afternoon tea with a twist in the wood-panelled Bond St. Tea Rooms.   From the exclusive boutiques on New Bond Street to the art galleries of Marylebone Village,  the city's top attractions are right on your doorstep.  The newly reopened Bond Street station is located directly opposite the hotel, providing easy access to Canary Wharf and Heathrow Airport on the Elizabeth Line.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel, London Marble Arch

9476.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy British cuisine at Steak & Lobster, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 161 square feet (15 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. Stay in one of 101 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Selfridges - 0. 1 km / 0.

9487.description: Situated in Dubai's Deira Business District, Mövenpick Dubai Creek is just 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport and the Airport Free Zone. The hotel offers 150 rooms and suites with stunning city skyline views. Each room features internet access (fees apply), a spacious work desk, and a 32-inch LCD TV. Upgrade to an Executive Room for access to the Executive Lounge, which includes complimentary breakfast, refreshments, and airport transfers. Dine at the Glasshouse Brasserie, serving Mediterranean cuisine, or catch live sports at Issimo Bar. Guests can unwind at the rooftop pool or utilize the well-equipped fitness center. The hotel also offers modern meeting spaces and a fully serviced business center, with complimentary Wi-Fi in all public areas.

9490.description: The Sacha hotel is a 4 star boutique hotel dedicated to the world of theater. Its 42 rooms are equipped with LCD satellite TV with international channels. All are furnished in a contemporary style that will immerse you in a different show from one room to another. 3 family rooms have been created in 2020 as well as 4 triple rooms in 2022 in a different color scheme. Just 350 meters from Saint-Georges metro station (and Theater!) and a 10-minute walk from the Sacré Coeur, the Moulin Rouge, the Sacha enjoys a privileged position that will enable you to enjoy numerous restaurants, theaters and bars nearby. The hotel is also a 15-minute walk from Galeries Lafayette and Opéra Garnier.

9500.description: Located only 10 km away from Birmingham International Airport, and a short walk from New Street station, the The Royal Angus Hotell really is in the hub of the Midlands. All 133 guestrooms offer excellent comfort ! Additionally, guests can enjoy the in-house restaurant and bar and free overnight car-parking facilities. The hotel also has 12 meeting rooms the largest seating 200 delegates. Also on offer is "Meeting Plan", a new branded meeting and conference product offering only the highest levels of customer care. Rates are not valid for nationals or passport holders of the following countries; United Kingdom, Ireland.

9515.description: Experience an upscale London hotel designed to flow between local experiences and business. Located near St Pancras International Station, and Farringdon Station, Crowne Plaza® London - Kings Cross is a short walk to the Eurostar trains, Elizabeth Line, and London Underground at Russell Square and King's Cross St. Pancras to Heathrow Airport (LHR). Walk out to discover our trendy King’s Cross neighborhood with restaurants, shops, entertainment, and attractions such as the British Museum, and Covent Garden. Plan a meeting or gathering in our flexible events space. Catch up over cocktails and conversation at the Bloom Bar and Lounge. Get a great night’s sleep in sophisticated guest rooms with contemporary décor. Connect, unplug, or explore your way.

9521.description:
Located in the historical, cultural and commercial centre of Madrid. The hotel is housed in a unique building dating back to the early 20th century. 
The Quatro Puerta del Sol is 200 metres from Madrid's Puerta del Sol and 500 metres from the Thyssen Bornemisza and Prado museums. It offers rooms with satellite TV and free Wi-Fi. 

All rooms at the Hotel Quatro Puerta del Sol have air conditioning and heating. All rooms have a flat-screen TV, safe and desk. There is a bathroom equipped with a hairdryer and free toiletries. 

Hotel Quatro Puerta del Sol has a tour desk where staff can provide information on what to see and do in Madrid. The reception is also open 24 hours a day. 

The hotel is a 5-minute walk from Plaza Mayor and 10 minutes from the Royal Palace. Retiro Park is 800 metres from Quatro Puerta del Sol.

9529.description: This design hotel is situated next to Tres Cantos Train Station, just 600 metres from Madrid Technology Park. Exe Tres Cantos offers a gym and soundproofed rooms with free Wi-Fi. Rooms at Exe Tres Cantos have elegant modern décor and smart wooden floors. Each air-conditioned room includes a safe, a minibar and a stylish bathroom. The Exe Tres Cantos restaurant serves Mediterranean cuisine and has a varied wine list. Light meals and a daily set menu are available in the snack bar. Located just off the N-607 Motorway, the hotel is a 10-minute drive from Madrid Autonoma University. Central Madrid is a 25-minute drive or a 15-minute train ride away.

9534.description: Nestled in Lisbon's historic Bairro do Castelo, between the Mouraria and Alfama quarters, this hotel offers stunning panoramic city views, including St. George's Castle. Just 7 km from Lisbon Airport, it combines modern amenities with traditional Portuguese hospitality. Comfortable rooms feature cable TV, air-conditioning, safes, and private bathrooms with hairdryers and toiletries. Guests can also enjoy a cozy bar serving a variety of cocktails and drinks.

9549.description: The Best Western Plus Paris Orly Airport offers spacious guest rooms and a convenient location just a five-minute shuttle ride from Paris Orly International Airport. This makes it easy to reach popular Paris attractions. A complimentary shuttle bus operates to the airport, with limited hours on weekends. The hotel is close to Rungis International Market and a short drive from the Peripheric Ring Road. For business travelers, the hotel offers 13 well-lit meeting rooms with Wi-Fi and is located near major companies like Thales and Danone. Guests can also utilize the on-site mini-gym and enjoy high-speed internet access in their rooms. Leisure travelers can easily access Paris attractions such as the Eiffel Tower and Notre Dame Cathedral via the nearby RER train station, with a journey time of under 40 minutes. The hotel's Lindbergh Restaurant serves a hot breakfast buffet and brasserie-style meals, and room service is also available.

name.content: Holiday Inn Berlin Airport Conference Center

9610.description: As one of the largest conference centers in Brandenburg, we welcome you to our superior business hotel. Ideally located, not far from BER Airport with international ICE train station and centrally located at the freeway junction, we are the stylish hot spot for business travelers and conference organizers. State-of-the-art equipment and technology as well as a highly modern hotel design will meet all your expectations and demands. The high-speed fiber optic Internet connection throughout the hotel and the latest conference technology in all 21 conference rooms guarantee you the highest level for events with up to 1000 participants. Our HANGAR 24 Bar &Restaurant convinces with a varied and international menu as well as fresh, seasonal products and a high standard of sustainability and regionalism - both in à la carte service and event catering.

9643.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at this Madrid aparthotel, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Take advantage of the area shuttle (surcharge) or explore nearby attractions such as Calle de la Princesa and Plaza de España. Dine at the on-site restaurant, order room service (limited hours), or enjoy a daily buffet breakfast (fee applies). The aparthotel offers a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Host your event in one of the two meeting rooms, totaling 667 sq ft. Airport shuttle service is available (surcharge), along with self-parking (fee applies). The 65 guestrooms include kitchens with refrigerators and microwaves, comfortable beds with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets, LCD TVs with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries.

9648.description:
Just minutes from IFEMA and the airport, Eurostars Puerta Madrid showcases modern architecture that combines elegance and functionality. Its glass façade and clean lines lead to a welcoming interior, where neutral tones create a calm and sophisticated atmosphere, perfect for relaxing after a busy day in the city. 

Designed for those seeking efficiency without compromising on comfort, the hotel offers cosy rooms, a restaurant that blends taste and style in every dish, a fully equipped gym, and versatile event rooms for all types of occasions. Surrounded by a peaceful and well-connected environment, Eurostars Puerta Madrid is the smart choice, merging the convenience of its location with the warmth of its facilities.

9649.description: This superb hotel enjoys a strategic setting at the heart of the business district of Paseo de la Castellana. The hotel's prime setting makes it a popular choice with business and leisure travellers alike. The hotel is located next to the Santiago Bernabeu Stadium and the conference centre. Metro and bus stations are located in close proximity to the hotel, and the airport and Juan Carlos I Trade Fair Centre are within a 15 minutes' driving distance away. This contemporary style hotel welcomes business and leisure guests with excellent facilities and impeccable service. The guest rooms are exquisitely appointed, offering functional space and a relaxing environment which is fully conducive to work and rest.

9650.address: Calle de los Hermanos Garcia Noblejas, 190 BIS
9650.description: This hotel is conveniently located to the east of the Spanish capital, between the city centre and Madrid-Barajas airport, boasting bright and spacious rooms with great city views. Alsacia metro station is just a stone's throw away, providing easy access to the city centre and attractions such as the Royal Palace, Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor and Mercado de San Miguel. Designed for both families and business travellers with its comfortable and welcoming facilities, the hotel also offers a restaurant and cafeteria services.

9667.address: Quinta Do Bom Pastor (Urbanização do Bom Pastor), S/N
9667.description: Nestled at the foot of the Arrábia mountain amidst a tranquil forest, this charming 18th-century hotel offers a peaceful retreat in Azeitão. Located just one kilometer from the town center, guests enjoy easy access to numerous restaurants, shops, bars, and public transport, all within two miles. Lisbon, the vibrant Portuguese capital, is a mere 20-minute drive away, while the inviting coastline and beaches are within 15 kilometers. The hotel features traditional, air-conditioned rooms equipped with private bathrooms, hairdryers, safes, minibars, direct-dial telephones, internet access, radios, and cable/satellite TV. VIP double rooms offer an in-room breakfast and a welcome drink. Guests can relax by the outdoor swimming pool, enjoy refreshments at the snack bar, and soak up the sun on the terrace with loungers and parasols. Active guests can utilize the hotel's tennis court or venture to the Quinta do Peru Golf Course, approximately 10 kilometers away. A delicious buffet breakfast is available daily.

9678.description: Four star hotel that perfectly combines contemporaneity and excellence in a harmonious response to the comfort needs of our guests. The interior design and its comfort are combined with the natural charm of Guimarães landscape. The Piano Bar offers relaxed and unforgettable moments. It is the perfect place to meeting or just to relax in a contemporary living room atmosphere overlooking the historical town centre. The Restaurant D. Maria offers the perfect place to delight in the flavours and aromas of the best contemporary cuisine author, with strong Mediterranean influences and the freshest products available. Hotel de Guimarães will provide you with natural surroundings, innovative facilities and flawless service to accommodate a range of different event set-ups. You will find Hotel de Guimarães' event spaces to be dynamic and flexible, providing you the perfect conditions to host a memorable event. The Health Club & Spa is the perfect place to awaken the senses and provide a full well-being in a very quiet environment. It includes indoor heated pool, hot tub, saunas and Turkish bath, spa room, underwater massage, Vichy shower, massage rooms and a relaxation area.

9711.description: Ideally situated near Madrid de los Austrias, Puerta de Toledo, el Rastro, and Madrid Río, this hotel offers convenient access to the city's attractions. A metro and commuter train station at the entrance provide quick connections to various points in the capital, including stations and the airport. The hotel features 93 spacious, comfortable rooms with classic decor, a buffet breakfast, five meeting and event rooms, and on-site parking. Each bright, outward-facing room offers a welcoming ambiance with wooden flooring and modern amenities for a pleasant stay. Air conditioning and heating are available seasonally. The hotel is entirely non-smoking and has been completely refurbished for a comfortable and inviting experience.

9712.description: Enjoy modern comfort and convenience at the 1881 Madrid Ventas Hotel near Calle de Alcalá. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and wired internet access in your air-conditioned room, complete with a flat-screen TV, safe, and private bathroom with bidet. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. This hotel offers a range of amenities including a restaurant with room service, concierge and wedding services, a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and banquet hall with conference and meeting room facilities. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include WiZink Center, San Camilo Hospital Quirón, and the U. S. Embassy. The preferred airport is Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD).

9731.description: As traditional as it is avant-garde, as classic as it is bold. This is the Exe Victoria Palace, a unique accommodation in a privileged location. Located in the historic centre of San Lorenzo de El Escorial, classified as an Asset of Cultural Interest in the Historical Territory category, the hotel invites its guests to enjoy an area where history and culture are all around.

9755.description: This exclusive beach hotel is situated on a rocky ridge above the stunning Konyaalti beach, which can be reached in 10 minutes by foot or with the hotel's shuttle service. Families will enjoy a wide array of activities available in-hotel, including use of the indoor and outdoor swimming pools, waterslide, tennis courts, kid's club and special kid's entertainment programme, while adults can unwind after a long journey in the fitness centre and spa with sauna and Turkish baths. The modern and comfortable rooms are furnished with air-conditioning, balcony and en suite bathroom. Hotel staff are professional, friendly and ready to help with an extensive list of services from laundry, florist and 24-hour room service to babysitting and car rental. Ideal for those seeking a relaxing beach holiday as well as those who wish to explore the area's rich history, this hotel offers something for everyone.

12857.description: Discover the convenience of the Holiday Inn Hasbrouck Heights-Meadowlands, situated near Teterboro Airport and with easy access to NYC. Our location offers proximity to major corporations like Agfa and Samsung, as well as attractions such as American Dream and MetLife Stadium. Explore nearby shopping at Riverside Square Mall and Westfield Garden State Plaza. For sports enthusiasts, the Meadowlands Sports Complex hosts NY Giants and Jets games, concerts, and more. Enjoy our newly renovated spaces, featuring modern design and enhanced comfort. Stay connected with free Wi-Fi, savor delicious meals at our restaurant and lounge, or grab a quick snack at our lobby shop. Maintain your fitness routine in our complimentary 24-hour fitness center, complete with a Peloton bike. We also offer 5, 000 square feet of multi-use space for your special events and meetings.

13000.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Fitness Center. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Business Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service, Valet Parking. Located in Downtown Manhattan – a true urban oasis – Conrad New York Downtown is just minutes from the city's most historic neighborhoods, including Tribeca, Greenwich Village, SoHo and Wall Street. The property is also walking distance to a list of acclaimed attractions such as the World Trade Center and Oculus, Statue of Liberty, Staten Island Ferry, Brookfield Place and more. Conrad New York Downtown is a 463 all-suite luxury hotel alongside the Hudson River. An urban escape for leisure and business guests alike, the hotel features ATRIO Wine Bar & Restaurant and the renowned Loopy Doopy Rooftop Bar (open spring and summer), as well as the largest hotel event space in Downtown Manhattan. The hotel is a bold leader in sustainable luxury offering an impressive series of green initiatives (a selection listed below).

13001.description:
This luxurious hotel overlooks Central Park in the vibrant city of New York. Located on Central Park South, it's less than 9 km from La Guardia Airport. On-site dining includes a cozy restaurant with breathtaking views and a selection of sophisticated dishes. Business travelers will appreciate the spacious, elegant meeting facilities equipped with the latest technology. A variety of accommodations, featuring elegant European decor, meets the needs of all travelers. 
The Park Lane is a luxury 46-story Midtown Manhattan hotel with panoramic views of legendary Central Park
Rose Lane Grab & Go - Lobby level - 6 AM - 11. 30 AM 
Dine Away (In Room Dining) - 24 hours
Calvert's Breakfast 7AM-11. 30AM, Lunch 11. 30AM - 2. 30PM, Dinner 5PM - 12. 00AM, Reservations required for Dinner

name.content: Westin New York Grand Central Hotel

13002.description: Centrally located in New York, The Westin New York Grand Central is a 5-minute walk from Grand Central Terminal and a 15-minute walk from Broadway. This luxury hotel is also conveniently close to the Empire State Building (0. 9 miles) and Rockefeller Center (1. 1 miles). Guests can enjoy a 24-hour fitness center and a ballroom. The hotel offers 774 individually furnished guestrooms, each equipped with a minibar, LCD television, pillowtop bed with down comforter and premium bedding, and private bathroom with rainfall showerhead and complimentary toiletries. Wireless internet access is available for a surcharge, and digital programming is provided for entertainment. Guests can dine at Amuse Marketplace & Bar, featuring American cuisine and a bar/lounge. Room service is also available during limited hours. Continental breakfast is offered daily for a fee. Additional amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and 16 meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite for a fee.

13003.description:
Our Hotel's Policies Have Changed ” Weve updated our reservation and cancellation policies and extended Hilton Honors Points and status. Prior to travelling, please check the local government website for your destination to understand any local requirements or restrictions that may be in place. Daily Mandatory Charge will be added to the room rate and includes: Urban Destination Charge with premium guest internet access (3 devices); daily $20 beverage credit in Lobby Lounge or Bridges Bar; daily $10 food credit in Herb N' Kitchen (grab and go only); local and toll-free calls. 

New York Hilton Midtown, located in the heart of midtown Manhattan on Avenue of the Americas between West 53rd and West 54th streets, is within a short walking distance of Central Park, Rockefeller Center, Radio City Music Hall, the Museum of Modern Art and Carnegie Hall, and is just a few blocks away from Times Square, Broadway theaters and the renowned Fifth Avenue shopping district. 

The 1, 907-room New York Hilton is a sophisticated international hotel that appeals to both savvy business and leisure travelers. The hotel has recently been renovated with a contemporary look present throughout the lobby, restaurant, bars and lounges, fitness center and spacious guest rooms and suites. 

Travelers select from a variety of modern, spacious guest rooms and suites featuring Hilton's Serenity comfortable bedding. 

Grab a bite to eat at Herb N' Kitchen, featuring seasonal salads, artisanal sandwiches, brick oven pizzas, and specialty coffees. Stay cool in our Minus5 Ice Bar, where you can touch, feel, and explore handcrafted ice sculptures and ice architecture made from Canadian ice. Enjoy your favorite cocktails in our Lobby Lounge or Bridges Bar. Stay active during your stay in the hotel's 8, 000 sq. ft.

13007.description: This comfortable and modern hotel is a haven of comfort amid the bustling excitement of New York City. Located on the historic Upper West Side, amid tree-lined streets and landmark buildings, luxury shopping, restaurants, nightlife and more, the hotel is a beacon for relaxation in the middle of all the excitement. Friendly and accommodating, the property offers handsomely decorated, oversized guestrooms and suites with wonderful views of Central Park, the Hudson River and Midtown Manhattan. Thus, the hotel is the perfect vantage point from which to venture anywhere in New York and when the day is gone, visitors will find a perfect place to rest and relax in a peaceful environment. The most discerning guests will also appreciate the sophisticated on-site bar to enjoy a cappuccino or a cocktail.

name.content: Intercontinental Hotels New York Barclay By IHG

13009.description: Since 1926, InterContinental New York Barclay has welcomed the world’s most discerning guests. Immaculately refurbished throughout the years, our hotel eloquently recalls the grandeur of the Jazz Era and old New York while fusing modern-day conveniences and amenities. InterContinental New York Barclay, conveniently located near Grand Central Station, plays host to every Manhattan occasion — whether you’re hosting a personal event, business meeting or enjoying a New York getaway.

13011.description: Stay at the New York Marriott Downtown in Manhattan, just a short drive from One World Trade Center and the Brooklyn Bridge. This upscale hotel offers a 24-hour fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, gift shops, a hair salon, and even wedding services with a ballroom. The 506 air-conditioned rooms feature refrigerators, cable TV, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Enjoy a meal at Bill's Bar and Burger or a snack at the deli. For business travelers, there's complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. The hotel also boasts over 11, 000 square feet of event space.

13013.description: This private and stylish hotel affords an excellent location surrounded by countless restaurants, bars, shops and a theatre. This city hotel is situated within paces of famous Broadway, Central Park and Times Square. The nearest public transport stop and a number of nightclubs and bars are just a block away. Decorated in a Pop Art style, this air-conditioned city hotel is spread over 8 floors and comprises 34 rooms, of which 8 are stylish suites. Guests may make use of the cosy foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a lift, a cloakroom and an Internet terminal (for an additional fee). Those arriving by car may take advantage of the car park, adjacent to the hotel (for an additional fee). The welcoming rooms come with an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a CD player and Internet access. Ironing facilities and carpeting are also included in the rooms as standard. The air conditioning and heating are individually regulated. De Luxe rooms come with 1 king-size bed and 1 double pull-out sofa (maximum of 3 guests in De Luxe rooms).

name.content: M Social Hotel Times Square New York

13014.description: With a premium central Manhattan location and iconic sweeping views of Times Square, the Novotel New York Times Square hotel is situated in close proximity to the Broadway Theater district, Central Park, Rockefeller Center, World-class shopping, and 'Must-See' Landmarks. Prepare yourself for an unforgettable experience in 4-star contemporary comfort, whether your stay is for business or leisure.

13015.description: This legendary hotel is located in the heart of Midtown Manhattan at the intersection of 50th Street and Madison Avenue, just steps from St. Patrick's Cathedral, Rockefeller Center and Saks Fifth Avenue. Countless shops and entertainment venues, bars and restaurants are to be found in the vicinity, as well as nearest public transportation link. The hotel's prime location on Madison Avenue affords guests the ability to easily experience all that New York has to offer.

13016.description: This is a refined boutique hotel located between Broadway and 8th Avenue, in the heart of the theatre district, a few minutes' walk from Times Square. There is a plethora of shops and entertainment venues, pubs, and restaurants in the area, and easy access to public transportation and La Guardia Airport is only 10 km away. Remodeled by a famous designer, the foyer holds the reception desk, lifts, safes, cloakroom. The pub and a restaurant are available for guests who want to relax, have a drink or delight their palates with local or international dishes. Guests on business may use the conference facilities and Internet access. Rooms are cosy and well designed, with comfort and home appliances to ensure your rest.

13017.description: Ideally located in the prime touristic area of Midtown West, Park Central Hotel promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. The hotel offers a wide range of amenities and perks to ensure you have a great time. To be found at the hotel are free Wi-Fi in all rooms, ticket service, daily housekeeping, convenience store. Guestrooms are fitted with all the amenities you need for a good night's sleep. In some of the rooms, guests can find television LCD/plasma screen, air conditioning, heating, desk, alarm clock. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include fitness center. Friendly staff, great facilities and close proximity to all that New York (NY) has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Park Central Hotel.

13018.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at this hotel near Carnegie Hall, Central Park, and other iconic Midtown Manhattan attractions. Maintain your fitness routine in the well-equipped fitness center and enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Other amenities include a hair salon and wedding services. The hotel features three restaurants, including the American cuisine of Burger Joint; room service is also available during limited hours, and lighter fare can be found at the coffee shop. Unwind at the bar/lounge after a busy day. A full breakfast is served daily (for a fee). The hotel offers 5 meeting rooms and 587 guest rooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, cable programming, and private bathrooms stocked with designer toiletries. For convenience, phones, safes, and complimentary newspapers are provided.

name.content: The Plaza - A Fairmont Managed Hotel

13021.description: Since its debut on October 1, 1907, The Plaza Hotel has remained a New York icon, hosting world leaders, dignitaries, captains of industry, Broadway legends, and Hollywood royalty. A staple for lavish society affairs and blockbuster films, The Plaza has welcomed guests from around the world to experience its magic on Central Park South for over a century. Ideally situated on Fifth Avenue, this prestigious address continues to define elegance with unmatched service. As a 5-star hotel on Fifth Avenue at Central Park South, you're in the heart of Manhattan's finest shopping, near the Museum of Modern Art, Broadway, and Rockefeller Center. Downtown attractions are just a short ride away. Experience the Plaza's blend of storied past and limitless future, where dedicated teams transform a New York minute into lifelong memories.

name.content: Crowne Plaza Manhattan Times Square by IHG

13023.description: Our Times Square hotel sits right on Seventh Avenue, in the heart of Midtown Manhattan and steps from the lights and energy of one of New York's most famous corners. LaGuardia Airport is about 9. 4 miles away, making the trip in and out of the city simple. The best of Midtown is right outside our front door. Radio City Music Hall is a short walk away, the Museum of Modern Art and the Museum of Broadway are both within half a mile, and Rockefeller Center, Saks Fifth Avenue, and the Theatre District are all close by. Central Park sits just to the north when you want some open green space. At the hotel, you'll find newly renovated rooms, free Wi-Fi, and a 24-hour fitness center. We're a pet-friendly hotel in Manhattan, so your travel companion is welcome too. Fifty-First Street Social is right off the lobby, with its own entrance from the street, serving American cooking with a New York accent for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

name.content: NH Collection New York Madison Avenue

13054.description: The NH Collection New York Madison Avenue in New York is situated in the heart of the city, and has been completely refurbished in 2020. Guests of the NH Collection New York Madison Avenue hotel are within easy walking distance of major Manhattan attractions. Take in the hustle and bustle of Times Square, then cap off your day with a trip to the top of the Empire State Building. For legendary shopping, visit Madison Avenue, Fifth Avenue, and Grand Central Terminal. Art enthusiasts can access priceless works of art at the MoMA within minutes, while the nearby Bryant Park offers a scenic spot for a cup of coffee. For the business traveler, the NH Collection New York Madison Avenue in New York City provides sophisticated meeting facilities that comfortably host events for groups of up to 30. A gym, bar and tearoom are also open onsite, giving you the perfect place to dine, unwind and stay in shape in the city that never sleeps.

name.content: Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel

13055.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy a meal at Hudson Market or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in New York? This hotel has 36000 square feet (3344 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 33 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 1780 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Wireless internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

13060.description: The Hampton Inn NY-JFK hotel is a superior, first class hotel featuring 216 elegantly styled guest rooms equipped with all the modern amenities needed by today's business and leisure traveler. Our Hampton Inn, located in Jamaica New York, is ¼ mile from JFK International Airport and just eight miles from La Guardia. The Hampton Inn New York provides complimentary shuttle service to and from JFK Airport. Our New York Hampton Inn provides the convenience, comfort and service to make any business or leisure trip to New York, pure pleasure. The hotel lobby has a warm, inviting fireplace in a library setting, which is the perfect place for our hotel guests to relax. Enjoy our complimentary deluxe European continental breakfast in our breakfast room, as well as the sports bar and restaurant located directly next door. Meeting and banquet facilities, which accommodate up to 60 people, and audio/visual equipment, are available for a nominal fee. We love having you here in Jamaica, New York at the Hampton Inn NY-JFK hotel!

13061.description:
The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Fitness Center, Breakfast.The following services and amenities are currently **not available**: Executive Lounge, On-site Restaurant(s), Pool, Room Service, Valet Parking.The Hilton JFK Airport Hotel is your ideal choice when visiting New York.  Enjoy upscale accommodations while being located only ¼ mile from JFK International Airport.  Whether you are visiting New York to enjoy a fun-filled vacation, here on business or just passing through, we are a favorite stop for New York bound travelers.
Enjoy luxurious oversized guest rooms and suites where every detail has been designed to create a pleasurable, relaxing environment during your stay.  Our King-bedded rooms feature a luxurious Sweet Dream Bed and oversized desk that provides the business traveler with a comfortable office away from home while our deluxe two-queen bedded accommodations with Sweet Dream Beds afford plenty of space for families and tour groups.  Our HHonors members will enjoy the luxury of two private floors featuring upscale accommodations with exclusive access to a private lounge. 

Our state-of-the-art hotel features and modern conveniences suited for the savvy business traveler, along with a great location and recreational amenities to please the leisure guests makes the Hilton JFK Airport the perfect choice when visiting New York. 

Our guests have full use of our many amenities including:
-	A sparkling indoor pool
-	A state-of-the-art well-equipped Fitness Center 
-	Gift Shop
-	On-Site ATM
-	Complimentary state of the art Business Center

Whether you're in the mood for international cuisine or traditional fare, dine at our casual American bistro-style restaurant-bar, offering breakfast, lunch and dinner daily.

name.content: Aiden by Best Western Newark Airport

13248.description: Travel is a breeze when you stay at this Newark, New Jersey hotel just minutes from New York City and the Newark Liberty International Airport. Discover all that Newark and nearby New York have to offer from the convenience of the sleek and modern Best Western Plus Newark Airport West. From museums and cultural attractions to dining and shopping, there's something for everyone near this Newark hotel. Shop to your heart's content at the nearby Jersey Gardens Outlet Mall, enjoy a show at the New Jersey Performing Arts Center or visit the awe-inspiring Statue of Liberty. New York City is just 10 miles away - ask our friendly staff about tours. For added convenience, we offer an affordable shuttle to many of these locations, plus the Prudential Center, Cape Liberty Cruise Port in Bayonne, NJ, and Newark Penn Station for easy access to New York City. Corporate travelers choose this hotel near the Newark Airport because of its convenient location to the airport, as well as local business attractions like American Airlines, the Prudential Center, and the University of Medicine and Dentistry of New Jersey. This Newark hotel offers 1, 000 square feet of meeting facilities, making it a perfect small event space in Newark. We offer a 24-hour complimentary shuttle to the Newark Airport. John F. Kennedy International and LaGuardia Airports are within 25 miles. The recently renovated rooms and lobby of this Newark hotel make guests feel at home with amenities that include stylish decor, 42-inch flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi, room service, refrigerators and microwaves. Guests are invited to enjoy a complimentary hot breakfast buffet or relax in our on-site restaurant and bar. Other services at this Newark hotel include a 24-hour exercise facility, guest laundry and a business center. For an affordable and enjoyable trip to Newark and New York, book your stay at the Best Western Plus Newark Airport West today! Guests must be 21 years old with a valid ID to check-in!

13380.description: In a prime location, on the corner of 54th Street and Broadway, this boutique-style hotel is only steps away from public transportation links. A short walk away, there is a wide selection of restaurants and bars. This recently renovated beautiful Beaux Arts 12-storey building has 210 rooms, including 12 exquisite suites. In the foyer, there is the 24-hour reception desk, a lift, a cloakroom, and public internet access. Laundry service and garage facilities are available to guests, for a fee. The hotel is 13 km away from La Guardia Airport, and 24 km from JFK International Airport. *****Minimum age to check in is 21*********

13382.description: At the amazing hotel guests can be in Chelsea or the Fashion District in just minutes. The location is ideal for all New York City plans! The soaring waterfall in the lobby soothes the senses, a perfect backdrop for a business meeting or romantic getaway. The restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner and overlooks Broadway and Times Square. There is also a café on site and guests can eat and drink cocktails outdoors on the terrace. The fitness center offers spa services. The hotel also has a business center, dry cleaning service and an ATM. The establishment has suites and rooms with different views. The hotel accommodations are equipped with comfortable furniture and appliances for a practical stay

13384.description: The newly revitalized Westgate New York Grand Central offers a modern flare of luxury in a historic Midtown East Manhattan location. Enjoy elegantly timeless accommodations near Grand Central Station, placing you steps away from iconic New York attractions, including the United Nations Plaza, Chrysler Building, Empire State Building, Times Square, and Broadway. The Guggenheim Museum and Rockefeller Center are just one mile away. Guest rooms feature luxury beds, full private bathrooms with quartz vanities and backlit LED mirrors, and modern desks with ergonomic chairs. Amenities include a mini-refrigerator, coffee/tea maker, flat-screen TV, and triple-pane windows for a peaceful stay. Enjoy the convenience of the on-site Tudor City Marketplace with grab-and-go items, Starbucks™ coffee, and a fully-stocked tavern.

name.content: Tempo by Hilton New York Times Square

13386.description: This hotel boasts a stunning setting on Times Square. The hotel is surrounded by a host of shopping and entertainment venues, as well as the intriguing attractions for which this wonderful city is renowned. Links to the public transport network are to be found nearby. This wonderful hotel tempts guests with the promise of unrivalled luxury and elegance. The guest rooms are sumptuously appointed, offering a haven of peace and serenity, in which to escape the bustle of the city which lies just outside. Guests will appreacite the wide range of first-class facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. Guests will enjoy the exciting entertainment programme that the hotel has to offer. The property is completely cashless.

name.content: JW Marriott Essex House New York

13388.description: Centrally located in New York, the JW Marriott Essex House is steps from Central Park and a short walk from Columbus Circle. This luxury Art Deco hotel offers a full-service spa with massages, body treatments, and facials. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, or browse the gift shops. The 528 air-conditioned rooms feature iPod docking stations, LCD TVs, and supremely comfortable memory foam beds with down comforters. Cable programming and wired/wireless internet access (for a surcharge) are also available. Bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Enjoy American cuisine at SOUTHGATE Bar Restaurant, or order room service. Full breakfasts are available for a fee. A 24-hour business center and dry cleaning/laundry services cater to your convenience. For events, the hotel offers 1480 square feet of conference space and 14 meeting rooms.

13392.description: Experience Manhattan's vibrant energy at Hotel 57 by LuxUrban. Conveniently located near LaGuardia (LGA), Newark (EWR), and JFK airports, this historic hotel offers easy access to the Lexington Avenue/59th Street subway. Explore iconic landmarks like Central Park, the Empire State Building, and MoMA, all within a short distance. Enjoy proximity to the Broadway Theater District, 5th Avenue shopping, and renowned department stores such as Bloomingdales.

name.content: La Quinta Inn & Suites New York City Central Park

13393.description: Stay in the heart of the busiest city on the planet, close to fine dining, exciting attractions, and everything that makes New York, well, New York. La Quinta® by Wyndham New York City Central Park hotel puts you in an unbeatable location, steps from Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts, the American Museum of Natural History, and Central Park. Cultural landmarks abound, you'll have plenty to explore whether you're here for business or sightseeing. Make the most of your Manhattan stay with free daily breakfast and our 24/7 business center.

13397.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a rooftop terrace. At Kixby, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 195 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Herald Square - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- 5th Avenue - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Macy's - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Empire State Building - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Broadway - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Bryant Park - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Times Square - 0. 7 km / 0. 5 mi- New York Public Library - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Madison Square Garden - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Madison Square Park - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Grand Central Terminal - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Flatiron Building - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Chrysler Building - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Rockefeller Center - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Top of the Rock Observation Deck - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi. The nearest airports are: LaGuardia Airport (LGA) - 14. 3 km / 8. 9 miTeterboro, NJ (TEB) - 19 km / 11. 8 miNewark Liberty Intl. Airport (EWR) - 27. 7 km / 17. 2 miJohn F. Kennedy Intl. Airport (JFK) - 27. 5 km / 17. 1 miLinden, NJ (LDJ) - 36. 8 km / 22. 8 miThe preferred airport for Kixby is LaGuardia Airport (LGA). With a stay at Kixby, you'll be centrally located in New York, steps from Herald Square and within a 5-minute walk of Macy's. This hotel is 0. 4 mi (0. 7 km) from Empire State Building and 0. 5 mi (0. 9 km) from Madison Square Garden.

13398.address: 109 East 42nd Street, Park Avenue At Grand Central
13398.description: Situated in the very heart of Manhattan, this luxurious hotel is just steps away from Grand Central Terminal and the Chrysler Building. Perfectly situated to explore the “Big Apple”, famous attractions such as the Empire State Building, Park Avenue, the excellent shopping facilities and art galleries of 5th Avenue and Madison Avenue or Madison Square Garden, home of the New York Knicks basketball team are within a short stroll. This Manhattan hotel is located next to Grand Central Terminal Station and features a restaurant service and the StayFit Fitness Center, which is open 24/7. The hotel's pub is open for all meals. The property also houses a market offering daily take-out meals and buffet breakfast. Buffet breakfast is $45 plus tax for adults, $25 plus tax per child 0-12 years old. Rooms have electronic devices and appliances to provide a home-like experience.

13437.description: The New York Marriott Marquis places you in the heart of New York, steps from Broadway and Times Square. This luxury hotel is 0. 4 miles (0. 7 km) from Rockefeller Center and 0. 7 miles (1. 1 km) from Grand Central Terminal. Take advantage of the 24-hour fitness center or amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The hotel also features gift shops/newsstands, a hair salon, and wedding services. Stay in one of 1, 966 guestrooms featuring Smart TVs, down comforters, and premium bedding. Cable programming and wired/wireless internet access (for a surcharge) are available. Private bathrooms with showers include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Enjoy American cuisine at The View Restaurant, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or order room service. Snacks are available at the coffee shop/cafe, and you can unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event? The hotel offers 124, 755 square feet (11, 590 square meters) of space, including a conference center and 48 meeting rooms.

13439.description:
Daily Mandatory Charge will be added to the room rate and includes: High Speed Internet Access; Complimentary local, long-distance, and international calls; and access to the Fitness Center. Welcome to Millennium Times Square New York, your quiet spot in the 'city that never sleeps. Our hotel offers an ideal location – perched 16 stories above the hustle-bustle of Times Square and moments from the iconic attractions you're here to see, such as theaters, city parks, famed restaurants and Midtown shops. Relax and settle into some of the largest guest rooms in Times Square, each featuring a Smart TV, WiFi access, work desk and oversized bathroom. Our beautifully appointed suites are situated even higher – 50 floors above the city – offering luxurious furnishings, indulgent bathrobes and slippers, and a living area that's perfect for entertaining. Head for the hotel gift shop for snacks and souvenirs. We have the perfect amenities for your stay in New York City including a fitness center, theater ticket desk, business center and concierge services. Our hotel offers 43 event spaces, truly accommodating any need during your visit to Times Square. Meet with coworkers in your choice of boardrooms or host an exhibit in our high-tech, sunlit Gotham spaces. 
A portion of the lobby will be temporarily closed or reconfigured while renovations are completed. The hotel will remain open, and access to guest rooms and hotel services will continue through clearly marked alternative pathways as needed, and guests should use the 45th Street entrance at 150 W 45th St, New York, NY 10036 for lobby access. The hotel restaurant will remain closed during the renovation period. Guests may experience some daytime construction noise, and the hotel will make every effort to minimize disruptions.

name.content: M Social Hotel New York Downtown

13440.description: Millennium Downtown New York is conveniently located in the heart of Lower Manhattan's Financial District, adjacent to the World Trade Center and three of New York City's most popular tourist attractions: Freedom Tower, the 9/11 Memorial and Museum, and the Oculus/Westfield World Trade Center. The hotel offers quick access to all 5 boroughs and beyond from the Oculus, Fulton Street and PATH transit stations and is walking distance from neighboring Lower Manhattan venues and landmarks that define New York: Wall Street (0. 5 miles), SoHo (0. 5 miles), South Street Seaport (0. 5 miles), Tribeca (0. 5 miles), Battery Park (0. 75 miles), Statue of Liberty / Ellis Island (0. 75 miles), and Greenwich Village (1 mile). In addition to its central location and proximity to major attractions, Millennium Downtown New York also features high-rise city view rooms with stunning, unobstructed views of One World Trade Center, the Brooklyn and Manhattan Bridges, the Woolworth Building and other iconic attractions.

13445.description: Night Hotel Broadway at 94th Street is conveniently located in the popular Upper West Side area. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, facilities for disabled guests, luggage storage, car park are on the list of things guests can enjoy. Some of the well-appointed guestrooms feature television LCD/plasma screen, clothes rack, complimentary instant coffee, linens, towels. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Days Hotel Broadway at 94th Street is an excellent choice from which to explore New York (NY) or to simply relax and rejuvenate.

13446.description: Centrally located in New York, The Lexington Hotel, Autograph Collection, is within a 10-minute walk of Grand Central Terminal and Rockefeller Center. This upscale hotel offers 725 guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at The Stayton Room bar/lounge and a coffee shop/café, with continental breakfast available for a fee. Amenities include a fitness center, concierge services, a 24-hour business center, and six meeting rooms. St. Patrick's Cathedral and Bryant Park are within easy reach.

13449.description:
Welcome to Sofitel New York, a hotel that blends French elegance with a New York City edge. Experience a sophisticated urban escape in our 398 fully renovated guest rooms, including 52 luxurious one-bedroom suites. Each accommodation has been completely reimagined with a refined, contemporary ambiance, stylish furnishings, and spectacular views of the Midtown skyline, including the Empire State and Chrysler Buildings. Our most exclusive accommodations, featuring the Penthouse Suite Manhattan Skyline View and our Panoramic and Skyscraper View Terrace Suites, offer unparalleled Manhattan views. Discover Social 45, our brand-new dining and lounge concept, where French inspiration meets New York flair. Social 45 is open for:

Breakfast: 6:30 to 11:00 AM
Lunch: 12:00 to 2:00 PM
Lounge Service: 4:00 to 11:30 PM 
Bar: 12:00 PM to 12:00 AM
Social Hours: 3:30 to 5:30 PM and 9:00 to 11:00 PM.

13453.description: For nearly a century, Waldorf Astoria New York has been a fixture of New York City society, earning its place as a beacon of radiance in the cultural capital of the world. Following an extensive restoration spearheaded by renowned interior designer Pierre-Yves Rochon, the property will retain the scale and beauty of the original Art Deco architecture, reimagined with fresh, contemporary furnishings that pay homage to the original Waldorf Astoria New York. The 375-room hotel will feature some of Manhattan’s largest rooms and suites that will embody the spirit of New York. Hotel guests and visitors will have access to a holistic wellness program, including a spa spanning over 30, 000 square feet and a state-of-the-art fitness center, unmatched culinary offerings with a standout signature restaurant, and 43, 000 square feet of modernized event space, including a striking new opera-inspired Grand Ballroom set to be the crown jewel of New York City’s entertainment scene. Visit waldorfastorianewyork. com for more information or follow the hotel on Instagram at @waldorfnyc and on Facebook at @TheWaldorf. As a Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts’ flagship property in a landmark location, Waldorf Astoria New York will set the new standard for world-class luxury when it opens Spring 2025.

13458.description: Located in the heart of New York City, the luxurious W New York - Times Square is steps from Times Square and Broadway, and a short distance from iconic landmarks like Rockefeller Center and Central Park. This Art Deco hotel offers 509 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring a plasma television, pillowtop bed with down comforters, and a private bathroom with rainfall showerhead. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site shopping, a 24-hour fitness center, and a choice between the hotel's restaurant and room service. Additional amenities include a bar/lounge, wedding services, a ballroom, and meeting spaces.

13750.description: This superb city hotel lies in the leisure district of Marrakech within a short distance of Medina and the beautiful Medina Gardens. The hotel provides the ideal setting from which travellers can explore this spectacular city with its abundance of captivating attractions and exciting activities. The hotel enjoys a typical Moroccan architectural style, inviting guests into the lobby which exudes luxury and comfort with Moorish influences and elaborate decor. The guest rooms are simplistic in style offering uncompromised comfort in which to relax and unwind. The hotel provides a selection of excellent facilities for guests' convenience and enjoyment.

13792.description: A very special hotel in Lisbon. Located in a small palace from the 18th Century, As Janelas Verdes is one of the most unique hotels in Portugal. It perfectly combines all the latest facilities with details that take guests back to a different time, like small pieces of art, wood walls, embroidered cushions, books, paintings and other objects. The famous novelist Eça de Queirós is traditionally linked to this building; it is said that he lived here and got inspiration in the small palace to write some of his books. The views to the Tajo River and Lisbon's most beautiful sights are the icing on the cake in As Janelas Verdes, an establishment that has gained fame over the passing of years. *Register of Tourism: 29/POL/2011

13796.description: With a fantastic location close to Paseo de la Castellana, the H10 Tribeca stands in Madrid's main business district. Recently refurbished by renowned interior designer, Lázaro Rosa-Violán, the hotel takes its name from New York's Tribeca neighbourhood due to its marked industrial inspiration. The hotel offers 140 comfortable rooms, the modern Soho Restaurant, the Lobby Bar, a library and two Meeting Rooms. The large, comfortable rooms at the H10 Tribeca are equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. With a modern design and large picture windows, this welcoming restaurant offers a full buffet breakfast as well as a range of carefully selected Mediterranean and international dishes. You can also enjoy chilling out by taking a drink in the Lobby Bar.

13801.address: Vila Universitària Campus de la UAB, Edifici blanc, s/n
13801.description: This elegant conference hotel enjoys a prime location on the Bellaterra Campus, just 20 km from the vibrant city of Barcelona. Guests benefit from easy access to the city via nearby public transport links. Beautifully appointed guest rooms offer functional space and a relaxing ambiance, ideal for both work and leisure. A wide range of facilities and services further enhances the guest experience.

13804.description: Stay at the Barceló Emperatriz Hotel to discover the wonders of Madrid. Both tourists and business travelers can enjoy the hotel's amenities and services. To be found at the hotel are 24hr room service, free Wi-Fi in guestrooms, daily housekeeping, laundromat, cab. The rooms are designed to provide the optimal level of comfort with cozy decor and various amenities such as flat screen television, bathroom phone, linens, mirror, sewing kit. The hotel's tranquil atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include fitness center, outdoor pool, massage, solarium. Discover all that Madrid has to offer by staying at the Barceló Emperatriz Hotel.

13817.description:
This hotel is located in the Guadarrama mountains. Within 1 km guests will find shopping and entertainment venues as well as public transport.

This mountain hotel consists of 38 double rooms, 4 junior suites and 7 bungalows over 5 floors. There is a lobby with a 24-hour reception and a lift. Further facilities include a café, a bar, a games room, a TV room and an air-conditioned restaurant. A laundry service and room service are also available.

The comfortably furnished rooms are en suite and come with a hairdryer. In addition, all rooms include a TV, background music, a minibar, a safe and central heating. Some of the rooms include a terrace with a view of the Navacerrada reservoir.

There is an indoor heated swimming pool, an outdoor swimming pool for the summer months, a sauna and a massage service available for use. Further leisure offers include table tennis, squash, a paddle, billiards and table football. The nearest ski slopes are located about 8 km away.

Guests are invited to serve themselves from the breakfast buffet. Lunch and evening meals may be chosen from the à la carte menu.

From Madrid take the A6 towards La Coruña and take exit 39 towards Puerto de Navacerrada. Follow the N-601 to the crossroads at Navacerrada. Please note: do not drive into the town, rive another 1 km towards Puerto de Navacerrada until reaching the hotel on the right hand side.

13819.description: This hotel is located within easy access of a host of attractions in the captivating city of Barcelona. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to a wealth of shops, entertainment venues, restaurants and bars. The nearest beach is located just 4 km away. Links to the public transport network are to be found nearby. The hotel enjoys a stunning architectural design, beautifully blending with its artistic surroundings. The guest rooms are exquisitely designed, and are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are invited to enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, for the perfect start to the day.

13837.description: This hotel is ideally situated just 9 km away from the centre of Madrid. Enjoying a peaceful setting, the heart of the entertainment is never far away from this hotel. The hotel lies in close proximity to the many attractions that this bustling city has to offer. A wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found nearby. Convenient public transport links are just 200 metres away from the hotel. This charming hotel greets visitors with warm hospitality. The guest rooms are spacious and well equipped with modern amenities. Business travellers will appreciate the hotel's conference facilities. The hotel features an a la carte restaurant, where delightful dishes can be enjoyed.

13843.description: This hotel is situated in central Lisbon, just steps from the iconic Praça Marquês de Pombal. Conveniently located near public transportation, it offers easy access to countless attractions and shops along Avenida da Liberdade and downtown. The Colombo and Vasco da Gama shopping centers are easily reachable by metro, while the vibrant Bairro Alto, with its array of restaurants, bars, and pubs, is only three metro stops away. Lisbon Airport is a mere 6. 4 km from the hotel. The hotel's 76 cozy, classically furnished rooms feature air conditioning, LCD flat-screen TVs, minibars, and private bathrooms with hairdryers. Business travelers can utilize the well-equipped business room on the first floor, complete with audiovisual facilities for successful meetings. The hotel proudly displays the Portuguese Tourist Official 'Clean and Safe' Seal.

13844.description: This hotel is located in the financial and shopping area of Lisbon, next to Avenida da Liberdade and the Marquês de Pombal metro station. This central location close to public transportation links provides quick and easy access to the whole city. There is a plentiful offer of shops and restaurants in the vicinity and bars and pubs are about 2 km from the hotel. Fulfilled with Portuguese Tourist Official Clean and Safe Seal Determinations.

13853.description: The NH Barcelona La Maquinista hotel is adjacent to the La Maquinista shopping and leisure center, which puts an enormous variety of fine dining establishments and entertainment venues just meters from your hotel room. Shoppers can explore major stores such as Apple, Leroy Merlin and Fnac, just to name a few, and international fashion boutiques are plentiful. NH Barcelona La Maquinista opened in 2004, and consists of 92 rooms spread throughout four floors. Every room is stylishly furnished and boasts lovely hardwood floors and plenty of natural light. A large and well-equipped conference room allows you to take advantage of the latest technologies along with professional catering services to ensure that any private occasion or business event runs smoothly. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a pet deposit.

13861.address: Kadriye Mahallesi beşgöz cad.No:8-1 Serik Antalya, 8
13861.description: Situated near the village of Kadriye, 35 km from Antalya city center, this hotel offers convenient shuttle service to a public beach just 1. 2 km away. Designed to harmonize with the natural surroundings, the hotel boasts extensive facilities, including a luxurious spa, four outdoor pools (some with waterslides), a mini football court, and an internet gaming hall. A diverse international animation program and occasional live music cater to all ages, while a dedicated mini disco keeps younger guests entertained. Throughout your stay, enjoy a variety of dining options, including the main restaurant, four à la carte restaurants, a patisserie, snack restaurants, and multiple bars, all showcasing Innvista Hotels' renowned hospitality. With its exciting water parks featuring slides and toys for all ages, Innvista Hotel Belek promises a fun and memorable holiday for you and your family.

13864.description: This charming beach hotel is located in Obagol, just 3 km from Alanya's center. Guests enjoy easy access to the beach, attractions, shops, and restaurants, with convenient links to public transport. The hotel offers warm hospitality and excellent service. Beautifully appointed guest rooms provide a peaceful retreat, equipped with modern amenities. Guests are invited to enjoy a wide range of hotel facilities and services.

13865.description: This hotel enjoys a stunning setting close to Alanya, close to one of the most beautiful beaches on the Turkish Riviera. The hotel is situated in Incekum, just 1 km from the small town of Avsallar. The town of Alanya is just 20 km away. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a host of attractions in the area, including Alanya Castle and the Manavgat Waterfalls. A wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment venues can be found just a short distance away. This beach hotel appeals to every type of traveller. The guest rooms offer a functional space in which to work and rest in comfort. Complemented by a homely ambience and exemplary service, this wonderful hotel offers first-class facilities, to ensure a memorable stay for each and every traveller.

13871.address: Kiriş Mah. Sahil Yolu Cad. No:88
13871.description: With its unique, award-winning architecture inspired by nature's essential elements, “water, earth, air and fire”, Maxx Royal Kemer Resort introduces a one-of-a-kind holiday experience. Standing out with its “Maxx Inclusive” concept, tailor-made services and elegantly-designed suites and villas, Maxx Royal Kemer Resort offers its guests the most exquisite and unforgettable vacation of their lives. Situated between two secluded bays, Maxx Royal Kemer Resort is surrounded by fragrant pine forests and frequented by friendly wildlife, including the occasionally inquisitive mountain goats.
