Thanks to Maxx Royal Kemer Resort's three private beaches, guests can savour the sea and the sun to the fullest. While the 400-meter Long Beach offers unlimited swimming pleasure with its expansive coast, natural ambiance and private pavilions, the 200-meter Middle Bay Beach is ideal for families thanks to its exclusive area for children. Standing out with its fine sands, Tangerine Beach offers adrenaline-filled moments with a wide range of water sports options.

13873.description: Located in Antalya, one of the most elegant and beautiful cities of the Mediterranean with its rich culture and heritage, the hotels offer you and your loved ones an enjoyable holiday. With its stunning natural scenery and the exciting rhythm of the city, Ma Biche Kemer and its dedicated team await to offer you the holiday of your dreams.

13875.address: Göynük Mah. Ahu Ünal Aysal Cad., 41
13875.description: Built in 1985 and fully renovated in 2015, this popular 453-room hotel caters to both business and leisure travelers. A 24-hour reception, safe, currency exchange, and cloakroom offer convenience. Guests can enjoy the on-site minimarket, shop, and garden views from select rooms. Relax on the terrace, utilize the key collection and room service, or take advantage of laundry and medical services. The hotel is wheelchair accessible and offers bicycle and car hire, airport transfers, and babysitting services. A gym and on-site parking are also available. Multilingual staff provides 24-hour security and bellboy service.

13883.description: This hotel is located close to the sprawling, sandy beach of Kizilagac. Manavgat and the historical town and resort of Side are located just a short driving distance away. This hotel offers guests a great location from which to explore the rich culture and history of the area. The complex enjoys a charming design, beautifully combining elements of traditional and contemporary styles. The guest rooms are exquisitely designed, offering a cocoon of peace and serenity, in which to unwind at the end of the day. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are sure to be impressed by the extensive array of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

13885.description: Independent, award-winning and one of a kind, The Athenaeum Hotel & Residences is London's foremost family-run five-star hotel. An original Art Deco building located in the heart of Mayfair, The Athenaeum Hotel & Residences is the ideal base for your city stay. Following a multi-million-pound refurbishment and with Michelin-starred chefs The Galvin Brothers now at the culinary helm, this Mayfair icon is poised to begin a new era. The Athenaeum Hotel & Residences offers a choice of spacious rooms, suites and a spectacular rooftop Penthouse with private balcony and 180-degree views of the city skyline. Adjoining the hotel are 18 private residences accessed via your own private entrance, with kitchens, living areas and 24-hour In Room Dining.

13889.description: The 3-star Best Western Corona Hotel in London offers comfort and convenience for both business and leisure travelers. Guests will appreciate amenities such as 24-hour room service, complimentary Wi-Fi, taxi service, and express check-in/check-out. The well-appointed guest rooms include amenities to ensure a restful stay. Select rooms feature non-smoking options, air conditioning, heating, and wake-up service. Discover all that London has to offer by making the Best Western Corona Hotel your base.

name.content: Hyde & Seek, part of Tribute Portfolio

13890.description: Hotel will be offering a Grab and Go Breakfast delivered to guest room. Great location for London's city centre attractions. The bright lights of London beckon with a stay at the Corus Hotel Hyde Park. We're in a prime spot for exploring Central London, whether you're shopping for luxury brands at Harrods, rowing a boat across the Serpentine or having a night out in the West End. Just a stone's throw from Lancaster Gate Tube Station, it couldn't be easier to experience the sights and smells of the UK's glittering capital. This elegant 200-year-old Grade II-listed Georgian mansion in Bayswater overlooks Hyde Park, where you can go for a pre-breakfast stroll or jog around this vast open space and dip your toe into the water at the Diana Memorial Fountain. Good food and drink is an important part of our culture, and our conservatory brasserie serves delicious flavours.

13891.description: This hotel enjoys a delightful setting in Compton Place, lying close to the bustling nightlife and shopping districts of London. Guests will find themselves in a great location from which to explore the wonderful attractions, shopping opportunities and entertainment venues that this wonderful city has to offer. The hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and the promise of a relaxing stay. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, offering peaceful setting in which to unwind in comfort at the end of the day. Guests will be pleased by the range of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. Conveniently located by King's Cross St Pancras station for major rail links and the Eurostar.

name.content: Hotel Indigo London K West Shepherd’s Bush

13893.description: This great hotel, located in Notting Hill, enjoys a nice location in a romantic and trendy area of the city. Guests will be able to reach a variety of shopping streets, such as Kensington High Street and convenient transport connections can be reached on foot. The hotel offers guests a large leisure centre with a hot tub. It is perfect for tourists as well as business travelers.

13894.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include babysitting (surcharge) and a banquet hall. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Reform Social and Grill, for lunch, dinner, or brunch. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 484 square feet (45 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Make yourself at home in one of the 142 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring DVD players and LCD televisions.

13895.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a garden. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Grab a bite at Gordon Ramsay Bar And Gri, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 2216 square feet (206 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 10 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 237 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and minibars. 32-inch LCD televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while wireless internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected.

13896.description: Enjoy London from this conveniently located hotel near Hyde Park and Marble Arch. The hotel offers a fitness center, terrace, and garden for your recreation. Savor British cuisine at The Pickled Hen restaurant and bar, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of concierge and wedding services. The 240 guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms, and laptop-compatible safes. For business travelers, a business center and express check-in/check-out are available, along with ample meeting space. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Baker Street, Selfridges, and Kensington Gardens.

name.content: Doubletree by Hilton London - Marble Arch

13897.description: The Doubletree by Hilton London Marble Arch, located in the heart of London's West End near Oxford Street, offers contemporary accommodations and attentive service. Our hotel features modern amenities for business travelers and a prime location ideal for leisure guests. Spacious guest rooms and suites include generous workspaces, comfortable beds, and WiFi in public areas. Guests can enjoy our fitness center, with jogging paths and tennis courts nearby. Relax in the Indigo lobby lounge, or dine at the Fire and Spice Restaurant. Our flexible meeting and event facilities are housed in the historic Bryanston Suite. We look forward to welcoming you with our signature warm Doubletree chocolate chip cookie at check-in.

13898.description: This property sits just a few steps away from Hyde Park, in London. Guests will appreciate close proximity to a wide range of attractions, as well as a host of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. The Heathrow Express rail service at Paddington is just a short distance away, offering ease of access to Heathrow Airport. London's lively West End, with its range of theatres and attractions, can be found just a 10 minutes' walk from the hotel. Guests can relax and unwind in the calming surroundings of the rooms, which offer modern amenities for added convenience. The hotel's staff are on hand to cater for the needs of every type of traveller.

13900.description: This hotel has a convenient location in a quiet, tree-lined residential street near the elegant neighbourhood of Kensington and Chelsea, just metres from Earl's Court London Underground Station. Numerous historical tourist attractions, parks, museums and shopping areas such as Kensington and Knightsbridge can be reached within several minutes. In the vicinity, there are banks and restaurants. Hyde Park, Earl's Court Exhibition Centre and Olympia are all within easy walking distance. The hotel features 25 comfortable guest rooms with modern amenities including complimentary Wi-Fi Internet, fridge, air conditioning, complimentary coffee and tea making facilities and a hairdryer.

13904.description: This hotel offers 393 guest rooms, each equipped with a Smart TV, pillowtop bed, and private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. While Wi-Fi is available for a surcharge, satellite programming is included. Guests can enjoy Italian cuisine at Carluccio's restaurant and bar/lounge, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Recreational facilities include an indoor pool, spa tub, and sauna. The hotel also offers a 24-hour business center, express check-in/check-out, concierge and wedding services, and extensive meeting and conference space. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Located near Stockley Park and just 3 km from Heathrow Airport (LHR), this hotel provides convenient access to Brunel University, Twickenham Stadium, and various other attractions.

13905.description:
Holiday Inn London Gatwick Worth is a convenient Gatwick hotel that has recently undergone a £9 million refurbishment and extension, transforming nearly all areas, including the reception, restaurant, and event suites. The extension added 40 new bedrooms, many of which are family rooms for up to 5 guests, making this one of the few hotels in the area to offer such accommodation. 

Located in Crawley, the hotel is perfect for both business and leisure travellers, with onsite car parking and excellent transport links. We are just 10 minutes from Gatwick Airport (LGW), and our Park, Stay & Go packages allow you to leave your car at the hotel and arrive at the airport feeling relaxed. Three Bridges station, nearby, provides trains to London Victoria in 40 minutes, while Brighton is only a 35-minute drive away. Local attractions include Wakehurst Place and Tulleys Farm, ideal for family days out. The Manor Royal Business District, home to over 500 companies including Thales, L3Harris, and Elekta, is also close by. 

Guests can enjoy free WiFi and a 24-hour reception desk. Our modern, spacious bedrooms feature tea and coffee making facilities and individual temperature control. Family rooms include sofa beds, while accessible rooms are also available. For extra comfort, our suites offer a separate lounge area and super-king-size beds.

13934.description: This hotel is situated close to the city centre, in Barcelona's entertainment centre. Public transport links are located within a few paces of the hotel's entrance. Built in 2000, the hotel offers a total of 63 double rooms spread over 5 floors, of which 2 are singles and 61 are doubles. Amongst the facilities count a foyer with 24-hour reception desk and a safe. There is also a lift, a bar, a TV room, and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with non-smoking area, a conference room and an Internet terminal. A laundry service is also available. The stylish and comfortable rooms are fully equipped. Internet access is also available. Guests may serve themselves at the breakfast buffet. Non smoking property.

13937.description: This city hotel is located in the renowned Barri Gotic of Barcelona, right in the centre of the city and close to Las Ramblas and other places of touristic and cultural interest. Within the area, guests will be able to find a wide range of cafes, restaurants, boutiques and shopping centres, as well as bars, pubs and discos, suitable to all tastes. Public transport services are also reachable within a two minute walk. This is a perfect hotel for those friends or couples wishing to experience Barcelona's vibrant atmosphere.

13943.description: This hotel is located in Incekum, directly beside a wonderful sandy beach, only some 25 km from Alanya. There are numerous shops, restaurants and bars in the area. The hotel is close to Alanya, where there is a plethora of attractions such as Alanya Castle, Alanya Dockyard and Arsenal, the Red Tower, Alanya Archaeological Museum and Damlatas Cave. ***Safe box extra - local payment***

13960.description: With sweeping views of Baía Beach and the Atlantic Ocean, this apartment hotel enjoys a central location in Espinho. The Espinho Casino with its 770 slot machines is situated next door. Hotel Apartamento Solverde offers spacious apartments with fully equipped kitchens and private balconies. Some include free Wi-Fi access and all have LCD TVs with satellite channels. Oporto Golf Club is located within 3 km of Apartamento Solverde. Fishing, surfing and windsurfing are some of the activities available on the beach. Guests can enjoy breakfast in the bright room overlooking the city. The hotel offers a comfortable and welcoming bar. Hotel Apartamento Solverde is about 5 minutes from Espinho Train Station and Porto with its Port wine cellars is about 30 minutes away.

13972.description: The NH Barcelona Les Corts hotel is a mere 6-minute walk from L'Illa Diagonal Mall and less than a kilometer from Les Corts metro station which provides links to the city center. Additional local points of interest include Las Ramblas, Camp Nou, and Santa Eulalia Cathedral. For buses to the beautiful beach, guests need only walk to the stop located 5 minutes away from the hotel. All of the our 81 bright and contemporary guest rooms come with modern comforts such as free Wi-Fi, wood floors, flat screen TVs, and minibars. Larger, upgraded room types also offer coffee and tea makers, and extra space for an additional bed. Each morning a scrumptious breakfast buffet is freshly prepared for our guests. Made-to-order hot dishes and an early bird breakfast are also available upon request. For delicious lunch and dinner selections, our friendly staff will gladly provide recommendations for highly-rated local restaurants. Our professional 24-hour front desk staff are ready to respond to guest requests for additional amenities such as providing extra beds and wake up service.

13973.description: Bohemian Entenza, is located in one of the city's financial and business hubs: Les Corts neighborhood. While it is a quiet area of Barcelona, the hotel is well-connected to the city center and other destinations by metro. The Entença metro station is a short walk away and in 10 minutes on foot guests can reach Barcelona Sants station, with high-speed AVE trains and direct links to the airport. Some close-by attractions also include the famous FC Barcelona Camp Nou Stadium and Plaza de España with singing fountains. For shops and restaurants, head to the Avenida Diagonal 10 minutes away on foot. Bohemian Entenza has 48 bright rooms with large windows, all of which have access to free Wi-Fi. The Superior rooms and Junior Suite have coffee and tea making facilities, as well as complimentary bathrobes and slippers.

13976.description: The NH Madrid Barajas Airport, formerly known as NH Barajas, is a modern hotel set in a tranquil location close to the lovely 18th century Capricho Park. Guests can take the metro from the nearby El Capricho station to the city center of Madrid and enjoy sights such as the Royal Palace and the Plaza Mayor which are only a few minutes away. The trade fair center IFEMA is only a 10-minute walk, and the Wanda Metropolitano Stadium is only 20 minutes away on public transport. All of our 173 bright guest rooms offer contemporary comforts such as free Wi-Fi, and air-conditioning. The spacious rooms can accommodate an extra bed as needed. In the mornings, guests can enjoy a delicious breakfast buffet complete with sweet and savory options. Made-to-order hot dishes and an early bird breakfast are also available upon request. The NH Barajas Restaurant is our quiet yet inviting in-house dining establishment serving Spanish cuisine for lunch and dinner from Monday to Friday. Our Bar serves a great selection of light refreshments in a light and airy ambiance. We offer an airport shuttle service operating between the hours of 6am and 12:30am every day. The shuttle is free to hotel guests and will deliver you to any terminal you choose. To make sure each of our guests enjoys the perfect stay, Our professional 24-hour front desk will be happy to assist with any additional requests.

name.content: Taj 51 Buckingham Gate Suites and Residences

14004.description: Located a short walk from St. James Park and Victoria Stations, Taj 51 Buckingham Gate Suites and Residences places you minutes from iconic landmarks like Buckingham Palace, Westminster Abbey, and the London Eye. This five-star hotel offers 86 contemporary suites, ranging from one to nine bedrooms, including specialty options like the Jaguar and Cinema Suites. Guests enjoy signature Taj excellence, including butler service, the Michelin-starred Quilon Restaurant, and a stunning award-winning courtyard garden. Families appreciate the children's amenities and impeccable five-star service. For further details about our commitment to safety and hygiene, please visit www. taj51buckinghamgate. co. uk/commitment-restrengthened/

14017.description: Hilton London Gatwick Airport is adjacent to the South Terminal and just 10 minutes from the North Terminal by free monorail, with access to the M23 and M25 motorways. Located just 30 minutes from central London by Gatwick Express, the hotel is a short train ride away from the city’s shopping, dining and entertainment scene. Visit nearby Brighton for the day or catch a ride on the Blue Bell railway to enjoy the English countryside. After a day of exploring, relax in a spacious guest room, including 22 family deluxe rooms, fully renovated in June 2021. All rooms include WiFi access and are sound-proofed for your comfort. Upgrade to an Executive Room for more space and exclusive access to the prestigious Executive Lounge. Our Gatwick hotel offers complimentary WiFi in public areas, a 24-hour fitness center, 24-hour Concierge and a business center. The Crew Lounge, newly refurbished in June 2021, offers complimentary WiFi, newspapers, magazines and tea and coffee. Unwind with a meal or cocktails at one of our bars or restaurants or enjoy the privacy of 24-hour room service. Start the day with a delicious breakfast in the family friendly Garden restaurant. Light lunch or snack in Amy’s Lobby Bar, or watch the game in Charlie Fry’s Sports Bar. Plan your next event for up to 450 people in our flexible meeting and event space, with 21 conference rooms including the versatile and fully renovated Ascot Suite.

14020.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a steam room and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a reception hall. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A shuttle from the airport to the hotel is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 49 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms with shower/tub combinations are provided. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

14028.description: This hotel is located just 200 metres away from Brussels' main train station. The city centre is located just 1 km away, where guests can explore the wealth of attractions that it has to offer. A host of shopping, entertainment and dining venues are to be found nearby. The nearest bus stop lies just a short distance away from the hotel. This chic city hotel enjoys a sophisticated design. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, and feature modern amenities for the utmost in comfort and convenience. Guests are invited to enjoy a delightful buffet-style breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day. The hotel offers a arrange of excellent facilities, catering for the needs of every type of traveller.

14034.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Pool, Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Airport Shuttle, Business Center, Complimentary Evening Social, Concierge, Fitness Center, Spa. Welcome to DoubleTree by Hilton Edinburgh Airport, where we'll greet you at check-in with a warm chocolate chip cookie. Our hotel is five minutes from EDI Airport. We're just 20 minutes from city centre and landmarks like Edinburgh Castle, Edinburgh Zoo and Princes Street. Catch a show at the EICC or Royal Highland Showground with ease during your stay. Our spacious guest rooms are styled in cool, calm tones and offer WiFi access, a 32-inch LCD TV, large work desk, USB charging ports, and daily newspaper. Upgrade to a Deluxe room to enjoy a welcome plate, mineral water, plush bathrobe, cosy slippers, and a later check-out time. Gather with friends and co-workers at The Space, a modern venue that merges restaurant, bar and lounge. Savour the diverse menus with locally sourced ingredients, and stay connected with WiFi access, charging stations and Bluetooth connectivity. For your convenience, our Edinburgh hotel also has 24-hour room service. Go for a swim in the heated indoor pool, take a class in the fitness centre, or book a beauty appointment in our spa. Planning an event in Edinburgh? Our hotel provides 22 fully equipped meeting rooms, all with WiFi access, natural daylight and air-conditioning. Host a meeting, social gathering or wedding reception for up to 250 people. The hotel is also pleased to offer event catering, a business centre and ample car parking.

14036.description: This charming city hotel is ideally located in Milan, just 6 km from the city center, offering easy access to the city's many attractions and a variety of nearby dining options. Conveniently situated near public transportation, the hotel features exquisitely designed guest rooms equipped with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy a range of hotel facilities and services. Please note: Rooms do not include a refrigerator or safe. Air conditioning is available for a maximum of 4 hours per day at 25 degrees Celsius, in accordance with current regulations in Lombardy.

14045.description: This charming hotel is located in the center of Vienna, in the city’s quiet 9th district. Situated just a short distance from the Strudlhofstiege, the hotel offers guests a great base from which to explore the many attractions this wonderful city has to offer. The Sigmund Freud Museum is also nearby. The rooms are beautifully furnished and combine classic elegance with modern design. Guests can enjoy a delicious breakfast in the morning to start their day off right.

14062.description: Strategically positioned at the heart of Knightsbridge, this superb establishment offers visitors a prestigious setting from which to explore the city. The property offers close proximity to public transport links, which ensure ease of access to many of the city's must-see attractions. This award-winning property has been awarded a Tripadvisor Certificate of Excellence, as well as the Gold Award for excellent accommodation, by Enjoy England. Stunningly-designed, self-contained apartments offer a home away from home. Well equipped with modern amenities, the accommodation options ensure the utmost in comfort and convenience. Professional, friendly staff are on hand to aid guests with ticket bookings and restaurant reservations, delivering a high level of customer service.

14071.address: Estrada Nacional Sitio de PoÇos-Vale de Touros, 379-2
14071.description: Our 4-star hotel is located close to the historic center and the most emblematic places in the town of Palmela, such as the Castle of Palmela and also to the most important regional business centers. Its privileged location also allows the discovery of the beautiful landscapes of the Arrábida Natural Park and the Sado Estuary Nature Reserve. This development was designed to offer travelers an unforgettable vacation and business customers everything they need during their time with us. In addition to a private space to rest, Amazónia Palmela has to offer guests an outdoor pool, 24-hour reception, 3 meeting rooms, free parking, free Wi-Fi and much more.

14080.description: Just 1969 feet from Victoria Coach and Railway Station, The House on Warwick has a 24-hour front desk elegant rooms with Free WiFi access. Buckingham Palace is a 15-minute walk away. Set in an elegant Georgian terrace, the cozy bedrooms at The House on Warwick have rooms with attached bathroom. There is a great range of international restaurants and Cafes just a short walk away. The hotel is located just a 20-minute walk from central Westminster, home to the Houses of Parliament, Big Ben and Westminster Abbey. Stylish Knightsbridge is a 20-minute walk away.

14091.description: The Hotel Indigo® London Kensington is situated in the heart of the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, our London hotel blends beautifully into this boutique neighbourhood. We’re also located close to the Earl’s Court tube station, placing all of London’s destinations and major transport hubs like Heathrow (LHR) and London City Airports (LCY) within easy reach.

14104.description: This hotel is located in the centre close to Hyde Park and 400 m away from Lancaster Gate tube station and it has great access to all of London's attractions. London Heathrow Airport is approximately 17 km away. With a range of services, this newly refurbished hotel now resembles a more luxurious property with all the trimmings including gold tinted marble flown in from Italy and all furniture hand crafted to create a unique space to relax and unwind. The restaurant houses a stunning conservatory style seating area with floor to ceiling windows, a creative cocktail bar and a beautiful terrace to enjoy some al fresco dining in the summer months. The establishment has 3 fully air-conditioned conference and function rooms a fully renovated lobby with 24-hour reception and wireless Internet. The 168 generously sized guest rooms with large comfy beds and contemporary design offer a restful space away from the fast city pace.

14106.description: Set just a stone's throw away from the British Museum, the charming Grange Blooms Hotel enjoys a privileged location in the heart of literary Bloomsbury. Exclusive shopping venues on Oxford and Regent's Street, Covent Garden and The Brunswick shopping centre are within a short stroll, while famous attractions such as Buckingham Palace, St. Paul's Cathedral, Westminster Abbey, Houses of Parliament, Big Ben or the London Eye are within easy reach. The elegant boutique hotel is situated in an 18th century townhouse, and period features have been restored to their original condition. The beautifully appointed rooms are individually decorated, some with four-poster or canopy beds, and all feature modern amenities such as high-speed WIFI or LCD satellite-TV. With a nod to the area's literary background, the hotel offers a Malt Whisky Library, with a select choice of more than 30 malt whiskies. A true gem in a perfect location.

14107.description: Enjoying a convenient location in the West End of Edinburgh, close to many local attractions and surrounded by beautiful Georgian streets, this luxurious boutique hotel offers a combination of traditional hospitality and modern comforts, where guests can spend a relaxing holiday. Edinburgh's New Town is a beautiful area to explore and the friendly staff of the hotel will be more than happy to suggest some great places to visit. Boasting a Victorian façade, the hotel offers spacious accommodation, all with a stylish décor and especially designed with guests' comfort in mind. Characterised by a sophisticated urban styling, the on-site restaurant is an ideal place to enjoy a pleasant dinner, while sampling delicious local specialities as well as a fine selection of wines. The bar is popular for its light lunches, delicious cocktails and typical afternoon teas.

14120.address: Gran Vía de les Corts Catalanes, 642
14120.description: This hotel enjoys a strategic setting in the heart of Barcelona. The hotel is located just a short distance away from Placa Cataluña and Paseo de Gracia. This wonderful hotel lies within easy access of the many attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer, including la Pedrera, Casa Battlló, Palau Robert, Casa Fargas and Casa Ametller. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to a host of shopping, dining and entertainment venues. Links to the public transport network are to be found nearby. This wonderful hotel is sure to impress, tempting guests into a world of unrivalled elegance and luxury. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, exuding an air of classical splendour and refined elegance. The hotel offers a host of facilities and services, catering for the needs of every type of traveller.

14121.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a seasonal outdoor pool or take in the view from a rooftop terrace. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 28 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

name.content: Rixos Premium Tekirova L.O.L ThemePark Free Access

14124.description: Rixos Premium Tekirova offers fabulous family holidays combining history, culture, quality and luxury. Tekirova sits facing the magnificent Mediterranean Sea with Mount Olympus rising majestically behind the resort creating colourful holidays in every shade of blue and green from the brilliant sky to the shimmering waters and lush scenery. The Turkish Riviera, with its miles of golden sands, hours of sunshine and beautiful azure waters, offers a wealth of activities. Complimentary roundtrip shuttle to The Land Of Legends Theme Park (LOL)• VIP entrance to the park from special gate• A Great Opportunity to Experience Spectacular Night Shows and a Unique Setting of an Open-Air Shopping Conditions:• Guests will enjoy unlimited free access to The Land of Legends Theme Park. • Hotel – Park – Hotel transfers shuttles during the day free of charge. Please contact guest relations for shuttle times. • The All Inclusive – All Exclusive concept is available only in Rixos Premium Tekirova only, not valid for the park. • Some services, food & beverages in The Land of Legends Theme Park are subject to a charge. • Theme Park opening and closing dates are subject to change through The Land of Legends Management. • Land of Legends Theme Park Aqualand does not operate in winter season. • Operation days of theme park may be changed or cancelled depending on weather conditions. • Depending on seasonal and operational conditions the operational status of our units may change

14125.description: Nestled amidst lush greenery with breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea, TUI Magic Life Rixos Beldibi +16 offers a tranquil escape in the charming coastal town of Beldibi on the Turkish Riviera. Guests enjoy complimentary roundtrip shuttle service and VIP entrance to The Land of Legends Theme Park. The resort features [mention at least one other specific facility, e. g. , multiple pools, a spa, or specific dining options] for an unforgettable experience. Note: Access to some services at the theme park may require additional charges.

name.content: Rixos Premium Belek L.O.L Theme Park Free Access

14126.description: The Rixos Premium Belek is amongst a pine and walnut forest on the shores of the Mediterranean coast. Belek's endless sandy beaches and beautiful scenery create a destination full of natural beauty on the Turkish Riviera. Rixos Premium Belek is at the centre of historical, cultural and natural beauties from the Tauras mountains to ancient ruins and national parks. Guests can while away the hours by the pool or head out for a day of cultural sightseeing and adventure. Complimentary roundtrip shuttle to The Land Of Legends Theme Park • VIP entrance to the park from special gate• A Great Opportunity to Experience Spectacular Night Shows and a Unique Setting of an Open-Air Shopping Conditions:• Guests will enjoy unlimited free access to The Land of Legends Theme Park. • Hotel – Park – Hotel transfers shuttles during the day free of charge. Please contact guest relations for shuttle times. • The All Inclusive – All Exclusive concept is available only in Rixos Premium Belek only, not valid for the park. • Some services, food & beverages in The Land of Legends Theme Park are subject to a charge. • Theme Park opening and closing dates are subject to change through The Land of Legends Management. • Land of Legends Theme Park Aqualand does not operate in winter season. • Operation days of theme park may be changed or cancelled depending on weather conditions. • Depending on seasonal and operational conditions the operational status of our units may change

14129.description: This hotel sits next to the IP4, close to the historical district of Braganca. It is surrounded by cultural and historical attractions. . Guests will find themselves within easy access of the nearby traditional villages, where they can experience the cultural traditions. The property is located just a short distance away from the castle. This charming hotel enjoys a modern design, adding a splash of contemporary sophistication to the surroundings. The guest rooms offer the very best in sophisticated design, featuring soothing tones for a peaceful ambiance. All rooms offer free Wi-Fi and room service. The restaurant overlooks the castle and serves international and local meals in a bright setting with lots of windows. The Montesano bar offers drinks and cocktails. Fabulous service and superior accommodations are here to serve all the needs. The hotel is ideal for every type of traveller visiting the area. Scenic views await for the next vacation getaway.

name.content: Mercure Dartford Brands Hatch Hotel & Spa

14140.description: The 4-star Mercure Dartford Brands Hatch Hotel & Spa is set amongst beautiful countryside, making it a great option for those looking to relax and explore. Brands Hatch Motor Racing Circuit is a short drive away, and London Golf Club can also be reached in just a few minutes. After a busy day of exploring, guests are welcome to unwind in the health club, which features an impressive indoor pool and a modern gym. Our Classic, Superior and Privilege room options are designed with style and comfort in mind.

14141.description: This charming London hotel offers a tranquil escape within walking distance of Hampstead Village, St. John's High Street, Primrose Hill, and Belsize Park, renowned for their shops, continental cafes, bars, and restaurants. Easy access to London's West End theaters and attractions is provided by public transport. Enjoy fine dining in the hotel's conservatory-style restaurant, or relax in the adjoining lounge bar, a favorite among guests and locals. The 135 well-appointed bedrooms feature modern comforts, including tea and coffee making facilities and private bathrooms with hair dryers. Limited paid parking is available under the hotel.

14170.description: This modern, glass-fronted hotel is situated in the heart of London's Docklands, offering magnificent views of Canary Wharf. Close to the O2 Arena and London City Airport (a mere ten-minute drive), the hotel provides easy access to the West End via the DLR and tube. Guests can enjoy on-site amenities such as air conditioning in public areas, a bar, two restaurants, and Wi-Fi (for a surcharge). Chargeable parking is also available. Spacious en-suite bedrooms feature TVs and tea/coffee making facilities, while upper-floor rooms boast spectacular views of the Thames and London skyline.

14227.description: Just a stone's throw away from the beach and the warm waters of the Mediterranean Sea, the attractive hotel Bora Bora Butik enjoys a wonderful location in the outskirts of Alanya. The city centre with its countless shops, restaurants and bars as well as attractions such as the Red Tower or the Archaeological Museum is about 4. 5 km away. The international airport of Antalya is at a distance of about 133 km. The holiday hotel offers elegant and stylish rooms with a modern, contemporary interior decoration. They are well-appointed and features include complimentary WIFI, air-conditioning, LCD satellite-TV and a kitchen corner with kettle and fridge. The hotel has an outdoor pool with separated children's area as well as a children's playground. The meals are served in a buffet restaurant, and guests can relax having a drink at the bar. This hotel is a great choice for couples or families with children wishing to spend a nice beach holiday.

14228.description: Refurbished in 2011, this large hotel is located across the road from the sandy beach and Mediterranean Sea and is situated 8 km east along the coast from Alanya in Kestel. In a relatively unbuilt area, the hotel has fruit orchards bordering its grounds. Public transport runs in front of the hotel and the journey to the centre of Alanya takes less than 20 minutes. Shops, café bars and restaurants can be found within 2-3 km of the hotel.

14234.description: The 2-star Altona Hotel is perfect for visitors travelling to Paris in search of value-for-money accommodation. Located within walking distance of the Gare du Nord railway station, the hotel is equally close to Montmartre and Sacre Coeur Basilica. Owned and managed by two brothers, this family-run hotel greets guests with a friendly and personal welcome, and a mix of turn-of-the-century architecture combined with contemporary accommodation. The simply furnished rooms are equipped with bath/shower, telephone, satellite TV and hairdryer; public areas are limited but do include a small lounge area in reception and a spacious breakfast room where guests can enjoy a typically French continental breakfast. Please note that the hotel does not provide any baby cots. Please note : City Tax is NOT included in the price from 1st July 2015

name.content: Sheraton Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport Hotel

14237.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include babysitting (surcharge), gift shops/newsstands, and a hair salon. Enjoy a meal at Restaurant Les Saisons, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. This hotel has 8 meeting rooms available for events. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 252 guestrooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wired internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

14382.description:
Following a comprehensive overhaul in 2025, we widely open our doors once more to unveil a new personality: more welcoming, more up-to-date and devised to offer you an unmatched experience. 
We have redesigned every aspect with first-rate materials such as natural wood featuring warm and soothing tones to create an ambience convivial to feeling at ease, relaxed yet inspired. 
From the warmth of the spaces to the friendliness of our staff, every little detail has been borne in mind so that you will enjoy a one-off and memorable experience. 
Our bedrooms are envisaged to offer the maximum levels of comfort. We have on-hand several room types to suit your needs, all of them with modern design. 
﻿Regardless of whether you travel as a couple or with your family, at the Hotel Zenit Borrell you will revel in a welcoming space in which you can rest and recharge your batteries following a hectic day of business meetings or sightseeing.

14401.description:
Bruntsfield Hotel, WorldHotels Elite is a townhouse hotel just a short walk from Edinburgh city centre, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It’s perfectly located for both leisure breaks and business in the city and enjoys open views across Bruntsfield Links park and the Meadows park. The hotel is within walking distance of Edinburgh Castle, Princes Street and The Royal Mile, and only a short drive from the panoramic views on offer at Arthur's Seat. With this abundance of sights and shops nearby, be rest assured you'll never be met by a dull moment during your stay. 

Limited parking spaces are available on a first come first serve basis at a charge of GBP 12. 50 per day payable locally. A per person pre-authorization taken of 30GBP on arrival. Please note our restaurant will be closed on Mondays and Tuesdays. The bar will open for drinks only on Monday and Tuesday evenings from 5 p. m.

14403.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Brunel Hotel, a short walk from both Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast, served from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM, and later dine in our on-site restaurant. The hotel offers 40 guestrooms equipped with LCD TVs, digital programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each room also features a private bathroom with designer toiletries and a hair dryer, along with convenient amenities such as a laptop-compatible safe and a desk. Business travelers will appreciate our business center and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Additional services include concierge assistance and dry cleaning/laundry. Marble Arch is 1 mile away, while Kensington High Street is 1. 5 miles from the hotel.

14406.description:
Blending timeless British charm with modern sophistication, The Byron Hotel offers a stylish boutique experience in the heart of London. Perfectly suited for both leisure travelers and discerning business guests, our property provides a peaceful, welcoming retreat from the bustling city while keeping you just moments away from London's most iconic attractions. 

Each of our thoughtfully designed rooms features contemporary amenities, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and plush bedding tailored for ultimate relaxation. With exceptional transport links right on our doorstep, exploring the West End, world-class shopping districts, and historic landmarks is completely effortless. 

Whether you are visiting for a weekend getaway or an extended stay, our dedicated team is committed to delivering personalized hospitality and a quintessential London experience. Book your stay at The Byron Hotel and discover your home away from home.

14414.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features wedding services, a picnic area, and barbecue grills. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 175 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is available. Bathrooms have shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

14418.description: The Side Star Resort Hotel offers guests an unforgettable Mediterranean experience with warm hospitality and exceptional service. Located near the historic peninsula of Side and just 12 km from Manavgat, this 5-star beachfront hotel boasts 462 rooms and a pristine Blue Flag-certified sandy beach. Enjoy all-inclusive amenities year-round, with a variety of room types, including suites, family rooms, and standard rooms, each designed with guest comfort in mind and offering stunning views.

14419.description: Located in the Beldibi district, this hotel lies right by a pebble beach (60m away) and is roughly 11 km from the centre of Kemer on Turkey's Mediterranean coast. This inviting hotel features modernly furnished rooms equipped for guests' comfort and convenience. Guests can choose to relax by the pool or take a short stroll to the beach for a refreshing dip in the sea. Some cafe bars, restaurants and shops can be found in the area close to the hotel and public transport stops close to the hotel entrance allowing easy access to Kemer for some great shopping opportunities or for exploring this area of natural beautiful where the Taurus Mountains stretch down to the coast.

name.content: Holiday Inn Club Vacations The Royal Cancun All In

14447.address: Paseo Kukulcan Km. 4.5, Lote C2 Y C2A, Zona Hotele
14447.description: Located on the north shore of Cancun, Holiday Inn Club Vacations The Royal Cancun All Inclusive is the perfect spot for a fun-filled family vacation or a relaxing getaway to revel in the beauty of the Mexican Caribbean. Nestled on a sheltered beach with calm, clear waters, this all-inclusive resort is set in lush tropical gardens and offers two-bedroom villas equipped with everything needed for a great stay. Enjoy stunning views of Cancun's turquoise waters, the resort pools, or gardens from your private balcony as you sip a cocktail. Ready for some fun? There are daily activities for all ages, a kids' club, two pools and a kiddie pool, tennis courts, a multi-sports court, and a fitness center. Try sailing, snorkeling, and paddleboarding, or take a kayak tour through the lagoon. After a morning of water activities, a beach massage is a blissful way to spend the afternoon.

14453.description: This apartment complex offers a privileged location, just 15 minutes by car from Madrid Airport. The complex has easy access to the Chamartín train station and the Juan Carlos I fairgrounds, and it is located a few steps away from the Prosperidad metro stop. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, Esentia Togumar is located just a short drive from Madrid lively city center, brimming with culture, fun and history. The apartments include tastefully designed accommodation options and allow visitors to enjoy a welcoming stay away from home, where they can relax or work in comfort.

14454.description: Centrally located in the popular Eixample district, this aparthotel is just a 5-minute walk from the Arc de Triomf Metro Station and Estacio Del Nord. Plaza Catalunya and arguably the most popular street in the city - La Rambla are a 15-minute walk away and guests who are looking to spark their visit with a shopping spree can find scores of shops just minutes away. The venue is also ideally positioned for anyone who wants a taste of the famous night-life of the city and its remarkable cuisine as tapa-bars and modern clubs are located within minutes. Those who simply prefer a quiet night in, can prepare a light meal in the kitchenette, which is a common feature of all apartments, and enjoy it in the spacious lounge area or on the private balcony.

14455.description: Sitting just next to Gaudí's Sagrada Família church, this apartment complex is as good of a base for exploring Barcelona as possible. Its guests will be just 100 metres from the unfinished landmark and within a 5-minute walk from the beautiful Modernista Hospital Sant Pau, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, while a short commute through the nearby public transport can take one to the beach of the popular destinations such as Las Ramblas. The venue itself is also a great choice for those looking for a long-term accommodation, since it offers fully-equipped kitchens for self-catering, comfortable living rooms where one can easily stretch out and even set-up a home office thanks to the internet access and the direct dial telephone lines. While the cosy king-sized beds and the balconies overlooking the city are ideal for relaxing after the long day.

14471.description: Swissôtel The Bosphorus, Istanbul is a five-star luxury hotel right in the center of Istanbul on the European banks of the Bosphorus. Nestled within 65 acres of historical gardens with world-class shopping and vibrant nightlife nearby. It offers 566 guest rooms and suites, featuring state-of-the-art technology and exclusive amenities. Wake up to views of minarets, the Golden Horn, a verdant garden and the Asian landmass across the water. Revel in five star comfort.

14472.description: This historic Istanbul hotel is a fully renovated manor house set between the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia, less than a five minute walk from each. Its spacious suites are air-conditioned, decorated in warm tones with marble bathroom and parquet flooring, and all with hot tub bathtub and breathtaking city or sea views, many overlooking the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia. Guests can enjoy authentic Turkish cuisine at the hotel's Garden Café and Restaurant, or indulge in a massage, Hammam and sauna after an energizing workout in the wellness centre. The hotel's resourceful, multilingual staff are available 24 hours a day to help with business, entertainment or travel arrangements, and the hotel offers an extensive list of superior services such as currency exchange, car rental service, airport transfers, in-house laundry service and 24-hour room service. With its quality service and unbeatable location, this hotel is ideal for any type of travel.

14473.description: Located in the heart of historical Istanbul, this four star hotel was renovated fully in 2013. Ideal for business and leisure travellers alike, it consists of 108 air-conditioned rooms with a classical decor. Features of the hotel include a wellness centre with indoor pool, Turkish bath, sauna and massage rooms. The roof terrace offers a superb view of the Bosphorus and during summer months traditional Turkish cuisine is served here. The main attractions of Sultanahmet are within a 5-minute walk while the city's modern centre at Taksim Square is 3. 5 km away and Sirkeci train station 450 m.

14474.description: With views over the Bosphorus, InterContinental Istanbul offers a luxury home base from which to explore this historic city. Located in Taksim, our hotel puts you close to historic sites and cultural destinations including Dolmabahce Palace, Taksim Square, and the Nişantaşı shopping district. Enjoy exceptional on-site dining, serving gourmet breakfast buffets and traditional Turkish cuisine. After a day of exploring, indulge in a treatment at our acclaimed SPA InterContinental.

14476.description: This hotel full of splendour and elegance is excellently located in Sirkeci, one of the quarters that form the historic centre of Istanbul. It features a restaurant, a bar and a rooftop terrace with fantastic views over the old town, the Golden Horn and the Bosphorus. Famous sights such as Topkapi palace, Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Spice Bazaar or Grand Bazaar are only a few steps away.

14477.description: This warm and friendly hotel is situated in the Laleli district, close to the historic district of Sultanahmet, the old town of Istanbul. It features a restaurant, a bar and a 24-hours airport shuttle service. The most important attractions of the Turkish capital such as the Topkapi palace, Hagia Sophia, Suleymaniye the Magnificent Mosque or the Grand Bazaar are within walking distance.

14493.description: This hotel is in a superb location on Alanya's famous Cleopatra's Beach. A range of shopping venues, restaurants, bars, nightclubs and links to the public transport network are located in the hotel's immediate vicinity (within 50 m). The lively town centre with its countless entertainment venues is merely 10-15 minutes' walk away. The hotel consists of 7 floors with 60 rooms. The cosy en suite rooms are pleasantly furnished and equipped with modern comforts. The hotel features an outdoor pool with a children's paddling area, a poolside snack bar as well as sun loungers and parasols. Other amenities within the complex include a hot tub, sauna, Turkish bath and a professional massage service. An abundance of water sports and a tennis centre are located nearby.

14494.address: Gullerpinari Mah. Ahmet Tokus Bulvari Selam Sok, 2
14494.description: This hotel is located just across the promenade from the beach. A range of shopping venues, restaurants, bars and links to the public transport network are located in the hotel's immediate vicinity while the lively centre, with numerous shops and entertainment venues, is less than 10 minutes away by public transport. Built in 1992 and refurbished over the years, this 6-storey hotel consists of a total of 122 rooms. Guests can benefit from a small supermarket, a hairdresser, a bar, a games room, a TV room and an air-conditioned restaurant on the roof terrace, offering a wonderful view over Alanya. The hotel also provides an outdoor freshwater pool with a children's paddling area, a poolside snack bar as well as sun loungers and parasols. Guests may make use of the gym and there is a sauna as well as a massage service for an extra charge.

14503.description: Set right on the beach in Alanya, this family-friendly, air-conditioned hotel is perfect for a sunny beach holiday. Families can enjoy its proximity to Disneyland Luna Park, while guests of all ages will appreciate the hotel's private beach area and sparkling outdoor pool with sun loungers and parasols. For additional pampering, there is a fitness centre. The hotel's restaurant serves a buffet-style breakfast, lunch and dinner, and refreshing drinks and snacks can be found at the poolside bar. There is an extensive range of activities and sports to enjoy in the area, including beach volleyball, windsurfing and parasailing, banana or pedal boating, jet skiing. With its excellent location right on the beach, this hotel offers a relaxing holiday in the sun for couples and families alike.

14542.description: Situated in the town of Side right next to the beach, this modern and bright hotel offers 71 bungalow-style apartment rooms. Each bungalow is air-conditioned with en suite bathroom and a balcony or private patio surrounded by a small garden, and comes with free WIFI and onsite parking. Guests may cool off in the hotel's sparkling outdoor pool, or walk just a few steps to the hotel's private beach and immerse themselves in the crystal-clear water of the Mediterranean Sea. The hotel offers a buffet breakfast in the restaurant, where lunch and dinner are a la carte, and meals can also be enjoyed on the shaded terrace surrounded by orange trees and with views of the turquoise sea. A game of table tennis or billiards may be enjoyed in the lounge, and shops, bars and restaurants are just a short walk away in the centre of Side. This hotel provides comfort and privacy for a relaxing holiday of sea and sun.

14550.description: Nestled in London's elegant Bayswater neighborhood, this charming hotel occupies a beautiful 19th-century building, seamlessly blending classic design with modern amenities. A stay in this unique hotel offers a special experience, inviting guests to unpack amidst intimate Victorian surroundings. The hotel boasts convenient access to London's main attractions, points of interest, international airports, railway, and underground stations. Kensington Gardens, renowned for Kensington Palace, the Italian Gardens, the Peter Pan statue, and more, is a mere three-minute walk away. The onsite restaurant delights guests with specialty Malaysian cuisine and beverages. Each of the 111 thoughtfully furnished rooms and suites promises a blissful and relaxing stay.

14551.address: Retorno Del Rey No 36, Zona Hotelera
14551.description: Located in Cancun (Zona Hotelera), Kempinski Hotel Cancún is within a 5-minute drive of Luxury Avenue Shopping Mall and Aquaworld. This 5-star resort is 1. 3 mi (2 km) from La Isla Shopping Mall and 2 mi (3. 1 km) from Iberostar Cancun Golf Course. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, an outdoor tennis court, and a sauna. This resort also features complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Make yourself at home in one of the 363 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and LCD televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Rooms have private balconies or patios. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Grab a bite at Casitas, one of the resort's 6 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, a computer station, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Cancun? This resort has facilities measuring 290626 square feet (27000 square meters), including a conference center. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and limited parking is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Ballenas Beach - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Luxury Avenue Shopping Mall - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Kukulcan Plaza Shopping Mall - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Aquaworld - 1. 4 km/0. 9 mi- Marlin Beach - 1. 5 km/0. 9 mi- Hotel Zone Beaches - 1.

14564.description: This exclusive hotel is beautifully set overlooking Lake Genval, in Brussels. The property sits just a few minutes' driving distance away from the battlefield of the Battle of Waterloo. Links to the public transport network can be found just 1 km away. This stylish property enjoys an attractive architectural design. Sumptuously-designed rooms are sure to impress even the most discerning traveller. Guests will spoilt for choice in the hotel's 2 delectable restaurants. Business travellers are invited to take advantage of the property's 6 conference rooms. The hotel also features an indoor swimming pool, sauna and a gym. Meeting the leisure, dining and business needs of every type of traveller, this hotel fails to disappoint.

14613.description:
greet London Harlow is perfectly positioned for both business and leisure travellers. Just 11 miles, around a 16-minute drive from Stansted Airport, the hotel offers easy access via the nearby M11 and convenient on-site parking. Direct rail links to Central London make it an ideal base for weekend city breaks. We can not wait to greet you. 

The hotel has four flexible meeting rooms, perfect for business conferences, training and team building events and social gatherings of up to 180 guests. Spaces are air-conditioned with modern equipment, Wi-Fi and catering options. Our function spaces can host your weddings, proms, graduations, celebrations of life, birthdays and anniversaries. Plus, the hotel offers plentiful breakfasts and delicious dinner options in our comfortable restaurant. 

Harlow is known as a "Sculpture Town" with over 100 pieces for you to explore nearby. Slightly further afield, our hotel also offers a great base to explore the open green spaces of Essex with Epping Forest reachable in under 30 minutes by car. 

Your comfort is our priority, and our dedicated team is here to ensure your stay is truly memorable. Enjoy every moment of your time with us at greet London Harlow.

14686.description:
Bentley Hotel Bosphorus Special Class was completely renovated in 2022 and has reopened with a stunning new appearance. 

Located in the heart of Istanbul, the hotel is just a few minutes’ walk from the famous shopping and fashion district Nişantaşı and Taksim Square. 

Many of the elements and structures used in the interior design of Bentley Hotel Bosphorus Special Class — such as lighting, comfort, and convenience — were designed by Milanese architects Piero Lissoni and Nicoletta Canesi. 

Thanks to its large windows, guests can enjoy watching the lively atmosphere outside throughout the day, while some rooms offer panoramic views of the Bosphorus. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. 

Elegantly decorated rooms feature a work desk, coffee machine, safe, flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom with a shower. Each room also includes an electric kettle. Guests can enjoy their tea while admiring either sea or city views. 

At the hotel’s restaurant, guests can savor a variety of Turkish and international dishes, as well as rare fusion cuisine specialties. The hotel’s rich open-buffet breakfast is ideal for starting the day before exploring the city. 

The hotel also offers a Spa & Fitness Center. Guests can relax after a long day in the Turkish bath, sauna, and steam room. 

The reception staff, who speak Arabic, English, French, and Turkish, are always ready to assist guests. 

City's Nişantaşı Shopping Mall is 650 meters from the hotel, while Cevahir Shopping Mall is 1. 8 km away. 

Istanbul Lütfi Kırdar International Convention and Exhibition Center and Istanbul Congress Center are only 200 meters away. 

American Hospital and Acıbadem Taksim Hospital are within 1 km, while Florence Nightingale Hospital is 2. 7 km away and Kolan International Hospital is 2. 2 km from the property. 

Bentley Hotel Bosphorus Special Class is located 44 km from Sabiha Gökçen International Airport and 34 km from Istanbul Airport.

14687.description: This Istanbul, Turkey hotel offers the most luxurious accommodations, highest quality of customer service and a convenient location to local attractions such as the Archeological Museum and Beyoglu. Centrally located in historic downtown Istanbul, the Best Western Empire Palace prides itself on unbeatable customer service and beautiful, luxurious accommodations. Situated near several Turkish towns, this Istanbul hotel offers convenient access to attractions such as the Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque also known as the Sultan Ahmet Mosque. The Best Western Empire Palace offers boutique-styled guest rooms each featuring cable satellite television and high-speed Internet access. Guests are welcome to a complimentary full breakfast each morning before heading out to see all that historic Istanbul, Turkey has to offer. Hotel amenities include a foreign currency exchange, guest laundry, massage services, business center and meeting facilities accommodating up to 100 guests. The hotel also boasts a cocktail lounge and restaurant which features both Turkish and International cuisines. The hotel is conveniently located just 0. 2 kilometers from the Archeological Museum and a short distance to the AKM Taksim and Beyoglu. Guests will enjoy spending a day sightseeing or an afternoon shopping around the Egyptian Bazaar. Istanbul is also home to a variety of fairs and festivals throughout the year including elaborate events for New Years Eve and Easter. Make a reservation today and save at the Best Western Empire Palace! Enjoy your stay.

14689.description:
Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can soak up the sun at the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities including an outdoor tennis court and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. This hotel is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Grab a bite at one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 3 bars/lounges.

Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite.

name.content: Millennium Hilton New York One UN Plaza

14739.description: Welcome to Millennium Hilton New York One UN Plaza, a landmark hotel across from the United Nations Headquarters and just blocks from the Empire State Building, Times Square, Rockefeller Center and other Manhattan icons. Starting 28 floors up, our newly renovated guest rooms are artfully appointed and offer plenty of space to work and relax. Enjoy thoughtful amenities such as complimentary WiFi for Honors members, a 40-inch HDTV and mini-fridge plus views over the East River or Manhattan skyline. Suites feature a separate living area, additional bathroom and two HDTVs. We make it easy to stay energized at Millennium Hilton New York One UN Plaza. Work out with a range of cardio and strength-training equipment in the fitness center—open 24 hours and complimentary to hotel guests—or challenge a friend to a game on our tennis court. Treat your taste buds to our Ambassador Grill, open all day. Designated a New York City Landmark in 2017, this restaurant serves globally inspired cuisine in a historic setting. Order cocktails in the Ambassador Lounge or visit Un Café in those on-the-go moments. Plan a board meeting, conference or elegant wedding reception in your choice of versatile event spaces.

name.content: The Benjamin Royal Sonesta New York

14740.description: The Benjamin Royal Sonesta Hotel enjoys a prime midtown Manhattan location near Rockefeller Center, the Museum of Modern Art, Fifth Avenue, and numerous corporate offices and attractions. This elegant hotel exudes old-world charm with oversized rooms and suites, many featuring kitchenettes, living rooms, private terraces, and connecting options. Experience sophisticated glamour in the heart of New York City, steps from iconic landmarks like the Chrysler Building, the United Nations, St. Patrick's Cathedral, and Grand Central Station. The hotel's unique Rest and Renew program, curated by sleep medicine expert Dr. Rebecca Robbins, offers amenities such as a pillow menu, on-demand meditation, and noise machines, ensuring a restful night's sleep. Discover world-class shopping at nearby department stores like Bloomingdale's, Bergdorf Goodman, and Saks Fifth Avenue.

name.content: The Gardens Sonesta ES Suites New York

14742.description: Nestled on a quiet, tree-lined street in Manhattan's Upper East Side, the Gardens Sonesta ES Suites offers a tranquil retreat. This all-suite hotel provides fully equipped kitchens and spacious accommodations, some with private outdoor space. Steps from Central Park and Madison Avenue's renowned shops and museums, our location offers easy access to culture and world-class dining. Enjoy amenities such as our 24-hour fitness center, guest laundry, and business center. Whether traveling for business or leisure, the Gardens Sonesta ES Suites welcomes you.

name.content: Algonquin Hotel Times Square, Autograph Collection

14755.description: The Algonquin Hotel Times Square, Autograph Collection, an Edwardian hotel, offers guests a variety of amenities, including a 24-hour fitness center, a garden, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services. Enjoy a meal at the Lobby restaurant or a drink at the bar/lounge. Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center and express check-out. The hotel boasts over 4, 900 square feet of event space, with seven meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). The 181 guest rooms feature iPod docking stations, flat-screen TVs with cable, premium bedding, pillowtop beds, and private bathrooms with designer toiletries and hair dryers. Located near Bryant Park, Times Square, and Broadway, the hotel offers easy access to many attractions.

name.content: The Beekman Tower Trademark Collection by Wyndham

14790.description: Along with a 24-hour fitness center, this smoke-free aparthotel has a bar/lounge and a 24-hour business center. WiFi in public areas is free. Additionally, 24-hour room service, a business center, and conference space are onsite. Each apartment provides a kitchen with a refrigerator, an oven, a stovetop, and a microwave. For a bit of entertainment, guests will find a flat-screen TV with cable channels, and other amenities include free WiFi and 24-hour room service. Weekly housekeeping is available. The Beekman Tower, Trademark Collection by Wyndham offers 178 accommodations with safes and complimentary bottled water. Each accommodation is individually furnished. 40-inch flat-screen televisions come with premium cable channels. Accommodations at this 3. 5-star aparthotel have kitchens with refrigerators, stovetops, microwaves, and cookware/dishes/utensils. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Guests can surf the web using the complimentary wireless Internet access. Business-friendly amenities include phones; local and long-distance calls are complimentary (restrictions may apply). Additionally, rooms include coffee/tea makers and irons/ironing boards. Housekeeping is provided weekly.

14797.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Concierge, Valet Parking. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Complimentary Evening Social, Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service. Daily Mandatory Urban Destination Charge will be added to the room rate and includes: Premium guest internet access (3 devices); daily $20 beverage credit in Pinnacle Bar; daily $10 food credit in the Coffee Kiosk or lunch/dinner in the Restaurant Above; local and domestic long distance calls. Hilton Times Square is a modern, boutique-style hotel. Originally built in 2000 and soaring 44 stories above Manhattan, this upscale, full-service landmark hotel is located on famous 42nd Street, between 7th and 8th Avenue, in the heart of Times Square and is steps from Broadway theaters, lively nightlife, New York City's best shopping, Restaurant Row, Madame Tussaud's Wax Museum, Ripley's Believe it or Not, Rockefeller Center, Radio City Music Hall and much more. Boasting a modernistic facade and sweeping vistas of New York City's famous skyline and the Hudson River, the hotel is within walking distance of Jacob Javits Convention Center and all major bus/subway lines. Hilton Times Square offers 478 recently renovated, oversized guest rooms, 330-360 sq. ft. , with sleek decor, spectacular panoramic views and high-end amenities including 46-inch flat-screen televisions, laptop-size safes, refrigerators, MP3 players and more. The Zagat-rated Restaurant Above overlooks Times Square and is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Additional hotel amenities include Pinnacle Bar, the hotel's chic lobby lounge, plus a 24-hour business center, 24-hour fitness center, room service and a Concierge/Theater Ticket Desk. For groups and meetings, the hotel has 500 sq. ft. of modern event space conveniently located within the lobby level.

14808.description:
The Surrey offers a prestigious Upper East Side location - within easy walking distance of New Yorks best museums - landmarks and shopping. Central Park is one block from the Hotels doorstep. The Surrey is located on East 76th at Madison Avenue. All of the citys best attractions - theaters - businesses and shopping addresses are within easy reach of the Hotel.An intimate address on the Upper East Side - The Surrey began as a townhouse to the stars of the 1920s and is now a hot 2014 pied-a-terre. Its location on Madison Avenue - just a block from Central Park - gives cultured guests direct access to world-class museums and iconic landmarks - while its discreet service allows for calm personal space.
 
The Surrey offers world-class dining by Cafe Boulud and the atmospheric Bar Pleiades - as well as Cornelia Spa and a Private Roof and Herb Garden featuring seasonal cocktails.  The art-inspired aesthetic and Michelin-starred dining creates a sense of true exclusivity-ideal for intimate meetings or social receptions on the Upper East Side. An impressive collection of 31 original modern artworks are dispersed throughout the private and public spaces. The 189 contemporary salons and suites were created by Lauren Rottet - accommodating style-icons and art aficionados the world over.

14835.description: Novotel London Tower Bridge is a 4-star hotel at the heart of the British capital, just metres from the world-famous Tower Bridge and the Tower of London. With London's landmarks within walking distance and sitting in the shadow of its famous skyline, visitors to London will struggle to find a location better than this. On the doorstep of the City and a couple of stops from Canary Wharf, those visiting on business will love the location and can also take advantage of our excellent on-site facilities.

name.content: Holiday Inn London - Kensington High St

14836.description: Kensington High Street Hotel in the heart of London's Museum &Gallery DistrictHoliday Inn® London Kensington High Street, our London hotel is moments away from High Street Kensington Tube Station. There is an on-site car park with limited chargeable spaces. Local bus stops are two minutes' walk away provide easy access to the city. The Heathrow Express from Paddington Station, two miles away, whisks you to the airport in 15 minutes. The boutique shops of Kensington High Street are just around the corner, and the Science, Natural History and Victoria &Albert museums are all within a mile of our Kensington hotel. The South Bank, Buckingham Palace and central London's galleries and museums are also within easy reach. You can host an intimate event or a conference for up to 300 guests in the hotel's 13 flexible meeting rooms. The private garden is ideal for outdoor events. Printing facilities are available in the on-site e-bar. There's free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Wake up to a buffet breakfast at the Boulevard Restaurant, or finish the day with a taste of contemporary European cuisine. Access to the gym is free and, for a fee you can swim laps in the indoor pool. Grab a light lunch, afternoon tea or a glass of wine with friends in the relaxed Lounge Bar. Kids stay and eat free.

14882.description: Situated in the cultural and historical centre of Istanbul, this lavish hotel opened in the year 2000 just a stone's throw from Sultan Ahmed Mosque, otherwise known as the Blue Mosque. From here, it's easy to explore the city by foot, as the famous Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace and Istanbul Museum of Archaeology are all less than 15 minutes' walk from the hotel, as well as the city's best shops, restaurants and nightclubs. There are also numerous links to public transport nearby. Guests can enjoy stunning panoramic views of the mosque and the Bosphorus from the rooftop restaurant, where a breakfast buffet is available in the morning. The comfortable, air-conditioned rooms are richly decorated with plush fabrics and premium bedding, luxurious right down to the slippers and complimentary tea and coffee tray. Hotel staff are happy to guide travellers with recommendations for sightseeing, shopping, and entertainment as well as assist with airline ticket reservations and car rental.

14885.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This Beaux Arts hotel also features babysitting and a television in a common area. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 19 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and minibars. LCD televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks.
