14900.description: Located in the heart of Madrid, this hostel is just a short walk from Gran Via and Plaza de España, placing you amidst a vibrant array of shops and entertainment. Explore the Spanish capital with ease thanks to excellent public transport links nearby. All rooms feature an en suite bathroom and central heating. Check-in is conducted online; for assistance, please contact us or email losperales@mydhotel. com

14901.address: Gran Via de les Corts Catalanes, 389-391
14901.description: This wonderful urban hotel is located in Barcelona, just beside a popular shopping centre and within a few steps from Plaça Espanya and Fira de Barcelona. The property's prime location, surrounded by metro stations and bus stops, allows visitors to quickly get around this impressive city. This contemporary establishment features minimalistic style and cutting edge comforts to cater for needs of all kinds of travellers. The spacious and generously filled with daylight rooms offer delightful avant-garde design in which to kick back and relax after a day of meetings or venturing into the area. There is a parking and guests travelling for business purposes may make use of conference rooms.

14905.description: The NH Madrid Zurbano hotel is only a 4-minute walk away from the Paseo de la Castellana business corridor and close to the Nuevos Ministerios financial district. Also nearby is the gourmet Chamberí district, where you can enjoy some of the best gastronomy Madrid has to offer. From the Gregorio Marañon metro station guests can enjoy direct links to both the touristic city center and the IFEMA Exhibition Center for business meetings and conferences. The 257 rooms at NH Madrid Zurbano were recently renovated in 2015 and are finished in comfortable neutral colors. Some of the Suites come with lovely terraces and many offer views over the Paseo de la Castellana. Free Wi-Fi is available in every room and throughout the hotel. The restaurant is a cozy space with a light wood paneling. You can enjoy our fresh delicious breakfast here, which features local specialties, such as churros with hot chocolate. The hotel's bar is also open all day. Here you can sink back into the comfy chairs with a coffee or a drink, or enjoy our early bird breakfast which starts at 5am. There is also an on-site gym.

14913.description: MS Aparthotel a strategic setting on the outskirts of Lisbon. The hotel is situated within easy access of the city centre and the international airport. The hotel enjoys an idyllic hilltop location overlooking the river and commanding spectacular views over the Estoril, Cascais and Sintra areas, as well as the Monsanto Park and the National Stadium. This modern hotel is nestled amidst impeccably-landscaped gardens, complementing its surroundings with a touch of sophistication and grandeur. The hotel provides luxurious, elegantly-styled apartments which feature a delightful blend of soft and warm tones, and come well equipped with modern amenities. The hotel provides a selection of business and leisure facilities which are sure to surpass the expectations of even the most discerning traveller.

14915.description: The Hotel Fira Congress, located in Barcelona's Hospitalet business district, offers convenient access to the Fira Gran Via convention center, just 5 km from the city center and 10 km from El Prat Airport. A short 100-meter walk connects you to the L9 metro line, providing easy access to the airport terminals, city center, and Camp Nou Stadium. Its 160 exterior rooms boast city views, modern amenities including minibars and ample natural light, along with complimentary Wi-Fi, in-room safes, and fitness room access. The hotel offers a range of attractive services, including a gym, multifunctional meeting rooms, individual offices (all with wireless internet access), and the Narandam Restaurant and Bar. *Outdoor parking: €5/day. Indoor parking: €14/day. *All rooms are non-smoking.

14917.description: The multi-award-winning Astor Court Hotel offers exceptional value in the heart of London's West End. Located on a quiet street, it's just a five-minute walk from Oxford Circus, Regent's Park, and Great Portland Street tube stations. Refurbished Superior rooms boast a stylish blend of modern comfort and Victorian architecture. Standard rooms on the lower floors provide an excellent base for business and leisure travelers, accommodating one to three guests. A complimentary continental breakfast is included. The hotel also features well-equipped, air-conditioned meeting rooms with natural daylight, ideal for various events. Experience a warm welcome and exceptional service from our dedicated hospitality team.

14919.description: The London Town Hotel is a converted Victorian townhouse, just 100 metres from Earls Court Underground Station. The hotel is situated in the heart of Earls Court in the Royal Borough of Kensington & Chelsea. Rooms at the London Town Hotel have an en suite shower and toilet with a selection of toiletries. They also feature a flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi, a hairdryer, a safe and a telephone. All rooms are non-smoking. Continental breakfast is available on pre-order and is served in the breakfast room. Free tea and coffee is available in the guest lounge, which leads onto the terrace overlooking the garden. Olympia Exhibition Centre is a 15-minute walk away. The famous shopping districts of Kensington and Knightsbridge are nearby and the Tube provides easy access to the West End and Central London.

14923.description: Boasting an excellent central location in London, this convenient and delightful hotel is within easy reach from several points of interest either for business and leisure travellers alike. The establishment is well-serviced with public transport links and a few steps from one of the city's main shopping districts such as Oxford Street and the Kensington area. Hyde Park is also within easy reach from the premises, allowing its guests to enjoy leisurely walks. Built in a Victorian-style building, this hotel's guest rooms are nicely decorated and offer comfortable amenities for a peaceful stay in the British capital. In addition, guests can taste a complimentary, delicious breakfast every morning at the on-site facilities.

14933.description: The total number of guest rooms is 30.

14935.description:
Located 984 feet from Barcelona’s Nova Icaria Beach, Hotel SB Icaria offers a gym, sauna and outdoor pool with sun terrace and hot tub. Rooms include free Wi-Fi and flat-screen satellite TV. 

The Hotel SB Icaria’s stylish modern rooms feature wooden floors and adjustable lighting. Each room has a mini-bar, safe and private bathroom with a hairdryer. 

The hotel’s elegant restaurant serves Mediterranean market cuisine. There is also a bar and a garden terrace. 

Hotel SB Icaria is located in the Olympic Port area, a 10-minute walk from Ciutadella Park and Barcelona Zoo. Ciutadella Metro Station is 2625 feet away, and is just 2 stops from Barcelona Cathedral and the historic Gothic Quarter.

14944.description: The Avenida Park hotel is ideally located in Lisbon's city centre, close to Parque Eduardo VII and the famous Marques de Pombal square, and just a short walk from the shops and restaurants of the city's main thoroughfare, Avenida de Liberdade. It offers 40 guestrooms, all with large windows, and some with a balcony offering stunning views over the green spaces of the park. All the rooms come with an en-suite bathroom, air conditioning, flat-screen satellite TV and free Wi-Fi. A full breakfast buffet is served each morning in the hotel's bright breakfast room and in-room dining is also available. The multilingual staff of Avenida Park hotel are able to arrange both car rentals and tours to nearby tourist attractions, while Parque metro station is just 150 metres away for good transport links across the city.

14967.description: This comfortable hotel lies amidst peaceful gardens and is situated close to the centre of London where there are countless shopping and entertainment venues just waiting to be explored. Links to the public transport network (Earls Court underground station) lie about 100 m away and restaurants and bars are to be found some 800 m from the hotel. This 6-storey hotel was built in 1860, renovated in 1998 and comprises a total of 18 double rooms, 2 twin rooms and 3 suites. Amongst the facilities count a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, lifts and a cloakroom. There is also a café, a bar and free public wifi. Laundry and room services round off the offerings. Each of the well-equipped rooms comes with a bathroom, a hairdryer, a safe, a direct dial telephone, Internet access and satellite/ cable TV. Guests may select their breakfast from and bag to-go breakfast. .

14968.description:
The Edwin Hotel 

Located in the favoured neighbourhood for the rich and famous over the years (Freddie Mercury, Alfred Hitchcock, a young Diana, Princess of Wales and currently Gary Barlow), our boutique townhouse hotel marries period architecture and design with all the contemporary comforts. 

The Edwin Hotel offers the perfect retreat whether travelling alone, on business, or with the family. Earls Court Underground Station, Olympia Exhibition Centre, Harrods, Chelsea and various attractions such as the Natural History Museum and Science Museum are all nearby.

14969.description: Located close to the centre of London, between the districts of Bayswater and Notting Hill, this hotel lies just 1 km from restaurants, bars and various shopping venues. Links to the public transport network lies about 200 m away and Bayswater is the nearest underground station. Built in 1880 and renovated in the year 2000, this hotel comprises 5 floors with a total of 37 double rooms and 7 suites. Facilities include a 24-hour reception desk, lifts, safes and a cloakroom. The rooms come with a bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV and central heating. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample buffet.

14975.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Sidney Hotel London Victoria, including Wi-Fi (surcharge), concierge services, and a television in the common area. Take advantage of discounted access to a nearby fitness center and our reception hall. Dine in our restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 9:00 AM. We also offer wired internet access (surcharge), a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge at scheduled times. Our 80 guestrooms feature LCD televisions with satellite programming, and wired/wireless internet access (surcharge). Private bathrooms with bathtubs include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Each room also provides a phone, safe, and desk.

14976.description: This upmarket hotel is located opposite Las Matas train station, close to the Parque Empresarial de Las Rozas business park, Heron City leisure center, and Las Rozas Village and Factory shopping center. Public transport is within walking distance. The fully air-conditioned hotel offers a cafe bar, a restaurant, and three conference rooms with a capacity of up to 150 people. Free parking is available in the hotel's garage. The spacious and comfortably appointed soundproofed rooms each feature an en suite bathroom, a lounge area, an office space, and a balcony. All rooms are well-equipped. The hotel also provides specially designed rooms for guests with disabilities. The nearest golf course is 5 km away, and a ski resort with lifts and slopes is approximately 30 km from the hotel. Guests can enjoy a breakfast buffet each morning.

14978.description:
The Petit Palace Puerta del Sol, completely refurbished in 2026, enjoys a privileged location next to Puerta del Sol, in the very heart of Madrid. The hotel offers comfortable rooms with free WiFi, ideal for both leisure and business stays. 

The recently refurbished rooms feature a modern and functional design. They are soundproofed and include parquet flooring, air conditioning, a minibar, a safe, and a private bathroom with a hairdryer, all designed to ensure maximum comfort during your stay. 

A full buffet breakfast is served every morning. In addition, the hotel is surrounded by numerous bars and restaurants where guests can enjoy Madrid’s diverse gastronomy. 

The 24-hour reception staff will be happy to provide practical information about the city’s main attractions. The hotel also offers complimentary bicycles, free baby cots for family stays, and single rooms if you prefer to travel on your own. 

Thanks to its excellent location, the hotel is just a 10-minute walk from the Royal Palace and Plaza Mayor. The Prado Museum, the Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum, and the Reina Sofía Museum are also within walking distance.

14979.description:
Petit Palace Triball Gran Vía is a boutique hotel in Madrid's Malasaña neighbourhood, two minutes from Gran Vía and the Chueca district. Set in a charming 19th-century building in the city centre, it puts Madrid's most eclectic streets at your doorstep and the Golden Triangle of Art — the Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen-Bornemisza museums — within easy reach. The surrounding streets are full of the independent shops, terraces and bars this neighbourhood is known for. 

The rooms pair the character of the building with modern facilities, including a flat-screen TV, a hydromassage shower and free WiFi throughout the hotel. Rooms with Gran Vía views, rooms with a terrace and rooms for 3, 4, 5 and up to 6 guests make it easy to travel with friends or family. Pets are welcome, with a charge of EUR 25 per pet, per stay. 

Start the day with breakfast before heading out to explore. Free bicycle hire lets you discover the city centre at your own pace, and late check-out until 3pm is available on Sundays and Mondays, subject to availability. With its location, its historic building and its neighbourhood feel, Petit Palace Triball Gran Vía is the place to experience Madrid like a local.

14982.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). For lunch or dinner, stop by XX-XXVIII Restaurant, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 139 square feet (13 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 3 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 86 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment.

14985.description: This charming 4 Star boutique hotel is an ideal option for business and leisure stays in the heart of London, only a few minutes from Hyde Park and within walking distance of Oxford Street and Notting Hill shopping areas. Located in a typical and recently remodeled Victorian building, enjoy this peaceful setting in a residential area with privileged views of Queens Gardens. A tranquil oasis to unwind from the city's frantic rhythm. Its classic English style front is in contrast with the modern and minimalist interior, decorated with fascinating Roman mosaics. The hotel features 140 stylish fully refurbished guest bedrooms, with warm comfortable atmospheres and modern amenities. With a gymnasium, sauna, business room and two unique gastronomic areas, enabling you to savor creative Spanish cuisine in the heart of England's capital.

14986.description:
Situated near the iconic Tower Bridge and Tower of London, Leonardo Royal Hotel London City is the perfect destination for leisure, business, and family travellers seeking to explore the heart of the capital. With a prime city centre location, it offers convenient access to some of London's top attractions, including Petticoat Lane Market, The O2, and St Katharine Docks. 

The hotel is just a two-minute walk from Tower Hill tube station, while Fenchurch Street station and Tower Gateway DLR are only four minutes away. These nearby stations provide quick access to London City Airport and other parts of the city. 

 Guests can enjoy an afternoon at the historic Tower of London, home to the Crown Jewels, or visit the Whitechapel Gallery, just a 15-minute walk from the hotel. Covent Garden, Oxford Street, and Carnaby Street are easily accessible by tube for shopping enthusiasts. 

Leonardo Royal Hotel London City features 317 spacious and comfortable guestrooms, all with modern décor and DREAM beds by Leonardo, ensuring a restful stay. Executive rooms offer additional amenities for those seeking extra comfort. The hotel also offers rooms designed for wheelchair access, meeting the highest accessibility standards. 

Families are well catered to, with rooms accommodating up to four adults or two adults and two children, making it an ideal choice for a family visit to London. In-room amenities include free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and luxury bedding for a great night’s sleep. 

Guests can enjoy a variety of dining options onsite. Leo’s Bar and Restaurant serves Mediterranean cuisine in stylish surroundings, while Corvo Bar & Café offers more casual dining with a selection of sandwiches, soups, and salads. Whether you’re looking for a hearty breakfast or a cocktail after a long day, both venues provide excellent choices for dining and relaxation.

14990.description: With the Gloucester Road subway station just across the road, our hotel is in a great location for exploring London. Located in the museum district, we are within a mile of Kensington Palace, Hyde Park, and the Natural History Museum. Knightsbridge luxury shops and eateries are just a mile away. Unwind in our private garden after a busy day.

14991.description: This modest hotel, built in the mid-19th century, is situated in a quiet area within walking distance of London's city center. Guests will find public transport conveniently located nearby, providing easy access to the city's many tourist attractions and cultural sites. Perfect for both couples and groups, this hotel offers flexible accommodations ranging from single rooms to family rooms with a mix of single and bunk beds, sleeping up to seven people. Rooms are clean, fresh, and simply decorated in a minimalist style. While a budget hotel, it prides itself on offering a little something extra. Guests can expect warm rooms with comfortable beds, private en-suite showers, flat-screen TVs, and Wi-Fi.

14993.description: Novotel London Bridge is a 4-Star hotel in an ideal location. Guests will find great tourist attractions such as the Shard, the Tate Modern, St. Pauls Cathedral and Borough Market - all within walking distance. Those looking to travel further afield can do so easily with multiple tube stations located nearby.

14994.description: A stay at Novotel London Waterloo places you in the heart of London, within a 15-minute walk of Westminster Abbey and London Eye. This upscale hotel is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Westminster Bridge and 0. 9 mi (1. 5 km) from Big Ben. Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center and bicycles to rent. This Art Deco hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 187 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Elements, for lunch, dinner, or brunch. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 2153 square feet (200 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. St. Thomas' Hospital - 0.

14995.description: This modern hotel is located in London, lying within easy access of a host of shopping and entertainment venues. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to many of the city's most prominent attractions. London Heathrow Airport lies within easy access of this hotel. This charming hotel enjoys a delightful architectural design. The guest rooms are exquisitely designed, bathing visitors in luxury and classical elegance. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests will appreciate the wide range of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. Guests can enjoy delightful dining in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

14997.description: This charming hotel is situated at the heart of London near to the Royal Albert Hall and Hyde Park. The shopping quarter of Knightsbridge with the famous department store Harrods is only a few minutes away. Links to the public transport network are within 150m of the hotel.Bars, pubs, and restaurants are to be found in the vicinity.The hotel additionally offers a bar, an à la carte restaurant and a conference room. Room and laundry services are also offered.The comfortably furnished rooms come with an en-suite bathroom. All of them come fully-equipped as standard. Guests may make use of the sauna and the gym for those wishing to keep fit.Guests may select their breakfast and midday meals from ample buffets. Lunch and dinner may alternatively be taken à la carte or chosen from a menu.

14998.description: This elegant hotel is wonderfully situated in Covent Garden, within easy walking distance of several attractions, including the British Museum, Trafalgar Square, and Leicester Square’s entertainment district. From this ideal location, guests can readily explore the captivating city, with Kingsway Hall, popular theaters, and the Covent Garden metro station nearby. The hotel offers elegantly designed guest rooms, each richly appointed in classic style. Guests can also enjoy a delightful dining experience in the hotel restaurant.

name.content: Petit Palace Junior anteriormente Sunotel Junior

14999.description: Petit Palace Junior formerly known as Sunotel Junior. Situated in a tranquil yet elegant neighborhood, this hotel offers an ideal base for exploring Barcelona's vibrant attractions. Conveniently located near public transport, guests can easily access the city's key areas. Foodies, shoppers, and architecture enthusiasts will find themselves within walking distance of numerous restaurants, boutiques, and iconic buildings. The hotel features 34 well-appointed guest rooms, each equipped with satellite TV, air conditioning, a desk, and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. Guests can unwind on the rooftop terrace, boasting a seasonal pool, a hot tub, and stunning panoramic views of Barcelona. This hotel presents a perfect retreat for both couples and families seeking a relaxing getaway. The hotel is a mere 30-minute drive from Barcelona El Prat Airport.

15001.description: This impressive resort hotel is set amidst beautiful gardens, lying on a pebble beach in Kemer. The hotel is located just a short distance away from a host of shopping and entertainment venues. Guests will find themselves in a great setting from which to explore the wonders of the area. Links to the public transport network are available nearby. This charming hotel tempts guests into a veritable lap of luxury. The guest rooms are sumptuously designed, offering a cocoon of peace and serenity, in which to completely unwind at the end of the day. Guests will appreacite the host of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

15003.description: This resort is a 3 minute walk to the plaja. This beachfront hotel offers rooms with private balconies and free Wi-Fi. The hotel has an outdoor pool with water slides and a sauna. The poolside restaurant serves dinner with its theme. The rooms of Club Boran have a simple decadence. All air-conditioned rooms are equipped with satellite TV, a safe and a minibar. All rooms are serviced daily. Additional facilities offered by the hotel include a games room, tennis courts and various sports clubs. Relaxation facilities include a hammam and a steam bath. Café Mare serves hot drinks and sugary snacks in an informal environment. Guests can enjoy imported alcoholic beverages and cocktails at Mango Bar. Club Boran Mare Beach is a 15-minute drive from the cultural attractions of Kemer such as Yörük Park.

15005.description: This elegant city hotel is situated in the Hoca Pasa neighbourhood of Istanbul just a five minute stroll from the Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, and Museum of Archaeology. Leisure travellers and business travellers alike can appreciate the hotel's central location, stress-free arrival and departure with airport transfers, the luxury of 24-hour room service, and convenience of staying connected to home and work with internet access. Rooms are spacious yet cosy with air-conditioning and double-glazed windows to ensure a good night's rest. The hotel restaurant serves delicious traditional Turkish cuisine on the terrace, where guests can take in 360 degree panoramic views of the city, while the bar is a delightful place to enjoy aperitifs or cocktails. This hotel provides the ideal place to rest whether after a long day exploring the city or a productive business meeting.

name.content: Sanderson London, A Morgans Originals Hotel

15006.description:
Step off the busy streets of Fitzrovia and into a world where reality loosens its grip. 

Hidden behind an unassuming façade, Sanderson has spent decades blurring the line between hotel and fantasy. Designed by Philippe Starck, Sanderson is one of London's most imaginative destinations, where surreal design, playful details and unexpected moments wait around every corner. 

While the city hums away outside, life inside moves to its own rhythm. Drift between long lunches, hidden cocktails and late-night conversations, while the hotel's iconic spaces invite curiosity at every turn. From the famous Long Bar and enchanting Courtyard to bedrooms designed to view your retreat from a new perspective, Sanderson offers a London experience unlike any other. 

Located moments from Oxford Street, the hotel places some of London's most exciting neighbourhoods within easy reach, yet there's something about Sanderson that makes leaving feel entirely optional.

15007.description: Viewed through a classic British lens with a dash of eccentricity, designer Philippe Starck conceived St Martins Lane London as a surreal wonderland. Elegant and edgy meet decadent in our social spaces, featuring gold tooth seating, life-sized chess pieces, and a boutique tea façade hiding something special. Fittingly situated in Covent Garden's bustling Theatre District, the hotel is pure drama.

15018.description: This delightful aparthotel is nestled in Edinburgh's cultural heart, steps from the historic Royal Mile and a short 5-minute walk from Princes Street. Edinburgh Castle and Camera Obscura are also within easy reach. Ideal for exploring this captivating city, the contemporary aparthotel offers relaxing accommodations with elegant, streamlined wooden floors and modern amenities. Nearby public transport links add to the convenience.

15019.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center, complimentary wireless internet access, and wedding services. This Edinburgh hotel also features tour/ticket assistance, a banquet hall, and a vending machine. Dine at Brasserie, specializing in British cuisine, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served weekdays from 7:00 to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:00 to 11:00 AM (fees apply). The hotel offers dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. With 1, 926 square feet (179 square meters) of event space, including conference and meeting rooms, it's ideal for hosting events. Free self-parking is available. Each of the 100 guest rooms features a flat-screen television with digital programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer, a coffee/tea maker, and an iron/ironing board. Nearby attractions include Edinburgh Port, Ocean Terminal Shopping Centre, Leith Links, and the Royal Yacht Britannia. The preferred airport is Edinburgh Airport (EDI).

15021.description: This impressive hotel enjoys a quiet setting in Edinburgh's beautiful and historic city center. Located midway between Haymarket railway station and Edinburgh Zoo, both less than two kilometers away, it's ideal for exploring the area. Guests find themselves in a cosmopolitan and historic downtown, with Edinburgh Castle and the National Museum of Scotland a short ride away. This charming establishment boasts Victorian design and warm Scottish hospitality. Its comfortable and beautifully decorated rooms offer a relaxing retreat after a day of meetings or sightseeing. Guests will delight in the home-cooked dishes and unique ambiance of the hotel restaurant and afterward, they may enjoy a drink in the beer garden. A meeting room is available for business travelers, and complimentary parking is provided.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Edinburgh City Centre

15026.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: On-site Restaurant(s). Stylish, modern conveniences meet old-world charm at DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Edinburgh City Centre. Set in the center of the city, this 1892 listed building offers a fantastic location within walking distance of many of Edinburgh's famous attractions. We look forward to welcoming you to the hotel and to Edinburgh with a warm chocolate-chip cookie at check-in. Make yourself comfortable in an elegant guest room with amenities for work and relaxation, including WiFi access. Select a spacious suite or deluxe room for spectacular views of Edinburgh Castle. Dine, for breakfast, lunch and dinner in the Bread Street Brasserie. With a focus on fresh, quality ingredients, this Edinburgh restaurant offers a delightful menu with options to suit any occasion and palate. After a busy day exploring the city, unwind with a refreshing cocktail in Monboddo Bar or reinvigorate with a workout in the complimentary 24-hour fitness center. With its central location steps from the financial district, our dedicated glass-fronted Conference Venue is ideal for meetings in Edinburgh. Allow our events staff to lend a hand, providing the latest A/V equipment rental and professional services. Choose the stunning Penthouse for a memorable, bespoke Edinburgh wedding or celebration. The Penthouse offers a truly exceptional experience with its outdoor decking area and views of the city skyline, the castle and the River Forth on the horizon.

15037.description: This hotel is located amidst the splendour and beauty of Barcelona's tourist centre. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from a host of attractions in the city, including the Placa Cataluña. An abundance of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues are to be found nearby. This charming hotel greets guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, offering a peaceful setting in which to unwind at the end of the day. Guests can enjoy delightful dining in the restaurant. The hotel features a wide range of exemplary facilities and services.

15038.description: Enjoy a complimentary local breakfast daily from 7:00 to 9:00 AM at the Luna Simone Hotel, a centrally located guesthouse in London's City Centre, just a short drive from Westminster Abbey and Hyde Park. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and make use of convenient amenities such as tour/ticket assistance. The 36 guestrooms feature Smart TVs, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, safes, and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. Victoria Station is just 0. 5 miles away, and Buckingham Palace is 1. 2 miles from the hotel. Heathrow Airport (LHR) is the preferred airport for the hotel.

15059.description: TRYP by Wyndham is a select service upper midscale hotel brand with over 100 locations tucked in the heart of some of the most dynamic and cosmopolitan cities in Europe and the Americas. TRYP hotels cater to both business and leisure travelers who value quality of life with professional excellence by offering several specialty guest rooms including Family Rooms with bunk beds and Fitness Rooms with exercise equipment. TRYP offers a unique experience that encourages guests to enjoy the city socialize and live life to the fullest.

15084.address: Kücük Ayasofya Mah. Şehit Mehmet Paşa Sk., 3
15084.description: Situated right in the heart of the Sultanahmet neighbourhood of Istanbul, less than five minutes from the Blue Mosque, this elegant and charming hotel offers an unbeatable location from which to explore the city. Guests can easily discover the wonders of this ancient city such as the Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, Topkapi Palace and Museum of Archaeology, all within walking distance of the hotel, in addition to the city's finest restaurants, shops and nightclubs. After a busy day of sightseeing or meetings, guests may relax with a hot tea or refreshing drink on the garden terrace. Rooms are lavishly decorated in traditional Turkish style, all with free wireless internet access and orthopaedic beds to ensure a good night's sleep and a pleasant stay. For added convenience, the hotel offers an airport transfer service, valet parking and currency exchange. Whether travelling for business or leisure, this hotel provides exemplary comfort and convenience in a fabulous location.

15101.description: This establishment offers luxurious private apartments that are well-placed for Hyde Park, Notting Hill and Kensington Palace. All apartments have modern, open-plan kitchenettes and are fully furnished with high-quality modern appliances. They are ideal if you require independence, space and serviced accommodation. Grand Plaza is 5 minutes’ walk from Paddington Train Station and is a short walk from Whiteley's shopping centre. Bayswater and Queensway Tube stations are a short distance away. Complimentary high-speed broadband internet is available. The apartments, holding up to 6 people, have a double room and the rest of the guests sleep in the living room. The bathroom is inside the master bedroom.

15102.description: This attractive apartment complex enjoys a prime location in Knightsbridge's shopping district, just a short walk from Kensington Palace and Hyde Park. Nearby attractions include the Natural History Museum, the Victoria and Albert Museum, and Harrods. Public parking and transport links are easily accessible. Numerous shops, bars, pubs, and restaurants are within a 2 km radius. Built in 1950 and renovated in 2001, the eight-story complex houses 89 apartments. Guests enjoy a 24-hour reception with safe and currency exchange, a cloakroom, lift, café, casino, restaurant with highchairs, internet terminal, laundry, and room service. The modern apartments feature tiled en suite bathrooms with hairdryers, direct dial telephones, satellite/cable TV, radios, internet access, kitchenettes, fridges, double beds, carpeting, central heating, and safes.

15103.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional amenities at this aparthotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Fraser Suites Queens Gate. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Make yourself at home in one of the 105 air-conditioned rooms featuring kitchenettes with refrigerators and microwaves. 40-inch LCD televisions with digital programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Cromwell Road - 0. 1 km / 0.

15126.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Hilton London Heathrow Airport is well connected to transport hubs, with direct access into Heathrow Airport’s Terminal 4 via a covered walkway. The hotel is located less than 15 minutes from Heathrow Terminals 2, 3, and 5, and our guest service team will be happy to assist with your connection. Paddington Station in Central London is 30 minutes away via Heathrow Express. Windsor Castle, and LEGOLAND® Windsor Resort are within 12 miles of our door. With 398 guest rooms, which includes executive rooms and stylish suites for the ultimate in luxury, the hotel also offers guests a whole host of amenities. Along with an onsite gym, fitness lovers can take advantage of the running and walking trails in the parklands around the hotel, or enjoy a meal, snack, or drink in one of the three OXBO dining experiences, which are available from early morning until late at night. The hotel boasts an OXBO Café, OXBO Bar, and OXBO Kitchen, each offering their own distinct menu – but all offering responsibly sourced, comforting, and generous dishes. The hotel has extensive conference, events, and meeting facilities, with 15 meeting rooms which can easily accommodate numbers from one to 300. The event spaces include the Concorde Atrium, with floor to ceiling windows, allowing natural light to infiltrate the space with a fantastic view over the hotel pond. It can easily accommodate up to 140 people and is versatile enough to accommodate everything from a drinks reception to a product launch.

On entering this charming hotel, you'll sense its unique atmosphere, making you feel at home. Every detail in the hotel has been carefully considered with your comfort in mind. Experience the hotel restaurant, Marco's New York Italian, courtesy of celebrity Chef Marco Pierre White.

15155.description: Contemporary chic and glamorous, Delano London Hotel offers the ultimate experience in the heart of London. Located opposite Hyde Park and overlooking Kensington Gardens and Palace, the hotel boasts an exclusive location close to the Royal Albert Hall , world renowned museums, and Knightsbridge. Set in an original Victorian building, the hotel flawlessly blends traditional style with modern elegance.

15159.description: This luxurious hotel enjoys a prime setting in a central quarter of Barcelona. The hotel is located within easy access of the many intriguing attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from a wealth of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. This elegant hotel is sure to impress, tempting guests with the promise of a truly memorable stay. The guest rooms are luxuriously designed, featuring lavish furnishings and a classical style. The hotel features a boundless array of exemplary facilities, catering for the needs of discerning travellers to the highest level of excellence.

15163.description: This design hotel is centrally located in the vibrant Gay-xample area, welcoming both gay and straight guests. It's also close to the exclusive boutiques on Passeig de Gràcia. Its new 500 m² spa features a heated pool with a water circuit, fitness room, experience showers, sauna, and hammam, accessible for €20 per person per hour. The Sky Bar by Axel, a rooftop terrace bar with stunning views, boasts a large pool, solarium, jacuzzi, and cocktail bar, hosting parties, art exhibitions, and shows. The Kitchen by Axel Restaurant offers Italian-Mediterranean cuisine. Located on the ground floor, the Ground Bar opens in the evenings, serving delicious cocktails accompanied by a DJ. A business center with free internet access is available on the first floor. All spacious rooms feature modern design and amenities, including a flat-screen satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and a safe. Guests must be 18 years or older.

15166.description: A modern hotel near Gatwick Airport with secure parking and a shuttle bus to the airport Holiday Inn® London - Gatwick Airport hotel offers sleek, comfortable rooms just five minutes drive from Gatwick Airport. Guests can take the convenient 24-hour airport shuttle bus from the hotel, which runs every 15–30 minutes, and every hour from 00:00-03:00. *chargeable, card only. If you book a Park, Stay & Go package, you can leave the car in the hotel's secure car park for four, eight or 15 days while you enjoy your holiday. Whether you're taking the family to the beaches of Tenerife or the ruins of Rome, you can have a good night's sleep knowing you're only five minutes from Gatwick Airport.  To start the holiday early, take the kids to Chessington World of Adventures, about a 30-minute drive from the hotel, or catch the Gatwick Express for a half-hour journey to London. Business guests can catch up on work in the modern rooms, thanks to the free Wi-Fi and comfortable work desk. You can hold a conference for up to 220 delegates in one of 11 fully equipped meeting rooms.  Set up your presentation with the digital projector, or improvise with a whiteboard. Lunchtime meeting? You can order salads or hot food for your team. Have a relaxing night with a tasty meal from the stylish restaurant. Kids stay and eat free, and they can choose from a delicious menu.  You can check in for your flight with free Wi-Fi.

15170.description: A 5-star hotel in the heart of Knightsbridge London, near Harrods and Harvey NicholsAs one of London's first boutique hotels we are proud members of Pride of Britain and Small Luxury Hotels of the World. The Capital hotel, Apartments & Townhouse prides itself on being epitome of authentic British hospitality, through our passionate staff who are dedicated to meeting your every need throughout your stay. The 5-star hotel near Harrods was awarded Best Hotel and Best Business for Customer Service at the Royal Borough of Kensington & Chelsea Business Awards 2018. At The Capital Hotel all of its elegant rooms are individually designed and classically decorated with original art and antique furniture adding to the already quintessentially British atmosphere of the hotel. For guests choosing to stay a little longer you can experience our Capital Apartments with en-suite facilities and self-catered kitchens making our 5-star hotel apartments the perfect London residence, with the added benefit of being able to access all hotel facilities. Choose from our studio apartments or go all out and treat yourself to our three bedroom penthouse. For the more modern traveller our twelve key Capital Townhouse offers unmatched comfort, style and convenience from its off the street entrance separate to the main hotel. Discover the award-winning Restaurant at The Capital, the hotels famous English Afternoon Tea or our extensive whiskey collection at The Capital Bar. With Knightsbridge tube station only a stone's throw away from the hotel we are in a fantastic location for you to get to all of London's landmarks and attractions. Come experience London living at The Capital hotel, Apartments & Townhouse.

15176.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Duke of Leinster Hotel, just a short walk from Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park. This hotel offers 36 guestrooms equipped with LCD televisions, digital programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast, served weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Additional amenities include a business center, concierge services, and limo/town car service.

15177.description: Centrally located in London, Edward Hotel Paddington is a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. This hotel offers 46 air-conditioned rooms with LCD TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers and complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy room service during limited hours, concierge services, and convenient on-site parking. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk and multilingual staff. Nearby attractions include Marble Arch, Royal Albert Hall, and Kensington Palace.

15178.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Kensington Court Hotel, conveniently located a short walk from Kensington High Street and the Design Museum. The hotel offers 35 guestrooms equipped with minibars, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, and in-room safes and desks. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. Additional amenities include concierge services, a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre and the Natural History Museum.

15185.description: Welcome to the Side Star Beach Hotel, a 5-star beachfront property boasting 266 rooms. Located a mere 10-minute walk from the ancient city of Side, our hotel rests on a Blue Flag certified sandy beach. Ideal for couples and families seeking a stylish and relaxing Turkish getaway, we offer a sparkling swimming pool, contemporary bars, and a welcoming atmosphere. The hotel is situated in the historic town of Side, 30 km from the ancient Roman amphitheater of Aspendos, 65 km from Antalya International Airport, and 70 km from Antalya city center.

15186.description: Enjoying fantastic panoramic views over the Mediterranean Sea, the Taurus mountain range and the city of Alanya from its hillside location, this great club resort is an excellent place to spend one's holidays. Several outdoor pools, an indoor pool and a spa area are perfect to relax. The private beach and the historic centre of Alanya with its castle and the Red Tower are easily reachable by shuttle bus.

name.content: Elite World Comfy İstanbul Taksim Hotel

15187.description: This attractive, "newly renovated", and exclusive hotel is situated in Taksim, the business district and meeting point of Istanbul. It's just a five minute walk from Taksim metro stop, making it easy for guests to explore the city, and a short stroll from the Lutfi Kirdar Convention and Exhibition Centre and Ataturk Culture Centre. This location is ideal for business travel, and the hotel also has four sizable and elegant meeting halls, well-equipped with the latest technology for presentations and seminars. The hotel is lavishly decorated with ottoman-influenced designs, and rooms come complete with pillow menu, 24-hour room service and babysitting on request. The wellness centre provides personal trainers to design individual fitness programmes as well as an opulent indoor pool, sauna, Turkish bath and range of massages. Guests may enjoy a drink after a long day of sightseeing or business meetings in the classic ground-floor bar or terrace bar with magnificent views of the city. In our hotel, a 'bonnet' is required to use the pool and can be purchased from the hotel.

15188.description: This beautifully decorated hotel is situated in Antalya, Turkey. It as an amazing location since the beach is just a short walk away from the complex. The airport is about 50 minute-car ride away. Guests will be delighted by the numerous restaurants and bars that are in the surroundings, they can spend the day tasting new flavours or just having a refreshing drink in a bar. For the ones who like to explore, there are many places they can visit such as the Alanya Archaeological Museum, the Damlatas Cave and the Alanya Red Tower and are at a walking distance. If travellers want to relax, they can visit the onsite spa, rest by the outdoor pool or have a well needed swim in it. After an exhausting day having tons of fun, visitors can enjoy the comfortable rooms equipped with cosy beds and all the essential amenities they need to be able to have the best and most memorable stay.

15189.description: Enjoying fantastic panoramic views over the beautiful Mediterranean Sea, this popular hotel is situated just 50m from the renowned, sandy Kleopatra Beach and 1km from the centre of Alanya. A large outdoor pool, a separate children's pool and a sauna are available for guests. The famous attractions of Alanya such as Damlatas Caves or the Red Tower are just a short stroll away, while Alanya's Castle which overlooks the beach from its clifftop position, is easily reached by public transport. Exuding a chic, understated style, all luxury hotel rooms including 2 rooms especially equipped for the disabled have views of the sparkling Mediterranean or the intriguing Toros mountains. All rooms are equipped with high-quality amenities.

15190.description: Located right on Kleopatra Beach, Grand Zaman Beach hotel is a paradise of sea and sun. Aside from gorgeous sandy beaches where sports enthusiasts may enjoy a range of outdoor activities such as windsurfing, parasailing and banana boating, the area offers many opportunities for cultural visits to historical sites such as the Red Tower, Tersane and Seljuk citadel Alanya Castle, all of which date back to the early 13th century. The hotel's comfortable rooms come with balcony, wireless internet and minibar, and guests will delight in local and international dishes at the hotel restaurant or a refreshing drink at the beach bar or lobby bar. The hotel also offers excellent facilities and services such as a fitness centre, minimarket, laundry, and complimentary use of poolside sun loungers and parasols. This is the ideal place for sunny holiday spent feeling the waves while windsurfing or on a jet ski, or simply lounging in the sun.

15204.description: The five-star Corinthia Lisbon offers a tranquil escape in the Sete Rios district, just a short distance from the city center. A mere 15-minute walk leads to attractions like the Calouste Gulbenkian Museum, and the metro station at the hotel's doorstep provides swift access to the historic heart of Lisbon. Guests can indulge in the hotel's luxurious amenities, including multiple dining options (several al fresco), Portugal's largest luxury hotel spa with 13 treatment rooms, an indoor pool, sun terrace, two Jacuzzis, and a fitness center with trainers and physiotherapists. The hotel also boasts extensive conference facilities and an exclusive Sky Lounge for suite guests, offering panoramic city views from the 24th floor. The 518 classically elegant guest rooms and suites feature floor-to-ceiling windows with charming views and comfortable sitting areas.

15235.description: This exceptional, cinema-themed hotel is conveniently located just off Avenida da Liberdade, Lisbon's elegant shopping district. Marquês de Pombal Square, Eduardo VII Park, and the nearest metro station are just steps away. The vibrant Bairro Alto district, with its restaurants, bars, and art galleries, and the historic city center are within a short stroll. Lisbon Airport is 7 km from the property. The hotel offers 72 rooms equipped with air conditioning, a safe, a minibar, a coffee maker, cable TV, and a bathroom with a hairdryer. Guests can maintain their fitness routines with a workout in the gym and enjoy American cuisine at the hotel restaurant with city views.

15242.description: This beach hotel is situated behind the Kukulcan shopping centre in the hotel district of Cancun. The hotel is located within easy access of a host of attractions in the area, as well as a wealth of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. The hotel is located just 20 km away from Cancun International Airport. The hotel enjoys a stunning Mediterranean design, exuding charm and beauty. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, alluring visitors into a veritable lap of luxury. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Business and leisure travellers are sure to appreacite the range of facilities and services that this wonderful hotel has to offer.

15255.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the suburbs of Santa Iria Da Azoia and was established in 2004. It is a short drive away from the Vasco da Gama Tower and the nearest station is Gare do Oriente Station Lisbon. The Hotel has a restaurant and an outdoor swimming pool. All 124 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning.

15256.description: This outstanding hotel combines perfectly an innovative design and state-of-the-art technology with comfort and an excellent service to suit all guests’ needs. It features a strategical location in Parque das Nações, Lisbon's modern business centre, offering easy access to some entertainment areas and different dining options. Distinguished for its hospitality and attention to detail, this upscale establishment provides a total of 300 rooms (including 8 suites and a presidential suite) for guests to choose from. A large choice of top-quality facilities is also available for guests’ convenience, including a restaurant, a bar and private parking for visitors arriving by car. Handicapped facilities and wireless Internet access are offered too. Those travelling for business purposes will appreciate the 8 conference rooms, filled with natural sunlight and for up to 180 people. It also includes an auditorium for up to 165 people, ideal to host conventions and seminars.

15305.description: Recently renovated and located in the fashionable Zamalek district, The President Hotel caters to the modern traveller who wants to be in the center of the finest dining and shopping in Cairo. With many options within a stone throw, The President Hotel is a destination in itself, offering comfort and convenience in the hustle and bustle of Cairo.

15316.description: A landmark on the Athenian Riviera’s finest spot, this iconic 5-star hotel offers guests modern design, a tranquil atmosphere, and stunning sea views. Guests can enjoy unique rooms and suites, a variety of seafront or poolside bars and restaurants offering delectable dishes and cocktails, and a wealth of leisure activities. Indulgence continues with premium outdoor swimming pools, as well as a private sandy beach boasting thrilling water sports and private yacht cruises. At the heart of it all lies the world-class Divani Athens Spa & Thalasso Center, the ultimate destination for wellness and rejuvenation, featuring the sole thalassotherapy retreat in Athens, an abundance of signature spa therapies, and Greece’s best Fitness Center.

15324.description: This hotel is located close to the sea, lying just a few minutes' walking distance away from Rafina Marina. Rafina ferry port offers many connections to the Aegean islands including Mykonos, Sytos, Tinos, Andros and Evia. Eleftherios Venizelos airport is just 22 km away from the hotel. This delightful hotel beautifully combines elements of traditional and contemporary designs. The rooms reflect the splendour of Greek style, featuring refreshing tones and a peaceful ambience. The hotel offers a range of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of every type of traveller.

15333.description: This hotel is located at the heart of the wonderful city of Athens. The hotel enjoys a prime setting, lying just a short distance away from many of the city's most prominent attractions. This charming hotel enjoys a stunning design, blending effortlessly with its culturally-rich surroundings. The hotel offers a boundless array of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of every type of traveller to a high level of excellence.

15457.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this boutique hotel, and take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Nice twin rooms that can accommodate two guests. Each room has a colour television with video films (pay movies), telephone, hairdryer, bath/shower and toilet. All the floors have lift access.

15468.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 76 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions.

15498.description: Located in the heart of Athens, the 5-star Electra Palace Athens is just a short walk from Syntagma Square and the Acropolis. This luxurious hotel offers a full-service spa with massages, body treatments, and facials, as well as a health club, indoor pool, and spa tub. The 157 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, 24-hour room service, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and five meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite for a charge.

15503.description: The 3-star Art Hotel Amsterdam offers comfortable rooms. Choose from single, double, triple, or quadruple rooms. The hotel is a short walk from Westerpark and a short drive from Dam Square, while the nearest station is Central Station. Facilities include a restaurant with a terrace, a bar, a fitness center, and a meeting room.

15564.description: Riad Kniza, a luxurious boutique hotel in Marrakech, is just a short walk from Jemaa El Fna square and the vibrant souks. Restored by owner M. Bouskri, a renowned antiques dealer and professional guide, this charming riad offers a tranquil oasis amidst the bustling city. Seven beautifully appointed rooms and suites feature satellite TV, air conditioning, ensuite bathrooms, safes, direct phone lines, and internet access. Some rooms also include fireplaces. The two open-air patios with fountains and two lounges provide relaxing spaces to unwind. Mr. Bouskri's extensive knowledge of Marrakech is a valuable resource for guests seeking to explore the city's cultural treasures and historic sites.

15630.description:
NLH MATI SEAFRONT is a contemporary beachfront hotel located in the charming seaside area of Mati, Attica, offering a perfect balance of relaxation, comfort, and modern hospitality. Ideally situated near Athens International Airport, and Rafina Port, the hotel provides an excellent base for both leisure and business travelers. 

Guests can enjoy a selection of comfortable and elegantly designed rooms and suites, including sea view accommodation overlooking the Aegean coastline. All rooms are equipped with modern amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, Smart TV with satellite channels, mini fridge, laptop safe, work desk, and premium bathroom amenities. 

Inspired by the natural beauty of its surroundings, NLH MATI SEAFRONT combines contemporary design with a welcoming seaside atmosphere, creating an ideal setting for guests seeking a relaxing stay by the sea.

15670.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Enjoy recreational amenities including two outdoor swimming pools, a health club, and a steam room. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. Savor French cuisine at Relais de Paris, one of the hotel's three restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Snacks are available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are offered daily (6:30 AM to 10:30 AM) for a fee.
