A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (24 hours, surcharge applies), and free valet parking is provided. Each of the 109 air-conditioned rooms offers a fireplace and private balcony. Complimentary Wi-Fi and satellite programming are provided for your entertainment. Conveniences include safes and desks, with daily housekeeping. Located near the Koutoubia Mosque, Jemaa el-Fnaa, and the Souk of the Medina in Marrakech, Les Jardins De La Koutoubia is a convenient base for exploring the city. Menara Airport (RAK) is 6. 7 km away.

15734.description:
Electra Rhythm Athens is a seamless blend of Athenian heritage and contemporary elegance, thoughtfully designed to offer a cosy retreat in the vibrant heart of the city. Just a stone’s throw from the iconic Syntagma Square and featuring stunning rooftop views of the Acropolis, the hotel caters to those who embrace an active, modern lifestyle. 
Electra Rhythm Athens is located on Ermou Street, a historic commercial road; it is inspired by the heartbeat of Athens and designed from the ground up to meet the needs of the modern traveller, whether they are visiting for business, leisure, or both. 

Infused with a sense of place in every aspect, the hotel is created to embrace a thriving community in tune with the urban tempo.

15774.description: A welcoming London hotel near Hoxton and Shoreditch with free WiFi and breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® London - City hotel is just steps from Old Street Tube station. The restaurants and buzzing nightlife of Hoxton and Shoreditch are a 5-minute walk. You can catch the Stansted Express train to London Stansted Airport (STN) at London Liverpool Street station. Shops and restaurants at Spitalfields Market and world-class performing arts at the Barbican Centre are a 15-minute walk away. St. Paul's Cathedral is also within easy reach, and buses whisk you to Oxford Street shopping and the London Eye in no time. Business guests are a short walk from the City of London financial district. Hosting an event? The hotel’s 5 naturally lit, flexible meeting rooms can hold up to 80 people. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- Express Start™ Breakfast included in the room rate- Discount passes to the nearby Nuffield Health gym- On-site parking (limited)- A Business CentreInviting rooms have blackout curtains to help you sleep soundly. Start the morning with a hot breakfast of sausages, scrambled eggs and baked beans. At day's end, you can meet with friends over drinks in the lobby bar.

15775.description: At COMO The Halkin, Italian design meets contemporary simplicity, creating a haven of tranquility. Its 41 guest rooms and suites offer a relaxed atmosphere and generous space paired with five-star service. Indulgent amenities include Egyptian cotton linen, interactive E-TV (with over 60 free channels), internet radio, and an extensive music jukebox. Complimentary WiFi is available throughout the hotel. The Halkin Bar provides afternoon tea, tapas, and cocktails. The intimate space also offers a relaxed all-day dining menu featuring Western classics and impeccably crafted comfort food, including pasta, steak, salads, and sandwiches. COMO The Halkin is a discreet insider's address in London's exclusive Belgravia.

15777.description: The hotel boasts a vibrant Park Lane location, combining attentive service with contemporary design. Created by leading names in music, cuisine, and interior design, it caters to travelers drawn to London's electrifying energy. Nobu restaurant offers an essential dining experience, serving award-winning Japanese-Peruvian cuisine. Signature dishes include black cod with miso, sashimi salad with Matsuhisa soy sauce dressing, Hamachi sashimi with jalapeños, and squid pasta with light garlic sauce. 24-hour room service offers both Nobu specialties and late-night comfort options. Standard room check-in is 3 PM, check-out is 12 PM. Two-bedroom apartments have a 4 PM check-in and 10 AM check-out.

15779.address: Mimar Mehmet Ağa Cad. Amiral Tafdil Sok., 9
15779.description: This inviting, whimsical hotel is set in the immediate vicinity of the Blue Mosque and surrounded by city life with countless shops, restaurants, bars and nightclubs. Sightseers can experience the best the city has to offer, from the world-famous mosque to the Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace and the grand bazaar, all just outside the hotel, while business travellers will appreciate the convenience of a central location in addition to copying, faxing and messaging services available in reception. Rooms are cosy yet spacious with air-conditioning, coffee and tea making facilities and free WIFI. Guests can wake up to a delightful breakfast with stunning views of the Marmara Sea at the hotel restaurant terrace, or enjoy 24-hour room service. The hotel also offers 24-hour reception, Turkish bath and sauna, laundry and dry-cleaning services and parking. At the crossroads of Europe and Asia, this charming hotel offers a peaceful stay in the heart of the city.

15780.description: Wonderfully situated in London, this hotel is the perfect base for visiting London. The property is located just a short walking distance away from Paddington train station, on Craven Road. Furthermore Lancester Gate station is 5 minutes walk from the hotel. Having 2 hotel is ideal for touriest going to their final destination. The hotel is well located for many of London's top attractions, including Hyde Park, Notting Hill Gate and Buckingham Palace. The property comprises stylishly-appointed guest rooms, which have been designed to a high standard. Excellent facilities are available at this property, delivering a high level of comfort and convenience. Business and leisure travellers are sure to appreciate the exemplary service that this property has to offer.

15781.description: The Hotel has been family-run since 1962 and we are constantly upgrading to meet the demands of the modern traveler. The hotel is ideally located, offering easy access to all of London's most important districts. Whether wishing to visit the city's attractions, simply go shopping or spend a pleasant evening at the theatre, this hotel offers the perfect stopover point. Since its opening in 1900, the hotel has been renovated and modernized several times, whenever quality specifications made it necessary. The nearest underground station, Paddington, is just 500 m from the hotel.

15798.description: This charming hotel boasts a strategic setting in London. The property is just a 3 minutes' walking distance away from Finchley Road underground, which offers ease of access to many areas of the city. The property is just a 2 minutes' walk from Finchley and Frognal rail station. ExCel Exhibition Centre and London City Airport are located just a short train journey away. Ideally positioned to suit business and leisure travellers, this hotel is sure to impress. The guest rooms provide a high level of comfort and convenience. Guests are invited to enjoy a hearty, English breakfast in the mornings, for a superb start to the day. A spacious lounge and bar area is available, where guests can sit back and unwind at the end of the day.

15810.description: Enjoy a stay at Hotel Solar São Gabriel, located in the heart of Porto. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Make use of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, a hair salon, and tour/ticket assistance. The 28 air-conditioned guestrooms feature private bathrooms, satellite TV, and desks. The hotel also provides dry cleaning/laundry services and luggage storage. Nearby attractions include Porto City Hall, Porto Cathedral, Dom Luis I Bridge, and Livraria Lello.

15812.description: This charming hotel housed in a beautiful Victorian building is conveniently situated just metres away from Paddington underground and train station. Renowned Hyde Park with Kensington Gardens and Princess Diana Memorial Playground can be reached within a 5-minute walk. Guests will find themselves close to a choice of famous sights such as Buckingham Palace, Big Ben and Trafalgar Square. The hotel features a wide choice of different room types ranging from single rooms to five-bedded rooms, ideal to enjoy a pleasant stay with family or friends. Ideal for leisure travellers wishing to discover this vibrant city, this hotel offers affordable rooms in a great location. The bunkbeds and single bed configuration can not be guaranteed. There is no rate difference and the configuration is upon request subject to availability.

15813.description: Housed in a beautiful 1850s building overlooking charming Norfolk Square, this city hotel offers an ideal location near Paddington Station and a wide array of amenities. Just moments from Paddington Train and Underground Station, and a short 5-10 minute walk from Oxford Street, the Shakespeare Hotel caters to both business travelers and romantic getaways. With a range of rooms from singles to family and multi-bed accommodations, it remains a popular budget-friendly choice in London. Please note that bunk and single bed configurations are available upon request and subject to availability.

15827.description: The hotel is strategically located in the town of Ciempozuelos, next to Madrid with excellent motorway access. There are numerous points of interest for visitors in the area, including the towns of Aranjuez, Toledo, Chinchón, Segovia and Ávila. This city hotel consists of a total of 54 rooms. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception. The air-conditioned hotel has great conference facilities, including a private hall for meetings with capacity for 80 people. Further facilities include a cloakroom, café, laundry service and car park. The hotel also has a restaurant, access for disabled people and an exclusive park for guests. Each of the rooms is equipped with a double bed, complete bathroom, TV and telephone. The rooms also feature air conditioning and central heating. The on-site restaurant serves traditional local cuisine.

15830.description: This historic hotel, housed in a beautifully restored 16th-century convent, is located in Chaves' city center. Just 500 meters away, guests enjoy easy access to public transport, shops, restaurants, bars, and nightclubs. The airport is approximately 180 km away. Opened in 1997, the hotel features 58 rooms and 4 suites across two floors, nestled within a 1500 m² garden. Amenities include a 24-hour reception, elevators, an auditorium, meeting rooms, lounges, a wine cellar, a chapel, and parking. Dining options include an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant and a bar. Guests can also enjoy complimentary internet access and laundry service (for a fee). The comfortable rooms feature private bathrooms with hairdryers, direct-dial telephones, cable TV, minibars, air conditioning, central heating, and safes. The hotel's outdoor area boasts a swimming pool, a sun terrace with loungers and parasols, and a sauna (reservations required). Guests can also take advantage of the tennis court, billiards/snooker, and gym. A breakfast buffet is served daily, while lunch and dinner are offered à la carte.

15836.description: This city hotel is located in the centre, next to City Hall, Avenida dos Aliados, and just 50 m Trindade Metro and S. Bento Station. Guests can easily visit the town on foot or using public transportation. The World Heritage Centre of Porto is a 5-minute walk from the hotel. There are many shopping venues and countless bars, cafés and restaurants in the vicinity.

15838.description: This lovely hotel full of character combines Victorian charm with modern comfort and is excellently located on the north side of Hyde Park. Marble Arch is within walking distance; the Lancaster Gate underground station is just a 3-minute walk away, providing easy access to all areas of London. The Paddington train station can be reached within a 10-minute walk, offering a direct link to Heathrow International Airport.

15847.description: Located in London (Acton), Holiday Inn London - West, an IHG Hotel is within a 10-minute drive of Westfield London Shopping Centre and Portobello Road Market. This upscale hotel is 3. 4 mi (5. 5 km) from London Designer Outlet and 3. 6 mi (5. 8 km) from OVO Arena Wembley. Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a rooftop terrace. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and discounted use of a nearby fitness facility. Make yourself at home in one of the 225 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Restaurant, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10 AM and on weekends from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 248 square feet (23 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 7 meeting rooms.

name.content: AC Hotel Palacio del Retiro Autograph Collection

15849.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at The Suite Bar, a bar/lounge which specializes in international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Madrid? This hotel has 452 square feet (42 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 50 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring iPod docking stations and minibars.

15853.description: This exclusive hotel enjoys an exceptional location next to Plaza de las Glorias and the Agbar Tower. Designed by Barcelona architect Juli Capella, this hotel stands out for its architecture and interior design. Set on the famous Diagonal Avenue, the hotel is opposite Glòries Shopping Centre. A selection of restaurants, bars and nightclubs are all to be found within 1 km of the hotel. Public transport departs from stops located directly in front of the hotel. Gaudí's Sagrada Familia is a 20-minute walk from the hotel, whilst the beach is 1. 5 km away.

15894.description:
Hyatt Regency London Blackfriars is located in the heart of the historic Square Mile directly outside Blackfriars station, close to St Paul’s Cathedral, the Tate Modern and Shakespeare’s Globe Theatre. The Grade II listed hotel is steeped in regal history, residing on the former grounds of King Henry VIII's Bridewell Palace. The hotel is ideal for corporate, leisure and family stays. 
All rooms and suites can accommodate maximum three occupants (children/infants included). Please note that there is an extra bed charge at £100 per night. A deposit is required on check-in for incidental charges.

15895.description: A family-friendly London hotel with meeting rooms, a restaurant and excellent transport linksHoliday Inn® London - Brent Cross hotel is only half a mile from the M1 motorway. We’re just off the North Circular Road and 20 miles from Heathrow Airport (LHR). It’s a quick hop by Tube to central London, with a free shuttle bus to and from Brent Cross station, so it’s simple to visit major museums, West End theatres or the London Eye. Sporting matches and concerts at Wembley Stadium are a short drive away, and it’s easy to take the kids to discover the world of Harry Potter at the Warner Bros. Studio in Leavesden. They’ll also love the vintage aircraft at the RAF Museum in nearby Hendon. If you’re visiting on business, you can host up to 100 guests in our well-equipped meeting rooms, with on-site parking for your clients and a convenient Business Centre in the hotel. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- Rooms with a sofa bed for families- Kids stay and eat freeOur spacious rooms have satellite TV and a handy desk for work. A pillow menu, blackout shades and adjustable air conditioning help you sleep in peace. Executive rooms have extra space, bathrobes and a minibar. Our Junction Restaurant offers a full English breakfast and meals throughout the day, and you can enjoy a cocktail and light snacks in the lounge.

15899.description: Located in the heart of Lisbon, next to the Altis Grand Hotel, the recently renovated Altis Suites offers complete privacy and functionality, making it an ideal choice for extended family stays. Guests enjoy the comfort and independence of a suite, along with personalized service at the reception desk, on-site parking, and access to all the amenities of the Altis Grand Hotel. The 32 soundproofed suites each feature a living room, safe, air conditioning, a Full HD LCD TV, free Wi-Fi, and a kitchenette equipped with a stove, microwave, refrigerator, kitchen utensils, and a Nespresso coffee machine. Altis Suites provides 24-hour room service, and guests can dine at the Grill D. Fernando restaurant with panoramic views on the 12th floor of the Altis Grand Hotel, or enjoy a meal at the Rendez Vous Bistro by the lobby. Four Bars at the Altis Grand Hotel are also available for drinks. Additional services include daily housekeeping, laundry, dry cleaning, and on-request medical assistance, home care, and babysitting. Pets up to 10kg are welcome for a fee (only one pet, cat or dog, per stay).

15901.description: Less than 10 minutes’ walk from Hyde Park and 2 miles from Buckingham Palace, the Prince William Hotel is centrally located in Paddington and only 7 minutes' walk from the station. There is free WiFi throughout the hotel, and a 24-hour reception. Guests at the Prince William Hotel can enjoy breakfast each morning in the dining room. A continental breakfast of croissants and pastries, toast and bread rolls, fruit, yoghurts, cornflakes, cheese etc. Breakfast can be included in your stay by selecting a rate that includes breakfast or purchased separately at the hotel. The hotel is situated in an 18th-century corner period-listed building that combines Victorian and modern design. Each room contains modern features, tea and coffee making facilities and a TV. Every room also comes with its own en suite bathroom. London’s major attractions are all easy to reach on the Tube. Lancaster Gate Underground Station is just 4 minutes' walk. The Prince William is close to Marble Arch, Oxford Street, and Kensington. Madame Tussauds is 1. 2 miles away and Portobello Market is 1. 4 miles away. Westfield Shopping Centre is 2. 1 miles away.

15911.description: This charming hotel enjoys a central location in Paris. The hotel is located close to the Place de la Concorde and the Champs Elysees. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a host of shopping and entertainment venues. The hotel offers a great setting from which to explore the most prominent attractions that this romantic city has to offer. Convenient links to the public transport network are to be found nearby. This hotel occupies a building that dates back to the early 19th century. The hotel enjoys a delightful design, exuding elegance and poise. The guest rooms are superbly designed, featuring modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. This hotel assures guests of a truly memorable stay.

name.content: Van der Valk Hotel Paris CDG Airport

15912.address: 351 Avenue Du Bois De La Pie
15912.description: This hotel is located at Charles de Gaulle Airport, lying just a short distance away from the TGV station and Paris-Nord exhibition centre. The centre of the city lies just 16 km away. Disneyland Paris is located just a 20 minutes' driving distance from the hotel. This luxurious hotel was designed by Helmut Jahn, and enjoys an elegant architectural style. The hotel exudes elegance and poise. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, oozing character and charm. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are sure to be impressed by the wide range of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

15930.description: A true Parisian boutique hotel, the Louvre Montana Hotel seduces with its privileged setting and its refined atmosphere. The hotel reveals the cachet of a Haussmannian building and the interior of a warm Parisian house. A rare and privileged location, facing the Jardin des Tuileries and the Louvre. This exceptional location allows immediate access to the most prestigious monuments of Paris and to the world's major brands.

15933.description: Holiday Inn Brussels Airport is five minutes from Brussels Airport, easily accessible via the E40 and E19 motorways and just a 15-minute train ride away from Brussels’ history, culture and cobbles via Diegem station. NATO Headquarters, Toyota, Honeywell, 3M, and EY offices are closeby. We’re big on convenience, offering express check-in kiosks, 24-hour room service, a grab-and-go Wundermart supermarket and a range of online payment options. Enjoy free Wi-Fi, our brand new fitness suite and our atmospheric restaurant/bar, as well as extraordinary pop-up events throughout the year. Our 310 new stylish, contemporary standard, standard twin, executive and premium rooms were recently refurbished by Doos Architects, Stockholm. And alongside all the basics you’d expect, there are some not-so-little extras: oversized towels, quirky decorative twists and coffee and tea facilities. We also have 18 vibrant, fully-equipped meeting rooms, bespoke set-ups and extensive banqueting options. Got a request to help make your meeting extra memorable? Just ask.

15938.description: Centrally located in Venice, Hotel Tre Archi is within a 15-minute drive of St. Mark's Square and the Port of Venice. This hotel offers convenient access to attractions like the Grand Canal and Piazzale Roma, both 6. 4 miles away. Enjoy rooftop terrace views, a relaxing garden, and complimentary Wi-Fi. The 34 guestrooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, and en suite bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Safes and daily housekeeping are also provided, and cribs/infant beds are available upon request. The hotel offers room service during limited hours, a bar/lounge, and a complimentary local cuisine breakfast served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Additional amenities include express check-in, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Nearby attractions include the Venetian Ghetto, Guglie Bridge, and the Jewish Museum of Venice.

15945.description: Enjoy a central Zürich stay at Hotel Sternen Oerlikon, conveniently located near Hallenstadion (1-minute drive) and the Swiss National Museum (5 minutes). This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and on-site shopping. Dine at Restaurant Ö, unwind at the bar/lounge, and enjoy a daily buffet breakfast (available for a fee). Business amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self-parking is available (charges apply). The 56 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms (bathtub or shower) with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include the Zurich Exhibition Centre, University of Zurich, and the MFO-Park. Zurich Airport (ZRH) is approximately 6. 5 miles away.

15951.address: Aerop. Inter. Ginebra Route De Pre-Bois, 16
15951.description:
The Holiday Inn Express Geneva Airport offers modern, comfortable accommodation just minutes from Geneva Airport, with a complimentary shuttle. The hotel features 154 fully air-conditioned rooms equipped with private bathrooms, tea and coffee facilities, workspaces, high-speed Wi-Fi, and international TV channels. Guests enjoy a rich complimentary breakfast each morning, access to a bar and work area and a conference room for up to 25 people. Free coffee and water are available in the lobby, and every guest receives a complimentary transportation pass valid across the entire Canton of Geneva. 

Located just 200 meters from the Blandonnet tram stop and opposite the Grand Hangar bus stop, the hotel offers quick access to the city: downtown Geneva is about 4 km away, and the United Nations district is roughly the same distance. 
Palexpo, Arena, the International Conference Centre, Balexert mall, and several corporate hubs are all within easy reach and are only few minutes away from our hotel. Underground parking is available on site for an additional fee, and the A1/N1 motorway is close by.

15957.description: The extraordinary location of this hotel allows guests to conveniently visit every part of Venice, a city that captures its visitors with romantic atmospheres, gorgeous palazzos, churches and hidden back alleys. Facilities include a 24-hour reception, lift access, a bar, Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, a reading room with foreign newspapers and TV, laundry and ironing service. CIN IT027042A192LCPZJL

15961.description: This unique hotel is conveniently located in the heart of the exclusive art and fashion Halles district close to the Palais Royal, the Tuileries Gardens and the Louvre museum. The opera house, the fantastic Orsay museum and the famous Notre Dame cathedral are all only a short stroll from the hotel. Thus, this is the ideal choice for business and leisure trips to the City of Light. This futuristic hotel boasts a real concept of curved lines and soothing materials to help create a relaxing mood based on the zen philosophy. Each one of its bedrooms is appointed in a contemporary style and feature an original shape to have everything at hand. Guests will be welcomed at the modern lobby and may benefit from the several services and facilities on offer, such as laundry service and complimentary wireless Internet access. Breakfast is also served every morning in a buffet style.

15967.description: Enjoy a relaxing drink with friends in the chic lounge bar of Hotel Hiro, located in the heart of Paris's bustling 8th arrondissement, just 280 meters from the Arc de Triomphe and Charles de Gaulle-Etoile metro station. Perfect for business or leisure travelers, this hotel offers 30 brightly decorated rooms featuring contemporary design furniture and rich fabrics. A multilingual staff ensures a warm welcome.

15975.description: Built in a futuristic design and is located near the Berlin Arena and the S-Bahn station Landsberger Allee, in an up and coming district in former East Berlin, just six tram stops from Alexanderplatz. The stylish hostel has colorful rooms with lockers and private or shared bathrooms, and the bar is the ideal place to relax at the end of a long day of sightseeing or having a few drinks before a night out on the town. In addition, karaoke evenings, film screenings and hikes are offered. This hostel promises a unique and unforgettable stay. The hostel has a lounge area, disabled access and a business centre.

15982.description: Ideally situated in the charming quarter of Petit Saconnex, InterContinental Genève is an oasis of calm in the diplomatic district of Geneva. Located just a few minutes away from the United Nations headquarters, Lake Geneva, and Geneva luxury shopping avenues, you are conveniently connected to everything our city is famous for. From elegantly designed rooms, creative cuisine, and innovative mixology to a luxurious spa experience, your stay is second to none at InterContinental Genève.

15994.address: P.O.BOX 5822, Khalid Bin Waleed Road, Bur Dubai
15994.description: Located on Khalid Bin Walid Street in Bur Dubai, this hotel lies within a short distance of the World Trade Centre, Dubai International Convention and Exhibition Centre and Dubai Museum. The central location of this hotel makes it the ideal base for both business and leisure tourists to the city. It is around 20 minutes to Dubai international airport. This modern, air-conditioned hotel comprises a total of 76 rooms. Facilities include a safe, a currency exchange facility, a lift and it is possible to dine in to Goan cuisine in Casa de Goa, choose from an array of snacks in the hotel café, South Indian dishes in Thattukada or enjoy a drink. Colors-an Indian nightclub, Beach Aficana-African nightclub and Mixxx-Russian nightclub provides some evening entertainment. Moreover, there are room and laundry services to take advantage of. Each of the spacious, comfortable rooms comes with a hairdryer, an LED TV, Wi-Fi, a minibar and centrally controlled air conditioning. Daily full buffet breakfast is served in the windows cafe, located on the mezzanine floor. The buffet comprises hot and cold favourites from Indian cuisine. The hotel is located opposite the road leading to Al Shindagha Tunnel (left side of the main road).

name.content: Mercure Paris Gare De Lyon Tgv Hotel

15996.description: Right by Gare de Lyon, the Mercure Paris Gare de Lyon TGV hotel is ideal for business travelers with its 5 meeting rooms and co-working station. Enjoy a work out in our fitness center or check out the Corner Station: our coffee shop with a private terrace. Recharge your batteries with our varied buffet or room service breakfast.

16001.description: The Hotel Plaza Etoiles is a short walk from the Champs-Élysées and the La Défense business district, with easy access to the Palais des Congrès - Porte Maillot metro station. Refurbished in 2012, this modern hotel offers 33 rooms, including six deluxe rooms and one with a stunning view of the Arc de Triomphe. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a business center, 24-hour reception, a bar, and Wi-Fi. It suits both leisure and business travelers.

16010.description: Situated in the heart of Geneva, this welcoming hotel boasts delightful colonial, Indies-inspired furniture and services that will cater for needs of even the most discerning guests. The main railway station is situated just 600 metres from the property while the enchanting Place des Grottes and the Institute and Museum of Voltaire with Library and Archives are also easily reachable on foot. Visitors may also relish the opportunity to walk along the waterfront of the Lake Geneva and enjoy the views over the Mont Salève and Mont Blanc in the foreground. This impressive hotel features spacious and bright rooms fitted with chocolate-brown furnishings, rich bedding and cutting-edge amenities. Travellers may also indulge in refined cuisine served at the award-wining restaurant and take advantage of the fitness area of the sister hotel situated just at 100m.

16012.description: Le Passage Cairo is conveniently located just two minutes from Cairo International Airport in the Heliopolis district. This hotel offers a variety of amenities, including fine dining restaurants serving Chinese, Italian, Egyptian, and international cuisine, a 24-hour Orangerie Restaurant, a discotheque, and a casino. Guests can enjoy two swimming pools (heated during winter), floodlit tennis and volleyball courts, a jogging track, a fully equipped gym, and a spa offering a range of massages and body treatments. Rooms feature individually controlled air conditioning, satellite TV, in-room safes, minibars, and hairdryers. 24-hour room service and free airport transfers are also available. Cairo's city center is 10 km away, and on-site parking is provided. ***Guests with Egyptian nationality sharing a room must provide a marriage certificate.

16013.description: The Best Western City Centre is a 3-Star hotel which offers good quality and service. At the top end of the 3-Star market, our well-maintained and comfortable hotel offers diverse facilities, luxury rooms as well as extremely friendly and helpful staff. We are within walking distance of many museums, such as old and modern arts, musical instruments, chocolates and cocoa, Belgian Centre for Comic Strip Art, Horta's Art Nouveau, a beer brewery, and more. The North Station, which is at a five minute walk from our hotel, provides good connections to places including the airport. For the frequent travelers, the Best Western City Centre can provide corporate rates as well as other attractive arrangements. Enjoy your stay.

16018.description: Pamper yourself at the full-service spa. Recreational amenities include an indoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or 24-hour room service. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily (7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee). Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities consist of conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (24 hours, surcharge), and self-parking is available onsite (surcharge). The 97 air-conditioned rooms offer iPod docking stations and flat-screen televisions with satellite channels. Bathrooms have shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes, desks, and phones with free local calls. The hotel is located near Rue de Rivoli, Tuileries Garden, and Place Vendôme, with convenient access to Paris Orly Airport (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG).

16027.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Dubai and was established in 1995. It is a short drive away from the City Malls and the nearest station is Al Rigga Metro Station. The Hotel has 1 restaurant, 5 Clubs & bars, a coffee shop. All 70 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, ironing set and air conditioning.

16029.description: Enjoy a stay at the upscale Alexander Hotel, situated on the riverwalk in Mestre. We're conveniently located within a 10-minute drive of Piazzale Roma and Porto Marghera, and a short distance from the Port of Venice and the Grand Canal. Our 77 guestrooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, and convenient amenities such as in-room safes and desks. Start your day with our daily buffet breakfast (fee applies) and unwind with a drink at our bar/lounge. Additional amenities include concierge services, bike parking, a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and on-site self-parking (for a fee).

16030.description: This charming hotel enjoys a majestic setting in Vienna, a short distance from the city's cultural attractions. Located just 50 meters from a tram stop, guests have easy access to numerous points of interest. The Viennese Ringstrasse boulevard is just a short tram ride away, and Belvedere Palace is a mere 10-minute walk. Vienna Airport is approximately 20 km from the hotel. All rooms are equipped with convenient amenities. Guests can savor a wide range of Austrian dishes at the onsite restaurant and enjoy local drinks at the hotel bar. Housekeeping is provided every three days, with daily service available for an additional fee.

16037.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Grab a bite at Luciano's, one of the hotel's 8 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and limo/town car service. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 342 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature designer toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. 16040.description: This charming Vienna hotel enjoys a stunning location near the town hall and Burgtheater, offering numerous nearby sightseeing opportunities. Just a five-minute walk from Rathaus underground station and 3. 5 km from Vienna's main train station, it also boasts convenient access to shopping within a 10-minute walk. The hotel's architecture blends beautifully with its surroundings, and the well-appointed guest rooms feature modern amenities. Guests will appreciate the hotel's range of facilities and services.

16044.description: 25hours Hotel Terminus Nord is a 4-star hotel located ideally in the center of Paris opposite the Gare du Nord train station, with immediate access to the Eurostar, Thalys, TGV and RER train services. Direct access to Villepinte exhibiti on center, Bourget, Paris CDG airport and the Stade de France. Our rooms are spacious and warm, and some offer stunning views of the Gare du Nord or Montmartre and Sacré Coeur. Take advantage of this unique view while enjoying your breakfast.

16057.description: Located in the Bloomsbury area of London, this hotel revels in the peace and serenity of its surroundings in the city's West End. Oxford Street and Covent Garden can be reached by just a short underground ride. The hotel is just a few minutes' walking distance away from many renowned theatres, as well as countless attractions and sights. The British Museum, as well as Russell Square and Holborn stations are situated nearby. This hotel occupies an elegantly-restored Georgian townhouse, which provides an intimate, inviting setting in which to unwind. Luxurious studios and suites offer a welcoming escape from the bustle of daily life. This property prides itself on its attention to detail and the utmost in comfort.

16061.description: Perfectly located on Southampton Row in the Midtown area between the City and London's West End. The hotel is just a ten-minute walk away from top attractions like the British Museum and fifteen minutes' walk from the vibrant Covent Garden and Soho areas. Holborn underground station is less than 5 minutes' walk from the hotel and Russell Square underground station is also within walking distance. King's Cross, Euston and St. Pancras International rail stations provide access to the rest of London and beyond. It offers 201 stylish and comfortable bedrooms, all fitted with modern amenities, including air conditioning, flat screen TV, en-suite bathrooms and tea and coffee making facilities. Health and Fitness club is based on-site, giving guests access to a range of luxury fitness and spa services during their stay.

16063.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting at the heart of the beautiful district of Bloomsbury. The hotel is situated close to Covent Garden, Oxford Street, the West End and many of London's top attractions. The hotel is also located just a short distance away from stylish shopping opportunities, delightful dining options and exciting entertainment venues. This luxurious, boutique-style hotel enjoys an intriguing design. The guest rooms are lavishly appointed, bathing visitors in grace and poise. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are invited to take advantage of the exemplary facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

16072.description: 'Enjoy convenient amenities such as complimentary wired and wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Dine at the onsite restaurant or enjoy a snack in the coffee shop/cafe. 24-hour room service is also available. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. For business travelers, the hotel offers a business center, complimentary wired internet access, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. The hotel's 77 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. The hotel is conveniently located near Cromwell Road (0. 2 km). '

16076.description: Enjoy convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. The hotel's restaurant, Langham Brasserie, offers lunch and dinner, while the coffee shop/cafe provides additional dining options. 24-hour room service is also available. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM (fees apply). Business amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. The hotel offers conference space and two meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 56 guestrooms featuring complimentary wired and wireless internet access, private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

16079.description: This hotel enjoys a unique location on Montague Street close to the spot where the Duke of Montague erected a big villa, which is now the British Museum. In spite of being quietly situated, the hotel is within minutes of the theatres of the colourful West End. The shops of Oxford Street and Covent Garden can be reached in around 15 minutes' walk from Grange White Hall. The hotel comprises a total of 52 rooms and features a cosy restaurant. The English Garden Restaurant looks out onto immaculate lawns. Guests can also relax in Elgin Lounge Bar, which is open 24 hours a day. All of the elegant rooms come en suite and well – equipped as standard. Some of the rooms have a view to the garden.

16105.description: Located in London's City Centre, Olympic House Hotel is a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. This hotel offers 40 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers and complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy a bar/lounge, garden views, and convenient amenities like a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and on-site parking (subject to charges). Marble Arch is 1. 2 km away, and Oxford Street is 2. 1 km from the hotel.

16106.description: Located in London City Centre, the Orchard Hotel is within a 15-minute walk of Hyde Park and Marble Arch. This hotel is conveniently located 1. 2 miles from Oxford Street and 2. 4 miles from Buckingham Palace. The hotel offers 46 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Desks are provided, housekeeping is offered weekly and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast served daily between 7:30 AM and 9:00 AM. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk and an elevator.

16108.description: The hotel is a comfortable, intimate hotel, located within the heart of London's West End, within easy walking distance of London’s lively and famous streets and activities like Oxford Street, Bond Street, Museums, Art Galleries and a wide choice of some of the best restaurants that London has to offer. With its 72 en suite, air cooled bedrooms and suites, the hotel provides the perfect base for the business and leisure visitor to London and provides a convenient, comfortable and tranquil haven amidst the pace of London's bustling environment.

16128.description: Experience the vibrant energy of Midtown Manhattan at this Beaux Arts hotel, boasting a rooftop terrace with stunning city views. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services throughout your stay. Dine at Serafina, our in-house Italian restaurant, or order room service during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge after a day of exploring nearby attractions like Broadway, Carnegie Hall, and Central Park. Start your day with a cooked-to-order breakfast (available for a fee). Our 221 air-conditioned rooms offer flat-screen TVs with cable programming, private bathrooms with designer toiletries, and convenient amenities such as safes, desks, and phones with free local calls. The hotel also provides dry cleaning/laundry services and luggage storage.

16206.description: As the closest hotel to the arrival and departure terminals, the 4-star Novotel Birmingham Airport hotel blends style with convenience. Just a minute's walk from the airport, the hotel is the perfect choice for your family or business trip. The airy sound-proofed rooms provide enough space to stretch out and relax, while the 24-hour bar is perfect for a pre-flight snack or well-deserved drink. Exclusive to our guests: discounted NCP parking tickets £12 for 24 hours in NCP : CP 1, 2&3 all next to the hotel.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh - Leith Waterfront

16210.description: Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh – Leith Waterfront is located on the outskirts of the city, in the cool harbour neighbourhood of Leith, also known as The Shore. Edinburgh Waverley train station is within easy reach and Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 25 minutes away. Catch trams into the city centre from opposite the hotel. On-site parking is 11 GBP per night and spaces are limited. Stroll along to the Royal Yacht Britannia and explore the former yacht of Queen Elizabeth II. Delve into Scotland’s rich history at the magnificent Edinburgh Castle, then wander through the cobbled streets of the Old Town to visit the Scott Monument and the National Museum of Scotland. Watch live debates and MSPs questions at the Scottish Parliament Building or tour the Palace of Holyroodhouse, The King’s official residence in Edinburgh. Ocean Terminal shopping centre is a short walk away, while Princes Street and St James Quarter offer the best from high-street to luxury fashion and beauty. Multrees Walk is home to the iconic Harvey Nichols. For entertainment, catch a comedy or theatre show at the Edinburgh Playhouse, two miles away. Relax after a busy day in your room with a flat-screen TV and en-suite with shower. Enjoy a free buffet breakfast each morning before heading out for the day. Order light bites and coffees throughout the day and grab a pizza in the evening from our menu. Relax with drinks from the bar in our Great Room and catch up with free Wi-Fi.

16229.description: This superb manor is located in Coulsdon, amidst 140 acres of landscaped parkland. London and Gatwick are just a 20 minutes' driving distance away, offering visitors the best of both worlds. This superb property was designed and built for the Byron family in the 1850s. Showcasing classical style and elegance, the property features stunningly-designed rooms, which are complemented with modern amenities. The surrounding golf course was developed in 1937, designed by the renowned H S Cold. Guests can enjoy an invigorating workout in the fitness centre, followed by relaxation in the steam room and sauna. A delectable dining experience awaits in the restaurant. The elegant terrace bar offers a peaceful setting in which to sit back and relax.

16233.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestJust 17 minutes by train to London, Hilton London Croydon offers a great location to explore London city center attractions, as well as Croydon city center shopping, restaurants, nightlife, and family activities. The newly refurbished hotel with all new rooms, lobby, lounge, and bar, offers comfortable family rooms and kids dining options, wellness rooms, and suites for guests who are seeking an exceptionally relaxing experience, with plenty of space to catch up on your laptop in your room or in the lounge bar. Add on a private session in the Hilton Private Wellness Area to recuperate from your travels, feel your best and sleep well. With 15 meeting rooms for up to 300 guests and unique wellness meeting themes, a 24-hour Gym with weights and cardiovascular machines, and dining at The Larder Restaurant or in the Lounge Bar, serving dishes inspired by the best local comforts and tastes from around the world, guests are sure to enjoy their stay.

16234.description: This hotel is centrally located, just 100 metres from a public transport connection. Bars, restaurants and shopping venues lie within 500 metres of the hotel. And the nearest nightclub is located a mere 800 m from the hotel. The city hotel was built in 2001 and consists of 240 double rooms on 12 floors. Various facilities are available to guests including a foyer with a 24-hour reception, a safe and a currency exchange facility. In addition, Internet access, a small supermarket and shops are also available. Furthermore a conference room, a TV room and a laundry service are available to guests. There is also an à la carte restaurant. All of the comfortable rooms come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a double bed and central heating. Guests may choose their breakfast from individual buffets. When dinner is included in the booking, vouchers will be provided which can be exchanged for meal in the restaurant.

16235.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Complimentary Evening Social, Fitness Center, Breakfast, Pool, Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: On-site Restaurant(s), Spa. Welcome to DoubleTree by Hilton Dartford Bridge, a stylish hotel at the ‘Gateway to London. ' Located just 4 miles from the premier Bluewater Shopping Centre, we're also just off the M25 motorway, making exploring the Kent countryside a breeze. Travel to central London in 17 minutes from the Ebbsfleet International rail station, just 5 miles away. We'll greet you at check-in with a warm DoubleTree chocolate chip cookie. Settle into a spacious guest room with modern decor, an LCD TV, work desk and WiFi access. Deluxe rooms offer indulgent extras like a welcome plate, sparkling mineral water, bathrobes and slippers. Suites provide a separate living area, coffee machine, and a later check-out time. Enjoy international cuisine and views of the Dartford Bridge at QE2 Restaurant – perfect for celebrating special occasions or catching up on business. Our QE2 Bar has an extensive wine, beer and spirits list, and the QE2 Lounge is a great spot for specialty coffees, pastries and sandwiches. Exercise body and mind with a fully equipped fitness centre plus leisure facilities including a 15-meter swimming pool, spa bath, sauna and steam room. Planning an event? Guests have a choice of eight meeting and conference rooms, all well-equipped, air-conditioned and newly refurbished. The Swanley Suite is particularly impressive for larger events, boasting natural light and a private bar. Ask our friendly staff about event packages and catering options. Highlights:-Dartford hotel near the M25 with on-site parking-179 oversized and recently renovated guest rooms-QE2 Restaurant, bar, lounge and 24-hour room service-Fitness centre, large indoor pool and wellness facilities-Fresh and modern event venues for up to 250 guests

16296.description: Conveniently located near London Stansted Airport, this stylish 4-star hotel is just a six-minute shuttle ride from the main terminal building. Whether you're heading off on a new adventure or are new to the city, it's the perfect base camp to relax and plan during your stay in the capital. With spacious rooms and a dedicated business centre, as well as 24-hour access to our on-site fitness centre, you'll have a hard time thinking of an excuse to leave!

16297.description: A stylish Sutton hotel with a welcoming Open Lobby, serving food all through the day, with a relaxing indoor pool and sauna. Holiday Inn® London - Sutton hotel places you a short walk from Sutton train station and steps from town centre shops and restaurants. At nearby Sutton station, fast trains to London Victoria take half an hour. On-site parking is available at the hotel, and Gatwick (LGW) and Heathrow (LHR) airports are both under a 45-minute drive away. Business travellers are close to several corporate HQs, and a Business Centre with printing facilities is available. A short drive away, you can enjoy horse racing at Epsom Downs. Thirty minutes by car takes you to the rides and zoo at Chessington World of Adventures, Hampton Court’s maze and palace, or Centre Court tennis at Wimbledon. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free Wi-Fi throughout- 24-hour room service- On-site parking at a daily rateStylish guest rooms feature comfy beds and pillow menus to guarantee a good night’s sleep. Start your day with a full English breakfast buffet, and enjoy lunch and dinner in our Open Lobby. Relax over Starbucks coffee or drinks in the lobby lounge. At Spirit Health Club you can enjoy the pool and gym, or pamper yourself with a spa session.

name.content: Birmingham North Moor Hall Hotel, BW Premier

16298.description: A delightful country house hotel set in parkland yet within easy reach of Birmingham, the NEC, the motorway network and attractions such as Drayton Manor Park and Cadbury World. Ideal for business or pleasure, the Birmingham North Moor Hall Hotel, BW Premier Collection offers 83 comfortable and well equipped ensuite bedrooms, including four posters, a choice of two restaurants, seven conference rooms and extensive leisure facilities including an indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, steam room, aerobics room and spa with three treatment rooms. There's ample free parking and conference and banqueting for up to 250. To complete the picture, our team of friendly and professional staff is always on hand to offer our unique brand of traditional personal service. Enjoy your stay. Main restaurant The Oak Room is closed on Sunday and Bank Holidays. Dinner rates include a 3-course Carvery instead.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express - Edinburgh City Centre

16310.description:
A modern Edinburgh hotel in a Georgian building within walking distance of the city's top attractionsHoliday Inn Express® - Edinburgh City Centre hotel is a 10-minute walk from Edinburgh Waverley station in the city's New Town. It's a short stroll to the York Place tram stop, which has a direct connection to Edinburgh Airport (EDI). The Edinburgh Playhouse theatre and OMNI Edinburgh's restaurants and cinemas are right across the road. Princes Street and George Street's shops are a few minutes' walk away. You can ramble over the ramparts of Edinburgh Castle, 20 minutes' walk from the hotel. Or experience more royal flavour, less than a mile from the hotel, at the Palace of Holyroodhouse, the Queen's official Scottish residence. Amble through the expansive Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh, half an hour on foot from the hotel, or wander into Princes Street Gardens to spot the huge floral clock. Business guests are on the doorstep of the financial district around St. Andrew Square and George Street, while the Edinburgh International Conference Centre is less than 10 minutes' drive away. The hotel has a smart meeting rooms. Enjoy free Wi-Fi and an inclusive hot Express Start Breakfast. A nearby Fitness Centre is available to guests. Unwind after a busy day's sightseeing over a cool beer in the lounge bar. 

Please note, if parking in the nearby Q-Park Omni, the hotel does have a discount code we can provide to give our guests a 30% reduction. Please contact the hotel front desk to get this code prior to parking in the Q-Park Omni

16339.description: This magnificent hotel is nestled in the beautiful and historically rich city of Athens. Athens Airport is only 37 kilometres from this charming property and may be also reached by metro. Guests will appreciate ease of access to numerous local shopping malls, dining options and places of interest including the National Theatre right in front of the hotel. The establishment boasts superbly appointed guestrooms, offering an oasis of peace and tranquillity in the centre of this vibrant city. All the rooms enjoy a flamboyant neo-classical décor, comfortable furnishings and come complete with modern amenities to ensure a pleasant stay. Guests may savour Greek delicacies and international cuisine and enjoy a unique ambience at the on-site restaurant. In the mornings visitors may wake up to a delicious and hearty breakfast buffet offering fresh local products. The property also features versatile meeting facilities.

16342.description: Nestled in the heart of the Athenian Riviera, the Oasis Hotel & Apartments enjoys a prime location in the cosmopolitan suburb of Glyfada. Just a 20-minute drive from central Athens and Piraeus, and 25 km from Eleftherios Venizelos International Airport, the hotel is easily accessible by public transport or taxi. It offers 70 stylish and fully equipped apartments, each with a private balcony and en-suite facilities. Guests can enjoy the gourmet restaurant, bar, coffee shop, and comfortable lounge, as well as conference and banqueting facilities. The tranquil garden, complete with a swimming pool and hot tub, provides a relaxing oasis for guests.

16351.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Park Hotel in Falkirk, conveniently located within a 5-minute drive of Falkirk Town Hall and Falkirk Golf Club. We offer 73 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Each room also includes a desk, coffee/tea maker, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combination and hairdryer. Hotel amenities include a restaurant with room service (limited hours), a bar/lounge, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and free self-parking. Nearby attractions include Callendar House (1. 4 mi), the Falkirk Wheel (2 mi), and The Kelpies (2. 6 mi). Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 20 miles away, and Glasgow International Airport (GLA) is 32 miles away.

16727.description: The Macdonald Houstoun House is actually three houses in one: the towerhouse complemented by an elegant country manor and charming steading. This characterful combination ensures that most rooms boast wonderful views across the hotel's gardens or beyond to the Ecclesmachan Hills. Built in the early 17th century by John Shairp, the old tower of Houstoun remained the Shairp family home for 350 years. Vaulted ceilings and open fires combine with traditional Scottish hospitality to create an atmosphere that is warm and welcoming but is still distinctly refined and discreet. All 71 guest rooms are tastefully furnished and well equipped, coming as standard with full en suite facilities, satellite television, direct dial telephone, modem point, hairdryer, iron and board, trouser press, complimentary mineral water, working area with desk and a shoe shine service. An extensive wine list, together with skilful presentation of dishes and fresh local produce, have made Houstoun one of the most outstanding restaurants in Scotland's central belt. The award winning fine dining restaurant is situated on the first floor in the historic 16th century tower. Alternatively, the Leisure Club Bistro offers more informal fare and surroundings. Leisure facilities at the Vital Leisure Club include an 18 metre swimming pool, sauna, sun shower, steam room, gymnasium, aerobics studio, beauty salon, tennis court, and golf course. These facilities are free for guest usage. tennis court, and golf course. Please note that the hotel doesn't accept any cash payments

16730.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace and garden at The Glasshouse, Autograph Collection hotel in Edinburgh. This hotel offers complimentary wired and wireless internet access, concierge and wedding services, and a television in the common area. Savor British cuisine at The Snug Lounge restaurant with garden views, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are available daily (for a fee). The hotel also features limo/town car service and express check-in. For events, there's 3, 714 square feet of space including a conference center and five meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). The 77 air-conditioned rooms include iPod docking stations, LCD televisions, and cable programming. Private bathrooms offer separate bathtubs and showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include the Edinburgh Playhouse Theatre, Calton Hill, and St. James Quarter. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is the preferred airport.

16734.description: This cosy boutique hotel is located in Edinburgh's fashionable West End, within easy walking distance of shopping at Princes Street, the Scottish National Gallery, and Haymarket Station. Sightseers might also visit the National Museum of Scotland and the historic Edinburgh Castle, both only two kilometres away. Guests will delight in the unique designs of the plush guest rooms as well as useful amenities such as free Wi-Fi and flat-screen cable televisions. The hotel serves a fresh, cooked-to-order Scottish breakfast prepared with local, organic produce and with traditional options such as haggis and black pudding, and the sumptuous library offers an inviting place for guests to enjoy a coffee or tea over a daily newspaper by the fire. Business travellers can also make use of the modern business centre and events room. This hotel's stylish design and great services make it no ordinary bed and breakfast.

16738.description: This vibrant international hostel is ideally located in the heart of Edinburgh's Old Town, with the historic Royal Mile at its doorstep. It's an excellent base for exploring Scotland's capital city. The hostel offers bright, clean, and comfortable accommodations ranging from 6- to 15-bed dormitories with superb city views to private double and twin rooms in a self-catering apartment with a fully equipped kitchen and bathroom. All dormitories include hot showers and free linen. Guests can enjoy the Southern Cross Café, the hostel's world-style bistro, with special discounts for residents. Additional amenities include 24-hour reception, secure storage for valuables and luggage, a booking service, a communal self-catering kitchen, email and internet access, cable TV, a pool table, and darts. Secure car parking is available a 5-minute walk away.

16741.description: This 3 star hotel is located within the city of Edinburgh. The nearest station is Haymarket.

16742.description: This luxurious 5-star retreat has a fine-dining restaurant and romantic bedrooms about 3 km from the Royal Mile. Prestonfield is surrounded by gardens and a golf course. Buses to the city centre are a 5-minute walk away. Parking is free. Each stylish room at Prestonfield House has antique furnishings, free Wi-Fi, Smart TV, a stocked minibar and views of the gardens and parkland. Rhubarb Restaurant serves excellent Scottish cuisine and traditional afternoon teas. The terraces, drawing room and gardens are relaxed, beautiful places to unwind.

16744.description: ‘Black Ivy' is situated on the south side of Edinburgh in Bruntsfield which has a relaxed village feel and a unique mix of original boutique shops, artisan bakers and chocolatiers as well as great cafes, bars and restaurants and all within walking distance of the city centre. Enter the hotel bar and you would be forgiven for thinking you had stepped into another world with Black Ivy's design ethos rich in thought and attention to detail, resulting in a bar appearance which is a treat for the eyes and simply makes you think 'wow”. Housed in 3 adjoining historic and beautiful town houses the hotel is contemporary and modern, inside and out. The welcome is warm and uniquely Scottish where you immediately feel part of the family and realise you have just discovered your new home from home. Above this coolest of bars with its live music, tank beer, table tennis games room and extensive and original cocktail list sits our boutique 22 bedroom Hotel offering divine luxurious beds, high speed WIFI, working desk and complimentary White Company Noir toiletries. The restaurant is open from 7am for the service of breakfast through to the early hours and is popular with locals and visitors alike. Our all-day menu has been created to suit all palates and cater for any dietary requirements. The South Side, as well as being a mecca for culture lovers and architecture buffs, is dominated by the vast green space of The Meadows which sits in front of Black Ivy's garden space which houses two warming and dramatic fire pits, bespoke seating and a tropical vibe whether your sipping a cooling summer cocktail or toasting marshmallow in the winter by the fire.

16770.description: Mussselburgh is a quiet fishing village. Edinburgh is one of the most exciting cities in the UK. So put yourself in pole position for both destinations, at Premier Inn Hotel Edinburgh A1 (Musselburgh). Whether you're here on business or pleasure, you'll have a great stay. Musselburgh is known as 'The Honest Toun', and we can honestly say you'll have a fantastic time here. Laugh your socks off at the Edinburgh Festival, or bet your shirt at the Musselburgh races. Don plus fours and have a round of golf at Royal Musselburgh, or visit Rosslyn Chapel, one of the most remarkable buildings in Scotland. Then come back to a hearty meal at our Brewers Fayre - no need to dress for dinner - and a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

16815.description: The Hotel is just a few minutes from the M42 and has free on-site parking. Birmingham City Centre is a short drive away, and it is less than an hour to Stoke-On-Trent. Birmingham New Street Station offers regular rail services to all major destinations across the UK. Birmingham International Airport is a 15 minute taxi ride, whilst East Midlands Airport is only 35 minutes. Situated in 550 acres of beautiful countryside, this hotel offers world-class golfing, sumptuous dining, extensive health & fitness facilities, Spa and free parking. The hotel's sole ambition is to create the perfect experience for their guests, whatever they wish to do. Of course, no visit would be complete without a few rounds on one of their legendary Golf courses. Host to more Ryder Cup matches than any other venue in the world, the Hotel is steeped in tournament history. Taking refuge in one of the 324 en-suite rooms, guests are sure of a comfortable and relaxing night's stay. All of the rooms are tastefully decorated and appointed with all the necessary modern amenities, including: TV, direct dial telephone, hairdryer and tea & coffee facilities. For extra indulgence, Superior Rooms are available, most with stunning golf course views. There are also the luxurious Suites, offering king size beds and balconies in selected rooms. The Hotel is a Mecca for professional and amateur golf players alike. Play the Brabazon, the internationally recognised championship course, the PGA National, England's only PGA branded course or The Derby – a shorter, more relaxed course for players of all levels. Benefit from world-class tuition at the PGA National Golf Academy or indulge in retail therapy at Europe's largest on-course golf and lifestyle store.

name.content: The Fifty Sonesta Hotel New York

16822.description: Experience the vibrant energy of Midtown East at the Fifty Sonesta Select New York. Located just blocks from Rockefeller Center, Times Square, and the Theater District, our hotel offers a relaxing and productive stay for both business and leisure travelers. Choose from 252 spacious guest rooms and apartments, some featuring urban kitchens and terraces, providing ample space to work or unwind. Enjoy the convenience of nearby Fortune 500 headquarters, Fifth and Madison Avenue shopping, and popular dining options. Discover Sonesta's signature hospitality with our inviting common areas and modern amenities. Whether you're here for business or pleasure, the Fifty Sonesta Select offers a comfortable and convenient home base for exploring Manhattan.

name.content: THE NEW YORKER HOTEL BY LOTTE HOTELS

16831.description: Ideally located in the Times Square area, The New Yorker Hotel promises a relaxing and wonderful stay. A wide range of amenities ensures a great time, with attentive staff to welcome and guide you. Guestrooms are designed for optimal comfort with welcoming decor, and some offer amenities like LCD/plasma TVs, carpeting, sofas, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enhance your stay with recreational facilities such as the fitness center. Make The New Yorker Hotel your base for exploring all New York City has to offer.

16833.description: Located in the heart of New York City, just steps from Times Square, The Gallivant Times Square offers a chic boutique hotel experience with 336 stylish rooms. This makes it the perfect base for exploring Manhattan's dining, nightlife, theater, and entertainment scene. Whether you're a business traveler, family planner, or weekend warrior, The Gallivant caters to all with a range of room layouts, including in-room fitness equipment, bunk beds and even a presidential suite with a rooftop balcony. Experience an upscale yet affordable New York City stay, complete with modern art-inspired decor, reflecting the concept of time. Check-in is at 3 pm, and check-out is at noon. Late check-out can be requested on the day of departure, subject to availability and potential charges.

16853.description: Ace Hotel & Swim Club Athens is our new home in Glyfada, hugging the region’s best beaches yet a short jaunt to the city core. The hotel stands as testament to Athenian tradition and the city’s cultural renaissance underway — and the tensions that exist therein. Featuring a sparkling pool and Mediterranean bistro, Ace Hotel Athens is a portal to the playful coastal culture of the Riviera and the vast energy of the ancient capital.

16854.description: Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Grab a bite to eat at Sintonía, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 110 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature designer toiletries and bidets.

16871.description: Situated in the heart of Edinburgh, this historic city hotel is just steps from Princes Street, Edinburgh Castle, the Royal Mile, and the vibrant Grassmarket area. Steeped in tradition and charm, the hotel's unique architecture features alcoves and turrets, creating a captivating atmosphere. The tastefully decorated contemporary rooms offer a relaxing retreat after a day exploring the city or attending events at the nearby International Conference Centre, located just 1. 5 km away. Start your day with the hotel's breakfast buffet, ensuring you're well-fueled for whatever adventures await.

name.content: Channings Hotel, an Ascend Hotel Collection Member

16872.description: This upscale hotel is undoubtedly one of the friendliest and most sophisticated in the city. It offers the rare charm of a country house atmosphere in an urban setting, making it ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Overlooking spectacular private gardens on a quiet, cobbled street, the hotel is just 10 minutes from the West End, with numerous shops and stunning views of Edinburgh Castle. Guests can choose from individually decorated bedrooms, including three suites and a four-poster room. Amenities include a private hot tub for a romantic stay, and a fabulous on-site restaurant is available for all guests.

16875.description: The 4-star Novotel Edinburgh Centre hotel is located in the heart of the Scottish capital. After a day exploring Edinburgh, recuperate in our heated pool & spa, and join us for cocktails and craft beers and contemporary cuisine in the Tap Kitchen & Bar. And when you're ready to relax, discover the meaning of true comfort in our newly upgraded rooms.

16876.description: Situated in the heart of the city, this luxurious hotel is the perfect place to explore cosmopolitan Edinburgh. In just a few minutes, visitors can walk to the world famous Princes Street, and the main business community, shopping and entertainment areas are all within easy reach. Rooms have been tastefully and traditionally furnished in keeping with the character of the building and offer a high standard of accommodation. The hotel also appeals to delegates meeting for a day or two, families and friends attending a city wedding, theatregoers and couples making the most of Edinburgh on a weekend break. Whether it is business or leisure, there is always time to relax amongst the comfort and warmth of this establishment.

16878.description: Hotel Transit offers 25 comfortable rooms equipped with TVs and central heating, conveniently located near the Sants metro and train station in Barcelona. This budget-friendly hotel provides a clean and functional base for exploring the city. Please note that the local city tax is not included in the room rate and is payable directly to the hotel upon arrival or departure.

16899.description: Enjoy the best leisure and business offer in Novotel Madrid City Las Ventas, a modern, functional hotel with excellent communication and location. Its spacious, quiet and fully equipped rooms, some overlooking Madrid, offer a perfect rest from work or touring. After a day in one of its eight multipurpose rooms, it is time to relax in the outdoor pool or on the terrace of your fusion restaurant.

16900.description: The Best Western Kings Manor Hotel offers an idyllic retreat in Edinburgh's quiet eastern suburbs, yet remains conveniently close to the city's vibrant attractions, shops, bars, and restaurants, just 20 minutes away. Housed in a charming 160-year-old former convent, this hotel boasts a rich history. Located just half a mile from Musselburgh's picturesque harbor and Portobello Beach's golden sands, and a short 20-minute drive from Edinburgh Castle and the Scottish National Gallery, the hotel offers easy access to key attractions. The hotel features a large leisure club, the second largest among Edinburgh hotels, and offers 100 en-suite rooms, including twin/double rooms, club rooms, and accessible accommodations. Dining options abound, from the contemporary Lauders Restaurant with its impressive à la carte menu to the relaxed Options Bistro serving classic and modern dishes, and Bar Zest for drinks and snacks. Children under 12 stay free when accompanied by two adults.

16903.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the suburbs of Edinburgh. The hotel has a gorgeous brasserie restaurant and bar on site, featuring bistro and á la carte menus. The grounds have several walking paths in the surrounding woods, a water fountain often featured in outdoor weddings, and neighbouring friendly horses.

16964.description: The Royal Scots Club is a 31-bedroom property located in Edinburgh's New Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Occupying three Georgian townhouses, the club is spread over six floors, with lift access to all levels. Located opposite a peaceful garden, the club is less than a 10-minute walk from Princes Street, with local bus routes just a 2-minute walk away. The club offers bed and breakfast, meeting and event spaces, private dining, and excellent cuisine in our dining room. With several meeting rooms catering for parties of 2 to 182, it's ideal for business trips or private events. Enjoy the stunning Queen Street Gardens during a private dinner. For GPS, use postcode EH3 6QE or W3W location: tent. odds. covers (55. 956283, -3. 197780). Breakfast is offered for £12. 50. The Royal Scots Club is Green Tourism certified.

16969.description: The Mercure Livingston Hotel is a sophisticated 3-star hotel in the city heart. Just 16 miles south of Edinburgh and close to some of Scotland's best country parks, it offers guests the perfect blend of style and convenience. With eight meeting rooms and a dedicated restaurant and bar offering international cuisine, it is the prime destination for business and leisure guests.

16970.description: Welcome to Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh Airport. With on-site parking, an airport shuttle, and a complimentary breakfast, it’s the perfect choice for a stress-free pre or post-flight stay. For travel, consider our Park, Stay & Go packages. Edinburgh's main train stations, Haymarket and Waverley, are both within a short drive. Explore nearby attractions like Edinburgh Castle, The Royal Mile, and Princes Street with a quick tram or bus ride into the city centre. Thrill seekers can visit the Edinburgh International Climbing Arena, while animal lovers will enjoy Edinburgh Zoo, just five miles away. For shopping and dining, visit the Gyle Shopping Centre or St James Quarter. If you're attending events, the Royal Highland Centre is a short walk from the hotel, and Scottish Gas Murrayfield Stadium is a 20-minute drive away. After a busy day, unwind in our lounge with a snack and a drink, or start your day with our free buffet breakfast.

name.content: The Caledonian Edinburgh Curio Collection Hilton

16973.description: Please always contact the property if you require a connecting room. The Caledonian is one of Edinburgh’s most significant landmarks. Standing proudly at the West End of Princes Street, this former Victorian railway building hotel nestles in the shadow of the imposing Edinburgh Castle. Its reputation for style and excellence has attracted international visitors and notable personalities for over one hundred years. Admire some of the best views in Edinburgh from our 231 guest rooms and suites and dine at Dean Banks at The Court. The Caledonian Edinburgh, experience the grandeur of The Lounge, formerly the station concourse and ticket office, now a haven for afternoon tea and elegant evening drinks. Treat yourself to some of the finest Scottish whiskies and signature cocktails at The Caley Bar, or indulge at the Spa at The Caledonian, a sanctuary of luxury and relaxation, home to a luxurious swimming pool, sauna, steam room, whirlpool, and two gyms.
