The Caledonian Edinburgh is one of the most splendid venues Edinburgh has to offer for meetings, events and weddings. Since opening in 1903, The Caledonian Edinburgh has staged many prestigious events, from extravagant wedding celebrations and star-packed parties to lavish corporate gatherings and grand banquets.

16974.description: Located in Edinburgh's stylish West End, this luxurious hotel seamlessly blends its 1860s heritage with chic, modern interiors. Guests will appreciate original features like ornate staircases and detailed coving alongside contemporary decor. Just 200 meters from Haymarket station and a short walk from Edinburgh Castle, Princes Street, and the Royal Mile, it's an ideal base for exploring Scotland's capital. A range of spacious guest rooms, suites, and deluxe rooms, all filled with natural daylight, await. For corporate travelers, the hotel offers three conference suites and five elegant meeting rooms, accommodating up to 500 delegates with state-of-the-art technology and support. After work, unwind with a meal at the hotel restaurant or savor a Scotch whisky at the contemporary bar while enjoying live sports.

16986.description: This city hotel is situated at the heart of the tourist area of Alanya with shops, restaurants and bars as well as links to the public transport system to be found in the hotel's immediate vicinity while the beach is only 100m away. Ideal for beach lovers and those who enjoy being close to a resort's amenities, the pretty harbour area where there are a number of bars and nightclubs is a 15-20 minute walk. The hotel features an outdoor pool where guests can enjoy a refreshing dip and benefit from the on-site snack bar for a light meal during the day. A couple of computer terminals in the lobby area are available for guests' use and there is a cosy bar where a pleasant evening can be spent

16988.description:
Right across the Mediterrenean Sea, this hotel offers an outdoor pool, spa facilities and a private beach area. It has air-conditioned rooms with a satellite TV and balcony. 
The rooms at Aydinbey Gold Dreams - Ultra All Inclusive come with a minibar. They all feature a private bathroom with shower and hairdryer. A safe is standard. 
Aside from the buffet restaurant that serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, you can also find a snack restaurant, gozleme and Turkish pastries at tea time. The à la carte restaurants include Barbeque, Fish and Italian cuisines. The bars serve refreshing drinks. 
Spa facilities include a Turkish bath, sauna, indoor pool and fitness room; massage services can also be provided. You can play a game of table tennis, billiards and darts at Hotel Aydinbey Gold Dream. There is also a children’s playground.

16989.description: Our Hotel is situated on the Konaklı - Alanya coastline, one of the most popular touristic places in Antalya and 115 km distance to Antalya, 110 km to Antalya Airport and 12 km to Alanya. Closest shopping center Konaklı is 1 km and main road is 20 m. distance from our Hotel. It is available every 10 minutes regular minibus from the main road to Konaklı or Alanya and 24 hours taxi service.

16990.address: Güller Pınarı Mahallesi, Ahmet Tokuş Blv, 43
16990.description: Enjoying excellent panoramic views over the Mediterranean Sea and the harbour of Alanya, this modern hotel is separated from the beach only by a coastal road. A spa area with hammam guarantees absolute relaxation, the centre of Alanya with its large variety of shops, restaurants, bars and cafés is within a short stroll. The international airport of Antalya is about 120 km away.

16991.description: This holiday village is located 16 km west of Alanya, a few metres from the beach and public transportation links. The complex consists of a main hotel building and individual blocks and offers a range of facilities which include 3 outdoor pools, a spa centre, internet corner and daily animation (seasonal). The hotel offers a private beach, 600 metres from the complex which has a snack bar, sunbeds and umbrellas. Local attractions include Alanya Castle, the Red Tower, Alanya Archaeological Museum and Damlatas Cave.

17000.description: Located in Alanya's city center, Maren Beach Apart Hotel is a short 2-minute walk from the beach. It features bright apartments with spacious balconies, each offering stunning sea or mountain views. All 52 units include air conditioning, fully equipped kitchens, and TVs. Bathrooms are fitted with showers and hairdryers. Guests can dine in the à la carte restaurant, enjoying their meals indoors, in the garden, or by the pool. The hotel bar serves a variety of refreshing drinks. For recreation, guests can play billiards or relax by the outdoor pool. A children's playground is available in the garden. Local attractions include Alanya Castle and Damlatas Cave, both just 2 km away. Antalya Airport is 120 km away, while Gazipaşa Airport is closer, at 40 km. The hotel boasts a top-rated location in Alanya, offering excellent value for your money.

17001.description: Located right by the beach in the district of Konakli, 13 km from the resort of Alanya, this seafront hotel is ideally placed for beach lovers and families. Buses and taxis run close to the property enabling easy access into the popular resort of Alanya as well as to the many other places of interest in the area such as Manavgat Waterfalls, a little over  50 km away. Boasting a range of entertainment amenities as well as facilities for relaxation, there is plenty to keep everyone occupied, even if this means chilling by the relax pool or having fun on the waterslides or on the hotel beach. Evenings can be enjoyed watching the sunset on the outdoor terrace directly over-looking the Mediterranean before being entertained by an animation show in the amphitheatre.

17017.description: CIN: IT015146A1B777BV8H The trendy hotel Mediolanum enjoys an ideal location in the centre of Milan, within a 5-minute walk from the central station, Porta Venezia and Piazza della Repubblica as well as within a short stroll from the Public Gardens. The city centre with attractions such as the Scala Theatre, the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II and the Piazza del Duomo with the impressive Cathedral are within easy reach. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with art works by renowned interior designers such as Man Ray or Le Corbusier. The stylish rooms are decorated in a vivid and colourful design, creating the beneficial atmosphere of colour therapy. Features include air-conditioning and satellite flat-screen TV. Business guests will appreciate the 24-hour business centre and complimentary WIFI access throughout the hotel. After a long day of working or sightseeing, guests can unwind having a drink at the cool space age-style bar. A great base from which to discover this vibrant city.

17018.description: Located near Milan's Public Gardens and Central Station, the boutique Hotel Sanpi offers 82 uniquely styled rooms. This hotel blends classic Italian design with contemporary touches, evident in the period furnishings and artwork throughout its rooms and common areas. A generous buffet breakfast is available from 7:00 am to 10:30 am, featuring sweet and savory options. Guests can also enjoy an aperitivo and international cocktails at the bar, open daily from 4:00 pm to midnight. For business travelers, the Azzurra meeting room provides a well-equipped space for corporate events. Hotel Sanpi also features a complimentary gym adorned with original paintings and sculptures. Repubblica and Porta Venezia stations, offering direct connections to Rho Fiera Milano, are a short 5-minute walk away.

17021.description: The Hotel Dei Cavalieri, a luxurious hotel nestled in the heart of Milan, occupies a building dating back to 1949. Just 400 meters from Duomo Square, it offers easy access to the renowned shopping district, with its array of traditional and trendy restaurants and bars. Public transport is available directly in front of the hotel, providing excellent connections to the main train station. The hotel is also easily accessible by car, with private parking available nearby for €28 per day. The front desk can assist with activating the congestion charge. Linate and Malpensa Airports are 8 and 50 km away, respectively. The hotel features contemporary, elegant rooms with stylish furnishings and modern amenities, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

17028.description: Enjoy numerous amenities at this Athens hotel, including a sauna, fitness center, and seasonal outdoor pool. Stay connected with complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and enjoy satellite programming on your LED television. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Savor lunch or dinner at Ellinikon restaurant, grab a coffee at one of the two cafes, or relax with a drink at the poolside bar or one of the two lounges. Room service is available during limited hours. Buffet breakfast is offered daily (fee applies). For business travelers, the hotel features a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and over 3, 000 square feet of meeting space. Limited onsite parking is available. Nearby attractions include Mount Lycabettus, Pedion Areos Park, and the National Archaeological Museum. Athens International Airport (ATH) is approximately 32. 6 km away.

17029.description: Located in the heart of Athens, Greece, it is a newly renovated hotel offering an oasis of calm in the centre of the bustling city of Athens. The great location of The Stratos Vassilikos hotel allows easy access to major tourist attractions and business districts. The hotel offers guests a lobby with a 24-hour reception, a café, an air-conditioned gourmet restaurant. Furthermore 5 conference rooms, a corner with tablets and a gym with a sauna are also available. The spacious and comfortable rooms offer an en-suite bathroom with hairdryer, and complimentary toiletries. Guests have the opportunity to relax in the hotel's sauna and steam room or to work out in the gym. A Greek buffet breakfast is served. Gourmet cuisine lunches and dinners are à la carte.

17030.description: Nestled in a quiet corner of Athens, this six-story hotel offers convenient access to the city's main attractions. It features 93 rooms, including 12 singles, 62 doubles, and 19 suites. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour reception, an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant, a café, a meeting room, a business center, and a bar. Room and laundry services are available, and limited parking is provided on a first-come, first-served basis. Each comfortable room includes an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer and complimentary toiletries, and is well-equipped for a relaxing stay. A buffet breakfast is served, and à la carte lunch and dinner options are available. During the summer months (May 1st to mid-October), guests can experience the 'Mavili Beach' rooftop, a Cycladic-inspired oasis with a pool and a minimum consumption policy.

17031.description: CIN: IT015146A128MHS885Set in a really well-connected location right in the centre of Milan, this hotel is a great choice for business and leisure travellers visiting the city. It sits between the Milano Centrale and Porta Garibaldi Railway stations, both a 5-minute walk away, and just 20 metres from the nearest subway station. From the property, guests can reach the famous landmarks such as the Duomo within minutes. Those interested in high-end shopping will be at just a 10-minute stroll from the famous Corso Buenos Aires and at the end of their spree they can enjoy a relaxed dinner and any of the posh restaurants that surround it. The venue itself offers a cosy atmosphere and all the necessities required for kicking back and enjoying a good night's sleep, such as comfortable and well-appointed rooms and a nice breakfast room.

name.content: Puccini Hotel Milan, Tapestry Collection by Hilton

17033.description: The Puccini Hotel Milan, Tapestry Collection by Hilton is on Corso Buenos Aires, centrally located and full of trendy restaurants and bars, in the heart of one of the most famous shopping area in Milan and a short walk from Central Station and the historic city center. At 50 metres from the hotel is the stop LIMA of the red line metro allowing quick access to all the major tourist attractions of the city. the 65 cozy rooms are equipped with all modern facilities and thanks to the large size, some rooms are suitable to comfortably accommodate families. Breakfast is served every day with a rich hot and cold buffet offering a great variety of delicious savory dishes and homemade cakes as well as health food or celiac. Free WiFi Internet connection is active throughout the hotel, while a pay garage is located within few meters from the hotel. A meeting room with natural light can accommodate 25 people theatre-style

17034.description: Hotel Morimondo is a unique hotel, set in a 12th century convent in the Morimondo Abbey. Its elegant rooms feature oak-beamed ceilings and simple furnishings, 19 mi from Milan. It is set in the Ticino National Park, and a 2. 5 mi from a partner spa, where guests enjoy discounts. Parking is free. Each air-conditioned guest room comes with free WiFi, a flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom complete with hairdryer and amenities. A buffet-style breakfast including local produce is served daily.

17035.description: This 44-guestroom hotel offers a range of amenities for a comfortable stay. Enjoy on-site dining at the coffee shop/cafe, or take advantage of room service during limited hours. Unwind at the bar/lounge or in the garden, and maintain your fitness routine at the fitness center. For entertainment, the hotel has an arcade/game room and a television in the common area. Business amenities include a business center and express check-in/check-out. Self-parking is available (fees apply). Each guestroom features a refrigerator, an LCD television with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, down comforters, Frette Italian sheets, designer toiletries, and a hair dryer. The hotel is conveniently located near the Sanctuary of Our Lady of Miracles (1. 4 mi), Teatro Giuditta Pasta (1. 5 mi), and Il Chiostro arte contemporanea (1. 5 mi). The nearest airport is Milan Malpensa Airport (MXP), 20. 3 mi away.

17042.description: A new hotel near the central station and very close to the Corso Buenos Aires shopping area. The nearest metro station is a few metres away in the Plaza Lima. All rooms feature satellite TV, free wifi, and air conditioning. The hotel is next to Lima Metro Station in central Milan and just 4 metro stops from the Duomo. Breakfast is buffet style, with a wide range of continental items. Casual Eclettico is a 15-minute walk from Milan Central Station

17056.address: Blvd. Kukulcan km. 19.5 Lote. 59-2. Zona Hotelera
17056.description:
All-inclusive family beachfront resort in Cancún with an exclusive adults-only area
Located on a spectacular white-sand beach with turquoise waters, GR Solaris Cancún is just 13 km from Cancún International Airport, offering an ideal combination of location, comfort, and service. 
The resort features 306 rooms designed for relaxation, with comfortable spaces and pleasant views. It also includes an exclusive adults-only area with a relaxation pool and jacuzzi, perfect for enjoying a more peaceful atmosphere. 
Among its facilities are a spa, a fully equipped gym, and a comprehensive program of daytime activities and nightly entertainment for all ages. For added convenience, room service is available 24 hours a day (additional charge of $5 USD per service). 
The dining experience is one of the resort’s main highlights, with a carefully curated selection of restaurants offering a variety of international flavors in unique settings. Café Solaris features a full buffet for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, ideal for enjoying a wide range of options. In the evenings, Don Gus invites guests to discover the best of Mexican cuisine à la carte, while Zai offers an oriental concept with freshly prepared specialties. Marco Polo completes the experience with an exquisite selection of Italian dishes à la carte. 
Additionally, guests can enjoy pizzas and light snacks at Le Cinque Terre, as well as a deli offering a selection of coffees and baguettes, perfect for a relaxing afternoon break. The experience is complemented by bars serving unlimited national and international drinks, ideal for any time of day. 
As an added value, the resort has a private marina located just 600 meters away, perfect for kayaking in the lagoon and participating in yoga and stretching sessions on the dock. 
Guests also enjoy access to an exclusive speakeasy-style sports bar located 800 meters away, open daily from 7:00 pm to 1:00 am (limited transportation available).

17060.description: This pleasant hostel is located in a quarter close to the Les Grandes Boulevards. The Musée Grévin, the opera house and Sacre Coeur as well as the large department stores are within walking distance. Other tourist attractions are easily reached using the local public transport, and there is a metro station around 100 m away. The nearest train station is around 500 m away. Charles de Gaulle and Orly airport are around 30 km away. The peaceful, comfortable rooms include oak furniture.

17061.description: This hotel enjoys a wonderful setting amidst the beauty and romance of Paris. The property is located close to the Grand Boulevard and Cadet Station. Guests can enjoy ease of access to the wealth of intriguing attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. Ample shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can also be found nearby. The hotel enjoys an attractive design. The guest rooms are comfortable and tastefully-styled. Guests can enjoy a wonderful dining experience in the restaurant, where delectable dishes are served. Guests will be pleased by the high level of customer service that the hotel has to offer.

17063.description: Situated in Levallois-Perret just outside of Paris, this city hotel is just minutes away from the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Elysées. Priding itself on its location, this hotel is within easy reach of the business district La Défense and Espace Champerret. Many tourist attractions are within walking distance making this hotel perfect for guests wishing to be in the centre of activity. Orly and Charles de Gaulle airports are within easy driving distance of the hotel. The hotel enjoys an attractive style, and tastefully furnished rooms allow for guests to unwind after a busy day of work or travel. This hotel utilises space efficiently so that guests can enjoy their time spent relaxing in their room. For guests wishing to couple affordability with comfort, this hotel will not fail to please. Conference facilities are available for guests on a working trip.

17064.description: This charming family-run hotel boasts a strategic location on the right bank of the Seine, just a short walk from the Moulin Rouge. Other attractions, including Montmartre and the Opera Grands Boulevards, are within a 10-minute radius. Guests can explore the romantic Parisian architecture and cultural scene, or indulge in retail therapy at Le Printemps and Galeries Lafayette. The cozy guest rooms are tastefully decorated and feature amenities such as flat-screen TVs and marble bathrooms. Each morning, a delicious continental breakfast buffet is served in the hotel's inviting vaulted dining room.

17067.description: The Hotel Beauvoisin, housed in a majestic Parisian building, offers elegant and comfortable interiors behind its beautiful façade. Ideally situated in central Paris, between Montmartre and the business district, it's just steps from the Moulin Rouge. This prime location provides easy access to major tourist attractions. The 31 guest rooms are pleasant and functional, each featuring a full bathroom, international TV channels, and a direct-dial telephone. High-performance fiber optic Wi-Fi and Netflix (on request) are also available. The friendly, professional staff is dedicated to making your stay in Paris a memorable one.

17069.description: Located only 10 minutes from the centre of Lisbon, encapsulated within the surroundings of the National Museum of Ancient Art and the districts of Lapa, Madragoa and Santos, this city hotel prides itself on its centrality. The Lisbon Portela airport is approximately 10 kms away, and public transport is within walking distance ensuring that access to and from the hotel is easy. This romantic boutique hotel is nested within a converted Carmelite convent and the traditional exterior creates an inviting aura for guests. Guests can enjoy views of lush greenery, old stone staircases and beautiful streamline interior architecture. Deep chocolate tones coupled with rich energising blues create a tranquil and peaceful living space. Guests can enjoy a tantalising meal in the restaurant and are sure to enjoy their time in this endearing, culturally-rich hotel. Note: Historic building, no elevator access to the upper floors, only by stairs.

17082.description: Situated near Uhlandstraße and Savignyplatz stations, this charming city hotel offers convenient access to Berlin's attractions, vibrant commercial areas, and diverse dining and shopping options. The Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, Stage Theater des Westens, and Berlin Zoological Garden are within a 10-minute walk. Guests appreciate the beautiful décor and warm hospitality. The rooms are designed for comfort and relaxation. Corporate travelers can utilize the on-site meeting facilities, while those seeking relaxation can enjoy the sauna and fitness center.

17097.description: The modern and comfortable Pozuelo Hotel offers a friendly atmosphere just outside Madrid's city center, in the thriving residential and business district of Pozuelo de Alarcón. This stylish hotel provides up-to-date services and amenities. All exterior rooms feature modern conveniences, including satellite TV, a minibar, and direct-dial phones. For business travelers, the Pozuelo Hotel specializes in all types of corporate and social events, offering various spacious lounges with state-of-the-art audiovisual equipment. Enjoy on-site parking, a snack bar, Wi-Fi, and a restaurant specializing in exquisite Spanish cuisine. The hotel also boasts convenient access to IFEMA and excellent transport links to Madrid.

17100.description: Centrally located in Amsterdam, Hotel The Exchange is a boutique hotel just a 5-minute walk from Dam Square and 12 minutes from the Anne Frank House. The 61 air-conditioned rooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi, LCD TVs with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Hotel amenities include a 24-hour front desk, express check-out, multilingual staff, wedding services, and tour/ticket assistance.

17101.description:
Centrally located, this hotel is situated on Amsterdam's main street, Damrak. It provides the ideal base from which to explore all Amsterdam has to offer. The North Sea is just 15 km away and the nearest golf course lies some 7 km from the hotel. Spaarnwoude Ski World with an indoor dry ski slope is within 10 km of hotel and public transport departs from stops directly in front of the hotel, allowing visitors to explore the rest of the city and its many sights.

This hotel offers a total of 36 rooms spread over 7 floors, of which 12 are singles, 13 are double rooms and 2 are suites. Amongst the hotel facilities count a foyer with 24-hour reception, a safe and a lift. Additional facilities include a café and an à la carte restaurant with a non-smoking area.

The comfortable rooms feature an en suite bathroom, a direct dial telephone, internet access, a safe, central heating, tiling and carpeting.

17102.description: The hotel is located in the city centre approximately 2 km from the railway station. It is just 30 m to the nearest canal. Various shops as well as international restaurants are just a stone's throw from the hotel's entrance and there is a nightclub close at hand. Public transport leaves from directly by the hotel. This hotel is located in an old house that was built in 1800. It has a total of 49 rooms. The lobby contains a 24-hour reception and a hotel safe. This hotel offers a very simple accommodation. It is recommended for guests who are not looking for luxury but want to be in the city centre. All of the simple, unostentatious rooms are fitted with central heating and are carpeted.

17106.description: CIN CODE: IT027042A15TGKBF3V This hotel is situated in a quiet location, close to the Grande Canal, only minutes from the main train station and the Piazzale Roma. The city centre, with numerous shopping and entertainment venues is just minutes from the hotel. Marco Polo airport is 15 km away and takes 20 minutes to reach on public transport. The hotel was built in 1900 and has been completely renovated. It offers a lobby with a 24-hour reception with a safe, a currency exchange desk and a TV room. There is also an air-conditioned restaurant with a non-smoking area and a bar available to guests. The hotel offers a room and laundry service to guests as well. The stylish rooms come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer. All of them are well equipped as standard and have a comfortable lounge area with a mini fridge. A breakfast buffet is available every morning.

17120.description: The Hotel Do Mar, situated in the charming fishing village of Sesimbra, offers stunning ocean views. Located just 40 km from Lisbon International Airport, this hillside retreat sits below the Moorish Castle and overlooks the picturesque bay of Sesimbra. Each of the 168 rooms features a sea view, air conditioning, a minibar, wireless internet, satellite television, a radio, a direct-dial telephone, and a safe. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as laundry and dry cleaning services, room service, and daily maid service. The hotel boasts a climate-controlled indoor swimming pool and a panoramic à la carte restaurant serving regional specialties.

name.content: Apollo Ht London–Near Hyde Park & Paddington Stati

17122.description: 'This affordable, family-run hotel offers comfortable accommodations in a quiet residential street near London's Hyde Park. A short walk from Queensway and Bayswater tube stations, it provides convenient access to central London. All guest rooms feature private bathrooms, color TVs, direct-dial telephones, and tea/coffee making facilities. Wi-Fi is available for a fee. Breakfast is included, and chargeable street parking is managed by Westminster Council. Guests are required to provide credit card details upon check-in as security for incidentals. Reception is open from 7 am to 11 pm. '

17123.description: The Beverley House Hotel, located in the heart of London, is a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. The hotel offers 23 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers. Guests can enjoy room service (limited hours), complimentary newspapers, and the convenience of a 24-hour front desk and multilingual staff. Marble Arch and Oxford Street are within a short distance, making this hotel an ideal base for exploring the city.

17125.description: The Shaftesbury Premier London Paddington, nestled in a private terrace just two minutes from Paddington Station, offers a tranquil escape from the bustling city center. This 4-star hotel boasts all the amenities expected of a premier London accommodation, including a stylish bar stocked with a wide selection of beverages. The spacious, airy, and quiet rooms, decorated in warm colors with quality furnishings, provide an ideal base for exploring London's many attractions.

17126.description: Discover London from our recently renovated and rebranded hotel in the heart of the city. Close to landmarks like Hyde Park, Royal Albert Hall, and Oxford Street, Europe's favorite shopping destination, our stylishly original rooms offer supreme comfort. Each boasts fashionable Italian furniture, vibrant chairs, and contemporary chandeliers, creating a perfect haven of convenience.

17127.description: The Troy Hotel, a privately owned boutique hotel, is ideally situated on a quiet terrace just west of London's Hyde Park. Offering convenient access to Oxford Street and the West End via public transport, and a direct bus route to Heathrow Airport just two minutes away on Bayswater Road, its location is unbeatable. The hotel's 33 elegant, contemporary suites, classified as Deluxe and Executive, have been recently renovated to the highest standards. All rooms feature Sky TV, pay-per-view movie channels, mini-fridges, and direct-dial telephones. Executive rooms additionally offer air conditioning and a choice of shower, shower and bath, or jetted tubs. The Troy Hotel also provides fully equipped conference facilities to meet all your business needs. Please note: Triple rooms may consist of either three single beds or one double bed and one folding bed.

17128.description: This hotel is well served by public transport and is an ideal starting point for those wishing to explore London's many sights. Numerous tourist attractions such as Kensington Palace, Buckingham Palace and Hyde Park are all to be found in the hotel's immediate vicinity. Heathrow airport is approximately 30 km away. There are a total of 50 appealing rooms are spread over 4 floors. The hotel's facilities include a reception hall, which is open 24 hours and a lift. The standard rooms are all en suite and come equipped with a hairdryer, a telephone, satellite TV, Internet access and central heating. Each morning there is a continental breakfast on offer for guests. By Car: From London Heathrow Airport - Depart. At the roundabout, take the first exit onto Bolton's Lane. Turn left onto Bath Road A4. At the roundabout, take the first exit onto The Parkway A312. At the roundabout, take the fourth exit onto Slip Road (M4 J3). Continue onto M4. Continue onto Great West Road A4. At the roundabout, take the second exit onto Great West Road A4. Continue onto A4. Turn left onto Warwick Road A3220. Turn right onto Pembroke Road A3220. Turn left onto Earl's Court Road B316. Turn right onto Kensington High Street A315. Bear left onto Kensington Church Street. Turn right onto Notting Hill Gate A40. Continue onto A40. Turn left onto Saint Petersburgh Place. Continue onto Ilchester Gardens. Turn right onto Prince's Square. Arrive.

17136.description: With a stay at New Hotel le Voltaire, you'll be centrally located in Paris, within a 10-minute drive of Notre-Dame and Centre Pompidou. This 4-star hotel is 2. 7 mi (4. 4 km) from Palais Garnier and 3. 1 mi (5 km) from Louvre Museum. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, babysitting, and tour/ticket assistance. Make yourself at home in one of the 48 individually furnished guestrooms. Satellite television is provided for your entertainment. Bathrooms have bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to noon for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Grands Boulevards - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Père Lachaise Cemetery - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Canal Saint-Martin - 0. 9 km/0. 5 mi- Place de la Bastille - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi- Opera Bastille - 1. 2 km/0. 7 mi- Place des Vosges - 1. 4 km/0. 9 mi- Rue de Rivoli - 1. 6 km/1 mi- Picasso Museum - 1. 8 km/1. 1 mi- Place de la Republique - 1. 9 km/1. 2 mi- Place de la Nation - 2 km/1. 2 mi- Île Saint-Louis - 2. 1 km/1. 3 mi- Jardin des Plantes - 2. 4 km/1. 5 mi- Centre Pompidou - 2. 5 km/1. 6 mi- Parc des Buttes Chaumont - 2. 5 km/1. 6 mi- Île de la Cité - 2. 6 km/1. 6 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 18. 6 km/11. 6 mi Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 29. 9 km/18. 6 mi The preferred airport for New Hotel le Voltaire is Paris Orly Airport (ORY).

name.content: Mercure Paris Opera Grands Boulevards Hotel

17137.description: Located in the center of Paris in the heart of the Opera district, close to the department stores and just minutes from the Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est stations, the Mercure Paris Opéra Grands Boulevards hotel combines charm, comfort and modern features. The Mercure Paris Opéra Grands Boulevards hotel is fully renovated with 49 air-conditioned rooms and free WIFI. Ideally located for public transit (Metro lines 4, 7, 8 and 9), this hotel will give you access to all of Paris.

17138.description: This hotel is situated at the heart of Paris, close to the famous Champs Elysées boulevard, making it the ideal starting point whence to explore the fascinating French capital. Links to the public transport network are some 200 m from the hotel. Occupying a historical building from the early 20th century, this luxury hotel offers a lounge bar, bellboy, concierge and valet parking. The spacious rooms and suites offer a combination of chic French décor alongside the latest technologies, all of them well – equipped as standard and with a bathroom with spa bath and separate shower. The hotel offers a spa centre with pink and grey tadelakt , a hammam, sauna and a gym equipped with the latest technogym equipment. A wide range of massages is available in the room on request. The closest subway metro station is Georges V on line 1.

17139.description: With a stay at New Hotel Lafayette, you'll be centrally located in Paris, within a 5-minute drive of Palais Garnier and La Machine du Moulin Rouge. This 4-star hotel is 1. 6 mi (2. 5 km) from Champs-Élysées and 2. 3 mi (3. 7 km) from Notre-Dame. Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and babysitting (surcharge). Stay in one of 50 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to noon for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Grands Boulevards - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Boulevard Haussmann - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Grevin Museum - 0. 6 km/0. 3 mi- Galeries Lafayette - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Theatre Mogador - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Grand Rex Cinema - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Palais Garnier - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Place de l'Opéra - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Printemps Department Store - 1. 2 km/0. 7 mi- Paris Olympia - 1. 4 km/0. 8 mi- Sacré-Cœur Basilica - 1. 4 km/0. 9 mi- Les Halles - 1. 4 km/0. 9 mi- Rue Montorgueil - 1. 4 km/0. 9 mi- Moulin Rouge - 1. 5 km/0. 9 mi- La Machine du Moulin Rouge - 1. 5 km/0. 9 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 29. 4 km/18. 3 mi Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 21. 4 km/13. 3 mi The preferred airport for New Hotel Lafayette is Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG).

17140.description: 'Stay at the 4-star Hôtel Petit Lafayette in the heart of Paris, just a short drive from the Palais Garnier and the Moulin Rouge. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Each of the 26 air-conditioned rooms features an iPod docking station, a flat-screen TV with cable programming, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Room service is available during limited hours, and to-go breakfasts are served daily for a fee. Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Nearby attractions include the Grands Boulevards, Grevin Museum, and Galeries Lafayette. '

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel London Stansted Airport

17149.description: Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy American cuisine at Station 169, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Bishop's Stortford? This hotel has 13993 square feet (1300 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 15 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 500 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions.

17178.description: This ho(s)tel is located in the lively and central area of the famous Red Light District of Amsterdam, a 5-minute walk from Dam Square, with many tram and metro stops nearby and Amsterdam central station about 12 minutes walking distance. You will experience a stay in a classic Dutch historical building, with 6 floors and its typical stairs (no elevator). Each room has a free Wi-Fi and there is a 24-hour reception.

17179.description:
Boutique Hotel De Pijp Amsterdam enjoys a prime location in the city’s lively De Pijp district, just a short stroll from the Heineken Experience and the bustling Albert Cuyp Market. Nestled directly across from Sarphatipark, guests can enjoy park views, peaceful walks, or simply relax in the hotel’s serene garden terrace with a drink from the boutique bar. Free WiFi is available throughout the property. 
Each room is thoughtfully designed for comfort and style, featuring a flat-screen TV, private shower or bath and some rooms offer beautiful views over the Sarphatipark. Whether traveling solo, as a couple, or with family and friends, guests will find a welcoming retreat to suit every need. 
A 24-hour front desk is available for your convenience. Start your day with a fresh continental breakfast including bread rolls, croissants, fruit, granola, juice, and unlimited coffee or tea, served to-go. The bar also offers a selection of Dutch snacks, local beers, and international spirits. 
Getting around couldn’t be easier: multiple tram, bus, and metro stops are all within a 5-minute walk from the hotel. Amsterdam Central Station is just a 5-minute metro ride away, while Schiphol Airport can be reached in under 30 minutes by public transport. Cultural hotspots like Leidseplein and Museumplein are both accessible in less than 10 minutes via tram. 
De Pijp is a favorite among locals and visitors alike for its vibrant bars, cozy cafés, diverse dining options, and relaxed neighborhood vibe.

name.content: Garner Hotel Berlin Ku'Damm by IHG

17190.description: The sparrows are singing from the rooftops of Berlin: A wonderful hotel is dedicated to them. In the Garner Hotel Berlin - Ku'Damm, a brand-new hotel with unique feel-good charm awaits guests. Close to the Kurfürstendamm, you as a business traveler or private vacationer will experience Nordic coziness during your stay. The Hygge lifestyle is reflected in the relaxed vibe and interior design. Warm, bright colors, soft light, and modern furnishings in Scandi style create a homey atmosphere—perfect for escaping the city's hustle! Our hotel offers 61 functional yet comfortable rooms, all with Smart TV, a cozy box spring bed, and high-speed WiFi. A varied breakfast buffet with Nordic dishes like smörrebröd and a fragrant waffle station completes the Hygge experience. Our bar also offers high-quality snacks and drinks. Thanks to its central location, our hotel is an ideal starting point for city tours.

17192.description: This hotel is situated in the district of Wilmersdorf on a quiet side street off the famous Kurfürsterndamm, the centre of West Berlin. Kaiser Wilhelm's memorial church, the ICC conference centre and the KaDeWe department store are located nearby. An abundance of shops and cultural venues are also to be found in the immediate vicinity. Numerous links to the public transport network lie close by. Amongst the hotel's facilities count a foyer with 24-hour reception with safes, a lift and a cloakroom. In addition, the hotel offers guests a restaurant with a non-smoking area and a TV. Car parking facilities are available. The agreeably furnished en suite rooms are fully – equipped as standard. Central heating comes as standard. A breakfast buffet is available to guests every morning.

17193.description: The hotel is located on Kurfürstendamm in the center of West Berlin. There are numerous shops, restaurants and bars in the area. The Brandenburg Gate, Potsdamer Platz and many other attractions can be easily reached by public transport . Guests can enjoy a nutricious meal with fantastic view over the city from the breakfast restaurant with terrace on the sixth floor. The cosy decorated rooms include TV, a private bathroom, some rooms feature balconies, and upgraded rooms add sitting areas.

17194.description: This modern apartment hotel is located on the Kufurstendamm Boulevard, in the heart of Berlin City West. The hotel enjoys close proximity to a wealth of attractions in the area. The hotel is situated close to Potsdamer Square, Alexander Square and the Column of Victory. Berlin Airport is conveniently located just 10 km away. The ICC Berlin and S-Bahn can be found just a few minutes' driving distance from the hotel. This wonderful hotel features luxurious materials, an upscale interior design, sleek decor and refreshing tones. The guest accommodation options offer an elegant setting in which to completely unwind. This hotel features a range of wonderful facilities and services, delivering a high level of comfort and convenience, along with an impressive standard of excellence.

17195.description: National fixed-line calls and WIFI are free at the ibis Styles Berlin City Ost Hotel. The ibis Styles Berlin City Ost hotel is located in the Friedrichshain district in the east of the city center. Alexanderplatz is just a few stations away on metro line U5, which can be reached on foot from the hotel. The individual design of our hotel makes it totally unique, and the 75 rooms offer lots of modern comforts. The bar is open until 2am daily.

17196.description: Priding itself on location, this hotel offers excellent transport links to numerous attractions in the city centre of Oporto and Villa Nova de Gaia. Salgueiros beach is only 1 km away, and Oporto airport is only 18 kms from the hotel. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to excellent golf courses. The hotel boasts a modern exterior architectural style coupled with streamline interior furnishings. Iconic views of the beach and coastline can be enjoyed by guests staying at this hotel. Rooms are decorated with peaceful yellow tones and warming orange shades contrasted with beautiful wooden furnishings. Guests can refuel with a buffet style breakfast served each morning, ensuring that guests have adequate energy to enjoy the peaceful surroundings of Porto.

17203.description:
Hotel Migny Opéra-Montmartre is a charming 3-star hotel ideally located in the heart of Paris, in the 9th arrondissement, between Montmartre, Pigalle and Opéra. 

The hotel offers 51 air-conditioned rooms, suitable for solo travellers, couples, families and small groups. Rooms can accommodate up to 5 guests and feature free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV, a mini refrigerator, a safety deposit box and a private bathroom with shower, hairdryer and complimentary toiletries. 

The hotel enjoys an excellent location within walking distance of Montmartre, Sacré-Cœur, the Moulin Rouge and many Parisian attractions. Pigalle and Saint-Georges metro stations are just a few minutes away, providing easy access to the Louvre, Opéra Garnier, Champs-Élysées and other major landmarks. 

Guests can enjoy a daily breakfast buffet from 7:00 am to 10:00 am, offering pastries, fresh bread, cereals, fruit, yoghurt, eggs, cheese, cold meats and hot drinks. Gluten-free bread is also available. 

The hotel provides free Wi-Fi throughout the property, 24-hour luggage storage and a reception team available to assist guests throughout their stay. 

With its central location, comfortable rooms and family-friendly accommodation options, Hotel Migny Opéra-Montmartre is an ideal choice for leisure and business travellers looking to discover Paris.

name.content: Holiday Inn Paris Opera - Grands Boulevards

17204.description: Stay at the Holiday Inn Paris Opéra Grands Boulevards, an IHG Hotel, and be in the heart of Paris. You'll be within a 15-minute walk of the Palais Garnier and Galeries Lafayette. This upscale hotel is also conveniently close to Les Halles (0. 5 mi) and Place Vendôme (0. 9 mi). Enjoy amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a communal living room. Relax in one of the 119 individually decorated guestrooms, each featuring a minibar and a flat-screen TV with satellite programming. You'll also have complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. For your convenience, phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Grab a quick bite at the snack bar/deli or enjoy room service during limited hours. A buffet breakfast is available daily (6:30 AM to 11:00 AM) for a fee. The hotel also offers complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. For events, there's 194 square feet of conference and meeting space.

17205.description: Situated between the Eiffel Tower and the Parc des Expositions exhibition centre in Paris's 15th arrondissement, this hotel offers cozy, brightly colored rooms with modern amenities. The 47 air-conditioned rooms feature satellite television, Wi-Fi, and double-glazed windows, ensuring comfort in this vibrant yet tranquil neighborhood. Steps away, you'll find the Rue du Commerce with its diverse shops, the Beaugrenelle shopping center, and the Seine River, perfect for a boat trip. The hotel's contemporary design blends seamlessly with the fashionable bars, restaurants, theaters, and clubs nearby. The attentive staff is always happy to provide recommendations. Metro and bus access are conveniently close. Please note: The elevator will be out of service from February 1, 2025, to March 31, 2025, due to refurbishment.

17206.description: Hotel located in the centre of Paris, close to the main tourist attractions such as the Opera, the department stores and the museums. This 3-star hotel has spacious rooms. Featuring an elegant décor, the Opera Lafayette hotel offers 54 rooms with direct dial telephone, satellite TV, mini bar and a private bar. Wi-Fi available in the hotel.

17207.description: This elegant hotel has an ideal location in the historic 6th district in Paris, only 3 minutes' walk from Saint-Placide Metro Station. Some of the world's most famous department stores, such as the Galleries Lafayette are within walking distance. In the vicinity, there are many tourist attractions as well as restaurants, bars and nightclubs. The nearest public transportation links are just a stone's throw away. Luxembourg Garden is a 10-minute walk from the hotel and Montparnasse Train Station is 1. 2 km away.

17209.description:
Situated in the heart of Amsterdam, this city hotel offers modern comfort and easy access to major attractions, most within walking distance. Just steps from the hotel, you'll find a variety of shops, restaurants, bars, and public transport. Amsterdam's main train station is a mere 500 meters away, while the beach is approximately 15 km. The hotel features a charming restaurant and café, and offers a range of recently renovated single and double rooms, some with picturesque canal views. Each room is comfortably furnished and equipped with a private bathroom and convenient appliances for a pleasant stay. 
We are on a makeover!! As of 1. 2. 26 we will be renovating our rooms to improve your experience. Construction noise may occur between 09:00 and 17:00 on weekdays. We apologize for any inconvenience.

17210.description: Located in the heart of Amsterdam, next to Dam Square, this hotel offers convenient access to attractions like Madame Tussauds and the Royal Palace. Guests can enjoy delicious meals at the hotel's brasserie, serving lunch and dinner daily, as well as a daily breakfast. A variety of comfortable, air-conditioned rooms are available, each equipped with a bathroom and modern amenities, ensuring a restful stay after a day exploring the city.

17225.description: Manofa offers simply furnished rooms in Amsterdam, 5 minutes’ walk from Dam Square and Amsterdam Central Station. It benefits from a 24-hour front desk and vending machines in the lobby. Free WiFi is available in the lobby. All of the rooms at Hotel Manofa have a TV and a private bathroom with a shower. Guests receive a discount when dining at the restaurant which offers Argentinian steak-house cuisine and bistro-style dishes. The restaurant includes a small street terrace. The Beurs van Berlage is situated opposite the hotel and the famous Red Light District is less than 10 minutes’ walk away. Manofa Hotel is only 450 metres from the Kalverstraat shopping area.

17228.description: Situated in Lichtenberg, this welcoming hotel offers an excellent base for exploring Berlin. Located directly opposite the iconic business center pyramid, known for its neon blue clock, the hotel provides convenient access to public transportation, allowing easy exploration of the city's attractions. Nearby bars, pubs, and nightclubs are approximately 1 km away, and a variety of shops can be found within 4 km. The hotel features a lobby bar and a breakfast room where guests can enjoy a nutritious breakfast each morning. Parking is available for an additional fee. The bright, contemporary rooms and apartments are equipped with Wi-Fi, a TV, and a private bathroom.

17230.description: Set right on the golden sands of the beach just outside of the small town of Belek, this hotel offers bright and contemporary rooms and impeccable service in a peaceful setting. The hotel offers an extensive range of premium facilities such as indoor and outdoor pools, children's pool, waterslides, meeting rooms and hotel animation club in addition to a fitness centre with sauna and Turkish baths. For dinner, guests can choose from the main, buffet-style restaurant or Olivia, Ottoman, or Roka specialty a la carte restaurants as well as four hotel bars for tasty treats between meals. This hotel provides the ideal retreat for families or couples to enjoy a fun-filled holiday in the warm sunshine.

17231.description:
Enjoy a peaceful and refreshing stay in our modern, stylishly furnished rooms…
At Çamyuva Beach Hotel, you’ll find a wide range of activities designed to make your holiday both fun and memorable. With dedicated areas and entertainment options for both adults and children, an exciting vacation awaits you. 
With our all-inclusive concept, Çamyuva Beach Hotel offers rich food and beverage selections to ensure a comfortable and carefree holiday experience. 
Featuring a Blue Flag private beach that opens to the refreshing waters of the Mediterranean and spacious pool areas, Çamyuva Beach Hotel promises an unforgettable summer getaway.

17233.description: The Delphin Palace Hotel, a five-star establishment, is nestled among palm trees in Lara, Antalya's rising tourism star. Located directly on the beach, it's a mere 10 km from the airport and 15 km from Antalya's city center. This sprawling 40, 000 m² resort boasts 485 standard rooms, 42 family rooms, 24 junior suites, and 6 handicap-accessible rooms within its eight-story building. Guests can enjoy a variety of amenities, including multiple restaurants (including à la carte options), a lobby bar with a dance floor and piano, an Avanti Cafe, shops, conference rooms, a spa, a cinema, a bowling alley, an internet cafe, a disco, and both indoor and outdoor pools.

17234.description: This stylish and elegant hotel enjoys a fabulous location right on the coast near Goynuk, a small town just outside of Kemer. Opportunities to lounge in the sun or play in the sparkling water abound as the hotel has a private beach as well as a total of four swimming pools- indoor and outdoor, children's pool and waterslides. Guests may unwind after a long journey in the fitness centre complete with Turkish baths, sauna, and massage services, sip a drink by the pool or in the English pub, and choose from a la carte and buffet-style restaurants for a satisfying meal. The hotel is also family-friendly, offering a playground and kid's club. The comfortable rooms are fully equipped and air-conditioned, some with balcony overlooking the pool. This hotel provides the perfect blend of comfort, service, relaxation and fun in the sun.

17236.description: This world-class hotel and resort is right on the beach just outside Antalya and offers the perfect holiday retreat with something for absolutely everyone. The hotel has a boundless variety of facilities and activities for all types of travel and guests of all ages, including a business centre, full spa and wellness centre, playground and kid's club, and facilities for just about any indoor, outdoor or water sport. Rooms and suites are elegant and spacious with premium bedding, parquet flooring and classic lines that speak to the hotel's seaside location. Guests can choose from five restaurants offering a delicious buffet, classic Italian dishes and authentic Turkish or Thai cuisine. There is also a traditional yoruk tent where guests can sample Turkish specialty gozleme pancakes with fillings of their choosing. This is the ideal place for family fun in the sun, a relaxing escape, or hosting a productive business event.

17247.description: Opened in 2005 and renovated in Winter 2018-2019, this hotel is situated on 72, 000 m2 of an extraordinary garden and pool landscape frontline to the beach and the warm waters of the Mediterranean Sea. The city centre of Antalya is only 17 km away, while the international airport can be reached within a short drive. The hotel excels in every aspect: it features various pools including a vast lagoon-style pool, the largest of the Lara region with more than 3, 000 m2. Children will love the children's pools with slides and animation as well as the mini club with cinema, mini disco and a host of other activities. Guests can spoil their taste buds in a buffet and various delicious à la carte restaurants, while 9 bars invite to have a drink. Excellent sports facilities including a bowling alley, an amphitheatre for 1, 000 people and a wonderful spa & wellness area complete the offer.

17249.description: This unique and impressive hotel is situated right on Lara beach, just outside Antalya, the largest resort city in Turkey. Ideal for guests of all ages, the hotel offers a special kid's club with different activities for different age groups as well as a teen lounge, so parents may relax with some time for themselves. There is no shortage of entertainment as the hotel has facilities and services to suit any taste, including a spa and fitness centre, tennis courts, a video game centre, waters sports from windsurfing to jet skiing, free diving lessons in the pool, and daily entertainment and night shows. The hotel's stylish rooms are ample and air-conditioned with a free mini-bar and balcony or terrace in each room, while every need is catered for in the hotel's many restaurants including a buffet-style restaurant with a separate diet buffet. This hotel offers the perfect retreat for those seeking a holiday full of adventure and sporting, or a fun family holiday by the sea.

name.content: Swandor Hotels and Resorts Topkapi Palace

17250.description: Located in Lara Beach, Swandor Topkapi Palace is a perfect starting point from which to explore Antalya. Offering a variety of facilities and services, the property provides all you need for a good night's sleep. Service-minded staff will welcome and guide you at Swandor Topkapi Palace. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer closet, towels, carpeting, clothes rack, slippers to ensure a restful night. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Friendly staff, great facilities, and close proximity to all that Antalya has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Swandor Topkapi Palace.

17252.description: Nestled in a historic Parisian quarter, this charming hotel is surrounded by cafés and bistros once frequented by renowned artists like Cézanne and Monet. Just steps from iconic department stores such as Galeries Lafayette and Printemps, the hotel also offers easy access to theaters, cabarets, boutiques, and lively pubs. The Pigalle metro station is a mere 100 meters away. Located between the Opéra Garnier and Montmartre, the hotel immerses guests in a warm Parisian ambiance. The beautifully designed rooms offer a tranquil retreat, blending simplicity and elegance for ultimate relaxation. Start your day with the hotel's welcoming breakfast, promising a memorable Parisian experience. Guests can enjoy amenities such as luggage storage, Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, and an airport shuttle service.

17262.description: This attractive hotel is situated close to the heart of Paris with the opera and numerous other sightseeing attractions within 500 m. Shopping and entertainment venues are only a few minutes away and public transport, such as Richelieu Drouot metro station, is only 3 minutes away. The transfer times to Orly airport takes around 45 minutes, Charles de Gaulle airport is roughly 60 minutes away. The hotel includes a total of 30 rooms spread over 7 floors. Amongst the hotel's facilities count a foyer with 24-hour reception and a lift. Furthermore a breakfast room, public Internet access (added fee) as well as a laundry service is available. The welcoming en suite rooms are equipped with a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV and a radio. They also come with Internet access, a minibar, a hire safe and individually regulated heating as standard. Guests are offered a breakfast buffet each morning.

17263.description: This cosy hotel is situated in the beautiful city of Paris, close to some of the most important tourist attractions on the area, including Place de la Concorde, the Louvre Museum, the Grevin Museum as well as the popular Saint Honoré and la Fayette streets. Featuring an excellent service based on attention to detail, this hotel offers a choice of stylishly furnished guest rooms ideal to enjoy a peaceful stay. All the units reflect perfectly the Parisian charm and have been completely equipped with air conditioning and private bathroom with all the necessary toiletries. Visitors may prefer the spacious Duplex room that can accommodate up to 4 people and gives onto the courtyard.

17275.address: Guzeloba Mah. Yasar Sobutay Bul. Lara, 30
17275.description: This attractive beach hotel lies directly beside the long sandy beach of Antalya-Lara, and 14km from the city centre. Established in 2005, the luxury hotel built on 110, 000sqm of land, comprises a total of 427 rooms located in a main building and annexe. Culinary options here include a range of bars, a patisserie, and several air-conditioned restaurants. The many entertainment amenities include a beautiful spa, a multi-purpose court, aqua pool, Thalaso Bath and cinema. There is also a kiosk, some shops, a hairdressing salon, a nightclub and free Internet access.

17285.description:
With a stay at Live Aqua Beach Resort Cancún - Adults Only - All Inclusive in Cancun (Zona Hotelera), you'll be a 4-minute walk from La Isla Shopping Mall and within a 5-minute drive of Chac Mool Beach. This luxury property is 2. 2 mi (3. 5 km) from Cancun Convention Center and 2. 9 mi (4. 7 km) from Iberostar Cancun Golf Course. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 7 outdoor swimming pools, a nightclub, and a health club. Additional amenities at this property include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Make yourself at home in one of the 371 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and Smart televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Rooms have private balconies or patios. 65-inch flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Grab a bite at SIE7E, one of the property's 8 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service.

17294.description: Located a convenient 20-minute drive from Cancun International Airport, this hotel offers easy access to public transport links right at its doorstep. Just 3 km away, guests can enjoy the beautiful beach and sparkling sea. A variety of shops, restaurants, bars, pubs, and a picturesque park are within the hotel's immediate vicinity, while a nightclub is just 10 km away. Renovated in 2004, this five-story hotel features 80 rooms, including 25 suites, all within a fully air-conditioned building. Guests are greeted by a 24-hour reception, complete with a safe, currency exchange, cloakroom, and lift. The hotel also boasts a café, hair salon, mini-market, shops, bar, nightclub, and an air-conditioned restaurant. Parking and garage facilities are available for guests arriving by car. Additional amenities include room service, laundry service, medical services, and bicycle storage. Guests can also relax in the hotel's garden or on the terrace. The comfortably furnished rooms feature a private bathroom, direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, radio, kitchenette, minibar, double or king-size bed, centrally regulated air conditioning, and an in-room safe. A refreshing freshwater swimming pool, children's pool, and sun terrace with loungers and parasols await guests in the outdoor complex.

17295.description: This hotel is centrally located at the heart of Barcelona, between Diagonal Avenue and Gran Via. It is beside the famous Plaza de Toros Monumental Bullring, the Auditorio concert hall and the National Theatre of Catalonia. Guests visiting this vibrant city will also find the Sagrada Familia Cathedral, 'Les Glòries' shopping centre and the Agbar Tower a few steps from the property. Numerous shops as well as restaurants, bars and nightclubs are in the hotel's immediate vicinity. The metro station is a 3-minute walk from the hotel, providing easy access to the city centre (just 2 stops). The beach is around 2 kilometres away. Guests will find a choice of classic rooms ranging from single to quadruple, ideal for those travelling with the whole family. They all come completely equipped and feature modern conveniences such as complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection.

17311.description: This beautiful building from 1900 is situated in the heart of elegant Paddington, a few minutes from Hyde Park near Oxford Street and Marble Arch, near Paddington and Lancaster Gate metro stations. There is a plethora of shops, restaurants and bars in the surrounding area and the nearest night club is 2 km away. Madame Tussaud's wax museum is just 1. 6km away. Both Stansted and Gatwick airports are easily accessible by train from Paddington. The closest airport is London City Airport, 15 km away. Rooms are decorated in traditional style, equipped with everything that guests will need during the stay.

17319.description: Hotel Gardena is set in the university and museum district, next to Papadopoli Gardens and a 5-minute walk from Santa LuciaTrain Station. Enjoy a delicious breakfast buffet in the courtyard. All rooms come with air conditioning, a private bathroom with bath or shower, and a TV. Some rooms offer antique furniture and unique views of Venice's rooftops or a canal. The lobby greets you with unique frescoes. You will find an interesting collection of period furniture and elegant fixtures throughout the hotel. There are plenty of places to relax including the hall, TV lounge, and coffee bar. Your day at the Gardena Hotel begins with a varied breakfast out in the courtyard, full of fresh ingredients, and available from 07:00 until 10:30. The friendly team of staff are always on hand and can share valuable local knowledge and tourist tips. Ask them about a discount at a nearby garage if you are arriving by car. Santa Croce is a great choice for travellers interested in walking, atmosphere and sightseeing.

17332.description: The hotel is conveniently situated a few meters from Jaures station, located in the north of Paris, Buttes Chaumont Hotel provides easy access to attractions such as Enclos-St-Laurent, Marais Quarter and Place du Tertre. All rooms are equipped with standard amenities. Hairdryer, telephone and cable TV are available in every room. Guests can start their day by having breakfast, served in the pleasant atmosphere, perfect to be ready to visit Paris and its many attractions. Please note : City Tax is NOT included in the price from 1st July 2015

17344.description: Enjoy amenities such as a health club and garden views at the AC Hotel Coslada Aeropuerto by Marriott. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and a TV in the common area. Dine at the on-site restaurant or grab a snack at the deli. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (7:00 AM to noon) for a fee. For business travelers, there's a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel boasts 6458 square feet (600 square meters) of event space, including a conference center and meeting rooms. A complimentary airport shuttle runs at scheduled times. The 113 guest rooms feature minibars, plasma TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include bidets and hair dryers. Safes, desks, and daily housekeeping are also provided. Located near Plenilunio Shopping Mall (4. 9 km), the hotel is approximately 9 km from Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD).

17345.description: This modern hotel is located in Hospitalet, around 4 km from Barcelona city centre. The conference and exhibition centre is in the immediate vicinity, about 1 km away and it is around 10 km to the airport. The hotel includes a café, an à la carte restaurant, conference facilities and car park facilities. Room and laundry services are available, as well as transfer to the airport on request. A king-size bed, air conditioning and central heating are also included. Guests are invited to make use of the hotel's heated indoor swimming pool, the hot tub and the steam room or to enjoy a professional massage. There is also a gym and a breakfast buffet is available every morning.

17372.description: This hotel is situated just off Place Victor Hugo, in Paris's fashionable 16th arrondissement. The Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées are a mere 300 meters away, with countless restaurants, bars, and convenient access to public transportation nearby. Orly Airport is approximately 20 km from the hotel, while Charles de Gaulle Airport is 35 km away. Hotel facilities include a café, a bar, a TV and breakfast room, room service, and dry cleaning. The warmly decorated, cozy rooms each feature a new DreaMax bed by Flex and a well-equipped en suite bathroom. Individually controlled heating and air conditioning are standard. Guests may select their breakfast from a generous buffet.

name.content: Hotel Maison Colbert Member of Meliá Collection

17374.description: This charming boutique hotel is situated on a quiet street facing Notre Dame Cathedral, on Paris's fashionable Left Bank. Orly Airport is 20 km away, and Charles de Gaulle Airport is approximately 35 km away. Housed in an elegant 19th-century building, the hotel offers air-conditioned rooms, a welcoming lobby with a currency exchange desk and 24-hour reception, a TV room, a café, a lobby bar, and a restaurant. Wi-Fi, room service, and laundry services are available for an additional fee. The French-style rooms feature en suite bathrooms and are well-equipped with central heating and individually adjustable air conditioning. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast each morning.

name.content: Hotel Paris Opera Affiliated by Meliá

17375.description: This elegant 18th-century hotel boasts a prime location in the heart of Paris, steps from shopping and entertainment. Orly Airport is approximately 20 km away, and Charles de Gaulle Airport is about 35 km from the hotel. The hotel offers 71 rooms, including nine suites. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour reception desk, safe, and currency exchange in the foyer. A breakfast room, cafe, and restaurant are available, along with a conference room and public Internet terminal. Room and laundry services are also provided. Each welcoming room features an en suite bathroom and comes fully equipped.

name.content: Hotel Villa Marquis Member Melia Collection

17376.description: Stay at the centrally located 5-star Villa Marquis Member of Meliá Collection in Paris, just a 5-minute drive from the Champs-Élysées and Arc de Triomphe. This luxurious hotel is 1. 2 miles from the Eiffel Tower and 1. 5 miles from the Palais Garnier. Enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center and a terrace with stunning views. Complimentary Wi-Fi and bicycle tour information are also available. Relax in one of the 64 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring an LCD television with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a safe, and a coffee/tea maker. Savor French and Spanish fusion cuisine at Dos Almas Restaurant, which also offers a bar/lounge and Mediterranean dishes. Room service and a buffet breakfast (for a fee) are available. Additional amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The hotel also offers a meeting room for events.

17377.description: The hotel is a boutique hotel located in the prestigious 7th district in the heart of Paris, close to Les Invalides, the Eiffel tower and the UNESCO headquarters, at the end of a street privileged by an absolute calm. The hotel is also well deserved by train & underground, and close to the international airports of Orly & Charles de Gaulle. The rooms proposed by the hotel have a contemporary and refined aesthetic, distributed in 4 categories, the rooms have all the equipment and technology required in your daily life. A deposit of 150€ may be requested upon arrival, by card or cash.

17378.description: This boutique hotel is very nicely located close to many points of touristic and historic interest of Paris. Guests will be able to find, within the area, La Madeleine Church and Place de la Concorde. Numerous shopping and entertainment venues are also within easy reach. The closest underground station is reachable on foot. Saint Lazare train station lies around 2 km from the hotel. Orly and Charles de Gaulle airport lie between 20 to 40 minutes away.

17380.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a 24-hour health club, a sauna, and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. This hotel has 6 meeting rooms available for events. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 94 guestrooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and blackout drapes/curtains. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Hackescher Markt - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Sealife Berlin - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Hackesche Höfe - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Oranienburger Strasse - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Museum Island - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- DDR Museum - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Berlin TV Tower - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Old National Gallery - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Berlin Cathedral - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Red Town Hall - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Neues Museum - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Humboldt Forum - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Unter den Linden - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Humboldt University - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Alexanderplatz - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi. The preferred airport for Classik Hotel Alexander Plaza is Berlin (BER-Brandenburg) - 27. 7 km / 17.

17382.description: InterCityHotel Berlin Ostbahnhof is conveniently located in the popular Friedrichshain area. Both business travelers and tourists can enjoy the hotel's facilities and services. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, facilities for disabled guests, luggage storage, Wi-Fi in public areas are just some of the facilities on offer. Some of the well-appointed guestrooms feature television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless (complimentary), non smoking rooms, heating, desk. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. For reliable service and professional staff, InterCityHotel Berlin Ostbahnhof caters to your needs.

17386.description: Situated beside the renowned Park Sanssouci, in the centre of Potsdam, this unique hotel offers you elegant accommodation within walking distance of all the attractions. All rooms at the MAXX by Steigenberger Sanssouci feature cable TV, radio and hairdryer. The welcoming interiors feature warm colours and natural materials. Enjoy free use of public transport services throughout Berlin and Potsdam, as a H-Rewards Member, when you stay at the MAXX by Steigenberger Sanssouci. Alternatively, you can borrow one of the hotel's bicycles to explore the surrounding area at your own pace. After an exciting day, savour a wide range of cuisine in the hotel's restaurant.

17394.description: This small and friendly hotel enjoys a fantastic location in the heart of London, perfect for sightseers looking for modest accommodation as well as easy access to city sights. Russell Square tube station is just a stone's throw away, and visitors will be able to reach the British Museum, Covent Garden, and Leicester Square all within an easy 20-minute walk. Madame Tussauds, Regents Park, and the shops of Oxford Street are also within walking distance. London City Airport is located 12. 7 km away. The hotel features a 24-hour reception and a bar. Each room comes with a television and tea and coffee making facilities. Refrigerators, irons and hairdryers are available upon request. There is one bathroom for every four rooms. This hotel's superb location makes it a great choice for a sightseeing weekend in London.

17396.description: Located beside a lake opposite Brentford Street. This hotel is within easy reach of Heathrow Airport.

17397.description: Located in the heart of London, the Travelodge London Kings Cross Royal Scot Hotel is within a 15-minute walk of Russell Square and University College London. This hotel is conveniently located near several key attractions: 1. 3 miles from the British Museum, 1. 4 miles from St. Paul's Cathedral, and 0. 7 miles from the British Library. The nearest airport is London City Airport (9 miles).

17398.description: Nestled near Venice's enchanting city center, this historic hotel dates back to the 11th century. A short 5-minute stroll leads to the iconic St. Mark's Square, with St. Mark's Cathedral and the Doge's Palace also within easy reach. The Rialto Bridge, a symbol of this captivating city, is just moments away. The hotel's understated yet elegant exterior hints at the rich Venetian atmosphere within. Each room is exquisitely appointed with luxurious fabrics and intricate patterns, bathed in captivating golds and rich chocolate tones that exude an aura of Venetian nobility. Guests are sure to feel relaxed and rejuvenated during their stay.

17400.description: This beautiful, historic canal-side hotel is centrally located near the Royal Palace. The city center and various prominent tourist attractions are within easy walking distance. Shops and nightclubs are within 100 meters of the hotel, while restaurants, bars, pubs, and public transportation are even closer. This three-story hotel comprises 41 rooms, including six single rooms and 27 double and triple rooms. Guests enjoy a 24-hour reception desk, a cloakroom, and a public internet terminal. Please note, as the hotel occupies a historic building, the stairways are fairly steep and narrow. The comfortably furnished en suite rooms feature satellite/cable TV, internet access, a safe, and central heating.

17401.description: Enjoy a stay at De Bedstee Boutique Capsules, a unique capsule hotel in the heart of Amsterdam. Located within a 10-minute walk of the Van Gogh Museum and Rijksmuseum, and just 0. 5 km from Vondelpark, our hotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a bar/lounge. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

17402.description: Located in a historic 17th-century building between Dam Square and Munt Tower, this hotel offers convenient access to Amsterdam's vibrant shopping and nightlife. The RAI Convention Center, Ziggo Dome, and Arena are easily reachable by tram or metro, and Schiphol Airport is approximately 15 km away. Renovated in 2023, this charming hotel features 22 comfortable rooms, each equipped with an en suite bathroom, hairdryer, satellite/cable TV, central heating, a safe, and a Nespresso machine with hot water function. Guests can also enjoy a dedicated lounge area and a cafe/bar, as well as free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Please note that this monumental building does not have an elevator and access to rooms is via a narrow staircase.

17403.description: Discover Amsterdam from our perfectly situated hotel in the city center on Rembrandt Square. Enjoy easy access to Amsterdam's best bars, restaurants, clubs, museums, galleries, theaters, cinemas, and shopping streets, all right on our doorstep. Schiphol Airport is less than 10 kilometers away. Our clean and friendly hotel offers a range of facilities to ensure a comfortable stay. Our dedicated staff is committed to making your Amsterdam experience truly memorable. Rooms are designed for optimal rest and comfort, perfect for families. Each unit features classic and practical furnishings, allowing you to relax and recharge before exploring the city.

17404.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as bicycle rentals, complimentary wireless internet access, and tour/ticket assistance. Buffet breakfast is served weekdays from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fee applies). Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk.
