Make yourself at home in one of the 107 air-conditioned rooms featuring espresso makers and flat-screen televisions with cable programming. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. The Alfred Hotel is centrally located in Amsterdam, within a 15-minute walk of the Moco Museum and Van Gogh Museum. This hotel is 1. 3 miles from Leidseplein and 1. 4 miles from the Rijksmuseum.

17405.description: The elegant Hotel Brunelleschi is ideally situated in the heart of Milan, the capital of Lombardy. It features a range of excellent services and amenities, including a restaurant with classic Italian cuisine. The most elegant boutiques and designer stores of the city can be found in the surrounding area; the world-famous Dome of Milan, the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele and La Scala opera house can be reached within a 5-minute walk. The University of Milan is only 200 m away. The hotel is perfect to explore this marvellous city.

17406.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Auriga Hotel, conveniently located in Milan's Central Station area, just steps from the Pirelli Tower and a short drive from the Planetario di Milano. This hotel offers 52 guestrooms equipped with minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and bidets. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (available for a fee), unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge, and take advantage of amenities such as concierge services, a banquet hall, and room service (limited hours). Additional services include express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry.

17407.description: The centrally located Hotel Canada Urban Chic offers convenient access to Milan's main attractions. Situated near the Crocetta and Missori metro stations, it's a short trip from Centrale Railway Station and Linate Airport. The hotel features 37 comfortable rooms, meeting and banquet facilities, and a cozy American bar. Guests can also enjoy room service, parking, and an on-site garage. Each room includes an ensuite bathroom, satellite TV, radio, a double bed, a minibar, and air conditioning. A breakfast buffet is served daily from 7:00 to 10:30 AM.

17408.description: CIN: IT015146A12EY3KZK6 Just 200 m from Lodi Metro Stop, Grand Visconti Palace offers luxury accommodation with free WiFi, just 4 metro stops from Milan Cathedral. It features a refined wellness area with swimming pool, and a gourmet restaurant located on the 5th floor, overlooking the city's rooftops. Each spacious room at the 4-star Visconti Palace boasts an elegant décor, including beautiful rugs and drapes. They all have soundproofed walls, a flat-screen TV, and a minibar. The Al V Piano restaurant specialises in creative dishes of international and Mediterranean cuisine, served with a variety of Italian and foreign wines. Breakfast is a varied buffet. The wellness area includes a fitness area, an indoor pool, a sauna, a Turkish bath and a hot tub.

17409.description: The Hotel offers a wide range of services based on the bed & breakfast concept: room service, free newspapers, a bar, laundry, underground parking for more than 100 cars and a spacious Breakfast Room. For Business guests, there are modular meeting rooms seating up to 120. Hotel La Spezia offers 76 well-lit rooms with minimalist furnishings, warm wooden floors and large pictures of the old Milan. They are fully soundproofed with climatisation, minibars, satellite TV, safety deposit boxes and free broadband internet connection.

17411.description: Situated less than 1 kilometre from both Kings Cross Thames Link and St Pancras International, this smart urban hotel is ideal for visitors seeking accommodation that is close to major transport links in London. A short walk will take travellers to the world famous British Library, with its immense collection of over 13 million books. Those interested in art and culture, can take a trip to the British Museum and discover a global collection of art and antiquities that are sure to inspire them. With convenient amenities and services like the early check-in/late check-out option, the complimentary Wi-Fi Internet access and the cash machine on the premises, this hotel will satisfy the requirements of even the most demanding travellers.

17414.description: This hotel boasts a delightful setting in London, lying close to the River Thames. The hotel enjoys close proximity to Clapham train station, which is just 600 metres away. Guests can enjoy a range of exciting activities nearby. Sitting on the pleasant York Road, a host of attractions are located in close proximity to this charming hotel. The hotel is located close to Hurlingham Park, lying just 16 km away from London City Airport. This wonderful hotel tempts visitors into the comfort and style of the lobby. The guest rooms are superbly designed, offering a serene setting in which to unwind. This hotel prides itself on its homely ambiance, exemplary service, and dedication to customer satisfaction.

17415.address: Belgrave Road, Lillington and Longmoore Gardens, 53-57
17415.description: This popular hotel, built-in 1800 and housed in a traditional Victorian building, is located in the centre of the city, very close to Piccadilly Circus, the London Eye, Buckingham Palace and the famous Big Ben and other touristic sites of cultural and historic interest. Guests will also be able to find, countless shopping and entertainment sites reachable on foot. The public transport stops are also within walking distance. Victoria Station is approximately 5 minutes away and Westminster Abbey, the Houses of Parliament, as well as the Tate Gallery, are only a few minutes away. The modern rooms are beautifully decorated and equipped with wooden elements and parquet flooring. Each has a private bathroom with toiletries.

17419.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 62 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Conveniences include safes and desks, and you can also request cribs/infant beds (surcharge). Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Corso Buenos Aires - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Piazza della Repubblica - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Indro Montanelli Public Gardens - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Porta Venezia - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Piazzale Loreto - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Piazza Gae Aulenti - 1. 4 km / 0. 8 mi- Via Montenapoleone Fashion District - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Via della Spiga - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Corso Como - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- 10 Corso Como - 1. 7 km / 1 mi- Palazzo Serbelloni - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Milan Fashion District - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Armani Megastore - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Villa Necchi Campiglio - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- San Babila - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi. The nearest airports are: Linate Airport (LIN) - 7. 5 km / 4. 6 mi Milan Malpensa Airport (MXP) - 53. 5 km / 33. 2 mi Bergamo Orio al Serio Airport (BGY) - 50. 6 km / 31. 4 mi The preferred airport for Hotel Mennini is Milan Malpensa Airport (MXP).

17426.description: The stylish and fully renovated ibis budget Grigny Centre, an economy hotel, is located right by the Grigny-Centre RER D train station, providing easy access to Paris Gare de Lyon and Gare du Nord. Ideal for business and leisure trips, the hotel is easily accessible from the A6 and by bus from Paris Orly International Airport (5 mi/8 km), Roissy CDG Airport, and the Stade de France. The hotel offers spacious, renovated rooms, free Wi-Fi, and free private parking. ibis budget Grigny Centre provides comfort and modern design. Its convenient location near the A6 highway (547 yards/500 m) and Orly International Airport (20 minutes) makes it an ideal stopover. Disneyland Paris is 40 minutes away, the Marques Avenue shopping center is 10 minutes away, and Château de Fontainebleau and its park are just 20 minutes from the hotel.

17430.description: Located in the suburbs of Les Mureaux, Welcomotel Les Mureaux offers convenient access to local attractions such as Bowl Center Orgeval and Notre Dame de Mantes, both within a 15-minute drive. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, and daily housekeeping. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast for a fee. Other amenities include a 24-hour front desk, an elevator, free self-parking, and a vending machine. Each of the 76 guestrooms features an LCD television with digital programming and blackout drapes/curtains for a comfortable stay. Nearby attractions include Villa Savoye (16 km) and Park and Castle of Thoiry (18. 8 km). The nearest major airport is Paris Orly Airport (ORY), 59. 2 km away.

17435.description: This charming and cosy hotel is perfectly located in the city centre of Paris at the St. Georges district, being surrounded by many dining, entertainment and shopping options nearby. This property is just a few steps away from the popular Moulin Rouge and the Sacré-Coeur with impressively beautiful views of the city. Those who like shopping will be delighted to find the famous Galeries Lafayette just a stroll away. Moreover, leisure travellers might discover other parts of the city very easily thanks to the metro stations that can be found close to the establishment. All the hotel’s guest rooms are tastefully appointed and offer all the necessary amenities for a comfortable stay. At their arrival, visitors will be welcomed at the establishment’s lobby where the friendly staff will help them with any doubt they have about places to go or booking tickets.

17436.description: This charming hotel is the ideal setting for business and leisure travellers visiting Paris. The hotel is located in the exclusive Arc de Triomphe district in the city, lying within easy access of its mesmerising attractions. Guests will find themselves just a short distance from the metro station, which offers ease of access to other areas of the city. The hotel is situated just a short distance from La Defense, the Levallois Business District, the Louvre, the Champs Elysees and the Eiffel Tower. This charming hotel exudes elegance and poise. The guest rooms are classically designed, exuding sophistication and charm. Guests will be pleased by the exemplary facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

17437.description: This 3-star hotel, established in 1910, is located in Paris's city center, a short drive from the Champs-Élysées. The nearest station is Pereire. The hotel features a restaurant, and each of its 40 rooms is equipped with a minibar, hairdryer, safe, and air conditioning. A €200 deposit is required upon arrival via credit card. Reservations of four or more rooms are subject to special conditions.

17439.description: The Hôtel des Deux Avenues is nestled in the elegant 17th arrondissement of Paris, on a lively street a 10-minute walk from the Place de l'Étoile, the Arc de Triomphe, and the Champs-Élysées. Its prime location is ideal for visiting the Eiffel Tower and other tourist attractions, as well as business centers like the Palais des Congrès Porte Maillot and the La Défense district.

name.content: Golden Tulip Villepinte Roissy Parc Expositions

17440.description: This charming design hotel is centrally located, only around 5 minutes drive from Charles de Gaulle airport. Parc Asterix and Disneyland Paris are easily reached, just a 30-minute drive away. The centre of Paris and the Gare du Nord takes around 20 minutes to reach, while the Chatelet les Halles is also within close reach of the hotel, around 50 minutes away with the RER. Built in 2001, this hotel comprises a 6-storey building with a total of 78 rooms. Facilities on offer include a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a safe and a lift. There is also an air-conditioned restaurant available to guests, Brasserie Parisienne. Business guests are offered conference rooms, free public Internet terminal (WiFi) in the entrance area, by the bar and in the restaurant. A laundry and a car park complete the offerings. The modern rooms come with an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a radio, Internet access, air conditioning and central heating as standard. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample American breakfast buffet and midday meals also from an ample buffet; lunch and dinner may also be taken à la carte or chosen from a menu. From Charles de Gaulle airport take the A1 towards Paris for around 5 minutes or take the RER train line B3. From Le Bourget airport guests should take the A1 towards Lille for roughly 10 minutes. From Orly airport take the RER-ORLYVAL train. Guests arriving by car should take the ring motorway for around 15 minutes (A1 exit La Chapelle / A3 exit Porte de Bagnolet). From the A104 take the exit Zi Paris Nord II and then drive towards Gare SNCF RER. With the RER train take line B3 to Parc des Expositions station and walk another 200 m to the hotel.

17441.description: Located in the heart of Paris, the 4-star Hôtel le Lavoisier is within a 15-minute walk of the Palais Garnier and the Champs-Élysées. This elegant hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. Each of the 30 air-conditioned guest rooms features complimentary Wi-Fi and satellite programming. Bathrooms include bathtubs and hair dryers. Enjoy room service, a bar/lounge, and full breakfasts (available for a fee from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM). Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

name.content: Cyan Hotel Roissy Villepinte Parc Des Expositions

17442.description: This charming hotel is situated close to Paris' Charles de Gaulle/Roissy airport, around 10 km away from the city centre of Villepinte. The Parc des Exposition is only around 5 minutes away on foot, the nearest train station is around 200 m from the hotel, Parc Asterix and Disneyland Paris are a 30-minute drive away. Chatelet les Halles takes around 50 minutes to get to with the RER and Paris' Gare du Nord lies 20 minutes away. The hotel was built in 2001 and consists of 154 rooms spread over 5 floors. Amongst the hotel's facilities count a foyer with 24-hour reception desk, a lift and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with highchairs for infants. There is a public Internet terminal and a car park available for use. The appealing rooms all come with en suite bathroom facilities, air conditioning and satellite TV with an alarm clock. A fine buffet is on offer at breakfast time and at midday. Lunch and dinner may be chosen à la carte or from the set menu. From Charles de Gaulle airport take the A1 towards Paris for around 5 minutes or take Line B3 on the RER. From Le Bourget airport take the A1 towards Lille for roughly 10 minutes. From Orly airport take the RER-VAL train. Guests arriving by car should take the ring motorway for around 15 minutes (A1 exit La Chapelle/ A3 exit Porte de Bagnolet. From the A104 take the exit Zi Paris Nord II and then drive towards Gare SNCF RER. With the RER train take line B3 to Parc des Expositions station and walk for a further 200 m to the hotel.

17444.description: This hotel is located in the city centre of Paris. Guests will find themselves just a short driving distance away from the Opera Garnier. It lies within easy access of the many attractions that the city has to offer. The nearby Pigalle Station offers ease of access to other areas of the city to be explored. This hotel enjoys a graceful design. The guest rooms are classically styled, featuring modern amenities for added convenience. The hotel features an outdoor pool, where guests can enjoy a leisurely swim. This hotel is sure to appeal to business and leisure travellers alike. The hotel offers first-class facilities and services to deliver the utmost in comfort and enjoyment.

17478.description: This modern hotel, refurbished in 2003, is located in the heart of Zurich's city center, directly on the famous Bahnhofstrasse. It's within walking distance of the shopping, business, and banking districts, and numerous bars and restaurants are nearby along Lake Zurich. All 84 guest rooms are spacious with an urban design and equipped with convenient amenities to meet the needs of both business and leisure travelers. Zurich Airport is 9 km from the hotel.

17479.description: The Sorell Hotel Rütli, a charming 3-star superior hotel, welcomes both business and leisure travelers in the heart of Zurich. Ideally situated near the entrance to the Old Town and the main train station, it offers easy access to a variety of attractions. Explore nearby shops, restaurants, bars, museums, cinemas, theaters, and the scenic lakeside boardwalk, all within walking distance. Refurbished in 2014, the ten superior rooms offer a unique and comfortable stay. Experience our warm hospitality and let us surprise and delight you during your visit.

17480.description: Opened in 2017, the four-star Z'ri by Fassbind boasts 167 modern rooms designed by renowned architects Gigon & Guyer. Each room features air conditioning, a minibar, safe, coffee and tea making facilities, an iron and ironing board, a flat-screen TV, a hairdryer, and complimentary toiletries. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, and a business corner with a printer is located in the lobby. Large, soundproofed windows ensure a quiet night's sleep while allowing ample natural light. Brand new beds provide exceptional comfort, and a spacious desk offers a productive workspace. Guests enjoy complimentary access to the fitness room and sauna during opening hours. Underground parking is available for a fee. Situated in trendy Zurich West, just 50 meters from Escher Wyss Platz, the hotel provides easy access to all parts of the city. The airport is a quick 10-minute train ride from Bahnhof Hardbrücke, which is also just one stop from Zurich Hauptbahnhof. The Zurich City motorway is only 2 km away, offering convenient access to destinations further afield. The hotel's prime location makes it ideal for exploring Zurich's vibrant nightlife. The reception is available 24 hours a day.

17482.description: Located on the Via Scarlatti at the heart of Milan, this hotel provides excellent transport connections – including a link to the airport – within a 200-metre distance from its front door. The helpful staff at the 24-hour reception desk will provide assistance with ticket purchase, and tours of local points of interest, like the Convent of Santa Maria delle Grazie, which houses Leonardo da Vinci's famous mural 'The Last Supper', and is open to organized groups only. After a day of sightseeing, guests will appreciate the elegant comfort of the rooms and suites, fitted with everything one might need to truly relax – from individually adjustable air-conditioning and heating, to free Internet access and lounges, when patrons can unwind with a refreshing drink from the minibar.

17485.description: Completely renovated in 2024, the Hôtel Dalila, just a stone's throw from the Butte Montmartre and Pigalle, welcomes you to a lively, generous and eclectic setting. Our rooms are all equipped with Wi-Fi, TV and air conditioning. You can enjoy a generous breakfast and spend the rest of the day in our coworking space

17486.description: Located at 22 rue Tronchet in the 8th arrondissement of Paris, the Hotel Chavanel is a 4-star hotel with discreet luxury but definite charm. This boutique hotel has been designed like a large Parisian house with its lounge for meeting and its rooms for more intimacy. The 27 rooms & suites of the hotel are spacious, bright and comfortable. They are a real cocoon in the heart of Paris.

17487.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Paris close to the Gare du Nord and Gare Saint Lazare as well as to the Opéra Garnier. The hotel is just a few minutes from the major department stores on Boulevard Haussmann. The typical Parisian market on Rue des Martyrs, the Sacré Coeur and Montmartre, the Louvre and the city's main boulevards are within walking distance. The hotel is only 1 km from various shops, around 20 km from Orly airport, and 30 km from Charles de Gaulle international airport.

17488.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Make yourself at home in one of the 25 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring espresso makers and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, as well as phones with free international calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore - 0. 4 km / 0.

17489.description: This modern hotel in Paris is the perfect choice for those wishing to discover all this vibrant city has to offer. Orly International Airport is some 20 kilometres away while Charles de Gaulle Airport is just a 30-minute drive away. Guests will find different metro stops nearby, providing easy access to all areas of the city. The spacious guest rooms feature a large choice of modern services including satellite TV and complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection for guests' convenience. They all have been tastefully decorated in a contemporaneous style, light and coloured in a perfect combination. Featuring a prime situation and a service based on attention to detail, this enchanting establishment is ideal to enjoy an unforgettable stay in the city of love.

17523.description: Strategically located in the West-Ring between Amsterdam's bustling city center, the Zuidas business district, and Schiphol Airport, the Artemis Hotel offers more than just 4-star deluxe accommodations. Its contemporary design showcases Dutch artistry throughout, from the lobby to the guest rooms, featuring works by designers like Marcel Wanders, Piet Hein Eek, and Richard Hutten. The hotel's central hub is the Restaurant-Bar 'De Stijl' with its inviting waterside terrace, perfect for enjoying drinks, lunch, or dinner, especially during the summer months. All 256 guest rooms are cozy and comfortable, equipped with modern amenities including air conditioning, a minibar, tea and coffee facilities, a safe, free Wi-Fi, cable TV, a telephone, a hairdryer, and a trouser press. (Guests booking a double room should note that it consists of twin beds).

17526.description: This cozy hotel, located in Amsterdam, offers easy access to the city's attractions, just 2. 2 kilometers from the center. Schiphol Airport is less than 14 kilometers away. Recently renovated, the hotel provides 24-hour reception and on-site parking. Each room features internet access, a private bathroom with modern amenities, comfortable furnishings, and views of either the interior or the river. Please note, pets are not allowed.

17527.description: This charming hotel is nestled in a pleasant residential area of Amsterdam, within easy reach of the city center's abundant shops, restaurants, entertainment venues, and tourist attractions via the nearby tram. Schiphol Airport is less than 10 km away. The hotel features a lobby with a reception desk and lift, a restaurant, pub, breakfast room, garden, conference room, and internet access. Each cozy room is beautifully decorated and includes a private bathroom with modern furnishings and appliances. One dog or cat under 20 kg is permitted per room (upon request) for a nightly fee and deposit.

17528.description:
This hotel is located in the West part of the city and offers excellent connections to the tram network. The city centre with its numerous shopping and entertainment venues is about half an hour away by making use of the trams that depart from a stop approximately 8 minutes' walk from the hotel. Countless shops, a theatre and restaurants are in the hotel's immediate surrounds. The hotel comprises a total of 180 spacious rooms spread over 6 floors. Facilities on offer include a modern foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, bike rental and nicely decorated lobby. Guests may take advantage of the free wifi make use of the car parking facility (separated charge, owned by the municipality). 

City Tax of 12. 5% per pax/night must be paid on arrival at the hotel due to mandatory request from the municipality of Amsterdam.

17529.description: This hotel is located at the heart of Amsterdam, directly beside the oldest canal in the city. Various restaurants, bars and nightclubs as well as convenient links to the public transport network may all be found within just a few paces of the hotel. Various museums are within walking distance. This hotel was built in 1895 and is comprised of 14 rooms spread over 3 floors of which 10 are double rooms. The hotel's facilities include a lobby with a 24-hour reception, a safe and a currency exchange desk. Further facilities include a buffet restaurant (breakfast only) and a public Internet terminal. Medical assistance is also available within the hotel. The comfortably furnished rooms come with a tiled en suite bathroom with hairdryer and come equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, Internet access, central heating and a safe. A breakfast buffet is available every morning.

17531.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace at Bastion Hotel Amsterdam Noord, located in Amsterdam North. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi and the convenience of a vending machine. The hotel's restaurant offers satisfying meals, and you can unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee). The hotel also features a computer station and offers express check-in/check-out. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The 68 air-conditioned rooms provide a comfortable stay with amenities including refrigerators, LCD TVs, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, in-room safes, and desks. The hotel is conveniently located within a 10-minute drive of Dam Square and Anne Frank House, and is also close to Museum Amsterdam Noord and WONDR Experience.

17533.description: This boutique hotel is housed in a row of 17th century buildings on the Singel, Amsterdam's oldest major canal and part of the ring of canals added to the official UNESCO World Heritage list in 2010. Dam square, the central railway station, the main shopping area, museums, theatres and night life are all within walking distance, Schiphol Airport is just 11 kilometres away. The hotel lounge offers canal views and a coffee pub, to enjoy a cold or a hot drink. There is internet access and a small library for book lovers. The restaurant presents sophisticated and modern cuisine and is a delicious culinary experience. The rich, colourful interior includes elegant romantic style decoration, luxurious fabrics, extravagant wallpapers, flowers, and plants.

17535.description: Nestled just off the vibrant Van Baerlestraat, this hotel offers convenient access to Amsterdam's city center. Explore the numerous shops and entertainment venues, or visit the nearby concert hall and Museum Square, home to the Van Gogh Museum and other attractions, all within walking distance. Schiphol Airport is less than 10 kilometers away. The hotel boasts a magnificent restaurant with a separate non-smoking section and a breakfast buffet. The elegantly furnished en suite rooms feature amenities such as internet access and comfortable furnishings, with various room types available to suit diverse travel needs.

name.content: Max Brown Htl Museum Sq, part of Sircle Collection

17536.description: Max Brown Museum Square, part of Sircle Collection is situated in four typical Amsterdam Townhouses in the Jan Luykenstraat. This largely residential neighborhood distinguishes itself with beautiful tree-lined streets and gorgeous 19th-century architecture. There is no place in Amsterdam where you will find an area with so much style and allure. Not only is The Museum Quarter (the neighborhood around Museum Square) famous for its impressive collection of museums & galleries, but it's also a bursting forth with shops, cafes, bars & restaurants everywhere.

17537.description: Lively, modern, colourful and still traditional and rich in history: Berlin is called the city of unlimited possibilities with good reason! harry‘s home Berlin-Moabit is located in the heart of Berlin‘s trendy Mitte district. Due to its location in the centre and the direct connection to public transport, it is the ideal starting point for extensive exploration tours of the diverse state capital. Numerous green spaces, the green overgrown banks of the Spree and a private park directly behind the hotel provide oases of calm in the city fever. Centrally located, the hotel features a ideal public transport connections. Plenty of shopping venues as well as bars and pubs are only steps away. The city centre is just 4 km away and the tourist centre is in the neighbourhood. The underground Line 9 stops directly next to the hotel and it is possible to reach Zoo train station in only 2 stations as well as the Kurfürstendamm. Numerous efficient bus lines are also easily reached offering access to the other areas of Berlin. Turmstrasse bus stop is only 20 metres from the hotel.

name.content: iStay by NH Berlin City Ost Hotel

17538.description: Formerly known as NH Berlin Frankfurter Allee, the NH Berlin City Ost hotel is set in the Lichtenberg area of Berlin. All of the 99 contemporary guest rooms come with modern comforts such as free Wi-Fi, flat screen TVs, work desks, and mini bars as standard. Additional amenities including living areas, rain-effect showers, and Nespresso machines are provided in the superior room types. Some rooms offer balconies. Every morning a delicious breakfast buffet is served in the Restaurant Rossini Quattro next door. The newly renovated Rossini Quattro restaurant welcomes you in a cozy and friendly atmosphere, serving high-quality Italian cuisine. For light, quick refreshments, the NH Berlin City Ost has an Open Bar available 24 hours a day, every day. Our two meeting rooms which are flooded with natural light can accommodate up to 50 guests.

17539.description: Located in a quiet side street near to Tiergarten, just a 10-minute bus ride from Berlin's famous sightseeing attractions, such as Potsdamer Platz, the Brandenburg Gate, Museumsinsel and the Reichstag, this hotel is a fantastic choice for work and leisure visitors to the city alike. Small, but extremely well-thought and comfortable, the establishment features a car park, a conference room and complimentary Wi-Fi Internet access. Before embarking on their tasks for the day, guests can try the delicious breakfast buffet and enjoy a cup of coffee or tea in the garden or on the sunny terrace of the hotel.

17540.description: The Grand Hostel Berlin Urban is the ideal place to experience the trendy Kreuzkölln neighborhood like a local. Located directly at Hermannplatz, a vibrant hub with a diverse culinary scene, you'll discover international restaurants around every corner. The hostel sits at a major public transportation hub, with U7 and U8 underground lines and M41 and M29 buses connecting you to all major city attractions. Airports are a 35-minute ride away, while the central train and bus stations are reachable within 20 and 30 minutes, respectively. Explore iconic landmarks like Alexanderplatz, Brandenburg Gate, and Museums Island, all easily accessible by public transport. Kreuzberg and Neukölln's vibrant nightlife, including bars, coffee shops, and clubs, is within walking distance. Socialize with fellow travelers on our outdoor terrace and enjoy our organized activities. All rooms feature free Wi-Fi and private bathrooms, while single and double rooms also include televisions. Dormitory beds are equipped with personal electrical sockets, reading lights, and security lockers. Experience our 'Grand-Service': a personalized welcome introduction to the city with a map and insider tips, plus 24/7 concierge service to ensure a memorable stay.

17541.description: This elegant hotel in classic English style is located in a beautiful building in the historical centre of Berlin, on the renowned Friedrichstraße and just 2 minutes from Checkpoint Charlie. Its features include a conference area, gym and sauna, a restaurant and a bar. Famous attractions such as Unter den Linden boulevard, Brandenburg Gate, the Reichstag building or Potsdamer Platz square are within walking distance.

17543.description: Practice your swing on the golf course and enjoy other recreational amenities, such as an outdoor tennis court and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, shopping on site, and a television in a common area. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Grab a bite at Restaurant Havelländer, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Rathenow? This hotel has 3165 square feet (294 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 5 meeting rooms. Guests may use a train station pick-up service for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 72 guestrooms featuring minibars. Rooms have private balconies or patios. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature bidets and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Westhavelland Nature Park - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Semlin Church - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Luther Square - 8. 4 km / 5. 2 mi- St. Marien Andreas Church - 9. 2 km / 5. 7 mi- Bismark Tower - 10. 7 km / 6. 6 mi- Naturbadestrand - 13. 7 km / 8. 5 mi- Badestelle Steckelsdorf - 14. 2 km / 8. 8 mi- Badestelle Böhne - 17. 4 km / 10. 8 mi- Badestelle Bützer - 20. 4 km / 12. 7 mi- Strand am Flachsberg - 30. 5 km / 18. 9 mi- Ribbeck Park - 30. 6 km / 19 mi- Ribbeck Church - 30. 9 km / 19. 2 mi- Strand am Flachsberg - 31. 1 km / 19. 3 mi- Badestelle Massowburg - 34. 8 km / 21. 6 mi- Badestelle Grillendamm - 36. 3 km / 22. 6 mi. The preferred airport for GolfResort Semlin is Berlin (BER-Brandenburg) - 145. 9 km / 90.

17544.description: Ideally located for exploring Potsdam's historical sites, the Brandenburg region, and Berlin, this hotel is perfect for events of all sizes. Three flexible function rooms and an in-house restaurant create an attractive setting for private parties, conferences, and business meetings. Potsdam's city center, with its charming Dutch Quarter, Russian Colony, and picturesque alleys, is easily accessible by public transport. Berlin is also within easy reach by car or public transport.

17550.description: This inspiring and stylish boutique hotel boasts an ideal position in the City of Love, right in a lively district, close to Gares de l’Est and du Nord and at a short distance from numerous sightseeing points of interest that all guests should visit, such as the Sacré Coeur, the Place de la République and the Canal Saint-Martin. For this reason, everyone staying at this property might take advantage of its good position and modern comforts offered. Guest rooms and suites boast a home away from home atmosphere and offer the best spaces in which travellers can rest and relax after a busy day of sightseeing or doing business. In addition, visitors can taste a great variety of locally produced beers at the on-site bar.

17552.description: Situated near Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est, the elegant Mademoiselle Hotel offers a Parisian oasis with its tranquil courtyard, well-appointed rooms, and inviting wellness area. This recently renovated boutique hotel in the 10th arrondissement boasts a prime location, also convenient to Canal Saint-Martin, the Opera, Sacré-Coeur Basilica, and the renowned Galeries Lafayette department store. Each room features premium bedding, bathrobes and slippers, an iPod docking station, a coffee maker, bottled water, complimentary Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and a flat-screen TV with a diverse selection of French and international channels. The wellness area includes a steam room, sauna, ice fountain, relaxation area, Technogym-equipped fitness center, and a massage room. Enjoy complimentary access to the spa from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM. After 1:00 PM, spa access is €20 per hour per person. Relax in the Mademoiselle lounge, complete with a large-screen TV and a selection of hot beverages available at any time. A delicious breakfast is served each morning in the charming courtyard.

17553.description: Enjoy modern comforts at the Color Design Hotel in Paris's vibrant Bercy district, just a 15-minute walk from the Opera Bastille and Place de la Bastille. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) and unwind with a drink at our bar/lounge. We offer complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a TV in the common area. Our 48 guestrooms feature LCD TVs, MP3 docking stations, and private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include in-room safes, desks, and phones. The Canal Saint-Martin is a short stroll away, and Notre Dame is within easy reach. For your convenience, we also offer dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk.

17556.description: Just 3 minutes from La Motte Picquet station on Metro lines 8 and 10 and Cambronne station on line 6, the hotel is ideal for combining work and pleasure, whether traveling alone or as a family. The hotel is close to Montparnasse, the Porte de Versailles exhibition center, the Eiffel Tower and 15 min by metro from department stores, the Opera, Saint-Germain-des-Prés and Saint Michel. A paying public car park is nearby.

17557.description: Located a few meters from the Moulin Rouge and a 15-minute walk from the Sacré-Coeur Basilica, the 29 Lepic Hotel welcomes you to the heart of historic Montmartre, a vibrant artistic and tourist district in Paris. Family-owned since 1972, the hotel is situated on Rue Lepic, near the Café des Deux Moulins (featured in the film Amélie) and the iconic Moulin Rouge. Our hotel is an ideal starting point for discovering Montmartre's charm, including the legendary Place du Tertre and Place des Abbesses, home to the 'I Love You' wall.

17559.description: This delightful hotel is situated on the left bank of the Seine, nestled between the Latin Quarter, Saint-Germain-des-Prés, and Montparnasse. Nearby, you'll find a variety of bars and restaurants, as well as convenient access to public transportation. Many of Paris's top attractions, including the Louvre and Notre Dame, are within a kilometer of the hotel. Montparnasse railway station is a short 5-minute walk away, while Orly and Charles de Gaulle airports are 15 km and 30 km away, respectively. Built in 1856, this hotel offers 41 rooms across six floors. Facilities include a 24-hour reception desk, an elevator, and a breakfast room, with the option of in-room breakfast and 24-hour room service. Wi-Fi and laundry services are also available (fees may apply). Guests arriving by car can use the neighboring car park (charges apply). The comfortable rooms feature en suite bathrooms, hairdryers, direct-dial telephones, satellite/cable TV, radios, internet access, minibars, double beds, individually controlled heating, safes, and sitting areas. Guests can also enjoy the hotel's squash facilities. Breakfast is available each morning. To reach the hotel from CDG Airport, take the RER B to Denfert-Rochereau and transfer to Line 4 to Montparnasse-Bienvenue. From Orly Airport, take the Orlyval to Antony, then transfer to Line 4 from Denfert-Rochereau to Montparnasse-Bienvenue. For those driving, exit Porte d'Orléans towards Montparnasse/St-Germain-des-Prés and take Rue de Rennes.

name.content: Apolonia Paris Mouffetard Sure Hotel Collection BW

17560.description: Hotel Apolonia Paris Mouffetard, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western, is a 3 Star rated hotel that benefits from a particular design and architecture designed around a courtyard, which offers a real bubble of relaxation and calm. The hotel's 42 rooms are subtly decorated in light tones and arranged according to their size: Standard, Comfort or Junior Suite. Because your well-being is crucial, a courtesy tray awaits you upon your arrival. The rooms have a walk-in shower and the main important amenities: mini-bar, Nespresso® and hairdryer. The WiFi connection is available throughout the establishment and in guest rooms as well. Ideal for stays with friends or for couples, rooms accommodate up to two people.

17561.description: Ideally located close to both the Gare du Nord and the Gare de l'Est, this contemporary style hotel is situated in the heart of the multicultural and lively 10th district of Paris. The waxwork museum, Musée Grévin is a 15-minute walk from the hotel. Château d'Eau Metro Station is 130 metres away, providing direct access to the historic Saint-Germain-des-Près district, the world famous Sentier confectionary district, the Halles commercial centre, Notre-Dame de Paris cathedral, the markets of Clingnancourt, and the Latin Quarter.

17562.description: Welcome to the ibis Paris Nation Davout, opening March 1. We're just a 10-minute walk from the Père Lachaise cemetery and 200 yards from Porte de Montreuil Line 9 metro. We're ideal for business stays or leisure weekends, and our rooms were completely refurbished in 2022. You can relax with a drink at the bar and start the day with a hearty and varied breakfast spread.

17565.description: Situated in Paris's 16th arrondissement, this hotel is surrounded by Parisienne culture and beauty. Roland-Garros stadium, the Parc des Princes, points of interest and amenities are located nearby.   Transportation links are unrivalled as stops for both the metro and bus line are located nearby. This hotel boasts an endearing interior, which is sure to captivate each guest. Hosting an inner courtyard, guests are enchanted by the decadence and poise that this hotel exudes, displaying opulence and elegance at every turn, guests will be enveloped in Parisienne chic. Charming guest rooms ensure that a peaceful night's sleep can be enjoyed. Lavish fabrics and embellished furnishings add character to each room.   Guests can also enjoy a breakfast in the hotel or on the courtyard.

17566.description: This hotel is located in exotic surrounds in Montparnasse, Paris' 14th arrondissement. This district is not only famous for its shopping area, but also for the bars and legendary theatre street, Rue de la Gaité. Built in 1990, this charming hotel offers a total of 40 double rooms spread over 6 floors. Amenities include a 24-hour reception desk, a salon bar and a conference room. There is a garage 200 m from the hotel, which may be used by hotel guests on payment of an additional fee. The charming rooms are each fitted with a tiled en suite bathroom with shower, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV and Internet access. The rooms are also centrally heated as standard. Guests may kick back and relax in the conservatory, which is filled with wonderful flora. A breakfast buffet is available every morning.

name.content: Apolonia Paris Montmartre Sure Hotel Collection BW

17567.description: Located in the residential area of the capital, the intimate and comfortable Hotel Apolonia Paris Montmartre, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western is a sure value for exploring the most beautiful monuments of Paris. The Place du Tertre, the Sacre-Coeur Basilica and the Grands Magasins on Boulevard Haussmann are waiting for you. Enjoy an exceptional stay and the unique atmosphere of the lively streets of Butte Montmartre. With its 3***, the Hotel Apolonia Paris Montmartre, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western will meet all your expectations: contemporary and warm decoration, soundproofing of the rooms and patio jungle style will help make this Parisian stay as pleasant as possible.

17568.description: This pleasant hotel boasts a marvellous setting on a peaceful, quiet street within a 15-minute walk from the Eiffel Tower and just three minutes from the Bir-Hakeim metro station. The Trocadero, Les Invalides and the River Seine are all within easy reach and guests will find a great number of shops and restaurants nearby. The hotel's charming en suite rooms come equipped with satellite television, free Wi-Fi and minibar with tea and coffee facilities. Guests can start the day with a buffet breakfast in the breakfast room or, in the summer, on the shaded garden terrace. This hotel will captivate guests through its hospitality and tranquillity.

17569.description: Centrally located in Paris, Hotel France Louvre is a 4-minute drive from Notre-Dame and 8 minutes from the Louvre Museum. This hotel offers 34 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions with cable programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each room includes a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. Coffee/tea makers are provided, and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. Enjoy a buffet breakfast daily (for a fee) and unwind at the hotel's bar/lounge. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services, along with complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Nearby attractions include the Champs-Élysées and Palais Garnier, both within 2. 9 miles (4. 7 km).

17570.description: This hotel is located in central Paris, opposite the Saint-Lazare train station and close to Galeries Lafayette and the Opera Garnier. The Champs-Élysées and the Louvre Museum are a 20-minute walk away, and the Moulin Rouge is just 15 minutes from the hotel, making it an ideal base for exploring the French capital. The hotel offers elegant, air-conditioned guest rooms with Wi-Fi, soundproofing, a TV, a work desk, and tea and coffee making facilities. Some rooms also feature a balcony and all are accessible by elevator. A daily breakfast is served in the breakfast room, and guests can unwind with a drink in the hotel's lounge bar.

17571.description: Nestled just steps from the Champs-Élysées, the Hotel Lord Byron embodies Parisian elegance with its intimate and refined atmosphere. This 4-star boutique hotel offers elegantly designed rooms and suites, inspired by English romanticism and Haussmannian charm. Its peaceful, green patio provides a haven of serenity in the heart of the capital. Guests can enjoy modern amenities, a wellness area with a hammam, massage room, and fitness center, as well as an elegant bar, perfect for savoring a signature cocktail. The ideal setting for a romantic getaway or an unforgettable Parisian stay.

17573.description: The hotel is located at the heart of the French capital's 9th arrondissement and around 100 m away from Folies Bergères. Grands Boulevard metro station is just a stone-throw away from the hotel and Gare du Nord is around 10 min away while the sightseeing attractions such as Notre Dame, the Eiffel Tower and the Champs-Elysées are 20 min away by public transport. Built in 1855, this typical city hotel has been renovated and offers the charm and authenticity of one of the prettiest cities in the world. The air-conditioned hotel offers a 24-hour reception desk with a safe as well as a lift. All of the pleasant rooms come with an en suite bathroom, a direct dial telephone and all other standard commodities as well as central heating and air conditioning. Guests are able to select their breakfast from the rich buffet offered. The hotel will switch from 3 stars to 4 stars on the 1st January 2024. City tax : 1€88Breakfast : 9€ from 2 to 12 years old / 18€ for 12 years old and over

17574.description: This comfortable hotel has a contemporary atmosphere, and is located in the 9th district of Paris, between Opera Garnier and Gare du Nord. Mythical places such as Montmartre, the Champs Elysées, the Louvre Museum, Notre-Dame-de-Paris cathedral, the Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower are reachable by metro, just a few stations away from Cadet Station, which is a 2-minute walk from the hotel. This is the perfect hotel for those looking for modern and comfortable accommodation in the heart of the French capital. Guests at the Pax Hotel can use the Peyris Hotel’s fitness center free of charge (see photos)

17575.description: Located in the heart of Paris, Le Relais Saint Honoré is a boutique hotel just a short walk from the Tuileries Garden and Orangerie Museum. This hotel offers individually decorated guestrooms featuring minibars, flat-screen televisions with cable, and complimentary wired internet access. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a sauna, concierge services, and daily buffet breakfast (for a fee). Additional conveniences include room service, a computer station, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Nearby attractions include Palais Garnier and the Champs-Élysées.

17576.description: This smoke-free, four-story hotel offers offsite parking and convenient room service during limited hours. Enjoy a daily buffet breakfast (available for a fee) from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Each of the 17 guestrooms features an espresso maker, a flat-screen television with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms are equipped with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. You'll also appreciate conveniences such as laptop-compatible safes, desks, and phones with free local calls. Centrally located in Paris, the hotel is a short walk from Boulevard Haussmann, Galeries Lafayette, and other attractions. It's also conveniently close to the Palais Garnier and Paris Olympia. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

17577.description: This brand new 4*-hotel is located in the 15th arrondissement of Paris, in a very Parisian district and within 10 minutes of the important attractions, including the Eiffel Tower and the Esplanade des Invalides. In addition a range of shopping and entertainment venues are also located in the immediate vicinity. The nearest metro stations are only metres away and enable easy access to all the attractions in the city. The exhibition centre, Porte de Versailles, is only a few minutes away. The transfer time to Orly airport takes around 25 minutes and Charles de Gaulle airport is around 45 minutes away. Built in 1800, this typical Parisian hotel includes 47 stylish guestrooms over 4 floors and 1 bathed with light Junior Suite with private terrace and Eiffel Tower view. The rooms all feature comfy beds, a safe, a minibar and courtesy tray, flat screen TV, bathrobe and slippers. The hotel added to its new conception, a spacious roof terrace with sauna and hot tub, to enjoy Parisian sunny days.

17578.description: The Novum Hotel Aldea caters to both business and leisure travelers with its central Berlin location and direct underground connection. This comfortable hotel offers contemporary furnishings and functional rooms in various categories. Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi and a large breakfast buffet. The majority of rooms are suitable for families of three or four.

17580.description: Enjoy rooftop terrace views at this family-friendly Paris hotel, located in the 13th Arrondissement, a short drive from Place d'Italie and Bercy Arena. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site shopping, and bike storage. Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge after a day exploring the city. Continental breakfast is available daily (for a fee), and room service is offered during limited hours. The 37 guestrooms feature LCD televisions with satellite programming, private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Other amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Self-parking is available (subject to charges).

17602.description: The Best Western Hotel Madison enjoys a prime location near the central train station, providing easy access to Milan's vibrant city center via the extensive bus, tram, and metro network. This 4-star hotel offers 106 tastefully appointed rooms, each equipped with modern amenities for a comfortable stay. For business travelers, the hotel features a well-equipped meeting room, accommodating up to 90 delegates. Guests can unwind at the hotel's new Mad'Son Restaurant, showcasing regional Italian cuisine, particularly Lombard specialties, infused with Mediterranean influences. The restaurant is open for lunch from 12:30 p. m. to 2:30 p. m. and dinner from 7:30 p. m. to 10:30 p. m. The dedicated staff at the Best Western Hotel Madison are committed to ensuring a pleasant and memorable stay.

17603.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 52 guestrooms featuring minibars. Satellite television is provided for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and blackout drapes/curtains. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. 17604.description: This traditional Italian hotel in the palazzo style lies close to the Vía Pisana, the street that leads from the Piazza Repubblica to the main train station. The city centre is just 2 km away. The nearest underground station is a 5-minute walk away. The international airport also lies around 10 km away. The hotel has a total of 32 rooms. With friendly staff on hand, the reception is open daily to assist guests in a variety of matters. The hotel also has a breakfast room. The pleasant rooms are fitted with a direct dial telephone and a TV. Automatic wake-up calls may also be arranged. A continental breakfast is available to guests each morning.

17608.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This Art Deco hotel also features concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and a television in a common area. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, express check-in, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 56 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and bidets. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Corso Buenos Aires - 0. 1 km / 0.

17609.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting at the heart of the stylish city of Milan. The hotel is just 300 metres away from Milanocity Trade Fair. Parco Sempione is within easy reach. Milan historical centre is a 15 minutes' tram-ride away. This property offers visitors a great setting from which to explore the city. The hotel features a special charm and unique ambiance. The guest rooms are stylish and relaxing. Guests are invited to enjoy a superb buffet-style breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day. A romantic dining experience can be enjoyed in the lounge bar, where delectable, Italian dishes are served.

17610.description: CIN: IT015146A1LCCZ4ZTO This comfortable hotel enjoys a privileged and quiet position in the city of Milan, being the ideal choice of accommodation for both business and leisure travellers alike. The property is only 200 metres from the world-renowned Piazza della Repubblica and Milan's central station, allowing its guests to easily access other parts of the city. Moreover, the city centre with the main sightseeing attractions and the fashion district are just a short walk away from the premises. The comfortable and spacious guest rooms are beautifully furnished in a classical style with all conceivable amenities to unwind a have a good time while on holidays or on a business trip. They have wireless Internet connection to keep updated and air-conditioning for added comfort. Those who come by car may use the private parking spaces and guests may relax with a refreshing drink at the lounge bar before dinner.

17611.description: Located in Hoofddorp, this hotel offers convenient access to Schiphol Airport via a complimentary 5-minute shuttle service. Amsterdam's city center is just 15 km away. This charming airport hotel features 80 double rooms, a 24-hour reception with a safe, a lift, a bar, and an à la carte restaurant with a separate non-smoking area and internet access. Laundry service and parking are also available. Each well-appointed en suite room includes a safe and central heating.

name.content: Best Western Plus Amsterdam Airport Hotel

17612.description: The Best Western Plus Amsterdam Airport Hotel is a 4 Star hotel that lives up to the Best Western standards. The hotel stands for personal atmosphere, hospitality, comfort and good facilities for an attractive price. The hotel offers 24-hour front office, comfortable hotel rooms and an à la carte restaurant. The hotel offers free use of its fitness facilities available for all hotel guests, air-conditioning and free wireless Internet in the entire hotel. This hotel is extremely suitable to stay in when you leave early from Schiphol Airport. Between 06:00 and 23:30 our shuttle bus will take you to the airport for free. During your stay in the hotel, you can make use of the free parking facilities (based on availability). Best Western Amsterdam Airport Hotel is located only four kilometers from Schiphol Airport. The airport is also easily accessible by public transport. Cities like Zaanstad, Haarlem and Leiden are well accessible. For the business traveler, the Best Western Plus Amsterdam Airport Hotel is ideally located near several business centers. The hotel offers 190 comfortable deluxe rooms and five quadruple rooms. The deluxe rooms are equipped with a television, work desk, safe, free coffee and tea making facilities and a bathroom with shower, toilet and hair dryer. The quadruple rooms are more spacious and are equipped with four single beds . Enjoy your stay.

17614.description: This hotel is set amidst the peaceful district of Castello, in the tourist centre of Venice. The hotel is located just a 15 minutes' walking distance away from St. Marco's Square. The hotel is located just a few steps away from many shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. Marco Polo Airport is just 8 km away from this charming hotel. This wonderful hotel enjoys a style rich in rustic elegance, blending effortlessly with its spectacular surroundings. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, featuring refreshing tones for a peaceful ambiance. The hotel's extensive range of first-class facilities and services is sure to impress even the most discerning travellers. The hotel features a conference centre, for the convenience of those travelling for work purposes.

17643.description: Located in the centre of Paris, close to the Opera and the Grands Boulevards, this cosy hotel offers a unique atmosphere with a decoration inspired in the famous French sculptor Argueyrolles. The property is at only a few minutes from the main attractions of this romantic city and travellers can find many transport options in the surrounding area, as well as many shops and restaurants. Charles de Gaulle and Orly airport are both about 30 minutes away by car. The charming hotel rooms invite guests to relax and enjoy a pleasant stay in a serene and stylish atmosphere. Before exploring the city, travellers might start their day with a hearty breakfast which is served in a buffet form and the wonderful bar will delight everyone with its unique decorative elements. Business travellers can find at their disposal a fully-equipped meeting room to celebrate successful conferences during their stay.

17644.description: Hotel Le Friedland welcomes you in an exceptional environment. Just a step away from the Avenue des Champs-Elysées, in the famous Faubourg Saint-Honoré, discover the elegance of an authentic Haussmann-style stone hotel. The bright rooms combine comfort and modernity. This 4-star establishment is located in the 'golden triangle' of business, not far from the La Défense district and the Porte Maillot convention center. The charming Boutique hotel counts 40 rooms and was fully renovated in 2022.

17645.description: Discover the100 spacious and bright rooms and suites. All have air conditioning, non-smoking, are equipped with a courtesy tray or a Nespresso coffee machine according to categories, safe, a bottle of fresh water available in the minibar, flat screen TV with a choice of French and international channels. Our rooms and suites are carefully decorated for a comfortable stay. The hotel is located in the heart of Paris, in the 8th district, next to the famous Champs Elysees and the Arc de Triomphe. Some rooms offer an extraordinary view of Montmatre and the Eiffel Tower. At the PLEY Hotel, everything is done to satisfy you, our friendly staff knows the best addresses in the area to make your stay in Paris unforgettable.

name.content: Ibis Styles Paris Gare Saint Lazare

17646.description: A stone's throw from Saint Lazare train station, its four metro lines and the RER, the hotel boasts direct access to Paris and its main attractions: the Opéra Garnier, department stores and Champs Élysées are easily accessible, as is the business district of Clichy-Batignolles.

17647.description: This upscale hotel enjoys a quiet location on Rue Washington, just moments from the Champs-Élysées. A vibrant array of bars, restaurants, nightclubs, and shops are within easy reach. The hotel offers 17 comfortable rooms, each featuring an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, and Wi-Fi. Guests can also enjoy a cozy bar and a 24-hour reception desk with safe and lift access. A car park and garage are available for an additional fee. Room and laundry services are also provided.

17648.description: Enjoy a central Paris stay at Hotel Monceau Wagram, just a 3-minute walk from Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore and 12 minutes from the Champs-Élysées. This hotel offers 25 air-conditioned guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, a bar/lounge, and room service. Start your day with a continental breakfast (available for a fee), and take advantage of amenities such as complimentary newspapers, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include the Arc de Triomphe (1. 2 km) and Boulevard Haussmann (1 km). The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

17649.description: This smart urban hotel is conveniently set in the 9th district of Paris, 16.4 kilometres from Paris Orly Airport. Within walking distance travellers will find the renowned Galeries Lafayette and the Boulevard Haussmann. Le Peletier and Cadet metro stations are within 5 minute-walk from the property, allowing visitors to explore the most important city attractions and local traditions. This wonderful establishment boasts spacious surroundings and delightful décor blending elegance with African touches. Travellers may avail for single and double rooms as well as suites. Each luminous and sumptuously appointed unit features a combination of soothing tones and warm hues with top notch amenities to create a warm home-away-from-home atmosphere. In the mornings guests may taste delicious and varied breakfast buffet in the main dining room with views over the Folies Bergères.

17652.description: The hotel is centrally located and is situated close to a number of sightseeing attractions, such as the Acropolis and the oldest quarter in Athens, Plaka. Public transport (Syngrou-Fix and Acropolis stations) are only minutes away. Built in 1974 and completely renovated in 2002, the hotel consists of 8 floors with a total of 84 rooms, of which 6 are singles, 75 are doubles and 3 are suites. Facilities on offer include an entrance hall with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe and a currency exchange service. In addition the hotel includes a café, a bar, an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with a separate non-smoking area, a conference room and Internet access. The stylish and comfortable rooms come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer. They are all fully - equipped as standard. The hotel prides itself on its sauna, steam room, massage services and gym.

17653.description: Located in the heart of Athens, the Evripides Hotel offers comfort and high-quality service. Just a short walk from the Acropolis, Plaka, and numerous museums and galleries, it's ideal for sightseeing. A nearby metro station provides easy access to the international airport, Piraeus port, and the rest of the city.

17654.description: With a stay at Crowne Plaza Athens City Centre, an IHG Hotel, you'll be centrally located in Athens, within a 5-minute drive of Syntagma Square and Panathenaic Stadium. This luxury hotel is 2. 1 mi (3. 4 km) from Acropolis and 2. 3 mi (3. 6 km) from Parthenon. Treat yourself with massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 193 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Your Tempur-Pedic bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, and LCD televisions with digital programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Grab a bite at Ambrosia, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. U. S. Embassy - 0. 7 km / 0.

name.content: Holiday Inn Athens Attica Av. Airport West

17655.description: Business-friendly Athens airport area hotel, with a restaurant, an indoor pool and free Wi-Fi Holiday Inn® Athens Attica Av, Airport West is a great hotel of the famous chain, on the fastest motorway of the Greek capital, a short distance from its modern airport, only 30’ from the city centre and 10’ from the Olympic Stadium of Athens. Whether your trip is for business or leisure, whatever your age, our Open lobby provides the opportunity to wine and dine at any time, enjoy playing PS or meeting other people, be informed by the interactive info-stand, relax, connect through the available iMac computers with extremely fast Wi-Fi, work efficiently at the ultra-modern e-bar, and of course, you can go from one activity to another. And if you would like a little privacy, we provide a Pop-Up Lounge, with comfortable and cozy sofas. Our goal at Holiday Inn® Athens Attica Av, Airport West is to make you feel in every corner of the hotel, as comfortable as you feel in our exceptional rooms: choose from 180 standard rooms, 11 executive rooms, 3 suites and enjoy comfortable beds, spacious bathrooms, the unique light of Attica and around-the-clock calmness. The indoor pool and gym, many function rooms - with natural lighting - for conferences, 24/7 airport connections, close proximity to major shopping malls and exhibition centers, make the Holiday Inn® Athens Attica Av, Airport West a top choice for every demanding traveler.

17656.description: The newly transformed Holiday Suites @ Arnis Street offers 34 ultra-spacious luxury suites, each a sanctuary with style. Tucked away in Arnis street, a quiet and green pedestrian side street, Holiday Suites opens again its doors after a complete renovation. This elegant and luxurious property with five-star amenities and services is less than five minutes away by foot from the Megaro Moussikis metro station and a leisurely 15 -minute walk to the heart of Downtown Athens, and its endless possibilities. Experience luxury accommodations filled with natural light, contemporary, custom furnishings and state-of-the-art technology.

17657.description: Wyndham Grand Athens hotel welcomes you, fully renovated, to a new haven of affordable luxury in the center of Athens. Conveniently located right next to the Metaxourgeio Metro station it offers the ideal starting point to explore all of the city's major attractions and places in just a few minutes walking distances. Wyndham Grand Athens hotel, with 276 exquisitely comfortable rooms and suites in 8 floors, offers a wide variety of brand new accommodations to suit single, couple or family needs for business or leisure travelers

name.content: The Roc Club, A Hotel to Live

17659.description: Suite Dreams. . . on the Attica Riviera Destination setting for just two or a whole party, Athens luxury hotel in Vouliagmeni-The ROC Club Vouliagmeni, combines the tranquillity and casual ambience of a resort with the lavish amenities of a boutique city hotel. Thirty-five premium deluxe guestrooms and suites, each individually furnished with the casual sophistication of a luxurious beach house, are the exclusive address for those who require the finer things in life. The ROC Club Vouliagmeni luxury hotel in Vouliagmeni, is located in the south-western suburb of Athens and just a 25-minute drive away from the city centre with great sea and sunset views. The beaches of the southern suburbs extend from Alimos to Vouliagmeni until Varkiza offering a full menu of amenities and services. Glyfada's Metaxa Street is one of the most commercial streets of Athens, and it leaves the dedicated shopper with nothing to be desired in terms of variety and choice.

17670.description: With a stay at Novotel London ExCeL in London (Docklands), you'll be within a 5-minute walk of ExCeL Exhibition Centre and Royal Victoria Bridge. This upscale hotel is 0. 2 mi (0. 3 km) from IFS Cloud Royal Docks Station and 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from The Crystal. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Make yourself at home in one of the 257 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Upper Deck, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 4532 square feet (421 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. ExCeL Exhibition Centre - 0. 2 km / 0.

17671.address: Piazza San Marco, Ponte Dei Dai, 877
17671.description: Located in the heart of Venice, Hotel San Marco is steps from St. Mark's Basilica and a short 3-minute walk from St. Mark's Square. This hotel offers easy access to iconic landmarks, including the Doge's Palace and Rialto Bridge, both within 0. 3 miles. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The 54 guestrooms feature minibars, LCD TVs with digital programming, and private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Safes and coffee/tea makers are also provided, along with daily housekeeping. Dine at the hotel's restaurant and bar/lounge or order room service during limited hours. Continental breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include complimentary wired Internet access.

17674.description:
This attractive hotel is located directly opposite of the well-known Bacino Orseolo, the gondola meeting point in Venice. Links to the public transport network are located directly in front of the hotel and the St Mark's Square is only a few minutes away by foot. 

Built in 1308 and renovated in 2003, this hotel is spread over a 4 floor main building and a 3-floor annexe block with 107 rooms in total. The main building comprises a lobby with a 24-hour reception, a safe, a currency exchange desk. A bar, a breakfast room, a TV room and an air-conditioned restaurant are also to be found within the hotel, as well as a conference room and a public Internet terminal. 

The comfortable rooms come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, and are fully - equipped as standard. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample buffet. Lunch and dinner may be taken à la carte or chosen from the menu.

17679.description: This comfortable, 5-star hotel, dating back to 1881, is nestled in the heart of Birmingham, within walking distance of the city center and many top attractions. A variety of bars and pubs are just 500 meters away, and public transport is easily accessible on foot. Following renovations in 2003, the hotel now offers 112 rooms, including five suites. Guests can enjoy the air-conditioned lobby with a 24-hour reception desk, a stylish bar, and a restaurant serving both traditional English and international cuisine. Rooms feature a unique blend of Victorian and minimalist design, adorned with exclusive works of art. All rooms are equipped with standard amenities. Please note: the hotel is cashless. Discounted parking is available at two nearby car parks: Grand Central (B5 4DQ) and B4 (B4 6DG). Please inquire at reception for details.

name.content: Park Inn by Radisson Berlin Alexanderplatz

17700.description: Enjoy a rejuvenating visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of the hotel's health club and sauna. This upscale hotel also provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops. Savor international cuisine at Spagos Bar and Lounge, one of the hotel's three restaurants, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). For your convenience, a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services are also offered. Self-parking is available onsite (charges apply). The 1029 guestrooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi, cable programming, and bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. In-room phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Located in central Berlin, the Park Inn by Radisson Berlin Alexanderplatz is within a 10-minute walk of Alexanderplatz and the Berlin TV Tower. The DDR Museum and Nikolaikirche are both 0. 7 miles away. Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER) is 17. 4 miles from the hotel.

17702.description: In the center of Berlin City-West in the district of Charlottenburg is our 4 Star hotel. You will find us in the parallel street to the Kurfürstendamm. You can reach the Berlin Zoo, the Messe Berlin, the City Cube Berlin, the Gedächtniskirche and all other sights within a few minutes on foot or by public transport. In the entire hotel area, we offer you our free high-speed Wi-Fi. Our 80 spacious rooms at the Best Western Hotel Kantstrasse Berlin are decorated in a modern, bright design and include a flat-screen TV and laptop safe. For refreshment, our free coffee and tea station is available in your room. A modern bathroom and soundproof windows are standard. In the morning, enjoy our breakfast buffet with a wide selection of fresh food.

17703.description: The Best Western Premier Airporthotel Fontane Berlin is located 14 km from BER Airport. Choose from 174 comfortable guest rooms, boarding house apartments, family rooms, and one-bedroom suites. All rooms are air-conditioned and feature complimentary tea and coffee, a safe, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Thirteen air-conditioned meeting rooms with natural light and free high-speed Wi-Fi offer flexible event space for up to 500 people. Enjoy our restaurant with a terrace, hotel bar, TV lounge, cozy smoking room, conference garden, and 24-hour room service. A 400-book library and relaxing saunas offer a tranquil escape. The 100-square-meter fitness room is open 24/7. Ample underground parking and free car, bus, and van parking are available.

17707.description: This comfortable city hotel is located between Rembrandt Park and Vondelpark, 2 km away from the museum quarter. It is close to several shops. Schiphol Airport lies about 5 minutes' drive away. This hotel comprises a total of 90 rooms spread over 5 floors and features a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, air conditioning, a lift, a bar, and an à la carte restaurant.
