You can use the free internet computer in the lobby and relax in the lounge with air conditioning and lounge chairs. A laundry service rounds off the facilities on offer. The comfortable rooms come with a bathroom and are fully - equipped as standard. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample buffet. Lunch and dinner may be taken à la carte.

17713.description: After its total renovation and redevelopment of the structure, the Hotel Morfeo will open its doors and present itself to the public, ready to welcome you with exclusive services and comforts. Strategically located between the two exhibition centers (MICO and Fiera Milano City), which can be reached in a few minutes, Hotel Morfeo stands in front of the new Consulate General of the United States of America and the IPER PORTELLO shopping center. The nearest subway can be reached in just 10 minutes on foot, while the San Siro Stadium takes only 10 minutes (with any of the chosen means of transport). Give space to your well-being despite the many commitments that Milan brings, take a seat in our 'Narciso' gym, equipped with the latest generation equipment and where you can find TECHNOGYM qualified staff to assist you. They will be able to advise you step by step, they will be able to follow your workouts and give you the best tips for proper nutrition, in relation to your usual workouts. If you are looking for the comfort and warmth of a home in Milan, combined with the efficiency and safety of a service with a great hotel tradition, Hotel Morfeo is the right choice!

17714.description: Comfortable 4 Star hotel located 50 meters from the Turro Metro Red Line MM1, which allows you to easily and quickly reach the historical city center, only 10 minutes away. The Rho-Pero and Milan Fair City Exhibition Centers, MiCo Milano Congressi Convention Center, the Milan Central and Porta Garibaldi railway stations can be reached in a few minutes. The C-Hotels Concorde has 120 spacious and soundproof rooms spread over 10 floors, equipped with modern facilities including Wi-Fi with free access. The C-Hotels Concorde is also equipped with a large, modern conference center, private garage and indoor parking spaces. A fully equipped gym complete the services available to our guests.

17715.description: The luxurious and stylish Hotel Rubens is strategically located in the centre of Milan, within walking distance of some of the major attractions such as the National Theatre, the Corso Vercelli Shopping Road, Leonardo's Last Supper, the Mi. Co Congress Centre, FieraMilanoCity and the San Siro Stadium, home of Inter and AC Milan football teams. Other famous attractions such as the Dome are easily reachable by metro which is mere steps away. The exceptional design hotel welcomes guests in an atmosphere of extraordinary elegance enriched by beautiful art works. The stylishly appointed rooms in a contemporary design are spacious and feature air-conditioning and complimentary fibre optic WIFI. Guests can work out in the fitness centre. Breakfast is served in the “Sala delle Nuvole” restaurant on the 5th floor, offering panoramic views thanks to its huge floor-to-ceiling windows. An ideal choice for business and leisure travellers alike.

17716.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages or enjoy recreation amenities such as a health club. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. This hotel has 4 meeting rooms available for events. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 103 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and espresso makers.

17717.description: This city hotel is centrally situated in the buzzing, Italian cultural hub that is Milan. The tourist and business areas, with countless shopping and entertainment venues, are waiting to be explored just a few steps away. There is also a public transport stop to be found 100 m away. For those travelling from further afield, the airport (around 50 km away) offers excellent international connections. The well-maintained hotel provides a stylish atmosphere and offers not only cultural visitors to world famous Milan an optimal stay. It comprises 14 comfortable rooms and is fully air-conditioned. The lobby has lifts, a 24-hour reception and a safe for securely storing valuables. In addition, the hotel bar and garden provide the ideal place to relax after an eventful day sightseeing. A laundry service and the public Internet connection round up the facilities on offer. The tastefully decorated rooms ideally suit guests' needs. They include an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, Internet access, TV, air conditioning and a minibar as well as a balcony. Breakfast is served every day.

17718.description: This hotel is located just a few minutes from the city centre, close to Milan's exhibition centre and a short distance from bars and restaurants. Links to the public transport network are some 50 m from the hotel. The family-run city hotel comprises a total of 36 rooms and features a foyer, a public Internet terminal, room and laundry services. Garage parking facilities are available to those staying at the hotel. The welcoming rooms come with a bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access and a minibar. A wide range of sports and leisure opportunities are on offer throughout the city of Milan. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample buffet.

17719.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 113 guestrooms featuring minibars (stocked with some free items) and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

17720.description: This unique, eco-friendly hotel in Milan offers a spa with panoramic city views. Conveniently located near the Fiera Milano City, MiCo Exhibition Centre, and the Violet Metro Station, it provides easy access to the historic city center, San Siro Stadium, the main train station, and the Rho/Pero Exhibition Centre. A historic tram stop opposite the hotel offers a charming ride through Milan's most impressive streets. Malpensa Airport is approximately 45 km away, while Linate Airport is only 11 km away. Enjoy a healthy breakfast featuring organic and gluten-free products and fresh fruit. Each room is designed around a leading color – green, red, or gold – and features elegant walnut and briar-root furniture. Marble bathrooms are adorned with shimmering Sicis glass mosaic tiles.

17721.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include wedding services, a ballroom, and a vending machine. Grab a bite to eat at Studio Bellerive, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Featured amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Zürich? This hotel has 2691 square feet (250 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 4 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 61 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding.

17722.description: 'Located in the heart of Zurich on the renowned Bahnhofstrasse shopping street, this superior hotel offers a warm, intimate ambiance and over a century of international hospitality expertise. Situated directly across from the main railway station, with a 10-minute direct train connection to the international airport, it provides convenient access to the financial district and major tourist attractions. Enjoy a quiet stay thanks to triple-glazed windows, along with amenities such as a buffet breakfast, twice-weekly guest cocktail receptions, and an evening butler service. '

17723.description: This stylish hotel, nestled on a quiet side street in Zurich's University quarter, is just a short walk from the city center, picturesque old town, and Lake Zurich. The 37 modern rooms (33 doubles, 4 singles) are spread over four floors and feature bespoke furniture, king-sized beds, en-suite bathrooms with hairdryers, direct-dial telephones, satellite TV with X-Box, internet access, and in-room safes. Hotel amenities include a 24-hour reception, lift, cloakroom, café, bar, à la carte restaurant, TV and lounge area, and a conference room for up to 16 people. Laundry and room service are available, along with public internet access and car parking. Enjoy breakfast each morning, and à la carte lunch and dinner at Restaurant Sento, open Monday through Friday.

17724.description: The Bauhaus-style building was built in the 1930s as a residence for young singles. Since then, not only the strict rules of the house have changed. In the 50's the building became a hotel and in the last 5 years they have renovated the house with a great respect for its architectural essence. The Engimatt City & Garden Hotel is your green oasis in the middle of Zurich – whether for a private trip to the city or for business. We look forward to welcoming you in the family-type atmosphere of our hotel.

17725.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at Hotel Europe, a boutique hotel in central Zürich, within a 15-minute walk of Kunsthaus Zürich and Zurich Town Hall. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. Indulge in lunch or dinner at Restaurant Max & Otto, or enjoy the cafe and room service. Unwind at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel also offers a hair salon, on-site shopping, a reception hall, computer station, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The 39 individually decorated guestrooms feature private bathrooms with designer toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. Hotel Europe is conveniently located near the Zürich Opera House, Lakeside Promenade, and Bellevue Square. The preferred airport is Zurich Airport (ZRH).

17726.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at this centrally located Zürich boutique hotel, just a 5-minute walk from Lindenhofplatz. The Marktgasse Hotel offers 39 air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs, cable programming, and private bathrooms stocked with designer toiletries. Make use of the on-site bar/lounge, coffee shop, and limited room service. Meeting rooms and dry cleaning/laundry services are also available. A shuttle from Zurich Airport (ZRH) is offered for a surcharge. Guests can also enjoy complimentary access to a nearby fitness center.

17727.description: Located in the heart of Zurich, this modern hotel is just a 5-minute walk from the main railway station and 2 km from Lake Zurich's stunning promenade. Ski resorts are approximately 100 km away. Shops, bars, restaurants, and nightclubs are all within a 500 m radius. Built in 1901, this 5-story hotel offers 56 well-equipped en-suite rooms and features a 24-hour reception with a safe, elevators, and a currency exchange desk.

17738.description:
This stylish hotel boasts a convenient location in the Quartier de l'Europe in the City of Love. Guests staying at this hotel will be able to discover the picturesque and charming atmosphere of the western side of Paris, with many interesting cultural and historical attractions and chic shops. The property is also well connected thanks to nearby public transport links. All guest rooms and suites are tastefully decorated in soothing colours and count with convenient amenities for a pleasant stay. They have double glazing for a quiet trip and complimentary wireless Internet connection for added comfort. The hotel’s interiors are inspired in the universe of railways using curved lines that imitate the railway lines of the nearby Saint-Lazare station. Guests can also enjoy a delicious breakfast every morning. 
Please note that the elevator is out of order until April 4th, 2026 included.

17739.description: This refined, boutique hotel boasts a prime location in Paris' city centre, being the ideal choice of accommodation for both business travellers and holidaymakers. This elegant property sits very close to the Opéra Garnier for excellent night shows and Galeries Lafayette for trendy shopping opportunities. For those who are more interested in culture, they may also visit the Musée Grévin, which can be found just a few steps from the premises. At the air-conditioned and non-smoking guest rooms, guests can luxuriate in the comfort of their superb amenities and feel completely at ease with the soothing and warm touches displayed. Guests can enjoy modern amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet connection to keep updated and a flat-screen TV to have a restful evening. This delightful hotel offers all the necessary services for a memorable stay and serves a hearty breakfast buffet.

17740.description: This attractive business hotel is centrally located in Paris' 15th arrondissement. The Eiffel Tower and River Seine can be reached in just a few minutes on foot, and many restaurants, bars and cafés can be found in the vicinity of the hotel. Additionally, Dupleix metro station is just 300 metres away, allowing guests direct access to the Champs Elysées, Trocadero and Montparnasse district. Rooms are modern and trendy, decorated in bright colours and furnished with cosy beds, flat-screen television, and free Wi-Fi. Guests can indulge in breakfast in bed, or start the day with a breakfast buffet, and the hotel's multilingual staff provides a range of helpful services including 24-hour reception, city information and tour recommendations, business services and luggage storage. Whether travelling for business or leisure, this hotel offers an uncomplicated and relaxing stay in the heart of Paris.

17741.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as bicycle rentals, a terrace, and a garden at Pepper & Paper Apartments. This aparthotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a vending machine. Guests can grab a bite at the snack bar/deli and mingle at the daily complimentary reception. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. The 17 guestrooms feature kitchens with refrigerators and ovens, flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and microwaves. Housekeeping is provided on request. A stay at Pepper & Paper Apartments places you in the heart of Paris, within a 15-minute walk of Luxembourg Gardens and the Panthéon. Notre Dame is 1. 5 miles (2. 4 km) away, and the Louvre Museum is 1. 9 miles (3. 1 km) from this aparthotel.

17742.description: This attractive hotel lies between the shopping quarter Montparnasse, the Eiffel Tower and the Parc Des Expositions De Versailles. An abundance of shops and entertainment venues are located in the immediate vicinity, while the nearest train station is around 1. 5 km away from the hotel. Les Invalides, the Champs-Elysées, the Louvre and Notre Dame are all within 4. 5 km of the hotel. The air-conditioned hotel was completely renovated and consists of 7 floors with a total of 38 rooms. The hotel offers a stylish lobby containing a lift, safes and a 24-hour reception. A buffet breakfast is available to hotel guests every morning.

17743.description: This hotel is situated in the Paris suburb of Puteaux, just a stone's throw from La Défense quarter. Here guests will find plenty of shopping facilities and entertainment venues. The metro station Esplanade de la Défense is around 700 m from the hotel and enables quick access to the centre of Paris. The Palais des Congrès lies roughly 3 km away and Charles de Gaulle is a 40-minute drive from the hotel. This refurbished hotel comprises a total of 29 rooms spread over 5 floors, as well as a garden. The welcoming lobby area offers a 24-hour reception, a lift, a bar and a lounge with complimentary newspapers. The multilingual staff are happy to help guests organise their stay, for example, to book restaurants, cruises or airport transfers. Parking places are available for an added fee. The comfortable en suite rooms come with a hairdryer and the beds come with duvets. The accommodation is equipped with a direct dial telephone, Internet access (charges apply), a minibar, an ironing set and a safe. They also include individually adjustable heating and air conditioning. The nearest golf course is just over 5 km away. The hotel offers an ample breakfast buffet, which is served in the basement. Guests arriving by car should take the Paris ring road to Porte Maillot and follow signs for Puteaux Centre - La Défense 11.

17752.description: Situated in Venice's historic center, this hotel occupies a beautifully preserved building near Piazza San Marco. Many rooms offer charming canal views, while all provide modern amenities. A short walk from Rialto's vibrant shops, bars, and restaurants, the hotel also offers easy access to San Zaccaria water bus station (less than 5 minutes) and Santa Lucia Train Station (2 km). Venice Marco Polo Airport is 15 km away. The hotel seamlessly blends the elegance of original late-nineteenth-century furnishings and rich velvets with contemporary comforts. Each room features air conditioning, a desk, satellite TV, and a private bathroom with bath amenities. Experience a memorable Venetian holiday in a truly charming and relaxing atmosphere.

17753.description: A few steps away from St. Mark's Square, Hotel Colombina is ready to welcome you in a refined and elegant atmosphere in the typical Venetian 18th-century style. Located in Calle del Remedio, the hotel is composed by two wings, the Palazzo, overlooking the famous Canonica Rio with its spectacular view of the Bridge of Sighs, and an elegant and fascinating noble floor accessible through a traditional Venetian private courtyard with an ancient well. In each guestroom you will feel the elegant Venetian atmosphere, surrounded by the quietness of the city, rocked by the serenades of the gondoliers and by all the comforts of a modern hotel situated in the most romantic city in the world. An unforgettable stay that will take you to discover the magic of Venice through its history, art and tradition. In the Cocktail Bar and Bistrot you can enjoy typical Venetian specialities or gourmet dishes accompany by a special selection of fine Italian wines as well as sought-after spirits from all the world. Every morning you can enjoy a fresh and wholesome breakfast in the frescoed atrium of the of the piano nobile or in the Palazzo’s dedicated lounge admiring the beauty and elegance of this historical residence. The private water dock is the cherry on top of the hotel giving you the possibility to experience the comfort and charm of an arrival and departure by water taxi as well the opportunity to alfresco dine or have an aperitif watching the gondolas characteristics and relaxing seesaw. The Colombina staff will be on hand to meet your every need and make your stay in Venice an unforgettable experience.

17754.description: Ideally located in the heart of Venice Mestre, the cozy 3-star Hotel Centrale offers convenient access to public transportation just outside its doors. This welcoming hotel, complemented by a friendly and helpful staff, is close to shops, restaurants, and various amenities, making it a perfect choice for exploring Venice. Comfortable accommodations include simply decorated rooms fully equipped with air conditioning, telephone, standard and satellite TV, private balconies, and ensuite bathrooms. Please note that the local city tax is not included in the booked rate and will be charged directly by the hotel upon check-in/out.

17756.description: Located near Amsterdam's Middenweg, close to Frankendael Park, this hotel offers convenient access to shops, restaurants, pubs, and public transport. Schiphol Airport is less than 12km away, and a golf course is within 5km. The hotel features a welcoming lobby with friendly staff, a lift, café, à la carte restaurant, conference rooms, internet access, laundry service, bicycle storage, and parking. The comfortable, modern rooms are fully equipped for a pleasant stay.

17760.description: The Citadines Apart'hotel Bastille Marais in Paris overlooks a charming garden and is conveniently located near Place de la Bastille, renowned for its iconic opera house, numerous restaurants, bars, and boutiques. Corporate offices such as Banque de France, Publicis, FOII, and Insign are within walking distance, as is the historic Place des Vosges. The hotel offers 108 air-conditioned studios for one or two guests and 30 one-bedroom apartments for up to four. Studios feature double or twin beds, while apartments have a choice of a sofa or pull-out beds in the living area and a double or two single beds in the bedroom. Citadines also prioritizes guest and staff safety with its 'Ascott Cares' program, which emphasizes high hygiene and cleanliness standards.

17761.description: A stay at Citadines Opéra Paris places you in the heart of Paris, within a 15-minute walk of Palais Garnier and Place Vendôme. This 4-star aparthotel is 1. 5 mi (2. 3 km) from La Machine du Moulin Rouge and 1. 6 mi (2. 6 km) from Champs-Élysées. Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Make yourself at home in one of the 72 guestrooms, featuring kitchenettes with refrigerators and stovetops. Wired and wireless Internet access is complimentary, and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Grands Boulevards - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi- Boulevard Haussmann - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi- Grevin Museum - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Place de l'Opéra - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Galeries Lafayette - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Palais Garnier - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Grand Rex Cinema - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Paris Olympia - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Printemps Department Store - 0. 9 km/0. 5 mi- Theatre Mogador - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Palais Royal - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Place Vendôme - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Rue de Rivoli - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Les Halles - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi- Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 30 km/18. 7 mi Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 20. 5 km/12. 7 mi Paris Beauvais Airport (BVA) - 86. 3 km/53. 7 mi Paris (XCR-Chalons-Vatry) - 214 km/133 mi.

name.content: Citadines Saint Germain des Pres Paris

17762.description: Nestled in the heart of Paris's Latin Quarter, this hotel offers a charming base for exploring the city's bohemian culture. Overlooking the Seine, it boasts magnificent views. Guests can easily immerse themselves in the vibrant atmosphere of the Latin Quarter, with its numerous bookshops, cafés, bars, and shops. For further exploration, the hotel is conveniently located near metro lines 4 and 7, and RER lines B and C, providing easy access to the rest of Paris. Charles de Gaulle Airport is approximately a 40-minute drive away. After a day of sightseeing, guests can relax in the comfortable beds, unwind in the cozy lounge area, or recharge in the fitness room.

name.content: Hotel Glasgow Monceau by Patrick Hayat

17766.description: Located in an exclusive Parisian neighborhood, this recently renovated hotel offers comfort and excellent service in a tranquil, sophisticated setting. Each vibrant, air-conditioned room features internet access and a flat-screen cable TV. Situated on a quiet street, the Glasgow Monceau by Patrick Hayat is near the Grands Magasins, the Opera, the Champs-Élysées, Montmartre, and the splendid Park Monceau. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, the hotel is surrounded by excellent restaurants and shops, just minutes from a charming street market, and conveniently close to Metro and bus stations. Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Please note: Some areas of the hotel are currently under renovation, and guests may encounter some noise. This work is expected to be completed around September 15th.

17767.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 35 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Grands Boulevards - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Folies Bergere - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Grevin Museum - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Boulevard Haussmann - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Les Halles - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Place de la République - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Centre Pompidou - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Place de l’Opéra - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Canal Saint-Martin - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Palais Royal - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Galeries Lafayette - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Rue de Rivoli - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Theatre Mogador - 1. 7 km / 1 mi- Palais Garnier - 1. 7 km / 1 mi- La Carrousel du Louvre - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 20. 3 km / 12. 6 miParis Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 29. 2 km / 18. 1 miThe preferred airport for Hôtel des Comédies is Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG). A stay at Hôtel des Comédies places you in the heart of Paris, within a 15-minute walk of Boulevard Haussmann and Place de la République. This boutique hotel is 1 mi (1. 7 km) from Palais Garnier and 1. 8 mi (2. 9 km) from Champs-Élysées.

name.content: Hotel du Theatre by Patrick Hayat

17768.description: The Hotel du Théâtre by Patrick Hayat, a charming boutique hotel in the heart of Paris, offers 21 newly refurbished rooms in a classic, elegant style. Each room is fully equipped with heating, a TV, Wi-Fi, a safe, and background music. Ideal for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel is located near the Palais Garnier opera house and the Champs-Élysées, with convenient access to the La Défense business district. Experience a unique Parisian stay at the Hotel du Théâtre, a must-visit in the City of Light.

17769.description: Unique, atypical and romantic, the Marais Hôme hotel invites you to enjoy a timeless stay in the heart of Paris. The hotel has been designed to offer a warm and welcoming setting, harmoniously combining the charm of old Paris with contemporary touches. Rooms are tastefully decorated, creating a romantic atmosphere conducive to relaxation. Located in the trendy Marais district of Paris, this 3-star hotel boasts an exceptional location for exploring the French capital's finest attractions. Staying at the Hotel Marais Hôme allows you to enjoy the hustle and bustle of Paris. The Marais district is renowned for its lively cultural life, art galleries, trendy boutiques, cafés and restaurants. Whether you're looking for a romantic getaway, a cultural adventure or a gastronomic experience, the Marais Hôme hotel will meet your expectations.

17770.description: Located in the 17th arrondissement, a short walk from Parc Monceau, the Prince Albert Wagram Hotel offers convenient access to central Paris. Just a five-minute walk from Malesherbes metro station, guests can easily reach St. Lazare and the city's renowned department stores. This welcoming hotel features 33 comfortable guestrooms decorated in traditional French style. Each room includes an en-suite bathroom, air conditioning, a flat-screen satellite TV, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can also enjoy a business center, 24-hour reception, and international newspapers available in the lobby. Public parking is located nearby. Please note: Local city tax is not included in the booked rate and is payable directly to the hotel upon check-in/out. Due to COVID-19 protocols, breakfast is currently served in guest rooms.

17772.description: This small boutique hotel, nestled in the Boulevard Saint Germain in the Latin Quarter, is very nicely located in the heart of Paris just minutes' walk from the main points of interest, such as Notre Dame, Louvre, and Saint Germain. Access to the public transport network is near at hand. This is a perfect place from where to start exploring the city.

17773.description: This hotel is housed in a beautiful 19th century building in the eight district of Paris. The hotel is only a short walk away from the St. Lazare metro station, which will conveniently connect guests to the whole city. The Eiffel Tower is just two metro stops away. Guests will appreciate staying minutes away from great nightlife, restaurants, and attractions. There are also many shops about 100 metres from the hotel, and there are excellent public transportation links.

17774.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Villa Des Princes, including complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The hotel offers room service during limited hours, luggage storage, a safe deposit box at the front desk, and an airport shuttle for a surcharge (available upon request). Each of the 11 guestrooms features a flat-screen television with cable programming, a private bathroom with shower, complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer, a safe, a desk, and a phone. Located in Paris's 6th Arrondissement, the hotel is within a 15-minute walk of Luxembourg Gardens and Notre-Dame, and conveniently close to attractions such as the Louvre Museum and the Panthéon.

17777.description: This charming hotel is nestled in the heart of the Latin Quarter, within easy reach of attractions such as the Jardin du Luxembourg and the Panthéon. The vibrant Rue Mouffetard market is also nearby. The well-appointed guest rooms and suites feature contemporary decor and modern amenities for a comfortable stay, including double-glazed windows and goose-down pillows. Guests can relax in the hotel's patio or, for business travelers, a reception room for up to 30 people is available. A delicious breakfast buffet is served daily, and the charming on-site bar offers a luxurious and comfortable atmosphere.

17778.description: Nestled in a district that has the typically gentle feel of a village, but a village that is conveniently situated in the heart of Paris, the Hotel Ami has been welcoming travellers since 1925, when it opened here in the peaceful and relaxing setting of the 15th arrondissement. Redesigned by the architect Gesa Hansen, who has given it a Nordic and minimalist style, this charming 3-star boutique hotel offers warm and intimate spaces to enjoy at any time of the day. . . From the comfortable rooms to the attentive service and cosy lounge, its unique atmosphere is intended to fulfil your desires and bestow a sense of wellbeing.

17781.description: This charming hotel is situated in a wonderful, central location, in the Opéra quarter on Boulevard des Italiens. Close to the hotel are numerous shopping facilities and tourist attractions such as the Place Vendôme and the well-known Louvre Museum. The hotel is located at 5-min walk from the station. With 49 well-equipped rooms over 5 floors, this 18th century hotel has single and double rooms. The amenities include a welcoming foyer with a reception, an air-conditioned restaurant. All rooms are well equipped as standard. Guests may serve themselves at the breakfast each morning. For guests arriving by car there is a public car park lies only 100 m from the hotel.

17782.description: This cosy hotel is set in a beautiful, listed building and enjoys an exceptional location in the heart of one of the oldest districts of Paris. The Place de la République and the Marais are just a few steps away, and many of the city's most important sights such as the Louvre Museum and the Centre Pompidou can be reached on foot. The nearby Republique metro station provides easy access to all the city sights as well as meetings in the La Defense business district. The hotel's charming guest rooms are tastefully decorated and well equipped with TVs, Wi-Fi access and soundproofing to guarantee a good night's rest. Guests can wake up to a delightful in-room breakfast in the morning, all for a pleasant stay in the heart of Paris.

17783.description: This endearing city hotel lies amidst the Opera house and Montmartre, surrounded by a vast array of shopping opportunities and theatres. The Gare du Nord, Gare de L'Est, Cadet and Anvers railway stations are easily accessible. This hotel is ideally located in the heart of the city's activity just minutes from the Louvre, Notre Dame Cathedral and the Arc de Triomphe. This hotel ensures that each guest can enjoy their stay in a prime location in this mesmerising city. The hotel rooms are simple yet elegant, decorated with Parisian chic and modern furnishings, ensuring that each guest can relax and unwind after a culturally invigorating day in the city. A buffet breakfast is offered to each guest, ensuring that they are ready for the day ahead.

17785.description: Enjoy your stay at the Radisson Hotel Zurich Airport, featuring a 24-hour fitness center, terrace, and garden. The hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops. Savor Italian cuisine at Bocca Buona, the on-site restaurant with a bar/lounge and garden view, or order room service during limited hours. A buffet breakfast is available weekdays and weekends for a fee. The hotel offers 211 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. Business amenities include a business center, express check-in/check-out, and 8 meeting rooms. An airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies), as is self-parking (fees apply). Nearby attractions include Kart-Bahn Zurich Ruemlang (1. 3 km), Circus Salto Natale (4. 3 km), and Hallenstadion (7 km). The preferred airport is Zurich Airport (ZRH) (10. 7 km).

17786.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace at Hotel Rössli, located in the heart of Zurich. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and wired internet access in one of the 27 comfortable guestrooms, each featuring a minibar, flat-screen TV, premium bedding, and complimentary toiletries. Start your day with a delicious buffet breakfast (fee applies) at the on-site restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel also offers convenient amenities such as multilingual staff and luggage storage. You'll be within a 15-minute walk of Bahnhofstrasse and ETH Zurich, with other attractions like the Grossmünster and Kunsthaus Zurich a short distance away. Zurich Airport (ZRH) is easily accessible, just 13 km from the hotel.

17814.description: Facing the Grand Canal and the Rialto Bridge, this elegant hotel enjoys an ideal setting the heart of the world's most romantic city. The world-famous St. Mark's Square with the Basilica, the Bridge of Sighs and countless other attractions can be reached within a short stroll. The Santa Lucia train station is at a distance of about 2. 5 km; the Sant'Angelo vaporetto stop is mere steps away, providing direct connection to the international airport. The hotel is set in a historical building constructed in 1890 as a private palace on the site of the former 17th century Sant'Angelo Theatre opera house. The hotel retains its ancient charm with an elegant façade and rooms restored to their original design with Murano chandeliers, marble bathrooms, antique furniture and original period floors. It also has a private dock where guests can arrive by motorboat or gondola. A perfect place to start discovering this enchanting city.

17816.address: Piazza San Marco - Ponte dei Dai, 875
17816.description: Situated just fifty metres from the Piazza San Marco in romantic Venice, this charming apartment hotel is absolutely ideal for sightseeing holidays. St Mark's Basilica, the Grand Canal, the archaeological museum, and La Fenice Theatre are all just steps away. The generously proportioned apartments and suites are well-appointed in Venetian style with Murano glass artwork and parquet floors. Guests can have a coffee under the clock tower in the Piazza San Marco and dine on delicious seafood in the nearby La Colomba restaurant, which is adorned with fabulous paintings and drawings, some by famous artists who dined there. The hotel also offers 24-hour reception, Wi-Fi, and airport transfers, and the multilingual staff can advise guests of the best city sights and book guided tours, museum entrance tickets and excursions. This unique hotel is the ideal choice for couples, families and groups on holiday in Venice.

17817.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Hotel Il Moro di Venezia, located in the heart of Venice, just a short walk from Piazzale Roma and the Grand Canal. Start your day with a complimentary local cuisine breakfast, served daily. The hotel offers 27 air-conditioned guest rooms, each equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, a safe, and a desk. Bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. The hotel also features a restaurant and concierge services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. Nearby attractions include the Venetian Ghetto and the Jewish Museum of Venice.

17823.description: This cozy, modern family hotel in Amsterdam's museum district blends convenience and charm, close to top tourist attractions. Excellent public transport links are nearby, and Schiphol Airport is less than 10 km away. Enjoy breakfast in the restaurant or courtyard garden. Some of Amsterdam's best restaurants are within walking distance. Comfortable and spacious rooms are available in several styles, each featuring modern decor reflecting the city's vibrant art and music scene. Relax in your room after a long day exploring the canals.

17824.description: Amsterdam House Hotel is set in a monumental building decorated with flowers and overlooking the Amstel river. It is surrounded by tourist attractions such as Rembrandtplein, Dam Square and the Flower Market. All rooms and apartments have a private bathroom, coffee/tea making facilities and a DVD player. A large separate seating area is also provided. A selection of movies is available at reception free of charge. Most of the rooms have views over the canal. An extensive breakfast including fair trade fruits, organic meats and free range eggs is served in the breakfast room. Various cafés, bars and restaurants surround Amsterdam House Hotel.

17833.description: Dona Palace is a 4-star boutique hotel 2 minutes' walk from Saint Mark's Square in central Venice. Facing the Ducal Palace's canal, it offers elegant Venetian-style rooms with an LCD satellite TV, minibar and free Wi-Fi. Set in a 14th-century building, rooms and suites at Hotel Dona Palace have a classic design with wood furniture and carpeted floors. Each one has air conditioning and a private bathroom with hairdryer and toiletries. Some are fitted with wooden floors. An American breakfast is served each morning. The hotel has its own internal garden, where drinks are served in summer, and a landing dock for water taxis. A pleasant 5-minute walk will take you to the Bridge of Sighs. San Marco is a great choice for travellers interested in museums, history and romance. This is our guests' favourite part of Venice, according to independent reviews. This property also has one of the best-rated locations in Venice! Guests are happier about it compared to other properties in the area. We speak your language!

17834.description: Steeped in history and culture, Venice has a magic about it that enchants all visitors who choose to stay in this incredible place, which is almost frozen in time and overflowing with beauty of every kind. Enhance the magic of your visit with a stay at the Baglioni Hotel in Venice, one of the top-rated 5-star hotels in Venice, a few steps from St. Mark's Square. The Palace of the Baglioni Hotel Luna is home to a fully-fledged art gallery. The recent restoration now highlights the incredible beauty of the style and architectural lines. Choose from a wide range of romantic rooms and prestigious suites furnished by Baglioni Hotels in the lush Venetian style. From the balconies of the suites and top suites of the Baglioni Hotel Luna, you can enjoy a spectacular panoramic view over the Venetian Lagoon and the Royal Gardens, which stretch over the San Marco basin and the island of San Giorgio Maggiore. Wine and dine in style at our award-winning Canova Restaurant. Relish the modern interpretation of original Venetian cuisine while feasting your eyes on the historical surroundings.

17836.description: Cambio de sábanas según estancia y cambio de toallas y limpieza a diario.

17838.description: Located in the heart of Madrid, the upscale Hotel Regina offers convenient access to Gran Via and Puerta del Sol, both within a 5-minute walk. The hotel features 175 guestrooms equipped with memory foam beds, down comforters, minibars, and private bathrooms with designer toiletries and bidets. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a 24-hour fitness center, concierge services, and a Mediterranean restaurant with a bar/lounge. Additional amenities include wedding services, a banquet hall, and airport shuttle service (surcharge). A buffet breakfast is available for a fee.

17839.description: This city hotel in the heart of Madrid is only a few metres from the Puerta del Sol, the Plaza Mayor, the underground station Tirso de Molina, as well as numerous leisure activities. The Reina Sofía Museum is a mere 500 metres away, whilst Thyssen and Prado are only 1 km away, within walking distance. The Royal Palace and Atocha station are also a mere 1 km away from the hotel. It is roughly 16 km from Madrid Barajas International Airport. The lavish interior furnishings comprises vibrant colours and high-quality fabrics, instilling a sense of luxury and decadence. Guest rooms are furnished in warm tones and streamline design to ensure that guests can enjoy the utmost comfort whilst on their journey. The mezzanine cafeteria-restaurant provides an ample buffet breakfast, as well as a select number of dishes for lunch and dinner.

name.content: B&B Hotel Madrid Centro Plaza Mayor

17841.description: Enjoy a central Madrid stay at the B&B Hotel Madrid Centro Plaza Mayor, just a 5-minute walk from Plaza Mayor and Puerta del Sol. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a communal TV area. The 40 guestrooms feature private bathrooms with showers and hair dryers, safes, and complimentary bottled water. Daily housekeeping is provided. The hotel is also conveniently located near Gran Via and the Royal Palace of Madrid (0. 5 mi/0. 8 km). Laundry facilities and a 24-hour front desk are available for added convenience.

17842.description: This hotel enjoys a great location in San Lorenzo de El Escorial. The property is situated opposite the historical monastery that was founded by Felipe II, and is considered to be the Eight Wonder of the World. The Casita del Principe is just a short walking distance away. The train station is just 1 km from the hotel. Guests will find themselves just 50 km away from Madrid. This family-friendly hotel offers a beautiful combination of unique, historical surroundings, with the high standards that are expected of a modern hotel. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, featuring modern amenities for added comfort. The hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, ensuring the utmost in convenience. Guests will be pleased by the many facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

17848.description: This welcoming hotel is located near the Grand Boulevard and Montmartre in northeast Paris, surrounded by shops and entertainment. Famous attractions, such as the Sacré-Coeur Basilica and the Opéra Garnier, are just minutes away. The Bonne Nouvelle metro station is only 250 meters away, and the Gare du Nord train station is approximately 700 meters away. The hotel offers 38 rooms, a safe, an elevator, and a bar. Each comfortable room features an ensuite bathroom with a hairdryer, a direct-dial telephone, and satellite TV. A continental breakfast is served every morning.

17849.description: The Claret Hotel offers a modern and elegant setting for your Parisian holiday or business trip. Located near the vibrant Latin Quarter, it provides easy access to major city attractions. The hotel's 52 comfortable rooms are designed for guest relaxation, each featuring a private bathroom, satellite TV, Canal+, telephone, and Wi-Fi. Five well-equipped meeting rooms are also available for conferences and events. Guests can enjoy the hotel's lively pub and restaurant, serving French and international cuisine. With excellent transport links, the Claret Hotel ensures a convenient and pleasant stay in Paris.

17850.description: This hotel boasts a stunning setting in a sleepy side street, at the heart of Paris. The property is located in the zone where the Sacre Coeur and Opera can be found. The hotel enjoys easy access to the treasure trove of attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. A wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found nearby. Convenient public transport networks are within easy reach. This charming hotel oozes French grace and style. The guest rooms are comfortable, featuring a classical design. The hotel offers convenient facilities and services, to ensure that guests enjoy a comfortable stay.

17851.description: This exclusive city hotel is located in the district of Champs Elysées, more specifically in the area of the Opera, a few metres away from Grands Magasins and Lafayette. The hotel is close to the Gare Saint-Lazare, the luxurious shopping centres on Boulevard Haussman and the Opéra Garnier. The hotel is well communicated with both airports Charles de Gaulle and Orly, and is the perfect place for both, business and leisure guests. Bookings of 3 or more rooms, as well as stays longer than 6 days, may be subject to special cancellation and payment conditions.

17852.description: The Lautrec Opera Hotel offers a warm welcome in a classic Parisian building, just steps from the Opera Garnier and the Louvre Museum. Choose from 60 modern or classically elegant rooms, each equipped with air conditioning, international TV channels, a minibar, and a safe. The hotel also provides a business center, laundry service, breakfast, and airport transfers.

17853.description: The Murat Hotel, a charming Parisian hotel in a beautifully renovated classic building, offers a delightful setting for both business trips and Parisian holidays. Its 28 warmly decorated rooms provide all the necessary comforts for a pleasant stay. Centrally located, it's just minutes from Roland Garros stadium and the Seine's romantic banks, with convenient public transport access to Paris's financial district and major monuments, including the Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe. A €30 deposit may be required upon arrival.

17856.description: This pleasant hotel is located in the 17th arrondissement just a few minutes from many of the French capital's top sights, such as the Champs Elysees, Opera and Montmartre. Shopping and entertainment venues are also just a stone's throw away, and the nearest metro station is Pereire, a short walk away. Roissy Airport is about 30 km away and Orly 20 km. The 5-storey hotel offers 22 rooms, and facilities include an elegant foyer and a breakfast room on the first floor, with a lift, a public Internet terminal and a 24-hour reception desk. Each of the tasteful rooms comes with an en suite bathroom, a telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a minibar (for a fee) and wireless Internet connection (fee applies).

17858.description: Our hotel is ideally located Rue du Faubourg Saint Honoré, in a quiet and secure area. You are in the heart of luxury stores and the residences of ambassadors, 250 meters from the Madeleine, 300 meters from Place de La Concorde and close to the legendary Avenue des Champs-Elysées. Our 4-star establishment offers 98 renovated rooms in a contemporary style. Our reception service welcomes you 24/7. Close to all amenities, you can access the Concorde and Madeleine metro stations a 5-minute walk away and the emblematic Gare Saint Lazare station a 12-minute walk away. Welcome to one of the most luxurious streets in Paris!

17859.description:
This 4 star hotel is located in the suburbs of Milan and was established in 2004. 
800 metres from the Purple Line Bignami and 2 km from the Red line Sesto Rondò subway station, both connecting to Milan City Centre.
The MilanRe Hotel is far only 10 minute drive from Monza Circuit Autodromo.

17860.description: Enjoy a central Milan stay at Hotel Club, conveniently located a short drive from Piazza della Repubblica and Corso Como. This hotel offers 53 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring a minibar, LCD TV, and private balcony. A buffet breakfast is served daily (for a fee), and you can unwind with drinks at the bar/lounge. Amenities include Wi-Fi (surcharge), concierge services, room service, express check-in/out, and a 24-hour front desk. Nearby attractions include Piazza del Duomo and the Cathedral of Milan. The closest airport is Linate (LIN), while the preferred airport is Milan Malpensa (MXP).

17861.description: The Hotel is located in Corso Buenos Aires, one of the most important and lively shopping streets of Milan, just in front of the Metro Lima and only 10 minutes walking from Central Station. Situated in an elegant fully restored eighteenth century building, the hotel has 202 rooms among classic, superior, suite and family, each one individually designed with its own particular style, elegance and unique personality to make your stay as comfortable as ever before. The hotel is perfect for business and leisure guests, thanks to its many facilities offered. Enjoy a rich buffet breakfast with a wonderful view over Milan, in our restaurant La Terrazza. Start a new day or enjoy a full relax day in our wellness centre & spa with indoor swimming pool, sauna, Turkish bath and a beauty center with massages also available. Furthermore, there is free Wi-Fi, Chromecast in all rooms and a useful Internet Point and iPad Corner located in the lobby. On sunny days, you can enjoy a drink at our Cardiff Bar in the garden or relax on our rooftop terraces, perfect for sunbathing or for an aperitif with your friends. Upon request and at extra charge, garage, meeting center and special rooms for pets are available. We are a 100% non-smoking hotel. In case of pre-payment bookings, a tax receipt will be issued, unless otherwise requested. To issue an invoice, you must inform us by sending an e-mail with the following data (complete header, VAT and Univocal Code). This property has joined the Stay for the Planet project. It undertakes to manage the hotel activities in a sustainable manner by monitoring consumptions, reducing the presence of disposable plastic, taking energy efficiency actions for a positive impact on the environment.

17862.description: Located in Milan's Central Station area, Hotel Colombia is a short walk from Corso Buenos Aires and Piazza della Repubblica. This hotel offers guests a fitness center, a garden, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy a drink at the bar/lounge or a meal from the snack bar/deli. Room service is also available during limited hours. A buffet breakfast is offered daily (for a fee). The 48 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, satellite TV, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, and in-room safes. Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Piazza del Duomo is 1. 7 miles away, and the Cathedral of Milan is 2. 4 miles from the property.

17863.description: We are an elegant, four-star hotel in the heart of the world capital of fashion and design. Our central location is one of our most appealing features, making us an ideal destination for those looking for comfortable accommodations a few steps away from the Old Town. The rooms and common areas are furnished in a style inspired by Liberty, the refined architecture of Art Nouveau, and its major masterpieces. Our hotel is located in a nineteenth-century building that was once the residence of a noble Milanese family. We are within walking distance of the famous business and exhibition area, as well as one of Milan's most famous landmarks, the Sforzesco Castle. We look forward to welcoming you to our refined and charming environment.

17864.description: Boasting free private parking, free Wi-Fi and soundproofed rooms with air conditioning, Hotel Dei Fiori is 150 metres from Famagosta Metro Stop in south Milan. Direct metro links get to Milano Centrale Train Station in 15 minutes. Rooms at the 3-star Dei Fiori come with double-glazed windows, a flat-screen satellite TV, small safe and a minibar. An extensive buffet breakfast is available daily until 10:00. It can be included in your rate or added at the time of booking. There are many restaurants and bars in the area. Great public transport links are available to take you to the rest of Milan and its Exhibition and Conference centres. Bike storage is also offered on site

17865.description: Located in Milan's Fiera district, the upscale Hotel Oro Blu is a 4-minute walk from 24ORE Business School and 10 minutes from the Milan Convention Centre. This hotel offers 27 air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs, premium bedding, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy amenities such as a bar/lounge, room service (limited hours), a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Limited on-site parking is available. Nearby attractions include Fiera Milano City (1. 1 km) and CityLife Shopping District (1. 8 km). The preferred airport is Milan Malpensa (MXP).

17866.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services, a fireplace in the lobby, and a banquet hall. Grab a bite to eat at the Le Jardin Ampere, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view, or stay in and take advantage of room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Paris? This hotel has 1346 square feet (125 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 3 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 97 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have hair dryers and bathrobes. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Parc Monceau - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Salle Pleyel - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Palais des Congrès de Paris - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Bois de Boulogne - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Champs-Élysées - 1. 5 km / 1 mi- Boulevard Haussmann - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Arc de Triomphe - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Place Charles de Gaulle - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Avenue Georges V - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Place de Clichy - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Avenue Montaigne - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- Grands Boulevards - 2. 6 km / 1. 6 mi- Grand Palais - 2. 6 km / 1. 6 mi- Moulin Rouge - 2. 7 km / 1. 7 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 24. 3 km / 15. 1 miParis Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 31. 2 km / 19.

17867.description: This hotel is located in the centre of Paris, only a few steps from Garnier opera house. An abundance of shops, including the world famous department stores, Galeries Lafayette and Printemps, are within the vicinity. The nearest metro station is Chaussee d'Antin, located around 50 m away. Renovated in 2013, this hotel offers a total of 48 rooms spread over 5 floors. The hotel foyer possesses a 24-hour reception with a safe. The facilities include a lift, a breakfast room and Internet access. Guests may also use the laundry service available. The en suite rooms are equipped with a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, Flat Screen TV and a radio. They also include a double bed, modem Internet access and central heating. Guests are able to choose their breakfast from the buffet offered. It is possible to book Bed & Breakfast.

17874.description: This charming hotel is nestled in the heart of Amsterdam's museum district, mere steps from the renowned Van Gogh Museum and the upscale shops of P. C. Hooftstraat. The vibrant nightlife of Leidseplein is a short 5-minute walk away. Inspired by Van Gogh, the hotel's private rooms feature large wall murals, comfortable beds, climate control, flat-screen TVs, complimentary Nespresso machines, safes, and private bathrooms. Beyond the hotel's doorstep lies a wealth of cultural attractions, including the Rijksmuseum and numerous other must-see destinations.

17875.description: Hotel Internationaal is located in a historic street, a 5-minute walk from Amsterdam Central Station and Dam Square. There is free Wi-Fi and a maritime bar. The basic hotel rooms come with cable TV and have either a shared bathroom or private facilities. The Red Light District is only steps away. Tram stop Dam Square offers quick access to the Museumplein with the Van Gogh Museum in 10 minutes. The Café Internationaal was first used by sailors. It serves international beers in a traditional setting and sport events are shown on a large screen.

17876.description: The Campanile Amsterdam overlooks the scenic Gaasperpark on the outskirts of the city. A metro and bus station adjacent to the hotel offers convenient 24-hour access to the city center (25 minutes) and Bijlmer ArenA. Amsterdam offers much more than just the city center, so don't miss out on exploring other districts during your stay! The hotel's restaurant and bar, renovated in 2020, now feature a colorful, spacious lounge perfect for relaxing, dining, or socializing with friends and family. Refurbished guest rooms are equipped with a shower and hairdryer, along with a new, modern layout. We look forward to welcoming you!

17961.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace at Hotel Seehof, centrally located in Zürich. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel offers 20 guestrooms featuring minibars, flat-screen TVs with cable, complimentary wired and wireless internet, and bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Safes, desks, and phones with free international calls are also provided. Complimentary newspapers, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk are available. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). You'll be within a 5-minute drive of Bahnhofstrasse and the Swiss National Museum, and a short distance from attractions like the Zürich Opera House and Lakeside Promenade. Zurich Airport (ZRH) is 7. 9 miles away.

17971.description: With a stay at Hotel Regence Paris, you'll be centrally located in Paris, within a 5-minute drive of La Machine du Moulin Rouge and Palais Garnier. This hotel is 1. 3 mi (2. 2 km) from Champs-Élysées and 1. 9 mi (3 km) from Arc de Triomphe. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Make yourself at home in one of the 27 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Wireless Internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Place de Clichy - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- La Machine du Moulin Rouge - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Boulevard Haussmann - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Theatre Mogador - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Printemps Department Store - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi- Galeries Lafayette - 1. 2 km/0. 7 mi- Parc Monceau - 1. 3 km/0. 8 mi- Grands Boulevards - 1. 4 km/0. 9 mi- Palais Garnier - 1. 4 km/0. 9 mi- Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore - 1. 5 km/0. 9 mi- Paris Olympia - 1. 6 km/1 mi- Place de la Madeleine - 1. 6 km/1 mi- Place de l'Opéra - 1. 7 km/1 mi- Sacré-Cœur Basilica - 1. 8 km/1. 1 mi- Rue de Rivoli - 1. 8 km/1. 1 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 27. 3 km/17 mi Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 29. 3 km/18. 2 mi The preferred airport for Hotel Regence Paris is Paris Orly Airport (ORY).

17974.description: Centrally located in Berlin, Henri Hotel Berlin is a boutique hotel just a 3-minute walk from Kurfürstendamm and 13 minutes from the Berlin Zoo. It offers 68 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Each room includes a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. Guests can enjoy amenities such as bicycle rentals, concierge services, and a snack bar/deli. Room service is available during limited hours, and a bar/lounge offers a variety of drinks. Buffet breakfast is served weekdays for a fee. Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

17975.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, shopping on site, and a television in a common area. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 135 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and blackout drapes/curtains, and housekeeping is provided on request. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Kurfürstendamm - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Theatre of the West - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Europa Center - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Zoo Berlin - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Berlin Aquarium - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Kaufhaus des Westens - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Tiergarten Park - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Bauhaus Archive - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Nollendorfplatz - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Victory Column - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Deutsche Oper Berlin - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi- Bellevue Palace - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- Schoneberg City Hall - 2. 8 km / 1. 7 mi- Gleisdreieck Park - 3. 2 km / 2 mi. The nearest major airport is Berlin (BER-Brandenburg) - 28. 1 km / 17. 5 mi With a stay at acom Hotel Berlin Kurfürstendamm, you'll be centrally located in Berlin, steps from Kurfürstendamm and 8 minutes by foot from Zoo Berlin. This hotel is 2. 2 mi (3. 6 km) from Potsdamer Platz and 2. 7 mi (4. 3 km) from Brandenburg Gate.

17980.description: This pleasant and welcoming hotel occupies a former palace from the 17th century and is located directly in the heart of the city. The hotel staff is nice, friendly and always ready to make sure your stay is an enjoyable one. Guests can explore the St Mark's square which lies at only 50 metres away. Built in the XVII century, the hotel comprises a total of 48 rooms set over four floors. Facilities on offer include a welcoming foyer with reception desk and bar. There is a restaurant serving culinary delicacies and a laundry service is also available. The cosy and relaxing rooms all come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone. Other commodities include satelliteTV, centrally regulated air conditioning and a hire safe.

17981.description: Sylter Hof Berlin is located in the city centre, close to many of Berlin’s main attractions. Zoologischer Garten underground station is less than 1 km away, and Kurfürstendamm can be reached within 1. 9 km. The rooms include air conditioning, a private bathroom with a bathtub and hairdryer, a work desk, carpeted floors, and a TV. Wardrobes and free WiFi are also provided. A continental buffet breakfast is served daily, featuring local specialities, warm dishes, juices, cheeses, and fruits. Vegetarian and gluten-free options are available. The property offers a lift, an electric vehicle charging station, luggage storage, and paid private parking on site. The reception staff speak German and English.

17982.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 indoor swimming pools, a health club, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services, gift shops/newsstands, and a hair salon. Grab a bite at emil´s Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Berlin? This hotel has 12917 square feet (1200 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 158 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions.

name.content: Hôtel le Derby Alma by Inwood Hotels

18004.description: This haute-couture hotel is located in the heart of the capital of fashion, only a few steps from the Eiffel Tower and the Champs-Elysées. Come experience a moment out of time in this luxurious and beautiful custom-made hotel, perfect for fashion lovers. The Derby Alma is a charming hotel under the influence of Designers' Art of Living. Great Parisian designers as well as design and experience studios have inspired this hotel.

18005.description: This friendly hotel enjoys a perfect location in the centre of Paris, only a short stroll from the École Militaire, Champ de Mars and the iconic Eiffel Tower. Trocadéro and Invalides are within easy reach and the nearest metro station is just 600 metres away, providing direct access to Opéra Garnier and the whole city. The hotel features a beautiful lobby with 24-hour reception and concierge service. Guests can wake up to a delightful breakfast in the breakfast room and after a long day of sightseeing, relax with a drink in the sophisticated bar and lounge. The rooms are smart and chic, and all come equipped with modern amenities such as cable television and wireless internet access.

18006.description: Enjoy a central Paris location at Hotel Petit Saint Honoré, just a 7-minute walk from the Champs-Élysées and 14 minutes from the Palais Garnier. This hotel offers 19 guestrooms equipped with smart TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a continental breakfast (available for a fee), and take advantage of amenities such as a computer station, complimentary newspapers, and a 24-hour front desk. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel is also conveniently located near attractions like La Machine du Moulin Rouge and the Arc de Triomphe.

18007.description: Enjoy a central Paris location at Hôtel Mathis, steps from Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore and a short walk from the Champs-Élysées. This upscale hotel offers 25 individually decorated guestrooms with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a cooked-to-order breakfast (fee applies) at Café Coutume or enjoy snacks in the coffee shop. Amenities include concierge services, a hair salon, and dry cleaning. Airport and train station transfers are available for a surcharge.

18009.description: This hotel is located at the heart of Paris just a few minutes' walk from the Eiffel Tower and the Champs Elysées. The surrounding neighbourhood offers numerous shopping opportunities and restaurants. Further famous sightseeing attractions such as the Louvre, Notre Dame, Montmartre or the Eiffel Tower are about 2 km away. This beautiful hotel is entirely air-conditioned in the summer and it features a small inner garden and 30 well-appointed rooms with free WiFi. Guests have access to a small garden and there is a breakfast room. The pleasant rooms come with a bathroom and are well-equipped as standard. A breakfast buffet is offered daily and it includes bread and French pastries prepared on site. French and international restaurants can be found in the area, within walking distance. The reception will be happy to advise on excursions, theatre tickets and restaurants.

18010.description: The 4-star Mercure Paris Pigalle Sacre Coeur is a friendly and tranquil oasis in Pigalle. An upscale location in a renewal area, it celebrates the local art scene through its bright bedrooms. Fling your shutters wide each morning on the Sacre Coeur or the Paris rooftops. Book your bedroom with a view, and enjoy the room service. Sunbathe right in the hotel, on the veranda and terrace.

18011.description: This hotel boasts a charming setting at the heart of Paris. The hotel is conveniently located in close proximity to the wealth of attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. Guests will find themselves just 600 metres away from the Eiffel Tower. Paris Orly Airport, and Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport are located within easy driving distance of the hotel. The Dupleix metro station lies just a short distance from the hotel, offering ease of access to other areas of the city. This upscale hotel combines elegance and convenience. The guest rooms exude poise and character, and are well equipped with modern conveniences. Guests can enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

18012.description:
Citadines Sainte-Catherine Brussels is located in the heart of Brussels' Sainte-Catherine district, a vibrant area known for its trendy boutiques, diverse restaurants, exciting nightlife, and historic buildings. This prime location makes it an ideal base for exploring the city, with the Central Train Station and the famous Grand-Place, showcasing its stunning Flemish Baroque architecture, just a short distance away. The aparthotel offers 125 studios and 44 one-bedroom apartments, each featuring modern design and views of the garden, street, or square. Accommodations include wood flooring, a fully equipped kitchenette with a cooker hob, hood, refrigerator, microwave oven, dishwasher, and all necessary cookware and tableware. The en-suite bathrooms offer a bathtub/shower combination, hairdryer, and bath amenities. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as a business corner with computer and printer, complimentary Wi-Fi, a laundry room, on-site parking, a meeting room, and a cozy parlor with fireplace. Additional services include daily or weekly housekeeping, 24-hour laundry and dry cleaning, grocery and meal delivery, multilingual staff, and babysitting services. 
Please note that the residence is located within Brussels’ Low Emission Zone (LEZ). Certain vehicles may be subject to access restrictions and a daily pass may be required to enter the city centre. Please check your vehicle’s eligibility and find more information at www. lez. brussels

18014.description: This comfortable and contemporary appointed hotel is ideally situated right in the city centre of Geneva on a peaceful area between two green parks. This is the best accommodation choice to visit this amazing city as it is well connected with public transport links: Cornavin railway station is a mere 5 minutes' away. Business travellers will also appreciate the hotel's proximity to several international offices. All guest rooms are decorated in an exclusive and modern style in soothing and original colours and include a wide range of useful amenities for a truly unforgettable experience. They include a fully equipped, private bathroom and a flat screen television for guests to relax at the end of the day. Guests can keep updated thanks to the complimentary wireless Internet connection and start the day with a comprehensive breakfast buffet.

18034.description: Located at just 2 minutes from Place de la Nation but away from its crowds, this hotel is the ideal place to stay, with easy access to all the city has to offer. Four metro lines and an RER line within a 5-minute walk guarantee that guests will be less than 25 minutes away from anywhere. While its location on a quiet street and a charming garden, where on fine days one can enjoy the delicious buffet breakfast, will help with relaxing and having a splendid time while visiting Paris. The neighbourhood offers some of the best restaurants and coffee shops one can find, so it is always worth venturing for a short stroll around in order to find just the perfect place.

18035.description: This wonderful and renovated hotel is ideally situated at the heart of the stunning city of Paris. The hotel is located in the Drouot district of the city, with many renowned attractions within easy access. This hotel enjoys close proximity to a number of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby, offering ease of access to other areas to be explored. The hotel features an attractive design, oozing classical charm and grace. The guest rooms provide a comfortable setting in which to completely unwind. The hotel offers a number of facilities and services, for guests' convenience.

18036.description: Located in one of the most popular areas of Paris, the hotel is right in the heart of Saint Germain des Pres and the Latin Quarter. This typically Parisian elegant hotel is close to the boutiques, cafes, relaxing bars and tempting restaurants that make this area so sought after. The Louvre, Jardin du Luxembourg and Notre-Dame Cathedral are all within a short pleasant walk from the hotel. All air-conditioned rooms are elegantly furnished to a very high standard and offer a relaxing stay in the French capital. Charm, location and relaxing ambience make this the perfect choice for that special trip!

name.content: ibis Styles Paris Place d'Italie Butte aux Cailles

18037.description: Set in the heart of the Butte-aux-Cailles district, a stone's throw from Chinatown and close to public transport links and stores, the entire team at the ibis Styles Paris Place d'Italie - Butte Aux Cailles welcomes you to a modern, fully renovated setting. Located near the metro, you are within easy reach of the Eiffel Tower, Champs Elysées, Arc de Triomphe, Louvre and the Latin and Marais districts. Every train station in Paris has direct links to the Place d'Italie.

18039.description: The Hotel Jardin Des Plantes offers a comfortable stay in the heart of Paris, just steps from the Jardin des Plantes and a short drive from Luxembourg Gardens. Enjoy the convenience of complimentary Wi-Fi, a terrace with scenic views, and a welcoming reception hall. Each of the 33 guestrooms features an espresso maker, a flat-screen television with satellite programming, and a Select Comfort bed with premium bedding. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. The nearest airports are Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) and Paris Orly (ORY).

18040.description: Welcome to our 3-star hotel nestled in the heart of the 18th arrondissement of Paris, on an emblematic square in the Montmartre district. Our exceptional location plunges you into the heart of the district of painters, artists, cabarets and traditional French restaurants, creating an atmosphere of unique charm. Just a few minutes from Sacré-Coeur and close to the famous Moulin Rouge, our 59-room hotel offers you an authentic Parisian experience. Air conditioning, luggage storage and 24-hour staff are on hand to make your stay as pleasant as possible. Some of our rooms offer breathtaking views over the rooftops of Paris, the Eiffel Tower or the Sacré-Coeur, adding a touch of magic to your stay. For an even more exclusive experience, discover our magnificent 26m2 Suite on the top floor. Our common areas have been completely renovated to create a welcoming and elegant space. Ideally located for leisure stays, our hotel offers you the opportunity to experience the charm of the most typical Paris. Book now for an unforgettable getaway in the French capital.

18041.description: This striking city hotel is located between the Eiffel Tower and Les Invalides. The UNESCO headquarters are nearby. There are also plenty of shopping and entertainment opportunities located close to the hotel, around 1 km away. Orly airport is roughly 12 km away and Charles de Gaulle is 30 km from the hotel.
