The inviting hotel consists of 2 4-storey buildings with a total of 19 rooms, of which 8 are suites. The hotel includes a reception open 24 hours, a lift and a safe, as well as a TV room, room and laundry service available for guests' use. The comfortable rooms come with an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, Internet access, a hire safe and a minibar. Air conditioning and heating are individually regulated.

18042.description: This lovely hotel is situated 15 minutes away from the Opera. The stations Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est are just a 10-min walk from the hotel. The famous Eurostar runs from here to London and other European destinations. Further facilities include a comfortable salon with sofas and Internet access point and a breakfast room. The elegant rooms include en suite bathroom facilities with a hairdryer and all the essential amenities to make a pleasant stay. A breakfast buffet is available every morning. There are 3 metro stations in the area surrounding the hotel: Bonne Nouvelle (lines 8 and 9), Poissonière (line 7) and Chateau d'Eau (line 4). All offer guests easy access to Paris's many attractions.

18049.description: 'The Hotel Elysées Céramic, located in Paris's elegant 8th Arrondissement, is a short walk from the Champs-Élysées and Arc de Triomphe. This hotel offers 57 guestrooms with minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast for a fee and relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include a terrace, fireplace in the lobby, and tour/ticket assistance. The Eiffel Tower and Moulin Rouge are within a short distance. Nearby airports include Charles de Gaulle (CDG) and Orly (ORY). '

18074.description: This luxurious hotel is ideally situated in the outskirts of the city of Paris, in the Levallois-Perret business district. The property is located in a green area and allows its guests to access in a convenient manner to Paris downtown, having a nearby station called Pont de Levallois-Becon. All the establishment’s guest rooms are tastefully appointed and offer splendid views. They boast a comfortable look which is based on Asian and European decorative styles. The establishment is well equipped with a large car park for those travelling with their own vehicle and offers other useful facilities such as a fitness centre with a sauna and a relaxation room to relax after a long day of sightseeing or doing business.

18075.description: Welcome to the Best Western Select Hotel, at the doors to the capital, Paris. We welcome you to a pleasant setting for your professional or tourist stays, located in the city centre of Boulogne-Billancourt, only 15 minutes from Champs-Elysées Avenue by subway (line 9). On the other side, if you want to have rest and peace in the heart of the countryside, you are just a few steps off the Bois de Boulogne and Parc de Saint Cloud. For leisure, you are next to major places, such as Le Parc des Princes for major league football matches, or Roland Garros, for International Tennis Championships (end of May, beginning of June, every year). For your business, many major companies have established their head offices in Boulogne, such as Renault, Alcatel, and Alsthom. We offer 62 fully-equipped bedrooms with air-conditioning, bathroom/shower, direct dial phone, cable television (12 channels), hairdryer, mini-bar and private safe. A private car park is also at your disposal. Enjoy your stay.

18076.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at this Courbevoie hotel, including complimentary Wi-Fi, a TV in the common area, and tour/ticket assistance. Start your day with a continental breakfast, available for a fee from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. A computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a 24-hour front desk are also provided. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Each of the 25 guestrooms features a minibar, LED TV, and private bathroom with a rainfall showerhead and hairdryer. Safes and desks are also provided for your convenience. Located in the heart of Courbevoie, Hôtel La Régence is steps from La Défense and a short drive from Paris La Défense Arena. The hotel is also within easy reach of iconic Parisian landmarks, including the Arc de Triomphe (3. 5 mi) and the Champs-Élysées (3. 6 mi).

18078.description: Located in the heart of Neuilly-sur-Seine, just minutes from La Défense, this hotel offers convenient access to central Paris within 10 minutes. The Pont de Neuilly ligne 1 , metro station is a mere 100 meters away, connecting guests to various shopping venues, boutiques, bars, and restaurants nearby. Orly and Charles de Gaulle airports are approximately 20 km and 25 km away, respectively. Renovated in 2003, this three-story hotel features 37 well-equipped rooms, each with an en suite bathroom. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast each morning and utilize amenities such as the 24-hour reception desk, safe, and lifts. On-site parking is also available.

18079.description: Elegantly modernized in 2015, our hotel is perfectly situated near the Avenue des Champs-Élysées, the La Défense business center, and the Louis Vuitton Foundation, just 50 meters from the Metro. The décor is sleek and contemporary, and our spacious accommodations offer air conditioning, soundproofing, Wi-Fi, TVs, minibars, and modern bathrooms with showers or bathtubs. Enjoy a relaxing break in our lounge's wine bar. Our 24-hour front desk provides express check-in/check-out and concierge service to meet your every need.

18080.description: Nestled in the peaceful Neuilly-sur-Seine district, this hotel offers convenient access to central Paris and its iconic attractions, including the Arc de Triomphe (approximately 2. 5 km away). Orly and Charles de Gaulle airports are both within a 30-minute transfer. The seven-story hotel features 34 comfortably furnished rooms, each with an en-suite bathroom with a hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, and a double bed. Guests can also enjoy room service and a daily continental breakfast. The hotel provides a reception desk and lift access. Public transport options include Metro Line 1 (Porte Maillot/Les Sablons), RER C (Porte Maillot), and the Air France shuttle bus. By car, the hotel is easily accessible from the ring road (Porte Maillot exit).

18102.description: Situated in the very centre of Venice in one of the trendiest areas of the city, the charming and cosy Guest House Palazzo La Scala enjoys a perfect setting surrounded by art galleries, restaurants and the Fenice Theatre. World-famous sites such as the Rialto Bridge, the Grand Canal or the Saint Mark's Square with the impressive Basilica, the Doges Palace and the Bridge of Sighs are just a 5-minute stroll away. The small, renovated Guest House exudes an air of luxury and timeless elegance, blending historic details with modern day amenities. The beautifully appointed rooms are decorated with antique walnut furniture and rich fabrics. They feature a range of services and amenities including air-conditioning, satellite LCD TV and complimentary wireless internet access. This enchanting structure is the perfect choice for a romantic getaway in the world's most romantic city.

18104.description: The tranquil neighbourhood. Venice is a fairy-tale of a city with palaces, cathedrals and museums to take your breath away. In our neighbourhood you can get your breath back again. It’s a place where you can escape the noise and bustle, experience genuine local life, and feel refreshed. This is a neighbourhood of true tranquillity. At the heart of the neighbourhood is Hotel Indigo® Venice - Sant'Elena, a converted 1930s monastery where a peaceful inner sanctuary offers further respite from the bustle. Our neighbours include the elegant red-brick Gothic church of Sant’Elena, built by Augustinian monks in the 11th century and known for its lofty landmark belltower. Important note about Dinner Bed and Breakfast rate: fully flexible rate includes breakfast and three course dinner from set menu or buffet in a designated hotel restaurant for one or two resident adults sharing a room.

18121.description: The centrally located Hotel Rali offers thirty-eight rooms, including three suites, across three floors. Guests enjoy 24-hour reception, a currency exchange, and safe. Amenities include a coffee bar, bar, game room, TV room, and conference facilities. Parking, room service, and laundry services are also available. Each comfortable room features air conditioning, a private bathroom, direct-dial telephone, safe, radio, and satellite/cable TV. Guests can also enjoy a game of billiards.

18194.description: Situated in the heart of Amsterdam, this hotel offers convenient access to the vibrant Leidseplein with its diverse cafes and restaurants. Guests can easily explore nearby attractions such as Vondelpark, Museum Square, and the Concert Hall. Housed within three historic townhouses, the hotel features elegantly designed rooms providing a tranquil retreat after a day of sightseeing. Rich blues complement crisp whites, creating a relaxing atmosphere. For those seeking outdoor activities, Vondelpark offers charming walks and bicycle paths. Guests can also enjoy a daily breakfast buffet.

name.content: Leonardo Eden Hotel Amsterdam City Center

18195.description: This charming hotel is located in the heart of Amsterdam, near Amstel, approx. 16 km from Schiphol Airport. Rembrandt Square, the famous flower market, a myriad of museums, shops, taverns and nightclubs are all 100 meters from the immediate vicinity. The public transport system allows easy and convenient access to the parts of the city that are further away. The multi-story building has facilities including a 24-hour reception, excellent friendly service personnel, lobby, elevator, bar / brasserie, as well as a restaurant where guests can enjoy delicious dishes. The hotel also offers Internet access, room and laundry services. The cozy rooms have an interior bathroom along with various amenities as well as the necessary appliances for a comfortable stay.

name.content: Leonardo Boutique Hotel The Lancaster Amsterdam

18196.description: This impressive monumental building, brimming with character, sits opposite Amsterdam's Artis Royal Zoo in a verdant area of the city center, close to a thriving scene of shops, restaurants, pubs, and clubs. Conveniently located near public transport, the hotel is also just 15 km from Schiphol International Airport. The nearby Rembrandt and Waterloo districts offer further exploration. Each morning, the hotel restaurant serves a breakfast buffet featuring hot and cold dishes. Guest rooms provide comfortable beds and high-quality furnishings, ensuring a relaxing weekend break.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London - Vauxhall Nine Elms

18223.description: A modern London hotel with free WiFi and breakfast included, plus easy access to London's sights and businessesHoliday Inn Express® London - Vauxhall Nine Elms hotel lies south of the River Thames, in central London. It's half a mile from Vauxhall station, where you can hop on a Victoria Line Tube to Victoria or Oxford Circus or catch an overland train to London Waterloo. Buses to Parliament Square stop near the hotel. London City Airport (LCY) is less than 10 miles away, and it's 18 miles to Heathrow Airport (LHR). Limited parking is available. Business guests are within easy reach of meetings, convention centres and exhibitions in the capital. The hotel's bright,  spacious lobby makes a good working space for informal meetings, with the hotel staff on hand to assist with photocopying and printing. The hotel is just four Tube stops from shoppers' heaven on Oxford Street. Half an hour's walk along the river takes you to the London Eye for panoramic city views, while a stroll over Vauxhall Bridge brings you to Tate Britain's exhibitions in 20 minutes. It's just over a mile from the hotel to concerts at the O2 Academy Brixton and a 15-minute walk to cricket at The Oval, and a 12 min walk to American Embassy. Use free WiFi to plan your day's activities over the inclusive Express Start Breakfast featuring scrambled eggs, sausages, bacon, croissants, Porridge, cereals.

18224.description: The hotel is situated around 3 km from the city centre, on the outskirts of Birmingham, with shopping opportunities, nightclubs and bars lying 2. 4 km away. Birmingham airport is a short distance away, only 14 km. The nearest train station is Birmingham New Street, which is around 2. 4 km away. The hotel includes its own professionally landscaped garden. The 24-hour reception, bar and the conservatory were modernised in summer 2006. Conference facilities are available. The restaurant offers a typical English meat buffet as well as an à la carte menu. The comfortable rooms come with an en suite bathroom and are well-equipped as standard. The well-tended grounds include a sun terrace. Guests may select their typical English breakfast and evening meals from varied (meat) buffets. Lunch and dinner may be selected from the menu. Snacks are available the whole day from the lounge menu.

18242.description: This boutique hotel is nestled in the historical old town of Zurich just 5 minutes' walk from Lake Zurich and the famous shopping arcade, Bahnhofstrasse. Travellers may stroll through the old town where abundance of theatres, museums, galleries, as well as the old guild houses are to be found. Links to the public transport network lie at the hotel doorstep and countless dining options, shopping venues and vibrant nightlife. The city hotel boasts elegant and well-equipped rooms. A delicious breakfast buffet offers a wide range of choices to energize one's day and throughout the day guests may sample the flavourful French culinary delights at the in-house restaurant. Patrons may unwind in the delightfully decorated lobby and library or sip a drink from the welcoming bar, while corporate travellers may avail for a well-equipped business centre siting up to 6 people.

18262.description: Located in Berlin's vibrant Schöneberg district, near the historic town hall, this 4-star hotel offers 31 well-equipped rooms. Guests enjoy easy access to countless parks, cultural attractions, excellent restaurants, bars, and shopping, all within walking distance. Public transport, including an underground station and bus stop, are also conveniently nearby. Each comfortable room features an en-suite bathroom with a hairdryer, satellite/cable TV, a minibar, a safe, and central heating. The hotel also provides a welcoming foyer, guest safe, lifts, and a dedicated non-smoking area.

18266.description: 'Stay at the Hôtel International & Terminus in downtown Geneva, featuring a fitness center, terrace, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy a meal at La Véranda restaurant or a buffet breakfast (fee applies). The hotel offers 63 guestrooms with fireplaces and flat-screen TVs with satellite programming. Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk. You'll be within a 5-minute drive of the Jet d'Eau Fountain and the United Nations European Headquarters. '

name.content: The Originals City, Hôtel Paix République, Paris

18272.description: Conveniently located in Paris' 10th arrondissement and just steps from the bustling Republique station, this charming city hotel is the perfect Paris base for sightseers as well as those who are travelling on business. Notre Dame Cathedral, Centre Pompidou and the Louvre are within walking distance, and easy access to the metro provides guests with quick connections to all of the city's sights and attractions. Hotel lift will be out of order for refurbishment from 2nd of November to 27th of December 2021 included. Guests are warmly welcomed in the classic lobby and sitting area, and the comfortable guest rooms are tastefully decorated and feature modern comforts such as Wi-Fi internet access, cable and satellite television, air-conditioning. Guests can wake up to breakfast served right in the room or venture down to the buffet breakfast served daily in the breakfast room. This hotel's great service and excellent location make for a pleasant stay in the City of Light.

18280.description: The elegant Doria Grand Hotel is ideally located in the heart of Milan, on a peaceful, tree-lined, traffic-restricted avenue. Loreto and Corso Buenos Aires, the longest shopping street in the world with fashionable shops and exclusive designer boutiques, are just steps away. The metro station is close by, providing easy access to other areas of the city, and the central train station is within a 5-minute walk. Guests are welcomed into a sophisticated environment, decorated in an early twentieth-century style. The luxurious rooms are excellently appointed with mahogany furniture and white Carrara marble bathrooms. Business guests will appreciate complimentary Wi-Fi, along with meeting and exhibition facilities featuring state-of-the-art equipment. The restaurant serves Italian and international dishes, as well as delicious homemade desserts, and guests can enjoy a drink in the elegant Jazz Club. A perfect place to experience Milan in style.

18323.description: Head straight for the casino, or wait for that lucky feeling while you enjoy one of the other recreational opportunities, such as a sauna and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features concierge services, gift shops/newsstands, and a fireplace in the lobby. Grab a bite at Brasserie Courtyard, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge and a garden view. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Hoofddorp? This hotel has 12336 square feet (1146 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 10 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge at scheduled times. Make yourself at home in one of the 260 air-conditioned rooms featuring espresso makers.

18330.description: IT027042A1VDIM9JV3A frame overlooking Venice with all the elegance and the efficiency of a 4 star hotel and its spacious and charming rooms. All of the new executive rooms offer a magnificent panoramic view over the islands and the lagoon. Located between Venice Marco Polo Airport (3 km - 1. 86 miles) and Venice city centre (10 minutes), it's just 3 minutes away from San Giuliano Park. Antony Hotel features 114 large and spacious rooms, of which 30 family rooms with 2 king size beds. Particularly loved by families, both for the outdoor/indoor playground and the attention reserved to the 'little' guests. Available to the guests: free wireless internet in the whole building, an excellent restaurant, a bar with typical Venetian appetizers, a meeting room for up to 90 persons and a small day office. City tax has to be paid to the hotel.

18332.description: Just 492 feet from Venezia Mestre Train Station, the 3-star City of Art Venice Lloyd offers modern rooms with air conditioning. The hotel features a hall and restaurant displaying sculptures and pieces of art. Rooms here come with a flat-screen TV, tiled floors and a safe. The private bathroom includes free toiletries and a hairdryer. A continental-style buffet breakfast is served each morning at the Venice Lloyd, while the 24-hour bar is always available for drinks and snacks. Set in the Marghera district, this hotel is a 10-minute bus ride from Venice’s center and 8. 7 mi from Venice Marco Polo Airport. A luggage deposit can be booked at the partner hotel with 24-hour reception, located across the road.

18333.description: A luxury hotel just steps from San Marco Square, is as elegant as the city itself. After a day exploring, this contemporary hotel is the ideal sanctuary: calm and comfortable, yet infused with Italian hospitality. It's no wonder it's often acclaimed as one of the best hotels in Venice. Like the city itself, the rooms are a mixture of styles, but all capture the essence of a romantic Venice holiday. Blending contemporary comforts with details that reflect classic Venetian character, each room has a light, elegant atmosphere, with many offering wonderful views over canals and the Venice skyline with its magnificent San Marco's bell tower in the horizon. The restaurant is popular with Venetians and tourists alike and serves classic dishes with a modern twist.

18336.description: The Inn on The Mile located on The Royal Mile in the heart of the city centre, offers an alternative boutique and luxury hotel experience in one of Edinburgh's most prestigious historic landmarks. Built in 1923 as the British Linen Bank, we have preserved, conserved and renovated our historical building into a place where you feel at home. Fully refurbished in 2013. A full Scottish and continental-style breakfast is served within The Inn on The Mile pub on the Royal Mile. Rooms at the hotel are situated across three floors and accessed by stairs only. If you require a lower floor please contact us directly in advance of your stay on 0131 556 9940.

18337.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 10 guestrooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Royal Botanic Garden - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Charlotte Square - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Georgian House - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- George Street - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Dean Village - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Assembly Rooms - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Princes Street - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Princes Street Gardens - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Johnnie Walker Princes Street - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Edinburgh Gin Distillery - 1. 7 km / 1 mi- Scottish National Gallery of Modern Art One - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- St. Andrew Square - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Western General - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Usher Hall - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Scottish National Gallery - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi. The preferred airport for The Raeburn is Edinburgh Airport (EDI) - 12. 9 km / 8 mi Located in Edinburgh (Stockbridge), The Raeburn is within a 5-minute drive of Princes Street Gardens and Royal Botanic Garden. This upscale hotel is 1. 1 mi (1. 8 km) from Scottish National Gallery of Modern Art One and 1. 4 mi (2. 3 km) from St. Giles' Cathedral.

18474.description: This charming establishment enjoys a convenient location in Paris, just a 5-minute walk from a wide of popular shopping venues including the world-renowned Lafayette shopping mall. The picturesque Montmartre district and all its lovely cafés are just 2 kilometres away while Charles de Gaulle and Orly International Airports are some 25 kilometres from this enchanting property. Saint Lazare railway station is 500 metres away and provides good rail links to the rest of the country. The soundproofed rooms have been fully-equipped and provide a functional design and a décor with neutral tones to create a relaxing atmosphere in which to completely unwind. Some of them also feature views to the interior garden. This comfortable hotel includes complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection as well as a pleasant patio where to enjoy a moment of relaxation after a busy day of work or sightseeing.

18496.description: Located in the heart of Paris, Hotel Central Saint Germain is within a 10-minute walk of the Panthéon and Luxembourg Gardens. This hotel is also conveniently close to iconic landmarks such as Notre Dame (0. 5 mi) and the Louvre Museum (1. 2 mi). Guests enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The hotel's 35 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions with satellite programming and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include safes, desks, and daily housekeeping. A snack bar/deli is available for a quick bite, and a buffet breakfast is served daily (for a fee) from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. The hotel also provides complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff.

18512.description: Novotel Athenes is the perfect hotel to live the authentic Greek experience in the heart of Athens. Relax and unwind in one of our 196 rooms. Food lovers will enjoy discovering international flavors at our restaurants. Savor 360° views of Athens and Acropolis from the roof terrace or re-energize in the gym and the outdoor pool during summer. For successful meetings, 8 flexible conference rooms will inspire you. Immerse yourself in Greek culture from our hotel near the city center, museums and monuments.

18521.description: The NH Vienna Airport Conference Center hotel, previously known as NH Wien Airport, is favorably located across from the arrivals hall of Vienna International Airport. As such, there are numerable transportation options close by, including a train station and bus and CAT stations. The Flugenhafen Wien is within walking distance and the hotel is approximately 16 minutes from the Historic Center of Vienna. Nearby shopping at Shopping City Süd and Naschmarkt are easily accessible via local transport. Our 499 soundproofed guest rooms have free Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and a minibar. Our larger upgraded rooms have additional features including connecting rooms, bathrobes, and Nespresso machines. Each morning guests are treated to a breakfast buffet and made-to-order hot dishes are available upon request. The in-hotel Restaurant Mundo offers national and international cuisine for lunch or dinner, including the traditional Wiener Schnitzel. An additional buffet restaurant offers more extensive self-serve dishes. On the ground floor, guests can grab a quick cocktail or unwind a while at The Bar which offers light meals along with a large variety of beverages. Our 21 meeting rooms vary in size, and can hold up to 500 people.

18523.description: This hotel is located in the former Jewish quarter of the city, around 15 minutes away from the centre. A daily market as well as various shopping and entertainment venues as well as public transport connections are just a few steps away. Famous sightseeing attractions, such as the Piazza San Marco, the Rialto Bridge, and the Palace Ca' d'Oro are within a 15-minute walk. The city airport lies around 20 km away. The hotel was built in 1900 and includes an impressive old Venetian building, which features many of the original decorations and a total of 18 rooms. 24-hour check-in is possible at the reception in the hotel foyer and other facilities include a safe, a TV room and a café. Guests may enjoy a tasty meal in the air-conditioned restaurant, which has a separate non-smoking area. Room service is available, as is an Internet terminal. Guests may park their cars either in the hotel car park, or in the garage. Each room comes equipped with a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a minibar and a fridge. In addition, the rooms also include a lounge area, central heating and a safe. All rooms are carpeted and partially tiled. A breakfast buffet is available each morning.

18525.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A train station pick-up service is available for a surcharge. Make yourself at home in one of the 60 guestrooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Piazza della Repubblica - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Indro Montanelli Public Gardens - 0. 3 km / 0.

18526.description: Enjoy garden views at this 46-room hotel, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Additional amenities include a computer station, express check-in/out, and a TV in the common area. Shuttle service and self-parking are available (surcharge). Each guestroom offers a minibar, flat-screen TV with digital programming, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a bidet. Conveniently located near the San Siro Clinical Institute and Milan Convention Centre, the hotel provides easy access to shopping at CityLife and attractions like San Siro Stadium. Train station pick-up is available (surcharge).

18527.description: Enjoy a central Milan stay at Mokinba Hotels King, an 8-minute walk from Santa Maria delle Grazie and 12 minutes from Teatro alla Scala. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a bar/lounge. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) and utilize the convenient shuttle service (surcharge) for shopping trips. The 48 guestrooms feature minibars, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, and in-room safes. The hotel also provides express check-in/check-out and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Close to Piazzale Cadorna, Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, and other key attractions. Linate Airport is the closest airport.

18537.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a spa tub and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy local cuisine at Dungeon Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary English breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 35 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

18545.description:
Village Hotel Birmingham Dudley is just 8 miles from Birmingham city centre and 6 miles from Wolverhampton.   The hotel is handy for the M6, M5 and M42 motorway links with easy access to the whole of the West Midlands and for exploring the Black Country. 

The hotel has everything you'd need under one roof including new look, fully refurbished bedrooms with big cosy beds, huge TVs and great showers, pool and state-of-the-art gym with all the latest tech and Village Pub and Grill where you can tuck into delicious food and drink. 

Access to the Leisure facilities is charged at £5 per day per room. Club Room guests receive access free of charge. 

Parking charges apply Monday - Sunday, 24 hours a day
Parking is free for up to 4 hours Monday - Sunday
Parking is charged at £7. 50 for 24 hours then £7. 50 per day thereafter Monday - Thursday
Parking is charged at £5. 00 for 24 hours then £5. 00 per day thereafter Friday - Sunday

 Club Room guests park free for the duration of their stay.

name.content: La Clef Louvre Paris by The Crest Collection

18558.description: Located in the heart of Paris, next to the Louvre Museum, this apartment-style hotel offers exceptional views of Parisian monuments. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen with integrated washer and dryer, Nespresso machine, microwave, dishwasher, and cookware. Stay entertained with the iPod/iPad docking station and connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. Benefit from convenient amenities such as a fitness center and concierge service, all within a charming Parisian atmosphere.

18559.description:
Hôtel Warwick Champs-Élysées Paris enjoys a prime location in the heart of Paris’s 8th arrondissement, just steps from the Champs-Élysées and the Arc de Triomphe. Ideally situated for both business and leisure travelers, the hotel offers convenient access to major cultural attractions, business districts and luxury shopping areas. 

The hotel features elegant rooms and suites combining contemporary comfort with a refined Parisian atmosphere. All accommodations are equipped with air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen television, safe, minibar, as well as a courtesy tray with kettle and Nespresso machine. Bathrooms include welcome amenities, bathrobes and slippers for enhanced comfort. Some rooms offer open views over the Paris rooftops or feature a private balcony. 

Guests can enjoy a restaurant serving refined cuisine and a welcoming bar, suitable for business meetings or moments of relaxation. Breakfast is available daily, served as a buffet or in-room. 

For business stays and events, Hôtel Warwick Champs-Élysées Paris offers dedicated meeting spaces suitable for conferences, executive meetings and private events. Additional services include a 24-hour front desk, concierge service, room service and tailored hospitality services designed to meet the expectations of an international clientele. 

Combining a strategic location, attentive service and high-quality accommodation, Hôtel Warwick Champs-Élysées Paris is a preferred address for a successful stay in Paris.

18561.description: Situated on a peaceful street, near the lively Grands Boulevards and just a short walk from the Opéra district, the hotel offers a classy backdrop. The hotel sweeps guests up in the traditional Parisian world of Offenbach and Mistinguette. Guests can take advantage of the hotel's many services such as a buffet breakfast, room service, air conditioning throughout and free wireless Internet access. With a total of 31 guest rooms, the establishment welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. Furthermore, a hotel safe, cloakroom, a newspaper stand and a TV lounge are provided. Guests may dine in the café or breakfast and dining room, and sip their favourite drink in the bar. The comfortable rooms come with a bathroom and are all well-equipped as standard. The rooms also feature a balcony or terrace.  A continental breakfast buffet is served each morning.

18562.description: Near the Champ de Mars, beloved by Parisians, and in the shadow of the Eiffel Tower, this aparthotel enjoys an exceptional location in one of Paris's most residential districts. In the Front de Seine district, the Beaugrenelle shopping center boasts 45, 000 sq m of shops, restaurants, and leisure attractions. Stroll along the banks of the Seine, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and admire the Parisian monuments. This 3-star establishment offers 104 air-conditioned apartments across seven floors: 84 studios for one or two people, and 20 one-bedroom apartments for up to four. Studios feature sofa beds, while one-bedroom apartments offer both sofa beds in the lounge area and a double bed in the bedroom. Each studio and apartment includes a bathroom with a hairdryer (one-bedroom apartments have separate toilets) and a fully equipped kitchen with a stove, microwave/grill, dishwasher, and fridge. All apartments have hi-fi systems, flat-screen TVs with satellite channels, safes, direct-line phones with voicemail and fax facilities. Linen and towels are provided and changed weekly, free of charge. Additional housekeeping is available upon request for a fee. Eight apartments are equipped for guests with reduced mobility. Located in the former village of Grenelle, near UNESCO, government offices at Place de Fontenoy, the dynamic Quai André Citroën, Quai Branly, and Porte de Versailles exhibition parks, this Citadines property is at the center of a vibrant hub. Nearby, a bustling marketplace and numerous cafes and brasseries offer quintessential Parisian charm.

18563.description: Built in 1928, Le Royal Monceau - Raffles Paris reopened in 2010 as the most exciting luxury hotel in Paris, after a complete two-year transformation by designer Philippe Starck. In 2013, the property’s “Palace” distinction was given, rewarding the hotel of its prestigious 5-star excellence rating. Located near the Champs-Elysées in Paris' 8th arrondissement, Le Royal Monceau – Raffles Paris, is known for its contemporary vibe and as a rendezvous for artists and writers as well as luxury seekers and adventurers. The omnipresent artistic and vibrant culture comes to life through the property’s exclusive Art Concierge, the Art Bookstore, an Art Gallery, a 99-seat Katara Cinema and an impressive private Art collection. With its 149 Parisian designed bedrooms and spacious suites, including 3 Presidential Suites, the only contemporary Palace in Paris is only steps from the Arc de Triomphe. Acclaimed for its international culinary offerings, the hotel’s award-winning restaurants showcase the property’s creative spirit, from the sweet symphony by Chef and Entrepreneur Yazid Ichemrahen, to the effervescence of ‘Le Bar Long’ and its three restaurants: ‘Matsuhisa Paris’, dedicated to Japanese-Peruvian gastronomy from the famous Chef Nobu and ‘Il Carpaccio’, a Michelin-starred Italian restaurant in collaboration with Da Vittorio family. Not to be missed are the outstanding brunches and breakfasts at ‘La Cuisine’ restaurant. Furthermore, the 1, 500sqm Raffles Spa & Wellness is an award-winning paradise, featuring one of the longest swimming pool of a Parisian Palace.

18569.description: The Citadines Trocadero Paris ApartHotel welcomes you to the prestigious 16th arrondissement, steps from the Eiffel Tower. This charming district, filled with public gardens, offers a pleasant atmosphere and easy access to iconic attractions like the Guimet Museum, Paris Aquarium, and the Museum of Man. The Eiffel Tower is a mere five-minute walk, while the Champs-Élysées is a leisurely 15-minute stroll. Here, you can marvel at the panoramic views from atop the Eiffel Tower and admire the Arc de Triomphe at the Place de l'Étoile. This stylish and elegant ApartHotel is entirely non-smoking and features on-site parking (for small to medium-sized cars), a business center with computer access, a laundry room, accessible facilities, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Services include weekly housekeeping, laundry, dry cleaning, and pressing. Accommodations range from studios for two to three-room apartments for up to six guests, each equipped with a modern kitchen and air conditioning. The Citadines Trocadero Paris also maintains high hygiene and cleanliness standards through its Ascott Cares program, ensuring a safe environment for both guests and staff.

18570.description: The ibis Paris Porte d'Orléans in Montrouge is ideally located for business or tourism. This 3-star hotel can be accessed by the Mairie de Montrouge metro, the A6 highway and the Porte d'Orléans ring road. It is close to Paris, Orly and Charles de Gaulle airports and Montparnasse train station. Enjoy the Courtepaille restaurant, free WIFI, a bar and payable private car park. Discover Paris, the Eiffel Tower, the Montparnasse area and the exhibition center while enjoying the peacefulness of Montrouge.

18572.description:
A stay at Citadines Les Halles Paris places you in the heart of Paris, within a 15-minute walk of Notre-Dame and Louvre Museum. This 4-star aparthotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 4 km) from Centre Pompidou and 1. 8 mi (2. 9 km) from Palais Garnier. Make yourself at home in our adaptable spaces, with a fully equipped kitchen, high-speed Wi-Fi, Chromecast TV, and air conditioning, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Stay active in the fitness room, get work done in the coworking space, and enjoy added convenience with a launderette, public parking, and a pet-friendly policy. 
The nearest metro station is Châtelet Les Halles, with the closest exit being Exit 1, “Place Marguerite de Navarre. ”

name.content: Prince De Galles, A Luxury Collection Hotel

18573.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a ballroom. Enjoy French cuisine at Bar 19. 20, a bar/lounge where you can take in the garden view and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Make yourself at home in one of the 159 guestrooms featuring espresso makers and flat-screen televisions. Your memory foam bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Avenue Georges V - 0. 1 km / 0.

name.content: Citadines Bastille Gare De Lyon Paris

18575.description:
The Citadines Bastille Gare de Lyon Paris Aparthotel immerses you in the heart of Paris's 12th arrondissement. Explore charming boutiques tucked away on side streets or enjoy a glamorous evening at the Bastille Opera. The Bastille-Gare-de-Lyon district caters to diverse interests. Begin your day with a stroll through Cour St-Emilion, where shops and bars now occupy Paris's former wine merchants' quarter. A local favorite, the Aligre Market offers a vibrant tapestry of traditional Parisian life. Take a refreshing walk through the Parc de Bercy or along the Coulée Verte, a former railway line transformed into a verdant promenade. For evening entertainment, choose from classical melodies at the Paris Opera or a rock-n-roll concert at the Bercy Arena. Ascott Cares ensures your well-being with nine commitments to hygiene, cleanliness, and safe distancing, providing a safe environment for guests and staff. 

Citadines Bastille Gare Lyon is getting a makeover from January 5, 2026, for 11 months and will remain open during the renovation works.

18576.description: With a stay at Hôtel Observatoire Luxembourg, you'll be centrally located in Paris, just a 3-minute walk from Luxembourg Gardens and 10 minutes by foot from Panthéon. This 4-star hotel is 1. 4 mi (2. 2 km) from Notre-Dame and 1. 6 mi (2. 6 km) from Louvre Museum. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 41 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. At Hôtel Observatoire Luxembourg, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Luxembourg Gardens - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Sorbonne University - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Panthéon - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Rue Mouffetard - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi- Paris Catacombs - 1. 3 km/0. 8 mi- Jardin des Plantes - 1. 4 km/0. 9 mi- Île de la Cité - 1. 4 km/0. 9 mi- Sainte-Chapelle - 1. 6 km/1 mi- Le Bon Marche - 1. 6 km/1 mi- Pont Neuf - 1. 6 km/1 mi- Notre-Dame - 1. 6 km/1 mi- Tour Montparnasse - 1. 8 km/1. 1 mi- Île Saint-Louis - 1. 9 km/1. 2 mi- Hôtel de Ville - 1. 9 km/1. 2 mi- Rue de Rivoli - 2. 1 km/1. 3 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 14. 4 km/8. 9 mi Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 37. 8 km/23. 5 mi The preferred airport for Hôtel Observatoire Luxembourg is Paris Orly Airport (ORY).

18577.description: Enjoy a central Paris stay at My Home in Paris Hotel, just a short walk from Canal Saint-Martin and Place de la République. This hotel offers 28 guestrooms featuring minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with bathrobes and slippers. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, a coffee shop, a bar/lounge, and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Nearby attractions include Place des Vosges and Rue de Rivoli.

18597.description: The Best Western Amsterdam is located in Amsterdam West District, just off the A10 City Ring. In 20 minutes you can reach the old city center by public transport. The hotel features a private parking space, 24 hour reception desk, a bar and terrace. The rooms of the Best Western Amsterdam have en suite bathrooms with a shower, toilet and free toiletries. Other room amenities include a television, safe and work desk. Every morning an international breakfast buffet is served in the restaurant of the hotel. In the evening the restaurant is open and during the night a selection of pizzas is served. The in-house bar features a lounge area with televisions and a billiards table. If offers several snacks and a wide variety of beverages. As soon as the weather is nice guests can enjoy a drink on the terrace. From the Best Western Amsterdam, the city center can easily be reached by using public transportation. The RAI Convention Centre, World Fashion Centre and World Trade Centre are 15 minutes away by the Metro.

18662.description: The Atlantic Hotel Milan, just a few steps from Central Station, is the ideal place for those coming to Milan for business or family holiday. From the hotel all points of interest in Milan can be easily reached, among which: Piazza Duomo, Castello Sforzesco, Teatro alla Scala, the Fashion District, Corso Buenos Aires (the famous longest shopping street in Europe) the Last Supper by Leonardo da Vinci, the Fair Area of Rho - Pero (Expo 2015) and the district of Fiera Milano City, the new MiCo Congress Center and Meazza Stadium, also known as San Siro. In addition, if you arrive in Milan by plane, a comfortable bus services connects you to the airports of Malpensa, Linate and Orio al Serio. The terminal arrival and departure of the buses is located 100 meters from the Best Western Milan Hotel. The underground stop Centrale FS (Metro M2-3) is located 50 metres from the hotel.

18668.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for dinner at PanEVO Restaurant, a restaurant which specializes in Regional cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to noon for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Milan? This hotel has 12917 square feet (1200 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 14 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 231 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars.

name.content: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

18675.description: The Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel already unveils its new lool inspired by the style of the sixties.  In the heart of a booming part of Paris, the Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel is located a few steps from the Paris Place de la Nation, close to the Gare de Lyon and the Bastille neighborhood.

18684.description: This hotel is located 70 metres from the beautiful Cleopatra Beach. There are numerous restaurants, nightlife and shopping opportunities in the vicinity. The centre of Alanya is just around 700 m away and there is a plethora of attractions such as Alanya Castle, Alanya Dockyard and Arsenal, the Red Tower, Alanya Archaeological Museum and Damlatas Cave. There are links to the public transport network about 400 m away and Antalya Airport is approximately 120 km from the hotel.

18687.description: This complex enjoys a secluded location approximately 1. 5 km from Side's center and 1. 3 km from the beach, yet close to shops and entertainment. Public transport is readily available (200 m), and Antalya Airport is 45 km away. Renovated in 2005, this three-story hotel offers 34 rooms, including 11 suites, with full air conditioning. Amenities include a 24-hour reception with currency exchange, a restaurant, a bar, a small supermarket, room and laundry services, and parking. Each apartment features a combined bedroom/lounge, a separate bedroom, an en suite bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, a minibar, and a safe. A kitchenette, individually controlled air conditioning, and a balcony with scenic views are also standard. Guests can relax in the well-maintained grounds, featuring a swimming pool with a children's area, sprawling gardens, a sun terrace with loungers and parasols, and a poolside snack bar. A breakfast buffet and an à la carte evening menu are available. Please note: Air conditioning and safe usage incur an extra local charge.

18688.description: This attractive hotel is located in Turkler, a beautiful green resort area just outside of the famous city of Alanya. The hotel's comfortable rooms are stylishly decorated and air-conditioned, each with sea or mountain views. Guests may enjoy a day of thrilling water sports including windsurfing, parasailing and diving at the nearby beach, or stay in the hotel to relax by the sparkling indoor and outdoor pools or play on the waterslides. Alternatively, visitors can take a day trip to Alanya or Side to see ancient ruins, the stunning Seljuk citadel and castle, or fascinating caves. The hotel puts on a lively nightly entertainment programme, and children are well cared for with a fun children's club, babysitting service on request, separate children's buffet and high chairs available in the hotel restaurant. Ideal for a holiday spent luxuriating on the beach or finding adventure in outdoor sports, this hotel is a fantastic choice for families and couples alike.

18691.address: Side Mah. Adnan Menderes Blv. No:17
18691.description: This welcoming, family-friendly hotel is situated right by the sea and just a few minutes' walk from the golden, sandy beach in the resort town of Side. Side is an ancient city, having been inhabited since at least the 3rd century BC, and has many ruins of classical Greek structures including city walls and a gate, an amphitheatre and a beautiful Temple of Apollo.  There is a separate children's pool and waterslide as well as a playground for younger guest's enjoyment. The hotel offers both regular rooms and family rooms with bunk beds to accommodate two adults and two children, all fully-equipped, air-conditioned and with balcony, and guests may wake up to a wholesome breakfast buffet in the hotel's restaurant. This hotel offers the ideal family retreat for fun and relaxation in the warm sunshine.

18692.description: With it magnificent location on a private sandy beach, this hotel offers a plethora of options for a fun holiday. There are countless shopping venues as well as bars and restaurants in the vicinity. The nearest public transport stop is only 500 m from the hotel, as do a range of nightclubs. Guests can venture out to the famous port town of Alanya to explore its bustling centre and stroll along its glorious harbour.

18695.description:
This property is 2 minutes walk from the beach. Yeni Acun Apartments offers air-conditioned apartments with a private kitchen, and an outdoor pool surrounded by sun loungers and parasols. The property has a private area at the beautiful Cleopatra Beach only 50 m away.
Decorated in earthy tones, the spacious apartments of Yeni Acun include a bedroom, and a separate living room with sofas and a kitchen. All apartments have a balcony. Some apartments also offer stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea.
The à la carte restaurant serves selected dishes of Turkish and international cuisine. The restaurant has both outdoor and covered dining areas. The bar serves a variety of drinks, including delicious cocktails.
Alanya town centre is just 2 km from the property. Antalya Airport is 120 km away.

18696.address: Kizlar Pinari Mah. Atatürk CDS Anahtar Cikmazi, 1
18696.description: This lovely complex boasts a fantastic location in Alanya, with restaurants, bars, and shops within easy reach. Cleopatra Beach is just a short walk away, and the airport is a 45-minute drive from the property. Spend your days strolling along the beach or sunbathing while listening to the Mediterranean waves. Explore local attractions such as Alanya Castle, the Alanya Dockyard and Arsenal, the Red Tower, the Alanya Archaeological Museum, and Damlatas Cave. Relax by the outdoor pool or enjoy a refreshing swim. The onsite bar offers a variety of drinks, and the restaurant serves delicious meals. The brightly decorated rooms feature cozy beds and all the necessary amenities for a pleasant stay.

18698.description: This family-friendly, modern resort is located just a few steps from a beautiful, fine sandy beach and the warm waters of the Mediterranean Sea in the popular holiday region of the Turkish Riviera. It offers delightful landscaped gardens, two large pools with water slides and an excellent spa area. The historic city of Side is just a short drive away, the international airport of Antalya about 55 km.

18699.description: This attractive hotel is conveniently situated in the popular holiday destination of Alanya, only 2 minutes from a wonderful sandy beach and 3. 5 km from the city centre with its plethora of shops, restaurants, bars, cafés and entertainment venues. Famous sites such as Alanya Castle, Cleopatra Beach or the Red Tower can be easily reached, as well as Alanya Harbour, the shipyard or the Archaeological Museum. The hotel features an L-shaped pool with a water slide, surrounded by a terrace with sun loungers. Younger guests will love the play area and the mini club, while adults will appreciate the fitness centre. After a long day at the beach or on a shopping and sightseeing trip, guests may make use of the Turkish bath, the sauna or the massage services. This place perfectly combines the features of a holiday hotel on the beach with the fantastic amenities only a city like Alanya can offer.

name.content: Kyriad Paris 10 - Canal Saint Martin - République

18716.description: This 3 stars hotel is located in the city centre of Paris. It is a short drive away from the Canal Saint Martin and the nearest station is Jacques Bonsergent. . All 39 rooms are equipped with hairdryer and ironing set.

18718.description: The Hotel Des Grands Voyageurs offers 134 accommodation units and convenient amenities for both business and leisure travelers. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi access in public areas, a 24-hour reception, and on-site parking. The hotel is committed to accessibility, featuring wheelchair-accessible units and adapted facilities. For dining, the on-site restaurant provides a sophisticated ambiance where guests can savor exquisite dishes. The hotel also offers functional business facilities and a convenient transfer service (fees may apply). Environmentally sustainable practices are a priority at Hotel Des Grands Voyageurs.

18761.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a shared television area at the Grand Hotel Francais. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge, and savor the daily buffet breakfast (available for a fee). The hotel offers express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a 24-hour front desk. Each of the 36 individually decorated guest rooms features a minibar (with complimentary items), a flat-screen television with satellite programming, and a memory foam bed with premium bedding. Bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Located in the heart of Paris, the Grand Hotel Francais is a short drive from Place de la Nation and Cimetière de Picpus, and within easy reach of Père Lachaise Cemetery and Place des Vosges. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

18766.description: The Hotel Le Square Fassbindhotels. ch is an elegant 3-star hotel, offering the services and facilities of a first class hotel. It is ideally located, within walking distance of the train station, the lake and the business district. Travelers will be pleased to know that we have a multilingual staff, currency exchange and concierge service. We offer comfortable rooms with all amenities, such as cable TV with remote control The Hotel Le Square Fassbindhotels. ch is located in the heart of the business district. The tourist tax of 4. 25 CHF per person per night is not included in the room rate.

18769.description: Located in the heart of Mestre's vibrant city center, Camelia Rooms is a charming four-story guesthouse. We offer three room types, including single, double, and twin rooms, all with private bathrooms. Our top floor boasts two spacious terraces with stunning city views. Conveniently located near supermarkets, restaurants, bars, a pharmacy, and a hospital, our guesthouse is just 0. 5 km from Mestre train station and 1. 4 km from the city center. Venice Marco Polo Airport is 10 km away, and we offer a paid airport shuttle service. Our friendly, multilingual staff is always available to assist you.

18770.description:
Characteristic for Amsterdam, the building of this hotel lies opposite the canal in the centre of the tourist district. The famous Rijksmuseum and the Spiegelgracht, the internationally well-known street for antique and art shops, also lie almost opposite the hotel.

Built in 1999, the 4 storey hotel has a total of 18 rooms, of which 12 are doubles and 6 are singles. The amenities include a pleasant lobby with a 24-hour reception, a hotel-safe, a restaurant with a non-smoking area as well as medical assistence.

The modern rooms feature warm, light colours and include their own Dutch paintings. The single rooms a shared shower/toilet on each floor. The double rooms offer a private shower and toilet. A hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, TV, ironing equipment and a cot all come as standard.

name.content: Petit Palace Aston anteriormente Sunotel Aston

18787.description: Petit Palace Aston formerly known as Sunotel Aston. This city hotel, housed in a modern building offering panoramic views of the city, is located in L'Eixample, very close to the Fair and Exhibition Centre in Plaza España and close to the financial and commercial centre of Barcelona. The hotel is also within easy reach from Sants Station, where guests will find convenient public transport services linking to most parts of the city. Barcelona El Prat Airport is less than 30-minute drive. This is an ideal location for those wishing to enjoy a central location in Barcelona. All rooms at the hotel are air-conditioned and come with satellite TV, safe, phone, desk and fully equipped bathroom with hairdryer. To guarantee a pleasant stay, the hotel features an outdoor terrace area with an outdoor swimming pool and jacuzzi.

18845.description: The property is close to Kurfuerstendamm and only 3 km from ICC fair ground. Good public transportation - underground and busses. We offer flexible services so you can customise your stay with us - for example breakfast dry cleaning daily cleaning or private car park. Introducing Ascott Cares our 9 commitments to maintaining high levels of hygiene and cleanliness standards as well as safe distancing to continue providing a safe home for our guests and a safe working environment for our staff. 18847.description: Rest up, revive, take a step back, transform and above all enjoy. Greet hotel Boulogne-Billancourt Paris is more than a hotel; Greet is a community welcoming everyone looking for meaning in their purchase choices. Our hotel is completely renovated, eco-responsible and locally engaged. Enjoy our air-conditioned bedrooms or just a cocktail at the bar after a long day. Come meet us, work, rest or share time.

18848.description: The Hotel De Neuve offers a warm and cozy atmosphere in the heart of the trendy Marais district. Located a short 5-minute walk from the Place de la Bastille, the Seine River, and City Hall, this boutique hotel also sits just 300 meters from the Place des Vosges. The newly renovated decor promises a memorable stay. Air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs and private bathrooms with either a bathtub or shower. Soundproofing ensures a peaceful night's sleep. A continental breakfast is served each morning in the lobby, and the hotel staff is available 24/7. The Saint-Paul and Bastille metro stations are within a 5-minute walk of the hotel, offering easy access to attractions such as the Pompidou Centre and Notre Dame Cathedral, both a 15-minute walk away. *Pet fees apply.

18849.description: Lying in the heart of Paris' 18th arrondissement, adjacent to the famous district of Montmartre, this hotel enjoys an ideal location. Guests can discover endless restaurants, shops and cultural havens during their stay here. Vivid streets line the hotel surroundings providing adventure, and insights into the French lifestyle. With easily accessible transport links, guests can unravel the secrets of Montmartre. The hotel illustrates traditional French architecture, whilst maintaining an elegant sense of sophistication and glamour. The guest rooms are spacious and functional, spread over two buildings. With breakfast provided each morning, guests will receive ample choice. Offering comfortable and simplistic accommodation, guests will find themselves thoroughly pleased after a stay here.

18850.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at this Paris hotel, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge service, and a banquet hall. The 69 guestrooms offer flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, safes, desks, and phones with free local calls. Located in the 14th Arrondissement, it's a short drive from Paris Expo and the Paris Catacombs, and convenient to Luxembourg Gardens and the Louvre Museum. Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff.

18851.description: This charming hotel is situated in the city centre of Paris. The property lies just a short driving distance away from the Opera Garnier. Guests will find themselves just a short walking distance away from Saint Lazare station, which offers ease of access to other areas of this romantic city. The city's myriad of intriguing, beautiful attractions can be found close by. This superb hotel oozes French sophistication and grace. The guest rooms are simplistic in style, focusing on comfort and functionality. The hotel affords visitors a wonderful restaurant, where traditional dishes can be enjoyed. This hotel assures visitors of a truly memorable stay amidst the splendour and beauty of Paris.

18901.description: This 4-star city hotel is located in the heart of Amsterdam, just steps from the renowned Concertgebouw. Its central location provides the perfect base for exploring the city's main attractions, including three major museums, various shops, and entertainment venues, all within easy walking distance. A bus stop is conveniently located just 200 meters away. The hotel offers 34 comfortable, eco-friendly rooms, including 29 doubles, spread across four floors. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour reception, safe, lift, currency exchange, an on-site restaurant, room and laundry services, and internet access. Each room features an ensuite bathroom, direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, radio, internet access, central heating, and a safe for hire. Amsterdam offers a wide array of sports and entertainment options for guests to enjoy.

18903.description: Nestled in a tranquil residential area between Leidseplein and the verdant Vondelpark, this comfortable hotel offers a relaxing retreat within easy reach of Amsterdam's vibrant city center. Guests can explore nearby cultural gems such as the Rembrandt and Van Gogh Museums, wander along the picturesque canals, and experience the lively atmosphere of Leidseplein. Shopping enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to the chic P. C. Hooftstraat, renowned for its designer boutiques, as well as the Van Baerlestraat and Leidsestraat. A wide array of pubs and restaurants are within walking distance, catering to every culinary desire. Schiphol International Airport is less than 15 km away. The hotel's modern rooms provide comfort and convenience.

18904.description: This completely refurbished hotel (2020) is located at the intersection of the elegant P. C. Hooftstraat and the charming Stadhouderskade, offering a central location in the heart of Amsterdam. The Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum, Leidseplein, the historic city center, and the canals are all within a short walk. Boat trips, the museum boat, water bikes, and the water taxi depart right in front of the hotel. The hotel's Coffee Boutique provides a stylish, state-of-the-art space for breakfast and lunch. The hotel offers a variety of well-equipped rooms featuring cozy furnishings and home appliances for a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

18906.description: Situated near the famous Rijksmuseum and Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS), the peaceful Park Plaza Vondelpark, Amsterdam overlooks the scenic Vondelpark, a 150-year-old public recreation ground. One of Amsterdam's most convenient city-centre hotels, Park Plaza puts guests within walking distance of the Valeriusplein tram stop and tourist attractions like the Van Gogh Museum and Leidse Square. The Zuidas financial district is also close by, and guests have access to a variety of on-site meeting facilities that are perfect for conducting business. Park Plaza Vondelpark, Amsterdam offers free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the hotel as well as concierge service and a range of other amenities designed to maximise comfort and style. 100% non-smoking hotel

18907.description: Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 16 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and plasma televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.
