18920.description: This luxurious complex enjoys a superb location just 10 minutes from downtown Cancun, offering the perfect choice to practice water sports due to its prime beachfront situation. The international Cancun airport is located some 20 kilometres away. The charming guest rooms boast a tropical-style atmosphere and include wooden furnishings as well as terrace or balcony, ideal to enjoy a beautiful sunset while sipping a refreshing cocktail. Those most demanding guests seeking a more luxurious experience may prefer the outstanding spa rooms, featuring hot tub as well as special access to the magnificent spa area. Visitors staying in this gorgeous hotel might appreciate the extensive range of dining options, including Italian, Mexican and à la carte specialities. The onsite Mexican cantina offering an assortment of tequila and international liquors is the best place where to share some fun moments with friends.

18957.description: Set on the banks of Geneva's Lake Leman, the Hotel d'Angleterre ensures every guest feels at home. Famed for excellent service and meticulous attention to detail. Each of the individually designed rooms and suites combine traditional charm and elegant style with modern amenities, and a host of personal thoughtful touches will ensure you leave with memories to treasure. *When booking more than 5 rooms or nights, a special cancellation policy will be implemented.

18958.description: Inspired by the principles of Feng Shui, this hotel is located in the heart of Geneva, close to Lake Geneva and the train station as well as within a short distance of many shops, restaurants, lively bars, and nightclubs. Facilities include a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, safes, a currency exchange, and lifts. In addition, there is a public Internet terminal with free WLAN access, a business center, as well as laundry and room services. A car park and garage facilities are available to those arriving by car.

18959.description: This authentic Swiss chalet hotel is located in the heart of Geneva, near the United Nations, museums, and the Red Cross. Numerous shops, lively bars, and restaurants surround this well-known establishment. The airport is approximately 15 minutes away. The hotel offers 42 comfortable en-suite rooms, each fully equipped. Facilities include a 24-hour reception, the air-conditioned Restaurant Edelweiss featuring Swiss cuisine and background music, and Wi-Fi internet access. Room and laundry services are also available. Experience the charm of a traditional chalet in the city center, complete with delicious Swiss cuisine.

18963.description: The 4* NH Venezia Santa Lucia Hotel is conveniently located moments from the Grand Canal of Venice and the Santa Lucia railway station. Set in the city's artisan quarter, the hotel is a short walk from all the main attractions. The five-storey hotel offers 100 elegant rooms in a Venetian style, with a range of room types to choose from. All rooms enjoy balcony terraces overlooking the sights of Venice. Guests can enjoy a comprehensive buffet breakfast and a selection of Italian appetizers in the hotel's dining room and relaxed Canaletto bar, which offers wines and cocktails with a happy hour offer.

18968.description: Set in a 19th-century building, this elegant hotel features an interior garden and is located only a short walk from the most beautiful avenue in the world, the Champs Elysées. Being close to the Arc de Triomphe, this wonderful hotel offers an exceptional location in the heart of Paris. The Champs Elysées with its luxury boutiques is a 12-minute walk from the hotel. There is a plethora of shops and entertainment attractions are located in the vicinity. Iéna Metro Station is just 130 metres away, providing direct access to the whole city.

18998.description: A haven for outdoor enthusiasts, spa-goers and golfers alike. This seaside escape boasts views of Bass Rock and the Firth of Forth and sits within putting distance of North Berwick Golf Club. Our thoughtfully-curated rooms pay homage to the ancient Scottish Linksland, its beauty and glorious colour palette. Warm woods, pops of blue and heathery hues abound, while chocolatey burgundy and pink help to create a sumptuous space for guests to relax and unwind. Selected rooms boast stunning scenic views of the West Links golf course, Firth of Forth estuary and islands, while all offer an abundance of amenities for an enjoyable and fuss-free stay. The Lawn Restaurant offers all-day dining, showcasing the very best of British and Scottish dishes. We've made a solid commitment to Scottish produce and provenance, so expect to find outstanding local beef, game and freshly-landed seafood on the menu. Bass Rock, our famous neighbour - is the inspiration behind our Bass Rock Bar, after all it offers unrivalled views, providing a wonderful ambience in which to spend some down-time. A place of immense natural beauty to reflect, unwind and just ‘be', the Marine North Berwick Spaoffers guests a range of facilities including an indoor-outdoor spa with heated 18m swimming pool, hydro pool and state-of-the-art fitness centre, plus sauna and steam rooms. The destination spa is available to all, for those looking to relax after a day on the links or those seeking to escape the everyday.

19022.description: This elegant, hotel is centrally located just 100 m from the main train station. Links to the public transport network lie about 150 m away and shops, bars and pubs are about 1 km from the hotel. It is 3 km to the nearest nightclub and the hotel is to be found directly beside a lake. This hotel comprises a total of 85 rooms spread over 6 floors of which 19 are single rooms and 66 are double rooms. Guests may make use of the foyer with 24-hour reception desk, a safe, a currency exchange desk, a lift and café. There is also a bar and a TV room on offer to guests as well as a public Internet terminal. Room and laundry services round off the hotel's offerings. The welcoming, modern rooms come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, Internet access, a minibar, a double bed, air conditioning, central heating, a hire safe and a sitting area. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample buffet.

19026.description: Enjoy a safe and comfortable stay at the Best Western Hotel Tritone, conveniently located across from the Venice-Mestre Railway Station. This classically styled hotel offers 66 soundproofed rooms, elegantly furnished and equipped with modern amenities, including free Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and a daily buffet breakfast. Business travelers will appreciate the meeting facilities for up to 56 people, while leisure travelers can easily explore Venice, just a 10-minute bus or train ride away. On-site parking is available, and our multilingual staff is ready to assist you. Treviso, Padua, and Vicenza are also within easy reach by train or car.

19027.address: Riva del Ferro / Ponte di Rialto, San Marco, 5149
19027.description: Centrally located in Venice, Hotel Rialto is steps from the Rialto Bridge and a 5-minute walk from St. Mark's Square. This 4-star hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a terrace with stunning views. The 79 individually furnished guestrooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, and safes. Guests can enjoy room service (limited hours), a bar/lounge, and a complimentary continental breakfast daily. Additional amenities include wired internet access, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. The hotel is conveniently located near St. Mark's Basilica (0. 3 mi) and Doge's Palace (0. 5 mi).

19028.description: This glorious country house hotel, just a short distance from Venice's historic district, offers a relaxing retreat surrounded by lush greenery. Nearby, guests can explore numerous sights, shops, and entertainment venues. The hotel features 60 uniquely decorated rooms, each showcasing antique furniture, art, and artifacts collected by Signore Bevilacqua, whose family has owned the property for over 50 years. Guests can enjoy conference facilities, a restaurant serving delectable dishes, a bar, and on request, concierge, babysitting, and dry cleaning services. 24-hour security ensures a peaceful stay. All rooms include an en suite bathroom and are well-equipped.

19029.description: In the heart of Venice, just 100 meters from St. Mark's Square, Hotel Casa Verardo – Residenza d’Epoca welcomes its guests into a charming 16th-century building where historical elegance blends harmoniously with modern comfort. The hotel's 27 soundproofed and air-conditioned rooms are furnished with refined period furniture and enriched with exclusive Rubelli fabrics, creating an atmosphere full of charm and sophistication. Guests can choose between rooms in the main building and those in the annexed Casa Giardino, a separate structure accessible through a picturesque Venetian “calle” just a few steps from Hotel Casa Verardo. Here, modern design meets the essence of Venetian tradition, ensuring a stay of relaxation and historical charm. The residence is adorned with exclusive details, such as magnificent Sansovino-style ceiling paintings and the iconic Fortuny sail lamps. The elegant ambiance extends to the internal garden, decorated with a suggestive 17th-century column, offering a peaceful retreat where guests can relax, immersed in the historical beauty of Venice. Every morning, guests can start the day with a rich buffet breakfast, served in the elegant salon on the noble first floor or, during the warmer season, on the terrace overlooking the canal. The buffet offers a variety of delicacies, including homemade cakes and muffins, cereals, fresh fruit, cured meats, and cheeses from the Veneto region. Upon request, breakfast can also be enjoyed in the privacy of the guest’s own room. Hotel Casa Verardo enjoys a privileged location, just a few steps from the city's main tourist attractions, such as St. Mark's Basilica, the Doge's Palace, the Correr Museum and La Fenice Theater. Despite its proximity to Venice’s most renowned landmarks, the hotel is tucked away in a quiet corner overlooking a serene Rio Drio La Chiesa canal, offering guests a peaceful and authentic stay.

19031.description: This modern, smart, luxury hotel is located close to St. Mark's Square, within minutes of the pulsating city center, which has an abundance of shops and other entertainment options. Relais Piazza San Marco is set in two historic buildings opposite each other. La Fenice Opera House, Rialto Bridge, and the Bridge of Sighs are less than a 10-minute walk away. The nearest beach is just 300 meters from the hotel. The hotel also offers many facilities, including a cozy bar, a pub, and an exquisite restaurant. Rooms come with either classic Venetian decor or contemporary furnishings. The modern, comfortable accommodations come with an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer and are all fully equipped as standard. In addition, a fridge and a safe are available.

19184.description: Newhotel Charlemagne is set in the heart of the European Quarter in Brussels and lies 300 m from the European Commission and Schuman Metro Station. It benefits from rooms with a minibar, an on-site restaurant and free WiFi throughout the property. Car rental is available. Each of the rooms at Newhotel come furnished with a work desk and a seating area with satellite TV. The rooms are also equipped with a Nespresso coffee machine which can be used for an extra charge. An American-style breakfast buffet is available each morning. The restaurant serves international dishes in a casual yet elegant setting. At the bar, guests can enjoy a light snack or drink including local Belgian beers. Brussels Central Railway Station is 4 metro stops away. The Council of the European Union is 450 m from the hotel. Parc du Cinquantenaire is less than a 10-minute walk away. The well-known Grand Place and the Manneken Pis Statue are 3. 5 km away.

19341.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include gift shops/newsstands, wedding services, and a television in a common area. Satisfy your appetite for dinner at Foundry Bar, a bar/lounge which specializes in American cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in New York? This hotel has 27756 square feet (2579 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 27 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 873 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations.

19344.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at the W New York - Union Square, centrally located in New York, a short walk from 5th Avenue and Gramercy Park. This luxury hotel offers a range of amenities, including complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services, and limo/town car service. The hotel also features 2444 square feet of event space, ideal for conferences and meetings. Each of the 270 air-conditioned rooms includes an iPod docking station, LCD TV, and a comfortable pillowtop bed. Guests can enjoy cable programming and Wi-Fi access. Bathrooms are equipped with shower/tub combinations, rainfall showerheads, and complimentary toiletries. Nearby attractions include Washington Square Park and New York University.

19348.description: This superbly located hotel enjoys a convenient setting on 39th Street between Park and Lexington Avenues in the Murray Hill neighborhood in the sophisticated city of New York. Guests are just blocks from Grand Central Station, the Empire State Building, Times Square, Rockefeller Center, 5th Avenue and the many other remarkable landmarks. Visitors luxuriate in charming and exclusive boutique hotel's spirit featuring unusually spacious accommodations and distinctive, impeccable service. The hotel is the destination of choice for international travelers, world-renowned celebrities, and those who prefer to do business with grace and style. With its classic design, casual bars and lounge, and the historical Murray Hill neighborhood surrounding, this luxury hotel is perfect for mature guests that appreciate the finest things in Manhattan. The upscale restaurant is sure to satisfy even the most discerning palates with a wide selection of refined dishes.

19356.description: Thriller, mystery or romance? With the Earls Court and Olympia Exhibition Centres on your doorstep and the must-see museums just minutes away, we promise a fairytale city break. Follow in the footsteps of Hitchcock and Agatha Christie and explore the beautiful streets (and stylish shops) of Kensington. See dinosaurs and experience earthquakes at the Natural History and Science Museums. Stroll to the latest show or cheer on your team at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge Stadium. And, with our friendly team, spacious rooms and extra-comfy beds, you can be sure of a winning night's sleep. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

19376.description: Surrounded by the greenery of the 'Parco Sud' of Milan, sheltered from the chaos of the down town but in an excellent position to reach the city center, Ripamonti Residence & Hotel with its 916 residential units is the largest hotel in Italy. Ripamonti Residence & Hotel is not a simple accommodation facility, but a real, self-sufficient and complete world, with a shopping area that includes a supermarket, pharmacy, women's and men's hairdressers, beauty center, medical center. The Restaurant & Self Service have been renewed in format and management as well. The spacious and functional apartments are perfect for medium and long term stays. Located in the green area of ​​the Metropolitan City, it offers a convenient free shuttle service that takes you to the Abbiategrasso Metro stop, reaching all the central points of Milan very easily.

19387.description:
Blue Tree Premium Paulista is centrally located in São Paulo just 9 km from Congonhas Airport and 28 km from Guarulhos Airport. This hotel is ideal for business and leisure travelers. Rooms are elegantly designed, with modern amenities and functional spaces. The hotel has rooms that are equipped with modern conference technology, which is sure to impress, and leisure facilities to ensure a comfortable stay for all types of travellers. 
The hotel offers free Wi-Fi, private covered parking on site (additional cost), room service, lobby bar, fitness center, heated pool and laundry. 
Hotel charges R$ 6. 60/day tourist tax.

19391.description: With a prime location next to the Octávio Frias de Oliveira Bridge and easy access to tourist attractions, parks, museums, shopping centers, and business districts, Hilton São Paulo Morumbi combines sophistication, comfort, and exceptional service. Recently renovated, the hotel features redesigned rooms and suites, blending contemporary design, comfort, and functionality. The new Executive Lounge offers private check-in, an exclusive breakfast, and happy hour with a selection of snacks and beverages. On the 28th floor, a swimming pool with panoramic city views, fitness center, sauna, and Amazonian SPA create a wellness environment inspired by a tropical terrace. In dining, Ritus offers an authorial cuisine that respects the time, precision, and essence of each preparation, while Armazem Morumbi welcomes both hotel guests and visitors for breakfast, lunch, and its traditional Sunday brunch. The hotel also features Caffè Cino (Grab & Go), room service, concierge, valet parking, and a pet-friendly policy. For business needs, the hotel provides Wi-Fi and 19 meeting rooms, including the divisible Morumbi Ballroom, which can accommodate up to 500 people.

19395.address: Av. Ministro Evandro Lins E Silva Nº10/100
19395.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Satisfy your appetite for lunch at the hotel's restaurant, Cafe Deville, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and 17 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary during limited hours. Make yourself at home in one of the 316 guestrooms featuring minibars and LED televisions.

19397.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a spa tub, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Terraço Jardins, for lunch, dinner, or brunch. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in São Paulo? This hotel has 29063 square feet (2700 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 20 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 444 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations and LCD televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wired internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. 19398.description: This hotel is located in the southern district of Copocabana, two blocks from the world-famous beach. The location enables direct access to the lively nightlife in the area. Bars, restaurants, nightclubs and public transport are to be found in the vicinity. This air-conditioned hotel comprises 145 rooms spread over 13 floors. The reception is open 24 hours a day. Facilities include a hotel safe, a currency exchange counter and a lift. In addition, there is an à la carte restaurant (with highchairs for children), a public Internet terminal and a WLAN access point. A laundry service, bicycle rental and a car park round off the services offered. The tastefully decorated rooms come with an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a minibar/ fridge, an Internet connection, air conditioning (centrally regulated) and hire safe. Breakfast may be selected from a buffet service.

19399.description: This 20-story air-conditioned hotel offers 110 tastefully decorated rooms, each with an en-suite bathroom and standard amenities. Located within a kilometer of shops, bars, and restaurants, and just steps from public transport, the hotel features a 24-hour reception, safe, cloakroom, lift, bar, café, air-conditioned à la carte restaurant, conference room, and wired internet access (R$12/day). Guests can also enjoy an indoor swimming pool and sauna. Lunch and dinner are available à la carte. On-site parking is available. From March 1, 2019, the parking fee will be R$30 per day, payable directly at the parking lot.

name.content: Copacabana Palace, A Belmond Hotel, Rio de Janeiro

19403.description:
Experience the legendary Copacabana Palace, A Belmond Hotel, in the heart of Rio de Janeiro's vibrant Copacabana district. Just steps from Avenida Atlantica and a short stroll from Copacabana Beach, this luxurious hotel offers an unforgettable stay. Indulge in a rejuvenating spa treatment, featuring massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of the outdoor pool and tennis court, or simply relax by the poolside bar. The hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Each of the 140 guestrooms features a minibar, plasma television, DVD player, and cable programming. Private bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Enjoy a meal at one of the hotel's three restaurants, including the acclaimed Pergula, or order from the 24-hour room service. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. For business travelers, the hotel offers a business center, conference space, and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. 


The annex building is currently closed and undergoing renovation until October 2026. The main building and other services are not affected, and we are doing our best to minimize any disturbance. From June 08th to September, all our guests will be invited to use our exclusive pool on the 6th floor, while we upgrade the iconic main pool of the hotel.

19406.description:
Novotel Rio de Janeiro Leme is a stunning hotel, with modern, sophisticated facilities and a rooftop with the most beautiful view of Copacabana Beach. Located in Leme, the best of 'Copa', this hotel has ample leisure spaces to enjoy with family and friends, a swimming pool with panoramic views, fitness with modern equipment and bold spaces for holding your event. A menu designed to provide a gastronomic experience and a breakfast prepared with a Carioca soul. 

**Important Notice – Rooftop Closed on December 31st
Please note that on December 31st, our rooftop will be closed to the public due to a New Year’s Eve party. 
Access to the event is exclusively for guests with pre-purchased tickets, starting at 8:00 PM. 
For more information about the party and how to purchase tickets, please contact the hotel directly at +55 (21) 3545-5333, Monday to Friday during business hours.

19408.description: This Copacabana hotel offers 103 guestrooms equipped with LED TVs, cable programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and desks. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Enjoy on-site dining at the Marinado Restaurante, or order room service during limited hours. Amenities include a health club, steam room, bar/lounge, and daily buffet breakfast (fee applies). Business travelers appreciate the 24-hour business center, while a 24-hour front desk and luggage storage add convenience. Nearby attractions include Copacabana Beach, Praca Serzedelo Correia, and Rua Barata Ribeiro. Rio de Janeiro International Airport (GIG) is the preferred airport.

19419.description: Centrally located in the picturesque and beautiful city of Lisbon, this inviting and charming hotel overlooks the Chiado square with many chic restaurants and popular cafes, ideal for everyone who enjoys wandering around the streets or doing some shopping. In the surrounding area, there is also a wide cultural offer, including the Mario Viegas Theatre and Chiado Museum within walking distance. The international airport is only 10 minutes by car. All the hotel's guest rooms and suites are tastefully appointed with elegant furniture and earthy hues, making it the ideal spaces in which to relax after a day of sightseeing or working. Among the practical hotel facilities, guests can make good use of the function rooms for any kind of event.

19420.description: Situated in the heart of Barcelona, Hotel Ramblas Internacional is just steps from La Rambla and an 11-minute walk from Plaça de Catalunya. This hotel offers a rooftop terrace with stunning city views, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. The 52 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions with digital programming, private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads, and convenient amenities like safes and a turndown service. Guests can enjoy a meal at the breakfast room, snacks at the coffee shop/cafe, or drinks at the bar/lounge. Room service is also available. A continental breakfast is offered daily for a fee. Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff.

19457.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This Mediterranean hotel also features gift shops/newsstands, a television in a common area, and a banquet hall. Grab a bite at one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 84 guestrooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Gülhane Park - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Istanbul Archaeology Museums - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Basilica Cistern - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Bosphorus - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Eminonu Pier - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Eminönü Square - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Sultanahmet Square - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Hagia Sophia - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Column of Constantine - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Grand Bazaar - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Topkapi Palace - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Süleymaniye Mosque - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Little Hagia Sophia - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 45. 8 km / 28. 5 miIstanbul Airport (IST) - 41. 3 km / 25. 7 miThe preferred airport for Erboy Hotel is Istanbul Airport (IST).

19458.description: The Ilkay Hotel offers top-notch services and amenities for a comfortable stay. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, allowing you to easily share photos and stay connected. Pre-book your airport transfer for a seamless arrival and departure experience. The hotel maintains a completely smoke-free environment for your well-being. Start your day with a complimentary breakfast and savor excellent coffee at our in-house cafe. For other meals, explore the enticing culinary options available within the hotel.

19459.description: With its own private museum showcasing an ancient cistern, a beautiful mosaic and many other remarkable pieces from the Hellinistic, Roman and Byzantine eras, this elegant hotel is the first boutique museum hotel in Turkey. The hotel is set just 200 metres from the Blue Mosque in the Sultanahmet neighbourhood of Istanbul. From here, visitors may explore the city's best historical and cultural attractions on foot, as the Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace and Grand Bazaar are all less than a 15 minute walk from the hotel. The hotel's restaurant boasts a terrace with stunning views of the Blue Mosque, old town and Marmara Sea, while the lavish rooms all come with in-room hot tub, air-conditioning, coffee and tea making facilities, premium bedding and double-glazed windows to ensure a good night's rest as well as a pleasant morning. This hotel is for those who are looking for something truly unique and luxurious in this celebrated city.

19460.description: Thank you very much for booking at Apartamentos G3 Galeon. To check in to your apartment, we have a modern self-check-in system via a touchscreen kiosk located at the hotel entrance. On the touchscreen, enter your reservation number or code and follow the instructions that appear on the screen. Once you have checked in, the machine will give you your room card. Very important: to check in, you must have the ID/passport of all the people who will be staying in the apartment. Our kiosk allows you to scan these documents; however, you can also enter this information manually. Remember that once you have collected your card, you must swipe it through the readers or locks located on both the entrance doors and the door to your apartment. If you have to make any payments, these must be made by credit card; cash is not accepted. If you wish to use the parking lot, there is an additional cost of €22 per night, and you must reserve it before your arrival, for which we will need the model and license plate number of your vehicle. Once in the parking lot, you can park in any space that does not have the orange logo. If you need physical assistance, our office hours are Monday through Friday from 10:00 a. m. to 2:00 p. m. Outside these hours, we will assist you virtually on our telephone number: (+34) 915712120. Our emergency telephone number for evenings and weekends is: (+34) 915712120. Our WIFI connection is: NETWORK: g3g_R Password: g3galeon4579

19461.description: This complex is located in a quiet side street in the centre of Madrid's Salamanca district. The Juan Carlos I convention centre and the international airport are close by. Madrid's shopping centres and the Las Ventas bullfighting arena can easily be reached on foot. Whatever the purpose of the visit, the intimacy and independence of these apartments, equipped with a kitchen and everything else that guests might need, will make every guest's stay in Madrid a pleasant one. With its unique location in the commercial district it is sure to satisfy the needs of every guest. The tastefully designed studios come with a separate bathroom and small kitchen with a fridge and a microwave. They are also fully equipped as standard. All guests are offered breakfast in the morning.

19462.description:
Merter Gunes Hotel - Istanbul 
Located in Merter, the heart of Istanbul’s commerce and fashion, the 4-star Gunes Hotel offers a perfect blend of comfort, prestige, and logistical convenience for both business and leisure travelers. 
Our Highlights & Privileges:140 Modern Rooms: Elegantly and functionally designed, all rooms feature free high-speed Wi-Fi, a work desk, orthopedic beds, and modern bathroom amenities. 
Central & Strategic Location: Within walking distance of metro, metrobus, and tram lines. It provides direct and fast access to the Historical Peninsula, tourist attractions, Istanbul Expo Center (IFM), and CNR Expo Center. 
Complimentary Large Parking Lot: A rare privilege in a megacity like Istanbul, our spacious parking facility is completely free of charge for all vehicle types, from passenger cars to tour buses. Professional Meeting Rooms: Two fully equipped meeting rooms featuring the latest audio-visual technology, ideal for product launches, training sessions, workshops, and corporate events. Dining & Social Areas: A restaurant serving select dishes from Turkish and international cuisines, a rich open-buffet breakfast for a great start to the day, a stylish hotel bar to unwind, and a spacious lobby area suitable for business meetings. 
Your home away from home in Istanbul, Merter Gunes Hotel awaits you with its comfortable details and professional team.

19463.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting amidst the bustle and excitement of Istanbul. The hotel is situated just a short distance away from the city centre, where guests will discover a diverse selection of bars, restaurants and shopping venues. A host of attractions can be found close to the hotel. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the captivating attractions that the Sultanahmet District has to offer. The Grand Bazaar is just 1. 5 km from the hotel. This charming hotel showcases the splendour of Ottoman style. The guest rooms are superbly designed, immersing visitors in comfort and style.

19464.description: This hotel is located in the tourist centre of Istanbul just a short walk from shopping and entertainment venues. There is a stop for public transport to be found in the hotel's vicinity lying approximately 200 m from the hotel. The hotel is housed in a historical Ottoman building that dates back to 1905 and that was lovingly restored in 1995 and equipped with every 21st century luxury imaginable. There are a total of 17 rooms of which 10 are doubles, 6 are singles and 1 is a suite. Facilities on offer include a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a lift, a safe and a currency exchange facility. An air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with highchairs for infants is also to be found within the hotel and a public Internet terminal, room and laundry services are on offer. Car parking facilities are available. The well-equipped rooms come with a bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, a minibar and central heating. Various sports and entertainment options are on offer from local providers in Istanbul. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample buffet. Lunch and dinner may be taken à la carte.

19466.description: This charming 1938 hotel is situated near the heart of Istanbul, offering convenient access to shopping, entertainment, and public transport. The hotel features 22 guestrooms, including single, double, and triple options. Amenities include a 24-hour reception desk, currency exchange, café, TV room, conference room, air-conditioned à la carte restaurant, room and laundry services, medical assistance, internet access, and on-site parking. Each stylish room features an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, satellite TV, minibar, radio, internet connection, central heating, and a safe. A delicious breakfast buffet is served daily. While a beach is located 25 km outside of Istanbul, an array of sports and entertainment options are available within the city center.

19467.description: This elegant and modern hotel is excellently situated in the historical centre of Istanbul, the Sultanahmet District. It features a restaurant, pub, lobby bar and a spa area with Turkish bath and sauna. The hotel is an ideal starting point to explore the city, as many of the major sights such as Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque or Hippodrome are within walking distance.

19468.description: Our hotel is centrally located in Istanbul's historic Old City, close to major tourist attractions. We offer 37 standard rooms, a welcoming lobby, a terrace restaurant and cafe, and a meeting room. Public transportation is just five minutes away, and you can walk to the Sultanahmet district in 10 minutes. Taksim Square is a 15-minute drive. We are also conveniently located near Atatürk Airport (14 km), Sabiha Gökçen Airport (55 km), and several convention centers.

19469.description: This charming hotel is located at the heart of the tourist centre of the town within 500 m of shopping venues, restaurants, bars and links to the public transport network meaning that all can easily be reached on foot. Built in 1991 and renovated in 2004, this hotel comprises a total of 19 rooms spread over 4 floors of which 15 are double rooms, 3 are single rooms and 1 is a suite. There is a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a safe and a lift as well as various further facilities including a café, a bar and a public Internet terminal. There are also room and laundry services as well as a car park on offer. The welcoming rooms come with an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, Internet access, a minibar, a fridge, central heating and a hire safe. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample buffet.

19470.address: Adnan Menderes Bulvari Cayir Meydani Caddesi, N43 Fatih
19470.description: This luxury hotel is centrally situated in the old town. The Sultan's palace is to be found nearby and Istanbul's airport is just a 30-minute journey away using public transport. The hotel building was built in 1992 and renovated in 2003. It consists of 8 floors and 275 rooms of which 265 are doubles and 8 are suites. Situated amidst 500 m² of gardens, facilities include a foyer with a 24-hour reception, a safe, a currency exchange facility and a lift. There is also a café, a shop, a hairdresser's salon, a bar, a nightclub, a games room, a conference room, a TV room as well as an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with a non-smoking area. Guests arriving by car may make use of the garage. Room and laundry services also count amongst the amenities on offer. The elegant, luxurious rooms are fitted with an en suite bathroom facilities and a hairdryer. In addition, all rooms come with a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a safe, a radio, a stereo, a minibar, a double bed, a fridge, a hire safe, a sitting area and central heating. Guests may take advantage of the swimming pool with a poolside snack bar, sun loungers and parasols as well as the gym. On payment of an additional fee there is a sauna, a steam room, a massage service, gymnastics as well as a pool table. Guests are offered breakfast and dinner in the form of a buffet. At midday and in the evenings, guests may also select dishes from the set menu, or take the à la carte option. Special dietary needs as well as individual-specific meals may be provided .

19471.address: Mesih Pasa Mh. Azimkar Sokak, Laleli, 32
19471.description: This intimate, privately-owned hotel offers comfort and quality in the heart of Laleli, Istanbul. Within easy walking distance of iconic landmarks such as the Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Topkapi Palace, our convenient location also provides quick access to the underground, connecting you to the city center and Atatürk Airport. Our tourist-class rooms provide everything you need for a comfortable stay. Enjoy delicious meals in our main restaurant, or relax with a drink in our café bar. For those seeking leisure, we offer a terrace pool with a snack bar and a relaxing terrace lounge. Business travelers can take advantage of our internet desk and secretarial services in the lobby. Whether you're visiting Istanbul for business or pleasure, our hotel is the perfect choice.

19472.description: Located in Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, the upscale Alzer Hotel - Special Class is a short walk from iconic landmarks like the Blue Mosque and Basilica Cistern. This hotel offers 22 individually decorated guestrooms featuring minibars, LCD TVs with satellite channels, and modern bathrooms with bidets and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast and utilize amenities such as free Wi-Fi and an area shuttle (surcharge). The hotel also provides convenient services including a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and airport transfers (surcharge).

19473.address: Mimar Mehmet Aga Cd.Amiral Tafdil Sok.-Sultanahmet, 19-58
19473.description: 'This centrally located Istanbul hotel boasts stunning views of a lush park and pristine riverbank. Within walking distance of the historical center, including the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Topkapi Palace, the hotel seamlessly blends modern style within a beautifully preserved 19th-century wooden building. Each elegantly designed room offers a tranquil escape. Guests can enjoy a daily breakfast buffet and breathtaking panoramic views of the Marmara Sea and its islands from the Sipsi bar and restaurant. '

19474.description: Indulge in the full-service spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of the health club, outdoor and indoor pools, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and hair salon. Savor local cuisine at Tugra, one of the hotel's six restaurants, or enjoy room service (limited hours). Unwind with a drink at one of the two bars/lounges. This hotel also features a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Event facilities include a conference center and meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite. The 317 guest rooms offer minibars, LCD televisions, down comforters, Egyptian cotton sheets, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Located on the Bosphorus, near Ciragan Palace, the hotel is conveniently close to Besiktas Pier, Ortaköy Mosque, and the Bosphorus Bridge. Istanbul Airport (IST) is the preferred airport.

19478.description: Our 78-room, six-story hotel is ideally located just 200 meters from Alanya's renowned Cleopatra Beach in the heart of this vibrant Mediterranean resort district. We're a short walk from the city center, bus stops, and the main terminal, and conveniently situated 45 km from Gazipasa Airport and 135 km from Antalya Airport. Enjoy quality service and delicious meals in our elegant restaurant overlooking a sparkling pool. Our all-inclusive guests have complimentary access to sunbeds and umbrellas on our private beach. We're also just a two-minute stroll from Alanya Aquapark and within easy walking distance of the Alanya Archeology Museum and Damlataş Cave. Alanya Castle is 1 km away, and Manavgat Waterfall is 55 km from the hotel. Please note that fresh fruit juices, Turkish coffee, ice cream, and alcoholic beverages (excluding wine and beer) are subject to an additional charge. Alcoholic beverages are not served to guests under 18, and all drinks are served by the glass. Paid services include internet access, dry cleaning, airport transfers, car, bicycle, motorcycle and stroller rentals, telephone service, photocopying, and fax services.

19497.description: This charming hotel, built in 1897, is conveniently located in Charlottenburg, just minutes from the exhibition center (ICC), the central bus station, and an easy 10-15 minute journey to attractions like Charlottenburg Palace and the Reichstag. Excellent transport links via the nearby U-Bahn and S-Bahn provide quick access to all of Berlin's districts. Tegel and Tempelhof airports are a short trip away (20 and 15 minutes respectively), while Schönefeld is an hour's journey. This 4-story hotel offers 75 rooms, including single, double, and multi-bed options. Guests can enjoy a welcoming lobby with reception, safe, newspaper stand, TV room, and conference facilities. Each cozy room features a TV, and some boast a washbasin and balcony. Shared bathrooms with toilets and showers are available on each floor. A breakfast buffet is served daily.

19499.description: This upmarket hotel is situated in a historic 19th century building directly on Las Ramblas in the heart of Barcelona. Its excellent mixture of historical features and modern facilities make it a unique experience and an oasis of luxury and tranquility. It features a heated wood-decked rooftop terrace with pool, an exclusive spa and several elegant ballrooms. The major attractions of the Catalonian capital are within easy reach.

19501.description: A typical Inn in the heart of Venice, 200 meters from Rialto and a few minutes from St. Mark's Square, overlooking the picturesque Calle della Fava, the Residenza Goldoni is one of the most popular guest houses in Venice for its enviable location and beautiful rooms, all with private bathroom and air conditioning. Its warm and intimate interior has been furnished with elegance and a touch of the Spellanzon family's own personal style.

19570.address: Hagley Road, Five Ways, Birmingham, England, 12
19570.description: The Delta Hotels by Marriott Birmingham offers upscale accommodation in the heart of Birmingham, a short walk from Broad Street and fifteen minutes from Utilita Arena. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, a terrace with city views, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services. The 104 guestrooms feature smart TVs, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, and private bathrooms with designer toiletries. The hotel's restaurant, The Brew Bar Lounge, serves British cuisine and also offers 24-hour room service. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available for a fee. Other amenities include a business center, express check-in/check-out, and on-site self-parking (for a fee).

19572.description: Thoughtful touches and discreet charm make your stay at voco™ St John’s Solihull different right from the start. A stylish yet unstuffy hotel with conference facilities. Birmingham NEC a convenient 10 minutes away. Close to Birmingham Airport and the Midlands motorway network. With 13 flexible events spaces and dedicated staff, we can deliver the ultimate corporate event or your dream wedding. Here to relax? Dive into the pool. Steam in the sauna, get a massage or hit the treadmill in the health club. Dine on seasonal dishes in Brasserie six5one and order a nightcap in the bar.

name.content: Hotel Domicil Berlin by Golden Tulip

19575.description: This cozy hotel is excellently located in Charlottenburg, a short walk from the ICC and the international trade fair center. Attractions such as Charlottenburg Palace, the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, and the renowned Kurfürstendamm shopping street are easily accessible. Nearby metro and train stations provide convenient transport throughout the city. The hotel features a bar and restaurant serving delicious meals and beverages, plus a lovely rooftop terrace with panoramic city views. Rooms and suites offer Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and ensuite bathrooms. Some also include tea and coffee making facilities and/or sitting areas.

19644.address: Calle Chacchi S/N ESQ Playa Norte
19644.description: Crystal-clear waters, spectacular white beaches, tropical vegetation with mangroves and a small fishing village without cars but with streets made of sand – this romantic resort is truly situated in a part of paradise on Holbox Island. Guests are accommodated in beautiful huts in traditional Mayan style with thatched roofs; the hotel offers a wide variety of activities, especially water sports facilities.

19663.description:
Take advantage of the hotel's facilities, including a fitness center and a seasonal outdoor pool. Additional amenities include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. 

Enjoy a meal at the hotel's restaurant or grab a snack at the coffee shop/café. The hotel also offers room service during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends and public holidays from 8:00 AM to 11:30 AM. 

Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk. On-site parking is available for an additional fee. 

Make yourself at home in one of the 156 rooms equipped with air conditioning or heating and a minibar. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms feature a shower and complimentary toiletries. Additional conveniences include a telephone and a safe, and housekeeping services are provided daily.

19720.description: This hotel is located directly beside Cleopatra Beach. The centre of Alanya is about 700 m away. Established in 2004, the hotel comprises a total of 215 rooms spread across three buildings. Guests to this air-conditioned hotel are offered a foyer with a lift, a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, and a currency exchange desk. Further facilities include a hairdresser, a bar, and a restaurant. The rooms come with an en suite bathroom and are well-equipped as standard. Every room features a balcony. The outdoor complex features a swimming pool with a children's paddling area. Guests may also relax in the sauna, swim in the indoor pool, or enjoy a massage. It is also possible to play tennis or billiards as well as try out a range of water sports. Guests may serve themselves from the buffets at breakfast and dinner. At midday and in the evenings guests may also dine from the à la carte menu.

19724.description: The Senza Sunset Beach Hotel offers a memorable seaside escape with unique architecture, a private beach, and stunning views. Located just 5 km from Alanya's vibrant city center and a short 15-minute trip to the tranquil Dimçay River, the hotel caters to both active and relaxing holidays. Guests can enjoy a 170-meter-long pebble and sand beach, a pool with three slides, and a spacious 600 m² pier perfect for sunbathing and water sports.

19725.description: This attractive luxury beach hotel is located along the coast, on a sweeping bay between Alanya and Side which is approximately 28km away. It is about 10 minutes with public transport to the nearest small town and a bus stop is located about 200m from the hotel. A small range of shops, restaurants, and bars can be found within 500m of the hotel, while the river located 300m away is an inviting place to take a stroll and enjoy the beautiful river landscape. Antalya airport lies some 90 km from the hotel. Established in 2004, the beach hotel comprises a total of 535 rooms, of which 23 are junior suites, set over seven floors. Guests are received in the welcoming and air-conditioned foyer with 24-hour reception and lift. There is a hairdressing salon and some shops, boutiques, and a kiosk where guests may purchase small items. Culinary options include a pleasant café, a cosy bar, and a restaurant. Guests arriving on business may make use of the conference rooms for meetings, while cosy sitting areas are ideally suited to more informal situations. There is also a nightclub and a games room open all evening. Younger guests can let off steam in the kid's club (charges apply). The stylish and comfortable rooms are either with tiled or laminate parquet flooring and come with a double or twin beds and en suite bathroom with hairdryer. A direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a minibar, a hire safe, and a balcony or terrace are also all included as standard in every room. Room temperatures are controlled centrally by means of the air conditioning and central heating.

19727.description: This hotel in Great Dunmow is conveniently located with easy access to the M11. It is just 7 miles from Stansted Airport and close to the historic City of Cambridge. Built in 1600, this is a historic coaching inn situated opposite the old market place on Great Dunmow's High Street and has been welcoming visitors for nearly 400 years. There are 31 guest rooms in total, spread over a 4-storey main building and a 2-floor annexe block. There are various facilities on offer including a 24-hour reception desk and 2 function rooms. The a la carte restaurant with highchairs for infants invites guests to stop off and indulge in some top cuisine featuring fresh local produce. All rooms include an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, central heating, a direct dial telephone and Internet access. All rooms are carpeted. Breakfast may be selected from a buffet. Lunch and dinner may be chosen from a menu. Furthermore, special dietary requirements can be catered for as well as the preparation of individual-specific dishes.

19756.description: Located in the historical market town of Dunstable, this stylish hotel is perfect for travellers who are eager to unwind. The property is just a short walking distance away from the centre of the town. Luton is a 10 minutes' drive away. Luton Airport is also located nearby. This charming hotel enjoys a rich heritage, oozing warm, old-English charm. The spacious guest rooms are stunningly designed, exuding rustic elegance and luxury. This property offers visitors a boundless range of facilities and services, to meet guests' individual needs. The hotel features spaces for special occasions and events. The property also offers a gym, for those who like to keep in shape while away.

19767.description: Neighbouring to the Ostkreuz railway station and right in a fashionable area , this charming establishment enjoys a convenient location in Berlin. Housed in a former factory, this attractive property blends tradition with modern touches, offering comfortable accommodation and excellent services in a peaceful urban setting. Visitors will find themselves within easy reach of the numerous entertainment venues, shopping opportunities as well as multiple dining options. The rooms are well-appointed and come complete with modern amenities, needed to ensure a pleasant and relaxing stay while on visit in the German capital. The on-site bar will enchant visitors with a welcoming atmosphere and flavourful drinks and snacks. There is karaoke, table soccer, billiard and kids' corner for guests' added convenience. Wi-Fi and launderette is also available.

19768.description: Situated in Berlin's central Mitte district, the 2-star Hotel AO Mitte is a short walk from the Spree River, the Märkisches Museum, and Oranienstrasse's vibrant bar scene. Excellent public transport links provide easy access to all attractions. Each of the 210 comfortably furnished rooms includes satellite TV, an en-suite bathroom, and a hairdryer. This hotel offers budget-conscious travelers good value. Please note: Breakfast is served in the hotel's breakfast room, but communal areas like the lounge and bar are shared with A&O Hostel Mitte guests. Double rooms are configured as twin beds. Local city tax is not included in the room rate and is payable upon check-in.

19771.description: This appealing hotel is situated in the lively district of Montparnasse in the south of Paris. The majority of the city's bars, cinemas and restaurants are to be found here as well as in the neighbouring Latin Quarter. In Montparnasse, the so-called Breton quarter, guests will discover countless crêperies, where the Breton speciality of cider may be enjoyed. Montparnasse Tower, which is the tallest building in Paris following the Eiffel Tower, visible from far away and acts as the local landmark, is only a few steps from the hotel. Also only a few minutes away is a cemetery with the graves of Jean-Paul Sartre and Simone de Beauvoir. From Montparnasse Train Station, all other sights of the French capital can easily be reached by metro. Facilities on offer include an inviting foyer with a reception desk as well as restaurant serving top-notch French and international cuisine. There is also a conference room and a public Internet terminal with WLAN access. Room service rounds off the facilities on offer, whilst those arriving by car may take advantage of the hotel garage facilities. The small yet beautiful hotel garden is superb for those wishing to snatch a little time amidst the greenery. The stylish rooms come with a bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, an Internet connection and fax facilities. Also featuring in the rooms are a kitchenette, air conditioning (centrally regulated) and a hire safe. Non-smoking rooms and a wake-up service are also available on request. Guests are also offered a number of spa options.

19857.description: This charming hotel, nestled in Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district (Old City), is within walking distance of iconic attractions such as the Hippodrome Square, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Basilica Cistern. Shops, restaurants, and bars are also conveniently nearby. The hotel offers superbly designed guest rooms that blend traditional elements with modern comforts, ensuring a pleasant stay for all travelers. The Marmara Sea and Istanbul Airport (15 km) are easily accessible.

19877.description: The The Crown London, WorldHotels Distinctive offers 152 tastefully decorated guest rooms, each providing a contemporary yet homely feel. Guests can choose from a variety of room types, including double, twin (double with a single bed), family, superior, suites, and wheelchair-accessible rooms. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Guests can enjoy breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and access the hotel's leisure facilities. The Crown Pub, a beloved local Irish bar, offers a wide selection of beverages and a diverse bar menu.

19903.description: Within walking distance of Lisbon's historic centre, close to Marques de Pombal Square, this hotel provides guests with a cosy base during their stay. Hotel Excelsior offers affordable accommodation in a central location. Have a drink in the hotel bar or read a newspaper in the lobby. All guest rooms include basic yet functional furnishings. Watch the world go by from your window or order in room service. In the meantime, the attentive reception staff can organize a rental car or tour of the city. For your convenience, Hotel Excelsior also offers laundry and business facilities.

19917.description: This luxury hotel lies close to the centre, where numerous shopping and entertainment attractions are located in the area. Public transport departs from stops within minutes of the hotel entrance. The hotel was built in 1995 and consists of 4 floors and a total of 154. Various facilities are available to guests including a foyer with a 24-hour reception, a lift, a safe, a cloakroom and a currency exchange facility. Additional facilities include an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with a separate non-smoking area, a TV room and a conference room. The luxurious rooms come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone and cable or satellite TV. A radio, Internet access as well as a kitchenette is available for the guests comfort as well.

19929.description: Enjoy amenities like a sauna, terrace, and garden at this Berlin hotel. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and take advantage of concierge services. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge and start your day with a cooked-to-order breakfast (fee applies). The hotel also offers a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Each of the 69 guestrooms features an LED TV, cable programming, and a coffee/tea maker. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Located in Berlin's Spandau district, the SensCity Hotel Berlin Spandau is a short drive from Waldbühne and Olympiastadion, and within easy reach of Kurfürstendamm and Zoo Berlin.

19959.description: The 4-star NH Berlin Kurfürstendamm is only a short walk away from one of Berlin's main shopping streets and is well connected to the entire city. With a privileged location in Charlottenburg, guests can visit the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, Charlottenburg Castle and Berlin Zoo on foot. For Berlin's Main Station and the ICC Exhibition center, take a direct train from the Uhlandstrasse metro stop. To enjoy stylish bars and restaurants head to the nearby Savignyplatz Square. NH Berlin Kurfürstendamm is the definition of classic meets contemporary. The spacious rooms are designed in a neutral color palette, and feature comfortable mattresses, flat-screen TVs, tea and coffee makers, as well as free Wi-Fi. For a little more luxury, guests staying in the Suite will have access to a large private terrace. In the morning, enjoy a large spread for breakfast with hot dishes made to order, accompanied by hot and cold beverages. Throughout the day guests can order drinks and snacks from the Van Gogh bar. For convenience, there is also a 24/7 Open Bar.

19961.description: Scandic Berlin Kurfuerstendamm is close to the Kurfuerstendamm shopping street and the famous KaDeWe department store in the heart of Berlin, and the Scandic Berlin Kurfuerstendamm is ideally located just a short journey from the city's exhibition halls. Ideal for sightseeing, shopping and business, the hotel has modern rooms and facilities, including a well-equipped gym. The hotel serves a hearty breakfast and has a conservatory terrace where guests can enjoy a coffee during the summer months. The guest rooms have modern decor and charming views of the city, air conditioning, flat screen TV. Secure parking is available for an additional fee.

20062.description: Rayelin Hotel Taksim is located in the heart of Istanbul at Taksim Square, surrounded by one of the most stylish districts in Turkey and close to the main places of interest in the city. Its 120 spacious rooms and suites are carefully designed to offer maximum relaxation with all their facilities and unique atmosphere. Explore ıstanbul’s hıstorıc heart from Rayelin TaksimLuxury hotel ın the Taksim. located just steps fromTaksim Square, İstiklal Street, Galata Tower, DolmabahcePalace, Pera-Beyoglu, Lutfi Kirdar Convention Centre, Istanbul Congress Centre, Cemal Resit Rey Concert Halland Muhsin Ertugrul Theatre and all local monuments.

20063.description: This special-category hotel is located in the heart of the old city, across from the Grand Bazaar and within a 5-minute walk of Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, and the Blue Mosque. Atatürk Airport is 18 km away, while Istanbul International Airport is 45 km away. The hotel offers 96 elegantly decorated rooms equipped with electronic safes, air conditioning, minibars, satellite TV, and luxurious private bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. A breakfast buffet featuring 40 menu options, including Turkish specialties, is served daily. Guests can relax in the full-service spa and experience natural therapies and treatments, including a sauna and resting areas. The hotel also offers meeting rooms with equipment and internet access for business travelers.

20064.address: Muhsine Hatun Mah.Cifte Gelinler Cad. 3 Kumkapi, 3-7
20064.description: Amber Hotel is set near the sea side, in the oldest and most colourful district of Istanbul, which is still a functioning fishing village. It is in walking distance from the Sultanahmet Sq. with Istanbul's most famous Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and Top Kapi Palace. The boutique hotel's building is a sample of Ottoman style, newly renovated and offers an authentic atmosphere for a lovely quiet get away for all kind of travellers. Guestrooms are spacious and comfortably furnished. Suites with city view and sea view are available.

20066.description: Set in the heart of Istanbul with the city's world-famous attractions just steps away, this award-winning hotel offers an unbeatable location. Visitors can shop at the Grand Bazaar, admire the renowned Hagia Sophia, and marvel at the Blue Mosque, the world's only six-minaret mosque, all less than 15 minutes walk from the hotel. Shops, restaurants, cafes, bars and excellent nightlife to suit guests' every whim and desire can be found in the immediate vicinity. The hotel's 34 bright and cosy rooms are air-conditioned and en suite with free WIFI, 24-hour room service and daily housekeeping services. Guests can relax with a drink after a long day of sightseeing in the 24-hour lobby bar, and will delight in authentic Turkish cuisine at the elegant restaurant. Whether travelling for business or leisure, with family or for a weekend getaway, this hotel offers a central location and comfortable rooms for a pleasant, stress-free stay.

20067.address: Küçük Ayasofya Mh, Küçük Ayasofya Cd. No:26, 26
20067.description: This charming boutique hotel is centrally located just minutes from Istanbul's most celebrated attractions including the Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar and Blue Mosque, all less than 15 minutes from the hotel by foot. The hotel gets its name from the exemplary 5th century Byzantine cistern that lies just behind it and is available for viewing free of charge for all guests. The hotel's 21 generous rooms were completely renovated in 2010 and come with air-conditioning, free wireless internet, a free copy of Time Out Istanbul and Turkish delight for guests to sample, while the lobby offers a daily English newspaper, chess and several helpful guidebooks. Guests can wake up to a wholesome and varied buffet breakfast, and enjoy a drink in the bar or terrace after a long day of sightseeing. The hotel is family-owned and operated, and its friendly and cheerful staff are happy to help guests with any questions they may have about the city orTurkish culture and history.

20068.description: This contemporary and exclusive hotel is situated near Istanbul's commercial and entertainment centre Gayrettepe. Business travellers will appreciate its proximity to the airport, only 25 minutes away, as well as Lutfu Kirdar and Sutluce Convention Centres and Taksim Square, providing easy access to the city's thriving business world. Meanwhile, sightseers can visit the nearby Ataturk Museum, and the cultural attractions of the historical peninsula such as Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque are within easy reach via metro. Rooms are luxurious and spacious, with modern décor and clean lines. The hotel offers a business centre capable of hosting conferences for up to 500 people as well as several meeting spaces for smaller groups, all equipped with the latest technology and with exquisite catering options available. With its superb conference facilities and central location, this hotel is ideal for hosting events or for exploring the city.

20069.description: Perfectly situated only 1 minute from the Taksim Square, the vibrant heart of Beyoğlu and of Istanbul, this elegant hotel is an ideal base to explore the Turkish capital. It features a bar, 1 restaurant, an indoor pool, spa & wellness centre, fitness centre and conference facilities. Nearby public transport links offer connections to the whole city.

20071.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a reception hall. Grab a bite to eat at the hotel's restaurant, which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, express check-in, and express check-out. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 24 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Hagia Sophia - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Sultanahmet Square - 0. 6 km / 0. 3 mi- Blue Mosque - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Basilica Cistern - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Gülhane Park - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Istanbul Archaeology Museums - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Little Hagia Sophia - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Cemberlitas Bath - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Grand Bazaar - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Topkapi Palace - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Bosphorus - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Beyazit Square - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Eminonu Pier - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 45 km / 28 mi Istanbul Airport (IST) - 43. 4 km / 27 mi The preferred airport for Yusufpasa Konagi - Special Class is Istanbul Airport (IST). A stay at Yusufpasa Konagi - Special Class places you in the heart of Istanbul, within a 10-minute walk of Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. This hotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 6 km) from Sultanahmet Square and 0. 4 mi (0. 7 km) from Basilica Cistern.

20072.description: The hotel is situated in the middle of Istanbul's many historical attractions, close to sights and shopping centres such as the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace and the Grand Bazaar, all within just few minutes' walking distance. The hotel's location, in one of the oldest and most colourful quarters of Istanbul. With a total of 42 rooms on offer, the air-conditioned establishment comprises a lobby with 24-hour reception, currency exchange facilities, cloakroom, lift access, a café, bar and restaurant. The conference facilities may be of use to business guests. Those arriving by car may make use of the car park and garage. A breakfast buffet is served at the hotel.

20076.description: At Casa de Juste, these facilities were once a wine cellar and today, after a detailed re-construction, they are a charming and attractive place for tourist accommodation. Located in a privileged area of ​​the property, this building allows all rooms to have a view of the vineyards, located in the heart of Casa de Juste. The existing rooms can be of single, twin and double rooms, all with private bathroom. On the floor with access to the outside, there is a vast leisure area, comfortably decorated. In the adjacent internal area, there is a dining room where breakfast and dinner are served.

20080.description: Situated in the historic city of Antalya, Turkey, this beautifully decorated hotel offers wonderful views of the Mediterranean Sea. Public transport runs near the hotel, providing easy access to the city center. The airport is conveniently located just a 25-minute car ride away. Nearby, guests will find several restaurants, cafes, and bars, perfect for enjoying a lovely evening meal. There are also many shopping opportunities for those seeking souvenirs. Guests can savor an elegant dinner with an incredible sea view, enjoy drinks at the bar, indulge in the spa, sunbathe by the outdoor pool, or take a refreshing swim. Comfortable and bright rooms, equipped with essential amenities, ensure a restful night's sleep.

20096.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Concierge, Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Pool, Room Service, Spa, Valet Parking. Experience one of France's leading luxury retreats at Trianon Palace Versailles, A Waldorf Astoria Hotel. Set amid the tranquil, three acre Parc de Versailles - located on the edge of the Royal Domain - the Palace is less than a mile from Louis XIV's world-famous Chateau de Versailles. Find peace amongst the centuries-old trees and verdant, rolling gardens of the estate - recently revitalized by world-famous landscape designer Louis Benech. Dine at the Michelin-starred Gordon Ramsay au Trianon, or enjoy a meal the relaxed La Veranda by Gordon Ramsay - serving fine French cuisine in approachably luxurious settings. Set in the nation's former power center, Versailles maintains a significant link with luxury and prestige - and is minutes from some of France's most exclusive golf courses, including Le Golf National. Only 30 minutes by car to the capital, it is close to a number of legendary Paris attractions - including Arc de Triomphe, the Eiffel Tower and the Louvre. From the sumptuously appointed decoration to the gourmet French restaurant by world-famous Chef Gordon Ramsay - indulge all of your senses, or relax in the oasis-like retreat of the Spa Guerlain within a hammam, steam room & Grecian-inspired heated indoor swimming pool. Cradle yourself in the luxury of the Trianon Palace Versailles, and appreciate the devoted, dedicated services of the staff.

20158.description: This modern, themed hotel is around 10 minutes from the congress centre and 15 minutes from the city centre, where there is a plethora of restaurants, bars, and nightclubs. The hotel restaurant offers lunch and evening menus with regional specialties inspired through the traditions of the Yucatan peninsula. Cancun International Airport is located 30 minutes from the hotel.

20184.description: Canon Court Apartments offer stylish 4-star accommodations conveniently located within a mile of Edinburgh's vibrant Princes Street and Waverley Rail Station. A large supermarket is a mere 150 meters away, and the surrounding local shops, restaurants, and bars create a charming village atmosphere. The 41 contemporary apartments, spread across two four-story buildings, are brightly decorated and feature separate living rooms, kitchens, and bathrooms. All apartments offer complimentary Wi-Fi, a 32-inch TV with Freeview channels, a DVD player, a dining area, and a tiled bathroom with a shower/tub combination. Bedrooms can be configured as a double bed or twin beds upon request. A convenient on-site car park is available (chargeable). For stays of 7 days or longer, a complimentary weekly refresh service includes a change of bed linen and towels. Additional services are available for a fee. Local bus services to Princes Street are located directly outside the apartments. Edinburgh International Airport is 8 miles away and easily accessible by shuttle, taxi, or airport bus. The railway and bus station are a 15-minute walk or a 5-minute taxi ride away.

20298.description: The hotel is located in the historical heart of the city, right next door to Haymarket station and only 4 minutes away on foot to Edinburgh International Conference Center. Varied selection of cafes, bars and restaurants are situated next to the hotel. Explore the numerous sights and events of the city such as Edinburgh Castle, Edinburgh Zoo, Murrayfield Stadium and much more. The hotel offers many modern rooms equipped with free Wi-fi. Have a refreshing start to the day with a an abundant Scottish breakfast buffet and enjoy traditional and modern dishes at the restaurant. Modern and well-equipped meeting room venues are available for business meetings.

name.content: Perre La Mer Resort and Spa

21003.description: Recently refurbished, this luxury hotel is located by the Turkish Riviera on the beautiful Mediterranean Coast. Guests staying at the hotel will be able to enjoy the stunning background of the Olympus and Taurus Mountains. The hotel is approximately 6 km from the largest resort of Kemer and 52 km from Antalya airport. The property comprises a total of 320 spacious and luminous guestrooms distributed into three floors. Set in spacious gardens leading down to the pebbly private beach and jetty, the hotel features three outdoor pools, a hammam and a gym among other facilities. There are different types of restaurant on site, where guests will be able to savour, delicious Turkish delights and there is a bar where they can enjoy a cocktail or an exotic juice

21021.description: Located in the centre of Kemer, the hotel is conveniently close to the many amenities of the resort. Guests use the facilities of the sister hotel which is by the beach and just a couple of minutes' walk away. With the Taurus Mountains as a backdrop and the turquoise waters of the Mediterranean to the fore, Kemer is surrounded by natural beauty. Public transport is less than a 5-minute walk away providing access to the remains of the old city of Phaselis and the shopping mecca and pretty harbour area in Antalya city, 50 km away.

21031.description: This charming apartment hotel is situated in the coastal city of Side, just a five minute stroll from the sea and within easy reach of the resort town's shops, cafes and restaurants. Side, which means ‘pomegranate, ' is an ancient Mediterranean city dating back to the Hittite period, thus offering a rich history and a plethora of ancient ruins throughout the region, including remarkable castles and city walls, beautiful Roman temples and amphitheatres. The hotel's 85 apartments are air-conditioned and spacious with two bedrooms, sitting area, kitchen, and balcony overlooking the hotel gardens and pools. Guests may lounge by one of the two sparkling outdoor pools or relax in the Turkish baths, while younger guests can play in two children's pools, kid's club, or the playground. There is also a shuttle service to the nearby sandy beach. This hotel is the perfect place for families to enjoy a relaxing holiday in the warm Mediterranean sunshine.

21035.description: Alp Pasa Hotel is a popular choice amongst travelers in Antalya, whether exploring or just passing through. The hotel offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. All the necessary facilities, including 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, fireplace, are at hand. Television LCD/plasma screen, mirror, slippers, towels, closet can be found in selected guestrooms. To enhance guests' stay, the hotel offers recreational facilities such as hot tub, outdoor pool, massage, garden. Alp Pasa Hotel combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make your stay in Antalya unforgettable.

name.content: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara ADULT ONLY

21037.description: Set high on a cliff-top overlooking the deep blue water of the Mediterranean Sea and rocky grey Bey mountains, this attractive hotel offers spectacular views and comfortable rooms for a luxurious holiday in the sun. The hotel is just outside the city of Antalya in the Lara beach area, where aside from sea and sun, visitors can enjoy remarkable cultural attractions such as Hadrian's Gate, the historic old town and several stunning mosques. The hotel's rooms are stylish and contemporary with air-conditioning and wireless internet. Guests can relax and rejuvenate in the hotel spa complete with traditional Turkish bath, sauna, hot tub, indoor swimming pool, steam room, vitamin bar and massage services, or simply relax with a book by the shimmering outdoor pool. The hotel restaurant serves a varied and wholesome breakfast buffet as well as lunch and dinner, and there is also an a la carte seafood restaurant where guests can enjoy panoramic views and delicious coastal cuisine.

21039.description: This hotel in Alanya is set in lush gardens and has a private beach on the Mediterranean Sea. Located by a bay with a long, sandy beach which gently slopes into the sea, it is a short walk from the centre of Avsallar, where guests will find shops, restaurants, cafes and bars.
