There are public transportation links a few steps from the hotel, to take guests to the popular resort of Alanya with its many attractions, such as Alanya Castle and Damlatas Caves.

21050.description: Set on the edge of a quiet forest, this luxurious hotel provides a space of comfort, peace and tranquillity near Antalya's busy airport. The hotel's 179 rooms are spacious and serene, decorated with a traditional Turkish touch and furnished with an orthopaedic bed, work desk, minibar, air-conditioning and internet access. Guests may get fit in the fully-equipped fitness centre with squash court, relax and rejuvenate at the lavish hotel spa with its sauna, Turkish baths and massage services, and dine in style with romantic forest and pool views. The hotel offers a catered conference centre with four elegant rooms suitable for seminars, meetings, conferences and even celebrations and cocktail events. With its classic service, comfortable rooms, superior conference centre and calming spa, this hotel is ideal for business trips and weekend getaways.

21052.description: This modernly furnished city hotel is very conveniently situated around 1. 5 km from the beach and the city centre where there are numerous shops, entertainment venues and the picturesque Kaleici or Inner Bailey. Public transport passes in front of the hotel while Antalya Airport is located 15 km away. Refurbished in 2011, the hotel features a pleasant garden and outdoor pool and has a total of 7 floors with 64 rooms.

21056.description: This charming city hotel, refurbished in 2010, enjoys a prime location in the city center, within walking distance of shops, cafés, restaurants, and the historic Kaleiçi district with its cobbled streets and quaint architecture. Antalya Airport is about 14 km away, and public transport is easily accessible. The hotel offers 35 stylish guest rooms with modern amenities, including air conditioning, en suite bathrooms with showers and hairdryers, and balconies or terraces. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, and on-site parking. Additional amenities include a lobby bar, restaurant, and an outdoor swimming pool with a terrace. For breakfast service, we have implemented a plated breakfast option in place of our previous buffet style. Lunch and dinner are available à la carte. A golf course is located approximately 40 km away in Belek.

name.content: A Good Life Utopia Family Resort

21068.description: Where the unique blue of the Mediterranean meets the lush green hues, A Good Life Utopia Family Resort Hotel awaits discovery, nestled among pine trees in the Okurcalar district of Alanya. A Good Life Utopia Family Resort in Alanya offers a private beach area and beachfront access. Guests enjoy a year-round outdoor swimming pool, sauna, and hot tub. Rooms feature air-conditioning, balconies with sea views, and private bathrooms. Additional amenities include minibars, free toiletries, and parquet floors. The family-friendly restaurant serves halal and vegetarian meals for lunch and dinner. Breakfast includes local specialities, fresh pastries, and a variety of beverages. The resort features a fitness centre, waterpark, and kids' club. Free on-site private parking and a paid airport shuttle service are available. Okurcalar Beach is a 9-minute walk away. Historical Alarahan lies 12 km from the property. Gazipaşa-Alanya Airport is 73 km distant.

21074.description: Located on the cliff tops between the city of Antalya and the resort of Lara, the hotel is conveniently positioned for access to the many tourist attractions of the area. The city centre is approximately 3 kms away and there are transport links from the road in front of the hotel. Antalya Airport is just some 15 kms away. Refurbished in 2019, the hotel has a total of 227 guest rooms. The property also features a car park, games room, and conference facilities. The rooms are equipped with satellite TV, centrally controlled air-conditioning and heating, and a balcony. The outdoor swimming pool area is connected to a sunbathing platform on the beach. In their leisure time guests may enjoy the hammam, sauna, billiards and tennis available at the hotel.

21081.description: Located just 100 meters from magnificent Kleopatra Beach, our hotel offers convenient access to Alanya's key attractions: 1 km from the city center, 2 km from the central bus station, 3 km from Alanya Castle, 45 km from Gazipaşa Airport, and 120 km from Antalya Airport. Our hotel features 107 rooms with 213 beds situated on a 1700 m² property. Enjoy delicious Turkish and international cuisine at our main restaurant, featuring a rich open buffet and themed nights. With a capacity of 150 people, the restaurant offers a perfect setting for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Our all-inclusive package includes local alcoholic and soft drinks, tea, coffee, cappuccino, and espresso between 10:00 and 23:00. Facilities include an indoor and outdoor pool with sunbeds and umbrellas, a fitness center, hot tub, and table tennis. Guests can enjoy 24-hour room air conditioning and fiber internet access throughout the hotel. Evening animation activities are provided during the summer season.

21098.description: This luxurious hotel boasts a prime location in Obagöl, just 5 kilometers from Alanya's center and close to the beach. The hotel's two buildings offer a variety of rooms to suit all needs, each featuring amenities like a private balcony with sea views and air conditioning. Guests can enjoy diverse culinary specialties at the rooftop restaurant and unwind by the magnificent swimming pools with a refreshing drink or snack. Please note: Night soup service is available from 11:30 pm to 12:30 am during the summer season. Family rooms have air conditioning only in the bedrooms; living rooms do not have air conditioning. Wi-Fi is free in the lobby and available for an extra charge in other areas.

21120.description: Just steps away from its own private sandy beach, this resort hotel offers beautiful gardens, sparkling pools with water slides, and cheerful staff for a luxurious holiday in the Mediterranean sun. Guests can meet dolphins, whales and walrus at the impressive Troy Aqua Park and Dolphinarium, or enjoy a game of golf at Gloria Golf Club, both just minutes from the hotel, in addition to excursions to Koprulu Canyon or Zeytintasi Cave. The sports and wellness centres provide opportunities to enjoy a great variety of activities including swimming, tennis, archery, and massages and beauty treatments at the spa. The hotel's sizable and stylish rooms come with modern amenities such as air-conditioning and free internet access, while the restaurants cater to guests' every need with open buffet as well as a la carte options, a special menu for guests with food allergies, and several bars where guests may find drinks and snacks at any hour. Simply the perfect place for a sunny, relaxing holiday.

21127.description: Experience breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea at this Antalya, Turkey hotel, close to many historical sites and beautiful waterfalls. The Best Western Plus Khan Hotel is located in the Antalya, Turkey city center, only a short distance from Antalya International Airport. A short walk from this completely renovated hotel, guests will find themselves in historic Old Antalya, surrounded by modern businesses and eclectic shopping opportunities. Come experience historical Antalya Castle and other ancient architecture that intermingle with Antalya's modern buildings. Nearby Konyaalti Beach offers guests resort-style attractions and breathtaking sunny shores. Outdoor activities nearby include white water rafting, winter sports, hiking stunning waterfalls, and exploring archeological ruins. Our Mediterranean Sea hotel offers guests the most comfortable of accommodations. Our cheerful, reliable staff will ensure the newly remodeled rooms and amenities please guests of all ages. Relax and unwind by our outdoor pool and sundeck, or spend time in our on-site game room. Our rooms offer all the comforts of home, including cable television and telephone. Come experience the beauty of Antalya, Turkey and the Mediterranean region at the Best Western Plus Khan Hotel. Enjoy your stay.

21129.address: Saray Mah. Alaaddin Çikmaz Sk. No 3 Alanya, 3
21129.description: The family-run hotel is situated in the bustling city of Alanya on the Turkish Riviera, only 2 minutes' walking to the well-known Kleopatra beach. The famous Red Tower is only 2 km away, the centre of Alanya with its shopping possibilities is at a distance of 1. 5 km. The 5-storey hotel features 60 rooms, 24-hours reception, currency exchange, restaurant, bar, outdoor pool, children's pool, designated smoking area, free WIFI in public areas, laundry service, car rental and free public parking close-by.

21137.description: The hotel was built in 1997 and completely renovated in 2011. It consists of a total of 114 rooms spread over seven floors and two buildings. Located just 800 metres from the centre of Alanya and only 300 metres from the beach, the hotel is ideally situated for those wishing to be close to local amenities while enjoying a relaxing holiday of sea and sun. Guests can benefit from the hotel's facilities which include a hairdressing salon, a TV and internet corner, a bar and restaurant as well as the hotel's attractive 600-square-metre garden with sun-bathing terrace and two pools.

21151.description: This hotel is located close to the Taksim Square in the Beyoğlu district of Istanbul, the pulsing cultural heart of the city. Guests will find themselves among art galleries, concerts, opera and theater, cinemas, places of entertainment, cafes and pubs. The Sultanahmet district with its attractions such as Hagia Sophia or Topkapi Palace is 3 km away, Atatürk International Airport 20 km. The hotel offers modern and convenient guest rooms, equipped with air conditioning and private bathroom with shower and bath accessories. Guests can have a taste of Middle East Arab and Mediterranean cuisine at the on-site restaurant while enjoying unique city views through panoramic glass wall on the roof floor.

21152.description: This resort hotel is wonderfully located over-looking the beach in the district of Beldibi; the Taurus Mountains are a back-drop and the larger resort of Kemer is a 10 minute car ride away. Built in the style of a catamaran with a modern interior design and furnishings, the hotel has 223 rooms situated on 15, 000sqm of land. Featuring a range of activities to suit most ages, including a spa, kids club, outdoor & indoor pool, waterslides and a private beach with a decked pier, guests will also enjoy the culinary choices and small, on-sight shopping centre. Public transport and taxis are available in front of the hotel providing easy access to the many attractions to be found in the area. (Some facilities may not be operational year round due to the weather / seasonal conditions).

21156.description: There are a total of 251 accomodation units on the premises. Guests may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection throughout. Champion Holiday Village offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. Unfortunately, there are no units where guests staying at this property can ask for a cot for the little ones. The varied entertainment offer at this hotel guarantees its guests will enjoy their stay. Some services may be payable.

21158.description: This hotel is located approximately 650 meters from Side's sandy beach and offers a complimentary shuttle service to another beach 2. 2 kilometers away. The shuttle runs twice each morning from the hotel and returns twice in the afternoon. Side's town center, with its numerous shops and entertainment venues, is about 2 kilometers away and easily accessible by taxi or minibus. Antalya Airport is approximately 60 kilometers from the hotel. The hotel features 73 rooms in total: 61 family suites and 12 standard rooms. Facilities include two pools (one with a waterslide), a separate children's pool, a restaurant, a TV lounge, a Turkish bath, laundry service, and free Wi-Fi in the lobby. Sunbeds, mattresses, and umbrellas are available free of charge at both the pool and the beach. Standard rooms accommodate two people and feature a shower, WC, hairdryer, telephone, TV, safe, individually controlled air conditioning, and a balcony. Family suites consist of two connecting bedrooms: one with a double bed and the other with two single beds and a sofa. Suites offer the same amenities as standard rooms. Guests should be aware that room electricity is activated by a key card energy saver. Please ensure all missing or damaged items are reported to reception upon check-in to avoid charges. Additional fees apply to towels and linens stained by hair dye, tattoos, or other substances. Bath towels are for in-room use only; beach towels are available for a refundable deposit of €1 or $1, with a €1 or $1 fee for each exchange. Safe rentals cost €14 (or $17) per week. The hotel is not responsible for lost valuables.

21162.description: Inspired by traditional Turkish architecture and nestled on 130, 000 square meters of land amidst pine forests, this resort was renovated in 2015. It boasts a unique location just 3 km from Europe's finest golf courses and ancient Roman cities like Perge, Side, and the Aspendos Amphitheater, a venue still hosting international events.

21165.address: Üç Kum Tepesi Mevkii Kadriye Mah.
21165.description: This popular, family-friendly beach hotel has a total of 594 guest rooms located in 2-3 storey villa blocks on a vast property of 125, 000 m2 in the district of Belek on the south coast. The hotel grounds stretch down to the sandy Blue Flag awarded beach where one of the swimming pools borders the sand offering a great view while taking a swim. Guests can benefit from a wide range of activities and facilities, both relaxing and sports oriented, including a cinema, climbing tower and Turkish lessons. There are also four restaurants and an open-air and indoor bar/disco for later in the evening.

21175.description: The award-winning hotel is the epitome of luxurious beach holidays on the Turkish Riviera. Located on 40, 000 m2, it boasts a privileged position frontline to 200 metres of fine sandy beach and the crystal-clear waters of the Mediterranean Sea. The city centre of Antalya is 12 km away, while the international airport is at 9 km. Stepping inside the hotel, guests will feel like oriental princesses and princes, as the interior decoration of the public areas and the rooms sumptuously reflects the splendour and riches of Ottoman palaces – down to the smallest detail. An indoor and an open-air restaurant tempt the palate of even the most discerning guests, while they can sip on a drink in up to 7 bars. First class features include a sophisticated spa area, sports facilities and fantastic outdoor pools. This hotel is the perfect choice for people looking for a beach holiday in luxurious surroundings, couples on a romantic getaway or honeymooners. *We would like to inform you that we will start renovations in our kitchen department between 03. 01. 2022 and 25. 01. 2022. We will host our guests in a different indoor restaurant.

21184.address: Sönmez Club Salima Beldibi mh. Başkomutan, Atatürk, 147 D1
21184.description:
As the fifth member of the Baia Hotels family, Baia Salima Kemer opens its doors to you, our valued guests, to create unforgettable moments and lasting memories. 

We set out to reinterpret a tradition… Hidden among the lush forests embracing the Taurus Mountains in Antalya – Kemer, we completely renovated this treasure in 2020, respectfully preserving its traditional character while blending it with the distinctive features of our “BAIA” brand, trusted for over 16 years. 

Throughout all our renovations and improvements, we have remained loyal to our foundation of being an excellent Ultra All Inclusive Family Resort in Kemer, while also shaping our concept standards to be an ideal Club Hotel for couples. 

Whether it’s the waves accompanying your seaside walk, the warmth of a beach bonfire that lets your mind drift, an ice-cold cocktail cooling you under the Mediterranean sun… the joy on your child’s face, the loving glance from your partner, or the perfect dessert crowning your evening meal — we invite you to experience countless moments like these at Baia Salima Kemer Antalya. 

Full details of our services and room options can be found on our website. You can also follow our most up-to-date photos and videos on our Instagram page and YouTube channel.

21199.address: Şirinyalı Mah. Lara Cad. No:24, 07100 Muratpasa
21199.description: Akra Antalya redefines the luxury hotel experience by moving beyond a numbers-focused approach to tourism. With its innovative Urban Social concept, the hotel offers a fresh perspective, prioritizing touch, flavor, community, sound, experience, and healthy living, all rooted in emotional and experiential connections. Boasting 471 Deluxe and Suite rooms with breathtaking views of the Mediterranean and Bey Mountains, Akra Antalya enriches the city’s cultural fabric, earning recognition in areas ranging from gastronomy and entertain ment to music and sports. To cover any additional expenses that may arise during our guests’ stay at the hotel, a deposit will be collected or a pre-authorization will be placed on their credit card at check-in.

21201.description: This city hotel is situated on a main road, close to the city centre. Convenient public transport links may be found right next to the hotel, making other areas of the city easily accessible. It is just 500 m to the wonderful, sandy beach. Restaurants, bars and nightclubs are approximately 250 m away. The hotel was built in 1997 and consists of 4 storeys with 48 double rooms. The hotel's facilities include a pleasant lobby with a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, a currency exchange desk, a TV room and lifts. Dining options include a bar and an air-conditioned restaurant with an indoor and outdoor area. The cosily furnished rooms all include en suite bathroom and are well-equipped as standard. The hotel offers a freshwater swimming pool, sun loungers, parasols and cushions. Guests are invited to serve themselves from the buffet at breakfast, lunch and dinner. Only wine and beer are available in the all inclusive concept.

21230.address: Sorgun mah. Titreyengol mevkii, Kume evler, 8
21230.description: Surrounded by a pine forest, this attractive hotel with its distinctive architecture is located in the marvellous area around the beautiful Lake Titreyengöl, just a 5-minute walk from the beach. Indoor pool, outdoor pool, sports facilities and a fitness centre invite to be active during the holidays. The historic town of Side with its ancient sites is 5 km away, the international airport of Antalya about 65 km.

21234.description: This hotel is located directly opposite Cleopatra Beach, in the centre of Alanya. Shopping establishments, cafes, restaurants, and entertainment venues are within a short walking distance. Public transportation is just 20 meters from the hotel. Local attractions include Alanya Castle, Alanya Dockyard and Arsenal, the Red Tower, Alanya Archaeological Museum and Damlatas Cave.

21242.description: Refurbished in 2012, this air-conditioned beach hotel comprises a main building and an annexe with a total of 273 rooms. Located on the Mediterranean coast between the resorts of Side and Alanya, the family-friendly hotel has palm tree filled gardens which lead down to Karaburun Beach where guests can enjoy the hotel's private facilities. The main road is a couple of minutes' walk away where public transport and a local bazaar are available.

21247.description: Set just outside the popular resort town of Belek, Gloria Verde Resort is just a short stroll from Gloria Golf Club with its 45-hole golf courses, and guests can enjoy free shuttle services to and from the links. Rooms are comfortable and spacious with terrace or balcony, air conditioning and wireless internet access. Guests can enjoy healthy, low-calorie dining in the hotel's buffet or a la carte restaurants or a luxurious breakfast in bed with 24-hour room service. The hotel has a wonderful outdoor pool surrounded by carefully landscaped gardens as well as a games room, children's playground and fitness centre and spa. The area has been home to loggerhead sea turtles for thousands of years, and the hotel therefore takes special precautions so as not to disturb this special and endangered species. For golf enthusiasts as well as beach and nature lovers, this hotel offers the ideal retreat for a relaxing and fun-filled holiday.

21249.description: Situated on Colakli's sandy Mediterranean beach in Turkey, this family-friendly hotel offers a wide range of activities, including access to some facilities at its sister hotel next door. Refurbished in 2013, the hotel features modern accommodations and various dining, bar, and entertainment options. Local attractions are easily accessible by public transport near the hotel, and a taxi rank is conveniently located near the entrance. The remarkable Roman and Hellenistic ruins of Side, along with numerous souvenir shops, are just 12 km away. (Some facilities may be unavailable due to weather/seasonal conditions. )

21251.description: The hotel is located just 600m from the beach and 8km from the resort of Side and its many shops, bars and restaurants and ancient ruins. Renovated in 2012, this air-conditioned hotel is surrounded by extensive gardens and comprises 180 rooms over 4 floors with additional rooms in bungalow type buildings in the grounds. The inviting lobby offers guests a 24-hour reception desk, a lift, a currency exchange desk and a safe. The hotel also has a bar, a hairdressing salon, an auditorium, a games room and a TV room. Further facilities include an A la carte restaurant and a conference room. The tasteful rooms each come with a bathroom and fully - equipped as standard. Some rooms are without a balcony.  There is a swimming pool and activity pool and a poolside snack bar in the well-kept outdoor complex. In addition, there is a sauna, a steam room and various massage treatments on offer.

21272.description: Situated just steps from Kleopatra Beach and a short 1 km from Alanya's vibrant center, this beach hotel offers convenient access to a variety of shopping venues, bars, restaurants, and nightclubs. Local attractions, including Alanya Castle, the Red Tower, and Damlatas Cave, are easily accessible. Antalya Airport is 118 km away, with taxis and minibuses readily available for transport.

21274.address: Karaburun Mah. Alparslan Türkeş Bul. No:259
21274.description: This family-friendly bungalow complex sits on a long sandy and shingle beach in Okurcalar, between Side and Alanya. Local transport is readily available from the main road, just 50 meters away. Nearby attractions include Manavgat (a 20-minute drive) and the Side amphitheater, museum, and Temple of Apollo (25 minutes by car). Antalya Airport is approximately 90 km away. The complex spans 50, 000 m² and comprises 47 bungalow-style blocks, ranging from two to three stories high. This air-conditioned hotel offers a total of 404 rooms and welcomes guests with a 24-hour reception and check-out service. Catering to an international clientele, the hotel also features conference facilities, a hairdressing salon, an auditorium, and a restaurant. Each of the spacious rooms includes a fully equipped bathroom.

21286.address: Obagol Mevkii Mersin Yolu Uzeri Alanya, *
21286.description: Our hotel offers 220 comfortable rooms, including 20 family rooms and 200 standard rooms, spread across three 7-story buildings, each equipped with elevators. Most rooms feature sea views and amenities such as satellite TV, air conditioning, telephone, hairdryer, minibar, and a balcony. Guests can enjoy a variety of delicious meals in our 400-seat restaurant, open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The S Bar provides a relaxed atmosphere for evening entertainment, and occasional animation activities add to the fun. For recreation, we offer a large swimming pool (13x22 meters), a waterslide, and ample sunbathing areas for both children and adults.

21306.description: Situated in the heart of Alanya, Kaptan Hotel boasts a rich history and close proximity to the Seljuk castle walls. Our 49 comfortable rooms offer stunning views of the port and Alanya Bay, blending city life with coastal tranquility. Savor delicious Mediterranean and seafood specialties at our Deck Restaurant. We are conveniently located 125 km from Antalya Airport and 40 km from Gazipasa Airport.

21310.description: Refurbished in 2011, this family friendly beach hotel comprises a total of 506 rooms and is ideal for spa and golf fans. Located on the long, sandy beach in the district of Belek on Turkey's Mediterranean Coast, the complex has many facilities and also caters for football and tennis groups. The golf course is just 300m from the hotel. Public transport and taxis can be found at the entrance of the hotel providing easy access to the city of Antalya, 35km away. (Some facilities may not be operational year round due to seasonal / weather conditions).

21315.description: Akra Kemer, with 360 rooms in 11 different types designed to cater to various needs and tastes. With its modern design and comfortable spaces in its rooms, the facility offers a refreshing and relaxing accommodation experience, making it a favourite among families, couples, and athletes. In addition to its comfortable rooms, the main restaurant, 5 à carte restaurants, 6 bars, Başka Ol Café and Luna Jazz Bar offer a variety of cuisines to its guests to enjoy, making your holiday a delightful experience. In addition to sports, the resort caters to all age groups and preferences with five heated indoor and outdoor pools of different sizes and concepts. In order for the families to enjoy their holiday with their children, the facility offers a wide range of activities and entertainment. Akra Kemer offers a unique spa experience for those wanting to turn their holiday into a wellness journey

21319.description: This luxury hotel is situated in the tourist center of Kiris, conveniently located on a main street. Kemer's town center is a 20-minute drive away, while Antalya and Antalya Airport are approximately 50 km and 55 km from the hotel, respectively. This family-friendly hotel offers 410 luxuriously appointed rooms equipped with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy various facilities, including a nightclub, a games room, a selection of shops, a conference room, and public internet access in the lobby and meeting rooms. Dining options include a bar, a main restaurant, and a child-friendly restaurant. Younger guests will appreciate the playground and kids' club. In addition to several pools, the hotel offers a range of water sports, including aqua aerobics. Guests can also play bocce ball, tennis, billiards, and more. For relaxation, various spa treatments are available. Children can participate in an organized activity program. The hotel operates on an all-inclusive basis from November 1, 2017, to March 31, 2018.

21336.description: Surrounded by lush, green pine forest just outside of Belek, this resort hotel offers elegant poolside and sea view rooms as well as bungalows nestled between trickling streams and forest trees. Golf enthusiasts can enjoy complimentary use of the driving range and putting greens, and the hotel partners with several local courses to offer special discounts at the links with gorgeous, panoramic views of the area's stunning landscape. The area has something for everyone, including spectacular beaches, craggy mountains and ancient ruins, and the hotel offers an impressive array of activities for sports, spa and wellness, and entertainment as well as seven restaurants and nine bars catering to guests' every whim. The hotel's 455 classic rooms are bright and cheery, featuring wood carved ceilings typical of the region. This hotel is perfect for any type of travel, from business to leisure, or family fun in the sun to romantic getaways for two.

21340.description: Nestled amidst the serene natural beauty surrounding Lake Titreyengöl, this popular hotel is just a short 5-minute stroll from a picturesque sand-and-pebble beach. Guests can enjoy a variety of sports facilities, including a refreshing pool with slides, and unwind in the tranquil spa area. The hotel's 239 rooms feature laminate flooring and convenient amenities. A vibrant entertainment program offers 18 different activities, 6 days a week, and a lively disco operates during summer evenings. The center of Manavgat, with its diverse shops and restaurants, is only 5 km away, while Antalya International Airport is 70 km from the hotel.

21345.description: This resort is located in the small coastal district of Goynuk, on the Mediterranean coast of Turkey. The resort hotel is situated just a short distance away from a wealth of attractions in the area. The larger resort of Kemer is located just a 15 minutes' bus journey away. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to a host of shopping, dining and entertainment venues. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. This wonderful resort comprises beautifully-designed guest rooms. The hotel features an endless choice of exemplary facilities and services. Guests of all ages will be pleased by the resort's first-class amenities. Guests can indulge in the ultimate relaxation and rejuvenation in the spa. The hotel also features a mini and teenage club, as well as a choice of outdoor pools and waterslides.

21366.description: Constructed on an area measuring 120, 000 m2, this spacious 5-star holiday village has an Ottoman-Selcuk architectural style and is ideal for families with children. The complex consists of a main building and 2-3 floored club buildings. Located close to Belek on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, the complex features a large sandy beach with a sun-bathing jetty. Public transport and a taxi rank are available at the hotel entrance. For golf lovers there is a golf course opposite the hotel. (Some facilities may not be operational year round due to weather/seasonal conditions).

21376.description: This resort hotel is perfect for every type of traveller. The resort is set on the beach, in the Alara District. The resort is set between Side and Alanya, lying within easy access of a wealth of attractions. The hotel enjoys close proximity to many shopping, dining and entertainment venues. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. This charming hotel enjoys a wonderful design, combining contemporary and traditional styled. The guest rooms are sublimely designed, featuring refreshing tones and a peaceful ambience. Guests can indulge in a spot of pampering and invigorating treatments in the spa and beauty centre. The hotel also features a kids club, ensuring fun for guests of all ages.

21387.description: Located on Alanya's renowned Cleopatra Beach, our beachfront hotel offers 84 rooms across two three-story buildings, nestled amidst the Mediterranean's natural beauty. A short 10-minute walk places you in the heart of the city center, with convenient access to public transportation just 2 minutes away. Enjoy stunning views of the sea, marina, and historic castle from our modern restaurant while savoring delicious meals and drinks. Children will delight in the dedicated play area, while adults can relax by the pool or engage in friendly competition with darts, table tennis, and more. Our all-inclusive concept ensures a hassle-free stay, with complimentary beach access, sun loungers, and umbrellas. Guests also enjoy free use of the traditional Turkish bath. *Freshly squeezed fruit juices, Turkish coffee, ice cream, and alcoholic beverages (excluding wine and beer) are subject to an additional charge. We are conveniently located 45 km from Gazipasa Airport and 125 km from Antalya Airport.

21394.description: The Nova Park Hotel offers guests a comfortable stay just 200 meters from the beach in Side, one of Turkey's most popular tourist destinations. With 326 rooms, including standard rooms and suites, the hotel provides a variety of accommodation options. Guests can easily access the beach via a private pathway or take advantage of the shuttle service, which runs every 5 minutes. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The hotel is located approximately 4 km from Side, 6 km from Manavgat, 64 km from the airport, and 70 km from Antalya city center.

21412.description: Located in the Kizilagac resort area, the hotel is 20 kilometres from the historical town of Side. Antalya Airport lies some 80 km away from the hotel. This first-rate holiday village occupies 183, 000m2 of land and boasts spacious, landscaped gardens leading down to the private beach. The hotel features 586 guest rooms equipped with satellite LED TV, direct dial phone, mini-bar, split A/C (heating-cooling), laminate floor, bathroom with bath-Shower, hair dryer. Guests might venture into Side to visit the stunning ruins of the Temple of Apollo and ancient theatre, or simply lounge by the hotel's expansive outdoor pool and relax in the spa and wellness centre with Turkish bath, sauna, relax pool and massage services. The complex has a wide range of activities and amenities especially suitable for families. Culinary facilities include a buffet restaurant and choice of five restaurants serving international cuisines, all for a fun-filled holiday by the sea.

21413.description: The Palm D'or Hotel offers guests a choice of indoor and outdoor pools, complete with a sun-lounger terrace. Each air-conditioned room features a private balcony. The hotel provides non alchol all inclusıve service and boasts a rich open buffet featuring Turkish and international cuisine in its restaurant, which seats 200 indoors and 100 outdoors. All rooms are well-equipped. Buffet-style breakfasts , Lunch and dinners are served in the hotel restaurant, and drinks are available at the poolside bar. Antalya International Airport is 65 km away, and the hotel offers a 24-hour shuttle service.

21419.description: This exclusive luxury hotel sits on a beautiful 18-kilometer sandy beach on the Turkish Riviera in the heart of Belek, surrounded by pine trees. Convenient minibus connections are available to Antalya and Side. Renovated in 2011, this excellent hotel comprises 490 rooms spread across a three-story main building and several one- to three-story bungalow buildings. Guests can enjoy a spacious foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, safe, currency exchange, cloakroom, and conference room. A cozy bar, café, newspaper stand, hair salon, shops, nightclub, auditorium, small supermarket, and restaurant offer further amenities. All rooms have an en suite bathroom and are fully equipped.

21420.description: This exclusive beach hotel is located directly on the beach. Belek is about 5 kms away. There is a minibus that runs twice a day to Antalya and once a day to Side. The airport is 35 kms away. Opened in 2002, this hotel includes a total of 338 rooms. Each of them is tastefully furnished with modern amenities and Internet access. The hotel offers access to various shops, a bar, a nightclub, an auditorium, a games room, an air-conditioned main restaurant with non-smoking area, and a number of à la carte restaurants. Additionally, a conference room, a public Internet terminal, car park, playground and a kid's club are available. The hotel has two swimming pools with a children's pools, sauna, hammam and a gym. It also offers various water sports. Guests can join the aerobics and archery classes.

21428.description: Located in the beautiful Çamyuva area of Kemer, Antalya, Pasha’s Princess Hotel offers guests a Mediterranean experience enriched with history and environmental awareness. Focused on personalized service and guest satisfaction, the hotel creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Pasha’s Princess is an excellent choice for couples and solo travelers seeking attentive and high-quality service.

21431.description: This family resort has been specially designed for sun & beach holidays and for sport lovers who want to make the most of Turkey's mild weather and pleasant temperatures. With a swimming pool with 6 slides, access to the pools of the Pegasos Complex, kid's club, spa and meeting rooms, the Pegasos Resort is the definite accommodation for your leisure trips to the southwest of Turkey. This popular hotel is perfectly located, separated only by a delightful garden from the beautiful, shallow sandy beach and the crystal-clear waters of the Mediterranean Sea. Guests may use the excellent aqua park of the neighbouring hotel of the same company. The town of Avsallar is within walking distance. The city of Alanya with its castle and the famous Red Tower is about 28 km away, the international airport of Antalya 95 km.

21433.description: This family-friendly hotel is excellently located on the Turkish Riviera, directly on a beautiful golden sandy beach with the warm waters of the Mediterranean Sea. Various restaurants and an aqualand with water slides make every stay pleasant. The town of Avsallar is within walking distance. The city of Alanya with its castle and the famous Red Tower is about 28 km away, the international airport of Antalya 95 km.

21434.description: This family-friendly hotel is situated in the popular holiday region of the Turkish Riviera and enjoys a fantastic huge 10, 000 m2 pool. The beautiful sandy beach is just a short stroll away, the hotel features 4 restaurants and several bars. The historic town of Side with its ancient sites is at a distance of 6 km, the city of Antalya and the international airport are 80 km and 70 km away, respectively.

21437.description: Located in Colakli on a long, sandy beach 9km from the resort and historical town of Side, the holiday village is witihin 500m of local amenities. A large, family oriented holiday village with rooms located in low rise blocks throughout the attractive grounds and a modern lobby and reception hall. There is a main restaurant and during the summer months there are menu restaurants offering a choice of cuisine. The refurbished rooms are well-equipped as standard and have a balcony or terrace. The spa centre has a Turkish bath and sauna and offers treatments and massages. In the grounds there is an aquapark (open summer months) with a number of waterslides including 4 childrens' slides. The holiday village's mini club is for 4-12 year olds and there is also a junior club for 13 to 17 year olds (subject to demand). All meals in the all-inclusive concept are served in open buffet form.

21464.address: Konakli Mahallesi, Konakli Kasabasi, Alanya, S/N
21464.description: The Five Star voted, Turkey's luxurious hotel offers you the finest service and experiences throughout the stay. Royal Garden Suite is situated in Konaklı, in the outskirts of Taurus Mountains, along the beautiful Mediterranean coastline, which is only 110 kms from Antalya Airport and 40 kms from Gazipaşa Airport. The hotel is at your convenience, since all the historical attractions of Alanya is in the range of 14 kms.

21467.description: This attractive, family-friendly resort is set on 15, 000 square metres of land on Turkey's southern coast, just steps from the sandy beach. The resort city of Alanya, where visitors will find a hilltop castle and pretty harbour, is just 12 kilometres away and easily reachable via public transport. Guests can enjoy a sunny, relaxing holiday lounging on the private beach or by the sparkling outdoor pool, and children will delight in the aqua park with three slides, kid's club and special children's buffet at lunch and dinner. The resort provides a wide variety of facilities for sports and leisure, including a fitness centre with tennis courts and a spa with Turkish bath and sauna. The two restaurants and snack bar provide Turkish and international specialties, and guests might make use of the free Wi-Fi provided in all public spaces, all for a spectacular family holiday by the sea.

21478.description: Kamelya Selin Hotel, Keep your standards high. . . When you're ready for a holiday with all the comforts of home, Kamelya Collections offers an impeccable experience that combines hospitality with extraordinary services. At the Selin Hotel, offering the tailored service approach of the Kamelya Collection, you will enjoy a serene holiday in elegant rooms, as well as delightful moments with your loved ones. Our master chefs await you at our restaurants with unique dishes from world cuisines. The varied flavours of the Kamelya Collection will make every moment unforgettable. Our à la carte restaurants, snack bars, cafés and bars are with you throughout your whole stay. With 14 pools within the Kamelya Collection, and an aqua park with distinct architecture, guests of all ages can dive into entertainment. Our splendid 500-metre-long beach will dazzle on its own, and you will enjoy basking on the Mediterranean shore. In our cabanas, located in a private area, you can enjoy delicious dishes from an extensive menu. Free Wi-Fi throughout the whole facility will connect you to the world, so you can share these dreamy moments with your loved ones. Renowned for its ample space, we serve our mini guests with specialised, distinctive entertainment at the Bubble Kids Club. The happiness in your child's eyes will be the most valuable gift of a holiday spent at Kamelya Collection.

name.content: Rixos Downtown Antalya L.O.L.ThemePark Free Access

21487.description: Rixos Downtown Antalya offers guests a fabulous juxtaposition; an urban resort in the centre of Antalya where city and nature collide. With views over the Mediterranean Sea and the Taurus Mountains, the picturesque setting of the Rixos Downtown Antalya makes it a natural choice for anyone seeking rich and varied culture in a resort setting. From the yacht-filled harbour to Hadrian's Gate, a powerful reminder of Turkey's role in the creation of civilisation, it is easy to see the allure of Antalya. Rixos Downtown Antalya gives its guests free access to The Land of Legend Thema park. Complimentary roundtrip shuttle to The Land Of Legends Theme Park (LOL)• VIP entrance to the park from special gate• A Great Opportunity to Experience Spectacular Night Shows and a Unique Setting of an Open-Air Shopping Conditions:• Guests will enjoy unlimited free access to The Land of Legends Theme Park. • Hotel – Park – Hotel transfers shuttles during the day free of charge. Please contact guest relations for shuttle times. • The All Inclusive – All Exclusive concept is available only in Rixos Downtown Antalya only, not valid for the park. • Some services, food & beverages in The Land of Legends Theme Park are subject to a charge. • Theme Park opening and closing dates are subject to change through The Land of Legends Management. • Land of Legends Theme Park Aqualand does not operate in winter season. • Operation days of theme park may be changed or cancelled depending on weather conditions. • Depending on seasonal and operational conditions the operational status of our units may change

21492.description: The hotel with 68 rooms in the main building and 58 apartments on the premises is located within beautifully maintained gardens very close to the sandy private beach, separated only by the lovely seaside promenade. The historic centre of Side can be reached easily. The facilities of the hotel include a reception, 2 restaurants, 2 bars, outdoor pool with children's section, indoor pool, spa and wellness, a minimarket and a children's playground.

21503.description:
This hotel is located in Beldibi-3, around 15 km from Kemer city centre and some 2 km from the tourism centre of Beldibi. It lies around 30 km from Antalya city centre and some 45 km from Antalya Airport.

This family friendly beach establishment comprises a total of 133 rooms with 270 beds, including 127 standard rooms, 2 family rooms and 4 suites. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned hotel include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility, a newspaper stand, a mini supermarket, a bar and a restaurant. Guests may also take advantage of the room and laundry services (both for an additional fee).

All rooms come with a private en suite bathroom with shower and WC, split-system, individually adjustable air conditioning, a direct dial telephone, TV, minibar and a hairdryer. A double bed, individual heating and either a balcony or a terrace are provided in all accommodation as standard.

The hotel features an open air swimming pool and, for an additional fee guests may enjoy a hot tub, a sauna, massage treatments, table tennis, billiards and darts.

Guests may select their breakfast from a buffet and the midday and evening meals are also available in buffet form.

21512.description: Crystal Sunrise Queen Resort & Spa is conveniently located in the popular Side area. The hotel offers a wide range of amenities and perks to ensure you have a great time. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, facilities for disabled guests, express check-in/check-out, luggage storage are on the list of things guests can enjoy. Each guestroom is elegantly furnished and equipped with handy amenities. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include hot tub, private beach, fitness center, sauna, outdoor pool. Crystal Sunrise Queen Resort & Spa combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make your stay in Manavgat unforgettable.

21524.description: Mövenpick Antalya Tekirova Resort is a small picturesque town surrounded by the Taurus mountain range, pine forests and orange groves. The abundance of coniferous trees and the proximity of the mountains make it easier to bear the heat, and the crystal clear sea offers truly unlimited opportunities for those who like to engage in water sports, diving or just enjoy swimming.

21535.description: Situated near the ancient city of Side, Turkey, this hotel offers convenient access to golden-sand beaches and local attractions. Just a short walk from the beach and within a short drive of both Side and Manavgat, guests can easily explore this beautiful Mediterranean region. Combining the comforts of home with unique amenities and attentive service, Turan Prince World promises a memorable stay.

21540.description: This hotel is located on a private sandy beach with a dock over the turquoise water of Mediterranean Sea. Side is 3 km away, with its amphitheatre and ancient city, and it is 5 km to Manavgat. Restaurants, shops, bars and nightclubs can be found in the touristic centre, around 4 km away, and the city centre is approximately 6 km from the hotel. There is a train station 25 m from the hotel.

21547.description: This exclusive luxury hotel enjoys a spectacular setting on its own beach with fine, golden sand, just outside of Antalya. With a Venetian theme in accordance with its name, the hotel offers an impressive range of facilities and services including 24-hour reception and room service, currency exchange, fitness centre, games room, kid's club and playground. There are five restaurants and several bars to choose from offering everything from simple, tasty snacks to traditional Turkish and Italian cuisines, and the hotel puts on its own daily and nightly entertainment programme. Guests may lounge in the sun by the outdoor pool while younger guests play on the waterslides, play a rousing game of tennis or beach volleyball, or find adventure in windsurfing or diving lessons at the nearby beach. For a carefree holiday in the Mediterranean sunshine, this hotel provides the ideal base.

21555.description: Located in the lively and colourful Beyoglu district of Istanbul, this modern hotel is just a 10-minute walk from the Istanbul Museum of Modern Art as well as Taksim Square, Istanbul's dynamic business, shopping and entertainment centre. Transport links are also nearby, making it easy to explore the city from here. The hotel has a unique and contemporary bar-café and a restaurant specializing in Mediterranean seafood, as well as 43 cosy guest rooms equipped with air-conditioning, free WIFI, and en suite bathroom. Guests can wake up to a wholesome breakfast buffet and fantastic city views in the rooftop terrace, and dance the night away in the hotel bar with its own DJ. The hotel also offers a range of services including currency exchange, car rental, tour desk and room service. The combination of service, central location and comfortable rooms make this hotel an excellent choice for business or leisure in historic Istanbul.

21558.description: Stop at Crystal Paraiso Verde Resort & Spa to discover the wonders of Antalya. The hotel offers a wide range of amenities and perks to ensure you have a great time. Facilities like free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, facilities for disabled guests, luggage storage, Wi-Fi in public areas are readily available for you to enjoy. All rooms are designed and decorated to make guests feel right at home, and some rooms come with television LCD/plasma screen, linens, slippers, towels, closet. Enjoy the hotel's recreational facilities, including bowling alley, canoe, dart board, mini golf course, watersports equipment rentals, before retiring to your room for a well-deserved rest. Crystal Paraiso Verde Resort & Spa combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make your stay in Antalya unforgettable.

21561.description: Conjuring up ancient Roman times with its distinctive architecture, this extraordinary hotel is located on the crystal-clear waters of the Mediterranean Sea. The regional capital of Antalya is 50 km away, Antalya Airport can be reached within about 40 minutes. The hotel features 24-hour reception, currency exchange, internet access, conference facilities, 7 restaurants, 10 bars, fitness centre, spa and wellness, 3 outdoor pools, indoor pool, 2 children's pools, sports facilities and medical assistance.

21592.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an indoor pool, an outdoor tennis court, and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at Daphne Restaurant Grill, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Istanbul? This hotel has 356511 square feet (33121 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 13 meeting rooms.

21715.description: Surrounded by orange trees and with the Taurus Mountains as a backdrop, the hotel consists of 170 rooms in three blocks. Located on the road into Kemer, the resort centre is less than a 10-minute walk and the hotel's private section of the beach is 150 m from the hotel. As well as being an area of natural beauty, there are the remains of ancient cities closeby, such as Olympos and Phaselis and the attractive ‘inner bailey' of Antalya city, the Kaleici is within 45 km and can be reached by public transport.

21739.description:
This attractive city hotel is located near to the city centre and distinguishes itself through its central location. Public transport is to be found in the surrounding area (approximately 50 m away). In addition, plenty of shops, countless restaurants, bars and nightclubs are to be found in the neighbourhood. The town centre is within walking distance and takes only half an hour to reach.

This modern hotel consists of a 5-storey building with a total of 24 apartments. The facilities on offer at this hotel include a 24-hour reception, a lobby, a lift and a café. Moreover, there is a restaurant for guests to dine in. In addition, a laundry service is available to hotel guests.

The modern apartments include a combined living/bedroom, a separate bedroom, an en suite bathroom, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, Internet access, a kitchenette, minibar/ fridge and central heating.

Guests are invited to serve themselves from the breakfast buffet.

21741.description:
This hotel lies at the heart of the beautiful French capital, within 140 m of links to the public transport network. Scores of bars, pubs and restaurant lie 100 m away, as do shops 200 m away and a nightclub 300 m away.

This air-conditioned apartment complex consists of 6 floors with a total of 24 apartments. Various facilities are available to guests including a foyer with 24-hour reception desk, a cloakroom, lifts, a café and a lobby bar. The inviting air-conditioned restaurant has a non-smoking area and highchairs for children. There is also a laundry service available to round off the hotel's facilities.

All of the comfortable rooms come with an en suite bathroom and are equipped with a hairdryer, a telephone, satellite/ cable TV, Internet access, a kitchenette, a minibar, a fridge and central heating. All are carpeted and final cleaning of the apartments is included in the price.

Breakfast is available to guests each morning. Guests are invited to serve themselves from the buffet at breakfast.

21780.description:
Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can soak up the sun at the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities including a health club and an indoor pool. Additional features at this property include complimentary wireless internet access, babysitting (surcharge), and an arcade/game room. This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Grab a bite to eat at one of the property's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 2 bars/lounges.

Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

21781.description: The ultra-modern designed Su Hotel blends minimal retro with futuristic chic in brilliant white and combines the convenient location of a city hotel with the advantages of a frontline beach hotel. The rooms are ultra-stylish, decorated completely in white with mood lighting, and boast stunning views over the Mediterranean Sea and the lofty Taurus mountain range. Guests can choose between an outdoor and an indoor pool, use the excellent fitness centre, get pampered in the spa or just enjoy the laid-back atmosphere of the beautiful garden area. Our Aquapark Water Hill is at your service for the 2026 season, admission is free for our guests. Aqualand (Waterhill Water Park) will be closed as of 30 September 2026, with 30 September 2026 being the final operating day of the season. Aqualand does not operate during the winter season. Please note that the opening and closing dates are subject to change depending on weather conditions. The estimated opening date for the 2027 season is May 2027. ”

21786.description: Indulge in a rejuvenating spa treatment, including massages. Take a refreshing dip in one of the two outdoor swimming pools or unwind on the private beach. This all-inclusive hotel offers various amenities, such as Wi-Fi (surcharge), an arcade/game room, and a hair salon. Rates cover meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments, with some exceptions for specialty restaurants, dinners, dishes, beverages, and other amenities. Savor delicious meals at the hotel's restaurant or grab a quick bite at the snack bar/deli. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or beach bar. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Free self-parking is available onsite. The 417 air-conditioned guest rooms offer minibars and private balconies, providing a comfortable retreat. Enjoy satellite television and freshen up in the bathroom with a shower and hair dryer. Located in Alanya, AQI Pegasos Club is by the sea and within a 15-minute drive of Kleopatra Beach and İncekum Plajı. This upscale hotel is also a convenient base for exploring nearby attractions.

21787.description: This luxury hotel comprises 346 rooms spread over 9 floors, in 2 wings. Located across from Antalya's Konyaalti Beach which is connected by a tunnel, this modernly designed hotel offers facilities for leisure and business, having a number of meeting and social function rooms. The city centre is 8 km and can be easily reached by public transport which runs in front of the hotel. An indoor shopping centre is nearby. (Some facilities may not be open year round due to weather and seasonal conditions).

name.content: Rixos Sungate Land of Legend Theme Park FreeAcces

21788.description: Rixos Sungate enjoys an enviable position in the heart of nature. Located in Kemer on the Gulf of Antalya, the resort sits on the golden sands of its glorious private beach, affording a spectacular view of the azure blue Mediterranean. Offering all-inclusive luxury on the edge of the Olympus National Park, home to the Olympos Mountains, the resort also overlooks the Taurus Mountains. It is this stunning backdrop that inspires the extensive leisure facilities on offer. Complimentary roundtrip shuttle to The Land Of Legends Theme Park • VIP entrance to the park from special gate• A Great Opportunity to Experience Spectacular Night Shows and a Unique Setting of an Open-Air Shopping Conditions:• Guests will enjoy unlimited free access to The Land of Legends Theme Park. • Hotel – Park – Hotel transfers shuttles during the day free of charge. Please contact guest relations for shuttle times. • The All Inclusive – All Exclusive concept is available only in Rixos Sungate only, not valid for the park. • Some services, food & beverages in The Land of Legends Theme Park are subject to a charge. • Theme Park opening and closing dates are subject to change through The Land of Legends Management. • Land of Legends Theme Park Aqualand does not operate in winter season. • Operation days of theme park may be changed or cancelled depending on weather conditions. • Depending on seasonal and operational conditions the operational status of our units may change

name.content: Hotel Turan Prince Ex. Sentido Turan Prince

21789.description: This hotel is situated on the outskirts of the beautiful city of Antalya, Turkey. The hotel is by a private sandy beach, surrounded by lush gardens, with a modern and comfortable design. The city of Side with its many shopping and entertainment venues is 12 km from the hotel and it is 100 km to the nearest ski resort as well as 5 km to a selection of nightclubs. Antalya airport is 50 km away and links to the transport network are located directly in front of the hotel.

21791.address: Avda. Lopez Portillo Super 60 Manzana 14 Lote 2
21791.description: Located at the heart of Cancún, this hotel lies within 5 minutes by taxi or bus from the banking district as well as a diverse selection of restaurants and bars, a bus stop, a handicrafts market and a range of shops. Ideal for both business guests and budget travellers, the city may easily be reached on foot. The nearest nightclubs are 12 km away and it is approximately 10 minutes by car to the nearest beach. This hotel comprises 45 rooms of which 6 are suites spread over a 5-storey main building and a single storey annexe block. Amongst the facilities count air conditioning, a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a safe and a lift in addition to a café, a restaurant and wireless Internet access. Room service, a laundry service (charges apply), car parking and a garage are available to guests. Each of the air-conditioned room comes with an en suite bathroom, a direct dial telephone, cable TV, an Internet connection, a minibar and a hire safe. All rooms also feature either a king-sized or double bed and a kitchenette as standard. The nearest golf course is 20 km away. A continental breakfast is on offer to guests each morning; lunch may either be chosen from a menu or taken à la carte. A bed and breakfast only stay may be booked.

21797.description:
Locanda Vivaldi is a 4-star Superior boutique hotel occupying the historic residence of composer Antonio Vivaldi, set on the legendary Riva degli Schiavoni waterfront. Few addresses in Venice can rival this location: steps from St. Mark's Square, the Doge's Palace and the Bridge of Sighs, with the shimmering waters of the San Marco Basin right at the doorstep. 

The hotel's signature feature is its panoramic rooftop terrace, offering breathtaking 180-degree views over the Basin — from the Doge's Palace to the distant Lido. Whether at breakfast or sunset aperitivo, this terrace delivers one of the most unforgettable vistas in all of Venice. The on-site restaurant Prete Rosso serves traditional Venetian cuisine in this spectacular setting. 

The 27 individually decorated rooms blend classic Baroque style with modern comforts, featuring sumptuous fabrics, Murano glass chandeliers and, in many rooms, sweeping lagoon views. Guests may arrive in true Venetian fashion directly at the hotel's private dock via water taxi. 

Locanda Vivaldi is the ideal choice for travellers seeking an authentic, romantic and culturally rich retreat in the very heart of Venice — where history, music and the magic of the lagoon come together in one exceptional stay.

21800.description: Two minutes from the M9 between Stirling and Edinburgh, this old Manor House has been lovingly transformed into a comfortable modern hotel with all the facilities that the modern day traveller would expect from a luxury four-star residence in the heart of central Scotland. Set in its own 44 acres of ground, the Inchyra Grange hotel is in the ideal location to explore the lands where some of the most pivotal moments in Scotland's rich and vibrant history took place. The Wallace Monument, Stirling Castle, Bannockburn Heritage Centre, Edinburgh Castle and the Falkirk Wheel are a few examples of the attractions that lay just a short drive away. Their 98 rooms are all en-suite and come as standard with WiFi access, satellite television and still/sparkling mineral water, as well as all the regular amenities you would expect from a quality hotel. Superior rooms also offer complimentary fruit bowl, slippers and bathrobes. Newspapers, interconnecting bedrooms and dry cleaning / laundry services are also available on request. With excellent chefs and the finest freshest produce, the Priory Restaurant offers a new flavour of Scottish Cuisine, called OPUS 504. Fine, traditionally prepared Scottish beef and wild, fresh fish are the centre-pieces of their mouth-watering menu, with other Scottish favourites like cullen skink and Stornoway black pudding making a welcome appearance. Please note that the hotel doesn't accept any cash payments

21840.description: Enjoying a convenient setting in Barcelona, this lovely hotel is located near to the Parque Güell and the worthwhile attraction of Casa-Museu Gaudí. Links to the public transport network, restaurants and bars are all to be found in the immediate vicinity. Shopping venues are located roughly 1 km from the hotel and the city centre with the Plaça de Catalunya is only around 3 km away. This contemporary and chic establishment provides comfortable, relaxing surroundings and exceptional facilities, making it the perfect choice for business and leisure travellers alike. The hotel's spacious guest rooms are air-conditioned and tranquil to ensure a good night's rest. Guests can wake up to a delicious buffet breakfast for a great start to the day. The attractive establishment also offers daily newspapers, 24-hour reception as well as laundry and room services.

21841.description: This hotel is perfectly located in the commercial district of Vallés. It is situated close to the Baricentro shopping and leisure centre. The lively city centre of Barcelona can be found just 14 km away. Guests will find themselves within easy driving distance of a myriad of attractions and prominent points of interest. This charming hotel appeals to business and leisure travellers alike. The guest rooms and suites are spacious and functional. The rooms are soundproofed for added comfort. The hotel features an extensive range of business facilities and services, including function halls with advanced audio-visual systems.

21947.description: This hotel is centrally located, behind the Palazzo Ducale and between the San Marco and Castello districts of the city. There are many shopping venues and bars located in the hotel's immediate surrounds and St. Mark's Square, the Marciana basilica, the archaeological museum and many more of the city's famous sights are located close by. Links to the public transport network are just 50 m away. This city hotel comprises a total of 25 rooms spread over 4 floors of which 24 are double rooms and 1 is a single room. Guests may make use of the foyer with 24-hour reception desk, a lift, a safe and room service. The welcoming rooms come with a bathroom and well-equipped as standard. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample buffet.

21948.description: Enjoy garden views and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and an elevator. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself at home in one of the 30 air-conditioned guest rooms. Complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. The hotel is conveniently located near Villa Salus Hospital (0. 7 mi), Ferretto Square (1 mi), and Porte di Mestre Shopping Center (1 mi). Other nearby points of interest include Ospedale dell'Angelo (1. 3 mi), San Giuliano Park (2. 7 mi), and the Port of Venice (6. 5 mi). The preferred airport is Marco Polo Airport (VCE), 5. 9 mi from the hotel. With a stay at Club Hotel in Mestre, you'll be within a 15-minute drive of Piazzale Roma and the Port of Venice. This hotel is 6. 9 mi from the Grand Canal and 12. 3 mi from Lido of Venice Beaches.

21949.description: Perched in the centre of Lido of Venice, this elegant hotel boasts quality accommodation in one of the most alluring European cities. The property lies close to the water bus that goes to Venice and its convenient situation allows visitors ease of access to a host of dining options, shopping venues and most important landmarks including the Dodge's Palace and St. Mark's Square. Surrounded by a verdant garden, this attractive establishment is sure to impress guests with a charming Art Nouveau design, fabulous décor and attentive service. Each of the individually designed rooms is sumptuously appointed and offers terrace or balcony some of them featuring views over this beautiful city or the mesmerizing Venetian Lagoon. Some of the rooms feature canopied beds and whirlpool bath for all those wishing to completely unwind after all day of work or sightseeing. Visitors arriving by car may make use of the on-site parking.

21950.description: Located in the heart of Cannaregio's Jewish Ghetto, this charming 4-star hotel in a renovated historic building offers guests an authentic Venetian experience. Its enviable position on the Canal Grande, near Lista di Spagna and Strada Nuova, makes exploring the city a breeze. This BW Premier Collection hotel is steps from the train station and Piazzale Roma, with easy access to vaporetto stops for travel to Rialto and San Marco. Shops, traditional 'bacari, ' and a vibrant neighborhood market are within walking distance. The modern, tastefully furnished rooms offer amenities such as private bathrooms, air conditioning, minibars, kettles, direct-dial phones, satellite TV, and safety deposit boxes. Guests can enjoy views of Lista di Spagna, the adjacent 'Campo, ' and the Canal Grande. Single, twin, double, and triple rooms are available, some featuring comfortable living rooms.

21996.description: This luxurious club resort hotel is set right next to a gently sloping sandy beach, perfect for family holiday of fun in the sun. Guests may enjoy a visit to Kursunlu Waterfall, see some of Turkey's best-preserved ancient ruins in Perge, or simply relax in a sunbed by one of the hotel's seven shimmering pools or at the nearby beach. The hotel's 363 rooms are tastefully decorated, all with free WIFI, air-conditioning, minibar and balcony to better appreciate the fresh, salty sea air. Guests can breakfast and dine at a wholesome and varied breakfast buffet, or choose from five specialty a la carte restaurants serving international dishes including Italian, Mexican and Chinese or traditional Turkish cuisine. The hotel provides its own kids' club with an extensive daily programme of supervised activities for kids and teens of all ages so that parents can relax while both they and their children have the fun-filled holiday of their dreams.

22017.description: This attractive hotel is quietly located in the northeast of Berlin. The Velodrom, the sport forum Hohenschönhausen, Lake Oranke and the idyllic Obersee Park and lake are to be found in the vicinity. The city centre with numerous shopping and entertainment venues as well many magnificent attractions may be easily reached using public transport. Links to the public transport connection is some 200 m from the hotel. Built in 1900 and carefully restored as well as renovated in 2005, this hotel comprises a total of 26 rooms spread over 2 floors. Guests may make use of the foyer, hire safes, lifts and the charming 40-m² gardens. In addition, there are conference facilities, an Internet terminal and an à la carte restaurant. Room and laundry services are on offer. There is also parking for guests arriving by car. The tastefully decorated rooms come with a spacious bathroom with hairdryer, a telephone, an Internet connection with charge, a radio, central heating, a double bed and satellite/ cable TV.

22038.description: The Melia Athens offers upscale accommodations in the heart of Athens, a short walk from Omonoia Square and the National Archaeological Museum. Guests can indulge in the full-service spa, take a dip in the seasonal outdoor pool, or unwind in the steam room. The hotel's 136 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Three restaurants, including the Sky Lounge serving Mediterranean cuisine, provide diverse dining options, complemented by 24-hour room service and a coffee shop/cafe. A poolside bar and a bar/lounge offer relaxing evening drinks. Additional amenities include a business center, concierge services, and gift shops.

22076.description: This splendid hotel enjoys a central location in mesmerising city of Venice. Marco Polo Airport is situated 14 kilometres away and Rialto Port just 210 metres away. Within a stone's throw travellers may enjoy stunning views and a myriad of historical attractions such as Piazza San Marco, Doge's Palace and Church in Campo Santo Stefano. Visitors will be enchanted by a delightful Venetian décor and welcoming atmosphere. There are different accommodation options including single, double, triple and quadruple rooms. The luminous, air-conditioned in summer season and superbly appointed unit offers a haven of serenity and tranquillity guaranteeing a good night's sleep. Patrons may wake up to a delicious and varied breakfast. The attentive and friendly hotel staff will assist guests in every need they may have. •CIR: 027042-ALB-00368•CIN: IT027042A19ILQ9MKS

22156.description: The Margi Hotel, a boutique haven in Vouliagmeni, the most exclusive area of the Athenian Riviera, offers a memorable escape. Steps from the Riviera's finest sandy beaches and conveniently close to Athens' historical sites, this hotel boasts superb cuisine featuring organic produce from its own farm. The attentive staff and exquisite design, blending colonial, Mediterranean, and ethnic influences, create a comfortable ambiance for every traveler, year-round. Each of the 89 bright, airy rooms and suites exudes luxury and relaxation. Enjoy views of the sea, pool, surrounding forest, and neighborhood, all while basking in the balmy sea breeze.

22319.description: This hotel complex is located 150 m from the public beach while the village resort centre is around 1km from the hotel. Public transport connections are approximately 300m from the hotel and Antalya airport is roughly 65 kms away. Opened in 2003 and refurbished in 2010, the hotel includes a total of 44 rooms. Facilities on offer include a restaurant and bar and a car park. All accommodation units come with a bathroom, a telephone, satellite/cable TV and air-conditioning. Guests are invited to relax in the hotel garden or pool. The pool is surrounded by a sun terrace, which offers guests sun loungers and parasols.

22437.description: The recently renovated San Lorenzo Hostal is a modern three-star establishment in the heart of Madrid. Located in a historic building on Calle Clavel, just steps from the bustling Gran Vía, this hostel offers a prime location in the vibrant Chueca district. Explore the city's authentic atmosphere with ease, surrounded by restaurants, cafes, shops, entertainment venues, cinemas, and theaters. Choose a modern room and enjoy comfortable accommodation at an excellent value. The San Lorenzo Hostal also offers accessible rooms for guests with limited mobility.

22438.description: Located in a prominent position on Shoreditch High Street, One Hundred Shoreditch is an independent hotel and home to 258 bedrooms and suites, five places to eat and drink, plus six meeting and event spaces. Blending modernity with East End charm, this dynamic district, nestled in the heart of Shoreditch, epitomises contemporary city living. From Lobby Lates and Seed Library, to their Eastern Mediterranean rooftop bar & kitchen, Kaso - there is much to see in this iconic contemporary hotel.

22462.description: This hotel is located near the edge of the commercial heart and hotel area of the city. Within good distance of Cancun's international airport (about 25 minutes away), and only some 2 minutes from the ferry link to Isla Mujeres, the hotel offers travellers an oasis of comfort and good service. The Mediterranean style hotel with a relaxing atmosphere reflecting the tropical and bright character of the Mexican Caribbean comprises a total of 42 rooms. It was recently renovated to appeal to the highest expectations of the frequent traveller. The double rooms were recently renovated and equipped with electronic key card entry. Standard fittings include air conditioning, cable TV, an Internet connection via WLAN, as well as an en suite bathroom and a fan, ensuring a pleasant and comfortable stay. Leisure options include a 50 m² swimming pool with a children's area. In addition, there is a sun terrace and a poolside snack bar with public sanitary facilities.

22478.description: This charming, family-run hotel, housed in a romantic 19th-century Venetian villa, is a short 20-minute vaporetto ride from Venice's city center and attractions like St. Mark's Square (with 24-hour vaporetto service every 10 minutes). The Congress Palace, the casino, and a lovely sandy beach (equipped with sun loungers and parasols) are just a 2-minute walk away. Shopping and entertainment venues are also nearby. The hotel features two floors with six double rooms, a reception area, a flowered garden with a delightful breakfast terrace, and a children's playground. Bicycle rentals and room service are available. The comfortable rooms include a bathroom with a hairdryer, a direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a radio, internet access, and central heating.

22479.description: Located in the heart of Berlin, just steps from the vibrant Kurfürstendamm, the Kurfürst am Kurfürstendamm hotel offers a convenient and comfortable stay. This hotel features 36 individually furnished guestrooms equipped with modern amenities, including flat-screen TVs, refrigerators, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Guests can also enjoy convenient services such as concierge assistance and access to a computer station, as well as take advantage of the hotel's conference space and meeting rooms. Zoo Berlin is a short 5-minute drive away, and other major attractions like Potsdamer Platz and Brandenburg Gate are within easy reach.

22522.description: Make yourself at home in one of the 193 guestrooms. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Royal Mile - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Edinburgh Vaults - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Museum of Edinburgh - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Real Mary King's Close - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Festival Theatre - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Parliament House - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- St. Giles' Cathedral - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- City Art Centre - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Holyrood Park - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Calton Hill - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Edinburgh Dungeon - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Scottish Parliament - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- National Museum of Scotland - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- University of Edinburgh - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Potterrow Student Centre - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi. The preferred airport for Travelodge Edinburgh Central is Edinburgh Airport (EDI) - 13. 2 km / 8. 2 miWith a stay at Travelodge Edinburgh Central, you'll be centrally located in Edinburgh, just a 4-minute walk from Royal Mile and 8 minutes by foot from University of Edinburgh. This hotel is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Edinburgh Castle and 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from St. Giles' Cathedral.

22578.address: Yeni Mahalle Şehit Polis Cemal Ilgaz Cad., 8
22578.description: The hotel is located directly on the beautiful coastline, 1km east of the Centre of Kemer. A great place for families, there is a range of activities to keep everyone occupied and it also has a number of meeting rooms and is suitable for conferences and social functions. Room and laundry services are available. The hotel has 311 modern rooms with carpeted floors, centrally controlled heating and cooling system, direct telephone lines, TV, minibar, safe, modern bathroom with shower, hairdryer and balcony. The hotel's many activities and recreational facilities include a spa and wellness Centre, volley, tennis and basketball courts, a grass football field, games room, water sports on the beach and an activity pool as well as indoor and outdoor pools. Additionally, the hotel's animation team provide entertainment including shows and a disco party.

22622.description: This charming hotel is located in the heart of Madrid. Encompassed within cultural attractions, shopping districts and fine-dining opportunities, this hotel is sure to please each individual guest. Public transport links are easily accessible from this hotel. The airport is easily accessible also, just 18 km away. Designed with an Art-Deco style, this hotel oozes modernity and poise.
