The guest rooms are embellished with artefacts from the 19th and 20th century, giving a tasteful flair to each individual unit. Guests can avail of the conference facilities, gym, rooftop terrace or steam bath. Breakfast is offered from the in-house restaurant, Europa Deco, in a buffet-form and delivering lunch and dinner in an à la carte fashion. Whether guests are travelling for business or for pleasure, this hotel is sure to enthral each visitor that passes through its doors.

22673.description: Situated in the heart of Alanya, the 4-star Club Big Blue Suite offers a blend of traditional Turkish hospitality and modern amenities. Spanning 5, 000 m², this centrally located hotel is within walking distance of Alanya Castle, renowned beaches, vibrant shopping centers, and diverse restaurants. Recent additions for the new season include a relaxing adult pool with a jacuzzi and waterfall, a fun-filled children's pool featuring two slides and a mushroom waterfall, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and a new à la carte restaurant serving international cuisine overlooking the pool (reservations required). Guests can also enjoy the stylish Blu Bar adjacent to the pools and a new lounge seating area.

22676.description: This sleek and modern hotel is situated in the centre of Antalya just a stone's throw from the coast. The hotel is also just a short walk from the old town, known as Kaleici, where visitors can admire Hadrian's Gate and Hidirlik Tower, as well as a number of fascinating museums, mosques, and historical houses. Guests can explore the city, head over to beautiful Konyaalti beach for sea and sun or simply relax by the outdoor swimming pool. The hotel also offers a fully-equipped conference centre, making it an ideal place for seminars and meetings. Rooms are modern and fully-equipped with central air-conditioning, wireless internet access, en suite bathroom and balcony. Guests can indulge in breakfast in bed with 24-hour room service, or enjoy a varied and satisfying breakfast in the hotel's restaurant. An excellent choice for business or leisure.

22679.description: How about experiencing the unique harmony of green and blue at Voyage Sorgun, stretching from the Sorgun Forest to the sea? Voyage Sorgun is ready to offer you a peaceful and pleasant holiday with its nature-friendly, modern architecture in the middle of the pine forest that shines like a jewel!The entertainment never stops at Voyage Sorgun, where you can easily check the activity program of the day on your TV or mobile app instead of looking around to see what's happening where!You will remember what peace really means when you wake up in Voyage Sorgun under an azure sky surrounded by pine trees. There are no words to describe the joy you feel when you walk from the Sorgun forest through the pines to reach the green sunbathing lawn, the turquoise waters and the blue flag beach!

22684.description: This family-friendly spa complex is located in Belek, 40 km from Antalya's city center. The hotel is near ancient historical landmarks and just 300 m from the beach. Antalya Airport is about 30 km away. The resort offers 508 accommodation units, equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. Guests enjoy a café, bar, disco, restaurant, conference facilities, internet access, and parking. Children will love the playground, kids' club, supervised team games, painting, computer games, and film screenings. Adults can participate in organized entertainment programs. The hotel also features three swimming pools and various sports activities.

22689.address: Türkler Mah., Fuğla Mevkii, Sipahioğlu sok, 4
22689.description:
Relax and unwind with massages and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 5 outdoor swimming pools, a complimentary water park, and outdoor tennis courts. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting. This hotel is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Satisfy your appetite at one of the hotel's 3 restaurants. Wind down with a drink at one of the 3 bars/lounges or 4 poolside bars. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

Featured amenities include a business center, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.

22696.description: At Özkaymak Marina Hotel, you'll experience the warm hospitality just like an esteemed guest in a Turkish home. Our hotel, designed to reflect the atmosphere of the Turkish Riviera, promises an unforgettable stay with its 6-story spacious atrium and special warm ambiance. Whether for business or leisure, Özkaymak Marina ensures a memorable and enjoyable accommodation. The hotel offers a 500-person capacity venue for meetings, conferences, seminars, weddings, and celebrations. Location Information: Located in the center of Kemer, the facility is 59 km from Antalya Airport and 45 km from the city center of Antalya. The hotel is only 150 meters away from the sea. Guests of the hotel can use the public beach, and there is a designated area for the hotel's guests. Services on the beach are chargeable, and beach towels are changed every 3 days.

22700.description: The popular, family-friendly hotel is just across the road from a beautiful blue flag shingle and pebble beach. Shops, bars, restaurants and nightclubs can all be found in the vicinity, as well as a bus stop. The hotel was completely renovated in 2012 and the welcoming rooms are en suite with sitting area and balcony as well as central heating and air-conditioning. The restaurant serves a varied and wholesome buffet for breakfast, lunch and dinner, and there is also an a la carte restaurant for evening meals. Guests can relax by the indoor and outdoor pools while younger guests play on the waterslide and in the children's pool, head over to the beautiful Konyaalti beach for various water sports including windsurfing, jet skiing and diving, or explore Antalya's old town with Hadrian's Gate, Hidirlik Tower and the famous clock tower. This is the ideal place to enjoy a family holiday in the sun.

22705.address: Sehit Mehmet Pasa Yokusu Ucler Hamam Sok, 13-15
22705.description:
Situated in Istanbul's historic district of Sultanahmet, only a 2-minute walk from Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia, this Ottoman-style hotel combines traditional décor with modern facilities, including free wireless internet access. 
Arena Hotel - Special Class is an excellent example of a 19th-century Ottoman stone house. It has been carefully restored in keeping with Istanbul's historic architecture and features antique furnishings. Each of the spacious rooms at Arena Hotel - Special Class is decorated in rich fabrics and a creative blend of warm colors. 
You are warmly welcomed to Arena Hotel - Special Class with complimentary coffee and cookies upon your arrival. You can also benefit from a buffet breakfast each morning, included in your room rate. 
The location of Arena Hotel - Special Class is ideal for exploring Istanbul's history. Topkapi Palace, Grand Bazaar, and Basilica Cistern are within walking distance. The friendly and helpful staff is happy to offer you recommendations for restaurants, shops, or day trips. Olivium Outlet Centre is 10 km away. Istanbul Airport is 50 km and Sabiha Gokcen is 48 km from the property.

22707.description: (+16)Adult Only. This hotel is located 7 km from Alanya city centre and offers a private beach area in the Mediterranean Coast. Konakli town centre is 5 km away. Alanya has a plethora of attractions such as Alanya Castle, Alanya Dockyard and Arsenal, the Red Tower, Alanya Archaeological Museum and Damlatas Cave.

name.content: Dogan Hotel by Prana Hotels & Resorts

22708.description: Doğan Hotel by Prana Hotels & Resorts has met the requirements of the Hygiene Measures to be Implemented in the hotels and their Food & Beverage Venues during the Pandemic ' published within the framework of the 'Safe Tourism Certification Program ' and has become entitled to recieve 'Safe Tourism Certificate'. This original and welcoming hotel is set right in the centre of Kaleci, Antalya's historic old town which is famous for its narrow, cobblestone streets and Ottoman-era architecture. Visitors can explore the ancient city centre with its various museums and mosques, beautiful harbour dating back to the Roman era, Hadrian's Gate and Hidirlik Tower, all just a few minutes' walk from the hotel. The hotel's 41 en suite rooms are spacious and charming with wooden floors and ceilings, cool stone walls and traditional Turkish bedspreads and upholstery. Guests can indulge in room service or enjoy healthy and timeless Turkish meals at the luxurious restaurant, Guests are invited to relax in the garden and swim in the refreshing outdoor swimming pool (open every year from May 1 to October 1) or enjoy the beach just 100 metres from the hotel. . With its central location and exquisite facilities and services, this is the perfect place to unwind after a busy day of business or sightseeing.

22758.description: This hotel is situated in Madrid's commercial district, near Calle Arturo Soria. It offers easy and direct access to the IFEMA congress centre. Madrid-Barajas Airport is around 6 km away. This air-conditioned hotel includes 83 rooms over 5 floors. A café, a bar and a restaurant are also available. It is additionally well suited for conferences and congresses with WLAN available. The car park offers direct access to the hotel. The rooms all include an en-suite bathroom, a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV with pre-paid films and ADSL Internet access. Entry to rooms is via magnetic key. The air-conditioning is individually adjustable. Guests may select their breakfast from the buffet service.

22769.description: Featuring a quiet location in Aravaca, a northern district of the vibrant city of Madrid, this luxurious hotel comprises three elegant buildings with an English-style façade and is surrounded by wonderful gardens. Guests will find themselves close to the Zarzuela Horse Racetrack and the Real Club Puerta de Hierro golf club, where visitors may practice their swing. The Spanish Golf Federation's National Centre is also in the surrounding area while Madrid-Barajas International Airport is some 22 kilometres away. The tastefully decorated guest rooms are all exterior-facing and feature a private bathroom with full-size bathtub. Those most demanding travellers may prefer the exclusive junior suites equipped with the latest technology. The onsite restaurant features the ‘nouvelle cuisine' concept, serving a choice of mouthwatering dishes that will tempt even the most discerning travellers.

22823.description: This charming hotel enjoys a quiet location in a secluded street in the Lafayette-Montmartre district of Paris. Orly International Airport is some 20 kilometres away and Charles de Gaulle Airport is just a 34-minute drive. Poissoniere metro station is only 100 metres away and provides easy access to some of the most important tourist attractions in the area, including the world renowned Eiffel Tower, Tuileries Palace and the popular Louvre Museum. Tastefully decorated with a Parisian theme, the modern and comfortable guest rooms spread over 6 floors include all the necessary amenities to guarantee a truly memorable stay. They all come with a fully-equipped bathroom where to revitalise body and mind with a shower. Guests can wake up to a buffet breakfast offered by the hotel each morning and try delicious French traditional pastries.

22867.description: This hotel is situated at the gateway to Madrid, on the La Coruna highway. It is just a 5 minutes' drive from Las Rozas Industrial Park. Guests can enjoy close proximity to the centre of the vibrant city of Madrid, where a wealth of attractions await. Many shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found nearby. The main business centres of the city are within easy access of the hotel. This hotel comprises tastefully-designed guest rooms and suites. The hotel features a cosy bar and an a la carte restaurant, where guests can sample the local delights. Business travellers will appreciate the hotel's conference room. The swimmingpool timeline is from 11:00 to 19:00 starting 1st June.

22868.description: This establishment is located in a strategic area of ​​Madrid, with ease of access to major routes: VI and M-40 and near the train station Barrial. The property is located a few minutes from several shopping centres such as Sexta Avenida and El Corte Inglés. The tourist apartments are near the Club de Campo Villa de Madrid, La Zarzuela hospital and Puerta de Hierro-Mahadahonda hospital. It offers spacious one and two bedroom studios and apartments, equipped with all types of amenities and services for a comfortable stay.

22869.description: This hotel lies just 10 km away from the bustling centre of Madrid. It is located just a short driving distance away from many of the city's and the area's attractions. The popular Madrid Club de Campo, as well as a shopping centre, can be found nearby. The hotel is well linked to the public transport network. This hotel offers visitors comfortable, tastefully-designed guest apartments, which come well equipped with modern amenities. The hotel features an onsite restaurant, where guests are invited to wine and dine in style. This hotel is the perfect choice for couples, families and business travellers alike.

22870.description: This hotel boasts a strategic setting in the business district of Madrid. Surrounded by gardens, the hotel enjoys an unprecedented air of peace and serenity, seemingly miles away from the centre of the city. Guests can enjoy direct access to the N VI motorway and the M 40. The train station can be found nearby. Large shopping and leisure centres can be found close to the hotel. This hotel comprises beautifully-designed rooms and suites. The accommodation options offer modern amenities, for added comfort. Facilities at the hotel include a cafe-bar, a conference room and complimentary wireless internet access, for guests' convenience.

22876.description: Located just 500 meters from Taksim Square and less than 1 km from the Lütfi Kırdar Congress Center, Point Hotel Taksim offers rooms with free WiFi in modern Istanbul. Rooms feature a light décor with natural colors, double-glazed windows for a quiet stay, a sofa, an HD TV with Digiturk and LigTV (football channel). Some rooms include executive lounge access. The top-floor View Point restaurant offers stunning Bosphorus views and serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The hotel also boasts an authentic Japanese restaurant and two café bars. The spa includes an indoor pool, sauna, and Turkish bath, plus a variety of massages and beauty treatments. Shopping and public transport are easily accessible. Acıbadem Taksim Hospital is 350 meters away, and Nişantaşı district, with its elegant shops and cafés, is 2. 5 km away. Istanbul Airport is 48. 7 km from the hotel, and private parking and airport transfers are available for a fee.

22877.description: Athens Poseidon Hotel provides the ultimate destination for holidays in the Greek capital. Away from the hustle and bustle of the city center and with incomparable connectivity to all the major sights and attractions in Athens, our hotel boasts a privileged location and can serve the needs of families, couples and parties of friends, adventurers and business people from all over the world. Even on a tight schedule, you may explore Athens to the fullest with the help of the specific location of Athens Poseidon Hotel and thanks to the superb access to all means of transportation. Just a breath away, there is the Tram and a bus station for you to hop on and start discovering the hidden gems of Athens. Greek hospitality is praised in Athens Poseidon Hotel, with fully personalized services that are tailor made to meet your needs and desires. Our team of professionals will make the most out of your stay, providing suggestions as to the places you ought to visit and the things you should do, always serving you with a smile. Our facilities and services will allow you to relax and enjoy every moment of your stay at our hotel. The modern décor of our interior, the wonderful bar and restaurants on offer, the great value for money and the attention to the slightest detail will delight you and introduce you to the true meaning of holidays in Athens. Be it summer or winter, spring or autumn, Athens Poseidon Hotel provides great accommodation while visiting Athens and wishing to take advantage of every last second of your journey here!

22896.description: The NH Alcorcón boasts a prime location near Alcorcón's historic center and the offices of several leading national and international companies. Parque Oeste Shopping Center is just an 8-minute walk from the hotel, and central Madrid, with the Royal Palace and Prado Museum, is only half an hour away by metro. Our 102 inviting rooms offer all the modern conveniences, including free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, minibars, and sitting areas. A freshly prepared breakfast buffet is served every morning, with an early-bird option and hot dishes cooked to order upon request. Nhube Restaurant, our dining space, prepares delicious Mediterranean dishes for dinner Monday through Thursday. You can purchase hot and cold snacks and drinks any time of the day or night at the self-service open bar. The hotel has five meeting rooms with a maximum capacity of 220 people. With advance notice, we can arrange a menu and other business or event services, such as audiovisual equipment. The gym, free for hotel guests, includes cardiovascular machines, a sauna, and complimentary towels. The outdoor terrace next to the restaurant is perfect for relaxing or holding business meetings.

22897.description: Hotelsituated in the business district and is only a 15-minute drive away from Madrid's city center. Take a short walk and you will find the Kinepolis, a cinema complex that is often used as a conference center. Other nearby attractions include the Madrid Amusement Park, the Zoo Aquarium Madrid, and the Casa de Campo conference center. Ciudad de la Imagen metro stop is close to the hotel and offers quick and easy access to Madrid. It has 76 beautiful rooms decorated in warm fall colors. They feature plasma TVs, air-conditioning (perfect for hot summer months), and free Wi-Fi to help you stay connected. Connecting and superior rooms are also available. In the mornings, guests can enjoy a delicious fresh breakfast buffet offering everything from pastries to cold cuts, accompanied by fresh juices and coffee.

22898.description: Situated in the Nuestra Señora de Butarque Business Park area of the Leganés neighborhood, the hotel Crisol Leganés provides travelers with a relaxing retreat after a day of business or sightseeing in Madrid's city center or at other local sites. The hotel is easily accessible by several freeways and highways including the M40, M50, A42, A4, and A5. Short drives connect guests to Parque Warner Madrid, a Warner Brothers theme park, shopping, and an ice skating rink. To reach Madrid's highlights like the Plaza Mayor, El Prado Museum, and the Royal Palace, hotel guests can take the Cercanías Madrid train from the nearby Zarzaquemada or Las Margaritas - Universidad stations. The hotel's 78 welcoming rooms are arranged over two floors, and are all are warmly decorated and have contemporary hardwood floors.

22899.description: This hotel is located on the main road to El Escorial. It is situated just 18 km away from Madrid, where guests will find a number of attractions, as well as many shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. The hotel is situated close to an industrial park, as well as the Europolis business development area and Las Rozas leisure Park. Transport connections and motorways can be found nearby. This wonderful hotel features tastefully-designed guest rooms, which come complete with modern amenities. The hotel offers an extensive range of facilities and services, ensuring that guests' enjoy the very best convenience.

22900.description: Located in Madrid's bustling business district, Erase un Hotel offers comfortable and welcoming accommodations. Guests enjoy convenient access to the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium, home of Real Madrid, and the city's exhibition center. The hotel provides free Wi-Fi, parking, and a meeting room. Just a short walk from the Valdeacederas metro station, guests can easily reach Puerta del Sol, the heart of Madrid's tourist attractions. Excellent motorway access makes travel to IFEMA and Barajas Airport a breeze. For those interested in football, entertainment, and culture, Erase un Hotel is an excellent choice.

22902.description:
This Hotel SB Madrid Norte is in a residential area with easy access to Madrid and the A-1, M-40 and M-50 Motorways. Wi-Fi is free in public areas. 

The air-conditioned, soundproof rooms at the Hotel SB Express Madrid Norte feature free WiFi, a 32-inch TV and a safe. Their private bathroom includes a set of toiletries and a hairdryer. 

Hotel SB Madrid Norte offers buffet breakfast and bar service. 

Hospital Infanta Sofia Metro Station is only 656 feet from the hotel, while the Micropolix Leisure Center is around 2625 feet away. The Hotel SB Madrid Norte is 7. 5 mi away from Barajas Airport and the IFEMA convention center is 9. 3 mi away. The La Moraleja Golf Course and the Jarama Racetrack are both within a short drive.

22903.description: The NH Madrid Atocha hotel, formerly known as NH Sur, is located right across the street from the Atocha train station. This means guests can enjoy easy access to the whole city, including the airport, as well as high-speed trains to Seville and Córdoba. The location is also perfect for exploring Madrid's top sites, with the famous Art Triangle - the Prado, Reina Sofia and Thyssen Museums - within a 15-minute walk, while the city center is just four stops away from the nearby Atocha Renfe metro station. NH Madrid Atocha has 68 pastel-colored rooms with sleek hardwood flooring. The rooms are functional and are equipped with free Wi-Fi and satellite TVs. We want breakfast to be the highlight of your morning, so we offer a wide variety of options, including local specialties, such as tortilla de patatas, or churros and hot chocolate. Around the hotel, guests will find some of Madrid's top restaurants and our staff will be happy to recommend delicious options. If you are in the city on business, we have a compact meeting room for up to 20 people.

22904.description: This modern hotel lies in the new residential area of Coslada between the industrial park and the new European Transport Centre. It is conveniently close to Barajas Airport and the Juan Carlos I convention centre. The property comprises a total of 78 rooms of which 7 are junior suites. Corporate travellers will surely appreciate the 6 conference rooms with audio-visual equipment, which are also suitable for personal functions and events. Parking is available for those arriving by car and guests may additionally make use of the airport transfer service. For further convenience, car rental is provided on site. The rooms and junior suites all come with an en-suite bathroom. For guest's entertainment Internet access, a games console and satellite/ cable TV also feature in all accommodations as standard.

22905.description: The NH Collection Palacio de Aranjuez hotel is set in an elegant 18th and 19th century building that sits right in the heart of town. The Palacio de Aranjuez, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is only steps away and you can explore the rest of the old town, including the Royal Gardens and Tagus River, on foot. The 86 rooms at NH Collection Palacio de Aranjuez are designed to ensure your rest and relaxation, which is why they feature extra-thick mattresses and a choice of pillows. The decor is neutral and light, with floor-to-ceiling windows and sleek hardwood floors. There is a full-sized bathtub in each room as well a rain-effect shower. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. A lovely breakfast buffet offers our guests a selection of cold cuts, cheeses, eggs made-to-order, fresh pastries, and much more besides. There are also gluten-free options available. The lobby bar has soft lighting and a warm color scheme, making it the perfect space for a laid-back drink. We also have a large courtyard terrace where you can unwind. There is a gym on-site as well as six unique meeting rooms for 300 people. For lunch or dinner, explore local restaurants, including Michelin-starred Casa José, which are just a five-minute walk from the hotel.

22906.address: Goya 5, entrada por c/ Marqués de Zurgena 4, 4
22906.description: NH Collection Madrid Colón, formerly known as NH Madrid Sanvy, is situated in Salamanca, one of Madrid's exclusive neighborhoods. Nearby, you can shop at luxury brands: Gucci, Rolex, Loewe and Armani. If you wish to taste Spain's gastronomy, head to the Platea gourmet food hall, managed by the city's Michelin-starred chefs. Madrid's museums and Retiro Park are close by and Recoletos station is reachable on foot providing links to the rest of the city. NH Collection Madrid Colón has quiet and spacious rooms equipped with free Wi-Fi. Some have a beautiful view of Plaza Colón and every room has a pillow menu. Our Guest Relations team can organize tickets and reservations during your stay. If you prefer to relax at the hotel, sunbathe on the 4th floor terrace, take a dip in the open-air pool and unwind with a drink at the poolside bar. NH Collection Madrid Colón offers an excellent daily breakfast. For lunch and dinner choose between our restaurant or bar – the Bar Colón or Sushi Bar 99 which offers fine Japanese cuisine. Accompany your meal with the perfect wine from our cellar or opt for a delightful cocktail. There are a gym and meeting rooms on-site.

22907.description: The ibis hotel in Alcalá de Henares is located 0. 6 miles from the town's historic center, just 547 yds. from La Garena shopping center, 9. 3 miles from Barajas Airport and the IFEMA exhibition center and 14. 3 miles from the center of Madrid. Its comfortable rooms are fully equipped with air conditioning, heating, LCD TV and WIFI. In Alcalá de Henares, this ibis hotel offers guests private parking and a well-priced 24-hour bar. In the immediate vicinity, guests can play golf or tennis.

22918.description: This attractive and contemporary hotel and conference centre is located in the Sisli quarter of Istanbul's new town. A variety of shops, bars, restaurants and public transport links are within walking distance of the hotel, and the excellent shopping and entertainment centres of Ninsantasi and Tesvikiye streets are only a short stroll away. Ideal for business travel, the hotel convention centre offers one of the largest ballrooms in Europe as well as a theatre and 22 multipurpose rooms with the latest audio and video technology. The hotel also provides a complimentary shuttle to Taksim Square and Cevahir shopping mall. With its outstanding facilities and services, this hotel is the perfect place to organize any type of event.

22937.description: This hotel boasts a strategic setting in Madrid. It is located close to Bravo Murillo Street, within easy reach of Vallehermoso stadium. A number of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found nearby. This establishment lies within easy access of many of the city's most prominent attractions. This welcoming hotel comprises elegantly-styled guest rooms. The rooms come well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are invited to enjoy a buffet-style breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to work or explore the city. This hotel is a great option for business and leisure travellers visiting Madrid. Our parking facilities are designed for small and medium-sized cars (segments A, B, and C, up to 4. 5 metres in length). Large vehicles cannot access the parking area. If your vehicle slightly exceeds the indicated dimensions, access may still be possible at the driver's own responsibility.

22938.address: Calle De Breton De Los Herreros, 29
22938.description: The NH Madrid Chamberí hotel, formerly known as NH Bretón, is in the Chamberí district of Madrid - a charming spot with some of the best gastronomic choices in the city, lovely tapas bars, trendy shops, and a leafy park. Paseo de la Castellana, the city's financial and business corridor, is only five minutes away on foot, so the location is also perfect for business travelers. For access to Madrid's city center, hop on the metro at one of the many nearby stops, such as Alonso Cano or Gregorio Marañon, and be there in just 20 minutes. NH Madrid Chamberí has 56 rooms that let in lots of natural light and feature a classic decor with sleek hardwood floors. Each room comes equipped with free Wi-Fi. An extensive breakfast buffet is served each morning in our cozy breakfast room. The varied spread features classic continental breakfast choices alongside local favorites such as churros with hot chocolate and Spanish omelets. While we don't have an on-site restaurant, guests will find a delightful variety of dining options just steps away from the hotel.

22939.address: Avenida De La Ciudad De Barcelona, 113
22939.description: The 4-star Catalonia El Retiro hotel, located in Madrid's vibrant Retiro district near Méndez Álvaro bus station, offers easy access to the city center via nearby metro and bus stops. The hotel is also conveniently located near the A-3 and M-30 motorways. Just a few meters from Puente de Vallecas station, guests enjoy a quick connection to Atocha train station and the city's cultural attractions. Within 3 km, explore the magnificent Retiro Park and the renowned Art Triangle, home to the Prado, Reina Sofia, and Thyssen-Bornemisza museums. The hotel's 62 modern, bright double and superior rooms feature air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, desks, safes, and free high-speed Wi-Fi. On-site parking is also available. Guests can enjoy complimentary amenities, satellite TV, and minibars. Bathrooms include hairdryers and rainfall showers. Small pets (under 20 kg) are welcome with prior request and applicable fees.

22940.description: The recently renovated Avani Alonso Martinez Madrid Hotel hotel is set within a historical building dating back to 1919. The hotel is in a central location, close to shops, tapas bars, and the city's top restaurants. Within minutes, guests will find the architectural gems of Plaza de Alonso Martínez, as well as Fuencarral Street and the Salamanca neighborhood. A few steps further are the Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen museums, as well as the famous Paseo del Prado. For connections to the rest of the city, hop on the metro at the Alonso Martínez Station. The 101 rooms at Avani Alonso Martínez Madrid Hotel are decorated in contemporary whites, greys, and dark blues. Each comes with a TV and free Wi-Fi for connectivity, as well as thick mattresses and a choice of pillows for comfort.

22941.description: Located in Madrid's financial district, the NH Collection Madrid Eurobuilding is a premier business hotel and home to DiverXO, the city's only three-Michelin-starred restaurant. Whether traveling for business or leisure, guests enjoy state-of-the-art facilities and close proximity to the Santiago Bernabeu stadium and metro stations. The hotel's 412 spacious rooms offer amenities like rain-effect showers, Nespresso machines, and pillow menus, with some boasting skyline views. Dining options include the lavish breakfast buffet with gluten-free and children's selections, DOMO for lunch and dinner, and 99 Sushi Bar. For a unique culinary experience, DiverXO, by Chef David Muñoz, awaits. The hotel also features 32 meeting rooms, some equipped with SMART Room Systems for videoconferencing, accommodating up to 1300 people. Guests can unwind at the expansive gym, paddle courts, spa, and jacuzzi.

22942.description: This lovely and comfortable hotel boasts a quiet location just 10 minutes from the municipality of Rivas Vaciamadrid and 22 kilometres from the city centre of the bustling and vibrant Madrid. Moreover, the property is a mere 17 kilometres from Warner Bros theme park, being the perfect accommodation option when travelling with children or for business in the surrounding area. All guest rooms are decorated in a cosy and cheery look, including modern amenities to ensure a pleasant stay. They have functional features for those who need to work or just relax and include a spacious private bathroom with shower and bidet. Business travellers may take advantage of the meeting facilities on-site to hold a meeting or an important event. Moreover, guests may relax with a refreshing drink at the hotel's bar or taste delicious dishes at the restaurant.

22957.description: This 4-star hotel is located on Barcelona's Avenida de Roma, between Montjuic fairgrounds and the commercial and business area of Avenida Diagonal, as well as a short distance from Sants Station. This wonderful hotel fits seamlessly into its surroundings and is decorated with contemporary works of art, dedicating each floor to a different artist. The hotel holds 59 rooms that exude elegance and style, and that are equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The hotel services include meeting rooms, a gym and a terrace with a bar and swimming pool.

22958.description: This hotel is beautifully located in the region of Barcelona, just 100 metres away from the beach. A number of restaurants, bars and the marina can be found just 300 metres away. Barcelona's city centre is just a 30 minutes' driving distance away. Guests will find themselves just a 10 minutes' driving distance away from a choice of shops. The hotel is conveniently located just 40 km away from Barcelona Airport. This modern hotel enjoys a charming design. The guest rooms ooze character and style. The hotel features 7 conference rooms, for the convenience of those travelling for work purposes. Guests are invited to enjoy the delectable dishes that the hotel's restaurant has to offer.

22964.description: This hotel is located in Praça de Espanha, a short stroll to the Metro Station, with quick easy access to Lisbon city centre. Designed to offer guests a comfortable stay in the Portuguese capital, this hotel is a 20-minute walk from downtown Lisbon. Lisbon's New University, the Calouste Gulbenkian Museum and El Corte Inglés department store are a 10-minute walk away from the hotel.

23108.description: NH Madrid Lagasca hotel is set in the Salamanca district of Madrid, right by the golden mile of luxury shops and designer boutiques. Enjoy a stroll through the Retiro Park and a walk around its famous pond. A longer walk will get you to Plaza Cibeles and Puerta de Alcalá. Business travelers have easy access to the IFEMA Exhibition Complex, which is only 10km away. For quick links to the rest of the city, hop on the metro at the Serrano or Recoletos stations. NH Madrid Lagasca features 100 relaxing rooms with hardwood floors. Each comes with free Wi-Fi, which is also available throughout the hotel. The Superior rooms come with Nespresso machines and mini-bars, and three have spectacular views of Madrid's skyline from their private terraces. Let our breakfast be the highlight of your day; offering up a healthy selection of cold cuts, cheeses, fresh pastries and other delights, it can be enjoyed with fresh fruit juice, fragrant coffee or a hot cup of tea. The bar serves drinks and snacks, which you can enjoy while watching a game on the TV or just relaxing on one of the cozy sofas. Simple dishes can be ordered through our room service, and the La Ventana de Flavia restaurant serves lunch and dinner daily.

23140.description: Overlooking the Rio Minho, the modern Hotel Bienestar offers a selection of spa treatments in Monção. Guests can enjoy the outdoor pool and explore the lush surroundings by bicycle. Surrounded by unforgettable landscapes along the River Miño, the hotel invites you to experience pure tranquility, forgetting everyday worries. Nearby, visit Peneda-Gerês National Park, one of Portugal's most beautiful landscapes, perfect for hiking, horseback riding, or off-road adventures. Golf enthusiasts can also enjoy the courses in northern Portugal and southern Galicia.

23160.description: Located in Vic, this hotel offers comfortable air-conditioned rooms with minibars, private bathrooms, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant, room service (limited hours), and a buffet breakfast for a fee. The hotel also features a banquet hall, discounted access to a nearby fitness center, and convenient amenities such as complimentary newspapers, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. With 2153 square feet of event space, it's ideal for conferences and meetings. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include the Praca Major, Episcopal Museum of Vic, and Vic Cathedral.

23164.address: Merkez Mahallesi, Baris Manco Caddesi, Antalya, 10
23164.description: This hotel is located in the resort of Kemer, just a 5-minute walk from the sea. The air-conditioned establishment comprises a total of 228 rooms and welcomes guests into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, currency exchange facilities, cloakroom, lift access, a children's playground and kids' club, games room, bar, disco, restaurant, conference facilities and a car park. The rooms each have an en suite bathroom, centrally regulated air conditioning and heating, a telephone, TV, a safety deposit box, a hairdryer and a minibar. The bathrooms feature a cosmetic mirror, bathtub, shower and WC, and the suite rooms include a shower cabin and double washbasin. Guests may also like to spend time relaxing on the private balcony or terrace (Some of the rooms have a French balcony).

23418.description: The Sorell Hotel Seefeld is nestled in Zurich's vibrant Seefeld district, offering stylish accommodations in the heart of the city. A short stroll from the hotel reveals the picturesque Zurich Lake promenade with its diverse array of restaurants and cultural attractions. Zurich's Opera House and renowned art museum are also within easy walking distance. The hotel's contemporary design features harmonious colors, modern furnishings, sleek parquet floors, and bright bathrooms. Guests can enjoy light lunches and snacks at the hotel bar, which transforms into a lively meeting place for evening aperitifs. The Bahnhofstrasse and the Old Town are easily accessible on foot, allowing guests to explore Zurich's rich history and vibrant shopping scene.

23419.description: Situated on the Zurichberg heights, the 4-star Sorell Hotel Zurichberg offers a tranquil and stylish retreat for business and leisure travelers. Enjoy breathtaking views of the city, lake, and Alps. Though nestled in nature, the hotel is just a short tram ride from Zurich's vibrant center, including the Bahnhofstrasse shopping mile, main station, cinemas, restaurants, clubs, and the lake. This architectural gem blends a historic building with a modern extension. Explore the surrounding nature with long walks or mountain bike tours (available at the hotel). Each of the 66 rooms boasts unique charm and designer furnishings by renowned names like Wettstein, Aalto, and Urquiola, creating a distinctive ambiance. Amenities include Bang & Olufsen TVs, Nespresso machines, Wi-Fi, and minibars. Savor a unique culinary experience at the R21 restaurant, featuring creative, French-influenced cuisine and stunning city views.

23422.description: Located in the heart of the Hernals, this establishment is endowed with luxurious services and facilities, allowing visitors to enjoy the Austrian capital like a true emperor. Vienna Airport is about 25 km from the hotel. Set in a hundred-year-old building, it has recently been refurbished and remodelled from the top to the bottom. The rooms have been designed with guests' expectations in mind and feature a relaxing atmosphere to offer them the utmost well-being. They all come with a large choice of contemporary services and facilities such as Wi-Fi, and range from the single to the Family units, ideal for those needing an extra space. Those travelling on business can take advantage of the onsite meeting facilities. For reservations of more than 3 rooms or more than 6 nights, the guests will be contacted for a change in the cancellation policy. The maximum entrance height of our parking is 2. 5 meters.

name.content: NYX Hotel Madrid by Leonardo Hotels

23424.description: The NYX Hotel Madrid by Leonardo Hotels features a unique design that incorporates the works of local street artists into its design, creating an exceptionally creative atmosphere. This 4-star hotel is located in the financial, commercial district of Madrid, beside the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium, the area of Azca and Orense street. Thanks to its excellent location and the good connections to other areas of the city by public transportation, the NYX Hotel Madrid by Leonardo Hotels is the ideal accommodation option for executives on business trips and tourists on holidays in Madrid. Very well connected to the city center, you will be able to reach Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor or Paseo del Prado in just a few minutes using public transportation. Besides, the hotel is near Real Madrid C. F. Football Stadium and just a few minutes walking from Nuevos Ministerios Metro station, which connects to Madrid-Barajas Airport. A breakfast buffet is offered daily and when the night falls, unwind with a delicious drink at the hotel bar. The hotel also offers a seasonal rooftop pool. The Rooftop Terrace including the pool opens in the Summer season (01. 08- 15. 09. ) It's also necessary that minors are accompanied by an adult at all time while swimming in the rooftop pool.

23425.description: The centrally located Candia Hotel in Athens is a short drive from key attractions like Syntagma Square (3 minutes) and the Acropolis (8 minutes). This 4-star hotel offers a seasonal outdoor pool, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. Other amenities include babysitting (surcharge), a TV lounge, and a reception hall. The 142 guest rooms feature refrigerators, complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Phones, safes, and desks are also provided. The hotel's Candia restaurant serves lunch and dinner, while a coffee shop/cafe offers snacks. Two bars/lounges provide refreshing drinks. Buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee). Additional amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in.

23477.description: This city hotel is located in a residential and commercial area and has good public transport connections to the center and other areas of the city, easily accessible by metro, bus or car. The property is 17 km from Barcelona Airport and a few meters from the Sagrada Familia Temple and the Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau. The hotel has 84 rooms spread over 8 floors. All rooms have a private bathroom with shower or bathtub and toiletries, as well as direct dial telephone, satellite / cable TV, free WIFI, mini bar, safe and air conditioning or heating (depending on season). Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, a safe at the reception, payment lockers to safe the luggage, elevator and terrace on the top floor. In addition, there are meeting rooms and free Internet access.

23497.description: The 300 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. All guests staying at this property will appreciate the 24-hour reception. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

23499.description: With its flawless structure designed according to 16th century Dutch architecture, Orange County Kemer invites you to a magical atmosphere with its magnificent view of the Taurus Mountains and its perfect harmony with the deep blue Mediterranean. Located at the seafront, the facility attracts attention not only with its architecture but also with its service quality and caring staff. You can enjoy your time in the stylish areas of our hotel, which welcomes its guests with the ultra all-inclusive concept, benefit from the swimming pools, sunbathe on the pier and the beach, enjoy the entertainment with activities and shows day and night, and crown your holiday with the restaurants and bars you will find open at all hours of the day. In addition, the little guests of Orange County Kemer can have fun all day long in the children's pool, water slides and Mini-Club.

23502.description: Located on the upper part of Avenida Diagonal and surrounded by other broad avenues, this is the ideal home base for shopping in the city's most fashionable malls and boutiques. Just a short stroll away is the Pedralbes monastery and palace, which houses the ceramics and decorative arts museums. The Bus Turístic has a stop right next to the hotel, and the historic city centre is just fifteen minutes away. This unique hotel tempts with restaurants, a café and the cosy Epsom scotch bar and restaurant offering mediterranean cuisine. The comfortable, stylish rooms come with a fully - equipped en suite bathroom, satellite/ cable TV and Internet access. The air-conditioned units also offer a minibar, a double bed and a safe. The hotel has a swimming pool, solarium, gym and sauna.

23597.description: This airport hotel enjoys a tranquil setting near several historical attractions, including the Abbazia di Chiaravalle, the Abbazia di Viboldone, Rocca Brivio, and the charming 15th-century village of Zivido with its castle and farmhouse. Public transport is conveniently located just 50 meters from the hotel, providing easy access to restaurants, the A1 motorway, and the Rogoredo FS/San Donato metro station (yellow line). Nightclubs, shops, bars, a lake, the town center, the Fila Forum di Assago, the exhibition center, the main train station, and the Monza Autodrome (20 km) are all within a 4-9 km radius. Linate Airport is a short 10-minute drive (6. 5 km), and Malpensa Airport is approximately 45 km away. Recently renovated, the four-story hotel offers 39 guest rooms, including 11 singles, 20 doubles, 3 triples, and 5 junior suites. Guests enjoy a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, lift, café, and TV room. Room and laundry services are also available. Comfortable and bright, each room features an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV (pay-TV, Sky), Wi-Fi, minibar, and a double bed. Rooms are elegantly appointed with tiled, carpeted, or parquet floors and include air conditioning and a safe. Guests can relax at the pool bar or enjoy a round of golf at a nearby course (7 km). A breakfast buffet is served daily.

23598.description: The popular Hotel Mistral is strategically located in the Santa Giulia area of Milan, the new centre planned by star architect Sir Norman Foster. It is just a few steps away from the Rogoredo train station as well as the Rogoredo metro station of the Yellow Line, offering direct access to the Piazza del Duomo and other famous attractions. Important multinational businesses such as Gruppo Eni, Agip, BMW Italia, Sky Italia or LG can be found in the surrounding area. The A1 motorway is only a 5-minute drive away; the international airport Linate can be reached within 10 minutes by car. The hotel offers comfortable accommodation in a peaceful and welcoming atmosphere. The rooms have a friendly interior decoration with appealing colours. Services and amenities include wired and wireless high-speed internet access, a transfer service and a 24-hour bar as well as complimentary breakfast. A perfect place for business travellers.

23638.description: A stay at Grand Hôtel du Havre places you in the heart of Paris, within a 15-minute walk of Palais Garnier and La Machine du Moulin Rouge. This hotel is 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Place Vendôme and 0. 9 mi (1. 5 km) from Champs-Élysées. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Stay in one of 81 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have bathtubs and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and complimentary newspapers. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Paris? This hotel has 269 square feet (25 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Boulevard Haussmann - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Printemps Department Store - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- Theatre Mogador - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Galeries Lafayette - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Grands Boulevards - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Palais Garnier - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Place de Clichy - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Paris Olympia - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Place de la Madeleine - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Place de l'Opéra - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Rue de Rivoli - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi- Place Vendôme - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi- Moulin Rouge - 1. 2 km/0. 7 mi- La Machine du Moulin Rouge - 1. 2 km/0. 7 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 30. 4 km/18. 9 mi Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 21. 2 km/13. 2 mi The preferred airport for Grand Hôtel du Havre is Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG).

23639.description:
This hotel is located in the 9th arrondissement, in a quiet side street, close to Galeries Lafayette and an array of designer boutiques. Numerous shopping venues, stylish restaurants, chic cafés and bars and trendy nightclubs are all in the immediate vicinity. The opera as well as Notre Dame de Lorette and Trinité metro stations are within walking distance. Paris' Charles de Gaulle airport is a mere 45-minute drive away.

Built in 1857 and renovated in the year 2000, the city hotel has 8 floors, of which 6 are singles and 24 are doubles and there are 2 suites. The hotel's facilities include a pleasant lobby, a 24-hour reception with a safe, a cloakroom, a lift, a currency exchange and a bar. In addition, there is an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with a separate non-smoking area and highchairs for children, a conference room and a public Internet terminal with WLAN Internet access. Room and laundry services are also available for guests' use.

The stylish rooms come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, direct dial telephone, satellite and cable TV, radio, a stereo, Internet access and a safe. Moreover they are equipped with a minibar, a fridge and central heating as standard.

The hotel has its own sauna for guests to relax in.

Breakfast is available to guests each morning. A breakfast buffet is available every morning.

name.content: Hotel Le Marquis by Inwood Hotels

23640.description: Located in the heart of the 15th district of Paris, Le Marquis invites you to experience the Parisian Art of Living, in the Rive Gauche district in close proximity to the Eiffel Tower and the Champ de Mars. Le Marquis is a charming and elegant hotel, reflected by Oscar Wilde's Dandy spirit. Come and enjoy the French Art of Living at Le Marquis. You will discover an elegant and refined boutique hotel where good taste and free thinking prevail.

23641.description: This charming hotel with a modern interior enjoys an excellent location in a lovely old part of Paris which maintained its village atmosphere. Situated 100 metres from the saint George metro station, this hotel is welcoming all guests in a unique style between Montmarre and Opera. Famous attractions such as Opéra Garnier, the Montmartre artist's district, Basilica of Sacré Coeur, Moulin Rouge, Place Pigalle or Folies Bergère are within walking distance. Paris entertainment, sightseeing, business and shopping areas are only a few steps from the hotel's front door. Paris - Orly Airport is located 20 km while Paris - Charles de Gaulle Airport is 27 km away from the hotel. Rooms are comfortable, cosy and charming painted with minimal creative artworks. In-room amenities include air-conditioning, flat-screen TV with satellite channels, LED bedside lamps, hairdryer, desk, safe and bath amenities. The hotel also features breakfast service and a beautiful flowered patio.

23643.description: This charming 3-star hotel is a short walk from Place de l'Étoile and the Palais des Congrès. The Champs-Élysées is a 15-minute walk away, and the nearest metro station, just 400 meters from the hotel, offers direct access to Haussmann's shopping area, the Opera House, and other famous Parisian landmarks. Renovated in 2018, the hotel features 65 rooms, including five junior suites and 60 double rooms. All rooms are modernly equipped and provide complimentary Wi-Fi and air conditioning. Each morning, guests enjoy a continental breakfast served in their room or on the terrace during summer. A bar is open daily, offering drinks and snacks in cozy lounges or on the terrace. Please note that the local city tax (€1. 88 per person, per night) is not included in the room rate and is payable directly to the hotel upon check-in/out.

23644.description: Located in the heart of Paris, Hotel Saint Dominique offers a convenient and comfortable stay just a short walk from Rue Cler and Les Invalides. Enjoy on-site amenities including a coffee shop, bar/lounge, and room service (limited hours). Continental breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel's 32 air-conditioned rooms feature refrigerators, free minibar items, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, and 32-inch flat-screen televisions with satellite programming. Bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. The hotel also provides concierge services, gift shops/newsstands, express check-in/check-out, complimentary newspapers, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge). Nearby attractions include the Eiffel Tower and Champs-Élysées, both within a 10-minute walk.

23756.description:
Where the breathtaking beauty of nature meets the turquoise waters, Türkiz Resort Hotel—located in the heart of Kemer—invites you to a unique sense of happiness with its stunning architecture and warm atmosphere. 

The property covers a total area of 12, 000 m² and consists of 4 floors and 4 elevators. 

Internet service is available in the lobby and in the rooms, free of charge. 

A complimentary bottle of water is placed in the minibar on the day of the guest’s arrival. 

Safety deposit boxes are available in the rooms and are free of charge. 

During the winter season, animation and other activities offered during the summer season are not provided as they depend on weather and seasonal conditions. 

The property does not accept pets.

23796.address: Carretera De La Santa Creu De Calafell, 101
23796.description: Escape the hustle of Barcelona at the Sercotel Sant Boi, a tastefully decorated hotel in the peaceful town of Sant Boi. Ideal for family vacations, romantic getaways, or business trips, this hotel offers a unique experience with a range of services. Located just 40 minutes from Barcelona's city center by public transport, you can enjoy the tranquility of Sant Boi while still being close to one of Spain's most vibrant cities. The hotel features a restaurant, gym, bar, cafe, sauna, and conference center. Nearby attractions include museums like the Agbar de les Aigües Science Museum and local shopping centers. Book your relaxing stay at the Sercotel Sant Boi through our official website for the best rates.

name.content: Maison Astor Paris, Curio Collection by Hilton

23817.description: Due to the current travel environment, this hotel is currently not accepting guests for a short period. Reservations are available for future dates. Please see below for up-to-date policy information and ways to contact Hilton Guest Assistance. We look forward to welcoming you to the hotel soon. Welcome to Maison Astor Paris, Curio Collection by Hilton, a hidden gem on a quiet central street in the luxury and fashion district. Built in 1907 by John Jacob Astor IV, our hotel is thoughtfully designed for a stay that's rich in history, Parisian chic and Astor's spirit. Our charming hideaway is steps from Haute Couture shops on the world-famous Avenue des Champs-Élysées, a 10-minute metro ride to the Eiffel Tower, and near the Saint Lazare train station, the gateway to the Normandy region. Our guest rooms take inspiration from Parisian apartments, featuring large windows, beautiful French doors, high ceilings and comforts like complimentary WiFi, an HDTV, work space and Nespresso® machine. Suites offer options such as an ornamental fireplace, terrace, private bedroom, rooftop views and a duplex-style layout. Delight in Parisian cuisine in Salle à Manger, our intimate restaurant showcasing fine dishes from land and sea made with organic local ingredients by Chef Nicolas Clavier. Our certified mixologists are pleased to craft you a cocktail, and we also offer room service from morning ‘til night. Maison Astor Paris is perfect for board meetings and small social gatherings, boasting fashionable conference rooms and restaurant spaces for up to 60 guests. Whether you enjoy an early or late workout, our fitness center is open round the clock. Our Concierge service is available 24 hours to go above and beyond your expectations for a memorable experience in the City of Light.

23841.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this Victorian hotel in Edinburgh. With complimentary Wi-Fi, iPod docking stations, and flat-screen TVs, our 71 individually decorated guestrooms offer a comfortable retreat. Savor British cuisine at the 1886 Restaurant with garden views and alfresco dining, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Amenities include a bar/lounge, full breakfasts (fee applies), a 24-hour business center, free self-parking, and extensive conference space. Nearby attractions include Braid Hills Golf Course (0. 5 mi), Napier University (1. 2 mi), and The Meadows (2 mi). Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 10. 4 miles away.

23876.description: This hotel enjoys a mesmerising location in San Lorenzo del Escorial. It is located within easy access of a broad range of attractions in the area. A number of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can also be found nearby. The hotel lies just 70 km away from Barajas International Airport. This hotel is widely recognised as the oldest establishment in the city. The hotel has beautifully retained its historical flavour, yet has been developed into a modern, stylish establishment. The guest rooms beautifully combine traditional and contemporary elements. The hotel offers many facilities and services that have been designed with the needs of every type of traveller in mind.

23982.description: This appealing budget hotel offering good value for money is situated in Esplugues de Llobregat in the outskirts of the Catalan capital of Barcelona. It features a 24h-reception. The next metro station is just a short walk away, the centre of Barcelona is easily reachable by public transport. The international airport is about 10 km away and can be reached within 15 minutes by public transport.

24396.description: This accomodation offers a total of 21 rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

name.content: Van der Valk Hotel Berliner Ring

24404.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, a fitness center, and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge) that operates within 6 kilometers. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Atrium Restaurant, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services.

24696.description: Overlooking Hyde Park in prestigious Knightsbridge, The Lanesborough stands as an elegant example of London's Regency architecture. Ideally located near Buckingham Palace, Harrods, and the boutiques of Sloane Street, this landmark hotel offers guests a luxurious experience. Following a meticulous renovation by the world-renowned Alberto Pinto studio, The Lanesborough, now part of the Oetker Collection, features 93 sumptuously decorated rooms and 46 suites. Guests can enjoy elegant dining at Apsleys, set within a beautiful, naturally lit conservatory, or savor a rare cognac in the Library Bar. The Garden Room, London's most luxurious cigar bar, offers an impressive selection of Cuban and pre-Castro cigars. Each guest is pampered with personalized butler service, ensuring a truly unforgettable stay.

24721.description: This modern, contemporary style city hotel is excellently located in Beyoğlu, just off the renowned Istiklal shopping street. Guests will find themselves among museums, art galleries, restaurants, bars and night clubs. Main transport links are within a short walking distance. The hotel is 22 km from Ataturk Airport and 52 km from Sabiha Gokcen International Airport. Rooms are decorated in chic and modern style, equipped with amenities that guests need during the stay. The hotel features a restaurant, a café and a fitness centre. Guests can enjoy fantastic views over the Golden Horn and the historic city centre with its famous attractions such as Hagia Sophia, Topkapi palace or Blue Mosque, especially from its delightful rooftop terrace with outdoor pool.

24722.description:
Pamper yourself with onsite massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 4 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional amenities at this property include complimentary wireless internet access, babysitting (surcharge), and an arcade/game room. This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Grab a bite at Paloma Restaurant, one of the property's 5 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 5 bars/lounges. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

24824.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Hotel Ceilidh-donia, located in Edinburgh's Prestonfield area, a short drive from the Royal Mile and the University of Edinburgh. This hotel offers 17 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can relax in the bar/lounge and make use of convenient amenities such as a picnic area and barbecue grills. A 24-hour front desk and luggage storage are also available. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 13. 1 miles away.

24838.description: This small luxury hotel is nestled in the heart of Antalya's historic district, just 10 km from Antalya Airport, easily accessible by land or sea. A short stroll reveals a vibrant array of shops, restaurants, bars, and nightclubs, while the nearest beach is a mere 250 meters away. Public transport is also within walking distance. The hotel offers handsomely appointed rooms, an on-site snack restaurant, a café, and a bar. Guests can also utilize a safe and currency exchange. Each comfortable, air-conditioned room features a private bathroom, a king-size bed, and a minibar. The outdoor swimming pool area is complete with a snack bar, sun loungers, and parasols.

24842.description: Seamlessly blending imperial charm with state-of-the-art facilities, this charming apartment hotel is the ideal starting point for those wishing to visit Berlin's most famous sights, with Potsdamer Platz just a 10-minute walk away. Whether they choose a guestroom, a suite or an apartment, visitors will receive a set of standard first-class features like individually controlled air conditioning, cable TV and minibar. After a long and eventful day of work or sightseeing, they can relax with a visit to the sauna or enjoy a rejuvenating massage, before heading down to the elegant on-site restaurant for a delicious dinner in a luxurious atmosphere.

24878.description: This charming hotel sits amidst the culture and history of the captivating city of Edinburgh. The hotel is situated in the city centre, close to Princes Street. The nearest station, Waverley, offers ease of access to other areas of the city to be explored. This wonderful hotel enjoys close proximity to a wealth of attractions in this charming city. The hotel enjoys a sophisticated design. The guest rooms offer comfort and functionality in a peaceful setting. The hotel offers an unprecedented choice of facilities and services, attending to the needs of every type of traveller to a high level of excellence.

25049.description: The Hilton Garden Inn Queens/JFK Airport offers both business and leisure travelers a comfortable and convenient stay near JFK Airport. Enjoy amenities such as our complimentary airport shuttle (call for pickup at Federal Circle), 24-hour business center, fitness facility, and in-room refrigerators and microwaves. Indulge in the comfort of our Garden Sleep System Beds in all King rooms. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Savor delicious meals at the Great American Grill or grab a quick snack at our 24-hour Pavilion Pantry. The hotel features 1200 sq ft of meeting space, ideal for events of 5 to 65 guests. Our dedicated sales team and onsite catering options can assist in planning your perfect business meeting, family reunion, or special celebration. Conveniently located near top businesses such as the FAA, JetBlue Airways, and Bombardier.

25199.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy British cuisine at Cast Iron Grill, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Bexleyheath? This hotel has 0 square feet (0 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 8 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 142 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets.

name.content: Embassy by Petit Palace anteriormente Icon Embassy

25260.description:
Embassy by Petit Palace formerly known as Icon Embassy Hotel is located in the heart of Madrid’s exclusive Salamanca district, on the prestigious Serrano Street, surrounded by luxury boutiques, art galleries, fine dining restaurants, and some of the city’s most important embassies. Ideally situated between Hermosilla and Ayala streets, and just a short walk from Paseo de la Castellana and Plaza de Colón, the hotel is the perfect base for discovering Madrid. 

Recently renovated, the hotel combines contemporary design, comfort, and a sophisticated atmosphere. Its elegant and fully equipped rooms feature private bathrooms and all the amenities required for both leisure and business stays. 

Guests can also enjoy the hotel’s restaurant, bar, and café, while the reception team will be delighted to provide local recommendations and assistance with tickets for Madrid’s main attractions.

name.content: New York Marriott at the Brooklyn Bridge

25353.description: The New York Marriott at the Brooklyn Bridge offers guests a variety of amenities, including a fitness center, garden, and on-site dining at the snack bar/deli and bar/lounge. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of concierge services and a hair salon. Each of the 666 individually furnished guest rooms features a refrigerator, Smart TV, premium bedding, and cable programming. For business travelers, the hotel boasts a business center, express check-in/check-out, and extensive meeting space, including a conference center and 30 meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Located near Brooklyn Bridge Park, Barclays Center, and the iconic Brooklyn Bridge, the hotel provides easy access to key attractions.

name.content: Doubletree By Hilton New York Laguardia Airport

25354.description: LaGuardia Plaza Hotel is an independent hotel that has joined the Hilton Honors program. Located across the street from LaGuardia International Airport (LGA) and eight miles from John F Kennedy (JFK) Airport, LaGuardia Plaza Hotel is an ideal base for travelers on business or pleasure. Take the stress out of traveling, knowing you are minutes from the airport while also accessible to all that New York City has to offer. Stay productive and spend more time in the City with the added convenience of our complimentary shuttle service to and from LGA Airport. Sink into the soft linens and in-room conveniences like complimentary WiFi, HDTVs with premium channels, spacious work areas and Starbucks™ coffee. Start your day right with a breakfast buffet at Pavilion Grille and watch your favorite sporting event on our large-screen TVs at Elements Lounge. Convenient in-room dining is also available. Unwind after a busy day of sightseeing with a dip in the indoor pool or re-energize with an invigorating workout at the fitness center. With 12, 000 sq. ft. of flexible meeting and event space, our LaGuardia Airport hotel provides a convenient destination for your next meeting or event. Choose from one of 15 function rooms to host everything from corporate retreats to weddings of up to 350 guests. Whether it’s business or a weekend getaway that brings you to LGA, our courteous hotel staff looks forward to welcoming you.

25438.description: Ideal for a weekend getaway or business trip, the charming and welcoming Hotel Le Dauphin is an independent three-star hotel offering a home-away-from-home experience. Ideally situated just a stone's throw from Paris and the renowned La Défense business district, the hotel provides easy access to the capital's attractions. The Hotel Le Dauphin welcomes guests 24/7, 365 days a year, to its 40 comfortable and well-equipped rooms, available in Classic or Luxe categories.

25457.address: Circuito de los Marinos No. exterior SN
25457.description: 'Nestled on a lush 480-hectare island teeming with coconut trees and fountains, this hotel offers a tranquil escape just two minutes from Barra de Navidad's beach and town center. Located on Mexico's Costa Dorada, it's conveniently situated 85 km from Colima and 35 minutes from Manzanillo International Airport. The hotel features 199 rooms spread across two buildings, adorned with original artwork and modern amenities, including air conditioning, 24-hour reception, currency exchange, and internet access. Guests can enjoy a variety of dining options, from the casual 'El Gran Café' with bay views to the vibrant 'La Plazuela' with its Mexican-inspired decor. The 'Tequilas' bar offers an extensive selection of tequilas, while 'El Faro' lobby bar provides cocktails and live piano music. Additional amenities include a pool with an aqua bar, kids' club, room and laundry services, and medical assistance. The spacious rooms boast classic-modern decor in earthy tones, complemented by light wood furnishings and ornate tilework. Each room features a king-size or two double beds, en-suite bathroom, hairdryer, and private balcony or terrace with mountain views. Modern conveniences include a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, minibar, coffee machine, and individually controlled air conditioning. A valid credit card is required upon registration. '

25496.description: Located near iconic landmarks like Big Ben and the London Eye, Park Plaza London Riverbank offers a perfect starting point for exploring London. Guests can maintain their fitness routines in the state-of-the-art fitness center or enjoy the heated indoor pool with natural daylight. The hotel also features the award-winning Chino Latino Pan-Asian Restaurant & Bar with stunning Thames views, and an Executive Lounge on the 12th floor offering panoramic cityscapes. Its 489 deluxe guestrooms and suites include amenities such as TVs and a pillow menu, with select rooms boasting impressive river views.

25519.description: Inntel Hotels Amsterdam Zaandam is a popular choice amongst travelers in Amsterdam, whether exploring or just passing through. Both business travelers and tourists can enjoy the hotel's facilities and services. Facilities like free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, express check-in/check-out, Wi-Fi in public areas, car park are readily available for you to enjoy. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like television LCD/plasma screen, separate living room, internet access – wireless, whirlpool bathtub, non smoking rooms. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include fitness center, sauna, indoor pool, massage, steamroom. No matter what your reasons are for visiting Amsterdam, Inntel Hotels Amsterdam Zaandam will make you feel instantly at home.

25536.description: Located on Turkey's Mediterranean coast in the small town of Çamyuva, this extensive complex enjoys a great location overlooking the turquoise sea and with a backdrop of the Taurus Mountains. Suitable for most ages, this luxury hotel has a range of leisure and sporting activities occupying an area measuring more than 22. 6 hectares. The pebble beach stretches for 235 m and as well as providing sunbeds and umbrellas, there are private cabanas which can be hired. Other features include a buffet and à la carte restaurants, a couple of bars and the Monkey Nightclub. Kemer is a short ride by public transport. Promo room doesn't have balcony and it is forest view.

25545.description: This hotel is located around 50 m from the city centre where bars, restaurants and shopping opportunities as well as a bus stop are to be found. Istanbul airport is around 16 kms away. The city's sightseeing attractions are within a 10-minute drive. Renovated in 2005, this hotel has a total of 81 rooms. It offers 2 conference rooms as well as Internet access and a WLAN access point. In addition, guests are offered shops, a hairdresser, a bar, a nightclub, a breakfast room and a dining room. Parking facilities are also available. As standard, all bedrooms include an en-suite bathroom, air conditioning and heating. The hotel's Turkish bath, massage services and the sauna are all available for an added fee. Guests may serve themselves at the breakfast buffet. At lunchtime and in the evenings guests may select dishes from the set menu or choose from the à la carte option.

25546.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Satisfy your appetite with Turkish cuisine at Terrace Restaurant, arestaurant where you can take in the ocean view and dine alfresco. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary on-the-go breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 27 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

25547.address: Osmanağa Mahallesi Mühürdar Fuat Sk. No:5, 5
25547.description: Located in Kadıköy, Istanbul's vibrant business district, the 4-star Dila Hotel offers 79 comfortable rooms, including a suite and superior options. Our earthquake-resistant building provides a secure and high-quality experience. Amenities include two well-equipped meeting centers, a restaurant showcasing Turkish cuisine, a terrace bar, a fitness center, and secure indoor parking. The Dila Hotel team looks forward to welcoming you.

25548.address: BINBIRDIREK MAH. KATIP SINAN CAMII SOK., 31
25548.description: Set on a quiet street just two minutes from the beautiful Blue Mosque and at the heart of Sultanahmet, Istanbul's cultural and historical district, this hotel offers the ideal combination of peace and comfort with a totally central location. Rooms are softly lit and decorated in lavish Ottoman style, all en suite with air-conditioning, free WIFI, complementary tea and coffee tray, and city, garden or sea views. Guests can indulge in breakfast in bed with 24-hour room service, or enjoy a wholesome buffet breakfast in the hotel restaurant, which also serves lunch and dinner to order from a set menu. Attentive hotel staff are happy to help give directions and plan cultural visits as well as arrange services including babysitting and car rental. This hotel is ideal for sightseeing at less than 15 minutes' walk from all the main attractions, including Topkapi Palace, the Grand Bazaar and Hagia Sophia.

25549.description: The Green Park Taksim is within walking distance of Istanbul's premier shopping, dining, and entertainment venues. Just steps from the metro, the hotel is 350 meters from Gezi Park and 600 meters from the Atatürk Cultural Center. The 185-room hotel embodies the spirit of Istanbul, offering guests an authentic cultural experience in the heart of the city. Enjoy the vibrant energy of Istiklal Street and Taksim Square, bustling with life day and night. The hotel's central location also provides easy access to various cultural and historical attractions. Please note: The Green Park Taksim prioritizes family accommodations. Bookings from unmarried couples may be declined, or a second room may be required.

25550.description: This hotel is located in Sirkeci, one of Istanbul's most historic districts, within easy reach of historical places like Hagia Sophia Museum, Sultan Ahmet Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Topkapi Palace and Hippodrome.
