Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, currency exchange, cloakroom, lift access, a bar and a restaurant. Guests can use of the hotel's Wi-Fi and, for an additional fee, the room and laundry services.

25551.description: This hotel is situated in Istanbul's city centre right next to Istanbul University's main campus and near many public transport links, making it easy to explore this ancient city and all its cultural and historical attractions. Ataturk Airport is only 15 km away. The hotel offers 65 comfortable and classic rooms, equipped with air-conditioning, satellite TV and bathroom with shower. The hotel's restaurant serves traditional Turkish cuisine and vegetarian dishes, and guests can enjoy a nice Turkish coffee or raki in the lobby bar after a busy day of sightseeing. Those who like to keep up with current events or football will appreciate the hotel's café and TV hall.

25552.description: Located in Istanbul's city center, Maya Hotel Istanbul is within a 15-minute walk of the Grand Bazaar and Süleymaniye Mosque. This hotel offers 50 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a refrigerator, LED TV, and minibar (stocked with some free items). Complimentary Wi-Fi and satellite programming are also provided. Private bathrooms include showers, bidets, and hair dryers. Enjoy a meal at the on-site restaurant, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily. Additional amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and a bar/lounge. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies). Nearby attractions include the Blue Mosque (2. 8 km) and Galata Tower (3. 2 km). The nearest airports are Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) and Istanbul Airport (IST).

25553.address: Kucuk Langa Caddesi - Aksaray Mah. Fatih, 9
25553.description: This family-friendly, city hotel is located in the heart of the historical district of Aksaray. Museums, historical buildings such as Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace are within a 15-minute walk. Atatürk International Airport is 15 kms from the hotel. This air-conditioned hotel was fully renovated in 2006 and offers 55 guest rooms, a restaurant-bar, a hotel lobby with a 24-hour check-in service, a hotel safe, a currency exchange service, lift access, WLAN Internet access, and 24-hour room service and a laundry service. All units are en-suite and contain a direct dial telephone, satellite TV and a hairdryer. The rooms have individually regulated air-conditioning units, central heating and balconies /terraces. The restaurant serves a breakfast buffet.

25638.description: This hotel is located directly in the historic and tourist centre of Madrid. It is around 100 m from the Puerta del Sol and the Plaza Mayor, as well as the Prado, Thyssen, and Reina Sofia museums. The nearest public transport stop can be found in the immediate vicinity of the hotel, while the railway station can be comfortably reached in about 15 minutes on foot. Constructed in 1871, this hotel has undergone restoration work and is well-preserved. Those arriving by car may make use of two public car parks situated about 50 m away (Plaza Santa Ana and Plaza Jacinto Benavente). The rooms all come with an en suite bathroom. Further facilities include a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV and a hire safe. Air conditioning and central heating alsp come as standard.

25639.description: This hotel enjoys an excellent location in a converted Ottoman house on the corner of Hippodrome Square and close to the major attractions at Sultanahmet. A small and cosy hotel, the rooms are well furnished and many have a relaxing view of the square. Breakfast can be enjoyed from the hotel's rooftop terrace affording exceptional views of the Blue Mosque and Bosphorous while the atmospheric pavement cafe is a great place for a daytime snack or refreshing drink. The famous sights in Sultanahmet are within easy walking distance and links to public transport are less than 5 minutes' walk, while ferries to the Asian side of the city depart from Yenikpai, 1. 5 km away.

25657.description: This 2 star hotel is located in the city centre of New York. The Hotel has an outdoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 360 rooms are equipped with air conditioning.

25658.description: The hotel is located on Long Island, approximately 1. 6 km from the centre of Manhattan, which can be easily reached via underground public transport. There is a station situated not far from the hotel and various restaurants are also found in the immediate vicinity of the property. This air-conditioned establishment comprises a total of 80 rooms, spread over 8 floors. Facilities available to guests include a bar and an on-site restaurant where delicious treats are served. The cosy rooms all come with an en-suite bathroom and offer entertainment via TV, radio and Internet access. Furthermore, most rooms come equipped with a microwave and fridge and all feature centrally regulated heating and air conditioning as standard.

name.content: Hilton Garden Inn London Heathrow Airport

25682.address: Eastern Perimeter Rd, Hatton Cross, London
25682.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Hilton Garden Inn London Heathrow offers you the perfect location near the airport, with easy access to central London. Located in central Heathrow, our hotel is within a 10-minute drive of Terminals 2, 3, 4, and 5. Our property also is within the free Heathrow underground travel zone, meaning you can travel for free between Hatton Cross and all Heathrow Airport terminals. Reach some of London’s must-see attraction, such as Hyde Park, the British Museum, and other destinations on the Piccadilly line from Hatton Cross underground station, situated a five-minute walk from our hotel. Relax at Jack’s Restaurant & Bar and enjoy crowd-pleasing British cuisine with an international twist from our chef. Our bright hearted team members are here to create memorable experiences for you and look forward to making you feel welcomed, recognized, cared for, and wowed when you leave our hotel.

25840.description: We would like to inform you that our Spa will be temporarily out of service for renovation between the period 1st and 16th December 2024. This 5 star hotel is located within the city of Istanbul and was established in 1982. It is a short drive away from the Shopping Centers and the nearest station is Gayrettepe Metro Stn. The Hotel has a restaurant, a bar, a coffee shop, an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 325 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, trouser press and air conditioning.

25842.description: This exclusive hotel is centrally located in the modern, European Taksim district in the beautiful and culturally rich city of Istanbul. Visitors will be able to easily reach the main sightseeing points of interest such as the Golden Horn or the Sultans palace of Topkapi, and discover plenty of chic boutiques and shops on Istiklal Street and Nisantasi district just a few minutes on foot. All bedrooms boast a luxurious look and come fitted with beautiful furniture and a touch of colour. Some exclusive amenities are included so that guests feel special, such as Egyptian cotton sheets and slippers. Those guests on business may make good use of one of the three state-of-the-art meeting rooms and at the hotel’s restaurants visitors may savour the tasty Turkish and European delicacies that are served. There is also wireless Internet connection to help guests keep updated.

25858.description: Situated moments from the Barbican Centre, Europe's largest arts venue and home to the London Symphony Orchestra and Royal Shakespeare Company, Citadines Barbican London offers a prime location for exploring the city. St. Paul's Cathedral is within a 15-minute walk, while the Globe Theatre and Tate Modern are a short trip across the Thames. Covent Garden is easily accessible, less than a 10-minute drive away. This aparthotel features 129 studio and one-bedroom apartments, each equipped with a separate kitchen (stove, microwave/grill, fridge, dishwasher), bathroom, TV, and safe. Weekly housekeeping is included, with additional cleaning available upon request. Explore the vibrant neighborhood's diverse restaurants, traditional pubs, historic Smithfield area, and Sadler's Wells Theatre. Major attractions like the Tower of London and Tower Bridge are also within walking distance. Citadines is committed to high hygiene standards through its 'Ascott Cares' program.

25859.description: Situated a short walk from Covent Garden and the West End, Citadines Holborn-Covent Garden London offers convenient access to the financial district, traditional pubs, international restaurants, art galleries, and churches. Nearby attractions include the British Museum and the Old Bailey. Excellent transport links are provided by the Holborn tube station, just 400 feet away. The aparthotel features studios and one-bedroom apartments, each with a fully-equipped kitchenette, stylish living area, and en suite bathroom. Guests enjoy weekly housekeeping, laundry and concierge service, versatile meeting rooms, a breakfast room, and an exercise room. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available in public areas. As Citadines is eco-friendly, e-car charging station is available for our guests. Please contact reception to book your space and your charging slot.

25860.description: Situated in the heart of London's chic Kensington and Chelsea districts, Citadines South Kensington London offers contemporary apartment-style accommodations. Refurbished in 2010, this aparthotel boasts a prime location surrounded by Victorian architecture and charming tree-lined streets. Enjoy free internet access and proximity to Kensington Palace, Hyde Park, renowned museums, and Harrods. Each studio and one-bedroom apartment features a bathroom and a separate, fully-equipped kitchen area. One-bedroom apartments include a dishwasher. All apartments offer a stove, microwave/grill, fridge, TV with satellite channels, a direct-line phone, hairdryer, safe, and air conditioning. Citadines is also committed to high hygiene standards through its Ascott Cares program.

25861.description: With a stay at Citadines Trafalgar Square London, you'll be centrally located in London, steps from The Strand and 3 minutes by foot from Charing Cross. This 4-star aparthotel is 0. 2 mi (0. 3 km) from Trafalgar Square and 0. 2 mi (0. 3 km) from National Gallery. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 187 guestrooms, featuring kitchenettes with refrigerators and microwaves. Wired and wireless Internet access is complimentary, and flat-screen televisions with digital programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

name.content: Best Western Plus Dunfermline Crossford Keavil Hou

25880.description: Best Western Plus Dunfermline Crossford Keavil House Hotel provides a gorgeous getaway, near Edinburgh. Found in the scenic village of Crossford, the country house hotel and spa offers rural relaxation just two miles away from Dunfermline (where Robert the Bruce, King of Scots is buried). Nearby you’ll also find several beaches, Knockhill Racing circuit, Deep Sea World and many scenic walks and cycling routes. However, if you’re looking for some city fun, you’ll be just 10 minutes away from the motorway network and half an hour from Edinburgh. Whilst in Edinburgh, why not visit the Royal Botanic Gardens, the Scottish National Gallery, Arthurs seat, or some of the splendid shops found on Princes Street. This Best Western Plus hotel in Dunfermline boasts state of the art leisure facilities, all waiting to be taken advantage of. A gym, 15 meter pool, sauna, steam room, Jacuzzi® spa, sunbed and tanning cabin can all be found, for plenty of well-deserved you-time. An abundance of beauty and spa treatments are also available, if you’re in need of some pampering. Here at Best Western Plus Dunfermline Crossford Keavil House Hotel we are proud to offer the most efficient service, the best customer care and facilities, and the most delicious cuisines of available in a Best Western Plus property, as you can expect nothing but style and comfort during your stay.

25883.description: Occidental Istanbul City, a 4-star hotel, has 153 rooms, designed in detail to suit the needs of travellers of all kinds. At this accommodation in Istanbul, each stay combines a modern and cosy style with a comfortable and functional atmosphere, ideal for both short breaks and extended trips. This Istanbul property, with 4 room categories, offers versatile options to suit every guest profile, ensuring everyone finds the perfect stay for their trip.

25899.description: Amrâth Hotel Alkmaar is located a short walk from the city centre. The train station is nearby, just as the Kaasmarkt, shops and the Stedelijk Museum. The hotel rooms have a bath, TV and minibar. A breakfast buffet is available in the breakfast area. There is a bar for drinks. Amrâth Hotel Alkmaar does not have a restaurant, but there are numerous possibilities to eat out. The staff will be happy to recommend any interesting places. The beach of Egmond or Bergen can be reached in a 15-minute car ride.

name.content: Summer Stays at The University of Edinburgh

25916.description: This inviting university complex is an ideal starting point for guests wishing to explore the city. From the complex, guests are offered a stunning view of the historical hill with Arthur's Seat. The Royal Mile, the Scottish Parliament and the Palace of Holyrood are all within easy reach of the complex. Restaurants, a train station, bars, pubs and public transport are within 500 m of the university complex, shopping facilities and nightclubs are within 1 km and the city centre is 3 km away. Edinburgh airport is located 12 km from the complex. Built in 2004, there are a total of 526 rooms spread over a 6-storey main building. Guests are welcomed in the foyer with 24-hour reception desk, 12 safes and 8 lifts, which is situated within the Chancellors Court building. Further facilities include 3 cafés, a kiosk, a bar and 2 restaurants with highchairs for infants and culinary delights. In addition, there are 18 conference rooms and a public Internet terminal available for use (additional fees apply). A laundry service, for an added fee, completes the offerings. Bicycle storage facilities are also on hand and those arriving by car may make use of the car park, which is free of charge. The pleasant rooms feature a bathroom with a shower, a direct dial telephone, a TV, a tea/ coffee maker and individual heating. Guests may select their breakfast, midday and evening meals from a buffet. In addition, lunch may also be chosen from the set menu.

25917.description: Located in the leafy Southside of Edinburgh, in the beautiful grounds of the Pollock Estate, The Scholar is a newly refurbished hotel within walking distance of all of the city's world famous landmarks. We take a serious approach to quality and comfort. All of the bedrooms in The Scholar are luxurious and feature large beds, Elite mattresses, and quality linen to ensure the best possible night's sleep. All rooms also include a TV with a whole host of channels, award winning Novus tea and cafetiere coffee, and a desk with ample work space. Our large bathrooms include rainfall showers, Laura Thomas toiletries and fluffy towels. The hotel's contemporary restaurant, bar and garden dining area proudly serve the highest quality breakfast, lunch and dinner. We focus on using locally sourced Scottish ingredients, from Stornoway black pudding at breakfast to serving Holyrood Gin from our neighbouring distillery, allowing you to sample Edinburgh's excellent food and drink scene without needing to leave the hotel. If you are seeking inspiration for what to do, the local Southside neighbourhood buzzes with small restaurants, bars and an eclectic mix of independent shops. Our friendly staff are always on hand to help and share their top tips on the best places to explore. We offer free parking on site but have limited availability. We also offer 18 free electric vehicle charging points (electric charging requires a 'Charge Places Scotland' card which can be borrowed from reception).

25936.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Business Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s). The following services and amenities are currently not available: Airport Shuttle, Fitness Center, Room Service, Valet Parking. Welcome to our Hilton Garden Inn New York/Staten Island hotel. Situated just minutes away from Newark International Airport and Manhattan, our Staten Island hotel boasts a prime location in the heart of the Corporate Park of Staten Island and is nestled in 415 acres of preserved woodland. Make yourself at home in a comfortable guest room at our bright and airy Hilton Garden Inn New York/Staten Island hotel. Enjoy complimentary WiFi access and relax on our comfortable Garden Sleep System bed. Work at the large work desk with an ergonomic chair by Herman Miller and enjoy secure remote printing. Enjoy freshly prepared breakfast, lunch and dinner at Lorenzo's Restaurant, Bar & Cabaret, featuring Italian and contemporary American cuisine and Tony Award-winning cabaret performances on select Friday evenings. Prepare a meal from the 24-hour Pavilion Pantry with your in-room microwave, refrigerator and coffeemaker or enjoy evening room service. Host a meeting in our flexible meeting space or celebrate a special occasion in the stunning Nicotra's Ballroom featuring a dramatic design, a spectacular outdoor Florentine Gazebo and striking views of the surrounding woodland.

26116.description: With a stay at Holiday Inn Istanbul City, an IHG Hotel, you'll be centrally located in Istanbul, within a 10-minute drive of Grand Bazaar and Galata Tower. This luxury hotel is 4 mi (6. 4 km) from Blue Mosque and 4 mi (6. 4 km) from Topkapi Palace. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a health club, a sauna, and a seasonal outdoor pool. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Make yourself at home in one of the 203 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature bidets and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Enjoy pizza at Pizza Kitchen, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Istanbul? This hotel has 861 square feet (80 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Parking is available daily for fee. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

26117.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. The Bosphorus Inn restaurant offers international cuisine with ocean views, and snacks are available at the coffee shop. Mingle with guests at the daily complimentary reception or unwind at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available (fee applies). The hotel features a business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Host your Istanbul event in 1, 184 sq ft of space, including conference space and five meeting rooms. The 103 guest rooms offer minibars, LCD TVs, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Located near Istiklal Avenue, Pera Palace Hotel, and Galata Tower, the hotel is also a short distance from attractions like the Galata Bridge and the Bosphorus. Istanbul Airport (IST) is the preferred airport.

26118.address: Mithatpasa Cad. Abuhayat Sok. No: 5 Beyazit
26118.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a sauna, a fitness center, and bicycles to rent. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and shopping on site. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 45 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions.

name.content: The Trafalgar St. James London, Curio Collection

26120.description: Boasting a prime location in the prestigious Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, 100 Queen's Gate Hotel London, Curio Collection by Hilton, is on the doorstep of iconic cultural attractions including the Royal Albert Hall, Natural History Museum, Science Museum, and Victoria and Albert Museum. Enjoy a leisurely stroll from our historic, Victorian-style hotel to Harrods, Notting Hill, Kensington Palace, Hyde Park, and the designer boutiques of Knightsbridge. Following a multimillion-pound refurbishment, guest rooms and suites at our Kensington hotel exude elegance and feature complimentary WiFi, electronic newspapers, flat-screen HDTVs with Chromecast, and bathroom amenities. Unwind in a stylish Deluxe or Luxury bedroom with upgraded amenities and additional space. For a unique experience, select a two-level Duplex suite, boasting a top-floor location. Enjoy a workout in our state-of-the-art gymnasium or host a small meeting in one of two elegant boardrooms. Our signature restaurant Cento proudly showcases the very best of traditional Italian cuisine. Breakfast and all-day dining can be enjoyed here, or unwind with a late-night drink in our concept cocktail bar ESQ. For a traditional Botanical Afternoon Tea or pre-theatre drinks in a sophisticated atrium setting, visit Botanica. 100 Queen's Gate Hotel London offers 24-hour room service so you can dine in the comfort of your room or suite, day, or night.

26156.description: This hotel is conveniently located on the island of Lido, a beautiful and long sandbar in Venice, where the Venice Film Festival takes place every year. Opposite the coast, guests will find a wide selection of shops, nightclubs, bars and other places where they can taste typical food. The nearest beach is 500 metres away. The island also offers numerous activities to do such as excursions, wonderful helicopter tours, golf clubs and water sports. For those visitors who appreciate good style, this elegant hotel features spacious and charming rooms. Additionally, the most discerning visitors may prefer to stay in rooms with direct views to the bay of San Marco and the lagoon, all of them decorated in a Venetian style, with pastel colours and Murano glass lamps. Guests can have a delicious breakfast every morning and relax at the on-site bar while enjoying a refreshing drink.

26157.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at this Venice hotel, featuring a café and bar/lounge. The 15 air-conditioned rooms offer minibars, satellite TV, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and bidets. Safes and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is daily. Located in Venice's Cannaregio district, A La Locanda di Orsaria is a short walk from Piazzale Roma and the Grand Canal, offering easy access to the Port of Venice.

26158.description: Overlooking the Grand Canal, the charming Hotel Canal is set in an old building alongside the most important waterway of Venice. Attractions such as the Basilica dei Friari, Scuola Grande di San Rocco and the Jewish Ghetto are only steps away; the Rialto Bridge can be reached within a 10-minute walk. World-famous Saint Mark's Square is within a leisurely 30-minute walk. The hotel is set opposite Santa Lucia train station and very close to Piazzale Roma. The rooms are very bright and inviting and feature 18th century furnishings as well as original flooring with lighting and mirrors made from Murano glass, creating the characteristic and elegant Venetian ambience. Guests can enjoy the hotel's beautiful flower garden, a very rare attribute for a Venice hotel. Other services and amenities include 24-hour reception, a bar and a lovely breakfast room. A wonderful place for a romantic getaway.

26159.description: Located approximately 1 km from the city center and 5 km from the nearest beach, this hotel offers convenient access to shops, restaurants, bars, nightclubs, and public transport. Originally built in 1800 and renovated in 2010, the two-story hotel features 15 rooms, a 24-hour reception, a safe, a bar, a café, and room service. Each comfortable room includes air conditioning, an en-suite bathroom with hairdryer, a king-sized bed, individually regulated heating, a direct-dial telephone, internet access, and satellite/cable TV. Guests can enjoy a daily breakfast buffet.

26196.description: 'Enjoy a comfortable stay at Hotel Clement Barajas in Madrid's Barajas district, conveniently located near IFEMA and Calle de Alcalá. Make the most of complimentary Wi-Fi and on-site dining at Urban Bistro, featuring Spanish cuisine and a bar/lounge. Room service is also available during limited hours. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies), and utilize amenities such as the business center and 24-hour front desk. The hotel offers 72 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a minibar, flat-screen TV, private bathroom, and safe. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Juan Carlos I Park and Plenilunio Shopping Mall. Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD) is just a short drive away. '

26202.description: Boasting a fantastic location in the heart of Venice's historical centre, this charismatic hotel offers its guests a perfect place to discover the main sites of this magical city. The property is just a short distance from the famous Rialto Bridge and a 5-minute walk from St. Mark's Square, where travellers can find many important monuments that are worth to see, such as the Bell Tower and St. Mark's Church. San Marco's district is also known as Venice's commercial point where visitors can find numerous shops as well as a popular local market. The establishment is decorated in a classic Venetian style, featuring charming rooms with a combination of vintage furniture and modern facilities such as complimentary Wi-Fi access and air-conditioning. Guests can start their day with a delicious continental breakfast every morning and the on-site restaurant is open for lunch and for dinner, offering excellent local cuisine.

26277.address: Camyuva Mah. Uzuncinar Deniz Cad. Kemer / Antalya, 1
26277.description: With the Taurus Mountains in the background and the aquamarine waters of the Mediterranean within 300m, this compact hotel offers a pleasant place to stay in the small resort of Camyuva, 8 km along the coast from the larger town of Kemer. Local amenities can be found in the vicinity of the hotel including public transport enabling easy access around the area to towns such as Kemer for a great selection of shops, cafe bars and restaurants or the nearby ruins of Phaselis by the water's edge. The hotel has a modern design with a glass atrium lobby and boasts a number of facilities for guests' entertainment and convenience, whether this is a rejuvenating sauna or Turkish bath, fun on the waterslide by the outdoor pool or enjoying the hotel's private beach facilities.

26416.description: Oran Hotel is located in a central position in historic peninsula 1. 2 km from Grand Bazaar, 2. 3 km from Hagia Sophia, 2 km from Blue Mosque and Basilica Cistern. The hotel offers comfortably furnished rooms with free internet access and buffet breakfast included, just 50 metres from a metro, tram and bus station. Oran Hotel is situated in Laleli neighbourhood, close to plenty of traditional restaurants and shopping opportunities. Each of the rooms is fully air-conditioned and has a cosy seating area. Guests can make full use of Oran's traditional Turkish bath facilities, sauna and hammam. Guests can easily access the rest of Istanbul using the nearby public transport. İstanbul Airport is 40 km, Sabiha Airport is 45 km away from the property.

26620.description: The modern and comfortable Travelodge Madrid Arturo Soria, a recently built hotel, is conveniently located next to the A-2 motorway. Its proximity to major businesses and easy access to the town centre make it an ideal choice for both business and leisure travellers. The hotel offers 74 spacious rooms, a bar-café and car park. Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is by 12:00. Early check-in is available subject to availability, for a supplement of €10, payable on arrival. The person making the booking must be over 18 years of age. The hotel is non-smoking and pets are allowed for an additional charge.

26720.description: This stylish hotel is located just 2 km away from the beach in Cancun. The hotel is surrounded by ample opportunities for exploration and discovery. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a number of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. A park is also located nearby. This charming hotel comprises tastefully-designed guest rooms, which come complete with modern conveniences. The hotel features a superb restaurant, where delectable dishes can be enjoyed. Guests can then sit back and unwind with a refreshing drink in the bar. A conference room is available to those travelling for work purposes.

26778.description: This pleasant Berlin hotel lies in a peaceful side street off the Ku'damm just a few minutes from the area's tourist centre. Countless shops, restaurants, bars and nightclubs are to be found in the surrounding area (150 m - 250 m away). Berlin Tegel airport is 7 km away and it is 18 km to Berlin Schönefeld airport. The nearest links to the bus service and the train station are both a mere 200 m away. This family-friendly city hotel is fully air-conditioned and was completely renovated in 2002. There are a total of 6 floors with 32 rooms including 1 elegant suite on offer to guests. Amongst the facilities count a spacious foyer with lifts, hire safes, a bar, a public Internet terminal with a WLAN access point and a 24-hour reception desk. An in-house laundry service may be taken advantage of as can the room service and it is possible to hire bicycles, make use of the bicycle storage facility as well as the hotel car park and garage. Each of the tasteful, air-conditioned rooms comes with an en suite bathroom with a bathtub or shower, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a radio, a hi-fi stereo system, Internet access, a minibar, a double bed and a balcony or a terrace. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample buffet.

26796.description: This former monastery, transformed into a fabulous boutique hotel, offers comfort and convenience to travelers visiting Venice for business or leisure. Enjoying a privileged location facing the Santa Chiara Canal, the hotel is just a 3-minute walk from Piazzale Roma and a 10-minute walk from Santa Lucia train station. Guests enjoy easy access to numerous city attractions, including the Frari Basilica, Scuola Grande di San Rocco, and Doge's Palace. The spacious, well-lit rooms blend traditional architecture with modern touches, creating a sanctuary of peace and tranquility. A complimentary breakfast is served daily. The hotel also boasts a functional meeting room for up to 60 people, featuring an antique stucco ceiling and exposed beams.

26797.address: Castello, Campo St Filippo e Giacomo, 4270
26797.description: This elegant city hotel boasts a privileged location in Venice, just 100 meters from the imposing Saint Mark's Square and steps from iconic monuments like the Doge's Palace, Saint Mark's Basilica, Bridge of Sighs, and Clock Tower. Guests will find themselves surrounded by local restaurants and cafes, where they can enjoy a wide selection of regional specialties and a unique, romantic atmosphere. Housed in an impressive 15th-century palace, this property offers utmost comfort and convenience. Relax in soundproofed and air-conditioned rooms showcasing enchanting Venetian décor, combining simplicity with classic elegance to create a relaxing and comfortable ambiance. Wake up to a rich continental breakfast, ideal for energizing your day before exploring the city.

26798.description: This modern city hotel, housed in a former convent, is nestled in one of Venice's oldest quarters. It's conveniently located near numerous shops, restaurants, bars, and public transportation (approximately 100 meters away). The nearest train station is about 1 Kilometer from the hotel, and Venice Airport is roughly 30 minutes away. Renovated in 2003, the hotel offers a cozy bar, a pleasant café, and an air-conditioned breakfast room. A small, comfortable conference room caters to business travelers. Laundry, room, and medical services are also available. The stylish rooms feature private bathrooms with hair dryers and well-appointed living areas, complete with king-size beds and air conditioning. Guests can unwind in the splendid garden situated in the former cloisters.

26858.description: Offering free private parking and public transportation services directly to Alexanderplatz and Tegel Airport, the privately run Hotel Sedes is located beside Berlin’s lively Prenzlauer Berg district. The hotel’s comfortable rooms are equipped with cable TV and all standard facilities. The spacious triple rooms with fridge are ideally suited to longer stays. A varied breakfast buffet is included in your room rate, and can be enjoyed at any hour. Across from the hotel you there is a bus stop, with services taking you directly to Tegel Airport. Trams are just a 3 minute walk away, allowing you to access the sights of the capital with ease. After a long day, enjoy a drink in the 24-hour bar of the Hotel Sedes.

26916.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this hotel, complete with complimentary Wi-Fi and a range of amenities. Concierge and babysitting services (surcharge) are available, along with wedding services. Explore nearby attractions easily with the area shuttle (surcharge). Dine at one of the hotel's two restaurants, including Flavours, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Unwind at the bar/lounge with your favorite drink. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel also offers complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Event facilities include a conference center and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and free self-parking is provided. Relax in one of the 50 guestrooms featuring private balconies or patios, complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite programming, and private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers, including deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Nearby attractions include Kunjani Wines (1. 1 mi), Louisvale Wines (1. 3 mi), and Stellenbrau Brewery (3. 3 mi). The preferred airport is Cape Town International Airport (CPT), 25. 3 miles away.

26976.description: This city conference hotel is situated in Cape Town close to a good selection of bars and restaurants and right in the centre of the tourist area. The nearest nightclubs are about 500 m from the hotel and countless shopping venues are to be found within 2 km. Located 3 km from the sea and 5 km from the nearest beach, this hotel is also just 5 km from the V & A Waterfront. The hotel offers a roof-top pool, The Famous Butchers Grill restaurant and a well-equipped gym. The luxurious rooms are equipped with modern conveniences such as 32 inch flat screen televisions, fully stocked mini-bars and electronic safes. Each unit is air-conditioned and comes with an en suite bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer and living area with a king-size bed. Leisure options include a swimming pool and the opportunity to play squash or golf.

name.content: Protea Hotel Cape Town Waterfront Breakwater Lodge

26977.description: Relax and unwind with massages, body treatments, and facials at this hotel, which also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a banquet hall. A shuttle service (surcharge) operates within a 25 km radius. Enjoy local cuisine at the on-site buffet restaurant, Stonebreakers, featuring a bar/lounge, or take advantage of room service (limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM (surcharge). Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center. Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel's event facilities consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (24 hours, surcharge), and self-parking is available on-site (surcharge). The 193 air-conditioned guest rooms feature refrigerators, LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks are also provided. Nearby attractions include the Greenpoint Market, Oranjezicht City Farm Market, Cape Town Stadium, Two Oceans Aquarium, and Table Mountain National Park.

26981.address: Victoria Road Camps Bay, Atlantic Seaboard
26981.description: This hotel is located on Victoria Road in a forested area in Cape Town within a short distance of the sea. Surrounded by gardens, this residence comprises 85 rooms of which 70 are doubles and 15 are suites. Dining options include a café, a bar and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant. Business guests will appreciate the conference facilities and the public Internet terminal. The comfortable and luxurious rooms come with a tiled bathroom, carpeted floor and air conditioning and heating. For guest's entertainment, an Internet connection and satellite/cable TV with a DVD player, also feature as standard. Recreation options include two swimming pools with a poolside snack bar and sun loungers and parasols. Those seeking further relaxation are invited to make use of the sauna and steam room and soak in the hot tub.

26982.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Haymarket Hotel, centrally located in Edinburgh within a 15-minute walk of Princes Street and Dean Village. Start your day with a full breakfast (fee applies) at our snack bar/deli and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Our 39 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and desks. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, luggage storage, laundry facilities, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Nearby attractions include Murrayfield Stadium and the Scottish National Gallery of Modern Art One, both within 0. 8 miles. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 6. 6 miles from the hotel.

26996.address: P O Box 12037, Mill Street, TAMBOERSKLOOF
26996.description: The Cape Milner is a landmark hotel in Cape Town – regularly voted as one of the world's greatest cities. Located in the trendy Tamboerskloof district of the city, with views of the iconic Table Mountain, The Cape Milner is ideally situated for both business and leisure travel. Much like the Mother City itself, The Cape Milner combines eclectic architectural styles from vintage to contemporary. Secluded yet convenient, it offers all the amenities that fans of modern boutique hotels demand. The Cape Milner is a space where elegance meets a refreshing quirkiness – the standards of service are impeccable, and yet they're delivered with winning smiles and the warmth for which Capetonians are renowned. With three different room categories to choose from (featuring newly refurbished bathrooms), guests at The Cape Milner are assured of the highest levels of comfort and relaxation, whether their stay is long or short. The Cape Milner is also a well-known foodie destination, with several wonderful dining spaces. The popular 2 on Milner bistro is ideal for more structured meals, while the vibey Glass Lounge offers a relaxed after-work setting for cocktails and informal dining. The private pool deck and outdoor terrace are justifiably popular with guests and day visitors and combine to create one of the best places in the city to while away a summer's evening. The Glass Lounge also serves as an excellent venue from events ranging from product launches to fashion shoots, underlining just how flexible and stylish this unique space is. Business travellers and local companies alike can make use of the hotel's state-of-the-art conferencing facilities, and our shuttle service provides convenient transport to the city centre – plus the chic beaches of Camps Bay and Clifton for those looking to relax. With secure underground parking and a fully equipped modern gym, The Cape Milner has everything required to become the ultimate Cape Town home-from-home.

26999.address: Esquina de Somerset y Ebenezer Road
26999.description: Trendy, well-appointed, and offering great value, our Green Point hotel has a choice of 172 en-suite rooms with a choice of pool, city or mountain views in the Mother City. Rooms feature air-conditioning, free uncapped WiFi, DStv and a space to work. Accommodation choices include Standard Rooms available with twin beds or comfortable king size beds, or with the option of a balcony to make the most of the location. Our split-level Superior Lofts offer more space and extra amenities including a kitchenette, a lounge area and a guest bathroom.

27001.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, an attached winery, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a television in a common area. Grab a bite at Cultivar Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and 9 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 181 air-conditioned rooms featuring plasma televisions. Rooms have private balconies or patios. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Technopark Stellenbosch - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- De Zalze Golf Club - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Stellenbosch Golf Club - 2. 7 km / 1. 7 mi- Blue Creek Weddings and Functions - 2. 8 km / 1. 7 mi- Mediclinic Stellenbosch - 3. 3 km / 2 mi- Dylan Lewis Sculpture Garden - 4. 3 km / 2. 7 mi- Root 44 - 4. 5 km / 2. 8 mi- Mediclinic Winelands Orthopaedic Hospital - 4. 7 km / 2. 9 mi- Rhenish High School - 4. 8 km / 3 mi- Markötter Sports Complex - 4. 9 km / 3. 1 mi- Rupert Museum - 4. 9 km / 3 mi- Dorp Street - 4. 9 km / 3. 1 mi- Toy & Miniature Museum - 5. 2 km / 3. 2 mi- Braak - 5. 6 km / 3. 5 mi- Van der Stel - 5. 6 km / 3. 5 mi.

27003.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, Riempie Restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 39 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

name.content: Protea Hotel Cape Town Sea Point

27056.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and discounted use of a nearby fitness facility. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Grab a bite at Spur, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and a meeting room. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a train station pick-up service. Make yourself at home in one of the 124 guestrooms.

27096.address: Kemeragzi Koyu Kopak C. Mevkii Kundu-Lara
27096.description: Located on the long, sandy beach at Kundu-Lara, this award-winning resort offers 349 spacious rooms and suites and features a large garden with a terrace and outdoor pools and a private section of the beach. Guests can choose to relax their days away or enjoy fun-filled activities in a setting that offers excellent restaurants and bars, live entertainment and a range of sporting activities. Public transport passes in front of the hotel providing easy access to the city of Antalya, 18 km away with its wonderful shops and historic district and harbour at Kaleici. **** AQUAPARK FACILITIES WILL BE OPEN ON 04. 04. 2024 ****

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Edinburgh - Queensferry Cross

27176.description: The hotel is located just outside the historic village of North Queensferry, set on the picturesque north shore of the River Forth and within walking distance from the Iconic Forth Bridges. The Hotel is a fantastic base not only for corporate guests but it is also very popular with leisure guests looking to explore Scotland's historical UNESCO World Heritage Site the Forth Bridge. With free car parking facilities, accessible road/rail links, and spectacular views from The Shore Grill, our onsite restaurant, the hotel offers a little something for everyone. With Edinburgh less than 15 miles away and St Andrews/Dundee only 35 miles east from the hotel, it is an excellent base for Golf lovers looking to explore and experience Scotland's finest golf courses as well as take in the sights of the capital city. Staying with us you can also benefit from joining our Hilton Honors program and get instant benefits on your next stay such as the lowest price anywhere and points towards free nights.

27179.description: Discover the stylish elegance of the Novotel London Greenwich hotel, which features bright, spacious bedrooms and colourful artwork throughout. Neighbouring Greenwich tube station, the 4-star hotel is a great choice for travellers interested in live music, riverside walks and nightlife. This modern hotel offers private on-site parking and boasts a fitness centre, a stylish restaurant, and spacious bedrooms. Please note that the Sauna & Gym will be refurbished from 25th November to 16th December 2019.

27336.description: Located in the Kâğıthane district of Istanbul, the Sheraton Istanbul Levent is a short walk from Istanbul Sapphire and the Levent Tennis Club. This family-friendly hotel is also conveniently close to Kanyon Mall and Ozdilek Park Istanbul. Guests can relax at the full-service spa, enjoying massages, body treatments, and facials. Recreational amenities include a health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. This Mediterranean-style hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge), as well as a complimentary shuttle within a 3-kilometer radius. The 248 individually decorated guestrooms feature minibars, LCD televisions with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences such as phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks are also provided. Levantino, the hotel's restaurant, serves lunch, dinner, and brunch. Guests can also dine at the coffee shop/cafe or enjoy 24-hour room service. A bar/lounge is available for evening relaxation. Buffet breakfasts are served daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in.

27436.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services and a ballroom. Grab a bite to eat at the Falyanos Restaurant, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view, or stay in and take advantage of 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Istanbul? This hotel has 11840 square feet (1100 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 5 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 110 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and plasma televisions.

27458.description: Nestled within landscaped gardens on the outskirts of Falkirk and Grangemouth, The Grange Manor offers a convenient location between Junctions 5 and 6 of the M9 motorway. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, the hotel provides a comfortable base for exploring the area. Our passionate chefs offer a delightful culinary experience, serving breakfast in Le Chardon Restaurant and lunch and dinner in the relaxed atmosphere of Cook's Bar and Kitchen. Afternoon tea is also available daily. Reservations are recommended, especially for lunch and dinner on weekends.

27517.description:
Experience Cape Town at our conveniently located hotel in Bantry Bay, set in a wind-sheltered bay between Table Mountain and the Atlantic Ocean. Enjoy sweeping views of Lion’s Head and the ocean from our palm-fringed infinity pool. 

Our tastefully furnished rooms and apartments, adorned with unique photographic art, offer a relaxing retreat or the perfect base to explore nearby attractions. With 349 luxury rooms, each space is airy, well-appointed, and equipped with modern conveniences including high-speed Wi-Fi and smart technology. 

Guests can enjoy a resort-style atmosphere with excellent leisure facilities, conferencing options, and warm, attentive service. 

Dining is a highlight, with a range of options to suit every occasion—from relaxed breakfasts to sunset cocktails. The Island Restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes, while the Deck Bar & Terrace is perfect for sundowners with ocean views. Senate Bar provides a casual space for sports and socialising, and The Base serves artisanal wood-fired pizzas with gourmet toppings.

name.content: Mount Nelson, A Belmond Hotel, Cape Town

27557.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, outdoor tennis courts, and a health club. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can get around on the complimentary shuttle, which operates within 5 kilometers. Enjoy Asian cuisine at The Red Room, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. This hotel has 8 meeting rooms available for events.

27558.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features babysitting (surcharge), a fireplace in the lobby, and a picnic area. Grab a bite to eat at the Breakfast Restaurant, a restaurant where you can take in the pool view, or stay in and take advantage of room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary English breakfast is served daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a computer station, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 123 guestrooms featuring LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks.

27617.description: This hotel's surroundings, with breathtaking views of the Indian Ocean and Kaaiman's Gorge, demonstrate Africa's indescribable beauty. The hotel has good links to National Highway N2, making it easy to reach by car, and a great base for exploring the surrounding area. Numerous shopping and entertainment venues, as well as various restaurants, are located in the immediate vicinity. The beach is roughly a 5-minute walk away, and the Wilderness National Park is only a stone's throw. George Airport is approximately 35 km from the hotel. Built in 1925 and renovated in 2003, this hotel comprises a 2-storey main building and annexe, with a total of 155 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby which houses a 24-hour reception desk, a safe, and a currency exchange desk. Within the hotel there is a small supermarket, several shops, a hairdressing salon, public Internet access, a TV room, and a bicycle hire and storage service. Dining options include a bar, a lounge with an open fire, and a restaurant with a separate non-smoking area and highchairs for infants. Business guests may use the conference rooms. Room, laundry and medical services are also on offer, as well as a car park and a garage. For children, there is a playroom, a playground, and a kids' club. The nautical-style blue and white rooms are carpeted and come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a hire safe, and tea and coffee making facilities. The air conditioning in the rooms is individually regulated. All rooms feature a balcony or a terrace.

27620.description: This hotel is situated very close to the Rialto Bridge, beside the Canale Grande. It lies just a few minutes away from St. Mark's Square with the Doge's Palace and the cathedral. Venice airport lies around 8 km from the hotel. The city centre, with its countless shopping and entertainment venues, lies around 200 m from the hotel. Built in 1700 and renovated in 2002, this hotel comprises a total of 37 rooms spread over 4 floors. This inviting hotel welcomes guests in the lobby area with a 24-hour reception desk, and a bar. The rooms come with a bathroom with a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, a TV, air conditioning (centrally regulated) and central heating. Breakfast may be selected from a buffet service.

27621.description: Boasting a strategic location, this modern establishment in Venice offers guests the best situation to explore all this historic city has to offer. Easy to find and accessible by car from A4 highway, this hotel is also at walking distance from public transport with connections to Venice's Piazzale Roma, Marco Polo Airport and Santa Lucia Train Station. Ideal for business and leisure travellers alike, it offers all the necessary facilities and services to guarantee a comfortable stay. Pillow menu and satellite televisions are only a few of the services provided by this hotel. All the spacious guest rooms have been tastefully decorated in soothing colours to create a restful atmosphere. The typical Italian restaurant offers a wide range of Venetian dishes that will delight even the most demanding palates.

name.content: Intercontinental Table Bay Cape Town by IHG

27757.description: This hotel is centrally located not far from the famous Victoria & Alfred Waterfront and offers expansive views of Table Mountain, the lively harbour and Robben Island. A public transport stop can be found about 1 km from the hotel. The centre of Cape Town is some 5 minutes away, whilst the beach lies approximately 10 km away. With its excellent facilities the hotel is an ideal destination. Cape Town airport is about 20 km from the hotel. This air-conditioned luxury building hosts an elegant lobby, various shops and a hairdresser's. Culinary options include a bar and 2 restaurants serving different cuisine. Business travellers may use the well-equipped conference rooms. The stylish rooms are air-conditioned and comfortable, with an en suite bathroom. Further fittings include a minibar, a hire safe, tea and coffee making facilities. The rooms also feature a separate sitting area.

27758.address: Portswood Square, Portswood Road, V & A Waterfront, na
27758.description: Superior accommodation in a safe and relaxed settingOriginally built as a Convict Station, today The PortsWood is the type of place whereyou're far more likely to want to extend your stay. Located a mere 22km from CapeTown International Airport, the elegant PortsWood hotel not only offers superioraccommodation and a relaxed atmosphere, but a uniquely personal approach toservice. This service commitment extends far beyond the leisure traveler to meet thedemands of the international business people. Of course, no stay would be completewithout one of the Quarterdeck Restaurant's famous breakfasts or traditional CapeMalay dishes before taking the short trip to Cape Town's vibrant Victoria & AlfredWaterfront where a variety of chic boutiques and entertainment venues await.

27937.description: At the foot of the Basilica of Sacré Coeur in Montmartre, Adagio Paris Montmartre is near the Théâtre de l'atelier, just a few steps from the Place du Tertre and Rue des Abbesses. Its 76 apartments, from studios (2-3 people) to 2-3 rooms (4 people), and its interior garden make it an ideal place to stay in the Montmartre of painters and artists. The aparthotel also has a private covered car park.

name.content: Aparthotel Adagio Val d'Europe nr Disneyland Paris

27940.description: The aparthotel is located close to Disneyland® Paris and is perfect for both leisure and business trips. It offers 262 studios and 3- or 4-room apartments for 3 to 9 people. They each offer exceptional comfort, are fully furnished and feature a balcony. The aparthotel offers a car park and heated indoor swimming pool (closed from June 5 to 9, 2017, inclusive) and a free shuttle linking the aparthotel and Disneyland®.

27945.description: The New York Inn is a budget-friendly Midtown hotel, ideally situated just two blocks from Times Square and Broadway theaters! All major attractions are within walking distance: Rockefeller Center (3 blocks), Radio City Music Hall (4 blocks), Central Park (6 blocks), Empire State Building (12 blocks), and Madison Square Garden (12 blocks). The Restaurant Row is also at walking distance, where you can try dishes from all over the world. We offer complimentary American breakfast from 7 am to 10 am in the Restaurant on the first floor. Occupancy tax 3, 5 USD per room/night direct payment at the hotel. Notice: four-story building, no elevator. All rooms with one full bed, no rooms with two beds available.

27977.description: In the heart of Bercy Village and the dynamic East Parisian business district, Adagio Paris Bercy Village offers 139 apartments from 2 person studios to two room, four person apartments. Located a few steps from the Parc de Bercy and the quays of the Seine, the Aparthotel has very easy, 5 minute access to the Gare de Lyon, and 10 min access to the center of Paris by metro line 14. It has a seminar room that hosts up to 20 people.

28005.description: This city hotel enjoys an exquisite, peaceful location within a short distance of the Champs Elysées and the famous Parisian arrondissement. It is just a stone's throw to a selection of highly elegant shops, fabulous restaurants and famous theatres. The nearest metro station, Franklin Roosevelt, lies less than a 5-minute walk from the hotel, as does a stop for the local bus service. It is just 3 km to the heart of the French capital. Facilities on offer include a bar and a dining room, whilst the airy breakfast room affords views out over Rue François. The rooms, designed in the traditional Louis XV style, include a bathroom with bath, shower and hairdryer. They are all air-conditioned and also comprise cable/satellite TV, minibar and wireless. The suites additionally feature a very pleasant lounge. Breakfast may be selected from an ample buffet in the breakfast room. City Tax per pax, per night is not included and is paid on the spot. Check in at 3. 00 p. m. , check out at noon.

28039.description: This hostel enjoys a central location in Barcelona, only a short walk to Las Ramblas, with numerous florists, street artists and musicians. Also close by is the old harbour, which is dominated by the 68 m high Christopher Columbus statue, and the Gothic Quarter, which features the wonderful cathedral of St Eulalia, the Plaça del Rei and the Frederic Marés museum. Public transportation links are in the vicinity, and further highlights include the Parc Güell and the Picasso Museum.

28316.description:
Oscar Boutique Hotel is located in the city center and it is a boutique hotel. Our hotel is established 2000 m2 and Oscar Boutique Hotel has one of the biggest garden in Kaleici. In hotel there are 50 rooms including 10 double, 8 twin, 6 triple, 2 single 16 superior and 8 maisonette. The rooms have air conditioning, satelite TV, telephone, an ensuite shower/WC with hot water, hairdryer. Also 6 rooms are including jacuzzi.
The Hotel which is set in the historical old city of Kaleici, has a large swimming pool and a childrens pool and a childrens pool surrounded by a beautiful orange tree garden. There is an outdoor restaurant and bar with BBQ. In addition to this there is also an indoor restaurant/bar large. We have 24 hours room service and free internet with wireless and satelite. Laundry and safe box services is not include room prices they are cost extra prices. 
***Hotel does not accept Pets***

28456.description: This pleasantly appointed hotel is situated below the Taurus Mountains in the district of Göynük, only 180m from a wonderful shingle beach and about 7 km from the centre of Kemer and its countless shops and entertainment venues. Refurbished at the end of 2011, this elegant, air-conditioned hotel consists of a main building, an annexe and 9 bungalow-type buildings, comprising a total of 265 rooms. The hotel features an attractive garden area with 2 pools and a shaded garden bar. Complimentary Wi-Fi use is available in the lobby area and organized animation is provided.

28556.description: Beldibi’nin muhteşem doğası ile çevrili tesis, huzurlu ve konforlu bir tatil sunuyor. Türk Rivierası olarak adlandırılan bölgenin Beldibi kısmında konumlanan tesis, kendi özel plajına doğrudan ulaşım sağlayan bahçesiyle misafirlerine dinlendirici bir atmosfer yaratıyor. 3 bloktan oluşan tesisin 2 ana binası ve 1 aile bloğu (ana bina dışında ayrı blok) bulunuyor.

name.content: The Howard, an Ascend Hotel Collection Member

28718.description: This intimate and elegant hotel is known for its distinct attention to detail together with the personal touch that makes all travellers feel special. This is a Georgian retreat in the city centre of Scotland's capital city, ideally positioned for both business and leisure travellers alike. Every guest has a dedicated butler who will tend to their every need – from unpacking their bags and serving afternoon tea in the drawing room to co-ordinating their social itinerary and serving a three-course dinner in their suite. In total, there are eighteen individually characterised rooms where every kind of guest will enjoy a memorable stay. Dining at this hotel is an experience full of decadent pleasures, where dishes are meticulously prepared by a dedicated team of chefs, and there is attention to detail in this warm and exclusive Georgian setting.

28728.description: The hotel is located in London's financial district just opposite Liverpool Street station, which is a short hop on the tube from the thriving West End and a stones' throw from the numerous bars and restaurants of London's fashionable Hoxton and Shoreditch districts. Guests can benefit from the flexibility of a hotel while at the same time enjoy the space and freedom of an apartment offering a range of serviced apartments from studios up to two bedrooms, and all with no minimum stay. Each of the serviced residences is decorated to the same high standard and has been furnished with a contemporary flair. All offer fully equipped kitchens, marble clad en-suites, and dining areas. Whichever type of apartment is required, they all guarantee the space to relax, work or entertainment.

28730.description: This welcoming hotel enjoys a stunning location in the Mexican city of Cancun. The beautiful sandy beach is only a 30-minute walk from the hotel. It is approximately a 10-minute drive from a selection of shopping and entertainment venues. The hotel comprises a total of 68 rooms spread over 4 floors. Guests are welcomed in the inviting lobby with a reception desk open 24 hours, 8 safes, a lift, a cloakroom and a bicycle cellar. Facilities include a delightful restaurant. Business guests may make use of the conference room and the WLAN Internet connection. Room, are further features that can be taken advantage of by guests. For guests arriving by car, there is car parking offered outside the hotel. The light and tastefully decorated rooms come with their own bathroom with shower, a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access and a hire safe. Each room also features air conditioning, a lounge and two double beds. From the balcony or terrace guests are able to enjoy fantastic views. Breakfast may be selected each morning and the midday and evening meals can be selected from the à la carte or set menu. Moreover, special dietary requirements as well as individual-specific dishes may be prepared. Guests are able to book either half board or full board stays.

name.content: AC San Sebastian de los Reyes

28856.description: The AC Hotel San Sebastián de los Reyes by Marriott offers guests a variety of amenities, including a health club, garden, restaurant, snack bar/deli, and bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Business travelers will appreciate the business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The hotel boasts 3, 100 square feet of meeting space, including a conference center and meeting rooms, perfect for events. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). The 100 guestrooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, private bathrooms with bathtubs, complimentary toiletries, bidets, safes, and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. Nearby attractions include the Plaza Norte 2 Commercial Centre (0. 7 mi), Autonomous University of Madrid (5. 7 mi), and IFEMA (7. 6 mi). The preferred airport is Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD), 9. 8 miles from the hotel.

28857.description: Boasting a prime setting at the heart of the Spanish capital, this Boutique and charming hotel offers guests a convenient location in close proximity to the myriad of attractions this mesmerising city has to offer. In the hotel's vicinity, guests will find the Royal Palace, Royal Opera House, Plaza Mayor and Puerta del Sol. Gran Via Avenue and the renowned artistic triangle are also situated close by. The setting is ideal for travellers who are eager to explore the rich culture, history, entertainment venues, dining options and shopping opportunities the city has to offer. This delightful boutique hotel occupies a historical 18th century building, and has retained elements of its former style. The guest rooms feature a harmonious blend of modern amenities and elements of a bygone era. The rooms are also sound-proofed, ensuring a truly relaxing stay.

28858.description: This modern hotel lies at the heart of Madrid's historical district. The city airport is some 13 km away. This 5-storey hotel was opened in 2005 and comprises a total of 83 rooms of which 5 are Double Deluxe with Terrace. Facilities include an inviting foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a currency exchange desk and a cloakroom. Dining options include a cosy bar and a nice restaurant. Room and laundry services are on offer. Each of the comfortable rooms comes with an en suite bathroom with a shower and a bathtub a well-furnished living area and a balcony or terrace. Further amenities include satellite/ cable TV, a minibar and a hire safe. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample buffet.

29099.description: The Sofitel Barcelona Skipper sits in the heart of Barcelona, a short walk from Barceloneta Beach and Port Vell. This luxury hotel is conveniently located 1. 6 miles from La Rambla and 1. 9 miles from Port de Barcelona. Guests can enjoy a range of amenities, including an outdoor pool, a 24-hour fitness center, and bicycle rentals. The hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (for a surcharge). Each of the 225 guest rooms features a minibar, Smart TV, and private bathroom with designer toiletries and a hairdryer. Other conveniences include a phone, safe, and coffee/tea maker. Savor Spanish cuisine at TenDiez, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Guests can unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee). Featured amenities include a business center, limousine/town car service, and express check-in. The hotel also boasts a conference center and nine meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

29116.description: An exquisite escape nestled in the heart of Barcelona’s vibrant business district. Located adjacent to the Convention Center CCIB and the Diagonal Mar shopping mall, our hotel offers unparalleled convenience for both business and leisure travelers. Just 550 meters from the pristine Platja de Llevant beach and a mere five-minute walk from El Maresme metro station, you can effortlessly explore the city. The metro ride to the bustling city center takes only 20 minutes. Indulge in culinary excellence at our Michelin-starred restaurant, Aürt, where every dish is a masterpiece. For a more relaxed yet equally delightful dining experience, visit Mai, the charming brother restaurant of Aürt, known for its exceptional gastronomy and casual ambiance. Unwind at Purobeach Barcelona, our urban oasis featuring a stunning pool area that offers the perfect retreat from the city's hustle and bustle. Stay active at our 24-hour fitness center, ensuring you can maintain your workout routine at any time. During the warmer months, enjoy our seasonal beach club and outdoor pool, ideal for soaking up the sun and savoring the Mediterranean atmosphere. At Hilton Diagonal Mar Barcelona, we provide a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience, making your stay in Barcelona truly unforgettable.

29247.description: The 4-star Mercure London Paddington hotel blends contemporary design with the convenience of being in Central London. Located next to Paddington station, this stylish hotel offers state-of-the-art facilities to help make your stay a welcome one. Its serene setting offers a contrast to the hustle and bustle of the city. Each ensuite bedroom provides guests with the comforts of home and more. The hotel comes equipped with free high-speed WiFi and a 24-hour gym, while the on-site restaurant serves food and drinks all day. Travellers can get between London Heathrow Airport and the hotel in just 15 minutes via the Heathrow Express train service. London Zoo, Hyde Park, Little Venice and Oxford Street are all nearby attractions.

name.content: Holiday Inn  Express Birmingham Castle Bromwich

29258.description: A smart hotel close to Birmingham with free parking and breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® Birmingham - Castle Bromwich hotel is a stone's throw from the M6 motorway. An easy 20-minute drive takes you to Birmingham Airport (BHX) or an exhibition at the NEC. Direct trains from the local Stechford station reach Birmingham city centre in less than 10 minutes, and we’re ideally situated for catching a football match at Villa Park. If you have kids with you, they can learn how chocolate is made at Cadbury World chocolate factory or brave the roller coasters at Drayton Manor Theme Park, only 11 miles away. If it’s raining, the nearby StarCity leisure complex has a 25-screen cinema, a bowling alley and laser tag to keep them busy. Business guests are close to the Jaguar factory at Castle Bromwich and the headquarters of the National Express Group, and your clients can visit you in our onsite meeting room. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- An inclusive Express Start™ Breakfast- Rooms with sofa beds for familiesComfortable bedrooms have a desk for work and blackout curtains to help you sleep. Start the day with our inclusive Express Start™ Breakfast buffet, and in the evening order a pizza in the Great Room or relax with friends and watch a match on the big-screen TV in the bar.

29281.description: Located in the historical centre of Madrid, close to the Plaza Mayor and within a pleasant 10-minute walk of Puerta del Sol, this hotel offers elegant and comfortable accommodation in the immediate vicinity of countless shopping venues, bars, restaurants and nightclubs, and provides the perfect base for both a business and leisure visits to the Spanish capital. Popular for being the oldest hotel in Spain, the refurbished and converted building maintains all its historical charm, while combining it with state-of-the-art amenities and services. Between the free Wi-Fi Internet accesses in the rooms, the complimentary breakfast, and the fact that all pets are welcome, guests will be sure to have all their requirements and needs met.

29283.description:
Petit Palace President Castellana is a 4-star design hotel in Madrid's Salamanca District, just 50 metres from Paseo de la Castellana, the city's grandest boulevard. The exclusive shopping area of Serrano Street, Plaza de Colón and the National Library are all a short walk away, along with countless shops, restaurants and entertainment venues. Rubén Darío Metro Station is 500 metres away, and the Cibeles Fountain and Retiro Park are within 2 km of the hotel. 

The rooms are bright, soundproofed and contemporary in style, fitted with the latest technology and a 32-inch flat-screen TV. Free WiFi is available throughout the hotel. The quiet the soundproofing provides makes it an equally good choice for a city break or a business trip in the Castellana financial district. 

Hotel facilities include free bicycle hire, ideal for exploring the neighbourhood and the city centre at your own pace, and children's pushchairs for guests travelling with family. With public transport links just metres from the door, every part of Madrid is within easy reach. Thanks to its prime location and its design-led style, Petit Palace President Castellana is an ideal base for discovering Madrid. of the hotel.

29287.description: This beautiful hotel blends modern features with classic design and is excellently situated frontline to the sea in the historic Sultanahmet District of Istanbul. The hotel features 2 restaurants, a café with fantastic views over the Marmara Sea and meeting facilities. Famous attractions such as Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace or Hippodrome are just a few steps away.

name.content: voco Madrid Las Tablas by IHG

29288.description: Voco Madrid Las Tablas by IHG is located in northern Madrid, in the heart of the residential and business area of Las Tablas. It's a 10-minute walk to Las Tablas Metro Station, offering a direct connection to the city center. Just off the M40 ring road, the hotel provides covered parking. Business travelers can enjoy free WiFi, a 24-hour business center, and four fully equipped meeting rooms, the largest accommodating 100 guests. Several prominent companies have offices nearby, and the IFEMA Feria de Madrid exhibition center is a 15-minute drive away. Madrid's famous sights, such as the grand Plaza Mayor and Puerta del Sol, Buen Retiro Park, and the Prado Museum, are easily accessible. Santiago Bernabéu Stadium is a 20-minute drive, and El Corte Inglés Sanchinarro shopping center is 12 minutes away. The trendy rooms feature work desks, tea and coffee-making facilities, and pillow menus. Kids stay and eat free. Enjoy a buffet breakfast and relax in the spacious Open Lobby. In the evening, unwind with a cocktail in the bar and savor delicious Mediterranean cuisine in the restaurant.

29289.description: The hotel is located in the Salamanca quarter, close to local boutiques, tourist attractions and restaurants as well as branches of several multinational companies. Madrid airport is situated 13 kms away. The hotel, built in 1900 was reopened in 2005 after extensive renovation. There are 88 rooms on 6 floors.
