The air-conditioned hotel also offers guests conference services and WLAN Internet as well as laundry and room services. Cuisine in the hotel restaurant varies according to season. Alternatively guests can drop by the hotel bar-cafeteria. All accommodation units are fitted with individually adjustable air-conditioning and heating, satellite TV and Internet. The fully equipped en-suite bathroom in constructed from marble in a manner reminiscent of the Japanese style. Guests can treat themselves to a massage on site. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a pet deposit.

29314.description:
This house is located in peaceful surrounds just a short taxi ride from the town of Bishop's Stortford, where guests will discover various shops, bars and restaurants. In addition, guests may quickly and easily gain access to Stansted Airport by making use of the express train link. The nearest bus stop is about 50 m from the hotel.

This hotel is housed in an English country house that has been lovingly restored and modernised (2005). It comprises 2 floors with 2-storey wings and a total of 23 rooms of which 20 are double rooms, 2 are suites and 1 is a studio. This typically English hotel features a foyer with a currency exchange facility and a cloakroom as well as a small supermarket, a conference room, a bar and an à la carte restaurant with highchairs for infants. There is a nightclub on offer within the hotel as well as special cabaret and casino nights. It is possible to make use of the room and laundry services as well as a public Internet terminal and there is a car park on offer to those arriving by car.

The Victorian rooms come with an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, a radio, Internet access, tea and coffee making facilities and individually controllable central heating.

The hotel's spa area has an indoor swimming pool with a sauna and steam baths as well as various massage and spa treatments. There is a gym with aerobics sessions on offer and archery can be tried out in the hotel's outdoor area. Furthermore, this is the ideal starting point for excursions to the city of London.

Breakfast is on offer in the mornings; lunch and the evening meal can be taken à la carte or chose from a menu. Special dietary requirement and individual-specific dishes can be provided.

29498.description: With a nod to the street art that this arrondissement is known for, Novotel Paris 13 Porte d'Italie offers you spacious rooms that feature a modern decor, shower and bathtub. Three meeting rooms and a coworking space meet the needs of business travellers. Our hotel in Kremlin-Bicêtre also invites you to have fun with family or friends as you play one of our video or board games. To delight your taste buds and relax at the end of the day, discover the beers of our recently renovated bar and restaurant.

29500.description: The hotel is located in the Champs-Élysées area of Paris, conveniently close to the Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Élysées Avenue, and the Palais des Congrès exhibition center. Paris-Orly Airport is 25 km away. This unique location makes it an ideal Paris hotel for both business and leisure travelers. Guests will enjoy the Parisian ambiance, parks, marketplaces, famous avenues and alleyways, and renowned restaurants, all just steps from the hotel. The 58 elegantly decorated rooms feature bronze and blond wood tones, accented with touches of blue or gray. Modern en suite facilities include high-definition TVs, minibars, prestige comfort mattresses and pillows, coffee makers, safes, and toiletries. This hotel offers a quiet retreat in the heart of the city.

name.content: Hotel Faubourg Galant Paris Handwritten Collection

29501.description: Centrally located in Paris, the Hotel Faubourg Galant Paris-Handwritten Collection is within a 10-minute walk of the Folies Bergere and Grevin Museum. This hotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Each of the 67 air-conditioned rooms features a flat-screen TV with satellite programming, a safe, and a desk. Bathrooms include a shower and hairdryer. Enjoy a meal at the on-site coffee shop/cafe or snack bar/deli. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. For events, the hotel offers meeting and conference space. Nearby attractions include the Grand Rex Cinema and Galeries Lafayette. The closest airports are Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) and Paris Orly (ORY).

name.content: Wipton by Petit Palace anteriormente Icon Wipton

29508.description:
Wipton by Petit Palace, formerly known as Icon Wipton, is a boutique hotel on Jorge Juan street, the most exclusive shopping area in Madrid's Salamanca-Serrano neighbourhood. Built in 1910 and renovated in 2018, it has 61 rooms across six floors. Retiro Park, the National Library and the Archaeological Museum are 250 metres away, and the Puerta de Alcalá is within 500 metres. Art galleries, antique shops, bars and restaurants are all within walking distance. 

The rooms stand out for their avant-garde décor, finished to the last detail, with free WiFi and a private bathroom. Accessible rooms are available and pets are welcome. The lobby, styled as an English pub, offers a lounge area and tourist information, and the hotel also has a restaurant, a bar and a café. 

Each morning brings a buffet breakfast, and throughout the day you can enjoy the menu at The Captain, the hotel's brasserie-restaurant. Guests receive discounted rates at a nearby private car park. Three Metro lines are within a 5-minute walk, Atocha station is one stop away on the suburban train line, and Madrid-Barajas Airport is 13 km from the hotel. With its location, its historic building and its distinctive character, Wipton by Petit Palace is the ideal base for exploring elegant Madrid.

29646.address: Avenue De La Fosse Des Pressoires, 20
29646.description: The Grand Magic Hotel invites its customers to a unique experience, right from the reception, which dons its theatrical costume. The Grand Hall lounges take customers on an immersive multimedia experience through a spectacular transformation of the space that reconnects with the wonder of childhood. The 396 rooms with walls decorated with constellations can accommodate up to 10 people and please children with their bunk beds. In the restaurant, in a natural and relaxing atmosphere, an all-you-can-eat breakfast is served every morning. In the evening, the restaurant also offers its buffet service, with another area dedicated to à la carte dishes. The indoor swimming pool promises total relaxation. A pool is reserved for children. A fitness room keeps athletes active. In addition to free access to the hotel car park, the Grand Magic Hotel is served by free shuttles to Marne-la-Vallée Chessy station.

29648.description: Stylish, four-star airport hotel with a restaurant and bar, plus fully equipped meeting facilitiesCrowne Plaza® Brussels Airport hotel is a five-minute drive from Brussels Airport. We offer a free shuttle service. You can also leave your car in our secure parking and take a train or bus from the airport into central Brussels, or to other cities in Belgium. Our Park, Stay & Go packages mean you can leave your car while you travel. You can invite up to 350 delegates to meetings in our 16 flexible, naturally lit conference rooms. We can also help with fine-dining arrangements for a business banquet. High-speed free WiFi helps you and your colleagues stay Completely Connected, and our Crowne Plaza Meetings Director is on hand to help with all your needs. The architectural wonders of Brussels's Grand-Place are 30 minutes from the hotel by bus or train. Closer to home, restaurants and bars dot central Zaventem, a 15-minute walk away. Burn off excess energy in our well-equipped Fitness Centre, or relax in the sauna. Sip a drink on our waterside terrace, and enjoy international fine-dining and lighter Fast &Fresh meals throughout the day in our elegant restaurant.  Rest in comfort with our Sleep Advantage® programme, with Quiet Zones and Guaranteed Wake Up Calls.

30341.description: This unique high-class hotel is ideally located on the west side of Paris, in the heart of Rueil-Malmaison and at only 7km distance from the business district of La Défense. The establishment offers excellent traffic connections, which allows travellers to easy access the main sites of the city, such as the Champ-Elysées and the Palace of Versailles. From classic to deluxe and depending on their needs, guests can choose between different types of rooms. All of them present an original stylish decoration with modern furniture and top-notch facilities such as a desk, a flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi. Visitors may enjoy a delicious continental breakfast every morning, which is served in the cosy dining room of the hotel. The bar, with its elegant decoration, is a perfect place for a relaxing break or an informal meeting. Whether travelling for leisure or on business purposes, the hotel is an excellent choice to enjoy a pleasant and memorable stay.

30342.description: Mercure Paris Nanterre, near RER station A Nanterre Ville and next to Chemin de l'Ile commercial district, welcomes you in a modern, family atmosphere. Ideal for business and leisure stays, we offer amenities designed for your comfort, wine bar, bistro restaurant, secure car park, charging stations, WIFI 6, Chromecast TV, TNT channels, modular meeting rooms with natural daylight and an outdoor terrace.

30343.description: This charming hotel lies on a quiet street between Saint Germain des Prés and Montparnasse, directly in the tourist centre of the city. Within around 2 minutes' walk guests will find countless shopping venues and a selection of restaurants. In the nearest vicinity there is a bus stop and the underground station Montparnasse Bienvenue. The hotel is approximately 30 km away from the Charles de Gaulle Airport. Built in 1924, this charming hotel comprises a total of 90 rooms, of which 11 are suites. The hotel is decorated in a classically French style with a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere. Amongst the facilities count a bar and a free wireless Internet access in the public areas. Business corner and conference facilities are also available. Each of the comfortable rooms is uniquely decorated. Guests may select their breakfast from a buffet.

30345.description: Barcelona hotel in quiet suburban location with good transport links, and near Grand Prix Circuit de Barcelona-CatalunyaHandy for a stopover, for a city break or to catch a motor race, Holiday Inn Express® Barcelona - Montmeló hotel is in a quiet area 40 minutes by car from Barcelona-El Prat Airport. The hotel is near the AP-7 Highway, which follows the coast from the French border to southern Spain. You can leave your car in one of the free parking spaces. It's a three-minute walk to the nearest bus stop and a five-minute drive to Montmeló Station, which has direct trains to Barcelona. The hotel is next door to the Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya race track, where events include the Formula 1 Spanish Grand Prix. With a 30-minute train ride you can be in central Barcelona, strolling through the narrow alleys of the Gothic Quarter or watching street artists perform on the lively Las Ramblas. Enjoy designer outlet shopping at La Roca Village, 14 km away. Here to work? Free WiFi ensures you stay connected. You can host events for up to 35 delegates in the hotel's air-conditioned meeting room and make your presentations using an LCD projector. Start each morning with the Express Start Breakfast, including pastries, cereals and fresh fruits. At the end of a busy day, unwind with a chilled glass of wine or a beer in the lobby bar.

30347.description: Welcoming Madrid hotel, near Urtinsa Industrial Estate and Alcoron station,  with free WiFi and breakfast includedLocated next to the A5 motorway, Holiday Inn Express® Alcorcon offers free on-site parking. Alcorcon train station is a 10-minute walk away, and several metro stations and bus stops are within an easy stroll, getting you to central Madrid in no time. International flights at Madrid–Barajas Airport are less than half an hour's drive away. The hotel is an eight-minute walk from the Tres Aguas commercial centre and 10 minutes’ drive to Madrid Zoo Aquarium. Marvel at word-class art at the Museo Nacional del Prado and Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía, or wander through bustling public squares like Puerta del Sol and Plaza Mayor. End the day by sampling the city’s famous tapas. Host events for up to 20 people in the hotel’s fully equipped meeting room. There's free WiFi throughout the hotel and a 24-hour Business Centre. Urtinsa Industrial Estate and Casa de Campo convention centre are both less than 10 minutes' drive away. Cheerful rooms feature satellite TV, sofa beds and work desks. Make a coffee in your room, then get set for the day with an included Express Start Breakfast. Relax with a glass of Spanish wine in the bar, then ask the friendly staff for local dining options.

30348.description: A family-friendly hotel close to Parque Warner Madrid, Faunia wildlife park and shopping destinations The Holiday Inn Express® Madrid-Rivas hotel offers large,  comfortable rooms just off the Autovía A3 Madrid–Valencia motorway.  It's about 20 minutes' drive to both the Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport and the city centre, and just over two km to the Rivas Urbanizaciones metro station. The nearest bus stop is less than 10 minutes' walk away. Families will love the rides and entertainment at Parque Warner Madrid,  a 25-minute drive away, and you can get up close to flamingos, sea lions and wallabies at the Faunia Wildlife Park, less than 10 minutes from the hotel by car. Visitors in need of retail therapy can visit the boutiques at H20cio mall, and it's an easy five-minute stroll to the Rivas Centro shopping centre. You can access free, high-speed WiFi throughout the hotel, and a naturally lit meeting room hosts up to 24 people in comfort. Guests and business delegates can take advantage of the hotel's complimentary parking, as well as a 24-hour Business Centre, where you can print and copy for a small charge. Start your day with an inclusive Express Start Breakfast buffet, featuring a range of continental items. Enjoy pleasant views from the glass-walled Great Room.

30349.description: Located in Alcobendas's business district, the Holiday Inn Express Madrid-Alcobendas, an IHG Hotel, is within a 10-minute drive of IFEMA and Paseo de la Castellana. This hotel offers complimentary wired and wireless internet access, a vending machine, and a coffee shop/cafe. Guests can enjoy a complimentary continental breakfast daily. The hotel also features a business center, meeting rooms, and free self-parking. Each of the 109 guestrooms includes satellite TV, a private bathroom with shower/tub combination, and conveniences such as a safe and desk. Nearby attractions include Santiago Bernabéu Stadium (12. 4 km) and WiZink Center (15. 2 km).

30356.description: This hotel, located in the tranquil residential center of Mogliano Veneto, offers convenient access to Venice and Treviso. A mere 50 meters from the train station, guests can reach the heart of both cities in just 15 minutes, bypassing parking and traffic woes. The hotel's surroundings offer a variety of shops, supermarkets, restaurants, and snack bars. Venice Airport is 9 km away, Treviso Airport is 10 km, and Padua is 25 km from the hotel. Recently renovated, the three-story hotel features 50 rooms of various categories. Guests can enjoy amenities including a reception area with a hotel safe, lift, café, bar, TV room, breakfast room, Wi-Fi, and an internet/multimedia PC point. A supermarket is conveniently located across from the hotel, and bicycle rentals are available. On-site parking and garage facilities are provided (garage for an added fee). Laundry, room service, and medical services are also offered (fees apply). Each appealing room features an en-suite bathroom with a hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, safe (for hire), individually controlled air conditioning and heating. For leisure activities, a golf course is 3 km away, and opportunities for riding, rugby, swimming, and tennis are available within 1 km of the hotel. Bed and breakfast bookings are available. To reach the hotel from Marco Polo Airport, take the bus towards Mestre, transfer to the Treviso-bound bus at the city train station, and alight at Mogliano Veneto center. The hotel is located directly in front of the train station.

30369.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including a sauna and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to noon for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Make yourself at home in one of the 77 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. The preferred airport for Hotel Q is Berlin (BER-Brandenburg) - 29. 5 km / 18. 3 miLocated in Berlin (Charlottenburg), Hotel Q is steps from Kurfürstendamm and a 2-minute drive from Zoo Berlin. This luxury hotel is 2. 8 mi (4. 5 km) from Potsdamer Platz and 3. 2 mi (5. 2 km) from Brandenburg Gate.

name.content: Classik® Hotel Hackescher Markt, Berlin - Mitte

30370.description: The Classik Hotel, located in Berlin's vibrant Mitte district, is tucked away on a quiet side street just steps from Hackescher Markt. A short walk connects you to Museum Island, tram stations, and a wealth of restaurants, bars, and boutiques. The hotel offers 32 modern rooms, a breakfast room, and a relaxing lounge with a reading corner. Each room features a safe, flat-screen TV, desk, and a bathroom with underfloor heating. Complimentary Wi-Fi and bottled water are also provided. Please note that a 5% city tax is not included in the rates and is payable directly to the hotel.

30373.description: Overlooking the Seine, the easily recognizable and accessible Novotel Centre Paris Tour Eiffel offers superb views of the river and capital. Ideal for a romantic weekend or family stay, we also cater for business meetings with 30 meeting rooms and an conference hall. Relax in our fitness center with heated pool and sauna. Enjoy pleasant moments at the bar and gastronomic Japanese restaurant Le Benkay.

30437.description: Just a 5-minute walking distance from the Marquês de Pombal Square in central Lisbon, this upscale establishment offers the ideal accommodation for those eager to explore all this enchanting city has to offer. Picoas metro stop is only 348 metres from the hotel, and Rossio Square is 1 kilometre away. Avenidas Novas is a great choice for travellers interested in gourmet food and discovering the monuments of the city. The hotel offers a choice of air-conditioned guest rooms featuring modern services such as Wi-Fi internet connection and flat-screen TV, decorated in a modern style with parquet floors and wooden furniture. A wide choice of facilities are offered at this hotel, including a restaurant serving international cuisine and a bar offering light meals, afternoon teas and evening cocktails. Guests can also enjoy a moment of relaxation in the reading room or benefit from the car rental service.

30641.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Taksim Metropark Hotel, centrally located in Istanbul, a short walk from Taksim Square and a quick drive from Galata Tower. This hotel offers 70 air-conditioned rooms equipped with minibars, flat-screen TVs with cable, and laptop-compatible safes. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) at the Taksim Restaurant and Bar, which also serves international cuisine and features a bar/lounge. For your convenience, the hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, 24-hour room service, and a shuttle service to nearby attractions (surcharge). Additional amenities include self-parking (surcharge), dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

30642.description: Ideally situated in the heart of the old city within a few minutes' walk of the major attractions at Sultanahmet, this popular boutique-style hotel is built on the site of a wooden Turkish house. Decorated and furnished in an authentic style by the owner's wife, guests can enjoy breakfast on the roof terrace with spectacular views of the Marmara Sea and Blue Mosque or in the pretty courtyard enclosed by a Byzantine wall.

30657.description: Located in central Berlin, MOXY Berlin Humboldthain Park offers convenient access to Friedrichstrasse (5-minute drive) and Brandenburg Gate (8-minute drive). This hotel features a health club, bicycle rentals, and a snack bar/deli. The 101 air-conditioned rooms include LED TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms. Continental breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Onsite self-parking is available (subject to charges).

30658.description: Offering a convenient setting in the heart of the commercial area of Rosny-sous-Bois, vicinity of the popular shopping centres and extensive golf courses, this enchanting hotel welcomes visitors with cosy décor, attentive service and warm hospitality to afford a truly relaxing stay. Situated at just 6 km from Paris, this attractive property is a perfect base whether travelling for pleasure or business purposes. The establishment is a just short stroll from Rosny-Bois-Perrier train station, allowing travellers to easily get around and explore the rich in historical heritage city of Paris. The guest rooms showcase simple elegance and elements with Moulin Rouge flair. Each unit comes complete with private bathroom and modern amenities to guarantee a truly enjoyable stay. Visitors may wake up to a delicious breakfast to start their day off on the right foot.

30660.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul, the hotel offers excellent views of the biggest attractions and are just steps away from Grand Bazaar, Topkapi Palace and Sultanahmet Square. Ataturk airport is to be reached within 20-minute drive. Each of the rooms at this hotel combines traditional Ottoman style with modern amenities. After a long day of sightseeing, enjoy a relaxing bath with natural olive oil soaps and use the traditional cotton towels from Bursa or enjoy a comfortable night's sleep on beds equipped with goose-down pillows and duvets. Guests will start the day with a delicious buffet breakfast, including home-made pastries bakery and admire the stunning views of Istanbul's most beautiful historic buildings, as well as the Marmara Sea and the Bosphorous from the rooftop terrace.

30719.description: Situated in the tranquil Amsterdam-Zuid, this hotel offers convenient access to Amsterdam's top attractions. It's steps away from the trendy Cornelis Schuyt quarter, brimming with shops, restaurants, and cafes. A short 5-minute walk leads to Museumplein, home to the Van Gogh Museum, Rijksmuseum, Stedelijk Museum, and Royal Concertgebouw. The hotel is also near Vondelpark, Amsterdam's largest park, a leisurely 10-minute stroll from Leidseplein. The hotel features a variety of rooms, each equipped with a private bathroom and appliances for a comfortable stay. Please note that while internet access is available in all rooms, not all rooms have air conditioning.

30845.description: Nestled in a leafy, upscale neighborhood in Berlin's western district, this art and business hotel offers a tranquil retreat just minutes from the RBB broadcasting studios, the ICC convention center, and the subway. Guests enjoy easy access to the Olympic Stadium and a nearby park. Tegel Airport is a quick 10-minute transfer, while Schönefeld Airport is about an hour away. Renovated in 2005, this 5-story hotel features 46 rooms and caters to both art enthusiasts and business travelers. Amenities include a reception area, cloakroom, safe, elevator, an à la carte restaurant with highchairs, and a hair salon. A conference room and on-site parking are also available. Guests can take advantage of room and laundry services. Comfortable rooms are equipped with an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, ISDN telephone with fax and modem access, cable TV, pay-per-view options, a radio, and internet access (fee applies). A minibar/fridge is also available (fee applies). Each room features a king-size or double bed, carpeting, individual and central heating, and a balcony. The hotel's health spa offers a refreshing swimming pool, a rainforest aroma shower, and a sauna area with a quiet room. Massages are available upon request. A cosmetic institute complements the spa's offerings. For golf enthusiasts, a course is located approximately 17 km away. Guests can enjoy a breakfast buffet and choose from à la carte or set menus for lunch and dinner. Half-board and full-board options are also available.

31122.description: This welcoming hotel enjoys a peaceful location in an elegant district of Paris, just 500 meters from the Arc de Triomphe. Shopping and entertainment venues are within easy reach, and the Ternes metro station (line 2) is a mere 200 meters away. The train station is only 1 kilometer from the hotel, while Charles de Gaulle and Paris Orly airports are 30 and 35 kilometers away, respectively. This comfortable hotel offers 49 rooms, including two suites. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour reception desk, a restaurant, a conference room, and access to a car park and garage. The hotel also features pleasant gardens for guests to relax in. Each tastefully decorated room comes fully equipped with internet access (charges may apply).

32476.description: Luxury amenities and comforts are offered throughout our Hermanus accommodation in a choice of 145 modern rooms and suites. From Deluxe to Presidential, every room type promises big views of the Kogelberg and fully equipped modern accommodation whether you’re visiting the Overberg for a romantic countryside escape or conferencing with a difference. Décor is calm and contemporary with rich woods and soft furnishings taking inspiration from South African design and the UNESCO reserve surrounding the hotel. Views of the lagoon, the mountains and the hotel’s beautiful grounds are framed by floor to ceiling sliding glass doors that open out onto your own private balcony or terrace.

32836.description: Accommodation at Southern Sun Cape Sun includes options for solo, group, and family travel, and is well-appointed for productive business trips or relaxing leisure escapes. Whether you're here for work or play, for a minibreak or an extended stay, our hotel in the heart of the city has everything you need. The hotel's choice of 368 rooms and suites feature free uncapped WiFi, air-conditioning, TV with DStv, tea and coffee facilities, an en-suite bathroom and more. Magnificent views of Table Mountain, Robben Island, Table Bay, and throughout the Mother City add to the appeal of the hotel's central location. Room choices include comfortable Standard Rooms, business-friendly Executive Rooms, and Family Rooms featuring twin double beds and great amenities. Suites at Southern Sun Cape Sun not only offer more space, and plenty of at-home conveniences, but a number of luxury touches. Our two Penthouse Suites and two Presidential Suites offer amongst the most spacious and well-appointed accommodation choices in the CBD, with everything from an en-suite Jacuzzi to a generous lounge and dining area.

33236.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy French cuisine at Louis B's Bar and Lounge, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Cape Town? This hotel has 5877 square feet (546 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 19 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 483 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed.

33656.description: Strategically positioned in the town of Castelldefels, this prestigious hotel is close to the Olympic Channel and the Ànec Blau shopping centre. Leisure travellers will appreciate its proximity to the beaches of Castelldefels, Gavà and Sitges, and business travellers may get to Barcelona’s city centre very easily thanks to the convenient train and bus nearby connections. The property includes several types of guest rooms and suites, fully equipped with all the necessary amenities for a pleasant and comfortable stay. All of them are sound-proofed and boast a spacious bathroom with toiletries and a magnifying mirror. Those staying at this establishment will enjoy a relaxing and fun time, thanks to the leisure facilities available such as a ping-pong area, two fantastic swimming pools and a large chill-out terrace. Other features include a steam room and a cocktail bar.

33724.address: Alara River Tur Merkezi Karaburun Mevkii
33724.description: This air-conditioned beach hotel comprises a total of 398 rooms and is built on 14, 000sqm of land bordering the turquoise waters of the Mediterranean on Turkey's southern coast. Situated 3km from the district of Okurcular, the hotel is positioned half-way between the popular resorts of Alanya and Side. Taxis and public transport are available on the main road in front of the hotel, and there is a shopping centre 2km away. Guests can enjoy sunny afternoons spent relaxing in the gardens and lounging in a sun lounger on the long sandy beach, which features a jetty, while those more adventuresome visitors might go scuba diving, fishing and snorkelling in the sea. The onsite restaurant serves both Turkish and international cuisines for lunch and dinner in addition to a buffet breakfast, all for a delightful holiday of sea and sun.

name.content: Mercure Marne la Vallee Bussy St Georges

33981.description: Located in the heart of Val d'Europe business center, Mercure Marne La Vallée Bussy St Georges has been completely renovated in a modern and warm atmosphere. The hotel has family rooms and a children's play area. We ask you to wear a mask. Our Puzzle restaurant welcomes you with its simple cuisine. Or enjoy our cocktails and our great wines in the calm and comfortable setting of our Domino bar.

34225.description: This stylish boutique hotel is perfectly situated in Gülhane in the Sultanahmet District of the Turkish capital, right in the heart of the historic centre of Istanbul. It features a restaurant, terrace bistro, bar and facilities for business meetings. The hotel is ideal to explore the old town on foot, as the major attractions such as Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque or Hippodrome are within easy walking distance. This hotel is also a perfect place for guests who want to see the night-life of Istanbul, the city that never sleeps on this side of the map. All rooms are newly renovated, fully furnished and equipped with convenient amenties in order to provide a cozy atmosphere. This hotel is just 20 minutes from the International Atatürk Airport while the International Sabiha Gökçen Airport is about an hour drive away.

34465.description: Occupying 9, 500sqm of land, including an avocado plantation, this relaxing apartment hotel consists of apartments and studios with 20 hotel rooms located in the annex building. The sandy beach is 900m away and a free shuttle service is available. The ancient city of Side is 3km with a good variety of bars, restaurants, nightlife and shopping opportunities. Links to the public transport network can be found within a couple of minutes' walk from the property. The hotel features two outdoor swimming pools and two children's pools, which are surrounded by palm, banana and other tropical trees. Sun loungers, parasols and a poolside snack bar, as well as a massage treatment area and Turkish bath are other amenities guests can benefit from.

34585.description: Discover the magic of Side, a captivating blend of ancient wonders and modern comforts. Nestled in a tranquil area amidst verdant greenery and historic ruins, this seaside hotel offers convenient access to both the beach and the bustling shopping center. Just a short walk from the shore, and an hour's drive from Antalya Airport, it's the perfect year-round retreat. The hotel features comfortable twin rooms in the main building and charming bungalows scattered throughout the garden. Each room is equipped with a shower, telephone, TV, minibar, hairdryer, and air conditioning, with most boasting stunning sea views. Enjoy the hotel's restaurant and bar, while children can have fun at the on-site playground. Private parking is also available for guests arriving by car.

34656.description: The Mövenpick Hotel Zürich Regensdorf has a large congress hall and 19 innovatively designed meeting rooms for 2 to 800 people. Equipped with latest technology, the hotel is ideal for meetings and events. Treat yourself in one of our distinguished restaurants - be it in the traditional Mövenpick restaurant, in the Trattoria Ciao with a Mediterranean atrium garden or in one of our cozy bars.

name.content: Kimpton Ashbel New York Park Avenue by IHG

34735.description: A perfect home base for both business and leisure travelers, the hotel is just a five-minute walk from the iconic Grand Central Terminal. Other highlights within a 10-minute walk include Fifth Avenue shopping, the Empire State Building, the New York Public Library, and Bryant Park, which transforms into a winter wonderland in the colder months. The health of our guests and employees is our top priority. Our housekeeping staff takes all necessary precautions to fully sanitize each room between guests. In the heart of Midtown Manhattan resides 70 Park Avenue, a 4-star boutique hotel. Set on a tree-lined stretch of Park Avenue, the hotel has a boutique residential atmosphere—a quiet escape from the normally bustling Midtown area. The lobby's inviting, plush decor makes guests feel instantly at home.

34758.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including a sauna and bicycles to rent. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a picnic area. Grab a bite at one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and laundry facilities. This hotel has 10 meeting rooms available for events. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 8 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries.

34816.address: Alara Tourism Center Okurcalar Mevkii Antalya
34816.description: Facing the beachfront, Holiday Garden Resort offers 5-star accommodations in Okurcalar and features a garden, shared lounge and terrace. Featuring a 24-hour front desk, this property also welcomes guests with a restaurant, a water park and a playground. The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool, fitness center, nightclub and a kids' club. The rooms are equipped with air conditioning, a safety deposit box and a flat-screen TV, and some rooms at the hotel have a balcony. A buffet breakfast is available every morning at Holiday Garden Resort. The wellness area at the accommodation is comprised of a sauna and a hammam. You can play table tennis, darts and squash at Holiday Garden Resort, and bike rental and car rental are available. Okurcalar Beach is a 3-minute walk from the hotel, while Historical Alarahan is 8. 8 miles from the property. The nearest airport is Gazipaşa-Alanya, 47 miles from Holiday Garden Resort, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

34963.address: Av. Cobá No. 5 y 7 Mz. 8 SM 22
34963.description: This hotel is centrally located in Cancun, about 20 m from Tulúm Avenue, the main street along with Coba Avenue, and only around 1. 5 km from the wonderful sandy beach. This was one of the first hotels in central Cancun, and is situated directly by countless shops, restaurants, bars, and nightclubs. The nearest links to the public transport network and railway station are all located only a few metres from the hotel and can easily be reached on foot. Cancun airport lies some 25 km from the hotel building. This modern city hotel was completely renovated in 2001 and comprises three floors with a total of 78 rooms. Guests are offered a relaxing terrace at this establishment situated beside a main road. All of the welcoming rooms have an en suite bathroom, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, AM/FM radio and a hire safe. The air conditioning is individually adjustable. The hotel offers several options ensuring guests will enjoy the beauty of Mexico and the Caribbean. Guests can enjoy quality and service in the hotel, which serves international dishes, refreshing drinks, and snacks. Lunch and dinner may be taken à la carte and lunch may also be taken as a set menu.

35060.description: This city hotel is situated in the centre of Barcelona. It is an ideal starting point for exploring the city. There are scores of restaurants, bars, nightclubs and shops in the surrounding area(within 2km of the hotel). The transfer time to the airport takes around 30 minutes. The public transport network is easily reached on foot. It is 2km to the beach from the hotel. This hotel has a total of 45 rooms spread over 8 floors. There is also a lobby with a reception open 24 hours a day, cloakroom and lift, a café, a bar and a restaurant. Guests can also use an Internet terminal, a car park. The hotel offers a massage service. The rooms consist of an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, direct dial telephone, satellite TV, Internet access, a minibar, a king-size bed, central heating and a hire safe.

35097.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and discounted use of a nearby fitness facility. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and multilingual staff. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 64 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and toothbrushes and toothpaste. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Blue Man Group Berlin - 0. 7 km / 0.

35200.description: Only three kilometers from Charles de Gaulle Airport and less than ten minutes from the Villepinte and Le Bourget Exhibition Centres in the north of Paris, the Hotel Inn Design CDG Airport is the ideal stopover for business and leisure trips. We are perfectly situated to enjoy all the attractions in and around Paris, 25 kilometers from the historic centre of the capital, 20 minutes from Parc Asterix, 40 minutes from Disneyland® Paris and 15 kilometers from the Stade de France. Our hotel has 244 comfortable rooms that are spacious, air conditioned and also include 26 'superior' rooms. This hotel establishment offers 15 function rooms, brightly lit by natural light and adaptable to suit your needs. They are equipped with a sound system and the latest in video-projection technology. Our fitness centre is at your disposal and consists of a sauna and gym room. Also available are services such as Internet and Wi-Fi available throughout the hotel, a fax, and photocopier. There is on-site parking for a nominal fee. Enjoy your stay.

35303.description: Stay in one of our spacious 323 ft² rooms. Take the family to Meudon Forest or visit Versailles and Paris. Prepare to splurge at one of the 180 stores in nearby Westfield Mall. Back at the hotel, relax in our 90°F heated indoor pool, round off the day with one of our regional beverages, then enjoy the seasonal flavors of our chef's cuisine.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London - Luton Airport

35317.description: Located near Luton Airport, the Holiday Inn Express London Luton Airport offers convenient access to ZSL Whipsnade Zoo and the University of Bedfordshire. This hotel provides 154 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers and complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy the convenience of an on-site restaurant, bar/lounge, and snack bar/deli. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Additional amenities include 3 meeting rooms, dry cleaning/laundry services, and self-parking (subject to charges).

35319.description: The Holiday Inn Express Hemel Hempstead offers convenient accommodation with free parking. Located across from Apsley train station, it's a short 20-minute drive to Luton Airport. A short drive away, experience the magic of Warner Bros. Studio Tour London – go behind the scenes of the Harry Potter films and enjoy a butterbeer. Families can visit over 10, 000 animals at Whipsnade Zoo or tackle the obstacles at Ninja Warrior Watford, five miles away. Explore local history at King Henry VIII's former home, Ashridge Estate (a National Trust property), or enjoy the fresh air at Batford Springs Nature Reserve and Gadebridge Park. For thrill-seekers, Drift Limits Racetrack offers the chance to drive a real Formula 1 car or supercar, while The Snow Centre provides skiing and snowboarding opportunities. Take a day trip to St. Albans, known for its Roman and medieval heritage and impressive cathedral, or visit Knebworth House, a historic stately home and garden. Sports fans can catch a game at the Hemel Hempstead Town Football Club. After a day of exploring, enjoy pizzas and drinks from the hotel bar, followed by an inclusive buffet breakfast in the Great Room lounge.

35386.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the Libertel Gare du Nord Suède, where our multilingual staff is ready to make your Paris stay comfortable and convivial. This refined hotel offers 50 rooms ideally situated between Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est train stations. We're also just five minutes from Stade de France, 15 minutes from the Villepinte Exhibition Center, and 25 minutes from Charles de Gaulle Airport via RER B. Enjoy easy access to department stores, major boulevards, and the Musée Grévin.

35481.description: Established in 1882, the welcoming and comfortable Hotel benefits from an exceptional location opposite the Gare de l'Est, 400 metres from the Gare du Nord, 10 min from the Stade de France, 20 min from Parc des Expositions de Villepinte, 30 min from Roissy Charles de Gaulle Airport by the RER line B, close to the department stores, the grands boulevards and Montmartre.

35482.description: Located in Paris (Paris City Center), Hotel Quartier Latin is within a 15-minute walk of Notre-Dame and Panthéon. This hotel is 1. 5 mi (2. 4 km) from Louvre Museum and 2. 3 mi (3. 7 km) from Champs-Élysées. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 29 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired Internet access, a computer station, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Rue Mouffetard - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Sorbonne University - 0. 6 km/0. 3 mi- Jardin des Plantes - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Île de la Cité - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Île Saint-Louis - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Panthéon - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Notre-Dame - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Sainte-Chapelle - 1. 2 km/0. 7 mi- Hôtel de Ville - 1. 2 km/0. 8 mi- Rue de Rivoli - 1. 2 km/0. 8 mi- Les Halles - 1. 5 km/0. 9 mi- Luxembourg Gardens - 1. 5 km/0. 9 mi- Pont Neuf - 1. 5 km/1 mi- Place des Vosges - 1. 6 km/1 mi- Centre Pompidou - 1. 6 km/1 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 36. 3 km/22. 6 mi Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 17. 7 km/11 mi The preferred airport for Hotel Quartier Latin is Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG).

35526.description: This Porto hotel boasts a prime location near major monuments and the city's historic districts, with easy access to transportation hubs. Its 89 rooms are spread across two buildings, and the hotel offers excellent meeting facilities in both, along with a restaurant, bar, and room service. Guests are just minutes away from attractions such as the Clérigos Tower, Ribeira district, Port wine cellars, Soares dos Reis Museum, and the Serralves Foundation. Note: Guests may be asked for ID and a credit/debit card upon check-in. All special requests are subject to availability and may incur additional charges. Different policies and supplements may apply to reservations of more than four rooms.

35528.description: Stunningly situated at the heart of Mirandela, this hotel offers guests the perfect setting from which to explore the captivating delights the area has to offer. Just a short walking distance away from the hotel lies the Mirandela Roman Church, while other attractions such as the Vila Flor Cultural Centre and the Vila Flor Municipal Museum are also situated nearby. Guests will enjoy the stunning views over the river, which evokes a sense of peace and serenity. The guest rooms are beautifully decorated, featuring soothing, crisp white tones for a serene ambience. The guest rooms offer modern amenities for the comfort and convenience of every type of traveller. The hotel offers a wealth of excellent facilities and services, ensuring a truly relaxing stay.

35576.description: Situated between the Champs-Élysées and the Eiffel Tower in central Paris, this charming 6-story hotel offers 40 rooms and convenient access to numerous attractions. Guests can enjoy nearby shopping on Montaigne Avenue, along with easy access to bistros, restaurants, bars, a nightclub, public transport, and the Georges V metro station, all within a 5-minute radius. The Seine is a mere 500 meters away, and the nearest train station is just 2 km from the hotel. Orly Airport is approximately 20 km away, while Charles de Gaulle Airport is 25 km away. Hotel amenities include a 24-hour reception desk, lifts, safes, free Internet access, and laundry service (at an extra charge). The air-conditioned rooms feature private bathrooms with showers and hairdryers, minibars, double beds, carpeting, direct-dial telephones, internet connections, and satellite/cable TV. Guests can also enjoy individually regulated air conditioning and heating. A breakfast buffet is available each morning.

35617.description: Our newly renovated, contemporary rooms feature a television, personal safe, and a private bathroom with a bath, shower, and hairdryer. Each soundproofed room has air conditioning and elevator access. Enjoy room service and free high-speed fiber internet access. Located in a quiet residential area in Paris's 17th arrondissement, Hotel Gaston is just 20 minutes from the Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées. The Wagram metro station, just steps from the hotel, offers direct access to Galeries Lafayette and Printemps. Continental breakfast is available each morning for €15 per person. Our reception desk is open 24/7 for your convenience.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Birmingham Airport NEC

35679.description: The Holiday Inn Express Birmingham Airport NEC, an IHG Hotel, is conveniently located in Marston Green, Birmingham, a short five-minute drive from the National Exhibition Centre and the National Motorcycle Museum. This hotel offers 179 guest rooms, each equipped with a flat-screen television, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with shower, a hairdryer and a desk. Guests can enjoy a satisfying meal at the Great Room restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A free buffet breakfast is served daily. Hotel amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, a vending machine, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage and meeting facilities. Self-parking is available (subject to charges).

35856.description: This charming hotel is located in northern Paris, in the romantic neighborhood of Montmartre, near the Moulin Rouge and a short walk from the Opera Garnier. Its 52 sophisticated yet comfortable rooms feature LCD TVs with satellite and cable channels, along with tea and coffee making facilities and private bathrooms. Ideally situated near the Saint-Lazare train station and just a 25-minute drive from Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG), the hotel offers convenient access to numerous metro stations, restaurants, pubs, and tourist attractions.

35918.description: Enjoy modern comfort and convenience at the Courtyard New York Manhattan/Midtown East. Located near iconic attractions such as Madison Avenue, St. Patrick's Cathedral, and the Museum of Modern Art, our hotel offers a prime location for exploring the city. Stay active in our 24-hour fitness center or relax and enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Savor a delicious meal at Table 866 or grab a snack and coffee in our cafe. Start your day with a continental breakfast (fee applies). For business travelers, we offer a well-equipped business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Our 321 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs, refrigerators, and comfortable pillowtop beds with premium bedding. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. In addition to room charges, a $50/night incidental hold is placed on your card to cover added services or fees. Unused funds are released, 5–14 business days after checkout.

36079.description: This pleasant hotel, nestled in the artistic district of Montmartre, is located very close to several touristic and historic points of interest, such as Place du Tertre and the Sacré Coeur. Guests will find within the area a variety of shops, bars, restaurants and nightclubs. Convenient public transport links are also reachable on foot. Charles de Gualle airport is approximately 30 km away. This hotel provides a welcoming atmosphere.

36080.description: This hotel is situated on a quiet side street in the 18th arrondissement, at the centre of Paris, and very close to Montmartre district and the renowned church of Sacré Coeur. Within the area guests will find convenient transport which provides links to most important touristic sights, such as Champs Elysées and Notre-Dame cathedral. Charles de Gaulle airport is 30 km away whilst Orly is approximately 50 km from the hotel.

36398.description: This smart southeast London hotel offers convenient access to central London and Kent, with Bexley station nearby providing direct trains to London Charing Cross and London Bridge. The new Elizabeth Line in Abbey Wood is just 15 minutes away. By road, the A2 provides access to Canary Wharf, Docklands, and London's O2 arena in 20 minutes, and the M25 is a short 10-minute drive away. Holiday Inn® London - Bexley is ideal for business and leisure travelers. Host a meeting or wedding for up to 120 guests in one of our eight well-equipped banqueting suites. Enjoy free WiFi, 24-hour room service, and comfortable rooms with desks, satellite TV, and a choice of pillows. Families can opt for rooms with sofa beds, and kids stay and eat free. Premium Rooms include a stocked minibar. The hotel restaurant offers an extensive breakfast buffet and hearty dinners, with drinks and snacks available all day in the lounge.

36403.description: A stylish Birmingham hotel close to the NEC that offers a variety of bedrooms, large meeting spaces and a restaurant that serves to everyone's needs. Crowne Plaza® Birmingham NEC hotel is located in a fantastic spot, only a five-minute drive from Birmingham Airport and a short walk from Resorts World and the NEC, so whether it is exhibitions at the NEC, concerts at Resort World Arena, or a trip away - we have you covered. We also offer Park, Stay and Go packages so you can catch your flight without a worry. The Hotel is situated just off the M42 motorway, which provides easy access to the M40, the M6 and the M1, and Birmingham city centre is only 15 minutes away by train from nearby Birmingham International station. Host a meeting for up to 200 guests in our eleven meeting rooms, with wall-mounted screens for presentations and a breakout space for networking. Our Crowne Plaza Meetings Director is on hand to take care of all the details. At this hotel, you can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, Energy Essentials, Sleep Advantage® Programme and 24-hour room service. Our restaurant offers buffet breakfasts and delicious meals in the evening, or for a more relaxed feel you can lounge in our Lobby Bar where you can grab a Starbucks coffee, and keep your energy up with Fast and Fresh meals at any time of day. Our thoughtfully designed bedrooms all have executive work desks, and USB ports to keep you completely connected.

36409.description: Located in a quiet residential area on Boulevard Péreire, this hotel offers convenient access to Parisian life. Within a short walk, you'll find restaurants, bars, traditional French markets, and a variety of shops. The Palais des Congrès, Porte Maillot, and Espace Champerret are less than a 10-minute walk away, and metro, RER, and bus connections are just 5 minutes from the hotel, providing easy access to iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower and Notre Dame Cathedral. A picturesque lake and park are within 900 meters. This four-story city hotel features 26 uniquely designed rooms. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour reception desk, a lift, a bar, a public Internet terminal, and a breakfast room. A garage and laundry service are available for an additional fee. Each comfortable room includes an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, central heating, a minibar, Wi-Fi access, and a king-size or double bed. Connecting rooms and disabled access rooms are available upon request. Guests can start their day with a breakfast buffet.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Birmingham - South A45

36422.description: A family-friendly Birmingham hotel near the airport with breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® Birmingham - South A45 hotel offers 83 spacious rooms just off the A45, a major road through the scenic Midlands. It's a short drive to Birmingham Airport, and just 10 minutes into Birmingham city centre. Business guests are a 15-minute drive from Birmingham's historic financial buildings along Colmore Row, and the NEC is even closer for major conferences and exhibitions. Back at the hotel, Curlers Room provides an elegant meeting space for up to 16 delegates, with friendly staff on hand to assist. For shopping and dining the famous Bullring Centre is a short drive away, and from there it's an easy walk to a concert at Symphony Hall. Less than 30 minutes' drive into the surrounding countryside are Drayton Manor Theme Park and Warwick Castle, both popular spots for family outings. Don't miss a trip to Cadbury World, a fun visitor centre at the world-famous chocolate factory. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- An included Express Start Breakfast buffet- Secure on-site parking- A Business CentreAll guest rooms come with spacious work areas and a choice of pillows, while family rooms include a sofa bed for the kids. After a busy day, you can enjoy local beers and tasty pub food at the friendly lobby bar and restaurant.

36598.description: Convenient Hotel in Crawley Town Centre with Breakfast IncludedHoliday Inn Express® London Gatwick - Crawley hotel is less than a 15-minute drive from Gatwick Airport (LGW). The hotel is just off the M23 near Crawley town centre. It’s a short stroll to Three Bridges station for trains to London, Brighton and the Sussex coast. Catch a show at The Hawth theatre, a quick walk away, or wander into Crawley to browse the shops or grab a bite to eat at the County Mall. You can tee off at the nearby Tilgate Forest Golf Centre, or take the kids to spy otters and owls at Tilgate Nature Centre. Hever Castle, Anne Boleyn's childhood home, is a 30-minute drive, and Wakehurst Place country estate is even closer. Business guests are within easy reach of Manor Royal Business District, for meetings with Virgin Atlantic, CGG, Thales or Boeing. You can also host up to 25 people in our Crawley hotels conference room. At our hotel near Gatwick Airport you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- All Day Dining menus- Express Start™ Breakfast included in the room rate- On-site parkingRooms include blackout curtains for a good night’s sleep. If you’re travelling with kids, you can choose a room with a sofa bed. Start the day with a hearty breakfast of scrambled eggs, baked beans and sausages. For lunch or dinner, our all-day dining menu is available.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London Croydon by IHG

36697.description: A central Croydon hotel with bright, thoughtfully designed rooms and breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® London - Croydon is in the centre of Croydon, next to the Centrale Shopping Centre. It’s a short walk to East Croydon station, where direct trains speed you to London Victoria or London Bridge in 20 minutes. Gatwick Airport (LGW) is also 20 minutes on the train, or 30 minutes by car. You’ll find a tram stop a few steps from the hotel. If you’re in town for a Crystal Palace game, it’s a short drive or bus ride to Selhurst Park Stadium. For your event needs, 8 versatile, fully equipped meeting rooms provide space for up to 65 guests. With plenty of natural light, these high-floor rooms offer sweeping views over London, and refreshments are available to suit your needs. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- A pillow menuFuel up for the day with the included Express Start™ Breakfast with a range of hot English and continental choices.

36698.description:
Holiday Inn Express® London – Dartford is conveniently located just off the M25, only a 35-minute drive from both London City Airport (LCY) and Gatwick Airport (LGW). Ebbsfleet International Station, less than 15 minutes away by car, offers Eurostar services to Europe. 

Guests can enjoy easy access to top shopping destinations, including Lakeside and Bluewater Shopping Centres. For a memorable family day out, the historic Leeds Castle is just a 30-minute drive away. Motorsport fans will appreciate being only 10 miles from Brands Hatch Circuit, while central London is easily reached in around 30 minutes from nearby Dartford train station. 

After a busy day, unwind in the hotel lounge with a refreshing drink and pizza, or relax in your room with fast, free Wi-Fi, a wall-mounted TV, bedside USB ports and an en-suite bathroom with a power shower. Start your day right with the free breakfast buffet, or grab a quick bite with our convenient Grab & Go option if you’re on the move.

36712.description: Smart hotel in Hemel Hempstead with a gym, sauna, indoor swimming pool and conference facilities. Holiday Inn Hemel Hempstead M1, Jct. 8 hotel has everything you need for a seamless stay, including free WiFi, an Open Lobby with a bar, restaurant and lounge, Spirit Health Club with a gym, pool and sauna facilities, and kids stay and eat free!Stylish hotel rooms have Smart TVs and pillow menus for customised comfort. All Day Dining means you can grab a bite to eat at any hour from the To Go Cafe, or enjoy a quiet night in with 24-hour room service. Here for work? Our 7 light-filled function rooms and breakout lounge offer space for up to 130 guests. A dedicated host can help personalise your business meeting. We also host amazing social events!Our Hemel Hempstead hotel is within 2 minutes of the M1 and 5 minutes from M25 motorways. Buses to London Victoria leave from right outside our accommodation, and Luton Airport is 8 miles away. We're also just minutes from direct trains to London via Hemel Hempstead Station. Take the kids on an adventure at the Warner Bros Studios, Harry Potter Studio Tour is only 12-minute drive. Or head over, a quick drive to the historic St Albans town centre, Cathedral and Abbey, as well as the majestic 11th-century Berkhamsted Castle.

36723.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Bask in the sun on the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities, including a nightclub and an indoor pool. This all-inclusive resort also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. An area shuttle is available (surcharge). Savor a meal at one of the four on-site restaurants, including Sultan, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at one of the two bars/lounges or two poolside bars. For business travelers, a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk are available. The resort offers 2, 152 square feet (200 square meters) of event space, including a conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided (surcharge, available 24 hours), and free self-parking is available. The 289 air-conditioned guest rooms feature minibars, private balconies or patios, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Private bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Alara Bazaar (1. 1 mi), Water Planet Aquapark (1. 9 mi), İncekum Plajı (5. 2 mi), Alara Han Castle (8. 4 mi), and Sealanya (9. 2 mi).

36727.description: Located on Turkey's southern coast in the district of Okurcalar, between the resorts of Side and Alanya, this luxurious property boasts a privileged situation on a stunning sandy bay. They city centre is just a 5-minute drive and Antalya International Airport is some 90 kilometres away. Public transport runs close to the hotel and nearby tourist attractions include the Alanya Castle and Aspendos Amphitheatre. Offering a modern accommodation and facilities suitable for most ages, this complex is ideal for those travellers wishing to escape everyday routine and enjoy a moment of calm. The guest rooms provide all the necessary amenities to guarantee a restful stay, such as air conditioning and Internet access. The magnificent outdoor pools, the state-of-the-art spa facilities and the private beach will be the icing on the cake to make guests' holidays complete.

36758.description: Explore London from our Modern Stratford HotelThe family-friendly Holiday Inn Express® London - Stratford hotel is a 10-minute walk from Stratford Tube and DLR station, where you can catch direct trains to London City Airport and the O2 arena. From Stratford International station, a 15-minute walk away, you can take high-speed trains to St Pancras station. You can also catch the fantastic new Elizabeth Line which can take you from Stratford straight to Heathrow without having to change. The landmark venues of Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park sports complex, and the towering ArcelorMittal Orbit sculpture are nearby the hotel. The restaurants, cinema and bowling alley of the expansive Westfield Stratford City shopping centre is located by the main station. Business guests are a 15-minute DLR ride away from the ExCel London exhibition centre. Host meetings at our Stratford London hotel for up to 80 people in the five flexible, air-conditioned spaces, with natural light and free Wi-Fi.  Limited on-site parking is available on a first come first serve basis for a daily fee of £20. Set yourself up for the day with Express Start Breakfast included, served in the modern dining area, which is also open for evening meals. The open-plan lounge bar area is a great spot to chat with colleagues and friends over a glass of wine, or relax at the table with a pint of draught beer.

36759.description: Contemporary hotel with breakfast included and free Wi-Fi, close to top London attractionsHoliday Inn Express® London - Limehouse hotel sits near the Thames River in a historic part of London close to major attractions. It's less than 5 minutes' walk from Limehouse DLR station, where trains travel to central London in about 20 minutes and to the O2 arena and London City Airport (LCY) in less than 30 minutes. Whether you want to explore the Tower of London, shop at Westfield Stratford City or see a popular band at the O2 arena, you can get around easily via public transport. You're right next to London's East End, a vibrant area with shops, restaurants and art galleries, and Bethnal Green's V&A Museum of Childhood. Business guests have a direct 30-minute link to the ExCeL centre, and the art deco Troxy theatre and concert venue is just seven minutes' walk away. Back at the hotel, two naturally lit meeting rooms can host up to 30 people, and you can have a working lunch catered. The Business Centre is open until midnight, and your delegates will appreciate the free Wi-Fi, available throughout the hotel. Start the day with an inclusive Express Start Breakfast buffet of scrambled eggs, sausages, baked beans and continental items. An airy lobby bar serves drinks and a selection of sandwiches.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London Swiss Cottage

36760.description: The modern Holiday Inn Express London - Swiss Cottage offers free WiFi and an inclusive breakfast, just minutes from London's main attractions and within easy reach of Heathrow Airport. Located a short walk from Finchley Road Tube station, with Metropolitan and Jubilee line connections, guests can quickly reach Oxford Street and other central locations. Heathrow Airport is easily accessible via the Tube and Heathrow Express train. On-site parking is available for guests arriving by car. Nearby, explore the charming canals of Little Venice or discover bargains and diverse food options at Camden Market, a short Overground train ride away. The O2 Centre, offering shopping and dining, is also just steps from the hotel. For business travelers, the hotel features a naturally lit, air-conditioned meeting room for up to 25 people, as well as a Business Centre with fax, PC, and copier facilities. Free WiFi is available throughout the hotel. Start your day with the included Express Start breakfast buffet, featuring fruit, yogurt, cereals, hot eggs, baked beans, and sausages.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Chingford North Circular

36761.description: Holiday Inn Express London Chingford offers a comfortable and convenient base to explore the city’s attractions with modern amenities, nearby attractions, and excellent transport links. Walthamstow Central Station has direct links to London Euston. Catch flights from London City Airport, 11 miles away, or Stansted Airport is a 30-minute drive along the M11. On-site parking is managed by YourParkingSpace and is available for £10 per day. Tick off top London attractions with ease. The Tower of London, Buckingham Palace, the British Museum and Big Ben are all easily accessible via public transport. Cheer on Tottenham Hotspur FC at the Spurs’ Stadium, less than four miles away. Escape the hustle and bustle of the city. Visit the picturesque Epping Forest, a 15-minute drive away, for walking trails and picnic spots, or head to the nearby William Morris Gallery. Roam around the beautiful gardens in Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, watch events in the aquatics centre and enjoy panoramic views across the city atop the ArcelorMittal Orbit sculpture. After a day’s exploring, refuel with pizzas and drinks from the bar and when you wake up, enjoy an inclusive buffet breakfast in the Great Room lounge.

name.content: voco London Camden Lock by IHG

36763.description: Located in the heart of London, the voco London Camden Lock by IHG offers convenient access to top attractions like The British Museum and Hyde Park, both within a 10-minute drive. This upscale hotel provides 130 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with deep soaking bathtubs. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the Mezzanine Restaurant and coffee shop/cafe, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A fitness center, concierge services, and a business center are also available. For those planning events, the hotel boasts over 6, 000 square feet of meeting space.

36764.description: Situated opposite Colliers Wood Underground station on the Northern Line, this modern hotel offers convenient access to central London, with Waterloo just 20 minutes and Leicester Square 30 minutes away. Popular attractions such as Legoland and Chessington World of Adventures are a 30-minute drive away, while Wimbledon's renowned tennis and greyhound racing venues are merely 5 minutes from the hotel. Heathrow and Gatwick Airports are easily accessible via the A3 and M25 motorways. The hotel's 83 air-conditioned rooms provide a comfortable stay, featuring private bathrooms with power showers, Sky TV, workspaces, internet access, and tea/coffee making facilities. Guests can also enjoy complimentary continental breakfast and make use of the hotel's lounge, bar, and conference facilities, complete with high-speed Wi-Fi. Secure underground parking is available for a fee. Five accessible rooms cater to guests with disabilities.

36765.description: A central London hotel with 52 modern rooms and easy access to Victoria Station and the West EndHoliday Inn Express® London Victoria hotel, housed in a historic building, is a 10-minute walk from Victoria Station, which has express trains to Gatwick Airport (LGW). Pimlico Tube station, with fast links to the city’s main shopping districts and the West End, is only three minutes away. Free on-street parking is available 6:30pm–8:30am on weekdays and all weekend. A car park is within walking distance of the hotel. The Apollo Victoria and Victoria Palace theatres are a 10-minute walk from the hotel. You are only a couple of Tube stops from the shopping hubs of Bond Street and Oxford Street. Some of London’s major sights, including Buckingham Palace and the Houses of Parliament, are less than half an hour away on foot. The nearby Queen Mother Sports Centre has a gym and an indoor pool. The QEII Centre, one of London’s largest exhibition spaces, is a 30-minute walk from the hotel. The financial districts of The City and Canary Wharf are about 20 minutes away by Tube, and it’s a 40-minute trip to ExCeL London. Business visitors can take advantage of inclusive Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Guests enjoy a complimentary breakfast each morning, and the Beverley Bar in the lobby serves drinks and snacks until late. There are many dining options in the surrounding area.

36766.description: The Holiday Inn Express London - Southwark offers a central London location near Southwark and Blackfriars Tube stations, providing easy access to attractions like the Tate Modern, Shakespeare's Globe, and Borough Market. Business travelers are within a short walk of The Shard and the London Stock Exchange. Amenities include free WiFi, on-site parking, a Business Centre, and the Express Start™ Breakfast buffet with hot and cold items. Relax after a day of sightseeing or meetings in the lobby bar.

36774.description: Smart, contemporary hotel with free Wi-Fi and included Grab and Go breakfast 20 minutes from central London. Holiday Inn Express® London - Park Royal hotel is a three-minute drive from the A40 motorway and around the corner from North Acton Tube station. Catch the Central line to inner-city London in 20 minutes or to Westfield London shops and restaurants in eight minutes. If you're landing at Heathrow Airport, you'll find the hotel just 40 minutes away by rail. London attractions like Buckingham Palace and the British Museum are a quick trip from the hotel. Vast Kew Gardens awaits you just four miles away, and Ealing Studios,  home to ''Downton Abbey'' and several hit films, is three miles away. See rock concerts and football games at Wembley Stadium, 20 minutes' drive away. The hotel is in the heart of the Park Royal Business Centre, with over 1, 200 companies, and less than four miles from the Wembley Conference Centre. An on-site conference room comes equipped with all you need for a successful boardroom meeting for up to 14 people. Modern and inviting public spaces make your stay at the hotel fun and convenient, and there's free Wi-Fi throughout. Wake up to an inclusive Grab and Go Breakfast. Relax at any time of day in the casual Express Café and Bar.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Birmingham Oldbury M5/Jct.2

36777.description: Holiday Inn Express Birmingham Oldbury is close to the M5 and a 15-minute drive from Birmingham city centre. Board direct trains to London and Glasgow from Sandwell &Dudley station less than 2 miles away or catch flights off from Birmingham Airport, a 30-minute drive away. Visit local companies in Birmingham Business Park in half an hour. Immerse yourself in the rich industrial history of the region with a visit to the nearby Black Country Living Museum. Experience the sights and sounds of the past as you explore reconstructed buildings and interact with costumed characters. If you fancy some retail therapy, visit Merry Hill Shopping Centre, a 20-minute drive away, or head into central Birmingham for the Bullring. For a day of adventure and wildlife with the family, Dudley Zoo and Castle is four miles away. Roam the castle grounds and spot animals from around the world. Book a trip to West Midlands Safari Park for a thrilling safari experience or indulge your sweet tooth at Cadbury World. Walk through a transparent tunnel surrounded by sharks and learn about the importance of ocean conservation at The National Sea Life Centre. When you return, order pizzas and drinks from the bar and when you wake up, enjoy a free buffet breakfast in the Great Room.

36878.description: The Líbere Barcelona Sant Antoni apartments are located in the heart of the Sant Antoni neighborhood in Barcelona. These apartments are modern and elegant, with a minimalist decoration and equipped with all the necessary amenities to ensure a comfortable stay. Additionally, guests have access to a rooftop terrace with impressive panoramic views of the city. The Líbere Barcelona Sant Antoni apartments are an excellent accommodation option for those seeking a comfortable and authentic stay in Barcelona.

37083.description: Waterfront hotel near London with top-notch meeting and banquet facilities. 37092.description: A mansion with a renaissance air that conjures up flavors of Tuscan villages; this is a place with exclusivity, charm, and surrounded by magnificent gardens and hundred-year-old cedars, that give the place its name. Affording easy access to the M-30, the accommodation is also only 6 miles from the airport and 2. 5 miles from Ifema. Bedrooms are individually decorated in different forms in a warm and homey atmosphere with special attention to detail. The exquisite restaurant is divided into three distinct atmospheres, and allows you to enjoy the summer terrace and gardens. The cuisine is based on traditional Mediterranean recipes, incorporating innovative touches. Other facilities include its function rooms for meetings or events, and an English bar. For those who want to visit Madrid, this is a perfect location, with a peaceful atmosphere, surrounded by nature and well-connected with the center.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London Royal Docks

37130.description: A smart, convenient London Docklands hotel with free Wi-Fi and included breakfast near The O2 arena and Canary WharfIn the heart of London's Docklands, Holiday Inn Express® London - Royal Docks, Docklands hotel is convenient for a business or leisure trip. You can walk to Canning Town Tube and DLR station in four minutes, and from there, there are fast connections to London City Airport and central London. The nearest bus stop is a two-minute walk away. The hotel is a 10-minute walk from the Emirates Air Line cable car. For a big concert or event, The O2 arena is one stop away by Tube. Westfield Stratford City shopping centre and Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, with its Aquatics Centre and kids' playgrounds, are both three miles north of the hotel. Guests heading to an exhibition are a 10-minute walk from the Royal Victoria Dock, home to both The Crystal and ExCel London. Hosting a conference? You can invite 40 delegates to the largest of the hotel's three meeting rooms. If you're visiting a local business, the hotel is just two miles from Canary Wharf. Help yourself to scrambled eggs, baked beans and sausages each morning as part of the inclusive Express Start Breakfast, and check emails using the free Wi-Fi. At dinner time, you can find several restaurants in the area around the hotel. Or simply relax with a drink in the lobby bar.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London - Stansted Airport

37137.description: Located near Stansted Airport in Bishop's Stortford, the Holiday Inn Express London Stansted Airport offers convenient access to Bishop's Stortford Golf Club (a 5-minute drive). This hotel is 14. 3 miles from Audley End House and 3. 4 miles from Flitch Way Country Park. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a vending machine, and an on-site restaurant, The Great Room, along with a bar/lounge for a relaxing drink. A complimentary continental breakfast is served weekdays from 4:00 AM to 9:30 AM and weekends from 4:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel's 254 guestrooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, digital programming, and private bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Coffee/tea makers and irons/ironing boards are also provided for your convenience. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and five meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and self-parking is available on-site (subject to charges).
