37278.description: The hotel enjoys a prime location over-looking the sandy, Incekum Bay, 24 km from the popular resort of Alanya and a couple of hundred metres from the beach. Guests can reach the hotel from Antalya Airport which is situated around 105 km from the hotel. This is a well-established hotel furnished in a classical style and featuring an outdoor pool, a restaurant with both indoor and outdoor seating, a lobby and a pool bar. The outdoor facilities are in an attractive garden surrounded by trees and the hotel has its own rocky beach. It is possible to use the facilities of the sister hotel next door which include a hairdresser's and a spa and beauty centre (fee payable). In addition, there is free Internet access in the hotel's lobby. The hotel is air-conditioned and features a 24-hour reception offering a 24-hour check-out service. A hotel safe is provided for the storage of valuables and currency exchange facilities are available. Lift access is also provided, as is a TV lounge and a laundry service, the latter of which is subject to an additional fee. The cosy rooms have carpeted flooring and are equipped with air conditioning, satellite TV and have either French or twin beds. The rooms are en suite with a shower and hairdryer, a telephone is also provided, as is a safe and a minibar. Guests can make use of their accommodation's ironing set. Individually regulated air conditioning and heating features as standard in the rooms. Guests can relax on their room's balcony or terrace.

37282.description: A very comfortable beach hotel, ideal for restful days on the wide beach or shopping and sightseeing in the nearby resorts of Side and Alanya. It comprises a total of 247 rooms and has a pleasant garden with outdoor pool and waterslides. The hotel is located approximately 2 km away from Okurcalar and public transport runs in front of the hotel .

37338.description: Welcome to our central Luton hotel, featuring our new generation bedrooms with an impressive 40" flat screen and brand new, slumber-inducing, king-size Hypnos bed. The hotel is ideally situated for both business and leisure guests. Luton Town Railway Station is just 0. 5 miles away, with connections to the North, and to London and the South. The hotel is just 2 miles from London Luton Airport and within easy reach of the M1 Junction 10. The Arndale Centre provides excellent shopping opportunities, with the Galaxy Leisure Centre offering a multi-screen complex and bowling facilities - all within a 5 minute walk of the hotel. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

37437.description: This charming city hotel is mere steps from central Paris, world-class shopping, entertainment, and renowned museums like the Louvre and Orsay. Public transport is conveniently located 50 meters away, and the train station, offering access to Versailles, is a short 5-minute walk. Charles de Gaulle Airport is 30 km and Paris Orly Airport is about 18 km from the hotel. The 7-story hotel features 33 rooms decorated by Christian Lacroix. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with a 24-hour reception, safe, currency exchange, and lift. The hotel's location on the Rue de Bellechasse reflects the 19th-century aesthetic of the Musée d'Orsay, surrounded by antique shops, neoclassical architecture, and art galleries. The Faubourg Saint-Germain neighborhood blends tradition with a contemporary, artistic lifestyle, capturing the unique spirit of Paris. Each tastefully decorated room includes an en-suite bathroom with a hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, minibar, double bed, and satellite/cable TV. A safe and carpeting are also standard. A buffet breakfast featuring fresh, delicious products is served from 7:00 am to 11:00 am in the spacious breakfast room. An express breakfast option is available in the bar during the same hours.

37456.description: Halfway between Rue Mouffetard with its lively market and the Botanical Gardens, the charming Hotel Maxim quartier Latin Paris, offers all the pleasures of the Latin Quarter, including a light-hearted atmosphere, cosy restaurants, cafés and cinemas and an unrestricted view of Paris from the Montagne St. Geneviève and the Pantheon. Its outstanding location on a quiet one-way street - just 50 metres from the metro - ensures peace and quiet as well as quick access to the city's most beautiful attractions. This welcoming hotel was renovated in a contemporary, inviting style.

37461.description: This city hotel, located approximately 4. 9 km from the vibrant city center, offers direct metro access to the heart of Madrid. A mere 10 minutes from Barajas International Airport, this air-conditioned hotel features 93 guest rooms showcasing local design. Guests are greeted by a 24-hour reception and lobby with a safe and currency exchange. Paid garage parking is also available. Dining options include a stylish café and a cozy restaurant. Each tastefully designed room is fully equipped and offers internet access. Guests can also enjoy the outdoor swimming pool and a daily breakfast buffet.

37599.description: The hotel is 40 km from Antalya city centre. It takes 5 minutes to reach Kemer city centre and it is 45 minutes to Antalya city centre by public transport. Guests will find the nearest restaurants, bars and tourist facilities around 15 minutes' walk away. The beach is just some 100 m from the property, which is 50 km away from Antalya Airport. The hotel is set among orange trees with the Taurus Mountains as a backdrop. It offers 130 comfortably furnished rooms and numerous facilities, both recreational and useful for business travellers. All rooms have wall-to-wall carpeting and feature a balcony or French balcony. Guests can enjoy daily entertainment in the indoor and outdoor swimming pools and relaxing saunas and steam baths. The more active ones can keep fit with aqua fit, aerobics or a workout in the gym. There are also water sports available.

37600.description: Situated just a fifteen-minute drive from the popular seaside resort of Kemer and less than an hour outside of bustling Antalya, this modern resort hotel is backed by the pine-shrouded Taurus Mountains and the turquoise blue of the Mediterranean Sea. The beach is only a short stroll away, and the hotel offers a wide range of facilities and services for a spectacular holiday experience. Guests might dine on Turkish or international cuisines in the restaurant, relax in the spa complete with fitness centre, Turkish bath, one sauna and a steam bath, or simply lounge in the sun by one expansive outdoor pool with a drink from the pool bar while children play on the water slides. The game room offer table tennis and the hotel features its own entertainment programme for children and adults.

37620.description: Located directly on the sand and gravel beach in Avsallar, this hotel is just a short walk from shops, boutiques, markets, bars, and other entertainment. A nearby footbridge provides easy access across the main street. The hotel comprises a six-story main building and seven three-story annex buildings, offering a total of 124 rooms. Guests can enjoy amenities including a reception area, lobby, TV corner, main restaurant, two bars (lobby and garden), fitness center, spa, various shops, a hairdresser, and daytime entertainment. Additional features include a swimming pool, children's paddling pool, playground, and complimentary sunbeds, umbrellas, and beach towels. Mattresses are available for an extra charge, as is parking. Rooms in both the main and annex buildings feature stone tile floors, a private bath or shower with WC, hairdryer, telephone, satellite TV, mini-bar (stocked with water upon arrival), and individually controlled air conditioning. A safe is available for an extra charge. Each room also includes a balcony.

37676.description: This stylish boutique hotel is just 10 km away from Gatwick, in London. The property is within easy access of everything that the culturally-rich, captivating city centre of London has to offer. This luxurious hotel boasts a stunning architectural design. Set in a country house, amidst 120 acres of parkland, the property offers a peaceful, inviting retreat, in which to experience well-deserved luxury and relaxation. The spacious guest rooms feature large beds and marble bathrooms, many of which come complete with Victorian baths. The ultimate rejuvenation can be enjoyed in the spa, which comprises plunge pools, a yoga studio and a wide range of beauty treatments. A gym, fitness suite and tennis courts meet guests' leisure needs, while a delectable restaurant satiates visitors' dining expectations.

37916.description: This city hotel is located in the centre of Paris, directly on a main road, and is surrounded by bars, restaurants and nightclubs. Links to the public transport network lie within walking distance of the property. Transfer to Orly airport takes about 30 minutes by car and to Charles de Gaulle, around 45 minutes. This fully air- conditioned hotel was extensively renovated and comprises a total of 48 rooms spread across 8 floors. Guests are invited to take advantage of amenities which include a public Internet terminal with wireless access and a conference room. The accommodations come with carpeting and central heating, while an en-suite bathroom and satellite/cable TV also feature in all units to provide further comfort.

37917.description: 'The Atypik Hôtel in Clichy offers convenient access to La Défense and Stade de France, both within a 10-minute drive. This hotel features 47 air-conditioned guestrooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a spa tub, sauna, and a bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. Additional conveniences include a business center, 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and onsite self-parking (subject to charges). '

38219.description: The Geneva By Fassbind, formerly known as NH Geneva City, hotel is set in a lovely residential neighborhood close to Geneva's business district. The tram stop is only two minutes away on foot, taking guests to the city center in 10 minutes, while the United Nations Headquarters building is only one stop away. You can also find shops, cafes, restaurants, and bars nearby and the Lake Geneva is only 15 minutes away. There are 70 rooms at Geneva By Fassbind Hotel, are tastefully decorated. Every room comes with modern comforts such as free Wi-Fi, flat screen TV, and climate control. For a bit more of a luxurious feel, the bathrooms are finished with marble and if you need more space, we have Junior Suites with separate living rooms. For breakfast, we serve a wide variety of options including cold cuts, cheeses, pastries, breads, fruit, yogurt, and cereals. Enjoy these alongside freshly brewed coffee and tea. In the afternoons, unwind at our cozy bar with your favorite cocktail or have a light snack on our garden terrace. The hotel offers extras such as a fitness center and a small meeting room for up to 12 people.

38298.description: This guesthouse is located in the historic centre of Venice. Famous sights such as St. Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge in addition to the district of Mercerie are just a few minutes' walk away. Links to the public transport network lie less than 10 minutes away on foot. Both the bus station and train station are within 2 km and can be easily reached by water taxi, as may the airport and the islands of Murano, Burano and Torcello. A good selection of shops, restaurants and bars are to be found in the vicinity. Built in the 18th century and renovated in 2002, this guesthouse comprises a total of 8 rooms spread over 3 floors. Guests may make use of the foyer with a reception desk and a safe. The rooms come with a bathroom with a hairdryer, TV, a hire safe and a double bed. Individually regulated air conditioning and heating feature as standard in each room. CIR 027042-ALT-00105

38479.description: Offering a perfect blend of classic charm and modern comforts, this appealing boutique hotel enjoys a central location in the popular town of Chueca, near the Retiro Park and at only 200 m from the Gran Vía, where travellers can find the best shops and restaurants of the city. The establishment is very close to many local attractions such as Madrid's Art Triangle, with its three famous museums, the well-known Puerta del Sol and the Plaza Mayor. The elegant guest rooms invite travellers to relax in a warm, charming atmosphere and offer excellent facilities like individually controlled air-conditioning, free Wi-Fi access and a smart TV for guests' entertainment. Everyone is welcome in the on-site restaurant, which serves a varied menu of traditional Mediterranean cuisine with signature touches. Special menus for celebrations can be organized upon request. Other hotel services include a 24-hour reception with free luggage storage as well as excellent meeting facilities.

38502.description: This comfortable 4-star all-inclusive hotel is located directly on one of Kemer's pristine blue-flag pebble beaches. Just 400 meters from the city center, the hotel is within easy walking distance of numerous attractions, shops, and entertainment venues, and conveniently close to public transportation. The 130 guest rooms are equipped with air conditioning (hourly, depending on weather conditions), safes, satellite TV, minibars (complimentary soft drinks upon arrival), telephones, toiletries, hair dryers, baths or showers, and balconies or shared terraces. Renovated in 2009, the hotel offers free Wi-Fi throughout, including guest rooms. High-speed internet access is available for a fee. A 24-hour reception desk provides currency exchange services. The restaurant serves delicious traditional Turkish and international cuisine, featuring live cooking demonstrations. The bar offers complimentary soft drinks, local alcoholic beverages, and cocktails. Refreshments and snacks at the beach bar are extra. Complimentary sunbeds, mats, and umbrellas are available at the beach and pool. Chaise lounges on the hotel's private jetty (weather permitting) are available for a fee. Water sports are offered by third-party vendors for a fee. Guests can relax in the spa and enjoy the indoor pool, steam bath, sauna, hammam, and fitness room free of charge. Massages and other wellness treatments are available for a fee. A selection of books and games is available for guests to borrow.

38699.description: Explore the best of London from Holiday Inn Express London Wandsworth. Heathrow Airport is 10 miles away, Catch flights from Gatwick Airport (LGW) via Clapham Junction Station, or Heathrow Airport (LHR) is just over an hour away. We also have parking available at £30 a day. Wandsworth town station is a 5-minute walk away, and Clapham Junction is a bit further. Stroll along the river in Wandsworth Park or take a boat trip along the Thames for scenic views of the Houses of Parliament and Tower Bridge. On sunny days, head to Clapham Common for a picnic. Browse the shops at Southside Shopping Centre or enjoy a show at Battersea Arts Centre. Hop on the London Underground to visit infamous sights like Big Ben, The London Eye, Buckingham Palace and St Paul’s Cathedral. Catch musicals and plays in the West End or head to Stamford Bridge to cheer on Chelsea FC. Watch rugby at nearby Twickenham Stadium or if you’re in town for tennis at Wimbledon, it’s a short tube ride away. Order a pizza and pint from the bar and relax in the hotel lounge after a day’s sightseeing. In the morning, tuck into a buffet breakfast, included for every guest.

38701.description: The Lucerne Hotel offers newly renovated rooms, each featuring a Keurig coffee maker, iron and ironing board, and an in-room safe. Enjoy convenient dining at Nice Matin next door, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The Lucerne is ideally located near Central Park, Riverside Park, and various cultural attractions, including the American Museum of Natural History, the Metropolitan Museum of Art, and Lincoln Center. Public transportation is easily accessible with subway and bus lines along Broadway, Amsterdam, and Columbus Avenues.

38759.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestThe DoubleTree by Hilton London ExCel hotel is situated on a dramatic waterfront on the banks of the historic Royal Victoria Dock London. A warm welcome to the bustling East London awaits. Enjoy the convenience and our proximity to London City Airport, with an enviable closeness to the ExCel London and ICC London. Be in your guest room within minutes of landing into the heart of the docks, and relaxing in our lounge bar within minutes of closing your meeting. If you're looking to enjoy the tourist sites of London, the hotel's superb transport links are just 20-25 minutes from the Docklands Light Railway, Stratford, The City, London Bridge, Tower of London and Central London. For music lovers, stroll along the dock and fly the Emirates Airline to The O2, taking in the sights of a stunning Canary Wharf backdrop along the way. For sports fans the Queen Elizabeth Park is easily accessible. Even Wimbledon and Wembley are easy commutes away. Relax in a spacious guest room with modern decor, complimentary WiFi, HDTV and climate control. Upgrade your room for that little touch of luxury, including deluxe rooms with floor-to-ceiling views and many with balconies and water views. Our stunning suites on the highest floors of the hotel offer uncompromised views of the Royal Docks, London City Airport and Canary Wharf, all with separate lounge, luxury decor and walk-in rain shower rooms. We've got space for all the family with interconnecting rooms. Stay committed to your workout in the 24-hour Fitness Centre. Our sustainable restaurant, The Salt Port Restaurant & Delicatessen, embraces the history of the royal docks, offering a delicious all-day dining menu.

38760.description: London O2 hotel close to Canary Wharf and Emirates Cable Car with breakfast included. Holiday Inn Express® London – Greenwich hotel is five miles from London City Airport (LCY), and London Euston station is a 35-minute tube ride away. Parking is available for 35 GBP per night. Ready to explore London? Hop on a bus to the Royal Observatory Greenwich, National Maritime Museum and Cutty Sark Ship Museum. Take a cruise on a Thames Clipper river bus from North Greenwich Pier or enjoy aerial views of London with Emirates Air Line cable cars. Sing your heart out at gigs at the nearby O2 Arena or check out the latest exhibits at the National History Museum. Host a conference for 70 in the hotel’s two flexible meeting rooms or attend events at the nearby ExCeL London exhibition centre. Canary Wharf is a 15-minute drive for visiting the offices of American Express, Barclays PLC, IBM and KPMG. Recharge your batteries in the comfy rooms with bedside USB ports and a large flat-screen TV or sip a refreshing gin and tonic in the bar. Choose from classic dishes like fish and chips, burgers and pizzas to enjoy in the hotel’s lounge while uploading your snaps of London on the fast and free Wi-Fi. In the morning, wake up to breakfast included.

38781.description: Stay connected with Premier Inn Hotel South Mimms/Potters Bar. Just off the M25 motorway, we're in a great spot to help break up a long journey. And if you've time to stop and explore, you'll also be well placed to zip off to business and leisure destinations in London. Hop on the train for all the sights and sounds of central London. Catch the big match at Wembley Stadium. Or take a magical trip to Hogwarts on the Harry Potter Studio Tour. After a busy day, return for a tasty meal in our restaurant and a great night's sleep in your lovely, comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

38876.description: Enjoying a prime location in the centre of Paris, this hotel offers a pleasant stay for all kinds of travellers. It is situated close to the Gare de Lyon Metro station, offering easy access to the main sites of this beautiful city such as the Louvre Museum and the Champs-Élysées. The famous Place de la Bastille is at less than 2 km distance. Travellers can also find many shops and restaurants in the nearby vicinity, while Orly and Charles de Gaulle airport are only a 20-minute drive away. After a busy day visiting the local attractions, guests might relax in the comfortable hotel rooms, equipped with air-conditioning and complimentary Wi-Fi access for those who need to stay connected all the time. Every morning, the hotel serves a delicious continental breakfast buffet to start the day full of energy. Other facilities include room service and complimentary newspapers.

38877.description: The Hotel Augustin Astotel, nestled on a quiet side street in Paris's elegant Right Bank, offers convenient access to the Opera, Place de la Concorde, Saint Augustin Church, and Saint Lazare train station. Its 63 soundproofed rooms provide modern comforts, including air conditioning, en-suite bathrooms, direct-dial telephones, alarm clocks, hair dryers, and cable TV.

38878.description: Situated between the Montmartre area (Moulin Rouge, Sacre-Coeur), the Opera district and the famous department stores, the 3-star Hotel George - Astotel invites you to discover the qualities of a typical Parisian hotel, where conviviality and charm are combined on a daily basis. Authenticity, charm and elegance to give quality to your business or pleasure trips.

38879.description: At the heart of the Comédie district, the Régina Opéra hotel is the ideal spot for lovers of Parisian culture. In the 10th arrondissement, the site is perfect for fans of the Opéra Garnier, which is just a few steps away, lovers of theatre (the Variétés and the Comedy Club, etc. ), cinema with the Grand Rex, together with countless restaurants (including the Hard Rock Café) and bars. Also nearby are the Grévin Museum, the Grands Boulevards, Grands Magasins and the République and Bastille quarters: the hotel is at the heart of things. In this lively quarter, well served by the metro and with direct access to the Gare du Nord and the Gare de l'Est, the hotel offers 42 colourful rooms. Quiet and pleasant, these cosy 4-star nests are decorated in rich red tones, the colours of the Opéra. Recently refurbished, the hotel offers comfort and enjoyment.

39121.description: 'Located in a quiet residential area near Madrid's city center, this luxury hotel offers convenient access to the metro and bus station, placing the Bernabéu Stadium and other attractions within easy reach. Just 10 kilometers from Barajas Airport, the hotel boasts a stylish modern restaurant serving innovative Spanish cuisine, a terrace and garden, and a top-floor bar with stunning city views. Each floor showcases the unique vision of a different international architect, and guests can choose their room from an available selection upon arrival. The spacious rooms feature stylish decor, sleek furnishings, and luxurious private bathrooms. '

39178.description: Experience the heart of Alanya! Our 70-room boutique hotel overlooks the famed Cleopatra Beach, with stunning views of the Red Tower, Alanya Castle, and the Lighthouse. We offer guests a unique culinary journey with exquisite selections from world cuisines, prepared with organic ingredients. Each room features a balcony for relaxation, modern design, and amenities for your comfort: shower, WC, hairdryer, minibar, air conditioning, TV, internet access, and natural soaps. Located on a main street along the Mediterranean coast, our hotel provides a chic, comfortable atmosphere. We are a 13-minute walk from Alanya Archaeological Museum, a 5-minute walk from Alanya Bus Station, and 46 km from Gazipaşa-Alanya Airport. We've been welcoming guests since May 15, 2019, and look forward to your stay.

39220.description: The Hampton Inn Linden, conveniently located near Linden Airport and just five miles from Newark Liberty International Airport, offers complimentary transportation to both airports daily from 7:00 a. m. to 10:30 p. m. This hotel, a short 25-minute drive from New York City, provides guests with upscale accommodations and warm, home-like features. Relax by the fireplace in the inviting lobby, featuring a mosaic marble floor and comfortable leather seating. Enjoy nearby dining options like Applebee's and Boulder Creek Steak House, along with convenient shopping within walking distance. The hotel offers 149 well-appointed rooms, including 16 Whirlpool Suites and six King Studios, both equipped with refrigerators and microwaves. Each room provides amenities such as a coffeemaker, hairdryer, iron and ironing board, cable TV with on-demand pay-per-view movies, complimentary HBO, and video games. Guests also enjoy complimentary high-speed internet access, a spacious work desk with an ergonomic chair, and two phones with data ports, voicemail, speakers, and complimentary local calls. Start your day with the complimentary deluxe hot breakfast buffet, served daily in the atrium lobby. The 24-hour Suite Shop offers snacks, beverages, and toiletries. Maintain your fitness routine in the fitness room or take a dip in the seasonal outdoor pool. Business travelers will appreciate the complimentary business desk services, Executive Boardroom, and meeting room facilities.

39398.description: The Globales Acis & Galatea hotel is a select urban accommodation, close to the Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport , IFEMA and the Palacio de Congresos . Perfect place for your business trips. The Wanda Metropolitan Stadium is only 5 km away. It also offers free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Cozy boutique hotel in Madrid decorated according to the latest trends in interior design by Esteban Mapi and Cristina Gabás, who have combined the avant-garde of the 21st century with decorative allusions inspired by the mythological theme of Häendel Acis and Galatea's Opera.

39678.description: Casas do Côro consists of a group of charming and rustic houses located in Marialva. The houses are the ideal place for those who wish to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy all that this magical place has to offer: excellent gastronomy and wines, pristine landscapes, and peace and tranquillity. The property includes a small and beautiful chapel, in addition to an outdoor swimming pool and sundeck, where guests can unwind. There is also a sauna and a hot tub for total relaxation. All the rooms have an equipped kitchenette and a living room. Guests can wake up to a delicious breakfast buffet with fruit juices, fresh bread, as well as pre-book a fantastic four-course meal in the evening. Guests can also take advantage of free Wi-Fi and free public parking for added convenience.

39763.description: Strategically situated in Bromley, Kent, this sophisticated hotel is located a mere 16 km away from the south-east side of the centre of London. Set amidst 2 acres of landscaped gardens, this hotel offers a convenient setting from which to explore the area. Occupying the original building, which was once the family home of Lord Farnborough, this heritage hotel offers guests historical surroundings. Embracing the charm of a bygone era, the hotel enjoys refined elegance blended with contemporary amenities. The guest rooms are beautifully decorated, featuring modern amenities and soothing tones for the convenience of business and leisure travellers. The hotel offers a myriad of excellent facilities, catering to the needs of every type of guest.

39838.description: Nestled amidst a lush forest and the azure waters of Titreyengöl, the Megasaray Resort Side offers an unforgettable escape where tranquility meets recreation. Situated on a sprawling 42-acre estate in Antalya, Side, this 346-room resort provides a haven of peace and natural beauty. As part of the esteemed Megasaray Hotels group, the resort maintains the high-quality service for which the brand is known. Enjoy the pristine private sandy beach, just 250 meters away, and bask in the Mediterranean sun. The all-inclusive resort offers open buffet service for all meals, while its à la carte restaurants tantalize the taste buds with diverse menus inspired by world cuisines.

39920.description: The upscale Mercure London Heathrow Hotel, located in Hayes (Pinkwell), is within a 15-minute drive of both Windsor Castle and LEGOLAND® Windsor. It's also conveniently close to Wembley Stadium (9. 7 miles) and Hampton Court Palace (9. 8 miles). The hotel offers 184 guestrooms equipped with refrigerators, flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences are phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Guests can enjoy a workout in the fitness center or take advantage of the concierge services. The hotel also provides wedding services and has a television in the common area. Dine at Borders Restaurant and bar/lounge, or order room service (limited hours). Full breakfasts are available daily (fee applies). Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, express check-out, a conference center, and six meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

40021.description: Blending European style with vintage charm, this elegant historic hotel boasts a prime location in the heart of Manhattan. Situated across from the Museum of Modern Art, it offers easy access to iconic attractions like Carnegie Hall, Central Park, Rockefeller Center, Radio City Music Hall, Times Square, Broadway Theater District, and Grand Central Terminal. LaGuardia Airport is a mere 10 km away. Guests can enjoy delicious meals at the hotel's elegant restaurant and unwind with a relaxing drink at the pub. The hotel offers a variety of guest rooms and suites, including unique signature suites, each blending sophistication and comfort.

40299.description: The Apple Inn Hotel offers classic comfort in the heart of Amsterdam's city center. Elegant common areas and cozy rooms reflect the hotel's traditional style. Located in the cultural district, it's steps away from Vondelpark and attractions such as the Van Gogh Museum, Rijksmuseum, and the Congress Centre. Please note, there is a 5% city tax (5. 5% from January 1st, 2013) payable directly to the hotel.

40377.description: Nestled in the heart of Midtown, our hotel puts you directly on Broadway between 48th and 49th Streets at the doorstep of Times Square. Stay steps from the greatest musical theater in the world, surrounded by iconic New York landmarks, top Fortune 500 companies, and the city’s best shopping. Perfecting the art of blended travel, our hotel puts you blocks from Central Park, Rockefeller Center, and Radio City Music Hall. When you’re not exploring or heading to a meeting, unwind in spacious rooms with all the essentials, including workspaces. Host a conference or gathering in our expansive 25, 000 square feet of event space, including 28 meeting rooms, a VIP boardroom, and two ballrooms. Relax, take in the city, and leave the details to us.

40388.description: This hotel is located directly in the centre of London and offers views out over Kensington Palace. It is housed in a 19th century historic building and comprises a total of 57 rooms spread over 6 floors. Facilities available to guests include a stylish air-conditioned foyer, a charming bar, and an à la carte restaurant with highchairs for infants. The tastefully designed and spacious rooms come with an en-suite bathroom and a comfortable king-size bed. Further fittings include satellite/cable TV and individually regulated central heating. The hotel offers the use of an indoor heated swimming pool and a massage service. Sport enthusiasts may enjoy their routine workout in the gym and take advantage of the sauna.

40435.description: Typical charming hotel in Venice. The La Forcola Hotel is an establishment built in a typical Venetian style, an ideal option to enjoy the time spent in the romantic Venice. The establishment is located inside a classical building, a former palace carefully restored. It offers comfortable facilities, an elegant decoration and the most modern services. All its rooms include, among others, air conditioning, heating, TV with international channels and complete Bathrooms. A comfortable and friendly hotel, situated in the old town of the mythical Venice. Notice: American Express Cards not accepted. *3 EUR City tax per person and night, direct payment at the hotel.

40492.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features a banquet hall and a vending machine. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 18 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Ferretto Square - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Toniolo Theatre - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Porto Marghera - 1. 7 km / 1 mi- Forte Marghera - 3 km / 1. 9 mi- San Giuliano Park - 3. 5 km / 2. 2 mi- Villa Salus Hospital - 3. 9 km / 2. 5 mi- Porte di Mestre Shopping Center - 4 km / 2. 5 mi- Ospedale dell'Angelo - 4. 4 km / 2. 8 mi- Villa Foscari La Malcontenta - 8. 1 km / 5. 1 mi- Port of Venice - 9 km / 5. 6 mi- Tronchetto Waterbus Stop - 9 km / 5. 6 mi- Piazzale Roma - 9. 2 km / 5. 7 mi- Venice Marina - 9. 3 km / 5. 8 mi- Scuola Grande di San Rocco - 9. 4 km / 5. 8 mi- Grand Canal - 9. 6 km / 6 mi. The preferred airport for Hotel Paris is Marco Polo Airport (VCE) - 17. 3 km / 10. 8 miWith a stay at Hotel Paris, you'll be centrally located in Mestre, within a 10-minute drive of Piazzale Roma and Port of Venice. This hotel is 6 mi (9. 6 km) from Grand Canal and 12. 1 mi (19. 5 km) from Lido of Venice Beaches.

40495.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Hotel Trieste in Mestre, including complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. The hotel offers an on-site restaurant, a coffee shop, and a bar/lounge. Start your day with a continental breakfast (available for a fee). A 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and safe deposit boxes are also provided. Self-parking is available for a charge. Each of the 27 guestrooms features a refrigerator, a flat-screen TV with satellite programming, a private bathroom with a deep soaking bathtub and complimentary toiletries, a phone, a safe, and a desk. The hotel is a short drive from Porto Marghera (3 minutes) and the Port of Venice (9 minutes), making it an ideal base for exploring the area. Piazzale Roma and the Grand Canal are also within easy reach.

40534.description: This stylish hotel is located in the Kumkoy area of Side, just 300 meters from a beautiful sandy beach. The town center, with its numerous shops and entertainment venues, is about 3 kilometers away, and Antalya Airport is approximately 65 kilometers away. Opened in 2005, this air-conditioned hotel offers 51 rooms spread over four floors. Guests are welcomed in a spacious foyer with a range of services. Dining options include a cozy bar and a restaurant serving delicious Turkish cuisine. The tastefully decorated rooms all feature air conditioning with individual temperature controls. The outdoor complex boasts a swimming pool with an integrated children's pool and a poolside snack bar for light snacks and refreshing drinks. Weekly evening entertainment is also available.

name.content: Red Roof PLUS+ Secaucus - Meadowlands - NYC

40607.description: The Red Roof Inn Secaucus Meadowlands offers easy access to the Lincoln Tunnel and the excitement of Broadway, just minutes away. This convenient location is also near 40 outlet stores and the Meadowlands Sports Complex, home to the New York Giants and Jets. Situated on the Hackensack River, a tranquil estuary leading to the Hudson, Secaucus is a shopper's paradise known for its outlet stores. Whether you're visiting for sports or shopping, the Red Roof Inn provides comfortable accommodations, a friendly staff, and easy access to major highways including I-95, I-90, I-78, and I-80.

40999.description: This elegant and charming hotel boasts a central location in Vienna, Austria's capital city, within easy access from the main sightseeing points of interest. Thus, this is an ideal choice either when visiting Vienna for leisure or business. Guests might appreciate its good position on Mariahilfer Strasse, one of the most important streets for those who enjoy shopping. The hotel offers different room categories, all of them beautifully furnished in traditional and contemporary styles to ensure all its guests a pleasant and relaxing stay. They are also fully equipped with smart amenities and luxurious furniture. Moreover, visitors may take advantage of the two practical on-site conference rooms and the dining facilities available.

41106.address: Avenue De La Fosse Des Pressoirs, Magny Le Hongre, 40
41106.description: The Dream Castle Hotel receives its guests in an enchanting palace nestled in the heart of nature. A place where the fauna and flora will mark their spirits. The 399 rooms invite guests into a fairy tale with views of the French gardens and the Bassin des Lumières. “Le Bosquet Gourmand” welcomes customers for breakfast from 7am to 10. 30am From 6:30pm to 10:30pm, “La Rôtisserie” takes customers to the kitchen of the castle, where exquisite aromas emanate from the large rotisserie. “L'Astrolabe” bar, open from 11am to midnight, bewitches customers with its stars and constellations. A bubble of well-being is offered to customers with its spa (sauna, hammam and jacuzzi) as well as its indoor and outdoor swimming pools (according to season). The Dream Castle Hotel is served by free shuttles to Marne-la-Vallée Chessy station.

41107.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Enjoy French cuisine at Café 52, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 50 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and espresso makers. Smart televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Avenue Georges V - 0. 1 km / 0.

41234.description: Situated in the main business and shopping district of the Portuguese capital of Lisbon, this hotel combining an elegant façade with a modern interior is surrounded by some of the best and most exclusive shopping facilities. The squares of Saldanha and Praça do Marquês de Pombal are just a few steps away, the vibrant Bairro Alto area with its restaurants, bars and art galleries is easily reachable.

41250.description: Situated in the Douro region, this is the perfect spot to visit the UNESCO World Heritage Sites of the Douro Valley and the Prehistoric rock-art sites in Coa Valley. Visitors can enjoy nearby river activities, such as fishing, canoeing and windsurfing. Located in a former 17th-century convent in Freixinho, this unique and charming hotel offers traditionally decorated single and double rooms and suites with central heating and a television. The hotel's facilities include an outdoor pool, a children's playground and a restaurant offering local specialities. There is also a free parking site available.

41285.description: Centrally located in London, Roseate House London is a luxury hotel within a short walk of St. Mary's Hospital and Paddington Central. Enjoy views from the terrace and garden, and take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and discounted access to a nearby fitness center. The 47 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, ensuite bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include in-room safes, desks, and phones. The hotel offers a restaurant, bar/lounge, and room service (limited hours). Buffet breakfast is available on weekdays for a fee. Other amenities include wired internet access, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park.

41387.description: This charming hotel is superbly located overlooking the islands of St. Michele, Murano, Burano and Torcello. Famous sights of interest such as the Rialto Bridge are only a few minutes away on foot. Restaurants, bars and shops are just a short walk away. Links to the public transport network are located directly in front of the hotel. Venice's airport is around 12 km from the hotel.  The warm atmosphere and the hospitable nature of the owners ensure that the hotel is a particularly popular holiday destination. This modern hotel comprises spacious and delightfully appointed rooms. All rooms come complete with modern amenities and also feature a balcony or terrace as standard. The charming on-site restaurant is sure to impress guests with mouth-watering dishes and unique atmosphere. Afterwards they may also enjoy a refreshing drink from the bar. Parking is to be found outside the hotel.

41768.description: This hotel is located in the suburbs of Side on the Turkish Riviera. The tourist area of the resort with a wide range of entertainment venues is only 800 m away. The nearest fine sandy beach is just 150 m. away and the sea is shallow. The impressive ancient ruins of the area are also within a few minutes of the hotel. There is a stop for the public transport in the hotel's vicinity. The transfer time to Antalya airport is around 1 hour (approximately 70 km). Newly opened in 2004, this beach hotel comprises 93 accommodation units spread over 2 floors. All units are nicely furnished and come with a balcony. Leisure options include a swimming pool with a children's area designed to provide fun for the whole family. Hotel guests are also able to play darts, table tennis, chess and beach volleyball, whilst a range of water sports are available on the beach. The hotel also provides an ideal point for hiking, cycling and horseback riding.

41852.description:
Perfectly positioned where Venice begins, Hotel Santa Chiara stands as the city's most strategically located property — right on Piazzale Roma, the only car-accessible point in the historic centre, and just steps from Santa Lucia Train Station, the ferry terminals, and the airport coach stop. 

What truly sets this hotel apart is a combination of advantages found nowhere else in Venice: it is the only hotel in the city with its own private parking — an extraordinary convenience for self-drive travellers and groups arriving by train. No bridges, no narrow calli with luggage. Just a seamless, stress-free arrival straight to the heart of La Serenissima. 

Every guest room offers a view worth waking up for — choose from Grand Canal panoramas, charming small canal vistas, or elegant city views — all in rooms thoughtfully designed in classic Venetian style with modern comforts including soundproofing, air conditioning, and premium facilities. 
Breakfast at Hotel Santa Chiara is an experience in itself: served with direct views over the Grand Canal, it transforms the most important meal of the day into an iconic Venetian moment. 

San Marco Square is reachable on foot or by a short vaporetto ride — with the water bus stop virtually at the hotel's entrance.

41911.description: This pleasant country house lies within a 15-minute walk of the centre of Mittenwalde. In the immediate vicinity (around 2 km away) are countless shops and restaurants. The bus station is approximately 1. 5 km away and the train station is 4 km from the hotel. The tourist centre may be reached in about 45 minutes by car and the airport is roughly 12 km away. This hotel comprises 12 rooms, including 1 suite. Guests are invited into the foyer with a cloakroom and safes. Culinary options include a snug café and a restaurant. Furthermore, there is a newspaper stand, an Internet terminal (charges apply) to be used within the hotel as well as a bicycle storage room with a bicycle hire service. Business guests may take advantage of the conference facilities. Younger guests can let off steam in the playground and room and laundry services are on offer to all. Those arriving by car may make use of the hotel's parking spaces or garage. The stylish rooms all come with an en suite bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Further fittings include a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a double bed, central heating and a balcony or terrace. A minibar is also available in the hallway. The well-kept outdoor complex features sun loungers and parasols. Leisure options include a massage service, table tennis, basketball and volleyball. Riding stables are to be found within 500 m of the hotel, it is 5 km to tennis courts and 9 km to the nearest golf course. Guests are offered breakfast in the mornings. Lunch and dinner may be taken à la carte; the evening meal may alternatively be chosen from a set menu.

42133.description: The General Hotel is a chic boutique hotel in Paris, offering edgy, modern accommodations ideal for young, fashionable travelers. Located near Canal St. Martin, Place de la République, and Place de la Bastille, it provides easy access to public transport for exploring the city's sights. Designer rooms feature amenities like air conditioning, Wi-Fi, iPod docks, and coffee makers. After a day of sightseeing, guests can unwind at the bar or in the well-equipped fitness center with a sauna. Please note that the local city tax is not included in the room rate and will be charged directly by the hotel upon check-in/check-out.

42210.description: Enjoy breathtaking views from the rooftop terrace at Nicola Hotel in Athens' vibrant Kypseli district. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, and stay connected with free Wi-Fi. Unwind at the bar/lounge or enjoy 24-hour room service. The hotel offers 29 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, private balconies, and ensuite bathrooms. A business center, express check-in/out, and tour/ticket assistance add to your convenience. Nearby attractions include the National Archaeological Museum and Syntagma Square, both within a 5-minute drive.

42330.description: Breakfast + unlimited WIFI included in all rates at the ibis Styles Paris Tolbiac Bibliothèque de France. Ideally located on the Left Bank, just a short walk from the Seine, the Bibliothèque Nationale (French National Library) and the Accorhotels Arena (formerly the Bercy Arena), our hotel is around 110 yds (100 m) from the Bibliothèque metro station (line 14) and RER line C, providing direct access to the Eiffel Tower, department stores, the Louvre and d'Orsay museums, the Notre Dame, and Orly airport.

42759.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include a picnic area and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to noon. Featured amenities include luggage storage and a safe deposit box at the front desk. This hotel has 2 meeting rooms available for events. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 16 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Glencorse Golf Club - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Penicuik Tower - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Pentland Hills Regional Park - 6. 3 km / 3. 9 mi- Rosslyn Chapel - 6. 6 km / 4. 1 mi- Hillend Country Park - 7. 3 km / 4. 6 mi- Napier University - 12. 8 km / 8 mi- Craigmillar Castle - 13. 7 km / 8. 5 mi- King's Theatre - 14. 4 km / 9 mi- Edinburgh Corn Exchange - 14. 5 km / 9 mi- FountainPark - 14. 6 km / 9. 1 mi- Dalhousie Castle - 14. 6 km / 9. 1 mi- John McIntyre Conference Centre - 15 km / 9. 3 mi- Holyrood Park - 15. 1 km / 9. 4 mi- Edinburgh International Conference Centre - 15. 3 km / 9. 5 mi- Festival Theatre - 15. 3 km / 9. 5 mi. The nearest major airport is Edinburgh Airport (EDI) - 23. 1 km / 14. 4 mi Located in Penicuik, The Craigie is within a 5-minute drive of Glencorse Golf Club and Penicuik Tower. This hotel is 3. 9 mi (6. 3 km) from Pentland Hills Regional Park and 9. 6 mi (15. 4 km) from Grassmarket.

42933.description: This 4 star superior hotel is located in the city centre of Geneva and was established in 1860. Renovated in 2024 in a beautiful Art-Deco style, it is close to the Geneva Lake and the nearest station is Cornavin. The Hotel has an award-winning restaurant, a piano-bar and a spa with fitness. All 110 rooms are equipped with minibar, safe, ironing set and air conditioning.

42944.description: Centrally located in New York, The Shelburne Sonesta New York is within a 10-minute walk of Grand Central Terminal and the Empire State Building. This hotel offers 325 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a flat-screen TV and cable programming. Stay connected with Wi-Fi (surcharge) and enjoy the convenience of in-room safes and desks. Bathrooms include showers and complimentary toiletries. Guests can take advantage of the on-site health club and concierge services. The Shelburne Sonesta also features Take Care Restaurant, serving American cuisine for lunch, dinner, and brunch, with room service available during limited hours. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are offered daily (for a fee). Additional amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Event space is available, totaling 1275 square feet.

42961.description: The Bass Hotel, a brand-new establishment in the heart of Montmartre, boasts a striking retro look inspired by the renowned American graphic designer, Saul Bass. The Scandinavian design features contemporary furnishings complemented by industrial materials such as steel and stone beams, a nod to the hotel's Parisian setting. Geometric headboards and graphic tiles further enhance the unique aesthetic. Each room offers a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a courtesy tray, and high-quality bedding. The dedicated team at the Bass Hotel is committed to providing guests with a memorable Montmartre experience.

43105.description: This elegant contemporary style hotel is excellently located in the eastern part of Midtown Manhattan, just a few steps from Grand Central Terminal, Chrysler Building and United Nations Headquarters. The restaurants of Park Avenue and the shops and boutiques of 5th Avenue, Rockefeller Center, Times Square and the Broadway Theater District can be reached within a short stroll.

43106.description: The Soho Grand Hotel sits in the heart of downtown's most vibrant and luxurious district, a crossroads of fashion, culture, and nightlife. The hotel offers luxury guest rooms and lavish penthouse lofts, renowned as glamorous venues for celebrity gatherings. Designed as an homage to historic Soho, the industrial-chic architecture and original artwork create a unique setting for creative professionals and weekend revelers alike. The lobby, a soaring salon overlooking West Broadway, features a classic bottle-glass staircase and enormous brick columns. The Grand Bar and Lounge and The Gallery offer a variety of ambiances to suit any mood.

43107.description: The Roxy Hotel Tribeca, steeped in New York history, has evolved from a 1920s movie theater to a legendary 90s dance club and now, a vibrant hub for music, film, and art. Partnering with local icons like Paul Sevigny (Paul's Cocktail Lounge), Maxwell Britten (The Django), Jack's Stir Brew Coffee, and Blackstones Hairdressing, The Roxy energizes the downtown Manhattan experience. Located between SoHo and TriBeCa, amidst cobblestone streets, cast-iron buildings, exclusive boutiques, and renowned restaurants and galleries, the hotel's unique triangular shape features a soaring eight-story atrium. The expansive Roxy Bar and Lounge offers a comfortable setting to relax, work, or enjoy cocktails and live music.

43130.description: Located in Geneva's historic business and banking district, the Tiffany Hotel offers a charming boutique experience within a tastefully restored Art Nouveau building dating back to 1900. Just a short walk from shopping, the lake shore park, and the Grand Theatre, this hotel is also conveniently close to art galleries, multinational companies, and major transport links. Combining elegance and comfort, the Tiffany Hotel provides a warm welcome to business travelers, art enthusiasts, and anyone seeking a refined stay in Geneva.

43136.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at the Abacus Tierpark Hotel Berlin, including complimentary Wi-Fi, a hair salon, and tour/ticket assistance. This hotel also features a banquet hall and a vending machine. Start your day with a buffet breakfast, available daily for a fee. Business travelers will appreciate the business center, 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. The hotel offers 8396 square feet (780 square meters) of event space, ideal for conferences and meetings. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Relax in one of the 278 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions with satellite programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Safes and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is available on request. Located in Berlin's Lichtenberg district, the hotel is within a 15-minute drive of Alexanderplatz and the East Side Gallery, and conveniently close to Tierpark Berlin.

43302.description: This beautiful hotel is located 50-minute ride away from the Alanya airport and 15-minute car ride away from the city centre of Alanya, Turkey, where travellers may find tourist attractions such as the Castle or the Red Tower as well as several restaurants, cafes and bars perfect to spend a lovely evening tasting new flavours. The outdoor swimming pool will be every guest's favourite spot since they can relax and enjoy the sun while sunbathing or having a refreshing swim. They can also go to the restaurant and have a delicious local meal or visit the bar to have tasty drinks. Business travellers will be happy to hear that there are well-equipped venues to host private events, meetings or conferences. The rooms with cosy beds and with all the essential amenities are decorated with a combination of bright and warm colours, to make travellers feel comfortable and have an unforgettable experience.

name.content: Limak Lara De Luxe Hotel & Resort

43303.description: This club resort is situated approximately 8 km from the centre of Lara and is close to the sea and a private beach on Turkey's Mediterranean coast. Antalya is 25 km from the club resort and Antalya Airport is around 13 km away. The hotel consists of 448 rooms. Each room features an en-suite bathroom. Accommodation units also feature an electronic keylock system, as well as a fire alarm and centrally regulated air-conditioning. Guests may take advantage of the Internet access in the lobby. There are many leisure activities offered to guests, such as squash, tennis, table tennis, billiards, basketball, volleyball, beach volleyball, bowling, minigolf, aerobics, canoeing and pedal boating. Other water sports include waterskiing, jet skiing, diving, surfing, windsurfing, motor boating, banana boating and sailing. The hotel also organises an entertainment programme for adults and children.

43304.description:
Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 4 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional amenities at this Mediterranean property include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Grab a bite at Pasha, one of the property's 6 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges.

Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff.

43315.description: This conference hotel is situated near to the Idroscalo (an artificial lake well known for its international boat competitions). A trade fair, an opening night in a theatre, a meeting and ritzy shopping sprees - in Milan the paths of culture, entertainment and business always cross. It is a city to enjoy and observe by lifting one's gaze above the bustling city to admire the different architectural styles of the buildings that have succeeded one another over the centuries. It is also the ideal point of departure for all types of trips, because it is less than 2 hours away from the sea of Genoa and the mountains of Cervinia. The hotel is around 24 km from the centre of Milan where guests will find a wide range of restaurants, shops, bars, pubs and clubs. Milan central railway station is 5 km from the hotel, which is near to many of Milan most important places of interest, such as Duomo Cathedral (12 km), the Scala Theatre (10 km) and Rho Fair (27 km). Malpensa Airport is approximately 2 km from the hotel and Milan-Linate Airport is around 7 km away. This is a modern hotel with air-conditioned rooms, located in the green countryside. All guests with a personal laptop can connect to Internet from their room free of charge and wifi Internet access is available in the lobby and meeting rooms, 24 hours a day. The hotel is also equipped with 6 meeting rooms. The air-conditioned conference hotel has 142 rooms in total an offers guests use of a lobby, café, bar and restaurant.

43316.description: The hotel is located near the Autostrada dei Fiori highway and quickly linked by shuttle bus to the subway which takes guests right to the city centre. A trade fair, an opening night in a theatre, a meeting and ritzy shopping sprees - in Milan the paths of culture, entertainment and business always cross. It is a city to enjoy and observe by lifting one's gaze above the bustling city to admire the different architectural styles of the buildings that have succeeded one another over the centuries. It is also the ideal point of departure for all types of trips, because it is less than 2 hours away from the sea of Genoa and the mountains of Cervinia. Famagosta underground station (green line) is approximately 5 km from the hotel, while Milan railway station is around 15 km away. The hotel is around 15 km from the centre of Milan where guests will find a wide range of shops, bars, pubs and clubs. The hotel is near to Milan's main places of interest, including Duomo Square (12. 5 km), Milano Fiori Congress Centre (3 km) and Monza F1 Racing Circuit (47 km). Linate International Airport is approximately 24 km from the hotel, while Malpensa Airport is around 24 km away. This is a modern hotel with 203 air-conditioned rooms on 11 floors and free parking. All guests with a personal laptop can connect to the Internet from their room free of charge, 24 hours a day. Wireless Internet access is also available. The hotel is also equipped with 16 meeting rooms and it operates a regular, daily shuttle service to and from Malpensa Airport. Also offered is a free shuttle service to/from the exhibition area (Rho) during the main expositions. The air-conditioned hotel also has a lobby, children's playground, bar and restaurant. Each of the rooms features an en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub and hairdryer, as well as a TV, Internet access, minibar and individually regulated air conditioning. The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool (open from June to September) and a gym.

43577.description: High-end hotel near Milan Linate airport, with a congress centre and fast city connections. Completely refurbished in 2020. Set in a commercial area just off the A1 motorway, Crowne Plaza® Milan - Linate hotel is 15 minutes' drive from Milan Linate Airport. Rogoredo high-speed train and subway station is five minutes away by car, for fast subway links to central Milan shopping, the Piazza del Duomo and soaring Gothic Milan Cathedral. We're within walking distance of major companies including Eni, BMW and Sky TV, and our conference rooms can host events for up to 1, 500 delegates. We offer the ExpoPlaza Conference &Exhibition Centre and 14 meeting rooms, many with natural daylight, and our Crowne Plaza Meetings Director takes care of all the details. At our hotel you can enjoy; a breakfast buffet, free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, ample on-site parking and a business centre. Retreat to warmly decorated rooms with indulgent soft beds, thanks to our Sleep Advantage® Programme's premium bedding. Generous suites add work areas and living rooms to create a home away from home. Dining options include Il Buongustaio buffet restaurant and Il Giardino, where you can relax while having drinks and enjoying live music. Start your morning with a gym workout, or wind down at day's end in our sauna.

43765.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as a fitness center and complimentary wireless internet access. Savor local and international cuisine at Caramela, a restaurant with a bar/lounge, or take advantage of room service (during limited hours). The hotel also offers complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Each of the 54 guestrooms features a minibar, an espresso maker, a flat-screen television with satellite programming, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combination, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. Conveniences include complimentary wired and wireless internet, a laptop-compatible safe, a phone and a desk. La Perle-du-Lac Park is located approximately 0. 2 kilometers from the hotel.

43995.description: The 198 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Travelodge Park Royal does not offer 24-hour reception. Travelodge Park Royal may charge a fee for some services.

name.content: Spark by Hilton Vienna Messe Prater

44050.description: We’re located near public transportation, Prater Amusement Park, and Prater Recreational Area. Shopping at Wien Mitte The Mall and Ernst Happel Stadium are three kilometers away. Vienna International Airport and Peruvian Penguins are within 40 minutes. Enjoy our 24-hour fitness center, on-site dining, and our pet-friendly rooms.

44054.description: Centrally located in Amsterdam, BackStage Hotel is a 4-minute walk from Leidseplein and 10 minutes from the Rijksmuseum. This hotel offers 22 guestrooms equipped with iPod docking stations, LCD TVs with cable, and safes. Daily housekeeping is provided, and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. Enjoy amenities such as an arcade/game room, a communal TV area, and tour/ticket assistance. A continental breakfast is available for a fee, and you can grab a bite at the coffee shop/cafe or snack bar. Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel also offers express check-out, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Nearby attractions include the Melkweg, Amsterdam American Hotel, Holland Casino, Keizersgracht, Paradiso, The 9 Streets, Vondelpark, and more. The preferred airport is Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS).

44200.description: This hotel boasts a prime situation just a 20-minute drive from Berlin-Schonefeld International Airport, offering the ideal accommodation for nature lovers who wish to enjoy fresh air. Around 48, 000 m2 woodland and stunning parks surround this cosy hotel on the Banks of Großer Müggelsee, creating a haven of peace where to leave the daily stress from the city behind. The spacious and bright accommodation units have been designed with guests' comfort in mind. Most of them feature their own private balcony offering magnificent views over the surrounding greenery. The luxurious suites provide plenty of space and a separate living room ideal for added privacy. The restaurant includes a beautiful lakeside terrace, and corporate travellers will find 20 flexible conference rooms perfect for closed meetings and team building activities. A sauna and massage services are also available for guests to relax and recharge their batteries.

44347.description: Located on the idyllic island of Holbox, off the northern coast of Cancun, CasaSandra is less than 100 meters from the turquoise waters of the Caribbean Sea. The hotel is accessible by ferry, private boat, or small plane, with Cancun Airport less than 50 miles away. Built in 2000 by artist and owner Sandra Perez Lozano, CasaSandra initially served as her home before opening to guests in 2003. The hotel offers 18 unique rooms and suites, as well as a villa, each styled with elegant, rustic luxury.

44644.description: This hotel is situated only 50 m from various motorways, meaning guests are able to reach Venice (7 kms away), Treviso (30 km) and Padova (25 km) quickly. The closest bus station is within 100 m of the hotel. The casino and the golf club are 5 km away. The centre with multiple shops and entertainment options as well as the international Marco Polo airport are 7 kms from the hotel. Mestre train station is 800 m away. This 2-storey family hotel underwent renovations in 2004 and comprises a total of 21 rooms. Facilities on offer include a foyer with a reception desk and a hotel safe. There is also a cafe and a breakfast room. The rooms feature a bathroom with hairdryer, shower, a direct dial telephone, a TV, an Internet connection, a minibar, air-conditioning (individually regulated) and a hire safe. Guests are able to select their breakfast from a buffet.

44750.description: Holiday Inn® Brussels Schuman hotel, set on a quiet road, is a two-minute walk from Schuman metro station and brings you to the city centre within 15 minutes. Brussels-Schuman train station is a seven-minute walk away and offers a direct train connection to Brussels Airport every 30 minutes. To do so, take the IC2510 train to Namur & Dinant and get off at Brussels-Schuman station. In 15 minutes by car, you are at Brussels-Midi train station for all international train connections. The hotel offers parking for a daily fee. Do you do a lot of video calls? Stay connected with free Wi-Fi available throughout the hotel. You can walk to the European Parliament, the European Commission headquarters and the Albert Borschette Congress Center in five to 10 minutes. The beautiful Cinquantenaire Park, houses several museums, including Autoworld. At Place Jourdan, you'll find a kiosk with Belgian fries, one of the best in the city. Four metro stops away, in the city center, you can admire the surrealist artworks of the Magritte Museum. The comfortable rooms offer a pillow menu for a good night's sleep, and Kids Stay and Eat Free. Wake up to an American breakfast buffet with Belgian waffles and enjoy a snack from the international menu in the hotel's brasserie, Bar Del Mundo. End the day with a Belgian beer in our open lobby. We have a Green Key certificate for a greener environment.

44806.description: A welcoming Essex hotel with an open lobby, conference centre and lakeside garden Holiday Inn® Basildon hotel is a 10-minute drive from the M25 and close to Basildon station. If you’re visiting the City of London or the Docklands on business, direct trains to Fenchurch Street station take only 35 minutes. You can host meetings, conferences or a wedding at the hotel's Conference Centre, which has space for up to 300 guests in its largest function space and optional catering. Local companies at Southfields Business Park are within a short drive of the hotel. The surrounding Festival Leisure Park offers dining and entertainment options, including a cinema, nightclubs and a bowling alley. The whole family can enjoy a trip to the Aqua Park located on the lake directly next door. At this hotel, you can enjoy a: full English breakfast, lunch and dinner served daily, room service available around the clock, comfortable rooms with a pillow menu to help you get a good night's sleep. The satellite TV and free WiFi will keep everyone entertained. In summer, you can stretch your legs, enjoy a drink from the bar or host a party in the pretty lakeside garden.

name.content: Crowne Plaza Venice East Quarto D'altino

44996.description: When you stay at Crowne Plaza Venice East, an IHG Hotel in Quarto d'Altino, you'll be near the airport and 13 minutes by foot from Sile River Regional Nature Park. This upscale hotel is 15. 8 mi (25. 4 km) from Piazzale Roma and 17 mi (27. 4 km) from Port of Venice. Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Make yourself at home in one of the 153 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature designer toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Enjoy international cuisine at Il Campiello, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary (available on request). Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

44997.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at Hotel Altieri, conveniently located in Mestre's Favaro Veneto district. The hotel offers 26 guestrooms equipped with LCD TVs, safes, and desks, each with a private bathroom featuring a bathtub or shower and hairdryer. Make the most of the 24-hour room service and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, a safe deposit box, and free self-parking. You'll be within a 15-minute drive of the Port of Venice and Piazzale Roma, with Porto Marghera 4. 2 miles and the Grand Canal 6. 8 miles away. Marco Polo Airport (VCE) is the preferred airport for Hotel Altieri.

45252.description: Enjoy garden views and amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi at Hotel Adler, situated in Milan's Città Studi district, a short walk from Corso Buenos Aires and a quick drive from Via Montenapoleone Fashion District. A buffet breakfast is served daily (fee applies). The hotel offers 23 guestrooms with private bathrooms, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Nearby attractions include Piazzale Loreto, Piazza Lima, and the Politecnico di Milano. Linate Airport is the closest airport.

name.content: Best Western Welwyn Garden City Homestead Court

45263.description: The Best Western Welwyn Garden City Homestead Court Hotel offers rooms with a view, just one mile outside the city center. Enjoy peace and tranquility as you wander through the hotel's landscaped gardens or relax on the patio. Excellent road and rail links provide easy access to London's attractions. Whether you prefer exploring local sights like Roman baths and historic houses or engaging in activities such as fishing and birdwatching, there's something for everyone. The hotel can accommodate weddings, meetings, and events, and guests can enjoy garden views from the suites. Spacious, stylish furnishings and well-designed bedrooms with modern amenities create a comfortable atmosphere. Bedrooms with kitchen facilities are also available. Guests enjoy complimentary access to the local Gosling Sports Park (pre-booking is recommended).

45366.description: Stay in the heart of AmsterdamInterContinental Amstel Amsterdam is a five-star hotel, characterized by a rich history of genuine hospitality and exceptional luxury. To this day, the landmark hotel still offers an international home to many guests. Enter via the famous staircase, where many greats preceded you. The Amstel Hotel is ideally located in the heart of Amsterdam and offers a beautiful view over the Amstel river. The 79 rooms and suites are among the largest in Amsterdam. Tastefully decorated, the rooms and suites of the Amstel Hotel offer a panoramic view of the city and the river. In addition to the spacious standard rooms, the Amstel Hotel offers unique Signature Suites. The Health & Fitness Club consists of a large indoor pool at equal height as the Amstel river, a whirlpool, steam bath, various saunas and a fitness centre with personal trainers. As a 'real Amsterdammer', the Amstel Restaurant proudly serves an international choice of food and drinks, but with a Dutch twist. With a focus on fresh and seasonal products, we have found the best ingredients. Wherever possible, local suppliers have been chosen. You can also enjoy the famous Amstel Afternoon Tea, which is served in the Lounge as well as in the magical Mirror room. The hotel is a 5-minute walk from the Royal Theater Carré, close to the Van Gogh Museum and a 10-minute tram ride from Dam Square and the Royal Palace. You can travel to Schiphol Airport, 20 km away, either by taxi or 15 minutes by train.

45608.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including wireless internet access (surcharge) and wedding services. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk. Stay in one of 168 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with Egyptian cotton sheets. Wireless internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Bryant Park - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- 5th Avenue - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Broadway - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Times Square - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Diamond District - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- New York Public Library - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Rockefeller Center - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Radio City Music Hall - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Top of the Rock Observation Deck - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Grand Central Terminal - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- St. Patrick's Cathedral - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Chrysler Building - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Herald Square - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Macy's - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Museum of Modern Art - 1 km / 0. 6 mi. The nearest airports are: LaGuardia Airport (LGA) - 14. 6 km / 9. 1 mi Teterboro, NJ (TEB) - 19. 9 km / 12. 3 mi Newark Liberty Intl. Airport (EWR) - 28. 2 km / 17. 5 mi John F. Kennedy Intl. Airport (JFK) - 27. 8 km / 17. 3 mi Linden, NJ (LDJ) - 37. 6 km / 23. 4 mi The preferred airport for Royalton New York is John F. Kennedy Intl. Airport (JFK). Royalton New York is centrally located in New York, a 4-minute walk from Bryant Park and 5 minutes by foot from Broadway. This boutique hotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from New York Public Library and 0. 5 mi (0. 9 km) from Times Square.

45870.description: Located in New York City's vibrant Meatpacking District, the Hotel Gansevoort offers a sophisticated, minimalist retreat designed by architect Andi Pepper and his wife. The 186-room, 14-floor hotel features a rich, contemporary style with lavish leather and fabric accents. Its signature rooftop boasts a landscaped garden, a spacious loft with 20-foot ceilings and stunning city views, and a 45-foot heated outdoor pool with underwater music. This stylish venue is perfect for special events. The hotel completed a full renovation in 2020, updating both accommodations and public spaces. Check-in is at 3:00 PM, and check-out is at 12:00 PM. Early check-in and late check-out are based on availability. Luggage storage is available, and guests can access hotel facilities while waiting for their rooms.

46059.description: Located in the centre of the colourful city of Barcelona, this hotel is set directly beside one of the main roads. Links to the public transport network are found near the establishment and offer easy access to all areas of the city. Numerous shopping and entertainment venues, as well as bars and restaurants, are within 500 m of the property and the beach is just 2 km away. Housed in a former hospital dating from the past century, the building has been converted into a hotel featuring the Art Nouveau / Art Déco styles. It comprises a total of 77 rooms, several of which are split-level, and some come with terraces and semi-private swimming pools. The accommodations shine through their stylish design and offer the highest comforts. They all come with satellite/ cable TV and Internet access as standard.

46216.description:
This hotel lies in a peaceful location in Famalicao, one of the most beautiful regions in Portugal. Famalicao is in the   Vinho Verde   area and well known for being the home of some of the finest cuisine in the country. The centre of the town is roughly 500 m from the hotel and offers visitors various numerous shopping and cultural venues. Porto airport lies around 30 km away.

The comfortable hotel comprises a total of 56 rooms, of which one is a suite.
