Facilities on offer include a spacious foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, lifts, a safe as well as a separate TV lounge. Dining options include a cosy bar and a pleasing restaurant. Conferences and events are catered for in the hotel's own auditorium, and guests may also make use of the laundry service and the public Internet connection. Medical assistance is available on request, and parking spaces are also on offer for those arriving by car.

The tasteful rooms all come with an en suite bathroom, a direct dial telephone, a radio, a hire safe, air conditioning, and a TV.

46596.description: Conveniently located in Side, this property is the perfect base for both business and holiday travel. Only 300 metres away from the beach, guests are sure to enjoy a stunning view at this hotel. For those who enjoy exploring the surroundings, an entertainment area is only 4 km away and Antalya Airport lies around 60 km away. All the rooms provide comfort to guests, being fully equipped with LCD TV, private bathroom, air-conditioning, a hair dryer and a balcony or French window. Guests will be spoiled with the wide range of activities being offered by this hotel, which includes but is not exhaustive, banana boating, jet skiing and aerobics. They will also be treated to a sumptuous breakfast buffet which the hotel's in-house restaurant serves up. Guests can take the benefits of spa and fitness centre for relaxation.

46622.description: This enchanting hotel boasts a prime situation in the heart of London, just a few metres from Hyde Park and the famous Oxford Street. Theaterland, countless galleries and museums and many local points of interest are all situated in the near vicinity, as are a range of shops, restaurants, and bars. The nearest public transport stop is around 300 m from the hotel. The rooms are tastefully decorated in soothing colours and include charming wooden furniture that creates a homely atmosphere in which to completely unwind. A café and a bar are among the hotel's culinary options, and there is a public Internet terminal available for guests' use. Breakfast is served every day in the dining room. The onsite services include Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, ideal for those staying for business purposes or guests wishing to stay in touch with the family or friends.

46779.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and tour/ticket assistance. Getting to the surf and sand is a breeze with the beach shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. This hotel has 2 meeting rooms available for events. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 25 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms feature shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers.

name.content: Best Western Glasgow Livingston Hilcroft Hotel

46858.description: The family-run Best Western Glasgow Livingston Hilcroft Hotel is ideally situated between Glasgow and Edinburgh, just one mile from junction 4 on the M8. This convenient location provides easy access to various attractions, including shopping centers, museums, art galleries, and picturesque countryside. The hotel features a contemporary bar and restaurant, offering a welcoming atmosphere after a day exploring. Guests can also look forward to well-appointed, modern bedrooms for a comfortable night's sleep. The hotel is a memorable venue for weddings and other events.

47354.description: Nestled in the upscale Itaim Bibi district, the Radisson Blu Sao Paulo provides a sought-after location within easy reach of renowned eateries, world-class shopping, and major corporations like Google. When you find a break in your busy schedule, you can browse the designer stores at Iguatemi and Shopping Cidade Jardim, both less than 10 minutes away, or enjoy a leisurely stroll through Povo Park. No visit to the area is complete without a trip to Paulista Avenue, the economic heart of Sao Paulo home to impressive skyscrapers and a buzzing nightlife scene. After a full day of client meetings or shopping, head to our 18th-floor solarium, where you can take in panoramic views of the metropolis while unwinding in the sauna, fitness center, or an indoor pool. Afterward, join us on the terrace at D. O. K, our on-site restaurant, to watch the bustle of Cidade Jardim Avenue while enjoying an exceptional meal. If you are planning a corporate event, consider our state-of-the-art meeting facilities for up to 200 guests. We also offer a convenience store and a full business center. Each of our 197 stylish rooms and suites is an urban oasis featuring a balcony, turndown service, and complimentary coffee facilities.

47356.description: This charming business hotel lies just 500 metres away from the centre of Sao Paulo. The hotel is situated close to Praca de Republica, as well as a wide range of intriguing attractions. The hotel is situated close to the business areas of the city, as well as a wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment venues. The hotel greets visitors with exemplary service, and the promise of a stay rich in comfort and convenience. Tastefully-designed guest rooms ooze elegance and style, offering functional space and modern amenities. The hotel features a well-equipped conference room, for the convenience of those travelling for work purposes. The hotel also features an indoor pool and a fully-equipped gym.

47358.description: The Quality Jardins boasts a prime location next to the Trianon-Masp subway station, just one block from Paulista Avenue, a hub for finance, culture, and leisure. Explore nearby shopping malls, theaters, art exhibitions, cinemas, restaurants, and parks, all within easy reach. Congonhas Airport is only 8 km away. The hotel offers a complete experience with recently renovated, non-smoking apartments featuring wood floors, designed for your comfort and convenience. Enjoy the recreation area, including a swimming pool, sauna, fitness center, spa, and a lobby bar with live piano music. We emphasize that the contracted daily rate is for 24 hours, with check-in from 2 p. m. and check-out until 12 p. m. The interval of up to 3 hours between guests' departure and arrival is provided for in MTur Ordinance No. 28 and is intended exclusively for cleaning, sanitizing, and tidying up the unit, ensuring the maintenance of our standard of excellence.

47359.description: This business hotel is set in the exclusive Jardins district, close to the shopping and culture centre of São Paulo and in the vicinity of the business and finance centre of the city. The fully air-conditioned hotel comprises a total of 190 suites. The lobby includes a 24-hour reception desk. Dining options can be found in the hotel restaurant. Those arriving by car may take advantage of the car park. All of the accommodation units come with an en-suite bathroom, a direct dial telephone with voicemail, satellite/cable TV, and a hire safe. Internet access is also included in the rooms and air-conditioning is centrally regulated. The hotel offers use of a sauna, a sun terrace and a swimming pool. Guests may also wish to use the fully equipped gym.

47363.description: This business hotel sits on Avenida Faria Lima, in Sao Paulo. Sitting amidst one of the most prominent financial and commercial centres in the city, this hotel is the ideal option for discerning business and leisure travellers. The hotel lies just a short distance away from the Pinheiros expressway, offering the utmost in convenience. This wonderful hotel is within easy access of the Jockey Club and Sao Paulo University. The hotel offers comfortable, tastefully-designed guest rooms. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that this wonderful hotel has to offer. Guests can enjoy wonderful dining in the restaurant, where international and regional dishes are sure to impress. Parking with a daily rate of R$ 35. 00 + ISS per car. We emphasize that the contracted daily rate is for 24 hours, with check-in from 2 p. m. and check-out until 12 p. m. The interval of up to 3 hours between guests' departure and arrival is provided for in MTur Ordinance No. 28 and is intended exclusively for cleaning, sanitizing, and tidying up the unit, ensuring the maintenance of our standard of excellence

47365.description: The Transamerica Executive Nova Paulista, conveniently located near the Sao Paulo State Symphony Orchestra and with easy access to convention centers and Avenida Paulista, offers value accommodations for your visit. Enjoy complimentary breakfast and wireless internet access, along with amenities such as a restaurant, fitness center, and swimming pool. Spacious, well-equipped rooms provide everything you need for a comfortable stay. Please note, there is a resort fee payable directly to the hotel, and extra beds are subject to availability and require advance request. The restaurant serves delicious pizzas for dinner from Tuesday to Friday. A new tourism fee of BRL 4. 65 applies, and parking is BRL 30. 00 per day/vehicle. Dinner card payments are not accepted. In accordance with Federal Law No. 8. 069, children under 18 must be accompanied by parents or a legal guardian. Guardians must present notarized written authorization from the parents at check-in. All children under 18, even those accompanied by parents, must present photo identification at check-in.

47366.description: The well-being of guests is top of mind at Choice-branded hotels. Guests may experience a variety of new, improved cleanliness protocols and products. The Quality Suites Vila Olimpia is located near Berrini Avenue and Faria Lima Avenue. The neighborhood of Vila Olimpia is famous for a variety of restaurants, bars and shopping malls. This hotel is near some of the most exciting local attractions, including Ibirapuera Park, MAM, Oca, and Ibirapuera Auditorium, where we have many music concerts. Guests of this hotel are invited to enjoy amenities like free breakfast, free WiFi, free coffee, exercise room and sauna. Business travelers will appreciate conveniences like a business center and a public computer with Internet. Guest rooms come with refrigerators, air conditioning, desks, balconies, hair dryers and TVs.

47367.description: Welcome to Roomo Transamerica SP Bela Cintra! We are located in a residential condominium with complete infrastructure and access to an amazing leisure area, which includes a heated pool, wet and dry saunas, gym, outdoor area, pay-per-use laundry, pet space, multi-sport court, 24-hour convenience store, and paid parking. Everything is designed to provide maximum convenience and quality during your stay. Our apartments are equipped with a kitchen and an amazing balcony to relax and enjoy the surroundings, making them ideal for both short and long stays. Perfect for those traveling for business or leisure, they offer all the comfort and practicality you need. Located in the Consolação neighborhood, close to Avenida Paulista. Get an early check-in for a quicker and more convenient arrival! Contact us via WhatsApp for support and inquiries.

47368.description: Located in São Paulo's exclusive Jardim Europa district, this city hotel offers convenient access to shopping and entertainment. Just 7 km from Congonhas Airport and a 30-minute drive from Guarulhos Airport, the hotel features 76 rooms with modern amenities, including en suite bathrooms and centrally regulated air conditioning. Guests can enjoy a restaurant, bar, complimentary internet access, and parking (R$ 35. 00 + ISS per car per day). Leisure facilities include a small indoor pool and a well-equipped gym. A daily breakfast is provided, while lunch and dinner are available à la carte or from a set menu. Reservations for up to 9 rooms can be made through this system. For larger groups (10+ rooms), different terms and conditions apply. We emphasize that the contracted daily rate is for 24 hours, with check-in from 2 p. m. and check-out until 12 p. m. The interval of up to 3 hours between guests' departure and arrival is provided for in MTur Ordinance No. 28 and is intended exclusively for cleaning, sanitizing, and tidying up the unit, ensuring the maintenance of our standard of excellence

47369.description:
Nestled in the vibrant Jardins district, home to São Paulo's finest restaurants and shops, this Choice Hotel offers a superior experience. Steps from Paulista Avenue and near major corporations like Siemens and H. Stern, with convenient access to the subway, it's ideal for business and leisure travelers. Enjoy city views from the outdoor terrace pool, unwind with a cocktail at the hotel bar, or savor a casual meal in the lobby restaurant. Well-equipped suites feature intelligent work desks and internet access, complemented by two conference rooms. Families will appreciate the home-away-from-home atmosphere and range of services. Unwind in the solarium and sauna, stay active in the fitness center, or enjoy a coffee and newspaper in the lobby. Multilingual staff are available to assist with your travel and business needs. 

Children up to 7 years old sleep free of charge in the same bed as their parents. If you wish to add an additional bed, the cost is R$84. 00 per night, subject to availability. You must call the hotel to confirm availability.

name.content: Campanile Marne La Vallee - Bussy Saint Georges

47535.description: This modern 3-star hotel, opened in 2003, is conveniently located near the Val d'Europe shopping center in Paris, with easy access to public transport. A 30-minute train ride connects you to the heart of Paris, while Disneyland Paris is just 7km away. Charles de Gaulle Airport is 40km from the hotel. The hotel offers 97 air-conditioned rooms, including 3 suites. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour reception, a bar, an à la carte restaurant with a dining room, and a conference room. A laundry service and a children's playground are also available. Each tastefully decorated room features a bathroom with a bathtub, shower, and hairdryer, along with a direct-dial telephone, satellite TV, tea and coffee making facilities, and climate control. A buffet breakfast is served daily, while lunch and dinner offer à la carte and set menu options. Special dietary needs can be accommodated upon request. Parking is available for guests arriving by car.

47585.description: Boasting a prime location on the seafront this unique hotel has more than meets the eye. Experience the incredible revolving rooms on offer that provide 360° views of the mountains and the Mediterranean. Guests can enjoy everything that the beautiful landscape of Antalya has to offer, either relaxing on the hotel's private beach or taking in the scenery from the Revolving Lounge restaurant. Perfect for those seeking a quiet retreat away on The Turquoise Coast where lush mountain ranges meet the sea. Local shops can be found within a 5 minute walk and the city of Antalya with outlets and restaurants is a short car ride away. All rooms are decorated in contemporary pastel shades and furnished with modern amenities. Non-smoking rooms are available and wheelchair access is available. Antalya airport is 15 km away. Pets are allowed. Charges may be applicable.

47586.description: Situated on Porte Maillot square in a bustling business center across from the Paris Congress Centre, this city hotel offers convenient access to a shopping center and various entertainment venues. The Porte Maillot bus and metro station are a short 2-minute walk away, providing easy access to Charles de Gaulle and Beauvais airports. Metro line 1, accessible directly from the station, connects guests to major Parisian attractions. The Champs Elysées and Arc de Triomphe are within 500 meters of the hotel. Charles de Gaulle airport is 30 km away, while Orly airport is 20 km away. The area also features a variety of restaurants and bars. The hotel provides a safety deposit box at the reception and an external laundry service. The receptionists are available 24/7 to assist guests with any inquiries. This 35-room hotel, including one disability-accessible room, boasts a relaxed atmosphere and magnificent views overlooking Porte Maillot square or a quiet Parisian courtyard. The comfortably furnished rooms are fully equipped with individual air conditioning, flat-screen TVs with satellite channels and Canal+, mini-fridges, and double-glazed windows. Free Wi-Fi access is available throughout the building. A continental breakfast is served daily from 7 am to 10 am in the breakfast room or in your room.

47594.description: This elegant hotel is situated in Madrid's historic center, between Puerta del Sol and Plaza de Cibeles. Just steps away, you'll find the Congreso de los Diputados and the Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum, while other major attractions are a short walk away. Public transport is easily accessible, and Barajas Airport is approximately 15 km from the hotel. The hotel offers modern guest rooms decorated in red and black, each featuring complimentary basic Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV with digital cable channels, and air conditioning. Safes are available upon request. Accessible rooms are also available upon request. Premium Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel for a surcharge. Guests can enjoy a daily breakfast buffet in the on-site cafe and cozy restaurant, while lunch and dinner are offered à la carte. For business travelers, a conference room is available. Private parking can be found nearby for an additional fee.

47595.description: This comfortable hotel is situated in the heart of Karaburun, right by the hotel's own wonderful sandy beach surrounded by other hotels which fringe this beautiful Mediterranean coastline. The tourist centre and a pretty forest area are around 1 km away and Manavgat is just 28 km; the centre of Alanya is easily reached by making use of public transport. Consisting of two blocks, the luxuriously appointed rooms are decorated in soothing, muted tones with splashes of turquoise and equipped with modern amenities for guests' convenience. A host of facilities are available for entertainment and relaxation, ranging from the glorious beach to the spacious outdoor pool area and the spa centre to the games' court and hall. Ideal for families and couples, guests are sure to enjoy all that this fun complex has to offer.

47624.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Barcelona, near the Parque de la Ciutadella, the Zoo and the Auditorium. There are several restaurants and bars in the nearby areas of the Eixample, Borne and Gothic Quarter. The famous Barcelona Auditorium is a 5-minute walk away, while the Sagrada Familia and the Ciutadella Park are 1. 5 km away. The hotel is only 200 m from public transportation links, and there is a selection of shops 400 m from the hotel. The hotel is surrounded by the Paseo del Borne, the harbour and the best museums of the city.

47625.description: Nestled in a tranquil corner of Paris's 17th arrondissement, this comfortable city hotel is ideally situated between the Arc de Triomphe and Porte Maillot, offering easy access to a vibrant array of restaurants, bars, and entertainment. Just steps from the Argentine metro station (Line 1), guests can quickly reach all of Paris's main attractions, including the Champs-Élysées and the Arc de Triomphe, both just five minutes away. Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports are conveniently located 30 and 20 kilometers away, respectively. The hotel offers 51 recently renovated rooms featuring air conditioning, flat-screen televisions with satellite channels, double-glazed windows, and hair dryers. Bathrooms are equipped with either a shower or bathtub. Each tastefully decorated room provides a welcoming retreat. A cold breakfast buffet is served daily from 7:00 am to 10:00 am in the breakfast room or in the comfort of your own room. Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel and take advantage of luggage storage and an external laundry service. Our reception is staffed 24/7 to assist you with any needs or questions during your stay.

47648.description: The NH Collection Milano Porta Nuova, formerly known as NH Milano Grand Hotel Verdi, is close to Porta Nuova, Milan's new business district. The center of the city is also a short walk away and provides access to taxis, the Gioia metro station and the Porta Garibaldi railway station. The Pinacoteca art gallery and the Brera district are just steps away from the hotel, while guests can shop, dine and unwind in the Corso Como area which is 5 minutes away (ask our Guest Relations for tips and must-seeS as well as off-the-beaten-track places to visit!). Guests at NH Collection Milano Porta Nuova stay in ultra-spacious rooms, completely renovated in 2018) many of which come with a beautiful view of the skyline. The relaxing decor features wooden floors, dark furniture and an elegant and sophisticated palette, with warm grey, green and gold accents. For modern comforts, enjoy flat screen TVs and free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. A fresh buffet breakfast is served here every morning and includes cold cuts, cheeses, yogurt, and cereals accompanied by fresh fruit juices and fragrant coffee. Tablafina gastrobar offers tapas with local produce. You can explore the city on one of our rental bikes or make use of our private parking. There is also a fitness center and for small meetings or interviews guests can use the lobby area (with a dedicated smart working corner) or one of the Suites, arranged for this purpose.

47730.description: This hotel is located in the immediate vicinity of the metro to Taksim Square. Links to the public transport network are located directly in front of the hotel. The city centre with a diverse range of shops and entertainment venues is within 1 km of the hotel. A golf course is located only 100 m away. Ataturk airport is some 20 km away. The spacious lobby houses a number of services and facilities appealing to both business and leisure travellers. This hotel comprises a total of 117 rooms spread over 9 floors. The rooms are carpeted and fitted with digital safe box, air condition, digital satellite LCD TV, minibar, hair dryer and bath amenities. Guests may take advantage of the pool in the grounds as well as the indoor swimming pool. There is also a spa centre where relaxation treatments can be enjoyed. Sports options include gymnastics sessions and a gym.

47732.description: This fabulous boutique hotel consists of seven Istanbul mansions housing 67 rooms. The mansions have been restored and re-interpreted to reflect their original 18th-century Ottoman architecture and are named after the towns that are situated on the coast of the Golden Horn. With its elevated position on a hill named after the French novelist and naval officer Pierre Loti, in the district of Eyup, the hotel and its grounds afford magnificent views of the 7 hills on which Istanbul is built. Visitors will find a cable car and other public transport options close by. The hotel offers a range of helpful facilities and services, including onsite meeting rooms, free outdoor parking, and a wellness centre with Turkish bath and massage services, all for a delightful weekend retreat or sunny holiday just outside of Istanbul.

47757.description: The Grand Hyatt Sao Paulo offers a luxurious stay in the Itaim Bibi district, just a short drive from Shopping Eldorado and Ibirapuera Park. Indulge in the on-site spa with massages, body treatments, and facials, or enjoy the health club, outdoor and indoor pools. This Art Deco hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services, and an area shuttle (surcharge). Each of the 467 guestrooms features a minibar, LED TV, and private bathroom with designer toiletries. Savor a meal at the restaurant, order room service, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available for a fee. The hotel also boasts extensive meeting and event space, as well as limo service and a 24-hour airport shuttle (surcharge).

47813.description: This elegant, luxury business hotel is the newest in São Paulo, renowned for its exceptional cuisine. Strategically located at the intersection of Paulista and Brigadeiro Faria Lima Avenues, the hotel boasts unique architecture, blending contemporary design with classic elements, such as period fixtures and an English brick façade. The hotel offers 64 rooms and an inviting lobby with a 24-hour reception desk, a cozy bar with relaxing music, and a fully air-conditioned restaurant, celebrated for its traditional Italian cuisine.

47814.description:
Hotel combining French-style luxury and refined local cuisine

French charm meets Carioca soul at Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema, a 5-star beachfront hotel on the most famous beach promenade. Take a dip in the infinity pool on the terrace while Two Brothers Hill receives the first rays of sun. Evenings end at the Lasai - a Michelin two-star restaurant. 119 rooms, 51 suites, KOS Paris Spa, and Club Millésime Lounge: everything you expect from the finest luxury hotel. 

Facing Ipanema Beach, a 5-star hotel between the sand and designer boutiques, cafes and Rio's most fashionable neighborhood. Pedra do Arpoador, famous for its sunset, is just a short hop along the waterfront. Rodrigo de Freitas Lagoon and Rio de Janeiro's Botanical Garden are also nearby, Copacabana Beach just a few mins by taxi, plus Christ the Redeemer and Sugarloaf Mountain for unforgettable moments.

47825.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. For lunch or dinner, stop by Surui, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Make yourself at home in one of the 99 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

47826.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. For lunch or dinner, stop by Surui, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in São Paulo? This hotel has 6932 square feet (644 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Make yourself at home in one of the 147 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. 47827.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. For lunch or dinner, stop by Tom, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is included. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, express check-in, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in São Paulo? This hotel has facilities measuring 2519 square feet (234 square meters), including conference space. Make yourself at home in one of the 162 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment.

47828.description: Enjoy a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, unwind in the sauna, or energize in the fitness center at this São Paulo hotel. Savor international cuisine at Tom, the hotel's restaurant with a garden view, or enjoy convenient room service (during limited hours). A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6 AM to 10 AM, and you can relax with a drink at the bar/lounge in the evening. Stay connected with complimentary wired and wireless internet access in your air-conditioned room, and enjoy cable programming on your LCD television. A minibar, safe, and desk add to your comfort, and the private bathroom includes a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. For business travelers, the hotel offers a business center, express check-in, and over 1, 000 square feet of meeting and conference space. Nearby attractions include the Morumbi Shopping Mall, U. S. Consulate General, and the scenic Ponte Estaiada de São Paulo. The hotel is approximately 6. 8 km from Congonhas Airport (CGH) and 53. 3 km from Guarulhos International Airport (GRU).

47829.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. For lunch or dinner, stop by Surui, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. Make yourself at home in one of the 118 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Rooms have private balconies.

47834.description: With a location just a block from Avenida Paulista, Radisson Hotel Paulista Sao Paulo offers both business and leisure travelers a simply delightful stay in the largest city in South America. Enjoy convenient access to the main corporate hub and world-class shopping of Sao Paulo. For a taste of local history and culture, visit the Sao Paulo Museum of Art and Casa das Rosas, both less than three kilometers from our full-service hotel. Our amenities feature an outdoor pool, a fitness center, and expansive meeting space. Our contemporary rooms with free WiFi, minibars, and individual room climate control invite you to recharge after a busy day in the city. You can begin each morning with a complimentary breakfast at All Seasons Bar and Restaurant, located on site. Pets Allowed. Pet Charge 150. 00 BRL Fixed Amount, Per Night. Refundable deposit of 150. 00 BRL is required Per Night. Pet limit 1 Pet Per Room.

47835.description: This hotel affords a quiet location in São Paulo. There are a number of modern boutiques and a shopping centre in the immediate vicinity. Renovated in 2009, this city hotel comprises a total of 216 rooms spread over 19 floors. In addition, the hotel offers five conference rooms with Internet access. There is also a bar and an on-site restaurant. Additionally room service and medical assistance are available. The hotel has a parking garage. All units include an en-suite bathroom and Internet access. In addition rooms are fitted with a kitchen and air-conditioning. Guests may make use of the sauna, the outdoor swimming pool and the hotel gym. Contemporary restaurant specializes in international cuisine.

47853.description: This city hotel, located in a Paris suburb near the Torcy metro station, offers convenient access to transportation, with a bus stop just 50 meters away. Nearby, you'll find a major shopping district, one of France's largest shopping centers with a park, diverse restaurants, cinemas, and numerous shops. Disneyland Resort Paris is a short 15-minute drive, offering a wealth of entertainment for all ages. Paris, with its galleries, museums, churches, and theaters, is approximately 20 km away, promising an exciting and enriching experience. Renovated in 2002, the six-story hotel features 85 rooms, including three wheelchair-accessible options. The welcoming lobby offers a 24-hour reception and a lift. Additional amenities include a pleasant terrace, a newspaper kiosk, two lounges, and three conference rooms, catering to both leisure and business travelers. A cozy bar, a dining room, and the à la carte Karousel Restaurant serve delicious international cuisine. Paid parking is also available. The comfortable rooms feature en suite bathrooms with a bath, shower, and hairdryer. Amenities include a direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, internet access, and central heating. Guests enjoy restful sleep on comfortable double beds, and tea and coffee making facilities are standard. Wheelchair-accessible rooms include adapted bathrooms. A continental breakfast buffet is available each morning. Lunch and dinner offer à la carte and set menu choices, with options for special dietary requirements.

47855.address: Hemel Hempstead Rd, Redbourn, St Albans, Herts
47855.description: Stunningly set amidst the beauty of the rolling English countryside with a woodland backdrop, this hotel is steeped in serenity and tranquillity. The property is located in Hemel Hempstead, within easy driving distance of the bustling city centre of London. Guests can explore the town centres of Hemel Hempstead and St. Albans with ease. The hotel boasts a long history, dating back to 1287. Beautifully respecting its rich heritage, the guest rooms are decorated in a classical style, with subtle contemporary influences. Guests are invited to sample the delights that the restaurant has to offer. A sumptuous afternoon tea can be enjoyed with friends, or guests can simply relax and unwind on the terrace. This magnificent hotel offers a retreat in which to escape the rest of the world.

47856.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Grab a bite to eat at Chiltern Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 97 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. 47891.description: This 4 star hotel is located within the city of Cape Town and was established in 1997. Located in the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, The Commodore Hotel provides sweeping views of Table Mountain, Cape Town Harbour and Robben Island. The Hotel has an outdoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 234 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning.

47910.description: This hotel is located in Ciudad de la Imagen, the business and leisure district of Pozuelo de Alarcon, in Madrid. The hotel is set just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from countless shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. Guests will find themselves just a 5 minutes' driving distance away from the main railway station. The centre of Madrid is just a 10 minutes' driving distance away. Barajas Airport is just a 30 minutes' drive from the hotel. This modern hotel comprises contemporary, elegantly-styled guest rooms. Guests can sit back and unwind with a delightful meal, in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant. The hotel features conference facilities, for the convenience of those travelling for work purposes.

47930.description: The Novotel Setúbal is a 4-star hotel in Setúbal, close to great natural heritage sites such as the Sado estuary, the Arrábida mountains and the beaches of Troia. Relax in one of the comfortable rooms. Visit the bar or restaurant. At Novotel Setúbal you can also have fun in the pool, play tennis and use the fitness club. Book your meeting or event in one of 5 fully-equipped rooms with natural light.

47932.description: This hotel enjoys a quiet location in Porto, about a five-minute drive from the lively city centre with its countless shops and entertainment venues in addition to a good connection to the local public transport network. Historic Porto University is located in the immediate vicinity of the hotel, while the beautiful city beach is within 10 minutes' walk. Transfer time to Francisco Sa Carneiro is only a couple of minutes (some 10 km away). The hotel was established in 2004 and comprises a total of 100 rooms spread over two floors. Alongside a lobby area with a 24-hour reception, the hotel offers guests a public Internet connection and W-LAN access points in all public areas of the building. Additionally, a cosy bar is available to guests, and business travellers may make use of four rooms suitable for conferences, meetings, and banquets. Those arriving by car may take advantage of the free hotel car park. The functionally designed rooms all come with an en suite bathroom or a shower unit with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, and air conditioning. Wheelchair accessible rooms and non-smoking rooms can be arranged on request.

47934.description: Ibis Porto Sul Europarque is situated in Santa Maria da Feira, next to the C Congressos Europarque and 15 km from the beaches of Espinho and Esmoriz. With great access to the main highways-A1+A29, the Porto center is just 30 minutes away. Relax in one of our comfortable rooms or in the swimming pool and enjoy free access to the WiFi and parking. In our Bar, discover the service of drinks and light meals, hot or cold, which offers options for all tastes, available 24/7.

47938.description: Ideal for business, leisure or shopping, ibis Lisboa Centro Saldanha is right in the city center, close to tourist sites, the airport, accessible by metro, with the historic center just 11 yards away. To relax, enjoy the comfort of our new renovated rooms, with modern equipment, free WIFI, private bathroom and 43' LCD TV.

47939.description: This appealing hotel is conveniently located in the centre of Lisbon. It is around 10 minutes on foot to the tourist centre of this pulsating metropolis. Approximately 1 km away guests will find the wonderful Rossio Square. It is a mere 4 km to the cultural centre Calouste Gulbenkian, and 5 km to venues where Fado is sung and played. The famous museums, the National Coach Museum and the National Tile Museum are located about 6 to 7 km away. The international exhibition centre and Bélem's congress centre lie just 12 km away. Links to the public transport network lie around 1 km away (Sta Apolónia train station). Lisbon airport is situated around 10 km away. The hotel is fully air conditioned and comprises a reception, which is open around the clock, a currency exchange facility and a lift. Dining options include a bar and a restaurant. A conference room is available for meetings and conferences. Moreover, the hotel offers public Internet access, and room and laundry services complete the offerings. Those arriving by car may make use of the hotel car park and garage. The functional rooms have an en suite bathroom with bath, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, ironing equipment, satellite/ cable TV and a radio. Room temperature is regulated via air conditioning. Coffee making facilities are also available in the king rooms. The business class rooms come with a hairdryer and an Internet connection. Rooms offering disabled access may also be booked. The hotel also features a swimming pool.

47940.address: Rua Cidade Do Porto Seguro Alto Da Guerra, 322
47940.description: This comfortable hotel in Setúbal is located close to picturesque surroundings, such as the Arrábida mountain range, the Sado River estuary and the Tróia beaches. Our modern and air-conditioned rooms are perfect for rest and relaxation. At the Hotel ibis in Setúbal guests can also enjoy WIFI access, 24-hour bar and snack service and private parking and terrace, in addition to a fantastic outdoor pool. Our two fully equipped meeting rooms are ideal for hosting both meetings and events.

47959.description: This hotel lies a mere 300 m from the airport, while the main roads and the motorways leading to São Paulo are directly accessible. The Shopping Ibirapuera mall is 4 km away and the city centre is around 10 km from the hotel. The air-conditioned establishment offers guests unique service. The lobby area has a reception desk manned around the clock, a TV room and a garage. All rooms are equipped with cable TV, fridge, iron and ironing board and a safe. Furthermore, an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, king-size or double bed as well as individually adjustable air conditioning is provided in all accommodation as standard. The hotel grounds feature a gym.

47960.description: This appealing aparthotel is located near Avenida Brigadeiro Faria Lima, a vibrant district in São Paulo known for its diverse restaurants, bars, and shops. Suitable for both business travelers and leisure guests, the hotel offers a comfortable and convenient base for exploring the city. Guests are welcomed in an inviting lobby with a 24-hour reception desk. The fully air-conditioned hotel features an elegant restaurant and laundry service. The cozy rooms include an en suite bathroom, a kitchenette with a microwave, a direct-dial telephone, a safe, satellite TV, and a minibar. Ironing facilities are also available. Guests can relax by the swimming pool, unwind in the sauna, or work out in the gym. Please note, there is a nightly tourist tax of $4. 85.

47961.description: The Transamerica Executive Perdizes Hotel is conveniently located in São Paulo's vibrant Perdizes neighborhood, near PUC University and the Barra Funda business district. Easy access to public transportation makes exploring the city effortless. Tastefully appointed rooms feature en suite bathrooms with hairdryers, direct-dial telephones, satellite/cable TV, internet access, and ironing facilities. A daily breakfast is served. Please note: Apartment renovations will begin January 1, 2025. Some noise may occur during business hours.

47962.description: This aparthotel is located in the heart of São Paulo, a short distance from Avenida Paulista, offering a variety of shopping and entertainment, including the Museum of Modern Art, home to one of South America's most significant art collections. The nearby Consolação station provides convenient access to the city. Situated in Jardins, one of the city's most beautiful districts, the aparthotel is just minutes from Paulista Avenue and surrounded by excellent restaurants, bars, and shops. It is 8 km from Congonhas Airport, 29 km from Guarulhos International Airport, 12 km from the Anhembi Convention Center, and 3 km from downtown. The hotel features a meeting room, swimming pool, restaurant, sauna, fitness center, and parking. Each comfortable apartment includes an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a kitchenette with a small fridge, microwave, and tea/coffee making facilities, a safe, and centrally controlled air conditioning. Guests can enjoy the outdoor swimming pool and a well-equipped gym.

47963.description: This apartment hotel is located in the city centre of São Paulo in the attractive Moema district, one of the greenest and most peaceful residential areas in the metropolis. The sprawling Ibirapuera Park is located in the immediate vicinity of the hotel, and transfer time to Congonhas airport is only a few minutes by car. This hotel features an air-conditioned foyer with a 24-hour reception desk. A range of modern conference facilities are available to guests arriving on business. Culinary options include a pleasant restaurant, while room and laundry services complete the offerings. The cosy apartments all come with an en suite bathroom, a direct dial telephone, an Internet connection, satellite/ cable TV, a radio, and a kitchen with an oven, a fridge, a microwave oven, and tea and coffee making facilities. A hire safe and centrally regulated air conditioning are also provided as standard. Guests can make use of the hotel swimming pool, or try a workout in the gym, which also includes a sauna area.

47964.description: This hotel is located in Jardins, one of the most elegant districts of the city. Facilities of this business hotel include a reception, a cosy restaurant and various conference rooms. Guests may also make use of the laundry and room services for an additional fee. Car parking spaces are also available. The tasteful rooms come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone and satellite/ cable TV. The comfortable rooms also include a kitchenette with a minibar and a microwave as standard. Ironing facilities and a hire safe feature in each as standard. There is a swimming pool in the hotel grounds. There is a sauna and a gym for guests to take advantage of.

47965.description: This apartment hotel is located in an attractive residential area in the centre of São Paulo. The Avenida Paulista, located in the immediate vicinity of the hotel, offers a full range of shops and entertainment venues as well as the museum of modern art, which contains one of the most significant art collections in South America. The hotel welcomes guests in an air-conditioned foyer with 24-hour reception desk. Further facilities on offer include a pleasant restaurant within the hotel. The cosy apartments all come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, an Internet connection, and satellite/ cable TV. The modern kitchen is fitted with an oven, a microwave oven, a small fridge, and a dishwasher. A hire safe is also included as standard. There is a small heated indoor swimming pool with a sauna area on offer to guests. Sports enthusiasts may make use of the in-house gym.

47966.description: This apartment hotel is located in the centre of São Paulo close to the Avenida Paulista as well as the Museum of Modern Art, which features the most important art collection in South America. Its central location means the tourist attractions and Trianon MASP Station can be reached within a short time. Various shopping and entertainment facilities are also to be found in the near vicinity of the hotel. Congonhas airport lies around 10 km away and Guarulhos airport is 30 km from the hotel. The hotel comprises a 24-hour reception in the air-conditioned lobby room. Business guests may make use of the spacious conference room. Dining options include a cosy bar and two appealing restaurants serving up a successful mixture of national and international dishes. The tastefully designed rooms include an en suite bathroom with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a hire safe and satellite/cable TV. The modern kitchens comprise an oven, a microwave as well as tea and coffee making facilities. There is outdoor swimming pool available to guests. Guests may also make use of the sauna area or pay a visit to the in-house gymReservations processed through this system comprise up to 10 apartments per period on average. Above 11 apartments, it is considered a Group policy, with negotiation and applicability of different Terms and Conditions. . We emphasize that the contracted daily rate is for 24 hours, with check-in from 2 p. m. and check-out until 12 p. m. The interval of up to 3 hours between guests' departure and arrival is provided for in MTur Ordinance No. 28 and is intended exclusively for cleaning, sanitizing, and tidying up the unit, ensuring the maintenance of our standard of excellence. "

48010.description: This appealing hotel is located to the west of the city centre along the coast in an area known as Konyaalti. Bars, pubs and nightclubs are to be found some 5 km away. The nearest shops are within 3 km of the hotel. The city centre can be reached on public transport, and is only about 9 km from the hotel, whilst Antalya airport is roughly 20 km away. Opened in 2005 and refurbished in 2010, the hotel is fully air-conditioned and comprises 48 rooms set over 5 floors, which can be reached by lifts. There is also a restaurant serving culinary delights. The stylish rooms are en suite and feature all amenities necessary for a comfortable stay, including a wireless Internet connection. There is a swimming pool and a paddling pool in the hotel grounds, where guests of all ages can take a refreshing dip.

48113.description: Why choose between location and comfort if you can have both? The Intercity Interative Jardins is located in the heart of the pleasant Jardins neighborhood, two blocks away from Avenida 9 de Julho and just a few minutes from Avenida Paulista. A perfect hotel to relax after a busy day working or a long day shopping and sightseeing in São Paulo. All this combined with a delicious breakfast which will ensure that you start the day with the right foot.

48131.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an indoor pool, a spa tub, and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy international cuisine at Atölye Restaurant, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms.

name.content: Mercure Sao Paulo Grand Plaza Paulista

48158.description: The Mercure SP Grand Plaza Paulista is conveniently located one block from Paulista Avenue, near Brigadeiro station and Patio Paulista mall. This vibrant cultural hub is close to Casa das Rosas, Japan House, MASP, cinemas, bars, and trendy restaurants in the Jardins district. It's also within walking distance of Hcor, Oswaldo Cruz, and Beneficiência Portuguesa hospitals. Enjoy cycling on Paulista Avenue, especially on Sundays when it transforms into a lively pedestrian zone. Experience the best of São Paulo!

48159.description: Enjoy the recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or make use of other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access. Enjoy a satisfying meal at Cafe Restaurant serving guests of Paraiso Suites by Charlie. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Planning an event in São Paulo? This apartment has 657 square feet (61 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 5 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 91 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided on request. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Hcor Hospital - 0. 9 km / 0.

48170.description: This charming hotel offers a comfortable and stylish stay for both leisure and business travelers. Ideally located in West Paris, it's just steps from Place de la Nation and a 15-minute walk from the Bastille Opera. The Rue des Boulets subway station is a mere 3 minutes away. The well-appointed guest rooms feature all the necessary amenities for a pleasant stay, including private bathrooms with hairdryers and satellite TVs. Guests can also enjoy a complimentary weekday newspaper and a delicious breakfast served in the hotel's inviting breakfast room.

48372.description: Hotel Des Arenes is located in Paris, a 3-minute walk from Rue Mouffetard and 1148 feet from Jardin des Plantes. It offers rooms with views of the historic Arenes de Lutece. Each air-conditioned room has classic decor and is equipped with satellite TV, Wi-Fi access and a private bathroom. All rooms are accessible by a elevator. A continental breakfast is served daily in the dining room. Guests can enjoy a drink at the hotel’s bar. A 24-hour front desk is also available. The Hotel Des Arenes is 10-minute walk from the Cathedral of Noter Dame and 2953 feet to the River Seine. Place Monge Metro station is 459 feet away, giving direct access to Chatelet and the Louver.

48474.description: Located in the heart of Venezia-Mestre, the historic gateway to Venice, Italy, this elegant hotel is just 9 km from Venice's Grand Canal, offering easy access to St. Mark's Square, Rialto Bridge, Doge's Palace, and other world-famous attractions via gondola, sandolo, or vaporetto. The Venetian Lagoon is minutes away, with Lido di Venezia's sandy beaches reachable in 35 minutes by ferry, Murano Island in 28 minutes, and Burano Island in under an hour. Venezia Airport is less than 10 km away, while Treviso's magnificent old city is 21 km away and Padua (Padova) is 35 km away. The hotel offers a 24-hour reception with an air-conditioned lounge, lift, private parking, a cozy breakfast room, and a large sun terrace surrounded by fragrant Mediterranean hedges. The elegant, soundproofed rooms feature private bathrooms with showers or bathtubs, hairdryers, air conditioning, direct-dial phones, plasma screen TVs with satellite channels, electronic safes, and minibars. Rooms are regularly refurbished to maintain their stylish ambiance. Triple and family rooms are available upon request. Guests can enjoy a hearty breakfast buffet each morning and relax on the rooftop sun terrace, complete with parasols and sun loungers.

name.content: Selectum Family Comfort Side (ex. Lyra Resort)

48611.description: Situated on the Kizilagac seafront, this resort hotel offers spectacular sea views, just 10km east of Manavgat and 75km from Antalya Airport. Ancient cities like Side, Aspendos, and Perge are easily accessible. With 485 comfortable rooms and excellent service, it's ideal for couples and families. Enjoy the sandy/pebble beach, numerous activities, a main restaurant serving Turkish and international cuisine, and à la carte options including Turkish, Italian, Asian, Fish, and Mexican. Relax at one of the various bars offering complimentary local alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. Evening entertainment includes shows with dazzling costumes.

48623.description: This charming hotel is located in the center of Amsterdam, just a few minutes from the Royal Palace and 1 km from the main train station. Amsterdam-Schipol Airport is about 20 km away, easily accessible by taxi or shuttle bus to the main train station, followed by a short tram ride (lines 1 or 5) to the Spui stop. The hotel is a mere 200 m walk from the stop. Guests can enjoy a daily breakfast buffet in the hotel's breakfast room and utilize the convenient laundry service. The welcoming rooms feature home appliances and cozy furnishings, along with internet access, ensuring a comfortable stay.

48629.description: Orla Copacabana Hotel is an impressive hotel looking out on Copacabana Beach in Rio de Janeiro offering great facilities and services. On the premises you'll find a swimming pool, a restaurant, a sauna, and a gym, as well as a number of bars. Complete with well-equipped guestrooms and a charming terrace with fantastic views, this property is a convenient choice for your next visit to Rio de Janeiro.

48670.description: This hotel has 398 comfortable rooms. Wi-Fi is available throughout the property for an extra charge. Guests are greeted by a 24-hour reception in the lobby. While baby cots are not available, the hotel offers a variety of dining options serving delicious meals. A wide range of wellness facilities provide ample opportunities for relaxation, while various entertainment options ensure a pleasant stay. Guests can start their day energetically with delicious meals at the hotel's Senza Garden Holiday Club (formerly Larissa Hill Beach) restaurant. Some services may be subject to an additional charge.

48784.description:
With 30 years of experience and a commitment to high-quality service, Marble Hotel offers a privileged accommodation experience in Taksim, the heart of Istanbul’s European side. 

For guests wishing to explore the unique history of this magnificent city, which has hosted three great empires, as well as for business travelers, our hotel provides an excellent location. Its central position, within walking distance of Taksim Square, makes it especially convenient. 

Thanks to Marble Hotel’s advantageous location, you can easily access Istanbul’s historical, cultural, and commercial centers. Its proximity to the metro, bus, funicular, and other public transport lines allows fast and comfortable access to all parts of the city, while nearby sea transport offers the opportunity to discover Istanbul from a different perspective. 

At Marble Hotel, featuring comfortable rooms and a warm, welcoming atmosphere, you can start your day with a rich and delicious breakfast overlooking the enchanting Bosphorus view. 

Combining modern comfort, professional service, a central location, and excellent transportation links, Marble Hotel invites you to turn your Istanbul journey into an unforgettable experience.

48831.description: The Renwick Hotel New York City is a contemporary, newly reimagined hotel housed in an iconic 1920's brick building, which evokes the spirit of the creative minds who once lived and worked here. Perfectly located on East 40th Street just off Lexington Avenue, the hotel is only two blocks from Grand Central Terminal and walking distance to Park Avenue, the Empire State Building, the New York Public Library, Bryant Park, Rockefeller Center, Times Square and Fifth Avenue shopping. Manhattan's best attractions, restaurants, museums and Fortune 500 companies are within steps of the hotel. Named for celebrated architect James Renwick, creator of world-renowned St. Patrick's Cathedral, The Renwick was once home to artists' studios, intellectuals and many celebrated writers (including John Steinbeck and F. Scott Fitzgerald) and honors its past by infusing art throughout its public space and guest rooms. Artfully outfitted interiors were designed by Stonehill & Taylor and simply bring The Renwick to life. The hotel offers 173 residential, loft-style guest rooms accented by hand-crafted furnishings and in-room artistic designs of famous artists; select guest rooms feature a personal balcony and 33 of the hotel's accommodations are suites. In-room amenities include a 48-inch Smart TV (55-inch TV in suites) plus mini-refrigerator, artist-style work desk, plush bathrobe and slippers and bath products by Brooklyn-based company Apotheke.

48867.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Make yourself at home in one of the 11 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and minibars. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Barcelona History Museum - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Picasso Museum - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Barcelona Cathedral - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Santa Caterina Market - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Basilica de Santa Maria del Mar - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Barcelona City Council - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Paseo del Borne - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Palau de la Música Catalana - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- El Born Centre Cultural - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Mercat del Born - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Portal de l'Angel - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Parc de la Ciutadella - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Plaça Reial - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Port Vell - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- La Rambla - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi. The preferred airport for Mercer House Bòria Bcn is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 16. 6 km / 10. 3 mi Mercer House Bòria Bcn is centrally located in Barcelona, a 3-minute walk from Barcelona Cathedral and 8 minutes by foot from La Rambla. This upscale hotel is 1. 1 mi (1. 8 km) from Barceloneta Beach and 1. 7 mi (2. 8 km) from Port de Barcelona.

48970.description: This hotel is located in a quiet street right in the city centre. Restaurants, bar and shops all lie in the immediate vicinity, as well as an underground train station which will take guests comfortable to the exhibition centre. The Corso Buenos Aires, world famous for its over 200 shops is easily accessible on foot, as is the Palazzo Reale, Milan's cathedral and the Galleria Vittorio Emmanuele II. After exploring its magnificent architecture, guests will find themselves directly in front of Milan's Teatro della Scala. The train station lies about 2 km away and Linate Airport is around 7 km away. The air-conditioned city hotel comprises 36 rooms over 5 floors and is ideal for business travellers and holidaymakers alike. Facilities on offer include a lobby area with a reception desk manned around the clock, a hotel safe, and lift access. Furthermore, it is equipped with a cafe, a bar, a TV lounge, a restaurant, conference facilities and public Internet access. A laundry service is available and a garage is in the immediate vicinity. All rooms are fitted with an en suite bathroom with bath/shower and a hairdryer and a direct dial telephone, TV, a radio, Internet access and a hire safe are at the disposal of every guest. Facilities include tea and coffee making facilities, ironing set, double or king/size bed, and air conditioning. Sport and concert fans will find something to their taste at the San Siro Stadium which is easily reached with the underground. Guests can select their breakfast from a buffet. Take the red underground line at the main railway station and get out at Porta Venezia. From the highway, follow the signs to the centre.

48971.description: Offering a strategic location in the historic centre of Mestre, this hotel is a perfect choice to spend a city break, romantic escape or a business travel. Venice lies within 8 kilometres and is reachable by means of public transport with a bus stop in front of the hotel, while town centre of Mestre, with its restaurants, bars and shops, can be reached in 2 minutes. Its convenient situation allows visitors to travel to Padua, Treviso and the Brenta Riviera. The establishment greets guests with modern facilities, attentive service and friendly atmosphere. The air-conditioned and well-appointed rooms are a true oasis of peace and tranquillity, needed to feel at ease after a long day or work or venturing into the area. Visitors may start their day with a flavourful continental breakfast served on-site and throughout the day enjoy a drink from the bar or relax in the well-manicured garden. There is also a 24-hour reception and private parking for guests' added convenience.

48993.description:
Located in a tranquil quarter, this hotel is located close to the historical centre of Mestre (around 2km away). Links to the public transport network are to be found about 200 m away and the airport is some 6 km from the hotel. The nearest restaurants and bars are less than 300 m away. Venice is the nearest city and is easily reached within 10 minutes on public transport.

Superbly situated, this hotel was opened in 2005 and comprises 20 rooms. The complex offers guests a lobby with a 24-hour reception desk, lifts, a TV room, a breakfast room, and a laundry service. Those arriving by car may take advantage of the car park.

The welcoming rooms come with an en suite bathroom, a mini-fridge, a hire safe, a direct dial telephone, Internet access and satellite/cable TV.

BY TRAIN: to come down to stopped of Venice-Mestre and out of the station turn on the left. The third street on the right it is Via Fagarè and after 100 meters you will find the Hotel Ambasciata. 
BY CAR: escapes from the freeway to the casello of Mestre to follow the indications for the station; with the station of forehead to you to turn on the right and therefore the third street on the right is Via fagarè; otherwise to exceed the station leaving it to your left and turn in the third street on the right that is Via Fagarè. 
BY AIRPLANE: the International Airport Marco Polo is only 8 km distant from the Hotel Ambasciata and is served by average publics ACTV (stopped Bus nr.15 with to the railway station of Mestre) and by private taxi (cost approximately euro 20,00)

49014.description: This delightful, family-run hotel, housed in a 1902 building, boasts a prime location on Washington Square in the heart of Greenwich Village. Steps away, you'll find a diverse selection of bars, restaurants, and shops. LaGuardia Airport is 19 km and JFK Airport is 31 km from the hotel. The inviting Art Deco lobby offers comfortable seating areas, and parking is available for guests arriving by car. The hotel features a popular bar and a restaurant with a jazz brunch on Sundays. Business travelers can utilize the conference facilities and public internet access. Charming, air-conditioned rooms showcase Art Deco furnishings, with some featuring carpeted floors and others hardwood. Each room includes original artwork and an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer and toiletries. Guests can also enjoy a workout in the on-site gym.

49016.description: Indulge in a relaxing spa treatment, including massages. Enjoy recreational amenities such as an indoor pool and sauna. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a common area television. An area shuttle is available (surcharge). Savor lunch or dinner at the hotel restaurant, or order room service (limited hours). Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. The hotel has two meeting rooms available for events. The 93 air-conditioned guest rooms feature minibars, flat-screen televisions with satellite channels, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and bidets, phones, safes, and desks. Located near Taksim Square, Istiklal Avenue and other main attractions. The nearest airports are Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) and Istanbul Airport (IST). The preferred airport is Istanbul Airport (IST).

49020.description: This hotel is beautifully located on the Turkish Riviera. Situated in the Alara region, the hotel is located just 35 km away from Alanya. Guests will find themselves surrounded by opportunities to explore and experience the rich culture and history of the area. Antalya Airport is located just 95 km away. This luxurious hotel comprises a main building, as well as a separate annexe building. The guest rooms are sumptuously designed, oozing character and charm. Guests will be spoilt for choice, with the hotel's 3 restaurants. The hotel also features 3 bars and a nightclub, for guests' entertainment. This hotel has been designed to surpass the expectations of even the most discerning traveller.

49023.address: Selimiye Mh. Adnan Menderes Blv. Manavgat/ Antalya, 24/1
49023.description: Surrounded by lush gardens and located directly on the beach with golden sands and turquoise-blue waters, this excellent hotel resort is a perfect place to spend one's holidays. A water park with slides, an amusement park and a luxury spa leave no desire unfulfilled. Beautiful lake Titreyengöl is just a few steps away, the historic town of Side with its ancient sites is within easy reach.

49050.address: Tilkiler Mevkii, Erhan Demir Bulv.Colakli, Antalya
49050.description: This resort hotel boasts a stunning setting in district of Colakli. The hotel lies just 10 km away from the resort centre of Side, where a number of attractions can be found. The hotel is situated just 100 metres away from the beach. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. This resort hotel is sure to impress, enjoying a blend of traditional and contemporary elements. The guest rooms offer a relaxed setting, in which to escape the rest of the world. The hotel offers a number of facilities and services, meeting the needs of each and every traveller. The hotel features a games room and a disco, as well as an outdoor pool with waterslides, offering entertainment for visitors of all ages.

49133.description: Nestled within 6 hectares of lush botanical gardens and boasting a 250-meter private beach, this holiday resort offers 258 guestrooms in low-rise blocks. Situated on the Manavgat-Alanya highway, it's a 20-minute drive from the ancient ruins of Side. The bright, colorfully decorated rooms feature air-conditioning and a balcony. Dining options include a main restaurant, snack bar, à la carte restaurant, tea garden, disco bar, and a cozy bar with a fireplace. Guests can enjoy a range of activities, including tennis, swimming, and gym access, along with an internet corner and Wi-Fi in the lobby. A spa offers relaxing massages and treatments. Please note: some outdoor facilities, including the amphitheater, beach bar, pools, and slides, operate seasonally.

49134.description: The Perre Delta Hotel sits on a sprawling 20, 000 m² beachfront plot in tranquil Alanya, boasting stunning mountain and sea views. Far from the city's hustle, guests enjoy the refreshing breezes from the Taurus Mountains and the sparkling turquoise waters of the Mediterranean Sea. With a wide array of games, entertainment, dining, and relaxation options, it's an ideal destination for families. The hotel offers direct access to a 150-meter stretch of sandy and pebble beach, complete with a pier, where the beauty of the Mediterranean and the Taurus Mountains converge.

49135.description: The Delphin Diva sits directly on Lara Beach, just 10 km from the airport and 15 km from the city center. With its own private 230-meter stretch of beach, this hotel offers an unforgettable seaside escape. Conveniently located with a minibus and taxi rank right outside, exploring local shops and attractions is easy.

49136.address: Çamyuva Mah. Vatan Cad. No:3 Çamyuva-Kemer/Antalya, 3
49136.description: This exclusive resort is located close to charming woodlands, in the town of Camyuva. The resort is located just 7 km away from the resort of Kemer. A wealth of attractions can be found nearby. Local amenities are just a short walking distance away from the hotel. Public transport links are just 130 metres away. Antalya Airport is situated just 63 km away from the resort. This wonderful resort enjoys a charming design. The guest rooms are superbly appointed, featuring refreshing tones and a serene ambience. The hotel offers a wide range of facilities and services, attending to the needs of each and every traveller. The hotel features a theatre, disco and a kids' club, offering fun for guests of all ages.

49143.description: The Hotel San Giuliano, situated along the Canal Salso in Mestre, offers convenient access to key meeting points like Piazza Ferretto and Piazza XXVII Ottobre, bustling with shops and the panoramic bistro at Le Barche shopping center. A short bus ride connects you to Venice's historic city center, while the vast San Giuliano Park, ideal for jogging and boasting stunning views of the Venetian skyline, is right at your doorstep. This 4-star hotel provides comfortable and affordable accommodation, easily accessible by car or train. Please note that parking is limited and cannot be reserved.

49153.description: This pleasant hotel is located in Viana do Castelo. There are a total of 50 guest rooms at Monte Prado & Spa. This establishment was built in 2003. Those who remain at this establishment can surf the internet thanks to the ready-to-use Wi-Fi access in public areas. Visitors can contact the reception at any time of the day. The common areas of this establishment are adapted for people with disabilities. This accommodation does not accept pets. Monte Prado & Spa has parking. Monte Prado & Spa offers several options of business facilities in order to offer the perfect combination of comfort and convenience for a business trip. Guests can relax and escape the daily routine at the property's wellness facilities. The entertainment options available are sure to impress everyone who stays at this establishment. Monte Prado & Spa reserves the right to charge a fee for some of these services.

49192.description: Situated in South Queensferry, the Orocco Pier is a beachfront hotel offering stunning terrace views. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site dining at the Samphire Seafood Grill and a cafe, plus a bar/lounge. The 17 guestrooms feature iPod docks, DVD players, and digital programming. The hotel is conveniently located near Forth Rail Bridge (0. 5 mi) and provides easy access to Edinburgh Airport (7. 6 mi). Other amenities include luggage storage and complimentary newspapers.

49295.description: This hotel is located at the heart of West Berlin. Various shopping and entertainment facilities are to be found in the vicinity of the hotel. The shopping boulevard of Kurfürstendamn, the Neue Nationalgalerie, the Philharmonie and the Sony Centre are only minutes away. Potsdamer Platz is a 10-minute walk away. Thanks to its proximity to links to the public transport network (100 m away), other districts of the city, sights of interest and cultural attractions are easily accessible. Tegel Airport is 30 minutes away, whilst Schönefeld Airport is around a 45-minute drive away. Renovated in 2003, this hotel comprises a total of 7 floors and 10 guest rooms. As well as a lobby area with a hotel safe and lift, the hotel also offers its guest a bar and an inviting breakfast room and free of charge car parking facilities. The comfortable rooms include an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, satellite/cable TV and a hire safe. Heating is individually regulated.

49375.description: 'Where history meets hospitality' is more than the motto of this truly remarkable centrally located hotel, it is a statement of intent. The hotel stands on a site that has a heritage dating back to Roman Britain, and many unearthed artefacts are proudly displayed in the Museum of London. There are a multitude of attractions and experiences to be enjoyed nearby; take a trip back in time with a visit to Shakespeare's Globe or join the ultra hip with a visit to the Tate Modern art gallery. The Thames Path is near to the hotel and a relaxing walk along the River Thames is particularly recommended in the summer months, whilst a spin on the London Eye will provide spectacular views of a truly great city at any time of year. The hotel prides itself on high quality service and all rooms are spacious and equipped with everything that guests will need during the stay. The hotel is just steps from The Shard. The View From The Shard is a fantastic tourist attraction and offers panoramic 360-degree views across the capital and beyond. The gym is currently under renovation, guests can use a local gym near the hotel until the renovation has been completed at the end of 2025.

49396.description: Located in the heart of Barcelona's vibrant downtown, Hotel SERHS Del Port offers convenient access to iconic attractions such as La Rambla and Boqueria Market, both within a 15-minute walk. This hotel provides 48 air-conditioned guest rooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and electric kettles. Guests can enjoy daily housekeeping and a buffet breakfast for a fee. Additional amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, concierge services, and a banquet hall.

49434.address: Selimiye Mah.Side Devlet Hast. Alti Side
49434.description: Indulge in exceptional service and amenities from the moment you arrive at Hotel Side Star Park. Opened in April 2005, this 5-star hotel offers 212 stylish rooms, just 150 meters from its private Blue Flag sandy beach and a 15-minute walk from the ancient city of Side. Perfect for couples and families seeking a relaxing Turkish holiday, the hotel features a stunning swimming pool, modern bars, and a welcoming atmosphere.

49462.address: Route De La Ferme Du Pavillon
49462.description: The 3-star Best Western Hotel Grand Parc, located in Chanteloup-en-Brie, is only 10 kilometers from Disneyland Paris and a short drive from Parc Astérix. The hotel offers 68 recently renovated rooms, each uniquely decorated with a nature and bird theme. Conveniently situated 35 kilometers from Charles de Gaulle Airport and a 15-minute drive from the Marne-la-Vallée Chessy TGV station, the hotel is easily accessible. A nearby bus provides transport to the Val d'Europe RER A station, offering direct connections to Paris and Disneyland Paris. From Paris, take the RER A towards Marne-la-Vallée Chessy, disembark at Val d'Europe (one stop before Disneyland Paris), and take a short 10-minute bus ride to the hotel. All 68 air-conditioned and soundproofed rooms feature a hairdryer, flat-screen TV, courtesy tray, and free Wi-Fi. Rooms accommodate one to six guests, and connecting rooms are available. A cold buffet breakfast is served daily in the restaurant from 7:00 am to 10:30 am. Bar service is available from 11:00 am to 11:00 pm. Numerous restaurants are also located nearby. The hotel staff is happy to assist with information, ATM access, and taxi reservations. A complimentary luggage room is available at reception. The hotel staff speaks French, English, and Spanish. Guests can enjoy the on-site spa (hot tub, sauna, and hammam, available for an extra charge) and fitness center. In addition to visiting Disneyland Paris and Parc Astérix, guests can explore the large Val d'Europe shopping center with La Vallée Village outlet shopping and the Sea Life aquarium.
