Enjoy a round of golf at the nearby 18-hole course or relax at Village Nature Paris, featuring the largest lagoon in the Paris region. A €200 security deposit is required upon arrival.

49573.description:
Inspired by the visionary spirit of Louis Pasteur, Mercure Paris Montparnasse Pasteur is an invitation to explore, connect and share. From the moment you arrive, you'll feel at home. The hotel features guest rooms accommodating up to four people, a light-filled glass-roofed lounge, coworking spaces, meeting rooms, the L'Antidote bar, and private parking. Experience the authentic lifestyle of Paris's 15th arrondissement, with its hidden gems, lively terraces and the unique atmosphere of the Left Bank. 

Here, the Left Bank reveals its true character. Stroll along Rue de Vaugirard, one of the longest streets in Paris, lined with cafés, restaurants and local hidden gems. Between the vibrant Montparnasse district, its renowned theatres and the major events at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, the hotel is the ideal base for discovering a different side of Paris, where culture, business and the Parisian art of living come together. Enjoy a prime location and experience the city like a local. 

Just minutes from Paris Expo Porte de Versailles and Montparnasse railway station, the hotel offers easy access to major business events as well as the iconic attractions of the Left Bank, from the Eiffel Tower to Saint-Germain-des-Prés.

name.content: Holiday Inn Berlin City Center East-Prenzl. Allee

49594.description: Family-friendly Prenzlauer Berg hotel with a bistro, bar and gymNear the city centre in cosmopolitan Prenzlauer Berg, Holiday Inn® Berlin City Centre East P-Berg hotel is close to fashionable shops, cafés and cultural venues. The M2 tram stops in front of the hotel, providing direct links to Alexanderplatz, both airports and the Messe Berlin exhibition grounds. It’s a short walk to the Prenzlauer Allee S-Bahn station, where trains whisk guests to city centre destinations such as the Brandenburg Gate and Berlin BER Airport (BER) in half an hour. Cultural draws within walking distance of the hotel include Max-Schmeling-Halle, with its programme of sports events, concerts and family-friendly shows, and the Kulturbrauerei, a converted brewery housing theatres, a cinema and bars. The MACHmit! Museum for Children offers craft workshops. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Inclusive Wi-Fi- A fitness centre- Kids stay and eat freeWake up to a generous buffet in our breakfast room, and enjoy a light lunch or dinner, including local specialities, in the casual lobby bistro. Business guests can hold a gathering of up to 70 in our 5 meeting rooms. A 24-hour bar enables you to order a nightcap as late as you like. Rooms have comfort-enhancing details such as pillow menus, and families can book accommodation with sofa beds and bathtubs.

49724.description: The Amazon Hotel is located at Syntagma, in the heart of Athens, in the scenic area of Plaka. Recently renovated, it has all modern amenities and with the particularly experienced staff, at the Amazon Hotel you will promptly feel the friendly and family atmosphere required to make your stay pleasant. The hotel has 40 completely renovated rooms, equipped with all modern facilities, such as sound-proof windows, satellite television, subscription television, direct phone line, bathroom, air-conditioning (heating, cooling) with autonomous thermostat, music, refrigerator, mini-bar, safe, magnetic locks, access to Internet (isdn, voice mail), hair dryer and dinner table. Room service is available on a 24-hour basis. The experienced staff as well as the reception of our hotel is at your disposal 24-hours a day so that you always have a pleasant stay. Furthermore, the hotel undertakes luggage safe-keeping, transportation from and to Amazon Hotel, arrangement of small trips, car and motorbike rentals and a massage studio (upon appointment). The cafeteria and breakfast room are on the first floor of the Amazon Hotel. There is also a small convention room for your professional meetings. The friendly and family environment of Amazon Hotel will provide you a pleasant stay in Athens, regardless of the purpose of your trip.

49725.description: The Alassia Hotel opened its doors on December 29, 2024, following extensive renovations. This deluxe Athenian boutique hotel boasts a prime location just 100 meters from Omonoia Metro Station, placing Syntagma Square and the vibrant Monastiraki area within easy walking distance. Guest rooms showcase contemporary furnishings in stylish grey and black or brown and black palettes. Each room offers a 50-inch TV, minibar, safe, and direct-dial telephone, while the en-suite bathrooms feature walk-in showers, hairdryers, makeup mirrors, telephones, and complimentary toiletries. Guests can unwind in the contemporary lobby bar and enjoy a selection of coffees, juices, and cocktails. Located in Athens' historical and commercial center near Omonoia Square, the hotel is also just a 15-minute walk from the scenic Plaka district and the Acropolis. The National Theatre, National Archaeological Museum, and many other cultural attractions are easily accessible.

name.content: Cape Sounio, A Resort to Live

49726.description: The Athens Riviera landmark. Discover the iconic Athens Riviera Resort, overlooking the legendary Temple of Poseidon. Cape Sounio encapsulates the Soul of the Riviera. A place to relax & reset on two beaches on the onset of the Aegean Sea, amid the ancient ruins and a pristine pine forest. Fall in love with the stellar service, cutting-edge Villas, sophisticated restaurants and outstanding experiences. An invitation to experience one of the most beautiful views in the world in an intensely personal way. Arranged amphitheatrically, terracotta coloured Bungalows, Suites and Villas blend into the unspoiled landscape. Exquisite Villas at this idyllic location are among the most sophisticated residences in the Mediterranean. Perfect hideaways with private pools and unique views to the sea & temple of Poseidon.

49773.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including a fitness center and a seasonal outdoor pool. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at Avenue, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Athens? This hotel has 4230 square feet (393 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 7 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 513 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators.

49774.description: The Exe Getafe hotel is conveniently located in Getafe's business and industrial center, near several industrial estates and a short drive from the Warner Bros. theme park. Numerous shopping malls are also easily accessible. Getafe Centro train station is a 10-minute walk away. Set amidst gardens, the hotel offers ample free outdoor parking and 112 spacious, naturally lit rooms, each with a well-equipped bathroom. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. The hotel's versatile meeting rooms, with natural light and a capacity of up to 375 people, are ideal for business or family gatherings. A restaurant serving a delicious breakfast buffet is also available. Whether traveling for business or leisure, the Exe Getafe is an excellent choice. Children are considered 0-11 years old, and guests 12 and older are considered adults.

49996.description: Our pet-friendly hotel is centrally located on Long Island, easily accessible off the Long Island Expressway. Minutes away from the train station and LI MacArthur Airport, as well as popular vacation destinations such as Fire Island and other Eastern Long Island beaches, shopping, and wineries. Our Hauppauge Hotel is great for business travelers due to our convenient location in the heart of Long Island Innovation Park, and a short distance from medical facilities such as Northwell Health, St. Catherine of Siena Medical Center, Good Samaritan Hospital, Northport VA Medical Center, and Stony Brook. Our well-appointed and spacious guest rooms feature newly-renovated guest bathrooms now featuring Dove bath products, premium IHG bedding, 50” LG TVs with premium cable/satellite channels, a Keurig coffee maker, a mini refrigerator, and microwave. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and be sure to fuel your adventures with daily hot breakfast served in our cozy, updated Great Room. Sneak in a workout in our on-site fitness facility and take a dip in our heated indoor pool. Whether you’re planning a corporate meeting or social gathering, our hotel is ready to host your event in one of our two function spaces. Event planners will enjoy a stress-free experience with our knowledgeable team who will help coordinate your needs such as AV equipment rental or catering options.

49997.description:
Welcome to the Holiday Inn Plainview-Long Island; where we offer exceptional service and an ideal location. Whether working or relaxing, the Holiday Inn Plainview-Long Island is the perfect place to revive and stay! If visiting Plainview for business, you will be pleased to know that we feature a modern Business Center, as well as on-site meeting facilities that can accommodate 5-200 guests. We are conveniently located on the Long Island Expressway Exit 46 near several businesses including Canon, Geico, Capital One, Grumman Studios, Coinmach, Leviton, Bank of America, Mattress Firm, Nikon and other numerous businesses located along the Route 110 Corridor. Take advantage of our ideal central Long Island location and visit New York City, the wineries of Long Island, Gold Coast Mansions, Long Island Children's Museum, The Cradle of Aviation, Long Island Beaches, Tanger Outlets, Walt Whitman Mall &Roosevelt Field. Catch your favorite musical artists at Nikon Jones Beach Theater, NYCB Theater or The Paramount. Sports fans can catch a game at Bethpage Federal Credit Union Park, Nassau Coliseum, Citi field or play a round of golf at world famous Bethpage State Park. 

 Enjoy a meal or a cocktail at our Bistro 46.

49998.description: Chester Hotel's Scenic New York Locale Delight Guests From gorgeous state parks to racetracks to Woodbury Common Premium Outlet Center to big businesses, Chester, New York has something for everyone. Experience it all at the Holiday Inn Express® Hotel & Suites Chester-Monroe-Goshen. This Chester hotel's location is close to Woodbury Common Premium Outlet Center, Stewart International Airport, SWF, Stewart Air National Guard Base and West Point. If you're visiting for work in Orange County, New York, the hotel's free high-speed, Wi-Fi access and 24-hour Business Center can help with business needs. This hotel is close to Chester Industrial Park, Tetz Industrial Park and major companies such as Pep Boys, so traveling to meetings is stress-free. If you need to host an event, you'll have access to our meeting room. Visitors can discover unique opportunities for fun amidst stunning Hudson Valley, NY scenery. The hotel's guests can shop at the popular Woodbury Common Premium Outlets, ski at picturesque Mount Peter and sample wines from Brotherhood Winery and build incredible structures at LEGOLAND NY. For those seeking big-city thrills, NYC is only 60 miles away. During your stay in wonderful Orange County, New York, unwind in the hotel's heated, indoor pool or sweat off stress in the Fitness Center. Wake up every morning to the complimentary full, hot breakfast that includes gooey cinnamon rolls. Book now for an unforgettable visit.

50001.description: Get together at the Clarion Hotel and Conference Center in Ronkonkoma, NY. We are located less than a mile from the Long Island MacArthur Airport and offer free airport transportation. Enjoy additional amenities like our free WiFi, free weekday newspapers, a business center and fitness center. All guestrooms feature coffee makers, irons and ironing boards and flat-screen TVs. Select rooms also include refrigerators and microwaves. Also, earn rewards including free nights and gift cards with our Choice Privileges Rewards program.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Stony Brook-Long Island

50002.description: Welcome to the newly renovated Holiday Inn Express Stony Brook, conveniently located less than a mile from Stony Brook State University and Stony Brook School of Medicine. As the official host hotel for the Stony Brook Seawolves, we welcome visiting sports teams, doctors, professors, nurses, students, and their families. We're also a short distance from Brookhaven National Laboratory and the Long Island High Tech Incubator. Our free shuttle provides transportation to and from Stony Brook University, Stony Brook University Hospital, Stony Brook Train Station, New York Blood & Cancer Research Center, Stony Brook Children's Hospital, Stony Brook Cancer Center, and the Smith Haven Mall. This Centereach/Setauket hotel is also minutes from Port Jefferson Village, Stony Brook Village, and the Long Island Museum. Enjoy a free hot breakfast, stay connected with free Wi-Fi and our 24-hour business center, and relax and keep fit in our heated indoor swimming pool. This 100% smoke-free hotel offers newly renovated rooms and executive suites, all equipped with a microwave, mini-fridge, and Keurig coffee maker.

50003.description: The newly renovated Holiday Inn Westbury is located in the heart of Nassau County on Long Island in proximity to numerous businesses, colleges, shopping hubs, medical facilities, and the judicial districts of Mineola, Garden City, Westbury and Carle Place, NY. The hotel is located 25 minutes from the New York’s JFK, LaGuardia and Islip Airports and a 10-minute walk from the Long Island Railroad Carle Place Station to New York City. We are also located 15 minutes away from Winthrop Hospital, NYU Langone Hospital, the Hofstra, Adelphi and Long Island University campuses. The Holiday Inn Westbury amenities include a 24-Hour Business Center, Fitness Center, Lobby Market, Coin-Operated Guest Laundry, AVIS/Budget car rental office, a Full Service Restaurant on premises, along with complimentary parking and high-speed internet. There are countless activities for our leisure travelers to enjoy here on Long Island. We are near the UBS Arena, Nassau Coliseum, NYCB Theater at Westbury, Jake 58 Casino, The Space at Westbury, Tiles Center for the Performing Arts, Long Island’s Children Museum, Cradle of Aviation Museum and plenty of more. Eisenhower Park and Jones Beach State Park are havens for those who love to stay active. Roosevelt Field Mall and The Gallery at Westbury are the common shopping hubs and dining only minutes away.

50005.description: This lovely hotel, located in Long Island, offers 118 welcoming guest rooms, providing a perfect place to relax. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi in communal areas and a 24-hour reception service. All rooms are wheelchair-accessible, and on-site parking is available. Committed to sustainable practices, the hotel minimizes its environmental impact. Conference facilities are also available, though some services may incur a fee.

50009.description: Nestle into your spacious suite at our extended-stay Jersey City hotel near top attractions in the area such as Ellis Island, the Statue of Liberty, Madison Square Garden, and the Empire State Building. Located across the Hudson River from Manhattan, you’ll have stunning city views with easy access to NYC sights and experiences. Enjoy our convenient amenities, such as a fitness center and on-site parking, along with a cozy atmosphere and dedicated service. Make Sonesta Simply Suite Jersey City your home away from home. At Sonesta Simply Suites, it’s better, not basic.

50010.description: The Sonesta Simply Suites Nanuet, an aparthotel in Rockland County, offers bright, modern suites with fully equipped kitchens. Located near the airport and a metro station, it's also convenient to the Spring Valley Marketplace Shopping Center. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a fitness center, snack bar, and complimentary parking. Nearby attractions include the Palisades Center, Paramus Park Mall, and Spook Rock Golf Course. Suites feature a stovetop, microwave, refrigerator, dishwasher, tea/coffee maker, and cable TV.

50012.description: The Armoni Inn & Suites offers 170 comfortable guestrooms with refrigerators, flat-screen TVs, and private bathrooms. Enjoy complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and free local calls. Amenities include a fitness center, seasonal outdoor pool, business center, and ballroom. Guests can also grab a bite at the on-site grocery/convenience store. Free self-parking is available. Located near Dominican College and St. Thomas Aquinas College, the hotel offers 2390 sq ft of event space. Nearby attractions include Tallman Mountain State Park and the Edward Hopper House Art Center.

50017.description: Guests visiting the area for business or pleasure can enjoy the convenience to the popular destinations such as the Culinary Institute of America, IBM, Vassar College, and Vassar Brothers Medical Center. While visiting the scenic Hudson Valley, guests should make plans to see sights like the Walkway Over the Hudson, Frances Lehman Loeb Art Center, and the Samuel L. Morse home at Locust Grove. Enjoy live entertainment at The Bardavon 1869 Opera House, Chance Theatre, and Mid-Hudson Civic Center, located only minutes from the hotel. The Holiday Inn Express of Poughkeepsie is located in the heart of the Hudson Valley. Our guestrooms are specifically designed for the modern day traveler and family who need modern efficiency without sacrificing comfort. As always, you can enjoy our complimentary, deluxe, hot breakfast in the Great Room. Connect with family and friends or get all of your important work done without any hassle by using the complimentary, high-speed wireless Internet. Enjoy your daily workout routine in the 24 hour Fitness Center.

50025.description: Welcome to the Crowne Plaza Suffern-Mahwah Hotel and Conference Center conveniently located near corporations Stryker, Konica Minolta, Jaguar Land Rover, UPS and IBM. Our New York hotel is just one mile from the New Jersey state line and 40 minutes from New York City. Our hotel offers easy to access I-87, Route 17, I-287 and the Garden State Parkway, we are 45 minutes from Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR). Making us an ideal base for business travelers and conferences. Our complimentary shuttle service is available to our corporate travelers Monday to Friday for journeys to many of nearby corporations in Mahwah, Ramsey and Franklin Lakes. Enjoy our 24-hour Business Center and complimentary Wi-Fi. Host a meeting, conference or special event at our hotel, featuring 25, 000 sq. ft of flexible meeting and ballroom space, banquet facilities and a full-service catering team. The Crowne Plaza Suffern-Mahwah is nestled between the lower Hudson Valley, northern New Jersey, Bergen County and close to New York City. Explore attractions such as Palisades Center Mall, Woodbury Premium Outlets, Bear Mountain State Park, enjoy outdoor concerts at Bethel Woods Center for the Arts, kayaking on the Hudson River with Storm King Adventure tours, wineries on the Shawangunk Wine Trail, wander amid sculptures at Storm King Art Center, stroll boutique shops in downtown Nyack and premier shopping at Woodbury Common Premium Outlets.

50100.description: This charming hotel is located in the 16th arrondissement of Paris about 20 minutes away from the Eiffel Tower. The hotel lies within paces of the Bois de Boulogne as well as the famous racetracks of Longchamp and Auteuil. The Stade Roland Garros and Versailles exhibition park are also to be found in the vicinity. Bars, restaurants and an underground station are just 2 minutes away on foot. Charles de Gaulle Airport is around 35 km away and Orly Airport is approximately 25 km from the hotel. The city hotel comprises a total of 27 rooms on 5 floors of which 3 are suites. The en suite rooms and suites come fully-equipped as standard including a direct dial telephone, a satellite/ cable TV and Internet access. Further standard features include a double or king-size bed, a minibar and a terrace.

50483.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace and garden at Hôtel Prince De Liège. Stay connected with complimentary wired and wireless internet access in one of the 32 guestrooms, each equipped with a flat-screen TV and private bathroom with a deep soaking bathtub. The hotel offers convenient amenities such as concierge services, a 24-hour business center, and room service during limited hours. Dine at the onsite restaurant, New Prince de Liege, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. For events, the hotel provides 161 square feet of conference and meeting space. Self-parking is available for a fee. Located near Erasmus House, Constant Vanden Stock Stadium, and Astrid Park, the hotel provides easy access to key attractions in Brussels. The nearest airport is Brussels Airport (BRU).

50715.description: Grand Hotel Central Barcelona, where things happen first. A historic stay in Barcelona’s beating heart that celebrates the culture and creativity of the Catalan capitalThe Grand Hotel Central flung open its doors in spring 2024 under new ownership and management following a meticulous refurbishment led by London design studio, Sagrada (London Art’s Club, Maison Breguet Paris, St Regis Venice). The renovation saw its 147 rooms and suites, two restaurants and bars, wellness suite, a rooftop pool and terrace completely reimagined in Catalan Noucentisme style to honour the building’s history and the fascinating life of its founder, Francesc Cambó, a revered politician and patron of the arts. Located in the centre of Barcelona on the emblematic via Layetana, the Grand Hotel Central sits between the bustling Born, glistening beaches and the sophisticated Paseo de Gràcia, putting the city’s cultural, gastronomic, and creative treasures within easy reach. Enjoy sharing tapas, plates and local wines at Can Bó, the hotel’s lively streetside restaurant & bodega, or light Mediterranean bites and creative cocktails poolside at La Terraza del Central where the rooftop infinity pool gives way to an unrivalled cityscape, far above the hustle and bustle.

50773.description: This elegant and welcoming hotel is set in a 19th century palace in Milan, right next to the beautiful Indro Montanelli public gardens and museum of natural history. The Corso Buenos Aires, the city's most famous shopping area and fashion stronghold, and Porta Venezia metro stop are right at the hotel's doorstep. The hotel's guest rooms are spacious and classic with parquet floors and in-room breakfast and newspapers available upon request. The hotel also offers a 24-hour reception, parking, and Wi-Fi, and the bar is an excellent place to sip a coffee or drink any time of day, while the breakfast room offers a delicious breakfast buffet. With the city's best shopping, cultural attractions, nightlife and the exhibition centre all within easy reach, this hotel offers the perfect base for either an exciting city break or productive business trip. Please note that the costs do not include the tourist tax, set at 7, 40€ per person per night to be paid directly at departure. Minors and other exempt categories can be found on the official website of the Municipality of Milan.

50775.description: This hotel has an excellent location in Vila das Taipas, by a Thermal Resort, 5 minutes from Guimarães, World Heritage, and the birthplace of Portugal, and 10 minutes from Braga. Facilities include a local gastronomy restaurant, a bar, a meeting hall, a garage and a TV room. The hotel is surrounded by beautiful gardens, ideal for a stroll.

50776.description: This hotel boasts a picturesque setting in Vila Nova de Cerveira. Guests will find themselves immersed in wonderful scenery, traditional art and local cuisine. The village of Vila Nova Cerveira can be found just 8 km away. Porto Airport is just 100 km from the hotel. This charming hotel comprises elegantly-styled, modern guest rooms, which come complete with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy an energetic game of tennis on the court, followed by a refreshing swim in the pool. Guests seeking relaxation can simply lie by the pool and revel in the beauty of the surroundings. A delightful breakfast is available in the mornings, ensuring a great start to the day. In order to preserve and offer a calm and relaxing environment to all our guests, the Spa Hotel Minho allows access for children under 12 years old when accompanied by adults until 17:00h each day.

50796.description: This family-friendly hotel is situated within walking distance from the centre of Konakli in the Alanya region of the Turkish Riviera, only steps from the sandy beach. Several pools with water slides, children's pool, restaurant, bar and a spa area are available for guests. The centre of the historic city of Alanya with its attractions such as the castle or the famous Red Tower can be reached within a short drive.

50797.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. When the sun is out, a round of golf or a day at the private beach are two great options for taking advantage of the fine weather. This resort also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. All-inclusive rates are available at this resort. Meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments are included in all-inclusive rates. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Grab dinner at Yada Sushi, a restaurant that specializes in Asian cuisine. Dining is also available at the 5 coffee shops/cafes, and 24-hour room service is provided. Wind down with a drink at one of the 6 bars/lounges or 2 poolside bars. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage.

50805.description:
Among the green hills of Falperra The Lince Braga is more than a hotel - it's a contemporary refuge, with lines traced through history. 

Just a few minutes from the historic heart of Braga, but far enough away to leave the noise of the world behind, it is the ideal destination for those looking to reconnect - with serenity, with nature, with moments that really matter. 

With views that invite contemplation, a spa that takes care of you from the inside out and surroundings made for deep breathing, The Lince Braga Braga is the perfect setting to awaken the senses.

50886.description: Located in the centre of Le Mesnil Amelot, this lovely property is just a short distance from Roissy and close to Charles de Gaulle airport. Roissy International Business Centre, Disneyland and the Asterix theme park are also within easy reach, making the hotel a good choice for both business and leisure trips. This airport hotel comprises a total of 177 rooms and features an inviting lobby with a 24-hour reception desk where guests will receive assistance and information. They can choose to enjoy a pleasant drink in the bar, and dine in the on-site restaurant, which serves delicious dishes. The functional guest rooms come with an en-suite bathroom and all feature air conditioning as standard.

50953.description: This hotel is located at the heart of Barcelona at the crossroads of Calle Balmes and Calle Mallorca, which count amongst the main streets in Eixample. The district is renowned for its wide avenues and top architecture. It is just 300 m to the Paseo de Gracia and the Casa Batló. Las Ramblas are 1 km away and the Sagrada Familia lies around 1. 5 km from the hotel. Sants railway station and the exhibition centre can be found 3 km away and it is 12 km to El Prat de Llobregat airport. The rooms offer maximum comfort, convenience and state-of-the-art technology. Each is equipped with a full bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite TV and ADSL Internet access as well as a minibar, a safe and heating. Leisure options include a fitness centre, a solarium, a hot tub and a sauna. Breakfast may be selected from a buffet each morning.

51138.description: CIN IT015146A156IRVQ4LThe hotel lies in a peaceful area, just a short distance from all major sightseeing attractions in Milan. Public transport connections are situated nearby. With its modern architectural style, the hotel was renovated in 2003. Facilities at this fully air-conditioned hotel include a foyer with a 24-hour reception and lifts. Dining options include an Italian restaurant. Further facilities include bars and a TV room as well as laundry services, Internet access and parking lots. All rooms are extremely comfortable and welcoming, and are furnished with style and simplicity, in a fine mix between classic and modern style. They are all equipped with air conditioning, Internet access, TV, minibar. Rooms specially fitted and fully accessible for wheelchairs are available on the ground floor.

name.content: JW Marriott Hotel Rio de Janeiro

51176.description: Relax and unwind with massages and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge) that operates within 9. 3 mi. Grab a bite at The Carioca, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Rio de Janeiro? This hotel has 7266 square feet (654 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms.

51177.description: This appealing hotel enjoys a great location in London, surrounded by historic theatres and museums and the famous Harrods department store. This hotel was constructed in a cosy country house style and is renowned for its outstanding interior appointment with comfortable service and warm hospitality. Guests may look forward to an inviting foyer with 24-hour reception, hotel safes and a lift. A bar and a W-LAN access point also feature within the hotel amenities, and laundry and room services are also available. The modern, tasteful rooms are all carpeted and come with an en suite bathroom with shower and hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, TV, and an Internet connection. Breakfast is served to guests every morning.

name.content: Garner Hotel Birmingham South East by IHG

51178.description: Located less than 6 miles from both the NEC and Birmingham Airport and with Birmingham city centre just 10 minutes away by train, this hotel offers an enviable location. But while guests may choose it for the convenience, it's the warm and friendly welcome that keeps them coming back. Whether you're exploring all Britain's second city has to offer or visiting on business, this is a great spot to enjoy a relaxing dinner and drinks before getting a restful night's shut-eye.

name.content: Four Points Flex by Sheraton Vienna Mariahilf

51213.description: Four Points Flex by Sheraton Vienna Mariahilf is modern, but comfortably furnished and a haven of peace from which you can immerse yourself in Viennese life at any time. Staying in one of the 62 comfortably furnished rooms with air conditioning, makes it easy to achieve every last point on your itinerary thanks to its central location in one of Vienna's most popular areas, the sixth district. The capital's most popular shopping street, Mariahilferstrasse, is just 200 metres away. Discover the local trendy bars, cafes, restaurants and boutique stores or walk to Vienna's historic city centre in just a few minutes. The nearby parks and woodlands are also worth a visit - the Four Points Flex by Sheraton Vienna Mariahilf isn't only the perfect base for getting to know Vienna, it is also the ideal point of departure for exploring the surrounding area.

name.content: Four Points Flex by Sheraton Vienna Hauptbahnhof

51214.description: This beautiful hotel is popular with guests for many reasons, but particularly because of its proximity to the city centre, making it an ideal base for any stay in Vienna. The establishment is surrounded by countless attractions, including some truly beautiful parks. The Südtiroler Platz underground station is just a few minutes' walk from the hotel while Vienna airport is about 30 minutes by car. All the comfortable rooms come completely equipped and feature a minimalist décor. As for the Executive rooms and suites, they are all situated in a peaceful location and offer views to the garden or a quiet side street. Guests can always rest assured that their car is safe in the hotel's private underground garage.

51215.description:
This attractive hotel affords a charming location in a historical district of Vienna and is an ideal base for exploring the city's famous sights. Good transport connections are to be found nearby, such as the Friedensbrücke underground station on the U4 and the tram from Julius Tandler Platz.

This wonderfully central hotel comprises a total of 70 rooms on 8 floors. Guests are welcomed in the inviting lobby which houses a 24-hour reception desk, safes, and a currency exchange. Within the hotel there is also a breakfast room and public Internet access with WLAN. There is car parking and a garage outside the hotel for those arriving by car.

The comfortable, modern rooms feature an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a radio, and a hire safe. Further fittings in the carpeted rooms include a minibar, a comfortable double bed, air conditioning, and central heating.

Guests may select their breakfast from a buffet.

name.content: Hotel Flor de Sal by the Editory

51273.description:
Hotel Flôr de Sal offers the perfect combination of modern comfort and a prime sea view. Imagine waking up to the sea breeze and admiring the endless blue of the Atlantic directly from your room. Each window is an invitation to lose yourself in the vastness of the ocean, providing a sense of tranquility and rejuvenation. 

Solinca – Health & Fitness Club
•	Opening Times:
Monday to Friday: Between 6:30 AM and 9:30 PM
Saturdays: Between 8:00 AM and 7:30 PM
Sundays and Bank Holidays: Between 9:00 AM and 5:30 PM (AUGUST CLOSES AT 2:00 PM)
Possible changes in hours or closure during festive periods (e. g. , Easter, Christmas, New Year's Eve, Carnival…)
Opening hours may be changed at the discretion of Solinca – Health & Fitness Club without prior notice to the Hotel. 

•	The Solinca Fitness Center is located inside the Hotel building (Level -1), and hotel guests have free access – to access, guests must request an access voucher at the hotel reception. 
•	Use of the swimming pools, indoor swimming pool, and leisure pool All equipment and other amenities are subject to the conditions defined by SOLINCA, and the Hotel is not responsible for the regulations in force. 
•	Swimming caps are mandatory in the pools, and bath slippers are required in all circulation areas. 
•	Bathrobes are requested and provided at the hotel reception (free of charge & subject to availability). 
•	The swimming pool can be used by people of any age, provided that children are always accompanied by an adult. 
•	The leisure pool and jacuzzi can be used by children from 12 years of age, always accompanied by an adult. 
•	The use of the gym, sauna and Turkish bath is only available for those over 16 years of age. 

SPA – Flor de Sol
•	Massages/treatments are not included in the reservation price; however, if you are interested in scheduling, please contact us directly at 910743472 or spaflordesol@gmail. com.

51393.description: Located in the business centre of El Carralero and about 600 m from central Majadahonda, this hotel proves to be an ideal choice for both business and leisure trips. Not far from the establishment, guests will find one of the best entertainment complexes in the northwest area of Madrid with an ice skating rink, multi-cinemas, dining venues and nightlife. For those who wish to further explore the surroundings, there is a bus stop just 100 m from the hotel and a train station approximately 1. 5 km away. The air-conditioned residence offers a charming interior patio garden with skylights and natural plants, which is a perfect venue for different events. In addition, there is a restaurant which serves Mediterranean cuisine, and drinks are available at the on-site bar-café.

51597.description: Hotel Comtur offers any kind of modern comfort to his clients: , wireless internet connection, two meeting rooms, lounge dedicated to our clients, and all rooms are provided with SMART TV , telephone, private facilities, air conditioning and heating, minibar, safe, hairdryer. International breakfast buffet. Restaurant open for dinner from monday to friday.

51654.description: Nestled in the urban business, retail and residential hub of George, this vintage styled hotel finds itself just minutes away from the Garden Route Mall in the midst of forests, mountains and the sparkling coastline. Surrounded by a host of vibrant shops and restaurants in the area, Protea Hotel Outeniqua also offers easy access to the George Airport and beaches and is the perfect halfway stop between Cape Town and Port Elizabeth. Described as an urban hub, this hotel offers unrivaled convenience and value for money. Nestled among the well-renowned golf courses of the Garden Route (George Golf Course 2km) - It is a hotel that complements your travel style. As one of our valued guests, you'll want for nothing at our quaint 3-star hotel as we offer friendly, obliging service combined with the ideal base from which to stay and play. Our accommodation comprises 50 comfortable rooms with en suite bathrooms.

51655.description: Southern Sun The Cullinan offers guests grand accommodation near Cape Town’s famous V&A Waterfront. Make your choice from 394 stately en-suite hotel rooms in a variety of configurations from Standard to Executive, as well as a choice of suites. All of our rooms and suites boast spectacular views of Table Mountain, the bustling Table Bay Harbour and Waterfront or the Cape Town city centre. Our accommodation is classically styled, with a focus on rich finishes and furnishings, while ensuring an atmosphere of comfort and relaxation. Each room has a luxurious private bathroom and in-room facilities that include air conditioning, free uncapped WiFi and others. An optional butler service is provided to the suites on request, as well as luxurious bath and pillow menus. Wheelchair accessible rooms are available on request.

51793.description: Overlooking the shimmering waters of the Mediterranean Sea, Gravel Hotels Select enjoys a wonderful location directly on a private stretch of pebble beach with sun loungers, parasols and a private jetty. The centre of Kemer with its numerous shopping opportunities, restaurants, bars and cafés as well as the marina and museums can be reached within a short stroll. The hotel's rooms are bright and modern, many of which enjoy splendid sea views. Surrounded by a lovely garden area, the hotel features various pools, including a main outdoor pool of more than 1, 000 m2 as well as a small water park with three slides and a children's pool.

51833.description: The Olivia Plaza Hotel, a designer hotel in downtown Barcelona, is ideally located near businesses, tourist attractions, and shopping. Opened in February 2006, this modern hotel offers premium services for both business and leisure travelers. Combining design, comfort, quality, and personalized attention, it provides an excellent base for exploring this beautiful city. Please note: The hotel will be closed for renovations from March 13, 2020 to March 30, 2020 and not accepting arrivals during that time.

52014.description: This beach hotel is located in the pleasant village of Apúlia and the beach is just 100 m away. Guests will have easy access to links to the public transport network, the bus station, the forest, the city windmill and shops. The nearest nightclub is 2 km away and the tourist office is approximately 7 km away. The Cavado River is about 3 km away. Other nearby places of interest include Esposende (about 7 km), Castro S. Lourenço (about 9 km) and Sameiro - Bom Jesus (about 25 km). Guimarães is about 35 km away and Santa Luzia is about 22 km away. Guests will find the train station about 15 km away, in Barcelos. Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is approximately 35 km away. This modern, air-conditioned hotel has a total of 44 rooms and a terrace. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, lift and currency exchange facilities. Wireless Internet access in public areas is also available. There is also parking in the private garage at guests' disposal. Facilities also include a café, a bar and room service. All rooms have a private bathroom, shower / bath, air conditioning, direct dial telephone, safe and satellite TV. Amenities include a double or king-size bed, Internet access and a balcony or terrace. Guests can enjoy spa treatments and sun loungers and parasols on the beach. Golf enthusiasts can practice the sport on the nearest course, about 2 km away. A breakfast buffet is served daily. Lunch and dinner may be selected from a menu or à la carte. If coming from Porto by car, take the IC1 / A28 towards Valença. Then take exit 18 (Apúlia / Fão) and continue straight on Apúlia's main street, Avenida da Praia. The hotel is about 100 m after passing the church.

52034.description: Nestled between the pine forests of the Taurus Mountains and the azure Mediterranean Sea, this hotel offers a tranquil escape near Kemer. Located 15 km from Kemer's center, 25 km from Antalya, and 50 km from the airport, it provides convenient access to area attractions. A variety of a'la carte restaurants and themed bars offer a wide selection of high-quality food and drinks. The modern classic rooms feature comfortable armchairs, flat-screen TVs, and private balconies. Guests can relax by the open swimming pool or children's pool, enjoy the water slides and hot tub, or stay active with volleyball, tennis, and a fitness center.

52117.description: This hotel is not only located just off Brussels' Grand Place but at the heart of the pedestrianized zone that is famous for its countless restaurants. It is just 5 min walk to the main railway station, Thalys trains and the Eurostar arrive at Brussels Midi station, which is just a short taxi ride away or 5 min by train. It is only 200 m to the nearest metro and bus links and an array of shopping venues. This hotel comprises 92 rooms of which 14 are Executive rooms spread over a main building and an annexe block. Each of the comfortably appointed rooms features an en-suite bathroom with a bathtub and shower. Guests can set a comfortable temperature thanks to the individually controllable air conditioning.

52135.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a steam room and a seasonal outdoor pool. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine. Satisfy your appetite for dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and an elevator. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 60 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and plasma televisions. Rooms have private furnished balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

52253.description: This attractive hotel is superbly situated in Copacabana and is only separated from the beach by the Avenida Atlântica coastal road (50 m). Breath-taking views of the beach are to be enjoyed from the hotel. Numerous shopping and entertainment facilities are just a few minutes walk from the hotel. The local airport is about 30 km away, whilst the center of Rio Branco is roughly 20 km from the complex. Renovated in 2002, the hotel includes 216 rooms over 15 floors. Guests are welcomed in the large foyer where 3 lifts are ready to take them up to the comfortable accommodation units. All rooms are fitted with individually controlled air-conditioning for maximum comfort. The hotel also offers many leisure activities and ample dining options. The breakfast takes place at the restaurant Cais da Ribeira (ground floor). Please note that an optional tourism fee of R$ 7 is charged per room per day. The price for parking is R$80 per car, per night. Please note that the rooftop will be closed for maintenance between April 25th and April 30th.

52316.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at this eco-certified Berlin hotel, including a sauna, 24-hour fitness center, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Dine at Cana restaurant, specializing in Middle Eastern cuisine, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel also offers concierge services, on-site shopping, a computer station, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The 144 guestrooms feature free minibar items, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, phones, safes, and desks. The Living Hotel Großer Kurfürst is centrally located, a short walk from Historischer Hafen Berlin and the Maerkisches Museum.

52333.description: Located in the heart of Berlin, the eco-certified Living Hotel Berlin Mitte offers convenient access to major attractions. A short drive takes you to Gendarmenmarkt or Checkpoint Charlie Museum, while Alexanderplatz and the iconic Berlin TV Tower are also easily reachable. This hotel features 58 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, free minibars, and private bathrooms. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and on-site shopping. The hotel restaurant, Cana, offers a bar/lounge and room service during limited hours. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include bicycle rentals, a terrace, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff at the 24-hour front desk. Limited on-site parking is available.

52374.description: This comfortable hotel is located across from Amsterdam's ARTIS Royal Zoo, in a pleasant, green, central district. A 15-minute walk takes you to Amsterdam Centraal Station, Dam Square, and Rembrandt Square, where you'll find a diverse selection of bars, pubs, and transport links. The historic city center, spanning 3 kilometers, is easily explored on foot. Oosterpark is 800 meters away, and the airport is 25 kilometers from the hotel. The hotel offers 19 rooms and features a welcoming lobby with a reception desk, internet access, fax service, and a public telephone. Parking is available for up to two cars in the hotel garage. Each inviting room includes an en suite bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, a TV, fridge, radio, internet access, a safe, and a pantry. Centrally controlled heating, double-glazed windows, and blackout curtains ensure a peaceful night's sleep.

52376.description: Located in Brussels' historic center, Hotel Aris is a 5-minute walk from Gare Centrale and public transport. This provides easy access to the European Quarter and Atomium. From Hotel Aris, explore charming cafes, Michelin-starred restaurants, trendy bars, traditional bistros, Belgian beers, exhibitions, and historic neighborhoods.

52433.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at Ballhaus Berlin Hostel, centrally located in Berlin, a short drive from Brandenburg Gate and Checkpoint Charlie. This hostel offers 18 guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and daily housekeeping. Bathrooms include showers. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include express check-in/check-out and ATM/banking services. Nearby attractions include the Humboldt Museum of Natural History, Friedrichstrasse, and the Oranienburger Strasse.

52434.address: Kadriye Mahallesi, Kadriye 3 Sokak, No: 8/7A Serik, 8/7A
52434.description:
A sophisticated beachfront resort set on approximately 70, 000 square meters, nestled between the captivating coastline of the Mediterranean and the natural beauty of the Taurus Mountains. Inspired by Seljuk architecture, the hotel's elegant design blends modern and traditional hospitality to offer guests a truly distinctive stay. 

With expansive spa and wellness facilities focused on both physical and mental rejuvenation, the hotel also features the Antalya Golf Club, home to Turkiye’s only PGA-certified golf course, offering a world-class experience for golf enthusiasts. 

The hotel accommodates a variety of events with meeting rooms of different sizes and dedicated outdoor spaces, making it an ideal venue for corporate gatherings, weddings, and special celebrations. 

Its refined culinary offerings showcase the finest in Turkish, Mediterranean, and international cuisine, served in an elegant and inviting atmosphere.

52437.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This Edwardian hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at The Dining Room, a restaurant which specializes in local cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. A shuttle from the airport to the hotel is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours).

52473.description: This hotel is located in Braga city centre. The hotel is set at the heart of the historical area of the city. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the city's main attractions, including stunning churches, museums and theatres. The hotel is located just 40 metres away from Viana do Castelo beach. Francisco Sa Carneiro Airport is just 50 km away. This charming hotel is housed in a historical building, beautifully preserving the original design of the premises. The guest rooms ooze character and charm, featuring rustic features and elegant style. Guests are invited to dine in style, in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant.

52558.description: Situated in the heart of Paris on Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré, the Hotel Le 123 Elysees Astotel is a charming boutique hotel. Just steps from the Champs-Élysées, guests enjoy easy access to major shops and attractions. Each of the 41 contemporary rooms features a minibar, modem connection, radio, tea and coffee making facilities, and cable/satellite television. Hotel Le 123 Elysees Astotel is an ideal choice for art and fashion enthusiasts. Please note that the local city tax is not included in the rate and is payable at check-in.

52559.description: This welcoming hotel is situated at the heart of the captivating city of Paris. The property revels in its prime setting, between the opera house and Sacre Coeur, in the traditional district of Nouvelle Athenes. Galeries Lafayette and Printemps can be found close by. A selection of theatres, nightclubs, restaurants and bars are within easy reach of the hotel. The Notre Dame de Lorette can be found just a short distance away. Charles de Gaulle Airport is just 35 km from the hotel. This hotel occupies a building that dates back to 1915. The guest rooms beautifully combine rustic elegance and modern convenience. Guests can avail of the facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

52655.description: Holiday Inn Express® Dunfermline is located just off the M90 motorway and 18 miles from Edinburgh, the hotel is a short drive from Dunfermline's historic centre and nearby coastal villages. Edinburgh Airport is 15 miles away, and for a night out, direct trains from Dunfermline Queen Margaret Station take you to Edinburgh Waverley. The golf courses and beaches of St. Andrews are less than an hour away by car. Families can discover 700 years of history at Dunfermline Palace and Abbey, and explore underwater adventures at Deep Sea World, a 13-minute walk from the hotel. Business guests can easily walk to events at the Carnegie Conference Centre next door. The local offices of Sky, Nationwide, Amazon and FMC Technologies are all within a short drive. At this hotel, you can start your day with a free buffet breakfast, park your car for free, and use the meeting room that fits up to 25 people. The rooms have USB ports to charge your phone, movable desks for work, ensuite bathrooms with showers, and comfy beds. In the evening, kick back with a pint at the bar or grab a snack in the Great Room.

52682.description: The modern Pullman São Paulo Ibirapuera hotel welcomes you. Cozy and soundproofed rooms with reduced-mobility options, offices, and executive floors with unique services. Free WiFi and A/C. Restaurants have varied dishes plus contemporary menu with 'fusion' cuisine, in addition to event rooms for social and work-based events, swimming pool and gym.

52689.address: Alameda Itu 1151 At Rua Augusta Jardins
52689.description: The Mercure São Paulo Jardins hotel boasts a privileged location in one of São Paulo's most upmarket district. On the corner of Alameda Itu and Rua Augusta, the hotel is 656 yards (600 meters) from Avenida Paulista and Rua Oscar Freire, the capital's main shopping destinations. The area also offers various bars, restaurants, shopping centers, theaters and cinemas. The hotel is two blocks from the Consolação metro station, ensuring easy access to other areas of the city.

52691.description: AN UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCE, WHETHER AT WORK OR AT LEISURE. Well located, Bristol Santo André is less than 20km from the capital and close to the most important points of the city. In addition to cozy and spacious rooms, the hotel offers a welcoming atmosphere in the spacious lobby, bar and restaurant. Come to work? Use one of the 5 function rooms or business center, plus parking and laundry facilities so you don't have to worry about a thing.

52692.address: Rua Sao Carlos Do Pinhal,87 Bela Vista
52692.description: The Mercure São Paulo Paulista Hotel is located a few minutes from Av. Paulista, Brigadeiro metro station and the Pátio Paulista and Cidade São Paulo shopping centers. With easy access to the city center and Congonhas Airport, the hotel is near the Pró-Matre, Santa Catarina, Sirio Libanês and Oswaldo Cruz hospitals, and to the city's main entertainment district, including the Municipal Market, Renault Theatre, Gazeta Theatre and MASP. It is 10 minutes from Fecomercio and the Frei Caneca convention center.

52716.description: Built in a fabulous location on a peninsula covering 100, 000 sqm, this beach hotel offers a range of facilities and recreational activities and has 358 rooms over a total of 12 blocks. Decorated in an elegant style, the spacious lobby has a marble floor and eastern feel with its arched ceilings and chandeliers. Located 4 km from Avsallar, the hotel is mid-way between the resorts of Side and Alanya on the Mediterranean coast and has public transport running along the main road in front of the hotel.

52717.description: This hotel is located in the centre of Alanya and it is only 150 m away from Kleopatra beach. It is just a couple of minutes to the town and the recreation centre. The hotel enjoys easy access to public transport. It is 120 km away from Antalya Airport. This family-friendly air-conditioned city hotel features a children's playground and kids' club among other amenities. All rooms have their own wide balcony and are fitted with everything guests may need for a comfortable stay. The hotel's health and leisure facilities include a sauna, Turkish bath and a gym with fitness equipment for those who wish to stay in shape. The outdoor swimming pool complete with a sun terrace, sun loungers, parasols is the perfect place for guests to work on their tan. A separate splash pool with waterslides is provided for children.

52718.description:
This charming hotel enjoys a great location, directly beside the beach and only 200 m from the centre of Kemer. A wide selection of shopping and entertainment venues are all located in the immediate vicinity. A bus station lies about 500 km away and it is some 55 km to Antalya airport.

Renovated in 2004, this well-located hotel consists of a main building and an annexe, both with 3 storeys, and a total of 171 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the inviting lobby with a reception desk open 24 hours, safes, a lift and a currency exchange desk. Further facilities in this popular hotel include shops, a TV room, a hairdresser, a dining room and bicycle hire. Culinary options take the form of a cosy bar and an air-conditioned restaurant with highchairs available for children, which is particularly inviting with its delicious cuisine. Additionally, laundry and medical services are available. The hotel is also suited to business guests with its conference room with an Internet connection and for guests arriving by car, there are parking spaces available.

The rooms all come with their own bathroom with shower, bathtub and hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, central heating and air conditioning. A comfortable double bed, a minibar and a balcony or terrace are also provided in all of the carpeted accommodation units as standard.

There is a swimming pool with children's paddling area, a poolside snack bar as well as sun loungers and parasols in the well-kept, green grounds of the hotel. Guests may also make use of the wide range of health treatments, the sauna, the steam baths and the massage service. It is also possible to take part in aerobics courses or play table tennis or billiards and a broad selection of water sports are additionally offered on the beach, such as sailing or canoeing. Sun loungers and parasols have also been laid out ready for use there.

name.content: Blue Tree Towers Analia Franco Tatuape

52758.description:
This hotel is located in an exclusive district in the east of the metropolis of São Paulo. Thanks to its convenient position, the hotel offers easy access to the outer city ring road. It is only a few minutes by car to the Expo Center Norte, the Expo Mart, and the Anhembi convention centre. Guarulhos airport is a 25-minute drive away. The hotel comprises a total of 134 apartments. As well as an air-conditioned lobby with a 24-hour reception, the hotel features a lounge and a cosy restaurant. There is an outdoor swimming pool available to guests. Sports enthusiasts may also enjoy a work-out in the gym. Child policy: 01 free child up to 05 years and 11 months old, provided they sleep in the same bed as their parents. Suites undergoing renovations: Work takes place from Monday to Saturday, from 9am to 7pm. 
Parking R$ 35 per day per apartment.

52765.description:
Recognized as the #1 hotel in São Paulo on TripAdvisor, Blue Tree Premium Faria Lima combines hospitality excellence with a truly unique location. 
As the only hotel situated on Faria Lima Avenue, it offers an experience that reflects the region's rhythm: dynamic, sophisticated, and contemporary. 
Located in the heart of Faria Lima Avenue—between the Itaim Bibi and Vila Olímpia neighborhoods—Blue Tree Premium Faria Lima connects you to the best the city has to offer. Business, dining, shopping, culture, and wellness are all just steps away. 
Featuring a panoramic rooftop, a heated pool, the Noah Gastronomia restaurant, and services designed for those who value comfort and convenience, it is the ideal starting point to experience São Paulo at its best. 
Blue Tree Premium Faria Lima offers air-conditioned rooms with custom-designed furniture and modern amenities, free Wi-Fi, and a well-equipped gym, alongside 24-hour reception services. The property is surrounded by bars, theaters, restaurants, and shopping malls such as JK Iguatemi, Vila Olímpia, and Iguatemi. It also provides easy access to Avenida Paulista, major exhibition centers (Expo Imigrantes, Transamérica Expo Center, Expo Center Norte), parks (Parque do Povo and Ibirapuera), and both Congonhas and Guarulhos airports. 
Where business, lifestyle, services, and wellness come together.

52770.description:
This apartment hotel sits in the south of Sao Paulo, in Brazil. The hotel lies close to the region's major business and office area, close to the shopping centres of Morumbi and Market Place. A wide range of intriguing attractions can be found nearby. The hotel is just a 15 minutes' drive from Congonhas Airport, while Guarulhos Airport can be found just a 40 minutes' car journey away. This wonderful hotel comprises 400 elegantly-styled apartments, which offer a comfortable, relaxing home away from home. The hotel features a restaurant, where guests can sample delectable cuisines. Hotel charges R$ 6, 25 / night tourist tax. 

We inform you that the Spa and Sauna services are temporarily suspended. We appreciate your understanding and hope you have an excellent stay. 

Access essential information about our hotel, such as guest registration details or online services. 
https://bluetreepremiummorumbi. zooxpass. com/welcome/menu

52778.description: Nestled between Sao Paulo's vibrant Paulista Avenue and tranquil Ibirapuera Park, this hotel offers convenient access to both business districts and airports. The 198 apartments provide a comfortable retreat, each featuring a private bathroom, combined living/bedroom area, and separate bedroom. Amenities include a minibar, in-room safe, and centrally controlled air conditioning and heating. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant and bar, parking in the hotel garage, and rejuvenate in the gym, sauna, or with a massage. A daily tourism fee of R$4. 85 per room applies. Please note, the pet-friendly accommodation supplement is €30. 00 per room, per night, effective January 1, 2025.

52813.description: Located on a stunning Amsterdam street in the cultural heart of the city, this hotel offers easy access to renowned museums like the Van Gogh Museum, Stedelijk Museum, and Rijksmuseum. Business travelers will appreciate its proximity to the World Trade Centre, Concertgebouw, and Rai Conference Centre, as well as being just 20 minutes from Schiphol Airport. Renovated in 2017, this 3-story hotel features 40 rooms, a garden, and a terrace. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour reception, lift, bar, theatre, breakfast room, and conference facilities. The Spiegelzaal provides an elegant setting for various events. Comfortable rooms include amenities such as a hairdryer, direct dial telephone, TV, desk, internet access, individually controlled heating/air conditioning, and a safe. Longer-stay guests can opt for an apartment. A breakfast buffet is available daily, and numerous restaurants are nearby for lunch and dinner.

52858.description: This charming hotel, located in Santo André, offers 180 accommodation units. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi in public areas and a 24-hour reception desk. Committed to accessibility, the hotel provides wheelchair-accessible accommodations and facilities. On-site parking is also available. This eco-friendly hotel may charge additional fees for certain services.

52861.description: With a privileged location, the ibis São Paulo Barra Funda is ready to welcome you, whether for business or pleasure. The rooms have free Wi-Fi and air conditioning, and accommodate couples, singles and some have an extra bed for a child. Meals are optional, with breakfast served from 6:30 am. The bar serves snacks, pizza and assorted drinks. In addition, the hotel has a gym and we accept dogs for a fee. For your corporate event, the hotel has 6 function rooms.

52959.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, a living plant wall, and tour/ticket assistance. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, Le Jadys Pamplona, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in São Paulo? This hotel has 1076 square feet (100 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 64 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

52977.description: Experience a unique stay at Fairmont Rio de Janeiro Copacabana for business or leisure. Enjoy the spa, sauna, massage and beauty salon services at the Fairmont SPA, including an infinity pool. The hotel has a mixology bar and restaurant specialized in seafood, plus meeting and event rooms, including beautiful panoramic view of Rio de Janeiro.

name.content: Lago Hotel Ex Azura Deluxe Resort and Aqua Sorgun

52993.description: Nestled between a tranquil lake (50m) and a meandering river (300m), the Azura Deluxe Resort & Aqua Sorgun Hotel offers a wealth of amenities for an unforgettable escape. Enjoy stunning views of the sea, surrounding forests, and our inviting pools, including four Jacuzzis, from the comfort of your room. Choose from a range of accommodation options including family rooms and luxurious suites. Indulge in diverse culinary experiences at our restaurants and bars, featuring both international and local cuisine prepared by our expert chefs. Beyond relaxation, the resort offers a variety of activities, from invigorating workouts at the fitness center and spa to lively entertainment at the amphitheater and nightclub. Additional amenities include indoor and outdoor pools (with a disabled access elevator), a sauna, kids' club, and shopping facilities. Explore the natural beauty of the area with nearby hiking, jogging, and cycling trails perfect for birdwatching enthusiasts. The hotel is conveniently located 9km from Side, 4km from Manavgat, and 63km from Antalya Airport.

53114.description: This elegant hotel is located in a quiet green area in the WISTA Science & Technology Park, just a 10-minute train ride from Airport / BER. The Adlershof S-Bahn station is just 400 metres from the hotel, providing a direct link to Airport BER, Berlin Main Station, Alexanderplatz and exhibition center Messe Berlin. The hotel offers the ideal environment for business travelers as guests can take advantage of meeting and conference facilities, but is also the perfect starting point to explore Berlin. Beside classical hotelrooms the hotel offers modern apartments with kitchenette and a private bathroom. At the bar or terrasse guests can enjoy hot and cold beverages.

53116.description: Located in an the exclusive park area and suburb of Berlin-Weißensee, with access to a lake in the northeast of Berlin, this hotel is ideal for guests who enjoy jogging or walking, but offers other activities for the sports buffs, as well – like tennis or squash. The lake, where guests can enjoy a swim or a boat ride, is within a brisk 4-minute walk from the hotel, and most of the popular attractions and points of interest in the German capital are within a 30-minute drive. Those travelling on business may make use of the function rooms for up to 80 persons, as well as the free Internet access. After a day of work or sightseeing, the beer garden of the hotel is sure to seem very enticing, as well as the air-conditioned restaurant with its rich menu of local and international dishes.

53135.description: This hotel complex is located in the centre of Cairo and is just a 10-minute walk from the Egyptian Museum and the Khan el Khalili souks. Designed in French style, the hotel building dates back to 1935 and includes 5 floors. This new, peaceful and charming boutique hotel offers 25 rooms and suites. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe and a lift. The rooms and suites are individually designed with an opulent oriental atmosphere along with all modern conveniences, including an en suite marble bathroom, international TV with 15 channels, individual air-conditioning and 24-hour Internet access. The suites additionally include a minibar and a hot tub, while all rooms either have a queen or a twin bed. It is possible to book bed and breakfast.

53136.description: Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the 2 coffee shops/cafes. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 110 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private balconies or patios. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

53137.description: This hotel, situated in a modern district of Cairo near the Giza pyramids, offers stunning Nile views. Surrounded by shopping and entertainment, this 16-floor renovated building houses several dining options: Scala Bistro, serving Italian-French cuisine with vegetarian and children's menus and live music; Regency, offering a casual open buffet for breakfast and dinner; and Papalon, providing light snacks and drinks. The air-conditioned hotel features a 24-hour reception, cloakroom, lift, cafe, shops, a bar, and a conference room. Room and laundry services are available, as is paid parking. Rooms boast classic furnishings, en suite bathrooms with bath and shower, direct dial telephones, color TVs, internet access, minibars, safes, and individual air conditioning. Guests can enjoy a rooftop swimming pool, sauna, sun loungers, parasols, and a gym.

53140.address: El MISSAHA SQUARE, DOKKI, GIZA-P.O BOX 138 ORMAN
53140.description: Located in Giza, this hotel is close to Orman Botanical Gardens, Cairo Tower, and Egyptian Museum. Also nearby are Coptic Museum and Cairo University. The residence offers comfortable accommodation and traditional ambience. Complimentary high-speed Internet access is available in public areas and an Internet point is located on site. The hotel features business amenities including a business centre, a meeting/conference room, and secretarial services. It offers 4 restaurants along with 2 coffee shops and 2 bars. The staff can provide tour and ticket assistance, wedding services, and event catering. The charming rooms open to balconies and come with TVs with satellite channels as standard.

53141.address: Corniche El Nil, Garden City Cairo
53141.description: Luxurious rooms and suites at the Hilton Cairo Grand Nile on Roda Island offer stunning views of the River Nile. This elegant hotel features a wellness center overlooking the Nile, eight restaurants, and an outdoor pool. Each room and suite is elegantly decorated and comes equipped with a work desk, satellite TV, minibar, and a modern bathroom stocked with amenities and a hairdryer. Guests can savor international cuisine while enjoying panoramic Nile views from the revolving restaurant. Japanese, Indian, and Italian dining options are also available. The hotel also offers regular live entertainment on its private yacht. Guests can work out in the gym, relax in the hot tub, unwind on the waterfront terrace, or visit the hotel's Galleria shopping and entertainment center. Airport shuttles to and from Cairo International Airport (20 km away) can be arranged. The Egyptian Museum is a 15-minute walk from the hotel. Guests with Egyptian nationality sharing a room must provide a marriage certificate.

53333.description: Centrally located in Paris, Hotel Vaneau Saint Germain offers a family-friendly stay just a short walk from Le Bon Marche and Les Invalides. The 39 guestrooms feature fireplaces, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Enjoy the convenience of concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and daily buffet breakfast (fee applies). The hotel also provides 215 square feet of event space, including a conference area and meeting room. Nearby attractions include Montparnasse Tower and the Louvre Museum. The preferred airport is Paris Orly (ORY).

53337.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After enjoying recreational amenities such as a health club and a spa tub, a lucky night at the casino is the perfect end to the day. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy international cuisine at Ristorante il Castelletto, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge and a garden view. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Casarile? This hotel has 5382 square feet (500 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and a meeting room.

53383.description: This splendid hotel is the ideal choice of accommodation either when visiting Madrid for business or leisure. The hotel is a mere 20 minutes by public transport from the bustling city centre with plenty of sightseeing attractions and a vibrant nightlife, as well as not far away from Madrid Barajas international airport. Guests will find themselves in a quiet residential area in a modern business district. Guests will be able to luxuriate in the comfort of their ample and tastefully fitted suites, which are a real private sanctuary of elegance and tranquillity. Guests may choose between several types of suites, but all of them will meet the expectations of even the most demanding. Among the wide array of excellent on-site facilities, visitors may pamper themselves at the spa and may sample delicious culinary creations at the on-site restaurant or at the exclusive terrace.

53493.description: Lisbon, city of hills and distinctive light. Lisbon, the city of the Jacarandas, is home to BOUTIQUE HOTEL PRINCÍPE REAL. Situated in one of the trendiest neighbourhoods in the city, this establishment has 18 rooms and suites in an intimate and cosy setting that ensures you won't miss out on anything in the city. Located between the Príncipe Real, Bairro Alto, Chiado and Avenida da Liberdade, BOUTIQUE HOTEL PRINCÍPE REAL offers you a team of staff who will make your visit to Lisbon even more pleasant and unforgettable. As because Lisbon is a dynamic city, we offer an à la carte breakfast between 7 am and 12 noon, which suits the different rhythms of those who visit us. Services and facilities:•24-hour reception•Room service•Reservations: tours, car rental, museums and restaurants•Internet corner

53515.description: Nestled at the foot of the Sacred Heart Basilica in Montmartre's 18th arrondissement, this hotel offers convenient access to iconic Parisian landmarks. A short walk from Place du Tertre and the charming Rue des Abbesses (featured in the film Amélie), and close to public transport, guests can easily explore the Louvre Museum, Eiffel Tower, and Champs-Élysées. After a day of sightseeing, relax in comfortable, warmly decorated rooms that exude Parisian charm. While air conditioning isn't available, a fan is provided. Begin your day with a delicious continental breakfast in the cozy dining room. The friendly 24-hour staff is happy to recommend local restaurants and assist with any needs to ensure a pleasant stay.

53516.description: Located in Paris's 15th Arrondissement, the Europe Hotel Paris Eiffel is a short walk from Champ de Mars and a five-minute drive from the Eiffel Tower and Beaugrenelle. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a business center, and concierge services. Guests can enjoy a drink at the bar/lounge and a full breakfast for a fee each morning. The 37 guestrooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with designer toiletries, and safes. Nearby attractions include Rue Cler, Les Invalides, and the Rodin Museum.

53533.description:
The hotel is located on the Giudecca Island, the largest one of the Venice lagoon with its eight islands connected by typical bridges. In this context with its backwater charm we find the Hotel Giudecca, an elegant building in a vaguely retro style far away from the tourist bustle of the historical center. In its renovation, this architectural lagoon gem has preserved the traits and the value of its incredible past. A private dock on the Palada Canal provides a water entrance. The 30 rooms have kept an ancient and sophisticated line though offering the most contemporary comforts and amenities. 

The Municipality of Venice has established (on some specific dates) the payment of an access fee. All persons staying in the accommodation facilities of the Municipality of Venice are exempt. To obtain the exemption please contact the hotel or visit the website of the Municipality of Venice https://cda. ve. it/it/

53538.description: This airport hotel is some 2 kms from Paris' Orly airport, which may easily be reached by making use of the complimentary shuttle bus service. With its convenient location, this hotel affords excellent links to many of the French capital's top sights. Links to the public transport network can easily be reached on foot and it is a short distance to an array of nightclubs and restaurants. Disneyland Paris is 40 kms away and Charles de Gaulle airport is also 40 kms away. Recently renovated, this fully air-conditioned hotel has 100 rooms some of which offer disabled access.
