In the morning, guests are welcomed into the elegant breakfast room, where they may select their breakfast from an ample buffet. 2 conference rooms are available to those wishing to conduct meetings at the hotel and there is a public computer terminal offering access to the Internet available to all.

53542.description: Completely renovated in 2021, the Victoria Palace Hotel is opening its doors for you to discover the elegant and intimate style of its 92 rooms. Look a little further and step out onto the terrace, where you will discover a refreshing oasis nestled at the heart of the hotel. An eco-friendly and welcoming Parisian hotel that puts nature first. Can you hear whispers of verses by James Joyce? The poet's words echo gently around the Victoria Palace like a soft breeze brushing the hotel's majestic façade, which dates back to 1913. Located on Paris' Left Bank in a quiet little street in the 6th arrondissement, the Victoria Palace Hotel has welcomed many famous figures over the years, well-known guests who have shaped the soul of this chic address.

name.content: Campanile PRIME- Roissy - Aéroport Paris CDG

53543.description: This hotel on the outskirts of Paris offers convenient access to Charles de Gaulle Airport, Villepinte and Le Bourget exhibition halls, Asterix Park, and the Stade de France. Nearby public transport provides easy access to the city center and a variety of shopping, dining, and entertainment options. The comfortable, stylish guest rooms and excellent facilities cater to all types of travelers .

53558.description: This outstanding urban hotel features a quiet location in the north of Barcelona in Sarria-Sant Gervasi district. Guests will find Sants train station a short driving distance away and the popular Monastery of Pedralbes, a Gothic monastery housing collections from Barcelona City's history museum, is just 1. 5 kilometres away. Breaking the mould of classical hotel aesthetics, this luxurious property includes a choice of contemporary rooms, daringly designed and equipped with writing desks and Wi-Fi internet connection. Hotel amenities and facilities include meeting rooms for events, banquet services and an outdoor swimming pool surrounded by deck chairs, ideal to soak up the sun or just to relax. A delicious complete breakfast buffet is served for guests to kick start the day and a covered car park is also available for those arriving in their own vehicles.

53561.description: This 3-star hotel is a 3-minute walk from TORCY RER Station, which leads directly to Disneyland® Paris in 3 stops. Private parking is free on site at the hotel. A TV with satellite channels is offered in all of the rooms at Inter-Hotel Torcy. Each room features a small private bathroom with a shower. All have access to the hotel's WiFi connection and ironing facilities are available upon request. French pastries and seasonal fruit are featured on the buffet breakfast at Inter-Hotel Torcy. Additional hotel facilities include vending machines and a lift that serves all of the rooms. Alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages can be purchased at the hotel's reception. Inter-Hotel Torcy is located in a leisure and shopping park with over 110 shops. Guests can buy cinema movie tickets at a reduced price directly from the hotel's front desk. Paris city centre can be accessed directly using the local RER train network. This property is also rated for the best value in Torcy! Guests are getting more for their money when compared to other properties in this city. We speak your language!

53562.description: Ideally located between the Champs Elysees and the Eiffel Tower. Restaurants, bars, shops and a bus stop can all be found in the near vicinity. The hotel is near connections with the number 6 and 9 metro lines as well as the 63, 32, 20, 22 and 82 bus routes. A number of theatres and museums are also located nearby. Both Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports are approximately 30 km away. Established in 2005, this hotel offers a total of 20 rooms spread over 5 floors, of which 5 are suites. Guests are welcomed in the lobby with a 24-hour reception desk, a TV room, and safe. A breakfast room and Internet access are also available to guests. The laundry service completes the offerings. The elegant rooms all come with a bathroom with hairdryer, a minibar, a safe. Further standard fittings include a direct dial telephone, an Internet connection, and satellite/ cable TV with CNN and EuroSport. Individually adjustable air conditioning and heating are also provided. By road from the Pèripherique exit Porte Maillot, direction Trocadero. Take Avenue de Malakoff then the Avenue Raymond Poincarè. After the Place Victor Hugo take the rue Lauriston; the hotel is at the end of the street at the corner of the rue Lauriston and the rue de Longchamp. From Orly: take the Orly bus to Denfert Rochereau and then the metro line 6, get off at Trocadero, 2 min walk. From CDG: take the AF bus to Etoile Champs Elysees and metro line 6 get off at Trocadero, 2 min walk. PD: This property does not accept group bookings, if a group booking is detected by the hotel, the hotel reserves its right to amend the booking cancellation conditions

53563.description: This fancy hotel, nestled in the centre of Paris, is located close to the theatre district and at a 5-minute walk from Grands Boulevards Metro Station. It is both a great testimony of the past and a great ambassador to the present, offering its guests a concentration of style and comfort. Guests will be able to find, within walking distance, a variety of touristic attractions, such as the Opéra Garnier, Grévin wax museum and the Drouot Auction Room. You can find a lot of restaurants, pubs and cafeterias nearby the hotel. Public transportation offers convenient access to most areas of the city, such as Montmartre, Pompidou Centre and the Louvre Museum. This hotel is perfect for both business and leisure travellers.

53564.description: This city hotel is located 450 metres from Sacré Coeur Basilica and Montmartre, just 300 metres from Notre-Dame-de-Lorette Metro Station. It is only a few minutes' walk to the busy shopping streets with their typically Parisian shops. There is a bus stop just 1 minutes from the hotel, offering direct links to the Louvre Museum and the Luxembourg Gardens. It is just a few metro stops to one of the most beautiful avenues in the world, the Champs Elysées.

53615.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Cairo and was established in 1978. It is close to the Cairo Museum and the nearest station is Dokki. The Hotel has a restaurant, a bar and a fitness centre/gym.

53616.description: The Baron Hotel Heliopolis, Cairo is ideally located in the heart of Heliopolis area, an upscale residential, business and leisure district that hosts Cairo International Airport and has easy access to some of the most popular commercial and industrial zones in Cairo and on its outskirts such as the 10th of Ramadan and El Obour Cities. Baron Hotel Heliopolis, Cairo, a boutique-style corporate Hotel, overlooks the famous historical Baron Empain Palace built in 1911 and is situated three km from the largest retail and leisure complex in Cairo, five km from Cairo International Airport and Cairo International Conference Center (CICC), and 10 km from down-town and the Cairo Opera House. *** Customers with Egyptian nationality who stay in the hotel sharing a room must provide a marriage certificate

53617.address: Cairo-Alexandria Desert Road, PO BOX 44 Pyramids
53617.description: Welcome To Jaz Pyramids ResortStep into a world of wonder at Jaz Pyramids Resort, effective 1st October 2024 (formerly Pyramids Resort By Jaz), where every moment is wrapped in the tranquility of our expansive 9-acre garden sanctuary. Behold the majesty of the iconic Giza Pyramids and Sphinx, painting an enchanting backdrop to your stay. With nature's splendor at your fingertips, lose yourself in the embrace of lush landscapes, verdant palm forests, and captivating vistas, promising an unforgettable retreat in the heart of history and beauty. Here, amidst the whispers of ancient legends, our iconic property seamlessly blends historical grandeur with modernized comforts, offering a truly magical experience that transcends time.

53618.description: This comfortable hotel lies on the island of Zamalek with views of the Nile. In the near vicinity, guests will find the embassy district and a residential area. The city centre is located around 5 minutes away and Cairo airport is only 40 minutes away by car. The internationally recognised city hotel provides guests with a wealth of facilities. Business travellers can make use of the well-equipped conference room while younger guests can let off steam in the playground. The welcoming rooms come with modern amenities to make guests feel at home. During the day, guests can unwind and relax in the sauna, steam bats and massage parlour which the establishment offers. Sports enthusiasts may also enjoy a work-out in the gym, go horse riding, sailing or swimming.

53633.description: Hotel Luz Plaza São Paulo has spacious and comfortable apartments, with natural lighting and a modern and cozy atmosphere. Strategically located in a privileged area in the center of São Paulo, in the Bom Retiro neighborhood, the hotel is close to the commercial, cultural and leisure center of the city, offering great comfort and easy access to the main points of the city. The hotel has a bar and is close to several famous attractions. The property is located 400 m from Estação da Luz, (start of the Jose Paulino Shopping Center), 6 km from Brás, 1. 6 km from 25 de Março, 6. 7 km from Allianz Parque and 4. 0 km from Barra Funda Terminal. The rooms have air conditioning, cable TV, minibar, electronic safe, hairdryer, wi-fi and work desk. In addition, we offer the gym as a courtesy. Bom Retiro is a great choice for travelers interested in business, sightseeing and shopping.

53635.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. For lunch or dinner, stop by Tom, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in São Paulo? This hotel has 2519 square feet (234 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 205 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions.

53654.description: Modern, comfortable and well located, Novotal São Paulo Center Norte offers an incredible experience to its guests. Its accommodations include rooms and suites for couples, singles and families, in air-conditioned spaces and with free Wi-Fi. Enjoy pizza from the first Gourmet Bar in Latin America and, in the evening, enjoy the delights of the Sushi Bar. Make your corporate event in one of the 7 rooms available and make use of the sauna, squash court, swimming pool, kids area and business center.

name.content: Wyndham Sao Paulo Ibirapuera Convention Hotel

53655.description: The Wyndham Ibirapuera Convention Plaza Hotel in São Paulo's Moema district places you steps from Shopping Ibirapuera and a short drive from Ibirapuera Park. This hotel offers 656 guest rooms with minibars, LCD TVs, and private bathrooms. Enjoy amenities like an indoor pool, fitness center, two restaurants including Brazilian cuisine at Figueira, a coffee shop, and 24-hour room service. Business travelers appreciate the hotel's extensive meeting space and business center. Distances to key locations: Shopping Ibirapuera (0. 1 km), Ibirapuera Park (2 km), Shopping Vila Olimpia (2. 7 km), JK Iguatemi Shopping Mall (3. 3 km), and São Paulo Expo (8. 7 km).

53674.description: The H4 Hotel Opera Jardins offers a comfortable stay in São Paulo's vibrant Jardim Paulista neighborhood, just steps from Rua Augusta and a short walk from Paulista Avenue. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a fitness center, and daily buffet breakfast (fee applies). The hotel's 53 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs with cable, and private bathrooms with showers, bidets, and hair dryers. Safes and desks are also provided, along with daily housekeeping. Nearby attractions include Oscar Freire Street and Ibirapuera Park.

53719.description: The Hotel de la Jatte is a charming three star hotel located on the Ile de la Jatte, just 10 minutes from the centre of Paris and close to the Porte Maillot Convention Centre and the Champs Elysées. Facing the River Seine, the property is warmly decorated in a contemporary style that combines comfort and modernity. It offers elegantly arranged rooms, each equipped with air conditioning, a hair dryer, telephone, satellite TV and Internet connection. In a residential district, the hotel enjoys total peace and quiet, while the pleasures of Paris are waiting close by: Place de l'Etoile, Champs Elysées, the Grande Arche de la Défense, the Palais des Congrés Convention Centre, the Bois de Boulogne and other attractions. Guests arriving by car should note that a public car park is available within the hotel area.

53748.description: The Mercure Rio de Janeiro Arpoador hotel is located by the famous Ipanema beach, 7. 5 miles (12 km) from Santos Dumont Airport. It is located in a strategic area, with access to the main tourist attractions in Rio de Janeiro. The comfortable rooms boast modern decor, air conditioning and WIFI. The hotel also features a leisure area complete with pool, fitness center and sauna. What's more, some apartments offer incredible views of the Girl from Ipanema Park and the ocean.

53755.description: The Mercure São Paulo Bela Vista hotel is located in Bela Vista, one of the most traditional districts of São Paulo, with Italian canteens and cultural spaces. 8. 7 km from Congonhas Airport, easy access to Vila Mariana and Liberdade. With modern décor, the hotel offers new rooms with anti-noise windows, air conditioning, Wifi. To complete your experience, enjoy the gym, heated swimming pool, and sauna.

53763.description: The Mercure São Paulo Moema is located just a few blocks from Av. Ibirapuera, close to the Ibirapuera shopping center and just 10 minutes from Ibirapuera Park. Located in the charming district of Moema, the hotel is close to bars, restaurants, shopping ce nters and leisure facilities. Nearby, you can visit excellent cultural attractions, such as the Ibirapuera sports complex and the new Ibirapuera auditorium. Please note that from September 8, the hotel reception will be undergoing refurbishment work.

53770.address: Rua Barao De Maua 450 Centro Guarulhos - Sp
53770.description: The Mercure Guarulhos hotel is located close to Guarulhos International Airport, the Marginal Tietê highway and Tatuapé, with easy access to the Rodovia Presidente Dutra highway and 9. 3 miles from the center of São Paulo. Near the Anhembi convention cente r and Expo Center Norte. We're a great choice for your connection or flight in Guarulhos. Our leisure area with fitness center. We also offer packages for weddings.

53772.description: The Mercure São Caetano, located on Rua Alegre, offers convenient access to Avenida Goiás and Presidente Kennedy, bustling with dining and entertainment options. It's 16km from Congonhas Airport (CHG), close to Green Line 2 metro stations, and a short 10-minute drive from Park Shopping São Caetano. Please note: the pool will be closed for maintenance from September 22nd to October 1st.

53774.description: At Nacional Inn Jaragua Sao Paulo you can count on the comfort of a hotel and the practicality of being located in the centre of São Paulo. The hotel offers large rooms with comfortable beds, gym, air conditioning, family space, parking, electronic concierge, Wi-Fi, and typical Oriental breakfast. Nacional Inn Jaragua Sao Paulo also has an official theatre, with plays on weekends.

53776.address: R Prof Manoelito De Ornellas 104 Chacara Santo Ant
53776.description: Mercure SP Nações Unidas Hotel in Chácara Santo Antônio, easy access to Marginal Pinheiros motorway which connects to the main business centers of São Paulo (Av. Luís Carlos Berrini, CENESP, American Consulate); 3km from Morumbi and Market Place malls. Newly renovated, modern structure, ideal for work stays. Near major exhibition centers, shuch as Transamérica Expo Center, WTC and Imigrantes.

name.content: Wyndham Garden Sao Paulo Convention Nortel

53778.description: Situated in São Paulo's vibrant Santana neighborhood, the Wyndham Garden Convention Nortel Hotel offers convenient access to the city's major events. Guarulhos International Airport is a short 30-minute drive away, while São Paulo/Congonhas Airport is 50 minutes away. The hotel is also well-connected to public transportation, with the Tietê Bus Terminal just 12 minutes away and the Parada Inglesa subway station within easy reach. Enjoy the nearby bars, restaurants, shopping malls, and other amenities.

53783.address: Rua Padre Joao Manuel 202 Jardins Sao Paulo Sp
53783.description: Well-located in the capital, Mercure SP Alamedas is modern, comfortable and perfect for your stay. Rooms for couples, singles and families, with office options. All air-conditioned and with WIFI. Da Franco restaurant offers breakfast and international cuisine for lunch in a classic setting. The event room is perfect for lectures. Take it easy in the gym, pool with a view to the City That Does Not Sleep.

53791.description: The Mercure São Paulo JK hotel is located in Vila Olímpia, an upmarket neighborhood in the south of the city considered the financial and business district. Just 492 yards from the JK Iguatemi shopping center and 3. 7 miles from Congonhas Airport, it boast s a prime location in an area with restaurants, bars and clubs. Enjoy the comfort of air-conditioned rooms with WIFI during your stay in São Paulo. For your well-being, the hotel also has a pool, sauna, fitness center and the Família Castro restaurant.

53792.description: The Mercure São Paulo Ibirapuera Privilege hotel is only 2. 5 miles from Congonhas Airport and 766 yards from the Ibirapuera shopping center. On the quiet streets close to the hotel, you will find a range of shops and excellent restaurants. The hotel's com fortable rooms feature modern decor, air conditioning, a digital safe and WIFI. It also has a heated, partially-covered pool, a fitness center and an events center. The restaurant, which is part of the renowned Don Pepe Di Napoli chain, is open 24 hours.

53800.description: The Grand Mercure São Paulo Ibirapuera hotel, located 0. 62 mi from Ibirapuera Park, is ideal for guests on leisure or business trips, or those celebrating special occasions. Enjoy dinner in the P Verger restaurant, serving the best international cuisine w ith a regional twist, or happy hour at the Aboo bar on Wednesdays. For a complete upscale experience, the hotel offers free Internet throughout, a spectacular breakfast in the Aquarelle restaurant and a bakery with the best millefeuilles in São Paulo.

53818.description: This hotel is conveniently located in the city centre of Itu, near the countless outlets of Plaza Shopping. Major companies, such as HDL, Schincariol, and hot tub are situated in the near vicinity of the hotel. The family-friendly hotel comprises a total of 96 rooms, and features a reception area, conference facilities, and Internet access (charges apply). Guests may also make use of the in-house laundry service (charges apply), and there are parking spaces available for those arriving by car. The tastefully fitted rooms all come with an en suite bathroom, satellite/ cable TV, a small fridge, Internet access, and a hire safe. The air conditioning is individually adjustable, and the alarm call service can also be taken advantage of. There is a swimming pool within the hotel grounds.

53825.description: The hotel is located in one of the best regions in São Paulo, the largest economic centre of the county. São Paulo Avenue lies in the near vicinity. This business hotel comprises a total of 54 apartments and features a reception desk and an à la carte restaurant. Guests may make use of the laundry and room services (charges apply), and parking is available for those arriving by car (charges apply). The tasteful apartments each come with an en suite bathroom and a fully fitted kitchen. Further standard features include a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, Internet access, and a hire safe. The air conditioning is individually adjustable. There is a swimming pool within the grounds of the hotel. Sports enthusiasts may also enjoy a work-out in the gym.

53826.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Business Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s). The following services and amenities are currently not available: Fitness Center. Find all the modern comforts and conveniences you need for a relaxing stay at our Hampton Inn by Hilton Guarulhos Airport hotel. Less than 4 km. from Guarulhos International Airport, our free shuttle will have you here and settled in no time. The city's best retail therapy is just minutes away at International Shopping Guarulhos and Shopping Maia as well as the diverse collection of museums and restaurants in downtown Sao Paulo. A popular choice among business travelers, along with our convenient location, our Guarulhos hotel features a 300 sq. m. convention center, perfect for your next meeting or special event. Prepare your presentation in our 24-hours business center equipped with free WiFi and printing services. Each air-conditioned guest room offers a fresh and modern space with mini-bar, 32-inch HDTV, tea/coffee making facilities, and a work desk with ergonomic chair. Enjoy a great night's sleep on the comfy bed, and stay connected with free WiFi and plenty of device-charging spots. Start each day with our included hot breakfast and help yourself to free coffee and tea in the lobby 24-hours a day. Our onsite restaurant also offers lunch and dinner and our 24-hour fitness center is fully equipped for a complete workout.

53918.description: This welcoming Milan hotel, near Central Station, offers excellent connections to the city's main attractions and is approximately 10 km from Linate Airport. The nearest underground station is within easy walking distance. This six-story, air-conditioned hotel features 50 rooms, including one suite. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a safe, currency exchange, lift, café, TV room, and breakfast room. Laundry service and a cloakroom are also available. Nearby garage parking is available for guests arriving by car. All rooms and suites include an en suite bathroom and are well-equipped. All rooms are non-smoking.

53921.description: This establishment is located close to the pedestrian area of the historical centre, from where it is possible to reach Mestre railway station in a few minutes. The hotel is within a 10-minute stroll of Municipal Tower of Mestre and Piazza Ferretto. Marco Polo Airport is at 12 km from the property. Guests can expect to find 32-inch a flat-screen TV with digital channels. Beds sport premium bedding and the bathroom offers a rainfall showerhead, a hairdryer and toiletries. The hotel has an onsite bar and restaurant in which it's possible to taste International and Regional dishes. The large and functional air-conditioned conference room of the hotel which can accommodate 30 people, is fully equipped for audio and visual presentations.

53938.description: This 15th-century Venetian palace, refurbished in 2014, is conveniently located 20–25 minutes from St. Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge, and just 10 minutes from the central station. Situated in a vibrant area with numerous shops, it's also only 5 minutes from Venice's historic Ghetto. The hotel offers 50 well-equipped rooms, tastefully restored with Moorish-style furniture and featuring amenities such as a TV, telephone, air conditioning, and a marble bathroom. Overlooking both the Sensa Canal and the Madonna dell'Orto Canal, it offers picturesque views.

54015.description: The Pullman RJ São Conrado overlooks São Conrado Beach and is located just a few yards from the Fashion Mall, Rio's traditional luxury shopping center. Offering comfortable apartments equipped with air conditioning, cable TV, free WIFI and amenities, and with views of the ocean or the Pedra da Gávea mountain from some rooms, the hotel is perfect for events, trade fairs and conventions, and a must for fans of good food.

54018.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. For lunch or dinner, stop by Surui, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in São Paulo? This hotel has 1119 square feet (104 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 127 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Cable television is provided for your entertainment.

54021.description: This hotel is located in a residential area, beside one of the most beautiful and enchanting beaches in Rio. Just a short walk from the hotel, guests can enjoy the wonderful countryside. A wide range of restaurants and bars, various shops, and many more leisure options can be found nearby. The beach hotel comprises a reception and a conference room. Within the hotel there is an à la carte restaurant. Guests may use the public Internet connection for an additional fee. The stylish rooms come with an en suite bathroom and an Internet connection. The rooms all feature plenty of space to work. From the terrace, there are breathtaking views of the ocean.

54076.description:
A stay at Sivas Buyuk Hotel places you in the heart of Sivas, within a 10-minute walk of Ataturk Congress and Ethnography Museum and Blue Seminary.  This 4-star hotel is 0.6 mi (0.9 km) from Sivas Castle and 0.6 mi (1 km) from Sivas 4 Eylul Stadium.
Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a sauna and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless Internet access, a hair salon, and wedding services.
Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite.
Grab a bite to eat at one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/café. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM.
Make yourself at home in one of the 114 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

54081.description: Discover the wonders of Istanbul from the Kybele Hotel. This property offers a range of services and amenities for your comfort and convenience, including complimentary Wi-Fi in all rooms, daily housekeeping, a gift shop, postal service, and taxi service. Guest rooms provide a comfortable night's sleep, and some include carpeting, cleaning products, clothes racks, in-room tablets, and linens. Enjoy the hotel garden before retiring to your room for a well-deserved rest. Make the Kybele Hotel your base for exploring all that Istanbul has to offer.

54084.description: Hotel Agli Artisti offers the perfect location for your Venetian holiday, just steps from the Grand Canal and Santa Lucia train station. Inside, classic and modern elements blend seamlessly. The decor evokes a sense of history, blending rich fabrics reminiscent of Marco Polo's Silk Road journeys with a modern Venetian aesthetic.

54174.description: This hotel is situated at the heart of the London district of Chelsea, one of the most modern and culturally interesting parts of London. There are scores of shops and restaurants on the King's Road, in South Kensington and in Knightsbridge. There are excellent links to the city centre, the West End and Waterloo as well as Heathrow (24 km) and Gatwick Airports (48 km). Built in 1935, this hotel welcomes international visitors every year including business travellers from Fortune 2000 and FTSE companies. A wide selection of accommodation is on offer including large suites for bigger groups. The apartment hotel comprises a total of 200 fully equipped apartments spread over 9 floors. The lobby features a 24-hour reception, a safe, a security service, a cloakroom and a lift. There is also a bar and 2 air-conditioned à la carte restaurants serving Japanese and Argentinean cuisine. A supermarket is located right next door. Room and laundry services are also available (for an additional fee), as are car-parking facilities.

54193.description: This hotel is located on Rio de Janeiro's dreamy Copacabana beach and continues to be a favorite with tourists from all over the world. The hotel has attentive staff and excellent services that guarantee guests a pleasant, comfortable and unforgettable stay. The hotel is located just a few minutes' walk from numerous shops and entertainment options. The nearest airport is 30 minutes away by car. This luxury hotel has 579 rooms. The city hotel has several shops and facilities and a gastronomic area. Businesspeople can take advantage of the well-equipped conference rooms, and room service is also provided. Those arriving by car can also take advantage of the car park, as there is a daily charge for parking. Sun lounger and umbrella service on the beach is subject to availability. Tourist tax paid locally R$9. 00

54194.description: This hotel is situated at the centre of the Brazilian metropolis of Rio de Janeiro, only steps from the world-famous tourist destination of Copacabana. There are numerous entertainment options in the vicinity. The hotel's location makes it suitable for business guests and holidaymakers alike. The hotel offers its guests an on-site restaurant. Guests visiting the establishment on business trips may take advantage of the conference room. The welcoming apartments come with a bathroom. The rooms also include a minibar, a TV and other modern facilities. Individually regulated air-conditioning provides guests with maximum comfort.

54197.description: Right on Copacabana Beach, with its beauty, this hotel is in a wonderful location, 5 minutes away from other beaches, like Ipanema, Arpoador and Leblon, and a few steps away from the city centre and the main entertainment areas in Rio de Janeiro. This air conditioned beach hotel offers a range of services: a lobby with a 24 hour reception desk, a bar and a restaurant. For extra fees, guests can hire internet access, room service and laundry service.

54198.description: Located in the famous Copacabana, a Brazilian metropolis of Rio de Janeiro, this hotel prides itself on its location. This hotel is strategically situated on Avenida Atlantica. Museo do Indio and Arpoador Beach are within 3 km from the hotel. The international airport is only a 25 minutes' driving distance from the hotel, ensuring that guests can relax and unwind. The guest rooms offer affordable accommodation for guests wishing to explore and discover the area of Copacabana-Leme. Guests can discover and explore the variety of shopping opportunities, bars and restaurants located nearby. Buffet breakfast is complimentary, ensuring that guests are rejuvenated for their day ahead.

54202.description:
This hotel is located near the Avenida Paulista, with its array of shopping and entertainment venues. The Ibirapuera Gymnasium and Park are only a short walk away. Its location makes this hotel attractive for tourists on a budget.

Hotel facilities include a restaurant, and an Internet connection and a laundry service (charges apply for both).

The functional rooms come with an en suite bathroom, satellite/ cable TV, a minibar, a king-size bed, a hire safe, and individual air conditioning.

The hotel has a swimming pool in its grounds. Guests may make use of the gym, the indoor swimming pool, and the sauna.

54203.description: This hotel is located in the Jardin Paulista district, not far from the Avenida Paulista, with its array of shopping and entertainment venues. Its location makes this hotel attractive for tourists on a budget. The hotel comprises 96 apartments, a bar, and a restaurant. Conference rooms are available for business guests. Room and laundry services are on offer for an additional fee. The functional apartments are fitted with a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, Internet access, a minibar, central air conditioning, and a balcony. The hotel has a swimming pool in its grounds. Guests may make use of the gym, the indoor swimming pool, and the sauna.

54214.description: This hotel is located in the district of Brás in the Brazilian metropolis of São Paulo. The Mega Pólo shopping centre is only a few steps from the hotel. A selection of cultural and entertainment venues lie within immediate reach of the hotel such as Municipal Market, Pinacoteca, Temple of Solomon and other great varieties of sights. This city hotel comprises 184 comfortable rooms, reception, shops, 3 conference rooms and an appealing restaurant. Guests may also take advantage of the room service facilities. The welcoming apartments come with an en suite bathroom, an office, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV and centrally regulated air conditioning as standard.

54275.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Hotel Niel, including complimentary Wi-Fi, a cozy lobby fireplace, and a reception hall. Buffet breakfast is available daily (7 AM - 10:30 AM) for a fee. The hotel also offers a computer station, complimentary newspapers, and a 24-hour front desk. Each of the 38 guestrooms features an LCD television with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a safe, a desk, and a bathroom with a separate bathtub and shower, and a hairdryer. Hotel Niel places you in the heart of Paris, within a 15-minute walk of the Champs-Élysées and the Arc de Triomphe. This hotel is also near Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore and Place Charles de Gaulle.

54278.description: This attractive city hotel is located in Noventa di Piave, 600m from the tollbooth for the San Donà/Noventa exit of the A4 Venice/Trieste motorway. The train station is 4 km from the hotel and it is 15 km to the nearest beach. The nearest airport, Venice-Tessera, is located 10 km away. The location right in the middle of northeast Italy enables quick and easy access to places in the Veneto region. The picturesque centre of Treviso is 22 km away and the lagoon city of Venice lies 25 km from the hotel. Guests are welcomed in the inviting lobby with a friendly reception, a safe, a currency exchange desk as well as a cloakroom and a lift. Culinary options include a bar, a café and a restaurant. A dining room, a TV room and a conference room are also offered. Moreover, there is a WLAN access point. Room, laundry and medical services are available on request. There is also a hotel car park.

54281.description: NH Collection Wien Zentrum, Vienna, formerly known as NH Wien Atterseehaus, is located on the Mariahilferstrasse, one of the longest shopping streets in Europe. Some of the main attractions in Vienna are a short distance away, including the city's Museum Quarter. Guests enjoy easy access to designer shops, restaurants, and bars. Directly in front of the hotel is the Zieglergasse subway station providing easy links to the rest of the city. The hotel is set in a 7-story building with a grand façade painted in the mid-nineties by Austrian pop artist Christian Ludwig Attersee. NH Collection Wien Zentrum offers some of the most spacious accommodations in Vienna so that guests can feel at home. The newly-renovated rooms are designed for your comfort and feature rain-effect showers, relaxation chairs and NH sleep better mattresses. Some also have access to a balcony and kitchenettes. Guests can stay connected with free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. In the mornings, enjoy a fresh, delicious breakfast on the hotel's rooftop terrace, which provides spectacular views of the city. For guests staying on the weekend, the hotel offers Lazy Sundays with free late checkout and breakfast until noon. The hotel has a compact gym and sauna facilities.

54282.description: Conveniently situated within a five minute walk of the Belvedere Palace, the beautiful NH Wien Belvedere hotel provides guests with the perfect stay. The hotel is only three tram stops away from downtown Vienna with its famous State Opera, Hundertwasserhaus, and Stephansdom. Rennweg train station is only a few steps away from the hotel. All of the 114 rooms have traditional décor with modern amenities including free Wi-Fi, flat screen TVs, and a minibar. Connecting rooms are also available. Our spacious rooms on the upper floors offer lovely views of Belvedere Park or the botanic garden. A tasty breakfast buffet is served daily. Guests are welcome to request an early bird breakfast or made-to-order hot dishes. For lunch and dinner, our staff will happily recommend local options such as Salmbräu which is a popular brewery serving roasted ham hock. For quick refreshments, the self-serve open bar has numerous choices. Our compact fitness center is free for guests to use and lockers are available. There is also a sauna, steam bath, and relaxation room for the optimal experience. Our professional staff is always on hand to ensure that guests have the perfect stay.

54284.description:
Set inside a 1930s skyscraper renovated on 2026, one of Madrid's most emblematic buildings, Petit Palace Alcalá preserves the classic charm and Art Deco style of its Calle de Alcalá address. The hotel is just 250 metres from Puerta del Sol, in the heart of the historic centre, and steps from Plaza de Cibeles. The Círculo de Bellas Artes is a 3-minute walk away and the Casino de Madrid is 100 metres from the door, while the Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen-Bornemisza museums are all within a 15-minute walk. 

The rooms blend traditional and contemporary elements and come with air conditioning, a minibar, a flat-screen TV, free WiFi and a private bathroom. Below the hotel you'll find a wide range of shops, restaurants and entertainment options. 

A buffet breakfast is included, and free hot drinks are available at reception throughout the day. The 24-hour reception team can advise you on what to see and do in Madrid, and free bicycles are available, subject to availability. Sevilla Metro Station is right outside the hotel and Atocha train station is a 15-minute walk away. With its location and its landmark building, Petit Palace Alcalá is the perfect base for exploring the Spanish capital.

54285.description: This city hotel is located on Tres Cruces street, on the corner of the completely renovated Gran Via Edificio street. An underground station can be found in the near vicinity. The hotel is situated at just 2 minutes walking distance from the train station in the Puerta del Sol. The Plaza Mayor and the Almudena cathedral are around 300 m away. The airport is around 10 kms away. Established in 2006, this fully air-conditioned hotel comprises a total of 57 rooms spread over 4 floors, and includes a lobby with a 24-hour reception and a lift. All accommodation units are equipped with an en-suite bathroom with a modern hydro massage shower and other modern amenities. The double rooms also feature air-conditioning or heating. Guests may select their breakfast from a buffet.

54288.description: The Travelodge Alcalá de Henares is a modern and functional 3-star hotel with 108 comfortable and well-equipped rooms. The hotel's facilities are perfectly adapted and accessible for people with reduced mobility. It is an ideal hotel for business trips as well as for family getaways. It has a friendly atmosphere and offers a range of services to make your stay as comfortable as possible. The hotel has a car park, 2 meeting rooms, a bar, and its own restaurant where you can enjoy healthy and tasty dishes. You can also bring your pet with you for a surcharge of 20 euros per stay. At the Travelodge Alcalá de Henares, we would love to offer you and your pet the best possible experience. Located in the Garena Plaza business centre just 15 km from Madrid's Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas airport and close to the IFEMA exhibition centre, Travelodge Alcalá de Henares is in a superb location. It is close to the A2 motorway which gives you easy access to the airport and the region's road network. Alcalá de Henares is a UNESCO World Heritage City and our hotel is in the perfect spot to explore it, with the Renfe train station ‘La Garena’ just a two minute walk from the entrance. Don't miss out on the wide range of cultural activities on offer in Alcalá throughout the year.

54313.description: Situated in Noventa di Piave, this hotel offers convenient access to the A4 Venice/Trieste motorway, just 600 meters from the San Donà/Noventa exit. Public transport is within a short walk (50-100m), and the San Donà/Jesolo Lido train station is approximately 3km away. Venice-Tessera Airport is about 10km from the hotel. The hotel features 22 rooms, including five suites, and welcomes guests with a friendly staff and inviting foyer. Amenities include a safe, currency exchange, restaurant, dining room, conference room, internet access, and a TV room. Room service, laundry service, and medical services are available upon request. Guests arriving by car can utilize the hotel's parking facilities, including a garage.

54314.description: The Agape Hotel is conveniently located 30 minutes from the city center and just 15 minutes from the airport, with public transport access within a 2-minute walk. Its 43 well-equipped rooms feature air conditioning, TVs, free Wi-Fi, radios, minibars, and other amenities. Guests can also enjoy on-site parking, a bar, safe, and 24-hour reception and security services.

54316.description: Nestled in a tranquil park setting just 500 meters from Milan's Linate Airport, the 4-star Best Western Air Hotel Linate offers a peaceful retreat while remaining conveniently close to the city. A short walk from the upcoming metro station (line 4) and with easy highway access, the hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Its 102 air-conditioned rooms feature amenities such as 50-inch LCD TVs, free fiber-optic Wi-Fi, and laptop safes. The Pegasus Restaurant showcases authentic Italian cuisine made with locally sourced ingredients, including vegetarian and gluten-free options (upon request). Six versatile meeting rooms, accommodating up to 130 people, are perfect for various events. The hotel also provides 80 parking spaces and a complimentary airport shuttle. Guests can unwind in the adjacent park and appreciate the hotel's commitment to sustainability through its participation in the Stay for the Planet project.

54356.description: Located in the heart of Kensington, a short three-minute walk from Earls Court tube station, this Dreamtel Group hotel seamlessly blends modern and classic vintage styles. Catering to both business and leisure travelers, it offers a range of amenities including a 24-hour reception, lift, bar, dining room, Wi-Fi, and an à la carte restaurant. Recently renovated, the stylish rooms provide en suite bathrooms, hairdryers, tea and coffee making facilities, irons, direct dial telephones, TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi for maximum comfort. Guests can enjoy breakfast, lunch, and dinner in the restaurant, recently acquired by London's renowned Med Salleh Viet, offering delicious Vietnamese street food in a relaxed atmosphere.

54358.address: Av Los Riscos Y Vista Hermosa Peninsula De Santiag
54358.description: This comfortable hotel is located in the wonderful Mexican Riviera, at the harbour of Manzanillo. The property comprises a total of 232 rooms, and includes an inviting lobby with a currency exchange counter. Corporate travellers are invited to take advantage of the conference facilities and, in addition, a public Internet connection is available. The rooms are designed in a Moorish style and all come with en-suite bathrooms and air conditioning. In the property guests will find two swimming pools, numerous fountains, tropical plants, and a minaret. Moreover, it is possible to hire a yacht at the hotel's own marina and explore the wonderful surroundings.

54377.description: Formerly known as NH Galaxy, the NH Amsterdam Noord hotel is in the perfect urban location of Amsterdam North. For great transport links, Amsterdam Central Station is just a short 1. 3km away. Several local points of interest are within a 12 to 15-minute walk including EYE Film Institute Netherlands and the Anne Frank House. All of our 290 modern guest rooms provide contemporary comforts such as free Wi-Fi connectivity, cable TV, and coffee makers. Upgraded suites offer the luxury of balconies or terraces. A freshly prepared breakfast buffet is served every morning and made-to-order hot dishes are available upon request. The Travelers Restaurant is NH Amsterdam Noord's light filled and welcoming dining establishment where a delectable selection of dishes inspired by traditional Dutch flavors is served for lunch. Bar King William III is an additional dining option and serves a range of tasty refreshments. We are always open to chat and provide special recommendations for alternate well regarded local restaurants. Our compact yet fully-equipped gym is open 24/7 and includes 10 cardio machines as well as weights. Towels and drinking water are provided. We also have a free City Center Shuttle Bus for guests providing transport to and from the city center every 20 minutes.

54378.description: Located in Amsterdam, this hotel is situated next to the Oosterpark, which connects the hotel to the energetic city center, the tranquility of the park and the Royal Tropical Institute that is an international knowledge hub; a gateway for the ideas of tomorrow, where knowledge in the field of sustainable and intercultural cooperation are shared. Schiphol Airport is less than 13 km. Hotel bursts with inspiration and renewal. Gusts will joy the experience of the tranquility in the middle of the swirling city of Amsterdam. It offers an inside café where visitors can enjy a drink. Rooms are available for all kind of travellers and attend any need, they are cosy and modern.

name.content: Avani Museum Quarter Amsterdam Hotel-previously NH

54379.description: Housed in the Museum Quarter, the Avani Museum Quarter Amsterdam Hotel is only a 7-minute walk to the Rijksmuseum, the Van Gogh Museum and the Heineken Brewery. Offering a peaceful and quiet location, Avani Museum Quarter Amsterdam Hotel has 163 spacious rooms and a lovely outlook over Amsterdam’s traditional architecture. Superior rooms offer canal views and rooms located on higher floors have floor-to-ceiling windows for the ultimate outlook over the city. Every room is equipped with a mini-bar, flat-screen TV, air-conditioning and free Wi-Fi. The hotel offers many spaces for guests to relax, unwind and enjoy delectable cuisine, including The Pantry or the courtyard terrace. The Pantry is open 24/7 and serves drinks and snacks including coffee and cakes, main meals and wine. Guests also have access to a 24-hour gym and may use the available boardroom.

54380.description: NH Collection Brussels Centre, formerly known as NH Atlanta Brussels, features an Art Deco-style façade and an original 1920s staircase, for a chic and stylish stay. The hotel is perfect for both business and pleasure, as it is a short walk to the Grand Placeand Rue Neuve with the city's best shopping, as well as the European Council, Parliament and Commission. For luxury boutiques and fine dining head to rue Antoine Dansaert. Recently renovated, rooms at NH Collection Brussels Centre feature pillow menus, Nespresso machines and ultra-comfortable mattresses, all to ensure your comfort. Junior Suites, Suites and Presidential Suites each have a separate living room or seating area. Our breakfast is a lavish affair with a wide selection of dishes. On a sunny day, enjoy it al fresco on our 9th floor terrace with lovely city views. There is also an attractive mezzanine overlooking the lobby to relax or take an informal meeting. For our business guests, choose from 6 meeting rooms for any function. Free Wi-Fi and a fitness area are also available.

54474.description:
This hotel is situated at London's most exclusive address, Sloane Street in Chelsea and Knightsbridge, opposite private gardens and a short walk from both Sloane Square (50 m) and Knightsbridge underground stations. The all-suite hotel is also just a few steps away from Harrods, Hyde Park and the Kings Road. It is easily accessible from London's main train stations and also from London's City, Gatwick (65 km) and Heathrow (25 km) airports, whether by taxi, train or limousine. There are numerous bars, restaurants and shopping facilities in the immediate vicinity.

The hotel is a discreet sanctuary in the heart of the vibrant London district of Chelsea. It is an all-suite hotel offering 11 elegantly furnished period suites, born of a traditional English classicism tempered with modern touches and dedicated personal service. The hotel offers a lobby with 24-hour reception desk and check-out service, as well as 24-hour room service. Furthermore, the hotel provides a hotel safe, lift access and a laundry service.

The spacious suites are 45 m² and upwards with kitchens, sitting rooms, period fireplaces, sofas, dining tables and chairs and space to sleep up to 4 people. Facilities include direct dial telephone, TV, Internet access, minibar, tea and coffee making facilities, iron and ironing board and double or king-size beds. The kitchens feature a fridge, oven and microwave, while the bathrooms contain a bath or shower and hairdryer. The rooms also come with central heating, individually regulated air conditioning and a safe.

Cadogan Place Gardens and Tennis Court
Directly opposite Durley House is Cadogan Place, private gardens for the use of local residents and guests. If you would like to stroll, have a picnic, play a few sets of tennis or just sit in the garden, please ask Reception for the key to open the gate. If you wish to play tennis, we are able to book online and to provide rackets and balls

name.content: The Cadogan, A Belmond Hotel, London

54475.description:
Since 1887, The Cadogan, A Belmond Hotel, has been a refined London residence at the crossroads of Chelsea, Knightsbridge, and Belgravia. This reimagined townhouse, with 54 exquisite rooms and suites, offers the intimate charm of a cherished home, elevated by Belmond's impeccable service. The rooms and suites effortlessly blend tradition and modernity. Historical touches like original flooring and fireplaces subtly grace certain rooms, while the top floor can be transformed into a seven-bedroom penthouse retreat. Once a haven for legendary figures such as Lillie Langtry and Oscar Wilde, it now welcomes contemporary icons. Two event spaces, aptly named Oscar and Lillie, evoke the property's storied past, accommodating up-to 60 seated guests for celebrations and gatherings. 
 
The Cadogan provides an ideal base for exploring London's thriving cultural scene. For moments of tranquillity amidst the city's energy, guests enjoy exclusive access to the serene Cadogan Place Gardens, complete with private tennis courts. 
 
Willett’s, the hotel's British bistro, offers familiar comforts with a meticulously crafted seasonal menu by Executive Chef Michael Turner. The Drawing Room perfect for a cozy morning read or an elegant evening cocktail, a true home away from home from dawn till dusk. 
 
The hotel’s dedicated concierge team, all members of Les Clefs d’Or, possess the secret key to unlocking London's latest theatre shows and bespoke experiences. 
 
Furthermore, The Cadogan’s proximity to Victoria Station facilitates seamless onward journeys aboard Belmond's legendary trains: The British Pullman or Britannic Explorer, inviting guests to explore England and Wales in unparalleled style and luxury.

54478.description: In the heart of Vienna, surrounded by greenery: Boutiquehotel Stadthalle by cocoon is your urban base camp with a clear conscience. Stylish design meets genuine sustainability, relaxed rooms meet green courtyards. Thanks to its central location near Westbahnhof station, you can get anywhere quickly—and come back down just as quickly. For city and business trips with attitude.

54479.description: Located on Vienna's Mariahilferstrasse, this historic 1924 hotel offers easy access to the city's attractions. The U3 Neubaugasse station is just steps away, connecting you to sites like the Museum of Fine Arts, Hofburg Palace, and St. Stephen's Cathedral within minutes. The hotel features 17 rooms across four floors, a breakfast room, elevator, internet terminal, and on-site garage (fees apply). Enjoy amenities like room service and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the building. Each room includes an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, free Wi-Fi, minibar, mini-safe, and cable TV. Non-smoking and family rooms are available upon request. Start your day with a delicious buffet breakfast each morning. Conveniently reach the hotel from Vienna Airport via the Vienna Airport Lines express coach or S-Bahn to Landstrasse/Wien Mitte, then take the U3 to Neubaugasse. Detailed directions for arriving by car are also available.

54480.description: This appealing historical hotel lies on the banks of the Brent Canal in Mira, Venice, on a traffic junction between Padua and Venice. Due to its rich artistic and architectural treasures, the famous villas of Palladio are known throughout Mira, Venice. Links to the public transport system are within 5 minutes walk of the hotel, whilst the train station is a 5-minute drive away. It is a mere 20 minutes by car to Venice. The beach of Sottomarina is a 20-minute drive away and it is about 20 km to Venice's airport. Dating back to the 16th century and enjoying a UNESCO listing, the hotel comprises 30 rooms and is fully air-conditioned. Guests are greeted in an inviting lobby featuring a reception, and a safe where valuables may be deposited. The hotel also has a beautiful conservatory. Culinary options include a cosy bar and an elegant breakfast room. Guests arriving on business may use a conference room. Room service rounds off the facilities on offer. Those arriving by car may make use of the hotel car park and guests are presented with the opportunity to rent out bicycles. The comfortably furnished rooms all come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a double or king-size bed, a minibar, satellite/ cable TV and a direct dial telephone. Also featuring in the rooms are individually controllable heating and air conditioning. The rooms additionally offer access to wheelchair users. The hotel is especially well located for holidaymakers wishing to take cycling tours along the Riviera Brenta. A golf course, a swimming pool and a gym are located close to the hotelIn the mornings, guests are able to select from a continental breakfast . It is possible to book a Half-Board stay.

54481.description: Laying in the area of Berlin referred to as the Engelbecken (Angel Basin), this hotel is exactly between Alexanderplatz and Potsdamer Platz, a 10-minute stroll from Fischerinsel. Due to its location it is ideal for those who want to visit Nikolaiviertel, the historical centre, which is just 1 km away and a 5-minute walk will take them to the nearest underground station, which provides quick and convenient access to the entire city. The venue also offers bicycle rental services, ideal for moving around quickly and independently. After a day of sightseeing there its well-appointed rooms will provide everything needed for a good night sleep - soundproofed ambience and cosy beds. A delicious breakfast buffet is provided each morning, so guests can be satisfied and happy as they walk out of the hotel.

54482.description: The NH Potsdam hotel, formerly known as NH Voltaire Potsdam, is set in the city's historic center. It's located close to top restaurants and bars, as well as the palace complexes and famous park. To visit Berlin, hop on the train which will get you there in just 30 minutes. NH Potsdam is in a stunning building with a façade that dates back to the 19th century. The rooms compliment the striking architecture and are decorated in a warm sand and Prussian blue color palette. These are quiet and comfortable spaces with many overlooking the Dutch quarter. We also have connecting rooms while the Brühl Palais wing houses 16 Superior rooms and three Suites. Every room comes with free Wi-Fi. Our breakfast is a delicious affair and includes a variety of hot and cold options. The Hofgarten restaurant serves local and Mediterranean specialties for lunch and dinner, or guests can enjoy a light meal with a drink at the cozy Karree bar. In the summer, enjoy your meal and drinks on our outdoor terrace. NH Potsdam has a number of amenities where guests can relax and unwind, including the use of a neighboring gym, and on-site sauna. For business travelers, we also have 8 meeting rooms.

54493.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Sara Hotel, including complimentary Wi-Fi and a TV in the common area. Dine at the on-site restaurant or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel also offers express check-in/check-out and a 24-hour front desk. Stay in one of the 18 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions with digital programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and hair dryers. Guestrooms also offer phones, desks, and daily housekeeping. Located in the heart of Milan, Sara Hotel is a short walk from Corso Buenos Aires and a quick drive from Piazza della Repubblica. It's also conveniently close to Linate Airport.

54514.description: Steeped in culture and elegance, this hotel enjoys a superb location in London. The hotel is situated just a short distance away from the Victoria and Albert Museum, the Serpentine Gallery, the Science Museum and Hyde Park. The Natural History Museum, Diana Memorial and Harrods can also be found nearby. Guests can explore the mesmerising Kensington Palace and Gardens, as well as the many shopping opportunities on Kensington High Street. This charming property adds contemporary style to its historical setting. The guest rooms ooze elegance and character. Guests can enjoy a delightful meal in the restaurant, refreshing drinks in the bar, or simply sit back and enjoy the view over the city rooftops.

54733.description: Affording a unique location at the heart of the Peneda/Gerês National Park, this hotel offers guests breath-taking views out over the Cávado River and the Caniçada dam. Guests may enjoy the wonderful scenery and beautiful sunsets that are reflected in the river's waters whilst relaxing on the hotel terrace with a delicious appetiser or when on an evening stroll through the hotel gardens. A total of 29 rooms are available on offer at this air-conditioned complex. All of them are fitted with central heating and other modern amenities. Guests may enjoy the hotel's swimming pool and tennis courts. Family games are organised and the surrounding area offers many more leisure options such as fishing (in the dam), tours of the national park (with or without a guide), horse riding, hiking, shooting, water sports (also in the dam) and boat trips.

name.content: Pousada de Viana do Castelo - Historic Hotel

54738.description: This splendid hotel is set in a magnificent, Belle Epoque-style building which is perched atop of Mt. St. Luzia, only 600 metres from the Basilica of Santa Luzia. This excellent setting provides fantastic views over the town. The main railway station of Viana do Castelo is within walking distance and much of the town can be reached within a ten-minute drive. The hotel is one of the Pousadas of Portugal, offering spacious and luminous guest rooms with sombre and tasteful décor and modern amenities such as hydro massage baths, wireless internet access, cable television and air-conditioning. The onsite restaurant serves lavish regional and international dishes, and guests can take advantage of the hotel's excellent facilities, including an outdoor pool, 24-hour reception, business centre, games room, and bicycle rental, all during a fabulous retreat to one of Portugal's most stunning and historic cities.

54773.description: The NH Brussels Airport hotel is within a five-minute drive of Brussels International Airport. It is also close to Diegem Station, so you can reach Brussels city center in just 15 minutes by public transport. The hotel has 234 spacious rooms. These are finished in natural warm colors and have soundproofing to ensure our guests get a great night's sleep. There are connecting rooms available which are perfect for families and groups. Each morning, NH Brussels Airport serves up a delicious breakfast buffet that includes options for any taste. Choose from cold cuts, cheeses, fruit, pastries, breads, cereals, and more, along with freshly brewed coffee and juice. For lunch or dinner, enjoy a meal at the Brasserie which offers international dishes. We also have a lobby bar where you will find authentic Belgian beers and snacks. In warm weather, you can choose to have your meal and drinks al fresco on the outdoor terrace. There is a 24/7 self-service Open Bar in case you get hungry out of hours. Our guests can stay fit during their stay at the fitness center. There are also seven meeting rooms on-site.

54814.description:
The Crowne Plaza Paris Marne-la-Vallée, fully renovated in 2026, welcomes guests to an elegant setting overlooking the prestigious Paris Val d'Europe Golf Course. Ideally located just a 10-minute drive from Disneyland® Paris and only 4 km from Val d'Europe Shopping Center and the RER station, the hotel offers the perfect balance of tranquility and accessibility. 

Designed with contemporary sophistication, the hotel's spacious rooms and suites feature refined décor and beautiful views of the golf course or landscaped gardens. Each accommodation is equipped with a flat-screen TV, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and tea and coffee-making facilities, while selected suites offer a separate living area for enhanced comfort and relaxation. 

Start the day with an abundant breakfast buffet at L'Orangerie, where a selection of fresh, seasonal products is served in a bright and welcoming atmosphere. For lunch or dinner, La Clairière invites guests to discover refined Mediterranean-inspired cuisine, while the Mystic Bar provides an elegant setting to enjoy signature cocktails, light bites, and gourmet sandwiches throughout the day. 

Reserved exclusively for hotel guests, the wellness area is a true haven of relaxation, featuring an indoor heated swimming pool, sauna, steam room, and a fully equipped fitness center—ideal for unwinding after a day at the parks or on the golf course.

54817.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this Georgian hotel include concierge services and a television in a common area. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 9 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. Planning an event in Edinburgh? This hotel has 22 square feet (2 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 16 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment.

54818.address: Corner of Main Road (M9) & Broadway Boulevard (R44
54818.description: Nestled amidst the natural beauty of the Cape Winelands, The Lord Charles welcomes guests with warm hospitality and effortless luxury. Situated a mere 20 minutes from Cape Town International Airport, The Lord Charles is a unique hotel combining the relaxed elegance and sophistication of a modern hotel, with the ease and charm of the local countryside. The Lord Charles has simply combined an international, cosmopolitan style, with a local flair and warmth making it a comfortable home-away-from-home from which guests can discover and enjoy their business or leisure activities.

54911.description: Located in Döbling, Vienna, the Living Hotel Kaiser Franz Joseph is a short drive from Setagaya Park and Grinzinger Friedhof. This upscale hotel offers 304 guest rooms with refrigerators, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy on-site amenities including a spa with massages, a health club, sauna, restaurant, and bar/lounge. A business center and conference facilities are also available. The hotel is conveniently located near Turkenschanzpark and Beethoven-Heiligenstadter-Testament.

54958.description: This hotel is located just 150 m from the beach and the Mediterranean shore. Within a radius of around 700 m, guests will find a range of bars, nightclubs, shops and links to the public transport network in the city centre. There is a bus station roughly 6 km away in Manavgat. Roughly 12 kms away, guests will find the Manavgat waterfall and Manavgat dam is around 18 kms from the hotel. Antalya airport lays 65 kms from the hotel. Established in 2004, the hotel features a terrace and 5 buildings each with 2 floors and a total of 124 rooms. The air-conditioned club resort offers a variety of entertainment and leisure activities. Guests will also find a garden surrounding the hotel as well as a café and a restaurant with a smoking area and highchairs available for children. Younger guests may participate in the kids' club activities as well as let off steam in the children's playground.

54973.description: This hotel is located only about 20 minutes away from Cancun International Airport. It is situated in the heart of the hotel zone, only about 50 m from the congress centre and the shopping streets. The famous restaurants and night clubs of the city are only a short distance away, and the nearest beach can also be found nearby. Renovated in 2006, the hotel offers guests an outstanding location in the heart of Cancun, and comprises a total of 84 rooms spread across ten floors as well as a terrace and gardens. The lobby offers a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe and lifts. Additional facilities include a café, a bar and a restaurant, as well as a breakfast room and parking for those arriving by car. The rooms with sea views all come with an en suite bathroom and satellite TV. The large rooms feature two double beds or one king-size bed, individually adjustable air conditioning, a safe, a sitting area, and a balcony. The rooms offer room for up to four persons. The complex features a swimming pool with a children's pool as well as a sun terrace with sun loungers laid out ready for use.

name.content: Campanile Val de France près de Disneyland® Paris

54977.address: Avenue De La Fosse Des Pressoirs, 10
54977.description: The Campanile Val de France près de Disneyland® Paris offers a cozy and relaxing atmosphere for families. CDG Airport is 40 kilometers away, approximately a 40-minute drive, while downtown Paris (Eiffel Tower, Champs-Élysées) is a 50-minute RER train ride. A free shuttle to Disneyland Paris is provided. The two-story hotel features an elevator and offers a variety of rooms with double or twin beds, most including bunk beds. All rooms have air conditioning and bathrooms with a bath, shower, and hairdryer. The hotel also boasts three soundproofed meeting rooms with natural light and air conditioning, accommodating up to 200 people.

name.content: Arden Guest House, Edinburgh - SELF CHECK IN

55019.description: 'Located on the outskirts of Edinburgh's city center, the OYO Arden Guest House offers comfortable accommodations near Craigmillar Castle and the scenic Portobello Beach. Each clean, tidy room features soft decor, plush beds, en suite bathrooms, free WiFi, TVs, and tea & coffee making facilities. Guests can also enjoy the hotel's garden with outdoor furniture, as well as books and board games. Free secure onsite parking is available, along with accessible and street parking options. While the hotel is conveniently located near major attractions such as the National Museum of Scotland, Mary King's Close, and the Royal Mile, please note that it does not have wheelchair access. Breakfast service is currently unavailable but will resume on February 1, 2023. '

55054.description: Recently refurbished, the hotel des Batignolles is now a 3-star hotel. This city hotel, built in 1850, is located in the 17th arrondissement in a side street, very close to Montmartre, Sacré Coeur, Moulin Rouge. The Opera and the Park Monceau are also within easy reach. Place de Clichy and Rome underground stations are within walking distance from the hotel, and offer convenient links to most sites of Paris. This familiar hotel is the perfect starting point to explore the sights of this wonderful city.

55073.description: Breakfast and WIFI are included in all rates at the hotel. Located in the 13th arrondissement of Paris, between the French national library and the business district, our hotel is a stone's throw from the Porte d'Ivry (line 7) and Olympiades (line 14) met ro stations. Rooms are air conditioned and spacious, and equipped with satellite television, a bathroom, hairdryer and safe. 24-hour reception with very welcoming staff.

55093.description: Located in London's Hammersmith and Fulham borough, the Holiday Inn Express London - Earl's Court offers convenient access to Kensington High Street and the Natural History Museum, both within a 5-minute drive. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine. The 150 guestrooms feature LCD televisions with satellite programming, and bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy a complimentary continental breakfast daily and grab a bite at the snack bar/deli or a drink at the bar/lounge. A business center and 24-hour front desk are also available. Onsite parking is limited.

55282.description: Whether you're here for shopping in the V&A, for conferencing at the CTICC, or for exploring the Mother City, each of the hotel's 537 rooms and suites are well-appointed with everything you'll need for work or play. Combining comfy and contemporary décor with modern amenities, it's easy to make yourself at home at Southern Sun Waterfront Cape Town. Accommodation options include great-value Standard Rooms, Family Rooms with two double beds, business friendly Executive Rooms, and spacious Suites with an open-plan lounge. Whichever accommodation option you choose, you'll get free uncapped WiFi, air-conditioning, tea and coffee facilities, DStv, space to work, an en-suite bathroom with bath and shower, and more.

55283.description: Designed for work and play, accommodation at our Gardens hotel blends contemporary design and great comfort with affordable room rates. The SunSquare Cape Town Gardens hotel has 136 rooms with Standard Room, twin double bed Family Room, and spacious king bed Suite options designed for solo, group and family travel. Every room type in our Gardens accommodation is well-appointed with an en-suite bathroom, free uncapped WiFi, air-conditioning, space to work, a mini-fridge, flatscreen with DStv channels, and more. The hotel also offers wheelchair-accessible rooms as well as smoking rooms on request. Suites are a favourite choice for business executives and Cape Town staycations. A spacious bedroom with comfortable king bed is complemented by a private lounge and dining area and views overlooking the historic Gardens suburb. Select Suites also feature two separate sleeping areas making them ideal for family travel.

55284.address: CNR. MELBOURNE & CORONATION ROADS, Walmer Estate
55284.description: Whether you're visiting the Mother City for a vacation or business, our Woodstock accommodation has everything you need for a relaxing and productive stay. The Garden Court Nelson Mandela Boulevard hotel's 292 en-suite rooms include a choice of bed configurations making them perfect for solo, group, and family travel. Great value rooms feature an excellent selection of amenities like air-conditioning, free unlimited WiFi, in room tea and coffee, space to work, flat screen with DStv, a comfy bed, and a choice of either Signal Hill or harbour views. In room dining is available between 17h30 and 22h00 daily for guests who prefer the convenience and privacy of their own rooms. The hotel also offers wheelchair-accessible rooms as well as smoking rooms on request.

55289.description: Whether you're here to wander amongst the beauty of Kirstenbosch Gardens, cheer on your team at Newland's cricket grounds, or for business in Cape Town, each of our 162 rooms and suites are well-appointed with everything you'll need for business and leisure. Combining classic comfort and modern amenities, it's easy to make yourself at home at Southern Sun Newlands. Accommodation options include great-value Standard Rooms, Family Rooms with two double beds, and spacious Suites with a separate lounge. Each accommodation choice includes free uncapped WiFi, air-conditioning, tea and coffee facilities, DStv, space to work, an en-suite bathroom and more.

55297.address: King George Drive, King George Park, 0
55297.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at this colonial-style hotel, complete with complimentary Wi-Fi and amenities such as concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and wedding services. Dine at the Fairway Terrace Restaurant, featuring a bar/lounge and garden views, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (fees apply). Business travelers appreciate the 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities include a conference center and four meeting rooms. Roundtrip airport shuttle service is available (surcharge, 24 hours), along with free self-parking. Relax in one of the 109 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions, private balconies or patios, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include the George Museum (1. 4 mi), Kingswood Golf Estate (1. 4 mi), and the Garden Route Botanical Garden (1. 9 mi). The preferred airport is George (GRJ), 7. 9 miles from the hotel.

55298.address: Cnr Of Church And Market Streets
55298.description: Located in the heart of Mossel Bay, the Protea Hotel by Marriott Mossel Bay is steps from the Dias Museum and a short distance from Mossel Bay Harbour and Santos Beach. This upscale hotel offers an outdoor pool, a fitness center, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can also enjoy concierge and wedding services, plus a shuttle service (surcharge) within a 40 km radius. The 38 air-conditioned rooms feature LCD TVs, down comforters, premium bedding, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Enjoy a meal at the poolside Cafe Gannet Restaurant with garden views and al fresco dining, or take advantage of room service. Two bars/lounges offer refreshing beverages. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). For business travelers, there's a business center, express check-in/check-out, a conference center, and a meeting room.

55299.address: 9 Ryk Tulbagh Square, Hans Strijdom Ave, Foreshore
55299.description: The Foreshore Hotel on the Square City Hotel is conveniently located within walking distance of Cape Town's vibrant V&A Waterfront, City Centre, and CTICC. Just minutes away, you'll find shopping destinations like Green Market Square, St Georges Mall, and the Flower Market. This modern hotel offers 50 spacious Standard and Deluxe en-suite rooms, each designed for comfort and tranquility. Amenities include a mini-fridge, tea/coffee facilities, a Nespresso machine, air conditioning, heating, a flat-screen satellite TV, and Wi-Fi. A desk and a lounge area with a couch, coffee table, and chairs complete the comfortable setting. The hotel's four floors are accessible by lift or stairs. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant, open from 6:30 am to 9:00 pm daily, and drinks at the bar, open from 11:00 am to 9:00 pm. Secure, off-site parking is available nearby for a daily fee. Reception and security are staffed 24/7.

55304.address: R310 Lynedoch Road, Baden Powell Drive
55304.description: Discover comfort and connection at the family-owned Spier Wine Farm in the heart of the Stellenbosch Winelands. Set within the natural beauty of the Cape Floral Kingdom, the new 80-room Fairtrade-accredited Spier Hotel features elegant rooms in a village-style layout, wild-landscaped gardens, and a world-class Cape Herbal Spa and Bath House. Guests can indulge in seasonal South African food at the new Veld and Garden Room restaurants or unwind with award-winning wines at the Wine Bar and Rooftop Bar. Discover Spier’s 3, 700-piece contemporary art collection, relax at our expansive heated pool, or experience the best of Spier Wine Farm, along with daily hosted experiences exclusive to hotel guests. Children can enjoy a dedicated nature-inspired kids' club, and the hotel is conveniently located just 30 minutes from Cape Town International Airport. “Our farm hotel will be an immersive place of peace and connection. Simple and timeless, with elegant comfort that never shouts. Set in a magnificent wild cape garden, it will be a more personal, more encompassing expression of our families vision. ” Mariota Enthoven, Family Owner

55373.description: Situated in the renowned tourist resort of Cancun, this fabulous hotel is an ideal place to disconnect from daily routine. Travellers will find themselves within amazing sandy beaches, stunning natural beauty and strategically situated to explore rich local heritage. Cancún International Airport is situated within 22 kilometres away. Set just a few steps from pristine beach surrounded by turquoise waters of Caribbean Sea and only a short stroll from the city centre with multiple restaurants, shops and entertainment venues, this property is the perfect place for a relaxing getaway.
