Visitors will revel in large and cosy rooms which offer an oasis of peace and tranquillity. The on-site restaurant immerses visitors into Yucatan and Mexican flavours, which might be followed by a drink from the bar. Patrons may refresh themselves with a plunge in the pool or relax in the lavish garden. The establishment also features business centre and parking for added convenience.

55404.description: The four-star Hotel Beauregard, situated on Paris's Left Bank, offers guests a tranquil escape moments from the Eiffel Tower. Modern amenities, including flat-screen TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi, are standard in each room, while select rooms boast balconies with Eiffel Tower views. A full buffet breakfast is served daily, and laptop rentals are available at reception. The hotel's central location provides easy access to the Porte de Versailles Exhibition Centre, the Montparnasse business district, as well as numerous shops, restaurants, and Metro stations. Please note that the city tax is not included in the room rate and is payable directly to the hotel upon check-in/out.

55493.description: The NH Wien City hotel is set in a perfect location on Mariahilferstrasse and puts guests within easy reach of excellent shopping selections and points of interest. The Leopold Museum and Museum of Natural History are less than a kilometer away and Vienna's historical city center is only a 10-minute walk. The Neubaugasse metro station is conveniently situated in front of the hotel. Each of our 105 spacious rooms offer modern conveniences. Free Wi-Fi, flat screen TVs, and coffee and tea-making facilities come as standard in every room. For those looking for even greater comfort, we offer an Apartment Suite which has a separate sitting area and kitchenette complete with Nespresso machine. In the mornings, guests are welcome to enjoy a healthy breakfast buffet. For early risers, we offer an early bird breakfast option. Our open bar supplies light refreshments 24 hours a day, every day. Given the numerous local restaurants, we will gladly recommend high-quality dining options for lunch and dinner. Our compact gym, sauna and relaxation area are additional amenities that our guests can enjoy. To further enhance your stay, an 8 seater airport shuttle is available and our 24-hour front desk is ready to provide additional amenities upon request.

55513.description: Located on the famous Lexington Avenue, this charming property is conveniently close to some of the city's most popular attractions such as Grand Central Station and Rockefeller Centre. Bloomingdales is just a 5-minute walk from the property, and so is Central Park. Also within easy reach, guests will find Carnegie Hall and the famous Times Square. This city residence successfully blends Irish charm with a refreshingly classic atmosphere in the heart of Midtown Manhattan. It comprises a total of 91 guest rooms and suites, well-equipped with amenities. They all come with an en-suite bathroom and offer pillow-top mattress and triple-sheeted king-size or double beds.

55613.description: This elegant hotel is perfectly located in the Sirkeci, the heart of the old city centre, close to the renowned Sirkeci Railway and Tram Station. The hotel features a restaurant, a bar, conference facilities and an excellent spa and wellness centre with indoor pool. Famous sights such as Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque and the Egyptian Spice market are within a short stroll.

55834.description: The Hyatt Regency Barcelona Tower is located in Barcelonas new business and financial district between the airport and the city center, just a few minutes from the exhibition center. The hotel features an extraordinary design by British architect Richard Rogers, renowned for his Centre Pompidou in Paris. As for the building itself, this architectural treasure stands out thanks to such features as its breathtaking glass dome. The hotel has 280 guestrooms located over 29 floors in various categories including one Presidential Suite and 29 suites, as well as 12 Duplex Suites, with a jacuzzi in the bedroom and amazing views of the city skyline. Each room brings together luxurious design elements with delicate jewel-colored materials.

name.content: Paris Gare du Nord La Fayette

55855.description: Just a few steps from the Gare du Nord and the Gare de l'Est, Paris Gare Du Nord La Fayette puts you in touch with nature in the heart of the city. The understated all-wood decor of the entryway, a wall of greenery, the display of decorated beehives. . . you are surrounded by Zen. Equipped with two meeting rooms, this Paris hotel invites you to relax - over a local wine in our lobby lounge bar or in one of the rooms with a terrace or balcony offering views of the Eiffel Tower.

56075.description: The NH Bussum Jan Tabak hotel makes for a great base to explore the natural beauty that surrounds Amsterdam. Guests have easy access to hiking and biking trails, plus there are also a number of celebrity and royal residences in the area. Amsterdam, meanwhile, is only a 20-minute drive from the hotel. The rooms at NH Bussum Jan Tabak are designed with our guests' comfort in mind and feature a comfortable contemporary decor. Each is equipped with free Wi-Fi which is also available throughout the entire hotel. The hotel serves a large spread for breakfast, including continental favorites and some local specialties. Choose from a selection of cold cuts, cheeses, yogurts, fruit, and fresh pastries and bread, while getting a boost of energy with a freshly brewed coffee. Brasserie Jan serves both international and local dishes from its rotating a-la-carte menu. You can enjoy also a meal al fresco on our garden terrace where we often host barbeques in the summer months. On cooler afternoons, relax in the warmth of the cozy Toeback bar and catch up on the latest sports. The hotel is also an excellent choice for functions as we have 15 rooms for up to 110 people.

56097.description: This hotel is located in an oasis of peace between Heemskerk and the dunes. Castricum lies about 10 minutes away by car and Amsterdam Schiphol Airport is just 35 km from the establishment. Surrounded by a nature reserve, the property features an accompanying castle built in 1225. The residence offers a total of 65 rooms including 1 suite. It additionally offers a business centre which comprises 11 conference rooms with ISDN connection, overhead projector and video equipment. The spacious rooms come with a balcony or terrace and guests can choose from a selection of different pillows to ensure a good night's rest. The on-site restaurant is located in the hotel and serves Dutch and international specialities accompanied by local, national and international wines.

56101.description: The NH Zandvoort hotel is set in a prime location near Holland's Zandvoort beach. It's just a 10 minute drive to Haarlem while Amsterdam and the famous Keukenhof tulip gardens are less than half an hour away. Each of the 216 guest rooms feature free Wi-Fi, cable TV, minibars, and a machine for making either tea or coffee. There is also air-conditioning in every room with most rooms having a beach view. Upgraded rooms offer an extra sitting area, a beach view, and room enough for the entire family. A buffet breakfast is provided daily and hot dishes are prepared upon request. Meer Restaurant is our in-house dining establishment offering International cuisine for both lunch and dinner. À la carte, vegetarian, and children's menu options are available. For guests with children, a children's play area is an entertainment option. Guests are welcome to make a reservation for a massage or relax in the sauna at the NH Zandvoort's sauna complex that offers a range of treatments. Our 16 meeting rooms vary in size and type, and can accommodate up to 150 people. Bringing a dog is upon availability. Please contact the hotel directly for the request. Only dogs under 40 cm and under 25 kg are allowed upon availability. The costs are Euro 25.

56136.description: A real home at the heart of Paris, this small hotel offers a cosy atmosphere with combination of modern design and old-fashioned comfort is ideal for both a tourist break and a business trip. In a decor inspired by their favourite cities, from Miami to Caracas and from Berlin to Shanghai, the owners will share their passion for travel and their faultless hospitality. Located just a 5-minute walk from the Eiffel Tower and Trocadero. Guests can find 3 Metro stations within a 2-minute walk of the hotel - Boissiere, Iena and Trocadero as well as the city’s main business districts. The Champs-Elysées and the Arc de Triomphe are also in close proximity to the hotel. The guest rooms each evoke mythical cities, both through pictures as well as through the materials, colours and objects used in their decor. They offer an irresistible mix of tranquillity and comfort with a modern yet traditional décor and spacious bathrooms. Breakfast is served every morning in the breakfast room.

56214.description: Our recently renovated, 3-star hotel offers well-equipped rooms with private bathrooms (shower, hairdryer), air conditioning, heating, direct-dial phones, color TVs, safes, and minibars. Whether you explore Venice's historic city center or the mainland, your car and luggage will be secure with us. Our restaurant offers diverse traditional cuisine, perfect for business lunches or romantic dinners. Our friendly staff is always available to help you enjoy a wonderful stay.

56275.description: Located 150 m from Milan Centrale Train Station, the hotel is a 5 min walk from Milan's shopping street, Corso Buenos Aires, and is also near the departure point for shuttles to Malpensa and Linate airports. This hotel offers 24h room service and air-conditioned rooms. It features a baggage storage room, a bar with plasma-screen TV and a selection of newspapers. Buffet breakfast is available each morning.

56276.description: This hotel is located amidst the bustle and excitement of the stylish city of Milan. The hotel lies at the heart of the University Quarter of the city. Links to the public transport network can be found just a short distance away. Guests will find themselves surrounded by intriguing attractions, shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. This city hotel tempts visitors with the promise of a comfortable stay. The guest rooms are superbly designed, offering a peaceful setting in which to work and rest. Guests are invited to enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day. This hotel features a range of wonderful facilities and services, delivering a high level of comfort and convenience, along with an impressive standard of excellence.

56278.description: Nestled in the charming town of Mira along Venice's Brenta Riviera, this historic hotel offers a tranquil escape where Venetian nobility once summered. Public transport links are conveniently located right outside, providing easy access to Venice (15 km), Padua (20 km), and Treviso (25 km). Explore the town center just 400 meters away, brimming with restaurants, bars, and taverns. Housed in a tastefully restored palazzo dating back to 1850, the hotel retains its original elegant design, from the cozy lounge to the inviting walled garden, a vestige of the 17th century. Its 13 guestrooms offer a unique blend of history and modern comfort. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a reception desk with a safe and currency exchange, a café, a TV room, a breakfast room, bicycle rentals, and on-site parking. Discover the surrounding area by bike or embark on one of the many organized boat trips along the Brenta River, immersing yourself in the beauty of the Venetian villas. Within an hour's reach are Verona, Vicenza, the Po Delta, the Dolomites, Adriatic beaches, Euganei thermal springs, and the Prosecco route.

56314.address: Mimar Mehmet Aga Cad. Amiral Tafdil Sk. 11, 11
56314.description: This family-friendly city hotel offers a warm atmosphere and a prime location in Istanbul's historic center. Shops, restaurants, public transport, and countless historical squares are just steps away. Major attractions such as the Hagia Sophia Mosque, the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, and the Grand Bazaar are also nearby. The Bosphorus is approximately 2 km away, and Istanbul Airport is about 17 km from the hotel. This six-story hotel features 27 guestrooms, a garden, and an air-conditioned restaurant. Guests can enjoy a breakfast buffet, and groups of six or more can book half-board or full-board options. Bicycle storage and parking are also available.

56315.description: Give colour to your Dubai visit with a stay at Mövenpick Hotel & Apartments Bur Dubai, situated close to key commercial areas, shopping malls and attractions in Oud Metha, a central business district in Bur Dubai. Several destinations can be reached within 10 minutes, including Dubai Healthcare City, Dubai World Trade Centre, Dubai International Airport and Dubai Frame. Make yourself at home in our 256 rooms and suites, or choose one of 57 stylish hotel apartments, with a kitchen and up to three bedrooms.

56317.description: Conveniently located on Al Murraqabat Street in the J5 RIMAL area, this hotel offers an ideal base for exploring Dubai, whether for business or leisure. Dubai International Airport (DXB) is just 5km away, and key destinations like the Dubai World Trade Centre, Dubai International Financial Centre, and Downtown Dubai (with the Dubai Mall and Dubai Fountains) are all within 10km. Al Rigga Metro Station is a short 600m walk from the hotel, providing easy access to the city. The hotel offers 97 studios and 26 one and two-bedroom suites across seven floors, combining the flexibility of apartment-style living with hotel amenities and attentive service. These accommodations are perfect for extended stays, whether traveling alone or with family and friends. Business travelers will also appreciate the extra space for work and relaxation, making the hotel suitable for temporary projects, contracts, or relocation. The light-filled lobby and public areas provide welcoming spaces to meet for coffee or dine at le Cafe. Guests can also enjoy the rooftop swimming pool, fully equipped gymnasium, sauna, and steam room. A flexible meeting space accommodating up to 35 guests is available for small residential meetings.

name.content: Ramada Plaza by Wyndham Dubai Deira

56318.address: Beside Abu Bakar Al Siddique Metro Station
56318.description: Thank you for choosing our Ramada Plaza by Wyndham Dubai Deira hotel. Ramada is a global upper-midscale hotel brand with over 820 properties located in over 50 countries worldwide. Most Ramada hotels feature free wired and wireless high-speed internet access meeting rooms business services fitness facilities and upgraded bath amenities. Many properties have an on-site restaurantlounge while other sites offer a complimentary continental breakfast. You do your thing leave the rest to us.

56319.address: Deira, Al Rigga Street, Clock Tower
56319.description: This hotel is located next to Dubai Clock Tower, and offers a wealth of souks, important landmarks and shopping centres, making it ideal for business and leisure. In the vicinity, guests will find Dubai Creek golf course, Yacht Club, Dubai Chamber of Commerce and Industry, World Trade Centre, International Convention Centre, Dubai International Exhibition Centre, Internet and Media City and Jebel Ali Freezone. The hotel houses the oldest and the most famous Irish pub in the city, the Dublin Arms.

56320.address: Opposite Dubai Museum, Al Fahidi Street
56320.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an outdoor pool, and a spa tub. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). The complimentary beach shuttle makes getting to the surf and sand a breeze. Enjoy Regional cuisine at Mumtaz Mahal, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 3 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 2153 square feet (200 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms.

56323.address: Tower A The Walk - Jumeirah Beach Residence, 9
56323.description:
Nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Beach Residence and close to Dubai attractions and malls, our hotel features a private beach with a wide range of fun activities including water sports, a kids club, and a games room. Ten unique dining venues await to satisfy all your cravings. Let off some steam at our health club and embrace serenity at The Spa. Our rooms and suites offer stunning views of the sea, Ain Dubai, or The Walk promenade. Each room is equipped with modern facilities including Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, minibar, and en-suite bathroom. Guests staying in executive rooms or suites enjoy exclusive access to the Executive Lounge, with complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea, and evening drinks with canapés. 
Property Details & Services
24-hour reception
Complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the property
Car park available on-site
Wheelchair accessible facilities and public areas
Concierge and guest services
Room Information
Fully equipped rooms with modern amenities
Various room layouts available (standard rooms, suites, executive rooms)
High-quality bedding and daily housekeeping

56324.address: Al Muteena St. Deira, P.o.box 25570. Dubai, 9th 4 4
56324.description: This refined hotel is centrally located in Deira's area, within walking distance to Sala Al Din green line underground station, providing good public transport links to the city's main tourist attractions. Moreover, Dubai Airport is within a 20-minute drive from the property. All the hotel's guest rooms are conveniently equipped with modern amenities for a perfect stay, including individually controlled air-conditioning and coffee and tea making facilities for added comfort. Some of them even have a private hot tub to relax after a bustling day and complimentary access to the excellent club lounge. The hotel offers a choice of several dining options as well as a temperature controlled outdoor pool and a well-equipped fitness centre for the more active ones.

56327.address: Sheikh Zayed Al Nahyan Road, P.O. 23215
56327.description: Located on the fashionable Sheikh Zayed Street in the heart of the magnificent city of Dubai this city aparthotel is the perfect choice for business and conference travellers visiting the city. Due to its close proximity to the business and commercial districts of the city, as well as a range of shopping centres, the World Trade Centre, Dubai Museum, Jumeirah mosque and Wild Wadi it places guests close to the vibrant heart of the city. Jumeirah Beach Park is just 20 minutes from the hotel and Dubai International Airport is a mere 15 minute drive away. Guests will appreciate the range of high-class facilities and services on offer. Business guests can take advantage of the first-class conference facilities and the range of restaurants serving a wealth of delightful cuisines will appeal to every type of guest.

56329.description: Fairmont Dubai is conveniently located across the Dubai World Trade Centre, within minutes from the Dubai International Airport and International Financial Centre. The hotel is also directly connected to the metro minutes away from The Dubai Mall and the Burj Khalifa. This luxury hotel provides welcome retreat in its 394 guestrooms and suites, as well as meeting spaces flooded with daylight on the 33rd floor, several restaurant and lounges and 40, 000 square feet of Spa, Health Club and pools.

56356.description: The Occidental Aranjuez, a four-star hotel belonging to the Barceló Hotel Group, is conveniently located a short 5-minute drive from the historic heart of Aranjuez and just 30 minutes from Madrid. Situated near the charming towns of Toledo and Chinchón, this hotel offers easy access from all parts of the country. Each elegantly appointed room features classic furnishings and modern amenities for a comfortable stay. Guests can enjoy a range of facilities, including a 5-star restaurant serving delectable cuisine, a relaxing wellness center and spa, and a state-of-the-art convention center adjacent to the Gran Casino Aranjuez. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Whether traveling for business or leisure, the Occidental Aranjuez provides luxurious accommodations in a city rich with history.

56495.description: Nirvana Cosmopolitan is a modern city-resort on Antalya’s Lara Beach, blending urban energy with seaside comfort. With local, healthy gourmet dining, an exclusive beach, extensive MICE facilities, wellness and sports experiences, pet-friendly services, and unique shows, concerts and vibrant entertainment, it offers a dynamic lifestyle for trend-oriented travelers.

56555.description: Just 100 metres from the nearest bus stop and within a short 10-minute walk from the Acropolis, this hotel is ideally situated in the centre of Athens. Athens International Airport is about 30 km from the property. After a day of sightseeing, vacationers will appreciate the air-conditioned comfort of the spacious suites. All of the elegantly furnished rooms have balconies, and some offer beautiful views of the city. Each room comes equipped with a satellite TV, minibar, tea and coffee facilities, safe and en-suite bathroom with hairdryer and toiletries.

56556.description: Nestled beneath the Acropolis, this hotel offers an ideal location near Athens' major attractions. Elegantly decorated rooms feature private balconies, some with breathtaking Parthenon views. A rooftop terrace provides a stunning setting for breakfast during the warm months, overlooking the Acropolis and picturesque Plaka district. Modern amenities include air conditioning, en-suite bathrooms, minibars, soundproof windows, daily maid service, and free WiFi. The hotel staff can arrange taxi transfers and provide travel information. Numerous entertainment and shopping venues are nearby, with the Ancient Agora and Monastiraki flea market within a short walk. Monastiraki Metro Station is just 150 meters away.

56561.description: Located in the centre of Athens, just a 5-minute walk from Monastiraki and an 8-minute walk from Plaka, the Hotel offer easy access to all the major attractions. Guests are greeted with a welcome drink, and free coffee and tea are provided throughout the day. The air-conditioned rooms and apartments are decorated in bright colours, while some have a balcony. All of them are well – equipped as standard. And all units include a private bathroom with bathtub. Hotel's facilities include a lounge area and offer a variety of board games. Free WiFi access is available in the entire hotel and guests enjoy free laptop use. Within approximately a 15-minute walk, guests can visit the Acropolis and Syntagma Square. The nightlife district of Gazi is easily accessible by Metro.

56599.address: Rue Harroun Errachid Quartier De L Hivernage
56599.description: The contemporary 5-star Sofitel Marrakech Palais Imperial & Spa is a quiet, sumptuous space in the middle of a gorgeous garden overlooking the Atlas Mountains. Rejuvenate body and mind in this luxurious haven just steps from the Medina. Offering comfortable rooms and spacious suites, this beautiful property promises moments of relaxation in the outdoor pools, spa, fitness room, gourmet restaurants and bars

56601.address: Omar Ibn El Khattab Street , P.O. Box 1026
56601.description: Explore Cairo's heritage amidst modern luxuries at the five-star InterContinental Cairo Citystars hotel in Heliopolis, next to Stars Centre Mall. Unwind in opulent rooms with stunning furnishings and views. Indulge at our nine exquisite restaurants and bars. Our private meeting rooms and Cairo's largest ballroom play host to stunning events and meetings. Our concierge gladly arranges private tours of the nearby Cairo Citadel, the Pyramids, and soon, The Grand Egyptian Museum.

56602.address: Ext. 26th Of July St.. 6 October City, Cairo.
56602.description: Enjoy 4-star peace and quiet at Novotel Cairo 6th of October hotel, around 30 minutes' drive from the centre of Cairo and 20 minutes from the Great Pyramid at Giza. Pull up a deck chair and unwind under the palm trees or take a dip in the heated pool. Your cool, airy room gives you all the space you need to work or relax at Novotel.

name.content: Four Seasons Hotel Cairo at Nile Plaza

56603.address: 1089 Corniche E Nil. Po. Box 63 Maglis El Shaab
56603.description: Treat yourself with massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite at Bella, one of the hotel's 5 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 3 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a train station pick-up service.

56653.description: The 3-star Hôtel Sanso by HappyCulture offers urban travelers a unique experience near the BNF in a vibrant, developing district of Paris. Its 70 rooms, ranging from 12 to 35 square meters, combine apartment-style comfort and functionality with convenient hotel services. Business and leisure travelers alike will appreciate the easy access to Line 14 and the RER C, providing quick connections to iconic landmarks like the Louvre Museum, Saint Michel, and Notre-Dame-de-Paris. Bercy Village is a short walk away, and the AccorHotels Arena is easily reachable. The hotel features a retro atmosphere with Scandinavian-inspired furnishings, inviting guests to relax in the majestic Chesterfield sofas of the lounge, reminiscent of a literary gallery. Room categories include classic single, double, triple, and quadruple family rooms, some equipped with a fully-equipped kitchen for added convenience.

56657.description: This design hotel, small and cosy, is conveniently located very close to Plaza Catalunya and the Ramblas, but on a quiet street. The commercial, business and historic areas are all within easy reach as well as a number of cultural and historical attractions, which are just a few steps away. The closest public transport links can be found at less than 200 metres away and countless restaurants, bars and cafés are also within easy reach. The closest beach is located approximately 2 km away. The hotel enjoys the ideal location from which to explore the city. The staff of this establishment stands out for its skilled and personalized service, offering services such as free kettle, plug adaptor and ironing set for guests’ convenience. Disability rooms are also available upon request.

56659.description: The Radisson RED Madrid offers a vibrant, convenient location in central Madrid, close to the 'Golden Triangle of Art, ' Atocha train station, and various public transport options. This modern hotel boasts stylish rooms and suites, excellent facilities, and easy access to nearby nightclubs, bars, and shops, making it an ideal choice for friends and couples exploring the city.

56665.description:
Perfectly located in the heart of the bustling Place d'Italie, adjacent to its shopping center popular with Parisian fashionistas, Citadines Apart'hotel offers quick access to all of the capital's business districts and iconic landmarks. Whether you're here for an extended stay or a business trip, you'll appreciate the easy access to Place de l'Étoile, Bastille, and Châtelet-les-Halles. Situated in southern Paris, Citadines Place d'Italie enjoys a location that embodies the dynamic vision of a modern Paris, blending tradition with modernity. Accommodations range from comfortable deluxe studios for two to serviced apartments for four. Meeting rooms are also available. For longer stays, our specially designed long-stay apartments offer a true home-away-from-home experience. Amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, weekly housekeeping, and a fully equipped kitchen allow you to relax and enjoy the views of the Eiffel Tower or Montparnasse Tower from select apartments. Ascott Cares ensures high hygiene and cleanliness standards and safe distancing for guests and staff. 

From January 2026, our serviced residence is getting a makeover while remaining open to welcome you

56666.description: Situated in the heart of Montparnasse, Paris's vibrant artistic hub of the 1920s, Citadines Montparnasse Paris is surrounded by stylish cafés, theaters, and cinemas. This bustling district offers a plethora of shopping centers, boutiques, and restaurants serving diverse international cuisine. The aparthotel is conveniently located a short two-minute walk from the Metro station, providing easy access to Saint-Germain-des-Prés and the Latin Quarter. Citadines Montparnasse Paris is a fully non-smoking serviced residence featuring stylish and elegant decor. Guests can enjoy a private indoor garden, on-site parking for small to medium-sized cars, a business center with computer access, a laundry room, accessible facilities, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the property. Services include weekly housekeeping, laundry, dry cleaning, and pressing services. The aparthotel offers studio and suite accommodations, each providing the conveniences of a hotel with the comforts of home. All units feature a well-equipped kitchenette or kitchen, ideal for extended stays or self-catering.

56671.description: Nirvana Dolce Vita is a luxury resort set in a private bay in Antalya’s Tekirova, blending Mediterranean nature with refined comfort. With a 1 km private beach, villas and suites, multiple pools, a mega aquapark, healthy all-inclusive dining, rich entertainment and pet-friendly services, it offers an elegant escape inspired by the dolce vita spirit.

56673.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at this hotel, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, a lobby fireplace, and banquet hall. A casino shuttle (surcharge) is available. Dine at the restaurant, grab a snack in the cafe, or enjoy room service (limited hours). Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is served daily (4:30 AM - 10:30 AM, for a fee). The hotel offers a computer station, complimentary newspapers, and a 24-hour front desk. Airport transfers and free self-parking are available (airport transfer surcharge applies, available upon request). The 27 guestrooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with bathtubs/showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Safes, desks, and daily housekeeping are also provided. Annia Park Hotel Venice Airport is conveniently located near Forte Bazzera (0. 9 mi), Ca' Noghera Casino (1. 7 mi), and Marco Polo Airport (VCE) (0. 7 mi).

56676.description: Centrally located in Milan, Hotel Palladio offers convenient access to Piazza del Duomo and the Cathedral, both within a 5-minute drive. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a 24-hour front desk. The 40 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions, Select Comfort beds, and private bathrooms with showers and complimentary toiletries. Bocconi University is just 0. 4 miles away, while San Siro Stadium is 5. 1 miles from the hotel.

56678.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the suburbs of Bergamo.

56680.description: Located close to the new business area of Bicocca, in a quiet neighbourhood, this recently renovated hotel is perfect for a comfortable stay for businessmen and for people who want to enjoy the Milanese lifestyle. It is some 2km from the central railway station and a 10-minute walk from the Sondrio underground station, from where the fashion district is just a few stops away. The cosy hotel offers modern meeting facilities and high-speed internet access, both a must for any business travellers. While its soundproofed rooms, comfortable beds and pleasant interior will take care of the much needed good night sleep. The hotel serves a complimentary American buffet breakfast in order to prepare its guests for the exciting day ahead, while the non-stop snack bar is great for a chilled drink of a light meal regardless of the time of the day.

name.content: Best Western Titian Inn Hotel Venice Airport

56681.description: Special Protection, our commitment to ensuring a safe stay with strict cleaning and sanitation protocols. Technologies to support the interaction with the staff to promote social distancing. Healthcare insurance throughout the stay in partnership with AXA Partners. The Best Western Titian Inn Hotel Venice Airport is a modern property located in an exclusive position at Venice's doorstep; it is the perfect solution for those wanting to visit Venice and the Veneto Region. In a wonderful and comfortable location in relation to the main arterial roads, it is only one kilometer for the highway connecting to A4 that connects Trieste to Milan, close to the Venice Marco Polo Airport, only 900 meters, and the Treviso Canova Airport only 30 kilometers. The Best Western Titian Inn Hotel Venice Airport gives you the opportunity to reach both Venice Downtown and the main industrial areas of Venice. You will find the Best Western Titian Inn Hotel Venice Airport only 15 minutes from Venice downtown and just a few steps away from St. Mark's Square. We are located in the heart of the Veneto Region which offers a number of picturesque cities to be discovered such as Padua, Vicenza, Verona and unforgettable landscapes like the Cortina Dolomites and the Brenta River. Kindness, professionalism and respect for our guest's traditions are the spirit of welcome that is waiting for you at the Best Western Titian Inn Hotel Venice Airport. We know how to take care of you. We have been doing it since 1979. Enjoy your stay.

56693.description: Located in the heart of the city, this historic 17th-century hotel is just 350 meters from both Repubblica and Porta Venezia subway stations. Occupying two floors of a charming building with a private entrance (note there is no lift), the hotel offers 21 well-equipped rooms, each featuring a shower, hairdryer, and both LAN and Wi-Fi internet access. Guests can also enjoy the convenience of an on-site breakfast room and parking.

56733.description: The Citadines Paris Montmartre Aparthotel, nestled in the heart of Montmartre near Place de Clichy, offers a charming Parisian experience. Explore the neighborhood's narrow streets, visit the Sacré-Coeur Basilica, and discover local cafes. The aparthotel features 113 studios and one-bedroom apartments, a rooftop terrace with Sacré-Coeur views, and amenities like a fully-equipped kitchen and high-speed internet access. Enjoy the flexibility of choosing services to suit your needs, with friendly staff available to assist you.

56834.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Brussels and was established in 1964. It is a short drive away from the Grand Place and the nearest station is Louise. The hotel has a restaurant, a bar and a conference room. All 80 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a deposit.

56835.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include a television in a common area and a ballroom. Grab a bite to eat at Gullivers, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Zaventem? This hotel has 23978 square feet (2228 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 20 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 289 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

56836.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary (available on request). Make yourself at home in one of the 141 air-conditioned rooms featuring LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

56837.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including a sauna and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at The Yard, a restaurant which specializes in international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Brussels? This hotel has 2582 square feet (240 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 191 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions.

56838.description: Discover the perfect blend of city comfort and hotel luxury at Mövenpick Hotel Cairo Media City. Located in the heart of Cairo, our hotel features stunning landscaping, multiple swimming pools and an exciting water park, making it the perfect oasis for relaxation. Just minutes away from the city, enjoy a tranquil retreat with world-class amenities and impeccable service.

name.content: Hotel des Colonies Brussels by Mercure

56877.description: Mercure Brussels Centre Rogier, located in the heart of Brussels, combines historical charm with modern amenities. Established in the early 20th century, this iconic hotel offers a warm and inviting atmosphere. The hotel features a cozy lounge, perfect for relaxing after exploring the city. Situated near Rogier Square and just minutes from major attractions like the Grand Place, it is an ideal base for both tourists and business travelers.

56878.description: This hotel is located in the suburbs of Brussels, the nearest station is Alma Station. The nearest shopping venues are just 2 km away whilst it is 10 km to the main train station. The hotel was established in 1994 and offers 126 rooms. It offers a restaurant, a bar, a café and a disco. There is also lift access and a hotel safe and room service are available to guests at the hotel. All of the rooms are equipped with a minibar, a hairdryer, a safe and a trouser press. In addition they feature a TV, a radio and individually regulated air conditioning. The hotel provides a swimming pool and a sauna for guests' use.

56879.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Brussels and was established in 1991. It is close to the Grand Place and the nearest station is Central Station. The Hotel has a restaurant and a bar. All 65 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, trouser press, ironing set and air conditioning.

56890.description:
Our 60 rooms hotel is just steps away from Brussels’ pedestrian zone, placing you within immediate reach of iconic landmarks such as Grand-Place (900m), Place de Brouckère (450m), the Bourse (800m) and Place Rogier (300m). 
Nearby public transport (Metro De Brouckere) will take you directly to the European Union institutions, Brussels Expo/Atomium, or even NATO. The North Station (900m) also offers easy connections to other Belgian cities as well as international destinations. 
Our bar, located right in the reception area, welcomes you with a great selection of Belgian beers, hot and cold drinks. 
Every morning from 7am to 10. 30am, we suggest a generous breakfast buffet. 
Our 60 rooms are well-designed, offering a compact, functional space, each equipped with a private bathroom with complimentary amenities. All rooms are non-smoking, equipped with a safe.

56894.description: The ibis Brussels City Centre is very close to all major highlights, which makes the hotel an ideal spot to to relax after a busy day in the city. Our rooms have everything you will ever need during your stay, from our comfortable SweetBeds to a bathroom with shower to free WiFi. Want to make the most out of your trip? Ask for an early check-in or late check-out! The reception is open 24/7. On top, parking is available nearby and the Brussels central train station can be reached easily by foot.

name.content: Urban Yard Hotel Centre Midi Station

56903.description: This hotel is located in the centre of Brussels, close to the Grand Place. The nearest station is Lemonier and lies just 500 metres away. The bus station is 400 metres away. Variety of shopping venues can be found just 1. 5 km from the building. The hotel was established in 1900 and comprises a total of 114 rooms. Furthermore, there is a lobby, a hotel safe and a lifts access. Room service is also provided at the hotel. All rooms are well-equipped and all come with individually regulated air conditioning units. Further amenities include a hairdryer and a TV.

56936.description: This hotel is located in the city centre of Brussels, near the Grand Place. It is approximately 500 m to Clémenceau metro station from the hotel. Brussels airport is 30 km away. Renovated in 2005, this hotel comprises a total of 48 rooms. Facilities on offer include a safe and lift access. Dining options include a bar and a nice restaurant. Room service is also provided. All the rooms come with an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, as well as a nicely-fitted living area. Further amenities include a direct dial telephone, a minibar and a safe. Internet access is available for an additional fee. The hotel provides a continental breakfast.

56993.description: Located in the heart of Kizilagac's bustling tourist center, this modern beachfront hotel offers easy access to shops, restaurants, bars, and nightclubs. Side and the stunning Manavgat Waterfalls are a short drive away, while Antalya Airport is approximately 75 km from the hotel. The hotel features several indoor and outdoor pools, a variety of spa treatments, and an activity program for all ages. Dining options include a main restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating and a la carte restaurants (open from June 11th to October 31st). Rooms are brightly decorated in a modern style and include air conditioning. The hotel also offers four accessible rooms. Please note the fitness center is closed for the 2021 season.

56996.description: Enjoy a central Paris stay at the Opera Deauville Hotel, just a short walk from Boulevard Haussmann and Galeries Lafayette. This hotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) and make use of the 24-hour room service. The 30 guestrooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, safes, and desks. The hotel also provides limo/town car service, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Nearby attractions include the Palais Garnier and the Moulin Rouge.

57001.description: Situated in the heart of Paris, this discretely charming and elegant hotel is just 10 minutes away from the Opera de Paris and the famous Parisian department stores, Galeries Lafayette and Le Printemps. Centrally located, the hotel is also only a few minutes from Montmartre and the Champs Elysées. Restaurants are within 250 m of the hotel, as are bars, pubs, and the railway station. The hotel is within a 20-minute walk of Parc Monceau, and within a 10-minute drive guests can find Avenue des Champs-Élysées.

57002.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center and garden views. This Beaux Arts hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and wedding services. An area shuttle is available (surcharge). Dine at the restaurant, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM (surcharge). Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event? The hotel offers 8, 719 square feet (810 square meters) of space, including a conference center and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (surcharge). The 93 guest rooms feature minibars, espresso makers, and flat-screen televisions with digital programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations offer designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks.

57058.description: The Hotel Medinaceli is a luxurious and elegant establishment that occupies a majestic and stately building: the palace of the Dukes of Medinaceli, in Barcelona. The hotel is located in one of the most charming areas of the city: the Gothic Quarter. It has 78 comfortable rooms equipped with full bathroom, TV, telephone and many other comforts. The establishment also has a magnificent social lounge where you can relax and have a good time. The Hotel Medinaceli is located next to the lively Ramblas, the Paseo Marítimo and very close to the beaches. This privileged location makes it the perfect accommodation to visit with comfort and ease the great number of tourist attractions in Barcelona.

57195.description: This hotel enjoys an enviable setting, lying amidst the heart of the city of Zurich. The hotel is situated in close proximity to the main train station and main attractions that this intriguing city has to offer. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from monuments, delightful dining options, upscale shopping opportunities and lively entertainment venues. This wonderful ***hotel welcomes guests with the promise of excellence and style. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, providing functional space and modern amenities, and offering the perfect area in which to work and rest in comfort. Guests will appreciate the wide range of excellent facilities and services that this wonderful hotel has to offer.

57202.description: Established in 1935, this hotel has built a reputation for quality and comfort in the heart of the city. The central train station is easily accessible via tram line number 10, which passes directly by the hotel and continues towards the airport. Guests seeking the city's vibrant energy should explore nearby Niederdorf, with its numerous restaurants, unique shops, and exceptional atmosphere, capturing the essence of Zurich. Business travelers and shoppers will appreciate the proximity to the main shopping area, business district, ETH, and hospitals, all within walking distance. Designed in original Swiss style, the hotel features rooms adorned with works by a well-known local artist. The on-site restaurant, Crazy Cow, serves delicious cuisine in a charmingly stylish setting.

57214.description: This city hotel is just 50 m from bus, tram and train terminals. Within a short walk, guests can reach the Lake Leman shore and the old town with its welcoming shops, restaurants and bars. The United Nations Office is approximately 1. 6 km away. It will take visitors about 15 minutes to get to Geneve-Cointrin international airport, the Palexpo Exhibition Centre and the International Conference Centre from the residence. Built in 1940, the air-conditioned establishment offers pleasantly furnished, soundproofed rooms and welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and lift access. Further facilities include a cafe and WLAN Internet access. The on-site pub is one of the first typical English-style pubs ever established in Geneva and serves a selection of drinks in a traditional ambience.

57273.description: CIN IT027042A1TN339LNA This hotel is located on the island of Murano. A boating jetty, glass museum and the basilica of S. S. Maria e Donato can all be found in the near vicinity. Quietly located about 15 minutes from the city centre, the hotel lies about 2 km from Venice's Marco Polo airport. This elegant hotel comprises a total of 26 rooms spread across a main building and an annexe. Appointed in Venetian style, facilities here include a lobby with a reception desk and safe. The rooms, which have been kept in Venetian style, offer modern comforts and all come with a bathroom with hairdryer, a double or king-size bed, a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, high-speed Internet access, a minibar and a hire safe. The air conditioning and heating are individually regulated. Some rooms also feature a terrace. Both wheelchair accessible and non-smoking rooms are available on request.

Each of the 64 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, Smart TV, and designer toiletries in the en suite bathroom with rainfall showerhead. Guests can dine at STRAF restaurant, specializing in local and international cuisine, or enjoy room service during limited hours. A bar/lounge and buffet breakfast (available for a fee) are also offered. The hotel provides complimentary wired internet access, a business center, express check-in, conference space, a meeting room, and self-parking (subject to charges).

Guests will find themselves just a 10 minutes' driving distance away from Rho Fiera Milano and the Expo 2015 exhibition areas. The Comasina Metro Station is just 700 metres away. This charming hotel blends effortlessly with its natural surroundings. The stylish guest rooms ooze character and charm. This property offers visitors a wide range of excellent facilities and services. Meeting rooms are available for guests travelling for work purposes. The property also offers a delightful restaurant, where international and Italian dishes can be enjoyed.

57473.description:
Petit Palace Plaza del Carmen is a boutique hotel in the heart of Madrid, set on Plaza del Carmen between Puerta del Sol and Gran Vía. With Puerta del Sol 350 metres away and the Teatro Principal Gran Vía just 50 metres from the door, the hotel is surrounded by the city's main attractions and its best shopping, theatre and nightlife district; the Gran Vía Casino is a 3-minute walk away. 

Rooms come with free WiFi, air conditioning or heating depending on the season, a laptop-sized safe, a 23-inch flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a hydromassage shower. 

At reception you'll find free coffee from 12:00 to 23:30, free bicycles for exploring Madrid at your own pace and discounted rates at a nearby public car park. Staff can also arrange tickets for Warner Bros Theme Park and for the Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen-Bornemisza museums, so everything is sorted before you head out. With its central location and its range of services, Petit Palace Plaza del Carmen is an ideal base for discovering the Spanish capital.

57482.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Enjoy Modern European cuisine at Indigo, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 102 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and minibars.

57533.description: Lying at the heart of Marrakech, this hotel is situated in the Hivernage district, Menara - Marrakech Airport is only 3. 4 km away. The air-conditioned establishment is located on a main road and features many thoughtful amenities, including a playground for younger guests. There is a luxurious swimming pool with a children's pool and poolside snack bar in the outdoor complex where visitors can enjoy their leisure time. Further leisure options include a hot tub, a sauna and a steam bath. The resort comprises rooms and suites of many various categories.

Just a 15-minute drive from Menara Airport and 10 minutes from the city center, train station, and numerous attractions, the hotel also provides a complimentary daytime shuttle to the city (subject to availability). The two-story hotel boasts 314 luxuriously furnished rooms, each with a private balcony overlooking the pool, golf course, or mountains. Guests can choose from several gourmet restaurants serving French, Moroccan, Italian, and Asian cuisine. Designed by Robert Trent Jones Sr. , the hotel's golf course is a must-see for any golf enthusiast. Lift access is available to the upper floor for guests with disabilities.

Comfortable rooms, attentive service, and close proximity to major attractions—Majorelle Garden, Avenue Mohammed VI, and Marrakech Train Station—make it a perfect base for discovering the Red City. Private bathrooms with bathtubs feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

57539.address: Angle Avenue Echouhada Et Rue Des Temples
57539.description: Within the privileged Hivernage area of Marrakech, Hivernage Hotel & Spa is only walking distance from the legendary Jemâa el Fna square. Our luxury Hotel is ideally located for exploring in the medina and for city sightseeing. The 85 rooms and Suites offer a Zen atmosphere and are built with traditional materials, providing bespoke comfort and tranquility with coziness and state-of-the-art equipment. The Spa is our heaven of well-being for mind, body and spirit. Our oriental treatments offer a typical Moroccan experience: hammam, essential oils bath, massage and aroma therapy. The hotel has also a fitness center offering aerobics, power plate, sauna, hot tub; as well as a hair dressing salon with manicure and pedicure services as well as facial treatments.

57540.description: Located in the tranquil residential district of L'Hivernage, midway between the vibrant Medina and the serene Palmeraie, this hotel offers a prime location for exploring Marrakech. Set against the backdrop of the Atlas Mountains, it provides convenient access to the historic old city and the beautiful Menara Gardens. Refurbished in 2005, the hotel offers 150 well-equipped rooms and amenities such as a swimming pool, spa, fitness center, and conference rooms.

57541.description: This hotel, located a short walk from Djemaa el Fna Square, Koutoubia Mosque, the stunning Agdal Gardens, the royal Menara, and the Congress Palace, seamlessly blends traditional and contemporary styles. The city center is approximately 3 kilometers away, while Essaouira is about 170 kilometers from the hotel. Guests can enjoy a refreshing swimming pool with a children's area, a relaxing spa corner, and various sports activities. An adventure playground is also available for younger guests. All rooms feature individual climate control and an en suite bathroom with a separate toilet. A garden and terrace provide additional spaces for relaxation.

57622.description:
Superior 4* hotel in the heart of the Gothic Quarter and just a few minutes away from the Cathedral, Plaça del Rei, Las Ramblas, Plaça de Catalunya, the Palau de la Música concert hall, the Picasso Museum, Santa María del Mar… An excellent location for discovering the magic of Barcelona and its wide range of cultural, commercial, gastronomic and leisure activities. 

But the best part is when you get back to the hotel and get to enjoy all the available services and the silence necessary for relaxing. What’s more, all services follow environmentally friendly guidelines. 

Make the most of your time and enjoy our exclusive services and the meticulously planned gastronomic offer we have prepared for you. Let us surprise you!

57628.description: This city hotel, just 130 meters from the beach and a 20-minute walk from the resort center, offers 72 guest rooms and a range of amenities. Refurbished in 2011-12, it features a bar, restaurant, snack bar, TV room, and 24-hour reception. Guests can also access medical assistance, currency exchange, and on-site parking. Each air-conditioned room includes a private bathroom, a balcony, and standard amenities. The hotel also boasts a refreshing outdoor swimming pool with a dedicated children's area and a poolside snack bar. Guests can relax on the sun terrace with loungers and parasols, indulge in a massage, or enjoy table tennis, pool, snooker, and darts.

57633.description: The Abbot Hotel offers 42 comfortable, quiet, and bright rooms across six floors. Each simply decorated room provides everything needed for a pleasant stay in Barcelona, including a television, air conditioning, minibar, safe, and a private bathroom with amenities, a hairdryer, and free Wi-Fi. The hotel's 24-hour reception staff is always available to assist guests. A varied buffet breakfast is available, featuring coffee, tea, milk, juices, yogurts, water, pastries, bread, cereals, sausages, cheeses, cakes, pizzas, and fresh fruit. For meetings and events, the hotel offers two equipped meeting rooms, the Dover and the Thames.

57739.description: AAusonia Hungaria is set in a building 820 feet from the beach and 5 minutes’ walk from the Vaporetto water bus stop. Modern rooms come with a flat-screen satellite TV. The hotel features the Lanna Gaia wellness center, which includes sauna, Turkish bath and a range of massages. Staff are graduates of the prestigious Lanna Thai Academy in Thailand. The restaurant is specialized in traditional Italian cuisine. During the summer, guests can enjoy drinks on the terrace by the bar. The Ausonia Hungaria hotel is 5. 6 mi from Circolo Golf Venezia. St. Mark’s Square can be reached with a 15-minute ride on the vaporetto water bus.

57897.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and shopping on site. This Art Deco hotel also features a fireplace in the lobby, tour/ticket assistance, and a reception hall. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, a computer station, and express check-in. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 24 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

57934.description: The Regent Palace Hotel boasts a prime location in the heart of Buenos Aires, ideal for travelers interested in the city's cultural, financial, and commercial scene. Within walking distance of Plaza Libertad, the Teatro Nacional Cervantes, and the Naval Center, this hotel offers convenient access to key attractions. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant, cafe, and bar/lounge. A complimentary breakfast is provided, as is Wi-Fi access in public areas. Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center and meeting room. Each of the 139 air-conditioned guest rooms features a laptop-sized safe, a minibar, and premium linens. High-speed Wi-Fi access is available (surcharge applies). All rooms also include televisions with cable channels.

57935.description: Rochester Hotel Concept offers modern rooms with trendy designer décor, only 650 m from the Obelisk. The hotel features free WiFi access, a fitness centre with modern machines, and a buffet breakfast offering artisan bakery as well as hot dishes. Decorated in lively colours, rooms at Rochester Hotel Concept are spacious and sound proof, with their own climate control and king size beds. All of them are fitted with LED cable TVs, minibars and safety deposit boxes. Comfortable work areas with large work desks are also included. The hotel provides a 24-hour front desk assistance and room service, as well as tour information, transfers and tours around the city. The restaurant offers regional and international dishes, and drinks can be ordered at the bar. Massage sessions are available upon request. Rochester Hotel Concept is 7. 5 km from Jorge Newbery Domestic Airport and 33 km from Ezeiza Airport. Retiro Bus terminal is 2 km away.

name.content: Howard Johnson Plaza Buenos Aires Florida Street

57936.description: Located on vibrant Florida pedestrian street, near Plaza St. Martin, the Howard Johnson Plaza by Wyndham Buenos Aires Florida Street offers the distinction of a four-star hotel. Just 35 minutes from Ministro Pistarini International Airport and ten minutes from Jorge Newbery Domestic Airport, this hotel places you within walking distance of shopping, art galleries, cinemas, and Buenos Aires' best restaurants. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and a buffet breakfast. Awarded the 2012 TripAdvisor Certificate of Excellence and the Presidents Quality Excellence Award, this hotel offers quality service. Guests must provide at least 24 hours' notice of early departure to avoid a one-night penalty fee.

57937.description: Rochester Hotel Classic is located between the Obelisk, Buenos Aires' epicenter, and the trendy Puerto Madero. Along the shopping district of Florida, Lavalle and 9 de Julio Avenue, the hotel presents a stylish decor beautifully combined with modern details. It includes free WiFi access and a daily breakfast with artisan bakery and hot dishes. Each room at Rochester Hotel Classic features independent climate control, laminate flooring, LED cable TVs, minibars and safety deposit boxes. The hotel also offers apartments with 2 bedrooms, fitted with microwaves and ovens. Equipped with a modern gym and a business centre, Rochester Hotel Classic features a glamorous lobby with vanguard furniture. The restaurant offers a chef-design menu and enjoys an extensive selection of local and international dishes. The bar offers cocktails drinks and high end drinks.

57938.description: This city hotel is situated in the heart of Buenos Aires, only four blocks from the Obelisco. It enjoys a perfect location near various bars, restaurants, shops, nightclubs, and public transport links. The fully air-conditioned hotel, housed in a building dating back to 1905, opened in September 2004 and was renovated in 2011. The hotel comprises 40 fully equipped apartments. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, a cloakroom, lift access, a restaurant, bar, café, wireless Internet access, a safe, and a currency exchange. Guests can also enjoy two lounges. The comfortable apartments, measuring 70 m², comprise either one or two rooms. All apartments come with an en suite bathroom and are fully equipped as standard. Each has a private balcony or terrace.

57939.description: This hotel boasts a superb setting at the heart of Buenos Aires. The hotel is located in the Tribunales neighbourhood of the city, just a few minutes' walking distance away from Avenida 9 de Julio. The hotel is surrounded by attractions, activities and ample opportunities for exploration and discovery. Jorge Newbery Airport is just 3 km away. This charming hotel extends a warm, friendly welcome to guests upon arrival. The guest rooms are superbly styled, offering the utmost in comfort and convenience. The hotel features a number of facilities and services, meeting the needs of every type of traveller.

name.content: Dazzler by Wyndham Buenos Aires San Martin

57940.description: The Dazzler San Martin hotel offers a modern experience for both business and leisure travelers. Located on a prime avenue near dining and commercial districts, our hotel provides comfortable accommodations. Many Dazzler hotels feature meeting spaces, on-site parking, and airport and local shuttles (fees may apply).

57941.description: The hotel is located right in the centre of the impressive commercial centre of Buenos Aires. Local attractions and places of interest in the area include the Teatro Colón, the famous Obelisk, the cosmopolitan Calle Florida and the exclusive Puerto Medero. With its convenient location and modern services this establishment is an ideal choice for both business and leisure stays. The large conference rooms are well-equipped to accommodate most functions and events. The property is air-conditioned and offers guests a lobby with a reception desk, manned around the clock, as well as an on-site restaurant. The rooms come with cable TV and individually regulated air conditioning.

57942.description: Its an elegant city hotel situated in the renowned Avenida Santa Fe, just by the charming Plaza Libertad. Guests will be able to discover Buenos Aires from this great location, finding most of the touristic attractions within easy reach. This sober and classy hotel offers an atmosphere of absolute calm and well-being, where guests will enjoy an unforgettable stay with personalised service and all the necessary extras.

57943.description:
DecO Collection is a 4-star boutique hotel located at Suipacha 1359, between Recoleta and Retiro, one of the most elegant and strategic areas of Buenos Aires. 

The hotel offers a contemporary concept that blends modern design, artistic details and a sophisticated urban style, making it an ideal choice for guests looking to experience the city with comfort, personality and easy access to its main cultural, gastronomic and shopping attractions. 

DecO Collection features 77 carefully designed rooms, including Studio, Studio Superior and Suite categories, created for both leisure and business stays. 

Its main amenities include buffet breakfast, high-speed Wi-Fi, 24-hour front desk, seasonal outdoor swimming pool with solarium, green areas, parking with additional cost, Ander restaurant, bar and room service.

57948.description: This luxurious hotel offers top of the line designer décor and a rooftop swimming pool in the heart of Buenos Aires (open from December though March). The hotel is located on Diagonal Street, joining the Obelisk with Plaza de Mayo and forming a magnificent corner in one of the most visited cities of the world. The hotel is 8 blocks from world famous Colon Opera House and it offers a unique mixture of emblematic design and tradition.

57949.description:
Located in the Abasto district, the 4-star Abasto Hotel offers spacious rooms with elegant decor and modern amenities. The property features an outdoor seasonal swimming pool and WiFi access. 

Each bright room is equipped with air conditioning, a 32" TV, a telephone, a work desk, a safe and an iron. Private bathrooms are completed with a hairdryer. Rooms have either a bathtub or a shower, according to availability. Some units also offer a spa bath, bathrobes, and a mini-bar. 

During your stay in the Abasto Hotel, you are invited to savor international dishes in the Volver Restaurant. A daily buffet breakfast includes coffee, milk, croissants, toasts, jam, orange and grapefruit juice, pastries, fruit, scrambled eggs, yogurt and cereal. 

In addition, the knowledgeable staff can provide tour information and several services you may need, such as laundry, car rental and room service. 

The hotel is located on Corrientes Avenue, opposite the Abasto Shopping Mall and a few yards from Carlos Gardel Metro Station. Parking is possible for an extra fee and is subject to availability.

57950.description: Enjoy stylish convenience at the Sheraton Libertador Hotel, in downtown Buenos Aires. One of the world's greatest urban centers, Buenos Aires is as alive during the night as it is during the day. Our ideal location is close to the financial and commercial districts as well as the main stores and theatres, such as the famous Teatro Colon. We are also just 40 minutes from Ezeiza International Airport, keeping your trip stress-free. Also, enjoy our full-service business center, state-of-the-art gym with an indoor pool and a confortable restaurante & bar.

58075.description: Located in the heart of Buenos Aires, a few meters from 9 de Julio Avenue and 3 blocks from the Obelisk, Gran Hotel Argentino has comfortable rooms and easy access to public transportation. Plaza de Mayo Square and the Pink House are 5 blocks away. The hotel offers a personlised service, with a foyer, a 24-hour reception, meeting rooms, a bar, a restaurant and a car park. The charming Gran Hotel Argentino invites you to rest in refurbished rooms with modern amenities that include air conditioning, cable TV and internet connection. Airport shuttles to and from the airport can be arranged. The Grand Hotel Argentino also has a restaurant, where a breakfast buffet is served every morning. Room service is available 24 hours a day. There are Smoking rooms (Classic Rooms) and non-smoking rooms (Contemporary).

58076.description: This hotel, with its stylish neo-baroque façade and elegant décor, offers design accommodation in the heart of Buenos Aires, just 200 metres from Corrientes Avenue. The hotel is a 10-minute walk from the Obelisk and 100 metres from the National Congress Palace. Ministro Pistarini Airport is 30 km away. This beautiful 1910s hotel guarantees a unique and idyllic stay in this beautiful city.

58077.description: Located in the heart of the city on Avenida 9 de Julio, just steps from the Obelisco and Avenida de Mayo, this hotel offers easy access to San Telmo and Puerto Madero. A variety of rooms, from single to quadruple and connecting rooms, are available. Each room features a safe, large double-glazed windows, centralized air conditioning and heating, and wooden floors. Room service is provided, and luggage storage is available. Check-in is at 2 pm, and check-out is at 10 am. Metro, bus, and train stations are within walking distance, placing guests at the center of the city's cultural, dining, entertainment, sports, and shopping scenes. Please note that reservations for five or more rooms are considered group bookings and may be subject to different policies.

58078.description: This hotel is located within a short distance of Buenos Aires' financial district, historical buildings and a selection of tourist spots. Facilities include a business centre as well as Internet access, for additional charges. Fees apply for use of the room and laundry services, and guests can take advantage of the 24-hour medical assistance. In addition, there is a 24-hour security service, video surveillance and a soft drink vending machine.

58079.description: The 5-star NH Buenos Aires City is in the center of historic Buenos Aires and close to the Puerto Madero waterfront. Its 1930s art deco façade fits in beautifully with its surroundings, with the Plaza de Mayo, Cabildo and Casa Rosada all nearby. There are plenty of other cultural attractions just a short walk away too, like the Museo Histórico Nacional and Catedral Metropolitana. Head for the shopping along Florida Street or walk on just a little further to the pretty cobbled streets of San Telmo. Just outside the NH Buenos Aires City you will find public transport to take you to all corners of the city. Take your pick from one of our 369 rooms, presented in modern décor or traditional style. Our 24-hour gym is free to use and after a workout you can enjoy a cool dip in our stylish rooftop pool during the summer months. The NH Buenos Aires City restaurant offers an innovative menu of international and Spanish cuisine, and The Lobby bar is open 24 hours a day. Our function and meeting rooms hold up to 500 people. And there's scope for a beautiful wedding in a modern space filled with natural light with up to 350 guests.

58080.description: The NH Collection Buenos Aires Crillon hotel is across the street from a luscious green park in the upscale Retiro neighborhood. The famous Avenida de 9 Julio is a few blocks away and you can reach the Puerto Madero waterfront area easily on foot. For shops and dining, the pedestrian Calle Florida is within a five-minute walk, while for business travelers, the Sheraton Convention Center is only 500 meters away. Bus and metro stops are steps away for easy access to the rest of Buenos Aires. NH Collection Buenos Aires Crillon has 96 stylish rooms featuring elegant furniture and sleek hardwood floors. Corner rooms and Suites have spectacular views of Plaza San Martín. There are connecting rooms available and the hotel provides 24-hour room service and free Wi-Fi. Our extensive breakfast buffet offering assorted cold cuts, cheeses, fresh fruit, pastries, and breads will set you up for the day ahead. Lunch and dinner are served at the hotel's Mediterranean restaurant or you can choose a light meal accompanied by your favorite cocktail at the lobby bar. The hotel also has six function rooms for up to 130 people.

58082.description: The Lancaster Gate Hotel enjoys a central London location, just minutes from several Underground stations. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. With major transport links on its doorstep, the hotel offers easy access to all top landmarks. Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens are just across the road, and Queensway and Lancaster Gate Underground stations are a 5-minute walk away. The modern, spacious bedrooms are well-equipped with a private bathroom, air conditioning, tea and coffee facilities, and an LCD flat-screen TV. A generous continental breakfast buffet is available daily. The stylish Serpentine Bar offers a range of beverages, snacks, and modern cocktails. Conference facilities are also available.

58173.description: This hotel enjoys a superb location in the centric L'Eixample, and is just 500 from the famous Paseo de Gracia shopping avenue. The hotel is also very close to other places in the area of touristic and cultural interest, such as La Pedrera and Casa Batlló, located at less than 700 metres from the hotel. The harbour and the closest local beach can be reached after a nice leisurely walk through the city. This is a perfect hotel for guests wishing to discover Barcelona.

58193.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this Belle Époque hotel include a television in a common area and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Make yourself at home in one of the 30 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

58196.description: In the heart of Brussels' European Quarter, The NH Brussels EU Berlaymont is ideally located for visitors to the European Union institutions. This contemporary hotel is close to Schuman metro and train station, and on the doorstep of both the European Council and the European Commission. For fresh air, Park Leopold and Cinquantenaire Park are both nearby. The hotel has 214 rooms, all of which offer a minibar, free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and a comfortable working area. The quiet, comfortable rooms are decorated with photographs from the hotel's extensive collection. Connecting rooms are available, and there are garden views from some rooms and Junior suites. Guests can start the day with a morning work-out in the complimentary gym, and then enjoy a buffet breakfast, featuring hot and cold dishes, breads, cheeses, fruit and pastries. Belgian and international cuisine is on the menu at L'Objectif, the hotel's signature restaurant. For a laid-back, convivial evening, guests can cozy up in the elegant News Bar, where a range of unique cocktails and popular Belgian beers await. Seven meeting rooms can cater for a total of 150 people. The hotel will provide all the audiovisual equipment you need, as well as translation services and snacks for coffee breaks.

58221.description: This hotel is situated in a residential area of Copacabana, just 3 blocks from the beach and close to a subway station. The city centre and the national airport may be reached in 15 minutes whilst it is 25 minutes to Rio de Janeiro's international airport. A total of 110 rooms and suites are available to guests in this air-conditioned beach hotel. Amongst the facilities count a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a bar, a restaurant and conference facilities. Fees apply for use of the garage parking. All of the modern rooms and suites come with cable TV, a radio, an answering machine, an Internet connection, a minibar and a hire safe. The air conditioning is centrally controlled. Leisure options include a swimming pool, a gym and a sauna.

58893.description: NoxInn Deluxe Hotel offers a five-star Ultra All-Inclusive-service in the Alanya Konakli region, the pearl of the Mediterranean. At the same time, NoxInn Deluxe Hotel faces the sea and has a private beach of 300 meters which is awarded with the blue flag. Our hotel has a distance of 12 km to Alanya center, 3 km to Konakli center, 95 km of Antalya airport and 50 km to Gazipaşa airport. The hotel's facilities include 497 rooms with sea or countryside views that can accommodate 1000 beds. Among them are 454 standard rooms, 5 rooms with interconnecting doors, 4 handicapped-accessible rooms and 34 standard large rooms. Activities include various animation programs, indoor and outdoor sports fields, aqua park with separate children and adult pools, hammam and spa.

59120.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include multilingual staff, luggage storage, and an elevator. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 41 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions.
