Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Kurfürstendamm - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Deutsche Oper Berlin - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Messe Berlin - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Theatre of the West - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Berliner Funkturm - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- ICC Berlin - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi- Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi- Europa Center - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Schloss Charlottenburg - 2. 3 km / 1. 5 mi- Tiergarten Park - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- Zoo Berlin - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- Berlin Aquarium - 2. 6 km / 1. 6 mi- Kaufhaus des Westens - 2. 8 km / 1. 8 mi- CityCube Berlin - 2. 9 km / 1. 8 mi- Bauhaus Archive - 3. 6 km / 2. 2 mi. The nearest major airport is Berlin (BER-Brandenburg) - 29. 4 km / 18. 3 mi With a stay at Hotel Abendstern, you'll be centrally located in Berlin, within a 5-minute drive of Kurfürstendamm and Zoo Berlin. This hotel is 3. 7 mi (6 km) from Brandenburg Gate and 3. 8 mi (6. 2 km) from Potsdamer Platz.

59159.address: Avenida Tulum y claveles N. 1, Av Tulum 4239
59159.description: This hotel is located on Cancun's main street - Tulum Avenue, and places its guests within a 10-minute walk from wonderful restaurants, commercial areas, flea markets, tourist attractions and a wide range of entertainment venues. With its typically warm Caribbean hospitality the venue provides everything needed for the perfect vacation. The outdoor swimming pool is surrounded by a lovely patio, where on can stretch and enjoy the sun. The bar will take care of that endless stream of refreshing drinks that is so needed in the warm afternoons, while the nightclub provides for some late evening entertainment - an indispensable part of any fun vacation.

59219.description: This stunning hotel enjoys a prime setting in Madrid, right next to Spanish Theatre and Santa Ana square. This upscale urban property offers easy reach of links of transport and situation in the very centre of the Spanish capital. Guests may find the famous Puerta del Sol and Plaza Mayor within a short stroll and lively area with bars, restaurants and shopping opportunities is within striking distance. The hotel's rooms and suites are cosy and bright with modern amenities such as Wi-Fi internet access. The on-site restaurant is the address for international culinary delights and top-notch service. Business travellers might make use of the business centre and in-room work desk, while everyone can enjoy the refreshing drinks and snacks at the modern hotel bar. Whether travelling to Madrid on business or on a family holiday, this hotel offers comforts and conveniences for a memorable stay. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a pet deposit.

59241.description: Enjoy numerous amenities at this hotel, including an indoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. Additional conveniences include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). The hotel offers a restaurant, a coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (fee applies). Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge; 24 hours), as is self-parking (surcharge). Relax in one of the 154 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring a refrigerator and an LED television with satellite programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected. Bathrooms offer shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Nearby attractions include Meena Bazaar (0. 3 km), the Textile Souk (0. 6 km), Sheikh Saeed Al Maktoum House (0. 9 km), the Grand Mosque (0. 9 km), and the Dubai Museum (1 km). The closest airports are Dubai International Airport (DXB, 12. 9 km), Sharjah International Airport (SHJ, 33. 8 km), and Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC, 66. 6 km). The preferred airport is Dubai International Airport.

59242.description: A well-established hotel, located in the Kargicak district on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, 15 km east of the popular resort of Alanya. Consisting of 9 blocks set in lush gardens, the hotel is situated across the road from the beach and is suitable for families with children. Public transport runs in front of the hotel providing easy access to Alanya and its many attractions. Located in a quieter district, with some hotels close-by, there are more amenities available in Mahmutlar, 4 km away.

name.content: The Park Hotel Ex Al Jawhara Gardens

59245.description: The The Park Hotel Ex Al Jawhara Gardens Hotel offers spacious rooms and suites decorated in a colorful Arabic style. Attention to detail is evident throughout, from the welcoming ambiance and attentive staff to the comprehensive facilities and halal dining options. Guests can enjoy international cuisine 24 hours a day, along with seasonal seafood specialties at the hotel's restaurant and coffee shop. Located within easy walking distance of Deira City Centre Shopping Mall and a short 4-minute drive from Dubai International Airport, the The Park Hotel Ex Al Jawhara Gardens Hotel is ideal for families. As a Sharia-compliant hotel, alcohol consumption and unmarried couples sharing rooms are not permitted. Guests should verify visa requirements before traveling. If the credit card used for booking does not belong to the guest, the hotel requires advance notification.

59246.description: This outstanding property boasts a prime location in the centre of Dubai, featuring magnificent views over Dubai Creek. The international airport is to be found just a 10-minute driving distance away. This city hotel is known for its outstanding design and good-natured staff, who are always eager to help visitors during their stay. Guests can unwind in one of the elegant rooms, which feature all the necessary facilities and have been decorated in earthy tones to create a pleasant atmosphere. This hotel includes a large choice of premium facilities that are sure to delight even those most meticulous travellers. It has a rooftop pool with sun-lounger terrace and provides a variety of dining options, including delicious Lebanese cuisine and live entertainment. There is also a restaurant that serves traditional Russian dishes, as well as a sports tavern. Moreover, guests can also enjoy a Swedish massage or tea-tree facial, all for an unforgettable stay in Dubai.

name.content: La Quinta by Wyndham Dubai Jumeirah

59247.address: Sheikh Rashid Road / off Jumeirah Street Near Mina
59247.description: Wake up on the bright side with La Quinta by Wyndham hotels. Whether you are in town for work or play we are here to help you relax with comfortable accommodations and modern amenities. While you are here enjoy our free Bright Side Breakfast connect to free WiFi and recharge in one of our spacious guest rooms. Our friendly staff also provides great service so you can make the most of your stay.

59248.description: The Coral Deira Dubai, a 4-star hotel, offers excellent value in the heart of Dubai's commercial and retail district. Located just 7km from Dubai International Airport and a short walk from the metro, it caters to both business and leisure travelers. Nearby attractions include the Dubai Creek, the gold and spice souks, and shopping malls such as Deira City Centre. Guests can enjoy the rooftop pool, fitness center, and sauna, as well as three dining options featuring local and international cuisine.

name.content: Howard Johnson Plaza by Wyndham Dubai Deira

59249.address: 26 B Street Al Rigga Al Muraqqabat Deira, 7
59249.description: Located in the centre of the Deira district, this luxurious hotel is 200 metres from the Al Rigga metro station and a 10-minute drive from Dubai International Airport. All rooms are spacious and elegantly furnished, equipped with free Wi-Fi and a wide choice of modern conveniences to guarantee a truly memorable stay. High speed Wi-Fi is available in all areas with unlimited device and is free of charge. At this property guests can enjoy a wide ranging buffet of international cuisine all day, and the coffee shop also offers a selection of juices, coffees, pastries and cookies. Guests can relax in the hot tub, visit the fitness centre to enjoy an invigorating workout or enjoy the rooftop pool, as well as experience various spa treatments and massages. This stunning establishment is ideally located for easy access to Deira and Al Ghurair shopping malls, Dubai Creek gold and yacht club and Gold souq, amongst other nearby attractions. The hotel offers a daily shuttle service to the beach and major shopping malls in Dubai. Free private on-site parking is also available.

59250.address: Al Rigga Street Near Al Ghurair Mall Behind Kfc
59250.description: This elegant, contemporary hotel is conveniently located in central Deira, only 9km from Dubai. Its accessible location, just 550 meters from the Al Rigga metro station, allows visitors to easily access and explore Dubai. The thoughtfully designed rooms are spacious and filled with natural light, offering a relaxing escape. Accommodations include a seating area, an LCD TV with satellite channels, internet access, and a private bathroom. Guests can enjoy exquisite cuisine in the stylish rooftop restaurant's charming atmosphere, with spectacular panoramic city views. Refreshments are also available in the welcoming bar and nightclub. Leisure amenities include a fitness center with cardiovascular equipment and free weights, and an outdoor swimming pool for a refreshing dip on warm days.

59251.description: Saffron Boutique Hotel offers one of the largest rooms in the 4-star category in Dubai. The warmly decorated guest rooms have city views and include satellite TV, air conditioning and a mini bar. Each private bathroom has a bathtub and shower. Guests can benefit from a temperature-controlled rooftop pool, a gym and an on-site restaurant and bar. Saffron Boutique's restaurant serves a range of Far Eastern and South Asian fine-dining in a modern setting. The bar is available for local drinks and international beverages. There is also a 24 hour coffee shop to keep you fresh for all your leisure and business activities. Al Baraha Corniche is just 1 Km away, and Al Mamzar Beach is 5 Km away from the Hotel. Dubai International Airport is 5 Km away from the hotel.

59259.description: Howard Johnson Hotel is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Dubai. The hotel has everything you need for a comfortable stay. All the necessary facilities, including 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, postal service, are at hand. Television LCD/plasma screen, carpeting, non smoking rooms, air conditioning, heating can be found in selected guestrooms. Entertain the hotel's recreational facilities, including hot tub, fitness center, sauna, outdoor pool. No matter what your reasons are for visiting Dubai, Howard Johnson Hotel will make you feel instantly at home.

59260.description: Holiday Inn Downtown Dubai, is a contemporary four star hotel located in Deira in the heart of Dubai. The hotel is placed within walking distance to Al Ghurair Mall, close to famous landmarks and cultural locations such as the city colorful Spice and Gold Souq, Dubai Creek, Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall and other sightseeing destinations. It is in close proximity to Dubai International Airport, 10 minute's drive, and Rigga Metro station, 2 minute walk. The hotel 139 rooms and suites offer a fresh and modern setting for your business or leisure stay. Enjoy an elegant atmosphere at our restaurants and lobby bar lounge. Unwind and reenergize yourself with all that our Spa and Fitness Center have to offer. For holidaymakers and families, the hotel makes a perfect base for sightseeing in Dubai. You can shop at state of the art malls or explore old markets and souks. Make use of the hotel complimentary shuttle bus to the beach and malls. When you are back at the hotel, you will be able to enjoy complimentary WiFi to connect with work or personal matters. Business travelers can make use of our meeting and conference facilities that cater for up to 120 people. Take advantage of our Business Center. When it comes to dining and entertainment, the 6 bars and 2 restaurants of the hotel offer a variety of dining options. During your stay with us, be sure to check out the beauty salon and our newly renovated outdoor swimming pool and the gym.

59261.description: Located in Bur Dubai, the Imperial Suites Hotel is just 200 meters from Al Fahidi Metro Station. Offering some of the most spacious rooms in its class at 400-450 sq. ft. , each suite features modern furnishings, a comfortable seating area, a work desk, and a minibar. The newly renovated suites also include Wi-Fi and a large sitting room with a dining area. All rooms are air-conditioned and have a private bathroom with modern amenities. Guests can unwind on the rooftop pool deck with its sun loungers and refreshing drinks. Nearby attractions such as Meena Bazaar and Burjuman Mall are within walking distance (500-750 meters), and the hotel is conveniently close to major international and local banks and consulates. Dubai International Airport is a 15-minute drive away, while the World Trade Centre and Dubai International Exhibition Centre are reachable in 8-10 minutes. A travel desk in the lobby assists with excursions and sightseeing trips, and laundry and dry-cleaning services are available.

59262.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including a nightclub, a 24-hour health club, and an outdoor pool. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy Chinese cuisine at The China Club, one of the hotel's 9 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 3 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 21689 square feet (2015 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 21 meeting rooms.

59263.description: Located in the heart of Karama, this hotel offers a peaceful retreat while still being within easy reach of Dubai's vibrant city center and business district. Dubai International Airport is also easily accessible. Opened in 2005, this air-conditioned hotel features 130 well-equipped rooms, each designed to provide a comfortable and relaxing stay. Guests can enjoy a range of amenities, including Wi-Fi, conference facilities, room and laundry services, and on-site parking. A variety of dining options are available nearby, offering Indian, Chinese, Continental, and Arabic cuisine. For leisure, the hotel boasts an indoor pool, massage services, a gym, and a beauty studio.

59265.description:
Millennium Airport Hotel Dubai is an award-winning contemporary lifestyle hotel that combines comfort, convenience, and exceptional hospitality in one of Dubai's most accessible locations. Just five minutes from Dubai International Airport (DXB) and within walking distance of Al Garhoud Metro Station, the hotel offers seamless access to the city's major business districts, shopping destinations, and iconic attractions, making it an ideal choice for both business and leisure travellers. 

Recognised for its outstanding service and commitment to excellence, the hotel has been named the Middle East's Leading Airport Hotel at the World Travel Awards 2025 for the thirteenth time since 2008. It also received the prestigious title of United Arab Emirates' Leading Airport Hotel 2025, reinforcing its reputation as one of the region's premier hospitality destinations. 

The hotel features 341 spacious, elegantly appointed, non-smoking guest rooms and suites, including Superior, Deluxe, Grand Rooms, and Executive Deluxe Suites. 

Guests can enjoy an exceptional culinary experience across nine distinctive restaurants and bars, serving a variety of international cuisines, including Italian, Mexican, Japanese, Indian, and international buffet selections. The hotel also offers vibrant nightlife venues, providing memorable dining and entertainment experiences. 

Leisure facilities include a large outdoor swimming pool with a pool bar, beautifully landscaped gardens, a children's playground, a spa, a beauty salon, and a fully equipped fitness centre. The hotel also offers versatile meeting and event venues for conferences, weddings, and social celebrations, including a ballroom, 7 meeting venues supported by dedicated event professionals. 

The Millennium Airport Hotel Dubai continues to be a preferred destination for travellers seeking comfort, convenience, and an outstanding stay in the heart of Dubai.

59267.description: This hotel is located on Al Maktoum Street within a short distance of the Clock Tower in the Deira district of the city. It lies approximately 5 km from Dubai international airport. The centre of Dubai is about 2 km away. The Nihal Hotel is conveniently located to all major attractions and shopping malls. The Nihal features a total of 70 guest rooms and suites. All of the accommodation is neatly decorated in a classical style and guests can enjoy spacious and comfortable rooms. Guests may enjoy international cuisine and specialties from Chinese restaurant, South Indian restaurant and Goan restaurant. All of the rooms are fully-equipped as standard with centrally controlled air conditioning. Leisure options include a hot tub, an outdoor pool and a gym.

59268.address: Dubai Golf Creek And Yacht Club, sn
59268.description: Located in Dubai Creek Golf Yacht club on the banks of the majestic Dubai Creek, Park Hyatt Dubai provides an idyllic setting for a luxury getaway. Nestled in the heart of city, ten minutes from Dubai International Airport, Gold Souk, Dubai Museum and Burj Khalifa. This 5 star Dubai resort offers 225 luxury rooms including 35 suites; all of which offer stunning views overlooking the Dubai Creek and marina. The resort is home to an inspired assortment of award-winning Dubai restaurants lounges, including the signature French brasserie Traiteur, The Thai Kitchen, Café Arabesque, The Terrace and The Lobby Lounge. The property also features five unique event venues, housed in a dedicated building with a separate entrance and reception area. As a premium Dubai city resort, the property offers its guests a number of exciting activities such as Seawings, the aerial seaplane taking off of Dubai Creek and an 18-hole, par-71 championship course that rolls into thousands of undulating yards, or pampering spa treatments at the luxury Amara Spa, one of the finest Dubai spas. Mandatory New Year’s Eve Gala Dinner charge of AED 2800 per adult and AED 1400 per child (6-12 years) is applied on overnight stay of December 31, in addition to room charge. Hotel requires 100% non-refundable deposit for the entire stay including mandatory New Year’s Gala Dinner and to be collected at the time of reservation. Children 13 years and above are considered as adult pricing, applicable throughout the hotel.

59269.description: The Shangri-La Hotel, Dubai, is conveniently located on Sheikh Zayed Road in the heart of the city, just 15 minutes from Dubai International Airport. This luxurious hotel offers 302 spacious, Arabian-inspired rooms and 126 serviced apartments, ideal for both short and long stays. Guests can enjoy stunning views of the Burj Khalifa, and benefit from complimentary shuttle transfers to key locations like the Dubai World Trade Centre, Dubai Mall, and Business Bay. Facilities include CHI, The Spa at Shangri-La, a fitness center, tennis and squash courts, a pool, fine dining options, and meeting rooms. For those seeking exclusivity, the Horizon Club offers premium accommodation on two private floors.

name.content: Sheraton Dubai Creek Hotel and Towers

59270.address: P.O.Box 4250, Baniyas Road-Port Saeed Riggat Al Bu
59270.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy Italian cuisine at Vivaldi, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 323 square feet (30 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 9 meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite.

name.content: The George Hotel by Saffron Dubai Creek

59271.address: Baniyas Rd - Deira - Al Ras - Dubai
59271.description: Located by the famous Dubai creek, this upmarket hotel offers spacious accommodation with panoramic views of both old and new Dubai. This stunning establishment features a wide choice of well-appointed rooms equipped with a large choice of premium amenities such as in-house video channels and Wi-Fi internet connection, ideal for those corporate travellers needing to stay connected. Gastronomy lovers staying at this luxurious hotel will appreciate the variety of cuisines across 3 restaurants, and there is also a discotheque including panoramic view of the Creek. This enchanting establishment is just a 5-minute walk from the Gold and Spice Souks. Al Ras Metro Station is just 150 metres away, offering easy access to the most popular areas of the city. Dubai International Airport is a 15-minute drive from this property.

59273.address: 15 Street, Al Rigga Road, P.O.BOX 33382, DEIRA
59273.description: Versailles by Raviz Hotel provides flawless service and all the necessary facilities for visitors. Stay connected with your associates, as complimentary Wi-Fi is available during your entire visit. To facilitate your arrival and departure, you can pre-book airport transfer services prior to checking in. Smoking is permitted solely in the specified smoking zones allocated by hotel. Start your day stress-free at Versailles by Raviz Hotel as breakfast is made available for you on the premises. How about kicking off each day of your getaway with a delicious cup of coffee? At the hotel, relish in the invigorating taste of a freshly brewed, excellent coffee. Various excellent meal offerings at hotel ensure that enticing and easily accessible options are constantly available. Versailles by Raviz Hotel provides a superb assortment of leisure amenities for guests to enjoy. Unwind by the pool at hotel and cherish a leisurely moment. Guests who enjoy maintaining their fitness regimen while on holiday can visit the fitness center provided by hotel.

59339.description: Situated between the vibrant Ixelles and Saint-Gilles districts of Brussels, this property offers studios and apartments perfect for exploring the city's museums, diverse architecture, and charming lifestyle. Each unit features a separate bathroom and toilet, a fully equipped kitchen with a stove, microwave, fridge, and dishwasher, as well as amenities such as satellite TV, Wi-Fi, a direct-line phone, hairdryer, and safe. The property also benefits from air conditioning and offers weekly housekeeping services, including linen and towel changes. Additional cleaning is available upon request. Two apartments are adapted for guests with reduced mobility. Ascott Cares program ensures high hygiene and cleanliness standards for a safe and comfortable stay.

59380.address: Al Hamra Corniche Road Jeddah 21531 Sea Front
59380.description: Enjoy breathtaking views of the Red Sea front and King Fahad's Fountain. Nestled in a prime location close to Jeddah business centers and top attractions such as Al Balad, shopping malls and famous historical sites, with fast access to King Abdulaziz International Airport. All guests are ensured an optimal experience through the essential amenities provided, elegant rooms and suites, Fitness Center, dining outlets and event venues.

name.content: Four Seasons Riyadh At kingdom Centre

59385.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a spa tub, and a sauna. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Grab a bite at Obaya Lounge, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 274 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with Egyptian cotton sheets. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is available.

59388.address: Al Mubarakiah Plaza King Abdulaziz Street
59388.description: Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including a health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Grab a bite at Brasserie on Four, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Riyadh? This hotel has 12917 square feet (1200 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 294 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions.

59427.address: 25, Arthur Bunder Rd, Apollo Bandar, Colaba
59427.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an outdoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and barbecue grills. Grab a bite at Poolside Dining, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 93 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries.

59430.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a 24-hour health club and an outdoor pool. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite at Fenix, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include wired internet access (surcharge), a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Mumbai? This hotel has 1001 square feet (93 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

name.content: Al Muntazah Plaza Hotel and Apt.

59447.description: This elegant hotel is ideally situated on Mansoora Street and a short drive from the international airport. The Al Muntazah Plaza Hotel offers 94 spacious guest rooms with modern amenities and pleasant city views. Doha's famous shopping area is just a five-minute walk away, making this hotel a great choice for those seeking retail therapy. The hotel's comfortable Mid Town Restaurant serves local specialties for lunch and dinner, and guests can also enjoy the hotel's excellent leisure facilities.

name.content: Grand Regency Doha, Trademark Collection Wyndham

59448.description: Set in a prime location of Doha, Grand Regency Doha Trademark Collection by wyndham puts everything the city has to offer just outside your doorstep. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. All the necessary facilities, including 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, facilities for disabled guests, express check-in/check-out, are at hand. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer television LCD/plasma screen, separate living room, internet access – wireless, non smoking rooms, air conditioning to ensure a restful night. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include hot tub, fitness center, sauna, outdoor pool, spa. Wyndham Grand Regency Doha is an excellent choice from which to explore Doha or to simply relax and rejuvenate.

59450.description: Located on Doha's longest beach and nestled in landscaped gardens, InterContinental Doha Beach & Spa features 12 restaurants and bars, including the famous La Mar by Gaston Acurio, a range of recreational facilities, a free-form swimming pool, and the exclusive Spa InterContinental. The hotel's prime location is minutes from Lusail, downtown Doha, the Doha Exhibition and Convention Centre, City Center Mall, and Doha Golf Club.

59451.description: On the Arabian Gulf, the Mercure Grand Hotel sits in the heart of the bustling business district of Doha next to Msheireb Metro Station, near Souq Waqif, the Arab marketplace and the Msheireb Downtown Doha. Our four meeting rooms for up to 200 people will meet your every business needs, while our restaurants and bars will take care of your appetite as you dine on international cuisine at La Brasserie, Italian cuisine at La Villa, and fine steaks at The Old Manor Steakhouse and Bar. Tours can be arranged.

name.content: Best Western London Queens Crystal Palace

59579.description:
Built in 1854 to coincide with the reopening of the Crystal Palace exhibition venue, Best Western London Queens Crystal Palace Hotel is a striking Victorian building in one of the most picturesque parts of south London. 
A stay here puts you in good company – French writer Emile Zola resided here for many months in the 1890s during his time in exile, while German emperor Kaiser Wilhelm II used the hotel as a base for his visits to Queen Victoria. 
Our updated rooms all come with contemporary décor, air conditioning, flat-screen TV and hairdryer. We also have an onsite car park, conferencing facilities, Italian restaurant and spacious ground floor lounge bar with satellite TV. 
Selhurst Park football ground is only a five-minute drive away, while Crystal Palace Park is just two minutes by car. If you’re looking to do a spot of sightseeing while you’re here, you’ll find the major attractions of central London around 8 miles from the hotel.

name.content: Bremon Boutique Hotel by Duquesa Hotels Collection

59599.description: The history, traditions and setting of Cardona make this ancient town more than just salt and famous buildings. The hotel has 19 rooms (double, superior and junior suites) equipped with safety box, heating, television and other amenities.

60059.description: This hotel enjoys a convenient setting in the city centre of Madrid. The hotel enjoys close proximity to many of the city's main attractions. The famous Teatro Real, Plaza Mayor and Palacio Real can be found nearby. Puerta del Sol is just 300 metres away. The hotel is conveniently situated just 8 km away from Barajas Airport. This charming hotel appeals to travellers who are eager to explore the city, as well as those visiting for business purposes. The hotel's design is based on an innovative concept of style and affordability. The guest rooms have been decorated by Tomas Alia, with bold tones to create a striking avant-garde style. Guests are invited to enjoy a wonderful breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to work or explore the area.

60180.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Barrio de las Letras. It sits on Santa Ana square, close to the most important commercial centre in the city. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to the Prado, Thyssen Bornemisza and Reina Sofia museums. The hotel is just a 5 minutes' drive away from Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor and Gran Via. The airport is just 10 km away. The hotel occupies a building that was designed by the famous architect, Modesto Lopez Knoll, at the beginning of the 20th century. The hotel comprises stunningly-designed rooms and suites. Guests are sure to be impresssed by the extensive range of exemplary facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. The safety of our customers is our priority and so in accordance with local health legislation, the breakfast service may have temporary changes (opening hours, products on offer, layout and service)

60199.description: Located next to Spain Square, Fira de Barcelona, and the Arenas Shopping Center, the four-star Hotel Pestana Arena Barcelona is a modern boutique hotel offering comfort and well-being. Ideal for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel is within walking distance of Sants train station and the airport shuttle service. The 84 guest rooms include eight junior suites and three executive rooms with terraces and outdoor Jacuzzis. All rooms feature air conditioning, minibars, free safes, hair dryers, 40' LCD TVs, and free Wi-Fi. A newly refurbished bar and lounge with an open terrace provides the perfect entertainment area. Guests also enjoy complimentary access to the sauna, steam room, and a small executive gym.

60279.description: The hotel, conveniently located just 300 meters from its sister hotel's beach, offers easy access to local amenities and shopping within a 5-minute walk. A variety of bars are nearby, with additional options a short stroll away. The Archaeological Museum is approximately 6 km from the hotel, and Antalya Airport is about 15 km away. Guests staying at the Akra V 4* are welcome to bring their cat or dog (up to 11 kg) for an additional fee of 25 euros per day (food not included). Please inform us of your pet's stay during reservation. Note: This pet policy applies only to the Akra V and not the main Akra building.

60359.description: This hotel is located in Sultanahmet, in the heart of Istanbul, a city which has always attracted travellers with its history, its nature, and its archaeological significance. Shops, bars and restaurants are located in the immediate vicinity, as are the famous Hagia Sophia and the Hippodrome. It is approximately 500 m to the Grand Bazaar, while Taksim Square is some 5 kms away. Guests will reach the airport in about 15 kms. Restored in 2006, a total of 48 rooms are on offer within this traditional building, which still reflects the architectural style of the 19th century. The interiors and decoration have been hand-crafted. In the hotel restaurant guests may enjoy outstanding Turkish and international cuisine in a traditional atmosphere with live music all day long, next to a terrace with views of historically important monuments.

60360.description: Situated in Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, Fuat Bey Palace Hotel offers rooms with free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, just 200 meters from the Sea of Marmara. Guests can enjoy an authentic hammam. The air-conditioned rooms feature neutral colors and parquet floors, along with a minibar, tea and coffee making facilities, and an en-suite bathroom. A 24-hour reception and tour desk are available for added convenience. Iconic landmarks such as the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, and Topkapi Palace are within a 10-minute walk. Fatih is an excellent choice for travelers interested in monuments, museums, and sightseeing.

60361.description: This beautiful Ottoman style boutique hotel is excellently located in the historic Sultanahmet district of Istanbul. It features a restaurant, a bar and a terrace with marvellous views over the Marmara Sea and the Blue Mosque, which is only 100 m away. The most famous attractions of the city are in the surroundings, such as the Hagia Sophia, Topkapi palace, Hippodrome or the Spice Bazaar.

60539.address: Mimar Kemalettin Mh., Abu Hayat Sk, 5
60539.description: Refurbished in 2013, the hotel comprises a total of 67 rooms spread across 7 floors. Located in the Beyazit district of Istanbul, the hotel is well placed for visiting the historical attractions of Sultanahmet, a 15-minute walk away and the Taksim Square, 20 minutes by public transport; the Grand Bazaar is just a 5-minute walk. Comfortably furnished, the hotel features a rooftop panoramic restaurant and free Wi-FI.

60540.description: This hotel is situated in the historic and cultural area of Istanbul. Restaurants, shops and a bus stop can all be reached in about 100 m, while Istanbul airport is around 15 km away from the hotel. Many of the city's sights, such as the Grand Bazaar or the Hagia Sophia Museum, are approximately a 10-minute drive away. Renovated in 2006, the hotel comprises a total of 126 air-conditioned rooms, some of which are disability-friendly. Food and drinks are served at the hotel's cafe, piano bar and 2 restaurants. A nightclub is available for evening entertainment. In the hotel grounds guests will find a heated swimming pool with loungers ready for use. Further relaxation is available at the SPA. Sports enthusiasts may also enjoy a workout in the gym.

name.content: B&B Hotel Santos Dumont Rio de Janeiro

60599.description: Located just 500 meters from Santos Dumont Domestic Airport and a short walk from the US Consulate, this hotel offers convenient access to Rio de Janeiro's city center. Guests are within easy reach of subway stations, museums, the Municipal Theatre, and just a short drive or taxi ride from the famous Copacabana Beach. The eight-story hotel features 75 rooms and suites, a 24-hour reception, and conference facilities, including an auditorium. A restaurant with room service is also available for guests' convenience. All rooms come well-equipped with standard amenities. Please note that visitors must register at reception and a fee may apply. Visitor access is also subject to room capacity limits.

60802.description: The Ramada Istanbul Taksim is a short five-minute walk from Taksim Square and the ICEC Lutfi Kirdar Congress Center. Conveniently located near the metro and airport shuttle service, this hotel offers four meeting rooms and a workshop space. Explore nearby shopping malls and historical sites, or take a quick metro or tram ride to Topkapi Palace, the Blue Mosque, and Hagia Sophia. A complimentary open buffet breakfast is included with your stay. Please note that pets are not allowed.

60807.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the suburbs of Milan and was established in 1960. It is a short drive away from the UNIVERSITY BICOCCA and the nearest station is Sesto Marelli. The Hotel has a restaurant. All 96 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning. ***Customers must pay a city tax by the property, except those under 18 years. ***

60819.description: The Hotel Miramar Barcelona, a 5-star luxury hotel, graces the eastern slope of Montjuïc mountain, overlooking the city and the Mediterranean Sea. This historic 1920s palace seamlessly blends its original grandeur with contemporary design and luxurious finishes. Enjoy the stunning outdoor pool, unwind in the spa, or take an evening stroll through the lush gardens of Montjuïc and Costa i Llobera. A mere ten minutes from the city center's upscale shops and trendy restaurants, and also a short walk from the Olympic Stadium and Palau Sant Jordi, the Hotel Miramar offers exceptional accommodations in Barcelona. Please note that parking is subject to availability and incurs an additional cost.

name.content: Cairo Marriott hotel & Omar Khayyam Casino

60964.address: Saray El Giziera St, El Zamalek, 16
60964.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. Gambling sorts can try their luck at the casino, while others may prefer a 24-hour health club or an outdoor pool. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy international cuisine at Omar's Cafe, one of the hotel's 14 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 3 coffee shops/cafes. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held on select days. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 5 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Cairo? This hotel has 35004 square feet (3252 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 14 meeting rooms.

60980.description: This modern hotel is just a short stroll from the centre of the historical city of Alanya, in Turkey, with its large variety of shops, restaurants, bars and cafés that will delight visitors and will allow them to spend the day exploring the city and tasting new flavours. The airport is about 40-minute car ride away from the complex. The Cleopatra beach is conveniently close and at a walking distance, visitors can relax and sunbathe while listening to the waves of the Mediterranean Sea. Tourist attractions such as the Alanya Archaeological Museumare and the Damlatas Cave are within easy reach. In the property, guests can relax and rest by the swimming pool, eat delicious food in the restaurant or have drinks in the bar. The well-equipped rooms are nicely decorated with bright and warm colours to make each traveller have the most pleasant and unforgettable stay.

61119.address: İncekum beldesi Alara Park Otel PK
61119.description: This family-friendly hotel sits on a rocky promontory over-looking the beautiful, sandy Incekum Beach on Turkey's Mediterranean coast. Occupying 12,000 m2 of land with luscious gardens, the hotel consists of 6 separate blocks and a private beach with plenty of little rocky inlets to explore. The main road is approximately 50 m away and from there public transport runs regularly. The town of Avsallar is 3 km away and the larger resort of Alanya is at a distance of 26 km.

61120.address: Tilkiler Mevkii, Erhan Demir Bulvari Pk6,Colakli
61120.description: The hotel is located 13 km from Manavgat and 6 km from the ancient city of Side. The Antalya national and international airport is 55 km away from the complex. Guests can enjoy the private beach of the hotel as well as beautiful view of the near mountains. The residence comprises of 224 rooms, distributed across 3 floors. The hotel offers a broad range of facilities including a lobby with currency exchange facilities and 24-hour reception. Guests can also enjoy the on-site café, a disco and a restaurant for drinks and dining. There are on-site conference facilities as well as Internet access for business travellers. All accommodation units are fully-equipped as standard featuring a split air conditioning and heating system. Leisure options include a fitness area, spa procedures and various sport options. The hotel offers all-inclusive meal packages.

61141.description: Conveniently located in central Paris near Saint-Lazare Station, Montmartre, the Opera, and department stores, the 4-star Posy Hotel by Happyculture seamlessly blends business and leisure. Its 48 comfortable, functional rooms and two junior suites accommodate one to two guests and are newly renovated with air conditioning. Nearby, explore numerous cabarets, theaters, museums, and restaurants. If you prefer to dine in, room service is available from 5 p. m. to 1:30 a. m. Enjoy the charming, quiet patio, a relaxing escape from the bustling city. Some rooms offer stunning views of the Moulin Rouge. A continental breakfast buffet, featuring pastries, cereals, bread, yogurt, cheeses, applesauce, juices, and hot drinks, is served from 7:30 a. m. to 10:30 a. m. The lobby offers a snack and soft drink dispenser and a business center with internet access (fee applies). Free Wi-Fi is available.

61145.description: The O&B Athens Boutique Hotel, a cozy 4-star establishment, is located in the heart of Athens, just steps from Ermou Street and a short 2-minute walk from the Thisio Metro Station. Enjoy easy access to the city's main attractions and the ancient ruins of the Agora and Acropolis. The hotel features Acropolis Suites with private terraces boasting views of the Parthenon, elegant rooms, and the O&B Athens All Day Bar Restaurant. Experience a unique blend of modern comfort and classic Athenian charm, with stylish design and a warm, inviting atmosphere.

name.content: Grand Hyatt Mumbai Hotel and Residences

61288.address: Off Western Express Highway, Santacruz East
61288.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a health club, an outdoor pool, and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy Chinese cuisine at China House Restaurant, one of the hotel's 5 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Mumbai? This hotel has 11571 square feet (1075 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 5 meeting rooms.

61290.description: Enjoy an array of amenities at the Sheraton Riyadh Hotel & Towers, including an indoor pool, sauna, and 24-hour fitness center. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, or take advantage of the concierge services and on-site hair salon. Dine at La Piazza, specializing in Italian cuisine, or enjoy the coffee shop/cafe and 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee). The hotel features a business center, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers. With over 10, 000 square feet of event space, including a conference center and five meeting rooms, it's ideal for hosting events in Riyadh. Free valet parking is available. The 193 air-conditioned rooms offer comfort and convenience with iPod docking stations, minibars, and 40-inch LCD TVs with satellite programming. Private bathrooms include designer toiletries and bidets. Safes and desks are also provided. Located near attractions such as Souq Taibah, King Fahd District Park, and the Riyadh Gallery, the hotel is approximately 33. 3 km from King Khaled International Airport (RUH).

61293.description: Strategically situated close to Santacruz's domestic airport and 15 minutes from Sahar International Airport, The Orchid is the perfect stop for conference and business guests. Having won countless awards and accolades, this upscale hotel lives up to its first-class reputation. Featuring stunning Indian opulence, this spectacular hotel will leave guests breathless once they walk through the door. The expansive lobby features warm tones, grand columns and ornate designs. Guests are invited to indulge in the culinary delights of the restaurants serving authentic Indian and exciting fusions that are sure to appeal to all the senses. Fully accommodating business meetings and conferences with its host of high-quality facilities, the hotel is the preferred choice among business travellers visiting the area.

name.content: Long Beach Alanya - Ultra All Inclusive

61401.description: General Introduction Located in the Turkler district of Antalya, one of the most beautiful holiday centers of the Mediterranean, Long Beach Resort Hotel & Spa Deluxe embraces the guests with its 600 m long beach and clean sea stretching along the length of the south. 2 salt water pools and aquapark on the beach of the property promise all guests very entertaining hours. In the aquapark of the property, there are 11 water slides for adults and 17 water slides for children. Promising a comfortable accommodation experience in its rooms decorated with modern details, Long Beach Resort Hotel & Spa Deluxe also stands out with its rich SPA facilities. Featuring a calm and peaceful atmosphere, the property is waiting for the guests who want to get rid of the tiredness of the whole year. In the SPA area there is an indoor pool, sauna, Turkish bath, jacuzzi and massage services. Located in Long Beach Resort Hotel & Spa Deluxe, the amusement park serves 3 hours a day. Guests can taste very good dishes in the main and a la carte restaurants of the property. Special privileges are offered to honeymoon couples in the property.

61419.description: Located in the charming fishing village of Sesimbra, facing the sea, and surrounded by unparalleled natural reserve Arrabida, the Sesimbra Hotel & Spa offers 84 standard rooms and 8 suites with modern design, all with a fabulous view over the Atlantic. Just 30 km from Lisbon, the hotel has a restaurant, bar, outdoor swimming pool for adults and children, children's play area, covered parking and Spa, with free use for guests of the following services: indoor relaxation pool, sauna, Turkish bath, tropical shower, Swiss shower and gym. All rooms equipped with cable TV (with screen plasma), free safe, minibar, air conditioning, direct-dial telephone to the outside and a private balcony.

name.content: Villas HM Paraiso del Mar Holbox

61586.description: Welcome to Villas HM Paraíso del Mar, your eco-friendly hotel in Holbox. Here, you'll experience a dream vacation in paradise, surrounded by stunning scenery and natural light. Enjoy luxurious tranquility and exclusivity throughout the hotel as you relax and create unforgettable memories in this beautiful corner of the Caribbean. We're dedicated to ensuring your utmost comfort and care.

61588.description: The LaLiT Mumbai places you in the heart of Mumbai, within a 10-minute drive of Powai Lake and the University of Mumbai. This luxury hotel is also conveniently close to Sanjay Gandhi National Park (7 km) and Juhu Beach (9. 1 km). Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Guests can enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a steam room, and a 24-hour fitness center. The hotel also offers Wi-Fi (surcharge), concierge services, and gift shops. The 367 guest rooms feature refrigerators, minibars, and 32-inch LCD televisions with satellite programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi is also provided. Private bathrooms include separate bathtubs and showers with rainfall showerheads. For dining, the 24/7 restaurant offers pool views, and 24-hour room service is available. Buffet breakfasts are served daily (7:30 AM to 10:30 AM, for a fee). Additional amenities include wired internet access (surcharge), a 24-hour business center, and express check-out. The hotel boasts over 8, 000 square feet of event space. Airport shuttle service is available (surcharge), and free valet parking is provided.

61810.description:
This hotel lies close to an array of shops, a bus station. The centre of Madrid is 15 km from Velilla de San Antonio and Madrid's Barajas Airport lies 22 km away.

Opened in 2004, this single-storey hotel comprises a total of 24 rooms, of which 1 is wheelchair accessible. The rooms are housed within a new, air-conditioned brick building featuring white and black marble. Facilities include a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a hotel safe and a cloakroom, in addition to a café and a restaurant. The large windows in the reception area and café mean that the hotel is well lit, spacious and comfortable.

Each of the modern, functional rooms comes with an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer and heated towel rails, a direct dial telephone, a TV, a minibar, a double bed, individually controllable heating and air conditioning, a safe, as well as a balcony or terrace.

Follow the extension of O'Donnell on the M-23 (Vicalvaro), then take the R3 (toll motorway) and take the Velilla-Mejorada exit. The M-40, M-45 and M-30 all afford access to the R3.

62062.description: Boasting a classic façade which contrasts with the modern interior design, this refurbished hotel enjoys a central location in Edinburgh, right in the vibrant Grassmarket area, one of the most visited places of the city with splendid views of the nearby castle. The property is only a few minutes' walk from the popular Royal Mile and the National Museum of Scotland, while Waverley Train Station is some 800 m away. The establishment is proud to describe itself as a little magic place with charming guest rooms, which present a very modern and pleasant decoration as well as great facilities such as iPod docks, air-conditioning, tea making facilities and rain showers in every bathroom. Also business travellers can take advantage of the on-site facilities which include free Wi-Fi throughout the building and comfortable work desks within every bedroom. The property offers a tasty room service menu with a great variety of delicious dishes and a packed lunch can also be arranged.

62099.description:
Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, outdoor tennis courts, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the complimentary area shuttle. All-inclusive rates are available at this hotel. Meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments are included in all-inclusive rates. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Enjoy Italian cuisine at Bene, one of the hotel's 5 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wind down with a drink at one of the 3 bars/lounges or 2 poolside bars.

62119.address: Kuwait Street, Bur Dubai, PO BOX 121545
62119.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a nightclub, a health club, and an outdoor pool. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy international cuisine at Docklands, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 4 coffee shops/cafes. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 7 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 34647 square feet (3219 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms.

62344.description: The five-star Dusit Thani Dubai hotel, located in Dubai's commercial district, offers easy access to business and leisure attractions. Just minutes from the World Trade Centre, Dubai International Convention Centre, Dubai International Financial Centre, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai Mall, this luxury hotel also provides convenient access to Dubai International Airport and major shopping malls. The hotel features 321 luxuriously furnished rooms and suites, combining modern amenities with traditional Thai hospitality. Guests can enjoy a variety of dining experiences at seven restaurants, including the signature Benjarong restaurant, offering Royal Thai cuisine. The hotel also boasts extensive meeting facilities, including the magnificent Al Wasl Ballroom, which can accommodate up to 600 guests, and a dedicated business centre. For added luxury, Dusit Club Rooms and Junior Suites offer access to the Dusit Club Lounge with complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea, and other exclusive benefits.

62345.description: The Move Inn Jeddah Hotel offers 140 spacious, newly furnished, and well-equipped guest rooms. This city-center hotel features a large ballroom, a boardroom, and five meeting rooms, ideal for business travelers. Enjoy convenient access to a shopping center across the street, as well as numerous consulates, hospitals, and major corporate headquarters located nearby. Wireless internet access is available throughout the hotel, including guest rooms and public areas. On-site parking is also provided, along with convenient access to the airport. Additional services and restaurants are planned.

62519.description: This historical hotel is located at the heart of Marrakech. Menara - Marrakech Airport is only 5 km away. The hotel marks the advent of a new generation presenting modern services which will allow guests to enjoy a wonderful holiday in a genuine Moroccan environment with all necessary amenities, from accommodation to dining. Guests can discover Moroccan family-style cuisine and even take part in the preparation of dishes. Located on a main road, this air-conditioned hotel de charme features a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a safe and a currency exchange desk. The hotel offers an outdoor pool, with a children's swimming area, a spa, a steam bath and massage treatments. Cooking courses of Moroccan cuisine are also available.

62662.description: This hotel is ideally located 100 meters from the Central Train Station and the metro station serving lines 1 and 3. Just 3km away, you'll find the city center (Corso Buenos Aires), the cathedral, and Sforzesco Castle. Linate Airport is a mere 7km away, while Malpensa Airport is 55km from the hotel. Renovated in 2017, this air-conditioned hotel offers 118 rooms across 5 floors. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a reception area, a lift, a restaurant, a breakfast room, and free Wi-Fi. Laundry service is also available. Each room is air-conditioned and fully equipped with a TV and internet access. Double-glazed windows ensure a peaceful night's sleep. A continental breakfast buffet is served every morning.

62719.description: Next to Saint Mark's Square and near the Bridge of Sighs, Torre Dell'Orologio Signature Residence offers 17 welcoming, comfortable apartments of various sizes in a quiet setting in the center of Venice. The apartments combine privacy with with modern comfort and feature wood-beam ceilings, wood floors, marble bathrooms, fully equipped kitchenette. In-room amenities include a safe, satellite TV, a telephone, individually controlled air conditioning, and a mini-bar. The property provides luggage storage, wake-up service and a front desk from 08:00 to 22:00 (for later check-in, please contact property in advance). Please note that daily cleaning is not provided. Staff can organize airport transfers, car rentals, babysitting services, tours and concert bookings, and gondola excursions.

62920.description: The Occidental Taksim Hotel, located in Istanbul's vibrant Beyoglu district, is just a short walk from Taksim Square and close to the promenade. This modern hotel offers 149 comfortable rooms, ideal for both couples and families. Guests can enjoy a range of amenities, including a wellness and spa center with a sauna, traditional Turkish bath, and massage services. A gym and a fantastic pool are also available. The hotel's prime location provides easy access to Istanbul's iconic palaces, bustling shopping streets, and main attractions.

name.content: DB Villas Le Ville del Lido Resort

62923.description: Situated mere steps from the Lido's famed beach and a scenic 15-minute water bus ride from St. Mark's Square, this hotel offers a tranquil escape or a vibrant holiday experience. Renovated in 2006, the hotel comprises 22 apartments spread across three villas, nestled within beautiful gardens and a terrace. Guests can enjoy a range of amenities, including a lobby with reception and safe, a breakfast room, Wi-Fi, laundry service, bicycle hire, a children's playground, and parking. Each apartment features an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, internet access, and a kitchenette equipped with a small fridge and tea/coffee making facilities. A sofa bed in the lounge, a double bedroom, a second bathroom, an optional in-room safe, and individually controlled air conditioning/heating are standard. Ground floor suites boast private gardens, while first-floor suites offer terraces. The hotel's leisure facilities include two heated pools, a children's pool, a poolside snack bar, and ample parasols. Guests can indulge in various water sports, such as banana boating, rowing, surfing, waterskiing, kayaking, sailing, and paragliding. Land-based activities include aerobics, table tennis, basketball, handball, volleyball, bocce, badminton, bowling, mini golf, and a varied entertainment program. A nearby golf course (5km) offers year-round golfing, tennis, archery, and horse riding. Explore the beautiful Venetian coast or venture into Venice to discover its myriad attractions.

63302.description: L’établissement 9Hotel Paquis se situe dans le centre de Genève, à respectivement 400 mètres et 1, 6 km de ces lieux d’intérêt : Gare de Cornavin et Jet d'eau de Genève. Cet hôtel 3 étoiles propose un bar ainsi que des hébergements dotés de la climatisation, d’une connexion Wi-Fi gratuite et d’une salle de bains privative. Cet hôtel comprend une piscine intérieure, un sauna et un service d'étage.

63303.description: Welcome to our establishment, the ibis Styles Paris Montmartre Batignolles, a completely renovated hotel with a resolutely modern and warm decoration. Stroll through the narrow streets of the famous Montmartre district, admire the wings of the Moulin Rouge, a 5-minute walk away, and discover the emblematic places of our beautiful capital thanks to the two metro stations nearby. In the heart of this lively and dynamic district, our hotel welcomes you for your stay in a friendly and unique atomosphere to forge unforgettable memories.

63404.description: The NH Buenos Aires Latino hotel is conveniently located in the vibrant San Nicolas neighborhood. The Obelisco and the Avenida Corrientes, where guests will find lively restaurants and theatres, are only steps away. Also within walking distance are the Colón Opera House, Casa Rosada, and Plaza de Mayo. The subway stop is 50 meters from the hotel and provides great connections to the rest of the city, plus the Sheraton Convention Center is 20 minutes away on foot. There are 100 contemporary rooms at NH Buenos Aires Latino. Each comes with polished hardwood floors, while some of the suites have panoramic views over the bustling city. All rooms are equipped with free Wi-Fi. For breakfast there is an extensive buffet including cold cuts, cheeses, fruit, cereals, yogurt, and eggs cooked-to-order which can be enjoyed with freshly brewed coffee and tea. Guests can enjoy our tasty international cuisine at the hotel's ground floor restaurant with its stylish understated atmosphere. There is a lobby bar if you prefer a casual drink. Stay on top of your workout and enjoy stunning views of the city at our top-floor gym and later unwind at the sauna. The hotel also has two compact meeting rooms for up to 30 people.

63405.description: The NH Buenos Aires Florida hotel is located in the heart of the commercial district of Buenos Aires and close to shops, restaurants, and bars. The pedestrian Calle Florida nearby is great for shopping, while the Sheraton Convention Center is a short walk away. For connections to the rest of the city, guests can head to the nearby metro, train and bus stations. There are 162 rooms at NH Buenos Aires Florida. Each one is designed for comfort and style with a neutral color palette and cozy hardwood floors. There is air-conditioning, free Wi-Fi and desks in every room, making them great spaces for work and relaxation. Some of our rooms also feature a private balcony where you can enjoy lovely views of the city. To get your day off to a good start, our hotel serves up a huge breakfast buffet each morning. There are plenty of options to satisfy all tastes, including cold cuts, cheeses, fresh pastries, and breads. The innovative lunch and dinner menus at our restaurant change on a regular basis and offer a great selection of international dishes. For a more casual option, head to the Cafeteria NH Florida bar and wind down with your favorite drink.

63406.description: The NH Collection Buenos Aires Jousten hotel is set in a historic building that dates back to 1926. Situated in the heart of the financial district, the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange is only steps away. Business travelers will be conveniently located just a short walk from major conference centers. You will also find cultural activities just two blocks away at the Luna Park Theater and the Kirchner Cultural Center. The rooms at NH Collection Buenos Aires Jousten are decorated in a soothing palette with a tasteful contemporary design, finished with hardwood floors. There is a desk and free Wi-Fi in each room, making them the perfect place for working. If you need an afternoon energy boost, you can make use of the in-room Nespresso machine. As your comfort is key, you will also find pillow menus and premium mattresses in every room. For real luxury, check-in to our Presidential Suite - a unique space that occupies an entire floor and features a Jacuzzi and spectacular views of Buenos Aires. The hotel restaurant serves a delicious spread for breakfast, while Aralar prepares fine Spanish cuisine with the freshest local produce for lunch and dinner. For a more casual drink, head to our bar. Guests also have access to a gym.

63539.description: Don't miss out on recreational opportunities including a health club and a sauna. Additional features at this Beaux Arts hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Grab a bite to eat at one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-out. Planning an event in Istanbul? This hotel has 646 square feet (60 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

63759.description: Centrally located in Paris, Hotel Opera d'Antin is steps from Galeries Lafayette and a short walk from the Palais Garnier. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The 30 air-conditioned guest rooms feature cable TV, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Enjoy a drink at the bar/lounge, and a buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Additional amenities include wired internet access, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies). Nearby attractions include Place de la Madeleine (1. 3 km) and the Champs-Élysées (1. 8 km).

name.content: Grosvenor House, a Luxury Collection Hotel

63839.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the complimentary area shuttle. Enjoy Asian cuisine at Buddha Bar, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge and an ocean view. You can also stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 6 meeting rooms available for events. Free valet parking is available onsite.

63900.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Hotel Ambra, conveniently located near the Sile River Regional Nature Park. Take advantage of our rooftop terrace, garden, and bicycle rentals. We offer 36 guestrooms equipped with minibars, private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads, complimentary Wi-Fi, and laptop-compatible safes. Savor a meal at our restaurant, enjoy room service (limited hours), or relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Hotel amenities include express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, conference space, and two meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies). Free self-parking is also available. Marco Polo Airport (VCE) is approximately 16. 9 km away.

64059.description: The hotel is situated in Fossó, a small country town located 29 km from Venice between Padova and Mestre, with very good connections to the A4 motorway. This wonderful residence includes 10 rooms, with innovative and hospitable elegance. An oasis of tranquillity, guests are offered a lobby and a bar. The rooms include an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, a safe, direct dial telephone, satellite TV, a minibar, Internet access and a radio. A continental breakfast is available to guests each morning. Bed and breakfast is also bookable.

64219.address: Al Mustaqbal Steet Opposite Dubai Mall Downtown
64219.description:
Location This hotel is part of the prize-winning Al Murook complex at the heart of Dubai's business district. It is a true attraction of the city due to its architecture and location, an ideal destination for business travellers and holidaymakers alike. The hotel lies on the famous Sheikh Zayed Street and next to the so-called Dubai International Financial City. The Congress Centre is just three minutes from the hotel. 
A security deposit of AED 300 per room per stay directly to the hotel upon arrival.

64220.address: Abu Baker Al Siddique Rd Deira Adjacent To Hamarai
64220.description: This exclusive property enjoys a convenient location in the heart of Deira, an area in the city of Dubai, in the United Arab Emirates. Guests will find themselves close to some tourist attractions that may provide guests with a feast for their senses, including Dubai Gold Souk, Jumeirah Mosque as well as Dubai Gold and Diamond Park. A wide choice of tantalizing restaurants is to be found nearby while golf enthusiasts may have the chance to enjoy a great day in the surrounding golf courses. This outstanding hotel offers luxurious rooms and suites featuring lavish amenities and top class services to satisfy even the most discerning travellers. The extensive facilities include a wide range of restaurants serving international cuisine as well as different bars ideal to spend a day at the pool or start a day off right with a quality cup of coffee. The fitness centre and spa area are the best choice to relax body and mind. *

64221.description: Located in Ajman's Rumailah district, Al Khaleej Plaza Hotel Apartments is a short drive from Ajman Beach and the Ajman Museum. This hotel offers 29 guestrooms equipped with refrigerators, microwaves, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Each room includes a private bathroom with bathrobes and slippers, a safe, a desk, and daily housekeeping. Free self-parking, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, multilingual staff, and luggage storage are also available. Nearby attractions include the Ajman Ladies Park, Al Heera Beach, and the Ajman Fish Market. The hotel is conveniently located 15. 4 miles from Dubai Creek and 14. 3 miles from Al Ghurair Centre. Sharjah International Airport (SHJ) is the nearest airport.

64240.description: This up-scale hotel is strategically located in the heart of Dubai’s central business district, enjoying close proximity to government departments, Dubai Creek Golf Course and the city centre. Dubai’s International Airport is only a 5-minute drive from the property, making it an ideal choice for both business and leisure travellers alike. All the luxurious guest rooms have been designed in a contemporary style and each of them come complete with all the necessary amenities for a comfortable stay. High standard facilities include a roof top swimming pool with hot tub and sauna rooms for a relaxing experience, as well as a fully equipped health club for guests to keep active during their stay. The property also counts with seven dining options where visitors can try a wide variety of culinary specialities.

64241.address: Al Rigga Street, Behind Commercial Bank Building
64241.description: Located in Dubai, near Al Rigga Street, this hotel offers easy access to key business and entertainment hubs, including Al Ghuarair City and the Dubai Shopping Festival venue. Numerous restaurants are nearby. This family-friendly hotel features 114 air-conditioned rooms, including 14 suites, all elegantly furnished. Known for its blend of traditional hospitality and modern amenities, the hotel provides a warm, stylish atmosphere, reflected in its high-quality furnishings and services. Designed for comfort, the luxurious yet contemporary rooms cater to both business and leisure travelers. Dubai International Airport is just 4. 3 km away.

64242.address: Al Maktoum Rd - DeiraRiggat Al Buteen
64242.description: Capturing inspiration from the vibrant culture of Russia and perfectly blending it with the modern strokes of Dubai, Moscow Hotel is an experience not to be missed. Located on the buzzing lanes of Al Maktoum Street in Deira, the hotel is conveniently nestled amidst Government Offices, Corporate Institutions and Shopping malls, and is a mere 7 Capturing inspiration from the vibrant culture of Russia and perfectly blending it with the modern strokes of Dubai, Moscow Hotel is an experience not to be missed. Located on the buzzing lanes of Al Maktoum Street in Deira, the hotel is conveniently nestled amidst Government Offices, Corporate Institutions and Shopping malls, and is a mere 7 minutes away from the Dubai International Airport and World Trade Centre.  As you enter the doorways to this landmark destination, you are welcomed to a breathtaking foyer, designed to the likeness of the famous Bolshoi Theatre.

64243.address: World Trade Center Road, Po Box 26816
64243.description: Situated on Trade Centre Road in Bur Dubai, this hotel is directly opposite the Burjuman shopping center and a short 5-minute drive from the Dubai International Exhibition and Convention Centre. Dubai International Airport is a convenient 10-minute drive away. This air-conditioned city hotel offers 144 comfortable rooms, perfect for both business and leisure travelers. Guests can enjoy a variety of amenities including a currency exchange desk, hairdressing salon, and business center. Dining options range from the Far East Seafood Market to the lively Rock Bottom American nightclub. Each room comes fully equipped with satellite TV, internet access, and a minibar. For recreation, the hotel features a swimming pool, hot tub, and a well-equipped gym.

64244.address: Al Qusais 1 - Al Nahda Rd. - Po Box 20107
64244.description: Al Bustan Centre & Residence is situated within easy distance from Dubai's business districts and is a perfect fit for leisure and corporate travelers as it is ideally located close to Dubai International Airport Terminals 1, 2 and 3, Dubai Airport Freezone and Mamzar Beach Park. Al Bustan Centre and Residence is 50 Meters away from Al Nahda Metro Green Line Station. Guests are assured of a comfortable and relaxing stay in the newly renovated 640 rooms and suites, they can choose from studio, one and two bedroom suites. The well-appointed accommodation features fully equipped kitchen, refrigerator and a tea/coffee maker. Each room is air conditioned and fitted with LED Satellite TV. Al Bustan Centre Shopping Mall has 85 shops attached to the Residence and offers the convenience of modern day one-stop shopping. Al Bustan Centre and Residence facilities include Health Club, Steam, Sauna, Massage, Swimming Pool and two Tennis Courts. The Fountain Restaurant and Café offers Arabic and International cuisine. The Food Court attached to the Mall serves a wide variety of cuisine. In addition, the Hotel also has a Pastry Shop, Coffee Lounge, Executive Club Floor with Club Lounge. The other facilities include the Crew Lounge, Business Centre, 24-hours Room Service, Laundry and Dry Cleaning services, Conference & Banqueting, Free Underground Parking, Tour Desk and Banking facilities. The reception desk is available 24/7. The Hotel offers daily complimentary shuttle service to Al Mamzar Beach Park, Deira City Centre and Naif Souq for their hotel guests. We offer free WIFI Internet (one connection) to all guests. This property is Smoke-free hotel.

64259.description: Overlooking Dubai Creek, Al Khaleej Hotel is situated in Deira's Al Nasser Square, offering an ideal location for both business and leisure travelers. Each room features individually controlled air conditioning, a minibar, satellite TV, an IDD telephone, a safe, and Wi-Fi. Most rooms also have a balcony. Dining options include three restaurants and bars, including an Italian restaurant.
