For added convenience, the hotel provides car rental, laundry and dry cleaning services, 24-hour room service, housekeeping, and complimentary transportation to the nearest beach. Nearby attractions include the Gold Souk, Dubai Creek, Dubai Museum, Jumeirah Beach, Dubai Mall, and Burj Khalifa. Dubai International Airport is just 6 km away.

64719.address: Karaburun Mah. Alparslan Türkeş Bulv. No:279
64719.description: Located in Okurcalar, a 4-minute walk from Okurcalar Beach, Holiday Park Resort provides accommodations with a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a fitness center and a garden. Providing a restaurant, the property also features a terrace, as well as a sauna and a hammam. The property has nightclub and a kids' club. The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms with a closet, a safety deposit box, a TV, a balcony and a private bathroom with a shower. At Holiday Park Resort all rooms are equipped with bed linen and towels. Guests at the accommodation can enjoy a buffet breakfast. Holiday Park Resort has a playground. You can play table tennis and darts at the 5-star hotel. Speaking German, English, Russian and Turkish at the reception, staff will be happy to provide guests with practical information on the area. Historical Alarahan is 8. 8 miles from the hotel, while Alanya Bus Station is 21 miles away. The nearest airport is Gazipaşa-Alanya, 47 miles from Holiday Park Resort, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

name.content: JA The Resort – JA Beach Hotel, Dubai

64759.address: Exit 13, Sheikh Zayed Road, Jebel Ali, PO BOX 9255
64759.description: The JA Beach Hotel at Jebel Ali Golf Resort is just a 40-minute drive from Dubai's city center and international airport. This self-contained, 128-acre resort is located on an 800-meter stretch of private beach overlooking the Arabian Gulf. A complimentary shuttle bus to major shopping malls is available daily. The resort is adjacent to the Jebel Ali Free Zone and offers a wide array of amenities, including three temperature-controlled outdoor swimming pools, a championship-standard 9-hole golf course, and a spa featuring Elemis and MD Skincare treatments. Guests can also enjoy an 80-berth marina, diving center, shooting club, 13 restaurants and bars, a kids' club, horse riding, seaplane excursions, a gym, and water sports facilities. JA Resorts and Hotels has implemented a comprehensive safety program covering sanitization, social distancing, and safety protocols, adhering to government directives, industry certifications, and the World Travel and Tourism Council's SafeTravels program.

name.content: Blue Beach Tower The Walk JBR Dubai (ex JA Oasis)

64761.description: Enjoy an upgraded experience and unmatched service at Blue Beach Tower, situated in the heart of new Dubai on the Jumeirah Beach strip. This location offers easy access to Dubai's top restaurants, beaches, shopping malls, tourist attractions, and business centers. Enjoy stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, Palm Jumeirah, and Dubai Marina. The hotel is a short walk from The Walk at JBR, with its outdoor shops, cafes, and restaurants, and just steps from a public beach area. Amenities include a private swimming pool deck, an all-day dining restaurant, and soon-to-open bars and fine dining outlets. Benefit from free grocery delivery and a nearby supermarket. Blue Beach Tower boasts some of the largest luxury serviced apartments in Dubai.

64763.description: Located at the beginning of the most prominent area of the city, the Jumeirah Beach Road, Dubai Marine Beach Resort & SPA is only minutes away from the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Mall, 15 minutes from Dubai International Airport. Exclusive shopping malls are within walking distance as well as some of the Dubai's most magnificent sightseeing locations. Golf lovers have easy access to the Dubai Creek Golf course and Nad Al Sheba Golf courses where you can also enjoy traditional camel and horse races, including the Dubai World Cup. The Dubai Marine Resort & Spa has tennis courts, a spa and a gym offering aerobic classes. There are 12 themed food and beverage options in total. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of cuisines including Arabian, Lebanese and Turkish. A mandatory security deposit of 500 dirhams is required upon check-in, and it will be refunded exclusively in cash at check-out.

64765.address: Madinat Jumeirah, Jumeira Road, Umm Suqeim 3
64765.description: Nestled in the heart of Madinat Jumeirah Resort, Jumeirah Mina A Salam offers a luxurious boutique hotel experience just 25 minutes from DXB International Airport. This charming hotel, completely refurbished in 2015, boasts spacious, beautifully furnished guest rooms with private balconies overlooking the sea. Guests enjoy authentic Arabian experiences in this beachfront location with family-friendly service. Known as the 'Harbour of Peace, ' the hotel is the gateway to the resort's waterways and walkways leading to 50 world-class restaurants, bars, cafes, the Talise Spa, and a traditional souk. Jumeirah Mina A Salam is conveniently located near iconic landmarks such as Burj Al Arab, Wild Wadi Waterpark, and Jumeirah Beach Hotel, with a shopping mall just 10 minutes away. *Please note that some facilities, including Wild Wadi Waterpark, Kids Clubs, Spas, Fitness Centers, and bars, may have temporarily suspended operations. Please contact the hotel for the latest updates. *

64919.description: This beach hotel is located in the district of Kumköy, where guests will find plenty of restaurants, bars, nightlife spots and shops, as well as links to the public transport network. The hotel is 3 kms from the ancient city of Side, 5 kms from the centre of Manavgat and approximately 65 kms from Antalya Airport. The hotel was built in 1995 and last renovated in 2001. The air-conditioned hotel offers 201 rooms in total and welcomes guests into a lobby which houses a hairdressing salon. Parents will be happy to know that the hotel has a playground and a kids' club. Additionally it offers a bicycle hire service. The comfortable, atmospheric rooms in the main and annexe buildings have a warm décor. Guests may relax on their private balcony or terrace, which is a standard feature of all accommodation units. The hotel restaurant serves continental breakfast, lunch and dinner.

64920.address: Ilica Mah. 11. Sok. No:1A/1 KUMKOY SIDE ANTALYA, 153
64920.description: The hotel is located in the Kumköy district, 5 km from the ancient city of Side, 8 km from Manavgat town centre and just 700 m from the beach. Local amenities can be found within 1 km of the hotel while Antalya Airport is located approximately 62 km away. This all-inclusive hotel has 278 rooms (143 standard, 48 bunk-bedded family rooms and 71 family connected rooms). There are 2 outdoor pools connected by a waterfall and 2 waterslides in the spacious garden. Guests are welcomed in the modernly designed lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe and lift access.

65041.description: The establishment is a beautiful city hotel, housed in a charming building dating back to the 19th century. The property is situated just a few paces from some of the most important tourist attractions in the city, including the renowned Las Ramblas, the famous Gothic Quarter and the bustling commercial district of the city. Guests will find a choice of restaurants, bars, and pubs, as well as numerous public transport links within the area. The Gran Liceu Theatre and the Boquería Market are also a stone's throw from this establishment. The hotel features a beautiful indoor garden and excellent facilities. The tastefully decorated guest rooms have been designed with guests' needs in mind, providing a relaxing atmosphere in which to completely unwind. This luxurious property is the perfect base from which to discover all this wonderful city has to offer.

65169.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including a health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy British cuisine at Lanes of London, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 1292 square feet (120 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 5 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 152 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

65172.description: Discover a tranquil haven at voco Vienna Prater, just steps from the Prater, Vienna International Centre, and Messe Wien Exhibition & Congress Center, and close to the city center. This urban oasis offers an unrivaled Vienna location. Experience the familiar yet surprising atmosphere of voco, where high standards meet individual personality. As Vienna's first voco, we're excited to share our charming lifestyle. Our thoughtfully designed spaces, from the lobby and rooms to the restaurant, bar, and meeting facilities, cater to your every need. Enjoy regional cuisine with international touches at Vienna Vibe restaurant and classic cocktails at the atmospheric Bluebird Bar. Stylish rooms and suites offer a relaxing retreat. Three meeting rooms accommodate various events. Ideally located in Leopoldstadt near the Vorgartenstraße subway station, with easy access to culinary delights and attractions like the Prater, Schönbrunn Palace, Hofburg, and St. Stephen's Cathedral. Experience voco Vienna Prater.

65173.description: The ARCOTEL Donauzentrum is located in Vienna's largest shopping and entertainment center – the Donau Zentrum in the 22nd district. The city centre is reachable in only 10 minutes by underground line 1. Also the station of the airport bus is right in front of the hotel. The modern city hotel is a place of retreat, where the main color green symbolizes the nature around the Danube. The rooms, bar and conference rooms invite to chill, relax and network. A free Wi-Fi internet access is available in the whole hotel. All rooms are equipped with smart TVs with streaming function. A small Grab & Go breakfast is always included in the room price. The hotel has its own parking garage with 30 spaces (fee-based).

name.content: Best Western Plus Hotel Le Favaglie

65246.description: The Best Western Plus Hotel Le Favaglie, a modern, comfortable and refined hotel, just a few kilometers from the Rho Pero fairgrounds, offers guests a wide range of services: a restaurant, wellness area, parking, shuttle service, and a congress centre which is ideal for leisure and business events. Efficiency, modernity and technology blend in the warm and comfortable ambience of this 4-star hotel which is a benchmark for leisure and business travelers as well as guests who come here to attend trade fairs. The spacious hall with its smart decor has comfortable corners in which to read, work or spend time with friends at the elegant and well-stocked bar. In the morning guests find a range of daily newspapers, and the competent reception staff is on hand to assist guests. Getting into the centre of Milan poses no problem thanks to the private shuttle service available for guests, which brings them to and from the Molino Dorino underground station. From there it is easy to get to all the city's main attractions. Enjoy your stay.

65279.description:
Located directly opposite the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM) and just 3 km from the Pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx, Steigenberger Pyramids Cairo is the ideal retreat for both sightseeing and relaxation. Guests enjoy the rare privilege of staying at the crossroads of ancient wonders and modern cultural heritage, with the timeless monuments of the Fourth Dynasty within easy reach. 
The hotel’s unique setting across from the GEM makes it an unparalleled destination for culture and history enthusiasts. Sphinx International Airport lies only 25 km away, while Cairo International Airport is 53 km from the hotel. The bustling city centre of Cairo, just 25 km away, offers the perfect opportunity to experience the vibrant energy of the Nile capital. 
For an unforgettable stay in Cairo, where Egypt’s heritage meets refined European hospitality, Steigenberger Pyramids Cairo is the perfect choice.

65284.description: InterContinental São Paulo Hotel offers elegance and exclusivity through personalized services, welcoming guests from different cultures with excellence and respecting their consuetude and traditions. Located in the charming Jardins region, one block from Paulista avenue and surrounded by a business and shopping area with the best cultural and gastronomic options of the city. The high standard of safety protocols guarantees total health security during your stay.

name.content: Grand Mercure Rio de Janeiro Copacabana

65285.description: Rediscover the uniqueness of Brazilian culture by staying at Grand Mercure RJ Copacabana. A hotel environment close to the beach that mesmerizes with elegance and Brazilian vibes. Enjoy large and comfortable rooms, plus a leisure structure complete with pool, gym, sauna and beach services. Start your days with a delicious hearty breakfast, freshly and specially made for your well-being and health.

65289.address: Av. Vinte de Janeiro, S/N – 3rd Floor, 4
65289.description: This hotel is located on the third floor of Rio de Janeiro international airport, just a few paces from the departure and arrival halls. It is ideal for those waiting for connecting flights, seeking a strategic meeting venue or experiencing an unexpectedly long delay at the airport. This fully air-conditioned establishment comprises a total of 62 rooms, and additional facilities include a 24-hour reception desk, a pleasant bar and a charming restaurant which serves a selection of dishes. The modern rooms provide all necessary comforts, and feature an en-suite bathroom, cable TV and a minibar. Guests can also keep up their fitness routine by making use of the in-house gym.

65290.description: Stay at the Mercure Rio de Janeiro Copacabana hotel, opposite Posto 4 of Copacabana Beach and near to the main tourist attractions in Rio de Janeiro. Relax in comfortable apartments with free WIFI, air conditioning, cable TV, safe and hair dryer. Want to enjoy the beach? You can loan towels and parasols from the hotel. Enjoy a delicious breakfast and all of the facilities with a peruvian restaurante, concierge service, fitness center and Spa.

65381.address: İçerenköy Mah. Manolya Sanayi Sok. Ataşehir, 36
65381.description: The first 5-star hotel on the Anatolian Side of Istanbul, The Green Park Bostancı offers its guests a pleasant stay with its beautiful location, its proximity to the very popular Bagdat Street and its proximity to famous shopping malls. The Green Park Bostancı, which has 196 non-smoking rooms, is also preferred for business meetings and wedding organizations. At The Green Park Bostancı, you can also access services such as a restaurant with a view where you can taste the flavors carefully prepared by the chefs, a specially decorated bar, an outdoor swimming pool. The Green Park Bostancı outdoor swimming pool usage fee is determined as 250 TL for hotel guests and 500 TL for external participants. 100 TL car parking for guests.

65439.description: Located in central Alanya, steps from Kleopatra Beach and a short stroll from shops and restaurants, this hotel offers a relaxing getaway. A 45-minute drive from the airport, it boasts an outdoor pool and spa. Explore nearby attractions like the castle, Red Tower, Damlatas Caves, and Archaeological Museum. Rooms feature bright, warm decor and are well-equipped for your comfort.

65441.address: Saray Mah. Guzel Yali Cad. Bebek Sok., 3
65441.description: Within a stone's throw of Alanya's famous Cleopatra Beach, this compact, city hotel is ideally located for those looking for a busy resort with plenty of great shops, cafe bars and restaurants as well as a beach closeby so they can enjoy days of sun-bathing or joining in water sports. Modestly furnished, the rooms are equipped with Wi-Fi and perfect for a good night's rest after a long day in the sunshine. Guests can also benefit from a relaxing sauna or Turkish bath in the hotel's small spa before enjoying a refreshing drink or tasty meal in one of the a la carte restaurants which open onto a pedestrianised street and are shared with this property's neighbouring, two sister hotels. The resort's many attractions are easily accessible from the hotel such as Damlatas Caves a few steps away and Alanya Castle, a ten minute bus journey.

65559.description: Nestled in the serene beauty of El Montseny National Park in Seva, this hotel offers a tranquil escape from the everyday hustle. With spectacular mountain views, guests can explore the natural wonders of the area. Barcelona's cultural richness and historical sites are just 56 km away, while Vic is a mere 15 km from the hotel. Barcelona International Airport is conveniently located 70 km away. The hotel blends seamlessly with its captivating surroundings. Guest rooms, decorated in refreshing tones, create a peaceful ambiance. A range of facilities and services are available to ensure a comfortable and convenient stay.

65569.description: Enjoy a central Edinburgh stay at The Frederick House Hotel, steps from George Street and a short walk from Edinburgh Castle. This guesthouse offers 44 comfortable guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and coffee/tea makers. Start your day with a cooked-to-order breakfast (available for a fee), and take advantage of amenities such as dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel is conveniently located near Princes Street, the Royal Mile, and various city attractions.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Molins de Rei

65622.description: Contemporary hotel with good transport links, free WiFi and included breakfastLocated in a quiet, suburban industrial park, Holiday Inn Express® Barcelona - Molins de Rei hotel is ideal for both business travellers and visitors on a city break. Barcelona-El Prat Airport is 15 minutes by car from the hotel, and it's a five-minute drive to the AP-2 highway. You can leave your car in one of the hotel's free parking spots and catch a train into the city centre from Molins de Rei station, a 10-minute walk from the front door. Central Barcelona is a 20-minute train ride away. In the city you can wander through the atmospheric narrow alleys of the Gothic Quarter, which are are lined with tapas bars, and admire Antoni Gaudí's iconic Sagrada Família cathedral. Closer to home,   Molins de Rei is a short stroll from the hotel and has numerous shops and bars. Football at Camp Nou is 20 minutes away by car. Here to work? The Holiday Inn Express® Barcelona - Molins de Rei hotel is in the El Pla industrial zone and close to several local businesses. All guests can keep up to speed with free WiFi, available throughout the hotel. If you need to host an event, you can make use of the naturally lit meeting room. Get off to a great start with the Express Start Breakfast buffet. After a busy day of sightseeing, relax with a chilled glass of wine in the lobby bar.

65659.description: Set amidst the charm and beauty of the leafy residential area of Kensington and Chelsea, this elegant hotel is perfect for discerning travellers eager to explore. The Natural History Museum, the Victoria and Albert Museum and the iconic Royal Albert Hall can be found nearby. Hyde Park is also located just a short distance away. This elegant hotel oozes style and sophistication. The guest rooms and suites are luxurious and spacious. Individually-styled event spaces offer the perfect setting for special events, weddings and conferences. Guests can treat themselves to the ultimate relaxation in the spa. A fitness centre is also available onsite. Delectable dishes and afternoon tea can be enjoyed in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant.

name.content: Jet Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western

65740.description: The Jet Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western, offers a safe and comfortable stay near Malpensa Intercontinental Airport, just 30 kilometers from Milan. Located in Gallarate, between Lakes Maggiore and Como, it's ideal for both leisure and business travelers. Our rooms feature air conditioning, satellite TV, and Wi-Fi. We also offer an outdoor pool, meeting rooms for up to 30 guests, and secure indoor parking. Enjoy complimentary shuttle service to the airport at 6:00, 8:00, and 10:00 a. m. , with paid transfers available at other times. Pre-booking is required for overnight airport transfers. We are committed to ensuring a safe stay with enhanced cleaning and sanitization protocols, contactless technologies, and healthcare insurance through AXA Partners.

name.content: Blue Tree Premium Verbo Divino  Nacoes Unidas

65761.description:
Located in one of São Paulo's main corporate areas, 7. 2 km from Congonhas Airport and 35 km from Guarulhos Airport, the Blue Tree Premium Verbo Divino stands out for its charm, elegance, comfort, hospitality and, above all, excellent service!
Come and enjoy a refined stay, a heated swimming pool, a business meeting, a quality dinner or lunch, or a game of tennis to get to know our facilities and services. A VIP meeting room complements your stay. 
Our restaurant serves Contemporary Cuisine (A La Carte). 
Note: All meals are served individually in à la carte format. Menu available via QR code. 
Tennis court - Use by appointment. For more information, contact the hotel reception. Open from 6:00 am to 8:00 pm. 
Gym - Opening hours are daily from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM. 
Smoking is not permitted in the rooms or in any area within the hotel. 
Hotel charges R$ 6. 60 / night tourist tax.

65800.description: This boutique property enjoys an enviable setting in the sophisticated area of Ekali. The hotel is set overlooking the forest and Parnitha Mountain, in a quiet, residential area. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from a myriad of attractions in the area. This wonderful hotel comprises a truly striking design, exuding contemporary elegance. This glass building, comprises stunningly-designed accommodation options. The rooms and suites are superbly appointed, featuring advanced amenities for the utmost in comfort. This superb hotel's exemplary service, first-class facilities and peaceful, homely atmosphere sets it apart as a prime option for visitors to the area.

name.content: Sir Victor Hotel part of Sircle Collection

65984.description: Set just off of Passeig de Gràcia—Barcelona's grand, humming shopping boulevard—and a few doors down from Gaudí's masterpiece Casa Milà, Sir Victor reflects and amplifies the vibrant, creative spirit of the city. With 91 impeccable guest rooms, incredible city views, a luxe spa, lively restaurant, rooftop pool and numerous meeting spaces, it's a rendez-vous spot for visitors and locals alike. Sir Victor's bright, big and beautiful guest rooms reflect the inspiring world of Barcelona humming just outside. People-watch Passeig de Gràcia from your balcony or hide away in your own tranquil space if that's what you prefer. The Zero SpaRelax and recharge in Sir Victor's stunning spa facilities operated by Signature, including an indoor pool, sauna, steam room and showers. If you're more of a gym person, sweat it out in our state-of-the-art, high performance space, complete with Hammer Strength machinery and Woodway treadmills. As a guest, you have full access to it all. The LobbyTake a book from our selection and relax in our harmonious ground floor space that looks out onto the buzzing Passeig de Gràcia. The Rooftop at Sir VictorSwim, eat and drink with views of Gaudí's Casa Milà and La Sagrada Familia on The Rooftop—our secluded bar, restaurant and pool in the middle of Barcelona. Mr PorterThe critically acclaimed Amsterdam restaurant makes its Barcelona debut. MR PORTER masterfully blends the modern steakhouse with a chic, sleek lounge, and serves elegant dishes for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Quiet sanctuaries for makers, the meeting rooms at Sir Victor can be your hub for business, brainstorms, collaboration and partnerships. With a variety of configurations, our spaces can transform into the exact specifications of your event.

name.content: B&B HOTEL Madrid Pinar de Las Rozas

65986.description: The B&B Hotel Madrid Pinar Las Rozas is a 3-star hotel located in northwest Madrid, next to the Las Rozas business park. It's also just a few kilometers from the Europolis estate and conveniently close to Las Rozas Village and the Royal Spanish Football Federation. The hotel offers 120 exterior rooms equipped with air conditioning/heating, a comfortable desk, a bathtub, and a 28-inch LCD TV. Guests can enjoy complimentary coffee and tea 24/7 in the large, modern lounge. High-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, including guest rooms and common areas. The B&B Hotel Madrid Pinar Las Rozas is perfect for both leisure and business travelers, with free underground parking and easy access to public transportation. This hotel offers a quality budget-friendly option for exploring northwest Madrid.

66041.description: The family-run Hotel Fehmi Bey offers charming, comfortable accommodations in a historic mansion, blending Ottoman and modern styles. Located within a two-minute walk of iconic sites like the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque, and ten minutes from the Grand Bazaar, the hotel provides amenities such as laundry service, 24-hour room service, complimentary internet access, and a sauna.

66042.description: Nestled in beautiful sea scenery of Antalya, this opulent resort is an excellent gateway for a romantic escapade, family holiday or sports team retreat. Boasting magnificent facilities and excellent service, this hotel is a quintessence of luxury. The guestrooms are delightfully appointed, featuring soothing tones and classy furnishings. The establishment will enchant guests with its glamorous in-house restaurants serving Italian, Turkish, Chinese and international buffet and sea food dishes. Patrons may enjoy a wide selection of drinks and snacks at one of the numerous on-site bars. Children will revel in fun-filled time spent in the on-site waterpark while adults may have a soothing dip in one of the numerous sparkling pools, have an invigorating workout at the gym or indulge in relaxing treatments at the spa. Visitors will delight in fabulous entertainment programmes offered on the premises. The hotel also features impressive and versatile meeting facilities. Guests should also know that some facilities may not be operational due to seasonal/weather conditions.

66043.description: This hotel is situated in Kumkoy, a 10-minute walk from the centre of town with its shops, bars, nightclubs, restaurants and bus station. From here, guests can enjoy easy access to all that the lively city has to offer. The hotel enjoys easy access to the city's myriad attractions and landmarks, such as Agora Museum, Theatre, Temples of Apollo and Athena.

66045.description: The nhow Milano is an artistic, cosmopolitan hotel centrally located in Milan's Via Tortona, only a 13 km journey from Milano Linate Airport and a 15-minute walk from Porta Genova metro station. Local attractions also within walking distance are the MUDEC Museum, the Tortona Design District, the Parco Solari, and Sant'Ambrogio Basilica. Our 246 individually decorated rooms provide contemporary features such as free Wi-Fi and hardwood floors. Upgraded room choices offer extra beds and sitting rooms and some executive rooms have features such as double showers or open-plan jacuzzis. A breakfast buffet is prepared and offered daily, with specially prepared hot dishes available upon request. The nhow Milano restaurant offers a sophisticated dining experience with a variety of Mediterranean and International dishes available daily, for both lunch and dinner. Room service is also a dining option. The hotel has 12 meeting rooms equipped with temperature control devices and entertainment services for conferences and events. On the first floor, our well- equipped a gym is free for guests to use and has a range of equipment as well as a Turkish bath, with fresh water and towels provided. Upon request, a personal trainer or massage session may be arranged.

66240.description: This hotel enjoys a wonderful setting in Alanya's city centre. The hotel is set amidst the city's unique architecture, in an area where natural beauty and history are combined. The Mediterranean is located just 100 metres away. Guests can enjoy the ultimate invigoration at Cleopatra Beach, while is just a short distance away. Many tourist attractions can be found nearby, in the historical areas of the city. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. This elegant beach hotel features sublimely-designed guest rooms, which offer a comfortable setting in which to unwind. The rooms are fitted with modern amenities, for the utmost in comfort. The hotel features a delightful cafe, bar and restaurant, meeting guests' dining needs to a high level of excellence. Guests will be pleased by the many facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

66500.description: This family hotel is located in Camyuva region on Turkey's southern coast, 6 km from the popular resort of Kemer. Nearby attractions include the resort of Kemer, the ruins at Phaselis and the large city of Antalya, 52 km away. Antalya Airport lies some 70 km. This hotel boasts fantastic views out to sea with mountains on the other side. The small town centre is a few minutes' walk and links to the public transport network are located directly outside the hotel. Suitable for families and couples, the hotel has a spacious garden leading down to the shingle beach where a jetty juts out into the sea. Other amenities include a couple of outdoor pools and an indoor pool, a wellness centre offering a range of treatments and a comprehensive activity programme and kids club. Various dining and nightlife options are on offer in the bars, disco and restaurants.

name.content: Le Royal Meridien Beach Resort and Spa

66528.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 3 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. If you'd like to spend the day shopping, you can hop on the complimentary shuttle. Enjoy Middle Eastern cuisine at Al Khaima, one of the hotel's 7 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 11 coffee shops/cafes. When you are in need of a refreshing drink, visit the beach bar or one of 4 bars/lounges, or 2 poolside bars. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 2045 square feet (190 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 4 meeting rooms.

66639.address: 53, Studio Misr Road, Mariottia Pyramids Giza
66639.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a rooftop terrace and a garden. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy international cuisine at La Palme Dore, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 240 guestrooms, featuring fireplaces and LCD televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and minibars. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Keops Pyramid - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Giza Pyramid Complex - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi- Giza Plateau - 2. 3 km / 1. 5 mi- Sound and Light Theater - 2. 9 km / 1. 8 mi- Giza Solar Boat Museum - 3. 8 km / 2. 3 mi- Pyramid of Khafre - 4 km / 2. 5 mi- Grand Egyptian Museum - 4. 2 km / 2. 6 mi- Pyramid of Menkaure - 4. 4 km / 2. 7 mi- Great Sphinx of Giza - 4. 2 km / 2. 6 mi- Pyramid of Khufu - 5. 2 km / 3. 2 mi- Cairo University - 8. 3 km / 5. 2 mi- Giza Zoo - 8. 6 km / 5. 4 mi- First Mall Cairo - 9. 1 km / 5. 6 mi- Nile - 9. 4 km / 5. 8 mi- Orman Botanical Gardens - 9. 5 km / 5. 9 mi. The nearest airports are: Cairo Intl. Airport (CAI) - 47 km / 29. 2 mi Giza (SPX-Sphinx Intl. ) - 38 km / 23. 6 mi The preferred airport for Grand Pyramids Hotel is Cairo Intl. Airport (CAI).

66660.description: Next to Plaza Mayor, in the centre of Madrid, this hotel enjoys a privileged location, close to historical monuments and places of interest, such as Puerta del Sol, the Royal Palace and Atocha Station as well as a variety of bars. The location, coupled with the modern facilities make this hotel perfect for a visit to Madrid. In the lobby, there is the 24-hour reception. Facilities include a café, bar, dining room and Internet access. Guests may also take advantage of the laundry service for an additional charge. Parking facilities are also available (subject to fees).

66661.description: The Líbere Madrid Palacio Real apartments are located on Travesía de los Trujillos Street, in the heart of Madrid, near the Plaza del Sol, Palacio Real, and Plaza Mayor. Recently renovated, they feature the latest technology, including TVs and Wi-Fi. All apartments have wardrobes, kitchens equipped with cooktops, microwaves, and refrigerators, as well as bathrooms with toiletries and hair dryers. One-bedroom apartments, accommodating up to three or four guests, have two floors: the first with a sofa bed, living room, kitchen, and bathroom; and the second with a double or single bed and a toilet. Studios, designed for up to two guests, have a single floor with a kitchen, bathroom, and a double bed. Access your apartment using your phone as a key. A 24/7 online reception is available. The building offers accessible features for guests with reduced mobility, tourist information, ironing services, extra cleaning, and cots. Pets are welcome.

66662.description:
Fully renovated in 2026, Petit Palace Plaza España is set in a historic building in the heart of Madrid, a short walk from Gran Vía and 450 metres from Plaza de España. Santo Domingo Metro Station is 150 metres away, and the surrounding streets offer a wide variety of shops, restaurants, bars, cafés and nightlife within a 1-minute walk. 

The elegant, newly refurbished rooms feature free WiFi, a flat-screen TV and an en suite bathroom with a shower. A buffet breakfast is served each morning, and free bicycle rental is available on request at the reception desk so you can explore the city centre at your own pace. 

Madrid's main attractions are all within easy walking distance: the Royal Palace and Puerta del Sol are within 650 metres, while the Teatro Real, Plaza Mayor and the Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen-Bornemisza museums are a 10-minute walk away, as are the city's most popular theatres. With its central location, its historic building and its full renovation, Petit Palace Plaza España is the ideal base for enjoying the charm, architecture and history of the Spanish capital.

66750.description: These apartments enjoy a popular central location in the Eixample quarter, halfway between the Plaza Catalunya and the Sagrada Familia. Guests will find themselves in the heart of Barcelona, where various restaurants, shops, cinemas and supermarkets are all within easy reach. In addition, it is close to the underground station and bus stops with connections to places of interest in the city. Opened in the summer of 2006, the property includes a lobby and a lift. The apartments provide all the comforts of home with quality facilities, ideal for long or short stays of a private and business nature. They are all soundproofed and feature a coffee/tea maker and air conditioning as standard.

66819.description: Nestled in the steeped in history city of Barcelona, this contemporary urban establishment is located just steps away from Palau Güell, constructed by the world-famous Catalan architect Antoni Gaudí, and is just a few metres from the emblematic Las Ramblas. Plaza Real is also just a couple of minutes away on foot. This area is home to most of Barcelona's tablaos, restaurants, bars and clubs for all tastes. The statue of Christopher Columbus and the port can be found at the end of Las Ramblas, while the Drassanes and Liceu metro stations as well as numerous bus stops are within walking distance. This wonderful central property is aimed at those who want to be completely free and independent during their stay in Barcelona. The charming and spacious apartments enjoy a delightful design and come well-equipped with modern amenities, sure to provide a pleasant and memorable stay. Apartments with kitchen , with all necessary items to cook. *parking available on request.

66839.description: This city and business hotel lies very close to the Acropolis and the Plaka area, the old city of Athens. The establishment is within 2 km of the Greek Parliament and the centre of Athens. It is just 4 km from the nearest beach. The local airport is about 192 km away. Completely renovated in August 2004, the establishment offers traditional Greek hospitality in combination with international standards of quality. The 6-storey building comprises a total of 91 guest rooms and suites. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out service. Facilities on offer include a bar, a restaurant, conference facilities and WLAN Internet access. The hotel rooms provide an elegant and colourful environment. All rooms are fully-equipped as standard including a flat screen TV, air conditioning and a private bar/mini fridge.

66841.description: Centrally located in Barcelona's vibrant Born and Gothic districts, these apartments are perfect for both business and leisure travelers. A variety of dining, shopping, and entertainment options are right at your doorstep. Las Ramblas, Plaça de Catalunya, and Port Vell are easily accessible. The tastefully appointed apartments feature a modern style with contemporary amenities for a comfortable and memorable stay. Soothing colors and natural materials like stone and wood create a cozy atmosphere. A private balcony and a fully equipped kitchenette allow guests to prepare their own meals. Complimentary Wi-Fi is also provided. Guests have two check-in options: online or in person.

66922.description: This pleasant hotel boasts a great position to discover the magnificent City of Light, as it is situated on a quiet residential area in the city centre of Paris. This property is close to several points of interest, such as the Eiffel Tower, Champs Élysées and the Montparnasse Tower. Guests may find several public transportation points of interest in the surrounding area, such as several metro stations and a railway station. All the hotel’s guest rooms are perfectly appointed for a relaxing and comfortable stay. Guests will be able to keep updated thanks to the complimentary wireless Internet connection and a flat-screen television to rest at the end of the day watching their favourite TV programme. Moreover, the private bathroom includes a shower for guests’ convenience. Those guests travelling by car might wish to use the on-site parking spaces.

66924.description: This modern hotel is situated in the 15th arrondissement of Paris. Boasting a spectacular setting at the heart of this romantic city, this hotel is sure to impress. Stunningly located between the Eiffel Tower, Les Invalides and Montparnasse, this hotel is perfect for travellers who are eager to explore. The Pasteur Instutite, Necker Hospital and the ASIEM conference hall can be found nearby. The hotel's proximity to the Rodin Museum, the Quai Branly Museum and the tomb of Napoleon, is sure to impress. The accommodation options are bright, spacious and airy, offering a charming ambiance, which promotes rest and relaxation. Guests can enjoy sumptuous French pastries in the stylish breakfast room.

67002.address: Lungomare Gabriele D' Annunzio, 2, Lido VE, 2
67002.description: Surrounded by the romantic landscape of the coast of Venice, between the Adriatic and the famous Laguna, the Venezia2000 Hotel is the ideal refuge for an unforgettable stay. Besides enjoying spectacular views, guests of the Venezia 2000 have the chance to reach the city center in 15 minutes by 'vaporetto'. Hotel Residence Venezia 2000 has double and triple rooms, all equipped with telephone, satellite TV, safe, air conditioning, hair dryer; in some of them there is a beautiful and spacious terrace. The quiet location, proximity to the sea, the brightness of our rooms, peace and relaxation, will help make your stay even more comfortable and enjoyable. *Economy rooms are located on ground floor in the outbuilding.

67003.description: This elegant hotel is situated in the heart of Venice, Italy, making it an ideal choice for romantic getaways or honeymoons. Venice Marco Polo Airport is a short 20-minute drive away, and Venice Santa Lucia Train Station is even closer, just 10 minutes from the hotel. Guests will appreciate the hotel's prime location, surrounded by a variety of restaurants, cafes, and bars offering local delicacies. Many of Venice's historical and cultural landmarks, such as the Rialto Bridge, St. Mark's Basilica, and the Church of San Giorgio Maggiore, are also within easy reach. The rooms are tastefully decorated in warm colors with sophisticated wooden furnishings, creating a comfortable and inviting atmosphere. Guests can enjoy cozy beds and a range of amenities designed to enhance their stay in this captivating city.

67051.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Istanbul’s old town district, Sultanahmet. It is a 20-minute drive from Ataturk International Airport. The property features air-conditioned rooms fitted with modern amenities including flat-screen TVs and free WiFi access. For in-room dining, Mina Hotel offers 24-hour room service. At the restaurant and bar, guests can unwind with a drink or a meal on Mina Hotel’s terrace while admiring the panoramic view of the Marmara Sea. Regional and international specialties are served with local and imported drinks. Staff at the 24-hour reception of Mina Hotel can provide information about local excursions and the hotel’s car rental service. It is located within walking distance of Sultanahmet’s historical sites such as Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and the Grand Bazaar. Istanbul Airport is 33 mi away.

67179.description: Located just 15 minutes from the city center, this modern hotel offers 209 rooms across five floors. Guests enjoy convenient access to shopping at Plaza Caracol (6km) and Cancun International Airport (20-minute drive). Amenities include three outdoor pools with a children's area, a gym, conference facilities, internet access, and a Starbucks coffee shop (extra cost). Each room features satellite TV, a minibar, and air conditioning. Various sports activities are also available.

67219.description: This hotel lies in the industrial and business centre of La Pedrosa, very close to Fira de Barcelona, a convention and fair centre, in L'Hospitalet district. The centre of Barcelona is approximately 4km from the hotel and can easily be reached with public transport services located in the area. Barcelona Airport is just 12 km away from the hotel. This is a perfect hotel for business travelers or guests wishing to be close to the airport.

67220.description: This charming, modern hotel boasts a fantastic location in Barcelona, just 300 metres from Las Ramblas. A variety of attractions are within walking distance, including the Gothic Quarter and Gaudí's Ruta Modernista. The famous Sagrada Familia and the beach and seaside promenade at Barceloneta are only a few metro stops away from the Universitat metro station, which is only a stone's throw from the hotel. The hotel is set in an emblematic building designed by Josep Majó Ribas at the beginning of the 20th century. After a busy day in the city, guests can relax in the stylish rooms with air-conditioning, free Wi-Fi and 24-hour room service, or make use of the relaxation area with sauna, steam bath and hot tub and dine on delicious Mediterranean cuisine in the onsite restaurant. This hotel's privileged location and excellent services allow guests to enjoy the varied cultural and commercial options the city has to offer. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a deposit.

67340.description: This hotel is located in one of the most renowned business areas in the north of Madrid. It is equally close to the Centro Comercial Plaza Norte shopping centre and the Centro de Ocio Diversia amusement park. Guests will also find links to transport network within a 1. 5 km radius of the hotel. All major tourist spots are easily accessible. The hotel comprises a total of 145 rooms. Facilities on offer include a lobby with a reception desk and a hotel safe. Guests may also make use of the café, the bar and the conference facilities. The hotel's restaurant offers an excellent service and a comfortable atmosphere. The bright rooms are designed and decorated in a contemporary way. All accommodation units are fully-equipped as standard including a satellite/ cable TV, a minibar and Internet access. The heating and air conditioning are individually adjustable.

67360.address: Gran Via De Les Corts Catalanes, 543-545
67360.description: Boasting a fabulous location on the famous Gran Via in Eixample district of Barcelona, this sophisticated hotel is a perfect choice for all those looking for a relaxing stay. At the property's doorstep travellers may find Urgell metro station and numerous bus stops. Guests will find themselves within walking distance to Plaça Catalunya and Plaça Espanya, Teatre Coliseum and Fira de Barcelona. The combination of privileged location, delightful décor, cutting-edge services and facilities complemented with attention of the friendly staff make it a perfect place for business people and holidaymakers alike. The air-conditioned and soundproofed rooms feature sumptuous design and modern amenities. Guests may wake up to flavourful breakfast served in a charming lounge with a mezzanine and throughout the day enjoy rooftop terrace and pool, both offering stunning views over Barcelona.

67561.description: Situated in the heart of Venice's vibrant cultural district, this elegant hotel overlooks the Grand Canal and sits opposite the historic Goldoni Theatre. Just a short stroll from St. Mark's Square and the city's renowned shopping boutiques, it offers a prime location for exploring Venice. The hotel, originally built in 1880 and renovated in 2006, features 35 rooms across five floors. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, café, bar, and restaurant. Room and laundry services are also available. Each luxuriously appointed room comes equipped with modern conveniences, including an LCD TV, Wi-Fi, and a minibar.

67584.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a health club and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Guests can get around on the shuttle (surcharge), which operates within 42 km. Grab a bite at panorama, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Giza? This hotel has 301 square feet (28 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and a meeting room.

67592.description: This hotel features a quiet location in Paris and offers guests an intimate and friendly atmosphere ideal for those eager to explore ‘la ville de l’amour’. It is set between the Gare du Nord and the Gare de l’Est railway stations, providing easy access to other parts of the area. Shopping lovers will appreciate its prime situation close to Grands Magasins, and in the surrounding area visitors will find a large choice of theatres, restaurants and attractions such as Montmartre neighbourhood and the popular Basilica of the Sacred Heart. The comfortable rooms provide the ideal place where to relax after a day discovering the hidden treasures of this city, and come equipped with private bathroom and satellite TV. And to make guests’ stay as pleasant as possible, the hotel also provides a charming breakfast room and a bar.

67593.description: This contemporary hotel is located between the Bastille, the historic old town of Marais and the railway station Gare de Lyon. Links to the public transport are to be found at the property's doorstep and in the vicinity there are bars, tourist attractions and shopping amenities, while there are parks just around 700 m away, the city centre and Opera district is within 2. 5 km from the hotel. This enchanting hotel combines modern comfort with artistic ambience. The air-conditioned rooms are furnished in 2 different styles. The urban-style rooms aim to provide guests with a cosy atmosphere, utilising colours that are at once both vibrant and elegant. The eco-style rooms are characterised by soft tones and natural materials. The hotel and some of its rooms are disability-friendly. A continental breakfast may be selected each morning. In addition to this guests are invited to make use of the bar, where to sip a cup of coffee or a refreshing drink.

67622.description: Situated on 39, 500 square meters, the luxurious beachfront Centro Hotel enjoys a prime location in Lara, Antalya, on the Turkish Riviera, renowned for its stunning sandy beaches. Antalya's city center, with its charming old town, vibrant harbor, and abundant shopping and entertainment, is just a short drive away. This family-friendly hotel, with its distinctive architecture, welcomes guests into a stylish lobby and offers modern, elegant rooms, many with marvelous garden and sea views. A children's paradise awaits with dedicated pools, waterslides, playgrounds, a mini amusement park, and a special children's buffet. The unique pool area includes a wave pool and a heated aquapark (alongside other heated pools, excluding the relax pool, weather permitting). Fun and relaxation are guaranteed for the whole family at this magnificent resort.

67625.description: This family-friendly hotel is located just a stone's throw from the beach in the popular holiday region of the Turkish Riviera. It offers several pools, various restaurants and bars, a spa area and a night club. In addition, the hotel features conference facilities for business guests. The city of Alanya with its castle, the famous Red Tower and the yachting harbour is less than 20 km away.

67626.description: This modern beach hotel is excellently situated just a few steps from the beach and within walking distance from the centre of the historical city of Alanya with its countless shops, restaurants, bars and cafés. The hotel offers indoor and outdoor pool, a spa area, fitness and sports facilities. The famous attractions of Alanya such as the castle or the Red Tower are easily reachable.

67639.description: Enhanced cleaning and safety standards in place including Clean and Safe and Safe Travels facility accreditation. Visit hotel website for more details. This hotel is located in Lisbon, in the Parque das Nações area, 7 Km from city centre and just 1. 5 Km from Lisbon international Airport. This is a booming business area, close to the river, the Lisbon International Fairgrounds (FIL), Vasco da Gama shopping centre and the Casino. This area is wonderfully served with public transportation to the whole city and the country.

name.content: Sao Paulo Tatuape, Affiliated by Meliá

67702.description: The elegant, contemporary style hotel Tatuape by Melia with its distinctive façade is conveniently located in the sophisticated area of Tatuapé in São Paulo. It features a rooftop pool with panoramic views over the city. A number of restaurants, bars and leisure facilities can be found in the surrounding area; the international airport Guarulhos is about 15 km away.

67707.description: São Paulo Higienópolis Affiliated by Meliá is an elegant hotel situated in a safe and quiet area near the city centre of São Paulo, in the famous shopping and residential district of Higienópolis. The hotel provides excellent service and features great facilities, such as a swimming pool, a sauna and a gym, which will guarantee a great stay. The in house restaurant offers international cuisine. This is a perfect place for business travelers.

name.content: Double Tree by Hilton Sao Paulo Itaim

67708.description: This elegant, contemporary style hotel, São Paulo Itaim By Atlantica is conveniently located in the upscale district of Itaim in São Paulo. It features free wi-fi, 24 hour room service, a rooftop gym and outdoor pool with panoramic views over the city. A number of restaurants, bars and leisure facilities can be found in the surrounding area. The Ibirapuera Park and JK Shopping Mall are within easy reach. The 126 room hotel has also modern meeting spaces on premises. Please note that more than 10 rooms are considered a group, with reservations subject to previous payment or cancellation by the hotel. We emphasize that the contracted daily rate is for 24 hours, with check-in from 2 p. m. and check-out until 12 p. m. The interval of up to 3 hours between guests' departure and arrival is provided for in MTur Ordinance No. 28 and is intended exclusively for cleaning, sanitizing, and tidying up the unit, ensuring the maintenance of our standard of excellence.

67710.description: Melia Jardim Europa is a luxurious hotel, housed in a modern building, located in a safe area in the commercial centre of Itaim Bibi, in São Paulo. The hotel provides excellent services and features great facilities, such as a swimming pool, a sauna and a gym. It also provides 24-hour room service which will guarantee a great stay. This is a perfect place for both leisure and business travelers.

name.content: SÃO PAULO NAÇOES UNIDAS, AFFILIATED BY MELIÁ

67712.description: The modern business hotel Tryp Naçoes Unidas is ideally situated in the heart of the financial district of São Paulo, close to the Transamerica Expo. It features excellent conference facilities as well as a great rooftop pool, a fitness centre and a sauna. The Convention Center, the American Chamber of Commerce and the World Trade Center can be easily reached.

name.content: Hotel Mercure Paris Boulogne Pont de Saint Cloud

67722.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center, terrace, and garden at Hotel Mercure Paris Boulogne Pont de Saint Cloud. The hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a communal TV area, and a snack bar/deli. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (7:00 AM - 10:30 AM) for a fee. The hotel also features a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and meeting/conference facilities (1292 sq ft). Self-parking is available (charges apply). The 75 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, safes, and desks. Located near the Seine and Bois de Boulogne, the hotel is convenient to Roland Garros Stadium, Parc des Princes, and other attractions. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY), Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG), and Heathrow (LHR).

67759.description: This hotel is set in an elegant Georgian townhouse in Paddington, only a 10-minute walk from Hyde Park. Within a few minutes' walk, guests will find restaurants and bars. This is an ideal starting point for a visit to the sights of London, such as the British Museum, Madame Tussauds, The Victoria and Albert and Natural History Museums to name but a few. Located in one of the most exciting and renowned capital cities in Europe, this hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travellers. With 52 comfortable & relaxing rooms ranging from singles to large family rooms, all with en suite facilities, we are confident we can meet the expectations of our guests.

68019.description: Located in the heart of Paris between the Opéra and Madeleine and approximately 5 minutes' walk from the Galeries Lafayette and Printemps department stores, the Caumartin Astotel is perfectly located. The Caumartin Street is ideal for shopping and for enjoying lunch or dinner in the typically French brasseries. Being closed to the underground, it gives easy access to Saint-Germain on the Left Bank, the Louvre Museum and all other major attractions. Tastefully furnished, all the rooms are very comfortable and offer all the modern facilities one can expect of this standard of hotel including air conditioning, modem connection, cable/satellite television and radio. Guests will enjoy having a drink in the glass-roofed bar. Guests should note that local city tax is not included in the rate booked. This will be charged directly to guests by the hotel and payable at check in/out.

68101.description: The Crowne Plaza Malpensa Airport, an IHG Hotel, offers upscale accommodation in Case Nuove, Somma Lombardo. A short drive from Volandia Museum of Flight and Congress Center MalpensaFiere, it's also convenient for exploring Lake Comabbio and Safaripark. Indulge in the full-service spa or enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge service, and the communal TV area. The 133 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, private bathrooms, and digital programming. Dine at La Brughiera restaurant, order 24-hour room service, or relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available (fee applies). Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center and meeting facilities. Limited on-site parking is available.

name.content: Doubletree by Hilton Newark Penn Station

68119.description: Enjoy a relaxed stay at the DoubleTree by Hilton Newark Penn Station, connected to Newark Penn Station for easy access to Manhattan. Ideally located near the Prudential Center, NJPAC, and Red Bull Arena, the hotel offers complimentary airport shuttle service. Unwind in comfortable guest rooms and suites featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, spacious work areas, and signature bedding. Enjoy in-room dining, or visit the Market Street Bar and Grill for casual American cuisine. The hotel also features a 24-hour business center and fitness center. With nine meeting rooms and 8, 300 sq. ft. of event space, including the spacious Garden State Ballroom, the DoubleTree is perfect for your next Newark event.

68141.description: Conveniently located on the famous Avenue Louise, this city hotel is in an area filled with the nicest boutique hotels in the city. It is in close proximity to the business centre and the Bois de la Cambre. It is just 4 km from the main road to the city centre and about 15 km to the airport. A total of 69 rooms are available, spread over 9 floors and guests are offered great hospitality in the congenial surrounds of a family hotel. Facilities include a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk where multilingual staff are on hand to answer guests' queries. Guests are offered daily papers as well as non-smoking rooms. It is possible to gain access to the Internet, use the hotel fax machine and car parking. Central heating comes as standard. The rooms may be accessed with a magnetic key. Breakfast may be selected from an ample buffet.

68239.description: This hotel is located right in the heart of the old Medina, only 2 minutes walk from the entrance of the Souks Market, and also 2 minutes from the Museum of Marrakech and the Medersa Ben Youssef. Menara - Marrakech Airport is only 5 kilometres away. The famous and magic Place Djemma el Fnaa is only 8 minutes walk. Guests will be able to enjoy a summer plunge pool and several lounge areas both in the courtyards and also on the large terraces. They will also enjoy the view of the Atlas Mountains or all round the Riad, the roofs of the old Medina of Marrakech. The hotel also has sauna, massage rooms, hammam, pub, restaurant, day trips, car rental, and internet access.

68299.description:
Inspired by the legendary Concorde aircraft, Concorde De Luxe Resort stands as one of Lara–Kundu’s most iconic beachfront landmarks, offering a perfect blend of elegance, comfort, and contemporary architecture. Located directly on the golden sands of Lara Beach, the resort provides easy access to Antalya’s vibrant city center, shopping districts, world-class golf courses, and key cultural attractions, making it an ideal destination for both leisure and family holidays. 

The resort features a wide selection of beautifully designed rooms and suites, many offering breathtaking Mediterranean views. Each room is equipped with an iron, ironing board, Nespresso coffee machine (with exclusive capsules), electronic scales, hair straightener, and luxurious Molton Brown toiletries. 

Guests can enjoy an extensive range of culinary experiences through our international buffet restaurant, diverse à la carte venues, stylish bars, and 24-hour offerings tailored to different tastes. From gourmet delicacies to refreshing drinks, the resort delivers a rich prive all -inclusive experience with exceptional quality. 

Concorde De Luxe Resort also offers an impressive variety of leisure and entertainment facilities. Families will appreciate our vibrant Mini Club, pools, aquapark, and engaging daily activities, while adults can relax in serene quiet zones, on the private sandy beach, or in our fully renovated Spa & Wellness center. The spa features a comprehensive menu of treatments, indoor pool, hammam, saunas, and modern fitness facilities designed to rejuvenate both body and mind. 

Evening entertainment, live music, sports activities, and seasonal events ensure that every day offers something memorable. With exceptional service, attention to detail, and a welcoming atmosphere, Concorde De Luxe Resort invites guests to enjoy an unforgettable holiday experience on the Turkish Riviera.

68329.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at the Teco Hotel in Milan's Central Station area, including complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a TV lounge. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel offers a computer station, express check-in/out, and an airport shuttle (surcharge). The 28 guestrooms feature minibars, LED TVs with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. The hotel is steps from Corso Buenos Aires, a 7-minute walk from Porta Venezia, and conveniently close to other key attractions such as Piazza della Repubblica.

68330.description: Located in Milan's vibrant Sempione district, steps from Corso Sempione and the MiCo Congress Center, this modern hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, internet terminals with printing, a spacious lobby with a reading room, and nearby paid parking. Each guest room features air conditioning, electronic locks, LCD TV, a mini-bar, telephone, and a desk. Enjoy the included breakfast, served in your room upon request.

68519.description: Just a few steps from the seafront, NG Phaselis Bay offers a private beach area, outdoor pool with waterslides and spa facilities. It offers air-conditioned accommodations with a satellite TV and balcony. All rooms and suites at NG Phaselis Bay come with a 32” flat-screen TV, safe and mini-bar. You can taste buffet breakfast, late breakfast, lunch and dinner at the Cuisine Main Restaurant. Local snacks such as gozleme (Turkish pancake), ice-cream, refreshing drinks are served during the day. Spa facilities include a Turkish bath, sauna and massage facilities. Live music and entertainment shows are available at nights. Younger guests can enjoy various activities at the mini club. Less than 4. 3 mi to Kemer town center, NG Phaselis Bay is 12 mi to the ancient Lycian city Phaselis. Antalya Airport is a 1-hour drive away.

68560.description: Located directly on the seafront of the Mediterranean region, Mukarnas Spa & Resort Hotel offers a private sandy beach, outdoor pools, water slides and spa facilities. The hotel features an architecture inspired by the Seljuks. The elegant rooms of Mukarnas include air conditioning, TV, minibar and free Wi-Fi. Each room offers a balcony. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are served as an open buffet at the main restaurant. You can also enjoy Chinese food, Italian cuisine and Turkish kebabs at the à la carte restaurants. For drinks and snacks, there are 5 bars and a café on site. During the day you can relax and sun bathe at the beach, enjoy beach volleyball or relax at the Turkish bath or sauna of the hotel. There is also a disco for nightly entertainment.

68621.description: Sun Beach Hill Hotel is an all-inclusive holiday hotel offering guests comfort, relaxation, and enjoyment. With its modern design, functional spaces, and proximity to the sea, it aims to provide a relaxing and peaceful stay for both families and couples. Our facility, with a total of 210 rooms, offers solutions to suit different expectations with economy, standard land view, and standard sea view room options. The rooms are equipped with basic amenities that enhance comfort, creating a simple and functional living space. The 8-story building, 2 elevators, and well-organized common areas provide guests with easy and comfortable use. The all-inclusive concept includes breakfast, lunch, and dinner served as a buffet; snacks are available throughout the day, tea and cake time is provided, and pool and lobby bar services are available during designated hours. Local alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages are included in the concept, while imported beverages and some specialty items are subject to an extra charge. With indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a children's pool, a pool with slides, and a private beach area, our guests can enjoy themselves throughout the day. Sun loungers, umbrellas, and cushions are available in the pool and beach areas. Resort activities include fitness, table tennis, darts, soft animation, and a disco during the season. The spa center offers amenities such as a sauna, Turkish bath, massage, and scrub-foam treatments to help guests relax and rejuvenate during their stay. Room decoration services are available upon request for honeymoon guests. Sun Beach Hill Hotel aims to offer its guests a pleasant holiday experience with its friendly service, accessible amenities, and simple approach to comfort.

68680.description: As a private or business traveler, you are in the right place at our enjoy hotel Berlin City Messe:Bright and modernly equipped, we offer 91 cozy and comfortable single and double rooms as well as triple and quadruple rooms – all with a shower bathroom. Ideal for solo travelers, families, and small groups. You can enjoy free Wi-Fi throughout the entire hotel.

68721.description: The property is located in the heart of Midtown Manhattan on New York's fashionable East Side between Lexington and 3rd Avenues. The hotel is strategically located just minutes from Central Park, the Theatre District and popular museums. The hotel is an elegant, charming and stylishly sophisticated hotel. It offers spacious lodging accommodation units, plush furnishings and warm personal service. The large and comfortable rooms are stylishly decorated with contemporary furnishings accented with tasteful artwork and soft colour tones. Each room features a microwave, coffee maker and a fridge. Upscale bath amenities, bathrobes and large-screen TVs complete the fantastic amenities. Luxurious bedding and double glazed windows ensure a wonderful night's sleep. There is an onsite gym. There is a lovely Indian restaurant on the property.

68780.description:
Panoramic mountain and ocean views, Lagoon Beach Hotel is where it all comes together, beautifully! 

Your ultimate business & leisure hotel where you'll find panoramic mountain and ocean views with the widest stretch of white sand on Lagoon Beach right on Milnerton Beach, this fantastic hotel offers an opulent atmosphere and unbeatable views of the most famous landmark in the area – Table Mountain, as well as of Robben Island, the Victoria and Alfred Waterfront and the Atlantic Ocean. 

An excellent accommodation choice for both business and leisure travellers, it features outstanding conference and banqueting facilities that, where a variety of corporate and private events can be hosted. 

Guest arriving by car can park free of charge on the premises, and the helpful staff can provide assistance with transportation, laundry services. 

From the spacious and elegant rooms to the two restaurants and beach bar (with heated outdoor pool), this amazing establishment leaves nothing to be desired.

68799.description: The hotel is located just 700 m from Piazza del Duomo, close to the San Babile underground station (line MM1). The convenient location within a short distance of links to the public transport network allows for quick and convenient access to the city centre as well as the suburbs. The historic old town, fashion boutiques, an array of shops, event venues, banks and leisure centres are also a stone's throw away. Daytrip destinations outside of the city may be reached from either the main Stazione Centrale or Garibaldi railway station, or by heading along the motorway in the direction of Venice, Bologna, Genoa, Varese, Como or Turin. Milan Linate airport is about 5 km from the hotel and it is some 45 km to Malpensa airport. Both may be reached by making use of the bus transfer service. The hotel comprising a total of 22 fully renovated rooms, amongst which count spacious single and double rooms as well as triple and quad suites, junior suites and luxury suites. Fully air-conditioned throughout, facilities include a foyer with leather sofas and a 24-hour reception desk, a safe, a cloakroom and a lift. Further in-house amenities include a café, a bar, a hairdressing salon, a TV room and public Internet access (WLAN; fees apply). There is a laundry service to take advantage of, as well as 24-hour room service (charges payable). The hotel staff are multilingual. Those arriving by car may make use of the hotel car park.

68879.address: 131B NEW LINK ROAD, Chakala, Andheri (East), Mumba
68879.description: The Mirador is a delightful business hotel located at the heart of Andheri's shopping and commercial district in Mumbai. Conveniently situated close to the rapidly developing business area of the Bandra Kurla complex it is the preferred choice for business travellers. The international airport is a mere 2 km away and guests will find the domestic airport just 4 km from the hotel. Offering the highest degree of luxury and hospitality, this elegantly-designed upscale hotel affords guests high-quality conference and business facilities. The stylish guest rooms offer a quiescent setting where guests can relax and reflect at the end of the day. Offering the very best in dining guests can indulge in superb delights that the restaurant has to offer.

68880.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Mumbai and was established in 2012. It is a short drive away from the Gate way of India and the nearest station is Railway Station.

68881.description: Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Leela MumbaiLocated in Mumbai, 2. 9 miles from Phoenix Market City Mall, The Leela Mumbai has accommodations with an outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a fitness center and a garden. This 5-star hotel offers room service and a concierge service. The property provides a 24-hour front desk, airport transportation, a shared lounge and free WiFi throughout the property. The rooms will provide guests with a minibar. Guests at the hotel can enjoy a buffet breakfast. At The Leela Mumbai you'll find a restaurant serving American, Cantonese and Caribbean cuisine. Vegetarian, dairy-free and halal options can also be requested. The accommodation offers a sauna. ISKCON is 3. 8 miles from The Leela Mumbai, while Powai Lake is 3. 9 miles from the property. The nearest airport is Chhatrapati Shivaji International Mumbai Airport, 0. 6 miles from the hotel. Couples in particular like the location – they rated it 9. 0 for a two-person trip.

68920.description: The Porto Bay Rio Internacional is a great luxurious hotel situated on the seafront of Copacabana. Guests will be able to enjoy beautiful views from most rooms and easy access to its famous beach. Private beach service and multi-lingual staff will guarantee satisfaction. Guests can also take advantage of the hotel's conference and business facilities. The business district is approximately 15 minutes away, as well as the main shopping and tourist attractions. It features a great restaurant on its top floor from where guests will enjoy magnificent views over Corcovado and Sugarloaf Mountains.

68939.description:
Intimate Elegance on the Champs-Élysées, Hotel Perpetual Paris is your prestigious 4-star boutique hotel. 
Ideally nestled just steps away from the Champs-Élysées and the prestigious Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré, Hotel Perpetual Paris redefines the boutique hotel experience in Paris. 

Our refined rooms, blending modern comfort with elegant design, promise an unforgettable getaway for a unique experience with our personalized service and warm atmosphere, providing a charming interlude in the heart of the City of Light

68942.description: The Hotel Paris Italie, a charming three-star hotel on Paris's Left Bank, borders the Latin Quarter, placing you steps away from cafes, restaurants, cinemas, and shops. Enjoy convenient access to public transportation at Place d'Italie station, connecting you to major Parisian sights. The hotel's 35 newly renovated rooms offer modern amenities, including air conditioning, private bathrooms, hair dryers, safes, and TVs with international channels. Additional services include a 24-hour bar, buffet breakfast, and assistance booking excursions and transportation.

68981.description: The Aura Hotel Times Square offers a prime location in the heart of New York City, just steps from Times Square and a short walk from Bryant Park. Guests can enjoy on-site amenities such as a fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. The hotel's 234 guestrooms feature LCD televisions, private bathrooms with designer toiletries, and convenient amenities like in-room safes and coffee/tea makers. Dining options include a restaurant and a bar/lounge. Additional services such as express check-out and dry cleaning are also available. Self-parking is available for a fee.

name.content: The Five Hotel Paris Quartier Latin

69041.description: Just steps from this charming hotel lies Rue Mouffetard, one of Paris's oldest streets. The surrounding buildings, though updated, retain their original medieval foundations and facades. The Jardin du Luxembourg is a mere 1. 7 km away, and the Panthéon is about 1. 3 km from the property. Guests will appreciate the sophisticated ambiance of the lobby, with its elegant design and calming color palette. An art gallery graces the entrance foyer, and a cozy fireplace invites relaxation. The uniquely designed rooms, featuring the signature style of Isabelle Emmerique and exquisite Chinese lacquer work, are sure to impress. Please note: The hotel will undergo renovations from January 1 to May 31, 2024, and will be fully closed from February 19 to March 3, 2024.

69079.description: 'Enjoy a relaxing stay at Cyan Cancun Resort & Spa, a beachfront hotel in Cancun's Hotel Zone. Unwind on the private beach, take a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, or savor a delicious meal at the on-site restaurant. Enjoy drinks at the bar, lounge, or poolside bar. Amenities include express check-out, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and free self-parking. The 155 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs with cable, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads, safes, desks, and phones with free local calls. The hotel is conveniently located near Delfines Beach and Iberostar Cancun Golf Course, and just a short drive from Cancun International Airport (CUN). '

69099.description:
Located in the hotel district of Evrenseki, less than ten minutes' drive from Side where guests can find restaurants, bars, a bustling nightlife, an archaeological museum and Roman/Hellenistic ruins of the old city, this family-friendly hotel offers a range of amenities and is a three minute walk from its' own beach. The spacious outdoor pool area features an aqua pool with waterslides, promising lots of fun and for those looking for more entertainment, there is an animation team on hand while younger kids can enjoy the mini club. A rich choice of dining options from the international buffet to the specialised a la carte restaurants will satisfy gourmet lovers while the varied bar venues provide variety for enjoying a refreshing drink. Local transport and taxis are available in the vicinity of the complex enabling easy access to the many attractions in this part of the Turquoise coast. 
GENERAL REMARKS:
*** Pets Are Not Allowed. 
*** All Hotel rooms are non-smoking. 
*** Guests under the age of 18 without one of the parents will not be accepted. 
*** The hotel reserves the right to modify the specified dates, times, and venues due to weather
conditions or operational requirements. Additionally, the hotel reserves the right to make changes to
the concept without prior notice. 
*** Depending on availability, guests staying a minimum of 7 nights or more are entitled to one
complimentary à la carte restaurant visit with prior reservation. 
*** In the UAI concept, all drinks are served by the glass. 
*** Alcoholic beverages will not be served to guests under the age of 18.

69199.description: This charming, family-friendly hotel is located within the walls of the Castle of São Jorge, in the heart of the Lisbon historic centre. Guests will find pubs, the bus and underground stations, the Casa dos Bicos historical house within walking distance. Jerónimos Monastery and Belém Tower are located roughly 5 km from the hotel and the National Museum of Ancient Art is located roughly 3 km away. Lisbon Portela Airport is approximately 9 km from the hotel. This hotel is a small mansion built within the Castle of São Jorge walls, on the site of the former Alcaçova Palace.
