The historical building from 1765 comprises 2 floors and a mansard, an inner courtyard with a small garden and some medieval remains such as the cistern. There is a lobby with 24-hour reception. Guests will find 14 welcoming rooms offering complete modern day comfort, such as free WLAN Internet access. The hotel is air-conditioned and features a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a bar and breakfast room. For an additional fee, guests may take advantage of the room and laundry services. All rooms are fitted with en suite bath, hairdryer and double bed. Direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access and a safe are available for guests' convenience while individually regulated air conditioning is provided for guests' comfort. Follow the signs to the centre and Praça Marquês de Pombal. Then, continue towards Praça dos Restauradores and Castle of São Jorge. Enter the Castle of São Jorge walls and take the first left.

69201.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a sauna and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:30 AM to 11:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to noon for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. This hotel has 4 meeting rooms available for events. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 87 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and espresso makers.

69202.description: This beautiful boutique hotel in an 18th century building is excellently located in the heart of the Portuguese capital of Lisbon, on the renowned Avenida da Liberdade. The historic centre with its famous attractions such as Praça do Rossio, Santa Justa Elevator or Praça do Comércio is just a few steps away, the Moorish castle of São Jorge is within walking distance. A large variety of shops, restaurants and bars is in the surroundings.

name.content: Ten Hill Place Hotel, WorldHotels Distinctive

69219.description: Opened in 2006, Ten Hill Place, WorldHotels Distinctive property, is a premier city center hotel in Edinburgh. From its airy public spaces to its 129 smart bedrooms, the hotel offers quiet sophistication, setting it apart from other Edinburgh accommodations. Seven fully equipped accessible rooms are available, with elevator access from the street level to all floors. Historic and contemporary rooms within Surgeons' Hall can accommodate conferences, meetings, and social events. This innovative hotel is within easy walking distance of Princes Street, the historic Old Town, and the city center's main tourist, shopping, and business districts, yet peacefully situated away from the main thoroughfares. The Festival Theatre is across the road, the National Museums are around the corner, and the Royal Mile, Edinburgh Castle, and Holyrood Palace are just a short distance away. Whether for business or a city break, make Ten Hill Place, WorldHotels Distinctive your first choice. The hotel is owned by the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh, and profits help fund surgical care and development worldwide.

69462.description: Located in the Kiris district, approximately 5 kilometres west of Kemer on Turkey's south coast, this stylish design hotel consists of 3 blocks and is situated on 9 hectares of land with a 350 metres private beach, connected by subway. The complex is suitable for most ages and features a particularly large pool and aqua park area, a spa centre, meeting/events room and a range of leisure activities. With a mountainous backdrop, establishment is 50 kilometres from Antalya city centre and is easily reached by public transport which is available from beside the hotel.

69479.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy international cuisine at Tigerlily, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Make yourself at home in one of the 33 guestrooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. George Street - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Charlotte Square - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Georgian House - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Princes Street - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Princes Street Gardens - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Johnnie Walker Princes Street - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Assembly Rooms - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Edinburgh Gin Distillery - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Usher Hall - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- St. Andrew Square - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Scottish National Gallery - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Scott Monument - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Dean Village - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Museum on the Mound - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Grassmarket - 1 km / 0. 6 mi. The nearest airports are: Edinburgh Airport (EDI) - 13. 4 km / 8. 3 mi Manchester Airport (MAN) - 359. 6 km / 223. 4 mi The preferred airport for Tigerlily is Manchester Airport (MAN). With a stay at Tigerlily, you'll be centrally located in Edinburgh, steps from George Street and 4 minutes by foot from Princes Street. This upscale hotel is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Grassmarket and 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Edinburgh International Conference Centre.

69520.description: Opened in 2007, the luxurious Viking Star Hotel enjoys a convenient setting in the centre of Kemer on the Turkish Riviera, just a few steps away from the main street with its numerous shopping possibilities. Many restaurants and bars can be found in the surrounding area; the sand and pebble beach is about 600 metres away. The elegant rooms have views of the pool, the land or the majestic Taurus mountain range. There is a large outdoor pool with separate children's pool as well as an indoor pool with a separated children's area. Guests can unwind having a drink at the pool bar, the beach bar or a specially designed English pub. Younger guests will love the mini club, while not so young guests can work out in the fitness centre or get pampered in the first-class spa and wellness area with hammam, sauna and 20 different massage services. A perfect place for couples and families with children wishing to spend a beach holiday in an urban environment.

69522.description: Faros Old City Hotel offers top-notch services and amenities, ensuring guests experience utmost comfort. Remain linked during your visit by utilizing the complimentary internet access available. Prior to your check-in date, you can arrange airport transportation services, guaranteeing a seamless and efficient experience for both arrival and departure. Parking is accessible, supplied by the hotel for guests who arrive by car. The hotel is completely smoke-free. Each morning at Faros Old City Hotel, a scrumptious, homemade breakfast kick-starts the day. Begin your holiday mornings right with your essential cup of coffee, offered daily at the cafe on-site. During your visit, indulge in a range of delightful culinary choices at hotel to enhance your experience. Faros Old City Hotel provides a superb assortment of leisure amenities for guests to enjoy. Eliminate those holiday calories by stopping by hotel and making use of their well-equipped exercise amenities.

name.content: Bab Al Shams Desert Resort & Spa

69559.description:
Nestled among the dunes a mere 45 minutes from both Dubai and Abu Dhabi International Airports, Bab Al Shams Desert Resort & Spa offers a spectacular desert escape. This tranquil oasis combines rustic charm with luxurious amenities, including twin infinity pools overlooking the breathtaking desert landscape and the award-winning Satori Spa, featuring private and couples' treatment rooms. The resort's unique ecosystem is home to gazelles, birds, geckos, and a variety of other wildlife, creating an authentic desert experience. 

Kindly informing on temporary closure of some facilities for Bab Al Shams as per below:

•	Restaurants: Anwa, Al Hadheerah, and Rait — closed until end of August 2026

69899.description: Located at the gateway to Paris, just steps from the Parc des Princes and Roland Garros, the DoubleTree by Hilton Paris Boulogne offers a peaceful and refined setting. Savor French cuisine on a vineyard view terrace, wander through nearby parks, and relax in one of the 170 spacious guest rooms. With a fitness center, private parking, and undeniable charm, the hotel promises an unforgettable Parisian stay.

69989.description: This Berlin hotel is within walking distance of the world-famous KaDeWe department store and the city centre. Guests can easily reach major tourist attractions such as the Berlin Wall Memorial, the Pergamon Museum and the Brandenburg Gate. In addition, a broad range of shopping and entertaining venues are located in the surrounding area.  The hotel comprises a total of 30 rooms. Facilities on offer include a lobby as well as conference and meeting facilities. Guests can dine in the onsite restaurant and also receive free weekday newspapers.  All guest rooms are equipped with showers, hairdryers, cable TV and safes. The spacious rooms for up to four guests are perfect for families. Guests of this Berlin hotel are sure to enjoy the free breakfast buffet in the sunny breakfast room.

name.content: Hotel Victor's Residenz Hotel Berlin Tegel

69992.description: Guests are welcomed to this Berlin hotel near Berlin-Tegel Airport. Sights like the Brandenburg Gate can be reached quickly by car or underground transportation systems. This Berlin hotel is minutes from Potsdamer Platz square, the Berlin Botanical Gardens and Alexanderplatz. A variety of restaurants and tourist attractions are located in the surrounding area. This 161-room Berlin hotel offers 3 air-conditioned conference rooms equipped with the latest communication and presentation technology. Guests are invited to enjoy a drink in the bar followed by a delicious meal in the onsite restaurant. A laundry service and wireless Internet access are also available. All of the air-conditioned guest rooms are fully-equipped as standard including kitchenettes with fridges and microwaves. Leisure facilities include a gym and a sauna.

70020.description: Situated directly on the sandy beach and overlooking the beautiful turquoise waters of the Mediterranean Sea, this modern hotel is surrounded by lush green gardens. A large variety of sports facilities, two outdoor pools, two children's pools, a fitness centre, a hammam, amphitheatre and nightclub are offered. The city of Alanya with its famous attractions is just a short drive away.

70159.description: The historical hotel is located in the impressive county of Venice, at Mogliano Veneto, in the middle of a landscape in which some of the most beautiful Venetian villas still stand. It is built on a famous Roman road, the Terraglio, which links Venice to Treviso. The hotel is situated just a few kilometres from the centres of both Venice and Treviso and guests can reach the airports of both cities in approximately 20 min. The beautiful Padua and the city centres of Conegliano and Asolo are easy to reach by train or by car. The hotel combines a contemporary sense of style with the ability to meet the needs of any traveller. The Murano glass, the frescoes and the antique-style decor work in harmony with modern standards of comfort. Renovated in 2006, this hotel comprises a total of 32 rooms, of which 2 are disability-friendly. Facilities on offer include a lobby area with a reception desk manned around the clock, a hotel safe and lift access. Also on offer at this air-conditioned hotel is a café, a TV room and conference facilities. The inviting American bar and the elegant breakfast rooms make the hotel a pleasant, relaxing place to be, ideal for work and meetings. Embedded in a green landscape, in amongst the trees, guests can relax and enjoy peaceful moments on the sun terrace or in the pavilion. For an additional fee, there is also a laundry service and room service on offer. Parking is available for those arriving by car. The rooms, which are furnished in Venetian style, are fitted with antique furniture, Persian rugs and paintings. All rooms come with an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, an ironing set, a double or king-size bed and either a balcony or a terrace. Suites, junior suites and deluxe rooms also come with all modern conveniences, with an additional satellite/cable TV, a minibar, a hot tub, a safe, Internet access and air conditioning.

70160.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include babysitting (surcharge), wedding services, and a fireplace in the lobby. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 16 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and espresso makers. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, while 40-inch LCD televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment.

name.content: Fun & Sun Smart Hane Sun Hotel

70229.description: Located in the Colakli district, on the Mediterranean coast and 8. 5 km from the historical ruins and resort of Side, the hotel consists of 4 blocks and has 203 rooms. Suitable for families and couples, the hotel features a restaurant, a couple of bars and a disco, swimming pools (one with slides) and a mini club and playground. The beach is a short stroll away or there is a shuttle service available. Cafe bars and some shops can be found in Colakli, a couple of minutes' walk from the hotel.

70242.description: This award-winning hotel is superbly located a 5-minute walk from Wembley Park Underground Station, Wembley Stadium, SSE Arena, Troubadour Wembley Park Theatre, London Designer Outlet, and Wembley Park Market. Central London is just a 15-minute tube ride away. The hotel offers 165 en-suite rooms, a sports bar, restaurant, and meeting rooms, as well as conference, training, and event halls for hire. Guest rooms feature triple-glazed windows (that open slightly), safes, irons and ironing boards, flat-screen TVs, work desks, and air conditioning. Three accessible rooms with walk-in showers are available on the ground floor upon request. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, and free parking is provided for one car per room on a first-come, first-served basis. Additional parking may be available with prior arrangement and may incur charges. Heathrow Airport is a 25-minute taxi ride, and St. Pancras International is a 25-minute tube journey from the hotel.

70244.description: The Bcn Urbaness del COMTE hotel is a 20-minute walk from Plaza Catalunya and Las Ramblas, and just 100 meters from the Urgell metro station (Line 1). Located in the vibrant Eixample district, you'll find a wide variety of shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues nearby. All rooms feature en-suite bathrooms, Smart TVs, safes, and hairdryers. Double rooms adapted for guests with reduced mobility are available upon request and require written confirmation from the hotel. Hotel policy requires a valid ID and credit card or a €100 cash deposit upon arrival. Smoking is strictly prohibited throughout the hotel (penalty: €100). Visitors are not permitted in guest rooms. Luggage storage is subject to availability and incurs a €2 fee per locker. Bicycles, scooters, and similar vehicles are not allowed in the hotel rooms or facilities.

70379.description: This family-owned hotel is located in the heart of Athens, at the foot of the Acropolis and beneath the Herodion theatre. The establishment is close to the old town district of Plaka offering various shopping and dining opportunities. The Acropolis underground station and tram stop lie within a few minutes of the hotel. Athens' beach is approximately 12 km away. This air conditioned hotel comprises a total of 50 rooms including several suites. Facilities include a 24-hour reception desk, a bar and a restaurant. Further amenities include a conference room and a laundry service. The pleasant, bright rooms and suites afford a modern style that has been softened with elegant fabrics and ambient lighting. Each has been tastefully furnished and fully-equipped as standard.

70380.description: This hotel enjoys a convenient location in the city centre, right at the foot of the Acropolis. It is only around 150 m away from the Plaka, the charming old town quarter of Athens with its shopping and dining opportunities. Athens Airport is roughly 30 km away. The stunning view of the Acropolis and the welcoming hospitality contribute to the excellent name of this hotel. All the tasteful rooms are individually designed and fully-equipped as standard including air-conditioning, satellite TV and minibar. Most of them include a balcony offering stunning views over the Acropolis. For sunbathing and full relaxation, guests can visit a roof garden to enjoy a breath-taking view or soak in one of two outdoor hydromassage hot tubs.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Brussels City, Belgium

70383.description: The conference hotel is situated at the heart of Brussels, within a short walk of the tourist centre around the Grand Place. It is just a short distance to a diverse selection of shopping venues, the main exhibition centres and the European institutions. Brussels airport is 12 km from the hotel. Dating back to 1908, the hotel has a long and distinguished history, having been at the heart of daily life in Brussels since its opening. Amongst the facilities count a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a currency exchange desk and a cloakroom. In addition, a café, a bar, a restaurant and 20 conference rooms are also available. Guests are also able to take advantage of the room and laundry services. All rooms are fully-equipped as standard including a satellite/ cable TV, a bathroom with a power shower and a king-sized or double bed.

70388.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a rooftop terrace. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a reception hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 6 meeting rooms available for events. Make yourself at home in one of the 210 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers.

70419.description: 'Nestled in the heart of Paris's 12th arrondissement, this charming hotel is just a five-minute walk from Gare de Lyon and a short stroll from Bastille and the Marais. Explore the city's myriad attractions with ease, then return to relax and unwind in comfortable guest rooms. The hotel offers excellent facilities and attentive staff dedicated to ensuring a pleasant stay. '

70521.description: Boasting an ideal position, this comfortable hotel is the best choice to stay in the City of Love either when travelling for leisure or business. Several main sightseeing attractions are within easy reach to the property, including the verdant Jardin du Luxembourg, the stunning Sorbonne church or the world-famous Notre-Dame cathedral. The property is set in a beautiful 19th century building, which includes tastefully decorated guest rooms with superior amenities. They can sleep up to 3 to 4 people and have complimentary WIFI connection for those who need to look for more information about the city or keep in touch with their beloved ones. Moreover, guests can enjoy a delicious comprehensive breakfast buffet at the on-site facilities to start the day full of energy.

70523.description: Located on the left bank of the city in the heart of the Latin Quarter, a 15 minute walk from the Luxembourg Gardens, the Pantheon and the Rue Mouffetard. The hotel is 500 meters from the metro station Censier-Daubenton, 7 subway line, which provides direct access to the Louvre and the Musée d'Orsay, opera and the city center. This hotel offers all the comforts with Wi-Fi breakfast buffet with French pastries and fresh fruit juices is served daily coffee available in the bar. The reception is open 24 hours a day and there is a tour desk. iPads and international newspapers are available to guests free of charge.

70526.description: In the center of Paris, in the 9th Arrondissement, the Best Western Hotel Opera Drouot is located in a highly cultural area. Located near the hotel's auction room, and just a few steps away from the Grands Boulevards, the hotel benefits from an ideal location in the capital. Take the time to stroll to the Opera Garnier or do some shopping in the Grands Magasins. On your way, discover the bookstores and antique dealers; take a quick metro journey to the Musee du Louvre, to Place Vendome, or to the Grands Magasins on Haussmann Boulevard. The Best Western Hotel Opera Drouot is perfect for business customers or for cultural and tourist trips. Discover one of the 39 rooms in the hotel, completely renovated calm and comfortable, all equipped with a flat-screen television, air-conditioning, Nespresso® machine, iPod docking, satellite channels, direct telephone and free Wi-Fi. The entire Best Western Hotel Opera Drouot team is at your disposal to guarantee you a pleasant stay. Enjoy your stay!

70527.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Paris and was established in 1950. It is a short drive away from the Eiffel Tower and the nearest station is Convention Line 12. The Hotel has a restaurant. All 32 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer and air conditioning.

70530.description: This business hotel is ideally located on the left bank in one of the liveliest areas of Paris. The hotel is close to famous landmarks like the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre and Arc de Triomphe. The establishment is close to a metro station and within walking distance of theatres and many restaurants. Charles de Gaulle Airport is approximately 29 km from the premises and Orly Airport is around 15 km away. The air-conditioned, city hotel comprises a total of 72 rooms. Facilities on offer include a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a cloakroom and a breakfast room. In addition, conference facilities and free Internet access are also available. All rooms are fully-equipped as standard including a minibar, a TV and individually controlled air conditioning. A breakfast buffet is served each morning.

70531.description: The Maison Malesherbes embodies the charm of a trendy Parisian home. From the entrance, the hotel's character is defined by intimate lobbies separating the bar, patio, and sitting area. The inviting bay window offers a perfect spot for relaxation. Each of the 24 rooms features luxurious materials and a unique color palette: red, yellow, emerald green, petrol blue, or powder pink. Every room exudes contemporary elegance with a vintage touch. Located in the heart of Paris, the Maison Malesherbes embraces a retro aesthetic with fresh prints, creating a bohemian atmosphere.

70534.description: Get rested and ready for anything at our smoke-free Comfort Inn Birmingham in Birmingham, EN near Broad Street. Our hotel is near the Birmingham Hippodrome theater, Birmingham Botanical Gardens and more. Prepare for a successful day ahead with such amenities as a continental breakfast, a meeting room, a lounge and bar, free weekday newspapers and more. Your spacious room includes a private bathroom and shower facilities, hospitality trays and more. Behind every great day is a great night at Birmingham hotels like our Comfort Inn Birmingham. Book now. Required extra bedding is free in rooms shared by one or two children 14 or under and two parents or grandparents. Email enquiriesthecomfortinnbirmingham. co. uk.

70660.city: San Sebastián de los Reyes (Madrid), Spain
70660.description: The B&B Hotel Madrid Aeropuerto T4 hotel is located in the north of Madrid, near the Plaza Norte 2 shopping center, in the Megapark of San Sebastian de los Reyes, a few kilometers from Adolfo Suarez Madrid Airport T4 and only 15 minutes from the Fair of Madrid. The hotel has a privileged access from the A1-Burgos motorway. Throughout the hotel, both in the rooms and public areas we offer wireless high-speed Internet access (600 MB), capable of managing 1520 devices simultaneously. The hotel has a 24-hour reception, free outdoor parking and indoor parking at an additional cost. Spacious, bright and perfectly soundproofed rooms, with a large writing desk, LCD TV 32'', free coffee machine, minibar, safe and bathroom. *Indoor parking: EUR 8. 50 per car and night. *When booking more than 5 rooms, different policies and additional supplements may apply. *Shuttle service from the hotel to the airport and from the hotel to the Ifema. Check conditions with the hotel.

70859.description: Conveniently situated in Alanya , this property is the perfect base for both business and holiday travel. It is located only 250 m from Cleopatra Beach in Alanya. Antalya airport is 125 km away from the complex. A shuttle service can be arranged to and from the airport. Renovated in 2010, the property consists of 68 rooms. Facilities on offer include air conditioning, a restaurant and a free WiFi internet access. Guests can also enjoy a lobby bar and a pool bar. All accommodation units are fully-equipped as standard including a LCD TV with satellite channels, minibar and a balcony. Private bathrooms come with free toiletries. Leisure facilities include an outdoor pool, Turkish bat and a sauna. In addition, there are plenty of sport options available for guests.

70989.address: South Quay Marsh Wall London E14 9sh
70989.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Situated in the heart of the thriving Canary Wharf business district, Hilton London Canary Wharf offers elegant guest rooms and suites as well as fully refurbished, flexible Hilton Meeting Rooms. With excellent transport links to the rest of the city and beyond, only 15 min from London City Airport, about 50 min to Gatwick Airport and 70 min to Heathrow Airport, this hotel will allow you to make the most of your event in London. Stay connected with WiFi access (fees apply) in London’s largest Hilton Guest rooms, complete with LCD TV (ESPN, CNN, BT Sports 1 & 2), US and USB plugs, safe, tea & coffee making facilities, iron & board, luxury bathroom amenities and much more. Upgrade to an executive room or suite on the higher floors and enjoy a range of complimentary services, including access to the executive lounge on the 14th floor, offering breathtaking views of the city. Unwind after a busy day with a workout in the fitness centre or relax in the steam room and sauna. With 8 elegant and flexible Meeting Rooms and a spacious function room, for up to 400 delegates, with state-of-the-art amenities, dedicated coordinator and 24/7 Business Centre, you are always guaranteed successful meetings & events at Hilton London Canary Wharf. Sit at the bar of the stylish Cinnamon restaurant decorated in green-glass and mahogany proposing contemporary and innovative dishes and sip signature cocktails.

71090.description: Why not stay in the very heart of old Lisbon at this 61 room property only a 5-minute walk from the nearest metro and 10 kilometres from Lisbon International Airport. The Alfama district, St. George's Castle and Mouraria are all just a stone´s throw and the Tagus riverside area with its famous night life is also within easy walking distance. The building and rooms combine traditional architecture with stylish furnishings and guests can relax on the sun terrace. This non-smoking hotel offers triple, double and single rooms, the latter two types with their own private bathrooms, all accommodations being air-conditioned and equipped with radio and satellite television. As well as Portuguese, the friendly staff at the 24/7 front desk speak English, French and Spanish, guests can ask about where to visit and the on-site car and bicycle rental and babysitting services.

71095.description: Ideally located on the main tourist area of downtown Lisbon, this charming hotel promises a relaxing and wonderful visit to the beautiful city of Lisbon. Rossio Square is just a few minutes' walk from the hotel. Lisbon Airport is at 7. 8 km away. The property combines warm and personalized hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make every stay in Lisbon unforgettable. Designed for comfort the hotel features a varied range of rooms from standard to superior categories ensuring a restful night. They are equipped with air-conditioning, satellite TV and private bathroom with toiletries. The hotel is always ready to help in planning the days from bicycle rental and tours and Tuk-tuk rides as an alternative way to explore the city.

71149.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and gift shops/newsstands. This hotel also features wedding services and a ballroom. Enjoy American cuisine at Aviation Grill, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Newark? This hotel has 9804 square feet (911 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 18 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 591 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

71189.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, an elevator, and coffee/tea in a common area. Stay in one of 53 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and irons/ironing boards. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Jacob K. Javits Convention Center - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Madison Square Garden - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- The High Line Park - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Macy's - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Madame Tussauds Wax Museum - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Herald Square - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Times Square - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Broadway - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- 5th Avenue - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Bryant Park - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Empire State Building - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Intrepid Sea, Air and Space Museum - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Chelsea Piers - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- New York Public Library - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Chelsea Hotel - 1. 7 km / 1 mi. The nearest airports are: LaGuardia Airport (LGA) - 15. 1 km / 9. 4 mi Teterboro, NJ (TEB) - 17. 9 km / 11. 1 mi Newark Liberty Intl. Airport (EWR) - 27 km / 16. 8 mi John F. Kennedy Intl. Airport (JFK) - 28. 3 km / 17. 6 mi Stewart Intl. Airport (SWF) - 101. 8 km / 63. 3 mi A stay at Hudson River Hotel places you in the heart of New York, within a 10-minute walk of Madison Square Garden and The High Line Park. This hotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from Jacob K. Javits Convention Center and 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Times Square.

71400.description: Discover an enduring haven for connection, inspiration, and respite in the world's most exciting city. Nestled in the heart of Times Square, steps from world-famous shopping, museums, Broadway shows, and nightlife, The Muse New York fosters belonging through warm service and captivating experiences. With a unique alchemy of comfort and allure, our hotel creates a palpable excitement and promise of possibility. From signature cocktails that mix unexpected flavors, to warm, thoughtful, and anticipatory experiences that surprise and delight, The Muse compels guests to return again and again.

71440.description: Surrounded by the delightful setting of a small Venetian courtyard, you will suddenly come upon the Ateneo Hotel hidden in a quiet street in the heart of our magical city. The architectural features are typical of Venetian buildings, and the materials and damasks found in the rooms, the historic Seventeenth Century furnishings together with the most up to date facilities allow our guests to experience the magical atmosphere of Venice, even in the privacy of their hotel rooms. *** City tax paid directly at the hotel.

71460.description: Discover ancient Egypt at this hotel on Pyramids Road, a path into the past. Guests can enjoy a sophisticated and tranquil atmosphere, perfect for unwinding after a busy day. Business travelers' needs are also catered to. Rooms feature en suite bathrooms, televisions, tea/coffee making facilities, and ironing sets. The hotel offers a sun terrace and swimming pool on the roof, a health club, the Makarena discotheque, and pool tables. Dining options include a variety of cuisines at the Hor grill room, Hamis coffee shop, and Ramis restaurant.

71499.description: Ecco la traduzione del testo in diverse lingue:Inglese:'We are Michela and Riccardo, owners of Villa Gasparini, a hotel with 15 rooms in an 18th-century Venetian villa. The villa is located in Dolo, Venice, right along the Brenta Riviera overlooking the river. All rooms are themed according to various symbols that are reproduced in different versions and colors: from angels, with their protective role, to flowers, almost reminiscent of the scent of the spring garden, from elaborated Venetian to ethnic themes from the early 1900s. But the dearest theme is that of dragonflies, symbolizing rebirth and lightness. The rooms have been recently renovated to ensure comfort and relaxation for our guests, who are considered part of the Gasparini family. All rooms are equipped with flat-screen TV, Italian and satellite channels, free Wi-Fi, minibar, hairdryer, direct dial telephone, safe, private bathroom with shower or jacuzzi with chromo and ozone therapy. The room types are: economy, standard, superior, deluxe, and junior suite. Breakfast, included in the room price, is both sweet and savory and served at the table. The property offers ample free parking in front of the entrance and private, monitored parking for a fee. Villa Gasparini is located between Venice and Padua, connected by frequent bus lines, with schedules and tickets available at the front desk. Just a few minutes away is the Fusina marina, from where a public boat service departs directly to San Marco, Venice. To explore the surrounding area, the Venetian villas and the charming village of Dolo, rental bikes are available. '

name.content: Premier Inn Edinburgh Cc Lauriston Place

71550.description: Premier Inn Hotel Edinburgh Central (Lauriston Place) is the perfect place to stay if you're coming to visit Edinburgh or Edinburgh Castle. You'll be within easy reach of all the tourist attractions, plus great transport links to the whole region. Spend the morning doing some window-shopping along the Royal Mile. For lunch, why not venture out to Leith, Edinburgh's 'port', and discover some glorious restaurants. If you're visiting during the Edinburgh Festival or the International Film Festival, there's plenty to distract during the afternoon. Then it's time to come back to the hotel for a meal in our tasty restaurant, and a well-earned rest in our new, modern rooms with extra-comfy kingsize Hypnos beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

71620.description: Relax in one of the two outdoor swimming pools or enjoy other amenities, including a sauna and fitness center. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. All-inclusive rates are available, covering meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may apply for select restaurants, special dinners, specific beverages, and other amenities. Enjoy a meal at one of the hotel's two restaurants or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind at the bar/lounge, beach bar, or poolside bar. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self-parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 84 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Rooms have private furnished balconies, Wi-Fi (surcharge), and satellite programming. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Kleopatra Beach (0. 1 mi), Alanya Cable Car - Damlatas Station (0. 5 mi), and other attractions. The nearest major airport is Gazipasa (GZP-Gazipasa - Alanya), 26 mi away.

71669.description: Business-friendly hotel near Porta Garibaldi station, with free WiFi and metro links to Milan city centreHoliday Inn® Milan Garibaldi Station hotel is just a 10-minute tram ride from the city centre and less than 10 minutes' walk from Porta Garibaldi train and metro station. From the station you can reach Malpensa Airport in 40 minutes and Linate Airport in 35 minutes. Music lovers can take in world-class operas at La Scala,  a 10-minute taxi ride from the hotel.  Shop and dine at Piazza Gae Aulenti, 15 minutes' walk from the hotel. Art and history buffs can enjoy Renaissance masterpieces at Sforzesco Castle, just 15 minutes' drive away. Take a 20-minute tram ride to admire views of the Alps from the rooftop of the Duomo di Milano. Sports fans are less than 20 minutes by metro from San Siro stadium. From the station it's less than 20 minutes by train to the international trade show centre of Rho Fair. The hotel's three meeting rooms host up to 65 delegates and there's a handy business centre too. Free WiFi helps you stay connected. The hotel fitness centre will keep you in top form.  Satellite TV, soundproof windows and a pillow menu offer the comforts of home. Enjoy meals in the restaurant Butterfly serving Italian cuisine.  Kids stay and eat free.

71759.description: This hotel is located in the tourist centre of Konakli. Avsallar is around 5 km away, while it is approximately 15 km to Alanya. Antalya airport is 100 km away. Taxis and buses provide access to an array of nearby sights. Built in 2006, this air-conditioned beach hotel comprises a total of 7 floors with 470 rooms. Amongst the facilities count a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a safe and a currency exchange desk. In addition, conference facilities as well as a variety of drink and dining options are also available. Further facilities include room, laundry and ironing services. The air-conditioned rooms are all fully-equipped as standard including a satellite/ cable TV, a minibar and a balcony. Leisure options include an outdoor pool, a water park, a gym and spa treatments.

71760.description:
Only 50 m from Alanya's Cleopatra Beach, this hotel has a seasonal outdoor pool and offers air-conditioned studios with private balconies. Wi-Fi is free in the public areas.
Kleopatra Tuna Apart Hotel has an a la carte restaurant and a pool bar for drinks. For outdoor dining, there are barbeque facilities, while room service is available throughout the day.
Overlooking the sea, mountains or pool area, all studios are equipped with American-style kitchens and dining areas. Each offers satellite TV and a private bathroom.
Kleopatra is located 1.5 km from the centre of Alanya and 125 km from Antalya International Airport.

71763.description: This beach hotel is located in the area of Avsallar, on the coast which runs from Alanya to Antalya, a great holiday destination for all guests. Around 150 m from the beach and resort centre, the hotel is approximately a 20-minute drive from Alanya Damlatas Cave and Alanya Castle. The river runs roughly 4 km from the hotel and the forest is approximately 2.5 km away. Antalya Airport is around 100 km from the beach hotel. The air-conditioned hotel offers 113 rooms in total and welcomes guests offering many services and facilities. There is a pleasant, clean outdoor swimming pool with children's swimming area, poolside snack bar and sun loungers and parasols laid out ready for use. Guests may relax with a massage or enjoy a game of table tennis or billiards. Additionally they can relax on their private balcony or terrace, which afford beautiful views.

71765.description: The hotel is located in the popular holiday region of Alanya, only 50 m away from the private sandy beach. The centre of Alanya with its shops, restaurants and bars is 2. 5 km away, Antalya International Airport is at 125 km. The hotel features 91 rooms, 24-hours reception, concierge service, currency exchange, free WIFI, restaurant, 4 bars, fitness centre, spa and wellness, sports facilities, outdoor swimming pool, mini market, laundry service and free on-site parking. Facilities for disabled guests.

71767.description: ***HOTEL HAS SAFE2STAY CERTIFICATION***This hotel is located only 90 m from the beach and about 2 km east from the city centre of Alanya. The airport of Antalya is 125 km away. The hotel features 24-hour reception, express check-in and check-out, currency exchange, free WIFI in public areas, restaurant, 3 bars, outdoor pool, children's pool, playground, laundry service, hair dresser, bicycle rental, car hire and free parking. Wheelchair accessible.

71768.description: This hotel, situated near the beach and a short distance from local shops, bars, and restaurants, offers convenient access to Alanya city (approximately 15 km) and Antalya Airport (approximately 110 km). The 296 air-conditioned rooms feature en suite bathrooms with showers, hairdryers, mini-fridges, telephones, satellite TV, individual climate control, and small lounge areas, along with balconies or terraces. Guests can enjoy a range of amenities, including a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, a restaurant, a bar, a poolside bar, a spa, a games room, and a children's playground. Additional features include a TV lounge and an on-call doctor. Some facilities may incur extra charges. Leisure activities encompass a swimming pool with a dedicated children's area, sun loungers, parasols, a gym, aerobics, water aerobics, and various sports facilities like pool/snooker, table tennis, tennis courts, basketball, and volleyball. A sauna, steam room, and massage services are also available for a fee. Meals are offered in a buffet style, and organized entertainment is provided.

71979.description: The hotel is located in the small town of Avsallar, in a small bay with its own sand and pebble beach. There are transport links close by to bigger towns, including the popular resort of Alanya, 23 km away. The hotel has an international mix of guests and offers a range of facilities and recreational activities including a soft animation programme and spa facilities. For wining and dining options there is a main restaurant and an a la carte restaurant, a lobby bar and garden bar. Some facilities are shared with the sister hotel next door.

72279.description: Perfectly positioned in the heart of the old city in the Sultanahmet district, with many important sights like the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque or Topkapi Palace within walking distance. Numerous shops, restaurants and visitor centre are just 3-minute walk. A tram station is only 500 m from the hotel while Atatürk Airport is 15 km away. The charming city hotel features cosy and comfortable rooms overlooking sea view, equipped with air conditioning, flat-screen TV and en-suite bathroom with shower and hair dryer. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast at the restaurant or International cuisine at the garden restaurant, or relax at the hotel's cafe with a wide selection of wines and drinks.

72439.description: This hotel is in a prime location 5 minutes from Gatwick airport, 15 minutes from the centre of Crawley, and an hour from central London, and 65 km from London Heathrow. Facilities on offer include an entrance hall with 24-hour reception, lift access, a café, a restaurant and parking for those arriving by car (charges apply).

72460.address: Rod Helio Smidt S/N Acesso Base Aerea Cumbica
72460.description: The Pullman São Paulo Guarulhos Airport Hotel is located near GRU Airport and has the convenience of free transfer (suspended until May/2020). It brings together design and sophistication in spacious and comfortable rooms. Free WIFI and car park. Enjoy the amazing leisure area of a hotel near the city of São Paulo with swimming pool, tennis and multi-sport court, playground, pet space and spa by Shishindo.

name.content: Grand Mercure Sao Paulo Vila Olimpia

72464.description: The Grand Mercure SP Vila Olímpia offers an authentic Brazilian experience. It offers renovated and spacious upscale rooms, such as the Premium Executive, designed by the architect Jóia Bergamo. The CipóRestô restaurant serves contemporary and Brazilian cuisine, features private spaces and an outdoor balcony. Hold your event in the largest convention center in the region, capacity up to 600 people.

72479.description: This hotel is located between Alanya and Manavgat on one of the best Turkish beaches, called Karaburun. The hotel is 23 km from Manavgat, 37 km from Alanya, and 85 km from Antalya Airport. The air-conditioned hotel comprises a total of 242 rooms. Guests are welcomed into an elegant and spacious reception hall with 24-hour reception and check out service. Facilities include a shopping centre, a disco and a variety of dining options. Additionally, the hotel offers conference facilities, a currency exchange, and a laundry service. Each en suite room comes fully-equipped as standard including a satellite/cable TV, a minibar and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. The hotel offers a main outdoor swimming pool with pool-side bar, spa treatment and a broad range of sport options.

72499.description: Indulge in onsite body treatments and facials at the Grand Mogador Menara, conveniently located near Avenue Mohamed VI in Marrakech. Enjoy this hotel's recreational amenities, including a health club, sauna, and seasonal outdoor pool. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and take advantage of concierge services and the gift shops/newsstands. Savor local and international cuisine at one of the two onsite restaurants, including 'International (Badiaa), ' or order room service during limited hours. Two coffee shops/cafés offer snacks. Buffet breakfast is available daily (7:00 AM to 10:30 AM) for a fee. The hotel also features a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. For events, the hotel offers 377 square feet (35 square meters) of space, including a conference center and six meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available onsite. The 244 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Phones and safes are also provided, and housekeeping is daily. Nearby attractions include the Palais des Congrès, Royal Tennis Harti, and Menara Mall, all within a short distance. Menara Airport (RAK) is the preferred airport.

72503.description: This hotel is located directly in the commercial and architectural centre of Madrid, approximately 50 m from Puerta del Sol, close to the Gran Via. The establishment is very well connected to the public transport network of buses and underground trains. It is ideally situated for taking tours around the city, shopping and experiencing local cuisine. It comprises a total of 62 rooms, and features air conditioning and an entrance hall with 24-hour reception. Facilities include a café and a restaurant, where guests can enjoy delicious meals complemented by a selection of drinks. The rooms are equipped with a minibar and feature individually adjustable heating and air conditioning, as well as a fully fitted en-suite bathroom.

72703.description: Less than a 10-minute walk from Halls 2 and 3 at Montparnasse station, Novotel Paris Centre Gare Montparnasse is perfect for family or business stays in Paris. Our team will take care of everything. Sip on a coffee at our coffee shop, sample creative cocktails in our bar and enjoy French specialties in our restaurant. Looking for more action? Try our meeting rooms, co-working space or fitness center.

72749.description: We have got you covered at the newly renovated Comfort Suites at Woodbridge hotel near the Newark Liberty International Airport. Amenities include free WiFi, free hot breakfast, free parking and a fitness center. Guest rooms feature microwaves and refrigerators, USB ports, premium bedding, work desks and flat-panel TVs. Our spacious Avenel, NJ hotel near the Newark Liberty International Airport with suites lets you access the top attractions in the area, including Kean University, Rutgers University, Mills at Jersey Gardens, Woodbridge Center Mall and the Liberty Science Center. If you are looking for an upgrade, keep in mind that the presidential suites come with wet bars and hot tubs.

name.content: Comfort Suites East Brunswick - South River

72870.description: The well-being of guests is top of mind at Choice-branded hotels. Guests may experience a variety of new, improved cleanliness protocols and products. Our Comfort Suites East Brunswick - South River hotel in East Brunswick, NJ gives you more of the space you need to spread out, relax or work. Situated between New York City and Philadelphia, our all-suites hotel is also just minutes from the New Jersey Convention and Exposition Center. Our spacious accommodations include microwaves, refrigerators, irons, ironing boards, hair dryers, HDTVs and convenient AC and USB outlets. Work out in our fitness center and enjoy the amenities you expect while on the road, including free WiFi, free hot breakfast, coffee and a weekday newspaper. Laundry facilities are also available. Also, earn rewards including free nights and gift cards with our Choice Privileges Rewards program.

name.content: Motel 6 Elizabeth, Nj-Newark Liberty Intl Airport

72871.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Motel 6 Elizabeth, NJ - Newark Liberty Intl Airport, including complimentary Wi-Fi, a TV in the common area, and a vending machine. Grab a snack at the on-site snack bar/deli. Business travelers will appreciate the business center, express check-in, and express check-out. A complimentary 24-hour airport shuttle is also available. Relax in one of the 123 air-conditioned guest rooms, each featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, cable TV, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combination, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. A desk and turndown service are provided, and microwaves are available upon request. Nearby attractions include The Mills at Jersey Gardens (1. 9 mi), Kean University (2. 5 mi), Prudential Center (4. 4 mi), and the New Jersey Performing Arts Center (4. 8 mi).

name.content: Days Inn By Wyndham Jersey City

72872.description: Enjoy comfort and convenience at our Days Inn by Wyndham Jersey City near NYC. Located just off US-9 and 10 miles from Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR), our hotel is eight miles from the Lincoln Tunnel entrance to Midtown Manhattan, placing you near iconic attractions such as Central Park, Times Square, and Madison Square Garden. You'll find numerous dining options nearby, and we're also minutes from MetLife Stadium, Liberty State Park, and the Liberty Science Center. Back at the hotel, enjoy amenities such as free light breakfast items with coffee, tea, and juice, along with complimentary Wi-Fi and parking.

name.content: Comfort Inn & Suites Airport La Guardia Airport

73062.description: Behind every great day is a great night at the Comfort Inn and Suites LaGuardia Airport hotel in Maspeth, NY. Our hotel is near sites and activities like Times Square, Central Park, New York Civic Center, Madison Square Garden, Penn Station and the John F. Kennedy International Airport. Take advantage of our free hot breakfast, free WiFi, free airport transportation, free weekday newspaper and free coffee. Guest rooms include a TV, hair dryer, coffee maker, desk and refrigerator. Upper-tier suites have even more amenities, such as a hot tubs. Also, earn rewards including free nights and gift cards with our Choice Privileges Rewards program.

73159.description: This luxurious hotel is located in the suburbs of Vienna, featuring a unique location next to Schönbrunn Palace. Guests will find themselves a short subway ride from some of the most important tourist attractions, making this luxurious hotel the perfect base from which to explore all this beautiful region has to offer. The elegant guest rooms are spacious and bright, featuring an elegant design and luxurious bedding to create a charming atmosphere that encourages relaxation. Guests can enjoy one of the refreshing cocktails served at the onsite summer terrace, ideal to meet with friends after a busy day of work or sightseeing.

73285.description:
Wake up in the heart of Barcelona — and start every day with a free breakfast. Petit Palace Museum sits on Carrer de la Diputació, steps from Plaça de Catalunya and Passeig de Gràcia, putting the city's greatest landmarks, shops, and restaurants within a 5-minute walk. 

The hotel occupies the Casa Garriga Nogués, a stunning Modernista building designed by architect Enric Sagnier in 1902 — part of Barcelona's famous Golden Square (Quadrat d'Or), the most concentrated area of Art Nouveau architecture in the world. From the moment you enter, the grand lobby, ornate details, and resident piano set the tone for a stay unlike any other. 

Free buffet breakfast is included with every stay — a healthy and generous spread to fuel your Barcelona adventures, served daily in the hotel restaurant. 

Rooms are spacious and thoughtfully equipped, with free Wi-Fi, hydromassage showers, and air conditioning. Families are warmly welcomed, with cribs, high chairs, and special gifts for little ones. 

 24-hour front desk ready to help with tours, tickets, and local tips. The hotel is fully wheelchair accessible and pet-friendly. 

La Rambla is a 5-minute walk away. Casa Batlló and Casa Milà are at your doorstep. The beach is 3 km away, and the metro is just around the corner — everything Barcelona is famous for starts here

73320.description: Featuring air-conditioned rooms with a balcony, Giardino Hotel is 10 minutes’ drive from Milan center. Offering links to the city center and Milano Centrale Station, Abbiategrasso Metro is 492 feet away. The hotel includes a bar and terrace, and guests enjoy a continental buffet breakfast every morning. Guest rooms are all en suite, and each comes with a safe and TV. The hotel is in a quiet area, serviced by a shuttle to/from the Humanitas Hospital and the European Institute of Oncology.

73321.description: Situated in the municipality of Opera, this hotel offers comfortable rooms and excellent services just outside of Milan. The train station is within walking distance, and the hotel is only ten minutes from Linate airport. The modern, sophisticated guest rooms offer air-conditioning, free internet access and laptop-friendly safes, making them ideal for business travel. Guests can start the day with a rich sweet and savoury breakfast in the breakfast room, sip a drink in the bar and roof garden, and enjoy local cuisine in the in-house restaurant, which also boasts vegetarian and gluten-free options. There are two small meeting rooms for up to 40 delegates as well as an expansive conference room to accommodate business meetings and seminars of up to 110 people. This is the perfect place of rest for those seeking comfort and quiet near Milan but away from the hustle and bustle of the city.

name.content: Golden Tulip São João da Madeira

73379.description:
The Golden Tulip São João da Madeira is an elegant 4-star hotel designed to offer comfort and convenience to all its guests, whether they are traveling for business or leisure. 
With a full range of amenities, the hotel features a cozy restaurant, a heated indoor pool, and a lounge with a TV—all designed to make your stay even more pleasant and relaxing, so you can make the most of your visit to São João da Madeira. 
The 117 rooms, decorated with quality furnishings and a contemporary touch, provide a welcoming and functional atmosphere.

73445.description: Located on Baker Street, our cosy hotel provides the perfect base for exploring the rich history, culture, and attractions that London has to offer. Our hotel features 29 guest rooms and offers great value accommodation with a continental breakfast included in the price. All guestrooms are with an en-suite bath/shower and equipped with modern amenities such as air-conditioning, flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and hairdryer for your comfort. There is a comfortable tv lounge by reception, where complimentary fresh ground coffee, hot chocolate and tea are available 24/7. Explore the world-famous Baker Street Underground station, just a short walk away providing excellent connectivity to attractions such as Madame Tussauds, museums, and the West-End theatres. Sherlock Holmes fans will take delight in visiting the Sherlock Holmes Museum, located just around the corner. Oxford street and Regents Park home to the zoo is also within walking distance. Our friendly staff are available 24/7 to assist you with any inquires or reservations whether you assistance planning your day in London or need help with transportation. No pets allowed.

73481.description: The Hotel is located on a long sandy beach in the heart of the hotel zone, 15 minutes from the International Airport and close to major shopping, tourist and entertainment areas of the city. Inspired by the grandeur of the Mexican-contemporary architecture, the hotel offers a peaceful tropical oasis with a mixture of outstanding natural beauty, making it ideal for the whole family. The Hotel offers the perfect combination to enjoy a pleasant stay: the turquoise sea with its calm waters and soft white sand, sunsets and lovely views that surround the rooms. Escape to a place of encounter and delight surrounded by an atmosphere of rest and relaxation, which will make your visit memorable.

73499.description: Nestled in Antalya's historic Kaleiçi district, this charming city hotel is a short stroll from the harbor, vibrant city center, and a pebbled beach. Renovated in 2005, the hotel features 30 comfortable rooms, including 3 accessible options, set across 3 floors surrounding a tranquil garden. Guests can enjoy Turkish cuisine in the restaurant, relax in the café and bar, or unwind by the pool with a dedicated children's area and snack bar. Special Turkish nights offer a set menu dinner with live music. Please note that air conditioning and safe boxes are available for an extra local charge.

73527.description:
Located in Opera, just 1. 5 km from IEO (European Institute of Oncology) and approximately 5 km from Humanitas Hospital, Acca Sporting Milano - AA Hotels is the ideal choice for guests traveling for medical, business, or trade fair purposes. The property is also a short distance from Forum Assago and Unipol Dome Santa Giulia, and is well connected to central Milan via the Rogoredo Yellow Line (M3) metro stop and the Tram 24 stop, which reaches Duomo in around 20 minutes. 
This newly built 4-star hotel offers rooms equipped with a desk, flat-screen TV, private bathroom, bed linen and towels, safety deposit box, closet and an electric kettle; some rooms feature garden views. 
Property amenities include a garden, free private parking, electric vehicle charging stations, a shared lounge, a bar, concierge service, luggage storage, a 24-hour front desk, airport transportation, room service, and free WiFi throughout the property. 
The hotel also features a 90 sqm gym, a spa area with sauna and Turkish bath, and a conference center accommodating up to 100 people, ideal for corporate events and meetings. 
The daily breakfast offers a rich buffet with Italian and international options. 
No city tax: unlike hotels in the city of Milan, our property is fully exempt, providing a concrete saving on every night's stay. 
The nearest airport is Milan Linate, approximately 12 km from the property.

name.content: Astoria Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western

73528.description: Special Protection, our commitment to ensuring a safe stay with strict cleaning and sanitization protocols. Technologies to support the interaction with the staff to promote social distancing. Healthcare insurance throughout the stay in partnership with AXA Partners. The Hotel Astoria, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western is in a very strategic location: near the exposition areas of Fieramilanocity and Fiera Milano Rho, close to the sporting area of San Siro and only few minutes from the city center, easy to reach by subway and tram. This hotel is complete with every comfort, and with its meeting facilities, is ideal for business travel or leisure.

73529.description: Quiet and welcoming, Hotel Lido is right next to Milan's exposition spaces of Fieramilanocity, a building well served by public transportation and easily reachable from the highway. Convenient to the centre of Milan, San Siro stadium, Mico Milan Congress, Ippodromo del Galoppo and just 300 meters away from Malpensa Shuttle stop (direct connection with Malpensa Airport), this hotel offers its guests a relaxing and friendly atmosphere. The professional staff is available to recommend the area's best restaurants or suggest the best way to get around the city via public transportation.

name.content: Novotel Marne La Vallee Noisy Le Grand

73530.description: Ideal for discovering Disneyland's magic, the fully air-conditioned Novotel Marne-la-Vallée Noisy-le-Grand delights children with its library corner, board games and arcade game areas. Our hotel in Noisy-le-Grand also doesn't forget business travellers, with its 12 meeting rooms, incl. a 220-seat conference hall.

73602.description: The hotel enjoys a central location in Karaiskaki Square, providing easy access to Athens' attractions. The Metaxourghio metro station, just 500 meters away, connects guests to Plaka, the Acropolis, and the historic city center. This six-story hotel offers 51 spacious rooms and various amenities, including a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, lift, the 'HR Bar, ' a restaurant, and a roof garden with stunning Acropolis views. Guests can also enjoy a satellite TV room and room service. The well-furnished rooms provide comfort and convenience, featuring satellite/cable TV, internet access, and a balcony or terrace.

73604.description: Created by Pritzker prize-winning architect Rafael Moneo, NH Collection Barcelona Constanza exudes calm elegance. A 15-minute drive from the city center, it is situated in the Les Corts financial district of Barcelona. This is the perfect choice for business travelers, with the Axa Auditorium right next door. Landmarks, such as the FC Barcelona Camp Nou is also close by. NH Collection Barcelona Constanza has 308 rooms, including 7 Junior Suites and 1 Suite. Each has flat-screen TVs, a Nespresso machine and free Wi-Fi. Enjoy contemporary design with polished wood, glass and large windows, along with modern comforts, such as a rain-effect shower and a pillow menu. Breakfast will be the perfect start to your day with a large spread of options, including eggs prepared-to-order and gluten-free dishes. Enjoy these on a beautiful terrace. For business travelers, NH Collection Barcelona Constanza is the perfect choice, with 11 rooms holding up to 800 guests. To unwind, head to the outdoor 7th floor pool or visit the fitness center and the spa.

73659.description: The multiple award-winning, extraordinary luxury design hotel is surrounded by pine trees and excellently situated on the seemingly endless sandy beach of the Belek area. Antalya Airport is located 30 km away. Many premium golf courses are within easy reach. The centre of Belek with its shops, restaurants, bars and cafés is within walking distance. Features include various swimming pools, including an oversized outdoor pool of more than double Olympic length and water slides. The hotel offers ultra-chic, fashionable accommodation in a white, minimalist style, from design rooms in the main building to exclusive villas. Decorated with almost 5 million little mirrors, is home to several restaurants as well as to the bar, unique with a bar length of 96 metres. The gastronomic offer also includes a blind restaurant. Guests can indulge in total relaxation in the superb spa area. This extraordinary hotel is truly a piece of heaven on earth.

73699.description: Strategically located in Tres Cantos, just a few steps from the Madrid Technology Park, the Eurostars Madrid Foro hotel allows easy access to the airport, the city center, and the IFEMA convention center, all about a 15-minute drive away. The newly renovated Eurostars Madrid Foro has 90 fully equipped rooms with an incredible range of services, including a full bathroom with hairdryer, satellite TV, minibar, air conditioning, and Internet connection. Eurostars Madrid Foro also offers excellent dining options.

73739.description: Nestling within 150, 000 m² of beautiful gardens, the family-friendly beach hotel is located on Turkey's Mediterranean coast. The resort and historical city of Side is 10 km and Antalya Airport 75 km (50 minutes). Consisting of a main building and 2-storey club buildings in the gardens, there are a range of facilities available, including a mini & teen-club, an open-air disco, a shopping arcade and à la carte restaurants. Further facilities include a hairdressing salon, spa, games room, 2 main pools, an Aquapark with 6 slides for adults and 5 slides for children and an indoor pool. Sports enthusiasts will enjoy the climbing wall, professional football fields and tennis courts. Some of these are located in the sister hotel and maybe at an extra charge. A bridge over a canal allows access to the sand and pebble beach. (Some facilities may not be operational due to seasonal conditions).

73740.description: This hotel enjoys a wonderful setting on Turkey's south coast, just across from Incekum Beach. The hotel is located just a short bus journey away from Avsallar. Guests will find themselves just 25 km away from the mesmerising resort of Alanya, where its cliff top castle and Damlatas Caves are sure tempt visitors who are eager to explore the area. The hotel is perfect for every type of traveller visiting the area. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, offering a relaxed setting in which to completely unwind. The hotel offers a wide range of leisure, dining and recreational facilities and services. Guests can enjoy the lively ambience of the Irish pub and disco.

73799.description: Situated in the heart of Madrid's vibrant leisure district, this modern urban hotel offers comfortable accommodations near the city's main attractions. Located next to the renowned Gran Vía shopping street, it is surrounded by theaters, cinemas, restaurants, and entertainment venues, with easy access to public transport. The hotel's contemporary rooms provide a cosmopolitan and timeless retreat. Guests can enjoy daily lunch and dinner menus, along with traditional Spanish tapas and homemade pastries at the on-site snack bar. A 24-hour front desk, free Wi-Fi, and car hire services are also available.

73819.description: The Barcelona Airport Hotel is conveniently located five minutes from Barcelona International Airport and ten minutes from Gran Via Fira, with a free 24-hour airport shuttle. Its 253 rooms, fully renovated in 2022, feature safes, 50-inch TVs with international channels, high-speed Wi-Fi, complimentary mineral water, and kettles with assorted teas. Guests can enjoy over 10, 000 square meters of gardens, a seasonal outdoor pool, gym, business center, private parking, and 12 naturally lit meeting rooms, some with private terraces. A varied culinary experience awaits at La Sal Restaurant, offering Mediterranean and seasonal cuisine, or enjoy tapas and snacks at the Terraza Garden. Catch sporting events at our Sports Bar.

73919.description: Damrak Inn offers simple and functional rooms with free Wi-Fi, only a 5-minute walk from Amsterdam Central Railway Station. It benefits from a 24-hour reception. Please note that the Hotel doesn't have an elevator as it's an historical building, the stairs are steep ! Please note that the Hotel doesn't have an AC (air conditioning). A damage deposit of € 100 cash is required on arrival. You should be reimbursed on check-out. Your deposit will be refunded in full via cash, subject to an inspection of the property. Each of the rooms at Damrak Inn is equipped with a work desk and TV. All of the rooms include private bathroom facilities with a shower, toilet and hairdryer. Dam Square is less than a 5-minute walk from the hotel and Dam Tram Stop is only 200 metres away. Damrak Inn is a 5-minute walk from the Kalverstraat shopping area and just over a 10-minute walk from the Anne Frank House.

74159.description: Renovated to a classic style, the elegant boutique hotel Hera with its charming façade is ideally situated in the historic heart of Athens, right at the foot of the Acropolis hill and next to the archaeological sites. Guests will appreciate the exceptional view of the Acropolis from the hotel's rooftop restaurant as well as a range of further excellent services and amenities. Major attractions such as the Acropolis itself, the new Acropolis Museum, the Temple of the Olympian Zeus or the ancient Plaka with its narrow streets are only a few steps away. An ideal base to explore the Greek capital.

74160.description: The hotel is located in the area of Alimos, and is approximately 25 km from the airport. Public transport is easily accessible, and the express bus line Χ-96 runs 24 hours a day and connects the hotel with Port Piraeus via Possidonos Avenue. This beach property features a lobby with 24-hour reception, a seasonal swimming pool (operates May 1st till October 31st ) and a car park. Several categories of rooms are available to ensure comfort for any type of travel. All offer functionality in superb surroundings, and feature an en-suite bathroom with hairdryer, satellite TV and soundproof windows. Individually adjustable air conditioning and a balcony with a sea view, also feature as standard.

74200.description: This modern and elegant hotel is situated in the area of Findikzade, close to the historic Sultanahmet District, the historic centre of Istanbul. It features a restaurant, a bar and a business centre. Public transportation links are in the vicinity of the hotel; famous attractions such as the Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Hippodrome or Topkapi Palace are within easy reach.

74359.description: The Ottoman Hotel Imperial, a former Ottoman school and hospital dating back to the mid-19th century, boasts a rich history. For 70 years, it housed teachers and pupils of the historical 'medrese. ' In the early 20th century, a hospital was added, serving local merchants and artisans. By the mid-20th century, the building was transformed into a hotel, welcoming young travelers and students. Following extensive renovations in 2005, it now stands as a premium historic hotel. The hotel enjoys a prime location in Sultanahmet, the heart of Istanbul's old city, offering stunning views of the Hagia Sophia. It is surrounded by major historical and cultural attractions, making it an inspiring destination year-round.

74462.description:
This luxurious design hotel is situated directly on a private beach in the popular holiday region of Belek. Antalya Airport is approximately 27 km away, the centre of the regional capital 35 km. The hotel features 535 guest rooms, 24-hours reception, express check-in and check-out, concierge service, currency exchange, conference facilities, free WIFI, 8 outdoor pools, indoor pool, playground, fitness centre, exceptional spa and wellness, sports facilities (especially water sports), 8 restaurants, 5 bars, medical assistance, car hire and free on-site parking. Facilities for disabled guests. 

From 01. 11. 25 to 31. 03. 2026, our property will operate under the Winter Concept. During this period, some outdoor facilities will be unavailable. However, heated pools for both adults and children will remain open. Heating for private villa pools is also available for an additional charge.

74464.description: This beach hotel is situated between the legendary Toros Mountains and the sparkling, turquoise Mediterranean Sea. The club resort is just 500 m from Göynük and its range of restaurants, 150 m from the beach and approximately 9 km from the centre of Kemer and its shops. Antalya Airport is approximately 50 km from the resort. Built in 2007, the air-conditioned hotel has an original transatlantic architectural style, gives the feeling like living on the ship and offers 490 rooms in total with standard amenities. Guests may spend time in the games room, TV lounge, enjoy a nice beverage at the bar or café or enjoy a night of dancing in the hotel's disco. For younger guests, the hotel provides a children's playground and a kids' club. The hotel also offers a spa with Turkish bath, Anka Sauna and Steam bath for guests to relax during the stay.

74467.description: Ideally located in the prime touristic area of Merkez, De Luxe promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. The hotel offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, 24-hour front desk, facilities for disabled guests, express check-in/check-out are there for guest's enjoyment. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer television LCD/plasma screen, carpeting, mirror. To enhance guests' stay, the hotel offers recreational facilities such as private beach, fitness center, sauna, outdoor pool, indoor pool. De Luxe is an excellent choice from which to explore Kemer or to simply relax and rejuvenate.

74468.description: This family-friendly beach hotel is located just 1 km from the centre of the resort of Kizilagac. It is around 15 km from Side, approximately 12 km from Manavgat and roughly 80 km away from Antalya Airport.   The holiday village is built on an area spanning 100 acres and offers guests a peaceful and happy holiday. The hotel establishment comprises a total of 590 rooms. The air-conditioned hotel welcomes guests into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe and currency exchange facilities. Further amenities include a hairdressing salon, a café, a bar and a restaurant. Conference facilities and Internet access are also available. The hotel has rooms housed in the main building as well as bungalow-type rooms designed in an Ottoman architectural style. Each room comes fully-equipped as standard including a satellite TV, a minibar and a balcony or a terrace.

74474.description: Ideal for families with children, this modern furnished hotel consists of 4 buildings and is located on the beach of Belek-Boğazkent, 9 km from the town of Belek, famous for its golf courses. Covering 23, 000 m2, the complex features a spacious garden area and a 150m long private beach. Public transport and taxis are available from the hotel entrance providing easy access to nearby places of interest such as the old town and harbour at Antalya and the ancient cities of Perge and Aspendos. It is 50 km from the city centre and 40 km away from the Antalya International Airport. This hotel features spacious and cosy rooms with a mini bar, satellite TV, a work desk and bathroom amenities. The hotel also offers a compact facility which consists of different size of pools and Aqua Park.

74475.description: Hotel Crystal Admiral is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Manavgat. The property features a wide range of facilities to make your stay a pleasant experience. Gift/souvenir shop, 24-hour front desk, room service, babysitting, car hire are on the list of things guests can enjoy. Comfortable guestrooms ensure a good night's sleep with some rooms featuring facilities such as carpeting, sofa, whirlpool bathtub, air conditioning, heating. Entertain the hotel's recreational facilities, including bowling alley, dart board, water park, wind surfing, hot tub. A welcoming atmosphere and excellent service are what you can expect during your stay at Hotel Crystal Admiral.

74540.description: The Augustin, a newly renovated 4-star boutique hotel, welcomes international guests with modern comfort and charm. Its 47 spacious rooms offer a warm, contemporary atmosphere and all the expected amenities and communication tools. Enjoy a drink with friends or conduct business meetings in the inviting cocktail bar or lounge. In warmer weather, the garden terrace provides a tranquil escape. Guests can also maintain their fitness routines in the hotel's fitness room.

74541.description: Enjoy a central Brussels stay at the Zoom Hotel, steps from Avenue Louise and a short drive from the Royal Palace. Start your day with a continental breakfast (available for a fee) at our snack bar/deli, and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge after a busy day. Our 37 guestrooms feature espresso makers, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, while safes and desks add convenience.
