A 24-hour front desk and multilingual staff are available to assist you. We're just a short walk from attractions like the Law Courts of Brussels, Egmont Palace, and Place du Petit Sablon.

name.content: Arabian Park Dubai, an Edge by Rotana Hotel

74699.address: Al Jaddaf, Oud Metha Road, Bur Dubai
74699.description: Ideally situated, the hotel is a short drive from Dubai International Airport. It also offers quick access to the Dubai World Trade Centre. The property is just 20 minutes from the beach, while Wafi City is only five minutes away. The hotel can be described as extremely affordable, offering outstanding value for money to the business, corporate and leisure markets. The rooms available in the hotel fall into the following categories: Standard Rooms, Superior Balcony Rooms, AP Executive Room and AP Executive Balcony Rooms. All rooms are fully-equipped as standard including Internet access, a mini-fridge and tea/coffee making facilities. Individually adjustable air conditioning is also available as standard. The hotel offers luxurious health, leisure and spa facilities from Pyramids. There is also a well-equipped gymnasium and a swimming pool.

name.content: Campanile Paris Est - Porte De Bagnolet

74702.description: This 3 star hotel is located within the city of Paris and was established in 1992. It is a short drive away from the CHATELET/ST GERMAIN and the nearest station is Gallieni. The Hotel has a restaurant, a bar and a conference room. All 274 rooms are equipped with hairdryer.

name.content: The Originals City, Hôtel Paris Sud, Orly-Draveil

74703.description: Nestled in a residential area along the Seine River, this family-friendly airport hotel offers complimentary parking and convenient access to Orly Airport, just a 15-minute drive away. Juvisy RER station (lines C and D), a major transport hub, is a mere 5-minute walk from the hotel, providing easy connections throughout the Île-de-France region. Guests can reach Gare d'Austerlitz in 16 minutes, Lyon Station in 18 minutes, Chatelet les Halles in 22 minutes, Gare du Nord in 26 minutes, and Bibliothèque François Mitterrand in 15 minutes. The hotel offers 33 rooms equipped with en suite bathrooms, Wi-Fi, and modern amenities. Two restaurants and the expansive Port aux Cerises park, featuring scenic trails, lakes, and an equestrian club, are within a short 50-meter stroll.

74705.description: Situated in the southern part of the Cancuns hotel zone, one of the best touristic areas of the world, the elegant and contemporary style Seadust Cancun Family Resort enjoys an excellent location on one of the regions most beautiful beaches. The hotel features a fantastic water park with slides, castle towers and a huge pirate ship. Cancun International Airport can be reached within 15 minutes by car.

74767.description: The hotel Arethusa is a three star hotel, ideally located just next to Syntagma (Constitution) square and Plaka (old town of Athens) in Mitropoleos street, street of the Cathedral of Athens. The position of the hotel allows our customers easy access to the most important attractions of our city like Acropolis, Archeological museum, Cathedral, Town Hall, Temple of Zeus, Plaka and many more. It offers breakfast and air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi. Simply yet tastefully decorated, all units come with a TV and fridge. Each includes a private bathroom with hairdryer and bath or shower. An American breakfast buffet is served in the dining area of the Hotel Arethusa or in the guests' rooms. Drinks and snacks are provided at the bar until late in the evening. The roof garden has seating areas where guests can admire panoramic views of the Acropolis and the city of Athens.

74819.description: Enjoying an ideal location in the heart of Paris, at less than 3 km from the Arc de Triomphe and 4 km from the Eiffel Tower, this charming residence offers the best place for those seeking a comfortable and functional hotel close to the main attractions of the city. The property is situated in a district full of shops, restaurants and cafes as well as different choices of public transport. Charles de Gaulle and Orly Airport are both around a 30-minute drive away. Guests can choose between classic and modern rooms, all designed and nicely decorated to offer an enjoyable stay. The rooms are equipped with minibar and free Wi-Fi access for those who need to stay connected all the time. Every morning, guests can enjoy a delicious breakfast in the hotel's restaurant and taste French cuisine on the terrace which is open in the summer. There are also meeting facilities available for business travellers.

name.content: Four Seasons Astir Palace Hotel Athens

74843.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and an arcade/game room. Enjoy Greek cuisine at Pelagos, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 3 bars/lounges. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni? This hotel has 22809 square feet (2119 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 10 meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 303 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and espresso makers. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Rooms have private balconies.

74848.description: The ibis Budget Fresnes has 84 newly renovated rooms, equipped with modern and designer furnishings for every comfort. Each room includes a private bathroom and a free WiFi connection. The reception is open 24 hours. The ibis Budget Fresnes provides towels and shower gel. Also provided: two free parking spaces, one outside and another in the basement level of the hotel.

74863.description: The hotel is located just 5 min from the Stade de France and 20 min from the business district of La Défense and the Villepinte and Bourget exhibition centres, allowing guests to fulfil their professional needs whilst enjoying some peace and quiet in a green setting on the outskirts of Paris. The hotel is situated in the city of Villeneuve la Garenne, near Paris. The centre of Villeneuve la Garenne is just 1 km away. The nearest train station is 1. 5 km away, and the closest bus stop 500 m, from the hotel. The international airport at Roissy is 23 km away, 25 min' drive, and Orly is approximately 33 km from the hotel, 39 min' drive. Renovated, this hotel comprises a total of 59 rooms. Facilities on offer include an entrance hall, a bar, a restaurant, public Internet access, a WLAN access point and parking for those arriving by car. Each room comes with an en suite bathroom with bathtub, toilet and hairdryer. In addition, they are equipped with an electric kettle for tea or coffee, a cable/ satellite TV and free WIFI access. Breakfast is served in the form of a buffet. Lunch and dinner can be taken as a set menu or à la carte. Starters and desserts are served in the form of a buffet. From the town centre (Villeneuve la Garenne): Follow directions to the swimming pool or Parc des Chantereines. From Paris: take the subway (line 13 to Saint-Denis Université) and get out at Mairie de Saint-Ouen. Then take bus 137 towards zone industrielle du Nord and get out at St Exupéry.

74866.description: The well-being of guests is top of mind at Choice-branded hotels. Guests may experience a variety of new, improved cleanliness protocols and products. Professional service, cozy accommodations and a delicious breakfast await at our hotel in Ivry Sur Seine, FR. Amenities include free WiFi, a full breakfast buffet for a small fee, free weekday newspapers, a 24-hour receptionist and copy, print and fax services. Guest rooms feature work desks, flat-screen TVs and courtesy tray. Hotel amenities and the location of our Comfort Hotel Paris Porte D Ivry makes it a great option for vacationing tourists and business travelers alike. Enjoy easy access to destinations like the Paris City Centre, AccorHotels Arena, Paris Zoological Park, Chateau de Vincennes and the Bibliotheque Francois Mitterrand. Complete your plans for your getaway by booking a guest room at our hotel in Ivry Sur Seine, FR. When you stay with us, you can also earn rewards, including free nights and gift cards, with our Choice Privileges Rewards program.

74903.description: This centrally located Madrid hotel is just steps from Gran Via, Puerta del Sol, and Callao Square. Other attractions, including Plaza Mayor, are also easily accessible. The hotel's prime location puts you within walking distance of Madrid’s shopping district and just meters from several metro stations, allowing effortless exploration of the city.

74979.description: The AC Hotel Porto by Marriott, located in Porto's Campanhã district, is steps from Alameda Shopping and a short walk from Dragao Stadium. This upscale hotel offers 128 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms. Guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant, snacks at the coffee shop, or drinks at the bar/lounge. A fitness center, business center, and concierge services are also available. For those planning events, the hotel offers meeting and conference space. Nearby attractions include Porto Cathedral and Ribeira Square, both a short drive away.

75000.description: This upscale hotel boasts a superb setting in the city centre of Barcelona. The hotel is located close to the Paseo de Gracia. The station is situated just a short distance away, offering ease of access to other areas of the city to be explored. Guests will find themselves surrounded by ample opportunities to explore the rich culture, artistic splendour and history of the city. The hotel features stunningly-designed guest rooms, which offer peace, tranquillity and convenience. The hotel features a delightful restaurant, as well as a charming bar. A conference room is available for the convenience of business travellers. “La seguridad de nuestros clientes es lo primero y de acuerdo a la actual legislación sanitaria y de forma temporal el servicio de desayunos puede sufrir cambios en cuanto a su horario, disposición y producto. ”“The safety of our customers is our priority and so in accordance with local health legislation, the breakfast service may have temporary changes (opening hours, products on offer, layout and service). ”

75003.description: Located in Milan's Porta Garibaldi district, the upscale AC Hotel Milano by Marriott is within a 10-minute walk of Corso Como and Piazza Gae Aulenti. This hotel is 2 miles from Piazza del Duomo and 3. 2 miles from the Cathedral of Milan. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. The hotel also offers wedding services and a television in the common area. The 158 individually furnished guestrooms feature minibars, espresso makers, down comforters, premium bedding, and 43-inch flat-screen televisions with satellite programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and bidets. The AC Hotel Milano restaurant specializes in Italian cuisine for lunch and dinner. Guests can also enjoy 24-hour room service or a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. The hotel offers 3014 square feet of event space, including a conference center and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

75006.description: The LCB Fuenlabrada Hotel is located in the town center, very close to the Town Hall and Fernando Martín Sports Centre. This modern, recently built hotel offers easy access from Madrid via the A-42 to Toledo and the M-50. It's also conveniently located near the Warner Bros. Park and a train station with service to Madrid.

75008.description: This 3 star hotel is located Located in the heart of Bagnolet, this hotel is within 3 mi (5 km) of Grands Boulevards, Parc des Buttes Chaumont, and Place des Vosges. Opera Bastille and Picasso Museum are also within 3 mi (5 km). Croix de Chavaux Station and Gallieni Station are within a 5-minute walk. This property is also rated for the best value in Bagnolet! Guests are getting more for their money when compared to other properties in this city. Please note a 90 EUR deposit will be required upon arrival (credit card only).

75045.description: The ideal location of the hotel enables guests to easily reach the archaeological sites, historical buildings, museums and cathedrals. The beach is around 200 m away and there is a bus stop just 100 m from the establishment. Glyfada Square, with its modern shopping venues and lively taverns, is within walking distance of the property. The hotel offers a choice of luxurious, modern and spacious rooms with inviting balconies, from which guests have a view of either the Saronic Gulf or of the mountains. They are comfortably furnished and make for a pleasant and calm stay. All come with double-glazed windows and feature high speed Internet access and a writing desk.

75046.description: Nestled in Glyfada, this elegant hotel offers a perfect point of departure to explore the archaeological sites, historical buildings, museums and cathedrals. The beach is around 50 m away and Glyfada Square, with its modern shopping and sports venues, its lively Greek taverns, harbours and exciting nightlife, is just a few paces away. Glyfada itself is around 15 km from the centre of Athens. The hotel offers a choice of opulent, modern and ample rooms with inviting balconies, from which guests have a view of either the Saronic Gulf or of the mountains. The air-conditioned and soundproofed units are cosily furnished and make for a pleasant and comfortable stay. The hotel has its own swimming pool and the nearest 18-hole golf course is just 1 km away. The elegant restaurant serves a lavish continental, English and American buffet-style breakfast and visitors may also enjoy the choice of Greek or international dishes and wide selection of finest Greek wines.

75080.description: Located in the heart of Cancun, City Express by Marriott offers convenient access to Plaza Las Americas and Plaza 28. This hotel provides a comfortable stay with 128 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring an LED TV, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a private bathroom. Guests can enjoy a complimentary full breakfast, take a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, work out at the fitness center, or relax on the private beach. Additional amenities include a business center, dry cleaning services, and free self-parking.

75132.description: The hostel is located on Edinburgh's historic Royal Mile, just a few minutes' walk from Waverley railway station and the airport link bus stop. This specially designed complex offers secure furnishings for women, as well as quiet peaceful rooms upon request. The hostel has a high level of security with electronic key cards and a 24-hour concierge service. Further facilities include a luggage storage, hotel safes and a bike cellar. Guests can relax, meet friends and have a drink in the stylish Bar 50. All rooms come fully-equipped as standard featuring a private bathroom and all the amenities world travellers and backpackers need. Guests can select their breakfast, lunch and dinner from a buffet. Lunch and dinner can be chosen either from a set menu or selected à la carte.

75202.description: The hotel enjoys a central location in historic surroundings, between the Royal Palace on Dam Square and the famous Westerkerk. It is situated within walking distance of all the city's main tourist attractions, museums and shopping districts. There is a wide range of restaurants and bars within a radius of 200 m. In addition, the train station is 1 km from the hotel. Amsterdam International Airport is approximately 12 km from the hotel premises. The hotel comprises a total of 45 rooms, 4 of which are junior suites. Facilities on offer include an entrance hall with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe and a bar. Internet access is also available. Each of the modern rooms comes fully-equipped as standard featuring an en suite bathroom, a TV and a room safe. Some rooms feature a small balcony with a canal view.

75206.description:
Icon BCN by Petit Palace is a boutique hotel in the very centre of Barcelona, just off Gran Via de les Corts Catalanes and a 2-minute walk from Passeig de Gràcia, home to the city's most exclusive shops and to Gaudí's landmark buildings. Plaça de Catalunya is 5 minutes away on foot, the Gothic Quarter and the Palau de la Música Catalana 7 minutes, and La Pedrera 750 metres. La Rambla and the Boqueria market are a short stroll away, and Ciutadella Park is a 15-minute walk. Urquinaona and Passeig de Gràcia Metro stations are both less than 5 minutes away. 

The hotel is known for its striking post-modern interior design. Rooms feature modern décor, a flat-screen TV and a shower, with free WiFi throughout the property. 

A buffet breakfast is included every morning, with healthy choices and a variety of hot and cold dishes. The hotel also has a bar and a restaurant serving Mediterranean cuisine, and the reception desk is open 24 hours. Free bicycles are the best way to explore the city at your own pace. With its central location and its distinctive design, Icon BCN by Petit Palace is an ideal base for discovering Barcelona on foot.

75220.description: This apartment complex is ideally situated in the centre of the Gothic district of Barcelona. The hotel is located close to many of the city's most renowned attractions. Guests will find themselves within easy walking distance of Las Ramblas, the cathedral, the Picasso Museum, Santa Caterina Market and the food market of La Boqueria. The harbour is located just a short distance away. The sandy beach of Barceloneta can be found 500 metres from the property. The complex is conveniently situated just 20 km away from the airport. This wonderful apartment complex enjoys a period design. The apartments enjoy tasteful decor and a relaxing ambiance. Guests will be pleased by the excellent service that the complex has to offer. TWO OPTIONS FOR CHECK-IN: Customers can choose two options for check in: CHECK ONLINE OR PRESENTIAL CHECK-IN.

75226.description: This city apartment complex is located in the gothic district at the heart of Barcelona, full of narrow, winding streets. It is in the middle of the old town, which contains a considerable number of Barcelona's most famous attractions and is renowned for its great variety of charming restaurants, offering quality tapas, Mediterranean cuisine, and the best seafood in town. There are also plenty of bars with terraces, which lend El Born its modern, artistic and cosmopolitan atmosphere. Just a few streets away there are galleries, artist's studios, designer shops and museums. The hotel itself is located just a short walk from Barcelona Cathedral. The closest metro station is Jaume I, which is only 5 minutes away. Within 500 m of the hotel guests will also find Estación del Norte bus station and Estación de Francia railway station, as well as Barceloneta beach, Las Ramblas, shopping options at the Corte Ingles, the city's port and the Picasso Museum. The ski resort of La Molina is just 2 hours away by car and Barcelona International Airport is approximately 20 km from the hotel. These five classic studios for one or two people are in a beautiful apartment building. Facilities include a 24-hour reception desk, lift access, a WLAN access point and, for a small additional fee, cycle hire. Five studios with private lift make this modern building the place to be in while in Barcelona. The studios are tastefully decorated in classic style. Guests are offered the choice between either a double bed or two singles, and each apartment comes with a fully equipped kitchen. No detail is missing in these studios, which come with satellite TV, individually adjustable heating and air conditioning, and a beautiful en suite marble bathroom with a shower. All studios have a private lift. Internet access, a mini fridge, tea and coffee-making facilities and either a balcony or a terrace come as standard.

75339.description: The hotel comprises a total of 38 snug guest rooms. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. Caballero Errante offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. Caballero Errante may charge a fee for some services.

75382.description: Perfectly located on Kensington Gardens Square, this hotel is set amidst elegant surroundings in London. The hotel is located just off Queensway, where guests will find a multitude of boutiques and restaurants. Whiteleys shopping complex is just a few minutes' walking distance away. Guests will find themselves within easy access of Oxford Street, Kensington Stores and the famous Portobello Market. This charming property has been beautifully restored to showcase its original, Victorian splendour. Stylish, comfortable guest rooms invite visitors into a world of calm and serenity. This property is a great choice for business and leisure travellers alike.

75399.description: Located in Cancun's Hotel Zone, the all-inclusive, adults-only Hyatt Zilara Cancun offers luxurious accommodations just a short drive from Forum By The Sea Mall and La Isla Shopping Mall. This property boasts two outdoor swimming pools, a full-service spa with massages and body treatments, a health club, sauna, and six restaurants, including La Adelita Cantina serving Mexican cuisine. The 307 guestrooms feature private furnished balconies or patios, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, free minibar items, LED televisions with cable, and private bathrooms with jetted bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Additional amenities include 24-hour room service, a coffee shop, multiple bars and lounges, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, a 24-hour business center, and free valet parking. The property also offers extensive meeting and event space.

75460.description: Ocean Serviced Apartments are in Edinburgh, offering spacious apartments for a comfortable stay including free parking and fast Wi-Fi. The Royal Yacht Britannia, cinema and restaurants of the Ocean Terminal complex is in the area along with a 24Hour supermarket. The bustling city centre with the famous Edinburgh Castle can be reached by bus and the tram which is located close by to us. Each apartment has two bedrooms which has two bathrooms consisting of one family bathroom with a bath and one ensuite shower room. The large living rooms have digital TVs and comfortable sofas. The fully equipped kitchens have ovens, fridges, dishwashers and a washing machine in the apartment. SELF CHECK-IN: Reception is open daily from 09:00 to 17:00, an emergency contact number is available for urgent matters after hours. Property operating on a self-check in basis. To arrange self-check in, guest needs to send a copy of valid driving license/passport or ID to stay@oceanservicedapts. com and to complete the pre-authorisation security deposit of £100 which will be sent via email. All requirements must be completed in advance. Check – in starts from 16:00, and check-in instructions will be only sent once both requirements are completed. Check out time is by 10:00 GROUP BOOKINGS POLICY: Ocean Apartments has a NO GROUP policy. We do not accept certain groups to stay such as single sex parties as well as hen/stag groups, and we reserve the right not to accept bookings with an EH postcode. All guests who made a reservation for 5 or more adults, need contact reception to confirm the nature of their group booking. If the nature of your stay is not confirmed, the deposit may increase up to £200/£300 per apartment. HOUSE RULES: no smoking allowed, no parties/events allowed, no pets allowed. OCEAN SERVICED APARTMENTS CONTACT: Tel: 0131 553 7394; Email: stay@oceanservicedapts. com; Emergency Tel: 07751764649

75479.description: Built in 1931, the Hotel Edison is an Art Deco-inspired gem in the heart of Times Square. Experience the center of the action with Broadway theaters, Restaurant Row, Rockefeller Center, and Radio City Music Hall all within walking distance. The hotel is also in the hub of the business district, steps away from Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, Viacom, Disney, MTV, Barclays, Ernst & Young, and Thomson Reuters, and 8 miles from LaGuardia Airport. Breakfast vouchers (for coffee and French pastries) for up to two people are included when the resort/amenity fee is paid upon arrival.

75499.description: The AC Hotel Madrid Feria by Marriott, located in Madrid's Hortaleza district, offers convenient access to IFEMA, the Juan Carlos I Park, and the Real Madrid City stadium, all within a 15-minute drive. This modern hotel features 154 guestrooms equipped with plasma televisions and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast for a fee, dine at the on-site restaurant, and unwind at the bar/lounge. A 24-hour fitness center, banquet hall, and conference spaces are also available. Self-parking is provided for a charge. Dry cleaning, laundry services, and multilingual staff ensure a comfortable and convenient stay.

75579.address: Saray Mah. Guzel Yali Cad. Bebek Sok., 5 1
75579.description: Set right on the edge of Alanya's famous Kleopatra Beach, this low-key city hotel provides a great base for a seaside holiday. Guests will find a variety of shops, restaurants and bars all along the seaside promenade that runs along the beach and right in front of the hotel. Alanya's famous castle is a ten-minute drive from the hotel, and the old town and celebrated Red Tower are within walking distance. The simply furnished rooms include air-conditioning, a minibar, satellite television and an en suite bathroom, and the hotel offers lift access for added convenience. Guests might choose to dine in the onsite restaurant and bar, which opens out onto the street, and can make use of complimentary wireless internet access throughout the establishment.

75580.description: This hotel is located in the Titreyengol area, 8km from the centre of Side with its shopping and entertainment possibilities. This modern hotel is in the vicinity of popular city attractions such as Field of Ruins, Theatre, Agora Museum. Close to a small lake and beside a river with the Sorgun forest close by there is plenty of natural beauty in the vicinity. Local transport and taxis run frequently from the front of the hotel.

75799.description: Centrally located in Paris, Hotel Convention Montparnasse offers convenient access to Paris Expo and Le Bon Marche, both within a 5-minute drive. This hotel provides 37 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a buffet breakfast (fee applies), concierge services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include the Eiffel Tower (2 mi) and Luxembourg Gardens (2. 3 mi). The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

75803.description: This apartment complex located in Val d'Europe is within a 5-minute drive from Disneyland Resort Paris, which is also accessible by public transport. This sophisticated residence offers air-conditioned studios with equipped kitchenette, TV, free Wi-Fi access and a private bathroom. Guests will find a variety of leisure, entertainment options and shopping centres in this new area. The capital is easily reachable with the RER train station, located very close to the complex. It is a 30-minute drive from Paris. These apartments offer guests a peaceful and relaxed atmosphere ideal for families with children and groups of friends.

75804.description: Enjoy furnished and equipped apartments like at home just 10 minutes away from the Disney Parks: living room with sleeping area, office area, dining area, equipped kitchenette and bathroom. Some studios have a balcony. The reception is open 24 hours a day. Check-outs are before 11:00 a. m. and check-ins start from 4:00 p. m. A credit card pre-authorization will be required upon arrival. For a check-in outside these hours, please contact us. Facilities:* 4 floors with elevator* Some apartments can accommodate people with reduced mobility* Heated outdoor swimming pool open from June to September* Breakfast room (continental)* Shuttle service to the Disney Parks* Luggage storage* Free covered or outdoor parking (subject to availability)* 2 seminar rooms.

76179.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including a sauna and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy French cuisine at Le Restaurant & Terrace, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Paris? This hotel has 6017 square feet (559 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 192 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and flat-screen televisions.

76270.description: Located in Madrid's bustling commercial and business district, this hotel sits near Plaza de Cuzco, Paseo de la Castellana, and the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium. Chamartín station and the city center are easily accessible, and Madrid-Barajas Airport is only 7 km away. The hotel offers 124 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a TV, double bed, safe, internet access, telephone, and a bathroom with a hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a snack bar, breakfast room, meeting room, and on-site parking. A 24-hour reception, internet access point, and laundry services are also available. A complimentary bottle of water is provided to all guests.

76399.description: This luxurious hotel boasts a stunning setting in Istanbul, sitting on the banks of the Bosphorus Strait. Sitting close to the Imperial Mosque, in the neighbourhood of Ortakoy, this hotel is sure to impress. It offers guests close proximity to a treasure trove of attractions, including the Yildiz Park, Bosphorus Bridge and Dolmabahce Palace. Ataturk and Sabiha Gokcen international airport are within easy driving distance of the hotel. This magnificent hotel allures visitors with the promise of unrivalled luxury and style. The elegantly appointed guest rooms that are fully equipped to offer the sublime comfort and relaxation for short stays offer visitors a truly magical experience, immersed in comfort and style. Standard and Superior Rooms have city view; Premium Rooms have partial sea view; Junior Suite and Suite Rooms have sea view. The hotel offers guests a range of facilities and services. Guests can enjoy a vigorous workout in the fitness centre, followed by indulgent treatments in the full-service spa. Historic attractions and local shopping venues makes this the ideal traveller's choice stay.

76400.description: The complex is located within 800m of a long, sandy beach to the west of Side village which is 2km away and where guests will find a great museum, amphitheater and the Temple of Apollo, as well as a lot of shops and restaurants. Public transport is available less than 200m from the complex. Refurbished, this apart hotel consists of 150 apartments and studios located in a main building and an annex. Occupying 6, 000sqm, there is a spacious garden and large outdoor pool. Other amenities include a restaurant and snack bar, a mini market, game and TV room and 24hr reception service. The studios and apartments are simply furnished and equipped with a kitchenette suitable for making light meals/snacks, air-conditioning and hire safe box.

76543.description: This apartment is situated in a desirable residential area in the centre of Barcelona between the Eixample and the old town. It is the perfect tranquil location to stay and enjoy the various attractions found in the centre of the city. The apartment is only a short walk from Placa Catalunya, Las Ramblas and Gaudi's tourist attractions such as La Pedrera and Casa Batlló. The elegant, comfortable and spacious apartment is set in a neoclassical building. It comprises several spacious bedrooms, and each room has its own bathroom inside. The apartment is fully air-conditioned and there is a lift as well as Internet access. The rooms are comfortable and quiet allowing guests to relax. Each bedroom comes with its own individually adjustable air conditioning and heating and has an en suite bathroom. The beds are spacious: single beds are 1. 35 m wide whilst double beds are 1. 5 m wide. All the rooms are bright and have windows with views either of calle Muntaner, one of the most outstanding streets in the city, or of the quiet inner patio which is characteristic of the architecture in the Eixample area. There is a kitchen equipped with all the necessary utensils for cooking as well as a washing machine so guests feel at home. Here guests can also get tea, coffee or a cool drink, which can be prepared at any time without additional cost. The living room is spacious and comes with satellite/cable TV and a DVD player. The apartment is decorated predominantly in white giving it a feeling of cleanliness, order and comfort. There are many pieces of baroque furniture such as small tables, armchairs and chest of drawers which give the apartment its own style and own personality. TWO OPTIONS FOR CHECK-IN: Customers can choose two options for check in: CHECK ONLINE OR PRESENTIAL CHECK-IN.

76548.description: This hotel enjoys a central location just 350 meters from Barcelona's Plaza Universitat and a short 5-minute walk from the Ramblas. Nestled between the vibrant Sant Antoni, El Raval, and Gothic Quarter neighborhoods, it offers easy access to the city's historic center and a wealth of leisure, cultural, and dining options. This makes it the perfect base for exploring this chic and cosmopolitan city. Renovated in 2013, the hotel boasts a vintage yet modern and cozy atmosphere. Guests can enjoy the convenience of a minimarket at the reception and relax in a common room with a sofa and TV. The hotel's 42 simple yet well-equipped rooms provide everything needed for a pleasant stay. Please note that special conditions and supplements may apply for bookings of more than five rooms. Guests under 18 years old must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.

76703.description: Renovated in 2017, with a cozy, stylish feel, our boutique hotel of 53 rooms has all the facilities and services you need to make your business trips or vacations a success. Relax or work with ease thanks to our free WIFI: this is how we offer welcoming accommodation.

76718.description: Located in the historic and artistic centre of Venice, but in a very calm area, the hotel enjoys an ideal location. It is situated not far from Rialto bridge and St Mark's square, just 5 minutes' walking distance from Piazzale Roma (the airport bus terminal, parking area and waterbus terminal) and just 5 minutes walking distance from the railway station. Marco Polo International Airport is just around 15 km away, while Treviso San Angelo Airport is approximately 40 km from the hotel. Originally built in 1700 and renovated in 2000, this historic hotel comprises a total of 30 rooms. The warm and friendly atmosphere, combined with the building's rich history and precious Venetians artefacts, will make every guest's stay an unforgettable one. Facilities on offer include an entrance hall with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe. All accommodation is equipped with a direct dial telephone, air conditioning, a safe and TV. An en suite bathroom with hairdryer, double bed and central heating also come as standard. The hotel rooms look out over the Rio Marin, a typical Venetian Canal known as the ''canal of the gondola's serenade''. From Marco Polo airport take bus number 5 to Piazzale Roma, 4 minutes' walk from the hotel. From St Lucia railway station cross the big bridge over the Grand Canal and take the road ahead, then go towards 'Rio Marin' for just 3 minutes.

76721.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this charming Venice hotel, and take advantage of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi. A concierge service, gift shop, and wedding services are also available. Dine at the snack bar or enjoy room service. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are served daily (7:00 AM to 10:00 AM) for a fee. The hotel also offers express check-in, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Each of the 22 individually decorated guestrooms features a minibar, LCD television, and digital programming. Private bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and bidets. Safes, desks, and phones are also provided. Ca' Nigra Lagoon Resort is located in the heart of Venice, a short walk from Piazzale Roma and the Grand Canal.

76722.description: The 3-star Antica Casa Carettoni is situated in an enviable location on the pedestrianised Lista di Spagna, often thought of as the Gateway to Venice. Just a few minutes' walk from the train station of Santa Lucia and the transport hub of Piazzale Roma, access to the airport and access to Venice's major tourist landmarks is equally convenient. The Grand Canal and its vaporetto stops (waterbus) is just a few steps away meaning getting around this unique city couldn't be easier. This bijou property offers 16 air-conditioned and contemporarily decorated guestrooms, all of which are equipped with hairdryer, TV, safety deposit box, private bath/shower and refrigerated mini-bar. Considering the hotel lies in the heart of the Cannaregio quarter of Venice, cultural and historical attractions such as the Ghetto, are literally on the doorstep. Complementing the hubbub of restaurants, bars and pizzerias, Cannaregio's quieter quarters are often considered as the true Venice - truly magical and inspirational. Guests should note that local city tax is not included in the rate booked. This will be charged directly to guests by the hotel and payable at check in/out.

76723.description: Enjoy garden views at Hotel Atlantide, centrally located in Venice, a short walk from Piazzale Roma. The hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and express check-in/check-out. Each of the 22 air-conditioned guestrooms features a private bathroom with a shower, bidet, and hairdryer, along with a safe, desk, and phone. Digital programming is also available for your entertainment. Nearby attractions include the Scalzi Bridge, Venetian Ghetto, and the Grand Canal. The preferred airport is Marco Polo Airport (VCE).

76962.description: The Thon Hotel Brussels City Centre is situated in a lively area in the heart of Brussels, just a 10-minute stroll from the Grand-Place and the cultural centre via the pedestrianized Rue Neuve, brimming with shops and cafes. This major 4-star hotel offers a unique relaxation centre on the top floor, complete with a fitness room and sauna boasting panoramic views from the 29th floor. The hotel also features 13 meeting rooms of varying sizes, all fully air-conditioned and equipped with modern AV equipment. Guests can unwind in the contemporary O Bar and enjoy the daily breakfast buffet. Its central location also provides convenient access to businesses such as Euroclear, the World Customs Organization, and BNP Paribas.

77060.description: Modern, avant-garde and cosmopolitan, HTL Urbano Buenos Aires Hotel is a living example of what the Argentine capital has always been. We present a new concept of Hotel in Buenos Aires:Strategically located in the heart of downtown Buenos Aires, steps from the main tourist attractions of the city and with unbeatable connectivity to all areas of it, HTL Urbano Buenos Aires Hotel is the best alternative for your Business or Pleasure trip in Buenos Aires. Its minimalist style, modern technology and personalized service impose its personality, making it an exclusive Hotel in Buenos Aires with a marked modern and elegant character. At the HTL Urbano Buenos Aires Hotel our slogan is to achieve your satisfaction and our highest honor is to be able to serve you.

77062.description: This hotel with a very elegant lobby enjoys a great location in the centre of the Argentinian capital. It is ideal both for leisure and business travellers, as it also features a meeting room and a business centre. The hotel is just 300 m from the Obelisk, 50 m from the Avenida 9 de Julio, the widest avenue of the world, and 100 m from Avenida de Mayo. Calle Florida, the main commercial centre, is within walking distance.

77063.description: Boasting a unique location in the heart of the upscale Recoleta district, this exclusive and refined establishment has something different to offer and delight its guests. Its prime situation just a few steps from many exclusive boutiques and excellent restaurants makes this hotel the perfect choice for travellers wishing to enjoy a day of intense shopping. Guests will find some of the most important tourist attractions in the surrounding area while Jorge Newbery International Airport is just a short driving distance. The tastefully decorated guest rooms feature a wide choice of modern amenities and combine classic elements with designer touches. They also include a fully-equipped marble room offering a choice of VIP toiletries. As for the onsite services, business travellers may appreciate the wireless high-speed Internet connection available for travellers' convenience.

77064.description: This boutique hotel boasts an exciting setting at the heart of Buenos Aires. The hotel sits just a few metres away from the Obelisco. The Recoleta Area is just a short distance away. The world famous Teatro Colon Opera House, as well as the theatre district, can be found just a short walking distance away. Jorge Newbery Airport is just 5 km away. The hotel is conveniently situated just 25 km from Ministro Pistarini International Airport. This city hotel offers visitors the highest standards of personalised service. Appealing to business and leisure travellers alike, the hotel is sure to impress. The hotel is decorated with classical-French style antiques. The guest rooms and suites are superbly appointed, oozing classical style and charm. Guests are invited to enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings.

77066.description: This stunning establishment boasts a privileged location in the centre of Buenos Aires, in the Recoleta district, an area of great historical and architectural interest. Travellers fill find some of main tourist sights of the city close to the property, as well as business, shopping and entertainment venues. Ezeiza International Airport is just a 30-minute drive from the property. This boutique hotel boasts a unique style based on service excellence, refined elegance and opulent décor. The guest rooms have been finely appointed with luxurious bedding and totally designed with exclusive furniture. Every detail of its interior exudes luxury and all the rooms come with top quality services and amenities to guarantee a truly unforgettable stay, such as air conditioning and a spacious private bathroom. The fine cuisine served in the restaurant, based in local and international specialities, is the best option to enjoy Argentina's gastronomy.

77068.description: Enjoy a privileged location in the heart of Buenos Aires' commercial and cultural center. Situated on Corrientes Avenue, just steps from the subway, our hotel offers easy access to the entire city. Explore nearby cinemas, theaters, and shopping malls, or venture to the fashionable Recoleta and Puerto Madero districts, both within a 5-minute reach. This hotel provides 72 well-appointed rooms for both leisure and business travelers. Each room features a private bathroom, hairdryer, telephone, satellite TV, internet access, and air conditioning, ensuring a comfortable stay with city views. Benefit from our 24-hour staff availability, two elegant meeting rooms, and two fully-equipped business centers.

77069.description: Located in the upscale Recoleta district, this elegant hotel is a short walk from iconic Buenos Aires landmarks like the Colon Theatre and the renowned Opera house. Francia Park and various museums are also nearby. A rooftop deck and bar provide the perfect setting for socializing, while comfortable, elegant rooms feature modern amenities and soundproof windows for a peaceful night's sleep. Guests can also enjoy the sauna, solarium, and a well-equipped gym.

77071.description: The Americas Towers Hotel, established in 2001, offers 96 rooms across nine floors. Located in the Recoleta neighborhood, it caters to both business and leisure travelers. All rooms feature magnetic locks, security safes, individual air conditioning, cable TV, free Wi-Fi, minibars, and desks. The hotel also boasts a lobby bar and an outdoor pool.

77072.description: The Cyan Hotel de las Americas, a 4-star establishment, is ideally situated in the heart of Buenos Aires' sophisticated Recoleta district. Key attractions such as the Obelisco and the city center are within easy walking distance. The hotel offers spacious rooms, catering to both leisure and business travelers, and each features a 32' LED TV, complimentary Wi-Fi, a desk, a bathtub, and an in-room safe. Guests can enjoy a full American buffet breakfast, including scrambled eggs, cereals, pastries, fresh fruit, and juices. The hotel restaurant offers a diverse international menu for lunch and dinner, with snacks also available. After a busy day exploring the city, the lobby bar provides the perfect setting to unwind with drinks and cocktails. For corporate or social events, the Cyan Hotel de las Americas offers versatile meeting and convention spaces, including a dedicated meeting room for business gatherings. High-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, and on-site parking is provided for an additional fee.

77073.description: Boasting a privileged location in the charming Recoleta district, a downtown residential neighbourhood in Buenos Aires, this stylish complex is close to local attractions such as Recoleta Cultural Centre (exhibition and cultural events centre) and the Museum of Fine Arts. Tastefully furnished, this stunning hotel has been designed with guests' comfort in mind. The fine décor is complemented by the wooden flooring, creating a warm ambience where travellers will fell right at home. All the studios include a fully-equipped kitchen and individual air conditioning. Guests will appreciate the spacious cosy sitting area where they will relax after a busy day spent exploring this vibrant city. An outdoor swimming pool is featured on-site and is surrounded by sun loungers where guests might top up their tan whilst reading a great book.

name.content: Ramada by Wyndham Buenos Aires Centro

77077.description: Join us for an inviting stay at Ramada by Wyndham Buenos Aires Centro, located off Avenida 9 de Julio in the heart of the city. Close to major businesses and dining options, our contemporary hotel is minutes from the subway, railway, and ferry, and just 7 kilometers from Jorge Newbery Airport. Enjoy the highend shopping of Florida Street and the famed Galerias Pacifico, or visit nearby sights like Plaza de Mayo, Teatro Colon, and Puerto Madero. After a busy day, relax in our comfortable hotel with free WiFi and rooftop pool.

77080.description:
This city hotel is situated at the main entrance to the world famous Puerto Madero with its attractive promenade lined with old walls, refurbished cranes and docks, marina and yacht clubs, modern buildings and an exquisite restaurant strip. The hotel is just a few blocks away from the main banks, financial district, and government and corporate buildings. It is also within walking distance of the amazing Florida Street, Santa Fe fashion district, Plaza San Martin, La Recoleta (design and bohemia) and 9 de Julio Avenue. The hotel's strategic location is ideal for accessing residential areas, San Telmo (tango and antiques zone) and motorways which connect directly to industrial and suburban areas in Greater Buenos Aires. The international airport is also easily accessible from the hotel.

The hotel was built by architect Bottazzini and inaugurated on May 25, 1985 Emerald Tower, by the architect Sanchez Elia in 2000 Viamonte Tower and renovation in 2007. Its name comes from the colonial era, as in this place where the cars, not travelers spend some nights. The fully air-conditioned hotel comprises a total of 90 spacious and comfortable rooms in two towers, Torre Ceibo y Torre Ombú. Along with a wide range of services in a warm atmosphere. Facilities include: lobby with 24-hour reception, maid service.

The rooms have air conditioning, DDI / DDN, cable TV, digital safe, Internet access and Wi-Fi, desk, mini bar and electricity 100/220W.
The bathrooms are equipped with hot tub, hair dryer and outstanding amenities.


The hotel has an indoor heated pool and a gym. 


The interior of the hotel's restaurant offers international dishes. Breakfast is offered

77081.description: In the heart of Buenos Aires, a few minutes from the main tourist attractions and shopping venues. Comfortable facilities make this hotel a practical and elegant option for business or leisure travels. In the lobby, there are the 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, cloakroom and lift access. Guest services include city tours, Internet access, meeting rooms, a restaurant, room service, shopping tours, honeymoon suites, and transfers to and from the city airports. Guests may also relax in the cafe or bar and take advantage of the laundry service and a bicycle hire service (fees apply).

name.content: Pestana Buenos Aires City Centre & SPA Hotel

77082.description: Pestana Buenos Aires Hotel is located in the heart of the city on the 9 de Julio Avenue steps from Teatro Colon and major business and financial centers in South America. It is one of the best hotels in Argentina for business. With an indoor swimming pool, a sauna room and luxurious décor, the Pestana offers rooms with free Internet access just an 8-block walk from Florida Street. Gym facilities and massage sessions are available.

77083.address: Fray Justo Santa Maria De Oro 2747
77083.description: Located 200 metres from Santa Fe Avenue and 300 metres from Libertador Avenue, Hotel Cristoforo Colombo features a seasonal swimming pool and a fitness centre overlooking the Palermo Woods. Free Wi-Fi and breakfast are provided. It is located in the heart of Palermo, only 100 metres from La Rural Convention Centre and 200 metres from the US Embassy. Decorated in sober colours, rooms at Cristoforo Colombo have wooden wardrobes and floors. They feature seating areas and minibars. A buffet breakfast including pastries and fresh fruits is served. Puerto de Palos Restaurant offers traditional local dishes. Drinks and snacks can be enjoyed at Timón Bar. Guest can relax on the sun loungers by the pool, or make use of the fitness centre, sauna and spa bath facilities. Massage sessions can also be requested. Palermo is a great choice for travellers interested in nightlife, great for wine and restaurants.

77084.description: Experience a new concept in hospitality at Hotel Madero, WorldHotels Elite, located in Buenos Aires' modern Puerto Madero district. Just five minutes from the city center and close to both domestic and international airports, our hotel offers convenient access to major tourist attractions and the ecological reserve. Each of our 197 spacious rooms features innovative style and design, ideal for business or leisure travelers.

77085.description: The city hotel is located in one of Buenos Aires' most active and elegant districts, just steps from the Florida Street and Santa Fe avenue, surrounded by a beautiful natural environment. This exceptional location near San Martin square, allows for easy access to commercial areas, restaurants and theatres. An excellent location, coupled with great service: In the lobby, there is the 24 hour reception, laundry and dry cleaning, hotel safe, tourism information desk, a bar and restaurant, business centre, WIFI in the entire hotel, 24 hour room service and medical assistance.

77086.description: Located in the Recoleta district, the most fashionable area of Buenos Aires, this charming establishment boasts a unique location close to the most prestigious cultural and entertainment venues of this vibrant city. Ezeiza International Airport is some 33 kilometres from this eco-friendly establishment. It exudes the charm, warmth and comfort that clients expect today. The comfortable guest rooms are spacious and bright, offering a traditional yet contemporary décor that everyone will enjoy. They all come with complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection and thermal acoustic isolated windows for guests' convenience. Business travellers may appreciate the on-site meeting rooms featuring state-of-the-art equipment, ideal for all types of meetings, seminars and conferences. As for the rest of facilities, guests arriving in their own car will find a private parking at their disposal.

77088.description: Located on 9th of July Avenue, in the very heart of Buenos Aires, just metres away from the city's iconic Obelisk, this hotel allows for quick and easy access to the financial district and the main touristic areas. The hotel has 52 comfortable rooms, all with a great panoramic view facing 9 of July and Santa Fe avenues. The hotel welcomes guests in a lobby with a 24-hour reception and a hotel safe. Apart from its excellent location, the hotel offers a business centre, free WI-FI throughout the hotel, bar, restaurant, meeting rooms, 24-hour room service and medical assistance, and a car park.

77091.description: This hotel is located adjacent to the bustling Florida Street in the downtown area of Buenos Aires. The hotel is situated just a short distance away from the city's most appealing attractions, including the Pacific Mall Galleries, Obelisk and Avenida Corrientes. Surrounded by dining options, shopping opportunities and exciting entertainment venues, guests will find themselves in the ideal setting from which to enjoy the sights and sounds of the city. This delightful hotel greets guests with a stunning architectural style, blending effortlessly with its historical surroundings. The guest rooms are sumptuously appointed, featuring refreshing tones and rich furnishings. The hotel provides a host of exemplary facilities, assuring guests of the ultimate in comfort and convenience.

77092.description: This hotel, decorated in classic and elegant European style, is located in Retiro, in the centre of beautiful Buenos Aires, a few metres from the Avenida 9 de Julio and Avenida Santa Fe. The hotel is within walking distance of shopping, theatres, restaurants, and parks, guaranteeing guests can easily find all they need. This sophisticated and harmonious hotel guarantees a unique and idyllic stay in this beautiful city.

name.content: Casa Lucia Member of Melia Collection

77094.description: Breathing the unique tradition and charm of the city, the mythical Arroyo Street welcomes you to Hotel Casa Lucia. This hotel invites you to an exceptional experience taking care of every detail of your visit. Located in the heart of Buenos Aires, in the emblematic Recoleta, this legendary building is a reference to Argentine architecture. Immerse yourself in Buenos Aires's essence, enjoying luxury and hospitality like no other. While walking in, you will discover a space full of light, and music, with elegant and cosmopolitan atmospheres, getting access to our Cantina Restaurant where you will taste typical local flavors, or Le Club Bacan, our cocktail bar where you’ll listen to the best music. Enjoy the best drinks, plates, and a complete selection of Argentine wines. We also offer you a magnificent Spa with treatment cabins that will delight your senses, an infinite pool to relax, and activities specially curated by our experts. We invite you to experience the art of discovering a new city: Buenos Aires through your stay at Hotel Casa Lucia.

77096.description: EFE Hotel & Cowork was inaugurated in 2022. Here we make your stay a unique moment, with rooms and common spaces equipped with state-of-the-art technology and modern design. We have the most complete of services. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers. It has free Wi-Fi in common areas and rooms. Our guests can enjoy our exclusive Lobby Bar where they can taste different meals and snacks.

77097.description: This hotel is located on the Avenida del Libertador, only a few steps away from the renowned Avenida 9 de Julio, close to the art galleries and museums district, a top restaurant area, shopping centres, and in the elegant neighborhood of Recoleta with easy access to Puerto Madero Harbour. The hotel offers excellent standards of service, accommodations and amenities, as well as a strategic location that is convenient both, for business and leisure travelers.

77101.description:
Welcome to Regal Pacific Hotel Buenos Aires, a five-star hotel where hospitality, comfort, and personalized service come together to create a memorable experience in the heart of the city. 
Ideally located just steps from Puerto Madero, Florida Street, and Galerías Pacífico, our prime location provides easy access to Buenos Aires' top attractions, the financial district, and the city's finest dining, shopping, and cultural experiences. 
Whether you are traveling for business or leisure, you will enjoy spacious and elegantly appointed guest rooms, thoughtfully designed to provide the comfort, relaxation, and tranquility you need throughout your stay. 
Your experience is enhanced by a culinary offering inspired by the flavors of Argentina, wellness-focused facilities, and a dedicated team committed to taking care of every detail, allowing you to simply relax and enjoy your visit. 
At Regal Pacific Hotel Buenos Aires, we believe that a truly exceptional stay is defined not only by outstanding facilities, but also by the quality of every experience and the genuine warmth of the people who make it possible.

77102.description: Relax and unwind with massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an indoor pool and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Hop aboard the shuttle (surcharge) and get to the casino or shopping center in no time. Grab a bite at La Luciernaga, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services.

77312.description: Situated in the heart of Strà, on the picturesque Riviera del Brenta, this guesthouse offers an ideal location for exploring the region. With easy access to Interstate 11, Venice and Padua are just a short drive away, while the renowned Villa Pisani is also nearby. The guesthouse is surrounded by local restaurants, bars, and nightlife, with convenient access to public transportation. This family-friendly accommodation features a garden, terrace, and 46 rooms. Business travelers will appreciate the conference facilities, while leisure guests can enjoy the on-site café, bar, and breakfast room. Additional amenities include a 24-hour reception, hotel safe, two elevators, room and laundry services, bicycle rentals, and parking. Each room provides modern comforts such as individually controlled air conditioning and heating, a TV, PC outlet, internet access, safe, and minibar. A direct-dial telephone, double bed, seating area, and a private balcony or terrace are also standard features. The en suite bathrooms, decorated with a unique mosaic whale pattern, boast a hairdryer and shower. Family rooms are available. Guests can maintain their fitness routines in the gym. A continental breakfast buffet is offered daily, and lunch is also served buffet-style.

name.content: Leonardo Boutique Hotel Berlin City South

77314.description: This modern boutique hotel is peacefully located in Berlin's south-eastern Rudow district, a 15-minute drive from Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER9. The hotel provides easy access to public transportation and the city centre, with its sights. This business hotel also offers banqueting facilities which may be adapted to suit guests' needs whether for a conference, an exhibition or a private party. This hotel is the ideal accommodation for business and leisure travellers looking for the perfect starting point for visiting the wonderful capital of Germany.

77370.description: A fun-filled summer, breath-taking nature to be enjoyed to the fullest. . . Voyage Belek Golf & Spa promises a holiday that will make every minute unforgettable with its special privileges. The hotel offers you an unparalleled holiday opportunity and welcomes you with luxurious services in a relaxing atmosphere. With its modern and elegant architecture, restaurants to suit all tastes, services that make you feel privileged from the first step, Voyage assistants to meet all your needs during your stay, Blue Flag beach and much more, Voyage Belek is one of the most popular holiday destinations with its enthusiastic and friendly staff. Comfort Zone, the rest area catered to those who are waiting for their rooms at early check-ins or for transfer or flight hour on the check-out days, offers the exclusivity of Voyage both at the start and at the end of the holiday.

77414.description: Beautifully located in the historic centre of Venice, this charming hotel enjoys a convenient setting just 30 metres away from the renowned Piazza San Marco. The hotel is situated close to the Rialto and Accademia bridges. The hotel is situated in Corte Foscara, in the hearth of the luxury shopping area, right opposite the Louis Vuitton Venice flagship store. Guests will find themselves in the perfect location from which to enjoy a gondola ride around this captivating city, and to explore the spectacular delights it has to offer. This historical hotel dates back to the beginning of the 16th century, and has been beautifully refurbished by the renowned architect, Fuin. Inspiration for the hotel was taken from the Procuratie Vecchie of Piazza San Marco, allowing it to blend effortlessly with its culturally-rich surroundings. With a harmonious blend of iron and marble, the hotel has retained the charm of the Liberty style. The beautifully-appointed guest rooms enjoy sleek style, and Venetian touches echo throughout the decor.

77415.description: This historical hotel is nestled in a park, with fountains and paths creating a calm and tranquil setting. Old style gazebos make this a perfect enchanting place for receptions and private parties. It is located in Mogliano Veneto, a very small, quiet town between Venice and Treviso. In the area, there are restaurants, bars, pubs and shops. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, currency exchange, lift access, a bar and a breakfast room. Guests can take advantage of the hotel's room and laundry services.

77430.description: This city hotel is located in the heart of Buenos Aires, only 200 metres from Florida Street and 400 metres from Puerto Madero. Jorge Newbery Airport is 7 km away and the international airport is 33 km from the establishment. The residence comprises a total of 150 rooms, a restaurant and a traditional pub. It offers all the services and comforts needed to ensure a pleasant stay, whether travelling on business or leisure. The accommodation units are fitted with either a double or a king-size bed and come with an en-suite bathroom with a hairdryer. Rooms include individually regulated air conditioning and heating, cable TV, broadband Internet access and either a balcony or terrace. Note that guests must be over 18 years old in order to book. All guests under this age can only check-in with an adult.

77591.description: Thank you for choosing our Ramada by Wyndham Istanbul Pera hotel. Ramada is a global upper-midscale hotel brand with over 820 properties located in over 50 countries worldwide. Most Ramada hotels feature free wired and wireless high-speed internet access meeting rooms business services fitness facilities and upgraded bath amenities. Many properties have an on-site restaurant/lounge while other sites offer a complimentary buffet breakfast. You do your thing leave the rest to us.

77592.description: This hotel is located just a 5-minute walk from the city centre, and from links to the public transport system, via which guests can reach a range of dining and entertainment options, as well as local attractions within 15 minutes. It is 5 minutes' walk from the Egyptian market and 10 minutes from the Grand Bazaar. Ataturk airport is at 18 km from the property. The rooms are equipped with modern amenities and thoughtful details. Each elegant room has, air conditioning, tea and coffee making facilities and a private bathroom with a hair dryer and toiletries. Guests can take advantages of a health club, offering an array of fitness and relaxation methods or relax at the spa centre with an authentic Turkish bath with foam bath and treatments in a unique Ottoman style.

77593.description: This luxurious hotel is conveniently located in Istanbul's vibrant city center, a short drive from the popular Sultanahmet district. The magnificent Fatih Mosque, a prime example of Turkish-Islamic architecture, is also nearby. Offering a variety of elegantly decorated rooms, the hotel provides all the necessary amenities for a comfortable stay. Guests can enjoy an open buffet breakfast, as well as delicious local and international specialties for lunch and dinner in the hotel restaurant. The health center offers a relaxing Turkish bath and sauna.

77594.address: Merkez Mah Turizm Cad No:10 Side/Çolaklı
77594.description: This lovely holiday hotel is located within walking distance from the centre of Çolakli and 350 m from the beach (free shuttle service). The historic town of Side with its ancient sites is 9 km away, the airport of Antalya 55 km. The hotel offers 102 rooms, 24-hour reception, currency exchange, TV room, restaurant, 3 bars, outdoor pool, children's pool, mini-club, wellness, medical assistance and laundry service.

77595.description: The hotel is located just 550 metres away from the beach and around 55 km away from Antalya Airport, while the historic village and resort of Side is just 10 km away and easily reached by public transport which runs in front of the hotel. Some local amenities such as shops and restaurants can be found in Colakli approximately 1. 5 km from the hotel. Built in 2005, the hotel was inspired by Greek Mythology. It has one central building and 8 annexe buildings with 300 rooms. It is a great resort for a holiday full of aquatic fun. It has a swimming pool, a children's pool, a covered pool, 2 water slides and a pool bar with sun loungers and parasols which guests can use to work on their tan. In addition there are some sports facilities available, such as tennis courts and a pool table. Some waters ports are available on the nearby beach.

name.content: Mercure Paris Arc de Triomphe Etoile

77633.description: Located in the Ternes district, Mercure Paris Arc de Triomphe Étoile provides a relaxing stay, 545 yards (500 m) from the Arc de Triomphe. Completely renovated, our Paris hotel offers clean designer rooms and 2 junior suites with terrace. We offer local products at the buffet breakfast and a gourmet shop for snacks. Discover our library space for relaxing in between visits.

77636.description: If you're seeking an unforgettable stay in Amsterdam, the Hans Brinker Hostel is the answer. We provide a vibrant atmosphere, affordable beds, basic amenities, and plenty of fun right in the heart of the city!You can find us at the Kerkstraat, a cozy street in Amsterdam, just around the corner of the lively Leidseplein (the hotspot of Amsterdam's nightlife). We're also located at a five-minute walk from the Museumplein (where many museums are situated) and the Vondelpark (best place to relax in summer). You can find many bars, restaurants and clubs around our hostel, so you'll never have to walk far or catch a taxi!

77652.description: The hotel enjoys an ideal location in Jardins, one of the most sophisticated districts of the city, and is close to several well-known shops, restaurants, bars, cafes and shopping centres. One of the most luxurious in São Paulo city, the hotel offers guests contemporary architecture, gourmet dining and attention to details. The hotel staff works to provide guests with everything they might need or desire. The rooms are spacious and elegantly appointed, equipped with the latest in technology. Terms and Conditions:- Rates: Valid for requested period, subject to change. - Reservations: Guaranteed by credit card or authorized CNPJ. - Cancellation: 1 day prior to check-in, except special packages. - Group bookings: 6+ rooms, rates and policies may vary. - Long stays (7+ nights): Advance payment may be required. - Taxes: 5% ISS, R$13. 30 tourism tax/night. - Check-in: 3 PM, Check-out: 12 PM.

77653.description: The Sofitel Buenos Aires Recoleta hotel offers a luxury experience with the French art de vivre in the heart of Recoleta. Located close to the city's main tourist attractions, it boasts modern, spacious rooms and a restaurant, bar, patisserie, wine cellar, heated swimming pool, fitness center, function rooms and a garden. The hotel is located opposite the Patio Bullrich shopping mall and just a block away from the prestigious Avenida Alvear and its international luxury stores.

77654.description: Elegant and contemporary, Ker Recoleta Hotel is excellently located in the center of Buenos Aires, between the Recoleta district and downtown. The famous Santa Fe and 9 de Julio Avenues are just a few steps away; Attractions such as the Teatro Colón, Florida Street or the Obelisco are just a short walk away. It offers 92 rooms that combine design, warmth, technology and comfort. It has a restaurant, spa area with heated pool, jacuzzis, dry saunas, facilities for events and conferences. TO TAKE INTO ACCOUNT:Upon check-in, all guests must present an identity document or passport, a credit card will also be requested as a guarantee or the cash equivalent of the total stay. The heated pool and Spa work from 10 am to 8 pm, while the gym runs from 7 am to 8 pm. The Health Club has limited places and is included in the rate 2 hours per day per person. To access it, you must request a shift at the Hotel Reception at check-in and they are subject to availability. Children under 18 can access the Spa accompanied by an adult and can only use the pool.

77655.description: Located two blocks from Rio de Janeiro's famed beach, this hotel offers comfortable accommodations and excellent customer service for both business and leisure travelers. Spacious rooms provide air conditioning, cable TV, direct-dial phones, safes, refrigerators, radios, and PC connection ports. Guests can enjoy a varied breakfast and relax in the coffee shop or American bar.

77690.description: Set against the backdrop of one of London’s best known historical landmarks, at the centre of the buzzing More London district, Hilton London Tower Bridge is a contemporary 4-star hotel ideally situated for business or sightseeing whilst experiencing a real slice of vibrant London life. A short walk from London Bridge mainline and underground station, the hotel boasts elegantly furnished guest rooms, with WiFi access (fees apply), 37-inch TV , US & USB plugs, safe, tea & coffee making facilities, luxury bathroom amenities and much more. Work out in the fully equipped fitness suite and upgrade to the executive floors to enjoy a range of complimentary services, including the stunning views of The Shard from our Executive Lounge City Terrace. With 8 elegant and flexible Meeting Rooms and 2 spacious Suites, for up to 450 delegates, with state-of-the-art amenities, dedicated coordinator and 24/7 Business Centre, you are always guaranteed successful meetings & events at Hilton London Tower Bridge. Sip cocktails with friends and colleagues in the lively atmosphere of the stylish TwoRuba cocktail bar. The energy of this dynamic area and the buzz from our stylish bar concepts flows right through the hotel for a chilled, informal atmosphere.

77697.description: This comfortable hotel Atlantico Copacabana is situated only 3 blocks away from the most famous beach of the world, the Copacabana in Rio de Janeiro. It features a lovely rooftop pool with wide open views over the city and of the Christ the Redeemer statue. The Siqueira Campos metro station is located just opposite the hotel, providing easy access to all parts of the city. The beach of Ipanema is around 4 km away.

77698.description: An authentic urban 'oasis'. In the very heart of Buenos Aires and a stone's throw from the most important places of interest as the Cultural Centre Kirchner. Claridge's Restaurant is one of the main references in Buenos Aires gastronomy. Designed by the prestigious architect, Arthur Dubourg, the Claridge has become the icon of the city of the Tango. Built by the Rosarios brothers, Felipe and Ottocar after the Second World War, one of the periods of greatest prosperity for the Argentine capital. The objective was to endow the city with a magnificent hotel in an unsurpassable location, sophisticated and luxurious and very similar in style to the grand European establishments. ** Restaurant Timetable: Monday to Friday from 12:00 pm to 10:00 pm and Saturdays and Sundays from 12:00 pm to 2:00 pm. **Breakfast times: From Monday to Saturday from 7 am to 10:30 am. Sundays and holidays from 7 am to 11 am. ** Bar Timetable: 11:00am - 10:00pm Monday to Sunday. Groups: When booking more than 5 rooms, different policies and additional supplements may apply. Parking: paid parking ($22/night) subject to availability for small and medium-sized vehicles. No advance reservations. Maximum height 2. 25 m. Swimming pool: from 10:00 a. m. to 7:00 p. m. (open from December to March).

name.content: Nest Hotel Paris la Defense - MGallery Collection

77703.description: Nest La Défense by MGallery, a 5-star cocoon hotel decorated by Oscar Lucien Ono, is located on the Esplanade in the heart of Paris's business district. Entirely renovated in 2020, its reinterpreted Memphis style embodies the philosophy of the 1980s movement: chic and convivial, soothing and lush, lively and colorful. The hotel is easily accessible by Metro Line 1, with the Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées just minutes away.

77710.description:
As one of New York City’s most striking and sophisticated hotels, Mandarin Oriental, New York elevates hospitality to new heights with its signature, award-winning service from its prime location in the heart of the city. 

Contemporary in design with a refined nod to its elegant Oriental flair, the hotel offers an exceptional guest experience complemented by unparalleled views of Central Park, the Hudson River, and the Manhattan skyline. 

Luxurious amenities include contemporary dining MO Lounge, reimagined speakeasy The Bar, an award-winning Spa and Wellness facility with a 75-foot indoor pool, and premium event spaces overlooking the iconic Central Park. 

Located in Columbus Circle’s Deutsche Bank Center, Mandarin Oriental, New York is in an idyllic location by world-class dining, shopping and entertainment, including the Broadway Theater District, Lincoln Center, and The Shops at Columbus Circle’s collection of luxury retail stores and renowned restaurants.

77870.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Zel Hotel, a family-friendly hotel located near Konyaalti Beach. Take a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, rent bicycles to explore the area, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Kids will love the arcade/game room and babysitting services are also available. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, and enjoy the convenience of 24-hour room service and free self-parking. Each of the 45 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, LCD TV, private balcony, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Just a short drive from Konyaalti Beach Park and other local attractions, Zel Hotel offers a comfortable and convenient base for your Antalya adventure.

77890.address: Mersin Yolu Uzeri Dimcayi Koprusu Yani, 61
77890.description: The city hotel is situated in a botanical garden and surrounded by the Toros Mountains, the Mediterranean and the Dim River. The hotel is also only 4 km from the city centre where guests will find numerous shops, restaurants, bars and nightlife spots. Alanya Castle is approximately 8 km from the hotel and Antalya Airport is around 125 km away. This family-run hotel was last renovated in 2008 and offers a personal touch to guests' holiday experience. There is an outdoor swimming pool with children's swimming area, which families can enjoy during the summer. There is also a range of water sports available for guests who prefer a more active vacation. The nearby beach is sandy and perfect for sunbathing.

77932.address: Arset Al Houta 1 Derb El Boumba, 1
77932.description: “A 19th-century guesthouse with a swimming pool, where time seems to stand still. ” Nestled in the heart of Marrakech’s medina, Riad Dama & Spa offers a sanctuary of serenity where Moroccan tradition and modern luxury harmoniously converge. Beautifully restored, this historic riad invites guests to an authentic experience in an enchanting setting, defined by mosaic-adorned courtyards, soothing fountains, and timeless architecture.

77933.description: This hotel is located in the North of the medina of Marrakech, close to Jemâa El Fna square, in the ancient district of the Caîd El Ayadi. Guests can enjoy the principal places of interest in Marrakech such as Souks, Majorelle gardens and Kutubia Mosque. The hotel has been restored to its initial state (Spanish-Moresque style), using the local and traditional materials of Morocco. The hotel has been classified as one of the top riads by the tourism authorities of Marrakesh. Guests are guaranteed comfortable accommodation and personalised service. This historical guest house has 6 rooms in total, and offers guests facilities including a 24-hour reception, a TV room, a breakfast room and a laundry service. The rooms all come equipped with a bathroom with a shower, plus individually regulated air conditioning and heating units.
