The hotel is located near a road of golf courses, on the way to the Palmgrove. Guests can also enjoy the enchanting golf courses in Marrakech. The hotel itself offers an outdoor swimming pool, a solarium, massage treatments and a tennis court. The hotel provides a bed and breakfast service and an à la carte evening meal.

78210.description: The hotel is located in the seaside suburb of Glyfada. The beach is just 100 meters away. The hotel consists of one 5 story building in modern style and was fully refurbished in 2003. It offers unique and friendly service, which can be described as all season hospitality. The hotel offers 24-hour reception, hotel safe, a nice bar, restaurant with Greek and international cuisine and a roof garden bar. Conference facilities, as well as room and laundry services feature. Free WiFi Internet and parking facilities are also available. All rooms are tastefully decorated, equipped with individually adjustable air condition, telephone, television, mini fridge, hairdryer, private furnished balcony, as well as Internet access. The rooms are in general smart, but for the more discerning guests the junior suites come recommended. All meals are served in the main restaurant, in buffet style.

78212.description: With a stay at Athens Cypria Hotel, you'll be centrally located in Athens, just a 5-minute walk from Syntagma Square and 9 minutes by foot from Acropolis. This 4-star hotel is 0. 4 mi (0. 6 km) from Monastiraki Flea Market and 7. 2 mi (11. 6 km) from Port of Piraeus. Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 115 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired Internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Ermou Street - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi- Metropolitan Cathedral of Athens - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Church Of Agia Irini - 0. 4 km/0. 2 mi- Tomb of the Unknown Soldier - 0. 4 km/0. 2 mi- Adrianou Street - 0. 4 km/0. 2 mi- Syntagma Square - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- Hellenic Parliament - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Athens National Garden - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Hadrian's Library - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Academy of Athens - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Monastiraki Flea Market - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Roman Agora - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Tower of the Winds - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Ancient Agora of Athens - 0. 7 km/0. 5 mi- Athens Central Market - 0. 7 km/0. 5 mi. The preferred airport for Athens Cypria Hotel is Athens Intl. Airport (ATH) - 34. 8 km/21. 6 mi.

78238.description: This hotel is located in Montparnasse, the district of the city popular with Paris' painters. Set conveniently close to the train station, guests of this hotel will be welcomed into an atmosphere of tranquillity and the style which was so dear to Renoir, the famous impressionist painter. Guests may take a walk in the Jardins du Luxembourg and stroll to Notre-Dame along the banks of the Seine, stopping off for a browse through the shops or pausing on their return for a cup of coffee on the terrace of a café in Saint-German-des-Prés. The Eiffel Tower is 10 minutes away on public transport and it is a 20-minute drive to Les Invalides. Orly Airport is around 20 km away and it is some 25 km to Charles de Gaulle Airport. This charming historical city hotel was built in 1930 and comprises a total of 29 rooms including 11 single rooms and 18 double rooms. It is ideally suited to both business travellers and holidaymakers. Further facilities available to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area, a 24-hour reception desk, a hotel safe, a lift, a breakfast room, WLAN access point and room and laundry services. All rooms feature a Renoir painting, to remind guests that they are in Montparnasse. Thanks to the sound-proofed rooms, guests may enjoy peace and quiet as well as an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, satellite TV with Canal+ or CNN and a modem connection for pleasure or work. Further amenities on offer in the rooms include a direct dial telephone, a minibar, a fridge, a king-size or double bed, individually adjustable air conditioning and a safe. Guests are offered a continental breakfast in the mornings.

78252.description: A short walk from the Champs-Elysées and the Opéra area, the Adagio Paris Haussmann has 53 comfortable apartments from studios for 2 to two-room apartments for 4. This 4-star holiday residence combines elegance and a high standard of services. The hotel is in a lively business district and boasts several major tourist attractions, including La Madeleine church, the Arc de Triomphe, the Louvre and the Tuileries gardens.

78255.description: Ideally located at the Gates of Paris, the Aparthotel is across the street from the Exhibition Park Porte de Versailles. Classified as a 4 star Tourist Residence, it has 137 apartments ranging from a studio for 2 people to an apartment for 6 people. For your comfort, the property offers paid private car parking as well as 2 seminar rooms.

name.content: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Centre Tour Eiffel

78256.description: On the banks of the Seine and just steps from the Eiffel Tower, the Adagio Paris Eiffel Tower 2 features a breathtaking panoramic view of Paris and its most beautiful monuments. Rated a 4-star holiday residence, the Aparthotel is ideally situated for living life like a true Parisian and has 375 luxury apartments, ranging from studios for 2 people to 3-room apartments for 6 people. It also has an enclosed private car park, fitness room and 2 large meeting rooms.

78257.description: The Adagio Paris Buttes Chaumont is situated on a calm and peaceful road, a stone's throw from the Parc des Buttes Chaumont and just a few minutes from the Canal de l'Ourcq. The modern building with a small inner courtyard houses 97 apartments ranging from 2-person studios to 3-room, 6-person apartments. This typically Parisian district offers numerous shops and services. The center of Paris can be easily reached by metro and there is an enclosed private car park for your convenience.

78399.description: Enjoy a central New York stay at The Sohotel, just a short walk from the New Museum and a quick drive from One World Trade Center. This hotel offers convenient amenities such as concierge services, on-site shopping, and a cozy fireplace in the lobby. Indulge in delicious Mexican cuisine at Casa Bocado, one of the hotel's five restaurants, or relax with a drink at one of the five bars/lounges. Each of the 100 guest rooms is individually decorated and features an iPod docking station, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a safe, a desk, and a private bathroom with designer toiletries and a hairdryer. Additional amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a 24-hour front desk.

78411.description: Located in Pinto, just 10 minutes from Warner Bros. Park, with direct access from the A-4 highway, this hotel offers modern, air-conditioned rooms. A large shopping center (Nassica-Factory) is just steps away, and Madrid's city center is a 20-minute drive. Each room features free Wi-Fi, a plasma satellite TV, a minibar, a complimentary safe, and a bathroom with toiletries, a hairdryer, and a magnifying mirror. Family rooms, smoking rooms, and accessible rooms are also available. Guests can enjoy the spa and fitness room, offering a range of massages and beauty treatments. Additional amenities include a restaurant serving daily menus and à la carte dining, meeting and convention rooms for up to 300 people, a summer terrace, a bar, room service, a business center, and free private parking.

78412.description: Situated in the heart of Madrid, this elegant urban hotel offers comfortable accommodations, perfect for exploring the city center. Just a short walk from major attractions like the Royal Palace, Opera Theatre, Plaza de España, Puerta del Sol, and Gran Vía, the hotel occupies a beautifully refurbished 19th-century building, blending historic charm with modern amenities. Guests will appreciate the air-conditioned rooms, tastefully furnished and equipped for a comfortable stay. A daily breakfast buffet featuring sweet and savory options is available, and numerous restaurants and bars are within easy reach for lunch and dinner.

78593.description: This contemporary boutique hotel on Fifth Avenue, just a block from the Empire State Building, offers 70 guest rooms with state-of-the-art amenities. The air-conditioned hotel features a 24-hour reception, check-out service, a safe, and lift access. Internet access and parking are available. Many rooms boast breathtaking views of the Empire State Building and feature custom cherry wood furnishings, wall-mounted flat-screen LCD TVs with 150 channels and 9 free movies, a radio, and iPod docks. Each en suite bathroom includes a shower, bath, and hairdryer. Guests can also enjoy complimentary local calls. Individually regulated air conditioning and heating ensure optimal comfort.

78594.description: This hotel is located right opposite Barcelona-Estació de França train station, not too far away from the Gothic Quarter, the Colón statue, the Picasso Museum and the harbour. It is situated in the heart of the city near to a myriad of shopping and entertainment venues and is close to the zoo and Ciudadela Park. The city hotel is a simple but well maintained property which offers excellent value for money for those travelling on a budget. It comprises a total of 20 rooms and offers a lobby where lift access to the upper floors is available. The rooms are very basic but they are clean and well-kept. All rooms come equipped with an en-suite bathroom, air-conditioning and central heating.

78650.address: Kocatepe Mah. Sehit Muhtar Bey Cad. No:49 Beyoglu
78650.description: This hotel is located in Taksim, a lively district of Istanbul. There is a metro station with in a few minutes' walk from the property, which connects with the train station in Sirkeci. This city hotel has 65 rooms including 4 suites. The establishment is air-conditioned and guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception service. A bar and a restaurant are available on site, and business travellers will appreciate the conference facilities and Internet access. All rooms have an en suite bathroom and amenities include satellite TV and tea and coffee making facilities. Air conditioning and central heating are standard features in all accommodation units.

78671.description: Enjoy a central Amsterdam stay at Hotel City Garden, steps from Vondelpark and a short walk from the Stedelijk Museum. This hotel offers complimentary wired and wireless internet access, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a vending machine. A continental breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The 73 guestrooms feature iPod docking stations, LCD TVs with digital programming, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include the Van Gogh Museum and Concertgebouw.

78792.description: The hotel is located only 15 minutes from the historic city centre of Madrid and 25 metres from the nearest underground station (Estrecho, line number 1). The Santiago Bernabeu Football Stadium is a 15-minute walk away. The hotel is on street Bravo Murillo, a wide, multi-cultural and commercial area that guests can enjoy on their doorstep. Barajas International Airport is 25 minutes from the hotel. This modern and family-friendly city hotel opened its doors in 2006 and consists of a total of 92 rooms. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services. Further facilities include air conditioning, a hotel safe, lift access, a newspaper stand, café and breakfast room. Guests can also use the car park, luggage room, cloakroom, 24-hour taxi service and laundry service. The hotel also organises various tours. The modern and warm rooms are equipped with digital TV, radio, Internet access, a telephone, safe and ironing set. The rooms are also en suite with various accessories, a shower and hairdryer. There are also tea and coffee making facilities while guests can individually regulate the air conditioning and heating. Guests can choose between a double bed and 2 single beds. Rooms for disabled people are also available. The hotel serves a continental breakfast.

78793.description: This 4-star hotel, established in 2007, is located in the center of Ferrières-en-Brie, a short drive from Disneyland Paris. The nearest station is Bussy-Saint-Georges. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant and indoor swimming pool. Proper swimwear is required; burkinis and shorts are not permitted. For safety reasons, the sauna, hammam, and hot tub are restricted to adults over 18. Children and teenagers under 16 are not allowed.

78810.description: The Sultanhan Hotel, a renovated former government house, welcomes you to the heart of Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district. The impressive lobby, spanning 400 square meters with 5-meter high ceilings, showcases Ottoman-style textiles and 150-year-old wooden accents. Each of the 40 spacious, non-smoking guest rooms features a king or queen-size bed, parquet flooring, and modern amenities including individually controlled heating and air conditioning, double-glazed windows with blackout curtains, a bathtub, bedside and bathroom telephones, a minibar, hairdryer, electronic safe, and Wi-Fi. Laptop rentals, TVs with local and international channels, and 24-hour room service are also available. Ottoman-inspired textiles, wooden furniture, and original silk 'Süzani' adorn each room. The hotel prioritizes safety with automatic fire alarms, fire escapes on each floor, and smoke detectors in all rooms and corridors. Fire hoses and extinguishers are also available on guest floors. Enjoy Turkish and international cuisine at the Sultanhan Terrace Restaurant, offering indoor and outdoor seating with breathtaking views of iconic landmarks such as the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sophia, and the Bosphorus. Unwind after a long day in our traditional Turkish bath or sauna. For a unique experience, the Fireplace, decorated with original Ottoman furniture and textiles, provides an elegant setting for business discussions or drinks.

78813.description: The hotel is located in the city of Marrakech, in front of the Koutoubia Mosque and close to the medina and Djemaa el Fna square. There is a train station nearby and Menara Airport is about 3 km from the establishment. The family-friendly residence consists of a total of 40 rooms. Guests are welcomed to a number of in-house facilities, which include lift access and a TV lounge. They can choose to enjoy refreshments in the café and try a selection of Moroccan, Italian and other European dishes at the restaurant. Each of the rooms is decorated in a traditional Moroccan style and offers all amenities required for a pleasant stay.

78834.description: Situated in Alcalá de Henares's bustling business district, a mere 10 minutes from Barajas International Airport, this air-conditioned hotel offers 79 well-appointed rooms and a spacious convention center. Guests enjoy 24-hour reception service, Wi-Fi, an on-site café, bar, and restaurant, as well as a garage and car park. Each room features twin or double beds, a terrace, and air conditioning, complemented by room and laundry services. Leisure facilities include an indoor and two outdoor swimming pools with a poolside bar, sun loungers, and parasols. The spa provides a refreshing upstream swimming experience, a relaxing solarium, and a traditional Turkish bath. Maintain your fitness routine in the fully equipped gym, complete with plasma TVs in front of each machine. A daily breakfast buffet is also available.

78997.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include babysitting (surcharge) and a television in a common area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a train station pick-up service. Make yourself at home in one of the 64 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

79051.description: The hotel enjoys a central location opposite the main railway station and connected to its underground car park. Links to public transport and the bus station are also in the immediate vicinity. It is a 5-minute walk from the lake and a 10-minute walk from the old town, St. Peter's cathedral, Patek Philipp Museum and the main shopping streets. It is about 7 minutes by train or 20 minutes by bus from Cointrin Airport. This historic hotel, which dates back to 1932, was renovated in 2006. It has 76 rooms in total spread across 7 floors. It is the ideal place for business, shopping and short stays. A lobby, 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, currency exchange facility, lift access, a breakfast room, and room and laundry services all feature. This hotel offers very cosy rooms in a typical sixties-style. The furnishings are very simple and typical of an economy city hotel. All rooms come with an en suite bathroom with bath or shower. Non-smoking rooms are available on request. A hairdryer, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a radio, central heating and a safe deposit box all feature. WIFI is free in all rooms. A continental breakfast is provided.

79054.description: This stylish new city hotel is located just a few minutes from the heart of Brussels. This modern new hotel offers a relaxing environment where guests can enjoy a break from the hustle and bustle of Brussels city centre life. Guests are offered accommodation in 40 well-appointed guest rooms. The hotel features a range of facilities designed to cater for both corporate and leisure travellers making it an ideal accommodation choice for a trip to the capital of Europe, Brussels. The rooms are cosy and well-equipped. A delightful breakfast buffet is supplied, providing an ideal start to a day of business meetings or sightseeing in the city centre.

79075.description: Strategically located next to Galerias Pacifico Shopping center, this historic hotel boasts spacious rooms with cutting-edge design that seamlessly integrates original architectural details. Each room features acoustic-insulated windows and a bathroom with separate bath and shower. The hotel's prime location offers easy access to the city's most interesting attractions, many within walking distance or a short subway ride.

79090.address: Denizyaka Mah, Kamisli Gol Kume Evleri, 1
79090.description: Nestled along the Mediterranean coast in Denizyaka, Antalya, near the Koprucay River, this golf resort offers a remarkable vacation experience. Built in 2007, the resort boasts 450 well-appointed rooms, suites, and villas, some with breathtaking sea views. Guests can indulge in the on-site spa, stay active with various land and water sports, or enjoy the lively entertainment programs for all ages. The high-quality Lykia Links golf course is conveniently located nearby. With a stunning 2. 5 km shoreline and extensive leisure facilities, including a fitness center, swimming pools, and a kids' club, Lykia World Antalya promises a memorable stay.

79116.description: This sophisticated, pet-friendly (10€ supplement per pet, per day) non-smoking hotel in Barcelona is perfectly situated for exploring the city. Its proximity to the Montjuïc International Exhibition Centre, Plaza España, and Rocafort metro station makes it an ideal base for both leisure and business travelers. This avant-garde hotel impresses with its stylish décor and exceptional service. A variety of thoughtfully designed rooms ensures a restful night's sleep. Guests can enjoy panoramic city views from the rooftop terrace bar, Villa Emilia la Terrassa, while savoring refreshing drinks. A wide selection of meals and beverages is also available at the Villa Emilia Bistrot. State-of-the-art meeting facilities cater to the needs of business travelers.

name.content: The Time New York, part of JdV by Hyatt

79257.description: Located in the heart of Manhattan's fashionable West Side, The Time New York is a lifestyle hotel offering 193 contemporary rooms, including 25 suites and a three-level penthouse. This hotel is situated near Broadway theaters, Times Square, and Rockefeller Center, with convenient access to various subway lines. Guests can enjoy world-class shopping, dining, and entertainment within walking distance, as well as renowned attractions such as Central Park and the Empire State Building. The hotel features a 24-hour fitness center, TMPL Fitness by David Barton, and LeGrande bar. A mandatory nightly facility fee covers continental breakfast for two, high-speed Wi-Fi, a wine and cheese hour, coffee or tea vouchers, and a fitness center discount. The modern, art-inspired rooms feature hardwood floors, custom furnishings by Moroso, designer bath amenities and robes, and Italian Frette linen.

79258.description: The hotel is located only a short drive along the coast from the centre of Alanya and just 38 km from the Gazipasa Airport. This family-friendly, air-conditioned beach hotel consists of 184 spacious rooms and is just a few steps away from the sandy beach and the beautiful Mediterranean Sea. The rooms are luminous and tastefully appointed. Guests can find public transport links close to the hotel, which allows exploring the area surrounding this beautiful resort. The resort features a wide choice of dining options, including several bars and a buffet restaurant. There is also a swimming pool with waterslides, a private section at the beach, a hammam and a sauna, as well as a fitness centre. There is a children's playground and kids' club available for the hotel's younger guests. Private parking is also available for the convenience of those travelling by car.

79273.description: Experience a unique stay at the Best Western White House Hotel, a charming townhouse hotel in Watford, just a short walk from the vibrant high street and convenient for exploring London. Enjoy easy access to the capital's countless attractions and shopping destinations. Our dedicated staff provides warm British hospitality, and the hotel offers delicious English and international cuisine. The hotel features comfortable rooms full of character, making it the perfect base for your London adventures. Please note: Bar times may vary for non-residents. Verify family room suitability for children's ages before booking. Limited free on-site parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Chargeable parking options are nearby; contact the hotel for details. Cash payments require a £100 deposit plus photo ID, or a £50 pre-authorization for incidentals. In-room dining is available with a £4 delivery and admin fee. Guests can enjoy meals in the lobby or breakfast room with a drink purchase from the bar.

79290.description: This charming boutique hotel is conveniently situated in the lively Beyoglu district, just off the shopping of Istiklal Street and within a 5 and 10 minutes' walk, respectively, from the famous Galata Tower and the Taksim Square. The hotel features a restaurant, bar, fitness centre, spa & wellness and business centre. The next metro station is only 30 m away, providing easy access to all areas of the city with its historic sights.

79314.description: The luxury four-star Le Parisis hotel is located on the Boulevard de Grenelle, in Paris's15th district. This peaceful, yet lively residential area offers easy access to numerous Paris landmarks and major museums. The hotel is within walking distance from famous sites such as the Champs de Mars, the Eiffel Tower or the Invalides.

79418.description: Enjoy a central Amsterdam stay at Hotel Library Amsterdam, within a 10-minute walk of Oude Kerk and Nemo Science Museum. This hotel offers 48 guestrooms equipped with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and private bathrooms with rainfall showers. Complimentary Wi-Fi and satellite programming are provided for your entertainment. Start your day with a continental breakfast (available for a fee), and utilize convenient amenities like tour/ticket assistance and luggage storage. Hotel Library Amsterdam is also conveniently located near ARTIS (1. 4 km) and Madame Tussauds (2. 4 km).

79451.description: Located in Midtown Manhattan's fashionable East Side, this comfortably luxurious hotel is near Rockefeller Center, Grand Central Terminal, Bloomingdale's, and the Theater District. It offers spacious rooms and suites, some with balconies, and a warm, inviting ambiance. Guests can enjoy a small fitness room on the second floor and complimentary internet when booking directly. Dining options include three restaurants: Bistango (Italian), Empire Steak/Seafood, and the popular Upstairs Rooftop Lounge, serving cocktails and small plates. The hotel is conveniently located 8 km from Grand Central Station, 2. 5 km from the Convention Center, and within a 15-minute walk of Broadway and the Museum of Modern Art. Access to the United Nations subway station is also nearby. LaGuardia Airport is 15 km away, and JFK Airport is 20 km from the hotel. Check-in is at 3:00 PM, and check-out is at 12:00 PM, with express check-out and early/late check-out available upon request.

79470.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, terrace, and garden at Na Balam Hotel, located in the heart of Isla Mujeres (Centro - Supmza 001), just steps from North Beach and a short walk from the ferry terminal. Savor delicious meals at the onsite restaurant and unwind with drinks at the bar/lounge or beach bar. Guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite channels, private bathrooms with showers and complimentary toiletries, safes, and bottled water. Complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and tour/ticket assistance are also available. Airport and ferry terminal shuttles are offered for a surcharge.

79510.description: The modern and comfortable Hotel Aarau West is in a peaceful location close to Aarau. Right next to the golf course and a large sport centre, the hotel has over 70 rooms, 3 conference rooms and is only 2 minutes from the motorway. Guests at the hotel are welcome to use the elegant restaurant in the adjacent golfclub, with a cuisine using fresh ingredients from the market, or the simple and comfortable restaurant with seasonal dishes in the nearby sports centre.

79511.description:
Sorell Hotel Aarauerhof is located in the heart of Switzerland - The Sorell Hotel Aarauerhof is a popular conference and seminar hotel. As  well as enjoying elegantly furnished business rooms  the hotel also offers  exceptionally large rooms with professional  technical infrastructure  ensuring a reliable service.
The Sorell Hotel Aarauerhof is a popular conference and seminar hotel. As well as enjoying elegantly furnished business rooms  the hotel also offers exceptionally large rooms with professional  technical infrastructure ensuring a reliable service. The modern gastronomy concept and the new wellness and spa oasis provide a perfect finishing touch to the offers in the Sorell Hotel Aarauerhof. Aarau lies in the heart of Switzerland. Our hotel has a central position  directly next to the main station and is easily reached both by car and train. These are you advantages at Sorell Hotel Aarauerhof - Free W-LAN throughout the entire hotel  Free admission to the hotels own spa oasis  free guest card to discover the Regional Aargau.

79520.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Grab a bite to eat at ENJOY, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. This hotel has 2 meeting rooms available for events. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 85 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is available. Bathrooms have bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and blackout drapes/curtains. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

79521.description: This family-friendly hotel is located in the heart of the city's business centre, close to the picturesque Lake Geneva. It offers comfortable accommodation in 42 fully air-conditioned rooms, studios and apartments, equipped with all the amenities required for a comfortable stay. Guests will be greeted in a charming lobby area, where they will encounter a friendly staff and will be invited to a number of services. A hotel safe is available to store valuables, and lift access will take visitors to their rooms. The accommodation units are spacious and tastefully decorated. Each features an en-suite bathroom with a nice bath and a television with multiple cable channels provides in-room entertainment.

79595.description: Indulge in a spa treatment, including massages, at the Park Hotel Winterthur. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Savor international cuisine at Bloom restaurant, with bar/lounge seating and alfresco dining, or enjoy room service during limited hours. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Business amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities comprise a conference center and three meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available onsite. The hotel's 73 guestrooms feature free minibar items, LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Safes and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Located near Stadthaus Winterthur, Kunstmuseum Winterthur, and other attractions, the Park Hotel Winterthur provides convenient access to the heart of Winterthur. The preferred airport is Zurich Airport (ZRH), approximately 25. 6 km away.

name.content: Small Luxury Hotel Ambassador a L'Opera

79596.description: Located in the heart of Zurich, the Small Luxury Hotel Ambassador Zürich offers a luxurious stay just a short walk from the Opera House and Lakeside Promenade. This hotel features 45 air-conditioned rooms equipped with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and private bathrooms. Guests can enjoy complimentary wired and wireless internet access, 24-hour room service, and an on-site restaurant and bar/lounge with alfresco dining options. Additional amenities include bicycle rentals, a terrace, concierge services, a computer station, and complimentary newspapers. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Bahnhofstrasse, the Swiss National Museum, ETH Zurich, and Letzigrund Stadium.

name.content: Hotel Swiss Night by Fassbind Zurich

79597.description: Opened in late 2016, the three-star Swiss Night by Fassbind offers 51 modern, Swiss-style rooms. Each room features air conditioning, a minibar, safe, coffee/tea facilities, iron and ironing board, flat-screen TV, hairdryer, and toiletries. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, and a business corner with a printer is located in the lobby. The uniquely designed rooms offer a quiet retreat in central Zurich, promoting restful sleep with brand new beds. A spacious work desk is also provided. Guests enjoy free access to the fitness room during opening hours. Paid outside parking is available. The hotel's central location near Zurich Kunsthaus provides easy access to all parts of the city. Bahnhof Stadelhofen, with quick connections to the airport and Zurich Hauptbahnhof, is also nearby. Discover Zurich's vibrant nightlife from this peaceful base. The reception is open 24 hours. Please note that some rooms and the fitness center will be under construction until April 2017.

79598.description: The boutique Hotel Helmhaus Zurich enjoys a central location in the heart of Zurich and awaits you with first class service! Whether you come to Zurich for business or pleasure – you want to stay in a non smoking hotel that rewards you for your travels - a hotel that compensates you for your stress. Stay at Swiss Quality Hotel Helmhaus! At this personally managed hotel you will find tradition paired with a modern lifestyle to make you feel comfortable. Personal care and service with a competitive offer is guaranteed.

79599.description: The Sorell Hotel Rex, a favorite of Friedrich Dürrenmatt, offers unbeatable value in the heart of Zurich. Just steps from the main train station and old city center, this charming hotel provides easy access to Zurich ETH and University. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the property, personalized service, and convenient on-site parking. Zurich-Kloten Airport is a short 15-minute drive away.

79602.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a spa tub, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at the hotel's restaurant, Restaurant & Grill, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. This hotel has 8 meeting rooms available for events. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 60 guestrooms featuring tablet computers and minibars (stocked with some free items).

79604.description: Boasting a prime situation close to the central Grand Place and just a 5-minute walk from the world renowned Manneken Pis statue, this charming establishment is set in a historical building in the heart of Brussels. The airport is 14 kilometres and Brussels-South Station is just 8 minutes' drive from the hotel. Its convenient location makes it the perfect place for both business travellers and those wishing to explore this vibrant city. It also offers a choice of accommodation options to suit all clients' needs, ranging from single rooms to executive rooms with private bathroom. They all come with Wi-Fi internet connection and satellite television. Guests will appreciate the wide range of leisure and sports venues located in the surroundings, such as tennis clubs and swimming pools. Pets are not allowed in this hotel.

79611.description: You will feel right at home in ibis Styles Amsterdam City. The hotel's location makes it an ideal place to explore the city from and a great spot for city breaks and business trips. With a tram stop just outside, you can get to the city's various attractions in no time. It's a 10-minute tram ride to the center, and the Carré Theatre and the Heineken Experience are within walking distance.

79617.description: This brand new boutique hotel is set in the city centre of Levallois, 200 meters from Louise Michel tube station and only a few minutes' walk from So Ouest shopping centre. Signed by the artist Julie Gauthron, the decoration of the establishment revisits the warm and cosy atmosphere of the fifties by focusing on the Boris Vian's character. In the lobby, striped chairs and orange tweed remind the times Boris Vian used to like Jazz clubs. The clients can also find a cocktail piano, which creates cocktails according to the music that is played directly from the imagination of Boris Vian's novel: Froth on the Daydream. All stylish and elegantly furnished rooms are equipped with top quality bedding and offer the comfort expected by customers to enjoy an unforgettable stay.

79621.description: A secret passageway connects the front of this property to Green Park, and within 5 minutes guests can walk to the Green Park underground station, Old Bond Street and Jermyn Street. Opened in 1912, parts of the establishment are almost 400 years old. After major renovation works, the hotel now offers 105 rooms, spread over 6 floors. Facilities include a traditional lounge and a fine-dining restaurant, as well as a distinctive American Bar, popular with royalty and a great spot for a light meal. The hotel is proud of its unique historical courtyard, provided with tables for outdoor dining. The elegant, traditional and quiet rooms each offer an en- suite marble bathroom and are fitted with complimentary wireless Internet access and individually regulated air conditioning and heating.

79712.description: The beach is 750 m from the hotel, and Side, with its selection of bars and restaurants, is only 900 m away. Nearby public transport makes the attractions of the ancient ruins of Side, the Manavgat Waterfalls and the Oymapinar Dam easily accessible. Antalya Airport is roughly 75 kms from the hotel. Facilities at this family-friendly air-conditioned hotel include 30 rooms spread over 3 floors, bars and a café. For dining and drinks, guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant. For business guests, the hotel has conference facilities and WLAN Internet access. In addition to the many activities it offers, the hotel also organizes entertainment programmes for children and adults. For fans of the fairway, there is a golf course in Belek, approximately a 20-minute drive away.

name.content: Hilton Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport

79852.description:
Hilton Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport offers spacious, soundproofed rooms with large windows and flat-screen TVs. Bathrooms feature a bathtub and walk-in shower. Guests in Executive Rooms enjoy exclusive Lounge access with complimentary refreshments and continental breakfast. At GG Green Gate, savor contemporary and classic French cuisine made with fresh, local produce, including à la carte and all-day breakfast options. The sauna is open daily from 6 a. m. to 10 p. m. 
Free WiFi is available in public areas (charges apply in rooms). The hotel offers 24-hour room service and covered parking. The RER B station “Aéroport Charles de Gaulle 1” is a 5-minute walk and provides direct access to Paris. The CDGVAL shuttle, connecting airport terminals, is just steps away.

79854.description: This boutique hotel enjoys an ideal location at the foot of Montmartre, in the heart of one of Paris's trendiest districts. Just one kilometer from attractions such as the Opéra Garnier, the Louvre Museum, and the renowned Rue de Rivoli, it offers excellent public transport links via the nearby Gare Saint-Lazare. Housed in an elegant building with a traditional Parisian facade, the hotel blends classic design with trendy decor, creating a welcoming atmosphere. The beautifully appointed rooms feature comfortable furniture and modern amenities, and accessible rooms are available. Guests can enjoy a delicious breakfast in the modern breakfast room and unwind with a drink at the cozy hotel bar after a long day. City tax is payable on arrival, up to €5 per person per day.

79856.description: Situated close to the Parly 2 shopping centre, 15km from the Eiffel Tower and 25km from Orly Airport, the 4-star Mercure Versailles Parly 2 offers comfortable, air-conditioned rooms. With a stylish and welcoming interior, you will find all the facilitiesy ou need for a quietly industrious business trip, plus a hotel bar for when you need to unwind. This hotel has a range of quality services making it equally suitable for conferences or family breaks.

79873.description: This stylish hotel is perched on a quiet corner of the Cannaregio district, where the atmosphere of old Venice has been preserved, off the tourist track and full of old restaurants and taverns. Yet all the sights are within easy walking distance, provided the property lies only 5 minutes to the Rialto Bridge and 10 minutes to St Mark's Square. The establishment is an example of Venice's minor architecture, but preserves the fascination of the ancient city. The moment travellers enter via the distinctive courtyard, they will be received by romantic atmosphere of the Venice of times gone by. The rooms and suites are characterised by a wealth of detail, fin de siècle period furniture, sumptuous tapestry and modern amenities. Guests may take advantage of the mouth-watering breakfast served at the enchanting dining room and after a busy day of meetings or sightseeing relax on the rooftop terrace offering quaint city views.

79876.description:
Situated in the heart of Geneva, this charming hotel offers convenient access to the main train station, public transport, and the shopping district. The scenic Lake Geneva, international organizations, Palexpo exhibition center, and Geneva International Airport are all within a 15-minute radius. Guests enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Each tastefully decorated and stylishly furnished room includes satellite/cable TV and a radio. Please note: Reception is open from 8 am to 3 pm. For later arrivals, please inform the hotel in advance. All rooms feature a washbasin, with showers and WCs shared between three rooms. The city tax is included in the price. 
IT IS MANDATORY TO CONTACT THE HOTEL BEFORE ARRIVAL TO GET ACCESS CODES AND THE FREE TRANSPORT CARD by email info@stgervais-geneva. ch or phone number +41227324572 at the reception hours from 07:00 - 15:00.

79877.description: Thanks to our location in the Neukölln district, you’ll only be a 15-minute drive away from Berlin Brandenburg Airport at our Premier Inn Berlin City Sud hotel. There’s plenty nearby to keep you entertained throughout your stay – we’re just a 35-minute drive from the city centre, where you’ll find Berlin attractions like the East Side Gallery and Brandenburg Gate! Plus, other popular places to visit near Berlin like Treptower Park and the Gropius Passagen shopping centre are right on our doorstep too. After fun days out in Germany’s capital, you can look forward to laid-back drinks back at our bar in the evenings, followed by a cosy night’s sleep in a super-comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions.

79934.description: Miarosa Konaklı Garden is located in Antalya, Alanya region. The distance of the facility from the sea is between 500 - 600 meters. The facility also considers the comfort of children and offers babysitting services. The complex has its own private sandy beach. On its 100 meters long beach you can enjoy the sea. You have the opportunity to cool off in the outdoor pool. You will not only swim in the sea, but you can also practice water sports such as pedal boat and canoe.

79977.description: This hotel enjoys a stunning setting in Villalba. The hotel is located in Collado Villalba, amidst the Sierra de Guadarrama. Many ski resorts can be found just a short distance away. El Escorial is located just a 15 minutes' driving distance away from the hotel. This modern hotel is surrounded by meadows, enjoying an atmosphere of peace and serenity. The guest rooms are superbly designed, offering comfort and convenience in a relaxed setting. Guests are sure to appreciate the many facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. Guests can enjoy a superb dining experience in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant.

80053.description: Located in the vibrant Bercy district, near Gare de Lyon and the Palais Omnisports, this hotel offers easy access to Paris's main attractions, including the Louvre and Eiffel Tower, via nearby Metro stations. It features hundreds of modern, comfortable rooms with Wi-Fi and private bathrooms. A friendly, attentive staff is available 24/7 to assist guests. After a day of sightseeing, unwind at the hotel bar, banquet hall, or fitness room.

80199.description: Indulge in a pampering experience at the full-service spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take a refreshing dip in one of the two outdoor swimming pools or unwind on the private beach. This all-inclusive property features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a game room. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments, with some exceptions for specialty dining and drinks. Savor delicious meals at one of the four restaurants, enjoy convenient room service (limited hours), or grab a snack at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind with a drink at the beach bar, poolside bar, or one of the two lounges. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast served from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel offers 341 guestrooms equipped with minibars and LCD televisions, each with a private balcony and satellite programming. Wi-Fi is available (surcharge). Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Located near Side West Beach, the hotel is also within a short distance of attractions such as Sulton Hamam Side, the Roman Ruins of Side, and Kumköy Beach.

80204.address: Cankurtaran Mahallesi Akbıyık Cd.Terbıyık Sk. No 7, 7
80204.description: The Tria Hotel Istanbul, located in the heart of Sultanahmet on Istanbul's historic peninsula, offers a unique blend of classic and modern design. Inspired by its name, 'Tria, ' the hotel provides a comfortable, home-like atmosphere where mystical style meets modern design. This charming hotel offers stunning views of the Marmara Sea and the Asian side. Its 20 deluxe and standard rooms provide spacious and comfortable accommodations for both business and leisure travelers. Each air-conditioned room is thoughtfully appointed for a relaxing stay. The hotel's quiet neighborhood and double-glazed windows ensure a peaceful night's sleep in the heart of this vibrant city.

80350.description: The Novotel Istanbul Zeytinburnu offers upscale comfort in a central location. Rooms feature modern furnishings, TVs, minibars, and stunning views of the Marmara Sea. The hotel provides multilingual service and boasts a sauna, massage services, a swimming pool, free parking, and a shop. Suitable for both family and business trips, the Novotel Istanbul Zeytinburnu is an excellent choice for city explorers and accessible to guests with disabilities.

80351.description: Ibis Istanbul Zeytinburnu delivers, comfort and high-quality service in a tremendous location. Being equipped with a brand new collection of furniture, cable TV, a safe and secured parking lot, the hotel offers the comfort of a real home. Being in the heart of Istanbul, Ibis Istanbul Zeytinburnu serves tasty and fresh varieties of traditional and international cuisine cooked by professional chefs. Ibis Istanbul Zeytinburnu is a good choice for city explorers as well as disabled guests.

80460.description: Make yourself at home right in the heart of the city centre of Amsterdam. Ibis Styles Amsterdam Central Station is stylish and ideally located right across Amsterdam's central train station. Reach the hotel in 30 minutes by taxi or train from Schiphol Airport. If you like shopping, then this hotel is ideally situated. Within 5 minutes you can be on Dam Square, Kalverstraat, and the 9 Streets area. Walk through the lively Jordaan area to reach the Anne Frank House in only 10 minutes.

80465.description: Located in the heart of Madrid's Centro district, the 4. 5-star ME Madrid by Melia is just a short walk from iconic landmarks such as Puerta del Sol (3 minutes) and the Thyssen-Bornemisza National Museum (7 minutes). This stylish hotel offers 192 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with an iPod docking station, LED television, and pillowtop bed with premium bedding. Guests can enjoy complimentary wired and wireless internet access, premium TV channels, and designer toiletries in the bathrooms. Recreational amenities include a health club and bicycle rentals. The hotel also provides convenient features like complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Savor Mediterranean cuisine at Ana la Santa, the hotel's restaurant and bar/lounge. Room service is available during limited hours, and a daily buffet breakfast is offered for a fee. Additional amenities include a business center, express check-in and check-out, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge). Self-parking is also available onsite (subject to charges).

80521.description: This city hotel is a modern property some 300 m from the port in Piraeus and 8 km from Athens and the Acropolis. The hotel, which has 30 rooms in total, has a lobby with 24-hour reception, currency exchange facility and lift access. Facilities include a bar and limited dining facilities (breakfast room). Also the hotel offers a TV room. Guestrooms are air-conditioned and feature a simple white decor with brightly-coloured fabrics, prints on the walls and dark wood furniture. All rooms have a private shower, balcony offering a view of the street, direct dial phone and a TV. Guests can order drinks and snacks in the informal mezzanine setting of the lounge bar, with its warm decor and dark wood furnishings.

80522.description: The hotel is situated 20 minutes from the centre of Athens, close to Karaiskaki square, where there is the bus station terminal offering connection to the international airport and Piraeus underground station from which Kifissia can be reached. This family-run city hotel, which has 25 rooms in total, offers standard accommodation simply decorated and with modern comfort in mind. There is a breakfast room, a bar with a friendly atmosphere and a TV at the comfortable hotel's lounge. It is air-conditioned and has a lobby with 24-hour reception, currency exchange facility and lift access. The rooms come with shower, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, radio and individually adjustable air conditioning.

80630.address: Saraç İshak, Tiyatro Cd. No:114, 34130 Fatih
80630.description:
Featuring a Turkish restaurant with panoramic Bosphorus and sea views, Grand Liza Hotel is just 600 metres (5 minutes' walk) from the Grand Bazaar. Free Wi-Fi is available. The rooms are air-conditioned and we have bathrooms in the room

Liza's rooms are fitted with warm, simple wooden furniture. They come with a minibar and satellite TV. Most rooms offer views of the Marmara Sea. 

The hotel serves a buffet breakfast every morning. 

Located in the Kumkapi district, Grand Liza Hotel is a 15-minute walk from the Sultanahmet Mosque and less than 25 minutes from Topkapi Palace. The Grand Bazaar is a 5-minute walk away.

80633.description:
Luxury boutique hotel in Istanbul. This luxurious boutique hotel is situated on the shores of Bosporus, in one of the residential area with high level of the Asian part of Istanbul. The Sumahan on the water has 13 light and large minimalist rooms with neutral colours. All the rooms and suites of the hotel have access to the Bosporus and fireplaces, which turns them into real dream places. Waterfront Restaurant is a casual-chic bistro/café in Çengelköy, Istanbul that starts the day off with a rich open breakfast buffet between 07. 30am - 10. 30am followed by an all-day Turkish and International cuisine à la carte menu. The waterfront terrace is a perfect place for winding down with an afternoon tea, sunset drinks or celebrating a special event. Small groups can also enjoy specially crafted menus for brunch, lunch or dinner. Sumahan hotel provides businesses privacy in the heart of Istanbul. Whether it's for an emergency meeting or a company retreat, Istanbul's leading business are discovering the secluded and scenic atmosphere of Sumahan's meeting facilities as a convenient place to get ideas flowing and quietly get the job done. 
***** THIS HOTEL DOES NOT ACCEPT CHILDREN UNDER 14 YEARS OLD ******

80635.address: Evliya Çelebi, Refik Saydam Cd No:37, 37
80635.description: This elegant, modern hotel is excellently situated in the Beyoğlu district of Istanbul and enjoys fantastic views over the Golden Horn and the beautiful old city. It is only steps away from famous Istiklal shopping street and within walking distance of Taksim Square, the heart of the Turkish capital. The hotel is ideal for business travellers and holidaymakers alike, as it features a spa area with sauna and hammam as well as a business centre.

80670.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at Hôtel Francois 1er, an upscale hotel in Paris's 8th Arrondissement, just a 3-minute walk from the Champs-Élysées and 9 minutes from the Arc de Triomphe. The hotel offers 40 guestrooms equipped with minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), a snack bar, room service (limited hours), a bar/lounge, and buffet breakfast (fee applies). Business travelers will appreciate the business center, limo service, and express check-in. Nearby attractions include Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore (0. 7 km) and Grand Palais (1 km). The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

80676.description: The AC Hotel Recoletos by Marriott offers a delightful stay in Madrid, just steps from Puerta de Alcalá and Paseo del Prado. Enjoy amenities such as a fitness center, garden, and a snack bar/deli. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies), and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Each of the 63 guestrooms features a minibar, espresso maker, and flat-screen TV. Complimentary Wi-Fi and private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations are also included. For business travelers, a business center, meeting room, and conference space are available. Self-parking is available for a fee.

80742.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul, the Martinenz Hotel offers convenient access to the city's vibrant attractions. Within a five-minute drive of the Grand Bazaar and the Blue Mosque, and a short distance from the Egyptian Bazaar and Hagia Sophia, the hotel provides a comfortable base for exploration. Guests can enjoy a variety of amenities including a steam room, terrace, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a 24-hour room service option from the Terrace Restaurant and Bar. The 95 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, LCD televisions with satellite channels, and private bathrooms with deep soaking bathtubs. Express check-in/check-out and dry cleaning/laundry services are also available, and an airport shuttle can be arranged for a surcharge.

80750.description: A spacious New York City hotel with all the comforts of home and a location in the heart of the city that never sleeps, is a dream come true. Expansive apartment-style suites feature fully outfitted kitchens with a stove, oven, microwave, dishwasher, and kitchenware for up to six people. The Best Western Plus Hospitality House dishes up complimentary breakfast daily. Enjoy piping hot eggs and waffles, cereals and yogurts, fruits, pastries, juices and 100% Arabica coffee. Best Western Plus Hospitality House has you covered. No other New York City hotel can compete with these oversized rooms, great location and two hotel restaurants. We're located within walking distance of Times Square, Grand Central Station, and numerous transportation hubs. Free Wi-Fi/high-speed internet access and a fitness center keep you connected and up with your fitness routine. The unique apartment suites at Hospitality House are just the beginning. Enjoy easy access to the Empire State Building, Rockefeller Center®, United Nations and Chrysler Building. Business travelers enjoy a homey environment complete with friendly staff. This New York City hotel regularly hosts employees of embassies, consulates, and numerous Fortune 500 companies' headquarters. This property is designed to be a home away from home; oak floors and 11-foot ceilings are a warm welcome. Choose from one-bedroom apartment suites or apartment suites that offer two bedrooms for your stay. Only pillow top beds are offered to guests at this New York City hotel for a restful nights’ sleep. The hotel features two restaurants, Abaita (Kosher) and La Bellezza Pizza. Complimentary fitness center access nearby with all equipment and classes, as well as a basketball court, sauna steam room, and two inviting swimming pools all included for adult guests. When done with your workout, a full amenity package awaits you in your bath.

80752.description: Located in the heart of Elizabeth, the Renaissance Newark Airport Hotel is a short drive from Kean University and The Mills at Jersey Gardens. This upscale hotel is also convenient to Cape Liberty Cruise Port (17. 4 km) and the Statue of Liberty (19. 8 km). Guests can enjoy a 24-hour fitness center, Wi-Fi (surcharge), gift shops, and a ballroom. The hotel offers 396 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations, flat-screen televisions with cable programming, and private bathrooms. Ironbound restaurant serves American cuisine and has a bar/lounge. Room service is available during limited hours, and buffet breakfast is offered daily for a fee. Additional amenities include a computer station, express check-in/check-out, and a complimentary 24-hour airport shuttle.

80782.description: Nestled in the heart of Paris's 1st district, between the Louvre Museum and the prestigious Rue Saint-Honoré, the Empire Hotel, a member of Hotels & Preference, offers a luxurious escape. This magnificent 18th-century hôtel particulier boasts exquisite design and a serene atmosphere, perfect for both business and leisure travelers. The recently renovated boutique hotel features 42 spacious rooms and suites, each bathed in natural light. Minimalist design and modern amenities, including state-of-the-art audio and video features, create a relaxing and comfortable environment. Enjoy the intimate atmosphere of the Petit Salon Fumoir, a unique lounge reminiscent of a traditional smoking room, ideal for business lunches or a quiet coffee by the fireplace. The hotel also features a stylish bar lounge serving sophisticated cocktails and some rooms and suites offer private terraces and Jacuzzi tubs. A spa is also planned for future enjoyment.

80952.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Make yourself at home in one of the 50 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. National Theatre of Greece - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Omonoia Square - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Athens City Hall - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Athens Central Market - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Ermou Street - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- National Archaeological Museum - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Monastiraki Flea Market - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Hadrian's Library - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Ancient Agora of Athens - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Adrianou Street - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Academy of Athens - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Pedion Areos Park - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Stoa of Attalos - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Roman Agora - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Maria Callas Museum - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi. The preferred airport for The Athens Mirabello is Athens Intl. Airport (ATH) - 40. 4 km / 25. 1 mi A stay at The Athens Mirabello places you in the heart of Athens, within a 15-minute walk of Ermou Street and National Archaeological Museum. This hotel is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Monastiraki Flea Market and 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Ancient Agora of Athens.

80985.description: With a stay at California, you'll be centrally located in Barcelona, steps from La Rambla and 12 minutes by foot from Port de Barcelona. This hotel is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Plaça de Catalunya and 0. 2 mi (0. 4 km) from Barcelona Cathedral. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a reception hall. Stay in one of 29 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Plaça Reial - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi- La Rambla - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Gran Teatre del Liceu - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Palau Güell - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Barcelona Cathedral - 0. 4 km/0. 2 mi- Pompeu Fabra University - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Boqueria Market - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Portal de l'Angel - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Barcelona Wax Museum - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Rambla del Raval - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Maritime Museum - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Picasso Museum - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Basilica de Santa Maria del Mar - 0. 7 km/0. 5 mi- Columbus Monument - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- El Corte Ingles - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi. The preferred airport for California is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 15. 8 km/9. 8 mi.

81083.description: Situated in Paris's prestigious 16th arrondissement, just a short stroll from the Champs-Élysées and Arc de Triomphe, the Keppler hotel offers a luxurious retreat. This boutique hotel, designed by Pierre-Yves Rochon, features a striking black and white aesthetic. The surrounding area boasts charming cafes, renowned restaurants, and vibrant cabarets. Discerning travelers will appreciate the hotel's blend of modern design and classic elegance.

81150.description: A warm welcome and traditional hospitality await guests at the Plough and Harrow Hotel in Edgbaston, Birmingham. The red brick Victorian architecture of the original building, along with its large garden, lawns, and ample parking, distinguishes the Plough & Harrow from other Birmingham hotels. Built in 1704 as a wayside inn, the hotel boasts a rich history. It was renowned as one of Birmingham's most popular hotels in the 1980s and early 1990s, even earning the Egon Ronay Hotel of the Year award in 1984. Its restaurant was *the* place to dine, attracting celebrities, politicians, and prominent figures. Following a period of underinvestment and changing ownership, the hotel returned to private hands in 2010 under TTM Partnership LLP. They've embarked on a 10-year phased investment and refurbishment plan, aiming to restore the hotel to its former glory as a high-quality, independent boutique hotel. The owners envision the Plough and Harrow as the preferred choice for corporate and leisure travelers, weddings, local functions, and casual dining. Future plans include expanding the hotel and potentially adding a spa and beauty facility around 2020 or later, after the existing public areas and bedrooms are refurbished.

81212.description: Featuring chic interiors, Samsun Airport Resort Hotel is located conveniently close to Congress and Expo Centre and Yeni Yasar Dogu Sports Complex in Tekkekoy district. Property offers an outdoor pool and a sauna. The hotel offers modern rooms with air conditioning and free Wi-Fi. The soundproofed rooms of Samsun Airport Resort Hotel are equipped with comfortable furniture in soft colours. They all include a seating area, TV and a minibar. Meals can be enjoyed indoors or outdoors in the garden, around the pool. The hotel has 2 bars offering a variety of drinks and snacks. Amisos Hill is 14 km from the hotel. Gazi Museum can be reached with a 10-minute drive. Bandirma Pier and Carsamba Airport is only a 5-minute drive away.

81214.address: Selcuk Mah.Mermerli Sokak no: 17 Kaleici Antalya, 15
81214.description: This hotel, nestled in the heart of Antalya, is a 3-minute stroll from the beach and a 5-minute walk from the city center. Housed within three beautifully restored, century-old Ottoman townhouses, this unique hotel seamlessly blends history with modern comfort. The 66 guest rooms retain their historic grace while offering amenities such as individually adjustable air conditioning and heating, a minibar, internet access, satellite TV, and an en-suite bathroom. Guests can enjoy a refreshing dip in the Roman-style outdoor pool, relax on the sun loungers, or savor international cuisine in the charming restaurant and garden terrace. Additional amenities include a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, and Wi-Fi. Nearby attractions include the Antalya City Museum (3 km), Perge (20 km), Aspendos Ancient Theatre (40 km), and Side (50 km). Antalya Airport is approximately 13 km away.

81231.description: The hotel is located in the heart of the city and linked directly to Birmingham International Convention Centre and Symphony Hall. It is within walking distance of Broad Street and Brindley Place, the city's vibrant nightlife area. The family-friendly residence features deluxe accommodation combining a central location, beneficial for both business and leisure travellers. It comprises a total of 319 guest rooms and guests are invited to make use of a number of in-house facilities and services. They can wine and dine in the two restaurants, one of which is located at the main lobby level under a unique glass-roofed atrium, and the other offers a relaxed atmosphere nestled around Roman pillars and naturalistic surroundings.

81253.description: Enjoy a central Madrid stay at Hotel Moderno, within a 10-minute walk of Plaza Mayor and San Miguel Market. This hotel offers 96 air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies), and utilize convenient amenities such as concierge services, a communal living room, and a computer station. Hotel Moderno is also conveniently located 1. 1 miles from both the Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía and the Thyssen-Bornemisza National Museum.

81261.description: This refined hotel is situated right on Berlin's famous Kurfürstendamm Boulevard, housed in a historic turn-of-the-century building that combines history and design. The hotel is by the area's exclusive shops, boutiques and designer stores, as well as the Berlin Theatre and Komödie am Kurfürstendamm. In the vicinity, there are a number of excellent restaurants, as well as public transportation links to the many points of interest in this vibrant city. The hotel offers 163 guest rooms, equipped with a flat-screen TV, safe, work desk, hair dryer, and free Wi-Fi. The hotel also offers private garage parking and parking spaces for guests arriving by car.

81264.description: This wonderful hotel is located on the coast, right on the beach, and guests have the unique splendours of the Mediterranean at their feet. Guests will find Kemer town centre and the tourist centre just 5 minutes away. It is 45 km to Antalya city centre and 55 km to Antalya Airport. Guests of this establishment can enjoy privileged and outstanding service through warm, sincere, friendly, respectful and hard-working hotel staff. This hotel offers a mini supermarket, a bar and a disco, amongst other facilities. The younger guests will enjoy the children's playground and the kids' club. All rooms come with a private bathroom with shower and modern amenities to ensure utmost comfort.

81294.description: This club resort is located in central Konakli, Alanya, just 12km from Alanya's city center and approximately 100km from Antalya Airport. Built in 2006, this resort features a garden and terrace, offering a total of 530 guest rooms. The air-conditioned establishment welcomes guests into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, a safe, currency exchange, lift access, and a hair salon. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a games room, children's playground, kids' club, bar, disco, and breakfast room. Conference facilities, internet access, and parking are also available. Room and laundry services are offered for an additional fee. The elegant and spacious guest rooms feature a bathroom with a bathtub, WC, and hairdryer, along with satellite TV, a direct-dial telephone, individual air conditioning, a furnished balcony, music, and a safe. Sixty non-smoking rooms are available. The hotel boasts two swimming pools: a heated indoor pool and an outdoor pool with a children's area, poolside snack bar, sun loungers, and parasols. Guests can work out in the gym (fees apply) or participate in aerobics or aqua fit sessions. Relaxation options include a sauna and steam room, with spa and massage treatments available for a fee. Other activities include canoeing, squash, tennis, table tennis, pool/snooker (fees apply), basketball, volleyball, beach volleyball, and bowling (for a fee). Sun loungers and parasols are provided on the nearby sandy beach, where water sports such as waterskiing, jet skiing, and banana boating are available for an extra charge. The hotel also organizes entertainment programs for adults and children. Dinner is served à la carte, and all-inclusive packages are available.

81433.description: Don't miss out on recreational opportunities including a sauna and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy Argentinean cuisine at Restaurante Las Cupulas, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Buenos Aires? This hotel has 97 square feet (9 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 103 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and plasma televisions. Your Select Comfort bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Rooms have private balconies.

81709.description: The hotel is located close to the port of Piraeus, which is a great spot for all guests who are travelling to the Greek Islands. The hotel is a great choice for a stay before heading for the Greek islands. This facility offers 50 accommodations, which are standard-issue and pleasant to stay in. Facilities available to guests at the hotel include a lobby with 24-hour reception with check-in and check-out service and a hotel safe. There are a breakfast room and very nice bar as well. This first-class hotel is open all year round and was recently renovated. Guests can enjoy their stay in the clean and airy rooms, each of which feature a private en suite bathroom with shower, a TV and individually regulated air conditioning.

81712.description: Centrally located in Athens, Pan Hotel is steps from Ermou Street and a 3-minute walk from Syntagma Square. This hotel offers 33 guestrooms with private balconies, minibars, and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi and 24-hour room service are provided. Enjoy the convenience of a complimentary buffet breakfast, a coffee shop/cafe, and a bar/lounge. Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center. Nearby attractions include the Acropolis (0. 7 km) and the Ancient Agora of Athens (0. 8 km).

81713.description: Centrally located in Athens, Lozenge Hotel offers convenient access to Ermou Street (a 4-minute walk) and Syntagma Square (a 6-minute walk). This hotel features 25 guestrooms equipped with minibars, plasma televisions, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Enjoy amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, a rooftop terrace with city views, bicycle rentals, and concierge services. A restaurant and bar/lounge are available for dining and drinks. Business travelers will appreciate the business center and 24-hour front desk. Nearby attractions include the Acropolis and Monastiraki Flea Market.

81896.description: Located just 800 meters from Granollers city center and 25 km from Barcelona, this hotel, fully renovated in 2007, offers 110 well-equipped rooms and a wide array of services. Guests enjoy a 24-hour reception, on-site café, restaurant, and bar, along with free Wi-Fi in public areas and complimentary public parking. Each room features a hairdryer, individually controlled air conditioning, direct-dial telephone, minibar, TV, and radio. Special requests, including bridal suites, soundproofed rooms, and non-smoking rooms, can be made upon booking. The hotel also provides exclusive health, beauty, and fitness packages and is a gay-friendly establishment.

81936.description:
Genius discounts at this property are subject to booking dates, stay dates, and other available deals. 

Experience the brand-new OYO Times Square, where you’ll enjoy a modern stay. Fresh new artwork and décor throughout the rooms and common spaces make OYO Times Square a comfortable respite from the bustling excitement of Manhattan. The hotel is less than half a block from Times Square, the Theater District and Fifth Avenue, two blocks from Restaurant Row, and four from Rockefeller Center. Walk just a bit further and you’re at the Empire State Building, Central Park, and Greenwich Village. 

And when looking for a great place to eat, you won’t have to go far – onsite restaurant Serendipity 3 has charmed New Yorkers and visitors alike with their famed frozen hot chocolate in their historic spot on the Upper East Side, and now, you can find them in the very center of it all. But of course, you’re going to order the aforementioned frozen hot chocolate, but don’t sleep on the Times Square exclusive savory Sunday Chicken Dinner Sundae, either

This family friendly Manhattan hotel features on-site restaurant with city views and modern in-room amenities, including flat-screen TVs. The hotel is 100% Non-smoking. 

Accommodations at OYO Times Square are furnished with a variety of amenities, including a feather beds and linens. The hotel also offers free weekday newspapers and wireless internet access. 

Pets allowed for an extra charge of USD 100 per pet, per stay. 

Early check-in subject to availability with additional charges.

81978.address: Circuit De La Palmeraie Nakhil Bp 12338
81978.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. For recreation, you'll find a health club and an outdoor pool. This guesthouse also provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, snacks at the coffee shop, or 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Additional amenities include limo/town car service, express check-in/check-out, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge, available 24 hours). Free self-parking is available onsite. The 22 individually decorated guestrooms feature minibars, DVD players, private balconies or patios, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, 72-inch LCD TVs with cable programming, and private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and bidets. Located in Marrakech's Palmeraie district, Palais Mehdi is within a 10-minute drive of Majorelle Garden and Avenue Mohamed VI. Nearby attractions include Musée Aman pour la Civilsation de l'Eau au Maroc (0. 7 mi), Palmeraie Palace Golf (1. 5 mi), and Le Grand Casino de la Mamounia (3. 7 mi). The preferred airport is Menara Airport (RAK), 8. 5 mi away.

81980.address: 47 Et 48 Rue De La Bahia, Medina, 47 et 48
81980.description: This Moroccan guesthouse is located in the heart of the old Medina, featuring a swimming pool on the terrace. It's a short distance from Marrakech's historic sites, including Bahia Palace, Dar Si Said, and the Saadian Tombs. Jamaa Lafna Square is 200 meters away, while restaurants, bars, and clubs are within a 10-20 minute walk. Medina shops are a mere 10-minute stroll away. Bab Doukala bus station is a 15-minute drive, and parking is 100 meters from the guesthouse. The air-conditioned guesthouse offers 16 comfortable rooms equipped with essential amenities. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour check-out service, a safe, a café, a restaurant, and room and laundry services. Additional amenities include a bar, a modern TV lounge, and a traditional Moroccan hammam. The vast, flowered terrace offers magnificent views of the Atlas Mountains and the Medina. Rooms feature air conditioning and private bathrooms with showers and WCs. Guests can relax on the sun terrace with parasols, unwind in the steam bath, and indulge in massage treatments. The guesthouse chef prepares excellent Moroccan dishes tailored to guests' preferences, served on the open-air terrace or covered patio for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

81981.description:
Located in the middle of the city, the hotel (classified by the Moroccan official services) is a very accessible guesthouse. It is the ideal place from which to discover true Moroccan culture. Menara International Airport in Marrakech is only 4 km away.

Built in 2005, this hotel combines traditional style with contemporary comfort. In this beautiful guesthouse, calm and comfortable living make every guest's stay more enjoyable. The hotel offers 24-hour check-in and check-out service.

Each room has a special mood and colour with furniture made from local materials. All rooms include a bathroom with tadelakt and bathtub/shower and artisanal wash basin of copper or plate marble, WC and individually regulated air conditioning/heating, depending on the season. Other amenities include hairdryer, satellite/cable TV, Internet access, tea and coffee making facilities, a washing machine, a double or king-size bed and a terrace.
