The hotel has a small swimming pool for relaxation, as well as a large terrace and a solarium. Massage service is also offered.

A European-style breakfast is served daily. A cup of tea will be offered each evening on the patio near the fountain or by the swimming pool.

name.content: B&B HOTEL Barcelona Mollet Porta de Gallecs

81986.description: This hotel lies just 18 km away from the culturally-rich city of Barcelona. It is just a 30 minutes' driving distance away from the golden-sand beaches of the Costa Dorada. The charming town of Mollet del Valles is located nearby, where guests will find a choice of typical bars and restaurants. The forests of the Gallecs Natural Park is located within easy access of the hotel. The old parish church of Santa Maria dels Gallecs is just a short distance away from the hotel. This charming hotel is immersed in culture and history. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, featuring soothing tones for a peaceful ambiance. The hotel offers facilities and services to meet the needs of every type of traveller.

82012.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as bicycles to rent, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and a television in a common area. Additional amenities at this hotel include tour/ticket assistance, a vending machine, and bike parking. Take advantage of the hotel's room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 45 air-conditioned rooms featuring LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. This hotel is 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Rembrandt Square and 1. 1 mi (1. 8 km) from Leidseplein.

82130.description: The hotel is located in the Bur Dubai area, near key business and leisure destinations in the city, making it an ideal base for all travelers. There is a variety of shopping malls as well as textile and computer markets are a few minutes' walk from the hotel, along with legendary shopping area of Meena Bazar, the Dubai Museum and the Ruler's Court. Facilities include a lobby, bars, restaurants, hotel safe, currency exchange, lift access, a café, a hairdresser, conference facilities, Wi-Fi, room and laundry services and parking for those arriving by car.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel, Dubai Media City

82131.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools and a health club. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. If you'd like to spend the day shopping, you can hop on the complimentary shuttle. Grab a bite at Chefs House, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 6265 square feet (582 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms.

82165.address: Binbirdirek Mah Terzihane Sok No 9 Sultanahmet, No:9
82165.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul's historic Old City, this newly opened hotel is surrounded by Ottoman-era landmarks. Guests can enjoy on-site dining, shopping, and conference facilities, as well as a Turkish bath, gym, and sauna. All air-conditioned rooms include en suite bathrooms, complimentary internet access, and LCD TVs. The rooftop restaurant offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Old Peninsula, including the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. For airport transfers or sightseeing tours, please contact the concierge at info@ladydianahotel. com.

82379.description: Located in Mumbai’s Art Deco district with panoramic views of the Arabian Sea, InterContinental Marine Drive-Mumbai stands out with its spacious accommodations, stunning rooftop pool and exquisite dining. Our rooftop bar, Dome, features the finest wine, food, and music under the stars. L&S Bistro & Pizzeria offers international comfort food, and heritage North Indian recipes are given a contemporary touch at Kebab Korner. Step outside our prime location and explore all that Mumbai has to offer.

82381.address: Khalid Bin Waleed Road Bur Dubai
82381.description: The hotel is located right in the heart of Dubai, making most places in the city easily accessible. Sheikh Zayed road is just 7 minutes away, and Burjuman - one of Dubai's premiere malls - is a mere 5 minutes away. The golden sands and pristine waters of Dubai make for a great day at the beach, especially during the winter months. All 181 beautiful and spacious rooms are elegantly decorated and equipped with its convenient amenities. The hotel also offers restaurants serving international cuisine. Dubai International Airport is 7 km away from the hotel.

82382.address: Al Sabkha Road, Deira, Dubai, PO BOX 4867, 13
82382.description: This 2 star hotel is located in the city centre of Dubai and was established in 2000. It is close to the Gold Souk and the nearest metro station is GOLD SOUK . The Hotel has a coffee shop, an indoor swimming pool and an outdoor swimming pool. All 70 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, ironing set and air conditioning.

82384.description: The Four Seasons Hotel Doha is located in Doha's landmark waterfront development, the West Bay Business and Residential Complex. This prime location offers easy access to embassies, consulates, the Qatar International Exhibition Center, businesses, and tourist attractions. Combining proximity to the city's commercial center with 24/7 business services and resort-like amenities, including a private beach and a 110-berth marina, the hotel offers an unparalleled experience.

82390.description: This 2 star hotel is located in the city centre of Dubai and was established in 1986. It is a short drive away from the Gold Souq and the nearest station is Union Metro(Main Junction). The Hotel has a bar and a coffee shop. All 46 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, trouser press and air conditioning.

82492.address: Sarac Ishak Mah. Uysal Sokak NO 6 BEYAZIT
82492.description: This family-friendly city hotel is situated within easy walking distance of Istanbul's major places of interest. Guests will find restaurants, shops and links to the public transport network within 5 minutes' walk of the hotel. The decor of this air- conditioned establishment is modern with soft colour tones. Guests may enjoy a refreshment at the on site café or choose to dine at the restaurant, absorbing the magnificent views of the Sea of Marmara. Conference facilities and WLAN Internet access are sure to be appreciated by business travellers. The guestrooms are spacious, with double-glazed windows to ensure an undisturbed stay. Non-smoking floors are available.

82495.description:
This hotel enjoys a convenient location: It is just 30 min by car from Venice, 8 min from Padua, 20 min from Treviso and Vicenza, and is close to the A4 motorway. Furthermore, it is 3 km from Vigonza train station and 6 km from Dolo station and centre, located in the middle of the Riviera del Brenta.

Enjoying a quiet location close to the centre, this 47-room, 4-storey, air-conditioned hotel offers the best options for quality and price. Facilities include a 24-hour reception, a safe and lifts, as well as a café. Room and laundry services are also available. The hotel has several parking lots, outside the hotel grounds or in the secure underground garage, for tourist busses as well. Bikes are also available for hotel guests.

The rooms feature all modern comforts, such as individually regulated air conditioning and heating units, a direct dial telephone, Internet access, a double/king-size bed and a TV set. Further features include a PC outlet, safe and a minibar. All the bathrooms include a hairdryer, a shower and mosaic-tiled walls. Furthermore, the rooms feature a balcony or terrace.

If arriving from Milan, Rome, Bologna (A4, A13), take the A4 motorway exit Dolo-Mirano. Turn right at the 2nd exit on the roundabout following the signs to Dolo. Turn left after about 500 m, at the first traffic lights. After the bridge 200 m further on there is a second set of traffic lights; continue straight on and after 150 m guests will find via Monte Verena on the left where the hotel is located.

82530.description: With a stay at Catalonia Avinyó, you'll be centrally located in Barcelona, within a 5-minute walk of La Rambla and Barcelona Cathedral. This eco-certified hotel is 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from Port de Barcelona and 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Plaça de Catalunya. Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Make yourself at home in one of the 83 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Plaça Reial - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi- La Rambla - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Gran Teatre del Liceu - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Barcelona Cathedral - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Pompeu Fabra University - 0. 4 km/0. 2 mi- Palau Güell - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Portal de l'Angel - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Boqueria Market - 0. 6 km/0. 3 mi- Barcelona Wax Museum - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Picasso Museum - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Basilica de Santa Maria del Mar - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Rambla del Raval - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Maritime Museum - 0. 7 km/0. 5 mi- Columbus Monument - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Port de Barcelona - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi. The preferred airport for Catalonia Avinyó is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 16. 1 km/10 mi.

82572.description: Ideally situated in the heart of Athens, this city hotel is only an eight-minute walk from the fascinating National Archaeological Museum.   Sightseers will definitely wish to see the Acropolis and explore the New Acropolis Museum, and might also visit the Temple of Olympian Zeus and Museum of Cycladic Art, all easily accessible as the nearest metro station is only a five-minute walk from the hotel. The functional, air-conditioned guest rooms come with private en suite bathrooms and satellite television, and guests can wake up to a delightful American breakfast buffet in the rooftop restaurant.   The café bar serves drinks and snacks that can also be enjoyed while checking email or catching up on current events in the internet corner.   For a productive business trip or wonderful sightseeing holiday in Athens, this hotel's convenient location and comfortable rooms make it a great choice.

82610.address: Yeni Mahalle, Sehit Polis Cemal Ilgaz Cad., 1
82610.description: This hotel enjoys a wonderful setting close to the beach, just 1 km away from Kemer. Sitting on Turkey's Mediterranean Coast, the hotel is perfect for those who are eager to get away from it all. Set amidst an area of natural beauty, dotted with pine-forested mountains, the hotel is located close to a number of attractions. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from the ancient ruins of Phaselis and Olympos. This hotel comprises elegantly-designed guest rooms, which ooze charm and style. Guests are sure to be impressed by the many facilities and services that the hotel affords, and are sure to enjoy a memorable stay at this establishment.

82612.description: This eye-catching hotel, built in 2000 and fully renovated in 2011, offers 120 rooms, including 116 doubles, two suites, and one accessible room. Perfect for weekend getaways or longer holidays, the hotel provides a 24-hour reception, safe deposit boxes, a currency exchange, lift access, an on-site shop, and a relaxing garden. Guests can also enjoy laundry service, medical assistance if needed, bicycle storage, and a well-equipped gym. The hotel is wheelchair accessible and welcomes pets of all sizes. Check-out time is [insert time].

82652.description: Located in the heritage area of Dubai along the Deira Corniche, Dubai's renowned waterfront promenade, Hyatt Regency Dubai presents spacious, amenity-rich accommodations for booking that are both modern and stylish. This Deira hotel features a sophisticated interior palette of warm natural tones as well as fabulous views of Dubai's striking skyline and the stunning Arabian Gulf in all 421 rooms and suites. For added convenience, the hotel also offers Regency Club Rooms, which include an array of complimentary amenities. For added comfort and convenience, the Dubai hotel features Regency Club Rooms which provide complimentary amenities including boardroom usage, wireless Internet, access to a private lounge serving continental breakfast, evening cocktails and hors d'oeuvres, and other seasonal services and offers.

82653.address: Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Barsha. Po Box 120679.
82653.description:
With its premier location directly connected to the Mall of the Emirates, this hotel offers unparalleled convenience for both business and leisure travelers. World-class shopping, dining, and entertainment are just steps away in the heart of modern Dubai. The mall itself boasts more than 520 prestigious international brands, a 14-screen VOX Cinemas multiplex, countless dining options, and the world’s first indoor ski slope, Ski Dubai. A short drive from Dubai Internet City, Dubai Media City, Jumeirah Beach, and just 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport, the hotel features 350 rooms and suites, including 20 stunning Aspen Chalets. 
When it's time to unwind, guests can rejuvenate at the serene SENSASIA Stories Spa or lounge by the stunning outdoor pool. Culinary experiences await at every turn: indulge in authentic Spanish flavours at Salero, savour contemporary Italian cuisine at Vera Versilia, or treat yourself to a sumptuous afternoon tea at Aspen after a day of shopping. Here, the possibilities are truly limitless, ensuring an unforgettable stay for every guest.

82656.description: Located 5 minutes' walk from Al Rigga Metro Station, Hotel is an ideal destination for all travellers. The casual rooms with colourful decor provide free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs. Room service is available 24/7. Other amenities include a gym, a rooftop pool and a bright restaurant serving international fare. Airport transfers and sightseeing tours can be arranged (fee). In the morning, the hotel serves a buffet breakfast. There are 2 on-site restaurants that serve international and regional cuisine, as well as a 24-hour coffee shop that serves continental food. The hotel's tour desk assists with car hire and provides information on local attractions. Eureka Hotel is less than 3 km from Deira City Centre, Burjuman Mall and the Gold Souk.

name.content: Holiday Inn Luton South M1, JCT.9

82669.description: A modern Luton Airport hotel near the M1 with free parking, a smart restaurant and a poolHoliday Inn® Luton - South hotel offers family-friendly accommodation a 10-minute drive from Luton London Airport (LTN). The hotel's Park, Stay & Go package allows guests to catch flights refreshed, leaving their car in a secure parking lot. For staying guests parking is free, and the nearby M1 makes it easy to get around. Travelling with kids? The lions and elephants of Whipsnade Zoo are just five miles from the hotel, and it’s a 20-minute drive to the Harry Potter tour at Warner Bros. Studios. Milton Keyes, 30 minutes away, draws shoppers with thecentre:mk, a covered mall with over 200 shops plus restaurants and a special events hall. Grand St. Alban's Cathedral, with the longest nave in England, is just eight miles away. Business travelers appreciate the location a short drive from central Luton businesses. You can host anything from a client meeting to a banquet in one of the hotel's five purpose-built rooms. Free Wi-Fi, in-room work desks and a Business Centre will help you stay productive. The skylit pool and spa area is a lovely place to unwind or cool off after a workout in the fully equipped fitness centre. Treat yourself at Borders restaurant with a delicious buffet breakfast and à la carte dinner. Arriving late? There's 24-hour room service. Kids stay and eat free.

82693.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Take advantage of the aparthotel's room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Madrid? This aparthotel has 657 square feet (61 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 57 air-conditioned rooms featuring heated floors and flat-screen televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Kitchens are outfitted with stovetops and microwaves.

82695.description:
Located in about 33,000 m² of lush and verdant Atlantic Jungle, the hotel is close to rivers and mountains in one of the most exciting parts of Petropolis. It is only 5 km from the historic centre of the city and just 10 km from Itaipava.

This eco-hotel offers some 20 rooms in total and is decorated with the unique artwork made in the Molinaro Atelier. A lobby, bar, auditorium, TV room, restaurant and Internet access all feature. Parking facilities are available to guests arriving by car. Younger guests are sure to appreciate the playground.

Rooms are divided into the following categories: superior, luxury and suite. All features every amenity and convenience necessary for a comfortable stay at the hotel. They come with cable TV, Internet access, direct dial telephone, minibar, super king-size bed, microwave, individually-adjustable heating and en suite bathroom with hydro-massage bath.

Guests may take advantage of the outdoor swimming pool, sauna and spa treatments. Volleyball is also an option.

Breakfast is served as a buffet.

82698.description: This family friendly hotel is located in the centre of Buenos Aires, close to the Obelisk, one of the city's main historical landmarks. Also close by, are the famous pedestrian Florida street, and Colón Theatre, the largest opera house in South America. The hotel is a short walk from downtown, where guests will find the main shopping centres, the finest shops and restaurants, cinemas and the important financial and theatre districts.

82701.description:
Belek Beach Resort offers a unique holiday experience for everyone. Families will love our spacious, fun accommodations, while adults can find peace in the Elite +13 area, ideal for romantic getaways. We ensure every guest, from young to old, feels special with unforgettable moments. 

Our modern rooms blend elegance and comfort, with every detail designed for your relaxation. Our food and beverage units boast stunning architecture and diverse menus to satisfy all tastes. 

Enjoy thrilling slides and water games at our aquapark and indoor pool, heated for year-round comfort. Our Blue Flag certified beach provides a serene environment with crystal-clear waters. Day and evening programs, packed with activities, animations, and shows for all ages, guarantee a joyful holiday.

82730.address: Al Rigga Road - Dubai Po Box 14441
82730.description: This luxurious hotel enjoys a great location in Deira just minutes from Maktoum Bridge, which connects the old and new sections of Dubai with Jumeirah. The Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai Exhibition Centre can be reached in under a ten-minute drive and the city centre of Deira is within walking distance. Guests will also find a wide variety of options for shopping and dining nearby. The hotel's inviting guest rooms and suites are equipped with a range of modern amenities such as air-conditioning, cable television and minibar. Guests can choose from a restaurant, two bars and a café to enjoy local and international cuisines, and might choose to relax with a massage in the spa or make use of the gym, pool and sauna after a busy day of meetings, shopping or sightseeing. Whether travelling to Dubai for business or leisure, this comfortable hotel offers a wonderful stay.

82771.description: Located between Broadway and Fifth Avenue on 32nd Street, The Hotel at Fifth Avenue offers the captivating energy of Midtown Manhattan just steps from the Empire State Building. This intimate boutique hotel is within walking distance of iconic attractions such as the Fashion District, Macy's, and Madison Square Garden, with convenient access to Grand Central Station, Penn Station, and the Port Authority Bus Terminal. Enjoy easy access to transportation and explore nearby attractions including Radio City Music Hall, Central Park, and Times Square.

82839.description: Just a stone's throw from the most famous avenue in the world, the Champs Elysées, and just around the corner from the Triangle d'Or, the hotel's sandstone façade stands proud on Rue de Berri, in Paris' 8th arrondissement. The surroundings of the hotel are easily explored on foot, including the prestigious Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré, the Place de l'Etoile, and the Place de la Concorde. The Eiffel Tower and the Jardin des Tuileries are only 15 minutes away by public transport and is a 20 minute ride to the Louvre Museum. Orly Airport is 20 km away and it is some 30 km to Charles de Gaulle Airport. Located in the heart of Paris, the hotel is a luxurious hideaway, housed in a 19th century private mansion. This establishment has the feel of an elegant private residence and offers 46 rooms and 11 suites over 8 floors, in a plush atmosphere that cultivates lifestyle à la Française. Traditional furniture, paintings by old masters, antiques and the re-creation of historical fabrics celebrate the best of the decorative arts. Its interior courtyard has been transformed into a Zen garden retreat. This hotel has all the feel of a thoroughly charming and stylish traditional home. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility, a cloakroom, lift access, a bar, a restaurant, conference facilities and Internet access. Guests may also take advantage of the room and laundry services and there is parking for those arriving by car.

82861.description: Situated in Berlin's historic city center, near the vibrant Friedrichstrasse with its array of bars, restaurants, and attractions, this hotel offers convenient access to public transport, shopping, and both Tegel and Schoenefeld Airports. The six-story hotel features 100 double rooms and two single rooms, all accessible by lift. Guests can enjoy amenities such as Wi-Fi in public areas, a drinks machine, and accessible facilities. The air-conditioned rooms include carpeted floors, double beds, satellite TV, and private bathrooms with showers and hairdryers. Family rooms and non-smoking rooms are also available. On-site parking is provided for guests arriving by car.

82932.description: Why should you choose between comfort or convenience if you can have them both. Located right in the hear of Moema, just a few minutes from Congonhas airport and Ipirapuera Shopping Mall, the Intercity Premium Ibirapuera hotel is the perfect choice for people staying in São Paulo who want to have a break at the end of a long working day in a comfortable and pleasant environment. Here you are received by friendly staff, you rest in spacious and cozy rooms, and you enjoy a delicious breakfast in the morning. It is not by chance that Guia Quatro Rodas considered the hotel as one of the best hotels in its category in São Paulo capital.

82971.description: This historic Georgian townhouse welcomes guests to central Edinburgh, conveniently located near excellent bus services to the city center. Enjoy complimentary off-street parking and a continental breakfast served in your room. The hotel adheres to WTTC guidelines, with disinfected rooms and contactless check-in/check-out. Please contact the hotel for late arrival information and your lockbox code. All bathrooms are either ensuite or private. From this elegant and peaceful setting, explore the vibrant city of Edinburgh, with its unique blend of historical and modern attractions. Edinburgh Castle, the Scottish Museum, Holyrood Palace, Dynamic Earth, the Royal Mile, the University of Edinburgh, the Royal Commonwealth Pool, and golf courses are easily accessible. The hotel offers stunning views of Edinburgh's renowned architecture and beautiful hillsides from every room. Our staff is happy to assist with directions, tour bookings, and local information. Edinburgh has mainline rail connections to London and other parts of Scotland. We are a 20-minute drive from the airport and 5 minutes from Waverley Train Station.

83150.description: Located a short driving distance from London City Airport and only 3 km from Woolwich Ferry, this charming hotel is ideal for those seeking accommodation for a holiday stopover or wanting to explore the vibrant English capital. Travellers can explore the ExCel Exhibition Centre, an international exhibition and conference centre which hosts a variety of interesting events, or visit Upton Park to see the grounds of West Ham Football Club. For shopping fanatics, Galleons Reach Shopping is a dream centre where they can discover over 35 major stores all in one convenient location. Alternatively, if guests are looking for hotels near the world-famous O2 Arena then this is a great option, as the thriving entertainment venue is only 9 km away, making it the perfect place to stay if visitors have tickets for an up-and-coming show. The hotel has a fresh new look and features a new room design complete with Dreamer Bed so travellers can be sure of a great night's sleep. Guests staying at this modern property can take advantage of the café bar and parking facilities, all for a comfortable stay in London.

83175.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Grab a bite to eat at BREAKFAST HALL, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 63 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries.

83277.description: Located right at the heart of the cultural and entertainment district of Buenos Aires, this hotel is right next to the financial district. This air-conditioned hotel welcomes leisure and business guests in an Art Deco building with an avant-garde trend in decoration. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, currency exchange and lift access. Facilities include a garage with extra charge, 2 meeting rooms and medical assistance. For extra fees, WIFI access, room service, laundry and dry cleaning services are available. Sauna, gym and swimmming pool ( only enabled in the summer season , 1/12 to 21/3)

83371.description: Downtown, amidst cinemas, shops and restaurants, near the city's historical, cultural and entertainment sites, this is the ideal location to visit Buenos Aires. Bookshops, exciting nightlife, theatres, and the opera are all in the vicinity. Public transportation is only steps away, reaching all parts of the city. In the lobby, there is the 24-hour reception, hotel safe, luggage storage, currency exchange facilities, and lift access. There is a bar, a restaurant, business centre, and wireless internet access. Room service, laundry and dry cleaning services and a garage are available, for a fee.

name.content: Four Seasons Hotel Istanbul at Sultanahmet

83372.description: Don't miss out on recreational opportunities including a health club and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Grab a bite at Avlu Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 65 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and plasma televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Smart televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers.

83375.description: Intercity Premium Berrini is so cozy place that you end up forgetting you are in the largest business center of Brazil. Located in the busy region of Berrini, in São Paulo, just a few minutes from Morumbi Shopping Mall, Congonhas airport, and the American Consulate, this hotel is ideal for executives that are looking to combine work and convenience.   Spacious and comfortable rooms, friendly and helpful staff, and a leisure area with an amazing view of São Paulo capital are just a few of the many advantages offered by the hotel. Guia Quatro Rodas gave a great review about the hotel.

83396.description: Situated in the heart of Plaza San Martin, this charming hotel is surrounded by elegant shops and excellent restaurants. Just steps from Calle Florida and a short distance from Avenida Santa Fe, it offers convenient access to Avenida 9 de Julio, the Obelisco, and the Recoleta area. Ezeiza International Airport is a mere 25 km away. Housed in a building rich in European heritage, the hotel showcases a stunning blend of Neogothic, French, and Italian architectural styles. Its individually styled rooms and suites offer a unique experience. Guests can enjoy the onsite restaurant and conference facilities, catering to both business and leisure travelers. Reservations of 5 or more rooms are considered group bookings and may be subject to different rates and conditions.

83476.description:
Located in the Belgrano neighborhood, one of Buenos Aires’ most traditional and well-connected areas, our hotel offers the perfect balance of comfort, location, and services. Just steps from the River Plate Stadium and with immediate access to restaurants, shops, and public transportation along Avenida Cabildo, guests can reach the city center in only 25 minutes. The hotel is also conveniently located near parks, medical centers, and important cultural landmarks. 

Renovated in 2020, the hotel features 48 bright rooms across 10 floors, ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Guests enjoy a 24-hour front desk, elevator, currency exchange service, Wi-Fi, café, daily continental breakfast, and conference rooms accommodating up to 70 people. All rooms include a private bathroom with shower and hairdryer, individually controlled air conditioning and heating, satellite TV, direct-dial telephone, internet access, and a safety deposit box. A private garage is available for an additional nightly fee.

83477.description: Located in the heart of one of the most prestigious neighborhoods in Buenos Aires, LOI SUITES RECOLETA shares the area with the best restaurants, bars, art galleries and beautiful squares. The hotel has 112 spacious and bright rooms decorated in neutral colors providing a warm and comfortable atmosphere, ideal for a good rest. A secret garden in the heart of the city, surrounded by greenery and full of natural light is the ideal setting for a full breakfast offering a variety of homemade breads, hot dishes, fruits, cold cuts, natural juices, sweets and delicacies from our pastry chef. In each season, we offer a renewed menu of signature cuisine based on national products: meats, a variety of homemade pastas, rice dishes, salads and fresh fish. Throughout the year you can enjoy the heated swimming pool, surrounded by greenery and natural light.

83489.description: The hotel is located in the old town, in an area of the city steeped in a warm, peaceful and friendly atmosphere. Links to the public transport network, the bus station and Hadrianus Gate are all within 1 km from the hotel. Antalya Airport is approximately 12 km away. This air-conditioned city hotel is an example of the architectural style of the Kaleici with all modern conveniences. Renovated in 2007, it comprises a total of 36 rooms on 3 floors. Facilities on offer include a bar and restaurant, and business guests can make use of the conference rooms. Some units offer a stunning view over the beautiful Kaleici Marina and Toros Mountains. All are air- conditioned and come with an en suite bathroom. There is an outdoor swimming pool on-site, complete with sun loungers and parasols.

83572.description: Situated in Cape Sounion, Attica's southernmost point, this hotel offers proximity to the renowned Temple of Poseidon. Located 60 km south of Athens and 30 km from Eleftherios Venizelos Airport, it's easily accessible and nestled among pine trees, just 200 meters from the beach. The rooms feature air conditioning, a refrigerator, a balcony, a telephone, and a TV. Greek specialties are served at the hotel's restaurant until late in the evening.

83595.description:
This hotel is located in central Buenos Aires, just steps away from the pedestrian zone and 6 blocks from the Obelisk and major tourist sights such as the Plaza de Mayo. Guests will find San Telmo 5 minutes' drive from the hotel, Barrio La Boca 10 minutes and the Puerto Madero area a 25-minute drive. Ezeiza International Airport is just 55 km away.

This city hotel comprises a total of 47 comfortable rooms spread over 4 floors. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility and a cloakroom. It also offers a café, a bar, a restaurant and WLAN/Internet access. Guests may take advantage of room service.

The hotel offers comfortable rooms, double and triple suites and apartments (2 of which come with a kitchenette) for 4 or 5 persons. They are equipped with air conditioning (hot/cold), TV, Internet access, double beds, a minibar/fridge, a direct dial telephone and a hydro-massage tub.

Guests may select their breakfast from a buffet.

83655.description: The typical Viennese hotel is located in the 4th district, within a short walk from the State Opera House, the Künstlerhaus and the Belvedere. St. Stephan's Cathedral is within easy reach, as well as other main attractions and shopping facilities of the city centre of Vienna. Vienna's airport is around 15 km away and public transport is found only a few metres from the property. The 79 comfortable rooms offer conveniences such as flat screen TVs and coffee facilities. Standard features in all accommodations also include soundproofed windows, a double bed and an en-suite bathroom. For 100 years of experience and tradition, Viennese charm and outstanding Austrian hospitality all await guests at this elegant residence.

83656.description: With over 400 years of tradition, this elegant metropolitan hotel is one of Vienna's oldest. As the longest-held hotel in the Schick family, it represents the foundation of the private SCHICK Hotels group—embodying 'Over a century of Viennese Charm. ' Located just minutes from Vienna's historic first district, the hotel seamlessly blends old-world charm with modern amenities. A wide range of stylish, air-conditioned rooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, three conference rooms (with a total capacity of 200 people), and the 'Stefanie' restaurant ensure a pleasant Viennese stay. The restaurant showcases Viennese cuisine, a hallmark of Austrian hospitality, served in the imperial ballroom or the relaxing courtyard garden. The hotel is a member of 'Historic Hotels of Europe. '

83693.description: Boasting a truly fantastic location in the heart of Barcelona, between Plaza Catalunya and Gaudí's world famous creation La Sagrada Familia, this fantastic complex offers a first-class two-in-one accommodation. On the one hand – all the services and the comfort of a hotel, on the other – the amenities of a fully equipped apartment, and all that paired with the close proximity of various restaurants, bars, shops, supermarkets and so on. Available for both short- and long-term stays, the suites can accommodate up to five people and come with fully-equipped kitchens, where guests can prepare food to their own liking. A laundry service is provided for those who want to leave the more boring chores at home, and enjoy the flavour of Barcelona without care.

83709.description: This hotel is right by the famous Ramblas, in the heart of the city, surrounded by museums, academic and cultural centres, art galleries and the Macba Museum as well as specialist libraries, artistic studios, international music festivals, legendary music shops, restaurants, bars and the exclusive La Boquería market. Hotel amenities include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, a cloakroom, lift access, a cafe, a bar, a restaurant and conference facilities. Guests may also use the wireless Internet access, room service and a garage.

83810.description: Situated in the upscale Belgrano neighborhood, this hotel offers convenient access to the city center via the nearby subway station, just three blocks away and a mere 20-minute ride to downtown. Located one block from Cabildo Avenue, this air-conditioned hotel features a 24-hour reception, lift access, a secure safe, currency exchange, and a welcoming breakfast room. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as Wi-Fi, laundry and room service, and on-site parking. Each room is equipped with a private bathroom (shower/bath combination), telephone, hairdryer, mini-bar, satellite TV, air conditioning, a balcony, and a comfortable double or king-size bed. Access to the hotel gym and a daily American breakfast buffet are included with your stay.

83812.description: Opened in June 2007, the BessaHotel is located in the prestigious Boavista area, a thriving business and commercial center, making it an excellent choice for both business trips and leisure stays. The BessaHotel incorporates an Iberian approach to the 'Invicta' lifestyle, focusing on the well-being of its guests through modernization, quality, and affordability. Here, we embrace Porto's design and introduce a new concept: The B Concept. B Our Guest. The hotel features the BBar and the BRestaurant, specializing in Iberian cuisine with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and afternoon tapas. It's an ideal opportunity to savor imaginative and exclusive dishes. *The hotel reserves the right to pre-authorize your credit card prior to arrival. *Non-smoking hotel.

83821.address: Topcu Cad No 16 Taksim Oteller Bolgesi, 16
83821.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include a hair salon, wedding services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Istanbul? This hotel has 280 square feet (26 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 137 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Satellite programming and DVD players are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature jetted bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Taksim Square - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Istiklal Avenue - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Acibadem Taksim Hospital - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Istanbul Technical University - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Vodafone Park - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Istanbul Congress Center - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Lutfi Kirdar Convention and Exhibition Centre - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Dolmabahçe Palace - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Bosphorus - 1. 4 km / 0. 8 mi- Galataport - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Pera Palace Hotel - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- City's Nişantaşı Shopping Center - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Istanbul Museum of Modern Art - 2 km / 1. 2 mi- Galata Tower - 2. 2 km / 1. 3 mi- American Hospital - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 61. 8 km / 38. 4 mi Istanbul Airport (IST) - 38.

83828.address: Av. Gran Vía De Les Corts Catalanes, 570
83828.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and a spa tub. This upscale hotel also features complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a vending machine. Dine at the hotel's restaurant, Aquarella, or grab a coffee at the cafe. Room service is also available during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself at home in one of the 80 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. A stay at Sunotel Central places you in the heart of Barcelona, within a 15-minute walk of La Rambla and Plaça de Catalunya. This hotel is 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Boqueria Market and 0. 7 mi (1. 2 km) from Casa Batlló.

83861.description: The luxurious Semiramis Hotel, located in Kifisia, is a short drive from both KAT Hospital (3 minutes) and the Olympic Athletic Center (7 minutes). This 5-star hotel offers guests a variety of amenities, including a health club, outdoor pool, sauna, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each of the 51 guestrooms features a minibar, DVD player, and private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Enjoy Italian cuisine at the hotel's Nolita Athens restaurant and bar, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available for a fee. For business travelers, the hotel offers a 24-hour business center and limo service. Free self-parking is also available.

name.content: Sheraton Buenos Aires Hotel & Convention Center

83876.description: The Sheraton Buenos Aires Hotel and Convention Center offers upscale accommodation in the heart of Buenos Aires. A short walk from Plaza San Martin and Galerias Pacifico, this hotel boasts 740 guestrooms with pillowtop beds, premium bedding, and LCD televisions. Guests can enjoy Italian cuisine at Buono Ristorante, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or relax with 24-hour room service. Recreational amenities include an indoor pool, spa tub, and sauna. Additional features include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Conveniently located near major attractions such as the Centro Cultural Kirchner and Colón Theatre, the Sheraton Buenos Aires provides a comfortable and luxurious stay.

83916.description: Nestled amid the natural beauty of Belek, Antalya, this unique holiday paradise overlooks the mesmerizing Mediterranean Sea and is just 34 km from Antalya Airport. This beachfront resort offers a luxurious spa and traditional Turkish bath, along with mini golf, table tennis, pool games, and more. Nine restaurants tantalize guests with diverse modern and traditional cuisines, bringing global flavors together under one roof. Relax on sun loungers by the outdoor pool, featuring five water slides and four water parks, and enjoy refreshments from the pool bar. With spectacular beaches, outstanding service, and thrilling activities, this resort is the perfect choice for an unforgettable family vacation.

83917.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an indoor pool and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Neyzade, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 32 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

83918.description: Pamper yourself at the full-service spa. Recreational amenities include a health club, spa tub, and sauna. This Art Deco hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy dining at one of the two on-site restaurants, or order 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the two bars/lounges. Buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Istanbul? The hotel offers 10, 226 square feet (950 square meters) of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and free valet parking is provided. Each of the 132 guest rooms features a minibar, LCD television with satellite channels, and a private bathroom with a shower, designer toiletries, and a hair dryer. Conveniences include a phone, safe, and desk. Nearby attractions include Maltepe Park Mall (1. 4 mi), Yorukali Beach (1. 7 mi), Kartal Marina (3. 6 mi), and Bağdat Avenue (4. 4 mi). The preferred airport is Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW), 15. 7 mi away.

83938.description: Located in the Montparnasse district of Paris, Hôtel Le Magnifique is a 4-star property combining modern comfort with a strategic location. Just steps from Montparnasse train station, public transport, shops, and theaters, it is an ideal base for exploring the city. The hotel offers well-equipped, air-conditioned rooms with a carefully designed interior, providing a pleasant setting for both leisure and business stays. Guests can enjoy a wellness area featuring a swimming pool, hammam, and fitness room, perfect for relaxing after a day in Paris. A bar is also available, offering a friendly and comfortable space to unwind. With its quality services and central location, Hôtel Le Magnifique meets the expectations of travelers looking for convenience and comfort during their stay in Paris. Friendly staff and 24/7 reception ensure a smooth and stress-free stay.

name.content: Pousada Mosteiro de Guimaraes - Monument Hotel

83964.address: Largo Domingos Leite De Castro - Lugar Da Costa, 4810-011
83964.description: This magnificent ‘pousada' is located in Guimarães, a northern Portuguese city located in the district of Braga. Sports lovers will find in the surroundings the Guimarães Sports Pavilion and Francisco Sá Carneiro International Airport, located a 38-minute drive. The city centre of Guimaraes, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is some 2 kilometres from the property. This award winning hotel (National Award of Architecture in 1985) is a return to the past with eyes fixed on the future. This charming establishment is housed in a beautiful 12th century Augustin Convent, offering a choice of tastefully decorated guest rooms equipped with a spacious private bathroom and modern amenities, such as cable television and Wi-Fi internet connection. Those seeking a unique culinary experience cannot miss the on-site restaurant featuring a wide choice of traditional dishes and a personalized service characterized by attention to detail.

83966.description: Nestled between the vibrant city of Braga and the serene Gerês mountain range, this air-conditioned hotel offers 30 comfortable rooms and two luxurious twin suites. Guests can enjoy a range of amenities, including a 24-hour reception, safe, and a hair salon. Leisure facilities include a games room, TV room, an on-site restaurant and bar, an outdoor swimming pool with parasols, and family games such as snooker. For the adventurous, paintball, canoeing, and bicycle tours are also available. WLAN, room service, and parking are provided for added convenience. Each room and suite features air conditioning, cable TV, a minibar, a safe, a dressing gown, and a telephone. Explore nearby attractions such as the National Park, Braga Cathedral, the Sameiro sanctuaries, and the charming village of St. Isabel do Monte.

83967.description: The hotel is located in Queluz, which is both a town and a parish within the municipality of Sintra. It has more than 70, 000 inhabitants and is located 14 km from Sintra and 12 km from Lisbon. Some interesting places for guests to visit nearby include the Pena National Palace dating back to the 19th century, the Village National Palace (12th/16th century), the Joe Berardo Museum, the Toy Museum, Mafra Convent, Cabo da Roca, Estoril, Cascais and Lisbon. The hotel is housed in a building formerly used by the Royal Guard of the Court in the Palace of Queluz, known as the 'Portuguese Versailles'. The hotel's attractive interior design and the exacting renovation of its little private theatre can only be matched by the exquisite cuisine of the Cozinha Velha restaurant. This air-conditioned establishment offers a total of 26 accommodation units including 24 rooms and 2 suites. In addition it provides a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility and lift access as well as a café and bar. It also offers a games room, conference facilities, wireless Internet access, and room and laundry services. The hotel offers accommodation units equipped with air conditioning, cable/satellite TV, a radio, a telephone and a minibar. At the hotel guests will find a gym and family games and they can also relax with a massage (on prior booking). External activities on offer include the beaches, casino, golf course and guided tours (on prior booking). Breakfast, lunch and dinner are all provided in buffet form whilst lunch and dinner can also be selected from a set menu or enjoyed à la carte.

83968.description: Boasting a striking setting in Palmela Castle, overlooking the town of Palmela as well as the links at Montado Golf Club, this fantastic pousada provides an ideal base for a cultural holiday or romantic weekend away. Built in the 17th-century on a hilltop, the castle provides wonderful panoramic views that on clear days stretch all the way to Lisbon. Rooms are spacious and modern with helpful amenities such as air-conditioning, LCD cable television, minibar and internet access. Guests might choose to dine on local specialties, such as cod with onion and coriander and partridge and wild mushroom pie, in the elegant onsite restaurant, which is set in the cloisters of the former convent. In the area around the hotel, visitors can partake in a wide range of outdoor activities such as hiking, canoeing and golf, and the area also offers muscatel tasting and visits to traditional pottery and tile makers.

name.content: Sunis Kumköy Beach Resort Hotel & Spa

84016.description:
Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 4 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional amenities at this property include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Enjoy international cuisine at Kumköy Restoran, one of the property's many dining establishments, which include 6 restaurants and a coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 9 bars/lounges. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

84037.description: This city hotel is located close to the Gran Via, in the heart of the city; it has a privileged location from where guests can start a tourist route to discover Madrid. Many tourist and historic attractions, museum and theatres are within walking distance, such as the Teatro Lope de Vega. It is close to the Plaza Mayor, in the commercial heart of the city and very near the triangle of the arts formed by the museums El Prado, Reina Sofia and Thyssen Bornemisza. Public transport, both the bus and the metro are also within walking distance.

84046.description: The hotel is near the Teatro Colón, Obelisk, Congress, the most attractive places of entertainment and culture of the city, the artistic, cultural and gastronomic center of Buenos Aires. The hotel offers a continental breakfast buffet, lounge, wireless Internet access and parking.

84058.description: The hotel is located in an upscale neighbourhood, just a few blocks from the heart of Buenos Aires. Florida Street, the Colón Theatre and Puerto Madero can be found in the vicinity. This air-conditioned city hotel, which was renovated in 2007, is an excellent choice for business and tourism travellers. It comprises a total of 97 guest rooms, including 22 suites. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour check-in/-out, hotel safe and currency exchange facility. The Vivaldi restaurant and coffee shop are located on the ground floor. In addition, there is a bar and conference facilities as well as room and laundry services. Parking is available for guests arriving by car. All rooms are equipped with standard amenities. Rooms come with double beds, kitchenette and en suite bathroom. The hotel provides a swimming pool, gym and sauna. A continental breakfast is served at the Vivaldi restaurant.

84059.description: This city business hotel is situated in the middle of the historical quarter of the city of Buenos Aires, in the neighbourhood of San Telmo; only 2 blocks from Plaza Dorrengo and from the modern district of Puerto Madero. This themed hotel is also just a few minutes away from the financial hub of the city, 2 km from the famous Obelisk and only minutes from the Ezeiza International Airport. This minimalist-style hotel is decorated with noble materials and refined details. The air-conditioned design hotel offers 16 rooms in colour tones ranging from brown to mahogany to beige and ochre. It also features a large multi-purpose room offering a bar, home theatre, board games, a library and attractive display cabinets where local art works and crafts are exhibited. Further facilities include a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, lift access, a cafe and restaurant, WLAN Internet access and room and laundry services. Each room features an en suite bathroom with a shower, bathtub and hairdryer, a king-size bed and a mini fridge, cooker, microwave and tea and coffee making facilities. Other in-room amenities include a satellite TV, a direct dial telephone, Internet access, a minibar and an ironing set. Guests may take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool. The restaurant has a capacity for 40 people. It has a small but selected menu, abound with typical flavours of Argentina, characteristic for its substantial content and irresistible flavours. A continental breakfast is served each morning.

84076.description: This large complex is located in the Kargicak area, just 4 km from the ancient city of Syedra and 16 km east of the popular resort of Alanya. The air-conditioned establishment is positioned on a pinnacle overlooking the Mediterranean Sea. Suitable for all ages, the hotel is also used for conferences and social functions and attracts a rich mix of nationalities. Younger visitors can make use of the children's playground and kids' club. Guests can enjoy a drink at the café, a choice of bars and disco, and dine in the restaurant. There is a wide choice of recreational activities offered by the hotel which include a large water park, a SPA centre, water sports and ball games. Additionally, the hotel organises entertainment programmes for adults and children. (Some facilities may not be operational year round due to weather/seasonal conditions). Hotel has family consept and does not allow only 'men' bookings.

84097.description: This attractive establishment is located in the centre of Madrid, offering great access to a multitude of museums such as Thyssen-Bornemisza and el Prado and historic attractions including the imposing Almudena Cathedral. It enjoys an incredible location near to Puerta del Sol, which is the main square in Madrid, and serves as the symbolic and tourist centre of the city. Set a few paces from multiple metro and bus stops, it is also well-connected to other district of the Spanish capital. The property offers comfortable and convenient base for all those visiting Madrid. The tastefully appointed facilities and welcoming atmosphere afford a perfect place to all those looking for affordable accommodation. The well-appointed and en-suite rooms feature modern amenities to ensure a pleasant stay. Guests may enjoy 24-hour snacks and beverage and there is a 24-hour reception for guests' added convenience.

84136.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy French cuisine at Café 52 Paris 1, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A shuttle from the airport to the hotel is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 66 guestrooms featuring minibars and espresso makers. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Cable programming and DVD players are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers.

84176.description: This hotel is nestled on the long fine sandy beach of Belek in Antalya. It is only 1 km from Belek town centre and 40 km away from Antalya city centre. This club resort and spa centre consists of 61 villas and a total of 546 rooms. Facilities offered include a 24-hour reception, currency exchange and hotel safe. There is a restaurant, café and mini club. Guests can use the room and laundry services, as well as hairdresser. Parking is provided for those arriving by car. All rooms contain a hairdryer, direct dial telephone and satellite TV with music channels. They are equipped with a mini bar, central air conditioning and safe. Each room has a balcony. The hotel has a heated indoor swimming pool, as well as an outdoor and a children's pool. There is also a poolside snack bar, fitness studio and a hot tub. The hotel provides a breakfast, lunch and dinner buffet.

84211.address: Belek Mah. Turizm Cad. No: 74/57 Serik / Antalya
84211.description: This charming beach hotel was renovated in 2007, and offers guests 367 rooms in total. It provides extensive facilities amidst its own pine forest and beside the Mediterranean coast. The air-conditioned SPA complex welcomes guests to take advantage of the karaoke bar, and disco, as well as all the other on-site facilities provided for a memorable stay. With a range of sports, leisure and SPA options, guests are sure to find something within this modern complex to suit their mood. The hotel also offers a pool area, with two outdoor pools, a heated indoor saltwater pool and a poolside snack bar and sun terrace. Guests may also wish to take part in an aerobics or aqua fit session or choose from a selection of SPA and massage treatments.

84220.description: 'Spacious yet cozy, the newly built Vain Boutique Hotel offers a perfect balance of Buenos Aires' Belle Époque charm and modern comfort. Located in the vibrant Palermo neighborhood, this 34-room hotel embodies a unique philosophy of self-acceptance and personal growth. It invites guests to embrace their individuality in a sophisticated setting that blends classic architectural details with contemporary design. '

84226.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 36 guestrooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Gülhane Park - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Bosphorus - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Eminonu Pier - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Istanbul Archaeology Museums - 0. 6 km / 0. 3 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Eminönü Square - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Basilica Cistern - 0. 7 km / 0. 5 mi- Hagia Sophia - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Sultanahmet Square - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Grand Bazaar - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Topkapi Palace - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Süleymaniye Mosque - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Blue Mosque - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Galata Bridge - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Little Hagia Sophia - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 47. 4 km / 29. 4 mi Istanbul Airport (IST) - 41. 1 km / 25. 6 mi Located in Istanbul (Istanbul City Center), Kafkas Hotel is within a 10-minute walk of Bosphorus and Egyptian Bazaar. This hotel is 0. 6 mi (0. 9 km) from Hagia Sophia and 0. 6 mi (0. 9 km) from Grand Bazaar.

84242.description: This hotel enjoys a superb location on the South Bank, rubbing shoulders with many of London's most famous attractions such as the Houses of Parliament, Westminster Abbey, London Dungeons and the London Eye. Named ‘Best Family Friendly Hotel' at the HRS Hotel Excellence Awards 2011, the hotel specialises in treating children like VIPs through its Family Fun in the City package. Spacious family rooms include substantial closets and plenty of space to relax and unwind, while Studio Rooms and Penthouse Apartments afford an enhanced feeling of indulgence with defined sleeping and living areas. Additional facilities include a restaurant and a bar where the guests can enjoy a nice meal and a beverage and a modern fitness centre were guests can keep up with their routine.

name.content: Bahia Principe Explore La Romana Hyatt Incl Col AI

84295.description: Located on the east coast of the Dominican Republic, between Santo Domingo and La Romana, the splendid holiday resort Bahia Principe Explore La Romana Hyatt Inclusive Collection AI is surrounded by coconut palms and overlooks a beautiful bay. The Pueblo Príncipe, a Caribbean-style shopping and leisure center at the entrance of the hotel area, offers night entertainment, shopping, and a 24-hour burger bar. All rooms feature air conditioning, a bathroom with a hydromassage tub, jet shower, and hairdryer, as well as satellite television, a direct telephone line, and a minibar. Guests can enjoy the swimming pool (with a separate children's pool), work out in the gym, or relax in the sauna. The fully air-conditioned, non-smoking restaurant offers breakfast, lunch, and dinner buffets.

84356.description: The hotel is centrally located in Bloomsbury, with Euston, Russell Square and King's Cross/St Pancras stations close by. Ideal location to explore attractions around the hotel, the London Zoo, the British Museum, Madame Tussauds and Camden Market are at a short driving distance. This stylish property was recently restored and is housed in a building which dates back to 1906. Italian architect Guiseppe Boscherini has created a fresh, contemporary design to meet the needs of a highly discerning corporate and conference market. The hotel offers 100 rooms spread over 6 floors. Facilities and amenities include conference and banqueting for up to 250 delegates, air-conditioned common areas, a restaurant and Internet. All bedrooms have en-suite facilities with everything that guests will need during the stay.

84417.description: Located in the lively centre of Amsterdam, Hotel Luxer offers free Wi-Fi access to its guests. There are many restaurants and bars in the direct surrounding of the hotel. Rooms here will provide you with satellite flat-screen TV. Featuring a shower, private bathrooms also come with a hairdryer. Extras include a desk, a safety deposit box and ironing facilities. At Hotel Luxer you will find a 24-hour front desk and a bar. Other facilities offered include luggage storage. The hotel is situated in the Red Light District area at 200 metres from Amsterdam Central Station, 500 m from Dam Square and 1. 8 km from Leidseplein. Schiphol Airport is 12 km away.

84430.description: This superb hotel is located in the neighbourhood of Belgrano and has been built overlooking the golf course and the forest of Palermo. It is surrounded by lakes and greenery, being 10 minutes from the city and 5 minutes from the domestic airport. This property has a different concept for guests' stay in 1-, 2- and 3-room apartments complete with maid service. Business travellers can also take advantage of the conference facilities and meeting rooms, coupled with the complimentary WiFi access which is offered throughout the hotel. Guests can take a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool and relax on the sun terrace where sun loungers and parasols are laid out for use. Guests can also work out in the gym and unwind in the sauna. Paddle tennis is another recreational option. A delicious American buffet breakfast is offered every morning for guests to start their day right.

84437.description: This family-friendly city hotel is located in the old city of Istanbul. Guests will find restaurants, shops and links to the public transport network in the immediate vicinity and Ataturk Airport approximately 12 km from the business hotel. This hotel has 97 well decorated rooms, each featuring an en suite bathroom and a private balcony or terrace. Facilities available to guests at the air-conditioned city hotel include a hairdressing salon and a bar and restaurant. Guests may also make use of the conference facilities and WLAN Internet access. The hotel offers a Turkish bath, massages and SPA treatments for guests who wish to relax, as well as an indoor swimming pool and a gym.

84456.description: Birmingham offers a wealth of cultural attractions and a fascinating history, as well as fantastic nightlife, and this luxurious apartment hotel puts guests in the heart of it all. Visitors can see the historic Bull Ring market, Victoria Square, and the jewellery quarter, and those with a sweet tooth will not want to miss Cadbury World. The serviced apartments are bright and spacious, each with a fully-equipped kitchen, open-plan lounge and dining area, private bathroom, and one or two bedrooms. Guests can take advantage of the kitchen and complimentary DVD rentals in reception to prepare a wonderful home-cooked meal and have a night in, though the hotel is surrounded by the city's best restaurants, pubs and entertainment venues. The hotel also offers a range of helpful services such as reception, parking and grocery shopping delivery service, all for a productive business trip or delightful city break. Check In: Reception opening hours are 08:30 to 19:00 Monday to Friday, 10:30 to 19:00 on Saturday, closed on Sunday. If you are arriving outside these hours, please contact The Spires reception. Please be aware we require a £250 security deposit before arrival which requires to be paid through our secure on-line payment portal. IMPORTANT** Please contact The Spires reception 48/72hours before your arrival date**

84459.description: The DoubleTree by Hilton is a great city hotel strategically situated in trendy Catalinas, beside Reconquista and close to other renowned sites such as Florida Street and the beautiful San Martin Square. A great place from where guests will easily get to know the city. The hotel provides a warm care and quality services and boasts fantastic, modern facilities to guarantee a great stay. It is a perfect place for both business travellers and holidaymakers.

84460.description: The modern, elegant, and renovated 474 Buenos Aires Hotel is ideally situated in the heart of the Argentinian capital, just off Avenida Corrientes, the so-called “Broadway of Buenos Aires, ” and the famous Calle Florida with its numerous shops, entertainment venues, restaurants, and bars. The Cervantes and Colón Theaters are a short stroll away, as are a wide variety of museums and iconic landmarks such as Plaza de Mayo and Casa Rosada.

84476.description: This hotel is located in New York City's vibrant midtown Manhattan, surrounded by excitement and cradled in comfort. The hotel is a short walk from Grand Central Station, Jacob Javits Convention Center, Times Square, Central Park, Fifth Avenue Shopping and the great restaurants of Manhattan. The hotel redefines opulence for a new age while preserving the landmark-quality architecture of the 1903 Beaux-Arts structure. Guests are welcomed in a reception lobby, and there is a hotel safe, lift access, a restaurant and free wireless Internet access. For a fee, guests can use the hotel garage.

84496.description: This family friendly hotel offers a range of facilities and recreational activities right on a wonderful sand and shingle beach. The hotel is located in the Beldibi area, which boasts magnificent, forested mountains in addition to the turquoise blue waters of the Mediterranean Sea. The resort town of Kemer is 12 km away and is easily reached by public transport, and guests will find some shops and cafe bars within a few minutes' walk. The hotel's cosy rooms are all air-conditioned and en suite, and each comes with a private balcony and wireless internet access. Guests can participate in a variety of activities at the beach, including windsurfing, water skiing and beach volleyball, or take part in the hotel's entertainment programme and relax with a fun, family game of chess, backgammon in the games room, all during a fantastic holiday.

84498.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an indoor pool, a spa tub, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's bar/lounge, Bar Lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Amsterdam? This hotel has 915 square feet (85 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 205 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

84513.description: Discover Dolce CampoReal Lisboa, a tranquil resort nestled in the rolling hills of Torres Vedras, just 30 minutes north of Lisbon and 20 minutes from Portugal's stunning west coast beaches. Choose from 151 inviting rooms and enjoy the on-site 18-hole golf course and equestrian center. The resort also offers extensive conference facilities for up to 650 guests. Explore the Oeste region's wine routes, savoring the country's finest wines while immersing yourself in the region's rich history and picturesque landscapes. Visit the medieval town of Óbidos, a short 30-minute drive from the hotel.

84536.description: The hotel is situated near exit 1 on the A8. The hotel now has 40 standard rooms and 40 deluxe rooms and the facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area with a 24-hour check out service, air conditioning, lift access, a bar, a restaurant and WLAN/Internet access. The rooms are personal, comfortable and offer good facilities. They come with a bathroom with shower, a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, individually adjustable heating, a radio, Internet access, air conditioning and a safe. Guests may enjoy their breakfast and midday meal in buffet form. The midday meal is, additionally, available à la carte or from a set menu as is the evening meal.

84538.description: This stylish hotel, conveniently located near the Parc des Expositions at Porte de Versailles, offers easy access to the Paris Metro, major roads, and rail links, placing you just 5 km from the city center. The hotel features 79 spacious and elegantly designed rooms, ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Three well-equipped conference rooms are available for business needs. Enjoy a delicious buffet breakfast and dinner at Les Quatre Saisons restaurant. Additional amenities include a 24-hour reception, safe, bar, and private parking. Each attractively furnished room includes a fully equipped bathroom, satellite TV, direct-dial telephone, terrace, and living area. Savor an excellent breakfast in a pleasant setting before exploring the city. Les Quatre Saisons restaurant, open from 7 pm to 9:30 pm, offers a diverse menu to suit all tastes. Directions: From Orly Airport, follow signs for Versailles and take the A86 motorway. Exit at ‘Petit-Clamart' and follow signs for Paris ‘Porte de Châtillon' - D906/N306. The hotel is on your left after the first roundabout. From Charles de Gaulle Airport, take the A3 motorway towards Paris Est. Exit at ‘Porte de Châtillon' towards Clamart via Avenue Pierre Brossolette, then Avenue de Paris, followed by Avenue de Verdun. The hotel will be on your right after the first roundabout.

84558.address: KHALID BIN WALEED STREET, PO Box 82555
84558.description: Centrally located in Dubai, York International Hotel offers convenient access to the Dubai World Trade Centre and BurJuman Mall, both within a 5-minute drive. This hotel provides 102 air-conditioned guestrooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, cable programming, and desks. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, and blackout drapes/curtains ensure a restful sleep. Housekeeping is provided daily. Enjoy onsite amenities such as six bars/lounges, a restaurant, a coffee shop, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and an elevator. Nearby attractions include the Dubai Museum, Meena Bazaar, and the Grand Mosque, all within a short distance. The closest airport is Dubai International Airport (DXB).

84565.address: Abu Hail Road Deira ,Dubai U.A.E P.O.Box 183532
84565.description: Lotus Grand Hotel offers elegant and spacious apartments only 3 km from Dubai International Airport. It features a multi-cuisine restaurant, shopping arcade and a rooftop pool with city views. The stylishly furnished 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments include balconies, well-equipped kitchens and private en suites for each bedroom. The large living room offers a 34-inch flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a DVD player. Free Wifi internet in public area & all room types. When hungry, guests can visit the 24-hour BiteRite, which offers a range of international and health-conscious choices. The coffee shop additionally features a children’s room and a library. Lotus Grand Hotel Apartments houses a health club with a fully equipped gym, hot tub, sauna and steam bath. The hotel also offers a separate children’s pool and baby-sitting facilities. Lotus Grand is located about a 15-minute drive from the World Trade Centre, Dubai Creek, the famous gold souks, the shopping centre and the many golf clubs around the city.

84566.description: Located close to Zaventem International Airport, this hotel lies just a 2 minutes' walking distance from Vilvoorde Station. The hotel offers visitors a great setting from which to explore the city. The centre of the city is just a 10 minutes' train journey away. Guests can explore the Atomium, the Brussels Expo and the Grand Place. A myriad of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can also be found nearby. This upscale hotel offers comfortable, stylish guest rooms, which feature soothing tones for a peaceful ambiance. The restaurant offers an array of delectable culinary delights. Business travellers will appreciate the convenience that the 4 seminar rooms have to offer.
