84567.description: Nestled in the heart of the ancient Sonian Forest, Dolce La Hulpe Brussels offers a tranquil retreat just minutes from Brussels City Centre and Brussels International Airport. This premier resort and conference hotel caters to both business and leisure travelers. It features an indoor pool, a state-of-the-art fitness center, a luxurious Cinq Mondes Spa, and two superb restaurants and lounges. The hotel offers 264 newly appointed guest rooms and suites, each boasting modern conveniences and sleek, contemporary decor. With 4, 500 m2 (47, 900 sq. ft) of IACC-certified meeting space, including two auditoriums and 35 meeting rooms equipped with cutting-edge technology, Dolce La Hulpe Brussels seamlessly blends work and play. Guests can enjoy exceptional sports, recreation, and leisure opportunities both on-site and amidst the breathtaking natural beauty of the surrounding area.

84637.description: This charming historical hotel is located in the picturesque old town Kaleici inside the city walls, close to the yachting marina and the beach. Shops, bars and restaurants are within easy walking distance, Antalya Airport is approximately 10 km away. Features of the hotel include 21 rooms, 24-hours reception, express check-in and check-out, concierge service, currency exchange, free WIFI, restaurant, bar, outdoor pool, art gallery within the hotel, library, medical assistance, airport shuttle, bicycle rental, car hire and free on-site parking.

name.content: B&B Hotel Rio de Janeiro Copacabana Posto 5

84697.address: Av. Nossa Senhora De Copacabana, 1256 posto 5
84697.description:
The B&B Hotel Rio de Janeiro Copacabana Posto 5 is located just one block from the famous Copacabana Beach and 9 km from Santos Dumont Airport. Enjoy the rooftop pool with panoramic views of Copacabana Beach, Sugarloaf Mountain, and the neighborhoods of Ipanema and Leblon. The hotel offers free Wi-Fi and a breakfast with seasonal fruits, juices, and sweets. The colorful rooms have wooden furniture, air conditioning, cable TV, and a minibar. 
Visitors must register at the front desk and may be subject to a fee; the number of visitors cannot exceed the room's capacity. 
***ATTENTION: The property's facade is undergoing maintenance for an indefinite period. To ensure the utmost safety and well-being of our guests, a screen has been installed across the exterior. ***

84798.description: Make lasting memories in the Midlands at the Best Western Appleby Park Hotel. Located on the outskirts of Tamworth in Appleby Magna, this hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Situated just off Junction 11 of the M42, you'll be within easy driving distance of major cities like Birmingham, Loughborough, Derby, and Nottingham. A visit to Cadbury World in Birmingham is a must, only a 45-minute drive away. Closer to the hotel, enjoy family fun at Drayton Manor Theme Park (under 20 minutes) or Twycross Zoo (just four minutes). The hotel offers 88 en-suite rooms, including doubles, twins, interconnecting rooms, and family options. Enjoy a meal at The Park Restaurant, our contemporary bistro, before settling in for the evening.

84800.address: Rue Du Marais Sec / Le Parc De Villers, 5
84800.description: Ideally located near a huge public park equipped with sports facilities and lakes for fishing, this hotel welcomes all sorts of guests and offers a wealth of services. The hotel's position means it is near the historical cities of Compiegne, Chantilly and Senlis and near the theme parks of Asterix and Disneyland Paris. Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports are 40 km and 60 km away respectively. Renovated in 2006, the hotel has 70 rooms and a lobby, reception service, hotel safe, cloakroom, restaurant, café, bar, TV lounge and publicly available Internet access as well as a car park and some covered parking. Rooms are available for 1, 2 or 3 persons. They are equipped with a balcony or terrace, en suite bathroom, satellite TV with Canal+, radio, Internet access, tea and coffee making facilities, microwave oven, safe box, individually adjustable heating and a small office. They are decorated in warm colours and have a calm atmosphere. The hotel has sun loungers and parasols as well as a tanning studio. A golf course is 10 km away. A buffet or continental breakfast is served. Lunch and dinner are available as a buffet, set menu or can be ordered à la carte.

name.content: Alexandra Barcelona, Curio Collection by Hilton

84841.description: Welcome to the Alexandra Barcelona Hotel, Curio Collection by Hilton. This designer boutique hotel is where fascinating history, modernist details, and avant-garde meet. Moments from Passeig de Gràcia – the fashion, culture, and commercial heart of Barcelona – our hotel is a quick walk to Rambla de Catalunya, Casa Batlló, La Pedrera, and other top attractions. Our fully renovated 19th-century building reflects the charm, elegance, and spirit of our Barcelona surroundings. You'll love the local photography that lines our walls, designer furniture from the ‘50s and ‘60s, original mosaic flooring, framed ceilings, and natural oak throughout the hotel. Every guest room features parquet flooring or modernist tiles, plush bedding, and complimentary WiFi. Upgrade to one of our spacious suites for a king size bed and a minimum 40-inch HDTV. Some of our suites feature a living room area with sofa, an indoor/outdoor bathtub plus bathrobe and slippers, and terrace.

84856.description: Overlooking the Mediterranean from a slightly elevated position, this hotel is just 150 meters from the sea. Antalya's city center, with its diverse shops, is 5 km away, and the international airport is 10 km away. This non-smoking hotel offers 81 rooms, a 24-hour reception, express check-in and check-out, concierge service, currency exchange, free WiFi throughout, meeting rooms, two restaurants, three bars, indoor and outdoor pools, a spa and wellness center, a fitness center, ticket service, and car hire. Facilities for disabled guests are also available.

84857.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an outdoor pool, and an indoor pool. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, babysitting (surcharge), and an arcade/game room. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 69 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

84859.description: The hotel is within walking distance from the fishing village of Negombo along a stretch of public beach. The hotel is located on a spectacular golden sand beach, fringed by the tropical turquoise sea. It nestles amidst the palm groves of the quaint nearby fishing village. The hotel, with its unspoiled private beach, is the most popular seaside resort in the immediate vicinity of the Bandaranaike International Airport. It is situated 40 km north of Colombo, approximately 30 minutes from Bandaranaike International Airport which is just 7 km away. The hotel offers 140 air-conditioned guest rooms, including 10 luxury villas, 5 suites and 1 penthouse, located on the beach front. It is renowned for having one of the best and widest beach fronts offering a breathtaking view of the Indian Sea. The hotel provides guests with facilities including lift access, a bar, a restaurant, conference facilities and a room and laundry service. All the rooms come equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a minibar, a balcony or terrace, a safe and individually regulated air conditioning. The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool with a children's pool. Guests can play darts and beach volleyball and the hotel has tennis and squash courts. Water sports can also be arranged. This hotel is the ideal base to explore the rich cultural heritage of Negombo which is greatly influenced by the Dutch and Portuguese.

84881.description: Hotel Schiphol A4 has 435 guestrooms featuring air-conditioning, a balcony or terrace and spacious bathroom with both shower and separate bathtub. All have complimentary wireless, high-speed Internet and 44 inch flatscreens. Guests can make a splash in the indoor swimming pool then relax at the onsite spa. The hotel also offers a gym and outdoor athletic court. The hotel has an elegant restaurant and a cosy bar.

84896.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at this hotel near Montseny Natural Park. Indulge in massages and body treatments at the full-service spa, or take advantage of the health club and sauna. All 8 air-conditioned rooms feature kitchenettes equipped with refrigerators and microwaves, as well as flat-screen TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Additional amenities include express check-in/check-out, concierge services, and a picnic area. An airport shuttle is available (surcharge). Breakfast is offered for a fee. Nearby attractions include the Church of Santa Maria and Montclus Castle. The closest airports are Gerona (GRO-Costa Brava) and Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN).

84920.description: This comfortable hotel is conveniently located on Cancun Avenue, facing the biggest lagoon in Southeast Mexico. There are a number of banks, restaurants, pharmacies, cinemas and shops within walking distance. There is also a handicrafts market, a tourism office, a taxi rank, a bus stop and a supermarket close by. Cancún's vibrant night life is within easy reach, as well as several beaches and shopping malls. Facilities include 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, outdoor swimming pool, a bar, Internet access, room service and parking for those arriving by car.

85040.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Enjoy international cuisine at the Roof Restaurant, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary daily reception. Unwind with a drink at one of the two bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (7:30 AM to 10:30 AM) for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours). The hotel offers 36 guestrooms featuring LED televisions, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms with showers include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. You'll also find laptop-compatible safes and desks, with housekeeping provided daily. Located near the Cemberlitas Bath (0. 1 mi), Theodosius Cistern (0. 1 mi), and the Grand Bazaar (0. 3 mi), the hotel provides easy access to Istanbul's historical sites. The preferred airport is Istanbul Airport (IST) .

85041.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a sauna or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a television in a common area. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Lantia, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Las Rozas de Madrid? This hotel has 8504 square feet (790 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 5 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 90 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

name.content: Marlin Apartments London Bridge - Empire Square

85077.description: The hotel area is steeped in London history with many sites and museums close by. Some such attractions include the Clink Prison Museum, the London Dungeons, the Tate Modern, Shakespeare's Globe Theatre, the Tower of London, Tower Bridge, Southwark Cathedral and many more. Any discerning wine enthusiasts should feel right at home at Vinopolis, located near to the hotel. Close by is the world-renowned Borough Food market which attracts traders from all over the UK and as far afield as Mainland Europe. This delectable market is a must for food lovers. Heathrow International Airport is 29 km from the hotel, Gatwick International Airport is 47 km away and Stansted Airport is located 57 km from the hotel. This 202 unit apartment-hotel is a new development which encompasses an internal square the size of Piccadilly Circus. Additional benefits include complimentary broadband, lift access, welcome basket and a weekly maid service. Rising from the northern tip of the development is a 22-storey landmark tower, specially designed to make its own distinct architectural statement. Designed by award winning architects, this landmark development presents a new vision of contemporary city living. The hotel features a lobby with WLAN Internet access and a 24-hour concierge operates on site. Many extra services are available on request, such as next day dry cleaning, car parking, childcare, additional maid service, and many more. The site is complimented by landscaped public areas, and facilities for cafes, restaurants and shops.

85082.description: This stylish hotel is just 2 km away from Basildon Centre. The property sits proudly at the heart of Essex, within easy access of the city centre of London. The coast at Southend-on-Sea is just a 20 minutes' driving distance away. This property features charming guest rooms, which are bright and tastefully decorated. The rooms are fitted with up-to-date amenities, for guests' convenience. Guests can enjoy a hearty buffet-style breakfast in the mornings, with cooked and continental options. A delectable dining experience can be enjoyed in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant. Perfectly conducive to work and leisure trips, this hotel is sure to impress.

85098.description: Campanile Marne La Vallée - Torcy is ideally located in Torcy, making it perfect for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel provides everything needed for a comfortable stay. Amenities such as 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, a 24-hour front desk, accessibility for disabled guests, and luggage storage are readily available for your convenience. Some of the hotel's well-appointed rooms feature a flat-screen TV, wardrobe, free Wi-Fi access, and air conditioning. The hotel also offers a variety of recreational options.

85116.description: This 4-star city centre hotel is one of London's most stylish and is home to the chicest destination restaurant in the area, The Lampery, Seething Lane. Serving everything from beautiful breakfasts and exciting cocktails to decadent dining and more, we know you'll take delight in every bite! Situated near St Paul's Cathedral and Tower Bridge, find yourself fully immersed in all that London has to offer whether travelling for work, play, or taking a trip with the family.

85142.description: This modern hotel, renovated in 2009, offers 409 well-equipped rooms decorated in warm tones. Located within walking distance of public transport, it features an outdoor pool with a snack bar, sun loungers, and parasols. Guests can also enjoy a gym, hot tub, sauna, and steam room. Business travelers will appreciate the conference facilities and Wi-Fi. Additional amenities include a 24-hour reception, room and laundry services, and on-site parking.

85143.description: Overlooking a Venetian canal, only steps away from St. Mark's Square, this hotel is in the heart of Venice. The hotel has 3 levels: the ground, first and second floors and includes 2 magnificent halls and terrace. It also offers a cafe and a breakfast room and business travellers will appreciate the conference facilities and Internet access. Guests can also use the room and laundry services.

85147.description:
The Hotel Rafiya is a budget hotel with standardised amenities at the best value. It is located in Redditch, providing you with easy access to nearby attractions such as the National SEA LIFE Centre Birmingham and Kingfisher Shopping Centre. The property has free WiFi and parking facility for your convenience. 
This hotel provides everything you need for your stay, including a hair dryer and an electric kettle. You can enjoy a cup of coffee or tea in the morning with breakfast service and TV. This hotel also has a smoke detector for peace of mind. 
This hotel has many amenities to make your stay more comfortable. You will be able to enjoy a designated smoking area for guests, never worry about housekeeping with their daily service, and have a smoke-free environment with smoke detectors in every room. For families traveling with pets, this hotel is perfect for you.

name.content: Royalisa Palmiye Beach Hotel Adults Only

85152.description: This beachfront hotel on Cleopatra Beach offers stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea and Alanya Castle. Fully renovated in 2022, the hotel features 60 rooms, an indoor/outdoor restaurant, and a bar. Guests can enjoy standard rooms with balconies or terraces, along with amenities including table tennis, snooker, and occasional evening entertainment. A small outdoor pool is also available. The hotel is conveniently located near shops and restaurants, with the city center just 1 km away. Economy rooms are situated on the ground floor with garden views, but offer the same standards as other room types. Antalya Airport is approximately 126 km from the hotel, while Alanya Gazipasa Airport is about 43 km away. The hotel is for adults 16 years and older. In-room amenities include air conditioning, a minibar (complimentary water), telephone, satellite TV, tea and coffee making facilities, and a hairdryer. Safe boxes are available at an extra charge.

85153.description: Offering a private outdoor pool, this popular hotel is conveniently located in the centre of the city of Alanya in the holiday region of Turkish Riviera. A large variety of shops, restaurants, bars and cafés is in the surrounding area, the seafront, the harbour, the Archaelogical Museum and the famous Red Tower can be reached within a short stroll. Alanya Castle is within easy reach.

85196.description: The establishment comprises a total of 65 snug units. Plaza Roma offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The reception desk is open all day long.

85224.description: This stylish, contemporary hotel is situated in the modernist triangle formed by Parc Guell, Hospital Sant Pau, and the iconic Sagrada Familia. Attractions nearby also include the La Monumental bullring and Agbar Tower, and city sights such as the Plaça de Catalunya, Las Ramblas, Gran Teatre del Liceu and Passeig de Gràcia is easily reachable by metro. The modern, tastefully decorated guest rooms are cool and bright with sleek parquet floors, air conditioning and Wi-Fi internet access. After a busy day in the city, guests might choose to dine in the chic and trendy onsite restaurant and make use of the public internet terminal. This hotel's fashionable design and great location make it the perfect choice for a city break in Barcelona.

85236.description: This hotel is situated 50 m from Alcalá Street and 600 m from Ciudad Lineal metro station. Newly opened in September 2007, the establishment comprises 32 suites offering the best facilities and exclusive services to both business travellers and families. It is fully air-conditioned and features an on-site café with a terrace and a TV lounge. Wireless Internet access and fax and photocopying services are available, and parking is provided for guests arriving by car. Three different types of suites are offered and standard amenities include a 32-inch flat screen TV with satellite channels, complimentary wireless Internet access and individually regulated air conditioning and heating units. Reservations of more than 4 rooms could have special cancellation policy.

85237.description: This hotel is in a prime location, next to Puerta del Sol and very close to “Paseo del Arte”, known for its numerous museums like the Prado Museum, the Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum, and the Reina Sofía Modern Art Museum, and countless palaces, gardens and fountains. There is also a plethora of restaurants, bars, tourist attractions and public transportation links in the hotel vicinity. The hotel welcomes guests in a lobby with 24h reception, safe, lift access, and has café, restaurant, and internet access and room and laundry services.

name.content: The Originals City Hotel, La Verrière

85239.description: Located on the outskirts of La Verrière, close to the Rambouillet forest and next to Saint Quentin, this cosy hotel offers a warm welcome and excellent facilities for all visitors of the western metropolitan area of Paris. Although it offers a tranquil and pristine surroundings its guests can reach the main train station within a short 5-minute walk and the RER commuter train line C within a 5-minute taxi ride, from there they can reach the famous attractions of Paris for less than 20 minutes. The hotel is also just a 20-minute drive from Château de Versailles and a 10-minute one from the France Miniature amusement park. The hotel itself offers fully-equipped rooms that come with everything needed for a good night sleep plus a flat-screen TV, modern and bright bathroom and complimentary WiFi internet access.

85265.description: Located in Amadora, just 15 km from Lisbon's city center, this hotel offers a peaceful retreat near the commercial district with easy access to public transport. A short 2-minute walk from Amadora train station, the hotel is surrounded by tranquil green spaces. The tastefully designed guest rooms provide a comfortable and relaxing environment for unwinding. The hotel is dedicated to providing exemplary service and ensuring customer satisfaction.

85276.description: Enjoy amenities such as a sauna and fitness center at this Vienna hotel. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy other conveniences like concierge services and babysitting (surcharge). Dine at Die Zwölf - Bar/Brasserie, featuring a bar/lounge and room service (limited hours). Buffet breakfast is available weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM (surcharge). The hotel also offers express check-in/check-out, complimentary newspapers, 538 sq ft of event space (including two meeting rooms), and airport shuttle service (24 hours, surcharge). Self-parking is available onsite (surcharge). The 78 guestrooms feature minibars, espresso makers, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, LCD TVs, and bathrooms with rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Nearby attractions include Kohlmarkt Street (0. 2 mi), Hofburg Imperial Palace (0. 2 mi), and the Spanish Riding School (0. 2 mi). Vienna International Airport (VIE) is 12. 7 mi from the hotel.

85282.description: This hotel is located in the city of Vienna and was established in 1901. It is a short drive away from the Townhall and the nearest station is Alserstrasse. Vienna International Airport is about 26 km from the property. The hotel offers 74 individually-designed and spacious rooms, equipped with flat-screen TV, minibar, tea and coffee facilities and bathroom with hairdryer and toiletries as well as soundproof windows for a pleasant sleep. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast with various hot dishes, home-made pastries and seasonal fresh fruits in the morning. For a perfect relaxation after an exhausting day, the hotel features a private spa that comes with sauna, whirlpool, heat cabin and steam shower.

85283.description: This family-run hotel, built in 1900, is conveniently located 3km from Vienna's city center and 6km from the Danube River. Vienna International Airport is a 30-minute drive away, and excellent public transport links are available, with the Franz Josef Station (underground and tram) just a 5-minute walk from the hotel. During cycling season, the station offers easy connections to Passau. This eco-friendly hotel provides comfortable rooms and great facilities, including air-conditioning, TVs, seating areas, and private bathrooms with hairdryers. Guests can unwind with refreshing drinks at the cozy on-site bar. Children aged 0-3 stay for €15 per night (excluding breakfast) in an extra bed (subject to availability) or free in a crib. Children aged 4 and older are charged at the adult rate.

85302.description:
The award-winning Henriette Stadthotel Vienna is more than just a sustainable boutique hotel; it's your home away from home in the heart of Vienna's vibrant 2nd district, birthplace of the Danube Waltz. Located between St. Stephen's Cathedral and the Prater, this family-run hotel offers various accommodations, including Comfort Studios, Superior and Deluxe Apartments with balconies. Please note, dogs are allowed with an additional fee, and apartments incur a €100 final cleaning fee. For stays up to 7 days in apartments, a one-time cleaning service is complimentary with additional cleanings available for €35 per day. Breakfast: 25€ per person. 
***The Vienna city tax is set by law by the City of Vienna. The amount must be paid locally in addition to the room rate.

name.content: Excess Venice Boutique Hotel & Private Spa

85303.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a communal living room. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a cruise ship terminal shuttle. Make yourself at home in one of the 16 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have bidets and hair dryers.

85339.description: Nestled in the north-western Parisian suburb of Sannois, this offers easy access to the A15 highway and guests travelling with their personal vehicles can use the free onsite parking. It is also just a 15-minute walk from the Cernay RER Station, through which they can reach the centre of Paris and the entire metropolitan area in minutes. The air-conditioned rooms of the venue are equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay and the complimentary WiFi internet access is available through its premises. The onsite restaurant serves mouth-watering traditional cuisine and excellent local wines, it also takes care of the most important meal of the day with its delicious daily breakfast buffet.

85360.description: Located in Brazil's most famous borough, this hotel is situated just two blocks from Copacabana beach, surrounded by restaurants, nightclubs, bars, theaters, cinemas and shopping centres, making for an unforgettable stay. The metro station is a short walk from the property, ensuring quick and easy access to the downtown area. The onsite restaurant serves a variety of local and international cuisine.

85398.address: 53 Derb Regragui, Riad Zitoun, Jdid La Medina
85398.description: This guesthouse is located in the Medina, or old city of Marrakesh, near the traditional souk markets and in a quarter made famous by the Bahia Palace. The hotel is also near the Badii Palace and the Mellah, the old Jewish district. Menara Airport is 60 km away. The small hotel has been created out of a converted Riad. In times gone by, Riads in Marrakech were the homes of governors, Caliphs and the city's other wealthy and influential people. Nowadays these homes have been transformed into small guesthouses that respect the norms and standards of the hotelier establishment. This Riad has 3 double rooms and a suite as well as a TV lounge, a bicycle cellar and its own parking. Room and laundry services are available. The house has been decorated with great care in warm tones of ochre and brown sand. Its patio is freshened by a fountain and the terraces have a view over the palace gardens. Rooms are en suite and have individually adjustable air conditioning and heating. The house has a nice sunbathing terrace and guests have the option of booking a massage. Guests who wish to eat meals in the house should book the meals first. Staff will be ready to prepare Moroccan or international dishes according to guests' requests as part of the guesthouse's personal service.

85405.description: The total number of accomodation units is 17. Clients may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Riad Ifoulki . Clients can enjoy the convenience of 24-hour reception.

85406.address: Douar Abiad, Circuit De La Palmeraie, 153
85406.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a fitness center, and bicycle rentals. This hotel also features complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting services (surcharge). Guests can use the complimentary area shuttle to reach nearby destinations. Enjoy a meal at Pergola, one of the hotel's three restaurants, or order room service (during limited hours). Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self-parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 41 guest rooms featuring minibars and plasma televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms offer complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, safes, and complimentary bottled water. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Palmeraie Palace Golf - 3. 4 km / 2. 1 mi; Museum Palmeraie - 3. 8 km / 2. 3 mi; Musée Aman pour la Civilsation de l'Eau au Maroc - 5. 4 km / 3. 3 mi; Tanneries - 5. 8 km / 3. 6 mi; House of Photography - 6 km / 3. 7 mi; Bab Debbagh - 6 km / 3. 7 mi; The Orientalist Museum of Marrakech - 6. 1 km / 3. 8 mi; Ben Youssef Madrasa - 6. 2 km / 3. 8 mi; Dar Bellarj - 6. 2 km / 3. 9 mi; Marrakech Museum - 6. 3 km / 3. 9 mi; Shrob ou Shouf Fountain - 6. 3 km / 3. 9 mi; Zawiya of Sidi Bel Abbas - 6. 4 km / 4 mi; Boucharouite Museum - 6. 4 km / 4 mi; Ben Youssef Mosque - 6. 5 km / 4 mi; Almoravid Koubba - 6. 5 km / 4 mi.

85407.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a spa tub, and a steam room. This riad also features complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy Moroccan cuisine at Le Bistro Arabe, one of the riad's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 10 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

85451.description: You'll immediately feel at home at the ibis Amsterdam Centre Stopera, a calm and relaxed space close to the city's famous Canal Ring. From the hotel you can reach almost all the city's highlights by foot, while back at the hotel you'll have the comfort of our relaxing SweetBeds, a private bathroom, a flat-screen TV and free WiFi. Our reception is open 24/7 and a late check-out is always possible. Breakfast is offered every morning, and you can also enjoy a great lunch or dinner in the ibis Kitchen.

85453.description: Located just 300 meters from RER A Train Station, Apparthôtel Torcy is ideally located for Disneyland Paris Theme Park in 3 stops. Paris-Charles de Gaulle Airport is 20km away. Many shops and restaurants are located near the hotel. Apparthotel Torcy offers different types of accommodation, all with free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom. The double studios, twin studios, family studios and family apartments are all equipped with a kitchenette and are located in the main building. Every morning you can enjoy a buffet breakfast of French pastries, ham, cheese, fruit and yogurts in our breakfast room. The reception and the breakfast room are located in the main building.

85454.description: This hotel enjoys an unbeatable location in a pedestrian street in the famous Gothic Quarter of Barcelona. Guests only need to cross the beautiful Flowers Ramblas to discover the Boquería, the most colourful market in the city. The most fashionable boutiques and shops in Barcelona are but steps away. The hotel offers free WI-FI in all the rooms, reception, and the café-bar. This hotel is the perfect choice for those who wish to be close to the modernist Barcelona and the Gothic quarter, with the best museums, tourist attractions and restaurants, without missing out on comfort.

name.content: Zoetry Villa Rolandi Isla Mujeres Cancun

85496.address: Fracc. Laguna Mar, SM7, MZ75, Carretera Sac, L15/16
85496.description: Located in the southern zone of the idyllic island of Isla Mujeres, this is an intimate beachfront escape of oceanfront and ocean view rooms. Upon arrival at the resort on private yacht, guests will enter a world of relaxation, where Tikul stone floors, Tikal and marble mats and tiled vault ceilings adorn each room and breathtaking views of the Caribbean Sea and mainland Cancun are offered throughout the property. This resort also features the famed restaurant, Casa Rolandi, serving high-end Swiss-Northern Italian fare; a variety of water sports and sailing experiences that depart from the resort's private dock; a Thalasso Therapy experience as well as an outdoor seawater hot tub; and luxurious accommodations, each with a hot tub on the balcony, fine linens and a therapeutic shower.

85526.description: This hotel enjoys a charming setting close to Kemer. The hotel is located in Goynuk, at the foot of the Taurus Mountains. Overlooking the turquoise waters of the Mediterranean, the hotel enjoys an air of peace and serenity. The larger resort of Kemer is just 7 km from the hotel, where guests can find a wide range of attractions, as well as shopping, dining and entertainment venues. Antalya Airport is set 50 km away. Links to the public transport are available nearby, offering ease of access to other areas to be explored. The hotel enjoys a distinctive architectural design. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, oozing character and charm. Guests can also dine at the on-site restaurants serving variety of food among world cuisines with the treasures in its menu. Providing a number of exemplary facilities and services, this hotel is sure to impress.

85557.description: Easily accessible by car and offering generous car parking, the stylish Park Plaza Amsterdam Airport is located in the small suburb of Lijnden, just ten minutes from Schiphol Airport. Ideal for leisure guests, the hotel is close to a host of places of interest, including the city of Haarlem, famed for its shopping and cuisine, the gastronomic town of Hoofddorp, The Nieuwe Meer and the city's largest forest, the Amsterdamse Bos. Nearby Zandvoort and the plane-spotting spot at Schiphol Airport are popular with children and adults. Guests can also enjoy the new Spa & Wellness facilities as well as the extensive fitness centre. Park Plaza Amsterdam Airport boasts 342 contemporary superior and executive rooms, each with complimentary Wi-Fi. Offering additional space, executive rooms include a defined living area with sofa and table, as well as a bathroom with bath, shower and separate toilet. Among the additional in-room amenities are tea/coffee making facilities, air-conditioning, a safe, flatscreen TV and electrical adapters. Rollaway beds are available on request. The hotel's restaurant serves a wide variety of international cuisines complemented by an extensive wine list in an informal setting.   The bar is the perfect place in which to relax over a freshly ground coffee, innovative sandwich or crisp salad. Cocktails, beers and snacks abound in the bar, and the hotel's Room Service menu is available until 11pm each day.

name.content: Doubletree by Hilton Lisbon - Fontana Park

85558.address: Rua Eng Vieira Da Silva 2 Lisboa
85558.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service. Discover the unique design of the DoubleTree by Hilton Lisbon - Fontana Park. Created from Lisbon's 20th-century metallurgical factory, our hotel features original details combined with contemporary geometry. The striking design and relaxing waterfall cascade in our outdoor Winter Garden have earned us several accolades in Design and Decoration since 2008. This cozy area has the perfect environment to relax at any time of the day. Enjoy your meal in a setting of trees that will take you to exotic, faraway places. Meet with friends or colleagues to enjoy cocktails and relaxing music played by DJs at Fontana Bar & Lounge. Visit our fashionable bar on Thursdays and enjoy a drink while filling your soul with the warm rhythms of our Jazz Sessions. Dine in style at our restaurant Saldanha Mar, where our Chef has created a tempting Portuguese and Mediterranean-style menu, showcasing the finest fish and seafood flavors. Relax in contemporary spacious accommodations at DoubleTree by Hilton. Choose from our stylish guest rooms, family rooms or suites, featuring an array of amenities to make you feel at home. Enjoy a drink from the minibar as you watch movies on the TV, soak in the bathtub or work at the large desk with WiFi. Upgrade to an expansive suite for superior views about Lisbon. Celebrate or hold a meeting for up to 400 people at this Lisbon hotel with 7 flexible meeting spaces, all with the latest A/V equipment and direct access to the hotel's interior car park. Modern, innovative and cosmopolitan, the DoubleTree by Hilton Lisbon - Fontana Park offers you a privileged location in one of the main business centers of Lisbon. The hotel is located in the heart of the city, close to the historical center and the main attractions of the Portuguese capital as well as shopping areas.

85576.description: This air-conditioned boutique hotel in Istanbul was renovated in 2007 and comprises a total of 22 guest rooms. It offers a range of facilities, including an entrance hall with a 24-hour reception service and WLAN Internet access. Guests are welcomed to enjoy refreshments at the bar, or dine at the charming terrace restaurant, where typical Turkish breakfasts are served. The design and decoration of the rooms has taken into consideration all of guests' needs. Each comes with an en suite bathroom, satellite/cable TV and Internet access. Air conditioning and heating feature as standard in all accommodation units.

85598.description: This hotel resort is situated in the town of La Garriga. The hotel is located just a short distance away from the station of La Garriga. The artistic, cultural city of Barcelona is located just a 25 minutes' driving distance away. Guests will appreciate this charming setting, from which to explore the many attractions that this captivating area has to offer. This hotel resort boasts an elegant design. The beautifully-appointed guest rooms exude character and poise. The rooms offer comfort and convenience in a peaceful setting. Guests can indulge in the ultimate relaxation in the spa centre. The resort also features 2 restaurants, a convention centre and outdoor pools. This resort is the ideal option for discerning business and leisure travellers.

85657.description: Hotel Villa Laguna is set in a historic villa in Lido, right on the lagoon, with enchanting views of St. Mark’s Square. The nearest vaporetto (water bus) stop is 55 yards away. The only hotel facing the Lagoon, Hotel Villa Laguna allows you to reach Venice and all its famous landmarks in minutes. You can also easily explore the islands, including Murano and its glass factories. In the immediate surroundings of Hotel Villa Laguna you will find supermarkets, restaurants, bars, the beach of Lido, and even the venue of the International Venice Film Festival. The hotel offers a restaurant and a cool garden. With comfortable, spacious rooms and self-catering options, Hotel Villa Laguna is a great place to stay in a great location. ***If your arrival is expected after 11 pm, please notify us promptly. ***

85660.description: The Adagio Access Paris Porte de Charenton welcomes you to the southeast of Paris, a few minutes from Place de la Nation and Bois de Vincennes park. With 132 charming, fully furnished apartments, ranging from studios to 2-room apartments, this Aparthoteloffers easy access to transport links, with 2 metro stations and the beltway nearby. Situated in a tranquil residential area, it is ideal for business travel and family vacations.

name.content: Adagio Access Vanves Porte de Chatillon

85661.description: On the outskirts of Paris, the Adagio Access Vanves Porte de Châtillon offers easy access to the exhibition center at Porte de Versailles and the Paris Palais des Sports arena. This 3-star holiday residence offers 79 furnished apartments, each equipped with a kitchen. Public transport is easily accessible in this tranquil residential neighborhood. The Aparthotel also offers an underground car park.

85671.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and laundry facilities. A shuttle from the hotel to the airport is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 28 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and blackout drapes/curtains, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. San Sebastian Beach - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Port Vell - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Barceloneta Beach - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Port de Barcelona - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Basilica de Santa Maria del Mar - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Parc de la Ciutadella - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Maremagnum - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Picasso Museum - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- El Born Centre Cultural - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Placa del Rei - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Barcelona History Museum - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Moll d'Espanya - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Chocolate Museum - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Barcelona Cathedral - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Barcelona City Council - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi. The preferred airport for Hotel 54 Barceloneta is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 18. 7 km / 11. 6 miLocated in Barcelona (Ciutat Vella), Hotel 54 Barceloneta is within a 15-minute walk of Port de Barcelona and Barceloneta Beach. This hotel is 0. 8 mi (1. 2 km) from Picasso Museum and 0. 9 mi (1. 5 km) from Barcelona Cathedral.

85678.description: The Wall Street Hotel epitomizes boutique hotel charm: small, modern, and stylish. Perfectly situated in Lower Manhattan, it's surrounded by iconic landmarks like the South Street Seaport, the New York Stock Exchange, Battery Park, and the 9/11 Memorial. A short ferry ride from Battery Park grants access to the Statue of Liberty. The hotel offers 56 designer rooms featuring queen-size beds, coffee machines, high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs with international channels, voicemail, Sony Dream Machines, microwaves, and mini-fridges. A city tax of $3. 50 per room/night ($7. 00 for Junior Suites) is payable directly to the hotel. Triple rooms include a queen-size bed and an extra bed. Breakfast is available for $15 per person/day, and parking is $40 per 24 hours. Upon arrival, guests are required to provide a photo ID and credit card.

name.content: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

85775.description: Set it the very heart of Paris, the hotel illustrates the elegance of romanticism. The hotel is ideally located in the very chic 17th district of Paris. It is within walking distance from the Grands Magasins, the Opera, the Champs Elysées, Montmartre, as well as the splendid Parc Monceau and the Palais des Congrès. The hotel is also very well served by metros and buses. Nearby, several excellent restaurants offer a large variety of cuisines to suit every pallet.

85821.description: Only 4 km from the world famous Sugar Loaf, and 9 km from the city centre, the hotel is located in one of Rio de Janeiro's best beaches, the notorious Copacabana. With an amazing view and privileged location, close to the metro and all the shopping and leisure in Copacabana, this hotel is designed to provide guests with comfort and an unforgettable experience. In the lobby, there are the 24-hour reception, an American bar, the restaurant and the business centre, the safe, and internet access, for a fee.

85883.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of the recreational amenities, including a sauna, a 24-hour fitness center, and a seasonal outdoor pool. This Art Deco hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fees apply). Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Geneva? This hotel has 18, 299 square feet (1, 700 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 12 meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself at home in one of the 226 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Paquis Baths (0. 3 mi), Park Mon Repos (0. 4 mi), and Sisi Monument (0. 4 mi).

85899.description: This hotel is located in the city centre of Lisbon and was established in 2008, close to the Praca de Touros and the nearest station is Campo Pequeno. It is only 10 minutes to Lisbon Airport by car. The hotel offers 295 guest rooms including 31 suites, furnished in a contemporary style. They come equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning. The hotel has 2 restaurants serving a wide range of international foods and many Portuguese specialities, and a trendy bar for cocktails and drinks. There is an outdoor swimming pool for guests to take a dip in the hottest day. Other leisure facilities include a sauna and a fitness centre where guests can relax with a number of treatments and massages.

85966.description:
The hotel is situated close to the Parc des Expositions and Porte de Versailles and not far from the Eiffel Tower and the Champs-Élysées. From here, guests enjoy direct access to the main sites. Charles de Gaulle International Airport is 35 km away and Orly International Airport is only 16 km away.

This small, charming, 15-room city hotel was completely renovated in 2004. Fully air-conditioned, it provides many services including 24-hour reception, La Dînée restaurant, and room and laundry services.

Each en suite guest room comes fully equipped with air conditioning, central heating, plasma-screen TV with Canal+ channels, broadband Internet access, direct dial telephone, triple glazing, Scandinavian bed with silk duvet, minibar, hairdryer, deluxe bath towels and cosmetic products.

Take the exit for Porte de Sèvres from the ring road and follow signs for Balard. Go under the bridge. When you reach Balard place, take a left. The hotel is 100 m down the road, on the right-hand side. Metro: Lourmel.

85968.description: Located in the heart of Paris, the Moxy Paris Bastille is within a 10-minute drive of iconic landmarks such as Notre-Dame and Palais Garnier. This hotel offers 185 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with an LCD TV, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast for a fee, grab snacks at the coffee shop/cafe, or dine at the hotel's bar/lounge for lunch or dinner. Additional amenities include a terrace, a garden, concierge services, a business center, and self-parking (subject to charges).

85971.description: Enjoy stunning rooftop terrace views at Economy Hotel, located in the heart of Athens. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy convenient concierge services. A coffee shop/cafe and limited room service are available for dining. Unwind at the bar/lounge. The hotel's 56 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, refrigerators, and private balconies. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. You'll be within a 10-minute walk of Ermou Street and Monastiraki Flea Market, and a short distance from the Acropolis and the Ancient Agora of Athens.

85972.description: The hotel is situated in the centre of Piraeus city overlooking the port. Fully renovated in 2006, this air-conditioned city hotel has 40 well-equipped rooms and offers the advantage of combining pleasure with business activities. It has been designed to satisfy the needs of its guests and to facilitate their activities. The hotel enjoys a unique combination of high quality services in a friendly and comfortable environment. Services provided by the hotel include a lobby with 24-hour reception and check out, a hotel safe, currency exchange facility and lift access. Guests can additionally make use of the hotel's Internet access and room and laundry services. All rooms are en suite with a shower. The rooms come equipped with double beds, a balcony or terrace and some also offer a view to city's main port. The hotel provides a continental breakfast.

85973.description: This hotel is situated in the centre of Piraeus city and is the ideal place to meet guests' needs and to facilitate their activities. This hotel offers a unique combination of high quality services in a friendly and comfortable environment, and is perfect for combining business activities with pleasure. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area, a hotel safe, a café, a bar, a breakfast room and Internet access. Guests may also take advantage of the room and laundry services. All rooms are simply decorated and are equipped with standard amenities including a shower and a direct dial telephone. The hotel's lounge provides a cosy atmosphere that is perfect for relaxing with a drink and sharing moments with friends and family.

85975.description: The hotel is 17 km away from the airport and 12 km away from the centre of Piraeus. It is situated just 100 metres from the sea, the beach and the tram station. This hotel is the ideal place due to its easy access to Athens city and for enjoying the relaxation of the Glyfada area which combines the beach and the great shopping area. The hotel is convenient to Glyfada's finest restaurants, shopping, entertainment, recreation and its business district. The hotel is only 100 metres away from the beach and among plenty of trees. The hotel has 75 guest rooms. Guests can enjoy the beautiful views of the Saronic Gulf from their room balcony. All these 75 comfortable hotel rooms are light and feature air conditioning, satellite TV, a direct telephone line, minibar, hairdryer and safe box to offer guests a pleasant stay. Some rooms have astonishing sea views of the Saronic coast. Driving from airport, take Attica road (the motorway that connects the airport with Athens) turning on the junction for Koropi Markopoulo, and follow signs for Glyfada. Drive along the Vari Koropiou avenue and at the end, at the Glyfada sign, turn to Posidonos avenue. The hotel is situated on the left-hand side, 800 metres away from Glyfada square.

86017.address: Prolongacion Bonampak, S/N, Punta Sam, Lote Terren
86017.description: Indulge in a luxurious escape at the 5-star Excellence Playa Mujeres - Adults Only All Inclusive, nestled in the serene Playa Mujeres area of Punta Sam. Just a short drive from Mujeres Beach and the Punta Sam Ferry Terminal, this all-inclusive property offers a wealth of amenities. Pamper yourself at the spa with massages, body treatments, and facials, or unwind by one of the seven outdoor swimming pools or on the private beach. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of concierge services and gift shops. Each of the 450 guestrooms boasts a private furnished balcony or patio, a free minibar, an LED television with satellite programming, and a private bathroom with a jetted bathtub and separate shower. Savor international cuisine at Toscana, one of the ten on-site restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Refreshments are available at the coffee shop, beach bar, eleven bars/lounges, and seven poolside bars. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and free valet parking.

86070.description: This 4-star superior hotel, established in 2008, graces Barcelona's trendiest district. Housed in a striking skyscraper designed by Dominique Perrault, it's a short drive from the CCIB and a 10-minute walk to Torre Agbar and the nearest metro station, Poblenou. The hotel boasts a restaurant, two bars, two terraces, a conference space and meeting rooms with natural daylight, an outdoor swimming pool, a 24-hour gym, a spa, and a 24th-floor terrace offering stunning city views.

86085.description: Enjoy a continental breakfast for a fee, served weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM. This hotel offers 24 individually decorated guestrooms, each featuring minibars, espresso makers, and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi is also provided. Private bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Additional conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. A 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage are available for your comfort. Maison Monceau is centrally located in Paris, a short drive from the Arc de Triomphe and Palais Garnier. Nearby attractions include Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore (0. 9 km) and the Champs-Élysées (2 km). The closest airports are Paris Orly Airport (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG).

86116.description: The hotel is located in a quiet place in the heart of Lisbon, near Praça dos Restauradores, close to Lisbon's main shopping area, and right by many of the best sightseeing spots in the city. Public transportation links are a few steps from the hotel, putting the whole city within easy reach. 100 modernly decorated rooms, the upper ones with views of St. Jorge Castle. In the restaurant Taberna da Glória, both the ambience and the food are excellent, a charming cosy place. This is a non-smoking hotel.

86138.description: Located in Taksim, the heart of Istanbul's new city, this hotel offers 73 deluxe rooms, nine of which boast stunning Bosphorus views. Guests enjoy air conditioning, a 24-hour reception, and paid room and laundry services. Parking is also available. The hotel's attention to detail ensures a quality stay, with specially designed furniture and custom-made beds in each deluxe room. Modern amenities include plasma TVs with satellite/cable channels, interactive TV, and internet access. The restaurant serves a delectable menu of Turkish and international cuisine.

name.content: Ramada Plaza By Wyndham Istanbul City Center

86140.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul's textile district, the Ramada Plaza Istanbul is within walking distance of Taksim Square, the Istanbul Convention and Exhibition Center, and the trendy Nisantasi district. This hotel offers easy access to the city's largest shopping centers via the nearby Osmanbey metro station, just steps away. High-tech meeting facilities are available, and children 12 and under stay free. Non-smoking and accessible rooms are available upon request. Atatürk Airport is 23 km from the hotel.

86178.address: Bp 14339, Quaha Sidi Brahim I La Palmeraie
86178.description: This charming, family-friendly club resort is just 10 km away from the city centre and its medina, and a 2-minute drive from the nearest beach at Essaouira. The hotel enjoys an excellent location, approximately 12 km from Marrakech-Menara airport. This luxury five-star property is located in the Palmeraie Desert, just 10 km from the enchanting city of Marrakech. Everything at hotel, from the architecture to the cuisine, is an innovative blend of old and new, allowing guests to step into the past and be submerged in true Moroccan style, while being spoiled with all imaginable present-day luxuries. The air-conditioned hotel offers 54 rooms in total and welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, and currency exchange facilities. Further facilities include a hairdressing salon, cafe, bar, restaurant, car park and garage. Guests may also take advantage of the conference facilities, WLAN Internet access, room service and a laundry service. Each of these hotel's comfortable rooms includes air conditioning and central heating, a double or king-size bed, a daily newspaper, desk and en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub, bathrobes and hairdryer. Other in-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, a radio, Internet access, a safe and a minibar. Non-smoking rooms are also available. The hotel's sport and leisure options include a selection of massages and spa treatments, minigolf, a hot tub, gym, sauna, tennis courts and a spa. There is also a heated outdoor swimming pool with poolside snack bar and sun loungers and parasols laid out ready for use.

86179.description: Located in the heart of the renowned and dynamic residential area of Gueliz, the hotel is right next to the famous Djemaa el Fna square and the Medina. Just 15 minutes from Menara International Airport (approximately 4 kms), the hotel offers immediate access to the centre of the city. At this hotel convenience and comfort have been transformed into an art. Its restaurants and bars provide the perfect setting for relaxing and socialising and offer refined French and traditional Moroccan cuisine with the latest in fusion dishes from around the world. Renovated in 2009, the residence features 181 rooms and several conference facilities. The establishment has two swimming pools, including one indoor and a separate children's swimming area. Guests may enjoy the sun terrace where parasols have been laid out for use. Massage and spa treatments are available.

86183.description: Discover central Scotland from our Falkirk hotel. In a quiet, green area of the town, you're well placed to get out and explore the countryside or zip off to business and leisure destinations in Edinburgh and Glasgow. Host your special event at Glenbervie House. Take a spin at the Falkirk Wheel, the world's only rotating boat lift. Step into Scotland's history at Stirling Castle, or get your boots on and explore the Lowlands. Then plot a course for our fantastic restaurant and a great night's sleep in one of our super comfy new generation bedrooms, with an impressive 40" flat screen TV, freshly-updated bathroom with large shower head, and brand new, slumber-inducing, king-size Hypnos bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

name.content: Premier Inn London Ilford - Newbury Park

86184.description: A friendly London hotel with excellent transport links, meeting rooms, free Wi-Fi and breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® London - Newbury Park hotel is 200 metres from the Newbury Park underground station. On-site parking is available for a small daily fee, and direct trains to central London take around half an hour. The nearby M11 and M25 motorways provide easy access to the city and London Stansted Airport (STN), half an hour's drive away. You can drive to London City Airport in 25 minutes. Central London's shops, museums and businesses are only 30 minutes away by Tube. The huge Westfield Stratford City shopping centre is seven miles away, and you can try out the facilities at the Lee Valley Velopark or the London Aquatics Centre in the neighbouring Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park. Book a round of golf at Hainault Forest Golf Club, four miles from the hotel. You can host your clients in the hotel's two naturally lit meeting rooms, complete with free Wi-Fi and space for up to 220 guests. If you're expecting a long day, buffet lunches can be arranged. Set yourself up for the day with an Express Start Breakfast with scrambled eggs, baked beans, sausages and continental items, included in your room rate. Settle down to dinner with friends during the week in the bright, roomy lounge, or enjoy a snack and a pint at the lobby bar.

86223.description: This club resort is located right at the beach. It is roughly 17 kms from Antalya city centre and some 15 kms to Antalya Airport. Situated directly on the sands of Lara Beach, the luxurious resort is the perfect choice for all holiday makers. The air-conditioned resort has a host of modern amenities on hand to cater for guests' every need, from an array of dining options to excellent children's facilities. Each of the 221 well-appointed guest rooms offers spacious and fully equipped accommodation. In addition to 3 swimming pools, one of which is indoors (heated), the resort provides a full daytime and evening entertainment programme for both adults and children. Those looking to truly relax and unwind can enjoy a visit to the sauna or the steam room. More active guests may want to try their hand at various sports and activities available at the hotel.

86276.description: This hotel is situated in Lisbon, just a 5-minute walking distance from Campo Pequeno metro station, which offers direct access to the popular Avenida da Liberdade in 3 stops. Lisbon Airport is only a 10-minute driving distance from the property. Guests will find themselves just a 10-minute walk from the Calouste Gulbenkian Museum and near a popular shopping mall. This hotel represents the ideal choice to stay, providing modern rooms with air conditioning, satellite TV, coffee and tea facilities and minibar. A great choice for gastronomy lovers, as well as for culture and history enthusiasts. As for the onsite facilities and services, a breakfast is served daily in the spacious breakfast restaurant whilst the bar provides a variety of drinks, snacks and light meals.

86280.description: With a stay at The Adamson Hotel in Dunfermline, you'll be within a 15-minute drive of Deep Sea World and Pittencrieff Park. This hotel is 16. 2 mi (26. 1 km) from Edinburgh Zoo and 15. 6 mi (25. 1 km) from Royal Highland Centre. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and a picnic area. Featured amenities include luggage storage and laundry facilities. Free self parking is available onsite. At The Adamson Hotel, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. To-go breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7 AM to 9 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Stay in one of 39 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily.

86316.description: The Hotel Ca' Tron offers a convenient base for exploring the Veneto region, including Venice, Padua, Treviso, Vicenza, and Chioggia. Located in the heart of the Riviera del Brenta, renowned for its historic Venetian Villas, the hotel provides easy access to both Venice and Padua. Check-in is between 5 pm and 8:30 pm. Arrivals after 9 pm will be considered a no-show. Late check-in is available between 9 pm and 11 pm for an additional fee of €70. 00, with a minimum of 10 days' prior notice. Please email your estimated arrival time to info@hotelcatron. it. Upon arrival, you will be asked for your voucher and a valid ID. Breakfast is available for an additional fee (information provided at check-in). Please note that luggage storage is not available, and the hotel and its rooms are non-smoking. A car (rental available) is recommended for exploring the charming town of Dolo, nearby beaches, spas, shopping centers, and restaurants. Free parking is available at the hotel. Public transport is also readily available, with a bus stop directly in front of the hotel offering service to Mestre, Venice, and Padua. From Venice 'Marco Polo' or Treviso Airport, take a bus to Venice 'Piazzale Roma, ' then purchase a return ticket to Dolo. Take the bus towards Dolo, Padua, or Stra (departures every 30 minutes), and request the 'Hotel Cà Tron' or 'Dolo Scuole' stop.

name.content: Ibis Styles Barcelona Sant Joan Despi

86336.description: The ibis Styles Barcelona Sant Joan Despí is the best option if you're coming by car and want to forget about it during your visit. With a bus and tram service close to the hotel, you can reach Barcelona center or Camp Nou in minutes. The hotel has spacious rooms. Unwind in our tranquil garden and pool, or sample the dishes at Be Smart Food.

86339.description:
This hotel is located in the historical, gastronomical and exciting downtown of Madrid. The hotel is very close to Gran Vía, to the Royal Palace, and the most important opera houses in the country. It is just a few minutes' walk from the Prado, Thyssen Bornemisza and Reina Sofia museums and a short walk from the best restaurants in the city. The hotel also has free Wi-Fi and conference rooms. The safety of our customers is our priority and so in accordance with local health legislation, the breakfast service may have temporary changes (opening hours, products on offer, layout and service. 
Please be informed that the swimming pool on the property has an age restriction (14yo). 
We’re refreshing our terrace to surprise you soon. Stay original.

86359.description: Le Caspien Hotel is located in the Gueliz district in the city of Marrakech, near the Carré Eden Mall, Central Market and from the main historical monuments of the medina and Jamaa El Fna. The 38 rooms are equipped with air conditioning, telephone, TV and safe (supplement). Its restaurants offer international and Moroccan cuisine in a modern and refined atmosphere decorated with artwork.

86412.description: Situated centrally, just a few minutes' walk from Ca Granda metro station, the modern a&o Milano Ca Granda offers an ideal location for both business and leisure travelers. Equipped with free Wi-Fi and a 380-seat convention center, the hotel is perfect for conferences and business trips. Guests can also enjoy a relaxing break in the fitness center or the seasonal outdoor pool, open from 10 am to 7 pm during the summer months. Explore the center of Milan with ease, thanks to the hotel's convenient location.

86416.description: The Novotel Venezia Mestre Castellana is a 4-star hotel for business and leisure trips, convenient for visiting Venice, just 7 km away. Located near the ring road and reachable by car or public transport (bus and tram), it has a private parking and is 2 km from Venice Mestre Station and 10 km from Venice Marco Polo Airport. Its location allows you to quickly reach the center of Mestre and Piazza Ferretto.

86417.description: A 10-minute drive from the airport, the 4-star Novotel Milano Malpensa Airport offers soundproof and air-conditioned rooms with free WIFI. Shuttle service currently available on request ( payable on the spot )Large convention center with meeting rooms. Gourmet bar open every day with a menu of light local specialties. Unheated outdoor pool and modern fitness room. Some services may be suspended in compliance with the new regulations.

86439.description: Enjoy a privileged location near the Pantheon and the Sorbonne, just steps from the Quartier Latin. Explore Paris's historic Île de la Cité, with Notre Dame Cathedral within easy walking distance. Metro stations Maubert-Mutualité and Saint-Michel are also nearby. Renovated in 2017, the Villa Pantheon welcomes you to the mythical Saint-Germain district on the Left Bank. Experience the authentic English colonial style and exceptional comfort of our refined rooms, a subtle blend of tradition and modernity.

86440.description: Stay at the 4-star 9Hotel Republique in central Paris, just a short drive from Notre-Dame and the Palais Garnier. This hotel offers 48 guestrooms with LCD TVs, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Enjoy satellite programming and private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Take advantage of the 24-hour fitness center, concierge services, and the on-site bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. Additional amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. The Louvre Museum and the Champs-Élysées are conveniently located within a 2. 6-mile radius.

86477.description: This hotel enjoys a prime location in Paris. The hotel is situated just a 10 minutes' tram ride away from the Porte de Versailles Exhibition Park. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the Parc Montsouris and the Cite Universitaire. The catacombs of Montparnasse Cemetery are located just 2 km away. The hotel is set amidst a colourful quarter of Paris, just a short distance away from many shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. This family-friendly establishment appeals to business and leisure travellers alike. The hotel features a stunning blend of Oriental and Moroccan decor. The guest rooms are luxuriously styled, oozing character and charm. Guests can take advantage of the wealth of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

86478.description: This hotel is located in very quiet and safe surroundings on the Left Bank, in the heart of the Montparnasse district. Notre Dame is a 10-minute ride away on public transport and it is 20 minutes by the same means to the Eiffel Tower. This city hotel features colonial-style interiors, with fine panelling and warm colours, combining of charming elegance and trendy design. Guests will feel as if they are returning from a safari on Left Bank of the Parisian jungle, with wood, in all its tones, and gilded lamps offering warmth and contrast. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and 24-hour check-in/check out service. The rooms are very attractive and charming and come with a bathtub or shower, a large bed or 2 beds in colonial style. A delicious hot and cold buffet breakfast is available every morning.

86522.description: The elegant 4-star is strategically located in the heart of Milan, 1. 2 miles from Centrale station, opposite the historic Porta Venezia and the park of the same name, an unexpected green oasis that is perfect for jogging. It is ideal for guests traveling for business or leisure who want to immerse themselves in this dynamic city: the Cathedral, La Scala and the famous fashion district can be easily reached in just a few minutes on foot or by metro (stop 5. 5 yds from the hotel).

86526.description: The Avenue Hotel Dubai is a four star hotel located in the heart of the Deira area. The 133 rooms and suites each contain a work desk, flat-screen TV, high-speed internet access, a mini bar, and tea / coffee making facilities. The hotel features 4 food and beverage venues, including a 24 hour restaurant and a lively nightclub. Leisure amenities include a rooftop swimming pool which offers panoramic views, and a fitness centre with gym equipment. The Avenue Hotel Dubai is a short walk from Al Rigga Metro Station, and just 10 minutes drive away from Dubai International Airport.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel, London Canary Wharf East

86531.description: The Radisson Blu Hotel, London Canary Wharf, part of Edwardian Hotels London, offers a sleek and stylish retreat with a relaxed, boutique atmosphere. Soft lighting, water features, and a riverside terrace provide a welcome escape from the bustling Canary Wharf district. Situated opposite the O2 Arena (accessible via the Underground) and conveniently close to the Excel Centre and London City Airport via the East India DLR station, the hotel boasts a tranquil East River Spa featuring ESPA treatments, a sauna, steam room, and a 24-hour gym. Eight meeting rooms cater to events from 2 to 250 guests. The 169 spacious bedrooms at New Providence Wharf offer rich furnishings, 350-thread-count Egyptian cotton bedding, down pillows, REN toiletries, and Italian marble bathrooms, some with freestanding baths. Guests enjoy free high-speed Wi-Fi, USB charging sockets, and Samsung TVs with 300+ channels. Ten river-view rooms offer stunning Thames vistas. The Scoff & Banter restaurant serves a seasonal modern European menu featuring locally sourced produce. Guest favorites include fish and chips, shepherd's pie, Eton mess, and afternoon tea, complemented by a wide selection of wines and cocktails. A full-sized American pool table adds to the entertainment. Floor-to-ceiling windows provide outstanding Thames views from the dining room and riverside terrace. A valid credit card is required upon arrival.

name.content: Ramada by Wyndham Istanbul Old City

86556.description:
Located in the historic heart of Istanbul, Ramada by Wyndham Istanbul Old City offers 108 modern, comfortable rooms designed for both leisure and business travelers. Situated in the vibrant Findikzade district, the hotel enjoys a prime location directly next to the tram line, providing effortless access to the city's most iconic landmarks. 

Within walking distance, guests can explore the majestic Blue Mosque, the magnificent Hagia Sophia, the historic Topkapi Palace, and the colorful Grand Bazaar — placing the very best of Istanbul at your doorstep. 

Each morning begins with a rich open buffet breakfast, while the on-site Marmara Restaurant serves a selection of Turkish specialties and international cuisine in a welcoming atmosphere. 

For relaxation and wellness, the Aqua Plus Spa invites guests to unwind with a traditional Turkish bath, sauna, steam room, massage therapies, and a fully equipped fitness center. Business travelers benefit from dedicated meeting facilities and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the property. 

With excellent public transportation connections right outside the hotel, guests can easily reach lively Taksim Square in just 5 km, while Istanbul Airport (IST) is approximately 44 km away. 

Whether visiting for culture, business, or a city escape, Ramada by Wyndham Istanbul Old City combines comfort, convenience, and authentic hospitality in an unbeatable location.

86564.description: Behind the hotel lies the lively Vaugirard neighbourhood with its countless boutiques, restaurants, bars and cafés. This charming city property is located next to the most important exhibition centre and near the famous Montsouris Park. The Eiffel Tower and Luxembourg Park are around 1. 8 km from the family-friendly business hotel and Montparnasse train station is roughly 2 km away. This warm and exotic haven is housed in a typical Parisian building dating back to 1900, offering a bar, 45 beautiful rooms and Internet access in the lobby. Completely refurbished in a safari style, the guest rooms are equipped with an en-suite bathroom, individually regulated heating and satellite TV.

86624.description: This splendid property is superbly located on Plaza de la Independencia, an essential part of Madrid's city centre. The hotel offers some fantastic views of the Puerta de Alcalá. This delightful building was built in 1883 and today houses a welcoming combination of elegance, dining and pure relaxation. This historical city hotel comprises a total of 41 rooms and facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility. The Malvar restaurant with an exterior Terrace and interior lounge bar, offer one of the best views of Madrid city centre. Conference facilities available and Wi-Fi in all public areas. At the Bodyna Spa, guests will find a wide range of areas and services fully dedicated to their well-being.   The rooms feature modern decoration and an exclusive avant-garde style. The hotel features an annexed building with a spa.

86756.description: Set in a great location on Cleopatra's Beach in central Alanya with views of the castle set high on a hilltop, this hotel is a great base for beach lovers and those who wish to be within easy reach of the resort's many amenities. The pedestrianized shopping centre is approximately a 10-minute walk and public transport runs close to the hotel. The hotel features a pleasant pool area with a cafe terrace leading onto the beach. There is also a sauna and Turkish bath for guest leisure, and guests will find drinks and snacks at the three bars and rich and varied buffet-style meals at the in-house restaurant.
