86776.description: Located in the Marais, one of the oldest and most vibrant neighbourhoods in Paris, this family-friendly city hotel offers easy access to famous museums such as the Picasso Museum and the Louvre, as well as the most exclusive designer boutiques. Guests can admire the historic mansions that line the Place des Vosges and the cosmopolitan crowds at the Bastille. The nearest public transport is only 100 m from the hotel and Orly International Airport is only 18 km from the property. This hotel is reminiscent of a great country house, featuring a sky-lit garden conservatory and 50 well-appointed rooms. The cosy units are decorated in classic French style with a hunting lodge atmosphere. Each comes fully equipped with modern amenities which include Internet access and satellite TV.

86802.description: This delightful hotel boasts an enviable setting in Milan. It offers the perfect setting from which to explore Leonardo Sa Vinci's Last Supper, the elegant La Scala Theatre, the gothic Duomo and the Alzaia Naviglio Grande. World-famous shopping opportunities are on the doorstep. Guests can enjoy delectable dining options and vibrant entertainment opportunities in the vicinity. This spectacular hotel has been designed with Italian style and grace in mind. The classically-styled guest rooms ooze character and charm. Guests are sure to be impressed by the wide range of first-class facilities and services that this superb establishment has to offer.

87006.description: Located in one of the flourishing areas of the Lisbon Region, Costa de Caparica is just 15km from the centre of Lisbon and 3 km from the sea. With 227 rooms while staying with us you can enjoy the hotel view of the ocean overlooking the town of Costa de Caparica, or visit the Boca do Vento elevator to see the best views over Lisbon. Combining work and leisure, our hotel is within a 25 minute drive of Lisbon Airport with the subway or buses direct to the heart of Lisbon. Renowned for Conferences and Congresses, major events are also hosted in the Centro Cultural de Belém, Lisbon Congress Centre or FIL-Lisbon Exhibition and Congress Centre. Our Crowne Plaza also offers 7 meeting rooms, with a spacious lobby ideal as a welcome-drinks venue, or an exhibition gallery. The ideal location for visiting Lisbon’s most iconic neighbourhoods, from Alfama to Bairro Alto or Madragoa, passing by the vibrant Marvila, Beato or Cais do Sodré, and landmarks like Mosteiro dos Jerónimos, Torre de Belém or Castelo de Sāo Jorge. For a beach holiday, Costa de Caparica’s beaches offer a whole range of activities, from a relaxing summer’s day enjoying the sun to winter surfing classes at some of the most renowned schools in the region. Or just book a treatment at our Hotel Spa. Our all-day dining restaurant serves reinterpretations of the most typical dishes and delicacies from the region. Access our complimentary Wi-Fi connection and relax or work at our lobby bars or poolside.

87020.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at The Dylan Amsterdam, a centrally located hotel in the heart of Amsterdam. Indulge in French cuisine at Vinkeles, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. The hotel also offers a coffee shop/cafe and a bar/lounge. A full breakfast is available daily for a fee. Recreational opportunities include a fitness center and bicycle rentals. The hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services. Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. The 41 individually decorated guestrooms feature iPod docking stations, LED televisions, satellite programming, designer toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and minibars. The hotel is conveniently located an 8-minute walk from Anne Frank House and 11 minutes from Dam Square, close to The 9 Streets and other attractions.

87056.description: This Buenos Aires Hotel represents the sophisticated and classic style of this historical city. Enjoy your holidays with the beautifully designed suites, indoor pool and onsite spa. Conveniently located near major cultural attractions such as museums, theatres, traditional coffee shops and famous neighborhoods such as San Telmo and Florida Avenue, this luxurious hotel will let you experience the authentic Argentina.

87080.description: Located 15 minutes' drive from Madrid and with easy access to the M30 and M40 motorways, Exe Madrid Norte offers free Wi-Fi. Set in gardens, it features a seasonal outdoor swimming pool (opening: 15. 06. 2026 - 09. 09. 2026). Queen-size beds are on offer in each of the stylish rooms at the Exe Madrid Norte. All rooms have tea and coffee-making facilities and a 26' LCD TV. Up to 1 child can stay for free when sharing their parents' room. The IFEMA Exhibition Centre is a 10-minute drive from the Exe Madrid Norte and Madrid Barajas Airport is less than 5 km away. The number 173, 174 and 176 buses stop close to the hotel.

87124.description: The NH Collection Buenos Aires Lancaster hotel is a Georgian-style hotel set in the business area of the city and near the major touristic attractions. The Galerías Pacífico mall is just across the street, where you will find high-end boutiques. You can also walk to Plaza San Martin, Círculo Militar as well as Calle Florida and Calle Reconquista for shopping. NH Collection Buenos Aires Lancaster has 115 comfortable and stylish rooms. Each one has a neutral color palette with rich wood floors and features high-end comfortable mattresses and a choice of pillows. Many of the rooms offer lovely views over Río de la Plata, which you can take in while enjoying a fresh coffee from the Nespresso machine available in each room. Our breakfast will tempt you with a wide variety of options, including local specialties, fresh pastries, dishes made-to-order, and fresh hot and cold beverages. Chef María Luz Mollura cooks up delicious Mediterranean cuisine and gives it an Argentine twist at our hotel restaurant. You can also choose to unwind at the elegant bar with a cocktail or a snack. For relaxation, we have a gym. There are seven meeting rooms for up to 70 people on-site.

name.content: Westin Mina Seyahi Beach Resort & Marina

87136.address: Al Sufouh Rd. Dubai C/O Dubai Int.Club
87136.description:
Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 6 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. All-inclusive rates are available at this hotel. Meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments are included in all-inclusive rates. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the beach bar or one of the 3 poolside bars. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee.

Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services.

87137.description: The Novotel Barcelona Cornell seamlessly blends business and leisure. It offers five meeting rooms and complimentary Wi-Fi, along with a pioneering mobile check-in/check-out service for added convenience. Each room features both a shower and bath. Guests can relax by the pool and garden or enjoy the spacious terrace at the Binomio Restaurant.

87138.description: Located in Sant Cugat del Valles, the AC Hotel San Cugat by Marriott offers convenient access to both the Autonomous University of Barcelona (a 15-minute drive) and the vibrant city center. Guests can enjoy a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, stay active in the fitness center, or relax by the lobby's fireplace. The hotel's 150 guestrooms feature minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. The AC Lounge serves Mediterranean cuisine for lunch and dinner, and room service is available during limited hours. A buffet breakfast is offered for a fee. Additional amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, conference space, meeting rooms, and on-site self-parking (subject to charges).

name.content: Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel

87176.description: With a stay at Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel by Marriott, you'll be centrally located in New York, steps from Times Square and within a 10-minute walk of Rockefeller Center. This hotel is 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from Radio City Music Hall and 0. 8 mi (1. 4 km) from Central Park. Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include wedding services and a television in a common area. Stay in one of 317 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Satellite programming provides entertainment, and wired and wireless internet access is available for a surcharge. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. At Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel by Marriott, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in New York? This hotel has 1591 square feet (148 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 5 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Times Square - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Broadway - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Rockefeller Center - 0. 5 km / 0.

name.content: Courtyard New York Manhattan/Upper East Side

87177.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and a banquet hall. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Courtyard by Marriott New York Manhattan/Upper East Side. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-out. Planning an event in New York? This hotel has 1367 square feet (127 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 226 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and microwaves. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Carl Schurz Park - 0. 5 km / 0.

87178.description: The Hampton Inn Long Island/Brookhaven hotel in New York is conveniently located in the center of Long Island's most popular attractions and major business districts. Local companies include Symbol Technologies, Computer Associates, Brookhaven National Lab, and Adesa Long Island. We offer complimentary shuttle to Islip's MacArthur Airport and the Long Island Railroad Ronkonkoma. The Hampton Inn Long Island/Brookhaven is just north from Fire Island Beaches and a short drive east to The Hamptons, Long Island's Wine Country, Tanger Factory Outlet and Splish Splash Water Park for your leisurely enjoyment. All Hampton Inn Long Island/Brookhaven hotel guests enjoy complimentary high-speed wireless internet, indoor heated pool, well-equipped fitness center and complimentary On the House breakfast. If your trip to New York requires a meeting room, The Hampton Inn Brookhaven hotel features meeting facilities that comfortably accommodate groups up to 120. We love having you here at the Hampton Inn Long Island/Brookhaven hotel in New York.

87179.description: The hotel is located in the heart of New York City's vibrant Lower East Side, a neighborhood brimming with eclectic shops, diverse bars and restaurants, and cultural attractions such as museums, galleries, and theaters. A nearby subway station whisks guests to midtown in just seven minutes. This architecturally stunning boutique hotel offers 22 oversized rooms with modern conveniences. Its warm, welcoming atmosphere and attentive staff anticipate guests' needs, ensuring a perfect stay. Housed in a building dating back to 1879, this charming hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Guests enjoy amenities including a 24-hour reception, check-in/out service, a hotel safe, lift access, and room service. All rooms feature complimentary wireless Internet access, a telephone with voicemail, an alarm clock, a coffee maker, a table and two chairs, a refrigerator stocked with soft drinks and water, a large closet, a flat-screen TV, a DVD player, a safe, and a lavish bathroom with a deep tub, 300-thread-count linens, and custom-made bedspreads. A hairdryer, an ironing set, a double bed, centrally regulated air conditioning and heating, and a private balcony or terrace complete each room. Guests can savor a continental breakfast featuring coffee, tea, fresh fruit, bagels, butter, and jam. To reach the hotel from uptown or midtown Manhattan, take 2nd Avenue downtown and turn left onto East Houston Street. Turn right onto Allen Street, continue past Delancey Street and Broome Street, then make a left onto Grand Street followed by an immediate left onto Orchard Street. The hotel is located at 100 Orchard Street, between Broome and Delancey Streets.

87180.description: This hotel offers convenient access to Newark Liberty International Airport, just 1 km from the main entrance, and is 2 km from downtown Newark. Nearby businesses and attractions are easily reached via major highways, including the New Jersey Turnpike and Garden State Parkway. New York City and Meadowlands Sports Complex are both within a 32 km radius. Built in 1988, this hotel features 378 guest rooms, each equipped with internet access, a TV, a radio/MP3 player, a work desk, a telephone, an iron, and a hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour fitness center, a Starbucks kiosk, and a convenient pantry located in the hotel lobby. The on-site restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and the hotel also offers private dining rooms and 10, 000 square feet of meeting space.

87198.description: Stop at Island Club Hotel and Apartments to discover the wonders of Cape Town. Both business travelers and tourists can enjoy the hotel's facilities and services. Facilities like 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, facilities for disabled guests, Wi-Fi in public areas are readily available for you to enjoy. Each guestroom is elegantly furnished and equipped with handy amenities. Access to the hotel's fitness center, outdoor pool, indoor pool, children's playground will further enhance your satisfying stay. Friendly staff, great facilities and close proximity to all that Cape Town has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Island Club Hotel and Apartments.

87206.description: The hotel is situated on the outskirts of Oudtshoorn, en route to the Cango Caves and Ostrich Farms. The bus and train stations are approximately 1. 6 km and 10 km away, respectively. The carefully renovated homestead (circa 1852), with its yellowwood beams and ceilings and a tasteful collection of antique furniture, exudes an aura of authenticity. The lovely rose garden, which gave the hotel its name, leads to stylishly decorated bedrooms, each individually furnished. The hotel also has a cosy pub and several luxury lounges with fireplaces where visitors can relax and admire works from well-known South African artists. The air-conditioned property offers a lobby, hotel safe, cloakroom, WLAN Internet access, room and laundry services and a car park. All rooms provide individually regulated air conditioning and heating, satellite TV, telephone, minibar and tea trays. The en suite bathrooms are fitted with a shower, bath and hairdryer, and the bedrooms with double or king-size beds. Further amenities include a radio, Internet access, a safe, an ironing set and a terrace. The spa centre, which offers a fully equipped gym, hot tub, sauna and a beauty clinic, is at guests' disposal. Massages are also available. Guests may enjoy the outdoor saltwater swimming pool with sun loungers and parasols at the water's edge. Golf fans may like to head to the Oudtshoorn Golf Club some 5 km away. Breakfast is served in a sunny breakfast room overlooking beautifully kept gardens. From the R62 in Oudtshoorn follow the main road used to enter the town. At the 3rd set of traffic lights, turn left into Baron Van Reede street. Follow this road for about 1. 5 km. The hotel is situated on the corner of Baron Van Reede and North Street on the right hand side of the road, opposite the Protea Hotel Riempie Estate. From the N2 via Mossel Bay, the two roads connect to one another just before entering Oudtshoorn. Follow the above directions.

87209.address: R310 Zorgvliet Wine Estate Banghoek Valley Helsh, 310
87209.description: The 4-star Zorgvliet Country Lodge offers comfort and convenience whether you're on business or holiday in Stellenbosch. The hotel offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. Wi-Fi in public areas, car park, room service, restaurant, laundry service are on the list of things guests can enjoy. Comfortable guestrooms ensure a good night's sleep with some rooms featuring facilities such as television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless, non smoking rooms, air conditioning, desk. Enjoy the hotel's recreational facilities, including outdoor pool, pool (kids), garden, before retiring to your room for a well-deserved rest. Discover all Stellenbosch has to offer by making Zorgvliet Country Lodge your base.

87211.description: This hotel is situated on the beach at Blouberg, a popular tourist beach on the West Coast. It is located 1 km from Tableview Town centre. It lies 17 km from Cape Town CBD and the V&A Waterfront and 20 km from Cape Town International Airport. With its 38 accommodation units, it is an exclusive resort but all the facilities of a corporate hotel. It enjoys a 24-hour security service and offers one of Cape Town's best Seafood and Sushi restaurants, The Blowfish. The hotel provides conferencing facilities for a maximum of 35 delegates. Further facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area with a 24-hour check-out service, a hotel safe, a cloakroom and lift access. It also offers a bar, a restaurant, conference facilities, Internet access and laundry services. The hotel has a cycle hire station on the premises. There is parking and children's playground as well.

87214.description: The hotel is in an ideal position in the heart of Cape Town, enticing guests to explore a myriad of attractions in the city – from the vibrant nightlife and trendy downtown restaurants and bars; to the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront to the breathtaking Peninsula and legendary winelands. Surrounded by a neighbourhood where cafés, galleries and museums spill onto the sidewalks and almost everyone prefers to take a walk, the Gardens suburb is like a small town community in the bowels of a bustling city. •Reception is manned 24 hours a day•Security is manned 24 hours a day•The Restaurant is operational from 06h30 to 21h00 daily – Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner available•The Bar is operational from 11h00 – 21h00 daily•Breakfast is available from 06h30 – 10h00. Should you require breakfast earlier, please advise us the day before

87219.description: Knysna Hollow re-opened in October 2018 as a brand-new contemporary country retreat offering stylish accommodation, authentic dining in our casual restaurant, Social Eatery and warm, personal service. Situated in the middle of the iconic Garden Route National Park of the Southern Cape Coast, Knysna is the ideal base from whichto explore the myriad of attractions the region has to offer. The history of Mossel Bay, the arid, semi-desert of Oudtshoorn in the Little Karoo and the coastal towns of Wilderness, Sedgefield and Plettenberg Bay are all within an hour's drive, as is Tsitsikamma National Park, renowned for the Storm's River Mouth and some of the country's best hiking trails.

87225.description: Located in Amsterdam's city center, this hotel is housed in a traditional building just minutes from Central Station, Rembrandtplein, major shopping areas, and tourist attractions. Enjoy convenient access to tram, bus, and KLM Airport Shuttle stops, with the airport less than 12 kilometers away. The hotel offers internet access in all rooms and public areas. Start your day in the hotel restaurant overlooking the street, and choose from a variety of clean, well-appointed rooms ranging from cozy singles to spacious family and group accommodations. Experience a warm welcome and professional service at this comfortable city hotel.

87226.description: Next to the Douro River, Imperio Hotel offers free Wi-Fi and accommodations with renovated bathrooms, just 164 feet from the Regua Train Station. Free parking is available upon availability. The air-conditioned guest rooms of the Imperio Hotel offer a work desk and a private bathroom with amenities and a hairdryer. Some rooms have relaxing hydromassage columns. Breakfast is available daily in the spacious restaurant with its blue tones. Guests can also benefit from babysitting services, a 24-hour reception and a laundry service. The Museu do Douro is located a 2-minute walk from The Imperio. Vila Real is a 20-minute drive away.

87234.description:
Situated in the centre of Alanya, this contemporary style hotel is just a few steps from the famous sandy Kleopatra Beach. A fitness centre and a spa area are available for guests. Numerous shops, restaurants, bars and cafés are in the vicinity, attractions such as Alanya Castle, the harbour, Damlatas Caves, the Archaeological Museum or the Red Tower can be easily reached.

***AIR CONDITION IS EXTRA EXCEPT ALL INCLUSIVE - FOR STANDARD ROOMS PER DAY 7€ - FOR APT ROOMS PER DAY 10€***

87265.description: The XO Hotels Blue Tower is located in Amsterdam's Bos en Lommer district. Start your day with breakfast in our on-site restaurant before easily exploring the city. A tram stop conveniently located behind the hotel provides access to the city center in 25 minutes, and bicycle rentals are available at the reception. Several shops and supermarkets are within walking distance in Bos en Lommer square. Schiphol Airport is a short 15-minute drive away, and the hotel offers easy access by both public transport and car, with public parking available next door.

87266.description: Central station (Thalys, Eurostar, streetcars, metro) is within walking distance and so are all the sights in the nearby historic downtown (Anne Frank House, Palace on Dam Square). Guests rate our location right in bustling downtown 9. 4/10. On a business trip? RAI Convention Centre, Amsterdam Arena and Amsterdam Airport Schiphol are only 15 minutes away by train. Our rooms are fully equipped with air conditioning, private bathroom, flat screen TV with free Wi-Fi. The hotel is 100% non smoking. Coming in late or leaving early? Easily check in and check out online. Don't forget to get some goodies from our take away shop in the lobby.

87267.description: The hotel is located near the centre, not far from Rembrandtplein in the De Pijp area of Amsterdam. All the sights such as Dam Square, Rembrandtplein and Leidseplein are close by. Museums such as the famous Rijksmuseum, the Van Gogh Museum, Anne Frank House and others are also in the vicinity. There are theatres and concert halls a short distance from the hotel, which can be reached using public transportation. Restaurants and bars can be found within around 100 m of the hotel, and there are shops within about 1 km. This city hotel offers a total of 21 non-smoking rooms, most of which were refurbished by the end of 2006, providing clean and reasonably priced tourist accommodation in the heart of Amsterdam. Facilities include a hotel lobby.

87268.description: Spectacular city views and views of the IJ River are just some of the highlights at Movenpick Hotel Amsterdam City Centre, just 20 minutes from Schiphol Airport. All 408 rooms offer great views of the city of Amsterdam. Enjoy dinner in our restaurant or a nightcap in the cozy Lobby and Lounge Bar. Relax in our Lifestyle Studio with fitness room, Finnish sauna, bio sauna, ice fountain and massage room.

87269.description: Located between two historic canals in the heart of Amsterdam, the Sofitel Legend The Grand Amsterdam boasts a rich history, evolving from a 15th-century convent to royal lodgings, the Dutch admiralty headquarters, and finally, Amsterdam's city hall. Today, this five-star hotel offers luxury in a unique ambiance, furnished with French elegance and grandeur. Amsterdam's most important landmarks are within walking distance. The Grand offers 178 luxurious rooms and suites with modern bathrooms and rain showers. The 52 exclusive suites include butler service. Combining traditional and contemporary French design with Dutch elements, the rooms and suites feature the advanced technology expected by today's traveler. Over the centuries, this landmark has hosted countless special events and garnered culinary acclaim. Experience exceptional dining at Bridges restaurant with its five-, six-, or seven-course Menu du Chef, or savor Mediterranean flavors at Oriole Garden Bistro. The Garden Terrace, nestled in The Grand's beautiful inner garden, is an oasis of peace and tranquility in the heart of the city. Enjoy The Grand Afternoon Tea at Library 'Or, ' or for whisky lovers, explore The Flying Deer pop-up bar, featuring art by Tadej Oblak and special Glenfiddich whiskies. The Grand also boasts 19 meeting and event spaces, five of which are historical monuments. Guests can unwind at the Sofitel SPA with its heated indoor pool, sauna, hammam, and fitness area. Join the complimentary daily historical tour to experience the hotel's rich history firsthand.

87273.description: This hotel is centrally located in Buenos Aires. The hotel boasts a strategic setting, just 300 metres away from the Obelisk. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the wealth of attractions that the city has to offer. A host of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found close by. Ezeiza International Airport can be found just 15 km away. This charming hotel appeals to business and leisure travellers. The guest rooms offer a high level of comfort, combined with exemplary amenities. The hotel features a wonderful restaurant, where international and Argentinian dishes can be enjoyed. Business travellers will appreciate the hotel's conference and meeting facilities and services.

87280.description: Situated on a quiet road just a 3-minute walk from Earl's Court tube station, this hotel offers convenient access to London's attractions. With 24-hour bus routes to Oxford Street, Knightsbridge, Hyde Park, and Kensington High Street, exploring the city is effortless. Heathrow Airport is 21km, Gatwick 47km, and Stansted 63km away. The hotel provides a 24-hour reception with express checkout and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Guests can enjoy the air-conditioned lobby and breakfast room. Each fully-equipped room features a kitchenette with a fridge, microwave, and coffee maker, along with a hairdryer, plasma-screen TV with satellite channels, telephone, and ironing facilities.

87390.description: Dispone de un amplio bar, espplanada panorámica, salas de lectura, sala de juegos y sala de reuniones y eventos. Se destaca su club de salud con sala de cardio - fitness, jacuzzi, baño turco, sauna y salas de masajes (algunos servicios todavía no estan disponibles)

87477.description: Whether your stay is for business or leisure, the Novotel Milano Linate Aeroporto hotel offers modern essentials, comfort and hospitality. The 4-star hotel is easy to reach from the airport via a convenient shuttle service and is only a few minutes' awayon public transport from Milan's cultural attractions and shopping streets. Fully equipped meeting rooms and relaxation areas are available so the whole family, including your four-legged friends, can have a comfortable stay. It's a lot better at Novotel.

87479.description: Istanbul World Trade Centre and the CNR Exhibition Centre are within walking distance, central Istanbul is approximately 16 km away. Features of the non-smoking hotel include 360 rooms, 24-hour reception, concierge service, free WIFI, 24-hour business centre, restaurant, bar, fitness centre, wellness, medical assistance, car hire and free on-site parking. Facilities for disabled guests.

87480.description: This hotel is located in the middle of the World Trade Center and the CNR exhibition centre. The centre of Yesilköy is only a 5-minute walk away and offers restaurants, bars and shops. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, cloakroom and 3 lifts, a cafe, a hairdressing salon, a bar, a restaurant, conference facilities and Wi-Fi in all public areas. There are also room and laundry services for an additional fee and there is parking and a garage guests' cars.

87510.description: Novotel Paris Gare de Lyon welcomes you for a family or business stay. Enjoy a break in our pool in the heart of Paris, in a dynamic district near Gare de Lyon, Place de la Bastille and the Marais. Fitness fans can enjoy our gym or jog by the River Seine. Children will enjoy our children's play area, while parents can savor a relaxing moment at the Olicéa bar and restaurant with a Mediterranean vibe.

87524.address: B. N. Agarwal Market, Vile Parle E, 4
87524.description: The Parle International Hotel offers comfortable, budget-friendly accommodations for business travelers in the heart of Mumbai. Our 100 well-equipped rooms and five banquet halls cater to individuals, families, and large groups. Enjoy 24-hour room service, a coffee shop, a bar, and an authentic Gujarati Thali restaurant offering diverse cuisine options. A complimentary breakfast featuring Indian and Continental favorites is included with every stay. We're conveniently located near both domestic and international airports (Terminals 1 & 2), the nearest mainline railway station, and just 20 minutes from the Bandra Kurla Complex and Bombay Exhibition Centre. Experience the vibrant energy of Vile Parle, with its bustling streets, diverse street food, and convenient shopping. We also offer versatile meeting spaces, from boardrooms to a grand ballroom, equipped for all your business needs.

87532.description: In the heart of the capital, discover Novotel Paris Vaugirard Montparnasse. For family holidays, romantic stays or business trips, the hotel offers comfortable rooms. Fast and convenient, for a break, enjoy a simplified restaurant menu! Your Novotel Paris Vaugirard Montparnasse is getting a makeover, and we can't wait to share this wonderful project with you. We promise you reasonable working hours during this renovation period.

87533.description: The Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel is nestled in the heart of chic Paris. Between the Eiffel Tower and the Champs-Elysées, only a few meters away from Trocadero place for breathtaking Eiffel Tower views. The neighborhood overflows with unique shopping, food and cultural experiences. Facilities and services include a restaurant, bar, 24/7 reception & room service, fitness lounge, parking (extra charge), wireless internet access, business center and meeting rooms. Our 103 rooms including 28 Suites bring you to discover a unique emotional experience. Wake up every morning with our delicious breakfast served in your room or in our new restaurant. Lordy’s Paris Club restaurant and bar invite you to discover a subtle blend of genuine French cuisine and casual chic English elegance. Our ambassadors create personalized experiences with a constant desire to meet guest’s expectations.

87576.description: Nestled in the vibrant heart of Secaucus, New Jersey, Harmony Suites welcomes you to a world of refined indulgence. Immerse yourself in the pinnacle of comfort, just moments away from the iconic American Dream Mall, where shopping fantasies come to life. Feel the exhilaration of being near the legendary MetLife Stadium, home to unforgettable events. Our lavish accommodations and personalized service promise a stay beyond compare. Embrace the perfect blend of convenience and luxury, where every moment is a cherished memory in the making. Your journey to opulence begins at Harmony Suites.

87579.description: Located less than a mile from Newark Liberty International Airport, we're just a 15-minute drive from New York City. The Ironbound District and Downtown Newark are two and half miles away and we're only five minutes from The Mills at Jersey Garden. Our complimentary, on-demand shuttles offer easy access to and from the airport. WiFi and access to our 24-hour fitness center is included in your stay.

87606.description: The hotel is located in the beautiful resort of Kemer, at the foot of the Taurus Mountains, in the district of Antalya. This magnificent resort has a private beach which is around 900 meters away and is easily accessible on foot. There is a free shuttle service for guests who want to visit both the city and the beach. Antalya Airport is 65 km away. ***ALL INCLUSIVE SERVICE IS JUST VALID BETWEEN 10. 00 AM TO 22. 00 PM***

87607.description: This extraordinary hotel has it all: its Chinese style architecture and interior design is simply impressive, on its beautifully landscaped premises it hosts a large pool area with water slides, an amusement park, an amphitheatre and a bowling alley. Various restaurants offer a large variety of delicious food. Last but not least, the hotel is directly situated on a golden sandy beach.

87611.description: The London House Hotel comprises five interconnected Victorian era buildings to form a 103 room hotel. The air-conditioned large lobby has cream walls, which contrast with the black reception desk and vibrant purple lounge chairs. It features charcoal grey chandeliers hanging from high ceilings, while tall mirrors add sunshine and a sense of spaciousness. All the rooms have been furnished with a blend of style and functionality in mind. Simple painted walls mean rooms feel light, while surfaces feature a dark wood veneer, such as bedheads, shelves and wardrobes. Each room has an en suite shower room tucked behind a white wooden door. Comfortable beds are accessorised with Byzantium purple cushions. The Breakfast Room is located on the lower ground floor, accessed just off the lobby. Dark tan chairs sit against square wooden tables. There is a wall of mirror lined with soft crimson chairs. Like the rest of the hotel, it's a sunny space, with five skylights. We offer a Continental breakfast selection between 7am and 11am as well as a range of services and amenities. This hotel offers excellent value for money in one of the world's most vibrant cities.

87658.description: This hotel is located in the Arturo Soria neighbourhood, a 5-minute drive from the IFEMA trade fair centre and is near to the Santiago Bernabeu football stadium (Real Madrid). The hotel offers access to the main tourist attractions. Barajas International Airport is 5 km from the establishment. It has a 24-hour reception and check-out service, hotel safe and lift access. The hotel is cleaned daily and has a restaurant, access for the disabled and fax facilities. Guests can use the parking and Internet access available at the reception. The hotel offers rooms with a double bed and a bathroom with a shower, bathtub and hairdryer. A telephone, TV, ironing set, Internet access, desk, minibar, individually regulated air conditioning and heating and a safe are offered as well. All rooms are specially adapted for disabled guests.

87698.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as concierge services and a television in a common area. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 120 guestrooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include electric kettles and free tea bags/instant coffee, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Kensington Gardens - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Portobello Road Market - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Kensington Palace - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Paddington Central - 1. 4 km / 0. 8 mi- Kensington High Street - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Hyde Park - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Imperial College London - 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Royal Albert Hall - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Science Museum - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- Cromwell Road - 2. 6 km / 1. 6 mi- Westfield London Shopping Centre - 2. 7 km / 1. 6 mi- Natural History Museum - 2. 7 km / 1. 7 mi- Marble Arch - 2. 7 km / 1. 7 mi- Lord's Cricket Ground - 2. 8 km / 1. 8 mi- Victoria and Albert Museum - 2. 9 km / 1. 8 mi. The nearest airports are: London City Airport (LCY) - 20. 1 km / 12. 5 mi Heathrow Airport (LHR) - 24. 5 km / 15. 2 mi Gatwick Airport (LGW) - 92. 3 km / 57. 3 mi Luton Airport (LTN) - 53. 9 km / 33. 5 mi Stansted Airport (STN) - 77. 5 km / 48. 2 mi A stay at Pembridge Palace Hotel places you in the heart of London, within a 15-minute walk of Kensington Gardens and Kensington Palace. This hotel is 1 mi (1. 6 km) from Kensington High Street and 1. 1 mi (1. 8 km) from Hyde Park.

87699.description: In the heart of London, in the multicultural and cosmopolitan district of Notting Hill, the Palace Court Hotel offers convenient budget accommodations just 5 minute walk from Hyde Park and the shops and restaurants of Queensway. We are very close to Bayswater and Queensway tube stations, just a few minutes away from Oxford Street and the West End. The Palace Court Hotel operates without a reception desk, with very quick and straight forward check-in and check-out procedures.

87738.description: This hotel is located in the immediate surroundings of Paris. The centre of Paris is a 30-minute ride away on the public transport network, or a 20-minute drive from the hotel. The airports of Orly and Charles de Gaulle are 8 and 40 km away. With a total of 110 spacious guest rooms, the hotel offers facilities including a 24-hour reception and check-out service, hotel safe and lift access. There is an on-site café, bar and restaurant. Event facilities are available in the form of 5 meeting or banquet rooms. Internet access is also provided. Guests arriving by car can leave their vehicles in the hotel's car park or in the undercover parking garage. The rooms are equipped with hairdryer, telephone, TV, radio, WiFi, coffee making facilities, and ironing set. The l'Opus restaurant is open from Monday to Friday and serves traditional French cuisine.

87739.description: Offering a personalised welcome, warm decor and upscale services, the Hotel Les Tournelles has a uniquely inviting feel, embodying the spirit of a house in the form of a hotel so that you can feel at home while staying in the heart of Paris. Located in a beautiful historic building, this elegant and discreet address boasts 24 comfortable rooms, a chic and cosy library lounge, an honesty bar available at any time of the day, and a breakfast room set in a magnificent cellar of vaulted stone. Whether you are in Paris to relax, see the sights or work, at the Hotel Les Tournelles you will find all the services and amenities you need to ensure a comfortable stay.

87756.description: Centrally located in New York, The Bryant Park Hotel offers a luxurious 4-star experience. Within a 5-minute walk of Broadway and 5th Avenue, and close to Times Square and Grand Central Terminal, the hotel provides convenient access to the city's vibrant attractions. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour fitness center, concierge services, and a ballroom. The 128 guestrooms feature iPod docking stations, 42-inch flat-screen Smart TVs with cable programming, and private bathrooms with designer toiletries. A restaurant and bar/lounge offer dining and drinks. Full breakfasts are available for a fee. Additional amenities include limo/town car service, express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and self-parking (subject to charges).

87757.description: Gild Hall, a Thompson Hotel, is located on historic Gold Street, bringing a new level of luxury to Manhattan's illustrious Financial District. Must be 21 years of age to check-in. Unless notified prior to, or at check-in, a one night penalty will apply to departures that occur earlier than the date specified on the original reservation. The hotel is 100% non-smoking. A $250 cleaning fee will be charged to any guest who violates the smoking policy. (Fee subject to change) Bookings of 7 rooms or more will be considered a group booking and are not applicable to higher rates. A daily destination fee of $35 plus tax (subject to change) is applied to each room of your stay in order to provide the services and amenities, which enhance the guest experience.

87901.description: This city hotel is ideally situated in the centre of Torrejon de Ardoz. Guests will find themselves just steps away from the main bus and train stations. The IFEMA exhibition grounds can be found just a short distance away. The centre of Madrid is a 20 minutes' car journey from the hotel. Barajas International Airport is conveniently situated just 6 km from this property. This wonderful property offers a new hotel concept, featuring a high-quality technological building, with striking style and modern convenience. The guest rooms and suites are sublimely designed, featuring modern amenities. Guests can explore the many dining options that the hotel has to offer. The hotel also feature a hairdressing salon, where visitors can be preened and pampered.

87920.description: Mercure Paris Roissy Charles de Gaulle immerses you in a quintessentially Parisian decor - with nods to Montmartre, the Citroën 2CV, Haussmannian boulevards and works by local artists. Our hotel in Roissy-en-France offers 5 meeting rooms and a large car park. During your downtime, relax on the terrace or play a game of billiards, table tennis, Wii or pinball. Savour products from the local market at breakfast, and taste the selection of wines in Before Paris - our restaurant and in-house brewery.

name.content: Novotel Paris Roissy CDG Convention & Spa

87926.description: Unwind with your family or partner in one of the spacious rooms at the Novotel Paris Roissy CDG Convention hotel! Enjoy the relaxed atmosphere of our bar and discover the platters and tapas made with seasonal produce at our Gourmet Bar restaurant. Enjoy free access to the wellness area, with its hammam-sauna and heated indoor swimming pool, and experience total relaxation. With 17 meeting rooms with natural daylight, our hotel is ideal for your business trips, seminars and conferences

87927.address: Royssypôle Ouest Route De La Commune
87927.description: The Mercure Paris CDG Airport & Convention hotel welcomes you to the heart of the airport. This friendly hotel is ideal for a business or leisure stay. Take advantage of stunning views of the runways from your room or meeting room and equipment to ensure you have a pleasant stay. Free WIFI, swimming pool with terrace, fitness room, games, entertainment, 24-hour dining and lounge bar. The hotel also offers 19, 375 sq. ft. (1800 m2) of conference space.

name.content: Le Louis Hotel Versailles Chateau-MGallery Collect

87957.description: Le Louis invites you to discover its 4-star services in the heart of Versailles near the palace. Treat yourself to a luxurious stay in a renovated historic hotel where different eras meet, combining contemporary elegance with classic refinement. Enjoy the cozy ambiance of L'Alcôve and bar with its majestic chandelier. Light reigns at Le Louis, lending a magical and warm aura to this sumptuous setting.

name.content: The Heritage Hotel, Autograph Collection ex Manzil

87972.address: Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashed Blvd, Downtown
87972.description: The Heritage Hotel, Autograph Collection, offers upscale accommodation in Downtown Dubai, within a 10-minute walk of Dubai Mall and the Dubai Fountain. This hotel features 197 air-conditioned guestrooms, each equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, a safe, and a desk. Bathrooms include a bathtub or shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. Guests can enjoy recreational amenities such as a health club and an outdoor pool, as well as on-site dining options including a restaurant, a coffee shop/café, and 24-hour room service. A daily complimentary reception provides an opportunity to mingle with other guests, and the bar/lounge offers a relaxing setting for evening drinks. Additional amenities include complimentary wired and wireless internet access, concierge services, a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and free valet parking. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. Nearby attractions include the Burj Khalifa (2. 7 km) and the Dubai International Convention and Exhibition Centre (5. 5 km).

87976.address: Guller Pinari Mahallesi Oba Yolu Uzeri, 21
87976.description: Located amidst history and nature, this apartment hotel is set in the paradise city Alanya, 800 m from the city centre. It is just 300 m to the private beach and 125 km to Antalya Airport. This air-conditioned family-friendly hotel complex welcomes guests into a reception hall with 24-hour check-in and check-out service. There are 54 apartments for 3-4 people and 12 rooms for 2 people, for a total of 66 rooms (202 person capacity). Facilities include currency exchange, hotel safe, wardrobe, restaurant, bar, satellite TV, Internet access (fees apply), a shop and 2 lifts. Room and laundry services (fees apply) are also available. The pleasant, comfortably furnished apartments and en suite rooms are equipped with individually adjustable air conditioning, double bed, satellite/cable TV, telephone, Internet access, minibar, refrigerator, kitchen with oven (apartments only), hot water 24-hours a day, hairdryer, safe and more. All rooms have a balcony facing the pool with a nature view. There is a swimming pool with a children's section, pool-side bar, lounge chairs and sunshades. The hotel also offers massage service (fees apply). A continental breakfast buffet is served daily. Additionally, breakfast, lunch and dinner may be ordered à la carte or as a set menu featuring national and international cusine.

87977.description: Only 656 feet from the Mediterranean Sea, this hotel has a private area at the beach. The hotel offers a large outdoor pool surrounded by palm trees, an indoor pool and air-conditioned rooms. Decorated in warm colors, the rooms of Novum Garden Side Hotel feature a peaceful setting. They all include a private balcony. The main restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner as an open buffet. The à la carte restaurant offers international dishes. You can enjoy a romantic dinner at the poolside. The beach bar offers snacks and refreshing drinks during the day. The hotel has an on-site Turkish bath. You can also benefit from the fitness center, or enjoy beach volleyball. Massages can be arranged and you are welcome to use the hot tub, table tennis and babysitting services. Side town center is a 20-minute drive from Novum Garden with Side Antique Theater and Apollo Temple. Antalya Airport is 34 mi away.

87997.description: Nestled in the Athenian suburb of Mati, our charming villa-style hotel offers a welcoming, home-away-from-home experience year-round. Relax by the pool or fireplace while enjoying refreshing drinks and home-cooked meals. Conveniently located near the Athens airport (a mere 20-minute drive), our tranquil, blossoming garden setting ensures a peaceful retreat. A bus stop at our doorstep provides easy access to Athens. Enjoy complimentary amenities, including Wi-Fi, computer usage, and boarding pass printing. We also offer an exclusive partnership with a luxury taxi service, providing convenient and affordable airport transfers.

88057.description: This establishment is situated at the heart of the famous, exclusive neighbourhood of Recoleta, in Buenos Aires. A number of bars, restaurants and nightlife options can be found nearby. The property is located just a few steps away from Avenida Alvear. The famous Recoleta Cemetery can be found close by. Guests will find themselves within easy access of Plaza Francia, the Museo Nacional de Belles Artes and the Plate River. This charming hotel tempts visitors with the promise of luxury and convenience. The suites beautifully combine elegance, style and cutting-edge technology. The property offers visitors a wide range of first-class facilities and services, delivering a high level of excellence that is sure to impress.

88078.description: Stay in the heart of the Boulogne and Issy-les-Moulineaux districts at the Mercure Paris Boulogne hotel. Bring your family to this hotel, located close to Roland Garros and the Parc des Princes and Jean Bouin stadiums. It can be easily accessed via public transport, and also offers quick and direct access to the main Parisian attractions, such as the Eiffel Tower and Champs-Elysées. The hotel has a restaurant-lounge bar, fitness center, Easywork space, private car park and pool (open May-September)

88079.description: Sought after by business guests for its 500 m² of meeting rooms and a location in the heart of the business district, Novotel Paris La Defense Esplanade is also ideal for families. We offer 4-person rooms, several play areas and a restaurant with child-friendly options. Our hotel in La Défense also invites you to take time out for yourself - on the patio, in the bar with views of the Seine or in the wellness space featuring a gym, yoga classes and massages upon request.

name.content: Hotel Boulevard, Autograph Collection ex Vida

88082.address: Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Blvd, Downtown
88082.description: Centrally located in Dubai, Hotel Boulevard, Autograph Collection, is a 9-minute walk from the Dubai Fountain and 13 minutes from the Dubai Mall. This upscale hotel is also conveniently close to Burj Khalifa (3. 3 km) and the Dubai International Convention and Exhibition Centre (6. 1 km). Guests can enjoy recreational opportunities, including an outdoor pool and bicycle rentals. The hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and bike storage. The 156 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, LED televisions, down comforters, premium bedding, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include separate bathtubs and showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Dining options include a restaurant and 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities comprise a business center, limo/town car service, dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour airport shuttle (surcharge), and free valet parking.

88097.description: This hotel is situated on Omonia Square in the very centre of Athens. Omonia metro station is only a stone's throw away, providing easy access to all parts of the city, and many famous sights are within walking distance, including the Parthenon, the National Gardens and the Museum of Greek Folk Art. The central train station is a 15-minute stroll from the hotel, while the airport is 30 km away. The hotel offers 24-hour reception, and a meeting room for added convenience, and guests might make use of free WIFI and dine in the restaurant and bar, all during a productive business trip or exciting sightseeing holiday. **use of Air condition is extra 5€ per night **

88098.description: The hotel is situated in the town centre in a quiet business and residential area close to tourist attractions. The National Gallery, a concert hall, museums, embassies and various nightspots are all near the hotel, and it is 8 km from the airport and 10 km from Piraeus port. This hotel is located in a quiet central area overlooking a park and offers its guests free parking. It comprises a total of 90 rooms and the hotel's public areas and guestrooms were renovated in 2004. Facilities on offer to guests include a 24-hour reception and 24-hour check-in/out service, a bar and a restaurant. All the rooms are individually air-conditioned and feature a hairdryer, TV, a radio alarm clock, a fridge, a safe, a telephone and double-glazed windows. Furthermore, the rooms offer either a balcony or a terrace. The hotel offers its guests a complimentary full buffet breakfast.

88163.description: Welcome to the PLAZA Premium Vienna, where a 4-star experience awaits you just 3. 5 km from Vienna Central Station. Explore Austria's capital and its iconic landmarks, including the Vienna Opera, Schönbrunn Palace, Hofburg Palace, St. Stephen's Square, the Prater, and the Natural History and Art History Museums. Unwind with a glass of wine at our hotel after a day of sightseeing. We offer a fitness room, a relaxing garden terrace, and a ground-floor bar. Our air-conditioned rooms feature comfortable beds, private bathrooms with bathtubs, and flat-screen satellite TVs. Choose from various room categories, each with a cozy seating area, desk, and safe. Enjoy scenic views of the city or surrounding countryside. A mini-fridge, iron, and ironing board are also provided. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Start your day with our rich breakfast buffet, featuring continental and regional specialties. A vending machine offers snacks and drinks throughout the day. In the evening, our bar provides a tranquil setting to end your day.

88233.description: Founded in 1951, this charming, family friendly city guest house offers privacy and excellent views of the Avenida dos Aliados. The property has 35 rooms, including 5 suites, all with the necessary amenities for an enjoyable stay. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area, a 24-hour check-in/check out service, a lift, a laundry service (charges apply) and a garage for those arriving by car (for an additional fee).

88234.description: This hotel is located in Vilanova Gaia, on the left side of the Douro River, near the wine cellars and close to the historical centre of Porto. It is a 5-minute metro ride to the centre of Oporto. Restaurants, bars, exciting nightlife, the bus and train stations, as well as shopping venues are in the immediate vicinity. Porto Wine Cellars, Estádio do Dragão, Music House and Serralves Museum can all be found nearby

88316.description: The hotel is located close to a wide range of entertainment and shopping opportunities, a few minutes from Galata Tower, Taksim Square, and the historical district. Restaurants, bars, and nightlife opportunities can all be found nearby. This hotel offers a lobby with 24-hour reception, a currency exchange facility, lift, and a cloakroom. Shared facilities include a café, the bar, a number of restaurants, the Frontera meeting rooms, a business centre, WLAN internet access and room and laundry services (subject to fees). Parking facilities are available to guests arriving by car.

88357.description: The NH Collection Bogotá WTC Royal hotel is in a perfect location in the Chicó business district. The hotel boasts excellent links to anywhere in the city and even a helicopter transfer option to and from the airport. There are 144 spacious rooms at NH Collection Bogotá WTC Royal. For relaxation, each one comes with a pillow menu, luxurious mattresses, and soundproof windows. Meanwhile, modern touches include an iPod dock, rain-effect showers, professional hair-dryers, Nespresso machines, and Wi-Fi. Our suites feature private terraces. Our breakfast will set you up for the day with its wide selection of hot and cold options, including made-to-order dishes, fresh local favorites, and authentic Colombian coffee. For lunch, we will take you around the world with our daily themed buffet, while an à-la-carte Mediterranean and Colombian menu is available for dinner. You can also get energized with a coffee at the Starbucks cafe located inside the hotel or unwind with a drink at the Sport Bar that also serves sushi and a full restaurant menu. Guests will love the views from our rooftop terrace and also have access to a gym, spa, and sauna. Additionally, there are 10 meeting rooms on-site.

88359.description: Located in the Teleport Business Park, just a 30-minute drive from El Dorado International Airport and within minutes of Hacienda Santa Bárbara shopping centre, this luxurious hotel has been designed to offer unmatched comfort and tranquillity. Ideal for a weekend getaway or an extended holiday, guests will find themselves close to a host of local tourist attractions, such as Primada de Colombia Cathedral and National Museum of Colombia. This eco-friendly establishment surpass all the expectations with a host of exceptionally appointed rooms overlooking the city. The modern marble bathrooms include a wide choice of luxurious amenities and all the accommodation units feature conveniences such as complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection. Business travellers will appreciate the state-of-the-art meeting spaces with all the necessary equipment to guarantee a successful event.

88361.description: The NH Collection Bogotá Hacienda Royal is in the heart of Usaquén, one of the most prestigious neighborhoods in Bogotá. Beautiful Spanish colonial-style architecture is nearby, while the hotel offers panoramic views of the mountains that surround the city. The hotel has 82 beautifully designed rooms with traditional décor and carpeted floors to give each a warm, comfortable feel. All rooms look out across the park and the mountains, while free WI-FI and 24-hour room service come as standard. Enjoy a delicious buffet breakfast in Dominique's Restaurant. Work out in our brand-new gym, or treat yourself to a massage or beauty treatment at the spa. Take dinner in the restaurant, and end the day with a cocktail in the piano bar. *Foreign customers without tourist stamp in the passport must pay 16% VAT directly at the hotel.

name.content: Avani Royal Zona T Bogotá Hotel

88362.description: The Avani Royal Zona T Bogotá Hotel is set in the exclusive Zona T neighborhood, famous for its shopping, dining, and nightlife. Just nearby, you’ll find the Andino, Retiro, and Atlantis Plaza shopping malls featuring top Colombian and international brands. The financial district is also close by, which makes the hotel a perfect choice for business travelers. For easy access to the airport, the hotel provides a shuttle which can be organized upon request. Avani Royal Zona T Bogotá Hotel has 66 stylish rooms with hardwood floors and sitting areas. It’s easy to stay connected as free Wi-Fi is available in each room and throughout the hotel. Enjoy a fresh breakfast each morning with a variety of sweet and savory options, accompanied by fragrant Colombian coffee and freshly squeezed juices.

88363.description: Surrounded by the city's most exclusive restaurants, bars, and business centres, this hotel is located in the most exclusive area in Bogotá, 3 km from the historical centre. It is ideal for business and leisure travellers alike. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception and currency exchange. There is a games room, a café and a restaurant. Business travellers will appreciate the conference facilities and Wi-Fi and guests can use the room and laundry services. There is a car park available for those arriving by car.

88364.description: This urban hotel is located in one of the most prestigious areas in the city, surrounded by boutiques, bars, restaurants and exclusive shopping centres. It is only 30 minutes from the Museum of Gold and from International Airport El Dorado. The hotel has 70 rooms in total and offers a high-standard service, ensuring that the needs of even the most discerning guest are met, to guarantee an unforgettable experience. The modern, fully-equipped rooms offer high-speed Internet access for those who wish to stay connected and come with one queen-size bed or twin beds, a desk and an en-suite bathroom with a bathtub.

name.content: Four Seasons Hotel Casa Medina Bogota

88365.description: The Four Seasons Hotel Casa Medina, a designated monument of cultural interest, graces Bogotá's historic heart, amidst the vibrant financial and commercial district. A mere 40-minute drive from the airport, this iconic hotel is surrounded by renowned restaurants and shopping centers, and enjoys close proximity to the National University of Colombia and the High Technology Center. Each of the uniquely appointed rooms and suites boasts colonial-style beamed ceilings and handcrafted doors, offering a tranquil retreat within Colombia's bustling financial core.

88367.description: Discover the city that The Sunday Times Magazine called the capital of cool Colombias dynamic capital Bogota is the heart of one of South Americas fastest-growing economies and is one of its largest cities with a population of eight million. Set 8 600 feet above sea level on a plateau in the Andes Mountains it ranks after Quito and La Paz among the highest capitals on the continent. Despite its closeness to the equator this altitude gives it a pleasantly mild climate year-round. Amidst the vibe of the Zona T where the citys high society comes to see and be seen feel the energy confidence and fun of this intimate gem Four Seasons Hotel Bogota. Discover one of the most intimate Bogota hotels located in a prime setting with many upscale activities in the area. Four Seasons Bogota adds to the vibrant Bogota restaurant scene with chic authentic Japanese cuisine that pairs a live action charcoal Robata grill and sushi counter with unique sakes and Japanese beers.

88376.address: Esentepe Mah.Sakip Sabanci Cad. Goynuk, No:7
88376.description: The hotel is located directly on the seaside beach, in the middle of the quiet pine forest in Göynük Kemer. It is 9 kms from the city of Kemer and 45 kms from Antalya International Airport. Guests can enjoy a holiday in the most inspiring seaside destinations in Antalya and an unparalleled experience in the Mediterranean. The resort offers superb dining and 542 fully furnished and elegantly designed comfortable rooms for its guests' happiness and privacy. The mini club for children has a professionally supervised programme featuring numerous entertaining activities designed to take advantage of the natural environment. Children can also play in the playground. Entertainment for adults is provided in the games room, TV lounge and disco. Food and drinks are served in the bar and restaurant. Business guests are sure to appreciate the conference facilities.

88377.description: This pleasant city and beach hotel faces Alanya's famous Cleopatra's Beach and is approximately 2 km from the centre of the resort. Café bars and restaurants can be found closeby, while the main bus station is just a 5-minute walk away. Guests can relax by the hotel's pool or alternatively, the hotel has a private section of the lovely beach where a beach bar service is available (seasonal).

88378.description: This family-friendly aparthotel is located just five minutes from a major city park, ideal for leisurely walks, jogging, cycling, or a fun day at the playground. The hotel is conveniently situated around 35 km from both the coast and Francisco Sá Carneiro-Porto Airport. Guests can also explore the Gourmet Route of Lousada and sample local cheeses and Vinho Verde wines. Business travelers will appreciate the hotel's 76 spacious and comfortable rooms, perfect for extended stays. A comprehensive range of services includes laundry facilities, an on-site supermarket, a bar and restaurant with room service (fees apply), and a library. Two flexible meeting rooms can be used separately or combined. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, ensuring guests stay connected. Additional amenities include a 24-hour reception, safe, lift, TV lounge, car park, and a covered parking garage. The modern and elegant rooms are offered in T0 and T1 categories. Each features a kitchenette with a fridge, satellite TV, individually controlled air conditioning, a safe, a shower, and a telephone. A double bed and a private balcony or terrace come standard, along with free internet access. Guests can maintain their fitness routines at the on-site gym. A breakfast buffet is served daily, while lunch and dinner are available à la carte.

88435.description: Nestled in a tranquil, green oasis in the heart of Paris, Citadines Austerlitz Paris offers the best of both worlds: a quiet residential setting just minutes from the city's cultural attractions. This 3-star aparthotel, located in a vibrant, traditional district between Place d'Italie and the Seine, is also conveniently close to the Austerlitz train station and the Jardin des Plantes. The residence is well-connected to the metro, with lines 5 (Campo Formio) and 6 (Nationale) within walking distance, providing direct access to Paris's tourist attractions and major train stations. Each of the 50 apartments, spread across 6 floors, features a fully equipped kitchen (microwave, fridge, hob), a bathroom (bathtub, hairdryer), a living area with satellite TV, free internet access, telephone, safe, and iron with ironing board. Linen and towels are provided and changed weekly for stays of 6 nights or longer. Citadines Austerlitz Paris also offers a business center with free Wi-Fi, laundry facilities, and on-site parking. The surrounding area boasts a diverse selection of cafes, pubs, and restaurants, and our receptionists are happy to provide recommendations. As part of our Ascott Cares program, we are committed to maintaining high hygiene and cleanliness standards, as well as safe distancing practices, to ensure a safe and comfortable environment for both our guests and staff.

88437.address: Paris La Défense,Les Saisons,boulevard de Neuilly, 1-8
88437.description: Citadines La Défense Paris is located in the heart of Europe's largest business district, near the Esplanade de la Défense, a vibrant hub with a shopping mall, shops, restaurants, and cinemas. The Esplanade de la Défense Metro Station is just 400 meters away, providing easy access to all of Paris, including the Champs-Élysées and Palais des Congrès Porte Maillot (both a mere 10-minute metro ride). The property is also adjacent to the Seine River and near the Pont de Neuilly bridge. Charles de Gaulle and Orly Airports are 30 and 28 kilometers away, respectively. The hotel offers a 24-hour business center, breakfast room, and reception. Guests can also enjoy laundry, dry cleaning, pressing services, on-site parking, complimentary Wi-Fi, and smoke-free facilities. Weekly housekeeping is included, with daily service available for a fee. The 130 studios and 104 one-bedroom apartments combine hotel convenience with the privacy and amenities of a private residence. Designed to maximize natural light, each contemporary accommodation features a spacious kitchen fully equipped with modern appliances, cookware, dishes, flatware, and a dishwasher.

88438.description: Located a short 20-minute drive south of Paris and Orly Airport, this aparthotel offers the perfect base to explore the city. Situated in a vibrant district near the Porte de Versailles Exhibition Park, you'll find numerous shops, bustling markets, and tranquil gardens right at your doorstep. Enjoy weekend treasures at the Vanves flea market or stroll through the picturesque Montsouris and George Brassens Parks. In the evening, the nearby Montparnasse district beckons with its lively theaters, cinemas, and restaurants. The aparthotel features 80 well-appointed studios and one-bedroom apartments, along with a meeting room boasting a lovely garden view. Ascott Cares ensures your well-being with enhanced hygiene and cleanliness standards.

88439.description:
Nestled between Place de la Republique and Père-Lachaise Cemetery, the Citadines Republique Paris recently renovated aparthotel offers a gateway to the trendy Right Bank. Explore the vibrant Belleville and Ménilmontant districts just steps away, or venture south to Boulevard Richard-Lenoir and Place de la Bastille. The surrounding République and Oberkampf districts boast bustling markets and lively streets. Discover the exotic charm of Belleville and the picturesque Ménilmontant. Stroll along the Saint-Martin Canal towards Boulevard Richard-Lenoir and Bastille, and lose yourself in the charming Marais district. Whether you are one or two guests in a studio, or three or four in a two-room serviced apartment, Citadines Republique Paris provides a comfortable home-like experience. Enjoy fully equipped kitchens, complimentary internet access, and weekly housekeeping. Daily housekeeping and other services, including laundry, dry cleaning, and parking, are available upon request. 

Kindly note that the city tax will be now at 8. 45€ / per person/ Per night

88456.description: Good to greet you! Located near Brussels Airport, the greet hotel features 68 eco conscious rooms alongside a lively social hub and bar. Our innovative hotel embraces sustainability and local culture, offering a unique experience by reimagining spaces and objects. Perfect for both business and leisure travelers, it combines comfort with environmental commitment for a memorable and impactful stay. Welcome to a place where each visit supports a brighter, greener future.

88537.description: Ramada Jersey City Hotel is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Jersey City (NJ). Offering a variety of facilities and services, the hotel provides all you need for a good night's sleep. Take advantage of the hotel's free Wi-Fi in all rooms, facilities for disabled guests, Wi-Fi in public areas, laundry service, elevator. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like television LCD/plasma screen, carpeting, internet access – wireless (complimentary), air conditioning, heating. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include fitness center. For reliable service and professional staff, Ramada Jersey City Hotel caters to your needs.

name.content: Hyatt Regency Jersey City on the Hudson

88539.description: This elegant waterfront hotel is ideally located in Jersey City, being the perfect hotel for elegant accommodations and easy access to New York City. This charming, urban hotel is a quick ferry or PATH train ride to Lower Manhattan's financial district and mid-town shops, theatre and museums. The luxuriously appointed guest rooms will make guests feel completely at ease in a delicate and contemporary ambience. They are tastefully decorated and count with exclusive amenities such as feather pillows or a granite private bathroom. Guests can host a meeting or celebration in the hotel's versatile spaces, with stunning skyline views and a full-service business centre. They may also savour contemporary American cuisine as they gaze out at the Hudson River and Statue of Liberty from this luxurious hotel in Jersey City, New Jersey.

88560.address: Kızlarpınarı mh Mehmet Akif Ersoy cad no:26, 26
88560.description: This city hotel has had a modern refurbishment in the winter of 2012-13 and consists of 82 pleasantly decorated rooms in total. Located a very short distance from Alanya's famous Cleopatra's Beach, the hotel is also within easy access to the resort centre and pretty harbour area. Facilities include an indoor and outdoor pool, a couple of restaurants, a bar and a Turkish bath. .

88563.description: Kamelya K Club, A corner of heaven. . . When you're ready for a holiday with all the comforts of home, Kamelya Collections offers an impeccable experience that combines hospitality with extraordinary services. Live the happiness and delight in the value of time spent with your family at K Club! Let go of stress and fatigue in tranquil gardens that are the keys to serenity, and can enter a world of limitless entertainment, delicious tastes, and leisurely walks amid a lush environment. Or, you can go out and explore incredible activities with your kids. Our master chefs await you at our restaurants with unique dishes from world cuisines. The varied flavours of the Kamelya Collection will make every moment unforgettable. Our à la carte restaurants, snack bars, cafés and bars are with you throughout your whole stay.

88621.description: This hotel is strategically located at the heart of the financial district of Suipacha. The hotel is located just a few metres away from Avenue Santa Fe, in Buenos Aires. Guests will find themselves within easy walking distance of the commercial and government area of the city, Plaza San Martin and the Galerias Pacifico. Guests will find themselves surrounded by exclusive shops of Florida Street, museums, theatres, art galleries and the superb area of Puerto Madero. Ezeiza International Airport is just a 40 minutes' drive away. This hotel enjoys a 21st-century design, combining modern advances with striking, contemporary style. The guest rooms are superbly designed, offering functional space, style and comfort. The hotel features an extensive range of first-class facilities and services, delivering a high level of excellence that is sure to impress.

88623.description: The Lafayette Hotel is located in the heart of Buenos Aires, close to Puerto Madero and Calle Corrientes. It has a restaurant, bar, business center and meeting rooms. All rooms are equipped with bathroom, minibar, LCD TV, desk and air conditioning. It also offers free wi-fi, and emergency medical service 24h.

88656.description: Located in Istanbul's city center, the Eyfel Hotel is a short walk from the Grand Bazaar and Süleymaniye Mosque. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, daily breakfast buffet, and convenient amenities such as concierge services and dry cleaning. Relax in the bar/lounge or coffee shop, and attend the daily complimentary reception. The 85 air-conditioned rooms feature heated floors, flat-screen TVs, and laptop-compatible safes. The Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia are a short drive away.

88681.description: This hotel, formerly the Athenian Inn of Kolonaki, is now ideally situated in Athens' historical center, near Monastiraki, the Acropolis, and Keramikos. Omonia station is a short walk away, providing easy access to the city. After 30 years of successful operation, the hotel continues to offer a pleasant and relaxing stay. All soundproofed rooms feature private bathrooms and modern furnishings for absolute comfort and style. Seventh-floor rooms boast large private balconies with Acropolis and Lycabettus views (subject to availability). In-room amenities include direct-dial telephones and TVs. Non-smoking rooms are available upon request.

88801.description:
Situated in Amsterdam's residential Berlage Quarter near the Amstel River, Hotel Flipper Amsterdam offers budget rooms and a garden. The Amsterdam RAI Congress Centre is 1 km away. The hotel rooms have either shared facilities or a private bathroom. Each room has a LED TV and free Wi-Fi access. For relaxation guests can visit the lobby lounge with a fireplace. Guests can use the public computer, which has free internet access. It is possible to rent bicycles. The Amstelkade tram stop is 400 m away and offers direct connection to Dam Square and Amsterdam Central Station in 20 minutes. Flipper Hotel is a 900 m from Amsterdam Amstel Station. 
Please note that the reception will be closed after 00:00 hrs during October.

88806.description: If you want to explore Berlin, Pullman Berlin Schweizerhof is the ideal exit point. Many Berlin highlights are just a short walk or drive away. Redesigned in Bauhaus style, the hotel combines avant-garde interiors with simple functionality, with 377 rooms and suites, 18 conference rooms, the 'BLEND - berlin kitchen & bar' restaurant and modernized 'Fit and Spa Lounge'.

88808.description: The hotel is a short walk from Times Square, very close to 6th Avenue's business and media corridor. Located on a quiet stretch of West 44th Street, between 6th and 7th Avenues, this property is close to Radio City Music Hall and the Rockefeller centre. It is surrounded by Broadway houses and Central Park is just a 15-minute walk away. The hotel has 100 apartments and 30 studios. It is fully air-conditioned and offers a 24-hour check-out, lift access, Internet access, and a laundry service. Each unit offers a TV in the living room and bedroom, a washing machine, and dryer, wooden flooring. A hairdryer, a telephone, a radio, a hi-fi system, a fridge, an oven, a microwave, tea-making facilities, an ironing set, and a king-size bed all come as standard. Central heating is provided and the air conditioning is individually adjustable. There is an on-site gym. Housekeeping service is included once per week.

88809.description: Near to Central Park, Bergdorf Goodman and the famed Plaza Hotel, this hotel lies in the centre of everything. Grand Central station is a 15-minute walk from the hotel. The hotel has a total of 134 rooms and it offers 24-hour check-out service, lift access, laundry service and Internet access. Studio Suites have Kitchenettes , One Bedrooms have kitchens with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. The bathrooms have stone flooring, shower or shower/tub combination dependent upon suite, bath amenities and hairdryer. Other facilities include a phone, TV, Internet access, tea making facilities, washing machine and ironing set. Rooms have seasonal heat and air conditioning. The hotel has a 24-hour gym. The hotel has a European-style cafe and espresso bar, open for breakfast and lunch. The lounge is warmly lit with two fireplaces, open in the evenings. Located on W 58th Street between 6th Ave (Avenue of the Americas) and 5th Ave.

88811.description: Just 2 blocks from the famous Copacabana Beach, this hotel boasts a rooftop pool with bar service. Air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi, a gym and a restaurant are also available. Bright and spacious, the 4-star rooms at Copacabana Mar Hotel are decorated in neutral colors and feature local artwork on the walls. They offer cable TV, telephone and minibar. The Tropical Restaurant is open for lunch and dinner, featuring regional and international cuisine. Here a varied buffet breakfast is served, with fresh fruits, cake and pastries. Exotic drinks can be ordered from the bar. Copacabana Mar Hotel is only 51 m from Cardeal Arcoverde subway station, giving easy access to other parts of Rio. Ipanema Beach is a 5-minute subway ride away. Private parking is supplied nearby. Copacabana is a great choice for travelers interested in beach walks, sightseeing and sandy beaches.

88812.description: Anhembi stands as Brazil’s largest convention hotel, renowned for hosting grand events. Nestled in the vibrant North Zone, our hotel is conveniently located near the Anhembi Events Center, Anhembi Sambadrome, and Campo de Marte Airport. Iconic attractions like downtown São Paulo, Allianz Parque Stadium, and Center Norte Mall are just a short distance away.
