After a day of exploring, unwind in our spacious accommodations, ranging from 26 to 46 sqm, and enjoy premium amenities including an indoor pool, fully equipped Fitness Center, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Our expansive convention center offers 2, 500 sqm of event space across three floors, making it the ideal venue for corporate and social gatherings. Indulge in delightful meals at Camauê Restaurant, where breakfast, lunch, and dinner showcase both local and international flavors. For drinks and snacks, head to Bar Du Hotel, the perfect spot to relax and socialize. Our pet-friendly policy ensures your furry companion feels just as welcome. We combine grandiosity, comfort, and exceptional service, making us your perfect home away from home in São Paulo.

88819.description: With a stay at Sheraton Bogota Hotel in Bogotá (Fontibon), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Salitre Plaza Shopping Mall and Gran Estacion Shopping Mall. This luxury hotel is 2. 5 mi (4 km) from U. S. Embassy Bogotá and 6. 9 mi (11. 1 km) from 93 Park. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Make yourself at home in one of the 247 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and minibars. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, and LCD televisions with cable programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Enjoy international cuisine at Cooks Restaurant, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services.

88857.description: Ideally located in the downtown area, the hotel is just 2 minutes from the principal avenue Mohamed V and just 10 minutes from the legendary Djemaa el Fna. This charming new hotel opened in 2005 and has 50 rooms distributed across 5 floors. It is air-conditioned and has a lobby, 24-hour reception and check-out service, hotel safe, cloakroom and currency exchange facilities. Additional amenities include a café, bar, TV room and a restaurant. Business guests can take advantage of the hotel's conference facilities and Internet access is also available. Room and laundry services are provided and parking facilities are available for guests arriving by car. All the modern and comfortable rooms come with a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, radio and an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer. Further in-room facilities include a lounge, an in-room safe (subject to fees) and minibar. Individually adjustable air conditioning and heating units also feature, and a balcony or terrace comes as standard. Breakfast is served as a continental-style buffet, while lunch and dinner are available either as a buffet, à la carte or from a set menu.

88916.description:
The hostel is located right in the middle of the popular district Mitte-Prenzlauer Berg. Alexanderplatz and Hackescher Markt are in the vicinity. The Museum Island, the Brandenburg Gate and Potsdamer Platz are all easily accessible via public transport. Berlin Tegel Airport is approximately 11 km away, while Schönefeld Airport is about 26 km away.

This city hostel, which was renovated in 2008, has a total of 90 rooms spread across 7 floors. It offers all modern conveniences including a lobby, a 24-hour reception desk, a safe, lift access, conference facilities, a breakfast room, a TV room and a games room. The bar and the café on the ground floor are the special highlights of the hotel. Internet and WLAN access allow guests to surf, chat and check their mails (for a small fee). Guests may take advantage of the cycle hire service.

All rooms are equipped with a bathroom with shower, WLAN access and a TV. The 52 single and twin rooms also have a telephone and central heating.

Pool/snooker, table football, video games, karaoke and much more are provided.

From the Hauptbahnhof (main train station) take any of the S-bahn lines toward Ostkreuz (S5, S9, S75) to Alexanderplatz (6-minute journey). From Alexanderplatz, take the U-bahn line U2 toward Pankow to Senefelderplatz (4-minute journey). The hostel is located directly next to the U-bahn station. From the airports: from Tegel Airport (TXL), take bus X9 or 109 toward Zoologischer Garten. Take the U-bahn line U2 toward Pankow to the stop Senefelderplatz (24-minute journey). From Schönefeld Airport (SXF), take the S-bahn line S9 (toward Spandau) and get off at Alexanderplatz. Take the U-bahn line U2 towards Pankow to the stop Senefelderplatz (34-minute journey).

88919.description: Enjoying an ideal location close to the town centre of London, this hotel is perfect for business and leisure travellers visiting London. The property is conveniently situated just a 15 minutes' drive from London Luton Airport. This modern property is surrounded by a number of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. Stylish, comfortable guest rooms offer a peaceful setting in which to work and rest. The restaurant offers a wonderful dining experience, with a choice of traditional and international dishes. Business travellers will appreciate the hotel's conference spaces, as well as the helpful, professional event staff.

88921.description: This luxurious hotel with its distinctive architectural design is located in the centre of the business district of Doha. Doha International Airport, Qatar International Exhibition Center and Aladdin's Kingdom are all within a 20 minute drive. Features of the hotel include 24-hour reception, currency exchange, free WIFI in public areas, meeting rooms, business centre, restaurant, coffee shop, fitness centre, outdoor pool, laundry service and free on-site parking (reservation needed). Facilities for disabled guests.

88934.description: Located in the heart of Bur Dubai\'s market area of Meena Bazaar on Al Fahidi Street, this property is just 15 minutes drive from the Dubai International Airport and is close to many shopping complexes as well as the Gold Souq. Grand Nova Hotel offers a warm welcome and excellent friendly service with the highest standards of accommodation to make your stay a memorable one. The lobby area is warm and welcoming in its style and is an ideal place to relax after a tiring day or to chat with friends. The hotel boasts 84 beautifully decorated guest rooms and spacious suites that have been elegantly furnished with an array of contemporary amenities to satisfy the needs of discerning travelers. Guests can dine in any of the on-site restaurants that serves a variety of delicious International cuisine for them to feast on.

89023.address: Belassis Road, Opp City Centre Mall, 292
89023.description: The hotel is located in the heart of Bombay's commercial district, within easy reach of major Government and corporate offices, bus and rail terminals, banks, shopping centres and malls. It is a stone's throw away from Bombay Central Station and approximately 20 km from Santacruz Domestic Airport and 24 km from Sahara International Airport. This hotel offers 88 rooms. Facilities on offer to guests include a 24-hour reception, a safe, a currency exchange facility, lift access, a cafe, a restaurant and Internet access. The hotel has 3 conference halls. Guests may use the room and laundry services and car park. The rooms are equipped with TVs, bathrooms, WiFi Internet access. They also offer a minibar, tea making facilities and air conditioning.

89094.description: This family-friendly apartment hotel is situated at the entrance to the town on Avenue Abdelkrim Khattabi. Guests staying at the hotel have easy access to most of the prominent parts of the city, with links to the public transport network right on the hotel's doorstep. The city centre, where guests can visit numerous places of interest, such as the Saadian Tombs and Bahia Palace, is 3 kms from the accommodation. The forest area is 20 kms from the hotel. The lake is 30 kms away, and it is 160 kms to the coast. This apartment hotel welcomes guests to spend an unforgettable holiday by offering the optimum facilities of its category. The 58-room budget hotel is fully air-conditioned. All the rooms are of medium size and are arranged in such a manner that they seem very spacious. Each room features an en suite-bathroom, a kitchenette and a private terrace.

89097.description: This city hotel enjoys a prime setting at the heart of Milan. The hotel is situated in Largo Carrobbio, just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Piazza Duomo. Guests will find themselves surrounded by the city's renowned museums and monuments. The famous shopping streets can also be found nearby. The central station is 15 km away. Malpensa International Airport is 40 km from the hotel. This wonderful hotel is sure to appeal to discerning business and leisure travellers. The property, which is hailed as the first ecological hotel in Milan, has been designed to respect its surroundings, yet to deliver a high level of excellence. The guest rooms offer a high level of comfort and convenience. The hotel's wide range of facilities and services are sure to impress.

89122.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Paris and was established in 1889. It is a short drive away from the Bastille and the nearest station is Daumesnil. All 36 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning.

89180.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, an outdoor tennis court, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for dinner at the hotel's restaurant, Sauvage, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 79 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and minibars (stocked with some free items). Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. The nearest major airport is Cape Town Intl. Airport (CPT) - 77. 9 km / 48.

89185.address: Beach Road, Sea Point, Po Box 768, 313
89185.description: The Peninsula All-Suite Hotel, with its subtle elegance, epitomizes Cape hospitality. Ideally situated on Cape Town's Platinum Mile, with majestic Signal Hill as its backdrop, this internationally acclaimed hotel offers 110 refined apartments, including one, two, and three-bedroom suites. Guests enjoy excellent facilities, including restaurants specializing in diverse cuisines, from local Malay curries to Mediterranean treats, and the Faces Cocktail bar. The hotel's location provides easy access to Cape Town's must-see attractions, making it an ideal base for exploring the Mother City and the Western Cape, including the winelands. Each beautifully decorated apartment features marvelous views. Overlooking the bay, the hotel is a short walk from the beach and a 10-minute drive from Camps Bay. Amenities include free Wi-Fi, two pools, a garden, and a bar. Each air-conditioned suite boasts a balcony with sea views, modern decor, an open-plan seating area with a flat-screen TV, a kitchenette, and a private bathroom. Guests can dine at the alfresco Sunset Restaurant, enjoy refreshments at the Sunset Deck, or order from the 24-hour room service. In-room breakfast is also available. Additional amenities include a gym and a sauna. A complimentary shuttle service to the V&A Waterfront, city center, Table Mountain, Clifton, and Camps Bay is provided, and airport transfers can be arranged.

89317.description: This is an elegant boutique hotel ideally situated as a perfect base from which to explore the city. There is a wide range of restaurants, bars, cafés, shopping streets and entertainment venues in the area. The hotel is within walking distance of the National Theatre, the Archaeological Museum, the Acropolis, and the ancient area of Plaka. Facilities on offer include a lobby with 24-hour reception, currency exchange, a café, a restaurant, and Internet access. For an additional fee, guests may use the room and laundry services.

89378.address: Boğazak mah. Akdeniz Cad. 50 Sok. No:18 Boğazkent
89378.description: 'Nestled on Turkey's famed Orange County Belek beach, this family-friendly resort offers a tranquil escape with the convenience of an ultra all-inclusive experience. Guests enjoy a private beach with calm Mediterranean waters, a dedicated children's area with slides and a pool, and lush gardens. A variety of modern rooms cater to every need, while numerous restaurants and bars, along with daily activities and presentations, ensure a vibrant holiday experience. We look forward to welcoming you. '

89379.address: Cumhuriyet Mah.Ahu Unal Aysal Cad. Goynuk
89379.description: Perfectly positioned directly on a private beach awarded the blue flag and surrounded by a delightful garden, this hotel has got everything to guarantee magnificent family holidays. The lovely town of Kemer is only 8 km away, the regional capital of Antalya 50 km and the international airport 65 km. The hotel has 272 rooms, 24-hours reception, meeting rooms, free WIFI in public areas, spa and wellness, outdoor and indoor pool, children's pool, playground, sports facilities, 5 restaurants, 3 bars, medical services, car hire and free on-site parking. Facilities for disabled guests.

89380.description: Indulge in a pampering experience at the full-service spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take a refreshing dip in one of the two outdoor swimming pools or unwind on the private beach. This all-inclusive property offers a wide range of amenities, including concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and gift shops. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments, with some exceptions applying. Savor delicious seafood at Mavi Restaurant, one of the property's three restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service in the comfort of your room. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/café. Join other guests at the complimentary daily reception. A beach bar, five bars/lounges, and two poolside bars offer a variety of refreshing drinks. The property also features a business center, express check-in, and dry cleaning/laundry services. For events, there are conference facilities measuring 2368 square feet (220 square meters). A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and free self-parking is provided onsite. Each of the 316 air-conditioned rooms provides a relaxing retreat, featuring free minibar items, an LCD television, and a private balcony with satellite TV. Private bathrooms are equipped with deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Nearby attractions include Blauhimmel beach (0. 2 mi), Daima (1 mi), and Alacasu (2. 9 mi).

name.content: Sunland Resort Beldibi Ex Imperial Sunland Family

89381.address: Ciftcesmeler Mevkii, Ataturk Cad. 2. Sok, Beldibi
89381.description:
Located in Beldibi, the jewel of our city Antalya with its rich historical and natural beauty, our property is committed to providing high-quality service and offering our guests an unforgettable holiday experience. 
The property consists of a 4-story main building and features 2 guest elevators. Complimentary water is provided in the minibar on the guest’s arrival day. Wi-Fi is available free of charge throughout all areas of the property. Special arrangements for birthdays, wedding anniversaries, and marriage proposals are subject to an additional fee. Entertainment activities are organized every other day during the summer season. Pets are not allowed in the property.

89400.description: Located in the heart of Sant Joan Despi, this hotel is near Barcelona's main access roads and close to Cornellá Exhibition Centre, Fira Gran Via 2 Exhibition Centre in Hospitalet, and the Catalunya Congress Centre. The hotel provides a breakfast buffet, café-restaurant, TV room, business centre, external laundry service and car park. The hotel offers Wi-Fi in all guest rooms.

89417.address: Opp The Gateway of India Apollo Bunder Colaba
89417.description: With a stay at The Taj Mahal Palace Mumbai in Mumbai (Colaba), you'll be steps from Front Bay and 5 minutes by foot from Gateway of India. This luxury hotel is 0. 5 mi (0. 7 km) from Cathedral of the Holy Name and 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from Bombay Natural History Society. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 285 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Satellite programming and DVD players are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Enjoy Japanese cuisine at Wasabi by Morimoto, one of the hotel's 7 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 3 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in.

89456.description: The President, Mumbai - IHCL SeleQtions, enjoys a central location, a short walk from Colaba Causeway and the World Trade Centre. This eco-certified hotel offers a full-service spa with massages, body treatments, and facials, alongside an outdoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. Guests can choose from 287 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring a refrigerator, minibar, and a 32-inch LCD TV. Complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands are also available. Dining options include Trattoria, serving Italian cuisine, 24-hour room service, and a coffee shop/cafe. A complimentary daily reception and a bar/lounge provide further opportunities for relaxation. Buffet breakfast is offered for a fee. The hotel boasts extensive event space and provides airport shuttle service (surcharge) and free self-parking.

89457.address: Bandstand Bandra West Byramji Jejebhoy Road
89457.description: The Taj Lands End, a luxurious hotel in Mumbai's Bandra West district, overlooks the Arabian Sea and the Bandra Worli Sea Link. A short drive from both the international (16 km) and domestic (12 km) airports, it offers convenient access to the city's business districts, including Bandra Kurla Complex, Andheri, and Worli. Guests can enjoy fine dining, elegant conference and banquet facilities, and experience India's renowned hospitality.

89529.description:
This hotel is located in the main square of Mogliano Veneto, Piazza Duca D'Aosta, 150 m from the local train station with regular service to the heart of Venice and Treviso, so guests needn't worry about traffic, or parking. There are restaurants, bars and shops in the immediate vicinity. Facilities include a lobby reception, hotel safe, lift, a café, a bar, a TV lounge, a breakfast room, conference facilities and Internet access. For an additional fee, guests may also take advantage of the room and laundry services. 
The check-in has to be done within 00:00, in case the arrival is later please contact the Reception to have the code to enter yourself in the Hotel.

89582.description: Nestled in an upscale neighborhood, the recently renovated 4-star Delphi Hotel offers a tranquil escape within walking distance of major attractions. Spacious, contemporary rooms feature plush bedding and fine linens. Unwind after a busy day in the cozy bar and lounge or explore nearby international restaurants, the RAI convention center, Vondelpark, and vibrant shopping streets, all within a 15-minute walk. A tram stop just 100 meters away provides swift access to the city center and Central Station. Choose from Classic rooms with warm, classical decor and views of Apollolaan or the garden, or opt for the modern luxury of the Executive rooms, boasting high-quality materials and premium amenities. All rooms offer quality beds, premium linens, and pay-per-view movies for a relaxing stay.

89583.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. This hotel has 4 meeting rooms available for events. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 87 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets.

89585.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a nightclub or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services, a picnic area, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Planning an event in Hornchurch? This hotel has 270 square feet (25 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 138 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily. The nearest airports are: London City Airport (LCY) - 34. 5 km / 21. 4 mi London (SEN-Southend) - 34. 2 km / 21. 2 mi Stansted Airport (STN) - 49. 6 km / 30. 8 mi Heathrow Airport (LHR) - 95. 8 km / 59. 5 mi The preferred airport for Palms Hotel & Retreat By Palette London Romford is London City Airport (LCY).

89589.description: Situated in a prime setting at the heart of the mesmerising city of Athens, this hotel is located in close proximity to the National Museum and Plaka Square. The hotel offers guests a great location from which to explore the delights that this captivating city has to offer, as well as a boundless array of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. The hotel is located within easy access of the Acropolis and Lycabettus Hill. Bathed in the rich culture and history of the city, this charming hotel embodies the elegance and style of a bygone era. Guests are welcomed into a world where tradition and modernity enjoy a happy union. The guest rooms are sumptuously appointed, commanding impressive views over the city streets. Guests are invited to take advantage of the facilities that the hotel has to offer.

89604.description: This charming 4-star hotel in Paleo Faliro on Athens's coastline offers 86 rooms and two junior suites, just a 15-minute drive from central Athens and the Port of Piraeus. Located on Possidonos Avenue, it's ideal for business, leisure, and family travelers, valued for its exceptional customer service, hospitable atmosphere, and meticulous cleanliness. Public transport is easily accessible, with taxi, bus, and tram stations just steps away. Many rooms boast stunning views of the Saronic Gulf and Kastela Hill. The hotel features three well-equipped event rooms with sea views, perfect for business meetings, weddings, and christenings, complemented by diverse banquet menus. Guests can enjoy a daily buffet breakfast, room service, a mini-gym, an indoor whirlpool, and free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Limited on-site parking is available for €12 per day.

89616.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including a health club and an indoor pool. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, ForKnife, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Doha? This hotel has 2476 square feet (230 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 5 meeting rooms. A shuttle from the airport to the hotel is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 347 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring kitchenettes. Your room comes with a Tempur-Pedic bed.

89617.description: Al Liwan Suites is located in close proximity to the centre of Doha, the Old Souk, the Doha Corniche and the Dasman Centre, making it the ideal base from which to explore the entire city. Doha International Airport is just 3 kms from the hotel. Inspired by traditional Qatari hospitality, this 83 room city hotel is a dream destination for both business and leisure travellers. Dining options include a café and a restaurant, and business guests will appreciate the conference facilities on offer. The hotel's recreational facilities include a gym, a swimming pool, sauna and steam rooms. Relaxing spa treatments are also available. The restaurant is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Here, guests can please their palates with a range of oriental, Egyptian and international cuisines. Come and stay at Al Liwan Suites and be assured of a warm and relaxing experience

89647.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a reception hall. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Planning an event in Paris? This hotel has 700 square feet (65 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 36 guestrooms. Your room comes with a Select Comfort bed. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

89653.description: This family-friendly city hotel is situated right in the heart of Amsterdam, between the Dam and Munt Squares. The hotel's immediate vicinity is full of restaurants, bars, pubs and shops. Public transport links are also just 100 m away. The 50-room hotel has a pleasant and informal atmosphere. There is a reception area with a front desk that is open 24-hours a day. Lift access, hire safes, luggage storage and an on-site bar are also featured. There is a breakfast room in which a buffet is served each morning, and the building is heated throughout. All rooms are en suite with bathtub or shower and a toilet. Further in-room facilities include hairdryer, direct dial telephone and cable TV. The hotel offers a bed and breakfast package.

89700.description: This 4-star hotel is located in Montcada i Reixac, near El Punt shopping center, and surrounded by the main business and industrial areas of Barcelona. It is located just 1 minute away from the Renfe train station and 15 minutes by train from Plaça Catalunya, the main square in Barcelona city center. Its proximity to Montcada-Ripollet train station also gives easy access to the Bellaterra University Campus, the Vallés Technology Park and the Montmeló Circuit. The hotel offers 105 fully equipped rooms, a gym, an outdoor swimming pool (only on summer season) and parking with charging spots for electric cars, among other services.

89746.description:
The “Susesi Luxury Resort” is located in Belek, one of Antalya’s most popular tourist destinations, and welcomes guests with its beachfront location, an atmosphere that highlights the beauty of nature, spacious gardens, and a private beach. The resort combines luxury with comfort and features a variety of accommodation options, each with its own unique concept. In addition to these options, the resort offers suites and villas that enhance your vacation experience. The thoughtfully designed rooms feature amenities such as a minibar, kettle, safe, Wi-Fi, telephone, LCD TV, hairdryer, tea and coffee making facilities, and a pillow menu. 
With its 300-meter-long beach, indoor and outdoor pools of various designs, and a water park, the resort offers a fun-filled vacation for guests of all ages. You can choose to enjoy the crystal-clear waters of the Mediterranean Sea or spend enjoyable moments by the pool or at the water park. 
The resort offers the chance to enjoy the summer while discovering a variety of flavors, with a main restaurant and a selection of restaurants offering à la carte menus as alternative options. These restaurants, which serve a variety of Turkish and international dishes, will add even more joy to your vacation. 
The resort caters to the needs of both families and couples seeking a romantic getaway, offering services and facilities for guests of all ages. Children can enjoy a day full of fun at the kids’ clubs, which offer specialized services for different age groups. Adults, meanwhile, can participate in a variety of sports activities or spend time at the fitness center, while the entertainment program adds a touch of fun to their vacation.

89836.description: Located in the bustling and picturesque Canal District and housed within a charming 17th century historical building, Citadines Canal Amsterdam enjoys a prime location being just a three-minute walk to Vijzelgracht metro and tramway station. Our apart hotel in Amsterdam is also within walking distance to popular attractions such as the Heineken Experience, Albert Cuyp Market and Museum Square, as well as the popular and touristic district of Dam Square (18 mins walk/1. 5km). Citadines Canal Amsterdam welcomes guests for both short and long stays. From Classic Rooms to One-Bedroom Apartments, make the choice that suits your accommodation needs. Spacious, stylish and equipped with modern facilities, our serviced residence in Amsterdam allows you to live like a local while feeling at home.

89912.description: Thon Hotel Brussels Airport is set in the business district of Diegem and offers modern guest rooms, free WiFi and breakfast buffet. It also features a restaurant, a terrace and a bar. Each air-conditioned room at the Thon Hotel Brussels Airport is equipped with a smart TV, a Nespresso machine, a fridge with a complimentary bottle of water, a desk and a telephone. A bath or a shower and a hairdryer come as standard in the en-suite bathroom.

89970.description:
This aparthotel is located approximately 1. 2 km from the city center, in a quiet residential area. About a 20-minute walk will take you to a major shopping center, and the public transportation network is just a few minutes away, providing easy access to other parts of the city. With great shopping and dining options nearby, it’s the perfect choice to combine business, relaxation, and style in Bogotá. 

104 Art Suites offers modern and functional spaces, including 18 fully equipped apartment-style suites for long stays and 9 standard rooms ideal for short visits. All suites are spacious, bright, and fully furnished with all the necessary amenities to ensure a comfortable experience. 

Enjoy a warm atmosphere with contemporary design, a cozy restaurant serving your daily breakfast, and a private meeting room for up to 30 people. 

104 Art Suites – Comfort and a privileged location in the north of Bogotá

89996.description: Nestled in Belek Kadriye, a tourist paradise and renowned golfing area amidst pine forests and natural wonders, this club resort offers a delightful escape. Located 2km from Kadriye town center, 7km from Belek city center, and a short 1450m from the beach, it provides convenient access to area attractions. Antalya's city center and airport are approximately 35km and 25km away, respectively. Built in 2008, the five-story main building houses 210 modern guest rooms, each featuring a furnished balcony, satellite TV, and a large private bathroom. Business travelers can utilize the conference facilities and internet access. Three swimming pools, a waterslide, an aqua park, and an amphitheater with light entertainment cater to leisure guests, while a dedicated kids' club ensures younger visitors stay engaged. Several golf courses are also nearby. With spectacular beaches, outstanding service, and thrilling activities, this club resort is an ideal choice for any vacation.

90006.description: This charming B&B is situated in the heart of Barcelona just minutes away from Gaudi's La Pedrera and Casa BatllÃ³ and surrounded by the most exclusive streets of Barcelona, Rambla Catalunya and Paseig de Gracia. All the best shops, restaurants and museums are also just a short distance away. At this Bed and Breakfast, guests are provided with an intimate and elegant environment for the discerning traveller. It is a chic and stylish B&B, housed in a building dating back to 1894, the B&B retains a modernist elegance yet combines this with contemporary interiors. The quality and design of the B&B is evident in the materials that have been used, with the finest marble, textiles and furnishings imported from around the world to complete the interior. The B&B features complimentary wireless Internet access throughout as well as a lounge with a PC, and a small bar where guests can relax after a long day of shopping or sightseeing. With its attention to detail, luxurious interiors, and 24-hour staff to cater to any need, the bed and breakfast is sure to be the perfect setting for any visit. All rooms are decorated in warm tones with designer furnishings and include designer toiletries. They each offer a private bathroom and have smooth satin, Egyptian cotton and plush velvet on the beds. All rooms are also equipped with a hairdryer, individually controlled air conditioning and heating, a LCD flat screen TV, wireless Internet access as well as a wired Internet connection. Rooms with balconies are available on request. Guests can take advantage of an agreement with a spa in the centre of Barcelona. A continental breakfast is served daily.

90011.description: This urban hotel is situated in the heart of Berlin, conveniently located near restaurants and nightlife. Tegel and Schönefeld Airports are both approximately 9 miles away. The six-story hotel offers 2 single and 138 double rooms, accessible by elevator. A 24-hour reception, safe, room service, and laundry service are available, along with Wi-Fi in public areas and accessible facilities. Guests can also enjoy on-site parking and shopping. All carpeted rooms feature air conditioning, central heating, double or single (80x200cm) beds, a safe, minibar, mini-fridge, desk, direct-dial telephone, satellite TV, and free Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include a shower, bathtub, hairdryer, and vanity mirror. Wheelchair-accessible rooms and family rooms are available, as well as 140 non-smoking rooms.

90019.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace at Arc la Rambla, a centrally located Barcelona hotel just steps from Teatre Principal and Centre d'Art Santa Monica. This eco-certified hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a communal living room, and tour/ticket assistance. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) and take advantage of the computer station and multilingual staff at the 24-hour front desk. The 98 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with deep soaking bathtubs, and convenient amenities like in-room safes and desks. Nearby attractions include the Columbus Monument (0. 2 mi) and Barcelona Wax Museum (0. 4 mi). Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) is 9. 7 mi away.

90023.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting, in a historical neighbourhood in Brussels. The hotel is located just a 15 minutes' walking distance away from the European Parliament. Jubelpark is located close to the hotel, while the centre of Brussels is just a 5 minutes' metro ride away. The hotel enjoys close proximity to the European Commission, which is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away. Schuman Metro Station is just 500 metres away from the hotel. This wonderful hotel is the perfect choice for business and leisure travellers visiting the city. The guest rooms are superbly designed, offering functional space and modern conveniences. Guests can avail of the many first-class facilities and services that this wonderful hotel has to offer.

90036.description: Situated in the city's most exclusive residential area, the hotel is surrounded by commercial and financial establishments, and the city's best restaurants and shopping centres are within walking distance. Facilities include a lobby area with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, cloakroom and lift access, a bar, a restaurant, and business travellers will appreciate the conference facilities and WLAN Internet access. Guests can use the valet service and room and laundry services. Covered garage parking is available for those arriving by car.

90063.description: The Best Western Dam Square Inn offers a comfortable home away from home in Amsterdam's vibrant city center. Located just steps from Dam Square, the Royal Palace, and the New Church, this hotel, situated in the former liqueur factory 'De Drie Fleschjes, ' places you in the heart of all the action. Explore nearby attractions including concert venues, museums, theaters, and a variety of shops. Our recently renovated rooms feature modern furnishings, private bathrooms with showers, toilets, and hairdryers, as well as in-room amenities such as telephones, safes, flat-screen televisions with in-house movies and media hubs, and coffee/tea makers. While our air conditioning is currently undergoing maintenance, each guest room is equipped with an electric fan for your comfort. The Best Western Dam Square Inn is a 100% smoke-free hotel.

90086.description: Located on the Upper West Side, this hotel is just a 10-minute walk from Central Park and away from the turbulence of Mid-town, but yet still an easy commute away. Even if one doesn't particularly enjoy museums, the nearby American Museum of Natural History is more than worth the 5 minute walk. Spread over 27 interconnected buildings and housing 45 permanent exhibition halls, there are so many fascinating things do to and see that one visit won't be enough. If some entertainment is needed the Lincoln centre of performing arts is just a 15-minute walk away and the surrounding area offers fantastic shopping facilities and a myriad of dining choices. The recently refurbished boutique hotel welcomes its guests to 250 rooms spread over 16 floors. On its last floor there is a green patio retreat, where one can relax while enjoying stunning views of the city.

90220.address: Meydankavağı Mah. Aspendos Bulvarı No:36 Muratpaşa, 36
90220.description: The Latanya Palm Hotel, conveniently located in the heart of Antalya, offers easy access to the city's main attractions, including the EXPO 2016 Antalya Expo center. Guests can enjoy a comfortable stay in one of the 86 elegant rooms, including 11 suites and 74 standard rooms, as well as one specially equipped room. The hotel features a restaurant, bar, two swimming pools, and a spa and wellness center offering a range of rejuvenating treatments. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. The Latanya Palm Hotel provides unparalleled service and comfortable accommodations, making it an ideal choice for both business and leisure travelers.

90387.description: This hotel enjoys a favorable location on a quiet street in the heart of the lively La Motte-Picquet district, across from the famed Village Suisse antique market. Restaurants, bars, shops, and public transport are just 100 meters away on Avenue de la Motte-Picquet. The Eiffel Tower and Champ de Mars are a short walk away, and with three metro lines nearby, guests have easy access to all of Paris. Les Invalides is 500 meters from the hotel, and the Champs-Élysées is 3 kilometers away. Orly Airport is 20 kilometers away, and Charles de Gaulle Airport is 30 kilometers away. Housed in a beautiful Haussmann building with classic Parisian architecture, this hotel offers 40 spacious rooms. Dating back to 1902 and fully renovated in 2007, the unique decor creates an exceptional setting for both business and leisure travelers. The air-conditioned hotel features a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a safe, and lift access. Guests can enjoy the bar and breakfast room, and business travelers will appreciate the Wi-Fi access. Laundry service and parking (for a fee) are also available. Ranging from 12 to 22 square meters, the rooms blend Baroque and contemporary decor, creating an elegant and comfortable living space. Each room features a Bang & Olufsen TV, luxurious Poltrona Frau furniture, and a spacious bathroom with Versace tile. All rooms include a private bathroom with a shower/bathtub and hairdryer, a king-size or double bed, direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, radio, internet access, a safe, a minibar, and air conditioning/heating.

90390.description: This hotel is located in the town centre of Lelystad, within walking distance of the central station and 200 m from restaurants and bars. It lies in the direct vicinity of Lelystad Business Airport, the Bataviastad outlet centre, the theme park Walibi World and the Dolfinarium. The city of Amsterdam and the airport as well as Utrecht are some 50 km away. Renovated in 2008, this is a small professional hotel offering all the facilities of a large establishment. This city hotel is ideal for business travellers and holidaymakers alike and features stylish guest rooms, equipped with modern furnishings and useful facilities such as free Wi-Fi, a comfortable work desk and a cosy seating area. After a restful night's sleep, guests may enjoy a delicious breakfast buffet every morning, while the restaurant and bar serves delicious meals and a wide selection of stylish beverages. The spacious, air-conditioned conference rooms are the perfect location to host successful meetings in a warm and professional ambiance.

90391.description:
Listed as national monument, it has been converted into a hotel and is now a true showcase for Dutch architecture and design. The Hoxton Lloyd is located in the Eastern Docklands allowing its guests to get in contact with an area with fascinating cultural, architectural and shopping highlights. Just a short stroll away from many of Amsterdam's cultural hotspots including Holland's biggest jazz club and the Rijksmuseum. The expressive tile work, sweeping staircases, and old-soul quirks meet The Hoxton’s signature charm: playful design, community-driven events, and a lobby that always feels like someone interesting just walked in. 

And the rooms? Let’s just say: sleeping here is part of the adventure. Due to its size it is also an outstanding venue for business meetings and conferences. Its unusual range of spaces and its innovative design features can accommodate for any type of event.

90393.description: A partner for your seminars and functions, Novotel Paris Orly Rungis offers 13 meeting rooms, as well as a range of business, executive and family guest rooms. The outdoor pool, open during summer months, and the fitness centre are ideal for relaxing and revitalising between business events or sightseeing excursions. Our hotel in Rungis also has gourmet moments in store for you. The bar tempts you with housemade cocktails, while the restaurant serves up tasty dishes in the dining room or on the terrace.

90399.description: Near the RER A and E, with direct access to La Defense and less than 30 mins from Disneyland Paris (Marne la Vallée), the Mercure Paris Val de Fontenay will meet all your needs for business trips or family stays. Our 4* hotel has 8 spacious and renovated seminar rooms, a fitness room for sporty types, a bar with a happy hour and a restaurant serving homemade products and a patio for sunny days.

90411.description: Dating back to the 18th century and build in the Biedermeier style, this charming hotel is the only one of its kind in Vienna and presents a true architectural monument. It is perfectly located for exploring the Austrian capital. Sitting in a quiet neighbourhood, it is just over 1 km away from the Ringstrasse and the centre of Vienna. The nearby Mariahilfer Strasse offers numerous shops and is ideal for a leisurely walk, whilst the adjacent metro station has direct trains to St. Stephen's Cathedral and Westbahnhof train station. The state opera house is just under 2 km from it and is worth a visit not only for the opera lovers, but also due to its amazing architecture. Whilst the world-famous Schönbrunn Palace, with its 1, 441-rooms and Rococo style, is only 3 km away.

90436.description: In a beautiful setting between pine trees and palms and the turquoise blue of the Mediterranean, the centre of Kemer is only a 10 minutes' drive away and it is 30 km to Antalya. Re-built in 2014-15, this beachside hotel offers modern furnished and equipped rooms and facilities and a range of amenities for guests' comfort and entertainment, the rooms offer free Wi-Fi, minibars, and LCD TVs with cable channels. You can either plunge into the Indoor and outdoor swimming pool with three water slides.  After a stressful, day or just enjoy coffee in the Lobby if you prefer to start your day with energy. Suitable for most ages, guests are also able to reach nearby attractions easily, with public transport running by the hotel and a taxi rank being closely. The popular resort of Kemer has a wide choice of shops and cafe bars/restaurants and an attractive yacht marina. Closer to the hotel, the centre of the small resort of Beldibi is approximately three km away. With a beach, location that will take the breath away this vacation destination will suit every need.

90465.description: This hotel lies just 2 km away from the centre of Milan. The historical centre of the city, the Trade Fair, Monza racetrack and Lake Como are all within driving distance of the hotel. Guests can explore the wealth of intriguing attractions that the city has to offer. Milan Central Station is just 8 km from the property. Linate Airport is 17 km away. This wonderful hotel represents a new, innovative design concept. It features a metropolitan loft, a blend of decor styles, fresh colours and technological innovation. The guest rooms are stunningly designed, using space and light to create a serene ambiance. The property features a charming restaurant, where traditional Italian dishes can be enjoyed. The COSMO Grill Restaurant will be open from Monday to Thursday from 19. 30 to 22. 30, with a menu by the chef. For the lunch service (from 12. 00 to 14. 30) and for dinners on Friday, Saturday and Sunday, the service will be guaranteed at our American Bar.

90482.description: Theatre break? Shopping trip? Business meeting or just seeing the sights? Whatever your reason for heading to the capital, this charming hotel is the perfect base for your adventures. Tucked away in sought-after Kensington it's just a short stroll from the upmarket High Street and a great selection of restaurants and shops. Or you can hop on the tube and be smack bang in the hustle and bustle of London in minutes. You'll find our 54 newly-refurbished bedrooms just the tonic for your stay in the capital – each kitted out with free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with Freeview, full-length mirror and safe.

90491.description: This cozy hotel is perfectly situated in the heart of Amsterdam, within walking distance of Central Station, a hub for trams and buses. Several tram lines stop directly in front of the hotel, providing easy access to the entire city. From this central location, guests can stroll along the picturesque canals, explore nearby markets and restaurants, and experience the charm of Amsterdam's city center. Schiphol International Airport is a convenient 30-minute drive away. The hotel lobby offers a trendy, welcoming lounge and a coffee room. Guest rooms feature private bathrooms, furnishings, and all the necessary amenities for a comfortable and complete experience.

90492.description: Ideally situated close to the beach in the captivating city of Barcelona, this delightful hostel provides the perfect place from which to explore the delights the area has to offer. The hotel is just a 15 minutes' metro ride away from the heart of this culturally-rich, historical city. Guests can easily take a tour bus ride around the city, or explore on foot and underground. Guests will find themselves just a short metro ride away from a host of attractions, landmarks and spectacular architecture designed by the renowned architect Gaudi. Guests will find comfortable, tastefully decorated guest rooms, which offer a relaxing setting in which to relax and unwind at the end of a long day's sightseeing.

90536.description: This hotel is situated in the heart of the centre of Almere. Due to its exceptional, central location, the cities of Amsterdam, Utrecht and Apeldoorn can all be reached in less than one hour. The Northern provinces are also within easy reach. The hotel's immediate vicinity features restaurants, bars and pubs and public transport links, providing quick and easy access to Almere via the excellent transport infrastructure. Amsterdam is some 40 km from the accommodation. Newly opened in 2008, the hotel comprises 117 design rooms, as well as a bar/lounge and the trendy food concept the Bierfabriek. The lobby features a 24-hour reception, hotel safe and lift access. Room and laundry services are also provided. The guest rooms are all comfortably furnished and en suite. Facilities include a direct dial telephone and TV set. Furthermore, the rooms all feature unique bespoke-design furniture.

90537.description: This charming city hotel invites guests to stay in the heart of Paris' ninth arrondissement, between the Sacré-Coeur Basilica and Opéra. Saint-Georges metro station is right outside the hotel, and the cable car bringing guests to the top of Montmartre is just a 15-minute walk away. The hotel's location provides easy access to shopping at the Galeries Lafayette and Printemps as well as sights such as the Moulin Rouge and the Louvre. The stylish, simply furnished guest rooms are equipped with en suite bathrooms, internet access and satellite televisions. In the morning, guests can enjoy a delightful buffet breakfast alongside the daily newspaper. Whether travelling for business or leisure, this hotel's sleek and contemporary rooms and wonderful, central location make it an ideal choice.

90556.description: Renovated in 2013, this modernly styled hotel is located in the Talimhane district, just 300 m north of the Taksim Square. Suitable for business and leisure travelers alike, it consists of 117 rooms over 8 floors and is ideally located for those wishing to be in the centre of the city. Close to numerous shops either in the upmarket Nisantasi area or Istiklal Avenue, there are also plenty of entertainment venues, restaurants and bars in close proximity. From the Taksim Square it is easy to take public transport across the Golden Horn to the historical district of Sultanahmet.

90558.description: Situated near Calle 72, Radisson Bogota Metrotel offers a superior location close to top financial institutions, government offices, and technology companies, including Digital Ware and Amadeus. Our full-service hotel is within walking distance of entertainment hot spots like Zona Rosa, a popular district filled with music venues, nightclubs, and casinos. You can explore the many restaurant options in Chapinero, also known as Zona G or the Gastro Zone, for a taste of local flavors. You can begin your day in our gym, sauna, or steam room, followed by a visit to our on-site restaurant for a complimentary breakfast. To get work done, stop by our 24-hour business center and use free WiFi to connect to the office. When you are ready to venture out, you can walk just a block to the local bus station. Car service and airport transfers to El Dorado International Airport can be scheduled at our front desk for an additional cost. Relax in a room or suite with a flat-screen TV, a mini bar, and a desk. Suites with a kitchenette and a sleeper sofa are available. Room service is an option for private dining. No Pets Allowed.

90561.description: This modern, family-friendly aparthotel is conveniently situated in the northern part of the city near CORFERIAS convention centre and just a few minutes from the airport. This location provides easy access to the city's public transport links, and many excellent restaurants, shops, bars, and clubs can be found in the immediate vicinity. From here, visitors can easily explore the historic and cultural centre of Candelaria and the city's myriad of museums, monuments, and parks. The contemporary apartments are perfect for both short and long stays, and all come with kitchenette, Wi-Fi, and satellite television. Guests can relax with a book in the reading room, enjoy a drink in the lobby bar, make use of the business centre, or get fit in the fitness centre, and parking facilities and laundry services are also available. This is the perfect place to rest after a long day of sightseeing or business in the vibrant city of Bogota.

90565.description: This hotel is located in a beautiful residential complex, just across from one of the biggest shopping centres in the country. Guests will find restaurants, bars and nightclubs close by. This hotel is ideal for staging cultural events. Facilities include a hairdressing salon, a bar and a restaurant. It also offers conference facilities and WLAN/Internet access (for a fee). Guests may also use the room and laundry services and there are parking facilities available.

90569.description: Suites Jones Estelar is a fabulous hotel situated approximately 3 minutes from the financial zone and around 15 minutes from historical and cultural center of the city. It enjoys a convenient situation which allows easy access to the main routes. This is a family friendly hotel offering a warm welcome and quality services guaranteed by its professional staff. Perfect both for business travellers and holiday makers.

90607.description: This luxurious establishment features a prime setting in the Spanish city of Pinto, providing easy access to the Autovía del Sur motorway. Nearby attractions include the popular Warner Bros theme Park, situated just a 5-minute drive away. Surrounded by a wide choice of entertainment options, including Plaza de Eboli commercial centre, this hotel offers the ideal accommodation either for business or leisure. Families travelling with children and needing an extra space will appreciate the family suites specially designed to satisfy all their needs and offering two fully-equipped independent bathrooms. The restaurant serves a wide selection of delicious specialities and those travelling on business will have the chance to enjoy a moment of relaxation in the ‘after work area' featuring drinks and snacks.

90699.description: The 4-star Hotel Josefshof am Rathaus is located in a quiet side street in the charming „Josefstadt“ district and impresses with its imperial flair and Viennese charm. The hotel is close to Vienna's city center and within a few minutes walking distance from Vienna's most famous sights: Vienna city hall, Vienna imperial palace, the museum district and the shopping street Mariahilferstraße. Our rooms are equipped with modern facilities and bookable in two different styles: While our main building presents a touch of imperial Vienna, our art nouveau building stages a loving homage to the great artists of this time and their most famous motifs. Wi-Fi is available free of charge in the entire hotel. A rich breakfast buffet is served every morning between 07:00 and 12:00 and includes a wide selection of coffee and tea specialties, homemade cakes and pastries, fresh fruit and juices. Our hotel bar is open around the clock and offers hot and cold drinks, Austrian wine, classic drinks and small hot dishes.

90727.description: This hotel is set near the magnificent Lake Geneva. Situated close to the business and shopping areas, it is the ideal home away from home for guests looking to make the most of their stay in Geneva. Cornavin Central Railway Station is 500 m from the hotel, whilst Cointrin International Airport is 5 km away. This distinctive property offers discreet luxury in the friendly and intimate atmosphere of a private residence. Behind the simple façade of a period building, the contemporary interior is rich in contrasts between East and West, simplicity and fantasy and tradition and technology. The hotel has a total of 41 guest rooms, including 2 junior suites and 2 duplex suites overlooking the patio, and is fully air-conditioned.

90796.description: The hotel is located in the entertainment quarter, a very well-connected area of Paris, at the foot of Montmartre, with easy access to public transportation. Opéra Garnier and the Moulin Rouge cabaret are nearby. Also in the area are the big boulevards, with famous stores, and the Grévin wax museum. To the north, guests will find Montmartre with the Sacré-Coeur Basilica and the Espace Dalí art museum. Facilities include 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, lift access and a laundry service.

90804.description: Located in Sesto San Giovanni's Isola del Bosco - Delle Corti district, the AC Hotel by Marriott Milan Sesto is a convenient base for exploring Milan. A short 15-minute drive takes you to the Piazza del Duomo and Milan Cathedral, while the Teatro alla Scala and Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II are within 9 km. The hotel offers 155 guestrooms with heated floors, LCD TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a fitness center, concierge services, and an on-site restaurant, Concordia, with room service also available. A buffet breakfast is served daily for a fee. Additional amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning services. Self-parking is available (charges apply).

90877.description: Built in 1600, this family-friendly Guest House B&B has been expertly restored and is part of the majestic ancient Palazzo Barbarigo. The Palace consists of 2 floors: a large staircase takes guests from the ground floor, with a small and pleasant reception, to a grand second floor where all of the beautiful rooms are situated. The well-appointed bedrooms are tastefully decorated in 18th century Venetian style and some of them open to a terrace with a delightful view of a typical canal, where gondolas glide by. The venue is located in a quiet and atmospheric area, very close to St. Mark's Square, La Fenice Theatre and Calle 22 Marzo, at one of the most elegant shopping streets of Venice. The nearest waterbus stop is Santa Maria del Giglio, located at just a 2-minute walk from the hotel. Due to this great location guests will be steps away from a charming small restaurant or a busy bar.

90916.description: This beach hotel is constantly updating itself and was last refurbished in 2010. Occupying 55, 000sqm of land, which stretches down to the beach and the hotel pier, it consists of 2 separate hotel blocks with 422 rooms and 189 rooms in the villa blocks which are located in the grounds. Over-looking the Mediterranean, the hotel is located 13km west of the resort of Alanya in Konakli. Local amenities are available within a 10 minute walk and public transport runs in front of the hotel.

90973.description: This complex is located at the junction of Muntaner and Valencia streets, in the heart of Barcelona. It lies within walking distance of the main sights and business areas. The beach is 2km away, and Sagrada Familia just under 3km. Paseo de Gracia, with its great shops and amazing architecture, is a 10-minute walk away, while the famous Las Ramblas starts three blocks away. The historic building, which houses the aparthotel, is a stunning representation of the city's typical architectural style. The boutique venue is ideal for those who prefer more freedom while traveling and the option of preparing their own meals in the fully equipped kitchens, with in-room delivery of ingredients available. For added comfort, a pillow menu is provided.

90979.description: This family-friendly beach resort, built in 2007, is located 500 meters from Okurcalar's center, offering easy access to restaurants, bars, nightlife, shops, and public transport. Situated directly on the beachfront, it's approximately 33 km from Alanya's center, Alanya Castle, and the Damlata Caves, 27 km from Side's city center, and 90 km from Antalya Airport. The hotel features 333 rooms, five bars, and an all-inclusive program catering to all ages. Guests can enjoy multiple pools and a luxurious spa with a wide array of treatments. Three restaurants provide varied dining options, including two seasonal à la carte menus. The air-conditioned spa complex guarantees a memorable stay.

90986.description: Located in Lisbon's cultural heart of Belém, the Jerónimos 8 Design Hotel offers a stylish stay amidst museums and historical sites. Its modern design blends chocolate brown, carmine red, and serene cream, complementing the traditional Portuguese façade. The 65 comfortable rooms provide a peaceful retreat, while the hotel's bar offers a relaxed atmosphere to enjoy Portuguese wines and cocktails.

91079.description: This hotel is located in the heart of old Athens, opposite the Acropolis and just metres from Thissio, the ancient agora and the forum. It is set on the pedestrian street of Apostolou Pavlou, an ideal base from which to explore the city and all of its great monuments. Thisseion urban train station is 50 metres from the hotel. Guests can enjoy all the standard facilities of a city hotel. With simple and functional accommodation, the hotel provides guests with a pleasant base from which get to know Athens. Easily accessible and air-conditioned throughout, it offers an entrance hall and check-out service, lift access, a restaurant and bar and 15 spacious guest rooms. Each room comes with an en-suite bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, a satellite television, Internet access, air conditioning, central heating. Check in: 14:00-22:00. Breakfast is served in the form of a buffet.

91087.description: This hotel is located in a wide green area on Lido Island, only 100 metres from the sea with easy connection to the centre of the city. Surrounded by greenery, the hotel is perfect for relaxing after a day spent soaking up the atmosphere of this beautiful city. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, cloakroom, lift access, bar, restaurant, breakfast room and FREE shuttle bus to the water boat station in the morning from 8:30 to 10:30. In addition, Free internet/WLAN access, bike hire, car park and children's playground are at the disposal of guests for an unforgettable stay.

91091.address: Carrer Del Torrent De L Olla, 212-214
91091.description: Located in the Gracia area of Barcelona, this hotel is very close to Gaudi's Parc Guell and within easy reach of the main centre and Gothic quarter. There is a great variety of shops and restaurants as well as libraries and cinemas in the vicinity. This popular student residence city establishment offers affordable, comfortable accommodation in single, double and triple rooms. Guests enjoy free WLAN Internet access, vending machines, a launderette, a TV and reading lounge, and a garden. Further facilities include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception, lift access and a breakfast room.

91100.description: This charming city hotel is located within the multifunctional Le Torri Bianche Centre in Vimercate, on the outskirts of Milan. It's a short 15-minute drive from Linate Airport and close to the main motorway. Guests will immediately notice the hotel's unique character and exclusive style. Inspired by its name, a cosmos theme is reflected in the decor of the public areas and guest rooms. The decoration features refined artwork, sculptures, and contemporary pieces. Each comfortable room offers a distinct design, creating a true home-away-from-home feeling. For relaxation, guests can enjoy a massage or visit the sauna and steam room.

91105.description: The Savoy Hotel Piraeus, a premium business hotel, is uniquely situated in the city center, within walking distance of the main port, Pasalimani Yacht Harbor, and a 15-minute walk from the train station. Athens' historical attractions are just 10 km away and easily accessible by bus or metro. Attica's beautiful beaches and the Argosaronic Gulf islands are less than an hour away. Its prime location in the heart of the shipping business district, close to exhibition centers, city sights, and shopping areas, makes it ideal for both business and leisure travelers. This fully renovated hotel offers modern facilities and a warm, friendly environment. Sixty-eight well-equipped rooms and three spacious suites, along with luxuriously furnished communal areas and personalized service, guarantee high-quality accommodations. The hotel's restaurant and bar, adjacent to the ground floor lobby, offer a generous buffet breakfast, Greek and Mediterranean cuisine throughout the day, and excellent local wines and drinks in the evening, all within a relaxed and elegant atmosphere. Newly renovated conference rooms on the mezzanine level, equipped with state-of-the-art audiovisual equipment, provide an exceptional venue for events. Guests can enjoy nearby bars and open-air restaurants, and a leisurely stroll along the scenic seaside promenade offers the perfect opportunity for relaxation.

91156.address: Sehit Mehmet Pasa Yokusu No 30 Sultanahmet, 30
91156.description: Centrally located in Istanbul, Ada Hotel Istanbul places you steps from Sultanahmet Square and a short walk from the Blue Mosque. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a 24-hour front desk. Enjoy a daily buffet breakfast and the convenience of 24-hour room service. The 16 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Nearby attractions include the Hagia Sophia and Grand Bazaar. Airport shuttle service is available (surcharge).

91196.description: Titanic City Taksim is a stylish hotel located in the vibrant heart of Istanbul, just steps away from Taksim Square. This contemporary hotel blends comfort and convenience, featuring an impressive array of amenities designed to enhance guests' experiences. The hotel's 202 air-conditioned rooms are thoughtfully designed, featuring private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Each room is equipped with phones, laptop-compatible safes, and work desks to ensure a comfortable and productive stay. Culinary options are diverse, with Alesta Restaurant offering full dining experiences and a charming coffee shop/cafe providing more casual fare. For added convenience, 24-hour room service caters to guests' dining needs at any time. The hotel's bar/lounge offers a sophisticated setting to enjoy refreshing beverages. Practical amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and a roundtrip airport shuttle available for an additional fee. Recreational facilities include an indoor pool, a relaxing spa tub, and a rejuvenating sauna, providing perfect spaces for unwinding after exploring the city. Complimentary wireless internet and attentive concierge services ensure guests remain connected and well-supported throughout their stay.

name.content: Four Points by Sheraton Sheikh Zayed Road

91256.address: Sheikh Zayed Rd Near Financial And Exhibition Cent
91256.description: Located in Dubai (Trade Center), Four Points by Sheraton Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai is within a 5-minute drive of City Walk and Dubai Mall. This upscale hotel is 2. 2 mi (3. 6 km) from La Mer and 2. 7 mi (4. 4 km) from Burj Khalifa. Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Make yourself at home in one of the 383 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Luigi's Italian, a restaurant which specializes in Italian cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 517 square feet (48 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 5 meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Museum of the Future - 1.

91264.description: This hotel is ideally located in the heart of Burj Dubai, putting you within walking distance of exclusive shopping centers, textile and electronics markets, the Dubai Museum, Heritage Village, the new metro junction, Khalid bin Al Walid and Al Musalla Stations, and a variety of restaurants and nightclubs. The central business district, World Trade Centre, convention halls, and the Burj Downtown area, home to the world's tallest tower, the Burj Khalifa, are approximately 4 kilometers away. Golden Sands offers accommodation in three buildings: Golden Sands 3, 5, and 10. Studios and family suites are located in Golden Sands 3, while two- and three-bedroom apartments are in Golden Sands 10.

name.content: Hôtel du triangle d’or – Proche Madeleine

91287.description: Located in the heart of Paris, near the prestigious Olympia music hall, the 3-star Hotel du Triangle d'Or offers a unique boutique experience. This charming hotel, conveniently situated near Place de la Concorde and the Louvre, provides easy access to public transport and iconic landmarks. The Hotel du Triangle d'Or is an ideal choice for design and music enthusiasts seeking a refined and welcoming atmosphere where attention to detail ensures an unforgettable stay.

91288.description: Nestled in the heart of Paris's 17th arrondissement, the 4-star Hotel Regent's Garden offers a tranquil escape just moments from the Arc de Triomphe and Palais des Congrès. Conveniently located near the Ternes, Porte Maillot, and Charles de Gaulle – Étoile metro stations, this charming boutique hotel, part of the Astotel family, provides easy access to Parisian attractions. Whether for business or leisure, the hotel's 40 rooms and dedicated multilingual staff ensure a memorable stay. Enjoy the Champs-Élysées, a mere 10-minute walk away, and experience the best of Paris.

91325.description: Located in the heart of Brussels, Hotel Queen Mary is within a 10-minute walk of Grand Place and the Brussels Christmas Market. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a coffee shop/cafe, and a bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The 17 guestrooms feature minibars, private bathrooms with showers and hair dryers, desks, and electric kettles. Daily housekeeping is provided. Nearby attractions include the Manneken Pis Statue (0. 5 mi) and the Royal Palace of Brussels (1. 6 mi). The nearest airport is Brussels Airport (BRU).

91367.description: Being in the heart of the city, this hotel is a perfect base from which to explore Barcelona. It is located on Paseo de Gracia, the city's main shopping thoroughfare, only 5 minutes from the romantic Gothic Quarter. Restaurants and bars are only steps from the hotel, and nightclubs are also within walking distance. Public transportation is in the vicinity, linking guests to everything the city has to offer. Facilities include a cafe, a bar, a breakfast room and WLAN/Internet access.

91368.description:
This hotel is located halfway between Vienna's centre and the Schönbrunn Palace on the city's longest shopping street, and is the ideal starting point for sightseeing and shopping trips. It lies 3 km from the city centre (Stephansplatz), and guests will find restaurants and links to the public transport network in the immediate vicinity. Vienna International Airport is just 25 km away.

The first records of this city hotel date back to 1706 and, although it is hard to imagine, the then Nentwichhof stood alone amidst countryside. During the 19th Century, the hotel was rebuilt and enlarged several times, and a great deal has been invested to transform it into the prestigious building it is today. After full renovation in fall 2018, it offers modern comfort in typical industrial style and comprises a total of 68 rooms. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area, a hotel safe, a lift, a beautiful garden and a restaurant. The hotel's own secure car park is available for an additional fee. Guests may take advantage of the WLAN/Internet access (whole building) for free.

The newly refurbished rooms offer optimal comfort and come with a Flat TV, two singe or one double bed, free Internet access, a safe and a private bathroom with a shower/WC and a hairdryer. They are centrally heated and most of the rooms are very quiet and face onto the inner courtyard garden.

91392.address: Orta Mah. Kaptaniderya Cad. No:37 Kartal
91392.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a spa tub, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy international cuisine at Alesta Restaurant, a buffet restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. This hotel has 15 meeting rooms available for events. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 192 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions.

91405.description: Welcome to Holiday Inn Cairo Maadi, the perfect choice for your stay in Cairo. Located on the renowned Maadi Corniche, our hotel offers a stunning view of the Nile River, creating a truly captivating atmosphere. We are proud to present our collection of 171 rooms & Suites, designed for both business and leisure purposes. Each unit offers breathtaking views of the city or the majestic Nile River. Indulge in the culinary delights of our exquisite restaurants, where our skilled chefs will tantalize your taste buds with their creations. For a more relaxed atmosphere, unwind in our stylish bar. Our international restaurants offer a plenty of culinary delights that will satisfy even the most discerning taste buds. Our banquet rooms, equipped with state-of-the-art technology and bathed in natural daylight, providing the perfect setting for your special occasions. Our dedicated team of professionals will meticulously plan every aspect of your event, from tailored menus to innovative coffee breaks. With our unparalleled expertise, we guarantee an unforgettable experience. Unwind and rejuvenate at our fitness center, boasting a wide range of cutting-edge cardio and strength machines. We invite you to immerse yourself in comfort during your stay at Holiday Inn Cairo.

91480.address: Avenue Abdelkrim Khattabi Route De Casablanca
91480.description: In its modern building in the colors of the Red City, ibis Marrakech Palmeraie has 147 air-conditioned rooms with a private bathroom, office area, television and free WiFi. To relax, our hotel offers a bar, an international restaurant and an outdoor swimming pool with terrace. Finally, it has a meeting room to host your business meetings.

91528.description: The Hotel Everness offers a tranquil escape amidst verdant surroundings, just 10 minutes from Geneva. Enjoy breathtaking views of the lake and the Alps. Take advantage of the on-site restaurant, outdoor pool, padel, and tennis courts. Rooms feature flat-screen satellite TVs, safes, minibars, and work desks. Indulge in the 'Everness Wellness' experience on the fourth floor, inspired by Scandinavian concepts. Alternate between heat and cold therapies, including a Finnish sauna, eucalyptus steam bath, outdoor wooden hot and cold tubs, and an ice fountain, culminating in deep relaxation by the fireplace. Please note that the city tax is not included in the room rate and is payable directly to the hotel.

91537.description:
The Empire Hotel's 427 hotel rooms and suites represent a new standard in New York City boutique hotel accommodations. Located in Manhattan's Upper West Side, the Empire is an iconic NYC landmark, glowing over Columbus Circle and Lincoln Center below. The Empire Rooftop Bar serves up delicious cocktails, with unparalleled views of the New York skyline. Relax on outdoor terraces, and cool off in summer season in the outdoor Rooftop Plunge Pool.
