Rooms offer high-quality amenities such as flat screen televisions, private bathrooms, hair dryers, irons, and art deco décor throughout. Located across from 66th St Station (1 train) and 3 minutes' walk from Columbus Circle (A/B/C/D trains). 

The Empire offers multiple bars and restaurants, and is conveniently located steps from Central Park, Carnegie Hall & so many other NYC attractions. Get into an Empire State of Mind.

91608.address: Avinguda Del Marques De L Argentera, 11
91608.description: This comfortable and delightful hotel boasts a great position right in the city centre of the Cosmopolitan city of Barcelona. The property sits in the Born quarter, a mere 1 kilometre from the beach and within easy reach from bars and restaurants, as well as from a wide range of historical and sightseeing points of interest such as the Santa María church. There are several public transport links in the surrounding area, including the França railway station at a stone's throw away. All the residence's guest rooms feature a modern style and offer a charming and pleasant atmosphere in which guests can truly rest and relax after a busy day of sightseeing or working. Those travellers on business may wish to take advantage of the meeting facilities on-site, which offer the possibility to celebrate any kind of event. Moreover, every morning visitors can start the day with a delicious breakfast buffet service.

91615.description: Less than 0. 5 miles from Paddington Rail Station and Hyde Park, this 4-star hotel offers boutique-style serviced suites in the heart of London. Each suite has free WiFi and a modern kitchenette. The Cleveland Square links modern design with Victorian period features. Each air-conditioned unit features a flat-screen TV, a seating area and luxury private bathroom. Guests can enjoy food self-prepared in the well-equipped kitchenettes, which include a hob, kettle, a fridge, cutlery and crockery. Friendly, multilingual staff are on hand 24-hours a day. There are 4 major London Underground stations within a 10-minute walk of The Cleveland. The West End, Westminster and the South Bank are all within 15 minutes on the Underground. All room categories are located on every floor, including ground floor.

91640.description: This hotel is located in the Osmanbey district of the city where Istanbul's textile market is situated. It is just 1 km away from Taksim with its bars and nightspots. This city hotel comprises a total of 28 rooms and is ideal for business travellers and holidaymakers alike. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment are carefully and thoughtfully selected to ensure a comfortable and convenient stay. Parking is available for those arriving by car. The rooms come with an en suite bathroom with bathtub or massage shower and Internet access. Guests may also enjoy a refreshment from the mini- bar on the balcony or terrace, which also come as standard in all accommodation units.

91658.description: The Aadam Hotel Wilhelmina is nestled in Amsterdam's serene Oud Zuid neighborhood, a coveted area known for its charming, century-old houses along Koninginneweg. A short five-minute stroll takes you to the iconic Vondelpark, a tranquil oasis perfect for joggers, skaters, and cyclists. Oud Zuid is ideal for travelers interested in museums, culture, shopping, and exploring the city on foot. A variety of restaurants and cafes are within easy walking distance, particularly along nearby Cornelius Schuytstraat. Cultural attractions such as the Van Gogh Museum, Rijksmuseum, Modern Art Museum, and Concertgebouw are just a 15-minute walk away, as is the chic PC Hooftstraat shopping area. You can reach these destinations by strolling through Vondelpark or hopping on tram 2 at the Valeriusplein/Koninginneweg stop, just 150 meters from the hotel. This tram also provides direct access to other popular spots like Leidseplein, Dam Square, Prinsengracht, and Amsterdam Central Station. The RAI Exhibition Centre is a quick 10-minute drive. For late check-ins after 7:00 PM, please contact the hotel via email at info@hotelwilhelmina. com or by phone at +31 (0) 20 6625467. Please include your reservation number and name.

91659.description: The Gore is a charming boutique hotel located in the heart of South Kensington, offering 50 unique bedrooms packed with history. Free WiFi is available. All the rooms at The Gore are individually furnished with hand-picked pieces, period pictures and ornate feature beds. All rooms include a flat-screen TV. The Gore contains the iconic Bar 190, the refined 190 Queen's Gate Restaurant and three bespoke event rooms. Bar 190 offers luxurious yet intimate surroundings where guests can unwind and peruse the extensive cocktail list, while at 190 Queen's Gate the gastronomic proposal combines English culinary tradition with contemporary flavours. Just a short walk from Kensington Palace, Hyde Park, the Natural History Museum, the Science Museum, Victoria and Albert Museum, Harrods and the chic designer boutiques of Knightsbridge. The shopping, theatres, sightseeing and nightlife of the West End are just 10 minutes away by bus or Tube. Kensington and Chelsea is a great choice for travellers interested in museums, parks and culture.

91696.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Glyfada, a fashionable area of Athens that is close to the sea and only 200 m from the nearest sandy beach. Due to it being one of the trendiest neighbourhoods of the city it is a great place where to experience the exciting nightlife and also to mix it up with a little resort-like atmosphere. Guests will be within a walking distance from some busy bars, open-air restaurants and great entertainment venues. The city centre of Athens, the airport and the main port of Piraeus are all within a 30-minute drive, while the Elliniko Exhibition Centre is only 2km away. The fashionable hotel itself offers beautifully appointed guestrooms, which combine style and functionality in order to ensure that its guests will be perfectly relaxed.

91701.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 180 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers.

name.content: Vista Playa de Oro All Inclusive

91736.description: This hotel is set overlooking Miramar Beach, in Manzanillo. It lies just a short distance away from a number of shops and restaurants. This charming property offers visitors tastefully-styled guest rooms, which are simplistic in style. The hotel ensures a truly enjoyable, relaxing stay. It also offers a seemingly boundless range of facilities and services, attending to the needs of every type of traveller. Young guests will be pleased by the playground and kids' club. Delightful dining options are just waiting to be enjoyed.

91756.description: This hotel is situated in Lisse, on the outskirts of Amsterdam. It enjoys a very central location nearby the beach, the airport and Keukenhof. Guests will find restaurants, bars, nightspots, links to the public transport network and shops all within 500 m of the hotel. This is the perfect home from home. This family friendly city hotel comprises a total of 42 rooms and offers public WLAN/Internet access and a conference room. Further facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and 24-hour check-in/check out service, a cloakroom, a lift, a bar and parking. Guests may choose from a selection of 3 different rooms: from standard rooms with a shower, WC, colour TV and a phone to fully equipped Junior Suites (1 floor) and Senior Suites (2 floors) which include such extras as a bathtub and a kitchenette. Furthermore, a hairdryer, a radio, Internet access, a king-size or double bed, heating and a safe are provided in all accommodation as standard. The nearest golf course is only 3 km away. Guests may select their breakfast from a continental buffet.

91758.description: This charming, small hotel is conveniently located a short 3-minute walk from Amsterdam's vibrant Leidseplein, offering a variety of restaurants, bars, and nightclubs. World-renowned museums, such as the Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum, are also within walking distance. Explore the city with ease, thanks to nearby public transportation options, including canal boat tours. The hotel features 20 cozy rooms with shared shower and toilet facilities.

91759.description: Located in Amsterdam West, Sara's Boutique Hotel is a short walk from Leidseplein and just minutes from the vibrant cultural scene of Amsterdam, including the Internationaal Theater Amsterdam, DeLaMar Theater, and Melkweg. This 4-star hotel offers 19 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and cable programming. Enjoy rainfall showers and designer toiletries in the modern bathrooms. Additional amenities include bicycle rentals, a television in the common area, express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS) is approximately 9 miles from the hotel.

91760.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and a cozy lobby fireplace at Hotel Sint Nicolaas. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) at the on-site café, and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge in the evening. Each of the 27 individually decorated guestrooms features a pillowtop bed, flat-screen TV, iPod docking station, and in-room safe. Bicycle rentals are available for exploring the heart of Amsterdam. Located within a 10-minute walk of Dam Square and The 9 Streets, this eco-certified hotel offers convenient access to nearby attractions like the Anne Frank House and Amsterdam Museum. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and safe deposit box.

91762.description: Located in Barcelona's vibrant 22@ district, this contemporary hotel is ideal for business travelers. It boasts a gym and a rooftop terrace with a pool offering stunning city views. Just steps from Llacuna and Poblenou metro stations, it provides easy access to the city center and other areas. The CCIB Convention Centre is within walking distance, and Barcelona El Prat Airport is 20 km away. This hotel, near the beach, offers 224 bright and spacious rooms, each equipped with amenities for both business and leisure travelers, including individual air conditioning, a TV with international channels, a safe, a desk, an exercise bike, a phone, and a full-length mirror. Guests can also enjoy a range of facilities, such as the rooftop pool, gym, work areas, and multi-purpose event rooms.

91807.description: Centric Buenos Aires Holiday Inn Express in Puerto MaderoWhen searching for hotels in Buenos Aires, Argentina, look no further than the Holiday Inn Express® Puerto Madero Hotel. Centrally located in the Puerto Madero district, a repurposed historic area in downtown Buenos Aires, this hotel offers an outstanding location and amenities convenient for business and leisure travelers alike. The hotel is less than ten minutes to the Torres Catalinas, home to businesses like IBM and Microsoft. On Puerto Madero, and within walking distance of the hotel, you will find a variety of restaurants and nightlife options. You can go shopping to the nearby Galerías Pacífico or Patio Bullrich or visit the Casa Rosada, that houses the presidential office and features guided tours. Our guests enjoy comfortable accommodations and complimentary amenities such as a daily Express Breakfast Buffet and high-speed Internet access. Guests can also exercise at the Fitness Center while enjoying views to the Río de la Plata, and find a convenient working area at the Business Center.

91833.description: The NH Milano 2 Residence hotel is a perfect place for a home away from home. The hotel is in an exclusive residential area of Milan, just 7km from the center. This is a quiet spot in a picturesque area with a village feel offering lovely views over a park and lake, great for jogging or cycling. At the same time, Milan's city center can be reached in 30 minutes by car. NH Milano 2 Residence has 50 rooms and 84 apartments. Each one has a relaxed atmosphere with a decor of warm fall colors. Every space comes with satellite TV and free Wi-Fi, while apartments have a kitchenette and access to a laundry room. There are one, two, and three-bedroom apartments available and the luxury ones have lovely views over the lake. For breakfast, lunch, and dinner, head to the NH Milano 2 hotel next door, where you can enjoy the extensive breakfast buffet, as well as classic Italian cuisine the rest of the day. We have a self-service Open Bar for snacks. The NH Milano 2 hotel welcomes our guests to use the gym and the outdoor terrace for relaxation, as well as the 10 meeting rooms for up to 330 people.

91855.description: Enjoy stunning rooftop terrace views at Hotel Flor Parks, centrally located in Barcelona, steps from La Rambla and a short walk from the Cathedral. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and wired internet access. The hotel offers 26 guestrooms with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and ensuite bathrooms featuring rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Guests can dine at the onsite restaurant, VIA 70, with its bar/lounge, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Additional amenities include concierge services, a computer station, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available (subject to charges).

91856.description: The Zentral Castellana Norte Hotel, located in Madrid's vibrant northern business district, offers convenient access to the A-1, M-11, M-40, M-30, A-2, and R-2 highways. Just five minutes from the IFEMA exhibition center and 10 minutes from Madrid Barajas Airport, its prime location is ideal for business travelers. Guests will also appreciate the easy access to the city center via the nearby Fuente de la Mora train station. The hotel features modern, soundproofed rooms equipped with comfortable 210 cm beds, perfect for a restful stay. For business needs, the hotel provides three meeting rooms with a capacity of up to 130 people, Wi-Fi, and a private covered car park. Additional amenities include satellite TV and convenient access to metro and bus lines, as well as a direct train to the airport. Enjoy a comfortable and convenient stay at the Zentral Castellana Norte Hotel during your visit to Madrid.

91918.description: ocated in Bogotá's most dynamic financial and business district, this exclusive property is the ideal base for exploring this impressive region. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, it is next to the city's historic center, home to numerous museums, and La Candelaria, a traditional and colorful neighborhood in downtown Bogotá. El Dorado International Airport is a 30-minute drive away.

91922.description: Choose the Park Inn by Radisson Berrini for a comfortable, cost-effective stay near the business and financial districts. Our central location places you within easy reach of destinations like Ibirapuera Park, Iguatemi Sao Paulo, the Sao Paulo Museum of Art, and the Congonhas Airport. For seamless transportation to local shopping centers, ask about our shuttle service. Start each day on a high note with a free breakfast at Lucca Restaurant, our on-site eatery, and return later for lunch and dinner. Free WiFi throughout the hotel makes it easy to stay connected with the office or research your next outing. If you are meeting with local clients, take advantage of our extensive event facilities. To unwind after a busy day, visit our rooftop fitness center and sauna for superb views of the city skyline or stop by our bar for a round of drinks. Our affordable guest rooms include a flat-screen TV, a minibar, and a large workstation. Pets Allowed. Pet Charge 100. 00 BRL Per Pet, Per Night. Pet limit 2 Pets Per Room. Max 15 Kilograms. We emphasize that the contracted daily rate is for 24 hours, with check-in from 2 p. m. and check-out until 12 p. m. The interval of up to 3 hours between guests' departure and arrival is provided for in MTur Ordinance No. 28 and is intended exclusively for cleaning, sanitizing, and tidying up the unit, ensuring the maintenance of our standard of excellence.

91923.description: Located in one of São Paulo's most exclusive neighbourhoods, Itaim Bibi, this hotel is the perfect starting point for travellers on both, business and leisure. The hotel is very close to various shopping centres, bars, clubs and restaurants. Decorated by architect Joao Armentano, rooms are equipped with minibars, cable TV, and free Internet access. The hotel has a restaurant specialized in international cuisine, which serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, and 24-hour room service is available.

91924.description: This hotel is located in a very sophisticated area of Sao Paulo, surrounded by a plethora of daytime and evening entertainment, close to Brigadeiro Faria Lima Avenue, Ibirapuera Park and Iguatemi Shopping Mall. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, lift access, a cafe, a bar, a restaurant, conference facilities and Wi-Fi. Guests may also take advantage of the 24-hour room service and a laundry service is also available (charges apply to both). Those arriving by car will find a car park and garage parking (both for an additional fee).

91925.description:
Welcome to Intercity Paulista, the perfect choice for those who value comfort and an excellent location. 
Located in the heart of São Paulo, the hotel is just one block from Paulista Avenue, close to the city's main business districts and cultural attractions, with easy access to Congonhas and Guarulhos airports. 
To ensure your comfort and leisure, Intercity Paulista offers excellent facilities, including cozy accommodations, a heated swimming pool, a dry sauna, and a restaurant serving outstanding cuisine. 
Experience the best of São Paulo and feel right at home at your Intercity hotel.

91944.description: The hotel is situated approximately 8 minutes walking distance from the Ringstrasse - home to many famous Viennese buildings including the State Opera House, the Imperial Palace of the Hofburg and the Austrian Parliament. All major tourist sights are within walking distance, and the property is situated very close to Spittelberg. It is set in a romantic pedestrian zone with beautiful buildings and restaurants. Facilities on offer include 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, lift access, a breakfast room and free Wi-Fi.

91946.description: The PLAZA Inn Wien Gasometer offers modern furnishings and 152 double or twin rooms. All guest rooms are equipped with air conditioning, 43-inch TV, telephone, free Wi-Fi and a bathroom with shower or bathtub and WC. Sports enthusiasts can let off steam in the hotel's own fitness centre, while business travellers can use one of the 3 seminar rooms for meetings and conferences. A rich breakfast buffet awaits you in our breakfast restaurant and our bar serves local wines, drinks, coffee specialities and hot snacks. The restored gas tanks that give the area its name, the Gasometer City, are around 200 metres away on foot. You can reach us directly by car in 3 minutes from the St. Marx motorway exit (A21)From Vienna Central Station take the underground line U1 to Stephansplatz, then change to the underground line U3 to Gasometer. Breakfast: 18€ per person. Parking: 7. 50€ per night. Pets are accommodated against a supplement of 20€ per pet/per day

91993.description: Located just outside the city center, a mere 10-minute drive away, this charming hotel offers a heated outdoor pool in winter and convenient access to nearby attractions. Restaurants and bars are within 1 km, shops are 2 km away, and nightlife spots are 4 km from the property. Marrakech train station is approximately 5 km away, with taxis readily available in front of the hotel and a bus stop a 10-minute walk away. For those seeking coastal relaxation, the nearest beach is approximately 171 km away. Golf courses and Menara Airport are both within a 15-minute drive of the hotel. Built in 2005, the hotel's architecture evokes the charm of a southern Kasbah, featuring large cob walls, an interior patio, and a tranquil fountain. The property comprises three riads, each housing six suites, accessible through a tower containing two royal suites. Each of the four buildings boasts a private swimming pool, private gardens, and private terraces on each floor.

92002.description: Surrounded by museums, shops, cafés, restaurants, galleries and all the unique attractions which Amsterdam has to offer, makes this venue the perfect hub for exploring the city. Located in the heart of Amsterdam, on the Singel Gracht, it is within biking distance from pretty much all its important landmarks. The establishment is a brand-new design hotel which was created under the watchful eye of the award-winning Dutch designer Edward van Vliet, he personally took care of the design, collaborating with the owners on the selection of materials, colours and decorations in order to create a truly unique venue. The rooms combine Zen-like tranquillity with an elegant Dutch touch and all the modern conveniences which one can expect.

92073.description: The hotel is in the heart of Brussels, near the Gare Central, within easy reach of Brussels' shopping and business districts, as well as the city's entertainment spots and restaurants. The hotel is surrounded by the top tourist sites in Brussels and is extremely well-connected for reaching the European institutions: the hotel is five minutes from Rue de la Loi. The hotel is located a 5-minute walk from the Magritte Museum and Grand Place. Lots of restaurants and bars are located in the immediate surroundings.

92074.description: Located in the heart of Brussels, this hotel is within walking distance of several attractions, including Brussels Central Station (384 meters), the Royal Palace (475 meters), Egmont Palace (416 meters), and Sablon Church (236 meters). The contemporary rooms feature minimalist touches, with a closet and desk for guests who need to work. Tea and coffee making facilities are also provided. The hotel offers a 24-hour reception, a modern-style pool, a sauna, and Wi-Fi throughout.

92077.description: This hotel is located at the foot of La Grande Arche in the city centre of the French capital. It is next to Parc du Millénaire, where guests can take a relaxed walk or a leisurely jog in this green haven. Those who are looking for bustling shops or fine restaurants should just explore the surrounding area and they will surely find some excellent offbeat places or famous Michelin-decorated establishments. Arguably the most famous street in the world - Les Champs Elysees is just a 20-minute bus ride away. The modern hotel is perfect for those who want a little extra space while travelling. The accommodation units range from two-bedroom apartments to spacious studios, both of which open to private balconies for some added airiness and extra natural light.

92078.description: With it's elegant 18th century style façade this residence is located in the same area as the Parisian department stores, the Garnier opera house, the Madeleine church, and just a step away from the theaters and the Grands Boulevards. Right in one of the liveliest areas of the city, where culture and business meet, you can quickly get to the Opera square with its majestic buildings and busy business district. Also take advantage of the proximity of Paris' famous monuments, and go see the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, Montmartre, Place de la Concorde, and the Champs Elysées.

92172.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Additional features at this hotel include gift shops/newsstands, a fireplace in the lobby, and discounted use of a nearby fitness facility. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Make yourself at home in one of the 38 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and plasma televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Cromwell Road - 0. 1 km / 0.

92179.description: The hotel is situated in an exceptional location next to Syntagma Square and opposite the National Garden and the House of Parliament. It is near to the Acropolis, and the historical centre and Plaka is a short and pleasant walk away. The hotel features a minimalist décor and offers modern hospitality and high-quality services. Guests are welcomed in a reception hall with 24-hour reception, and a lobby lounge, a restaurant, the banquet/conference halls, and the roof-top garden with a stunning view of Athens, are just a few of the facilities that the hotel provides.

92180.description: This city-hotel is located in the historical triangle of Athens, only 50 m from Syntagma Square and close to all the main sights and monuments of the city. Just a short stroll around the area will take its guests to the Parliament, Plaka and the Temple of Olympian Zeus or the business centre. Restaurants, bars, links to public transport, the bus and train stations, an underground station and shopping opportunities can all be found in the vicinity. This is the place for everyone who had dreamt of waking up to the magnificent view of the ancient Acropolis Hill. For an even better vista of the hill and the city skyline its guests can head to the top-floor Bella Vista restaurant, where they can dine on delicious Greek and international dishes, sip on some outstanding wine and enjoy its refined atmosphere and pleasant airiness.

92184.description: Pamper yourself with onsite facials or enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Grab a bite to eat at Main Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. This hotel has 3 meeting rooms available for events. Make yourself at home in one of the 99 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Omonoia Square - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- National Theatre of Greece - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Athens City Hall - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- National Archaeological Museum - 0. 6 km / 0. 3 mi- Athens Central Market - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Academy of Athens - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Pedion Areos Park - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Ermou Street - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Adrianou Street - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Monastiraki Flea Market - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Hadrian's Library - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Metropolitan Cathedral of Athens - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Roman Agora - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Mount Lycabettus - 1. 4 km / 0. 8 mi- Tomb of the Unknown Soldier - 1. 4 km / 0. 8 mi. The preferred airport for Polis Grand Hotel is Athens Intl. Airport (ATH) - 40. 6 km / 25. 2 miA stay at Polis Grand Hotel places you in the heart of Athens, within a 15-minute walk of Ermou Street and Monastiraki Flea Market. This hotel is 1. 1 mi (1. 7 km) from Syntagma Square and 1. 7 mi (2. 7 km) from Acropolis.

92248.description: Ideally located in the heart of Athens and within walking distance to main of the city's main attractions, the Acropolis Select Hotel is the perfect place to stay during your next visit to Greece's capital. A short stroll from the hotel places guests at the ancient site of the Acropolis, the New Acropolis Museum, and the Plaka District while other major landmarks such as Syntagma Square, the Temple of Olympian Zeus, and the Flee Market as well as the city's shopping hotspots are within easy reach. The property is a stone's throw away from metro, tram, and bus stations, making traveling around the city and its beach suburbs very convenient. This 72-room hotel has recently undergone renovation, fitted with elegant Italian design furniture, fine German fabrics, and original pieces of art inspired by ancient Greece, which adds to its modern, stylish décor and welcoming ambiance. American buffet breakfast is served daily and there is free Wi-Fi access (VDSL) in all public areas. The on-site rooftop restaurant, 180 West, serves snacks and Mediterranean cuisine and offers Acropolis views.

92258.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace at the Acropolis View Hotel in Athens City Centre. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel offers a coffee shop/café, snack bar/deli, and a bar/lounge for your dining and refreshment needs. The 32 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions, refrigerators, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. Additional amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. The Acropolis View Hotel is within a 10-minute walk of the Odeon of Herodes Atticus and Filopappos Hill, and a short distance from the Acropolis Museum and the Temple of Olympian Zeus.

92263.description: Divani Escape is located in the Vouliagmeni neighborhood in Athens, just 16. 1 km from Piraeus. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant. Free WiFi is available throughout the property and private parking is available on site. Every room includes a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Certain units include a sitting area where you can relax. All rooms are fitted with a private bathroom. For your comfort, you will find bathrobes, slippers and free toiletries. You will find free shuttle service at the property. The hotel also provides car rental. Aegina Town is 30. 6 km from Divani Apollon Suites, and Póros is 46. 7 km away. The nearest airport is Eleftherios Venizelos Airport, 19. 3 km from Divani Apollon Suites.

92294.description: This is an exclusive luxury resort set on 72 acres of a lush green private peninsula with numerous idyllic magical sandy coves and encircled by the blue waters of the Aegean Sea. It is 60 minutes from the vibrant city of Athens and 20 minutes from Eleftherios Venizelos International Airport. A perfectly designed sanctuary for those looking for a relaxing holiday, this tranquil resort offers the opportunity to enjoy the ultimate in accommodation, dining and leisure activities. There are a total of 273 accommodation units at this club resort that was fully renovated in 2010. Guests are welcomed in the lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services. The resort includes a currency exchange facility, café, mini shops, a bar, conference room with modern audiovisual equipment, a dining room and high-speed wireless Internet access in common areas (extra fee). Room and laundry services as well as a car park and garage are available for additional fees. Further facilities include air conditioning, a hotel safe, lift access to the upper floors, a newspaper stand, hairdressing salon and a TV lounge. The rooms are very bright and elegant with a contemporary design. All rooms offer an in-room safe, terry bathrobes and slippers in the marble en suite bathroom with hairdryer, shower and bath, as well as air conditioning, heating, a safe and twice-daily maid service. Some other services and facilities are available for an extra fee, such as 24-hour room service, a multi-line direct dial telephone with voicemail, wired and wireless high-speed Internet access, satellite TV, video-on-demand and the fully stocked minibar. The accommodation units feature panoramic sea views and a private balcony. Double or king-size beds are available.

92296.description: Vincci EverEden 4* hotel is located on the Athenian Riviera, known for its fantastic beaches and strategic location. The estate where the property is located, with 45, 000 m2, extends over a hillside, among a beautiful pine forest. With 259 rooms spread out over three buildings, the hotel has direct access to the idyllic EverEden beach, where you can go diving or do water sports, relax in the sun on its comfortable loungers or enjoy a fun Aqua Park in the sea. The hotel's swimming pools with panoramic views, relaxing Spa Centre, modern Fitness Centre and exquisite dining options at its different bars and restaurants allow you to have a true Vincci experience in this idyllic setting overlooking the Saronic Gulf. With all the amenities, this space becomes the best option to make any celebration or event an unforgettable day. A meeting place equipped with the latest technology can only be improved if it is bathed in natural light and framed by beautiful views. Vincci EverEden 4*, provides all the comforts and is the best choice to organize an event or your unforgettable vacations.

92299.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include a television in a common area and a picnic area. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Art Hotel. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and multilingual staff. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 14 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and blackout drapes/curtains. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Villa XXV Aprile - 0. 6 km / 0.

92374.description: Only a 5-minute walk from Vondelpark and Leidseplein, this 3-star boutique hotel features a courtyard garden with a seating deck. The simple yet functional rooms feature a TV and a modern bathroom. Guests can make use of a computer with free internet in the lobby. Hotel Alexander has a 24-hour reception, a tour desk and a bicycle rental service. Set on a quiet street, Hotel Alexander is 400 metres from the Leidseplein tram and bus stops. The Van Gogh Museum and the Rijksmuseum are only a 10-minute walk away. The PC Hooftstraat, famous for its luxury boutiques, is just a short walk away. Guests have the possible to park their car at a public location nearby at a surcharge.

92437.description: This hotel is situated in a small and peaceful town of Hauts d'Andilly, surrounded by green. This charming town is but a short drive along the banks of the Seine away from the main economic centre of France, being only 18 km from the business district of La Défense and close to the famous spa resort of Enghien-les-Bains. This residence offers apartments in a luxury 2-storey building with function room and breakfast service in a superb setting on the edge of the forest.

92513.address: Cankurtaran Mah Bayram Firini Sok No 3 Sultanahmet, 3
92513.description: The hotel is nestled in a beautiful and historic part of the city, in Sultanahmet. Within easy reach guests will be able to find a variety of historic attractions such as, Topkapi Palace, The Ayasofya Museum and Sultanahmet Mosque. The Grand Bazaar and other touristic attractions are also reachable on foot. Istanbul's international airport is about 17 km from the hotel.

92601.description:
This hotel is located 700 m from the sea in the heart of Piraeus marine commercial zone, 1 km from the city centre. Guests will find all they need in the vicinity: links to the public transport network (50 m), shops (500 m), bars (700 m), nightclubs (800 m) and restaurants (1 km). It is also near to the port, the Piraeus Exhibition Centre (Piraeus' Port Organisation) and the Karaiskaki and Peace & Friendship stadiums.

The recently refurbished hotel ensures guests a relaxing and unforgettable stay in a hospitable and recreational atmosphere. It is convenient for both business travellers and leisure tourists travelling to the Greek islands and comprises a total of 91 luxury rooms, 2 suites and 6 studios. All the hotel's communal spaces offer WiFi Internet access (charges apply) and further facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area, a hotel safe, a bar and a restaurant.

All the hotel's accommodation is fully air-conditioned and features satellite TV, a private bathroom with a shower, high-speed Internet access (ADSL), a safe, a minibar and a hairdryer. Furthermore, a direct dial telephone and individually adjustable heating are provided in all accommodation as standard.

This hotel offers bed and breakfast stays.

92625.description: Conveniently located a short walk from the Canary Wharf financial hub, this hotel is an ideal base for guests working in the area. The nearest underground station is just 8 minutes on foot from this city-hotel. Guests will find numerous restaurants, bars and shopping facilities right on its doorstep. London Heathrow is the nearest international airport, just 37 km away. The hotel comprises 96 elegant executive apartments, showcasing the best of contemporary design and furnishings. Each apartment offers magnificent views over Canary Wharf, the River Thames and a marina fronted by the O2 Dome. Corporate travellers will find convenience in the hotel's business centre and the Internet access provided. Parking facilities are available for those arriving by car.

92664.description: Spend the day on the private beach or dip into one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Grab a bite to eat at Kalak, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the poolside bar. Local cuisine breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available on request), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 111 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

92666.description: The welcoming Concord Callao By Recoleta apartments is excellently located in the heart of the elegant and secure area of Recoleta in the Argentinian capital. It features comfortable and modern studios apartments. Numerous shops, banks and restaurants can be found in the surroundings. Attractions such as the Water Company Palace, Cervantes Theatre and Colón Theatre are within a short stroll; famous Calle Florida street, Plaza de Mayo or Casa Rosada are easily reachable.

92800.description: With a stay at Attalos Hotel, you'll be centrally located in Athens, within a 10-minute walk of Ancient Agora of Athens and Monastiraki Flea Market. This hotel is 1 mi (1. 6 km) from Hellenic Parliament and 1. 4 mi (2. 2 km) from National Archaeological Museum. Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Make yourself at home in one of the 78 guestrooms featuring refrigerators. Your Select Comfort bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired Internet access, a 24-hour business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Ermou Street - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Church Of Agia Irini - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Athens Central Market - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Hadrian's Library - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Athens City Hall - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- Adrianou Street - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- Ancient Agora of Athens - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Metropolitan Cathedral of Athens - 0. 6 km/0. 3 mi- Monastiraki Flea Market - 0. 6 km/0. 3 mi- Roman Agora - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Tower of the Winds - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Acropolis - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Stoa of Attalos - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Omonoia Square - 0. 7 km/0. 5 mi- Temple of Hephaestos - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi. The preferred airport for Attalos Hotel is Athens Intl. Airport (ATH) - 34. 2 km/21. 3 mi.

92835.description: Just 5 minutes from Asnières train station, the Ibis Styles Asnières Centre Hotel is ideal for reaching the capital's major points of interest and exploring the sights of the City of Lights. The Ibis Styles Asnières Centre offers 60 functional and comfortable rooms, equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi and televisions. There is also a bar and a terrace. Breakfast and unlimited Wi-Fi are included in all prices.

92848.description: The word “Calmo” comes from Portugese and means tranquility, silence, calm down. We want to reflect the quiet location of the hotel and the relaxed atmosphere of the inner courtyard to our guests. Our rooms give an insight into the tile art of the classic Portuguese style. Further details of the “Calmo Vida” can be found throughout the hotel. Hotel Calmo is designed to give both business and leisure travelers the peace and quiet they need. Hotel Calmo provides guests with an excellent location for exploring Vienna. The hotel offers convenient access to some of Vienna's most famous attractions, cultural landmarks, and shopping areas. Whether you want to take leisurely walks along historic streets, explore world-class museums, or savor local cuisine at nearby restaurants, Hotel Calmo serves as an ideal launching point for your Vienna adventure. Breakfast is offered for 14€ per person.

92851.description: Located only a short walk from the city centre and the Wien-Mitte railway station and transportation hub, it is the perfect choice for anyone looking for convenience and comfort. It sits just a 5-minute walk from the Viennese City Park and within easy access of all of the main attractions which the Austrian capital has to offer. The elegant apartment hotel comprises a total of 50 suites for business and leisure travellers seeking an alternative to traditional hotel accommodation. The units provide a chic and personalised atmosphere, ideal for relaxing after a day of sightseeing or working. They all come with fully-equipped kitchens and separate living and sleeping areas. Guests who want to truly unwind can head to the onsite sauna or maintain their work-out regiment at the well-equipped gym.

92942.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Manhattan, near the fashionable Flatiron district, minutes away from New York's most exciting attractions. The establishment was completely renovated in 2008 and is fully air-conditioned. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception, and facilities include a hotel safe, lift access, breakfast room, 24-hour in-room food delivery service, wireless Internet access, dry cleaning and laundry services, room service, and a parking garage. Effective immediately the SUV and oversize vehicle price for the 2 parking garages the hotel works with (800 6th Avenue and 7-11 W. 28th Street) have changed. Regular size vehicles are $35 per 24 hours and SUVs are now $50 per 24 hours.

92999.description: Close to all major business districts including the Palais des Congrès exhibition centre, this hotel is an outstanding choice when it comes to executive travellers visiting the capital of France. They will be just a 2-minute walk from Rome metro station which gives them a direct line for North, East and St Lazare train station. Those who want to mix a little shopping spree with their travels will be within easy reach of some of the most famous Parisian department stores and many well-loved tourist attractions, including the Louvre, the Moulin Rouge, the Sacré-Coeur and the Champs Elysees. Shuttle service is available to the two Airports and guests can take advantage of it in order to make the 30-minute journey as pleasant and hustle-free as possible.

93013.description: The ibis Amsterdam City West is edgy and convenient, due to its stylish rooms and the easy connection to the city centre and airport. Complimentary WiFi is available throughout the hotel, so your new pictures of Amsterdam can be uploaded right away. All rooms are equipped with a work desk, flat-screen TV, soft Sweet Beds and bathroom with shower. Breakfast is offered every morning, and don't forget about lunch and dinner at ibis. The reception is open 24 hours a day and the hotel is 100% non-smoking.

93077.description: The Flag Hotel Barcelos is located in the historic center of the charming city of Barcelos, in the heart of the Minho region, an area rich in culture and tradition. With a rich architectural heritage, as part of the Way of St. James, and the famous legend of the Rooster of Barcelos—a symbol of Portugal—the hotel is the perfect retreat for those who wish to explore the city’s history and beauty. This 3-star hotel features 37 comfortable rooms, many of which have balconies. Just a 2-minute walk from the shopping district, with stores, cafés, and restaurants, the Flag Hotel Barcelos offers the convenience of being close to everything, yet in a quiet and welcoming atmosphere. If you’re looking to explore the region, you’ll be just 20 km from Braga, Famalicão, and Viana do Castelo, and 40 km from Guimarães, making it the ideal starting point for discovering the Minho region. It’s the perfect choice for leisure stays, pilgrimages, group trips, or business travel, offering a comfortable and convenient stay right in the heart of the city.

93286.description: The Appart'City Paris La Villette aparthotel is located right next to Ourcq metro station (line 5) which serves the Est, Nord and Austerlitz stations. It offers private accommodation with a lift, private parking and free Wi-Fi. Our 84 apartments are furnished and equipped with a lounge area, study area, satellite TV and a kitchen with hob, fridge, microwave and dishes. Our aparthotel is located just 5 minutes from the La Villette Cité des Sciences and 10 minutes from the Zénith concert hall. You can also make the most of your stay by going for a walk in Parc de la Villette, one of the biggest parks in the French capital. Our premises are ideally located just opposite metro line 5, meaning you can access the main points of interest in Paris with ease, whether you prefer the Louvre, Montmartre or the Eiffel Tower.

93309.description: Built in 2007, this golf hotel has 174 rooms in a beautiful setting, surrounded by a lake. The property features a golf club and pro shop on site and has a private beach 400 m from the hotel for which a shuttle service is provided. The large city of Antalya is a 35-minute car ride away and closer to the hotel are the towns of Kadriye and Belek, each 5 minutes from the hotel by car. Public transport and taxis can be found at the main entrance of the hotel. Guests can enjoy the luxurious facilities at this property's sister hotel situated nearby.

93315.description: This hotel is located in Fort Lee, New Jersey, at the George Washington Bridge. It is well placed for easy access to New York City and lies just minutes from Manhattan. A broad range of shopping and dining venues are easily accessible. This city hotel is well-equipped and offers a great alternative to the usual Manhattan hotel prices. The establishment provides superb facilities and convenient access to the whole of New York City and New Jersey. Among the facilities on offer count a business centre with a large meeting room and wireless internet access. All spacious and comfortable rooms are fully-equipped as standard.

93454.description: Fountain Court Apartments - Harris offers 18 one and two-bedroom serviced apartments. They are ideal for up to four people visiting the city for either business or pleasure. Facilities include a 24-hour reception nearby (subject to change), lift access, WiFi access and limited car parking nearby. Parking is chargeable at £15 per night per car and is on a first come first served basis, located at the main check in reception. The apartments offer an open plan lounge/dining area. The fully fitted kitchen comes complete with a dishwasher, fridge, oven, microwave and washing machine. The 2 bedroom apartments come with a double bed and 2 single beds as standard. 2 double beds are available on request. The 1 bedroom apartments have a double bed. All apartments have a bathroom with a shower over bath configuration, hairdryer, selected satellite channels and iron/ironing board. The apartments also have self-controlled heating. The apartments are self-catering, breakfast packs are available to book in advance at an additional fee of £7 per person per night. The breakfast packs are placed in the apartment. Breakfast is not guaranteed for bookings made less than 48 hours prior to arrival. Dogs may be accommodated on request, maximum 2 dogs per apartment (dependant on size). This is chargeable at £15 per dog per night. The apartments shall be serviced every 4 days and additional cleaning can be arranged at an extra charge. Please arrange this directly with Fountain Court. Check in to the apartments is at the main reception located at 121 Grove Street, EH3 8AA. Check in is from 3pm and check out is 10. 30am. Upon arrival, guests must provide the credit/debit card used for the booking. This card will be pre-authorised for GBP 100- 200 for use against any incidental charges, such as damages. Photo ID which matches the name on the card must also be provided. If a guest does not have the card, an alternative payment must be provided and the original card shall be refunded.

93455.description: The apartment hotel is situated in the West End, 2 minutes' walk from the Edinburgh International Conference Centre. Haymarket Station is just across the road and Murrayfield Stadium is a mere 15-minute walk away. The 27 self-catering apartments offer space, flexibility and convenience in the heart of the city, with everything guests may need for a comfortable stay. All units are accessible by lifts and each of them offers a double bedroom and private bathroom. A fully equipped kitchen is provided so that guests can prepare their own meals. A lounge area with Freeview TV, CD player and complimentary WI-FI access serves for entertainment purposes. In each unit guests will find an array of quality appliances, including individually regulated air conditioning units. The apartments shall be serviced every 4 days and additional cleaning can be arranged at an extra charge. Please arrange this directly with Fountain Court.

93473.description: Located in the historic centre of Lisbon, Baixa Pombalina, this hotel is close to the Rossio Squares and opposite the Lisbon Coliseum. Numerous shops, restaurants and bars can be found in the hotel's vicinity. Restauradores and Rossio metro are only a few minutes' walk from the hotel. Lisbon Airport is approximately 6. 4 km from the property. This hotel offers cosy rooms, equipped with air-conditioning, satellite TV and bathroom with shower and toiletries. Some rooms have a seating area and coffee facilities. In the mornings, guests can enjoy a rich buffet breakfast prepared with fresh ingredients. Local dishes are served for lunch and dinner at the restaurant.

93494.description: Nestled at the beginning of arguably the world's most famous beach, Copacabana, this hotel is the perfect choice for anyone visiting Rio de Janeiro. Praia de Copacabana and Rio Sul Mall are both in the immediate vicinity, while Sugarloaf Mountain is about 2 km away. Guests are within a 10- to 15-minute ride from downtown and the main tourist attractions. Dating back to 1950, the hotel has forged a reputation for excellent facilities and courteous service, attracting both business and leisure travelers. The large terrace offers a magnificent view of Flamengo Park, with its wonderful gardens designed by internationally renowned landscape architect, Burle Marx. Guests can enjoy the view while relaxing on the sun loungers around the outdoor pool and enjoying refreshments from the poolside snack bar.

93558.description: This stylish hotel boasts an excellent location on Praça do Marquês de Pombal, overlooking the beautiful Park Eduardo VII. Just steps away, you'll find the famed Avenida da Liberdade, renowned for its elegant shops. The nearby metro station provides easy access to the historic city center, including Praça do Rossio, Praça do Comércio, and the Tagus River. The international airport is also easily accessible. The hotel's interior features bright, cheerful tones, while the charming rooms exude glamour and romance. Each room is equipped with air conditioning, cable TV, and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. For a relaxing experience, guests can unwind in the lobby bar and enjoy the tranquil view of the small, glass-enclosed garden inspired by nature.

93585.address: Saniye Ermutlu Sokak No:3, Kozyatağı Kadıköy
93585.description:
Where Comfort and Elegance Meet in the Heart of the City

Located on the Asian side of Istanbul, in Kozyatağı—the heart of the business world—Byotell Istanbul offers its guests a five-star accommodation experience with its modern architecture, refined details, and exclusive service approach. The hotel’s striking glass-facade high-rise structure provides both business and leisure travelers with a comfortable stay accompanied by panoramic city views. 

Byotell Istanbul enjoys an exceptionally advantageous location in terms of transportation. Situated just a one-minute walk from Kozyatağı Metro Station, the hotel offers easy access to Kadıköy, Üsküdar, and the European side of the city. 

The surroundings of the hotel are enriched by some of Istanbul’s most distinguished shopping and lifestyle centers. City’s Mall Kozyatağı is just a 10-minute walk away, offering a modern concept that blends shopping and social life. Palladium Mall and Emaar Mall, both only a short drive from the hotel, provide luxurious shopping experiences with world-renowned brands and upscale dining options. 

Additionally, Akasya Mall and Hilltown Mall—located just one metro stop away—stand out as popular destinations offering a wide range of shopping and entertainment opportunities. Beyond shopping, the nearby Bağdat Avenue is an ideal stop for guests looking to feel the vibrant spirit of the city, with its boutique stores, cafés, and restaurants. 

Located approximately 25 minutes from Sabiha Gökçen Airport, Byotell Istanbul serves as an excellent starting point for business trips, trade show visits, or city explorations thanks to its central location.

93593.description: NH Collection Brussels Grand Sablon is set on the historic Grand Sablon square and surrounded by antique shops and authentic Belgian chocolatiers. The Grand Place, Royal Museum of Fine Arts, Magritte Museum and Parc de Bruxelles are all a short walk from the hotel. For luxury boutiques and fine dining take a stroll through Avenue Louise, Brussels' famous shopping area. If you wish to explore the city further, take the tram at the Petit Sablon stop or walk to the Central railway station. Rooms at the NH Collection Brussels Grand Sablon feature sophisticated design with a modern touch. Superior and Deluxe Rooms and Suites have a wonderful view of the Grand Sablon Square and Cathedral. In the morning, enjoy a fresh breakfast at the hotel, with a variety of local and international products. Hispania Brasserie by Marcos Moran offers tapas all day, created under the guidance of award winning Chef Marcos Morán. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. There are also 11 compact meeting rooms.

93664.address: Jumeirah Beach Residence, the walk, PO BOX 26525
93664.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 6 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Enjoy international cuisine at La Baie, one of the hotel's 8 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wind down with a drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges or 2 poolside bars. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 32292 square feet (3000 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 10 meeting rooms.

93665.address: Mina Road, Bur Dubai, PO BOX 52700, DUBAI, .
93665.description: This city hotel is 4km from the World Trade Centre and a 15-minute walk from BurJuman Shopping Mall. It's ideal for combining a sunny vacation with world-class shopping, with several major retail outlets a 5-minute drive away and the Meena Bazaar across the road. Deira City Centre, Dubai Creek, and the beach are all within a 10-minute drive. The 7th-floor conference centre offers spectacular views of Dubai and the Gulf, along with state-of-the-art technology and trained staff to facilitate business meetings. After a busy day, guests can dine at The Kohinoor, a Mughlai specialty restaurant serving authentic Indian cuisine in a space adorned with intricate craftsmanship and artifacts from India's royal families.

93771.description: Nestled in the heart of Madrid's Salamanca district on Goya Street, this hotel offers 177 well-appointed rooms, ranging from singles and doubles to superior suites. Seven apartments featuring kitchens, living areas, bedrooms, and bathrooms are also available, accessible through the hotel or a private entrance on Hermosilla Street. Guests can enjoy on-site parking, a gym, a cozy library, and Mediterranean cuisine at the inviting SoMa restaurant. The hotel's prime location places you just moments from Retiro Park, the Prado Museum, and Puerta del Sol. Twelve additional rooms on the first floor offer full hotel services.

name.content: Protea Hotel Fire & Ice Cape Town

93777.description: Pamper yourself with massages, body treatments, and facials. Recreational opportunities include an outdoor pool and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a television in the common area. A shuttle (surcharge) takes guests to the nearby beach or shopping center. Satisfy your appetite at the Fire and Ice Restaurant, which features a bar/lounge. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary daily reception. Full breakfasts are available daily (6:30 AM to 10:30 AM) for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities consist of a conference center and six meeting rooms. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a train station pick-up service. Stay in one of 201 guest rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Bree Street - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi; Long Street - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi; Kloof Street - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi; South African Museum and Planetarium - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi; Company's Garden - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi; Greenmarket Square - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi; Western Cape High Court - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi; Bo Kaap Museum - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi; Christian Barnard Hospital - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi; South African National Gallery - 1 km/0. 6 mi; South Africa Library - 1 km/0. 6 mi; Adderley Street - 1 km/0. 6 mi; St. Georges Mall - 1 km/0. 7 mi; Cape Floral Region Protected Areas - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi; Parliament of South Africa - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi.

93815.description: This luxurious hotel is located in a quiet area close to the historical heart of Vienna, only a few minutes walking distance from the magnificent Ringstrasse and Vienna State Opera, as well as fine restaurants, bars and cafes. Vienna Airport is 24 km away. The hotel's warmly decorated rooms and suites represent a stylish blend of turn-of-the-century architecture and modern amenities. The comfortable, air-conditioned rooms offer docking stations for external media, tea & coffee facilities and are appointed with fine decorating fabrics, exquisite furniture and high-quality beds. The elegant, bar is an inviting place to relax and enjoy company within a cultivated atmosphere, especially after a long day of sightseeing or business meetings.

93954.address: Rue De La Tour D Auvergne, 34 Ter
93954.description: Enjoying a fabulous setting in heart of the trendy 9th arrondissement of Paris , near Montmartre and the Opéra Garnier, this enchanting city hotel is a perfect place for all those looking for comfortable accommodation and quality service. It lies in a quiet district with a rich artistic and historical heritage. Guests will find a host of restaurants and bars just 200 m from the hotel and links to the public transport network including Pigalle and Anvers metro station, both within 550 metres from the property. It is 10 minutes on foot to the Sacré Coeur, Galeries Lafayette is a 15-minute walk and the Louvre Museum is 20 minutes' walk away. The cosy rooms and suites feature charming décor blending elegance with warm hues. All of them are fitted with modern furniture and top-notch amenities to provide everything needed to ensure a memorable stay.

93955.description: This charming hotel sits right in the centre of Piraeus, with its beautiful port, promenade and the University just a 5-minute walk away. It is perfectly connected with the rest of the city and the Airport thanks to the bus and metro station that sits just 200 metres from it. The hotel itself is one of the new landmark buildings that inhabit the prestigious block of the business district of Greece's biggest port. Its unique architecture combines elements of the neoclassical style with modern building design in order to create a delightful mix of classical worldly charm and comfortable modernity. It is a great place for all executive travellers due to its excellent conference and business facilities. After a day of meetings they can head to the relaxed onsite bar for a pleasant chat and a chilled drink.

93956.description: This hotel is located not far from the business centre of Maroussi. Cafés, restaurants, a variety of shops and the Kifissia Park are all within a 5-minute walk of the hotel. The train station is a 15-minute walk from the hotel, which is 15 km from the city centre and 6 km from the Olympic Stadium. Athens International Airport is some 32 km away. This theme hotel has a total of 13 accommodation units and is an impressive 19th century mansion with a remarkable aristocratic atmosphere. Recently renovated, it offers a high standard of facilities and services. The first impression of the hotel that guests receive is the reception, which features a VIP check-in service, hotel safe, and lift access. Just beside the reception, the coffee and dessert service in the lobby lounge is available all day long. There is a cosy garden area and a hot tub on the rooftop. Guests can also make use of the business centre for meetings and presentations for a small number of people. Further services offered by the hotel include WIFI access throughout the establishment, as well as a 24-hour concierge service. A breakfast room and a café feature, and room and laptop rental services are also provided. A CD library, laundry services and newspapers (free of charge) are additional amenities. The hotel features 13 suites, each one with an authentic theme inspired by areas around the world. All of them offer two main rooms with individually regulated air conditioning and heating units, double glazed windows and king-size beds. There is also a spacious sitting room and a kitchenette. A minibar, Internet access and an office and dining table feature, in addition to a balcony and a direct dial telephone with a voicemail service. Further features include a hairdryer, electronic safe and a satellite TV, as well as a CD player, soundproofing, slippers and robes, natural toiletries and a variety of types of pillow.

93958.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a health club and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite to eat at Bel Ami Bar, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Paris? This hotel has 2368 square feet (220 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 102 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

93978.description: Located in the heart of Barcelona's vibrant Born district, these modern loft-style apartments and studios offer a unique blend of comfort and functionality. Guests are surrounded by artisan boutiques, art galleries, and trendy tapas bars, while also enjoying easy access to shopping centers like Maremagnum. Each of the 19 units features a comfortable bedroom, a lounge/dining room with a work desk, and a fully equipped open-plan kitchen. Enjoy natural Mediterranean light in the exterior-facing rooms and entertainment with the provided TVs. Guests also receive free entry to the Barcelona Egyptian Museum. Barcelona Airport is approximately 14 km away. Note: Reception and key handover are available daily from 10:30 am to 6:30 pm. An additional reception is open from 10:00 am to 1:00 am at 60 Muntaner Street. A €350 security deposit is required upon arrival and check-in is at 3:00 pm.

94006.description:
Blue Wave Suite Hotel is a family-friendly all-inclusive hotel located in the lively Oba district of Alanya. Its proximity to the city's most popular attractions makes it an excellent choice for guests who wish to combine their holiday with exploring the city. The hotel is located 2 km from Alanya city center, 37 km from Gazipaşa Airport, and 125 km from Antalya Airport. Thanks to its central location, Alanyum Shopping Center, the weekly local market, cafés, and restaurants are all within easy reach. 

Blue Wave Suite Hotel has been designed with families in mind. With its modern aquapark, playground, kids club, game room, and all-day entertainment programs, it offers a fun-filled holiday experience for both children and adults. 

We look forward to welcoming you to Blue Wave Suite Hotel for a holiday where children make new friends, families enjoy quality time together, and unforgettable memories are created.

94007.description: Crystal Flora Pear Collection is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Antalya. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Facilities like free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, Wi-Fi in public areas, car park are readily available for you to enjoy. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like television LCD/plasma screen, carpeting, internet access – wireless (complimentary), air conditioning, heating. Access to the hotel's private beach, fitness center, sauna, outdoor pool, indoor pool will further enhance your satisfying stay. Discover all Antalya has to offer by making Crystal Flora your base.

94008.description: The Aramunt Apartments offer modern, stylish studios a 10-minute walk from Passeig de Gràcia Metro Station. Located in the heart of Eixample, the property features a small outdoor pool and is within walking distance of elegant boulevards and chic boutiques. Apartments accommodate two to four people and feature air conditioning, a kitchenette with a washer-dryer and dishwasher, a dining area, and a seating area with a flat-screen TV and a double sofa bed. The bathroom includes a shower, hairdryer, and complimentary toiletries. Guests enjoy free access to the Barcelona Egyptian Museum. Stays of six nights or more include a general cleaning service. Guests are requested to ensure the kitchen is clean upon departure. Please contact the hotel by phone or email at least 48 hours before arrival to arrange check-in and key collection. Only two apartments can be booked at a time. Three or more apartments are considered a group booking and are subject to different cancellation policies. A €350 security deposit will be charged upon arrival. Registration and key collection take place between 10:00 AM and 1:00 AM in the same building as the Aramunt Apartments, at 60 Muntaner Street. Check-in is at 3:00 PM.

94023.description: 'This boutique hotel is conveniently located in the heart of Mumbai's famous Juhu beach area. The railway station is located 8 kms away. It takes about 20 minutes to reach the domestic airport and it takes approximately 30 minutes to reach the hotel from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport. The hotel has its very own night club with DJs playing on Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays only. Additionally the hotel offers: gym, an outdoor swimming pool, a sauna, a solarium, a steam room and massage treatments. The 24-hour coffee shop Rhythm & Blues is located at the lobby level and serves buffet breakfast, lunch and dinner. There is also a specialty Indian Restaurant located on the hotel rooftop. The Lobby Bar serves a range of cocktails, wines and spirits. This hotel is the perfect destination for a convenient and comfortable visit to Mumbai. '

94024.address: Juhu Tara Road, Juhu, Mumbai, Maharashtra
94024.description: 'This hotel is located in Juhu, an upmarket location in Mumbai. It lies 2 kms from Bandra with its shops and is also very close to the Bandra-Kurla Commercial Complex, the Bandra-Kurla Exhibition Grounds and the Bombay Exhibition Centre, Goregaon. The domestic airport is only 7 kms away and the international airport is just 8 kms from the hotel. It comprises a total of 85 exquisitely furnished guest rooms to suit the individual requirements of corporate, leisure and individual travelers, as well as families travelling to Mumbai. Sports enthusiasts may enjoy a workout in the gym. The hotel has a well-stocked bar where guests can enjoy a beer or a choice of the best of wines. The hotel's coffee shop offers breakfast, lunch and dinner. The hotel also features The Sapphire restaurant which serves multi-cuisine vegetarian food. Stay at this hotel and experience the real Mumbai ambiance. '

94053.address: Ebusuud Cad No 2 Gulhane Parki Tarafi, 2
94053.description: This charming establishment has an excellent location overlooking Gulhane Park, Topkapi Palace and the Bosphorus. It is housed in an old town house in the historic district of the city, which was converted to a hotel in 2002. The decor and furnishings are stylish and elegant and the hotel offers a restaurant, terrace bar and friendly, multilingual staff. Guests are welcomed to the many facilities and amenities on site, such as the café and pub. The top floor terrace provides a magnificent view over the Bosphorus and Topkapi Palace. The elegantly styled and cosy rooms are individually themed and fully fitted with air conditioning and central heating. An LCD satellite TV and wireless Internet access also feature in rooms as standard.

94054.description: Conveniently situated in the Sultanahmet district of the Turkish capital of Istanbul, this elegant hotel is a perfect base to explore the wonderful attractions this beautiful city has to offer. The hotel features a restaurant, a bar and 24-hour room service. Famous attractions such as Topkapi palace, Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar or Hippodrome are within a short stroll.

94055.description: Renovated in 2008, this charming hotel is an old wooden Ottoman mansion with 24 unique, nicely decorated rooms. It displays Ottoman architecture from the 19th Century and was recently renovated and converted into a hotel with modern amenities. Features of the hotel include a delightful garden with a waterfall and ancient walnut trees, and an attractive wooden open-air cafe. Facilities available to guests at the air-conditioned establishment include a restaurant and WLAN Internet access. The hotel offers spacious and spotless, elegantly furnished rooms, designed in a contemporary Ottoman style. The hotel has a courtyard cafe and a restaurant, which serves delicious Turkish dishes.

94074.description: Socialtel Palermo is in the hip neighborhood of Palermo. Travelers and locals mingle in the trendy bars, restaurants, clubs and green spaces of this district. Here, you'll feel right at home among the parks and plazas of Buenos Aires. There's a reason why Buenos Aires is ranked as the top destination for digital nomads in South America. This city is sexy, vibrant, and exciting at every turn. Stop by one of Argentina's famous steakhouses before heading to a nearby speakeasy or dancing til dawn; take in a tango show, or tour around the European-style art and architecture. Buenos Aires is seductive, stylish, and a can't miss stop for every traveler.

94094.address: Sehit Muhtar Cad, Taksim Oteller Bolgesi, 42
94094.description: This magnificent and luxurious hotel is set in a very practical position, very close to the main business, shopping, convention, cultural and entertainment area of the city. Located within walking distance to Taksim Square, this is the ideal choice of accommodation either when travelling for leisure or for business. This hotel's location is also very convenient as it is only 25 kilometres from Ataturk Airport. All this hotel's guest rooms and suites feature a neo classical and baroque style with refined and elegant furniture that will help its guests to escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Guests will have the opportunity to taste delicious culinary specialities at the on-site restaurants and completely unwind at the exclusive health and fitness centre. Business travellers might appreciate the state-of-the-art meeting facilities to celebrate any kind of event. In our hotel, a 'bonnet' is required to use the pool and can be purchased from the hotel.

94114.description: This city hotel is situated in the centre of Plan-les-Ouates. It is less than 3 minutes by car from one of the biggest centres of the clock and jewellery industry in the world. Geneva city centre and lake can be reached in 25 minutes using public transport. The United Nations and museums are a 15-minute drive away, and the water fountain is a 20-minute drive away. Lausanne is a 1-hour drive from the hotel. There is a park within 3 minutes' walking distance of the hotel, and the nearest bus station (bus D) is just one minute away. Cornavin station is a 15-minute drive away. The restaurant, Des Marroniers, is only a stone's throw away. The Palexpo congress and fair centre is 10 minutes away, as is Geneva Cointrin International Airport (GVA). Renovated in 2008, the decoration of this charming, 32-room business hotel is based on the tools and instruments used by the masters of the watch-making industry through the centuries. Facilities include a lobby, hotel safe, currency exchange, lift access and breakfast room. For an additional fee, guests can use the Wi-Fi Internet system that is active throughout the hotel, as well as the laundry service. The en suite rooms are comfortably furnished with all the modern conveniences. Guests will find all the comforts necessary for their stay: double or king-size bed with quality bedding, a safe with code, LCD TV with a wide choice of international channels, direct dial telephone, minibar, tea and coffee making facilities and double-glazed windows. In the bathroom, quality towels, a range of aloe vera soaps and shampoos, a large mirror and a hairdryer are at the guest's disposal. The rooms also have Internet access and central heating. A Box Breakfast wil be in a minibar in your room. For lunch and dinner, numerous restaurants are located minutes away from the hotel.

94124.description: Head down to the water and enjoy a day at the private beach, or take advantage of other recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a spa tub. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Getting to the surf and sand is a breeze with the complimentary beach shuttle. Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at El Henequen, a restaurant which specializes in international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Cancun?
