This hotel has 2852 square feet (265 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 4 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary (available 24 hours).

94128.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features gift shops/newsstands, a hair salon, and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Midtown Grill, a restaurant which specializes in international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Amsterdam? This hotel has 8740 square feet (812 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 12 meeting rooms. Stay in one of 396 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Cable television is provided for your entertainment.

94159.address: Avenida Mare de Deu de Bellvitge, 3
94159.description: Enjoy the convenience of apartment living at the Hesperia Barcelona Fira Suites, located at the entrance to Barcelona. Feel at home with your own fully equipped kitchen and excellent transport links. The Hospital de Bellvitge metro station (red line) is nearby, placing you a short 5-minute drive from the Fira de Barcelona convention center and just 10 minutes from the airport. Guests also enjoy access to paid services (subject to conditions) at the adjacent Hyatt Regency Barcelona Tower, including breakfast, restaurants, and bars. Apartments feature Smart TVs with e-room cast functionality, allowing you to stream your favorite shows and movies. Cleaning service, including a change of linens and towels every three days, is included for stays of six nights or longer. For shorter stays, or to request additional cleaning, a fee of €20 (VAT included) applies per service. Towel changes are also available for €8 (VAT included). A self-check-in kiosk (card payment only) is available for your convenience. Please note that check-in is guaranteed from 3 PM.

94249.description: Nobody makes it easier to explore Edinburgh than the 4-star Novotel Edinburgh Park hotel, which offers ample car and coach parking and immediate train and tram access. Our 170 stylish rooms include family-friendly options and modern air-conditioning, while our full-service bar and restaurant offer a casual setting for fresh, modern cuisine. After exploring Edinburgh's sights, unwind in our heated indoor pool, whirlpool, sauna or gym, all part of our contemporary leisure centre and free to guests.

94253.description: The Ibis Berlin City Nord offers good transport links to the city. The hotel is an ideal rendez vous for international meetings. As holiday-makers, you can benefit from a perfect starting point for your excursions. The center of Berlin with attractions such as the government district and museum island can be reached in around 15 minutes on the U-Bahn. All 116 rooms are equipped with free WIFI and modern equipment. Affordable car parking available.

94294.address: Ap7 Km 165, Area Servicio Porta De Barcelona
94294.description: This newly built hotel constitutes the ideal choice for business and leisure travellers who are looking to remain close enough to the city centre, but at the same time outside of all the stress which is associated with big cities. Sitting close to the AP7 motorway, which runs along the coast to Valencia and Andalusia, allows its guests to reach the centre of Barcelona or the sandy beach within a 20-minute drive. The venue offers a wide range of conference and business facilities, making it an attractive choice for those who are looking for a place where to stage their next meeting of corporate event. The comfortable and cosy rooms provide ideal conditions for relaxing and recuperating after a long day.

name.content: Four Points by Sheraton Downtown Dubai

94295.address: Sh. Sabah Al Ahmad Al Jaber Street 4C Bur Dubai
94295.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. The complimentary shuttle will take you to the nearby beach or shopping center. Grab a bite at Purani Dilli, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 244 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions.

94308.description: Housed in the pleasant Haussmannian residential district in the 17th Arrondissement in Paris, this small, but very charming hotel takes its guests to a journey back in time. With a beautiful woodland park just a few steps away, one can hardly imagine that he or she is in the immediate vicinity of the Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower. Only a short walk separates its guests from the prestigious Avenue des Champs-Élysées with its many shops open through the night and its world-class restaurants. Constituting only 29 beautifully-appointed rooms allows this hotel to offer personalized services, which can hardly be matched by the bigger establishments and which will surely allow its guests to feel special during their stay.

94337.description: Situated in Venice's historic center, near the Frari Basilica (Scuola Grande di San Rocco) and a short walk from the Grand Canal, this 1950s city hotel offers 30 rooms across four floors. Enjoy modern comforts blended with old-fashioned hospitality. Amenities include air conditioning, 24-hour reception, a safe, lift, breakfast room, and room service. A parking garage is available for a fee. The tastefully decorated rooms provide a warm, romantic atmosphere, featuring en suite bathrooms, hairdryers, direct-dial telephones, satellite TV, radios, minibars, individual climate control, and safes. A continental breakfast buffet is served daily. The hotel is visible from Piazzale Roma (bus terminal and car access). From the train station, turn right and cross the Calatrava Bridge; the hotel is at Piazzale Roma.

94393.address: King Fahd Road, Olaya, Riyadh 11484, Ksa., 0
94393.description: A stay at Mandarin Oriental Al Faisaliah, Riyadh places you in the heart of Riyadh, within a 10-minute drive of National Museum of Saudi Arabia and Al Musmak Fortress. This luxury hotel is 6. 2 mi (10. 1 km) from King Abdullah Park and 6. 7 mi (10. 8 km) from Riyadh Zoo. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 indoor swimming pools, 2 spa tubs, and a health club. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Make yourself at home in one of the 325 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring iPads and Smart televisions. Rooms have private balconies or patios. 46-inch flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Enjoy international cuisine at La Brasserie, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.

94394.description: Set amid lush, beautifully landscaped gardens in one of Saudi Arabia’s most affluent cities, the InterContinental® Riyadh offers an oasis of tranquility. Relax in stylish rooms with a modern Arabian design, indulge in the onsite premiere restaurants, and unwind in our lavish pool, the perfect rejuvenation following a day exploring the city’s nearby cultural and historic sites: Kingdom Tower, Al Diriyah, and the National Museum of Saudi Arabia.

94395.address: King Saud Road Al Wazarat District, S/N
94395.description: Treat yourself with massages and body treatments. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a 24-hour health club, an indoor pool, and a spa tub. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the complimentary area shuttle. Enjoy international cuisine at Mosaic Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Riyadh? This hotel has 81612 square feet (7582 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 27 meeting rooms.

94402.address: Po Box 3655, El Salama District Saqr Quraish St.
94402.description: Located on Medina Road, a short 10-minute drive from both Jeddah International Airport and the city center, this first-class hotel offers convenient access to major shopping and business districts. Experience warm hospitality and comfortable accommodations, ideal for leisure, celebrations, or business meetings. Hotel rooms feature comfortable furnishings, individual climate control, direct-dial telephones, and satellite TV.

94404.description: With a stay at Jeddah Hilton, you'll be centrally located in Jeddah, within a 5-minute drive of Red Sea Mall and North Corniche. This luxury hotel is 2. 4 mi (3. 9 km) from Fakieh Aquarium and 2. 5 mi (4 km) from Jeddah Sea Corniche. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find outdoor tennis courts, a 24-hour health club, and an outdoor pool. Additional features at this hotel include wireless internet access (surcharge), concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Make yourself at home in one of the 388 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LED televisions. Rooms have private furnished balconies. Cable programming and DVD players are provided for your entertainment, while wireless internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Enjoy international cuisine at Al Safinah Restaurant, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in.

name.content: Jeddah Grand Hotel (Ex The Trident Jeddah)

94408.description: This hotel offers excellent value, situated near Jeddah's Industrial Area, Sea Port, and Al Balad. The 220 rooms provide a comfortable 'home away from home' experience for a variety of guests. Recently renovated, five floors showcase unique designs, complemented by a new swimming pool and Diamond Wedding Hall. Guests also enjoy express check-in and check-out.

94410.address: Intersection Sitten St & Plastine St.Op Samba Bank
94410.description: Hotel is conveniently located, about 3 km from the city centre and 2 km from Serrafi Mega Mall. It offers elegant and spacious rooms and suites. It also has a modern gym. All the units at this hotel are decorated with a mix of modern and classic furniture and have air conditioning, a TV and a telephone. The spacious suites also feature a fully equipped kitchen with dining area and living room. Guests can enjoy the 24-hour room service for their meals or explore the city and its variety of restaurants. Guests can also choose to have breakfast in the hotel.

94411.description: Experience the Art Deco elegance of this Jeddah hotel, ideally located near Palestine Street and the Red Sea. Enjoy a wealth of amenities, including a 24-hour health club, outdoor pool, sauna, and three restaurants, including the international Al Zahra Restaurant. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, or unwind in your air-conditioned room featuring an iPod docking station and LED TV. For business travelers, a 24-hour business center and 13 meeting rooms are available. A convenient airport shuttle service is also offered (surcharge).

94423.address: Al Maktoum Hospital Rd, 2nd Street, PO BOX 14963
94423.description: 'This hotel is located in the heart of Dubai city, just 10 minutes away from Dubai International Airport and within walking distance of famous shopping malls, business centres and wholesale markets. This air-conditioned hotel is a home away from home. The friendly and courteous hospitality will make each guest's stay most enjoyable and memorable. There are 88 well-furnished rooms, refurbished to meet international standards of comfort and luxury. Golden Cue is a one-of-a-kind snooker club for all interested amateurs and budding pros. The hotel offers an international buffet for breakfast and brunch at the Caspian Restaurant, which features a wide selection of salads, main courses, soups and deserts. This hotel is the perfect destination for a convenient and comfortable visit to Dubai. '

94433.description: This hotel boasts an idyllic setting in Getafe. It is surrounded by stunning natural scenery, just a short distance away from the centre of the town. Nassica shopping and leisure centre can also be found nearby. The hotel is situated within easy access of the Warner Bros Park. Links to the public transport network can be accessed nearby. The hotel is situated just a 20 minutes' driving distance away from Aranjuez. Madrid is also located nearby. This family-friendly hotel is sure to impress. The guest rooms have been designed with comfort and convenience in mind. The hotel offers an extensive range of facilities and services, attending to the needs of every type of traveller.

94440.description: This hotel is located in one of the quietest areas in the city centre of Athens, near the Music Hall and the USA Embassy, with lots of coffee shops and restaurants in its immediate vicinity. The contemporary seven floors city hotel offers a business centre fully - equipped with the latest technology that is more than capable of facilitating the needs of the modern executive travellers. There is also an elegant lounge room where guests can relax and meet with friends or colleagues and a luxurious restaurant-bar for those looking for a truly fine-dining experience and a taste of the finest Greek cuisine.

name.content: Sure Hotel by Best Western Paris Gare du Nord

94474.description: The Sure Hotel by Best Western Paris Gare du Nord is conveniently located in Paris's 10th Arrondissement, a short drive from the Canal Saint-Martin and Palais Garnier. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a business center, and tour/ticket assistance. The 56 air-conditioned rooms feature LCD TVs with satellite programming, safes, and desks. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Buffet breakfast is available on weekdays for a fee. Nearby attractions include Sacré-Cœur Basilica, Grands Boulevards, and Parc des Buttes Chaumont. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

94500.address: Byng Street, Canary South, Westferry Road, 9
94500.description: These apartments are accessible from Byng Street, off Westferry Road. It is approximately a 7-minute walk from the apartments to the heart of Canary Wharf and the Jubilee underground line with fantastic underground and rail links to London's West End and London City. The development is about a 3-minute walk from either South Quay or Heron Quays DLR station. It is also conveniently located near to London City Airport, which is some 33 km away. These apartments comprise the newest development in this sector. Each of the 42 apartments at this apartment hotel has been specially designed with space and convenience in mind and contains all the luxuries of home-away-from-home living. Facilities include easy-to-operate entry phone systems, a reception area and lifts. WLAN Internet access is provided, and there are parking spaces for guests arriving by car (charges apply). These modern apartments include furnished living and dining rooms. Facilities available to guests include a satellite/digital TV, DVD player and free broadband Internet access. Apartments also feature a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher, washer/dryer, oven and hob, as well as a fridge and freezer. An iron and ironing board and tea and coffee making facilities are also provided. The bedrooms include a double bed with a walnut headboard, in addition to a telephone and alarm clock. Each apartment comes with a private bathroom with a power shower, heated towel rail, a hairdryer and a shaving socket. Central heating and a balcony/terrace are further standard features. Guests can take advantage of significantly discounted passes to Canary Wharf's premier gym.

94501.description: These luxurious serviced apartments are within easy walking distance of many of London's main attractions, including the Tate Modern, Shakespeare's Globe, St. Paul's Cathedral, and the Royal Exchange. Heathrow Airport is 27 km from the property, Gatwick is 49 km, and both Stansted and Luton are 57 km away. Located in the heart of London's financial center, this premier corporate housing development comprises 90 luxurious serviced apartments, including six studios ideal for short and long-term corporate rentals. The stylishly designed contemporary apartments are furnished to the highest standards, emphasizing quality and space. Their central location and sophisticated style are perfect for the discerning corporate traveler. The building features a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, and lift access to all floors. One of the City's most architecturally significant buildings, this unique development boasts bold design, sash windows, and contemporary materials, making these apartments the perfect base for business and leisure guests. Its convenient setting provides unmatched access to some of London's most important financial and civic buildings. Each apartment includes a private bathroom with a shower, bathtub, and hairdryer, along with a fully equipped kitchen featuring a fridge, cooker, microwave, and tea and coffee making facilities. Guests also enjoy a king-size bed, direct dial telephone, satellite TV, radio, internet access, a washing machine, an ironing set, and central heating. For stays of two nights or longer, a welcome hamper with food and drinks is provided.

94604.description: This newly built hotel, located on the outskirts of Barcelona, is approximately 15 km from the city center. Guests benefit from convenient transport links less than 100 meters away, providing easy access to the center and other tourist attractions. Fira 2 Gran Via is 9 km and Fira de Montjuïc is 10 km from the hotel. Ideal for business travelers, the hotel offers a complimentary 24-hour airport shuttle service.

94612.address: Av. Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Estrada Nacional 13, S/N
94612.description: This hotel is situated on the south bank of the River Ave, in Azurara, Vila do Conde. It is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from the centre of Vila do Conde. Porto is just 20 km away. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. Guests can find delightful beaches and important monuments in the area. Francisco de Sa Carneiro Airport is 20 km away. This wonderful hotel appeals to every type of traveller. The guest rooms are superbly designed, offering comfort and convenience in a peaceful setting. The hotel features 3 meeting rooms, for the convenience of business travellers. The hotel offers a delightful bar, cafe and restaurant, where guests can wine and dine in style.

94636.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including a steam room, a fitness center, and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Haarlem? This hotel has 8870 square feet (824 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 19 meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 294 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

94654.description: This hotel enjoys an idyllic setting on the shores of the Marmara Sea, in the Bakirkoy District of Istanbul. The hotel is surrounded by charming parks, lying close to the Golden Anchor Marina. Guests will find themselves amidst one of the main shopping and commercial centres of the city. A wide range of attractions can be found nearby. The hotel enjoys close proximity to Ataturk International Airport, as well as the Seabus Terminal. This charming hotel enjoys an attractive design. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, featuring soothing tones and a serene ambience. The hotel offers a number of leisure, recreational and dining facilities, ensuring a memorable stay for each and every traveller.

94673.description: The Hostel is located in the heart of Barcelona, next to the Sagrada Familia, very close to metro stations, train station, and bus routes, connecting it to all major sites of this vibrant city. This brand new hostel is ideal for young visitors. It offers the help of a friendly multilingual staff and features many amenities young people can't do without. WiFi and Bluetooth connections are available throughout the building. The on-site bar is a good place to relax with friends over a drink in a cosy atmosphere. The hotel has a terrace and a chill out lounge where guests can work or read in peace. A common kitchen is provided for everyone's use. All the bedrooms have en-suite bathrooms with lockers inside.

94675.description: Don't miss out on recreational opportunities including a sauna and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Grab a bite to eat at 91-restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to noon for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 142 guestrooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment.

94678.description: Located in the commercial Peschiera Borromeo district and along Idroscalo, Milan's popular artificial lake, the NH Linate Hotel provides convenient access to Milan Linate Airport, while also serving as a great base for exploring the art, architecture, and shopping of the city center. To visit Milan's Duomo, Leonardo da Vinci's “The Last Supper” fresco, Sforza Castle, Fondazione Prada, and luxury shopping at the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, hotel guests can take public transportation from the nearby bus stop at the intersection of Via Fratelli Bandiera and Via IV Novembre. Stadio Giuseppe Meazza, the stadium home of the A. C. Milan and Inter Milan football teams in the Serie A league, is a half hour's drive from the hotel. NH Linate's 67 fresh, modern rooms are decorated in a minimalist style with paintings of Amedeo Modigliani above the beds. Each room offers free Wi-Fi and a flatscreen TV with international channels. The hotel offers a range of dining options including a continental breakfast buffet, the Jet Lag Restaurant serving Milanese and Italian dinner specialties in an informal setting, an Open Bar offering 24 hour grab-and-go snacks, and the NH Linate lobby bar. The hotel has 5 meeting rooms on-site which can accommodate events for as many as 200 guests.

94687.description: Enjoy a stay at Maison Barbès, conveniently located in central Paris, within a 15-minute walk of Place du Tertre and Rue Lepic. This hotel offers 29 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a flat-screen TV, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a private bathroom with a rainfall showerhead. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (available for a fee), and unwind at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include a fitness center, concierge services, and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel is 0. 9 miles from the Moulin Rouge and 1. 5 miles from the Palais Garnier.

94689.description: It's all on our doorstep! Climb Lion's Head. Sail to the top of Table Mountain in the cable car. Walk to our finest galleries and coffee shops or stroll in the Company's Garden and feed the squirrels. Uber to the V&A Waterfront to explore the craft market. Toast the sunset from the beaches, then hit the restaurants and pubs and enjoy nightlife, Cape Town style. Then come back to the unpretentious comfort, friendly smiles and warm welcome waiting for you at the Townhouse – your very own space in this beautiful, exciting city.

94696.address: King Abdul Aziz Road, Old Airport Road,P.B.3525
94696.description: The hotel is located in the heart of Riyadh. It is a 15-minute drive from the exhibition centre and the diplomatic quarter and 25 minutes' drive from King Khalid International Airport. This hotel comprises 178 guestrooms over 3 floors and provides lift access to all units. Guests can enjoy a meal and drinks at the on-site bar and Arabic restaurant, and commission their laundry to the hotel's same day delivery laundry service. There is also a car park where guests can safely leave their vehicles. A swimming pool and a health club with gym and a sauna provide recreation for visitors in their leisure time. All of the air-conditioned units are fully equipped with IDD, telephone system, colour satellite/cable TV with multiple channels and mini fridge. Non-smoking rooms are also available.

94714.description: Conveniently located on Al-Rigga Street in Deira, Dubai's main commercial district, this hotel offers easy access to the Al Ghurair Centre and Dubai International Airport. Its 112 well-furnished rooms and suites provide a warm, home-like atmosphere, complete with modern amenities for a comfortable stay. Whether traveling for business or leisure, guests can enjoy the rooftop swimming pool and hot tub, diverse dining options, including multi-cuisine restaurants, a coffee shop, and an Irish-style bar, as well as room service and a poolside snack bar.

94737.description: Experience the vibrant energy of Buenos Aires from this excellent hotel, ideally situated near major city attractions such as Florida Street, Galerias Pacifico, and Puerto Madero. The hotel's 118 renovated rooms feature amenities like 21-inch TVs, air conditioning, hair dryers, central heating, alarm clocks, radios, safes, wooden floors, Wi-Fi, and minibars. Enjoy easy access to the city's best restaurants and attractions.

94803.description: Situated directly on the Grand Canal, Palazzo Stern offers an unforgettable Venetian experience. Housed in a beautifully restored historic palace, the hotel exudes romance and charm, from its peaceful garden overlooking the canal to its rooftop terrace with a hot tub. With the Accademia and Guggenheim nearby, Palazzo Stern complements the city's artistic spirit with its own collection of antiques, sculptures, and exquisite furnishings. Conveniently located near a Vaporetto (water bus) stop, the hotel is easily accessible. Accommodation reflects traditional Venetian style, featuring luxurious fabrics, oriental carpets, stuccos, gilding, Murano glass, and chandeliers. All rooms offer excellent 4-star amenities, including satellite TV, air-conditioning, a safe, a mini-bar, Wi-Fi, and a tea/coffee tray. Check-in begins at 2:00 PM, and check-out is available 24 hours a day. Please note that the local city tax is not included in the room rate and is payable directly to the hotel upon arrival or departure.

94804.description: This charming city hotel is located just of Avenue Louise and near the European Parliament. Being close to the heart of EU administrative capital means that there are number of government buildings and corporate offices just minutes away. At the same time it guarantees that there will be several exclusive restaurants in the immediate vicinity. The hotel itself spreads across 6 floors and offers state-of-the-art conference technology and natural daylight in its modern conference room, which is just perfect for staging corporate events or meetings.

94893.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and tour/ticket assistance. You can enjoy a meal at Dittmanns Drogerie serving the guests of Hotel Waldzeit Berlin-Grunau, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and multilingual staff. Planning an event in Berlin? This hotel has 3767 square feet (350 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 72 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

name.content: B&B Hotel Madrid Aeropuerto T1 T2 T3

94895.description: This hotel is situated directly on the A2 motorway, with easy access to all the major ring roads. The hotel is surrounded by the business parks of Coslada, San Fernando and Torrejón. For leisure travellers, the hotel is next to Plenilunio and the Aquopolis water park. The IFEMA exhibition and fair centre and Madrid city centre are just minutes away, as is Madrid Barajas International Airport, some 2 kms from the hotel. This 124-room airport hotel is brand-new and air-conditioned. The hotel features a meeting room and a 24-hour business corner, WLAN Internet access and secure parking – facilities, sure to be appreciated by business travellers. All standard bedrooms, including 3 disability-friendly rooms, are equipped with air conditioning and heating, providing guests with maximum comfort.

94962.description: The Barceló Raval****, a cosmopolitan hotel in Barcelona's vibrant Raval district, is just a short walk from iconic landmarks like Las Ramblas, Plaza Catalunya, and the Boqueria market. This urban oasis offers 182 comfortable rooms and 4 suites, each featuring stunning city views, iPhone docking stations, and free Wi-Fi. Guests can also enjoy the innovative lobby and a panoramic 360° terrace showcasing Barcelona's skyline. The hotel is easily accessible by metro and bus, with excellent connections throughout the city. Enhanced hygiene protocols are in place to ensure guest safety and well-being.

95094.description: The Adagio Paris XV aparthotel is located opposite the Parc des Expositions at Porte de Versailles, just a short trip from central Paris. It offers 183 studio apartments, as well as two-bedroom apartments that sleep four, many overlooking tranquil gardens. Guests also benefit from private covered parking. The vibrant heart of the 15th arrondissement and the Aquaboulevard water park are within easy reach, making this aparthotel an ideal choice for both business and family travelers.

95098.address: Rue Gabriel Peri Aparthotel Paris Montrouge, 96
95098.description: Ideal for a stay in Paris, the Adagio Paris Montrouge hotel is well served by public transport and close to the shopping streets. This 4-star aparthotel has 133 modern and functional studios and 2-room apartments. It is 15 minutes from Orly airport and acar park is available.

95104.description: The Adagio Paris Opéra is located in a very prestigious district, just a stone's throw away from the Opéra Garnier and the department stores on Boulevard Haussmann. The 4-star holiday residence offers 99 apartments, ranging from 2-person studios to 2-room apartments for 4 people, all of which are air-conditioned and fully equipped with a kitchen, bathroom, TV with international channels and WIFI. The location is ideal for seeing Paris' sights and is also a vibrant business district.

95107.description: On the outskirts of Paris and just a few minutes' ride from the Champs-Elysées, Adagio La Défense Le Parc holiday residence offers 76 apartments, ranging from 2-person studios to 1 bedroom apartment for 4 people. The La Défense business center is less than a 10-minute walk away via a pedestrian route and a range of stores and amenities are in close proximity to the Aparthotel. A private covered car park is also available.

95108.description: Located in the La Défense district (Courbevoie) and just 13 minutes from the Champs-Elysées, the Adagio La Défense Kléber 4-star holiday residence has 88 comfortable apartments ranging from 2-person studios to 6-person, 3-room apartments with a terrace or balcony. A full range of shops and amenities are within close proximity of the Aparthotel and the La Défense business district is only an 8-minute walk away. A private covered car park is also available.

95118.description: Enjoying a fantastic location in a typical Venetian square, this historic hotel enjoys close proximity to the 16th-century Giovanni Crisostomo Theatre, today the Malibran Theatre, home to an important season of chamber music. Within ease of access to the centre of Venice and just a 5-minute walk from the Rialto Bridge with its quaint fish market, and the Church of Saints John and Paul, examples of Venetian Gothic architecture. Venice Marco Polo International Airport is located approximately 15 kilometres. In the immediate vicinity, guests can also admire the Church of Santa Maria dei Miracoli and the monumental splendour of Saint Mark's Square. Housed in a 15th-century convent, this friendly hotel is an optimal choice for travellers seeking a comfortable accommodation in Venice. The guest rooms are the epitome of elegance, and dark wood-panelled walls, the work of skilled craftsmen, provide a classical backdrop for the hotel's warm and intimate atmosphere. Guests may enjoy American-style breakfast and also enjoy a drink from the on-site bar.

name.content: Max Brown Htl Canal District, part of Sircle Colle

95135.description: Max Brown Canal District is situated in three monumental Amsterdam canal houses with an amazing 300-year old facade, at the corner of Amsterdam's most famous canals, the Herengracht & the Brouwersgracht. The three canal houses in which Max Brown is located have seen a great amount of different owners and users over the three centuries of their existence. Now it's time for our guests of Max Brown to call these beautiful canal houses their home away from home in Amsterdam. The Amsterdam Canal District area is likely everybody's favourite part of Amsterdam.  As you probably already know, the Amsterdam Canal District is added to the UNESCO World Heritage List. It's a place where beautiful architecture, art, fashion, design and culinary delights come together. Max Brown Hotel Canal District is a unique location. It's here where you literally get the ‘real' Amsterdam local life experience.

95136.address: Po Box 111695, Hor Al Anz Mamzar Area
95136.description: This establishment is located in the heart of Dubai, just a 5-minute drive from both the major shopping centre of Al Mamzar Park and Al Mamzar beach. Moreover, it is only an approximate 10-minute drive from Dubai International Airport, being ideal for both business and leisure travellers alike. This apartment hotel offers several types of accommodation units, all of them boasting a warm and soothing decoration with standard amenities. The hotel features two swimming pools, a sauna and a steam room for guests to rest and relax. Massage and spa treatments are also offered. Guests will find jet skiing, motor boating, sailing, catamaran sailing and beach volleyball at the nearby sandy beach and pool snooker and bowling are also offered on-site. Breakfast is served as a continental-style buffet, while lunch and dinner are available either à la carte, from a set menu or as a buffet.

95154.description: Camelot Hotel offers bargain long-stay beach accommodations, perfect for travelers enjoying Sri Lanka's coast or seeking a final beachside retreat. All rooms feature sea views and private balconies. Guests can also explore nearby Negombo town, with its diverse restaurants and vibrant evening atmosphere, or dine in-house.

95173.description: This hotel is close to the city centre, within easy reach of the city's main sights. The breakfast room boasts panoramic views of Viana do Castelo and the 7th floor solarium is perfect to sunbathing, protected from the wind, with a magnificent view of the city and the river. The hotel has a function room great for special occasions. The hotel has a bar and small gift shop, two beautiful swimming pools surrounded by a large grass area. There are parking spaces for both cars and buses. Other facilities include a reading room, a winter garden, meeting facilities and a party salon.

95238.description: The AS Hotel Giovi in Cesano Maderno offers a convenient location between Milan and Como, just 20 minutes from Linate, Malpensa, and Orio al Serio airports, as well as the Milano City and Rho-Pero fairgrounds. Ideal for business travelers, the hotel provides a relaxing atmosphere of classic elegance. Its 134 newly renovated rooms feature quality materials and modern amenities. Guests seeking luxury can opt for stunning suites with exclusive features like hot tubs. Start your day with the 'Wonderful Buffet Breakfast' and enjoy the hotel's bars and ample parking. The Mediterranean restaurant offers an unforgettable dining experience. Two meeting rooms are also available, accommodating up to 100 people. Economy rooms are accessed via the outdoor patio, with parking directly in front.

95239.description: This modern hotel, nestled in the heart of Brianza, offers convenient access to Milan, Monza, Lake Como, and Saronno. Both Linate and Malpensa Airports are within a 30-minute drive, and the Bovisio Masciago train station is a mere 700 meters away. Elegantly appointed rooms provide a relaxing and private retreat for both business and leisure travelers. Business guests will appreciate the convenience of private entrances and parking directly in front of their rooms. The rich décor features high-quality boiserie and warm-toned fabrics, creating a welcoming and comfortable atmosphere.

95240.description: Boasting a prime location in the typical Venetian district of Cannaregio, this modern boutique hotel is located just a few minutes away from the ferry line that stops along the Canal Grande and continues on to Saint Mark's square. From this establishment, visitors can easily reach some of the main local attractions including Rialto Bridge (just a 5-minute walk), Fondamenta Nuove (starting point for boat rides to visit the glassworks of Murano) and Palazzo Vendramin Calergi. This hotel is conveniently located close to a wide great range of shops, restaurants and entertainment options that will ensure guests enjoy the ultimate in convenience. This comfortable cosy hotel features a choice of accommodation options to suit all clients' needs. All the rooms have been tastefully decorated with an exquisite contemporary design and evocative 18th century Venetian style. They all come with air-conditioning and Wi-Fi.

95256.description:
Located in Soto del Real, this hotel is 42 km from Madrid. It is to the north of the province in the surrounding areas of the Sierra of Guadarrama and not far from the Pedriza, a traditional centre for hiking visitors to Madrid. The municipalities of Manzanares el Real and Colmenar Viejo y Miraflores de la Sierra are also close at hand. Barajas International Airport is some 35 km from the hotel.

This city hotel is a modern air-conditioned establishment with a total of 50 rooms, furnished in a comfortable and functional manner. In addition to a hotel lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, the hotel's services and facilities include a bar, cafeteria, restaurant and 12 meeting rooms.

The rooms have a direct dial telephone, wifi Internet access and a satellite TV, as well as a private bathroom with a bathtub/shower. Further standard features include a mini fridge, individually regulated air conditioning units, central heating, a terrace and a safety deposit box (for a surcharge).

There is a pool in the hotel grounds.

When coming on highway M40 in direction of the M607/A1: Take the exit to Highway Colmenar M607 in the direction of Tres Cantos/Colmenar Viejo. Continue along this motorway until it terminates and turn right at the roundabout, heading in the direction of Soto del Real, Miraflores de la Sierra for approximately 8 km. On entering the village you will see a roundabout. Follow signs to the town centre.

95273.description: The Amauris luxury boutique hotel embodies the grandeur and grace of Vienna. Step with us into a world of beauty, where the glamour of 19th century style meets contemporary elegance. Situated on the historic Ring Boulevard, right between the Vienna State Opera and the Musikverein concert hall, our luxury boutique hotel is your gateway to Viennese rich culture. Explore the city's opulent palaces, famous museums, renowned restaurants, coffeehouses and vibrant shopping districts. Explore the cultural heart of this historic city and then come back to The Amauris for its five star pampering.

95305.description: The four-star Side Sun Hotel, located in Kumköy on Side's unique beachfront, offers a delightful vacation experience. Just 4 km from ancient Side and 62 km from Antalya Airport, this beachfront hotel boasts spacious rooms, modern activity spaces, and unlimited entertainment options. Recognized with Green Star, Blue Flag, Holiday Check, and Zoover awards, Side Sun Hotel maintains high quality standards, certified by ISO 9001 and ISO 22000. The hotel offers 207 rooms, including 175 standard rooms with sea views and balconies. All rooms feature split air conditioning, private bathrooms with showers, LCD TVs, direct dial telephones, minibars, hairdryers, kettles, and safe deposit boxes. Additionally, 32 family rooms with connecting doors and two bedrooms are available. Experience the allure of the Mediterranean in Side Sun Hotel's elegant and stylish spaces. Enjoy meals at the hotel's terrace restaurant with breathtaking views or in the air-conditioned indoor restaurant. For a unique culinary experience, explore the unforgettable tastes of Mexican, Ottoman, and Italian cuisines at the hotel's à la carte restaurants.

95366.description: Boasting a prime location beside the stunning Palau de la Música building, in Barcelona, this chic and last generation hotel is located at the historic heart of the city, just 19 minutes' drive away from Barcelona-El Prat airport and only a 12-minute walk from popular local attractions such as La Boquería market or Las Ramblas, a vibrant central street, popular with tourists and locals alike. The Barrio Gótico (Gothic district) is just a 10-minute walk from this establishment. This modern accommodation boasts a unique stylish atmosphere ideal for families, friends and business people who want to enjoy a special stay in a state-of-the art aparthotel. All the apartments are fully-equipped and include a wide range of services and amenities that will suit every client's needs, such as music equipment, satellite TV and a pleasant balcony from which to enjoy the stunning views of this vibrant city.

95367.description: The apartment hotel's central location allows easy access to Barcelona's main attractions, such as Las Ramblas, the Palau de la Música Catalana, La Boquería market, Gaudi's Casa Batlló, the Sagrada Família and Cathedral of Saint Eulalia. The Bogatell and Marina metro stations are a stone's throw away, so guests can easily reach the rest of the city as well. The apartments are quiet apartments ideal for a family trip . It has a playground within 100 meters. The beach is 5 minutes walk . The famous Ciutadella Park encuenta 5 minutes walk . It is only two subway stops from the historical center of Barcelona. They are connected by subway and buses. The apartments were recently refurbished giving a modern and elegant touch , not loosing the welcoming touch that makes it a great place to spend your holidays.

95377.description: Completely renovated (2007), is located in the center of Barcelona, in the heart of the Eixample neighborhood. Is located in a modernist nineteenth century building with elevator and furnished with all the comforts to make your stay. It is near the Sagrada Familia and also to a very short distance from Las Ramblas and Paseo de Gracia. It is connected to the old town. Just around the apartment, you will find bars and restaurants along Avenida Gaudí, leading to Sant Pau Hospital.

95495.description: CIN CODE: IT027042A1WD2RXRV5 This hotel is located in an ideal position for guests to experience the authentic atmosphere of Venice and to discover its magnificent sights. Saint Mark's Square is just a 3-minute walk away, while the Rialto Bridge is just 7 minutes away on foot. Guests will discover a rich area, packed with fascinating testimonies to art and history which contribute to making Venice one of the world's unique cities. This hotel comprises a total of 26 rooms and features typical Venetian style. It offers guests welcoming and cosy surroundings. The hotel is housed in a building dating back to 1920. The rooms are bright, and some feature splendid views over the rooftops of Venice and the dome of Saint Mark's Basilica. The delightful accommodation is furnished in a classic Venetian style, which is reminiscent of the 1700s.

95496.description: The Hotel da Bruno is ideally located, in the dynamic Salizzada San Lio, right in the heart of the city's historical centre, just a moment away from St. Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge. Recently renovated and restructured, the interior of the hotel provides all the luxuries and conveniences that modern travellers need while maintaining a certain charm with the historic building. A typical Italian breakfast buffet is served in the cosy breakfast room every morning from 7:30 am to 10:00 am.

95533.description: Thanks to this hotel's privileged location guests can visit the Montesquieu medieval castle that is 1. 4 km away, the ski slopes in Valle Nuria which are within 30 km of the property and some of the most picturesque towns in Spain, such as Vic, which is 20 km from the hotel. The establishment features well-appointed, spacious guestrooms with a private terrace from which guests can enjoy the impressive views over the Ter River. Guests can wine and dine at the on-site restaurant or purchase drinks at the hotel's bar/pub. Corporate travellers will be glad to know that the hotel offers meeting facilities. Guests with special needs are also welcome at this disability-friendly establishment.

95677.description: This charming hotel, housed in a heritage-listed former factory building from the 1920s, is located in northern Berlin, a short 10-minute walk from Gesundbrunnen train and metro station, providing easy access to the city's attractions, including the Reichstag, Museum Island, Brandenburg Gate, and Potsdamer Platz. Tegel International Airport is a convenient 10-minute drive away. Combining distinctive charm with modern interiors, the hotel offers seven conference rooms, a bar, and a restaurant. Each guest room features high ceilings, ample natural light, plush pillow-top mattresses, a flat-screen LCD TV, and complimentary WiFi. Guests can also enjoy 24/7 access to the fitness center.

95853.description: KM Hotel, located next door to KM Apartments, offers modern accommodation in an enviable location that sits between Edinburgh’s historic Old Town and lively Southside. A stone’s throw from the Royal Mile and Waverley Train Station, guests can easily explore Edinburgh and enjoy the local neighbourhood. The vibrant Southside combines charming Victorian architecture and leafy public squares with a bustling array of independent, vintage and eco-friendly shops, brilliant budget-friendly cafes and restaurants, as well as a whole host of entertainment and events venues. Only a couple of minutes’ walk away is Arthur’s Seat, Edinburgh’s number one free attraction, where you can climb 250m above the city for stunning panoramic views and the perfect Instagram moment. You also have free access to The University of Edinburgh’s award-winning Pleasance Sports Complex with its modern gym facilities.

95878.description:
Enjoying an enviable location in Venice, this wonderful hotel offers convenience and quality accommodation to business and leisure travellers. Set directly on the renowned Lista di Spagna, this 18th-century Venetian palace converted into a boutique establishment allows travellers ease of access to numerous shops, restaurants and situated near Santa Lucia train station and public boat transportation. Visitors will have the opportunity to enjoy the unique Venetian flair and city attractions such as Gran Canal, Palazzo Ducale, Saint Mark's Basilica. The property is sure to impress guests with a delightful design, stunning views over the hypnotizing Venetian lagoon and excellent services. The ample and luminous hotel rooms are elegant and richly decorated with Italian patterns, all with a range of modern amenities including complimentary Wi-Fi. 
For any kind of support contact: +39 0662290200

95879.description: This cosy city hotel is situated right in Milan's city centre, only 400 metres from the stunning Duomo and a short walk from the bustling Montenapoleone shopping area. The famous La Scala theatre is only 600 metres away, and attractions such as Sforza Castle, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, and ‘The Las Supper' at Santa Maria delle Grazie Church are within walking distance. The hotel's functional rooms come with modern amenities such as air conditioning and satellite television, and guests can make use of the free Internet service. The on-site American bar is a great place to wind down after a busy day of meetings or sightseeing, and the restaurant serves delicious Italian cuisine. Whether travelling to Milan for business or on a sightseeing holiday, this hotel's wonderful location and comfortable rooms make it a great choice.

95903.description: Hotel Indigo Barcelona Plaza Espana is a modern design hotel with a bright central courtyard. It offers free Wi-Fi and a convenient location, next to Barcelona's Plaça Espanya. The modern rooms at the Hotel Indigo Barcelona Plaza Espanafeature a private bathroom, and free mineral water for the first night. All are soundproofed, with flat-screen TVs, and air conditioning. The Barcelona Via is set next to the Fira Exhibition Centre, at the bottom of Montjuic. This hill is home to a castle, the National Art Museum, and the Magic Fountain. Espanya Metro Station is 150m from the hotel. The historic center of Barcelona and the famous Ramblas are just a few steps away. A direct bus service to the airport stops in Plaça Espanya, near the hotel.

95973.description: The Campanile Setúbal is located in a quiet, tree-lined area of the city of Setúbal, about 45 km from Lisbon. This 3-star hotel stands out for its welcoming, relaxed, and functional atmosphere, making it ideal for both leisure and business travel. It features 72 comfortable rooms, a seasonal outdoor pool, a tree-lined garden, a playground, and free parking.

96000.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 45 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

96005.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services, an arcade/game room, and a fireplace in the lobby. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Make yourself at home in one of the 48 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

96017.description: We welcome you to the Garner Hotel Berlin - Checkpoint Charlie. Whether for private or business occasions, the central location in Berlin Mitte, only about 500 meters from the subway station Kochstraße / Checkpoint Charlie, makes our hotel the ideal place for a stay in the capital. Sights such as Potsdamer Platz, the Brandenburg Gate or the Museum Island are only a short walk away. Whether a business meeting or conference, job interview, group trip or a wedding - with us you will find the adequate venue: Our modern business lounges, equipped with beamers, screens and pin boards, offer space for up to 35 people. And our 112 single and double rooms also convince business guests and vacationers: take advantage of the free high-speed WiFi. At night, you can be sure of a restful night's sleep thanks to soundproofed windows. Of course, we also have extra beds and baby cribs available for you. First-class service and comfort are our top priorities. Our multilingual reception desk is open 24 hours a day. In the morning you can enjoy a buffet in the Daylight breakfast restaurant. In the evening you can end the day with a cocktail or drink at the lobby bar. On request, we can also prepare a packed lunch for the day.

96157.description: City Hotel Amsterdam offers a complimentary breakfast and is situated at only 500 meters from Central Station. Its 18th century building gives the hotel a characteristic atmosphere. All rooms have private bathroom facilities, coffee and tea making facilities and TV, as well as free high-speed wired internet. A safety deposit box is also available in each room. The hotel bar serves drinks until 01:00. The hotel stays open all night so you can leave and return as you like. City Hotel Amsterdam offers free travel and tourist guides of Amsterdam to find your way around the city. The Red Light District, Dam Square and the main shopping street are at walking distance.

96196.description: Yirmi yılı aşkın bir süredir, İstanbul'un en önemli turizm ve merkez ticaretin merkezi ve eski İstanbul yarımadasının 'başında tarihi mirası üzerinde olan bin yıl İlkbal De Luxe Hotel, İstanbul'un' Öz donanım ve kesintisiz müşteri memnuniyeti hedefleri daha tekrar tarafından hizmet açarak yukarıda . . . . Otelimiz muhteşem manzarası oluşan Marmara Denizi ve şehir 163 de luxe oda. Bununla birlikte; Özel hazırlanmış antibakteriyel duş ve delüks oda ve 2 suit ' ettik O zevk vardı jakulizil banyo. . Aynı zamanda yerli ve yabancı büyük uydu kanalları, LCD TV, saç kurutma makinesi, elektronik kasa, karşılama kahve molaları ile elektrikli su ısıtıcısı, tam sahip ortopedik bizim bütün gün yükünü almak için hazır olduğunu ile yatak, bizim oda için özel dizayn edilmiş siz değerli misafirlerini kolaylığı.

96197.description: The family-friendly city hotel comprises a total of 80 rooms across 9 floors. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment are all selected to ensure a comfortable stay. Guests are welcomed to a charming on-site cafe and restaurant. Business travellers will appreciate the conference facilities and WLAN Internet access provided. A car park and covered garage parking are available for those arriving by car. All rooms come with an en suite bathroom and are equipped with amenities such as satellite TV and Internet access. Air conditioning and heating are provided in all accommodation units as standard.

96215.description: The Travelodge Barcelona Cornellá Fira is a 3-star hotel with 138 rooms offering a cheerful decor and contemporary style. The hotel is adapted to the needs of people with reduced mobility and has a ramp at the entrance of the building, flat unobstructed floors and several rooms with en-suite bathrooms that have been designed to accommodate all needs. The hotel has its own parking, 4 meeting rooms and a restaurant with a welcoming atmosphere where you can enjoy Mediterranean cuisine with tasty and creative dishes. You can also bring your pet with you for a surcharge of 20 euros per stay. At the Travelodge Barcelona Cornellá Fira, we would love to offer you and your pet the best possible experience. Perfectly located for both a business trip and a family holiday with all the facilities to make your stay as easy and comfortable as possible. Situated on the outskirts of Barcelona, it is conveniently located for access to El Prat airport, a 10-minute drive away, and 250 m from the Fira Cornellá conference centre and 5. 6 km (10 minutes by car) from Fira Hospitalet. Guests can reach the centre of Barcelona in 30 minutes thanks to the many train and bus connections.

96370.address: KEMALPASA MAH. GENCTURK CAD CUKURCESME SOK, 29
96370.description: This city hotel is located in the historical city centre of Istanbul. This is an ideal location for tourists who want to be close to the city's most famous historical and cultural sites. Restaurants, shops and links to the public transport network are around a 5-minute walk from the hotel, and guests can find bars, pubs and clubs in Taksim, which is around a 15-minute ride away using public transport. Ataturk Airport is around 15 kms away. This hotel combines architectural magnificence with modern comfort, offering guests a somewhat different experience. Renovated in 2008, the air-conditioned hotel offers 58 rooms in total. With its completely revised healthcare concept, the Dream Spa offers luxury and excellent care products with unique therapies for all guests in a relaxing ambience. Guests can sample classic dishes of Turkish and Ottoman cuisine at the Dream restaurant.

96396.description: This hotel is located in a privileged location in the Portuguese capital, where the business, the tourist and shopping areas meet. There is a plethora of Lisbon attractions within walking distance, such as Marquês de Pombal, Bairro Alto with its bars and restaurants and nightlife. Lisbon Airport is about 15-minute drive. The hotel offers 107 comfortable rooms with marble and walnut wood for luxury environment, equipped with air-conditioning, LCD TV, coffee facilities and bathroom hairdryer and toiletries. The hotel features an on-site restaurant with its outdoor terrace where guests can have a taste of Portuguese cuisine and international dishes. Travellers for business purpose may appreciate with 4 meeting rooms, furnished with all technological facilities.

name.content: Marrakech Ryads and Spa All inclusive

96448.description: Opened in 2008, this hotel beautifully blends traditional Moroccan architecture with modern amenities. Its 260 rooms are nestled within thirteen charming ryads, each offering stunning views of the lush gardens, the expansive 1, 200 m² pool, or the majestic Atlas Mountains. Beyond leisure, the hotel boasts five meeting rooms ideal for conferences and conventions. Unwind in the lounge bar with a refreshing drink and live music, while younger guests enjoy the dedicated kids' club. Each room features an en suite bathroom with a relaxing tub, hairdryer, complimentary toiletries, a minibar, TV, individually controlled air conditioning, an in-room safe, telephone, and a private terrace or balcony overlooking the pool or gardens. Active guests can take advantage of two tennis courts, a volleyball court, a soccer field, a pétanque court, and ping-pong tables. Indulge in a variety of beauty and health treatments at the hotel's 1, 200 m² spa. The Darkoum Restaurant offers a sumptuous international buffet with a wide selection of dishes. *Please note that sauna, hammam, and massage services incur an extra charge.

96674.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Tulip, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-out. Planning an event in Istanbul? This hotel has 538 square feet (50 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. Make yourself at home in one of the 86 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Taksim Square - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Istiklal Avenue - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Acibadem Taksim Hospital - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Istanbul Technical University - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Vodafone Park - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Istanbul Congress Center - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Lutfi Kirdar Convention and Exhibition Centre - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Dolmabahçe Palace - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Galataport - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Bosphorus - 1. 5 km / 1 mi- Pera Palace Hotel - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- City's Nişantaşı Shopping Center - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Istanbul Museum of Modern Art - 2 km / 1. 2 mi- Galata Tower - 2. 2 km / 1. 3 mi- American Hospital - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi.

96713.description: Just 3 minutes' walk from Kurfürstenstraße Underground Station and 1 km from Potsdamer Platz, this modern city hotel is located in Berlin's Tiergarten district. In Potsdamer Platz, guests will find the Sony Centre, the Potsdamer Platz Arcade, the musical theatre and the Museums of Culture Forum, and the famous Wintergarten Varieté Theatre is just around the corner. Public transportation links are found just 200 m from the hotel and it is 4 km to the city centre and Alexanderplatz.

96760.address: 37th Street, Al Rigga Road, Clock Tower, Deira
96760.description: The hotel is located in the centre of Dubai, close to the shopping centre and the famous Clock Tower. It is a five-minute drive from Dubai International Airport and Dubai's business and shopping districts. The complex was established in 1997 and consists of a total of 118 accommodation units. The well-furnished guest rooms are the pride of this city hotel. They are all fitted with the latest amenities and the flawless 24-hour room service ensures that clients will be in utmost comfort. In-room amenities include a safe, television, minibar and much more. For guests' leisure time the hotel offers the use of a health club and a small rooftop swimming pool. The restaurant serves Chinese and Indian cuisine in the background of traditional Iranian music and live entertainment.

name.content: NH Collection Madrid Paseo del Prado

96878.description: NH Collection Madrid Paseo del Prado is situated in the heart of Madrid's art triangle, across the street from the Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen museums. Shop at the nearby designer boutiques and exclusive cafés in the Salamanca district and Calle Serrano or stroll through Retiro Park. For links to the rest of the city and the airport, Banco de España and Atocha stations are minutes away. NH Collection Madrid Paseo del Prado is set in a historic Neo-Baroque palace with some of the rooms overlooking the famous Neptuno fountain. Designed in relaxed, neutral colors, rooms are enriched with handmade carpets from the Real Fábrica de Tapices and beautiful paintings adorn the walls. For modern comforts, guests enjoy free Wi-Fi, as well as tea and coffee making facilities. Connecting rooms are available. A fresh breakfast buffet is served daily and offers a delicious variety of hot and cold dishes. In the afternoon and evening, delight in tapas creations by Paco Roncero, a Michelin-starred chef. The Estado Puro tapas bar offers a wide selection of wines and al fresco seating. Our tea room offers a unique Suite & Tea service with a surprising collection of teas and sweet as well as savory snacks. To invigorate your body, make use of our rooftop gym and enjoy spectacular views of Madrid during your workout.

96960.description: Omni Berkshire Place is in the heart of Midtown, Manhattan. Our New York hotel is perfect for a romantic getaway, business trip or New York vacation. We’re located between Madison and Fifth Avenue, near St. Patrick’s Cathedral, Fortune 500 companies, shops, Broadway theaters and historic attractions. Our 399 guest rooms and suites are designed to emulate an Upper East Side residence with modern touches and spacious comfort. Several accommodations feature outdoor terraces with city views. All rooms are equipped with in-house technology for uninterrupted connectivity at our hotel in Midtown Manhattan. Start the day with a workout in our fitness center or tuck into breakfast at Berk’s Bar. Our inviting bar serves shareable plates and desserts throughout the day. It’s also a perfect place for pre-theater cocktails or a nightcap. Destination charge includes 2 Bottles of water daily, Local and Long Distance Calls, 24 hr access to fitness center, Complimentary premier Wi-Fi access, Coffee Maker, Mini-Refrigerator, Tea Kettle can be requested at no charge, newspapers available at concierge complimentary.

96968.address: Al Sufouh Road , PO BOX 75157, DUBAI
96968.description:
Located 25 minutes from DXB International Airport, Al Qasr Hotel is adjacent to Burj Al Arab, Wild Wadi Waterpark, and Jumeirah Beach Hotel. The nearest shopping mall is a mere 10 minutes away. Meaning 'The Palace, ' Al Qasr is the jewel in the crown of the Madinat Jumeirah resort. Designed in the style of a Sheikh's summer residence, the hotel replicates traditional royal architecture blended with modern luxury. Approaching the hotel along a tree-lined avenue adorned with sculpted Arabian horses is breathtaking. A tribute to the age-old architectural styles of Arabia, Jumeirah Al Qasr Dubai is an oasis of luxury dedicated to relaxation, recreation, and life's finer pleasures. As part of Madinat Jumeirah, the hotel offers access to all resort facilities and activities, including world-class restaurants, bars, cafes, Talise Spa, Talise Fitness health club, and a traditional souk with boutiques, shops, and galleries. *Please note that some facilities may have temporarily suspended operations. Please check with the hotel for the latest updates. *
** The main swimming pool at Jumeirah Al Qasr will undergo a transformation, featuring a refreshed design, upgraded finishes, and renewed surrounding landscaping . In addition, the adjacent beachfront dining area will be reimagined, with French Riviera Beach and La Promenade coming together to form a new concept, creating an elevated beachfront setting. Within the hotel, there are select operations being adjusted on a temporary basis, including the ongoing closure of Wild Wadi Waterpark and the suspension of Abra boat services. The enhancement project is due for completion by Q4 2026.

96969.description: Welcome to our recently renovated hostel in Vienna's Favoriten district! Located just steps from the Keplerplatz metro station and a short 10-minute walk from the Central Train Station, we're your perfect home base for exploring this beautiful city. Check in with our friendly, multilingual team and choose from spacious, modern pod dorms or a cozy private room. Make sure to join our free daily events to meet fellow travelers in our awesome Belushi's bar! Please note we have a maximum stay policy of seven nights and are strictly for guests over 18. Groups of nine or more guests may be subject to additional terms and conditions; please contact us before booking. Guests are required to show a valid, physical passport or EU ID card for check-in. Photocopies or pictures of ID will not be accepted. Vienna City Tax of 5% is not included in rates shown and will be charged at check-in.

97022.description:
These apartments are located in a privileged position, close to the beautiful Passeig de Gracia, one of the main streets of Barcelona, lined with fashionable restaurants, cafes and elegant shops, and few minutes' walk from some of Gaudí's renowned creations.

The apartments are situated in a modern building equipped with a lift and safe. Built in the early twenties of the 19th century and totally restored, all the flats have heating and air conditioning. There is also a laundry service available for a fee.

The apartments are equipped with all modern conveniences, including satellite TV and DVD player, a radio and CD player. In each apartment there is a lounge/dining area for 4 people. The bedroom has a double bed and the bathroom has a bathtub and a shower. The kitchen is fully equipped with a microwave, oven/grill, dishwasher and fridge-freezer. In the apartment there is also a separate laundry room with washing machine, as well as tea and coffee making facilities and a safe.

97034.description: This hotel is an oasis of peace in the heart of the lively, picturesque medina, just a few steps away from the hustle and bustle of the famous Jema el Fna Square. Marrakech-Menara International Airport is just 5 km away. This Moorish style hotel is housed in a building dating back to 1830 and is comprised of 5 rooms including 3 suites, 1 junior suite and 1 double room. All accommodations are air-conditioned and provided with contemporary conveniences and entertainment amenities such as wireless Internet access, satellite TV and a stereo system. All units open onto a balcony overlooking a gorgeous patio with a pool decorated with arabesques and ceramic tiles. Guests can enjoy lying in the sun by the pool or treat themselves to a professional massage.

97043.description: Recently renovated, the Jardin de Villiers is a charming, air conditioned hotel of 26 rooms offering old world charm and elegance with all of the modern amenities. Located in a quiet street a few steps away from metro Villiers and Monceau Park, the Jardin de Villiers's staff will welcome you with professionalism and simplicity. Located less than 10 minutes from Opera Garnier, Montmartre, Sacré Coeur, Arc de Triomphe, Champs Elysées, Galeries Lafayette and Gare du Nord, the hotel is ideal for business people, lovers and tourists. In good weather, our flowered terrace transforms into an urban oasis, free from the stress of the city. There is also a brand new fitness room ready to help you burn off some steam free wifi throughout the entire hotel. A buffet-style breakfast (complete with scrambled eggs, sausages, charcuterie, cheese, pastries. . . ) is served every morning under a veranda. Last but not least, a private, secure parking garage is located right down the street from the hotel. Reserving in advance is encouraged as it is in high demand.

97044.description: PAR-Paris 0 MI NArchitect Jean-Philippe Nuel is regularly employed by the major international hotel chains and has also designed the most beautiful interiors for charming establishments such as the Royal Rive Gauche. The emotional appeal of his work is achieved through a combination of neoclassical design and a practised eye for colour alternating between warm shades and sparkling tones. The refreshing result also gives pride of place to the latest technologies for optimum comfort. This little gem is located in a pleasant neighbourhood on the Rive Gauche close to the Jardin du Luxembourg and Montparnasse with easy access to public transport for travel throughout the capital.

name.content: Orchid Hotel Al Barsha Formerly Golden Tulip Al Ba

97074.address: Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Barsha, P.O.BOX 125962, 38 2
97074.description: The modern and contemporary Golden Tulip Al Barsha Hotel is a premium 4-star hotel in downtown Dubai, conveniently located in Al Barsha 1 next to the InsuranceMarket Metro Station, 2 minutes away only . It offers easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road, JLT, and Al Quoz, and is a short 25-30 minute drive from the Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai International Convention & Exhibition Centre. Part of the renowned Golden Tulip brand, this hotel caters to both business and leisure travelers seeking a comfortable and affordable retreat. Guests can enjoy two dining options: FRESH, an all-day dining restaurant, and Sky Korean Restaurant. The Locker Room Bar provides a relaxed setting for socializing. The hotel offers 125 contemporary rooms and suites featuring stylish decor and amenities such as complimentary tea and coffee making facilities, a fully stocked minibar, a flat-screen LCD TV with multi-channel satellite service, an in-room safe, high-speed internet access, and IDD telephone lines. For events and meetings, the Windsor 1 and 2 rooms are ideal venues. Additional facilities include a business center.

name.content: Best Western Plus Brooklyn Bay Hotel

97099.description: Choose this waterfront Brooklyn, New York hotel offering convenient access to key attractions such as Coney Island, the Statue of Liberty and Brighton Beach. The Best Western Plus Brooklyn Bay Hotel is located on the waterfront of New York's Long Island area. This Brooklyn hotel offers convenient access to a variety of local restaurants and shopping within the surrounding resort-style neighborhood. Each of the 48 well-appointed loft guest rooms features cable satellite television with HBO® and free wireless high-speed Internet access. Guests staying at the Best Western Plus Brooklyn Bay Hotel will find an array of amenities including a complimentary full breakfast, 24 hour fitness center and business services. The Best Western Plus Brooklyn Bay Hotel is ideally situated just one mile from local beaches including Brighton Beach and the beaches at Sheepshead Bay. Guests staying at this New York hotel can spend the day in New York City, just 15 miles away, to visit attractions such as the Rockefeller Center and the Guggenheim Museum. Locally, guests will enjoy touring the Brooklyn Museum or spending the afternoon at Coney Island, only one mile from the hotel. This Long Island hotel also offers convenient access to Kingsborough Community College and Coney Island University. The friendly, helpful staff at the Best Western Plus Brooklyn Bay Hotel is ready to ensure a fun-filled memorable stay in Brooklyn, New York. Make a reservation today and save! Parking is limited. It is on a first come, first serve basis.

97100.description: Appreciate the picturesque Manhattan skyline from our newly renovated, all-suite Doubletree Hotel Jersey City. Just next to Hoboken, NJ, and across the Hudson River from New York City and Wall Street, our Jersey City hotel welcomes you with friendly service and a warm Doubletree cookie upon check-in. Enjoy the view from our all-suite accommodations or be in Midtown in a New York minute. The hotel is located in the heart of the vibrant Jersey City Financial District. We are only ten miles and 20 minutes from Newark International Airport and five short minutes from both the Holland Tunnel and the New Jersey Turnpike. Business travelers will find our all-suite hotel is moments away from New York City's and Northern New Jersey's largest financial centers and major corporations. Hotel Features: Complimentary weekday shuttle service to Jersey City companies and local attractions based on availability. This full-service hotel has state-of-the art amenities including high-speed Internet access, complimentary Precor Fitness Center by Doubletree and 24-hour Business Center. Newly renovated, spacious guestrooms with high-tech amenities - tastefully appointed with earthen tones and brushed steel finishes. Dine at the Harsimus Cove Bar & Grill in a casual yet sophisticated atmosphere open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. In-room dining is also available. 1316 square feet of meeting and banquet space with the ability to accommodate groups of 100. The hotel offers a full slate of support services for our business travelers including meeting space, equipment rentals and audio/visual services. Location and Nearby Attractions: Newport Centre Mall located directly across the street featuring three levels of fine shopping, food court and 11 screen cinema. Liberty State Park, Statue of Liberty, Ellis Island.
