97103.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, a terrace, and a garden. This aparthotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting services (surcharge). Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (surcharge). Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a computer station, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self-parking is available onsite (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 134 guestrooms, featuring kitchens with refrigerators and stovetops. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is provided, along with flat-screen televisions with cable programming. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls. Located near La Défense, the aparthotel is also a short distance from Bois de Boulogne, Grande Arche, and the Louis Vuitton Foundation Museum. The nearest airports are Paris Orly Airport (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG).

97104.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center, terrace, and garden. This aparthotel also offers complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Take advantage of room service and the daily buffet breakfast (available for a fee). Additional amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The 135 guestrooms feature kitchens with refrigerators and stovetops, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Located in the heart of Paris, Fraser Suites Le Claridge Champs-Élysées is just a short walk from the Champs-Élysées and a 10-minute stroll from the Arc de Triomphe. Nearby attractions include Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore and Avenue Montaigne.

97117.description: This outstanding hotel can be found in Athens coast. The hotel consists of 47 rooms. This establishment was lastly renovated in 2019. Guests will not be bothered during their stay, as this is not a pet-friendly establishment. Glyfada Riviera Hotel is located on the Athenian Riviera, close to the beach and within walking distance of the Glyfada Golf Course. Guests can enjoy a swim in the outdoor pool, while free Wi-Fi is available throughout. Rooms have a fresh décor with light-wood furnishings and earthy tones. Comfortable rooms are complete with air conditioning and satellite TVs. A buffet breakfast is served daily. A restaurant and bar are available on site. In-room dining is provided through room service, from 7 in the morning until midnight. The 24-hour reception staff can assist you with car rental, excursions and city information. A nearby bus stop provides easy access to Athens city centre, 18 km away, or the International Airport, 25 km away.

97133.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This Art Deco hotel also features a television in a common area and discounted use of a nearby fitness facility. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 48 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and plasma televisions. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, while 42-inch Smart televisions with cable programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Prospect Park - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Barclays Center Brooklyn - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- New York Harbor - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Brooklyn Museum - 2. 6 km / 1.

97154.description:
Hotel SB Diagonal Zero Barcelona is opposite Barcelona’s International Convention Center and Barcelona's Forum Auditorium. It has a spa, a gym, a seasonal panoramic pool and a solarium on the hotel rooftop. 

There is free access to the hotel gym. The spa is only for guests over 14 years old, and includes a Turkish bath and Finnish sauna. Beauty and massage treatments are available at a surcharge. 

All air-conditioned rooms at the Hotel SB Diagonal Zero Barcelona have flat-screen satellite TV, free WiFi and a laptop safe. The soundproofed rooms have facilities to connect iPods. 

All rooms have ironing facilities, tea and coffee making facilities, and a kettle. There is a touch-screen control for lights and temperature. The private bathroom is equipped with a hairdryer, and bathrobes and slippers can be provided upon request.

97259.address: Junction of S.V. Road & Veer Savarkar Flyover
97259.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy international cuisine at Musaafer, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and limo/town car service. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms.

97281.description: This comfortable hotel is located in the heart of the trendy district of Mitte, enjoying excellent public transportation links, directly beside the Humboldthain Park. The capital's famous night-life is only 1 stop away on the train and guests can relish the cosmopolitan city life and a relaxing base at this convenient hotel. There is a plethora of bars, shops, and restaurants very close to the hotel. BER Airport is 20 km away and connected with the airportexpress train. This is an ideal hotel to explore the fascinating German capital.

97285.description: Friendly Barcelona hotel with free WiFi, included breakfast and easy access to the beach and city sightsHoliday Inn Express® Barcelona City 22@ hotel is located in the hip 22@Barcelona business zone, formerly an industrial district of Poblenou. Llacuna Metro Station is four minutes’ walk from the hotel. The B-10, also known as Ronda Litoral, Coastal Ring Road is minutes away by car and on-site parking is available. It’s a 20-minute drive to Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN). Unwind on Mar Bella Beach, a short stroll from the hotel. On the nearby Rambla del Poblenou, seafood dishes are popular. Barcelona attractions, like the soaring Sagrada Familia and imaginative Park Güell, are with easy reach. Looking for some retail therapy? Diagonal Mar mall is less than 10 minutes away by taxi. The hotel location in the 22@ innovation and financial district makes it an ideal base for business travellers. For events, it's a 10-minute drive to the CCIB convention centre. Guests can take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour Business Centre and fully equipped meeting room for up to 30 people. Bright, colourful guest rooms offer free WiFi to keep you connected. Get set for the day with an Express Start Breakfast buffet of continental items. In the evening, simply step outside the door to experience Barcelona's lively dining scene.

97286.description: This charming hotel is set in a prime location in the center of Secaucus. Local places of interest include Downtown Secaucus, Downtown North Bergen and Harmon Cove Outlet Center. Other points of interest are Meadowlands Exhibition Centre, Meadowlands Hospital Medical Center, Palisades Medical Center and Upper West Side. The hotel is within walking distance of restaurants and shops.

name.content: Design cE Hotel Boutique de Diseño

97295.description: Located in the heart of Barrio Norte, overlooking the beautiful Plaza Rodriguez Peña, this hotel offers convenient access to Buenos Aires' top attractions. Just a short walk from the exclusive Recoleta district, Calle Florida, and Avenida Santa Fe's vibrant restaurant scene, it's also easily accessible to the financial district, shopping areas, and both domestic and international airports. The hotel features 28 comfortable rooms, a restaurant, bar, conference facilities, and Wi-Fi. Guests can also enjoy amenities like a 24-hour reception, laundry service, and on-site parking. Each room is equipped with a king-size bed, LCD TV, air conditioning, a jacuzzi/shower, in-room safe, minibar, microwave, and coffee/tea facilities. A delicious breakfast buffet is available each morning. Whether traveling for business or leisure, this hotel provides a comfortable and convenient base for exploring the city.

97317.description: A welcoming Berlin hotel in the North of Berlin, with an indoor pool and large-scale event facilitiesHoliday Inn® Berlin - City West hotel has fast, easy access to sights in Charlottenburg and the city centre. Set in a leafy area of West Berlin, the hotel is a 5-minute walk from a U-Bahn station and 20 minutes from Berlin Central Station. In nearby Charlottenburg, you'll find fine dining and upmarket shopping, plus spectacular Charlottenburg Palace to explore with the family. Also great for children is the Olympic Stadium, which offers tours. We're next to Siemens offices, and business guests can use our expansive conference facilities, including 18 meeting rooms and a striking atrium that suits gatherings of all kinds. The A111 motorway can be reached within minutes, and the Messe Berlin trade fair grounds are a short drive away. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Inclusive Wi-Fi- Underground parking- Charging for electric cars- Kids stay and eat freeWith an indoor pool, sauna and gym, the hotel helps you feel your best during your stay, and spacious rooms with a pillow menu promote restful sleep. Dine on the terrace of our restaurant, and end the day sipping drinks with friends or colleagues in our lounge bar.

97356.description: Viana do Castelo, near the mouth of the river Lima, is the district capital of the northwest of Portugal, and of the region of Alto Minho. Viana is about 75 kms from Oporto, 28 kms of Ponte de Lima, and the border of Spain is just 30 kms north. Vigo, in Spain, is 98 kms away. Viana do Castelo is also serviced by train. This complex is the most recent addition to the Axis Hotels and Golf group. The contemporary architecture of the building and the hotel concepts makes this complex one of the most modern hotels of Portugal. It features a contemporary restaurant, a comfortable living room, a bar and, an exterior esplanade with a swimming pool, where guests can enjoy a refreshing dip. A business centre is available to the use of guests travelling on business.

97442.description: This charming guesthouse is located in the heart of Marrakech, the beautiful Red City, in the midst of Medina and its colourful markets. It is just a 5 minute walk from Djemaa el Fna square. There are various places of interest in the immediate vicinity, such as Bahia Palace and the Koutoubia, and it is just 8 km distance from Marrakech-Menara Airport. Comfort, charm, elegance and peace are likely to be the main reflections guests will have of this hotel when they leave. Set around a cosy patio with a fountain, the guest rooms present a traditional Moroccan décor and come with air-conditioning and a private bathroom. Daily traditional breakfast is served each morning and on request a typical Moroccan lunch and dinner are served in a large dining room. The Riad offers excursions to discover the beautiful surroundings of Marrakech and guests can also improve their swing on one of the most famous Moroccan courses and receive the advice of a professional golfer.

97447.description: Enjoying a convenient location right by the historic La Fenice Theatre and just a 5-minute walk from St. Mark's Square, this charming hotel welcomes guests into elegant, warm and relaxing surroundings where they can enjoy the levels of service and comfort of the most prestigious hotels in Venice. Guests can watch a gondola slowly glide by the hotel windows and enjoy direct access to the hotel by water taxi. Inspired by 18th-century Venetian-style décor, the establishment offers charming bedrooms, which are beautifully appointed with a combination of classic furniture and modern comforts that will make guests' stay really unforgettable. Travellers may set up for a busy day of sightseeing with a rich breakfast buffet, which includes a wide selection of sweet and savoury options. The beautiful rooftop terrace, with its panoramic view over the city, boasts a fantastic self-service bar where guests can relax and enjoy a variety of soft drinks, tea and infusions.

97524.description: Situated in the Beyazıt district of Istanbul, the elegant Kent Hotel enjoys a great location in Istambul. It is just a few steps away from the Grand Bazaar and the Spice Bazaar, and the historic Sultanahmet district with its famous attractions including Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Mosaic Museums, Basilica Cistern or Hippodrome can be reached within a short stroll. Guests are welcomed in a sophisticated atmosphere. The spacious rooms are decorated in a contemporary style with soothing earth tones. Excellent services and amenities include complimentary WIFI throughout the hotel, and business guests will appreciate the business centre and the meeting facilities. The on-site restaurant serves delicious Turkish and international cuisine, and guests can unwind having a drink or a tasty cocktail in the hotel bar. This hotel is a wonderful choice both for business and leisure travellers.

97568.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include a hair salon, shopping on site, and wedding services. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in New York? This hotel has 3944 square feet (366 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 13 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 238 air-conditioned guestrooms. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

97576.description: An elegant hotel, ideally located for both Business and LeisureWelcome to Crowne Plaza London Gatwick Airport Hotel. We are located just 5 minutes drive from LGW Airport and less than 1 mile from Crawley Manor Royal Business District, home to many multinational companies such as Thales, Elekta, and the Boeing Flight Simulator. The Gatwick Express offers a direct rail link to London in just 30 minutes and regular trains from Three Bridges and Crawley, just under 2 miles from the hotel, also offer links to London and Brighton. Our comfortable bedrooms have free Wi-Fi, USB chargers and satellite TV and the Sleep Advantage® programme offers premium bedding and quiet zones so you will not be disturbed. The Cube Restaurant serves delicious locally sourced food for breakfast and dinner and drinks and light meals are available all day in the trendy Bar 92. When you are off duty, relax and enjoy cocktails with your colleagues on the heated outdoor terrace, enjoy our 24 hour Fitness suite. Our chic meeting spaces include private boardrooms and a gorgeous event suite with a foyer and a bar, so you can host receptions or dinners for up to 200 guests or 280 guests for meetings. Your Crowne Plaza Meetings Director can help take care of all the details.

97623.description: This hotel is located opposite the beautiful sandy Barra da Tijuca beach and guests will find innumerable attractions nearby such as fine bars and restaurants, nightspots, mega shopping centres featuring world-famous brands and designer labels, theme parks, nature reserves and sports of all kinds. The nearest links to the public transport network are only 50 m away (Alvorada stop). This conference hotel offers 5 floors of accommodation for non-smokers and 15 disability friendly rooms, with a total of 338 rooms. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and 24-hour check-in/check out service, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility, a cloakroom and a cafe. It offers a bar, a restaurant and extensive conference facilities as well as room and laundry services. There is parking and a garage for those arriving by car. The convention centre features a separate entrance and reception area and offers more than 2976 m² of meeting rooms, some with a 5 m high ceiling, with capacity for between 20 and 1200 people. The rooms are equipped with centrally regulated air conditioning, high-speed Internet access, 2 telephone lines, a voice mail facility, soundproofed windows, cable TV and a minibar. The ample, tastefully decorated bathroom is designed for comfort and offers a shower/bathtub. Furthermore, a hairdryer, an ironing set, a king-size or double bed and a terrace are provided in all accommodation as standard. This hotel features an open air heated pool with a children's section, a poolside snack bar, sun loungers and parasols. Guests may also enjoy the spa bath and a sauna as well as the sun terrace and steam bath. Sports enthusiasts may enjoy a work-out in the gym.

97624.description: Offering breath-taking views over the world-famous Copacabana Beach, this magnificent hotel grants comfortable accommodation in Rio de Janeiro. Situated within a few steps from the Calçadão de Copa and bustling area with myriad of dining venues, vibrant nightlife, while Siqueira Campos metro station is just 2-minute walk away. The hotel's elegant large guest rooms exude an understated luxury and offer a wide range of cutting-edge comforts to afford guests a complete escape for senses. The enchanting in-house restaurant invites visitors to delight in Brazilian specialties and international tastes, sure to satisfy even the most discerning palates. There is a fabulous rooftop terrace with the shimmering swimming pool, where to lounge with an exotic cocktail or enjoy a soothing dip while enjoying stunning sea views. Guests may also relax at sauna, tone up at the state-of-art fitness centre or sip a drink at the enchanting hotel bar.

97625.description: This hotel is located in the downtown area of Rio de Janeiro, lying amidst the city's central business district. The hotel is situated close to governmental buildings and a myriad of tourist attractions. The hotel is a great option for business and leisure travellers visiting the area. This charming hotel welcomes guests with the promise of an unforgettable stay. The guest rooms and suites are elegantly designed, featuring functional space and a relaxing ambience, perfectly conducive to work and rest. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities, for the utmost in comfort and convenience. Guests can enjoy a refreshing swim on the rooftop pool, or simply sit back and revel in the splendour of the surroundings. Delightful dining is to be savoured in the relaxing restaurant.

97626.description: Ideally situated in Rio de Janeiro, just a few minutes' walk from Flamengo Beach, this prominent hotel offers a great base for both business and leisure travel. Catete metro station is only two minutes' walk from the hotel, bringing guests quickly and easily to the bustling city centre. Guests might go for a walk along the world-famous Copacabana Beach, just 30 minutes away via metro, or venture into the city centre for its National Museum of Fine Arts and National Historical Museum. The hotel's cosy guest rooms and suites are simply furnished for a relaxed and inviting atmosphere. Business travellers might also make use of the conference centre with 15 versatile meeting rooms and a range of helpful services, all for a high-powered business trip to Rio. Parking is available at an extra cost.

name.content: Great Hallingbury Manor, BW Signature Collec

97661.description: This eco-friendly hotel is beautifully situated amidst the splendour and appeal of the English countryside. The property is located within easy access of Hatfield Forest and Flitch Way. Links to the public transport network can be found just 1 km away, in the town of Takeley. Restaurants, bars and nightlife opportunities are just 5 km from the property, in Bishops Stortford. Stansted Airport is conveniently located 3 km from the hotel. This classical, Tudor-style mansion is set amidst its own private parkland, which features a natural lake. Guests can dine in style in the restaurant, or enjoy a more relaxed meal in the lounge.  Standard double and single rooms are located in our Annexe across the road, Hallingbury House. All patrons of these rooms are welcome to enjoy all the benefits of the main building and its facilities.

97873.description: Based in a quaint 19th-century building, this modern and chic hotel is ideally situated in Barcelona. Its prime location within a few paces from Passeig de Gràcia and Urgell metro stations and only 1 kilometre from Barcelona-Plaça de Catalunya railway station, allows travellers to get around the city and enjoy the best gastronomy, numerous entertainment and shopping venues as well as many city attractions. This elegant property is a perfect choice for a leisure trip, city break or a business travel. The bright and sumptuously decorated rooms offer generous space and combination of soothing tones and warm hues complemented with cosy furniture to create a warm and inviting atmosphere. The in-house restaurant serves refined cuisine, offering unmatched culinary experience. Guests may also have a soothing dip in the pool or unwind at the lounge bar or rooftop terrace, while sipping a drink and overlooking the city panorama.

97923.description: This aparthotel enjoys an enviable setting in the captivating city of Athens. The aparthotel is situated just a short distance away from the Athens National Gallery, offering guests the ideal setting from which to explore the delights that this mesmerising city has to offer. Guests can enjoy ease of access to the stunning historical district of Plaka. This wonderful aparthotel is bathed in the rich culture and tradition of Greece. The complex comprises beautifully-decorated guest rooms and apartments, providing a relaxing home away from home. The accommodation options come complete with modern amenities for guests' comfort and convenience. This delightful hotel offers exemplary facilities and services.

98025.description: A HOTEL INSPIRED IN BARCELONA AND THE SIXTIESHotel with a unique charm, a great atmosphere and a story to tell. It is located just steps from Las Ramblas in the heart of Barcelona. The décor at chic&basic Ramblas has been carefully selected to create a designer hotel inspired by 1960s Barcelona. Just as they were in the '60s, playfulness and creativity are closely linked at the hotel, with a photo exhibition on the doors of all 85 rooms, hallways bursting with colour and history, a green Seat 600 in the lobby and a restaurant complete with a bar and terrace. The warm and personalised service at Hotel Sixties Ramblas will make you feel right at home. The hotel is well served by public transport and within walking distance of many of the city's monuments and sights. Guests can enjoy a charming hotel in an exceptional location in the heart of Barcelona's tourist centre. Located close to bus and metro connections, with shops only 500 metres away, this hotel is in a prime location. A stroll up Las Ramblas will take guests to the Gothic Quarter, as well as museums such as the Picasso Museum. The Cathedral is nearby and the closest beach is Barceloneta, which is 15 minutes away. Additional facilities include lift access, a café and bar. Internet access wifi is also provided on the rooms and in the common areas. A laundry service and a small parking garage are available for a fee.

98047.description: This beautifully designed hotel is situated on a quiet street in Athens, a short 20-minute drive from the city's business center. Guests are within a 5-minute walk of various shops, cafes, restaurants, and Kifissia Park, with easy access to public transportation. The Museum of Natural History, Olympic Stadium, city center, and Athens International Airport are also just a short drive away. This modern, minimalist hotel focuses on functionality and comfort, emphasizing personalized service. The luxurious guest rooms feature modern amenities, and guests are invited to enjoy the hotel's many facilities and services.

98048.description: Centrally located in Athens, the upscale Periscope Hotel is a 2-minute drive from Syntagma Square and 8 minutes from the Acropolis. This hotel offers 21 guestrooms featuring Tempur-Pedic beds with premium bedding, minibars, and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming and DVD players. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Take advantage of the spa tub, concierge services, and snack bar/deli. Room service is available during limited hours, and to-go breakfasts are offered for a fee. Business amenities include a business center and limo service. Complimentary newspapers are available in the lobby. Nearby attractions include Mount Lycabettus (0. 2 mi), the Benaki Museum (0. 3 mi), and the Athens National Garden (0. 4 mi). Athens Intl. Airport (ATH) is 20. 3 mi away.

98100.description: The hotel is located in the Aksaray-Laleli district, just a short stroll from the historic Sultanahmet district with many historic sights such as the Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia or the Topkapi Palace. The airport is 15 km away. The hotel features 24-hour reception, express check-in and check-out, concierge service, currency exchange, free WIFI throughout, restaurant, bar, medical assistance, laundry service, car hire and on-site parking (charges apply).

98115.description: The Best Western Hotel am Spittelmarkt is situated in a peaceful side street in the heart of the city, a short walk from famous Friedrichstrasse. Due to the central location right by Spittelmarkt, all interesting sights are easily reached within minutes. The nearby underground stop takes you quickly and directly to the two hubs of Alexanderplatz in the east and Zoologischer Garten in the west. You can also easily reach attractions such as the Exhibition Centre, the Branderburg Gate, Gendarmenmarkt Square and Potsdamer Platz with its bars and restaurants. Come and stay in comfortable and modern guest rooms, including family rooms, and enjoy the delicious and varied breakfast buffet to give you a great start to an active day in Berlin. Enjoy our breakfast buffet at the fee of 18. 00 EUR per person per day. The state of Berlin has introduced a city tax , which is additionally to the room rate and is payable locally.

98204.description: This hotel is located in the dynamic business district of Dubai, close to a number of shopping areas, 100 m from Al Reef shopping centre. Restaurants, bars, and the bus and train stations can be found in the immediate vicinity. Enjoy the fitness centre and the outdoor swimming pool or indulge in a treatment in the luxury Spa. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, cloakroom, lift access, a café, restaurant, conference facilities and Wi-Fi. Room and laundry services are also provided. Parking facilities are available to guests arriving by car.

98221.description: This up-scale and world-class hotel enjoys a convenient location in the centre of Río de Janeiro, just a few steps away from the famous Copacabana Beach. The historical centre is also not far away from the premises and the popular Sugar Loaf Mountain is around a 10-minute ride away. Business travellers might also like to know that Rio de Janeiro-Galeao Antonio Carlos Jobim International Airport is around 25 kilometres away. Guests will be able to have an amazing experience at one of the hotel's luxurious guest rooms and suites. All of them are smartly appointed with modern and classical touches to make visitors feel home away from home. Some of them even have breath-taking views over the ocean, adding a special feature to every stay. On the rooftop terrace, guests can exercise at the contemporary fitness centre and afterwards bask in the sun by the infinity-edge swimming pool.

98295.description: Enjoy stunning rooftop terrace views at Aparthotel Hispanos 7 Suiza, located in the heart of Barcelona, just a 4-minute walk from Sagrada Familia. This family-friendly aparthotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a convenient area shuttle (surcharge). Each of the 19 guestrooms features a private balcony, a fully equipped kitchen with a refrigerator and stovetop, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combination and complimentary toiletries. Flat-screen televisions with satellite programming and complimentary wired and wireless internet access are also provided. The hotel is conveniently located near popular attractions such as Casa Batlló (within a 5-minute drive) and offers easy access to Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) via a 24-hour airport shuttle (surcharge).

98306.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a steam room and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy American cuisine at Sant Ambroeus, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in New York? This hotel has 1905 square feet (177 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 379 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars.

98313.description: This 4-star hotel, established in 2007, is conveniently located near Roissy Airport, just 25 km from central Paris. The nearest station is RER B - CDG. All 121 air-conditioned rooms feature a hairdryer and a kitchenette. Breakfast is served from 5:00 am to 10:00 am for an additional fee. Parking is available for €10 per night, and all rooms are non-smoking. A complimentary shuttle service operates between 5:30 am and 10:30 pm on your arrival and departure dates with a fee of 5€ per room. Please contact the hotel at +33 1 39 88 88 42 to arrange pickup at the designated shuttle stop between Terminals 2B and 2D.

98314.description: Located in the heart of Barcelona's Gothic Quarter on the vibrant Calle Ample, this hotel offers convenient access to the city's attractions. Just steps away from public transport, the port, and the city center, it's an ideal base for exploration. Barcelona Airport is a short 15 km journey. The hotel features a currency exchange, a bar, a restaurant, and a dedicated internet area with computers and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Modern, air-conditioned rooms include a TV with international channels, a telephone, a minibar, a laptop safe, and a private bathroom with a shower. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast and relax by the outdoor swimming pool and sun terrace. The suite offers a luxurious spa tub. One dog or cat under 20kg is permitted per room upon request, subject to a nightly fee and deposit.

98376.description: This boutique hotel is nestled in the heart of historic Istanbul, just steps from a bustling commercial area with restaurants and numerous local landmarks such as the monumental Haga Sophia, Topkapi Palace, the Blue Mosque, the Yerebatan Cistern and the Grand Bazaar. Travellers will find Sirkeci railway station within 1. 2 kilometres and tram stop within just a few steps from the property. This magnificent establishment boasts a fabulous architecture, impressive décor and exceptional service with attention to detail. The rooms are carefully designed in luxurious Ottoman style and offer spacious and inviting surroundings, where to kick back and relax at the end of the day. Guests may indulge in exquisite dishes in the glamorous restaurant situated on the 7th floor and offering breath-taking views over dome of Haga Sofia. After all day of meetings or sightseeing, patrons may sip a drink and unwind in the care-free atmosphere of the snug bar.

name.content: Side Alegria Hotel & Spa ADULT ONLY

98533.description: The adult-only Side Alegria Hotel is located in Kumköy Mevkii, just 3km from the ancient city of Side and 7km from Manavgat city center. The hotel offers 293 standard rooms, many with sea or partial sea views. Guests can enjoy a private sandy beach with shuttle service, two outdoor pools, an indoor pool, a waterslide (seasonal), multiple bars, a disco, and a spa and beauty center. Free Wi-Fi is available in all rooms and public areas, including the beach bar. Other amenities include a mini library, shops, and meeting rooms.

98595.address: 7 Derb El Feranne Azbetz - Place Ben Salah Medina
98595.description: The Riad Karmela offers five spacious rooms with twin or double beds, accommodating up to twelve guests. Enjoy the rooftop plunge pool during summer months and full access to the riad's facilities, including a hammam, jacuzzi, massage services, dining, and trip organization. Breakfast is served at the neighboring Riad El Nour. All rooms feature air conditioning and heating, and bathrooms are en-suite. Moroccan and vegetarian cuisine is available at Riad Karmela.

98612.description: This beach hotel is located in one of Brazil's most famous neighbourhoods, just 2 blocks away from the beach. Guests will find a range of dining options and shopping opportunities just metres from the hotel and tourist attractions such as the Sugar Loaf Mountain and the Corcovado are just 15 minutes away by public transport. Public transport links are also close by and the nearest metro station can be reached in 5 minutes on foot. This fully air-conditioned hotel features 50 comfortable rooms, a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out service and a TV lounge. There is a breakfast room where guests can start their day, WLAN Internet access and, for an additional fee, guests can make use of the laundry service provided. Garage parking is also available (fees apply). The hotel offers a concierge service that provides guests with information on tours. All of the rooms are equipped with en suite bathrooms (bath/shower), direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, radio, Internet access, minibar, individually regulated air conditioning and a safety deposit box. Background music is available in the rooms. A breakfast buffet is included.

98613.description: This family-friendly hotel is situated in the centre of Rio de Janeiro. It offers easy access to attractions like Corvocado, Pão de Açúcar, the National Museum and the beautiful beaches. The town centre is just 2 km from the hotel and there guests will find restaurants, bars, pubs and nightlife spots. Public transport links can be found right by the hotel and shops are some 7 km away. Galeão-Antônio Carlos Jobim International Airport is some 25 km from the accommodation. The hotel comprises a total of 146 rooms, each with all the amenities required for a comfortable stay. Fully air-conditioned, it features a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, hotel safe and currency exchange facilities, and is ideal for both business and leisure travellers. Guests will find a hairdressing salon on site, as well as a café, bar, restaurant and TV lounge. Conference facilities are available and WLAN Internet access is provided. Guests can make use of the laundry service and leave their cars in the undercover parking garage. The guest rooms come with en suite shower rooms, as well as amenities including a hairdryer, direct dial telephone, cable TV, radio, Internet access, minibar and safe. Double beds and individually regulated air conditioning units also feature. Breakfast is served in a buffet style, whilst midday and evening meals are available from an à la carte menu. An additional buffet is also served at midday.

98678.description: Enjoy this upscale Marrakech hotel, featuring an outdoor pool, steam room, and on-site dining at Restaurant Marocain, specializing in local cuisine. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, and enjoy the convenience of concierge services, a hair salon, and room service (limited hours). A continental breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Each of the 36 air-conditioned rooms offers a refrigerator, satellite TV, and a private bathroom with a shower. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, laundry facilities, and airport shuttle (surcharge). Located just a short walk from Avenue Mohamed VI and Marrakech Plaza, Hotel Mont Gueliz is centrally located for exploring the city. It's also conveniently close to attractions like Jemaa el-Fnaa and Majorelle Garden.

98710.description: This prestigious hotel enjoys a privileged location in the Cuatro Torres business park complex. The hotel occupies the first 31 floors of the imposing 236-metre-tall SyV Tower. The decor displays an urban, avant-garde personality in line with the exterior appearance of the tower, while the rooms feature warm tones in order to create a more relaxing atmosphere. Enjoy the spectacular views, spanning 360 degrees from the mountains to Plaza Mayor. This hotel is the perfect venue for the highest-level meetings, congresses and conventions.

98711.description: This attractive hotel is located just 2 minutes from a broad, sandy beach and the turquoise waters of the Mediterranean Sea. Several restaurants and bars offer culinary delicacies, various pools and sports facilities invite to be active. The historic town of Side with its ancient sites such as the spectacular Temple of Apollo, the Temple of Athena or the largest amphitheatre of Anatolia is within easy reach.

98733.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace at Astors Belgravia, a centrally located London hotel. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast, served from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of concierge services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Relax in one of the 47 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a flat-screen TV, safe, and desk. The hotel is within a 15-minute walk of Buckingham Palace and Victoria Station, and a short distance from Sloane Square and Harrods.

98813.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge) at the Hotel Bella Venezia. Room service is available during limited hours, and you can unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is offered daily (fee applies). Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and 24-hour front desk. The hotel also has 2 square meters of conference and meeting space. The 24 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Safes, desks, and phones are also provided. Hotel Bella Venezia is centrally located in Venice, steps from the Teatro Goldoni and Palazzo Contarini del Bovolo, and within close proximity of the Rialto Bridge and St. Mark's Square.

98834.description: Situated at the edge of Paris, guests of the hotel may visit such attractions as Parc de la Villette, Cité des Sciences et de l'Industrie, Le Zénith and Disneyland Paris and Parc Astérix (the latter two are 30 minutes away). Orly International Airport, Charles de Gaulle International Airport and Beauvais Tillé Airport are situated approximately 18 km, 20 km and 75 km from the hotel, respectively. The air-conditioned hotel offers 120 rooms, a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service and lift access. A car park is available for an extra charge 24 hours a day. The hotel is open 24 hours a day, all year round. The comfortable and spacious rooms offer guests a place to sleep, relax or even get some work done. The hotel offers its famous courtesy plate in each room with coffee/tea and biscuits. The rooms also have an en suite bathroom with bath and hairdryer, satellite TV, direct dial telephone and free wireless Internet. Further standard in-room amenities include a double bed and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. A breakfast buffet is served each morning. Take the metro line 5 toward Bobigny Pablo Picasso and alight at Hoche station.

98835.description: This hotel occupies an ideal location, near to Paris by metro (line 5), 100 metres from the centre of Bobigny. Guests will find links to the public transport network just 50 metres away and there are shopping venues only 300 metres from the hotel. It lies close to the Parc des Expositions de Villepinte (1. 2 km), the Parc des Expositions du Bourget, Disneyland Paris and the Zénith de Paris arena as well as the Stade de France stadium (9 km). Charles de Gaulle Airport is 15 km and it is 18 km to Orly Airport. This city hotel comprises a total of 113 rooms spread over 5 floors. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a 24-hour reception and check-out service and lift access. There is a bar and a restaurant and guests can take advantage of the conference facilities, TV lounge and car parking. The hotel offers free wifi Internet access in all rooms as well as in the conference rooms, the bar and the restaurant. All the rooms are quiet and spacious and come with a private bathroom with a bathtub and a hairdryer. They are also equipped with a TV with Canal + and satellite channels and offer a courtesy tray with tea, coffee and biscuits. Wifi Internet access is provided free of charge and a direct dial telephone, a double bed, individually adjustable air conditioning and heating come as standard. Guests can enjoy breakfast in buffet form, as well as lunch and dinner.

98853.description: The hotel is situated in the Eixample district, near the city center and many tourist attractions. Its welcoming décor offers a familiar and pleasant ambiance with all the modern conveniences. Facilities at this hotel near Sagrada Familia include a breakfast room with a daily breakfast buffet (7:30–10:30 a. m. ), a TV room, a small meeting room (up to 12 people), and spacious on-site parking. This air-conditioned establishment also offers a 24-hour reception, elevator access, internet access, and room and laundry services. The hotel reserves the right to charge the first night's stay for bookings of more than five rooms upon receipt of the reservation. These bookings are not confirmed until the first night's charge is processed. Special conditions and supplements may apply to bookings of more than five rooms.

98854.description: This hotel is located in a beautiful residential district within walking distance of Saint-Germain-des-Pres, the Latin Quarter, the Orsay and Rodin Museums and the left bank luxury department stores (Bon Marche and the Conran shop). There are many bars and restaurants in the surrounding area and guests will find links to the public transport network just 50 m away. It is 300 m to Les Invalides and 500 m to Montparnasse. Orly Airport is 20 km away and it is 40 km to Charles de Gaulle Airport. This boutique hotel is set in very tranquil surroundings in the heart of Paris and offers guests a lovely inner courtyard and a view over the gardens of Matignon (residence of the French prime minister). It comprises a total of 39 guestrooms decorated in a refined manner and featuring stylish and modern furniture. Housed in a building dating back to 1900 and renovated in 2023, this air-conditioned city hotel offers guests a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service and lift access. There is a breakfast room and guests can take advantage of the room and laundry services for an additional fee. The standard rooms have been fully renovated and are decorated with chic French furniture. They offer a desk, WLAN Internet access, a TV, centrally regulated air conditioning and a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower and a hairdryer. They are also equipped with a direct dial telephone, an ironing set, individually adjustable heating, a double bed, a safe and a terrace. Guests may select their breakfast from a buffet. From Roissy CDG and Orly Airports and from Gare du Nord, take RER B until Denfert Rochereau. Then, take undergroung line 4 to Porte de Clignancourt and stop at Montparnasse-Bienvenüe. And take line 13 to St Denis Université/Gabriel Péri. Stop at St François Xavier station.

98860.address: Avenida do Pepe, 690 - Barra da Tijuca, 690
98860.description: This hotel is set overlooking Pepes Beach, in Barra de Tijuca. Set amidst one of Rio de Janeiro's most modern areas, the hotel is surrounded by bars and pubs. Shopping opportunities can be found just a short driving distance away. Links to the public transport network are just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from the hotel, offering ease of access to many of the city's most prominent sights. This hotel features a modern design. The spacious guest rooms provide serenity and relaxation, seemingly miles away from the bustling city that lies just outside. Guests are invited to savour the delights of international dishes in the restaurant. This hotel is a prime choice for business and leisure travellers visiting Rio de Janeiro.

98893.address: 110, El Barh El Aazam, Corniche El Nile, 110
98893.description: The hotel is near to the Pharaonic Village, with views over the Nile. Design of the hotel combines contemporary elements with traditional pharaonic motives. Rooms and suites are designed for maximum comfort for both individual travellers and families. Restaurants are serving international dishes as well as local delights. *** Customers with Egyptian nationality who stay in the hotel sharing a room must provide a marriage certificate

98919.description: The Mercure Paris Montparnasse Raspail hotel boasts an ideal location in the heart of Paris's Latin Quarter. Steps from the Luxembourg Gardens and a short stroll from Saint-Germain-des-Prés and Saint-Michel, it offers a quintessential Parisian experience. Conveniently located near public transportation, the hotel is a five-minute walk from Gare Montparnasse and easily accessible by Metro (lines 4, 6, 12, and 13) to other main train stations.

name.content: Mercure Paris Porte De Versailles Expo

98923.description: Welcoming you in its immense atrium bathed in light, Mercure Paris Porte de Versailles Expo is ideal for a family stay with its connecting rooms. Popular with delegates and business travellers, our Vanves hotel also is there for your professional events with its 18 seminar rooms, total capacity of 300 people. You can count on our lounge bar and our restaurant serving French and international dishes.

98924.description: Discover our recently renovated hotel, located in the heart of the Courtaboeuf business park and close to Saclay. The 4-star Mercure Paris Sud Les Ulis hotel is ideal for your business meetings, visiting Paris or unwinding with friends around the swimming pool in summer or the fireplace in winter. Our spacious and comfortable rooms all offer a relaxing atmosphere

98926.description: For your business trip or family getaway, enjoy the comfort of a 4-star room at the B&B Hôtel Cergy Port 4 étoiles. The hotel is just a 9-minute walk from the RER A train station - you will be in the center of Paris in 40 minutes. Enjoy the charms of the ca pital or discover the treasures along the Impressionists Route that passes through the region. Make your seminars a success with our eleven meeting rooms, contemporary restaurant and bar. Make the most of life on the outskirts of Paris at B&B Cergy Port.

98927.description: The Novotel Paris Créteil Le Lac, renovated in April 2019, invites you for a stay by the shore in a lush green setting. Enjoy a room with a lakeside view for a guaranteed change of scenery. Discover the beautiful terrace with the swimming pool. The restaurant has homemade brasserie-style cuisine. Enjoy our free and secure parking lot with electric charging stations. Take a break at a green oasis just 10 minutes from Paris, enjoy cocktails on the terrace, a game of petanque, or a refreshing dip in our outdoor pool. The Novotel Paris Creteil Le Lac has received theGreen Key socio-environmental certification.

name.content: Novotel Domaine de Maffliers - Paris Val-d'Oise

98928.description: Just 12. 4 miles (20 km) from Paris, immerse yourself in nature at the Novotel Domaine De Maffliers - Demeure De Campagne. Ideal for romantic weekends, family trips, private events, or seminars, the hotel offers 99 rooms, three reception rooms, nine meeting rooms, a contemporary restaurant, and a British-style bar. Explore nearby attractions such as the Château de Chantilly and the Enghien-les-Bains casino. Relax and revitalize in our indoor pool and sauna during your stay in Ile-de-France at Novotel.

98929.address: Allée des Portes de la Forêt, 2
98929.description: Enjoy a business or leisure stay near Paris at Novotel Marne-la-Vallée Collégien, a hotel with 18 renovated, unique meeting rooms and a spacious outdoor car park free for guests. We invite you to rejuvenate in our fitness room or the outdoor pool, open during summer months. With family or friends, have fun in our indoor or outdoor game areas. Then discover the gourmet menu of our restaurant, which features a sunny terrace.

98930.description: Located in a wooded park, halfway between Massy & Palaiseau, Novotel Massy Palaiseau offers a perfect setting for private/business events thanks to its 8 modular daylit meeting rooms. With Family Rooms, our Palaiseau hotel appeals to children with its outdoor pool and beautiful terrace. Come & enjoy small dishes in our bar and restaurant in a welcoming room with contemporary design

98931.address: Rue Michel Ange Carrefour De L Europe, 65
98931.description: Located in the heart of the most important business area of Europe and the future Grand Paris Express, the recently renovated 4-star Novotel Paris Nord Expo will welcome you during your professional and personal stays. Come discover new flavors at our gourmet bar restaurant for lunch or dinner. Every week, the Chef creates using fresh produce. Enjoy our many services, incl. outdoor pool and free WiFi.

98932.description: Located close to the Bourget and Villepeinte Parcs des Expositions, the Musee de l air et de l espace, Parc Asterix and the Stade de France, the Mercure Paris Le Bourget hotel has stylish rooms. Easy to access from the highway networks A1, A3 and A104 and 15 min from the Roissy Charles de Gaulle Airport. After a day of work in one of our meeting rooms, relax in the restaurant, on the pool-side terrace or by savoring a glass of wine at the hotel bar.

98933.description: Welcome to Novotel Évry-Courcouronnes, a recently renovated space featuring a chic and trendy interior decor. Ideal for business meetings with five conference rooms and an enclosed car park, our hotel in Évry-Courcouronnes also attracts families, thanks to an indoor garden and outdoor playground and swimming pool. Take time out to rejuvenate in our fitness room. Enjoy drinks on one of our terraces, and savour regional products in our two restaurants.

98934.description: Discover the Novotel Poissy Orgeval hotel, located just 20 minutes from the La Défense business district. With 10 meeting rooms, the hotel is perfect for your seminars and conferences. Relax in the comfortable rooms and then treat yourself to a delicious meal in the bright and stylish restaurant with terrace. In the summer, dive into the pool or give your wedding reception the grandeur it deserves in the extensive indoor and outdoor spaces. Take life as it comes at Novotel.

98935.description: The Novotel Paris Saclay hotel is located just 11. 2 miles (18 km) from Paris, in the heart of the Greater Paris scientific and university center. The hotel offers light, modern rooms for couples and families. Outdoor pool, mini golf course, tennis and ind oor and outdoor games. Our 15 meeting rooms have everything you need for meetings and seminars. After a day of work or a visit to the Château de Versailles, take a moment to relax on the terrace at Novotel.

98944.description:
Ideal for a business trip or Parisian getaway, Mercure Paris 15 Porte de Versailles welcomes you in the 15th district. A short walk from Porte de Versailles Exhibition Center, the hotel is perfect for trade fairs and events. Enjoy comfortable workspaces and meeting rooms bathed in natural light. Our hotel is appreciated by business travelers and families wishing to discover Paris in complete serenity. 

Between Rue de Vaugirard and Rue Lecourbe, in Paris' 15th district, the hotel enjoys a prime location 765 yards from Paris Expo Porte de Versailles and Palais des Sports. 20-min walk from the Eiffel Tower and Champ-de-Mars, it is easy to discover the capital's top sights. Nearby metro lines 8 and 12 for quick access to central Paris, while Orly and Paris-Charles-de-Gaulle airports are easily accessible. 

Take advantage of your business or leisure stay to discover Parisian district that mixes authenticity, tranquility and commerce: Rue du Commerce, Parc des Expositions, Eiffel Tower, banks of the Seine.

name.content: Hotel Mercure Paris Centre Gare Montparnasse

98945.description: 5 min from Gare Montparnasse TGV, 4-star Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse Hotel welcomes you in the famous Rue de la Gaîté. Combine work & leisure, benefiting from our friendly spaces, for brainstorming and studying. Our fully renovated hotel has everything for a successful stay: Gourmet cuisine, wine tastings, comfortable & colorful rooms, everything is there for a relaxing break, in an offbeat setting!

98948.description: The Mercure Paris Bercy Bibliothèque hotel, located just a stone's throw from the POPB AccorHotels Arena, Austerlitz train station, the François-Mitterrand Library and Bercy Village, offers comfortable rooms with free WIFI. Metro line 6 is outside the hot el, providing you with easy access to central Paris and the Gare Montparnasse, Gare du Nord and Gare d'Austerlitz train stations. Its proximity to metro line 14 and the Gare de Lyon train station make it easily accessible.

98949.description: You will get a warm welcome at the Novotel Paris Centre Bercy, opposite the Accor Arena and next to Bercy park. The hotel has been fully restyled, with modern and comfortable rooms to suit all needs, and 7 naturally lit and modular, smart lounges for your events. The Paris Bercy restaurant serves bistro cuisine in a bright and spacious dining room, and you will find platters and cocktails at the bar.

name.content: Mercure Paris Opera Faubourg Montmartre Hotel

98954.description: A charming hotel in the heart of the capital, Mercure Paris Opera Faubourg Montmartre is set against a 1930s backdrop with a splendid Art Deco facade. Stroll to the nearby Galeries Lafayette. Enjoy evenings in the lively Opera district with its theaters and restaurants, then soak up the Montmartre ambience. After a day sightseeing, take a refreshing tot at the decorative Le Josephine bar.

98956.description: Admire the dance of the airplanes from your fully renovated room. Located in the heart of the airport, the hotel offers spacious, soundproofed and air-conditioned rooms and suites that are ideal for families. Relax in our bar or sit back in the Novotel Café restaurant during your layover; you're only a few minutes from the airport terminals. Take advantage of the hotel's five meeting rooms for your seminars and business meetings.

98957.description: Located close to the palace of Louis XIV, the Sun King, Novotel Château de Versailles welcomes you to a family-friendly establishment. The hotel is in a tranquil and unspoilt setting, making it ideal for relaxation. Enjoy the restaurant, a lounge bar with 24-hour dining service, and play spaces for children and adults alike. Also geared towards business guests, our venue offers 5 meeting rooms and a private car park. Join us for a peaceful stay, whether you are here for work or leisure.

name.content: Mercure Paris Vaugirard Porte De Versailles Hotel

98967.description: Located in the 15th arrondissement, Mercure Paris Vaugirard Porte de Versailles boasts 91 spacious rooms and family suites. With the Eiffel Tower as a central element, the decor is quintessentially Parisian. Bordering the Porte de Versailles exhibition centre, it is the perfect coworking space for a business stay. The hotel, situated in the former workshop of racecar great Amédée Gordini, offers 10 meeting rooms, as well as dining services in our modern room that can accommodate up to 130 people.

98969.description: Discover the Novotel St Quentin Golf National hotel, only 18. 6 miles (30 km) from Paris. Ideal for a stay for golf or with family, this fully renovated hotel offers 131 air-conditioned rooms, 10 meeting rooms for your seminars and private events and 346 a cres (140 hectares) of green space, perfect for combining work and relaxation and organizing your teambuilding activities. Take some time out in the greenery of the Novotel St Quentin Golf National hotel

98970.description: Renovated in 2023, the Novotel Suresnes Longchamp hotel is located in the west of Paris, 10 minutes from La Défense and Porte Maillot conference center. The 4-star hotel has 112 spacious, comfortable and soundproofed rooms with free WIFI. There is also a children's play area, a cozy bar, a bright, modern restaurant, a private car park (charges apply) and 8 fully equipped, modular meeting rooms. Enjoy a pleasant stay in Paris with Novotel!

98974.description: Located in the heart of the business district of Massy, 2min from the TGV train station and RER B, C, we are waiting for you to have a drink in our nice bar lounge, to offer you lunch Made in Massy, or rest for a night in our incredibly cozy range of beds. Here it's like home, but it's our team that takes care of you!

99009.description: Hôtel Scribe has been beating to Paris' vibrant rhythm for over 150 years. This key venue in Parisian life is now writing a new page in its history. The new design by Tristan Auer (Wilson Associates) combines impeccable service in a Haussmann residence in the city center. On the right bank between Opéra Garnier and Place Vendôme, its location is ideal for enjoying the best of Paris during your getaway.

99014.description: Our hotel is being renovated to enhance your experience! Each change is carefully thought out to guarantee a pleasant stay in a comfortable and welcoming setting. Novotel Paris Les Halles welcomes you in the heart of the capital. This modern and cozy hotel has excellent public transport links and is perfect for a romantic weekend or family stay. Access Notre-Dame, La Samaritaine and the Louvre on foot.

99033.description: The 4-star hotel affords an exquisite location in Berlin's green outskirts, with the comfort of the northern periphery and at the same time proximity to the vibrant capital of Germany. Both Friedrichstrasse and Potsdamer Platz at the centre of Berlin may easily be reached by public transport. Those with a car may take advantage of the complimentary parking at the hotel. A car may also be rented at the hotel reception and tickets for events and museums purchased via the Mercure ticket service. The VDR-certified 4-star hotel features four meeting rooms for up to 80 persons.

99034.description: The Mercure Berlin Tempelhof in the trendy Kreuzkoelln neighborhood is ideal for leisure and business guests. Start off the day in our fitness center or refuel at the generous breakfast buffet. Our large meeting area offers the perfect environment for meetings and training events, while our restaurant and hotel bar are the ideal place to take stock of your day before returning to your spacious room.

99038.description:
Enjoy memorable stay at the recently renovated Novotel Zurich Airport Messe with the motto, 'Modern Easy Living'. 
Reach the airport and the city centre within minutes with the tram links. 
The 4-star hotel in Zurich offers many comforts: 
Large, modern rooms with air conditioners, free Wi-Fi, sauna and gym. 
For seminars and meetings, Novotel Zurich can serve about 320 people.

99039.description:
Make yourself at home at the 4-star and family-friendly Novotel, just a stone's throw away from Brussels' iconic Grand-Place. Our quiet and spacious rooms supply you with a wonderful place to work or relax and are fully equipped with a minibar, desk, sofa, air conditioning and free WiFi. Start your day off right with our delicious breakfast buffet and take a moment to unwind at the terrace later in the day. The reception is at your service 24/7 and the Novotel offers a fitness centre and room service. 


We’re improving our restaurant area for your future comfort. 
Don’t worry — breakfast is always guaranteed!

name.content: Le Louise Hotel Brussels - Mgallery Collection

99041.address: 40 Avenue de la Toison d Or
99041.description: Ideally located on the prestigious Avenue Louise, Le Louise Hotel Brussels – MGallery blends elegance, creativity, and the city's unique Belgitude. Just a short walk from iconic landmarks and luxury boutiques, the hotel is a refined yet playful urban retreat. Discover Le Jardin Suspendu, a 400 sqm hidden garden offering a peaceful escape for relaxing, gathering, or enjoying cultural events. At the heart of the hotel is Maison Louise, a chic lounge, bar, and restaurant serving seasonal, shareable cuisine and inventive cocktails. The rooms and exclusive Homage Suites pay tribute to Brussels icons like Audrey Hepburn and the creator of The Smurfs through curated art and memorabilia. With versatile event spaces and a warm, welcoming spirit, Le Louise is the ideal destination for both business and leisure travelers seeking comfort, style, and authenticity in the heart of the capital.

99045.description: The hotel is located a 30-minute train ride from the centre of Brussels. This city hotel is the ideal base for a business trip to the Belgian capital or to the Heysel Exhibition Park. It offers guests the convenience of a free 24-hour shuttle to Brussels Airport. The establishment features 209 modern and comfortable guestrooms equipped with all amenities visitors may need during their stay. 9 modular meeting rooms are available for the use of guests travelling on corporate errands. In their leisure time visitors can enjoy a workout in the fitness centre or a dip in the swimming pool. The bar and restaurant, which are open until midnight, boast views of the well-tended garden.

99051.description: The hotel Mercure Wien Zentrum is situated right in the historical heart of Vienna - a phenomenal central location, pulsating with the city's business and cultural life. St. Stephen's Cathedral, the State Opera House, Hofburg Imperial Palace, Museum Quarter and exclusive shopping streets are all within walking distance. The ideal location for a perfect stay: modern Privilege and Standard Rooms, customer-tailored service with that Viennese charm and world-famous Viennese cuisine.

99057.description: Located in the heart of Paris, the Mercure Paris Opera Lafayette hotel offers convenient access to iconic landmarks such as the Palais Garnier and Boulevard Haussmann, both within a 15-minute walk. Galeries Lafayette and Les Halles are also nearby. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, a coffee shop/cafe, room service, and a bar/lounge. The 40 guestrooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, and in-room safes. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk and express check-out.

99060.description: In the peaceful green setting of Essonne, at the intersection of major highways and city gates on the outskirts of Paris, discover this fully renovated and air conditioned hotel. Our teams look forward to welcoming you and are available now to organize a business meeting, banquet or simply a peaceful family break on the way to your main destination.

99061.address: 8 bis avenue de la Soeur Rosalie
99061.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This hotel also features concierge services, a living plant wall, and a banquet hall. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A shuttle from the hotel to the airport is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 60 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Place d'Italie - 0. 2 km / 0.

99062.description: The Mercure Paris La Défense Grande Arche hotel welcomes tourists and business travelers alike. It is located 55 yards (50 m) from the Nanterre Préfecture RER A train station, 219 yards (200 m) from the U Arena, home to numerous sporting events, and 328 yards (300 m) from the Grande Arche. Les Quatre Temps shopping center is a 10-minute walk away. Take advantage of our rooms, fitness center and interior terrace. We also have 11 seminar rooms.

99063.address: 9 Place E.F. Choiseul, Avenue du centre
99063.description: Our 4-star B&B HOTEL Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines Centre Gare welcomes you 24/7, year-round. We offer 74 single and double rooms across six floors, accessible by elevator. Each air-conditioned room features carefully selected bedding for a restful night's sleep, a private bathroom, a flat-screen TV, and free, unlimited Wi-Fi. A luggage rack is also provided for your convenience. For the comfort of all guests, our hotel is entirely non-smoking. Pets are welcome.

99064.description: Breakfast and unlimited WIFI are included in the price at the ibis Styles Evry Cathédrale. Located in the center of Evry, opposite the cathedral and town hall and close to the Agora shopping mall. 55 yards (50 m) from the Evry-Courcouronnes RER train stat ion (30 minutes from Paris) and 20 minutes from Paris by car. The hotel has 110 contemporary rooms, a restaurant, a bar and meeting/banqueting areas.

name.content: Mercure Paris Arc De Triomphe Wagram Hotel

99067.description: Located very close to the Palais des Congrès and the Champs Elysées, only ten minutes from the La Défense business district, this hotel is appreciated for its cosy designer ambience. A warm welcome which invites you to relax after a day working or shopping in the capital. In a family room, enjoy a delicious breakfast before setting off to discover Paris.

99074.description: The 4-star Mercure Hotel Berlin City is centrally located and ideal for tourists or business travelers. Our 246 rooms have A/C and free WIFI. We have 6 air-conditioned conference rooms with up-to-date technology for your events. Arrival: The main train station is just 0. 6 miles (1 km) away. It is 3. 1 miles (5 km) from the A100 highway. The U-Bahn stops right at the hotel.

99075.description: Stay at the Hotel Luc, Autograph Collection, in Berlin's Mitte district, and you'll be just a short drive from Checkpoint Charlie and the Brandenburg Gate. This hotel is also conveniently close to Alexanderplatz and Potsdamer Platz. Enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center and complimentary Wi-Fi. Relax in one of the 92 comfortable guest rooms, each featuring a pillowtop bed with down comforters and premium bedding. Bathrooms are equipped with showers. Start your day with a continental breakfast, available for a fee. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk and an elevator.

99097.description: Set down your bags and relax at the luxurious Sofitel hotel. Set in the heart of Brussels, in direct connection to the Grand Place, next to the European District, Sofitel Brussels Europe is a truly elegant hotel, ideally located on the vibrant Place Jourdan, one of the last typical Brussels atmosphere square. Close to the famous Cinquantenaire park and several museums, the hotel offers the best location for all trips. Enjoy traditional food market on Sundays and the typical 'Ambiance Bruxelloise'.

name.content: Ramada by Wyndham Amsterdam Airport Schiphol

99099.description: Thank you for choosing our Ramada hotel. Ramada is a global upper midscale hotel brand with over 820 properties located in over 50 countries worldwide. Most Ramada hotels feature free wired and wireless high-speed internet access meeting rooms business services fitness facilities and upgraded bath amenities. Many properties have an on-site restaurant lounge while other sites offer a complimentary continental breakfast.

99106.description: Hotel Stoller, open since 1938!Welcome to Hotel Stoller in Zurich. Watch the hustle and bustle at Albisriederplatz from our terrace or grab a tram that will take you to Zurich's most exciting places almost every minute. To the famous Bahnhofstrasse with it’s extraordinary shops, to the cozy squares at Lake Zurich with a breathtaking view to the Alps or to Langstrasse with its pulsating nightlife. Welcome to Zurich West – the perfect starting point to experience the city with all your senses!

99108.description: Take a break at the Novotel Suites Genève Aeroport hotel. For a family vacation or business trip, this 4-star hotel boasts comfortable suites that can be converted into meeting areas. Enjoy a workout in the fitness room, open from 6:30am to 10:30pm, and sample delicious dishes in the dining area or in the privacy of your suite. Relax on the banks of Lake Geneva or take a stroll through the city streets. Enjoy a calming and rejuvenating stay at Novotel Suites.

name.content: Ibis Styles Parc des Expositions de Villepinte

99117.description: Located right beside the Paris Nord Villepinte Exhibition Center and its RER train station, on the outskirts of Paris and close to the Paris Roissy Charles De Gaulle and Bourget airports, the 3-star ibis Styles Parc des Expositions hotel welcomes you for business or family stays. We have 85 air-conditioned rooms, a seminar room, private car park and free WIFI. Enjoy a nice glass of wine at the bar, in our Courtepaille restaurant or on its lovely terrace.

99133.description: Located a short walk from the Gare de l'Est train station and 7 mins from the Gare du Nord train station, enjoy direct access to Paris's airports. This hotel allows you to explore the real Paris and its famous history at ease from the heart of the city. Fancy wandering around the department stores, strolling through the streets of Montmartre or walking by Canal Saint Martin? Our hotel is the ideal base for your stay!

99142.description: Located on the Left Bank in Paris, bordering the 5th and 6th arrondissements, the 4-star Mercure La Sorbonne St Germain hotel sits opposite the Sorbonne University, nestled among the trees of the Latin Quarter and Saint-Germain des Prés. Easily accessible by RER Line B or the Saint-Michel and Cluny-La Sorbonne metro stations, this boutique hotel features contemporary decor and air-conditioned rooms, perfect for a relaxing stay after a day of Parisian shopping.

99153.description: Located in central Paris, the Hôtel Haussmann Saint Augustin is within a 15-minute walk of the Palais Garnier and Place de la Concorde. This hotel is 2. 4 miles from Notre Dame and the Eiffel Tower. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The 34 guest rooms feature minibars, flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Room service is available during limited hours, and you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. The hotel also offers complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

name.content: Mercure Hotel & Residenz Berlin Checkpoint Charlie

99157.description: It's just a short walk from the chic shops and bustling life of Friedrichstrasse and the Gendarmenmarkt - and yet, as a guest of the 4-star Mercure Hotel & Residenz Berlin Checkpoint Charlie, you will have a quiet and comfortable stay. Our spacious 117 rooms have air conditioning and free WiFi, many rooms have balconies or terraces facing the green courtyard.

99160.description: The Residence Studio Geneve Centre is located in the heart of the Paquis district, close to the Lake Geneva, Cornavin train station and about 15 minutes from the UN, Geneva airport and the Palexpo Exhibition Center. Guests can take advantage of free public transport and Wi-Fi access. Check-in is at the neighboring Novotel, where breakfast, lunch and dinner are also served. Undercover car park is available at extra cost.

99165.description: Why choose between comfort and location? For your next stay in Paris, book a 30 m² suite at Novotel Suites Paris Montreuil Vincennes. From the Nespresso machine to the bathroom with shower and bathtub, few Parisian addresses offer such comfort. Children have a dedicated space to read and play, adults have the gym. From breakfast to aperitif, everyone can enjoy the relaxation + dining area.

99166.description: Novotel Berlin Mitte on Spree Island is within walking distance of Museum Island in Berlin. Located between Potsdamer Platz and Alexanderplatz, this 4 star hotel offers a play area and family rooms. Rooms with work space & free WiFi as well as 6 meeting rooms are also ideal for business guests. Enjoy the Mediterranean cuisine or relax in the sauna after a workout in the fitness area.

99169.description: Treat yourself to a large room with all the comfort and space you need, close to Roissy Charles de Gaulle Airport and Villepinte Exhibition Center. Our hotel has contemporary, spacious suites (which can be adapted) spanning 323 sq. ft. for up to 4 people. Ideal for work or family stays. We look forward to seeing you every evening for our brand-new dining concept at the DUNDY Bar.

99170.address: 31 Avenue Jules Rimet, Saint Denis La Plaine, 31
99170.description: Comfort and freedom at Novotel Suites Stade de France. 323 sq. ft. well equipped suites to accommodate up to 4 people. Tea or espresso, an energizing shower or a soothing bath: at any time of day or night. Enjoy home comfort with the memory foam mattress, microwave and refrigerator. A 4-star hotel with 101 rooms, 24/7 fitness center and Boutique Gourmande with prepared meals, salads and desserts.

99172.description: Just 15 minutes from Paris, discover the B&B HOTEL Vélizy Est hotel. Located opposite the Vélizy 2 shopping complex, close to the Palace of Versailles, this fully renovated 4-star hotel boasts spacious and modern Suites measuring 323 sq. ft. (30 m² ) with fiber-optic Internet and a free TV package (Canal +, beIN, etc. ). Situated close to the Thoiry animal park, France Miniature, Haras de Jardy and the Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines leisure center, find the perfect base for your visit at B&B HOTEL Vélizy Est.

name.content: B&B HOTEL Paris Grand Roissy CDG Aéroport

99174.description: Ideal for business or leisure stays, B&B HOTEL Paris Grand Roissy CDG Aéroport features spacious 30 m² suites that can also be adapted as workspaces. Each suite comes fully equipped with a microwave, refrigerator and Nespresso machine. If you need a snack, our hotel in Roissy-en-France offers a 24/7 gourmet boutique and a generous breakfast, which we invite you to enjoy on the sunny terrace during warmer months. Take time to unwind in our fitness room, and enjoy a free seated massage every Thursday evening.

99178.description: The Mercure Cergy Pontoise Centre hotel is 500m from the RER station A Cergy Préfecture and 35km from Paris, 40 mins from CDG and Orly airports and Villepinte and Le Bourget Exhibition Parks. This contemporary hotel offers elegantly furnished bedrooms with A/C. Warm welcome, quality amenities and modern equipment: All you need to work or relax in a soothing setting. Ideal for seminars or family stays.

99181.description: In the modern rooms of the 4-star Novotel Berlin Am Tiergarten hotel, families, business travelers and tourists alike will all feel right at home. Free WIFI and a desk space in the rooms make preparing for conferences remarkably easy. Eleven meeting rooms are available for up to 350 people. The central location of the hotel is ideal for exploring the capital. End your evening in our bar or restaurant or take some time out to relax in our fitness and spa area.

name.content: Novotel Suites Berlin City Potsdamer Platz

99184.description: The 3-star Novotel Suites Berlin City Potsdamer Platz hotel invites you to enjoy a relaxing stay in Berlin in our 323-sq. ft. (30-m²) suites. The Suites are equipped with kitchenette, double bed and extra bed, shower, bathtub and separate toilet. Start the day with our extensive buffet breakfast and put the day to bed at the hotel bar.

99188.description: Just 10 minutes from Parc de la Villette and 15 minutes from Montmartre, discover the B&B HOME Paris Nord 18emeème hotel. Located in the 18th arrondissement, 1. 9 mi (3 km) from the Gare du Nord train station and the Stade de France, this 4-star hotel boasts spacious and modern Suites measuring 323 sq. ft. (30 m²) with fiber-optic Internet and free TV package (Canal+). Close to the Villepinte exhibition center and Charles de Gaulle Airport, choose your perfect stay at B&B HOME Paris Nord 18eme.

99190.description: Welcome to Novotel Paris 17, located in the 17th arrondissement only a few steps away from the So Ouest shopping centre. This sleek hotel offers spacious guest rooms and Executive rooms with views of the Eiffel Tower. But above all, this is a place where you immediately feel at home. Take time out to unwind in the 24-hour gym while the kids have fun in the play areas. With a loved one, as a family or solo, indulge in delicious moments in our bar-restaurant.

99192.description: Located in the heart of a quintessential Parisian suburb in the 13th arrondissement, Mercure Paris Place d'Italie immerses you in a world of haute couture with its fashion-inspired decor and display of designer gowns.
