In this completely renovated hotel are a meeting room and elegant guest accommodation, including four family rooms and Privilege rooms with views of the Eiffel Tower. Each morning, we are pleased to serve a delicious breakfast featuring regional fare from a small market nearby.

99206.description: Located in the prestigious 8th arrondissement of Paris, the Hôtel Royal Madeleine is just a few steps away from Place de la Madeleine and Opéra Garnier, offering easy access to the city's main historical and cultural monuments as well as the most popular shopping districts. Surrounded by luxury boutiques, bars, and restaurants, it is also close to famous department stores and Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré. The 60 spacious rooms offer a contemporary and warm style with air conditioning, flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi, and tea and coffee making facilities. A buffet breakfast is served every morning in the hotel's bright breakfast room from 7:00 a. m. to 10:30 a. m. , and from 7:30 a. m. to 11:00 a. m. on weekends, while the elegant Bar Talaé offers drinks and tapas from 5:00 p. m. to midnight. The Arboré restaurant is open Monday to Friday from 12:00 PM to 2:30 PM. The hotel also has a 24-hour front desk and multilingual staff. Please note: Local tourist tax is not included in the booked rate and will be charged directly to guests by the hotel upon check-in/check-out. A deposit of €100 per night per room will be required upon check-in, payable by credit card.

99208.description: Located in Vienna's historic heart, surrounded by grand art and music venues, the elegant Hotel am Konzerthaus awaits. Be inspired by its enchanting history, becoming the star guest both backstage and onstage! Comfortable rooms impress with exquisite style, featuring striking theatrical elements. The corridor evokes a backstage area, while the living spaces shine—inviting you to take center stage.

99213.description: Mercure Paris Orly Rungis Airport is the ideal base for your business or leisure trips. There is a hearty breakfast buffet with varied regional fare, and the Terminal restaurant has a menu for all tastes, with dining facilities on the terrace, in the restaurant or as room service. The spacious bedrooms provide all the comforts for relaxing throughout your stay.

99222.description: Situated on the edge of Bois de Vincennes, near Paris Bercy Village and Accor Arena, our Charenton-le-Pont hotel is ideally located for business and family stays. Ranked the number one place to live in Île-de-France, the hotel offers easy access to Gare de Lyon (1. 9 miles with a direct bus every 15 minutes) and Orly (7. 5 miles) and CDG (14. 3 miles) airports. Metro line 8, Liberté station, is a short walk away, providing a 15-minute connection to Bastille station in the city center.

99223.description: Welcome to Hotel Mercure Wien City! Our serene, newly renovated 4-star hotel seamlessly merges the elegance and craftsmanship of Vienna's early 20th-century Workshop, offering a perfect balance of timeless charm and contemporary comfort. With 123 beautifully designed rooms, you'll enjoy top-tier amenities and refined style. Begin your day with a delicious breakfast buffet featuring regional specialties, and relax with a selection of fine Austrian wines at our inviting 24-hour bar.

99226.description:
The Hotel Secession an der Oper is situated in the historical center of Vienna, in the Mariahilf district. Vienna's main tourist attractions (such as the Vienna State Opera House, St. Stephan's Cathedral and various museums) are just a short walk away. The hotel offers spacious, air-conditioned rooms (during the summer months) and an indoor car park to make your stay as comfortable as possible. Our family-run hotel has a fantastic view of the golden cupola of the Vienna Secession. Traditional Viennese hospitality, cozy atmosphere, spacious, optimally appointed rooms and an attentive team who care about your wellbeing look forward to your visit!

***City tax payable on the spot 5% per person per night.

99227.description: In the Novotel Suites Wien City Donau hotel, you will be staying in the heart of the city, close to St. Stephen's Cathedral, the Prater and the Donauinsel. For all major attractions, the U-Bahn is very close to the hotel. The spacious 323 sq. ft. suites have a bathtub, shower and separate toilet. The kitchenette with microwave, modular furniture and movable partition for the children's sleeping area make you feel right at home. End your day in the fitness room or by relaxing in the peaceful hotel garden

99232.description: The 4-star Mercure Hotel Potsdam City is located in the historic city center, opposite the historic Potsdam City Palace. All 210 air-conditioned rooms offer Wi-Fi. The top floors boast fantastic views of Potsdam and its surrounding lakes. Thirteen meeting rooms, some situated on the top floors, can accommodate events of up to 200 people. The main train station is just a short walk away. If traveling by car, take the A115 highway. Berlin Brandenburg Airport is 25 miles (40 km) away.

99234.address: 21 Avenue Edouard Belin, Reuil sur Seine, 21
99234.description: The ideal partner for your professional events, Novotel Paris Rueil Malmaison has available 14 meeting rooms, an amphitheatre and a comfortable coworking space in the Gourmet Bar. Also welcoming families and leisure travellers, our hotel in Rueil-Malmaison offers a fitness room, electric bikes for hire and modern rooms with a sleek decor. For gourmet moments, you will find a menu of organic and vegan wines, as well as a selection of delicious dishes in our street-art inspired restaurant.

name.content: Le Stendhal Place Vendome Hotel Paris Mgallery

99235.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 21 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. LED televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Place Vendôme - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Grands Boulevards - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Paris Olympia - 0.

99236.description: Located in a former Haussmann mansion right next to the Passage des Princes, the Hotel Mercure Paris Opéra Louvre offers comfortable, modern rooms with photographs by Michel Fraile. This fully renovated boutique hotel in Paris has preserved the late 19th century architecture in several rooms where you can enjoy a breakfast of local produce. And our gourmet shop is available if you're feeling peckish.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Berlin City Centre

99250.description: This modern Holiday Inn Express® Berlin City Centre hotel, located near Potsdamer Platz, offers next-generation bedrooms and is a short walk from the vibrant Friedrichstrasse, known for its dining and shopping. A 30-minute drive from Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER), the hotel provides secure underground parking for a daily fee. The remnants of the Berlin Wall, the lively Potsdamer Platz, and Checkpoint Charlie are within a 15-minute walk. U-Bahn and S-Bahn stations are also easily accessible, connecting you to Alexanderplatz, the Jewish Museum, and Brandenburg Gate. Enjoy a variety of cultural events and concerts at the Tempodrom next door, and explore diverse culinary options just steps from the hotel. Amenities include inclusive Wi-Fi, a complimentary Express Start™ Breakfast, and a fully equipped meeting room. The welcoming, air-conditioned guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs, flexible workspaces, blackout curtains, and pillow menus for a restful night's sleep. The Lobby Bar offers a wide selection of soft drinks, German beers, and international wines.

99264.description: 5 minutes from the Bercy Gate, Mercure Paris Ivry Quai de Seine offers rooms overlooking the river for a relaxing stay. Enjoyed by business travelers, our hotel in Ivry-sur-Seine has 10 meeting rooms and a business lounge to host your meetings. We offer tasty French cuisine with fresh seasonal produce, but also a gourmet, healthy breakfast, and a cozy bar.

99282.address: 19 rue Philippe de Dangeau, Angle rue Montbauron
99282.description: In the heart of historic and commercial Montbauron, Mercure Versailles Chateau ensures a calm stay in a charming hotel. With 60 rooms fully renovated in 2020, our hotel still has a family feel. Enjoy produce from local businesses for breakfast and meal options from our Boutique Gourmande. Make traveling easier with our private car park available on reservation, 10 spots excl. people carriers and 4x4s.

99294.description:
WELCOME TO DOUBLETREE BY HILTON PARIS BOUGIVAL
Discover our accommodation near VersaillesA contemporary hotel in a quiet suburb, with handy transport links to central Paris. 
The Doubletree by Hilton Paris Bougival is located beside the River Seine in the leafy suburb of Bougival. The A86 motorway is nearby and secure parking is available. It's less than an hour by road from both Paris' airports, and the city centre is about 15 km away. Bougival train station is a few minutes away. Explore the riverside views of Bougival, known as the for its links to Monet, Renoir and other painters. The Château de la Malmaison, the former home of Napoleon Bonaparte, is a short bus ride away. It's about 20 minutes by taxi to the astonishing Château de Versailles, with its extravagant architecture and landscaped gardens. Business visitors can make use of the hotel's 18 well-equipped meeting rooms, which can hold up to 300 people. The business centre and free WiFi help guests stay connected and on top of deadlines. The hotel is 10 minutes' drive from La Défense and three minutes from Rueil 2000 business centre.

99295.description: Centrally located in Paris, the luxurious InterContinental Paris le Grand, an IHG Hotel, is steps from the Paris Olympia and a short walk from the Palais Garnier. This hotel offers 470 guest rooms featuring pillowtop beds with down comforters, Egyptian cotton sheets, minibars, and Smart TVs. Guests can enjoy complimentary wired and wireless internet access, private bathrooms with designer toiletries, and satellite programming. Indulge in the full-service spa with massages and body treatments or take advantage of the sauna and 24-hour fitness center. The hotel also provides concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and a business center. Dine at the Café de la Paix restaurant or enjoy room service and the coffee shop/cafe. Continental breakfast is available (fee applies). With ample conference space and meeting rooms, this hotel is ideal for events. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge).

name.content: Holiday Inn Paris Palais de l'Elysee

99296.description: Centrally located in Paris, the Holiday Inn Paris Palais de l'Elysee, an IHG Hotel, is steps from Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore and a short walk from the Champs-Élysées. This upscale hotel offers complimentary wired and wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in the common area. The 43 guestrooms feature minibars, flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. Guests can enjoy room service, a snack bar/deli, and a bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Additional amenities include a business center and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.

99306.description: A sophisticated Milan hotel with a stylish restaurant, meeting facilities and a free Fitness Centre. Crowne Plaza® Milan City is located next to Sondrio Metro Station and there are handy bus and tram stops nearby. The hotel is 750m from Milan Central Railway Station, which offers connections to Milan Malpensa Airport (MXP) and Milan Linate Airport (LIN). Secured parking also available with electric car charging station. Visitor attractions such as the Piazza Duomo, with its huge Gothic cathedral and historic shopping arcade Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, are within easy reach. Business travellers can use our Business Centre and four meeting rooms with a maximum capacity of 60. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Crowne Plaza® Milan City is Completely Connected. All our elegant rooms and suites have soundproofing. After a packed day of sightseeing or meetings, relax with a sauna or steam bath, then enjoy a drink in our cosy bar and Italian cuisine at Metropolitan Restaurant. A sunny terrace in the inner courtyard is available for your moments of relaxation in absolute silence and away from the chaos of the city. Moreover, indulge with our seasonal outdoor Pool and lounge Bar, lying on the sun loungers, sipping a cocktail by the pool or enjoying a pleasant evening with family and friends at the daily Happy Hour.

99317.description:
Discover the renovated 4-star voco Paris – Porte de Clichy Hotel situated in the eco-district of Clichy-Batignolles. 

A few meters from "Porte de Clichy" metro station, our hotel provides easy access to Paris attractions like the Galeries Lafayette and the Louvre Museum. 

Near major international companies, international airports (CDG and ORY), and train stations such as Gare de Lyon and Gare de Nord , we are ideal for business, leisure, and bleisure travelers. 

Host events in our meeting rooms, collaborate in our Conservatory and co-working spaces, and enjoy free Wi-Fi and onsite parking. 

Relax in spacious rooms, all air conditionned, with courtesy amenities and savor cosmopolitan cuisine at Romcoco Restaurant and Rum Bar. 

We make your stay in Paris très magnifique!

99323.description: The Holiday Inn® Paris-Montmartre hotel is ideally located in Montmartre, offering easy access to all of Paris's tourist sites. The Lamarck and Place de Clichy Metro stations are less than a 10-minute walk away, while CDG and Orly airports are less than an hour away by transport. Eurostar, Thalys and Bahn trains are also accessible within 15 minutes by metro. The hotel is close to the famous Basilica of the Sacré-Cœur, the Cabaret Le Bal du Moulin Rouge, and the Place du Tertre. The Eiffel Tower, the Arc de Triomphe, the Louvre and Orsay museums are easily accessible by transport. Sports enthusiasts can reach the Stade de France in 30 minutes via line 13, which offers direct access to attend the Rugby eventThe hotel offers free WiFi throughout the property, as well as a business counter and a well-equipped meeting room that can accommodate up to 19 people. Key business districts such as La Défense, Saint-Ouen and Clichy are easily accessible. The spacious family rooms offer guaranteed comfort, with a satellite TV and a Pillow Menu. Children stay for free as soon as the room has the right count of beds, and you can start your day with a hearty breakfast or an express breakfast at the bar, Remember children between 13 and 17 years old pay a supplement for the breakfast even if it is a breakfast included rate. End your day with a relaxing drink at the hotel bar. Book now for an unforgettable stay in Paris.

99324.description: The Holiday Inn Paris - Auteuil, an IHG Hotel, is located in the heart of Paris, a short drive from Parc des Princes and Paris Expo. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a communal living room. The 46 guestrooms feature minibars, flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, bidets, and hair dryers. Safes, desks, and phones with free local calls are also provided. Guests can enjoy room service (during limited hours), a complimentary daily reception, and buffet breakfasts (available for a fee). Additional amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a computer station, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Nearby attractions include the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe.

99325.description: NH Paris Gare de l’Est is located in the 10th arrondissement of Paris. It can be found opposite Gare de l’Est train station and only an eight-minute walk away from Gare du Nord. Plus, the hotel also sits close to two magnificent markets and Canal Saint-Martin, which is surrounded by restaurants, bars and shops. Added to this, many attractions and points of interest including Jardin Villemin, the Passage Brady and the churches of Saint-Vincent-de-Paul and Saint-Laurent are nearby. Meanwhile, Opéra Garnier, Centre Pompidou and Sacré-Cœur are within a 30-minute walk. The hotel itself is located in a beautiful, 8-story, Haussmann-style building that dates back to the 19th century. Within, it contains 207 airy and stylish guest rooms. The hotel offers a room type to suit each traveler, including single rooms, connecting rooms, accessible rooms and suites. Elsewhere, you’ll find five meeting rooms that measure a total of 152m². Each of these spaces offers a number of set-up possibilities and all feature lots of daylight and modern equipment. Added to this, the hotel serves the famous NH Hotels breakfast each morning and offers a relaxing lounge bar that serves a great range of drinks and snacks.

99332.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Hilton Molino Stucky Venice is just a short boat-ride from St. Mark’s Square by shuttle boat and easily reachable from Venice Marco Polo airport. It is one of the most important architectural projects of the end of 19th century, formerly a flour mill and granary on the Giudecca Island. Marvel at the spectacular views of the city and the lagoon as you enjoy a drink in the contemporary 8th floor Skyline Rooftop Bar or spoil yourself in the unique panoramic rooftop pool. The hotel features one of the largest Congress Centers of the city making it the ideal location for both business and leisure travelers. Relax your senses with a fully equipped fitness & wellness center or savor the Chef's Mediterranean dishes at the Aromi Restaurant. The hotel proudly presents, one of the biggest suites in Venice, a 300m²/3229 sq. ft. Presidential Suite with fitness room, hydro pool, private panoramic tower and elevator. Hold an event in one of 13 function rooms or convene in Venice's largest ballroom offering a breakout area, wireless internet access and space for up to 1000 guests.

99342.description: Behind the historic façade of Novotel Wien City is a modern 4-star hotel with bright, comfortable rooms. Two children under 16 stay free in the Family room. Surf the free internet, explore Vienna's old town and stroll to the Prater or St. Stephen's Cathedral. End the day convivially at the bar in the 'Family and Friends' restaurant.

name.content: Cairo World Trade Center Hotel & Residences

99344.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include babysitting (surcharge), wedding services, and a television in a common area. Satisfy your appetite at The Lounge, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 104 air-conditioned rooms featuring fireplaces and LED televisions. Kitchens are outfitted with full-sized refrigerators/freezers, ovens, and dishwashers. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

99360.description: The Hilton Madrid Airport, housed in a striking building, offers seamless connectivity to Madrid and the world. A complimentary shuttle bus operates between the hotel and all airport terminals daily from 5:30 a. m. to 1:00 a. m. Located a short 15-minute drive from Madrid's city center, the hotel provides easy access to this vibrant, multicultural hub. For relaxation, guests can utilize the 24-hour Precor Fitness Centre, sauna, and hydrotherapy pool. Dining options include Mediterranean cuisine at the Reserva Grill restaurant and traditional Spanish tapas at the Ferrum Bar. The hotel's architecture, inspired by the four elements, is showcased through hand-carved walls, water features, and abundant natural light. Thirteen meeting rooms, a stylish boardroom, and an elegant ballroom with a capacity of 450 delegates are available for events.

99368.description: Seven minutes from Orly Airport 4, our fully renovated contemporary hotel, has been carefully thought out for an ideal wellness stay. Enjoy our comfortable rooms that can accommodate up to 4 people. You can waken your taste buds at TATA Restaurant and Lounge-Bar with Mediterranean specialities. Taste healthy cuisine with fresh produce In its unique, Zen and energizing setting.

99402.description: This luxurious hotel enjoys a prime location in Madrid's northeastern business district, providing easy access to IFEMA, the Madrid Convention Centre, and Barajas International Airport. Public transport is readily available. Each guest room is tastefully decorated and features modern amenities and cutting-edge technology for a comfortable stay. Guests can unwind with a drink at the friendly on-site bar or savour a meal at the innovative restaurant. Function rooms are also available for business meetings.

99421.description: Our Premier Inn Berlin City West / Berlin City (Zentrum) West hotel is set right at the heart of the vibrant capital. You'll only be a short walk away from the famous Kurfurstendamm shopping boulevard and the popular department store KaDeWe. For a more laid-back day out in Germany, why not visit Berlin Zoo or the Tiergarten before enjoying a walk along the River Spree? Potsdamer Platz and Charlottenburg Palace are also great places to explore. After a full day of discoveries in Berlin, you can look forward to a tasty meal back at the hotel and a great night's sleep on a super-comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions.

name.content: Residence Inn New York Manhattan/Times Square

99423.description: Centrally located in New York, Residence Inn by Marriott New York Manhattan/Times Square is within a 5-minute walk of Broadway and Times Square. This hotel is also conveniently close to the Empire State Building (0. 4 mi) and Grand Central Terminal (0. 6 mi). The hotel offers 357 guestrooms, each featuring a kitchenette with a refrigerator and microwave. Guests enjoy complimentary wired and wireless internet access, flat-screen TVs with digital programming, laptop-compatible safes, and daily housekeeping. Recreational opportunities include a fitness center. Additional amenities comprise concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), a TV in the common area, and a banquet hall. Dining options include an onsite restaurant, a grocery/convenience store, and a bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. For business travelers, the hotel provides complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and 5, 005 square feet of meeting and conference space. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

99426.description: This hotel is situated frontline to a wonderful sandy beach with shallow waters, ideal for families with younger children. The historic town of Side with its antique sights including the famous Temple of Apollo is 13 km away, easily reachable due to frequent Dolmus connection. The hotel features 156 rooms, 24-hours reception, currency exchange, meeting rooms, TV room, restaurant, 6 bars, outdoor and indoor pool, 2 children's pools, mini-club, sports facilities, fitness centre, wellness, on-site shops, disco, laundry service and hairdresser.

99427.description: This modern holiday hotel is perfectly situated directly on a wonderful sandy beach in the popular Side area of the Turkish Riviera. Ideal to relax, it features a fitness centre, a beauty parlour, a spa, a variety of massages and numerous sports facilities. The historic town of Side with its ancient sites such as the spectacular Temple of Apollo or the largest amphitheatre of Anatolia is just a short drive away.

99433.address: Av. Adolfo Lopez Mateos Sm. 001 Mza. 001 Lote 005
99433.description: The Privilege Aluxes Isla Mujeres is located near downtown Isla Mujeres, just across the shore from Cancun. This luxury hotel features 124 modern units, perfect for travelers seeking an exclusive retreat. Its pristine beachfront location is ideal for beach lovers, scuba divers, and snorkelers. Dining options abound with three on-site restaurants offering everything from casual poolside fare to fine dining and tropical cocktails. Choose from the beachfront Privilege Beach Club, the indoor Sabor restaurant with ocean views, or the oriental specialty restaurant, Satay. A pool bar and the cozy Sabor terrace lounge bar provide additional spaces to relax and refresh. The hotel offers breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with options varying depending on the restaurant and season. Dinner service may be buffet or à la carte. Reservations are recommended for some restaurants and can be made through the concierge. For added security, access to the Privilege Aluxes is exclusively for hotel guests. However, friends and family can join you at the Playa Norte Beach Club (subject to availability and fees). Please note: An environmental tax is payable at the hotel (10. 86 MXN for the first night, 32. 57 MXN per person/night for additional nights, as of 2024. This amount is subject to annual change).

99459.description: Ideally situated for both shopping and sightseeing, the 3-star Hotel Acadia - Astotel is close to the main department stores and the Opera. The hotel is perfect for guests wanting a small, quiet hotel that is centrally located. All 36 air-conditioned rooms are tastefully decorated to combine comfort and quietness, an ideal place to relax at the end of a busy day. Close to the hotel there are a variety of restaurants and cafes offering international and typical French cuisine. Please note : City Tax is NOT included in the price from 1st July 2015 'Guests should note that local city tax is not included in the rate booked. This will be charged directly to guests by the hotel and payable at check in/out. '

99497.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting in Vienna, lying within easy access of a host of attractions in the city. The hotel is located on the famous shopping street Landstrasser Hauptstrasse, and is just a short walk from the city centre and Wien-Mitte railway station. This charming hotel is located within easy access of Viennese City Park, St. Stephen's Cathedral and Belvedere. This wonderful hotel enjoys an attractive architectural design, blending effortlessly with its surroundings. The guest rooms are eloquently appointed, offering a relaxing setting in which to work and rest in comfort. Appealing to discerning business and leisure travellers alike, the hotel affords a wide range of exemplary facilities, ensuring the utmost in comfort and convenience. Right now the breakfast will be served from 6:30 till 10:30 from Monday until Friday and from 7:00 until 11:00 Saturday, Sunday and bank holidays.

99499.description: The 50, 000 m2 club resort is located 10 km to the east of Manavgat at the popular tourism centre of Kizilot Manavgat and close to ancient cities like Side, Aspendos and Perge. Antalya Airport is 80 km away, the private beach can be easily reached on foot. The hotel offers 475 rooms, 24-hour reception, currency exchange, free WIFI in public areas, meeting rooms, 5 restaurants, 6 bars, outdoor and indoor pools, children's pool, fitness centre, spa and wellness, bicycle rental, car hire and free on-site parking (reservation needed). Wheelchair accessible.

99553.description: This elegant and wonderful hotel is perfectly situated in the historic centre of Istanbul, the Sultanahmet District. The hotel is surrounded by the most important attractions of the Turkish capital such as Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque, Hippodrome and Basilica Cistern. Ataturk Airport is just 19 km from the property. This hotel offers 70 classic rooms decorated in warm tones, equipped with TV with satellite channels, coffee & tea facilities, air-conditioning and bathroom with shower and hairdryer. The hotel features a terrace restaurant with a fantastic view of the Hagia Sophia, a garden restaurant and an excellent spa area where guests can free body and mind with natural therapies and treatments.

99660.description: ***ANNABELLA PARK HOTEL IS LOCATED AT THE D-400 AND AROUND 300 MT. FROM THE BEACH. THERE IS A ROAD BETWEEN ANNABELLA PARK HOTEL AND ANNABELLA DIAMOND RESORT. THE ANNABELLA PARK GUESTS CAN USE ALL FACILITIES OF THE ANNABELLA DIAMOND HOTEL. THE MAIN RESTAURANT OF THE ANNABELLA DIAMOND CAN NOT BE USED BY THE ANNABELLA PARK GUEST***This magnificent complex enjoys a convenient location in Alanya, nicknamed as “The Pearl of the Mediterranean”. The city-centre is just 20 kilometres away and Avsallar, a popular tourist resort, is only 2 kilometres from this establishment. Featuring a contemporary décor, all the accommodation units have been designed with guests' needs in mind and provide a choice of modern conveniences. The onsite facilities include a delicious buffet with local and European flavours as well as a pool bar serving a choice of refreshing beverages and light snacks. Younger guests will have the time of their lives in the children's pools while adults can take a refreshing dip in the magnificent outdoor pool, set amongst pines trees. . The hotel is provide the All Ultra Inclusive services (AUI)

99661.address: Iskele Mevkii D400 - Karayolu Uzeri - Konakli, D-400
99661.description:
This hotel is located in the Konakli area of Alanya. The centre of Konakli is 500 metres and it is 15 km to Alanya city centre. Antalya Airport is 110 km away.

This family friendly beach hotel comprises a total of 211 standard rooms spread over 6 floors. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility, 2 lifts, a cafe and a mini supermarket. It also offers a hairdressing salon, a nightclub, a theatre auditorium, a TV lounge and a restaurant as well as conference facilities. Guests may take advantage of the WLAN Internet access and the room and laundry services (both for an additional fee). Parking is available for those arriving by car and the younger guests will enjoy the children's playground and the kids' club.

All the rooms come with a private bathroom with a bathtub and a hairdryer as well as a telephone, a TV, a free minibar with water and mineral water which is refilled every day. They are also equipped with Internet access, a king-size or double bed, centrally regulated air conditioning and heating and a safe. All accommodation also features a balcony.

The hotel features 3 swimming pools including indoor and outdoor pools (1 heated) and a children's pool. Guests can unwind at the poolside snackbar on sun loungers or in the sauna. Massage treatments are available for an additional fee and it is possible to play tennis, table tennis, join an aerobics session, play basketball, beach volleyball or billiards (charges apply). There is also an entertainment programme with separate activities for children and adults. Water sports are available on the beach, from a third party supplier (for an additional fee).

This hotel offers an all-inclusive concept from 10 am till midnight, and all local drinks with and without alcohol are free. Imported drinks, fresh orange juice and bottled drinks are available at an extra charge.

99695.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Istanbul within a walking distance of the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, Islamic Museum and Grand Bazaar. A tram and various bus lines are at the entrance of the hotel which provide an easy access to other parts of the city. Istanbul International Airport lies some 45 km away. Elegance and charm are in every detail of the hotel and make it a very warm and cosy residence. The hotel offers 93 bright rooms with contemporary decor. Each room is fitted with air-conditioning, satellite TV, minibar and bathroom with toiletries. Guests may enjoy a refreshing dip in the indoor and outdoor swimming pools, relax on the sun lounges, or workout in the gym. The hotel also offers a Turkish bath and massage treatments for guests who wish to relax.

99735.description: Indulge in a pampering session at our full-service spa. Bask in the sun on our private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities, including a nightclub and outdoor pool. This beach hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, an arcade/game room, and tour/ticket assistance. Savor delicious meals at one of our two restaurants, and unwind with refreshing drinks at the bar/lounge, beach bar, or poolside bar. For your convenience, we offer a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, laundry facilities, and valet parking. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. Our 223 guestrooms feature private balconies, minibars, LCD televisions with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include designer toiletries and hair dryers. Located in Kemer, Selcukhan Hotel is a short drive from Konyaalti Beach and Beldibi Beach Park. We're also conveniently close to attractions such as Moonlight Beach and Park, and Konyaalti Beach Park.

99796.description: The Petit Palais Hotel De Charme, a converted 17th-century convent, offers luxurious suites just a 10-minute walk from the Duomo. This charming hotel comprises 18 cozy accommodations and provides complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. The reception is open 24 hours a day. While cribs are not available, some additional services may incur a fee.

99814.description:
Discover the charm of Hotel Villa Patriarca, a beautifully restored 18th-century residence. Located in Mirano, this elegant 4-star hotel is the perfect starting point for exploring the artistic and architectural treasures of Venice, Padua, Treviso, and Vicenza. 

The 50 guest rooms are divided between the refined historic wing, showcasing Venetian elegance, and the modern contemporary wing, offering comfort and style for every need. Guests can unwind in the expansive landscaped park, featuring a swimming pool with hydromassage, a football field, and a tennis court—a true oasis of peace, ideal even for business travelers. 

The hotel’s restaurant blends traditional regional flavors with creative, modern cuisine, making it the perfect venue for weddings, private celebrations, corporate dinners, meetings, and training events. A large free parking area is also available for guests.

99833.description: Nestled in the heart of Kemer, this charming city hotel offers stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea. Just a short stroll away, guests can enjoy the pristine Blue Flag beach, the vibrant Moonlight Park, and a variety of bars, restaurants, and shops. Antalya Airport is conveniently located 60 km from the hotel. This 37-room hotel provides a warm, family-friendly atmosphere with hospitable staff dedicated to ensuring a pleasant stay. Guests can enjoy 24-hour reception, currency exchange, and internet access (fees apply). The hotel also features indoor and outdoor restaurants, three bars, and room and laundry services (fees apply). On-site parking is available for guests arriving by car. Each comfortable room includes a private bathroom with a bathtub and shower, satellite TV, air conditioning, direct dial telephone, and a balcony. Guests can relax in the outdoor swimming pool with a poolside snack bar or unwind with massage treatments, a Turkish bath, and sauna (fees apply). A range of water sports is available nearby, including banana boating, waterskiing, jet skiing, and diving. Beach volleyball facilities and an à la carte lunch menu are also offered. Please note that there is a fee for beach access.

99834.description: Renovated in 2007, this air-conditioned hotel offers 201 rooms. Some of the services and facilities provided are a games room, a restaurant and a children's playground. All rooms are equipped with a LCD TV with satellite interactive system, as well as wireless Internet access. One of the best ways for guests to relax in their rooms is to enjoy the pleasant view from their balcony or terrace, which also comes as standard to all accommodation units. Guests may pamper themselves with massage and SPA treatments, or enjoy the sun at one of the two swimming pools on site. Parasols and sun lounges are laid out ready for use on the hotel's sun terrace.

99841.address: Alemdar Mah.Kazım Ismail Gürkan Cad Sultanahmet, 2
99841.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy international cuisine at Arden Bosphorus, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Featured amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 41 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and electric kettles.

99901.description: Located near the A4 motorway, with easy access to Linate, Orio al Serio, and Malpensa Airports, this hotel offers spacious, functionally designed rooms featuring warm-colored decor, parquet floors, and modern amenities. Each classic room includes a private bathroom with a large shower, hairdryer, and toiletries, while some rooms also boast a jacuzzi. Guests can unwind in the wellness center, take a dip in the swimming pool, or energize in the fitness area. The Green Line Gessate subway, the Milan Rho-Pero exhibition center, and the Monza racetrack are also easily accessible.

99973.description: This hotel is located just a few steps away from the beachfront in Alanya. Cleopatra's Beach is just a short distance away. The hotel is situated just 2 km from the resort centre and the pedestrianized shopping streets. Entertainment and dining options can be found nearby at the charming harbour area, which lies just 2. 5 km away. The hotel also enjoys close proximity to a number of attractions. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. The hotel enjoys a charming design, beautifully combining traditional and contemporary styles. The guest rooms are superbly designed, offering modern amenities for visitors' comfort. The hotel affords visitors a host of exemplary facilities and services, delivering a high level of excellence, which is sure to impress.

99974.description: This beach hotel is just 450 m from the beach and only 10 km from the centre of Side. It is located on the most beautiful coast of the Mediterranean Sea, where the nature and history come together and coexist in perfect harmony. There are many places of interest nearby, including Köprülü Canyon, a popular location for river rafting. The town of Manavgat is approximately 13 km from the resort, while Antalya Airport is roughly 65 km away. The resort's dreamlike setting has a family-friendly atmosphere and is fully equipped with 173 guest rooms on 4 floors. All of the rooms are fully-equipped as standard including individually regulated air conditioning and heating, a satellite TV with music channels and Internet access. Guests may enjoy a broad range of sport activities including beach volleyball, table tennis and various water sports.

99997.description: Located on the south bank of the Douro River, 10 km from Castelo de Paiva town center and 40 km from Porto, the Douro41 Hotel offers stunning views of the river and its terraced banks. This renovated, modern hotel features 55 rooms and 6 suites, boasting minimalist design, natural light, and neutral tones that complement the picturesque surroundings. Guests can enjoy two panoramic swimming pools, a gym, a movie theater, meeting rooms, on-site parking, and a lobby market. The hotel also provides private docks, making it an ideal starting point for exploring the Douro River. Dining options include the 140-seat Raiva Restaurant, specializing in regional cuisine, and the À Terra Bar & Canteen, offering a farm-to-table concept with shared dishes and creative cocktails. The Douro41 Spa features specialized therapists, an indoor panoramic pool, and a hydrotherapy circuit.

100038.description: A welcoming Redditch hotel with free parking and breakfast includedHoliday Inn® Express Birmingham - Redditch hotel places you in the town centre within easy reach of the M42 motorway. Steps from the hotel, Redditch Station offers direct trains to Birmingham New Street Station. Catching your flight is a breeze, with Birmingham Airport (BHX) just 30 minutes away by car. Business guests can host meetings for up to 50 delegates in our 2 naturally lit conference rooms. Within a 30-minute drive, you can sink your teeth into chocolate production at Cadbury World, or explore England's grisly history in the medieval dungeon of Warwick Castle. In Stratford-upon-Avon, also an easy drive away, visitors can view the half-timbered house where William Shakespeare was born, and see productions of his plays at the Royal Shakespeare Theatre. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free Wi-Fi- Complimentary on-site parking- Business CentreThe Express Start™ Breakfast buffet included in the room rate features sausages and scrambled eggs, as well as continental items. After a busy day, settle down to a satisfying evening meal in the smart restaurant, or enjoy a glass of wine or a pint in the bar. Comfy guest rooms come with handy bedside USB ports to keep your devices charged, and a choice of pillows for a restful stay.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London - Golders Green (A406)

100047.description: A modern London hotel near Hampstead Heath with free WiFi and parking, and an inclusive hot breakfastJust off the North Circular road, Holiday Inn Express® London - Golders Green hotel is within 15 minutes' drive of both the M1 and M25 motorways, and the hotel offers free, on-site parking. A 10-minute bus ride away, Tube trains run from Golders Green underground station to central London. Heathrow Airport (LHR) is 45 minutes' drive from the hotel. Head to historic Hampstead Heath, a 10-minute drive away, for woodland, swimming ponds and sweeping London views. Or drive 15 minutes to the 19th-century Alexandra Palace, set in leafy parkland with an ice-skating rink and an international entertainment programme. Also a 15-minute drive from the hotel, iconic Wembley Stadium hosts major football matches. You can host events in the hotel’s two flexible meetings spaces for up to 250 people. There's free WiFi throughout the hotel and free parking.

100052.description:
Crowne Plaza Solihull is a stylish 4-star hotel set in landscaped grounds and perfectly positioned in the Heart of England. Just minutes from the M42, Birmingham Airport (BHX), the NEC, and bp pulse LIVE, it’s the ideal base for both business and leisure travellers. 

Our 120 spacious, contemporary bedrooms feature premium bedding, smart TVs, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and dedicated work areas — designed for comfort, productivity, and a great night’s sleep. 

Solihull’s vibrant town centre is just a short stroll away, offering excellent shopping at Touchwood Centre, John Lewis and a fantastic choice of dining from cosy pubs to fine dining restaurants. Family-friendly attractions are within easy reach, including Drayton Manor Theme Park (home of Thomas Land), West Midlands Safari Park, Warwick Castle, and Cadbury World. 

Unwind at our Leisure Club with a heated indoor pool and fully equipped, air-conditioned gym. Savour lakeside dining at the Terrace Restaurant or enjoy a relaxed drink in the Terrace Bar & Lounge. 

With 12 versatile, fully equipped meeting rooms for up to 200 guests, a dedicated Crowne Plaza Meetings Director, conference café, and tailored catering options, we make business events effortless. 

Solihull train station is less than a mile away, with direct trains to Birmingham (Moor Street) and London Marylebone, and Birmingham Airport is just a 15-minute drive. The hotel offers 184 on-site parking spaces (£12. 50 per night for residents).

name.content: Doubletree Fort Lee George Washington Bridge

100107.description: The DoubleTree Fort Lee, conveniently located near the George Washington Bridge and just off I-95, offers upscale accommodations and easy access to New York City via a scheduled shuttle service (nominal fee applies). This modern hotel features contemporary guest rooms and suites, including executive accommodations, with amenities such as Sweet Dreams beds, marble and granite bathrooms, and complimentary Wi-Fi. While some services are currently reduced, the hotel typically offers a variety of dining experiences, including Northern Italian, Continental, American, and Japanese cuisine. A fitness center, indoor pool, and whirlpool are also available. Business travelers will appreciate the well-equipped business center (currently unavailable) and proximity to NYC. The hotel also boasts state-of-the-art meeting facilities, including a 4, 500-square-foot grand ballroom.

100198.description: This hotel boasts a prime setting in Madrid, sitting on the main street of the city. The hotel is set at the principal entrance to the Plaza Mayor. Its enviable setting offers ease of access to many of the city's most prominent attractions, including the historical centre and the Puerta del Sol. The city's museums, the Royal Palace and the Almudena Cathedral can all be found nearby. Housed in a historical building, yet hailed as one of the most modern hotels in the city, this property is sure to impress. The guest rooms are stunningly designed, beautifully combining old and new elements, for a classical style. The hotel features the latest technology, offering unrivalled comfort and convenience. Guests are sure to enjoy the many leisure, business and dining facilities and services that this first-class hotel has to offer.

name.content: The Regency Hotel Sure Hotel Collection by BW

100218.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at The Regency Hotel Solihull. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and a banquet hall. Dine at the onsite restaurant and bar/lounge or grab a coffee at the cafe. Full breakfasts are available daily (fees apply). Amenities include a business center, express check-in/check-out, and self-parking (charges apply). The 111 guestrooms feature private bathrooms, digital programming, and coffee/tea makers. Located in Solihull, the hotel is near Blythe Valley Park and Touchwood Shopping Center, and is 8. 3 mi (13. 4 km) from the National Exhibition Centre and 8. 5 mi (13. 7 km) from the University of Birmingham.

100233.description: Located 8 km west along the Mediterranean coast from the resort and historical village of Side, this resort and spa complex is a family-friendly hotel consisting of 5 building complexes. Features include a spacious outdoor area fronting the sandy beach with swimming pools including a relax pool and one with slides. There is a choice of culinary options, some light entertainment provided and free internet access in the lobby area. Public transport runs close to the hotel with easy access to Side's ancient ruins and shopping centre. ****HOTEL DOES NOT ACCEPT ONLY MEN BOOKINGS***

100234.description: Featuring a convenient location in the Gundogan district on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, this family-friendly establishment is less than 15 minutes' drive from the fascinating resort of Side, a paradise for shopping lovers and the perfect place to enjoy a moment of relaxation in the private section of the beach, just a few metres from this luxury property. Guest will find some public transport links just 150 metres away providing easy access to many attractions in the area. This establishment includes a choice of spacious, comfortable accommodation options ranging from standard to family rooms as well as a host of outstanding facilities such as spa centre, indoor and outdoor pools and a children's club.

100274.description: Centrally located and only a short walk from attractions such as the Calouste Gulbenkian Museum, the modern, 4-star Hotel Alameda is close to Alameda metro station for good transport links across the city. Providing guests with a comfortable base from which to explore Lisbon, the hotel offers contemporary interior design and clean lines, alongside 70 stylish guestrooms. Rooms come with a private bathroom, double glazing, air conditioning, LCD satellite TV, free Wi-Fi and tea/coffee making facilities. A buffet breakfast is served each morning, followed by a menu of international dishes and Portuguese specialities, and there is also a bar for relaxing with drinks, cocktails, TV and music. A reading room provides space for enjoying some quiet time or catching up with work, and there is also a business centre and a choice of meeting rooms. Reception is 24 hours and limited parking is available.

100294.address: Bingeşik Mevkii Side / Antalya / TÜRKİYE, p.k.150
100294.description: This family-friendly hotel, located just 300 meters from a long sandy beach and 4 km from the ancient city of Side, offers a variety of amenities and activities. The 404-room hotel features an indoor pool (open during winter), two outdoor pools with separate children's pools, a restaurant, multiple bars, a disco, and conference facilities. Guests can enjoy water sports at the beach, along with daytime activities like water aerobics and boccia. Evening entertainment includes animation and Turkish nights. Rooms include a bathroom with shower, WC, and hairdryer, a direct-dial phone, mini-fridge, satellite TV, individually controlled air conditioning, and a balcony. Safes are available for an extra charge. The hotel offers all-inclusive packages with meals served buffet-style in the indoor restaurant or on the roofed terrace. Additional amenities include a sauna, massage services, and various water sports for an extra fee. Table tennis, darts, and beach volleyball are available free of charge. Children's entertainment is provided with a mini club and mini disco. The hotel is located 65 km from Antalya Airport.

100373.description: This city beach hotel boasts an excellent location just 200 meters from Flamengo Beach and Aterro do Flamengo Park, with Copacabana only 10 minutes away. A short 5-minute drive takes you to downtown Rio de Janeiro and Santos Dumont Airport, while the Rodoviária Novo Rio bus station is reachable within 10 minutes by car. Built in 1924 and renovated in 2008, this 117-room hotel offers a comfortable stay. The fully air-conditioned lobby features a 24-hour reception, safe, and lift access. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant, internet access in public areas, and a business center. Laundry service is also available. The en suite apartments include a bath/shower, direct-dial telephone, cable TV, radio, internet access, a minibar, and an ironing set. Each room is equipped with a double bed, individually regulated air conditioning, and an electronic safe. Deluxe apartments offer hot tubs. One child under 12 years old stays free when sharing their parents' room. Additional children, even those under 12, are charged as adults. A buffet breakfast is served daily, while lunch and dinner are offered à la carte.

100414.description: This hotel is located in Sarria-Sant Gervasi, in the upper zone of Barcelona, with views of Placa Kennedy and surrounded by the vegetation of La Tamarita gardens. It lies close to the most important areas of the city and is 5 minutes' drive from Placa de Catalunya. It is 700 m to the Museo de la Ciencia and 2 km to Gaudi's Parc Güell and the Cuadrat d'Or as well as Barcelona football club. The Palacio de Congresos/Exhibition grounds are 3 km away. Barcelona Airport is just 12 km from the hotel. Housed in a building dating back to 1920 and renovated in 2008, this historical design hotel comprises a total of 15 rooms as well as one of the best restaurants in Barcelona, awarded by the Michelin Guide. The hotel also has a wonderful garden and is ideal for both holidaymakers and business travellers alike. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility, a cloakroom and lift access. It also offers a cafe, a bar and a pub, conference facilities and WLAN/Internet access. Guests may take advantage of the room and laundry services and there is a car park and covered garage parking for those arriving by car.

100437.address: Gullerpinari Mah Oba Yolu Cad. Altin Sok. 1, 1
100437.description: The hotel enjoys a good location just 1. 5 km from the resort centre and 100 metres to the sandy beach and public transport. Local amenities such as shops, bars and restaurants are available less than 5 minutes' walk from the hotel. Gazipasa Airport is about 40 km away, while Antalya Airport is some 130 km away. This air-conditioned city hotel has a total of 88 comfortable rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception as well as a hotel safe and lift access to the upper floors. Guests can enjoy a drink at the bar and dine in the restaurant.   All rooms are simply furnished and fully-equipped as standard featuring air conditioning and a balcony or terrace.   The hotel has a small outdoor swimming pool with a children's' swimming section and a sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols.

100438.description: Situated on the cliffs overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, this air-conditioned hotel offers 72 seaview rooms, each with a private balcony. Located just 8 km from the city center, the hotel features a sun-bathing platform with direct sea access, complimentary Wi-Fi, a restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating, a snack bar, and a lobby bar. Guests can also enjoy the hotel's private beach platform.

100444.description: The cosy hotel/pension is situated in the heart of the historic town of Side amongst the ruins of the ancient Greco Roman city. The antique theatre is just 200 m away, the spectacular Temple of Apollo 500 m. Many shops, restaurants and bars are within easy walking distance, Antalya Airport is 70 km away. The hotel features 16 rooms, 24-hours reception, express check-in and check-out, currency exchange, free WIFI in the entire hotel, bar, garden, playground, private beach, medical assistance and free on-site parking.

100445.description: This environmentally friendly, award-winning hotel is conveniently situated on the shores of Lake Titreyengöl and just a few steps from the lovely beach of the Mediterranean Sea. Features of the hotel include an extensive aqua park and a wellness centre with hammam. Manavgat, the famous waterfalls and the historic town of Side with its ancient sites are just a short drive away.

100520.description: Experience Lisbon's bohemian spirit at this sophisticated hotel in the historic Baixa district. Steps from premier shopping and attractions like the Basilica dos Martires church, and only 7 kilometers from the international airport, this property offers a prime location. Guests will appreciate the range of services available, including a stylish lounge bar and a restaurant blending traditional and modern design. The spacious, bright guest rooms feature tasteful decor, a minibar, a safety deposit box, and a private bathroom with toiletries, ensuring a comfortable stay for even the most discerning traveler.

100522.address: Avenue Mohamed Vi, Zone De L'Agdal
100522.description: This hotel faces the mythic ramparts and luxuriant royal gardens of Agdal, an enviable setting in the red capital of Morocco. Just 10 minutes from the principal tourist attractions of Marrakech and its surroundings, the hotel is near the atmospheric Jamaa El Fna Square, the colonial quarter of Gueliz and Menara - Marrakech Airport is only 4 km away. This city spa resort welcomes holidaymakers and business travellers alike, with a wide array of facilities available. Business guests can take advantage of the well-equipped conference facilities which are offered by this establishment. After a busy day, guests can retire to their fully furnished rooms which offer a spectacular view of the Atlas Mountains from the balcony. All group reservations exceeding 5 rooms must be communicated directly to the hotel , Different policies apply to these reservations. '

100616.description: Securing a room in this distinctive Victorian building puts you within easy reach of London's iconic attractions, including the Science, Victoria & Albert, and Natural History museums, as well as Earl's Court. From our Kensington location you can reach Gloucester Road tube stop in just two minutes. Admire the elegant façade of the Royal Albert Hall, stroll through Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park, then return to style, comfort, and attentive service courtesy of our hospitality team. It's what we do.

100617.description: CIN CODE IT027042A1OSBOSY86 This hotel offers an ideal solution for those searching for accommodation around St Mark's Square and its highlights. It also makes the ideal starting point from which to reach all the sites of historical interest in the city. It is 2 kms to the sandy Lido beach. Venice Airport is 8 kms away by ferry and 15km by car. This family-friendly city hotel is housed in a former 17th century 'Palazzo' - the residence of an ancient Venetian family. In 2008 it was fully restored in classical style and features a spectacular view of the Osmarin Canal. The restoration has preserved the charm and history of the residence and its 16 guest rooms. The perfectly harmonious and balanced atmosphere created by plaster, damask fabric, furniture, Venetian flooring, frescoes, ceilings with exposed beams (by Sansovino) and maximum attention to detail, recreates the atmosphere of the 1700s in Venice without neglecting modern technology.

100693.description: Situated on the banks of the Water of Leith in the West End of Edinburgh City Centre, the Britannia Hotel Edinburgh is conveniently located within easy reach of many of the city's major attractions and the main shopping area. The Britannia Edinburgh Hotel features 178 well-appointed guest bedrooms with room facilities including televisions and tea & coffee making equipment. In addition, the hotel also offers complimentary WIFI and chargeable car parking. There is an on-site restaurant and bar where guests can enjoy breakfast, lunch and evening meals. The hotel is only 1 mile from Edinburgh Haymarket Train Station and 12 Miles from Edinburgh Airport.

100714.description: Situated a short walk from Side's west beach, the Greco-Roman ruins, and the resort center, this pleasant aparthotel offers convenient access to numerous restaurants and cafes. Each cozy apartment is comfortably furnished and features partial views of the countryside or the on-site pools. Guests can enjoy two outdoor swimming pools, an indoor pool, a sauna, a Turkish bath, and a private section of the local beach complete with sunbeds and umbrellas.

100761.description: The Manor Elstree offers 49 comfortable guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, a terrace, and a garden. The Cavendish Restaurant provides on-site dining, with room service also available during limited hours. A bar/lounge, complimentary breakfast for a fee, and free self-parking are also offered. For events, the hotel features conference space and meeting rooms. Nearby attractions include Elstree Film Studios (2 mi) and the Royal Air Force Museum London (5. 9 mi). The closest airport is Luton Airport (LTN), 23. 6 miles away.

100954.description: We would like to inform you that regulation no. 408/2024 approving the municipal tourist tax in Amarante. Tourist tax details;2 €/night, in the period between April 1st and September 30th (the fee is due, up to a maximum of 3 consecutive nights, per person and night, as long as there is no interruption in the reservation)1 €/night, in the period between October 1st and March 31st (the fee is due, up to a maximum of 3 consecutive nights, per person and night, as long as there is no interruption in the reservation)The fee will be applied to all stays for guests aged 16 and over and will be charged per night of stay.

100997.address: Port Saeed,Near Deira City Center,Po Box 119062
100997.description: This fantastic hotel offers studios and suites with up to two rooms, conveniently located just 2 km from the airport. Each unit features a private bathroom, a kitchenette, and a balcony, along with television and internet access. Guests can enjoy 24-hour reception service, a jacuzzi, and a well-equipped gym. For business travelers, the hotel provides a business center and dedicated meeting lounges with all the necessary materials for events. Two on-site restaurants offer delicious dining options.

101069.description: Located in Vienna's prestigious 1st district, this hotel offers spectacular views of the Ringstrasse and the city skyline. Perched on the 11th, 12th, and 13th floors, each of the 55 rooms and suites boasts a private roof deck and complimentary Wi-Fi. Tastefully furnished and equipped with modern amenities, including tablets and air conditioning, the rooms provide a comfortable and luxurious experience. The suites offer separate living or study areas, creating the ambiance of a chic penthouse overlooking Vienna.

101080.description: 'This charming beach hotel lies just steps away from a white, sandy beach. The hotel enjoys its natural surroundings and brings a touch of vibrancy and life to the atmosphere. Guests will find the enchanting city of Colombo just a 90 minutes' drive away while Bandaranaike International Airport is a 40 minutes' drive away. The ultimate family-friendly beach destination, the hotel offers exciting recreational and leisure activities that everyone is sure to enjoy. The hotel's pool area and bar offers the perfect place to spend lazy days and the pool boasts the ideal place to cool down with a refreshing swim. Guests of all ages will enjoy the lively night-time entertainment, tennis court and squash court, there is something for everyone. '

101133.description: This hotel is strategically placed in the commercial and industrial area of Ramassar, in Granollers. The hotel lies just 10 km away from the Circuit de Catalunya racing track. Barcelona's intriguing city centre can be found just 25 km away. Guests will find a number of wonderful attractions within easy access of the hotel. The hotel is conveniently situated just 43 km away from Barcelona Airport. This hotel features a modern, functional design. The guest rooms are comfortably-appointed, offering a peaceful setting in which to work and rest. The hotel's personalised service ensures that guests' needs are met at any time of the day or night. The hotel provides wireless internet, so guests can keep in touch with work or home.

101136.description: Situated a few strides from Alanya's famous Cleopatra Beach, this simply furnished city hotel is ideally located for enjoying the resort's many shops, cafe bars and restaurants as well as the popular beach for lazy days of sun-bathing or swimming in the Mediterranean. The resort's many attractions are easily accessible on foot, such as Damlatas Caves a few steps away and the Red Tower and old boatyard, while Alanya Castle is a ten minute bus journey. Gazipasa Alanya Airport is about 42 km from the hotel. Ideal for a good night's rest after a long day in the sunshine or sight-seeing, the rooms are also equipped with air-conditioning, TV with satellite channels, mini fridge, safe box and hair dryer. Sharing amenities with its' two sister hotels located on the same street, guests can benefit from a relaxing sauna or Turkish bath in the small spa before enjoying a refreshing drink or tasty meal in one of the a la carte restaurants.

101140.address: Jumeirah Lakes Towers, P. O. Box 31303
101140.description: The Oaks Liwa Heights Apartments is located in the heart of Dubai's Jumeirah Lakes Towers community, just 30 minutes from both Dubai International and Dubai World Central Airports. This aparthotel offers 168 spacious, fully self-contained apartments, including one and two-bedroom options. Each apartment features modern amenities and home comforts, such as a fully equipped kitchen, living area, wireless internet access, and a spacious balcony with spectacular views.

101214.description: Conveniently located only 100 m from the famous Kleopatra Beach, this cosy hotel is perfect to explore the holiday region of Turkish Riviera around Alanya. The airport is about 45 minutes away by car. In the surroundings, there are several restaurants cafes and bars ideal to spend a nice evening tasting new delicious flavours or having a drink. There are also many shopping opportunities perfect to look for the best souvenirs. Guests will love to relax under the sun while sipping from a margarita. If they prefer, they can go to spa where time will stop and they will feel rejuvenate. The rooms have been decorated with a combination of bright and touches of vibrant colours to create a pleasant atmosphere. They are equipped with all the essential amenities to make each visitor’s stay the most comfortable and unforgettable one.

101254.description: Centrally located in Amsterdam, Ozo Hotels Armada Amsterdam is a 3-minute walk from Rembrandt Square and a 14-minute walk from the Rijksmuseum. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine. The 30 guestrooms feature safes, desks, and private bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Housekeeping is provided daily. Nearby attractions include the Flower Market (0. 4 mi) and The 9 Streets (0. 7 mi). The nearest major airport is Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS), 13. 8 mi away.

101313.description:
The St. James's Hotel & Club prioritizes the health and safety of its guests, as evidenced by its Global Health Assured certification. This luxurious hotel offers a prestigious location in London's city center, near Piccadilly Circus and Green Park Station. Guests enjoy convenient access to exclusive shopping, dining, and entertainment. Elegantly appointed rooms provide luxurious accommodations, while exemplary facilities and services cater to every need. Business travelers will appreciate the hotel's conference facilities. For a truly exceptional culinary experience, the award-winning Michelin-starred restaurant, Seven Park Place by William Drabble, awaits. Breakfast can also be enjoyed in the Francatelli Restaurant upon request. 

Please note the hotel does not have rooms with twin beds only doubles. If twin rooms are required please contact the reservation team on reservations@stjameshotelandclub. com

101317.description: This hotel, nestled in Potsdam's scenic Pirschheide district amidst forests and lakes, is conveniently located 10 minutes from Potsdam's city center and 30 minutes from Berlin. Nearby, guests can enjoy restaurants, bars, public transportation, Templin Lake, and Pirschheide Forest. Local attractions include Park Sanssouci (2 km), Bornstedt Crown Estate (3 km), Potsdam's Dutch Quarter (4 km), the New Garden (5 km), and Babelsberg film theme park (7 km). Berlin Tegel Airport is 35 km and Berlin Schoenefeld Airport is 40 km from the hotel. This acclaimed city business and conference hotel offers 495 rooms across four floors, including 11 junior suites and 50 apartments. Guests enjoy a 24-hour reception, safe, cloakroom, lift access, café, bar, pub, TV lounge, restaurant, and Wi-Fi. The hotel provides an ideal setting for conferences, meetings, parties, and banquets of all sizes. On-site parking is available in the underground garage (charges apply), and bicycle rentals are also offered. The three accommodation blocks, named after the airships Graf Zeppelin, Viktoria Luise, and Nordstern, offer a variety of room types. Each room features high-quality furnishings, a private bathroom with shower, WC, and hairdryer, along with a telephone, TV, radio, and internet access. Additional amenities include an ironing set, double bed, individually adjustable heating, and a balcony or terrace.

101413.description: Nestled on a quiet street in the heart of Paris, this city hotel offers convenient access to a wealth of attractions. Within a 10-minute walk, guests can discover the Folies Bergère, Musée Grévin, numerous theaters, and the renowned Opéra Garnier. The surrounding area boasts a vibrant array of boutiques and restaurants, while excellent public transport links and the train station are also easily accessible. The hotel features 63 rooms across two buildings, each offering an en-suite bathroom and comfortable furnishings. Guests can also enjoy convenient amenities such as Wi-Fi and on-site parking. Check-in begins at 3 PM.

101473.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at AC Lounge, a bar/lounge which specializes in Spanish cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Planning an event in Barcelona? This hotel has 1808 square feet (168 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 78 guestrooms featuring minibars. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

name.content: Al Barsha Hotel Apartments by Mondo

101656.address: Opp Sharaf DG Metro Station, Al Barsha, 1
101656.description: This enchanting complex is located in the cosmopolitan and alluring city of Dubai, within a short stroll from Sharaf DG Metro Station and lies within walking distance from Mall of the Emirates, home of the famous Ski Dubai. The establishment is a short drive from Knowledge Village, Internet City and Dubai Media City. The spacious accommodations comprise of bright and sumptuously appointed one and two bedroom apartments. Each of the air-conditioned guestrooms are equipped with a bathroom, living and dining area, a fully equipped kitchen, laundry facilities, flat panel Cable TV and free internet access, provided to ensure guests' stay would be truly enjoyable. Various restaurants can be found within the vicinity of the establishment.  Visitors may while away at the recreational facilities including a rooftop swimming pool where to freshen up on warm days and those who wish to keep in fit may work out at the fitness centre and then unwind in the sauna.

101677.description: The hotel is located approximately 1 km from the centre of Beldibi and has the magnificent Taurus Mountains as a backdrop. The larger resort of Kemer with its choice of shops and entertainment venues is 15 km away and easily reached by public transport, which passes directly in front of the hotel. There are bars, restaurants and clubs in the immediate vicinity and tourist attractions are within easy reach. The hotel is situated approximately 44 kms from Antalya Airport. This pleasant 98-room, air-conditioned, beach hotel occupies 7000 sqm of land and guests will enjoy its spacious garden. Recreational facilities include an outdoor swimming pool. Youngsters are sure to enjoy the children's swimming area which features waterslides. The hotel's sun terrace is equipped with sun loungers and parasols and a gym is available for guests wishing to stay in shape.

101739.address: Ctra M 506 De Villaviciosa A Pinto, km 20.7
101739.description: This hotel, located near the M506, is a short 5-minute drive from Fuenlabrada's city center, offering easy access to shopping, dining, and entertainment. Madrid's center is just a 15-minute drive away, and Madrid Barajas International Airport is conveniently located 29 km from the hotel. For those interested in history, Toledo's historical center and Jewish Quarter are 60 km away. This modern hotel combines functionality and style, providing well-appointed guest rooms equipped with state-of-the-art technology to meet the needs of both business and leisure travelers. A range of services and facilities ensure a comfortable and convenient stay.

101746.description: This hotel boasts a prime location at the heart of Marrakech. The hotel is located in l'Hivernage, close to the Palace of Congress, the Royal Theatre and the train station. The renowned Jemaa el Fna Square can be found just a 10 minutes' walking distance away. Guests will find themselves just a 20 minutes' walk from the Koutoubia. Menara Airport is conveniently situated just a 20 minutes' walk away. The hotel features a delightful restaurant, where delectable dishes can be enjoyed. Also, it features a pool and sun loungers, as well as a rooftop sun terrace. This hotel enjoys a superb design, beautifully combining traditional and contemporary elements. The hotel's rooms and flats are sumptuously designed.

101747.description: This hotel is located in the city centre, in the Guéliz district and is an ideal point of departure for walks around the city and visits to cultural sites. The medina is 2 kms away and it is 70 kms to Oukaimeden. Marrakech Airport is just 4 kms from the hotel. This hotel is built in style of traditional Moroccan houses and riads and combines this traditional element with convenient facilities for its guests. The lines and warm colours of the hotel interiors mix Zellige Fassi, marble and mosaics and offer a true haven of peace. There is parking available for those arriving by car. At the spa centre guests can enjoy a real traditional Hammam beauty ritual. This city hotel comprises rooms spread over several floors as well as a garden and a terrace.

101749.description: This hotel is located 300 metres from Majorelle Gardens, near Doukalah and not far from the coach station. Gueliz is 1 km away, as are the nearest shops, and it is 2 km to Place Jamaa el Fna. The hotel lies a 15-minute drive from Marrakech Airport. This city hotel comprises a total of 41 twin rooms and 5 suites and is ideal for business travellers and holidaymakers alike. It features a cafeteria with panoramic views on the ground floor, as well as a garden, private parking and a conference room. Further facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility and a cloakroom. It also offers a newspaper stand, a TV lounge, a dining area, Internet access (charges apply) and room service (for an additional fee). All the rooms come with a private bathroom with a shower/bathtub as well as a telephone, Internet access and satellite TV. They are also equipped with a king-size or double bed, air conditioning and heating, a safe and either a balcony or a terrace. Guests may select their continental breakfast from a buffet or a menu.

101750.description: This hotel is located in the centre of the new tourist zone, and faces the Atlas Mountains, the Ancient wall of the Royal Palace and Marrakech's Gardens of Agdal. Gueliz is just a 15-minute walk, as is Place Jamaa el Fna and it is 2 hours' drive to Casablanca. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a conference centre with meeting rooms. This hotel is proud of its SPA centre which offers a range of services and facilities designed to induce utter pleasure and relaxation. Additionally, sports enthusiasts may enjoy a work-out in the gym. This SPA hotel features traditional architecture and is decorated in Moroccan style. It is ideal for both holidaymakers and business travellers alike and comprises very spacious rooms.

101805.address: Rue Louise-Emilie De La Tour D'Auvergne, 10
101805.description: This charming city hotel, housed in a building dating back to 1890 and renovated in 2008, is nestled on a quiet street near the Opéra Garnier and major department stores. Restaurants and bars are mere steps away, and the Cadet metro station is just 150 meters from the hotel, providing easy access to the heart of Paris (a 10-minute walk) and attractions like Montmartre. This 24-room hotel offers a range of amenities for both business and leisure travelers, including a 24-hour reception, air conditioning, lift access, a café, a bar, a breakfast room, internet access, room service, and laundry services. Each individually decorated room provides a cozy and restful atmosphere with modern conveniences like a private bathroom with a shower/bathtub and hairdryer, a double bed, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a mini-fridge, and individually adjustable air conditioning and heating. Guests can enjoy breakfast each morning.

101816.description: Your home in the heart of Paris! Cadet Residence offers studios and apartments for true Parisian living during your stay in the French capital. Our tourist residence offers you the convenience of some hotel services with the intimacy of an unusually spacious place of your own, ideal for tourists and business travellers alike. Our central location and accessibility to public transport is a major advantage.

101978.description: With a stay at Hôtel Claridge, you'll be centrally located in Paris, a short 3-minute walk from the Champs-Élysées and 12 minutes on foot from the Arc de Triomphe. This 4-star hotel is 1. 1 miles (1. 7 km) from the Eiffel Tower and 1. 4 miles (2. 2 km) from the Palais Garnier. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall. Make yourself at home in one of the 42 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Enjoy a bite from the snack bar/deli, or take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge.
