Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to noon for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The hotel also offers 25 square feet (2 square meters) of event space, including a conference area and meeting room. Airport shuttle service is available 24 hours a day (surcharge).

102045.description: Located on vibrant Commercial Road, this apartment complex offers easy access to Limehouse Station, the City, and Canary Wharf. Nearby, explore picturesque docks, basins, and waterways, including Limehouse Marina just 400 meters away. Renowned dining options such as Gordon Ramsay's The Narrow and Nobu Restaurant are within 800 meters. London City Airport is 8 km away, and Heathrow is 54 km. Established in 2008, this complex caters to both business and leisure travelers. Its 81 stylish apartments offer comfort and striking London views. Guests enjoy a 24-hour reception, lift access, and Wi-Fi. Each modern apartment features a furnished living and dining room, satellite/digital TV, DVD player, iron, ironing board, and a fully equipped kitchen with a fridge, cooker, microwave, and tea/coffee facilities. The emphasis on light and space is evident in the large, picturesque windows, many floor-to-ceiling in the living areas. Enjoy ten times the space of a typical hotel room, complimentary broadband internet, Sky Freeview, and weekly linen changes. Bedrooms include a double bed with a walnut headboard, telephone, and alarm clock. Private bathrooms offer a power shower, bathtub, Molton Brown toiletries, a heated towel rail, hairdryer, and shaving socket. A direct-dial telephone, radio, washing machine, and central heating are also standard. All apartments include a balcony or terrace.

102175.description: This hotel is located on the north-western limits of the region of Alt Penedés, in a zone which is considered to be the lung of the area. It borders on Llacuna, Querol, Aiguamúrcia, Montmell and Torrelles de Foix, and occupies the most densely wooded area of the region. The Solanas peak (914m), that of Mas Fonoll (794m) and the rocks of Pany (712m) are some of the highest in the region. Guests will find links to the public transport network 100 m away and a restaurant/ bar just 200 m from the hotel. It is a 15-minute drive to the tourist centre of Vilafranca, with its shops, and the beach is a 30-minute drive away at Sitges. Guests will find a number of attractions in the area such as the Ruta de las Hermitas (3 km), the Castell de Sat. Martí de Sarroca (10 minutes), the Monasterio de Santes Creus (15 minutes) and the Ruta del Vino y el Cava (10 km). Barcelona Airport is 55 km away. This country hotel, with its 14 rooms, is housed in a beautiful stone-built residence dating back to the 19th century and restored in 2007. It preserves the charm of bygone decades, combining it with all the comforts of the modern age. The interiors feature rustic, romantic and welcoming decoration using natural materials. This charming, family friendly property is also a great venue for any kind of event. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area, a currency exchange facility, a cafe, a newspaper stand and a mini supermarket. It also offers a bar, a restaurant and WLAN Internet access and guests may take advantage of the room and laundry services. The property also offers a game reserve so that fans of hunting sports have all the more reason to enjoy their stay here. Those wishing to explore the surrounding area by bicycle will find a cycle hire station at the hotel and there is parking for those arriving by car.

name.content: Melia London Kensington Member of Melia Collection

102239.description: This luxury newly refurbished townhouse hotel enjoys a stunning setting in London. It is located at the heart of Kensington and Chelsea, on one of London's renowned tree-lined avenues with the Natural History Museum, Science Museum, V&A, Royal Albert Hall and Hyde Park minutes away. Well connected with Gloucester Road tube station just a short walk, the hotel enjoys close proximity to London's financial and business centre. SW7 restaurant and bar is located in the hotel, an exclusive place to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and discover a fascinating fusion of British and Mediterranean cuisine and an eclectic selection of signature cocktails inspired by William Morris artworks The hotel lies just a short stroll away from the city's Royal Parks. This hotel combines an excellent location with exemplary facilities and genuine hospitality. The guest rooms enjoy a classical design, oozing elegance and sophistication. The hotel offers a range of exemplary facilities and services, ensuring a first-class experience that is sure to impress.

102244.description: This unique hotel is located in the heart of the art district of the Montmartre area, facing the Sacré Coeur, just a short walk from the famous Moulin Rouge and Galeries Lafayette. This quarter of Paris is a vibrant district for theatre and music, catering for all tastes. In the vicinity, there are many boutiques, cafes and restaurants. The surrounding area is filled with beautiful heritage buildings. The hotel enjoys easy access to the French capital's major attractions, such as Notre Dame Cathedral, the Eiffel Tower, and Disneyland.

102294.description: This modern aparthotel enjoys a prime location in Buenos Aires' exclusive Recoleta residential district. The Retiro railway station and renowned Recoleta Cemetery are only a fifteen-minute walk from the hotel and the distinguished Plaza de Mayo can be reached in half an hour on foot. The hotel's contemporary studio apartments are perfect for business and leisure travel alike, offering the maximum in comfort and practicality in a large, inviting space where guests can rest, work, cook and eat. Each apartment features trendy decor, a kitchenette with refrigerator and microwave, work space, and a full en suite bathroom. After a long day of meetings or sightseeing, guests might go for a refreshing swim in the indoor pool, work out in the fitness centre or make use of the free Wi-Fi and internet station in the lobby. This hotel's excellent location and helpful amenities make it ideal for any type of travel to Buenos Aires.

102333.description: Located in Paris's 17th Arrondissement, L'Adresse hotel is a short drive from the Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées. This hotel offers 23 guestrooms with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy satellite programming, private bathrooms with designer toiletries, and convenient amenities like laptop-compatible safes and desks. Take advantage of room service, or enjoy the daily buffet breakfast (available for a fee). Additional amenities include a terrace, concierge services, complimentary newspapers, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Nearby attractions include the Eiffel Tower and Palais Garnier.

102338.description: This charming property is conveniently located close to the city of Haarlem, the capital of the province of North Holland. It is situated along the A208 in Santpoort and Amsterdam city centre is just a 15-minute drive. Guests will find themselves close to a number of galleries, bars, restaurants and museums. The accommodation units feature a modern décor and are equipped with air conditioning and complimentary coffee and tea making facilities. Bright and spacious, all the guest rooms provide magnificent views over the city. Ideal for business and leisure travellers, all the outstanding facilities have been designed with travellers' comfort in mind and include a terrace, ideal to enjoy a refreshing drink in the warmest summer days and a restaurant serving an extensive choice of dishes from the à la carte menu. Free Wi-Fi internet connection is available for visitors' convenience.

102417.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including an outdoor pool, a spa tub, and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Grab a bite to eat at the The Bayview, a restaurant where you can take in the ocean view, or stay in and take advantage of 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Mumbai? This hotel has 6426 square feet (597 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 68 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Marine Drive - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Air India Building - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Mantralaya - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Maharashtra State Assembly - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- MCGM Garden Oshiwara - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Bombay High Court - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Wankhede Stadium - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Fashion Street Market - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Flora Fountain - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Museum - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Bombay Stock Exchange - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Colaba Causeway - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Maharashtra State Lawn Tennis Association - 1. 4 km / 0. 8 mi- Horniman Circle Gardens - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Bombay Hospital - 1. 6 km / 1 mi.

102420.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an indoor pool, and a spa tub. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy British cuisine at Twentynine Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). English breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 67 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

102503.description: Located in Barcelona's Sants-Montjuïc district, the eco-certified Aparthotel BCN Montjuïc is within a 5-minute drive of Poble Espanyol and Plaça de Catalunya. This aparthotel offers a fitness center, a seasonal outdoor pool, and bicycle rentals. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, digital programming on your flat-screen TV, and premium bedding. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Other amenities include a business center, 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Self-parking is available (subject to charges).

102505.description: This hotel is located in the town centre, next to the famous Fenice Theatre, and a 5 minutes' walk from St. Mark's Square, the Palazzo Grassi and public transport links. The location of the hotel is particularly privileged - a home in the heart of the city; a unique chance to experience real Venetian life in a pleasant and relaxed atmosphere. This historical city hotel, built in 1894 and renovated in 2007, offers a total of 68 rooms. Popular with performing artists and painters for decades, it displays autographed photographs in the lobby. The tranquillity and 19th-century Venetian atmosphere of the hotel is also enjoyed by an international blend of leisure travellers. The bright entry hall forms a triangle shape, which connects the original building on the left to the new wing on the right. All guestrooms are unique, each with its own charm, all in Venetian style.

102553.description:
•	Newly refurbished Victorian building style Boutique hotel in the heart of London, only a few minutes walking from Marble Arch, Hyde Park and Oxford Street. 
•	Amazingly connected with Paddington station, located just metres from our hotel, with easy access to Heathrow Airport (Heathrow express available) and 4 different underground lines: Bakerloo, Circle, District line and Hammersmith & City.
•	All our newly refurbished rooms and suite have modern amenities, including air conditioner, a flat-screen smart TV, minibar and safe for our guest's best comfort. Hair dryer, iron and tea-coffee maker are available in all rooms as well.
•	All rooms have their own new modern design bathroom equipped with smart toilets, spacious showers and complimentary toiletries.  
•	Free Wi-Fi is available in the rooms and throughout the property.
•	24 hours reception/concierge.

102554.description: Located in central London, the Waterloo Hub Hotel is a budget-friendly option for solo and family travelers. Our cozy rooms feature comfortable beds, fresh linens and towels, a TV, and an en-suite bathroom with a shower, complimentary toiletries, and ample storage. Guests can also enjoy complimentary tea and coffee around the clock in our lounge area. We're within walking distance of iconic landmarks like the London Eye, Houses of Parliament, Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, and Trafalgar Square, and just a short stroll from Waterloo International Train Station, as well as Lambeth North and Elephant & Castle tube stations.

102576.address: Gullerpinari Mah. Arikan Yilmaz Dim Sok.No:3
102576.description: This aparthotel is 1. 4 km from the city centre of Alanya and 400 m from the beach. It is surrounded by banana trees, palms, oleander trees and many other different plants. Alanya Castle is around 5 km away, and Damlatas Cave is some 3. 5 km from the property. The hotel is located around 10 km from the Dim River. Antalya Airport is around 130 km away. This lovely boutique aparthotel comprises 28 accommodation units. It is air-conditioned and additionally features a restaurant, a market, a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and lift access to the accommodation. Guests may make use of the TV lounge and the children's playground, relax in the café or bar, or enjoy room service. A car park is available for those arriving by car, and a laundry service is offered (for a fee). All hotel rooms are air-conditioned and have individually regulated heating and feature double beds, a telephone, a kitchen with refrigerator, cooker, kettle and all kitchen utensils, a private bathroom with shower/WC, a hairdryer and balcony. The hotel offers guests the possibility of playing volleyball in the garden, as well as chess and table tennis. It also has dance activities every day. The large garden also features an outdoor pool with water slide and children's swimming area, a poolside snack bar, sun loungers and parasols. These can also be hired for an additional fee on the nearby sandy beach. Breakfast is served daily. Lunch and dinner are available à la carte.

102614.description: Located in downtown Rio de Janeiro, this budget-friendly hotel offers quality service and convenient access to top attractions. Situated near the vibrant Arcos da Lapa district, known for its culinary scene and lively music, the hotel provides easy access to Santos Dumont Airport, the Museum of Modern Art, the Municipal Theatre, and more. The hotel's 166 standard rooms feature air conditioning and essential amenities. Guests can enjoy refreshments at the on-site coffee shop, bar, and lounge. Business travelers will appreciate the business center and meeting room facilities. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.

102615.description: The attractive city hotel OK Rio de Janeiro is ideally located in the centre of this fascinating city, just a step away from famous Cinelândia Square. In the vicinity, guests can find points of interest such as the Municipal Theatre, National Museum of Fine Arts, National Library, Petrobras or the Metropolitan Cathedral. The metro station at Cinelândia offers easy access to the whole city, including the world-famous beaches of Copacabana and Ipanema. The hotel features comfortable and cosy rooms, all equipped with air-conditioning. Culinary options of the hotel include a restaurant serving a delicious combination of Carioca, Brazilian and international dishes as well as a coffee shop tempting with the best of cakes, pies and cappuccinos. A fitness centre, a sauna and an outdoor pool invite to work out and relax. Thanks to its perfect situation, this hotel is an ideal starting point to explore one of the world's most fascinating cities. Important: The pool is closed every Monday for weekly maintenance.

102663.description: This hotel enjoys a central location close to the lively Leidseplein square where guests can find restaurants, shops and bars. Amsterdam Airport Schiphol is located around 12 km away. Recently converted from an 18th-century mansion, the establishment is now a design-centric hotel where traditional décor is combined with modern amenities. It offers 38 air-conditioned guestrooms and an array of services designed for guests' convenience. Visitors can take refreshments in the bar and unwind in the living area. All of the comfortable units are en-suite. The bathrooms enjoy plenty of natural daylight and have a walk-in shower. Rooms also feature a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV and Internet access. Guests can relax on the balcony or terrace. The double rooms overlook the Roemer Visscherstraat.

102715.address: Lugar Do Extremo, Vale de Anta, -
102715.description: Situated near the exit of the A24 to Chaves, and only 8 kms from Spain, the Hotel Casino Chaves rises majestically over the city in a green area, which invites one to days of rest and leisure. Overlooking the city and the mountains, in a unique environment of tranquility, the four-star unit is the ideal setting for those travelling for leisure or on business, looking for comfort, refinement and quality. The Casino, situated next to the Hotel, complements the offer by opening its doors to fun with a wide variety of games and slot machines, the best cuisine and cultural events and shows filled with national and international artists.

102836.description:
This country house hotel is conveniently located close to Caterham, Redhill and Crawley & Reigate. It is also within easy reach of the centre of London, as well as attractions like Hever Castle, Chartwell National Trust, Chessington World of Adventures, Thorpe Park, Legoland, the RHS Gardens at Wisley and Lingfield and Epsom Race course. Gatwick Airport and Heathrow Airport are roughly 14 km and 54 km from the hotel, respectively.

The hotel, which dates back to 1872, is an idyllic country mansion set high on Nutfield ridge. It enjoys breathtaking views of the Sussex and Surrey countryside. Enjoy afternoon tea in one of the elegant Victorian lounges; curl up in front of a roaring log fire in the grand Library; or, on a fine day, simply enjoy the fresh air and panoramic views across the countryside from the terrace. The hotel has 60 guestrooms and a lobby providing a 24-hour reception and check-out service, cloakroom and lift access. Guests can wine and dine in the hotel restaurant, café and bar, and the hotel also offers room service. There are conference facilities and a car park on site.

Each of the guestrooms, including family rooms and sleek executive rooms, has been lovingly furnished. There are soft, warm fabrics, high-quality furniture and, in the gleaming bathrooms, unique luxury toiletries. Alongside these timeless comforts is the latest 21st-century gadgetry, including widescreen TVs with satellite channels, DVD and CD players, direct dial telephone, radio and high speed Internet access. All rooms come fitted with an en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub and hairdryer, as well as tea and coffee making facilities, a fridge and an ironing set.

Adjacent to the hotel, the Spa is an oasis of relaxation with its sauna, steam room and range of health treatments. For those looking to get more active, there is the Leisure Club complete with indoor pool, snack bar, gym, squash courts and body studio for yoga and Pilates (fees may apply).

102837.description: Set in a Victorian mansion in 55 acres of grounds, Norton House features a luxury spa, award-winning restaurant and boutique rooms with free internet. Edinburgh is a 20-minute drive, and Edinburgh Airport is 3 miles away. Bedrooms at Norton House Hotel & Spa each have a modern bathroom with free toiletries and fluffy bathrobes. All rooms have a satellite TV/DVD player and a minibar. Guests can relax in the sauna, steam room or hydrotherapy pool in the luxurious spa. The health club also has a swimming pool with feature fountains, a fully equipped gym and treatment rooms. Ushers Restaurant offers fine dining and specialist wines in elegant surroundings. The Brasserie offers traditional British cuisine, and The Glass Lounge serves classic cocktails and afternoon teas. Set in leafy grounds, Norton House Hotel is just off the junction of M8 and M9 motorways. Free on-site parking is available.

102935.description: Located on Belek's glorious shoreline, this modern hotel has an eye-catching architectural style and spacious grounds occupying 200,000 m2 of land. Suitable for most ages, the complex features a variety of accommodation including rooms and villas with direct/private access to a swimming pool. Amongst the extensive range of facilities is the hotel's own golf course which is accessible through a passageway from the hotel. Antalya Airport is 35 km away and public transport and taxis run from the hotel entrance. (Some facilities may not be operational year round due to weather/seasonal conditions).

102965.description: Situated on the frontier with Spain, in the historical centre of Valença, in Portugal, this stylish property is the ideal choice for those travellers seeking the harmony of nature in an idyllic setting. It provides easy access to some medieval sites in the city such as Santa Maria dos Anjos church. Oporto airport is 115 kilometres away. This charming hotel welcomes guests in a peaceful atmosphere and invites them to discover the beautiful landscape of the region. All the guest rooms have been tastefully decorated and include a private bathroom with VIP toiletries. Business travellers will appreciate the meeting facilities featuring state-of-the-art equipment. As for the dining options, the on-site restaurants are known for their high quality and refined ambience, offering guests a sophisticated cuisine.

102971.description: There are a total of 38 units on the premises. Clients may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. La Perle offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. La Perle may charge a fee for some services.

103061.description: This beach hotel is situated in the commercial suburb of Glyfada, near the beach resort known as the 'Athenian Riviera'. The heart of the Greek capital is a 20-minute drive away and Glyfada Square, with its shopping and sports centres, restaurants serving all choices of international cuisine and non-stop nightlife, is a 5-minute walk away. The modern 7-storey building is furnished in a classy style and offers all the conveniences required by business and leisure travellers. There are specially-dedicated executive rooms decorated in different styles and perfectly equipped for business use. Those who need to take their meetings to a more casual surrounding can book a round at the nearby 18-hole golf course. The rest of the guests can spend their days lazing around in the garden with its outdoor swimming pool or working on their tan and enjoying the waves at the nearby beach.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express New York City - Chelsea

103073.description: EXPLORE EXHILARATING NEW YORK CITY FROM OUR CHELSEA HOTEL!The newly renovated Holiday Inn Express NYC - Chelsea places you near top attractions and big businesses with maximum ease. Our newly remodeled accommodations feature contemporary design, thoughtful amenities, and flex space to keep you productive. Stay connected with free Wi-Fi, charging stations, streaming TV, and access to an on-site business center. Start each day with a delicious hot breakfast that’s always our courtesy and recharge at the fitness center allowing you to maintain your wellness routine even when you travel. While staying in NYC, take advantage of our prime location. Situated between SoHo and Central Park near Madison Square Garden, Penn Station, Hudson Yards with many major corporations close by. Plus, convenient access to the Empire State Building, High Line Park, Rockefeller Center, Jacob Javits Center, Times Square and Chelsea Market. Stroll along to see the many NYC attractions like world-class museums, the dynamic arts & culture scene, exceptional shopping, and a multitude of dining choices. It’s all yours to explore, right outside our doors.

103094.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at this Mediterranean hotel, complete with complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. A shuttle service (surcharge) provides convenient access to the nearby beach and shopping center. Savor delicious meals at the beachfront Adalya Restaurant, featuring a bar/lounge and 24-hour room service. A complimentary local breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 11:30 AM, and guests can mingle at the daily complimentary reception. The hotel also offers wedding services, a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Roundtrip airport and cruise ship terminal shuttles are available (surcharge). Each of the 30 guestrooms provides comfort and convenience, including a minibar, LCD television with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, down comforters, Egyptian cotton sheets, and a bathroom with a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. Located near Antalya’s historic Kaleiçi district, the hotel is a short distance from attractions such as the Antalya Toy Museum, Kaleiçi Marina, and Alaaddin Mosque. Antalya Intl. Airport (AYT) is the preferred airport.

name.content: Hampton Inn Manhattan - Madison Square Garden Area

103133.description: The newly renovated Hampton Inn Manhattan-Madison Square Garden offers stylish, modern rooms with enhanced comfort features. Located in midtown Manhattan, it's steps from Madison Square Garden, Penn Station, and Herald Square. Enjoy complimentary hot breakfast and high-speed wired/wireless internet. Explore nearby attractions like the Empire State Building, Macy's, and Hudson Yards, or discover trendy neighborhoods such as Chelsea and the Garment District. While the Business Center, breakfast, and valet parking are available with reduced service, please note the Fitness Center is currently unavailable.

103134.description:
The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Business Center, Breakfast, Valet Parking.The following services and amenities are currently not available: Fitness Center.The Hampton Inn Manhattan-Chelsea, NY hotel is a new modern 20 story high-rise hotel located in the trendy up and coming district of Chelsea, New York, bordering the West Village and Midtown Manhattan.  This New York Hampton Inn hotel is equipped with all the latest conveniences to make you feel right at home in the Big Apple.  The Hampton Inn hotel at Chelsea is located on the south side of 24th Street near the southwest corner of 6th Avenue, between 6th and 7th Avenues.  

The Hampton Inn Manhattan-Chelsea hotel in New York features some of the latest state-of-the-art offerings including complimentary high-speed internet access.  Guests can relax in our lobby area in comfort and style overlooking the garden terrace.  This New York Hampton Inn hotel offers the luxury of being located in the heart of Manhattan and the convenience of all major transportation hubs right near our doorstep.  

Transportation venues nearby include the NJ Path train station, Subway lines F and V, 1 and 9, Metro North to Grand Central and the Long Island Rail Road to Penn Station.  Parking is available adjacent to the Hampton Inn Manhattan-Chelsea hotel and rates vary by times of entry and length of parking.

As a member of Hilton Hotels, the Hampton Inn Manhattan-Chelsea hotel in New York proudly offers the HHonors guest rewards program and our 100% satisfaction guaranteed program.  

We love having you here at the Hampton Inn Manhattan-Chelsea hotel in New York, New York.

103246.description: The Astoria Copacabana Hotel enjoys a quiet, tree-lined location in the heart of Copacabana, just two blocks from the famous beach. Its strategic position on this renowned avenue provides easy access to numerous restaurants and entertainment venues. The subway is also within walking distance, offering convenient links to the rest of the city. Rio de Janeiro-Galeão International Airport is approximately 20 km away. Airport transfers and city tours are available; please consult our reservations department for details. General Information: * Daily rates begin at 2 pm and end at 12 pm. * Breakfast is included in the daily rate when served in the hotel restaurant. * One child up to 8 years old stays free when sharing existing bedding with parents. * Cancellations or changes must be made 48 hours before check-in (excluding group bookings). * Payments for New Year's Eve, Carnival, and other major events are non-refundable.

103259.description: Located in Barcelona's heart, near Placa Catalunya, this 2007 hotel offers easy access to major attractions. A short walk takes you to Las Ramblas, Paseo de Gracia, or the Picasso Museum. Sagrada Familia and Barceloneta Beach are a pleasant stroll away, and Barcelona Airport is conveniently close. The hotel features twelve modern accommodations, including eight one and two-bedroom apartments. Each apartment offers a fully equipped kitchen, ensuring a comfortable home-away-from-home experience. Guests can enjoy amenities such as lift access and Wi-Fi. Apartments are spacious, bright, and warmly decorated. They feature private bathrooms, satellite TV, internet access, and well-equipped kitchens with fridges, cookers, microwaves, and tea/coffee facilities. Additional conveniences include ironing sets, double beds, individual climate control, and balconies or terraces.

103274.description: Guests seeking charming service, an inviting atmosphere, and a central location will find what they're looking for at Hotel Vilar América, a family-run business since 1979. The hotel features 7 meeting rooms, two cozy restaurants, and 76 spacious guest rooms, including fully equipped apartments ideal for extended stays in Bogotá. Boasting an ideal location in Bogotá's main business and financial district, Hotel Vilar América is conveniently located near the historic Candelaria district, the vibrant Zona Rosa nightlife, and the gastronomic Zona G. These unique features make this welcoming hotel a priceless retreat for both business and leisure travelers, who will appreciate the proximity to numerous shopping options and popular tourist attractions. At Hotel Vilar América, you'll enjoy a commitment to a safe and clean environment, along with excellent service, recognized with the TripAdvisor Certificate of Excellence Award for four consecutive years (2016-2020). By choosing Hotel Vilar América, you'll also support the social and environmental commitment that has led it to become the first B Corp Hotel in Colombia.

103293.description:
Located by the beach on Dubai’s glamorous and cosmopolitan leisure and retail promenade, The Walk, Amwaj Rotana is one of the finest five-star luxury hotels in the Marina district. With popular attractions right on its doorstep, from the famous Jumeirah Beach and bustling Beach Mall with its children’s waterpark, to Bluewaters Island, home to the world’s tallest Ferris Wheel, Ain Dubai, it is a convenient and luxurious destination for business and leisure travelers. Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International are both a 25-minute drive from the property. 

Enjoy the sophistication and space of our 301 elegantly-furnished rooms and suites, all featuring private balconies with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, Palm Jumeirah, Bluewaters Island and Ain Dubai, plus complimentary Wi-Fi. Upgrade to our bespoke Club Rotana rooms and make the most of our hotel-within-a-hotel concept offering exclusive benefits and privileges, including lounge access. 

Experience our award-winning food and beverage venues including the world-famous Benihana Restaurant, serving delicious American-Japanese Teppanyaki; JB’s Gastropub, with a menu inspired by British and American pub favourites; the chic Rosso Restaurant and Bar offering authentic Italian flair; and our all-day dining venue, Horizon, showcasing the world’s most popular cuisines. For a casual get together with friends, try the funky Arabesque Fumo Lounge by Rosso; sip a relaxing drink by the pool at the Sundeck Pool Bar; or enjoy a quick bite and coffee or freshly-squeezed juice at the Atrium Lobby Lounge. For business meetings or events with distinction, choose from three conference rooms and the world-class Sadaf Ballroom, all equipped with state-of-the-art technologies.

103294.address: Po Box 211222, Crescent Road, The Palm
103294.description: Atlantis, The Palm is a 1,548-room ocean-themed destination resort that will take you a world away from your everyday. Spectacularly situated on the crescent of Dubai's iconic Palm Island, this majestic resort is home to mesmerising experiences that will give you a holiday of a lifetime. Thrill-seekers can enjoy record-breaking rides at Atlantis Aquaventure Waterpark, the world's largest waterpark with a total of 105 slides, attractions, and experiences. Take the Leap of Faith and slide through a shark-filled lagoon or enjoy over 2 kilometres of river rapids in the Lazy River. Children can play at Splashers, the biggest kid's only waterpark experience in the Middle East. Those looking to discover our spectacular marine animals can wander through The Lost Chambers Aquarium and witness the myth of Atlantis brought to life through a maze of underground tunnels offering underwater views of 65,000 marine animals. Those looking to make new friends can head down to the most sophisticated marine mammal habitat on the planet and interact with our charming lndo-Pacific bottlenose dolphins at Dolphin Bay or our furry South African fur seals at Sea Lion Point. Guests staying at Atlantis, The Palm benefit from daily complimentary access to Atlantis Aquaventure Waterpark and The Lost Chambers Aquarium and enjoy exclusive rates at Dolphin Bay and Sea Lion Point during their stay. For food lovers, Atlantis, The Palm is an extraordinary culinary destination, with award-winning restaurants and celebrity chef experiences from Gordon Ramsay, Nobu Matsuhisa and Giorgio Locatelli. Kids and teens can take a break from their parents with Atlantis Kids Club for children ages 4 to 12 and The Zone for teens ages 13 to 17. Mum and dad unwind from the daily grind in one of the 27 treatment rooms at the award-winning ShuiQi Spa & Fitness.

103296.description: Strategically located in the heart of Dubai's new business district on Sheikh Zayed Road, The H Dubai stands opposite the World Trade Centre and close to the Dubai International Finance Centre. The hotel offers easy access to and from the airport, commercial areas in south Dubai, shopping malls, and beaches. Showcasing elegance and bespoke luxury, it provides unique experiences and warm hospitality. The H Dubai is known for its diverse dining options and the Mandara Spa, a two-time World Spa and Wellness Awards finalist and the only one of its kind in the UAE. This contemporary Arabesque hotel also features 15 function rooms and a ballroom with a capacity of 500 to 800 guests. Boasting 236 spacious rooms and suites with views of Dubai's skyline, The H Dubai is ideal for both leisure and business travelers. It's just a short walk from the Dubai International Exhibition Centre and Dubai International Financial Centre, and offers easy access to The Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, and a myriad of exclusive shopping and dining experiences.

103297.address: Sheikh Rashid Road, Wafi, PO BOX 121800
103297.description: Raffles Dubai, a stunning landmark hotel in a distinctive pyramid shape merges Asian style with an Egyptian aesthetic. Rooms and suites are some of the largest in the city starting from 70 square metres with a private balcony, spectacular views and a luxurious residential feel. With a choice of 7 exceptional restaurants and bars, luxury spa, outdoor pool, extensive meetings facilities as well a myriad of retail stores in Wafi Mall, the hotel is the ultimate destination from which to explore Dubai.

103299.description: This luxurious urban hotel is located just 9 km from Dubai International Financial Centre, traditional souqs (markets) and modern shopping centres. The hotel lies amidst the commercial and business district of Deira. It houses a large choice of rooms and suites, each completely equipped to the very highest standards. The hotel also has 2 restaurants and a café, as well as comprehensive conference facilities. For a fresh and energetic start to the day guests have the choice to take a quick jog in the gym, sweat it out in the sauna or steam room, or simply relax and unwind in the hot tub. There is also a rooftop pool overlooking the Creek of Dubai, ideal to take a dip while enjoying the beautiful vistas.

103300.description: You'll be centrally located in Dubai with a stay at Crowne Plaza Festival City, an IHG Hotel, you'll be 9 minutes by foot from Dubai Festival City Mall. This luxury hotel is 5. 8 mi (9. 3 km) from Dubai World Trade Centre and 6. 8 mi (10. 9 km) from Gold Souk. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a health club, an outdoor pool, and a spa tub. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can catch a ride on the complimentary shuttle, which operates within 10 kilometers. Make yourself at home in one of the 316 guestrooms featuring minibars and plasma televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at Zaytoun, a poolside restaurant where you can dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and 11 meeting rooms. A shuttle from the hotel to the airport is complimentary at scheduled times, and a train station pick-up service is also provided at no charge. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Dubai Festival City Mall - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Dubai Creek - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Dubai Creek Golf & Yacht Club - 3. 3 km / 2 mi- Dubai Tennis Stadium - 3. 7 km / 2. 3 mi- Mohammed Bin Rashid University Of Medicine and Health Sciences - 4.

103301.description: You'll be centrally located in Dubai with a stay at InterContinental Dubai Festival City, an IHG Hotel, you'll be 10 minutes by foot from Dubai Festival City Mall. This luxury hotel is 5. 7 mi (9. 2 km) from Dubai World Trade Centre and 6. 7 mi (10. 9 km) from Gold Souk. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an outdoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the complimentary area shuttle that operates within 10 kilometers. Make yourself at home in one of the 508 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Bathrooms feature bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Enjoy international cuisine at Anise, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee.

name.content: Tamani Marina Hotel and Hotel Apartment

103303.description: Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including a health club, an outdoor pool, and an indoor pool. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy international cuisine at Cafe Society, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 am to 11 am for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. The hotel has two meeting rooms available for events. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available on-site. Make yourself at home in one of the 245 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Satellite programming and DVD players are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected. Bathrooms feature showers, designer toiletries, and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. American University of Dubai (AUD) - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi; Mohammad Bin Ahmed Al Mulla Mosque - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi; Palm Islands - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi; The Walk - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi; Skydive Dubai - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi; Marina Beach - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi; Dubai Harbour Viewpoint - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi; The Beach Mall - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi; Dubai Marina Mall - 2. 5 km / 1. 5 mi; Emirates Golf Club - 2. 6 km / 1. 6 mi; Dubai College - 3. 4 km / 2. 1 mi; Al Sufouh Beach - 3. 8 km / 2. 4 mi; Jebel Ali Race Course - 4. 2 km / 2. 6 mi; Bluewaters Island - 4. 3 km / 2. 7 mi; Ain Dubai - 4. 3 km / 2. 7 mi. The nearest airports are: Al Maktoum Intl. Airport (DWC) - 38. 4 km / 23. 9 mi; Dubai Intl. Airport (DXB) - 31. 3 km / 19. 5 mi; Sharjah (SHJ-Sharjah Intl. ) - 59 km / 36 mi.

103304.address: 8th street Port Saeed District. Deira, N/A
103304.description: This stunning city hotel enjoys a prime location in captivating Dubai, close to the Dubai International Convention Centre and the city's thriving business district. Dubai International Airport is just a 4-minute drive away. With a spectacular interior to match its impressive facade, this grand hotel entices guests with ultimate luxury and splendor. Original, hand-painted artworks adorn the walls, creating an ambiance of understated elegance. The guest rooms, featuring timeless beauty and decadence, offer the perfect escape from the bustling city. Guests will be impressed by the exemplary range of amenities and facilities, catering to their every need with the highest degree of excellence.

103305.description: The Copthorne Hotel Dubai is located in Port Saeed, Deira just 5 minutes walk from the popular shopping and entertainment complex Deira City Centre, and 10 minutes drive from Dubai International Airport. This contemporary four star hotel consists of 210 spacious rooms and suites, offering guests panoramic views over Dubai Creek and surrounding parks from private balconies. Accommodations benefit from modern amenities including plasma TV with satellite channels, mini bar, tea and coffee making facilities, and high speed internet. The hotel has a choice of 3 restaurants, including one where guests can enjoy their meal under a glass ceiling. There is also a cafe on-site serving light meals and refreshments. Leisure facilities include a well-equipped gymnasium, temperature-controlled outdoor swimming pool and jacuzzi, steam bath, sauna, and sun lounge beds. Customers please note no alcohol is served on the premises.

103306.description: This charming and comfortable hotel boasts a great position in Deira, near Al Ghurair Shopping Mall and within easy reach from public transport links, as Al Rigga Metro Station is a stone's throw from the premises. In the surrounding area, visitors will find attractions such as Dubai Clock Tower and Dubai International Airport at a mere distance of 5 kilometres away. All the hotel's rooms are equipped with a working desk, an en-suite bathroom and tea and coffee making facilities. There is also Internet access available for guests to keep updated during their stay. The hotel's main restaurant serves international cuisine, whilst a choice of light snacks and beverages are available in the lobby lounge. The hotel also features a poolside bar and three themed nightclubs. Leisure amenities include a rooftop pool and a fitness centre.

103307.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a nightclub, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features a hair salon, a television in a common area, and a vending machine. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 77 guestrooms featuring minibars. Rooms have private balconies or patios. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Al Ghurair Centre - 0. 5 km / 0.

103308.description:
This city hotel is located in the Deira district of the city, a major business area, and is just a 10-minute taxi ride from the Dubai Creek Golf & Yacht Club and the Dubai World Trade Centre. The Dubai International Airport lies approximately 5 km away.

This homely hotel has comprehensive facilities and services including secretarial services for business guests and a beach shuttle bus service for leisure travellers. The air-conditioned hotel provides a total of 81 guestrooms, as well as a lobby, bar, café and 3 restaurants.

Each of the hotel's guest rooms is fitted with an en suite bathroom with a shower. The rooms are also equipped with air conditioning, satellite TV, a direct dial telephone, a minibar, Internet access, a fridge, tea and coffee making facilities, an ironing set and a safety deposit box.

There is a swimming pool, a gym and a sauna in the hotel. The Dubai Creek Golf Club is located nearby.

There are three finely designed restaurants in the hotel. Relish authentic Italian dishes at the coffee shop. The bar offers fine drinks and scintillating performances by a live band. The Piazza's Terrace serves international delicacies along with a tempting array of desserts.

name.content: Rose Garden Hotel Apartments - Bur Dubai

103314.description:
A stone's throw away from Burjuman Shopping Centre, this city hotel is strategically located in the heart of Bur Dubai's commercial district. Its proximity to the Dubai World Trade Centre, leading banks and the Dubai Airport makes it an ideal place to stay for businessmen, tourists and shoppers alike.

The hotel offers a total of 56 accommodations, which include beautiful, thoughtfully designed, very spacious studios, as well as 1 and 2-bedroom apartments with all amenities. This air-conditioned establishment has a lobby, coffee shop, leisure facilities, covered car parking and endless hospitality.

All of the accommodation units are fitted with a personal safety deposit box, satellite TV, high speed Internet access, ironing set, centrally regulated air conditioning, international direct dial telephone, washer/dryer, refrigerator and much more to ensure a truly comfortable stay.

The hotel features a luxurious pool and health club with gym, offering sheer elegance and guest satisfaction.

A breakfast buffet is served each morning.

103317.description:
This apartment hotel is superbly located at Baniyas Square in Deira, close to an array of shopping centres, including the Dubai World Trade Centre, which is 10 minutes' drive away.

The air-conditioned hotel offers a choice of 90 well-appointed studio apartments, featuring contemporary furnishings and state-of-the-art amenities. The hotel also provides a lobby, restaurant, coffee shop, conference facilities and room service.

The apartments feature satellite TV, a direct dial telephone, Internet access, minibar, safety deposit box and fully equipped kitchenette.

Fine recreational facilities include a modern gym, a spa offering a range of treatments, a sauna and a hot tub.

There is a restaurant and a cafè, serving excellent cuisine and coffee.

103319.address: PO Box 113696, Khalid Bin Waleed Road
103319.description: Surrounded by a myriad of shopping opportunities, dining venues and vibrant nightlife, this elegant hotel is an optimal option for visitors who seek central setting and utmost comfort on their visit in Dubai. This contemporary property is situated within a few steps from the famous Bur Dubai, Bur Dubai metro station and the popular shopping centre. The welcoming, air-conditioned rooms feature sleek bedding, cosy furniture and cutting edge amenities to afford a truly enjoyable stay. Travelers may enjoy refined dishes and comprehensive selection of beverage served at the hotel restaurant. Throughout the day take a cooling dip in the dazzling rooftop pool or invigorate at the well-equipped gym. Corporate travellers may take advantage of the business centre. Patrons may turn to a friendly and professional staff at the 24-hour reception for recommendations on the best places to visit.

103437.description: The chic and stylish apartments at W6 Hotel come with free Wi-Fi and modern kitchen facilities. Hammersmith Tube Station is a 5-minute walk away, for links to London attractions. Each W6 Hotel apartment is different. However, all feature an LCD TV, some have a DVD. A laundry service, shopping service and concierge can also be used. Via the Piccadilly Line, Hammersmith Station offers direct access to Heathrow Airport, museums at Knightsbridge, and entertainment at Leicester Square and Covent Garden. Private parking is opposite the property, and is available at an additional cost per day.

103462.description: This adults-only hotel enjoys a prime beachfront location in Alanya, with the Taurus Mountains providing a stunning backdrop. Explore the city's rich history at the Ataturk House Museum, Alanya Castle, and the Byzantine-era Church of Saint George, or relax on the area's gorgeous beaches and visit a nearby waterpark. The hotel boasts spacious, sumptuously appointed rooms offering a tranquil retreat. Savor Turkish and international cuisine at the glamorous on-site restaurant, take a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, or enjoy a drink at one of the three bars. Guests can also take advantage of the fitness center, Turkish bath, sauna, hairdresser, table tennis, mini golf, and meeting rooms.

103466.description:
Located on the seafront of the Mediterranean region, Aydinbey King's Palace & Spa - Ultra All Inclusive offers a private sandy beach. The property includes 3 outdoor pools, water slides, a fitness centre and spa facilities. 
Elegantly decorated, the rooms of Aydinbey include air conditioning, LCD TV and a minibar. Each room features a private balcony furnished with a coffee table and 2 chairs. Some rooms offer sea views. 
With indoor and outdoor dining options, King’s Restaurant offers breakfast, lunch and dinner in buffet style. You can enjoy selected dishes of Turkish and international cuisine. The à la carte restaurants offer Turkish and Far East cuisine, and seafood. There are also 5 bars serving a variety of alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, and a café on site. 
The spa centre includes a sauna and a Turkish bath. You can also relax in the hot tub. 
Manavgat town centre is 15 km from the property. Antalya Airport is within 60 km.

103482.description:
The hotel enjoys a peaceful and relaxed location in the centre of the city. The building is one of the city's landmarks, along with the Hostería del Estudiante in the former San Jerónimo college, which was founded by Cardinal Cisneros in 1510 and which offers marvellous views over the beautiful Patio Trilingüe courtyard of the University of Alcalá de Henares. The hotel is next to monumental treasures such as the Capilla de San Ildefonso, the Palacio Arzobispal and the baroque convent of Las Bernardas. Nightlife opportunities and links to public transport can be found in the immediate vicinity. The bus and train stations are about 15 and 20 minutes' walking distance away, respectively. The La Dehesa shopping centre is about a 15-minute drive away, and Barajas Airport is approximately 25 km away.

This newly opened city hotel was built in 2008. It is housed in a magnificent seventeenth-century building, the former Santo Tomás Dominican Convent and School. All in all, it offers a great combination of tradition and avant-garde, making it perfect for either relaxing stays or successful business meetings. It has 128 rooms in total spread across 3 floors. Amenities and services include air conditioning, a lobby, 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom, lift access, a garden and a terrace. A restaurant, café, bar, TV lounge and Internet access are provided. There are also twelve rooms suitable for holding conferences, meetings and other events. Some of these even have a separate reception area. Room and laundry services are available for a fee. A car park and garage also feature, providing parking for up to 124 vehicles.

103491.description: The non-smoking hotel is excellently located at only 3 metro stops from Plaça Catalunya and within only a short walk to Sagrada Familia, Vila Olímpica and the beaches. The airport of Barcelona is only 24 km away. Features of the hotel include 95 rooms, 24-hours reception, restaurant on weekly days, meeting rooms, free WIFI throughout, self-service laundry service, gym, ticket service, car rental and underground parking. The property is accessible for handicapped.

103613.description:
This charming hotel boasts a stunning setting on the Mediterranean Coast. The hotel enjoys a magnificent mountain backdrop, revelling in the splendour of its position in Beldibi. The hotel is located just 11 km away from the larger resort of Kemer. This attractive hotel extends a warm, friendly welcome to guests upon arrival. The guest rooms are attractively designed, featuring modern amenities for added convenience. Guests can dine indoors our outdoors, and savour the splendid dishes that the restaurant has to offer. Guests can sit back and unwind on the sun terrace, or relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar.
Featuring a private beach area, Rama Beach Hotel offers rooms in Beldibi, 5 km from Beldibi Beach Park. Each accommodation at the 3-star hotel has sea views, and guests can enjoy access to an outdoor swimming pool and to a sauna. The hotel features an indoor pool, fitness centre, evening entertainment and a 24-hour front desk.

All units in the hotel are equipped with a TV with satellite channels. All rooms at Rama Beach Hotel include air conditioning and a wardrobe.

Guests at the accommodation can enjoy a continental breakfast.

At Rama Beach Hotel guests are welcome to take advantage of a Turkish bath. You can play table tennis and billiards at the hotel, and bike hire is available.

The nearest airport is Antalya Airport, 33 km from the property.

103640.description: Located in one of the best residential zones in Madrid, the hotel has direct access to the M-30. The nearest public transport and shopping facilities are only about 100 metres away and the metro and train stations are about 7 kms away, in the city centre of Madrid. The hotel is close to exhibition locations and Madrid-Barajas International Airport, which is only about 7 kms away. Built in 2007, this air-conditioned city hotel is a newly constructed and modern building with a parking service, car park, garage, restaurant and bar and VIP area, among other services. It has a total of 195 accommodation units. All of the en suite rooms have individually regulated air conditioning and heating. Guests are welcome to the hotel's gym. There is a golf course located about 5 kms from away.

103693.description: This modern hotel is situated in the centre of Badalona, close to the C31 highway and near the commercial district known as the Calle del Mar. Restaurants, bars, nightspots and links to the public transport network are easily reachable within a 15-minute walk and the beach, with its picturesque promenade, is only 2km away. Frequent suburban rail services connect the town with central Barcelona and the other beach resorts along the picturesque Costa Maresme. The 15th floor hotel offers the ideal conditions for both business and leisure travellers. The 7 well-lit meeting rooms have a maximum capacity of 350 persons and are equipped with modern audiovisual and video-conferencing equipment, plus the high-speed internet connection needed in order to make everything run smoothly. For the post-even banquet guests will have two spacious terraces at their disposal and an excellent restaurant.

103695.description: Situated first line to the sea in the popular holiday region of Konakli on the Turkish Riviera, this hotel offers a 200 m long sandy beach and an attractive spa area. The city of Alanya with its shops, restaurants, bars and attractions such as the Red Tower or the yachting harbour is about 13 km away, the international airport of Antalya is at a distance of about 115 km.

103696.description: The hotel is located in Konakli on the shore of a sandy beach with boundless crystal water. It is 13 km from Alanya and 113 km from Antalya Airport.  This beach hotel was renovated in 2008, offering good hospitality and a quality service to satisfy guests' needs. This air-conditioned establishment welcomes guests into a lobby with 24-hour check-out service. Facilities on offer include a hotel safe, a currency exchange and a hairdressing salon. Further amenities include shopping facilities, a TV lounge and conference facilities. The hotel has its own restaurant and bar. There is also a children's playground on site. All accommodation units are well-equipped as standard including a minibar, a satellite TV and a balcony.

103754.description: Indulge in a rejuvenating experience at the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. This Hoboken hotel also provides concierge services, on-site shopping, and wedding services. Savor American cuisine at Halifax, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or enjoy convenient room service (during limited hours). Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Business amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event? The hotel offers 2, 346 square feet (218 square meters) of event space, including conference space and eight meeting rooms. Retreat to one of the 220 air-conditioned guest rooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Your pillowtop bed is dressed in premium bedding. 50-inch LCD televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while wireless internet access is available (surcharge).

103773.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including an indoor pool, a spa tub, and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Grab a bite at Fire and Oak, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Jersey City? This hotel has 20227 square feet (1879 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 11 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 429 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

103814.description: The 3-star Adagio Access Paris Quai d'Ivry holiday residence is located close to the Seine and the François-Mitterrand Library. Its 176 units, ranging from studios to 2-room apartments are fully furnished and have a fully equipped kitchen. The aparthotel offers parking and free WIFI. With the RER train station a short walk away, you can reach the center of Paris in 10 minutes. Discover Ivry-sur-Seine and visit the Moulin de la Tour windmill and the Manufacture des Oeillets cultural center.

103835.description: This centrally located London guesthouse is within walking distance of the city's famed landmarks and a short stroll from Victoria's rail, tube, and coach stations, including the Gatwick Express. Guests will find a lively pub and bar scene just 150 meters away. Built in 1850, this family-friendly guesthouse offers en-suite rooms with modern amenities ideal for both leisure and business travelers. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and a healthy continental breakfast each morning.

name.content: Andaz London Liverpool Street, By Hyatt

103836.description: Hyatt’s five star luxury boutique hotel, Andaz London Liverpool Street is a 21st century masterpiece, a stunning blend of traditional and contemporary features throughout.

103854.description:
The hotel is located 850 m from the beach and 2 km from the resort centre. It offers convenient access to all local amenities with public transport available within less than 3 minutes walk. Antalya Airport is some 65 km away.

Constructed in 1998 and last refurbished in 2009, the aparthotel has a main building which consists of 4 floors, while the annexe consists of 3 floors. There are 47 rooms in total and a garden on site. Hotel facilities include a TV lounge, a children's playground, a restaurant, WLAN Internet access and a car park. Free shuttle service to the beach is provided.

Each of the apartments/studios features a bathroom with shower, as well as air conditioning, a safety deposit box and a kitchenette suitable for making light meals. Further amenities include a telephone and balcony or terrace.

There is an outdoor swimming pool with a children's swimming area, as well as a furnished sun terrace and a pool bar serving snacks. Guests may hire sun loungers and parasols on the nearby sandy beach.

The hotel restaurant serves dinner à la carte

103855.description: This apartment hotel is situated in Istanbul, immersed in the rich culture and history of this mesmerising city. The hotel is located in one of the most popular and exclusive districts of the city, close to a wealth of attractions. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from the Blue Mosque, The Egyptian Market and Topkapi Palace. Ataturk Airport is located just 24 km away from this hotel. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. This hotel was designed to create a living space, providing the utmost in comfort and convenience. The guest rooms offer a homely environment, featuring a modern design and up-to-date conveniences. The hotel affords guests a range of exemplary facilities and services, ensuring a comfortable stay for every type of traveller.

103856.description: This family-friendly hotel enjoys a wonderful setting overlooking the Mediterranean, in Alanya. The hotel is situated close to a number of restaurants and shops. The resort centre is just a 15 minutes' walking distance away. Convenient links to the public transport network can be found nearby. This hotel is the perfect option for every type of traveller visiting the area. The hotel comprises elegantly-designed guest rooms, which offer comfort and convenience in a stylish setting. The hotel offers a homely ambience, in which to completely relax and unwind, complemented by exemplary service and excellent facilities.

103857.description: This is a new and charming hotel, which combines comfort and elegance. Decorated with neo-classic furniture it offers modern amenities to ensure a pleasant and memorable stay for both business and leisure travellers. The hotel comprises a total of 32 guest rooms and suites. The standard, deluxe and suite rooms come with a French balcony, an LCD TV with satellite channels and complimentary wireless Internet access. The rooms provide spacious and comfortable accommodation and the quiet neighbourhood ensures a peaceful night's sleep in the centre of this metropolis. Guests can work out in the well-equipped gym, or enjoy a Turkish hamam and a massage treatment.

103901.description: The Adagio Access Paris La Villette is located opposite the Cité des Sciences, close to the park and Grande Halle de la Villette, as well as the Zénith. The 3-star holiday residence offers 72 comfortable and fully-equipped apartments ranging from studios to 2-room apartments. The Aparthotel offers free WIFI and two meeting rooms. Buses and the metro are easily accessible from just outside the Aparthotel.

103933.description: Situated right between the city centre and Schoenbrunn Palace, just 2 kilometres from the centre of Vienna with its numerous sights like Stephansdom Cathedral and the Stadthalle, this charming city hotel dates back to 1892 and combines tradition, great attention detail and comfort to provide the ideal escape from the hustle and bustle of the city. The spacious rooms and suites are decorated in the typical Old-Viennese style, but the homely décor should not mislead the demanding travellers – they feature all contemporary amenities for a carefree stay, like high-speed Internet access and satellite TV. Guests can start the day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, and the 24-hour reception staff will provide assistance throughout the day and night with any service needed – from currency exchange to transportation and tour bookings.

103934.description: Sitting at just 2 km from the city centre of one of Europe's most beautiful cities, Vienna, this modern venue brings its guests within walking distance from its biggest monuments. From this family-friendly establishment they can easily reach the Gothic style town hall, where the famous Christmas market takes place, the magnificent Greek-styled Parliament and Schönbrunn Palace, the former imperial 1,441-room Rococo summer residence, which with its lush landscaped gardens offers the perfect background for a truly postcard-worthy picture. Those who want to experience the true pace of the city can use the hotel bike hiring service and explore it on two wheels. At the end of the day the clearly structured, friendly rooms of the venue will welcome its guests and provide them with everything needed for a good rest.

103938.description:
Set in the heart of Brussels, Marivaux Hotel offers guest rooms opposite the City2 Shopping Mall, a 12-minute walk from Brussels' Grand Place and 550 m from De Brouckère Metro Station. Marivaux includes a fitness centre, an à la carte restaurant, a 24-hour reception and free WiFi. 

All of the air-conditioned rooms have an on-suite modern bathroom with a shower and/or bath + tea and coffee facilities. 

The hotel is 200 m from Rogier Metro Station and is parallel to the Rue Neuve shopping street. Guests can make use of the car rental and tour desk services when planning excursions. 

Marivaux La Brasserie serves French and local Brasserie cuisine. 

This is our guests' favourite part of Brussels, according to independent reviews. 

Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 8. 8 for a two-person trip. 

This property is also rated for the best value in Brussels! Guests are getting more for their money when compared to other properties in this city. 

Private parking is available on-site at a fixed charge. Reservation is required. 
Public parking is possible at a location nearby (reservation is not needed) and charges are applicable.

103939.description: This hotel is ideally located in central Paris. This establishment provides the perfect base for sightseeing, shopping, dining and entertainment. The nearest bus and underground stops can be found just a short walking distance away. Charles de Gaulle Airport is just 25 km away. This city hotel greets visitors with style and charm. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, featuring modern amenities. The hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so guests' needs can be attended to at any time. Guests can enjoy a superb breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore the beauty of this captivating city.

103993.description: Touch down in to London at Sofitel London Heathrow, the only hotel with direct access to Heathrow Terminal 5 via a 5 minutes covered walk way. Conveniently situated, discover London many attractions only 21 minutes away by train. Our award-winning hotel features 605 luxurious bedrooms and suites with modern amenities and the largest ballroom in Heathrow, catering up to 1300 people. Indulge into diverse dining options including our 2 AA Rosette Restaurants where guests can experience rich global flavours.

104033.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services, wedding services, and complimentary use of a nearby fitness facility. Grab a bite at Cafe Standard, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in New York? This hotel has 1365 square feet (127 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 145 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and LED televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

name.content: The Luxury Collection Hotel Manhattan Midtown

104034.description: Following the recent renovation and reopening as the The Luxury Collection Hotel Manhattan Midtown, this all-suite luxury hotel in Manhattan's vibrant Midtown neighborhood offers guests an array of amenities. Each suite boasts a generous 500+ sq. ft. of space, featuring separate living and sleeping areas. Guests will find themselves steps away from iconic landmarks like Central Park, MoMA, and Rockefeller Center, as well as an array of dining and entertainment options. The hotel features the Dabble restaurant and bar, serving seasonal American cuisine and cocktails. Additional amenities include a spacious gym, 24-hour room service, a 24-hour business center, and flexible event spaces. Enjoy stunning city views from the soaring 54-story structure, complimentary Wi-Fi, and convenient digital check-in.

104174.description:
Hotel Norman Paris Champs Elysees is situated 2 minutes walk from the Champs-Elysées, on the quieter and more private side of Paris's chic 8th arrondissement. 
Just off the Champs Elysées: Norman, (www. hotelnorman. com) a tribute to the vibrant 1960s and graphic art, with 37 rooms and suites (some with balcony or terrace and Eiffel Tower view), bar, Thai- French fusion restaurant and well-being area. 

Inspired by the refined Paris of the 1960s, graphic arts and the work of Norman Ives, Norman is a new luxury boutique hotel of only 37 rooms and suites. Its sophisticated and warm atmosphere is an open invitation to travelers from all over the world and Parisians, to meet and share moments at the bar, the restaurant and the well-being area. 
 
Chef Apiradee Thirakomen, famously known as Thiou, moves to the right bank to join the Norman adventure. Her signature? A refined, Thai-inspired cuisine with contemporary dressings, in which a unique mix of flavours allies the ones of her native country to French products.

104195.description:
This charming guest house is located down a very quiet, Jacaranda tree-lined back road. It is only 5 minutes' drive from the centre of Stellenbosch, where guests will find restaurants, bars/pubs, nightspots and shops. Cape Town is 3.5 km away and Cape Town International Airport is some 30 km from the accommodation.

This family-friendly, 8-room guesthouse is the ideal base from which to discover the breathtaking surroundings of the Western Cape. The accommodation is fully air-conditioned and features a hotel safe and currency exchange facilities. There is a bar and a breakfast room on site and WLAN Internet access is also available. A laundry service, a bicycle hire service and car parking are all provided.

Guests can choose from 7 individual suites and a charming cottage, all with flowering gardens and a refreshing pool. Guests can reside in style here and enjoy a charming decor in warm earth tones, as well as treasured accessories. The cosy bathrooms come with a bathtub/shower and luxurious skin products, as well as a hairdryer. The air-conditioned suites are all non-smoking and equipped with satellite TV and WLAN Internet access. Some come with a fully-equipped kitchenette, a private patio near the swimming pool, a safety deposit box and a minibar. Tea and coffee making facilities, a microwave, an ironing set, double/king-size beds and individually regulated heating also feature.

The hotel includes a outdoor swimming pool with sun loungers poolside. Massages are available and guests can play golf and mini golf, go cycling or horse riding or enjoy a game of tennis. A number of water sports is also available, including waterskiing, motor boating, diving, surfing, wind surfing, sailing and catamaran sailing.

This is a bed and breakfast establishment.

104205.description: The Jardins d'Eiffel hotel, centrally located in Paris, is a short walk from Rue Cler and the American University of Paris. Les Invalides and Pont Alexandre III are also within easy reach. Guests can enjoy views from the terrace and garden, and complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout. The 81 guestrooms feature minibars, LED TVs, and satellite programming. Bathrooms are equipped with bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Additional amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a computer station, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) is 36 km away, and Paris Orly Airport (ORY) is 17 km from the hotel.

104235.description: LOI Flats Buenos Aires enjoys a prime location in the city center, near Plaza San Martin, Florida Street's pedestrian area, and convenient access to train and bus stations. A variety of bars, pubs, restaurants, and shops are within easy walking distance. Each apartment is designed for maximum comfort and fully equipped with individual air conditioning. Most apartments also feature a kitchenette or full kitchen and can accommodate one to five guests, making them ideal for both family vacations and extended business trips. LOI Flats offers flexible solutions for corporate and leisure travelers who appreciate apartment living enhanced by the support, security, and service of the LOI Suites hotel group.

104275.description: Located in Hyde Park, Days Inn Hyde Park is a perfect starting point from which to explore London. Both business travelers and tourists can enjoy the hotel's facilities and services. All the necessary facilities, including free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, express check-in/check-out, luggage storage, Wi-Fi in public areas, are at hand. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like whirlpool bathtub, air conditioning, heating, desk, iPod docking station. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Days Inn Hyde Park combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make your stay in London unforgettable.

104298.description:
XO Hotels City Centre is divided over ten monumental buildings, which date back to the 18th century. The hotel is located in the historical heart of Amsterdam right in front of the Beurs van Berlage. The hotel rooms have a private bathroom, a flatscreen television, free WiFi and a Nespresso machine. The famous Anne Frank house, the Van Gogh museum, the Rembrandthuis and the red light district are in walking distance of the hotel. 

The hotel can easily be reached from Schiphol airport by train in 15 minutes. From Amsterdam Central Station it is a 10 minute walk to the hotel.

104299.description:
XO Hotels Blue Square is centrally located near Plein '40-‘45, where there is a small market every Tuesday to Saturday. Visit the market and get on the tram to the centre of Amsterdam. You can reach the city centre in just 30 minutes. After a busy day exploring the busy city relax with a free cup of coffee in your spacious and comfortable room. Are you travelling with children? We have a kids corner where children can play (under your supervision). 

Schiphol Airport is a 15-minute drive from the hotel. XO Hotels Blue Square is the perfect base to discover Amsterdam and its surrounding area due to the accessibility both by car and public transport. The hotel has a parking garage where you can park your car for €15, 00 per 24 hours.

104320.description: This Tudor-style hotel is conveniently situated in the west of London, at less than 10 km from Heathrow International Airport. It features a restaurant, a bar and free parking. Osterley underground station is within a 10-minute walk, providing easy access to Central London. Osterley Park can be reached within a short stroll; Twickenham Rugby Stadium is less than 5 km away.

104337.description: This family-friendly hotel is located near many pubs, bars and restaurants where guests can sample English specialties and international food. The area, known as the Borough of Newnham, is well served by public transportation. The centre of London and its attractions are only 12 km away. This is an ideal location from where to discover the English Capital and all it has to offer.
