104397.description: Located in Getafe, Holiday Inn Express Madrid - Getafe, an IHG Hotel is connected to a shopping center, within a 5-minute walk of Industrial District Las Arenas and Nassica Shopping Center. This hotel is 8. 6 mi (13. 8 km) from Parque Warner Madrid and 11. 8 mi (19 km) from Prado Museum. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and tour/ticket assistance. Stay in one of 98 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and complimentary newspapers. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Holiday Inn Express Madrid - Getafe, an IHG Hotel. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Featured amenities include wired internet access (surcharge), a 24-hour business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Getafe? This hotel has 398 square feet (37 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Free self parking is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Industrial District Las Arenas - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Nassica Shopping Center - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Parla Business District - 7. 9 km / 4.

104413.address: Gullu Pinari Mah Sahire Tuzun Cad Anilgan Sok
104413.description: A total of 30 accomodation units are available for guests' convenience. Those who stay at this establishment can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the hotel. This hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience.

104647.description:
This hotel is located next to the Dahme Lake area, which inhabitants of the inner city traditionally use for their recreational needs. The beautiful landscape contains over 70 interconnecting lakes, rivers, brooks and canals. Water enthusiasts, cyclists, campers, nature lovers and culture vultures are drawn to this region, not only for its scenic beauty but also for its close proximity to Berlin proper. Here, guests can find typical Brandenburg life with its expansive forests and lake views, Prussian cobblestone streets and quiet villages. Guests will find restaurants and shops just 50 m from the hotel, while the nearest pubs and links to the public transport network are around 250 m away. It is 500 m to the Berlin Forest, and Eichwalde beach is 1.5 km away. Berlin's attractions are nearby, such as the Museum Island (28 km away), as well as the Brandenburg Gate and the Reichstag (both 30 km away). Potsdam's Sanssouci palace is some 55 km away. It is 10 km to Berlin's Schoenefeld Airport, and Tegel Airport is 39 km from the hotel.

Renovated, this family-friendly city hotel offers a garden and comprises a total of 11 accommodation units including single rooms, double rooms and appartements. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area, a hotel safe and a cloakroom. Guests may also take advantage of the WLAN Internet access (free), the laundry service and the bicycle hire service (charges apply). Parking is available for those arriving by car.

All rooms are non-smoking and feature modern design, including paintings by artists from the region. They each come with a private bathroom with a shower, a WC and a hairdryer, as well as a telephone, an LCD TV with satellite channels, a radio and a minibar/fridge (charges apply). Each one is also equipped with a desk with appropriate lighting, free wifi Internet access, a double bed and central heating.

Guests may select their breakfast from a buffet.

104655.description: Situated in the heart of Marrakech, on Semlalia Square, this hotel enjoys an endearing and culture-rich location. Joutobia Mosque is some 5 minutes away by car, and the famous Jemaa el Fna is a mere 8 minutes from the hotel. The nearest public transport links are just 400 metres from the hotel. It is just 17 km to Essaouira, and a 15 minutes' drive to the airport. This superb hotel fuses modernity with culture in a manner like no other. The hotel enjoys a magnificent view of Marrakech, and the breath-taking Atlas mountains and Koutoubia Mosque can also be viewed. The guest rooms are spacious and provide a private haven for relaxation or work. Guests are sure to feel well rested and rejuvenated after a stay here. Guests can enjoy mini-golf or spa treatments during their stay also. For a breath-taking setting, eloquence and comfort, this hotel will not fail to impress.

104753.address: Topcu Cad No : 25 Taksim Oteller Bolgesi/ Taksim, 25
104753.description: This hotel offers excellent connections with the entire city via the metro system and is only a 5- minute walk from the conference centres of Istanbul. This contemporary and trendy hotel with a minimalist interior and architectural style provides an excellent accommodation. Comprising a total of 34 guest rooms, the air-conditioned establishment offers a lobby with 24-hour reception, a cafe and a restaurant. Business guests are sure to appreciate the conference facilities and WLAN Internet access. A car park is available for those arriving by car. All rooms have an en suite bathroom and are equipped with satellite TV and Internet access. In addition, tea and coffee making facilities, as well as air conditioning and central heating, come as standard.

104795.description: This superb establishment features impressive neo-baroque architecture and it is located in the prestigious neighbourhood of Recoleta, very close to the shopping area of Santa Fe Avenue, close to business and tourist districts of the city. It comprises a total of 77 illuminated rooms and suites, which are spread across 6 storeys. The hotel is fully air-conditioned and features some excellent conference and banquet rooms that are perfectly designed for hosting all business and social events. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception, check-out service and a cloakroom. This hotel also has lift access and wheelchair-accessible rooms, ideal for disabled guests.

104798.description: This hotel is set in the vibrant city of Rio de Janeiro. The hotel lies just a short distance away from a number of attractions in the city. Copacabana Beach and Ipanema Beach can be found nearby. The international airport is just 24 km away from the hotel. The guest rooms are classically styled, offering peace and serenity, complemented by elegance and charm. The hotel features a rooftop pool and sun terrace, where guests can enjoy a leisurely swim, or simply sit back and enjoy the spectacular views over the city. The hotel offers a wonderful breakfast in the mornings, for a superb start to the day.

104934.description: This city hotel, nestled in a quiet neighborhood very close to the CIM Vallès Industrial Park, is located in the centre of the business and industrial area of Vallès Oriental. The centre of Barcelona is easily reached by car, where guests will find numerous sites of cultural and touristic interest. This is a perfect hotel for those business travelers who wish to enjoy a convenient location for their business affairs or for those guests who wish to enjoy a good connection with the main motorways that link to other surrounding regions.

104946.description: This city hotel is situated at Lietzenburger Strasse 13-15, in the district of Schöneberg, the heart of Berlin's gay scene. Built in 2009, this hotel comprises guest rooms and a rooftop garden/sun terrace. The air-conditioned establishment welcomes its guests into a lobby with 24-hour reception service. On-site facilities include lift access, a café, and a restaurant with a patio. Business guests may use the conference facilities Internet access throughout the entire hotel. The rooms include comfortable beds, TV a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer.

name.content: Aha Harbour Bridge Hotel And Suites

105116.description: Featuring a prime situation in one of the premier tourist destinations in the world, this stylish urban hotel in Cape Town reflects modern luxury and premium services that will delight even the most discerning travellers. It is located on the Roggebaai Canal Waterfront, in Cape Town's CBD, close to the world-renowned V&A waterfront. The hotel provides a choice of perfectly appointed rooms and stunning suites to suit business and leisure travellers' needs alike. Ideal for families and for visitors wishing to maintain their daily diet routines, the onsite suites come with an additional sitting area and a fully-equipped kitchenette. The onsite facilities include a magnificent swimming pool and corporate visitors can take advantage of the boardroom and Wi-Fi internet connection. Guests will appreciate the onsite restaurant featuring picturesque views of the canal and offering a wide choice of mouth-watering dishes.

name.content: The Bantry Bay Aparthotel by Totalstay

105117.description: This charming and distinguished hotel enjoys a great position in the city of Bantry Bay in Cape Town and it is surrounded by an impressive array of entertainment and dining options. The popular V&A Waterfront shopping centre is a stone's throw and Queens and Saunders beaches can be found a minute's walk away. Moreover, the hotel is within easy reach from the most remarkable tourist attractions, including Table Mountain, Lion's Head, Camps Bay and Clifton Beaches. Guests can choose between several accommodation types but all of them are tastefully appointed and include unique features to ensure a memorable stay, such as panoramic views and light-filled spaces. Visitors will appreciate the excellent facilities, including a stylish cafeteria where they can relax while on holidays or on a business trip, as well as a sunny terrace where they can taste delicious cocktails.

105118.description: These beachfront apartments are situated directly on the dunes, just 20 meters from Milnerton Beach, offering panoramic views of Table Mountain and Robben Island. A short 10-minute drive takes you to the V&A Waterfront, and Cape Town's city center is a mere 20 minutes away. Canal Walk Shopping Centre is also conveniently close by. This aparthotel offers various accommodation units and welcomes families. Guests can enjoy on-site laundry services and parking. High-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. Each sea-facing apartment features an en suite bathroom with a separate bathtub and shower, a spacious lounge, a dining area, and a fully equipped kitchenette with a microwave and tea/coffee making facilities. Amenities include a hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, and internet access (available at an additional cost). Daily housekeeping is available upon request (24 hours in advance), as are ironing sets. All units come standard with a double or twin beds and a safe. The suites, ideal for families, boast large sun-filled terraces with stunning views and easy beach access. A refundable breakage deposit of R1000. 00 is required upon arrival and refunded upon departure. Décor varies among units; however, views, facilities, and services remain consistent. All units feature Smart TVs with access to Netflix, YouTube, DSTV, etc. , using your own subscription details. Please note that reception and lobby areas will be closed for renovations from November 1, 2024. Our team will meet guests for check-in between 3 pm and 5 pm daily.

105142.description:
Escape to the Presidential Quarter of Heliopolis, less than five KMs from Cairo International Airport, City Centre Almaza, and Baron Empain Palace. Cairo International Convention Centre is nine km away. Enjoy our two outdoor pools with pool rooms, kids pool, fitness centre, and 13 dining options from 7 different cuisines. Our concierge will help plan your days. just 10 minutes from Cairo's airport and 15 km from city center and the business district. 

Every guest room offers complimentary WiFi, an HDTV, opening windows, a work desk, mini-bar and options like connecting rooms and nightly turndown service. Upgrade for views overlooking the pool or hotel gardens, or choose a suite for a separate living area with sofa and a second bathroom. 

Hilton Cairo Heliopolis has an astonishing 10 restaurants and bars with cuisines from all over the world - Lebanese, Thai, Indian, French and Mediterranean are just a few. Try our light meals and cocktails. In-room dining is available 24 hours. 

Pamper yourself in our hotel's health and wellness spa. Book a massage in a private treatment room, or relax in our peaceful sauna. Exercise is easy with complimentary 24-hour fitness centre. Other hotel conveniences include two outdoor pools (one heated), clothing store, bank, children's playground, car rental desk and airport pickup service. 

From small meetings to grand receptions, we have the chic and high-tech function space that's perfect for every occasion. Host a conference in or plan a wedding reception in an elegant ballroom - our dedicated bridal suites add a special touch to the day.

105143.description: An excellent holiday resort surrounded by lush gardens and frontline to a sandy beach, this fantastic hotel has got everything to guarantee a perfect holiday. The hotel is 40 km away from Antalya Airport, 50 km from Antalya city centre and 4 km from Kadriye. Features include 600 rooms, 5 themed restaurants, 5 pools, fitness centre, spa, many sports possibilities, cinema, amphitheatre for shows and a commercial centre with a variety of shops. Accessible for handicapped.

105314.description: The Colon Hotel, a business hotel in the heart of Buenos Aires, stands opposite the iconic Obelisk and 9 de Julio Avenue. Its prime location offers easy access to key cultural attractions like the Kirchner Cultural Center, as well as financial and shopping districts. The hotel's 173 warmly decorated rooms provide comfort and quality. Guests can choose from Double Obelisco rooms with panoramic views, family-friendly Junior Suites, and spacious Suites with work areas. All rooms feature LCD TVs. The hotel also offers a breakfast room and eight meeting rooms suitable for a variety of events. Note: Different policies and additional supplements may apply for group bookings exceeding five rooms.

name.content: Hotel Inn Design Paris Saint Quentin

105397.description:
Located at 25 kilometers from Paris, near the Chateau de Versailles, the Best Western® Paris Saint-Quentin enjoys a quiet and green environment. The hotel is 400 meters from the National Velodrome of Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines and in the heart of the Pas du Lac Business Park with several corporations. 

The hotel offers 81 comfortable and modern rooms spread over 3 floors. All rooms have a flat-screen television, coffee and tea facilities, bottle of mineral water, air-conditioning, and private bathroom with toilet, hairdryer and shower products.

The onsite restaurant Live and Life Caffe welcomes you in a musical atmosphere where you will find traditional and gourmet cuisine.

On a sunny day, enjoy the shady terrace.

The Best Western Paris Saint-Quentin offers a free mini-gym, free Wi-Fi and free parking for a pleasant stay.

Four meeting rooms with natural daylight, all equipped for your event, meeting, training, conference, etc.

Only two kilometers from downtown and from the train station which goes direct to Paris, do not search anymore, The Best Western Paris Saint-Quentin is the perfect destination for business or leisure.

105653.description: This hotel is set at the heart of the lively city of Rio de Janeiro. The hotel is located close to Paseo Publico, the Municipal Theatre and the Museum of Modern Art. The excitement of Lapa, with its many bars, can be found just a short distance away. The cultural programme of the Progress Foundation and the Circus Voador can be found nearby. The hotel is just a 10 minutes' drive from the world-renowned Copacabana Beach. Santos Dumont Airport and Galeao Antonio Carlos Jobim International Airport are just a short driving distance away. This charming hotel tempts business and leisure travellers with the promise of luxury and convenience. The hotel features stunningly-designed guest rooms and suites. The hotel's first-class facilities and services ensure that the needs of even the most discerning traveller are fully met.

105673.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 184 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and LED televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding.

name.content: Premier Inn LON Heathrow Airport T2 & T3 (Bath Rd)

105693.description: Jetting off or flying in? Wherever you're heading, you'll find Premier Inn Hotel Heathrow Bath Road a handy launch pad. And with great transport links and the Heathrow Express Rail just minutes away, you'll be well placed for business and leisure destinations throughout London too. If you've time to stop and explore, plan a big adventure at Legoland. Cheer on your team at Twickenham Stadium. Or head for high-adrenalin thrills and spills at Thorpe Park. Then come back to earth at our tasty restaurant, and unwind in your spacious room and extra-comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

105774.description: The hotel offers easy access and is ideally located a few steps from the Parc des Expositions of Porte de Versailles and the Paris Palais des Sports. This business hotel, composed of 250 rooms and suites with contemporary design and modern amenities, offers a lounge bar and an exclusive covered car park. Guests may also enjoy the terrace. The 7-storey, air-conditioned hotel has a lobby with 24-hour reception. Room service is also available and for a fee, there is WLAN Internet access and a laundry service. The rooms are en suite with an Oceania exclusive bathroom including a shower/bathtub, which takes full advantage of space and light. The partition of obscure glass allows guests to enjoy the advantages of natural light while preserving their privacy. The rooms are also equipped with hairdryer, double bed, direct dial telephone, radio, hifi and individually regulated air conditioning.

105795.description: The hotel is situated at the foot of La Butte Montmartre, a few meters from the famous Moulin Rouge cabaret, and it offers an ideal location to experience one of Paris's liveliest districts. Charles de Gaulle airport is 15 km away and Orly airport is 25 km away. Rooms on the 6th and 7th floors are particularly popular, owing to their panoramic views of the rooftops of Paris and the Eiffel Tower. The hotel offers a lobby, a safe and lift access. Guests may use the TV lounge, the Internet access and the breakfast room. Laundry services are available for an additional fee. The rooms offer a balcony and are equipped with individually regulated air conditioning and heating and a TV. Further amenities include WiFi, phone and a minibar. The bathrooms are fitted with a hairdryer.

105814.description: Located in Cairo's Heliopolis district, just minutes from Cairo International Airport and the International Convention Centre, the Royal Marchel Hotel offers comfortable accommodations for both business and leisure travelers. Enjoy a variety of international and local cuisines at the hotel restaurant and unwind at the cozy bar. Business travelers can also utilize the hotel's conference facilities. Each well-appointed, air-conditioned room is tastefully decorated and equipped with amenities for a relaxing stay, including a private bathroom with a hairdryer and a television.

105833.description: The hotel is located in the heart of the Old Town on a quiet side street, a few steps from the historic Dam Square, Amsterdam's central square, where the Royal Palace and the New Church are located. The Art-Deco style of the building can still be admired in the lobby, creating a classical and elegant atmosphere. The hotel is completely non-smoking and facilities include a 24-hour reception, a bar, breakfast room and wireless Internet access. Guests arriving by car may leave their vehicle in the garage.  The rooms are modern and comfortable, and each one is equipped with an en suite bathroom with shower or bath and a satellite TV. The rooms have a fridge.  A breakfast buffet is served each morning.

105899.description: This hotel is located in an enviable area of Copacabana. The hotel is set overlooking the sea, lying just a 10 minutes' driving distance away from the bustling centre of Rio de Janeiro. The hotel is surrounded by ample opportunities for exploration and discovery. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from a host of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. The international airport is just a 20 minutes' driving distance away. This charming hotel offers luxury and style, in a wonderful setting. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, offering a high level of comfort. The hotel features a charming restaurant, where guests can enjoy sumptuous international and regional dishes.

105933.description: This family-friendly hotel is ideally located in Side. The hotel is located directly on the beach and the city centre. A treasure trove of attractions can be found nearby. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a number of shopping, dining and entertainment venues. Antalya Airport is just 64 km away from the hotel. This wonderful beach hotel is sure to impress. The guest rooms are superbly designed, offering comfort and style in a relaxed setting. Guests can enjoy delectable dining in the restaurants, followed by a refreshing drink in the bar. The little ones will be pleased by the many facilities and services that the hotel provides.

105935.description: This luxurious resort is located in the popular Side region on the Turkish Riviera, just 200 meters from a sandy beach. Side's center, with ancient sites like the Temple of Apollo and a harbor lined with restaurants and bars, is easily accessible. The hotel features 287 rooms, a 24-hour reception, express check-in/check-out, free Wi-Fi in public areas, a restaurant, a bar, a fitness center, a spa, medical assistance, indoor and outdoor pools (including a children's pool), a playground, shops, and car hire. Please note: Some services have adjusted hours or availability. From March 1st to March 31st, 2021, à la carte restaurants are open (one free visit with a minimum 7-day stay), and the indoor pool, fitness center, sauna, and spa are open by reservation from 8:30 am to 7:00 pm. The beach bar is open from 10:00 am to 4:00 pm. The pool bar is closed and there is no animation program during this period.

105944.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as bicycle rentals, a terrace, and a garden at this Amsterdam hotel. It also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby. The Shiraz Food & Wine Bar offers international cuisine with garden views, and room service is available during limited hours. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event? The hotel has 2, 153 square feet (200 square meters) of space, including conference space and four meeting rooms. Limited parking is available onsite. The 40 individually decorated guest rooms feature free minibar items and Smart TVs. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. 23-inch flat-screen televisions with satellite programming are provided. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include the Concertgebouw (0. 5 km), Museum Square (0. 6 km), Stedelijk Museum (0. 7 km), Albert Cuyp Market (0. 8 km), Van Gogh Museum (0. 8 km), and more. The preferred airport is Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS), 15. 8 km away.

105956.description: This charming, urban hotel is ideally located in the heart of Barcelona, right in the Gothic quarter, in front of Plaça de Catalunya and close to the Ramblas. The property is well-connected with a wide range of public transport links and the most beautiful sightseeing attractions of this cosmopolitan city can be easily reached, such as La Boqueria market, the Liceu Opera House and the Eixample modernist district. All guest rooms boast a contemporary and functional decoration to ensure a pleasant stay for those on holidays with the whole family or with friends. Apart from state-of-the-art equipment, they include complimentary wireless Internet connection throughout for added convenience. Every morning travellers can wake up to a delicious breakfast served at the hotel.

105982.description: This apartment hotel is conveniently located just a 55 minutes' driving distance away from Antalya Airport. The hotel lies just 650 metres away from the gently-shelving sands of Side Beach. The hotel is situated just 3 km from Side Village. The larger town of Manavgat is situated 6 km from the hotel. Links to the public transport network can be found close by. The hotel comprises tastefully-designed apartments, which are well equipped with modern amenities. The air conditioning fee is extra and it is 5 € per day. The apartments offer a peaceful home away from home, in which to completely unwind. The complex offers an extensive range of facilities and services, ensuring the utmost in comfort for travellers.

name.content: TOP Retaj Al Rayyan Hotel Doha

106033.description: Situated in Doha's Al Dafna business district, the elegant Retaj Al Rayyan hotel enjoys marvellous views over the Arabian Gulf and the West Bay district. Contrasting the hotel's modern interior design, the Al Maiz restaurant is decorated in traditional Qatari style reflecting local heritage. Guests will appreciate the excellent services and facilities such as a lovely sea view terrace with outdoor pool. Doha Convention Center Tower, the Corniche or Qatar SC Stadium are within walking distance. An ideal place both for business guests and holidaymakers who wish to experience this dynamic city.

106034.description: Overlooking the Royal Mews at Buckingham Palace, this hotel is situated adjacent to the Queens Gallery. Buckingham Palace, the Royal Parks, Pall Mall and theatres are located close by. This property is hailed as London's smallest, most intimate boutique hotel, yet is uncompromising on comfort, luxury and relaxation. The guest rooms are stunningly designed, immersing visitors in elegance and style. Guests can enjoy a traditional afternoon tea, or dine in style in the award-winning restaurant. The club lounge offers the ideal place in which to completely relax and unwind. This property combines 21st-century technology with attentive service.

106035.description: Located in literary Bloomsbury, just steps from the British Museum, we are famous for al fresco dining and wonderfully fun pop-ups. Our chic Leopard Bar offers live jazz, whilst the conservatory is the perfect place to enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea overlooking peaceful gardens. Each and every one of our guest rooms and suites is elegantly and individually designed, from garden facing rooms and suites, to family studios and multi-bedroom apartments which feature a private entrance and patio. All of our guest rooms are designed with our guests' comfort in mind and include luxury Floris amenities, marble bathrooms and Savoir beds. We are proud to be a part of the family-owned and run Red Carnation Hotel Collection and of our hotel's exceptional heritage. We strive to create the most enriching and rewarding experiences for our guests – which is why they choose to stay with us again and again. The Montague on the Gardens combines the best of two worlds. In front is the British Museum, whilst to the rear there's a serene private garden, cut off from the city by a rectangle of fine Georgian townhouses. Between the two lies The Montague on the Gardens – an intriguing blend of up-to-the-minute city vibrancy and old-world Bloomsbury charm, where guests can expect British hospitality at its finest.

106036.description: Our beautifully restored historic hotel is cared for by a team who take genuine pride in delivering impeccable service and exceeding expectations at every turn. Overlooking The Royal Mews of Buckingham Palace - the entrance used by the Royal family - The Rubens showcases exceptional dining journeys, and enriching and rewarding experiences, from the very first moment guests are greeted by our red-uniformed doormen.

106037.description: Step into our polished marble lobby and you will immediately notice the warm and personalised service that defines The Chesterfield. Our staff members are empowered to make a real difference to each and every guest's stay, whether that's remembering a favourite welcome drink or organising a romantic surprise for a special birthday. We go above and beyond to ensure every stay is exceptional. Red Carnation's first hotel, located in the heart of Mayfair, is quintessentially British and exudes classic charm and unique personality. Renowned for the best Dover sole in London, themed Afternoon Teas, molecular cocktails and gin tasting experiences, we are ideally located, moments from Bond Street, Piccadilly and the Royal Parks. We are honoured that our guests choose to stay with us again and again. Every one of our team offers remarkably considerate service and discrete attention to detail. From freshly-cut flowers in the suites to personalised gifts for special occasions, it is no surprise that guests often remember the names of our staff and ask after them when they return. Exhale and relax after a busy day of exploring London in the warm, intimate surrounds of Butlers Restaurant. Renowned for serving London's best Dover sole, filleted right at your table, our Executive Chef Nathan Hindmarsh offers an enticing range of delicious dishes that make the most of organic, seasonal British ingredients – from salmon smoked by H. Forman & Son, London's oldest smokery, and classics such as roasted Orkney scallops and venison Wellington, to our famous signature dishes. With the smart shops of Bond Street nearby and some of London's most vibrant sights – The Royal Academy, Buckingham Palace, the Royal Parks – just a short stroll away, this truly is the beating heart of Mayfair. Yet our elegant Charles Street address offers a tranquil haven from the bustle outside, a place to retreat, relax and regroup.

106040.description: Complete with modern conference facilities and a comfortable and cosy lounge, you're guaranteed a stylish welcome at our pet-friendly hotel. Plus we're proud to offer a gorgeous outdoor terrace, where guests can sip a glass of something cool and fizzy while watching planes take off and land at Luton's runway. What better way to kick off or wrap up your trip?

106058.description: With a stay at Exe Ramblas Boqueria in Barcelona (Downtown Barcelona), you'll be steps from La Rambla and 9 minutes by foot from Plaça de Catalunya. This hotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from Barcelona Cathedral and 1. 7 mi (2. 7 km) from Barceloneta Beach. Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Make yourself at home in one of the 30 guestrooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms have deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Take advantage of the hotel's room service. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 8 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. La Rambla - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi- Boqueria Market - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Gran Teatre del Liceu - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Plaça Reial - 0. 4 km/0. 2 mi- Portal de l'Angel - 0. 4 km/0. 2 mi- Palau Güell - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Barcelona Cathedral - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- El Corte Ingles - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Rambla del Raval - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Plaça de Catalunya - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Barcelona Wax Museum - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Maritime Museum - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Pompeu Fabra University - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Palau de la Música Catalana - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi. The preferred airport for Exe Ramblas Boqueria is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 15. 1 km/9. 4 mi.

106107.description: Enjoy a refreshing dip in the seasonal outdoor pool or explore the area on rented bicycles at the Amarilia Hotel in Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services, and a restaurant, Artemis, with garden views. Room service is also available. Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar after a busy day. For business travelers, a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and check-out are provided. The hotel also features 1668 square feet (155 square meters) of event space, including conference space and six meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available onsite. The 100 air-conditioned rooms offer flat-screen TVs with digital programming, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Conveniently located near Kavouri Beach (0. 5 mi), Astir Beach (1. 4 mi) and Vouliagmeni Spa Lake (1. 8 mi). Athens International Airport (ATH) is 13 miles from the hotel.

106203.description: Our hotel is located in central Hounslow, five miles from Heathrow and ten miles from central London, with easy access to the motorway network. We are also just a two-minute walk from Hounslow Central Tube Station. All guest rooms and the lobby area offer free high-speed internet access. Our in-house restaurant is open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner seven days a week, and the hotel bar is open late. Limited parking is available for a nominal fee.

106234.description: This city hotel is strategically located in Al Barsha, less than two minutes from the Mall of the Emirates and close to many of Dubai's top attractions, including Media City, Dubai Free Zone, beaches, and the Convention Center. Public transport is approximately 500 meters away, and Dubai International Airport is a 30-minute drive or easily accessible by public transport or taxi. All rooms feature Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs with cable channels, a safety deposit box, mini-fridge, and a coffee maker. Suites include living rooms and dining areas. Guests can enjoy 24-hour room service, an outdoor pool, a fitness center, and a sauna. Valet and self-parking are available, as well as a 24-hour airport shuttle. A 24-hour front desk provides concierge services, luggage storage, and assistance with securing personal belongings. A buffet breakfast is available for a fee, and other amenities include free Wi-Fi in public areas, a business center, and complimentary newspapers.

name.content: The Jangle Hotel Paris Charles de Gaulle airport

106254.description: The Jangle Hotel Paris CDG Airport is certainly the best value for money in the region. With 240 completely renovated rooms and suites, The Jangle Hotel Paris CDG offers an accommodation package with breakfast, parking, airport shuttle as well as access to the largest water park in the region located 2 minutes from the hotel. The Plaine Oxygène Aquatic Park, a 11, 000 m² complex, offers 6 swimming pools, a fitness and wellness area as well as a giant ice rink. The Jangle Hotel Paris CDG Airport also has 940 M² of meeting space with 12 rooms from 40 to 400 M², a fun garden with a giant chess game, a pétanque court, ping-pong, volleyball court and football. 2 restaurants and 1 bar complete the offer at the Jangle Hotel Paris CDG. Protected from the hustle and bustle of the airport, the Jangle Hotel Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport represents a sweet alliance between the calm of a large green space and the practicality of Roissy CDG. Located in the greenest setting of the airport, while being 10 minutes from the terminals – RER/TGV station, 20 minutes from the Paris Nord Villepinte exhibition center and 40 minutes from the center of Paris, the hotel remains by far the best value for money for one night or more, alone, as a couple, with your family or for your events.

106287.description: Overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, the modern, family-friendly Annabella Diamond Hotel & Spa is perfectly situated in Avsallar, a popular tourist destination on the Turkish Riviera. Avsallar's center is within walking distance, while the city of Alanya, with its shopping, entertainment, and historical sites such as the Castle and Red Tower, is 26 km away. Antalya International Airport is 98 km from the hotel. The hotel offers elegant rooms, some with splendid sea views. A private sandy beach with complimentary sun loungers and parasols awaits, along with a pool featuring three water slides, a children's pool, and a mini club. Guests can enjoy a well-equipped fitness center and a spa with a Turkish bath and sauna. An excellent choice for couples and families seeking a delightful beach holiday. The Annabella Diamond's main building is located directly on the beach. The Annabella Park building is across the road, approximately 350 meters from the beach and main building, accessible via an underground passage. Importantly, both buildings have their own reception and restaurant. Guests staying at Annabella Park can use all facilities in the main building, such as the snack and lobby bars, except for the main restaurant. . The hotel is provide the All Ultra Inclusive services (AUI)

106316.description: The hotel is located in the downtown area of the city and has easy access to tourist destinations. The corporate Mumbai Bombay Stock Exchange, Colaba, Nariman Point, Worli and Lower Parel are just 15 minutes away. The railway station is around 5 km from the hotel and the bus station around 2 km. It is 23 km away from the Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport. This city hotel offers excellent service for holiday travellers, and features meeting and conference facilities for business travellers to make their workshops and conferences more comfortable and convenient. The air-conditioned hotel has a lobby with safe, currency exchange facilities, lift access, café, bar and restaurant. Room service, laundry service and a car park are also available. The 96 tastefully furnished rooms are designed to anticipate the needs of business travellers. The interior is designed with colours and textures to soothe tired eyes. They are equipped with hairdryer, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, fridge, tea and coffee making facilities, a balcony or terrace and safe. The hotel's restaurant has well-laid-out, generous buffets with a choice of Indian, continental and Chinese fare for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Guests can enjoy a quick and full meal without fuss or delay.

106318.address: 75, Off Nehru Road - Next To Domestic Airport
106318.description: The hotel is centrally located at Vileparle, very close to the domestic airport which is 1 km away and the international airport which is 3 km away. The unique location of this hotel makes it an ideal choice for the traveller, offering the best of both worlds - business as well as pleasure, with the utmost in comfort and unsurpassed hospitality. It is luxuriously appointed with amenities that ensure a comfortable and productive stay. This air-conditioned establishment welcomes its guests in a lobby with a hotel safe and currency exchange facilities. There is a restaurant and a bar on-site and conference facilities are on-hand for business travellers. Guests can take advantage of the hotel's room and laundry services. Those arriving by car may park their vehicles in the hotel's car park. The hotel is a modern property, offering guests comfort and unsurpassed hospitality. The luxuriously appointed rooms come with amenities that ensure a comfortable stay. These include an en suite bathroom with a shower and a bath, a TV with satellite/cable TV channels, a telephone, air conditioning and a refrigerator. There is a multi-cuisine restaurant at the hotel as well as a bar.

106319.address: Near Domestic Airport, Nehru Rd, Vile Parle East
106319.description: Nestled within Mumbai Domestic Airport, this hotel is the perfect hub for the weary traveller. Sahar International Airport is only 3km away and the complimentary airport shuttle service allows guests to relax and enjoy the short trip. All rooms come with modern Indian décor and feature everything required for a pleasant and relaxed stay. Business guests who need a place where to conduct their meetings can utilize the spacious onsite facilities. While those who are looking for a little more casual surrounding or just crave a tasty meal can head to the restaurant located on the premises. There they can find a fine selection of local and international dishes that will satisfy any appetite and taste. Light snacks and refreshing beverages are offered in the pleasant ambience of the coffee shop.

106321.description: Situated between Navi Mumbai and Mumbai, this classic hotel offers convenient access to the city's expanding commercial center and both domestic and international airports. The 39 newly furnished rooms and 24-hour service cater to both business and leisure travelers. Air-conditioned throughout, the hotel provides a lobby, restaurant, conference facilities, laundry service, and parking. Each aesthetically designed room features an en suite bathroom with a shower and bathtub, hot and cold running water, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, a direct-dial telephone, a safe, a minibar, and tea and coffee making facilities. Guests can enjoy diverse cuisine at the hotel's multi-cuisine restaurant, bar, and coffee shop.

106323.description: Situated near Mumbai's vibrant Juhu Beach, this hotel offers convenient access to business and entertainment centers, including the Hare Rama Hare Krishna Mandir Temple. Just 4 km from the domestic and 6 km from the international airport, it provides easy travel connections. Guests are welcomed into an elegant lobby and offered quality service throughout their stay. Amenities include air conditioning, a hotel safe, currency exchange, a restaurant, 24-hour room service, and laundry services. The comfortable rooms boast tasteful decor and convenient features like a minibar, safe, Wi-Fi, and individual climate control. In-room entertainment includes a TV with in-house movies and international channels, as well as a direct-dial telephone and tea/coffee making facilities. Dining options include two restaurants specializing in Southeast Asian and Italian cuisine, another serving authentic North Indian dishes, a dedicated dessert parlor, and a coffee shop.

106324.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Bandra, considered one of Mumbai's buzzing neighbourhoods, filled with multi-cuisine restaurants, malls, art galleries and luxury boutiques. It is only 3 km from the Bandra bandstand where one can enjoy the breathtaking views of the Arabian Sea and the beautifully landscaped promenade is just perfect for quiet and romantic walks. The hotel is within 15 minutes of Mumbai domestic airport, around 25 minutes from the international airport and just 2 minutes from the railway station. This contemporary business-class hotel, where business and relaxation blend in perfect harmony, started its operations in February 2008. All the 44 guest rooms are exquisitely decorated and outfitted with the finest amenities. Facilities include 2 conference rooms, a fine dining restaurant and bar, and an open-air roof-top banquet venue. High-speed wireless Internet access is available throughout the hotel, which is decorated in the finest fabrics and linens. The air-conditioned hotel also offers a lobby, 24-hour room service, transportation services for guests' travel needs and a laundry service. The spacious and well-appointed rooms focus on comfort and leisure. Every room is comfortably furnished with state-of-the-art fittings which define its own style. Each room features an en suite bathroom with a shower, bathtub and hairdryer as well as a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, Internet access, a safe, minibar and ironing set. Popular with hotel guests, as well as businesses and food lovers, the contemporary restaurant and bar is ideal for lunch, dinner, cocktails and special occasions. It serves creative fresh seafood, a variety of international and Indian delicacies, vegetarian specialities, fantastic desserts, and much more. Guests can quench their thirst at the well stocked Ozone Bar serving innovative and perfectly mixed cocktails and international drinks.

106325.address: Midc Central Road, Andheri East, B 11
106325.description: The hotel is located on the MIDC central road in Andheri, in close proximity to the international and domestic airports as well as the western express motorway. A busy travellers' destination, this air-conditioned hotel combines business with luxury and has been satisfying guests with its excellent service since the day it opened its doors. The lavish hotel rooms offer all modern day amenities, hotel facilities include a lobby, restaurant, and room and laundry services. The hotel's excellent facilities and service are sure to leave the busy traveller overwhelmed with joy. Cosy is the word that comes to mind the moment one enters one of the hotel's guest rooms. Each room features a host of fine amenities to ensure each and every guest feels truly pampered. An en suite bathroom with a shower and bathtub, as well as satellite TV and Internet access feature in all rooms as standard. Being a business hotel, there are no entertainment facilities at this hotel. With an exotic array of cuisines to choose from, this is the ideal destination to set off on gourmet adventures. Be it Goan, Mangalorean, Konkani or continental, all dining options will leave guests with an aftertaste of pure satisfaction. Guests can let the high seas seduce the taste buds with a sinful selection of exotic seafood prepared in an authentic style. There is also a vegetarian restaurant that serves delightful cuisine.

106326.description: Located in New Marine Lines, this air-conditioned hotel offers stylish rooms and excellent value in the heart of Mumbai's shopping and entertainment district, just 23 km from the airport. Whether traveling for business or leisure, guests appreciate the spacious, tastefully designed rooms ideal for families. A range of services and amenities ensures a memorable stay. The on-site restaurant features a diverse menu of Continental, Tandoori, and Mughlai cuisine, with a dedicated vegetarian kitchen.

106327.address: Plot No. 3, Kohinoor Rd. Opp Swami Narayan Temple
106327.description: Centrally situated in Dadar in the South of Mumbai, India's main business and finance centre, the Ramee Guestline-Dadar is an elegant boutique hotel just next to the Dadar Railway Station. Guests enjoy the hotel's services and facilities, such as 24-hour room service, a restaurant with authentic Indian cuisine, a 24-hour tea lounge or a rooftop terrace with outdoor pool and hot tub. The main business area is within easy reach. This hotel is an ideal place for those business guests who prefer a more private and personal atmosphere over huge business hotels.

106328.description: 'This hotel is centrally located in Khar, placing Mumbai's trade and commercial center within easy reach. Guests are just a 30-minute drive from Juhu Chowpatty Beach. This business hotel offers convenient access to both airports, just 15 minutes from the international terminal and 7 minutes from the domestic. Renowned for its exceptional hospitality and service, the hotel provides a café, bar, pub, and restaurant for dining and drinks, complemented by room service. The elegant property comprises beautifully appointed accommodations equipped with a fine array of modern conveniences for a comfortable and effortless stay. The friendly staff is always available to guide guests and provide information about Mumbai's many attractions. '

106329.description: Situated near the MIDC business complex, this premium business-class hotel offers convenient access to major motorways and Andheri Railway Station. For over three decades, it has provided distinguished service and earned numerous accolades. Guests enjoy amenities including air conditioning, an on-site restaurant, conference facilities, and room and laundry services. Cozy rooms feature a host of amenities such as en suite bathrooms with a shower and bath, satellite/cable TV, and internet access. While primarily a business hotel, guests can relax in the outdoor swimming pool, stay active in the gym, or indulge in a massage. The multi-cuisine restaurant offers a diverse menu with flavorful dishes, including vegetarian options. In the evening, the hotel bar comes alive, welcoming guests to unwind after a long day.

106331.address: Andheri Kurla Rd, Sakinaka Junction, Andheri East
106331.description: This business friendly hotel is perfectly located in Andheri, no more than 20 minutes from the major highways, around 10 minutes from the international airport and 20 minutes from the domestic airports. From the moment guests set foot in the establishment they will find themselves surrounded by calm and luxury, far removed from the frenetic pace of the city. Those who need a place from where to set their perfect home office while on the road can check the business centre, while guests looking for a place to host their next conference can check the banquet facilities. Excellent dining options are available at the two onsite restaurants, the first one specializes in Indian and Oriental dishes, while the second is perfect for those looking for a little more international cuisine. The coffee shop is a high energy, fun place, which serves an intriguing blend of beverages and small treats.

106332.address: Juhu Tara Road juhu Beach Santacruz '00west)
106332.description: This 5 star hotel is located on the coastline of Mumbai. It is a short drive away from the Juhu Beach. The Hotel has a coffee shop and an outdoor swimming pool. All 115 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, ironing set and air conditioning.

106333.description:
Located a short drive away from Mumbai’s business district, Kohinoor Continental offers free parking, a fitness centre, an outdoor pool and restaurants. Rooms feature carpeted, wooden or tiled flooring. 
Kohinoor’s rooms are also equipped with air conditioning, a private bathroom with hairdryer and a writing desk. A minibar and coffee/tea making facilities are provided.

106334.description: 'Situated at Juhu Beach, this luxurious city hotel is far from the buzz of the city. It is India's first beachfront hotel and was commissioned in 1962. It is ideally located 40 minutes away from the city centre and just 20 minutes from the Domestic and International airports. The major attractions around the hotel include the ISKON Temple and the Prithvi Theatre located just 5 minutes away. Guests can rejuvenate at “Ocean View”, the fully equipped health club which overlooks the Arabian Sea. The bright, airy rooms offer a relaxing haven where guests can unwind in intimate surroundings. The restaurants within the hotel offer delectable choices for even the most discerning of guests. For leisure times the guests can take advantage of the shopping arcade. The Kabab Hut serves authentic Awadhi cuisine and is very popular amongst hotel guests and local residents. '

106336.description: This 5 star hotel is located within the city of Mumbai. It is close to the Aksa Beach. The Hotel has a coffee shop, an indoor swimming pool, an outdoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 94 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning.

106337.description: This stylish city hotel is located 1 km from the domestic airport, 1. 5 km from Vile Parle Railway Station, and approximately 5 km from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport. Its 223 well-appointed rooms, including 13 luxurious suites, are complemented by nine specialty restaurants. This luxury hotel features a picturesque tropical lagoon beneath the world's largest pillarless clear-to-sky dome and three custom-designed glass elevators offering panoramic views. Each room boasts a spacious balcony with serene lagoon views. Guests can enjoy a well-equipped gym, an exclusive spa, an international-standard beauty salon, and various recreational activities.

name.content: Sheraton Grand Doha Resort & Convention Hotel

106394.address: Al Corniche St, P.O. Box 6000, s/n
106394.description: Relax and unwind with massages and facials. After dipping into one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional amenities at this resort include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. If you'd like to spend the day shopping, you can hop on the complimentary shuttle. For lunch or dinner, stop by Al Hubara, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Doha? This resort has 94937 square feet (8820 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 26 meeting rooms.

106395.description: Our guests enjoy a warm, friendly atmosphere thanks to our lively café/restaurant and 24-hour snack service. Complimentary fiber Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, and each of our 356 bedrooms features fresh, modern decor and plush Sweet Beds, earning us consistent five-star reviews. Enjoy a convenient location less than a mile from the runway at unbeatable room rates!

106396.description: This hotel enjoys a great location, with Paddington, Queensway, Baywater and Lancaster Gate stations all nearby, providing easy access to all areas of London. The hotel is within convenient reach of London's West End and easy access to tourist attractions, fine restaurants, exclusive designer boutiques and department stores. It is also a short walk away from Marble Arch and Oxford Circus, and Piccadilly Circus is a 10-minute underground ride away.

106397.description: Indulge in the hotel's sauna and 24-hour fitness center. Stay connected with complimentary wired internet access and benefit from concierge and wedding services. Enjoy delicious meals at the Manhattan Grill steakhouse with a bar/lounge, or order room service during limited hours. Buffet breakfasts are available for a fee on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:30 AM. The hotel also offers a 24-hour business center and express check-out. For events, there's 14, 445 square feet of space, including a conference center and 19 meeting rooms. Relax in one of the 301 guest rooms featuring minibars, 48-inch Smart TVs with satellite programming, and pillowtop beds with premium bedding. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, deep soaking bathtubs, and complimentary toiletries. Located near the Thames River, the hotel is also a short distance from attractions like the Cutty Sark, ExCeL Exhibition Centre, and O2 Arena.

106399.description: The hotel is located in a quiet square in the heart of Bayswater, close to Queensway, Hyde Park and Notting Hill, and providing easy access to all areas of London. Hyde Park can be reached in about a 5-minute walk, Oxford Circus is around 20 minutes' walk away, and Piccadilly Circus is some 25 minutes' walk from the hotel. The hotel's convenient location provides quick and easy access to and from London Heathrow, Gatwick and Stansted airports. The hotel has an accentuated style with regal overtones. It offers the best value for money with brand-new contemporary styling, graced with the comfort of mood lighting and Internet access. Other facilities at this air-conditioned city hotel include a lobby, 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe and a cloakroom. There is also a bar and breakfast room, and room service and a laundry service are offered. All rooms have been renovated recently, providing the greatest standards in comfort and relaxation. They have en suite bathroom facilities with a shower, bath and hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV with pay movies, free Internet access and a radio. Furthermore, the rooms include a fridge, a microwave, tea and coffee making facilities, ironing facilities, a double bed, carpeting and a hire safe. All the rooms are air-conditioned and come fitted with central heating as standard. A breakfast buffet is served daily.

106416.address: The Lake View, El Teseen Street, Fifth Settlement
106416.description: Situated in a lush, resort-style setting in New Cairo, the 5-star Dusit Thani features waterfalls, tree-lined streets, lakes, and a stream. This luxurious hotel offers three outdoor pools, eight restaurants and bars, and complimentary airport transfers. Each room includes a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a minibar with complimentary soft drinks, and a private bathroom with bathrobes, slippers, and free toiletries. Some rooms also offer a seating area. Guests can enjoy a wide selection of fitness, spa, and swimming facilities, including the Devarana Thai spa. The hotel also boasts 23 function rooms, a business center, three ballrooms, and diverse dining options ranging from Asian and Turkish cuisine to an international all-day dining restaurant. The Bake Bar offers all-day brunch, while the lobby lounge and terrace serve gourmet delicacies 24/7. Cairo International Airport and major attractions are easily accessible from the hotel. For the property's cleanliness policy, please visit the Dusit Thani page on Preferredhotels. com.

106430.address: Thalwila Wella, Thoduwawa, Marawila Sri Lanka
106430.description: The city business hotel is situated in the quiet north-western beach town of Marawila, approximately 35 km north of Katunayake International Airport (the journey takes around one hour). The air-conditioned hotel features a fully equipped conference and banquet hall with direct dial telephone facilities, and a daily laundry service. Further facilities available to guests at the business hotel include a lobby, lift access, a breakfast/dining room, room service and a car park. The rooms have an attached en suite bathroom with a shower and hot running water. Guests can also enjoy the sweeping view of the lagoon and garden from the room's private veranda. Other in-room amenities include a double bed, direct dial telephone, satellite TV, Internet access, an in-room safe, tea and coffee making facilities, as well as air conditioning and heating. The hotel is equipped with an on-site gym (fees apply), table tennis facilities (fees apply), squash courts, and an Ayurvedic health centre. Further sport and leisure options include archery, pool/snooker (fees apply), table football and other indoor games. Guests may also take a dip in the indoor swimming pool. The hotel features a breakfast buffet, while lunch and dinner are served from set menus.

106449.description: The Trident Nariman Point, a 35-story landmark in Mumbai's bustling business district, offers panoramic views of Marine Drive, affectionately known as the Queen's Necklace. Within walking distance of major corporations, entertainment, and shopping centers, the hotel also boasts convenient access to iconic attractions. The Gateway of India is a mere five-minute drive, while the World Trade Centre is just ten minutes away. Experience some of the city's finest accommodations at this luxurious hotel.

106456.address: P.O. Box 23400, West Bay Lagoon Doha
106456.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. After a day at the private beach, you can enjoy other recreational amenities including indoor tennis courts and a 24-hour health club. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. The complimentary beach shuttle makes getting to the surf and sand a breeze. Grab a bite at The Lagoon Restaurant, one of the hotel's 6 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Need to unwind? Take a break at the bar/lounge, the beach bar, or the poolside bar for a tasty beverage. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in.

106493.description: This 5-story beach hotel, located about 1 km from Alanya's city center and just 30 m from Cleopatra Beach, offers 67 air-conditioned rooms with city or sea views. Gazipasa Airport is 46 km away. Each room features a satellite TV, telephone, safe, and bathroom with toiletries. Guests can relax in the lobby bar with its TV corner, dine in the restaurant with an outdoor terrace, or enjoy refreshments at the poolside bar. The hotel also boasts a swimming pool with a children's area and waterslide, complete with sun loungers and parasols for a perfect sunbathing experience.

106495.address: Yeni Mah Ataturk Cad 519 Sok No 7 7, 7
106495.description: This hotel is located in Kemer and is 10 km from the nearest town. The hotel is 600 m from the sea and features a private sandy and pebble beach. There is an underpass between the hotel and beach. Antalya Airport is 60 km from the establishment. This hotel is situated in the city with a wealth of culture, nature and many historic places. Guests will be able to enjoy the incomparable beauty of Kemer situated at the foot of Beydaglari Mountain as well as traditional Turkish hospitality. In addition to a lobby area with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and lift access, facilities available to guests at this 65-room city hotel include restaurants, bars and Internet access. Room and laundry services are provided (both for a fee) and guests arriving by car may use the hotel's parking facilities. All of the hotel's rooms feature air conditioning and heating units. Other amenities include a TV set, minibar, telephone, safe, balcony and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Guests can enjoy facilities such as the outdoor swimming pool with children's section and waterslide. Other facilities include a spa centre, fitness centre and a sauna (fees apply), as well as a Turkish bath and massage treatments (for a fee). For a fee the more adventurous at heart can try their hand at various water sports, including banana boating, waterskiing, jet skiing, motor boating and diving, in addition to windsurfing, sailing, catamaran boating, canoeing and paddle boating. The hotel has 1 outdoor restaurant and 1 indoor restaurant, as well as 2 bars where guests can taste delicious foods and sip drinks. All-inclusive stays are available to be booked.

106553.description: The Green Park Merter is located in the center of textile shopping in Istanbul. Moreover, congress and fair tourism in its close vicinity becomes an ideal option with Atatürk Airport and Marmara Forum AVM. In addition, with its proximity to the tram and metrobus station, many locations can be reached by a single vehicle without getting stuck in traffic. The hotel, which aims to make its guests feel special at all times by exceeding the understanding of standard accommodation, has a total of 165 rooms. At the Rumeli Restaurant, you can have your breakfast as an open buffet, and your lunch and dinner by choosing from the specially prepared menu. Guests can enjoy alcoholic or non-alcoholic cold drinks as well as delicious coffees and teas at the Lotus Bar located within the hotel. In the spring and summer months, you can relax in the hotel's magnificent garden. SPA facilities such as fitness, massage, sauna and hammam also offer the guests the opportunity to refresh. Frequently preferred for various organizations, the hotel also has large halls suitable for use during meetings and weddings.

106673.description: Tailor-made services, the perfect harmony of luxury and comfort, and the stunning beauty of the Mediterranean… Maxx Royal Belek Golf Resort is committed to creating the best holiday experiences that go beyond every expectation! To maximize guests' comfort and happiness, Maxx Royal Belek Resort has been elevating the luxury holiday experience to the next level since its inception. Nestled in Belek's spectacular nature, each villa will take your breath away with its spectacular architecture, elegant design, and bespoke services. Whether you relax on your private terrace amidst the greenery, plunge into your private pool, or enjoy the elegant indoor spaces with splendid scenery after a soothing bath, one thing is sure: each moment spent at Maxx Royal Belek Golf Resort will become an unforgettable memory. Guests at Maxx Royal Belek Golf Resort enjoy the unique privilege of having their own holiday assistant. Whether you need a restaurant reservation, have a specific pillow preference, or want to sign up for a fitness program, your Maxx Assistant will fulfill your request and make your holiday even more special.

106695.description: Sleep like a princess (or prince) at the Premier Inn Hotel Gatwick Airport South, situated in the grounds of the thirteenth-century Gatwick Manor. Relax before lift off or recover from a long-haul flight with a stroll around the tranquil medieval grounds, keeping your eyes peeled for wildlife. And, if you're here for work, we're close to key destinations like Manor Royal business centre, too. Catch a film or bowl a strike at Crawley Leisure Park. Take a dip or hit the gym at K2 Leisure Centre. Fly back in time at Gatwick Airport Aviation Museum. Then land safely with a tasty meal in our restaurant and a great night in your huge comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

106713.description: This apartment hotel is situated on Inverness Terrace, on the north side of Hyde Park in London. The establishment is located just a 5 minutes' walking distance from the Queensway and Bayswater underground stations, enjoying ease of access to Oxford Street and Covent Garden. Guests will find a number of bars, pubs, restaurants and shops in the vicinity, while Notting Hill can be found just a 15 minutes' walking distance away. London Heathrow and Gatwick airports are within driving distance of this hotel. The hotel comprises stylishly-decorated apartments, which offer contemporary accommodation in a prestigious location. The apartments are well equipped with up-to-date conveniences. Guests are sure to enjoy a memorable stay at this wonderful establishment.

106734.description: This fully renovated establishment combines traditional stone walls and wooden beams with modern technology. It offers the perfect conditions for anyone who enjoys both independent living and the services provided by hotels. The spacious apartments feature large dining areas and kitchenettes where guests can prepare their own food. Centrally located in the Gothic Quarter, the venue is close to Las Ramblas and the main culture and entertainment centres of the city. Gaudi's Casa Milà building is approximately 2 km, while those who are interested in arts can find Plaça del Pi, MACBA (Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art), CCCB (Barcelona Centre of Contemporary Culture), the cathedral, port and Teatre del Liceu all within walking distance. For a tasty meal or just a light snack guests are warmly invited to explore the surrounding areas and visit any of the tapas bars.

106735.description: Situated in Diagonal Mar, this apartment hotel complex is placed right next to the Nova Mar Bella beach and close to the city centre. It is an ideal place to enjoy life in the midst of nature, with beautiful parks, playgrounds for children and a lake. Barcelona International Airport is approximately 15 km away from the establishment. This apartment hotel complex features brand new high-quality air-conditioned apartments with lots of natural light coming from all sides. There is a restaurant, a children's playground and WLAN Internet access. Guests may also make use of room service, the laundry service and the hotel's car park and garage. The spacious air-conditioned units have 2 comfortable bedrooms fully-furnished with double or 2 single beds. There is a fully-equipped kitchen. The complex has an outdoor swimming pool with children's swimming area.

106746.description: The Nash Airport Hotel is perfect for both corporate or leisure trips being minutes away from the city centre, which is known for its prime shops, international organisations and its beautiful lakeside. The bus station is within walking distance, and the train station is roughly 1 km away. The hotel is located next to Geneva Cointrin International Airport. In 2019, the establishment was completely renovated. It offers a restaurant serving traditional cuisine, a sunny terrace and a garden for refreshing walks. The 7-storey hotel has 177 rooms fitted with everything visitors may need during their stay. Those who wish to relax can enjoy the sauna while active guests are welcome to use the gym.

106793.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a spa tub, and a steam room. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, 500, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

106794.description:
This aparthotel is located 30 minutes from the centre of Marrakesh, away from the hustle and bustle of the city, at the foot of the Ourika Valley. It takes approximately 30 minutes to reach Menara International Airport, as well as the train station, Jemaa-el-Fna or the Koutoubia.

The hotel combines Moroccan tradition with modern comfort. Guests will appreciate the tranquillity of this Moroccan haven of peace, the purity of the air, as well as the warm and convivial ambience. Renovated in 2008, this air-conditioned establishment offers a total of 17 accommodation units, including rooms and apartments, and welcomes guests in a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out service and currency exchange facilities. Guests may take advantage of the TV lounge and on-site restaurant, while Internet access, a laundry service and a car park are also provided.

The elegant and quiet rooms are equipped with air conditioning. Each unit comes with an en suite bathroom with shower/bathtub, as well as a double bed, satellite TV and a balcony or terrace.

During the day guests may enjoy the outdoor swimming pool located in the garden. The hammam features relaxing massage treatments using oils from the region. There is also a children's swimming area, poolside snack bar and spa treatments.

In the evening guests will have the opportunity to savour Moroccan specialities in the hotel restaurant, Douirya. Continental breakfast is served in the morning, whilst à la carte is offered at lunch and dinner. A set menu is also available at dinner.

106874.description: This urban hotel boasts a prime location in Barcelona's cosmopolitan Poblenou district, the city's thriving technological hub. Just 3 km from the Forum Auditorium and the CCIB, it's ideal for business travelers. A 15-minute walk takes you to the beach, while the historic city center and National Theatre of Catalonia are easily accessible. The Sagrada Familia is approximately 2 km away. This modern hotel offers a wide range of inviting accommodations, from standard rooms to luxurious suites perfect for extended stays. The onsite restaurant serves a diverse menu of Mediterranean specialties.

106878.description: This charming mid-sized property is located very close to the metro station at Platia Victoria and within walking distance of the National Archaeological Museum. It is a good choice for travelers from all over the world who seek high design and quality standards in their accommodation, as well as top quality service. On the premises of the venue they will find the perfect conditions for an unforgeable stay in the capital city of Greece. In addition, they can hop on the sight-seeing public bus line that departs from the nearby museum and visit any of the 16 attractions that make the city such a popular tourist destination.

106879.description: This hotel lies close to the bustling, culturally-rich centre of Athens. The hotel is set on Patisson Street, enjoying close proximity to links to the public transport network. The city's many intriguing sights can be found nearby, including the National Archaeological Museum and the Acropolis, which are within 3 km of the hotel. Eleftherios Venizelos International Airport is just 27 km away. This wonderful hotel is perfect for every type of traveller. The guest rooms come complete with modern amenities, ensuring comfort and convenience. Guests can avail of the hotel's many facilities and services, which add to their experience at the hotel.

106894.description: This city hotel lies close to the Kalimarmaro (Panathinaiko) stadium, where the 1st modern Olympic Games were held in 1896. The hotel is situated on a quiet pedestrian street and is just a short distance from the National Gardens and the Zappion Megaron. The establishment is not far from the historical city centre and Syntagma Square. Eleftherios Venizelos International Airport is some 36 km from the accommodation. This 4-storey hotel comprises a total of 16 guest rooms and welcomes its guests into a lobby with 24-hour reception service and secure luggage storage. Guests can relax and have a drink in the bar or enjoy the convenience of 24-hour room service (fees apply). All of the guest rooms have a simple modern décor and an en suite bathroom with shower and hairdryer. The rooms have been fitted with individually regulated air conditioning and feature a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV and a balcony or terrace. Non-smoking rooms are available. From Eleftherios Venizelos International Airport: Follow the metro line to the centre of Athens. Alight at Evangelismos and the hotel is about 500 metres from the station. Walk down the Vassileos Konstandinou Avenue, towards the Kalimarmaro stadium. Take the third right and then the third right again. The hotel is on the right-hand side on Ironda Street.

name.content: Al Ponte Dei Sospiri Junior Suites

106968.description: Enjoy a stay at the boutique Hotel Al Ponte dei Sospiri, nestled in the heart of Venice's City Center, just steps from St. Mark's Square and Basilica. This charming hotel offers 13 guestrooms equipped with minibars, satellite TV, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include bidets and hair dryers. Take advantage of convenient amenities such as concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), limited room service, and a bar/lounge. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Nearby attractions include St. Mark's Campanile (0. 2 km) and the Bridge of Sighs (0. 3 km).

106969.description: Located in the heart of Watford, this hotel is just a 5-minute walk from Watford Junction Railway Station, the town centre and its busy shopping streets. From there it takes just a 20-minute train ride to get to Euston Station in central London, which means that both business and leisure travellers can use the property as their hub. Business travellers can also find 8 dedicated meeting rooms, all with natural daylight and featuring the most up-to-date technologies. For a less formal environment, the venue offers a cosy coffee shop and more casual restaurant. The hotel restaurant serves excellent international dishes with great beers and wines to complement the mouth-watering food. There is also a bar where one can relax at the end of the day with a chilled pint and some good company.

106973.description: Vittorio de Sica and Sofia Loren, Bud Spencer and Terence Hill welcome you in the entrance of the Studios Hotel. These myths of cinema history introduce you to a hotel marked by extremely comfortable, wide-open and luminous spaces. The Studios Hotel is in Cologno Monzese, North-East of Milan, in the heart of the cinema, television and radio district. The Hotel is close to Milan, to Monza and to the Linate, Malpensa and Orio al Serio Bergamo airports. It boasts conference rooms, a restaurant, a bar, a gym and a free shuttle service to Cologno Sud. The hotel's public spaces can be used to organize various events such as parties, table- based tournaments, exhibitions and shows.

name.content: Side Story Resort & Spa (Ex Seher Sun Beach)

106994.description: This high-class hotel is located next to the beach, 8 km from Side and the wonderful ruins of the ancient city which once inhabited the peninsula; Antalya airport is approximately 55 km away. The accommodation complex comprises a total of 184 contemporary and comfortable rooms, provided with all amenities and facilities needed for a pleasant and unforgettable stay. In addition to an en-suite bathroom and satellite TV, each room has a private balcony with breathtaking sea or garden views. Individually controlled air conditioning also features in rooms as standard. Guests can choose to dine at the restaurant or enjoy a drink at the on-site bar. A swimming pool is also at guests' disposal and younger guests can enjoy the game centre located at the property's sister hotel next door.

106995.description: Indulge in a rejuvenating experience at the full-service spa, offering a variety of massages and body treatments.
