Take a refreshing dip in one of the seven outdoor swimming pools or unwind on the private beach. This all-inclusive property offers complimentary Wi-Fi, an arcade/game room, and a hair salon. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments, with some exceptions applying for specialty dining and drinks. Choose from four restaurants for a delightful culinary journey. Quench your thirst at one of the four bars/lounges, two beach bars, or the poolside bar. For added convenience, the property features a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free valet parking is available onsite. The 551 air-conditioned rooms provide a comfortable retreat with free minibar items, flat-screen televisions, premium bedding, and private furnished balconies or patios. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy satellite programming. Private bathrooms with showers include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Phaselis Ancient City (2. 5 mi), Kleopatra Beach (2. 7 mi), and Tekirova Beach (2. 4 mi).

107033.address: Al Meena Street, Old Salata. PO Box 22920
107033.description: From its location, accommodations to its facilities and cuisines, the Plaza Inn Doha caters to everything that today’s tech-savvy value-oriented business executives are looking for. An ideal blend of sophistication, comfort and affordability, the hotel is conveniently situated in walking distance to Doha’s stunning Corniche, the landmark Souq Waqif and the avant-garde Museum of Islamic Art and close proximity to various government offices, banks and the international airport. Work or rest…in total comfort Plaza Inn’s 180 guestrooms (120 suites) are spacious, beautifully appointed and designed to allow the crucial work-life balance a business executive requires. The rooms and suites have open-space work areas with scanner, copier and printing facilities. Expect large, flat-screen TVs, contemporary comfortable bathrooms and accessories, Direct-dial Telephones, Coffee and Tea making facilities, a Mini bar and host of other amenities. And, of course, there’s free Wi-Fi connectivity throughout the hotel. The pleasure of innovative dining Plaza Inn is known for the dining experiences it offers. Guests can choose from a variety of dining options including Middle Eastern, Indian and Western cuisines. The Atrium is known for its fast service, cozy ambiance and affordable pricing. If you are looking for Indian food, the Bollywood Lounge and Restaurant is your preferred choice. You can grab a light meal or enjoy a leisurely afternoon tea in our Lobby Lounge in an environment where work, communication and innovative dining merge harmoniously. Perfect business settings. Whether for meetings, product launches conferences or other business occasions; with the latest in Audio-Video technologies and a personal meeting planner, Plaza Inn is set to exceed your every meeting requirement and ensure you of a memorable and successful event. Relax. Recharge.

107035.address: Jawaan Street, Al Sadd, Po Box 24249, Doha, Qatar
107035.description: This stylish city hotel is located in the heart of Doha's diplomatic and commercial district. Centre Point shopping mall can be reached within 15 minutes on foot, and attractions such as Al Saad sports club, the National Theatre, Doha Zoo, and the National Museum are all within close proximity to the hotel. Doha International Airport is approximately 10 kms from the lodgings. This air-conditioned hotel is a luxurious property offering well-appointed accommodation, professional service and pleasant staff. Mixing traditional Arabian hospitality with a modern metropolitan feel, guests can enjoy the facilities and comfort of the hotel. The spacious rooms, exclusive amenities ensure that guests feel at home. After a long day sightseeing guests can unwind in the gym or spa centre, or sit back and relax in the hotel café.

107038.description: Located on the Corniche in Jeddah, this city hotel offers a luxurious, comfortable escape that will satisfy the most discerning traveller. The establishment lies 15 km from the Balad (the old town) and is about a 10-minute walk from the Red Sea. This hotel features a spa and wellness centre, as well as a fitness centre. All of the air-conditioned rooms at the Issham Hotel include free wired internet and satellite TV. They also feature private bathrooms and a refrigerator. A free breakfast is available from the buffet-style Café. Guests can also request room service. The hotel has a 24 hour front desk where guests can arrange laundry, or massage services. The hotel has free parking, and also has an elevator.

107054.address: Khalid Bin Waleed Road Bur Dubai
107054.description: The Royal Ascot is located right in the heart of Dubai, making most places in the city easily accessible. Sheikh Zayed road is just 7 minutes away, and Burjuman - one of Dubai's premiere malls - is a mere 5 minutes away. . The golden sands and pristine waters of Dubai make for a great day at the beach, especially during the winter months.

107058.description: The hotel is perfectly located a minute's walk from the Arc de Triomphe, which stands in the middle of the Place Charles de Gaulle, formerly the Place de l'Étoile, at the western end of the Champs-Élysées, which is a key player in this historical area of the city. Starting from the courtyard of the Palais du Louvre, with a sequence of monuments and grand thoroughfares leading out of Paris, this avenue is a must-see destination on any visitor's agenda. Likewise not to be missed is the Eiffel Tower, one of the top-10 spots in Paris. The airport is only about a 25-minute ride from the accommodation. The hotel is quite convenient for shopping purposes and for experiencing the lifestyle of the French people. This 23-room air-conditioned city hotel, was built with the concept of respect and love for the environment. It was built with a special style using artisan products, giving it the impression of a being a village. Care for the individual's senses and feelings has been taken in order to provide a warm and restful environment for each guest. This establishment combines the personality and style of an intimate residence with the functionality, reliability and attentive service of a major business and leisure hotel. Facilities at the hotel include a lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, lift access, a bar, a breakfast room, conference facilities, Internet access and room service. All of the hotel's suite rooms are fitted with individually regulated air conditioning and heating. Each one comes with a double bed, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, radio, Internet access and a safe. The bathrooms each have a bath/shower and a hairdryer.

107067.description: This charming city and business hotel is situated in the heart of Palermo Soho, a neighbourhood with the best gastronomical options, famous designer boutiques and art galleries. The Viruta Center, offering tango lessons, is just 50 m from the hotel, and guests will find a number of bars, pubs and nightlife spots in the immediate vicinity. The nearest public transport links are within a 30-minute walk of the hotel and nearby sights include the zoo (5-minute drive), Recoleta (10-minute drive), the Obelisk (10-minute drive) and the football stadium (20-minute drive). Jorge Newbery Airport and Ministro Pistarini International Airport are 5 and 20 km away respectively. Built in 2008, this boutique hotel offers full hotel services combined with the best warmth and personal attention, helping to make guests' stays unique and exclusive. The eco hotel comprises a total of 11 guest rooms and suites spread across 3 storeys. Fully air-conditioned, it welcomes its guests into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and a cloakroom. Lift access, a TV lounge, a café, bar and restaurant, and conference facilities can all be found on site. WLAN Internet access and room and laundry services are provided (the latter incurs a fee) and guests arriving by car can leave their vehicles in the parking garage (fees apply). The exclusive rooms have en suite bathrooms with a shower/bathtub, soft bathrobes, amenities and a hairdryer. The rooms have been designed and decorated with the utmost comfort and quality. All rooms have large windows and a balcony overlooking the street or the courtyard. They are equipped with one king-size bed or two twin beds, as well as a direct dial telephone, a plasma TV with satellite/cable channels, WIFI Internet access, a minibar and a safety deposit box. Individually regulated air conditioning and heating also feature.

107090.description: Located in Zuidas, Amsterdam's business district, the NH Amsterdam Zuid offers a free weekday shuttle service to facilitate your meetings. A short drive from the hotel, you'll find the World Trade Center, RAI Convention Center, Amstelpark, and the vibrant Pijp district. Access the city center in 20 minutes via the metro or tram at the nearby Van Boshuizenstraat station, arriving directly at Amsterdam Central Station. The hotel's contemporary rooms feature white décor with bright splashes of green, wooden floors, and ample natural light. Guests staying in Superior Rooms and Junior Suites enjoy Nespresso machines. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Savor a fresh breakfast buffet in the cozy yet contemporary Sinfonía restaurant, which later serves delicious French and international cuisine. For lighter snacks and drinks, relax on our lovely terrace. With 18 conference rooms equipped with SMART Room System technology for seamless videoconferencing, the hotel provides excellent meeting facilities. Guests can also enjoy the hotel gym and spa.

107097.description: The Crowne Plaza Istanbul Old City, located in Istanbul's historic peninsula, seamlessly blends Ottoman and Seljuk architectural influences with modern design. Its 257 rooms offer contemporary comfort and cater to every need. Guests can enjoy the a la carte restaurant, café, bar, and well-equipped meeting rooms. The hotel's magnificent interior courts showcase the building's artful architecture, reflecting the rich history and cultural heritage of the area. Light-filled atriums and beautifully designed courtyards further enhance the hotel's visual appeal. As part of the IHG Group, the Crowne Plaza Istanbul Old City is committed to providing the highest quality of service and looks forward to welcoming you.

107117.address: Carretera Garrafon, Vista Alegre Km 4.5 SM, 8 Mza.
107117.description: This lavish, couples-only resort is situated on the exclusive Mujeres Island, just off the coast of Mexico and with regular ferries running from Cancun. Guests might enjoy the resort's daily entertainment programmes, participate in activities such as snorkelling, beach volleyball and kayaking, or simply lounge on the pretty beach and soak up the sun. The bright and airy guest rooms are decorated in soothing neutral tones and are well-appointed with double hot tubs, luxurious bedding and designer bath products. Rooms come with views of the pool, island or surrounding sea, and guests can make use of in-room Wi-Fi internet access as well as the handy minibar and coffee maker. Guests might choose to dine in the onsite restaurant, offering Mexican, Italian and pan-Asian cuisines alongside an extensive wine list, or indulge in room service for a relaxing meal in the privacy of the room, all during a wonderful island retreat. SMOKE FREE PROPERTY

107255.description:
This elegant luxury hotel is located in Midtown Manhattan, the very heart of the world's most exciting city. Neighbouring Central Park, Carnegie Hall, the Rockefeller Center, Broadway, and the shopping paradise that are Madison Avenue and Fifth Avenue, this hotel enjoys the ideal New York City location. The Museum of Modern Art, Radio City Music Hall, and St. Patrick's Cathedral are a short walk away. Luxurious suites with first class service and amenities guarantee a wonderful stay. 

Valid Credit Card mandatory to complete booking. A government photo ID at time of check-in along with a valid credit card is
required. Please note that a 500. 00 USD security deposit is held on the credit card upon arrival. We strongly urge our guests not
to use debit cards at time of check in due to the authorization.

name.content: Abalu Hotel Design & Boutique - Adults Only

107317.description: Located in the heart of Madrid, 200 meters from Gran Via and close to museums, restaurants and shops, this hotel emerges as the ultimate urban boutique hotel and a self-contained destination with a completely original manipulation of space that blurs all 'normal' distinctions. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, lift access, café, bar and breakfast/dining room, Wi-Fi, room and laundry service.

name.content: NYX Hotel Berlin Köpenick by Leonardo Hotels

107318.description: This city hotel is located in one of the greenest districts of Berlin. It is an oasis of peace, providing easy access to the city centre of the German capital. Enjoy the charming, medieval ambience of the town and the marvellous views. Take a walk along the Dahme River and travel back in time to the heyday of the historical castle. By using public transport, guests will conveniently reach the numerous sights and attractions of Berlin's city centre. Within 20 minutes, they will be at Alexanderplatz square, Brandenburg Gate or in the picturesque Nikolai Quarter. It is approximately 8 km to Schoenefeld Airport and about 25 km to Tegel Airport. The hotel has 190 rooms and offers first-class service and wonderful amenities for both business and leisure travellers. Relax with colleagues or friends at the bar overlooking the river and the castle. In the event that guests are planning a wedding, a banquet, a conference or a meeting, the event facilities are recommended for catering for those unforgettable moments. Other amenities on offer at the hotel include a 24-hour reception, hotel safe, lift access, bar, restaurant and conference facilities. WLAN Internet access, a laundry service and an 85-space garage are available for an additional fee. All the en suite rooms come with bath/shower, hairdryer, double or king-size bed, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, radio and Internet access. The hotel offers a breakfast buffet.

107359.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this Baroque hotel include concierge services, a banquet hall, and bike storage. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A train station pick-up service is provided at no charge, and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 50 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature hair dryers and slippers. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and electric kettles.

107360.description: Located in Istanbul's historic Yenikapi district, this hotel offers air-conditioned rooms with private bathrooms. Just 45 km from Istanbul International Airport, it provides a range of amenities for a comfortable stay. Experience contemporary service blended with Turkish hospitality. Enjoy drinks at the bar and dine at the restaurant. On-site parking is available. Please note: the pool, sauna, hammam, and massage services are temporarily unavailable due to renovations. Other hotel facilities remain open for your enjoyment.

107361.address: Sección A, Lote 3 Km. 8.5 Boulevard Kukulkan
107361.description:
This European plan resort has a breathtaking beachfront location in Cancun, close to the major tourist attractions, exquisite restaurants and lively shopping malls, only 25-minutes driving from the Cancun International Airport. 
Fiesta Americana Cancun Villas features an outdoor pool, beach, a lively coral reef, three delicious on-site restaurants La Palapa, El Mexicano and La Bodega, and two enchanting bars. The spacious guest villas include a kitchenette and a balcony with different dimensions for the comfort of the whole family. Our guests will be able to enjoy outdoor sports and competitions, a fitness center as well as the Uru Spa, with regenerating treatments and massages. Kids between the age 4 and 12 will experience fun activities at Fiesta Kids Club during the day. The hotel also offers an on-site gift shop and it is a dog friendly property.

107490.description: This central hotel close to the Dam Square, is known for being home away from home for our many guests who return year after year. Hotel Damsquare offers a 24-hour reception and nearby bicycle rental is available. A flat-screen TV, safe deposit box, tea/coffee making facilities, private bathroom and airconditioning are provided. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. All the rooms in our hotel are different, the room published on the picture cannot be guaranteed. Please note that the hotel does not have a lift and that there are narrow staircases in these typical Amsterdam buildings. Possible noise nuisance: the hotel is located in the heart of Amsterdam, on one of the most vibrant streets of the city. You will find everything close by but there is people, bikes and some traffic throughout the day and night.

107615.description: This high-class resort complex is only 9 km from Side and 60 km from Antalya. The nearest airport is 55 km away. Links of the public transport network are conveniently reached from the hotel and provide easy transportation to Side and Manavgat every 20 minutes. This accommodation establishment is set in palm gardens and has its own private beach. Guests are welcomed to take advantage of the many facilities and amenities on offer. The friendly and well trained staff is also there to contribute to a memorable and pleasant stay. All in room amenities are selected, so that guests lack nothing during their stay, and in addition to an en suite bathroom, each room comes with a private balcony.

107616.description: The five-star Bella Resort Spa is located on Çolaklı's unique Side beach, 12 km from ancient Side and 45 km from Antalya Airport. Airport shuttles are available (surcharge), and a 24-hour taxi stand is conveniently located next to the hotel. This all-inclusive beachfront resort boasts a large outdoor pool, two children's pools with waterslides, and an indoor pool. Free Wi-Fi and private parking are available. Guests enjoy complimentary access to the gym, sauna, Turkish bath, and steam room. Massages and beauty treatments can be booked for an additional fee. Awarded the prestigious Blue Flag, Bella Resort Spa also holds ISO 9001 and ISO 22000 certifications. The resort offers 291 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with satellite TV, a minibar (complimentary soft drinks), and a private bathroom with a shower, hairdryer, and toiletries. Savor a variety of Turkish and international cuisine at our open buffet, prepared according to international hygiene standards. For an unforgettable dining experience, explore the flavors of Mexico, Italy, and the Ottoman Empire at our à la carte restaurants.

107618.address: Çolaklı Turizm Beldesi Deniz Caddesi No:50
107618.description: The hotel is located in Colakli-Side, directly on the beach. Its main building consists of 4 floors and is surrounded by palm trees. All rooms are stylishly furnished and equipped with amenities such as an en suite bathroom, a satellite TV and a balcony. Sport enthusiasts may enjoy the vast range of water sport activities such as, water skiing, parasailing, canoeing and jet skiing on the beach. A fitness centre and tennis facilities are also available, as well as massage and sauna treatments for those who wish to pamper themselves. There are daily entertainment programmes for adults and children and evening shows as well.

107619.description: The appealing Viking Garden Hotel & SPA is beautifully situated in one of the former orange gardens and in the spring, guests can enjoy the fine scent of the blossoming trees. The centre of the popular holiday resort of Kemer with its shopping opportunities, restaurants, bars and the harbour is within walking distance. The hotel has a private beach, which is just over a kilometre away; the public pebble beach is at 300 metres. The architecture of this family-friendly resort hotel is reminiscent of the Ottoman Empire style and fits perfectly in these beautiful surroundings. Children will get taken care of in the mini club, there is a separate children's pool as well as a playground. In addition, there is a main outdoor pool, an indoor pool, a pool with slides as well as an adults-only pool in the relax garden (open from May 15/October 15). Guests can indulge in total relaxation in the spa area. A fantastic hotel for couples and families with children.

107620.description: Located in a quiet area, directly on the beach, the hotel is 70 km from Antalya's city centre. Decorated in an attractive, bright style, the hotel has pleasant, spacious public areas offering many facilities and services, including a restaurant with smoking area and WLAN Internet access. Younger ones can make use of the kids' club, and guests can enjoy their favourite drinks in the bar, pub and disco. The hotel's many facilities include a number of pools and 4 water slides, as well as a poolside snack bar and parasols. Guests may also take advantage of the SPA centre and massage service. Water sport lovers are sure to appreciate the wide selection, including water skiing, jet skiing, canoeing and pedal boating. Entertainment programmes are arranged for adults and children.

107677.description: Discover the very best that the capital has to offer at our Novotel London Paddington hotel. With contemporary stylings, a fitness centre and a heated swimming pool, this is the perfect base for guests travelling alone or as a family. With four major tube lines and National Rail services situated nearby, guests can move around the city with ease or stay local with a family day out at London Zoo. We are delighted to announce that Novotel London Paddington will undergo a full renovation of its rooms from November 2025 and due to end January 2027 During this time, structural works will take place from Monday - Friday, 09:00 am to 17:00 pm.

107695.description: The resort is set in palm-filled gardens on its own private beach. Renovated in 2008, this air-conditioned establishment features a lobby with a hairdressing salon and auditorium. The conference facilities may be of use to business travellers. Guests are also provided with a bar, disco and restaurant. The accommodation units have an en suite bathroom and air conditioning. A balcony and sitting area also feature as standard. A massage service is provided and a gym is available for sport enthusiasts. Guests may also take advantage of other facilities and activities on offer, such as water sports and tennis. Daily entertainment for adults and children are available, as are night time shows 6 times a week.

107696.description: Süral Garden Hotel offers you an unforgettable vacation experience with private services just for you in the magnificent panoramic garden, where you will feel free in nature accompanied by the golden yellow beach and the special fine sand of the Western Mediterranean. This establishment is situated just 250 metres from the beach. Guests are welcomed to take advantage of the many facilities and amenities on offer. All in room amenities are selected, so that guests lack nothing during their stay, and in addition to an en suite bathroom, each room comes with a private balcony. Sport enthusiasts may take advantage of activities available, such as water sports and tennis. Daily entertainment for adults and children are provided, as are night time shows 6 times a week.

107746.address: Ras Abu Abboud Street, PO Box 26662
107746.description: Nestled in Doha's historic district, Sharq Village & Spa, a Ritz-Carlton Hotel, is a short drive from the Doha Corniche and Pearl Monument. This luxury hotel offers guests a variety of amenities, including three outdoor swimming pools, a health club, and a spa featuring massages, body treatments, and facials. Each of the 174 guestrooms boasts private balconies, minibars, and entertainment options such as DVD players and 55-inch LCD televisions. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Dining options include the beachfront bar/lounge, Iris Doha, with stunning ocean views, as well as 24-hour room service. For added convenience, an area shuttle service is available (surcharge).

107748.description:
Tulip Hotel Apartments – Your Home Away from Home in the Heart of Bur Dubai
Discover the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and value at Tulip Hotel Apartments, ideally located in the bustling heart of Bur Dubai. Whether you're in the city for business or leisure, our stylish, fully serviced apartments offer all the space and amenities you need—just 600 meters from BurJuman Mall and within walking distance of both BurJuman and Sharaf DG Metro Stations. 
With quick access to Dubai’s top attractions and commercial hubs—including the Dubai World Trade Centre (5 km) and Dubai International Airport (15 minutes by taxi)—Tulip Hotel Apartments places the best of the city right at your doorstep. 

Spacious Living, Thoughtful Comfort
Each of our self-catering apartments is thoughtfully designed with warm amber tones, large windows, and all the essentials to make your stay effortless—whether it's for a few days or a few months. 
Your apartment includes:
•	A separate living area with plush seating and a flat-screen TV with satellite channels
•	A fully equipped kitchenette with a refrigerator, cooking range, washing machine, and dining space
•	Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi to keep you connected throughout your stay

Relax, Recharge, and Explore
At Tulip Hotel Apartments, we go beyond just a place to stay—we offer experiences designed to make your visit memorable. 
Enjoy a range of amenities including:
•	A rooftop swimming pool with panoramic views and a sun-soaked deck for ultimate relaxation
•	A fitness center, sauna, and steam room to keep up your wellness routine
•	A dedicated travel desk to assist with car rentals, tour bookings, and local excursions across the UAE

Step Into the Heart of Dubai Culture
Step outside and immerse yourself in the charm of Old Dubai.

107751.description: Savoy Park Hotel Apartments in Dubai offers 126 well appointed, individually controlled air-conditioned, luxurious studio rooms with a choice of twin or large beds. All of our Dubai hotel apartment rooms have en suite bathrooms and an extra sofa bed with a fully equipped kitchenette. Ideal for overseas assignments, leisure vacation and relocation. *City tax not included.

107788.address: 12 Allee du Trait d'Union Carre Senart
107788.description: Located in the heart of Paris's vibrant southern suburbs, this hotel offers convenient access to Orly International Airport (15 minutes) and Disneyland Paris (25 km). Each of the 165 stylish suites features a fully fitted kitchenette, a seating area with a leather sofa and a flat-screen TV, and an en-suite bathroom with complimentary internet access. The hotel restaurant serves innovative, internationally-inspired cuisine.

name.content: B&B HOTEL Marne la Vallee Chelles

107790.address: Zac La Tuilerie, 6 Rue de L'Ormeteau, 6
107790.description: The B&B Hotel Marne-la-Vallée Chelles in Chelles is conveniently located 11 miles from Disneyland® Paris and 8. 9 miles from Val d'Europe. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a vending machine, and a garden. The 42 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs with cable programming, desks, and private bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Enjoy the daily buffet breakfast (fee applies) or a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel also provides express check-in, complimentary weekday newspapers, dry cleaning/laundry services, and free self-parking. Meeting facilities are available, spanning 891 square feet.

107800.description: Located in Brétigny-sur-Orge, hotelF1 offers convenient access to Linas-Montlhéry Autodrome and Évry 2 Regional Shopping Center, both within a 10-minute drive. This budget-friendly hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, a terrace, and a garden. Each of the 73 guestrooms features an MP3 docking station and a flat-screen TV with digital programming. A buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee). Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and coffee/tea facilities. Free self-parking is also available.

107804.description: The Logis Hôtel des Lacs Paris Sud is located in green area on the banks of the lake. It offers comfortable rooms with free WiFi internet access. The Logis Hôtel des Lacs Paris Sud offers rooms with a simple and functional decoration. Canal +, Canal Cinema and Eurosport are available. L'Envolée, the hotel’s restaurant offers a selection of traditional dishes. A mini golf and the municipal swimming pool are just few steps away from the hotel. Orly Airport is 5 mi away and Viry-Châtillon RER Train Station is a 15-minute walk from the property and offers direct access to the center of Paris. Our restaurant is closed on sundays, and from July 30th to August 22nd.

107806.description: Conveniently located just a 15-minute drive from Paris' Orly airport and a 20-minute drive from the city centre, this popular, pet-friendly hotel offers a good night's rest before a long journey or during a stopover flight. The contemporary guest rooms feature plump, cosy beds a handy work desk, and wireless internet access. Guests can take advantage of free onsite parking and complimentary weekday newspapers, and the onsite restaurant serves a delicious, full buffet breakfast in the mornings. Business travellers might also make use of the onsite meeting room and fax machine, and the professional, multilingual staff at the hotel are happy to assist guests by recommending the best restaurants sights to see in the area. Whether travelling for business or leisure, this hotel's comfortable rooms and modern services make for a pleasant and restful stay.

107811.address: allee Rosa Luxembourg Eragny sur Oise
107811.description: This comfortable hotel is conveniently located minutes from many of France's most popular tourist destinations. A variety of restaurants and cocktail lounges are located in the surrounding area. The on-site restaurant and bistro serve breakfast, lunch and dinner in traditional French cuisine. There is also a lounge on the premises featuring a full-service bar. Business travellers will appreciate access to copy and fax services. The banquet and meeting room accommodates up to 60 people for most events and business functions. Handicap accessible rooms are available. There is a jogging trail located nearby for guests who want to stay fit while traveling. Guest laundry facilities and a currency exchange are located on the property for added convenience.

107825.description: Built in 2002, the Ramada Hotel London North M1 stands as one of the largest Ramada Hotels in Europe. Enjoy free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel and in-room TVs with on-demand movies. This modern hotel boasts 200 en-suite bedrooms, each larger than average for London accommodations. The hotel offers easy access to Central London, Wembley, Heathrow Airport, and Luton Airport. All double rooms feature a queen-size bed. Guests can enjoy the convenience of an on-site bar and restaurant, along with buffet and continental breakfast options (fees apply). A complimentary newspaper and a cash machine are also available. Please note, pets are not allowed, and access to the hotel is via the M1 motorway.

107836.description: The hotel is located in Voula, 18 km from Athens city centre. For guests' convenience, the hotel is just across the road (K. Karamanli Street) from Voula beach. The centre of Voula is approximately 100 m from the hotel, and Voula's shops, restaurants, discos and clubs are around 50 m away. Lake Vouliagmeni and the peninsula of Sounion are about 10 minutes and 40 minutes away by public transport, respectively. The Elliniko metro station is about a 20-minute drive away, and Kifissos bus station is about a 50-minute drive from the hotel. Larissis train station is around 90 minutes away by car, and Athens International Airport is 19 km from the hotel. This deluxe hotel was fully renovated in 2008 and is both air-conditioned and soundproofed. Due to its good location, it appeals to both leisure and business travellers alike. With a total of 20 guestrooms, the hotel offers a lobby, 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and lift access. Guests can relax in the hotel's TV lounge, bar and restaurant. The hotel also features conference facilities, WLAN Internet access and a car park. Room and laundry services and a bicycle hire are provided. The rooms are divided into single, double/twin and triple rooms. All rooms are equipped with satellite TV, individually regulated air conditioning, hairdryer, telephone, free wireless Internet access, minibar, shower and magnificent sea views over Voula's beach. All rooms come with a fridge and a balcony or terrace. Two separate single beds are available in twin rooms, and triple rooms have either 3 separate single beds or 1 king-size bed and a separate single bed. The hotel offers a snack bar An ample breakfast buffet is served daily.

107857.description: Enjoy a central Paris location at the eco-certified Hotel Paris La Fayette, a short drive from iconic landmarks like the Palais Garnier and Paris Olympia. Our 60 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs with cable programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, and convenient amenities such as phones, desks, and hair dryers. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) served from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Additional amenities include a 24-hour business center and multilingual staff at the front desk. We're conveniently located near the Grands Boulevards and several metro stations, placing you within easy reach of attractions such as the Louvre Museum, Champs-Élysées, and Notre Dame Cathedral.

107862.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 70 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Bois de Boulogne - 1. 5 km / 0.

107873.description: This charming hotel is set in the heart of Rueil-Malmaison, only a five-minute stroll from the pretty Saint-Peter-Saint-Paul Church, the Local History Museum, and of course, the magnificent Chateau de Malmaison, the residence of Napoleon's first wife. The enchanting city centre of Paris is only a twenty-minute drive away, as is Versailles, making this an ideal base for a sightseeing holiday. Guests will feel welcomed in the refined lobby and lounge as well as the colourful, individually designed guest rooms. Each room features a range of modern comforts, including air-conditioning, satellite television and free Wi-Fi internet access. Guests can wake up to a delicious breakfast in the lounge bar and take advantage of the convenient onsite parking facility to leave the car for a day and take the train into Paris, all during an amusing, unhurried family holiday.

107908.description: Miiro Templeton Garden offers a central stay in well-heeled Kensington, close to museums, landmarks, luxury shopping and some of the city's most beautiful green spaces. Tucked away on a magnificent Victorian row near Earls Court, a charming hidden gem that combines traditional townhouse elegance with all the stylish, modern flair of a hotel. Guests may start their days with generous breakfast overlooking the tranquil award-winning landscaped private garden, a rare luxury and tranquil oasis in the heart of London. Its restaurant offers a variety of contemporary dishes. The stylishly designed rooms radiate warm elegance and comfort expected from a Central London accommodation. Between dawn and dusk, the visitors can enjoy a high-end gym in the fitness centre or just indulge themselves with the electronic devices using the high speed Wi-Fi and LAN internet.

107909.description:
This hotel enjoys a central location in Richmond. It is situated close to the rail, underground, bus and road (M3, M4, and M25) links and has a number of restaurants, bars, pubs, nightlife spots, tourist attractions and shops within 500 metres. Nearby airports include London Heathrow (17 km), London City (40 km), Luton (60 km), London Gatwick (75 km) and London Stansted (77 km). 

This guesthouse is set in a recently refurbished Victorian townhouse dating back to 1874. The establishment comprises a total of 23 guest rooms and offers a warm but modern decor, with affordable accommodation in a non-smoking environment. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, and on-site facilities include a restaurant and a laundry service (fees apply). Guests arriving by car can leave their vehicles in the nearby car park. 

Each bedroom has been designed with modern, warm, welcoming colours and fabrics. Single standard rooms have large 1, 20 m single beds. No rooms are suitable for extra beds but double standard rooms can accommodate baby cots. Singles without a bathroom have a washbasin within the room and a shared shower room and toilet. All rooms have complimentary tea and coffee making facilities, and other facilities available include a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a radio and central heating. Hairdryers and irons are available on loan from reception. 

A continental buffet breakfast is served each morning. 

From Heathrow Airport: Take the M4 towards London, exit at Junction 1. Follow the signs for Richmond. When entering the town centre, Church Road is the first turning on the left after the Richmond Circus roundabout.

107959.description: Situated in San Sebastián de los Reyes, just a short drive from central Madrid, this hotel offers convenient access to Madrid-Barajas International Airport (8 km), Infanta Sofía Hospital, IFEMA, Antena 3 TV, and major commercial and industrial areas. Leisure destinations such as Plaza Norte 2, Diversia, and La Moraleja Green are also nearby. Public transport is easily accessible with the C4 Cercanías train and Metro Line 10 (Reyes Católicos station) within a 10-minute walk. Built in 2001, the three-story hotel features 15 comfortable rooms equipped with air conditioning, heating, and a private bathroom. Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, a 24' LED TV in each room, and a lobby with an elevator and a TV lounge.

108006.description: The Stay Boulevard Nisantasi is in the city that never sleeps, so our hotel follows afoot. The entrance is from Saint Pâtissier, which serves classic French delicacies that is perfect to grab a bite before heading out to discover the city, as well as fresh handmade bread and Turkish delights to take home with you. By climbing a floor up by the stairs to the lobby, you can experience our AI real-time digital installation by the internationally acclaimed digital artist duo Ouchhh! that changes and evolves every minute. 82 spacious rooms and luminous suites offer multiple accommodation selections. Some are designed with walk-in closets, built-in kitchenettes, private terraces, and marbled bathrooms with both rain showers and bathtubs. *The state-of-the-art Connecting rooms and suites with multiple bedrooms are designed perfectly for larger groups and extended families.

108007.address: Kucuk Ayasofya Caddesi Cayiroglu Sokak No: 17, 17
108007.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and wedding services. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Grab a bite to eat at the hotel's family restaurant, which features a bar/lounge and an ocean view. You can also stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, limo/town car service, and a computer station. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a cruise ship terminal shuttle. Make yourself at home in one of the 25 individually decorated guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Sultanahmet Square - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Little Hagia Sophia - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Blue Mosque - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Bosphorus - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Hagia Sophia - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Cemberlitas Bath - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Basilica Cistern - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Gülhane Park - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Istanbul Archaeology Museums - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Grand Bazaar - 1. 4 km / 0. 8 mi- Beyazit Square - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Yenikapi Ferry Terminal - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Eminönü Square - 2 km / 1. 2 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 44. 1 km / 27. 4 mi Istanbul Airport (IST) - 47. 6 km / 29.

108008.address: Hudavendigar Cad Erdogan Sok No 14-16 Sirkeci
108008.description: The hotel is situated in the heart of Istanbul. Ideally located, guests may easily reach restaurants, pubs, discos, the tourist centre, the park and shopping on foot. Public transport links and the railway station are also nearby. Guests may reach tourist attractions on foot such as the Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, the Grand Bazaar, the Blue Mosque and the Basilica Cistern. Atatürk International Airport Istanbul is located approximately 17 km from the hotel while Sabiha Gokcen International Airport is approximately 60 km away. Nowhere will guests feel the comfort of luxurious service in such a small hotel more than in this establishment with just 17 rooms. This 6-storey, air-conditioned city establishment offers a lobby with a 24-hour reception, currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom and lift access. The family-friendly hotel also has a bar, a restaurant and WLAN Internet access as well as room and laundry services, both for an additional fee. The hotel has comfortable rooms decorated in authentic style. There are different kinds of accommodation including French bed single, French bed and twin-bed double and 3- and 4-bed accommodation. The rooms are en suite and come equipped with a shower and a hairdryer as well as a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV and Internet access. Furthermore, they have a minibar, individually regulated air conditioning and heating and a safe.

108009.address: Ilıca Mahallesi 310 Sokak No: 3 Kumköy Mevkii
108009.description: The hotel is located in the popular region of Kumköy on the outskirts of the historical city of Side, 6 kms away. The beach is just 100 metres from the hotel and Antalya Airport is 60 kms with the market town of Manavgat just 12 kms away. The well-established hotel with spacious grounds features a large indoor restaurant and an outdoor, shaded snack bar. The air-conditioned property comprises 319 guest rooms. Younger guests will enjoy the kids' club and playground. The main pool has a fountain feature in the centre and is bordered by sun terraces and well maintained gardens with grass lawns and palm trees providing shade. Children can enjoy their own swimming area. Refreshments are served at the poolside snack bar. The hotel entertainment team arranges day and evening programmes, organise games, sports and shows, and ensure lots of fun.

108153.description: CIN: IT027042A1EO64SEL5The Biasutti Hotel in Venice is a pleasant and sunny villa, located between the sea and the lagoon and surrounded by a flowered garden. Thanks to its position, this property combines the fascinating atmosphere of this wonderful art city and the relaxing atmosphere of the Lido. The hotel is situated just 2 ferry-boat stops from La Biennale di Venezia and only 10 minutes from San Marco square. The property can also feature a cozy american bar and a pleasant terrace. Nice affiliated beach only 500 meters away. This property can be easily reached by ferry - boat in 30 minutes from 'Venezia - Tronchetto (cars can be boarded on the ferry boat). Local city fee is up to 3. 6 EUR per night, per adult over 10 years old. The additional fee is excluded and it will be paid directly at the hotel. Enjoy your stay.

108178.description: Located in the heart of downtown Brooklyn, this city lifestyle hotel offers convenient access to Manhattan and iconic New York attractions. Explore the Brooklyn Academy of Music, the Brooklyn Botanical Gardens, and the New York Transit Museum, all within easy reach. Foodies will delight in nearby eateries such as Bar Tabac, Nicky's Vietnamese Sandwiches, and Jolie Restaurant Français. Penn Station is approximately 9. 7 km away. The hotel features 93 comfortable guest rooms equipped with cable flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, telephones, radios, safes, and minibars. Each en suite bathroom includes a shower, hairdryer, and Aveda bath products. An ironing set, individually controlled air conditioning, and heating are also provided. Guests can enjoy a refreshing dip in the pool, stay active in the gym, and take advantage of other convenient amenities. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast in the café, which also serves a light tapas menu in the evening. A full-service bar is available for a relaxing drink. For those arriving by car, on-site parking is available (fees apply), and bicycle rentals are also offered.

108244.description:
Hilton Buenos Aires stands out for its iconic architecture, featuring a stunning glass atrium lobby, a modern terrace pool, and a versatile 72, 290 sq. ft. Convention Center. Perfectly located in the vibrant Puerto Madero waterfront district, the hotel offers convenient access to airports and is just a short walk from the financial district, top attractions, and some of the city’s best dining. 

Our spacious Deluxe Rooms provide comfort and style, with complimentary access to pool and fully equipped fitness center. For an elevated stay, choose our Executive Rooms and Suites, which include exclusive access to the Executive Lounge with complimentary continental breakfast, all-day refreshments, and evening cocktails. 

Hilton Buenos Aires also offers 24-hour room service and three distinctive onsite dining experiences: El Faro Restaurant, Alberto’s Lobby Bar, and Croutons Grab ’n’ Go.

108367.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include babysitting (surcharge) and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, DO CO Restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Local cuisine breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Vienna? This hotel has 75 square feet (7 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 43 guestrooms featuring minibars and DVD players. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

108368.description: Above a traditional London pub, this family-run budget hotel offers reasonably-priced accommodations and free Wi-Fi. Elephant & Castle and Kennington tube stations can be reached with a 15 minute walk. Each comfortable room at Hour Glass has a TV, free tea/coffee-making facilities, sink and a fridge. There are ample shared bathroom and kitchen facilities, including a washer and dryer. This Victorian pub and hotel still retains some original wood framing. The pub can also serve meals throughout the day. Burgess Park with its playground and barbecue facilities is a 2 minute walk away. Hour Glass is across from a bus stop, allowing easy access to the center of the city. There are a number of restaurants and clubs including the Ministry of Sound in Elephant and Castle, which are just a 5 minute drive away.

108369.description: Sitting proudly on Green Lanes, this hotel basks in the splendour of this vibrant area of North London. Finsbury Park is just a few minutes' walking distance away. Manor House tube station and Harringay Rail Station are a 5 minutes' walk away. The lively centre of London, with its array of intriguing, world-renowned attractions, is within easy reach. This hotel is housed in an attractive Victorian building. Classically-styled guest rooms offer serenity and comfort. The hotel features a traditional pub, where guests can relax and unwind with a drink. A delightful breakfast is available in the mornings, for a superb start to the day.

108458.address: Riad Zitoun Jdid Derb Sidi Fares, 1
108458.description:
Situated in the heart of the old Medina, guests can enjoy easy access to places of interest such as the Bahia Palace (200 m), the Ben Youssef Mosque and the Dar Si Said Museum, as well as the famous Djemaa el Fna Square (10 minutes). The central bus station is 3 km away and parking is situated at 100 m from the riad. Menara International Airport is situated at a distance of approximately 15 km.

This riad is a beautiful, traditional Moroccan guest house located in the historical centre of Marrakech with a charming interior courtyard with a garden and fountain. It offers 8 rooms in oriental style. Among the facilities available at this riad are a TV room with satellite TV and a DVD player, a lobby with 24-hour check-out service, currency exchange facilities, a hairdressing salon and wireless Internet access in public areas. Meals are served in the breakfast/dining room and guests may also take advantage of the room and laundry services.

All hotel rooms have private bathrooms (shower/WC) and free wireless Internet access. The rooms are also equipped with double beds, individually regulated heating, fans and four of them have air conditioning.

There is a traditional hammam available to guests as well as a sun terrace, parasols and a massage service. Royal Amelkis Golf Club is around a 20-minute drive away.

The restaurant serves fresh salads, grilled food and tasty Moroccan specialities. A continental breakfast is served each morning.

Leaving Menara Airport, follow the road N8 to Marrakech. Then take Avenue Mohamed V. Turn at Rue El Mouahidine and continue to Avenue Hammoun El Fetouaki. Take a left at Rue Riad Zitoun el Jdid and turn right at Rue de la Bahia.

108599.description: The comfortable 3-star ibis Dubai Deira City Centre hotel is just 2 minute walk from Deira City Centre Metro Station. Boasting contemporary guest rooms, 2 restaurants and an al fresco dining, daily free parking and complimentary shuttle service to the Al Mamzar Beach, we make sure to cater to your needs during your stay. Don't miss the important meal of the day at Tempo, our breakfast room. Keep connected with our free WiFi access or make use of our web corner in the hotel for your business needs.

108600.description: The hotel is situated in the heart of the business and commercial district of Deira. It boasts contemporary guest rooms & suites, 4 meeting rooms, 3 restaurants & bars, 24 hour fitness centre, outdoor pool, free parking and full access to connecting Ibis Dubai Deira City Centre facilities. Take advantage of the complimentary shuttle to Al Mamzar Beach and stay connected with our free WiFi access and 24 hours Web Corner.

108614.address: Nehru Road Ext, Vile Parle (E),Nr Domestic Airport, -
108614.description: Strategically located in central Mumbai, this transit hotel offers easy access to transportation, including Mumbai Airport just 1 km away. The hotel provides 54 luxuriously appointed rooms featuring comfortable seating areas, en suite bathrooms, flat-screen satellite TVs, minibars, and complimentary toiletries. For dining, the Red Grill restaurant serves a diverse menu of Indian, Oriental, and Western cuisine, including specialty Dum Biryanis, along with a variety of beverages. Room service is also available.

108618.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Mumbai. It is a short drive away from the Victoria Memorial and the nearest station is Howrah Railway Station. The Hotel has a fitness centre/gym. All 52 rooms are equipped with hairdryer, safe, ironing set and air conditioning.

108619.description: All prices displayed are subject to good and services tax (GST) at prevailing rates - 12% for transaction value up to INR 7500 and 18% for transaction value exceeding INR 7500. The tax amount based on the prevailing rates will be added to the hotel bill and payable by guests. Hilton Mumbai International Airport is an intimate hotel that blends the grace of a 19th Century summer palace with modern facilities. Just one kilometer from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport, the hotel offers proximity to prime business destinations, including Andheri Jio World Convention Centre, MIDC Industrial Estate, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bombay Convention & Exhibition Centre, MMRDA Ground, and Powai Bombay Exhibition Centre, all within about seven kilometers. The hotel also offers easy shopping destinations like Oberoi Mall and Phoenix Marketcity Mall, both within just 20 minutes. Choose from 171 spacious Guest Rooms, Executive Rooms, and Suites.

108620.description: This elegant city hotel, located near Apollo Bunder, Nariman Point, and Churchgate, offers guests a luxurious experience of true Indian hospitality. Just a short walk from the Gateway of India and Mumbai's vibrant markets, it's ideally situated for exploring the city's shopping, dining, and entertainment scene. The hotel is approximately 2 km from the railway station and 30 km from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport. The beautifully decorated interiors provide a relaxing and comfortable atmosphere. This air-conditioned hotel offers 49 well-furnished rooms, each featuring a TV, minibar, and ensuite bathroom. Guests can also enjoy a range of amenities, including a lobby with a hotel safe and currency exchange facilities, a café serving Indian, Chinese, and continental cuisine, conference facilities, and room and laundry services. A tour and travel assistance desk is available to help guests plan their excursions.

108621.description: The first VITS Mumbai property at Andheri near the Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport Maharashtra, India showcases the VITS concept of luxury business accommodation for discerning business.

108694.address: Adel Hussein Rostom, Ad Doqi A, Ad Doqi, 16
108694.description: Guests appreciate the strategic location of this hotel in Cairo. With a total of 115 rooms on offer, the air-conditioned hotel welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and a parking. The café and restaurant provide dining options, and the conference facilities may be of use to business guests. Laundry service is also available. All of the rooms are adjoined with a private bathroom fitted with a shower and bathtub. Moreover, an array of ultra-modern room amenities such as air conditioning, telephone and satellite TV ensure guests a comfortable stay. The rooms are furnished with double or king-size beds. Further amenities include a radio, safe, minibar and balcony or terrace. The hotel offers a pleasant outdoor swimming pool. In summer guests are sure to have a lot of fun in the pool. A continental breakfast buffet is served.

109171.description: The hotel is a small-budget hotel providing guests with a base for exploring London. The hotel is located near the Golden Green and Brent Cross underground (tube) stations, providing guests with easy access to central London and all its famous tourist attractions. Local attractions include the nearby suburbs of Hampstead Heath and Regent's Park as well as Wembley Stadium. The classic rooms are clean, bright and very cosy. Each room feature tea and coffee making facilities and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. The reception is manned 24 hours and the staff is friendly and always ready to help with any enquiries. For the guests arriving by car, there is a car park available.

name.content: Park South Hotel, part of JdV by Hyatt

109182.description: Amid the bustle of Midtown Manhattan's Flatiron District – tucked behind the classic brick and stone facade of a turn-of-the-century building – this beautifully transformed boutique hotel awaits. This hotel is set in a prime location in the center of New York. Local places of interest include Madison Square Garden, The Morgan Library and Museum and Gramercy Park. Other points of interest include the Empire State Building, and the Flatiron Building.

109289.description: This hotel is located in Alcala de Henares, close to the historical centre. It enjoys close proximity to the metro and the train station. Guests will find themselves in the ideal setting from which to explore this wonderful area. The birthplace of Cervantes can be found just 1 km away. The Archaeological Museum and the Magistral Cathedral can be found within 0. 8 km of the hotel. The bustling city centre is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away, where guests can find a broad choice of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. This wonderful hotel offers tastefully-designed guest rooms. The hotel features a wealth of excellent facilities and services, catering for the needs of every type of traveller.

name.content: Holiday Inn L.I. City Manhattan View ( Closed)

109310.description: The Holiday Inn Manhattan View in Long Island City, Queens, welcomes business and leisure travelers with convenient access to LaGuardia, JFK, and Newark airports. Corporate guests appreciate the hotel's location, ideal for accessing businesses such as JetBlue, MetLife, the United Nations, and Wall Street. Families will also find the hotel's proximity to Manhattan attractions appealing. The hotel provides free high-speed internet access and a multi-lingual staff ready to assist with directions and transportation options. Nearby subway lines include the N, W, 7, E, M, and R. The hotel is located at the intersection of 29th Street and 39th Avenue and will be undergoing cosmetic renovations in early 2020.

109359.description: The holiday hotel, located in Kargicak, just 50 meters from the beach, operates on a winter concept from November 1, 2018, to April 30, 2019, with all-inclusive service available from April 1 to April 30, 2019. Situated 10 km east of Alanya's center, this hotel features 200 rooms, a 24-hour reception, express check-in/out, concierge services, free Wi-Fi, meeting rooms, a restaurant, bar, gym, spa, indoor and outdoor pools (unheated), and sports activities. Car rental and free parking are available, along with facilities for disabled guests. Please note: Several amenities, including the pier, beach access, fitness center, and children's accommodations are unavailable during the winter season due to weather-related damage. The hotel's bar, main restaurant, indoor pool, sauna, spa, and Turkish bath remain open. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

109372.description: Located in East Grinstead and with Hever Castle reachable within 16 km, Elite Venue Selection Felbridge - Gatwick provides concierge services, allergy-free rooms, a garden, free WiFi throughout the property and a bar. Providing a restaurant, the property also has a fitness centre, as well as an indoor pool and a sauna. The accommodation features room service, a 24-hour front desk and currency exchange for guests. At the hotel, each room has a wardrobe and a flat-screen TV. The private bathroom is equipped with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. Guest rooms at Elite Venue Selection Felbridge - Gatwick include air conditioning and a desk.

109423.description: Hotel Senator Vienna is located in Vienna’s Hernals district, offering easy access to the city centre as well as the Wiener Stadthalle. The hotel features 179 modern, air-conditioned rooms, all equipped with a flat-screen TV, refrigerator, kettle, and free Wi-Fi. Guests can start their day with a rich buffet breakfast (available for an additional charge) and relax at the hotel’s bar/lounge. 24-hour front desk. On-site parking is available for an extra fee.

name.content: Vienna House by Wyndham Andel's Berlin

109425.description: This charming hotel is located in eastern Berlin, at less than ten minutes from Alexanderplatz square. This establishment offers urban design, modern lifestyle and perfect meeting options. Guests and locals mingle at the hotel restaurant as they enjoy culinary sensations and a sparkling Berlin skyline. The conference rooms offer a total of 4, 400 m² of space, for more than 500 people. The comfortable rooms are equipped with individually regulated air conditioning, tea and coffee facilities. The bathrooms are spacious, they include a hairdryer and floor heating. The 550 m² urban spa area is a wellness dream come true with bio sauna and steam bath. For guests looking to have a good workout, the gym has all sorts of options available. Relaxation terraces are included.

109510.description: The family-friendly hotel is nestled at the foot of the Acropolis hill, just a few steps away from the Parthenon, the Temple of Zeus, Hadrian Arch and other monuments of Ancient Greek civilisation. Sitting in the very heart of the city's historic centre allow its guests to reach the Constitution Square, the Greek Parliament, Athens stock market and Athens' exclusive shopping areas of Ermou and Kolonaki within a short walk. Guests who want to explore the rest of the city can find the nearest metro station just 400 metres away, while those who are looking for something off the beaten path can visit the nearby Monastiraki flea market. The hotel is housed in a classical building that dates back to 1928 and which has undergone complete renovation in order to turn it into a modern and comfortable establishment.

name.content: Mercure Paris Gare de Lyon Opera Bastille

109575.description: The Lyon Bastille Hotel, a Parisian gem for nearly a century, upholds the finest hospitality traditions with its warm welcome and personalized service. Located in the heart of Paris, near the Opera, Bastille, and Picasso Museum, it offers a quiet, elegant atmosphere. Guests enjoy air conditioning and free Wi-Fi. Well-connected to public transport, the Lyon Bastille Hotel promises an unforgettable Parisian experience.

name.content: The Ritz-Carlton New York, Central Park

109634.description: Indulge in a massage at the full-service spa. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at Contour Lounge, a bistro with a bar/lounge, or order room service (limited hours). Full breakfasts are available daily (6:00 AM to 11:00 AM, for a fee). Amenities include complimentary wired internet, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Make yourself at home in one of the 253 individually decorated guest rooms, each featuring a minibar and an LCD television. Your bed includes down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, while satellite programming provides entertainment. Bathrooms offer separate bathtubs and showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Located near Central Park, Fifth Avenue, and Madison Avenue, The Ritz-Carlton New York, Central Park is a short distance from iconic landmarks like Tiffany & Co. , Carnegie Hall, and Columbus Circle. LaGuardia Airport (LGA) is the preferred airport for the hotel.

109653.description: The hotel is located on a cliff top, approximately 400 metres from Incekum Beach. Restaurants, bars and shops are just a few minutes' walk from the hotel and public transport is available from the main road with links to nearby towns, including the popular resort of Alanya which is approximately 23 km away. Alanya Castle, Damlatas Caves and Manavgat Waterfalls are all around 50 minutes away on public transport, while Antalya airport is approximately 110 km from the hotel. The club resort consists of 3 accommodation blocks containing 153 guest rooms, all in an elevated position with spectacular views over the Mediterranean. Built in 2000, the hotel offers modern accommodation and a range of facilities including a meeting room, shops, a hairdressing salon, a choice of bars, a main restaurant and an à la carte restaurant, a children's playground and a kids' club. Guests are welcomed to the air-conditioned hotel in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and a cloakroom. Further facilities include an auditorium, TV lounge, disco and a car park. Wireless Internet access, room service and a laundry service are also offered for additional fees. The modern rooms are equipped with an en suite bathroom with a bathtub, shower and hairdryer, a double bed and a private balcony or terrace. Other in-room amenities include air conditioning, a minibar (extra fee), satellite TV, a hire safe, direct dial telephone and Internet access.

109654.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include an arcade/game room, a picnic area, and barbecue grills. At Forest Gate Hotel, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary English breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 9:00 AM. Featured amenities include luggage storage and laundry facilities. Make yourself at home in one of the 20 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and microwaves. Flat-screen televisions with pay movies are provided, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Westfield Stratford City - 3. 4 km / 2. 1 mi- Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park - 3.

name.content: Hotel Indigo London Paddington Hyde Park

109693.description: Hotel Indigo® London Paddington is nestled in a leafy part of the Paddington neighbourhood – the perfect location to experience London. Situated just a short stroll from the Heathrow Express, Paddington train and tube stations, Hotel Indigo Paddington is ideally located for you to enjoy world-famous Hyde Park, canal rides and buzzing bars at Little Venice and the shops of Oxford Street. Explore the grandeur of elegant Georgian townhouses, cobbled streets, and the surrounding quaint street cafes, and then step inside to modern interiors, boutique bedrooms and inspirational artwork. Enjoy sensational Italian cuisine in our Bella Italia restaurant or choose to escape the hustle by relaxing with a drink on our private garden terrace - we’re ready to welcome you.

109733.description: A fantastic location in the heart of London. Best Western Buckingham Palace Road Hotel occupies a prime spot close to the capital’s top attractions. Buckingham Palace, the Houses of Parliament, London Eye, Hyde Park and West End theatres are all within walking distance, so there’s plenty to tick off your must-do list!Whether you’re in London for a business meeting, stopover or sightseeing trip, our handy base will make your stay a comfortable one, with rooms at prices to fit your budget. Look forward to a restful night’s sleep in our cosy beds, and enjoy home comforts including a hairdryer, TV, central heating, direct dial telephone, hospitality tray and modern bathroom. All our stylish rooms are decorated in subtle tones with contemporary furniture and tasteful artwork. Wi-Fi is also available.

109734.description: An attractive hotel in West London, The Best Western Chiswick Palace & Suites is conveniently located on Chiswick High Road, just half an hour away from Central London and Heathrow Airport. If you want to enjoy all the capital has to offer - or even jet off and see the world - this hotel is just the place to stay. Set in a beautiful and trendy suburb of West London, the Best Western Chiswick Palace & Suites is also close to Kew Gardens. You'll have the best of both worlds - close to the bright lights of London's shopping and nightlife, yet well away from the hustle and bustle when you return to the hotel and its tree-lined setting. London Underground stations are also just a short walk away to give you full access to the whole city, day and night. For the sports fans amongst our guests, we're just a drop kick away from Twickenham, while Wembley is also nearby for sporting and all kind of other events. If you're not interested in sport, try the regular music and comedy gigs at the nearby Hammersmith Eventim Apollo. If you're looking for an exceptional hotel in Hammersmith from which you can explore the capital, look no further than the Best Western Chiswick Palace & Suites.

109813.description: Nestled in the vibrant Palermo Soho district, this hotel is surrounded by a plethora of art galleries, boutiques, cafes, bars, and restaurants. Major attractions like La Boca, San Telmo, and Plaza de Mayo are easily accessible, as are the city's main football stadiums. Conveniently located near subway lines, the train station, and Palermo's Zoo and Botanical Gardens, the hotel offers guests easy access to explore the city. For added convenience, a bus station is located 3. 5 km away, and El Rosedal Park is a short 10-minute drive. Opened in 2008, this air-conditioned hotel features 20 well-appointed rooms, a 24-hour reception desk, and safe deposit boxes. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a wardrobe, elevator, TV room, coffee shop, bar, and Wi-Fi. Laundry service is available for an additional fee. Each room is equipped with a queen or two twin beds, cable TV, DVD player, desk, Wi-Fi, minibar, individually controlled air conditioning, electric kettle, hairdryer, and laptop safe. En suite bathrooms include a shower, direct-dial telephone, and tea and coffee making facilities. Individually controlled heating ensures a comfortable stay.

109940.description: Lying in the heart of the city, this pet-friendly Setúbal (Portugal) hotel is the perfect location for a holiday or a business trip. Those on a leisure visit will find this establishment the ideal starting point for discovering all the natural wonders of the region, as well as its historical and cultural heritage, such as the local Convent with its small harbour, and numerous forts and castles. Others might prefer a boat trip and a bit of dolphin-spotting or just lazing around on the white sandy beaches in the beautiful bay. The double, twin and family rooms on these wheelchair-friendly premises (there are rooms for the disabled), are equipped with air-conditioning, satellite TV, telephone and complete en-suite bathroom. Guests can order drinks and light meals at the on-site bar and the hotel has an agreement with a local restaurant (3 min. away) for meals.

109975.description: Nestled on the Lycian Way, just 5 kilometers from the ancient city of Phaselis, Hotel Berke Ranch & Nature offers stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea and the majestic Tahtali Mountain with its volcanic Twin Peaks. Spread across 18, 000 square meters, this eco-friendly boutique hotel and horse ranch provides a tranquil escape surrounded by fragrant pine forests. Guests can enjoy a variety of activities, including horseback riding on the beach or in the mountains, swimming in the outdoor pool beneath swaying palm trees, and exploring the natural beauty of the region. Choose from a range of standard rooms, suites, and villas, all designed for a comfortable stay. The hotel also features a private beach in Çamyuva, various sports courts (volleyball, mini-football, tennis, and basketball), and a kids' club with engaging activities such as horseback riding and visits to an organic farm. Located 50 km from Antalya and 6 km from Kemer, Hotel Berke Ranch welcomes pets and offers riding lessons for all levels.

109976.description:
Kemer Holiday Club

With its unique architecture and exceptional beachfront location, Kemer Holiday Club is a truly special holiday village nestled within pine forests where the foothills of the Taurus Mountains meet the Mediterranean Sea. Built as a modern adaptation of traditional Anatolian “Türk Evi” architecture, the property stretches across 42, 799 m² of natural beauty. 
Our resort, which provides the ideal environment especially for families with children, holds several prestigious certifications: Quality Assurance System, Food Safety System, Blue Flag for clean sea and beach, Sustainable Tourism, and Bike-Friendly Facility certifications. Kemer Holiday Club has also been nominated for the Aga Khan Award for Architecture and has been honored with the “Most Beautiful Garden Award” by Antalya Metropolitan Municipality.

109993.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an indoor pool, and a spa tub. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the complimentary area shuttle that operates within 100 meters. Grab a bite at Cookbook, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service.

110025.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an indoor pool, a spa tub, and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Alesta Restaurant, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. This hotel has 4 meeting rooms available for events. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 181 air-conditioned guestrooms.

110026.description: This hotel offers excellent access to enter and exit the city. It has a unique appearance and readiness to satisfy the wants and needs of every guest, so they can appreciate the magic of Oporto, its historical patrimony, cultural dynamics, business, architecture, gastronomy, excellent wines and lively nights. This business hotel is ideal for those who seek new experiences. In addition to a lobby area with 24-hour reception, currency exchange and lift access, further facilities include a bar, TV lounge, a laundry service, free wireless Internet access and a coffee area open 24 hours a day.

110036.address: Ascott Place, Sheikh Zayed Road, Po Box 117452
110036.description: Ascott Park Place Dubai is centrally located on Sheikh Zayed Road, opposite the Dubai International Convention and Exhibition Centre and the Dubai International Financial Centre. The Dubai Trade Center Metro Station, exclusive restaurants, and shops are within walking distance. The property offers excellent views of the Arabian Sea or Sheikh Zayed Road. Facilities include a temperature-controlled 40-meter outdoor swimming pool, a fitness center with state-of-the-art Precor equipment, a sauna, steam room, two restaurants, a bar, 24-hour front desk, on-site parking, and accessible public facilities. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the non-smoking property. Services include laundry, dry cleaning, 24-hour business services, full housekeeping, grocery delivery, and a concierge desk. The property features 133 fully serviced apartments, ranging from 82 to 221 square meters. Apartments are soundproofed with high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing views of the Arabian Sea or Sheikh Zayed Road. Amenities include a dining table, a fully equipped kitchen with an oven, full-size refrigerator, microwave, dishwasher, cookware, and dishware. Guests also enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and L'Occitane bath amenities, plus a rainforest showerhead.

110046.description: The Ascot Lodging is just 1. 9 mi from Terminal 2 of Milano Malpensa Airport. The property is just out of the flight paths, and is surrounded by woodland. It offers free Wi-Fi in the rooms. All rooms at the Ascot are large, and feature a satellite TV. Some of the rooms are complete with fitness equipment. A free shuttle to the surrounding restaurants is also provided. The Rho Fiera Milano exhibition center is located within 22 mi of the Ascot Lodging.

110133.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an outdoor pool, and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). If you'd like to spend the day shopping, you can hop on the complimentary shuttle. Grab a bite at Tobagos, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge and an ocean view.
