You can also stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Cape Town? This hotel has 2303 square feet (214 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 4 meeting rooms.

110239.address: Corniche Street, Al Shatie District, Jeddah 21453, 21572
110239.description: Situated on Jeddah's Corniche, just 20 minutes from the airport, the Rosewood Corniche Hotel offers a luxurious experience. Enjoy a USD 50 hotel credit per paid night for spa treatments, dining, and other incidentals for stays through December 19, 2020. This offer is not applicable to group or corporate rates but can be combined with Elite amenities. Note that if your package already includes a hotel credit, only the higher credit will apply. This ultra-luxury hotel flawlessly blends cutting-edge technology with spectacular design and unparalleled sophistication. Catering to both business and leisure travelers, the hotel redefines elegance, luxury, and personalized service. Its prime location in the fashionable northern corner of Jeddah's Corniche provides easy access to key business and diplomatic districts, as well as designer shopping. Each of the 127 rooms and suites boasts stunning Red Sea views and dedicated Rosewood butler service. A unique feature is the dedicated ladies' floor, offering a more private residential stay for female travelers. Rejuvenate your body and spirit at the rooftop health and fitness area. Relax by the outdoor pool or work out in the scenic gym with the assistance of personal fitness instructors.

110261.description: This apartment complex is situated just a few steps away from the Sagrada Familia building, in Barcelona. Surrounded by culture, art and history, this complex is perfect for travellers who are eager to explore. The city's many captivating attractions can be found just a short distance away. Nearby links to the public transport network offer visitors ease of access to other areas of the city. This complex comprises elegantly-styled apartments, which are conveniently appointed. The apartments are stylish and modern, offering up-to-date amenities to ensure a relaxing stay. Guests will appreciate the Wi-Fi access that this complex has to offer, which allows them to stay in touch with work or home while away.

110262.description: These apartments are located in the heart of Barcelona in the Raval quarter, which is next to the famous Ramblas. The location is very convenient for travelling around the city and visiting the main tourist areas, many of which can be reached on foot. Barcelona International Airport is 14 km from the apartment hotel. This 5-storey building comprises a total of 10 apartments with 2 double bedrooms each. All apartments feature wooden furniture and gorgeous tapestries creating a unique combination of contemporary style and traditional décor. All units are provided with a kitchen equipped with everything down to the smallest utensil. All living rooms have parquet flooring and plenty of light, being situated close to the little balcony. Entertainment is provided through a radio with a hi-fi CD player, a colour TV and DVDs which are available on request. High speed free WIFI included

110284.description: Located in the heart of Paris, the 4-star Grand Hotel Saint Michel is a 10-minute walk from the Luxembourg Gardens and the Panthéon. This Art Deco hotel offers 47 guestrooms with minibars, flat-screen televisions, and Select Comfort beds with premium bedding. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, a spa with massages and facials, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can enjoy room service (limited hours), a bar/lounge, and daily buffet breakfast (fee applies). The hotel also features a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers, dry cleaning/laundry services, and meeting/conference space. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge). Nearby attractions include Sainte-Chapelle (0. 9 km) and Notre-Dame (1. 7 km).

110319.description: This luxurious aparthotel offers sleek and spacious studios in the central Recoleta area of Buenos Aires. The hotel is surrounded by numerous lush, green parks and plazas, and the renowned Recoleta Cemetery is just down the street while the National Museum of Fine Arts is a ten-minute walk away. The neighbourhood also boasts a variety of prestigious restaurants and designer boutique shops. The hotel's studio apartments feature a contemporary design with air-conditioning, full-sized private bathrooms and handy kitchenettes where guests can prepare and enjoy meals and snacks. After a busy day of meetings or sightseeing, guests might go for a refreshing swim in the pool, unwind with a workout in the fitness centre, and make use of wireless internet access in the lobby. Whether travelling for business or leisure, this hotel's comfortable apartments and excellent location make it an ideal choice.

110375.description: Thank you for choosing our Ramada by Wyndham Madrid Getafe hotel. Ramada is a global upper-midscale hotel brand with over 820 properties located in over 50 countries worldwide. Most Ramada hotels feature free wired and wireless high-speed internet access meeting rooms business services fitness facilities and upgraded bath amenities. Many properties have an on-site restaurantlounge while other sites offer a complimentary continental breakfast. You do your thing leave the rest to us.

110384.description: This informal hotel is located very close to Madrid-Barajas International Airport, just 5 minutes from T1, 7 from T2 and 15 from T4. It provides specialized services for travelers transiting between 2 flights or starting a leisure flight. It offers a shuttle service, subject to charges, that operates 24 hours a day between the airport and the hotel, free parking during your stay and paid parking for long stays while you enjoy your vacation. This property offers a selection of spacious double, triple and quadruple family rooms, equipped with all the services and amenities necessary to ensure a truly comfortable stay. The hotel is located just 15 minutes by car from the city of Madrid and there are frequent public transport connections right on the hotel's doorstep. The IFEMA congress center is less than 7 kilometers away. A continental buffet breakfast is served between 07:00 and 11:00, while lunch and dinner can be enjoyed in a grill restaurant located right next door. There is external room service and a vending machine section available. We have 3 pet cats so your pet will be welcome subject to an additional charge. Our team will always be at your disposal offering personalized information, help and solutions to get you to the airport on time.

110386.description: Our exclusive Ramblas Hotel will provide you with excellent services during your stay and all the tourist information you may need. In addition, it is located in one of the most interesting areas in terms of gastronomy and nightlife. At the Ramblas Hotel you can always keep in touch with our free Internet connectionAnd you can enjoy great moments in our bar-cafeteria with a modernist design that you will love. Rest in our rooms with top quality services. The rooms at the Ramblas Hotel Barcelona are equipped with free Wi-Fi, a desk, a TV, a wardrobe, air conditioning and a complete bathroom.

110433.description:
The hotel offers a quiet and privileged location in the heart of Paris's Golden Triangle, and offers its guests the pleasure to discover luxury and department stores, art galleries, museums, famous restaurants and shows. The Champs Elysees is just 100 metres away, while the Eiffel Tower is about a 20-minute walk from the hotel. The nearest metro station is 200 metres away. Paris-Charles de Gaulle Airport is about 30 km from the hotel and Paris-Orly Airport is around 20 km away.

This family-friendly city hotel offers 40 rooms including 6 suites. It has a lobby and 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, lift access, a breakfast room and a games room. Guests can relax in the hotel café or bar. Conference facilities and Internet access are also available.

Rooms offer double glazing, en suite bathroom with bath or shower, hairdryer, direct dial telephone, automatic alarm clock, minibar and satellite TV. Rooms have double or king-size beds, a balcony or terrace and individually regulated heating.

Breakfast is served daily in the form of a continental buffet.

110441.address: Manuel Carromeu, Vale da Abrunheira-Aguas de Moura
110441.description: This 3-star property provides free parking, spacious accommodation and a variety of facilities, just a few minute's walk away from Sado Beaches. It is located in the wine-growing region of Palmela. Aldeamento Turístico de Palmela consists of group of apartment buildings built around swimming pools and a centrally located restaurant. The fully-equipped apartments with a separate lounge and balcony with views. Continental breakfast is included in the room rate. There are 2 swimming pools, 2 tennis courts, a children's playground, a soccer field and bicycle circuit. The reception is available 24/7 and offers personalised service. Aldeamento's Restaurant Aromas includes a terrace that opens to panoramic views. Guests can enjoy rich breakfast and lunch buffet and an à la carte menu for dinner. For drinks, there is a spilt-level bar. Aldeamento Turístico is situated close to the historic streets of Palmela. Guests can also visit the nearby museums, monuments, and a medieval castle.

110536.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center (free) or indoor golf (surcharge). Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Round off your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is served daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 179 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerator, in-room tablet and smart TV. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers.

110543.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace at Hôtel Jardin le Bréa, located in the heart of Paris. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. A bar/lounge and buffet breakfast (available for a fee) are also offered. The hotel's 23 guestrooms feature LED televisions, pillowtop beds, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. You'll be within a 15-minute walk of Luxembourg Gardens and Montparnasse Tower, and close to attractions like Le Bon Marche and the Paris Catacombs.

110556.description: Enjoy a wealth of amenities at this hotel, including an indoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, and take advantage of concierge services and babysitting (surcharge). The St. Regis Restaurant offers international cuisine for lunch and dinner, complemented by a coffee shop/cafe and 24-hour room service. Unwind at the bar/lounge with your favorite drink. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (for a fee). Business travelers will appreciate the business center and limo/town car service. Complimentary newspapers are provided in the lobby, and self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Each of the 180 guestrooms provides a comfortable retreat, featuring a minibar, LED television with satellite programming and a DVD player, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Your Select Comfort bed with premium bedding ensures a restful night's sleep. Bathrooms include separate bathtubs and showers with rainfall showerheads, and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Plaza San Martin, Florida Street, and Galerias Pacifico, with easy access to various attractions in Buenos Aires.

110557.description: Housed in an exquisite Victorian building dating back to 1859, this traditionally decorated hotel offers a prime location in Victoria, London. Just a ten-minute walk from public transport, it provides easy access to iconic attractions like Buckingham Palace and the Houses of Parliament. Fully renovated to the highest standards of comfort, the hotel caters to both leisure and business travelers with its impeccable service and convenient access to historic sites and shopping.

110593.description:
PREMIER SUITES Edinburgh Fountain Court boasts a prime location in Edinburgh’s West End, near Haymarket and the Financial District. Everything you need is right on your doorstep, and only a twenty-minute walk to Princes Street, where you will find all the best retail, hospitality, and cultural experiences. 

We have created a home away from home experience. We provide you with everything you need to make you feel at home and enjoy an easy, stress-free and comfortable stay. 

All apartments include one or two-bedroom units and all come with a fully fitted kitchen, living room, bedroom and ensuite bathroom. Each of the fully equipped kitchens includes a combi-oven, microwave, hob, fridge with icebox, laundry facilities and coffee machine. Our serviced apartments also include a contemporary living area with a flat-screen TV. 

Whether you are traveling for business or pleasure our serviced apartments cater for everyone’s needs.

110619.description: Enjoy garden views at Blue Bells Hotel in London City Centre, and take advantage of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM. Luggage storage and a safe deposit box are available at the front desk. The hotel offers 25 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions with digital programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences such as desks, coffee/tea makers, and irons/ironing boards (upon request) are also provided. A short walk from Portobello Road Market and Kensington Gardens, the hotel is also conveniently located near Kensington Palace and Kensington High Street.

110620.description: Conveniently close to central London, Chelsea House Hotel offers good-value accommodations, 5 minutes’ walk from Earl's Court Underground Station and 2 miles from Victoria Train Station. A Victorian listed building, Chelsea House Hotel provides comfortable rooms, all with en suite private bathrooms and a TV. Guests can also make use of tea and coffee-making facilities. A continental breakfast buffet is served in the morning, and there is free Wi-Fi internet access in public areas of the building. Earl's Court Exhibition Center and Stamford Bridge, home of Chelsea Football Club, can both be reached in 15 minutes’ walk or less. Numerous pubs and restaurants are also nearby.

110621.description:
With a stay at Acacia Hostel in London (London City Centre), you'll be steps from Natural History Museum and 6 minutes by foot from Victoria and Albert Museum.  This hostel is 0.4 mi (0.7 km) from Imperial College London and 0.5 mi (0.8 km) from Kensington High Street.
Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a reception hall.
Featured amenities include luggage storage and microwave in a common area. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge.
A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM.
Make yourself at home in one of the 20 guestrooms featuring refrigerators. Prepare your meals in the shared/communal kitchen. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers. Housekeeping is provided daily, and irons/ironing boards can be requested.

110733.description: This hotel is located on the edge of Barcelona, a 2-minute walk from the City of Justice and a 5-minute drive from the Barcelona FC''s Camp Nou Stadium. The new facilities of Fira de Barcelona in L'Hospitalet and the Gran Via 2 shopping arcade are both in the vicinity of the venue and there are a number of important business and commercial areas within a short drive. Both an underground station and railway station are within a 10-minute walk and through them the city centre is just a 20-minute commute. This city business establishment is housed in a 5-storey modern building that consists of 46 well-appointed rooms. All of them have stylish décor with grey tones and bright finishes, and are equipped with ample work area with a writing desk and table lamp, as well as flat-screen satellite TV and free Wi-Fi. Business travellers will have the convenience of 2 modern meeting rooms.

110734.description: Opened in 2009, the exclusive hotel Mardan Palace sets the tone for top-class luxury accommodation on the Turkish Riviera. It is located on a private beach in the renowned destination of Lara, just a short drive away from the centre of Antalya and the international airport. Playground of the rich, famous and powerful, the hotel boasts an impressive architecture and interior design in the style of an ancient palace, conjuring up the opulence of days past. The elegant rooms have views over the Taurus Mountains, the Da Vinci Bridge spanning the spectacularly landscaped, largest pool of the Mediterranean or partial sea views and are equipped with Hermès toiletries. For added convenience, features of the hotel include a 24-hour butler service, an eclectic selection of gourmet restaurants and bars, unrivalled spa and sports facilities as well as unparalleled service. Simply the perfect place for guests demanding nothing less than ultimate luxury.

110738.description: A stay at the Golden Tulip Hotel Washington Opera places you in the heart of Paris, within a 15-minute walk of the Palais Garnier and the Louvre Museum. This 4-star hotel is 0. 4 miles (0. 7 km) from Place Vendôme and 1. 2 miles (1. 9 km) from the Champs-Élysées. Enjoy views from the terrace and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. Make yourself at home in one of the 36 guest rooms featuring minibars and espresso makers. 70-cm plasma televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours).

110739.description: The Paris-Evry extended stay hotel is at heart of Genopole 'genetics valley', across from the University complex. It is located in the town center, close to the train station, a shopping center, and a few kilometers away from Orly airport. With its balanced and bold architecture, the residence blends in harmoniously with its downtown neighborhood. The residence has shops on the ground floor and a private garden, a doorman and a secure environment.

110740.description: The family-friendly guesthouse is only a short drive away from important centres and towns, but is nestled in surroundings of rural, natural beauty, allowing for a truly unique holiday experience. Access to public transport is around 1 km away and Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is some 15 km away. This beautiful and charming hotel is harmoniously integrated into the surrounding natural landscape, offering comfortable, modern accommodation off the beaten track. With 7 rooms in a magnificent rustic house dating from the 18th century, which was renovated in 2010, guests at the hotel are assured a variety of services at very high standards of friendliness and quality. The hotel comprises a lobby, games room, TV lounge and breakfast and dining rooms. Guests may use the WLAN Internet access for an additional fee. A laundry service is also provided, and those arriving by car may take advantage of the car park free. Guests may hire bicycles on site. The rooms are equipped with an en suite bathroom with a shower and bathtub. Further in-room amenities include a TV set, Internet access, minibar and central heating. The hotel offers an outdoor swimming pool. There is a golf course some 15 km away. The hotel features a rustic room where a breakfast buffet is served, as well as dinner in the evening, offering a quiet place away from stress. On the A28/IC1 take the Famalicão/Guimarães exit and after 50 m leave the motorway to Touguinhó/Beiriz. At the roundabout continue straight on to Touguinhó/Beiriz. At the next roundabout follow the exit to Rio Mau. After passing by Rio Mau, turn right onto Arcos/Turismo Rural and drive for 1. 5 km. From the A3 take the Famalicão/A7 exit, continue on the A7 for roughly 15 km and exit at Rio Mau/Junqueira. At the roundabout turn right to Rio Mau and drive for 3 km. After passing Rio Mau, turn right to Arcos/Turismo Rural and drive 1. 5 km.

110773.description: Smartly designed Watford Junction hotel with inclusive breakfast and easy access to London. Holiday Inn Express® London - Watford Junction hotel is just steps from Watford Junction train station. Trains reach London's Euston Station in about 20 minutes, and only 15 minutes by train to reach Wembley Stadium. Heathrow Airport (LHR) is a 45-minute drive. Central Watford shopping and dining are a short walk away. A shuttle from Watford Junction bus station carries Harry Potter fans young and old to the Warner Bros. Studio Tour. Walk 10 minutes to the Atria Watford shopping centre, or take a breezy stroll along the Grand Union Canal. Two well-equipped, naturally lit meeting rooms make it easy to organise small seminars. Catering options range from fresh coffee and biscuits to a hot lunch. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free Wi-Fi- Express Start™ Breakfast included in the room rate- All Day Dining- Competitive car parking ratesSpacious, streamlined Next Generation rooms offer comfortable bedding, plus thoughtful touches like blackout curtains, bedside USBs and Smart TVs. Double rooms with sofa beds are perfect for families. Start the day with a hearty breakfast, including scrambled eggs, bacon, sausage and beans, and end it with a drink in the bar. A tasty dinner awaits you in the open-plan Great Room lobby.

110798.description:
This charming guesthouse is situated just a few kilometres outside Marrakech, on Fès Road next to the palm grove. Menara Airport (Marrakech) is approximately 15 km from the family-friendly spa complex.

The hotel is a building which combines the charm of a traditional Riad and the charm of a villa amidst nature. Away from the glares of the streets, guests enter this property through an alley covered by a pergola, under a cascade of bougainvilleas, leading them to the entrance. At first sight, the architecture is the same as that of a kasbah, but as guests enter into this haven of peace, they are really entering the medina, but with the advantage of fresh air and open space. Opening out onto a beautiful patio full of orange trees, the Riad is faithful to its traditional structure where all the rooms face towards the fountain, the house's central point. The hotel offers an airport transfer service, babysitting service, a bar, beauty salon/hairdresser, a concierge service, conference facilities and an on-call doctor. With just 4 rooms in total, this intimate air-conditioned guesthouse also offers guests a lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom, Wifi Internet access, a laundry service, library, car park and garage and a restaurant. There is also a games room, children's playground and bicycle hire service (fees apply).

The rooms are comfortably equipped with cable TV, a hairdryer, tea and coffee making facilities and minibar. Non-smokers can request special non-smoking rooms. Each room features an en suite bathroom with shower and bathtub, a double or king-size bed, radio, Internet access, an in-room safe, washing machine, ironing set and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. Guests may also relax on their private balcony or terrace.

110800.address: 113/114 DERB EL ARSA - PLACE Sidi Ayoub Medina, 113/114
110800.description: Riad Sidi Ayoub Located in the heart of Marrakech's Medina and a 10-minute walk from Jamaâ El Fna Square. Riad Sidi Ayoub features a plunge pool and free Wi-Fi. Its roof terrace enjoys panoramic views of the city and the mountains. Featuring personalized decoration in a Moroccan style, all spacious rooms have air conditioning and open onto the riad's courtyard, some of which have a fireplace. Breakfast will be served on the terrace of the riad courtyard or in your room. Guests can enjoy traditional Moroccan dishes and mint tea in the dining room or on the patio. Offering airport shuttle and car rental services, Riad Sidi Ayoub can also organize excursions. Sidi Ayoub Square is 50 meters away.

110801.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at this charming Paris hotel. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge and start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies). The hotel also provides wired internet access, a computer station, and complimentary newspapers. Airport transfers are available (surcharge applies). Each of the 32 individually decorated guestrooms features a refrigerator, minibar (with complimentary items), satellite TV, and a private bathroom with a deep soaking bathtub and complimentary toiletries. Safes and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is daily. Located in the 5th Arrondissement, Hôtel Elysa - Luxembourg is a short walk from Luxembourg Gardens and the Panthéon. Notre Dame is 1. 2 miles away, and the Louvre Museum is 1. 4 miles away. The nearest airports are Orly (ORY) and Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

110802.description: This enchanting establishment features a privileged situation in the heart of one of the most stylish quarters of Paris. Guests will find themselves a short distance from some of the world-renowned tourist attractions in the area, including Champ de Mars Park, the popular Luxembourg Gardens, Monceau Park and Champs Elysees Boulevard. Tastefully decorated and finely furnished, the different guest rooms of this property have been designed to provide both maximum comfort and style. They all come with a classic décor with sepia tones, floral patterns and light woods, creating a welcoming atmosphere where to completely relax. There's also the option to stay in a spacious apartment if you want more privacy. This establishment also offers a cosy café ideal to meet with friends or colleagues and enjoy a delicious drink.

110817.description:
From the moment you arrive, Quartier Libre Opéra envelops you in an atmosphere of absolute privilege and serenity. Designed for discerning travelers, this 5-star aparthotel redefines luxury hospitality: here, you don’t just stay in Paris—you live a bespoke experience where the ultimate privacy of a prestigious apartment meets the excellence of highly personalized service. 

Every moment is curated with your well-being in mind. After immersing yourself in the vibrant energy of the nearby Opéra Garnier or the iconic Grands Magasins, you return to a sun-drenched sanctuary of calm, boasting contemporary design and haute-couture comfort. Whether you are traveling for business or leisure, the guest experience is elevated to an art form: the feeling of being instantly at home, with the absolute freedom to experience the capital at your own pace, all while surrounded by exceptional 5-star standards. A truly memorable, chic, and uniquely Parisian escape.

110853.description: Take a chance and experience the unique and charming spirit of Vienna at Lucia Hotel. Home and a friendly environment together with the modern spirit of our capital city create a unique blend that will leave you with unforgettable memories. Once you enter one of our comfortable rooms or apartments, you will feel the warmth of hearth and home, as we cordially invite you to experience high three-star-hotel service in close proximity to Schönbrunn Palace and the very heart of the city, both easily accessible due to nearby access to public transportation. Whether you are travelling on business or for leisure, alone or accompanied by colleagues, family or friends, our hotel staff is prepared to meet your daily needs and desires in a timely manner. All of our services are waiting for you to feel welcome and at-home, so you will be sure to return and stay with us again.

111000.description: This cozy hotel, nestled in a quiet neighborhood just off Leith Walk and opposite a large park, retains many original period features across its three floors. Waverley Station and the city center are within a 15-minute walk, while Edinburgh Castle, Calton Hill, and the Zoo are easily accessible by public transport. The airport is approximately 25 km away. It's an ideal base for exploring Edinburgh's attractions and activities.

111013.description: Situated in the central commercial district of Belapur, this hotel offers guests spectacular views of the surrounding landscape from its outstanding location. CBD Belapur station is about 1 km away and DY Patil Stadium is roughly 3. 5 km away. This city hotel provides a contemporary and elegant setting featuring Indian-style décor combined with modern elements and sets international standards of hospitality and comfort both for business and leisure travellers.

111068.description: Located in Amsterdam's City Centre, ITC Hotel is a short walk from Rembrandt Square and the vibrant Flower Market. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV in guestrooms, and convenient amenities such as luggage storage and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include the Rijksmuseum (1. 1 km) and the Heineken Experience (0. 9 km).

111114.description: Guests will find the airport within 14 km. There are a total of 21 accomodation units at Ishakpasa Konagi . Everyone staying at this accommodation may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Ishakpasa Konagi . The reception is open 24/7. Some services of Ishakpasa Konagi may be payable.

111143.description: Overlooking the famed Kefalari Park and Kefalari Square, this hotel offers convenient access to all the major business, entertainment, and cultural attractions in this exclusive Athenian suburb. Characterized by elegant simplicity and old-world charm, the neoclassical architecture and decor create an atmosphere of grandeur and beauty. Guests can start their day in the tranquil pool area, home to the hotel's private health club and sauna, complete with state-of-the-art equipment and experienced staff to ensure total relaxation and rejuvenation. A tennis court and fitness center provide additional recreational options. The hotel's excellent restaurant offers delicious Greek and Italian specialties, carefully prepared by master chefs. Guests can also relax in the brand-new spa, featuring an indoor heated swimming pool, sauna, hot tub, and hammam, open daily from 2 pm to 9 pm for an additional fee of €25 per person per day (available for adults and children over 16).

111151.description:
This hotel is located in the university center, near the main access to the city of Oporto. This Oporto hotel has a privileged location and accessibility, close to the metro, and only 3 km from the UNESCO World Heritage city centre of Oporto. The Douro River and the historical city centre, with its businesses, churches, monuments and museums, is a few minutes from the hotel. Guests will find a range of restaurants, bars, shops and clubs just a 5-minute drive from the hotel and S. João bus station is just a 5-minute walk away. 

Spa Information:
Access is not allowed for children under 5 years old, until 16 years old, access is only allowed during specific hours and they must always be accompanied by an adult.

111158.description: Welcome to the Garner Hotel Berlin - Gendarmenmarkt. Whether you're planning a city break or a team event, our centrally located hotel in Berlin-Mitte offers excellent transport links, charm, and exceptional service. Explore nearby sightseeing hotspots and event venues. Start your day in our breakfast restaurant with a rich buffet featuring hot and cold dishes, from pastries and cereals to sausages, cheeses, bacon, and baked beans. In the evening, unwind in our lobby bar with freshly tapped beer, fine wines, and delicious longdrinks. We welcome individuals and groups. Our 134 modern rooms across five categories offer flat-screen TVs, adjustable air conditioning, and soundproof windows for a restful stay. Business travelers will appreciate the free high-speed WiFi, in-room workstations, and safes for laptops and tablets.

111173.description: This charming city hotel is ideally located within walking distance of several historical attractions. Built in 2008, the hotel offers 19 elegantly designed rooms across six floors. Guests enjoy amenities such as air conditioning, a lobby with 24-hour reception, a safe, currency exchange, and cloakroom. The hotel features a bar, restaurant, and terrace, along with Wi-Fi access. Room and laundry services are available for a fee, and on-site parking is provided. All rooms include an en suite bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, air conditioning, a minibar, LCD TV, and Wi-Fi access. Breakfast is served buffet-style or as a fixed menu, while dinner is available à la carte.

111174.description: Located in Barcelona's central Eixample district on Villarroel Street, these apartments are a 15-minute walk from Paseo de Gracia and conveniently close to the Hospital Clínic metro station. Barcelona Sants AVE train station is also within a 15-minute walk or a short metro ride. The fifteen modern apartments, accommodating four to five guests, offer free Wi-Fi throughout. Choose from deluxe and executive two-bedroom apartments, each featuring a living-dining area with a sofa, flat-screen TV, a private bathroom, and a well-equipped kitchen. For stays of six nights or more, a general cleaning is included, though guests are kindly requested to leave the kitchen tidy on their departure day. A maximum of two apartments can be booked per reservation. Three or more apartments are considered a group booking and are subject to different cancellation policies. A €350 security deposit is required upon arrival to cover potential damages. Check-in and key collection take place at Calle Muntaner 60, between 10:00 AM and 1:00 AM. Apartment access begins at 3:00 PM.

111215.description: The Star Champs-Elysées hotel is a magnificent peaceful and quiet haven completely renovated in 2023 less than 500m from the Arc de Triomphe. Enjoy one of its 59 air-conditioned rooms and suites, and its various à la carte services including its superb swimming pool. The multilingual staff will be at your disposal 7 days a week and 24 hours a day to answer all your requests. Parisian chic in every detail. Whether it’s a business trip, a romantic or a family getaway, the Star Champs-Elysées Hotel is the ideal choice for travellers looking for an unforgettable experience. The Star Champs-Elysées hotel has an exceptional location, allowing you to reach via the Charles de Gaulle-Etoile Station the business district of La Défense, the Louvre Museum but also Disneyland. It is also located a few steps from the Avenue des Champs-Elysées and the Palais de Congrès. Hotel is fully non smoking. Free Wi-Fi accessParking (nearby with charges).

111218.description: Enjoy a central Edinburgh stay at Fraser Suites, a Victorian aparthotel just steps from St. Giles' Cathedral and a short walk from Princes Street Gardens. This eco-certified aparthotel offers 75 individually furnished guestrooms with kitchenettes (refrigerator and microwave included), LCD TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a continental breakfast (fee applies), and take advantage of the 24-hour fitness center, concierge services, and fireplace in the lobby. Additional amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

111228.description: Enjoy a central Madrid stay at Hotel Madrisol, steps from Puerta del Sol and Plaza de Santa Ana. This hostal offers 37 air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with bathtubs and hair dryers. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast served from 8:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, a safe deposit box, and a café. Gran Via and Plaza Mayor are within easy walking distance.

111237.description: The Twelve hotel is a 3 star hotel in the center of the 12th arrondissement of Paris, just a few minutes walk from the Place de la Nation. Charming hotel with a family atmosphere, Twelve hotel enjoys an exceptional location to reach the center of Paris in a few minutes by Metro Line 1.

111276.description: Special Protection, our commitment to ensuring a safe stay with strict cleaning and sanitization protocols. Technologies to support the interaction with the staff to promote social distancing. Healthcare insurance throughout the stay in partnership with AXA Partners. The Best Western Hotel Goldenmile Milan is located in a strategic position, especially for business travelers, just off Milan's Tangenziale Ovest and the major motorways, near the Rho-Pero trade fair complex and just a few kilometers from Milan's airports. The focal point of the Best Western Hotel Goldenmile Milan is the lobby area, equipped with comfy armchairs and a spacious plasma video screen. A concept attentive to design and modernity characterizes interiors done in natural materials and warm, inviting colors. At your complete disposal is a large relaxation area with an open bar offering free snacks and beverages throughout the day. The Best Western Hotel Goldenmile Milan offers 150 rooms with exclusive design. All rooms are equipped with every convenience to satisfy the needs of guests used to travelling, in an informal, pleasant environment. Eight rooms are accessible and equipped for our physically challenged guests. The original show kitchen guarantees rapid, efficient restaurant service with its exclusive 'counter' formula. Inside a large ring-shaped counter is an open kitchen where the chefs prepare the food. The dishes are based on recipes out of the Mediterranean tradition prepared using quality local ingredients. A hotel so attentive to its guests' needs could not fail to have a wellness area, ideal for moments of pure relaxation or a pleasant break from work. A large exercise tub is available with hydro massage, Turkish bath with chromo therapy, tropical shower with cold mist and relaxation zone. The fitness area features the latest equipment from Techno gym. Five meeting rooms able to host up to a maximum of 180 people.

111287.description: This city hotel is situated in the centre of Paris. It is just a 5-minute walk from the Porte de Versailles and offers direct access to Montparnasse, Invalides, Champs-Elysées, the Opera house, Galeries Lafayette and Printemps department stores and Place de Clichy. The Eiffel Tower is some 15 minutes away, and the hotel's vicinity features restaurants, markets, shops and public transport links. Montparnasse train station is approximately 2 km from the establishment, and nearby airports include Orly Airport (10 km), Charles de Gaulle Airport (40 km), Paris Beauvais Tillé Airport (70 km) and Brussels Airport (300 km). This city hotel dates back to 1928 and features 25 simple and comfortable guest rooms. After a long day in the French capital, guests are invited to relax in this 5-storey establishment. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service and a hotel safe, whilst on-site facilities include lift access, a bar, a breakfast room and Internet access. Guests arriving by car can leave their vehicles in the nearby parking garage, which offers 18 spaces for a fee. Newly decorated in light tones, all guest rooms have an en suite bathroom with a shower/bath, WC and hairdryer. In-room amenities include cable TV, a telephone, a desk, complimentary wifi Internet access and central heating.

111291.description: The hotel Cordelia is the place where romantic writers used to meet in the 19th century. In an elegant and relaxing atmosphere of serenity, Countess Cordélia of Greffulhe invites you to discover her 30 non-smoking and air conditioned rooms, all recently renovated. A harmony of shimmering colors combined with some historical eye winks and modern equipment. The courtesy of our staff will make your stay a special moment!

name.content: The Watermill Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best

111574.description: Built on the site of an old flour mill on the banks of the River Bulbourne just outside Hemel Hempstead, The Watermill Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western offers serene surroundings away from the hustle and bustle of city life. Our 71 tastefully decorated bedrooms offer modern home comforts, with several boasting beautiful views of the surrounding lush green meadows and river. Whether you're here for leisure or business, you can take advantage of ample free parking and WiFi throughout the hotel and relax in our Riverside Bar and Lounge when your day is done. We're within easy reach of London and a host of top attractions, like Whipsnade Zoo and Woburn Abbey. Harry Potter fans can follow in the footsteps of the adventurous boy wizard on a magical day out at the Warner Bros Studio Tour, while ski and snowboard enthusiasts can take to the indoor slopes of The Snow Centre.

111604.description: Located in the heart of Paris, the Best Western Bretagne Montparnasse is within a 15-minute walk of the Montparnasse Tower and the Paris Catacombs. This hotel offers 45 air-conditioned rooms equipped with refrigerators, LCD televisions, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy satellite programming and private bathrooms with hair dryers and bathrobes. Guests can take advantage of amenities such as express check-in/check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a daily breakfast buffet (fee applies). Babysitting services and room service are also available.

111613.description: Discover the posh neighborhood of Vitacura, filled with upscale dining, shopping, and nightlife, while enjoying the contemporary comforts of Wyndham Garden Santiago Kennedy. Located 25 miles from Santiago International Airport (SCL), 18 kilometers from Santiago Central Station, and three kilometers from Metro Station Escuela Militar, our non-smoking hotel is ideal for business and leisure travelers. Enjoy complimentary breakfast, Wi-Fi, and parking, as well as a gym, indoor and outdoor pools, a restaurant, and a bar. You’ll be within walking distance of Parque Arauco mall, KidZania Santiago, and exclusive restaurants and bars, and close to the Chilean capital’s business districts.

111637.address: Cihannuma Mah Saray Cd No5 Besiktas
111637.description:
Located in the city centre, the award-winning Conrad Istanbul Bosphorus boasts panoramic views of the Bosphorus. Featuring luxurious rooms and upscale suites with contemporary design, state-of-the-art technology and Bosphorus views, the hotel is within walking distance of the Bosphorus and Dolmabahce Palace. The ferry port is just a few minutes' walk away, offering easy access to the Asian side of the city. Ortakoy, Kabatas, Zorlu Center, Nisantasi and Galataport are among the city's vibrant shopping, dining and lifestyle destinations. 
Conrad's guest rooms feature contemporary decor, luxurious furnishings, seating and work areas, and marble bathrooms with luxury amenities by Byredo. Each room offers a satellite LCD TV, complimentary WiFi, Nespresso coffee machine and iHome docking station. Conrad Suites offer private check-in and check-out and enhanced in-room amenities. 
Dining options include Manzara Restaurant, serving breakfast, lunch and dinner with Turkish cuisine and views of the Historic Peninsula and Bosphorus. Summit Bar and Terrace on the 14th floor offers Pan-Asian cuisine, sushi, signature cocktails and beverages with breathtaking Bosphorus and city views. Monteverdi Ristorante, a 2026 MICHELIN Guide Recommended restaurant and Gault and Millau Gourmand Table award recipient, offers Italian fine dining led by Head Chef Nicole Scandella. 
Leisure facilities include three open padel courts, one open clay tennis court, a spa, 24-hour fitness centre, traditional Turkish hammam, and indoor and outdoor swimming pools. State-of-the-art business facilities and versatile meeting spaces are available for professional gatherings and events.

111645.description: Just 30 minutes from London, the Holiday Inn London Luton North is ideal for business and leisure travelers. This 100% smoke-free hotel offers easy access to the M1 and A1M motorways, local business parks, and London Luton Airport. The hotel boasts 10 modern, well-equipped meeting rooms suitable for small meetings, conferences, and product launches, plus complimentary Wi-Fi. Maintain your fitness routine in the complimentary fitness center. Choose from 157 recently refurbished, modern bedrooms, each with complimentary internet access and stylish bathrooms. Enjoy freshly prepared lunch from our lounge menu or dinner in the brasserie-style restaurant. Evening room service is available 24hrs.

111676.description:
Set within lush gardens in the very heart of Istanbul, the iconic Hilton Istanbul Bosphorus — a place where history, nature, and contemporary life meet with quiet confidence. Overlooking the Bosphorus and just a short walk from Beyoğlu District and Nişantaşı, the hotel offers a rare sense of retreat within the city’s most vibrant district. 

Newly renovated guest rooms and suites reflect a refined, residential elegance. Private balconies open to sweeping Bosphorus views or tranquil gardens, inviting guests to slow down and settle into the rhythm of Istanbul. 
The hotel’s culinary and social experiences flow seamlessly from day to night. Morning light spills over Mediterranean-inspired moments at Arlo, while Lalou invites conversations to linger over refined brasserie fare and terrace culture. As evening descends, Sazzou’s intimate jazz ambiance and Malva’s quietly expressive fine dining craft experiences rooted in place, where every detail whispers a story of sophistication. Poolside days at Bosolei evoke the carefree ease of a Riviera escape, framed by seasonal sun and garden serenity. 

Magnolia-lined gardens and the iconic outdoor pool offer an urban escape, while the Executive Lounge provides an elevated experience with private check-in, personalized service, and carefully curated refreshments throughout the day. 
Wellness facilities continue to evolve as part of the hotel’s ongoing refinement journey; selected spa and indoor pool areas are currently unavailable. 
Surrounded by Istanbul Congress Center, Lütfi Kırdar Convention & Exhibition Center, and Harbiye Cemil Topuzlu Open-Air Theater, and within easy reach of the city’s historic peninsula, Hilton Istanbul Bosphorus remains a timeless address — discreet, composed, and unmistakably iconic.

111678.description: This modern hotel is situated in the heart of the city, only a few minutes' walk to the beautiful Dolmabahçe Palace. Offering an elegant refuge it features a business centre, a bar and a rooftop terrace restaurant with marvellous views over the Maçka Park, the Bosphorus and the Asian side of Istanbul. World-famous attractions such as Topkapi Palace or Hagia Sophia can be reached within a short drive. All rooms are non-smoking.

111687.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Home to the largest ballroom in Hertfordshire, Hilton London Watford hotel is a 3-minute drive from the M1 and 16 minutes from London Euston. Local attractions include a variety of museums in St Albans, the Warner Brothers Studio Tour - The Making of Harry Potter, and the stately homes of Knebworth and Hatfield that evoke times gone by. The LivingWell Fitness Centre offers guests a great way to work out. Start your day with a delicious breakfast at Jamie's Restaurant, guaranteed to get your day off to a great start, while Rayner's Bar is the perfect spot to relax over drinks, lunch, dinner, and bar snacks, or enjoy an evening nightcap. During summer, enjoy al-fresco dining in our Secret Garden. WiFi is available in all Hilton London Watford hotel rooms, fees apply. For more space, upgrade to a Deluxe Room, Suite, or Family Room.

111691.description:
With generous rooms, a welcoming atmosphere, and a mix of classic style and modern convenience, this hotel in Bromsgrove is ideal for business breaks, leisure breaks or for a short stayover in the West Midlands. Conveniently located near the M5 and M42, our Bromsgrove hotel offers a welcoming base for exploring Worcestershire and the surrounding West Midlands, with easy access to Birmingham, Stratford-Upon-Avon and the Cotswolds. . 
 
As a guest, you can choose from a range of comfortable bedrooms all of which are en-suite & offer classic décor, giving you a calm and welcoming place to unwind, with flat screen tv’s, free Wi-Fi access and a work desk, tea & coffee making facilities, ironing facilities & complimentary toiletries. 
 
During your stay, you can take advantage of the hotel’s dining options, where you can enjoy breakfast, afternoon teas and evening meals in a traditional setting. The hotel also features stylish bars and lounges—perfect for meeting friends, enjoying a quiet drink, or simply taking a moment to relax in the Coffee Lounge. 
 
The hotel is also well known for its impressive 9 function suites and event spaces, regularly hosting weddings, conferences, and social events. 
 
We also have a leisure club which includes a 60ft heated swimming pool, fully equipped fitness room & sauna which guest are welcome to use at a special discounted rate. Guests can explore nearby countryside at Lickey Hills Country Park or Waseley Hills Country Park, discover local history at Avoncroft Museum of Historic Buildings, or enjoy family attractions such as Cadbury World and West Midland Safari Park. With a mix of relaxation, nature and attractions nearby, Bromsgrove Hotel & Spa is an ideal location for all our guests needs. 

On‑site parking is now free with approximately 230 spaces available on a first-come, first-served basis. Guests must register their vehicle details at reception to avoid penalties.

111753.description: The NH Madrid Las Tablas hotel is in a convenient location for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel is 14km north of the city center, close to business parks and the BBVA Financial City, while Madrid's top sites, such as the Museo Nacional Del Prado, are within easy reach via public transport. The Maria Tudor light metro station is 300m from the hotel and an El Corte Inglés department store is also within walking distance. NH Madrid Las Tablas has 149 spacious rooms decorated in soothing brown shades with blue accents. Each room comes with all the necessities such as free Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and a minibar. The breakfast is a delicious affair with many options, including local Spanish specialties. Our in-house restaurant serves scrumptious local and regional cuisine, while guests can also have a drink with a light meal in our bar - a bold and contemporary space to unwind. On warm days, opt for a drink on one of our two outdoor terraces. Guests will be able to invigorate their body at the fitness room. For functions, the hotel has 8 meeting rooms for up to 70 people.

111775.description: The hotel enjoys a privileged location in one of the most strategic sectors of the neighbourhood of Providencia. Shopping venues are some 7 km from the hotel and nightspots are half an hour away by public transport. Furthermore, the hotel is located within walking distance of Salvador subway station and is also only 30 minutes from the international airport. This residence features all the facilities business travellers require. In addition to the 48 comfortably furnished, air-conditioned guestrooms, it offers a fully equipped business centre and WLAN Internet access. In their leisure time guests can enjoy a game of golf at the nearest golf course, which is 9 km away. The hotel features a high-quality restaurant serving exquisite cuisine in an elegant setting, suitable for business meetings and corporate lunches.

111777.description: Located in Santiago's upscale Las Condes district, the Mandarin Oriental offers easy access to the airport, downtown, shopping, golf courses, and vineyards. Ski resorts and beaches are just an hour or so away. Recently renovated, this iconic hotel, the first Mandarin Oriental in South America, boasts luxurious rooms, suites, and state-of-the-art facilities with stunning views of the Andes Mountains. Admire artwork by local female artists and the signature fan by Chilean muralist Mario Toral. The lush gardens and lagoon-style pool with a waterfall create a tranquil urban oasis.

111822.description: This amazing city hotel, featuring a great terrace open during the summer, which offers great views over Paris, is beautifully located in a quiet area in the north of the city. The hotel is situated in the charming area of Montmartre and close to the Opera underground station in a 5-minute walk. Private parking is available. Nearby guests will find a number of touristic sites, such as Sacre Coeur, Pigalle and Galeries Lafayette. Orly and Charles de Gaulle airports are 30-minute drive away from the hotel. Ideal whether you are travelling for business or pleasure, the hotel offers you all modern facilities to enjoy an unforgettable few days in Paris.

111842.address: King Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud Street.
111842.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a hot tub, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include wireless internet access (surcharge), concierge services, and a hair salon. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge) that operates within 15 km. Enjoy international cuisine at Counter Culture Cafe, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include wired internet access (surcharge), a business center, and limo/town car service. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

111855.description: The well-being of guests is top of mind at Choice-branded hotels. Guests may experience a variety of new, improved cleanliness protocols and products. Get rested and ready for anything at the smoke-free Comfort Inn Edgware Road, W2 hotel in London, EN near the city of Westminster. Our hotel is also near the Marble Arch monument, Hyde Park and Bayswater District. Prepare for a successful day ahead with amenities like free breakfast, free wireless high-speed Internet, a business center and a restaurant, to name a few. Guest rooms come with TVs, coffee makers, desks, hair dryers, safes and more. Behind every great day is a great night at our Comfort Inn Edgware Road, W2. Book now. Local phone calls are available for a small fee, contact the hotel for more information.

111915.description: Located in the Providencia district of Santiago, the Sheraton Santiago Hotel and Convention Center is within a 10-minute walk of Clínica Indisa and Sculpture Park. This upscale hotel is conveniently close to several attractions, including Costanera Center (2 km) and Plaza de Armas (4 km). Guests can enjoy a range of amenities, including an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, a sauna, and complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel offers 379 guest rooms featuring minibars, flat-screen televisions with cable programming, and private bathrooms. Guests can choose from four on-site restaurants, including El Jardin Coffee Shop serving international cuisine, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Additional amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and 7, 578 square feet of event space. An airport shuttle is available for a surcharge, and self-parking is available on-site.

112038.description:
Hôtel Eiffel Rive Gauche is located on a quiet street in the heart of Paris’s 7th arrondissement, just a short walk from the Eiffel Tower, the Champ de Mars and the lively Rue Cler. 
This charming 29-room hotel combines Parisian character with contemporary interiors. Soft neutral tones, dark furnishings and subtle golden accents create a warm and welcoming atmosphere, offering a comfortable retreat after a day exploring the city. 
The hotel features a 24-hour reception, lift access, complimentary Wi-Fi and an interior patio. A buffet breakfast is served each morning in the breakfast room. 
The individually decorated rooms offer a cosy setting, with a private bathroom, television, complimentary Wi-Fi and tea and coffee-making facilities. Selected rooms also enjoy views of the Eiffel Tower. 
With its attentive team and convenient location close to restaurants, shops and public transport, Hôtel Eiffel Rive Gauche is an inviting base for a Parisian getaway. breakfast buffet is served.

112039.description: The family-friendly city hotel is located in the heart of the triangle of the Eiffel Tower, Invalides and Montparnasse, right in front of the UNESCO parliament and 10 minutes from the Parc des Expositions de la Porte de Versailles. There is a metro station just 100 m from the city hotel and nearby airports include Orly (approximately 15 km away), Charles de Gaulle (around 30 km) and Beauvais-Tille (roughly 50 km). This family-run and owned hotel offers harmony and tranquillity amidst the hustle and bustle of Paris. The warm welcome and quality service will assure a pleasant stay at the hotel. The family-friendly hotel offers guests 23 rooms in total and facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, lift access, a café, bar, breakfast room and Internet access. The rooms are equipped with a double bed or twin beds, a TV, direct dial telephone, hi-fi system, work desk with free wireless Internet access, central heating and a private bathroom with shower and hairdryer. A breakfast buffet is served each morning.

112040.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Hôtel de l'Exposition République, conveniently located in Paris's 10th Arrondissement, just steps from Place de la République and a short walk from Canal Saint-Martin. This hotel offers 28 air-conditioned rooms equipped with refrigerators, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, express check-in, and a banquet hall. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Nearby attractions include the Picasso Museum, Les Halles, and Centre Pompidou. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

112045.address: C-56 G Block Bkc Bandra Kurla Complex Mumbai
112045.description: With a stay at Trident Bandra Kurla Mumbai in Mumbai (Bandra Kurla Complex), you'll be steps from U. S. Consulate General and a 2-minute drive from University of Mumbai. This luxury hotel is 0. 9 mi (1. 4 km) from MMRDA Grounds and 1. 3 mi (2 km) from St. Andrew's Church. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Guests can catch a ride on the shuttle (surcharge), which operates within 2 meters. Make yourself at home in one of the 436 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring MP3 docking stations and minibars. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. LCD televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Grab a bite at 022, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in.

112048.description: This charming riad is located in the medina of Marrakech, 5 minutes from Jamaa El Fna square, next to El Badi palace and 5 minutes from Dar Si Said museum. The hotel can be easily accessed by car and there are taxis stationed nearby. Menara Airport is approximately 6 km from this establishment. This family-friendly hotel is built in a charming traditional Berber style, which means it features natural materials used by the Berber people of Morocco, such as natural stone, terracotta, clay and wood. Guests are sure to feel the spirit of authentic, traditional Morocco. All the richly decorated rooms come with modern amenities to ensure guests feel at home. Guests can also choose to enjoy the delicious Moroccan or international cuisine which the on-site hotel serves up.

112053.description: This Moroccan-style establishment is the ideal choice of accommodation for travellers interested in knowing at first-hand how people live in the city while having a pleasant stay. Visitors will be a short walk from some of the most popular places in this beautiful city, including Djema el Fna square, El Badi Palace and Dar Si Said Museum. Each spacious and bright guest room is perfectly appointed and combines traditional elements with a modern style. They include central heating for the winter and complimentary wireless Internet connection in case visitors want to keep in touch with their beloved ones and keep updated with what is going on in the rest of the world. In the morning, travellers may taste a hearty and delicious breakfast at the patio or on the terrace and in the evening a traditional dinner will be served. Moreover, from the rooftop terrace, guests can enjoy panoramic views.

112084.description: Located in Miraflores de la Sierra, 29 miles from Chamartin Station, Palacio de Miraflores has accommodations with an outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a garden and a shared lounge. Offering a bar, the property is located within 30 miles of Santiago Bernabéu Stadium. Some accommodations at the property have a balcony with a garden view. At the hotel, rooms are equipped with a closet. Complete with a private bathroom equipped with a bidet and free toiletries, all rooms at Palacio de Miraflores have a TV and air conditioning, and selected rooms also feature a terrace. At the accommodation the rooms have bed linen and towels. Guests at Palacio de Miraflores can enjoy a buffet or a continental breakfast. The hotel has a playground. IFEMA Convention Center is 31 miles from Palacio de Miraflores. The nearest airport is Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport, 35 miles from the accommodation.

112085.description: This historic hotel is located in downtown Milan, one of the world's major commercial and financial centres, a prestigious meeting point of cultural figures and athletes. Milan is renowned as a world capital of design and fashion, and is home to spectacular works of art. Thanks to the hotel's strategic and functional location, 200 metres from the Stazione Centrale and from the metro, all major business, cultural, and shopping centres are within easy reach.

112133.description: This family-friendly apartment hotel boasts a strategic setting in Sant Cugat del Valles. The hotel is located amidst the famous business and leisure district of the city. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from Can Sant Joan Business Park and a large shopping centre. The centre of Sant Cugat and its famous Roman Monastery can be found just 1. 5 km away. The artistic, culturally-rich city of Barcelona is just 20 km away. The airport is conveniently located 25 km from the hotel. This hotel comprises stunningly-designed apartments, which are fully fitted with modern conveniences. The hotel offers a wide variety of excellent facilities and services, delivering a high level of convenience.

112160.description: This hotel is set on Avenida Libertador General Bernardo O'Higgins, in Santiago. The hotel is set between the city centre and Avenida Providencia. Guests will find themselves just a few minutes' walking distance away from 2 of the main metro stations in the city. The hotel is set facing the Diego Portales Convention Centre. The ideal option for business and leisure travellers, the hotel is surrounded by many of the city's main attractions. Comodoro Arturo Merino Benitez International Airport is just a 15 minutes' driving distance away. This charming hotel enjoys a charming design. The guest rooms are functional, spacious and comfortable. Those travelling for work or events purposes will appreciate the hotel's expansive conference space. The hotel features a fitness centre, which comprises a gym and sauna , as well as an outdoor pool and a hot tub ( closed from April to October-winter season)

112217.address: The Waterfront Level Street Bierley Hill
112217.description: Set in the heart of Dudley's historic canal marina, the Copthorne Hotel Merry Hill-Dudley is a luxury corporate hotel boasting a stunning waterfront location. With 138 en-suite rooms, modern amenities and conference space for 570 guests, commercial and social events can be hosted with ease. Perfect for leisure and family breaks, the Copthorne is just minutes from the fantastic Merry Hill Shopping Centre and within easy reach of such as Cadbury World, Dudley Zoo and the Black Country Living Museum. With convenient road, rail and air transport links, onsite parking, and only 12 miles from Birmingham, the Copthorne offers a picturesque and peaceful location, close to a vibrant city. ** As of the 1st August 2024, we wish to advise you that Copthorne Hotel Merry Hill-Dudley will be operating as a cashless business. **

112218.description: This hotel is ideally located close to commercial and recreational areas of Alcala de Henares and just 2 km from the city centre. The establishment is situated just 200 metres away from links to the public transport network. A number of shops, bars and restaurants can also be found nearby. The bustling city of Madrid is just 30 km from the hotel. This modern property has been designed with comfort and style in mind. It offers the perfect option for business and leisure travellers. The guest rooms are brightly decorated and spacious. The property offers well-equipped conference areas, for the convenience of those travelling for business purposes. It offers a wide range of facilities and services, attending to guests' needs.

112222.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Make yourself at home in one of the 37 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have hair dryers and slippers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Messe Berlin - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Berliner Funkturm - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- ICC Berlin - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- CityCube Berlin - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Deutsche Oper Berlin - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Kurfürstendamm - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Schloss Charlottenburg - 2. 7 km / 1. 7 mi- Olympiastadion - 3 km / 1. 9 mi- Theatre of the West - 3. 5 km / 2. 2 mi- Tiergarten Park - 3. 8 km / 2. 4 mi- Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church - 4 km / 2. 5 mi- Europa Center - 4. 2 km / 2. 6 mi- Zoo Berlin - 4. 3 km / 2. 7 mi- Waldbühne - 4. 4 km / 2. 8 mi- Classic Remise Berlin - 4. 4 km / 2. 8 mi. The nearest major airport is Berlin (BER-Brandenburg) - 31 km / 19. 3 mi With a stay at Hotel Brandies Berlin, you'll be centrally located in Berlin, within a 10-minute walk of Berliner Funkturm and ICC Berlin. This hotel is 1. 6 mi (2. 6 km) from Schloss Charlottenburg and 1. 9 mi (3 km) from Olympiastadion.

112230.description:
In the heart of the 13th arrondissement, 200 metres from Bibliothèque François-Mitterrand metro station (line 14) and just steps from the Seine, you drop your bags and Paris opens up. Major landmarks, business districts, Bercy Village and the Accor Arena are all only minutes away. 

Our 140 spacious, fully furnished apartments sleep up to 4 guests. Here you have the space to properly settle in: a fully equipped kitchenette (fridge, hob, microwave, kettle and crockery) to keep your freedom at mealtimes, a work area, free high-speed Wi-Fi, a TV with Chromecast and, in most units, a private balcony. 

In the morning, the buffet breakfast is waiting: sweet and savoury options, fresh fruit and hot dishes. Around you, a 24-hour front desk, private parking (subject to availability), housekeeping and laundry services — everything that makes a stay simpler from the moment you arrive. 

The neighbourhood does the rest: restaurants, cafés, shops and things to do right on your doorstep, with line 14 and the RER C to take you anywhere else.

112296.description: Enjoy a stylish stay at Numa London Bloomsbury, a boutique hotel in the heart of London's City Centre, just steps from Tottenham Court Road and a short walk from the British Museum. The 86 air-conditioned rooms offer smart TVs with digital programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each room includes a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. Coffee/tea makers and safes are also provided for your convenience, and housekeeping is offered weekly. Leicester Square and Covent Garden Market are within a mile of the hotel.

112339.description: Enjoy a stay at the Hotel Petit Palais, a beachfront hotel on Venice Lido, just steps from the beach and a short walk from the Palazzo del Cinema. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, and make use of amenities such as free Wi-Fi, concierge services, and discounted access to a nearby fitness center. The hotel's café and bar offer convenient dining and refreshment options. Each of the 31 guestrooms features a minibar, flat-screen TV with satellite programming, private bathroom with designer toiletries and a bidet, safe, and desk. The hotel is 7. 7 miles from the Port of Venice and 8 miles from Piazzale Roma.

112340.description: 'Enjoy scenic views from the terrace and garden at Hotel Alle Torri, located in Mestre (Marghera), a short drive from Piazzale Roma and Porto Marghera. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, 24-hour room service, and a bar/lounge. Start your day with a to-go breakfast (fee applies) and make use of amenities like express check-in/check-out and dry cleaning/laundry services. The 26 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, refrigerators, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Free self-parking is available onsite. The Port of Venice and the Grand Canal are within a 15-minute drive. '

112375.address: Avda Lib Bernardo O'Higgins,632 Santiago Centro
112375.description: Mercure Santiago Centro is close to the main tourist spots: Plaza de Armas, Metropolitan Cathedral, Palacio de la Moneda, Central Market, Chilean Museum of Pre-Columbian Art, City Theater. It is 30m from Santa Lucía subway station and 18km from Santiago International Airport. The hotel facilities meet all your holiday or business trip needs, swimming pool, bar, restaurant, gym and meeting/event rooms.

112376.address: Av Alonso De Cordova 5199 Las Condes
112376.description: This business hotel is located on Avenida Alonso de Cordova, in Las Condes. The hotel is situated just a few metres away from Araucano Park. The area's business centre and the Las Condes shopping centre are also in the vicinity. The hotel is just a 20 minutes' journey away from Bellavista. This wonderful hotel is just a 90 minutes' driving distance away from Vina del Mar. This charming conference hotel enjoys a modern design. The guest rooms offer comfort and style. The hotel features a business centre, as well as 5 large rooms for meetings and conferences, offering the utmost in convenience to those travelling for work purposes. Guests can enjoy a vigorous workout in the gym, followed by a refreshing swim in the pool.

112377.description: Pullman El Bosque has a prime location in Sanhattan. Enjoy a premium stay in the best area of the capital. Rooftop, Swimming Pool, Gym and Breakfast Buffet are the upgrade you need. The hotel is located in front of Metro Tobalaba, with spacious and comfortable rooms with incredible views of the city, in the heart of the city of Santiago.

112413.description: The hotel is located in the heart of Paris, between the Opéra Garnier and Gare du Nord. Les Grands Magasins and Montmartre are situated very close by. The hotel has excellent access to transport services connecting with different sites in the city, including underground stations Le Peletier (metro line 7) and Notre Dame de Lorette (metro line 12) and a bus stop just a few metres from the hotel entrance. Paris Orly is some 17 km from the hotel, while Charles de Gaulle Airport is approximately 22 km away. This family-friendly city hotel offers guests with a quirky, affordable, clean and safe place to stay in Paris. The air-conditioned hotel comprises a total of 28 comfortable bedrooms. It offers a wide range of facilities including an entrance hall with 24-hour reception, lift access, a restaurant, WLAN Internet access and room service. There is ample parking for those arriving by car (charges apply). The guest rooms are all fully sound proofed and come equipped with a direct dial telephone, a desk, high-speed access to the Internet and satellite TV. A hairdryer and air conditioning come as standard. Almost every bedroom has a fully fitted private bathroom, although some rooms simply offer a wash basin and a shared shower and WC in the corridor. From the circular motorway (Boulevard Périphérique), exit at Porte d'Asnières and drive towards Concorde, then follow directions for Opéra. From Opéra turn off onto La Fayette and the 7th street on the right-hand side will be Rue du Faubourg Montmartre.

112420.description: This charming historic hotel is nestled in the heart of Venice, just a short stroll from St. Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge, yet enjoys a tranquil, secluded atmosphere. Guests can easily access public transport links to explore the city and the lagoon islands (Torcello, Burano, Murano, Chioggia, and Lido). Numerous restaurants and shops are at the doorstep, with bars and nightlife a short walk away. This family-friendly hotel occupies a historic aristocratic house showcasing exquisite neo-gothic design dating back to 1700. The hotel offers a 24-hour reception, safe, cloakroom, lift, cafe, breakfast room, and room and laundry services (fees may apply). The elegantly appointed rooms evoke the sophistication of 18th-century Venice, featuring fine furnishings and rich color palettes. Each room includes a minibar, direct-dial telephone, safe, private bathroom with hairdryer, double or king-size bed, satellite TV, internet access, washing machine, ironing set, and individually controlled air conditioning and heating. A private balcony or terrace and a kitchenette with a fridge and tea and coffee making facilities are also standard. A continental breakfast buffet is served daily.

112531.description: At Hotel Onix Fira, a comprehensive renovation has transformed all facilities, from the rooms to the common areas, resulting in a contemporary and avant-garde design that combines comfort, functionality, and style. This three-star hotel boasts a privileged location overlooking Parc Joan Miró and adjacent to Plaça Espanya. It's perfectly situated near major business venues, including the Palau de Congressos and Fira II de Barcelona, and offers excellent connections to the airport and the Fira Exhibition Centre. All spacious, bright rooms have been renovated with a modern and functional design, featuring a private bathroom, free Wi-Fi, a safe, a minibar, and a telephone. Guests can enjoy a seasonal rooftop swimming pool with unique city views and relax or work in the modern and cozy common areas. Discover our new gastronomic spot at the Hotel, El Quiosco: you can savour traditional tapas.

112532.description: The establishment offers all kinds of surprises, from Mozarabic architecture to the latest trends in digital art, to its excellent location. Sitting in the city centre, its guests are a short walk away from the Gran Teatre del Liceu, Las Ramblas and the districts of Gòtic and Born. Those who are interested in exploring the architecture and the art scene will be in the immediate vicinity of the Cathedral, Palau Güell and the two most important museums: the Picasso and MACBA. The greatly preserved 19th century of the faced blends perfectly with its stylish interior. The public areas are designed to create a relaxing ambience similar to an art gallery. While the comfortable and modern rooms are equipped with top of the line amenities and are perfect places for relaxing after a long day of sightseeingParking (surcharge) under availability at check-inBreakfast is €14 per person and per day

112533.description: The combination of a modern design, a central location and an excellent service make this hotel a popular choice for any traveller searching a comfortable accommodation in the centre of Barcelona. The hotel stands on Rambla de Catalunya, the main commerce and business thoroughfare, and is just a few metres away from most popular tourist sites, such as Plaça Catalunya, Passeig de Gràcia and La Pedrera. After exploring the city, guests may relax in comfortable rooms, decorated in a minimalist style and equipped with amenities to ensure a perfect stay. The property proposes a healthy breakfast buffet to start every morning with a burst of energy, which is €14 per person and per day. More active guests may take advantage of the on-site fitness area and relax afterwards at the hotel's terrace, which is equipped with a sparkling outdoor pool. Parking (surcharge) under availability at check in.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Santiago Las Condes
