112553.description: Santiago Holiday Inn Express in the Business District of Las CondesIn front of San Cristobal Hill, the Holiday Inn Express® Santiago Las Condes Hotel provides a warm and welcoming atmosphere for all travelers. Located in Vitacura Avenue, just outside of the city center, visitors can enjoy the buzz of Santiago's main avenues and retire to a quiet neighborhood in the evening. Guests coming for business find our location particularly convenient. Las Condes neighborhood is home to a number of corporations such as the Chile offices for Citibank, Sony Ericsson and Microsoft, which are all situated within a mile of our property. The US Embassy is across the street, and you can have easy access to several subway stations. Our hotel is next to a great restaurant area in Isidora Goyenechea Avenue, where you can find a wide variety of choices including local seafood meals. In addition, Costanera Center, the biggest mall in Chile, is down the road. At this hotel in Santiago, Chile we guarantee travelers a comfortable and convenient stay. Our Fitness Center provides an exercising space, the Business Center and complimentary Internet access allow you a comfortable working time, and the guest patio and lounge offer peaceful resting spaces with the cleanliness high standards included in our IHG Clean Promise®.

112593.description: This modern Midtown Manhattan hotel is within walking distance of iconic destinations like Central Park, Rockefeller Center, and Broadway theaters. The 135 contemporary rooms feature TVs and bath amenities. Business travelers will appreciate the on-site facilities, and the 24-hour gym offers free weights, yoga training, and cardio equipment with personal television screens. LaGuardia, Newark Liberty, and JFK airports are all a short drive away. Enjoy high-quality service and superb dining options at this perfectly located hotel.

112607.description: This historical establishment features a superb location in Campo Santa Maria Formosa, a very central area in the historic centre of Venice. This enviable situation makes this luxurious property the ideal base from which to explore all the attractions of the area, including the world-renowned St. Marks' Square and Rialto Bridge. Marco Polo airport is just 10 kilometres away and guests will find a waterbus stop just 350 metres away. This hotel preserves the charm and elegance typical of times gone by, but is also equipped with a choice of modern conveniences. The luxurious guest rooms combine a contemporary design with a range of Venetian heritage elements, including open beams and Venetian floors. Those most demanding guests may prefer the stunning Royal Suite, a spacious accommodation with breathtaking views to the canal and Santa Maria Fornosa.

112636.description: Situated in the scenic Titreyengöl Lake area, this exclusive hotel is mere steps from a sandy beach. Manavgat and its waterfalls are easily accessible, while the historic city of Side, with its ancient sites including the Temple of Apollo and Anatolia's largest amphitheater, is only 5 km away. Antalya's city center and airport are 75 km and 65 km away, respectively. The bright, comfortable rooms feature private balconies, LCD TVs with satellite channels, private bathrooms, minibars, and other standard amenities. Guests can enjoy various sports facilities, a fitness center, and an excellent spa. Sunny Side, with its ancient sites and welcoming staff, awaits your visit.

112638.description: Set in Braga’s historic square, this contemporary hotel is just a 5-minute walk from Braga’s town center. It features a 24-hour front desk and air-conditioned rooms with a balcony. Each room at Hotel Senhora A Branca is decorated with antique furnishings. All have a seating area with a sofa and cable TV. A buffet is served every morning in the breakfast room. Cold, refreshing drinks are served at the bar. Room service is available as well. The hotel also offers car rental and laundry services. Local attractions include Braga Se Cathedral, 0. 6 mi away.

112655.description: This hotel is located in the centre of Santiago, close to major tourist attractions like the Museum of Fine Arts, Santiago Cathedral, and the Municipal Theatre. The hotel offers room service, a laundry service, a terrace, and a lobby with 24-hour reception. It also has 7 comfortable and spacious halls with natural lighting, ideal for hosting events. The hotel provides a hotel safe, currency exchange, cloakroom, lift access, a TV lounge, café, bar and restaurant. Guests may also make use of the WLAN Internet access and the car park.

112678.description: The hotel is situated in a quiet, upmarket neighbourhood, just a few blocks from the Congress Hall at Porte Maillot, minutes away from the Champs Elysées and Arc de Triomphe, plus a short ride away from the Paris La Défense business district. Guests will find a wide choice of restaurants and a number of small boutiques in the vicinity of the hotel. The RER Porte Maillot station and Les Sablons underground station on line 1 are nearby. The Palais des Congrès (Porte Maillot) is approximately 5 minutes away on foot, and the American Hospital is around a 7-minute walk from the hotel. The ICAO head office can be found approximately 400 m away. Orly Airport is around 20 km from the establishment, Charles de Gaulle Airport about 25 km away and Beauvais Airport roughly 35 km from the hotel. With a total of 30 rooms, each one is decorated according to a different theme in which originality is crossed with elegance and refinement. Some of the themes to be discovered in this hotel are Andalusian, Mandarin, Sahara, Japanese, the Love Room or even the American Indian Room. The décor throughout is warm and will make guests feel right at home. This beautiful establishment is an ideal location for customers looking for entertainment and haute-couture boutiques in the Parisian tradition. The establishment offers free wifi Internet access, air conditioning and a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe and lift access. Other amenities include a breakfast room and a laundry service. Guests will find a public car park close to the establishment (fees payable on site).

112681.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Make yourself at home in one of the 55 air-conditioned rooms featuring espresso makers and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, as well as phones with free international calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Grands Boulevards - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Place de la République - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Canal Saint-Martin - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Les Halles - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Centre Pompidou - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Folies Bergere - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Picasso Museum - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Grevin Museum - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Boulevard Haussmann - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Place des Vosges - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Rue de Rivoli - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Palais Royal - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Hôtel de Ville - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Île de la Cité - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Parc des Buttes Chaumont - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 20 km / 12. 4 miParis Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 29. 8 km / 18. 5 miThe preferred airport for Hotel Taylor is Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG). A stay at Hotel Taylor places you in the heart of Paris, a 1-minute drive from Place de la République and 7 minutes from Notre-Dame. This hotel is 1. 9 mi (3 km) from La Machine du Moulin Rouge and 2. 5 mi (4. 1 km) from Champs-Élysées.

112687.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Barcelona's commercial and financial centre. It comprises a total of 65 rooms including 2 single rooms and 4 junior suites. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception. Dining options include a café, a bar and a restaurant. There are conference facilities and WLAN Internet access. Guests can also take advantage of the room and laundry services. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a bath or shower and a hairdryer. They also offer a king-size or double bed, a plasma TV and a minibar. Free WLAN Internet access is provided. Furthermore, individually regulated air conditioning and heating are provided in all accommodation as standard. Guests can enjoy Mediterranean cuisine in the elegant dining room. They can select their continental breakfast from a buffet. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a pet deposit.

112693.description: This 4-star boutique hotel is 750 metres from the famous Galeries Lafayette department store. Miromesnil Metro Station is 280 metres away, providing access to the Champs Elysées. Public parking is available nearby. The 8th arrondissement is a great choice for travellers interested in shopping, romance and food. Some of the guest rooms feature a private balcony overlooking the city's rooftops. A flat-screen TV, iPhone station and a minibar are included in all of the soundproofed and air-conditioned accommodation units. They also feature an espresso machine and include free Wi-Fi access. The private bathrooms are decorated with colourful mosaics and offer free toiletries upon arrival. Cocktails are served in the hotel bar, which is open 24 hours a day. A buffet breakfast is served every morning in the breakfast room at Hotel Park Lane Paris, or in guests' room upon request.

112713.description: Hotel Altstadt Vienna - sensuality and style in Spittelberg, Vienna's historic and artistic quarter. Jam-packed with modern art, this unique boutique hotel is housed in a 19th-century Patrician town house in a quiet part of Vienna, just a 15 minute walk from the city centre. Spread across five floors, modern works of art by mostly contemporary Austrian artists like Markus Prachensky or Alex Ruthner, but also international legends like Andy Warhol and Annie Leibovitz, decorate the walls throughout the hotel. Rooms, suites and apartments range from classic modernity to stylish decadence, and each room is different and unique. Wake to a sumptuous breakfast - before heading out to the vibrant city of Vienna. Return in the afternoon to enjoy complimentary tea & homemade cake next to the cozy fireplace or treat yourself with a sundowner at the rooftop terrace. Transfer from/to airport or main train station/to main train station costs 65€ for up to 3 guests and for up to 8 guests 95€. Parking fee: 12€ per vehicle per night. Children extra bed prices: 0-6 years: free of charge;7-12 years: 30€ per child per night;from 13 years: 50€ per child per night.

112714.description: Hotel Das Triest is located in the center of Vienna. The 120 spacious rooms and suites offer all the amenities of a design hotel and are equipped with air conditioning, a coffee maker and free Wi-Fi. Some rooms and suites have private gardens or terraces. While the hotel's quiet courtyard invites guests to relax, Mediterranean specialties can be enjoyed at the hotel's Bistro Porto. Five seminar rooms and a business suite are available at Hotel Das Triest for functions, events and seminars.

112735.description: Strategically located in Fuenlabrada, just 20km from Madrid, we offer modern amenities and high quality services. Through the M40 and M50, train station, less than 10 minutes walking distance, and metro, we easily connect with different areas of Madrid. We have free outdoor parking until full capacity is reached and garage with additional cost. In our restaurant, guests can enjoy an exceptional gastronomic experience. We have a terrace, rooms for events, a restaurant and a snack bar that is open 24 hours a day. In our café, we offer different varieties of breakfasts. We highlight our location near Warner Park, Puy du Fou, shopping malls and other points of interest. We ask our guests to confirm their arrival time and, at check-in, a valid ID and a debit/credit card.

112736.description: This guesthouse is strategically situated in the centre of San Martin de la Vega, only 3. 5 km from the Parque Warner theme park in Madrid. A broad range of restaurants, shops and nightlife venues are to be found in the surrounding area. Guests can enjoy their holiday in the absolute tranquility of this renovated guesthouse. The establishment offers 43 rooms in total including rooms adapted for guests with physical disabilities. Facilities at this air-conditioned hotel include a 24-hour reception, a breakfast room and WLAN Internet access. Further amenities include a summer terrace and a lounge suitable for meetings. All of the rooms are equipped with a TV, air conditioning and central heating. Moreover, rooms include a double or king-size bed and a complete en suite bathroom with a bathtub and a shower.

112760.description: This charming riad is situated in the Dar El Bacha district, one of the most exclusive districts in the medina of Marrakech. The city centre is approximately 1 km from this themed design hotel and the Djemaa el Fna main square is just 400 m away. Guests will find main places of interest in the immediate vicinity and Menara Airport is around 7 km away. The family-friendly historical hotel features 5 traditional rooms and an open patio in the centre of the riad, offering a relaxing setting where guests can unwind or enjoy a drink or meal. Fitted with a lovely fountain, it provides a refreshing atmosphere during the summer months. Guests who need extra refreshment can relax on the sun terrace or make use of the hotel's SPA facilities. Meals are created on-site by the hotel's cook according to guests' individual requirements.

112765.description:
The Bijoux Aparthotel offers a modern, central urban abode in the heart of the Cape Town CBD. With 22 beautifully appointed studio and 1 bedroom en-suite units, open-plan living and dining areas, plus a host of on-site facilities ranging from a rooftop swimming pool and deck to a communal gym, secure parking and more, The Bijoux Aparthotel is the ideal choice for guests who want the flexibility of a self-catering apartment with the luxury of a fully serviced hotel.

The hotel is situated at the historical end of Cape Town's main thoroughfare, Adderley Street, and is well placed for corporate travellers with business interests in the city as well as for tourists who wish to experience Cape Town's finest leisure attractions. The hotel has historic façades with chic 21st century luxury interiors and can be best described as cool. The hotel occupies a unique combination of refurbished historical buildings (built in 1903) and an 11-storey tower. Designed for the modern traveller

112766.address: Jubilee Square, St Georges Street. Simonstown
112766.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a reception hall. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a train station pick-up service. Make yourself at home in one of the 29 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

112793.description: This family-friendly city hotel, built in 2009, is nestled near San Enrique Square in the prestigious Lo Barnechea and Las Condes district of Santiago, offering breathtaking views of the Andes, Cerro Pochoco Observatory, and the entire Santiago Valley. Within walking distance are Santiago's finest shops, restaurants, antique stores, and cultural centers. The hotel is conveniently located a 30-minute drive from Comodoro Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport, downtown Santiago, and the renowned ski slopes of Valle Nevado and Farellones. The historic port city of Valparaíso, a World Heritage Site, is just 75 minutes away. This charming boutique hotel offers seven rooms with en suite bathrooms featuring showers, hairdryers, and amenities. Guests can also enjoy satellite TV, internet access, and air conditioning. Further amenities include a breakfast and dining room, WLAN internet access, room and laundry services, and a car park. The hotel also boasts an outdoor swimming pool with a children's area, sun loungers, a sauna, and a hot tub. Breakfast is served daily, while lunch and dinner are offered à la carte.

112794.description: Set in the Providencia neighborhood, the NH Ciudad de Santiago hotel gives guests easy access to the city's top attractions. Many can be reached on foot, while the Salvador metro stop is only a short walk away. From the hotel you can see the Bellas Artes Museum, the Government Palace, Palacio de la Moneda, and panoramic views of the Santa Lucia and San Cristobal hills. You will also be close to the international airport which is only a 15-minute drive away. NH Ciudad de Santiago's 122 smartly furnished rooms have a modern and stylish décor and are finished with sleek hardwood floors. Each comes with a sofa, TV, and mini-bar so that you can feel at home while away. Some of the rooms come with spectacular views of the Andes Mountains. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Guests will enjoy our large breakfast spread that offers a wide variety of options to accommodate all tastes. For lunch and dinner, try our delicious meals which include local Chilean specialties and classic international dishes. If you are feeling a little parched, head to our lobby bar and unwind with a quick drink. There is also a gym and five meeting rooms for up to 200 people.

112795.description: This hotel is located 10 minutes away from the centre of Santiago and 15 minutes from the tourist centre of Pueblo Inglés. A fully equipped business centre caters to the needs of today's business traveller. The restaurant provides guest with a wide range of culinary options. Guests are welcomed into the air-conditioned hotel in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, hotel safe, cloakroom and lift access. The hotel offers a range of facilities, including a café, breakfast room, WLAN Internet access, room and laundry services and a garage.

112796.description: Conveniently located in Las Condes, this elegant hotel is the best choice for both business and pleasure. Enjoy your holidays in our comfortable rooms, suites and indoor pool. Nearby you can find the largest shopping center in Latin America, Costanera Center, US Embassy, WTC, Bicentennial Park and subway stations. In addition, it offers spacious meeting rooms that make it one of the most important convention centers in Santiago.

112824.description: Situated in the heart of Milan's Porta Venezia district, the WorldHotels Casati 18 offers convenient access to the city's main attractions. Located halfway between Central Station and Porta Venezia, and just a short walk from Corso Buenos Aires, Milan's premier shopping street, the hotel is also well-connected by public transport. Recently renovated, the hotel features 80 elegant rooms across four floors, equipped with amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, premium linens, and climate control. Guests can enjoy innovative cocktails in the lounge bar or relax in the cozy outdoor seating area. For business travelers, the hotel offers a naturally lit board room suitable for small meetings and training events, as well as a fully equipped gym with Technogym machines.

112833.description: This modern hotel is 3 km from Madrid Barajas Airport and the IFEMA Convention Centre. It enjoys a strategic location on the outskirts of the charming village of Paracuellos del Jarama. Elegant design with brightly colored walls decorated with photos in black and white. The T4 offers rooms with soft lighting and wooden floors. This property is 30 minutes from the heart of Madrid and is a welcome retreat outside the city center. Hostal T4 offers a 24-hour shuttle service for a fee.

112857.description: 'Overlooking the panoramic views of Santa Maria da Feira Castle, Hotel Dos Loios offers air-conditioned rooms, each with a private balcony. A rich breakfast buffet featuring fresh bread and regional specialties is served daily, and room service is also available. The hotel provides a 24-hour front desk and elevator access for guest convenience. Located centrally in the Aveiro district, the hotel is a short 10-minute drive from the Europarque Congress Center and less than 6. 2 miles from the Caldas de São Jorge hot springs. Each spacious room features a seating area with cable TV, a work desk, and bright decor with wooden furnishings. '

112876.description:
This apartment hotel boasts a prime setting in Madrid. Boasting an exceptional location close to the city's best commercial, cultural and leisure areas, this hotel is sure to impress. Guests will find themselves within easy access of Puerta de Alcala and Buen Retiro park. The Museo del Prado art gallery and the national library are just 1. 5 km away. The hotel lies just 50 metres away from public transport links. The centre of Madrid is just 2 km away. This stablishments offers a comfortable, relaxing home away from home. The hotel offers facilities and services to meet the needs of every type of traveller. 
Includes cleaning services from Monday to Friday, weekends and Bank Holidays there is no cleaning services, however at your arrival you will find your accommodation cleaned. 
Also includes free basic wifi, however its funcionality can be altered depending on the number of users at the same time.

112877.description: This family-friendly apartment hotel provides the perfect accommodation for business travellers, families and those on holiday. The hotel features a bright, attractive décor. In the vicinity, guests will find the Coslada train station, which provides easy access to the centre of Madrid. There is a shopping centre only 800 m from the hotel. Only 5 km away, is the IFEMA Campo de las Naciones exhibition grounds and the Madrid Congress Palace. This is the perfect hotel for trips to the enchanting Spanish capital.

112879.description: The B&B Hotel Fuenlabrada is located in the south of Madrid, near the Cobo Calleja industrial area, near Getafe Air Base and the Warner Park. It has 110 stylish, exterior rooms, with natural light, a large work desk, LCD TV and a bathroom. It offers quality accommodation at an affordable price in South Madrid. It has a spacious and modern lounge in the hall where coffee and tea will be offered 24 hours. In addition, it offers you a meeting room. Throughout the hotel, both in the rooms and public areas, high speed WiFi is provided. The B&B Hotel Fuenlabrada is the ideal place to stay for leisure or business in the south of Madrid. It has a parking, so if you come by car, the access is really easy from the M50 beltway, which is the artery that encircles Madrid. The location is excellent: only 4 km from Cobo Calleja industrial area, 7 km from the Getafe Air Base, 20 km from the Warner Park and just 22 km from the Puerta del Sol in Madrid. It is the perfect solution for travelers looking for a budget and quality hotel but well connected.

112934.description: This friendly hotel is conveniently situated in Kumkapi, one of the quarters that form the historical centre of Istanbul. It features a restaurant, a bar and a rooftop terrace with great views over the city. The Sultanahmet district with its famous attractions such as Grand Bazaar, Topkapi palace, Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern or Hippodrome is just a short stroll away.

112954.description: This hotel enjoys a great location just a few short steps away from the city centre and near to some of the city's most famous landmarks. The popular Avenida 9 de Julio, the Obelisco and the Colón Theatre are all in its immediate vicinity, while closest metro stop is just a 5-minute walk away and Calle Florida is some 500 metres away. Business guests can find Congreso de la Nación and the Plaza de Mayo just a 5-minute drive away, while the huge shopping complex of Galerias Pacifico sits at only 1 km. Besides its top-notch location this city hotel offers its guests very good service and pleasant ambience. They can spend the leisurely afternoon with a freshly made pastry and a strong coffee at the onsite snack bar, while surfing the web thanks to the hotel-wide WiFi access. A morning newspaper is provided along the continental breakfast to ensure that the guests will be ready for the day.

113074.description: The Hôtel Fior d'Aliza enjoys an ideal location near renowned department stores and the Garnier Opera House, just minutes from the Sacré-Cœur Basilica and Montmartre. This charming 3-star hotel is adorned with a romantic 19th-century theme, creating an elegant Parisian atmosphere. Rooms are fully equipped with modern amenities, including Wi-Fi throughout the hotel and complimentary international newspapers. Enjoy a pleasant stay in Paris at this delightful hotel. Please note: City tax is not included in the price from July 1, 2015.

113134.description: Plaza El Bosque Ebro offers plush, self catering rooms with stylish decor in Las Condes. Free parking and WiFi are provided. La Moneda palace is 15 minutes drive away. The 24-hour front desk can make arrangements for shuttles to Comodoro Merino Benitez Airport, which is 23. 2 km away. Plaza El Bosque Ebro is located right by El Bosque Norte avenue, popular for its upscale restaurants and shops. whereas the elegant Enebro offers international and Chilean specialties. Drinks and snacks can be enjoyed on the terrace bar.

113155.description: Centrally located in Paris, Hotel Lumen Paris Louvre is within a 15-minute walk of Palais Garnier and Louvre Museum. This 4-star hotel is 1. 1 mi (1. 8 km) from Champs-Élysées and 1. 5 mi (2. 4 km) from Notre-Dame. Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Make yourself at home in one of the 37 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and coffee/tea makers. Take advantage of the hotel's room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Rue de Rivoli - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi- Tuileries Garden - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Palais Royal - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- Place Vendôme - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Place de l'Opéra - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Grands Boulevards - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Paris Olympia - 0. 9 km/0. 5 mi- Les Halles - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Palais Garnier - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Place de la Madeleine - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Place de la Concorde - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Galeries Lafayette - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Boulevard Haussmann - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Orangerie Museum - 1 km/0. 6 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 30. 7 km/19. 1 mi Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 20 km/12. 4 mi The preferred airport for Hotel Lumen Paris Louvre is Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG).

113164.description: This residence is 2 miles from Porte de Versailles, and a 10-minute walk from the Malakoff-Plateau de Vanves Metro station. It features furnished studios with equipped kitchens and free Wi-Fi access. Each studio also has a private bathroom, an office area and a flat-screen TV. A continental breakfast is served every morning in the dining room at the Séjours & Affaires Paris-Malakoff. The Séjours & Affaires Paris-Malakoff is in a quiet area, overlooking 2 parks. It is 3 miles from central Paris and private parking is available on site. *Reception opening hours: Monday to Friday from 7:00 am to 11:00 pm. Saturday and Sunday from 8:00 am to 23:00 pm.

113233.description: Located in the heart of Santiago, Four Points by Sheraton Santiago is within a 5-minute drive of Costanera Center and Clinica Santa Maria. This hotel is also conveniently located 3. 1 miles from both Santiago Town Square and the National History Museum. Enjoy recreational opportunities such as a health club and an outdoor pool. Stay connected with complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and take advantage of the concierge services and television in the common area. An area shuttle is available for a surcharge. The hotel's 127 guestrooms feature minibars, LCD televisions, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Savor international cuisine at Buganvilia Restaurant, one of the hotel's two dining venues, or enjoy room service during limited hours. A bar/lounge is also available. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. For business travelers, the hotel offers complimentary wired internet access, a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and five meeting rooms.

113294.description: The hotel is located in the heart of Providence, Santiago, a few steps from the Los Leones metro station and surrounded by one of the most active commercial centres of the city. Links to the public transport network are just a few metres from the hotel. The establishment offers 102 rooms, suites and fully equipped apartments as well as Internet access throughout the premises. The rooms are spacious and comfortable with a contemporary style and atmosphere of warm and neutral colours. All accommodation units are en-suite and fitted with a safe, cable TV, radio and telephone. The apartments feature kitchens equipped wit a list of appliances and kitchenware so that guests will find it easy to prepare their own meals.

113398.description: Novotel Wavre Brussels East provides 102 modern, comfortable rooms in natural surroundings with free private outdoor parking. Six conference rooms for up to 120 people and all kinds of meetings and events are available. Our Resto Bar Blomi offers excellent international cuisine and the bar enables you to enjoy a refreshing drink with a selection of Belgian beers in a pleasant atmosphere. The hotel has an outside swimming pool with a beautiful terrace.

name.content: Voco Times Square South New York By IHG

113415.description: Escape to a tranquil oasis at voco® Times Square South New York. Unwind in chic rooms with stylish comfort and stunning views of Hudson Yards and Manhattan West. Indulge in craft cocktails and small plates at Finches Den or host events in our modern spaces designed for every occasion. Located just two blocks from Penn and Moynihan Stations, our West Midtown hotel offers an unbeatable location near Hudson Yards, the High Line, Times Square, and the Theatre District. Explore the city’s best attractions, catch events at Madison Square Garden, or enjoy a leisurely stroll through Central Park. With impeccable service, contemporary accommodations, and a prime location, experience the best of New York City at voco® Times Square South.

113416.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at the Mayafair Design Hotel, including complimentary Wi-Fi, a gift shop, and tour/ticket assistance. An area shuttle is available (surcharge). All-inclusive rates cover meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments, though some restaurants, special dinners, dishes, beverages, and other amenities may incur extra charges. The hotel features a restaurant, a grocery/convenience store, and a bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily (fee applies). The 47 air-conditioned rooms offer flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, desks, and blackout drapes/curtains. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Daily housekeeping is provided. The hotel offers express check-out, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and free self-parking. Located near West Coast of Isla Mujeres, Punta Cancun, and Punta Nizuc National Park, the hotel is also close to Plaza Caracol Mall, Playa Ancha, and UltraMar Ferry Terminal. Cancun International Airport (CUN) is 24 km away.

113455.description: This family-friendly business hotel is located in the charming Riviera del Brenta, a lovely area rich in history and noble buildings along the Naviglio River. Just 15 minutes from Venice and Padua, it's an ideal base for exploring the Veneto region. A bus stop in front of the hotel provides easy access to both cities. Dolo's town center and bus station are 2. 5 km away, and Mira train station is approximately 4 km away. Jesolo Beach is roughly 54 km from the hotel, while Marco Polo Airport (28 km) and S. Angelo Airport (35 km) offer convenient flight options. Built in 1884 and fully restored, this historic hotel is one of the Veneto region's most prestigious. Guests enjoy unforgettable stays, whether traveling for business or leisure. The hotel offers ten Venetian-style rooms, a lobby with 24-hour reception, a TV lounge, a bar, and a restaurant. Conference facilities, room service, laundry service (fees apply), and parking are also available. Guest rooms feature en suite bathrooms with shower, bathtub, and hairdryer, along with double or king-size beds. Some rooms boast views of the centuries-old park from a terrace or balcony. Amenities include a TV, fridge, safe, direct-dial telephone, internet access, a washing machine, and air conditioning. A continental breakfast buffet is served daily, while lunch and dinner are offered à la carte.

113456.description: This first-class hotel occupies a modern, avant-garde building in Marcon, near Venice. Just six minutes from Marco Polo Airport and 15 minutes from Venice's city center, the hotel offers convenient access to public transport, situated 400 meters from Gaggio Porta Est railway station and close to a major shopping mall. The elegantly appointed guest rooms and suites provide relaxing spaces with superior fabrics and materials, large windows, and a combination of wood and carpeted floors. Corporate travelers can utilize the state-of-the-art congress center, while two on-site restaurants offer delicious dining options for all guests.

113537.address: Via Don Orione, (Navigator:Via G. Di Vittorio), 18-20
113537.description: This city and business hotel is located in Novate Milanese, in the heart of a pleasant rural area close to Milan. Guests will find themselves just a 5 minutes' walking distance from the town centre, while the bustle, style and excitement of Milan lies 10 km away. This wonderful hotel is located just 4 km from Milan's exhibition grounds. Nearby attractions include San Siro Stadium and the Monza GP Circuit. The hotel is conveniently situated within 35 km of Linate and Malpensa airports. This charming hotel provides the perfect solution for business and leisure travellers seeking a peaceful, yet convenient setting. The hotel features beautifully-designed guest rooms, 8 state-of-the-art meeting rooms and exemplary facilities and services, delivering comfort and convenience to suit every type of traveller.

name.content: Hilton Garden Inn NY West 35 Street

113555.description:
Hilton Garden Inn New York/West 35th Street is a modern Midtown Manhattan hotel that underwent a full renovation in 2026. Located on West 35th Street between Fifth and Sixth Avenues, the hotel is within walking distance of the Empire State Building, Macy’s at Herald Square, Times Square, Madison Square Garden, Fifth Avenue shopping, and the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade route. 

The hotel is also conveniently located near Penn Station, the Port Authority Bus Terminal, Grand Central Terminal, and multiple subway lines, providing access to destinations throughout Manhattan and the surrounding area. 

The hotel features 298 fully renovated guest rooms, many offering views of the Empire State Building and the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade route. Guest rooms include 50-inch flat-screen TVs, Keurig coffeemakers, complimentary WiFi, and spacious work areas with large desks and ergonomic chairs. 

Onsite amenities include Shop+, offering grab-and-go breakfast options daily, as well as snacks, beverages, sundries, gifts, and gourmet coffee. A lobby bar with seasonal outdoor seating provides a casual place to relax and unwind. Additional amenities include a 24-hour fitness center, wireless printing station, digital concierge, and selfie station. The hotel also features a flexible boardroom for meetings and small events. 

Additional guest conveniences include room-key access elevators, on-site security, self-parking, and pet-friendly accommodations for a fee. The hotel is 100% non-smoking. 

Located approximately 20 miles from John F. Kennedy International, LaGuardia, and Newark Liberty International Airports, Hilton Garden Inn New York/West 35th Street offers a convenient Midtown Manhattan location for both business and leisure travelers.

113558.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. You can enjoy a meal at WXYZ serving the guests of Aloft New York LaGuardia Airport, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in East Elmhurst? This hotel has 1001 square feet (93 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary (available on request). Make yourself at home in one of the 148 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected.

113623.description: Don't miss out on recreational opportunities including a steam room and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Enjoy Regional cuisine at Ristorante Conte Camillo, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and a meeting room. Guests may use a train station pick-up service for a surcharge, and limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 119 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

name.content: Hotel Cristoforo Colombo – Preferred Hotels & Res

113624.description: The Hotel Cristoforo Colombo, a 4-star establishment, enjoys a prime location on Corso Buenos Aires in Milan's city center. This central location makes it an excellent choice for business and leisure travelers, as well as those seeking a shopping-focused city break. The hotel is easily accessible from railway stations and international airports, with the Porta Venezia metro station (red line M1) just 20 meters away. Many of Milan's iconic landmarks, including the Duomo, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele, Teatro alla Scala, and the Quadrilatero fashion district, are within walking distance or a short tram ride. As part of the Worldhotels group, the hotel maintains its individual character and style.

113636.description: Suites Avenue Barcelona Luxe offers a new concept of accommodation in Barcelona. A recently-constructed avant-garde building with 41 luxury tourist apartments, fully-equipped spaces for comfortable medium to long-term stays. Personalized attention and an unsurpassable range of exclusive services are available: gym, sauna, exterior swimming pools, communal terrace, function rooms, parking and a museum that showcases unique pieces of Hindu and Buddhist art. The spectacular stainless steel façade, designed by renowned Japanese architect Toyo Ito, is a departure from neighboring classical buildings and draws the attention of both Barcelona residents and tourists alike. Since opening its doors in 2009 Suites Avenue Barcelona Luxe has become an architectural icon and a benchmark for luxury stays in the heart of Barcelona. Located on the central Passeig de Gràcia, the Suites Avenue boast a superb location with spectacular frontal views of Guadí's Modernist La Pedrera building. Surrounded by international boutiques, restaurants, terraces and the best nightlife the city has to offer, there's no better place to enjoy Barcelona's charms. *Pets: only small dogs.

113657.description: The modern Nuevo Boston hotel is located in the financial district near Barajas Airport, a short drive from both the IFEMA exhibition center and Wanda Metropolitano Stadium. Guests enjoy free Wi-Fi and a complimentary 24-hour airport shuttle service (reservations required, limited availability; please call from the airport for pickup). The hotel boasts excellent facilities and stylish decor for a pleasant stay. Breakfast is served from 7:00 to 10:30 am on weekdays and 8:00 to 11:30 am on weekends and holidays. The swimming pool is open from June 1st to August 31st. Parking is available for a fee.

113813.description: The hotel enjoys a fantastic location in the heart of the bustling city centre, just 150 metres from Taksim Square and its many shops, restaurants and bars. The Bosphorus Straits are a 20-minute walk from the hotel and the sights of Sultanahmet, including Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and Topkapi Palace, are 25 minutes away on public transport. The hotel's decor is a combination of Art-Nouveau, Baroque and Ottoman styles. Amenities include an attractive restaurant/bar with a bistro atmosphere and a rooftop terrace bar and in the summer. Furthermore, there is a meeting room and a business service centre. The rooms are decorated and furnished in an elegant and classical manner, and are fitted with modern comforts. Amenities include air conditioning and heating, Internet access and a private terrace.

113854.description: CIN CODE: IT027042A12MZQ6RKW This enchanting hotel is located in Riva degli Schiavoni, in front of the island of San Giorgio, offering magnificent views over the dome of the stunning Basilica della Salute, Punta della Dogana and the wonderful island of Giudecca. Other nearby attractions include the beautiful Bridge of Sights, Palazzo Ducale, St. Mark's square, and a wide choice of charming cafés where to enjoy a delicious espresso. Guests wishing to explore the island of Lido can take a vaporetto or water taxi. This elegant property offers an excellent service based on attention to detail. The tastefully decorated guest rooms are furnished in a pleasant art deco style, some of them featuring magnificent views over St. Mark's Basin. The restaurant serves a wide choice of delicious Venetian and Italian dishes, prepared with fresh, top quality ingredients.

113878.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Good Morning + Berlin City East, located in the heart of Berlin, just a minute's drive from the Stasi Museum and nine minutes from Alexanderplatz. This hotel offers 241 guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and en-suite bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy buffet breakfast, a bar/lounge, and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, gift shops, and bike storage. The hotel also features conference space and four meeting rooms, totaling 1507 square feet. Free self-parking is available onsite.

114016.description: The hotel is located on Sheikh Zayed Road between the Mall of the Emirates and Ibn Battuta Shopping, only a 5 minutes' walk away from the Internet City Metro Station, opposite Dubai Media City, and adjacent to Emirates and Montgomery Golf Clubs. This is an exclusive new property offering luxurious, spacious and tastefully furnished guestrooms, complete with state-of-the-art-technology. The hotel has 343 guest rooms across ten sizes and styles, and a total of six restaurants, lounges and bars. The hotel offers the Jasmine Spa, an outdoor swimming pool, hot tub and gym.

114028.description: Enjoy a stay at Maison Pigalle, located in the heart of Paris, just a short walk from the Moulin Rouge and La Machine du Moulin Rouge. This hotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services, as well as room service and a daily breakfast buffet (available for a fee). The 38 guestrooms feature iPod docking stations, flat-screen TVs with cable programming, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. The hotel also provides dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and an airport shuttle (surcharge applies). Palais Garnier and Galeries Lafayette are within a kilometer of the hotel.

114029.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Hotel Daunou Opera, located in the heart of Paris, just a short walk from iconic landmarks like the Palais Garnier and the Place Vendôme. This hotel offers 50 guestrooms equipped with minibars, flat-screen televisions with cable programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) and take advantage of convenient amenities such as concierge services, a 24-hour business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The hotel is also within a 5-minute drive of the Champs-Élysées and conveniently located near the Grands Boulevards and Paris Olympia.

114030.description: This city hotel is situated just a few steps away from the famous Louvre Museum, the Forum des Halles and a few minutes away by metro from Paris' major monuments, including Cathedrale Notre Dame de Paris, Saint-Germain des Près, the Champs Elysées and the Eiffel Tower, as well as shops such as Printemps or the Lafayette. With the nearest metro station just 150 m from the hotel and Gare de Lyon train station just 3. 5 km away, guests can discover one of the world's most renowned cities with ease. Numerous restaurants and a park can also be found at the hotel's doorstep. Nearby airports include Orly (17 km), Charles de Gaulle (25 km) and Beauvais-Tille (80 km). With its cosy style, the hotel is a perfect cosy retreat from where guests can either enjoy the historical and cultural richness of its surrounding environment or rest in between professional appointments. The air-conditioned hotel offers guests 26 rooms in total and a number of facilities, including a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, lift access, breakfast room, WLAN Internet access and a laundry service. Guests will enjoy resting in the warm and cosy style rooms which have double glazed windows and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. They all have their own private bathroom with shower and hairdryer and are equipped with wifi Internet access, flatscreen TV, a telephone, safe and double bed. A breakfast buffet is served each morning.

114031.description: This family-friendly eco-hotel is ideally located between Montmartre (Sacré-Coeur Basilica) and the Opera House, less than a three-minute walk from two metro stations (Saint-Georges and Pigalle). Built in 1900, this charming hotel offers 31 guest rooms and several amenities, including a 24-hour reception, safe, luggage storage, and a breakfast room. Guests enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and access to a nearby public car park. A lift provides access to the upper floors, and the hotel also features a bar and a private garden. The rooms are equipped with either a large double bed or two single beds, accommodating one or two guests. Each room includes an en suite bathroom with a bath or shower, a TV, Wi-Fi, a minibar, a hairdryer, and central heating. A breakfast buffet is served daily.

114032.description: This charming city hotel is located in Paris' 14th arrondissement, within the famous Montparnasse area, close to the train station and surrounded by this lively district's numerous cinemas, theatres and cabarets. Pernety metro station is a 3-minute walk from the hotel, Orly Airport is approximately 10 km away and Charles de Gaulle Airport is around 25 km away. At the corner of two streets overlooking a small public garden, the hotel attracts the eye with its beautifully crafted facade, its wrought iron ornamentation and flower-filled balconies. Facilities available to guests at the hotel include a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, lift access, a TV lounge, breakfast room, WLAN Internet access and room service. Each of the rooms has a countertop, double glazed windows, cable TV with foreign channels, high-quality bedding, a direct dial telephone and complimentary WiFi Internet access as well as a private bathroom with shower and hairdryer. A double bed, in-room safe and ironing set also feature in all rooms as standard. Generous continental breakfasts are served in the breakfast room or can be delivered to the room (for no extra charge).

114035.description: Located in Berlin's Reinickendorf district, the Good Morning Berlin City West hotel offers convenient access to Schloss Charlottenburg and Gendarmenmarkt, both within a 15-minute drive. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, an on-site shop, and a vending machine. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast for a fee, served weekdays from 6:00 AM to 9:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. The hotel also features a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and limited on-site parking. The 70 guestrooms are equipped with LCD televisions, cable programming, and private bathrooms with showers. Blackout drapes/curtains and daily housekeeping are provided, and cribs/infant beds are available upon request. Brandenburg Gate and the Berlin Zoo are approximately 5 miles from the hotel.

114048.description:
Enjoying a strategic situation on the beautiful Riviera del Brenta region, this nice and enchanting hotel sits around a 20 minutes drive from Padua and the popular city of Venice, full of sightseeing attractions and interesting things to do and see. 
Thus, this is the best accommodation choice for everyone who wishes to discover the cultural and historical treasures that hide in these two important Italian cities. 
All the 57 rooms and suites are lavishly appointed with exclusive amenities to ensure a truly comfortable stay. They are fully equipped and feature a cosy atmosphere in which guests will feel like at home. The well-furnished and versatile conference facilities allow all business travellers to hold their meetings at the on-site facilities. 
Moreover, if visitors wish so, they can wake every morning and taste a delicious, comprehensive breakfast buffet at the hotel restaurant.

114062.address: Derb Ben Amrane 5 Riad Zitoun Lakdim, 5
114062.description: The hotel is located in the historical heart of Marrakech, in the 'Riad Zitoun Kedim' district. The establishment offers a harmonious balance between the past and the present by offering all the comforts of a modern guesthouse. Fully air-conditioned, the establishment offers guests 8 rooms, a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. Other facilities are a hotel safe, lounge, breakfast/dining room and WLAN Internet accesses are offered, besides two luminous patios with garden and swimming pool. The guesthouse provides guests with an outdoor swimming pool and sun terrace with sun loungers. The hotel rooms and suites, spacious and traditionally designed, await guests in a refreshing and peaceful haven.

114064.description: This charming guesthouse is located in La Medina in a small street, only 5 minutes from Djemaa el Fna Square with its market, and close to all other attractions of the city. This cosy Marrakech hotel combines the very best of Morocco's traditional riad hospitality with the latest in modern comfort and facilities. The air-conditioned riad offers very personalized service. Guests who wish to return home with a tan are welcome to the outdoor complex featuring a swimming pool and a sun terrace with loungers and parasols. Guests can enjoy some quiet entertainment at the lounge or surf the web through the WLAN Internet access provided. Room facilities include individually regulated air conditioning and heating, a private bathroom and attentive room service.

114065.description: Enjoying an idyllic setting on the banks of the river Tensift and only 4 km from the entrance to Marrakech, this fantastic resort and spa offers a perfect combination of fun, relaxation and traditional Moroccan hospitality. Guests may take advantage of a free shuttle service to visit the city of Marrakesh and the Lake Takerkoust is only a 30-minute drive away. Decorated in a typical Moroccan style, the establishment offers charming guest rooms, fully equipped with all the modern comforts expected by today's traveller. Visitors can discover authentic Moroccan specialities at the on-site restaurant, which also serves some delicious European dishes. The property offers an extensive choice of activities such as excursions, quad biking, dromedary rides and much more. Guests can also enjoy a well-pampering session at the on-site spa, which offers different massages and beauty treatments as well as a traditional Hammam.

114075.description: The Dazzler Camberland is a comfortable city hotel strategically located next to route 8, Panamericana, which provides an easy access to the rest of the city and to Buenos Aires. It is within easy reach of several malls and leisure areas. The hotel boasts spacious rooms, a nice pool with a surrounding garden as well as private parking in front of each room. The hotel features fantastic facilities and multilingual staff to guarantee a great stay both for business trips or leisure holidays.

114095.description: Surrounded by historic buildings that are rich in tradition, this city hotel serves as the ideal base for expeditions in the heart of Vienna. The local tram stop is just 200 metres away and the local train station can be found at a similar distance. Vienna International Airport is approximately 10 km from the property. The daylight-bathed atrium, with its lounge and bar, is the focal point of this modern building, which was completed in 2007. It is from here that guests access the 309 comfortably appointed rooms and suites, as well as the fitness and vitality area, featuring cutting-edge equipment. The 8-storey building is fully air-conditioned and offers various facilities catering to the needs of both corporate and leisure travellers.

114096.description: The hotel is nestled in the medina of Marrakech. Situated between the avenue El Fetouaki and the Mellah, near the most prestigious monuments, guests are within 400 m of the famous square Djamaa el Fna. Guests can reach the bus and train stations by public transport in around 10 and 15 minutes respectively. Menara International Airport of Marrakech is located approximately 5 km from the hotel. The riad boasts an enchanting terrace with a panoramic view enables guests to admire the Koutoubia Mosque and part of El Badi Palace. Travellers may completely unwind in the spacious and delightfully appointed rooms and suites, some of the units are accessible. They feature an opulent Moroccan décor complemented by top-notch comforts. Guests may indulge in sumptuous Moroccan dishes served at the beautiful dining lounge or on the rooftop terrace with garden. Those who seek relaxation may take a cooling dip in the charming courtyard pool or treat themselves to a massage available on-site.

114099.address: 222, Derb El Kadi Bab Aylen Medina, 222
114099.description: This hotel is set in a traditional, residential area of the medina, yet is only a 15 minute walk from the famous Place Djemaa al Fna. Menara - Marrakech Airport is only 6 kilometres away. The property has a comfortable living room, and a sunny, secluded roof terrace with sunbeds and parasols. There is a parking facility close by. Breakfast and other meals are available in the restaurant. Hotel staff can help organise day trips, recommend and book restaurants and hammams, and assist with anything else you require. The hotel comprises traditionally decorated guest rooms, around a spacious central courtyard.

114100.address: Sidi Ben Slimane, N°1 Derb Si Mouh
114100.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and a steam room. Additional features at this riad include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Amina, a restaurant which specializes in Moroccan cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 8 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 16 individually decorated guestrooms.

114116.description: Breakfast and unlimited WIFI included in all rates at the ibis Styles Paris Mairie de Clichy. This hotel is ideal for cultural and business trips alike. Located 55 yards (50 m) from the Mairie de Clichy stop on metro line 13, which will get you to the center of Paris in 10 minutes. The hotel is within easy reach of all the business districts in northwest Paris. With an array of restaurants and stores close to the hotel, make the most of everything Paris has to offer, with peace and quiet too.

name.content: Four Points by Sheraton Venice Mestre

114117.description: Don't miss out on recreational opportunities including a sauna and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Mestre? This hotel has 2153 square feet (200 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 168 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is available. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and bidets.

114118.description: This hotel is well located in Navalcarnero. The property is situated just 25 km away from the captivating city of Madrid, where many cultural and historical attractions can be found. Guests will find a number of shops, restaurants and entertainment opportunities just a short driving distance away. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. This modern hotel offers the ideal option for business and leisure travellers alike. The guest rooms are superbly styled, offering the utmost in comfort and convenience. Fully soundproofed, the rooms ensure peaceful slumber. The hotel features a restaurant, as well as a conference room.

114194.description: A beacon of personalized hospitality and Egyptian heritage, the Waldorf Astoria Cairo is an exclusive gateway to authentic experiences, where unforgettable moments are curated for each and every guest. Located in Heliopolis, described as the most “Mediterranean” part of the metropolis, designed to serve as an oasis for those who wish to stay away from the crowded downtown Cairo. our hotel boasts luxury accommodations, elegant design, unparalleled dining and events. This hotel represents our door to Africa, the first Waldorf Astoria to Egypt, where ancient Cairo meets a new sophisticated luxury era.

114238.description: The ibis Dubai World Trade Centre Hotel is part of the Dubai World Trade Centre complex. Located off Sheikh Zayed Road and next to World Trade Centre Metro Station, the hotel enjoys direct links to both the airport and Dubai International Convention and Exhibition Centre. ibis Dubai World Trade Centre hotel offers complimentary shuttles to Jumeirah Beach, Dubai Mall and other major malls, and is also well connected for sightseeing trips to historic Bur Dubai.

114239.description: Hotel that makes every moment matter. Check in to 4-star comfort right at the Novotel World Trade Centre Dubai hotel. Your airy contemporary room gives you space to spread out and work or relax with the skyline views. Start the day fresh with a buffet breakfast off the trendy lobby, and wind it up with live jazz at Blue Bar at Novotel.

114313.address: Kucuk Ayasofya Mah. Yusuf Askin Sok. Kadirga, 28
114313.description: The Best Western Antea Palace Hotel & Spa boasts a prime location in Istanbul's historic Old City, offering stunning views of the Marmara Sea. Just a short walk from iconic landmarks like the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Topkapi Palace, this hotel ensures a memorable stay. Its 58 rooms, ranging from standard to deluxe suites and family rooms, feature a postmodern Turkish and Ottoman design. Each room is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi, an LCD TV with satellite channels, a comfortable orthopedic bed, a bathrobe, and a quiet air conditioner. Many rooms also include balconies with breathtaking sea views. Guests can savor delicious Ottoman and Turkish cuisine at the Antea Terrace Restaurant while enjoying panoramic views. After a day of exploring, unwind at the hotel's spa with a traditional Turkish bath, sauna, steam room, and swimming pool. Massages are also available upon request.

114316.address: Mahmutbey Mah. Tasocagi Yolu Cd. Bagcilar, 35
114316.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an indoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Guests at ADM Grand Hotel can get around on the complimentary shuttle, which operates within 10 kilometers. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-out. Planning an event in Istanbul? This hotel has 2691 square feet (250 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 4 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 334 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions.

114318.address: inonu Cd. Dunya Saglik Sk. No.11 Taksim-Beyoglu, 11
114318.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul's vibrant Taksim Square, the Star Hotel Taksim offers convenient access to the city's bustling atmosphere. Just steps from Taksim Metro Station and a short walk from the Bosphorus ferry, the hotel provides a 24-hour front desk, elevator, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Each accommodation features a living room with a flat-screen TV, a comfortable sitting area, and a work desk. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. Guests can explore the nearby shops, restaurants, and cafes along Taksim Square and Istiklal Street. An airport shuttle service to both Istanbul and Sabiha Gokcen Airports is available every 20 minutes.

114373.description: Nestled in the charming Jordaan district of Amsterdam, often referred to as 'the garden, ' this hotel offers an ideal base for exploring the city's many attractions. A leisurely 15-minute walk leads to popular destinations such as Leidseplein Square, Museum Square, and Vondelpark. Schiphol Airport is conveniently located less than 11 kilometers away. Guests can unwind after a day of sightseeing with a wide selection of beers and refreshments at the on-site pub. The hotel provides comfortable, modern rooms designed for a restful stay, complete with all essential amenities. Check-in begins at 2:00 PM and continues until midnight. Luggage storage is available for a small fee. A delicious continental breakfast buffet is offered each morning from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM for €15 per person. While centrally located, the hotel is situated in a quiet residential area, so guests are kindly requested to be mindful of noise levels after 11:00 PM.

114508.description: This hotel is conveniently located 200 meters from public transportation and 1 kilometer from restaurants, bars, and the town center. The air-conditioned establishment offers a range of facilities, including a lobby with reception, conference facilities, Wi-Fi, a café, a bar, a restaurant, laundry service, and parking. Each room features a private bathroom with a hairdryer, a king-size or double bed, a TV, a minibar, background music, a radio, individually controlled air conditioning, central heating, and electric blinds. Guests can enjoy a large outdoor swimming pool in the garden and relax on the sun terrace with parasols.

114513.description: Located near Gatwick Airport, this hotel offers 218 guestrooms with LCD TVs, digital programming, and private bathrooms. Enjoy amenities like a fitness center, garden, restaurant, bar/lounge, and room service. Business travelers appreciate the 24-hour business center and meeting rooms. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available in common areas, while in-room Wi-Fi is available for a surcharge. Buffet breakfast is offered daily (fee applies). The hotel provides a convenient airport shuttle (surcharge) and on-site parking (fee applies). Nearby attractions include Manor Royal Business Park and Gatwick Aviation Museum.

114597.description:
The hotel is located close to the heart of the city centre in Doha. The location offers shopping centres and exhibition centres in the vicinity of the establishment. The ideal location of the hotel provides tourists with a good opportunity to explore Doha and its surrounding areas.

The hotel offers 110 elegant, luxurious accommodation units, great business and relaxation facilities and excellent services for a true taste of hospitality. All of the hotel's sophisticated suites are luxurious and comfortable, and the hotel's great relaxation facilities offer guests the perfect way to unwind after a hard day's work. The hotel offers all the services and amenities guests need and the value they expect. Facilities available to guests at this air-conditioned hotel include a lobby, hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, lift access and a hairdressing salon. Guests may also enjoy a drink in the café, dining in the restaurant, and can make use of the conference facilities, WLAN Internet access, room and laundry services and a car park.

The hotel's guestrooms provide home-like comfort in an atmosphere of exclusivity. All the hotel's suites are well-equipped, with all the modern comforts and facilities guests need, including a double bed, air conditioning and high-speed Internet access, which is also available throughout the hotel,

There are various means to unwind at the hotel including a gym, barbecue facilities, an outdoor swimming pool and a golf course within 3 km of the hotel.

The hotel offers exquisite wining and dining options in its restaurants and cafés, which serve delectable cuisines from around the world.

114601.description: La Villa Hotel provides flawless service and all the necessary amenities for your visit. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, allowing you to stay connected. For your convenience, pre-book our airport transfer service. Guests arriving by car can enjoy free on-site parking. Smoking is permitted only in designated areas. Start your day with a stress-free breakfast served on the premises. Enjoy freshly brewed coffee each morning and savor delicious meals throughout the day. Maintain your fitness routine at our well-equipped fitness center. For entertainment, take advantage of the various activities offered at the hotel.

114653.address: ISKENDER PASA MAH. SEKERCI SK. NO:20, No:20/A
114653.description: Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and a television in a common area. A complimentary local cuisine breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and an elevator. Make yourself at home in one of the 42 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and slippers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and a turndown service. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Laleli Mosque - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Historia Fatih Shopping Centre - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Beyazit Square - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Fatih Mosque - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Istanbul University - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Grand Bazaar - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Yenikapi Ferry Terminal - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Süleymaniye Mosque - 1. 7 km / 1 mi- Cemberlitas Bath - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Golden Horn - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi- Little Hagia Sophia - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Sultanahmet Square - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Basilica Cistern - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 43. 8 km / 27. 2 mi Istanbul Airport (IST) - 41. 8 km / 25. 9 mi A stay at Hotel Melita places you in the heart of Istanbul, within a 5-minute drive of Historia Fatih Shopping Centre and Grand Bazaar. This hotel is 2. 3 mi (3. 7 km) from Sultanahmet Square and 2. 5 mi (4. 1 km) from Blue Mosque.

name.content: Crowne Plaza Riyadh Palace, an IHG Hotel

114743.address: Prince Abdulrahman Bin Abdulaziz St, P.O. BOX 2691
114743.description: Crowne Plaza Riyadh Palace, is strategically located in the district of ministries, government departments and other banks and hospitals in Riyadh. Close to Historical attractions like the King Abdul Aziz National Museum, Al Masmak Palace, less than 30 minutes’ drive from King Khalid International Airport. The hotel offers 304 elegant rooms and suites. Enjoy a variety of food and drink options throughout the day from fine dining to lighter meals. Work or relax at your leisure with convenient in-room dining. Re-energize with various facilities like a health club, an outdoor pool, Jacuzzi and a sauna. Stay at the Crowne Plaza Riyadh Palace and let us host your next event in Riyadh.

114794.address: Ataturk Caddesi Kizlarpinari Mahallesi H.Senli Sok, 3/A
114794.description: Situated near Kleopatra Beach, the Kleopatra Royal Palm Hotel is 1 km from Alanya Centrum and 50 m from the beach. Antalya Airport is 118 km away. The hotel offers a variety of activities and entertainment for all ages. The 24 m² rooms feature ceramic flooring, split air conditioning, satellite TV, a music channel, a safe (extra charge), a telephone, a minibar (extra charge), a bathroom with a shower, toilet, and hairdryer, and a balcony. Expert animators provide unlimited activities and entertainment throughout the day, from belly-dancing lessons to beach volleyball on the hotel's sandy beach.

114814.description: Located on Gran Vía Avenue, this beautiful building is within walking distance of many of the city's main attractions, cinemas, theatres, and shops. This refined hotel has a rooftop terrace with a stylish bar and spectacular views over Madrid. True to its literary theme, the hotel boasts a well-stocked library. Amenities at this air-conditioned hotel include 24-hour reception and check-out service, cloakroom, lift access, café and a restaurant. Conference facilities, wireless Internet access, room service and a laundry service are also available. The hotel will have a swimming pool on the top floor from the end of June 2018.

114853.address: Via Francesco De Pinedo - Case Nuove
114853.description: Welcome to the Holiday Inn Express Milan-Malpensa Airport, a smart hotel near Milan Malpensa Airport. Enjoy free parking, Wi-Fi, and daily complimentary breakfast from 5:00 am to 10:00 am. Our 121 contemporary, soundproofed rooms feature wood floors, air conditioning, digital TV, Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers. We offer triple and connecting rooms, accommodating up to five guests. The 24-hour bar and evening diner offer various food and beverages. A self-service breakfast buffet is included with your stay. Vending machines are available in the lobby. Free external parking is available during your stay. Inquire about our Park, Stay, and Go program for long-term parking (fee applies). Two electric vehicle charging stations are available. Private transportation to and from Malpensa Airport can be arranged (fee applies; contact reception in advance). Explore the Volandia Aviation Museum (1. 5 km away), cycle or walk through Ticino Natural Park (14 km away), or enjoy a day trip to Lake Como or Lake Maggiore, including Arona, Stresa, and the Borromean Islands.

114871.description: This comfortable city hotel offers budget accommodation within walking distance of Rembrandt Park in Amsterdam's Baarsjes district. It is located 13km from Schiphol airport, and Lelylaan train station is just two tram stops away. A short drive or tram ride will bring visitors right to the city centre, where leisure travellers might wish to tour the Rembrandt House Museum or Allard Pierson Museum. The hotel's cosy guest rooms are all en suite and offer colour televisions. Each morning guests can wake up to a breakfast buffet, and guests might also take advantage of the outdoor terrace to relax with a book or chat with friends on warm, sunny days. Whether travelling to Amsterdam for business or leisure, this hotel's accessible location makes it a great choice.

114872.description: Enjoy a central Amsterdam stay at the Aston City Hotel, steps from the Heineken Experience and a short walk from the Rijksmuseum. This hotel offers 24 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Take advantage of amenities such as free Wi-Fi, bicycle rentals, and tour/ticket assistance. Other conveniences include a 24-hour front desk and luggage storage. The Van Gogh Museum and Leidseplein are within a mile.

114878.description: Situated in a tranquil Paris neighborhood near the Champs-Élysées, Parc Monceau, and the fashionable Ternes district, this charming boutique hotel offers a sophisticated retreat for both leisure and business travelers. The surrounding area boasts a vibrant array of theaters and restaurants, conveniently served by various public transport links. The hotel's comfortable, modern rooms and suites feature stylish decor and thoughtful amenities, promising a memorable stay. Guests can enjoy a delicious homemade breakfast buffet in the hotel restaurant or opt for the privacy of in-room dining.

114898.description: Parkside Hotel Apartments are ideally located in Discovery Gardens, just a short walking distance from Ibn Battuta Mall. The property has 169 rooms including deluxe studio and deluxe one bedroom apartments. All rooms have a fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning, desk, hair dryer, internet access, ironing board, in-room safe. The Parkside Hotel Apartments ensures the highest standard of hospitality for families, business and leisure guests, for both short and long term stays. This excellent hotel in Dubai also has 24hr room service, coffee shop and laundry service/dry cleaning. Our 6th floor also offers a fully equipped gym for those who like to keep fit; it is open to all guests. With a full range of popular amenities and friendly, caring staff, it's no wonder guests keep returning to Parkside Hotel Apartments. The Parkside Hotel Apartments is a non-alcoholic property but there is a wide variety of bars and clubs within the area for those who want to enjoy and experience the exciting nightlife Dubai has to offer. Free wifi is available in public areas only, we can provide an airport shuttle (chargeable) and provide entry visas (chargeable). *

name.content: Al Khoory Hotel Apartments - Al Barsha

114900.description: The Al Khoory Hotel Apartments in Al Barsha, Dubai, offers well-equipped, stylish suites near Ski Dubai and the Mall of the Emirates. Each soundproofed suite features a designer bathroom and modern kitchen. Guests can enjoy the outdoor pool, gym, sauna, and on-site restaurant. The hotel also provides free Wi-Fi in rooms and the lobby. Please note that a Tourism Dirham Fee of AED 10 per room, per night applies.

114913.description: The Ramada London Stansted Airport, built in 2009, is conveniently located near motorway junction 8 off the M11, just four miles from Stansted Airport. This hotel offers free Wi-Fi, complimentary newspapers, and digital Freeview flat-screen TVs with over 60 channels in each of its executive and interconnecting family rooms. Guests can enjoy a full English breakfast (for a fee) and 24-hour reception service. On-site amenities include a cash machine and adjacent petrol forecourt and food court. Parking is available for £5 per night. All rooms feature triple-glazed windows, walk-in wet rooms with power showers, coffeemakers, and Hypnos deluxe beds. Taxis are available upon request. Cambridge City is 14 miles away, London Docklands a 25-minute drive, and Olympic Park a 20-minute drive. Please note that pets are not allowed.

114914.description: This hotel, conveniently located a short taxi ride from London Stansted Airport, offers a variety of rooms, including executive rooms and rooms with laptop safes. All rooms feature flat-screen TVs with 60+ digital Freeview channels and free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. Guests can also take advantage of on-site parking, 24-hour reception, and pet-friendly accommodations (fee applies). Additional amenities include hot drinks and snacks available for purchase at reception, a free newspaper, and a cash machine.

name.content: Southcrest Manor Hotel BW Signature Collection

114993.description: Built in 1921, this former manor house offers 63 stylish bedrooms, each featuring modern decor and contemporary conveniences.
