Guests enjoy complimentary access to a fully equipped fitness suite, outdoor hydrotherapy hot tub, and Swedish & infrared saunas. The elegant Laura Ashley-designed restaurant and bar, inspired by the hotel's stunning surroundings, provides a uniquely British setting for special occasions. The menu offers a range of delicious dishes, including the popular Sunday roast, along with an exciting cocktail menu and an extensive wine list. In the charming Laura Ashley Tea Room, guests can enjoy a delightful afternoon tea experience, featuring homemade sandwiches, fresh scones, beautiful cakes, and a selection of teas, catering to all dietary requirements. The Elemis-approved Manor Health & Beauty Club offers a unisex range of luxury products and treatments. The hotel also caters to a variety of events, from interviews and conferences to private dinners and weddings, with a range of meeting rooms and outdoor spaces.

114996.description: Our Edinburgh Haymarket hotel is located in Edinburgh's elegant West End, perfect for those wanting a quiet base within touching distance of everything the Scottish capital has to offer. And we're just around the corner from the train station. Set in a listed Georgian building, it's great whether you're in town for the Festival, Edinburgh Castle, world-class shopping and restaurants or just want to soak up the vast history and culture of this majestic city. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals.

114997.address: King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud St,Umm Suqeim 3, .
114997.description:
Nestled amidst tranquil gardens, waterways, exclusive pools, and Madinat Jumeirah's private beach, the intimate and exquisite summerhouses of Jumeirah Dar Al Masyaf offer newly refurbished, elegant, and spacious guest rooms and courtyards. Enjoy personalized butler service and an understated Arabian luxury experience. These summerhouses provide an exquisitely designed hideaway, representing the premium accommodation at this Arabian resort in Dubai. Each summerhouse features a traditional Arabian Majlis, or living room, where guests can enjoy refreshments. Transportation within the resort is available via traditional abra boats, on foot, or by golf buggy, providing access to the resort's numerous restaurants. Jumeirah Dar Al Masyaf, featuring Arabian Gulf and Ocean villas, was completely redecorated in the summer of 2015. For those seeking ultimate luxury, the resort also offers Jumeirah Malakiya Villas, hidden within Madinat Jumeirah's captivating waterways and architectural marvels. These villas boast spacious bedrooms, oversized marble bathrooms, generous living spaces, fully furnished kitchens, and private terraces overlooking the waterways and resort. The word 'Malakiya' translates to 'royal' in Arabic, epitomizing the level of luxury guests can expect. The seven independent villas are designed for those seeking spacious opulence, seclusion, and impeccable service with complete discretion. 
**Within the hotel, there are select operations being adjusted on a temporary basis, including the ongoing closure of Wild Wadi Waterpark and the suspension of Abra boat services. The enhancement project is due for completion by Q4 2026.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Dubai, Internet City

114998.description: Welcome to the Holiday Inn Express Dubai Internet City. Stay in the heart of the Knowledge Village, minutes from Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Beach. Start your day with complimentary Express start Breakfast buffet. Enjoy our fully equipped 24-hour Fitness Centre and stay productive in our 24-hour Business Centre. Take advantage of our a complimentary high-speed wireless Internet, fast enough for you to download that important presentation or just connect with friends. Host a sales meeting, training sessions or an informal get-together at one of our three naturally lit meeting rooms with space for up to 110 delegates. The hotel is strategically located in TECOM (Internet City, Media City and Knowledge Village), a perfect location for those visiting Eye of Dubai, and close to the Jebel Ali Port Free Zone. Being close to the largest malls in Dubai, Madinat Jumeirah, Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah, offers our leisure travellers the variety to choose between shopping, dining, entertainment and beaches. Pack your bucket and head to Jumeirah Beach or catch the hotel's complimentary shuttle to the Mall of the Emirates where you can combine shopping with indoor skiing. Rejuvenate yourself with refreshing cocktails in our lobby bar, and indulge in enticing international cuisines in our Great Room. Come and stay for a memorable experience in Dubai.

115100.description: Located in East Disneyland Paris, this hotel offers 100 cozy guest rooms and on-site Wi-Fi. The reception operates from 7:30 am to 8:00 pm, Monday to Friday, and 8:00 am to 7:00 pm on weekends. Families will appreciate the specially designed family rooms, which include a cot for children (available only in the four-person apartments, not studios). Small pets are welcome. Parking is available upon request and reservation, and some services may incur additional charges.

115197.description:
The hotel is located in the heart of Marrakech. It is close to the Bahia Palace and metal works and it is 5 minutes to the Jemaa el Fna square. There is a bus station about 10-minutes' walk away and Marrakech-Menara Airport is approximately 5 km away from the establishment.

This family-friendly guest house was inspired by the magnificence of the Palais Bahia which is quite close by. It offers its guests contemporary oriental charm, comfort and tradition. This is a riad of exception in Marrakesh, the luxurious guest house offers 5 spacious suites such as the romanticism of the Chamade suite. Intimate and devoted to guests' well-being, the guest house has thought of the smallest of details to help visitors escape day-to-day stresses and to taste the pleasures of life instead. Discreet but always available, the team will gladly respond to each of the guests' needs to guarantee them an unforgettable stay. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services. Facilities at the air-conditioned establishment include a hotel safe, hairdressing salon, TV lounge, bar and restaurant. Guests can take advantage of the hotel's Internet access, room service and laundry service.

The spacious suites are full of character and each one is decorated with its own individual style. From the romanticism of the Shalimar suite to the zen-like ambience of the Joy suite. Each one has an en suite bathroom with a bathtub and hairdryer. The double or king-size beds are fitted with Egyptian cotton sheets. Amenities include a telephone, plasma-screen TV with satellite reception and internal channel, WLAN Internet access, a safe, mini fridge and both tea and coffee making facilities. A washing machine is provided for added convenience. Air conditioning and heating are standard features in all accommodation.

115203.address: Avenue Du President John Fitzgerald Kennedy, 1
115203.description: Discover this charming, discreet business hotel and restaurant in the heart of the Saint-Germain forest, in an unusual location amidst nature, yet close to Paris. Guests will find Saint-Germain-en-Laye and its numerous restaurants, bars, clubs, shops and train station just 2 km from this charming design hotel, and a bus runs past the hotel's front door, connecting them easily to other parts of city. The Palace of Versailles is approximately 15 km from the hotel, and Paris is around 16 km away. Nearby airports include Orly (42 km), Charles de Gaulle (47 km), Beauvais-Tille (80 km) and Brussels Airport (329 km). The hotel's design follows the rhythm and the ever-changing seasons and colours of the Ile de France skies. Surrounded by the park and its trees, the hotel has 25 high-quality rooms and 5 apartments. Renovated in 2008, the hotels offers guests a number of facilities, including a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, cloakroom and lift access, a bar, restaurant, conference facilities and a car park. For an additional fee, guests may also make use of the Internet access and room and laundry services. Each room has a different decor, just the right blend of charm and modern comfort, each one expressing its very own personality. It has not overlooked the functional aspects either - each room is equipped with satellite TV, canal+ TV, a direct dial telephone, minibar, safe and hairdryer. An en suite bathroom with shower, a king-size bed, radio, Internet access and individually regulated air conditioning also feature in all rooms as standard. Some rooms feature a private terrace and some have a balcony. There is a golf course just 2 km from the hotel, and guests may also enjoy a game of tennis or go horse riding. Fees apply to all sport and leisure activities.

115204.description:
Different conditions and supplements may apply for bookings of 5 rooms or more. 

Different conditions and supplements may apply for bookings of more than 15 nights. 

The hotel restaurant will be closed on the following dates:

- April 6 at lunchtime
- May 1 and 8
- May 25 at lunchtime
- July 14
- August 10 to 24 inclusive
- December 24 to January 4, 2027 inclusive

New Year's Brunch will be available on January 1, 2027. 

Breakfast is available from 7am to 10:30am Monday to Friday inclusive and from 7:30am to 10:30am inclusive on Saturday and Sunday.

name.content: The Royale Chulan Hyde Park Hotel London

115212.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at The Royale Chulan Hyde Park, including complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall. Room service is available during limited hours. The hotel also offers a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and an elevator. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The 52 guestrooms feature kitchenettes equipped with refrigerators and stovetops, flat-screen televisions with digital programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Desks and electric kettles are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Located in London's City Centre, the hotel is within a 10-minute walk of Kensington Gardens and Portobello Road Market, and a short distance from Kensington Palace and Hyde Park.

115215.description: Situated at 31st and Madison in the Flatiron/NoMad district, The Hotel AKA Nomad offers a central location for exploring NYC. This boutique hotel on fashionable Madison Avenue exudes old-world charm with chic, unconventional interiors by Anna Busta. Its 194 spacious guest rooms, some featuring private garden terraces, provide a stunning retreat. Guests enjoy amenities such as a 'Breakfast Pantry' stocked with treats from local culinary icons like Petrossian, Sarabeth's, Balthazar, and Ceci Cela, along with handcrafted cuisine and cocktails curated by Jonathan Morr. The hotel also boasts unique decor, including celebrity photos adorning the lobby's exposed brick walls, and restful guest rooms blending uptown elegance with downtown cool, designed by Annette Jaffe. Committed to guest safety, the hotel adheres to protocols developed in conjunction with the AHLA and CDC.

115356.description: This stylish guesthouse is located in the centre of Madrid, just 150 metres from Gran Vía. It is 200 metres from the nearest metro station, providing it with quick access to all points of interest in the city. The hotel consists of 35 guestrooms with a contemporary décor, featuring flat-screen satellite TVs. Here guests can enjoy amenities such as an elegant lounge with a large flat-screen TV, a computer room with free Internet access and an airport shuttle, which is available upon request. Drinks and snacks can be obtained from vending machines in the lobby. Parking is possible at a nearby location.

115362.description: The Royal Garden Champs-Elysées, a 4-star hotel, places you in the heart of Paris, a short walk from the Champs-Élysées and the Arc de Triomphe. Enjoy views from the terrace and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The 72 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include bathtubs, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Room service is available, and you can unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfast is served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (for a fee). Additional amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

115398.address: Sheik Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard, PO BOX 123234, 220
115398.description: Towering high at 302 metres across 63 levels, Address Downtown is a veritable landmark of luxury, situated in the very centre of Downtown Dubai. The hotel directly overlooks Burj Khalifa, offers uninterrupted views of the daily Dubai fountain show (the world's tallest water-music spectacle) and is connected to The Dubai Mall (the world's largest shopping mall) by a pathway-bridge. The 220 guest rooms and suites are equipped with high-speed wireless Internet, interactive TVs with Apple AirPlay devices, an entertainment interface, dressing areas with Hollywood mirrors and L-shaped sofa seating area. The marble bathrooms are fitted with dual sinks, a bathtub and a rain shower. Guests can choose among 9 unique restaurant concepts, serving a variety of cuisines from Asian to Latino, as well as local Middle Eastern specialities. The in house Neos Bar is located on the 63rd floor and overlooks the ever-changing Dubai skyline and Dubai Fountain View. As a a wellness destination with state-of-the-art Technogym centre, Address Downtown also offers an exclusive spa with 9 treatment rooms. Business guests can make use of the versatile meeting rooms and world-class amenities ensure that the stay is marvelously memorable, while young children can look forward to reveling in the immersive activities in Qix club. The hotel is located next to Souk Al Bahar. Popular nearby attractions include the notorious Burj Khalifa skyscraper , the Dubai Fountain and the Dubai Mall, the greatest in the world. A limousine shuttle service is available upon request and airport transfers can also be arranged. Private parking is free.

115399.address: Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard, S/N
115399.description: Set in a traditional palatial residence, Palace Downtown overlooks Dubai Fountain and the lake surrounding Burj Khalifa. It features an Arabian-style spa and a gym with personal trainer. The guest rooms of Palace Downtown hotel are decorated in a contemporary Middle Eastern style and offer balconies and luxury bathrooms. All rooms are equipped with an interactive TV system, DVD player and free WiFi. Four different restaurants provide fine dining opportunities, ranging from Argentinian meat to Thai curries. All-day eateries serve a buffet of Mediterranean and Middle Eastern dishes. Leisure facilities at Palace Downtown include a palm-fringed outdoor pool and the spa offering facial and body treatments. Guests can also enjoy a Hammam, monsoon showers, hot tub and steam rooms. Palace Downtown is located a 5-minute walk from the Dubai Mall and the Souk Al Bahar shopping and entertainment centre. The property offers transfers from Dubai International Airport to the hotel upon request.

115413.description: Ideally located next to the Excel Centre, only 40 minutes to Central London by public transport, 20 minutes from the O2 Arena by public transport and 20 minutes by car. London City Airport is just 1 mile away. Conveniently located for Prince Regent DLR station. Our London Docklands (Excel) Premier Inn has everything you'd expect, incredibly comfy beds in every room and an integrated restaurant serving a mix of traditional and contemporary dishes. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

115493.description: The hotel is located on the coast at Serik. Public transport connections are within around 200 m of the hotel, and the touristic centre is 2 km away. Nearby attractions include Aspendos and the waterfalls at Kursunlu and Manavgat, around 30 and 35 km away respectively. The beach hotel consists of 235 rooms, and welcomes business and leisure guests with a large range of services and facilities provided for a pleasant stay. The hotel has 1 indoor and 1 outdoor swimming pool with a waterslide, children's swimming area, poolside snack bar and sun loungers. Guests may enjoy massages and SPA treatments and a wide range of water sports and events.

115494.description: Set in thoughtfully restored building overlooking the Atlantic, Grande Hotel da Povoa offers neatly furnished rooms with private bathrooms on Povoa do Varzim's seafront promenade. It features a casino next door. This seaside hotel provides contemporary rooms which were recently fully renovated. All have an intimate décor, air conditioning and have satellite televisions. The private bathroom is equipped with a shower and hairdryer. A daily 100% Halal breakfast buffet is served in the dining room or on the terrace. The hotel's restaurant with panoramic sea views offers unique Portuguese dishes and steaks. Lunch and coffees are available from the café. Porto city center can be reached within one hour from Póvoa de Varzim Metro Station, 2 minutes' walking from the hotel. The trip to Francisco de Sá Carneiro Airport, on the same line, takes only 15 minutes.

115518.description: This city hotel is located in the old and historic area of Istanbul, in Sehzadebasi. The city centre can be reached within a 15-20 minute walk, or the local tram, which is just outside the hotel, can be used. Within walking distance, guests can find major historical sites such as the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia Museum, Topkapi Palace, the Underground Cistern, Hippodrome and Archaeological Museum. The hotel offers traditional Turkish hospitality. Sabiha Gökçen International Airport is around 62 km away and Atatürk International Airport is approximately 12 km from the hotel.

115519.description: This high quality SPA hotel comprises a total of 172 rooms, including rooms for disabled guests. A number of amenities and services needed to ensure a comfortable and pleasant stay are provided. All rooms have parquet flooring, luxury furniture and decoration elements. The highest service standards are offered to guests in their rooms. In addition to a bath in the en suite bathroom, rooms are fitted with amenities such as a 26-inch interactive LCD TV with satellite channels and Internet access. Guests can make use of the hotel's swimming pools which also have a children's swimming area. Refreshments are served at the poolside snack bar and guests can relax on sun lounges. Further relaxation can be gained in the sauna and steam room or with a massage or SPA treatment.

115521.address: Sehit Muhtar Mah Kurabiye Zambak Sk No:1, 1
115521.description: Located in the heart of modern Istanbul, just a few meters from Istiklal Avenue and Taksim Square, the Santa Ottoman Hotel is 100 meters from Taksim Metro Station. It offers Ottoman, Baroque, and boutique-style rooms with air conditioning, flat-screen TVs with cable channels, and free Wi-Fi. All rooms include complimentary tea/coffee making facilities, a minibar, and a safety deposit box. Bathrooms feature a hairdryer and free toiletries. The hotel's 24/7 reception and tour desk can assist with exploring the city, including easy access via the nearby metro and bus station to key areas like the historic Sultanahmet district (home to the Grand Bazaar and Hagia Sophia), and the iconic Galata Tower. Enjoy a rich daily breakfast and traditional dishes at the restaurant, or a refreshing drink at the bar. Room service is also available. The Lutfi Kirdar Convention and Exhibition Centre is a short 10-minute walk away.

115522.description:
The Albatros Premier Hotel perfectly located main heart of Old City Center called Sultanahmet. All the major attractions are walking distance max 5-8 minutes, such as St. Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, Hippodrome, Basilica Cistern and many other sides. The Marmara Seaside is just 2-3 minutes walking distance. The Hotel area is guiet & safe. With the local transportation system nearby, you will enjoy easy access to the Bosphorus, Taksim Square, and the biggest shopping centers of Istanbul. 
The designed rooms offer air conditioning, satellite TV, a minibar, and a hairdryer for a comfortable stay. A continental breakfast is served. 
The Hotel is 40 km to Istanbul Airport and 55 km to Sabiha Gokcen Airport. 
There is shuttle bus from Istanbul Airport to Sultanahmet area name is HAVAIST. Sultanahmet bus sttaion is just 2-3 minutes to walking distance to Albatros Premier Hotel.

115562.description: Nestled between Montmartre's Sacré-Coeur and Gare du Nord, this charming 40-room city hotel offers convenient metro access to the Champs-Élysées, Opera, theaters, and Stade de France. Recently renovated, it presents a unique Parisian experience, ideal for couples and families seeking a blend of charm and serenity. A 4-star hotel, it features a 24-hour reception, safe, lift, and on-site parking. Guest rooms include a shower, hairdryer, TV, internet access, iron, ironing board, and safe. A buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 am to 10:00 am.

115568.description: The NH Milano Fiera hotel is set in a beautiful building designed by the famous architect Dominique Perrault. The 2 minimalist towers form part of the FieraMilano trade fair and exhibition center. The city center, where you will find all of Milan's main attractions, is only a 20-minute drive away. Many of the 398 rooms at NH Milano Fiera offer spectacular views over Milan and each is designed in a chic minimalist style. The modern hotel offers a range of home comforts including air-conditioning and free Wi-Fi. The breakfast buffet, which offers a wide variety of mouthwatering dishes, along with freshly brewed coffee and hot tea, will energize you for the day. You can order á la carte Italian dishes or enjoy a buffet meal at our hotel restaurant, Nhube, during the peak season. Each tower has a bar on the ground floor. The Nhube Bar offers chic cocktails and the Tower H Bar serves snacks and drinks, sometimes accompanied by live music. A gym and private parking are also available. A perfect space for conferences and events, NH Milano Fiera has 16 rooms and can accommodate 220 people. Our staff will be happy to provide you with catering and technology for all of your meetings.

115570.description: This beautiful boutique hotel is excellently located in the historic district of Sirkeci, conveying an unobtrusive air of elegance. The most important sights of Istanbul such as Topkapi palace, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque or the Spice Bazaar are just a short stroll away; the centre of Sirkeci with its restaurants, shops, public transport and the train station can be reached in only a few minutes.

115571.description: This beautiful hotel is located in the 14th arrondissement of Paris, close to Denfert-Rochereau Square and to the charming Daguerre market street, where visitors will find an array of delicious fresh produce. They will also appreciate the cosy and picturesque cafés surrounding the hotel as well as the restaurants offering both French cuisine and specialities from all over the world. Some of the nearby attractions visitors can explore include The Paris Catacombs, the Cartier Foundation for Contemporary Art and the world-renowned Montparnasse district. The tastefully decorated accommodation units are spacious and feature a charming décor, providing functional amenities such as Wi-Fi internet connection and iHome station. A tasty breakfast is served every morning for guests to kick-start their day and they can enjoy a relaxing moment in the sitting area or have a snack at the honesty bar.

115574.description: This modern hotel is ideal for business guests, just 2 metro stops away from the ICC and the international trade fair centre. Charlottenburg Palace and the Opera are within walking distance; attractions such as Kurfürstendamm Boulevard with its elegant shops, Victory Column, Reichstag building, Brandenburg Gate, Potsdamer Platz square or the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church are within easy reach. The metro station “Bismarckstraße” is situated only 100 metres away where guests can have an access to famous attractions such as the Olympic Stadium, the Berlin Zoo and Friedrichstrabe. The hotel offers cosy and comfort rooms, equipped with air conditioning, work desk, safe, hair dryer, coffee & tea facilities and flat-screen TV. Business guests may use the meeting space of the hotel which can seat up to 30 people.

115593.address: Kucukayasofya Mah Demirci Resit Sk No:14, 14
115593.description: The hotel is centrally located in the Old City, only a few minutes' walk from the Blue Mosque, St. Sophia, Topkapi Palace and other tourist attractions. The establishment used to be a wooden edifice built in the 19th century as a private home. In 1980 it was rebuilt in its original Ottoman style and opened as a hotel in July 1990. Ever since then, it has offered traditional Turkish hospitality for guests from all over the world. There are 25 rooms at this historical air-conditioned property. Guests can take advantage of the WLAN Internet access, as well as the other amenities offered. Each room has an en suite bathroom with a shower and is furnished with double beds.

115597.description: AXYHOTELS InnStyle Milano is a new 4**** a stone's throw from the shopping street of Corso Buenos Aires and 50 meters from the M1 Porta Venezia metro stop. Its modern rooms, all with private bathroom, are equipped with every comfort such as a 55'' Smart TV, Super Fast Wi-FI, safe and minibar. There is a free gym with Tecnogym machinery, a Lounge Cafè and Terrace with an honesty bar and a Coworking space.

115598.description: Special Protection, our commitment to ensuring a safe stay with strict cleaning and sanitization protocols. Technologies to support the interaction with the staff to promote social distancing. Healthcare insurance throughout the stay in partnership with AXA Partners. The Best Western Hotel Cavalieri Della Corona is an elegant hotel close to Malpensa Airport. It is the ideal place to combine refinement and class with your travel and work needs in a warm atmosphere. Amenities of the property include restaurant, meeting center for up to 160 guests, an American Bar, fitness center, outdoor swimming pool and ATM. We look forward to accommodating your travel needs. Enjoy your stay.

115613.description: The Bermondsey Square Hotel is located in the heart of Bermondsey, London. This 90-room hotel is designed to meet the needs of discerning guests, from business travellers to party people, to those simply looking to relax and enjoy the local attractions. Bermondsey is one of London's most happening areas, with great galleries, boutiques, bars and restaurants, all within a stone's throw of the City Centre, the London Eye, Shakespeare's Globe and TATE Modern amongst other attractions. With a thriving restaurant, bar and clubs, art galleries, design studios and boutique shops are located just a short distance from the hotel as well as main attractions like the Design Museum, Borough Market, Tate Modern and Tower Bridge, the Bermondsey Square Hotel is the ideal place to stay.

115758.description: This hotel enjoys a great location in Getafe. It is just a 10 minutes' driving distance away from Madrid. Guests will find themselves just a 15 minutes' driving distance away from Parque Warner Madrid. Many intriguing attractions can be found in the surrounding area. A host of shopping, dining and entertainment venues can be found nearby. This peaceful hotel enjoys an attractive design, set amidst large gardens for added serenity. The guest rooms are spacious and comfortable. The hotel features an outdoor pool, where guests can enjoy a leisurely swim. Guests are sure to be pleased by the wide range of convenient facilities that the hotel has to offer.

115759.city: SAN LORENZO DE EL ESCORIAL MADRID
115759.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Stop by the hotel's restaurant for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 36 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have jetted bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Auditorio San Lorenzo de El Escorial Theater - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- El Real Coliseo de Carlos III Theater - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Friars' Garden - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Prince's House - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Casita del Infante - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Church of San Bernabe - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Real Club de Golf La Herreria - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- La Silla de Felipe II - 3 km / 1. 9 mi- Luis Ceballos Arboretum - 3. 2 km / 2 mi- Abantos - 4 km / 2. 5 mi- Forestal Park Madrid-Guadarrama - 13. 7 km / 8. 5 mi- Valley of the Fallen - 13. 9 km / 8. 6 mi- Megacampo - 14. 7 km / 9. 1 mi- Pilas del Navazo - 14. 9 km / 9. 3 mi. The nearest major airport is Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD) - 71 km / 44.

115772.description: The Hilton Garden Inn New York/Manhattan-Chelsea enjoys a prime location in the fashionable Chelsea district, just south of Times Square. Our 169 newly appointed guest rooms offer king or queen beds with the Garden Sleep System, 48' HD flat-panel TVs, mini-refrigerators, microwaves, and coffeemakers. Enjoy complimentary wired and wireless high-speed internet access, and start your day with free morning coffee, tea, and a copy of USA Today. An on-site fitness center and business center cater to your needs. Nearby attractions include Penn Station, Grand Central Station, Madison Square Garden, the Empire State Building, and Times Square, all within easy walking distance. Explore the vibrant nightlife, award-winning restaurants, museums, and shopping of Chelsea, Greenwich Village, and SoHo.

115774.address: Topcu Cad. No:11 Taksim Beyoglu ISTANBUL, 11
115774.description:
Arts Hotel Taksim is a modern and elegant city hotel located in the heart of Istanbul, just a few steps from Taksim Square. Ideal for both business trips and leisure stays, the hotel offers guests a blend of comfort, sophistication, and exceptional service. Its convenient location within walking distance of the city’s cultural, artistic, shopping, and entertainment venues allows guests to fully experience the vibrant spirit of Istanbul. 

Welcoming guests with comfortably and modernly designed rooms, Arts Hotel Taksim offers a rich open-buffet breakfast to start the day. The hotel’s restaurant serves refined flavors throughout the day, while its spa, sauna, and fitness facilities help guests enjoy a relaxing and rejuvenating experience. The professional team, prioritizing guest satisfaction, provides attentive service to meet every need with care. 

Thanks to its proximity to Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue, guests can easily access significant historical and cultural landmarks as well as major business centers. The hotel is also conveniently close to convention centers and transportation networks, making it an ideal choice for both business and leisure travelers. 

Designed to offer guests a unique accommodation experience that blends the charm of Istanbul with comfort and quality, Arts Hotel Taksim highlights tranquility, elegance, and high standards of service in every detail.

115775.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul, connecting Europe and Asia, Revia Square Hotel is situated in Taksim, right in the center of Istanbul, the city's most important hub for business, art, entertainment, shopping, and conference events. Revia Square Hotel is located just 100 meters from Taksim Square, 100 meters from the Metro, 2 km from Galata Tower, 1, 4 km from Galataport, and 1 km from Lütfi Kırdar Congress Center, providing easy access to all locations in Istanbul

name.content: Four Sides Taksim Lion Hotel and SPA

115776.description: Treat yourself to a relaxing massage at the on-site spa. This Istanbul hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and convenient gift shops. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or order 24-hour room service. Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Each of the 104 air-conditioned rooms provides a cozy fireplace, safe, minibar, and daily housekeeping service. Located in the heart of Istanbul, Lion Hotel is within a 10-minute walk of Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue. This spa hotel is also near Dolmabahçe Palace (0. 7 mi) and Galata Tower (1. 6 mi). Istanbul Airport (IST) is the preferred airport.

115777.address: Topçu Caddesi No:10 Taksim Istanbul Turkey, 10
115777.description: Golden Age Istanbul, with its location and uniquely themed decor, offers guests an unforgettable stay in the heart of Istanbul. One of the first hotels in the area, it was renovated in 2015 with artifacts from various ancient civilizations, blending modern architecture with historical elements. Featuring sculptures, reliefs, ceramics, and oil paintings on its floors, meticulously crafted by skilled artists, the hotel bridges civilizations of different eras with contemporary architecture. With floors designed around artifacts from the Hittite, Trojan, Phrygian, Hellenistic, Archaic, Persian, Classical Greek, Western Roman, and Eastern Roman periods, Golden Age Istanbul boasts a total of 173 rooms, including 13 Standard Rooms, 111 Superior Rooms, 32 Deluxe Triple Rooms, 7 Connection Rooms, 7 Junior Suites, 2 King Suites, and 1 Disabled Room.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London Heathrow T5

115835.description: The comfortable, 300-bedroom Holiday Inn Express London - Heathrow Terminal 5 is conveniently located a short 10-minute drive from the terminal. With an included Express Start Breakfast and ample on-site parking (fee applies), we offer everything you need for a great stay, whether for business or leisure. The hotel provides easy access to numerous local companies and business parks, including Balfour Beatty, Travelport, DHL, and Royal Mail. Slough Trading Estate, home to many global headquarters, is only 5 miles away. Just minutes from the M25, M40, and M4, and situated outside the newly extended ULEZ zone, the hotel offers convenient links throughout Greater London. Direct trains from nearby Slough station can whisk you to London Paddington in just 20 minutes. The hotel's seven well-equipped meeting rooms can host up to 120 guests, with packages available for all events, from day delegate and all-inclusive rates to room hire, residential conferences, private dinners, and social celebrations. For leisure travelers, Windsor Castle and Windsor Racecourse are a short drive away. Families with children will find the Holiday Inn Express T5 a perfect base for visiting Legoland® Windsor Resort. Relax and enjoy a meal and a drink in our Great Room Restaurant and Bar after a busy day.

115837.description: The hotel boasts a convenient location in Dubai's Bur Dubai district, placing guests near numerous commercial and shopping centers. Ideal for both leisure and business travelers, it's a short walk from the metro station and a 20-minute drive from Dubai International Airport and a public beach. Downtown Dubai, Sheikh Zayed Road, and the Burj Khalifa are just a 10-minute drive away. Following recent renovations, the hotel's 84 well-equipped studios and one-bedroom apartments offer a comfortable and relaxing stay. Each unit is tastefully decorated and features modern amenities. Guests can enjoy the rooftop swimming pool and sundeck, or stay active in the gym, complete with saunas and hot tubs.

115865.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including a fitness center and bicycles to rent. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and shopping on site. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Papillon, a restaurant which specializes in international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Berlin? This hotel has 18019 square feet (1674 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 15 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 186 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions.

115953.description: A paradise for couples and families with children, this large hotel complex consists of modern buildings and well-manicured gardens bordered by tall palm trees, all just a five-minute walk from Kemer. Antalya Airport can be reached with an hour drive. The hotel features a 180-metre private beach in addition to a variety of pools and an aquapark. Public transport passes in front of the hotel, providing easy access to Kemer, and guests will be able to reach places of interest such as Antalya's old town and harbour in under an hour's drive. The hotel's sleek guest rooms feature modern décor with laminated parquet or carpeted floors, an en suite bathroom, satellite LCD televisions and free wireless internet access. Guests can choose from seven bars and four restaurants specializing in seafood, Italian and Turkish cuisines, and spend warm, sunny days relaxing by one of the pools or enjoying the entertainment programme.

116059.description: The Bogotá Plaza Hotel, located in Bogotá's vibrant northern district, offers convenient access to the city's financial centers, diverse culinary scene, shopping, and tourist attractions. Its elegant and spacious rooms provide stunning city views and amenities such as Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a minibar, and a work desk. Guests can unwind at the hotel's spa, featuring a steam bath, solarium, water circuit, and gym. Savor delicious breakfasts and explore the flavors of Latin American and Colombian cuisine at La Macuira restaurant.

116062.description: Located on Avenida 15 and Calle 100 in the city of Bogota this hotel is executive, modern concept, in a strategic point surrounded by shopping malls, theme parks and embassies, which places it near the World Trade Centre and the National Theatre La Castellana. Its location and facilities make it the best choice for a memorable stay. With a luxurious lobby, the hotel offers stylish rooms with complimentary high- speed free wireless internet access and city views. Only a 10-minute drive from Bogota's commercial area, the hotel is a 2-minute walk from the Barraquer Eye Clinic. The rooms feature city views and are equipped with air conditioning, cable TV and DVD players. All have minibars and bathrooms with baths. There is free private parking on site.

116073.description: The total number of guest rooms is 18. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. Riemergasse Appartements provides 24-hour reception.

116074.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center or unwind on the terrace. This hotel also offers complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Savor lunch or dinner at The Ambassador, specializing in French cuisine, or enjoy room service (during limited hours). Conclude your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself at home in one of the 64 individually decorated guestrooms, each featuring a minibar and an espresso maker. Flat-screen televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

name.content: Windsor House INN BY GEH SUITES

116183.description: The elegant Windsor House is conveniently situated in the financial district of Bogotá, the capital of Colombia, in the exclusive neighbourhood of the Park 93. The Military University Nueva Granada and the World Trade Center are only a few steps away. Attractions such as the Andino and El Retiro commercial centres with their shops and restaurants are within walking distance. El Dorado International Airport is just a short drive away. This hotel is a great choice for business and leisure travellers alike.

116184.description: The Hotel Dann Carlton Bogota is one of the most recognized of the Dann Chain and located close to Calle 100 in the north of Bogotá. Less than 2 km from the most luxurious entertainment venues, restaurants, shopping centres, supermarkets, pharmacies and miscellaneous stores, this hotel is in a prime location, with easy access to public transportation. Hotel services include a car park and garage, a laundry service, 24-hour room service, currency exchange, a medical service and Wi-Fi. The hotel welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe and lift access, a hairdressing salon, games room, cafe, bar, restaurant and conference facilities. We have adopted a Biosecurity Management System that covers all those involved in our value chain, all cleaning and disinfection processes have been strengthened and in this way we provide security to our collaborators, clients and all our visitors. Dann Hotels in accordance with the Health Emergency COVID-19, at the time of Check-in, Colombian guests are asked for identification of the EPS (Health promoting entity) and for our foreign guests support or to have active international medical assistance insurance . Due to the coronavirus (COVID-19), some facilities or services of the Hotel, will present closings or schedule changes, more information will be provided at the time of check in.

116186.description: Located in the center of Bogota, 45 minute's drive from El Dorado International Airport. It's a 15 minute walk from the Park 93, thanks to its central location, surrounded by lively bars and restaurants. The hotel is a classic and elegant style preserves the European boutique hotels. Its architecture is Art Deco, ideal for business. It offers spacious, stylish and well equipped, decorated with mahogany wood for a pleasant stay. The guest will know the restaurant specializes in international cuisine and a full bar that serves exotic cocktails.

116187.description: This hotel is in a prime location, surrounded by the main industrial areas of the city, in a more developed urban area of Bogota. Salitre Plaza shopping centre and Gran Estación are close to the hotel and guests will find restaurants, bars, nightlife, shops and public transportation links in the vicinity. Facilities include a lobby with a 24-hour reception, hotel safe and lobby bar, as well as a business centre with conference facilities, restaurant, WLAN Internet access, 24-hour room service, a laundry service, and a car parking.

116188.description: The hotel enjoys a privileged location in La Candelaria, the historical and cultural centre of Bogotá. The area surrounding the hotel is richly steeped in history and offers today's guests an insight into the country's heritage. The atmosphere of the old La Candelaria district transcends time via the history and memories preserved in museums, art collections, libraries, churches, theatres, buildings and streets, keeping the past very much alive. Guests will find the bus rapid transit station Museo del Oro just 50 m from the hotel. It is 300 m from the nearest nightspots and 400 m from restaurants, bars and pubs. The big old market buildings are Spanish-influenced neoclassical style, also called a Republican. You can see the richness of its architecture in the hallways, courtyards and thick walls erected in the nineteenth and early twentieth century. This historic hotel, ideal for families, is perfect for guests traveling for business or pleasure and has a total of 33 rooms including 15 suites. The air-conditioned establishment include a lobby with reception and 24-hour check-in/check-out, hotel safe, currency exchange, hairdresser, games room, plus a cafe, bar and restaurant. Guests, business travelers in particular will appreciate the conference room and WLAN Internet access. Guests are offered room service and laundry facilities, parking and garage for those arriving by car. The rooms feature classic Italian-style décor and keep alive the Bogotá of days gone by, breathing a historical atmosphere into guests' stay. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a shower/bathtub and a hairdryer, and each one also offers a double or king-size bed. They are each equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, hi-fi system with radio, Internet access, safe, fridge and minibar. Furthermore, air conditioning and heating are provided in all accommodation as standard, and all rooms feature a terrace.

name.content: Cosmos 100 Hotel y Centro de Convenciones

116189.description: The Cosmos 100 Hotel and Convention Center is ideally suited for meetings, conventions, and other large business gatherings. Its strategic location provides easy access to the commercial and financial districts, major clinics, and the Zona Rosa, renowned for its vibrant nightlife and upscale shops. Public transportation is also readily available. This modern, five-star hotel offers personalized service and warm hospitality for business travelers. Guests traveling with children under 18 may be required to present additional documentation upon check-in.

name.content: Sky Hotel Goussainville Charles de Gaulle

116219.description: Just 30 minutes outside Paris, the Comfort Hotel CDG Goussainville provides a tranquil base from which to enjoy the sights and attractions of the Paris region. With easy access to Charles du Gaulle and Paris-Le Bourget airports, we are an ideal place for travellers flying into and away from Paris to spend the night, while our nearby RER stop connects you to the City of Lights itself, as well as the Palace of Versailles, Parc Asterix and Disneyland Paris. Our free outdoor parking makes it easy to travel the Îsle-de-France region, allowing you the freedom to explore. Business travellers will find us well-prepared to make their stay a success; our well-equipped conference rooms can accommodate up to 30 attendees for most functions, perfect for meetings, seminars and other events. After a full day of exploration or business, why not relax in our billiard room or enjoy a delicious dinner in our restaurant. No matter the purpose of your visit, we look forward to making it unforgettable.

116337.description: This charming golf hotel is located in a small village near Malesherbes, only one hour from the south of Paris. Guests are only a 3-minute walk from the centre of the village and only 20 metres from the golf course. Nearby sights include Fontainebleau, which can be reached in 20 minutes by car (30 km away), and the Castle of Vaux le Vicomte, which is 45 km away. Guests can also visit the Yèvre le Chatel Medieval Fortress, which is around 20 minutes' drive from the hotel. The local train station is in Malesherbes and is 6 km away. Nearby airports include Orly Airport (81 km), Charles de Gaulle Airport (113 km), Paris Beauvais Tillé Airport (167 km) and Brussels Airport (394 km). This charming hotel is a true haven of peace. It features a beautiful golf course and is redolent with history. Set in a building dating back to the mid 15th century, the recently renovated hotel comprises a total of 40 guest rooms, including 2 executive suites, which are located in the chateau itself and in the two 17th Century listed outbuildings. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, and on-site facilities include lift access, a restaurant and room and laundry services. Guests arriving by car can leave their vehicles in the nearby car park for free. These spacious guest rooms are all individually decorated and fitted with individually regulated air conditioning. They feature a stylish décor and overlook the golf course, the gardens and the main courtyard. The peaceful atmosphere is complemented by contemporary tones and facilities include double/king-size beds, a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access, a safe and minibar. The en suite bathrooms come with a shower, bath and hairdryer.

116338.description: Located very close to Gare de l'Est and Gare du Nord train stations, this fantastic urban hotel offers a combination of modern comforts and traditional hospitality with excellent traffic connections in the heart of Paris. The property is an ideal choice for those seeking to explore the city and its main attractions such as the famous Eiffel Tower, Moulin Rouge or the Louvre Museum. Travellers can also find numerous restaurants, bars and shops in the surrounding area. The establishment features lovely rooms, decorated with attention to detail and designed to provide a comfortable and charming stay. Facilities include modern furniture, free Wi-Fi access and a flat-screen TV for guests' entertainment. Every morning, a delicious buffet breakfast is served in the hotel's dining room, providing a perfect way to start a day of shopping or sightseeing. Oher hotel services include a 24-hour reception, multilingual staff and daily newspapers.

name.content: Ibis Styles Paris Boulogne Marcel Sembat

116360.description: Breakfast - Unlimited Wi-Fi included. Located 10m from the Marcel Sembat subway, the Design hotel is located downtown, 15 minutes from the Eiffel Tower and 20 minutes from the Champs Elysees. Public parking lot - 250m. Whether you are traveling for business or leisure, everything is nearby: Roland Garros, the Parc des Princes, the Seine Musicale, the green lung of Seguin Island, a growing district.

116361.description: Located in the heart of Paris, the Accueil Hôtel Paris Pigalle Montmartre is within a 10-minute walk of the Moulin Rouge and La Machine du Moulin Rouge. This hotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Guests can enjoy the on-site coffee shop/cafe and bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee). The hotel features 49 guestrooms equipped with LCD televisions, satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each room also includes a safe, desk, phone, and a bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. Nearby attractions include the Sacré-Cœur Basilica and Boulevard Haussmann. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

116362.description: This hotel is set at the heart of Boulogne. The hotel is just a 10 minutes' walking distance away from the Marcel Sembat metro station, which offers ease of access to the centre of Paris. The hotel enjoys close proximity to a wealth of attractions in this wonderful city. The Porte de Versailles exhibition centre can be found just a short distance away. The hotel lies within easy walking distance of the Parc des Princes stadium and Roland Garros tennis arena. The Eiffel Tower and the Louvre are just a short metro ride away. This charming city hotel offers visitors a peaceful setting in which to unwind. The guest rooms offer modern amenities and comfort. Guests will be pleased by the high level of service that the hotel has to offer.

116395.address: Avenida Das Américas, 7897 - Barra Da Tijuca
116395.description: This modern hotel is located near the Bosque da Barra in Rio de Janeiro's stylish Barra da Tijuca district. Rock in Rio and Riocentro convention centre are within a 15-minute drive, and the area boast a variety of upscale shops and exceptional restaurants. The hotel is also within walking distance of other natural attractions such as Marapendi ecological park and Lake Jacarepaguá Marapendi. After a busy day spent exploring the area, guests might work out in the fitness centre, relax in the sauna or go for a swim in the refreshing outdoor pool. The hotel also provides a complimentary hot breakfast and free wireless internet access. Combining elegance and sophistication with a privileged location, this hotel makes for a fabulous stay in Rio whether travelling for business or leisure.

116407.description: Located on Ipanema's most desirable block, this hotel offers easy access to all the neighborhood's attractions. It provides a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere, ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Guest rooms feature cable TV, private bathrooms, radios, air conditioning, safes, and balconies. Some rooms also include living rooms and mini-kitchens. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a whirlpool, steam sauna, gym, and complimentary beach service. A credit card is required as a guarantee upon check-in. The hotel adheres to strict cleaning protocols in accordance with WHO guidelines.

116408.description: This apartment hotel is situated in the sophisticated Leblon neighbourhood of Rio de Janeiro. The hotel lies just 1 km away from the city centre and the beach. The tourist centre of Caneco can be found just 6 km away. This wonderful hotel is just 60 km away from Niteroi. A wide range of attractions, as well as shopping, dining and entertainment venues can be found nearby. This hotel comprises tastefully-designed guest rooms, which offer comfort, convenience and style. Those travelling for work purposes will appreciate the hotel's business centre and conference facilities. The hotel also features a gym and an outdoor swimming pool, as well as a sauna.

116413.description: Indulge in a luxurious escape at the 5-star Beloved Playa Mujeres - Couples Only All Inclusive resort, nestled in the serene Playa Mujeres area of Punta Sam. A short drive from the Punta Sam Ferry Terminal and El Meco Archaeological Site, this all-inclusive property offers 109 lavish guestrooms, each boasting private furnished balconies, indoor spa tubs, and premium bedding. Unwind with a massage at the spa or take a refreshing dip in one of the three outdoor pools. Stay active at the fitness center or explore the resort's four restaurants, seven bars/lounges, and coffee shop/cafe. Complimentary Wi-Fi, 24-hour room service, and valet parking are just a few of the amenities provided for your comfort and convenience.

116461.description: This hotel is situated in the historical quarter of Saint Germain des Prés, a small area within the heart of Paris. The establishment is within 10 minutes' walk of the Musee Maillol, the Musee Rodin and the Musee d'Orsay. Meanwhile, Orly and Charles de Gaulle airports are approximately 18 and 27 km from the accommodation respectively. This hotel welcomes its guests into friendly and refined surroundings, offering the comfort and tranquillity needed for a pleasant stay in Paris. The establishment is set in an ancient 5-storey townhouse with a lift and comprises a total of 29 guest rooms. Fully air-conditioned, the establishment is a delightful place to be, whether relaxing in the living room surrounded by its authentic beams, or in the library with its deep and comfortable lounge chairs. The patio is the ultimate place in which to enjoy a moment of tranquillity after a day exploring the sights of Paris or working. On-site facilities include a 24-hour reception service, a hotel safe and a cloakroom. Complimentary WLAN Internet access is provided throughout the hotel. The soundproof bedrooms have all been developed and equipped with guests' needs in mind. Each one has its own individual style and is decorated with Louis Philippe and Empire furniture. Every room has air conditioning and central heating, as well as satellite/cable TV, a telephone, an individual safe and wireless Internet access. The en suite bathrooms come with a shower, bath and hairdryer, and the rooms are also fitted with double beds and an ironing set.

116463.description: Enjoy a stay at the boutique Hotel Odéon Saint Germain, located in the heart of Paris, a short walk from the Luxembourg Gardens and Notre-Dame. The hotel offers 27 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a minibar, flat-screen TV, and private bathroom with designer toiletries. Complimentary Wi-Fi and wired internet access are available, along with convenient amenities such as concierge services and babysitting (surcharge). Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies), and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include a business center, airport shuttle (surcharge), and a welcoming fireplace in the lobby. The Louvre Museum and Panthéon are within a 15-minute walk.

116464.description: This charming city hotel enjoy a privileged location near the Arc de Triomphe, just a short walk from the Argentine metro station on line one and three minutes walk from the Champs Elysées with its luxurious boutiques, cafés, cinemas and cabarets. In the same area guests will also find Faubourg Saint-Honoré, a hot spot of Parisian shopping where prestigious luxury department stores mingle with gourmet restaurants and art galleries. The hotel is also ideally situated for easy access to the La Défense business district. Porte Maillot is around a 5-minute walk away and the Louvre Museum is approximately 25 minutes away on foot. The Place du Châtelet metro station is about 9 minutes away via public transport. Paris' Orly, Charles de Gaulle and Beauvais Tille airports are roughly 20 km, 32 km and 90 km away respectively. A stylish and perfectly located boutique hotel set in a distinguished private townhouse, the hotel is both elegant and intimate. Deep blacks and reds set against a glossy white background, the discerning use of mirrors and muted lighting give the renovated hotel a comfortable discreetness and a seductive ambience that is decidedly Parisian. With a timeless feel, the townhouse's beautiful existing façade and interiors have been skilfully enhanced by the contemporary refurbishment. The air-conditioned hotel houses 37 guest rooms and a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe and lift access. Guests can also take advantage of the hotel's hairdressing salon, bar and restaurant. Internet access and room and laundry services are provided. The safety of our customers is our priority and so in accordance with local health legislation, the breakfast service may have temporary changes (opening hours, products on offer, layout and service).

116533.description: The hotel is situated in 2 historical houses built in around 1870 and designed by the famous Dutch architect P. J. H. Cuypers, who also designed Amsterdam's central station and the Rijksmuseum (national museum). It is charmingly decorated and centrally located in the vicinity of the city centre. Art-lovers can reach the Stedelijk Museum of modern art, the Van Gogh Museum and the Anne Frank House for around 20 minutes on foot. Those who want to experience the vibrant nightlife of the city will be close to excellent bars, restaurants and shops. Through the bus station and the public transport links, that can be found just 100 metres around the venue, guests can reach any area within minutes. For a truly Dutch experience the hotel offers bicycles for hiring. After a day spent sightseeing there is hardly anything more relaxing then a chilled drink in the onsite bar.

116577.description: This quality 3-star hotel is situated in an elegant 19th century Parisian building and perfectly located just steps from La Madeleine church and Place de la Concorde, in central Paris. It features 46 comfortable and chic guest rooms ranging from standard to spacious suites and boasts a private bar, a meeting room and a quiet inner courtyard.

116650.description: This well-known hotel, just across the street from Cleopatra Beach, offers comfortable accommodations a short walk from Alanya city center. The hotel features 193 rooms across three buildings and five floors, with amenities including a lobby with reception, lift, lobby bar, TV corner, restaurant with non-smoking area and terrace, pool bar, two swimming pools with a separate children's pool, and an indoor pool. Rooms include a safe (with charge), shower, WC, hair dryer, satellite TV, minibar, music channels, individually adjustable Wi-Fi, air conditioning, direct-dial telephone, and a balcony. All rooms are non-smoking, and room service is available, as are handicap-accessible rooms. The spa features a heated indoor pool (open November-March), a Turkish bath, sauna, fitness room and massage rooms. Guests can use the sauna free of charge from 4:30 pm to 6:30 pm. Free activities include table tennis, live music twice a week, and Wi-Fi in the lobby and rooms. Umbrellas, mattresses and sunbeds are complimentary at the pool. Paid activities include beach volleyball, use of four public tennis courts across the street, room service, hairdresser, laundry service, and various water sports offered by local providers. The all-inclusive accommodation offers breakfast, lunch, and dinner buffets, along with late breakfast, afternoon cake and ice cream. Local alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages are available from 10:00 am to 11:00 pm at the hotel's bars. The hotel is located near a spacious, steeply sloping sandy beach. Note that parasols and sunbeds are available on the beach for an extra charge.

116874.description: Located in the heart of San Telmo, this youth hostel is located a few metres from the Avenida 9 de Julio, Puerto Madero and the famous Plaza Dorrego, as well as 300 m from the metro station. Casa Rosada is around 1 km away, and the Obelisco around 2 km away. The 30-room hostel, which opened in 2008, features a different colour on each floor of the building, with rooms and furniture corresponding to the colour theme of their respective floor. Good music and a great atmosphere are guaranteed in this air-conditioned establishment. The lobby offers a 24-hour reception and check-out service, hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and lift access. There is a TV lounge, café, bar and restaurant within the hostel, and WLAN Internet access is available. The rooms are equipped with private bathroom with shower, hairdryer, cable TV, safe and modern design. Rooms feature double beds, Internet access and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. Continental breakfast is served daily, and dinner is offered à la carte or as a set menu.

name.content: Dazzler by Wyndham Buenos Aires Maipú

116875.description: The fashionable Dazzler Tower Maipú enjoys an ideal location in Downtown Buenos Aires. It features a stylish contemporary design. Galerías Pacífico shopping mall, a historic monument thanks to its beautiful architecture, and Calle Florida street, known for its abundant shops, restaurants, bars and entertainment venues are only a few steps away. Attractions such as the exclusive and modern Puerto Madero neighbourhood, Colón Theatre or the Obelisk can be reached within a short stroll.

116913.description: Located just 50 meters from Istanbul's vibrant Istiklal Avenue, Taksim Star Hotel offers free WiFi and easy access to numerous restaurants, bars, and shops. Each air-conditioned room features a flat-screen TV and a minibar, with select rooms boasting balconies and panoramic views of the Bosphorus or city center. Guests can savor local and international cuisine at the hotel restaurant and enjoy a rich buffet breakfast served each morning in an adjacent building. An indoor pool, massage treatments, and individual steam baths are also available in a neighboring building owned by the hotel. Additional amenities include currency exchange and airport shuttle services. Dolmabahce Palace is within a 20-minute walk, and Taksim Metro Station, providing convenient access throughout the city, is just 300 meters away. Ataturk International Airport is 20 km from the hotel, while Istanbul Airport is 51 km away.

116914.description: Located on Taksim Square, this family-friendly city hotel was built in 1983 and renovated in 2009. Taksim Metro Station is just 2-minute walk from the hotel while Istanbul International Airport is some 40 km away. The hotel offers 118 guest rooms, decorated in modern style and offer amenities and services selected to make guests enjoy an experience above the usual hotel standard. They come with an en-suite bathroom and are equipped with satellite TV and convenient in-room amenities. The hotel features an outdoor swimming pool with a children's swimming area and a poolside snack bar where guests can relax after a busy day. Sports enthusiasts may enjoy a work-out in the gym, and guests can also relax with a massage treatment.

116915.address: A.Nazif Gurman Mh. Ahmet Kutsi Tecer Cad. No:12, 12
116915.description: The hotel is situated 10 km from the city centre, the Trade Center and the CNR trade fair grounds, while the national bus terminal is roughly 5 km away. The accommodation establishment is located in the Ataturk Airport area and at the heart of the textile industry of Istanbul. The hotel offers assistance with reservations for sightseeing tours, which are highly recommended considering the many cultural and historical places of interest of the area. Guests can enjoy a meal in the breakfast room or opt for room service. Free Internet access is sure to be appreciated by all guests. Rooms are all well- appointed with an en suite bathroom and satellite TV.

116939.description:
The location of the hotel makes it the ideal base for art lovers and culture enthusiasts. It is situated in the cultural heart of the city, also known as the Museum Quarter, where guests will find all the major museums. Amsterdam Schiphol Airport is approximately 15 km away.

This family-run hotel offers guest 19th century charm and an attractive setting, with its typical Amsterdam architecture, adorned with art nouveau elements. It comprises a total of 28 guest rooms spread over 5 floors. Facilities on offer include 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, a cloakroom, lift access and a bar. For an additional fee guests can make use of the hotel's Internet connection and bicycle hire service.

Part of the appeal of this hotel is that each room has its own distinct charm and character. Each one comes with an en-suite bathroom with shower, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, a satellite/ cable television and a radio. Internet access and individually adjustable heating are provided in every room.

116946.description: This city hotel boasts an excellent location in the center of Vienna, situated between Schönbrunn Palace and Naschmarkt market, both within easy walking distance. Guests will find a variety of chic restaurants and shops nearby. St. Stephen's Cathedral is just 2 km away, and Vienna International Airport is a 30-minute drive. This stylish, modern hotel offers a 24-hour lobby bar for guests to relax at any time of day, as well as complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Guests can surf the web from the comfort of their contemporary rooms while watching a movie on the flat-screen satellite TV or relaxing on the comfortable double bed.

116959.description: This is one of Side's oldest hotels, peacefully nestled in an abundant garden by the seaside. It offers unique wooden bungalow-type rooms and a variety of activities and amenities, including a choice of bars and a kids' club. The modern, refurbished rooms have light wood furniture and tiled floors. They are equipped with air conditioning and a balcony or terrace feature as standard. On-site recreation options include 2 outdoor pools, one with a slide and children's swimming area, and a poolside snack bar. Guests can work out in the gym and there is a sauna and massage service available. An entertainment programme is also provided for adults and children.

116962.description: This green oasis is located close to the sandy beach in the popular holiday region of Çolakli on the Turkish Riviera. The historic town of Side with its ancient sights like the largest amphitheatre of Anatolia or the famous Temple of Apollo is 10 km, Antalya Airport is 60 km away. The hotel features 210 rooms, 24-hours reception, currency exchange, free WIFI in public areas, 3 restaurants, 5 bars, spa and wellness, fitness centre, 2 outdoor pools, indoor pool, 3 children's pools, mini-club, car rental and free private parking on site. Free beach shuttle. Wheelchair accessible.

117073.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an outdoor pool and a sauna. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the swim-up bar. Buffet breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 131 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have separate bathtubs and showers and hair dryers.

117074.address: 33 El Harm St With Abu Al Hol Street
117074.description: Tiba Pyramids Hotel provides luxury, 4-star accommodations with views of the Great Pyramids of Giza. All air-conditioned rooms feature private balconies and include satellite TV. The spacious rooms are well-furnished with seating areas, and modern decor. Each room provides a private bathroom that includes a bath and shower. *** Customers with Egyptian nationality who stay in the hotel sharing a room must provide a marriage certificate

117096.description: This elegant city hotel is located in the heart of the business and cultural district of Montparnasse in Paris. Guests will find a range of shops, theatres and cinemas nearby, and Saint-Germain-des-Prés is just steps from the hotel. The Eiffel Tower and the Champs-Élysées are within walking distance, and the nearest metro station is just 200 m away. Paris-Charles de Gaulle Airport and Paris-Orly Airport are 40 and 25 km away, respectively. This 55-room hotel is fully air-conditioned and provides guests with a range of facilities and services, including complimentary wireless Internet access in public areas. The rooms come equipped with individually regulated air conditioning and heating units and many other useful amenities.

117114.description: Situated a short 10-minute drive from Potsdam's city center, this air-conditioned business hotel offers convenient access to Brandenburg's picturesque Templiner See. Berlin Schoenefeld Airport is 35 km away, and Tegel Airport is approximately 45 km from the hotel. Guests can enjoy modern, comfortably furnished rooms and suites featuring internet access, satellite TV, en-suite bath and shower, a hairdryer, and air conditioning. The hotel also boasts a swimming pool, gym, fitness center, massage service, and a beauty salon.

117134.description: Conveniently situated in Barcelona's Eixample District, this stylish modern hotel is an ideal choice both for business trips or leisure stays as many of the major attractions are within walking distance. Opposite the National Theatre of Catalunya, it is just a short stroll from La Monumental bullring, @22 district, Sagrada Familia, Port Olímpic, Plaça de Catalunya or the old town Barri Gòtic.

117237.description:
The hotel offers comfort and character in the heart of Paris. It is ideally located next to the famous Champs-Elysées and near the Eiffel Tower. Within walking distance guests will find many of the city's most renowned sites. The hotel's proximity to all forms of public transport makes the rest of the city easily accessible. Paris Orly Airport is some 20 km away, while Charles de Gaulle Airport is approximately 30 km from the residence. This luxurious boutique hotel, renovated in 2009, offers comfortable and refined accommodation. The 49 guest rooms have been stylishly decorated and uniquely furnished with such attention to detail as to provide a charming and inviting setting. Each room is equipped with a marble bathroom and modern amenities, such as a plasma TV set. 
As part of our ongoing commitment to enhancing our facilities, renovation works will be carried out in selected guest rooms starting February 1st 2026, for a period of several months. 
All works will be carefully planned to minimize any inconvenience and preserve our guests’ comfort. 
The works will take place exclusively during daytime hours, from 9:00 a. m. to 6:00 p. m. 
In recognition of any potential inconvenience, the rates offered during this period have already been adjusted.

117515.description: This sublime beach resort enjoys an idyllic setting in Negombo on the north western point of the island. The tourist hub of Negombo is rich in history and culture, offering guests the ideal opportunity to immerse themselves in the enriching surroundings of the area. The resort is conveniently situated just a 20 minutes' drive from Bandaranaike International Airport. The resort is nestled amidst 1. 1 hectares of swaying palm trees and tropical gardens fringing the sprawling, pristine Jetwing Beach. The resort is the design of Sri Lanka's most renowned architect, Geoffrey Bawa and features a stunning contemporary Sri Lankan architectural style allowing it to blend harmoniously with its surroundings. The guest rooms feature soothing earthy tones, rattan furniture and modern amenities, offering the perfect hideaway from the bustle of daily life.

117575.description: Located 30 meters from Copacabana Beach, Rio Design Hotel is the first design hotel in the city of Rio de Janeiro. With apartments, suites and corridors decorated for ten renowned Brazilian architects, the hotel offers creativity, refinement and a unique style, presenting a design for each floor and an amazing harmony. ***The hotel temporarily closed its leisure areas (swimming pool, sauna and gym) for refurbishment and is expected to reopen on December 31, 2023***

117576.description:
O Rede Andrade Canadá oferece acomodações em uma região segura da Praia de Copacabana, a apenas 250 m do mar e a 550 m da estação de metrô Siqueira Campos. 

Você pode contar com a equipe de confiança da propriedade, que pode fornecer excelentes informações sobre passeios e outros serviços, incluindo excursões, aluguel de carros e serviço de quarto. 

Os quartos são equipados com Tv, frigobar, ar condicionado e wi-fi. 

O Hotel Canada está situado a 2, 1 km do Forte de Copacabana e a 4, 4 km do Estádio da Lagoa. O Aeroporto Santos Dumont fica a 8, 6 km de distância, enquanto o Aeroporto Internacional do Galeão está localizado a 25, 4 km da propriedade. 

Informações Importantes:
Horário de check-in: 14:00 às 22:00. Para check-in após esse horário, o(a) hóspede deverá avisar o hotel por meio dos contatos indicados. 
 Pets até 10kg aceitos mediante cobrança de R$60, 00 por dia, por pet

117617.description: This hotel is situated in Barajas, just 500 metres away from the centre. It is located just a 5 minutes' driving distance away from the IFEMA exhibition grounds, which is sure to please business travellers. Shopping venues can be found just 3. 5 km away. The hotel is conveniently situated just 3 km away from Madrid Barajas Airport. This modern establishment offers a pleasant, family-friendly atmosphere. The guest rooms are spacious and brightly-lit with natural light. The hotel's many facilities and services are sure to impress every type of traveller visiting the area. Guests will appreciate complimentary internet access, which allows them to keep in touch with home or work while away.

117634.description: Enjoy suburban comfort at Hotel Sommerau-Ticino in Dietikon, conveniently located within a 15-minute drive of Letzigrund Stadium and the Swiss National Museum. This hotel offers 84 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with deep soaking bathtubs. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) and take advantage of amenities including concierge services, a business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Free self-parking is available onsite. Discover nearby attractions such as Bruno Weber Park (1. 4 mi) and Shoppi Tivoli (2. 4 mi). Zurich Airport (ZRH) is 12. 8 mi away.

117637.description: The hotel is glad to greet guests in the heart of Montparnasse, in the 14th district of Paris. This very famous and lively area of Paris was shaped in the past when painters and writers frequented the area, thus creating a unique atmosphere. The hotel is located close to the famous restaurants La Coupole, Le Dôme and La Rotonde. It is a very pleasant place, not far from Saint Germain des Prés and Les Invalides, and one of the best locations to experience the Parisian way of life. The airports of Orly, Charles de Gaulle and Beauvais are approximately 25 km, 45 km and 80 km away, respectively. The air-conditioned hotel has a welcoming and classical decor which makes guests feel right at home in a total of 34 rooms. Entirely non-smoking, guests will appreciate the attention to detail in all the rooms as well as in the lounge and breakfast area. Facilities include a lobby, 24-hour reception, lift and laundry service. Each of the rooms comes with a satellite/cable TV, minibar, telephone, WLAN Internet access, safe and air conditioning. The renovated en suite bathrooms are fitted with shower, bath and hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a continental breakfast buffet with a nice view of the hotel's interior garden.

117638.description: Enjoy a central Paris stay at the Beaugency Hotel, steps from Rue Cler and a short walk from the Eiffel Tower. Our 30 air-conditioned rooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, minibars, and safes. Start your day with our daily buffet breakfast (fee applies). We provide a 24-hour front desk, concierge services, luggage storage, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Les Invalides and Champ de Mars are also within easy walking distance. The closest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

117639.description: Located near the Saint-Lazare train station, not far from the Garnier opera house, department stores, the Madeleine church and the Montmartre district, this hotel offers a pleasant setting in the heart of Paris's tourist and business districts.
