It is 20 km from Orly airport, 40 km from Roissy-Charles de Gaulle airport and 70 km from Beauvais airport. This 30-room hotel offers a warm atmosphere, as well as top-of-the-range decoration and services. It features a 24-hour reception, a safe and an elevator. Rooms include a double bed, telephone, satellite TV with TPS and Canal+, Internet/WiFi access, minibar, personal safe, and bathroom with shower or bath, WC and hairdryer. Breakfast is served as a continental buffet.

117640.description: Nestled in the tranquil 17th arrondissement of Paris, at the intersection of Rue Brunel and Rue Labie, this charming city hotel offers a warm welcome. A short 3-minute walk from Porte Maillot and the Palais des Congrès de Paris convention center, and just 10 minutes from the Champs-Élysées, it's also conveniently located near the La Défense business district. Private shuttles to the three main airports are readily available at Porte Maillot. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services including fax, lift access, and a delightful buffet breakfast served in the breakfast room or in the comfort of their own rooms upon request. The 24-hour front desk staff can also assist with sightseeing tour reservations. Each room features an en suite bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, along with a satellite/cable TV.

117837.description: Boasting a rooftop pool with stunning sea views, Hotel Fasano Rio de Janeiro offers luxurious beachfront accommodations on Ipanema Beach. The property also offers a spa and wellness centre. Elegantly decorated, rooms at this 5-star hotel feature a balcony, air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a minibar and a private bathroom with a hairdryer and a bath or shower. The spacious rooms also offer hardwood floors and high quality wood and leather furniture.

117873.description: Experience the authentic Carioca spirit at the Mar Ipanema Hotel. Boasting modern design in a prime location on Ipanema's most exclusive corner, this Rio de Janeiro hotel offers warm hospitality and essential services for a comfortable stay just steps from the beach. Book a Standard room in April and receive a complimentary upgrade to a Superior room, along with free parking and a 4 PM late checkout.

117874.description: Soaking up the breeze, right bang smack on the sand, arms flung wide open to the Atlantic, this is JANEIRO. Located in the middle of Leblon's marvellous beach-culture, we bring Rio's bossa vibe to life. Nature is a joyful accomplice. And what about that view? The Cagarras islands scatter across a horizon blue as far as the eye can see. No make-believe needed here. At night, the Moon beams, and in the distance, the lights of Vidigal glitter and dance like fireflies. Pure poetry for the eyes, woven into the urban effervescence of the city. The barefoot simplicity of the beach finds its way into the smallest of details; from the rooms to the food, the music to the art, all is an extension of the golden sands out front. We sway to no other rhythm but Rio's. IMPORTANT: Official communication from the hotel: 'From July 19th to December, we are currently enhancing the exterior of our building. To ensure your convenience, maintenance activities will occur from 10 AM to 7 PM during this period. Our services and experiences continue as usual without any changes. Thank you for your understanding. '

117876.description: Situated in the vibrant heart of Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro, this hotel offers convenient access to the Siqueira Campos subway station, both airports, and is just two blocks from the beach. Located on Tonelero Street, it boasts a beautiful auditorium suitable for conventions and events, as well as an excellent international restaurant. The hotel provides comfortable, sophisticated rooms, including accommodations adapted for guests with special needs.

117878.description: This hotel is located 1. 5 blocks from Copacabana beach and close to the metro station as well as to other places of interest to visitors. Renovated in 2008, this city hotel comprises a total of 94 guest rooms and offers guests a pleasant and friendly atmosphere. It is ideal for business travellers and holidaymakers alike and facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check out service, a currency exchange facility and a TV lounge. It also offers a café, a lobby bar and a restaurant and business travellers will appreciate the conference facilities and WLAN Internet access. Guests may also take advantage of the room and laundry services and the medical service and there is parking available for those arriving by car. The rooms have a welcoming atmosphere and feature modern decoration to provide convenience and comfort. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a shower/bathtub and a hairdryer and offer a king-size or double bed. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, cable TV, radio, a hifi system, Internet access, a safe and a minibar/fridge. Furthermore, an ironing set, background music and individually adjustable air conditioning are provided in all accommodation as standard amenities. This hotel features an outdoor swimming pool with a poolside snack bar and a sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols. Sports enthusiasts can enjoy a workout in the gym and it is possible to unwind in the sauna. The hotel offers guests a restaurant which serves national and international dishes. Guests may select their breakfast from a buffet and the midday and evening meals may be enjoyed in buffet form, from a set menu or à la carte.

117879.description: Located just 50 meters from Copacabana Beach, this hotel offers breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean and easy access to Rio's vibrant attractions. A 5-minute walk from Cardeal Arcoverde subway station, guests can easily explore Sugarloaf Mountain and other iconic landmarks. Lively bars and restaurants line the beach, while the hotel's in-house restaurant serves a delicious daily breakfast buffet featuring tropical fruits, cakes, and pastries. The poolside bar offers light meals, refreshing drinks, and colorful cocktails throughout the day, perfect for enjoying on the rooftop terrace while soaking up the sun. Please note: As of September 1, 2021, proof of vaccination is required to access public spaces in Rio de Janeiro.

117883.description: Sitting at just 200 metres from the world's most famous beach – Copacabana, this hotel is the ideal venue for a sun-soaked vacation in Rio. Its guests will be just a 10-minute drive from the city centre and within a short walk from the restaurants and open-air bars along the beach. Guests who would like to sparkle their vacation with a small shopping spree can reach the big Rio Sul Shopping Centre within a 10-minute leisurely stroll. The soundproofed and air-conditioned rooms of the hotel are equipped with everything needed for a relaxed stay including large-screen TVs and high-speed internet for little entertainment. The hotel's restaurant is the place where one can experience the true variety of the Brazilian cuisine and its amazing taste. While the outdoor pool is where the magnificent weather does its part.

117884.description: This hotel is set only 150 metres from Copacabana Beach and near various public transport links including Cardeal Arcoverde metro station. Everything a visitor could possibly need is in the vicinity of the hotel- shops, banks, currency exchanges, shopping malls, cinemas, theatres, bars, and restaurants where guests may delight in the wonders of Rio. The comfortable hotel rooms are equipped with flat-screen cable TV, minibar, electronic safe, AM/FM radio, air-conditioning, internet access, and en suite bathroom with vanity mirror and hairdryer. Perfect for both business and leisure, this hotel offers comfort and sophistication in the heart of Rio de Janeiro.

117885.description: This hotel is in a prime location, Copacabana, only three blocks from the beach, situated between two metro stations at the heart of one of the most important tourist centres in Rio de Janeiro, surrounded by theatres, cinemas, bars, restaurants and various shops. Facilities include a hairdressing salon, cafe, bar, restaurant and a business centre with a meeting room, and wireless Internet access. There is also room and laundry services, and car park (fees apply). The hotel is wheelchair-accessible. The hotel's outdoor swimming pool is open from 9am to 9pm. Dear guests:From september 1st 2021, all people will have to present proof of vaccination in order to access places of collective use in the city of Rio de JaneiroThank you!

name.content: St Teresa Hotel Rio de Janeiro-MGallery Collection

117887.description: The Santa Teresa Hotel RJ MGallery is a boutique hotel in Rio, which offers comfortable rooms with Brazilian design, Le SPA and pool with panoramic views, all to make your stay an incredible experience. Enjoy the famous Bar dos Descasados, known for its cool audience-and the contemporary Brazilian gastronomy of Térèze, one of the best hotels restaurants in Rio.

117888.description: Situated on Ipanema Beach, just steps from the iconic 'Station 9' and the renowned Garota de Ipanema bar, Sol Ipanema Hotel offers an ideal location for both leisure and business travelers. With easy access to Rio de Janeiro's city center and top attractions, the hotel provides comfortable accommodations to suit diverse needs, including accessible rooms. Each room is equipped with air conditioning, a minibar, soft background music, an individual safe, a work desk, a telephone, and cable TV. Guests can enjoy 24-hour room service, a pool, and complimentary internet access. All rooms can accommodate a third guest with an extra bed. The hotel's welcoming ambiance, attentive service, and stunning views from the restaurant complement the sophisticated Italian and Mediterranean cuisine.

117889.description: The beaches of Copacabana and Ipanema and the Corcovado, the Sugarloaf – iconic images of Brazil, are within easy reach from this modern hotel in Rio de Janeiro. The beaches and a large variety of restaurants and shops are just a few steps away, attractions such as the Culture Palace, Candelaria Church, St. Anthony Monastery, Fine Arts Museum or the Museum of Modern Art are easily reachable. The international airport is only 23 km away.

118044.description: Located only a 2 minute walk from the RER and TGV train stations, and just 15 km from Paris, the Residhome Paris-Massy offers an indoor pool and free Wi-Fi access. Guests have free access to the sauna. Please note that children under the age of 3 are not permitted in the relaxation area, even when accompanied by an adult. This Appart Hotel residence provides a range of studio and apartment accommodation equipped with a kitchenette, flat-screen TV and balcony. Original recipes inspired by the flavours of Provence are served at the hotel's partner restaurant, Les Moulins Bleus, which is located nearby and is open for lunch and dinner every day. The nearby Massy-Palaiseau RER train station provides access to the centre of Paris in 20 minutes.

118054.description: The hotel is in an ideal location, a few meters from Barcelona's Ramblas and right next to the famous Boqueria market in the heart of the Old City. The Gothic Quarter, the Port, the Cathedral and Plaça Catalunya just a short walk away from the hotel and the rest of the city is within easy reach thanks to the Liceu Metro station, a few meters away. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, currency exchange and lift access, a breakfast room, conference facilities and a laundry service. Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.

118093.address: 2 East 61St Street At 5Th Avenue Midtown Manhattan
118093.description: The Pierre, a Taj Hotel, graces Fifth Avenue in the heart of Manhattan, directly across from Central Park. This iconic hotel offers unparalleled access to luxury shopping on Fifth and Madison Avenues, with boutiques like Bergdorf Goodman, Tiffany & Co. , Bloomingdales, and Saks Fifth Avenue just steps away. Guests can enjoy various activities in Central Park, including boating, biking, and ice-skating, or visit the renowned Central Park Zoo. A white-gloved oasis for discerning travelers, The Pierre has hosted royalty, heads of state, and Hollywood's elite, solidifying its status as a true Manhattan gem.

118132.description:
Cape Royale Luxury Suites is located in the central district of Green Point, just 5 minutes' walk from Cape Town Stadium and the V & A Waterfront. Cape Town International Convention Centre (CTICC) is 2 km away.

Our apartments are spacious and have been decorated in soothing colours to create a relaxing and welcoming atmosphere.
Cape Royale Luxury Suites feature a Juliet balcony- ideal to enjoy a refreshing drink whilst admiring the sunset, a well-equipped kitchen, as well as a large living and dining area. The suites have views over Cape Town Harbour and Table Mountain. All rooms have a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. It offers accommodation with free uncapped WI-Fi, access to the rooftop pool, spa and a gym featuring cardiovascular equipment.

Guests of the luxury Cape Royale Luxury Suites have a choice of several dining options located in the area.

118133.address: St Georges Mall, CBD City Center, 1
118133.description: The Best Western Fountains Hotel, situated in Cape Town's central business district, is ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Renowned for its pleasant climate, Cape Town offers numerous attractions, easily accessible from our location. The hotel features 156 comfortable rooms, many with views of the harbor, bustling Thibault Square, or iconic Table Mountain. Each room includes air-conditioning, a safe, coffee and tea making facilities, satellite TV, a mini-bar, and complimentary Wi-Fi. The on-site restaurant offers sumptuous buffet-style breakfast, lunch, and dinner, featuring international and South African dishes, fresh pastries from our in-house bakery, and a variety of fruits and yogurts. 24-hour room service is also available. Guests can easily visit Table Mountain, explore the city center, or stroll to the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront. The Cape Town International Convention Centre is a short 500-meter walk away. For business needs, our five conference rooms can accommodate up to 250 people. A dedicated conference manager will assist with room configurations and other arrangements. Standard audio-visual equipment is provided, and the spaces can be adapted for banquets and special occasions. We offer various configurations and table/chair designs, complemented by attractive flower arrangements to create the desired ambiance. The hotel is committed to environmental conservation and sustainability, implementing green practices throughout our operations.

118141.address: Bombay Airport, Nehru Rd, Vile Parle(E), Mumbai
118141.description: This city hotel is situated approximately 5 km from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport. Comprising a total of 43 deluxe rooms, this air-conditioned hotel offers comfortable accommodation with state-of-the-art facilities. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out service and currency exchange facilities. There is a TV lounge and restaurant on site, and business guests will appreciate the conference facilities and Internet access, which is available for an additional fee. Room and laundry services are also offered (fees apply to the latter), and guests arriving by vehicle may use the hotel car park. The en suite rooms have been recently renovated and come equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access and individually regulated air conditioning. The hotel features a multi-cuisine restaurant serving a range of Indian, Chinese and local dishes.

118143.address: Sahar Elevated Rd, Sahar, Airport Area
118143.description: Located in Mumbai's business district, the ITC Maratha Mumbai, a Luxury Collection Hotel, is within a 5-minute drive of the Nehru Centre and Global Pagoda. This luxury hotel is 1. 7 miles from the MIDC Industrial Estate and 2 miles from the Santacruz Electronic Export Processing Zone. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Guests can enjoy recreational amenities such as a health club, an outdoor pool, and a sauna. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. The 380 individually furnished guestrooms feature minibars and LED televisions. Your memory foam bed comes with Egyptian cotton sheets. Complimentary Wi-Fi and satellite programming are provided for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers offer complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Dine at Yi Jing, one of the hotel's 5 restaurants, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The hotel offers a conference center and meeting rooms for events. Free self-parking is available onsite.

118213.address: Tareq Bin Zeyad Street, PO BOX 26816,DUBAI
118213.description: Ramee Royal Hotel is in Dubai's Bur Dubai neighborhood. We are close to BurJuman and Creek Park. Also nearby are Deira City Centre and Dubai Creek. Guests are offered a diverse choice of dining and entertainment including Sports Bar, the Indian nightclub with a DJ, and an Arabic nightclub. The European-styled night club with live entertainment, situated on the 4th floor, offers a spectacular view of the Dubai Creek. Guests can also relax with a shisha, soft drinks and light snacks at the rooftop. Ramee Royal Hotel also has a health club, an outdoor pool, and a sauna. This 4 star Dubai property features a hair salon and beauty services. Business amenities include a business center and business services. We also have a restaurant, a bar, and a coffee shop/café. Guests are served a complimentary breakfast each morning. 24-hour room service is also available. Event facilities consist of conference rooms and banquet facilities. This property is self-catering. Amenities featured in guestrooms include DVD players, air conditioning, and minibars. Business-friendly amenities include desks and direct-dial phones. Bathrooms feature shower/tub combinations, bathroom phones, and bidets. Sofa beds are provided. Wi-fi charges are as follow: 1 Hour - AED 15, 1 Day - AED 45, 1 Week - AED 175, 1 Month - AED 250. Ramee Royal Hotel offers rooms with spectacular views of either the Deira Creek or Dubai's skyline. The hotel has the unique Regent Club Floor, where the discerning business traveller can enjoy exclusive benefits and privileges.

118338.description: Enjoying a vibrant setting in Rio de Janeiro, this hotel is perfectly situated between the neighbourhoods of Copacabana, Arpoador and Ipanema. The hotel boasts a spectacular setting close to the centre of this lively city, and is located within easy access of the most intriguing entertainment areas in Rio de Janeiro. Guests will be impressed by the host of attractions the city has to offer, all of which are within easy reach of the hotel. Just a short walking distance away lie the spectacular beaches for which the area is renowned. Boasting some of the world's most beautiful beaches, the area is the perfect choice for travellers who are seeking a truly unique seaside break. The beautifully-appointed guest rooms are tastefully decorated and come complete with a range of modern amenities for visitors' convenience and comfort.

118339.description: The hotel is located in a privileged area, next to the beach of Copacabana, which is one of the most famous beaches in the world. It is the ideal place to stay whether for pleasure or business, offering comfortable spaces, tranquillity and premium services. Thanks to its privileged location and infrastructure, this city residence provides easy access to all parts of the wonderful city of Rio de Janeiro. Comprising a total of 88 guestrooms, the air-conditioned establishment features useful facilities and a helpful staff. The hotel offers rooms equipped with a variety of amenities such as a telephone, cable TV, Internet access and individually regulated air conditioning for maximum comfort. The en-suite bathrooms are fitted with a shower and a hairdryer.

118354.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at Konak Hotel Taksim, where complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services enhance your stay. Savor international cuisine at Strada Restaurant, complete with a bar/lounge and alfresco dining. If you prefer, 24-hour room service is available. Start your day with a full breakfast, served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM (fee applies). For business travelers, the hotel offers a business center, express check-in/check-out, and three meeting rooms, along with conference space. Airport transfers are available 24/7 for a surcharge. Relax in one of the 117 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars, LCD TVs, and satellite programming. Each room includes a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower, rainfall showerhead, and complimentary toiletries. Laptop-compatible safes and desks are also provided, with daily housekeeping. Located near Taksim Square, the hotel is conveniently close to Istanbul Congress Center, Istanbul Technical University, and Istiklal Avenue. The closest airports are Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) and Istanbul Airport (IST).

118355.description: Enjoy convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and on-site shopping. A shuttle service is available to nearby attractions (surcharge). Dine at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe or enjoy room service (limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, or relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary local breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Roundtrip airport transfers are available for a surcharge (24 hours). The 23 guestrooms feature minibars (stocked with some complimentary items), LCD televisions with satellite programming, premium bedding, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Gülhane Park, Istanbul Archaeology Museums, Eminonu Pier, Egyptian Bazaar, Eminönü Square, the Bosphorus, Basilica Cistern, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, and Sultanahmet Square. Istanbul Airport (IST) is the preferred airport.

118376.address: Sheikh Zayed Road Al Basha 1 Behind Mall Of Emirat
118376.description: This modern, luxurious apartment hotel is ideally located a short walk from the Mall of the Emirates, and a quick drive from Wild Wadi, Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, and Dubai Media City. Downtown Dubai is about 15 minutes by car, while attractions like Ski Dubai are within a 5-minute walk. Umm Suqeim Park is approximately 3 km away, and Dubai International Airport is about a 35-minute drive. The two-story hotel offers 64 units, including single and double/twin apartments. Guests enjoy friendly, professional service and air-conditioned comfort. The lobby provides 24-hour reception, check-out service, a safe, currency exchange, and cloakroom. A lift, café, and restaurant are also available, as well as internet access and laundry service. Each comfortable apartment is well-equipped with satellite/cable TV, a telephone, and an en suite bathroom with a shower, bath, and hairdryer. Additional amenities include a radio, internet access, in-room safe, and a kitchen with a minibar, fridge, cooker, microwave, and tea/coffee making facilities. A washing machine, ironing set, air conditioning, central heating, and a private balcony or terrace complete the accommodations.

118434.description: As well as beautifully-designed rooms and locally curated art murals, on-site features include a cinema, library, common kitchen, and a comfortable cowork space. Plus, there's a beach-front restaurant serving authentic cuisine, and a rooftop bar with gorgeous sea views. To say that Copacabana Beach is lively is an understatement. As well as glistening warm waters and wide stretches of white sand, numerous hotels, restaurants, bars, and nightclubs dot the famous, mosaic-tiled promenade. Whether you want to go for a swim, play sports with the locals, chill out on the sand, or enjoy freshly-caught fish it's easy to soak up the atmosphere at one Brazil's most popular tourist destinations. The ultimate destination for around-the-clock beach-side action, Copacabana beach is policed and lit throughout the night, so it's always buzzing with hundreds of visitors, musicians, and food vendors. Insiders' tip: take a sunset stroll on the beach's iconic walkway, and stay late to see locals singing, dancing, and playing footvolley right on the water's edge.

118435.description: This hotel enjoys an ideal location, in one of Copacabana's most popular areas. This hotel enjoys ease of access to a pristine sandy beach, as well as numerous public transport links. A number of shopping , dining and entertainment venues are to be found nearby. This hotel enjoys a modern architectural style, embodying traditional and contemporary elements. The hotel rooms are spacious and endearing, infusing soft soothing tones and a refreshing ambience. Guests can relax with a refreshing swim in the hotel pool, or enjoy an invigorating workout in the gym. Guests can enjoy delicious meals from the hotel restaurant, ensuring adequate energy the day ahead. For an ideal break, this hotel provides ease of access to numerous attractions within the area, and ensures a professional, friendly service.

118579.description: This hotel is in the heart of Paris, located in a quiet side street just steps from the famous Opera Garnier and Galeries Lafayette. All rooms are decorated in modern colours and furnished with comfortable furniture. They are equipped with free Wi-Fi, satellite TV and a private bathroom. For further pleasure, room service and a concierge are available every night to customise the stay. The Opéra metro station is 3 minutes from the hotel and offers direct access to the Louvre, the Eiffel Tower, Disneyland, the Gare Saint-Lazare and Gare de Lyon. Guests will also find the metro station Chaussée d'Antin Lafayette, as well as a shuttle service to Roissy-Charles de Gaulle airport in Paris. The hotel is set in the Opera district, ideal for guests who love museums, shopping, culture and other options of entertainment.

118613.description:
Hotel Embassy Park Bogotá is strategically located just a few steps from Corferias Convention Center, near the U. S. Embassy, El Dorado International Airport, and Bogotá’s main business district. The hotel offers comfortable rooms equipped with air conditioning, complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and private bathrooms. 

Guests can enjoy a complete wellness experience with a spa featuring a jacuzzi, sauna, and steam room, as well as a fully equipped gym. A delicious buffet breakfast with Colombian coffee is included, along with free parking, currency exchange services, and 24-hour front desk assistance. 

Ideal for business travelers and tourists, Hotel Embassy Park is one of the best options for those looking for a hotel near Corferias in Bogotá, combining comfort, convenience, and excellent service.

118614.description: The comfortable Faranda Express Belvedere is conveniently situated on Calle 100 street in the north of Bogotá, in an upscale neighbourhood close to the city's financial district. The best entertainment venues, shopping facilities and restaurants are to be found in the surrounding area. The National Theatre La Castellana, the World Trade Center and the Park 93 are within walking distance, while the shopping centres Andino and El Retiro are only a few minutes away by car. The nearby metro station Calle 100 offers access to the whole city.

118618.description: This hotel enjoys a superb setting in Bogota. It is located just 100 meters away from the bus stop. Guests will find themselves just a 20-minute drive away from the city center of Bogota. The American Embassy is also situated close by. Many shopping, dining, and entertainment opportunities can be found in the area. The hotel is conveniently located just 2 kilometers away from El Dorado Airport. This hotel represents a new concept in accommodation. The architectural style harmoniously combines brick, wood, steel, and marble. The guest rooms feature soothing tones for a peaceful ambiance. Guests are invited to enjoy a sumptuous dining experience in the restaurant.

118619.description: The hotel is a five-minute walk away from exclusive shopping malls and is very close to the T Zone, one of the city's most exclusive entertainment areas where you will find top restaurants, bars and nightclubs. The hotel's 53 rooms are equipped with minibar and LCD TV with cable channels, high-quality bed linen and tea and coffee making facilities. The hotel boasts a fitness center, sauna, meeting rooms, laundry service, 24-hour reception and car park

name.content: Embassy Suites by Hilton Bogotá Rosales

118620.description: The five-star Embassy Suites by Hilton Bogota Rosales is located in Bogota's financial/commercial district, north of the city center. It's within walking distance of the Centro Granahorrar Shopping Mall, Teatro Nacional Bogota, and various embassies/consulates. This upscale all-suite hotel is also just minutes from attractions such as the Centro Andino Shopping Mall, downtown Bogota, the Gold Museum, and several art museums. El Dorado International Airport is 9. 5 miles away. Guests enjoy spacious two-room suites, complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast, and a nightly manager's reception. Wireless high-speed internet is available throughout the hotel. Amenities include an art cafe, bar, sauna, spa, gym, and business center. Transportation is available upon request. Please note: Some services, including the business center, evening social, breakfast, and on-site restaurants, are currently operating with reduced service. The fitness center and spa are temporarily unavailable.

119213.address: Sultan Ahmet, Küçükayasofya Cad, Akbıyık Değirmeni, 27
119213.description: Located in Istanbul's prestigious historic district, near the Arasta Bazaar, this luxury boutique hotel offers 29 comfortable rooms. A short 10-minute walk places you in the heart of Sultanahmet, with its vibrant restaurants, bars, shops, and iconic attractions like the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. Refurbished in 2009, the hotel provides high-quality service and amenities, including air conditioning, flat-screen LCD TVs, and internet access in every room.

119215.description: The Dream Hill Business Deluxe Hotel in Istanbul, Asia, offers top-notch services and amenities for a comfortable stay. Guests enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, airport transfers, and parking. A cozy fireplace warms the hotel on chilly days, and designated smoking areas are available. Start your day with a delicious on-site breakfast and quality coffee from the hotel cafe. Throughout the day, easily accessible meal options satisfy any craving. Leisure amenities include a refreshing pool and a poolside bar for enjoying your favorite beverages. Maintain your fitness routine at the hotel's well-equipped gym.

119253.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages and facials. You can soak up the sun at the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy international cuisine at Market by Jean-Georges, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Doha? This hotel has 8135 square feet (756 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 7 meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite.

119379.address: North Corniche Road, Al Shate'e, Jeddah
119379.description: Due to the current travel environment, this hotel is currently not accepting guests for a short period. Reservations are available for future dates. Please see below for up-to-date policy information and ways to contact Hilton Guest Assistance. We look forward to welcoming you to the hotel soon. A true Arabian palace offering an oasis of tranquility and luxury in the city of Jeddah. Indulge in exceptional Waldorf Astoria hospitality and relax in opulently decorated interiors. Let the personalized butler service attend to your every request. Admire the stunning 3-story length Swarovski crystal chandelier suspended from the lobby ceiling. Four distinct styles of suites make up the luxury accommodation presented at Waldorf Astoria Jeddah/Qasr Al Sharq. Each ensures matchless privacy and ultimate relaxation. More than 10, 000 sq ft of the finest Italian furnishings, magnificently decorated interiors and the latest amenities welcome you in the largest of the Qasr Al Sharq Suites. Enjoy the regal stature and grace of the Royal Suites with separate living, sleeping and dining areas. Unwind on the private balcony with panoramic Red Sea views or rejuvenate in your own whirlpool spa. Modern designer amenities complement interiors with the opulence of Old Arabia in the Executive Suites. Gaze out on stunning Jeddah city views from these luxurious suites. Dine on exemplary cuisine at Qasr Al Sharq's two outstanding restaurants. Aromi Restaurant features contemporary design, sea views and a modern Italian menu with a Venetian twist. Mataam Al Sharq boasts oriental fine dining in a lavish palace setting. Ladies can indulge in an unforgettable luxurious treatment in the spa with unique aquamedic massage pool. Experience a haven of serenity in this sanctuary of calm. Only 15 minutes from King Abdulaziz International Airport (JED), Qasr Al Sharq is conveniently located for all that Jeddah has to offer.

119534.description: A stay at Hotel Barcelona Colonial places you in the heart of Barcelona, within a 10-minute walk of Port de Barcelona and La Rambla. This 4-star hotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 4 km) from Barcelona Cathedral and 0. 8 mi (1. 3 km) from Barceloneta Beach. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Stay in one of 81 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Hotel Barcelona Colonial. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Limited parking is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Basilica de Santa Maria del Mar - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Port Vell - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Pompeu Fabra University - 0. 4 km/0. 2 mi- Barcelona Cathedral - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- Barcelona City Council - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- Port de Barcelona - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- Picasso Museum - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- El Born Centre Cultural - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Plaça Reial - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Maremagnum - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- La Rambla - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Portal de l'Angel - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Barcelona Wax Museum - 0. 7 km/0. 5 mi- Parc de la Ciutadella - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Palau de la Música Catalana - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi. The preferred airport for Hotel Barcelona Colonial is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 16. 1 km/10 mi.

119596.description: 4* Mercure Paris Alésia, fully renovated, modern design illustrating Paris! Modern, warm setting and rooms offering comfort and tranquility for a family or business stay. Runner-up of the Best Breakfast France award. Opposite Porte d'Orléans metro station, visit the capital and nearby districts of St-Germain-des-Prés and Montparnasse. Easy access: Orly Airport, Porte de Versailles exhibition center.

name.content: Hotel des Arcades de Cachan Grand Paris Sud

119597.description: The fully renovated Hôtel des Arcades de Cachan Grand Paris Sud offers a modern and airy atmosphere in the historic Cachan area, just south of Paris. This location provides a tranquil escape from the city center while remaining conveniently close to major attractions and the business district. The hotel features an on-site restaurant serving delicious regional specialties, along with amenities such as photocopying, fax, and valet services. Each air-conditioned room is cozy and well-appointed, promising a comfortable stay.

119637.address: Lara Turizm Merkezi Kemeragzi Mevkii Kundu
119637.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 6 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, babysitting (surcharge), and an arcade/game room. This hotel is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Baia, a restaurant which specializes in international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge, the beach bar, or the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM.

119642.description: Located in the heart of Juhu Beach's vibrant business and shopping district, this city hotel offers a convenient and refreshing retreat for both leisure and business travelers. Just a 20-minute drive from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport, the hotel features 54 well-appointed guest rooms, a restaurant serving diverse Indian, Chinese, and continental cuisine, and a range of amenities including a 24-hour reception, conference rooms, and Wi-Fi. Each room includes a private bathroom, satellite TV, and a minibar. Additional services such as laundry and parking are available for a fee.

119644.address: 287, Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Rd, Parel, Mumbai
119644.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Grab a bite at Kebabs and Kurries, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Mumbai? This hotel has 5382 square feet (500 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 3 meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 242 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. KEM Hospital - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Tata Memorial Hospital - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- High Street Phoenix Mall - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Alibag - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- High Court - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Peninsula Corporate Tower - 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Palladium Mall - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Siddhi Vinayak Temple - 2. 8 km / 1. 7 mi- Shree Siddhivinayak Ganapati Temple - 2. 8 km / 1. 8 mi- Prince Aly Khan Hospital - 3. 2 km / 2 mi- Nehru Centre - 3. 3 km / 2 mi- Nehru Planetarium - 3. 3 km / 2 mi- Worli Sea Face Promenade - 3. 9 km / 2. 4 mi- The National Sports Club Of India - 4 km / 2. 5 mi- Mahalaxmi Racecourse - 4 km / 2. 5 mi.

119645.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Mumbai. It is a short drive away from the Gateway of India and the nearest station is Mumbai Central. All 68 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, ironing set and air conditioning.

119646.description: 'This luxury city hotel is strategically located in the downtown area of the city in South Mumbai's elite residential area. The hotel enjoys a convenient setting just 22 kms from Mumbai-Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport. Guests are enticed with the promise of elegance and opulence from the impressive exterior to the timeless beauty of the interiors. Guests will be impressed by the luxury and comfort of their surroundings. The guest rooms are beautifully-appointed with a classic style and modern amenities offering the ideal environment in which guests can relax and unwind at the end of the day. Guests are invited to wine and dine in style in the decadent surroundings of the hotel's restaurant where guests can sample the delights of a range of cuisines. '

119674.address: Dreamland-Al Wahat Road 6th of October City-Giza
119674.description: Located in Cairo's vibrant 6th of October district, this three-star hotel offers easy access to shopping, entertainment, and the city's business center. Just minutes from the industrial area and a short drive from the Giza Pyramids and the Egyptian Museum, it provides a range of leisure facilities to ensure a relaxing stay. Please note: Egyptian nationals sharing a room must present a marriage certificate.

name.content: Braston Augusta Hotel by Castelo Itaipava

119782.description: Boasting a prime location close to a host of bars, restaurants, theatres and shopping malls, this luxurious establishment is located in the Consolaçao, a district located in the central part of the city of São Paulo, in Brazil. Guarulhos International Airport is located a 29-minute drive from this stylish property. Ideal for business and leisure travellers alike, this stylish property is the perfect reference point for those guests wishing to explore this vibrant region staying in a contemporary and comfortable accommodation. All the guest rooms come with satellite television and air conditioning and have been tastefully decorated in soothing tones to encourage a restful night's sleep and provide peace and tranquillity. Boasting a cosy and warm atmosphere, the restaurant offers a unique ambience and a wide range of amazing à la carte specialities.

119786.description: The hotel is located in the neighbourhood of Liberty, about 400 m from the San Joaquin and Liberty stations and about 10 minutes' drive from major roads in the city. The hotel has a total of 99 rooms ready to accommodate those just passing through, longer term residents, and even whole families. For travelling professionals, or those looking to host a catered social gathering, the hotel also provides five meeting and seminar rooms, the largest of which can accommodate up to 400 people. Each room features central air conditioning, cable TV, individual safes, minibars, broadband Internet access and radio alarm clocks. Further in-room amenities include an en suite bathroom with a shower.

name.content: Gran Villagio Hotel SP by Castelo Itaipava

119787.description: The Brasson Flights Business Hotel, a São Paulo classic, offers personalized service from our highly qualified team, dedicated to ensuring your comfort and well-being. A cozy atmosphere, friendly staff, and central location are our strengths. We offer a daily continental breakfast featuring breads, cereals, pastries, juices, and fresh fruit. Our spacious accommodations are equipped with private bathrooms and well-lit workspaces, ideal for both work and study. A minibar is included in each room; charges for consumed items can be conveniently settled with a credit or debit card. We also have excellent facilities for meetings, conventions, and banquets. Seven versatile rooms accommodate small, medium, and large events, complete with state-of-the-art equipment and professional services.

119855.description: This establishment is located in the centre of the historical district of Marrakesh. Guests can access the famous Souks and Jemaa El Fna Square in a few minutes. Menara International Airport is roughly 10 km from the guesthouse. Carefully renovated in the art and tradition of Morocco, the hotel offers to be guests' new heaven in Marrakech. A pick-up service from the airport to the residence can be arranged. The hotel offers a hammam, massages and spa treatments, two outdoor swimming pool, and solariums facilities, which all contribute to guests' well-being and relaxation. For guests' comfort, all rooms are air-conditioned and equipped with en-suite bathrooms.

119913.description: Strategically located in the heart of Sao Paulo, the hotel is close to the financial, cultural and historical centres and major exhibitions and events, such as Anhembi Convention Centre and the ExpoCenter Rebolledo. Various shopping centres in the city, such as March 25, Bom Retiro and Brás, are also nearby. The subway stations Republic and St. Benedict are in the vicinity of the hotel. This chain of hotels is characterised by bold concepts, innovative architecture and personalised service, making it the preferred option for guests who value space, cleanliness, modern facilities and intelligent design concepts. Facilities include a lobby, restaurant, conference facilities, WLAN Internet access and room service. Designed to calm the mind and provide pleasant memories, the suites have a foyer where guests can relax or connect their notebook and carry out work in a peaceful and comfortable environment. Suites come with a king-size double bed, individually regulated air conditioning and heating, a fridge, cable TV, piped music, 24-hour room service, a direct dial telephone, radio, WLAN Internet access and a hairdryer. A breakfast buffet is served each morning.

120056.description: The Barceló Cairo Pyramids hotel offers modern accommodations on Pyramids Road, just 25 minutes from downtown Cairo and 60 minutes from Cairo International Airport. Enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the Giza Pyramids and Sphinx from this chic hotel. Amenities include free Wi-Fi, in-room safes, a heated rooftop pool with a sundeck, and three restaurants serving Italian, Mediterranean, and international cuisine. The 12th-floor restaurant boasts stunning pyramid views. Additional services include a 24-hour lobby bar, laundry, and excursions.

120057.description:
Warmth, simplicity and a gentle way of life are a few words that describe this hotel located in the Gobelins-Mouffetard district, close to the New Library, and the Latin Quarter. The lively bars and restaurants on Rue Mouffetard are a 10-minute walk away. The capital's numerous attractions such as Notre Dame, the Eiffel Tower, the Opéra or various department stores can be reached within minutes. Les Gobelins Metro Station is only 200 metres away, providing direct access to the Louvre Museum. This charming hotel will spark guests' appreciation for traditional hospitality. 
Our hotel is not air-conditioned. Fans are available for your use.

120061.description: This hotel is strategically situated in one of the most exclusive areas of Buenos Aires. The hotel is situated just a short distance away from the financial district of the city. The most prestigious cultural, shopping and entertainment areas can be found nearby. Many prominent attractions can be found in the area. This hotel lies within easy access of links to the public transport network. The hotel enjoys a contemporary style, welcoming visitors with the promise of a truly memorable stay. The guest rooms are superbly designed, featuring modern conveniences for a truly comfortable stay. The hotel offers guests access to an extensive range of first-class facilities and services, including a spa area, sauna and a gym.

120092.description: Located in the Bogazkent district on Turkey's southern coast, this luxurious establishment is just a 10-minute drive from Belek. The city of Antalya with its modern shopping centres, old city (Kaleici) and harbour is 49 kilometres away. This charming property, built in 2008, boasts a design inspired by the architecture and philosophy of the Far East and is a paradise for families and children. Spanning a total area of 3 ha the hotel features a choice of delicious culinary options, entertainment venues and relaxing activities. The outdoor complex contains a couple of pools and a stunning water park. Guests staying at this wonderful accommodation may enjoy the private beach, just a few steps away.

120099.description: Special Protection, our commitment to ensuring a safe stay with strict cleaning and sanitization protocols. Technologies to support the interaction with the staff to promote social distancing. Healthcare insurance throughout the stay in partnership with AXA Partners. The Hotel Mirage, Sure Hotel is located in the heart of the Italian economic hub, in a strategic position, just a few steps from the main places of the city. The hotel is set in Viale Certosa and is well connected with the main city roads, very close to Fiera Milano and Fiera Milano City exhibition sites. The good position of this hotel allows guests to discover the soul of the city, moving between elegant boutiques and trendy nightclubs. The hotel has 86 elegant rooms, all available with parquet and whirlpool. Each room is soundproof and provided with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, television with satellite and pay television channels, phone, safes, minibar, coffee maker and bathrobes for all guests. The Hotel Mirage, Sure Hotel is a 4 Star, perfect for any kind of traveler. It has a well-equipped gym, a bar open from 10 a. m. until 1 a. m. , Wi-Fi, storage, 23 parking spaces and shuttle service available during the main trade fairs based on availability and on request. This hotel, with three well-equipped meeting rooms, is the ideal solution for the business universe. Enjoy your stay.

120115.description: The contemporary hotel is situated in L'Hospitalet, one of Barcelona's busiest business development areas. Located across from Barcelona's international trade fair, this attractive property offers easy access to the city center and El Prat International Airport. Designed by renowned Japanese architect Toyo Ito, its unique architecture is an integral part of the Barcelona skyline. Offering exquisite service, this impressive hotel is ideal for business travelers, holidaymakers, and conference attendees. The soundproofed and thoughtfully appointed rooms guarantee a comfortable atmosphere and a good night's sleep. Guests can dine on international cuisine at the charming in-house restaurant, enjoy a drink at the welcoming bar, and work out at the on-site gym. The hotel also boasts impressive meeting facilities and a professional 24-hour reception. Just a few minutes' walk from the Europa-Fira metro station (L9, orange line), the hotel provides direct connections to the airport and city center. By car, the airport is just 10 minutes away, and the Gran Via 2 Shopping Centre is only 150 meters from the hotel.

120120.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this Georgian hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, 144 on the Hill, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 142 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected.

120121.description: Housed in an elegant eighteenth-century building at the top of Richmond Hill, this hotel is an excellent option for visiting Surrey and London's West End. To the right of the venue is Richmond Terrace, where they can enjoy magnificent views across the Thames valley that has for centuries been an inspiration for poets and painters. To the left are the 2, 500 acres of Richmond Royal Park, home to herds of red and fallow deer. This soothing and tranquil surrounding is the perfect place for a relaxed stay. Guests can treat themselves to a visit to the Health and Leisure club where an indoor swimming pool and 6-metre spa pool awaits. There is also a modern gym equipped with both cardio and free weights equipment and for the perfect recovery they can unwind in the spa afterwards. The restaurant is the perfect choice for a delicious, proper sit-down meal with friends and family.

120141.description:
Located in Jardins, one of the most prestigious neighborhoods in São Paulo and just one block from Avenida Paulista, the Tivoli Mofarrej São Paulo Hotel is the perfect choice to enjoy the best of the city. 

With all the amenities of a 5-star hotel and the best view of São Paulo, the hotel transforms your stay into a unique experience, whether for travelers or residents of São Paulo seeking special treatment at the Anantara Spa or even at the Seen Restaurant & Bar, which offers a privileged view of São Paulo's beautiful skyline, enlivening the city's nights. 

In addition, the cozy rooms and the largest and newest presidential suite in Latin America, the excellent meeting rooms, the outdoor pool, and the Must restaurant make the Tivoli Mofarrej São Paulo the ideal destination to discover the city. 

The Tivoli Mofarrej São Paulo is 500 meters from Chopping Cidade São Paulo and 2 km from the trendy Rua Oscar Freire. Cidade Jardim and JK shopping malls are 6. 5 km away. Congonhas Airport is 7 km away and Guarulhos Airport is 24 km away. 

The Tivoli Mofarrej São Paulo hotel informs that the daily rate corresponds to a 24-hour period, as stipulated in MTur Ordinance No. 28/2025. Check-in time is 3 PM and check-out time is 12 PM. The first 3 hours (from 12 PM to 3 PM) are strictly necessary and intended for cleaning, tidying, and sanitizing procedures, ensuring that the room is in perfect condition for the guest's arrival.

120161.description: This family-friendly city hotel is ideally situated in Hammersmith. The property is located just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Hammersmith tube station. Offering the ideal base from which to explore the sights of London, the property is within easy access of the West End, the Lyric Theatres and the River Thames. The Olympia and Earls Court exhibition centres are also located nearby. London's Heathrow Airport is just 18 km away. This property comprises tastefully-designed guest rooms. The property offers a range of facilities and services, catering for the needs of business and leisure travellers alike.

120174.description: Enjoy a stay at Hotel du Vin & Bistro Edinburgh, an eco-certified hotel nestled in Edinburgh's historic Old Town, just steps from the University of Edinburgh and a short walk from Edinburgh Castle. This charming hotel offers 47 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a flat-screen television, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a coffee/tea maker. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy French cuisine at the on-site Bistro du Vin, 24-hour room service, and a relaxing drink at the bar/lounge. A full breakfast is available for a fee. Additional amenities include concierge and wedding services, dry cleaning/laundry services, and luggage storage. The hotel is conveniently located near major attractions, including the Royal Mile and Princes Street.

120175.description: Nestled in the heart of Edinburgh, overlooking Princes Street and Edinburgh Castle, these luxurious apartments offer excellent destination for all those looking for peace and comfort. Positioned in the heart of Edinburgh's city centre, Princes Street Suites is located at Waterloo Place and only a two minute walk from Harvey Nichols and St. Andrews Square and a short stroll from Waverley Station. This elegant property includes 3-bedroom, 2-bedroom and studio apartments. Ideal for short or long stays in Edinburgh, each chic, sophisticated apartment has a kitchen, a bathroom and a lounge area with a TV and DVD player. The rooftop terrace has stunning panoramic views of the city and is a great place to enjoy the annual Edinburgh International Festival Fireworks, held each August in Princes Street Gardens. The complex boasts an award-wining spa, where patrons may balance body and soul.

name.content: J5 Hotel Port Saeed (formerly Rihab Rotana)

120184.address: 27 Street, Next to Deira City Centre, Port Saeed
120184.description: Ideally located on Al Gharhoud Road, J5 Hotels Port Saeed is a short walk from Deira City Centre and a 15-minute drive from Dubai International Airport. The Deira City Centre metro station is just steps away, providing easy access to attractions like the World Trade Centre, Dubai International Financial Centre, Dubai Mall, Dubai Fountains, and Dubai Creek, all within 10km. This Deira district landmark offers 134 spacious deluxe, premium, and suite accommodations, perfect for business and leisure travelers. Each room includes a fully equipped kitchenette, dining space, and a washing machine. Guests can enjoy a breathtaking view from the top-floor glass-fronted gym and relax in the adjacent swimming pool. Experience attentive service in a welcoming atmosphere.

120197.description: At La Villa Palace Hotel, exceptional service and top-notch amenities create a memorable experience for guests. Complimentary internet access is available in the hotel to ensure you stay connected during your visit. Arrange your trips to and from the airport using the hotel's convenient transportation services booking. Complimentary parking is available for guests. Due to health concerns, smoking is strictly prohibited within the entire premises of hotel. For the health and well-being of all guests and staff, smoking is restricted exclusively to assigned zones. A delightful breakfast is the perfect way to begin your day, and at La Villa Palace Hotel, you can always indulge in a scrumptious meal on-site. All adore a delightful cup of coffee! An on-site coffee shop ensures you can relish a cup of authentic, freshly-brewed coffee every morning -- or whenever you desire it. Allow your journey to be free from the pangs of hunger! On-site eateries offer delicious and accessible meal choices.

120198.address: Al Najma Area Near Souq Al Haraj Gate No.2
120198.description: This city hotel is located in a famous area of the Doha commercial district - 'Al Najma'. The establishment lies in close proximity to the C Ring road, the airport and shopping malls. Doha International Airport is approximately 3 kms away. This is a deluxe city hotel comprising 88 suites and apartments, which have been elegantly designed to provide sophisticated services to business travellers, couples and family holidaymakers. All accommodation units are luxuriously and elegantly furnished and equipped with all needed amenities for a comfortable stay. Guests looking to stay in shape can head to the on-site gym for a work-out and afterwards enjoy the sauna.

120201.description: Located in the elegant Salamanca district of Madrid, this family-friendly hotel offers 44 rooms and a range of amenities. Built in 2009, the hotel features a lobby with currency exchange, a cloakroom, and lift access. Guests can enjoy the on-site café and restaurant, while business travelers have access to conference facilities. Internet access, room service, and laundry services are also available. Each room includes an en suite bathroom with a shower, bathtub, and hairdryer, along with a king-size bed, individually controlled air conditioning, a TV, a safe, and internet access. Massage treatments can be booked for an extra fee. The hotel's restaurant, Ramón Freixa Madrid, serves a daily breakfast and offers à la carte options for lunch and dinner.

120202.description: The hotel is situated 100 m from Atocha station, within the area known as the Art triangle. The city's major art galleries are just a few minutes away, including the Reina Sofia, the Prado and the Thyssen. There is an abundance of restaurants and bars of all culinary persuasions close at hand. Madrid Airport is approximately 14 km from the hotel. In this establishment guests can enjoy tasteful, exquisite surroundings, a great deal of fun and an even greater ambience. The units each come with a balcony or terrace. They are filled with natural light and the calm murmurings of Madrid's streets below. A range of off-white tones form the basis of the interiors, true to the hotel's own design philosophy. All rooms have been devised with curiosity, simplicity and practicality in mind.

120234.description: This hotel is housed in a charming 19th-century building on the rue Godot de Mauroy, which links the Place de la Madeleine with the nearby department stores. It is just metres from the fashionable boutiques of the rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré, museums such as Pinacothèque, Louvre, Orsay, Orangerie and the theatres of Edouard VI, Mathurins, Michel and the Olympia. 'Gastronomic' Paris with its numerous and tempting restaurants is also close by. The nearest metro station is just 100 m away, and Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport and Paris Orly Airport lie 20 km and 30 km from the hotel respectively. Built in 2008, this air-conditioned hotel comprises 22 rooms and 1 suite. Charm, elegance, refinement and harmony are the most suitable words to define the ambiance in this establishment. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, safe, cloakroom and lift access. Internet access is provided throughout public areas and a laundry service is also available. Guests will be sure to appreciate the comfort of the guestrooms, which have been fitted with the latest in modern technology. Amenities include a direct dial telephone, LCD flat-screen TV with satellite and cable channels, complimentary high-speed Internet access, a safety deposit box and a minibar. The double beds come with high quality bedding, and the en suite bathrooms feature a shower, bath and hairdryer. Tea and coffee making facilities and an ironing set are also provided, and all rooms feature individually regulated air conditioning and heating and access to a private terrace. The sauna is the perfect place to unwind after a busy day's sightseeing. A continental breakfast buffet is served at this establishment. By metro: take line 12 and 14 to the Madeleine stop, which is 100 m from the hotel. By rail: take line RER A to Auber station, 100 m from the hotel. Alternatively, take lines 3 and 7 to the Opéra stop, 500 m from the hotel.

120387.description: Located directly across from Grand Central Terminal on East 44th Street, this hotel is ideal for business trips, weekend getaways, or family vacations to the heart of New York City. Its prime location adjacent to one of the world's most renowned train stations provides easy access to all of Manhattan. The Theater District, Times Square, the United Nations, Central Park, Rockefeller Center, the Empire State Building, and Fifth Avenue shopping are all within walking distance. LaGuardia Airport is a mere 9 kilometers away. The elegant rooms feature bay windows, spacious bathrooms, and convenient appliances and comfortable furnishings.

120418.description: Situated in the midst of the lively area of Soho, this property is surrounded by elegant shopping opportunities and theatres. Oxford Street, Bond Street and Liberty's Department Store can be found just a short distance away. This elegant hotel offers a luxurious haven for travellers who are eager to explore everything that this vibrant capital has to offer. Style and tradition combine at this property, to create a sophisticated setting in which to unwind. Classically-styled guest rooms offer the utmost in luxury. A luxurious spa offers visitors an escape, in which to indulge in the ultimate rejuvenation. Sumptuous dishes can be enjoyed in the upmarket restaurant. The property also features a cinema and a stunning rooftop terrace, where guests can admire the spectacular views over the city.

120445.description: The hotel, complete be renewed, wants to be an adequate counterpoint to the external environment. For those traveling for business and for those who participate in cultural events, artistic or promoting the territory, the hotel is offered as a friendly place, in the peace and beauty. The city has a historic artistic itinerary that ranges from the fourteenth century to the present day, from the Annunciata complex, the church of Santa Maria Nuova to the Castello Visconteo the itself. A few kilometers away, accessible by bicycle Castelletto, Cassinetta and Robecco sul Naviglio, propose noble villas and palaces overlooking the Naviglio Grande. Four Kilometers away is Morimondo, Cistercian heart of our territory. But if the Naviglio Grande is the “road” to Milan, the Ticino river is a natural element that animates the whole territory.

120452.description: This charming family-friendly hotel is located in the heart of Paris, just steps from the Centre Georges Pompidou. Close to both the famous cathedral Notre Dame and the Louvre museum, this hotel will turn any trip to Paris into an unforgettable experience. Built in 1700 and renovated in 2008, this historical hotel comprises a total of 20 rooms. Guests are welcomed into a foyer with a safe, 24-hour concierge service and luggage storage facilities. Wireless Internet access is provided throughout public areas. The hotel's double and single rooms come equipped with an in-room washbasin and standard rooms feature a private en suite bathroom and WC. There are communal bathrooms on each floor (open 24 hours a day). All rooms feature double-glazed windows and Internet access.

120473.description: This hotel boasts a fantastic setting in Barcelona's Eixample district, offering views to Gaudi's celebrated Sagrada Familia. Public transport links are within easy reach and the shops of Diagonal Avenue are only an eight-minute walk from the hotel. The hotel's chic and stylish guest rooms come with free mineral water and Wi-Fi, and some boast views of the Sagrada Familia. Guests can enjoy the hotel's warm and comfortable restaurant, the cosy café with its chill-out area, or enjoy the terrace views of the Sagrada Familia. The hotel also features five well-equipped meeting rooms and a private car park for customers.

120483.address: JBR on The Walk, The Beach
120483.description: Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach is a luxury five-star hotel located directly on Dubai's most popular recreational promenade, The Walk, and the new beachfront low-rise leisure and retail destination, The Beach. All 444 rooms and suites offer Arabian Gulf views and the hotel is no exception with its restaurants and lounges presenting truly international flavours. Leisure facilities extend to SoFIT fitness centre and magnifique meeting rooms dedicated to business facilities.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Dubai- Safa Park

120496.address: P.O BOX 71136, Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Safa, Dubai
120496.description: Welcome to Holiday Inn Express Dubai Safa Park and enjoy the view of the Dubai Water Canal. Stay in one of the city’s most central hotels, located just off Sheikh Zayed Road and minutes away from Dubai Mall, one of the world’s largest shopping malls. Hop on to an easy 15-minute drive or by Metro from Dubai International Airport to our fully equipped, modern 171 room hotel. The hotel is in the heart of Dubai’s business districts like Burj Khalifa district, Business Bay and Dubai World Trade & Convention Centre. Exploring Dubai’s latest additions - like the Museum of the Future or City Walk and the Water Canal, is now easy when you stay with us. Cruise your way in a water taxi or board the metro from Business Bay Water Canal or Metro station located within walking distance from the hotel. Hop on to our complimentary shuttle to Jumeirah Beach, Dubai Mall & Burj Khalifa. Try our Mexican restaurant Muchachas and indulge in enticing international cuisines in our Great Room. Start your day with a free express hot buffet breakfast. Pamper yourself in our fully equipped 24-hour Fitness Center, and take advantage of our complimentary high-speed wireless Internet. Host a sales meeting, training sessions or an informal get-together in our naturally lit meeting room. Earn IHG® One Rewards points every time you stay with us. We offer our guests the best hotel experience, while they are away from home.

120538.description: This hotel is situated in close proximity to Bogatell beach, in the quiet neighbourhood of Poblenou. The establishment is around 5 kms from the centre of Barcelona and offers easy access to Ronda del Litoral. Built in 2009, this city and business hotel is ideal for guests looking for a quiet location for work or leisure. The modern rooms are all abundant in natural light and come equipped with high-speed Internet access and an en-suite bathroom. Leisure options offered in the establishment include a gym, a sauna and a steam room. Guests can also treat themselves to a massage, which is available upon request.

120553.description: This airport hotel is situated 8 km from the World Trade Center and many shopping centres, business avenues and tourist attractions are located in close proximity, including the Dubai Museum, Al Mamzar beach and the Gold Souk. The hotel is just 4 km from Dubai International Airport. This hotel first opened its doors in 1992. It was recently renovated in 2008 and comprises a total of 84 guest rooms and suites spread across 7 storeys. The air-conditioned hotel features a modern dark glass exterior, and welcomes its guests into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and a cloakroom. Lift access is available, and additional hotel facilities include a coffee shop, an English pub, 4 bars, a disco and a restaurant. Conference facilities and room service are also provided. This hotel consists of 6 single rooms, 72 double/twin rooms and 6 suites. All rooms are equipped with a minibar, satellite/cable TV and air conditioning. The en suite bathrooms come with a shower, bath and hairdryer, and additional facilities include Internet access, a safe, minibar and an ironing set. The nearby beach is sandy. The hotel features a coffee shop, which serves a breakfast buffet and light snacks. There is also a pub and 4 lounge bars offering Indian, Pakistani, Korean and Iranian cuisine.

120563.description: Enjoy Dubai's vibrant Jumeirah district at the Holiday Inn Express Dubai Jumeirah, conveniently located near the beach and World Trade Centre. A complimentary shuttle whisks you to Jumeirah Beach and Port Rashid Docks, just three kilometers from the World Trade Centre. Dubai International Airport is a 20-minute taxi ride away. Start your day with our complimentary hot buffet breakfast in the Great Room and stay connected with free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Host up to 70 delegates in one of our two naturally lit meeting rooms or utilize the 24-hour self-service business center. Our friendly 24-hour Front Desk staff can assist with everything from Jumeirah Beach shuttles and shopping recommendations to desert safari bookings and Downtown Dubai excursions. Enjoy international cuisine at the Great Room or catch up with friends at The Brick Wall Sports Bar, open until 2 am. Don't miss the recently opened Museum of the Future during your stay.

120569.description: This hotel is strategically located in downtown Miraflores, close to the handicraft markets, financial centre, and surrounded by shops, cafés, bars, and the best restaurants in Peru. The hotel is renowned for being located in a quiet and comfortable area. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, cloakroom and lift access, a café, bar and restaurant, Wi-Fi and room and laundry services. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the car park.

120570.description: Located in the San Isidro residential area, this hotel is near the historic city centre. Minutes away, there is the tourist district of Miraflores, where guests can find a plethora of museums, art galleries and exclusive shops. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, cloakroom, lift access, and a hairdressing salon. The hotel has a café, bar and restaurant, and conference facilities with WLAN Internet access. Room and laundry services, as well as parking facilities are available.

120573.description: This city hotel is situated in the heart of Miraflores, which is considered the most popular entertainment and business district. The establishment lies within walking distance of a number of restaurants, nightclubs, casinos and theatres. It was renovated in 2008 and comprises a total of 53 guestrooms spread across 8 storeys with lift access provided. The establishment is fully air-conditioned and features a range of high-tech facilities, as well as personalised services and comfortable installations for business travellers and tourists. Apart from the standard amenities, the elegant guestrooms are fitted with individually regulated climate control and open to a balcony or terrace. Dining options are available at the hotel.

120598.description: Valencia guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 1 rooms.

120633.description: CIN: IT108033A19OV4O7HV - CODICE CIR: 108033-ALB-00003This city hotel is situated in the heart of Brianza, just a few minutes' drive from Milan. Guests will find a range of restaurants and shops nearby, and the Monza Autodrome is just 2 km away. Links to the public transport network can be found just 300 m away, while Milan Linate Airport and Milan Malpensa Airport lie 18 km and 60 km away, respectively. With a total of 66 rooms, this air-conditioned hotel aims to satisfy the demands of both business and leisure guests. Lift access is provided to all guestrooms, and there is a bar, breakfast room and restaurant where visitors can enjoy delicious meals and refreshments. Business travellers will appreciate the conference facilities and those arriving by car can make use of the hotel's car park.

120637.description:
Monsieur Aristide, a 4-star boutique hotel, has nestled itself on one of the charming cobblestone streets of Montmartre. A 19th-century building houses the hotel's 25 rooms and suites, arranged around a secluded, idyllic garden. An open and unique establishment, its furnishings were largely sourced from antique shops and boutiques both near and far. It also boasts a restaurant serving authentic bistro-style cuisine featuring seasonal ingredients, a cocktail bar with live music, a hidden terrace, and a garden under the stars. 

It's a vibrant, hybrid space where evenings linger for locals and travelers alike, who have made it their home away from home.

120640.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Paris and was established in 1864. It is close to the Saint Sulpice and the nearest station is Saint Placide. All 20 rooms are equipped with hairdryer and air conditioning.

120642.address: Po Box 7347 Riyad, Main Olaya Rd, 2299
120642.description: The Executives Olaya, a 4-star hotel in Riyadh, offers 178 neutrally decorated rooms featuring work desks, in-room safes, and TVs with international channels. Private bathrooms include showers and hairdryers. Located on Olaya Street, the hotel is a 25-minute drive from King Khalid International Airport and 200 meters from the Kingdom Tower. Guests can enjoy a restaurant, conference facilities, room service, laundry service, and parking. The hotel also features an indoor swimming pool, gym, sauna, and steam room. Dining options include an oriental buffet, along with popular regional and international dishes.

120645.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an outdoor pool, and an outdoor tennis court. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Grab a bite at Olaya Express Coffee Shop, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Riyadh? This hotel has 1679 square feet (156 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

name.content: Dobedan Exclusive Hotel and Spa Ex Alva Donna

120657.address: Sahil Mah. Mimar Sinan Caddesi, Bogazkent, Antalya, 5
120657.description: Located in the district of Bogazkent, this property is some 9 kilometres from Belek. The city of Antalya is 47 kilometres and Antalya airport is a 60-minute drive from this unique and luxurious hotel. Spanning a total area of 3. 1 ha this beachfront establishment includes gardens, ornamental pools and a wide range of top quality facilities to suit all travellers' needs. This stylish property blends perfectly with the environment and includes a selection of tastefully decorated spaces with modern interior and exterior designs such as the Ottoman corner and the futuristic bar. Public transport and taxis are available at the hotel entrance. ***Outdoor heatable pool is on service in winter season***

120680.address: Fray J Sta. Maria de Oro 2529
120680.description: This modern and friendly apartment complex enjoys an excellent location in the popular Palermo district of Buenos Aires. It is equally ideal for business and leisure travellers. The convention & exhibition centre Predio Ferial La Rural is within minutes; the green area Los Bosques de Palermo, the Japanese and the Botanical Garden are within a short stroll. The nearby metro station offers easy access to the city centre.

120697.description: Tranquillity and relaxation awaits guests at this country retreat, which is tucked away in the district of Armamar. The establishment offers fantastic views over the Naçarães Valley. The city of Lamego is 22 km away and Peso da Régua is 16 km away.
