Offering 9 villas and a few double rooms, this family-friendly establishment stands for comfort and attentive service. Its traditional architecture and antique furnishings lend the place an exclusive charm and it was fully refurbished in 2009. On-site facilities include a games room and a bike hire service for those wishing to explore the local surroundings. The villas are equipped with a kitchenette with a minibar and microwave; a private bathroom with a shower/bath; a private terrace and amenities such as satellite/cable TV, a safe and central heating. The leisure facilities available at this establishment include an outdoor swimming pool and a sauna. Guests can also make use of the rental bikes or simply soak up the sun during a stroll through the garden or the surrounding vineyards. Guests can sample regional specialities at the restaurant while overlooking the Naçarães Valley. The restaurant Barroca offers the possibility to choose between dining on the terrace or in the comfort of the villa (additional charges apply).

name.content: Rural Casa dos Viscondes da Várzea

120698.description: A total of 37 rooms are available for guests' convenience at Rural Casa dos Viscondes da Várzea.

120700.description: The hotel is located in the financial district and most exclusive residential area in Lima, the suburb of San Isidro. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, cloakroom, lift access, a newsstand, hairdressing salon, a casino, a café, bar and restaurant, conference facilities and Wi-Fi. Guests may also take advantage of the room and laundry services. The Hotel is 25 minute distance from Lima International Airport. Guests can enjoy an amazing view to one of the greatest green areas in the capital: the Lima Golf Club.

120702.description: The hotel is located in the attractive business and residential district of San Isidro in Lima, Peru. Its unique location provides easy access to important institutions and major corporations as well as boutiques, shopping centres, restaurants and nightlife. The hotel offers restaurants, health club, meeting space, business centre and other luxury amenities. This hotel delivers the perfect combination of warmth, comfort and personalised service.

120709.description: Nestled right in the heart of the San Isidro residential district, the hotel boasts an outstanding location very near the historical centre of the capital city and some of its top attractions. The Gold Museum of Peru, the National Archaeology Museum, and Magical Water Circuit and Inca ruins are just a few of the tourist charms in the Peruvian capital that can easily be visited from our hotel. The hotel's facilities include a restaurant, a bar, a meeting room, Wi-Fi throughout the hotel and a business centre.

120712.description: This city hotel is located in the capital's financial district, around 45 minutes' drive from the Catedral de Lima and the Iglesia de San Francisco y Catacumbas, and approximately 30 minutes from Jorge Chavez Airport. Along with relaxing views of the golf course, this fully air-conditioned hotel features currency exchange facilities, on-site business centre and wireless Internet access. Dining options include a bar and restaurant, and children will enjoy the kids' club. The hotel's guestrooms come equipped with double or king-size beds, satellite/cable TV and a minibar. Guests can enjoy a workout in the hotel gym, followed by a visit to the sauna or steam room. Alternatively, they may want to treat themselves to a relaxing massage treatment or a soak in the hot tub. In the restaurant and bar, guests can sample the world-renowned Peruvian cuisine.

120739.address: Cnr Century Way & Century Boulevard, Century City
120739.description: This opulent hotel enjoys an enviable setting in Century City, just 11 km from downtown Cape Town. It's a convenient base for both business and leisure travelers. The Central Business District, the V&A Waterfront, and numerous shopping and entertainment venues are a short drive away. The impressive décor blends elegance with modern trends. Guests can relax in spacious, sumptuously designed suites and ample penthouses with views of Table Mountain or the Durbanville Hills. After a day of work or sightseeing, unwind in the cocktail bar. Versatile meeting rooms are available for business travelers, and the friendly 24-hour reception staff can offer recommendations on the best places to visit.

120876.description: This hotel is in a prime location, in the heart of the Miraflores district, known for its great cultural and artistic activities, as well as being the financial centre of the city, near its major companies, and 5 minutes from the beach. Boutiques, restaurants, cinemas, coffee shops, art galleries, artisan markets and parks are all nearby. Larcomar, Lima's newest shopping and entertainment center overlooking the Pacific Ocean, offers a myriad of exciting activities. The hotel offers currency exchange facilities, lift access and a restaurant.

120914.description: Located 100 meters from Exponor (Porto International Fair) and just a few minutes from Porto International Airport, the Marshopping (IKEA) and Norteshopping shopping centers, Porto de Leixões, the Matosinhos Equestrian Center, the beaches of Leça da Palmeira, the hotel offers 134 modern and comfortable rooms. Equipped with air conditioning, bathtub with shower, hairdryer, cable TV, desk, free Internet access, ironing board and iron on request, coffee and infusions available. The Hotel also has a bar from 11:00 am to midnight, facilities for people with reduced mobility, elevator, safe, luggage storage, meeting room (up to 25 participants). Customers arriving in their own vehicle will be able to park on site (public outdoor parking or private garage). Possibility to charge your electric car. The attentive reception team is at your disposal 24 hours a day. Start the day with our free breakfast buffet offer. In the evening, before heading to your room, enjoy a drink at the bar.

120933.description: Located a short 7km from Mumbai's Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport, this 3-star city hotel offers comfortable accommodations at affordable rates. Just a short distance from the railway and bus stations, guests will find restaurants, bars, pubs, and nightspots nearby, with shopping venues a 20-minute walk away. The 35 air-conditioned rooms are tastefully decorated with neutral colors and wooden furnishings, perfect for both business and leisure travelers. Each room features a private bathroom, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, internet access, and a balcony/terrace. Hotel amenities include a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, lift access, supermarket, pub, disco, restaurant, room service, and laundry service. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast each morning and à la carte or menu-based dinners in the hotel's elegantly appointed restaurant, specializing in Indian, Chinese, and Continental cuisine. Bed and breakfast stays are also available.

120935.description:
This option includes accommodation + general admission standing tickets for the Shakira concert. 
Accommodation will be in a 3* category hotel located within the urban area of Madrid. 
The specific hotel will be assigned within 3 working days following the creation of the reservation. 
The hotels included in this modality offer adequate standards of comfort and functionality. 
The hotel location may vary and can be in different areas of Madrid.

120964.description: Tucked away on Copthall Avenue, this 4-star boutique hotel sits in the heart of London's old city. The Clayton Hotel London Wall offers a variety of stylish rooms and suites with free Wi-Fi, a modern gym, and convenient access to everything the city has to offer. Each room includes a flat-screen TV, super king-size beds, and a luxurious en suite bathroom with Antipodes organic toiletries. Make yourself at home with the Nespresso coffee machine and Bowers & Wilkins wireless Bluetooth speaker. Some rooms also feature private balconies overlooking the city (subject to availability). Cots and highchairs are available upon request. For dining, the Clayton Bar & Restaurant serves delicious dishes in an art deco setting. If you prefer to explore the local culinary scene, Old Spitalfields Market and the vibrant Shoreditch district are less than a mile away. The hotel boasts excellent transport links, with three tube stations and Liverpool Street Station nearby, providing easy access to Westminster, the West End, and beyond. You'll also find yourself surrounded by some of London's greatest attractions, including St. Paul's Cathedral and the iconic London Bridge.

name.content: Altis Belem Hotel & Spa, a Member of Design Hotels

120966.description:
The Altis Belém Hotel & Spa is a five-star design hotel located in Lisbon’s historic Belém district, nestled beside the Tagus River between the Monument to the Discoveries and Belém Tower. The hotel’s contemporary design draws inspiration from the Age of Exploration. 

Its 45 rooms and five suites offer amenities such as full HD LCD TVs, coffee makers, safes, wired and wireless internet, minibars, workspaces, and, in some cases, balconies with Jacuzzis. Guests can also enjoy an à la carte pillow menu, down duvets, and luxurious Egyptian cotton linens. 

No stay is complete without a gastronomic experience at the Feitoria Restaurant & Wine Bar. Awarded a Michelin star, the restaurant focuses on contemporary Portuguese gastronomy blended with influences from some of the world’s most exotic cuisines. 

For a lighter meal, Cafetaria Mensagem offers a more relaxed atmosphere, featuring a terrace with views of the marina. Altis Belém also recommends Bar 38º41’ for drinks and an exclusive musical selection. 

On the ground floor, three fully equipped rooms overlooking the marina are available for all types of events, making them ideal for both business meetings and unforgettable celebrations. 

For relaxation and wellness, the Bspa by Karin Herzog features indoor and outdoor pools, a gym, a variety of treatments and rituals, a Hammam, sauna, Vichy shower, and body and facial massages. 

Seasonally open, the rooftop area overlooks the Tagus River and offers guests the opportunity to enjoy the sun by the outdoor pool, complete with sun loungers and parasols.

120967.description: The hotel is located in the Esentepe, the new business district of Istanbul with convenient public transport links to the rest of the city. It is furnished and decorated in a modern, contemporary and functional style, suitable for business and leisure travellers alike. One of the 3 restaurants enjoys a breathtaking panoramic view of the Bosphorus. A patisserie and 3 bars are also available to guests. There are up to 15 meeting rooms suitable for business meetings and functions with conference facilities. The accommodation units are furnished and decorated in a contemporary style with a number of technological features such as an interactive TV system, 40-inch LCD full HD television with satellite channels and Internet connection.

120969.description: Situated in Istanbul's historic Fatih district, our hotel offers easy access to iconic attractions such as the Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, and Spice Bazaar. Just a short 5-minute walk from the metro and tramway, exploring Taksim, Sirkeci, Mecidiyeköy, and other vibrant areas is effortless. Our 126 rooms range from standard to deluxe, executive, and family options, ensuring a comfortable stay for every traveler. We're conveniently located 40 km from Istanbul Airport and 55 km from Sabiha Gökçen Airport, with private VIP transfer services available upon request. Experience exceptional Turkish hospitality and a wide range of services at our well-established hotel.

120970.description: Santiago Holiday Inn® in front of Santiago’s AirportA sleek, contemporary design and a convenient location make the Holiday Inn® Santiago - Airport Terminal Hotel a perfect choice for your next stop at Santiago, Chile. We are ideally located directly in front of the Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport Terminal, just a few steps outside of baggage claim. Our corporate guests will find everything they need, like a superb Business Center, four meeting rooms and free Wi-Fi access. Local and international businesses, as well as major embassies and consulates, are easily accessible from our hotel's location in Santiago. Leisure travelers can enjoy the city’s numerous and varied attractions. From breathtaking views on top of San Cristobal Hill, to Alto Las Condes mall, where you will find shops, restaurants and a cinema theatre, there's something for everyone to enjoy. Spend an afternoon exploring the colorful and bohemian Barrio Bellavista, or enjoy an evening performance at the Teatro Municipal de Santiago. After a busy day, guests can unwind in their quiet and comfortable room, enjoy a meal at Grill Restaurant, or try an appetizer at Boarding Bar. High quality amenities and recreational facilities, such as an indoor pool, a sauna and a Fitness Center, complement our award-winning service.

name.content: Miraflores Park, A Belmond Hotel, Lima

120972.address: Av Malecon De La Reserva 1035 Miraflores
120972.description:
Miraflores Park, a Belmond Hotel, enjoys an unparalleled location in Lima. Perched in verdant parkland on the Pacific coast, this all-suite urban sanctuary affords spellbinding views. Each of the refined suites boasts vistas of shimmering sea, vibrant city or its own flower-filled terrace. Guests enjoy a spectacular rooftop pool, sublime spa and sought-after dining venues. In Tragaluz, arresting art-filled interiors set the scene for imaginative Asian-Peruvian cuisine. Belo Bar’s innovative cocktails are prized by the city’s trendsetters. On the doorstep are the upscale shops and cultural attractions of the stylish Miraflores neighbourhood. Tailor-made activities unveil the treasures of Lima, from foodie hotspots to archaeological sites. 

From July 30th to December 31st 2026, hotel access will be temporarily available through Tragaluz Restaurant, located on Los Carolinos Street.

120995.description: Make the most of your stopover, business trip or weekend break at this inviting Lisbon hotel with breakfast and Wi-Fi included. Enjoy easy access to Lisbon Airport (less than 2kms away), close proximity to Lisbon city center and Lisbon International Fair (FIL). Holiday Inn Express Lisbon Airport is located just 10 minutes from downtown Lisbon with easy access to public transport, Hop On Hop Off buses and metro a mere 4kms from the hotel at Gare do Oriente, where numerous trains leave heading South and North. Music lovers are a 5-minute drive from Meo Arena, where big shows are held throughout the year, and the Rock In Rio venue Parque da Bela Vista, and sports fans enjoy close proximity to catch the big games at Sporting stadium or Benfica Stadium. Make your room your own with a choice of pillows and complimentary tea and coffee. Our 24-hour lobby bar and our outside terrace are perfect to have a drink. Inclusive high-speed Internet is available throughout the hotel and in all rooms. Start your day off with our inclusive Express Start breakfast to ensure you are fully fueled for your day.

121054.description: Ibis Dubai Mall of Emirates is situated in Al Barsha, next to Mall of the Emirates, which offers fun attractions & activities such as Magic Planet, VOX Cinemas & Ski Dubai. It is conveniently located 30 minutes' drive away from Dubai International Airport. The hotel offers modern guest rooms, 2 restaurants, a bar and free daily parking. Stay connected with our complimentary WIFI and make use of our web corner in the hotel for your business needs.

name.content: Novotel Suites Mall Avenue Dubai Hotel

121055.description: Everything Dubai has to offer is just minutes away from this charming and modern hotel. This stylish hotel is a mecca for shoppers, while business guests will appreciate the proximity to the city's major financial district. With beaches, the marina and even skiing, just a stroll away, travellers can prepare themselves for a fun-filled stay. All suites are beautifully appointed in soothing tones and can be smartly divided into bedroom and living room in case it is more convenient for guests than only having one space. Travellers will be impressed by their modern look and useful amenities. Those guests travelling by car will be able to use the hotel’s indoor parking facilities and everyone will have the opportunity of enjoying a refreshing dip at the rooftop swimming pool.

121056.address: P.O. BOX 118737 Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Wasl, Dubai
121056.description: The hotel is ideally located in the business hub of Dubai, next to the Dubai International Financial Centre. Dubai International Airport is only 7 km away by car. At this hotel, guests can enjoy 118 fully equipped rooms with stylish, luxurious and modern amenities. Liberating services, from in-room dining to daily housekeeping, help guests make the most of their time by taking the load off their shoulders. The air-conditioned hotel offers a café, conference facilities and room and laundry services. In-room facilities include tea and coffee making facilities, satellite TV, international direct dial telephone and safe. All rooms are en suite and air-conditioned. Tastefully decorated, the on-site café is a unique blend of contemporary design and urban chic. Guests can pamper their senses with the mouth-watering breakfast buffet.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel Dubai Barsha Heights

121057.description:
Radisson Blu Hotel, Dubai Barsha Heights, our 5-star hotel, provides a prime location with easy access to Dubai’s major business hubs, shopping, and attractions. Enjoy convenient metro access and a 20-minute drive to both international airports. 
Plan a memorable stay in one of our 537 spacious rooms and suites with modern amenities. Enjoy a delicious meal or drink at one of our five specialty restaurants. Feel at home with extensive facilities including meeting spaces, a wellness and fitness club, swimming pool, Kids’ Club, and leisure amenities. 
Whether you’re traveling for business, leisure, or with family, our thoughtful amenities will ensure a seamless stay.

name.content: Arjaan by Rotana – Dubai Media Vity

121058.address: King Salman Bin Abdul Aziz Al Saud Street
121058.description: Located in the heart of Dubai's Media City, Arjaan by Rotana offers luxurious suites and apartments with contemporary Moorish-style interiors and balconies overlooking the Palm Jumeirah and stunning cityscape views. Guests can enjoy a temperature-controlled pool, modern gym, and on-site dining options, including the poolside Veranda snack bar and Arabesque Restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The hotel also provides a separate children's pool, babysitting services, and 24-hour front desk assistance.

121092.description: Situated in Paris's 17th arrondissement, west of the city center, the hotel boasts a prime location. A short walk from the Porte Maillot Congress Centre and La Défense business district, it's also just ten minutes from the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Élysées. The hotel occupies a quiet one-way street lined with elegant Haussmann-style buildings. This chic neighborhood offers a vibrant village atmosphere with numerous bars, restaurants, and shops within easy walking distance. Several rooms feature views of the 17th arrondissement or Parisian rooftops, and breakfast can be enjoyed in your room or from the buffet.

121113.description: This beautiful boutique hotel is set in a prime location in the historic Sultanahmet district of Istanbul, just between Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque and enjoying fantastic views over the Old Town and the Marmara Sea from its rooftop terrace. It features a restaurant, two excellent lounges, a bar and a lovely garden. The major attractions such as Topkapi palace are literally only steps away.

name.content: Wyndham Costa del Sol Lima Airport

121115.description: 'Just steps from Lima International Airport, our hotel—winner of the World Travel Awards' Best Airport Hotel in South America in 2010, 2014, 2015, and 2016—offers an unexpected experience. Enjoy local and international cuisine in our 24-hour restaurant or unwind in our 24-hour spa featuring massages, a jacuzzi, steam room, and sauna. Take a refreshing dip in our indoor pool. Our attentive staff can assist with meeting services and recommend must-see destinations in historical and colonial Lima. Please note: Peru's 18% national sales tax applies to Peruvian citizens and foreign guests staying 60 consecutive days or more. Foreign guests presenting a valid passport and Andean Migration Card at check-in are exempt. The tax may apply per room if shared by taxable and non-taxable guests. '

121116.description: El Manto Hotel Lima MGallery está localizado en una zona exclusiva con una excelente ubicación. Este hotel en Lima, Perú, tiene una conexión con la historia y la cultura limeña. En el Restaurante Saya, podrá degustar riquísimos platos limeños y de la gastronomía peruana, acompañados de una privilegiada selección de vinos y bebidas, así como un exclusivo menú de cócteles en el Bar Patio Republicano. También ofrecemos un gimnasio, exposiciones temporales de arte, biblioteca, estacionamiento y mucho más.

121132.description: This hotel lies just 500 metres away from the town centre of Vilafranca del Penedes. Set in an area known for its prestigious wines and champagnes, the hotel is immersed in the rich culture of the region. The hotel's privileged location allows for ease of access to Barcelona and Sitges, as well as a number of attractions in the area. This functional hotel is sure to meet all expectations. The guest rooms are sublimely styled, featuring functional space and modern furnishings. Guests can enjoy superb, contemporary cuisine in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant. The hotel also features a bar and a cafe. Business travellers will be pleased by the hotel's conference facilities.

121133.address: Trepat (Pol. Industrial el Clot de Moja), 5
121133.description: This comfortable hotel combines functionality and friendly service and is the ideal place for a short business trip or a relaxing holiday in the Penedes. The air-conditioned establishment welcomes its guests to well-appointed rooms where they can unwind by watching a movie, browsing the internet thanks to the WiFi internet access or just stretch and nap on the cosy bed. For the perfect start of the day one can treat him/herself to a freshly baked pastry and a strong coffee from the onsite cafe, before heading out to explore the area. There are plenty of things to do and see around the venue since it sits only one kilometre from Vilafranca del Penedès, capital of the Alt Penedès wine region and the so called “queen of Cava”. Those who are looking for some sun and sand will be just a 20-minute drive from the Vilanova i la Geltrú beach.

121136.description: This hotel is stunningly situated in Paris' 9th district, close to Montmartre. This charming hotel is situated close to the opera, Paris Nord, Thalys and Eurostar stations. The hotel lies within easy access of the many intriguing attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. Paris-Orla Airport and Paris-Charles de Gaulle Airport are situated within 40 km of the hotel. This wonderful hotel enjoys a long history, dating back to 1850. The hotel enjoys a beautiful blend of old-world charm and contemporary chic. The guest rooms offer a relaxing atmosphere, complemented by soft, bright colours. This wonderful hotel offers modern facilities, ensuring an unforgettable stay for each and every visitor. Visitors can enjoy a breakfast with fresh and varied produce in the cosy lobby. Guests will find free soft drinks and snacks at the open bar in the afternoon.

121138.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. Additional features at this Victorian hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 14 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars.

121140.description:
Strategically situated with easy access to bus and metro stations, Piedras Suites is just a stone's throw from the financial district, commercial centre and most tourist spots such as Plaza de Mayo, Puerto Madero and La Boca.

Built in 2009, this exclusive Apartment building offers 15 fully equipped apartments for a comfortable stay in Buenos Aires, as well as a lobby with reception, lift access and WI FI Internet access.

With wide windows and balconies in each apartment, guests are provided with a spacious and sunny venue complemented by unique characteristics, solid wooden furniture and vivid colours to complete this minimalist retreat of contemporary architecture and design. Every detail has been meticulously checked for guests' comfort. Each apartment has a Full Bathroom with shower/bathtub on the upper level. Other standard features include a double bed, individually regulated air conditioning and heating, a safe, 32-inch LCD cable TV, DVD player, direct dial telephone, ironing set upon request and a kitchenette with microwave, fridge, electronic squeezer, crockery, cutlery and glassware.

121141.description: This hotel is located in an important touristic area of Buenos Aires City, just metres away from the Congress building and the Obelisk. In the vicinity, there are numerous restaurants, cinemas, shops, theatres and the bus station. Guests may make use of the lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, lift access, a breakfast room, WIFI Internet access and room service. Facilities available for an additional fee include a laundry service, car park and a garage.

121167.address: Colinton Road (Off Protea Rd) Po Box 151
121167.description: We are one of South Africa's best-loved hotels, maybe because we exist to please the guests who stay with us. Looking for somewhere to relax and dine , try our authentic, ethically sourced cuisine served in the restaurant. Want that with a side of exercise? Work off your worries in our gym, in the pool with its stunning view of the eastern slopes of Table Mountain, or just defrag in the luxury of our famous spa. Your room? Well, it's lovely and contemporary, and welcoming.

121168.description: Modern meets vintage at the oldest running hotel in South Africa. With a history spanning three centuries – it's intimate luxury combined with chic antique style. Located in the heart of Stellenbosch in Church Street, step out to explore the wonders of the town or venture out to the nearby famous wine farms of the region.

121179.description: The hotel is located in the district of Miraflores, the commercial centre of Lima. It is 20 minutes' walk from the beach and 20 minutes from the city centre. The international airport is 30 minutes away. Renovated in 2008, the air-conditioned hotel offers 151 rooms, each featuring 3 telephone lines, voice mail, modem connection and WiFi Internet access, making them especially suitable for guests travelling on business. Rooms are further fitted with private bathrooms and modern recreational amenities. The hotel's café, bar and restaurant provide food and drinks, whilst conference facilities are available to corporate guests. The hotel has a gym and sauna. An entertainment programme is provided for adults and there is a casino on-site.

121205.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a sauna and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, an arcade/game room, and a television in a common area. Satisfy your appetite with international cuisine at OUIBar + KTCHN, a delicatessen which features a bar/lounge. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Brussels? This hotel has 1163 square feet (108 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 149 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

121206.description: Discover the heart of Vienna right at your front door. In the IntercityHotel Wien you will reside in a central location at the Westbahnhof (western train station) on a lively shopping street offering the best transport connections. Located near the city centre, with its major sightseeing attractions you will find all the comforts of a modern city hotel. The centrally located IntercityHotels offer modern, comfortable rooms in a friendly atmosphere in which guests have come to appreciate. Not only will you enjoy a sound sleep in the delightful rooms, but also the convenience of quick access to major transport connections, in close proximity to the hotel. The rooms at the IntercityHotel Wien offer perfect facilities, such as TV, telephone and fridge, as well as the convenience of High-speed internet connection.

121213.description: The 4-star Art Hotel Amsterdam is situated on the edge of Amsterdam's historic center, a 15-minute walk through Westerpark from the heart of the city. Schiphol Airport is less than 15 km away and easily accessible. The rooms are fully equipped with amenities such as free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV, an espresso machine, a mini-fridge, and room service. Each room also features a unique piece of artwork on the wall. Facilities include a restaurant with a terrace, a bar, a fitness center, and a meeting room.

121214.description:
This charming and modest hotel is ideally located right in the middle of Amsterdam's Museum Quarter.  Jacob Obrechtstraat tram and bus stop is right outside the hotel, making it incredibly easy for visitors to move about the city.  Guests will be able to reach the Van Gogh Museum, Stedelijk Museum, and Rijksmuseum on foot in just ten minutes, and the Anne Frank House and old town are within easy reach via public transport.
The hotel's cosy guest rooms are all en suite and come with cable television with international channels.  Guests will delight in the traditional Dutch breakfast served in the morning and can relax with a drink at the bar after a busy day of sightseeing.  There is also a lovely, flowering garden terrace and handy computer with internet access for guest use.  For a wonderful weekend city break or family holiday in Amsterdam, this hotel is an excellent choice.

121226.description: This city hotel is located in the Lince district, within walking distance of the historical centre of Lima, 30 minutes from the international airport, 2 minutes from San Isidro Business Centre and 10 minutes from Miraflores. The establishment has 11 floors and air conditioning in common areas. It is an ideal alternative for both tourism and business trips. The interiors feature colonial design with wooden ceilings and chandeliers. Renovated in 2009, the hotel offers 99 rooms and a business centre which provides Internet access and faxing services. A beauty salon is available for guests who wish to try a new style. Visitors may also chance their luck in the casino, enjoy a drink in the cafe or bar, or dine in the on-site restaurant.

121227.description:
These apartments are the ideal choice to visit this amazing city, either when travelling for business or leisure. The premises sit very close from the lively Miraflores nightlife, as well as within easy reach from the well-known Larco avenue with numerous cafés and shopping centres for guests' convenience. The apartments are also a mere 20 minutes away from the beautiful Lima's historical city centre and half an hour from Jorge Chávez international airport. The spacious and light-filled apartments are the ideal spaces in which guests can truly relax and disconnect from everyday stresses. They are smartly and stylishly appointed with superior amenities and sophisticated furniture. Guests can taste the mouth-watering specialities served at the wonderful on-site cafe - 
restaurant. Visitors can keep updated thanks to the WIFI connection. Enjoy our well equiped fitness center available from monday to friday (6hrs to 22hrs), saturdays (8hrs to 17hrs), sundays is closed.

121229.description: This charming hotel is conveniently situated in Miraflores, in the historical city of Lima. The hotel is located a short walking distance from the historical centre of the city, allowing guests the opportunity to easily explore the captivating attractions and points of interest it has to offer. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a host of restaurants, bars and nightclubs, while Jorge Chavez International Airport lies a mere 30 minutes' driving distance away. Guests are welcomed by warm hospitality and a relaxing ambience. The guest suites enjoy a traditional design, and comprise a living and dining area. The rooms come complete with modern amenities for guests' convenience and comfort. Guests are invited to relax and unwind in the hot tub and sauna, or can enjoy the ultimate invigoration with a massage.

121241.description: Just 450 metres from Copacabana Beach, the Hotel Atlantico Star features a sun terrace that overlooks the sea. Hotel Atlantico Star offers air-conditioned rooms that feature views of the Atlantic Forest and Copacabana main avenue. With modern décor, they offer plenty of space. Excursions and day trips are available from the tour desk and car rental can be arranged through the 24-hour reception. Hotel Atlantico Star is located 750 metres from Cardeal Arcoverde tube station, 7 km from Santos Dumont Airport and 23. 8 km from International Airport (Galeão). Copacabana Fort is only 3. 8 km away. Parking is subject to availability and charges will apply.

121286.description: This hotel is situated near the A6 and is ideal for guests visiting Almere or Amsterdam. The capital is approximately a 15-minute drive away. This city hotel comprises a total of 154 comfortable rooms. It is ideal for business travellers and holidaymakers alike and guests are welcome to relax in the cosy hotel bar. Business travellers will appreciate the conference facilities and there is parking available for those arriving by car. The rooms are cosy and comfortable, they all come with a private bathroom and are equipped with modern amenities to provide a pleasant stay. Sports enthusiasts may enjoy an invigorating workout in the gym. The hotel has an attractive restaurant with an extensive à la carte menu.

121306.description:
The hotel is located just 1.7 km from Junction 4 of the M6, 4.8 km from the NEC/Birmingham International Airport and it is just a 17-minute train ride to Birmingham City Centre from Coleshill Parkway. The other closest airports include West Midlands International (about 33 km), East Midlands (53 km), London Luton (130 km), Ringway International (139 km) and Liverpool John Lennon (163 km).

This hotel is small and cosy enough to have all the friendliness of a traditional country establishment, but big enough to offer great food, wine and comfort. Whether staying for business or pleasure, a really warm welcome awaits every guest. The modern bar and restaurant serves a variety of tasty meals and the two function rooms are ideal for weddings and conferences. The hotel is non-smoking throughout. There are 23 rooms available in total and guests are welcomed in the lobby. Internet access and a car park are also available.

Each of the bedrooms offers an individual character, split between the main building and the Georgian annexe, Ferndale House, which is directly across the road. Facilities and services include a telephone, daily housekeeping, a TV and tea and coffee making facilities. All are en suite with a shower and bathtub. A double bed, radio, Internet access and an ironing set also come as standard.

The bar and restaurant offer seasonal menus, with a wide selection of modern and traditional British favourites, from the  all morning breakfast' to hearty main courses and lighter snacks, complimented by real ale, carefully selected wine, and speciality teas and coffees. During the summer months these may also be enjoyed on the heated terrace.

121357.description: The hotel, located in Istanbul's historic city center, is within walking distance of iconic attractions like the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Topkapi Palace. A short tram ride connects guests to other must-see sites. Renovated in 2009, this air-conditioned hotel offers 98 elegant rooms with excellent service. Amenities include a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, a hairdressing salon, conference facilities, Wi-Fi, and parking. Guests can also enjoy the on-site café, bar, restaurant, and indoor pool. Room service and laundry service are available for an additional fee. Each room features an en suite bathroom, hairdryer, double bed, direct dial telephone, satellite TV, internet access, safe, minibar, and individually controlled heating and air conditioning. For relaxation, guests can visit the sauna, steam room, and massage services (fees apply). A poolside snack bar offers refreshments. Dining options include a breakfast buffet, à la carte lunch, and dinner.

121358.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace at Hotel Uyan - Special Class. This upscale hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and 24-hour room service. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Each of the 26 individually decorated guestrooms features a minibar, LCD TV, and private bathroom with designer toiletries. Located in the heart of Istanbul, you're a short walk from Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, and Sultanahmet Square, with the Grand Bazaar just a mile away.

121383.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center and in-room fitness options. This Berlin hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, gift shops/newsstands, and a communal living room. Savor international cuisine at Kitchen & Bar, a restaurant with a bar/lounge, or grab a quick bite at the coffee shop/cafe. Buffet breakfasts are available on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM (fee applies). For business travelers, the hotel offers a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event? The hotel boasts over 14, 500 square feet of event space, including conference space and 11 meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Relax in one of the 267 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring a flat-screen television, a pillowtop bed with premium bedding, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include showers, hair dryers, toothbrushes, and toothpaste. Located near Friedrichstrasse, Gendarmenmarkt, and Checkpoint Charlie, the hotel is a convenient base for exploring Berlin. The preferred airport is Berlin Brandenburg (BER), approximately 16 miles away.

121396.description: This hotel is situated in the heart of England and set within 17 acres of stunning manicured gardens and rugged woodland. Featuring an idyllic location, the establishment is nestled between the charming towns of Warwick, Leamington Spa, Stratford-upon-Avon and Kenilworth, and is within easy reach of all neighbouring motorways and main roads. Restaurants, bars and pubs are some 25 minutes' walk away, and nightspots and shopping venues are to be found in Leamington Spa, which is some 10 minutes away by car. Leamington Spa's railway station is about a 15-minute car ride from the hotel, and Birmingham International Airport is approximately 20 km away from the establishment. This hotel is steeped in history with the original house dating back to 1902 when it was a family home. With its stone entrance, red roofed turrets and black and white panelling guests are beckoned into the hotel with a warm and friendly welcome as soon as they walk through the doors. In addition to a reception area with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, cloakroom and lift access, amenities available to guests at this 205-room, family-friendly rural house include a bar, restaurant, conference facilities and public Internet access. Room and laundry services are provided and there is a bike hire service on site. Guests arriving by car may park their vehicles in the hotel car park free of charge. The hotel bedrooms feature a contemporary feel in addition to plush surroundings. They are beautifully appointed with every modern convenience and comfort (including LCD screen televisions and private bathrooms with a bathtub/power shower and a hairdryer). Further in-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, radio, Internet access and tea and coffee making facilities. Furthermore, double beds and an iron and ironing board also feature as standard, along with central heating and a safety deposit box.

name.content: Pullman Dubai Creek City Centre Residences

121478.address: P.O. BOX 61871 Deira City Centre,Baniyas Road
121478.description: The Pullman Dubai Creek City Centre Residences offers a sophisticated atmosphere with apartments featuring fully equipped kitchens, king-size beds, bathrooms with bathtubs, and balconies. Take a dip in the rooftop outdoor pool, energize in the 24-hour fitness center and on the tennis court, and rejuvenate in the Fit & Spa Lounge with its wide array of treatments. The adjoining City Centre Deira Mall offers an unmatched shopping experience. Discover the surrounding city via the Dubai Metro Station, a few minutes' walk away. The Pullman Dubai Creek City Centre offers both hotel rooms and apartments: Superior Rooms are located in the hotel, while apartments are situated in the residence section.

121481.description: This hotel is located in Vienna's vibrant 7th district within walking distance to some of the most important tourist attractions in the area, including the Wiener Stadthalle, Mariahilfer Straße and the Westbahnhof. Vienna Airport is about 27 km away. All the rooms are equipped with air-conditioning, flat screen TV, safe and bathroom with amenities. At the hotel's own restaurant, everything is freshly cooked using only the best quality and regional products. The onsite facilities include a bar which is decorated throughout in colonial style and offers a large range of gins and a courtyard garden. On the top floor the hotel offers a spa and gym area equipped with sauna, whirlpool, treadmills, stepper, chest press and much more.

121482.description: This outstanding property perfectly blends into the new and impressive Viennese skyline along the Danube River opposite the Uno City and the Austria Centre Vienna. Due to its position and well-designed ambience, it combines parallel worlds, such as nature and the city, and provides a symbiosis of business and relaxation. With regard to transport links the hotel has a particularly favourable location. It is close to the Reichsbrücke motorway exit and the nearest underground station is on its doorstep, so that guests can directly reach Vienna's centre in a few minutes. They will sense the special atmosphere as soon as they enter the venue. Corporate travellers will appreciate the Executive Floor with its own lounge. Those who need some fresh air can use the direct access it offers to the green recreational area of the Alte Donau oxbow lake.

121484.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a health club or take in the view from a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access and a banquet hall. Enjoy international cuisine at SB RESTAURANT, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 40 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your Select Comfort bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have bidets and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

121512.description: Enjoy a fascinating holiday experience with the unique beauty of the Mediterranean Sea. We invite you to the world-renowned Konyaalti Beach surrounded by the deep blue sea and the Taurus Mountains. You can enjoy peace in the hot summer months while you swim on the clean beaches of the unique Konyaalti Beach with a blue flag. As soon as you arrive to Crowne Plaza Antalya, the smiling and professional teams will be ready to welcome you and help you have a great holiday. You can also view the matchless landscape of Antalya using the Tunektepe Aerial Tramway next to the hotel. You can watch the sunset and the Beydag Mountains on the terrace of the Neapolis Fine Dining on the 10th floor. Only 23 kilometers away from the airport, you can easily reach the hotel and discover the narrow streets of the ancient city where you can see historical monuments with a 15-minute drive. Charming everyone who loves to do sports anytime they want, Crowne Plaza Antalya offers a wide range of choices with indoor and outdoor swimming pools, gyms furnished with sports equipment, and 7 kilometers of beach and running track lying right before the hotel. The resting pool, Turkish bath and Finnish sauna in the SPA center will help you refresh yourself and relax your soul. The hotel has a car park area, and you can apply to the valet services offered by the hotel. Invite your friends to the meeting rooms in Crowne Plaza Antalya.

121513.description: Situated overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, our main swimming pool offers guests a privileged spot to relax and sunbathe while enjoying the exquisite architecture. To the east, a tranquil 5, 000 m² Zen garden awaits, complete with enchanting waterfalls, ponds, and breathtaking natural beauty. Hotel rooms are elegantly decorated and feature unique Mediterranean flora. Designed with your comfort in mind, our variety of rooms caters to all guest requirements. For dining, our à la carte restaurants offer a fantastic selection of seafood, traditional Anatolian cuisine, steak house favorites, Far Eastern dishes, and Teppanyaki. With modern decor and an adults-only (16+) concept, we aim to create the perfect atmosphere for an unforgettable vacation.

121514.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages or enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent. Additional features at this bed & breakfast include complimentary wireless internet access, a hair salon, and a television in a common area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the bed & breakfast's 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 42 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets.

121585.address: Rua Barata Ribeiro, 547 - Copacabana, Rio De Janei
121585.description:
The Américas Benidorm Hotel enjoys an excellent location, just 400 meters from Copacabana Beach (Posto 4) and the subway station, providing easy access to Rio de Janeiro. Downtown Rio is about 18 km away, featuring attractions such as the Museum of Tomorrow, Yup Star Ferris Wheel, AquaRio Aquarium, and cultural venues. Iconic landmarks like Christ the Redeemer, Tijuca Forest, and the Botanical Garden are around 20 km from the hotel. 

For shopping and leisure, RioSul Mall is 5 km away, while Sugarloaf Mountain is 7 km. The main bus and train stations are 15 km (30 minutes by car). Santos Dumont Airport (SDU) is only 5 km away (18 minutes), and the Antonio Carlos Jobim International Airport (GIG) is 25 km (45 minutes). 

The hotel is undergoing renovations: 80% of rooms are refurbished, with full completion expected by December 2025. Social areas, including rooftop and restaurant, are planned for May 2026. 

With 90 cozy rooms, Américas Benidorm Hotel offers a welcoming environment and 24-hour front desk, currency exchange, elevators, TV lounge, breakfast restaurant, laundry service, paid Wi-Fi, room service, and parking (subject to availability and fee). 

All rooms feature private bathroom with shower and hairdryer, single, double, or queen beds, digital TV, minibar, telephone, safety deposit box, individually controlled air conditioning, and Wi-Fi access. 

While the hotel pool is under renovation, guests can enjoy the swimming pool at our partner hotel across the street. 

Start your day with a buffet breakfast, carefully prepared to make your stay pleasant and energizing. 

Welcome to Américas Benidorm Hotel.

121586.description: This simple hotel is located in Copacabana - Leme. Facilities include 31 welcoming units. Angrense was completely renovated in 2008. This hotel is ideal for a productive stay, thanks to the internet access available throughout the building. In addition, the facilities provide an all-day reception service. Cribs are available upon request for younger guests. Angrense is not a pet-friendly establishment.

121612.description:
The apartment hotel is situated at the foot of Tibidabo in the Gracia district, 15 minutes by metro from the centre and close to Park Güell, the science museum, the Parc del Laberint d'Horta and Tibidado's amusement park. It is very well connected with the centre of the city by bus and metro. There is a beach around 8 km from the property. Barcelona Airport is located approximately 12 km away.

The elegant and quiet apartments at this establishment were renovated and are part of an old villa. It is perfect for families, groups of friends and couples to enjoy maximum comfort and privacy during their stay. 4 apartments are on offer. WLAN Internet access is available.

All flats and suites feature a double bedroom, living room with sofa bed, en suite bathroom with shower and bathtub, private terrace or garden and a fitted mini kitchen or kitchenette with coffee machine, refrigerator and microwave. Each accommodation unit is fitted with TV, Internet access, washing machine and ironing set as standard. The heating is centrally regulated. There are cots available upon request.

Sant Cugat golf course is roughly 20 km away.

121614.description: Set amidst the beautiful, rural location on Forest Row, this hotel is steeped in peace and serenity. Close by, guests will find Royal Ashdown Forest, the home of Winnie the Pool. Many attractions can be found nearby, including the Bluebell Steam Railway and Sheffield Park Garden, where 5 lakes and 120 acres of grounds offer a haven of relaxation. Royal Tunbridge Wells and Brighton can also be found nearby. This hotel is set in a charming, 17th-century country house. Rich in old-world charm, the hotel features oak beams and open fires. The guest rooms retain an element of rustic elegance, combined with contemporary convenience. A wide range of exemplary facilities and services are available, ensuring a memorable stay for every type of traveller.

121616.description: This wonderful property is situated close to the centre of Dunstable Downs. The property boasts spectacular views over the Vale of Aylesbury, enjoying close proximity to the London Gliding Club, Whipsnade Zoo and Dunstable Golf Club. Bletchley Park and the Enigma code de-cypher centre are also located nearby. St Albans, with its Roman ruins of Verulamium and the Cathedral, can be found just a 20 minutes' driving distance away. This charming property comprises stylish, traditional guest rooms. Guests can enjoy a traditional dining experience in the relaxing surroundings of the restaurant, followed by a refreshing ale in the bar.

121704.description: Nestled in the heart of historical Paris, in the famous and trendy district of le Marais, this charming boutique hotel offers luxurious accommodation overlooking 1500 square metres of lush private gardens, which create the ideal setting for leisurely strolls. Within 10 minutes of walking guests will reach a number of local points of interest, such as the Place des Vosges, Picasso Museum, Carnavalet Museum, Place de la Bastille and the Bercy business district. Numerous pubs and eateries can also be found in the vicinity, although the on-site bar and restaurant, with their elegant contemporary style, excellent drinks and food will prove more than adequate even for the most seasoned epicureans.

121705.address: Rue Du Faubourg Saint Antoine, 289 bis
121705.description: Located in Paris's Bercy district, Le Patio Bastille is within a 10-minute drive of Notre-Dame and the Centre Pompidou. This residence is 3. 4 miles (5. 4 km) from the Louvre Museum and 3. 5 miles (5. 6 km) from the Palais Garnier. Enjoy views from the terrace and garden, and take advantage of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi. Make yourself at home in one of the 88 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring a refrigerator, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences such as phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

121748.description: Located a 7-minute walk from Francisco Sá Carneiro International Airport, the AP Aeroporto Porto offers spacious rooms and free Wi-Fi. Recently renovated, the modern rooms of the AP Aeroporto Porto feature wooden floors, telephone and a flat-screen satellite TV. Each air-conditioned room includes a large private bathroom with free toiletries. The hotel has a bar serving a variety of snacks and beverages. The 24-hour front desk can help guests with car rental services. The Botica and Aeroporto Metro Station are each a 5-minute walk away and offer convenient access into Porto City. An airport shuttle service is available free of charge. This property is also rated for the best value in Maia! Guests are getting more for their money when compared to other properties in this city. We speak your language!

121750.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Paris' most picturesque district. Near the property guests will find everything they need to explore the surrounding area and experience the unique Parisian culture. Dining opportunities and shopping venues are found within easy walking distance from the establishment. The Quartier Pigalle, with the Moulin Rouge, is 300 m away and it lies 700 m from the Butte de Montmartre and the Sacré Coeur. It is 22 km from Charles de Gaulle Airport and Orly Airport is just 34 km from the property. This charming city hotel welcomes guests in its newly renovated reception area and offers a total of 39 fully refurbished, comfortable rooms.

121849.description: Fashion Hotel Amsterdam is located opposite the World Fashion Center, within ring road A10. Schiphol Airport and Amsterdam RAI convention center are 10 minutes by car. Vondelpark and Leidseplein can be reached in 10 minutes by tram or bicycle. In this design hotel you will experience service and comfort with a stylish touch! Visit restaurant Mme Coco - with outside terrace - or enjoy a cocktail in the SKYY Bar. Satisfy your senses at WellCome Wellness, with 2 saunas, Turkish steam bath (for a fee), indoor pool and work out at the gym room (free of charge), will complete your luxurious stay.

121861.address: Camí Sant Benet de Bages, S/N
121861.description: This hotel is situated in Sant Fruitos de Bages. This establishment is located close to the city of Manresa. The rich culture and history of Barcelona can be found just a 45 minutes' drive away. The hotel is surrounded by ample opportunities for exploration and discovery. The city centre of Navarcles is just a 10 minutes' walk away. This hotel occupies a prominent, historical building. Having beautifully preserved the former monastic architectural style of the premises, this hotel harmonises perfectly with its natural environment. The guest rooms are steeped in comfort and elegance. The hotel's extensive range of facilities and services deliver a high level of excellence.

121862.description: This design hotel is located in the historic centre of Madrid, only 500 meters from Puerta del Sol and Plaza Mayor. Two minutes from Metro Tirso de Molina, in the historic area of Madrid de los Austrias and a 15-minute walk from the famous Art Triangle of Madrid, which houses the Museo del Prado, the Reina Sofia and the Thyssen Bornemisza. The elegant and minimalist guestrooms are soundproofed and have flat-screen TVs with satellite channels. Less than 2 minutes from the hotel guests will find many tapas bars, restaurants and shops as well as the famous Mercado de San Miguel. The staff can provide information about attractions in and around Madrid, as well as getting tickets for shows and tours (Estadio Santiago Bernabeu, Toledo, Segovia, Avila). For information regarding shuttle service to airport, please contact the hotel.

121897.description: This hotel is located in the heart of the old city on a main street. It lies just a few steps from the historic Dam square, the central square in Amsterdam, where visitors will find the Royal Palace and the New Church. The central train station is about a 10-minute walk away and shopping and night life centres are close to the hotel. Guests will find the best department stores, the unique Magna Plaza shopping centre, and the long Kalverstraat pedestrian shopping street close by. Excursions by bus leave from outside the hotel and boat trips leave from just down the street. Surrounding the hotel are the canals with their historical buildings. This city hotel was opened in 1973 and since then has been owned by the same family. It comprises a total of 43 rooms and the two connecting buildings are from the 17th century. Throughout the hotel guests will find typical Amsterdam ceilings with old oak beams. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby with a 24-hour reception and a new reception area, lift access, wireless Internet access (charges apply) and a spacious lounge. Parking is available for those arriving by car. The rooms are modern and comfortable. All come with a private bathroom with a shower, a WC and a hairdryer. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, Internet access and a safe. The hotel has a beautiful breakfast room and offers a delicious buffet breakfast.

121941.description: . Enjoy the ideal location of the Dolce Milan Malpensa by Windam hotel, just 7 km from the airport with a 24/7 complimentary shuttle service available. Set near the highway, the hotel offers easy access to all the attractions of Milan city center and nearby businesses. Prepare for tomorrow in a guest room with modern, comforting amenities and great technology. Catch up with work at the spacious desk with ergonomic chair, stay connected with complimentary WiFi with remote printing through PrinterOn® , relax watching the 32-inch HDTV and rest in the adjustable Garden Sleep System bed®. Select a family room for an extra single bed or a spacious suite for a separate living room with sofa-sleeper. Wake up to a cooked-to-order breakfast in Atmosphere Restaurant. Savor Italian specialties for lunch and dinner or pick up a microwave meal from the 24-hour Pavilion Pantry, also offering snacks, drinks, and travel essentials. After a hectic day or a long flight sip a refreshing drink in Spirit Café. Work out your way - in the 24 hour fitness center or in the comfort of your own room with a complimentary Stay Fit Kit®. Take advantage of the professional services and equipment in the 24 hour business center and host meetings and events for up to 400 guests in our meeting space, which offers natural light, modern A/V equipment, and complimentary WiFi. Our friendly team members will be delighted to plan the details, ensuring your event is a success.

121960.description: This hotel is situated in the heart of Lisbon, near Marquês de Pombal, providing quick and easy access to Lisbon downtown and the historic centre. The hotel is 4 metro stops from the Praça Do Comércio on the Tagus riverfront. The city's vast public transportation network, can quickly and easily take guests to places such as Belém, Parque das Nações, the St. George's Castle or even the outskirts of Lisbon, Cascais, Estoril, and Sintra.

122041.description: With a stay at Mama Shelter London - Shoreditch in London (Shoreditch), you'll be within a 15-minute walk of Columbia Road Flower Market and Victoria Park. This upscale hotel is 1 mi (1. 5 km) from Brick Lane and 1. 6 mi (2. 5 km) from Old Spitalfields Market. Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including a fitness center, karaoke, and bicycles to rent. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Stay in one of 194 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. This hotel has 3 meeting rooms available for events. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Columbia Road Flower Market - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Victoria Park - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Brick Lane - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Old Spitalfields Market - 2. 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Liverpool Street - 2. 5 km / 1. 5 mi- The Gherkin - 2. 8 km / 1. 8 mi- Barbican Arts Centre - 3 km / 1. 9 mi- Sky Garden - 3. 3 km / 2.

122042.description: A stay at Holiday Inn Dubai - Al Barsha, an IHG Hotel places you in the heart of Dubai, a 2-minute drive from Mall of the Emirates and 7 minutes from Burj Al Arab. This upscale hotel is 5. 7 mi (9. 1 km) from Dubai Marina Mall and 7. 4 mi (11. 9 km) from The Walk. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a nightclub, a health club, and an outdoor pool. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. The complimentary shuttle will take you to the nearby beach or shopping center. Make yourself at home in one of the 309 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Your room comes with a memory foam bed. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Enjoy Thai cuisine at The Royal Budha-Thai, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 3 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 491 square feet (46 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Fatima Abdullah Mohammed Rasheed Mosque - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Ski Dubai - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Mall of the Emirates - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Al Barsha Pond Park - 1. 8 km / 1.

name.content: The Dominican, Brussels, a Member of Design Hotels

122078.description: Located in the heart of Brussels, The Dominican, a Member of Design Hotels, is within a 10-minute walk of Grand Place and Manneken Pis. This upscale hotel is also conveniently close to the Royal Palace of Brussels (1. 2 km) and Avenue Louise (2 km). Enjoy recreational amenities such as a health club and sauna. The hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Each of the 150 guest rooms features a minibar, a flat-screen television with satellite programming, and a private bathroom with designer toiletries and a hairdryer. For your convenience, there are also phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. The hotel's restaurant, GRAND LOUNGE, serves lunch and dinner. Room service is also available during limited hours. Guests can unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available on weekdays for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. For events, the hotel offers 180 square meters of conference space and meeting rooms.

122098.description: This attractive hotel is conveniently located just a few steps off famous Alexanderplatz square with its attractions such as the TV Tower or the Red Town Hall. Its features include a spa lounge, business centre, restaurant and bar. Alexanderplatz is located at the meeting point of Berlin's trendiest districts of Prenzlauer Berg, Mitte and Friedrichshain; it offers great public transportation links, providing easy access to all parts of the city. All rooms are modern and are equipped with Flatscreen TV, WI-FI, tea and coffee making facilities, a private bathroom with designer toiletries.

122132.description: Located in the heart of Brussels, Hotel Le Dome offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and a banquet hall. Enjoy local cuisine at Kom Kom restaurant, or order room service during limited hours. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel features a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Each of the 125 guestrooms includes a minibar, cable TV, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. A stay at Hotel Le Dome places you within a 15-minute walk of La Grand Place and the Brussels Christmas Market.

122146.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Re Lissone in Lissone, including complimentary Wi-Fi and a vending machine. Make the most of room service and unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Indulge in the daily buffet breakfast (available for a fee) from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel also offers dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and self-parking (subject to charges). Each of the 65 guestrooms provides a comfortable retreat with minibars, LCD televisions, private bathrooms (with bathtubs or showers, bidets, and hair dryers), phones, safes, and desks. A short drive from Monza Park, Monza Circuit, and the Royal Villa of Monza, this hotel also grants you easy access to the thrills of Autodromo Nazionale Monza, making it a fantastic base for both leisure and motorsport enthusiasts.

122196.description: Located in the northeastern part of Madrid, this hotel is a great choice for anyone traveling through the Madrid-Barajas or Madrid-Torrejón Airports. Both of the transport hubs are within a 15-minute drive and guests can use the complimentary shuttle service in order to make the trip as pleasant and hustle-free as possible. Upon request the service also runs to the IFEMA exhibition centre. Due to its location the modern venue offers everything a business traveller can desire. From the fully-soundproofed rooms, all fitted with extra-long beds and designer furniture, to the business centre and the multifunctional meeting spaces, everything is geared towards making ones stay just perfect. Guests will also find plenty of ways for relaxing - a workout in the gym, a swim in the pool or a chilled cocktail in the bar.

122197.description: This modern and stylish hotel is located in Torrejon de Ardoz, a few kilometres from Barajas Airport and IFEMA, with easy access to Madrid. This sophisticated property is perfect for a stay before or after air trip, for conventions on and exhibition centre or for business visits to Madrid or the Henares Corridor. This family-friendly hotel is fully air-conditioned and offers a wide array of elegant and comfortable rooms. The units are spacious and well-equipped with modern amenities to make one's stay as comfortable as possible. Visitors may energize their day with delightful buffet-style breakfast and throughout the day enjoy a drink or a snack from the welcoming bar. There is an internet corner for those who need to keep updated and a friendly staff at 24-hour reception will be happy to assist visitors in any query or doubt. Travellers arriving by car may make use of the covered parking.

122198.address: Plaza De La Rosa Dels Vents, 1
122198.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. For recreation, you'll find a nightclub, an indoor pool, and a spa tub. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and on-site shopping. Enjoy Japanese cuisine at NOXE, one of the hotel's four restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind at the bar/lounge, the beach bar, or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (7 AM to 11 AM) for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities consist of a conference center and 19 meeting rooms. Airport shuttle (24 hours) and train station pick-up services are available (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 473 guest rooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Flat-screen televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. San Sebastian Beach - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi; Port Vell - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi; Barceloneta Beach - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi.

122248.description: Dating back to 1920 this charming boutique property welcomes its guests to a wonderful patio and garden, featuring exotic flora and a pleasant atmosphere. Located in a particularly peaceful and verdant district of the Medina, it is only a 10-minute walk from Djemaa el Fna square. The bus station is around a 5-minute walk away and the train station roughly 15 minutes. The touristic centre of Gueliz and the Koutoubia Mosque can both be reached within a 5 minute walk and offer the perfect destinations for sightseeing or shopping. The beautiful Menara Gardens are around 20 minutes' walk away and provide welcomed escape from the warm and noisy city. The hotel's lounge is the perfect spot for relaxing at the end of the day, where guests can enjoy a cooling drink and a quiet conversation. There is an outdoor swimming pool available for refreshing and unwinding.

122299.description: This city hotel is situated just two blocks from the Copacabana beach, and offers easy and quick access to the south and the city's commercial and business districts. The Sugar Loaf is approximately 1 km from the hotel and the Christ the Redeemer monument is around 5 km away. The metro is just a few metres away and the hotel is only 10 km from Rio de Janeiro's international airport. Comfort and convenience are the hallmarks of this air-conditioned hotel, which is located in the centre of the city. It is ideal for business or leisure trips with 66 rooms and a wide range of services, such as 24-hour room service, lift access, a café, a bar and a restaurant, a laundry service and currency exchange facilities. Further facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe and a cloakroom. Each room features an en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub an hairdryer. Rooms are furnished with a double bed and have a private balcony or terrace. Other in-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, a radio, a hi-fi system, Internet access, a safe, a minibar and individually regulated air conditioning. There is an outdoor swimming pool and a poolside snack bar with parasols laid out ready for use. Guests may also relax in the hot tub or sauna. A continental breakfast buffet is served each morning and set menu and à la carte options are available for lunch and dinner.

122300.description: This popular hotel, renovated in 2007, offers 71 rooms, including nine suites, 71 apartments, and six triple rooms. It's an ideal base for exploring the surrounding area. Guests can enjoy air-conditioned public areas, 24-hour reception, a safe for valuables, an elevator, internet access, room service, and laundry service. The hotel is wheelchair accessible and welcomes pets of all sizes. Check-out is at midnight. Multilingual staff are available to assist with inquiries and service bookings.

122301.description: This stunning hotel enjoys a delightful setting, in close proximity to Copacabana beach, where shimmering, azure waters await. Within 500 metres of the hotel, guests will find links to the local transport network, enjoying access to theatres, shopping centres and a number of delightful restaurants. Guests wishing to explore the delights of the area will enjoy the monumental sights of Christ the Redeemer, just 10 km away. This modern hotel instantly impresses guests, with its stunning architectural design and infusions of tradition and poise. The guest rooms are spacious and elegant, offering minimalist furnishings and soothing, natural tones. Guests travelling for business purposes can avail of the conference facilities, ensuring productivity and efficiency. Guests can enjoy a breakfast buffet each morning, ensuring adequate energy for the day ahead.

122302.description: The Plaza Inn American Loft offers apartment-style accommodations with fully equipped kitchens, split air conditioning, private bathrooms, telephones, stocked minibars, microwaves, electric stoves, queen-size beds, cable TV, electronic locks, safes, and workspaces with free Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a cozy atmosphere and amenities such as a fitness center with professional equipment, a swimming pool with panoramic views, and a jogging track. A full breakfast is provided, along with room service until 11 pm and a restaurant with buffet service for groups and events. The hotel's event room is equipped with sound and projection systems. Its strategic location is opposite Allianz Parque and Bourbon Shopping Mall, home to the Bradesco Theater. It's also the closest hotel to the Pompeii Convention Center, Água Branca Business Center, Sesc Pompeii, and the Latin America Memorial.

122307.description: L'Hotel Porto Bay São Paulo is a lovely hotel, with charming rooms and modern facilities, beautifully situated in São Paulo on Alameda Campinas, at approximately 50 metres from the bustling Avenida Paulista. The hotel features a wonderful roof top swimming pool as well as sauna and gym. Within the area guests will be able to find numerous restaurants, bars and sites of touristic and cultural interest as well as museums. The nearest underground station can be found at approximately 5 minutes on foot. The famous Trianon Park is also within walking distance from the hotel.

122308.description: The hotel offers rooms and suites with beautiful views of the city. It also has a gym, sauna and indoor/outdoor whirlpool tub also overlooking the city. All rooms have views and are equipped with comfortable beds, free Wi-Fi, large flat screen TV with cable channels, and safe for laptop. The restaurant serves a buffet breakfast every morning .

122358.description: Located in the heart of London, this aparthotel is within walking distance of the city's most famous attractions and financial district, as well as a variety of restaurants and bars nestled in traditional cobbled courtyards. The vibrant Shoreditch and Brick Lane area is just moments away, and Aldgate and Aldgate East tube stations are easily accessible, providing service to the Hammersmith and City, Circle, District, and Metropolitan lines. London City Airport is approximately 8 km away, and Heathrow Airport is about 32 km from the property. Built in 2009, this impressive aparthotel comprises two towers housing 100 new luxury serviced apartments. A spacious 24-hour reception area offers concierge and check-out services. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property, and lift access is provided. The stylish apartments feature fully-fitted kitchens equipped with a fridge, cooker, microwave, and tea and coffee making facilities. Elegant en suite bathrooms include a power shower, bath, hairdryer, and complimentary designer toiletries. Apartment interiors are expertly designed with superior soft furnishings and cutting-edge technology. Additional amenities include a double bed, direct dial telephone, TV, radio, ironing set, and central heating. Complimentary internet access, towels, and linens are also provided.

122359.description: Hotel is just 300 m from the famous P.C. Hooftstraat and less than a 10-minute walk from Museum Square where the Rijksmuseum, Stedelijk Museum and Van Gogh Museum are located. Leidseplein Square is less than 700 m away, and the Amsterdam Auditorium and Schiphol Airport is only 10 km away. Hotel's warm-hearted service, its stylish decor and its prime location attract guests from all over the world. Anyone wishing to discover Amsterdam's dazzling life in comfort is sure to immediately feel at home at this hotel. This luxurious boutique hotel is the first hotel in Amsterdam to recently have its rooms completely furnished by  designers that have created an oasis of tranquillity and elegance for guests.

122386.description: This family-friendly historical hotel is located in a very central and quiet area, 100 m from the famous La Salute Church and 200 m from St Mark's Square.
