Guests will find restaurants and the bus station within the immediate vicinity of the city hotel, and Santa Lucia train station is around 1 km away. The nearest beach is 2 kms and Marco Polo Airport is roughly 5 kms from the property. Built in 1500, this elegant historical hotel now offers 56 guest rooms with stunning views, wide halls and Internet access. Guests can enjoy refreshments served in the cafe or a light meal in the breakfast room. The passion for detail contributes to the creation of an intimate and cosy atmosphere that transforms every room into a pleasant refuge, a place to recover strength after a long romantic walk through the city. Each unit features an en-suite bathroom and individually regulated heating.

122388.description: Located 5 minutes from the Porte de Bercy, on the banks of the Marne river, this apartment hotel enjoys a strategic location on the Paris Marne-la-Vallée corridor. The hotel is close to numerous restaurants and a bus station, in the centre of Saint Maurice Charenton. There is a metro station close to the hotel, putting the centre of Paris and its many shops are within easy reach. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, lift access and a WLAN Internet access.

122399.description: Just 984 feet from the Acropolis and its museum, Marble House Hotel is within walking distance from Sygrou-Fix Metro Station. The family-run property offers classically decorated rooms with free Wi-Fi in the center of Athens. Fitted with iron beds, the colorful rooms at Marble House come with a fan, safe and fridge. Some units have a private bathroom while others share a bathroom. Most include a furnished patio or balcony with inland views. The staff at Marble House can provide guests with complimentary city maps and ticket services and can also arrange car rental. Luggage storage is free of charge and a computer with printer is available for common use at the lobby. Laundry facilities can be found nearby. A continental breakfast is served daily upon request. A variety of restaurants and cafés surround the hotel. You can reach Syntagma Square and the historic area of Plaka after a couple of metro stops or after a 10-minute walk. Monastiraki’s flea market lies within a 20-minutes' walk.

122412.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Additional features at this Beaux Arts hotel include a banquet hall and a vending machine. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Make yourself at home in one of the 45 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

122413.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Take advantage of the hotel's room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk and multilingual staff. Make yourself at home in one of the 45 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Montparnasse Tower - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Paris Catacombs - 1. 5 km / 1 mi- Place Denfert-Rocherau - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Parc Montsouris - 2. 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Paris Expo - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi- Le Bon Marche - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- UNESCO Headquarters - 2. 6 km / 1. 6 mi- Champ de Mars - 2. 8 km / 1. 7 mi- Luxembourg Gardens - 2. 8 km / 1. 7 mi- Les Invalides - 3 km / 1. 9 mi- Sorbonne University - 3. 2 km / 2 mi- Rue Cler - 3. 2 km / 2 mi- Place d'Italie - 3. 3 km / 2 mi- Panthéon - 3. 4 km / 2. 1 mi- Rue Mouffetard - 3. 4 km / 2. 1 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 14. 8 km / 9. 2 mi Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 43 km / 26. 7 mi Paris Beauvais Airport (BVA) - 94. 2 km / 58. 5 mi Paris (XCR-Chalons-Vatry) - 216. 4 km / 134. 5 mi With a stay at Hotel La Maison Montparnasse, you'll be centrally located in Paris, within a 5-minute drive of Paris Expo and Paris Catacombs. This hotel is 1. 9 mi (3 km) from Luxembourg Gardens and 2. 5 mi (4 km) from Louvre Museum.

122415.description: The hotel is ideally located half a block from the traditional Corrientes Avenue, close to theaters, cinemas, cafes, tango shows, Abasto shopping, and the iconic Obelisk. The nearest metro station is just two blocks away, and the property is 15 minutes from the chic Recoleta and Palermo neighborhoods. Fully renovated, the hotel offers comfort and modern amenities while maintaining its traditional style and the chain's high standards. Spacious, renovated rooms cater to both business and leisure travelers.

122417.description: Surrounded by bars and tango venues, in one of the oldest and best preserved area of the city, this hotel is within walking distance of central Buenos Aires. It was designed to provide maximum comfort and relaxation to guests, whether they are business, or leisure travellers. This air-conditioned city hotel welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and lift access. Further facilities include a breakfast and dining room, conference facilities, wireless Internet access, room service, and a car park. Cleaning service is not included in rates.

122444.description: The hotel is located in the Heliopolis area, just a 7 km drive from Cairo International Airport and 21 km from the city centre. With a total of 320 rooms on offer, the air-conditioned hotel welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour check-out service, a hotel safe and currency exchange facilities. The hotel additionally comprises a hairdressing salon, casino, bar and restaurant. Furthermore, guests may take advantage of the room and laundry services. All the spacious rooms, in various different categories, are sure to meet the needs of business travellers. The en suite bathroom is fitted with a shower and hairdryer, and further amenities include a double or king-size bed, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access, a safe, minibar and tea and coffee making facilities. In addition, each room has its own balcony or terrace as standard. Zing fitness and health club is fully equipped with state-of-the-art cardiovascular equipment, while the spa area has a sauna, hot tub and steam room. Guests may also enjoy use of the outdoor swimming pool with children's swimming area. Moreover, massage and spa treatments are available, as are squash and tennis facilities.

122461.description: This apartment hotel is 5 minutes from Buenos Aires' biggest shopping centre, Dot Baires. The hotel offers easy access to the main roads and is close to many businesses. Restaurants, bars, nightlife, the train station and metro station can all be found on the hotel's doorstep. The famous Obelisk and Calle Florida are half an hour's drive from the hotel. Facilities include a café and bar and a breakfast room. Guests may also use the conference facilities, WLAN Internet access, and room and laundry services.

122487.description: The hotel is located in the new tourist area of Marrakech, opposite the sumptuous gardens of Agdal and the snowy summits of the High Atlas mountain range, close to the Djemaa el Fna square, the medina and the railway station. Menara - Marrakech Airport is only 5 km away. It is a luxurious place of peace and guarantees well-being and absolute relaxation in a marvellous setting. Guests may take a refreshing dip in the wonderful swimming pool or take advantage of the multiple SPA services offered. The air-conditioned hotel features spacious guest rooms and provides all facilities and services needed for a peaceful and comfortable stay. Guests will lack nothing in the well-appointed rooms, which are air-conditioned and feature a balcony or terrace as standard.

122490.description: This hotel enjoys an ideal location in a quiet street between the Porte de Vincennes and Place de la Nation. It lies 100 m from line 1 of the metro system, giving guests direct access to the Bastille, Chatelet-les-Halles, the Louvre, the Champs Elysées, la Grande Arche and many other famous attractions. This charming, family-friendly hotel is ideal for business travellers and holidaymakers alike. It offers fully refurbished rooms appointed in warm, contemporary style and featuring pleasant interiors as well as a newly landscaped garden. All rooms open to a terrace with dramatic views, but what corporate travellers will appreciate more are the conference facilities and Internet connection provided. Guests who wish to explore the city of love by car can safely leave their vehicle at the hotel's garage.

122537.description: This charming historical hotel is located in the Kasbah, in the ancient medina quarter of Marrakech, just 15 minutes' walk from Jemna el Fna, the pulsating main square of Marrakech where guests will find plenty of shops and the bus station. The train station is approximately a 15-minute drive away and numerous restaurants can be reached on foot within 7 minutes. Menara Airport is just 3 km away. This boutique hotel constitutes a complex of six small town houses and one riad. With interiors decorated in Arabo-Moorish style, the hotel provides a peaceful haven contrasting with the lively centre outside its walls. Here guests can forget their daily stress and give themselves over to relaxation, massages and a wealth of SPA treatments. The outdoor swimming pool has an incorporated children's area so the whole family can enjoy the sun together.

122550.description: Hotel Spaander, BW Signature Collection is an iconic 3 Star hotel established in 1881 bordering Lake Markermeer. Half of the rooms and suites are facing the lake with stunning views, especially from the balconies. The Historic Inn restaurant and other public areas of the hotel feature over 1400 historic paintings from the Volendam painting school area. Several multi-functional rooms and terraces, a bar, a wellness area with an indoor pool complement this 100 percent smoke-free hotel.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Barcelona - Sant Cugat

122641.address: Avda. Can Fatjo dels Aurons s/n Parc Empresarial A, S/N
122641.description:
Welcoming Barcelona hotel with free Wi-Fi, inclusive breakfast and easy access to the city centre
Holiday Inn Express® Sant Cugat hotel is served by several transport links. Sant Joan Train Stationn (Line S2) is a four-minute drive away and the AP-7 motorway is right next to the hotel. Free parking is available. Barcelona-El Prat Airport is 30 minutes' drive away. 
With its handy connections to the city centre, the hotel is an ideal base for visiting Barcelona’s famous attractions. Iconic Sagrada Familia, vibrant La Rambla boulevard and Park Güell, home to Antoni Gaudi’s architectural follies, are all within easy reach by train. Catch some rays on the city’s beaches, then feast on tapas and Catalonian cuisine in its lively bars and restaurants. 
The hotel’s location in Parc Empresarial Business Park makes it a great pick for business travelers. The hotel also features a 24-hour Business Centre and a fully equipped meeting room for up to 18 people. 
Comfortable guest rooms offer free Wi-Fi and a pillow menu, and family rooms for up to two adults and two children are available. Get set for the day with an inclusive Express Start Breakfast of continental items. Sip a cocktail or glass of champagne in the welcoming lounge bar to wind down after a packed day. Ask the friendly staff for local dining recommendations.

122668.description: This charming historical property is very close to all major tourist attractions and historical places of interest. Celal Aga Konagi is next to at Vezneciler metro station that offers easy access to the most famous tourist attractions as well as Ataturk Airport. The Grand Bazaar is a 20-minute walk away. The family-friendly city hotel is approximately 15 km from Ataturk Airport while Sabiha Gokcen Airport is roughly 55 km away. A real Istanbul tale at the heart of the historical peninsula, the hotel comprises a total of 87 comfortable rooms. Guests will find accommodation units well-appointed with a satellite plasma TV, computer and fax connection points. All rooms are equipped with Tempur double beds with goose quill duvets, cushions covered with silk sheets and silk carpets. The hotel offers a contemporary health SPA with the ancient 600-year-old Acemoglu Turkish bath, a sauna and steam room.

122669.description: Ideally located in the prime touristic area of Antalya City Center, Ramada Plaza Antalya Hotel promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. Offering a variety of facilities and services, the hotel provides all you need for a good night's sleep. 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, facilities for disabled guests, luggage storage are just some of the facilities on offer. Some of the well-appointed guestrooms feature television LCD/plasma screen, bathroom phone, carpeting, dressing room, fireplace. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include hot tub, fitness center, sauna, hot spring bath, outdoor pool. Discover all Antalya has to offer by making Ramada Plaza Antalya Hotel your base. fitness center will be closed for the dates 03. 01. 2024 -31. 03. 2024 due to being under renovation, Only SPA ( Turkish bath , sauna and massage treatments will be available.

122699.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Trebovir Hotel, conveniently located a short drive from Kensington High Street and the Natural History Museum. We offer 61 guestrooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with rainfall showers, and coffee/tea makers. Daily housekeeping is provided, and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. Start your day with our complimentary continental breakfast and take advantage of amenities such as concierge services and an area shuttle (surcharge). Our multilingual staff at the 24-hour front desk is always ready to assist with luggage storage and other needs. Hyde Park and Westfield London Shopping Centre are within a short drive. We are also near: Cromwell Road, Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre, Imperial College London, Kensington Gardens, Victoria and Albert Museum, the Science Museum, Kensington Palace, Stamford Bridge Stadium, Royal Albert Hall, the Thames River, Eventim Apollo, and Harrods.

122702.address: Gran Via De Les Corts Catalanes, 678
122702.description: The hotel is located close to one of the main avenues of the city, the Passeig de Gràcia and within walking distance from Plaça de Catalunya and the main street Las Ramblas. It is quite convenient for those who arrive from the El Prat airport since it is just 5 km away and there are convenient links to it. Guests who want to visit the famous Barceloneta beach will be roughly 3km away, but the journey is more than worth it. Business travellers can find everything they need onsite. From the conference centre, to the Internet access and the specially designed rooms that are perfect for both relaxing and working. They will even have access to modern multimedia and desktop facilities. The hotel has the best cure for the heat, a large outdoor swimming pool that will help with cooling down and refreshing.

122738.description: The hotel is ideally located in the very heart of Paris, in the 2nd district, one of the oldest areas of the town. It is the perfect venue for those who want to explore what the city has to offer outside of the touristic zones. Just a 10-minute walk will lead them to the Gare du Nord Train Station, while the closes metro station is only a 3-minute walk away at Bonne Nouvelle. The Opera Garnier and the famous Galeries Lafayette department stores can be reached for around 15-minutes on foot and the surrounding area boasts a number of theatres, bars and restaurants. The onsite bar is also a great place where guests can relax with a chilled glass of wine or any other beverage of their choice. Afterwards they can head to the comfortable rooms, where in warm, determinedly quiet and serene atmosphere they will be able to unwind and prepare for the next day.

122784.description: Centrally located in the heart of New York's vibrant Times Square, the Courtyard by Marriott New York Manhattan/Times Square offers convenient access to iconic attractions. Steps away from Broadway and a short walk from the Empire State Building and Grand Central Terminal, this hotel provides 244 comfortable guestrooms featuring refrigerators, flat-screen televisions with satellite channels, and pillowtop beds with premium bedding. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. Dining options include Nosh restaurant, a coffee shop/café, and continental breakfast (available for a fee). For business travelers, the hotel offers a 24-hour business center, express check-in/check-out, and meeting rooms.

122859.description: Situated on a sprawling 69-hectare estate, once belonging to a now-ruined abbey, this golf hotel offers convenient access to major attractions. A short drive from Junction 2 of the M42, guests are within easy reach of Birmingham, the NEC, historic Stratford-upon-Avon, and Warwick. Redditch town centre, with its vibrant nightlife, shops, and transport links, is also just minutes away. Explore local gems like Cadbury World and West Midland Safari Park, or venture further to Birmingham's Bullring shopping centre, Sea Life, the ICC, and the NIA. Multiple airports, including Birmingham International, are easily accessible. The hotel's modern architecture houses 100 en-suite rooms, a first-class restaurant and bar, and ample conference facilities, perfect for weddings and civil ceremonies. Unwind on the championship golf course, a frequent host of county matches. Guests can also enjoy 24-hour reception, currency exchange, Wi-Fi, and on-site parking. Room and laundry services are available for a fee. Stylish contemporary rooms feature en-suite bathrooms with shower, bathtub, and hairdryer. Amenities include cotton duvets, complimentary Wi-Fi, H2K toiletries, direct-dial telephone, satellite TV, trouser press, ironing set, radio, individual heating controls, tea and coffee making facilities, comfortable seating, and full-length mirrors.

122877.description: Located in the Küçükçekmece district of Istanbul, the Courtyard by Marriott Istanbul West is within a 5-minute drive of Acibadem University Atakent Hospital and 212 Istanbul Power Outlet. This luxury hotel is 4. 3 miles from the Mall of Istanbul and 12. 4 miles from the Grand Bazaar. The hotel features 264 guest rooms equipped with minibars, plasma TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a full-service spa with massages, a 24-hour health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. Additional amenities include an on-site restaurant, snack bar, bar/lounge, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. The hotel also offers a business center, express check-in/check-out, and over 3, 000 square feet of meeting space. Free self-parking is available.

122897.description: This city and business hotel enjoys a convenient location, close to the underground and the railway stations, and only a short taxi ride from mainline central London train stations. The establishment is well serviced by buses travelling to and from central London and is easy to get to by car. This business and conference hotel offers bedrooms designed with a thoughtful layout and furnished with an impressive attention to detail. The 4-storey hotel is fully air-conditioned and welcomes both leisure and corporate guests with equal care and provision. Each of the stylish guestrooms has been creatively furnished with excellent designer materials - from the hand-built furniture to the Hansgrohe bathroom fittings. The conference facilities offer top-of-the-line equipment for hosting various business functions.

122921.address: Opp. Marol Fire Brigade, Andheri Kurla Road, Andhe
122921.description: The hotel is conveniently situated in Mumbai's elite commercial neighbourhood. There is a railway station approximately 3 km away. The establishment, which is also located about 20 km from South Mumbai, has easy access to Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport and the domestic airport. This air-conditioned city hotel is one of Mumbai's luxury hotels. It offers a wide range of world-class accommodation facilities and matchless services. It also provides multiple-stay options to customers. There is a total of 51 rooms at the establishment. Amenities at the hotel include a lobby with hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and a hairdressing salon. There is a bar and restaurant on the premises. Its well-equipped banquet and conference halls ensure successful accommodation of large gatherings and brilliant meetings, making it a perfect place to stay for both business and leisure travellers. Guests can also take advantage of the hotel's room and laundry services. Those arriving by car may park their vehicles in the hotel's car park. The hotel has elegantly appointed guest rooms and suites and offers a varied choice of accommodation to suit the needs of each of its guests. Appointed in different themes, such as traditional and contemporary, all rooms are innovatively designed and furnished with modern conveniences such as direct dial telephone, TV and air conditioning. The spa and beauty salon as well as the health club are under construction. Guests will be able to book spa treatments in the future. There is a multi-cuisine restaurant that serves a variety of delectable delicacies in the hotel. There is also a cosy lounge bar, where exotic drinks are served in a chic ambience.

122923.description: Right in the heart of the 1st district, the location for the Steigenberger Hotel Herrenhof with 196 elegant rooms and comfortable suites could not be better. The Kohlmarkt and the Graben - Vienna's most beautiful shopping miles - can be reached on foot in just a few minutes. Furthermore, it is only a short walk to the Hofburg and the State Opera, the parliament, the government quarter and many other famous sights are also close to the hotel. Ideal conditions for leisure and business travelers alike. WiFi (free of charge), underground parking with valet parking for EUR 45. 00 per night (no reservation required), regional cuisine in the a la carte restaurant Béla-Béla, Béla's Wohnzimmer & Bar with Austrian and Viennese specialties, SPA Comfort World with sauna and bio sanarium and relaxation area, 8 partly combinable meeting rooms with daylight for business events with up to 220 participants.

122924.description: Experience Parisian charm in the heart of the Marais. This hotel boasts a prime location near Place des Vosges, Notre Dame Cathedral, and Opéra Bastille. Enjoy the warm atmosphere and comfortable, non-smoking rooms featuring a bathroom with shower or bathtub, hairdryer, LCD flat-screen TV, telephone, and complimentary tea and coffee. Start your day with a delicious breakfast served from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The dedicated team is committed to making your stay memorable.

122925.description: Stay at the 4-star Maison Nabis by Happyculture in Paris's city center, just a short drive from the Palais Garnier and the Moulin Rouge. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and bicycle rentals. The 30 guestrooms feature free minibar items, flat-screen TVs with cable programming, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Enjoy a daily complimentary reception and weekday buffet breakfasts (for a fee). Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, a computer station, and airport shuttle service (surcharge). Nearby attractions include Place de Clichy, the Theatre Mogador, Boulevard Haussmann, and Printemps Department Store.

123163.description: The hotel's Art Deco facade hides an intimate and elegant space, captivating from the lobby onward. Contemporary decor in a refined, Zen ambiance, designed by architect Axel Schoenert, promotes rest and relaxation. Across six floors, 40 tranquil rooms offer comfort and style: light oak parquet floors, a subtle mix of white and raw textures, and hazel velvet curtains. All rooms feature free Wi-Fi, freeview channels, a minibar, and a safe. Select rooms or those by request also include the fabulous NightCove to enhance your sleep.

123164.description: This intimate hotel enjoys a strategic location near the department stores, the Opera, Montmartre and Châtelet Les Halles. Only minutes away, guests will find restaurants, bars, and shops. The hotel is also conveniently placed for public transportation, close to Gare de l'Est station. Le Halles, the Seine and the Park Buttes Chaumont are with 3km of the hotel. Whether travelling for leisure or business, this hotel welcomes guests in a warm atmosphere and assures an enjoyable stay in the heart of the French capital.

123223.description: Situated next to the airport Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas, the Axor Feria hotel offers modern and stylish accommodation close to the IFEMA Trade Fair Centre and Metropolitano Stadium. Guests are offered a variety of services and amenities, including 43'' TV with Chromecast integrated, 24 hours free transfer to and from the airport and the IFEMA. The Park Juan Carlos I and a golf club are within easy reach. City centre with its countless historic attractions is just a short drive away. This hotel is ideal for business guests and travellers who wish to stay close to the airport.

123224.description: The hotel is strategically located 5 minutes from IFEMA Exhibition Centre, Metropolitano Stadium, Congress Palace and Juan Carlos I Auditorium. Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas Airport is just 5 minutes from the hotel and the city centre is a 15-minute drive away. Built in 2009, this air-conditioned establishment features 217 rooms, all equipped with 43'' TV Chromecast integrated and WLAN Internet access. Axor Barajas offers 24 hours shuttle service to the airport and to IFEMA when trades, exhibitions and congresses are shown. Air-conditioning and heating are individually regulated for additional comfort. There are rooms suitable for smokers and disabled guests. Pet-friendly accommodations are also provided. The hotel facilities include a fitness room and wellness area (with extra cost).

name.content: Appart'hotel Vacanceole Paris Quai de Marne

123225.description: Just 15 minutes from Paris, the L’appart’hôtel Vacancéole Paris Quai de Marne*** is located on the banks of the river Marne. This 3-star Aparthotel holiday residence offers 50 comfortable and air-conditioned apartments, all furnished and equipped with a kitchen, as well as a range of optional services. Parc de Tremblay is 437 yds (400 m) away and Bois de Vincennes is nearby. The Aparthotel offers convenient access to the RER, as well as the major road network to Paris or the Disney® theme parks. Supplier informed that front desk closes at 18:00 on weekends.

123226.description: Close to the forest of Saint-Germain-en-Laye and on the banks of the Seine, the Adagio access Carrières-sous-Poissy welcomes you in a calm and relaxing environment. Its 120 apartments, ranging from studios to 2-room apartments, are comfortable and fully e quipped. The RER Poissy train station is located 656 yds (600 m) away and you can reach Paris in 30 minutes. This Aparthotel is ideal if you're looking for outdoor activities or if you simply want to relax.

name.content: Aparthtl Adagio Access La Defense-Leonard De Vinci

123228.description: Opposite the Léonard de Vinci university campus in Courbevoie, the Adagio access La Défense Léonard de Vinci (formerly Citéa) offers direct access to public transport and the major road networks. Its 119 comfortable, furnished apartments can accommodate up to 4 people and offer a fully equipped kitchen. The Aparthotel has a heated indoor swimming pool and is located a few minutes from the La Défense business district and the Grande Arche, the CNIT and shopping centers.

123230.description:
This hotel is ideally located between Montmartre and the Garnier Opera House, in the heart of the business district, close to Gare du Nord, Gare Saint-Lazare, and the theatres. Guests will find restaurants, bars, and shops in the immediate vicinity. It is near the popular cabaret Moulin Rouge as well as the Galeries Lafayette and Printemps department stores. The Champs-Élysées is only 3. 5 km from the hotel. Facilities include 24-hour reception, free Wi-Fi, cloakroom, lift access, and a breakfast room. 

Please note that a city tax of €5. 53 per person, per day is payable by guests upon check-out.

name.content: Hampton Inn New York - LaGuardia Airport

123237.description: At Hampton Inn New York - LaGuardia Airport you'll find exactly what you need. Whether you're traveling for business or pleasure, you'll enjoy all the extras our hotel has to offer. You'll enjoy complimentary On the House hot breakfast, complimentary high-speed internet access throughout the hotel, state-of-the-art Fitness Center and the 100% Hampton Guarantee. You can start your weekday morning relaxing in our lobby while relaxing with a complimentary cup of coffee or tea, offered 24 hours a day. Located just minutes from LaGuardia Airport (complimentary shuttle service), Manhattan, CitiField and the USTA National Tennis Stadium, be sure to the make the Hampton Inn New York - LaGuardia your premier hotel when in the New York area. We look forward to having you here!

123249.description: Located just 15 km from Antalya city and 10 km from the airport, the 5-star Botanik Exclusive Resort Lara offers an unforgettable holiday experience. Set within a sprawling 112, 000 m² landscape garden, this 8-storey hotel boasts 534 rooms with magnificent sea views, ensuring a comfortable and memorable stay.

123251.description:
Adalya Hotels is a Mediterranean hospitality group shaped by experience, consistency, and a refined approach to resort living. 
With a portfolio of distinct properties across key destinations, the group delivers well-curated stays that balance comfort, flow, and operational excellence. 
Built on strong infrastucture and long-term expertise , Adalya Hotels offers partners a lifestyle-driven product supported by reliability, trust, and proven performance. 
GENERAL REMARKS:
*** Pets Are Not Allowed. 
*** All Hotel rooms are non-smoking. 
*** Guests under the age of 18 without one of the parents will not be accepted. 
*** The hotel reserves the right to modify the specified dates, times, and venues due to weather
conditions or operational requirements. Additionally, the hotel reserves the right to make changes to
the concept without prior notice. 
*** Depending on availability, guests staying a minimum of 7 nights or more are entitled to one
complimentary à la carte restaurant visit with prior reservation. 
*** In the UAI concept, all drinks are served by the glass. 
*** Alcoholic beverages will not be served to guests under the age of 18.

123264.description: Situated in Braga, this hotel is close to Minho University, Bom Jesus do Monte, and Santa Bárbara Garden. The city centre and its shopping venues is a 5-minute drive away, as are the bus and train stations. The historic city centre is 2 km from the hotel. The Sameiro Sanctuary can be reached by car in 11 minutes and it is a 20-minute journey to Guimarães. The hotel is 30 minutes from Ofir beach.

123288.description: Our welcoming, lakeside Holiday Inn Express Tamworth hotel is just moments from the M42 and in walking distance of historic Tamworth town centre, Tamworth Castle and the train station. We're neighbours with the SnowDome, Drayton Manor is a ten minute drive away, and Birmingham Airport, NEC and city centre are all around a half an hour's drive so we're not just ideally located for Tamworth itself. Our guests enjoy modern, en suite rooms, free WiFi and buffet breakfast. If you're visiting on business, you can host and attend meetings in our four conference rooms. The Great Room is a relaxed spot to enjoy dinner and drinks, and food is available 24/7 so you can always grab a bite to eat at our Tamworth hotel.

123299.address: Mimar Mehmet Aga Cad. Amiral Tafdil Sok No 5, 15
123299.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul, Acra Hotel - Special Class is within a 10-minute walk of the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. This hotel offers 25 guestrooms with amenities such as minibars, LCD TVs with cable programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy a meal at the onsite restaurant, Acra, or take advantage of room service. Daily amenities include a complimentary continental breakfast and a complimentary reception for mingling with other guests. Business services, including complimentary wired internet and a 24-hour business center, are also available. Airport transfers are available (surcharge).

123303.description: Since 1963, the Alantur Hotel has captured the essence of Alanya, a city steeped in thousands of years of history and diverse cultures. Located on the Turkish Riviera, where lush greenery meets the azure Mediterranean, the Alantur invites you to experience a truly special holiday. Our beachfront location and consistently warm climate ensures you'll enjoy every moment of your stay, with a wide range of family activities available. Choose from 350 rooms in various categories, each featuring a balcony or patio. Larger families appreciate our spacious Family Superior, Family Connection, and Bunked Bed rooms, while our suites offer unparalleled comfort. We also provide accessible rooms designed for guests with disabilities.

123305.description: This hotel is conveniently located in the district of Konakli. The hotel is situated just a 15 minutes' bus journey away from the popular resort of Alanya. The hotel is situated within easy access of a myriad of attractions in the area. The hotel is connected to a private beach by an underpass. The hotel enjoys a charming design, greeting visitors with the promise of a comfortable stay. The guest rooms are superbly designed, offering a relaxed setting in which to completely unwind. The hotel offers spacious grounds, with sun-bathing terraces and a shaded snack bar. Guests can avail of the many facilities and services that this wonderful hotel has to offer.

123307.description: The hotel is situated 1 kilometre away from the city centre and the bustling Alanya Shopping District. Guests will find the nearest restaurants, bars and shops in the vicinity. The hotel also enjoys easy access to the main local attractions and landmarks, such as Alanya Castle, Alanya Dockyard and Arsenal, the Red Tower, Alanya Archaeological Museum and Damlatas Cave.

123308.description: This holiday hotel combines a great location just 2 minutes from the sandy beach and the ever-blue waters of the Mediterranean Sea with an appealing architecture and an elegant interior design. In addition to other features such as a delightful garden and a pool area it also offers a football center. The shops and restaurants of Kumköy are within walking distance, the historic city of Side is only 8 km away.

name.content: Seher Kumkoy Star Resort & Spa ex Hane Hotel

123309.description: This hotel is located on a long sandy beach in Kumkoy, approximately 5 km from the ancient city of Side and its museum, amphitheatre, and the Temple of Apollo. Guests will find shops, cafés, bars and restaurants as well as public transportation links in the immediate vicinity, while the nightlife of Kumkoy is around 2 km away. Manavgat is approximately 15 km from the hotel and the Manavgat Waterfalls are a 20-minute drive.

123310.description: Built on an area measuring 380, 000 m2, the holiday complex features Ottoman style architecture, with well-maintained gardens, courtyards and a traditional caravanserai. Suitable for families and couples, the club features superb entertainment and sports activities as well as a tranquil pool for those who wish to chill out. Highlights include a large aqua park, adventure park, 62 tennis courts, Fitness First Studio & a Wellness & Spa. Located in the Kizilagac Tourism Centre on Turkey's south coast, the resort and Hellenistic ruins of Side are 17 km away and easily reached by public transport.

123311.address: SAHIL CAD. No:1 KIRIS - KEMER ANTALYA, .
123311.description: The hotel is situated in the Kiris area of Kemer and enjoys a pleasant beachside location. Antalya city centre is 40 kms and Antalya Airport is 50 kms away. This air-conditioned establishment prides itself on being able to cater for business and leisure travellers alike, via the vast range of on-site facilities and services. All units are well-appointed and air-conditioned. For those who prefer pampering and relaxation, the on-site SPA centre offers a range of services, including Turkish baths, a hot tub and a sauna. The hotel is the perfect choice for guests seeking a fun-filled, lively break, with 2 outdoor swimming pools including children's swimming area, sun loungers and parasols.

123317.description: This charming city hotel enjoys a great location in the heart of Istanbul's historical city centre in the district of Sultanahmet. Guests will find a number of restaurants, bars and shops in close proximity of the hotel. Popular nightlife spots in Taksim are approximately a 15 minutes' ride using public transport. Ataturk Airport is roughly 16 km from the city hotel and Sabiha Gokcen Airport is around 55 km away. This stylishly designed, family-friendly hotel offers magnificent views of the Marmara Sea and the Blue Mosque from the guest lounge in the rooftop restaurant. Built and renovated in 2009, the establishment also features a breakfast room, American bar and wireless Internet access throughout the hotel.

123318.address: A‡amyuva mah. AAYa Ceylan cad. no 6 - Kemer 6, 6
123318.description: To ensure guests' comfort and satisfaction, the hotel has been designed to provide high standards in every aspect. Facilities and services at this air-conditioned establishment are carefully and thoughtfully selected to contribute to an unforgettable stay. Guests will find rooms spacious and well-appointed, especially for families with children. The standard guest rooms, furnished in modern Mediterranean style, have carpeted floors and a balcony or terrace. The hotel provides entertainment programmes for adults and children. There are various leisure facilities and activities available, ranging from swimming pools to outdoor trips. Guests can indulge themselves in a massage or SPA treatment if they choose to relax and rejuvenate.

123356.address: Tilkiler Mevkii, Erhan Demir Bulvari Pk:6 Colakli
123356.description: This family-friendly beach hotel enjoys a wonderful setting in the district of Colakli. The hotel is located just 10 km away from the historical attractions at Side. Shops and Iokantas are situated close by, in Kumkoy. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. This wonderful hotel comprises beautifully-designed guest rooms, which offer comfort and convenience in a peaceful setting. The hotel features an outdoor pool, where guests can enjoy a leisurely swim, for the perfect start to the day. The hotel also features a buffet restaurant and 2 a la carte restaurants, for guests' dining needs. The hotel offers a wide range of exemplary facilities and services, to ensure a memorable stay.

123383.description: Located in Lisbon's vibrant downtown, this hotel offers easy access to iconic landmarks such as the Rua Augusta Arch, Rossio Square, Chiado district, the historic Tram 28, and São Jorge Castle. Public transport is readily available, and Lisbon Airport is just 6. 3 km away. Each room and suite features a refreshing blue and white décor, complete with air conditioning, a minibar, a safe, a flat-screen satellite TV, and a bathroom with a hairdryer and toiletries. Savor traditional Portuguese cuisine with a classic twist at the hotel's restaurant, or unwind at the rooftop bar (located next door at the sister hotel) offering a wide selection of drinks and cocktails.

123388.description: Conveniently located in midtown Manhattan, this newly renovated boutique hotel offers easy access to Times Square, Broadway, Central Park, Fifth Avenue, and the United Nations. A wide array of restaurants, pubs, and clubs are just steps away. The hotel features contemporary design and state-of-the-art amenities, including spacious and comfortable guest rooms designed for a restful stay. LaGuardia Airport is a mere 8 kilometers away. Friendly staff await to welcome you.

name.content: JA The Resort – JA Palm Tree Court, Dubai

123448.address: Exit 13, Sheikh Zayed Road, Jebel Ali,P.O.BOX 9255
123448.description: Nestled along the pristine shores of Jebel Ali, just off Sheikh Zayed Road past Jebel Ali Village and the first entrance of the Jebel Ali Free Zone, this resort offers a luxurious escape. Exit 13 from JAFZA leads to the resort. Boasting a private 800-meter palm-lined beach, three temperature-controlled pools, and a championship 9-hole golf course, guests can indulge in a variety of recreational activities. The resort also features a spa, marina, diving center, shooting club, 13 restaurants and bars, and a kids' club. JA Resorts and Hotels has implemented a comprehensive safety program adhering to international and local guidelines, ensuring a secure and enjoyable stay.

123519.description: With a stay at Melia Berlin, you'll be centrally located in Berlin, steps from Admiralspalast and within a 5-minute walk of Friedrichstadt-Palast. This upscale hotel is 0. 2 mi (0. 3 km) from Berliner Ensemble and 0. 3 mi (0. 4 km) from Bode Museum. Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including a 24-hour health club, a sauna, and bicycles to rent. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 364 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Enjoy international cuisine at Cafe Madrid, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, a computer station, and express check-in. Planning an event in Berlin? This hotel has 12917 square feet (1200 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms.

123528.description: This modern aparthotel is located in a quiet residential area of Carrières-sur-Seine, a 6-minute drive from the Houilles-Carrières-sur-Seine RER A Station and within a short walk from a number of charming, local restaurants. Due to its proximity to the transport hub its guests can reach the La Défense business district within a 6-minute ride, while central Paris is at only 20 minutes. For their convenience the venue also offers a complimentary, weekday shuttle service that runs to the train station and the central commercial and entertainment area. The venue itself is a great choice for both business travellers and holidaymakers, the well-appointed studios and apartments offer plenty of space for relaxing or setting up a home office. There is also an indoor pool where guests can unwind and a modern fitness centre for those who want to maintain their workout schedule while on the road.

123540.description: This extraordinary hotel is situated in an exceptional 18th century palace with spectacular interior decoration, located directly on the banks of the river Douro. Being a beautiful example of Portuguese Civil Baroque, the hotel is listed as a National Monument. The historic centre of Porto with attractions such as the Museum of Port Wine or the Casa da Música is easily reachable, the international airport is 18 km away.

123577.description:
Located a 10-minute walk from the city centre of Marrakesh, the property offers an air-conditioned studios. Guests can enjoy the hammam and the outdoor pool. 

The apartments at the Mogador Menzah Appart Hôtel all feature balconies, Moroccan seating areas, and private bathrooms. Each has an equipped kitchenette and a mini-bar. Free Wi-fi is available in the hotel’s common areas. 

Guest of Mogador Menzah Appart Hôtel can enjoy a relaxing massage, or sunbathe on the poolside terrace. 

Mogador Menzah Appart Hôtel offers a range of services, such as an on-site currency exchange and a tour desk. The Menara Gardens are 2 km away and private parking is also available at an extra charge.

name.content: Al Maha, a Luxury Collection Desert Resort & Spa

123580.address: Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, Al Ain Road
123580.description: Indulge in the full-service spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Experience local wildlife on a safari adventure, followed by relaxation at the outdoor pool or sauna. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops. Enjoy lunch or dinner at Al Diwaan Restaurant, specializing in international cuisine, or order 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Business travelers appreciate the 24-hour business center, express check-in/check-out, and 2, 906 sq ft of meeting space. Free self-parking is available. The 42 individually decorated guestrooms boast private pools, LED TVs, furnished patios, complimentary wired and wireless internet, iPod docking stations, and cable programming. Private bathrooms offer deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Al Maha, A Luxury Collection Desert Resort & Spa, Dubai is located in Murqquab. The preferred airport is Dubai International Airport (DXB), 72. 3 km away.

123597.description: This hotel is in an excellent central location. The hotel is located in Avsallar, 22 km from Alanya city centre. Guests can use local public transportation to visit Alanya, where there are attractions and landmarks, such as Alanya Castle, Alanya Dockyard and Arsenal, the Red Tower, Alanya Archaeological Museum and Damlatas Cave.

123600.description: The IC Hotels Green Palace Villas in Kundu, Antalya, offers a luxurious escape within a sprawling 70-acre landscape. Guests enjoy private pool villas nestled beside the extraordinary gardens of the IC Green Palace. Just 15 km from Antalya Airport and 25 km from the city center, this exclusive retreat features 44 lavish villas. A warm welcome awaits, complete with sparkling wine, Turkish delights, fresh fruit, and special offerings. Honeymooners are treated to additional perks, including in-room flowers, special decorations, a fruit basket and sparkling wine, complimentary breakfast in the room (one morning upon request), a complimentary dinner at the à la carte restaurant, a commemorative photo, and discounts at the Lilium SPA Center. Free services include Wi-Fi, fax, beach and pool towels, chaise lounges, sun umbrellas, four tartan-covered tennis courts, buggy service, a fitness center, a Turkish hammam, a sauna, a mini club, animation activities, and an open-air/indoor disco.

123702.description: CIN: IT015201A1BU86JOHQ - CODICE CIR : 015201-ALB-00004 The hotel is located 1 km from the centre of San Vittore Olona and 3 km from Legnano. It lies just 10 km from the Milan Rho-Pero Exhibition Centre and Milan's cultural and historic centre is a 30-minute drive. The property is also well located for Milan Malpensa Airport, which is just 18 km away. This city hotel offers a total of 82 spacious, air-conditioned rooms. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and lift access. Guests can relax and enjoy typical Italian cuisine at the Sempione 320 Restaurant or a drink in the lounge-bar area. Here guests will also find free internet Wi-Fi access and a selection of daily newspapers. Staff at the 24-hour front desk can advise on transport arrangements and there is room service (charges apply) and free outdoor and indoor parking at guests' disposal. Rooms are spacious and come with a large private bathroom with a double shower and a hairdryer. They are equipped with satellite TV, Internet access, and a safe. Furthermore, individually regulated air conditioning units are provided in all accommodation as standard. The excellent breakfast buffet will give guests a great start to the day and in the evening guests can enjoy the dinner choosing from the various specialities offered on the restaurant's à la carte menu. CIR : 015201-ALB-00004

123704.description: Located in Alanya; it takes 1 km to the center, 30 m to the beach, 118 km to Antalya Airport . Taxi and minibus are available for your transportation. Situated on the boulevard which runs parallel to Cleopatra Beach, the hotel is well-located with the beach being just 30 metres away and the centre of Alanya 1. 5 km from the property. Gazipasa Airport is approximately 45 km from the hotel and Antalya Airport is around 120 km away. This well-established, air-conditioned hotel has been refurbished in 2011 and offers 203 comfortable rooms and a prime location within the resort. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel car park. The rooms are spacious with en suite bathrooms and carpeted flooring. Some light entertainment is provided by the hotel and an outdoor swimming pool with a children's section and poolside snack bar is also at guests' disposal.

123711.description: The premises count with 99 welcoming units. Moreover, Yetkin Hotel has made important environmental improvements in order to minimize its impact on the environment and features the certification.

123728.description: This family-friendly hotel, located near the popular resort town of Side, is just 600 meters from a private sandy beach with a complimentary shuttle service. The historic center of Side, with its ancient sites, is 5 km away, and Manavgat is 7 km away. Antalya International Airport is 54 km from the hotel. The hotel offers 197 rooms, a 24-hour reception, express check-in/check-out, Wi-Fi, a restaurant, a bar, indoor and outdoor pools, two children's pools, a fitness center, a spa, sports facilities, car hire, free on-site parking, and facilities for disabled guests.

123729.address: Kizilot Beldesi Yenice Pazar Mah. Ada Mevkii
123729.description: This holiday village is located on a quiet part of the coastline. Guests will find shops and other amenities in the nearest small town of Kizilagac, just 5 km away. Renovated in 2024, this holiday village complex is attractively built and consists of small blocks of accommodation units, spread throughout the pretty grounds. The pleasant lobby area has a small atrium with chandeliers suspended from the wooden beamed roof. Refreshments are served at the bar and restaurant and guests can enjoy the disco. The rooms are pleasantly decorated in a comfortable style and are housed in small villa-type blocks with wooden balconies. The gardens of this establishment feature a total of 3 swimming pools, including a children's swimming area and a castellated water slide. Guests can relax at the sauna and steam room or unwind with a SPA or massage treatment.

123730.description: The hotel is located by the sandy beach running west of the historical town and resort of Side, which is approximately a 15 minutes' walk away. Nearby places of interest include Side Amphitheatre, Side Archaeology Museum and the Temple of Apollo, all within 900 metres from the hotel. This small, family-run hotel offers a total of 33 rooms spread over 4 floors, and welcomes guests to a refreshment at the café or a meal at the perfectly located restaurant by the beach, which is also used as a bar and disco. Internet access is available, and those arriving by car may leave their vehicle in the hotel car park. The rooms are comfortably furnished, and all come with a balcony which enables guests to enjoy beautiful views at all times during their stay.

123731.address: Kemerağzı Mahallesi, Yaşar Sobutay bulvarı no:402, 402
123731.description: This family-friendly hotel with a unique design is located directly on the sandy beach between Antalya and Belek on the Turkish Riviera. The centre of Antalya is 15 km away, the international airport 12 km. The hotel has 322 rooms, 24-hours reception, currency exchange, meeting rooms, WIFI, 3 restaurants, 3 bars, outdoor pool with children's section, indoor pool with separated children's pool, playground, mini-club, fitness centre, spa and wellness, sports facilities, medical assistance, disco and car park.

123758.description: The family-friendly club resort is located on the beach in the Kizilagac district, 13 km from Manavgat, where guests will find numerous shops, restaurants and bars, and 15 km from the popular resort of Side, which has a bus station, Side Amphitheatre and Museum, Temple of Apollo and ancient ruins. Guests will find links to the public transport network in front of the hotel. Manavgat Waterfalls are approximately 18 km from the beach hotel, Aspendos Amphitheatre is around 40 km away, the city of Antalya is roughly 80 km away and Antalya airport is approximately 70 km away. This is a spacious and family-friendly hotel surrounded by lavish gardens. The main building hosts the lobby with its bar and 24-hour reception desk and check-out services, while the 363 guest rooms are located in 16 two-storey villas within the grounds. The hotel has 1 main restaurant and 2 smaller à la carte restaurants, as well as a Turkish cafe and beach bar. The hotel also has an Internet cafe (fees apply) and free wireless Internet access in the lobby. Further facilities available to guests at the air-conditioned establishment include an auditorium, TV lounge, children's playground, kids' club, conference facilities, a laundry service (fees apply) and a car park. All rooms are located in 2-storey villas around the grounds of the hotel. They have tiled floors, either a balcony or patio, and are equipped with an en suite bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, satellite TV, a minibar (water and soft drinks only), safe and individually regulated air conditioning and heating.

123760.description: This resort boasts a magnificent setting close to Belek. The resort is set on a sprawling sandy beach, just a short distance away from a myriad of attractions. The complex is serviced by public transport links, as well as a taxi rank, offering ease of access to other areas to be discovered and explored. This spectacular resort is sure to surpass all expectations. The guest rooms are luxuriously appointed, exuding classical elegance and sophistication. Guests can enjoy a round of golf on the resort's course, which was designed by Peter Thomson. An extensive choice of first-class facilities and services are available for guests' use. Guests are assured of a truly unrivalled experience, rich in comfort and convenience, at this sublime hotel.

123764.description: Hotel is located in the heart of the city and close to business centers (Levent-Sisli-Maslak). The Zorlu Center, Cevahir, Kanyon and Metrocity shopping malls are few minutes from the hotel. Hotel offers a convenient place to stay in while amazing you with a breathtaking view of the Bosphorus. With a sophisticated, unique and innovative sense of style, whilst meeting your expectations at a superior level of service. The new design rooms offer a seamless blend of comfort and technology.

123765.address: Alemdar Mah. Ticarethane Cikmaz Sok. No:3 Fatih, 3 5
123765.description: Situated in the very heart of Istanbul’s renowned Sultanahmet district, our centrally located hotel offers guests a unique blend of comfort, convenience, and cultural richness. Just a short walking distance from the city’s most iconic landmarks — including the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, and the Grand Bazaar — our property provides an ideal base for both leisure and business travelers seeking to explore the historical treasures of the city. Our elegantly appointed rooms are designed to ensure a restful and enjoyable stay, combining modern amenities with a refined ambiance. Guests are invited to begin each day with a traditional Turkish breakfast, served with warm hospitality and care. Whether visiting for a short stay or an extended holiday, we are dedicated to providing an exceptional experience marked by genuine service, outstanding location, and a welcoming atmosphere.

123811.description: Great care is taken to ensure guests experience comfort through top-notch services and amenities. Remain linked during your visit by utilizing the complimentary internet access available. Prior to your check-in date, you can arrange airport transportation services, guaranteeing a seamless and efficient experience for both arrival and departure. Parking is accessible, supplied by the hotel for guests who arrive by car. The hotel is completely smoke-free. In limited designated zones, smoking is exclusively permitted. Begin your day on a delightful note with a scrumptious complimentary breakfast, consistently served at Viva Deluxe Hotel. Begin your holiday mornings right with your essential cup of coffee, offered daily at the cafe on-site. During your visit, indulge in a range of delightful culinary choices at hotel to enhance your experience.

123860.description: Adagio La Défense Esplanade is located in the heart of the La Défense business district, near CNIT and the Grande-Arche. It has 99 fully equipped studios and apartments, including 2 studies for PRM. Large shopping center and all services within walking distance and paid public parking in the immediate vicinity. Perfect for business stays, the Aparthotel is 10 minutes from the Champs Elysées by metro.

123900.description: You will quickly feel at home at Aparthotel Adagio Brussels Grand Place. Our aparthotel combines the best of the hotel service and the space of an apartment. We have 140 apartments available for our guests. We are located in the city centre nearby train station Brussels Central, in the Anspach shopping centre with its casino, theatre and panoramic restaurant. This privileged location between the Grand Place and the Rue Neuve gives you easy access to the city for business trips or cultural visits.

123933.description: Please note that because of Covid-19 and the sanitary pass, breakfast will be served in the bedroom. Located on a quiet area of the 12ème arrondissement in Paris, and next to some of the most beautiful tourist sites in the city, the Prince Albert Lyon Bercy hotel is the perfect place to unwind after a day of sightseeing. The hotel is situated next to the Gare de Lyon, minutes away from the Opéra Bastille. Charles de Gaulle airport is approximately 22 km away. The hotel rooms are comfortable and fully equipped, decorated in a discreet manner. At the hotel's breakfast room, guests will feel like they're looking onto Paris' beautiful rooftops. There are also numerous cafés and bistros on the hotel surroundings. The metro line 1 station of Reuilly-Diderot is a few minutes away, with stops on the main tourist sites in the city centre: the Jewish distric of Marais, the Louvre Museum, the beautiful Tuileries gardens, the exclusive Champs Elysées avenue and the Arc de Triomphe.

123935.description: The well-being of guests is a top priority at Choice-branded hotels, with a variety of new and improved cleanliness protocols and products. Enjoy travel essentials and friendly service at our Quality Inn hotel in Rochester, NY. Amenities include free WiFi, free hot breakfast, an exercise room, meeting space, and a 24-hour reception desk. Guest rooms feature a microwave, refrigerator, hair dryer, iron and ironing board, a desk with an ergonomic chair, and more. Our pet-friendly and accessible hotel is conveniently located near the I-490/I-390 interchange, about 10 minutes from Greater Rochester International Airport, downtown attractions, and the University of Rochester. Explore city attractions such as the Susan B. Anthony House, Frontier Field, the Strong Museum, and the Seneca Park Zoo. Make the most of your trip to Rochester at our Quality Inn hotel. Earn rewards, including free nights and gift cards, with our Choice Privileges Rewards program.

123960.description: Our independent hotel is located in the heart of Brussels' European Quarter, just 100 meters from the Schuman metro/train station. Awarded the Bike Friendly and EUQB labels in 2023, we welcome guests to the international atmosphere of the European Village, a friendly and secure area. Our 133 bright and spacious rooms offer classic comfort and a warm, welcoming ambiance. Enjoy a buffet breakfast featuring Belgian products, including local and homemade specialties, served in our breakfast room overlooking a large garden. We are conveniently located a 15-minute drive from the Grand Place and the historic city center. Standard rooms measure 32 square meters. Coffee/tea making facilities, and air conditioning are provided in every room. A bank with a cash machine is located 100 meters from the hotel.

123973.description: The hotel enjoys a great location in the historic Sultanahmet district of Istanbul. The top attractions such as Topkapi Palace and Hagia Sophia are within a 10 to 15 minutes' walk, and local transport is close by with links to other parts of the city. The train station is about 2 km away. Istanbul and Sabiha Gokcen International Airports are about 15 and 45 km away, respectively. This boutique-style accommodation establishment opened in 2009 with 24 rooms and is decorated in an attractive mix of Ottoman and modern styles. The charming hotel has a breakfast hall and a terrace restaurant. The rooms are pleasantly designed and furnished blending the past with the present and offering modern amenities.

123984.description: Situated on Holbox Island, the Xperience Hotels La Palapa Etno-Chic Hotel is an oasis of tranquillity surrounded by a true Garden of Eden. The hotel comprises comfortable rooms with a rustic décor, the ideal place to relax. The turquoise waters of the sea are literally only steps away; there are no streets, but sand roads, and a wide range of tropical flora and fauna can be seen.

124002.address: Calle Perdro Joaquin Codwell S/N, Sm 19
124002.description: In the heart of Holbox Island, Holbox Dream Beach Front Hotel offers direct beach access to the fantastic and beautiful turquoise sea. Here, you can take time to admire great sunsets and renew your body and spirit. The hotel includes two outdoor pools, a restaurant and cozy rooms with terrace in a serene island atmosphere. The air- conditioned rooms provide comfortable queen size bed, private shower with natural seashell showerhead, free organic amenities, toiletries, ceiling fan, free WIFI and a complimentary bottle of water. The concierge service can arrange transportation and tours around Holbox Island and they can provide lots of useful information about some of the island's main attractions.

124019.description: The hotel enjoys an ideal location in the calm and quiet district of Da El Bacha. The souks are just some 5 minutes' walk away and Djemaa el Fna Square and Ben Youssef Madrasa are both around 10 minutes' walk away. Restaurants and nightspots are within close reach, while the bus station is just 5 minutes' walk away and Marrakech train station is about 10 minutes' away by public transport. Majorelle Garden is some 15 minutes away from this establishment, the Saadian Tombs can be reached in 30 minutes on foot or 10 minutes by public transport and the centre of the modern city of Gueliz is around 15 km away. Marrakech-Menara Airport is some 6 km. This hotel is housed in a former residential palace dating back to 1900 and all rooms overlook a pleasant patio with a fountain surrounded by palm and bananas trees. The terrace is among the highest in the old medina of Marrakech and it features a small plunge pool for refreshment as well as offering a panoramic view over the entire old medina and the Atlas Mountains. Facilities at the hotel include a lobby with 24-hour check-out service and hotel safe, a café, bar and restaurant. Internet access is offered, and a laundry service is available (for a fee). The hotel offers spacious, quiet rooms which will give guests a feeling of harmony. All open onto an elegant patio and are provided with a welcome kit including flowers, fruit and water. A hairdryer and safe are also available and the en suite bathroom is fitted with a shower and bath. The rooms offer double or king-size beds and are equipped with tea and coffee making facilities. Individually regulated air conditioning and central heating ensure guests' comfort.

124020.description: From the outside, it is always difficult to imagine the luxury which is behind the door. On arrival, a Moroccan tea will be offered in the beautiful and welcoming patio. Located in the historic heart of Marrakech (Medina) and a few minutes’ walk from the new city (Guéliz), this charming 6- bedroom guesthouse immerses you in a typical and vibrant area of the old city. Ideally located close to the Bab Doukkala and well-served by local transport, Riad Zayane is a beautiful Marrakech guesthouse within a 5-minute walk from the Souks and a 15-minute walk from Jemaa El-Fna square. Most attractions and things to see in Marrakech are within walking distance. A smiling and friendly staff, available 24/7, will take care of your every need. Delicious and varied breakfasts are served throughout your stay. Cozy, intimate and peaceful, this lovely guesthouse has 6 beautifully decorated bedrooms made with comfort and harmony for a perfect change of scene. Tastefully decorated, all rooms blend harmoniously traditional Moroccan materials (tadelakt, zelliges etc), wood paneling and antique decorative objects to create a warm and authentic atmosphere. All rooms include a private bathroom with shower and toilet. The rooms also feature double or twin beds, air conditioning and a safe. In addition to its 6 air-conditioned rooms, luxuriously decorated, Riad Zayane has a rooftop terrace with solarium, a lounge and a magnificent patio which is an ideal setting for a romantic candlelit dinner over tasty Moroccan dishes concocted by the in-house chef. The staff are available 24/7 and will help you organize excursions and guided tours of Marrakech and its surroundings, or to book a restaurant table and other entertainment tickets. A shuttle service to the airport will be provided with prior reservation (additional fee). A free wireless internet is available throughout the building. Parking and taxis are nearby.

124021.description:
Located at Riad Larousse, near the souks and only a few minutes from Djemaa el Fna Square, this hotel is located in one of the nicest parts of the medina. The nearest link to the CTM buses is a 25-minute walk away and the bus station is 5 minutes' walk. A 10-minute ride with public transport will bring guests to the train station. The city centre is within 15 minutes' walk. Marrekech-Menara Airport is situated roughly 6 km from the residence.

This chic guesthouse's high ceilings and Islamic arches open onto the patio, giving it a majestic touch. Some of the hotel's guest rooms overlook the elegant patio with a pool surrounded by palm trees, a fountain and a lounge with fireplace. The terrace offers a panoramic view of the beauty of the sunrise and sunset, with a spectacular view over the medina and the Atlas Mountains. The residence also features a lobby with 24-hour check-out service, a hotel safe, a café, a bar and laundry service.

The hotel rooms are quiet, harmonious, spacious and open onto an elegant patio with a swimming pool surrounded by palm trees, a fountain and a lounge with fireplace. All of them are provided with welcome trays including flowers, fruits and water. The en suite bathrooms are fitted with shower, bathtub and hairdryer, and the bedrooms are furnished with double or king-size bed. Furthermore, all rooms are equipped with a safe, tea and coffee making facilities, individually regulated air conditioning and central heating.

The hotel has relaxing massages on offer (fees apply). Royale golf club can be reached in 15 minutes by public transport.

The hotel provides breakfast, as well as light à la carte lunches and Moroccan à la carte options for dinner.

124033.description:
The hotel is located at an elevation of 1,000 m, 60 km south of Marrakech, at the foothills of the Atlas Mountains and near the beautiful Berber villages of Ouirgane, Asni and Tahnaout. Situated near the Azzadan River, 10 km east of Lake Takerhoust, the hotel offers its visitors a breathtaking panoramic view of the white snow-capped Atlas Mountains. The hotel can organize guided treks and mule rides around the Berber villages and lunches with Berber families. Menara International Airport is located approximately 60 km from the hotel.


Situated on its own olive grove, the hotel offers its visitors 10 rooms and 11 suites, built in the typical Berber style pisé (rammed earth construction), with beautiful hand-carved wooden doors and furniture, colourful Berber carpets decorating the rooms, fine tadelakt plasterwork on the walls and tataoui craftwork on the ceilings. Fully air-conditioned, the hotel offers a lobby with 24-hour check-out service, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a hairdressing salon, a TV lounge, a café, a bar and a restaurant. Business guests are sure to appreciate the conference facilities and Internet access is available for a fee. Guests may also take advantage of the room and laundry services and car park.



The traditionally built hotel rooms and kasbahs (suites) are nicely decorated and all have a fireplace and a private terrace. All are en suite and equipped with a shower, bath, double or king-size bed and individually regulated air conditioning and heating.


Guests may make use of the outdoor swimming pool, the children's swimming area, the poolside snack bar and sun loungers and parasols which have been laid out for use. Furthermore, the hotel features a sauna, a steam room and massage and spa treatments.


The hotel produces its own olive oil, fruity and organic vegetables grown in property's own garden, which are used in the preparation of the delicious Moroccan specialities.

124043.description: The Adagio Berlin is situated just minutes from the world-famous Kurfürstendamm in the heart of West Berlin. Ranging from studio apartments for 2 people to two-roomed apartments for 4 people, our 132 apartments are fully equipped, featuring a kitchen, living room, desk etc. On-site facilities include breakfast service, Internet access, a meeting room and a fitness center where you can relax.

124049.description: Adagio Vienna City is located at Julius-Raab-Platz at the heart of Vienna in the immediate vicinity of the Ringstrasse and historic center. We offer 124 fully equipped rooms, from studios for 2 guests to 2-room apartments for 4 guests. Nestled among the unique house facades, narrow streets and backyards of the 'Stubenviertel', it is the perfect place to stay for business stays or a long relaxing weekend.

124095.description: Located in the district of Alara, mid-way between Alanya and Manavgat, this resort-styled hotel is set in lush, spacious gardens leading down to a private beach. Antalya Airport is at 90 km away. Public transport runs within a few metres of the complex, enabling easy access to the many wonderful historical and sight-seeing attractions such as Alanya Castle and the ancient Roman and Hellenistic ruins at Side. Enjoying a laid-back atmosphere, families will feel at home with activities for children available and the convenience of connecting rooms. A range of amenities are provided for guests' entertainment and relaxation, whether sports, animation or a relaxing Turkish bath and massage. The rooms are modern and well equipped providing a comfortable resting place at the end of the day. Each room features a private bathroom.

124099.description: This hotel is perfectly situated to explore Antalya-Side, 800 m from Side city centre and 200 m from the beach. The airport is about 50 minutes away by car form the complex. With its convenient location, and public transportation links close to the hotel, it offers easy access to the city's must-see attractions. Manavgat Waterfall and the town of Manavgat are both a 20-minute drive away. There are several restaurants, cafés and bars in the surroundings, they are ideal for the ones who like to explore delicious flavours. Guests can rest and enjoy the sun by sunbathing on a sun lounger by the side of the outdoor swimming pool or diving in it for a refreshing swim. The rooms are decorated with warm colours to create a cosy atmosphere and make travellers feel welcomed and have unforgettable holidays.

name.content: Candlewood Suites New York City- Times Square

124110.description: Discover NYC Manhattan from Our Extended Stay HotelSurrounded by the electrifying Times Square, Candlewood Suites New York City Times Square is the perfect NYC location for your extended stay. When blending business with leisure, our NYC hotel is convenient to major businesses in Times Square and the attractions of New York City. If you are traveling to the Big Apple for just an overnight stay or for a long stay, our NYC hotel's studio suites with full kitchen facilities will make your trip a smashing success. Our Times Square address places you within walking distance of the Jacob Javitz Convention Center, Madison Square Garden, Penn Station, Port Authority, Hudson Yard, Ernst &Young, New York Times Building and Amazon among others. Our All-Suite hotel offers comfortable work spaces and free high-speed Internet access. Our hotel in NYC's Times Square is centrally located so it is easy to visit the best of the city; the electricity of Times Square, the majesty of the Empire State Building and the excitement of Broadway Theater are at our doorstep. All modes of transportation, from trains, buses and subways are nearby. Our extended stay Midtown Manhattan hotel offers a free 24-hour fitness center. We are a 100% non-smoking hotel. There is the Candlewood Cupboard, located in the main lobby, for food and sundries. We also offer free laundry facilities. Please note the daily parking rates for our guest is Standard Cars $90 / SUVs $100

124112.description: Tranquil modern settings balanced with traditional service…Nestled on Park Avenue and 38th Street is the Kitano New York Hotel, a well-kept 4-Diamond secret.  This first Japanese owned hotel has been a Murray Hill fixture since 1973. Located in the prestigious Murray Hill district, this property is within walking distance to Grand Central Station, the Empire State Building and Times Square. Featuring 150 luxurious guest rooms and suites, our rooms have full marble bathrooms, sound-proofed windows that open, ergonomic work desks and electronic door locks, as well as a free premium cable, complimentary USA Today and Asahi. Enjoy two different venues for dining experiences - Jazz at Kitano our lobby restaurant and bar with Live Jazz 7 days a week and Hakubai for fine Japanese dining. Perched on the Penthouse Level is the newest member to the NYC rooftop bar scene – Roof at 66 Park which features two outdoor terraces, one terrace views the Chrysler Building and Grand Central, the other enjoys an unobstructed view of the Empire State Building. Hotel will be The Price Kitano New York Hotel as of Spring 2023. Please visit our website for COVID-19 Protocols.

name.content: Delta Hotels by Marriott Marrakech Eden Andalou

124113.description: Surrounded by beautiful Andalusian-style landscaped gardens, this hotel enjoys magnificent views to the Atlas mountain range. Downtown Marrakesh can be reached within a 20 minutes' drive. Menara - Marrakech Airport is only 5 km away. A perfect place for couples and families with children. It perfectly combines wonderful Moorish architecture based on palaces of the tenth century with twenty-first century amenities. Features include an adjacent fantastic water park, as well as a relaxing spa area. Some restaurant and all Spa services are with supplement. The suites feature modern decor and include appliances and a bathroom inside.

124114.description: Located in the historic centre of Lima, the hotel is ideal for a visit to Peru. It is near the Government Palace, Plaza de Armas, cathedral, and Park of the Reserve, which offers one of the best water, light and sound shows in the world. The beach at Larcomar is roughly 6. 5 km away. The air-conditioned hotel offers a lobby, 24-hour reception and check-out service. Further facilities include safe, currency exchange facilities and lift access. Guests may dine and enjoy their favourite drinks in the café, bar and restaurant. The residence offers rooms with minibar, international direct dial telephone and hairdryer. Further standard amenities include double or king-size beds, kitchenette and terrace. Breakfast buffet is served each morning.

124115.description: Conveniently located in the most cosmopolitan commercial and residential area of Lima, just a 25-minute ride from the international airport and near the main bus station and the beach, this hotel combines the latest technology with the unique Novo Andean design, incorporating the art of ancient Peru into its modern architecture. Especially preferred by business travellers, it offers a 24-hour reception and check-out service, complimentary Wi-Fi Internet access and conference facilities. Whether in town for work or leisure, guests can start the day with hearty continental breakfast buffet served each morning, while the on-site restaurant and bar are an excellent choice for an evening drink or a delicious dinner.

124118.description: Located in the heart of Lima, the Sheraton Lima Historic Center is a short drive from attractions like the Magic Water Circuit and Plaza San Martin. This upscale, Art Deco hotel offers 437 air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a fitness center, a seasonal outdoor pool, two restaurants including Mariva, a bar/lounge, and on-site shopping. Business travelers will appreciate the business center, conference facilities, and 8 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge, and free self-parking is provided.

124121.description: Situated in Athens city centre, this attractive and contemporary hotel is within walking distance of many of the city's most celebrated attractions.
