The famous Parthenon, Odeon of Herodes Atticus, Acropolis Museum, and the Temple of Olympian Zeus can be reached by foot in under 30 minutes, and other nearby attractions include the National Gallery of Art, Museum of Greek Folk Art, and the National Gardens. Rooms are modern and bright, decorated in vivid colours, and feature paintings by Corinna O'Brien, bringing an extra touch of style and grace. Guests can start a busy day of sightseeing with a rich buffet breakfast, and later take a coffee in the chic lobby lounge and enjoy views of the magnificent Acropolis from the rooftop terrace. The hotel also provides free Wi-Fi throughout, and has a helpful tour desk to assist guests in organizing excursions sightseeing in the Athens area.

124125.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an attached winery and an outdoor pool. Additional amenities at this Edwardian guesthouse include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Satisfy your appetite at Mimosa Lodge, a fine-dining restaurant which features a bar/lounge. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wrap up your day with a drink at the poolside bar. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include wired internet access (surcharge), dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available on request), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 23 individually decorated guestrooms. Your Select Comfort bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected.

124139.description: Located in the very heart of the city, near Marquês de Pombal, a few steps from Avenida da Liberdade, this is the perfect place from which to explore the city. All public transportation networks are in the vicinity and the airport is 8 km away. All areas of the hotel are extremely inviting, thanks to their modern architecture and design, combining sophistication and informality, making this a perfect hotel for both, business and leisure travellers. Facilities include a lobby with a 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, breakfast room, and conference facilities.

124192.description: With a stay at Amister Apartments, you'll be centrally located in Barcelona, just a 4-minute walk from La Rambla and 5 minutes by foot from Plaça de Catalunya. This aparthotel is 0. 6 mi (0. 9 km) from Barcelona Cathedral and 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Casa Batllo. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 13 guestrooms, featuring kitchens with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and ovens. Your bed comes with premium bedding, and all rooms are furnished with sofa beds. Wired and wireless Internet access is complimentary, while 32-inch LCD televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and microwaves, and housekeeping is provided daily. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired Internet access, express check-in, and express check-out. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a cruise ship terminal shuttle. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. University of Barcelona - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- La Rambla - 0. 4 km/0. 2 mi- Plaça de Catalunya - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- Portal de l'Angel - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- El Corte Ingles - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Rambla de Catalunya - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Boqueria Market - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Tivoli Theatre - 0. 7 km/0. 5 mi- Barcelona Cathedral - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Palau de la Música Catalana - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Gran Teatre del Liceu - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Rambla del Raval - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Plaça Reial - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Casa Batllo - 1 km/0. 6 mi. The preferred airport for Amister Apartments is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 16. 8 km/10. 4 mi.

124193.description: The hotel enjoys a desirable location in Paris, nestled in a quiet street close to the Palais de la Femme and a few steps from the Place de la Bastille. Guests are invited to take a stroll and experience this old, historic Parisian quarter, with the Place des Vosges, the Notre Dame and the Opera Bastille. There are also numerous bars, restaurants, theatres and fashion boutiques in the surrounding area. This modern and trendy property was recently entirely renovated and is equipped with contemporary and refined furniture. It offers 29 personally designed, fashionable rooms on white backgrounds, creating the perfect mood for an unforgettable stay.

124194.description: This charming hotel is ideally situated in the heart of Amsterdam, just a short 4-minute walk from the vibrant Leidseplein. This lively square offers a variety of entertainment, shopping, and dining options. Located in the quaint Spiegel Quarter, the hotel provides easy access to all parts of the city. Each uniquely themed room is tastefully decorated and features modern furnishings and amenities, including Wi-Fi. Family rooms are also available. For added convenience, the hotel offers laundry service. Please note that there is no elevator.

124240.description: This modern Bromsgrove hotel offers easy access to Birmingham, free Wi-Fi, ample meeting space, a restaurant, and a spa. Located just off the M5 motorway, the Holiday Inn® Birmingham - Bromsgrove hotel is a 30-minute drive from Birmingham City Centre. Free parking is available, and direct trains from Bromsgrove station, a mile away, take 30 minutes. Birmingham Airport (BHX) and the NEC are easily accessible via the nearby M42. You can reach the Cadbury World chocolate factory or the Black Country Living Museum in about 30 minutes. West Midlands Safari Park is also close by. The stylish Fairfield Suite has its own bar and can accommodate up to 220 guests, making it a popular wedding venue. Host an intimate business gathering or a conference in one of the hotel's 10 hi-tech meeting rooms. Wi-Fi is free throughout the hotel, and a dedicated events team can arrange catering and business services. Relax in the steam room, swim laps in the heated indoor pool, and enjoy delicious meals in our Sourced restaurant, which features daily specials. Alternatively, unwind with a refreshing drink in the lounge bar. Kids stay and eat free.

124259.description: Situated just 100 meters from Kleopatra Beach and 2 km west of Alanya's vibrant center, this city hotel offers convenient access to public transport, shops, and restaurants. Gazipasa Airport is approximately 46 km away, while Antalya Airport is about 123 km from the hotel. Refurbished in 2010, this air-conditioned hotel features 123 comfortable rooms equipped with satellite TV, air conditioning, and balconies. Guests can enjoy the outdoor swimming pool, children's pool, and a relaxing spa area complete with a sauna and hammam.

124260.address: Behind Mall Of The Emirates, Al Barsha, Dubai
124260.description: The hotel is situated in the city of Dubai and is just behind the Mall of the Emirates. It is close to some of the local attractions of Dubai, such as Sheikh Saeed's House, Dubailand (8. 5 km), the Grand Mosque, Tower of Arabs (Burj Al Arab), Majlis Gallery, Magic Planet and Wild Wadi Waterpark (3 km). The centre of the city is approximately 12 km from the hotel and Dubai International Airport is around 22 km away. The air-conditioned apartment hotel in Dubai features 47 quality accommodation units and friendly service for guests to enjoy a pleasant holiday in Dubai. Facilities include a lobby, hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, lift access, a restaurant, conference facilities, room and laundry services, and a car park. The hotel consists of hotel apartments, all of which are extremely spacious, well-furnished and offer a range of modern amenities. Guests will find a fully equipped kitchen in each apartment, perfect for business, long-stay guests or families requiring extra space. Each apartment features an en suite bathroom with bathtub, a direct dial telephone, satellite TV and air conditioning. During their leisure time, guests can work out in the gym or relax in the sauna. The Emirates Golf Club is approximately 5. 5 km from the hotel. Guests can dine at the on-site restaurant, which serves a great selection of dishes in a friendly atmosphere.

124291.description: Located in Rio de Janeiro, this economical hotel sits near Recreio Beach, offering stunning views of the sea and mountains. Ideal for nature lovers and surfers, the area boasts excellent waves year-round. The hotel is also conveniently close to shopping and entertainment centers. Apartments accommodate up to four people, catering to both business and leisure travelers.

124293.description: Situated on one of the Upper East Side's best blocks, surrounded by New York's premier museums, shops, and restaurants, and the splendor of Central Park, The Mark not only surrounds you in luxury and style, but it also places you at the epicenter of Manhattan's social and cultural riches. The Mark is housed, as it has always been, in a beautiful 1927 landmark building at the corner of 77th Street and Madison Avenue. Inside, The Mark has been completely reimagined for the 21st century. Newly reborn, it combines old-world comfort, avant-garde design, up-to-the-minute technologies, and an unprecedented level of personal service to create a premier five-star hotel experience.

124294.description: Set in a prime location of New York (NY), Belvedere Hotel puts everything the city has to offer just outside your doorstep. The property offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Convenience store, laundromat, 24-hour front desk, valet parking, room service are just some of the facilities on offer. Each guestroom is elegantly furnished and equipped with handy amenities. Enjoy the fitness center before retiring to your room for a well-deserved rest. Convenience and comfort make Belvedere Hotel the perfect choice for your stay in New York (NY). A daily $100 or max $300 security authorization will be processed on your credit card at check-in. *****FOR ACCESSIBLE ROOMS PLEASE CONTACT THE HOTEL FOR AVAILABILITY******

124325.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Hotel Felix, located in the heart of Zurich, within a 10-minute walk of ETH Zurich and Bahnhofstrasse. This hotel offers 56 guestrooms equipped with memory foam beds, premium bedding, minibars, and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi and private bathrooms with toiletries and hair dryers are also provided. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) served on weekdays. The hotel features convenient amenities such as concierge services, express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and on-site self-parking (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include the Swiss National Museum (0. 7 km) and Letzigrund Stadium (3. 8 km), with Zurich Airport (ZRH) just 11. 3 km away.

124326.description:
The Hotel Arte Spreitenbach is the ZFV Group's first self-check-in hotel, and offers a range of practical benefits. Conveniently located by a motorway junction and near Zurich Airport, the hotel offers free underground parking spaces for a comfortable arrival, whenever suits you best. The digital check-in counter means you can check in easily on your own. There are vending machines with drinks and snacks in the lobby, and there is also a small kiosk offering toiletries and other products for your stay.
It's the simple and practical way to stay at a hotel.

124327.description: The Sorell Hotel Sonnental, conveniently located near Zurich's airport and exhibition halls, offers over 100 stylishly furnished rooms and ample free parking. From casual dining to elegant meals, the hotel's restaurant caters to diverse tastes. Guests can also enjoy complimentary access to the spacious 300m² spa oasis. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Whether for business or leisure, the Sorell Hotel Sonnental provides a comfortable and convenient stay on the outskirts of Zurich.

124358.description: The hotel is located within the heart of Kalk Bay village and within walking distance of all restaurants, bars, shops and sandy and rocky beaches. Restaurants are speckled all along the main road along the shore catering for every taste. There are monuments attesting to the history of Kalk Bay, a variety of quaint home-owned stores far removed from the impersonal malls of the city. Down the road is the Historic Naval Base in Simon's Town resplendent with old pubs and seaside dining. Within 30 minutes is the Cape of Good Hope. Cape Town International Airport is approximately 35 km away. Lovingly restored in 2008, this is a 120-year-old grand house overlooking the picturesque Kalk Bay harbour. Almost all the hotel's 13 rooms offer unrivalled views over the sea and Kalk Bay harbour. Decorated in an understated, comfortable and uncluttered style, contemporary sea house luxury awaits guests, far from the cares of the world. Guests are welcomed into a lobby and the hotel has a hotel safe and breakfast room. There are conference facilities available to business guests and WLAN Internet access (fees apply). Guests can also take advantage of the hotel's room and laundry services. Those guests arriving by car may park their vehicles in the hotel's car park or garage (fees apply to the latter). All hotel rooms have an en suite bathroom with shower and hairdryer and are furnished with king-size beds and a flat screen TV with satellite/cable TV. Internet access is also available and a safe is provided.  The hotel has a beautiful outside swimming pool with deck, sun loungers and parasols where guests can relax and soak up the sun. Drinks are offered at the pool at an extra charge.

124390.description: The NH Buenos Aires 9 de Julio hotel is within easy walking distance of the main sites of the city, as it is located right on Avenida de 9 Julio. The famous Colón Theater is only steps away from the hotel, as are the boutique shops on Florida Street. You can reach Avenida de Mayo and the iconic Casa Rosada in five minutes on foot, while the financial and business districts are also easily accessible for business guests. NH Buenos Aires 9 de Julio has 175 rooms featuring neutral decor and hardwood floors. Each room comes with free Wi-Fi and many have lovely views over Avenida de 9 Julio. The hotel serves a delicious fresh buffet breakfast each morning. You can also enjoy the relaxed atmosphere of our restaurant while savoring dishes from our international menu. For a relaxing drink, you can head to our lobby bar or have it al fresco on the terrace. In the warmer months, guests have access to an outdoor pool, while the gym is open throughout the year. For business travelers, our lobby has work stations and the hotel has 3 meeting rooms for up to 120 people.

124407.description: One&Only Cape Town is a destination unto itself – an urban chic waterfront resort providing an unprecedented level of luxury in South Africa. In the heart of the picturesque Victoria & Alfred Waterfront with captivating views of Table Mountain, this contemporary resort features the largest accommodation in all of Cape Town, with a stylish island design and African flair accentuating the 131 spacious guest rooms and suites. Within the lobby of the seven-storey Marina Rise, guests can experience the continent's only restaurant by legendary chef Nobuyuki “Nobu” Matsuhisa, where the upper level Nobu bar features a selection of Sakes including plum wines, Japanese beer and a selection of Sake and Shochu based cocktails. Welcoming to both couples and families, Ochre, the new restaurant at One&Only Cape Town, offers a contemporary interpretation of age-old South African recipes. Bringing together a kaleidoscope of heritages to create a local menu of intriguing and enticing flavours. Amidst the energy of a bustling city, One&Only Spa occupies its own private island and offers many signature treatments. Guests looking for a relaxed, poolside setting can enjoy Isola, our outdoor restaurant.

124659.description: Sitting on the edge of Vienna's 16th district in a beautiful and green setting, this hotel is right on the city's public transportation system, making it an ideal base for tours of the city or business appointments in downtown Vienna (St. Stephen's Cathedral is less than 30 minutes away. Vienna Airport is roughly 30 km from the property. This hotel combines modern comforts with an ambience that is truly fit for royalty. The comfortably appointed rooms invite to spread out and relax high above the rooftops of Vienna. All accommodations feature a large choice of top-quality services, amenities to guarantee guests enjoy an unforgettable stay and incomparable panoramic views. Guests can enjoy excellent cuisine at the restaurant while enjoying one of the most beautiful views over Vienna.

name.content: Fairfield Inn By Marriott Manhattan Times Square

124699.description: The Fairfield Inn by Marriott New York Manhattan/Times Square puts you in the heart of New York, a short walk from Times Square and Broadway. This hotel is conveniently located near Madison Square Garden and the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and relax by the fireplace in the lobby. The hotel's 244 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and cable programming. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. You'll also find laptop-compatible safes, desks, and phones with free local calls. Start your day with the complimentary self-serve breakfast, available from 7:00 AM to 9:00 AM. For added convenience, the hotel offers a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, a 24-hour front desk, and on-site self-parking (subject to charges).

124717.description: The hotel is located in the historical Pera, Istanbul's shopping and entertainment centre. It is a 5- minute walk from the historical Galata Tower, Saint Antoine-Saint Maria Draparis Church and the world's oldest metro. Numerous shops, bars, night clubs and restaurants are located in the hotel's immediate vicinity. Links to public transport are within walking distance. This comfortable and convenient city hotel offers a relaxing and enjoyable stay in each of its 55 rooms. Some of the amenities available to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby with dining facilities and Internet access. All hotel rooms have an en-suite bathroom and are air-conditioned. Hotel guests can indulge in the Turkish bath and sauna or treat themselves to a massage. Atatürk International Airport and Sabiha Gokcen International Airport are located approximately 15 kms and 65 kms away, respectively.

124742.description: This modern hotel enjoys a great location in Athens. The hotel is located within easy access of a host of attractions in this mesmerising city. Guests will find themselves in the ideal setting from which to experience the essence of this captivating city. The hotel enjoys a style rich in traditional charm, yet has perfectly blended it with contemporary design. The interior is tastefully appointed, exuding an air of peace and serenity, seemingly miles away from the bustle which lies just outside. Visitors will appreciate the spacious, warm guest rooms, which offer a relaxing setting in which to unwind in comfort at the end of the day. The rooms feature modern amenities for guests' convenience. The hotel offers excellent facilities, meeting the needs of every type of traveller.

124797.address: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Blvd, PO Box 31166, 244
124797.description: This premium luxury hotel is located in the most fashionable heart of Dubai, overlooking the world's tallest tower, the Burj Khalifa. The hotel is connected to the Dubai Mall, which is one of the largest shopping and entertainment destinations in the world. The famous Jumeirah Mosque and the Dubai International Airport are less than 15 km away. It offers five unparalleled restaurants and lounges where guests can taste the finest cuisine, luxurious spa facilities where the visitors experience signature treatment, innovative shopping services, and convenient business equipment and conference facilities. The serene guestrooms feature the typical luxury, intelligent design combined with fluffy carpeting and first-class furnishings to stimulate a pleasant impression of majestic luxury. Each room has a luxurious, private bathroom with high class amenities. The visitors may contemplate the splendour of Burj Khalifa while sample refreshing beverages from the pool deck.

124798.description: The JW Marriott Hotel Marina offers luxury accommodation in Dubai's vibrant Marina district, a short drive from Dubai Marina Mall and The Beach Mall. Guests can enjoy a full-service spa with massages and body treatments, a health club, outdoor pool, and spa tub. The hotel's 200 guestrooms feature iPod docking stations, LCD TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Dining options include Mazina, specializing in international cuisine, a coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service. Two bars/lounges and a poolside bar offer refreshing drinks. A business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary airport shuttle are available.

124799.description: This cozy and comfortable hotel is located in the heart of Athens, in the scenic Plaka district, at the foot of the Acropolis. Situated in the city's business and commercial center, it's close to major corporate offices and banks. The surrounding area offers a variety of traditional Greek restaurants, open-air cafés, boutiques, and tavernas. The Syntagma and Acropolis metro stations are within a 5-minute walk. Established in 1976, this family-run hotel boasts many loyal guests. Its neoclassical style complements the neighborhood's charm, creating a relaxed and calm atmosphere. Guests can enjoy a delicious breakfast featuring jams, freshly baked breads and cakes, and juices.

124838.description:
Miiro Le Grand Hôtel Cayré is ideally located in Saint-Germain-des-Prés, just a short walk from the Musée d’Orsay, Le Bon Marché, and the Latin Quarter. The River Seine and the Louvre Museum are also within easy reach. Rue du Bac Metro Station is just 90 metres away, offering direct access to Saint-Lazare, Sacré-Cœur, and Porte de Versailles Exhibition Centre. 

Our air-conditioned rooms and suites feature complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen HDTV, espresso machine, mineral water on arrival, and a private bathroom. 

Start your day with our breakfast featuring local specialties at Annette Restaurant. For lunch and dinner, Annette offers seasonal French brasserie cuisine, while Officine Bac, our intimate speakeasy, invites you for a relaxed evening drink. Guests also have access to our fitness facilities with Norsk equipment.

124848.description: The hotel is in the heart of Milan, in the vicinity of the Porta Garibaldi, the fashionable Brera district and within easy reach of the FieraMilanoCity trade fair grounds. This elegant hotel offers a congress centre with facilities which will be appreciated by business travellers. Fully air-conditioned, it comprises a number of leisure amenities and services, making it an exceptional choice for holidaymakers. All rooms are en suite and equipped with Internet access. The refined restaurant features in the most important Italian and international food and restaurant guides and is available for lunch and dinner offering à la carte options.

124849.description: The hotel is strategically situated at just a 2-minute drive from the San Siro-Fiera exit on the West ring-road and close to the exhibition centres of Milano Fiera Rho and Milano Fiera City. The famous Giuseppe Meazza Stadium, home of AC Milan and Internazionale FC, is just 4km away and guests who want to reach the centre of the city can use the complimentary shuttle service of the venue to the Bisceglie M1 Station. Due to its location the hotel provides top of the line conference facilities including 2 modernly equipped, naturally lit, modular meeting rooms perfect for hosting all types of presentations and training. Also the well-appointed accommodation units come with comfortable work desks and there is WiFi internet access through the premises. When the time for dining comes guests can visit the onsite restaurant and try its classic Italian cuisine and elegant local wines.

124854.description:
Wonderfully situated in a 45, 000 m2 of landscaped greenery, this exceptional hotel can be found 30 minutes by train from Vienna and surrounded by a myriad of possible activities. Shopping City Süd shopping centre is just a few steps away, offering a great shopping opportunity and, apart from visiting the interesting and popular city of Vienna, guests can also visit other surrounding destinations such as the spa town of Baden. There are several types of guest rooms and suites available and all of them live up to the expectations of the today’s executive traveller, as they include a cosy sofa and a flat-screen TV. This modern accommodation includes a 3, 500m²-congress centre, as well as several restaurants and bars serving delicious food, which is ideal for a successful business event. 
City tax payable on the spot - 2, 50 eur per per person per night.

124862.address: Palmeraie, Near The Big Stadium of Marrakech, .
124862.description: This conference hotel lies just 10 km away from the city centre of Marrakech. The hotel is located within easy access of the many attractions that the culturally-rich city of Marrakech has to offer. Gueliz is located just a 12 minutes' driving distance away from the hotel. The hotel is conveniently located just 10 km away from Menara Airport. This hotel offers a haven of peace and tranquillity. Set amidst luxuriant greenery, the hotel exudes serenity and peace. The guest rooms provide functional space and modern amenities. The hotel's extensive range of facilities and services is sure to impress. Guests can take part in an aqua fit or an aerobics lesson, work out in the gym, or simply indulge in an invigorating spa treatment. The hotel offers first-class facilities for those travelling for work purposes.

124869.address: Kızılağaç Mahallesi Meydan Alanı Sokak No:56
124869.description: This resort is situated 2 km from the centre of Kizilagac, 13 km from Manavgat and its waterfalls, 15 km from Side with its amphitheatre, museum and Temple of Apollo, and 48 km from Aspendos Amphitheatre. The hotel is around an hour's drive from Antalya and approximately 70 km from Antalya Airport. This impressive modern facility consists of a main 5-storey building with 543 guest rooms. The spacious lobby area offers 24-hour reception and check-out services, and lift access to the upper floors. The family-friendly beach hotel offers a main restaurant and 3 à la carte restaurants as well as a choice of bars, and a disco. Further facilities include a hairdressing salon, games room, children's playground, kids' club, conference facilities, a car park, bicycle hire service and a small shopping centre. Wireless Internet access and room and laundry services are also offered for additional fees. Each room features an en suite bathroom with a bathtub. Amenities include a hairdryer, air conditioning and central heating, a double bed and a private balcony. Other in-room facilities consist of satellite TV with music channels, a safety deposit box, minibar, direct dial telephone, and a radio. There are 6 rooms for physically disabled guests.

124925.description: This stunning hotel is situated in the district of Bab Doukkala just a few steps from the castle of Pasha, the famous Jamaa el Fna Square and the Souks. It is the ideal base from which to visit the historic centres of Marrakech, and the district of Gueliz and Hevernage where multiple restaurants and shops are to be found. Golf lovers may find verdant golf course within just 6 km away. This historic establishment features air-conditioned and sumptuously decorated rooms. There is a patio surrounded with galleries and arches, and beautiful terraces with a view on the oldest mosque 'the Koutoubia' and the Atlas Mountains, from where one can admire magnificent sunsets. Travellers may relax on sun beds or have a dip in the swimming pool in gradations of green, offering coolness and tranquillity. This upscale hotel offers guests the chance to discover Moroccan gastronomic delights at the in-house restaurant. The hotel also has a 24-hour reception and private parking.

124962.address: Al Muteena Street, Deira, Dubai PO BOX 21969
124962.description: Abjad Crown Hotel is located in Deira, within walking distance from Al Ghurair Centre and Reef Mall. All of the spacious accommodations feature individually controlled air conditioning, satellite TV, mini-fridge, hairdryer, and IDD telephone. A safe-deposit box is available at the reception. The hotel offers 2 restaurants and several nightclubs that are located on the mezzanine floor. In-room dining is also available via room service. Major attractions in Dubai include the Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, Mall of the Emirates, Gold Souk, Madinat Souk, Dubai Museum, and the Palm Jumeirah. The Dubai Palm Hotel is approximately 10 minutes from Dubai International Airport.

name.content: Altis Avenida, member Preferred Hotels & Resorts

124963.description:
Experience the glamour of 1940s Portugal at the Altis Avenida, a boutique hotel in Lisbon's city center near Rossio and Restauradores squares. Its 118 rooms, including two suites, offer a sophisticated and glamorous atmosphere. The hotel features the panoramic Rossio Gastrobar on the 7th floor, serving a unique, seasonal menu created by chef João Correia, along with curated music and a DJ. 

The Lobby Bar is the ideal place for a break while visiting the city or for a
more casual meeting, right in the center of Lisbon. 

The hotel has one 50 m² meeting room, a Business Corner and free
access to WIFI is available throughout the hotel. 

 Enjoy convenient on-site parking with valet service. This hotel is Dog-Friendly (accepts only one pet per stay, up to 15 kg, for an additional fee).

124984.description: Set in a small noble residence, this 4-star boutique hotel offers a combination of an historic setting, rich classical design with modern comforts, and a central location in Venice. Enjoy spacious and luxuriously decorated rooms and suites. In-room amenities include free Wi-Fi internet access, year-round air conditioning and heating and satellite TV. The guests can relax with a drink on a small terrace and admire the view of the Grand Canal. They can take advantage of the hotel's meeting rooms, bar and internet point. The hotel features its own private dock so the guests can quickly arrive by private water taxi or gondola. Professional staff will assist guests with tours and area information.

124993.description: This apartment offers spacious apartments. It is located in the Providencia neighborhood of Santiago, one block from the station Pedro de Valdivia subway and close to many shops, restaurants and cultural activities. It offers accommodation with fully equipped kitchen, cable TV and safe. The hotel has a heated pool for clients and guests where they hold group classes, and a gym, both open from Monday to Friday from 7:00 am to 10:30 pm, Saturday, Sunday and holidays from 9:00 am to 10:00 pm. Free internet and parking are available free of charge (subject to availability). A buffet breakfast is served daily in the restaurant Neruda Hotel, located in the same building.

124994.description:
MR. Hotel (Ex Hotel Neruda) is a distinguished four-star hotel located in the heart of the Providencia neighborhood, one of the most attractive and dynamic areas of the city. Its privileged location allows easy access to various points of interest, being just an 18-minute walk from Costanera Center and MUT, one block from Pedro de Valdivia metro station, and approximately 40 kilometers from the nearest ski center. 
Its rooms stand out for their spaciousness and elegance, offering a modern and comfortable environment. They feature queen-size beds, air conditioning, heating, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, minibar, coffee set, and a safety deposit box. 
The hotel offers free Wi-Fi throughout its facilities, as well as private parking «subject to availability». It also includes a buffet breakfast service in the rate, a restaurant, and a gym with a fitness room and a heated swimming pool. 
The 24-hour front desk ensures continuous and personalized service, guaranteeing a comfortable stay and a high-quality experience.

124995.description: The MR Express (formerly Hotel Neruda Express), located near El Golf metro station, offers convenient access to Santiago's bustling business district and diverse dining scene. Each bright, comfortable room features air conditioning, heating, cable TV, a mini-fridge, and a safe. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and free parking (subject to availability). A buffet breakfast is served Monday through Friday from 7:00 am to 10:30 am, and until 11:00 am on weekends and holidays. The 24-hour reception desk is always available to assist guests with any needs during their stay. With 53 rooms across 11 floors, check-in is at 2:00 pm and check-out is at noon.

125018.description: This charming city hotel is situated in the centre of Athens in a quiet district on Syngrou Avenue, just behind the historic Agios Sostis Church. The business hotel is just 3 km, or a 10-minute ride on public transport, from the town centre and places of interest, such as the Acropolis, Plaka, Philopappos Monument and the New Acropolis Museum. There is a bus station just 100 m from the conference hotel, while the nearest metro station lies just 1. 2 km away. The beautifully appointed and well-equipped rooms offer a haven of peace and tranquillity in which to totally loosen up at the end of the day. Visitors may energize their day with delectable breakfast served at the enchanting hotel restaurant. Corporate travellers may avail for the versatile business centre and meeting rooms, ideal to host a conference or a special event. There is also a snug hotel bar where guests may enjoy a drink and while away in a carefree atmosphere.

name.content: Hôtel De France Gare de Lyon Bastille

125024.description: Situated near Lyon train station, in the vibrant Bastille-Marais district of Paris, this air-conditioned hotel offers comfortable and affordable accommodations. The 42 guest rooms, suitable for 1 to 4 persons, provide amenities such as an alarm clock, small desk, double-glazed windows, TV with Canal+, internet access, and telephone. Each en suite room includes a shower, double bed, air conditioning, and central heating. Hairdryers are available at reception. Guests can enjoy a daily breakfast buffet and benefit from the convenience of a 24-hour reception and lift access.

125103.address: The Green Business Park, Dog Kennel Lane
125103.description:
Village Solihull is just off the A34, one of the main roads into the city and well connected to the M42 at Junction 4 and M40, meaning you are just a short drive from historic towns like Stratford-upon-Avon, Warwick and Leamington Spa. The hotel is located in peaceful surroundings yet less than 10 miles from Birmingham city centre, 9 miles from Birmingham International Airport and under 2 miles from Shirley train station. 

The hotel has everything you'd need under one roof including new look, fully refurbished bedrooms with big cosy beds, huge TVs and great showers, pool and state-of-the-art gym with all the latest tech and Village Pub and Grill where you can tuck into delicious food and drink. 

Access to Leisure facilities is charged at £5 per day per room. Club Room guests receive free access. 

Parking charges apply Monday - Sunday, 24 hours a day
Parking is free for up to 4 hours Monday - Sunday
Parking is charged at £10. 00 for 24 hours then £10. 00 per day thereafter Monday - Thursday
Parking is charged at £5. 00 for 24 hours then £5. 00 per day thereafter Friday - Sunday

 Club Room guests park free for the duration of their stay.

125142.description: This modern, family-friendly holiday hotel offers an outdoor pool with slides, various sports facilities and fitness amenities. In addition, there is a football center. The wide sandy beach can be reached in less than 5 minutes, the shops and restaurants of Kumköy are within a short walk. The historic town of Side with its ancient sites such as the spectacular Temple of Apollo is just a short drive away.

125158.description: The attractive hotel Club Kastalia enjoys an excellent location directly on the sand and gravel beach and the shimmering waters of the Mediterranean Sea in the Konakli area of the renowned holiday region of the Turkish Riviera. The centre of Alanya with its shopping venues and entertainment spots as well as its historical sites such as the Castle or the Red Tower is at a distance of 12 km; the international airport of Antalya is about 113 km away. The hotel is a popular choice amongst sports enthusiasts, especially beach volleyball players, as its 16 professional beach volleyball courts attract teams from all over Europe to make the hotel their training camp. Other sports facilities include professional clay tennis courts and archery. After a long day of practising, guests may use the Turkish bath. Families with children will love the pool area, the mini club and the aquapark, with a water playground and waterslides.

125197.description:
Located in the heart of Sultanahmet, Hotel Saint Sophia Istanbul is steps away from the Hagia Sophia Mosque in Istanbul's historic city center. Other historical landmarks, including Topkapi Palace, the Blue Mosque, and the Basilica Cistern, are within a 3-minute walk. Originally an Ottoman mansion, the hotel was restored and opened in 1999, then renovated and reopened in October 2013. Rooms range from 19 to 28 square meters and feature Bianco Carrara marble bathrooms and Bvlgari amenities. The hotel offers 26 rooms: 12 Superior, 10 Deluxe, and 4 Grand Deluxe. Room amenities include L'Occitane Bvlgari toiletries, a pillow menu, luxury linens, air conditioning, a Tchibo coffee machine, a kettle and tea set, hardwood floors, a work desk with a lamp, a rain shower, bathrobes, complimentary bottled water, and a free minibar. After breakfast, consult our concierge team for recommendations and assistance with any requests. We are at your service 24/7, catering to both leisure and business travelers with easy access to trams, ferries, and the metro. For a quiet respite, visit our Sophia Pita Lounge. Enjoy tea or coffee overlooking the Basilica Cistern and Hagia Sophia, or relax in our tranquil interior courtyard. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, including the lobby. 

Please be informed that food service in our restaurant is available until 3:00 PM. After this time, only beverage service will be available.

125231.description: 'This luxurious aparthotel is set amidst 265 acres of lush green fairways, landscaped gardens and lakes. The complex offers discerning travelers the perfect getaway in which they can relax and unwind or enjoy a spot of golf. Dubai International Airport is just 25 kms away from the complex. The hotel exudes Arabian regal beauty and guests are welcomed into a world of striking style and design wrapped in traditional hospitality for which the country is renowned. The elegant guest rooms feature lavish furnishings, exuding luxury and serenity. The complex offers guests exemplary leisure and dining amenities including a Spa where guests can indulge in rejuvenating treatments. Guests are invited to dine in style in the hotel's award-winning restaurant where they can enjoy tantalising tastes that are sure to captivate even the most discerning palate. '*

125239.address: Kucuk Ayasofya Mahallesi Su Terazisi Sokak, 26
125239.description: The Dara Hotel offers modern accommodations with a rooftop terrace and stunning views of Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district and the Marmara Sea. Guests enjoy free Wi-Fi and a 24-hour front desk with a tour desk for convenient travel arrangements. The soundproofed rooms feature white-washed walls, hardwood floors, air conditioning, and flat-screen satellite TVs. Private bathrooms include hairdryers and complimentary slippers. Start your day with a delicious Turkish and international breakfast at the hotel restaurant while enjoying scenic views of the Marmara Sea and Sokollu Mehmet Pasha Mosque. The bar offers local drinks and spirits. The hotel is conveniently located within a 5-minute walk of Topkapi Palace and Hagia Sophia. The multilingual staff is available to assist with booking excursions and airport transportation.

125240.description: Located in one of Istanbul's oldest districts, Fors Hotel offers a base for exploring the historic peninsula. The hotel offers a variety of air-conditioned single, double, twin, and triple rooms, each equipped with a private bathroom, television, and free Wi-Fi. For convenience, the property offers a 24-hour reception, room service, and airport shuttles can be arranged for an additional fee. The hotel is located approximately 500 meters from the city center and a 12-minute walk from the Blue Mosque.

125241.address: SULTANAHMET MAH OGUL SOK no 8 FATIH, 8
125241.description: The Timeks Suite & Hotel is ideally located within walking distance of iconic attractions such as the Sultanahmet Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, and the Grand Bazaar. Our building houses twelve rooms, each with a private bathroom. We offer six double rooms and six family rooms, designed to provide a comfortable, home-like atmosphere. We are dedicated to helping our guests enjoy their vacation.

125243.description: This charming property enjoys an amazing location in the centre of Istanbul. There are numerous restaurants, bars, clubs and shopping opportunities nearby. Istanbul Airport is about 22 km and Sabiha Gokcen Airport about 65 km from the hotel. The design hotel was fully renovated in 2009 and comprises a total of 22 stylish rooms all prepared to ensure a comfortable stay. Guests are welcomed to take advantage of the services offered. All accommodation units were recently renovated and come equipped with new, stylish furniture and amenities such as LCD satellite TV, free WLAN Internet access. Non-smoking rooms are also available.

125245.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, our hotel offers high-quality service and a welcoming atmosphere. Enjoy a daily open buffet breakfast in our dining room or the privacy of your own room. Explore local restaurants, bars, and cafes just a short two-minute walk away. Our hotel provides laundry and room service for your convenience, along with a charming patio for relaxation. Each room features warm wood furnishings, air conditioning, a minibar, and an LCD TV with satellite channels. Private bathrooms include a hairdryer, complimentary toiletries, and slippers.

125250.description: Located on a peninsula overlooking its own bay, the hotel is approximately 2. 5 kms from the local points of interest at Avsallar. Public transport is available at the main road, which is about 500 m from the hotel. This air-conditioned beach hotel comprises all facilities expected for a high-class accommodation. Guests will find the rooms stylishly arranged, and provided with air- conditioning and a balcony or terrace. For the little ones the hotel has a mini club, and for other guests there are a number of recreational facilities to choose from. For relaxation there is the steam room and sauna with massage treatments available, as are the 3 swimming pools. Sports facilities and an entertainment programme for adults and children are available. Some facilities are shared with the property's sister hotel.

125251.description: Surrounded by pines, ROBINSON Camyuva faces the Mediterranean in a scenic location at the foot of the Taurus Mountains. The resort features a private beach, extensive sporting facilities and a spa. Opening out onto private balconies, air-conditioned rooms at ROBINSON Camyuva are decorated with tile floors and wooden furnishings. They are equipped with satellite TV channels and include private bathrooms with hairdryer. Guests can enjoy traditional Turkish specialties from Antalya Province, served at the restaurant of the hotel. In house WellFit Spa features a modern gym, various face and body treatments with extra charge, and a sauna area. Sports facilities at the Robinson Club hotel include 12 tennis courts, and diving equipment and an archery range are also available at an extra charge. Popular nearby attractions include the coastal Kemer, a 12-minute drive away and the pristine village of Çıralı, where treks for the Lycian Way depart. Free private parking is available on site.

125254.description: Welcome to Numa Port Hotel, your luxurious getaway in the heart of Alanya. Our hotel offers guests an unforgettable experience with its unbeatable location, modern amenities, and exceptional service. We feature 58 modern rooms, each designed to provide you with the utmost comfort and convenience. All of our rooms come equipped with air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, LED screen TV, and a minibar. Our guests also have access to 24-hour room service, ensuring that your every need is met. . Our bed and breakfast concept ensures that our guests wake up to a delicious breakfast buffet, featuring a variety of options to suit every palate. We take pride in our exceptional dining experiences. Our Lobby Bar offers a wide selection of cocktails, wines, and snacks for you to enjoy while taking in the stunning views of the port. Our hotel features a stunning view of the Alanya port and Red Tower.

125300.description: This comfortable hotel is just 1km from Milan's city center, making it an excellent choice for leisure and business travelers. The nearest metro and tram stop, a mere 50 meters away, provides direct access to the Duomo, Brera district, and Navigli Canal. Milano Centrale Train Station, a 5-minute walk from the hotel, connects to all three of the city's airports. The light-filled rooms are meticulously furnished and offer amenities such as large-screen TVs and comfortable beds for a relaxing stay. Business travelers can utilize the spacious hall and conference room, while the elegant bar invites all guests to unwind with exquisite cocktails.

125310.description: Occupying a renovated modernist building, the hotel is located in the heart of the Gothic Quarter of Barcelona, by the Cathedral, Plaça Sant Jaume and the unavoidable Portal de l'Àngel, a few metres from the famous Ramblas and Plaza Catalunya. Shopping venues, the bus and railway station, and the best nightspots are a few minutes' walk away. The building has a historic facade built in 1910 and its balconies with modernist motifs blend in with the streets of the Gothic city of Barcelona. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a pet deposit.

125331.description: Nestled between the vibrant Atlantic Seaboard and Table Mountain, the city hotel is ideally situated opposite Cape Town's International Convention Centre, minutes away from the famous V and A Waterfront and all main tourist attractions. Furthermore, the hotel is suitably positioned about 20 km from Cape Town International Airport and within walking distance of all major offices and shopping centres. This modern and relaxed setting compliments a unique experience whereby the staff pride themselves by ensuring superlative service and taste with a disciplined attention to detail. Furthermore, all the 170 elegantly appointed, fully equipped spacious rooms, feature spectacular views of either Table Mountain or Table Bay. Facilities available to guests include a 24-hour check-out service, lift access, a café and restaurant, room and laundry services, and a car park. All rooms feature a remote control TV with selected channels, air conditioning, an electronic door lock and an en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub, full bathroom amenities and hairdryer. Other in-room amenities include tea and coffee making facilities, an iron and ironing board on request, direct dial telephone, Internet access, safe and fridge.

name.content: Melia Desert Palm Member of Melia Collection

125336.description: Nestled within a 64-hectare polo estate and lush greenery, this exclusive boutique resort epitomises the fusion of Latin and UAE cultures, honouring the equestrian spirit. A mere 20 km from downtown Dubai, this 5-star hotel offers exceptional facilities, signature design and a team devoted to providing a personalised stay for each guest. The resort boasts spacious suites and cosy villas with private pools in a modern equestrian style and views of the natural surroundings. You'll love the art collection and avant-garde Arabian aesthetic in every corner. Meliá Desert Palm Meliá Collection offers fine dining spaces overlooking the polo field and Dubai's skyline. The hotel features a wellness area where you can relax and connect with your inner self or loved ones.

125353.description: Located within easy access of the city of the centre, as well as the many attractions for which it is renowned, this establishment is the ideal choice for every type of traveller. As part of a terrace of houses, the property oozes tradition and charm. Occupying a Victorian building, this property offers visitors an insight into the rich history of the area. The guest rooms are charming, tastefully designed and well equipped with modern amenities. Excellent facilities and services are offered to enhance each stay at this property. Professional, friendly staff are on hand to ensure that guests' needs are fully met. The hotel kept the traditional look, property has no AC or lift, every room comes with a fan, kettle and fridge. The bunkbeds and single bed configuration can not be guaranteed. There is no rate difference and the configuration is upon request subject to availability.

125377.description: Located in the exclusive elegant neighbourhood of La Recoleta, within walking distance of the Financial and Commercial centre of Buenos Aires and surrounded by the best gastronomic and leisure area of the city. Louis XV furniture and delicate inlaid Queen Anne style, combined with sophisticated facilities to blend classic design style and luxury. The hotel features a lobby with 24 hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange and lift. Additional facilities include a café, bar and restaurant as well as free wireless Internet, room service and laundry.

125379.address: Esentepe M. Ahu Unal Aysal Cad.Antalya, 1
125379.description: Located on the beach in Goynuk, the family-friendly hotel is just 9 km from the popular resort of Kemer, where guests will find shops, restaurants and nightlife, and approximately 35 km from the city of Antalya. The Taurus Mountains form a scenic backdrop and the area is rich in pine forests reaching down to the sea. Public transport is available from outside the hotel. Built in 2009, the air-conditioned beach establishment is decorated in an opulent style and offers 394 rooms and 46 villas. Business travellers may take advantage of the conference rooms and WLAN Internet access. The hotel provides a wide range of sport and leisure facilities on-site, including an exceptional SPA centre with a special Ottoman concept.

125381.address: Fulya Mh. Ortaklar Cd. No:30 Mecidiyekoy/Sisli, 30
125381.description: Stylishly decorated with a modern interpretation of 1950s style, this 4-star hotel is conveniently located in Sisli just 700 metres from Cevahir Shopping Centre, offering easy access to business districts Gayrettepe, Levent and Maslak. You will find the metro station 200 metres from the hotel which is connected to popular areas such as Taksim Sqaure and historical parts of the city. Free WiFi and panoramic Istanbul views are featured in each room of this pet-friendly hotel. Zorlu Centre is just one metro stop away and Trump Towers is a short walk away. Famous fashion and entertainment area Nisantasi is 2 km away with many luxury shops, restaurants and cafés. Free on-site parking is offered. 24-hour taxi stand is available nearby. Numerous shops and 4 different malls are within a 5-minute walk from the hotel. Istanbul Airport is 49 km away.

name.content: Hilton Club West 57th Street New York

125388.description:
**Elevator Upgrades: An elevator system upgrade is currently underway and is scheduled to continue through January 2026. During this time, one elevator car will be operational. **
Due to the current travel environment, this hotel is currently not accepting guests for a short period. Reservations are available for future dates. Please see below for up-to-date policy information and ways to contact Hilton Guest Assistance. We look forward to welcoming you to the hotel soon. West 57th Street by Hilton Grand Vacations recently received the AAA Inspector's Best of Housekeeping Award which recognizes AAA Inspected & Approved hotels that receive the highest possible cleanliness and condition scores that puts us in the top 25% of all 27, 000 AAA Inspected & Approved hotels. West 57th Street by Hilton Club is located in the heart of midtown Manhattan, between 6th and 7th Avenue, only a few doors down from Carnegie Hall and 2 blocks South of Central park.
