Under new ownership, our revamped rooms, sensational amenities, and a location that embraces the very soul of the city, your New York adventure starts the moment you step through our doors. Don't just visit the city – become a part of it. Book your stay today and unlock the best that NYC has to offer!

125417.description: Located near Twickenham Stadium, the upscale Radisson RED London Twickenham offers convenient access to Hampton Court Palace (8. 8 km) and Stamford Bridge Stadium (13 km). Guests can enjoy an indoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. The hotel provides 156 air-conditioned guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, phones, safes, and desks. Dining options include 22 South Restaurant with a bar/lounge and 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. Additional amenities include a business center, express check-out, complimentary newspapers, and event facilities. Self-parking is available (charges apply).

name.content: Galleria Vik Milano - Townhouse Galleria - SLH

125428.description: Welcome to Galleria Vik Milano – Townhouse Galleria where we offer our guests:• Historical Monument Living: Galleria Vik Milano is within one of Italy’s most iconic landmarks. • Singular Design: Each room is a design and architectural surprise! Each floor and room offer a new experience. • Original & Diverse Artwork & Furnishings: Galleria Vik Milano is home to an extensive collection of art by over 100 artists and design furniture. • Unique Views: Chose spectacular views into Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, some sweeping all the way to Duomo Square, or Scala Square or Via Silvio Pellico, as well as into the charming courtyards of the Galleria. • Shopping: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II is home to most of the celebrated fashion brands in the world including the original Prada!• Epicurean: Vik Pellico Otto, our signature restaurant overlooking the Octagono dome of the Galleria, gives our guests a birds’ eye view of life in the heart of Milano is open for breakfast, lunch, aperitivos and dinner. Il Dodici Gatti, located on the 6th floor above the structure of the Galleria with a terrace and views out over the cityscape of Milan is a favorite Italian pizzeria of the Milanese. • Personalized Service: Our team will treat you like our friends, like guests staying in our home. Use your mobile phone to communicate with them inside the hotel or wherever you are in Milan by What’s App or text messages. • We offer a virtual check-in and check-out, so you won’t waste a minute in Milan!

125430.description: Perched in rich in historical and cultural heritage Austrian capital, Vienna, this fabulous establishment reveals itself within a well-manicured garden. Set within a 2-minute walk from the impressive Belvedere Palace and the main city railway station, the hotel is an optimal choice for a business travel, romantic escape or weekend gateway. Guests will be enchanted by smart design featuring modern furniture and a fantastic combination of vibrant tones. This magnificent hotel boasts a wide range of spacious and luxurious suites. Each of them was carefully designed and fitted with cutting edge amenities. Guests can unwind after a long day of meetings with a workout at the well-equipped fitness centre. Every morning, patrons may indulge in a generous and flavourful buffet-style breakfast for a great start to the day. In addition, visitors arriving by car may make use of the on-site garage.

name.content: Radisson Blu Le Vendome Hotel, Cape Town

125432.description: This elegant hotel boasts a fantastic position just 50 metres from the ocean promenade and a short drive away from the city centre. Points of interest within close proximity of the hotel includes the popular Victoria and Alfred Waterfront and Table Mountain National Park. The establishment is situated in the Sea Point suburb, where adventurous travellers will find plenty of nightlife, upmarket bars, boutique shops and prevalent restaurants. Visitors will be able to enjoy their stay at this hotel, as it offers old world decor and fully equipped guest rooms and suites. Guests will be able to keep updated thanks to the complimentary fast wireless internet connection and the Radisson Blu One Touch mobile app. Visitors will enjoy the exquisite dishes served at the on-site restaurants and will be able to relax at the outdoor swimming pool and bar. The hotel offers a wake-up call on request should you choose to make use of the on-site fitness facilities. Business travellers might also appreciate the convenient business centre and large meeting rooms.

125448.description: Lancaster House is an all-suite, seven-story, modern-shick hotel in northern Bogota. It is located in the upscale neighborhood of Chico-Navarra, near major business, commercial and residential districts, and only 30 minutes from the International Airport. The hotel offers 55 very ample suites ranging from 500 to 900 square feet. There are 45 Junior Suites with one bedroom and one bathroom, and 10 Master Suites with two bedrooms and two bathrooms. Suites on the second floor offer an outdoor private terrace as well. All suites feature a living room that includes sofa-beds, LCD's, Home Theaters, dining room and full kitchen. For your convenience, suites offer complimentary Wi-Fi, international Satellite TV channels, mini-bar, direct dial, and a safety box. The hotel has 2 restaurants. Gatsby Restaurant offers in a classic ambiance international cuisine and monthly culinary festival. Kosher meals are available upon request. Eclectic Bistro 106 serves light fare meals, and aromatic cups of Colombian coffee. The Chimney Bar features international cocktails, and live music. We also feature a business center; 7 conference rooms ideal to host business and social events. A newly renewed and expanded fitness center contains cardiovascular, weight-training equipment, as well as a new hot tub with solarium, sauna, and massage rooms. Other services provided by the hotel include 24-hour room service, concierge desk, Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, underground parking, 24/7 security surveillance, and transportation. Pets are welcome. Lancaster House is ideal for families, business guests and others needing extra space; as well as for those who need extended stay services. Special discounts for groups as well as monthly rates are available.

name.content: Tui Blue Side Hotel Adult Only +16

125477.description: The spa complex is located on a long, sandy beach which runs for miles and reaches the peninsula where the old historical town of Side is located, approximately 8 km away. Local amenities, with restaurants, bars and shops, are close by in Kumkoy and local transport is available on the doorstep with links to nearby towns. Attractions in Side include the amphitheatre, museum and Temple of Apollo. Manavgat Waterfalls are approximately 13 km from the club resort and Aspendos amphitheatre is around 18 km away. Antalya airport is roughly 50 km from the hotel. This newly built hotel with modern architecture features contemporary furniture and decor. The grounds have an ornamental garden and water features as well as a large outdoor pool area and terrace, all of which lead down to the hotel's fine, sandy beach. Facilities include the main restaurant with open terrace and a couple of a la carte restaurants and there is a choice of bars. The air-conditioned establishment offers 237 rooms in total and welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and lift access to the upper floors. Guests may also take advantage of the hairdressing salon, TV lounge, conference facilities, wireless Internet access and a laundry service (fees apply). The rooms are modern and well-furnished and equipped with centrally controlled air conditioning, a mini bar, tea and coffee facilities and a hire safe box. In addition, they have Internet access, a TV and a direct dial telephone. An en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub and hairdryer, and a private balcony or terrace also feature in all rooms as standard.

125529.description: Located in the vibrant heart of Barbès, Paris, the Best Western The Playce Hotel offers a welcoming and playful atmosphere. Natural light highlights the wooden décor, creating a warm and inviting lobby. Throughout the day, this versatile space transforms from a breakfast area to a library and coffee corner. True to its name, The Playce Hotel features entertaining amenities such as foosball, arcade games, and a PlayStation®. Whether traveling for business or leisure, guests will appreciate the fully air-conditioned rooms, Wi-Fi access, and a well-equipped meeting room. The hotel is within walking distance of Montmartre, the Sacré-Cœur Basilica, and the Moulin Rouge. Conveniently located near two major metro lines (4 & 12), it provides easy access to attractions like the Louvre Museum and the Opera House. Charles de Gaulle Airport is a 20-minute taxi ride away, and exhibition centers such as Le Bourget and Porte de Versailles are easily accessible by public transport.

125558.description: Located in the heart of the Garden Route, this hotel is uniquely positioned on the rocks below Mossel Bay's famous St Blaize Lighthouse. The air-conditioned hotel offers 52 sea-facing rooms, a lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom and lift access. Further facilities at the hotel include a restaurant which offers stunning views over the sea and rocks, with à la carte menu, as well as set menus and buffets available for functions and special occasions. Furthermore, the hotel offers a bar, conference facilities, WLAN Internet access (for a fee), room and laundry services (both for a fee) and a car park. The en suite rooms, each with a private balcony which guarantees stunning sea views over the Indian Ocean, are spacious and well-appointed with modern light furnishings. The bathrooms are fitted with shower, bath and hairdryer. Each room also has a seating area. Furnishings include a desk, bedside reading lamps, satellite/cable television, individually regulated panel heater, remote controlled ceiling fan, international plug points, radio alarm, safe and coffee and tea making facilities. Built-in wardrobes, luggage storage area, direct dial telephones, double beds and an ironing set, as well as WLAN Internet access, all additionally feature as standard. A huge outdoor tidal pool in front of the hotel offers safe bathing. Guests may also go surfing. Breakfast buffet is served each morning, whilst lunch and dinner are offered à la carte.

125568.description: The hotel enjoys a beachfront location on the lovely coast of Belek, just 2 km from the resort centre with its restaurants, bars and shopping venues. Set in large, well-maintained grounds, the resort consists of a main building with a variety of room types and low-rise bungalows . Standard rooms are located in the village part of the complex and have a balcony or terrace. A wide range of activities is available to be enjoyed on the premises. The hotel takes pride in its impressive aqua park set close to the beach, with a number of slides in addition to a children's section, activity pool and a quiet pool. Guests can take advantage of a variety of evening entertainment options, including an , while younger ones can enjoy the hotel's kids' entertainment programme.

125572.description: The hotel is located in resort of Kemer, just 1 km from the beach. The town centre is in the immediate vicinity, where a broad range of shopping and entertaining venues are easily accessible. The nearest bus stop is about 30 m from the hotel and Antalya Airport is approximately 60 km away. The hotel comprises a total of 62 rooms. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with a 24-hour reception, a TV lounge and currency exchange facilities. Further amenities include air-conditioning, a restaurant and conference facilities. Hotel rooms are well furnished and fully-equipped as standard featuring a satellite/cable TV, a safe and a minibar. Moreover, each room has its own balcony or terrace. Leisure facilities include an outdoor swimming pool, a gym and a sauna. Table tennis and pool/snooker are also on offer.

125626.description: Situated near the Eiffel Tower and the charming early 20th-century district, this hotel offers a prime location for both leisure and business travelers. Just a short metro ride from Porte de Versailles, Place du Trocadéro, and Quai Branly, it's also convenient for exploring the city's cultural attractions. The Sèvres-Lecourbe metro station is easily accessible, and the vibrant Rue du Commerce, with its array of restaurants, bars, and shops, is close by. The hotel features beautifully illuminated rooms and suites, each boasting a romantic view of the Eiffel Tower and modern design elements. All rooms include a private bathroom with a hydromassage shower and fiber optic lighting. Guests can also enjoy massages, a sauna, and various spa treatments.

125627.description: This hotel is near some of Paris's most fascinating cultural sites, and only a short stroll from Rue du Faubourg Saint Honoré, also known as one of the world's most luxurious shopping streets. Public transportation links are but a few short steps away. With its Haussmann-style facade, the hotel is considered a traditional Parisian property. The hotel features a TV lounge, bar, breakfast room, Internet access and room and laundry services.

125644.address: Cnr of Parliament and Longmarket St, 117
125644.description: Situated in Cape Town's historic heart, this art deco hotel, once the 1930s headquarters of American Swiss, is surrounded by architectural gems like Greenmarket Square and the Castle of Good Hope. The beautifully renovated building offers stylish, comfortable rooms, each individually decorated, and a rooftop relaxation area. The lobby provides a range of services for a pleasant stay. The front desk is available 24/7, and secure parking is offered for 70 ZAR per night. Entertainment is a short walk away, and a city sightseeing bus stop is just 0. 20 km from the hotel.

125651.description: Located in Milan, 1. 2 km from Villa Necchi Campiglio, TownHouse 33 offers rooms with garden views and free WiFi. At this 4-star hotel, each accommodation has city views, and guests can enjoy a garden and a bar. The property provides room service, concierge service and luggage storage for guests. This hotel offers guests air-conditioned rooms with a desk, an electric kettle, a minibar and a safe. There is also a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a bidet. At TownHouse 33, rooms include linens and towels. A buffet, continental or Italian breakfast is available at the property. Staff at the 24-hour front desk speak German, English, Italian and Filipino, and are always at your disposal. San Babila Metro Station is 1. 5 km from this property, while GAM Milano is 1. 4 km from the property. Milan Linate Airport is 6 km away.

name.content: Rixos Park Belek  L.O.L Theme Park Free Access

125697.description: Set in large, well- maintained grounds, the resort consists of a main building with a variety of room types and low-rise bungalow villas built in a Moroccan style. A total of 368 guest rooms are on offer. With a wide range of activities available, the hotel's main attraction is its impressive aqua park, set close to the beach, with a number of slides. The hotel's SPA facilities include a variety of massage and beauty treatments. There are a number of pools to choose from and refreshments are served at the poolside snack bar. Sun lounges and parasols are laid out at the hotel and on the sandy beach for use. It is approximately 3 km from Belek where guests can find a great choice of golf courses. Complimentary roundtrip shuttle to The Land Of Legends Theme Park (LOL)• VIP entrance to the park from special gate• A Great Opportunity to Experience Spectacular Night Shows and a Unique Setting of an Open-Air Shopping Conditions:• Guests will enjoy unlimited free access to The Land of Legends Theme Park. • Hotel – Park – Hotel transfers shuttles during the day free of charge. Please contact guest relations for shuttle times. • The All Inclusive – All Exclusive concept is available only in Rixos Park Belek only, not valid for the park. • Some services, food & beverages in The Land of Legends Theme Park are subject to a charge. • Theme Park opening and closing dates are subject to change through The Land of Legends Management. • Land of Legends Theme Park Aqualand does not operate in winter season. • Operation days of theme park may be changed or cancelled depending on weather conditions. • Depending on seasonal and operational conditions the operational status of our units may change

125698.description: Overlooking the Mediterranean's sandy beach, this family-friendly hotel is just 5 km from historic Side. Many of the balconied rooms offer stunning views of the Gulf of Antalya. With a dedicated children's entertainment program and nightly entertainment complex, it's an ideal family getaway. The hotel provides convenient direct bus service from the airport, approximately a one-hour journey (70 km). Guests can relax and enjoy quality time together amidst beautiful natural surroundings. The fully renovated club boasts a main bar with breathtaking sea views and a lively atmosphere. Children can also enjoy swimming lessons in the children's pool or at the beach.

125699.description: Located just 7 meters from the town center, the Robinson Nobilis offers easy access to all this destination has to offer. Guests are a short walk from the nearest golf course and transport links. The beach is just 150 meters away, while the airport is 40 km away. Completely renovated in 2012, this hotel features 404 welcoming rooms, providing a perfect place to relax. The hotel offers Wi-Fi, a 24-hour reception, accessible rooms, and parking. Guests can also enjoy on-site health and wellness services, dining options, entertainment, and a variety of sports and activities. Business facilities are also available. Note that some services may incur extra charges.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Cape Town City Centre

125718.description: Take in Table Mountain views from the high-rise Holiday Inn Express Cape Town-City Centre hotel, conveniently located in the heart of the city's business district. It's just a 15 minute drive from Cape Town International Airport to our lively downtown location, set on a tree-lined street packed with restaurants, art galleries, markets, cafes and bars. Exploring Cape Town is made easy, with our close proximity to all major public transport lines, including the popular City Sightseeing Red Busses. For our business travelers, we are ideally located in Cape Town's business district, placing government offices, major companies and the Cape Town International Convention Centre (CTICC) on your doorstep. Our 24-hour complimentary high-speed wi-fi ensures that you stay connected. Invite your colleagues for a meeting in one of our two air-conditioned meeting rooms or make use of our 24 hour business centre. Take in the splendor of Cape Town, from the nearby V&A Waterfront and Two Oceans Aquarium to Table Mountain, one of the official New7Wonders of Nature, and the only one to be located in an urban area, making it highly accessible. Our friendly staff will gladly advise of numerous excursions in and around Cape Town. Kick-start your day with a complimentary Express Start buffet breakfast in our vibrant Great Room, and unwind in the evenings on our decked terrace with a chilled glass of South African wine.

125791.description: This hotel boasts a strategic setting at the heart of the Miraflores District of Lima. The hotel is set amidst the financial, entertainment and commercial area of the city. The city centre is just a 20 minutes' driving distance away. The hotel lies just a 15 minutes' bus journey away from the beach in Costa Verde. The hotel lies just a few steps away from the main avenue of Miraflores, where a wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment venues can be found. Guests are greeted with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms provide a relaxing space, in which to work and rest in comfort. Guests can enjoy a wonderful breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to work or explore the city.

name.content: Marriott Vacation Club Pulse, New York City

125792.description: Centrally located in New York City, the Marriott Vacation Club Pulse is within a 10-minute walk of the Empire State Building and Bryant Park. This upscale hotel is also conveniently close to Broadway and Times Square. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. The 177 guestrooms feature refrigerators, iPod docking stations, flat-screen TVs with digital programming, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Guests can also relax with a drink at one of the hotel's two bars/lounges. Additional amenities include a business center and dry cleaning/laundry services.

125821.description: This aparthotel is located in the heart of Milan, just a short walk from the Naviglio Grande canal. Key attractions like the Duomo Cathedral and Square (1. 5 km), Galleria Vittorio Emanuele, La Scala Theatre, the Montenapoleone fashion district, and Da Vinci's Last Supper (2 km) are easily accessible. The Rho Fiera Exhibition Centre is 20 km away, Linate Airport is 9 km, and Malpensa Airport is 46 km from the property. The hotel offers 12 comfortable studios, accommodating 2 to 5 people. Combining comfort and design, each studio features harmonious materials, creating a warm and intimate atmosphere. All studios are situated on the first floor of a charming 1970s building. Guests enjoy amenities such as a lobby, lift, café, bar, pub, free Wi-Fi, and a self-service laundry. Each stylishly decorated apartment features a private bathroom with a bathtub, a double or twin beds, a TV, and a kitchenette equipped with a fridge and microwave. Ironing facilities and individually controlled air conditioning and heating are standard. Please note, this is a non-smoking property, and pets are not allowed. Metropark Porta Genova (open 24 hours) and the Porta Genova MM2 metro stop are both 500 meters away. Check-in is from 2 pm to 9 pm, and arrangements must be made 24 hours in advance.

125831.description: Hotel Villa Braida is set in an aristocratic Venetian manor in Mogliano Veneto, city of art, ideal for holidays and meetings. The hotel is also near to Venice and Treviso. Villa Braida offers a stay in the quiet Venetian countryside. The premises feature spacious traditional Venetian interiors, with exclusive Italian Renaissance furniture and upholstery. Suites and Deluxe rooms are located in the main building, overlooking the paddock and recalling ancient atmospheres. Enjoy a really exclusive stay among Renaissance style fabrics. Villa Braida also offers modern accommodations in the annex building with elevator, where 34 comfortable rooms are located. All rooms offer free WiFi and satellite TV. Hotel Villa Braidas staff speaks: English, French, German and Spanish.

125837.description:
Cheval Harrington Court in South Kensington presents is ideally located just a two-minute walk from South Kensington Tube Station. Guests benefit from complimentary WiFi and elegantly designed, spacious accommodation. Each air-conditioned studio and apartment is equipped with a flat-screen satellite LCD TV, iPod docking station, and a dining and seating area adorned with wooden flooring. Strategically situated, Cheval Harrington Court is in proximity to a variety of London’s renowned attractions, including the prestigious Natural History Museum and the Victoria and Albert Museum, both just a five-minute stroll away. Hyde Park is a 15-minute walk from the property. 
Cheval Apartments have introduced a service charge policy. This is a discretionary service charge which will be applied to accommodation bookings. The service charge applied will be 4% for all bookings .

125857.address: Av. Sayil Supermanzana 4 Manzana 1 A, Centro
125857.description: This enchanting hotel offers an ideal location in the world-famous tourist resort of Cancun. Travellers will appreciate the close access to the business area and the best Cancun spots and holiday attractions. Exclusive shopping, nightlife, restaurants and entertainment are just steps from the front door and beautiful white sandy beaches are only minutes away. It is 500 m to Plaza las Americas and the centre of Cancun, 800 m to shops and 1 km to links to the public transport network. This family-friendly city hotel is a unique and new concept which integrates all the requirements of the business traveller. The rooms are cosy and well-equipped with modern amenities to provide a perfect place for all those wishing to escape the daily routine. Visitors may indulge in delightful cuisine in the restaurant and sip a cup of aromatic coffee from the bar with terrace overlooking the glittering outdoor pool.

125884.description: This comfortable airport-hotel features a fresh new look and new room design complete with Dreamer Bed so guests can be sure of a great night's sleep. Located at just 3km from the Edinburgh Airport it is the perfect choice for anyone arriving through it. Thanks to the convenient shuttle service guests can be relaxing in the comfortable rooms just minutes after stepping off the plane. The property is also well placed for local transport links including Edinburgh Waverley train station and Edinburgh Bus station. Guests can soak up Edinburg's history, visit Linlithgow Palace or St Giles Cathedral in a matter of minutes. They can enjoy family attractions including Edinburgh Zoo or get back to nature at Almondell Country Park and the Edinburgh Botanic Gardens. For rugby fans, Murrayfield Stadium is well worth a visit and is located just over 10km away.

125887.description: The hotel is located 2.4 km from Edinburgh city centre, making it ideal for a stay in the city whether for business or leisure. All local points of interest are easily reachable and the vicinity offers many amenities, such as shops, dining places and entertainment venues. This establishment is a comfortable budget hotel offering 115 rooms in total. All accommodation units are simply, contemporarily furnished and strive to provide guests with all modern day necessities. Each guestroom features a king-size bed, a television and tea and coffee making facilities. The hotel offers 24-hour reception which ensures flexibility.

name.content: De la Ville Monza - Slh Hotel

125890.description: This hotel boasts an exclusive setting in Monza. The hotel is situated in one of the most prestigious residential areas of the city, overlooking the Royal Palace of Savoy and the park. The hotel is located just a short walking distance away from the pedestrian area of the city. Guests can explore a wide range of attractions nearby, as well as a host of shopping, dining and entertainment venues. The non-smoking guest rooms are individually decorated with luxurious fabrics, artistic influences and the latest technological conveniences. This hotel's exemplary service, first-class facilities and peaceful, homely atmosphere sets it apart as a prime option for visitors to the area.

125959.description: NH Berlin Potsdamer Platz is a hip hotel set in the artistic Kreuzberg district. Potsdamer Platz is a short walk from the hotel and in 10 minutes on foot you can reach some of the biggest attractions Berlin has to offer. This includes the Brandenburg Gate, the Holocaust memorial, and the Reichstag building. The neighborhood is a trendy spot with chic cafes, boutiques, restaurants, and modern nightclubs. For access to the rest of the city and the airport, hop on the train at Anhalter Bahnhof Station. NH Berlin Potsdamer Platz has 89 modern rooms. Each is designed with chic contemporary colors and finished with sleek hardwood floors. To stay connected throughout your travels, use our free Wi-Fi. To ensure that you get a great night's sleep rooms come with soundproofing and high-end mattresses. In the morning, enjoy a delicious and complete breakfast, with a variety of cold cuts, cheeses, cereals, and yogurt, accompanied by fragrant coffees and teas. You can also have it on our outdoor terrace, which later turns into a cozy bar. If it's chilly out, taste an authentic German beer at the indoor bar instead. For dinner, explore the surrounding neighborhood. A private parking garage is also available.

125961.description: Situated in Istanbul's historic Galata district, this modern boutique hotel is steps away from designer shops, acclaimed restaurants, captivating museums, and vibrant art galleries. Housed in a beautifully restored 1893 apartment building, each spacious room features original wooden floors, exposed brick walls, and high ceilings. Interior designer Onur Yilmaz has meticulously crafted a unique blend of historic charm and contemporary style, evident in the bespoke furniture and handcrafted lighting. Mere steps from the iconic Galata Tower, the World House Boutique Hotel offers an authentic Istanbul experience, inviting you to explore the neighborhood's enchanting streets.

125997.description: Boasting a superb beachfront location on the shores of the Mediterranean, this well established hotel lies halfway between the resorts of Alanya and Side in an area popular with hotels and agricultural small-holdings. Guests will find some shops within walking distance and public transport passes close by with links to nearby attractions such as the wonderful Roman/Hellenistic ruins at Side and Alanya Castle. Offering an informal atmosphere with plenty of entertainment, guests can enjoy fun beach parties during the summer months and regular shows put on by the animation team. A beachside terrace offers the perfect venue to enjoy an evening meal within metres of the sea before enjoying a drink from one of the bars.

126004.description: The Marine is one of the southern hemisphere's most spectacular seaside properties. Perched on the cliffs, overlooking Hermanus' Walker Bay, The Marine boasts 40 individually decorated bedrooms and suites. This unforgettable property overlooks South Africa's most pristine whale sanctuary, and it is just a stone's throw from one of the greatest densities of the endangered Great White Shark, and selection of fynbos species in the Cape. The Marine offers guests the unique opportunity to experience the finest land-based whale watching in the world. From June to November guests are able to view these majestic creatures from the comfort of their beautiful sea view room. The attention to detail is apparent in every aspect of this remarkable owner managed property - from the personal service to the exceptional cuisine which is overseen by Chef, Peter Tempelhoff, the perfect-for-sundowners Sun Lounge and the in-house Carchele Beauty Spa. Each piece of The Marine's story adds another element to an unforgettable stay.

126006.description: The Cellars-Hohenort is located in 'Cape Town's Vineyard', the historical Constantia Valley, with its views of Table Mountain. We have 51 rooms that boast panoramic views of the iconic mountain and our manicured gardens. Our rooms range from double rooms to luxury double rooms, suites and the opulent Madiba Villa. At the hotel we have an award-winning restaurants to take our guests on a memorable  culinary journey. The Conservatory serves traditional recipes, including a selection of The Collection founder Liz McGrath's favourite dishes. After a full day of activities, a quick visit to our Fresh Wellness Spa will leave you rejuvenated and ready for the next day. We also have 2 heated swimming pools, tennis court, vineyards and our gardens have lots to offer. We also host corporate events and special occasions, where our experienced team will bring your vision to life.

126007.description: The Plettenberg – situated on a rocky headland in one of South Africa's most spectacular beach towns – is the ultimate escape. This property, with 37 individually decorated rooms and suites, showcases the most breathtaking vistas in Southern Africa with views of the ocean, mountains and endless stretches of golden beach. The Plettenberg is situated in the heart of Plettenberg Bay, along the adventure–rich Garden Route which is world–renowned for its excellent selection of outdoor activities. From regular dolphin and whale sightings to bungee jumping, treetop canopy tours and other more daring pursuits in the surrounding countryside, The Plettenberg is the ideal place to relax and unwind, recharge and reinvigorate.

name.content: Delta Hotels New York Times Square

126008.description: This charming hotel is conveniently located near the center of New York. Local tourist attractions such as Madame Tussaud's Wax Museum are not far from the hotel. Guests will enjoy being so close to Times Square, Broadway theatres, Restaurant Row, and Bryant Park. Take in the grandeur of New York City from the hotel's central location and see it all as you walk everywhere, even to the Empire State Building. Will no longer have Laundry Facilities available at the hotel for guests to do their own laundry. We no longer have a Gym/Fitness facility until further notice. From March 1, 2022, our rooms will no longer feature kitchens as we will then be offering all new fully renovated rooms.

126040.description: Head down to the water and enjoy a day at the private beach, or take advantage of other recreational amenities including a seasonal outdoor pool and bicycles to rent. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Need to unwind? Take a break at the bar/lounge, the beach bar, or the poolside bar for a tasty beverage. A complimentary local cuisine breakfast is served daily from 8:30 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 6 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, while DVD players and satellite programming provide entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Suna & İnan Kıraç Kaleiçi Museum - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Kaleici Museum - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Tekeli Mehmet Pasa Mosque - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Hadrian's Gate - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Antalya Clock Tower - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Kale Kapısı - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Holly Stone Performance Hall - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Old Bazaar - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Broken Minaret - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Yivli Minare Mosque - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- 14th-Century Tombs - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Mevlevi Tekke - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Alaaddin Mosque - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Ataturk Boulevard - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Mermerli Beach - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi. The nearest major airport is Antalya Intl. Airport (AYT) - 15. 5 km / 9.

126041.description:
This property is 8 minutes walk from the beach. Situated directly on Side Beach, with view of the Mediterranean Sea, non-smoking Ali Bey Resort offers an Aqua Park, luxury spa facilities and free Wi-Fi in the entire hotel.
All guest rooms at Ali Bey Side are equipped a private balcony overlooking the sea and the resort's 100,000 m² gardens. Every room has an en suite bathroom which includes a hairdryer. The 3 restaurants at Ali Bey Resort offer fresh seafood and Turkish specialties. Guests have a choice of 5 bars, and there is a café that serves traditional pastries.Tennis lessons and water sports are available on site, and you can relax with a massage in the spa area. Belek's 11 championship golf courses are a 1-hour drive from the hotel.Ali Bey Resort Side is 65 km from Antalya International Airport. Free on-site car parking is available.

126044.description: This modern hotel enjoys a wonderful setting close to Side. The hotel boasts spectacular views over the Mediterranean sea, complemented by a charming pine forest backdrop. The hotel is located in the Sorgun District, just 5 km away from the resort of Side, where the famous Hellenistic and Roman ruins can be found. Links to the public transport network can be found close by. This charming, lifestyle complex boasts beautifully-designed guest rooms. Guests are invited to avail of the seemingly endless range of facilities and services that this contemporary hotel has to offer. Business and leisure travellers are sure to enjoy a truly memorable stay at this hotel.

126050.description: Welcome to Duque Hotel & Spa! Immerse yourself in the glamour and romantic charm of the early 20th century. As part of the Miravida Collection of boutique hotels, Duque Hotel offers an experience that stands apart from large chains, with exceptional, personalized accommodations, services, and amenities. Designed for those who seek luxury with the warmth of a home-like atmosphere, our boutique experience ensures you'll feel both pampered and perfectly at ease.

126085.address: Derb Chtouka, Quartier De La Kasbah, 21
126085.description: Nestled in Marrakech's Kasbah Quarter, this hotel offers convenient access to the city's captivating sites, including the Royal Palace and Djemaa el Fna. Just 3 km from Menara Airport, it boasts spectacular views of the Atlas Mountains. Housed in a 19th-century residence, this authentic riad showcases traditional Moroccan architecture blended with modern amenities. The stylish guest rooms provide a tranquil retreat, while the hotel's extensive range of first-class facilities and services ensures a comfortable and memorable stay.

126087.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Hotel Flora Parc in Castelldefels, featuring a seasonal outdoor pool, bicycle rentals, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Savor delicious meals at the onsite restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Start your day with the included buffet breakfast. The hotel also offers convenient amenities such as a business center, 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and self-parking (for a fee). Each of the 68 guestrooms provides a minibar, plasma television with satellite programming, private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a bidet, safe, and desk. Housekeeping is provided daily. Hotel Flora Parc is located within a 15-minute drive of Castelldefels Beach and Gran Via 2, 9. 6 mi (15. 4 km) from RCDE Stadium, and 10. 5 mi (16. 9 km) from Fira Barcelona.

126098.description: The hotel consists of 64 guest rooms. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Ark Suite Hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. Parking facilities are available for guests' convenience. If pampering is needed, all guests staying at this property can take advantage of the health facilities offered.

126099.description: Enjoying a serene location, this hotel offers guests enchanting views of pristine shoreline and white sandy beaches. Side is a mere 3 km away, easily accessible via numerous public transport links. Within a short distance of the hotel, guests can enjoy a range of restaurants and bars. Guests wishing to explore the culture of the area can enjoy trips to the Temple of Apollo, Manavgat Waterfalls and the Side museum. With Antalya airport just 65 km away, this hotel ensures comfort and convenience. Guests will enjoy ample space within the rooms, which are complemented by modern furnishings and elegant fabrics. Guests can relax and unwind in the gardens, or enjoy a refreshing drink in the hotel bar. Guests travelling for business purposes can avail of the conference facilities, ensuring productivity whilst away.

126100.description: The hotel enjoys a great location on a long, sandy beach just 3 km from Side's impressive amphitheatre, museum and Temple of Apollo, all easily reached by public transport or taxi, both of which are available from in front of the hotel. Refurbished in the winter of 2011-2012, this large 300-room, air-conditioned resort shares 70, 000 m2 of land with its sister hotel and is suitable for couples and families. The hotel features a range of recreational and culinary facilities, including a 4-slide aqua park, spa & wellness centre, patisserie, buffet and a la carte restaurants.

126139.address: Opp Apt Colony, New Sanjay Nagar, Sahar Road
126139.description: The hotel is located in Andheri (east) in Mumbai, easily accessible to cultural, historical and shopping districts by road and just 1 km from the Andheri Station. It is 2 km from the international airport, 1 km from the domestic airport and the famous Juhu Beach is just 3 km away. The hotel is an oasis of elegance and luxury, strategically located in Andheri offering a consistently higher standard of facilities and services like a multi cuisine restaurant with a range of delicious Indian and Chinese delicacies and a bar with a collection of good liquors. The property also features a travel desk, around-the-clock room service, a lobby with 24-hour check-out service and laundry service. The amenities offered in the rooms include a satellite television, telephone, refrigerator, Internet connection, safety deposit lockers and a DVD player. There is a bathtub and shower in the attached washroom. The suites offer a small kitchenette to make guests' stay more comfortable.

126140.address: Subhash Road, Adjacent to Garware House
126140.description: The hotel enjoys a distinctive location in Vile Parle (East) in the heart of Mumbai within close proximity to the business, historical and shopping hubs of the city, just 2 km from the domestic airport and 5 km from the international airport. This budget hotel offers guests complete privacy with all the comforts of a modern home and adequate services, such as daily housekeeping, 24-hour hot and cold water, a doctor on call, courtesy coach services, a daily national newspaper, and banqueting and conference rooms to make stays comfortable for both business and leisure travellers. The air-conditioned hotel also offers a lobby with 24-hour check-out service, a hotel safe, and room and laundry services. The hotel offers well appointed and beautifully decorated rooms divided into deluxe and super deluxe room categories, all of which are well equipped with modern amenities, such as air conditioning, a TV, writing table, mirror and intercom. The bathrooms are clean and come with a shower and bathtub and amenities such as soap, shampoo, moisturiser, a dental kit and shaving kit. The deluxe rooms are the largest and have a minibar, chairs with a coffee table and guest slippers. One of the walls here is all glass with a nice view of the tall coconut trees outside. A direct dial telephone, satellite TV and Internet access also feature in all rooms as standard.

126141.address: 101, DP Road No. 9, MHADA Colony 20, Powai, Mumba
126141.description:
The hotel is conveniently located close to Powai Police Station in the Powai area of Mumbai. The local bus terminus is a short distance away from the property. The international airport is 20 minutes from the hotel, and the domestic airport is about 30 minutes away.

This budget-class business hotel offers luxurious comfort with warm hospitality, and is equipped with contemporary amenities and world class services, such as 24-hour room service, a lobby with 24-hour check-out service, lift access, a bar/pub, meeting facilities, a restaurant, safety deposit boxes and a laundry service. The hotel offers a full range of popular amenities and a friendly, caring team of staff to make guests' stay at the hotel a memorable one.

The hotel offers a fine selection of fully air-conditioned, non-smoking and well-designed guestrooms. All rooms are spacious and equipped with amenities, such as air conditioning, satellite/cable TV, a direct dial telephone, Internet access, tea and coffee making facilities and an en suite bathroom with a shower and bathtub. Each room has been decorated keeping guests' tastes and requirements in mind.

Guests may take advantage of the sport or leisure activities available at the hotel, such as a hot tub, sauna and spa.

126142.address: 1st Road, Near Milan Subway, Santacruz (W), Mumbai
126142.description: Ideally situated in the entertainment district of Mumbai, just 5 minutes from Milan Subway and the local train station, and 3. 6 Km from the airport, this hotel is a great place to stay, especially for business travellers. There are many places of interest and landmarks to see such as the University of Mumbai, Juhu Beach, Isken Temple, Chatrapathi Shivaji and Bandra Kurla Complex. Hotel facilities include free parking, a shuttle service, wireless internet access and a dry cleaning and laundry service. Corporate travellers have the use of a business centre with fax & copy machines and two meeting rooms. The on-site restaurant serves Indian, Chinese and continental fare and there is also a coffee shop. Bright, modern air-conditioned rooms have cable television, safety deposit box, refrigerator and iron with ironing board. Non-smoking rooms are available.

126196.description: Designed following the old principles of Feng Shui philosophy, this charming hotel is excellently located close to the central square Praça do Marquês de Pombal and the Avenida da Liberdade with its elegant shops and boutiques. The beautiful park Eduardo VII and the historic centre with its famous attractions such as Praça do Rossio, Santa Justa Elevator or Praça do Comércio are within a short stroll.

126202.description: This hotel is located approximately 4 km from Stellenbosch, South Africa's second-oldest town, and a mere 25-minute drive from Cape Town International Airport. Opened in May 2008, this spacious, modern hotel offers 41 luxurious rooms, including three generous suites. Guests enjoy fine wine tastings and superb service throughout their stay. The luxurious rooms and suites are spread among three buildings across the estate, each maximizing the stunning views of Stellenbosch, the surrounding vineyards, and mountains. The air-conditioned hotel offers a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, and a currency exchange facility. Guests can enjoy gourmet and casual dining in the two on-site restaurants and bar. Business travelers will appreciate the conference facilities and WLAN Internet access (charges apply). Additional amenities include laundry service and 24-hour room service (charges apply), as well as ample parking. All facilities offer spectacular views, with a tranquil waterside setting against the grandeur of the Stellenbosch and Helderberg mountains and vineyards. Each room features a private bathroom with a bathtub and separate shower, a king-size or twin bed configuration, a direct-dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, internet access, a safe, and a minibar fridge. Tea and coffee making facilities, individually regulated air conditioning, and heating are standard. All units also include a balcony or terrace.

126204.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. Additional amenities at this Mediterranean hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 41 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have hair dryers and bathrobes.

126226.description: Our beachfront resort, nestled between the pine forests and the sea, is located in the heart of Tekirova. Spread across 200, 000 square meters, the resort's two and three-story buildings showcase Turkish architecture and offer the highest comfort standards. Enjoy our 500-meter-long sandy and gravel beach.

126230.description: Located in the heart of Amsterdam, Hotel CC offers 81 air-conditioned rooms with modern amenities such as LCD TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and laptop-compatible safes. Enjoy a cooked-to-order breakfast (fee applies) and convenient access to a computer station, gift shop, and multilingual staff. A short walk from Dam Square and The 9 Streets, this hotel is also within easy reach of popular attractions like the Amsterdam Museum and Flower Market.

126231.description: XO Hotel Inner is located in the Museum district of Amsterdam. The Van Gogh Museum and Rijksmuseum are in walking distance. The stylish, non-smoking rooms are equipped with the most modern facilities. The hotel can easily be reached from Schiphol airport by public transport. From Schiphol airport you can take the bus to the Museum Square and from there it is a 5 minute walk to the hotel.

126237.description: This hotel boasts an idyllic setting, surrounded by a green park and making it the ideal place in which visitors can truly relax while on holidays or on a business trip. The hotel is within easy reach from the main points of interest, having Venice and Treviso not far away by car. All guest rooms exude an elegant atmosphere and are decorated in a charming, luxurious style to enhance all types of stays. They boast superior amenities and elegant furniture for added comfort. The extra-large suites boast exclusive amenities such as a private hot tub and a large terrace with views to the park. Business travellers might take advantage of the ideal conference rooms available for their important meetings, as well as the delicious on-site dining facilities that include a comprehensive, exquisite breakfast buffet every morning that can be taken outside at the terrace.

name.content: Mercure Paris Malakoff Parc Des Expositions

126239.description: A complete escape at the Gates of Paris. . . On Line 4 of the subway, our hotel has private car parking.  Our garden provides a relaxing atmosphere, perfect for recharging yourself. Our hotel is renovated in a trendy style,  along the theme of electricity. Let yourself be surprised by our dazzling rooms. Who would think they were so close to the Parc des Expos, Porte de Versailles? A unique place for your business and tourist trips.

126260.description: This beautiful hotel is located on the south side of Westminster Bridge, with views across the river to the Houses of Parliament and Big Ben. The hotel is only a short walk from Waterloo Station. The restaurants and bars of South Bank are just 100 m away and it is 200 m from the Thames. It is perfectly situated within short walking distance of London's key tourist attractions, including Big Ben, the Houses of Parliament, the London Aquarium, the London Eye, the Imperial War Museum, Westminster Abbey, Trafalgar Square and Buckingham Palace. Decorated with contemporary flair and a hint of boutique-style elegance, the comfortable hotel rooms, Suites and Penthouses offer striking city views and modern amenities.

126299.description: Located in Schönefeld, the IntercityHotel Berlin Airport Area North offers convenient access to the airport, and is a short drive from the Berlin ExpoCenter Airport and Köpenick Palace. This spa hotel provides guests with complimentary Wi-Fi, a TV lounge, and tour/ticket assistance. Each of the 198 guestrooms features a plasma TV, cable programming, and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Additional conveniences include a phone, laptop-compatible safe, and a desk. Guests can enjoy a meal at the hotel restaurant or a quick snack at the deli. A bar/lounge is also available. Buffet breakfast is served daily for a fee. The hotel features a business center, express check-in and check-out, and ample meeting space. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

name.content: Hotel L'Horset Opera, BW Premier Collection

126313.description: Nestled near the Opéra Garnier, Louvre Museum, and renowned department stores, the charming Hotel L'Horset Opera, BW Premier Collection, offers a tranquil escape in the heart of Paris. As the closest Best Western to the Opéra Garnier, it's ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Steps away, discover the Place Vendôme, famed for its exquisite jewelers, and the Faubourg Saint-Honoré, home to luxury boutiques and gourmet food shops. The hotel's 54 comfortable and quiet rooms provide a warm ambiance, featuring elegant woodwork, dark-wood furnishings, and modern amenities, including air conditioning, satellite television, minibars, and free Wi-Fi. A buffet breakfast is available, and the hotel bar offers snacks throughout the day. For prepaid bookings, please present the payment card and a matching passport upon arrival.

126315.description: CIN code: IT027042A1GL9DEFJP This comfortable and lovely hotel sits in a privileged position in the beautiful city of Venice. The property is a short walk away from Santa Lucia's railway station and the bus terminal of Piazzale Roma. This charming hotel is ideally situated on the Dorsoduro sestiere, where guests will find plenty of sightseeing attractions like the beautiful squares of Campo Santa Margherita and Campo dei Carmini. Guests may take advantage of the lavishly appointed guest rooms and suites, all of them fully equipped with a wide range of superior amenities to ensure visitors will enjoy a truly pleasant stay. Adjacent to the hotel, visitors can also stay at the tastefully fitted apartments, all of them also well equipped as standard. Just 15 minutes from the hotel, travellers may taste delicious dishes at the typically Italian restaurant decorated in a cosy and enchanting style.

126321.description: Casa Martini is the ideal place for a pleasant stay in the old town centre of Venice, near all the main points of interest, which can be reached either on foot or by vaporetto. The ancient building used to be the home of the Martini family, skilled spice traders between Venice and the far East, since 1700. The palace has been recently restored preserving the ancient structure and bringing up to light the beautiful wooden beams, the fireplaces, the frescoed walls and the typical Venetian marble pavement. Set on 3 floors, you can find different sitting corners and a summer terrace where you can enjoy your vacation in relaxation and tranquility. Guests are welcomed in a friendly and familiar atmosphere to make your stay pleasant and uforgettable; an attentive and courteous staff is at your disposal for useful information and advice on Venice and its surroundings.

126338.description: Nestled at the entrance to the palm groves, this residence offers convenient access to the main road to Casablanca. Guests enjoy amenities such as a lobby, currency exchange, hairdressing salon, and a nearby children's playground and kids' club. The onsite restaurant provides convenient dining. Suites feature vibrant décor, carved furniture, and a comfortable lounge area. Each air-conditioned suite includes a bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, along with a king-size bed, TV, and minibar. Guests can relax by the outdoor swimming pool and sun terrace, complete with sun loungers and parasols, while enjoying magnificent views of the lake and the 27-hole golf course. A complimentary shuttle bus to the city center is also available. Housekeeping services include bed making upon arrival, linen changes every two days, and a final cleaning (excluding the kitchen area).

126362.description: Nestled between the marina and the beautiful Zuid-Kennemerland National Park, the Leonardo Hotel IJmuiden Seaport Beach is just a step away from the seemingly endless sandy beach of the Dutch coast. The city centre of Amsterdam with its countless shopping facilities, museums and nightlife spots can be reached within a 25 minutes drive, while Schiphol International Airport is a 30 minutes' drive away. Guests are welcomed in a stylish environment. The well-appointed rooms and suites are bright and decorated in a contemporary style with all the necessary features including balconies. Business guests will appreciate the business desk and the fantastic conference facilities. After a long day working or on the beach, guests can work-out in the mini-gym or indulge in total relaxation in the wellness area. The exquisite restaurant Chef's! Food and Drinks literally gives you a 'peek in the kitchen'. Surprising dishes are prepared for you in our open kitchen. For the unique experience, real chefs give the dishes a finishing touch at the table. Why? We think it's important that you can see that we only use high-quality, fresh ingredients and that you can taste them too!

name.content: Cape Grace, A Fairmont Managed Hotel

126368.address: West Quay Road Victoria & Alfred Waterfront
126368.description:
Welcome home. Standing at the heart of the V&A Waterfront is a figure that evokes familiarity, comfort and a sense of adventure. Cape Grace is a timeless presence. With rooms gazing out onto the harbour, marina, or majestic silhouette of Table Mountain, our grand hotel feels as if it has always been part of the landscape. No matter where life takes you, Cape Grace will always welcome you back home. 

Every visit, even the first, truly feels like a homecoming. Handcrafted journeys, thoughtfully curated. Our service comes from the heart, genuine and unscripted. Our personalized room experience envelops you in warmth, infusing your stay with an abundance of thoughtful amenities and heartfelt gestures.

126457.description: The Sunis Elita Beach Resort Hotel & SPA welcomes you to Manavgat, Antalya, with modern, luxurious service and unforgettable experiences. Our 5-star hotel, nestled where the beach meets the turquoise sea, offers charming views, elegantly furnished rooms, complimentary Wi-Fi, and 24-hour room service for a peaceful and enjoyable holiday. Choose from six room types, each designed with your comfort in mind. Find your own private sanctuary and experience the tranquility of lush gardens filled with the songs of birds. Indulge in our spa's indoor and outdoor pools, rejuvenating massages, and invigorating fitness center. Pamper yourself in our beauty center and unwind in our comfortable lounges. Savor diverse world cuisines crafted by our master chefs in our restaurants. Meanwhile, children will enjoy engaging activities, learn, and socialize with peers under the guidance of our dedicated instructors, creating memories that will last a lifetime.

126479.description: This aparthotel in Kensington and Chelsea places you near London's top attractions, including Harrods, the Royal Albert Hall, and the National History, Victoria and Albert, and Science Museums. The West End's vibrant shopping, dining, and entertainment scene, along with Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens, are easily accessible. South Kensington tube station is a mere 550 meters away, and Heathrow Airport is just 22 km from the hotel. The six-story aparthotel offers 38 stylish apartments, featuring a minimalist design. Guests enjoy a 24-hour reception, lift access, a hotel safe, and laundry service. Each spacious apartment is meticulously clean and boasts modern furnishings and state-of-the-art technology. The well-equipped kitchens cater to diverse tastes. All apartments include a private bathroom with a shower/bathtub and hairdryer, a double bed with daily linen changes, a direct dial telephone, TV, internet access, a safe, a fridge, cooker, microwave, tea and coffee making facilities, an ironing set, air conditioning, and central heating.

126521.description: This apartment hotel enjoys a strategic setting in Roissy en France. The hotel is located just a short distance away from Paris Charles de Gaule International Airport. The hotel enjoys close proximity to links to the public transport network, which place other areas of the city within easy access. This complex boasts close proximity to a host of attractions in this wonderful hotel, as well as a wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment venues. This hotel affords guests the charm of traditional architecture, combined with high-quality service. The guest apartments offer a luxurious setting, in which to work and rest in comfort. The apartments offer home comforts, ensuring a high level of convenience for guests.

126540.description: Hotel Nazionale is situated just 100 metres from the Santa Lucia railway station and only a few minutes' walk from Piazzale Roma. The hotel plays host to 88 guest rooms, all equipped with every imaginable comfort and featuring stylish décor that is enriched by paintings depicting some of the most delightful views of this lagoon city. Guests at Hotel Nazionale are sure to love the elegant, stylish rooms, which afford every imaginable comfort, including room service, colour TV, air-conditioning and direct-dial telephone. All our rooms are very quiet not being placed on the main street.

126541.description: CIN : IT027042A1AI5S6V6HLocated 150 m behind St Mark's Square, Hotel Antigo Trovatore offers air conditioned rooms, great water bus connections and panoramic views across Venice from its rooftop terrace. Rooms at the Antigo Trovatore are simply decorated and feature satellite TV and a private bathroom with hairdryer. Some have access to a communal terrace overlooking the 16th-century Doges Palace and Saint Mark's bell tower. Wi-Fi access is available in the rooms and there is also an internet point with printer in reception. Here guests have a luggage storage room for departure day. The hotel is surrounded by some of Venice's most popular shops, cafés and restaurants.

126560.description: Jazz on the Park Hostel is located in the heart of the Upper West Side, along Central Park and super close to subways and buses, so the whole City is at your fingertips. Explore local hangouts or walk through Central Park to 5th Avenue and the Museum Mile, where you will find the Metropolitan Museum of Art, the Guggenheim Museum, and much more.

126586.address: Bank Street Khalid Bin Waleed Road, Bur Dubai
126586.description: The aparthotel is located in the heart of Bur Dubai, on Khalid Bin Walid Street near the Meena Bazar. The train station is nearby and Dubai International Airport is approximately 5 km away. The aparthotel offers 110 spacious accommodation units and free parking in the car park and garage in a convenient location. Guests have easy access to the rooms directly from the parking area without having to go through the hotel lobby thus offering complete privacy. The air-conditioned aparthotel offers a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom, lift access, a hairdressing salon and a TV lounge. Guests may dine in the café and restaurant. Business guests are sure to appreciate the conference facilities and WLAN Internet access. Room and laundry services are also provided. The hotel has studios and apartments, all of which have been furnished in a neutral style. Guests have the choice between the open-plan studio-style units or the larger one and two-bedroom apartments with their separate living areas. The en suite bathrooms are fitted with a shower and a bath, and the bedrooms are furnished with a double or king-size bed. In-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access, a safe, washing machine, ironing set and balcony or terrace. The kitchen/kitchenettes are equipped with a fridge, cooker, microwave and tea and coffee making facilities. The air conditioning in all accommodation is individually regulated. Leisure facilities at the aparthotel include a rooftop saltwater heated swimming pool and a modern fitness centre with gym. There is also a small children's pool. There is also a sauna and steam room. A continental breakfast buffet is served each morning, while buffet, à la carte and set menu options are offered at lunch and dinner.

126592.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an indoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite with Italian cuisine at Beneci's, a family restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge, take in the ocean view, or dine alfresco. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Weehawken? This hotel has 2112 square feet (196 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 5 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 358 guestrooms. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Wireless internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.
