Airport (JFK) - 32. 3 km / 20 miLinden, NJ (LDJ) - 33 km / 20.

126593.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace at this 32-room hotel, where amenities abound. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and take advantage of concierge services. Additional services include wedding planning, a comfortable communal living room, and discounted access to a nearby fitness center. A shuttle service to shopping areas is available for a surcharge. Savor delicious meals at the restaurant or grab a snack at the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with fellow guests at the daily complimentary reception or unwind at one of the two bars/lounges. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast served from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Business services, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk are also available. Roundtrip airport and bus station shuttles are provided for an additional charge. Each guestroom features a minibar, a flat-screen television with cable programming, complimentary toiletries, a hairdryer, a safe, and a desk. Housekeeping is provided daily. Located near Greenmarket Square, Long Street, and the Cape Town Gateway Visitor Centre, you'll be just steps away from the city's vibrant heart. Cape Town International Airport (CPT) is 19. 5 km away.

126709.address: Angle Rue Imam Malek Et Rue Iben Toumert
126709.description: This aparthotel in Marrakech's Gueliz district offers an indoor pool, a terrace with scenic views, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy lunch or dinner at the on-site restaurant, or take advantage of room service during limited hours. Additional amenities include concierge services, express check-in/check-out, and free valet parking. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. The 40 guestrooms feature kitchens, complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, minibars, and daily housekeeping. Résidence Appart hotel Assounfou is steps from Marrakech Plaza and a short drive from Jemaa el-Fnaa, the Majorelle Garden, and Avenue Mohamed VI.

126725.description: Discover the Novotel Marrakech Hivernage hotel in the middle of the trendiest part of Marrakech, where you can unwind and have fun in the many restaurants, casinos and Jet set clubs. You will love our cozy yet refined rooms. Take a stroll and discover the Koutoubia Mosque and the famous Jemaa el-Fna square. After a walk through the souks, relax in our outdoor swimming pool, and savor local delicacies in our casual, one-of-a-kind restaurant, Bazz'art.

126997.description:
Dutch Design Hotel Vondelpark enjoys a peaceful location in Amsterdam's charming Oud-Zuid district, just a short walk from the beautiful Vondelpark. The hotel offers comfortable, modern accommodation with easy access to popular attractions such as the Van Gogh Museum, Rijksmuseum, and Museumplein. Schiphol Airport can be reached in approximately 15 minutes by car, while excellent public transport connections make it easy to explore the rest of the city. Guests will also find a variety of restaurants, cafés, and bars within walking distance. The multilingual staff is available to assist guests throughout their stay, and each room is thoughtfully designed to provide a comfortable and relaxing experience with complimentary Wi-Fi and modern amenities. 
*Important info: Reception is open daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Check-in is available from 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM, and check-out is between 7:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Guests arriving after 10:00 PM are kindly requested to contact the hotel in advance at +31 20 714 2010 to arrange a smooth arrival.

127177.description: CIN code: IT027042A1BBJ3CMT5 Thirty years of experience in the hotel industry make the family running Hotel Lux experts in catering to all guest's needs. Enjoy a comfortable stay really near St. Marks’ Square. Hotel Lux is ideal to visit the whole of Venice. The main landmarks of the Lagoon are enjoyable on foot or via public transport. All rooms, sanitized with ozone, are furnished in Venetian style and equipped with modern facilities. The Hotel Lux's staff can help you to arrange transfers, tours and excursions, to book museums, expositions and concerts, to reserve a restaurant or a flight. The Hotel Lux room park extends over two separate buildings.

127178.address: Santa Croce Salizada Fontego Dei Turchi, 1739
127178.description: This hotel is situated in the Santa Croce district of Venice. Guests will find themselves in the perfect setting from which to explore the rich culture and intrigue of this mesmerising city. The hotel is located just a short distance from the historical centre of the city, just steps away from the Fontego dei Turchi and the Grand Canal. The Museum of Natural History is located just a short distance away. The hotel occupies a building which enjoys a rich, long history, dating back to 1500. This charming hotel enjoys a unique atmosphere, taking guests back in time to a bygone era. The guest rooms are beautifully designed in a Venetian style. The hotel ensures guests of a truly enjoyable, memorable stay.

127179.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace of this Art Deco hotel in Venice's Dorsoduro district, just a short walk from the Peggy Guggenheim Museum. Ca' Pisani Hotel offers 29 guestrooms equipped with minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Indulge in the hotel's steam room, bar/lounge, and coffee shop/cafe. Continental breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Take advantage of the area shuttle (surcharge) to explore nearby attractions, including St. Mark's Square, a 13-minute walk away. Additional amenities include concierge services and a TV in the common area.

127237.description: Hotel Piccola Fenice offers free Wi-Fi and spacious suites in a 17th-century building. It is near the La Fenice Theater, a 5-minute walk from Saint Mark's Square. Each suite features a large living area. You will find a Nespresso coffee machine, fridge and cutlery so you can make your own breakfast. The Piccola Fenice has an internal courtyard. It is located in the center of Venice in a quiet side street. At the partner Hotel La Fenice you can have breakfast, available at an additional cost. The reception is open only in the morning, after midday you can check-in at Hotel La Fenice et Des Artistes, at your disposal 24H.

127440.description:
NUMBER ONE TOWER SUITES & HOTEL APARTMENTS
A prestigious address, ideally located in Dubai along the prime stretch of Sheikh Zayed Road in the heart of the executive business district. Number One Tower Suites and Hotel Apartments is the ‘number one’ location to enjoy all of Dubai for business & pleasure. 
Minutes away from the Dubai World Trade Convention Centre, DIFC and its Metro Station with direct access to Dubai International Airport, Business Bay, Dubai Media City, Internet City, JLT, Jebel Ali Free Zone and EXPO City Dubai. 
A short distance from The Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, City Walk, Coca-Cola arena and close proximity to all other major shopping malls, golf courses, beaches and local tourist attractions.

127442.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. The hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and a banquet hall. Enjoy international cuisine at Nuevo, a restaurant with a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of room service. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 807 square feet (75 square meters) of space consisting of a conference space and a meeting room. Free self-parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 304 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Mar Thoma Parish - 9. 2 km / 5. 7 mi; Gurunanak Darbar Sikh Gurudwara - 9. 2 km / 5. 7 mi; Dubai Exhibition Centre - 9. 6 km / 5. 9 mi; Ibn Battuta Mall - 11 km / 6. 8 mi; Expo City Dubai - 11. 4 km / 7. 1 mi; Dubai Autodrome - 12. 5 km / 7. 8 mi; Circle Mall - 13. 1 km / 8. 1 mi; Dubai International Stadium - 13. 2 km / 8. 2 mi. The nearest airports are: Al Maktoum Intl. Airport (DWC) - 31. 3 km / 19. 5 mi; Dubai Intl. Airport (DXB) - 39. 9 km / 24. 8 mi; Sharjah (SHJ-Sharjah Intl. ) - 61. 6 km / 38 mi.

127457.description:
The youth hostel is centrally located right next to one of Europe's largest and most modern railway stations, Berlin Central Station. Berlin Tegel Airport is situated at a distance of approximately 3 km and Berlin Schönefeld Airport roughly 20 km from the hostel.

This property offers high standards with air-conditioned rooms, WLAN Internet access and a fantastic view over the Berlin rooftops from the bar on the 9th floor. The hostel and its 296 rooms are equipped with a highly modern key card system. The entire hostel is equipped with a modern fire alarm system with smoke detectors and fire extinguishers on every floor, as well as a video monitoring system in the entrance area and bar. Furthermore, the reception is manned 24 hours a day so that guests will always find someone to speak to about questions and concerns. The establishment features a lobby with a 24-hour check-out service, a hotel safe, cloakroom, lift access, a games room, café and breakfast room.

All rooms are en suite and equipped with a shower, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access, individually regulated air conditioning and central heating.

Guests may make use of the solarium.

A breakfast buffet is served each morning.

From Tegel Airport (TXL): Take the bus TXL (toward Mollstraße/Prenzlauer Allee) and alight at Berlin Hauptbahnhof (Central Station). From Schönefeld Airport (SXF): Take the railway RB14 or RE7 from the S-Bahn station Flughafen Schönefeld and alight at S-Bahn station Berlin Hauptbahnhof (Central Station). Alternatively, take the airport bus SXF 1 and alight at the S-Bahn station Suedkreuz. Change to the RE5 train to the S-Bahn station Berlin Hauptbahnhof (Central Station) or take the S-Bahn S41 from Suedkreuz to the S-Bahn station Westkreuz. Then take the S7 and alight at the S-Bahn station Berlin Hauptbahnhof (Central Station).

127460.description: The hotel is located in Dar El Bacha quarter, less than 10 minutes away from Djemaa el Fna square. Menara International Airport is approximately 3 km away. This hotel is an authentic old house in Marrakech which has been transformed into a charming riad or guest house which harmoniously combines the refinement of traditional architecture and the comfort of a modern Marrakech accommodation. The large roof-top terraces of the hotel overlooking the medina offer various relaxation areas, a caidal tent and an upper terrace with a panoramic view of the medina and the Atlas Mountains. The air-conditioned establishment features 12 rooms, a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a breakfast/dining room and conference facilities. Furthermore, WLAN Internet access, room and laundry services, a car park and bicycle hire are provided. All rooms are a mix of contemporary decoration and traditional architecture. The en suite bathrooms are fitted with a shower, bath and hairdryer, and the bedrooms with double or king-size beds. Standard in-room amenities include a satellite/cable TV, radio, hi-fi system, Internet access, a safe, a fridge and tea and coffee making facilities. A washing machine, an ironing set, individually regulated air conditioning, heating and a terrace also come as standard in all rooms. In one of the courtyards there is a small swimming pool. Guests can treat themselves to an exfoliation and massage in the hammam as well as further spa treatments. An indoor swimming pool and children's swimming area are available for a fee. Guests may also play basketball and golf or go horse riding. Entertainment programmes are arranged for adults.

127462.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages or enjoy recreation amenities such as an indoor pool. This riad also features complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy a satisfying meal at Restaurant Al Jazira serving guests of Riad Al Jazira. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 8 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 18 air-conditioned guestrooms. Bathrooms have shower/tub combinations and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include safes and a turndown service, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Zawiya of Sidi Bel Abbas - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Perfume Museum - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Zaouia El Abassia - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Dar Bellarj - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Souk Cherifia - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Ben Youssef Mosque - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Almoravid Koubba - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Ben Youssef Madrasa - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Marrakech Museum - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Shrob ou Shouf Fountain - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Ensemble Artisanal - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- The Orientalist Museum of Marrakech - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Mouassine Fountain - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Mouassine Mosque - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Le Jardin Secret - 1 km / 0. 6 mi. The preferred airport for Riad Al Jazira is Menara Airport (RAK) - 8 km / 5 mi A stay at Riad Al Jazira places you in the heart of Marrakech, within a 5-minute drive of Le Jardin Secret and Koutoubia Mosque. This riad is 1. 5 mi (2. 4 km) from Jemaa el-Fnaa and 1. 6 mi (2. 6 km) from Marrakech Plaza.

127463.description: With a charming traditional atmosphere and a central location in Marrakesh, this beautiful residence is the ideal base to explore the famous Medina and discover the traditions of the surrounding area. Restored with respect to tradition and featuring elegance and sobriety, this small house offers exquisite rooms with cool patios which teem with the finest sounds that emerge from the fountain which is enthroned in the centre of the residence. The place also has a two-storey terrace that offers stunning views of the Glaoui Palace and the Koutoubia Mosque. To discover the best of Moroccan cuisine, the hotel proposes trying the variety of traditional menus served in the salon, on the patio or on the roof-top terraces. The establishment also offers a traditional Hammam, a relaxing massage service and free Wi-Fi in common areas. The family-like atmosphere and the cosiness of the rooms merge into an unforgettable experience for those who seek warmth, style and tradition.

127467.description:
The charming guesthouse is located at the 9 km point on the 'Route de Ouarzazate'. Surrounded by olive and palm trees, this intimate estate is located some 20 minutes' drive from Marrakech city centre and 10 minutes from the Medina. Menara airport is approximately 15 km from the guesthouse.

This stunning boutique sanctuary in Marrakech is a complex of traditional riads and villas. The rooms and the suites, overlooking the Atlas Mountains, pay tribute to the splendour of Moorish architecture. Facilities available to guests at the air-conditioned hotel include a lobby, TV lounge, restaurant and a car park.

The hotel's guest rooms are all elegantly and luxuriously decorated and have marble bathrooms with a shower, hairdryer and luxurious amenities. The views from the rooms and the suites include the Atlas Mountains, the swimming pools, the gardens and the olive groves. Each room additionally features a double or king-size bed, satellite TV, Internet access, an in-room safe, individually regulated air conditioning and a private balcony or terrace.

Guests may take a dip in one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools or relax using the sun loungers and parasols provided. Cafe Maure also has its own pool and there are two Moroccan hammams, a sauna, a tennis court, an outdoor hot tub, jogging spaces and a table tennis table available to guests.

A full Moroccan breakfast is served each morning.

At the 9 km point on the Route de Ouarzazate, turn left before the American School. There is a sign on the left-hand side coming from Marrakech to indicate directions.

127468.description: The hotel is located at km 9 on the 'Route de Ouarzazate'. Surrounded by olive and palm trees, this intimate estate is located some 20 minutes drive from Marrakech's city centre. Marrakech-Menara Airport is approximately 6 km from the hotel. The hotel has modern facilities, traditional architecture and magnificent views of the Atlas Mountains. It includes three riads dedicated to guesthouse accommodation, consisting of sober and elegant architecture combined with comfort and discreet charm with uniquely decorated rooms loaded with amenities, and different interior decoration styles. The 3 patios with fountains give a feeling of space. The premises are air-conditioned and facilities include a hotel safe and a TV lounge. The comfortable guest rooms include free WLAN Internet access, a direct dial telephone, en suite facilities, satellite TV, a minibar, safe and a work desk. Rooms are furnished with double or king-size beds. All rooms have individually regulated air conditioning. Guests are provided with a VIP welcome, a fully daily breakfast, mineral water, a selection of pastries, fruits and flowers. Guests can take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool and relax on sun loungers under the shade of the parasols. Palmeraie Golf Club is about 20 minutes' drive from the hotel. Turn left before the American School at km 9 on the Route de Ouarzazate. There is a sign on the left-hand side coming from Marrakech to show directions.

127557.address: Sheikh Zayed Road, Trade Center 2,P.O. BOX 126452
127557.description: Welcome to Rose Rayhaan by Rotana - the world's third tallest hotelSetting a benchmark for comfort and style in Dubai, soaring 333 metres, 72 storeys and the World's third tallest hotel, Rose Rayhaan by Rotana located in a prime location of Sheikh Zayed Road, 3 mins away from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) and a step away from Financial Centre metro station is the flagship property of the alcohol-free brand, Rayhaan Hotels & Resorts. The hotel is near Dubai Mall and 15 minute drive from Dubai International Airport. The hotel delivers a refreshing combination of contemporary sophistication and innovative technology with 462 luxurious rooms and suites offering panoramic views of Dubai overlooking Burj Khalifa. This landmark of Arabian hospitality is a home to 3 Food & Beverage outlets, each with its own distinct sense and place. With a capacity of 160 guests, Petals restaurant is an abode for casual yet stylish all day dining offers mesmerizing high-quality food which caters to the excellent variety of dishes for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The conference area located on two floors, features 7 meeting rooms, all equipped with the latest audio-visual facilities, wire-free connections and facets. The hotel's recreation area, Bodylines Fitness and Wellness Club provide a fully-equipped gymnasium, outdoor temperature-controlled rooftop swimming pool for adults and children, beauty salon, treatment rooms for massage and skin care as well as a separate sauna, steam room and hot tub.

127758.description: Built in 1913, this hotel graces one of Buenos Aires' main avenues, placing you in the heart of the city near major attractions. Partially restored in 2009, it retains its original character while boasting a refreshed look with bold colors. The spacious guest rooms include full bathrooms. Enjoy breakfast Monday through Saturday from 7:00 a. m. to 10:30 a. m. , and Sundays and holidays from 7:00 a. m. to 11:00 a. m. For groups booking more than five rooms, different policies and additional supplements may apply.

127785.description: Located 150m from the Gran Via, Inhala Hotel Garden -former Hotel SantoDomingo- is an urban shelter where nature and elegance merge. Its iconic hanginggarden surrounds the hotel in a fresh and calm environment, creating a true oasis inthe very centre of the city. Free wi-fi is available in all rooms, each with its own unique design. The buffet breakfast offers a varied and complete selection of products, includedgluten-free options. Enjoy its panoramic roof -top terrace, open all year around, and taste its deliciousdishes and cocktails, with the best views over the capital. In summer the terraceturns into a swimming-pool surrounded by vegetation, the perfect place todisconnect. Open from June to September. In addition, the hotel offers a public car park and shuttle service to the airport (with asuplement). Just a 5-minute walk from the Puerta del Sol, near the Plaza Mayor and the RoyalPalace, and 15 minutes away by underground from the Santiago Bernabeu stadium, the hotel is the perfect location from which to explore Madrid. The hotel is a great option for those who want to experience Madrid’s night life, eattapas, go shopping and visit the city’s best museums, theatres and musical shows. Enjoy an unforgettable experience in Inhala Hotel Garden, where nature comes alivein the heart of the city.

127800.description: This 4-star beach hotel was constructed in 1999 and refurbished in 2008. Occupying 12, 000 m2, the resort has a total of 196 rooms, made up of a main building and club rooms located in villa-style blocks covered in purple bougainvillea. Situated in the district of Konakli, approximately 12 km west from the popular resort of Alanya, there are some local amenities within a 15-minute walk and public transport runs 100 m from the hotel. Free internet access is available in the hotel lobby; a laundry service (for a fee) and a car park are also provided.

127825.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages and body treatments. After dipping into one of the 3 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy international cuisine at El Sabor de Las Nubes, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge and an ocean view. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the beach bar or the poolside bar. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available on request) and a cruise ship terminal shuttle. Make yourself at home in one of the 27 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private balconies. Cable television is provided for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Paseo Kuka Beach Path - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Holbox Beach - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Punta Mosquito Beach - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Pajaros Island - 1. 5 km / 1 mi- Main Square - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Whale Shark Pier - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Holbox Letters - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Holbox Church - 2. 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Holbox Ferry - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi- Holbox Baseball Park - 2. 6 km / 1. 6 mi- Bioluminescence Beach - 4. 5 km / 2. 8 mi- Punta Coco Beach - 4. 5 km / 2. 8 mi- Punta Coco - 4. 6 km / 2. 9 mi- Passion Island - 5 km / 3. 1 mi- When you stay at Las Nubes de Holbox in Isla Holbox, you'll be on the waterfront, within a 5-minute walk of Holbox Beach and Paseo Kuka Beach Path. This upscale hotel is 0. 1 mi (0. 1 km) from Punta Mosquito Beach and 0. 1 mi (0. 1 km) from Pajaros Island.

127828.description: Stay at the Grand Hotel Colonial Cancun in the heart of Cancun, just a short drive from Cancun Mall and the Convention Center. Enjoy a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, relax in the garden, or take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The hotel's 47 air-conditioned rooms feature LCD TVs with satellite programming, desks, and ceiling fans. Bathrooms are equipped with showers, and housekeeping is provided daily. Nearby attractions include Las Palapas Park and Cristo Rey Church, both within walking distance. Cancun International Airport (CUN) is approximately 18. 1 km away.

127834.address: Cumhuriyet Mah. Prof.Celal Oker Sok. Harbiye-Sisli, 5
127834.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This hotel also features concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and a hair salon. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 19 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature bathtubs or showers, hair dryers, and slippers.

name.content: Four Seasons Hotel Istanbul at the Bosphorus

127835.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, and a spa tub. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at the hotel's restaurant, Aqua, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 170 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and DVD players. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

127837.description: This elegant hotel is situated in the heart of Istanbul's old town, within a short walk to some of its most important sights such as Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque and the Galata Bridge and Tower. A metro stop can be reached within 10 minutes, the airport is about 12 km away. The hotel offers 116 tastefully decorated guest rooms. Each comes equipped with air-conditioning, LCD TV and a large and modern bathroom with shower and toiletries. Guests can try traditional Turkish cuisine at the on-site restaurant while enjoying stunning views of the Marmara Sea from its spacious terrace. The hotel also features a spa centre where guests can relax with a Turkish hammam and massage facilities.

127840.description: In a prime location, a few metres from Cleopatra's Beach in the popular resort of Alanya on Turkey's Mediterranean Coast, guests can walk to the centre brimming with shops, restaurants and bars or take a short bus ride. Here, guests can view the old dockyard and Arsenal, the Red Tower and Damlatas Cave, while a steep climb or couple of minutes' bus ride reaches Alanya Castle which perches on top of a rocky peninsula. Featuring a small pool with bar and restaurant, guests may also benefit from a private section of the beach for lazy days sun-bathing or swimming in the turquoise sea. The hotel offers comfortable accommodation and provides a good base for those enjoying both a beach holiday and also the benefits of a large resort. Our All Inc. system is between 11:00 till 22:00 hours. Soft Alcoholic Drinks (Beer – Wine )Soft Non-Alcoholic Drinks (Cola , fanta, concentrated fruit juices, tea, coffe etc. ) All imported drinks, cocktails, fresh fruit juices, Turkish coffee, ice cream, ice tea and cappuccino are extra chargable. ***AIR CONDITIONING IS EXTRA PAYMENT FOR BED & BREAKFAST AND ROOM ONLY ACCOMMODATIONS*** ( PER DAY 3 €)

127861.description: Mia Pera Hotel & Spa is located in the heart of the cosmopolitan city of Istanbul, in an elegant building of French architecture of 19th century, a few meters from the commercial Istiklal Avenue and Pera Museum. The hotel boasts with comfortable rooms with a modern and elegant design as well as spectacular SPA with heated pool, bar with panoramic terrace at the top roof. Ideal for couples or families and cultural trips. Its event and conference rooms and facilities make it perfect for business meetings.

name.content: Onomo Hotel Cape Town -Inn On The Square

127881.description: Nestled in the heart of historic Greenmarket Square, ONOMO Hotel Cape Town – Inn On The Square invites you to experience stylish accommodation with modern amenities. Each room features a flat-screen satellite TV, free WiFi, and air conditioning, providing a comfortable retreat in the city center. The highlight of our hotel is the heated rooftop pool, offering panoramic views of Table Mountain. Our rooms also include tea and coffee making facilities, and each has a private bathroom with a shower for your convenience. Begin your day with a delightful English buffet breakfast at ONOMO restaurant, where South African cuisine and an extensive selection of local and international wines are also on offer. Relax on the outdoor terrace with a refreshing drink. For wellness enthusiasts, Inn on the Square boasts separate male and female sauna facilities.

127883.address: 76, August Krani Marg (Gowalia Tank) Near Cumballa
127883.description: This hotel enjoys an ideal location in the vicinity of the business district of South Mumbai and in close proximity to fast-food outlets, restaurants, renowned hospitals, consulates, banks with cashpoint services, shopping centres, historic venues and a bus station. Mumbai Central railway station is only 10 minutes' drive away and the hotel is 23 km from the international airport. This hotel features warm hospitality, cosy interiors, convenience and comfort, and offers reasonable prices, and has become a favourite among travellers. It is designed to suit the budget and tastes of the guests and to provide all they need for a memorable stay. The hotel is fully air-conditioned and offers efficient and friendly services at a very competitive price to tourists, business travellers and corporate executives alike. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby and room and laundry services. The rooms are well-equipped and designed to provide guests with all the basic comforts and facilities. All come with a private bathroom with hot/cold water 24 hours a day. They are also equipped with a telephone, a TV and a safe.

127884.address: Sadaf 3, King Salman bin Abdulaziz Street
127884.description: The SUHA JBR Hotel Apartments in Dubai are fortunate to occupy one of the best locations in the center of Dubai, within the famous JBR complex and just a short walk from the crystal-clear waters of Jumeirah Beach. Our apartments in the center of Dubai offer a range of options from one to four-bedrooms, making them perfect apartments for families in Dubai. A contemporary and spacious accommodation that provides comfortable living and dining areas and modern fully-equipped kitchens, as well as luxurious king-size beds, free cable TV and free Wi-Fi, among many other services and amenities. The SUHA JBR Hotel Apartments in Dubai are a fantastic choice, whatever the reason for your visit or the size of your travel group. Conveniently located near all of the most important business hubs such as Media City, Knowledge Village, Internet City and the Jebel Ali Free Zone, our apartments are also perfect for enjoying the Dubai beach life or amazing shopping and leisure opportunities. Book your stay now on the official website of the Suha JBR Hotel Apartments in Dubai.

name.content: Four Points by Sheraton Midtown Times Square

127886.description: Located in the heart of New York City, the Four Points by Sheraton Midtown-Times Square is within a 10-minute walk of Times Square and Broadway. This hotel offers 244 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions, pillowtop beds with down comforters, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Smart TVs with digital programming and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries are also provided. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the Gotham Bistro for lunch and dinner, or order room service during limited hours. Two bars/lounges and a buffet breakfast (available for a fee) are additional dining options. A fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a television in the common area are available for guest use. Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center and express check-in. Nearby attractions include Madison Square Garden, Bryant Park, and Macy's, all within a mile of the hotel.

127903.description: This attractive city hotel is set in the heart of Istanbul's cultural and historical peninsula just a short walk from the renowned Hagia Sophia, famous Topkapi Palace and iconic Blue Mosque. Visitors can watch thousands of years of history come to life while walking the ancient city streets just outside the hotel. Rooms are spacious and elegant with air-conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and safety deposit box, and guests can enjoy 24-hour room service or a traditional Turkish breakfast in the terrace restaurant with views of the celebrated Bosphorus. The hotel has its own full spa with an extensive list of services including massage, hamam and sauna, as well as an on-call doctor. With its attentive service, comfortable rooms and unbeatable location, this hotel is ideally suited to business travel as well as a jam-packed sightseeing holiday in the historic city of Istanbul.

127904.description: Welcome to HI NYC Hostel, a generously proportioned accommodation fully outfitted for your New York City stay. With a total of 110 guest rooms, our hostel ensures ample space and comfort for all guests. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the premises, allowing you to stay connected during your visit. Our commitment to exceptional service and guest comfort is underscored by our prestigious Green Globe 21 certification. Guests benefit from round-the-clock reception services, ensuring convenience and support whenever needed. At HI NYC Hostel, we prioritize your satisfaction with great amenities, events and personalized service, making your stay in NYC memorable and enjoyable.

127916.description: This hotel, built in 2009, is located in the heart of Palermo Hollywood, offering an exceptional urban stay. Nearby, guests will find numerous shopping areas, design exhibitions, cafes, libraries, museums, and the vibrant Buenos Aires nightlife. The hotel is 1. 5 km from the zoo and 3 km from the city center. This avant-garde design hotel provides distinct and refined accommodations where design and technology combine to create a welcoming atmosphere. The boutique hotel offers 30 rooms, including 6 junior suites, and features a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, lift, café, restaurant, Wi-Fi, room and laundry services, and paid parking.

128021.description: This hotel enjoys a privileged location linked with the main streets of the Cuzco district of Madrid. It is near Nuevos Ministerios and only a few minutes from the Juan Carlos I fairgrounds. In addition, the Santiago Bernabeu football stadium is 500 m away. Madrid-Barajas Airport is situated at a distance of approximately 15 km from the hotel. The building has a total of 61 air-conditioned rooms, provided with modern amenities such as satellite TV and Internet access. For the convenience of corporate travellers, the hotel offers an excellent meeting room which holds up to 50 people. The meeting room is especially recommended for seminars and business meetings and features all the necessary audio-visual equipment for all such events. The on-site restaurant can also be reserved for business meals. A car park is available for guests arriving by car.

128047.description: Set in nine acres of countryside, the Russ Hill Hotel is just 4 miles from London Gatwick Airport and offers value overnight accommodation before or after Gatwick flights. All 190 bedrooms have an ensuite bathroom, television, telephone, tea and coffee making facilities and hairdryer. The hotel's Rusper Restaurant serves typical English dishes. Light snacks and a wide range of drinks are served in the Garden Lounge Bar. An airport shuttle operates to and from the airport (payable). As of the 2nd June 2015 transfers to and from the airport are by taxi and cost approx. ?9. 00 each way. Please contact hotel for details

128081.description: The apartments are located in central Madrid, just a short stroll from Gran Via and with easy access to the legendary Puerta del Sol. The nearest metro station is just 100 m from the aparthotel and there are other convenient public transport links so guests can get around Madrid with ease. There are also a wide range of shopping and leisure options within easy walking distance. Barajas Airport is approximately 20 km from the hotel. The hotel has 12 apartments offering state-of-the-art facilities and they are ideal for families, groups or business people alike. Facilities include a hotel safe, lift access and WLAN Internet access. Each apartment features a bedroom and a living room. Towels, linen and bedding are provided. The apartment is very well-lit and suitable for up to four people. The well-furnished kitchen has a fridge, cooker, microwave and tea and coffee making facilities, and each apartment also features a balcony and an en suite bathroom with a shower. Other in-room amenities include a hairdryer, TV, safe, washing machine, ironing set, Internet access, air conditioning and central heating. From the airport, take metro line 1 (light blue) in the direction of Pinar de Chamartin and get off at Tribunal. Take the exit (Salida) marked Calle Barceló, cross the wider street and turn into Calle Barceló to the left. Take the first street on the left which will be Calle de Churruca, go straight and the first perpendicular street will be Calle Apodaca.

name.content: Mercure Chateau Fontainebleau Demeures De Campagne

128169.description: Located 47 miles (75 km) from Paris and a stone's throw from Fontainebleau castle, the hotel welcomes you to its beautiful building surrounded by a lush garden, ideal for family vacations or business meetings. Want to relax? You will love the tranquility of the comfortable rooms, but also our proximity to the famous Fontainebleau forest for long walks.

128182.address: C/Amsterdam, N°3 Campo De Las Naciones
128182.description: Discover the Novotel Madrid Feria and Airport, a great site next to IFEMA. Designed for the bleisure segment, it is perfect for leisure and business travelers. Enjoy soundproofed and contemporary rooms with AC, WIFI, Smart TV, tea and coffee service, and mini-bar. Indulge in our Taste breakfast buffet and enjoy our facilities: meeting area with nine meeting rooms, social hub, pool and fitness centre.

128188.description: ibis London Stratford positions you perfectly for your London getaway and, from check-in to check-out, we've got your every need covered. Our bar will keep you refreshed from morning to midnight, and our on-site restaurant offers a relaxing spot to enjoy a lazy lunch or an indulgent evening meal. So whether you're here to take in a show at the O2, shop 'til you drop at Westfield or take care of business at Canary Wharf, we've got you covered for a great stay.

128296.description: Located in the historical and cultural centre of Istanbul, the hotel's roof terrace overlooks Beyazid Square and the public library. The Hippodrome of Constantinople is a 20 minutes' walk, and links to the public transport network are roughly 150 metres away. Ataturk International Airport is situated at a distance of approximately 13 km and Sabiha Gokcen International Airport is some 70 km from the property. The stylish boutique hotel blends Ottoman with contemporary design. Comprising 48 guest rooms, the air-conditioned establishment welcomes guests to dine at the restaurant, treat themselves at the pastry shop or enjoy the outdoor terrace. The rooms are furnished and decorated in an attractive contemporary classic design and equipped with all necessary amenities.

128303.description: The property consists of 62 accomodation units. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. Atiskan Otel does not offer 24-hour reception. Some services may be payable.

128307.description: The hotel consists of 225 guest rooms. Guests can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the hotel. Those who stay at this establishment can enjoy the convenience of 24-hour reception. Visitors travelling for business purposes may take advantage of the property's business facilities.

128320.description: This hotel offers the perfect blend of historic Neoclassical charm and modern day luxury, an ideal contemporary elegant suburban sanctuary where a warm welcome is a tradition. Guests will be greeted in a warm and comfortable lobby which offers non-stop reception and check-out service and is decorated with flowers, elegant handcrafted wooden furniture and original artwork. Comprising of only 12 guest accommodations, the air-conditioned property can provide a unique level of personalized services. Guests can indulge in the taste for the finer things in the suite, distinguished by generous space and classical style and decorated in warm earth tones. The sleeping quarters are secluded from the living and working areas, ensuring privacy during informal meetings or while relaxing. Guests can enjoy a rich breakfast or a delicious Mediterranean cuisine in the brasserie by the swimming pool.

128324.description: This 5-star hotel is modern and contemporary, with exciting dining and recreation options only a few steps from the stunning Arabian Gulf beaches. All of our 297 rooms have balconies and free WIFI, in addition to partial sea views from some rooms and suites. The hotel is only 30 mins drive from Dubai International Airport and also offers a large swimming pool, wellness center, and fitness center. Modern meeting, conference, and banqueting facilities are available for event planners and corporate clients.

128325.address: Near Qatar Islamic Museum، Ras Abu Abboud St
128325.description:
The business hotel is located on Ras Abu Aboud Street within the city's major access routes and on the main road to the new Doha International Airport. The hotel is 15 minutes' drive from the airport, a short walk from Corniche Road and a short drive to most of the city's shopping centres.

This luxury hotel in the centre of Doha offers warm hospitality, an inviting atmosphere and top-notch services sure to please business and leisure travellers alike, perfect for organising any kind of corporate or social event. The air-conditioned business hotel offers 200 rooms  and welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and currency exchange facilities. Further facilities available to guests include a cafe, bar, restaurant, conference facilities, WLAN Internet access and room service.

The hotel offers newly renovated, welcoming and relaxing bedrooms, furnished in a modern design, each featuring a double to king-size bed and a private bathroom with a shower or bathtub and a hairdryer. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, wireless Internet access, a telephone, central heating, satellite TV, minibar, safe, tea and coffee making facilities and a desk. Non-smoking rooms are available on request.

The hotel is equipped with a large outdoor swimming pool, an indoor hot tub, a fully equipped gym and a sauna and steam room.

Guests can enjoy a cosmopolitan blend of Japanese, Asian, Indian, Arabic, European and Mediterranean cuisines prepared at the hotel restaurant. Breakfast is served each morning and set menu options are available for lunch and dinner.

128329.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 11 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 78 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Harun Sanat Galerisi - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Harun Art Gallery - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Harput Castle - 6. 9 km / 4. 3 mi- Hazarbaba Kayak Merkezi - 38. 4 km / 23. 9 mi- Lake Hazar - 38. 5 km / 24 mi. The nearest major airport is Elazig (EZS) - 11. 2 km / 7 mi With a stay at Marathon Hotel in Elazig, you'll be within a 10-minute walk of Harun Sanat Galerisi and Harun Art Gallery. This upscale hotel is 4. 3 mi (6. 9 km) from Harput Castle and 23. 9 mi (38. 4 km) from Hazarbaba Kayak Merkezi.

128351.description: Set in the heart of the Belgrano district, this elegant hotel is a 3-minute walk from Cabildo Avenue and the local high street. There are numerous restaurants and bars at just minutes from the venue, while the closest public transport stop is less than 100 metres away. The distance to Palermo is 2. 5 km and it is 3 km to the Recoleta and the tourist centre of Buenos Aires. The city establishment offers excellent personal service and all the comfort guests can expect. The apartment-style accommodation comes with a well-appointed kitchenettes with a minibar, and opens to either a balcony or a terrace. After a busy day, guests can unwind by using the spa and wellness facilities, which include a hydromassage tub, sauna, fitness room and offer a large variety of massage services.

128363.description:
Located in Kutahya, Qtahya Hotel is within a 10-minute drive of Donenler Mosque and Iznik Cini.  This hotel is 1.2 mi (1.9 km) from Kutahya Ceramic Museum and 1.2 mi (1.9 km) from Archeological Museum.
Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and a television in a common area.
Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.
You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Qtahya Hotel, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM.
Make yourself at home in one of the 35 guestrooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and complimentary bottled water.

128407.description: XO Hotels Infinity is located near Plein '40-'45. Near the hotel there is a small market which you can visit from Tuesday – Saturday. Across the street you can find the tram with connections to the Rijksmuseum and Amsterdam Central Station. The hotel rooms have a private bathroom, a flatscreen television, free WiFi and a Nespresso machine. Start the day with a delicious breakfast in the restaurant. From Schiphol Airport the hotel is easy to reach by bus. The stop is opposite the hotel and the travel time is about 40 minutes.

name.content: LE DIYAR Al Waha Hotel Riyadh

128408.address: Wadi Al Dawassir Street, 6 - Olaya Main Road
128408.description: The four-star LE DIYAR Al Waha Hotel Riyadh is located in Riyadh's burgeoning Olaya financial district, north of the city center. Nearby attractions include the Kingdom Centre and Al Faisaliyah Centre, as well as various ministries and government offices. The hotel offers 73 elegantly appointed rooms and suites, designed to accommodate both business travelers and families. All rooms feature 32-inch LCD TVs (suites boast 40-inch screens) and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy international cuisine at the Flamingo restaurant, open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, or indulge in delicious pastries at the Sunset Café. Additional amenities include the state-of-the-art Alwaha fitness center and an indoor swimming pool. For meetings and banquets, the hotel offers over 250 square meters of flexible event space, including the Al-Janadriya hall (capacity 100) and the smaller Al-Olaya meeting room, suitable for 20-30 attendees. Both venues are equipped with high-tech audiovisual equipment.

128414.description: Ideally located just steps from Place Vendôme and the Tuileries Gardens, Le Burgundy Paris is the perfect starting point to explore the city and experience its unique art de vivre. In the lively Madeleine district, surrounded by couture houses, fine jewelers and landmarks such as the Louvre and the Opéra Garnier, this address has combined history and modernity since 1850.

128429.description: The PORTOBAY HOTEL TEATRO is a 4-star hotel in Porto belonging to the PortoBay Group. After being fully refurbished in the first half of 2021, it is now reopening its doors with a fresher, brighter and fully rejuvenated image. It is located in the theatre district, right in the historical centre of the city, in Rua Sá da Bandeira. It is just a few steps from the city's main attractions including São Bento Station, Clérigos Tower, Porto Cathedral, Avenida dos Aliados, Lello Bookshop, Bolhão Market and the well-known Cais da Ribeira, the Douro riverfront. At the entrance, in the main common area of the hotel is the reception and lounge where subtle décor highlights Nordic elements, natural fabrics and light wood panelling. Next to the entrance, but with its own access, the Il Basilico restaurant offers Italian comfort food flavours in the bruschettas, tortelloni, pizzas and risottos that find their way to the tables. The Il Basilico bar serves some dishes from the menu when the restaurant is closed. This area can be completely open to the street giving the feeling of a porch or indoor terrace. The hotel has 75 spacious rooms (ranging from 19. 5 to 52m2), divided into 5 categories (Gallery, Tribune, Audience, Junior Suite, and Suite), which offer a contemporary, natural and comfortable style. The neutral tones and light woods give a warm atmosphere that can be felt throughout the hotel.

128432.description: Centrally located in Lisbon, Hotel Sete Colinas offers convenient access to Avenida da Liberdade and Rossio Square, both within a 5-minute drive. This hotel features 31 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers and bidets. Enjoy amenities such as bicycle rentals, a terrace, complimentary newspapers, and a banquet hall. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel also offers concierge services, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Nearby attractions include the Castle of São Jorge, Graça Viewpoint, and several prominent squares and gardens. Humberto Delgado Airport (LIS) is approximately 6. 1 km from the hotel.

128474.description: Nestled in a malaria-free private game reserve just a scenic 3. 5-hour drive from Cape Town, this lodge offers luxurious comfort amidst abundant wildlife, including the Big Five. Positioned at the gateway to South Africa's renowned Garden Route Coast, with the majestic Langeberg Mountains as a backdrop, the lodge is conveniently located 97 km from George Airport and 355 km from Cape Town Airport. Renovated in 2010, this family-friendly lodge features 34 spacious rooms, each adorned with an African theme. Guests can enjoy breathtaking sunsets from their west-facing balconies, conveniently located steps from the pool. Families will appreciate the proximity to lodge amenities. Expansive wooden decks overlooking the valleys provide tranquil spaces to unwind while listening to the sounds of the African night. The lodge offers a lobby and two distinct dining experiences. Each room includes a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, along with a TV and tea and coffee making facilities. Knowledgeable game rangers lead morning and evening game drives, sharing their expertise on the local wildlife and captivating African folklore. The lodge boasts two unique restaurants. The African Boma offers a hearty menu of traditional cuisine and chef's specialties, cooked over open coals in African pots, while Serengetis provides a more interactive dining experience. Guests traveling from Cape Town can take the N2 highway east for 348 km, finding the lodge entrance 7 km past Albertinia. Those arriving from George can take the N2 highway west for 85 km, locating the entrance 12 km after the Gouritz River Bridge.

name.content: Max Brown Hotel Ku’damm, part of Sircle Collection

128493.description: Centrally located close to the elegant Kurfürstendamm shopping street, Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church and the Theater des Westens, this hotel is ideal both for leisure and business travellers. ICC and the international trade fair centre are about 3 km away; all of the famous sights such as Brandenburg Gate are easily reachable by public transport. The rooms at this hotel are designed for guests to feel at home in no time. With suitable space, perfect in room size and cosy style, each room offers air conditioning, tea facilities, safe box, hair dryer, TV, telephone and bath amenities. Some rooms feature a view of the city or courtyard.

128503.description: Developed by one of the most successful and applauded hotel groups in the region, Centro is a contemporary concept that is young and fresh in its approach, original in its presentation, and dynamic in its offerings. It is designed for a new generation of travelling executives who demand both finesse and functionality at reasonable rates. Created for purpose - from the ground up - Centro signals the launch of a new genre of executive hospitality. With chic looks and slick delivery underlying its service offering, Centro is an inspired philosophy and sets an unparalleled benchmark for the budget conscious business traveller.

128551.address: 24-26, B.K. Boman Behram Marg Apollo Bunder
128551.description: The 3-star Diplomat Hotel offers comfort and convenience whether you're on business or holiday in Mumbai. Featuring a complete list of amenities, guests will find their stay at the property a comfortable one. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, 24-hour room service, facilities for disabled guests, express check-in/check-out are just some of the facilities on offer. Comfortable guestrooms ensure a good night's sleep with some rooms featuring facilities such as television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless, internet access – wireless (complimentary), non smoking rooms, air conditioning. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Discover all Mumbai has to offer by making Diplomat Hotel your base.

128601.address: Kadriye Mah. Beşgöz Cad. Üçkum Tepesi, 36
128601.description: Open on all four sides to the lush vegetation, luxury, entertainment and recreation opportunities on the large plot of land, this hotel offers it guests a chance to experience the greenery of the Taurus Mountains, the natural beauty of the pine trees, golf courses and sports fields, all nestled in a place guaranteeing an unforgettable holiday. Antalya Airport is 30 kilometres away and those arriving by car may leave their vehicle in the car park, which is especially convenient as the area is best explored on four wheels. Whether they prefer to swim in the sea – the beach is 2 kilometres from the premises – or in the calmer waters of the outdoor swimming pool, guests are sure to get all the sun, water and fun they need.

128604.description: This 20-storey tower hotel is located directly in the heart of the vibrant café society in downtown Cape Town. It places its guests at only a 5-minute walk from the city centre and some 200 metres from the famous Long Street. Overlooking the majestic Table Mountain and Lion's Head the venue treats to some amazing views of the entire area. After the exciting day guests can head to the Pool Deck on the 8th floor to relax and enjoy its airy ambience. From November to March they can also savour light lunches at the poolside bar or just refresh in the infinity pool. From sumptuous breakfasts to candlelight dinners, the continental-style restaurant offers an array of dishes that can satisfy any appetite or dietary requirement. The intimate 29-seat cinema works throughout the day and well into the evening, and is designed in a retro Sixties style for ultimate comfort and delight.

128607.description: The historic neoclassical building of this establishment is located in the centre of Athens, within walking distance of the business and commercial zones. The area around it is a part of the historical centre of city and offers plenty do to and see. Within a 5-minute walk guests can get to the train and bus station which allow easy access to the airport and the entire countryside. Through the Metaxourgio metro station, which sits at just 30 metres from the venue's front door, one can get to the Acropolis and Erechtheum, the Acropolis Museum, the Odeon of Herodes Atticus and the Ancient Market for less than 5 minutes. Guests who don't feel like exploring the surrounding area can take advantage of the onsite restaurant, which serves a great variety of traditional and international dishes. Before heading to their modern rooms they can opt for a relaxed drink at the elegant hotel bar.

128608.description: With panoramic views over the Grand Canal, Hotel Palazzo Giovanelli dates back to the 16th century. Saint Mark's Square is just 2 stops away on the water bus. Hotel Palazzo Giovanelli e Gran Canal offers large elegant rooms with original paintings, air-conditioning, and a flat-screen satellite TV. Breakfast is a varied buffet. Many rooms have exposed wooden beams on the ceilings, and a balcony with views over historic Venice and the Grand Canal. Some rooms overlook the inner garden. This former palace has been home to the Doge of Venice, and Mozart's family. The spacious lounges feature Murano-glass chandeliers and elegant Italian furniture. Venice Casino is a 2-minute ride across the canal. The multi-lingual staff at the 24-hour front desk can book water taxis on request. Santa Croce is a great choice for travellers interested in atmosphere, scenery and sightseeing.

128618.description:
Located in the heart of the commercial district, opposite the renowned Al Ghurair Retail City and Riqqa Street and around 1 km from Mamzar Beach, the hotel is well suited to business and leisure travellers alike. It is a five minutes' drive (approximately 8 km) from both terminals of Dubai International Airport.

The hotel has friendly and courteous staff promising a comfortable and rewarding stay to all its guests. Renovated in 2009, it provides an extensive range of facilities and warm, attentive service in a family atmosphere. Featuring a unique colour scheme and decor, the 39 luxuriously appointed guestrooms feature contemporary furnishings with carpet. The fine dining restaurant serves exclusive mouth-watering Indian and Chinese cuisine. Guests may also dine in the café. The air-conditioned hotel offers a lobby, 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom, lift access, a newspaper stand and a hairdressing salon. Furthermore, WLAN Internet access and both room and laundry services are available.

The rooms comprise an en suite bathroom with make-up mirror, hairdryer and shower/bath combinations. Tea and coffee making facilities, a mini fridge, Internet access, a safe and an ironing set are provided in the rooms. Large windows with soft, flowing drapes let in natural light. All accommodation includes a double bed or a king-size bed, air conditioning, satellite television, and a direct dial telephone for local calls.

To work up a sweat and stay in shape there is a wide choice of leisure facilities. An outdoor rooftop swimming pool will give guests an enjoyable and relaxing time in a traditional environment. Children can enjoy their own swimming area. Sun loungers and parasols have been laid out on the sun terrace for use.

128620.address: Al Mankhoul Street, Next to Al Fahidi Metro Stat, 87
128620.description: Regal Plaza is located centrally in commercial and business district of Bur Dubai, within a few minutes walk from Al Fahidi Metro Station and easy access to Dubai’s major attractions. The hotel features 87 spacious accommodations, each equipped with modern amenities such as air conditioning, LCD TV, electronic safe, mini bar and internet access. Guests can choose from various dining options at a number of in-house restaurants, lounge bars and night clubs. These include a 24/7 restaurant serving variety of snacks and sandwiches as well as a choice of fresh juices and aromatic coffees. Leisure facilities include a sauna, steam room, massage room, fitness centre and an outdoor temperature controlled swimming pool. Dubai International Airport is only 15 minutes drive away from the hotel.

128623.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at Orange Restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.

128624.address: Dubai Media City, Al Sufouh, Dubai
128624.description: The Media One Hotel, a vibrant and stylish international hotel, is located in Dubai Media City, just a short walk from the Nakheel metro station. This puts it within easy reach of key attractions: 3 minutes from the metro, 10 minutes from the nearest shopping mall and beach, 15 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 25 minutes from the airport. The hotel boasts 264 modern rooms with stunning views of the Gulf or the Dubai skyline, each equipped with a Smart TV, free Wi-Fi, and a mini-bar. Guests can enjoy a state-of-the-art gym, a refreshing outdoor pool and sundeck, three restaurants, two bars, and a relaxing outdoor chill-out lounge and grill. Business travelers will appreciate the fully-equipped business center and seven meeting rooms. With ample parking and 24-hour room service, the Media One Hotel offers a comfortable and convenient stay.

128626.description: The Landmark Hotel Baniyas is located in Baniyas (Nasser) Square in Diera, close to the Gold Souk, Dubai Creek and Deira City Centre. The hotel is also just a few minutes walk to the metro station providing easy access to the city's main tourist destinations. Accommodations are equipped with individually controlled air-conditioning, satellite TV, mini bar, safe deposit box, work desk, WiFi access and en suite bathroom with hairdryer. The hotel offers a choice of two restaurants with buffet and a la carte menus featuring Chinese and international dishes. Other facilities include an outdoor pool, sauna, steam room, well-equipped gym, conference rooms and a business centre. Tours, transit visa processing and airport and beach transfers can also be arranged on request. Dubai International Airport is approximately within a 15-minute drive from the hotel. *Daily Beach Transfer for free : 08:30 – Hotel – AL Mamzar Beach / 12:30 – Al Mamzar Beach – Hotel

128627.description: The Landmark Plaza Baniyas hotel, conveniently located near Baniyas Metro Station in Al Nasser Square, offers modern amenities including Wi-Fi, air conditioning, satellite TV, and a private bathroom. Guests can enjoy two dining options: a restaurant serving diverse cuisines and a 24-hour cafe. Recreational facilities include a fitness center, sauna, and jacuzzi. Explore nearby attractions such as Dubai Creek and the Gold Souk, or take advantage of the complimentary daily beach shuttle to Al Mamzar Beach. Dubai International Airport is a short 15-minute drive away.

128642.description: Situated in a historic Venetian building, this elegant hotel is just 300 meters from Saint Mark's Square and 1km from Venice Santa Lucia Train Station, easily accessible via waterbus route 1 to Santa Maria del Giglio. Each room features air conditioning, satellite TV, and in-room breakfast service. Refurbished with exquisite Venetian-style decor, this sixteenth-century palace offers guests a truly special experience. A bar and Wi-Fi are also available.

128650.description: Enjoy a central Venice stay at Hotel Casanova Venezia, steps from St. Mark's Square and a 3-minute walk from St. Mark's Campanile. This hotel offers 50 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Conveniences such as safes, desks, and phones are also provided. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM. Additional amenities include room service (limited hours), dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and tour/ticket assistance. Nearby attractions include St. Mark's Basilica and Teatro La Fenice, both within a short walk.

128653.description: Located in Venice's exclusive Dorsoduro district, this renovated hotel offers 15 elegant Venetian-style rooms. Just steps from the Accademia di Belle Arti and Ca' Foscari University, guests can easily walk to iconic landmarks like the Rialto Bridge and St. Mark's Square. Each comfortable room features a private bathroom, satellite TV, safe, hairdryer, air conditioning, minibar, direct dial telephone, and internet access. A continental breakfast buffet is served daily. The hotel also provides a safe, TV lounge, and room service (fees may apply). Please note: Reception is open from 8 am to 3 pm and 4 pm to 9 pm. Guests are kindly requested to advise their arrival time at least 24 hours in advance and send a copy of their ID to receive an access code for automatic check-in. For any emergencies, please call +39 041 710896. Daily cleaning service is not included for apartments located in the annex building but can be requested for €50.

128654.description: The hotel is near the San Tomà ferry stop, in Venice's busy university district. Santa Lucia Railway Station is 700 m away and distance walk to Rialto Bridge is 10 min. The hotel offers free Wi-Fi access in the hall and in the garden. The Internet point in the lobby is also free of charge. All rooms are provided with satellite-TV, air conditioning, hair-drier, heating and telephone. A typical Italian breakfast is served daily. In warm weather breakfast is served in the garden.

128655.description:
Set in a 16-th century building just 300 metres from Saint Mark's Square, Hotel Torino is just off Calle Larga XXII Marzo, the main shopping street in Venice. The Baroque-style rooms have offer free Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and air conditioning. 

All rooms are en suite, and most are located in the main building, which is complete with a lift. Other guest rooms and apartments are in nearby buildings. 

Breakfast can be brought to your room on request. Other services include a 24-hour front desk, and a luggage deposit that is also available after check-out for the rest of the day. 

Torino Hotel is well connected by water bus, being close to the Santa Maria del Giglio stop, on line 1, and San Marco Vallaresso on line 2.

128656.description: Relax in the spa tub or enjoy rooftop terrace views at the Exis Boutique Hotel in Athens. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy amenities such as concierge services and a common area television. Dine at the on-site coffee shop/cafe, or order 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfast is available daily for a fee. The hotel offers a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and an elevator. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. Each of the 26 air-conditioned rooms features a DVD player, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. A desk and a phone with free local calls are also provided. The hotel is conveniently located near Pedion Areos Park, the National Archaeological Museum, and other key attractions. Syntagma Square and the Acropolis are a short drive away.

128662.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Madrid? This hotel has 2519 square feet (234 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 122 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature rainfall showerheads and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones and safes, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.
