128674.description: This hotel is located in the centre of Cancun, just 15 minutes from impressive local beach. The beach of Punta Cancun is 2 km away and it is 10 km from Playa del Carmen and 40 km to Merida. Local and international restaurants, bars and lively nightclubs can be found in the surrounding streets. The famous Mercado 28 craft market is also nearby. El Meco Mayan ruins are within a short drive of the hotel, while Cancun International Airport is a 25-minute drive away.

128699.description: Surrounded by a vibrant dining scene, colorful bars, and unique shops, our hotel puts you within walking distance of the best of the City of London. We're a half-mile walk from Spitalfields Market, Brick Lane, and the Jack the Ripper Museum. Aldgate East Station is a five-minute walk from our doors, and the Tower of London is less than 10 minutes away.

128702.description: This superb design hotel is very nicely situated on the famous known Waterloo Road, just 5 minutes' walk from Waterloo Tube Station. Guests will be able to reach on foot a number of touristic and cultural attractions, such as the London Eye, the River Thames, Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament. Waterloo Train Station is approximately 600 m away. London Heathrow is at a distance of approximately 29 km, London Luton at some 45 km and London Gatwick and London Stansted are both at around 50 km from the hotel. The H10 London Waterloo has bright, recently renovated modern rooms, with laminate wood flooring, that are equipped with all the amenities you could need for a comfortable stay. Classic superior rooms - 19 m² room with modern décor and large picture windows with street views. Classic Superior Sky View rooms - 19 m² room located on the upper floors, with modern décor and large picture windows that offer panoramic views of London **Important note: The Sky Bar will be closed on the 31st December 2026.

128759.description: A boutique Hotel designed by the highly celebrated Spanish firm Kikekeller. 7 Islas Hotel is located in the creative hearty of Madrid between the Gran Vía and the vibrant Malasaña neighborhood. The Hotel design aspires to bring art lovers, cultural adventurers and business eclectics a unique local experience. It's 79 rooms allows for a bespoke service for each and every guest with many options available for hosting business events.

128762.description: This hotel is situated in the residential district of Castellarnau, in the small town of Sabadell, close to the local main roads. It is 4 kms from the centre of Sabadell and 30 kms from El Prat Airport. The establishment comprises a total of 100 rooms with modern, well-maintained interiors. Guests may enjoy relaxing in the hotel bar after an eventful day. Further facilities include complimentary Internet access and parking facilities for those arriving by car. The well-kept rooms include an en-suite bathroom and individually regulated air conditioning. Guests can also take advantage of other in-room amenities, such as a TV or Internet access. Breakfast may be selected from a buffet each morning.

name.content: Four Points By Sheraton Manhattan Chelsea

128763.description: Located in Manhattan's vibrant Chelsea neighborhood, the Four Points by Sheraton Manhattan - Chelsea is a short walk from iconic attractions like Madison Square Garden and 5th Avenue. This smoke-free hotel offers 158 comfortable guestrooms, each featuring a pillowtop bed, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and cable programming. Private bathrooms include designer toiletries and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy convenient amenities such as express check-out, a 24-hour front desk, bellhop services, and multilingual staff. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include the Empire State Building and Times Square.

128771.description: The hotel is located in the heart of one of the most gorgeous landscapes in the district of Vila Real, Alvão national park. It lies in the municipality of Mondim de Basto about 3 kms from the town centre. Porto Airport is 100 kms away. This charming, family-friendly hotel forms the perfect symbiosis between the comfort of a modern establishment and the surrounding natural landscape. It comprises a total of 42 comfortable rooms, all overlooking the river Tâmega. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment guarantee a pleasant and enjoyable stay. The rooms are appointed in elegant and contemporary style and include a terrace with a spectacular view. Guests can indulge themselves in the SPA centre, or relax on the sun loungers by the swimming pool.

128787.description: Stay at the luxury, 4* Pestana Chelsea Bridge Hotel and enjoy London's trendy Chelsea Wharf development. Nestled between scenic Battersea Park, the river Thames and the iconic Battersea Power Station, our hotel features 217 spacious, modern bedrooms, including one and two-bedroom Suites. Each one is equipped with individual bath and shower facilities. Pestana Chelsea Bridge's excellent facilities and first-class service make it a perfect fit, whether you're visiting on business travel, enjoying a family vacation or a weekend for 2. The Hotel's ideal location allows guests to enjoy easy access to the city's major attractions, without compromising the opportunity to relax in the tranquil surroundings of Battersea Park, alongside the River Thames. Our Restaurant will be open for breakfast from 7am to 11am and our Bar will be operating between 12pm to 10. 30pm for drinks and from 12pm to 10pm for food. Our Room Service is available from 5pm to 10pm. Kindly note that our Spa facilities, which includes the indoor pool, sauna, steam room & Spa treatments has reopened and our Gym is available 24hours.

128801.description: This 4-star hotel is located in Póvoa do Varzim, close to the beach and less than a 30-minute drive from the centre of Oporto. Ideal for business or leisure travelers, this hotel has 8 conference rooms with natural light, a restaurant, a bar, private parking, pool, tennis court and a terrace. The hotel's privileged location and easy access to good highways make it easy to move to and from local points of interest.

128803.description: This remarkable residence standing in the very heart of Paris is refined and cosy and welcomes its guest with charming and personalised décor. Located only a few metres from the Arc de Triomphe it is close to all the boutique stores, the Palais des Congres and Porte Maillot, while the world's most famous street - Champs Elysée, is a 15-minute walk away. Guests will also have the advantage of convenient links to the public transport network that stop on the hotel's doorstep. After the busy days the venue offers everything needed for proper relaxing. It can treat its patrons to a soothing massage or melt their stress away in the sauna. Afterwards a fresh juice from the onsite cafe will help with revitalizing the body and those who want something a little stronger can visit the bar.

128859.description: CIN: IT015146A1EIHP4W43In the heart of Milan, in via Santo Spirito, between Via Montenapoleone and Via della Spiga, a short walk to the Duomo, this hotel is for travelers who appreciate style and impeccable service. The city's most prestigious shops, exclusive boutiques and superb restaurants are within easy reach of hotel. Attractions in the area include the Galleria d'Arte Moderna, the Biblioteca Ambrosiana, Palazzo Reale di Milano and Duomo di Milano. Guests will find public transportation links (bus and metro) 200 m from the hotel.

128867.description: The hotel is positioned at the start of the causeway leading to the Pearl-Qatar project. It is minutes away from the city's financial and commercial centre and places of cultural and historical interest. The property is situated only 20 kms from Doha International Airport. The rooms are decorated with contemporary Arabian touches that are complemented by a work desk and a marble en suite bathroom with walk-in rainfall shower and separate tub. The hotel provides a 400-metre luxury private beach, outdoor swimming pool and fully equipped gym. Guests can entice their senses at the Rocca poolside restaurant overlooking landscaped gardens and the west bay lagoon. Diverse cuisine of the Mediterranean and authentic fare from France, Greece, Italy, Morocco, Spain and Turkey is prepared in a lively open kitchen and wood-fired oven. The hotel is the perfect location for unforgettable memories.

128884.description: This hotel is located just minutes from Milan's Navigli district with quick access to the city's business and cultural areas. Milan Linate Airport is 9 km away, while Milan Malpensa Airport is 35 km distant. Housed in a modern building, it is Milan's largest congress hotel, offering services for business travellers, conventions, exhibitions, etc. Amenities include a 24-hour reception, hotel safe, bar, gym and garage facilities. Each room is soundproofed, with modern furnishings featuring a private bathroom with shower and hairdryer, double bed, direct dial telephone, safe, minibar, and satellite TV with Sky channels. Individually regulated air conditioning, a balcony or terrace, non-smoking rooms, and accessible options are also available. Hotel achieved DCA sustainability certificate in 2025.

129684.description: Enjoying an enviable setting at the heart of Sint-Niklaas, this upscale hotel offers the perfect choice for discerning business and leisure travellers visiting the area. The hotel is located in close proximity to a number of prominent attractions and points of interest in the area. This wonderful hotel lies just a 20 minutes' walking distance away from the Grand Place, at the centre of the city. This marvellous hotel enjoys a sleek, sophisticated architectural style. The interior is sumptuously designed, featuring elegance and luxury at every turn. The guest rooms are superbly appointed, offering a peaceful setting in which to work and rest in comfort. This wonderful hotel invites guests to enjoy delightful dining, complemented by live music over the weekends, ensuring a truly enjoyable stay.

name.content: The Green Park Pendik Hotel & Convention Center

129694.description: The Green Park Pendik is located in the Pendik district of Istanbul, where transportation can be provided by both air and rail transportation as well as land and sea transportation. It is only 400 meters from Marmaray station, 1 km from the ferry port in Pendik, 20 km from the Istanbul Formula 1 track, and only 13 km from Istanbul Sabiha Gökçen Airport. The hotel offers its guests a unique accommodation experience for business, entertainment and touristic trips. There are luxurious and comfortable rooms, restaurants that will add privilege to your business and private meals, world cuisine at gourmet standards, as well as a SPA & Fitness center where you will feel pleasant and special. The facility, which is ready to host different organizations; In addition to hosting 55 meeting rooms and 1 auditorium, it offers guests the option to have a pleasant time with its nightclub, bar and swimming pool. The Green Park Pendik outdoor swimming pool usage fee is determined as 500 TL for hotel guests and 800 TL for external participants.

129703.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, a sauna, and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge) that operates within 10 km. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Feathers & Flatcaps, for lunch or brunch. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 3 bars/lounges. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and a meeting room.

129713.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy international cuisine at BaB Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Meet other guests and eat at the complimentary reception. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-out. Planning an event in Marrakech? This hotel has 108 square feet (10 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 45 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and plasma televisions are provided for your entertainment. Bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. 129723.description: The Faena Hotel Buenos Aires is a 5-star design hotel housed in an impressive building. Located in the exclusive Puerto Madero district, it offers luxurious accommodations, a spa, a pool, a bistro, and a wine cellar. Guest rooms feature elegant decor, automatic velvet curtains, Venetian blinds, home theater systems, and minibars. The white and gold Italpast restaurant serves international cuisine. Guests can also explore a dedicated wine cellar showcasing a wide selection of Argentine wines. Attendance at our New Year's Eve party is mandatory for guests staying on December 31st, for an additional fee. For more details, please contact the hotel at reservations@faenahotels. com or +5411-4010-9070. Please note that a credit card is required as a guarantee at check-in.

129780.address: Derb Al Aati Allah Hay Salam, 11 1
129780.description: Riad Al Ksar & Spa is a charming riad with a swimming pool, nestled in the heart of the Medina. Ideally located for exploring the Medina on foot, it's less than a 10-minute walk from Jemaa El Fna, the souks, and museums such as Bahia Palace, Badi Palace, the Saadian Tombs, and Dar Si Said Museum. This spacious and comfortable nine-bedroom boutique hotel offers numerous 24/7 services, including a spa, free Wi-Fi, a superb panoramic terrace, homemade breakfast, a bar, a restaurant, excursions, airport transfers, and 24-hour access. Each bedroom features air conditioning, a private bathroom, and percale cotton bed linens. Spa treatments, including hammam scrubs, massages, and body treatments, are available by reservation. Please note, a city tax of €3/night/person (35 dirhams/night/person) is payable upon arrival (children under 12 are exempt). In case of no-shows or early departures, a 100% fee applies. Direct payments can be made in EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, or MAD (currency exchange to MAD available at the hotel).

129781.description: The Es Saadi Gardens and Resort is nestled in an eight-hectare park in the heart of Marrakesh. Shaded pathways lead you through the grounds to the hotel, palace, villas, restaurants, swimming pools, spas, and the Casino de Marrakesh. Facing the snow-capped Atlas Mountains, the palace features sumptuous decor created by master Moroccan craftspeople. Ninety spacious suites offer meticulous and artistic decoration. Each uniquely themed villa showcases distinctive oriental architecture, ranging from 120 to 200 square meters, with grounds spanning 400 to 1200 square meters. Private gardens and heated pools complete the luxurious experience.

129783.description: Located in one of Marrakesh’s newest residential areas, Labranda Targa Club Aqua Parc is housed in a modern structure with all that is required for a relaxing holiday. Our family hotel in Marrakesh is equipped with a wide portfolio of rooms ranging from studios to suites and an all-day dining restaurant serving international cuisines and live cooking stations. At Labranda Targa Club Aqua Parc Marrakech hotel, guests can enjoy a cool daily swim in its majestic pool. For an adventurous experience, guests can even have a ride in one of our water park slides, suitable for all ages.

129796.description: This high-quality hotel is located on the key transportation crossroads of Catalonia, on the intersection between the AP-7 motorway, running from south to north, joining up with France and major Spanish cities. The business hotel is a 5-minute drive from the train station and a 20-minute drive from the city centre, the beach, the port and the trade fair grounds. El Prat de Llobregat Airport is approximately 22 km away. This air-conditioned establishment offers every comfort necessary and spacious rooms equipped with the latest technology for all kinds of business and leisure events. Each room features an en-suite bathroom and guests can make use of the WLAN Internet access and satellite TV.

129798.description: Enjoy a range of recreational amenities at the Wilderness Beach Hotel, including an outdoor pool, tennis court, and sauna. Stay connected with Wi-Fi (surcharge) or wired internet access (surcharge) in one of the 150 guestrooms, each featuring a flat-screen television and private balcony with satellite programming. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel also offers babysitting services (surcharge), gift shops/newsstands, and a convenient shopping shuttle (surcharge). Dine at the Garden Grill restaurant with its garden view or enjoy room service. For business travelers, a business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services are available. Event facilities include a conference center and two meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available 24/7 for a surcharge, and free self-parking is onsite. Located near the Cape Floral Region Protected Areas and Wilderness National Park in the Garden Route, the hotel is a short drive from attractions such as the Wilderness Lagoon and the Map of Africa View Point. The preferred airport is George (GRJ).

129799.address: Garhoud Road Opposite City Center Mall, Deira, 27
129799.description: Located just 3. 2 km from Dubai International Airport, Leela Hotel offers modern, air-conditioned accommodations with complimentary Wi-Fi. A 24-hour front desk and an on-site restaurant cater to guests' needs. Less than a 5-minute drive from Raintree Hotel and 4 km from Dubai Festival City, Leela Hotel also provides free private parking. The spacious rooms and suites feature flat-screen satellite TVs and private bathrooms with luxury amenities. Select accommodations include a separate living room with a DVD player and an iPod docking station. Guests can enjoy a refreshing swim in the outdoor pool or work out in the well-equipped gym. Additional conveniences include luggage storage, room service, and laundry and ironing services. A shuttle service is available upon request for a fee. This hotel is also rated for offering excellent value in Dubai.

129800.description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Sunday Hotel Holiday international Dubai. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.

Situated in the Embassy district, Holiday International Hotel offers modern rooms. It features a rooftop pool and a 24-hour restaurant. A free shuttle to the beach is provided. 
The spacious rooms at Bur Dubai come with a 32-inch flat-screen TV and a private bathroom. A work desk and an iron are in all rooms. 
International dishes are served at Anwar restaurant. Guests can enjoy a beer in Two Guineas, a traditional English pub. 
Burjuman Mall is within walking distance. Dubai International Airport is a 15 minutes' drive from Holiday International Hotel.

129801.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features a communal living room and barbecue grills. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are served on weekdays for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Cape Town? This hotel has 3089 square feet (287 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 38 air-conditioned rooms featuring plasma televisions. Your Select Comfort bed comes with premium bedding. Smart televisions are provided for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.
