129805.description: The hotel is situated right on the beach amidst the swaying coconut palms of Negombo. Nearby attractions include the Old Dutch Fort Gate, the Dutch Canal, old churches and sleepy fishing villages. The hotel is also conveniently located just a 15 minute drive from Bandaranaike International Airport. Featuring a beachfront location, the air-conditioned hotel is an ideal place for an unforgettable holiday. Guests can enjoy the outdoor swimming pool that also has a children's swimming area. The in-house restaurant offers a broad and varied à la carte menu featuring international as well as traditional Sri Lankan cuisine. The cosy bar is an ideal place to relax with a wide variety of coolers and cocktails. Stay at this hotel for a truly pleasant and unforgettable experience.

129813.address: Khaleed Bin Waleed Road , Computer Street , Bur Du
129813.description: This 3-star hotel, established in 1994, is located in Dubai's city center, near Burjuman Mall and the Al Fahidi station. The hotel offers a coffee shop and 103 well-appointed rooms, each equipped with a minibar, hairdryer, safe, trouser press, ironing set, and air conditioning. Guests can choose from a range of luxurious rooms and suites, all decorated and furnished to the highest standards.

129814.description: Nestled amidst 80 acres of lush gardens with the majestic Hajar Mountains as a backdrop, Hatta Fort Hotel offers a luxurious mountain retreat just an hour's drive from Dubai and ten minutes from the Omani border. This chalet-style hotel features spacious deluxe rooms and suites, each with a private balcony or terrace. Two-bedroom villas with private jacuzzis are ideal for families. Guests can enjoy two temperature-controlled pools, a beauty salon offering massages and wellness treatments, a golf driving range, mini golf, two floodlit tennis courts, and indoor table tennis and billiards. Target archery and guided four-wheel-drive excursions are also available. Dining options include two restaurants and two bars. The hotel also provides conference facilities and team-building activities. Explore the nearby red desert dunes and dried riverbeds of the Hatta region, as well as the Hatta Heritage Village. For guest safety, JA Resorts and Hotels has implemented a comprehensive program adhering to the World Travel and Tourism Council's SafeTravels program.

129816.description: Premier Hotel Cape Town is located in the beautifully tree-lined Marais Road on the Sea Point promenade in Cape Town, commanding spectacular views of Table Mountain and the awe-inspiring Atlantic Ocean. This Western Cape hotel is situated at the heart of the fairest Cape's tourism centre and attractions like Table Mountain, the world famous Victoria and Alfred Waterfront, Green Point Stadium and the beautiful Camps Bay and Clifton beaches surround this luxurious destination for both business executives and leisure travellers. Guests at the Premier Hotel Cape Town can enjoy wonderful evenings out in the cosmopolitan area of Cape Town and then return to their comfortable rooms with mountain & sea views for pure relaxation. Alternatively, enjoy your favourite drink on the hotel deck at the Promenade Cocktail Bar while watching the sun set over the Atlantic Ocean. Whether you are looking for a business facility or stylish accommodation, we at Premier Hotel Cape Town welcome you to the best of Cape hospitality. Premier Hotel Cape Town offers guests 130 rooms that cater to every accommodation need, offering you a truly Premier experience, as well as conference facilities to suit every business traveller's needs. Premier Hotel Cape Town also has a pristine restaurant, serving delicious meals accompanied by excellent service and a relaxing atmosphere.

129849.address: Bonnington Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Cluster J
129849.description: Here at voco® Bonnington Dubai, we offer you the perfect place to relax and unwind, with excellent service from our friendly staff. Enjoy a great night's sleep in our comfy beds, take a soak in your standalone bathtub, and feel completely at home during your stay with us. voco® Bonnington Dubai hosts a range of vibrant dining experiences, including The Cavendish Restaurant, with its carefully crafted menu, and the award-winning Irish pub, McGettigan's. The Leisure Deck has sweeping views of the Dubai Marina skyline where you can enjoy the swimming pool, gymnasium, sauna and steam rooms. We also provide meeting rooms and event spaces, perfect for your every need. Located in the heart of bustling and cosmopolitan Jumeirah Lakes Towers, at voco® Bonnington Dubai, you are minutes away from Almas Tower, Dubai Marina and its beaches, and a short ride from a host of luxury shopping facilities and malls, restaurants, bars, and some of the world's top golf courses. Our 5-star hotel is just a short journey to the Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC), Dubai Expo 2020 site, Jebel Ali free zone, and within easy reach of both Dubai and Abu Dhabi international airports, making voco® Bonnington Dubai the ideal location to explore Dubai, be it for business or for leisure. Enjoy your stay with us.

129850.description: Experience a warm welcome and an uplifting ambiance at Capitol Hotel, one of Dubai's finest 4-star deluxe hotels. From arrival to departure, our facilities and services ensure comfort, efficiency, and guaranteed satisfaction. Strategically located in the heart of Bur Dubai's business district, the hotel is just minutes from the Dubai World Trade Centre, offering a prime location for both business and leisure travelers.

129855.description: This magnificent property lies in mesmerising city of Dubai, located within 11 kilometres from Dubai International Airport. The complex is set right next to one of the largest shopping centres in the region. Guests will find themselves within ease of access to multiple financial and business centres, vast number of dining options and entertainment venues. The hotel boasts exclusive design blending flamboyant Arabic elements with classical elegance. There is a variety of accommodation options including studios and one-bedroom apartments. Each of them consists of comfortable king-size bed, dining area, fully-equipped kitchenette, cloakroom and private bathroom. Patrons may dine on delicious European and Asian dishes in a delightful atmosphere of the on-site restaurant. The establishment features business centre and impressive meeting facilities. *

129856.address: Sheikh Zayed Road, P.O. Box 11189, Dubai
129856.description: This aparthotel is just a 10 minute drive from Dubai Mall, Jumeirah Beach and close to links to the metro. Dubai International Airport is a 15 minute drive away. The marble hallways lead to spacious one, two and three bedroom hotel rooms offering short and long stay options. With contemporary furnishings and decor, the hotel offers comfort and convenience whether visits are for business or leisure. There are 281 rooms in total at this aparthotel. The hotel has a fully equipped Nautilus gym including a power plate, sauna, hot tub, steam room facilities, a swimming pool with an outdoor hot tub and a children's pool. The hotel's Chelsea Garden Restaurant and Café offers à la carte menus for breakfast, lunch and dinner, with dishes from all around the world. Whether guests are in Dubai for business or leisure, the hotel makes their stay memorable.

129857.description: City Star Hotel is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Dubai. The hotel has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour security, photocopying, printer, taxi service, 24-hour front desk. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer carpeting, towels, television LCD/plasma screen, mirror, linens to ensure a restful night. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Convenience and comfort makes City Star Hotel the perfect choice for your stay in Dubai.

129858.address: Al Barsha Dubai - United Arab Emirates, 1 1
129858.description: The 30 fully furnished villas 'Family Villas only' are built around the edge of the complex, with all villas having a front door and private covered parking for two cars. The dining room and lounge of each villa overlooks the gardens, with all properties having their own terrace and many of them directly surrounding the swimming pool. There are patio doors to the lounge and the dining room, allowing all residents very easy access to the rest of the complex. On walking through the front door, there is a large hallway with stairs leading up to the 1st floor landing. The hallway leads through to a large open plan fully equipped state-of-the-art kitchen and very spacious dining and lounge areas, with enough room to entertain a large number of people. The rooms are bright and airy and have floor-to-ceiling windows. The villas are decorated in light pastel tones, enhanced with colourful soft furnishings and all have light coloured marble floors with colourful scatter rugs throughout. The stairs lead up to a lounge landing area furnished with sofas, chairs and coffee table and lead off to four bedrooms each with an ensuite bathroom.

name.content: Neues Schloss Hotel Zurich, Autograph Collection

129862.description: Centrally located in Zürich, the Neues Schloss Privat Hotel Zurich, Autograph Collection, is steps from Tonhalle Zurich and a short walk from the FIFA World Football Museum. This luxury hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Its 57 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, flat-screen televisions, and private bathrooms with designer toiletries. Guests can enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at Castellan's restaurant, room service, or drinks at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel also provides complimentary newspapers, dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and meeting/conference space.

129874.description: The hotel enjoys an exceptional location, right at the heart of the famous Palm Grove of Marrakech, and only 10 minutes from the excitement of the Jamaa-el-Fna Square. The property is nestled in a park of lush greenery featuring palm trees, olive groves and bougainvilleas. It is very quiet and an ideal site for families or couple retreats. Marrakech Station is about a 15-minute drive away and Marrakech-Menara Airport is approximately 5 km from the hotel. This air-conditioned historic property was renovated in 2010 and has a total of 10 guest rooms. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services. Facilities include a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and a cloakroom. It provides a TV lounge, complimentary wireless Internet access, a bar/lounge, a café, restaurant, a poolside bar and barbecue grills. There is a children's playground for the hotel's younger guests. On-site parking is complimentary. Recreational amenities at the hotel include an outdoor pool and a steam room. Furthermore, guests can take advantage of the hotel's room and laundry services. Bicycles may also be hired from the hotel. Delicately decorated, the rooms offer all the facilities one may need, such as a large en suite bathroom with a bath, high quality sheets, towels and a king-size bed. Moreover there is a TV, DVD player, safe, hairdryer, Internet access, individually regulated heating and air conditioning. Each room also has its own balcony or terrace. Guests can take a dip in the hotel's heated outdoor swimming pool. Refreshments are available at the poolside snack bar (fees apply) and sun loungers and parasols are laid out on the sun terrace. Guests can relax in the sauna or steam room and book themselves in for a massage or spa treatments (fees apply). Bocce and biking (hire fees apply) are other recreational options on offer and for fans of the fairway, Palmeraie Golf Club is located nearby, about a 5-minute drive away.

129876.description: With a stay at Greywalls Hotel and Chez Roux in Gullane, you'll be next to a golf course, just steps from Muirfield Golf Course and a 3-minute drive from Gullane Golf Course. This 5-star hotel is 13. 7 mi (22. 1 km) from Musselburgh Racecourse and 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Gullane Beach. Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor tennis court or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this Edwardian hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Grab a bite to eat at Chez Roux, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge, take in the garden view, and even dine alfresco. You can also stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 23 individually decorated guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

129878.description: The NH Buenos Aires Tango hotel is ideally located in the center of Buenos Aires, just off the Avenida de 9 Julio. It places guests within easy reach of the Colón Opera House, the famous Obelisco, and the theaters on Avenida Corrientes. You can reach the pedestrian Calle Florida in 10 minutes on foot for shops, bars, and dining, while the Sheraton Convention Center is only 700 meters away. The hotel also has great links to the rest of this large city since there is a metro station and a bus stop close by. NH Buenos Aires Tango has 108 relaxing rooms that feature a natural color scheme and hardwood floors. Many of the rooms overlook Avenida de 9 Julio and every single one comes with complimentary Wi-Fi. Each morning, our chefs prepare a delicious breakfast that includes sweet and savory options to satisfy all tastes. Lunch and dinner are available at the sophisticated and stylish NH Buenos Aires Tango Restaurant. You can also kick back with your favorite cocktail at the NH Tango bar on the first floor of the hotel. Amenities include a gym and sauna. There are also two meeting rooms for up to 150 people.

129884.description: The property consists of 79 rooms. This apartment hotel is ideal for families and groups as well as couples and business travellers. The establishment is wheelchair-accessible. The on-site car park may be useful to those arriving by car. Check-out is at . This establishment allows pets. Large pets are allowed on the premises. Located in the Olaya district of Riyadh, the Boudl Khurais is only one kilometre from the Al Faisaliyah Center. It offers spacious guestrooms with air conditioning and free Wi-Fi.

129887.description: The Boudl Al-Fayha'a is 33 km from King Khalid Airport. The hotel provides 24-hour front desk service and has an airport shuttle service available on request. Located in the Al-Solay district of Riyadh, Boudl Al-Fayha'a is only one kilometre from Eastern Ring Rd. It has an outdoor pool, and offers spacious guestrooms with air conditioning and free Wi-Fi. Al-Fayha'a rooms and suites have marble floors and modern furnishings.

129888.description: In Riyadh, the hotel offers panoramic views of the park. It has an outdoor swimming pool and a modern gym. Rooms include a flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi. Equipped gym with cardiovascular equipment and free weights. Guests who prefer to relax can have a drink by the outdoor swimming pool, which is surrounded by a lush green area and palm trees. Free parking is available onsite.

129891.address: Behind AlQasr Mall, AlSweedi Str With AlSultana St
129891.description: Located in Riyadh, Boudl Al Qasr offers modern accommodations. It offers free WiFi in public areas, an indoor children's pool and a fitness centre. Al Qasr Mall is a short walk away. Each unit will provide you with a flat-screen TV, air conditioning and a minibar. Featuring a bath or shower, private bathroom also comes with a hairdryer and free toiletries. Guests can enjoy local and international menu options at the restaurant or in the room. Room service is available 24 hours.

129896.description: Boudl Al-Woroud Hotel is a 5 km drive to Riyadh city centre. The rooms are decorated in light colours and are equipped with wooden furniture. Guests can also unwind in the hotel's indoor swimming pool. The hotel has a 24-hour coffee shop serving light snacks and drinks, and can provide room service to guests. There is a children's playground for the kids to play in. The lobby has 4 different waiting areas with a flat-screen TV. Free Wi-Fi is available to guests. Boudl Al-Woroud's 24-hour front desk offers laundry and ironing facilities as well

129898.address: Prince Mohamed Bin Abdul Aziz Street , City Center
129898.description: The hotel is situated at Jeddah, Tahlya street, the branch enjoys being in most luxury streets in Jeddah where important and vital commercial centers.

129909.description:
This hotel is a traditional dwelling located in a quiet derb (alley) in the médina of Marrakech, within the district of Ben Salah, which has kept all of its authenticity. The easy access makes it an ideal starting point for taking a walking tour of discovery through the historical heart of the city, the souks (market areas), and the Jemaa El Fna market place (700 m). Marrakech-Menara Airport is approximately 15 km from the hotel.

There are 5 rooms at this charming guest house, which is dominated by an intimacy created by the camaïeu of beige and chestnut and its splendid painted ceilings. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services. A TV lounge and a dining room are also on the premises. Two Moroccan living rooms face into the patio which features a fountain decorated with a Zellige terra cotta tiled mural. The courtyard also has a removable transparent cover. Furthermore, for guests' comfort the guesthouse offers reversible air-conditioning, free WLAN Internet access, a hotel safe, a laundry service and parking facilities (an extra charge applies for the latter).

The guesthouse offers 5 different rooms decorated in Moroccan style with engraved tadelakt plasterwork. Each has a private shower room and toilet, with a hairdryer and bathrobes. Rooms are furnished with double beds and they are equipped with reversible air conditioning and free WLAN Internet access.

The guesthouse has a heated swimming pool on the sun terrace where guests can relax on sun loungers under parasols. It also offers a hammam, a steam room and massage treatments (an extra charge applies). There is a golf club roughly a 10-minute drive away.

The hotel offers oriental cuisine with fresh market food at lunch or dinner, on request. A continental breakfast is served each morning.

129913.description: Enjoy a straightforward shuttle bus connection and get from the hotel to the airport in a matter of minutes. This newly-refurbished ibis budget hotel is designed for comfort and convenience, with spacious bedrooms available for up to four guests. All the rooms at this budget-friendly ibis hotel boast flat-screen TVs and clean, contemporary design features. The ibis budget London Heathrow Terminal 5 hotel is an ideal choice for leisure or business travelers who want to remain close to the airport.

129936.description: The hotel is situated in the new Diagonal Mar district of Barcelona, just 200 m from the nearest beach. There are several shopping and entertainment venues located in the area surrounding the hotel. Built in 2000, this hotel offers a total of 75 rooms spread over 5 floors. Various facilities are available to guests including an elegant foyer with lifts to upper floors and a 24-hour reception service. Guests can enjoy their favourite drinks in the on-site café. Those travelling on business may make use of the in-house Internet access and well-equipped conference facilities. Parking is available for guests arriving by car.

129940.description: Located in Doha's Diplomatic Area, at the north end of the Corniche, Somerset West Bay Doha is surrounded by embassies, consulates, and government institutions. City Centre mall is within walking distance. Nearby are major offices and skyscrapers, including Tornado Tower, the World Trade Centre, Burj Qatar, and the Qatar Petroleum District. The property offers easy access to Doha's promenade and the Lusail Expressway. A short drive away are attractions such as the Museum of Islamic Art, the Museum of Illusions, Mathaf, Katara Art Centre, the State Grand Mosque, and Souq Waqif.

129955.description: This luxurious hotel is located in the heart of Deira, Dubai's traditional commercial and shopping district. Just behind Al Reef Mall, the hotel offers easy access to beaches, malls and is only 10 minutes away from Dubai Airport. The smoke-free hotel features 154 rooms, 24-hour reception, express check-in and check-out, concierge service, currency exchange, WIFI, meeting rooms, 24-hour business centre, restaurant, fitness centre, wellness, outdoor pool and free on-site parking.

129956.description: The Nine Hotel, a premier boutique hotel in Dubai, offers luxurious accommodations for discerning travelers. A myriad of services and amenities ensure an exquisite stay. Located just minutes from Dubai International Airport, Dubai Expo, Al Ghurair Shopping Mall, and Al Mamzar Beach, the hotel features 125 tastefully designed rooms, including deluxe and executive suites. All rooms are equipped with a minibar, personal safe, direct-dial telephone, widescreen satellite television, iron and ironing board, bathtub, and 24-hour room service.

129973.description: Situated in the south of Madrid, this hostel is 30 minutes from the centre of the capital. This hostel provides efficient, economic and functional accommodation with luminous and quiet rooms with aire conditioning, and shared bathrooms outside the rooms. It offers free Internet access, vending machines, garage (for a fee) and a washing machine and dryer (for a fee). Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and may also make use of the hotel safe, lift access, the TV lounge or the garden. The perfect place to rest after an exhausting day visiting Madrid.

name.content: Room Mate Macarena, Madrid Gran Vía

129985.description: Right on the Gran Via you'll find Room Mate Macarena, Madrid Gran Vía, a modern hotel in the heart of the city. Just a few meters from the main spots of interest such as the Plaza Mayor, Puerta del Sol and Templo de Debod, it is also surrounded by theaters, bars and restaurants. All rooms are equipped with a private bathroom, air conditioning/heating, minibar, desk and some with views of the Gran Vía.

129987.description: These luxurious apartments are magnificently located in Dubai's city centre and close to banks, embassies, shopping malls and Dubai International Convention & Exhibition Centre. Visitors can enjoy plenty of nearby sightseeing attractions such as the Mall of the Emirates, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Wild Wadi Water Park and Dubai Museum. The property enjoys easy access as it is only 15 minutes from Dubai International Airport. All guests can pamper at their air-conditioned, spacious and fully-equipped apartments that include a complete kitchenette, a satellite TV, internet connection and an en-suite bathroom with a hairdryer. The premises are also provided with a fantastic roof top swimming pool with a hot tub and a sun deck ideal to relax, as well as a fitness room for those who wish to do some exercise. There is also a coffee shop that serves a delicious breakfast, lunch and dinner.

130004.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an outdoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and tour/ticket assistance. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Nuevo, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are available daily from 6:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 281 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment.

130006.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and tour/ticket assistance. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Nuevo, a restaurant which specializes in international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 30 square feet (3 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. A train station pick-up service is provided at no charge, and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 230 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions.

130008.address: St K Dubai Marina Dubai Marina, Po Box 73029,Dubai
130008.description: Situated along the gorgeous waters of the Arabian Gulf, our hotel overlooks the beautiful coastline and spectacular architectural masterpieces of Dubai. Visitors can enjoy the beach year round thanks to constant warm temperatures, and impressive malls make the city a retail oasis in the Arabian Desert. Our rooms and long-lease apartments feature a minimalist design by Matteo Nunziati along with essential conveniences like a kitchen. Dubai has an amazing transportation system and the Radisson Blu offers ample parking to simplify your visit. The well-equipped Al Marsa conference room makes the perfect venue for gatherings of up to 40 attendees. Our meeting specialist is happy to assist with catering and logistics.

130010.description: This comfortable hotel is the ideal choice for visitors eager to explore this exciting and lively metropolis. Situated in the bustling market area of Deira, it is just 10 minutes' drive from Dubai International Airport and 100 metres from Al Nasser Square and Baniyas Square metro station. It is the perfect base from which to visit old and new Dubai and also enjoy the fabulous shopping malls. This large hotel offers comfortable double and twin rooms as well as executive suites. The Wi-Fi connection and desk make this an ideal choice for business travellers and other facilities include a safe and minibar. Services include express check in and out, transfers to and from the beach and airport. There is a sauna, steam room, gym and rooftop swimming pool and guests can also enjoy a range of superb dining experiences at the restaurants serving Asian, Arabic and international dishes.

130012.address: Close to Mashreq Metro Station, Near Mall Emirates, N/A
130012.description: On the famous Sheikh Zayed Road, this excellent hotel is just 800 metres from the famous Mall of the Emirates and Ski Dubai. Mashreq Metro Station is a mere 100 metres away. This hotel features a rooftop swimming pool offering panoramic views of Dubai. It offers modern, self-catering studios and apartments with complimentary WiFi access, ideal for those who want to stay in contact with their loved ones. The apartments also come with a fully equipped kitchen that allows guests to cook in. Guests can enjoy the sun at the deck surrounding the rooftop pool. They may also opt for a workout in the fitness centre that comes with cardio equipment and free weights.

130031.description: Nested in a quiet residential neighbourhood in the historic district of Dubai, this apartment hotel presents an ideal accommodation for all visitors of the city. A number of attractions such as the Burjuman Shopping Mall, Al Khaleej Centre and Al Ain Centre can all be reached fast and conveniently. The golden sands and the crystal waters of the Jumeirah beach are just 4 km from the venue and scenic Burj Al Arab is at 20 km. The apartments of the hotel are modernly furnished and feature all the comforts needed for a pleasant and enjoyable stay. The heated rooftop swimming pool invites everyone to unwind with a leisurely swim or work on their tan on the sun loungers. The barbecue on the sun terrace offers an ideal location for spending a relaxed afternoon with friends and family, while the fully equipped health club is great for both the occasional gym session. Other additional services include laundry service, currency exchange, doctor on call and free on-site car parking. Additionally, the hotel also offers a complimentary shuttle service to various popular landmarks, including Burjuman Metro Station, Burjuman Centre, Burj Khalifa (world's tallest tower), Dubai Mall, Dubai Creek and Dubai Museum.

130034.description: Byblos Hotel welcome you to a modern 4 star concept with a flavour of the Lebanese hospitality. Anchored in the heart of TECOM area, the Phoenician architectural hints of the building will take you to Byblos citadel with wall paintings, mosaic, marble and wooden work of art. The 152 elegant rooms and suites with their unique paintings and Phoenician alphabet pattern carpet, are a blend of luxury, comfort and convenience, designed to suit the needs of both business and leisure travelers. Selective palates will enjoy our dining options. A complete Dubai restaurant experience is offered at Byblos Hotel where guests are treated to various cuisine in a comfortable, relaxed atmosphere. Guests can also enjoy delicious cuisine from their room, with our 24 hour room service. Make the most of warm Dubai days with a dip in our outdoor swimming pool located on the first floor. In a secluded, temple-like our guests can swim in the Hotel's unique terrace pool and relax. Private cabanas, umbrellas and comfortable lounge chairs are offered, and cool drinks and à la carte menu are served poolside from Murjan coffee shop. In addition, the pool area is equipped with music and Internet access. It's the ideal way to cool off and relax! Your Byblos Hotel Dubai experience is about far more than a place to sleep. We will ensure your stay is as comfortable as possible, with friendly yet discreet service, a relaxed atmosphere, and fantastic facilities.

130063.description: This hotel is located in the Barcelona Eixample, a residential and business area of the city, where guests can find restaurants, cafés, shops and boutiques. Nearby guests will find some of the best architectural offers like the Sagrada Família, the Monumental bullring, the Ciutadella Park, the Arc de Triomf square, Teatre Nacional de Catalunya, the auditorium, and the innovative Agbar Tower. With the nearby public transportation, guests can reach the whole city within minutes.

130074.description: The beach hotel is situated right across from the beach and is connected by an underpass. It is around 14 km from Alanya, close to many dining venues and attractions, such as Alanya Castle and Damlatas Caves. The centre of Mahmutlar is just a 10-minute walk away and Antalya Airport is around 140 km from the hotel. The air-conditioned establishment comprises a total of 250 rooms. Facilities on offer include a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe and currency exchange facilities. Further amenities include a buffet restaurant, a TV lounge and a shop. All rooms are fully-equipped as standard featuring a private bathroom with shower, a satellite TV and a private balcony. Floors are either carpeted or tiled. Leisure facilities include a large outdoor swimming pool with children's swimming area, a gym and spa treatments.

130103.description: This hotel is situated in a unique and beautiful setting, surrounded by vineyards, high on a mountain overlooking the picturesque Franschhoek valley. The hotel invites guests to relax and enjoy some of the most spectacular views across the valleys and vineyards of Franschhoek. It spans over three wings, giving guests the privacy one would expect from a boutique hotel. The 16 elegant bedrooms and 6 luxury suites are individually decorated with a classic elegance. The two very different restaurants encapsulate what Franschhoek is all about: good food and good wine in beautiful surroundings. The hotel also offers a lobby, bar and room service. Each room features an en suite bathroom with shower, a double or king-size bed, satellite TV, a minibar, tea and coffee making facilities and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. The hotel offers guests a range of activities to choose from, such as massages at the spa centre or even tasting excellent wines from the region. Guests may also take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool, work out in the gym or explore the surrounding area by bike or on horseback. From Cape Town follow the N1 in the direction of Paarl. Take exit 47. Turn right onto the R44 (Pass Butterfly World on the left), and go across the 4-way stop. Turn left onto the R45 (sign posted for Franschhoek) which follows through Klapmuts until reaching a T-junction (still the R45). Turn right onto R45 (via Simondium) towards Franschhoek. Follow the R45 through the town of Franschhoek until reaching Bordeaux Street, turn right and follow the signs to the hotel.

130104.description: Set in the breathtaking Constantia Valley, Steenberg Hotel & Spa offers guests an immersive and curated 5-star boutique experience with 24 beautifully appointed rooms, including three luxury suites and two bespoke private villas, a luxe spa, two exceptional, locally inspired onsite restaurants, the Steenberg Vineyards Tasting Room, an 18-hole championship golf course and 60 hectares of vineyards. Steenberg Spa offers a variety of revitalising treatment options. In summer, a secluded scented garden offers outdoor treatments under old oak trees in the dappled shade. The immaculate gardens and majestic vineyard and mountain views make Steenberg Hotel & Spa a complete leisure destination. It is centrally located 25 minutes from the V&A Waterfront, Cape Point, and Cape Town International Airport. The hotel provides a free shuttle service to the V&A Waterfront daily. Free 5-km radius transfer services are also available to and from the local restaurants, wineries, and shopping centres. A paid shuttle is available on request to and from Cape Town International Airport.

130107.description: This modern hotel is located in Paris's city center, near the Moulin Rouge and Opera Garnier. The closest station is Saint Georges. All 44 soundproofed rooms feature air-conditioning, free Wi-Fi, room service, hairdryers, safes, ironing sets, and tea and coffee facilities. Guests enjoy a quiet atmosphere, with some rooms offering charming rooftop views. Montmartre is a 20-minute walk away, Gare Saint-Lazare is 10 minutes away and several metro lines are nearby.

130123.description: Nihal Residency Hotel and Apartment enjoys a central location in Bur Dubai, within walking distance of Bank Street and the Dubai Creek. It is situated 15 minutes drive from Sheikh Zayed Road, the World Trade Centre and Dubai International Airport. This family-friendly aparthotel was renovated and has 56 apartments. Guests can enjoy spectacular moments in the hotel's rooftop swimming pool and sauna. The hotel's gym is fully equipped to meet international standards. Dubai Creek Golf and Yacht Club is about 4 kms from the hotel. Banks'Treat Café is located on the ground floor of the hotel and is open 24 hours a day. It serves a choice of multi-cuisine dishes. Banks'Treat Café serves breakfast every day with an international spread of dishes which are carefully planned and screened by a team of expert nutritionists and chefs. Stay at our hotel for a truly pleasant and unforgettable experience.

130128.description:
Located on the beautiful Isla Holbox, which is a virtually unspoiled paradise in the Yucatán Peninsula. To reach the hotel it is necessary to take a boat from the small town of Chiquilá in Quintana Roo, Mexico. The hotel is located on the beach.

In addition to comfort, guests will find the peace and tranquillity of taking a nap on a traditional Yucatecan hammock, or simply enjoying the natural beauty of the emerald green sea at the eco hotel. Renovated in 2009, the air-conditioned hotel comprises 14 rooms and features a lobby with 24-hour check-out service, a hotel safe, a café, a bar and a breakfast room. WLAN Internet access, a laundry service (for a fee) and bicycle hire are also provided.

There are different options for accommodation at the hotel. The choice depends on the preferences and needs of guests. The accommodation ranges from bungalows to triple occupancy cabins, which are a great option for families or groups of friends travelling together. All alternatives in this property have been designed and decorated in a traditional Mayan style, built with wood and palm leaves. The en suite bathrooms are fitted with a shower. Standard features include air conditioning, Internet access, a kitchenette with a fridge and a balcony or terrace.

Guests may enjoy use of a sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols laid out for use, aqua fit classes and massage service. For additional fees guests can go windsurfing, motor boating, catamaran boating and horse riding. Facilities for basketball and beach volleyball are additionally available. Sun loungers and parasols can also be found on the beach.

Follow the signs for 'Mérida Libre' (free) and not 'Cuota' (toll). Exit onto Avenida Lopez Portillo of Cancún and signs to Isla Holbox can be seen. Travel time is 2 1/2 hours.

130145.description: The hotel is situated right across from the famous Mauerpark and in close proximity to the Gedenkstätte Berliner Mauer (Berlin Wall Memorial). Only a short walk away guests will find Kastanienallee, Oderberger Strasse, the Kulturbrauerei (800 m) and Kollwitzplatz (1. 5 km) which offer a huge variety of interesting cafes, restaurants and shops. Alexanderplatz and the TV Tower (city centre) are 2. 7 km away. It is approximately 10 km to Tegel Airport and around 25 km to Schoenefeld Airport. Built in 2009, this new, family-friendly city hotel offers guests accommodation amidst thrilling contemporary German history and the chance to enjoy a vibrant lifestyle. Occupying the perfect location between East and West, this new hotel resides on historical ground, and the property and its staff are devoted to the contemporary history of Berlin. With its large-scale, spectacular photos and interesting motifs, the excitement of the location is reflected throughout the entire building, from the lobby to the rooms themselves. This property comprises a total of 96 rooms including 12 junior suites. Facilities on offer to guests at this establishment include a lobby, 24-hour reception, hotel safe and WLAN Internet access (for an additional fee). There is a car park and covered garage parking for those arriving by car (charges apply). The rooms are furnished in a modern and friendly style and come with a bathroom with a shower/bathtub, a WC and a hairdryer. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone and a flat-screen TV (on request).

130158.description: ***Adult Only Hotel - Hotel does not accept under 18 years old***Enjoying a superb location directly on Alanya's famous Cleopatra Beach, this established hotel has been consistently refurbished over the years and features modern, comfortable accommodation with a landscaped garden and an outdoor pool and sun-bathing terrace directly on the beach. Ideal for guests who enjoy beach holidays and being in the centre of a resort, the excellent, pedestrianised shopping centre in the heart of the resort, entertainment venues around the harbour and bus terminal are all reachable on foot. Alanya's Castle atop the imposing promontory at the end of Cleopatra's beach is both visible from the hotel and accessable by local transport.

130163.description: The Gallion Hotel offers a convenient location in Alanya's city center, just a short walk from golden beaches like Cleopatra and Damlataş, as well as the vibrant city market and commercial center. Enjoy the tranquility of a peaceful side street, yet be within easy reach of the bustling city center and exciting nightlife. The hotel features 55 comfortable rooms, accommodating both couples and small groups. Meticulous daily cleaning ensures a fresh and inviting space, with linens and towels refreshed every two days. The closest beach is a mere 100 meters away, and Antalya (AYT) and Gazipaşa (GZP) International Airports are 117 km and 43 km away, respectively.

130170.description: There are a total of 80 units on the premises.

130173.description: Melissa Moment offers 22 identical apartments, each with a balcony overlooking either the road or the pool. Every apartment features a shower, bed, sofa, television with satellite channels, hairdryer, free Wi-Fi, safe, and more. Poolside, tables and chairs are available for guests to enjoy the Turkish sun, and breakfast is served in this area as well. The restaurant provides à la carte dining daily. With our premium package, à la carte dining is complimentary every day. Originally founded in 2001, Melissa Moment was renovated in 2012 and welcomes guests from across Europe and Scandinavia.

130193.description: This hotel is located in Kumkoy, 400 m from the long sandy beach, approximately 4 km from the historical centre of Side. This hotel enjoys easy access to all that the lively city has to offer. Also within easy reach are Agora Museum, Theatre and the Field of Ruins. This hotel is an ideal spot from which to explore Side. Public transport links are close by and it is 65 km to Antalya Airport.

130205.description: Situated in the very centre of the Portuguese capital, this hotel is just a few steps away from the delightful park Eduardo VII, Praça do Marquês de Pombal Square and the elegant shopping facilities of the Avenida da Liberdade. The nearest metro station is just across the street, providing easy access to the historic centre with its famous attractions such as the Praça do Rossio or Praça do Comércio squares. Lisbon Airport is within a short driving distance. Rooms at this hotel are cosy, decorated with wooden furniture. They come equipped with air-conditioning/heating, satellite TV, safe and bathroom with hairdryer. Guests can relax at the bar with refreshing drinks and light snacks.

130214.description: This fantastic modern and bright hotel enjoying panoramic views over the Caribbean Sea is excellently located directly on the white sandy beach. It is ideal both for leisure and for business travellers, as the Cancún Convention Center is just a few steps away. Numerous shopping facilities, restaurants and bars can be found in the surrounding area.

130218.address: Siraselviler Cad. K.M Celebi Mah. Billurcu Sok, 1
130218.description: This hotel lies in a comfortable and peaceful environment, only a minutes' walk from Istanbul's business, art, shopping and entertainment centre at Taksim Square. Ataturk Airport is about 25 km away and Sabiha Gokcen Airport is approximately 45 km from the property. This historical city hotel was decorated and refurbished in 2010 in a contemporary style and offers a comfortable stay for business and leisure guests alike. It has a restaurant and a bar on the top floor with superb panoramic views over the city. There are 81 guest rooms in total at this establishment. Carefully and meticulously crafted, the extremely comfortable rooms all have air conditioning and feature a stylish en suite bathroom. The hotel's facilities include a health club with complimentary use of the Turkish bath and sauna for guests.

130229.description: Stay connected at the Holiday Inn Express Madrid-Leganes, an IHG Hotel in Leganes, conveniently attached to a shopping center. You'll be within a 15-minute drive of Casa de Campo and La Cubierta Bull Ring, and a short drive from Madrid Zoo Aquarium and Prado Museum. Enjoy the terrace views and amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. This hotel also offers gift shops, a picnic area, and a vending machine. Relax in one of the 80 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions with cable programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, bidets, and hair dryers. Safes, desks, and phones are also provided. Dine at the hotel's restaurant, Holiday Inn Express Legan, grab a snack at the deli, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is included. Business travelers will appreciate the business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The hotel also offers 968 square feet of event space, including a conference area and meeting room. Self-parking is available (subject to charges).

130232.address: Campo Santa Maria Del Giglio - San Marco, 2494
130232.description: This hotel is located in a fantastic location of Venice, just a few steps from Piazza San Marco, shopping area and the best restaurants. It is just a short stroll from a waterbus stop and 5 minutes' walk to Saint Mark's Square. Marco Polo Airport is at 15 km from the property. The hotel offers special guest rooms, designed in a sleek contemporary and traditional classic Venetian style for comfort and convenience. They all come equipped with air conditioning, LCD TV, Satellite TV, safe, minibar, tea and coffee facilities and en-suite bathroom with bath amenities and hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a rich variety of selected products for breakfast and relax at the bar with drinks at the end of the day.

130233.description: This property basks in the convenient and quiet location in the historical area of Venice, set within striking distance of St. Mark's Square and the famous Clock Tower. The steeped in history Rialto Bridge and Dodge's Palace may be reached within a short walk. Access to the public transport network (by boat) is around 250 m from the hotel and the bus station at Piazzale Roma and the Santa Lucia railway station are roughly 3 km away. Housed in a charming building, the establishment offers excellence in décor and top notch service to cater for needs of even the most demanding guests. The hotel rooms feature delightful design fitted with the 17th century Venetian style rich with decorations and gilded carvings. Each unit offers modern comforts to ensure a pleasant and memorable stay. Check in, check out and breakfast will be at the Hotel Castello, just a few steps from the Locanda.

130245.description: Experience Parisian chic at this vibrant hotel in the Montparnasse district, surrounded by theaters, cinemas, museums, and iconic cafes. This central location offers easy access to exhibitions and fairs, with convenient transport links including the Metro, taxis, buses, Air France shuttle, and Montparnasse station. Orly Airport is a short 21-minute drive, and Charles de Gaulle is approximately 53 minutes away. The stylishly decorated rooms and well-equipped bathrooms provide a comfortable and elegant retreat.

130248.description: The riad is located in the historic area of Marrakech, close to the Hosts Palace of the King in a very quiet and secure pedestrian zone. The city centre and touristic centre are in the immediate vicinity, and it is within easy reach of the Djemaa el Fna market place and the souks. The domestic airport is around 10 km away, and it is only approximately 20 km from Marrakech-Menara International Airport. This charming 5-room riad is an old riad hidden in the heart of Marrakech's medina. Faithfully restored in the true spirit of traditional architecture, it nonetheless has a special emphasis on high standards of comfort. A cosy dining room is available to guests. The building is fully air-conditioned and offers a 24-hour check-out service. The hotel guest rooms are decorated in traditional style with air conditioning and a fire place. A complete and modern en suite bathroom with shower, bath and hairdryer comes as standard. Additional features include a king-size or double bed. The hotel offers a hammam and a massage room (fees apply). A swimming pool and sun deck with loungers and parasols are also available. The riad serves a continental breakfast each morning. Lunch and dinner are available from a set menu.

130258.description: Relish tranquility, and an illustrious take on Manhattan at the InterContinental® New York Times Square Hotel. Gaze out at majestic views of the city with floor-to-ceiling windows from various room accommodations and modern event spaces. With an unrivaled location, our luxury hotel in the Theater District, places you at the doorstep of Times Square and Broadway Theatres, and close to iconic sites like Central Park and Rockefeller Center.

130259.description: The Washington Hotel is an upscale hotel located in the heart of New York City's Financial District. This prime location places guests just a 4-minute walk away from the Wall Street subway station and the National September 11 Memorial and Museum. The iconic Statue of Liberty is also within walking distance, just 11 minutes away. Guests can enjoy contemporary rooms that are equipped with desks, Wi-Fi, and TVs, as well as minifridges and safes. The hotel also offers 1-bedroom suites that feature additional living and dining areas for added comfort and convenience. The hotel's on-site restaurant and lounge, which serves Mediterranean cuisine, is a stylish and elegant spot to dine and unwind. Other amenities include a 24-hour fitness center and a terrace with panoramic views of the city.

130261.description: Situated halfway between Barcelona and Tarragona, the hotel's location allows quick access to motorways and other roads. It is only 2 minutes from the city centre and just a few kilometres from the best Catalan wines and cava wineries. The bus and train stations are around 3 km from the hotel and Barcelona Airport is situated at a distance of approximately 45 km. The modern hotel offers 59 ample guest rooms, WLAN Internet access, and outdoor parking. Guests are welcomed to the air-conditioned establishment in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. Further facilities provided include a hotel safe, lift access, a café, a breakfast room and conference facilities. For an additional fee guests may make use of the laundry service. The spacious rooms come with exterior-facing windows, a full en suite bathroom with shower, bath, hairdryer and bathrooms amenities, a minibar, a safe and satellite TV. The rooms are also equipped with a telephone, desk, Internet access, air conditioning and central heating. The hotel offers an outdoor swimming pool in summer as well as information about and reservations for wineries in the Penedès and Cava region. Sun loungers are laid out at the hotel for guests use. Guests may like to go golfing in Sant Jaume dels Domenys, around 15 km away. A buffet breakfast is served each morning.

130262.description: This hotel is located in the cultural and historical heart of Athens within walking distance of Omonoia Square, Syntagma, Agora and of course the Parthenos and the new Acropolis Museum. It is a 10-minute walk from Athens city centre, whilst Metaxourgeio metro station is just outside the hotel. The airport can be reached in 40 minutes by car. This hotel welcomes guests into a stylish, urban and essential experience of the city. All rooms are fitted with air-conditioning, TV, fridge, safe and bathroom with hairdryer and toiletries. Guests can unwind at the rooftop poolside bar with snacks and refreshing drinks. Business travellers will not find anything wanting, with 2 business meeting rooms, equipped with modern audio-visual equipment and having capacity of up to 350 people.

name.content: UNA HOTELS Hotel Residence Contessa Jolanda Milano

131431.description: Located in a quiet neighbourhood in the northern part of Milan, this comfortable hotel is just a 5-minute walk from the Maciachini subway stop. Guests travelling through the Linate and Malpensa Airports can use the shuttle service, while the convenient links to the public transport system makes moving around the area fast and easy. The residence is the perfect hub for anyone who is looking for a tranquil accommodation. The sound-proofed apartments are equipped with all necessary comforts needed to guarantee a high-quality stay, including flat-screen TVs, spacious living areas and work desks. The fitness enthusiasts will have access to a modern gym where they can work the stress off and prepare for the busy day. The breakfast is served on the 8th floor, which treats its guests to beautiful panoramic views over Milan. It is possible to add breakfast on site at € 13.

131437.description: Enjoy a convenient stay at Mary's Hotel République, located in Paris's vibrant 11th arrondissement, just steps from Canal Saint-Martin and a short walk from Place de la République. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box. Start your day with a continental breakfast (available for a fee), and relax in one of the 40 air-conditioned rooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, phones, safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include Place des Vosges and Rue de Rivoli, both within a mile of the hotel. The nearest airport is Paris Orly (ORY).

131446.description: Hotel Do Pozzi is in the heart of Venice, a 5-minute walk from St. Mark's Square. Rooms are individually designed, and breakfast is served in a sunny courtyard. Rooms at Do Pozzi feature a traditional Venetian or contemporary style. Each has a private bathroom and is equipped with satellite TV and Wi-Fi access. Breakfast is rich in fresh fruit and Italian pastries. Do Pozzi Hotel is just a short stroll away from all the main attractions in Venice. The nearest vaporetto water-bus stop is just 50 metres away. Tours and gondola rides can be arranged at reception.

131448.description: Centrally located in Venice, Hotel Al Codega is a 5-minute walk from St. Mark's Square and Teatro La Fenice. This hotel offers 28 air-conditioned rooms with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast and the convenience of 24-hour room service and concierge assistance. Amenities include a bar/lounge, complimentary newspapers, and multilingual staff. Nearby attractions include St Mark's Campanile (0. 4 km) and St. Mark's Basilica (0. 5 km).

131452.description: The Holiday Inn Riyadh Izdihar offers a relaxing stay midway between King Khalid International Airport (15-minute drive) and Riyadh city center. Located in a peaceful residential neighborhood near major corporate offices and attractions, this hotel features 289 standard, executive, and suite rooms. Enjoy two restaurants, two outdoor pools, two business centers, a spacious lobby, 24-hour room service, fitness centers, tennis, basketball, and football courts. Eight meeting rooms and the Izdihar Ballroom cater to events of up to 1200 guests. Free internet and covered parking are available. Explore nearby shopping malls and family entertainment options like World Sight Park and Ad Diriyah. Our dedicated staff ensures a refreshing and comfortable experience.

131455.description: Enjoy a refreshing dip in the indoor pool or unwind in the steam room at this Paris hotel near the Champs-Élysées. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of concierge services. The hotel offers a coffee shop, 24-hour room service, and a bar/lounge for your dining and relaxation needs. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. Each of the 33 air-conditioned rooms features a flat-screen TV with satellite programming, a safe, a desk, and a phone with free international calls. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel also provides complimentary wired internet access, newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event planning services are available, with 129 square feet of conference and meeting space. Nearby attractions include the Arc de Triomphe, Salle Pleyel, and Parc Monceau.

131456.description: This delightful hotel is situated close to the Place de la Nation and benefits from an excellent location with the Bastille, République, Châtelet, le Louvre and the Champs Elysées all only a few minutes away by metro. The metro, bus and train stations are all just a 1-minute walk from the family-friendly business hotel and nearby airports include Orly (18 km away), Charles de Gaulle (25 km away), Beauvais-Tille (80 km away) and Brussels (250 km away). Renovated in 2010, this charming and welcoming hotel offers 35 comfortable accommodation units and the perfect address for business and leisure travellers alike. Guests can relax in the beautiful hotel lobby and read the complimentary newspapers offered by the courteous and attentive staff. Further facilities available to guests at the air-conditioned historical hotel include 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, lift access, a breakfast room, Internet access and a laundry service (fees apply). Each room features an en suite bathroom with a shower, bathtub and hairdryer, a double bed, air conditioning and central heating. Other in-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, Internet access, a safe and tea and coffee making facilities. A continental breakfast buffet is served each morning.

131478.address: Kucuk Ayasofya Mah.Katip Sinan Camii Sok, 30
131478.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include concierge services and a television in a common area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 8:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 16 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and complimentary newspapers, as well as phones with free local calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Sultanahmet Square - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Little Hagia Sophia - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Cemberlitas Bath - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Blue Mosque - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Grand Bazaar - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Basilica Cistern - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Hagia Sophia - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Beyazit Square - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Bosphorus - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Istanbul University - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Gülhane Park - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Istanbul Archaeology Museums - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Eminönü Square - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 44 km / 27. 3 mi Istanbul Airport (IST) - 47. 4 km / 29. 5 mi The preferred airport for Art City Hotel Istanbul - Boutique Class is Istanbul Airport (IST).

131479.description: This Art Deco hotel boasts a rooftop terrace with stunning views, a 24-hour fitness center, and two restaurants. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of concierge services and 24-hour room service. A coffee shop/cafe offers snacks, and guests can mingle at the complimentary reception. Unwind at the bar/lounge, and start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies). The hotel provides dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Airport transfers are available for a surcharge, and free self-parking is provided. Each of the 34 individually furnished guestrooms features an iPod docking station, an LCD TV with satellite programming, a Tempur-Pedic bed with premium bedding, and a bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a bidet. Located near Little Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet Square, and the Blue Mosque, the hotel is conveniently situated for exploring Istanbul's historical sites. The preferred airport is Istanbul Airport (IST).

131480.description: This hotel is located in the district of Macka with Macka Park on one side and the famous shopping and business district of Nisantasi just a few minutes' walk further on. Renovated in 2007, this 23-room city hotel has a friendly atmosphere and is designed for comfort in every detail. The lobby bar is an ideal place to relax and on the first floor guests will find the marvellous restaurant, which serves international cuisine and is a popular dining spot. The hotel's stylish and comfortable rooms are spacious and come with complimentary tea and coffee facilities, as well as Internet access. They are all elegantly decorated in warm colours and wood, creating a cosy ambience.

131481.description: Enjoy garden views at the Lausos Hotel Sultanahmet in Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, steps from Sultanahmet Square and a short walk from the Blue Mosque. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, 24-hour room service, and a daily buffet breakfast. Amenities include a 24-hour airport shuttle (surcharge), concierge services, and dry cleaning. The 34 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, and bathrooms with jetted tubs. Nearby attractions include the Hagia Sophia and Basilica Cistern.

131482.description: Located in Istanbul in the region of Marmara Region, 1. 3 km from Grand Bazaar, Matiat Hotel Istanbul features a terrace and views of the city. Guests can enjoy the on-site bar. Each room is fitted with a flat-screen TV. You will find a kettle in the room. The rooms include a private bathroom. For your comfort, you will find slippers, free toiletries and a hairdryer. There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. Suleymaniye Mosque is 1. 4 km from Matiat Hotel Istanbul, and Column of Constantine is 1. 4 km away. The nearest airport is Ataturk - European Side Airport, 11. 3 km from Matiat Hotel Istanbul. We speak your language!This property has been on Booking. com since Jul 15, 2015. Hotel Rooms: 51

131483.description: Indulge in onsite massages or enjoy amenities such as a sauna. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's restaurant for lunch or dinner, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (7:00 AM to 10:00 AM) for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in/check-out and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Istanbul? This hotel has 54 square feet (5 square meters) of space, including a conference area and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (24 hours) for a surcharge. Make yourself at home in one of the 60 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and slippers. The hotel is conveniently located near Laleli Mosque (0. 3 mi), Istanbul University (0. 4 mi), and Süleymaniye Mosque (0. 5 mi). The preferred airport is Istanbul Airport (IST).

131492.description: The Faubourg Hotel is ideally situated in the heart of Paris, nestled between Gare du Nord, Gare de l'Est, Montmartre, and the Paris Opera. Just a short walk from iconic nightlife destinations like the Folies Bergère, the Moulin Rouge, and Pigalle, the hotel is conveniently located between the Poissonnière and Bonne-Nouvelle metro stations on lines 7 and 8, respectively. Whether traveling for business or leisure, the Faubourg Hotel offers comfortable accommodations ranging from single rooms to duplexes. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel and unwind with a drink at the hotel bar. Shopping enthusiasts will appreciate the hotel's proximity to Galeries Lafayette and other major department stores, just a 15-minute walk away.

131494.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at this conveniently located Paris hotel. The on-site snack bar/deli and limited room service offer convenient dining options, while the bar/lounge provides a relaxing setting for a drink. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Additional amenities include complimentary wired internet, a computer station, and newspapers in the lobby. Each of the 27 guestrooms features an espresso maker, a flat-screen TV, a Select Comfort bed with premium bedding, a safe, a desk, and a phone. Hôtel Saint Martin Bastille is located in the 11th Arrondissement, steps from Canal Saint-Martin and the Bataclan. The Picasso Museum and Atelier des Lumières are within a mile.

131556.description:
Located in the Recoleta neighbourhood, between the streets Uruguay and Parana, this city hotel is just steps away from the city's main theatres, art galleries and shopping centres in the Reina del Plata, and it offers an ideal location for those who want to visit the city's main attractions, such as Puerto Madero, San Telmo and La Boca. The business hotel also provides business guests with easy access to the financial centre and main corporate buildings in the city. Guests will find restaurants, bars, nightlife and shops all within a 7-minute walk of the hotel. The nearest metro station (line D/B) is a 5-minute walk, and Retiro bus and train station are both approximately 1. 5 km away. Built in 1949 and renovated in 2009, the air-conditioned hotel now provides warmth and a cosy atmosphere in which to relax or work. The hotel has 59 rooms. WLAN Internet access is available throughout the building. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, luggage storage and lift access. There is also a breakfast room, concierge service, . An American breakfast buffet is served each morning. Starting March 1, 2020, Law 6278 came into effect, establishing the Urban Use Fee in the City of Buenos Aires. In this way, as in many other cities around the world, each foreign tourist over the age of 12 will pay a fee of 1. 50 
USD for each night spent in the City. 
Reservations for 6 or more rooms will be considered group reservations and might apply different rates or conditions.

131557.description: This luxurious hotel set in upscale Recoleta neighbourhood is only 7 blocks from traditional Francia Park's Artisans Fair and the museum circuit. Guests will find 22 art galleries in the surrounding area and the city hotel is just 2 blocks from Plaza San Martín, 9 de Julio Avenue and the motorway, and in close proximity to Patio Bullrich shopping centre and Pacific Galleries. Guests staying at this hotel can relax in the sauna and sunbathe by the pool with breathtaking views of the city.

131563.description: This hotel is situated in a lovely beachfront location on the beautiful coast of Vravrona. Attractions such as the Archaeological Museum of Vravrona, the Sanctuary of Artemis, Metropolitan Expo, Expo Athens or the cave of Peania are easily reachable. The international airport Eleftherios Venizelos is only 12 km away while the city centre of the Greek capital of Athens is at a distance of 32 km. (NOT bookable for the French, Polish, Dutch and Belgian markets)

131569.description: Within a convenient distance from the historic center of Athens and in a privileged spot at the wider area of Attica, Ramada Athens Attica Riviera, the new 5-star hotel in the area of Mati, offers a great option for unique accommodation and refined, cordial services. The historic center is just 25 kilometers away, while the airport lies at a distance of 21 kilometers. Located exactly on the waterfront, the hotel provides the perfect retreat for couples. Romance overflows by the beach, as the sun spreads in million colors and provides the ultimate scenery for celebrating love and passion. Enjoy comfort and relaxation in fully functional, spacious rooms and suites with private balcony and a multitude of amenities and facilities on offer. Guests are free to enjoy air-conditioned rooms with satellite LCD TV, mini fridge and safe deposit box, bathroom with shower or bathtub and branded toiletries.

131625.description:
Located in the heart of Manhattan’s sought-after Fashion District, Hilton New York Fashion District recently completed a full renovation (2025) of its guest rooms and public spaces, offering a refreshed and contemporary stay in one of New York City’s most dynamic neighborhoods. 

Just steps from the Empire State Building, Times Square, Madison Square Garden, the Fashion Institute of Technology (FIT), Chelsea Piers, Broadway, Macy’s at Herald Square, Fifth Avenue shopping, and the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center, the hotel puts the best of New York City within easy reach. Guest rooms feature upscale accommodations and city skyline views, while private and semi-private meeting spaces provide flexible options for small meetings and events. 

The hotel also offers a variety of dining and entertainment experiences. Enjoy panoramic city views and cocktails year-round at Sandbar, the hotel’s rooftop bar. For dining and entertainment, Chelsea Stage features live music in an energetic setting, while Chelsea Table offers a more relaxed environment for enjoying breakfast, dinner, or a casual meal. 

Explore the city with convenient access to Penn Station and Grand Central Terminal, walk to an event at Madison Square Garden or the Javits Center, or enjoy a stroll along the nearby High Line, the elevated former railway transformed into one of Manhattan’s most iconic parks.

131664.description: Completely renovated in 2015, Hotel Amadeos offers a modern and welcoming atmosphere, blending comfort and stylish design. Located in central Matosinhos, it's just 4 km from the Exponor Convention Centre and a short 9-minute walk from the beach. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, especially those who enjoy the beach, sea, and surfing, Hotel Amadeos is conveniently located a minute's walk from the metro station, providing direct access to Porto's historic center, Casa da Música, Dragão Stadium, Campanhã, and Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport (a mere 6-minute drive). The rooms feature air conditioning, parquet floors, modern furnishings, private bathrooms with hairdryers, LCD TVs with cable, and Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a continental breakfast buffet each morning, featuring a variety of breads, pastries, coffee, tea, milk, and seasonal fruit. The Bar & Lounge provides the perfect setting for a relaxing evening cocktail.

131665.description: Located in the center of Braga, near the old town and the main streets, the Estação hotel is directly opposite the train station and close to major highways, allowing a quick and easy access to other cities. It has a total of 51 rooms: 16 doubles, 27 twins, 7 triples and 1 family spread over 5 floors. All rooms are air conditioned and well equipped for your comfort. If traveling by car, it offers a private parking. The reception is available 24 hours to assist you with your needs during your stay, including the transport service to tourist sites or to the airport, car rental or organizing tourist routes. In addition, you can also enjoy a continental breakfast buffet.

131686.address: Carrer De L Arc Del Teatre, 58
131686.description: Casa Lit Barcelona, strategically located for you to enjoy all that Barcelona has to offer. The ideal hotel for those who visit Barcelona in search of good vibes, cultural programmes, nightlife and gastronomic tourism. Located where the Cine Colón Cinema was originally located, this large house with high ceilings, light colours and pure light is 5 minutes from Las Ramblas, near the port and a few metres from Avenida Paralelo. Nearby, you will discover the most emblematic theatres and the city's top class restaurants. The hotel has 89 rooms, including duplex, double or triple rooms, making it an ideal accommodation for holidays or getaways with your partner or friends. It also has single rooms for those travelling on business. You can make use of the coworking area on the main floor. Start the day with a buffet breakfast in the dining room on the ground floor and in the evening enjoy the sunset on our rooftop terrace.

131722.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby. Stop by the hotel's restaurant for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 36 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private furnished balconies.

131745.description: Located in the centre of Oba, this elegant modern hotel is just one minute from the beach and the warm waters of the Mediterranean Sea. The airport is just about 30-minute car ride away from the complex. Guests will be delighted to know that the centre of Alanya with its large variety of shops, restaurants, bars and cafés and its famous attractions such as the Red Tower, Alanya Castle and the Damlatas Cave are within easy reach. Travellers can unwind in the outdoor pool area or have a refreshing swim in it. Delicious meals are offered in the restaurant along with an agreeable atmosphere. For the ones who like to feel active, they can visit the gym and the rest and relax in the spa. The rooms are equipped with all the essential amenities and are decorated with warm colour to make travellers feel cosy and have the best experience.

name.content: Hyatt Centric Wall Street New York

131819.description: Constructed in 2010 this hotel welcomes it guests near many of the top sights and landmarks of New York City. Located in the famous Financial District it is just 3 blocks away from the Federal hall, 4 blocks from the Stock Exchange and just a minute walk from Hanover square. The property aims to provide all of the comforts of home while on the road, plus a dash of arty touch. The high ceiling of the comfortable guestrooms creates a roomy residential-style space. Make yourself at home in one of the 253 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars (stocked with some free items). Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. 42-inch LCD televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers.

131833.description: Located on the Eastern Head of Knysna, surrounded by a lush paradise of indigenous forests, mountains, lakes and pristine beaches, our hotel offers unsurpassed luxury on South Africa's iconic Garden Route. With a Championship Golf Course on your doorstep and luxurious suites, an award-winning spa and a restaurant focused on locally sourced dining to enjoy, it's easy to see why Pezula Nature Retreat should be your Knysna luxury retreat of choice. When staying at Pezula Nature Retreat, you'll find that we cater for every kind of traveller, from families to couples to groups of friends, we have the perfect space to complete your accommodation needs. Our Suites are all beautifully designed, expertly decorated and feature complimentary Wi-Fi, air-conditioning and a number of other amenities and facilities, all expertly curated to give you a sense of luxury from the moment you put your luggage down.

131847.address: 6 Commune Rurale Ouidane, Sidi Youssef Ben Ali, s/n
131847.description: Nestled at the very heart of Marrakech's palm oasis, the hotel is located just 13 km from the Koutoubia Mosque and famous Djemaa el Fna square. Menara Airport is 15 km away. Surrounded by the peaceful gardens of olive and palm trees extending over 4 hectares, the complex blends modern architecture and traditional Moroccan elements. The sumptuously decorated rooms and suites offer incredible views over a sparkling pool, the artificial lake and the magnificent Atlas Mountains. Guests will be taken by flavourful dishes served at 2 restaurants. Afterwards they may have a drink from one of the on-site bars. The youngest ones will delight in kids' club while adults pamper themselves at spa equipped with Hammam, sauna and gym. Further leisure facilities include outdoor pool, paddling pool, sun loungers, aerobics, badminton, tennis. Travellers arriving by car may avail for on-site parking.

131862.description: Situated in Saki Naka, Andheri's emerging business district near the convention center, this budget-friendly hotel offers modern amenities and a convenient location. Just 2 km from Andheri Railway Station and Saki Naka Bus Stand, and a short drive from both domestic and international airports, it caters to both business and leisure travelers. The hotel features 24-hour room service, a conference hall, currency exchange, laundry service, on-site parking, a café, and a bar. Each room has tiled floors and is equipped with air conditioning, a direct dial telephone, cable television, a safe, and a private bathroom with a Western-style toilet. A small work desk, armchair, and cupboard are also provided for guest convenience.

131863.address: PLOT NO.53, Opp cosmos Bank, Nr Railway Stn, East
131863.description: The Legend Hotel, a modern budget-friendly option in India, provides exceptional value. Located a mere 3. 5 km from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport, it's ideal for travelers flying in and out of Mumbai. Conveniently situated near Santacruz bus depot (350 meters) and train station (450 meters), exploring the city is easy. Spacious and elegantly decorated rooms offer essential amenities, complimentary Wi-Fi, and breakfast. name.content: The Westin Lagunamar Ocean Resort and Villas

132664.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 4 outdoor swimming pools, 4 spa tubs, and outdoor tennis courts. Additional features at this resort include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and shopping on site. Enjoy local and international cuisine at Oceano, one of the resort's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours).
