Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the swim-up bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 580 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Rooms have private balconies.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Dubai Port Saeed

132665.address: 2 27th St, Port Saeed, Al Maktoum Road, Deira
132665.description: This Dubai hotel is located on Airport Road, near the Toyota Showroom. It lies very close to the city centre shopping venues, Dubai Creek Golf and Yacht Club and the business district. It is within 10 minutes' drive of Dubai International Airport. This stylish, family-friendly city hotel is ideal for business travellers and holidaymakers alike and offers accommodation which is fashionably decorated and elegantly furnished with an assortment of luxurious amenities. This hotel features a gym and a rooftop swimming pool with a refreshment bar and a hot tub. The sophisticated hotel offers guests 2 dining options and the on-site restaurant specialises in delicious Italian food, while the more casual coffee shop serves light snacks and beverages. Step into a world of luxury and relaxation by staying at this hotel.

132692.description: Situated directly at the Porte d'Orléans metro station providing easy access to other areas of Paris, this modern design hotel makes a stay unforgettable. Several major sights like Notre Dame Cathedral, Louvre Museum or Eiffel Tower are within easy reach. The airports of Roissy-Charles de Gaulle and Orly are 35 km and 15 km away, respectively. Features of the hotel include 24-hour reception, express check-in and check-out, concierge service, free WIFI throughout, meeting rooms, business centre, bar, fitness centre, laundry service and on-site parking (charges apply).

132719.description: At May Hotel Istanbul, exceptional service and top-notch amenities create a memorable experience for guests. Complimentary internet access is available in the hotel to ensure you stay connected during your visit. Arrange your trips to and from the airport using the hotel's convenient transportation services booking. For guests with their own vehicle, parking facilities are provided. Due to health concerns, smoking is strictly prohibited within the entire premises of hotel. For the health and well-being of all guests and staff, smoking is restricted exclusively to assigned zones. A delightful breakfast is the perfect way to begin your day, and at May Hotel Istanbul, you can always indulge in a scrumptious meal on-site. Allow your journey to be free from the pangs of hunger! On-site eateries offer delicious and accessible meal choices.

132723.description: Located near Laleli Mosque, this hotel offers 131 guestrooms with refrigerators, minibars, and LCD TVs. Amenities include a fitness center, sauna, restaurant, coffee shop, and bar/lounge. Complimentary buffet breakfast and Wi-Fi are provided. Business facilities and airport shuttle (surcharge) are available. Enjoy nearby attractions such as Istanbul University and the Grand Bazaar.

132725.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this property. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Casa dos Varais.

132726.description: Set within the centenary wine estate of Quinta Casal de Celeirós- long associated with wine production and agriculture - The Manor House Celeirós is a collection of buildings that includes a hotel, a restaurant, a visitors' centre, and winegrowing facilities. Together, they blend comfort and elegance to offer an authentic experience in the world’s oldest demarcated wine region.

132728.description: From the vibrant mural that greets you in the lobby to our 116 beautifully designed en suite bedrooms, we offer a chic London bolthole unlike any other. Whether you're here for sightseeing, business, shopping or just taking a load off, our friendly team will take care of you around the clock. So if you're craving a refreshing nightcap at 11pm or a hot coffee at 6am, our 24-hour people will make sure your every need is met. Our 118 newly-refurbished, fully air-conditioned rooms are bright, minimalist and modern, providing a calm and relaxing environment to unwind after a full day exploring the delights of the city.

132731.description: In the heart of the historic city center, the newly opened Boss Hotel seamlessly blends European tradition with local heritage. Designed by the renowned architect Germán del Sol, recipient of the 2006 National Architecture Award, the hotel features elements such as grand Andean-inspired tapestries, richly painted walls, slate floors accented by warm rustic rugs, and an abundance of natural light. The vibrant colors in the guest rooms and dining areas complement the classic European furniture, reimagined with a minimalist and fresh perspective.

132765.description: This hotel is located in the popular holiday destination of Side-Kumkoy-Evranseki, only 300 m from the beach. Guests may find links to the public transport network 100 m from the hotel. The centre of Evrenseki, offering various tourist venues is easily accessible. Antalya Airport is 60 km from the hotel. Opened in 2009, this modern beach hotel comprises a total of 205 rooms, spread over 5 floors. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area, a hotel safe and a currency exchange facility. Guests also have a hairdressing salon, a games room and a TV lounge at their disposal. The younger guests can let off steam at the children's playground or the kids' club. The standard comfortable rooms at this hotel are pleasantly decorated in muted tones fully-equipped as standard. The rooms also feature either a balcony or a terrace.

132767.description: This charming and welcoming hotel is located in the wonderful city of London, in United Kingdom. The London City Airport is about 50-minute car ride away from the complex. The Paddington Station is conveniently just a couple of steps away. In the surroundings, there are several local and international restaurants offering delicious dishes and great atmospheres. There are also many lovely cafes and bars ideal to spend a nice evening with family or friends. Trendy shops can be also found within walking distance. If travellers prefer, they can have breakfast in the property and then go out and explore the city. The rooms have been decorated with warm colours and are equipped with all the essential amenities to please every visitor and make them have a pleasant stay.

name.content: Mercure Gold Hotel Al Mina Rd

132769.description: Mercure Dubai Gold Al Mina Road welcomes visitors to enjoy four-star hospitality in downtown Dubai. Refurbished in 2016 & 2017, 184 stylish, comfortable rooms are equipped with high-speed Internet connections, satellite TV, and spacious bathrooms including bathtubs and walk-in showers. Only 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport, the hotel is ideally located near the Dubai Convention Centre, World Trade Centre and Jumeirah Beach-La Mer. The hotel offers free shuttle service to beach and Dubai Mall.

132785.description: 100 meters from Gare du Nord (Eurostar / Thalys, direct CDG Airport) and Gare de l'Est, in the center of Paris, the Hotel Lucien & Marinette is located in a quiet side street. Access to tourist sites such as the Louvre, the Sacré-Coeur, Printemps and Galeries Lafayettes department stores, the Opéra Garnier and the Marais district are less than 15 minutes away by public transport. The hotel is located in a lively area (bars and restaurants), opposite the Saint-Quentin market. A true gourmet pleasure, it offers a wide selection of local products such as cheeses, wine and French cold meats. In a warm setting and a refined atmosphere, the hotel offers modernly decorated rooms that combine charm, comfort and elegance. Safe, Mini Bar, Chromecast are part of the equipment available in each room.

name.content: Kyriad Paris Est- Bois de Vincennes

132786.description: The Kyriad Paris Est - Bois de Vincennes is a beautiful 3-star hotel and restaurant located south of Paris on the banks of the Marne. Just steps from metro line 8, the hotel offers quick and easy access to central Paris and the charms of Bercy and the Bois de Vincennes. Disneyland Resort Paris, Orly, and Roissy airports are all less than 25 km away via the A4 and A6 motorways. This 3-star hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travelers.

132820.description: The Hotel Rigel, located on Venice's Lido island, offers convenient access to St. Mark's Square via a short, frequent boat service. Uniquely positioned between the Adriatic Sea and Venetian lagoon, it's the only island accessible by car, eliminating parking hassles and costs. The three-story hotel features 42 classically furnished rooms, many with balconies, and all equipped with private bathrooms, showers, air conditioning, direct-dial telephones, satellite TV, and Wi-Fi. An internet point is available in the lobby. The hotel's intimate size and direct management by the owners ensure a warm, personalized welcome, making guests feel at home.

132836.description: The Cite Hotel-Hoteles Cosmos is a fantastic city hotel located on a quiet area on the other side of el El Virrey park in the north side of Bogota, in the 'Zona Confort' , which is also very close to the 'Zona Rosa' and to the financial district. It enjoys a strategic location with easy access to a range of attractions and sites. This is a modern hotel offering a quality service and great facilities surrounded by a natural and urban atmosphere which will delight guests, an ideal place for business travellers and holidaymakers alike.

132847.description: This cosy accomodation guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 12 guest rooms. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Visitors may contact the reception desk any time during the day. Visitors arriving by car may leave their vehicle at the accommodation's parking spaces. Ararat - Haydar Sarigul may charge a fee for some services.

132849.address: Saray Mahallesi Hoca Ahmet Yesevi Cad., 20
132849.description: Located just a short walk from the town center and a variety of attractions, the Elegant Baronessa Apart Hotel offers 36 units and convenient access to transportation links within 150 meters. The nearest beach is only 500 meters away. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi in communal areas and benefit from the 24-hour reception service. While the entertainment areas are a bit further afield, the hotel's central location makes it an ideal base for exploring the area. The airport and harbor are also accessible, though distances need to be confirmed.

132861.description: Lying just a short distance away from central London, this hotel offers visitors the best of both worlds. Set amidst the tree-lined, tranquil surroundings of Chiswick High Road, the property is within easy walking distance e of Gunnersbury tube station. Kew Bridge Station and Heathrow Airport are also within easy reach. The hotel offers luxurious accommodation options, a high-class leisure centre, well-equipped conference spaces and wonderful banqueting facilities. Offering the ideal choice for every type of traveller, this property ensures an unrivalled level of comfort and convenience, in a superb setting. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification.

132945.description: Located in Póvoa de Varzim, the Torre Mar Hotel offers accommodation comprising 31 rooms, including family-friendly options. The hotel features a rooftop terrace with panoramic views of the town, countryside and sea. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, a minibar and a television. Guests have access to on-site private parking and a bar on the ground floor. A buffet breakfast is served daily. The property also offers room service and meeting facilities. The hotel is situated 1. 5 km from the centre of Póvoa de Varzim.

132960.description: The city hotel enjoys a wonderful location, on the most central square of this young and vibrant city. Guests will find restaurants, bars and links to the public transport network (bus and train) in the immediate vicinity. The beach in Espinho is approximately 20 km from the hotel. Furthermore, it is just 20 minutes away from Vila Nova de Gaia and Oporto. Other nearby places of interest include the Hat Museum (200 m), the winemakers of Porto (20 km away) and Santa Maria da Feira Castle (7 km away). Porto-Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is approximately 30 km from the city hotel. The hotel welcomes business and leisure travellers alike, and features only 36 guest rooms and suites, ensuring an intimate atmosphere at all times. Guests can enjoy breakfast in the comfort of their room with room service and the bar is the ideal spot to treat oneself to a refreshing drink after a day of sightseeing, shopping or working. The attentive staff are happy to be of assistance should guests wish to make use of the laundry or fax service. Further facilities available to guests at the air-conditioned hotel include a 24-hour reception, hotel safe, TV lounge, breakfast room and a garage. Each room features an en suite bathroom with a shower, bathtub and hairdryer, as well as a double bed and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. Other in-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, Internet access and a safe and minibar. Guests can watch the world go by from their private balcony, which offer views of the main square or the public pool. Guests can start the day in the breakfast room and indulge in a hearty breakfast while overlooking the main square.

132961.description: Located in Mumbai's vibrant heart, this hotel is surrounded by a diverse shopping district offering everything from bargains to high-end goods. Just 6 km from the domestic airport, this convenient stopover for leisure travelers features 16 elegantly styled suites with contemporary decor. Guests enjoy housekeeping, a multi-cuisine restaurant with 24-hour room service, and in-room safes, all contributing to a comfortable and pleasant stay.

132962.description: Hotel Bawa International-A Hotel near Domestic Terminal T1--Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. This hotel also features wedding services, a fireplace in the lobby, and discounted use of a nearby fitness facility. Grab a bite to eat at Royal Palatte, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 84 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and minibars. 32-inch LCD televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

132963.address: Juhu Tara Rd, Opposite Theosophical Society, Juhu
132963.description: The hotel is located at the heart of Mumbai's central tourist area, close to the city's major commercial, historical and shopping hubs. It is around 5 kms from the domestic airport and approximately 7 kms from the international airport. The budget-class business hotel is located in an upscale area of the beautiful city of Mumbai, and is well-known in the region for offering traditional hospitality, impeccable service and superb dining options to its guests. The hotel offers rooms with contemporary interiors to cater to the needs of all types of travellers Each room is equipped with modern amenities to ensure guests enjoy a comfortable stay. Stay at this hotel and experience the real Mumbai ambiance.

132964.address: Plot No.16/76, Gokuldas Pasta Rd, Dadar(East)
132964.description: The hotel is located in Dadar, one of the oldest commercial areas in the city, close to all the city's commercial, shopping and historical hubs. The hotel is around 2 km from Dadar Railway Station, roughly 12 km from the domestic airport and approximately 15 km from Chatrapathi Shivaji International Airport. The budget-class hotel is situated between south Mumbai and the suburbs, and offers a warm welcome, pleasant ambience and convenient facilities. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception, currency exchange facilities and lift access, and further facilities include air-conditioned public areas, conference and banqueting facilities, a coffee shop or café, complimentary newspapers in the lobby and a 24-hour power backup generator. Guests may also take advantage of the express check-in/check-out service, valet parking, room and laundry services, and a porter/bellhop and security guard. The hotel also provides prestigious, clean and comfortable accommodation units at outstanding value for the budget traveller. The hotel offers well-furnished and spacious rooms that are designed with wall-to-wall carpeted floors, an en suite bathroom with shower, individually regulated air conditioning and other standard amenities such as a cable/satellite TV, reading lamps, dial-up Internet access, a complimentary newspaper, direct dial telephone, tea and coffee making facilities, welcome amenities, a make-up mirror and separate sitting area.

132967.address: Sector 2 A,Plot No. 55 B,Main Road,Kopar Khairane
132967.description:
The hotel is located in the heart of Kopar Kharaine in Navi Mumbai, around 10 minutes from Vashi Railway Station and 4 minutes from Kopar Kharaine Railway Station. The domestic airport is approximately 30 km away and the international airport is 28 km away.

This modern air-conditioned hotel offers visitors to Mumbai a comfortable stay with efficient services and facilities, such as a V-Lounge, a rooftop restaurant, laundry service, free high-speed Internet access with wireless connection, free parking, a car rental service, a travel desk, taxi service, and a guide service for sightseeing trips. Further facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, a bar, conference facilities, room service, a babysitting service, on-call doctor, safe deposit lockers, a 24-hour power backup generator and a fax facility available on request.

The hotel offers comfortable and well-appointed air-conditioned rooms complete with all the modern facilities and amenities required for a hassle-free stay, including cable TV, intercom, tea and coffee making facilities, a mini fridge/minibar, mineral water, free broadband Internet access with wireless connection, an electronic safe, desk, sofa and a balcony/outdoor seating area to make each room a quintessential home away from home. Each room additionally features an en suite bathroom with shower, a direct dial telephone and individually regulated air conditioning.

132973.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul, this special class hotel offers 28 beautifully renovated rooms in a historic building, just steps away from iconic landmarks like the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. Enjoy a continental breakfast in our restaurant and stunning views of the Bosphorus and Golden Horn from the Firuzende Terrace Restaurant and Bar. While 14 rooms cater to smoking guests, unfortunately, we do not currently have accessible rooms or allow pets. Experience the unique charm of Istanbul from our comfortable deluxe rooms, junior suites, or executive suites, each designed with your comfort in mind.

133018.description: Spacious Accommodation: Silvertree in Cape Town offers a spacious 3-star villa with six bedrooms and six bathrooms. The property features a sauna, outdoor swimming pool, and a beautifully maintained garden. Modern Amenities: Guests enjoy free WiFi in public areas, a fitness room, and an outdoor seating area. Family rooms provide comfort for all visitors, ensuring a pleasant stay. Prime Location: Camps Bay Beach is a 9-minute walk away, while Table Mountain lies 6 km from the villa. Cape Town International Airport is 26 km distant, offering convenient travel options.

133022.description: The Victoires Opéra Hotel is a 4-star establishment ideally located in the heart of Paris, just steps away from the city's most famous tourist attractions. Its prime location, close to public transportation, restaurants, typical cafés, and shops, makes it the perfect starting point for exploring Paris. The elegant atmosphere of the hotel ensures an exceptional stay for its guests. Whether for business or leisure, this hotel offers top-notch comfort and service in a vibrant and historic neighborhood.

133023.description: Boasting a unique location in central Paris, this charming property is close to some of the most important tourist sites of this vibrant city, such as the Moulin Rouge, located a 20-minute walk from this hotel, and Place de Clichy, just 1 kilometre away. It provides a choice of rooms featuring a contemporary design that combines aesthetics and comfort with convincing functionality. They all come with wooden furnishings and parquet flooring, creating a relaxing ambience of peace and tranquillity. The services on offer include Wi-Fi internet connection available in all the accommodation units and a continental breakfast served every morning in the breakfast room.

133034.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Flushing? This hotel has 2700 square feet (251 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary at scheduled times. Make yourself at home in one of the 81 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and microwaves. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

133040.description:
Paloma Grida is being completly renewed, breathing new life into the resort while staying true to its original charm. This transformation ensures that the iconic features and lush natural gardens, 
which have long defined the resort, remain at the heart of the guest experience. 

Paloma Grida is located in Belek, Iskele Mevkii, just 700 meters from the town center. It is 35 kilometers from Antalya Airport and 45 kilometers from Antalya city center.

133045.description: Fully refurbished in 2009 and furnished and decorated in a modern, contemporary style, this beach hotel features an attractive outdoor pool area which overlooks the sandy beach and Mediterranean Sea. Located in the district of Avsallar, the hotel is midway between the resort towns of Side and Alanya, both of which boasting wonderful historical attractions and a wide range of shops and entertainment options. Guests will find local amenities less than 10 minutes' walk away, and amenities offered by the hotel include a meeting room and a choice of bars as well as a main buffet restaurant and two á la carte restaurants. The comfortable rooms are stylish and bright with flat-screen televisions, private balconies and wonderful sea views. Guests might take advantage of in-room Wi-Fi internet access as well as the handy coffee and tea tray during a relaxing holiday of sea and sun.

133158.description: This amazing hotel is located in Antalya, Turkey. The Antalya Airport is conveniently located just about 15 minutes away from the complex. For the ones who are looking for a place where to have fun, comfort, relaxation and where to eat delicious food, this property is simply the best option. Guests won’t have enough time to experience everything the property has to offer. The outdoor swimming pools and the surroundings are perfect to have fun in the water slides and enjoy the sun sunbathing in a sunlounger while sipping from a cocktail. The wide variety of food options is ideal for all types of visitors. The spa will spoil travellers and make them feel relaxed and calm. There are venues to host business meetings and conferences with the necessary facilities to make each event a success. The rooms are elegantly decorated and well-equipped with all the essential amenities and comfortable beds to make guests have the best and most memorable experience.

133200.description: Located on the Mediterranean coast in the Kizilagac region, this large holiday complex is approximately 11 km from Manavgat and around 12 km from the popular resort and historical city of Side. A wide range of leisure, sport and convention facilities are offered in this family friendly hotel and guests can also benefit from the comprehensive Thalasso and Spa Centre. The complex consists of 811 rooms situated in the main building and club rooms which are in 2-storey blocks in the grounds. There are a number of shops and a hairdressing salon within the complex. Further facilities include a games room, children's playground, kids' club, a choice of bars and restaurants, swimming pools and sports amenities. Guests can also benefit from the sister hotel's activities nextdoor. (Some facilities may not be operational due to weather/seasonal conditions).

133211.description: The hotel is located in the heart of Buenos Aires and offers the opportunity to live like a Porteño (citizen of Buenos Aires). All the apartments have a living room and a kitchen, giving guests the freedom of home with the comfort of a hotel. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with virtual reception; guest must contact hotel to arrange check in time. Services include wireless internet connection, a hotel safe, lift access, room and laundry services. Subways, railways, buses and taxis are all very close to the hotel.

133214.description: Those who stay at this establishment will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay on the premises, as it counts with a total of 6accomodation units. Travellers may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Casa Varzea.

133238.address: Tekirova Mah. Sehit Er Hasan Yilmaz Cad., 18
133238.description: This hotel is situated in the small resort of Tekirova, on Turkey's Mediterranean Coast. The hotel enjoys a stunning setting, lying by the sea, with a mesmerising Taurus Mountains and pine forest backdrop. The hotel lies within easy driving distance of a wealth of attractions. Links to the public transport can be found nearby. The resort sites on 40, 000 squared metres of land. The guest rooms are stunningly designed, beautifully combining traditional and contemporary elements. The hotel features a seemingly boundless range of facilities and services. Guests can enjoy water sports on the beach, or simply lie back by the pool, and revel in the splendour of the surroundings.

133263.description: This charming hotel is situated in the serene seaside fishing village of Hout Bay, Cape Town. The beach in Llandudno is approximately 15 minutes away. Due to its location, guests can explore with ease the scenic Cape Peninsula and visit the famous Chapman's Peak, World of Birds, Noordhoek, Camps Bay, Table Mountain, Robben Island and the ever-popular Victoria & Alfred Waterfront with its many shops. The centre of Cape Town and its train station are around a 30-minute drive from the design hotel, and Cape Town International airport is roughly 25 km away. Built in 1871, the family-friendly hotel is one of Cape Town's most graceful landmarks with 16 individually designed rooms, a fine dining restaurant and a boutique boardroom. It has preserved the history and heritage while infusing the interiors with Zulu and Xhosa chic decor to celebrate the vibrant pulse of South Africa. Guests can relax under magnificent old oak trees in the tranquil setting of the indigenous private garden. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, as well as a hotel safe, and further facilities include a bar and Internet access. Guests may also make use of the room and laundry services and car park. All rooms offer an en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub and hairdryer, a double or king-size bed, and a private balcony or terrace. Other in-room amenities include a safe, plasma screen satellite TV, a telephone, minibar and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. The peaceful setting and beautiful surroundings of the outdoor heated swimming pool ensure guests are able to relax and unwind on the sun loungers. A full menu of massages, facials and other pampering spa therapies in the Inzolo Wellness Suite is also available. The nearby beach is sandy.

133269.description: This modern hotel is located in Lisbon's historic district, within walking distance of the city center, Constantine Garden, and Almirante Reis Avenue. Downtown Lisbon is also easily accessible on foot. Excellent restaurants and cafes are nearby, as is the Anjos metro station. Lisbon Portela Airport is approximately 5 km away. The hotel offers 50 sophisticated rooms equipped with standard amenities, including a flat-screen TV and air conditioning, for exceptional comfort and convenience. Guests can also enjoy the convenience of a 24-hour on-site bar.

133286.description: Just a few steps from the vibrant Taksim Square and the Istiklal Street with its museums, galleries, shops, bars and exciting nightlife, this elegant hotel is ideal both for business and leisure trips. The Lütfi Kirdar Convention & Exhibition Centre and the lively Beyoglu district are within walking distance, Sultanahmet district with its famous attractions such as Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace or Blue Mosque is within easy reach.

133306.description: This hotel lies in the International Centre of Bogota, the banking and financial heart of the city. The hotel is located just a 5 minutes' driving distance away from the Gonzalo Jimenez de Quesada Convention Centre. The Museo Nacional can be found just a 15 minutes' walk away. The hotel lies within easy walking distance of Monserrate, the Museo del Oro, the Museo de Botero and the Qunita de Bolivar. El Dorado International Airport can be found just a 15 minutes' driving distance away. The hotel enjoys a modern design. The guest rooms are beautifully styled in a simplistic design, featuring wooden flooring and modern amenities. This hotel is the ideal choice for business and leisure travellers, featuring conference facilities, meeting rooms and a restaurant.

133310.description: This hotel boasts a prime location in Barra da Tijuca, a famous neighbourhood in the West Zone of Rio de Janeiro. Close to the major shopping malls in the region, this luxurious hotel is just a 30-minute drive from Galeão International Airport and a short driving distance from the world-renowned Ipanema Beach. Nature lovers will find Tijuca National Park some 25 kilometres away and the popular Pedra da Gavea mountain, one of the highest mountains in the world that ends directly on the ocean, just a 20-minute drive away. Guests staying at this hotel will find a choice of tastefully decorated rooms providing a pleasant atmosphere in which to completely unwind. Facilities at this air-conditioned establishment include business centre and a complimentary ferry shuttle to the beach. The swimming pool is ideal for visitors to refresh with a swim and the fitness centre is ideal to enjoy an invigorating workout. ***FREE TRANSPORT TO THE BEACH, EXIT IN FRONT OF THE HOTEL. NO SCHEDULE IS REQUIRED. AVAILABLE TRANSPORT OF TIME IN HOUR, EXCEPT MONDAYS. ***

133322.address: Naser Square, Naif road, Deira, Dubai, 25th 4
133322.description: The Golden Square Hotel Apartments is a 5-story, 155-unit property ideally situated in the heart of Deira, Dubai. Located between Nasser Square and Naif Souk, guests are within walking distance of the famed Gold Souk, Dubai Creek, Dhow Cruises, and Abra water taxis to the Dubai Museum. Banks, free zones, ports, educational hubs, and major shopping malls are easily accessible. The hotel is a short 3-minute walk from the metro and bus stand, a 5-minute drive from Deira Palm, and just 5 km from Dubai International Airport. The hotel offers tastefully decorated studios, deluxe studios, and one-bedroom apartments, each equipped with modern furnishings and a full kitchen, including crockery, cutlery, an electric kettle, toaster, microwave, fridge, and cooking range. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as an LCD/Plasma TV, Wi-Fi, a fully equipped gym, rooftop swimming pool, sauna, banquet hall, and an on-site restaurant/coffee shop. Additional services include a free shuttle to beaches and shopping malls (subject to booking), 24-hour reception, housekeeping, room service, laundry and dry cleaning, travel assistance, and paid private parking.

133344.address: Al Salam Tower,Sheikh Zayed Road, Media City
133344.description: Alsalam Grand Hotel Apartments Overlooking Burj Al Arab and Palm Island, Alsalam Grand Tower features an expansive pool area with panoramic views. It offers an elegant restaurants, and spacious accommodation with 32-inch flat-screen TVs. All suites and studios are decorated with a combination of dark wood furniture, white leather seats and warm, orange fabrics. They include fully equipped kitchens and modern bathrooms with design glass or marble sinks. Guests can keep fit in the spacious fitness centre, or unwind in the Finnish sauna, steam room, or in the round outdoor jacuzzi. Spa is available at a cost. The Alsalam Grand Hotel Apartments - Media City is steps from Dubai Media City and Internet City, and is opposite a 24-hour supermarket. Popular areas such as Knowledge Village, Dubai Marina, and Jumeirah Beach Walk are also nearby. Complimentary One-Device internet now included. Free Wifi for all inhouse guests and Public Areas.

133354.description: This new charming boutique hotel close to the Eiffel Tower enjoys a prime location in one of the most prestigious districts of the city: the 7th arrondissement. The decoration of hotel La Comtesse, a hotel particulier, is both contemporary and inspired by 18th century literary salons as well as by the women who hosted them (baronesses, countesses, marchionesses and duchesses). La Comtesse welcomes guests in her 40 rooms or suites, cozy cocoons filled with softness and finesse with exceptional views over the monuments of Paris (the Eiffel Tower, the Dôme des Invalides, Ecole Militaire). Its V-shaped Haussmannian building provides each room with a unique view over the Eiffel Tower, from the front or the side. As in the 18th century, guests will be able to enjoy a good book or a conversation in the Café located on the ground floor of the hotel. Additionally, La Comtesse will invite them to discover French delicacies with local produce. A steam bath and fitness equipment will enable you to stay fit while exploring Paris!A place of life tailored for a delicious experience in a timeless bubble!

133399.description: This luxurious country house hotel is situated on the border of Hertfordshire and Essex. The property is ideally located for access to Bishop's Stortford, Harlow and London Stansted Airport. This stunning property is set amidst 110 aces of land, oozing charm and sophistication. Superbly-styled guest rooms have been designed to exude classical elegance and splendour, beautifully echoing the charm of the surroundings. Guests can indulge in an alfresco dining experience, amidst the sophisticated surroundings of the estate. The establishment features a well-equipped fitness centre, as well as tennis courts, an opulent lounge, a cocktail bar and a restaurant. A fully-functional conference centre is available for the convenience of discerning business travellers. Pets are allowed. Charges may be applicable.

133439.description: Rixos Gulf Hotel Doha's mission is to offer our guests more than an experience by introducing a unique lifestyle and luxurious services and products, Rixos warm hospitality, the vibrant entertainment programs, and the trendy and distinguished All Inclusive Food and Beverage concepts.

133473.description: Paloma Finesse Side is located in Titreyengöl, Manavgat, about 6 km from Side city center and 75 km from Antalya Airport. This 299-room hotel offers a luxurious, modern take on traditional hospitality. Set amidst expansive gardens, it boasts a comfortable ambiance, a large beach, and à la carte restaurants with stunning Mediterranean views. For a truly elevated dining experience, savor the authentic flavors of Turkish cuisine at Paloma Finesse, featuring Gourmet Food by Vedat Başaran. Using locally sourced, high-quality ingredients, our culinary team crafts innovative dishes with impeccable technique. Beginning in 2019, renowned chef Vedat Başaran debuted his Gourmet Mediterranean concept at Finesse. His contemporary approach to Turkish cuisine, combined with revolutionary cooking techniques, elevates the hotel's culinary offerings. Complement your meal with selections from our organic and exclusive wine lists, or enjoy imaginative cocktails prepared by our skilled bartenders.

133476.address: Saray Mahallesi Çevreyolu Cad. Toromanlar Sok.
133476.description: The hotel is located towards the west side of the popular resort of Alanya. Cleopatra Beach is roughly 600 m away. The centre of the resort with its many attractions, including shops, restaurants and bars is 2 km away. Public transport connections are only around 100 m from the hotel, while the bus station is about 200 m away. Antalya Airport is approximately 130 km away from the hotel. The air-conditioned, family-friendly hotel offers a total of 335 rooms and suites. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe and currency exchange facilities. Further amenities include a hair dressing salon, a restaurant and conference facilities. The rooms are comfortably furnished and fully-equipped as standard featuring a satellite TV, a mini fridge and a hire safe box. Each room also comes with a balcony or terrace.

name.content: Inhabit Queen's Gardens, a Member of Design Hotels

133482.description: This hotel is in the idyllic corner of Queens Garden at Paddington, offering the perfect calm and serenity while still being in the heart of all the buzz of the capital. This prime location is less than 5 minutes from Paddington whilst being surrounded by all the excitement of London's West End. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, a restaurant, Wi-Fi in public areas and room service.

133483.description: Located in the heart of London, The Villa Kensington is within a 15-minute walk of the Natural History Museum and Kensington High Street. This hotel offers 38 air-conditioned guest rooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, digital programming, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. Enjoy convenient amenities such as express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and a continental breakfast available daily (for a fee). Nearby attractions include Imperial College London and Kensington Gardens. The closest airport is London City Airport (LCY).

133485.description: Located on the north bank of the Thames, residential Hammersmith retains a bustling, city-centre feel with high-street shops and offices. The area is best known for Stamford Bridge, the home stadium of football team Chelsea FC. There is an underground station within a 10-minute walk. The airports of Heathrow (about 21 km), Luton (43 km), Gatwick (58 km) and Stansted (78 km) are all nearby. This is an ideal choice for both business and tourist travellers. The hotel features 13 guest rooms located on three floors. There is also a conference room and complimentary wireless Internet access in the public areas. The reception in the lobby is open 24 hours a day. All rooms have standard décor, television, complimentary wireless Internet access, and complimentary toiletries. These rooms have shared bathroom facilities. The hotel serves a continental breakfast.

133487.description: This London hotel places you in the heart of the city, within a 10-minute walk of Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. The Astoria Hotel offers 12 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions and complimentary wireless internet access. Each room includes a private bathroom with a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. Additional conveniences such as electric kettles and daily housekeeping are also provided, and cribs/infant beds are available upon request. On-site amenities include multilingual staff, luggage storage, and coffee/tea in a common area. Self-parking is available for a fee. Nearby attractions include Marble Arch (0. 7 mi) and Oxford Street (1. 2 mi). Heathrow Airport (LHR) is the preferred airport for the hotel.

133498.description: Located in George, 7. 8 miles from George Golf Club, Far Hills Country Hotel has accommodations with an outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a garden and a shared lounge. With free WiFi, this 4-star hotel has a terrace and a bar. Some rooms at the property feature a patio with a pool view. At the hotel, the rooms are equipped with a desk, a flat-screen TV, a private bathroom, bed linen and towels. The rooms include an electric tea pot, while certain rooms also offer a balcony and others also have mountain views. Far Hills Country Hotel offers an à la carte or continental breakfast. At the accommodation you'll find a restaurant serving African, British and French cuisine. Vegetarian, dairy-free and vegan options can also be requested. Far Hills Country Hotel has a playground. Guests at the hotel will be able to enjoy activities in and around George, like hiking. There's an in-house snack bar and guests can also use the business area. Languages spoken at the reception include Afrikaans and English. Outeniqua Pass is 10 miles from Far Hills Country Hotel, while Lakes Area National Park is 13 miles from the property. The nearest airport is George Airport, 10 miles from the accommodation.

133500.description: This friendly, family-run hotel, housed in a restored, historically listed Victorian building, is just a two-minute walk from bustling Marble Arch. With its convenient access to the Underground, train stations, Hyde Park, and world-class shopping on Oxford Street, the hotel is ideally situated for exploring London. All major city attractions are within easy reach. Nearby airports include Heathrow (approximately 30 km), Luton and Stansted (both around 50 km), and Gatwick (roughly 60 km). Recently refurbished rooms feature direct-dial telephones, satellite TV, refrigerators, central heating, hairdryers, fans, and tea and coffee making facilities. The hotel offers late check-in for a fee, upon request. Please note: cribs/cots are not available, and children under 12 are not permitted.

133501.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Corbigoe Hotel, conveniently located within a 5-minute drive of Buckingham Palace and Hyde Park. This hotel offers 22 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs and digital programming. Stay connected with Wi-Fi (surcharge). Each room includes a coffee/tea maker and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Hotel amenities include a 24-hour front desk, express check-in, luggage storage, and tour/ticket assistance. Victoria Station is a short walk away (0. 6 mi).

133502.description: Conveniently located in Victoria, this hotel enjoys close proximity to the nearby station. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the wealth of intriguing attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. Major links to the public transport network can be found nearby. Perfect for business and leisure trips alike, this property offers a high level of comfort and convenience. The guest rooms are comfortable, tastefully designed and well equipped with modern amenities. Offering friendly staff, excellent service and an ideal location, this hotel is a great choice for any type of visit to London.

133505.description: The hotel is placed in one of the most convenient locations in the Victoria and Westminster neighbourhood. This area features a large amount of attractions and tourist sites, such as the Westminster Abbey, Houses of Parliament, London Eye, Buckingham Palace, and the Tate Britain. London Heathrow Airport is around 22 km from the hotel, London Gatwick some 36 km, whilst London Luton and London Stansted airports are situated at a distance of approximately 46 km and 51 km, respectively. This traditional, clean and comfortable bed and breakfast hotel in Victoria, Central London is an ideal choice for travellers looking for competitive and moderately priced accommodation within easy reach of all London has to offer. Comprising a total of 21 rooms, the hotel offers a 24-hour reception and a breakfast room. The hotel features clean, comfortable and traditional guestrooms with or without en suite facilities depending on guests' needs and budgets. A direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV and tea and coffee making facilities come in the rooms as standard. Breakfast is served each morning. By train, from Heathrow Airport: take the Piccadilly Line to Earl's Court and once there interchange to the District Line towards Westminster/Upminster and get off at Victoria Station. The hotel is within walking distance of the station. It is also accessible from Gatwick Airport by trains which run directly to Victoria Station.

133506.description: The Seymour Hotel & Annex is situated in one of London's most popular tourist locations. It is a small and friendly place to stay on your visit to London. Only a few minutes walking distance from Hyde Park, and with Paddington, Lancaster Gate and Edgware Road Stations all being close by, visitors are never far from any of the great tourist sites of Central London. All 19 bedrooms have full en-suite facilities, direct-dial, telephone, satellite television and hair dryers.

133518.description: Strategically located only 5 minutes from the Victoria coach and train stations, all major sights, shops, restaurants, and theatres are within either walking distance or reachable within a few minutes using public transport. London Heathrow Airport is situated approximately 22 km away and London Gatwick is some 36 km away, whilst London Luton Airport and London Stansted Airport are roughly 46 km and 51 km away, respectively. This family-run hotel offers comfortable, good value bed and breakfast accommodation in London's fashionable district of Pimlico. Comprising a total of 18 rooms, the hotel features a 24-hour reception and a breakfast room. All well-furnished en suite rooms have an LCD flat-screen Freeview TV, complimentary high-speed Internet access, a direct dial telephone and tea and coffee making facilities. The en suite bathrooms are fitted with a shower and hairdryer. A continental breakfast is served each morning.

133519.description: Located in London's City Centre, the Gresham Hotel is a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. This hotel offers 56 guestrooms and amenities such as a 24-hour front desk and an elevator. A complimentary breakfast is included. Nearby attractions include Marble Arch (1. 2 km) and Paddington Central (0. 8 km). The closest airport is Heathrow (LHR).

133520.description:
The hotel is situated at Marble Arch in the heart of London's West End, only a few minutes' walk from Oxford Street and Hyde Park. Bus and underground transport links are located virtually at the door, making it easy to access all major airports and intercity rail terminals. London Heathrow Airport is some 21 km away, Gatwick Airport is around 39 km away, Luton Airport is about 43 km away and it is roughly 50 km to Stansted Airport.

The hotel's cosy atmosphere and a warm welcome provide an ideal starting point for a holiday. Whether guests are looking for a comfortable guest room or a well-equipped self-contained apartment, this hotel has the perfect accommodation on offer. Being a small establishment, with just 11 rooms in total, the friendly staff have time to offer advice and assistance to make every guest's stay as enjoyable as possible. The hotel reception is open around the clock.

All of the clean and comfortable rooms have an en suite bathroom and are fully equipped with a radio, TV, telephone, tea and coffee making facilities, a safe, minibar, hairdryer and ironing set, ensuring a pleasant and enjoyable stay.

133525.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Hyde Park Court Hotel, including complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall. Continental breakfast is available daily for a fee. The hotel also offers express check-out, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Relax in one of the 21 comfortable guestrooms, each featuring a pillowtop bed, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Located in the heart of London, Hyde Park Court Hotel is a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens, and conveniently close to Marble Arch and Oxford Street. Nearby attractions include Paddington Central, Baker Street, Madame Tussauds Wax Museum, and the Sherlock Holmes Museum.

133527.description: This modern hotel on London's Upper Berkeley Street places you near various attractions, shopping, dining, and entertainment. Conveniently located near public transport, it offers easy access to the bustling city center. The charming property features stylish guest rooms equipped with modern amenities. With warm hospitality and high-quality service, it's an excellent choice for both business and leisure travelers.

133528.description: Ideally located at the heart of London, this hotel is just a few minutes' walking distance from the Heathrow Express terminal at Paddington Station. World-famous attractions can be found nearby, including Oxford Street, Regent Street, Knightsbridge, Hyde Park and the West End theatres. Buckingham Palace, Trafalgar Square and many museums are also within easy reach. This property offers tastefully-decorated guest rooms, which are fully fitted with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy a hearty breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore the city. This property offers a high level of service, complemented by warm hospitality and an inviting ambiance.

133554.description: Located in the suburbs of Sant Cugat del Valles, Hotel Venture Sant Cugat offers convenient access to Barcelona's attractions, with Camp Nou and Passeig de Gràcia within a 15-minute drive. This hotel provides 83 guestrooms equipped with plasma televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Each room includes a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, along with a safe and desk. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant or grab a quick bite at the snack bar/deli. A bar/lounge is also available for evening relaxation. Buffet breakfast is served daily for a fee. Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, free self-parking, and a terrace with city views.

133555.description: This hotel is located on the Can Alzamora industrial estate, very close to Can Jardí and La Bastida. It lies only 10 km from Barcelona, approximately 10 minutes by car via the Vallvidriera tunnels. Rodalies Renfe Rubí station is 200 m from the hotel can get guests to Barcelona centre (Plaça Catalunya) in 25 minutes. Facilities include a 24-hour reception, a business corner, a luggage store and a meeting room. Guests have an Internet terminal at their disposal and can enjoy a coffee service 24 hours a day.

133574.description: This hotel is situated in Fuenlabrada, to the south of Madrid. It is ideally located close to Warner Bros Theme Park, which is sure to please guests of all ages. The hotel is just a 20 minutes' driving distance away from the centre of Madrid, where a myriad of attractions, as well as many shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities, can be found. Madrid Airport is just 35 km away. This functional, family-friendly hotel entices guests with its inviting ambiance. The guest rooms are fully equipped with modern amenities, as well as offering space and comfort. The hotel's many facilities and services ensure that each and every traveller enjoys a truly impeccable stay.

133579.description: Galaico Hotel is located in the town of Collado Villaba, only a half-hour drive from Madrid's city centre and 10 minutes from the Sierra de Madrid. This convenient location offers easy access to both the city and popular tour destinations such as Segovia, Avila, and La Granja de San Ildefonso. Guests may wish to visit the nearby El Escorial, or take the train to Madrid for excellent restaurants and shopping and to take in the city sights. The hotel's sound-proofed guest rooms offer en suite bathroom, internet access and satellite television for a restful and stress-free stay, and the hotel provides a variety of helpful services and facilities such as free access to the nearby gym, indoor parking, and meeting rooms for business meetings and seminars. Guests can also appreciate the convenience of the onsite restaurant-café serving traditional Spanish cuisine, snacks and coffees.

name.content: The Regency, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western

133588.description: The Regency Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western, is a 4-star hotel located approximately 15 minutes from the Monza Formula One circuit and 18 km from Milan. The Milano Rho-Pero fairgrounds are only 20 km away. The hotel offers 69 rooms, including an executive suite, two family suites, and several triple rooms. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, a private bathroom with shower, high-quality toiletries, a minibar, a safe, and Wi-Fi (up to 100 MB). Additional beds or cribs for babies and children are available upon request, as are accessible rooms. Each morning, a breakfast buffet featuring a wide selection of freshly prepared sweet and savory options is served in a large, bright room. Gluten-free choices are also available. The hotel bar offers a variety of drinks and cocktails, accompanied by hot and cold snacks, which can be enjoyed in the elegant Regency-style lounge or, during the summer, in the outdoor courtyard adjacent to the garden. For a quick and informal dinner, hot and cold dishes are also available at the bar. Guests arriving by car can take advantage of the free 100-space parking garage, which also includes a complimentary electric car charging point. Ample free public parking for buses is available directly in front of the hotel. The Regency Hotel is an ideal starting point for visiting Monza, Milan, Lake Lecco, and Brianza, as well as the Milan Fair, the Monza Formula One circuit, and Monza Park with its Royal Villa. The Lissone train station is only 500 meters away.

133597.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and convenient tour/ticket assistance at The Park Hotel, located in London's city center. The hotel's 18 guestrooms offer comfortable accommodations with rainfall showers and work desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. You'll be within a 5-minute drive of Westminster Abbey and Buckingham Palace, and a short walk from Victoria Station. Nearby attractions include Big Ben, St. James Park, and Hyde Park.

133601.description:
Please let us know your expected arrival time, as our reception operates with limited opening hours. 

A city tax of €10. 45 per person, per night applies (up to a maximum of 7 nights) and is charged to guests aged 16 and over. 

Located just 200 meters from Bogatell Beach in Barcelona’s peaceful Poblenou neighborhood, Lugaris Beach Apartments offers modern accommodation with floor-to-ceiling windows and free high-speed internet access. Each apartment features a fully equipped private kitchen with an oven, Nespresso machine, and refrigerator, as well as a living area with a flat-screen TV offering international channels and a washer-dryer. 

Guests are welcomed with a complimentary essentials pack including coffee, tea, milk, sugar, salt, and oil. On-site services include a tour desk and babysitting upon request. Shuttle service is also available for an additional fee. 

Bed linen, towels, and beach towels are provided free of charge. Car and bike rentals can be arranged, and parking is available for an extra charge. 

The property is a 5-minute walk from Poblenou Metro Station and a 2-minute walk from Poblenou Park. The surrounding area offers a wide selection of bars, restaurants, and a shopping center. Plaza Catalunya and Las Ramblas in central Barcelona can be reached in approximately 20 minutes by metro.

133602.description: A true urban oasis located just steps from Glorieta de Cuatro Caminos and Paseo de la Castellana, where our Welcoming Luxury philosophy transforms every stay into a unique experience. You’ll feel at home, yet surrounded by the elegance of redefined luxury and meticulous attention to every detail. This cozy hotel offers 102 spacious rooms, designed in a minimalist and carefully curated style, crafted to provide maximum comfort. You’ll also find Mercado Madriles Reina Victoria, a vibrant space in the heart of Madrid where traditional Spanish tapas, Mexican cuisine, Asian dishes, and healthy options coexist—offering a unique culinary experience without leaving the hotel. Additionally, the hotel features several naturally lit rooms, ideal for any type of meeting or event.

133686.description: Situated near Olympia, Westfield, BBC studios, and Shepherd's Bush Empire, this cozy hotel offers convenient access to transport links, placing Hyde Park, Notting Hill, and central London within easy reach. Heathrow Airport is 20 km away. This 11-room city hotel in Hammersmith provides a bustling atmosphere amidst shops and offices. Guests enjoy a 24-hour reception, breakfast room, and Wi-Fi. Rooms feature amenities like TVs, Wi-Fi, and telephones, with shared bathrooms. A continental breakfast is served daily.

133689.description: Located in fashionable South Kensington, St Simeon offers cooked breakfast in the mornings, a self-catering communal kitchen, and free WiFi in public areas. Less than 10 minutes' walk from central London's famous museums, it is also just a 5-minute walk from both Earl's Court and Gloucester Road Tube Stations. With period-style decor, each budget room includes a flat-screen TV, tea/coffee making facilities in central kitchen, and an en-suite bath or shower room. Hairdryers are available upon request. St Simeon offers a communal kitchen for guests along with a dining area and a TV room. Reception closes at 1. 00am. There are numerous bars and restaurants within 10 minutes’ walk of the building. In London's affluent Kensington and Chelsea district, St Simeon is just 20 minutes' walk from the world-famous Harrods Department Store. Home to the historic Houses of Parliament and Big Ben, iconic Westminster can be reached after a 20-minute journey on the District or Circle Tube Lines. Public car parks and on-street metered parking is available just 5 minutes' walk away.

name.content: Hotel Ariane Montparnasse by Patrick Hayat

133702.description: The Ariane Montparnasse Hotel***, nestled in the heart of the Montparnasse district on a quiet pedestrian street, opens onto a charming tree-filled square. A short five-minute walk from the Pernety and Alesia metro stations and ten minutes from the Montparnasse train station, it's ideally located for exploring Paris. This vibrant neighborhood, popular with tourists and Parisians alike, offers a diverse array of restaurants, theaters, and attractions. Guests appreciate the elegant hourglass-themed decor, comfortable rooms with high-speed Wi-Fi, and attentive 24-hour service. A delicious buffet breakfast featuring freshly squeezed orange juice, homemade cakes, and traditional French breads and pastries is served daily. The Jardin du Luxembourg, the Catacombs, the Latin Quarter, and Bon Marché are just minutes away, while Paris Expo Porte de Versailles is a 15-minute drive.

133703.description: The Sir Savigny Hotel, part of the Sircle Collection, exudes creative energy in Berlin's fashionable Charlottenburg district. Located on Savignyplatz in the heart of the City West's Art Nouveau quarter, this luxury boutique hotel is within walking distance of the renowned Kurfürstendamm shopping street. A stylish yet casual haven, the Sir Savigny offers a welcoming atmosphere for cosmopolitan travelers and locals alike. Guests can enjoy the hotel's culinary offerings or relax and discuss art and culture in the casually elegant common areas. Please note, there is an additional 5% city tax payable at the hotel.

133705.description: This hotel's Scandinavian style brings a relaxing Scandinavian atmosphere to Berlin's busy Potsdamer Platz. This modern area offers a great selection of shops, restaurants and entertainment. Situated near the former Berlin Wall, this hotel is close to Brandenburger Tor, Holocaust Memorial and the German Parliament. Note: Drinks are available at our bar every day between 17:00-01:00. Snacks are available 24 hours a day in our Scandic Shop.

name.content: Hotel Riu Tikida Palmeraie - All Inclusive

133712.description: Hotel Riu Tikida Palmeraie is located nestled in exotic gardens and it has all the facilities you need in order to enjoy an unforgettable holiday in an oasis of peace. This all-inclusive hotel in Marrakech offers a never-ending array of services, including free WiFi, a broad range of cuisine and fun entertainment programmes so that you can enjoy an unforgettable experience with RIU Hotels & Resorts. Hotel Riu Tikida Palmeraie has more than 350 rooms, all fully equipped to offer you the facilities you need. In all of them, you will find heating, air conditioning, a safe box, a mini-fridge and a balcony or terrace, along with many other services. And if you want to enjoy a refreshing dip, the hotel has an outdoor pool with a sun lounger and umbrella area where you can take a moment to totally relax. The hotel's culinary offerings are rich in both quality and variety. In the mornings, we suggest you enjoy the delicious buffet breakfasts with live cooking stations, and for lunch and dinner, we provide the best Moroccan cuisine so that you can explore Morocco's food culture, or top Italian dishes in the restaurant in the pool area. We also have 3 bars where you can savour the best soft drinks and aperitifs. Entertainment is guaranteed at this all-inclusive hotel: creative types can have fun at the RiuArt workshop, sports lovers can enjoy the RiuFit programme, and the little ones in the family will have a fun-packed holiday with the children's pool and park and RiuLand kids' club, a special programme with activities designed especially for them. The hotel also offers guests the chance to play sports like tennis and table tennis, or to visit the local golf courses where aficionados can enjoy their favourite sport. And, after a day packed with activities, you can head to the Tikida spa to enjoy a moment of peace and well-being.

133713.description: This hotel provides the perfect base from which to explore all the hidden treasures of the ‘ville de l’amour’, Paris. Guests staying at this cosy hotel will find themselves close to Georges Brassens Park, ideal for them to practice their morning runs. They can also easily explore the Parc des Expositions at Porte de Versailles, the Palais des Sports, and visit the world-renowned Eiffel Tower and Champ de Mars, situated a short metro ride away. Guests will find a choice of different room types to choose from to meet everyone needs, ranging from the double units to the spacious and luxurious Junior Suite, equipped with a choice of delightful amenities for guests to enjoy their stay as much as possible. The welcoming lounge area is ideal to share nice moments with friends, and a delectable breakfast is served for guests’ convenience.

133714.description: Enjoy a central Paris stay at the eco-certified Hôtel Coypel by Magna Arbor, just a 3-minute walk from Place d'Italie. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and discounted access to a nearby fitness center. Start your day with a continental breakfast (available for a fee), and take advantage of room service during limited hours. The 42 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, private balconies, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Île Saint-Louis (5-minute drive), Luxembourg Gardens (1. 3 mi), and Notre-Dame (1. 9 mi).

133765.description: This hotel is located at Porte D'Italie. Guests have access from the périphérique ring road and the A6B motorway and it is just 500 m from the underground and tramway stations (Porte d'Italie). L'Opéra is just 800 m from the hotel and further attractions in the surrouding area include Place d'Italie (3 km), Stade Charlety (3. 5 km) and Chatelet (6 km). It is 9 km to the Eiffel Tower and 40 km to Disneyland Paris. The hotel lies 8 km from Paris Orly Airport and 29 km from Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport. This fully renovated city hotel features a new concept in accommodation and comprises a total of 150 rooms. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, lift access and a cafe. There is a cosy restaurant with delicious cuisine that changes every day, a lounge bar and 6 bright conference rooms. Guests also have Internet access at their disposal for an additional fee, and there is covered garage parking available for those arriving by car. The hotel offers spacious, well-lit rooms and non-smoking facilities and has been designed to offer a relaxing stay. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a shower/bathtub and a hairdryer, as well as offering a double bed. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV and Internet access. Furthermore, tea and coffee making facilities, an ironing set and individually regulated air conditioning and heating are provided in all accommodation as standard. Guests can select their breakfast from a buffet and the midday and evening meals are available in buffet form, from a set menu or à la carte. Guests arriving from the Paris périphérique (outer ring-road) should exit for Porte d'Italie, then the N7 towards Kremlin-Bicetre and take the 1st right. For those coming from Orly/Lyon, take the A6B towards Porte d'Italie and then exit for Porte d'Italie.

133776.description:
The hotel is located only 500 metres from the synagogue and the famous Tacheles artists' complex in Berlin. The Friedrichstrasse shopping street is 5 minutes' walk. Located in the heart of Berlin, the hotel offers excellent connections by underground and train stations, with Hackescher Markt station 200 metres away and Oranienburger Strasse metro station 500 metres away. There are shops, restaurants, bars and nightlife in the immediate vicinity. Hauptbahnhof main train station is 20 minutes' walk from the hotel. Nearby places of interest include Museum Island (5 minutes' walk), Brandenburg Gate and the Reichstag (both 20 minutes on foot), Potsdamer Platz (2 km away) and the Kurfürstendamm shopping street (10 minutes by metro).

Renovated in 2011, this modern hotel offers 124 stylish rooms and a colourful breakfast room. With simple decor, the family-friendly historical hotel offers wireless Internet access in public areas (fees apply) and a laundry service. Guests are welcomed to the air-conditioned themed hotel in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe and lift access to the upper floors. The city hotel also offers a games room, TV lounge, children's playground, breakfast room and a bicycle hire service (fees apply).

Each room features an en suite bathroom with shower and hairdryer, satellite TV, a radio, Internet access and individually regulated air conditioning and heating.

A breakfast buffet is served each morning.

133786.address: 7, Derb El Marstane Zaouia El Abassia
133786.description:
The hotel is located in the north of Marrakech's medina in an area called Bab Taghzout, twenty minutes' walk from Djemaa el Fna Square. The nearby Bab Taghzout Square is a hub for taxis. The city centre at Gueliz is around 2 km, or a 15-minute walk, away. Sidi Bel Abbas temple is around 200 m away, and the souks of the medina are some 300 m away. Marrakech-Menara Airport is approximately 6 km away.

The 12 rooms and suites of the hotel are laid out around the patio on two levels, and are decorated with taste, originality, and with a constant eye to refinement. The furniture and decorative objects were exclusively designed and created here by Moroccan craftsmen. The crystalline murmur of a fountain can be distinguished over the hubbub of the bazaars, a heavy door is discreetly ajar among the ancient facades of the old town (medina) opening onto one of the most beautiful riads of Marrakech. Facilities at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby, 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, restaurant, Internet access and a laundry service.

The rooms bear the names and tell the stories of explorers and great voyagers of legend such as Saint-Exupéry, Marco Polo, Théodore Monod and Alexandra David-Neel. In-room amenities include an en suite bathroom, double or king-size bed, satellite/cable TV, Internet access, a safe, minibar, individually regulated air conditioning and a balcony or terrace.

The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool with sun loungers, and massage and spa treatments are offered (for a fee).oroccan breakfast is served in the patio's coolness or on the terrace.

133801.description: This elegant hotel evokes a Parisian feel, situated mere minutes from the Val D'Europe shopping centre and 2 km from Disneyland Paris. The nearby RER Val d'Europe train station provides access to Paris in 35 minutes. Located 35 km from both Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports, it's ideal for business travelers. The buffet breakfast is €18 per adult and €10 per child (ages 3-11).

133838.description: This charming aparthotel, nestled in the Sierra de Guadarrama mountains, offers a tranquil escape near San Lorenzo del Escorial and its renowned monastery. Explore nearby attractions, including the Valley of the Fallen, the Palacio Real de Riofrio, and the Palacio Real de La Granja de San Ildefonso, or enjoy the slopes at the Navacerrada ski resort. Madrid and Segovia are both within a 30-minute drive. Conveniently located 3km from Guadarrama bus station and 10km from Villalba train station, this 4-star hotel provides free parking and easy access to Madrid-Barajas Airport (70km). Indulge in the on-site restaurant, unwind in the café and bar, or dance the night away in the disco. Additional amenities include a children's playground, WLAN internet access, and laundry service. Choose from three double room types: rustic rooms with charming wooden floors, standard rooms with scenic views, or external wood-and-stone bungalows featuring private balconies and breathtaking vistas. All rooms are equipped with an ensuite bathroom, satellite TV, internet access, and individually controlled air conditioning and heating. Enjoy the garden, sun terrace, and children's area, or explore the region by bike or horseback. A continental breakfast buffet is served daily, while lunch and dinner offer both set menu and à la carte options. To reach the hotel from Madrid via the A6 motorway, take exit 42 and continue straight for 10km. Pass through Guadarrama village until kilometer marker 51. 5 on the N-VI.

133839.description: These apartments are the perfect choice for all visitors of Barcelona that prefer a highly independent and relaxing break in the city and don't enjoy the rigidness of the standard hotels. Housed in a modernist building that is within a walking distance of the famous Paseo de Gracia and perfectly connected to the rest of the city through the Tetuan metro line (#2) that is just opposite of it. The famous Ramblas and the beaches can be reached for only 10 minutes by public transport and the bus station that gives easy access to the rest of the country is approximately 10 minutes' walk away. The spacious accommodations can house up to 7 guests and are furnished with all of the necessary equipment required for self-catering. The living room has a double sofa bed and the apartments are fully equipped with bed linens, duvets and towels for every guest.

133843.description: With a total of 5 accomodation units, this is a nice place to stay. Those staying at this hotel may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Additional fees may apply for some services.

133844.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Grab a bite to eat at the hotel's restaurant, which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 5 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 50 guestrooms featuring DVD players. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Mountfitchet Castle - 4. 9 km / 3 mi- House on the Hill Toy Museum - 4. 9 km / 3 mi- Whoosh Explore - 6. 4 km / 4 mi- Flitch Way Country Park - 6. 4 km / 4 mi- Hatfield Forest Country Park - 6. 8 km / 4.

133845.description: This hotel is located only 5 minutes from Victoria coach and train stations. All major sights, shops, restaurants, and theatres are either within walking distance or reachable in a few minutes using public transport. The hotel is situated on a quiet residential street, with no traffic noise. It is around 1. 8 km to Buckingham Palace, some 2 km to Westminster and the tourist centre, about 2. 5 km to Hyde Park, roughly 2. 9 km to Piccadilly Circus and around 6 km to Notting Hill. Heathrow Airport is approximately 26 km away. A warm welcome awaits guests at this city hotel. It comprises a total of 10 rooms spread over 6 floors and has discrete and attentive staff who take the utmost care to retain the traditions of hospitality and superior service at this establishment. Facilities on offer to guests include a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, a breakfast room and wireless Internet access. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer. They are equipped with satellite/cable TV, Internet access and tea and coffee making facilities. Furthermore, an ironing set and central heating are provided in all accommodation as standard.

133848.description: Enjoy a complimentary breakfast at the Staunton Hotel, located in London's City Centre, a short walk from Russell Square and Tottenham Court Road. This hotel offers 17 guestrooms, a 24-hour front desk, computer station, and multilingual staff. You'll be within a 5-minute walk of University College London and just a short distance from attractions like the British Museum and Covent Garden Market. The nearest airport is London City Airport (LCY), and Heathrow Airport (LHR) is also easily accessible.

133852.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Opulence Boutique Hotel, located within a 10-minute walk of Marble Arch and Hyde Park. This boutique guesthouse offers 19 comfortable guestrooms equipped with refrigerators, LCD TVs, and satellite programming. Wireless internet access is available for a surcharge. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and bidets. Additional conveniences include desks, coffee/tea makers, and daily housekeeping. The hotel also provides dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. You'll be just a short stroll from Oxford Street and Madame Tussauds Wax Museum, putting the best of London at your doorstep.

133853.description: Situated in the heart of Golders Green, this city hotel is set in a very quiet location, only a short walk away from the local shops and restaurants and Golders Green metro station. Golders Hill Park is a 5-minute drive away and nearby airports include London Heathrow (21 km away), London Luton (36 km away), London Gatwick (45 km away) and London Stansted (46 km away). This well-established bed and breakfast hotel offers 23 rooms to suit almost everyone. Breakfast is served in the breakfast room. The hotel offers comfortable rooms to suit almost everyone, with a mixture of singles, twins, doubles and triples. All rooms are fully equipped with a TV, tea/coffee making facilities and a direct dial telephone.

133854.description: Enjoying a great location on London, this bed and breakfast is situated in the district of Tufnell Park. The property is located within easy walking distance of the area's underground station. Local attractions include Hampstead Heath and Camden Market. Central London, with its treasure trove of intriguing attractions, is just a 10 minutes' underground ride away. This charming property occupies an elegant Edwardian house, which was built towards the end of the 19th century. The guest rooms echo the character and charm of the building, featuring soothing tones and fine furnishings. Guests are invited to enjoy a superb breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore this vibrant city.

133856.description: This unique new central London hostel is housed in a Victorian listed building that has received a substantial refurbishment to restore it to its original condition. It offers travellers all the facilities expected from the very best hostels in London at an ideal location. Sitting near Swiss Cottage and Finchley Road tube stations it allows them to get to the heart of the city within minutes. Regent's Park is around 1. 5 km away, while Camden Town is roughly 2. 9 km and the downtown area is just a 10-minute ride away. At the venue they can relax in the TV lounge with the free Wii console or a game of pool. Those who want to try a proper British pint can visit the onsite bar. Couples can share a double bed, which comes equipped with privacy curtains, their own lights and power sockets

133867.description: The Somerset Hotel is located in London City Centre, a neighbourhood in London. Buckingham Palace and The British Museum are notable landmarks, and some of the area's popular attractions include London Eye and Natural History Museum. Looking to enjoy an event or a game? See what's going on at Wembley Stadium or O2 Arena. Take the opportunity to explore the area for outdoor excitement like cycling. 3-star hotel near Oxford StreetNear Madame Tussauds Wax Museum, The Somerset Hotel provides everything you need. Stay connected with free WiFi in public areas. You'll also enjoy the following perks during your stay:Self-parking (surcharge), smoke-free property and luggage storageA 24-hour front desk.
