Note-Late check-in will carry an extra fee of £10 per hour between 00:00-02:00, then £20 per hour for 02:00 onwards. Guests will have to pay £100 refundable security deposit at check-in.

133868.description: Enjoy convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and wedding services at the Ravna Gora Hotel in London's Kensington district. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge after exploring nearby attractions like Portobello Road Market (a 15-minute walk) and Kensington Gardens. A computer station, 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff are available for your assistance. Self-parking is available for a fee, and breakfast can be added to your stay. The hotel offers 23 comfortable guestrooms. Westfield London Shopping Centre and Kensington High Street are within a short distance, and Heathrow Airport is easily accessible.

133869.description: Situated just 6 km away from London Heathrow Airport, this property boasts a convenient setting in London. Twickenham Rugby Stadium is just a short driving distance away. This property sits just a short walk away from Hounslow West London Underground Station, offering ease of access to the bustling centre of the city, where a wealth of attractions can be found. A number of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities are located in the area. This charming property ensures a warm welcome and a peaceful setting in which to unwind. The tastefully-designed guest rooms offer a comfortable space in which to work or rest. The lodge offers a superb breakfast in the mornings, for a hearty start to the day.

133871.description: Located in London's Kensal Green neighborhood, Kensal Green Backpackers 1 is a convenient base for exploring the city. Westfield London Shopping Centre and Wembley Stadium are within a 10-minute drive. This hostel offers 103 guestrooms, a shared kitchen for preparing meals, and both complimentary Wi-Fi and paid Wi-Fi options. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant for lunch and dinner, a coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service. Additional amenities include a bar/lounge, an arcade/game room, a communal TV area, and a 24-hour front desk. Nearby attractions include Hyde Park, Royal Albert Hall, and Portobello Road Market. Buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee. )

133873.description:
This hotel enjoys an ideal location, just a short walk from Paddington Station and some 4 minutes' walk from Edgware Road station. It offers easy access to London's major tourist attractions such as Madame Tussaud's, Buckingham Palace and Kensington Palace. Hyde Park and Oxford Street are around 10 minutes' and 15 minutes' walk away respectively.

This city hotel comprises a total of 35 rooms over 5 floors. Facilities on offer to guests include a 24-hour reception and reservations service, a breakfast room and wireless Internet access on all floors. Parking is available on the premises (for an additional fee).

All rooms are comfortable and come with a private bathroom with a shower. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access and a fridge as well as tea and coffee making facilities.

Guests are served a continental breakfast each morning.

Edgware Road is the nearest tube station and is served by the Circle, District and Hammersmith and City lines.

133979.description: Located in Antalya's Old City, Kauçuk Hotel occupies two beautifully restored 19th-century Ottoman mansions. This unique art hotel showcases Turkish contemporary paintings and sculptures, including a replica of Rodin's The Thinker. The glass-floored art gallery, which doubles as a concert hall, reveals fascinating Hellenistic ruins beneath. The hotel offers spacious, air-conditioned rooms with distinctive designs, adorned with Anatolian carpets and original artwork. Each room features a marble bathroom with a shower, TV, minibar, slippers, and bathrobes. Hypoallergenic, antibacterial, and orthopedic beds ensure a comfortable night's sleep. Free WiFi is available throughout the property. Enjoy a delicious breakfast with fresh, locally sourced ingredients in the garden or art gallery. Relax by the outdoor pool or take a short stroll to Mermerli Beach. Beach towels are provided. The tranquil garden, often filled with the sounds of classical or jazz music, offers a peaceful escape. The hotel's prime location provides easy access to the historic clock tower and other Old City attractions. Please note that this is a non-smoking hotel and caters to guests over the age of 12. Airport transfers are available for an additional fee.

134010.description: This beach hotel is located on a main road, a few metres from the beach and from public transportation links. The hotel is surrounded by landscaped gardens, offering a very laid-back environment. The accommodation is close to Konakli, a small town where guests can find shops, bars, nightlife and restaurants. The large tourist resort of Alanya is just 12 km away and has many attractions to visit, including a colourful weekly market and Alanya Castle.

134078.description: Just a 5-minute stroll away from Plaça d'Espanya, the modern apartment complex MH Apartments Urban is conveniently situated in Barcelona. Major sights such as the bullring, the trade fair centre, Palau de Congressos, Magic Fountain, MNAC and Montjuic with the Olympic facilities and the Joan Miró Foundation are within walking distance. Plaça Catalunya and Las Ramblas can be easily reached within a 5-minute metro ride. The complex offers guests a range of beautifully designed one- and two-bedroom apartments sleeping up to 6 persons. They have a stylish, contemporary design and features include complimentary wireless internet access, air-conditioning and 32” flat-screen TV. In addition, there is a fully equipped kitchen for the convenience of the customers. These excellent apartments are a perfect choice for business travellers as well as families and groups of friends wishing to discover all this vibrant city has to offer.

134094.address: Panday Road, Opp.President Hotel, Cuffe Parade, 4
134094.description: This hotel is located just a stone's throw away from Churchgate Railway Station, CST Railway Station, Bombay Hospital, the Metro Cinema, the shopping centre, Crawford Market, Colaba and central Mumbai. It lies just 23 km from the domestic airport and 27 km from the international airport. This budget business class hotel in south Mumbai epitomises business comfort and luxury accommodation in a central location. Whether guests are travelling alone on business, as a group, or seeking to host a corporate event, this hotel understands their needs and offers appropriate services. It is an ideal base for business travellers who need to be close to the city - especially during the week - and, at the weekends, is perfect for holidaymakers. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception service, a currency exchange facility, a cloakroom and lift access. It offers a restaurant, conference facilities and STD/ISD/fax facilities. Guests can also take advantage of round-the-clock room service, same-day laundry service and ample parking space, as well as a baggage room, a doctor-on-call and a well equipped meeting space. This hotel offers well appointed, spacious and luxuriously furnished comfortable rooms with modern amenities. All come with a private bathroom with hot and cold running water 24 hours a day and a shower. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, cable TV, Internet access and a mini fridge. Furthermore, tea and coffee making facilities and individually regulated air conditioning are provided in all accommodation as standard.

134150.address: Av. Rueda Medina lote 12 mza 8 smza 1 centro
134150.description: This innovative, adults-only hotel, renovated in 2009, offers modern and comfortable facilities with contemporary architecture and all the necessary amenities. Located on Rueda Medina Avenue, just minutes from the city center, beaches, shops, restaurants, bars, and nightclubs, the hotel provides easy access to ferries departing every 30 minutes to Cancun. The 25 guest rooms feature distinctive designs, air conditioning, private bathrooms with showers, and balconies or terraces, most with panoramic views of the Bay of Isla Mujeres or the central courtyard and swimming pool. King or double beds, complimentary internet access, hairdryers, direct-dial telephones, satellite/cable TV, radios, hifi systems, safes, and ironing sets are standard in each room. Guests can enjoy the outdoor pool, relax on sun loungers, and partake in various water sports (for a fee) on the nearby sandy beach. The hotel offers a lobby bar specializing in martinis and margaritas, a variety of cocktails and tropical beverages, a café with room service, and a continental breakfast. Additional amenities include a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, hotel safe, conference facilities, and laundry services (for a fee).

134194.description: Your stay near shopping and beaches. Montreal Barsha Hotel is located two kilometers from the Mall of the Emirates - one of the largest malls in Dubai. Beaches including Jumeirah Beach and Kite Beach, and the Dubai Marina are 10 minutes away. Museum of the Future and Dubai World Trade Centre are within 17 minutes. Enjoy our rooftop swimming pool, hot tub, sauna, spa, on-site dining, and fitness center.

134225.description: The hotel is located on APMC Road, near Mafco market in Vashi, Navi Mumbai. Vashi Railway Station is 1 km away and Mumbai city centre is about 40 kms away. The international airport is 38 kms away and the domestic airport, Chatrapati Shivaji Terminus, is approximately 40 kms away. This is a luxury business-class hotel with its own distinctive character that has elegant and luxurious rooms, fine restaurants, quality services, and modern facilities . The hotel offers well appointed, beautifully decorated centrally air-conditioned rooms fully equipped with modern in-room amenities. Guests can enjoy a workout in the gym. The hotel is perfect for both business and leisure travellers who require quick and easy access to the city.

134226.address: Near Metro Theatre,1St Marine Street,Dhobi Talao
134226.description: The hotel is located in the heart of a famous area of Mumbai, a short drive from Nariman Point, Colaba and the railway stations V. T, Churchgate and Marine Lines. It is also within easy reach of Mumbai, whilst a commercial and entertainment centre is just 1 km from the nearest bus and train station. Furthermore, the hotel is just 30 km from the airport. This is a delightful boutique hotel situated in Mumbai offering guests a warm welcome to enjoy the services such as business centre, travel desk, valet parking, a car rental desk, fax, 24-hour coffee shop and sumptuous catering services making it an ideal place to stay for both business and leisure travellers. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception. Currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom, lift access, conference facilities, 24-hour room services, laundry service and a car park round off the facilities on offer. The hotel offers well appointed, beautifully decorated, exquisite rooms with all the modern amenities such as individually regulated air conditioning, a fridge with mini-refreshments, a satellite TV with 30 channels, electronic safe, direct dial telephone, Internet access, and tea and coffee making facilities. Each room also features an attached en suite bathroom with shower and hot/cold running water to make guests' stay as comfortable as possible.

134231.address: 7 DERB IHIHANE SIDI BEN SLIMANE Parking Bab Taghzo
134231.description: This riad is a 15-minute walk from Djemaa el-Fna, the Marrakech Museum, Medersa Ben Youssef, and the new city of Gueliz. Menara Airport is about 2 km away. The riad's contemporary decor offers a tranquil escape from the bustling medina. It features six bedrooms, a TV lounge, a dining room, a patio with refreshing water features, and a sunny terrace. Recently renovated, this design hotel welcomes guests with a 24-hour reception and check-out service. Amenities include air conditioning, a safe, Wi-Fi, room and laundry services, and parking. Guests can enjoy the café, bar, and restaurant. Stylish rooms offer large double beds, air conditioning, and internet access, along with private en suite bathrooms. Guests can relax by the children's pool and use the sun loungers and parasols. Massages and spa treatments are also available.

134233.description: Located in the heart of Berlin, this hotel offers the perfect base for exploring the city's vibrant arts, culture, shopping, and entertainment scene. Just a short stroll from Hackescher Markt, Museum Island, and numerous restaurants, you'll find convenient access to public transport within 200 meters and the central railway station within 2. 2 kilometers. Tegel and Schönefeld Airports are approximately 10 and 21 kilometers away, respectively. The hotel's 85 guest rooms and suites boast a unique design, featuring warm colors, sharp lines, and luxurious velvet accents. Floor-to-ceiling glass walls create an open, airy feel, seamlessly integrating the bathroom into the living space. Modern amenities include individually controlled air conditioning and heating, a minibar, laptop-size safe, DVD/CD player, flat-screen TV with satellite/cable channels, radio, and complimentary high-speed internet access. En suite bathrooms are equipped with a shower, bath, and hairdryer. Double or king-size beds are available, and suites on the upper floors offer breathtaking city views. Guests can start their day with the Velvet To Go packed breakfast, featuring a daily selection of bagels, fresh fruit, and a muesli bar or smoothie. Coffee, tea, juice, and water are also available to take away. Additional hotel facilities include a 24-hour reception, check-out service, safe, currency exchange, and lift access.

134273.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages and body treatments. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an indoor pool and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy a meal at Litros or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 109 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Forum Istanbul - 1. 7 km / 1 mi- Eyup Sultan Mosque - 4. 7 km / 2. 9 mi- Golden Horn - 5. 5 km / 3. 4 mi- Medipol Mega University Hospital - 6. 2 km / 3. 9 mi- Venezia Mega Outlet - 6. 6 km / 4. 1 mi- Memorial Bahçelievler Hospital - 7. 3 km / 4. 5 mi- Fatih Mosque - 7. 4 km / 4. 6 mi- Laleli Mosque - 7. 6 km / 4. 7 mi- Pierre Loti Tepesi - 7. 8 km / 4. 8 mi- Fisekhane - 7. 8 km / 4. 8 mi- Vialand Tema Park - 7. 8 km / 4. 9 mi- İstoç Ticaret Merkezi - 8. 1 km / 5. 1 mi- Beyazit Square - 8. 3 km / 5. 2 mi- Süleymaniye Mosque - 8. 8 km / 5. 5 mi- Capacity Shopping Center - 8. 8 km / 5. 5 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Airport (IST) - 39. 9 km / 24. 8 mi Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 66. 4 km / 41. 3 mi The preferred airport for Grand S Hotel is Istanbul Airport (IST).

134274.description: Situated on the coast between Side and Alanya, near the charming town of Okurcular, this impressive hotel offers a delightful seaside escape. Just 90km from Antalya Airport, 30km from Alanya city center, and 30km from the ancient city of Side, it's ideally located for exploration. The hotel features sparkling, air-conditioned guest rooms with central heating/cooling, a 32 LCD TV, a minibar, a safe, and an en-suite bathroom. Families and couples alike will appreciate the range of recreational activities, including a spectacular decked jetty extending over the sea, perfect for sunbathing. Children will enjoy the mini club and indoor/outdoor pools. Guests can savor local and select imported drinks at the bar and dine at the on-site restaurant, which offers both Turkish and international cuisine.

134287.description:
Situated moments from Disneyland Paris (one train stop) and Val d'Europe shopping center (600m), this aparthotel offers convenience and comfort. Charles de Gaulle Airport is a 42-minute drive (35km). Air-conditioned rooms and suites feature light, neutral décor, wooden flooring, and other wooden accents, along with fully equipped kitchens and bathrooms with bathtubs. The on-site restaurant serves French and international cuisine, while the stylish bar provides a relaxing setting. Guests can unwind in the luxurious spa. Excellent meeting facilities cater to business travelers. The spa, fitness room, and pool are reserved for adults, but children aged 4+ are welcome under parental supervision from 10 am to noon and 3 pm to 5 pm. The Relais Spa adheres to current COVID-19 regulations. 
Due to an acutal maintenance the SAUNA is not available

The Ô Relais restaurant will be closed for lunch service from August 3rd to 23rd, 2026 inclusive. 
Breakfast and dinner will be served during this period. 
For lunch snacking is available at the hotel bar.

name.content: Kempinski Nile Hotel Garden City Cairo

134308.description: Discover the perfect blend of convenience and luxury at our strategically located downtown hotel. Ideal for business travellers, our hotel is just a few miles away from Cairo's iconic attractions, including the Pyramids of Giza, the Egyptian Museum, the Cairo Opera House and more. With 137 rooms and 54 exclusive suites, we offer flexible options to cater to solo travellers, couples, and large groups. Each suite features a private balcony, providing a serene retreat. Indulge your taste buds at our four exceptional restaurants and lounges, where Kempinski's culinary expertise shines. Our leisure spa awaits, where you can refresh and recharge for ultimate relaxation. End your day at our Rooftop pool, which offers stunning views of Cairo's skyline. Your well-being is our priority. That's why we've implemented Kempinski White Glove Services, ensuring a healthy and safe environment for all guests and employees worldwide.

134311.description: This family-friendly hotel enjoys a convenient location just a 25-minute drive from Cancun International Airport, and 10 minutes from the main shopping and nightlife area. Featuring magnificent views over the Caribbean Sea, guests may have the chance to take a refreshing dip in the beach or just relax and “switch off” on the sand while listening to the waves. The rooms have been decorated in soothing tones and include a simple yet functional design that will satisfy even the most discerning travellers. Some of them have connecting doors, ideal for families travelling with children. Sports lovers may appreciate the extensive range of water sports on offer, including kayaking and parachuting. As for the rest of onsite services, complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection is available for guests' convenience. **pets aren´t accepted**

134344.description: Located on the historical peninsula of Istanbul, known as Sultanahmet, this city hotel is excellently placed for being within easy walking distance of the major sights such as Topkapi Palace and Haghia Sophia. Guests can benefit from an elegantly styled lobby lounge for an ideal place to relax, while the rooftop terrace and restaurant offers superb views of the Blue Mosque and Haghia Sophia as well as the Bosphorous. Boasting  traditional Turkish hospitality, in addition to great comfort, the hotel also offers quality service, and guests can enjoy Turkish and Ottoman cuisine in the restaurant. Links to public transport are closeby, including a tramline just 250m away and there are shops and restaurants in the vicinity of the hotel.

134350.description: This modern hostel was renovated in 2019, centrally located yet in a quiet area, just a few steps from Berlin Central Station. It features a bar and a rooftop terrace with panoramic views over the city. Government buildings, the Reichstag building, Brandenburg Gate, Victory Column and Potsdamer Platz square are within walking distance; attractions such as Alexanderplatz square can be reached within minutes by S-Bahn trains. Berlin Tegel Airport can be reached within 20-minute drive. Each guest room comes with private bathroom with shower/WC and the main toiletries. The hotel features lobby with plenty of space for relaxation. It comes with billiards and table football.

134355.description:
Appart'City Paris Clichy is right in the centre of Clichy, two minutes from Mairie de Clichy metro station: you're a few stops from the heart of the capital, and in the evening you come back to a real apartment. Not a room. A space to drop your bags and breathe. 

Our units sleep 1 to 6 guests: a bedroom, a sitting area, a private bathroom and an equipped kitchenette. Cook a simple meal when you feel like it, keep your habits, plan your days exactly as you want. 

A multi-night business trip, a family stay or a Paris getaway: you stay in control of your stay, on a budget that stays under control too.

134359.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at Hotel Pulitzer Paris, located in the 9th Arrondissement. Make the most of complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The hotel offers a coffee shop/cafe, room service (limited hours), and a bar/lounge for evening drinks. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The 44 guestrooms feature espresso makers, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, and bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. Amenities also include safes, desks, and phones with free local calls. The hotel is conveniently located near attractions like the Palais Garnier and La Machine du Moulin Rouge, and a short drive from Place de la Concorde and Notre-Dame.

134386.description: The spa city Baden is situated at the border of the Wienerwald, 25 km south of Vienna. The hotel is centrally located, close to the casino and can be reached by taxi within 3 minutes from the train station/city centre. The basic amenities provided at this Baden accommodation comprise a lift, laundry service/dry cleaning, meeting facilities, safety deposit boxes, hotel/airport transfer and a business centre. The property was built in 1600 and features 37 guest rooms. For additional fees guests may take advantage of the Internet access and car park. Each guest room features amenities such as a television, direct dial telephone and an en suite bathroom with a bathtub and shower. Furthermore, a hairdryer, double bed, Internet access and a fridge come as standard. For guests to unwind, the hotel offers a variety of facilities and services including a spa.

134407.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting in Milan, lying just 100 metres from Garibaldi train station. Guests will find themselves in a prime setting from which to explore the attractions of this stylish city. An abundance of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues are to be found nearby. Via Montenapoleone is located just 2 km from the hotel. This wonderful hotel enjoys close proximity to Brera, Corso Buenos Aires, Teatro alla Scala, Smeraldo Theatre and Alcatraz. This wonderful hotel invites guests into the relaxing surroundings of the lobby. The guest rooms are elegantly designed, offering a peaceful setting in which to work and rest in comfort. Guests will appreciate the host of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

134430.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This hotel also features concierge services and a television in a common area. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 34 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. This hotel is within close proximity of Peggy Guggenheim Museum and Museo Correr.

134461.address: Avenida Diagonal 201 (Entrada por Ciutat de Granad, 201
134461.description: Upon arrival, you'll be greeted by our friendly team in a clean & completely sanitized environment. Go up to the 19th floor & enjoy the spectacular panoramic view of Barcelona. Enjoy a cocktail or tapas & dive into our pool under the sun's rays. Relax in our hammam & have a massage. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine with fresh & seasonal products, while being safely carried away by the magic of show-cooking.

134475.description: Excellently located next to the metro station Sèvres Lecourbe and only 10 minutes by bus from Eiffel Tower, this hotel is equally ideal for a business stay or a city trip. Close to the Exhibition Centre, the next TGV station is at Gare Montparnasse at only 1 km, the Airport of Paris-Orly is only 15 km away. Features of this non-smoking hotel include 47 rooms, 24-hours reception, free WIFI, garden patio, restaurant and bar. Pets are allowed for free. Front desk closed from midnight to 6. am

134479.description: The Grand Hôtel du Calvados is located in the 9th arrondissement of Paris, about twenty metres from the Gare Saint-Lazare public transport hub. On a business trip, you will be in the heart of a very active district but also just six minutes from the business district of La Défense. If you love to go shopping, the Printemps Haussmann and Galeries Lafayette department stores are less than 10 minutes away on foot while the Triangle d'Or (Golden Triangle) of Parisian luxury is only 15 minutes away by Metro. Situated in the Quartier de l'Europe, the Grand Hôtel du Calvados invites you to enjoy fascinating cultural experiences, tours and visits, with the Museum of Romantic Life, the Palais Garnier and the Gustave Moreau Museum being less than fifteen minutes away on foot. What's more, the conveniently accessible Gare Montparnasse enables you to head directly to the Palace of Versailles and, thanks to the RER A, you can be at Disneyland Paris in less than an hour.

134482.description: This friendly modern hotel is situated in the Laleli area of Istanbul, close to the historic centre. It features a rooftop terrace with pool and fantastic views over the city, an indoor pool, sauna and a restaurant. The famous Grand Bazaar is a 15 minutes' walk away; other major attractions such as Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Hippodrome or Basilica Cisterna are within easy reach.

134483.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Grand Hotel De Turin, located in the heart of Paris, just a short walk from the Moulin Rouge and Sacré-Cœur Basilica. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and blackout drapes/curtains in each of its 50 guestrooms. Start your day with a continental breakfast (available for a fee) and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and a safe deposit box.

134580.address: P.D'Mello Road, Opp. St. George Hospital, 221/225
134580.description: The hotel is centrally located in Mumbai within easy reach of all the commercial, business and shopping districts of the city. It is just 2 km from Chhatrapathi Shivaji Railway Station, 25 km from the domestic airport and 28 km from Chhatrapathi Shivaji International Airport. This budget air-conditioned hotel is best suited for the transit traveller and is the premier choice of Mumbai hotels, offering a warm and inviting environment. It is perfect for romantic getaways, fun-filled holidays, and productive business travel alike. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. There is lift access to the upper floors. The hotel offers services and facilities such as a currency exchange, car rental facility, laundry service and an on-call doctor. There are also conference facilities, safety deposit lockers, 24-hour hot and cold water, a parking facility and a housekeeping service to make stays memorable for guests. Moreover, all guests can avail of round-the-clock room service to make their stay even more comfortable. The hotel offers beautifully decorated and well-appointed air-conditioned rooms that are divided into the categories standard, deluxe and super deluxe. The amenities remain the same across all categories, comprising of a direct dial phone, satellite/cable television, a safe, a large mirror and a wardrobe. The en suite bathrooms are clean with a spacious shower space and hot and cold running water 24-hours a day.

134583.address: International Business Park, Oberoi Garden City
134583.description: The Westin Mumbai Garden City places you in the heart of Mumbai, steps from Oberoi Mall and a short drive from Sanjay Gandhi National Park. This luxury hotel offers 268 individually decorated guestrooms, complete with refrigerators, LCD televisions, and Select Comfort beds with premium bedding. Pamper yourself at the full-service spa with massages and body treatments, or enjoy the two outdoor pools, steam room, and 24-hour fitness center. Savor a meal at one of the hotel's three restaurants, including 18 Lounge, or order from the 24-hour room service. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, babysitting, and a complimentary shuttle to nearby shops.

134584.description: This boutique hotel boasts a stunning setting at the heart of the mesmerising city of Istanbul. Proudly sitting in Taksim Square, the hotel enjoys magnificent views of Istiklal Street and the city, and is a mere 100 metres away from an array of business, exhibition, entertainment and cultural districts. Guests will be impressed by the spectacular location which places the city's attractions and points of interest within easy reach. This stunning hotel is the ideal choice for discerning business and leisure travellers, welcoming them with the promise of impeccable service, luxurious surroundings and meticulous attention to detail. The guest rooms are beautifully designed and command breath-taking views over the Golden Horn Sea and the Pera district of the city.

134617.description: Situated in Milan's vibrant Brera district, steeped in history and tradition, this hotel is quickly becoming a favorite among visitors. Housed within a beautifully restored 19th-century palazzo, it seamlessly blends contemporary hospitality with a passion for music and sophisticated charm, all while maintaining a strong focus on sustainability. Guests can enjoy a stylish lounge bar and restaurant, a multimedia library beneath a glass-ceilinged vertical garden, a well-equipped gym, and on-site parking. A stunning panoramic terrace on the eighth floor offers breathtaking city views, while dedicated meeting rooms cater to business travelers. Each guest room provides the comfort and amenities expected of a luxury hotel, including air conditioning and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries.

134644.description: This beautifully decorated hotel sits directly on Cleopatra Beach in Alanya, Turkey, overlooking the Mediterranean Sea. The airport is a 45-minute drive away. Guests will find bars, restaurants, and public transport nearby, with shops just a 10-minute walk from the hotel. Local attractions, including Alanya Castle, Alanya Dockyard and Arsenal, the Red Tower, Alanya Archaeological Museum, and Damlatas Cave, are easily accessible. The outdoor pool area is the perfect place to unwind and relax poolside or under the shade of an umbrella. The restaurant offers a wide selection of delicious dishes to suit all tastes. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated in a palette of light and vibrant colours creating a pleasing atmosphere. They are also equipped with all the essential amenities for a memorable stay.

134649.description: This charming city hotel, located in Berlin's Quartier am Auswärtigen Amt, offers a unique experience for travelers. Situated between Museum Island and Gendarmenmarkt, it's within walking distance of Friedrichstraße and Unter den Linden. Conveniently, the central train station is just 300 meters away, a bus station is a minute's walk, and the Hausvogteiplatz metro station is a mere 3-minute walk. Numerous restaurants, bars, and shops are nearby. This lively design hotel provides an international and open atmosphere. Its restaurant and bar offer a variety of dishes for guests to relax and enjoy. Built in 2009, this air-conditioned hotel features 190 rooms, a 24-hour reception with check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange, and lift access. Guests can also utilize conference facilities, Wi-Fi, room and laundry services, parking, a garage, and bicycle hire. The rooms, suites, and apartments feature custom-designed furniture, high-quality materials, and comfortable design elements. All are characterized by clean lines, tasteful details, and modern technology. Each includes an en suite bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, a double or king-size bed, and a kitchenette with a minibar. Amenities include a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, a radio, hi-fi, a safe, internet access, an ironing set, individually controlled air conditioning, and central heating. Guests can also enjoy complimentary SKY Cinema from the comfort of their rooms.

134651.description: This enchanting hotel enjoys a prime position in the heart of Paris, just a few minutes from the stunning Garnier Opera, the Printemps and Galeries Lafayette department stores. Other nearby attractions include La Madeleine Catholic Church, Concorde Square, the Champs Elysées, the Louvre Museum and the world-renowned Tuileries garden. The accommodation units feature a choice of tastefully-designed guest rooms and charming Art-Deco style that will impress the most discerning type guest. Those travelling on business will appreciate the three onsite meeting rooms, ideal to host any kind of event, as well as the complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection. A delicious breakfast buffet is served to start the day on the right track.

134655.description:
The family-friendly beach hotel is located in Southampton Village on the East End of Long Island, NY nestled on more than 5 acres of manicured lawn. It is just steps away from world-renown shopping, dining, beaches and cultural attractions and just a two-hour drive from New York. Guests will find Coopers Beach, Hampton Jitney bus station and nightlife spots all around 3.2 km from the holiday village. Other nearby places of interest include Agawam Park (300 metres), Wolfur Estates Winery (11.2 km), Osborn-Jackson House Museum (19.3 km), East Hampton Windmill (20.9 km) and Westhampton Beach Performing Arts Center (22.5 km).

This eclectic Tudor-style inn is a local landmark with its 90 uniquely decorated rooms. Whether for business or pleasure, the hotel provides all the comforts of home with a library and a cosy fireplace as well as complimentary on-site parking. Renovated in 2009, the air-conditioned hotel offers a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, lift access, a games room, TV lounge, children's playground and an on-site restaurant. Guests may also make use of the conference facilities, Internet access (fees apply), and a bicycle hire service.

All the guest rooms include a fridge, individually controlled heating and air conditioning, cable TV and wireless Internet access (nominal fee applies). Other standard room features include an en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub and hairdryer, a double or king-size bed, direct dial telephone, radio, safe, ironing set and tea and coffee making facilities.

There is a heated outdoor swimming pool with a poolside snack bar and a sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols laid out ready for use. Guests may also work out in the gym, choose from a selection of spa treatments, or enjoy a game of badminton, tennis or volleyball. The hotel also organises entertainment programmes for children.

134662.description: This New York City hotel offers an eclectic urban escape on Manhattan's West Side, in the diverse Hell's Kitchen neighborhood. Overlooking the Hudson River and the Intrepid Sea, Air & Space Museum, it's a short walk from Times Square and the Theater District. Numerous restaurants and nightlife options are within a five-minute walk, and the M50 bus stop is just two minutes away. Penn Station, the Time Warner Center, Central Park, and Hudson Yards are all within a 20-minute walk. Housed in a former printing press, the hotel's design respectfully incorporates its past into its present-day decor. Guests can also enjoy the fantastic Press Lounge, boasting breathtaking views of the city skyline and the Hudson River.

134663.description: Honoring our artful Chelsea address, Hotel Eventi offers a cutting edge design-centric escape in the heart of Manhattan — which occupies an entire city block. The result? Two restaurants led by an award-winning chef, two buzzing new bars, and one stunning lobby that’s more like a warm-yet-vogue living room. If you can tear yourself away, the Empire State Building, Madison Square Garden, High Line Park, and more are nearby. Share what you love to do, and we’ll curate a fresh New York experience, just for you.

134664.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, a terrace, and a garden. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a television in the common area, and a banquet hall. Dine at the on-site restaurant or grab a snack at the snack bar/deli. Unwind at the bar/lounge with a drink at the end of the day. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (7:00 AM to 10:00 AM) for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Planning an event in Madrid? This hotel has 2, 164 square feet (201 square meters) of event space, including a conference center and two meeting rooms. Self-parking is available on-site (subject to charges). The 161 guest rooms feature minibars, flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Conveniences include phones, safes, and coffee/tea makers. Located near Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía (0. 4 mi), Atocha Station Memorial (0. 5 mi), and Paseo del Prado (0. 5 mi). The preferred airport is Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD).

134667.description:
This modern hotel is a convenient accommodation option when visiting this multi-cultural and interesting city either for business or leisure. The property is situated on the Aston University Campus within easy reach from the city centre. In a 5-minute stroll, visitors may reach a wide entertainment and shopping offer, including the famous Bullring shopping centre. The stylish guest rooms are tastefully decorated with all of the expected comforts. Business travellers may also appreciate the meeting facilities available as well as the complimentary WIFI access. Guests may enjoy the delicious on-site restaurant and bar, with a choice of menus available; guests may enjoy a la carte restaurant from Sunday to Thursday, with lighter bar menus available Friday and Saturday. Room Service and Takeaway Delivery services are also available. Guests may relax at the nearby sports centre a short two-minute walk from the hotel with a Victorian indoor heated swimming pool and large gym. Pool requires pre-booking and is subject to availability. Pool and Gym are closed all bank holidays, Christmas week, New Year, Easter Tuesday and August Bank Holiday Monday and Tuesday. 
Undercover parking parking is a two minute walk from the hotel and must be pre-booked online via the hotel website. Guest code of conduct: http://www. conferenceaston. co. uk/cacodeofconduct

134681.description: This luxurious city hotel boasts a prime setting in the business and shopping centre of Istanbul. The hotel is a mere 5 minutes' walking distance from the nearest metro station, which offers ease of access to other interesting areas of the city. Guests will find a myriad of attractions and points of interest in close proximity to the hotel. Business and leisure guests alike will be impressed by the host of exemplary facilities and services the hotel has to offer. The attractive architectural style tempts guests with the promise of an unforgettable stay. The guest rooms are stunningly designed, offering business and leisure guests functional, comfortable space which is perfectly conducive to work or relaxation. The hotel provides excellent amenities and services which will surpass the expectations of even the most discerning traveller.

134691.address: Kuwait Road، Al Mankhool AreaPo Box 124054
134691.description: Baity Hotel Apartments is centrally located in Bur Dubai, within a 5-minute drive from the World Trade Centre and a few minutes walk from Burjuman Shopping Mall and the Dubai Metro providing easy access to the city’s major attractions. Accommodations are equipped with air-conditioning, satellite LCD TV in the living room, tea and coffee making facilities, in-room safe, WiFi access, iron and ironing board, dining area, fully equipped kitchen with branded appliances, en suite bathroom and some rooms include a balcony. The in-house restaurant serves authentic Indian, Arabic and international dishes. Other facilities and services include a rooftop pool with views over Burj Khalifa and Dubai skyline, sauna, steam baths, fitness room, free unlimited WIFI access throughout the hotel, meeting rooms, business support services and free private parking on 2 levels. The Mall of the Emirates, Jumeirah Beach, Dubai Mall, Wild Wadi Water Park and Dubai Museum are some of the attractions in the area.

134726.description: This hotel is located in east Antalya, 400 m from the beach, offering stunning views of the sparkling Mediterranean and the magnificent Taurus Mountains in the background. This historic town and popular holiday was a major centre for the Roman, Byzantine, Seljuk and Ottoman empires and visitors will enjoy exploring its many attractions or relaxing on the beach. The international airport is just 13 km northeast of the city centre. The hotel offers apartment accommodation for up to 5 people. Each apartment has a well-equipped kitchenette as well as a large balcony.  Facilities at this family-friendly hotel include a children's pool, Hotel has only room only service consept and guest can use outloor swimming pool

134767.description: The Ibis Dubai Al Rigga is an excellent choice for both business and leisure travelers. This 3-star hotel boasts a meeting room, 280 guest rooms, two restaurants and a bar, a 24-hour fitness center, and complimentary parking. Stay connected with free Wi-Fi access throughout the hotel. Take advantage of our complimentary shuttle service to Kite Beach.

name.content: Kenzi Club Agdal Medina- ALL Inclusive

134779.address: Zone de l’Agdal, boulevard Mohammed VI
134779.description: The hotel is situated in the area of Agdal on Boulevard Mohamed VI, near the largest discotheque in Africa, 'Pacha'. Marrakech-Menara Airport is approximately 5 kms away. This hotel-club provides a full range of activities, together with the best contemporary design by architect Imaad Rhamouni, and is located in the middle of 10 hectares of centenarian olive trees. Dining options include a café and restaurant, and drinks are served in the bar and pub. Guests can watch TV or make use of the Internet access from the comfort of their rooms, all equipped with an en-suite bathroom and a balcony or terrace. A poolside snack bar serves refreshments, while guests may enjoy swimming or sunbathing on the sun terrace. SPA and sport facilities are available to contribute for a special stay.

134788.description: Spread across 2-hectares of gardens, this boutique hotel is a 2. 6 mi shuttle ride from Jemaâ El Fna Square and faces the Atlas Mountains. It offers luxury accommodations, outdoor pool heated all-year and a spa center. Each air-conditioned room is equipped with free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV with a DVD player and a private terrace or garden. A mini-bar is provided and some suites have a heated private pool. Surrounded by 9 golf courses, Sirayane Boutique Hotel & Spa offers hammam and beauty and massage treatments. Guests are free to use the fitness room or mini tennis and there is a library of books and DVDs. The restaurant serves Moroccan and International specialties for lunch and dinner. Guests can enjoy a cocktail in the bar while taking in views of the Atlas Mountains. The hotel is 2. 7 mi from Marrakech-Menara Airport. A free shuttle bus to the Jemaâ El Fna Square runs 7 times per day. For guests with cars, free parking is offered on site. An airport shuttle can be arranged at an extra cost.

134796.description: Located within a 10-minute drive from Kifissia Metro Station, Boutique Hotel Anixi features tastefully decorated rooms and suites with free WiFi. It offers a buffet breakfast. Decorated with well-chosen furnishings, the renovated rooms of Anixi are bright, spacious and air conditioned. Each unit includes a work desk, a minibar and a TV with satellite channels. The private bathroom is stocked with free toiletries. Car rental services are provided and free private parking is possible on site. Free late check-out is possible. Guests will find restaurants, bars and shops within a walking distance from Boutique Hotel Anixi. The area is also suitable for jogging and hiking. Marathonas Lake with its famous archaeological monument is at 13 km, while Athens International Airport is around a 20-minute drive away. The archaeological site of Delphi lies within 1. 5-hour drive.

name.content: Mercure Paris Eiffel Tower Grenelle Hotel

134831.description: Thanks to its characteristic design, the Mercure Paris Tour Eiffel Grenelle hotel immerses you in the history of the Pondicherry and Chandernagor trading posts. The lounge bar, patio, fitness room and sauna will ensure you relax after long days discovering Paris. We offer free WiFi, room service and a private car park.

name.content: Mercure Parc Du Coudray Demeures De Campagne

134843.description: Located between Paris and Fontainebleau, this authentic guest house is set in a 50-acre estate just outside Paris that aims to provide a rural retreat that evokes your best childhood memories. Whether it is a fireside reading nook, woodland walks, golf, tennis or petanque with an aperitif, there are lots of activities to give you the best experience and make us your favorite place to be.

134859.address: Route Nationale 152 Chemin De Melun Ile -De France
134859.description: Connect with nature at Novotel Fontainebleau-Ury. Less than 1 hour from Paris, our friendly hotel welcomes you on the edge of Fontainebleau forest in a 12-acre park. Enjoy our heated outdoor pool & Ospa institute all year round. We offer 14 meeting rooms for your business meetings. Committed to responsible practices towards nature, we have been Biosphere certified (label created by UNESCO) since 2018.

134879.description: Make yourself at home at the Mercure Amsterdam City, set in a convenient location by the Amstel river. At the hotel you can find a relaxing bar, restaurant for lunch and dinner and 14 meeting rooms. A delicious breakfast buffet is served daily and the reception is open 24/7. Make use of the bicycle rental service or hop on a transfer to the heart of the city. All rooms are equipped with a comfortable bed, work desk, air conditioning and free WiFi. The Mercure offers a infrared sauna and fitness.

134883.address: Golf De Greenparc D 402 Route De Villepecle
134883.description: Practice your swing on the golf course and enjoy other recreational amenities, such as an indoor pool and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy French cuisine at Parenthèse, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Saint-Pierre-du-Perray? This hotel has 2583 square feet (240 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 81 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Greenparc Golf Club - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Carré Sénart - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- Seine - 3. 8 km / 2. 4 mi- Parc Babyland - 5. 7 km / 3. 5 mi- Winnoland - 6. 8 km / 4. 2 mi- Etiolles Golf Club - 7. 5 km / 4. 6 mi- Coquibus Park - 8 km / 5 mi- Marques Avenue Shopping Center - 8. 6 km / 5. 4 mi- Évry Cathedral - 8. 9 km / 5. 5 mi- Évry 2 Regional Shopping Center - 9. 9 km / 6. 1 mi- Gâtinais Français Natural Regional Park - 12 km / 7. 4 mi- Caillebotte House - 12. 6 km / 7. 8 mi- Le Port aux Cerises - 14. 4 km / 8. 9 mi- Brie-Comte-Robert Castle - 15. 7 km / 9. 8 mi- Château de Grosbois - 16. 8 km / 10. 4 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 34. 2 km / 21.

134897.address: R Ministro Nelson Hungria 577 Vila Tramontano
134897.description: Novotel São Paulo Morumbi is located in a prime area of ​​SP, with its doors open for your stay. With a modern design, the rooms are comfortable, air conditioned and have free Wi-Fi. In options overlooking the Estaiada Bridge, office and reduced mobility. Restaurant Greem serves breakfast with tapiocas and omelets, lunch and dinner, and drinks at the bar. Use of the function room and business center. Relax in the massage room, pool and gym. Kids will love the kids space. And we are a pet friendly hotel.

134910.description: Novotel Cairo El Borg is a contemporary 4-star hotel with panoramic views over the Nile. Centrally located, the hotel is within walking distance of the Opera House and Egyptian Museum. After immersing yourself in Egyptian culture with a visit to the iconic Pyramids and the Sphinx, cool down in the pool or relax with a massage at Novotel.

134916.description: Sunday Hotel Berlin City West is conveniently located near the Charlottenburg district, not far from the exhibition center. All 119 modern, air-conditioned rooms have free WIFI. Use our 8 meeting rooms for your events in our CCH-certified hote l. If arriving by train, the nearest ICE train station is Berlin Spandau. Tegel Airport is 1. 8 miles (3 km) away; Schönefeld Airport is 18. 6 miles (30 km). The A110/111 is the best way to reach us by car and the subway line 7 is in front of the hotel.

134988.description: Enjoy a central Athens stay at the boutique AVA Hotel & Suites, a short walk from the Temple of Olympian Zeus and Syntagma Square. This aparthotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a 24-hour business center, and concierge service. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) at the on-site cafe. Relax with room service (limited hours) or unwind at the bar/lounge. The 15 individually decorated guestrooms feature kitchenettes, LCD TVs, DVD players, and laptop-compatible safes. The Acropolis and Parthenon are within a kilometer.

135081.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at AlburaKathisma Restaurant, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Make yourself at home in one of the 28 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls.

135153.description:
The hotel is located in a quiet cul-de-sac in the heart of Knightsbridge, an exclusive and fashionable address. London's finest museums, Hyde Park and its most exclusive shops are all within a 5-minute walk, and the hotel is next door to Harrods and Harvey Nichols. Links to the public transport are within around 200 m and the bus and railway stations are roughly 3 km from the hotel. The Knightsbridge tube station can be reached in some 5 minutes on foot. The hotel is situated at a mere 15 km from London City Airport, whilst London Heathrow Airport and Gatwick Airport are approximately 40 km and 70 km away respectively. London Luton and Stansted Airports are both about 100 km from the residence.

The elegant award-winning Victorian boutique townhouse features stylish decor, with fine fabrics, original art and handpicked antique furniture. The hotel was built in 1880 and comprises a total of 28 guest rooms. With warm and personable service that cannot be matched, guests feel more like friends when they stay at this hotel. The air-conditioned property welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. Facilities on offer to guests include a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom, lift access and a newspaper stand. Meals may be taken in the breakfast/dining room. In addition, WLAN Internet access, 24-hour room service, a laundry service and a car park (for a fee) are at guests' disposal.

135225.description: Nestled amongst orange groves in Beldibi with the Taurus Mountains as a backdrop, the family-friendly holiday village is located on a beautiful beachfront. Local transport passes in front of the hotel making it easy to visit the city of Antalya, approximately 25 km away, and the city of Kemer, around 18 km away. Antalya airport is roughly 40 km from the establishment. The hotel is low-rise building set in attractive gardens with lawns reaching down to a decorative wall which borders the beach. There are a couple of bars and a restaurant specialising in fish for gourmet lovers. The spacious rooms are decorated in cooling tones and all have a balcony. In the grounds guests can enjoy a couple of outdoor swimming pools with slides. The animation team keeps everyone entertained with entertainment programmes for adults and children including daily activities and shows most evenings.

name.content: Faranda Collection Bogota, A Member Of Radisson In

135235.description: Nestled in the quiet Santa Paula neighborhood, Faranda Collection Bogota, a member of Radisson Individuals, delivers excellent service with a unique style. Business travelers appreciate our proximity to major corporations like Bancolombia, ScotiaBank, and Davivienda. If you are in town to sightsee or need a break between meetings, get a taste of Colombia at a trendy cafe in nearby Usaquen Park, or learn more about local history at The Museum of Gold roughly 30 minutes away. At the hotel, you can pamper yourself with a treatment in our on-site spa and enjoy a delicious meal at Alma Restaurant. Start your morning with a pilates class or a cardio session in our fitness center, which overlooks the green hills of Bogota. We also have a small movie theater so you can watch a favorite film with your group. If you are interested in services such as car rentals or airport transfers, visit our 24-hour front desk. After a busy day, unwind in one of our tranquil rooms or suites, each featuring free WiFi, a flat-screen TV, and a coffeemaker. Pets Allowed. Pet Charge 25. 00 COP Per Pet, Per Night. Pet limit 1 Pet Per Room.

135262.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this Piraeus hotel, and stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. Amenities include babysitting services (surcharge), wedding services, and a common area television. The Park restaurant offers delicious international cuisine for lunch and dinner, and room service is available during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel also features limo/town car service, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. For events, the hotel offers 2, 260 square feet (210 square meters) of conference and meeting space. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Each of the 80 guestrooms provides a refrigerator, private balcony, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. The hotel is conveniently located near the Municipal Theatre of Piraeus, the Port of Piraeus, and other attractions.

135275.address: Alfonso d Albuquerque -S. JOAO DA CAPARICA, .
135275.description:
The hotel is a few kilometres from Lisbon, in the beach area of Costa da Caparica and integrated in a wooded park.

This modern and cosy hotel features a bar, restaurant, equipped meeting room, a games room, wireless Internet access and a chapel. The hotel offers a private car park. There are 35 guest rooms available.

All rooms are equipped with a minibar (an extra fee applies) and a TV. They are all en suite and contain a direct dial telephone and individually regulated air conditioning.

Guests may enjoy a refreshing dip in the pool.

Breakfast is served each morning.

name.content: The Levante Parliament - A Design Hotel

135293.description:
Our hotel is in the heart of Vienna. To be more precise, in the vicinity of the Austrian Parliament, which was also the inspiration for the name of the hotel. The Levante Parliament bears the distinction of being a “design hotel” for good reason. In fact, since opening in 2006, our hotel has been one of the first design hotels in Vienna. Art and design are prominently featured throughout the hotel and create a unique atmosphere that provides moments of pure beauty. The art of unforgettable moments. Welcome to The Levante Parliament A Design Hotel!
Built in 1908 in a classic modern style, our hotel has undergone several renovations and remodels. Yet its original, linear, and simple architecture has been preserved. Based on the four elements of life, fire, earth, air, and water constitute the architectural cornerstones for the basic design of the design hotel The Levante Parliament. The element of fire is highlighted with a lot of natural light, indirect lighting, and the transparency of numerous glass elements. Earth is represented by high-quality materials and the carefully selected colors. Air is embodied by a sense of lightness and freedom.

135294.description: This upscale hotel is housed in an iconic building on the Atlantic seafront in Cape Town. The property enjoys an enviable location within close proximity to the city centre, beaches and entertainment. The famous Victoria and Alfred Waterfront and the central business district just a short stroll away. Guests will be impressed by beautiful design and high quality service. The spacious rooms are filled with natural daylight and fitted with cosy furniture to create a haven of peace and tranquillity. Patrons may pamper their palates at on-site dining options offering exquisite Mediterranean, European and South African cuisines. The youngest ones will delight in entertainment and facilities tailored especially for them, while adults may have a cooling dip in the pool, treat themselves to complete relaxation at the spa or sip a drink in the landscaped courtyard.

135318.description: This hotel lies just 10 metres away from Avenida Libertador, in Buenos Aires. The hotel is surrounded by ample opportunities for exploration and discovery. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from exclusive shops, exciting entertainment venues and delectable dining options. A number of attractions can be found nearby. The hotel is just a 5 minutes' drive away from the city's main convention centres and the Jorge Newbery Airport. The hotel is ideal for business and leisure travellers. The guest rooms offer style and comfort, in a peaceful setting. Guests can indulge in the ultimate relaxation with a spa treatment or a massage. The hotel also features a gym and a pool, for guests' leisure.

135319.description: Located just a few steps from the beach and the crystal-clear waters of the Mediterranean Sea and surrounded by the Taurus Mountains, this elegant modern holiday hotel is an excellent choice to spend the holidays. The spa area invites to relax to the max. The restaurants, bars and shops of Kumköy are within few steps, the historic town of Side with its antique sites is just 5 km away.

135328.description: The hotel is located within easy walking distance from the Eiffel Tower, the Seine River, Champs de Mars, the Invalides and the Montparnasse theatre district and railway station. Ideal for business or leisure. It comprises a total of 33 rooms, spread over 5 floors. Some rooms feature a brand new decor with modern furniture, parquet flooring and comfortable indirect lighting. All rooms boast large double beds with top quality mattresses and duvets. It has private shower room and a hairdryer. Hotel services include: fast and free Wi-Fi access in all rooms and throughout the hotel, air conditioning, elevator or daily housekeeping. A varied and plentiful breakfast buffet is laid out each morning in a light and welcoming breakfast room. The front desk team is available 24/7. A terrace located at the hotel's rear offers a quiet place to have a drink or just relax on warm days. Non-smoking.

135329.description: Situated in Paris's 9th arrondissement, the Hotel Aida Opera is a 15-minute walk from the Opera Garnier and 1. 2 miles from the Louvre Museum. It offers a fitness room and air-conditioned guest rooms with complimentary Wi-Fi. Each elegantly decorated room features a flat-screen TV, a desk, and an empty minibar. Private bathrooms include a hairdryer, complimentary toiletries, and a bathtub or shower. A buffet breakfast is served daily in the breakfast room, and guests can enjoy afternoon snacks with tea, coffee, and milk in the lobby. Several shops, restaurants, and bars are within walking distance. With a 24-hour reception, the hotel is conveniently located near Cadet Metro Station (Line 7) and a short walk from Galeries Lafayette. Some deluxe rooms offer a bathtub, subject to availability.

135338.description: Located just a short walk from Vienna's city center, the Palais Coburg Hotel offers easy access to all the major sights. This unique five-star hotel features 34 individually designed luxury suites, each with a fully equipped kitchen. Many suites are split across two floors, offering at least 54 square meters of space. Guests can enjoy an exclusive spa area with an indoor pool and a beautiful garden. The hotel also boasts a 2 Michelin-starred restaurant, Silvio Nickol Gourmet Restaurant, and a more casual dining experience at Clementine im Glashaus, with idyllic garden seating. For wine connoisseurs, the hotel's collection includes around 60, 000 bottles housed in six cellars, earning it the World's Best Wine List award from World of Fine Wine. Twelve versatile meeting and event rooms cater to a variety of functions. Originally the seat of the House of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha, this historic palace, built between 1840 and 1845, showcases six centuries of Viennese architectural history.

135382.address: 33 derb El Guessaba Lkebir, Le Moukef, Medina
135382.description: There are 13 guest rooms at this establishment. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. Facilities include a hotel safe, currency exchange and a TV lounge. There is a café and a restaurant on the premises. Internet access is provided and guests can use the room and laundry services on offer. Those guests who are arriving by car may park their vehicle in the hotel's car park and bicycles can be hired on-site. All bedrooms and suites have en suite bathrooms in Tadelakt plaster and mosaics, with a shower and separate toilets. The bathrooms also have bathrobes, hairdryers and shower gel or soaps. They are decorated with full respect for Moroccan traditions. The rooms are appointed with double/king-size beds. All rooms have air conditioning, Internet access and ironing set. For an additional fee, guests can use the swimming pools.

135383.description:
The RIAD is ideally located in the middle of the medina, 100 m from the Djemaa el Fna square (2 minutes on foot) and only 10 minutes from Marrakech-Menara Airport.

The riad has a wonderful terrace which overlooks the old city of Marrakech, the Koutoubia tower and the snowy Atlas Mountains. Built in 2009, the property comprises 7 guest rooms and welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. Facilities on offer to guests include a hotel safe, TV lounge, café, bar and a restaurant. Furthermore, Internet access, room service, laundry service and a car park are provided for guests.

The rooms of the house each have their own colour and a Berber name to identify them. It is always a concern at the riad to make associations to all forms of Moroccan crafts. Rooms also feature modern comfort with individually regulated air conditioning on the 1st floor and an LCD TV with satellite/cable channels in all rooms. All rooms also feature an en suite bathroom with a shower, Internet access, tea and coffee making facilities, a washing machine and an ironing set.

Guests will appreciate the outdoor swimming pool in the centre of the patio. Its depth allows them to fully enjoy a fresh drink in hand. There are tables and a big terrace.

Guests can discover the multitude of flavours and recipes forming Moroccan cuisine. The team is able to prepare Moroccan dishes such as couscous, tagines, pastillas, briouates and more on request.

135384.description: This most charming little hotel in a historic building with Moroccan style interior decoration and a lovely patio is excellently situated in the famous district of Bab Doukkala, next to the Majorelle Gardens. The Medina of Marrakech, the Jemaa el Fna square, Palais des Congrès, El Badi Palace, Royal Palace, Molay Al Yazid Mosque and Theatre Royal are easily reachable

135440.description:
Located in a quiet area 10 minutes' walk from Viale Certosa, Radisson Blu Hotel, Milan has a strategic position. From the hotel, guests can easily reach the city centre with its attractions and the trade exhibition centers of Rho Fiera and MiCo.
The hotel has 250 recently renovated rooms and suites: a modern design and first-class comfort including free high speed Wi-Fi, smart 50" UHD TV with national and international channels, USB ports for direct charging of electronic devices, coffee and tea making facilities and minibar, that make it the ideal accommodation for a business or leisure stay.
Upon waking up, guests can enjoy a delicious breakfast at the Leonardo restaurant, where they can find a rich sweet and savoury continental buffet.
Also, Leonardo restaurant offers traditional Italian and Milanese dishes with modern and creative influences, which can be enjoyed in the beautiful garden during the spring and summer season. 
The welcoming atmosphere of the Lobby Bar, is the ideal place for an aperitif, a snack or an after dinner drink. 
All the guests have free access to the Wellness & Fitness area which includes an indoor swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, sauna and bio sauna. 
The hotel has thirteen meeting rooms with natural light that can accommodate up to 250 people, ideal for hosting any meeting or private event.
This Green Key eco-labeled hotel is a 5-minute walk from Villapizzone train station and 100 metres from a tram stop leading to the historic centre. By car you can reach the Rho Fiera exhibition centre in 15 minutes and the MiCo congress centre in about 5 minutes.

name.content: Hotel Barcelona Condal Mar Affiliated by Meliá

135449.description: The Barcelona Condal Mar by Meliá is located in Barcelona, one of the most modern and cosmopolitan cities in Europe. Situated close to the International Convention Center of Barcelona (CCIB), the Diagonal Mar Shopping Center and the "Mar Bella" beach, as well as the tram (T4), the metro (L4) and the bus (H14), which connect with the center of the city in less than 20 minutes. Among its wide range of facilities and services, you can enjoy a magnificent outdoor pool (seasonal) with spectacular 360º views of the city of Barcelona, 11 meeting rooms with capacity for more than 200 people, equipped with the latest technologies in audiovisual media and communication and a full gym, sauna, massage cabin and free WIFI.

135450.address: N 45 Sidi Mimoune Derb Sidi M'Barka Medina
135450.description: The hotel is in the old town of Marrakech, just a few metres from the famous Jemaa El Fna square and the Badii Palace. The nearest bus station is about 4 km and the nearest train station is about 3 km away. It is approximately 3 km from Marrakech-Menara Airport. In addition to a unique architecture, hotel guests will enjoy the magnificent view over the old city. A saltwater swimming pool offers a coolness which will be much appreciated and enjoyed. Sun loungers and parasols are laid out for guests to use. Refreshments can be enjoyed in the café and a restaurant serves a variety of tasty dishes. The air-conditioned rooms are cosy with en-suite bathrooms in traditional Tadelakt. The terraces will surprise guests with exceptional views.

135459.description: Nestled amidst the majestic Hottentots Holland Mountains and adjacent to the magnificent Erinvale Golf Course, the Erinvale Estate Hotel and Spa is located just outside the historic town of Stellenbosch. Set among private gardens, cobbled walkways, and beautiful oak trees, this hotel offers a tranquil escape. A mere 31 miles from Cape Town and 22 miles from Cape Town International Airport (CPT), it's easily accessible. The hotel features 56 exquisitely styled guest rooms, each fully equipped with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy a variety of delicious dishes at the sophisticated Magnolia Restaurant and rejuvenate at the serene Erinvale Estate Spa, renowned as one of Africa's finest.

135562.description: Stay at the Hotel Aida Marais Printania in the heart of Paris, just a short walk from the Grands Boulevards and Place de la République. This hotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a ballroom. Enjoy daily buffet breakfast (fee applies) and room service. The 45 air-conditioned rooms feature LCD TVs with digital programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include the Canal Saint-Martin, Les Halles, and the Picasso Museum, all within a 10-minute drive. Orly Airport is 19. 2 km and Charles de Gaulle Airport is 29. 8 km from the hotel.

name.content: La Cigale Hotel Managed By Accor

135641.address: Suhaim Bin Hamand Street Al Sadd Area, 60
135641.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a nightclub, an indoor pool, and a sauna. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Grab a bite at Le Cigalon, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 3 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and limo/town car service. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and a meeting room.

name.content: Signature Hotel Apartment & Spa Marina (Ex Lotus)

135642.description: This apartment complex revels in the splendour of its surroundings, on Dubai Marina. The complex is situated within easy access of the Marina Mall and the Mall of the Emirates. The complex is located within easy access of a wealth of intriguing attractions in this captivating city. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the Burj Khalifa, Jumeirah Beach, Dubai Museum and Safa Park. The mesmerising Burj Al Arab and Wild Wadi Park are also located just a short driving distance away. This wonderful complex is just 39 km away from Dubai International Airport. This charming complex appeals to discerning travellers. The apartments are sumptuously designed, oozing decadence and grace. The complex offers an endless choice of first-class facilities and services. Guests can indulge in the ultimate rejuvenation in the elegant surroundings of the full-service spa.

135646.description:
This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre in an historic building in the fashionable Freihaus quarter of Vienna’s 4th district. The property was established in 1911 and it is close to the Belvedere and the nearest station is Westbahnhof. 
The centrally situated Hotel offers 53 rooms (9 single rooms, 30 double rooms, 10 triple rooms as well as 4 suites) thus allowing it to offer appropriate and most convenient accommodation for each guest, both business travellers and tourists.
The Hotel has a bar and a coffee shop. All 53 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning. All of them are non-smoking.

135647.address: Al-Jazeera Street,Off Al-Riqqa Rd,Behind La Ghurai
135647.description: This modern and sophisticated hotel boasts a prime location between Dubai's old town with the souks of Al Ras and the international airport. Not far from the property, visitors will find places of interest such as Al Riqqa Road shopping centre and the popular Dubai Creek. Thus, this is the best accommodation option for both business and leisure travellers alike. Guest rooms and suites are lavishly appointed with marble floors and very comfortable beds, offering its visitors the best place in which to rest and relax. They include a flat-screen TV and complimentary wireless Internet connection. After a day of working or sightseeing, guests can go to the rooftop swimming pool or to the health club with a sauna. Afterwards, they can taste a delicious variety of exclusive dishes at the on-site restaurant.

135649.address: Omar Bin Al Khattab Road, Deira
135649.description: Close to Hor Al Anz East's shopping centre, restaurants and the beach, this hotel occupies a prime location in the heart of Dubai, 15 minutes from the World Trade Centre, Dubai Creek, the famous gold souks and many other tourist attractions around the city. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, and lift access, business center, swimming pool and a fully equipped gym, free Wi-Fi, a newsstand and a café. Furthermore, guests can use the 24-hour room service, and laundry services.

135650.address: Al Nahda 1, Amman Street, Al Mamzar, Al Qusais
135650.description: The establishment features elegant accommodations 7 miles from the centre of Dubai, and just under 4 miles from the International Airport. Other attractions like Al Mamzar Beach Park and Festival City are just 10 minutes away. It features a private parking lot, a meeting room, a roof-top pool, a sauna, and a well-equipped gym. The apartments of Al Nawras present spacious living and dining areas, a work space and a fully-furnished kitchen. All units extend out onto balconies. A range of international dishes is served at the restaurant, which also offers in-room dining and buffet services.

135660.description: Located within the historic Macka Palas built in 1922, Park Hyatt Istanbul - Macka Palas blends the timeless elegance of its Art Deco heritage with modern sophistication. Nestled in the heart of Nişantaşı, Istanbul’s most fashionable shopping and lifestyle district, the hotel offers an exclusive retreat for both business and leisure travelers. The property features 90 spacious rooms and suites, some with private Turkish hammams and deep soaking tubs, offering a unique in-room spa experience. A semi-Olympic outdoor pool provides a tranquil escape, while interiors display iconic Istanbul photographs by the legendary Ara Güler. Guests can enjoy modern Aegean flavors at Kalimera Istanbul and signature coffees and artisanal desserts at Kapicciiiinoo, each reflecting the refined essence of Nişantaşı.

135666.description:
Only a 10-minute walk away from the city center, the stylish 4-star hotel IMLAUER Wien is located in a quiet side street between 2 underground stations, both only 200 metres away.
The modern business hotel offers 117 air-conditioned rooms and junior suites which combine a straight design with most up to date furnishings.
A cozy bar in the glass-covered Winter garden provides cosiness and relaxation in the center of the city. The sauna, the fitness centre and the internet corner are available free of charge. Free WIFI is available
The congress and exhibition centre, as well as the Vienna Prater with the Giant Ferris Wheel and many more famous sights are located in the immediate vicinity of the hotel.
For successful seminars four air-conditioned seminar rooms are available for up to 70 persons.

135673.description: Located in the heart of Paris, Villa Madame is a 4-star hotel just a short walk from Luxembourg Gardens and a 5-minute drive from the Louvre Museum. This charming hotel offers 28 guestrooms equipped with minibars, flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, desks, and phones with free local calls. The hotel features a terrace, a garden, and a cozy lobby with a fireplace. Additional amenities include concierge services, a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and room service during limited hours. Start your day with a cooked-to-order breakfast (available for a fee), and unwind at the bar/lounge in the evening.

135692.address: Calle 17 Norte, Mz 23, Lote 9 al 14, SM 64
