135692.description: Perched between Lopez Portillo Avenue and Chichen Itza Avenue in a famous city and tourist resort of Cancun, this splendid hotel is a perfect base for  family holiday, weekend gateway and business travel.  Cancun International Airport is 20 kilometres away and visitors will find themselves within easy reach of many local businesses, corporate offices, entertainment venues and local landmarks. This charming property boasts spacious and tastefully adorned rooms in which to completely rest at night. Guests may wake up to a delicious American or continental breakfast and dine on Mexican culinary delights at the traditional on-site restaurant. Throughout the day, patrons may play snooker, make use of a sparkling outdoor pool, soak up the sun on the on-site sun loungers or sip an exotic cocktail from the hotel bar. There is a parking for visitors arriving by car.

135745.description: This hotel is set amidst the heart of the Marrakech Medina. The hotel is beautifully located just a few steps away from Jemaa el Fna Square. Guests will find themselves within easy access of many of the city's most prominent attractions. The hotel is conveniently located just 2 km away from Marrakech Menara Airport. Agadir is just a 90 minutes' driving distance away. This hotel exudes a welcoming, relaxing environment. The guest rooms offer elegance and style. The hotel features stunningly-designed independent riads, which offer guests a truly unrivalled experience. The hotel also features 2 restaurants, for a spectacular dining experience. Guests will experience an combination of Oriental style and comfort, and French refinement at this hotel.

135806.description: Situated in the heart of Providencia, the hotel has a prime location. It is close to Los Leones metro station, and has direct access to the main commercial, tourist and cultural parts of the city. Restaurants, bars and clubs are a short walk away. This classic city hotel welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception. Facilities include a safe, currency exchange, cloakroom, lift access, a bar and a restaurant. Business travellers will appreciate the conference facilities, WLAN Internet access, and further services include 24-hour room service, a laundry service and parking.

135809.address: Calle Paso Kuka s/n, Playa Norte
135809.description: This hotel is a tropical beachfront property that is located on the secluded island of Holbox and surrounded by the Caribbean Sea. Its bungalow-style dwellings place guests right on the sandy beach, just metres from the oceanfront. Besides their nice decoration and cosy ambience, they offer spacious furnished patios with hammocks, where one can relax with a book in hand and let her/him self be gently rocked by the refreshing breeze. The onsite restaurant has a beautiful palapa-style roof and treats to gorgeous ocean views. It serves international dishes and fine Mexican cuisine, plus all of its meals are prepared with fresh ingredients and follow closely the original Caribbean recipes. It's the ideal place for a romantic dinner or family gathering, featuring a tropical ambiance and delicious regional seafood cuisine.

name.content: Residence Inn By Marriott  Sheikh Zayed Road

135812.address: PO Box 417451 Sheikh Zayed Road Dubai
135812.description: Located in the heart of Dubai, Residence Inn by Marriott Sheikh Zayed Road is a 5-minute drive from the Dubai International Financial Centre and the Museum of the Future. This upscale hotel is also conveniently close to the Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo (3. 7 km) and the Dubai World Trade Centre (4. 1 km). Unwind at the full-service spa with massages, body treatments, and facials. Maintain your fitness routine at the health club, take a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, or relax in the sauna. The hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and a complimentary shuttle to nearby shops. The 430 air-conditioned guest rooms feature kitchens equipped with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and ovens. Enjoy a restful sleep on a Select Comfort bed with down comforters and premium bedding. Each room includes a 32-inch flat-screen TV with cable programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. A phone, safe, and desk are also provided for your convenience. Dine at one of the hotel's two restaurants, including Turkish Lounge, or order from the 24-hour room service. Snacks are available at the two coffee shops/cafés. A continental breakfast is offered daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Additional amenities include wired internet access (surcharge), a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.

135823.description: This landmark hotel offers a relaxing atmosphere and high-quality service near Venice. Set within a vast park with walking trails and tranquil ponds, it provides a welcome respite. Conveniently located near airports, the hotel also offers easy access to Venice's city center. The historic 16th-century building features original frescoes and Venetian-tile flooring. Guest rooms and suites are decorated in a traditional country style and offer modern comforts. In the summer, guests can enjoy the on-site swimming pool and its catering facilities.

135825.description: A stay at Hotel Les Bulles de Paris places you in the heart of Paris, within a 15-minute walk of Notre-Dame and Panthéon.  This 4-star hotel is 0.7 mi (1.1 km) from Luxembourg Gardens and 1.3 mi (2.2 km) from Louvre Museum. Pamper yourself with onsite massages or enjoy recreation amenities such as a sauna. Additional amenities at this Beaux Arts hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Stay in one of 44 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones and safes, and housekeeping is provided daily. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.1 mile and kilometer.Sorbonne University - 0.2 km/0.1 mi- Panthéon - 0.4 km/0.3 mi- Rue Mouffetard - 0.4 km/0.3 mi- Île de la Cité - 0.6 km/0.4 mi- Île Saint-Louis - 0.8 km/0.5 mi- Notre-Dame - 0.9 km/0.6 mi- Sainte-Chapelle - 1 km/0.6 mi- Jardin des Plantes - 1.1 km/0.7 mi- Luxembourg Gardens - 1.1 km/0.7 mi- Rue de Rivoli - 1.1 km/0.7 mi- Hôtel de Ville - 1.1 km/0.7 mi- Pont Neuf - 1.2 km/0.7 mi- Les Halles - 1.3 km/0.8 mi- Centre Pompidou - 1.6 km/1 mi- Louvre Museum - 1.8 km/1.1 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 18.1 km/11.2 mi  Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 36.7 km/22.8 mi  The preferred airport for Hotel Les Bulles de Paris is Paris Orly Airport (ORY).

135826.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance at the Grand Hôtel Magenta, located in Paris's 10th Arrondissement. The hotel's 30 guestrooms feature satellite TV, safes, desks, and bathrooms with bathtubs or showers. A 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and an elevator are also available. The hotel is within a 15-minute walk of the Sacré-Cœur Basilica and Canal Saint-Martin, and a short distance from attractions like Palais Garnier and the Champs-Élysées.

135850.address: Angle Bd Zerktouni Et Mohamed V, 89
135850.description: Located in Marrakech's vibrant Guéliz district, this hotel sits between modern shops and the traditional souks near the famed Djemaa el Fna square. Just 4 km from Menara International Airport, this hotel offers 35 rooms and various amenities, including a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, and on-site dining. Each air-conditioned room features a private bathroom with a shower/bathtub and hairdryer, along with a king-size/double bed, TV, internet access, a safe, and a minibar. Guests can enjoy the hotel's swimming pool, loungers, steam room, and massage treatments.

135868.description: Located within Istanbul's ViaPort shopping complex, the Crowne Plaza Istanbul - Asia offers extensive event facilities and a complimentary shuttle to Sabiha Gökçen International Airport. A 10-minute drive from Pendik Metro Station and 8 minutes from Tersane Train Station, the hotel provides easy access to Istanbul's city center. The hotel features 26 flexible event spaces, the largest accommodating up to 1, 000 guests, with a dedicated Crowne Plaza Meetings Director to assist you. Enjoy a peaceful night's sleep with the Sleep Advantage Programme, including premium bedding and quiet zones, followed by complimentary breakfast. Relax in the traditional hammam or swim in the indoor or outdoor pool. The Cesni and Belvedere restaurants offer a range of exquisite Turkish and international cuisine.

135869.description: This city boutique hotel is ideally located in the Sultanahmet district of Istanbul. The hotel is a mere 100 metres from the Egyptian Bazaar and the Spice Market, where guests can explore the exciting and alluring experience which provides a feast for all the senses. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the city's mesmerising attractions, making this the ideal choice for travellers who are eager to explore the sights and sounds of Istanbul. Guests will be impressed by the stylish surroundings and elegant furnishings the hotel has to offer, which are coupled with impeccable service and attention to detail. The guest rooms are classically styled and feature modern amenities for visitors' convenience. Guests will appreciate the delightful culinary treats which are served in the relaxing restaurant.

135870.description:
Located 350 m away from the Blue Mosque, Harmony Hotel Istanbul offers a rooftop terrace with panoramic views of Marmara Sea. Its rooms have free WiFi and satellite TV. Grand Bazaar is 500 m from the property.

Set in a traditional Ottoman building, all rooms are decorated in soft, neutral colours and feature floor-to-ceiling windows. Each room is equipped with a well-stocked minibar. The private bathroom comes with a hairdryer.

Buffet breakfast is served in the breakfast hall and includes a variety of Turkish dishes made from regional produce. Guests can relax here with a warm drink after lunch or dinner.

The staff at Harmony can organize city tours and outdoor excursions to popular local attractions.

Hotel Harmony Istanbul is a 5-minute walk from Topkapi Palace. It is less than 200 m away from the Hippodrome, a location featuring a historic racetrack and ancient pillars. Lutfi Kirdar Congress Centre is 4 km away while Yenikapi Port is 1 km from the property. Airport pick-up can be arranged. Istanbul Airport is 55 km away.

135873.description: The modern and comfortably designed hotel in the heart of Berlin is the ideal starting point to explore one of the most happening cities in the world. Sights and attractions are located practically in front of our hotel door. With perfect connections to the autobahn, BER - Berlin Brandenburg airport, Berlin's main railway station. The bright and spacious rooms meet the highest comfort requirements. Equipped with individually controlled air conditioning and hypoallergenic floors. Guests can enjoy a varied and high-quality breakfast, each day. The stylish lounge and sports bar is a popular meeting point to enjoy cool drinks and delicious snacks.

135876.description:
IMPORTANT: A city tax of 3 euros will be applied. 

Kasbah Agounsane is a luxurious guest house located in the Ourika Valley, a 30-minute drive from Marrakech. Its furnished lounge/terrace sits in the courtyard with its lush gardens and swimming pool. The Kasbah offers elegantly decorated suites, each with a private balcony or terrace and a separate seating area. The private bathrooms include bathrobes, slippers and a hairdryer and free Wi-Fi access is provided in all rooms. The spa & wellness center has a hammam and sauna and offers massage treatments upon request. Wellness and beauty treatments are also available. The elegant bar and restaurant is open for guests of Kasbah Agounsane. You can enjoy a drink or meal on the terrace under the stars and overlooking the valley. The property is set in the heart of Berbère surrounded by the Atlas Mountains. Staff can arrange airport transfer and day trips to the surrounding areas upon request.

135889.description: Boasting a convenient location in the heart of Puerto Madero, in Buenos Aires, Argentina, this unique establishment is just a 6-minute drive from the city centre and only 7 kilometres from Alto Palermo shopping centre. Ministro Pistarini International Airport is some 30 kilometres away. Guests will find the famous San Telmo neighbourhood close to the hotel, with several art galleries and a host of bars and restaurants. This modern property features European décor and has been created combining modernity, attention to detail and comfort in all areas. The spacious guest rooms have been tastefully decorated and provide a seating area where travellers can relax after a long day visiting this vibrant city. They all come with complimentary wireless high-speed Internet connection for guests' convenience. Guests staying at this hotel might have the chance to have breakfast while enjoying the stunning panoramic views.

135897.description:
Housed in a modern building, this elegant hotel is ideally located in the business district of Santiago, only a few steps from La Moneda Palace, the Government House and Moneda Metro Station. Besides being a perfect spot for business travellers, the property is also an ideal choice for those who want to explore the historic city centre and its main attractions. Visitors can find many museums, restaurants, supermarkets and other entertainment venues in the surrounding area. The hotel offers comfortable rooms with modern furniture and a simple but charming decoration. Standard facilities include air-conditioning, free Internet access and a flat-screen TV for guests' entertainment. Other hotel services include a 24-hour reception. 

"Depósito de garantía para cubrir posibles consumos de USD 30. 00 o $25. 000 pesos Chilenos por noche de estadía. Garantía puede ser pagada en efectivo o tarjeta de crédito. Esta garantía será retornada al momento del check out. "

135984.description: This apartment complex is located in Providence. The complex is situated close to the Los Leones Metro Station, offering ease of access to other areas to be explored. The complex is situated within easy access of a number of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. The centre of Santiago is located just 3 km away. The Palacio de la Moneda can be found just 5 km from the complex. This apartment hotel is housed in a French-style building. The apartments are superbly designed, offering functional space and a comfortable home away from home. Guests are invited to enjoy a delightful, continental breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

135990.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an indoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a picnic area. Satisfy your appetite for dinner at the hotel's restaurant, Courtyard Restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and 8 meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 62 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and coffee/tea makers.

136011.description:
The complex is set on a hilltop overlooking Alanya and the Mediterranean Sea. Located in a rural setting with spectacular views, the local town of Mahmutlar is just 2 km away and Antalya Airport is roughly 140 km from the hotel. 
An on-site shopping centre, small cinema or an atmospheric Irish pub are all there for guests to enjoy. Leisure options like a revolving rooftop bar or a visit to the hotels' private beach guarantee a memorable stay. The deluxe standard rooms are stylishly decorated with carpeted floors and plush fittings. All have a balcony and individually regulated air conditioning. Each room surprises guests with private amenities including a hot tub. The complex has a wide range of entertainment facilities including a SPA Centre, a sports complex and 6 swimming pools, tempting guests to a sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols laid out ready for use.

136043.description: This comfortable property is located in Side. Situated within 2. 5 kilometre(s) from the town centre, the hotel is easily accessible on foot to a host of places of interest. The establishment is just a short walk from the main entertainment areas. Public transport connections are at 500 MT (s) away. The nearest beach is within 1300 metres from the property. The hotel consists of 64 guest rooms. New Garden underwent renovation in 2021.

136069.description: This luxurious property is located near Deira Creek in Dubai. Both business and leisure guests at this hotel will appreciate the convenient location in the business district, just minutes from Dubai International Airport. Exceptional amenities, including free wireless high-speed Internet connection and plush furnishings, provide the apartment and suites, ensuring a restful stay. All rooms at this hotel in Dubai showcase either stunning views of the creek or the impressive city sprawl. On-site dining options include an all-day restaurant that serves East African and Indian cuisine. Visitors may also take advantage of the hotel's convenient services, such as a health club, swimming pool, airport transfer and complimentary valet parking.

136071.description:
This hotel is located in a commanding central position in Dubai's fashionable Merchant City overlooking Baniyas Square. It lies only a 10-minute drive from Dubai International Airport.

This city establishment has been built to international standards and is a popular budget hotel in Dubai. It comprises a total of 100 spacious and well-appointed rooms, including 15 suites and it offers discerning travellers a good package of facilities, essential services and sumptuous dining at reasonable rates. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility and lift access. There is a café, a bar, a pub, a disco and a restaurant. Guests can also take advantage of the room and laundry services.

The accommodation offers guests all necessary amenities. All come with a private bathroom with a shower and offer a king-size or double bed. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, a work desk, Internet access, a safe and a mini fridge. Furthermore, an ironing set and individually regulated air conditioning are provided in all accommodation as standard.

136136.description: This eco-friendly establishment is situated in Colombia's capital city, the vibrant Bogotá. Set in the heart of the business district, it is located a short driving distance away from El Dorado Airport, although it operates a complimentary transfer service to/from the airport. Whether for business or leisure, this great region has something for everyone. This luxurious hotel is surrounded by some of the main local tourist attractions, such as the Gold Museum and National Museum. Guests staying at this stylish property will have the chance to enjoy the world-class amenities and services it offers. It provides a choice of guest rooms decorated in a traditional or modern way depending on the taste of the client. Business travellers will appreciate the state-of-the-art business centre providing secretarial services and technical concierge, among others.

136143.description:
Located at the Fuğla peninsula in the Incekum area of the Turkish Riviera, the stylish boutique hotel Venessa Beach has a fantastic frontline position and direct access to a private part of the fine sandy beach this area is known for. The centre of Avsallar is just a short stroll away, while the centre of Alanya with its entertainment and shopping venues as well as its points of interest such as the Archaeological Museum, the Castle or the Red Tower is at a distance of 22 km. 
All of the hotel's rooms are decorated in a contemporary style and feature free WIFI, floor-to-ceiling windows and a spacious balcony with stunning views over the eternal blue of the Mediterranean Sea. Guests can relax in the sauna and the hamam or enjoy a drink at one of the bars, including a beach-/garden bar and a waterpipe café. A wonderful place for couples who wish to spend a holiday on the beach or a romantic getaway.

name.content: Demeures D'Orient Riad de Luxe & Spa

136176.description:
Boasting an ideal location in the heart of the Medina and easy to access by car, the brand new riad welcomes guests in a setting combining space and light. Marrakech-Menara Airport is just 3 km from the hotel.

The 11 luxurious rooms and suites are spread across 1,000 m² and set around a patio and pool, which is the perfect place to enjoy a relaxing moment in the warmer hours of the day. The air-conditioned establishment welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and a cloakroom. Further facilities available to guests at this charming hotel include a hairdressing salon, TV lounge, café, restaurant, WLAN Internet access and a car park. For additional fees, guests may also take advantage of the room service, laundry service and bicycle hire service.

Each room and suite features all the comforts and facilities to satisfy the most discerning of guests, while showcasing a typical Oriental style. The rooms feature charming handcrafted furniture, a large en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub and hairdryer, a double or king-size bed, individually regulated air conditioning and heating, and a private terrace. Other in-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, Internet access, a safe and a minibar.

After a day of sightseeing, guest can enjoy some relaxing moments in the hammam, or unwind with a massage or spa treatment. There is a heated outdoor swimming pool with poolside snack bar and a sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols laid out ready for use. Further sport and leisure activities available to guests include tennis, golf, horse riding and biking (fees apply for all). The hotel organises entertainment programmes for adults and children (fees apply for both).

136178.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, a 24-hour fitness center, and bicycles to rent. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy American cuisine at Red Salt Room, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Garden City? This hotel has 25000 square feet (2323 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms.

136226.description: This luxury spa hotel is strategically located in one of Bogotá's most exclusive areas, offering easy access to top-rated restaurants and entertainment venues. Two shopping centers are within a 20-minute walk, and the international airport is 19 km away. This family-friendly hotel features two towers: one with 237 rooms and another with 91 apartment-style accommodations ideal for longer stays. All rooms boast either a balcony or a terrace and an en-suite bathroom. The hotel offers accessible facilities, including adapted rooms for guests with disabilities. A dedicated business floor with a private restaurant caters to conventions and corporate events. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour reception, lift access, an indoor heated swimming pool, spa, sauna, and a well-equipped gym. Please note: Wet area facilities are unavailable on the first Monday of each month. The hotel has implemented a comprehensive Biosecurity Management System and enhanced cleaning and disinfection protocols. Colombian guests are asked to provide EPS identification at check-in, and international guests are asked to present proof of international medical assistance insurance. Due to COVID-19, some hotel facilities or services may be subject to closures or schedule changes. Further information will be provided upon arrival.

136265.description: Located in the heart of Buenos Aires, this boutique hotel offers easy access to the city's main attractions. Just a short walk from the bus and train stations, The Obelisk, and the Puerto Madero Waterfront, it's ideal for exploring the capital. Built in 2009, this hotel features 58 comfortable and spacious rooms, each equipped with a king-size bed, soundproofed walls, Wi-Fi, and an en suite bathroom with a shower, bathtub, and hot tub. Guests can enjoy a variety of amenities, including a 24-hour reception, lobby bar, café, restaurant, business center, and fitness facilities with a sauna and an outdoor hot tub on the terrace overlooking Avenida 9 de Julio. Start your day with a delicious breakfast buffet and savor à la carte lunch and dinner options.

name.content: Almacruz Hotel y Centro de Convenciones ExGalerias

136267.description: This hotel boasts an exciting location in the metropolitan area of Santiago. The hotel offers visitors the ideal base from which to explore the most important attractions of the city. Santa Lucia Hill and its metro station, can be found just a 3 minutes' walking distance away. The central railway station is just a short distance away from the hotel. Guests will find themselves just a 30 minutes' driving distance away from the airport. This hotel enjoys a charming style, adorned with decorative, historical features. The guest rooms offer functional space and comfort. The hotel features a delightful restaurant, where guests can enjoy a wonderful dining experience, followed by a refreshing drink from the bar. The hotel's conference facilities offer convenience to those travelling for work purposes.

136304.description: This charming apartment complex enjoys a prime location in the city center, near the world-renowned Alexanderplatz. Constructed in 1900 and completely refurbished in 2000, it offers ideal accommodations for travelers eager to explore all the hidden treasures of this beautiful city. Guests will find a total of 20 comfortable rooms on the premises. This apartment complex offers the convenience of a hotel and provides all the necessary services and amenities to enjoy a truly memorable stay. Pets are allowed. Check-in takes place at Pappelallee 21, 10437 Berlin, between 3:00 PM and 10:00 PM daily. In the interest of noise prevention, please note that Old Town Apartments may not be booked for parties or stag groups.

136315.description: Icarus Suites presents a fresh approach to accommodation in Buenos Aires, emphasizing wellness and thoughtful design. Known for exceptional service, the hotel boasts spacious rooms averaging 48 square meters. Each room is bathed in natural light from expansive windows that open onto private balconies.

136360.description: This luxurious beach hotel enjoys a spectacular frontline setting on the powder-white sands of Konyaalt. This sprawling stretch of beach runs to the west of the city of Antalya which is a mere 3 km away. Guests will find themselves in the perfect setting from which to enjoy a relaxing, indulgent beach break, while also being close to the heart of the action. This upscale hotel is set amidst 35, 000 square metres of land, which lends an air of peace and serenity to the environment. Guests are greeted with the promise of unsurpassed service and attention to detail. The guest rooms have been elegantly furnished, featuring a classical style and up-to-date amenities, exceeding the expectations of even the most discerning traveller. This wonderful hotel provides guests with exemplary facilities and services, catering to their leisure and dining needs.

136362.description: The Paloma Orenda Resort, a bungalow complex with 270 modern, luxuriously furnished rooms, is located in Titreyengöl, Manavgat, approximately 6 km from Side's city center, 75 km from Antalya Airport, and 80 km from Antalya's city center. Nestled within extensive gardens, the resort offers a comfortable ambiance, a beautiful beach, and a la carte restaurants with stunning Mediterranean views. Guests can enjoy delicious meals throughout the day at various dining venues, including the main restaurant (Paloma Restaurant) which serves complimentary ice cream with lunch and dinner. In 2019, renowned Turkish chef Vedat Başaran debuted his Gourmet Mediterranean concept at the resort, offering innovative and contemporary Turkish cuisine made with locally sourced, high-quality ingredients. The resort also features organic wines at its restaurants and bars.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Bogotá Salitre AR

136388.description:
DoubleTree by Hilton Bogotá Salitre AR
Strategically located in the Ciudad Salitre district, DoubleTree by Hilton Bogotá Salitre AR offers an ideal combination of comfort, wellness, and connectivity for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel is just 15 minutes from El Dorado International Airport and close to important city landmarks such as Corferias, Ágora Bogotá Convention Center, the United States Embassy, and the shopping centers Gran Estación and Salitre Plaza. 
Its modern and spacious rooms are designed to ensure comfort and functionality, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a work desk with ergonomic chairs, TV, and a coffee maker. Some rooms also include a kitchenette, making them ideal for extended stays. 
Guests can enjoy a complete wellness experience at the hotel’s spa, recognized as one of the best in the city. The spa offers services such as a hydrotherapy circuit, body rituals, facial treatments, and a variety of relaxation packages. The hotel also features a fully equipped 24-hour fitness center. Additionally, guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant and bar, offering a daily breakfast buffet, local and international cuisine, and live music. 
Featured amenities include complimentary airport shuttle service at scheduled times, free parking, 24-hour front desk, laundry service, a business center, and meeting or event rooms. The hotel is also pet-friendly, allowing guests to travel with their pets. 
Thanks to its prime location and the international standards of the Hilton brand, DoubleTree by Hilton Bogotá Salitre AR is an excellent choice for corporate travelers, guests attending fairs and conventions, or anyone looking to explore Bogotá with comfort and style.

136493.description:
The hotel is a 15 minutes‘ walk from the beach and 15 minutes from the centre of Side with its restaurants, bars and shops. The ancient sites like the spectacular Temple of Apollo or Anatolia's largest amphitheatre are easily reachable. Antalya Airport is 65 km away. Features of the hotel include 24-hour reception, WIFI, restaurant, bar, meeting rooms and outdoor pool.
The family rooms is a 50 mt away to the main building,pool and bar.
 - local payment - Safe box is at the reception..

SAFE BOX EXTRA.LOCAL PAYMENT./ SAFE BOX IS AT THE RECEPTION ***

136494.description: Choose the striking Holiday Inn Istanbul-Sisli hotel in the city's retail district, a short taxi ride to convention centres and 45 minutes from Istanbul Airport. Welcome from our friendly Front Desk staff inside the cool marble lobby of the Holiday Inn Istanbul Sisli. The modern design continues in the Guest rooms, which combine chic fittings and wooden floors with complimentary wireless Internet. From our location in the heart of modern Istanbul it's 350 metres to Sisli Metro, where trains speed you to the Old Town. Well placed for business, with the Lutfi Kirdar ICEC Conference Centre a 10 minute taxi ride from Holiday Inn Istanbul Sisli. You can prepare for meetings in the 24-hour Business Centre and keep up with work via wireless Internet throughout the hotel. Sisli is a shopper's paradise, and the hotel is walking distance from the enormous Cevahir shopping mall. We're also just 5km from atmospheric Istanbul Old Town, Grand Bazaar and see the towering minarets of the Blue Mosque.

name.content: Max Brown 5th District, Part of Sircle Collection

136502.description:
The hotel is located in the 5th district of Vienna, close to the city centre (historical part of Vienna). It is a 2-minute walk to public transportation and to the famous Naschmarkt, as well as Mariahilferstrasse with its large selection of shops. 

With both modern and classic styles, this hotel offers a feel-good atmosphere. The hotel successfully combines tradition and modernity, and has its own unique flair. The 117 rooms in 2 different styles are perfect for those who appreciate Viennese elegance as well as style-enthusiasts in general. Guests of this city hotel are welcomed in the lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange, and lift access to the upper floors. Facilities include air conditioning, conference facilities, wired and wireless Internet access (wireless for a fee), room and laundry services (both for a fee) and a car park (for a fee). Guests can enjoy a snack in the café, a drink in the bar or a delicious meal in the restaurant. 

All of the rooms are en suite with a shower or bathtube and hairdryer. In-room amenities include a double bed, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a radio, Internet access, a safe, and tea making facilities. The air conditioning and heating are individually regulated. 

Guests looking to relax in the evening can try out the recreation area on the top floor, which features a sauna offering views over the rooftops of Vienna. 

The hotel serves a breakfast buffet each morning.

136537.description: Situated only a few minutes from the Cape Town Convention Centre, in the CBD and close to the Waterfront, this upscale hotel has the ideal location for business travellers as well as for tourists seeking to discover the Mother City and its main attractions. Cape Town International Airport is approximately a 30-minute drive away and a transfer service can be arranged upon request. This luxury apartment hotel is designed to offer superb comfort, ensuring that guests feel that sense of home-away-from-home. The accommodation units feature an open plan lounge and kitchen area and a separate bedroom. All of them are tastefully appointed with stylish furniture and modern comforts such as air-conditioning, a flat-screen TV and a fully-equipped kitchen. The on-site restaurant offers a great selection of local and international dishes to start the day full of energy and can accommodate up to 80 people.

136554.description:
Located in Tekirova, one of Antalya’s most popular holiday resorts, Club Hotel Phaselis Rose stands out with its seafront location, offering a delightful vacation surrounded by nature. 
Nestled in one of the most beautiful corners of the Mediterranean, where green meets blue, the hotel welcomes its guests amidst the ancient heritage of Phaselis. 
Guests who wish to fully enjoy the sea and sun can relax on the hotel’s 300-meter-long private beach, while others may prefer spending time by the pool.

136602.description: Offering a choice of Emirati and international cuisine, MD Hotel features a rooftop pool with views over the Emirates Mall. Professional trainers and masseurs pamper guests at the health club. MD Hotel’s rooms combine 43” flat-screen TVs and high-speed internet with elegant furniture, black-and-white photos and a homely feel. The bathroom includes a bathtub, bathrobes and slippers. Business lunches and 3-course dinner buffets can be enjoyed at the Emirati Restaurant. The extensive breakfast at the MD Hotel is served at Zabeel Hall. A 24-hour room service is available. A Finnish sauna, a relaxing hot tub and separate steam rooms for women and men can be found at MD Hotel. MD Hotel is a 10-minute walk to the Mall of the Emirates, and a two-minute walk to the Insurance Market Metro Station offers easy access to the main shopping areas in Dubai.

136666.description: With a modern, warm and functional style, this 53-room fantastic hotel offers all the convenience you need to enjoy an exclusive stay at the capital of Colombia. The Exe Santafé Boutique Hotel, located in the northwest area of the metropolis, at Bárbara neighbourhood, includes the excellence and comfort that are typical of a boutique hotel. Within its facilities, the hotel has a business centre and two ballrooms for events and business meetings. *Direct payment reservations will be debited in the local currency, at the current exchange rate.

136682.address: Umer Bin Khatt Ab Road Deira Dubai
136682.description: This recently renovated hotel welcomes guests with an ultra-modern look, exceptional service, and amenities designed to exceed expectations. Centrally located in Dubai's Al Ghurair City, near Fish Roundabout and just minutes from Dubai International Airport, it's an ideal hub for exploring this vibrant city. Nearby attractions include the Reef Mall, BurJuman Mall, Gold Souk, Grand Mosque, and Dubai Museum, all easily accessible via the complimentary shuttle, which also serves the area's sandy beaches. Guests can enjoy a variety of on-site entertainment options, including a relaxed lounge bar, a classic English pub, a modern nightclub, and a restaurant serving tantalizing specialties.

136687.description: The 3-star 55 Montparnasse Hotel welcomes you to the heart of Paris's historic 14th arrondissement, in the Montparnasse district. Explore the area's traditional shops and bakeries, and enjoy easy access to the Montparnasse Tower and Station, just 500 meters away. The hotel's 40 comfortable rooms are tastefully decorated and equipped with satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and a hairdryer. Please note: City tax is not included in the price from July 1, 2015.

136702.address: Corner of Wale and Burg Streets, /
136702.description: Situated in Cape Town's city center, this modern apartment complex offers chic, 21st-century deluxe apartments. Just steps away from restaurants, bars, and nightspots, and a short drive from the renowned beaches of Clifton and Camps Bay, it's ideally located for exploring the city. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a swimming pool, gym, and laundry service. The complex also offers convenient lift access and a lobby area with check-in from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM daily. Public transport is within easy reach, and Cape Town International Airport is a mere 25 km away.

136705.description: The Fuat Pasa Yalisi - Special Category Bosphorus, located on the Bosphorus, offers impeccable service and comprehensive facilities. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site parking, and airport transfers (arranged in advance). Smoking is restricted to designated areas. Each room is designed for comfort and a home-like feel, while the executive lounge provides a luxurious retreat. Start your day with breakfast at the hotel and enjoy delicious meals without venturing out. Take advantage of the numerous amenities, including a refreshing pool for a revitalizing swim.

136736.description: The Hotel De Paris is centrally located in Paris's 9th arrondissement, just 500 meters from the Gare du Nord and one metro stop from the Gare de l'Est. A short 10-minute walk takes you to the Sacré-Cœur Basilica in Montmartre. The hotel offers a variety of rooms and suites, all with free Wi-Fi. Recently renovated rooms on the 5th and 6th floors provide modern comfort. Each room and suite includes a private bath or shower and satellite TV. All floors are accessible by elevator except the 6th floor, where the family suites are located. Guests can choose between street-facing rooms or quieter courtyard accommodations. Fifth-floor street-side rooms boast balconies with Eiffel Tower views. A daily self-service breakfast is available, and the hotel provides a 24-hour reception. Excellent public transport links make exploring the city easy. The Poissonnière metro station (line 7) is a 5-minute walk, providing direct access to Galeries Lafayette, Châtelet-les Halles, and the Louvre Museum. The Anvers station (line 2), an 8-minute walk, connects to the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Élysées. Bus 42 stops directly in front of the hotel and travels to the Eiffel Tower.

name.content: Max Brown 7th District, part of Sircle Collect

136746.description: Conveniently set in the 07. Neubau district of Vienna, Max Brown 7th District is located a 17-minute walk from Wiener Stadthalle, 1. 2 km from Museumsquartier and a 17-minute walk from Leopold Museum. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, a 24-hour front desk and luggage storage space, along with free WiFi throughout the property. Private parking is available on site. Guest rooms are equipped with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, an electric tea pot, a shower, a hairdryer and a desk. At the hotel, every room comes with a private bathroom with free toiletries. A buffet breakfast is available daily at Max Brown 7th District. Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Natural History Museum, Parliament of Austria and Vienna City Hall. The nearest airport is Schwechat Airport, 18. 7 km from Max Brown 7th District. 07. Neubau is a great choice for travelers interested in museums, art and culture.

136771.description:
Its magnificent location between the ocean and mountains has made Cape Town one of the most attractive cities in the world. The hotel is conveniently situated in Sea Point, one of the most popular suburbs along the Atlantic Coast. The city centre is around 3.7 km away, and the tourist centre along the Victoria and Alfred Waterfront is some 3.5 km away. The beach at Sea Point is just 200 m from the property. The nearest restaurant is just 1 minute's walk away, and there is a bus stop just around 20 m from the hotel. Cape Town International Airport is around 25 km away.

Sweet Orange Guesthouse is a beautifully restored Victorian house and was built about 100 years ago. The wooden floors, ceilings, windows and doors have been lovingly restored to their original state and the 6 individually designed rooms are fitted with vintage furniture to reflect Cape Town's diversity. All the rooms have en-suite bathroom, king-size beds, an electronic safe, Hairdryer and Satellite TV. The tranquil garden with a small pool is a perfect place to relax and unwind. During the warm summer months breakfast will be served in the garden and in winter in the living room at the big table in front of the fireplace. We are centrally located in Sea Point with many small shops, cafes and restaurants to choose from. At Sweetest Guesthouses we offer you a unique experience – one where simplicity, great hospitality and exquisite decor unite, ensuing a sense of unforgettable wellbeing.

136778.description: Located near the Venezia-Mestre railway station and Mestre city center, this hotel offers easy access to Venice in just 10 minutes by bus or train. Venice Marco Polo Airport is a short drive away, and convenient bus services connect the hotel to both Marco Polo and Treviso Airports. Enjoy nearby restaurants, bars, and supermarkets, or explore the enchanting corners of Venice with a memorable water bus trip along the Grand Canal, taking in the city's rich cultural, artistic, and architectural attractions. The hotel's modern, well-appointed rooms feature Wi-Fi, LCD TVs, air conditioning, fridges, and private bathrooms with baths or showers, all offering excellent value.

136792.description: The Garner Hotel Vienna is centrally located near the new main railway station. Whether you are travelling to Vienna for business or pleasure, alone, as a couple, with family or friends: The Garner Hotel Vienna is the perfect address for your stay in the Austrian capital. Not only the typical Viennese charm awaits you here, but also a cosy atmosphere with an authentic Nordic hygge feeling - cosy box-spring bed, Smart TV and high-speed WiFi included! Cordiality, Scandinavian charm and sustainability are the top priorities in our design hotel. We rely on deliberate minimalism, bright colours and lots of warm light. Our hotel offers an ideal starting point for a discovery tour through Vienna. Thanks to its direct proximity to the main railway station, you have optimal transport connections and sightseeing highlights such as Belvedere Palace. You will also find everything you need in the neighbourhood: from restaurants and cafés to shopping facilities, fitness studios and much more. The cosy 77 rooms have a spacious double bed, a bathroom with shower, WC and hairdryer, as well as a flat-screen TV and soundproof windows. During your stay you are welcome to take advantage of our breakfast buffet. In addition to our delicious cocktails, we also serve a selection of first-class snacks at our bar. The hotel offers free high-speed WLAN and the reception is staffed around the clock. If you have any questions, someone is available 24 hours a day.

136820.description: Situated in Side in the Mediterranean Region, 6 km from Side Antique City and 500 m from the beach, Side Royal Palace boasts an outdoor pool, children's playground and sun terrace. The hotel has a spa centre and sauna, and guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant or a drink at the bar. WiFi is featured throughout. Each room at this hotel is air conditioned and comes with a flat-screen TV. You will find a kettle in the room. Rooms come with a private bathroom. Extras include free toiletries and a hairdryer. Side Royal Palace features free WiFi throughout the property. International cuisine is served at the 3 open-buffet restaurants as well as Italian and Turkish delicacies can be savoured. Guests can also enjoy fresh sea food at the restaurant. On-site bar offers refreshing drinks. There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. This hotel has a private beach area and bike hire and car h

136866.description:
This hotel boasts an unbeatable location in the center of Lisbon, near fashionable shopping and renowned museums. Combining the comfort of spacious studios and suites with luxurious service, its innovative design creates a contemporary atmosphere. The rooms offer a balanced concept of elegance and understated luxury, featuring comfortable living areas, workspaces, Full HD LCD TVs, modern bathrooms, and fully equipped kitchenettes. The stylish cafe provides the perfect setting for breakfast, light meals, or drinks, offering a trendy yet casual environment for relaxation. 

The Lounge Caffé, open daily, is the perfect place for breakfast, or a drink
anytime of the day, in a design, trendy and casual environment. It is also
the meeting place for those who want a moment of relaxation. It offers a
selection of wines, drinks, cocktails and cafeteria. A seasonal Sundeck with jacuzzi and lounge area. 

The Hotel has a 25m2 boardroom with capacity for 8 people, natural light, 
free WIFI Internet and video phone. The guest can also use the services of
the Altis Grand Hotel, such as the 20 meeting and banqueting rooms. This hotel is Dog-Friendly (accepts only one pet per stay, up to 10 kg, for an additional fee per day).

136870.description: Located in the heart of the popular seaside district of Miraflores, the Crowne Plaza® Lima Hotel is perfectly suited for business or leisure trips. Centrally situated in the commercial area, surrounded by colonial buildings, lush green parks overlooking the ocean and a variety of trendy restaurants. We are minutes from the British and Canadian Embassies and within walking distance of Costa Verde Beaches. Find beautiful souvenirs at the Indigenous Market or shop at Lancomar Outdoor Shopping Center. Also, history buffs can enjoy the National Museum of Archaeology, Anthropology and History. With personalized service and quality amenities, the hotel stands out among others in Lima. Our facilities include a bar where you can enjoy pisco cocktails, a spa, a Fitness Center with sauna and an indoor glass-roofed patio with pool and Jacuzzi. We also offer seven meeting rooms, an excellent catering service and the latest A/V equipment.

136897.description: Surrounded by beautiful gardens, this hotel is located only 150 m from a private beach and close to the town of Konakli. The town centre with its shops, bars and more than 100 restaurants is just 15 km away, the sandy beaches stretch for 10 km. The hotel features 176 rooms, 24-hours reception, quick check-in and check-out, restaurants, bars, Spa and wellness, fitness centre, indoor and outdoor pool, two children's pools, children's playground, WIFI in the community areas and a car park. Accessible for persons with reduced mobility.

136901.address: Avenida Pedro de Valdivia 150, Of. 1217, Edificio, 12
136901.description: This apartment hotel is set in the Providencia district of Santiago. The hotel is set close to Pedro de Valdivia metro station, which offers ease of access to other areas of the city. A number of restaurants, bars and nightlife venues can be found just a short walking distance away. Many prominent attractions, as well as the convention centre, can be found nearby. The centre of Santiago and the historical centre can be found just a 15 minutes' car journey away. This wonderful hotel offers visitors many opportunities for activities and exploration. The Valle Nevado cross country ski runs and the Farellones ski resort are within a 2 hour's driving distance away. This hotel combines comfort, style and convenience. The apartments offer visitors a home away from home, featuring modern amenities. Guests will be pleased by the many facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

136902.description: Hotel Casa Nogales is located in the heart of Providencia in Santiago de Chile, a 25-minute drive from Comodoro Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport and 56 km from the Valle Nevado ski resort. In addition, only 10 minutes walk from the Los Leones Metro station and 15 minutes from the Costanera Center shopping center.

136903.description: This city-center hotel, renovated in 2009, is ideal for both family vacations and business conferences. Located in the heart of Providencia, it's a short 5-minute walk from Los Leones metro station and surrounded by excellent dining, unique shops, shopping centers, and financial hubs. The Mediterranean architecture, featuring warm, domestic timber décor and a grand clock tower, creates an inviting atmosphere. Guests can enjoy delicious cuisine in the on-site restaurant. For business travelers, the hotel offers top-of-the-line facilities, including meeting rooms, Wi-Fi access, on-call taxis, and a business center. Comfortable guest rooms feature spacious beds and premium bedding, ensuring a good night's sleep.

136919.description:
The hotel is located in the small hamlet of Goynuk, just 10 km from the popular resort of Kemer. The beach is 400 m away and local transport is available on the main road 50 m from the hotel. Antalya Airport is approximately 40 km from the hotel.

This small hotel in a peaceful setting has a unique style which blends well into the local scenery. Making use of the plentiful pine supply in the area, the hotel has 15 wooden bungalows and there are a total of 38 guest rooms at this bungalow complex. The premises are air-conditioned and guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. Facilities include a hotel safe, TV lounge and a children's playground. There is a restaurant, bar and a beer garden on the premises. Internet access is available in the hotel for a charge and WLAN Internet access is also provided. Guests can take advantage of the laundry service (fees apply) and those guests who are arriving by car may park their vehicle in the hotel's car park.ost of the rooms are located on the second storey of wooden bungalows in the hotel grounds. They are furnished with a double bed, air conditioning (payable), a mini fridge, safe, satellite/cable TV, Internet access and a telephone. The en suite bathrooms are fitted with showers and a hairdryer. Each room has a balcony or terrace.

The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool and a children's pool. Refreshments are available from the poolside snack bar and guests can relax on sun loungers under the shade of parasols on the sun terrace. Guests can also play table tennis at the hotel and there is a golf course about 45 km away in Belek. For an additional fee, guests can hire sun loungers and parasols on the pebble beach.

Breakfast and dinner are served in an open buffet style.

136931.description: This hotel, located in the heart of Providencia near the Pedro de Valdivia metro station, offers 31 comfortable rooms. Guests enjoy air conditioning, a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, and an on-site restaurant. A children's playground and Wi-Fi are also available. Each room features a private bathroom with hairdryer and toiletries, a king-size/double bed, TV, in-room safe, minibar, and individual climate control.

136933.description: This hotel is situated in the exclusive Santiago suburb of Providencia. The hotel is located just steps away from the metro and main shopping streets. Many restaurants, cafes and bars can also be found nearby. A number of attractions are located close to the hotel. Cerro San Cristobal, Teatro Municipal, Plaza de Armas and Bellavista are all within a 25 minutes' drive of the hotel. Valparaiso is a 90 minutes' driving distance away. This charming hotel is perfect for business and leisure travellers. The hotel features superbly-styled rooms and suites. The hotel provides guests with many dining, leisure and business facilities and services. Those travelling for work purposes will appreciate the hotel's business centre and conference facilities.

136935.description: The Hotel Plaza San Francisco was first built in 1989 and has since become the newest 5-Star luxury hotel in downtown Santiago after undergoing extensive renovation works and remodeling. Located just a short distance from the heart of Santiago, it offers unbeatable possibilities of sightseeing well within walking distance of the hotel. Nearby, visitors can find the Government palace as well as some of the most important national monuments. Convention centers and cultural activities are also to be found in the vicinity; among these are the Diego Portales Building, the Museum of Fine Arts, and the Opera House. Our modern rooms - 140 standard rooms and 15 suites -reflect a perfect harmony of noble woods, exclusive upholstery and stylish furniture. ***Chilean customers must pay 19% VAT on arrival. In case of no show, the tax will be levied, anyway. Foreign clients are exempt.

136944.address: Pokhran Road 1, Next To Cadbury, Thane (W)
136944.description: The hotel is nestled amongst lush greens in the heart of Thane. It enjoys easy access to major business centres, with superior connectivity to the international and domestic airports in Mumbai, express motorways and major arterial roads. The hotel is about 22 km from the international airport and 2 km from Thane Railway Station. The hotel offers its guests luxury living along with a variety of services and facilities for a comfortable and pleasant stay. The hotel provides several halls and meeting rooms with conference facilities that can accommodate from 10 to 1, 000 people as needed. Facilities offered at this air-conditioned hotel include a lobby, hotel safe, travel desk, express laundry, room service, a restaurant and a car park. Each of the rooms is well appointed with comfortable beds and amenities including individually regulated air conditioning, a TV, safe, telephone and tea and coffee making facilities. All rooms are en suite. The hotel features an outdoor swimming pool and a gym.

136945.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at the London Marriott Hotel County Hall, situated near Westminster Bridge, with stunning views of the Thames River. This hotel offers 206 guestrooms with pillowtop beds, premium bedding, LCD televisions, and private bathrooms. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy satellite programming. Take advantage of the hotel's amenities, including an indoor pool, fitness center, two restaurants (including the British cuisine Gillray's Steakhouse), and a bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel also provides concierge, wedding, and business services, along with ample conference space and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include the London Dungeon, London Eye, Big Ben, Houses of Parliament, and Westminster Abbey.

136947.description: The hotel is located in the heart of Mumbai in Hiranandani Gardens, adjacent to the beautiful Powai Lake. The hotel is just 7 km away from the international airport and 8 km away from the domestic airport, while the nearest railway station is 2 km away. This eco hotel is designed with modern interiors displaying a distinct combination of contemporary design and old world charm. It offers a fully equipped business centre and conference and meeting facilities for more than 250 individuals. A lobby, hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a bar, restaurant, laundry service and car park are also at guests' disposal. Each room is equipped with a TV, telephone, minibar, tea/coffee maker, electronic safe and individually regulated air conditioning to ensure guests' comfort. All rooms are en suite and are furnished with a double bed.

136958.description: The hotel is located on Military Road, Marol at the heart of IT and BPO surroundings like SEEPZ, MIDC, Powai and Andheri Kurla Road. The hotel is just 2 km away from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport and 5 km from Mumbai's domestic airport. This is a budget business hotel close to Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport. It ensures a memorable stay with its unmatched style, elegant design, dedicated service and world class facilities. The hotel is a preferred choice for both corporate and leisure travellers. The air-conditioned establishment offers a lobby, hotel safe, Internet access, room and laundry services and a car park. All hotel rooms are designed with the maximum of comfort and amenities such as cable television, a telephone, writing desk and a safe deposit box. The en suite bathrooms are fitted with a shower and a bath. Each room additionally comes with Internet access, a mini fridge and tea and coffee making facilities.

136960.address: Building No.2, Near Bandra Court,Off W.E.
136960.description: The hotel is conveniently located at Bandra, also known as the 'Queen of Suburbia', situated at heart of Mumbai city. The hotel is in close proximity to the Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), the up-and-coming business and commercial hub, as well as to Bandra Railway Terminus. It lies just a few minutes away from Mumbai International Airport and Mumbai Domestic Airport. This hotel redefines the concept of hospitality and is committed to providing guests with the finest facilities. A collection of classy rooms is divided into Standard and Deluxe categories and fitted with modern amenities to ensure a memorable stay. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby, a hotel safe and a restaurant. Guests can take advantage of the room and laundry services and there is parking available for those arriving by car. The hotel provides comfortable, spacious and well-furnished rooms. All come with a private bathroom with hot/cold water. The rooms are equipped with modern amenities such as a telephone, a TV, a work desk and tea and coffee making facilities.

136964.address: 24Th Rd., Bandra, Off Turner Road, Bandra (West)
136964.description: Located in the 'Queen of Suburbs' - Bandra, Grand Residency Hotel and Serviced Apartments is an easy-to-access all-encompassing hotel with serviced apartments. Graciously blending into the commercial and luxurious lifestyle, and embodying corporate flair, it is the landmark of status. Experience the privileges of being in close proximity of the city's business center, as well as one of the most luxurious and lively locales. Discover innumerable comforts that make it an ideal choice for the traveler, offering the best of both worlds - business and leisure. Grand Residency Hotel and Serviced Apartments is also a most contemporary and spacious serviced apartment hotel in Mumbai, 15 minutes from the prime business hub, The Bandra Kurla Complex. Its easy accessibility to the Domestic and International Airports gives the location an edge for the business and international traveller. Grand Residency Hotel and Serviced Apartments is just 4. 35 km away from Hinduja Speciality Hospital and 3. 66 km away from Lilavati Hospital. Situated in the heart of Bandra, Hotel Grand Residency is surrounded by various fine-dine restaurants in Mumbai, sea-side promenades, shopping vistas and an exuberant nightlife.

136978.address: Dr. Charat Singh Colony, Near Mirador Hotel, 102
136978.description: This hotel is located near to the Andheri-Kurla Belt, Sakinaka, Powai, the Bandra Kurla Complex, Kalina and the Western Express Highway. It lies just 13 km away from the international airport and close to the domestic airport. This business class hotel is distinguished by its exceptional facilities for business support, relaxation and entertainment. Guests here can choose from an array of accommodation options for short or extended stays. The hotel also provides spacious business conference rooms with all facilities to meet the needs of corporate and business travellers. Further facilities on offer to guests include a lobby, a hotel safe and a restaurant. Guests can also take advantage of the laundry service and there is parking for those arriving by car. The hotel offers rooms which are comfortable, well-furnished and self-contained, providing all basic facilities and modern amenities to make guests' stay pleasant. All rooms come with a private bathroom and are equipped with a direct dial telephone, a TV, Internet access and an electronic safe. Furthermore, a mini fridge, tea and coffee making facilities and individually regulated air conditioning are provided in all accommodation as standard.

136979.description: This hotel is located just 500 m away from Powai Lake and close to the most important business districts such as Andheri, Mulund and Ghatkopar. The Western Express and Eastern Express Highways are just 10 minutes away from the hotel and it lies only 14 km from the international airport. This business class budget hotel offers world-class facilities, and its fully furnished plush interiors are a perfect choice for business as well as leisure travellers. This establishment offers the best of both worlds - business as well as pleasure. The hotel also provides well-equipped function rooms with audiovisual equipment and facilities that make them ideal venues for business meetings, seminars, conferences or private functions. Further facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe and lift access. There is a restaurant and guests can also take advantage of the room and laundry services. There is parking available for those arriving by car. The hotel offers guests smartly designed rooms with fine furnishings, elegant interiors and wooden flooring. Every room is equipped with all modern amenities and comes with a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer. They are equipped with a telephone, a TV, a safe, a minibar and tea and coffee making facilities. Furthermore, individually regulated air conditioning units are provided in all accommodation as standard. Sports enthusiasts may enjoy a work-out in the gym and guests can relax with a massage treatment.

136981.address: Plot 211, Chakala, Sahar Rd, Opp Cigarette Factory
136981.description: This superb hotel is located on Chakala Sahar Road close to a myriad of attractions that the enchanting city of Mumbai has to offer. Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport is conveniently situated just 2 kms away. This charming hotel enjoys a superb elegant design blended with opulent Indian vibrance and opulence. The guest rooms are sublimely-appointed, featuring soothing tones with subtle splashes of vibrant colour, offering the ideal surroundings where guests can relax and unwind in an intimate environment. The hotel provides a host of facilities and amenities, catering to guests' conference and dining needs and requirements.

136982.address: 3Rd Rd., Next To Khar Railway Station, Khar (West)
136982.description: The UniContinental is a centrally located Boutique hotel in the heart of Mumbai, adjacent to Khar railway station (west). The hotel is approximately 3 km from the domestic airport, the Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC) and Juhu Beach and only 6 km from the International Airport. This hotel features modern furnishings, well-appointed interiors and offers well-equipped air-conditioned rooms including a penthouse apartment suite and 4 suite rooms.  Facilities on offer to guests include an air-conditioned lobby with WLAN Internet access, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility, a cloakroom and lift access.  There is a café, a bar, a Pub and a restaurant on the premises. The hotel also provides a conference hall with state-of-the-art facilities for business gatherings. Guests can also take advantage of the room and laundry services, and there is parking available for those arriving by car. The rooms feature pleasant décor and are equipped with all world-class facilities and modern amenities. They come with a private bathroom with 24-hour hot and cold running water. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable LCD TV, Internet access, a safe, a minibar and tea and coffee making facilities. Furthermore, individually regulated air conditioning units are provided in all accommodation as standard.

136985.address: Guru Gobind Singh Marg,Near Khar Rly Station(West)
136985.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Mumbai near Khar railway station and Linking Road, Bandra and the BKC ground. It is just 4 km from Santacruz domestic airport and 7 km from the international airport. This business hotel offers all the modern facilities required by business travellers and leisure travellers alike. The hotel is known for its affordable accommodation, well kept rooms, nearby restaurants and bars, and services which make guests' stay a pleasant one. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area and guests can take advantage of the room and laundry services. The hotel also provides a mini conference room for small meetings. Parking is available for those arriving by car. Each room is equipped with all modern amenities. All rooms come with a private bathroom and are equipped with a telephone, cable TV and individually regulated air conditioning units.

136989.description: Ilum Experience Home offers 27 guestrooms. 42-inch plasma televisions come with cable/satellite channels. Complimentary wireless Internet access is provided along with complimentary newspapers and in-room safes. Bathrooms include bath tubs and complimentary toiletries. City or courtyard views are featured in guestrooms. Minibars and climate control are also included. Ilum Hotel has a Gym and a breakfast area. Breakfast and Spa Access are both only included in Standard rate plans. In case of Non Refundable rates, those services could be included at an additional cost.

name.content: Element New York Times Square West

136990.description: Discover your ideal getaway at Element New York Times Square West, where you’ll enjoy the convenience of a hotel room with the comfort of home! Take advantage of a well-equipped 24-hour fitness center and an on-site market to satisfy your cravings. Start your day with our complimentary continental breakfast served weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. The hotel also features a business center, dry cleaning service, a laundry room, and two meeting rooms, ideal for your next event. Relax in one of 411 air-conditioned rooms, each with kitchenettes, full-sized refrigerators, and stovetops. Enjoy a restful night on comfortable pillowtop beds, catch your favorite shows on the LCD TV with cable programming, and benefit from complementary wireless internet throughout your stay. Experience convenience and comfort in the heart of New York City!

137009.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Airport Shuttle. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s). Enjoy views of the New York City skyline as you relax at the conveniently located Hilton Hasbrouck Heights/Meadowlands hotel. Situated close to key Northern New Jersey destinations such as Teterboro Airport, the Meadowlands Complex, Hackensack University Medical Center and the Izod Center, the inviting Hilton Hasbrouck Heights/Meadowlands hotel is also just a short drive from the excitement of New York City. Whether you are sampling our casual American cuisine at Bistro Six Five Zero, keeping up your exercise regimen at our state-of-the-art fitness center, enjoying our seasonal outdoor pool, or prepping for a meeting in the 24-hour business center, our friendly and dedicated staff will make sure your stay at Hilton Hasbrouck Heights/Meadowlands meets every expectation. Our experienced team can also help you plan a special event to remember. From our IACC-certified meeting spaces to our sky-level ballroom with sweeping views of New York City, our Hasbrouck Heights hotel offers a large and welcoming space appropriate for corporate events and storybook weddings. Come enjoy our welcoming atmosphere, comfortable accommodations and exceptional value.

137010.description: NoMo SoHo embodies the artistic spirit of its neighborhood, a vibrant hub of major design firms, couture houses, and bespoke boutiques. Easily access all of Manhattan, including Times Square, Central Park, the Empire State Building, Madison Square Garden, the Brooklyn Bridge, the 9/11 Memorial, Rockefeller Center, the New York Public Library, and Lincoln Center. Breathtaking decor and an energetic vibe await you at NoMo SoHo, a stylish destination hotel in SoHo, renowned for fashion and design. The hotel features NoMo Restaurant and NoMo Bar, a vibrant bar and nightlife space. Whether you're exploring world-class shopping or New York's cultural and historical landmarks, NoMo SoHo provides a convenient base. Return each evening to luxuriously appointed guestrooms designed for relaxation and rejuvenation.

137024.description: The NH Collection Plaza Santiago sits in the financial heart of Chile's capital city and across the road from Constanera Center, the largest shopping mall in South America. There are plenty of top-quality restaurants along nearby Isidora Goyenechea, while Trader's Bar is the perfect place to relax after a long day with its happy hour buffet and great selection of local wines. Arrive in style at our heliport on the top of the building and stay in our romantic Royal Suite with Jacuzzi, a favorite with honeymoon couples. The NH Collection Plaza Santiago is also close to the luxurious boutiques of Nueva Constanera and Alonso de Córdova, and the hotel's amenities offer a great way to unwind after a day's shopping. The pool is free to hotel guests. We have 159 comfortable, air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi and extra space for work or meetings. You can enjoy wonderful mountain views from rooms on the higher floors. Our 9 fully-equipped rooms can host meetings, video conferencing and events for up to 200 people.

137099.description: Located in Doha, Hyatt Regency Oryx Doha is in the suburbs, within a 5-minute drive of Doha Corniche and Gold Souq. This luxury hotel is 1. 9 mi (3. 1 km) from National Museum of Qatar and 2. 5 mi (4. 1 km) from Museum of Islamic Art. Pamper yourself with onsite massages and body treatments. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, gift shops/newsstands, and wedding services. Make yourself at home in one of the 400 guestrooms featuring minibars and espresso makers. 43-inch LED televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Enjoy international cuisine at Choices, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Doha? This hotel has 10312 square feet (958 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 11 meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite.

137180.description: Offering 74 one-bedroom apartments and 4 two-bedroom suites. Guests have all the trimmings of a hotel and all the comforts of a home. Offering fully equipped gym, sauna and hot tub facilities as well as a pool deck situated on the roof top guests can relax and enjoy a healthy life style. Property Highlights: * Conveniently located to shops, schools and entertainment facilities. * Close to beaches. * Offers fully serviced apartments. State of the art CCTV system throughout the building. * Underground parking garage, central air-conditioning. * Electronic apartment door locking system. Electronic building access control. * Fully equipped gym and roof top pool. Additional Services: * Complimentary Transport to “The Mall of the Emirates”. * Transport to Dubai International Airport.

137182.description: Enjoy a stay at Palazzo del Giglio, nestled in Venice's City Center, a short walk from iconic landmarks such as Teatro La Fenice (3 minutes) and St. Mark's Square (5 minutes). This hotel offers convenient amenities including complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and room service. Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge after a day exploring Venice. The 24 air-conditioned rooms provide comfort and convenience with minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and bidets, safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include St Mark's Campanile (0. 4 mi) and St. Mark's Basilica (0. 4 mi).

137190.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as wireless internet access (surcharge) and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include wedding services, a television in a common area, and a ballroom. Grab a bite to eat at Avere, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Featured amenities include wired internet access (surcharge), limo/town car service, and a computer station. Make yourself at home in one of the 321 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and LCD televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters. Cable programming provides entertainment, and wired and wireless internet access is available for a surcharge. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Barclays Center Brooklyn - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Brooklyn Bridge Park - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- New York Harbor - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Brooklyn Bridge - 2. 3 km / 1.

137208.description: Located just five minutes from Piraeus, one of Europe's largest ports, this stylish, modern hotel offers family-friendly accommodations. The 56 guest rooms have been fully renovated and feature private bathrooms with showers and hairdryers, along with amenities such as internet access, TVs, and refrigerators. Individually controlled air conditioning and central heating are standard. Some rooms also include balconies, verandas, or large windows showcasing city views. Guests can enjoy a delicious continental breakfast and lunch menu in the hotel's restaurant, and a 24-hour reception and check-out service is available in the lobby. On-site garage parking is also provided for guests arriving by car.

137287.description:
This uniquely designed hotel will impress guests from the moment they arrive. Initially built in the 16th century, the solid brick structure preserves the spirit of the time. Wooden beams support the three-story building and luxurious loft, complete with two 18th-century gables. Staying at this historic hotel offers the perfect opportunity to experience the lagoon city. Restaurants, shops, and public transport are all within the immediate vicinity. Most importantly, major landmarks such as St. Mark's Square, the Scuola Grande di San Rocco, Santa Maria Gloriosa dei Frari, and the romantic canals are just a short stroll away. 

The Municipality of Venice has established (on some specific dates) the payment of an access fee. All persons staying in the accommodation facilities of the Municipality of Venice are exempt. To obtain the exemption please contact the hotel or visit the website of the Municipality of Venice https://cda. ve. it/it/

137306.address: Ng Complex, Near Ashok Nagar, Militry Road
137306.description:
Attractively situated in the Andheri district of Mumbai, Capital O 68855 Ace Residency is situated 4.2 km from Phoenix Market City Mall, 5 km from Powai Lake and 5 km from Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay. Featuring a shared lounge, the 3-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with a private bathroom. The accommodation features a 24-hour front desk and room service for guests.

The rooms in the hotel are fitted with a TV with cable channels. The units have a wardrobe.

Guests at Capital O 68855 Ace Residency can enjoy a buffet breakfast.

Bombay Exhibition Centre is 8 km from the accommodation, while ISKCON is 9 km from the property. The nearest airport is Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport Mumbai Airport, 2 km from Capital O 68855 Ace Residency.

We speak your language!

137307.description:
Located in Vile Parle (East), the hotel provides easy access to all commercial hubs and shopping areas in Mumbai. The hotel is just half a kilometre away from the domestic airport and within walking distance of the Vile Parle railway station.

The hotel provides all modern conveniences required by guests for a comfortable and convenient stay.
