The hotel provides well appointed, fully furnished and comfortable rooms that are equipped with all modern amenities including an air conditioner, telephone and a television. Each room has an attached bathroom with hot and cold water.

The hotel includes a restaurant and bar named Siachen that serves delicious multi-cuisine dishes.

137311.description: On the shore of the Firth of Forth, Queensferry is situated ten miles to the north of Edinburgh. So the Premier Inn Hotel Edinburgh (South Queensferry) is the ideal base for venturing into Scotland's first city, or for exploring the majestic landscape of the Lothians. Queensferry has some puzzling traditions, like the procession of the Burry Man and the annual dip in the Firth of Forth. But there are plenty of other things to do, such as a visit to the Georgian splendour of Hopetoun House or Dundas Castle. There are lots of business venues and good transport links. Once you're done for the day, come back to great food at our Brewers Fayre restaurant and a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

137313.description: This 4 star hotel is located within the city of Vienna and was established in 2007. It is close to the Shopping Street and the nearest station is Wien Westbahnhof. The Hotel has a restaurant, a bar, a conference room and a fitness centre/gym. All 174 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, ironing set and air conditioning.

137331.description: Residencial Alcobia offers 38 comfortable units with Wi-Fi throughout. The front desk is available 24/7. Guests can also reserve one of three charming one-bedroom apartments, each with a kitchen and private bathroom, located a short five-minute walk from the main hotel. These apartments are situated on the 2nd, 4th, or 5th floor (please note there is no lift). Check-in and breakfast are at Grande Pensão Residencial Alcobia. This eco-conscious hotel is committed to sustainable practices and holds relevant certifications. Some services may incur additional charges.

137360.address: Adjacent To Kalpana Cinema Lbs, Marg, Near Bandra
137360.description:
The hotel is located adjacent to Kalpana Cinema on LBS Marg, in Kurla West. It is situated close to the business hub of the Bandra Kurla Complex. Kurla Railway Station is 5 km away from the hotel. The domestic airport is located 4 km away, while the international airport is 5 km away from the hotel.

This air-conditioned hotel features modern décor, and is practical for travellers due to its convenient location. The hotel offers its guests state-of-the-art facilities to provide them with a pleasant stay. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception service, as well as a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and a cloakroom. Facilities on offer to guests include a newspaper stand. Guests can enjoy a drink at the café, and dine in the breakfast and dining rooms. Conference facilities are available to business travellers. Guests can enjoy the convenience of Internet access. They can also take advantage of the room and laundry services, and a housekeeping service is available. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel car park.

The hotel provides budget-class, yet comfortable accommodation. It offers well-designed and fully furnished rooms, which come with modern amenities. All rooms come with an en suite bathroom with a shower/bath and a hot and cold water supply. Guests can enjoy a good night's rest on their double bed. Rooms also come equipped with a telephone, safe and minibar. Standard in-room amenities include satellite/cable TV and Internet access. Furthermore, tea and coffee making facilities, individually regulated air conditioning and individually regulated heating are provided in all accommodation units as standard.

137364.address: Old Nagardas Road, Pump house subway, 30
137364.description: Situated on Old Nagardas Road, off the Western Express Highway, this hotel offers convenient access to Mumbai's key attractions. The well-appointed interiors feature a lovely décor. Guests can enjoy a range of amenities including complimentary buffet breakfast, 24/7 check-in, on-site parking, and Wi-Fi. Several dining options are located nearby, and the Mumbai Airport and Railway Station are easily accessible.

137377.description: This hotel enjoys an excellent situation in the very centre of Madrid. Guests will find varied shopping opportunities nearby, and easy access to cinemas and theatres. Moreover, the city's most important museums are within walking distance, minutes away from the hotel. It is ideal for business travellers and holidaymakers alike and offers an extremely pleasant atmosphere. Facilities on offer a TV lounge, a cafe, a restaurant and Wi-Fi as well as room and laundry services.

137395.description: The 5-star Hotel Portón Bogotá offers luxurious boutique accommodations in the upscale La Cabrera district of Bogotá. A short five-minute walk from the Zona Rosa, guests enjoy easy access to premier shopping centers, businesses, restaurants, and entertainment venues. The hotel features 39 exquisitely appointed rooms with soundproof windows, LCD TVs, safes, minibars, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Select rooms also offer a relaxing hot tub. The on-site restaurant, Le Jardin Perdu, serves a delightful menu of international and local cuisine. Guests can unwind with a drink at El Olmo bar, open from 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM. Additional amenities include a business center, laundry service, parking, a gym, and 24-hour room service. Each individually decorated room provides a refined atmosphere with luxurious linens, a private bathroom, and thoughtful touches like a hairdryer, work desk, and alarm clock. Guests can choose from double or king-size beds. Other conveniences include a direct-dial telephone, radio, microwave, coffee/tea maker, iron and ironing board, and individually controlled air conditioning.

137404.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a spa tub and a fitness center. This Art Deco hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Grab a bite to eat at Ander Local Food, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Buenos Aires? This hotel has 452 square feet (42 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Make yourself at home in one of the 35 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars.

137405.description: Situated in Microcentro and Recoleta neighbourhoods, this hotel offers easy access to the best commercial and business centres. Further facilities include a fitness centre, swimming pool, breakfast room, and meeting rooms. Guests may dine in the café or restaurant and sip their favourite drink in the bar. Business guests will appreciate the conference facilities. For additional convenience, there is free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, room and laundry services and the garage.

137419.address: Ebussuud Cad. Saffetipasa Sok. no:4 Sirkeci Fatih, 4
137419.description: The hotel is located in the old city, close to Sultanahmet. Restaurants, shops and public transport can all be found within a 5 minutes' walk. The Eminönü bus station is around 1 km and Sirkeci railway station is some 400 m away. Sabiha Gökçen International Airport is some 50 km from the establishment. This 31-room city hotel opened in the 1960s and was renovated in 2010. It has a café and bar/restaurant where guests can try traditional water pipes. Wireless Internet is available free of charge in the lobby as well as a lift, 24-hour reception service and currency exchange facilities. The air-conditioned establishment also offers a hotel safe and room service. All rooms come with an en-suite bathroom, a telephone, satellite TV, individually regulated air conditioning and central heating. Internet access and a mini-bar are also provided.

137420.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 63 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

137421.description: Situated in Istanbul's city center, this hotel, established in 2009, is a short walk from iconic landmarks like the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Topkapi Palace. Sirkeci Train Station and the Grand Bazaar are just a 15-minute stroll away, while Ataturk Airport is 20 km from the property. Guests will find a variety of shops, bars, and restaurants nearby. The hotel's 17 guest rooms feature modern amenities, including a minibar, hairdryer, safe, ironing set, and air conditioning. The on-site cafe-restaurant offers delicious Turkish cuisine, and a rooftop terrace provides panoramic views of the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia in the summer.

137422.description: This wonderful hotel offers guests the ideal setting from which to explore the delights and intriguing sights that the mesmerising city of Istanbul has to offer. Just 1 km from Sultanahmet, the hotel is a mere leisurely stroll away from the Bosphorus and Galata Tower. Guests will find themselves in the perfect place from which to enjoy an exciting shopping experience at the Spice Market, or to sample the culinary delights the city has to offer. The hotel welcomes guests with a soothing air of peace and tranquility, seemingly miles away from the vibrant city which lies just outside. The guest rooms are beautifully presented, providing comfortable surroundings in which to relax and unwind at the end of the day.

137425.description: Ideally located in the historic Laleli district on Istanbul’s Old Peninsula, Mirilayon Hotel offers an excellent base for discovering the city's rich cultural and historical attractions. Many of Istanbul’s iconic landmarks, including the Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Basilica Cistern and Topkapi Palace, are within walking distance, while public transportation provides easy access to Taksim Square, Nişantaşı and other key areas of the city. The hotel combines modern comfort with warm Turkish hospitality, making it an ideal choice for both business and leisure travellers. Guests can enjoy elegant accommodation, a restaurant, meeting facilities and a Wellness & Spa centre featuring a Turkish bath, sauna, steam bath, fitness centre and a variety of massage treatments. Stylishly appointed rooms are equipped with modern amenities, including complimentary Wi-Fi, minibar and tea & coffee making facilities, ensuring a comfortable and relaxing stay

137464.description: Conveniently located just a 5 minutes' driving distance outside the historic town of Stellenbosch, this stunning aparthotel is beautifully nestled amongst the Bottelary Valley hills in the heart of the Cape Winelands. It offers an idyllic setting for travellers who are seeking a holiday with that extra something special. The complex features 20 self-catering apartments and 10 guest rooms, all of which offer an oasis of peace and serenity in which to relax and unwind. The accommodation options come complete with modern amenities for guests' relaxation and enjoyment. The complex provides a magnificent 18-hole golf course, as well as a pool area where guests can enjoy a leisurely swim, or simply lie back and revel in the beauty of the surroundings.

137467.description: Discover the scenic Beyoglu District, minutes from the historic downtown Istanbul. Pera Museum, the Museum of Innocence, and many local restaurants are nearby. Taksim Square, the Istanbul Lutfi Kirdar International Convention Center, and Galata Port Shopping Mall are within four kilometers city center as well

137469.description: Located right on the bank of the Spree, the nhow Berlin is just a short distance from Berlin Tegel Airport and Berlin Central Station. The nhow Berlin has many nearby attractions. Guests will find that the Oberbaumbrücke, the Arena Badeschiff, and the Ratibortheater are all within walking distance. However, this hotel offers more than the usual in terms of in-house entertainment. Immerse yourself in art and music at our in-house concerts, exhibitions and fashion shows. Our freshly designed selection of 304 soundproof rooms offer guitar and keyboard room service, Ipod docking stations and flat screen TVs besides free Wi-Fi, minibars, Nespresso machines rain effect showers etc. Upgraded larger rooms feature connecting rooms, sitting areas, sofas, and a sofa bed. Cats and dogs are welcome to stay with their owners. A daily breakfast buffet is prepared for guests along with cooked-to-order hot dishes which are available upon request. For lunch and dinner, Restaurant Fabrics opens its doors and offers local and international cuisine. Our gym is equipped with a sauna and our spa offers guests a Finnish sauna, steam baths, and biosauna. For meetings and events, there are 12 function spaces with the biggest Spree terraces in Berlin.

name.content: Eric Vokel Boutique Apart Sagrada Familia Suites

137506.description: Located in the historic Eixample dreta area, on Industria street, this splendid apartment hotel is set in an early 20th-century building only a stone's throw from the celebrated Sagrada Familia cathedral. Guests will find the main shopping area, Paseo de Gracia, just a 5-minute metro ride away, and the famous attractions of Casa Batllo and La Pedrera are within easy reach. Other places of interest such as Plaza Catalunya, Las Ramblas and the port are just a 7-minute metro ride from the property. The aparthotel itself features luminous one- and two-bedroom apartments, each spacious and modern with a full kitchen, bathroom and furnished terrace. Guests can enjoy additional services such as a convenient 24-hour reception desk with multilingual staff, Wi-Fi Internet access and luggage storage services, all for a wonderful city break or successful business trip to Barcelona.

name.content: Eric Vokel Boutique Apartments Bcn Suites

137507.description: These enchanting apartments are conveniently perched in Barcelona, just a few steps from the imposing Sagrada Familia and within walking distance from La Pedrera or Casa Batlló the vibrant Gràcia district with its multiple restaurants, bars and shopping opportunities is just steps away. Visitors will find themselves within easy reach of links of public transportation, allowing them easy access to the other parts of the city and to the nearest beach. This elegant establishment presents beautiful modern design and fantastic, air-conditioned penthouses and 2-bedroom apartments, some of the latter are provided with 2 bathrooms. The spacious and bright units are fitted with commodious furniture and cutting-edge amenities to guarantee a fully comfortable and enjoyable stay. The property has a private parking and visitors may inquire with multilingual staff at the reception for the best places to see in Barcelona.

137514.description: The hotel is 20 minutes' drive from Dubai International Airport and Abu Dhabi International Airport is 45 minutes' drive away. Mall of the Emirates is only 5 minutes walking distance away from the hotel. The aparthotel offers elegant and well-appointed meeting rooms - Acacia and Capparis - which are ideal for corporate gatherings, seminars, workshops, conferences, luxurious events, product launches or weddings. With an adaptable meeting space and a team of professionals, guests are assured of a flawless event. Built in 2010, the air-conditioned establishment features 143 apartments, a lobby with 24-hour reception, lift access, a breakfast dining room and room service. Each apartment features a separate lounge with attached kitchen as well as world-class facilities. All are en suite and offer a shower, TV, safe, tea and coffee making facilities, and ironing set. The hotel health club facilities include a gym, rooftop swimming pool and hot tub, male and female saunas and a steam room. Guests can enjoy the upbeat modern atmosphere restaurant 'MnM', serving international buffets and á la carte menus for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

137525.description: This 5-star hotel offers the finest experience in Santiago, located in the upscale Las Condes district near elegant boutiques, restaurants, and financial institutions. Enjoy local and international cuisine in the gourmet restaurant or unwind with drinks at the bar. A state-of-the-art business center helps you achieve your objectives, while versatile conference rooms host both social gatherings and corporate meetings. The lobby features a 24-hour reception, safe, currency exchange, cloakroom, and elevators. Amenities include wireless internet access, room service, parking, and a garage. This is a smoke-free hotel.

137541.description:
The riad is located approximately 10 minutes' walking distance from the Famous Djemaa el Fna square, in a lively area with shops in the palaces quarter (El Badi Palace, Bahia Palace and Royal Palace). Marrakech-Menara Airport is situated at a distance of approximately 15 km.

Built in 1900 and renovated in 2009, the establishment offers 6 rooms, a patio, a dining room and a TV lounge. It provides open terraces to fully enjoy quietness and sun in summer time and a cosy lounge with a fireplace in winter time. The decoration is simple, traditional and elegant. The property also features a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, a cloakroom, laundry service and car park. For additional fees guests may make use of the Internet access and room service.

The three categories of rooms (Standard, Superior Double and Junior Suite) are decorated in a simple and traditional way. Located on the ground floor, on the first floor overlooking the patio and on the 2nd floor directly on the terrace, they are all equipped with a shower, individually regulated air conditioning and heating and an individual safety box. In addition, they have a hairdryer, double bed, Internet access and a balcony or terrace.

The riad features 2 sun terraces with sun loungers and parasols laid out for use and a small indoor swimming pool (fees apply to all). The golf course is around a 10-minute drive from the hotel.

Dinners are available at La Table Al Badia, lunches on the terrace or in the lounge by the fireplace. Traditional Moroccan cuisine is available.

137558.description: A total of 235 accomodation units are available for guests' convenience.

137603.description: 91 rooms at different concepts are waiting for its guests to experience the beauty of Istanbul and to prove the Turkish hospitality in CVK Taksim Hotel Istanbul. With the fascinating location in Taksim; the shopping, culture, and entertainment district of İstanbul, CVK Taksim Hotel İstanbul offers you a comfortable and cozy ambiance in the heart of the city, with its impressive İstanbul and Bosphorus view and stylish rooms. Located at İstiklal Street, where the never-ending İstanbul dream can be experienced, CVK Taksim Hotel İstanbul makes its guests embrace the spirit of the city. The hotel is in close proximity to cultural, entertainment and shopping centers, and promises you a comfortable stay in which each and every detailis taken care of. Feel the joy of being in the heart of the city with CVK Taksim Hotel İstanbul.

137656.description: Hotel is located in the heart of the central business hub of Mumbai, Hotel Silver Inn - Mumbai International Airport is easily accessible from the International as well as the Domestic Airports. Our Hotel offer's 43 spacious rooms spread across six floors which have been re-designed with modern functionality and design aesthetics. Our refreshing suites, comfortable luxury bedding & functional work spaces offer the perfect blend of upscale amenities for business travellers. Rooms come with Wi-Fi, desks and flat-screen TVs with satellite channels. They also feature seating areas and minibars, as well as tea and coffee making facilities. Room service is available. The hotel offers free parking and breakfast. Other amenities include a casual international restaurant, a coffee shop and banquet halls. There's also event space.

137658.description: The hotel is located in the heart of the city and close to various shopping arcades and provides easy access to other points of interest. The hotel is an ideal choice for business travellers due to its close proximity to various business districts. The hotel is within walking distance of the C. S. T. station and just 23 km away from the international airport. The hotel provides traditional Hindustani hospitality with 80 rooms and suites tastefully designed to make each guest's stay a pleasant and comfortable experience. The hotel rooms are equipped with all modern amenities and comforts. Rooms also come with queen or king-size beds and private balconies.

137660.address: Plot No. 37, Sector 30-A, Vashi, Navi Mumbai
137660.description: The hotel is located strategically in the heart of Navi Mumbai at Vashi which is a fast developing area. It is also near to commercial and business districts. The international airport is about 18 km from the hotel and the railway station is approximately 15 km away. This is a world-class business hotel built on an expansive field with a panoramic view. The hotel provides comfortable rooms, an exclusive lounge and unmatched services to assure its guests a memorable experience. The hotel is an ideal place for both business and leisure guests. The premises are air-conditioned and guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception service. Facilities include a hotel safe, currency exchange and a hairdressing salon. Guests can wine and dine in the bar and restaurant. Conference facilities are available to business travellers. Guests can take advantage of the room and laundry services on offer, and those who are arriving by car may park their vehicle in the hotel's car park. The hotel rooms exude a sense of luxury and comfort. They are categorised under various headings in order to suit the budgets of various travellers. Rooms are equipped with the best of amenities, such as a tea/coffee maker, safe and a minibar. Each room also has an en suite bathroom. Further amenities include a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV and an iron and ironing board. Guests can take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool and relax with a massage treatment.

137661.description: The hotel is located on a central avenue in a quiet corner of the bustling city of Chembur. The hotel is within walking distance of Chembur station and about 7 km from the international airport. The hotel has been conceptualised and designed with a desire to make each guest's stay a memorable experience. The hotel is air-conditioned and guests are welcomed in a lobby. There is Internet access available and guests can take advantage of the room and laundry services on offer. There is also a rooftop conference and banquet hall, which is ideal for holding conferences, parties and get-togethers, and certain to satisfy the needs of every traveller. The hotel provides well-appointed, elegantly designed and spacious rooms. The hotel rooms are air-conditioned and are complete with all world-class facilities and amenities like satellite television, Internet access, a direct dial telephone, a minibar and a safe for a comfortable stay. Tea and coffee making facilities are also provided. Moreover, each room has an en suite bathroom with a shower and a bath.

137668.description: Hotel Garden Mumbai offers a tranquil escape in the heart of bustling Colaba, just 600 meters from the iconic Gateway of India. Enjoy spacious, well-appointed rooms with complimentary Wi-Fi and breakfast. Relax in the terrace garden with views of the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel. Conveniently located near Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus (3. 5 km) and Colaba bus depot (1. 9 km), exploring Mumbai is effortless. Discover nearby attractions like Marine Drive (3. 5 km), Apollo Bunder (600 m), Nariman Point (3. 5 km), and Cuffe Parade (1. 5 km). Indulge in the legendary cafes of Leopold's (400 m) and Mondegar's (900 m), and explore the vibrant Colaba Causeway just 50 meters away.

137669.description: Situated in the heart of Churchgate on Veer Nariman Road, this budget-friendly hotel offers convenient access to Mumbai's prime commercial, business, entertainment, and shopping districts, with excellent dining options just steps away. A mere 20 minutes from Mumbai Airport and close to the railway station, it caters to both corporate and leisure travelers. The hotel provides comfortable, clean accommodations with amenities such as air conditioning, room and laundry services, and on-site parking. Each room features an en suite bathroom with a shower and bath, as well as running hot and cold water, cable television, telephone, in-room safe, and internet access.

137670.description: The hotel is located in the heart of Thane on the Eastern Express Highway. The hotel is in close proximity to various points of interest and is just 2 km from Thane railway station and 30 km from the international airport. This is a budget hotel with modern decor and elegant interiors making each guest's stay a thoroughly pleasant experience. The hotel provides an air-conditioned conference room with capacity for about 50 people to cater to the needs of corporate travellers. There is also a bar at the hotel and guests can take advantage of the room and laundry services on offer. The rooms of the hotel are well furnished, tastefully designed and comfortable. All the rooms are air-conditioned and complete with amenities like cable TV and a direct dial telephone. Internet access and tea and coffee making facilities are also provided. The deluxe rooms have a minibar, refrigerator and a luxurious en suite bathroom with a shower and a bathtub.

137671.address: Next To R-Mall, L.B.S. Marg, Mulund West
137671.description: Surrounded by beautiful hills, the hotel is located in Mulund West in close vicinity to shopping centres, multiplex cinemas and it is also near industrial and commercial districts. The international airport is about 30 minutes' drive from the hotel. This business hotel provides comfortable accommodation and all facilities for both the business traveller as well as leisure travellers for a pleasant stay. Surrounded by the lush greenery of the Yeoor hills, a stay at the hotel gives guests the feeling of space with comfort and luxury. The interiors of the hotel are pleasing and the 31 rooms, restaurant and conference halls are also well appointed with deep primary colours. The premises are air-conditioned and guests are welcomed in a lobby. Internet access is provided and guests can take advantage of the room and laundry services on offer. Those arriving by car may park their vehicle in the hotel's car park. The hotel provides well-appointed, spacious and tastefully decorated rooms. The rooms of the hotel are air-conditioned and complete with all modern amenities like a telephone, satellite/cable television and an en suite bathroom with a shower. There is a bathtub in the executive deluxe room.

137672.address: Opp. Jupiter Hospital, Near Flower Valley
137672.description:
This business hotel is located next to the Flower Valley Complex on Eastern Express Highway in Thane and is close to various points of interest. The hotel is about 40 km away from the airport.

The hotel is a blend of tradition and modernity with the finest hospitality traditions and unmatched services making each guest's stay a memorable experience. The premises are air-conditioned and guests are welcomed in a lobby. The hotel also provides a spacious conference hall with capacity for up to 50 people equipped with projectors, microphones, Internet access and other services. There is a bar on site and guests can take advantage of the room and laundry services on offer.

The hotel provides well-furnished, elegantly designed and spacious rooms. Every room has tea and coffee making facilities, an LCD satellite/cable TV, Internet access and a minibar. Each room also has an en suite bathroom with a shower and a bath.

137695.description: Situated in the heart of Knysna, the Knysna Log-Inn Hotel is just steps from the Cape Floral Region Protected Areas and a short stroll from the vibrant Knysna Quays. This charming hotel offers 57 guestrooms, each featuring a private balcony, flat-screen television, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast served from 7:00 AM to 9:00 AM. Guests can also enjoy the outdoor pool and free on-site parking. Nearby attractions include Knysna Lagoon, Pledge Nature Reserve, and the Knysna Waterfront, all within easy walking distance. The nearest major airport is Plettenberg Bay (PBZ), approximately 34 kilometers away.

137712.description: The modern apart hotel IQ Callao by Recoleta Apartments enjoys an ideal situation in the heart of the fashionable and secure area of Recoleta, surrounded by numerous shops, restaurants and banks. It features contemporary studios, 1- and 2-bedroom apartments as well as a lovely rooftop terrace with outdoor pool and hot tub. Attractions such as the National Library of Argentina, the Water Company Palace or the cemetery of Recoleta where guests can visit Evita Perón's grave are just a few minutes' walk away.

137714.description:
The comfortable hotel Atlantico Praia is ideally situated close to the most famous beach of the world, the Copacabana in Rio de Janeiro. It enjoys fantastic views over the Atlantic Ocean and the iconic Sugarloaf Mountain is within easy reach. Guests can take a stroll along the Avenida Atlântica. The centre of Rio de Janeiro can be reached within a 20 minutes' drive. 
The Hotel is undergoing exterior painting renovations on the building, at the back - city view (standard category), this renovation is temporary.

name.content: NH Collection Madrid Palacio de Tepa

137745.description: Designed by Juan de Villanueva, NH Collection Madrid Palacio de Tepa is set in the building that served as a palace for Count Tepa. Today, the hotel provides the perfect location to access all of Madrid's iconic sites. Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen museums are close by, as are the Royal Palace, Plaza Mayor and Puerta del Sol. For the gourmands, walk to some of Madrid's most famous restaurants, such as Botín and Casa Lucio. The rooms at NH Collection Madrid Palacio de Tepa are spacious and let in a lot of natural light. Many enjoy fantastic views of historic Madrid. Connecting rooms are available and all rooms are equipped with free Wi-Fi. A gym and spa are available on-site. The hotel's Guest Relations team will be delighted to assist you in purchasing tickets or making reservations during your stay. In the morning, delight in a fresh breakfast. A 7-minute walk away from the hotel, you will find Paco Roncero Restaurante, a gourmet restaurant awarded two Michelin stars.

137748.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, a terrace, and a garden. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and wedding services. Dine at Antica Ristorante, specializing in Italian cuisine, or enjoy room service (limited hours). Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily (fee applies). Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. This New York hotel offers 880 square feet of event space, including conference space and two meeting rooms. The 369 guest rooms feature flat-screen televisions, pillowtop beds with down comforters, Wi-Fi (surcharge), and cable programming. Bathrooms include showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include the Holland Tunnel (0. 3 mi), New York University (0. 5 mi), and Washington Square Park (0. 8 mi). The nearest airports are LaGuardia (LGA), Newark Liberty (EWR), and JFK International.

137773.description: This charming riad boutique hotel enjoys a prime location in Marrakech's Medina, in the heart of Dar El Bacha, just a short 7-minute walk from the vibrant Djemaa El Fna Square. Essaouira's beaches are a scenic 2. 5-hour drive away, and Marrakech-Menara Airport is conveniently located approximately 5 km from the hotel. Built in 1900 and renovated in 2009, this air-conditioned hotel seamlessly blends contemporary design with traditional Moroccan elements. It offers 10 well-appointed rooms, a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, a relaxing TV lounge, a café, and a restaurant serving both Moroccan and Western cuisine. Guests can also enjoy a refreshing dip in the patio swimming pool, unwind in the oriental hammam with massage and spa treatments, or soak up the sun on the terrace. Additional amenities include conference facilities, internet access, room and laundry services, and on-site parking. Each room features air conditioning and a plasma TV. To reach the riad from the airport, take a taxi to Dar El Bacha in the medina. From the car park, attendants with carts can guide you to the riad's entrance, just 100 meters away.

137802.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After practicing your swing on the golf course, you can dip into one of the 5 outdoor swimming pools. This Art Deco hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can get around on the shuttle (surcharge), which operates within 15. 00 kilometers. Grab a bite at Waterside Grill, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 3 bars/lounges. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in Herolds Bay? This hotel has 12917 square feet (1200 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 3 meeting rooms.

137819.description: The Radisson Blu Hotel Zurich Airport in Kloten offers convenient access to Zurich Airport. This upscale hotel provides 330 guest rooms with LCD TVs, complimentary wired and wireless internet, and private bathrooms. Enjoy on-site dining at Filini Restaurant, 24-hour room service, and a daily breakfast buffet (fee applies). The hotel boasts a spa with massages and facials, a business center, and extensive conference facilities. Hallenstadion and the Swiss National Museum are within a 15-minute drive.

137850.description: The Evelyn, a historic landmark in the heart of Manhattan's NoMad district, offers a unique blend of Beaux-Arts architecture and Art Nouveau-inspired interiors. Built in 1903 and designed by William H. Birkmire, this distinguished hotel, formerly the Hotel Broztell, is ideally situated near iconic landmarks such as the Empire State Building, the Flatiron Building, and Madison Square Park. Just steps from Fifth Avenue shopping, Greenwich Village, and Times Square, and conveniently located near the 6, N, and R subway lines, The Evelyn provides easy access to all of New York City. LaGuardia Airport is a mere 8 miles away. The recently renovated rooms feature modern amenities while retaining the charm of the Art Nouveau period, making it the perfect choice for travelers seeking a stylish and convenient Manhattan experience.

137885.address: Merkez Mah. Akdeniz Blv. Turkler Kasabasi, 4
137885.description: Located 18 km from Alanya, the pearl of the Mediterranean, our hotel sits in Türkler, a district famed for its sandy beaches. We're conveniently situated 5 km from Avsallar and Konaklı centers, 90 km from Antalya Airport, and 60 km from Gazipaşa Airport. Opened in 2011, our complex comprises five two-story main buildings and five three-story villas, offering a total of 470 modernly furnished rooms equipped for a pleasant and enjoyable holiday. Start your day with our daily breakfast buffet and savor fresh seafood and local dishes in our restaurants, along with refreshing drinks and snacks from our bars. For a delightful culinary experience, choose from our main restaurant and five à la carte options featuring Ottoman, Italian, Asian, and Grill cuisines.

137887.description: Situated in the centre of Sultanahmet, the hotel is just a stone's throw from Topkapi Palace and the fabulous Basilica Cistern with the Grand Bazaar being no more than 10 minutes stroll away. Istanbul International Airport is about 45 km from the property. Close to practically everywhere worth visiting in the old city, this hotel combines Turkish hospitality with the historical attractions of the city of Istanbul. Rooms are well decorated, come equipped with air-conditioning, smart TV, tea and coffee facilities and bathroom with shower and toiletries. The hotel features a roof-top breakfast room overlooking Marmara Sea and the Sultanahmet Blue Mosque or guests can enjoy a wide selection of drinks at the bar, located on the 1-floor.

137888.description: One of the earlier hotels to be built in the area, this beach resort was renovated in 2010 and added an additional building and outdoor pool. Located in Kumkoy, 6 km west along the coast from the historical centre of Side, the hotel has its own section of the beach and offers a wide range of facilities suitable for families. Just a few minutes' walk from the hotel can be found some shops/bazaar and café bars, and public transport is available allowing easy access to the wonderful centre of Side where the present-day village exists amongst the Hellenistic and Roman ruins of the ancient city.

137909.description: Ideally situated near the Agdal Gardens and the city ramparts, with a bus station just 50 meters away, this hotel is a short 10-minute walk from the renowned Djemaa el-Fna square. Marrakech Menara Airport is a mere 4. 3 kilometers away. The air-conditioned hotel welcomes guests with a 24-hour reception and check-out service. Facilities include a children's playground, café, pub, and restaurant. Guests can also enjoy internet access and laundry service. All rooms feature individually controlled air conditioning, modern appliances, and comfortable furnishings for a restful stay. En-suite bathrooms are standard, and some rooms also boast a balcony or terrace.

137936.description: Situated in the prestigious Las Condes neighbourhood and overlooking a stunning landscape of lush, green mountains, this modern boutique hotel is the ideal base for exploring the area whether travelling for business or a leisurely family holiday. Numerous embassies, the United Nations Santiago offices, and public transport links can be found nearby, and guests can take the kids to KidZania Santiago, hit the links at Los Leones Golf Club, and take in art and culture at the Ralli Museum. The hotel offers impeccably elegant suites, and business travellers can make use of the versatile onsite business centre and meeting rooms. The hotel also offers a range of helpful facilities and services including free parking and a tour desk. Guests may take a refreshing swim after a busy day in the hotel's outdoor or indoor pool, relax in the sauna, work out in the health club, and enjoy delicious Chilean cuisine at the hotel restaurant on a pleasant business trip or holiday.

137938.description: On a quiet, tree-lined street in the residential neighborhood of El Golf, steps from Santiago's best shopping and business district. Close to the metro, supermarket, fine shops, and the headquarters of important companies. Located in the capital's most exclusive restaurant and pub district. Quick route to the airport. Practical apartments, fully equipped and decorated in a modern style, with hotel services, will allow you to enjoy your business or visits with complete peace of mind. Facing a beautiful plaza and overlooking gardens, steps from all the activity in the best area of ​​Santiago. The building features electronic access with magnetic locks in each apartment and public areas. Check-in must be done at Callao 2988, in our Time Suite property, located 50 meters away.

137941.description: This extended stay 7-storey hotel welcomes its guests to a large variety of accommodation options - from apartments, to studios to one-bedroom suites. All of them feature fully-equipped kitchenettes, bathtubs, flat-screen TVs and an office area. All suitable for the different tastes and desires. It is located in the new Monceau neighbourhood. Near is the Parc des Bruyères, a 2-hectare park, unique place that is perfect for a relax walk or refreshing jog. Paris city centre is a 5-minute drive away, as are the La Defense and CNIT business districts. It takes about 14-minutes to reach the famous department stores and Champs Elysees and around 8 minutes to the exhibition centre. This convenient location means that both business travellers and tourists will be well positioned.

137942.description: This traditional Moroccan house is situated in the district of Kasbah, in the medina of Marrakech, near the famous Djemaa el Fna square in the historical town centre. Menara Airport is about 10 minutes away by car (approximately 5 km). It features a lobby with a 24-hour reception, a hairdressing salon, bar, restaurant, Internet access and a car park. Its 5 elegant rooms are en suite and equipped with a shower, hairdryer, Internet access and a balcony or terrace. Guests can take a refreshing dip in the swimming pools or relax under the parasols. There is also a gym onsite. The riad offers Moroccan meals which can be sampled in the various spaces of the property, in the lounge with its original fireplace, on the patio under the orange trees or on the sunny terraces.

137952.description: Enjoying an incredible location just steps from the Museo del Prado, this hotel is the embodiment of culture and sophistication in Madrid's artistic Golden Triangle. It lies within a stone's throw from nearest metro station and the popular department store, while Atocha train station is just 500 metres away. This charming boutique city hotel comprises sumptuously designed rooms and suites. Each unit features classical elegance in design complemented with city images and cutting-edge amenities. There is a café, and the special whisky bar on the patio offers views of the skyline. . Guests may select their continental breakfast from a buffet and the midday and evening meals may be enjoyed à la carte. Corporate guests will appreciate the Internet accesses provided, while spa enthusiasts may treat themselves to ultimate relaxation in the spa and health centre with a steam room and hammam.

137955.description: Ideally located in the prime touristic area of Downtown Dubai, Wyndham Downtown Dubai promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, fireplace, gift/souvenir shop are there for guest's enjoyment. All rooms are designed and decorated to make guests feel right at home, and some rooms come with television LCD/plasma screen, clothes rack, linens, mirror, towels. Recuperate from a full day of sightseeing in the comfort of your room or take advantage of the hotel's recreational facilities, including badminton court, fitness center, outdoor pool, children's playground, pool (kids). For reliable service and professional staff, Wyndham Downtown Dubai caters to your needs.

137956.address: Meydan Racecourse Al Meydan Road, Nad Al Sheba
137956.description: While the golfer in the family is out on the course, try one of the other recreational amenities offered, such as an outdoor pool or an outdoor tennis court. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. For lunch or dinner, stop by Farriers Restaurant, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 645834 square feet (60000 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

137957.description: The 3-star Allegro Barcelona is a boutique hotel with a futuristic design located in the popular Eixample neighbourhood in the centre of Barcelona, next to the Rambla de Catalunya and 3 minutes from the Paseo de Gracia. Thanks to this excellent location, it is surrounded by tourist attractions (La Pedrera, Casa Milá and Casa Batlló), as well as restaurants and leisure facilities. Designed by architect Nadal Moneo and interior designer Tomás Alia, the hotel blends in perfectly with the architecture of Barcelona's city centre. It has 56 modern, practical, functional rooms offering complete comfort for couples, groups of friends or families. Decorated with modern and avant-garde décor, they ensure a perfect rest. The Allegro Barcelona hotel offers a full breakfast buffet, in addition to other services including a concierge service, laundry and room service. All of this makes the Allegro Barcelona hotel the perfect choice for a work trip or a getaway with your partner, friends or family in a boutique hotel in Barcelona's Eixample.

137971.description: Sitting close to the Tour Asnières business park, this residence complex offers excellent transport links to the entire area. Its guests will be only 300 metres from the RER C Les Grésillons suburban train station that provides easy access to the centre of Paris and a 20-minute walk from the Gabriel Peri Asnieres-Gennevilliers subway station. The venue itself is the perfect place for all travellers who enjoy a more independent living lifestyle. The spacious studious and apartments come with fully-equipped kitchens that are ideal for preparing delicious home-like meals and separate living and working quarters. They all also feature complimentary WiFi access and large LCD TVs for some entertainment.

138030.address: Plot 49 Sheikh Zayed Road, Trade Centre District D
138030.description: Welcome to voco® Dubai. Ideally situated across the street from the World Trade Centre and a metro stop with direct links to Dubai's most iconic attractions including the Burj Khalifa, Museum of the Future, Dubai International Financial Centre, The Dubai Mall, and Dubai Frame. With 471 contemporary guestrooms designed to elevate your stay, voco® Dubai boasts a perfect fusion of modern comfort and thoughtful amenities. Whether you're here for business or leisure, our rooms provide ample space to unwind and recharge, ensuring a memorable experience. Indulge in a culinary journey at our diverse dining venues, where international flavours tantalize your palate with every bite. From gourmet treats to savoury delights, our restaurants offer an array of options to suit every taste and preference. Pamper yourself at our club lounge with gourmet treats and spectacular views through floor-to-ceiling windows, promising a truly indulgent experience. Experience the convenience of versatile meeting and event facilities, including spacious meeting rooms, a boardroom, and a ballroom, ideal for hosting successful business gatherings. Plus, unwind after a busy day at our health club, ensuring a perfect balance of work and leisure for discerning travellers. Discover the epitome of comfort and premium at voco® Dubai, where every detail is meticulously crafted to exceed your expectations and create unforgettable memories. That's voco® Dubai.

138155.description:
Venice-Marco Polo airport is approximately 15 minutes away from this structure and Treviso-Canova airport is around 30 minutes away. 
Hotel President Venice is located 10 minutes from Piazzale Roma of Venice, easily reachable by tram. 
It is renowned for its elegant appointed environment, warm atmosphere, outstanding hospitality and impeccable service. 
In the surroundings, there are plenty of restaurants, bars and cafés perfect for a lovely evening having a nice meal or a well-needed drink break. It is characterized by a discreet elegance and an exquisite familiarity. 
This establishment features large, refurbished and elegant accommodation. 
 All rooms are equipped with an en-suite bathroom. 
The restaurant serves its guests a hearty and delicious buffet breakfast. 
The rooms are perfectly decorated to make every guest feel the most comfortable and enjoy their stay.

138217.address: Corner Lower Long Hans Strijdom Streets 214217421, 0214217421
138217.description: The hotel is modern, sophisticated and perfectly located in Cape Town's Foreshore. The hotel is conveniently located within walking distance of the Cape Town International Convention Centre (CTICC), the Victoria and Alfred Waterfront and the Two Oceans Aquarium. The neighbourhood is loaded with award-winning restaurants, night clubs, coffee shops, delis and gift shops. It is only 5 minutes drive from the Cape Town Stadium. Cape Town International Airport is situated at a distance of approximately 20 km from the hotel. This apartment hotel offers luxury accommodation, facilities and the surrounding area offers entertainment and activities for every taste. Facilities provided at the hotel include a lobby with 24-hour reception, lift access, a hairdressing salon, a café and a breakfast room. WLAN Internet access is available for a fee and those arriving by car may leave their vehicle in the garage. Daily cleaning and laundry services ensure a comfortable and hassle-free stay. Guests are offered a choice of 3 designer studios, 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom apartments or an exquisite penthouse. Each apartment is stylishly furnished and equipped with a luxurious en suite bathroom with a shower, an air-conditioned lounge, dining room and a fully functional kitchen with a fridge, cooker and microwave. A plasma screen TV with DSTV, double beds, and Internet access in the rooms ensure a comfortable stay. Guests have an outdoor swimming pool and a gym at their disposal.

name.content: The Langham New York Fifth Avenue

138225.description: The Langham, New York, Fifth Avenue, offers an ideal Midtown Manhattan location on Fifth Avenue, steps from world-class shopping, entertainment, museums, and businesses. A short walk from Grand Central Terminal, Times Square, and the Empire State Building, and less than an hour's drive from JFK, LaGuardia, and Newark airports, The Langham places you in the heart of the city. This 60-story limestone tower offers 234 residentially styled guest rooms and suites featuring Swedish Duxiana beds, Italian Pratesi linens, marble bathrooms with rainfall showers, and oversized windows framing iconic skyline views. Enjoy Michelin-starred cuisine at Ai Fiori, Chef Michael White's Italian and French Riviera-inspired restaurant and bar, or unwind at the Chuan Body and Soul spa.

138450.address: Caferaga Mh Albay F Sozdener Cd, 31
138450.description: The outdoor pool is open from May 15, 2024 - September 30, 2024. For additional information, please contact the hotel directly. Welcome to the first Hilton Worldwide hotel on the Asian side of Istanbul. The DoubleTree by Hilton Istanbul-Moda hotel offers upscale accommodations and the most convenient of locations on the Asian side of Istanbul. Located in the heart of the bustling commercial center of Kadikoy and the historic residential district-Moda, the hotel enjoys a prime coastal position within a 5 minute walk of the Kadikoy Ferry Docks. This luxury Istanbul hotel is less than 30 minutes from either Istanbul International Airport (IST) or Sabiha Gökcen International Airport (SAW) (by car or shuttle). Situated within walking distance of the Kadiköy Bus Station, and soon the new underground station, the Hilton Istanbul-Moda hotel is the perfect choice when staying in the lively and cosmopolitan district of Moda-Kadiköy on the Anatolian side of the Bosphorus.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Birmingham Star City

138461.description: A Birmingham hotel near Star City, with free parking and breakfast included. Holiday Inn Express® Birmingham - Star City hotel is just off the M6 motorway at Junction 6 and is a 10-minute drive from the city centre. Alternatively, leave your car in the hotel’s complimentary car park and hop on a bus into town from the stop near the hotel. A short drive away, Aston Station offers local train services. Birmingham Airport (BHX) is a 25-minute drive from the hotel. Business guests can host events for up to 40 people in our five flexible and fully equipped conference rooms. A short walk from the hotel, StarCity entertainment centre houses a multi-screen cinema, bowling alley and indoor mini golf. A quick drive away, you can browse high-street shops at the Bullring retail complex. Twenty minutes by car takes you to the varied exhibition and event programme at the National Exhibition Centre or the rides and attractions at Drayton Manor amusement park. At this hotel you can enjoy Free Wi-Fi throughout and complimentary on-site parking. Set yourself up for the day with our inclusive Express Start™ Breakfast buffet, featuring scrambled eggs, sausages and continental items. In the evening, relax in the lounge bar over a chilled glass of wine with friends, or if you're feeling peckish, order a bite to eat from the snack menu.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Istanbul  Old Town

138465.description: Explore nearby museums and Istanbul attractions including the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace from the Doubletree by Hilton Istanbul –Old Town hotel. Located in Istanbul’s central historical district, this Istanbul hotel is a five minute walk from Istanbul’s famous Grand Bazaar. Thoughtfully designed to blend into the Old City’s historical surroundings, our new Istanbul hotel offers a variety of modern and stylish accommodations, all featuring amenities such as luxurious Sweet Dreams® beds, internet access and satellite TV. Celebrate in the Doubletree by Hilton Istanbul – Old Town hotel’s top floor ballroom or choose from four flexible meeting spaces, all with the latest in audiovisual technology. Take in historical peninsula views as you savor international cuisine and unique Turkish flavors in Terrace Restaurant or choose from the open buffet breakfast in the relaxed atmosphere of the Old Town Restaurant at this Istanbul hotel. Refresh in the Turkish Hamam, enjoy a relaxing massage or re-energize with Doubletree Fitness by Precor®. Our caring and hospitable hotel staff look forward to welcoming you to the Doubletree by Hilton Istanbul – Old Town hotel with our signature, warm Doubletree chocolate chip cookie at check-in.

138488.description: The 4-star Hotel Eurotel offers modern European style in a prime location in Santiago's tourist and financial center. Its 55 comfortable rooms feature LCD TVs, private bathrooms with amenities, work desks, safes, free Wi-Fi, and breakfast served in the restaurant. Choose from double or twin rooms. For events, the hotel provides five well-equipped rooms suitable for seminars and banquets. The H'otelo Restaurant serves international cuisine, including French specialties and Chilean wines. Guests can also enjoy a professionally equipped gym, open from 7:00 a. m. to 11:00 p. m. The rooms, bathrooms, lobby, and restaurant were last renovated in November 2017.

138518.description: Located 7. 5 miles from St. Stephen's Cathedral, Hotel Attaché contactless offers complimentary Wi-Fi. A bus and tram stop is conveniently located right outside. Elegant rooms are decorated in a modern or classic style and feature air conditioning, a safe, and a bathroom with a hairdryer. Belvedere Palace, Karlskirche Church, and the Taubstummengasse underground station (line U1) are within a 10-minute walk.

138521.description: This city design hotel, housed in a classical 19th-century building, combines the atmosphere of the period with 21st-century technology. The beautiful rooms offer the perfect blend of functionality, comfort, and modern design features, where guests can relax and enjoy their stay. Its location in the cultural and commercial center of the city places guests in the middle of all the fun and excitement. The hotel is just 100 meters from the Omonia metro station, offering links to every point of the city, including Athens International Airport and Piraeus port. On foot, guests can explore the ancient Acropolis and Plaka, visit the famous Syntagma Square and Monastiraki, and finish their trip by browsing the boutiques on Ermou Street and grabbing a bite at the restaurants around Kolonaki Square.

138522.description: This hotel is located in the commercial centre of Athens, just a 1-minute walk from Omonia central station. It lies 1 km from the National Archaeological Museum, 1. 3 km from Monastiraki, 1. 6 km from Plaka, 2. 1 km from the Acropolis/Parthenon and 2. 3 km from the New Acropolis Museum. Piraeus beach is 10 km away and it is 25 km to Alimos and its beach and 32 km to Athens International Airport. Renovated in 2021, this city design hotel has been carefully and tastefully decorated, offering a pleasant, clean and inviting atmosphere. It comprises a total of 51 rooms over 9 floors. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe and lift access. There is a cafe, a 24-hour bar and a large breakfast room where a traditional continental breakfast is served. Guests will appreciate the wireless Internet access. The rooms are simply decorated and come with a private bathroom with a shower. They offer a queen-size bed and are equipped with a direct dial telephone, a TV, a desk and free high-speed wireless Internet access. Furthermore, individually regulated air conditioning and heating are provided in all accommodation as standard. All rooms also feature either a balcony or a terrace. Guests are served breakfast each morning. Guests arriving from Athens International Airport by metro will need around 70 minutes to get to the hotel. They should take line 3 towards Egaleo, change at Syntagma station to line 2 towards Agios Antonios and get off at Omonia station, then walk down Pireos street. It is also possible to reach the hotel by bus X95, getting out at Syntagma terminal station, then taking metro line 2 towards Agios Antonios and getting off at Omonia station. From the Port of Piraeus, guests can get to the hotel by train. They should take line 1 from Piraeus, get off at Omonia station and then walk along Pireos street.

138524.description: This hotel is located just minutes away from all the excitement of Athens, very close to the National Archaeological Museum, the ancient market and the National Theatre. It lies minutes from the Acropolis (2 km), Ancient Agora (2 km) and the new Acropolis Museum. It is centrally located only blocks away from the shopping and commercial districts of Kolonaki Square and Ermou Street. Renovated in 2010, this is a modern city hotel housed in an urban design building and offering quality services. It comprises a total of 8 single rooms and 23 double/twin rooms spread over 6 floors. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service and lift access. There is a bar and a breakfast room and guests will also appreciate the free Internet access. The accommodation comes with a shower and 2 single beds. The rooms are equipped with a direct dial telephone, a TV, a radio, a desk and free high-speed wireless Internet access. Furthermore, individually regulated air conditioning and heating are provided in all accommodation as standard and all rooms feature either a balcony or a terrace. Guests are served a continental breakfast each morning.

138541.address: Av. El Bosque Norte 0124, Las Condes
138541.description: This modern hotel offers top-notch European-style and a perfect setting. It is conveniently located in Las Condes, the financial centre of the capital and its most important gastronomic area. It offers easy access to the airport, the civic centre and the ski resorts that are located in the outskirts of Santiago. It is also within a 15-minute drive from both the bus and railway station, with shuttle services available. The elegant venue welcomes its guests to comfortable and spacious rooms, that are beautifully-appointed and each open to a nice terrace that presents magnificent views towards and city and the mountains. Each room comes with a hospitality corner, where guests can prepare some light snacks or the invigorating morning coffee. Business travellers can take advantage of the fully equipped auditorium and the high-speed WiFi, that will help them stay on top of their workload.

138546.description: This hotel is located next to the lively République Square and just 200 metres from the metro station. The hotel has an oriental-style exterior and it offers soundproof rooms. The hotel is located in a lively area with many bars and restaurants. The metro allows guests to reach the famous Champs Élysées in just 15 minutes, and the Place de l'Opera and the Bastille in just 10 minutes. Guests may also choose to walk for 10 minutes to either Canal Saint-Martin or the Georges Pompidou Centre. Charles de Gaulle Airport and Orly Airport are both about 30 km away.

138548.description: The hotel occupies a beautifully renovated neoclassical building in the heart of old Athens, near the Ancient Agora and the Central Market. The picturesque neighborhoods of Plaka, Psirri, the Acropolis, and the Parliament are within easy reach. A short walk connects you to a vibrant array of restaurants and nightclubs, offering diverse entertainment options day and night. The hotel is conveniently located two minutes from Monastiraki metro station, 45 minutes from the airport, and 25 minutes from Piraeus port. Its location, services, and magnificent rooftop terrace views make it an ideal choice for both business and leisure travelers.

138556.description: This cosy and modern hotel is situated in the heart of Paris, just 2 minutes from the Grands Boulevards Metro Station. The hotel offers rooms with LCD TV with satellite channels and a minibar in the rooms. Modern and colorful design combines the style of Parisian cabarets with Scandinavian influences for an ambiance that is equally suited for business or leisure trips. Its cozy atmosphere will win you over. A perfect location for fast access to the most sought-out neighborhoods in Paris. Famous attractions such as Folies Bergère, Opéra Garnier, Galeries Lafayettes, Printemps or Louvre Museum are within walking distance; Notre Dame Cathedral, Place de la Concorde, Champs Elysées and the Basilica of Sacré Coeur are within easy reach.

138594.description: The hotel is situated in the centre of Le Marais. Ideally located in the centre of Paris within the triangle formed by the Marais quarters, the Louvre and the Opéra (with the famous department stores), the hotel offers a great place to stay, from which guests can easily visit Paris' most famous places for tourists, entertainment and business. Gare du Nord railway station is about 1 km away. The city hotel offers the comfort of its 28 rooms. If guests are looking for a great place that feels safe and clean on a budget, this is a good choice. The hotel has a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services. Internet access is also provided. Each room has an en suite bathroom with a shower. Amenities include a direct dial telephone and a TV. The hotel serves a continental breakfast buffet. From Charles de Gaulle Airport: take RER B, stop at Gare du Nord station then change for line 7 in the direction of Place d'Italie and stop at Republique station. From Orly Airport: take Orlyval to Antony station then change for RER B in the direction of Paris. Stop at Chatelet station then change for line 11 in the direction of Mairie des Lilas and stop at Republique station. From Gare du Nord station: take line 7 in the direction of Place d'Italie and stop at Republique station.

name.content: Best Western Plus The Hub Hotel

138640.description: CIN: IT015146A17JBJALZ4The hotel is set in a strategic location, only 4 kms away from Fiera Milano, and only 5 kms from Fiera Milano City. The hotel offers a free shuttle service to both trade fair locations. Linate Airport is approximately 13 kms from the hotel and Malpensa Airport is roughly 39 kms away. Comprising a total of 162 rooms, the hotel features a modern congress centre, including 9 meeting rooms, all provided with the required equipment. The air-conditioned establishment welcomes guests in the lobby with a 24-hour reception service, a café bar and a restaurant. A hotel garage is available as is free Internet access. Each room features an en- suite bathroom, direct dial telephones, TV, Internet access, mini-bar and tea and coffee making facilities. Air conditioning and central heating also feature as standard. A breakfast buffet is served each morning, while lunch and dinner are served à la carte.

138648.description: Located on Passeig de Gràcia, just steps from Gaudí's Casa Batlló and other modernist façades, Mandarin Oriental, Barcelona offers avant-garde luxury in a prestigious setting. A short walk from Las Ramblas and the Gothic Quarter, the hotel is surrounded by the city's finest shopping, dining, and cultural venues. Housed in an elegant mid-20th-century building, the hotel boasts stylish interiors and acclaimed restaurants. Its 120 guest rooms and suites overlook Passeig de Gràcia and its renowned modernist architecture. The hotel is conveniently located a short 30-minute drive from Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN).

138660.description: Located in Long Beach this oceanfront hotel offers 143 luxurious guest rooms and suites. Guests will be mesmerized by the breath-taking views of the Atlantic Ocean and the New York City skyline, which the venue presents. Sitting at less than 40 km from Manhattan and 5 blocks from the Long Island Railroad, this property offers a year-round beachfront escape that embodies relaxed elegance, sophistication and style. Build in 2009 it delivers everything needed for corporate events and meetings, romantic getaways, weddings, family celebrations and special occasions. On top of it all the modernly decorated rooms offer the comforts required for a truly relaxing vacation – large beds with plush bedding with high-count Egyptian cotton, spa showers and bathtubs and a fully functional spa centre that can provide more than a little treat.

138675.description: This charming hotel is a 5-minute walk from Porte de Saint-Cloud Metro Station, which lead directly to Trocadéro and the best views in the city of the Eiffel Tower. Guests can walk to the Bois de Boulogne in 30 minutes and go rowing on the lake or visit the Porte de Versailles Exhibition Centre, 2 km away. Local transport links lead directly to the city centre and Galeries Lafayette department store. Thus, the district is a great choice for travellers interested in sightseeing and shopping. The air-conditioned rooms are decorated in a contemporary style with red and neutral tones. Offering Wi-Fi access and an LCD TV, they all look onto the street or the little courtyard. A buffet breakfast is proposed in the small breakfast room every morning. Additional facilities include luggage storage and a 24-hour reception where guests can buy drinks. However, free French wine, cheese and other local products can be enjoyed every day.

138676.description: In the heart of the Opera Garnier district, the hotel enjoys an exceptional location for leisure and shopping, just minutes from the Place de la Madeleine. The location invites guests to stroll along the big department stores such as Galeries Lafayette on Boulevard Haussmann. There are restaurants, bars and nightlife spots in the immediate vicinity, while the Mogador Theatre is 100 metres away and Place Vendome is around 400 metres away. The air-conditioned city hotel offers 42 rooms in total and combines high-end facilities with elegant décor featuring exotic wood furniture and brightly coloured wall coverings. The hotel will delight guests with its comfortable rooms and suites which are beautifully decorated in a chic Art Deco style. Each unit features an en-suite bathroom with toiletries, a double bed with champagne-coloured duvets, climate control, and a private balcony or terrace.

138681.description: Located In the heart of Constantia, a hotel rich in heritage and filled with modernity, awaits. Retreat into modern sophistication and timeless charm on the edge of the Constantia Greenbelt at this Provincial Heritage site. Having evolved into an exceptional five-star boutique hotel, with luxury in every detail, guests are ensured a world-class experience from the moment they arrive. Feel at home in this undeniably timeless boutique hotel with every modern touch imaginable. The Alphen Boutique Hotel & Spa boasts 18 designer suites that overlook the magnificent, sprawling gardens and surrounding nature. From our heritage architecture with original fireplaces from centuries past, a heated pool and lush lawns, to a tranquil spa and three unique restaurants; Cape Town doesn’t get any more tasteful or timeless than this.

138685.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Make yourself at home in one of the 56 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Beyazit Square - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Grand Bazaar - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Column of Constantine - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Süleymaniye Mosque - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Little Hagia Sophia - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 1. 5 km / 0.

138692.description: The hotel is located in the centre of Palermo Hollywood, the true heart of Buenos Aires, only 40 minutes from Ministro Pistarini International Airport and 16 minutes from Jorge Newbery Airport. This particular French hotel of 1904 was renovated in 2010 and is elegant and modern. With a total of 11 guest rooms, the air-conditioned establishment welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. It offers a cloakroom, lift access, a café, bar, breakfast room, WLAN Internet access, room service and bicycle hire. The rooms are all equipped with a double bed or king-size bed. The bedrooms are decorated with their own colours, material and theme, following the Feng Shui philosophy. The rooms offer WLAN Internet access, a safe and a minibar. The en suite bathrooms are fitted with a shower and a hairdryer. A direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, individually regulated air conditioning and heating and a terrace also feature as standard. Guests may make use of the sun terrace, hot tub and massage service. A continental breakfast is served each morning.

138706.description: The hotel enjoys an exceptional location, right in the heart of Paris. It is conveniently close to top attractions such as the Louvre, the Palais Royal and the Comédie Française. Forum des halles, the Palais Royal, Rue Saint-Honoré and the Musée du Louvre are all about 500 m away. The Opéra Garnier is around 800 m from the establishment. This city hotel offers a total of 29 rooms. The former cellars of the property are now a cosy breakfast room. Coffee and tea are offered in the lobby, as are high-speed Internet access and complimentary newspapers. The friendly staff can arrange car hire, organise secretarial or translation services and offer sightseeing advice.

138707.description: Located a short walk from the Place de la Nation, the hotel enjoys a stunning location. The 5 metro lines at its doorstep allow easy access to the main highlights of Paris. The Bastille is around 1 km away, Cimetière du Père Lachaise is around 1. 8 km away, and the Bois de Vincess is roughly 2 km away. Paris-Orly Airport is some 17 km away, Paris-Charles de Gaulle Airport is about 22 km and Beauvais-Tillé is roughly 32 km from the property. The customised and innovative features offered by this 43-room city hotel are sure to delight leisure visitors, as well as business guests. There is a café and a loft-style breakfast room featuring a magnificent glass roof adorned by doves. The hotel also offers conference facilities, Internet access and room service. The hotel provides an advanced gym, equipped with the latest TechnoGym equipment.

138709.description: Located just a stone's throw from the Porte de Versailles Exhibition Centre and the Palais des Sports arena, this comfortably-sized hotel puts guests in the front row. The Gare Montparnasse railway station is some 500 m away and it is about 2 km to the Eiffel Tower. Orly Airport is 22 km and it is 28 km to Charles de Gaulle Airport. This city hotel offers guest accommodation with a peaceful, warm feel, and amusing, brightly-coloured, exotic decor. It comprises a total of 43 rooms, and the spaces are bright and stylishly decorated and furnished. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, a cafe and breakfast room. Guests will appreciate the Internet access and room service. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer and offer a double bed. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, free wireless Internet access and a safe. Furthermore, air conditioning and heating are provided in all accommodation as standard. Guests can take their breakfast in the pleasant dining area, or on the hotel's peaceful, central patio during the summer months.

138723.description: The hotel is located in a pedestrian street of the Old Town of Barcelona. The Liceu Theatre is 300 m from the hotel. Plaza Catalunya and the MACBA museum are 1. 1 km away, while the cathedral is 900 m from the hotel, all just a short walk from the hotel. La Sagrada Familia is around 2. 5 km away. La Ramblas is just some 100 m away and the beach at Barceloneta is around 1 km from the hotel. La Pedrera by Antoni Gaudí, also called Casa Milà, is around 1. 8 km away. The hotel opened in 1850, which makes it one of the oldest hotels in Barcelona. It was refurbished in 2000, keeping the original façade while completely rebuilding the interior, and now offers a total of 53 rooms, as well as a bar, lift access to the rooms and wireless Internet access throughout the building. This air-conditioned establishment offers non-smoking rooms. All rooms have individually regulated air conditioning and heating, a TV, telephone, desk, wireless Internet access, a safe and a private bathroom with a shower.

138733.description: This hotel is located directly on a private beach made of sand and pebble mixture at zero distance to sea. Only 1. 3 km from the centre of the popular holiday resort of Kemer with its restaurants, bars and shops. The regional capital of Antalya is 45 km away, the international airport 55 km. Public transport runs in front of the hotel providing access to nearby attractions such as the ancient city of Phaselis and Antalya's Inner Bailey and old harbour. The hotel is modern furnished and decorated and its grounds stretch down to the pebble beach. Rooms are air-conditioned and come with amenities as standard including with LCD TV, bathroom, hair dryer and safe. Guests can enjoy various daytime sport activities, live music and night shows. Guests can also ease mind and spirit at the spa experiencing care services from massage to care packages, to sauna and Turkish bath.

138734.description: A modernly styled hotel with an atrium lobby reaching up 4 floors with open corridors to the 109 rooms. Facilities include an indoor and outdoor restaurant, bars, shop, health club and a mini club and playground for younger guests. Refurbished in 2012, the hotel has a private section of the beach with sunbeds and umbrellas laid out ready for use. Access to the centre of Kemer is within a short ride by public transport or a 15-minute walk.

138737.description: Boasting an excellent location in the centre of Kemer, this comfortable hotel is within a few metres of the main shopping street where there are many café bars and restaurants to be found and less than 5 minutes' walk from the public beach. For those wishing to explore this beautiful part of Turkey's south coast, the bus station is just 2 km from property with links to the city of Antalya and ancient sites such as Olympos and Phaselis. Featuring a laid-back atmosphere, guests can choose to lie by the outdoor pool, take a rejuvenating sauna and massage or chill out in the hookah bar. Refurbished in 2013, the rooms are modern and equipped with amenities for guests' comfort and convenience.

138770.description: This conference hotel is situated in the heart of Franschhoek winelands on The Fransche Hoek Wine and Olive Estate. The exclusive hotel offers a sanctuary for the soul with its breathtaking view of the surrounding mountains, quaint cobbled streets, vibrant piazza and indigenous Fynbos landscape. Guests will experience a unique and unforgettable taste of the Franschhoek country lifestyle. The town centre of Franschhoek is around 1 km away, and restaurants, bars and tourist facilities can be found around 15 minutes' walk away. Cape Town and the beach are around 1 hour's drive away. Cape Town International Airport is some 65 km from the property. The hotel has a sense of old-fashioned community that abounds in this sanctuary, which offers weary city-dwellers the tranquillity and relaxed atmosphere of a five-star hotel. Here, residents can stroll the cobbled streets and meet neighbours and friends for coffee or a chat without the rush. And yet, in the midst of this courteous and kindly village with its vibrant piazza and swimming pools, are superior modern amenities and an unparalleled lifestyle.
