The hotel, which was built in 2008, offers a total of 57 rooms. Facilities at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby, 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, café, restaurant and conference facilities. Room service, laundry service and a car park are also offered. The villas are spacious and equipped with a full private bathroom with a shower, bath and hairdryer, an open-plan lounge and dining area, a fully equipped kitchen with a fridge, cooker, microwave and tea and coffee making facilities, and a balcony. There is also individually regulated air conditioning in the lounge and all the bedrooms. The bedrooms are beautifully decorated with lovely views. Other amenities include king-size beds, a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, hifi, Internet access, a safe, minibar, washing machine and an ironing set.

name.content: Best Western Premier Marina Las Condes

138786.address: Av. Alonso de Cordova 5727 Las Condes
138786.description: Discover the Best Western Premier Marina Las Condes, located in the sophisticated Las Condes neighborhood, with stunning views of the Andes Mountains. It's an excellent choice for exploring modern Santiago, Chile's largest city and business center, with easy access to world-class ski resorts. This upscale hotel, built between 2007 and 2010, offers 244 rooms, including four junior suites. Guests can enjoy a lounge bar, restaurant, meeting rooms, a pool, and a gym. Foreign non-residents paying with US dollars or credit card are exempt from tax, while Chilean residents and foreign residents will be charged the 19% VAT.

138787.description: Located in the upscale Las Condes district of Santiago, the 5-star Santiago Marriott Hotel offers luxury accommodations just a short walk from Parque Arauco Mall and Parque Araucano. Guests can indulge in the full-service spa with massages, body treatments, and facials, or enjoy the health club, outdoor pool, and sauna. The hotel's 280 guestrooms feature iPod docking stations, minibars, and LCD televisions with cable programming. Wired and wireless internet access are available for a surcharge. Dining options include two restaurants, 24-hour room service, and a coffee shop/cafe. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, express check-in, a conference center, meeting rooms, and airport shuttle service (surcharge). Self-parking is available onsite for a fee.

138792.description: The Hotel Bidasoa, a 4-star eco-boutique hotel in Santiago's exclusive Vitacura neighborhood, offers a unique blend of nature and city living. Recently expanded, it now boasts 87 uniquely designed rooms, each thoughtfully detailed for a warm and cozy atmosphere. Founded and still operated by the Sanz family, the hotel prides itself on providing a welcoming experience. Committed to sustainability, Bidasoa incorporates numerous ecological practices, earning its reputation as one of Latin America's most environmentally conscious hotels. The hotel features a garden, outdoor pool, restaurant, bar, free Wi-Fi, and parking. Guests enjoy a welcome drink upon arrival, and the cozy rooms include cable TV and a safe. With easy access to Santiago's attractions and entertainment, Hotel Bidasoa offers a timeless escape.

138795.description: This hotel is located in central Kemer, opposite the police station and just 350 meters from the beach. Restaurants and bars are within a short 50-meter stroll. Antalya Airport is 65 kilometers away. The 47-room establishment features air conditioning throughout, a bar/restaurant with hookah service by the pool, a café, and a 24-hour reception. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as currency exchange, a children's playground, and wireless Internet access. Each room includes an en-suite bathroom, individually controlled air conditioning and heating, a mini-fridge, and satellite TV. For relaxation, the hotel offers a sauna, a Turkish bath, and massage services. An outdoor swimming pool with a dedicated children's area, sun loungers, and parasols is also available.

138796.description: The airport hotel is located on the grounds of the business centre ENEA, only 5 minutes from the international airport and 15 minutes from the centre of Santiago. It is 2 minutes from the main motorway leading north and south of Chile and the 5th region. One of the most renowned hotels of its category thanks to the distinguished care provided by its staff and excellence in service, the hotel was designed for those seeking a comfortable hotel near the airport, thus guests can travel to various regions of the country easily. Renovated in 2010, the hotel has 134 comfortable rooms and welcomes its guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. The property also offers a shuttle service to and from the airport to its distinguished clientele. Fully air-conditioned, the establishment features a hotel safe, lift access, a café, a restaurant, WLAN Internet access and a laundry service. The rooms are equipped with a minibar, safe, WLAN Internet connection, double glazing to isolate the noise, air conditioning and central heating. They overlook the park from the airport and gardens sector. Further amenities in each room include cable TV, a private bathroom with a shower, bath and hairdryer, a radio, electronic lock and international direct dial telephone. Non-smoking rooms are available. 30 rooms are furnished with king-size beds and 104 with queen-size beds. The hotel features a pool for guests' use. A breakfast buffet is served each morning and lunch and dinner may be selected à la carte. Lunch is alternatively offered from a set menu.

138797.description: This historical city establishment was designed to preserve the 'Palacio Rivas' national heritage and is equipped to the highest standards of the modern hospitality industry. Recently renovated it seamlessly combines the facilities of a conference-hotel and a leisure destination. Located in central Santiago it is just steps from the main tourist areas, the government buildings and La Moneda subway station. The lively Lastarria district is approximately a 10-minute walk away and the famous Bellavista district can be reached for just over 15 minutes. At the end of their travels guests will be pleasantly surprised by the cosy beds in their comfortable, soundproofed and air-conditioned rooms. Each of them is tastefully decorated and has large windows that soak the natural daylight. If they need to cool-down a can dip in the outdoor swimming pool or chilled drink from the cafe-bar may do.

138861.description: This eco-friendly hotel boasts a hip and trendy design in the heart of Amsterdam, right next to the renowned Vondelpark. The RAI Congress Centre is a quick 10-minute bike or taxi ride away, and Leidse Square is easily reachable in 5 minutes by tram or bike. Guests enjoy exclusive access to day passes for David Lloyd Fitness, the largest fitness and wellness center in the Netherlands, located right next door. Start your day with a delicious organic and fair-trade breakfast. The hotel offers free Wi-Fi, a bar serving fantastic coffee, drinks, and snacks. All rooms feature modern LED TVs, comfortable beds, and bathrooms with walk-in showers. Sustainable furnishings include cradle-to-cradle carpets, desks made from recycled coffee cups, organic cotton bed linens and towels, and FSC-certified wood wardrobes.

name.content: Park Apartments Dubai,an Edge by Rotana Hotel

138867.address: Al Jaddaf, Oud Metha Road, Bur Dubai
138867.description: This luxurious aparthotel is the ideal accommodation for both business and leisure travellers alike, as it is very well positioned in the city centre of Dubai, a stone’s throw from the underground and 10 minutes from an Exhibition Centre and the airport. Moreover, some of the most important sightseeing sites are also nearby, such as the world’s tallest building known as Burj Khalifa. There are several accommodation options, ranging from 1-bedroom apartments to 3-bedroom ones. All of them are fully equipped and tastefully appointed to guarantee an unforgettable stay, thanks to the large beds and individual air-conditioning included. Corporate travellers may use the meeting facilities available, which include a small meeting room and business centre.

138898.address: Carrer De L Arc De Sant Ramon Del Call, 4
138898.description: This hotel is located in Barcelona city centre and is very well connected to all public transport links, making it ideal for any holiday or business trip. There is no better location; everything is within walking distance, including the cathedral, Las Ramblas, Barceloneta beach, the Picasso Museum and Plaza Catalunia. In addition, the local area features restaurants, cafés, bars and tourist attractions. This 26-room city hotel is clean, comfortable and well maintained and features wireless Internet access in the lobby. Other amenities available to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a reception area and lift access. The rooms are equipped with individually regulated air conditioning and heating units, a direct dial telephone, safety deposit box and a bathroom with a bath and shower.

name.content: Royal Club By RVHR, Palm Jumeirah

139099.description: Situated near the Aquaventure Waterpark and Dubai Marina, this popular hotel offers unique accommodations with easy access to Dubai's city center. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at high-quality restaurants, explore nearby shopping malls and cinemas, or stay active at the hotel's sports facilities. Golf enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity of three world-class courses within a 10km radius. The hotel's 50 well-appointed apartments and rooms feature air conditioning, safes, and internet access. Guests can also unwind in the refreshing outdoor swimming pool and relax on the provided sun loungers.

139100.description: This charming riad is set next to the El Badia Palace in Marrakech. Located in the medina, the riad is immersed in the rich culture and history of the city. The riad lies within easy access of a myriad of intriguing attractions in the city. Links to the public transport network can be found just 1 km away, offering ease of access to other areas to be explored. The railway station is just 2.5 km away. This riad is sure to impress, mixing traditional style with modern conveniences. Boasting a long historic dating back to the mid-18th century, the riad is sure to impress. The guest rooms are decorated in a striking style. The riad's facilities offer unprecedented comfort and convenience.

139117.description: Situated in Venice's historic center, this charming hotel overlooks the Rio del Gaffaro, a mere 5-minute walk from Piazza Roma—the city's main transport hub for buses, cars, and ferries to Venice and Treviso airports. Santa Lucia train station is just a 10-minute walk away, offering easy access to the vaporetto (water bus) routes that navigate the Grand Canal and Giudecca Canal, connecting you to Venice's most iconic landmarks. The hotel seamlessly blends 15th-century elegance with modern amenities, including climate control, minibars, and televisions in every room. En-suite bathrooms feature a bathtub or shower, bidet, and hairdryer. A daily breakfast buffet is also provided.

139179.address: Rua do Choupelo, Vila Nova de Gaia Sta Marinha, 345
139179.description: As a proud member of the prestigious Relais & Châteaux collection and distinguished with two Michelin stars, The Yeatman Hotel offers classic luxury in the historic heart of Vila Nova de Gaia. Executive Rooms, situated between the first and third floors, feature terraces or balconies with views of either the garden or the city of Porto. Please note these rooms require the use of two lifts. The outdoor swimming pool is closed from November 1st to March 31st, and the two-Michelin-starred Gastronomic Restaurant is closed from January 5th to March 3rd, 2026. Due to high demand, advance reservations are recommended for both the restaurant and spa to guarantee availability. Special requests and preferences are subject to availability upon check-in and may incur additional charges.

139184.description: This hotel is located in Malaga's exclusive El Golf district, conveniently situated by the Alcántara metro station in the heart of the city's commercial and financial center. A short walk from Los Dominicos and Orrego Luco, it's also a quick drive to Providencia's center and Parque Arauco. Guests will find themselves surrounded by art galleries, upscale shops, boulevards, restaurants, and antique stores. Viña del Mar is just 90 minutes away, and the international airport is a 30-minute drive. Renovated in 2010, this family-friendly city hotel offers 73 quiet and welcoming rooms, including 36 singles. Suitable for both business travelers and vacationers, the hotel provides a cozy lobby with 24-hour reception, professional multilingual staff, postal service, currency exchange, special discounts, a safe, and elevator access. Guests can enjoy the on-site cafe and restaurant, as well as Wi-Fi, room service, laundry service, parking, and an airport shuttle. The rooms, approximately 24 square meters, feature private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations and hair dryers, along with king-size or double beds. Amenities include direct-dial telephones with national and international calling, safes, minibars, cable TV, and internet access. Air conditioning and central heating are standard. For relaxation, the hotel offers an outdoor swimming pool with parasols. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast each morning, while lunch and dinner are served à la carte.

139220.description: 'A getaway about 30 minutes from Lisbon'. Disconnect from the world and discover the Mercure Lisboa Almada. This 4* hotel in a green setting overlooks the Tagus River and mythical Cristo Rei. A short drive away, you can relax on the beautiful beaches of Costa da Caparica. The hotel has a modern restaurant with a very intimate atmosphere as well as 4 equipped meeting rooms with plenty of natural light.

139226.description: This comfortable aparthotel boasts a convenient position in the village of Guyancourt, close to the world-renowned and enchanting Palace of Versailles. The property enjoys a quiet position and is surrounded by plenty of nice shops and has easy access to main highways, allowing its guests to get to Paris’ city centre in a short ride away. All the apartments are fully equipped to guarantee a pleasant stay to both business and leisure travellers. They feature a modern and fresh look and include a well equipped kitchen for the more independent guests who prefer to prepare their own meals. The property also offers Internet access to its guests free of charge, allowing them to keep updated while they are away. The aparthotel is also provided with common facilities such as a breakfast room and laundry and dry cleaning facilities.

139332.description: This comfortable seven-bedroom apartment, with three bathrooms and a kitchen, is housed in a classic building on one of central Barcelona's most emblematic streets, just steps from the cathedral. Ideal for families, groups, or business meetings, it can accommodate seven to fourteen people. Guests are a short walk from Las Ramblas, Plaça Catalunya, and the vibrant Born district. A variety of restaurants and bars showcasing Catalan cuisine are within a five-minute walk, and the nearest shopping center is less than ten minutes away. Barceloneta beach and Estación de Francia train station are a twenty-minute walk from the apartment. Admirers of Gaudí's work can find Casa Batlló and the Gothic Quarter roughly ten minutes away. Guests have two check-in options: online or in person.

139375.description: Situated at the heart of Paris, close to the chic and lively avenue of the Champs Elysées, between the Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower, Le Belmont Champs Elysées hotel offers elegant accommodations and superb facilities. Guests will find the closest metro station of Charles de Gaulle-Etoile just a few minutes from the property. The hotel features a lounge bar serving refreshing cocktails, 200 sqm of spa with hammam and five massage rooms, as well as a fitness room. Renovated in 2013 and decorated in a romantic French style, the rooms and suites at this stylish hotel feature modern amenities to provide a pleasant and comfortable stay. Some rooms and suites even have a terrace, a Nespresso machine and a seating area for added convenience. Guests will be able to enjoy the Parisian touch of the breakfast buffet served every morning in the bright lounge bar.

139434.description: Located in Paris's charming 17th arrondissement, in the Batignolles neighborhood, this hotel offers both business and leisure travelers convenient access to major attractions. The Champs-Élysées, Eiffel Tower, and Boulevard Haussmann department stores are easily reachable via nearby public transport. The hotel features modern decor creating a welcoming atmosphere. Soundproofed rooms ensure a peaceful night's sleep, whether you're enjoying Paris's nightlife or simply relaxing. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, and enjoy the convenience of en-suite bathrooms with tubs and individual climate control. Start your day with breakfast on the charming terrace of the gourmet restaurant, or savor a delicious dinner under the stars. The restaurant offers traditional French cuisine. For a relaxing evening, enjoy cocktails in the moonlight. Multilingual staff and a 24-hour reception desk complete the hotel experience.

139466.address: Bd Zerktouni Angle Rue Mohamed Beqqal Marrakech
139466.description: Located in Marrakech's Gueliz district, Hotel Tachfine offers convenient access to various attractions. Within a 15-minute walk, you'll find Marrakech Plaza and Avenue Mohamed VI. The hotel features two bars/lounges, a restaurant with room service (limited hours), and private balconies in the air-conditioned guestrooms. Bathrooms are equipped with bathtubs or showers. For added convenience, the hotel provides bellhop services, a safe deposit box at the front desk, and an elevator. Nearby attractions include the Majorelle Garden (1. 2 km) and Jemaa el-Fnaa (3. 1 km). Menara Airport (RAK) is 7. 6 km from the hotel.

139473.description: Conveniently situated in Alanya, this apart hotel is just a 5-minute walk from renowned Kleopatra Beach and within a short stroll from the city centre with its large variety of shops, restaurants, bars and cafés. An outdoor pool, children's pool, restaurant and bar are available for guests. Attractions such as Alanya Castle, Damlatas Caves or the famous Red Tower are within easy reach.

name.content: La Quinta Inn & Suites by Wyndham Garden City

139502.description: Located in a prime area of New York City, La Quinta Inn & Suites Garden City offers convenient access to the city's attractions. Business and leisure travelers alike will appreciate the hotel's amenities and attentive staff. Well-appointed guest rooms feature flat-screen televisions, air conditioning, heating, alarm clocks, and telephones. The property also provides various recreational opportunities, ensuring a memorable stay.

139503.description: Located in Hauppauge, La Quinta Inn & Suites Islip MacArthur Airport is a perfect starting point from which to explore Hauppauge (NY). Featuring a satisfying list of amenities, guests will find their stay at the property a comfortable one. Service-minded staff will welcome and guide you at La Quinta Inn & Suites Islip MacArthur Airport. Guestrooms are fitted with all the amenities you need for a good night's sleep. In some of the rooms, guests can find flat screen television, air conditioning, heating, desk, alarm clock. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Friendly staff, great facilities, and close proximity to all that Hauppauge (NY) has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at La Quinta Inn & Suites Islip MacArthur Airport.

139526.description: Relax and unwind at this Art Deco hotel with massages, body treatments, and facials. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. A snack bar/deli and limited room service are available. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge, and start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) served from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM. The hotel also provides express check-in/check-out and dry cleaning/laundry services. Each of the 35 guest rooms features an espresso maker, a flat-screen TV with premium channels, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer, a safe, and a coffee/tea maker. Located in the heart of Paris, Seven Hotel is a short drive from Luxembourg Gardens and Notre Dame. Other nearby attractions include the Louvre Museum and the Champs-Élysées.

139527.description:
Town Hall Hotel, East London
Discover Town Hall Hotel, a luxury boutique hotel in Bethnal Green, London, set within a beautifully restored Grade II-listed Edwardian building. Our 97 individually designed rooms, suites and apartments range from approximately 23–94 sqm, offering stylish accommodation for everything from city breaks to extended stays. Many suites feature kitchens, separate living areas and spacious layouts, ideal for couples, families and business travellers. 
Guests can enjoy our 14-metre heated indoor swimming pool, refurbished gym with Peloton bikes, in-room spa treatments and exceptional dining, including two-Michelin-starred Da Terra, Elis restaurant and the Assembly Lounge. The hotel also offers seven versatile event spaces for meetings, weddings and private celebrations. 
Located on Patriot Square, Bethnal Green, Town Hall Hotel is just a short walk from Bethnal Green Underground Station, with easy access to Shoreditch, Brick Lane, the City of London and central London. 
Experience the perfect blend of historic character, contemporary design and exceptional hospitality at Town Hall Hotel.

139562.address: Plot No 1/136, Dr. E Moses Rd, Worli
139562.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite to eat at San Qi, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Mumbai? This hotel has 15985 square feet (1485 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 5 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 202 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. 46-inch LCD televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. High Street Phoenix Mall - 0. 6 km / 0. 3 mi- Palladium Mall - 0. 7 km / 0. 5 mi- Nehru Science Centre - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Nehru Planetarium - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Nehru Centre - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Atria Mall - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Peninsula Corporate Tower - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Worli Sea Face Promenade - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- The National Sports Club Of India - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Mahalaxmi Racecourse - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Haji Ali Dargah - 2. 8 km / 1. 7 mi- Mahalaxmi Temple - 2. 8 km / 1. 7 mi- Jaslok Hospital - 3 km / 1. 9 mi- Lamington Road - 3. 2 km / 2 mi- Breach Candy Hospital - 3. 3 km / 2 mi. The nearest major airport is Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport (BOM) - 18. 3 km / 11.

139563.description: Novotel Mumbai Juhu Beach is AccorHotels breathtaking beachfront property located in the financial capital of India. Offering an inventory of 203 guest rooms and suites along with 6 dining options. The hotel puts forward stunning design components in a spectrum of styles. Strategic location with comprehensive facilities which provide modern comfort, a unique feeling of spaciousness, and contemporary décor for business and leisure travelers, celebrities and local guests alike.

139564.address: Crystal Plaza, Plot No. 18/27, Sect 7, Kharghar, 18/27
139564.description: Located in Kharghar, off the Mumbai-Pune Highway, this convenient budget hotel offers easy access to commercial and leisure districts, with both domestic and international airports within a 40-45km radius. The hotel features 43 spacious deluxe rooms boasting Italian décor and modern amenities, including a telephone, TV, en-suite bathroom with shower and bath, internet access, a safe, refrigerator, and tea and coffee making facilities. Guests can also enjoy individually controlled air conditioning and heating. Additional facilities include a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, café, newspaper stand, banquet hall for corporate events, laundry and room service, and on-site parking.

139566.address: Plot No. 4, Sector 23, Opp. Sanpada Rly. Stn.
139566.description: This interesting hotel sits just of the Mumbai-Pune Highway, a 10-minute walk from the Vashi Railway Station and around 30km from the Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport. Guests will be  within walking distance from one of Mumbai's lively shopping areas, where they can find absolutely anything from a brand-name clothes, top of the line electronics, to hand-made jewellery and souvenirs. The area also offers plenty of dining venues and food stalls. Those of the guests who don't feel like exploring the surroundings can visit the onsite restaurant for a hearty meal. Afterwards they can head to the bar, where in its relaxed ambience they can enjoy a chilled drink and some pleasant conversations. Business travellers who are looking for a place where to host their meetings or conferences can check the spacious banquet hall.

139567.address: DX–12,’D’ Zone Bonsari Village,TTC Indust. Area
139567.description: Situated in Mumbai's Bonsari Village, this hotel offers homely comforts and world-class service. It's conveniently located near Inorbit Mall (3km), CST Railway Station (30km), and both the domestic (27km) and international (30km) airports. Enjoy a range of dining options and amenities including currency exchange, conference facilities, internet access, room and laundry service, and parking. Spacious guest rooms feature computer workstations with internet, electronic safes, direct dial telephones, satellite/cable TV, and minibars. En suite bathrooms include rain showers, hairdryers, and shaving mirrors.

139575.description: Located in Juhu, Mumbai, the JW Marriott Mumbai Juhu is a short walk from Juhu Beach and Prithvi Theatre. This luxury resort is also conveniently close to the ISKCON Temple and Nanavati Super Speciality Hospital. Guests can relax at the full-service spa, enjoying massages, body treatments, and facials, or take advantage of the resort's recreational amenities, including three outdoor swimming pools, a health club, and a waterslide. Complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands are also available. The 358 guestrooms feature iPod docking stations, LED televisions, premium bedding, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Guests can also enjoy DVD players and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. The resort offers a variety of dining options, including Lotus Cafe, which serves local and international cuisine, as well as 24-hour room service and a coffee shop/cafe. Guests can unwind with a drink at the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include limo/town car service, a computer station, and express check-in.

139576.description: With a stay at The Westin Mumbai Powai Lake in Mumbai (Powai), you'll be a 4-minute drive from Sanjay Gandhi National Park and 9 minutes from R City Mall. This luxury hotel is 6. 3 mi (10. 1 km) from Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre and 6. 7 mi (10. 8 km) from Juhu Beach. . Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a spa tub, and a steam room. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). . Guests will find themselves immersed in spectacular surroundings, rich in grandeur and elegance. The guest rooms exude graceful style with lavish furnishings and soothing colors. The hotel offers a host of unrivaled facilities and amenities, catering to business, conference, leisure, and dining needs with the highest degree of excellence.

140160.address: Kuwait Street and Mankhool Road, Al Mankhool
140160.description: This charming establishment is located in the vibrant district of Bur Dubai, offering convenient access to the city's business district and top tourist attractions. The DIFC, World Trade Centre, Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa are quite close, as are the Dubai Creek and the city‘s Heritage and Diving Village. Jumeirah Beach is some 15 minutes' walk and it is around 30 minutes to Sharjah Beach. The elegant rooms feature a contemporary décor and range from single to twin. Wheelchair accessible rooms are also available. Besides being amidst a hub of coffee shops and restaurants, the hotel offers Wi−Fi in the lobby and features an extensive choice of in-house dining and entertainment options, including a gym, a rooftop swimming pool as well as an Indian and an Asian restaurant, ideal to taste flavours from another countries.

140164.description: This stunning beach resort is located in Negombo, a popular resort town on Sri Lanka's western coast. The area enjoys spectacular surroundings with golden beaches and shimmering, azure waters. The hotel is located just 12 kms from Colombo International Airport and 43 kms from the culturally-rich city of Colombo. Set amidst luxuriant greenery and swaying palms, this magnificent resort blends effortlessly with its natural surroundings. This family-friendly resort affords guests the ultimate experience in luxurious, tropical living. The captivating guest rooms feature muted tones and soothing shades, enveloping guests in a cocoon of serenity and tranquility, away from the bustle of daily life. Guests will find an array of conference, leisure, recreational and dining amenities and facilities, to ensure that the whole family enjoys the time of their lives.

140165.description: This captivating beach resort is located just 4 km away from the charming city of Negombo in Sri Lanka. The area is renowned for its pristine, golden beaches and crystal-clear sea waters. This hotel is ideally situated just 14 km from Bandaranaike International Airport and 4 km from the nearby railway and bus stations. This stunning resort exudes flawless beauty and splendour, providing guests with a peaceful retreat by the ocean. The resort enjoys Sri Lankan inspired design, while also embracing contemporary influences. The guest rooms are divinely-appointed, creating an ambience of sheer relaxation and serenity, offering a veritable haven where guests can leave their world behind. Guests are invited to take advantage of the resort's exceptional leisure, dining and recreational facilities, for the ultimate in relaxation and enjoyment.

140166.description:
Ideally located in the "Gold Coast" - Negombo, which is just a 15 minutes drive from Bandaranayake International Airport.

The hotel, features the charm of Dutch and Portuguese influence. It offers free Wi-Fi in public areas, conferences, boat rides and weddings.

140211.description: Located in one of the city's most exclusive areas, next to Estádio do Dragão and with easy access to the city centre, STAY HOTEL PORTO CENTRO ANTAS is the perfect choice for both business and leisure stays. Ideal for FC Porto fans and visitors from foreign clubs who want to experience the excitement of live matches, it offers an experience that combines comfort and proximity to the main points of interest.

140257.description: This family-friendly city hotel is located in the heart of Cancun on Ave. Yaxchilan, just metres from banks and shopping centres. The establishment has a contemporary design, offering its guests a calm and comfortable environment. Renovated in 2009, the hotel is perfect for a business trip. Facilities available to guests include a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a cafe and a restaurant. Guests may also take advantage of the WLAN Internet access, room service and a car park. The beautiful suites have two queen beds and a minimalist style. They are fully-equipped as standard featuring a work desk, an LCD satellite TV and individually regulated air conditioning. Leisure facilities include a swimming pool with children's swimming area and various spa treatments.

140304.description: This charming hotel is located in Athens, within 2 kilometers of the city center, providing easy access to local attractions and entertainment. The hotel is a short walk from public transportation and 10 kilometers from the nearest beach. The airport is 17 kilometers away, and the harbor is 13 kilometers away. The hotel offers 84 guest rooms and features Wi-Fi throughout. The 24-hour reception welcomes guests to this accessible property, with all public spaces and bathrooms designed for wheelchair users and those with mobility issues. Small pets are also welcome. Business facilities are available for corporate travelers, and the on-site restaurant provides a sophisticated dining experience. Some services may incur additional charges.

140324.description: This lovely Hotel is set in Barajas-Ifema. This accommodation offers a total of 41 units. Internet connection is provided for those needing to keep connected both in public and private spaces. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. Furthermore, Hotel Villa de Barajas offers cots on request for children. Pets are not allowed at Hotel Villa de Barajas. For added convenience, travellers might use the garage facilities. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

140349.description: This upscale business hotel enjoys a prime location in an affluent and well-connected area of the city. The hotel is strategically situated close to the corporate districts of North and Central Mumbai. The international airport is conveniently located just 1 km from the hotel, while the domestic airport is 4 km away. This elegantly designed hotel features a breath-taking, contemporary style and welcomes guests with luxurious surroundings and impeccable service. The guest rooms exude luxury, decadence and uncompromised functionality with an ergonomic style, which will appeal to even the most discerning business traveller. The hotel affords guests a selection of exemplary business, conference and dining facilities, designed to meet the individual needs of every type of traveller to the highest level of excellence.

140388.description: Whether you're exploring the capital, taking care of business at Canary Wharf, heading for adventure from London City Airport or indulging in serious retail therapy at Westfield Stratford, ibis London Barking offers easy access to all of it. Home to 86 inviting guest bedrooms (complete with en suite power showers, 43' flat screen TV's and tea & coffee facilities), our affordable London hotel puts on a very good value hot & cold breakfast spread each morning, setting you up for even the busiest of days.

140401.description: Located in Solihull, Ramada Birmingham Solihull Hotel is a perfect starting point from which to explore Birmingham. Both business travelers and tourists can enjoy the hotel's facilities and services. To be found at the hotel are 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, daily housekeeping, taxi service, 24-hour security. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer television LCD/plasma screen, carpeting, linens, mirror, towels to ensure a restful night. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include yoga room, fitness center, golf course (within 3 km), massage, garden. For reliable service and professional staff, Ramada Birmingham Solihull Hotel caters to your needs.

140407.description: This boutique hotel, housed within seven Victorian townhouses in London's Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, offers a blend of grand architecture and contemporary design. Located near Earl's Court Underground station (500m), it provides easy access to Olympia, the Royal Albert Hall, world-renowned museums like the Victoria and Albert and Natural History Museum (1km), and the upscale shopping districts of Knightsbridge and Kensington, including Harrods (1. 2km). Paddington Station is approximately 2km away, and Victoria Coach Station and Piccadilly Circus are both roughly 3km from the hotel. The hotel's 76 rooms and 2 apartments are spread over four floors, featuring amenities such as a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, and lift access. Guests can enjoy a private garden, on-site bar and restaurant serving pan-Asian cuisine for lunch and dinner, and a comprehensive breakfast. Each room includes a private bathroom, king-size or double bed, satellite TV, internet access, a minibar, and tea and coffee making facilities. For those looking to stay active, a gym is also available.

140408.description: VIP Executive Saldanha Hotel is located in the business and financial center of Lisbon next to the building of Saldanha Residence in an area served by most transportation facilities. The Hotel is about 15 minutes from Lisbon International Airport and 5 minutes from downtown shopping. With 54 rooms, VIP Executive Saldanha Hotel was totally reconstructed, aiming to present the most recent hotel business trends in a European capital. All the rooms were decorated in a comfortable and functional way and are equipped with the most modern technologies, ideal for leisure or business stays. This 4 star Hotel has also a space that can be used for work meetings or conferences and offers wireless Internet access.

140409.address: Rua José Morneiro - A Ver O Mar, 100
140409.description: It is located in the northern part of Póvoa de Varzim, in a quiet place with a small garden, just a 3 minute drive from the motorway and 10 minutes' walk from the blue flag beach. It's a dead end street 100 meters from the national highway and only 2 minutes walk to several restaurants. It has bus and Lidl supermarket only 2 minutes walk and Congress Centre 2 minutes by car.

140412.description: The hotel is located 9 km from the centre of Belek on a long stretch of beach. The smaller town of Kadriye is 5 km away and public transport and taxis are available from in front of the hotel with links to nearby towns and the city of Antalya, which is some 45 km away. Antalya airport is approximately 35 km from the complex. The holiday village is situated on 90 acres of protected green land. Refurbished in 2010, in addition to holiday accommodation, the hotel provides facilities for conferences and seminars as well as for football teams who can take advantage of the hotel's two professional football fields. There is a selection of small shops on site, a hairdressing salon, a main restaurant and an à la carte one, a choice of bars and a disco. Further facilities available to guests at the air-conditioned, 293-room hotel include a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, currency exchange facilities, auditorium and a café. There are double-storey buildings in the style of bungalows in the holiday village and three types of rooms. Decorated in a modern style, all of the rooms have a balcony, TV, minibar (only water), telephone, hairdryer, centrally controlled air conditioning and a safe (fees apply). Standard rooms have parquet flooring. In addition to an en suite bathroom with bathtub, other standard features of all rooms include a double or king-size bed, Internet access and an iron and ironing board.

140413.description: This luxurious hotel is perfectly located on a sprawling, sandy beach in the Evrenseki resort in Turkey. The hotel is  7 km away from the intriguing historical resort of Side. Guests will find public transport links just a few minutes' walking distance away, offering ease of access to other interesting areas and attractions. The hotel boasts a contemporary, attractive architectural style, adding a touch of modernity to its surroundings. Guests are invited into the stylish, elegant surroundings of the interior, where striking designs and luxurious furnishings abound. The guest rooms enjoy a sleek, sophisticated style, and offer a cocoon of tranquility in which to relax and unwind in comfort. The hotel affords guests a selection of first-class facilities and services, catering to their needs to the highest degree of excellence.

140428.description: Overlooking the Canal Grande, right in front of the famed 'Ca' d'Oro', the hotel is conveniently located just 5 minutes from the Rialto bridge and 15 minutes from Saint Mark's Square. The train station is at immediate vicinity while Marco Polo Airport is about 20 minutes by car. The hotel offers splendid guest rooms featuring Venetian furnishings in relaxing and comfortable atmosphere. In-room amenities include air-conditioning, satellite TV, minibar, safe and bathroom with shower and hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a continental and international breakfast buffet n the splendid dining hall with a terrace facing the Canal Grande. For its calm and quiet environment, guests are guaranteed to have a peaceful stay in the centre of Venice.

140430.description: Located in Doha (As Salatah), Mövenpick Hotel Doha is steps from Doha Corniche and a 2-minute drive from Souq Waqif Art Gallery. This upscale hotel is 4. 4 mi (7. 1 km) from City Centre Shopping Mall and 7. 9 mi (12. 6 km) from Katara Beach. Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including a health club, an outdoor pool, and a spa tub. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 154 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Stop by the hotel's restaurant for lunch, dinner, or brunch. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 2 meeting rooms available for events. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.

name.content: Hampton Inn & Suites Newark Airport Elizabeth

140459.description: Located less than five miles from Newark Liberty International Airport, Hampton Inn & Suites Newark Airport Elizabeth offers complimentary shuttle service to and from the airport. Cape Liberty Cruise Port is a 20-minute drive away. Guests enjoy free breakfast and WiFi, as well as access to an indoor pool and fitness center. Each room features cable TV, a microwave, refrigerator, and a private bathroom with a shower, hairdryer, and complimentary toiletries. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, hot tub, meeting facilities, luggage storage, and dry cleaning services. A complimentary hot breakfast with Belgian waffles is also provided. The hotel is conveniently located near Jersey Gardens Mall Shopping Center (500m) and Elizabeth Station (3. 3km), which offers city rail service to New York Penn Station. Please note: The main entrance is closed daily from 8 am to 5 pm. Please use the back entrance. Hotel renovations are underway from February 3, 2023, to March 3, 2023. We appreciate your patience.

140486.description: This hotel sits on the bank of the River Seine. It is located next to the Place del la Madeleine, in Paris' Golden Triangle. The hotel offers visitors a highly convenient setting from which to explore the monuments and sights that the city has to offer. The Haussmann department stores, the Garnier National Opera and the Place de la Concorde are located close by. Guests can explore the Champs Elysees and the Louvre with ease. Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport is just 30 km away. This city hotel offers a luxurious, warm setting, featuring contemporary interiors bathed in light. The guest rooms and suites feature design furnishings and modern conveniences. The hotel's first-class facilities and services ensuring unrivalled convenience.

140487.description: From the start the Hotel Mercedes has always cultivated the art of reception according the French tradition. It is located a stone's throw from the Avenue des Champs Elysees and the Arc de Triomphe, in the very heart of Paris with its business, tourism and shops proposing luxury articles. Today, Hotel Mercedes has been completely refurbished and opens its doors for you to enter in a luminous, refined and convivial Art deco space. The restoration of the building has been carried out with particular care. Its art deco theme of the thirties and its stained-glass window by the sculptor Grueber will attract businessmen and tourists from all over the world. Enjoy your stay.

140490.description: This hotel boasts a prime location on Rue St. Honoré in Paris's 1st arrondissement, steps from the Louvre and Palais Royal. The Châtelet metro station is a mere 100 meters away, providing easy access to the rest of the city. Surrounded by exciting shopping, dining, and entertainment, the hotel offers an ideal base for exploring this captivating city's romantic charm. Housed in an 18th-century building, the hotel exudes splendor. A glass canopy bathes the lobby in natural light, creating a welcoming atmosphere. The exquisitely appointed guest rooms offer a serene ambiance for relaxation.

140491.description: The Hotel Ducs de Bourgogne is within walking distance of the Louvre Museum, Notre Dame Cathedral, the Pompidou Center, and the shops of Rue de Rivoli. It offers tailored meeting rooms with up-to-date technology. Located in a central hub of Parisian public transport, the hotel provides direct access to train stations, airports, and the Villepinte Exhibition Centre. Whether for business or leisure, the Hotel Ducs de Bourgogne is ideally situated in the heart of Paris. Its 37 air-conditioned rooms are equipped with flat-screen televisions and tea and coffee makers.

140492.description: The Maison Albar Hotel Opera Diamond, BW Premier Collection®, a luxurious 5-star hotel in the heart of Paris, offers 72 rooms dedicated to elegant comfort. Like a diamond, the hotel embodies purity and commitment with carefully chosen materials appealing to both sight and touch. The elegantly designed furniture creates a warm and inviting atmosphere with timeless charm. Relax in various spaces, including our reception area with a majestic fireplace, an intimate bar, and a peaceful internal garden. Inspired by haute couture, the hotel's décor features a brilliant orchestration of black, accented by sparkling optical fiber in the floor resembling scattered diamonds and Swarovski crystal chandeliers. Located near the Opera House, department stores, and the Champs-Élysées, the hotel offers five floors of accommodation. The top floor boasts six executive rooms equipped with modern amenities, including Wi-Fi, televisions, in-mirror bathroom televisions, Nespresso machines, and iPod docking stations. Treat yourself to a unique Parisian experience at the Maison Albar Hotel Opera Diamond, where timeless elegance meets modern luxury.

140515.description: The hotel is located on Battery Street at Wellington Pier in the Colaba district of Mumbai, and enjoys the advantage of being close to the major parts of the city. The international airport is 22 km away, and the Chatrapathi Shivaji railway terminus is 3 km away. This charming, air-conditioned hotel has been designed with stylish and innovative themes which differ on each floor, refreshing guests' moods when they enter into the hotel. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange and newspaper stand. It also offers Internet access, room service and a laundry service. Guests can enjoy a drink at the café, bar or disco, and dine in the restaurant. Business travellers can make use of the conference facilities. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel car park. The hotel provides rooms in three different categories divided into three floors like The Mediterranean rooms, The Country rooms and The Scandinavian rooms. All rooms have smartly coloured walls for different moods, and good quality furniture and well-maintained floors to enhance the warmth and vibrancy of the modern atmosphere in the rooms. Each room features a double or king-size bed, direct dial telephone, LCD TV with cable/satellite channels, wireless Internet access, a safe, minibar and tea and coffee making facilities. Air conditioning and central heating are standard features in all accommodation. The hotel features an outdoor swimming pool and a gym.

name.content: Ramada Plaza By Wyndham Palm Grove

140517.description: This hotel offers 114 spacious rooms, some with soothing Arabian Sea views. Amenities include coffee/tea makers, electronic safes, and free Wi-Fi. Non-smoking and accessible rooms are available upon request. Dining options include three exquisite venues: The Oriental Bowl, The Tangerine, and The Deck Bar. 24-hour room service is also provided. Additional facilities comprise a swimming pool, health club, beauty parlor, bookshop, cyber cafe, and a business center with three meeting rooms. Conveniently located near international and domestic airports, the hotel is also within two kilometers of shopping centers and nightclubs.

140526.description: This charming hotel is located on P. J. Ramchandani Marg in Mumbai. The hotel is situated just a few minutes' walk away from the Gateway of India and is within easy access of the myriad of attractions the city has to offer. Chhatrapati Shivaji Train Terminus is located just 2 kms from the hotel, while the domestic and international airport is just 18 kms away. Guests will be welcomed by warm hospitality, friendly service and comfortable surroundings. The guest rooms have been tastefully-decorated, featuring a warm, minimalist design, and offer the ideal setting where guests can relax and unwind at the end of the day. The hotel also offers delightful dining and conference options, for guests' convenience.

140536.description: Situated in Porto's historic center, overlooking the renowned Port wine cellars and just steps from the Douro River, this 4-star superior hotel offers breathtaking views of Ribeira Square, Palácio da Bolsa, and the Alfândega Congress Center. Refurbished across five buildings, the hotel boasts 90 rooms, including six suites. All rooms feature Wi-Fi, air conditioning/heating, a private bathroom, and a 32 LCD television. The hotel also provides five well-equipped meeting rooms suitable for various configurations, accommodating up to 300 people. Further amenities include a 100-seat restaurant with show cooking, a business center, a 24-hour reception, and a gym/fitness area. Tourism Registry Number: 3926

140548.description: Indulge in the Majestic Hotel - SPA Champs Elysées, a luxurious Parisian retreat just a 5-minute stroll from Place Charles de Gaulle and the Champs-Élysées. This 5-star hotel boasts an array of amenities, including an indoor pool, steam room, and on-site restaurant serving delectable meals. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Each of the 57 air-conditioned rooms offers a pillowtop bed with premium bedding, an LCD TV with satellite programming, and designer toiletries. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (available for a fee), and take advantage of convenient services like limo/town car service and concierge assistance. Limited on-site parking is also available. Nearby attractions include the Arc de Triomphe, Palais de Chaillot, and Place du Trocadéro.

name.content: Van Der Valk Hotel Brussels Airport

140551.description:
Van der Valk Hotel Brussels Airport is a modern 4-star hotel ideally located near Brussels Airport, offering convenient access to the city centre, Brussels Expo, Tour & Taxis, and the European institutions. Combining comfort and functionality, the hotel is an excellent choice for both business and leisure travellers. 

Guests can unwind in one of the spacious and stylish rooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, minibar, espresso machine, premium bedding, and modern amenities. Dining options include Restaurant Catharina, serving contemporary European cuisine, as well as a welcoming bar and lounge area. 

The hotel features a fitness centre, bicycle rental service, concierge assistance, and extensive meeting and event facilities with 16 meeting rooms, making it suitable for conferences and corporate events. Parking and airport transfer services are also available for added convenience.

140626.description: This enchanting riad enjoys a convenient situation in the historic centre of Marrakech, a short walking distance from the popular Djemaa el Fna Square. Guests will find themselves close to some of the most important tourist attractions in the area, including Bahia Palace. When visitors walk through the front door the traditional aromas and décor will make them feel like they have gone back in time. This beautiful establishment offers a choice of beautifully appointed suites decorated in an Arabo-Moorish architectural style. Guests will appreciate the interior courtyard with a beautiful fountain, ideal to relax during break times, as well as the rooftop terrace where travellers can enjoy the best views over the surrounding landscape. The hotel also features a hot tub for guests' convenience, all for a relaxing stay in Marrakech.

140633.description: Motel One Berlin Ku Damm features a total of 249 units. This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception. This hotel is environmentally friendly.

140637.description: Situated on the vibrant Avenida 9 de Julio, the neoclassical Scala Hotel Buenos Aires stands as a striking urban landmark. Its majestic presence graces the San Telmo district, renowned as the birthplace of tango. This prime location offers convenient access to the city's historical, cultural, financial, and culinary heart. The hotel boasts 143 spacious rooms designed for comfort, along with versatile meeting spaces suitable for conferences and product launches. A restaurant serving Mediterranean cuisine, a bar, gym, and business center are available for guests. A pool, outdoor spa, and bar are also coming soon. The attentive staff is dedicated to providing an unforgettable experience, making the Scala Hotel a compelling choice in the heart of Buenos Aires.

140669.description: Situated in a quiet side street, the appealing Timhotel Gare de Lyon enjoys a strategic location in the centre of Paris, only steps away from the important train stations Gare de Lyon, Gare de Bercy and Gare d'Austerlitz. Famous attractions such as the Palais d'Omnisports in Bercy, the Ministry of Finances, the Notre Dame Cathedral, Bastille, Rue Rivoli or the Centre Pompidou are within walking distance. The small hotel welcomes guests in a relaxed atmosphere full of hospitality. The well-appointed rooms boast a modern decoration in friendly, warm colours. Features include complimentary wireless internet access, individual heating and 26” flat-screen TV. For business guests, there is a computer with free internet access as well as fax and photocopying service. This hotel is a great place both for business and leisure travellers and a perfect base to discover this fascinating city.

140728.description: Located in the centre of the Gueliz neighbourhood close to the Medina's Old Town, this hotel opens its doors a few steps from the Marrakech Plaza commercial centre with its many shops and stores. It is a 15-minute walk to the Place Jemaa El Fna and 5 minutes from Mohamed V Avenue, the main artery of the city. Menara Airport is only 4 km away. This hotel features luxurious rooms and a magnificent terrace. This exquisite building has all the facilities to allow guests to truly unwind and relax. The hotel's restaurants are renowned for their excellent and varied Moroccan and international cuisine. The hotel also has a business centre and a meeting room fully equipped with a capacity for up to 20 people. Guests can also make use of the additional facilities, including an outdoor pool, a sun terrace and a lounge area.

140769.description: Nestled in the heart of Mumbai's western suburbs, Hotel Parkview offers a tranquil escape from the bustling city. Our urban-designed rooms feature plush fabrics, calming layouts, and elegant flooring to soothe travel-weary guests. Enjoy modern amenities such as LCD TVs, air conditioning, and en-suite bathrooms with chrome fixtures. The hotel also boasts a multi-cuisine restaurant, conference facilities, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Indulge in comfort and convenience at Hotel Parkview.

140809.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul's vibrant Beyoğlu district for over a century, the iconic Pera Palace Hotel epitomizes timeless elegance. This luxurious property boasts a unique heritage blended with modern touches, symbolizing Istanbul's renowned cosmopolitan culture. Overlooking the magnificent Golden Horn and the historic old city, and within walking distance of the Bosphorus, Galata Tower, and the famed Istiklal shopping street, the Pera Palace Hotel commands a prime location. The 115 well-appointed rooms and suites retain classic 19th-century characteristics, with many inspired by iconic guests who once called this hotel home. Afternoon tea in the opulent Kubbeli Lounge is a beloved tradition for both Istanbul residents and visitors, while the Orient Terrace remains one of the city's most popular outdoor venues, a renowned meeting place in the Pera district. The bijou Patisserie de Pera offers the perfect Turkish coffee and indulgent cakes throughout the day. For an ideal escape from the city's hustle and bustle, the calming spa provides guests with a traditional Turkish Hammam experience, along with an indoor pool, gym, sauna, and steam rooms. Having hosted luminaries such as Agatha Christie, Ernest Hemingway, Greta Garbo, Mata Hari, and Sarah Bernhardt, the Pera Palace Hotel was also frequented by Atatürk, the founder of modern Turkey. In 1981, his original room was restored and nationally recognized as a unique historical feature, earning the hotel its status as Istanbul's only museum hotel.

140818.address: Melik Gazi Ilcesi Tekir Yaylasi Erciyes Kayak Merk
140818.description: The total number of units is 105. The property offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Additional fees may apply for some services.

140885.description: Located in Puerto Juarez, this family-friendly hotel offers a variety of accommodations, including rooms, suites, and apartments, to suit every traveler. Explore nearby attractions such as Playa del Nino beach and downtown Cancun, or venture slightly further to Plaza de las Americas, just 10 km away, and Market 28, 15 km from the hotel. Isla Mujeres is easily accessible by a 25-minute boat ride. Start your day with a delicious breakfast and enjoy dining in the elegant on-site restaurant. A paid airport shuttle service is available with advance booking.

140895.description: The hotel is located downtown, directly across from the renowned Parque de las Palapas, close to major banks, shopping centers, the city center, and the restaurant district. Playa las Perlas beach is about 6 km away, and Playa del Carmen is approximately 45 km away. The hotel is conveniently located just two blocks from the bus station, five minutes from the hotel zone entrance, and 20 minutes from Cancun International Airport. This air-conditioned hotel offers 63 rooms suitable for both leisure and business travelers, providing comfort and value. Amenities include a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a safe, currency exchange, internet access, laundry service, and parking. All rooms feature a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, a double bed, cable TV, a safety deposit box, individually controlled air conditioning, a telephone, and complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel boasts a two-tiered outdoor swimming pool; the first level is designed for children, while the second has a depth of 1. 6 meters. Sun loungers are available at the nearby beach.

140916.address: 41, derb Lalla Bent El Amri Assouel - Marrakech -
140916.description:
Situated in Assouel, one of the oldest districts of the medina, the riad is within 5 minutes on foot from the post office Bab El-Khemis, near a car park watched by a guard and close to the Ben Youssef Madrasa and close to the small museum created by Omar Ben Jelloun. The bus station is around 100 m from the riad and the railway station is some 800 m away.

The riad consists of three big rooms and two superior suites, each of them different and personalised. It is inspired in decoration by the city which carries its name. The riad offers a lounge bar to take a mint tea and taste the Moroccan sweet petits fours. Under the Berber tent on the terrace is the ideal place to take in a magnificent view of the medina of Marrakesh and the Atlas Mountains. Renovated in 2010, the air-conditioned establishment welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. The property also offers a hotel safe, TV lounge, café, breakfast room, room and laundry services and bicycle hire.

The rooms and suites are equipped with air conditioning (individually regulated) and heating. Suites Fes and Essaouira are equipped with fireplaces and the atmospheres are created in the style of Dar El Beida with Art Deco furniture, the Berber style of Zagora and the colours of the Red City, Marrakech. The en suite bathrooms in the rooms are fitted with a shower and hairdryer. All accommodation features a double bed and Internet access.

The riad offers guests an indoor swimming pool and children's swimming area, a sun terrace and massage and spa treatments for a relaxing stay. Guests can find a golf course about 700 m from the riad.

The meals are served either inside in the Western dining room, the Moroccan lounge, outside at the edge of the pond or on the terrace. Products are fresh, bought every day on the market. The breakfasts are served each morning. Lunch and dinner are offered à la carte.

140949.description: Acropolis Hill Hotel enjoys one of the most privileged locations in the centre of Athens. It is nestled in the serene green area of the Philopappou, offering Acropolis views and luxury accommodation near the new Acropolis Museum and the historic centre of Athens in Greece. It is a 10-minute walk from the Plaka area. The venue welcomes its guests with a large lobby lounge with an urban, chic character, red plump sofas and modern decoration and a beautiful bar serving refreshing drinks. Recently renovated it offers modern and elegant rooms that include a private balcony, some with a view of the Acropolis. Guests can relax around the large outdoor saltwater swimming pool or the roof terrace with views over the Acropolis, Lycabettus Hill, the Hill of the Muses, and the whole of Athens. Acropolis Hill hotel is ideal for a business meeting in one of its conference rooms topped with an excellent catering that offers Coffee Beaks, Luncheon and dinners.

140959.description: Enjoy a wealth of amenities at Hotel Ninety, including an outdoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. Stay connected with complimentary wired and wireless internet access in your guestroom, and enjoy cable programming and a kitchenette. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies), or enjoy room service during limited hours. Mingle with other guests at the daily complimentary reception or unwind at the bar/lounge after exploring nearby attractions such as Oscar Freire Street (0. 3 mi) and Paulista Avenue (0. 6 mi). This hotel also offers a conference center and three meeting rooms for business travelers.

name.content: Villa del Palmar Cancun Luxury Beach Resort & SPA

140963.address: Carretera a Punta San Km 5.200,Zona Continental Is
140963.description: This spectacular holiday resort hotel enjoys a fantastic setting in Cancun surrounded by lush, Caribbean greenery just 25 minutes from the international airport. The resort offers a spa, gym, golf and private beach for guest leisure, and visitors might venture out to the Interactive Aquarium or El Rey Archaeological Site, both within a half-hour drive, or visit Tulum at two hours' drive away. The hotel's lavish suites enjoy garden or Caribbean views from the private balcony and are tastefully decorated with sleek, modern furnishings and oversized hammocks. Guests can choose from five onsite restaurants to enjoy Japanese, Greek, American and regional Mexican cuisines. Whether seeking a relaxing holiday swimming and sunbathing by the five outdoor pools, or adventure and culture visiting the region's various archaeological sites and practicing water sports, this resort offers everything guests need for a fabulous holiday.

141034.description: Situated on the edge of the Marne, close to Paris Porte de Bercy and just five minutes from the RER station A, offering direct access to the center of Paris, the Hotel offers spacious and modern rooms. Rooms are soundproofed, air-conditioned and nonsmoking rooms, with a flat-screen television including cable and a free WIFI connection. The reception is open 24 hours. Enclosed free parking, both outdoor and indoor, is at your disposal. Buffet breakfast is available at a charge.

141073.description: Enjoy a central Vienna stay at the O11 Boutique Hotel, steps from the Vienna State Opera and a short walk from the Hofburg Imperial Palace. This boutique hotel offers 49 individually furnished guestrooms with heated floors, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (available for a fee), and utilize convenient amenities such as concierge services and dry cleaning. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies). Nearby attractions include the Albertina and Naschmarkt.

141305.address: Plot 67, L-3, Sector 19-Palm Beach Road, Vashi
141305.description: Located within the central commercial zone of Vashi, the hotel provides easy access to the most popular shopping centres, multiplexes and a wide selection of restaurants and bars. The hotel is 25 km from the international airport, 28 km from the domestic airport and within easy reach of Vashi railway station. This contemporary and vibrant business hotel is located in the high-class commercial area of Vashi. The hotel provides high-quality services to cater to the needs of today's modern business travellers. The hotel provides excellent accommodation units and features a 24-hour business centre and a coffee shop. Thus the hotel provides the perfect combination of business and leisure matching the high expectations of both business and leisure travellers. Guests are welcomed in the lobby with a 24-hour reception service, while on-site facilities include air conditioning, a currency exchange service, conference facilities, Internet access, room and laundry services, and a car park. The hotel provides luxurious accommodation units in its well-appointed guest rooms which are categorised as either Deluxe Rooms or Club Rooms. All rooms are comfortable, well-furnished and have been designed to offer the ultimate in comfort. Rooms are equipped with all the latest amenities such as an LCD TV with satellite channels, a minibar, a direct dial telephone, a tea/coffee maker and an electronic safe. All rooms are en suite with a shower, bath and hairdryer. Further in-room amenities include a king-size bed, Internet access and an ironing set. The hotel features a well-equipped health club. Guests can also take a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool or work out in the gym.

141461.description: The Hotel Reding Croma offers a unique boutique experience in the heart of Barcelona, just steps from Plaza de Catalunya and Las Ramblas. Each room is individually designed, providing a personalized stay with innovative touches. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site parking, a versatile event lounge, and convenient access to the city center, perfect for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel's vibrant design, incorporating a Dreaming in Color theme, creates cozy and comfortable spaces from reception to the smallest details, ensuring an unforgettable experience.

141462.address: Quartier Anzourh El Kabli Commune Lalla Takerkoust
141462.description:
The villa is located at the foot of the Atlas Mountains and is 35 km from Marrakesh, where guests will find restaurants, bars, clubs and shops. There are links to the public transport nearby and the train station is about a 35-minute drive away. The hotel offers views over the lake of Lalla Takerkoust. Menara Airport is about 32 km away.

The 6 rooms at this charming country house were decorated and fitted out with the country in mind. Guests are welcomed in the lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services and a currency exchange. Guests can wine and dine in the café, bar or restaurant. The hotel provides facilities including free wireless Internet access, car rental, an ironing service, laundry service, airport shuttle, bike hire, child minding and an excursions desk.

All the rooms of the hotel feature individual décor and come with a privative bathroom with a shower, bath and hairdryer as well as Internet access. Double or king-size beds are available. The air conditioning and heating are individually regulated.

The hotel's outdoor swimming pool offers fantastic views over the lake and the mountains. In this little piece of heaven allying a relaxed rhythm of life with user friendliness and refinement, numerous activities are possible, including horse riding, jet skiing, quad biking and golf (some incur additional fees). There are also sun loungers laid out ready for use on the sun terrace and on the nearby sandy beach. Guests can also enjoy a massage or play table tennis. The hotel organises an entertainment programme for adults (for a fee).

At the hotel restaurant guests can savour traditional specialities prepared with organic products, served on the terrace, in the flowery garden or in the lounge near the fireplace. The hotel serves breakfast, and both lunch and dinner from a set menu. Lunch is additionally available à la carte.

141490.description: Nestled on the exclusive Palm Jumeirah peninsula, One&Only The Palm offers a secluded oasis of Moorish and Andalusian-inspired architecture blended with contemporary chic interiors. The resort boasts 64 rooms, 26 suites, and 4 private beach villas, each offering a residential feel within the Manor House, low-rise Mansions, or beachfront setting. Guests can enjoy an 850 sqm swimming pool, 450 meters of private beach, and the luxurious One&Only Spa and fitness center. A short water taxi or limousine ride connects guests to the vibrant energy of Dubai.

141536.address: The Crescent West, Palm Jumeirah P.O Box 213208, .
141536.description: The Kempinski Hotel Palm Jumeirah is gracefully situated on the western crescent of Palm Jumeirah, one of the world's most coveted addresses. With magnificent views on both sides, the suites, penthouses, and villas overlook either the striking Dubai skyline or the azure waters of the Arabian Sea. This extravagant property sprawls over 500 meters of Dubai's prestigious Palm Jumeirah, a man-made island shaped like a date palm. The hotel offers 244 suites, penthouses, and villas, along with an exquisite selection of restaurants and bars, catering to travelers seeking stylish, luxurious accommodations.

name.content: Casas Novas Countryside Hotel Spa & Events

141558.description: This enchanting rural hotel was built in 1754 and was owned by several distinguished Portuguese families with coats of arms. It is located atop of a hill on the outskirts of Casas Novas, Chaves, in Portugal and offers the perfect position to enjoy a unique and luxurious stay. This stylish, historical hotel is rooted in the past but it also has a strong connection with the present. It offers an exceptional degree of privacy, comfort and hospitality, as well as private terraces overlooking a beautiful panoramic view of valleys and mountains in most of their well-appointed and romantic guest rooms and suites. This is the perfect escape for discerning guests that like to experience a peaceful rural lifestyle and who recognize and appreciate the exclusivity of luxury with a personal level of service and fine amenities like a wine bar and a wine cellar.

name.content: Four Points Flex Sheraton Istanbul Taksim Square

141580.description: Enjoy convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a cozy lobby fireplace. Dine at the on-site restaurant or grab a snack at the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service and a bar/lounge for evening relaxation. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (7:00 AM to 10:30 AM, for a fee). Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours). Relax in one of the 42 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions with satellite programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi is provided. Private bathrooms with showers offer rainfall showerheads and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. The hotel is conveniently located near Istiklal Avenue (0. 3 km).

141581.description: Enjoy recreational amenities including outdoor tennis courts, an indoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel restaurant, or take advantage of room service (during limited hours). Unwind with a drink at the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served weekdays from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:30 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self-parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 46 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, daily housekeeping, and irons/ironing boards (upon request) are also provided. Nearby attractions include Hilltown AVM (1. 8 km), Bağdat Avenue (4 km), and Maltepe Park Mall (5 km). The nearest airports are Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen International Airport (SAW) (28. 5 km) and Istanbul Airport (IST) (57. 8 km). The preferred airport is SAW.

141587.description: Perfectly situated in the heart of the ancient medina and the souks, the beautiful Riad Chorfa is a palace dating back to the 18th century, caringly restored and opened in 2000 as a luxury boutique hotel. It has maintained many of its Moorish features, such as a lovely interior courtyard with a fountain. Famous Djemma el Fna square is only 400 metres away; the traditional markets can be reached within a 2-minute stroll. Ben Youssef Madrasa with its 16th-century Islamic architecture is within a 10-minute walk. A wonderful place to start exploring this fascinating city.

name.content: Andaz 5Th Avenue A Concept By Hyat

141604.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include wedding services and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at the hotel's restaurant, The Shop, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in New York? This hotel has 6500 square feet (604 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 184 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding.

name.content: Leonardo Boutique Hotel Barcelona Sagrada Familia

141605.description: This modern and stylish hotel housed in an old printing-press building, is nestled in L'Eixample very close to the renowned architectonic master piece of La Sagrada Familia. The city centre can easily be reached with the public transport service or the underground, which is located in the hotel's immediate vicinity. Within the area, guests will be able to find a wide range of cafes, restaurants, boutiques and shops. This is a perfect hotel from where to begin discovering the city.

141625.description: Opened in 2011, this contemporary hotel sits at the foot of Montjuïc hill, just steps from Avinguda del Paral·lel and a five-minute walk from the ferry terminal. Famous attractions such as Las Ramblas, Plaça de Catalunya, and Plaça d'Espanya, with the Fira de Barcelona trade fair center, are within walking distance. The hotel is also close to the old port and cruise terminal. It offers bright, spacious guest rooms with an art-deco flair. Soundproofed windows and a quiet location create a home-like atmosphere. Amenities include flat-screen TVs, telephones, coffee and tea making facilities, hairdryers, and high-quality, eco-friendly bathroom products. Guests can also enjoy the excellent spa and well-equipped fitness center. Please note that children under 12 are not permitted in the spa.

141631.description: Camps Bay, an opulent residential and vacation spot, nestled between the Twelve Apostles Mountain Range and a beautiful palm-fringed beach, is Cape Town's jet-setting capital. The hotel is set on the promenade, directly opposite the beach. It is only 7 minutes from the Central Business District and V&A Waterfront and within a short drive from Table Mountain and Constantia Winelands. Showcasing superbly designed rooms, suites and penthouses, this beach hotel is favoured by romantics, families and business people alike. Some of the units feature stunning mountain, ocean and pool views. The unique hotel's restaurants invite visitors on a journey through flavours from local and international cuisines accompanied by the finest wines and elegant atmosphere. The on-site spa and fitness centre are among the offerings and visitors may also use the nearby tennis and squash courts. There are also functional meeting facilities and parking for guests' added convenience.
