141632.description: Overlooking the tranquil Langebaan lagoon, The Farmhouse Hotel is an experience to be savoured. Celebrated for our pleasant staff and West Coast warmth, The Farmhouse Hotel offers guests an authentic coastal farmstead experience. Explore the lagoon or simply relax and enjoy the sunset. La Petite Maison a gastronomic delight, with exquisite taste and visual appeal, coupled with gracious French-style service and beautiful lagoon views. The charming atmosphere is cosy, warm and familiar. The Farmhouse Hotel is an unpretentious and welcoming escape for travellers and families who appreciate the warmth of farm style hospitality.

141641.description: This aparthotel is ideally located in Vitry-sur-Seine, just 3 km from Paris. It's a great base for exploring the city's rich culture and history. The Rungis International Market is 10 km away, while the Exploradome and Port de Versailles are easily accessible by car. The Val-de-Marne Museum is just 400 meters from the hotel. This charming complex offers comfortable, well-equipped apartments, providing a relaxing setting for guests.

141687.description:
During the current pandemic, this hotel is open only for housing key workers and workers with no alternative abode. Breakfast is a self-service 'grab & go' on departure.

The Best Western Gatwick Skylane Hotel, the shortest of short-hauls away from London Gatwick Airport, is ideal for overnight stays en route to foreign destinations and just the ticket for short breaks close to London too.

The hotel is as affordable as it is affable, combining great value with friendly service and warm Best Western personality. And as you would expect from a conveniently located London Gatwick Airport hotel, we offer parking and transfers to make your journeys a joy. 

Situated in the south east of England, the Best Western Gatwick Skylane Hotel also puts you within touching distance of Central London, with a 45 minute train ride making departures to London Gatwick Airport equally hassle free.

From our bar to our breakout areas and our restaurant to our rooms, the hotel has everything you might need for functions, conferences, meetings, weddings, private parties and great nights sleeps! Airport shuttle from 6am to 11:40 pm. 3 GBP one way or 5 GBP round trip. Out of these hours suggest Roadrunners taxi phone: 01293 780 780 (24hrs). Airport Shuttle: North/South Terminals coach pick-up points listed as ‘Days Hotel Gatwick'.

141690.description:
White House Hotel is 1990 built property, specialised to cover all facilities and requirements for passengers travelling to & from Gatwick airport. 
We have Concierge services within 5-10miles, for leisure, shopping, beaches, historical places, wedding venues, nature reserves, countryside walks and cyclings etc. 
The Hotel is suitable for adults, business delegates, day rooms, airline crews, students, families and aged guests who need ground-floor rooms. 
We have one of the best locations, which is just 10 minutes’ drive from Gatwick Airport and 10-minutes walk from Horley town centre and train station offers services to central London, Brighton, and many other places to be visited. M23 motorway is 2 miles away, and M25 is 5miles. 

Hosted by experienced family in the hospitality industry, making your stay comfortable, valuable, memorable in a relaxed & friendly atmosphere. 

The bedrooms at Gatwick White House feature colourful linens, towels and a private bathroom with free toiletries and other small travelling essentials. consists of a water bottle, tea/coffee facilities with biscuits, TVs. 
Welcome drink dispensers are located at the reception. 
Our additional facilities are: Breakfast, "All day cafe" Bar and Restaurant, evening meals, transfers to Gatwick, car park, luggage storage, laundry and customised services as required. 
Charges are applicable and preferable to book in advance. 

Charges are applicable and preferable to book in advance. towels and a private bathroom with free toiletries and other small travelling essentials. consists of a water bottle, tea/coffee facilities with biscuits, TVs.

141697.description: This apartment complex boasts a prime setting at the heart of Madrid. The complex is located just a short walking distance away from Plaza Espana. Noviciado metro station is 200 metres away. A wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found nearby. The historical city centre is just 250 metres away. Many museums can be found in the vicinity. Madrid Barajas Airport is 15 km away. This charming apartment hotel enjoys a stunning architectural design. The apartments are bright and elegantly styled. Business travellers are sure to appreciate the conference facilities, meeting rooms and business centre that the property has to offer.

name.content: Ribeira Collection Hotel by Piamonte Hotels

141702.description: The Ribeira Collection Hotel is a 4 star charming hotel, housed in a historic building from 1916. Located in the heart of the village of Arcos de Valdevez, Viana do Castelo District, the hotel is 5 minutes walk distance from the river beach, 1 hour from Porto and Vigo.  With 37 elegant rooms distributed by 4 typologies, located on the Vez river, all rooms are equipped with minibar, air conditioning, flat screen TV, safe and free wi-fi.  The hotel has a SPA with all facilities as well as a large garden with direct access to the river. It has a private garage, a terrace, the lobby bar and the 1880 English bar, where you can enjoy the best of our special menu, while enjoying the interior garden.  It also has facilities for corporate events, fruit of its central location. 50 minutes from Porto - Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport, the Ribeira Collection Hotel is the closest access to the Peneda Gerês National Park, where you can explore its vast nature.

name.content: Ibis Styles Paris Jardin de la Villette

141710.description: Breakfast and unlimited WIFI included in all Ibis Styles Paris Jardin de la Villette rates. This stylish hotel features 40 rooms that pay tribute to Rosa Parks and Martin Luther King. Near the Parc de la Villette, the Zénith stadium and the Centquatre cultural center. The hotel is on metro line 7 (Crimée) with links to the Gare du Nord and Gare Saint-Lazare stations via the RER E and the new Rosa Parks station. The Sacré-Coeur in Montmartre and the Louvre are within easy reach on nearby public transport

141760.description: The ibis Styles Antony Paris Sud, open since March 2016, is ideally located on the Antony Pole business park and close to Orly airport. This design hotel features contemporary, a bar and a restaurant. If you are staying with us for leisure, book our family suites which can accommodate up to four people. For your business stays, our two seminar rooms have everything you need for your meetings. Direct access from the A6 and A10 highways.

141801.description:
Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After making a splash in one of the 4 indoor and 8 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. This property also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Sentido Kamelya Fulya Hotel - All Inclusive. Wind down with a drink at one of the 2 beach bars or 3 poolside bars.

Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.

141899.description: Discover Istanbul's rich history at The Time Hotel Old City, located near the ancient city gates in the Laleli district. This boutique hotel offers 65 stylish rooms for a comfortable and restful stay. Enjoy convenient access to local transportation and Istanbul's captivating attractions. The hotel's striking architecture and exceptional facilities cater to your leisure, dining, and recreational needs, promising a memorable Istanbul experience.

141950.description: The total number of rooms is 31. Clients may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception. This hotel has a minimum impact on the environment, thanks to its sustainable practices. Chic & Basic Born may charge a fee for some services.

141964.description: Located along South Africa's scenic Garden Route, less than a four-hour drive from Cape Town International Airport, the award-winning Gondwana Game Reserve offers a luxurious safari getaway. This private, malaria-free, 11, 000-hectare reserve provides an authentic Big 5 free-roaming safari experience. Guests can choose from romantic, stand-alone suites or family-friendly villas, all featuring stunning views. Expert-guided game drives, a Junior Ranger program, Africology spa treatments, and fynbos bush walks are available. Accommodation includes meals and game drives. For exclusive luxury, Ulubisi House accommodates 6 adults or 4 adults and 4 children.

142059.description: The hotel enjoys a stunning location on the Asian shores of the Bosphorus in the Kanlica district of Istanbul. A number of sightseeing attractions are within the area of the hotel such as Sultanahmet, home to Topkapi Palace. St Sophia and many other must-see attractions during a stay in the city is 13 km away. The nearest public transport connection is about 100 m away. Atatürk International Airport is roughly 35 km away and Sabiha Gökçen International Airport is approximately 25 km from the hotel. Built inside a historic Ottoman mansion on the Asian shores of the Bosphorus, the hotel elegantly blends Old World architecture with luxurious contemporary facilities and interior design. Awarded the 2009 Condé Nast Johansens Award for Excellence as 'Most Excellent Charming Hotel' in Europe, the hotel blends attention to detail with individual service and a hip vibe. The boutique hotel has 16 rooms, 10 deluxe and 6 suites, each with a modern design within a 1870s pavilion setting. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services. Facilities include a hotel safe, currency exchange, cloakroom and lift access to the upper floors. The hotel also has its own café, restaurant and bar. Conference facilities are available to business travellers. Additional services include free Internet access and a complimentary shuttle service to the European side of the city. Guests can also take advantage of the room and laundry services on offer (fees apply to both). Those guests who are arriving by car may park their vehicle in the hotel's car park.

142101.description: The Parque 97 Suites Hotel offers an exceptional location in Bogota's exclusive Chico neighborhood, in the heart of the financial district. Close to major shopping centers and the renowned Parque 93 and Zona T, this hotel provides convenient access to the city's attractions. El Dorado International Airport is a 35-minute drive away. The hotel features 75 newly renovated, spacious rooms across eight floors. Each room is equipped with modern amenities, including acoustic design, comfortable bedding, a 32 LCD TV, safe, desk, and Wi-Fi. Two restaurants serve a variety of national and international dishes, and a complimentary buffet breakfast is offered daily. Guests can also enjoy private parking, Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, access to a business center, and 24-hour concierge service. Laundry service is available for an additional fee. All rates include breakfast. Guests can opt for hotel insurance at COP 5, 000 per person, per night.

142127.description: The hotel is conveniently located in Yenikapi, approximately a 20-minute walk to the highlights of Sultanahmet. Public transport links are a couple of minutes' walk from the hotel while a tram stop is just around the corner. Ataturk International Airport is approximately 13 km and Sabiha Gokcen International Airport is roughly 47 km from the hotel. This is a historical hotel refurbished in 2010, offering 93 guest rooms and a variety of services and facilities, including a restaurant with panoramic views over the city and Marmara Sea on the top floor. The rooms are tastefully decorated and enjoy modern amenities. Each room has an en suite bathroom and features individually controlled air conditioning for a more comfortable stay. The hotel offers SPA treatments for guests seeking a relaxing vacation. Guests who prefer to stay in shape can work out in the on-site gym.

142131.description: This hotel revels in the wonders of its surroundings of Marrakech. It is located close to the myriad of intriguing attractions that this culturally-rich city has to offer. The hotel is situated just a short distance away from Jemaa El Fna. A treasure trove of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues can be found nearby. Links to the public transport network are situated close to the hotel. This charming, historical hotel oozes grandeur and style. The guest rooms are presented in a refined, sophisticated style. The hotel features a breakfast room. The hotel's facilities deliver a high level of excellence.

142180.description:
Located at 16 bis Avenue de Paris in Éaubonne, Hotel L’Eaubonne enjoys a prime location just 20 minutes from central Paris by public transport (or 40 minutes by car), while offering a peaceful and relaxing setting—perfect for both business and leisure stays. 
The hotel is just a short walk from local bus stops and the RER stations of Enghien-les-Bains and Ermont-Éaubonne, providing easy access to the surrounding areas. Just 1 km away, you’ll find the lively town of Enghien-les-Bains, known for its casino, bars, shops, and clubs, as well as the famous Montmorency Forest, which is only a 15-minute walk away. 
Major Parisian attractions are within easy reach: La Défense business district (9. 5 km), the Palais des Congrès (15 km), and the Champs-Élysées (17 km). The hotel is also conveniently located 14 km from Paris-Charles de Gaulle Airport and just 1 km from Ermont-Éaubonne train station. 
Established in 1980 and recently renovated, the hotel offers 48 modern and comfortable rooms, each equipped with a private bathroom (shower or bathtub), satellite TV, and free Wi-Fi. Guests also have access to a private parking area with direct access to the hotel, as well as a fully equipped conference room ideal for business meetings.

142222.description: Located in Avsallar, a vibrant tourist hub in Alanya, Turkey, the Granada Luxury Beach offers a modern, tropical beachfront experience. Just a short drive from Antalya (104 km) and Gazipaşa (67 km) Airports, and within easy reach of Alanya city center (24 km) and the ancient city of Side (43 km), our hotel provides convenient access to key attractions. Each room features the latest technology for a comfortable stay. Enjoy a wide array of dining options in our stylish restaurants and bars, and rejuvenate your senses at our Far East-inspired spa.

142259.description:
Experience the vibrant and flourishing Kurfürstendamm: 
Our 4 star hotel is in the heart of Charlottenburg distric, just right on the world famous Kurfürstendamm. 

With its 72 rooms in the style of a french chateau, we are located on the quiet side street Knesebeckstrasse. It is only minutes walk to all shopping boutiques, the Breidscheidt Place and Bahnhof Zoo (train station) and Zoo Berlin. 

While the lobby is in style of the Kurfürstendamm, our rooms and restaurant pay tribute to the french provence chateau style. 
All rooms are with airconditioning and free WiFi. 

Our hotel is a non-smoking hotel. 

Enjoy your stay in our spacious rooms with tea & coffee making facilities, comfortable beds and in the quiet neighbourhood. 

Start your day with our rich breakfast buffet and welcoming service. 

Nearby, the renowned department store KaDeWe invites you to go shopping, while excellent transport links allow you to explore all of Berlin’s sights with ease. 

The Hotel Chateau Kurfürstendamm is 3. 7 km or a 20-minute drive from the Messe Berlin and Alexanderplatz away. Berlin Brandenburg Airport BER is 25 km away, but easy to reach from the Bahnhof Zoo by public transport.

142287.address: Adjacent To Ibn Battuta Shopping Mall, NA
142287.description:
Inspired by the adventures of legendary 14th-century explorer Ibn Battuta, NH Collection Dubai Ibn Battuta is a wonderland for the modern traveller, with dreamlike architecture, sanctuary interiors, and so much to experience. 

Highlights: 
- 411 rooms, suites and apartments
- Private pool suite available
- Located adjacent to Ibn Battuta Mall and metro station
- Onsite leisure facilities: rooftop pool, spa, gym and salon
- 6x restaurants & bar
- Conference, meeting and wedding venues
- 15 minutes' drive from Expo City Dubai
- 25 minutes' drive from Al Maktoum International Airport
- 30 minutes' drive from Dubai International Airport

142292.address: Corner Abu Bakker Al Siddique and Sallahuddin Road
142292.description: This outstanding property features a prime situation in the heart of Dubai's historic and most culturally diverse quarter, with easy access to several shopping centres and business districts. Dubai Metro is also close by. Guests staying at this outstanding property can explore Deira's vibrant, winding and historic Creek area, where local 'abra' water taxies ply their trade. Guests will appreciate the extensive selection of finely furnished rooms, ideal for guests to de-stress after a day of work or sightseeing. Connecting rooms are also available for families’ convenience. This luxurious property offers the perfect facilities for any personal needs, such as Internet access, room and laundry service.

142302.description: This exceptional hotel is perfectly situated in the historic Old Town of Istanbul within only 15 minutes walking to Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque, Spice Market, Archeology Museum and Grand Bazaar. The hotel is tastefully decorated, reflecting Istanbul's colourful history. Features include 58 rooms, 24-hours reception, currency exchange, A/C and free WIFI in every room, a Spa area, cultural library, car hire, tour desk, concierge service and airport shuttle. Accessible for handicapped.

name.content: Fairfield Inn & Suites NY Manhattan/ Fifth Avenue

142305.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at the Fairfield Inn by Marriott New York Manhattan/Fifth Avenue, conveniently located near iconic attractions like 5th Avenue, Herald Square, and Macy's. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast and grab a snack from the on-site deli. This hotel offers 92 guestrooms equipped with iPod docking stations, Smart TVs, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center and limo/town car service. Enjoy cable programming and in-room safes for a comfortable and convenient stay.

142362.description: The Paris Gennevilliers hotel is located in the heart of the new business district, just outside Paris. It's conveniently situated two minutes from the RER C and ten minutes from central Paris via tram, with Paris's famous monuments only 6. 2 miles away. Nearby attractions include the Leclerc shopping mall, Stade de France, Paris Air Show, and La Défense. The hotel features a unique blend of modern and antique design elements. Guests can enjoy 85 spacious, air-conditioned rooms, on-site parking, and complimentary Wi-Fi.

142392.description: Located in the Sant Antoni neighborhood, in the center of Barcelona, the Market Hotel receives its name in honor of one of the most emblematic architectural pieces of Barcelona's urban growth, the Sant Antoni Market. This hotel with charm in Barcelona stands out for its decoration, a neoclassical and cozy style, and for its great team of professionals that will make the stay of the guests warm and comfortable. The location of the hotel, right in the center of Barcelona, makes the Market the perfect destination for both tourism and business.

142394.description: A total of 27 accomodation units are available for guests' convenience at Casp 74. Visitors can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the property. There is no 24-hour reception. Additional fees may apply for some services.

142406.address: The North Comiche P.O. Box 14315 Jeddah 21424
142406.description: Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including a health club, an outdoor pool, and an outdoor tennis court. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Enjoy Middle Eastern cuisine at Tropical Garden, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Jeddah? This hotel has 4392 square feet (408 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 7 meeting rooms. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 149 guestrooms, featuring heated floors and Smart televisions. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed.

142418.description: These apartments are situated in Camps Bay, approximately 30 km from Cape Town International Airport and 400 m from the beach. The establishment consists of luxury serviced apartments with views of the ocean, Twelve Apostles mountain range and Lion's Head, and finished with modern and clean aesthetics and expansive windows that maximise the scenery. It offers guests the choice of studio apartments, 2-bedroom apartments and 3-bedroom loft apartments. Top class interior finishes emphasize stone and timber, while maximum use of glass curtain-walls optimize the natural light and frame the magnificent views. The apartments feature individually regulated air conditioning and heating, under-floor heating, satellite television, wireless Internet access and a fully equipped kitchen. Key collection is at our sister property, 35 Medburn Road, Camps Bay

142419.description: This apartment hotel is located in Camps Bay, which is known as the most sought after residential suburb in Cape Town. From its elevated position, it offers splendid views of its beautiful surrounds. The beach is about 1. 3 km away. It is approximately 23 km from Cape Town International Airport. The apartments offer guests the choice of studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom, and two-bedroom loft apartments. These luxury serviced apartments, all have panoramic sea views and private balconies or patios. All apartments are fully equipped and features include satellite television, individually regulated air conditioning and heating, washing machines, tumble dryers, dishwashers and Internet access. Outdoor swimming pool on an expansive terrace provide refreshing dips and splendid ocean views.

142420.description: This property is 3 minutes walk from the beach. Set below the Twelve Apostles Mountain Range and across the road from Camps Bay Beach, these apartments feature 2 outdoor pools and complimentarty WIFI. Camps Bay Apartments' units are fitted with kitchen or kitchenette facilities. Room amenities include a tea and coffee maker, ironing facilities and a fridge. The Camps Bay strip, with a variety of restaurants and bars, is within 1-minutes walk from the property. Camps Bay Village is 30 m away from Promenade Shopping Centre. It is less than 5 minutes' drive to beachside attractions at Camps Bay beachfront area.

142421.address: West Quay Road, Marina Rd V & A Waterfront
142421.description: Situated on the vibrant Victoria & Alfred Waterfront in Cape Town, these serviced apartments offer a unique and exquisite marina setting. Guests enjoy easy access to a variety of shops and restaurants within walking distance. Amenities include an on-site reception, complimentary Wi-Fi and parking, swimming pools, and a gym. Choose from Standard, Luxury, and Deluxe apartments, ranging from one to three bedrooms, all featuring superior services and facilities. Each apartment is fully equipped with satellite television, a washing machine, tumble dryer, and dishwasher.

142423.description:
This property is 15 minutes walk from the beach. Located within 10 minutes' drive from the V&A Waterfront and CTICC, Mouille Point Apartments features an outdoor pool, WiFi and a travel desk.
Mouille Point Apartments features studios and self-catering apartments, all of which enjoy stunning views over the Atlantic Ocean, Robben Island or Table Mountain. Guests can choose between open-plan studio living or the larger and more spacious One or Two-bedroom apartments. All accommodation is neatly furnished and comes equipped with selected satellite TV channels, a DVD player and a well-equipped kitchenette area.

Guests at the property can make the most of the on-site swimming pool. The uncrowded beaches and promenade of Mouille Point is just a 5-minute walk away, as are the numerous trendy restaurants and cafés.

Housekeeping provides a daily refresh of the units, while linen and towels are changed every 5 days. This service can be arranged on Sundays and public holidays at an additional charge.

Mouille Point Apartments is just 10 km from the Table Mountain Cableway and Camps Bay Beach and is an ideal base for exploring all that Cape Town and the surrounding area has to offer. 

Mouille Point is a great choice for travellers interested in food, wine and restaurants.most in relaxation.

142424.description: Camps Bay Retreat is a sanctuary for the soul. A luxury boutique hotel set on four acres of lush green nature reserve with a natural mountain pool, thickets of trees, a waterfall, and streams. Stay in the elegant Earl’s Dyke Manor, the contemporary Deck House, or the Villa where the stunning views include the natural surrounding beauty, the ever-changing Atlantic Ocean, and the majestic mountains. The estate features 5 swimming pools and a spa with an outdoor nature tent for an unforgettable wellness experience. The in-house restaurant, Bella’s, places local, organic, and quality ingredients at the top of its priority list. A fully equipped Padel court and stunning, pathways throughout the gardens of the estate make it ideal for outdoor activity. A refuge for the body and a haven for the mind - you’ll unravel and surrender to tranquillity at Camps Bay Retreat.

142427.description: Nestled between Table Mountain, the central business district, and the vibrant Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, this charming guesthouse offers a tranquil escape in the heart of a historic village. Located on Loader Street, it's just minutes from the Cape Quarter Shopping Centre, trendy restaurants, bars, and exciting nightlife. This elegant, nine-room Cape Georgian manor house exudes a relaxed European ambiance. Guests can unwind on the tranquil terrace overlooking the village, Table Bay, and the distant Stellenbosch mountains, or take a refreshing dip in the pool. Enjoy an aperitif on the terrace before savoring dinner at a nearby restaurant, or explore the pulsating nightlife within walking distance. Amenities include a BBQ area, a comfortable lounge, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each luxurious room features a refreshment station with tea and coffee making facilities, a mini-fridge, satellite TV, a safe, a fan, and a wall heater. Guests can enjoy leisurely hours by the pool and savor breakfast at the Village Café or Cafe Charles (additional cost applies).

142428.description: Located in the fashionable Recoleta shopping and residential district on Avenida Alvear, surrounded by the finest stores, shopping centres and typical cafes where Portenos life takes place. Featuring beautiful gardens, the hotel offers a stunning array of sights and experiences along with the renowned Park Hyatt graciousness and service. Palacio Duhau-Park Hyatt, the jewel of the Park Hyatt crown.

142433.description:
Iconic Views & 4-Star Style 
Perfectly positioned for exploring the Mother City, Cresta Grande offers a premium stay with unmatched city and mountain views. Located 3. 1 miles from Table Bay Harbor and a short 13-minute drive from the airport, it’s the ideal home base for both work and play. 
•	Sky-High Fitness: Workout with a view in our 17th and 18th-floor gym, featuring cardio and free weights. 
•	Refined Rooms: Air-conditioned retreats with 32” TVs, mini-bars, and spacious bathrooms with separate tubs and showers. 
•	Global Flavors: Enjoy a full English breakfast or a gourmet dinner featuring fresh calamari, steaks, and prawns. 
•	Note: Our sauna and steam room are currently undergoing maintenance to improve your future experience. 
The CTICC is five minutes from the hotel and the vibrant V&A Waterfront is just 10 minutes away.

142434.description: This charming, family-friendly hotel occupies a traditional 19th-century Venetian villa on the picturesque island of Lido di Venezia, just steps from the water bus departure point. Restaurants, bars, and public transport are within 100 meters, while nightlife and the congress center are a short stroll away. Venice's iconic sites, including St. Mark's Square (1 km) and the Rialto Bridge (1. 3 km), are easily accessible by boat or water bus, which also connect to the islands of Burano, Murano, and Torcello. The hotel offers six double rooms, some with French beds or single bed options, and the possibility of connecting rooms. Amenities include a lobby, flower garden with a terrace, children's playground, bicycle rentals, room and laundry services, and air conditioning. Each room features a private bathroom, satellite TV, internet access, and a minibar. Guests can enjoy a breakfast buffet and, for an additional fee, play golf or rent bicycles and beach loungers.

142444.description: The hotel is located at the foot of the Rialto Bridge with easy access to the public transport network and the characteristic open-air historical area with typical Venetian restaurants. It is 700 m from St. Mark's Basilica. This accommodation establishment is equipped with air- conditioning in all seasons and offers a 24-hour reception service as well as Internet access throughout the hotel. All rooms have an en- suite bathroom with a shower, bath and hairdryer. In-room amenities also include a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a radio, safe and mini-bar. The air conditioning and heating are individually regulated.

142445.address: Paseo De La Virgen Del Puerto, 57
142445.description: The NH Madrid Ribera del Manzanares hotel is set in a peaceful area of Madrid and overlooks the green and luscious Manzanares River gardens. You will find the Royal Palace and the Almudena Cathedral nearby. For business travelers, the Casa de Campo fairgrounds are also close to the hotel, and the M30 highway provides easy access by car. There are 224 rooms at NH Madrid Ribera del Manzanares, each with a flat screen TV and free Wi-Fi. Your sleep won't be disturbed thanks to the soundproof windows and comfy mattresses, while the warm neutral colors and hardwood floors will help you relax. Some of the rooms offer lovely views of the river and the Royal Palace. Enjoy our daily fresh breakfast, with cold cuts, cheeses, eggs cooked-to-order, and fresh pastries. Mediterranean and Spanish dishes are available at the La Ribera restaurant and can be enjoyed on our sunny terrace, along with drinks and snacks. There is also a bar at the hotel. Get the most out of your relaxing stay by heading to the gym, outdorr pool in the summer months, or making use of our massage services. For transportation, we have parking, e-bikes for rent and electric car chargers.

name.content: Sheraton Dubai Mall of the Emirates Hotel

142488.address: Al Barsha 1, Sheikh Zayed Road Po Box 450309, E11
142488.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After a day on the slopes, you can relax in one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and ski storage. Getting to the surf and sand is a breeze with the complimentary beach shuttle. Enjoy Turkish cuisine at Besh Turkish Kitchen, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 3289 square feet (306 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 10 meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite.

name.content: The Ritz-Carlton, Dubai Intl Financial Centre

142489.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After a day at the private beach, you can enjoy other recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and an indoor pool. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. The complimentary beach shuttle makes getting to the surf and sand a breeze. Enjoy Belgian cuisine at Cafe Belge, one of the hotel's 6 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge, the beach bar, or the poolside bar. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services.

142519.description:
Civitel Attik is a contemporary hotel in Marousi, Athens, conveniently located near OAKA (Athens Olympic Stadium), HELEXPO Marousi, Golden Hall and The Mall Athens. Designed to accommodate both business and leisure travelers, the hotel offers a range of room categories suitable for corporate stays, conference guests and families. 

All rooms feature marble bathrooms with walk-in rain showers, complimentary minibar, high-speed Wi-Fi, refillable bathroom amenities and recycling facilities. Depending on the room category, guests can also enjoy a private balcony or ground-floor patio, a comfortable seating area, a dedicated workspace and convenient charging stations. 

With easy access to the Athens business district and major transport links, Civitel Attik provides a comfortable and practical base for business trips, events and city stays in the northern suburbs of Athens.

142520.description: The Civitel Olympic Hotel aims to provide a high degree of comfort to our guests, be they business people, adventurous travelers or athletes. At a glance, within the hotel lies a superb restaurant and bar. Additionally, the spacious lobby provides an excellent meeting place, while the conference room is ideal for events and seminars. Our multipurpose room at the rooftop is an ideal choice for corporate or social events, such as weddings, since it can accommodate up to 290 persons. These services are enhanced by the free indoor parking. The rooms themselves offer all the necessary amenities and features such as flat-screen interactive TV, double-glazed windows in all rooms, tea/coffeemaker, room service, hairdryer, free minibar, laptop-size safe boxes, turndown service and much more. Connectivity is very important in today's fast-paced world for everyone, which is why the property offers fast and free Wi-Fi internet on all floors of the hotel. Business services at the reception include e-mail, fax, printer, postal services and photocopying facilities. Our BaRestaurant will be opened from 07:00 – 22:00*Last order for food and drink 21:30

name.content: Four Points by Sheraton Navi Mumbai, Vashi

142570.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a steam room, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. For lunch or dinner, stop by Wrapped, a restaurant that specializes in Asian cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Navi Mumbai? This hotel has 5167 square feet (480 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 5 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

142585.address: 18 Avenue De Suffren Entrée Au 22 Rue Jean Rey, 22
142585.description:
The 4-star hotel Pullman Paris Tour Eiffel is set at the foot of the Eiffel Tower and the Trocadero. Open 24 hours a day, the fitness room offers cardio equipment, and you can enjoy dining on the terrace at the restaurant, Frame. The property is located 5 km from the Parc des Princes Stadium, only a 10-minute drive away. 

Decorated in a contemporary style, the bright guest rooms offer panoramic views of Paris. They includes a flat-screen TV with free access to the latest films, an iPod dock and free WiFi access. Most of the rooms have a balcony, while some also have a stunning view of the Eiffel Tower or the garden. 

The hotel's restaurant serves modern bistro-style cuisine. It has an open-plan kitchen and a stylish wine bar. A connectivity lounge featuring computers and printers is also available in the hotel. Several types of breakfast are available each morning including Asian, vegetarian and gluten free options. 

Pullman Paris is on the Left Bank, just a 5-minute walk from the Eiffel Tower. It is conveniently located 600 metres from the Bir-Hakeim Metro Station (line 6), providing direct access to the Arc de Triomphe, Champs Élysées and Louvre Museum. . 

A security deposit of €100 per night is required upon arrival. A pre-authorization will be requested on your credit card. You will be refunded on your credit card upon departure if no extras or damage have been noted by the establishment.

142609.description: This hotel basks in its central location, at the heart of Bur Dubai, on Bank Street. The hotel is located within easy access of a number of attractions, appealing to business and leisure travellers alike. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from the Indian Bazaar, the famous Dubai Creek, the Dubai Museum and the Khaleej Centre. The hotel is located just a 5 minutes' driving distance from Dubai's World Trade Centre, while Dubai International Airport is just a 10 minutes' drive away. This hotel enjoys a stunning design, combining traditional and contemporary elements. The guest rooms exude elegance and sophistication, promoting comfort and luxury. The hotel's extensive range of leisure, business and dining facilities are sure to impress even the most discerning traveller.

142644.description: This hotel offers a variety of amenities for a comfortable stay, including a health club, outdoor pool, and two dining options: a restaurant and a coffee shop/café. Guests can also enjoy 24-hour room service and drinks at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Each of the 58 individually decorated guestrooms features a refrigerator, minibar, flat-screen TV, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include safes, desks, and daily housekeeping. A business center, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby are also available. Continental breakfast is offered daily for a fee. The hotel is located near Dubai Tennis Stadium and City Centre Deira, with Dubai International Airport (DXB) being the closest airport.

142645.description:
Located in Dubai (Palm Jumeirah), Jumeirah Zabeel Saray Dubai Dubai is within a 15-minute drive of The Pointe and Nakheel Mall. This luxury hotel is 8. 6 mi (13. 9 km) from Dubai Marina Mall and 8. 9 mi (14. 3 km) from Marina Beach. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After making a splash in one of the 2 indoor and 2 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and supervised childcare. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the complimentary area shuttle. Make yourself at home in one of the 405 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, and LCD televisions with cable programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Enjoy international cuisine at Imperium, one of the hotel's 8 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. Free valet parking is available onsite. 
Please note from 30 Jul 25 the hotel will commence a carefully planned refurbishment of its guest rooms. The hotel will remain fully operational and all guest experiences including dining, Spa, pool, beach and leisure facilities will continue to operate as usual.

142646.description:
Arriving at the All-In-One-Space MOA Berlin
• Experience Berlin Mitte: From here, you’ll be in the heart of Berlin in no time. Discover first-class cuisine in the hidden courtyards of Mitte, enjoy drinks in the trendiest bars on Torstraße, or make the most of the endless shopping opportunities around Hackescher Markt and Friedrichstraße. 
• Station & Getting Here: Berlin Central Station is just a few minutes away, making for a stress-free journey. With 440 parking spaces and 20 charging points in our on-site car park, we offer one of the most convenient solutions in the city
• Trade fairs & business: Thanks to excellent transport links (Birkenstraße underground station right on your doorstep), you can reach the exhibition grounds in no time
• Culture & events: The Brandenburg Gate and the large fan zone on 17 June are practically on your doorstep
• A sense of responsibility: As a certified “Sustainable Berlin Leader”, we use carbon-neutral electricity and support local circular economies. Your stay with us is a statement in favour of conscious travel
MOA STAY: Your personal retreat
Our 336 rooms and suites are designed as “hideaways”. In the heart of the city, you’ll find the peace and quiet you need without losing touch with the world. 
• Facilities & comfort: Air-conditioned rooms, high-quality beds for a restful night’s sleep and free high-speed Wi-Fi are standard at our hotel
• Variety: From stylish double rooms for short breaks to spacious suites for discerning business travellers or families, every guest will find the perfect room
MOA EAT: A culinary hotspot in the neighbourhood
Our kitchen team delights guests with modern Berlin cuisine, combined with international influences.

142650.description: The hotel is located in central Paris, just a 2-minute walk from the Jardin du Luxembourg and 900 metres from Montparnasse. St-Germain des Prés and the Latin Quarter are just a 15-minute walk away. It is 300 metres from RER station Luxembourg, which leads directly to Notre Dame, Chatelet and Orly and CDG Airports. The establishment offers air-conditioned rooms and free Wi-Fi access. Each soundproofed room has simple décor and is equipped with satellite TV and a private bathroom with shower and bathtub. All of the non-smoking bedrooms are comfortable and well appointed. Breakfast is served every morning in the dining room, or in the comfort of guests' rooms. Guests can enjoy a drink at the hotel's bar.

142659.address: Burj Khalifa Sheikh Modammed Bin Rashid Blvd, .
142659.description: An extraordinary blend of style, location and outstanding hospitality, the luxury Armani Hotel Dubai was conceived by renowned fashion designer Giorgio Armani and enjoys an unsurpassable setting, occupying 11 storeys of the Burj Khalifa, with more than 800 metres of height the world's tallest building. Every detail reflects the understated elegance and minimalist approach, creating a unique experience in one of the most dynamic places in the world. Dubai Mall, the world's largest mall, and the traditional style Souk al Bahar are within a 5-minute stroll. A hotel experience as good as it gets.

name.content: YOTEL New York Times Square, Select by Hilton

142665.description: Centrally located in Midtown Manhattan, YOTEL New York Times Square is steps away from the city’s best entertainment, dining and shopping including Times Square and the nearby Hudson Yards. A great homebase for exploring Manhattan, quickly and easily walk to a Broadway show, meal in Hell’s Kitchen, or conference at the Javits Center. The hotel offers room types to suit every guest, budget and occasion with YOTEL's including the signature SmartBed – adjustable for sleeping, working or relaxing. The hotel is also home to two-onsite dining establishments. Green Fig offers an eclectic menu with full-service dining area and bar while Social Drink & Food rooftop is the perfect backdrop for a New York City night. You’ll also find Green Room 42 adjacent to these restaurants, featuring off-Broadway cabaret style shows along with food and drink.

142674.description: The new go-to destination for business travelers in Issy-les-Moulineaux: Hotel Izzy! This newly renovated hotel, conveniently located near the Parc des Expositions at Porte de Versailles, offers the perfect blend of work and relaxation. A magnificent glass-roofed space extends into a tranquil garden, providing a versatile area for work or leisure throughout the day. Enjoy a game of foosball, relax with a book, or unwind with a drink amidst the bamboo garden in the evening. The modern rooms, featuring natural wood and metal accents, offer a serene retreat after a busy day.

142675.description: Situated between Place de la Bastille and Père Lachaise cemetery, this charming hotel offers an ideal location in the heart of historic Paris. Thanks to the many public transport lines located nearby, guests can easily reach the most beautiful places in the City of Light. Guests are welcomed to the establishment in a lobby with 24-hour reception. Further facilities on offer to guests include a hotel safe, cloakroom, lift access, café and free Wi-Fi.

142676.description: This hotel lies just outside the stunning city of Paris. It is located within easy access of the Porte de Versailles Exhibition Centre and the Issy les Moulineaux area. The Gare Montparnasse station is just a 10 minutes' metro ride away. Paris Orly Airport and Paris Charles de Gaulle can be found just 30 km away. This charming hotel enjoys a modern design. The contemporary guest rooms offer comfort and convenience. The hotel features a wide range of facilities and services, ensuring that guests enjoy the best experience possible. The hotel offers a wonderful breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

142677.description: Enjoy a range of amenities at this upscale hotel, including an indoor pool, steam room, and 24-hour fitness center. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's restaurant, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel also offers a 24-hour front desk, laundry facilities, an elevator, and six meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 100 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions and complimentary wireless internet access. Private bathrooms with bathtubs include hair dryers and slippers. Safes and desks are provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Located in Kayseri City Center, City One Hotel & SPA is within a 15-minute walk of Kurşunlu Cami and Ulu Cami. Meydan Camii and the Twin Minaret Madrasa are also within easy reach.

142680.description: This upscale city hotel enjoys a prime setting in the mesmerising ancient metropolis of Istanbul. The hotel is ideally located just a few minutes' walking distance away from Taksim Square, where guests will find convenient transport links to other parts of the city. Shops, restaurants, bars and entertainment venues are all close at hand, while the intriguing Sultanahmet and its host of attractions is a mere 5 km away. The hotel is the ideal option for discerning business and leisure travellers visiting the city. The rooms have been decorated in a modern style, featuring functional space and a soothing environment conducive to work or relaxation. The rooms all come complete with up-to-date facilities for guests' convenience. The hotel offers a delightful buffet breakfast to ensure that guests get a great start to the day.

142684.description: The hotel is located just 160 m from its private sandy beach in the centre of Evrenseki. There are public transportation links a few metres from the hotel, which is only 9 km from the popular, historical resort of Side. The hotel is a 30-minute drive from Manavgat Waterfalls. With its convenient location, the hotel offers easy access to the area's must-see destinations.

142724.description: The hotel is located in a strategic position, a few km from the city centre, 200 m from shops and restaurants and 2. 5 km from the Fiera Milano City exhibition grounds and San Siro stadium. It is 100 m to the nearest public transportation links. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange and lift access. There is a newsstand, a TV lounge, a bar and a breakfast room, conference facilities and free Wi-Fi.

142731.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at the Marriott Village d'Ile-de-France, nestled in the countryside of Bailly-Romainvilliers, just a short drive from Val d'Europe and Golf Disneyland® Paris. This family-friendly hotel offers an array of amenities, including an indoor pool, spa tub, sauna, and arcade/game room. Guests can dine at Le Bistro Bar, grab a snack at the coffee shop, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel also provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, a computer station, and 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. Free self-parking is available on-site. Each of the 185 guestrooms features a pillowtop bed with premium bedding, a flat-screen TV with satellite programming, a microwave, an espresso maker, and a bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a bidet. The hotel is conveniently located within a 5-minute drive of Val d'Europe and Golf Disneyland® Paris, 3. 4 miles from Walt Disney Studios Park, and 4. 9 miles from Disneyland® Paris.

142801.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy French cuisine at Restaurant Mangeaver, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Paris? This hotel has 108 square feet (10 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Stay in one of 47 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

142806.description: Nestled amidst the thriving city of Amsterdam, this hotel is within walking distance of numerous amenities. The Vondelpark lies directly behind the hotel. This is a unique hotel located in an authentic 19th century building. This hotel is suited to business and recreational travellers alike, with beautifully decorated guest rooms featuring functional space and modern comforts. Boasting modern furnishings, this hotel exudes taste and poise. Guests are sure to awaken fully rested and energised for their day ahead. Meeting rooms are also available for guests who wish to maintain their workload whilst away. This hotel boasts a lively bar, an elegant restaurant and an endearing spacious garden. Whether for business or for pleasure, this hotel is sure to please each individual guest.

142815.description: This hotel is very close to Brussels' central train station and bus station, and the nearby St. Michael's Cathedral. The famous Rue des Bouchers street with its restaurants is just 2 minutes' walk from the hotel and nightlife spots are just 10 minutes away on foot. All tourist tours can be accessed 100 m away from the hotel, as can Brussels Central metro station. The hotel welcomes its guests into a lobby with a 24-hour reception, hotel safe and lift. There is an intimate lounge, several meeting rooms and underground private parking. Wi-Fi and business facilities are also at guests' disposal.

142899.description: Don't miss out on recreational opportunities including a 24-hour fitness center and in-room fitness. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and a ballroom. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Pestana Brussels Schuman. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Brussels? This hotel has 1076 square feet (100 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 3 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 150 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

142924.description: This family-run hotel is ideally located near Place d'Italie in a residential and peaceful area of Paris from where guests can easily reach the Eiffel Tower (7 km away) and Place d'Italie (just 1 km away). Entirely renovated, this is a refined and modern decorated hotel. This family-run hotel is equipped with everything required to make guests feel at home whilst away. The hotel also has a basement garage available where guests can leave their vehicles for an additional fee. Wireless Internet access is available subject to an extra charge. The property also comprises a lobby with cloakroom and lift access. The en suite accommodation comes with a hairdryer, telephone and TV. Guests can stay connected thanks to the in-room Internet access. The accommodation's kitchen features tea and coffee making facilities. Air conditioning and central heating also feature as standard. A continental breakfast is served in the morning at this hotel.

142933.description: This apartment building is located in the heart of the Eixample, in Barcelona. The hotel lies just a short walking distance away from Paseo de Gracia and Plaza Cataluna. Guests will find Las Ramblas just a 6 minutes' walking distance away. The hotel is a 12 minutes' stroll away from L Sagrada Familia. Barrio Gotico is a 20 minutes' distance on foot. The beach at Port Olympic is just 4 km from the hotel. The nearest metro station is a 2 minutes' walk away, offering ease of access to other areas of the city to be explored. This hotel comprises tastefully-styled apartments, which offer everything that guests will need for a comfortable stay. The apartments offer a contemporary style, oozing charm and style.

142935.description: This wonderful and luxurious hotel sits in a picturesque setting in the magical and enchanting Red City, Marrakesh. This charming property is very close from the old town, where guests will find the main sightseeing attractions and plenty of small and nice craft shops, where they will find amazing souvenirs or other types of objects. All the hotel's guest rooms are lavishly furnished with an inspiring array of typical Moroccan pieces of furniture that will help its guest to feel comfortable in a cosy and charming atmosphere. They are very spacious and luminous and some of them count with exclusive features such as a four-poster bed. Among the on-site leisure facilities, visitors may truly rest and relax at the fantastic pool with a terrace to sunbathe and enjoy a refreshing drink with their beloved ones. Guests may escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life at the well-equipped spa.

name.content: Hampton By Hilton Berlin City West

142936.description: The Hampton by Hilton Berlin City West offers stylish, comfortable accommodations at a great value. Located in the heart of Berlin's City West, near the iconic Kurfürstendamm, this 3-star hotel puts you steps away from upscale shopping, diverse dining, and convenient public transport. Explore chic boutiques and department stores, relax in Savignyplatz's lively bars and restaurants, or easily navigate the city via the nearby Uhlandstrasse or Zoologischer Garten stations. Whether traveling for business or leisure, the Hampton by Hilton provides a perfect base for your Berlin adventures. Its contemporary design creates a relaxing atmosphere from the moment you arrive. Each well-appointed room features high-quality furnishings and thoughtful amenities for a restful stay.

142959.description: This family-friendly business hotel is located in the centre of Santiago, only metres from the fine arts district. Being in the Bohemian part of the Chilean capital there is a plethora of dining and cultural options in the vicinity. The apartment hotel rooms have balconies with breathtaking views of the city, in a contemporary and sophisticated atmosphere. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, cloakroom and lift access to the upper floors. The guests arriving by car may make use of the car park and garage.

142960.description: This hotel is located in Evrenseki, approximately 9 kms from the popular resort of Side. The beach is a 5-minute walk and local transport is 150 metres away on the main road with links to nearby towns. Antalya airport is around 65 kms from the hotel. The hotel has a restaurant, bar and disco as well as a kids' club. In the lobby, guests will find a 24-hour reception, currency exchange and lift access to the upper floors. Further facilities available include a hairdressing salon, games room, cafe, pub, conference facilities and a car park. Each room features an en- suite bathroom and private balcony or terrace. They are also equipped with satellite TV, a mini-bar and tea and coffee making facilities. Guests are welcomed to the swimming pools and SPA centre with various treatments.

143148.description: Plaza Resort hotel is located in Anavyssos-Palaia Fokea, a small coastal village. Located directly beside the sea, there are plenty of restaurants and bars close to the hotel. The tourist centre at Glyfada is around 35 km away, and guests may also visit the ancient temple of Poseidon, which is only 10 km away. Athens International Airport is 25 km from the hotel. The family-friendly hotel offers a total of 132 rooms and has a contemporary Italian design with a minimal, luxury and boutique style. It is renowned for its magnificent scenery and warmth of hospitality. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. Facilities at this air-conditioned resort include a hotel safe, a café, bar and restaurant. The hotel's grounds and guest parking area are well-suited for showcasing events, with the benefit of a variety of conference facilities, making it ideal for an exhibition and a formal dinner. There is also a private area 100 m from the beach for social and corporate events. Internet access, room service and a laundry service are also available. All rooms are stylishly decorated with wooden and leather furniture, designed especially for the hotel, and earthy colours and soft lighting to create a relaxing atmosphere. An en suite bathroom with shower, bath, bath amenities, children's bath amenities, bathrobes, slippers and a hairdryer features as standard. Furnishings and services include a double or king-size bed, direct dial telephone with speakerphone and voicemail, satellite plasma TV, radio and wireless Internet access (free of charge). Air conditioning (hot and cool air), an in-room electronic safe box, minibar and an ironing set are also provided. A balcony or a terrace comes with every room.

143182.address: P.O. Box 237844, Damascus Road St. Al Qusais
143182.description: TIME Grand Plaza Hotel is located just a 10-minute drive from Dubai International Airport and only 15-minute drive from Dubai Exhibition and Convention Centre, Al Mamzar Beach, Deira City Center and some major tourist attractions such as Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall. The hotel is highly accessible to public transportation having a metro station just a 5-minute walk away. This 4-star property, a perfect choice for holidays and corporate trips, features 232 spacious air-conditioned rooms and suites with stylish design including premium quality beds, a comfortable work desk, chair, and complimentary high-speed wireless Internet access. The bathrooms include a range of luxury amenities designed for your comfort. The property offers three delightful restaurants - including superb international cuisine at Brio all day dining restaurant; coffee, tea, and pastries at the Courtyard Café or refreshing mocktails and snack at Splash Pool Lounge. A 24-hour in-room dining is also available. The hotel features a rooftop temperature controlled swimming pool and a state-of-the-art Powerzone fitness centre and Spa with the most up to date and technologically advanced equipment. Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, you're sure to appreciate the unique features and convenient setting of TIME Grand Plaza Hotel.

143201.description: Indulge in the surprising design of Vice Versa, a unique couture hotel in Paris adorned by Chantal Thomass. Each room playfully embodies one of the seven deadly sins, with meticulous attention to detail, from furnishings to fabrics. Enjoy amenities such as free Wi-Fi, a minibar, cable TV, and a safe. Ideally located near the Eiffel Tower and Porte de Versailles exhibition centre, Vice Versa caters to both leisure and business travelers. The Convention metro station, a short walk away, offers direct access to the Champs Élysées and Saint Lazare station.

143221.address: 170 Derb El Mejjat Hilana Bab Ailen, 2
143221.description: Nestled in one of Marrakech's last authentic districts, this beautiful riad offers a unique and restful atmosphere. Explore the vibrant souks and reach the iconic Jemaa el-Fna square in just a 15-minute walk. Relax in various lounges, on the terrace, or under the Berber tent. The cozy rooms blend simplicity and modern comforts, including private shower rooms, air conditioning, and safes. A refreshing patio pool and wall fountain enhance the tranquil ambiance. Golf enthusiasts will appreciate the course just a 5-minute drive away.

143253.description: Welcome to the ibis Styles Bobigny Centre Préfecture, conveniently located 656 yards from the metro line 5 (Bobigny-Pablo Picasso) station, providing easy access to Paris. This hotel is ideal for exploring the vibrant cultural districts of east Paris, including the Zénith, Cité des Sciences de la Villette, and the charming Canal Saint Martin and Canal de l'Ourcq, all reachable within a 25-minute metro ride. Breakfast and Wi-Fi are included.

143263.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as bicycle rentals, a terrace, and a garden at this Teltow hotel. It also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a television in the common area. Dine at GINN Restaurant, offering modern European cuisine, a bar/lounge, and garden views. Room service is available during limited hours. Buffet breakfast is offered daily (for a fee) from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM. The hotel provides express check-in/check-out, a 24-hour front desk, a conference center, and 13 meeting rooms, totaling 5, 500 square feet (511 square meters) of event space. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The 198 air-conditioned guest rooms feature LCD televisions with satellite programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Safes and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is daily. Nearby attractions include All Saints Catholic Church (4. 4 mi), the Free University of Berlin (4. 6 mi), and the Botanical Garden (5 mi). The nearest major airport is Berlin (BER-Brandenburg), 25. 9 mi away.

143279.address: Estrada Nacional 106, KM 39 Torre Portela pnf
143279.description: The hotel is located in Quinta da Torre, a few kilometres from Peñafiel. It is a place with abundant natural mineral water endowed with a richness and bacteriological purity evident in the treatments carried out in the thermal centre. Situated at the confluence of the Douro and Tamega rivers, its strategic location was once an important river port where the boats sailing in the Douro weighed anchor. Its landscapes are so stunning that it is definitely worth a visit. This historic hotel has a total of 69 fully equipped rooms. Facilities available to guests at this family-friendly establishment include a bar, games rooms, restaurant and WLAN Internet access, as well as a meeting room, chapel and a private car park (extra fees apply to parking facilities). The hotel rooms all feature a bathroom, heating, TV and a telephone. The hotel facilities include a thermal spa and a sports centre.

143280.description: This accommodation establishment is located in Vila Nova de Cerveira and on the banks of River Minho. Porto Airport is a 1-hour drive from the property. On-site facilities include a restaurant, bar, sun terrace and 2 swimming pools. The rooms are all equipped with an en-suit bathroom with a hairdryer and free toiletries, air-conditioning, free WiFi, cable TV and a balcony or terrace. A buffet breakfast is served daily in the dining room and the restaurant serves national Portuguese and international cuisine. A library, a tennis court and billiards are also at guests' disposal. Free parking is available.

143283.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center, terrace, and garden. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, a TV in the common area, and a living plant wall. Satisfy your appetite at the RBG Bar, a bar/lounge with garden views, or grab snacks at the coffee shop/cafe. Buffet breakfasts are served weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fees apply). Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in Brussels? This hotel offers 1421 square feet (132 square meters) of space, including a conference center and seven meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 142 air-conditioned rooms with LED TVs, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and digital programming. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. The hotel is conveniently located near Brussels South Railway Station, Midi Market, and several attractions. The nearest airports are Brussels (BRU), Antwerp (ANR), and Charleroi (CRL).

143323.description: The stylish Ramada Encore, located in Doha's Al Asmakh area, is within walking distance of Grand Hamad Street and Bank Street. Our property offers convenient access to museums, Souq Waqif, Gold Souq, and the Corniche, and is only 13 km from Hamad International Airport. As a modern select-service hotel, the Ramada Encore provides remarkable service and reasonable rates, including free Wi-Fi throughout. The hotel's bright, stylish decor creates a refreshing atmosphere for work, leisure, dining, and meetings. The Hub, our on-site restaurant, offers a dynamic space to enjoy fresh, innovative world cuisine prepared by our creative chefs. Guests can also enjoy coffee and snacks at our coffee bar while staying connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. The Hub is committed to using quality ingredients to create classic dishes with an innovative twist. For meetings and conferences, our hotel features two flexible, high-tech rooms with a combined capacity of up to 20 people. Our professional event planners can assist with catering and transportation. Guest rooms include 24-hour room service, complimentary Wi-Fi, an in-room safe, a mini-refrigerator, and a flat-screen television with satellite channels. Guests can also enjoy our indoor pool and fitness center. A hotel car and guest laundry service are available for a nominal fee.

143345.description:
Nestled in the heart of the Chantilly forest, the hotel l’InterContinental Chantilly Château Mont Royal is located just 45 minutes from Paris and only 9. 9 miles from CDG Airport. 
Delight your palate every day for lunch or dinner at our Brasserie and enjoy views of the forest. Exceptional cocktails, refreshing creations, sweet treats or dishes to share, each tasting is an experience in itself. We also serve brunch every Sunday

For sports enthusiasts, we also provide a tennis court, bike rental and a well-equipped fitness room. Meanwhile, our Spa offers a range of rituals and treatments, ensuring complete relaxation for all. 
The hotel’s wellness area invites you to enjoy a moment of pure relaxation. There is a heated indoor swimming pool, a fitness center and a sauna with a breathtaking view of the Chantilly forest. A true sanctuary of serenity, where every detail has been designed for total escape. 
From July 4 2026, our wellness area (indoor swimming pool, sauna, hot tub, and fitness room) will be open daily from 9:00 a. m. to 9:30 p. m. , with the following conditions:
From 9:00 a. m. to 3:00 p. m. , access is free and does not require a reservation. 
From 3:00 p. m. onwards, access is by reservation only, with a maximum of 20 people per time slot. 
Every Saturday, an exceptional slot from 9:30 p. m. to 11:00 p. m. is available without reservation and open to all guests. 
Children are welcome in the wellness area from 9:00 a. m. to 5:00 p. m. , under the supervision of their parents. 
We recommend booking your time slot in advance, as availability is limited. 

Additionally, our property features several reception rooms, all bathed in natural light. The largest room spans 1, 148 square feet and includes a private terrace overlooking the forest—ideal for corporate meetings or private events. Come and discover the magic of the InterContinental Chantilly Château Mont Royal, where history, luxury, and nature intertwine to create an unforgettable getaway near Paris

143385.address: Nile City Towers 2005 B Corniche El Nil Ramlet Bea, 2005 B
143385.description: Fairmont Nile City presents seven dining options, Asian fusion cuisine at Saigon Restaurant & Lounge, authentic Italian cuisine at L'Uliveto restaurant, Middle Eastern cuisine at Bab El Nil. Experience the true Asian International at Gingko Restaurant and Bar. For an afternoon tea, unwind at Onyx Lounge or enjoy a relaxing social setting at Champagne bar with a wide range of champagnes, wines, and cocktails. The Deli for fast meals, fresh juices, coffee, and freshly made French pastries.

143390.description: The luxurious Grange Beauchamp Hotel enjoys a privileged situation in the centre of London, just steps away from the famous British Museum and the shopping venues of the Brunswick shopping centre. The exclusive shops and boutiques of Oxford Street and Regent's Street as well as Covent Garden are within a short stroll, while attractions such as Buckingham Palace, Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament are within easy reach. The elegant hotel exudes an air of unobtrusive luxury. The excellently appointed rooms are tastefully decorated in a contemporary style, and features include high-speed wireless internet access and flat-screen LCD TV. The hotel offers meeting facilities, and guests can dine in the on-site restaurant serving delicious international cuisine. Guests can relax having a drink in the cosy bar. This hotel is a perfect base to discover this vibrant city surrounded by style.

name.content: Leonardo Royal Hotel London St Pauls

143393.description: Situated beside St Paul's Cathedral in London's business district, Leonardo Royal Hotel London St Paul's boasts an excellent base for exploring the rest of the capital . Each elegant room at the Leonardo Royal Hotel London St Paul's features a luxury bathroom with power shower, designer toiletries, and hairdryers. Rooms offer a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, bathrobes and slippers, and free WiFi. Leo's onsite Bar and Restaurant is the perfect place to enjoy lunch, dinner or a cocktail. The health and fitness club features a fully equipped gym with TVs, personal trainers, and fitness classes. The spa offers a number of luxurious treatments, while guests can relax in the hot tub and sauna. The hotel also has 2 floors of meeting and events space. St Paul's Underground Station and the London Stock Exchange are both a 5-minute walk away. One New Change shopping centre is a 4-minute walk away and Shakespeares Globe is an 11-minute walk away. Leonardo Royal Hotel London St Paul's is also just a short walk away from key transport links like Mansion House and Blackfriars stations.

143394.description: Situated directly on Vincent Square, the elegant hotel Grange The Wellington enjoys a prime location in Westminster in central London. World-famous attractions such as Buckingham Palace, Westminster Cathedral, Westminster Abbey, Houses of Parliament, Big Ben or St. James's Park are within walking distance, while Hyde Park or the London Eye are within easy reach. London Victoria Station is just a few steps away. The hotel is housed in a beautiful Edwardian building. The spacious rooms and apartments are wonderfully appointed and decorated in a classic style of timeless elegance and with neutral colours. They are equipped with high-speed wireless internet access and LCD satellite-TV. This attractive hotel is an oasis of peace and tranquillity in the centre of London, ideal to start discovering this fascinating city.

143433.description: Pod 51 places you in the heart of New York City, within a 10-minute walk of 5th Avenue and St. Patrick's Cathedral. This hotel is 0. 7 miles (1. 1 km) from Radio City Music Hall and 0. 7 miles (1. 1 km) from Grand Central Terminal. Enjoy views from the rooftop terrace and garden, and make use of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi. Stay in one of 348 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming provides entertainment. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Satisfy your appetite with American cuisine at Clinton Hall, a restaurant with a bar/lounge. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services.

143437.description: Situated in the heart of Colombia's capital, this hotel offers convenient access to key government buildings, universities, and financial, cultural, and historical attractions. Public transportation is readily available. Guests can enjoy amenities including a 24-hour reception, safe, cloakroom, elevator, TV lounge, restaurant, conference room, and Wi-Fi. Room service, laundry service, medical service, and garage parking are also provided. Please note that some hotel facilities or services may have adjusted schedules or closures due to COVID-19. Further details will be provided upon check-in. Colombian guests are asked to provide EPS identification, and international guests are requested to have active medical assistance insurance.

143440.description: The hotel is located one block from the famous Avenida 9 de Julio and Avenida Santa Fé, in a privileged area of Buenos Aires. Also close by, are Plaza San Martin and Florida Street and 5 blocks from the Pacific Galleries shopping centre. The famous Teatro Colon and the new Puerto Madero and Palermo are just a few minutes away. The hotel's architecture and décor set it apart, as this hotel offers a combination of personalised service and new technology. It provides modern, spacious, bright, comfortable and completely soundproof accommodation.

143441.description: This hotel is strategically located in the heart of Buenos Aires, one block from the Obelisk and Avenida Corrientes. The hotel is located close to the main areas of interest, for entertainment, business and tourism. Links to the local public transport network are close at hand and Puerto Madero is some 700 m away. Hotel amenities include a 24-hour reception, free Wi-Fi, a business centre, bar, laundry service, parking (optional) and room service.

143481.description:
The Appart'City Paris Villejuif aparthotel : More space to live your own way, 15 minutes from Paris. 

On the edge of the capital, with the metro (line 7) right next door: you're 15 minutes from central Paris, free to line up sightseeing or meetings, and in the evening you come back to a real apartment. Private car park on site if you're driving. 

From studios to one-bedroom apartments sleeping up to 4, our 172 fully furnished units give you room to drop your bags and live at your own pace. Each has an equipped kitchen (hob, fridge, microwave, extractor hood, coffee maker, crockery and a dishwasher in selected apartments) and a Chromecast TV. 

Wi-Fi and a 24-hour front desk. Business trip or family holiday: you stay in control of your stay, on a budget that stays under control too.

143508.description: Situated within a short stroll from East Croydon train station and the Warehouse Theatre, the home of the annual International Playwriting Festival, this contemporary hotel is ideal for visitors seeking accommodation in London with easy access to local entertainment. Visitors may easily reach Wimbledon town centre, 10 km away, a bustling hub which offers shopaholics a fantastic retail experience, or football lovers may explore Crystal Palace Selhurst Park and tennis fanatics will enjoy a trip to the world-renowned Wimbledon Lawn Tennis Club. Whether looking for somewhere for a holiday stopover or wishing to explore the nearby attractions, travellers will not find a better place to stay in Croydon Central than this. This hotel has recently been updated with a fresh new look and features  new room design complete with commodious bed so guests can be sure of a great night's sleep.
