They may also enjoy a daily breakfast and throughout the day sip a drink from the bar.

143517.description: Built in 2010, this hotel boasts distinctive architecture and is conveniently located near the area's main attractions. A 24-hour reception and business center are available for guest use. The comfortable, spacious rooms feature a light and dark color palette and amenities including air conditioning, a private bathroom with a hairdryer, a safe, a minibar, and a telephone. Guests can also enjoy the sauna and indoor swimming pool.

143518.description: Completed in 2011, this brand-new beach hotel has an eye-catching design. Shaped in an oval sphere with a flat roof, the hotel is furnished in a contemporary style and sits at the tip of a promontory on Turkey's Mediterranean Coast. Local amenities can be found within a couple of kilometres of the hotel and public transport is available within a few metres. The large resort of Alanya is 20km away and worth a visit for its many shops, restaurants and attractions such as the hilltop castle and Damlatas Cave.

143542.description: The ibis Saint-Ouen-l'Aumône is located on the N184 in the heart of Cité de L'Auto, as well as Caravelles and Epluches business parks. Quick access to the A15 and A115 in the Paris and Cergy-Pontoise direction. 64 modern and comfortable rooms with a flat-screen TV and satellite bundle. Free WiFi throughout the hotel and breakfast buffet. Free private parking for guests, hotel open 24 hours, 7 days a week.

143543.description:
Your Gateway to Unforgettable Journeys at Piraeus City Hotel!
Stay at our 3-star hotel, just steps from Piraeus Port, offering perfect convenience for travelers. Located near the cruise and ferry terminals, metro, and bus stations, we're 3 minutes from Gate E9 and a prime choice for easy access. 
Our newly renovated modern comfortable rooms cater to both business and leisure, with top-tier amenities for a relaxing stay and a 24-hour reception at your service.

name.content: Hotel Alden Splügenschloss - Leonardo Ltd Edition

143544.description: This 5 star hotel is located in the city centre of Zurich and was established in 1895. It is close to the Lake Zurich and the nearest station is NA in Zurich. The Hotel has a restaurant and a bar. All 22 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, ironing set and air conditioning.

143564.description: This business hotel is centrally located, only a few steps from the main shopping boulevard in the west of Berlin. Guests will find numerous shops, restaurants and nightlife spots within a 2-minute walk of the apartment hotel. This historical establishment welcomes its guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe and lift access to the upper floors. Guests may wine and dine in the bar and restaurant within the premises. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicle in the garage. Moreover, conference facilities are also available for the business guests. The spacious rooms offer wireless Internet access, a flat-screen TV and a full en suite bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer.

143578.address: ALTO DA SERRA DE BORNES, Apartado 23, 315
143578.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. For recreation, the hotel features an indoor pool, spa tub, and sauna. Enjoy international cuisine at Nordeste, one of the two on-site restaurants, or take advantage of room service (limited hours). Snacks are available at the two coffee shops/cafés. Unwind with a drink at one of the three bars/lounges. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, an arcade/game room, wedding services, a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. The 23 air-conditioned rooms offer LCD televisions, private balconies, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Bathrooms include bathtubs and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Macedo de Cavaleiros Hospital (18. 2 km), Albufeira do Azibo (22. 2 km), and Mirandela Roman Church (29. 9 km). The preferred airport is Porto Airport (OPO), 190. 8 km away.

143586.description: On a tranquil square, the budget European Hotel offers rooms 3 minutes’ walk from St Pancras Station and the Eurostar Terminal. Kings Cross Station, a 2-minute walk away, offers access to the London Underground. The British Museum is 10 minutes by bus and the British Library is 5 minutes' walk away. Each room at European Hotel has free WiFi and tea/coffee making facilities are also available. Hairdryers and irons are available on request.

143587.description: This luxurious hotel boasts a peaceful and strategic location on Lido Island. Surrounded by greenery, guests will enjoy a relaxing stay while remaining just a short distance from St. Mark's Square and other inspiring attractions. Luxuriously appointed in classic Venetian style, all guest rooms feature a wide array of superior amenities, including air conditioning and heating. Some rooms also offer magnificent views of historic Venice from a private balcony. Guests can savor delicious specialties at the on-site restaurant, featuring a central Murano glass chandelier. A beautiful terrace surrounded by a flowered garden is also available for special events.

143588.description: Conveniently located on the Venice Lido, only 100 metres from the nearest restaurants and shops and just 250 metres from the main vaporetto landing that connects guests to Venice and St. Mark's Square. This family-friendly hotel offers not only that, but also the proximity of the beautiful beach and the crystal-clear waters, both of which can be found within a 5-minute walk. Guests can reach the Santa Lucia railway station within a 5-minute drive and the Venice Airport is some 12 km away, but shuttle service can be arranged to make the journey a little bit more pleasant. The venue welcomes to its lovely flower garden, where breakfasts are served during the summertime and invites its visitors to relax in the elegantly decorated Venetian style rooms. All of them are fully-equipped with everything needed for a peaceful and pleasant stay, CIN IT027042A1H5IKR29X

143589.description: This hotel is located between the sea and the lagoon, 10 minutes away on public transport to the centre of Venice. San Marco Square is about 2 kms away, as is the International Film Festival Palace. The hotel was built during the 1930s and was fully restored in 1998. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception, air conditioning, a hotel safe, lift access to the upper floors, a TV lounge and Internet access. A café and bar are also to be found on-site and a car park is provided for those arriving by car. All the rooms at the hotel are stylishly furnished and include an en-suite bathroom, external sound-insulation, air-conditioning, mini-bar, satellite TV, security safe and Internet access. Breakfast is served in the form of a buffet.

143650.description: Best Western Plus Embassy Hotel, combining understated luxury with the comforts of a modern hotel, provides unforgettable moments of pleasure. The hotel has direct access to the Syntagma Square and the archaeological sites of Athens. It is located between two metro stations just three minutes from the stop 'Ambelokipi' and five minutes from the stop 'Music Hall'. Within walking distance of many public transport stations, it constitutes an ideal choice since everything is easily reachable. This is a 4 Star boutique hotel that is centrally located at the foot of Lycabettus Hill, near the American Embassy, the Concert Hall as well as major private and public hospitals. Enjoy your stay.

143680.description: Continental Bluedoors offers the exceptional location in the heart of Bogota. In addition, all their apartments offer the highest levels of comfort in furniture and space, technical assistance and training of its staff and a system of authentic and efficient service, makes our product an ideal solution to your requirements for accommodation, tourism and business. The traditional neighborhood of La Candelaria, in the center of Bogota, is today the epicenter of culture, tourism attractions, dining, entertainment and the academic and governmental system of our country. This area could not afford not having a hotel with the international features for the most demanding visitors, which allow tourists to live an unforgettable experience. All the suites at the Continental Bluedoors have loft rooms, LCD TV, electronic safe box, mini bar, fully equipped kitchen and furniture in general. *LOCAL TAX USD 4 PER PERSON PER NIGHT MUST BE PAID AT CHECK OUT TIME. *Colombian and resident guests must pay additional 19% VAT, tourists exempt. *Pets: on request. Direct payment at the hotel.

name.content: Citymax Hotel Al Barsha at the Mall

143705.address: Al Barsha District Behind Mall Of Emirates, 1
143705.description: Centrally located, Citymax Hotels Al Barsha gives easy access to Dubai's premier lifestyle destinations, like Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Media and Internet City, Jebel Ali Free Zone, Al Quoz, the magnificent beaches, Jumeirah Beach Residence and The Walk, making it a favourite among business and leisure travelers. Our hospitable service and neighbours like these help rank this hotel among Trip Advisor's Top-20 UAE bargain hotels for 2013. The hotel has plenty of entertainment and dining options, including Huddle Sports Bar & Grill, Maxx Music Bar & Grill, City Cafe our all day dining restaurant, 24hr Lavazza, and the Pool Bar. Its facilities include 376 modern rooms, free Internet access, a gorgeous rooftop pool, a state-of-the-art gymnasium, an easy access travel desk and complementary bus service to the beach. *Per local law, all guests staying at the hotel must present a valid Original passport, Emirates ID (for UAE residents) or original National ID card from GCC countries (Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Saudi Arabia & Qatar) upon check-in.

143715.description: This elegant urban hotel offers an enviable setting between the sea, situated just a few steps away, and the lagoon in a quiet area of Lido di Venezia and is easily reachable by car and public transport. The city centre lies within 7 kilometres and is easily accessible by means of public transport that might be found within 50 metres from the property. This enchanting establishment is a perfect base to explore the myriad of famous city attractions such as the Teatro la Fenice is around 32 minutes away and the Ponte di Rialto can be reached in some 45 minutes, while the Peggy Guggenheim Museum is about 40 minutes away. After a long day of venturing into the city guests may completely loosen up in the spacious and delightfully designed rooms. In the mornings they may enjoy a delectable and rich breakfast to start the day off on the right foot. Pets allowed upon request .

name.content: Stewart by Heeton Concept Aparthotel Edinburgh

143721.description: Tucked just off George Street, Stewart by Heeton Concept is your launchpad for exploring Edinburgh’s historic heart. Spacious apartments, local charm, and all the comforts of home —right where the city buzzes. Situated in Edinburgh’s UNESCO-listed New Town, just minutes from Edinburgh Castle, Old Town, and St. James Quarter. ​ Spacious studios and multi-room apartments with kitchenettes—perfect for families of all sizes. ​Quiet rooms, flexible layouts, and thoughtful touches tailored for traveling families. ​

143759.description: As the lodge is just 3 km from the beautifully preserved, historic university town of Stellenbosch, it is ideally located for exploring what is one of South Africa's oldest communities. Many of the original buildings have been faithfully restored, giving visitors a glimpse of life in the town 200 and even 300 years ago. The beach is about 20 km away. There are plenty of shops on Stellenbosch Square, which is about a 3-minute drive away. Cape Town International Airport is about 35 km away. The rooms enjoy breathtaking views of the Stellenbosch Mountains and are surrounded by 120 hectares of vineyards. Accommodation is available in a variety of units, including 2-room family suites, 1-room suites, superior rooms and standard rooms. This country house was fully renovated in 2010. There are a total of 37 accommodation units available. Facilities include air conditioning, a hotel safe, restaurant, conference facilities and a car park. For additional fees, Internet access, room and laundry services as well as bicycle hire are also available. The rooms are available with kitchens or kitchenettes, complete with a microwave, tea and coffee making facilities, cutlery and crockery for those who prefer to self-cater. In addition to 24-hour security, all accommodation units, both suites and individual rooms, are air-conditioned, fitted with under floor heating, a satellite television, Internet access, room safes and even European wall plugs. All rooms are furnished with a double bed and have an en suite with a shower, bath and hairdryer. The hotel offers a rim-flow saltwater swimming pool, a range of vineyard trails for hiking or running, mountain bike trails, as well as wine tastings and cellar tours. Sun loungers with parasols are laid out ready for use in the resort and on the nearby sandy beach (for a fee on the beach). Guests can also work out in the gym or unwind in the sauna. Golf and biking are offered for additional fees.

143761.description:
The hotel is located in the heart of De Waterkant, Cape Town, tucked below the historical Bo Kaap and close to the bustling V&A Waterfront, having re-established itself as the latest and trendiest hot spot, not only in its continual extending variety of stylish retail stores, restaurants, coffee bars and nightspots, but also in the new trend of upmarket and contemporary holiday destinations. The hotel is 20 km away from Cape Town International Airport.

Inspired by the early 1900 buildings of Downtown Manhattan, the hotel displays an inherent richness and warmth. It has been designed to have an upmarket, industrial New York feel. Textured raw rock, brick and plaster are set against smooth glass and tempered steel. This incorporation of the more sophisticated elements to the more traditional designs gives the hotel a contemporary feel and a style all its own. Guests of this city hotel are welcomed in the lobby with lift access to the upper floors. Facilities include air conditioning, a café, restaurant, conference facilities, wireless Internet access and room service.

The hotel offers en suite rooms and apartments with views of Signal Hill, Table Mountain, Cape Town Harbour or Green Point. All the rooms are equipped with tea and coffee making facilities, electronic safes, selected satellite channels, 60MB free Internet daily and hairdryers. All are en suite with a shower and a bath. Further in-room amenities include a double bed, individually regulated air conditioning and a balcony or terrace.

Guests are invited to take a dip in the heated swimming pool.

An in-house restaurant serving a variety of delectable meals for breakfast, lunch and dinner is available. For guests' convenience, the hotel's room service menu is available daily until 10 pm. Lunch and dinner are available à la carte.

143762.description: Located on South Africa's picturesque Garden Route, aha The Rex Hotel is a celebration of urban style and impeccable service. This elegantly designed 4-Star establishment features a combination of urban, contemporary and classic decor, presenting cool colours and rich fabrics. Its Subtle charm makes it the ideal place for a perfect holiday, anytime of the year. aha The Rex Hotel features 30 standard double rooms and 25 standard twin rooms with en-suite bathrooms. All rooms boast air-conditioning, LCD TV's and extra-large windows.

143812.description: Ideally located in the charming surroundings of the Victoria and Alfred Waterfront, this hotel enjoys an exciting setting. The hotel enjoys views of the harbour and Table Mountain. Within a short distance of the hotel, guests can enjoy a number of retail outlets, restaurants, craft markets, boat cruises and entertainment venues. This hotel was originally built in 1904 as the North Quay Warehouse, and has since been restored to deliver the utmost in luxury and relaxation. The architecture of the hotel exudes tradition and elegance. The guest rooms are spacious and elegantly appointed, with a stream of regal decor throughout. This historical hotel offers a break unlike any other, in a thriving area, where tradition and culture are waiting to be unravelled.

143827.description: Pamper yourself at the full-service spa, and enjoy recreational amenities such as a sauna and bicycle rentals. This hotel also offers complimentary wired and wireless internet access, a television in the common area, and tour/ticket assistance. Savor local and international cuisine at Restaurant Gaumenfreund, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or take advantage of room service (during limited hours). Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM (for a fee). Featured amenities include a business center and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Event facilities consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The hotel's 161 guest rooms feature flat-screen televisions, Select Comfort beds with premium bedding, and private bathrooms with rainfall showers and complimentary toiletries. Located near Letzigrund Stadium, the hotel is also convenient to the Museum of Design Zurich, Prime Tower, and SIX Swiss Exchange. The preferred airport is Zurich Airport (ZRH).

143836.description: Located in Boadilla del Monte, this hotel offers convenient access to Madrid's city center, just a 20-minute drive away. The Prado del Espina tram stop is mere steps from the hotel, connecting guests to local attractions and amenities. Barajas Airport is also easily accessible, situated 30 km away. The hotel features spacious accommodations in a simple, functional style, catering to a variety of travelers. Conference facilities are available for business guests.

143857.description: The Premium Chaves - Aquae Flaviae Hotel offers a comfortable and classic design near Chaves' thermal springs. Whether traveling as a couple, with family, or friends, you can enjoy a relaxing and entertaining oasis. Book your stay at the best online rate exclusively through our official website and enjoy the convenience of being close to the springs. We are continually expanding our services to enhance your experience.

143858.description: This modern hotel is close to the most important universities and the Das Antas zone with the Estádio do Dragão football stadium, home of FC Porto. The São João Hospital Metro Station is just a few steps away, offering easy access to the historic centre, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with its famous attractions such as the Museum of Port Wine. The international airport of Porto can be reached within 15 minutes.

143885.description: This hotel (Actahotels Laumon) is strategically located in Barcelona, lying close to Avenida Meridiana. Guests will find themselves in a convenient setting, close to Sagrera metro station and the AVE train station. The city centre lies just a 20 minutes' journey via public transport. This wonderful, family-friendly property extends a warm welcome to guests upon arrival. The guest rooms provide a relaxing haven, in which to completely unwind in comfort at the end of the day. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests will appreciate the wealth of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. Guests can enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore the splendour of the city. When booking more than 5 rooms, special conditions and supplements may apply.

143889.description: The hotel is quietly situated on large grounds on the fringe of Swellendam, a pretty little town with lush green streets and historical buildings. Restaurants are within strolling distance, and there are shops, galleries and the Drostdy Museum in the city centre. The hotel is surrounded by 2 nature parks, Bontebok national park and Marloth nature reserve. Cape Town Airport and George Airport are about 200 km away and Port Elizabeth Airport is roughly 500 km away. This modern, elegant and luxurious guest house offers the calm and restful feel of a country retreat with the eclectic chic of a design hotel. There are 7 rooms at this guest house which is managed by the owners. The reception is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The guest house also has a dining room and a lounge. The guest house offers bright, spacious garden rooms with doors opening out onto the green gardens. Each room has a private terrace with views over the mountains, gardens and pools. The spacious rooms come with design furniture, a desk, minibar and tea and coffee making facilities. They feature satellite/cable TV with a DVD player, iPod docking station, radio and wireless Internet access. There is also air conditioning and a heater, a safe and percale linen extra length king-size beds. Furthermore, each room has an en suite bathroom with a walk-in shower, double bath, hairdryer, bathrobes and slippers, and 'Rain' luxury bath and body products. The guest house has a heated saltwater swimming pool with sun loungers, a daybed and hammocks on the sun deck for relaxing. There is an open-air hot tub and a gym available. In-house spa and beauty treatments are offered by an authorised therapist and include massages, pedicures, manicures, facials and more. Recreational options include canoeing, golf and biking. Sun loungers and parasols are also laid out on the beach.

143893.description: Malacuna Birmingham is located in the Jewellry Quarter, a hip and interesting area in town where one can find great speakeasies, restaurants and creative spaces. Next to the check-in desk, enjoy a cool coffee shop kiosk with the highest quality coffee and light bites. We offer private and shared rooms.

143896.description: This luxurious riad is situated in the heart of the Marrakech Medina right next to the Bab Doukkaka Mosque and 10 minutes' walk from the exotic Jemma El Fna Square and from a number of shops and nightlife options. Menara - Marrakech Airport is only 4 km away. The tourist centre of Gueliz, with its many bars and restaurants, is a 15-minute walk away. This charming riad offers a patio full of plants and terraces with fabulous views over the snow-capped Atlas Mountains and the roof-tops of the 'Red City', Pearl of the South. Guests will be spoiled for choice by the number of activities which this establishment offers, including offers cooking lessons, spa treatments and massages.

name.content: Premier Inn London Gatwick Manor Royal

143900.description: Jetting away or heading home? Wherever your destination, you'll find a warm welcome at Premier Inn Hotel London Gatwick Airport (Manor Royal). Just a short distance from the airport, you'll also be well placed for business and leisure destinations around London. Unwind after a long flight, or stretch your legs at K2 Leisure Centre. Head for the bright lights and city sights of central London. Or seek out the seaside charm of Brighton and the South coast. After a busy day, unwind with a tasty meal in our restaurant and a great night's sleep in your extra-comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

name.content: Premier Inn London Gatwick Airport A23

143901.address: Longbridge Way Gatwick Airport, North Terminal
143901.description: Whether it's a short hop or a long haul flight, the Premier Inn London Gatwick Airport (A23 Airport Way) is the perfect place to rest your head. And with the frequent shuttle bus service you'll be at the North or South Terminal in no time. But it's not all about the air miles. Keep your feet on the ground with quick connections into London, a spot of sightseeing in Sussex or a jaunt into nearby Crawley town centre. We'll be here with our tasty restaurant and comfy rooms whenever you need us. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

143903.description: This stunning boutique hotel enjoys a central location in the main historical district of Istanbul, Sultanahmet. The hotel is located within easy access of many of the city's main attractions including the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace. The hotel boasts a delightful architectural style and welcomes guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. Priding itself on its charm and attention to detail, this wonderful hotel enjoys a sleek, luxurious style which is sure to surpass the expectations of even the most discerning traveller. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated and enjoy a modern, elegant design. The rooms come complete with modern amenities for the convenience of guests. The hotel provides a selection of exemplary services, befitting the expectations of a first-class establishment.

143930.description: This hotel was built in an attractive and historic building in the heart of the bustling city of Amsterdam. The city is at your doorstep with Leidse Square, Rembrandt Square and the Museums Quarter just around the corner. Other nearby places of interest include the Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum, Anne Frank Museum, Dam Square, Madame Tussauds. Hotel facilities include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception, lift, a newspaper stand, a café and a bar. It offers free Wi-Fi in rooms and common areas and laundry service.

name.content: GR Caribe Deluxe All Inclusive Resort

143954.address: Blvd Kukulcan Lote 64 Bis, Seccion Zona Hotelera
143954.description:
Stay at one hotel and enjoy two incomparable experiences
GR Solaris Caribe is an exclusive adults-only retreat, where the elegance of its Mediterranean architecture blends with the serenity of the Caribbean. Located just 13 kilometers from Cancún International Airport, it offers the perfect balance of privacy, sophistication, and accessibility. 
Its 195 spacious and thoughtfully designed rooms provide an atmosphere of comfort and distinction, equipped with a flat-screen TV, minibar, coffee maker, and privileged views that invite complete relaxation. Room service is available for an additional charge. 
The dining experience is designed to delight all the senses. Café Solaris offers a high-quality breakfast buffet; Bogavante captivates with its spectacular ocean view and an exquisite selection of seafood and international cuisine; and Veneto, specializing in Italian cuisine, provides the perfect setting for a sunset dinner in an intimate and sophisticated atmosphere. In addition, the deli invites guests to enjoy specialty coffees, artisanal baguettes, and light snacks. 
The resort offers spaces designed for wellness and disconnection, such as reading terraces, ocean-view hot tubs, access to a white-sand beach, and areas that invite total relaxation. 
Guests can also enjoy the dining and entertainment venues at Royal Solaris Cancún, expanding their culinary and leisure options. The resort features a private marina just 200 meters away, where you can go kayaking in the lagoon and participate in yoga and stretching sessions on the dock. As night falls, the experience continues with live shows and a vibrant atmosphere at its exclusive speakeasy-style sports bar.

143962.address: Kuwait Street, Al Mankhool Road, Bur Dubai
143962.description:
This aparthotel is centrally located in Bur Dubai, on Kuwait Street, minutes from ADCB Metro Station near Bur Juman Mall. The hotel is minutes from Trade Centre Road, across from the busy dining and shopping district. Attractions such as malls, cinemas, textile and souvenir shops, museums, the Gold Souk, the World Trade Centre with exhibition and convention halls, as well as Shaikh Zayed Road are in close proximity. Dubai Mall is just a short 10 minutes' taxi or metro ride. Zabeel park is also nearby. This elegant accommodation has 173 spacious rooms, which range from studios to luxurious suites, all of them with free Wi-Fi connection. All rooms are well furnished and have modern and convenient amenities such as air-conditioning, washing machine and tea/coffee making facilities. The on-site restaurant offers breakfast, lunch and dinner, specialising in Indian curries and kebabs. The meeting room is for up to 60 guests. Recreational facilities include a swimming pool, and a well-equipped gymnasium. 
Note : Swimming pool is currently under renovation.

144057.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting, just 20 km away from the culturally-rich city of Barcelona. The establishment is located on the Rambla del Celler, close to the Town Hall. Guests will find themselves just 500 metres away from the Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat station. The hotel lies within 300 metres of the auditorium and the monastery, in the Sant Cugat area. Barcelona Airport is just 26 km away. This hotel enjoys a stunning, Avant-garde style. The lounge area offers space, comfort and striking style. The guest rooms are superbly appointed, offering unprecedented comfort and style. The hotel offers many exemplary facilities and services, ensuring an unforgettable stay for every type of traveller.

144096.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an indoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a ballroom. Enjoy international cuisine at Restaurant The Market, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 48 meeting rooms available for events. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 505 air-conditioned rooms featuring Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Tiergarten Park - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Berliner Philharmonie - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Bauhaus Archive - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Legoland Discovery Centre - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Sony Center - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Berlinale Palast - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Blue Man Group Berlin - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Potsdamer Platz - 1 km / 0. 7 mi- German Spy Museum Berlin - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Mall of Berlin - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Nollendorfplatz - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Strasse des 17 Juni - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Brandenburg Gate - 1. 5 km / 1 mi- Bellevue Palace - 1. 5 km / 1 mi- Victory Column - 1. 5 km / 1 mi. The nearest major airport is Berlin (BER-Brandenburg) - 28. 8 km / 17.

name.content: St Christopher's Inn London Bridge - The Village

144097.description: This multi-award winning London Bridge backpacker hostel is located right in the heart of London. All of the rooms are modern, safe and secure, and can only be accessed by digital key cards. Not only is St Christopher's The Village the UK's first hostel to offer Japanese-style capsule beds designed to give you the best night's sleep possible, but this hostel also has brand new private rooms now available too, including ‘The Shard' Room, offering killer views from your own private balcony of the Shard!Please note: We have a 7 day maximum stay policy. We cannot accommodate guests under the age of 18. Bookings of 9+ guests are subject to additional conditions and supplements apply, contact the reception team for any queries. Guests are required to show in date photo ID on check in, the accepted forms are passport or UK drivers license. Photocopies or images of ID will not be accepted.

144099.description: A few minutes from the prestigious shopping area and near the main Berlin sights, the hotel is ideally located on famous Friedrichstrasse, right in the centre of the city. The Brandenburg Gate and the Museumsinsel are only two of the many sights in the area. Guests are welcomed in the lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, lift, and a cloakroom. Business guests can use the conference facilities. There is a cafe, restaurant and a bar onsite. There is Internet access, and for additional fees, room and laundry services as well as a car park and garage are available.

144127.description: Only metres from the centre of the city's culture and nightlife scene this hotel is an unforgettable sensory experience. Stylish design, modern comfort and cutting edge technology distinguish this unique urban oasis. Facilities include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, cloakroom and lift access. There is a TV lounge, café, bar, restaurant, conference facilities and Wi-Fi. Guests can also use the meeting room and business centre as well as room and laundry services, security and medical services.

144131.description: In this hotel guests will find that modern comfort blends with traditional Parisian features, giving it a distinguished air, perfect for their stay in the ‘City of Light'. This hotel is near Montmartre, an artistic district that has countless theatres, concert halls, cafés, restaurants and nightspots. In addition to a lobby area with a 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange desk and lift access, facilities available to guests at this refined hotel include a bar, restaurant. Room and laundry services are also provided.

144133.description: This luxurious boutique hotel enjoys a prime location in cosmopolitan Sea Point, perfect for both leisure and business travelers. Guests are treated to stunning views of Cape Town's iconic landmarks, including Table Mountain, Signal Hill, and Lion's Head. The sea promenade, ideal for leisurely strolls along the Atlantic Ocean, is just 100 meters away. The hotel's courtyard offers a delightful dining experience where executive chefs prepare exquisite specialties. The modern, open-plan rooms and suites provide ample space, kitchen facilities, and superior amenities, including comfortable beds, ensuring a memorable stay. Guests can also enjoy a refreshing dip in the rooftop pool and cocktails on the sky deck.

144156.description:
The hostel is located in the centre of Barcelona, just a few minutes' walk from Plaça de Catalunya and the Ramblas. The hostel is situated in the elegant Eixample district, in the immediate vicinity of the city's main tourist attractions. Within walking distance of the hostel, guests will find restaurants, a metro station and shopping opportunities. The coast and beach are approximately 30 minutes' walk away from the hostel.

The guesthouse/hostel comprises a total of 16 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as a hotel safe. The hostel offers great services for exploring Barcelona. Guests can enjoy the convenience of Internet access (for a fee) and free wireless Internet access. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the nearby parking facility, which offers special rates to guests of the hostel. It is also possible to hire bicycles on the premises.

All rooms come with an en suite bathroom with a shower. Rooms also come equipped with a direct dial telephone and safe. Standard in-room amenities include a TV and Internet access. Furthermore, air conditioning and heating are provided in all accommodation as standard. The superior rooms are located on the first and second floors. A daily cleaning service is provided. Guests can also request a cot in the double room.

144202.description: The hotel is centrally located in the residential area of l'Hivernage, just a 2-minute walk from Avenue Mohammed V with its many restaurants, bars, nightlife options and shops and shopping centres housing countless international brands. The famous Jemaa el Fnaa Square is a 10-minute walk from the hotel, as are the souks, Menara Gardens and the Majorelle Garden. The train station on Avenue Hassan II is approximately 1 km from the hotel, Bab Doukkala bus station is around 1. 5 km away and guests will find links to the public transport network just 500 metres from the hotel. The beach in Essaouira is around 3 hours' drive, and the Oukaimeden ski area is approximately an hour and a half by car. Marrakech-Menara airport is just 3 km from the hotel. This air-conditioned city hotel offers guests a relaxing place to stay for a holiday or business trip, with 51 guest rooms and a wide choice of room types available, including doubles, singles, triples and suites. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a newspaper stand and lift access to the upper floors. Further facilities include a TV lounge, cafe, bar and restaurant. Guests may also take advantage of the Internet access, room service, a laundry service and a car park (fees apply). The guest rooms are equipped with an en suite bathroom with a shower and bathtub, a double or king-size bed and a private balcony or terrace. Other in-room amenities include a safe, satellite TV, a telephone and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. There is an indoor swimming pool with a separate children's swimming area and guests may also relax by the poolside snack bar. Sun loungers and parasols are provided free of charge at the hotel and for an additional fee on the beach. The hotel chef offers a variety of Moroccan and international dishes. Fast food options and a wide range of drinks are also available.

name.content: Pickalbatros Aqua Fun Club All Inclusive Marrakech

144203.description: Nestled in the heart of Southern Suburbs, this hotel is an ideal spot from which to discover Marrakech. With its convenient location, 18 km from the city centre, the hotel offers easy access to the city's must-see destinations, like Jamaa El Fnaa Square and the Menara Gardens. The hotel offers fantastic facilities, including garden, tennis courts, kids club, fitness center, steam-room, to help guests unwind after an action-packed day in the city.

144211.description: Enjoy breathtaking views from the rooftop terrace and garden of the Sphendon Hotel, a family-friendly establishment in the heart of Istanbul. Located a short walk from the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia, this hotel offers a range of amenities, including concierge services, babysitting, a restaurant with 24-hour room service, and a bar/lounge. Each of the 12 guestrooms features a minibar, DVD player, and satellite TV. Modern conveniences such as private bathrooms, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Additional services include express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry, a 24-hour front desk, and airport shuttle (surcharge). Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

144212.address: MITHATPASA CAD.KUCUK HAYDAR EFENDI SOKAK. BEYAZIT, 14
144212.description: This charming boutique hotel is conveniently situated just 200 metres away from the Grand Bazaar in Istanbul. The hotel is located within easy access of the intriguing area of Sultanahmet where guests can explore the delightful attractions, including the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace. Guests will find a selection of bars, shops and restaurants within easy walking distance away, while links to the public transport network are just 150 metres from the hotel. The hotel enjoys an attractive architectural style and blends harmoniously with its culturally-rich surroundings. The guest rooms offer the ideal surroundings in which to relax and unwind in comfort at the end of the day and in which to enjoy restful slumber.

144213.description: This superb hotel enjoys a prime setting in Istanbul, close to Gulhane Park in the Sultanahmet district of the city. Guests will find themselves immersed in history and culture, with the city's main attractions within easy access of the hotel. Istanbul Airport is 53 km from the property. A selection of shops, bars and restaurants are to be found nearby, while links to the public transport network lie just outside the hotel. The hotel's charming architectural style allows it to blend seamlessly with its culturally-rich surroundings, while contemporary design and features embrace modern elements. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated and offer a soothing environment and relaxing atmosphere in which to completely unwind. All rooms come with air-conditioning, TV with satellite channels, coffee facilities, desk, safe and bath amenities. The hotel provides a selection of excellent facilities and services for guests' convenience.

144331.description: Centrally located in New York, the Heritage Hotel is steps from Madison Square Park and a short walk from the iconic Flatiron Building. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a 24-hour fitness center, and concierge services. Guestrooms feature satellite TV, safes, and desks, with housekeeping available upon request. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Madison Square Garden and the Empire State Building.

name.content: Ramada By Wyndham New York Times Square West

144365.description: Stay in the heart of the Big Apple while enjoying free breakfast and WiFi at the contemporary Ramada by Wyndham New York Times Square West. You will be walking distance from the excitement of Times Square shows on Broadway and epic events at Madison Square Garden. If you are here for the holidays see the Christmas tree in Rockefeller Center and the Christmas Spectacular at Radio City Music Hall. We are 10 miles from LaGuardia Airport LGA and 17 miles from John F. Kennedy International Airport JFK and Newark Liberty International Airport EWR.

name.content: Distrikt Hotel New York City, Tapestry Collection

144432.description: Stay in the center of New York City at our Midtown Manhattan hotel. Each room features a smart TV, mini-fridge, and triple-paned windows that let in the sights but block out the noise. Distrikt Hotel features:-Free WiFi-Restaurant and bar-Fitness center access-Car serviceDine on-site at Collage Bistro & Bar. Our cozy hangout serves it all – from grab ‘n' go breakfasts to late-night cocktails. We're minutes from Times Square, Hell's Kitchen, The Empire State Building, and more. The concierge team is on-hand to plan your itinerary and transport – plus Distrikt guests enjoy local discounts. Food & Beverage credit included in stay $29 credit can be used for breakfast.

144476.description: The Comfort Inn & Suites JFK Airport is a popular choice for travelers in New York City, whether exploring or just passing through. The hotel offers a range of services and amenities designed for comfort and convenience, including 24-hour room service, accessible facilities, Wi-Fi in public areas, parking, and airport transfers. Guest rooms ensure a good night's sleep, and some feature amenities such as flat-screen televisions, non-smoking options, air conditioning, heating, and work desks. Guests can also enjoy the hotel's fitness center. A welcoming atmosphere and excellent service await you at the Comfort Inn & Suites JFK Airport.

144552.description: The Comfort Inn hotel in Medford, NY will get you rested and ready for anything. Located off Interstate 495, our non-smoking hotel is less than six miles from the Long Island MacArthur Airport. We offer free WiFi, free hot breakfast and weekday newspaper, a fitness center and laundry facilities. All guestrooms include desks and TVs. Select rooms also have refrigerators and microwaves. Also, earn rewards including free nights and gift cards with our Choice Privileges Rewards program.

144716.description: For a comfortable and affordable stay near MacArthur Airport, choose the Rodeway Inn in Ronkonkoma, NY. Enjoy free breakfast, Wi-Fi, and a business center. Guest rooms feature amenities such as a TV, microwave, refrigerator, hairdryer, coffee maker, iron, and ironing board. Nearby attractions include Shea Stadium, Stony Brook University, Stony Brook University Medical Center, and Smith Haven Mall. Plus, earn rewards like free nights and gift cards with our Choice Privileges Rewards program.

144743.description: A good night and a great savings await you at the Rodeway Inn Meadowlands hotel in Secaucus, NJ. Located near the MetLife Sports Complex, our hotel is a convenient location for vacationers and business travelers alike when visiting the bustling New York and New Jersey region. At our hotel, you can enjoy such amenities as free continental breakfast, free WiFi, and free outdoor parking. We also offer you access to fax and copy machines to help you stay in touch with your home office. Our relaxing guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs, hair dryers, coffee makers, desks, microwaves, irons and ironing boards. Also, earn rewards including free nights and gift cards with our Choice Privileges Rewards program.

145159.description: The most beautiful hotel in the East of Amsterdam, that's how The Manor is known. Where The Manor previously fulfilled a role as a civilian hospital and district office, today it's known as a full service urban boutique hotel. This hotel is conveniently located near the Oosterpark, and just minutes away from the heart of Amsterdam. Public transportation is available right outside the hotel. Guests will find shops, museums and nightlife in the immediate vicinity. Facilities a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe and lift access, a newsstand, conference facilities, Wi-Fi, room and laundry services, and a bicycle and car hire service.

145211.description: This hotel is located in the centre of Braga, close to the railway station, a 10-minute walk from the historic and commercial centre of the city, including Braga See Cathedral. The shopping streets are just 1 km from the hotel. This location is very convenient to visit the sights and architectural monuments of the ancient city of Bracara Augusta, a city geographically located near the most important sights of northern Portugal.

145238.description: This wonderful hotel boasts a spectacular setting in the mesmerising city of Paris. The hotel is set close to a wealth of attractions. The Champs Elysees can be found nearby. The underground station is just 650 metres from the hotel, offering ease of access to other areas of the city to be explored. This hotel is drenched in the rich culture and romance of this captivating city. The hotel enjoys a stunning design, blending effortlessly with its surroundings. The guest rooms are elegant and spacious, featuring harmonious colours and rich furnishings. The hotel offers the latest technology to ensure a comfortable stay for discerning business and leisure travellers. The hotel's first-class facilities and services deliver an unrivalled level of excellence.

145239.description: Located in Barcelona's city center on Numancia, opposite La Illa shopping center and 1. 2km from Sants train station, this bright, spacious hostel boasts unique architecture. The air-conditioned property offers 47 rooms, each with amenities for a comfortable stay, including a large terrace. Guests can enjoy a games room, TV lounge, and a charming café. Rooms accommodate 8-10 people. Guests under 18 must book a double room. Reservations for over 20 people are considered group bookings and have special conditions, including a non-refundable deposit.

145245.description: A stay at The Mirror Barcelona - Adults Only places you in the heart of Barcelona, within a 15-minute walk of Casa Milà and Passeig de Gràcia. This 4. 5-star hotel is 0. 7 miles (1. 2 km) from Casa Batlló and 1. 4 miles (2. 2 km) from La Rambla. Don't miss out on recreational opportunities, including an outdoor pool and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 63 guest rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self-parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Rambla de Catalunya - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi, Hospital Clinic - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi, Carrer Gran de Gràcia - 0. 7 km/0. 5 mi, Casa Milà - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi, Francesc Macià Plaza - 1 km/0. 6 mi, Plaça de la Vila de Gràcia - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi, University of Barcelona - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi, Passeig de Gràcia - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi, Barraquer Clinic - 1. 2 km/0. 7 mi, Casa Batlló - 1. 2 km/0. 7 mi, Casa Vicens - 1. 5 km/0. 9 mi, La Rambla - 1. 6 km/1 mi, Plaça de Catalunya - 1. 7 km/1 mi, Church and Convent of the Salesian - 1. 7 km/1. 1 mi, L'Illa Diagonal Mall - 1. 8 km/1. 1 mi.

145250.description: The charm of this hotel emanates from a unique atmosphere, halls adorned with period furniture, an impressive antiques collection, and elegant rooms and suites, each brimming with personality and generously furnished with original pieces. Superbly located, it offers an enchanting view of the lagoon facing the island of San Giorgio and is just steps from Piazza San Marco. Housed in a 16th-century building, the hotel offers rooms imbued with an Oriental allure, where burning incense spreads a delicate fragrance. The splendid Citrus Garden, with its exotic palms, provides the perfect backdrop for an evening meal from the two-Michelin-starred Met Restaurant, where the chef's unique fusion menus have earned him an enviable reputation and guarantee guests a truly satisfying experience.

145364.description: With an exceptional location close to the Arc de Triomphe, this hotel is an oasis of serenity at the corner of Avenue Wagram, perfect for those looking for leisure, boutiques and high fashion in a pure Paris tradition. The hotel enjoys an fantastic location, exhaling a typical Parisian atmosphere. The closest metro stop is 150 metres away. Facilities include 24-hour reception, lift access, a breakfast room, café and a bar. Wi-Fi, room service and a laundry service are also provided.

145365.description: Located at 10 rue de l’Arc de Triomphe, in the prestigious 17th arrondissement of Paris, our recently renovated 3-star hotel invites you to enjoy an unforgettable experience in the heart of the French capital. Immerse yourself in the elegant and refined atmosphere of our establishment, ideally located close to the Champs-Élysées, offering easy access to the main attractions of the City of Light. Whether you are in Paris for business or pleasure, let us welcome you and help you discover this magnificent city.

145366.description:
Arena Copacabana offers the perfect balance between the comfort of its 135 guest rooms and the vibrant energy of the beachfront. With a rooftop designed for admiring the sunset and a location that allows guests to enjoy the very best of Rio on foot, the hotel is the ideal choice for those seeking an authentic and hassle-free stay alongside the city’s finest beaches. 

With a unique identity dedicated to authentic Spanish haute cuisine, Otaviano Restaurant offers a true immersion into Spanish flavors through classics such as paellas, tapas, and traditional desserts prepared with Protected Designation of Origin (PDO) ingredients. The restaurant holds the international “Restaurants from Spain” certification granted by ICEX, ensuring a culinary experience that remains rigorously faithful to its roots. 

The panoramic ocean view elevates any event experience. The property features the Jesus Hortal and Nélida Piñon Rooms, spacious and versatile venues ideal for a wide variety of setups, from auditoriums to round-table formats. For outdoor celebrations, the Viva Rooftop and the Upper Pool transform the top of the hotel into the perfect setting for cocktails and unforgettable social events. 

*Reservations without the name of the guests made as a block will not be accepted, and can be freely canceled by the hotel. 
**Group Bookings: We consider from 10 rooms. If we identify these reservations, even if separated, they will be subject to cancellation by the hotel, and application of different conditions. 
***The bar, pool, sauna and general area of the rooftop will be closed on December 31st due to preparations for the New Year's Eve party that will take place in the evening, access to which will be exclusive to guests who purchase a ticket for the rooftop party.

145375.description:
Overlooking the Champs-Élysées and close to the Arc de Triomphe as well as the famous Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré, Hôtel Arc Élysées*** is an excellent address for discovering Paris. Fully renovated in 2024, this charming hotel offers 26 elegantly appointed rooms. Guests will enjoy a 24-hour front desk, free Wi-Fi throughout the property, luggage storage, and laundry service. 
All rooms, both modern and refined, are soundproofed, feature parquet flooring, and are equipped with a flat-screen TV with digital channels, a minibar, a safe, a direct-dial telephone, and a private bathroom with shower or bathtub, toilet, and hairdryer. All rooms are accessible by elevator, and a buffet breakfast is served every morning in the dedicated breakfast room. Individually controlled air conditioning and heating ensure a perfect stay.

145376.description: The stylish Crowne Plaza Madrid Airport hotel offers convenient access to Madrid's northeast business parks and Barajas Airport, just a 10-minute drive away. Ideal for travelers, the hotel provides a paid airport shuttle and a Park, Stay, and Go package. Public transport links are easily accessible, with bus routes to Canillejas and Avenida de America metro stations just 500 meters away, and San Fernando train station, a 7-minute drive, offering a 30-minute direct connection to the city center. Explore city highlights like the Prado Museum or enjoy shopping and dining at Plenilunio Shopping Centre, a short ride away. The hotel features seven meeting rooms for up to 220 delegates, free Wi-Fi, and a dedicated Crowne Plaza Meetings Director. Business parks like San Fernando, Las Mercedes, and Coslada, as well as offices of Iveco and Airbus, are within a 10-minute drive. IFEMA Exhibition Centre is also easily accessible by car. Relax in spacious, elegant rooms equipped with comfortable beds, premium bathrooms, and flat-screen TVs. Family rooms are available, and the Sleep Advantage program ensures a restful night with quality bedding and a designated quiet zone. Start your day with a delicious assisted breakfast buffet and savor fine dining at the hotel restaurant.

145377.description: The modern hotel is conveniently located only 5 minutes' walking from the Sants train station, thus offering easy access to all areas of Barcelona. Montjuïc and Camp Nou, the stadium of FC Barcelona are within walking distance. The exhibition centre La Fira is close-by, the airport of El Prat can be reached within 30 minutes by car. Features of the hotel include 80 rooms, 24-hours reception, meeting rooms, free WIFI in the entire hotel, business centre, restaurant, bar and laundry service. When booking more than 5 rooms, special conditions and supplements may apply.

145396.description: This hotel is situated a 5-minute walk from the Aksaray district, with its many restaurants, bars, shops and links to the public transport network, and it is around an 8-minute journey on public transport from the sights of Sultanahmet, including the Grand Bazaar, Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia Museum. Istanbul-Atatürk airport is approximately 17 km from the hotel. This city hotel provides highly comfortable and inviting accommodation options with 28 well-appointed, clean rooms. It offers a range of facilities and services to meet every need, ensuring a truly relaxing stay in the heart of Istanbul. Guests can benefit from the hotel's lobby bar and restaurant and free wireless Internet access is available. Room and laundry services are provided for additional fees. All of the 28 standard rooms are modern with traditional Turkish decoration.

145397.description: Freshly renovated, this charming hotel in the Etoile district, close to the Champs-Elysées, is near everything you could wish to see in Paris. In a place where hospitality and style meet, you will enjoy an elegant tropical chic setting and Art-Deco style. Additional services: Airport shuttle booking on request, cable TV, safe, Bathrobe. . . Intertainment and transport bookings can be made, as well as car rentals.

145403.description: Enjoy your stay at the Park Hotel in Ilford's Cranbrook district, conveniently located within a 15-minute drive of the ExCeL Exhibition Centre and the Thames River. This hotel offers 60 guestrooms equipped with LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, coffee/tea makers, and work desks. Guests can also enjoy free Wi-Fi and a television in the common area. Free self-parking is available onsite. The hotel is a short drive from the O2 Arena (9. 5 mi) and the Tower of London (10. 3 mi). London City Airport is the closest airport.

145406.description: This superb hotel boasts a very convenient central location in the capital city of Spain, Madrid. The property is surrounded by numerous sightseeing attractions and points of interest, such as the verdant Retiro park or the famous Puerta de Alcalá, all within walking distance. Visitors may also be able to discover other parts of the city, thanks to the numerous railway and underground connections in the surrounding area. All spacious and comfortable guest rooms and suites are tastefully appointed with modern amenities, such as soundproof system and a fully equipped kitchenette. Guests will also be able to keep updated thanks to the free wireless Internet connection and may appreciate unique services such as a pillow menu. Everyone will also enjoy the tasty Mediterranean specialities served at the on-site restaurant, which counts with an outdoor terrace and a charming decoration.

145407.description: This splendid hotel is ideally located in the exclusive district of Salamanca, within walking distance of the Goya and Serrano shopping streets and about 7 km from the centre of Madrid. Thanks to its great traffic connections, the property offers easy access to the main sites of the city such as museums, parks and local monuments. Renovated in 2010, this air-conditioned hotel offers a lovely private garden and spacious rooms with a stylish, bright decoration, offering a relaxing atmosphere, ideal to unwind after a busy day of work or sightseeing. Room facilities such as free Wi-Fi, a fully-equipped kitchenette and complimentary water and soft drinks for the first night, will enhance guests' stay and make their visit to the city a memorable one. Every morning a delicious breakfast buffet is served in the hotel and guests can find many dining options surrounding the property. Other services include private parking as well as meeting facilities .

145476.address: Kucuk Ayasofya Mah. Sehit Mehmet Pasa Sok, 15
145476.description: The hotel is ideally located close to Sultanahmet in the historical district of Istanbul. Kumkapi, by the Sea of Marmara, is a five-minute walk and offers a great choice of shops, restaurants and bars. There are links to the public transport network just 5 minutes' walk from the hotel. Istanbul-Ataturk Airport is approximately 18 km from the hotel and Sabiha Gokcen Airport is around 45 km away. This small hotel has a terrace cafe with views over the old city and the Sea of Marmara. In addition, there is a breakfast room and bar where guests can enjoy a refreshing drink. Renovated in 2011, the air-conditioned establishment offers 15 guest rooms in total. The rooms have an en suite bathroom and feature an array of thoughtful amenities.

145516.description:
The hotel is located in the heart of the Meatpacking District on the west side of the city. The area has boutique shopping, restaurants and nightlife. The Highline open-air park is directly behind the property. Links to the local public transport network are in close proximity and the railway station is about half an hour's walk from the hotel.

This property is a private members' club and hotel in Manhattan's Meatpacking District. It offers all the comforts of home with its 24 guest rooms and varied spaces suitable for a wide range of purposes, from curling up with a book to formal dinner parties. In addition to a lobby area with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, cloakroom and lift access, facilities available to guests at this air-conditioned city hotel include a bar, games room, TV lounge, restaurant, conference facilities and Internet access. Furthermore, guests can take advantage of room and laundry services and there is a bike hire service. Younger guests will be entertained at the kids' club.

Each bedroom offers guests a unique combination of luxury and style. In addition to a private bathroom with a bathtub, walk-in shower and a hairdryer, all rooms have Sony Bravia LCD and Dream Systems, wireless Internet access, in-room safes and a minibar. Further in-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, an iron and ironing board and a king-size bed, as well as air conditioning and heating units.

145540.description: Enjoy garden views at the Britannia Inn Hotel in Ilford, and take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a microwave in the common area. Free self-parking is available on-site. The hotel's 36 guestrooms feature LCD televisions and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Coffee/tea makers and desks are provided for your convenience, and housekeeping is offered daily. The hotel is conveniently located near ExCeL Exhibition Centre and the Thames River, and within a 15-minute drive of London City Airport. It's also within easy reach of attractions like London Bridge and St. Paul's Cathedral.

145542.description: The Best Western London Ilford Hotel offers a perfect blend of business and leisure accommodations in the heart of Ilford Town Centre, just 20 minutes from Central London. Enjoy easy access to shopping, markets, and financial institutions, all within easy reach. Back at the hotel, unwind in well-appointed rooms featuring flat-screen HDTVs, radios, private telephones, tea/coffee makers, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Our new state-of-the-art media hubs allow you to connect your iPod, MP3 player, DVD player, PlayStation, Xbox, laptop, or digital video camera to your TV and also offer Bluetooth connectivity for mobile phones. For effortless travel to the capital, the hotel is conveniently located just two minutes from Ilford Train Station and a short walk from two Central Line Underground stations.

145543.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Cranbrook Hotel, located in Ilford. . We offer 80 guest rooms equipped with LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, coffee/tea makers, with daily housekeeping. Ilford station is a 5 minute walk from the hotel where you can take the Elizabeth line direct to the centre of London in 20 minutes. Stratford home to the London stadium is 10 minutes away. You'll be within a 15-minute drive of ExCeL Exhibition Centre and the Thames River, and a short distance from London City Airport. Explore nearby attractions including London Bridge and St. Paul's Cathedral.

145568.description: Based a few minutes' walk from the West End of Princes Street in the New Town of Edinburgh, these apartments are a perfect base to explore the riches of Scotland's capital, either as a weekend stopover or for a short-term business visit. St. Andrew Square bus station and Waverley train station are both roughly 1. 5 km from the hotel. Built in 1840, these 5 self-contained apartments fuse traditional Georgian architecture with modern design flair and technology. The city hotel's full-height windows overlook gardens. The establishment is equipped with modern stylish furnishings coupled with state-of-the-art fittings. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service. The hotel also provides wireless Internet access and a laundry service. The living areas are designed to the highest standard with modern furniture and appliances, offering a perfect base from which to explore Edinburgh. All rooms are en suite and feature a shower, bath and hairdryer, as well as a king-size bed, a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a radio and Internet access. The apartments also feature a kitchenette with a fridge, a cooker, a microwave and tea and coffee making facilities. Further amenities include a washing machine, an ironing set and heating.

145604.description: Spend the day on the private beach or dip into one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Grab a bite at one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 8:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Planning an event in Montauk? This hotel has 2100 square feet (195 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 5 meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 107 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

145616.address: West Bay, Al Qassar Street P.O. Box 32129
145616.description: Strategically located in the Central Business District, near major embassies, financial centers, international companies, and sports complexes, Kempinski Residences & Suites offers 368 suites and apartments with breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf. Guests enjoy comprehensive on-site facilities, including a cutting-edge Leisure and Wellness Center and a children's playroom.

145617.description: Holiday Inn Riyadh al qasr, an IHG Hotel is centrally located in Riyadh, a 4-minute walk from King Fahad National Library and a 3-minute drive from Olaya Towers. This luxury hotel is 3. 4 mi (5. 5 km) from National Museum of Saudi Arabia and 4. 8 mi (7. 7 km) from Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib Hospital. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a health club, an indoor pool, and a spa tub. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Make yourself at home in one of the 203 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. For lunch or dinner, stop by Mozart Restaurant, a restaurant that specializes in Middle Eastern cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in.

145619.description: Ideally located in the prime touristic area of Al Sharafiyah, Ramada Continental Jeddah promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. Both business travelers and tourists can enjoy the hotel's facilities and services. All the necessary facilities, including 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, 24-hour front desk, are at hand. Guestrooms are fitted with all the amenities you need for a good night's sleep. In some of the rooms, guests can find television LCD/plasma screen, linens, mirror, closet, separate living room. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. For reliable service and professional staff, Ramada Continental Jeddah caters to your needs.

145670.description: This hotel has an excellent location, opposite the Obelisk, Buenos Aires' most significant landmark and offers easy access to a plethora of attractions. The hotel offers a laundry service, car rental, medical service, wireless Internet access in the guest rooms and common areas, as well as meeting and conference rooms. Guests can dine at the cafe and restaurant and take advantage of the room service on offer.

name.content: Golden Tower Pinheiros by Fenix Hoteis

145673.description: Situated in São Paulo's vibrant Vila Madalena neighborhood, between Faria Lima and Rebouças avenues, this 4-star hotel offers convenient access to the city's attractions. Just three blocks from the Faria Lima subway station and various bus routes, it's also a short distance from Iguatemi and Eldorado shopping malls. The hotel features an on-site restaurant, event space for up to 170 guests, a gym, pool, sauna, and solarium. Choose from five room categories, ranging from cozy 28m² rooms to spacious 58m² two-room suites. Parking is available for an additional fee.

145686.description: Intersur Recoleta is a four-star hotel, located in the heart of Recoleta; which facilitates the experience of living Buenos Aires and its most representative aspects - its gastronomy, the expressiveness of its art, its events and lifestyle - in a special way. The hotel is consolidated as one of the most representative buildings of French architecture in Recoleta, and is integrated into the area with a diversity of residences and premises of the main brands. Enjoy its elegant and contemporary atmosphere, where the classic French style prevails, which is transmitted in each of its spaces, combined with refined service and professional and personalized treatment, allowing you to live an exclusive personal experience. The Hotel has 100 rooms distributed, from the second to the eleventh floor, in Executive rooms (25 m2), Junior Suites (28 m2), Suites (32 m2) and Deluxe Suites (48 m2), equipped to offer maximum comfort. The rooms are decorated in a unique style, where classic French and contemporary styles are combined, to achieve an intimate and refined atmosphere, where the quality of its fabrics and the details of the furniture stand out. They were all recently renovated with hardwood floors. None of the rooms has carpet. All are equipped with desks, a dressing room, individual hot / cold air conditioning, a telephone, a minibar, Wi-Fi internet access, a large safe and a 32” plasma with access to cable television. The bathrooms are equipped with different amenity kits, designed to offer a refreshing experience. The hygiene products offered are natural, and made with ingredients of plant or mineral origin, with organic certification. They are products that provide special fragrances and quality for personal care. The bathrooms have a bathtub and shower, a toilet and bidet area, a large mirror and a hairdryer.

145738.description: This hotel is located close to Sultanahmet in the historical district of Istanbul, just a few metres away from Gulhane Park. The main sightseeing attractions such as the Grand Bazaar, Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sophia and the captivating Blue Mosque are within easy walking distance. Numerous shops, restaurants, bars and the train station are also close by. It is set at about 45 km from the Istanbul International Airport. This boutique-style hotel will impress guests with its strikingly impressive design, capturing the essence of a bygone era, while embracing contemporary style. Rooms are equipped with air-conditioning, satellite TV and bathroom with shower and toiletries. Each room is elegantly designed and offer relaxing surroundings in which to lie back and unwind in luxury.

145739.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 13 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and slippers. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and blackout drapes/curtains. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Cemberlitas Bath - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Grand Bazaar - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Sultanahmet Square - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Beyazit Square - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Basilica Cistern - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Little Hagia Sophia - 0. 7 km / 0. 5 mi- Hagia Sophia - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Blue Mosque - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Eminönü Square - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Istanbul Archaeology Museums - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Süleymaniye Mosque - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Laleli Mosque - 1. 4 km / 0. 8 mi- Golden Horn - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 44. 1 km / 27. 4 mi Istanbul Airport (IST) - 46. 4 km / 28. 8 mi The preferred airport for Hotel New House is Istanbul Airport (IST). With a stay at Hotel New House, you'll be centrally located in Istanbul, within a 10-minute walk of Grand Bazaar and Sultanahmet Square. This hotel is 0. 5 mi (0. 9 km) from Blue Mosque and 1 mi (1. 7 km) from Hagia Sophia.

145741.description: Located in Istanbul's vibrant Taksim district, Hotel Monopol offers convenient access to key attractions. A short walk from Istiklal Avenue and Galata Tower, and close to the Bosphorus and Golden Horn, this hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, an on-site bar/lounge, and daily buffet breakfast. Guests can also utilize room service, airport shuttle (surcharge), and self-parking (surcharge). The 64 air-conditioned rooms feature refrigerators, LED TVs, and private bathrooms.

145756.description: The design hotel is located in the distinguished Quintana Avenue, at the heart of Recoleta, within walking distance of the Museum of Fine Arts, Colon Theatre and entertainment and leisure options. Fine materials combine beautifully to create a unique aesthetic, warmth, and intimacy in each and every one of the room and suite. Guests enter the hotel by passing through an imposing 6-metre oak gate. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, lift access, a coffee shop, Wi-Fi, room service, laundry service, medical service

145810.description: Enjoy your stay at Locke am Platz hotel in laidback Enge. Where elegant riviera style meets modernism to create an inviting space across 80 rooms and suites, many with private balconies. Downstairs, thoughtful social spaces take you from productive mornings to indulgent evenings. Minutes from the train station and FIFA Museum, with Bahnhofstrasse and Lindenhof in close reach, our central hotel is stylish and connected.

145836.description: Located in London's Kensington district, the Holland Inn Hotel is a short walk from Kensington High Street and the Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre. Westfield London Shopping Centre and the Natural History Museum are also easily accessible. The hotel offers 26 guestrooms equipped with refrigerators, coffee/tea makers, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and convenient amenities such as a 24-hour front desk and luggage storage.

145837.description: Located in the heart of London's Bayswater and Queensway, this charming hotel offers warm hospitality and convenient access to Notting Hill, Hyde Park, and Kensington Gardens. A short distance from the West End's shops, restaurants, and theatres, it provides a relaxing garden for guests to unwind. The cozy guest rooms feature private bathrooms with showers, ensuring a peaceful stay. This non-smoking establishment offers breakfast and Wi-Fi in public areas, making it an excellent choice for both business and leisure travelers.

145920.description: In front of Montmartre, right in the heart of ParisBetween the hill of Montmartre, the Basilica of the Sacré Coeur and Avenue Trudaine, in this historical and touristic district of Paris, facing a quiet garden is the Hôtel du Square d'Anvers. The Hôtel offers a warm and comfortable atmosphere with a summer garden and free Wi-Fi connection throughout the hotel. Easily accessible, the hotel is located just 50 yards from the Anvers metro stop and also very close to the Trianon Theatre as well as a being near a number of museums, the shopping malls on Boulevard Haussmann (Printemps, Galeries Lafay//ette), the Opera and the Champs-Elysées.

145934.description:
The hotel is centrally located and leading companies in the financial sector and services trade can be found in the near vicinity. Also nearby are a variety of sites of interest such as Monserrate Mountain , Colpatria Building, auditoriums, museums, cultural centres, libraries, galleries and retail shops. There are also links to the public transport network nearby. Trasmileno Station.The establishment is 15 minutes from the international airport.

The hotel is in the city of Bogotá International Center near to Convenciones Center Gonzalo Jimenez de Quesada,. There is also a business centre, 24-hour reception and check-out service in the lobby, a safe, currency exchange, wireless Internet access, as well as room and laundry services. Further facilities include air conditioning, a cloakroom, lift access to the upper floor.

The rooms are comfortable and equipped with a variety of services such as an en suite bathroom and shower with hot water.  include a telephone, cable TV,  Wi-fi access,  and a living room. All rooms also come with a double bed, Colombian Coffe and Water free 24 hours
The Hotel does not have Restaurant.

146000.description: Enjoy a relaxing experience at the full-service spa offering a variety of massages. Take advantage of the hotel's recreational amenities, including a fitness center and bicycle rentals. This hotel also provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a banquet hall.
