The Iris restaurant offers a delightful dining experience with its bar/lounge and garden views. For added convenience, 24-hour room service is available. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fees apply). Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Brussels? This hotel offers 17, 222 square feet (1, 600 square meters) of event space, including a conference center and 12 meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The hotel's 422 guest rooms provide a comfortable retreat, each featuring a minibar, espresso maker, and smart TV with satellite programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi is also provided. Private bathrooms are equipped with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. The hotel is conveniently located near Avenue Louise, Egmont Palace, and Place du Petit Sablon, among other attractions.

name.content: Ramada By Wyndham Istanbul Grand Bazaar

146038.description:
The Hotel is at the heart of the old city. All the tourist attractions such as museums, palaces and mosques are walking distance from our fully renovated modern hotel with professional staff ready to serve our guests. Our Hotel has Turkish and international cuisine with professional chefs. The Rooms at Ramada Istanbul Grand Bazaar are decorated with contemporary furnishings and offer all the modern amenities. 
Room service is available for a fee between 08:00 and 15:00.

146176.description: This beautiful boutique hotel is strategically situated in Istanbul's historic district, just a few hundred meters from captivating attractions like the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Topkapi Palace. The renowned Kumkapi waterfront, with its popular fish restaurants, is only 1 km away, and local transport links are easily accessible. The exciting Grand Bazaar is a 10-minute walk away, while Taksim Square and the city center are a 35-minute bus ride away. This charming hotel beautifully captures the area's historical essence, blending it with contemporary influences in its architecture and decor. The hotel prides itself on its personalized service, ensuring guests enjoy the ultimate city break.

146203.description: The hotel is located in Tres Cantos. The local train station is just 150 m from the hotel. Madrid city centre is 15 km away and Madrid-Barajas Airport is approximately 20 km from the establishment. This air-conditioned business hotel offers a 24-hour reception, currency exchange facilities and lift access to the upper floors. There is a café, bar and restaurant on-site. Guests may also take advantage of the wireless Internet access, room service and a meeting room. There is a car park and garage available. The rooms come with an en- suite bathroom with shower, bathtub and hairdryer, a double or king-size bed and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. Other in-room amenities include a telephone, safe, mini-bar, mood music, satellite TV and wireless Internet access.

146306.description: Located 500 metres from Istanbul's Grand Bazaar, Prestige Hotel is less than a 10-minute ride from Little Hagia Sophia. It offers comfortable accommodation with free WiFi. Prestige rooms are spacious and have air conditioning. They include modern furnishings, and come equipped with a minibar and seating area. Some rooms feature four-poster beds and warm coloured décor. In the morning, the hotel serves a rich buffet breakfast with omelets, crepes, and seasonal fruit. The Prestige Restaurant serves international cuisine. There is also a large bar that serves refreshing beverages. Prestige guests can relax on the sun terrace and enjoy panoramic city views, or visit the tour desk and ask for information on local attractions. Currency exchange and car hire are available. Laleli Tram Station is just a 3-minute walk from Prestige Hotel, while Vezneciler Metro Station is 450 metres away offering easy access to popular areas in Istanbul. Ataturk Airport is 16 km from the property. Airport shuttle can be arranged at an additional fee. Istanbul Airport is 55 km from the property.

146336.description: The hotel is located in the popular summer resort of Alanya-Turkler on the beautiful Turkish Riviera. This hotel features a private Mediterranean beach. This elegant hotel is situated steps from the beach, and close to Alanya centre. Guests can discover marvellous beaches, explore delightful villages nearby and experience real Turkish hospitality. The hotel is 20 km from Alanya town centre.

146337.description: Across from Geneva Airport and Palexpo exhibition center, we're located only 15 minutes from Lake Geneva and the city center. Enjoy our indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, steam room, fitness center, our three restaurants, and over 3, 000 sq. m. of event space. A complimentary airport shuttle and a transportation card are available.

146361.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Hotel Virgina, including complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a banquet hall. An area shuttle is available (surcharge). Take advantage of limited room service, or quench your thirst at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is offered daily (fee applies). The hotel also provides express check-in/check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and self-parking (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 55 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen TVs with satellite programming. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Located in Paris's 14th Arrondissement, Hotel Virgina is a short drive from the Paris Catacombs, Montparnasse Tower, and Luxembourg Gardens. It's also convenient to the Panthéon and Paris Expo.

146363.description: The hotel is located in the 9th district of Paris, 650 metres from the Moulin Rouge, a 10-minute walk to Montmartre, and 300 metres from the nearest metro station. It provides access to the capital's many sites, with Sacre-Coeur and Opera 800 metres away, and the Gare du Nord train station 1 km away. Built in 1905, this city hotel offers 31 guest rooms and facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, lift access to the upper floors, a TV lounge, breakfast room and wireless Internet access. Each room features an en suite bathroom with shower, a double bed, satellite TV, Internet access, a safe, ironing set and individually regulated heating. A continental breakfast is served each morning.

146376.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul's City Center, Ethnica Hotel Old City is a short walk from the Bosphorus and the Egyptian Bazaar. Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace are less than a mile away. This hotel offers 26 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a minibar, LCD TV, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy international cuisine at the on-site restaurant, Mandy Home, or order room service during limited hours. A continental breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, concierge services, dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and airport shuttle (surcharge applies).

146396.description: This modern hotel features a prime situation on Avenida da Liberdade, just 1. 6 kilometres from the centre of Lisbon, where guests will have the chance to visit the magnificent São Jorge Castle and Lisbon Cathedral. Marques De Pombal metro station is just a 2-minute walking distance from the hotel. This establishment offers the ideal accommodation for gourmet lovers, and enthusiasts of culture and history. It provides a choice of rooms equipped with contemporary furnishings and decorated in soothing colours, all including complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection, TV and a private bathroom with oversized mirrors. As for the onsite facilities, visitors may take advantage of the car rental and laundry services, and those travelling for business purposes will find a business centre. Moreover, guests can enjoy Portuguese dishes and international delicacies at the onsite restaurant, and share nice moments with the family or colleagues at the bar.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Bogota Parque La 93

146402.description: Contemporary Hotel in Bogota near Park 93Whether you're traveling to Colombia for business or planning a vacation in Bogotá, the best hotel choice is the Holiday Inn Express® Bogota. You will enjoy staying near 93 Park, the World Trade Center, major embassies such as France, Spain and Korea, important companies and upscale shopping malls like Centro Comercial Andino. Our location makes it easy to enjoy the area. We are within walking distance to many restaurants and bars and the city center is only five miles away. Spend the day at the Gold Museum or the Botero Museum, ride the funicular railway to Cerro de Monserrate, and enjoy 93 Park, a nearby exclusive area that offers upscale, designer shopping and historic attractions in north Bogotá. Remember to visit the Salt Cathedral of Zipaquira, one of the Wonders of the Colombia located less than 30 miles away. Our contemporary rooms are ideal for business travelers. They offer amenities like free high-speed Internet access, ergonomic chairs and a laptop safe. A 24-hour business center and a meeting room are also available. Always conscious about the environment, Holiday Inn Express® Bogota is certified with the Colombian Environmental Seal. A complimentary hot breakfast and an equipped Fitness Center are available every day for our guests, and professional staff will ensure the best hotel accommodation for your next business trip or vacation in Bogotá.

146411.description: This luxurious hotel is strategically situated in one of the most exclusive districts of the city of Bogotá. Just within a 5-minute walk from the beautiful 93 Park, guests will be able to easily reach mouth-watering restaurants, cosy bars and interesting art galleries. Moreover, this is the ideal choice of accommodation for both business and leisure travellers alike, as it is close to main road connections. The welcoming and ample suites are beautifully appointed with modern features and come equipped with cutting-edge amenities for a truly comfortable stay. Some of them have a king-size bed for a restful night's sleep and an en-suite bathroom with a magnificent private hot tub to relax after a bustling day at work or visiting the city. Among the hotel's facilities, guests might enjoy the on-site spa for a healing experience and the well-equipped and modern fitness room.

146413.description: Located directly across from the iconic El Virrey Park in the exclusive Chapinero district, Jazz Apartments offers a sophisticated, pet-friendly experience that combines the independence of a modern apartment with the comfort of a top-tier hotel. Highly rated on TripAdvisor and recognized with the Travelers' Choice award, the hotel features spacious, self-contained suites equipped with a kitchenette, dedicated workspace, high-speed Wi-Fi, and optional balconies with park views, along with free parking for guests. Its strategic location places travelers just a 5-minute walk from Zona T, 900 meters from 93 Park, and 25 minutes from El Dorado International Airport, guaranteeing direct access to Bogota's premier business, dining, and entertainment districts. kfast is included, while lunch and dinner are available à la carte.

146558.description: This apartment hotel is very centrally located, just a couple of minutes' walk from the resort centre with its links to public transport and the pedestrian shopping streets (some 100 m away). The nearest restaurants are around 150 m and it is about 850 m to the eastern beach and the Mediterranean and approximately 1 km to bars, pubs and nightspots in the harbour area. Tourist sites such as the Damlatas Caves (about 1 km) and Alanya Castle (around 1. 7 km) are nearby, while the bus station is 2 km from the complex. It is around 60 km to Manavgat and 125 km to Antalya International Airport. This small, city apartment hotel comprises a total of 19 apartments and studios. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility and lift access. There is a TV lounge, snack bar and free wireless Internet access in the complex. The apartments have a separate bedroom and kitchenette/living area with cooking facilities for making light snacks. All come with a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer and are equipped with a TV and Internet access. There are safes for hire and individually regulated air conditioning is provided in all accommodation as standard. The studios have 1 room with a sleeping area and a kitchenette. There is a lift to the roof terrace where guests will find a small pool and a children's pool. They can relax at the poolside snack bar or on the sun terrace. Golf enthusiasts will find courses 90 km away in Belek. Guests are served breakfast each morning.

name.content: Areias do Seixo Charm Hotel & Residences

146617.address: Prc do Atlântico, Mexilhoeira, Póvoa de Penafirme
146617.description: This magical place is located less than an hour from Lisbon and near Santa Cruz beach. Lisbon Airport is 50 km from the hotel. Facilities on offer to guests include a reception, a bar and a restaurant. Guests will appreciate the WiFi access and they can use the room and laundry services. Parking is available. The residence offers each guest a different sensorial trip in each one of its Gold and Land rooms. The common elements in the Gold rooms include the warming character of the fireplace, the astonishing view of the ocean and the dunes from the wooden patio. Each room hosts a great spa tub, a high shower which gives a revitalizing sensation of falling rain, and an enclosed patio. All rooms come with a bathroom and offer a double bed. This hotel features swimming pool and guests can relax in the sauna or steam room.

146645.description: This world-class and fashionable hotel is located in the charming Gothic Quarter, just at 400m from the famous La Rambla street and just a five-minutes' stroll from Plaza de Catalunya and Paseo de Gracia, right next to Urquinaona Metro Station, the Palace of Catalan Music and Barcelona cathedral. The property is a protected area with a neoclassical facade building, so guests will be pleasantly surprised by the contrast between avant-garde design and sculptural art on the façade. Romain Fornell is the head chef for all the culinary spaces at Hotel Ohla Barcelona: Caelis restaurant, awarded with a Michellin star and La Plassohla, high-level 'tapas' and 'platillos'. Guests will be surprised by the state-of-the-art technology and the modern amenities found at the exclusive guest rooms and suites.

146646.description:
The Napoleon Hotel is strategically located in the heart of the shopping area close to the underground Buenosaires. The rooms have SKY TV and free WiFi and are decorated with fine materials and quality with every possible comfort. The hotel also has parking and breakfast room. 
Offering a central location, Hotel Napoleon is a 3-minute walk from Corso Buenos Aires, home to 350 shops. Milan's Lima Metro Station on the red line is just 164 feet away. 

With free Wi-Fi, rooms at the Napoleon include a flat-screen TV with free SKY channels. Each room is air conditioned and has a fully equipped private bathroom. Some rooms have a balcony.

146649.description: This hotel has a great location, close to many well-known sites and is perfectly connected with public transport stops only 200 metres from the hotel. In the neighbourhood there are many restaurants and bars, fashion stores and art galleries. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, a modern and innovative lobby bar & lounge, a restaurant, 24h fitness room, sauna and conference facilities. Wi-Fi, room and laundry services are available.

146650.description: The hotel enjoys a central location close to the Trocadero, between the Eiffel Tower and the Champs Elysees. This beautiful establishment sits off the main road. Restaurants and shopping spots are within walking distance. The bus station is 400 metres from the hotel. Boissiere train station is 5 km away. The Louvre Museum and Notre Dame de Paris are both around 25 minutes away using public transport. The charming city hotel features elegant contemporary decoration. Facilities include a TV lounge, bar and room service. Wireless Internet access and a laundry service are also offered for additional fees. Each air-conditioned room provides free wireless Internet access and international TV. There is an en suite bathroom, a double bed and a minibar. Guests may take a dip in the saltwater swimming pool. A breakfast buffet is served each morning.

146651.description: Dunes Hotel Apartments Oud Metha Featuring a rooftop pool with panoramic views over Dubai, this hotel offers self-catering apartments with wall-mounted flat-screen TVs. It is located right across from Dubai’s American Hospital. The air-conditioned apartments at Dunes Hotel Apartments Oud Metha have modern décor in warm colours, and are equipped with stylish furniture. A microwave and a washing machine are also featured in each apartment. After a training session at the well-equipped gym, guests can relax in the sauna or the jacuzzi. The outdoor heated pool is a refreshing spot also for cooler months. The staff at the 24-hour reception can help you organize city tours. In addition, rental cars and airport transfers can be arranged. The Wafi City Shopping Mall is a 10-minute walk from Oud Metha Dunes Hotel Apartments, while the Dubai Museum is a 10-minute drive away. Free private parking is available on site.

146700.description: With a stay at Sunset Royal Beach Resort - All Inclusive in Cancun (Zona Hotelera), you'll be a 3-minute drive from La Isla Shopping Mall and 10 minutes from Delfines Beach. This 4-star property is 1. 4 mi (2. 3 km) from Cancun Convention Center and 3. 6 mi (5. 9 km) from Tortuga Beach. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this property include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 234 air-conditioned rooms featuring free minibar items and flat-screen televisions. Cable programming and DVD players are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and bathrobes. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Enjoy international cuisine at Acuario, one of the property's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 3 bars/lounges. A complimentary full breakfast is included. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Free self parking is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. West Coast of Isla Mujeres, Punta Cancun, and Punta Nizuc National Park - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Chac Mool Beach - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Forum By The Sea Mall - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Forum Beach - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Cancun Convention Center - 1. 2 km/0. 7 mi- Plaza Caracol Mall - 1. 3 km/0.

146719.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance at Hotel Conti Dietikon. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies), or grab a snack from the snack bar/deli. Room service is also available during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel offers a business center, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers. Host your event in our 2422 sq ft (225 sq m) event space, including conference and meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available. Our 72 guestrooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs with cable, and Select Comfort beds with premium bedding. Bathrooms include bathtubs/showers and hair dryers. Located in suburban Dietikon, we're within a 15-minute drive of Letzigrund Stadium and Hallenstadion, and convenient to Bruno Weber Park and Shoppi Tivoli. Zurich Airport (ZRH) is 11. 4 miles away.

146720.description: Strategically located in Roissy en France, just 10 minutes from Charles de Gaulle Airport and central Paris, Clarion Hotel provides self catered, comfortable accommodations ideal for business and leisure guests visiting the French capital. All our 452 apartments include modern conveniences like a fully equipped kitchenette, a private bathroom with a shower or a bathtub, a hairdryer, complimentary toiletries, top quality mattresses and beddings, air conditioning, free WiFi access, tea and coffee making facilities, a flatscreen TV, and a balcony. Treat yourself to a relaxing stay in Roissy en France thanks to Clarion Hotel s amenities, which include a rich, free buffet breakfast, a fitness centre equipped with state of the art cardio machines, an indoor swimming pool, a 24 hour reception desk with multilingual staff, free onsite parking, and extensive meeting facilities. You can reach the centre of Paris in around 35 minutes by train.

146776.description: This full-service resort provides everything you need for a stress-free vacation. Located on the Nichupté Lagoon side of Boulevard Kukulkan, it's a short 5-minute drive from the heart of the hotel zone, where you'll find the best shopping centers, nightclubs, and the convention center. Guests arriving from Cancun International Airport can arrange a 20-minute shuttle service. Upon arrival, you'll be enchanted by the elegant, relaxing, family-friendly atmosphere. All guest rooms are equipped with modern comforts, guaranteeing a pleasant and cozy stay. In the evening, enjoy one of the shows at the open-air theater or choose from three bars, each serving domestic and imported beverages in a stylish and friendly atmosphere.

146838.description: This heritage hotel enjoys an enviable setting amidst the rich culture and history of Athens. The hotel lies in the commercial district of the city, lying within easy access of a number of attractions. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from the Acropolis and its museum, Plaka, Monastiraki and the vibrant district of Psiri. Guests will appreciate the hotel's close proximity to the Syntagma Metro Station, which lies just 650 metres away, and offers ease of access to other areas of the city. This wonderful hotel presents a delightful architectural design. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, enjoying an aura of peace and tranquillity. Guests are sure to be impressed by the wide range of facilities that the hotel has to offer.

146842.description: The Grand Aşiyan Hotel, recently renovated, is located in Laleli, in the heart of Istanbul's Old Town. Just 15 minutes away are historical landmarks such as the Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Basilica Cistern, and many more. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Marmara Sea from the rooftop restaurant during your complimentary buffet breakfast. Each elegantly refurbished room features stylish design and is equipped with free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and a 32-inch LED TV. After a tiring day exploring Istanbul, relax in our traditional Turkish bath or enjoy the swimming pool. Our attentive staff is available 24 hours a day to provide tourist information and assist with transfers to/from airports, ports, and the city center.

146843.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Ephesus Hotel Istanbul, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 77 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature bathtubs or showers, bidets, and slippers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Laleli Mosque - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Beyazit Square - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Yenikapi Ferry Terminal - 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Istanbul University - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Grand Bazaar - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Süleymaniye Mosque - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Cemberlitas Bath - 1. 7 km / 1 mi- Fatih Mosque - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Little Hagia Sophia - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Sultanahmet Square - 2 km / 1. 2 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Golden Horn - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi- Basilica Cistern - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi- Blue Mosque - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 43. 1 km / 26. 8 mi Istanbul Airport (IST) - 41. 3 km / 25. 7 mi The preferred airport for Ephesus Hotel Istanbul is Istanbul Airport (IST).

146897.description: Centrally located in the heart of New York City, Hotel St. James is just a five-minute walk from Times Square and Broadway. This hotel offers 144 air-conditioned rooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. For your convenience, each room also includes a safe, iron, and ironing board. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk and multilingual staff. Nearby attractions include Bryant Park and Rockefeller Center. LaGuardia Airport (LGA) is the preferred airport for the hotel.

147191.description: This hotel is located close to Madrid's shopping, cultural and financial centre. It enjoys close proximity to the emblematic Plaza de Legazpi. The city centre and Plaza del Sol can be found just 1. 5 km away. This wonderful hotel is modern in style. Guests are greeted with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are stunningly designed, featuring Alicante marble and locally-sourced wooden furnishings. The hotel appeals to every type of traveller, offering a wide range of facilities and services. Guests can rent a car or book tickets for attractions at the hotel's 24-hour front desk.

147203.description: The apartments are located in close proximity to one of the city's main streets, the Paseo de Gracia, in the shopping and financial centre of Barcelona. They are also only 5 minutes from the Gothic Quarter and near the underground network. Restaurants and bars are some 500 m and many of the city's clubs are also within walking distance. Local public transport links are available directly in front of the apartments. The beach is some 2 km away. The Neoclassical façade invites travellers to enter a world of luxury and to discover exquisite accommodation and excellence in service. Guests are also welcome to use the terrace, spa and gym of the hotel Majestic.

147209.description: This hostel is located in the historic part of Collbató, at the foot of Montserrat Mountain. The surroundings are beautiful and the majestic massif of Montserrat can be seen from any part of the hostel. 200 m away is a small path that starts out at the Chapel of la Salut and ends at the Salnitre Caves. This is an old mansion that has been totally refurbished turning it into a small charming hostel. Preserved within the residence is the Catalan Vault, an architectural feature that was very popular in the past. The first floor has a cosy fireplace. This is much more than just a rural hostel; it is a place where one can lose and find oneself; a place that transports guests to another century, but with the added attraction of the comforts and facilities of a modern hotel. Food is served at the hostel's restaurant. Guests can stay connected during their stay thanks to the Internet access provided, and can leave their vehicles at the car park. The hostel offers a bicycle rental service. All the rooms in the hostel are decorated in a cosy style, and each room has its own unique style and characteristics, thus lending it a particular charm. All rooms have a full en suite bathroom with bath, shower, hairdryer and daily change of towels. Heating is provided, as is satellite TV, a telephone and ADSL and wireless Internet access. Guests can take a dip in the hostel's swimming pool, or for an additional fee try their hand at horse riding and biking. The hostel has a restaurant that offers home-cooked food made from local produce. There is a varied choice of high-quality dishes, with both set menu and à la carte options available at lunch time.

147259.description: 30 minutes from Lisbon, in Portugal West Region, the STAY HOTEL TORRES VEDRAS CENTRO, is located in the historical centre of the city of Torres Vedras. Live the Torres Carnival, the most Portuguese of carnivals, for the Hotel is situated in the heart of the event. The hotel is located only 15 minutes' drive from the ocean, the Silver coast and Santa Cruz Beach. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception and lift, a bar and a restaurant and guests will appreciate the conference facilities and Wi-Fi, as well as the room and laundry services.

147281.description: This beach-side hotel is situated close to the historical town of Marathon, in Attica, just 7 km away from Marathon town centre, affording guests a great setting from which to explore the rich culture and tradition of the area. The hotel is within easy driving distance of the town of Nea Makri, the centre of Athens and Eleftherios Venizelos Airport. All rooms are beautifully designed, decorated in a traditional Greek style, resembling a traditional Greek village. Each room comes equipped with air-conditioning, satellite TV, safe box, mini fridge, terrace or balcony and bathroom with hairdryer and toiletries. Guests can relax on a sandy beach or take a cool dip in 1 of 3 open-air sweet water swimming pools while kids can enjoy their time at a mini club.

147290.description: Welcome to Maison Mère, the House of Beautiful Houses. A 4* hotel with a distinctive identity and a hybrid friendly place to live, nestled in the heart of Paris 9th. A home of character, Parisian but flowing against the current, where you feel at home. In this chic and cozy nest, the 51 rooms and 2 suites are fitted with the best technology and comfort, and a vintage decoration selected along our encounters to become an extension of your home. In the heart of the 9th arrondissement, Maison Mère benefits from a privileged location, just a few steps away from the main tourist spots of Paris, but in an authentic neighbourhood, preserved from mass tourism. The hotel is located 15min walk from the main train stations (Gare du Nord, Gare de l'Est & Saint-Lazare); close to Cadet metro station (Line 7 - 1min walk) Anvers metro station (Line 2 - 10min walk) Notre-dame-de-lorette metro station (Line 12 - 5min walk) Richelieu Drouot metro station (Line 8&9 - 10 min walk); and close to the galeries Lafayette, Moulin Rouge, Montmartre & Pigale.

147292.description: Located in the city center, this hotel is next to the train, bus, and taxi stations. It is just 15 minutes from Madrid, with easy access via the main roads. This hotel features air conditioning and welcomes guests in the lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out services. Among other amenities, it offers a safe, a TV room, and elevator access. Breakfast is available in the café. Guests can stay connected during their stay thanks to the provided wireless Internet access. Laundry service is also available, as well as parking and a garage for those arriving by car for an additional fee. All rooms are spacious and equipped with a private bathroom with shower, satellite TV, and telephone. Individually adjustable air conditioning and heating are standard throughout the accommodation.

147293.description: This hotel is in a prime location, very close to the KaDeWe department store and a 10-minute walk from the Kurfürstendamm shopping street and Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church. Augsburger Straße Metro Station is only a 2-minute walk away. With 208 rooms, including 13 Suites and 42 Apartments, SANA Berlin Hotel offers a wide choice of accommodation for short or long stays. All rooms are equipped with a free wi-fi, coffee machine, hair dryer, heated bathroom floors, air conditioning, flat, as well as a safe and a minibar. The apartments also offer an equipped kitchenette. Guests can enjoy a delicious meal and have a drink at the Lobby Bar or simply relax in the open air patio. The hotel facilities also include a gym and massage service. The property features 6 modern and quiet conference rooms with natural light, providing the perfect conditions for a focused and creative work.

147321.description: The hotel is located in one of the most elegant and quiet streets of the city in the Avenue El Salvador. It is close to Lake Palermo, the Río de la Plata and the rose gardens of the Parque Tres de Febrero. There are several streets of restaurants, clubs and bars nearby (around 2 minutes' walk away). The city centre of Buenos Aires is around 5. 3 km away, and can be reached in 30 minutes by public transport. The Terminal Retiro bus station is around 6. 2 km away and the railway station is some 3. 1 km away. Other attractions in the area include the Zoologico de la Ciudad (Buenos Aires Zoo), around 15 minutes' walk away, La Rural, some 22 minutes' walk away, Alto Palermo Shopping Mall, roughly 25 minutes' walk away, and the Palais de Glace, which is about 25 minutes away by public transport. Jorge Newbery Airport is around 15 km away and Ministro Pistarini International Airport is roughly 45 km from the hotel. This city design hotel, which was built in 2010, has 6 well-appointed rooms. The hotel features an urban style with rustic wooden floors, dark-stained parquet and marble. The facilities at this sophisticated and elegant air-conditioned establishment include wireless Internet access, a TV lounge and a cafe. The lobby offers a hotel safe and lift access. There is a breakfast room and room service is available. For additional fees, guests may also make use of the laundry service, car park, garage and bicycle hire service. The hotel offers 6 well-appointed rooms featuring cable TV, a telephone, mini fridge, wireless Internet access, clock radio, a hifi system, safe and an ironing set. The en suite bathroom offers a shower, bath and hairdryer. Each room has a double or king-size bed and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. The rooms offer a quiet and elegant atmosphere, perfect for relaxing. assage and spa treatments are on offer (for a fee). A continental breakfast is served to guests daily.

147345.description: Stayokay Hostel Amsterdam is located in the heart of the Vondelpark and offers a view on the green surroundings. The Van Gogh Museum is an 8-minute walk away. The accommodation includes free WiFi access throughout the whole building. The hostel offers bunk beds in shared dormitories as well as private rooms. All rooms/dorms have a bathroom and lockable cupboards. Guests can buy padlocks at the reception or bring their own. Coin operated lockers are available in the lobby at EUR 2 per hour or EUR 6 per 12 hours. Breakfast is available in the morning for a surcharge. At the end of a busy day, guests can relax and have a drink or snack in The 5TH . The lively Leidse Square is situated a 5-minute walk away and offers plenty of bars and restaurants. Trams 1, 12 at Leidse Square offer direct access to Dam Square and Amsterdam Central Station. Guests can explore the surroundings by bicycle as Stayokay Vondelpark provides a rental service.

147400.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a 24-hour health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. This Beaux Arts hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at Clement Restaurant, a restaurant which specializes in American cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 3 bars/lounges. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. This hotel has 5 meeting rooms available for events. Make yourself at home in one of the 233 guestrooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

147414.description: This is the coolest hostel in London. Modern, cosy and intimate, it has an impressive fully equipped kitchen, TV rooms and internet. It is around a 10-minute walk to the British Library and some 2. 3 km to Covent Garden, the British Museum and Dickens' House. Only steps from the impressive King's Cross station and Hoxton, it is the perfect base to explore the city and relax. Facilities include a lobby with a 24-hour reception, hotel safe, lift access and a TV lounge.

147457.description: This opulent waterfront hotel is conveniently located in cosmopolitan Cape Town, just 22 kilometers from Cape Town International Airport. Guests enjoy easy access to the city's vibrant offerings, including renowned dining, sports venues, and shopping. The hotel's delightful décor blends Victorian style with modern touches. The luminous, spacious guest rooms are superbly appointed with elegant furniture and contemporary elements, offering breathtaking views of the city. Modern amenities are provided throughout. The hotel boasts a signature restaurant with exquisite dishes and superb views of the V&A Waterfront and Table Mountain, a cozy bar restaurant, and a Mediterranean-style bar. Guests can indulge in relaxing treatments at the on-site spa. Impressive meeting facilities cater to business travelers.

147479.address: Mehmet Akif Cad. Bogazak Mah. 29 Sok, 9
147479.description: Located on the Bogazkent coast, 10 km away from the town of Belek, this five star luxury resort has an intimate atmosphere catering to adults who want a restful and revitalising vacation. The 230 stylish rooms and suites are located in one main building and there are 16 lake houses. Quality food and excellent service provide a great dining experience while the opulent spa combines a feel of Ottoman charm with a modern twist. When not enjoying the spa, guests will be able to lounge by the beach and the large swimming pool which meanders between the lake houses and pedestrian bridge walkways.

147491.description: This upscale city hotel is located in the Laleli district of the historical part of the captivating, ancient metropolis of Istanbul. The hotel is situated within easy access of Sultanahmet and the major sightseeing attractions the city has to offer. The exciting Grand Bazaar lies just 400 metres away, while a tram stop is just 150 metres from the hotel, and offers links to Sultanahmet and Galata Bridge. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to numerous restaurants, bars and shops. This modern hotel enjoys a stunning classical style, greeting guests with warm hospitality and impeccable service. Guests can enjoy a refreshing drink or sumptuous meal in the rooftop bar and restaurant, and relish the spectacular views over the city and the Marmara Sea. The guest rooms are elegantly decorated and come complete with modern amenities for visitors' convenience and comfort.

147616.description: This resort is located on a long sandy beach, approximately 2. 5 km from the historic center of Side. Nearby, you'll find restaurants, bars, clubs, shops, and public transport links. Set within expansive gardens that extend to the beach, the complex offers 680 rooms and a variety of on-site amenities. Dining options include a main restaurant, à la carte restaurants, and several bars. A conference room caters to business travelers, and parking is available. Outdoor amenities feature numerous swimming pools and water sports, while indoors, a spa provides a range of treatments and massages. Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel for a fee.

147674.description: This elegant hotel is located a 15-minute tram ride from Berlin's famous Alexanderplatz Square, and directly opposite a tram stop. For leisure travellers, there are sporting and event venues situated near the hotel, such as the Sportforum, the Velodrome events venue and the Max-Schmeling-Halle. Berlin Tegel Airport is at 18 km from the property. The hotel offers guest rooms which are perfect for either a short trip or extended stay. They are equipped with a comfortable bed, air conditioning, TV with satellite channels and a desk. Guests who want to try typical Berlin Bistro can enjoy at the hotel restaurant. It offers high-quality cuisine with fresh and seasonal ingredients with a wide selection of fish, meat and vegetarian menus. Whether as a tourist or business traveller, Berlin has something for everyone.

147718.description:
Hotel Beethoven - Vienna lovers welcome!

The Hotel Beethoven Vienna is an owner-managed boutique hotel with 47 different guest rooms, each of which tells the story of Vienna. It is tucked away in a small side street at the beginning of Vienna's Naschmarkt, opposite the Papageno Gate of the Theater an der Wien. 

Our concierge service is always available to meet the needs of our guests. We are happy to recommend and reserve an individual cultural and/or culinary program in advance. For an inspiring and enjoyable trip to Vienna, please contact us at +43 1 587 44 820 or by email at concierge@hotelbeethoven. at. 

The culturally engaged Ludwig family, owners of the hotel, supports numerous Viennese cultural institutions such as the Albertina, the Mumok, and the Musikverein, and can inspire Vienna lovers to enjoy cultural delights: invitations to vernissages, exhibition openings, museum visits, and preferential ticket orders at the "Musikverein". 

Music belongs to Vienna just as much as Beethoven does. We love this tradition and host a concert featuring chamber music of the highest caliber every weekend. The focus, as you might expect, is on Viennese classical music. 

Michael Babytsch on the cello and Pavlo Kachnov on the piano play works by Haydn, Mozart, and Beethoven. During the intermission, enjoy a glass of sparkling wine on the house. Incidentally, the Bösendorfer grand piano belonged to Barbara Ludwig's mother, Sissy, who was a great pianist.

147723.description: Located close to La Scala Theatre, the cathedral and the 'Quadrilatero della moda', Milan's upscale fashion district, this hotel is in the heart of Milan, with a unique view over the city's most beautiful park. Guests will find the restaurants and public transportation right outside the hotel. Facilities include a lobby, 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, lift access and a newsstand. There is a bar and restaurant, free Wi-Fi in the lobby and free Internet point. The hotel offers room service and laundry service. A car park is also available to guests (for a fee).

147732.description: Beside the Topkapi Palace and a few hundred metres from St Sophia, the hotel is located in a charming, quiet street where local families still live. Restaurants, bars and cafés can all be found in the vicinity around Sultanahmet. Shops as well as links to the public transport network can also be found within a short stroll. Atatürk International Airport and Sabiha Gökçen International Airport are about 14 km and 44 km away, respectively. This 19th century mansion was once occupied by a master perfumer and is now a family-run wooden hotel with 8 specially decorated rooms that was fully refurbished in 2010. The hotel prides itself on offering a personal, customised service and has free Internet access. Guests of this city hotel are welcomed in the lobby. The hotel also offers a breakfast room. In addition, there is a small rooftop terrace with panoramic views of Hagia Sophia, the Bosphorus and Marmara Sea. The rooms have traditional Ottoman-style decoration and wooden handmade furniture but with modern conveniences. Decorated in rich colours with wooden floors, they have Internet access and the modern en suite facilities come with a bath or shower and a hairdryer. Double or king-size rooms are available. Further in-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a safe, minibar and individually regulated air conditioning. Guests can select their continental breakfast from a buffet.

147823.description: This hotel is located at the end of Avenue Mohammed VI, just a few paces from the nearest nightspots. Jemaa el Fna Square is a 10-minute drive. Marrakech Airport is approximately 5 km away. This luxurious city SPA complex offers guests a large choice of top-notch restaurants, hairdressing salon, games room, a nightclub and lounge. The younger guests are welcomed to enjoy the kids' club. On-site leisure options include indoor and outdoor swimming pools and tennis courts. A well-equipped business centre is available for business travellers. All rooms come with an en-suite bathroom and home appliances. Individually regulated air conditioning is provided in all accommodation as standard, and all units feature either a balcony or a terrace.

147825.description: The 4-star Rose Aqua Parc hotel, located in Marrakesh's Hivernage district, offers a unique experience with its on-site aqua park. Guests can choose from a variety of dining options, ranging from international cuisine to traditional Moroccan dishes. The hotel boasts extensive leisure facilities, including an aqua park with slides and attractions, a refreshing outdoor pool, and a spa with an indoor heated pool and wellness treatments. For those seeking more active pursuits, a well-equipped gym is also available.

147859.description: This nice and modern apartments are extraordinarily positioned in Bairro Alto, the most bohemian and typical neighbourhood in the picturesque and beautiful city of Lisbon. The apartments are very close to Praça Luís de Camões and Chiado area, where guests will find plenty of sightseeing attractions and convenient public transport connections. Moreover, business travellers might like to know that Lisbon’s international airport is a mere 10 kilometres away. The stylish apartments have been carefully designed to guarantee an unforgettable experience, either if travellers are on business or on holidays. They exude a relaxing and calm atmosphere thanks to the white tones that they boast and come fully equipped with state-of-the-art amenities for the most discerning visitors. Apart from other facilities included, guests may relax at the bathtub of the en-suite bathrooms at the end of a busy day.

147873.description: The hotel is located in the old town, within the ramparts, and is 500 m from the minaret of the Koutoubia mosque, Jemaa El Fna square and the souks of the Medina. Situated just opposite the famous Mamounia, it is very close to the winter headquarters. Transfers to Menara Airport, 5 kms away, take just 5 minutes. This 146-room city hotel offers a lobby area with 24-hour reception service, hairdressing salon and Internet access. Younger guests may enjoy the kids' club. Rooms are air-conditioned and equipped with an international direct dial telephone and a TV. Most bathrooms have a bathtub but only 22 of them have a shower. The rooms have large balconies and terraces. A swimming pool with a poolside snack bar, gym, a tennis court and table tennis are also available. There is a specially designed room for children playing games in the garden.

147876.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at Hotel Constanza, located in the heart of Barcelona. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and take advantage of convenient concierge services. A business center and 24-hour front desk cater to your needs. Each of the 46 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, safe, and desk, while the bathrooms offer rainfall showerheads and hair dryers. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available for a fee. The hotel also provides conference space and meeting rooms. Within a 10-minute walk, you'll find Plaça de Catalunya and La Rambla, with Palau de la Música Catalana and Barcelona Cathedral just a short distance away.

147911.description: Enjoying a prime city centre location, the apartments are just two minutes from St Andrews Square and the exclusive shopping district of Multrees Walk and the world renowned Harvey Nichols. The trendy bars and restaurants of George Street and Rose Street are also within a short distance making this the perfect location for a city break in Edinburgh. Alternatively for a splash of culture famous historical attractions including the Walter Scott Monument, National Gallery and Edinburgh Castle are within easy reach. The apartments are easily accessible from Waverley station and the new tram system has a stop just round the corner at St Andrew Square ensuring those travelling from the airport are able to transfer practically door to door. The apartments are comfortable, spacious and well equipped both in the kitchen and the bathroom. The apartments shall be serviced every 4 days and additional cleaning can be arranged at an extra charge. Please arrange this directly with Fountain Court.

name.content: Eric Vokel Boutique Apartments Gran Via Suites

148027.address: Gran Via De Les Corts Catalanes, 454
148027.description: Ideally situated in the heart of Barcelona, within a few steps from Plaça Espanya, Fira de Barcelona and a popular shopping centre, this sophisticated apartments feature a perfect base to explore this fantastic city. Just beside Rocafort metro station and within a stone's throw from Espanya metro station, this elegant establishment allows visitors to easily get around Barcelona. The apartments showcase a fabulous combination of Nordic elegance and Mediterranean touches. They are fitted with comfortable furniture and top notch amenities. Every morning guests may start the day with the rich breakfast offering lots of delicious items to fuel one's day ahead. There are computers for guests' added convenience and travellers may inquire with the multilingual staff at the 24-hour reception for recommendations on the best sights in this impressive city.

148061.description: Reconquista Garden is recognized as one of the best options for your business or family trip. It stands out for offering excellent service and comfort in a pleasant natural setting. It has 78 spacious rooms. Hotel belonging to the Latitud Hotels chain, with establishments in important destinations. Our product stands out in the quality of its services and personalized attention. In Reconquista Garden we provide an excellent service taking care of all the details so that you have a pleasant stay. We have trained personnel 24 hours a day to help you whenever you need it and with whom you will feel totally safe. It has buffet breakfast with own pastry, Wi-Fi Internet service throughout the establishment. Reconquista Garden has its own restaurant, with an extensive menu and affordable prices, you can find different dishes to enjoy the cuisine of Buenos Aires both day and night.

148069.description: The Atlantico Business is a great hotel, featuring modern accommodations, very nicely located in the centre of Brazil's capital. Facilities include a swimming pool, a sauna, a gym and two bars. It also offers a restaurant with national and international cuisine. The nearest underground station is at approximately 35 metres, easily reachable on foot. Santos Dumont Airport is at approximately 2 km from the hotel. It is a great place for business travelers.

148074.description: Nestled in a stunning natural landscape just 5 km from the historic city of Alcalá de Henares, this golf hotel offers a unique blend of sport and wellness. A mere 30-minute drive (35 km) from Madrid and 20 km from Madrid Airport, it provides convenient access to both urban excitement and tranquil retreat. Built in 2011, the hotel features 39 air-conditioned guest rooms, each equipped with modern amenities including Wi-Fi, a minibar, satellite TV, and an iPhone/iPod charger. Guests can enjoy a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, unwind on the sun terrace, or tee off on the challenging 18-hole golf course designed by Von Hagge, Smelek, and Baril. Additional amenities include a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, TV lounge, bar, restaurant and on-site parking. Savor innovative cuisine at the hotel restaurant, helmed by renowned Spanish chef David Marcano.

name.content: Hotel Berlin Alexanderplatz by Leonardo Hotels

148109.description: Located just a two-minute walk from Alexanderplatz, Hotel Berlin Alexanderplatz by Leonardo Hotels offers 336 modern and functional rooms in the heart of Berlin. Guests can enjoy an on-site restaurant, bar, terrace, room service, a complimentary fitness room and a sauna. With 13 meeting rooms, extensive event facilities and excellent transport connections, the hotel is ideal for both business and leisure stays.

148110.description: Leonardo Smart Hotel Berlin Alexanderplatz offers a practical stay in the heart of Berlin, just steps from Alexanderplatz, the TV Tower and Museum Island. The hotel features 288 modern rooms with individually adjustable air conditioning, Wi-Fi, underfloor-heated bathrooms and rain showers. Guests can enjoy an open-plan restaurant, lounge and shop, as well as bike rental and underground parking. With excellent transport connections, the hotel is ideal for both business and leisure stays.

148156.address: Emin Sinan Mah. Piyerloti Cad. Sultanahmet, 39
148156.description:
This delightful hotel is located just a few minutes' walking distance away from Sultanahmet in Istanbul. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the city's main attractions, while the waterfront area of Kumkapi, with its superb fish restaurants, is within walking distance. 
This cosy city hotel offers comfortable accommodation and warm hospitality. The guest rooms enjoy a simplistic style and come complete with modern amenities for visitors' convenience and comfort. The hotel provides a selection of excellent services and amenities, including a wonderful rooftop restaurant which commands spectacular views over the city. Guests can enjoy a delightful meal with something to tempt even the most discerning palate.

148160.description: The Reconquista Plaza Hotel, conveniently located near Buenos Aires' main attractions, offers comfort and convenience for both business and family travelers. Our spacious rooms and personalized service make us an ideal choice. Part of the Latitud Hotels chain, we're known for quality and attention to detail. Enjoy amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, a breakfast buffet featuring fresh pastries, and our newly renovated family rooms. The hotel boasts 60 spacious rooms across nine floors.

148169.description: A classical wooden city residence dating from the Ottoman period and restored into a 13-room hotel, offering suites with a separate living-area as well as double rooms. Ideally situated for those wishing to be in the heart of Sultanahmet, the major sight-seeing attractions are all within a short walk. Gulhane Park is in very close proximity and there are shops and restaurants to be found close-by.

148170.description: Located in the centre of the historical district, the hotel is within walking distance of the major attractions at Sultanahmet and there are local amenities nearby such as shops, restaurants and public transport. A small, historic hotel built in 1921 and most recently refurbished in 2010, it offers comfortable accommodation with a lobby and breakfast room, where drinks are served. Wi-Fi Internet access is available throughout the hotel so that guests can stay connected with friends and business associates. All rooms have a partial sea view and are decorated in a classical style but with modern amenities. All units are air-conditioned to ensure guests' comfort.

148174.description: This modernly furnished beach hotel has an elegant and spacious lobby lounge with free Wi-Fi access and family-friendly facilities. It is located on Turkey's southern coast, 8 km west from the resort and historical village of Side. Some shops can be found in Evrenseki, a couple of minutes' walk from the hotel where public transport is available with easy access to Side's ancient ruins, shopping centre and restaurants. During the summer months guests can relax by the outdoor pool and enjoy the water slides or soak up the sun on the beach with a heated indoor pool option during the winter months. An on-site spa provides stylish amenities for various treatments and massages, while younger guests can benefit from the mini club and games centre.

148257.description:
The hotel’s elegant terraces and shimmering pools offer an exclusive haven for relaxation, where panoramic views set the tone for an unforgettable stay. From sunset cocktails and leisurely moments by the pool to indulgent treatments at the luxury spa and refined culinary experiences inspired by Barcelona’s vibrant food scene, every moment is designed to delight. 
Whether you choose a sophisticated escape in one of the hotel’s 70 beautifully appointed rooms or wish to immerse yourself in the city’s dynamic lifestyle, METT Barcelona stands as a destination in its own right. Complimentary transfers to the city centre complete the experience, ensuring effortless access to the heart of Barcelona.

148277.description: This hotel enjoys a strategic location in touristic Barcelona. Camp Nou Stadium and the Barcelona Football Club Museum are 400 m away, various restaurants are in the immediate vicinity and the bus station and shopping venues are about 50 m away. The sea and sandy beach are around 5 km and 7 km from the establishment respectively. The city centre is 6 km from the hotel and Barcelona El Prat De Llobregat Airport is approximately 9 km away. This modern, minimalistic, 30-room hotel has a hall with floor-to-ceiling panes of glass. It features wireless Internet access throughout the entire complex, offering an Internet connection from any laptop. A variety of services, such as professional massage treatments and bike hire, are at the disposal of guests. The units are furnished in a modern style and feature LCD flat-screen TVs, music channels and private bathrooms.

148305.description: Upmarket Istanbul hotel with meeting rooms and an indoor pool, in the Harbiye business area near Taksim SquareCentrally located in the Harbiye business district, Crowne Plaza® Istanbul – Harbiye hotel is ideal for business travellers and visitors on a city break. We are a 30-minute drive from Istanbul Airport. Leave your car in our free underground parking and visit the sights by way of Osmanbey Metro Station, a 10 minute walk away. The smart shops, restaurants and cinemas of the City's Nisantasi mall are 10 minutes away on foot. It's a pleasant 20-minute stroll to Taksim Square and two stops by metro to the 14th-century Galata Tower. The hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and 17 meeting rooms, the largest accommodating 300 people. Our Crowne Plaza Meetings Director can help with all the details.  We are a 10-minute walk from the Istanbul Congress Centre and the Lutfi Kirdar Convention Centre, while the Halic Congress Centre is six kilometres away. Destress in our Turkish bath or indoor pool before you relax with a drink in the Onyx bar. Enjoy international cuisine in our Ege Restaurant or Mediterranean dishes in our Sisha Pup Restaurant. For comfort, 24-hour room service is available. The Sleep Advantage® programme ensures a good night's sleep in our large, elegant rooms thanks to premium bedding and quiet zones.

148309.address: Ruzgarlibahce Mah.Sehit Yuzbasi Sinan Eroglu Cad., 5
148309.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, and a sauna. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite to eat at one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-out. Planning an event in Beykoz? This hotel has 1345 square feet (125 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite.

148344.description: This city hotel enjoys a central location, only minutes from the Arc de Triomphe and the shopping boulevard of the Champs Elysées. The nearest metro station is located around 100 m away, and so is a bus station. Charles de Gaulle Airport as well as Orly can be reached within around 30 minutes. Paris Beauvais-Tille Airport and Brussels Airport are approximately 65kms and 316 kms from the establishment respectively. Built in 1904, this 4-storey city hotel comprises 40 rooms. It offers a 24-hour reception service with a safe, lift. Dining options include a café and a breakfast room. There is a TV lounge and a laundry service also available, as well as an Internet terminal and wireless access. The accommodation units come with an en- suite bathroom, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, and air-conditioning.

148345.description: This hotel enjoys a delightful setting amidst the romance and charm of Paris. The hotel is located just 5 km from Notre Dame, lying just a short metro ride away from the mesmerising attractions that the city has to offer. Guests will find themselves in the ideal setting from which to experience the rich culture, history and style of the city. This hotel welcomes guests with elegance and charm, inviting them into the beautifully-designed interior. The guest rooms are exquisitely appointed, reflecting the elegance and charm of French style. Guests are invited to enjoy a delicious breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore the intrigue of the city. This hotel offers a stylish setting for business and leisure travellers visiting Paris.

148361.address: J2G4+VP4, Derb Abdellah Ben Hssain Bab
148361.description: The hotel is located 5 minutes from the famous Jamaa el Fna Square, just by Bab Laksour (The Gate of Palaces). The lively souks with their Moroccan handicrafts and the Koutoubia Tower are just a short walk away. The Majorelle Garden is approximately 3 km away and the Bahia Palace is around 2 km away. The hotel is a 10-minute drive from Marrakech-Menara International Airport. This air-conditioned family-friendly hotel was renovated in 2010 and offers 5 rooms. Guests will be made very welcome in the lobby, which also features a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe and currency exchange facilities. A restaurant and a bar are also available. Other services provided by the hotel include a laundry service, car and bicycle hire, assistance with golf bookings and a babysitting service. The hotel also offers a car park and the lounge can be used for seminars or conference purposes. Each of the guest rooms at the hotel is equipped with en suite bathroom facilities including a shower and WC, as well as a double bed, air conditioning and satellite TV. They provide an elegant and cosy living space for a comfortable stay in Marrakech. The rooms are decorated in typical Moroccan style and additionally feature a telephone, a hairdryer, an ironing set, a safe (on request) and a washing machine. They come with Internet access, tea and coffee making facilities, individually regulated heating and a balcony or terrace as standard.

148362.address: 21 Derb Abdellah Ben Hssain Bab Laksour Medina
148362.description: This ancient 18th century riad is situated close to the Bab Laksour, also known as The Gate of Palaces. Guests will be conveniently situated near the Koutoubia Mosque, with the famous Jemaa El Fna square only a 5 minute walk away. Majorel Gardens and Bahia Palace are both around 5 minutes away using public transport. This charming, family-friendly historical hotel offers rooftop terrace with a panoramic view of the Koutoubia Mosque and the Atlas Mountains. Guests will find the peaceful atmosphere in their well-appointed rooms very welcoming. Those who enjoy soaking up the sun can do so beside to the outdoor swimming pool on the rooftop. A delightful dining experience awaits guests, as the main restaurant is out on the patio.

148375.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting at the heart of the mesmerising city of Barcelona. The hotel is located just 200 metres away from the renowned Passeig de Gracia. Guests will find themselves in the ideal setting from which to explore the essence and delights of this artistic city. The hotel is situated just a short walking distance from links to the public transport network, while the beach is just 1. 5 km away. Barcelona El Prat De Llobregat Airport lies just 12 km from the hotel. This wonderful hotel exudes character and style. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, featuring a perfect blend of classical and modernist designs. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities, offering comfort and convenience. Guests are sure to be pleased by the host of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

148404.description: Find our hotel and private beach in the West Bay diplomatic area on the north end of the Doha Corniche. Within 10 kilometers, reach The Pearl, Souq Waqif, and the Museum of Islamic Art. Enjoy our restaurants, outdoor pool, water sports, and the Nashira Ballroom for special gatherings. Concierge services and sea-view rooms complete your stay.

148407.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Set on the picturesque and exclusive island of Zamalek on the magnificent waters of the River Nile, the Hilton Cairo Zamalek Residences is located in a tranquil spot between downtown Cairo and Giza and is only 12 miles from Cairo Airport. All of the luxurious Guest Rooms at this hotel in Cairo offer spectacular city or river views and feature modern amenities such as high-speed internet access and LCD TVs. Upgrade to an elegant Suite for additional space, a kitchen, living and dining areas and terraces offering scenic Nile views. Hold a professional conference in one of 3 flexible meeting rooms, all of which feature the latest in audio/visual technology and make use of our business center. Dine on international and oriental cuisine overlooking the pool and the River Nile in Nile Breeze, listen to live music in the Tea Time Lounge and enjoy casual al fresco food and drink on the deck at Waves. Work out in the complimentary Fitness Center, swim lengths in the heated swimming pool, which features a whirlpool or indulge in a massage while the little ones have fun in the Children’s Play Area. Explore the Egyptian Museum, experience the exotic sights, sounds and smells of the vibrant Egyptian Bazaar, 'Khan El-Khalili' and marvel at the Great Sphinx and Pyramids at Giza.

148414.address: 126 Buitengracht St, Cape Town City Centre
148414.description: Welcome to Hyatt Regency Cape Town . Immerse yourself in the culture and color of one of Cape Town’s most vibrant neighborhoods, Bo-Kaap. This historic area is rich with brightly painted houses, spice shops, and cafes, to satiate your desire for discovery. Taste your way through a flavor-filled Cape Malay gastronomic experience along two of the city’s hottest food and beverage streets, Long street and Bree, both walking distance from the 5-star hotel. If you make it in before dark, you just might catch a sunset-kissed view of Table Mountain or Signal Hill. With our newly renovated guestrooms, lobby and restaurant areas it will create the perfect stay for the business and leisure traveler.

148442.description: This family-friendly beach hotel offers an intimate and warm atmosphere at an unbeatable location. Sitting in the heart of the hotel zone it is close to the lagoon, the large shopping and leisure centres, the restaurants, nightclubs, and the convention centre. Everything can be reached both fast and easy. Most importantly the beach is just a 5-minute drive away. The hotel grounds feature many flowers typical of the Caribbean, creating an ideal environment in which to relax and forget all the worries of the outside. Guests can take advantage of the outdoor swimming pool, where both sun-loungers and parasols are provided and where the poolside bar mixes one of the most refreshing cocktails The air-conditioned rooms are well-appointed and come with king-sized beds, hospitality corners and private balconies.

148443.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at this full-service hotel featuring a spa with massages, an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to noon. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a restaurant with room service (during limited hours). Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. The 49 air-conditioned rooms offer minibars, Smart TVs, and private bathrooms with designer toiletries. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. Located near Arpoador Beach, Ipanema Beach and close to Rio de Janeiro International Airport (GIG).

148447.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in Kemer. The hotel is situated just 3. 5 km away from Phaselis Antique City. Antalya Airport is just 65 km away. This wonderful hotel is a great option for travellers who are eager to explore and experience the rich culture and history of this wonderful country. The hotel exudes charm and comfort, offering guests a peaceful setting in which to unwind. Immersed in a homely environment, the guest rooms are tastefully decorated, and are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy stunning mountain views from the rooms. Guests can enjoy delightful dining at this hotel. The hotel offers modern facilities and services for added comfort

148505.description: Ideally located just 10 km from Porto airport, and close to the transport network, this hotel is a great place to stay for those who want to explore the city. The Casa da Musica, the Rotunda da Boavista, the City Market Bolhao, the Cristal Palace Gardens and the Sandeman Port Wine Cellars and Museum are some of the sights worth seeing, and are all nearby. In addition there is a good selection of retail and dining options within easy reach. The hotel offers all the necessary facilities to cater for the requirements of their guests including free wireless internet access. A complimentary breakfast is served and drinks and snacks are available from the bar. The air-conditioned/centrally heated rooms are simply yet tastefully decorated. They all have balconies and come with everything that is needed to ensure the clients comfort and enjoyment. Non-smoking rooms are available.

148507.description: Enjoy a central Paris stay at the Hôtel Royal Bergère, within a 15-minute walk of the Galeries Lafayette and Palais Garnier. This hotel offers 29 guestrooms with amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, LCD TVs with satellite programming, and laptop-compatible safes. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box. Conveniently located near the Folies Bergère and Grands Boulevards, the hotel is also 1. 2 miles from the Moulin Rouge and 1. 3 miles from the Palais Royal. The nearest airports are Orly (ORY) and Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

148514.address: Rue Du Bas Marin / Zone Senia, 6
148514.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a shared TV area, and a vending machine at the Grand Hôtel Senia in Orly's business district. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Amenities include complimentary newspapers, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. The hotel provides free roundtrip airport shuttle service (24 hours) and train station pick-up. The 36 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs, complimentary wired and wireless internet, and digital programming. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Desks and a turndown service are also provided, with daily housekeeping. The hotel is conveniently located near the Belle Épine Shopping Center and Espace Jean Monnet, a short drive from Rungis International Market and Paris Expo.

148547.description: YOUR APARTMENT IS LOCATED 5 RUE DE VARENNE 75007 PARIS You benefit from a self-check in so please read the instructions below carefully to get to your apartment (PLEASE NOTE THE KEYS WILL ONLY BE AVAILABLE FROM 4 PM CHECK IN TIME) either:For self check in instructions to directly reach your apartment thanks to send a whats ap message indicating your name and arrival date on + 33 6 16 31 28 16 or by mail claudine. caussignac@bridgestreet. fr Informations will be given 1 week prior arrival only for security reasons.

148603.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the eco-certified Hotel L'Interlude in Paris's Bercy district, a short drive from Bercy Village and Arena. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (available for a fee) and stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel offers 44 air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs and private bathrooms. Additional amenities include room service (limited hours), a computer station, and a 24-hour front desk. Notre Dame and Palais Garnier are also within easy reach. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

148612.description: Centrally located in the heart of Jumeirah 1, our five star upscale Crowne Plaza Jumeirah counts 252 rooms and suites that are perfect for those staying for business or leisure and craving some fun. We are centrally located on Al Mina Road, near Sheikh Zayed Road, Jumeirah Beach, Port Rashid and La Mer Dubai. We offer a variety of room types, from deluxe and suites, including 32 family connecting rooms. All rooms feature all necessary 5-star amenities, and some designated ones include Burj Khalifa views. Our hotel includes an extensive culinary offering, from The Plaza, on the ground floor, including a Coffee lounge and coworking space, our signature restaurant, Ginger, a Pan Asian restaurant, and The Docks gastropub, a British pub favourite in the area. Our Wellness facilities include a pool to enjoy a refreshing cocktail, five treatment rooms, a whirlpool, a Moroccan bath and a sauna. Our meeting facilities are suitable for small reunions or big weddings and celebrations for those coming for business or events. Relax at Jumeirah Beach, enjoy the nearby nightlife, or go shopping to most of the city's malls/centres within the hotel, just a lift away by our complimentary shuttle bus.

148614.description:
Welcome to NX London Hostel, proudly nestled in a classic Victorian building dating back to 1897. Rich with history, character, and timeless charm, our hostel is anything but ordinary. Like any heritage treasure, it comes with a few delightful quirks, reminders of a bygone era that lend a truly unique flavor to your stay. 
We adore our historic building and the charm it brings, but we know it’s not for everyone. 
Please keep your expectations consistent with the budget, community minded accommodation we provide. 
The hostel is just a two-minute stroll from both New Cross Gate and New Cross Overground and train stations. 
Reception is open 4. 00 PM to 1:00 AM daily
Upon arrival all guests must provide a copy of a valid Photo ID*, along with a £50 deposit for incidentals. 
We reserve the right to refuse accommodation to anybody without giving a reason.

148670.description: Situated in Dubai's Bur Dubai area, this hotel is less than 2 km from Jumeirah open beach and 1 km to mean bazaar and is a 2-minute walk from public transportation links. It features a rooftop swimming pool and a lively nightclub. Rooms at the hotel have tiled floors and modern furnishings. They come equipped with air-conditioning, a safety deposit box and satellite TV. Some rooms also feature a balcony with panoramic city views. Guests can relax in the sauna, or visit the fitness centre to make use of the cardiovascular equipment. There is also a tour desk that provides information on local attractions and assists with car hires.

148672.description: The Holiday Inn Porto Gaia, an IHG Hotel, is located in Vila Nova de Gaia (Mafamude), a short drive from the Douro River and Dom Luís I Bridge. This upscale hotel offers a full-service spa with massages, body treatments, and facials, as well as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (for a fee). Each of the 179 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, LCD TV, pillowtop bed, and private bathroom with a rainfall showerhead. The hotel's restaurant, Friends Kitchen, serves Portuguese cuisine and has a bar/lounge. Room service is also available during limited hours. A buffet breakfast is served daily for a fee. Additional amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, a conference center, and 16 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies), and self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

148756.description: Enjoy a central Paris location at the Hôtel Williams Opéra, a short walk from the Grands Boulevards and just a five-minute drive from the Paris Olympia and Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore. This hotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (available for a fee), served daily between 7:00 AM and 10:00 AM. The 30 guestrooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, digital programming, and en suite bathrooms with bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Safes, blackout drapes/curtains, and phones with free local calls are also provided. Nearby attractions include the Galeries Lafayette (1. 1 km) and the Palais Garnier (2. 2 km).

148758.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can catch a ride on the complimentary shuttle, which operates within 5 km.
