Satisfy your appetite for dinner at the hotel's restaurant, Restuarant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Cape Town? This hotel has 1356 square feet (126 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite.

148765.description: Situated on a breathtaking beach just 14 km from Cancun International Airport, this beautiful hotel offers a perfect family getaway. The central pyramid-shaped building and four surrounding buildings provide stunning Caribbean views. Guests can enjoy convenient access to shops, bars, restaurants, and public transport, plus on-site parking. The hotel features cozy rooms for relaxation, seven restaurants for sumptuous dining, and fabulous leisure facilities including three pools, a spa, gym, and tennis courts. Internet access is also available.

name.content: The Pyramid Cancun by Oasis - Gourmet Premium AI

148766.description:
The hotel is conveniently located in one of the largest and most beautiful sandy beaches of Cancun, close to a number of dining and shopping venues. This exclusive luxury establishment is surrounded by elegant gardens and offers the best live entertainment, music festivals, and in-house facilities. It is the stage where imagination and fun know no bounds. Plenty amenities and various services are offered in order to provide maximum comfort. Guests may make use of the outdoor swimming pool with poolside snack bar, the tennis courts and the in-house gym. Sun loungers with parasols are laid out on site and on the nearby sandy beach. 

Please note that while the resort offers an All-Inclusive experience, select services, amenities, and premium offerings may be subject to additional charges.

148776.description: This hotel is located in the historic and commercial centre of Vila Real and in close proximity to all of its points of interest. The hotel can house a total of 332 guests in its 166 rooms. All of its accommodation units are equipped with modern amenities including air-conditioning, satellite TV and free WiFi Internet. One of the rooms is especially equipped for persons with disabilities. The hotel has 6 conference rooms and an auditorium with 196 seats. It offers audio-visual equipment, bar and secretarial service, which makes it suitable for business and leisure travellers alike. The hotel restaurant overlooks the Corgo River and serves local cuisine during the lunch and dinner hours. Indoor Swimming Pool (seasonal) - closed between October and May. Guests can take a 5-minute walk to the Câmara Eclesiástica De Vila Real or take an 8-minute drive to the Matteus Palace.

149517.address: Plot No F 77 Vile Parle East Junction of Nehru Roa
149517.description: The ibis Mumbai Airport hotel is conveniently located near Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), BEC, Bandra, and both Mumbai airports—the Domestic Terminal (5 minutes) and the International Terminal (12 minutes). A complimentary shared shuttle service is available to and from both airports with select packages, ensuring you'll never miss a flight. Spice IT restaurant offers an extended breakfast service and 24/7 global cuisine, while the Hub bar provides a wide selection of beverages and fun games. Stay connected with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi.

150366.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden at Hotel Elba am Kurfürstendamm - Design Chambers, a boutique hotel located in Berlin's vibrant Charlottenburg district, just steps from the iconic Kurfürstendamm and a short drive from the Berlin Zoo. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi and the convenient area shuttle (surcharge). Savor delicious meals at the on-site restaurant, and start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies). The hotel offers 26 guestrooms equipped with cable TV, coffee/tea makers, and complimentary bottled water. Daily housekeeping and dry cleaning/laundry services are also available.

150466.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Grab a bite at RAYMOND CAFE RESTAURANT, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 36 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and slippers.

150472.description: The four-star Hotel Lugano offers 70 comfortable rooms in various configurations, from single to quadruple, all featuring air conditioning, direct-dial telephone, Wi-Fi, minibar, TV, radio, safe, laundry service, and a hairdryer. The hotel's excellent restaurant, 'Eat & Wine, ' serves traditional and international dishes alongside a wide selection of local wines, catering to special dietary needs. Guests can also enjoy a well-stocked bar and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel.

150524.description: Enjoy a relaxing drink at our on-site bar/lounge. We offer complimentary Wi-Fi, a computer station, and a 24-hour front desk for your convenience. Free self-parking is also available. Our 16 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions. Located in the heart of Croydon, the Kirkdale Hotel, a charming bed and breakfast, is within a 15-minute drive of Surrey Hills and conveniently close to central London attractions such as the London Eye and Westminster Abbey (both 10. 7 miles). The nearest airport is Gatwick (LGW), approximately 20. 5 miles away.

150525.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at the Mowbray Court Hotel in London City Centre. Dine in the on-site restaurant and enjoy a continental breakfast (fee applies). The hotel offers 138 air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs, satellite programming, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and electric kettles. Daily housekeeping is provided. Nearby attractions include Kensington High Street, the Natural History Museum, Westfield London Shopping Centre, and Hyde Park. The closest airports are London City (LCY), Heathrow (LHR), and Gatwick (LGW).

150567.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, gift shops/newsstands, and a fireplace in the lobby. For lunch or dinner, stop by Oleo Pazzo Bistro, a restaurant that specializes in Mediterranean cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Saint-Denis? This hotel has 1345 square feet (125 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

150570.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at Gramaci, a theme restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Puteaux? This hotel has 10258 square feet (953 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 330 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions.

name.content: Renaissance Paris Le Parc Trocadero Hotel

150571.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, a terrace, and a garden at the Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a ballroom. Savor a meal at Maison Revka, and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fees apply). The hotel also features a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. For events, the hotel offers 3, 143 square feet (292 square meters) of space, including a conference center and five meeting rooms. The 122 guest rooms feature iPod docking stations, minibars, and flat-screen televisions. Private bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks are also provided. Located near Place du Trocadéro, the hotel is a short distance from attractions like the Eiffel Tower and Champs-Élysées. The preferred airport is Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG).

150572.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, a terrace, and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Solis restaurant offers delicious meals, and you can grab a quick bite at the snack bar/deli. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fees apply). Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Paris? This hotel offers 1, 615 square feet (150 square meters) of space, including conference space and four meeting rooms. The 118 guest rooms feature minibars, espresso makers, and 46-inch LCD televisions with satellite programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi and private bathrooms with designer toiletries and hair dryers are also provided. For your convenience, phones, laptop-compatible safes, and complimentary newspapers are included. The hotel is located near Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore, the Champs-Élysées, and the Arc de Triomphe. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

150574.description: The hotel is located on Rumeli Avenue in Nisantası with easy access to the most popular entertainment, shopping within walking distance, and 5 minutes from the metro and Lütfü Kırdar Congres. Guests will find restaurants and bars in the immediate vicinity and clubs are a 5-minute walk away. Taksim Square, Ortaköy, and the sights of Sultanahmet, such as Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sofia and Blue Mosque, are not far from the hotel. This hotel offers a comfortable and friendly atmosphere.

150602.description: Apartments Sixtyfour Barcelona are located in one of the traditional buildings on Paseo de Gracia. It is, without a doubt, Barcelona's most prestigious street, a paradise of shops and modernist art. Our apartments are completely refurbished and have been designed to offer you room, comfort and wellbeing during your stay in the city, be it for business or pleasure. Therefore, everything from the bedroom, to the dining room, kitchen and bathroom are fully equipped down to the last detail. Ideal for both families with children and groups of friends (maximum capacity 8 people).   Their privileged location means that you are within walking distance of the main tourist sites with Las Ramblas, the Cathedral and the Gothic Quarter, the Sagrada Familia, Gaudi's most emblematic buildings or the most representative shops of Barcelona.

150609.description: This modern apartment building, located in Chatou near the Seine River, offers a peaceful retreat just a short walk from the Chatou-Croissy RER station and a ten-minute drive from La Défense. Ideal for extended business trips and family getaways, the property is surrounded by green spaces and provides easy access to cultural attractions like the Château de Malmaison and La Maison Fournaise. Comfortable rooms feature air conditioning, soundproofing, internet access, and a balcony or terrace. Studios and apartments also include kitchenettes for preparing meals. A daily breakfast buffet is available, and guests can dine at nearby partner restaurants, purchase a sack lunch at the reception desk, or have meals delivered to their rooms (contact reception for details). CERISE Chatou is Accueil Vélo approved.

150639.description: The hotel is located in two 18th-century mansions in the heart of Amsterdam. It is in the middle of the museum and fashion district, 350 m away from the Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh museum and Stedelijk Museum Leidseplein. Vondelpark and the Concert Hall is just a short walk away. The lounge bar, the restaurant and the private garden give a pleasurable place to rest. The air-conditioned establishment offers room and laundry service, as well as bicycle hire. The rooms come with full-range of amenities including a TV, DVD player and WiFi Internet access. Spa bathroom products, a rain shower and a hairdryer are also provided in the bathrooms. The units are air-conditioned and come with a safe and a minibar. The rooms also offer a double/king-size bed and coffee making facilities.

150646.description: Situated opposite South Bank University, this modern city hotel offers 33 stylishly appointed rooms, blending traditional elegance with contemporary amenities. A short walk from Lambeth North and Elephant & Castle tube stations, it's surrounded by numerous bars and restaurants. Ideal for business conferences, weddings, and receptions, this family-friendly hotel features a lobby and restaurant. Comfortable rooms include a TV, fridge, hairdryer, tea/coffee making facilities, complimentary fruit and bottled water, and Wi-Fi access. Triple rooms are furnished with one double and one single bed. A continental breakfast is served daily. Guests can request twin or double rooms directly with the hotel, subject to availability.

150670.description: This upscale business hotel is located in the TTC Industrial area of Mahape, in India. Guests will find themselves just 35 km from the Mumbai Airport, 23 km from Lokmanya Tilak Terminus and 39 km from Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus. This contemporary hotel exudes refined elegance and a timeless classical design. The lobby welcomes guests with glass features, opulent chandeliers, lavish leather sofas and intricate, embellished designs. The guest rooms feature warm, earthy tones, luxurious bedding and furnishings, and stunning Indian influences. The guest rooms offer a serene sanctuary, in which to relax or work, undisturbed by the rest of the world. The hotel provides first-class business and meeting facilities, to surpass all expectations.

150702.description: This hotel boasts an excellent location in the heart of Palermo, near restaurants, bars, and designer shops. Buenos Aires's main attractions are easily accessible. The hotel offers a lobby with 24-hour currency exchange, lift access, a cafe, bar, and breakfast room. Wireless internet and room service are available. Limited parking is available in the hotel's car park and garage; booking in advance is recommended.

150737.description: This charming and cosy hostel is excellently located in the centre of Barcelona in the Eixample district. Gaudí's famous La Pedrera is only 200 m away, Passeig de Gràcia 100 m. Plaça de Catalunya, the great central square of the city, and the Sants train station can both be reached in about 10 minutes on foot. Metro station Diagonal is only 50 m away, offering easy access to all areas. The hostel features free WIFI throughout and luggage storage.

name.content: You Stylish Barcelona Apartments City Centre

150747.description:
The city hotel is located in city centre of Barcelona, in the main square Plaza Catalunya. It is the best connected area of the city with metro and bus stops and just 5 minutes from the beach by car. Las Ramblas is only 300 metres away.

The city hotel is housed in a nice renovated building. The establishment has a hotel safe, lift access to the upper floors and wireless Internet access.

The hotel offers perfect 3-bedroom apartments for guests to enjoy a family stay with views of the main city centre. The apartments are spacious and bright and have air conditioning and stylish contemporary decor. There is a double master bedroom with an en suite bathroom with a shower, bath and hairdryer. The other two bedrooms have twin beds. There is also a nice living room with direct access to the balcony. The kitchen is fully equipped with a mini fridge, microwave and tea and coffee making facilities. Each apartment additionally has a direct dial telephone, safe, wireless Internet access and a flat-screen TV. Moreover, they have an ironing set and a washing machine. Heating is a standard feature in all accommodation units.

There are sun loungers available on the sandy beach.

150749.description: The apartments of this beach hotel are located on the first line of Barcelona's beach. It is well connected to the city centre with metro and bus and only 5 minutes away by car. It is also 1. 5 km from the Parc Diagonal Mar. Barcelona El Prat De Llobregat Airport is about 17 km away. The beach hotel is located in a nice building complex. The hotel has a big private garden, hotel safe, lift access and a kids' playing area. Wireless Internet access is provided and there is a 24-hour security guard at the complex. Moreover, there are parking places available on request in the car park. Each room has an en suite bathroom with a shower, bath and a hairdryer. Rooms are furnished with double or king-size beds and amenities include a direct dial telephone, TV, radio, Internet access and a safe. The kitchen has a fridge as well as tea and coffee making facilities. There is also a washing machine and an ironing set for added convenience. Individually regulated air conditioning and individually regulated heating are standard features in all accommodation units. Furthermore, each room has its own balcony or terrace. The hotel offers 2 paddle courts and an adult's swimming pool with a separate children's pool. Sun loungers are on offer at the hotel and on the sandy beach.

150779.description: Hotel Casa Bárbara is located on the island of Holbox, surrounded by lush gardens with hammocks, offers an outdoor pool, a spa area and free Wi-Fi. Its 19 spacious rooms, all with garden views, have air conditioning, fan, cable TV, a comfortable desk and private shower. Some of the rooms offer the option of a king size bed and two other double beds. The hotel is located 10 minutes walk from the beach and 5 from the main town square, where you can find various dining options and shops of all kinds. The staff can help you organize various experiences and organize excursions through Holbox and the Yum Balam nature reserve. They can also support you to rent bicycles or a golf cart to explore the island.

150809.address: P.O.Box: 20409, Old Salata, Al Safilia Street
150809.description: Welcome to Best Western Plus Doha Hotel!The best in Qatar accommodations are conveniently close to the airport, and are a favorite of business travelers with Qatar Petroleum and other nearby enterprises. Take advantage of everything luxury hotels near the Hamadan Airport have to offer at this Best Western property. Qatar International Trading workers and business travelers with Qatar Airways regularly enjoy the convenience and luxe accommodations only Doha hotels can provide. Whether travelers need family rooms in Qatar or to be located in the City Centre for easy commutes, this Doha hotel offers a superior location. Many guests choose this property for business purposes, with very close proximity to the airport as well as leading corporations making travel simple. Newly refurbished in 2015 with all modern conveniences and spacious family rooms, this Doha hotel has everything travelers need for a seamless trip. Katara Beach, home of the Souq Waqif, is close by and Aspire Park is also in the region. Travelers can easily access the Mall Shopping Centre for luxury goods and keepsakes, or go to the Islamic Art Museum for a touch of history and culture. The Aqua Park Qatar and the relaxing Corniche is a must for families, adventure seekers, and anyone looking to keep cool and indulge in a thrill while traveling. There is close proximity from this Doha hotel to all major embassies, and guests are within walking distance to popular tourist spots and key commercial centers. All rooms are refurbished and feature a lounge with couches, ideal for extended stays. Employees of Ericsson, IBM and Caterpillar are regular guests at the Doha hotel. Whether traveling on business with Halliburton, for leisure, or a mixture of both, the management and staff are committed to providing the highest standard of service. Book your oversized suite at the Best Western Plus Doha Hotel today and get ready for the most relaxing international trip imaginable!

150813.description: This upscale city hotel is strategically situated in the Laleli district of old Istanbul. The hotel is conveniently situated within easy walking distance of the city's must-see attractions, including Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque and Topkapi Palace. Local transport links are available nearby, offering ease of access to other areas of this mesmerising city. The exciting Grand Bazaar is situated just a 10 minutes' walk away, while the waterfront, fish restaurants and lively bars at Kumkapi lie less than 1 km from the hotel. This stylish, modern hotel welcomes guests with traditional Turkish hospitality, elegance and luxury. The guest rooms are beautifully designed in an elegant style, and offer the perfect place in which to relax and completely unwind in comfort at the end of the day.

150816.address: Boulevard Kukulcan, Lote C-1, Hotel Zone, KM 4.6
150816.description: Situated just fifteen minutes from the city centre of Cancun and a 20-minute drive from the international airport, this family-friendly beachfront resort is the perfect place for a relaxing, sunny holiday with the whole family. Those who enjoy history and culture might venture out to the ruins of El Rey and El Meco, both within 15 kilometres of the hotel, and explore the famous archaeological site at Tulum 135 kilometres away. Alternatively, guests might sunbathe on the white sand beach or lounge by one of two sparkling outdoor pools with a drink from the swim-up bar. The spacious rooms come with cool tile floors and views over the lagoon or the ocean, and with six onsite restaurants serving a wide range of cuisines from Italian and sushi to local tapas and seafood specialties, the resort truly offers something for everyone, making it the perfect choice for a delightful family holiday in the sun .

150842.description: This hotel is located in the historical centre of Madrid. It lies just 100 metres away from the Gran Via, between the famous districts of Chueca and Malasana. Guests will find restaurants, bars and clubs within a 5 minutes' walking distance away. The Plaza de Espana, Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor, the Cathedral and Palacio Real can be found nearby. The major museums of the city can be found just a 20 minutes' walking distance away. This hotel occupies one of the few remaining Art Nouveau buildings in the historical centre of the city. Dating back to 1890, the building oozes historical charm. The guest rooms have been designed to respect the style of a bygone era. The hotel offers modern convenience through its exemplary facilities. ***Please note hostel requests arrival time, and phone, please contact them prior to your arrival*** ***Reception opening hours are from 8. 00 AM to 22. 00 PM exclusively, after this time no check in is allowed***

150845.description: Just 5 minutes’ walk from the famous Bullring Shopping Center, B&B Hotel Birmingham has a great location, less than 0. 5 miles from Birmingham city center. With free Wi-Fi in its trendy bar and public areas, it also features 2 meeting rooms, an on-site restaurant and a fitness center. Each spacious room at B&B Hotel Birmingham has an en suite shower and free toiletries, a flat-screen TV and a desk. In the morning you can enjoy a hearty breakfast – or grab a pastry to go if you’re in a rush. Lunch and dinner are also available in the on-site restaurant. The NEC is only 9 miles away, and Birmingham’s National Sea Life Center is 5 minutes’ drive from the building. Cadbury World, where you can see tours and exciting events, is a 10-minute drive away, and Birmingham International Airport is a 20-minute journey by car. Birmingham New Street Station is within 10 minute's walk from the hotel.

150850.description: The hotel is situated in the heart of Paris, 1 km from the Champs-Élysées. Its convenient location allows easy access by metro to all major attractions of the city such as museums, galleries and theatres. This beautiful boutique property places great emphasis on a warm welcome and comfort. The atmosphere is one of refinement and elegance in all 28 rooms. Guests are welcomed to visit the stylish bar where they can enjoy a drink and a friendly conversation. Both wired and wireless Internet access is also provided throughout the hotel. All rooms feature an en-suite bathroom with a bath as standard. In-room amenities include a TV with satellite cable channels and tea and coffee making facilities. The hotel is baby-friendly : in addition to the cot, the hotel has a bathtub suitable for children, baby bottle warmer and changing table that can be requested directly at the hotel.

150854.description:
B&B HOTEL Brussels East Woluwe – Your Hotel Near Brussels:
Located in Woluwe-Saint-Lambert, just minutes from Brussels city center, our hotel offers comfortable, budget-friendly accommodation ideal for business travelers, families, and tourists. 

Strategic Location:
The hotel is well-connected via the E40 and public transport. Key destinations like Grand Place and Manneken Pis are within 10 km, and Brussels Airport is just 10 minutes away. It's also near EU and NATO offices, with Brussels-Midi train station 10 km away. 

Comfortable Stay:
We offer 165 rooms with comfortable beds, private bathrooms, free high-speed Wi-Fi, and international TV channels. Family rooms host up to 4 people, with baby beds and irons available upon request. 
Guests can enjoy:
24-hour reception, Underground parking (€15/day) with bike and motorbike storage, Luggage storage, Accessibility features and pet-friendly policy (extra fee)

Breakfast Buffet:
Enjoy an all-you-can-eat sweet and savory buffet, including pastries, eggs, cheeses, fresh fruits, cereals, juices, and hot drinks. 

Discover the Area - Nearby attractions include:
Woluwe Park: Great for walking or jogging
Woluwe Shopping Center: Shops, dining, and cafés
Brussels: Visit the Grand-Place, Magritte Museum, and BELvue Museum. Try local dishes like moules-frites and Belgian waffles. 
Ideal for exploring nearby towns such as Leuven, Mechelen or nature spots like the Sonian Forest.

name.content: Hotel Feel Inn Venice Airport Rooms

150855.description: The modern Hotel Feel Inn Venice Airport is conveniently located on the main road to Venice's historic center, just 2. 5 km from Marco Polo Airport. Public bus number 5, stopping just steps from the hotel at Passo Campalto Orlanda, provides quick access to the airport (5 minutes) and Venice's city center (15 minutes), with service every 15 minutes, even after midnight. The hotel offers uniquely themed rooms, each with a private bathroom, and some featuring balconies or park views. Amenities include private parking and LCD TVs. A grocery store, café, bar, restaurant, ATM, and pharmacy are all nearby.

150856.description: The hotel is located on Alfonso XII Street in the impressive Retiro district. It is just 290 m away from the popular Puerta de Alcalá, Plaza de Cibeles and Paseo del Prado. Madrid Barajas Airport is approximately 16 km away. This boutique hotel was built in 2011 and is ideal for both tourists and business travellers. It has been totally refurbished with a renewed design and technological advances, while retaining its structure and emblematic facade. This city hotel has 87 elegant rooms, each equipped with Internet access and climate control. All units are accessible through lifts. The hotel is fully air-conditioned and has a bar and a lovely breakfast room where guests can enjoy tasty food and drinks. Conference facilities are available and bicycles may also be hired on-site.

150857.description:
Petit Palace Santa Bárbara occupies a former palace renovated in 2026 on the historic Plaza de Santa Bárbara, in the Chamberí district and just 20 metres from Alonso Martínez Metro Station, in one of Madrid's most stylish areas. Plaza de Colón, Gran Vía and the nightlife of Chueca are a 5-minute walk away, and Plaza de Cibeles is close by, surrounded by restaurants, cafés and shops. The Santiago Bernabéu Stadium is three Metro stops from the hotel, and Barajas Airport can be reached in 30 minutes from Alonso Martínez. 

The rooms and apartments are spacious, with views over the city centre and a striking contemporary décor with modern furnishings. All come with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV and free WiFi. 

A buffet breakfast is served each morning, and throughout the day the hotel's restaurant, The Place to Be, offers international cuisine combining healthy dishes with modern signature cooking. Its terrace, with a lounge area and a wide cocktail list, and the patio bar, open in the evenings, are two of the hotel's most appealing spaces. The 24-hour reception provides information on the city, free bicycles for guests and electric scooter rental, subject to availability. With its location, its palatial building and its atmosphere, Petit Palace Santa Bárbara is an ideal base for exploring Madrid.

150878.address: SAB TV Road, Off Link Road Andheri West
150878.description: The hotel is located in the heart of the Lokhandwala Complex, in the midst of North Mumbai's largest commercial and residential district of Andheri West. The hotel is situated within close proximity of leading Bollywood studios, shopping centres, multiplexes and business arcades. It is located 5 km away from Andheri railway station and 8 km from Chhatrapati Shivaji airport. A service-oriented hotel with superb facilities and amenities provides travellers with excellent value for money. The hotel's chic styling is inspired by Swedish design philosophy and features clean lines and minimalist interiors. The hotel is conveniently located, offering modern amenities in all guest rooms and superb service thus making it the ideal choice for both business and leisure travellers. The hotel provides a total of 29 guest rooms categorised into 22 superior rooms, 6 deluxe and 1 luxury suite. The hotel is air-conditioned and houses a lobby with a 24-hour reception offering a 24-hour check-out service and a hotel safe. A newspaper stand also features, and fine food is served in the restaurant. Those looking to organise an event will appreciate the conference facilities, whilst guests can surf the web thanks to the wireless Internet access provided. Room and laundry services are also provided at the hotel. The air-conditioned guest rooms are spacious and comfortable. They are well-furnished and come complete with modern amenities like flat-panel satellite/cable TVs with DVD players, complimentary wireless high-speed Internet access and tea and coffee making facilities. They are en suite with a shower, bath and hairdryer. A double bed features as standard as does a telephone, safe and minibar. Guests can also relax on their balcony or terrace.

150976.description: Centrally located on a residential street in Earls Court, this property enjoys close proximity to Kensington and Chelsea. The property is located close to links to the public transport network, enjoying ease of access to the many attractions that the city has to offer. Many shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can also be found nearby. The hotel comprises 3 former townhouses, which were build in the 1800s. The guest rooms are stunningly designed, beautifully retaining an element of rustic elegance and history. This property prides itself on its excellent customer service, welcoming ambiance and comfortable setting, ensuring a relaxing stay for every type of traveller.

150992.description: Pamper yourself with body treatments and facials at this Ipanema hotel, where you'll also enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and on-site shopping. Savor a meal at the restaurant or take advantage of room service (during limited hours). Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast served daily from 7 AM to noon. The hotel also offers complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. The 56 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, flat-screen televisions with cable programming, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Private bathrooms include showers, hair dryers, and bathrobes. Additional conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Located near Ipanema Beach, the hotel is also a short distance from Posto 9, Rodrigo de Freitas Lagoon, and Leblon Beach. The preferred airport is Rio de Janeiro International Airport (GIG).

150997.description: Nestled on a hill in southern Isla Mujeres, this hotel offers partial Caribbean Sea views and convenient access to Coco Paraiso Beach Club and other island attractions, including reefs and watersports. While not directly on the beach, complimentary golf cart transportation to the beach club is provided daily. Opened in summer 2011, the hotel cultivates a warm, tranquil atmosphere. Guests can enjoy a refreshing swimming pool, lounge bar, and a rooftop terrace with a jacuzzi. Golf cart transportation and massage services are available both at the hotel and in the suites. Featuring a blend of Caribbean and modern decor, the suites offer private jacuzzis and kitchenettes. Although the hotel itself does not offer on-site sports activities, watersports are readily available at the nearby Coco Paraiso Beach Club. Front desk services are provided from 7 am to 11 pm.

151053.description: Stop at Side Palace to discover the wonders of Manavgat. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Take advantage of the hotel's daily housekeeping, fax machine, photocopying, gift/souvenir shop, 24-hour security. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer complimentary tea, closet, towels, wooden/parqueted flooring, slippers to ensure a restful night. To enhance guests' stay, the hotel offers recreational facilities such as dart board, canoe, water park, watersports equipment rentals, private beach. For reliable service and professional staff, Side Palace caters to your needs.

151054.description: The hotel is located on an area measuring 22, 000 m2. Situated in the Colakli district on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, the hotel is 13 km west of the historic ruins and resort of Side, 55km away from Antalya airport and 60 km away from city centre. This air-conditioned beach hotel is built in five 4-storey blocks and has extensive grounds and a large, sandy beach. The hotel features modern guest rooms equipped with satellite TV, minibar, a private bathroom with a hair dryer and bath amenities. The hotel is furnished in an elegant style and features spacious grounds with a large pool and Aqua Park as well as a fully equipped spa with its skin and body treatments, special jet showers, relaxation beds with hot tub and private hot tub, complete with salt rooms. Guests can relax at the SPA centre after an exhausting day.

151060.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including an indoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite at The Bistro, a bistro which features a bar/lounge. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Jersey City? This hotel has 1032 square feet (96 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 4 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 187 guestrooms featuring Smart televisions. Wireless internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

151075.description: The hotel is located at the heart of the historical part of Athens city and the picturesque neighborhood of Plaka. It is right next to Monastiraki Square and the metro station that will ease your transportation to and from the airport and Piraeus port . Alimos beach is around 4 km away and Piraeus beach is roughly 7 km away. This establishment offers a total of 33 rooms, all elegantly furnished in a cozy atmosphere. The hotel is air-conditioned and features an all-day bar and restaurant with magnificent views of the Acropolis and Monastiraki Square. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and currency exchange. Further amenities include a safe, laundry and room services. The accommodation units have a unique style with a family atmosphere. All rooms are fully-equipped as standard and feature wooden floors, as well as high-quality and modern furnishings.

151099.description: The hotel is located in the northern part of the beautiful Holbox, by one of the most charming beaches of this tiny island in the Mexican Caribbean. The nearest airport is Cancun International Airport, which is approximately 150 km from the hotel. The beach hotel offers a fresh, clean and comfortable environment, with very attentive personalised service. There is an exclusive area with lounge chairs for guests as well as free wireless Internet access, tourist information and transfers in and out of Cancun International Airport (reservation required, additional charge). There are 15 guest rooms in total. All suites have a private bathroom with shower (cold/hot water). Beach towels are provided for guests' comfort. The rooms are located on the second row back from the beach and offer nice views. Each room features 2 double beds and individually regulated air conditioning. The nearby beach is sandy.

151138.description: Enjoy your stay in Paris at the Best Western Allegro Nation, a four star hotel, situated in eastern Paris near the Palais Omnisport of Bercy. The hotel is also near the Bastille Opera House and the Francois Mitterrand national library. Each of the hotel's 49 bedrooms is equipped with a bath, satellite television, direct dial telephone and Wi-Fi. And of course, the Best Western Allegro Nation is fully air-conditioned and has private parking. Enjoy your stay.

151150.description: 'Enjoy stunning terrace views at the centrally located Athens Way Pop Art Hotel. Stay connected with complimentary wired and wireless internet access and take advantage of convenient services such as concierge and express check-in/check-out. A surcharge airport shuttle is available. The hotel offers 25 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a refrigerator, LCD TV, and private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Unwind at the on-site bar/lounge or coffee shop. Located near Mount Lycabettus, the hotel is also a short drive from Syntagma Square and Ermou Street, providing easy access to Athens' vibrant attractions. '

151151.description: The hotel is located in Chalandri, one of the most famous suburbs of Athens, and in the heart of the commercial centre of the area, close to the Ygeia, Mitera and Iaso medical centres. The centre of Chalandri is some 500 m away, while the centre of Athens is roughly 8 km away. Maroussi and the Olympic Stadium are about 1 km away. Athens International Airport is around 25 km from the property. This is modern establishment, built in 2010, that offers a total of 14 rooms. It includes a lobby/reception area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a breakfast room and an underground car park. Other facilities at this air-conditioned establishment include a cloakroom, TV lounge and bar. Wireless Internet access is offered, and room and laundry services are available. The rooms are designed to offer comfort, luxury and beauty, combined with high-quality facilities. Each room provides a HD TFT digital 32-inch TV, digital TV channels, satellite TV, free wireless Internet access and an office workspace. A direct dial telephone, digital safe, air conditioning and heating are also provided. Further amenities include a double or king-size bed and a kitchenette with a fridge, minibar, microwave and tea and coffee making facilities. A washing machine and ironing set are also provided. The en suite bathroom offers a shower, hairdryer and personal toiletries pack. Each room has a balcony or terrace. The hotel offers an indoor heated fresh-water swimming pool for relaxing moments. A breakfast buffet is served to guests daily.

151154.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy international cuisine at Kitchen & Bar, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge, take in the garden view, and even dine alfresco. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Colombes? This hotel has 904 square feet (84 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 150 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and minibars. LCD televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while wireless internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Seine - 1. 5 km / 1 mi- Grande Arche - 2. 7 km / 1. 6 mi- Paris La Défense Arena - 2. 8 km / 1. 7 mi- La Défense - 2. 8 km / 1. 7 mi- Bois de Boulogne - 5. 1 km / 3. 2 mi- Louis Vuitton Foundation Museum - 5. 3 km / 3. 3 mi- Palais des Congrès de Paris - 6. 1 km / 3. 8 mi- Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore - 6. 8 km / 4. 2 mi- Place Charles de Gaulle - 7 km / 4. 4 mi- Arc de Triomphe - 7. 1 km / 4. 4 mi- Champs-Élysées - 7. 2 km / 4. 5 mi- Parc Monceau - 7. 3 km / 4. 6 mi- ParisLongchamp Racecourse - 7. 5 km / 4. 7 mi- Avenue Georges V - 7. 6 km / 4. 7 mi- Place du Trocadéro - 7. 7 km / 4. 8 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 38.

151156.description: This hotel is conveniently located in the serene surroundings of Lallubhai Park, with shopping centres, business districts and other points of interest in close proximity. Andheri station is a stone's throw away and both airports are just 5 km from the hotel, thus making it ideal for guests whether they are on business or holiday. This air-conditioned budget hotel situated in Mumbai's Lalubhai Park area provides a comfortable stay and efficient services with a wide variety of rooms to choose from depending on the needs of the traveller. Facilities available to guests at the air-conditioned hotel include a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, newspaper stand, and a café and restaurant. Business guests are sure to appreciate the conference facilities, and wireless Internet access, room service and a laundry service are also available. There are 54 guest rooms in total. The hotel provides beautifully designed, centrally air-conditioned rooms equipped with all modern amenities, such as cable TV, a direct dial telephone, air conditioning, Internet access and a laptop. Each room additionally features an en suite bathroom with shower and bathtub, a double bed, in-room safe, minibar, fridge and a private balcony or terrace.

151161.description: 'A short stroll from the Champs-Élysées, the Hotel Bassano offers a stylish Parisian retreat. This early 20th-century building, nestled between the 16th arrondissement and the Golden Triangle, features contemporary furnishings and light parquet floors, all bathed in natural light. Its pale sky blue and grey slate facade exudes classic Parisian charm. Enjoy easy access to the Palais des Congrès, La Défense, and the Eiffel Tower via public transport. The hotel's attentive staff provides impeccable personal service, including an online concierge to help you plan your stay. '

151162.description:
Hôtel Elysées Régencia: The Perfect Blend of Comfort & Parisian Charm

Ideally located just steps away from the famous Champs-Élysées and the iconic Arc de Triomphe, Hôtel Elysées Régencia offers guests a perfect balance of luxury, comfort, and convenience. Our attentive staff ensures a warm and personalized welcome, making every guest feel right at home. 

The spacious rooms offer a relaxing retreat in the heart of Paris, with ample space for you to unwind after a day of explorating Paris. Designed with your comfort in mind, each room provides a serene environment that’s perfect for both relaxation and productivity. 

For those looking to recharge, the hotel features a cozy fitness center and a tranquil hammam—ideal for a moment of rejuvenation. Whether you’re here to discover Parisian landmarks or simply enjoy a peaceful escape, Hôtel Elysées Régencia offers the ideal base for your stay.

151176.description: Indulge in a relaxing experience at the full-service spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and a steam room. This riad also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Dine alfresco at the riad's poolside restaurant or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. For your convenience, a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers are available in the lobby. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The 25 air-conditioned guest rooms offer minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, bidets, phones, safes, and complimentary bottled water. Located in the heart of Marrakech's Medina, Palais Sebban is within a 5-minute drive of Jemaa el-Fnaa and Palais des Congrès, and conveniently close to Dar el Bacha Palace and Cyber Park. Menara Airport (RAK) is the preferred airport.

name.content: Protea Hotel By Marriott Cape Town North Wharf

151182.description: Enjoy amenities such as a health club and an outdoor pool. This Cape Town hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. The beach is easily accessible with the beach shuttle (surcharge). Dine at North Wharf Restaurant, enjoying drinks at the bar/lounge or alfresco dining. Room service is also available (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM (for a fee). Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event? The hotel offers 646 square feet (60 square meters) of space, including conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge; on request), and self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The 50 air-conditioned rooms feature microwaves, plasma televisions, and satellite television. Bathrooms include separate bathtubs and showers, hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include Bree Street, the Cape Town International Convention Centre, and Long Street.

151245.description:
DoubleTree by Hilton Vienna Schönbrunn is located right next to Vienna’s Technical Museum and just a short walk from the famous Schönbrunn Palace. Surrounded by its own private park, the hotel offers a peaceful setting while providing excellent connections to Vienna’s city centre. 

The spacious, air-conditioned and soundproof rooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, a 49-inch flat-screen TV, a laptop-sized safe and a minibar, ensuring a comfortable stay for both business and leisure travellers. Guests can also unwind in the hotel's fitness area with a sauna and steam bath. 

The elegant Regio Restaurant and the Chino Lobby Bar with its adjoining terrace overlooking the garden invite guests to relax and enjoy a variety of culinary delights. The hotel's green inner courtyard provides an additional tranquil retreat in the heart of the city. 

Flexible meeting and event facilities for up to 500 guests make the hotel an ideal venue for conferences, meetings and special occasions. Thanks to nearby tram and underground connections, Vienna’s city centre and many of its most popular attractions are easily accessible. 

Whether you're visiting for business or leisure, DoubleTree by Hilton Vienna Schönbrunn combines modern comfort, a peaceful atmosphere and an excellent location for a memorable stay in Vienna.

151286.description: Situated opposite Saint-Germain-des-Prés Church, the hotel is located in the heart of Paris' Latin Quarter. The hotel's location makes it easy to access the principal tourist sights of Paris, including the Louvre, Orsay museums and Notre Dame Cathedral, all of which are around 1. 1 km away. Luxembourg Garden is some 15 minutes' walk from the hotel, and shopping on the Rue de Rennes is just around 1 minute away. This city hotel offers modern accommodation units and an elegantly decorated bar. It is located in a building which dates back to 1925 and was fully renovated in 2011. It is decorated in a contemporary style and offers a total of 50 rooms across 8 floors. There is wireless Internet access available. In the evenings, guests can relax with a drink at the stylish bar. Other facilities at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby, 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, lift access to the upper floors, a TV lounge and a breakfast room. The rooms offer an en suite bathroom with a shower, bath and hairdryer, double or king-size beds, a TV, hifi, Internet access, a safe and a minibar. Tea and coffee making facilities and an ironing set are also provided. The rooms have individually regulated air conditioning and heating. Every morning a continental breakfast is served in the authentic breakfast lounge.

151287.description: A stay at Hôtel Bourgogne & Montana places you in the heart of Paris, within a 10-minute walk of Champs-Élysées and Place de la Concorde. This 4-star hotel is 1 mi (1. 7 km) from Louvre Museum and 1. 6 mi (2. 6 km) from Eiffel Tower. Relax and unwind with massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Make yourself at home in one of the 31 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and a meeting room. A shuttle from the airport to the hotel is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Orsay Museum - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Tuileries Garden - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Orangerie Museum - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Rodin Museum - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- Les Invalides - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Champs-Élysées - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Rue de Rivoli - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Place de la Concorde - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Grand Palais - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi- Rue Cler - 1. 2 km/0. 7 mi- Grands Boulevards - 1. 2 km/0. 7 mi- Place de la Madeleine - 1. 2 km/0. 8 mi- Place Vendôme - 1. 4 km/0. 9 mi- Quai Branly Museum - 1. 4 km/0. 9 mi. The nearest airports are: Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) - 35. 2 km/21. 9 mi Paris Orly Airport (ORY) - 16. 4 km/10.

151292.description: Located in the heart of Berlin, the Art Deco Park Plaza Berlin hotel is just a short walk from Kurfürstendamm and a quick drive from the Berlin Zoo. This family-friendly hotel offers 152 guestrooms with refrigerators, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a fitness center, and a sauna. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies), grab a satisfying meal at the on-site restaurant, and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. For business travelers, a business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services are available. The hotel also features a conference center and meeting room for events.

name.content: art'otel berlin mitte powered by Radisson Hotels

151293.description: Reflecting our hip location in the heart of Berlin's Mitte district, the newly renovated art'otel berlin mitte is a stone's throw from the city's most notorious landmarks, including Alexanderplatz with its TV Tower and red town hall, Gendarmenmarkt, Friedrichstrasse and the lively Hackescher Markt. Take a stroll and you'll discover historic icons such as the Brandenburg Gate and the city's old town with its St. Nicholas quarter, before exploring famous museums on the Museumsinsel. Or if you prefer to get close to nature, the Tiergarten is the city's largest public park and can be reached in a matter of minutes using the subway outside the hotel.   art'otel berlin mitte is themed around a dedicated art exhibition comprising over 300 of artist Georg Baselitz's original works, from large and vibrant paintings to very petite and demure charcoal prints. Our 109 beautiful Art Rooms and Art Suites are contemporary and stylish. Each room has a piece of unique Baselitz art, as well as air-conditioning, satellite TV, indulgent Elemis guest amenities and, in some cases, a private balcony. There's also complimentary wi-fi throughout the hotel.   Tasty light bites and bar nibbles inspired by ingredients and flavours from across the Mediterranean is on offer in our Upside Down bar & restaurant in the Rococo Ermelerhaus. The courtyard connects the old Ermelerhaus with new part of the hotel and the ambience is one of relaxation and enjoyment. And if you're curious, why not ask a member of our team to reveal what lies behind Baselitz's inspirational art during a personal guided art tour?

151296.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center, a terrace, and a garden. Hotel Vilamari also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a TV in the common area. Dine at L'Actual, the hotel's restaurant, or grab a quick bite at the snack bar/deli. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (7:00 AM to 11:00 AM) for a fee. For business travelers, a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk are available. Planning an event? The hotel offers 549 square feet (51 square meters) of conference and meeting space. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The 90 air-conditioned guest rooms feature minibars and Smart TVs with digital programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, desks, and electric kettles. The hotel is conveniently located near Avenida del Paralelo, Arenas de Barcelona, and Plaça d'Espanya, with easy access to Fira de Barcelona Montjuïc and other attractions. Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) is the preferred airport.

151329.description:
This hotel enjoys a convenient location, 1 km away from the Hammersmith HMV Apollo, Shepherd's Bush theatres, the Westfield shopping centre and Kensington Olympia. The famous Kensington High Street is within walking distance (2 km).

This city hotel features contemporary-style interiors and offers its guests a range of convenient facilities and services. It comprises a total of 16 rooms, including 3 singles. There is a 24-hour reception, Internet access and an elegant breakfast room.

All rooms come with a shower and are equipped with a TV, Internet access, tea and coffee making facilities, an ironing set and central heating.

In the morning, guests can enjoy a hearty continental breakfast in the elegant breakfast room.

151330.description: This hotel is situated on Shepherd's Bush Road and has 5 main London underground stations within 5-15 minutes' walk. It lies just a 5-minute walk from Westfield, Europe's biggest shopping centre. Big London attractions and venues are all only minutes away and easily accessible, including the West End, Piccadilly Circus, Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park, Hammersmith Apollo Theatre, Olympia Grand Hall, BBC Television Centre and many more. It is a 10-minute walk to the Olympia Exhibition Centre and 20 minutes' walk from the Earl's Court Exhibition Centre. This city hotel is a pleasant and relaxed property and offers its guests a great experience, making them feel at home from the moment they arrive. The friendly team is on hand 24 hours a day, and is available to assist guests with any queries. The hotel comprises a total of 33 rooms, including 3 singles. Facilities on offer to guests include a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe and a laundry service. All rooms come with a shower and a hairdryer and are equipped with Internet access, a safe, a fridge and tea and coffee making facilities. Furthermore, an ironing set and central heating units are provided in all accommodation units as standard.

151347.address: Taffara Circuit Palmeraie Vers Douar Abiad
151347.description: The hotel is situated in the palm grove of Marrakech, in an oasis of calm and serenity. It is just 5 minutes from the commercial centre, and is surrounded by historical monuments, as well as being just 6 minutes from the famous Jemaa El Fna square and the souks. The district of Guéliz is about 3 km away, Bab Atlas is about 2. 5 km away and the metro is around 2. 7 km away. The hotel is roughly 15 minutes from the airport. Seeking perfection in the design of this establishment, the owners have made it into an absolute haven of tranquillity and charm. Guests who enter this peaceful retreat will find that every inch of this sumptuous villa radiates a perfect quality of Feng shui balance. The air-conditioned hotel is tucked away at the heart of the palm grove, within extensive gardens that guests can enjoy walking around. It also offers a style that combines eastern charm and European design know-how. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as a hotel safe. A TV lounge, bar and restaurant also feature, and business guests can make use of the hotel's conference facilities. A laundry service and 24-hour room service are available, and guests with their own transport can use the car park or garage. All rooms are luxurious and offer a private terrace or balcony, elegantly furnished in a traditional Moroccan style. The rooms are en suite and feature a shower and bath, as well as a double bed, satellite/cable TV and Internet access. Each room also comes equipped with a hairdryer, safe and minibar as standard. Additional features include air conditioning.

151349.description: Situated at the heart of the Medina in Marrakech, the riad enjoys a privileged location that makes discovering the city easy and fun. Only 10 minutes on foot separate the hotel from some of the most renowned sites in Marrakech, such as the grand square Jamaa el Fna, which is just 200 m away. The riad is an oasis of peacefulness and comfort which guests will really enjoy after the bustle of life in the heart of the city. The riad has a central patio and 9 en suite bedrooms. The bedrooms are decorated in cool and crisp neutral colours with a splash of colour in each, traditional alcoves and tadelakt en suite bathrooms. The rooms come with mint tea, fresh fruit and Moroccan pastries on arrival. The riad serves Moroccan and international dishes. Guests are served breakfast and water in the room on arrival. Guests can follow Rue Fatima Zohra until they reach the Dar Marjana restaurant. Then turn into the first alleyway on the left and look out for Derb El Halfaoui on the right.

name.content: Ambasciatori Hotel Venice Mestre, Tapestry Collec

151353.description: By entering a child, child's breakfast and dinner are not included in this rate, they will be charged by the hotel at check-in time. We’re in Mestre, on the mainland and only a few minutes from Venice Mestre train station. Trains will take you to the historic center of Venice in under 15 minutes. Parco San Giuliano is four kilometers away and offers views of the city. Enjoy our fitness center, restaurant, and bar. Meeting space is also available.

151393.description: A modern, comfortable accommodation at only 5 minutes from the international airport and a 10-minute drive from the city centre, offering an ideal base for any stopover, business trip or a short weekend stay. Cancun has plenty of activities to offer as well as a vibrant nightlife with a wide range of bars and nightclubs. The beautiful guest rooms present an elegant, bright decoration and invites guests to relax after a long day out. Facilities such as air-conditioning, Wi-Fi access and a flat-screen TV will enhance guests' vacation and ensure a fully comfortable stay. Travellers may wake up to a delicious continental breakfast and taste some local specialities for lunch and for dinner. The hotel offers 2 hot tubs, which are located on the terrace next to the chill out bar, where visitors can enjoy some relaxing moments while sipping a delicious cocktail.

151445.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an indoor pool, a spa tub, and a steam room. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Pimento, a restaurant which specializes in Italian cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Bogotá? This hotel has 7933 square feet (737 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 8 meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 239 guestrooms featuring minibars. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Wireless internet access (surcharge) is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Avenida El Dorado - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Salitre Plaza Shopping Mall - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Gran Estacion Shopping Mall - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Bogotá Botanical Garden - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Centro Comercial Galerias, Bogota - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Simon Bolivar Park - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Cundinamarca Government Building - 2. 7 km / 1. 7 mi- Multiplaza - 2. 7 km / 1. 7 mi- Attorney General's Building - 2. 8 km / 1. 7 mi- Salitre Mágico - 2. 8 km / 1. 8 mi- Iglesia Centro Mundial de Avivamiento - 2. 9 km / 1. 8 mi- National University of Colombia - 3. 2 km / 2 mi- Connecta 26 - 3. 3 km / 2. 1 mi- Nuestro Bogotá Shopping Center - 3. 3 km / 2. 1 mi- Hayuelos Shopping Center - 3. 4 km / 2. 1 mi.

151446.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a 24-hour health club, an indoor pool, and a spa tub. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy international cuisine at The Market, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Bogotá? This hotel has 5823 square feet (541 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 8 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.

151450.description: We are located in one of the safest centric zones of Buenos Aires, one block away from the famous Corrientes and Callao Avenues, at three blocks from the National Congress and steps away from theaters, restaurants and cultural / entertainment complexes. Less than ten blocks away are the Obelisco, 9 de Julio Ave. , Recoleta and the Abasto Shopping Center (the largest in the Capital framed in a typical tango neighborhood) along with the 'Children's Museum', the only one of its kind in Latin America. Additionally, we are one block away from a Metro Station for easy and cheap access to almost all important points of the City.

151504.description: This apartment complex is situated in the luxurious district of Charlottenburg. The complex lies just 200 metres away from the Gedachtniskirche and the Berlin Zoological Garden. The train station of Zoologischer Garten is just a short distance away. The complex lies close to the Ku'damm, perfect for those who like to indulge in a spot of retail therapy. A range of restaurants and entertainment venues can be found nearby. The apartments are situated in two modern buildings located 600m away from each other. The units are tastefully designed, offering modern furnishings and up-to-date conveniences. This complex offers many facilities and services to meet guests' expectations.

151506.description: Is located in the heart of Catalunya, in a tranquil spot in the region of Anoia. The nearest city Igualada is about 11 km from the hotel and the Monastery of Montserrat is just 14 km away. This old country mansion dating from the 14th century has been renovated giving each one of the rooms an individual touch. It offers a range of services such as a restaurant and also wired internet is available in the hotel.

151516.description: Clients will find the airport within 11800 km. Everyone staying at this accommodation will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Up Suites Barcelona as it counts with a total of 11 rooms. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. Up Suites Barcelona does not operate a 24-hour reception. Up Suites Barcelona may charge a fee for some services.

151577.description: Pamper yourself with on-site massages or enjoy recreational amenities such as bicycle rentals. This Art Deco hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Stop by Le Vernet, a bar/lounge specializing in French cuisine, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Paris? This hotel offers 377 square feet (35 square meters) of space, consisting of a conference area and four meeting rooms. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a train station pick-up service. Make yourself at home in one of the 50 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and espresso makers. Flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Bathrooms include designer toiletries and bidets. Conveniences such as safes and desks are provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. The hotel is located near the Champs-Élysées, Avenue Georges V, and Place Charles de Gaulle. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

151634.description: The hotel is located near Tower Bridge and the Tower of London and offers modern and spacious bedrooms. The hotel, in London's historic core, is close to a number of popular local attractions including the Tower of London, Borough Market, St. Katherine's Dock and the HMS Belfast. The hotel also offers a number of transport options, with Tower Hill Tube Station close by and both Fenchurch Street rail and Tower Gateway DLR stations a short distance away. Each spacious luxurious room offers cosy bathrobes, a private bathroom that includes luxury toiletries. The restaurant serves a range of grill and authentic tapas dishes. A range of cocktails and wines is offered in the sophisticated lounge bar. The swimming pool and a gym feature in the hotel's leisure facilities. There is a business centre on site, and there are well-equipped event suites for guests to use.

151703.description: Centrally located in Athens, the luxurious New Hotel is just a 2-minute drive from Syntagma Square and 7 minutes from the Acropolis. This Beaux Arts hotel offers 79 individually decorated guestrooms, each featuring iPod docking stations, minibars, and plasma televisions with digital programming. Enjoy premium bedding and private bathrooms with rainfall showers and designer toiletries. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. Indulge in the on-site spa with massages, body treatments, and facials, or take advantage of the steam room, fitness center, and bicycle rentals. Savor Mediterranean cuisine at the New Taste restaurant, or enjoy a meal at the coffee shop/cafe. 24-hour room service is also available. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are offered daily for a fee. For business travelers, the hotel provides complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.

151739.description: Located in the heart of Buenos Aires' vibrant Las Cañitas district, this hotel offers easy access to the city's finest dining, design, and fashion. Explore nearby attractions such as the Latin American Art Museum, Rosedal, and the Palermo racecourse and forests. The hotel boasts a unique blend of modern and antique design, featuring a cozy fireplace, a tranquil garden with a timber deck, and a relaxing hot tub. Modern amenities include a 24-hour reception, lobby bar with snacks, TV lounge, café, and Wi-Fi. Each of the 10 rooms features an en suite bathroom, individually controlled air conditioning and heating, satellite TV, and internet access. Please note that room access is via stairs. Major credit cards are accepted.

151749.description: This fun, modern and sophisticated hotel is located in Bogotá, one of the most dynamic cities in Latin America, offering the best location and exclusive suites, ideal for both, business and leisure travelers. Facilities include a 24-hour reception, lift access, a hairdressing salon and a children's playground. Guests can enjoy a drink in the bar and a meal in the on-site restaurant. The hotel also features conference facilities, wireless Internet access, room and laundry services and a car park.

151750.description: This luxurious beachfront hotel in Alanya offers an unforgettable sun-and-sand holiday experience. Guests seeking relaxation will appreciate the prime location and nearby dining options. Gazipasa Alanya Airport is a convenient 40-minute drive away. The comfortable rooms feature soothing decor, luxurious bedding, and unique furnishings, along with amenities such as LCD TVs, safes, hair dryers, air conditioning, and private balconies—perfect for enjoying a refreshing cocktail. The hotel offers a variety of sports activities, a Turkish bath, steam rooms, and a mini club designed specifically for younger guests. Please note: the hotel does not accept bookings for men only.

151751.description: This hotel is located in Konakli, 12 km from Alanya. The hotel is 250 m from the beach and has a unique style mixing modern facilities with a French/Ottoman design, thus creating an attractive ambiance. The building consists of one main building and villa-style outbuildings, a garden and large pool with sun terrace. A section of the local beach is privately used by the hotel. There is a range of shops, restaurants and bars only 1 km from the hotel. Local attractions include Alanya Castle and the Damlatas Caves.

name.content: Hotel Riu Tikida Garden Adults Only- All Inclusive

151783.description: The Hotel Riu Tikida Garden, exclusively for adults, is your ideal choice to enjoy an all-inclusive holiday in Marrakech. You have the best services at its facilities to make your stay a unique experience: outdoor swimming pools, comfortable rooms, conference rooms, entertainment programmes and an exceptional culinary offering. The pool area of this adults-only hotel in Marrakech will become your perfect place to loosen up and relax in the warm Moroccan climate. Make the most of the loungers to sunbathe and enjoy a moment of relaxation with your favourite drink. And if you want to have breakfast or a snack by the pool, at the Riu Tikida Garden there is a restaurant with an ideal buffet for your pool days. The Hotel Riu Tikida Garden's culinary offering doesn't end here. Breakfast and dinner buffets with live cooking stations await you at the main restaurant, and at the Culinarium restaurant you are offered a varied menu with the best dishes prepared by our chefs for you to enjoy a special dinner. And the bars at this all-inclusive adults-only hotel in Marrakech feature delicious beverages and aperitifs. Hotel Riu Tikida Garden hosts various entertainment options for you to enjoy during your holiday. You can do sports such as tennis, volleyball or badminton, plus many more, and enjoy the activity programmes run by the entertainment team, as well as live shows and music. If you are looking to unwind, we offer you the Tikida Spa wellness centre, for you to loosen up with your favourite treatment.

151837.description: The City Residence is a convenient 5-minute drive from Madrid Barajas Airport and 3 km from the IFEMA Convention Centre, with Barajas metro station an easy 8-minute walk away. This four-story hotel offers 38 air-conditioned rooms, all accessible by lift. Each tastefully decorated room features amenities such as a direct-dial telephone, TV, and wired internet access. All rooms also include a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Conference facilities are available for business guests (for an additional fee), and Wi-Fi service is provided in the lobby.

151840.description: Located right in the beating heart of the German capital, the hotel Berlin Alexanderplatz has 61 rooms and an open public area with a breakfast room, business area and a 24-hour mini-market with snacks and groceries. The hotel offers a cost-effective, efficient yet environmentally friendly travel experience.

151853.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Ascot Hotel Buyukada, centrally located in Adalar, a short walk from Dock Square and Dilburnu Recreation Area. Take advantage of the seasonal outdoor pool, bicycle rentals, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a complimentary full breakfast, and enjoy meals at the restaurant or snacks in the café. Unwind at the bar/lounge or poolside bar, and mingle with other guests at the daily complimentary reception. The hotel also provides 24-hour room service and a 24-hour front desk. Each of the 22 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, flat-screen TV with cable, and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Additional amenities include a safe and daily housekeeping. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge.

name.content: Dock House Boutique Hotel and Spa by Newmark

151918.description: This unique and opulent gem in Cape Town's glamorous, world-renowned Victoria & Alfred Waterfront is the perfect choice for discerning travelers seeking exceptional luxury, personalized attention, and excellent service. Its prime location offers sweeping views of the Atlantic Ocean and Table Mountain, with easy access to the vibrant harbor area, shopping malls, and excellent restaurants. The Two Oceans Aquarium is also within walking distance. Accommodation ranges from suites with private gardens to chic rooms, each individually decorated with a unique Victorian elegance that blends seamlessly with modern conveniences. Guests can experience sophisticated fine dining at the onsite restaurant, take a refreshing dip in the swimming pool, or enjoy a moment of relaxation in the state-of-the-art spa.

151936.description: Located in the heart of Nanterre, west of Paris and just a 5-minute walk from Place de la Boule where guests will find numerous bus stops and connections to the rest of the country and the capital. The business district of La Defense is a 10-minute drive away and Rueil 2000 can be reached for half the time. The aparthotel offers warm and cosy fully equipped and furnished studios, 1-bedroom apartments and a wide range of hotel services. All of the apartments can use the complimentary Wi-Fi and a spacious work area that is ideal for working remotely while on the road. They also a feature a complete kitchen with fridge and a TV in the living area. Each morning guests can start their day with the hearty continental breakfast buffet.
