151938.description: Safir Hotel Doha is centrally located in Najma, just 11 km away from Hamad International Airport. It features a rooftop snack bar and wellness facilities. This deluxe hotel offers well-appointed modern guest rooms and suites. They come with flat screen TV and air conditioning. Flavours Restaurant features international cuisine. Lounge Café has an informal atmosphere and a light snack menu throughout the day. A fully equipped fitness centre, outdoor pool and children's pool are available to guests. For relaxation there is a sauna , and a steam room. Safir Hotel Doha is located close to the city's business and banking district, tourist attractions and museums.

name.content: Park Hyatt Jeddah - Marina, Club and Spa

151939.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as outdoor tennis courts, a health club, and an outdoor pool. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the complimentary area shuttle. Grab a bite at Nafoura, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Jeddah? This hotel has 8138 square feet (756 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 5 meeting rooms.

151943.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a fitness center and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy Regional cuisine at FACIL, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a train station pick-up service.

151947.description: The Han Hotel, conveniently located just five minutes from Atatürk International Airport, offers international standards blended with Turkish hospitality at affordable prices. Enjoy 24/7 security and electronic card access for peace of mind. Your stay in Istanbul will be enhanced by the hotel's commitment to providing a clean, comfortable environment, allowing you to fully experience this magnificent city, as French poet Lamartine so eloquently described.

151948.description: This charming city hotel is ideally located in Beyazit, in the historical district of Istanbul. The hotel is located just a few minutes' walking distance away from the captivating attractions the city has to offer, including the exciting Grand Bazaar, Topkapi Palace and the intriguing Blue Mosque. The hotel is just a short walking distance away from an abundance of restaurants, shops, bars and entertainment venues, making this the ideal choice for travellers who are eager to explore the sights and sounds the city has to offer. The hotel enjoys an attractive, modern architectural design, tempting guests with the promise of warm hospitality and luxurious surroundings. The guest rooms are superbly designed, and feature comfortable furnishings and modern amenities. Numerous facilities and services are available, catering to guests' needs to the highest degree of excellence.

151949.address: Kucuk Ayasofya Mah. Katip Sinan Sokak, 38
151949.description: Ideally located in Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, this boutique hotel offers a perfect base for exploring major attractions on foot. A myriad of local bars, shops, and restaurants are within easy reach. The Sea of Marmara is a short 7-minute walk away, while the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Grand Bazaar are all less than a kilometer from the property. Topkapi Palace is only slightly further. Public transport links are a mere 2-minute walk away, providing easy access to the vibrant nightlife of Istiklal Street (20 minutes) and Taksim Square in the city center (25 minutes). This sophisticated hotel offers a wide variety of sumptuously designed rooms, some with fabulous sea views. Guests can enjoy a delectable breakfast to start their day, and the rooftop terrace offers panoramic city views.

151950.address: Merkez Mah. Ibrahim Bilgen Cad. Tosmur
151950.description: This delightful aparthotel is located in the Tosmur area of Alanya, which is just 5 km along the coast from the heart of the resort. Guests will find a host of restaurants, shops and entertainment venues in the centre of the town, yet are ideally situated to enjoy a relaxing, peaceful break. The hotel places the area's attractions, including Alanya Castle and the Damlatas Caves, within easy reach. Set amidst attractive gardens, the hotel enjoys an air of peace and serenity, seemingly miles away from the bustle of daily life. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated and provide relaxing surroundings in which to lie back, unwind and enjoy restful slumber at the end of the day. Guests will be impressed by the hotel's wide selection of excellent facilities, which have been designed with comfort and enjoyment in mind. Wi-fi in the lobby is free of charge but wi-fi in the room is extra charge.

152079.description: The hotel is located on the Rue De Buci at the heart of the Latin Quarter in Saint Germain des Prés. The hotel is within easy walking distance of famous landmarks, art galleries and antique shops. The Louvre is about a 15-minute walk away and the Eiffel Tower is some 1. 5 km away. Guests are welcomed in the lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, and currency exchange and lift access. Guests can enjoy a drink in the bar and the hotel also offers Wi-Fi, room service and a laundry service.

152080.description: Inspired by the 18th century, the hotel reflects the lifestyle of the Age of Enlightenment. It boasts a subtle, neat and sophisticated décor and is a real voyage through history. This intimate hotel has been created in the style of a boudoir. The 24 rooms and suites, designed in the boudoir style, are a real treat for the eyes, with stunning fabrics, patterns and colours. They are the pure embodiment of Parisian charm, and will make you feel thoroughly pampered. Containing antique wooden furniture, the Buci rooms offer the perfect chance to get away from it all. Rooms are also equipped with cable TV, a minibar and free Wi-fi. The hotel also has an equally refined dining room for buffet breakfasts, as well as reading rooms for relaxing or enjoying a drink. These rooms are the ideal place to enjoy a peaceful moment in our hotel.

152081.description: Enjoy this Paris hotel's fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. Room service is available during limited hours, and buffet breakfast is offered daily (fee applies). The hotel also provides a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Each of the 36 individually decorated guest rooms features an espresso maker, a flat-screen TV with cable programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include showers, hair dryers, and toiletries. A desk, coffee/tea maker, and daily housekeeping are also provided. Hôtel Tilde is located in Paris's 19th Arrondissement, a short drive from Canal Saint-Martin and Stade de France. It's also convenient to Palais Garnier and Notre-Dame.

name.content: Comfort Zone Parkside Apartment Hotel Birmingham

152119.description: These centrally located apartments are just 350 meters along the canals from the International Convention Centre (ICC), the National Indoor Arena (NIA), and Broad Street. Birmingham New Street train station and the Bullring shopping and leisure complex are a short 10-minute walk away. Enjoy the extra space and comfort of these modern city-center apartments. Whether for business or leisure, these apartments offer an excellent alternative to a traditional hotel and are an ideal choice for short or long stays.

152134.description: This hotel is located in the centre of Madrid, near Plaza Mayor and the emblematic Puerta de Sol, in the most attractive cultural and shopping area of the city. The hotel is within walking distance of the main museums, (El Prado, Reina Sofía, Thyssen Bornemisza), theatres, bars and the best shopping district of the capital. Its proximity to Puerta de Atocha railway station also makes it the perfect hotel for business sojourns or meetings. The hotel has a gym, hot tub, free Wi-Fi, a café and snack bar and a restaurant for meetings and events. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a pet deposit.

152135.description: Situated in central Madrid, this hotel is near Paseo del Prado, Atocha Railway Station, and the city's main museums and attractions. The hotel boasts a neoclassical style and is conveniently located near a variety of restaurants, bars, and entertainment options. Puerta del Sol and Plaza Mayor are within 850 meters. Small pets (one dog or cat under 20kg) are welcome upon request for a small nightly fee and deposit. Spa: Minors under 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Access to the spa is not allowed for children under 16. Price: €15. Advance reservation is required.

152199.description:
This majestic hotel is situated in landscaped grounds at Negombo, close to Bandaranaike International Airport at Katunayake.

This airport hotel features 20 luxurious, air-conditioned rooms with views over the swimming pool and beautiful garden. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services. Additional facilities at this air-conditioned establishment include a hotel safe, cloakroom, games room, bicycle hire, TV lounge and restaurant. It also has a luxurious banquet hall, with capacity for up to 700 persons, making it the biggest banquet hall in the city. A children's entertainment programme is provided for younger guests. 24-hour room service and a laundry service are also available, while those arriving by car may leave their vehicle in the hotel car park.

All rooms are en suite with a shower, bath, hot and cold water and other bathroom amenities. Facilities include a double bed, direct dial telephone, cable TV with international and local channels, wireless Internet access, an ironing set and a safe. A minibar, fridge, cooker, microwave and tea and coffee making facilities are also provided. A balcony or terrace features as standard.

The hotel offers badminton, table tennis and pool/snooker facilities.

A continental breakfast and breakfast buffet are served each morning. Lunch and dinner may be enjoyed from a buffet, à la carte or as a set menu.

152256.description: This delightful boutique hotel enjoys a prime setting in the district of Beyazit. The hotel is a mere 400 metres away from the captivating attractions of Sultanahmet, including the Topkapi Palace, the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia. Exciting shopping opportunities can also be enjoyed at the renowned Grand Bazaar. The Kumkapi area, on the waterfront of the Marmara Sea, lies within easy access of the hotel. Guests can explore the area and its popular fish restaurants, as well as its lively bars. This charming hotel occupies an old city mansion house which has been restored to capture its former glory, while also embracing modern style. The guest rooms offer soothing, relaxing surroundings in which to completely unwind. Guests can immerse themselves in culture in the restaurant, and enjoy the Turkish culinary delights which are served.

152271.description: Situated in Venice's most antique district, the site of St. Gregory Abbey, the Centurion Hotel is a majestic luxury Palace ideally positioned for visiting the world-famous attractions of Salute Church and the Peggy Guggenheim Collection. Fitting harmoniously into its surroundings the hotel sits proudly on the Grand Canal, overlooking St. Mark's Basin and the many unmissable attractions Venice is renowned for. It features 50 rooms, including 12 Junior Suites and 4 Suites, all decorated in a contemporary style, enriched with a refined Venetian touch, each one boasting its own originality.

152272.description: Located in the heart of Milan, just 270 meters from the Duomo Cathedral, The Gray offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a terrace, and a bar. Overlooking the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II shopping arcade, this boutique hotel features rooms with modern design, accented by African fabrics and décor. Select rooms include private gyms or Turkish baths. The La Scala Theatre and the Fashion District are within a 3-minute and 700-meter walk, respectively. A city tax of €7. 00 per person, per day applies, excluding children under 18.

152329.description: This hotel is in the pink quarter, one of the main tourist centres in Bogotá, surrounded by the best shopping centres, Andean Centre, The Retirement and Atlantis Plaza, very close to a modern financial area, the best entertainment venues, and the most exquisite restaurants. Facilities include a lobby area with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, cloakroom and lift access, a TV lounge, restaurant, Wi-Fi and a cellar for storing bicycles. The hotel features a garage, bar, pond and room and laundry services.

152332.description: This superb boutique hotel offers guests the ideal setting in Istanbul from which to explore the delights the city has to offer. The hotel is located in the Sultanahmet district of this mesmerising city, placing attractions such as the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, the Grand Bazaar and Hagia Sophia, within easy reach. Nearby local transport links offer ease of access to other areas of the city, while an abundance of restaurants, bars and shops lie just a short stroll away. This comfortable, hidden treasure offers 17 tastefully-decorated guest rooms, which come well equipped with modern amenities for visitors' convenience. The rooms feature wooden floors and relaxing tones for a haven of peace and serenity. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast in the mornings, which is sure to set them up for the day.

152350.description: The team at ibis Birmingham Centre New Street Station prides itself on always going above and beyond from the speediest check-in systems in the city, free WiFi and healthy hot buffet breakfast to a guaranteed warm welcome around the clock. As an added bonus, our trendy, laidback bar and restaurant offers relaxing spots for enjoying drinks and dinner. Throw in on-site private parking plus excellent modern business facilities and it is easy to see why we remain a top pick for regular visitors to Birmingham.

152416.description: This chic hotel is ideally nestled on the vibrant Mouille Point promenade, Cape Town's own platinum mile, within a few minutes from gorgeous beaches as well as the myriad of bars and shopping venues. This elegant property allows easy reach of museums, a popular aquarium and golf courses. This iconic hotel offers luxurious rooms and suites with majestic views of either the Atlantic Ocean or verdant landscapes. The units welcome guests in spacious and sun-lit surroundings, offering a haven of peace and tranquillity. For dining and wining guests may choose from two restaurants offering delicious mouth-watering dining and cocktail experience, one of them overlooking Table Mountain and the other with views over the Table Mountain and the V&A Waterfront and the bar with Mouille Point Lighthouse and Atlantic Ocean in the background. After a long day guests may indulge in an impressive spa offering a complete escape for senses.

152441.address: Avenida Alvarez Calderon 194, Esq. Miguel Dasso
152441.description: The hotel is located in the heart of San Isidro, in a secure residential area, close to exclusive boutiques and all kinds of stores. Within walking distance, you will find famous restaurants, outdoor cafes, art exhibits, theatres, cinemas, spas, gyms, supermarkets, banks and other places of interest. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe and lift, a TV lounge, café, bar and restaurant, Wi-Fi, business centre with meeting rooms and conference facilities, underground parking, room service and a laundry service. This is a 100% non-smoking hotel.

name.content: La Clef Tour Eiffel Paris by The Crest Collection

152486.description:
Discover the timeless luxury of La Clef Tour Eiffel Paris by The Crest Collection, a 5-star residence in the prestigious 16th arrondissement, housed in a 19th-century building designed by Ricardo Bofill. Just steps from the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe, it elegantly blends history and modernity. 
Each room and apartment is a cocoon of refinement, inspired by the 1889 Universal Exhibition and crafted with noble materials for exceptional comfort. 
Enjoy high-end services, including gymnasium, equipped with the latest technology and available 7 days a week, hammam, meeting room, breakfast room, and sophisticated bar. Experience French excellence at La Clef Tour Eiffel Paris by The Crest Collection for an unforgettable Parisian getaway.

152493.description: The hotel is ideally situated at the heart of the gigantic Medina of Marrakech, in the Bab Doukkala neighbourhood. This charming design establishment was completely restored in 2010 in accordance with an authentic Moroccan style, and offers a warm and traditional setting. Guests are welcomed in a lobby by a friendly staff, which is ready to assist with service and information. The hotel consists of a ground floor, including a common living room with a salon, TV and Internet access. It comprises a total of 5 rooms, each equipped with all modern comforts and decorated with taste and refinement in a contemporary style with an oriental touch.

152495.address: Gran Vía de les Corts Catalanes, 327
152495.description: This modern and comfortable hotel is located on bustling Gran Via Avenue, close to Plaza España and the FIRA de Barcelona Congress Centre. Conveniently situated near various public transport links, the hotel is just a two-minute walk from the tourist bus line, Aerobus, and a subway station. Attractions such as the Magic Fountain of Montjuic and Palau Sant Jordi are also nearby. This stylish establishment offers a range of spacious rooms ideal for families, groups of friends, and business travelers seeking comfort and a prime location. Accommodation options range from double to quadruple rooms, all fully equipped for a comfortable stay. Guests will appreciate the extensive onsite facilities and services, including high-speed Wi-Fi and private parking. Please note: Special conditions and supplements may apply when booking more than five rooms. A €150 damage deposit is required upon check-in for apartments and family rooms.

152603.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy seafood at Views Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge and an ocean view. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. A complimentary English breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a computer station, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 26 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and Smart televisions.

152615.description: This wonderful complex is located next to Istanbul's modern business districts of Levent and Maslak. Lying a mere 3 km from the bars and vibrant nightlife of Taksim Square, this delightful complex offers guests the perfect setting in Istanbul. Guests will find themselves within easy access of convenient transport links to other parts of the city, while restaurants and shops lie a few minutes' walking distance away from the complex. This extensive complex features superbly-appointed accommodation options, shops, restaurants and a large international supermarket, and is the perfect choice for business and leisure travellers alike. The complex provides a wide array of unparalleled facilities and services, catering to guests' business, leisure, dining and entertainment needs to the highest degree of excellence.

name.content: The Westin Lima Hotel & Convention Center

152622.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an indoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. The shuttle (surcharge) will take you to the nearby beach or shopping center. Enjoy international cuisine at Market 770, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Lima? This hotel has 27222 square feet (2529 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms.

152624.description: Enjoy the best of Rio de Janeiro at Hilton Copacabana. Our hotel offers the largest number of ocean view rooms in the city, two outdoor swimming pools overlooking Copacabana Beach, beach service, Anna Pegova Spa, 24-hour Fitness Center, restaurant and two bars. Relax and enjoy sunset and a 360° view from our rooftop Isabel Lounge with while having a drink. The rooms are spacious and comfortable. The Family Suite can accommodate up to 02 adults and 02 children up to 12 years old. For both leisure and corporate guests, we are conveniently located near to most of Rio attractions, close to downtown and airports. Our meeting space offers 36 flexible rooms, perfect for small meetings to large conferences and social events.

name.content: Fairfield Inn & Suites Ny Manhattan/ Chelsea

152637.description: Stay at the Fairfield Inn & Suites by Marriott New York Manhattan/Chelsea and enjoy a central New York location, just a 10-minute walk from 5th Avenue and Madison Square Garden. This hotel offers complimentary continental breakfast, Wi-Fi, and a 24-hour fitness center. Other amenities include a business center, gift shop, and snack bar. The 110 guest rooms feature pillowtop beds, cable TV, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Nearby attractions include the Empire State Building and Broadway.

152670.description: 'Hotel Mary in Mestre's Campalto district offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. Guests can enjoy cooked-to-order breakfasts (fee applies), dine at the onsite restaurant, and relax at the bar/lounge. The hotel provides a 24-hour front desk, express check-in/out, airport shuttle (surcharge), and free self-parking. The 28 guestrooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs with digital programming, private bathrooms with bidets, safes, and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. Hotel Mary is conveniently located within a 10-minute drive of Piazzale Roma and the Grand Canal, and is a short drive from Marco Polo Airport (VCE). '

152725.address: Marina Residential, Dock Road, V&A Waterfront
152725.description: These upmarket apartments offer guests luxurious, modern spaces to relax and recharge. Each apartment features a spacious living area, perfect for entertaining or unwinding after a busy day exploring the city. The property offers 28 apartments and 2 penthouses, with amenities including reception and check-out services, lift access, laundry service, car park, and garage. Each apartment includes an en suite bathroom with a shower, bathtub, and hairdryer, along with a double or king-size bed and a fully equipped kitchen. Guests can also enjoy a private balcony or terrace, satellite TV, internet access, a safe, ironing set, air conditioning, and central heating.

152921.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include shopping on site and complimentary use of a nearby fitness facility. Stop by the hotel's bar/lounge, Henderson Bar and Kitchen, for dinner or brunch, or grab snacks at the coffee shop/cafe. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Make yourself at home in one of the 51 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

152930.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a steam room and a seasonal outdoor pool. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Local cuisine breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.

152933.description: Boasting a prestigious location in the centre of Brussels, this hotel enjoys close proximity to everything that this mesmerising city has to offer. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the European Council and Parliament, Grand Place and the many museums dotted throughout the city. Excellent shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities are also located nearby. This exclusive hotel tempts visitors with the promise of luxury and style. The stunningly-designed guest rooms offer unrivalled luxury and elegance. First-class facilities, impeccable service and meticulous attention to detail make this hotel the ideal option for discerning travellers.

153000.address: Blvd. Miguel de la Madrid Km 8.5
153000.description: The property is located in the hotel district, just 10 minutes from the centre of Manzanillo. The hotel is situated on the wide, sandy beach and close to the commercial area, which features excellent Mexican and international restaurants, lively bars, popular nightclubs and wide selection of shops, all within easy reach. The bus station is located approximately 25 minutes away and Lake Cuyutlán roughly 30 minutes away, each by public transport. The Turtle Sanctuary and Peña Blanca are each about a 30-minute drive away. This is a family-friendly hotel is set on the beach, with a 124 m² area for sunbathing. The rooms are decorated in tropical, Mexican style and have beautiful ocean views. Playa de Oro Manzanillo International Airport is 25 minutes away.

153001.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily from 8 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 33 guestrooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Hagia Sophia - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Sultanahmet Square - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Blue Mosque - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Basilica Cistern - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Gülhane Park - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Istanbul Archaeology Museums - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Little Hagia Sophia - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Cemberlitas Bath - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Grand Bazaar - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Topkapi Palace - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Eminonu Pier - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Eminönü Square - 1. 7 km / 1 mi- Istanbul University - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 45. 1 km / 28 mi Istanbul Airport (IST) - 43. 5 km / 27 mi The preferred airport for Henna Hotel Istanbul is Istanbul Airport (IST). Located in Istanbul (Sultanahmet), Henna Hotel Istanbul is a 4-minute walk from Hagia Sophia and 6 minutes by foot from Sultanahmet Square. This hotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from Blue Mosque and 0. 4 mi (0. 6 km) from Basilica Cistern.

153002.description: This wonderful boutique hotel is situated just 80 metres away from the vibrant Istiklal Street in the mesmerising city of Istanbul. The hotel is just 700 metres from the lively Taksim Square, while the city's major sightseeing attractions, such as Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace and the Blue Mosque are just 4, 5 km away, and are easily accessible via convenient public transport links. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to an abundance of excellent restaurants, bars and shopping opportunities. The hotel is stylish in design, blended with superb Turkish hospitality which will greet guests as soon as they walk through the door. The hotel provides a selection of excellent facilities and services for guests' convenience and comfort.

name.content: Alanya Risus Park Ex Millenium Park

153013.description: This family-friendly hotel enjoys a prime setting in the popular resort of Alanya. The hotel is set on Turkey's Mediterranean Coast, lying just a few minutes' walking distance away from the centre of the resort, where a host of attractions can be found. Links to the public transport network are situated nearby. The beautifully-designed guest rooms offer a relaxed setting in which to completely unwind. Guests can enjoy the utmost in comfort and convenience with a massage, or in the Turkish Bath. The hotel also features an outdoor pool and waterslides, for fun for all the family. Guests of all ages are assured of a memorable stay at this hotel.

153015.address: Makhwana Road, Off Military Road, Marol, Andheri, -
153015.description: This modern hotel, conveniently located near Mumbai's industrial areas, offers easy access to both Mumbai International Airport (1. 5 km) and the domestic airport (8 km). Andheri Railway Station is just 6 km away. The hotel features 48 spacious, comfortable rooms, a welcoming lobby, and stylish interiors. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a conference hall, Wi-Fi, and on-site parking. A multi-cuisine restaurant caters to diverse palates, while each room includes a large TV, refrigerator, telephone with ISD/STD capabilities, and tea/coffee making facilities. Wi-Fi and an electronic safe are standard. For fitness enthusiasts, a well-equipped gym is available.

153019.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at the Lisbon Art Stay Apartments Baixa, located in the heart of Lisbon. This aparthotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) at the on-site café, or enjoy Portuguese cuisine at Navegadoors bar/lounge. Each of the 53 individually decorated guestrooms features a microwave, LCD TV, and cable programming. A 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage are also available. The aparthotel is a short walk from Rua Augusta, Chiado, and other key attractions. Airport transfers are available for a surcharge.

153035.description: This apartment hotel is located amidst one of the most prominent business areas of Madrid, the Calle de Orense. The hotel is situated parallel to the Paseo de la Castellana, just 500 metres from the Plaza de Castilla. Guests can enjoy excellent connections to the trade fair grounds, IFEMA Juan Carlos I and the Palacio de Congresos. Madrid Barajas Airport is just 15 km from the hotel. The hotel features an attractive style, tempting visitors with the promise of unrivalled comfort and convenience. The guest rooms are stylish and comfortable, and are well equipped with modern amenities. The hotel offers conference facilities, for business travellers. From 1st of December of 2021, reception will be opened every day from 07:00 am to 02:00 am.

153123.description: Welcome to the InterContinental Porto Palácio ds Cardosas . The InterContinental Porto was born from the former Palacio das Cardosas and has become a luxurious 5 star hotel. Situated in the historic center of Porto, the hotel has a privileged view of the emblematic Avenida dos Aliados. The InterContinental Porto - Palácio das Cardosas is one step away from the city's major tourist attractions and is the ideal hotel to get lost in the city of Porto.

153141.description: Located in the foothills of the mountains of Montserrat, the hotel is only 15 km from Martorell. Its location offers easy access to the A2 and A7 motorways. This charming luxury Hotel was built in 2005 in a modernist building typical of this region. The hotel is air-conditioned and offers a total of 150 rooms and suites. It is particularly popular with golf fans and provides its guests with many modern amenities. Conference facilities and WLAN Internet access are available, and those arriving by car can make use of the car park and garage on site. Guests can enjoy a relaxing dip in the outdoor swimming pool, or relax on sun loungers beneath the shade of parasols. Pets are not allowed.

153149.description: Enjoy the convenience of a 24-hour fitness center or relax on the terrace with scenic views. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, gift shops, and a television in the common area. Dine at the on-site Kitchen & Bar or enjoy room service. Buffet breakfasts are available on weekdays for a fee (6:30 AM - 9:30 AM). For business travelers, there's a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and check-out. The hotel also features 200 square feet (19 square meters) of event space, including conference space and meeting rooms. The 170 guest rooms provide a comfortable stay with refrigerators, Smart TVs, and satellite programming. Wi-Fi is available (surcharge). Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences are phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Located near Maison des Examens (0. 4 mi), Gustave Roussy (1. 8 mi), and Paris Catacombs (1. 9 mi), the Courtyard by Marriott Paris Arcueil is a convenient choice for exploring the area. The preferred airport is Paris Orly (ORY), 7. 8 miles away.

153155.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at the Paris Marriott Rive Gauche Hotel & Conference Center. Benefit from amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. Indulge in French cuisine at R'Yves brasserie and bar/lounge, or enjoy 24-hour room service. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). For business travelers, the hotel offers a business center, limo/town car service, and extensive conference facilities. The 757 air-conditioned guest rooms feature minibars, premium bedding, and satellite TV. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Located near Place Denfert-Rochereau, the hotel is also convenient to the Paris Catacombs and Parc Montsouris. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

153164.description: This bungalow-style beach hotel, located near the town center, offers convenient access to public transport links. Antalya Airport is approximately 64 kilometers away. The hotel features 99 bungalows, each equipped with air conditioning, an en-suite bathroom, satellite TV, and individually controlled heating. Guests can enjoy amenities such as internet access, a currency exchange, a children's playground, and a restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating. Leisure facilities include a Turkish bath with massage services, a sauna, indoor and outdoor swimming pools, and a private beach area with complimentary sun loungers and parasols.

name.content: Marriott Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport

153192.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a sauna and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). If you'd like to spend the day shopping, you can hop on the shuttle (surcharge). For lunch or dinner, stop by 1704 Bar & Restaurant, a restaurant that specializes in French cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Roissy-en-France? This hotel has 26684 square feet (2479 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary (available on request).

153224.description: The Wit Hotel, located in the heart of Paris, is a short walk from iconic landmarks such as the Palais Garnier and Boulevard Haussmann. Galeries Lafayette is just a kilometer away. The hotel offers 40 guestrooms equipped with minibars, satellite TV, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each room includes a private bathroom with a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. Additional amenities include concierge services, a reception hall, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. Room service is available during limited hours, and a continental breakfast is offered daily (for a fee).

153241.description: In the heart of one of the largest business centers in Europe, 10 minutes from the Champs-Elysées, the Pullman Paris la Defense hotel is a haven of peace and light in the center of La Défense. This upscale hotel offers spacious designer rooms. Savor delicious moments in the Quinte&Sens restaurant with its open kitchen. You can also enjoy the bar, fitness center, WIFI and private car park. The meeting areas will ensure your seminars and events are a success!

153246.description: Entirely renovated in 2017, Novotel Paris 14 invites you to take in views of the capital from its suites and Executive rooms. Total soundproofing and top-of-the-line bedding guarantee a sound night's sleep. In each room is a panoramic photograph of Paris' rooftops. With four meeting rooms, a mezzanine work space, lounge bar, restaurant and fitness room, this Paris hotel is designed for business as well as relaxation.

name.content: Riad La Porte Rouge By La Siredrah

153288.description: Enjoy this riad's indoor pool and hot tub, or take advantage of other amenities including complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). A convenient area shuttle is available (surcharge). The onsite restaurant offers alfresco dining, a bar/lounge, and 24-hour room service. A poolside bar is also available. Start your day with a complimentary full breakfast served daily from 6:00 AM to noon. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Roundtrip airport shuttle service is available (surcharge), and free valet parking is offered onsite. Each of the seven individually decorated guest rooms features a pillowtop bed, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a private bathroom with a shower, hair dryer, and bathrobes. Riad La Porte Rouge By La Siredrah is located in Marrakech's Mechouar-Kasbah district, a short drive from Jemaa el-Fnaa and Avenue Mohamed VI. Nearby attractions include Agdal Gardens, the Royal Palace, and various historical sites.

153296.description: The hotel is situated on a quiet street close to Victoria Station, in the historic Belgravia district. London's museums, the theatres of the West End and the shops of Knightsbridge are about 100 m from the hotel. Restaurants, bars and nightclubs are a short walk away, as are bus, train and underground services. Buckingham Palace and Westminster Cathedral are a short walk away, as is Hyde Park. The hotel offers contemporary services, traditional hospitality and a tranquil atmosphere.

153387.description: Rapidly changing Turkey's most important brand unchanging Istanbul, now it confronts us with very different structures on the Anatolian side. The smiling face of Agaoglu brand in tourism, My City Hotel is one of the important businesses that contribute to this value. With our smiling face, we implemented the idea of being the closest hotel to you in My City Hotel by eliminating the distances. Rapidly changing Turkey's most important brand unchanging Istanbul, now it confronts us with very different structures on the Anatolian side. The smiling face of Agaoglu brand in tourism, My City Hotel is one of the important businesses that contribute to this value. With our smiling face, we implemented the idea of being the closest hotel to you in My City Hotel by eliminating the distances.

153395.description: The hotel offers guests a good location opposite Konyaalti Beach, around 4 km west of the city centre. The beach can be found just across the road and public transport passes in front of the hotel. Local amenities are available within 1 km of the hotel. Within walking distance of the hotel, guests will find restaurants and bars, as well as the Miniature Culture Park. The main bus station is around 6. 5 km away. From the hotel, guests are able to reach the Archaeological Museum is around 10 minutes, or Antalya's Old Town, Kaleici, and the harbour in about 15 minutes, each by public transport. Antalya Airport is approximately 21 km away from the hotel. The hotel was renovated in the winter of 2010/2011. This air-conditioned beach hotel comprises a total of 74 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom and lift access to the upper floors. Facilities on offer to guests include a games room. Guests can enjoy a drink at the café and bar, and dine in the restaurant, which features a terrace with good views of the Mediterranean. Conference facilities are available to business travellers. Guests can enjoy the convenience of the complimentary wireless Internet access. They can also take advantage of the room, newspaper and laundry services (each for an additional fee). Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel car park at no extra charge.

153404.description: This historic hotel, a beautifully preserved riad, is located in the heart of Marrakech's Kasbah, just a 7-minute walk from Jemaa El Fna square, the Koutoubia Mosque, and near Rue de la Kasbah. Offering unique views of the 16th-century El Badi Palace and its resident storks from the hotel terraces, it's also a perfect starting point for exploring Morocco's stunning landscapes and palm groves. Menara Airport is conveniently located approximately 3 km away. The riad, retaining its original Arabic-Andalusian decor from the late 19th century, offers 10 spacious and comfortable rooms and suites. Some suites boast a lounge and a large terrace. All accommodations feature reversible air conditioning, a private en-suite bathroom with a shower, a king-size bed, internet access, a hairdryer, and a safe. Guests can enjoy a refreshing dip in the indoor pool, relax in the charming patio, or unwind in the Andalusian-styled living room bar. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily in the hotel restaurant, which also offers a set menu for dinner. Additional amenities include a 24-hour reception and check-out service, currency exchange, laundry service, and a hotel safe. Guests are also invited to attend a reception hosted by the manager.

153409.address: Port Saeed Road Baniyas Street PO Box 61871
153409.description: Each spacious, luxury room and suite caters to guests' needs, offering panoramic views of the Dubai Creek and skyline. Four restaurants and bars entice travelers with flavorful fare from around the world. The Fit and Spa, 24-hour fitness center, rooftop outdoor pool, and tennis court provide a relaxing hub for hotel guests. Stay connected with free WiFi and our 24-hour Connectivity Lounge. The hotel also offers the perfect venue for meetings, conferences, seminars, banquets, receptions, and weddings in Dubai.

153413.description: Nestled in the heart of the Al Maaden golf course, experience a serene escape just 10 minutes from Jemaa el Fna square. With breathtaking views of the Atlas Mountains, this exclusive retreat offers a timeless and memorable experience away from the bustling crowds. Our Ryads, located within a pedestrian-friendly area bordering Kyle Phillips' 18-hole golf course, blend traditional Moroccan architecture with modern elegance and refinement. *Please note that direct payment reservations will be processed in the local currency at the current exchange rate.

153415.description: Located in l'Hospitalet de Llobregat, just 250 meters from the train station, this aparthotel offers easy access to central Barcelona (a 15-minute train ride). FC Barcelona and Espanyol stadiums, as well as the international trade fair grounds, are easily accessible. Barcelona-El Prat Airport is a convenient 15-minute drive, and the A2 Motorway is readily available. Landmarks such as the Fira de Barcelona, Fira de Cornellà, and Fira Gran Vía 2 exhibition centers are reachable within a 10-minute drive. Enjoy amenities including concierge service, complimentary Wi-Fi, a meeting room, a business center, a restaurant and bar, and car hire services. Guests can also take advantage of the seasonal rooftop pool offering panoramic views. The spacious, modern apartments feature a living room with a sofa bed and a TV. Please note that pets are not allowed.

153418.description: 'This charming 4-star hotel, nestled a short 5-minute walk from the historic St. Germain-en-Laye old town, offers a tranquil escape near the castle and park. A variety of restaurants, bars, pubs, and shops are within a 500m radius, while the bus station is just 200m away. Conveniently located 15km from Versailles and 20km from Paris, the hotel also provides easy access to both Orly (45km) and Charles de Gaulle (60km) airports. Housed in a beautiful mansion, the hotel boasts 42 rooms, many with breathtaking views of Paris and the Seine Valley, while others overlook the tranquil park. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour reception service, lift access, on-site parking, a restaurant with panoramic views serving refined traditional cuisine, and room and laundry services. Each room features a private bathroom with a shower, bathtub, and hairdryer, along with amenities such as satellite/cable TV, a minibar, and a double or king-size bed. Centrally regulated heating ensures comfort throughout your stay. '

153438.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services, an arcade/game room, and wedding services. Grab a bite at Parklands Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 3 bars/lounges. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 148 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Your room comes with a Select Comfort bed. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Drayton Manor Theme Park - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- The Snow Dome - 3. 5 km / 2. 2 mi- Tamworth Castle - 3. 6 km / 2. 2 mi- Kingsbury Water Park - 3. 7 km / 2. 3 mi- Ash End House Children's Farm - 5. 6 km / 3. 5 mi- Middleton Hall - 5. 9 km / 3. 7 mi- Belfry Golf Club - 7. 9 km / 4. 9 mi- Sutton Park - 12. 2 km / 7. 6 mi- New Hall Valley Country Park - 12. 4 km / 7. 7 mi- Sutton Coldfield Mall - 12. 7 km / 7. 9 mi- Samuel Johnson Birthplace Museum - 14. 4 km / 9 mi- Aston Wood Golf Club - 14. 5 km / 9 mi- Little Aston Golf Club - 14. 5 km / 9 mi- Erasmus Darwin House - 14. 5 km / 9 mi- Lichfield Cathedral - 14. 7 km / 9. 2 mi. The nearest airports are: Birmingham Airport (BHX) - 22. 1 km / 13. 8 mi East Midlands Airport (EMA) - 43. 4 km / 26. 9 mi The preferred airport for Drayton Manor Hotel is Birmingham Airport (BHX).

153450.description: The hotel is situated in the heart of the city of Alcalá de Henares, just 50 m from the Cervantes Birthplace Museum and the Archbishop's Palace. It is only a few minutes' walk away from the train and metro stations and shops. The Regional Archaeological Museum and the Cathedral-Magistral are only around 150 m away. It is just 26 km to Madrid-Barajas Airport. The air-conditioned city hotel has 13 rooms in total and is nestled in a 16th century building. The hotel has a bar/cafe, terrace and a lounge which is decorated with wood and features a flat-screen TV. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as a hotel safe. Here guests can also find currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom and lift access to the upper floors. Guests can dine in the hotel restaurant, and room and laundry services are offered. Wireless Internet access is available throughout the building. The rooms are appointed to a high-quality with top standards of comfort. The rooms are spacious and bright, with views of the 16th century monastery, and offer the perfect conditions for relaxation. All rooms feature a complete bathroom with shower and bath, as well as an LCD TV with cable channels, and wireless Internet access. The rooms also come equipped with a hairdryer, direct dial telephone and radio as standard. Additional features include air conditioning, heating and a balcony or terrace. Guests can enjoy dining in the hotel restaurant, which is listed in the Michelin Red Guide. The hotel serves a continental breakfast. Lunch is offered from a set menu and dinner is served à la carte.

153490.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools and an outdoor tennis court. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge) that operates within 5 km. Grab a bite to eat at the Restaurant at Grande Roch, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view, or stay in and take advantage of 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 28 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and plasma televisions. Rooms have private patios. Satellite programming and DVD players are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Laborie Wine Farm - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Paarl Mountain Local Nature Reserve - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- KWV Wine Emporium - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi- Boschenmeer Golf Estate - 4. 1 km / 2. 6 mi- Paarl Rock - 4. 9 km / 3 mi- Afrikaans Language Monument - 5. 5 km / 3. 4 mi- Dal Josafat Stadium - 6. 7 km / 4. 2 mi- Fairview Wines - 7. 2 km / 4. 5 mi- Nederburg Wines - 8. 3 km / 5. 1 mi- Cape Floral Region Protected Areas - 8. 6 km / 5. 4 mi- Babylonstoren - 9. 3 km / 5. 8 mi- Rhebokskloof Estate - 9. 5 km / 5. 9 mi- Vrede en Lust Estate - 10 km / 6. 2 mi- Backsberg Estate Cellars - 11. 3 km / 7 mi- Anura Vineyards - 11. 4 km / 7. 1 mi. The preferred airport for Grande Roche Hotel is Cape Town Intl. Airport (CPT) - 57. 2 km / 35.

153491.description: Located in Brussels' European Quarter, the 4-star Thon Hotel EU is ideal for business and leisure travelers. A short walk from European institutions and the historic city center, it offers easy access to Brussels International Airport via the nearby Schuman Station. Enjoy modern cuisine at The Twelve Bar and Restaurant, stay connected with free Wi-Fi, and make use of the hotel's 10 well-equipped meeting rooms. Certified with the Green Key and Entreprise Ecodynamique Labels, the Thon Hotel EU combines comfort, technology, and sustainability for a superior guest experience.

153508.description: Due to the current travel environment, this hotel is currently not accepting guests for a short period. Reservations are available for future dates. Please see below for up-to-date policy information and ways to contact Hilton Guest Assistance. We look forward to welcoming you to the hotel soon. Situated in the countryside, close to Venice airports and Venice city center, the Hotel Venice - North offers fantastic facilities in a convenient location. Whether you are here for work, to explore the local area or just to take it easy, you will appreciate the warm welcome and modern comfort at this hotel in Venice. Check-in to a stylish guest room or suite with wooden floors and comfortable bedding, and stay connected using complimentary WiFi. The hotel is only a short shuttle bus ride away from the shops and attractions found in the center of Venice. Admire the Brenta River and its wonderful bordering villas, and take a leisurely drive along the Prosecco wine road, its route touching the most characterful and important wineries involved in the production of DOC Prosecco. Soak up the Italian sunshine from the sundeck terrace and relax beside the sparkling outdoor swimming pool. Energize with a workout in the contemporary fitness center or improve your putt as you admire the beautiful natural scenery of the two nearby golf courses. Ensure that your next meeting or conference is a successful one by holding it at the hotel's adjoining Congress Facility, offering 1, 800 sq. m. of flexible event space, dedicated staff and the very latest A/V technology. Sample award-winning Italian cuisine and local wine at the Arco Restaurant, before enjoying cocktails and soothing lounge music at Arco Bar. Our friendly staff look forward to welcoming you with a signature chocolate chip cookie at check-in.

153510.description: Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including outdoor tennis courts, an outdoor pool, and an indoor pool. This property also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and barbecue grills. Guests can get around on the shuttle (surcharge), which operates within 7 kilometers. You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Green Garden Resort, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, express check-in, and multilingual staff. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a cruise ship terminal shuttle. Stay in one of 30 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected.

153512.description: This hotel boasts an idyllic setting at the heart of the charm and beauty of Venice. The hotel is located just 20 metres from the Fenice Theatre. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to a wide range of attractions in the area, including St. Marco Square and Rialto Bridge. This delightful heritage hotel is steeped in the rich culture and history of the surroundings. Enjoying a charming architectural style, the hotel blends effortlessly with its stunning surroundings. The hotel features striking Venetian Baroque interiors, adding an air of elegance and intrigue to the ambience. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, featuring refreshing tones and a relaxing ambience. The hotel affords guests a number of excellent facilities and services.

153513.description: This boutique-style hotel boasts a prime location near the city center, placing you within walking distance of restaurants, bars, shops, and nightclubs. Schiphol Airport is less than 11 kilometers away. Guests can relax in the elegant lounge with its unique fireplace and internet access, enjoy a drink and music in the cozy pub, or utilize the convenient conference facilities. A laundry service and bicycle hire are also available. The hotel offers a range of well-appointed rooms, from cozy singles to spacious family suites, each featuring boutique decor and modern amenities.

153535.description: Albergo ai Tolentini takes its name from the famous Tolentini Church next door. Just 5 minutes' walk from Piazzale Roma bus station and municipal car park, it offers air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi. Rooms at Tolentini come with wood floors and simple furnishings. Each one includes a private bathroom with hairdryer. The hotel is in the quiet Santa Croce area. Santa Lucia Train Station is just across the Grand Canal, easily reached by crossing Ponte degli Scalzi bridge. You have excellent Vaporetto (water bus) links to St. Mark's Square.

153565.description: The hotel is situated in Paris, 100 metres from the Galeries Lafayette department store. It is just 3. 9 km from Notre Dame and 4. 5 km from the Eiffel Tower. The Palais Garnier opera is 500 metres, and the Champs-Élysées is 1. 5 km away. Charles De Gaulle Airport is around 25 km and Orly Airport is about 20 km away. This air-conditioned design hotel offers a total of 24 rooms and boasts extraordinary views of the city. In-house amenities include a bar, a café and a breakfast room. Business travellers can make use of the conferenced facilities. All rooms feature a satellite/cable TV and Internet access.

153653.description: Discover Istanbul's vibrant attractions, including the Bosphorus, Beylerbeyi Palace, Maiden Tower, and Çamlıca Hill, with convenient access to nearby businesses and shopping. Located in Istanbul's new business district, the hotel is only 47. 7 km from Istanbul Airport and 32 km from Sabiha Gökçen Airport. Enjoy modern, stylish accommodations with complimentary high-speed internet access and satellite TV. The hotel also features four flexible meeting spaces, an open buffet breakfast, à la carte lunch and dinner service, and international cuisine available through room service. Capitol Shopping Mall is a five-minute walk away. Free WiFi is available throughout the hotel.

153688.description: Nestled in the historical centre of Venice, this establishment offers simple comfort at an amazing location. Sitting at just 160 metres from The Ponte della Costituzione and 150 metres from Palazzo Mocenigo means that guests will be in the centre of the city, just minutes from all its main attractions. Piazza San Marco, the Doge's Palace, Basilica San Marco and the Rialto Bridge can all be visited just minutes after stepping out of the front door. Due to the proximity to everything the only transport that will be needed is one of the gondolas  for a truly Venetian romantic evening trip between its most famous bridges and buildings.

name.content: ibis Birmingham Airport - NEC (new ibis rooms)

153696.description: Ibis Birmingham International Airport hotel is a modern hotel located 100m from Birmingham International Airport, within walking distance to the NEC, Resorts World, Genting Arena and BHX train station. We offer 162 recently renovated bedrooms, free WIFI, restaurant and bar open 24/7. You can pick up a snack or relax with a nightcap in the friendly bar. Please note that the hotel does not have its own car park. We suggest booking parking online with NCP directly.

153723.description: Situated in the city centre, this hotel is close to the Museum of Islamic Art, Souq Waqif and Doha Fort. Local area attractions also include the Qatar National Museum and Grand Hamad Street. The 162-room hotel offers many facilities to ensure its guests a comfortable and pleasant stay. It features an Indian restaurant and uninterrupted views of Doha's Corniche and the West Bay neighbourhood. All the accommodation offered by the hotel is comfortable and well-equipped. The hotel also provides its guests with live entertainment at the restaurant, a bracelet-making corner, as well as live band and DJ performances at the Farenheit night club. Guests are welcomed in the hotel lobby with lift access. Conference facilities are provided for corporate visitors, and for an additional charge guests can take advantage of the laundry service. The hotel rooms feature stunning city, ocean or sea views. They are fitted with LCD televisions with satellite channels and coffee and tea makers. The bathrooms include a shower or bathtub combination with rainfall showerheads, bathrobes, slippers and make-up/shaving mirrors. Guests can stay connected thanks to the Internet access provided. Air conditioning also features as standard, as does a minibar. A rooftop outdoor swimming pool and a children's pool can be found on site. Other recreational amenities include a health club, steam room and a gym. For an additional fee guests can relax in the sauna. Buffet breakfasts are available in the morning.

153727.description: This hotel is located in the city of Valongo, 12 km from Oporto city centre and 2 km from Valongo train station. The hotel features spacious rooms with flat-screen cable TV, and conference rooms. The breakfast buffet starts the day and there are snacks and drinks available from the vending machines, while the bar serves refreshing drinks. There are regular buses to Oporto city centre departing from near the hotel. The hotel offers free indoor and outdoor parking.

153745.description: Stay at Le Lapin Blanc in the heart of Paris, just a short walk from the Luxembourg Gardens and the Panthéon. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Enjoy a continental breakfast on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM (for a fee), or grab a bite from the snack bar. Room service is also available during limited hours. Each of the 30 guestrooms features a minibar, a flat-screen TV with satellite programming, a safe, and a desk. The hotel also provides dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk. Nearby attractions include Notre Dame, Rue de Rivoli, and the Louvre Museum. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

153747.description: This lovely hotel is located in the central picturesque Bab Doukkala district, next to the popular Djema el Fnâa Square and to the Majorelle Gardens. The bubbling colourful Souk and the traditional bazaar, where tourists can experience the most authentic Moroccan atmosphere, are also located not far from the property. In its six beautifully decorated double rooms this hotel successfully maintains the charm of an authentic Moroccan house, where guests feel immediately comfortable and welcome, and combines it with modern amenities. Each accommodation unit features an en-suite bathroom and air-conditioning as standard.

153759.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional amenities at this Beaux Arts hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy American cuisine at Refuel, a café which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Cooked-to-order breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in Brooklyn? This hotel has 603 square feet (56 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and a meeting room. Stay in one of 176 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries.

153801.description: Easily accessible from the C-17 motorway, this spa hotel is located in La Garriga, in Catalonia's Vallès Oriental region. It offers a large thermal spa and air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi. The spa at Termes La Garriga features natural hot springs and a wide range of beauty and relaxation treatments. Guests can also enjoy the fitness center and games room. The rooms at Termes La Garriga have tiled floors and smart décor in soft tones. Each room includes a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. A varied breakfast buffet is served in the bright dining room, and the restaurant offers creative Mediterranean cuisine. La Garriga is a 35-minute drive from central Barcelona, while the beautiful Montseny Nature Reserve is just 10 minutes away by car.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Cape Town - Upper Eastside

153804.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Airport Shuttle, Concierge, Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service. Discover Cape Town from DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Cape Town - Upper Eastside. Enjoy the perfect location, just 10 minutes from the vibrant heart of Cape Town, and the V&A Waterfront and 15 minutes from Cape Town International Airport. From museums to natural wonders, wineries to fine dining options and adventurous sporting activities, Cape Town is a tourist's haven. We'll greet you to our hotel with a freshly baked chocolate chip cookie on arrival. Combining style with convenience, our rooms offer an array of choice amenities to help you relax and stay productive. Settle in to your elegant guest room with WiFi, a sumptuous bed and indulgent bathroom amenities. Step up to a one-bedroom suite for more space or choose an exclusive executive room for access to the Executive Lounge, serving complimentary continental breakfast. Workout in the modern fitness center at this Cape Town DoubleTree hotel. With years of experience across South Africa and Europe, our Executive Chef has created a menu of fusion dishes and traditional favorites. Sip cocktails in the sophisticated bar which combines a cozy lounge with a library area and plenty of space for casual meetings. With nine versatile event spaces, A/V equipment, superb catering options and a dedicated events team, DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel in Cape Town offers the perfect venue for meetings and celebrations for up to 350 guests.

153812.description:
Stay in the heart of Istanbul – 
Located in the historical district of Sultanahmet, this hotel really does enjoy an enviable position within 100 m of the Hagia Sophia and even closer to the Underground Cisterns. Shops, cafés, bars and restaurants are close by and a tram stop is within 200 m of the hotel. Topkapi Palace and the Blue Mosque are also nearby. İstanbul Airport is about 40 km away and Sabiha Gokcen Airport is about 45 km from the establishment. 

At the hotel, each room has a desk, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom. 

The accommodation offers an buffet breakfast. 

Sura Luxury Milion & Spa offers 5-star accommodation. 

Popular points of interest near the hotel include Grand Bazaar, Column of Constantine and Blue Mosque. 

Fatih is a great choice for travellers interested in old town exploring, architectureand history.

153837.address: P.O. Box 26816 Al Barsha(South) TECOM, N/A
153837.description: This wonderful hotel is ideally located in the heart of Dubai's new business district, only a short drive to Dubai Media City. This is a brand new luxurious 3-star hotel which features 93 gracefully appointed guestrooms and suites. The hotel boasts impressive leisure facilities, business services including a Spa that takes up one full floor of the hotel, as well as a fully equipped health club and swimming pool with sun deck on site. Dedicated business centre, fantastic casual dining facilities and unique clubs are available in the hotel. The standard rooms are designed for comfort with warm interiors, offering relaxing and inviting atmosphere. All rooms are fully equipped. In addition there are Wi-Fi, wall mounted flat screen television with satellite channels and safe deposit locker.

153854.address: Carrer Nou De La Rambla, 15 TRASLADOS
153854.description: This cosy accomodation guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 12 rooms.

153879.description: Nestled in the tranquil Collbato Provincial Park, the Checkin Montserrat hotel offers a family-friendly retreat just a short drive from the captivating Coves del Salnitre and the majestic Montserrat mountain. Guests can enjoy a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, explore the area on rented bicycles, or relax in the arcade/game room. The hotel's 113 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with bathtubs. A convenient on-site restaurant, coffee shop, and bar/lounge cater to all dining needs. Business travelers can utilize the business center and meeting rooms, while multilingual staff at the 24-hour front desk are always available to assist. Free self-parking is also provided. Montserrat Monastery and the Aeri de Montserrat cable car are easily accessible, making this hotel an ideal base for exploring the region.

153886.description: This wonderful hotel is conveniently located just 2. 8 km from the famous Champs Elysees. Louise Michel Metro Station is just 80 metres from the property. This contemporary hotel features a terrace decorated with Japanese-style floral bouquets, where guests can enjoy splendid views of the surroundings. This establishment is the perfect starting point for those who would like to experience France from an elegant and comfortable place. The friendly well-trained staff is prepared to assist with service and information at all times. The hotel offers a number of modern amenities, such as Internet access and a 24-hour reception.

153891.description: This ultra-luxurious hotel located in the vibrant Long Island City neighbourhood, the westernmost neighbourhood in Queens, New York's most populous and ethnically diverse borough, just one subway stop from midtown Manhattan. LaGuardia Airport are within a short driving distance 11 km away. The hotel is close to all major attractions such as Apple Fifth Avenue and Times Square, and also perfectly positioned for the best views of Manhattan. This hotel features a restaurant, pubs and  lounges. Business guests can take advantage of the business centre, complimentary internet access. The guests can enjoy the rooftop terrace with a breakfast each morning. All the rooms come with home appliances and forniture with modern design.

153939.address: August Kranti Margi, Kemps Corner, Peddar Rd, Flyo, 131
153939.description: This hotel is situated in one of Downtown Mumbai's elite residential neighbourhoods, providing easy access to the south Mumbai commercial district, shopping areas and the Bandra Kurla complex. The hotel is about 15 km away from the domestic airport, 17 km from the international airport and about 5 km from Mumbai central station. This budget-class hotel is centrally located, well-appointed and fully furnished, and it provides 35 quality accommodation units, efficient services and world-class facilities, making it the preferred choice of business and leisure travellers. Guests are welcomed to the air-conditioned establishment in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe and a newspaper stand, while further facilities include a restaurant, conference facilities, wireless Internet access, and both room and laundry services. Guests arriving by car may leave their vehicle in the car park. The hotel provides accommodation in elegantly designed and well-appointed rooms with oak wood flooring. The rooms are spacious and comfortable, and come equipped with state-of-the-art amenities, such as satellite TV, air conditioning, a direct dial telephone, tea and coffee making facilities, a writing desk and neatly kept en suite bathrooms with a shower and bathtub. A double bed, Internet access, a safe and a minibar also feature in all rooms as standard.

153949.description: This cosy hotel is located in the Batignolles district in the north of Paris, only 2 km from the Basilica of the Sacred Heart in the Montmartre district with its bars, cafés and nightlife. La Fourche metro station is 700 m away, the Eiffel Tower can be reached within 20 minutes. Features of the non-smoking hotel include 28 rooms, express check-in and check-out, WIFI, laundry, ticket service and luggage storage. Wheelchair accessible.

name.content: The Canvas Hotel Dubai - Mgallery Hotel Collection

153967.description: Located in the heart of historic Bur Dubai, The Canvas Hotel Dubai MGallery Hotel Collection is a 5-star hotel offering modern accommodations. Within walking distance of the Dubai Museum, Dubai Creek, the Heritage Centre, and the Gold Souk, this hotel provides guests with easy access to key attractions. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the property and unwind in the expansive 1, 000 m² spa. The non-smoking rooms feature a contemporary style and include a seating area with a flat-screen TV. Bathrooms are equipped with a bathtub, shower, and complimentary toiletries.

153988.address: Gran Via De Les Corts Catalanes, 559
153988.description: This elegant hotel, situated in the heart of the Eixample district, enjoys a prime location on the renowned Gran Via de les Corts Catalanes. Within walking distance of Plaza Catalunya, Las Ramblas, and other sites of cultural and historical interest, the hotel offers convenient access to the city's vibrant core. Prefer to take public transport? You'll find convenient links just outside the hotel. Sants Station is approximately 1. 5 km away, and the airport is approximately 8 km from the hotel. This is an ideal starting point for discovering this wonderful city.

154018.description: Magnificently located in the 9th district of Paris, this enchanting hotel is very well situated regardless of the purpose guests may have for travelling. Visitors will enjoy a pleasant stay at its classical and elegant interiors, and be minutes away from famous points of interest such as the impressive Opéra Garnier, the boulevard Haussmann and the Grands boulevards. All guest rooms are tastefully decorated in a traditional style and count with classical pieces of furniture. They overlook the courtyard or the street but feature double glazing windows to ensure a calm and quiet stay. If visitors are travelling with the whole family or with a group of friends, they may prefer to stay at the adjacent rooms available. Guests will be warmly welcomed at the nice lobby with stained glass ceiling and may taste the delicious breakfast served on-site.

154023.description: Located next to a large park in the pedestrian zone of Baden, Hotel Admiral is 164 feet away from the casino. Free WiFi is available throughout the property. The rooms of Hotel Admiral am Kurpark are all air-conditioned and feature a flat-screen cable TV and a mini-bar. All bed linen are allergy-tested. Russian TV channels are available on request. An internet terminal is available in the lobby. A limited number of parking spaces is available free of charge.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh Royal Mile

154029.description: Located in the heart of the historic city of Edinburgh, Holiday Inn Express® Edinburgh – Royal Mile is where comfort and Scottish charm come together. Catch trains to Glasgow and London from the nearby Edinburgh Waverley station or take off from Edinburgh Airport (EDI), 30 minutes away. Situated steps away from iconic landmarks and cultural treasures, such as the magnificent Edinburgh Castle and the Royal Mile, our hotel allows you to get lost in the city's buzzing atmosphere. For those looking to explore the natural wonders of Edinburgh, we’re an eight-minute walk from Holyrood Park, offering breathtaking views of Arthur's Seat. Culture enthusiasts will be delighted to find the National Museum of Scotland and the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh within easy reach, providing a glimpse into Scotland's fascinating past and its diverse botanical wonders. No visit to Edinburgh is complete without a trip to Calton Hill, just 12 minutes away and soak in panoramic views of the city and the striking Scottish National Monument. Additionally, history buffs can explore the impressive Royal Yacht Britannia and discover the grandeur of the Palace of Holyroodhouse, the official residence of the British monarch in Scotland. Unwind in our modern hotel. Rooms feature handy amenities like free Wi-Fi and ironing facilities. Start your day off right with our free buffet breakfast, offering tasty hot and cold items.

name.content: Ramada By Wyndham South Mimms M25

154045.description: Located just off the M25 at Junction 23, the Ramada London South Mimms offers convenient access to London attractions such as Wembley Stadium (a 30-minute drive) and Emirates Stadium. The hotel provides complimentary parking and each room features free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV, a comfortable Hypnos bed, and tea/coffee making facilities. Guests can enjoy onsite dining at the hotel restaurant. Please note, pets are not allowed.
