154049.description: Right by Lake Geneva. . . A welcoming retreat where privacy is considered essential. The unique Rotary hotel creates the perfect setting for an exceptional getaway. At the very centre of Geneva, in the business district, the hotel opens its doors to reveal a stunning, refined and completely renovated setting. The rooms themselves give the guest an unequalled travel experience with luxurious comfort and a subtle blend of classic and antique furnishings.

154066.description: Located in the centre of Bogota, this city hotel is situated close to clinics, museums, and shopping centres. It is also conveniently located near the city's business districts, making it an ideal destination for business travellers. Guests can access the city centre in around a 10-minute drive, and visit restaurants, bars and pubs located some 5 minutes' walk away. The nearest local transport links are to be found around 200 m from the hotel, and it is close to the city's airports. Built in 2011, this hotel is the epitome of elegance and modernity. The excellent facilities and impeccable service are designed to ensure that each guest will take home unforgettable memories of their holiday. It is situated close to numerous attractions and offers recreational facilities. Other useful amenities include meeting/banquet and conference facilities, a business centre, a 24-hour concierge service, a 24-hour reception, room service, a library and much more. A 24-hour check-out service is provided in the lobby, as is a hotel safe and currency exchange facilities. If you are traveling with children, you may need to present new documents at the establishment. Parents who travel to Colombia with children under the age of 18 may need to present the child's birth certificate and their photo ID at the time of check-in. If the minor is accompanied by a family member or guardian, the minor must present a certified travel authorization signed by both parents, in addition to a copy of the parent's document. If the child travels alone with his / her parents, it is possible that the child must present a travel consent certified and signed by the other parent.

154071.description: Located in the center of Valença, Hotel Lara is an excellent base for exploring this historic town. It features modern rooms with balconies and a breakfast room overlooking the fortress. The air-conditioned rooms at the Lara feature wooden furnishings and are decorated in neutral tones. Each room includes a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. Guests can start their day with a rich breakfast buffet before exploring the surrounding area. We offer breakfast service for early risers (04:00 to 07:00) upon request. The hotel bar serves refreshing drinks and there are many restaurants and cafes nearby. The hotel's games room has a pool table. Vigo-Peinador Airport is 14 mi away and the hotel offers free public parking on site.

154073.description: This romantic and sophisticated establishment boasts a convenient position close to all the main places of interest that the magical and interesting city of Marrakech has to offer, such as Bab Doukkala 5 minutes away, as well as Souk’s baazars and the famous Jemaa el Fnaa a few steps away. Menara - Marrakech Airport is less than 5 km away. If travellers want to sunbathe they can do it at the furnished terrace with sunloungers and to relax they will find a small indoor pool. Guest rooms are decorated in an individual and unique style, include exclusive amenities and maintain the typical Moroccan flair, making it possible for its guests to feel completely at ease and enjoy a good night’s sleep.

name.content: Le Belgrand Hotel Paris Champs Elysees, Tapestry

154075.description: Featuring neoclassical design and being a typically Parisian establishment, this charming hotel is ideal for business travellers and holiday makers alike, with views over beautiful tree-lined garden, offering an oasis of calm in the heart of hectic Paris. The hotel is 2 km from the Eiffel Tower and 200 m from the Arc de Triomphe. Facilities include air conditioning, a 24-hour reception and Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. A public car park is situated in the vicinity (fees apply).

154078.description: Ideal for a family holiday, Mercure Apparthotel Paris Boulogne offers various apartments from Studio to 2 rooms for your stay. For a few days or weeks, our Boulogne-Billancourt hotel allows you to choose between our bar-restaurant or the kitchen area of your private accommodation. You will also have access to a laundromat and paid covered parking. You will feel at home, while benefiting from our services.

154084.description: The 3-star ibis Styles Paris Roissy-CDG offers convenient 24-hour access, making it ideal for business or leisure travelers. Located near Roissy-Charles-de-Gaulle Airport (CDG) and the Villepinte Exhibition Center, the hotel includes breakfast and unlimited Wi-Fi in the room rate. Guests can enjoy a cozy bar and restaurant, and on-site private parking is available (fee applies). A paid shuttle service operates daily.

154147.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services, wedding services, and a picnic area. Enjoy international cuisine at Mary Beale, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge, take in the garden view, and even dine alfresco. You can also stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. English breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 59 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

154159.description: Just a stroll away from the city centre. Crowne Plaza Amsterdam-South is located in the south of Amsterdam, just a five-minute walk from Amsterdam Zuid station, which connects guests to the city center within 10 minutes by metro. Art fans are just 10 minutes away from the masterpieces at the Van Gogh and Rijksmuseum. Bikes are available at the hotel to explore the city like a local. The hotel offers modern design accommodation with free Wi-Fi, fitness facilities, a business corner and a convenience store in the lobby. Every morning, a full American breakfast with live cooking is served. Visit the Manhattan Lounge Bar for a coffee, some cake and later in the day a tasty cocktail with delicious food. Explore the touch of Japanest culture at our newly opened restaurant: De Japanner Zuid and enjoy the Izakaya concept of share dining. The spacious hotel rooms offer luxurious beds, a pillow menu to guarantee a good night's sleep, a comfortable seating area, coffee and tea facilities, air-conditioning, ironing facilities and a large modern bathroom with either a bathtub or walk-in shower. Windows in each hotel room can be opened for some fresh air. Whether you are hosting a convention, a brainstorm session or after-work drinks, our centrally located venue and on-site catering will exceed your expectations. With ten flexible meeting rooms, featuring natural daylight, Crowne Plaza can seat up to 145 delegates in theater style.

154184.description: Situated in the heart of Marrakech, near the vibrant Gueliz district, Almas Hotel seamlessly blends traditional Moroccan style with contemporary design. Rooms adorned with antique furnishings offer captivating views of central Marrakech and the fashionable Gueliz district, renowned for its exclusive shops, boutiques, restaurants, and art galleries. Guests can experience renowned Moroccan hospitality while relaxing at the rooftop pool and lounge, enjoying panoramic city and Atlas Mountain views. A short stroll leads to the bustling Mohammed V Avenue, while the train station is a mere five-minute walk and the airport a quick 15-minute ride away. Marrakech's rich culture and gastronomy make it an alluring destination for couples and families alike.

154186.description: The Millennium Hotel Paris Opera, your Parisian home away from home, is situated on the sophisticated Boulevard Haussmann. It's within easy reach of major business areas, department stores such as Galeries Lafayette and Printemps, and prominent museums. This hotel offers 163 spacious guest rooms and suites, all completely refurbished. Amenities include individual air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, and flatscreen TVs with Chromecast. All rooms feature en suite bathrooms, tea and coffee making facilities, and a full-size working desk with a USB socket. The hotel also offers six meeting rooms, including the boardroom, Le Perreire (up to 10 people), and the ballroom, Le Grand Opera (up to 90 people), as well as a private lobby and bar. Millennium Hotels and Resorts maintains high standards of cleanliness and hygiene.

154192.description: Hotel Raphael Wien enjoys a quiet and central location in the heart of Vienna. Situated close to Mariahilferstrasse, our hotel is ideal for culture and shopping, and a variety of restaurants is also nearby. Attractions such as the Hofburg Imperial Palace, State Opera House and Schönbrunn Palace are easily accessible. Viennese charm in a cosmopolitan atmosphere: We want to make your stay with us a special experience. Take us at our word - we look forward to welcoming you.

154195.description: This delightful apartment complex enjoys a prime location in Eixample, in the heart of captivating Barcelona. Situated just 20 meters from the modernist Casa Fuster and 200 meters from the Diagonal metro station, it offers easy access to the rest of the city, including Las Ramblas, Plaça Catalunya, and Barcelona's exciting shopping, dining, and entertainment venues. Refurbished in 2020, the complex welcomes guests with an attractive interior design and a relaxing ambiance. The stylish apartments offer a comfortable home away from home, complete with modern amenities for added convenience. A €150 deposit is required at check-in.

154201.description: The Praderón Hotel in San Sebastián de los Reyes is 7 miles from IFEMA Trade Fair and 2. 5 miles from Jarama Race Course. The hotel offers free Wi-Fi. All of the Praderón’s rooms have private bathroom, air conditioning, heating, flat-screen satellite TV and telephone. There is a cafe from morning until late at night, and the restaurant serves evening meals. There is also a lounge open 24 hours a day, which has vending machines. Barajas Airport is about 9 miles away, while the A-1 highway to the north of Spain is less than half a mile away. Reyes Católicos Metro station is about a 10 minute walk away and the Micropolix Shopping Center is nearby. The hotel has private parking, upon request.

154231.description: 'Our Birmingham Central Broadway Plaza hotel is conveniently located for the Edgbaston cricket ground and the University of Birmingham, and a short walk from the atmospheric Symphony Hall and the Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery. Step back in time at the National Trust's Back to Backs or visit the nearby National Sea Life Centre. Embrace your inner chocoholic at Cadbury World or commune with nature at Winterbourne House Botanic Gardens. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals.

154252.description: 'Our Stansted Great Dunmow hotel is perfectly placed if you want to just pack up and fly off - it's an easy 12-minute drive to the airport. And it's easy to find, thanks to its convenient location just off the M11. The historic Roman village of Great Dunmow is a stone's throw away. Wander the cobbled streets enjoying the friendly atmosphere and then stop for a pint in one of the cosy local pubs. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals.

154264.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at this hotel, including concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and a television in the common area. Additional features include a reception hall and a vending machine. A shuttle (surcharge) takes you to the nearby beach or shopping center. The hotel offers a restaurant, a coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (7:30 AM to 10:30 AM, for a fee). Featured amenities include limo/town car service, a computer station, and express check-in. Roundtrip airport and ferry terminal shuttles are available (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 36 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring tablet computers and minibars. Your memory foam bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. LCD televisions are provided for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. The hotel is located near Sultanahmet Square, the Basilica Cistern, and other popular attractions. The nearest airports are Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) and Istanbul Airport (IST). The preferred airport is Istanbul Airport (IST).

name.content: TRYP by Wyndham New York City Times Square South

154270.description: The 3-star Tryp by Wyndham Times Square South offers comfort and convenience whether you're on business or holiday in New York (NY). The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Service-minded staff will welcome and guide you at the Tryp by Wyndham Times Square South. Some of the well-appointed guestrooms feature television LCD/plasma screen, separate living room, internet access – wireless (complimentary), non smoking rooms, air conditioning. Entertain the hotel's recreational facilities, including fitness center. A welcoming atmosphere and excellent service are what you can expect during your stay at Tryp by Wyndham Times Square South.

154274.description: Enjoy breathtaking views from the rooftop terrace at Boutike Cibeles, a luxurious aparthotel in the heart of Madrid, steps from Calle de Alcalá and Plaza de Cibeles. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services, and relax in the communal living room or elegant ballroom. A buffet breakfast is available for a fee each morning. The aparthotel also features a business center, 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff, as well as conference space and a meeting room. Each of the 18 guestrooms offers a fully equipped kitchen with a full-sized refrigerator/freezer and oven, a 55-inch LED TV with cable programming, and a bathroom with a deep soaking tub and designer toiletries. For your convenience, phones, desks, and separate sitting areas are also provided. Boutike Cibeles is just a short distance from attractions such as Gran Via and the Prado Museum, offering an ideal location for exploring the city.

154341.description: Overlooking Bogota, this hotel is right by 93 Park, a meeting point surrounded by the best brand shopping and excellent restaurants, and all outdoors. The closest metro station is about 100 metres from the hotel. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange, cloakroom and lift access, TV lounge, café, bar, pub and a restaurant, conference facilities, broadband internet, WI-FI area, gym, spa, steam, jacuzzi. The hotel has a bilingual concierge, laundry service and 24-hour room service, car park or garage, and bicycles may be hired on site.

154345.description: This hotel with gym is just 2 blocks from the impressive building of Congress and 6 blocks from the Obelisk. Wi-Fi is free. This is the ideal place to enjoy a stay in Buenos Aires, thanks to the strategic location in the middle of downtown, close to theatres, historic buildings, shops and restaurants. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with a 24-hour reception and facilities include a hotel safe, cloakroom, lift access and a TV lounge.

154350.description:
Situated in Alanya, the Bella Bravo Suit Hotel is an easy drive from the city centre.
The Bella Bravo Suit Hotel has 40 rooms and offers an outdoor swimming pool (seasonal). It also features a currency exchange, a lift and a 24 hour reception. A Wi-Fi connection is also provided.
All the well-equipped rooms at the Bella Bravo Suit Hotel include an in-room dining area and a kitchenette. 
For those preferring to dine out, there are a number of dining options a short stroll from the hotel.
Gazipasa Airport (GZP) is under a 40-minute drive from the Bella Bravo Suit Hotel. Guests can discover nearby attractions.

154895.description: The hotel offers an unbeatable location in the district of Miraflores. Its setting provides guests with easy access to shopping opportunities, banks and restaurants. The bus station is only 200 m away. A park can be found a 10-minute walk away. Here guests can enjoy spectacular views of the local coastline. The range of facilities offered means that guests are able to enjoy their stay here. Further amenities include a games room and a TV lounge. Guests can enjoy a drink at the cosy bar, and dine in the restaurant. Meeting rooms are available to business travellers. Guests can enjoy the convenience of complementary wireless Internet access, which is available not only in rooms but also in all other areas of the hotel. They can take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel garage.

154896.description: Centro by Casa Andina Miraflores is a comfortable, practical and functional hotel with a strategic location in the main tourist area of Lima. It offers the basic services a traveler expects to enjoy the city to the fullest. The hotel is located in the district of Miraflores, approximately 50 minutes from the Aeropuerto Internacional Jorge Chávez. Its location allows easy access to the most important roads in the city, making it easy to move around the city. Just a few blocks away you can find handicraft stores and the main restaurants of Miraflores. It is also close to Parque Kennedy and the Miraflores Boardwalk. Cleaning service with additional cost. Buffet breakfast included from 6 a 10 a. mCheck-in: 2:00 p. m. - Check-out: 12:00 noon

name.content: Casa Andina Standard Miraflores San Antonio

154897.description: The hotel is located in a residential area, a 10-minute walk or short taxi ride from Central Park. It is close to restaurants, shops and offices in Miraflores. The closest metro station is about 5 minutes' walk away. It is a 30-minute taxi ride from Jorge Chavez International Airport. All premises are air-conditioned. Facilities include a currency exchange and a hotel car park. Guests can dine in the restaurant. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet access and a medical service at the hotel. Each air-conditioned room has an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer. Travellers can enjoy a good night's rest on their double bed. Facilities include a lounge, telephone and TV. There is also a safe, fridge and an Internet access. All units have a balcony or a terrace. The hotel serves a breakfast buffet and a set menu at lunch.

154898.description: Located two blocks from Miraflores Central Park and 40 minutes from Lima International Airport, Casa Andina Premium stands as a landmark of luxury. Originally the first upscale hotel outside downtown Lima, it has been meticulously restored, incorporating elements of coastal culture. Situated in the heart of Miraflores, a vibrant district transformed from a beach resort to a hub for dining, shopping, and seaside entertainment, this hotel offers guests a prime location.

154900.description: Situated in Miraflores' vibrant tourist district, this hotel is conveniently located a short 5-minute drive from Larcomar, 20 minutes from Lima's historic center, and 30 minutes from Jorge Chavez International Airport. Each room features a minibar, air conditioning, and a safe. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast and utilize the business center. Whether traveling for business or leisure, this hotel offers comfort, convenience and competitive rates, making you feel right at home.

154907.description: This 3 star hotel is located within the city of Rio De Janeiro. The Hotel has an outdoor swimming pool. All 90 rooms are equipped with safe and air conditioning.

154909.description: This 3 star hotel is located within the city of Rio De Janeiro. It is close to the Aquatic Park Rio Water Planet. The Hotel has an outdoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym.

name.content: B&B Hotel Rio de Janeiro Copacabana Forte

154913.description:
Perfectly located in Rio de Janeiro, with stunning views of Sugarloaf Mountain, this hotel is just a two-minute walk from both Copacabana and Ipanema beaches. Guests can enjoy remarkable sunsets and on-site dining at the hotel restaurant. Business travelers can utilize the three conference rooms of varying capacities. The beautifully decorated rooms, styled in tranquil tones, offer a harmonious retreat. Amenities include a TV, minibar, private bathroom with hairdryer, telephone, and a dining table. Visitors must register at reception and pay the stipulated fee; visits are limited by room capacity. 
*ATTENTION:The hotel is currently undergoing renovation. *

154921.description: Hotel Monte Castelo is strategically located on a residential street in the historic district of Glória, a few meters from the Glória subway station, 10 minutes from Santos Dumont Airport, with easy access to the main tourist attractions and the financial center of the city. All rooms are equipped with TV, air conditioning and minibar, we offer free wifi. Check in time from 14:00 and check out until 12:00. *** Hotel Monte Castelo does not host children under 7 years ***

name.content: Real Palace Hotel Rio de Janeiro

154934.description: The hotel is located at the heart of Rio de Janeiro, near the Cardeal Arcoverde subway station, accessible by both airports and in an urban area that represents one of Rio de Janeiro's finest attractions: the neighborhood of Copacabana; and the highlight: only a block and a half from the beach – one of the most beautiful and famous beaches in Brazil. At the hotel, the travellers will discover the best way of combining comfort, convenience and versatility into one unique place with all the refinement you deserve. On top of that, the highly qualified staff is always ready to help you in the best possible way.

154937.description: Just 200 meters from Leblon Beach and 500 meters from Antero de Quental Metro Station in Rio de Janeiro, the charming Ritz Leblon offers a gym and a swimming pool with a wooden deck and sun loungers. The property's restaurant serves a buffet breakfast daily. Wi-Fi is free in all environments. The rooms feature modern décor, stereo, minibar, LCD cable TV and air conditioning. Guests can enjoy cocktails at the Tropical Bar located in the lobby. Ritz Leblon is 6. 5 km from the famous Copacabana Beach and 14. 6 km from Santos Dumont Airport. The Christ the Redeemer Statue and Maracanã Stadium are 13 km from the accommodation. Parking is available at an additional cost.

154938.description: The Hotel Rondônia Palace guarantees an unforgettable stay in Rio de Janeiro, conveniently located for both business and leisure travelers. Just 15 minutes from Santos Dumont Airport and the city center, it's also close to Copacabana, restaurants, cinemas, shopping centers, and the subway. Discover the Hotel Rondônia Palace, where our team is dedicated to making you feel at home.

154941.description: 200 meters from Copacabana beach and located in one of the best gastronomic corridors in Rio de Janeiro, our guests have the privilege of enjoying a location that is a postcard of Rio de Janeiro: Copacabana. The Riale Vilamar Copacabana has a heated swimming pool, steam sauna, gym, meeting room, electric car charger and bicycle rental. Parking is not included in the daily rate, and is subject to availability. The hotel has 70 apartments, all equipped with air conditioning, cable TV, digital safe, Wi-Fi, minibar, hairdryer and makeup mirror. The Hotel also has a delicious breakfast that is served from 06:00 to 10:00, a Lobby Bar that opens from 10:00 to 23:30 with Room Service, as well as an events room and a business center. *charged separately.

154948.description: The Villa Rica Hotel offers simple, yet comfortable accommodation with complimentary Wi-Fi in Rio de Janeiro's vibrant Lapa district. Conveniently located next to Glória Subway Station, it's just 2 km from Santos Dumont Airport and within easy reach of the city's key attractions. Rooms feature dark green decor and en suite bathrooms with brown granite accents. All are equipped with air conditioning. A daily breakfast featuring fresh fruit, pastries, bread, cold meats, and juices is available, and can be served in your room for an additional fee. For entertainment, the hotel is 2 km from Rio's lively Sambodrome and 700 meters from the Modern Art Museum. Car rental services are also available.

154950.description: Enjoy amenities including an outdoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Dine at Restaurante Ca'd'Oro, specializing in Italian cuisine, or enjoy room service (limited hours). Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Buffet breakfast is served weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM (fee applies). Business services, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk are available. The hotel offers 4 meeting rooms. The 140 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars and LED TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Located near Rua Augusta, the hotel is a short distance from Mackenzie Presbyterian University, Copan Building, and Frei Caneca Shopping and Convention Center.

154952.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Sao Paulo. It is a short drive away from the Night life Center. The Hotel has an outdoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 76 rooms are equipped with hairdryer and air conditioning. We emphasize that the contracted daily rate is for 24 hours, with check-in from 2 p. m. and check-out until 12 p. m. The interval of up to 3 hours between guests' departure and arrival is provided for in MTur Ordinance No. 28 and is intended exclusively for cleaning, sanitizing, and tidying up the unit, ensuring the maintenance of our standard of excellence.

name.content: DELPLAZA Excelsior Sao Paulo - By Monreale

154954.description: Enjoying a central location, this hotel is beautifully situated at the heart of the entertainment in Sao Paulo. Within a short distance of the hotel, guests can explore the range of entertainment, dining and shopping venues that the city has to offer. Guests can also explore the delights of Guarulhos, Congonhas, Anhembi, Avenida Paulista and southern Sao Paulo. Within 8 km of the hotel, lies Sao Paulo Congonhas airport. The hotel presents a charming architectural design, which is sure to impress. The guest rooms are spacious with modern furnishings, featuring soft soothing natural tones, to induce an aura of relaxation and tranquillity. Guests can avail of the gym located on site, should they wish to enjoy an invigorating workout. An ideal destination for business and leisure travellers alike, this hotel offers a prime location, complemented by professional service.

154956.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities, including a 24-hour health club, an outdoor pool, and a steam room. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, a communal living room, and a vending machine. Grab a bite to eat at Casablanca, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a computer station, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Make yourself at home in one of the 125 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Paulista Avenue - 0. 3 km / 0.

154959.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Sao Paulo. All 100 rooms are equipped with minibar, safe and air conditioning.

154961.description: Located in the heart of São Paulo, Hotel Columbia offers convenient access to key attractions. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. The hotel features 99 guestrooms equipped with minibars, LCD TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include rainfall showerheads. Amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. The Municipal Theatre of São Paulo is a short walk away, and Sala São Paulo Concert Hall is within easy reach.

154963.description: The ibis Styles SP Faria Lima hotel is located in Pinheiros, on the avenue that hosts many of the world's largest companies. It is close to the Faria Lima metro station and 6. 2 miles from Congonhas Airport. This budget hotel, perfect for business or leisu re travel, has decor inspired by street art and an amazing mural by artist Eduardo Kobra on its façade. The rooms are comfortable, well equipped and offer free WIFI. Enjoy the delicious breakfast and Peruvian food served in the Q Ceviche! restaurant.

154969.description: The hotel is located in the city centre of Sao Paulo 500 metres from the metro station and Avenida Paulista. Casa das Rosas, the Norte Expo Centre, Palácio dos Bandeirantes and many entertainment and leisure opportunities are all closeby. The hotel is within easy reach of the airport. This air-conditioned, 156-room city hotel features a lobby with 24-hour reception, lift access and a café as well as a restaurant. In addition to conference facilities, the hotel offers wireless Internet access.

154979.description: This Sao Paulo hotel, refurbished in 2016, offers 178 rooms and an ideal resting place. Centrally located, it's within walking distance of major train and bus stations and just minutes from key entertainment areas. The hotel provides easy access to transportation, including the airport. It also offers accessible facilities for handicapped persons. Please note that charges not included in the daily rate require a prior deposit. We adhere to strict cleanliness and hygiene standards to prevent COVID-19 transmission, following all recommended health authority guidelines. Masks are mandatory on the premises. As a precaution, our pools and gym are currently closed.

name.content: Travel Inn Paulista Wall Street Suites

154983.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Sao Paulo. It is close to the Museum of Art Sao Paulo. The Hotel has a coffee shop, an outdoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym.

154984.description: The Pergamon Hotel Frei Caneca is the perfect base for exploring São Paulo. Its comfortable, modern rooms offer excellent amenities, including free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, an in-room safe, and cable TV. Savor authentic Brazilian cuisine at the Veríssimo Restaurant, which also offers vegan options and handcrafted burgers. A multi-brand wine cellar, 11 meeting rooms, and a well-equipped gym are also available for guests. This pet-friendly hotel welcomes one pet per room.

154986.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Sao Paulo. All 76 rooms are equipped with air conditioning.

154987.description: Conveniently situated in Sao Paulo's Brooklin Novo district, one of the city's major financial centres, this city hotel provides a great base for a business trip. Shoppers might spend an afternoon at the nearby Morumbi and Market Place shopping centres or in the heart of Sao Paulo at Paulista Avenue, while art lovers might venture into the city centre to visit the famous MASP museum. The hotel's spacious guest rooms are well-appointed with work space and handy electric kettles. Guests can take advantage of the free high-speed internet access offered throughout the hotel and wake up to a delightful breakfast buffet in the in-house restaurant or indulge in room service. The hotel also offers onsite parking, a business centre and a laundry facility for guests' convenience. Whether travelling to Sao Paulo on business or on holiday, this hotel's convenient location and comfortable rooms make it a great choice. Please note that more than 10 rooms are considered a group, with reservations subject to previous payment or cancellation by the hotel. We emphasize that the contracted daily rate is for 24 hours, with check-in from 2 p. m. and check-out until 12 p. m. The interval of up to 3 hours between guests' departure and arrival is provided for in MTur Ordinance No. 28 and is intended exclusively for cleaning, sanitizing, and tidying up the unit, ensuring the maintenance of our standard of excellence

154988.description: Nestled in the tranquil and upscale Moema neighborhood, Quality Moema offers convenient access to São Paulo's finest shops, entertainment venues, and restaurants. Guests enjoy proximity to Ibirapuera Park and Shopping Ibirapuera, as well as the vibrant Vila Olimpia district. The hotel is also conveniently located near business centers, the Immigrant Exhibition Center, Congonhas Airport, and major thoroughfares such as Avenida Santo Amaro, Avenida Ibirapuera, Avenida 9 de Julho, Marginal Pinheiros, and 23 de Maio. Children up to 7 years old stay free when accompanied by a paying adult (one child per room, cribs and extra beds subject to availability upon check-in).

154991.description: Located in downtown São Paulo, this fully renovated hotel offers a refined experience with diverse facilities. Its 87 apartments, including luxury options, comfortably accommodate 1 to 4 guests. Each room features amenities for a comfortable stay. The hotel is conveniently located near major shopping centers, business districts, and the iconic corner of Ipiranga and São João avenues, home to Bar Brahma. Guests can enjoy on-site meeting rooms, a business center, luggage storage, in-room Wi-Fi, and safes at reception. Additional services include room service, laundry, a restaurant, and valet parking. Apartments boast ceramic tile floors and are available in standard and luxury suites. Luxury suites offer hot tubs and two double beds; some rooms are specially designed for four guests with a separate bathroom and toilet.

154992.description: This 3 star hotel is located within the city of Sao Paulo. The Hotel has a fitness centre/gym. All 96 rooms are equipped with minibar and air conditioning.

name.content: SJ Business San Juan Sao Paulo

154993.description: One of our bestsellers in Sao Paulo! The 3-star San Juan Business São Paulo is located close to the Republic Square, with easy access to convention centers, theaters, cinemas, restaurants, parks, airports, subways and downtown. The Republic subway station is 50 m away. All apartments are equipped with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with cable, minibar and internet access. Room Service is available 24 hours a day. The hotel also offers a restaurant, as well as a bar and games room. A breakfast buffet is included and serves fresh fruit, a variety of breads, cold meats, cereals, scrambled eggs and a selection of hot and cold drinks. São Paulo's famous Paulista Avenua is 4 km away. Within a 2 km walk is the St Benedict Monastery, the Patio do Colégio landmark, Sé Cathedral and the Luz train station. The hotel is 12 km from Congonhas Airport and 26 km from Guarulhos International Airp

154995.description:
Looking for a well-located hotel in São Paulo for both business and leisure? Novotel SP Jardins is perfect for you. 
The rooms are comfortable, featuring spacious beds, air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and options for guests with reduced mobility. Enjoy drinks and cuisine at the hotel bar. Make use of the event rooms for lectures, workshops, coffee breaks, and events. Take advantage of our leisure area with a swimming pool and gym for your self-care moments. 

The location of Novotel SP Jardins is ideal for those who want to fully enjoy São Paulo. 
The hotel is just a 7-minute drive from Avenida Paulista, home to shopping malls, museums, and major events such as New Year’s Eve celebrations and the LGBTQI+ Pride Parade. Visit Ibirapuera Park, one of the city’s main landmarks, perfect for outdoor activities and a pleasant stroll, only 8 minutes away by car. You can also explore Oscar Freire Street for shopping at the most renowned brands, just a 7-minute drive from the hotel. 

Stay at a hotel in Jardins with a strategic location, close to the main attractions of the city, offering comfort and services that will make your stay even more enjoyable. Whether for business or leisure, book your stay at Novotel SP Jardins.

154998.description: Enjoy everything that São Paulo offers when staying at the Staybridge Suites São Paulo. Located in the modern Itaim Bibi district, our hotel is next to some of the best restaurants and bars in São Paulo. Our guests can enjoy the bustling nightlife of Itaim Bibi just steps from the hotel. Secure your accommodation for the next events that will take place in São Paulo, such as concerts by The Weeknd, Bruno Mars and Iron Maiden, Primavera Sound Festival and CCXP 2024 fair. We are surrounded by excellent shopping centers: Brascan Open Mall, an open air shopping mall on João Cachoeira Street, Iguatemi São Paulo Mall and JK Iguatemi Mall. For those looking for more tranquility, we are a short distance from Ibirapuera Park and Do Povo Park. After a day exploring the city, relax in the comfortable accommodations at Staybridge Suites São Paulo, which range from 38 sqm to 80 sqm. Our inviting hotel in Itaim Bibi offers various services and benefits: breakfast included, parking included, an American kitchen in all rooms, an outdoor pool, gym, 24-hour Business Center and free Wi-Fi throughout the entire hotel. Our Família Castro Restaurant serves delicious options for breakfast, lunch and dinner. We are pet friendly! Your dog or cat will be most welcome at Staybridge Suites São Paulo.

154999.description: The Intercity Pamplona – The Universe Paulista offers a modern and comfortable hospitality experience in the heart of São Paulo. Located in one of the city’s most strategic areas, the hotel provides easy access to Avenida Paulista, as well as commercial, cultural, and gastronomic centers. The apartments are spacious, functional, and equipped to ensure practicality and well-being, making them ideal for both leisure and business stays. The hotel also features complete infrastructure, quality service, and amenities designed to make each stay more comfortable and efficient. With a perfect combination of a privileged location and urban comfort, the Intercity Pamplona – The Universe Paulista is the ideal choice for guests seeking practicality, convenience, and an excellent experience in the city of São Paulo.

155003.description: Sitting just across the avenue from the trendy Jardins district, which houses many shops and nightlife options, is this modern hotel. Its location on the edge of the charming district of Higienópolis allows its guests to reach the famous Paulista Avenue, with its museums, theatres and art galleries, within a short walk. Those who don't feel like exploring the area can find a number of bars and restaurants just around the corner, they are also warmly invited to visit the onsite venue which offers excellent traditional and international dishes at a pleasant ambience. After the busy day guests can head to the roof-top swimming pool and relax while enjoying the beautiful views of Sao Paulo skyline or visit the gym for a workout. Afterwards they can top their day with a few restful moments in the sauna before heading to their spacious and beautifully-appointed rooms for much deserved rest. .

155014.description: This 2 star hotel is located in the city centre of Sao Paulo. The Hotel has an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 72 rooms are equipped with minibar and air conditioning.

155031.description: Sheraton São Paulo WTC offers luxury and comfort so you can enjoy the very best the city has to offer. Make your stay unforgettable by choosing from newly renovated classic rooms or by indulging in the luxurious Presidential Suite. The hotel provides services such as in‑room spa treatments, a private walk‑in closet, a helipad, a fitness center, and an outdoor swimming pool with an integrated bar. We are connected to a shopping center featuring restaurants, shops, a pharmacy, a beauty salon, and a supermarket, as well as to the WTC Events Center, forming a complete complex for events and accommodations.

155033.description:
This hotel is located 2 km from Ibirapuera Park, in the upscale Moema neighborhood. The property offers a buffet breakfast and free Wi-Fi. 

The rooms feature air conditioning, cable TV, a minibar, a telephone, and a safe. Rooms with either tiled or wooden floors are available. 

Ibirapuera Shopping Mall is 2 km from Fênix Hotel Moema. The property is 4. 3 km from Congonhas Airport. Parking is available for an additional fee.

155034.description: Located in the charming city centre, this hotel offers guests ease of access to a host of local attractions. Within a short distance of the hotel, guests will find a host of museums, shops, cinemas and tourist attractions. Guests can explore the delights of this region by taking a stroll though the meandering streets, where the local culture is to be uncovered. The hotel is 10 km from Sao Paulo Congonhas airport, and just 15 km from Guarulhos international airport. The hotel presents a traditional architectural design, inviting guests into the comfortable surroundings of the lobby. Guests will be impressed by the spacious bedrooms, which are well equipped with modern furnishings and elegant fabrics.

155184.description: This hotel is located right in the heart of Istanbul's Historical Peninsula and only minutes away from the spectacular Blue Mosque, the mighty Hagia Sophia, the beautiful Basilica Cistern and of course the magnificent and intriguing Topkapi Palace. The hotel is a convenient 10 to 15-minute walk from the major attractions in the area. There are restaurants, cafés and shops in the vicinity. Taksim Square is 4. 5 km away and easily reached by public transportation.

155197.description:
This luxury resort is in a key location, minutes away from Cancun's main attractions and only 15 minutes from the Cancun International Airport. This hotel features a convention centre and outdoor areas for events and social activities. The hotel offers elegantly designed rooms most offering a Caribbean Sea view. A few of the room amenities include Wi-Fi, and daily minibar service. Each room is air-conditioned and comes with room service. Your stay in the beautiful Cancun will be a memorable one. The restaurants offer the tastes of traditional Mexican cuisine. Relax and unwind at the spa offering a wide variety of treatments, facials, and scrubs. Spend the day relaxing on the beach or try your hand at snorkelling. On the other hand, you can just soak in the sun and take a dive into our outdoor pool. Children's programs are available for all ages based on age groups with activities designed to stimulate and educate. 

**Due to the implementation of the CURP (Unique Population Registry Code) registration requested by the Federal Government, implemented as of April 1, 2026, guests will be required to present their valid INE or passport containing the CURP at the time of check-in (Registration Process). In the case of minors without official identification, it is essential to present the valid CURP. CURP registration is mandatory only for reservations of guests who are listed as having Mexican nationality.

155252.description: Located in Manhattan's vibrant Soho district, Soho 54 offers a unique blend of entertainment and convenience. This casino hotel boasts a nightclub, 24-hour fitness center, and gift shops. Guests can enjoy room service and amenities like complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The 160 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen televisions, private balconies, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Soho 54 is within a 15-minute walk of New York University and 5th Avenue, and a short distance from Washington Square Park and Wall Street.

155257.description: A stylish London hotel offering upscale dining, an indoor pool and a spa. Crowne Plaza® London Docklands hotel offers stylish accommodation a six-minute walk from the ExCeL London exhibition centre. London City Airport is a 10-minute cab ride from the hotel. The O2 arena is 15 minutes away by the IFS Cloud Cable Car car over the Thames; Custom House Elizabeth Line station and Royal Victoria DLR station is only five minutes' walk away. From there, trains can whisk you to Canary Wharf in 15 minutes or to Bank station in the City in 25 minutes. You can host conferences for up to 275 people in our eight flexible meeting rooms, with natural light, AV equipment and free Wi-Fi. There's a breakout area for networking, and our Crowne Plaza Meetings Director can manage all the little details. After a busy day, you can swim a few lengths of the indoor pool, work up a sweat in the fully equipped gym or book a beauty treatment in the spa. If you have time, ride the IFS Cloud Cable Car over the river to check out The O2's buzzing bars and restaurants. The airy Docklands Bar &Grill serves breakfast, as well as juicy steaks, burgers and international dishes for lunch and dinner. Enjoy views over the docks from the covered terrace. Relax with a glass of wine or a cocktail in our modern bar, or take it really easy and order from our 24-hour room-service menu.

155259.description: Located just a few minutes' driving distance from Heathrow Airport, this property will appeal to every type of traveller. It offers the ideal accommodation for business guests or for a stopover, as the airport terminals are just 5 minutes from the hotel. Several golf clubs are in the surrounding area, making this property a great choice for those who enjoy a leisurely game on green. Complimentary public buses will transfer guests from Heathrow Central bus station to Blunts Avenue and Sipson Way, and guests can also buy tickets in the ticket machine situated in the lobby to travel between Heathrow Airport and the hotel. The guest rooms offer comfort and convenience, including triple-glazed windows to guarantee a restful night sleep. This establishment features a stylish restaurant as well as a mini gym, ideal to enjoy an invigorating workout after a busy day of work. There is also a parking monitored for guests’ convenience. The excellent facilities guarantee that the needs of every type of traveller are fully catered for.

155309.description: Only 4 km away from Vienna Airport, this guesthouse enjoys a quiet location away from the flight corridors. Guests at this airport Hotel can use all facilities at the nearby partner hotel just 250 metres away. These include a restaurant, a sauna, and a fitness room. The reception is also located there. It offers free Wi-Fi in public areas and a 24-hour bar. Free parking is available on site. The rooms feature wooden floors, a flat-screen satellite TV, a work desk, and a bathroom with hairdryer. A free bottle of water is provided on arrival. The breakfast buffet is served in the on-site café. Early breakfast is available on request.

155310.description: Excellently positioned to explore London, this hotel is located in the heart of Kensington. This Mid-Victorian building is typical of the area’s white Italianate façades with stately doric columns. Numerous restaurants, bars and small coffee shops are close-by, famous attractions such as Royal Albert Hall, Buckingham Palace, Natural History Museum, the West End Theatres or Stamford Bridge, home of Chelsea FC are within easy reach. Kensington High Street, Hyde Park, Knightsbridge and Harrods are within walking distance. The breakfasts are freshly prepared and served daily in the elegant dining room. Guests can relax at the elegant lounge, with the cosy fireplace. The cosy rooms have fresh, modern décor, a tv, tea and coffee making facilities and a private bathroom with toiletries.

155397.description: This boutique city hotel boasts a prime setting on the grounds of Alanya Castle. The hotel commands spectacular views of the town of Alanya and the shimmering waters of the Mediterranean Sea. Guests will find themselves within easy walking distance from the town centre and a pretty beach, while local transport links lie just a few metres away from the hotel, offering ease of access to other areas to be explored. An abundance of restaurants, bars and shops, as well as exciting entertainment options, lie in the town centre, while captivating attractions, such as the Damlatas Caves lie just over 1 km away. This romantic hotel occupies a former 19th century castle mansion, and hosts 11 individually decorated guest rooms. The rooms are sumptuously decorated, and feature countless windows which drench the surroundings in natural light for a soothing ambience.

name.content: Hôtel Le Walt by Inwood Hotels

155558.description: Le Walt Hotel is located in the heart of the 7th district of Paris, a short walk to Champ de Mars, Esplanade des Invalides and the Eiffel Tower. Inspired by art and museums, this hotel will take you through the greatest classical paintings of the last century. A four-star boutique hotel celebrating the art of painting, Le Walt is sure to surprise you.

155566.description: The Sanctuary Hotel is an award-winning boutique hotel strategically located in New York City's famous Time Square and Theater District. The hotel is an oasis of elegance and luxury and boasts 4 restaurants including a private dining room and a rooftop restaurant. Shopping, nightlife, Broadway shows and famous museums are all just a heartbeat away.

155594.description: Enjoying a peaceful setting on a quiet street in Osmanbey, this attractive boutique hotel is situated in the well-known district of Sisli. Guests can find a selection of shopping and leisure venues just a short stroll away, while the elegant neighbourhood of Nisantasi is a mere 400 metres from the hotel, where guests can find a myriad of exclusive boutiques, a modern shopping centre, cinemas and restaurants, as well as exciting nightlife options. Public transport links are within a short walking distance away, offering ease of access to other areas of the city. This modern hotel enjoys an attractive architectural style, welcoming guests with warm hospitality and exceptional service. The guest rooms are superbly decorated and come complete with modern amenities for visitors' convenience. Guests will appreciate the abundance of excellent facilities and services the hotel affords them.

155687.description: This centrally located riad, a short walk from Djemma el Fna, offers a tranquil escape for first-time visitors, families, couples, and groups. Admire the owner's stunning contemporary art collection in this cool, peaceful haven. The souks, Djemma el Fna, and Marrakech's attractions are easily accessible. The Scottish owners and friendly multilingual staff (English, French, Arabic) provide attentive service, assisting with restaurant reservations, excursions, taxis, and car hire. Airport transfers and in-house dinners are available for an additional fee. Relax in the light-filled courtyard adorned with plants and comfortable seating, or enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi. A stylish dining area offers homemade Moroccan breakfasts and delicious Moroccan dinners. Each bedroom features striking vintage kaftans, soft Berber rugs, individual climate control, and ample storage. The Douiria Suite boasts a wood-burning fireplace. All en suite bathrooms, finished in sleek beige and white, include a shower, basin, separate WC, and complimentary toiletries. The rooftop terrace provides a unique Medina experience, complete with birdsong, dining and lounging areas, sun loungers, and a Berber tent offering a cool retreat on sunny days.

155691.description: Find us 10 kilometers from Milan Malpensa Airport and 50 kilometers from the center of Milan. Castello Visconti di San Vito is a few minutes’ drive away, and Volandia Park and Flight Museum is just eight kilometers from us. Lake Maggiore is an hour’s drive. We offer a 24-hour fitness center, spacious meeting rooms and a restaurant with outdoor space.

155694.description: Located in Mozzate, 20 km from the New Entertainment fairgrounds of Rho – Pero, this establishment provides a good start for those who would like to explore the surroundings and experience the local culture. The city centre is only 3 km from the hotel and the nearest train station, Ferrovie Nord, is just 400 m away. With a friendly staff, willing to assist at all times, and a number of in-house facilities, this hotel provides cosy ambience and comfortable accommodation. Completely soundproofed, it offers a refined environment with a classic style together with modern and functional comforts that are able to satisfy any type of requirement.

155699.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including a 24-hour health club and bicycles to rent. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby. Satisfy your appetite for dinner at Grace Restaurant, a restaurant which specializes in international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. This hotel has 4 meeting rooms available for events. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 141 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring heated floors and flat-screen televisions.

155702.description: The property is located in a residential neighbourhood just 10 minutes north of the main square, ideally situated for exploring the ancient medina. Tucked away at the end of a peaceful lane, crossing the threshold is like entering another world- of peace and serenity. It's within easy walking distance of many of the main attractions, and there are also excellent restaurants within 5 min walk. This gorgeous boutique hotel in the Marrakech medina is a mixture of ancient Morocco architecture and ambiance, Black Africa and modern European style and comfort. It offers 4 double en-suite bedrooms, spacious sun terrace, cosy salons, fireplaces and Wi-Fi. All rooms have air-conditioning/heating and digital safe. The Hotel features a sun terrace with sun beds and parasols, with outdoor shower for cooling off. On the courtyard level there is also a dipping pool.

155707.description: Luxury 5 star boutique hotel with Restaurant and Spa in beautiful lush valley walking from centre town- Hidden jewel of SwellendamThe estate is ideally situated in a lush green, secluded, quiet and safe area, within walking distance of the historical part of Swellendam town. Local transport links can be found around a 5-minute walk away, and the centre is just some 100 m away. Guests can visit the beach at Arniston, located about a 45-minute drive from the hotel. Cape Town International Airport and George Airport can be found around 220 km from the hotel and Port Elizabeth International Airport is situated some 500 km awayBuilt in 1801, this boutique hotel is the hidden jewel of Swellendam, where history meets contemporary trends. For lovers of interior design, honeymooners, golfers and people who enjoy the finer things in life, it offers the ideal retreat of choice. With its secure parking, wonderful and breath-taking mountain views, lovely gardens and birdlife it really is a little piece of paradise. The hotel is air-conditioned and comprises a lobby with a hotel safe, cloakroom and newspaper stand. Younger guests can have fun in the children's playground, whilst older visitors may enjoy a drink at the hotel bar. Fine food is served at the restaurant and conference facilities are provided. Guests can stay connected thanks to the wireless Internet access available at the hotel. Room and laundry services are also provided, and there is a garage where guests can leave their vehicles. A bicycle hire service is provided for those looking to explore the surrounding area on two wheels.

155726.description: The Wyndham Garden Cancun Downtown, located in the heart of downtown Cancun, offers convenient access to world-class entertainment, dining, and the Caribbean Sea's beautiful beaches. Ideal for business or leisure travelers, our hotel is steps from Malecon Americas shopping mall, as well as banks, restaurants, and other essential services. Nearby activities include water sports, exploring archaeological ruins, and golfing. Our guest rooms feature pillowtop mattresses, microwaves, refrigerators, coffee makers, hairdryers, irons, in-room safes, 32' LCD TVs with premium channels, alarm clock radios, and free high-speed internet access. Enjoy our complimentary breakfast, free Wi-Fi in public areas, a 24-hour business center, a fitness center, an outdoor pool, room service, and our on-site Mexican restaurant. Unwind with your favorite drink at our lobby bar after a busy day. The Wyndham Garden Cancun Downtown team is dedicated to providing excellent service, warm hospitality, and personalized attention to every guest.

155731.description: Located in the heart of the city, just steps from Santa Fe Avenue's shops, the metro, Florida Street, and San Martin Square, this hotel is an urban oasis near major downtown attractions. Restaurants, bars, and shops are within easy reach. The hotel offers a restaurant, bar, café, and Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour reception, hotel safe, lift access, room and laundry services, and bicycle hire. Superior and Deluxe rooms feature king-sized or twin beds, LCD TVs with cable, DVD players, iPod docks, Wi-Fi, laptop safes, Nespresso machines, minibars, and air conditioning. Bathrooms include double hot tubs, showers, and hairdryers. A wellness boutique with select products is available (for a fee). Deluxe rooms also boast individual dry saunas, Scottish showers, and small balconies overlooking Suipacha Street.

155781.address: Sehit Recep Koc Cad Isa Celebi Sk, 8
155781.description: With a small number of only 14, this establishment is very convenient for a quiet stay. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception.

155786.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at the Aristocrat Hotel, conveniently located in Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, a short walk from the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (available for a fee) at the on-site cafe. The hotel offers 17 guestrooms equipped with minibars, LCD TVs, and digital programming. Partially open bathrooms feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge applies). The Grand Bazaar is just 1 km away.

155787.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center, a terrace, and a garden. This hotel also offers complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Dine at Bellis Restaurant, savoring delicious meals and drinks at the bar/lounge with garden views, or enjoy alfresco dining. 24-hour room service is also available. Full breakfasts are offered daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Event facilities consist of a conference center and a meeting room. A cruise ship terminal shuttle is available (surcharge). The 31 individually decorated guestrooms feature minibars, LCD televisions, down comforters, Egyptian cotton sheets, complimentary wireless internet access, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include designer toiletries and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Cemberlitas Bath (0. 2 mi), Sokollu Mehmet Pasha Mosque (0. 2 mi), the Turkish and Islamic Art Museum (0. 2 mi), Sultanahmet Square (0. 2 mi), and Little Hagia Sophia (0. 4 mi). Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) is 27. 4 mi away, and Istanbul Airport (IST) is 29. 5 mi away. The preferred airport is Istanbul Airport (IST).

155845.description: Decorated in a classical style, this charming hotel is located in the city centre of Aksaray, close to cultural and historical points of interest such as Topkapi Palace, St Sophia Museum and the Blue Mosque. Shopping and entertainment venues are also to be found in the immediate vicinity. Ataturk International Airport is just 16 kilometres from this hotel. This establishment features a wide choice of comfortable rooms offering satellite TV, minibar and air-conditioning, among others. With an a la carte restaurant situated on the top floor, guests will appreciate the panoramic views over the city. This is the perfect place to discover Turkish hospitality.

name.content: Hyatt Place Long Island East End

155847.description: Overlooking the on-site full-service marina, the excellent hotel Hyatt Place East End enjoys a wonderful location on the Peconic River in Downtown Riverhead. It is adjacent to the Long Island Aquarium & Exhibition Center, and other attractions such as Long Island Science Center or Vail-Leavitt Music Hall are only steps away. Long Island Wine Country and the famous beaches of the Hamptons can be reached within a short drive. The hotel offers spacious guest rooms decorated in a stylish, contemporary design. Thoughtful services and amenities include complimentary WIFI, 42” HDTV and plush bedding. Business guests will appreciate the business centre and the meeting facilities. The hotel offers an indoor and an outdoor pool as well as a state-of-the-art, 24-hour fitness centre. Every morning, the hotel serves a complimentary hot breakfast, and the Gallery Menu is available 24/7. A perfect place both for business and leisure guests.

155849.description: Somnio Hostels guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 10 accomodation units. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the car park. Somnio Hostels follows environmentally sustainable practices. Additional fees may apply for some services.

155876.description: The hotel is located at 5 five minutes from the metro, located in the south of Paris just 10 minutes from the exhibition centre Porte de Versailles and 100 m from the Porte d'Orleans station. The Eiffel Tower and the Champs Elysees are both about a 15-minute drive away. Facilities include a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, lift access, free Wi-Fi, and a hairdressing salon. Guests can dine in the on-site restaurant. The breakfast buffet is served both in the restaurant and in the room.

155929.description: The hotel enjoys a convenient location in one of Madrid's business areas at the end of Paseo de la Castellana street. Guests will find a metro station around 1 km away and Madrid-Barajas airport about 13 kilometres from this outstanding establishment. This air-conditioned business hotel comprises 121 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as a hotel safe and currency exchange. Further amenities include a newspaper stand and TV lounge for guests' convenience. The hotel provides luxurious, elegantly-styled guest rooms which feature a delightful blend of soft and warm tones to create a relaxing atmosphere in which to completely unwind. Additional features include a fully-equipped fitness centre.

155933.description: Situated conveniently between Paris, Disneyland, and Versailles, this hotel offers easy access to Orly Airport with a regular free shuttle service. Guests can enjoy a relaxing stay with amenities including a business center, restaurant, bar, and room service. Renovated in 2019, the hotel offers 96 guest rooms, each equipped with an en suite bathroom (shower, bath, and hairdryer), double or king-size bed, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, and internet access. A continental buffet breakfast is served daily. The hotel also provides a 24-hour reception and check-out service, lift access, and conference facilities. Shuttle service operates between set hours (6:45 AM - 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM - 10:30 PM) with reservations made upon arrival, limited to two trips per booking. Contact the hotel (+331 49 84 91 40) after luggage collection for shuttle pickup. Pickup points: Terminal 1/2/3 - Exit Gate 18A, Stop D1; Terminal 4 - Exit Gate 47D, Stop 6. The shuttle costs €5 per trip/room during operating hours and €15 outside these hours or for non-guests/parking users.

155956.description: Located just 7 minutes from Pointe du Lac station on Metro line 8, providing easy access to central Paris attractions like Grands Boulevards, Bastille, Invalides, and Opéra. The Hotel Paris Créteil offers modern comforts including air-conditioned rooms and accessible accommodations. The on-site restaurant seats 120 and serves traditional French cuisine with a fresh buffet. This 3-star hotel is conveniently located in Créteil's Europarc, near the A4 and A86 motorways, offering easy access to destinations like Bercy and Disneyland Paris. For those traveling by public transport, take Metro line 8 to Pointe du Lac station. Enjoy 24/7 service at our hotel bar.

155963.description: Located in the most sophisticated and prestigious area in Buenos Aires, Recoleta, a district chosen by the most exclusive brands in the world, with plenty of art galleries, restaurants, museums and exhibition centres, just steps from Avenida Alvear. The hotel has 24 hour reception, internet access, security, luggage storage and medical service. This is a smoke free hotel.

155972.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 40 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions.

155986.description: 'Enjoy a stylish stay at this Art Deco hotel, conveniently located in Birmingham's vibrant shopping district near Hurst Street. Indulge in British cuisine at Collage, the hotel's restaurant and bar, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Amenities include a fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a 24-hour business center. Each of the 211 air-conditioned rooms features a flat-screen TV with satellite programming, a private bathroom, and a laptop-compatible safe. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel is conveniently located near several local attractions including the Alexandra Theatre and the Birmingham Hippodrome. Birmingham Airport (BHX) is the closest airport. '

155994.description: Barcelona Apartment Republica is located 150 meters from Llacuna Metro Station, just a 15-minute walk from the beach and Poble Nou park. This modern loft-style apartment features exposed brick walls and offers access to a rooftop pool and terrace with magnificent city views. The air-conditioned apartments include a kitchen equipped with a microwave, hob, refrigerator, and dishwasher. A washing machine, linen, and towels are also provided. A concierge service can arrange activities such as tours and water sports. Guests enjoy free entry to the Barcelona Egyptian Museum. Glories Shopping Mall is a 10-minute walk away. Stays of six nights or more include a general cleaning service, with the kitchen to be left tidy on the final day. A maximum of two apartments can be booked at a time; three or more are considered a group booking with a different cancellation policy. A €350 security deposit is required upon arrival. Registration and key collection are available from 10:30 a. m. to 6:30 p. m. and 11:00 p. m. to 7:00 a. m. at Pujades 120, the same building as Republica Apartments. For arrivals outside these hours, check-in is available at our main building on Muntaner 60 from 10:00 a. m. to 1:00 a. m. Apartment check-in time is 3:00 p. m.

155995.description: Centrally located in Paris, the upscale Hotel Elysée Secret is steps from Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré and a short walk from the Champs-Élysées. This hotel offers 26 air-conditioned rooms equipped with iPod docking stations, minibars, and flat-screen TVs with satellite programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi and private bathrooms with bathtubs, toiletries, and hair dryers are also provided. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast for a fee and utilize amenities such as a 24-hour business center and concierge services. Airport and train station shuttle services are available for a surcharge.

156029.description: This design hotel is located in Paris' 15th district, just 300 m from Charles Michels metro station. From there quests will have access to the metro line number 10, which passes through the Latin Quarter, home of the Sorbonne and a centre of student life, lively atmosphere and bistros. It also goes to Saint-Germain-des-Prés, where famous cafés, such as Les Deux Magots and Café de Flore, once gathered the main figures of the existentialist movement. For more traditional sightseeing guests can take the 20-minute stroll to the Eiffel Tower or visit the boutique shops at Champs Elysees, which is about 3 km away. The venue itself is the perfect place where they can relax at the end of the day. They can visit the spa centre for a treatment or a soothing massage and unwind in the sauna. For a strong coffee or a glass of fine wine they can check the chic bar and the cafe.

156032.description: This charming hotel complex enjoys a delightful setting in Venice, lying just 200 metres from La Fenice Theatre. The Vaporetto stop for Venice Santa Lucia train station is located just 500 metres away. The complex affords guests the ideal location from which to explore the rich culture and history of this captivating city. San Marco Square and its elegance cafes are located just a short distance away. This hotel occupies an elegant 16th-century building, set overlooking the canal. Revelling in its culturally-rich setting, the hotel beautifully embraces the essence of Venetian style and grace. The classically-styled guest rooms exude an air of character and poise. Featuring a range of exemplary facilities and services, this hotel delivers the utmost in comfort and convenience, complemented by impeccable service and warm hospitality.

156060.description: Located in Vienna’s Neustift am Walde region, Hotel Landhaus Fuhrgassl-Huber is surrounded by wine taverns, hills and greenery. The property has a terrace, sauna, infrared cabin, relaxation area, and wine sampling is possible at the property’s wine-growing estate. Rooms at the Fuhrgassl-Huber have a mini-bar, free pay TV and free WiFi. Some rooms have a balcony or terrace. A breakfast buffet is served each morning and can be enjoyed in the courtyard during summer. The hotel bar offers home-made desserts, coffee and warm snacks. A business corner with a computer, internet and printer is available to all guests of Landhaus Fuhrgassl-Huber. The Viennese Woods, and the Kahlenberg and Leopoldsberg mountains can be walked to from the hotel. Downtown Vienna and the Creditanstalt Clubhaus Wien Golfclub are within 5 mi, and Vienna Airport is 16 mi away. The 35A bus is within a 5-minute walk and goes at 10-minute intervals.

156061.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, babysitting (surcharge), and tour/ticket assistance. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 30 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private furnished balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

156063.description: The 5-star Ramada Navi Mumbai Hotel offers comfort and convenience whether you're on business or holiday in Mumbai. The property features a wide range of facilities to make your stay a pleasant experience. 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, facilities for disabled guests are there for guest's enjoyment. All rooms are designed and decorated to make guests feel right at home, and some rooms come with television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless, non smoking rooms, air conditioning, wake-up service. Enjoy the hotel's recreational facilities, including hot tub, fitness center, outdoor pool, before retiring to your room for a well-deserved rest. Ramada Navi Mumbai Hotel combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make your stay in Mumbai unforgettable.

156074.description: The 20 welcoming units offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day.

156075.description: Located on 60, 000 m2 of unique architecture and delightful gardens at 40 km from Antalya Airport and 9 km from the historic town of Side, this hotel combines opulence and modern facilities to offer perfect holidays. Features of the hotel include 579 rooms, 24-hours reception, currency exchange, free WIFI in the lobby, meeting rooms, business services, restaurants, bars, fitness centre, spa and wellness, sports facilities, 2 outdoor pools, indoor pool, children's pool, playground and laundry service.

156081.description: This friendly hotel is located in the popular holiday region of Çolakli on the Turkish Riviera. The historic town of Side is 9 km away, Manavgat 12 km. The private sandy beach is 600 m from the hotel, there is a free shuttle transfer. Antalya International Airport is 55 km away. The hotel features 90 rooms, lobby with reception, WIFI, TV room, restaurant, bars, wellness, outdoor pool and children's pool.

156086.description: Only 5 minutes from the centre of the bustling city of Alanya on the popular Turkish Riviera, this hotel on 12, 000 m2 with two buildings offers everything to make a holiday unforgettable. Crystal clear waters and sandy beaches are combined with the cultural highlights of the area. The hotel features 312 rooms, 24-hours reception, currency exchange, meeting rooms, business services, free internet access, 2 restaurants, 3 bars, TV room, outdoor and indoor pool, children's pool, aquapark, mini cinema, fitness centre, spa, wellness and medical services.

156088.description: This hotel is located in the popular holiday region of Alanya-Konakli, directly above the sea and on a private broad sand and pebble beach with private pier. The town centre of Konakli with its shops, bars and more than 100 restaurants is easily reachable. The family-run hotel offers 120 rooms, 24-hours reception, pool, children's pool, indoor and outdoor restaurant, bars, mini-market, fitness centre, spa area and free WIFI in public areas.

156092.description: Located in the Bellavista neighbourhood, the hotel is at the heart of the art scene, entertainment, restaurants and the bohemian side of life in the city of Santiago. Close to the metro station, and 5 minutes from the city centre, it offers easy access to shopping centres. This hotel offers fully equipped suites. Within the hotel there is a lobby with a 24-hour reception, and it features wireless Internet access. Laundry and medical services are available, for a fee. Other services include a hotel safe, lift access, garage and large terrace. The hotel is wheelchair accessible.

156093.description: Enjoy the convenience of ski-in/ski-out access at this hotel, which also features a 24-hour health club and an outdoor pool. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy Japanese cuisine at Karai, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

156094.description: Located in Bogotá's Usaquén district, Hotel Santa Barbara Real is within a 15-minute walk of the Usaquén Flea Market and Hacienda Santa Barbara Mall. This hotel is conveniently located near Unicentro Bogotá (1 mi) and Palatino Mall (1. 2 mi). Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a shared television area. A shuttle service is available for shopping trips (surcharge). The 48 guestrooms feature refrigerators, LCD televisions, Select Comfort beds with down comforters and premium bedding, cable programming, and private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Dine at PIÚ DI PASTA, specializing in Italian cuisine, or enjoy the coffee shop/cafe and room service. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 6:30 AM to 10 AM. Mingle with other guests at the daily complimentary reception, or relax at the bar/lounge. The hotel also offers a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services.
