Roundtrip airport shuttle (24 hours) and a bus station shuttle are available for a surcharge.

156095.description: Hotel Peninsular, a historic building converted from an old monastery, offers guests a unique experience in the heart of Barcelona. This family-run hotel features a stunning ancient patio garden and other preserved architectural details. The modestly-sized rooms have simple furnishings, tiled floors, and small bathrooms. A charming cafeteria on the ground floor serves a continental breakfast each morning. Hotel Peninsular is an ideal choice for budget-conscious travelers.

156119.description: Mercure Birmingham West Hotel is conveniently situated just five miles from Birmingham city centre, and is close to the M5 and other major transport links, making it easy to access wherever you're coming from. With 168 bright, spacious, and comfortable rooms available and Wi-Fi included throughout, the hotel is perfect for those visiting Birmingham on business or leisure. Guests are welcome to make use of our onsite leisure facilities, which include a heated pool, spa, steam room and multi gyms.

156238.description: This unpretentious Hotel can be found in Dubai. A total of 60 accommodation units are available for guests' convenience at President Hotel Dubai. The reception desk is open all day long. This Hotel does not except pets.

156248.description: The Bloc Hotel, nestled in Birmingham's vibrant Jewellery Quarter, offers a unique village atmosphere surrounded by cafes, bars, restaurants, and convenient access to business, shopping, arts, and sports facilities. Inspired by Japanese pod hotels, our rooms are more akin to luxury yacht cabins, boasting king-size beds with luxurious linens, climate control, en-suite wet rooms with monsoon showers, 32-inch Samsung LED flat-screen TVs, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Birmingham's central location and excellent transport links provide quick and easy access to the motorway network, national rail, and international flights.

156249.address: Royal Victoria Dock, One Eastern Gateway
156249.description: Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a banquet hall, and bike parking. Enjoy a satisfying meal at Docksider Restaurant serving guests of Aloft London Excel. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 252 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is available. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

156266.address: Haunch Lane, Lea Marston, Sutton Coldfield
156266.description: Lea Marston Hotel is a delightful modern 4-star hotel set in 52 acres of countryside near Sutton Coldfield. Lea Marston Hotel offers 88 stylish, well appointed bedrooms with a contemporary style. All rooms feature en-suite bathrooms with luxury toiletries, free Wi-Fi access and plasma screen televisions. Excellent leisure facilities include a health club featuring indoor pool, whirlpool, sauna, steam room and gymnasium, plus a luxury spa with a rasul, hydrotherapy bath, relaxation area and spa treatment rooms offering indulgent spa treatments using leading beauty product Elemis. Complete with two 9-hole golf course onsite and a floodlit driving range this is the perfect place to relax and unwind. Lea Marston a great base to explore the local area and the many local places of interest including Drayton Manor Theme Park, the Bullring Shopping Centre in Birmingham city centre, Tamworth Castle, SnowDome, Warwick and Stratford. Lea Marston Hotel is a member of Classic British Hotels.

156267.description: This modern boutique hotel is conveniently located beside the Opera underground station, not far from the heart of the city and very close to the major railway stations, Gare de l'Est and Gare du Nord, both within walking distance. The Opéra House Galeries and Lafayette are just 800 metres away and Sacre Coeur is roughly 2. 8 km away. If guests are looking for a charming hotel with character and baroque atmosphere, this is the hotel.

name.content: Marriott Marquis City Center Doha Hotel

156272.address: Omar Al Mukhtar Street Area 61 Aldafna, str #850
156272.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a 24-hour health club, an outdoor pool, and a spa tub. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. If you'd like to spend the day shopping, you can hop on the complimentary shuttle. Enjoy Brazilian cuisine at Ipanema, one of the hotel's 6 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 3 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Doha? This hotel has 17997 square feet (1672 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms.

156292.address: Mosteiro De Tibeas R Do Mosteiro
156292.description: Set in the Monastery of St. Martin of Tibaes, this attractive hotel is 10 km away from Braga. This establishment offer guests air-conditioned rooms that have modern décor and wooden floors. They also come en suite and with flat-screen satellite TVs, amongst other modern amenities. Guests can enjoy a drink in the plush lounge area or stroll through the colourful courtyard garden. The friendly staff can also arrange car rental and a guided tour of the monastery for guests.

156346.description: Asteria Bloom Side is the perfect holiday destination for young families, couples and groups of friends looking for vitality and excitement. Our hotel is characterised by its exceptional comfort and warm hospitality. Asteria Bloom Side invites you to relax on a sunbed during the day and enjoy live entertainment and themed parties in the evenings. With its compact yet lively atmosphere, Asteria Bloom Side offers a dynamic holiday experience where fun and relaxation go hand in hand. Get ready to enrich your holiday with unforgettable moments!

156376.description: The hotel is located in the lively neighbourhood of the Grands Boulevards, next to theatres and the Grand Rex cinema. There are links to the public transport system and a bus station just 5 minutes' walk from the hotel, while the nearest train station is 1 km away. This air-conditioned city hotel offers an Art Deco-style bar, a dining room and meeting rooms with conference facilities. Wireless Internet access is available throughout the entire hotel and is free of charge. Guests are welcomed to in a lobby with a 24-hour reception, currency exchange facilities and lift access to the upper floors. There is also a TV lounge and a laundry service is provided. Each room features an en suite bathroom, a double bed and a satellite TV. Other in-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, a safe and a fridge.

156377.description: This hotel is located in the Montparnasse district of Paris. There are many shops and the Latin Quarter just 500m away. This city hotel provides contemporary and comfortable accommodation enclosing a central courtyard and garden. It offers a spacious lobby with 24-hour reception, a restaurant and 2 lifts. Further amenities at the air-conditioned conference hotel include a safe for valuables, currency exchange facilities and TV lounge, as well as cafe and a bar. Guests may also make use of the conference facilities, Internet access and a laundry service. Each room features an en suite bathroom with a shower, bathtub and hairdryer, as well as a double bed, Internet access and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. Other in-room amenities include a satellite TV, fridge and ironing set. A continental buffet breakfast is served each morning.

156384.description:
Located in Edinburgh's vibrant Cowgate, STAY Central offers more than just a good night's sleep. A short walk from major attractions, this hotel features 37 refurbished rooms, accommodating from two to six guests. Each room includes complimentary Wi-Fi, large flat-screen TVs, and rainfall showers, along with unexpected extras. Perfect for adult travelers (guests must be 12 or older), STAY Central offers a range of room types, from cozy doubles to spacious dorm-style accommodations equipped with modern amenities for a memorable stay in the heart of Edinburgh's bustling city center. 

Please be aware: downstairs bar atmosphere can be lively at night

156391.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a health club, outdoor pool, and sauna. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. Dine at Skye & Walker Cafe, specializing in international cuisine, or grab a bite at the coffee shop/cafe. Room service is available during limited hours. Full breakfasts are offered daily for a fee. Business amenities include complimentary wired internet, a business center, and express check-in. Host your Dubai event in the hotel's 840 sq ft (78 sq m) of conference and meeting space. Free self-parking is available. Each of the 172 individually decorated guest rooms features a kitchen with a refrigerator and stovetop, complimentary wired and wireless internet, and a flat-screen TV with satellite programming. A phone, safe, and desk are also provided. The hotel is located near Deira Clocktower (0. 2 mi), Creek Park (0. 8 mi) and City Centre Deira (0. 9 mi). Dubai Intl. Airport (DXB) is 2. 9 mi away.

156508.description: A 10-minute’s drive from Sa Carneiro Airport, Porto Mar is located in the suburbs of Porto, near the beaches and the surf school. Brito Capelo Metro Stop is only 328 feet away with links to the city center. Air-conditioned rooms at Hotel Porto Mar are fitted with modern furnishings and cable TV channels. They all include private bathrooms with hairdryer, and some have a spacious seating area with sofa. The on-site bike rental allows reaching the popular Leça Marina and a series of beaches on the Atlantic Ocean. Set in the lively Matosinhos District, featuring many shops, restaurants and clubs, Porto Mar hotel is also a 10-minute drive from Exponor Fair Grounds.

156518.address: Behind AlNashwan Buldg - 24.c St, Bur Dubai
156518.description: This hotel is strategically located in the heart of metropolitan Dubai, very close to the Dubai museum, BurJuman Shopping Centre, World Trade Centre and Exhibition Halls, and international restaurants. All apartments have high speed wireless internet, cable TV and electronic safes. Additional amenities include 24-hour housekeeping, security, concierge, valet and laundry services. The Lobby Coffee Shop is ideal for informal meeting or to unwind after a hard day shopping. *

156556.description: Featuring a strategic situation in the heart of Dubai’s marina, this luxurious hotel perfectly reflects the culture and charm of the city. Guests staying at this property will enjoy contemporary luxury in an unrivalled situation, just a few steps from the popular JBR and just a 30-minute driving distance from the airport. The tastefully decorated guest rooms feature magnificent city views and come completely equipped to guarantee guests have a truly home away from home. The onsite dining options range from a charming coffee shop to a captivating shisha terrace with beautiful views over Dubai Marina. The hotel also includes a rooftop pool as well as a wellness and spa area offering a wide range of massages and natural therapies to rejuvenate body, mind and soul.

156562.description: Close to everything, yet in a tranquil position, the boutique hotel Jetwing Ayurveda Pavillion is wonderfully located in the fishing port of Negombo on the West coast of Sri Lanka, only a few steps away from the beautiful golden sandy beach. The city centre of Negombo can be easily reached. Bandaranaike International Airport is about 12 km away, while the capital city of Colombo is at a distance of about 38 km. The luxurious Jetwing Ayurveda Pavillion is an oasis of peace offering beautifully appointed pavilions; each of the pavilions also has a walled-in garden, so that guests can enjoy absolute privacy. The wellness hotel offers holistic Ayurveda Nivasa treatments, perfect to rejuvenate and regain the balance of body, mind and soul. In addition, there are a swimming pool, yoga classes, restaurant and bar. This intimate hotel is a true haven of peace and tranquillity for guests seeking total relaxation.

156563.description: There are a total of 48 rooms at Apartments. Apartments offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Those who stay at this establishment will appreciate the 24-hour reception.

156564.description:
Our hotel is nestled in Aslanbucak, just 2. 5 km north of the lively resort town of Kemer with its many shops, cafés, and attractions. The beach is only 3 km away, and public transport is conveniently close by. For those arriving by air, Antalya Airport is 60 km from the hotel. 

We offer a range of facilities to make your stay comfortable, including a bar, restaurant, TV lounge, and complimentary WiFi throughout the property. Guests can also enjoy convenient services such as parking and bike hire. 

Each room features an en-suite bathroom, WiFi access, a double bed, and individually controlled air conditioning and heating for your comfort. 

Step outside and relax by our outdoor pool, complete with loungers and parasols along the water’s edge. For deeper relaxation, unwind in our sauna, steam room, hot tub, or tanning studio. 

Start your day with a delicious buffet breakfast. For lunch, choose from an à la carte menu or set options, and in the evening enjoy a variety of dishes served either à la carte or as a buffet.

156569.description: Housed in a modern structure, the NH Barcelona Diagonal Poblenou hotel sits at the center of Barcelona's 22@ technology district. The local beaches are only a 10-minute walk away and the city center with attractions like the Sagrada Familia and Las Ramblas can be reached via metro line 1 from the Marina stop. The 129 guest rooms come complete with contemporary comforts such as free Wi-Fi, flat screen TVs, minibars, desk, and parquet floors. Our superior room types feature separate seating areas. A delicious breakfast buffet is freshly prepared for our guests each morning and made-to-order hot dishes and an early bird breakfast are also provided upon request. Our welcoming staff will provide recommendations for well-regarded local restaurants and our Open Bar offers you refreshing drinks and delicious snacks. There's also a compact gym onsite. NH Barcelona Diagonal Poblenou has 5 meeting rooms which seat a maximum of 100 people. We are pleased to host events both large and small, and with advanced notice our special events services will assist in event organization as well as menu planning. Additional event amenities include audiovisual equipment rental or an EV (electric vehicle) charging station onsite. Our professional 24-hour front desk is on hand to meet further guest requests.

156575.description: CIN CODE: IT027042A169E44Y7K This historical city hotel is housed in a building dating to the 1600s and is the ideal starting point from which one can explore Venice and delve into its most celebrated monuments. Sitting at just 100 m from St. Mark's Square and the Doge's Palace means that its guests will be in the heart of the city and a short walk from its most famous and picture-worthy landmarks. The property comprises a total of 16 rooms and ensures guests every modern comfort while maintaining a customary level of care and attention. It can offer them a variety of different arrangements from romantic rooms facing the lagoon with their original antique furniture to the more discreet and practical comfort of the rooms facing San Zaccaria Church. For an authentic Italian meal guests should just visit the outstanding onsite restaurant, which serves not only tasty dishes but also excellent wines.

156599.description: Built in a mansion with Ottoman architecture, this hotel offers a central location at the heart of the old city, Sultanahmet. Mari Time Hotel features stylish rooms with air-conditioning and free WiFi. The rooms of Mari Time Hotel combines modern design with 1970s classical decorations. They all have wooden floor, mini-bar and flat-screen TV with satellite channels. There is also a complimentary coffee/tea setup in the rooms, which is refilled daily Mari Time offers a rich menu of traditional Turkish breakfast including pastries, cereals, fresh eggs and dairy products from villages. Guests can benefit from the computer at the lobby. The staff, available 24 hours a day, arranges car rentals, airport shuttle services and offers information about local attractions. Blue Mosque is only 984 feet from Mari Time Hotel. Topkapi Palace, Haghia Sophia and Basilica Cistern are within 10 minutes’ walking distance. Ataturk Airport is within 12 mi of the property, and Sabiha Gokcen Airport is 30 mi away.

156600.description: Side Zeugma Adult Only +16 Age features a total of 96 units. Side Zeugma Adult Only +16 Age offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The reception is open 24/7. The premises offer accessible public areas. Travellers may take advantage of the car park. Clients may appreciate the airport transfer service. Those who wish to disconnect from daily routine may make use of the property's health and wellness facilities. A selection of flavourful delicacies is offered at this charming hotel. Side Zeugma Adult Only +16 Age may charge a fee for some services.

156603.description: This stylish complex enjoys a superior setting in the upmarket district of Nisantasi. The area is well known for its exclusive shopping opportunities, making it the perfect choice for those who enjoy a spot of retail therapy. The renowned area of Taksim Square, with its bars, pubs and vibrant nightlife, is just 2.2 km away from the hotel, while Osmanbey metro station is just a 10 minutes' walking distance, and offers ease of access to other areas of the city. This unique residence of 13 suite apartments offers luxurious accommodation and exemplary service amidst elegant surroundings. The residence is the perfect choice for business and leisure travellers alike due to its strategic setting and exceptional facilities. The apartments have been designed in a modern style, and come well equipped with up-to-date facilities for guests' comfort and convenience.

156620.description: Pool access: Hotel guests get access to the pool, Jacuzzi, sauna, steam room and relaxation room for £25. 00 per person for 2 hours. Please note these are adult-only facilities. Hilton London Syon Park is a hotel designed with comfort and convenience in mind, marrying the best of contemporary London with the finest traditions of an English country house estate. Conveniently located to the West of London, centrally positioned between London City Centre and London Heathrow Airport, Hilton London Syon Park offers a peaceful retreat from London’s cosmopolitan center, with 200 acres of idyllic parkland, convenient for both business and pleasure. 137 guest rooms and suites offer guests total comfort. All bathrooms have rain showers and HDTV. All rooms feature modern technology, wired and wireless internet access, 55 inch HDTVs and Media Hubs. The rooms have varying views, many benefiting from their own private balcony or terrace. The adults only hotel spa features a complimentary gymnasium, as well as 11 treatment suites, an indoor swimming pool, sauna, steam room, and whirlpool spa, which guests can access for an additional fee. Enjoy our restaurants - Mood in the Park and Syon Lounge. Syon Lounge offers wide variety of Sushi and other Japanese specialties whilst Mood in the Park offers contemporary & elegant cuisine. Ideal for everything from small meetings to large exhibitions and conferences, social events to weddings, the hotel features twelve flexible function suites with the latest technology, accommodating from 10 to 400 guests.

156624.description: Located in the charming city centre, at Rua Rafael Balzani Avenue, this modern hotel offers centrality and accessibility for guests. Lying adjacent to Guarulhos University, just a short distance to Via Dutra, the hotel is immersed in culture and tradition, offering ample opportunities for exploration and discovery. Guests can enjoy delectable delicacies in the appetising Churrascaria do Bosque restaurant. With Sao Paulo just a 30 minutes' driving distance away, guests will enjoy a stay unlike any other during their time at this hotel. The guest apartments are spacious and endearing, offering modern furnishings and relaxing decor. Guests travelling for work purposes can avail of the conference facilities and business centre located onsite. Guests can relax with a refreshing swim in the pool, or enjoy an invigorating workout in the hotel gym.

name.content: Hotel Madisson Inn Luxury By Geh Suites

156642.description: The Madisson Inn Hotel Bogotá, located in the upscale Chico neighborhood, offers convenient access to the city's financial and business districts. Nearby, you'll find Parque 93, the T and G Zone restaurants, the World Trade Center, and shopping centers like Centro Andino 93. This service-oriented hotel features loft architecture with minimalist elements. Its 64 rooms and suites provide a comfortable and elegant atmosphere for both short and long stays. Executive suites include amenities such as minibars, coffeemakers, and 40-inch flat-screen TVs, while some also boast Jacuzzis, walk-in closets, and terraces. Standard rooms are also available, some with kitchenettes. Guests enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, a business center, international HDTV channels, and ambient music.

156651.description: Enjoy a central Barcelona stay at BYPILLOW Twenty, steps from La Rambla and a short walk from Barcelona Cathedral. This hotel offers 20 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Guests can enjoy to-go breakfasts and the convenience of an on-site coffee shop. Additional amenities include multilingual staff, an elevator, and lockers. The hotel is also conveniently located near the Boqueria Market and Plaça de Catalunya.

156652.address: Al Jaazira Street, off Al Rigga Road, 7
156652.description: Located in Deira's heart on Al Rigga Street, this family-friendly hotel is a 15-minute drive from the airport and within walking distance of Al Ghureir Mall and the Gold Souk. Attractions like Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are a short taxi ride away. The 116-room hotel features one restaurants, two nightclubs, and a bar, offering entertainment until 3 am, including shisha and sports viewing. Renovated in 2011, the modern, chic rooms often include balconies, perfect for enjoying Dubai's pleasant winter weather.

156692.description: This eco-friendly hotel is situated in a quiet area of Lisbon, an 8-minute walk from the Picoas metro station, providing easy access to the rest of the city. Lisbon Airport is a 15-minute drive away. Rooms are thoughtfully designed with natural colors and textures to create a cozy and restful atmosphere. They feature air conditioning, an LCD TV, a minibar, and a private bathroom with amenities. For a relaxing escape, the hotel offers a spa with various massage rituals, holistic therapies, and a jacuzzi.

156705.description: This contemporary style hotel is centrally located in Lisbon on one of the city's most popular avenues. An underground station is just a few steps away, the city centre can be reached within a 5-minute walk. Attractions such as Saldanha Square, Castle of São Jorge, Rossio Square, Gulbenkian Museum or the Santa Justa Elevator are all within easy reach. Lisbon International Airport is only 4 km away.

156739.description: This hotel is situated at the junction between Avenida de Mayo and Avenida Bernardo de Irigoyen. The hotel enjoys a unique view over the Avenida 9 de Julio. This wonderful hotel affords guests a great setting from which to explore the many attractions that the area has to offer. Plaza de Mayo, Calle Florida and the Obelisk of Buenos Aires are situated nearby. The hotel is within 600 metres of the Congressional Plaza and San Telmo. This wonderful hotel is immersed in the rich culture and history of the city. The hotel welcomes guests into the peaceful surroundings of the lobby. The gracefully-designed guest rooms offer a relaxing setting in which to unwind. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that the hotel affords.

156757.description: Stop at Row NYC Hotel to discover the wonders of New York (NY). The hotel has everything you need for a comfortable stay. To be found at the hotel are 24-hour security, convenience store, daily housekeeping, gift/souvenir shop, wheelchair accessible. Comfortable guestrooms ensure a good night's sleep with some rooms featuring facilities such as television LCD/plasma screen, carpeting, sofa, separate living room, internet access – wireless. Access to the hotel's fitness center will further enhance your satisfying stay. Discover all New York (NY) has to offer by making Row NYC Hotel your base.

name.content: Grand Hotel Villa Torretta, Curio by Hilton

156803.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Airport Shuttle, Fitness Center, Breakfast. The following services and amenities are currently not available: On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service. Discover the charm and splendor of Grand Hotel Villa Torretta Milan Sesto, Curio Collection by Hilton. Nestled in the scenic Parco Nord, this 17th-century residence once belonged to Milan's most illustrious families and has been reimagined with modern comforts while maintaining its unique spirit. Explore the city's rich culture with ease – the hotel is close to the Milan Central Railway Station and just 15 minutes from city center. Every guest room is luxuriously decorated with its own personality. Enjoy contemporary amenities such as a 40-inch TV, complimentary WiFi, a tea kettle, work desk and marble bathroom. Junior suites offer a living area with sofa, and suites provide the ultimate space with large windows and views of the courtyard or gardens. Savor Milanese cuisine while sipping your new favorite wine at Il Vico Della Torretta, our award-winning restaurant overlooking the villa's historic cloister. Our lobby bar is the perfect place for great drinks and conversation – try the signature Torretta Spritz cocktail – and we're pleased to deliver meals to your room. Indulge with a holistic massage or ask the Front Desk for a bike to explore the city. When it's time to work, the hotel has a 24-hour business center and a variety of event spaces and services. Host up to 600 guests in the conference center with your choice of an auditorium and eight meeting rooms, or plan receptions in the enchanting Italian gardens.

name.content: La Boutique Hotels & Suites +16 AGE ADULT ONLY

156813.address: Eski Lara Yolu Sirinyali Mah 1537 Sok, 16
156813.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a spa tub, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy local and international cuisine at Blance Restorant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Relax with your favorite drink at the beach bar or the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. This hotel has 2 meeting rooms available for events. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 97 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars (stocked with some free items) and LCD televisions.

156831.description: The hotel is situated in a quiet residential neighbourhood, just 100 m from the A6 Madrid-A Coruña motorway. It is 1. 5 km from the Sexta Avenida shopping centre and 1 km from the Majahonda stop on the C-10 suburban line. Guests can easily reach the centre of Madrid via de M40 motorway, which is only 3 km away, or on the suburban train. This city hotel was recently renovated in an avant-garde style designed to ensure an unforgettable stay with maximum comfort. It offers 25 functional rooms and several modern services such as a guest parking, and wireless Internet access throughout the entire hotel. Conference facilities are at the disposal of business travellers, and dining options include a café and a restaurant.

156856.description: Taksim Square, the heart of Istanbul, with its restaurants, shops, entertainment, museums and exhibition centres is within mere minutes from this stylish modern boutique hotel. Atatürk Cultural Centre and the Lütfi Kirdar Convention & Exhibition Centre are within walking distance. The historic district of Sultanahmet with famous sights such as Hagia Sophia or Topkapi Palace is within easy reach by public transport. The international airports Atatürk and Sabiha Gökçen are 20 km and 38 km away, respectively.

156918.description: Fraser Suites Doha Right on the waterfront, along the Corniche promenade, these modern and spacious studios and apartments are located in the heart of Doha. There is an outdoor pool and a panoramic gym. Offering views of the Doha Port and Indian Ocean, the 5-star Fraser Suites come with a seating area with a flat-screen TV and iPod docking station, and a kitchenette with a dining area. The bathrooms offer luxurious toiletries and a hairdryer. Every morning, a buffet breakfast is served in Fraser’s restaurant. There is also a trendy bar and an adjoining lounge area. Guests can enjoy wide views over the city from the fitness room, which has large windows and modern equipment. Fraser Suites Doha also has a sauna and a massage service. Free private parking is available on site. The Doha Museum and the lively Waqif Souk are a 10-minute drive away from Fraser Suites. The 24-hour reception can help arrange trips to Doha’s main sights and attractions.

156955.description: A 20-minute walk from London's leading attractions, including the Victoria and Albert Museum, Hyde Park and some of the city's most exclusive shopping areas, this hotel enjoys a prime location in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It offers contemporary style within an elegant setting in one of London’s most bustling and popular districts. The property features 171 well-appointed and modern rooms along with refurbished public areas. The stunningly crafted rooms meet the highest expectations of the guests. Each of these spacious rooms are carefully crafted to provide convenience and comfort. Guests can unwind and enjoy a cocktail at the onsite restaurant and bar which also offers live music and a delicious Thai and British Food menu. This state-of-the-art hotel is ideal for families or groups and is sure to provide a relaxing and memorable experience while visiting London. PROPERTY ENHANCEMENTS FROM JUNE 2025 – IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT YOUR STAYWe are currently making enhancements to the property to improve your experience. As the property is historic, dating back to the 19th century, we are making necessary upgrades to preserve and enhance its legacy. Work is taking place daily, and while there may be minor disruptions during your stay, we will make every effort to minimize any inconvenience.

156961.description: This luxury hotel boasts a convenient location 16 kilometres from the Colombo International Airport, 35 kilometres from Colombo and some 7 kilometres from Negombo town. Situated between the Indian Ocean and the Negombo lagoon, this property blends perfectly with the surrounding area offering a combination of rejuvenation and relaxation experiences. This establishment is the perfect choice for travellers seeking to enjoy a relaxing holiday and the privacy of a spacious villa. It boasts the longest pool in the west coast, a state-of-the-art wellness area with spa and a host of sports activities in the lagoon. The onsite restaurants offer a choice of different flavours to meet all travellers' expectations.

156975.description: Wall Street Hotel in the Buzzing Financial DistrictLocated near Wall Street Steps away from Wall Street, the Holiday Inn Express® Hotel New York City - Wall Street is situated in the heart of the Financial District. Whether you're in town on business or for a New York City vacation, this hotel's lower Manhattan location is convenient for all travelers. Moments from Wall Street, the New York Stock Exchange, City Hall and the Federal Reserve Bank, this New York City hotel offers corporate guests the utmost in service and amenities. Free wireless internet access makes staying in touch easy, and the Business Center is there for support. The Big Apple is brimming with exciting attractions, and the Holiday Inn is minutes from everything. Must-see attractions like Ground Zero, the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island are only blocks away from the hotel. You can enjoy the outdoors at nearby Battery Park or hunt for bargains in the numerous SoHo, Chinatown shops and boutiques. Additionally, we are within walking distance from the subway making it easy to explore the entire city. The Fitness Center helps you maintain your workout routine while away, and you can join us each morning at the free Express Start Breakfast Bar, which features a number of hot and cold items including our famous cinnamon rolls. Our friendly staff looks forward to welcoming you to Manhattan.

name.content: Holiday Inn New York City Wall Street

156978.description:
A Lower Manhattan Hotels Steps Away from Wall StreetSoak in NYC’s inspiring atmosphere from the Holiday Inn New York City – Wall Street, a hotel with contemporary accommodations and an unbeatable location in the heart of the Financial District. With our central location, guests can embrace all the Big Apple has to offer including Wall Street, the 9/11 Memorial, One World Trade Center, Battery Park, The Statue of Liberty, Staten Island Ferry and much more. Discover our thoughtful downtown Manhattan hotel amenities, including: a 24-hour business center, in-room desk & coffee-maker, free high-speed internet, affordable room rates and a fitness center to keep your workout on track! Plus kids stay and eat for free! For a convenient and delicious meal, grab a bite at our on-site restaurant, ePasta, a Northern Italian cuisine serving breakfast, lunch and dinner. Situated within blocks of the New York Stock Exchange and Wall Street, you will especially enjoy our Lower Manhattan hotel. The Holiday Inn New York City – Wall Street also puts you close to many of the city's major subway lines making it a piece of cake to get to your meetings on time. After a day of meetings or sightseeing, our guest rooms are the perfect place to rest, recharge and enjoy unmatched city views. 
Resort Fee payable upon arrival $17. 21/per room per day

157015.description: Located in the upscale Las Condes district of Santiago, The Ritz-Carlton, Santiago offers luxury accommodation just steps from Apoquindo and a short walk from Peru Plaza. This five-star hotel features an array of amenities for guests to enjoy, including a health club, an indoor pool, and a spa tub. Stay connected with complimentary wired internet access in your room, or enjoy the convenience of wireless internet access (surcharge) throughout the hotel. Additional amenities include concierge services and gift shops. Each of the 205 air-conditioned rooms features an iPod docking station, a minibar, and a 32-inch plasma television with cable programming. Partially open bathrooms are appointed with designer toiletries and hair dryers. For dining, the hotel offers the acclaimed Estro restaurant, a coffee shop/café, and 24-hour room service. Business travelers can take advantage of the business center, express check-in, and check-out services. The hotel also offers event space, including a conference center and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge), as is self-parking.

157036.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a rooftop terrace. This Beaux Arts hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is included. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a train station pick-up service. Stay in one of 39 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

157059.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a health club, an indoor pool, and a hot tub. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can catch a ride on the complimentary shuttle, which operates within 5 kilometers. Grab a bite at La Torre, a poolside restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the poolside bar. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Istanbul? This hotel has 2034 square feet (189 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms.

157064.description: The new hotel is located in Porto's historic city center, providing easy access to major tourist attractions. Nearby, you'll find the Rua de Santa Catarina shopping district and the recently renovated Miguel Bombarda art gallery quarter. The hotel's 54 rooms are equipped with direct telephone lines, air conditioning, safes, and satellite TV. Each aesthetically pleasing bedroom, inspired by Greek design, features warm terracotta colors and sculptures, creating a unique Mediterranean ambiance. Guests can enjoy stunning city views from the ninth-floor terrace bar. The lounge, bar, and other hotel areas offer a uniquely elegant atmosphere.

157070.description: Pamper yourself at the full-service spa at the Renaissance Zürich Tower Hotel. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). The hotel offers two dining options, including EQUINOX - urban food, serving regional cuisine, and 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A full breakfast is available on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM (fee applies). The hotel features a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. With 10, 000 square feet of event space, including 10 meeting rooms, it's ideal for conferences and events. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). The 300 guest rooms offer flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. Located near the Technopark Business Center, the hotel is a short distance from attractions like the Maag Halle, Prime Tower, and Puls 5. Zurich Airport (ZRH) is 12. 3 km away.

157092.description: Excellently located in the heart of the Medina, this boutique hotel with its Moroccan royal architectural style is an oasis of tranquillity in the vibrant centre. The famous Djema El Fna Square, El Badi Palace and Kotouba Mosque are within walking distance. Marrakesh-Menara Airport is 6 km away. The hotel features 24-hour reception, free WIFI throughout, restaurant, bar, outdoor pool, ticket service, airport shuttle, car hire and luggage storage.

157094.description: Centrally located in Valdemoro, this hotel offers free Wi-Fi and is 20 minutes’ drive from Madrid and 10 minutes from Warner Bros Theme Park. Buses to Valdemoro Train Station stop 164 feet from the hotel. Direct trains into Madrid’s Atocha, Sol or Chamartin Train Stations run from here. Air-conditioned rooms at Hotel Valdemoro feature tiled floors and a flat-screen TV. The private bathroom comes with a hairdryer and toiletries. There is also a safe and a work desk. Valdemoro’s main shopping street is within a short walk. There are many bars and restaurants near the hotel, with a karaoke bar just next door. You can hire a car from the tour desk and Aranjuez is a 15-minute drive away. Severo Ochoa Ice Rink is 10 minutes’ walk from the hotel.

157097.description: This modern hotel offers 76 comfortable accommodations, all with convenient Wi-Fi access. A 24-hour reception desk ensures seamless check-in and assistance. Holiday Inn Express Altunizade prioritizes accessibility and offers wheelchair-accessible rooms and adapted facilities. Guests can also utilize the on-site car park. Committed to environmental responsibility, the hotel also features conference facilities. Some services may incur additional fees.

157100.description: This superb hotel is perfectly situated in Istanbul's Fatih district, just 500 meters from the Aksaray underground station and 3 km from Sultanahmet's major attractions. A variety of restaurants and shops are within a 12-minute walk, while vibrant nightlife and entertainment venues are a 45-minute drive away. The hotel boasts an Ottoman palace-inspired style, featuring gleaming marble floors and luxurious fabrics. Beautifully designed guest rooms showcase varying color schemes with traditional Ottoman furnishings. The restaurant offers delectable culinary delights to tempt every palate. The hotel offers non-alcoholic services and exclusive services for married Turkish couples.

157101.description: The hotel is located two and a half miles from the Cathedral Square, São Paulo's central square. The hotel is 15 minutes from the Parque do Iberapuera, which has many attractions including the Planetarium, the Museum of Modern Art and the Museum of Folklore. This family-friendly city hotel offers 80 guest rooms in total and is the perfect venue to combine business with pleasure. The air-conditioned establishment provides conference rooms with a capacity for 200 people, and also has a business centre, a concierge service, non-smoking rooms, and both room and laundry services. Further facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe for valuables, a cloakroom, lift access and a breakfast/dining room. Wireless Internet access is available, and guests arriving by car may leave their vehicle in the car park or garage. The rooms include cable TV, air conditioning, a minibar, radio and an in-room safe. An en suite bathroom with a shower, bath and bathroom accessories, as well as a double or king-size bed, hairdryer, direct dial telephone and Internet access feature as standard. A breakfast buffet is served each morning.

157103.description: The Best Western Plus 93 Park Hotel, the first of its kind in Latin America, caters to executives seeking comfort, cutting-edge technology, and exceptional service. Located in one of the city's most exclusive areas, you'll find yourself surrounded by premier restaurants, business centers, shopping malls, and vibrant nightlife. Enjoy convenient access to the best the city has to offer. For international visitors, tax exemptions may apply; please inquire for details. A nominal hotel insurance fee of US$3 per person, per stay is not included in the room rate.

157106.description: Housed in a renovated 1927 mansion this boutique hotel is located in the heart of the most bohemian district of Santiago - Lastarria. The surrounding area is full of history and boasts the best museums, modern shops, antiques dealers, cinemas, theatres and restaurants. Guests will be within a 5-minute walk from the Museum of Visual Arts, the Archaeological museum and Gabriela Mistral Cultural Centre. The venue itself also houses an excellent restaurant in which the master chef prepares delicious specialities and the wine menu boasts only the best wines to perfectly complement the tastes. Guests can also book a wine tasting session or make arrangements for ski resort passes at the tour desk. Those who simply want to relax can opt for a swim in the pool enclosed in the walled garden or visit the spa and wellness centre for a beauty treatment or soothing massage.

157108.description:
This hotel is located near to the Cerro San Cristobal, which houses the Metropolitan Park, one of the best known parks in the world. It is just a short walk to the picturesque Barrio Bellavista, which is a major tourist attraction in the city of Santiago, where guests can enjoy the city's nightlife in the bars and restaurants, with live music and fine wines.

The charming business hotel offers a quiet, relaxing and welcoming atmosphere. The family-friendly design hotel is decorated in a contemporary style with a pavilion, bar and patio offering romantic spots to enjoy the soothing, peaceful sounds of the waterfalls. The balcony and terraces are a great place to see the beautiful sunsets. There are 15 guest rooms in total and facilities include a lobby with hotel safe (fee) and lift access, wireless Internet access and laundry and medical services (both for additional fees). The city hotel is wheelchair-accessible and guests arriving by car may leave their vehicle in the garage.

The comfortable and spacious rooms are designed with a fusion of artistic styles and special touches. Each one features a balcony and terrace with spectacular views of the nature of Cerro San Cristobal, as well as Internet access, an in-room safe, cable/satellite TV and a fitted en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub and hairdryer. The rooms also come equipped with a kitchen with fridge, cooker, microwave and tea and coffee making facilities, a double or king-size bed, and individually regulated air conditioning and central heating. A direct dial telephone, radio, hi-fi, minibar, washing machine and ironing set also feature in all rooms as standard.

157114.description: Located in the traditional neighbourhood of Providencia in Chile, this charming hotel offers guests a beautiful setting immersed in culture and history. This family-friendly, city hotel offers comfortable, tastefully decorated guest rooms in which to relax and unwind in peace and serenity. The rooms come complete with modern amenities for guests' convenience. The hotel is the perfect choice for business and leisure travellers alike, offering meeting rooms and a business centre, as well as a bar where guests can relax with a refreshing drink. The hotel staff can help guests to book taxis and to organise customised tours to explore the splendour that the area has to offer.

157118.description: This hotel is superbly placed in London's premier commercial and cultural centre. Park Lane, Piccadilly, The Royal Academy of the Arts, Buckingham Palace, Bond Street, Green Park and Hyde Park are a few minutes' walk away, as are Oxford Street, Piccadilly Circus, Regent Street and Knightsbridge. There is a plethora range of restaurants, bars and clubs in the vicinity. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, lift access and currency exchange, a café, bar and restaurant. The hotel also offers conference facilities, Wi-Fi, and room and laundry services.

157132.address: Off Al Wahda Street P. O. Box 22178 Doha
157132.description: Step into the vibrant heart of Doha at InterContinental Doha The City, a 58-story icon where business and leisure converge. Relax by the serene 46th-floor pool with breathtaking skyline views, and savor global cuisine crafted to delight discerning palates. Choose from diverse accommodations, from chic studios to luxurious suites, each designed for comfort and elegance. With modern luxury and exceptional service, every stay promises a memorable experience.

157139.description:
Wyndham Santiago Pettra is located in La Dehesa, one of the city's most exclusive and safe neighborhoods, with excellent connectivity just 30 minutes from the airport, right across from Portal La Dehesa shopping center and a wide variety of dining options, offering guests a comfortable and modern experience. 
The hotel features 105 rooms with a modern design, equipped with cable TV, a coffee maker with 4 coffee capsules, a minibar, 4 complimentary bottles of mineral water per stay, ironing amenities, and a comfortable workspace.

157163.description: Just 270kms from Cape Town, this ecological oasis of open plains, rock pools and waterfalls set amongst landscapes of staggering rock formations, has a spirit and mystical beauty that gently soothes and rejuvenates, leaving one feeling at peace and restored. This spectacular hotel combining beautiful finishes with South African-colonial, and ethnic art and furnishings. It offering an exhilarating combination of wellness, tranquility, restoration, conservation and heritage. Offers a variety of exhilirating outdoor activities, these include Mountain Biking, Hiking, Fly Fishing, Canoeing, Archery & Swimming. Depart Cape Town via the N1. Befor Century City take the N7 towards Malmesbury. After approx. 2 hours turn onto the R364 to Lamberts Bay/Clanwilliam. Continue straight on the R364 towards Wupperthal and Calvinia. Follow this road for approx. 25km, past Luis Leipoldts Grave and over the Pakhuis Pass. The hotel will be on your right hand side.

157202.description: This modern hotel is set close to the Taksim Square, the beating heart of Istanbul with public transport connections to every place of the city. Shops, restaurants and bars are in the vicinity. Atatürk Cultural Centre (AKM) can be reached within a short stroll, Atatürk Airport and Sabiha Gökcen Airport are 20 km and 41 km away, respectively. The hotel features 200 rooms, 24-hour reception, concierge service, free WIFI throughout, meeting rooms, business centre, restaurant, bar, spa and wellness, fitness centre, laundry service and free on-site parking. Facilities for disabled guests. Deluxe rooms are in the Annex building

157210.description: The Ecohotel Villa Costanza offers a welcoming, relaxing ambiance within a beautifully restored 19th-century building, showcasing carefully preserved original materials. Its strategic location provides easy access to Venice, Treviso, Padua, Vicenza, and Verona, as well as the Brenta Riviera and the Palladian villas. The hotel demonstrates its commitment to sustainability with photovoltaic solar panels for electricity generation, an electric car charging station, and a sophisticated room management system that automatically controls lighting and air conditioning for optimal energy efficiency. Please note that reception hours are limited, with check-in required by 9:00 PM. For late arrivals, guests must contact the hotel at least 12 hours in advance to arrange key collection. A €30 surcharge applies for check-ins after midnight, payable upon arrival.

157244.description: Brilliantly located in the 17th arrondissement of Paris, this charming hotel is ideal to explore the French capital. The famous Montmartre district with the Basilica of Sacré Coeur, Montmartre Cemetery or the Moulin Rouge cabaret is within a 15-minute walk. The Guy Môquet Metro Station is just 5 minutes away, providing easy access to attractions such as Champs Elysées or Stade de France.

157261.description: The hotel is located in the heart of Powai, surrounded by Haico, R City and D Mart Shopping Mall. Boasting a pool and spa, it offers free parking. The hotel is 5 km from Andheri Railway Station. Mumbai International Airport is 12 km from the hotel, while Mumbai Domestic Airport is 16 km away. Guests can visit the business centre for communication needs. Car rental services are available for those seeking to take a drive. Laundry and dry cleaning services are also provided in the hotel. A variety of international cuisine can be enjoyed at Tiara Restaurant. Drinks are served in the bar.

157265.description: Located in the heart of Paris near the Eiffel Tower, the Champ de Mars and the river Seine, the hotel welcomes guests in a contemporary and warm atmosphere. Guests will enjoy the peace and comfort of the bar for a well-deserved break after a day of sightseeing and shopping. The hotel also features several services such as a 24 hour reception desk, a breakfast buffet, and free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.

157273.description: Directly on the beachfront, this impressive hotel in contemporary design is located on the coast between Alanya and Side in an area known as Okurcalar. Bars, nightclubs and restaurants are located in Alanya some 35 km away. Antalya Airport is around 100 km away. The hotel offers 24-hour reception, free WIFI throughout, meeting rooms, 4 restaurants, 5 bars, fitness centre, spa and wellness, 2 outdoor pools, indoor pool, sports facilities, laundry service and free on-site parking. Wheelchair accessible.

157274.description: In the pampering climate of Mediterranean, luxury, comfort and glory came together at Delphin Imperial… Delphin Imperial, which is the resting point for those who dream of a perfect holiday in the blue of the glamorous sea, is in Lara district which is only 15 km to the city center and 10 km to the airport. Delphin Imperial, which is located on a 54. 000 m2 area in total, offers you a special holiday experience with its architecture, rooms decorated with an authentic taste, suits combining luxury and comfort with elegance, social facilities where you can spend pleasant time and its splendid tastes.

157276.description: Located just across the road from the beach, this hotel is situated in the east of the popular holiday resort of Alanya. Restaurants and some shops are in the surroundings, and the main pedestrian area with its shops is within walking distance. Other attractions such as the Red Tower and the marina are within easy reach. The international airport of Antalya is approximately 130 km away. Guests can spend leisurely days relaxing by the hotel's four pools, all with separate children's swimming areas, or venture out on an excursion. The cosy rooms are simply furnished with a private balcony, cool tile floors and handy mini-fridge, and guests might choose to dine in the main buffet-style restaurant or a la carte restaurant, all during a relaxing, sunny holiday in Alanya.

157284.description: This cozy, three-star hotel, Villa Delle Palme, offers 11 charming rooms in Lido di Venezia. Centrally located on Via Enrico Dandolo, it's a short walk from the public boat pier and a 15-minute boat ride from St. Mark's Square. Built in 1905 as a private home, this beautiful Liberty-style villa was converted into a hotel around 1950. Guests can enjoy breathtaking views of the Venetian Lagoon, Doge's Palace, and the bell towers of St. Mark's and San Giorgio from the rooftop terrace. All rooms have been recently remodeled with new carpets and elegant wall fabrics. A rich breakfast buffet is served in a bright, dedicated room. The large garden provides a refreshing escape during summer, and guests can also enjoy breakfast outdoors. Ample parking is available, making it convenient for those traveling by car or motorbike. The Lido is easily accessible by ferry from Tronchetto Island and is renowned for its Blue Flag beaches, the Adriatic Sea, and opportunities for sailing, golf, cycling, and horseback riding. Enjoy a relaxing stay at Hotel Villa Delle Palme and experience its warm, family atmosphere.

name.content: London Chigwell Prince Regent BW Signature

157292.description: The hotel is located just 10 minutes' drive from the M11 motorway and less than 3 km from Woodford Underground Station. There are numerous restaurants, bars and shops within walking distance. This 61-room city hotel is a listed Georgian building and a unique conversion of an old chapel. It offers a range of services and facilities, including a lobby with 24-hour reception and a hotel safe. Additionally a bar, a restaurant and a beautiful terrace are on site. The en suite rooms are equipped with a shower and a bath as well as a double bed. Additional amenities include a direct dial telephone and satellite/cable TV, and tea and coffee making facilities. A terrace also comes in all rooms as standard. There is a golf course located directly beside the hotel. In addition to a continental breakfast, guests can enjoy A la carte and set menu options for both lunch and dinner.

157295.description: The hotel is located in C. B. D Belapur in Navi Mumbai, near to various tourist spots and shopping areas. The international airport is around 42 km away while Panvel station is about 12 km away from the hotel. This budget hotel with modern décor and elegant interiors provides an exclusive ambience that is both plush and relaxing. It also has a business centre and wireless Internet access throughout the hotel premises. The hotel is value for money to travellers as it provides quality accommodation and good services at affordable prices. The hotel provides 45 meticulously appointed guest rooms and suites. The rooms are luxurious havens of contemporary elegance and are well appointed to meet the increasingly strict requirements of today's business or leisure traveller.

157301.description: This modern hotel with Chinese features in its architecture is situated in Getafe, just outside of the Spanish capital of Madrid. The town centre, a shopping centre and the Ciudad del Automóvil centre are within walking distance, as is the Getafe Central Metro Station providing easy access to all areas of Madrid. The Stadium Vicente Calderón, home of Atlético de Madrid, can be reached within a short drive.

157311.description: Situated in a popular resort area just outside the coastal town of Side and near the sandy beach, this attractive resort hotel is perfect for a relaxing holiday of sea and sun. Rooms are generous and brightly lit with natural sunlight, all furnished with wireless internet, central air, soft slippers, and a balcony to better appreciate the fresh, seaside air. The hotel offers several bars and a la carte restaurants specializing in traditional and modern Turkish cuisine as well as a romantic Italian restaurant. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of daily activities from relaxing ping pong, bocce ball and shuffle board in the games arcade to adrenaline-pumping windsurfing, jet skiing and parasailing on the beach, and on hot summer nights entertainment is provided in the hotel's amphitheatre. Alternatively, guests can simply relax with a book by the refreshing outdoor pools or play on the water slides. A simply delightful place to take a relaxing holiday in the Turkish sunshine.

157326.address: Al Diwan Street , Fereej, Abdul Aziz
157326.description:
Experience the essence of urban tranquility in the heart of downtown Doha (Qatar), the hotel is located on Al Diwan Street and less than a two minute walk from the city's famed Souq Waqif. Doha has been deemed the business spine of Qatar and site of the citys most popular attractions and shopping spree.
 
The heart of Qatar has a pulse that is easily felt, radiating the excitement and beauty of the hotel's location. The three stars Hotel delivers a refreshing blend of classic elegance, organic ambiance and modern lifestyle comforts for an unforgettable experience. The Hotel is a short walk away from the famous Souq Waqef and it also gives you convenient access to designer shopping and International Airport.

157327.description: The hotel is located in the south of the old medina, in the Kasbah area, close to the Saadian tombs and the Royal palace - only 10 minutes away from Jamaa el fna square. It is the ideal starting point for explorations of the historic sites around the city. The seven very comfortable bedrooms of the riad have been decorated with ancient oriental furniture. They open up to different semi-private terraces and look down to the patios. All bedrooms are equipped with air-conditioning, including pollen filters, responding to the highest environmental standards. Wintertime the property offers the comfort of a central heating system. Each bedroom is equipped with a safety box as well.

157343.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and a television in a common area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Make yourself at home in one of the 90 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and Smart televisions. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Shopping District - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- The Mailbox - 0. 1 km / 0.

157382.description: Located on the banks of Lake Geneva, the 3-star Adagio Genève Mont Blanc is in the town centre, a stone's throw from the stores and gardens. 158747.description: The Crowne Plaza Dubai Deira, the sole IHG hotel in the area, is conveniently located just 300 meters from Reef Shopping Mall and under 8 kilometers from both Dubai International Airport (DXB) and the Dubai World Trade Centre (DWTC). Relax in comfortable 32-square-meter rooms featuring spacious bathrooms with walk-in showers and large bathtubs. For an enhanced experience, book a Club Room or Suite to enjoy exclusive Club Lounge access with all-day snacks, refreshments, and evening happy hours. All rooms boast double-glazed windows, ensuring a peaceful night's sleep. The hotel's Spice Island restaurant, a local favorite, is known for its lively theme nights, expansive seafood buffet with six interactive cooking stations, a unique Mongolian grill, and live Cuban music. For evening entertainment, Magnum Deira Night Club offers happy hour and live music featuring a DJ and Gogo dancer. Guests can also take advantage of Hero's Health Club, complete with a well-equipped gym, a large rooftop swimming pool, and a whirlpool bath. Gym memberships and swimming lessons are available. Seven versatile meeting rooms are conveniently situated on a single floor, complemented by a spacious pillar-free ballroom with a separate entrance, ideal for weddings and other special events.

158748.description: This property enjoys a delightful setting in Dubai, lying just a short distance away from the city's main intriguing attractions. A wealth of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues can be found nearby. This elegant hotel enjoys a majestic design, blending effortlessly with its stylish surroundings. The guest rooms tempt visitors into a world of luxury and decadence. Guests are sure to be pleased by the many facilities and services that this majestic hotel has to offer.

158755.description: This is undoubtedly the best location in the Chilean capital, only steps away from all the main points of interest. The 170 rooms were designed for comfort, and the hotel offers a wide range of amenities, such as 24 hour room service, restaurant, fitness centre, wireless internet access, a laundry service and garage parking.

158757.description: The Hilton Garden Inn Santiago Airport, located within the largest business complex in ENEA, is just 2. 8km from Santiago International Airport and offers a complimentary shuttle service every 30 minutes. A short 20-minute drive takes you to Santiago's downtown area, as well as key business districts like Las Condes and El Golf. This beautiful 9-story hotel features 144 guestrooms, each equipped with a Garden Sleep System bed and a Mirra Chair for ultimate comfort. All rooms offer complimentary wired and wireless high-speed internet access, a 37' LCD television, a spacious work area, two telephone lines, a refrigerator, a coffee/tea maker, and a safe. Guests also enjoy complimentary access to a 24-hour business center. While some services are currently limited, the hotel typically offers breakfast, an on-site restaurant, and room service. Although the fitness center, pool, and evening social are temporarily unavailable, guests can enjoy an indoor pool and sauna. A golf course and the Arauco Maipu Mall are just five minutes away. For meetings and events, the Hilton Garden Inn Santiago Airport boasts seven meeting spaces, including a ballroom with a capacity of up to 230 people and five smaller meeting rooms.

158838.description: This 4 star hotel is located within the city of Milan and was established in 2002. It is a short drive away from the Milano and the nearest station is Sesto Rondo. 158844.description: The hotel is located 800 m from the Museum of Natural History and the Jardin des Plantes. It is just 50 m from Saint-Marcel metro station. This design hotel, built in 1880, has air conditioning and comprises a total of 40 rooms. Some of the amenities offered on site include a newspaper stand, a hairdressing salon and a TV lounge. Guests can enjoy a drink at the café, pub and unique lounge bar. Moreover, they can dine in the restaurant and dance the night away at the disco. Business travellers will appreciate the convenience of conference facilities.

158847.description:
The ibis Styles Brussels Centre Stephanie is a contemporary hotel located in the heart of Brussels. Perfect for an urban getaway or a business holiday, it has a central location close to the European institutions. Discover Stephanie Square, the shops on Avenue Louise, the Grand Place, the Bois de la Cambre, the Horta Museum and, art and exhibition galleries. Many restaurants in the area are available on delivery platforms. You can dine in our rooms equipped with a microwave and a fridge. 
The ibis Styles Brussels Centre Stéphanie is within walking distance from the Horta Museum. The surrounding parks, such as the Cinquantenaire Park, Park van Vorst and the Tenbosch Park are eminently suited for leisurely walks. Visit the iconic attractions of Brussels, such as Manneken Pis, the Atomium and Brussels Grand Place. Have a look at mesmerizing art in the Royal Museums of Fine Arts. Or go taste some local specialties in one of the many cafés in the city centre.

158856.description:
Hotel Tito is the smart choice for travelers who want to enjoy Venice without the high island prices. Our 3‑star hotel offers clean, comfortable rooms, excellent service, and one of the best locations in Mestre, perfect for guests who value convenience and great value for money. 

Located on Via Cappuccina, the hotel sits right in front of a bus stop with frequent direct connections to Venice, and just a 5–7 minute walk from Venezia Mestre Train Station. Reaching the historic center is fast, easy, and affordable, making Hotel Tito an ideal base for exploring the city. 
Guests love our spotless rooms, reliable Wi‑Fi, air conditioning, and the warm, welcoming atmosphere. With consistently positive reviews across major booking platforms, Hotel Tito stands out as a top budget-friendly option for couples, families, and business travelers. 

The neighborhood offers everything you need within steps: supermarkets, cafés, Italian restaurants, Asian cuisine, and local shops. Popular attractions like Parco San Giuliano, Mestre’s shopping streets, and the lively city center are all close by. 
Choose Hotel Tito for comfort, convenience, and unbeatable access to Venice, at a price that makes your stay even more enjoyable. ​

158913.description: This hotel is centrally located in the bustling suburb of Jogeshwari, in the west of Mumbai, within close proximity to business areas, shopping and entertainment centres. This is a 7-storey, world-class hotel comprising a total of 54 well-furnished guest rooms, globally known for excellence in hospitality and services. It provides modern facilities, high-tech amenities, customer care and excellent accommodation, all of which are complemented by state-of-the-art amenities and services of an international standard, ensuring the safety and security of all guests. The hotel rooms are designed with a touch of international class. Rooms at the hotel are spacious and elegant, divided into deluxe, super deluxe and family room categories. They are all equipped with modern amenities, such as air conditioning, a telephone, an LCD TV and an en suite bathroom.

158914.description: The hotel is located in Andheri in the heart of the commercial centre of Mumbai. Kingston was the first capital of New York State. Much of the history is reflected in the Uptown Stockade District. Whether you are visiting the famous town of Woodstock, the historic mansions such as the Roosevelt Estate and Vanderbilt Mansion in Mountain and Bellayre Mountain or attending a Horse Show in the Sun, The Hampton Inn will provide a warm familiar place to rest and relax.

159472.description: The Hampton Inn and Suites by Hilton of Rockville Centre is conveniently located in the center of Long Island's most popular attractions and major business districts.
