Conveniently located just one mile south of the Long Island Expressway (I-495), it offers easy access to the Hamptons, Jones Beach, and New York City. This luxurious hotel provides an ideal retreat with newly renovated rooms and suites. Enjoy on-site dining at FUSE, relax by the indoor or outdoor pools (open seasonally), and take advantage of the complimentary self-parking and area shuttle service. With over 30, 000 square feet of flexible meeting space, including a grand ballroom, the hotel also caters to business travelers. While some services like the fitness center and room service are currently unavailable, the hotel continues to offer breakfast and on-site restaurant options.

name.content: Homewood Suites by Hilton East Rutherford - Meadow

159764.description: Welcome to the Homewood Suites by Hilton East Rutherford - Meadowlands, NJ! Located on Route 17 South in the Liberty Commons Shopping Center, our hotel offers convenient access to dining and shopping. We're just minutes from the Meadowlands Sports Complex (MetLife Stadium, IZOD Center), Prudential Center, and the future American Dream Meadowlands. Our all-suite hotel offers studio, one- and two-bedroom accommodations, each featuring a fully equipped kitchen, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a 37' LCD flat-screen TV. Enjoy our complimentary hot breakfast daily and evening receptions (Mon-Thurs, subject to local laws). Amenities include an indoor pool, fitness center, sports court, business center and meeting space for up to 200 guests. Please note some services, including the pool and evening social, may have reduced availability, and shuttle service is not available to the Meadowlands Sports Complex.

159822.description: The Hilton Garden Inn Ridgefield Park offers convenient access to New York City, located just 7 miles away. Our hotel is easily accessible from major highways, including I-95 and the New Jersey Turnpike (Exit 68). We are also just minutes from Teterboro Airport (TEB) and a short drive from both Newark (EWR) and LaGuardia (LGA) Airports. Guests enjoy easy access to Manhattan's vibrant attractions, including Broadway shows, Times Square, and countless dining options. Sports fans will appreciate our proximity to the Meadowlands Sports Complex, home to the New York Giants and Jets. Shoppers can explore nearby outlets like the Secaucus Factory Outlets and numerous malls. While currently unavailable, the hotel typically offers a Business Center, Fitness Center, on-site restaurant, pool, room service, and breakfast.

159939.description: The Hilton Garden Inn Westbury in Long Island offers both business and leisure travelers a relaxing and enjoyable stay. Our amenities include a complimentary 24-hour business center and fitness facility with Stay Fit Kits, comfortable king rooms featuring the Garden Sleep System Bed, wireless internet in the lobby and restaurant, and the Garden Grille serving breakfast in our lobby dining area. Guests can also enjoy our 24-hour Pavilion Pantry convenience mart, an indoor heated pool and whirlpool, and the Garden Grille Bar opening daily at 5:00 PM. For meetings and events, we offer versatile banquet and meeting rooms accommodating up to 80 guests, along with dedicated sales professionals and on-site catering. Our eEvents Booking service simplifies arrangements for smaller groups and meetings.

159962.description: The Hampton Inn Long Island/Commack hotel is conveniently located at exit 52 of the Long Island Expressway, between Hauppauge and Melville Industrial Parks. The hotel is close to Long Island Sound, Atlantic Ocean beaches and Fire Island ferries, as well as shopping malls and antique browsing in small, quaint villages. Our Commack Hampton Inn is nine miles from the Long Island Macarthur Airport and two miles from the Deer Park Railroad Station with service to New York City. The Hampton Inn hotel provides a courtesy van to and from the airport, the railroad station and businesses within a five mile radius. The Hampton Inn Long Island features amenity filled hotel rooms that include coffeemaker, hair dryer, iron and ironing board, phone with data port, as well as complimentary high-speed wireless internet service, and cable TV with HBO and Lodgenet. Commack hotel guests can request micro/fridges, refrigerators, rollaway beds, cots and laundry and valet services. Sure to please the busy executive or leisure New York traveler, Long Island Hampton Inn hotel guests will enjoy complimentary On the House hot breakfast buffet served daily. We love having you here in Commack, New York at the Hampton Inn Long Island hotel!

160010.description: The Hilton Garden Inn Secaucus/Meadowlands offers comfortable accommodations for both business and leisure travelers near the Northern New Jersey/Secaucus shopping district and New York City. Enjoy complimentary self-parking, a 24-hour business center, and a workout facility with Stay Fit Kits. Start your day with breakfast at the Great American Grill and take advantage of our convenient 24-hour Pavilion Pantry. Though some amenities have reduced service or are currently unavailable, we strive to ensure a relaxing and enjoyable stay. Our flexible meeting spaces, including the Meadowlands and Liberty rooms, can accommodate various group sizes, complemented by on-site catering options and a dedicated sales professional to assist with event planning.

160022.description: Experience stylish comfort and affordability at the new AMTD Idea Tribeca Hotel. Located in trendy Tribeca, home of the renowned Tribeca Film Festival, our pet-friendly hotel offers convenient access to the best of the city. Enjoy spacious guest rooms, each featuring a 50' HDTV, microwave, refrigerator, and coffee maker. While some amenities are temporarily unavailable, we strive to provide excellent service. Explore nearby attractions like Canal Street, Chinatown, and Little Italy, all within easy reach. Discover luxury boutiques, art galleries, and award-winning restaurants just steps from our door, or explore further afield with the subway station conveniently located right outside.

160048.description: Discover Long Island's newest hotel, the Hilton Garden Inn Riverhead. Located across from the Tanger Outlet Mall, our hotel offers complimentary shuttle service for convenient shopping. Explore Long Island Wine Country with our wine tasting getaway package, visiting award-winning wineries just a short drive away. Our 114 guest rooms provide all the comforts of home. Enjoy on-site dining, a fitness center, a pool, and golf (currently with reduced service). Explore local attractions such as Splish Splash Water Park, Atlantis Marine World, and the beautiful beaches of the Hamptons. Whether you're seeking family fun or a relaxing getaway, the Hilton Garden Inn Riverhead is the perfect base for your Long Island adventure. Please note that room service is currently unavailable.

160076.address: N.S. Phadke Road, Off. Western Express Highway
160076.description: The hotel is just 100 metres from the Western Express highway in Andheri East and in close proximity to the business districts as well as excellent shopping and entertainment areas. The Andheri railway station is 1 km from the hotel and the international and domestic airports are 3 km away. This modern 48-room hotel has been specially designed for the business traveller. The hotel features exclusive design with ultra modern architecture and a chic exterior, which provides a sense of luxury to the guests. The hotel also provides state-of-the-art business services such as broadband and wireless Internet access and soundproof rooms for the comfort and convenience of the guests. The hotel's luxurious rooms are suitable for all kinds of travellers. Designed with functionality and aesthetics as the core values, the rooms are categorised into Standard, Deluxe and Interconnecting to suit the needs of every traveller.

160079.address: Tarun Bharat Co-Op, Hsg. Soc. Dr. Karanjia Road, 45
160079.description: The hotel is located on Dr Karanjiya Road in Andheri, Mumbai in close proximity to shopping and commercial areas. The property is 20 km away from the city centre and just 3 km from the international airport. This 36-room hotel's excellent location, comfortable accommodation and well facilitated services make it a perfect place to stay for both business and leisure travellers. With its elegant facilities and hospitality, the hotel is certain to leave an impression on its guests. The spacious and air-conditioned rooms are fully furnished and elegantly designed. Guest rooms are all equipped with modern facilities such as a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, wardrobe, luggage storage area and room service.

name.content: Hilton Garden Inn Venice Mestre San Giuliano

160111.description:
Ideally located between Venice Marco Polo Airport and the vibrant city of Venice, the Hilton Garden Inn Venice Mestre San Giuliano is the perfect choice for both business and leisure travelers seeking comfort, convenience, and excellent connectivity. 

The hotel offers a convenient shuttle service to the airport and Mestre train station, ensuring smooth and efficient transportation. 
The rooms are elegant and comfortable, featuring complimentary high-speed internet access, an LCD TV, and a functional workspace with a desk and an ergonomic Mirra chair, ideal for both work and relaxation. 

Guests can stay active in the 24-hour fitness center or unwind in the seasonal outdoor swimming pool in a calm and welcoming setting. For meetings and events, the hotel provides over 300 square feet of flexible meeting space, equipped with modern audio-visual technology, tailored catering services, and a dedicated professional team ready to support every need. 

In the evening, guests can enjoy cocktails and a selection of local and international cuisine at the main restaurant, offering a relaxed and inviting atmosphere. For added flexibility, evening room service is available, along with The Shop, open 24 hours a day for snacks and essentials. 
Thanks to its prime location, Venice’s historic city center is just a 15-minute drive away, while the peaceful Parco San Giuliano, located directly in front of the hotel, offers extensive green areas perfect for relaxing walks and outdoor leisure.

160154.description: Located just off I-95, the Hampton Inn Carlstadt is the closest hotel to MetLife Stadium and the New American Dream Mega Mall. Our free shuttle provides transport within a five-mile radius, including convenient access to the Meadowlands Exposition Center and NJ Transit for a quick 15-minute trip to New York City. Newark Airport is a 20-minute drive. Enjoy free Wi-Fi and daily hot breakfast. This three-diamond/three-star hotel offers 121 amenity-filled rooms, featuring coffeemakers, hair dryers, irons, refrigerators, and cable TV. Deluxe suites with whirlpools, connecting rooms, cribs, and microwaves are available upon request. Guests can also utilize our fitness center and laundry services.

name.content: Homewood Suites by Hilton Edgewater-NYC Area

160156.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Complimentary Evening Social, Fitness Center, Breakfast. The Homewood Suites by Hilton Edgewater-NYC Area, NJ hotel overlooks Manhattan from the western banks of the Hudson River in New Jersey. The convenient location of Homewood Suites by Hilton offers you easy access to all of the Tri-State area's corporate and industrial parks, popular tourist sites and attractions. The Homewood Suites by Hilton in Edgewater, New Jersey features 122 spacious studio (king) suites and one-bedroom suites (with a king bed or two queen beds). The EMPIRE Suites boast a Manhattan skyline view and a whirlpool tub overlooking the master bedroom. Our suites will make guests feel right at home and pampered with a fully equipped kitchen including a full-size refrigerator, range top, microwave, dishwasher, and coffeemaker. Each suite has a sofa bed in the living area. Large flat-screen TVs, two-line telephones, iron with ironing board and hairdryers are just a few of the amenities found at our Edgewater, New Jersey Homewood Suites by Hilton hotel.

160422.description: Welcome to the Hampton Inn Nanuet, located on Route 59 just off the New York State Thruway, near the Palisades and Garden State Parkways. We're minutes from corporate offices, businesses, and popular leisure destinations, including Woodbury Common Premium Outlets, Palisades Center, Garden State Plaza, and New York City attractions. Explore West Point Military Academy, Brotherhood Winery, and the Montvale business district. Our hotel features 84 well-appointed guest rooms and suites, each with a new Hampton Cloud 9 bed, spacious work desk with ergonomic chair, complimentary wired and wireless internet, hairdryer, iron and ironing board, refrigerator, and microwave. Enjoy our complimentary hot breakfast daily and On the Run Breakfast Bags on weekdays. While our pool and business center are open with reduced service, please note the airport shuttle, executive lounge, fitness center, and breakfast are temporarily unavailable. Your stay is backed by our 100% satisfaction guarantee.

160749.description: The guesthouse is located in a listed Victorian building in the area of Stockbridge in Edinburgh, within a short walk from the Royal Botanical Gardens, Princes Street or Edinburgh Castle. The Edinburgh International Conference Centre, the Stand Comedy Club and the Scottish Gallery are also close-by. A bus stop is 50 m away. Features of the non-smoking guesthouse include WIFI, express check-out and luggage storage.

160755.description: This sublime boutique city hotel is ideally located in the mesmerising ancient metropolis of Istanbul. The hotel is located within walking distance of the unique historical and cultural tourist sights of the old city. Hagia Sophia, the Grand Bazaar, the Blue Mosque and Topkapi Palace are situated in close proximity to the hotel. This former historical mansion was converted into a boutique hotel and has beautifully captured the charm and style of its former glory. The guest rooms are superbly designed in an Ottoman style, and come complete with modern amenities for visitors' convenience and comfort. The hotel provides a selection of exemplary facilities and services, catering to guests' leisure and dining needs to the highest degree of excellence. Guests can enjoy the ultimate relaxation in the hotel's sauna and Hammam.

160811.description: Genius discounts at this property are subject to booking dates, stay dates, and other available deals. Located only 2297 feet from Plaza de Mayo. Boasting modern stylish decor, the spacious rooms at Design Suites Buenos Aires have wooden furnishing and parquet floors. They feature a flat-screen TV, air conditioning and a mini-bar. Large windows make them very bright. All of them have private bathrooms with a spa bath and free toiletries. The cutting-edge spa facilities are located on the first floor and include a large indoor heated swimming pool, dry sauna, wet sauna, a hot tub and a massage room. A breakfast is served daily. Drinks and snacks can be ordered at The Bar, where guest can also enjoy a tea service in the afternoon.

160883.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including a 24-hour fitness center and bicycles to rent. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Grab a bite to eat at Ristorante Da Mario, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:00 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available on request) and a cruise ship terminal shuttle. Make yourself at home in one of the 106 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and bidets.

name.content: Park Inn by Radisson Cape Town Foreshore

160887.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy local and international cuisine at RBG Bar & Grill, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Cape Town? This hotel has 1345 square feet (125 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 2 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

160889.description: This small, air-conditioned, city hotel was renovated in 2011, has 16 rooms and offers guests a comfortable stay. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as a hotel safe and currency exchange. Guests can dine in the breakfast room and use the wireless Internet access. A laundry service and car parking facilities are available for a fee.

160933.description: This apartment hotel is situated next to the University of Barcelona, just 300 m from the Universitat metro station and 5-minutes' walk from the bus stop to the airport. The 28 spacious and stylish apartments have a sleek minimalist design and are decorated in light colours. They are perfect for business travellers, for families with children and also as a starting point for a tour of this exciting city. The hotel offers wireless Internet access and there is an on-site parking available for those arriving by car. Guests are welcomed to take advantage of the remarkable terrace-solarium. Fans of the fairway can visit Golf Can Drago, located about 8 km from the property.

160937.address: Av. Arq Carlos Lazo Mza 28 LT 15-1 SMZA 1, Zazil-h
160937.description: Isla Mujeres, the Island of Women, is a small tropical island rich in Mayan history, surrounded by powdery white sand and crystal-clear turquoise waters, about 13 km off the coast of Cancún. This charming hotel is located in the north of this gem, just steps from a vibrant fishing village with shops and restaurants. El Garrafon National Park and the El Meco Mayan Ruins are a 20-minute drive away. A security deposit of $150 is required upon check-in via credit card (Visa or Mastercard) and is refundable upon check-out. Please note that smoking is prohibited by law anywhere on the hotel property. Guests are required to respect this law; otherwise, local authorities will be contacted. The front desk and main entrance of the hotel is under renovation from October 23 until December 5, 2025 La recepción y entrada principal de la propiedad esta en renovacion desde Octubre 23 hasta Diciembre 5, 2025

160938.address: Calle Nicolas Bravo y Entre Abasolo
160938.description: This charming, family-friendly beach hotel on Isla Mujeres overlooks the Caribbean Sea and enjoys a convenient downtown location, just minutes from restaurants, shops, bars, and the world-famous North Beach. Garrafon Natural Reef Park is about 2 km away, and Cancun is approximately 10 km away. Renovated in 2010, the hotel features 32 rooms, including town view rooms, ocean view rooms, and a beach house. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, a TV lounge, and wireless Internet access. Room and laundry services are also available (laundry service incurs an additional fee). A car park is provided for guests arriving by car. Located on the first and second floors, each room offers an en-suite bathroom with a shower, a king-size or two double beds, a TV, a fan, internet access, a safe, a mini-fridge, an ironing set, and a private balcony or terrace. The hotel features an outdoor swimming pool with a sun terrace, complete with sun loungers and parasols. Guests can indulge in massages and spa treatments (for an additional fee). Water sports enthusiasts can enjoy diving, windsurfing, motor boating, and catamaran sailing (additional fees apply). Sun loungers and parasols are also available on the nearby beach. Please note that a refundable security deposit of $150 USD is required upon check-in via credit card (Visa or Mastercard). Smoking is prohibited by law within the hotel premises. Guests are expected to adhere to this law; non-compliance will result in contacting local authorities.

name.content: Hôtel Le Monna Lisa by Inwood Hotel

160944.description: Located in the heart of the most beautiful city in the world, the Monna Lisa hotel welcomes you in the world of sculpture, a few steps from the Champs-Elysées. Travellers who love shapes and delicacy feel like home here. Le Monna Lisa represents the Sculptor's Art of Living for designers and art lovers. Materials and volumes mix together in this artist studio, where you will experience sensibility, elegance and delight.

160984.address: Off Sahar Road (Opp Lane Of Cigarette Factory)
160984.description: Situated in Mumbai's bustling GTB Nagar, amidst corporate offices and shopping arcades, this budget-friendly hotel offers convenient access to key attractions. Bandra Terminus is just 8 km away, and the international airport is a mere 3 km from the hotel. Renowned for comfortable accommodations and professional service, the hotel features 36 well-appointed rooms in single, double, and executive categories. Each room includes modern amenities such as a television with satellite channels, telephone, air conditioning, safety deposit box, and a minibar. Whether traveling for business or leisure, guests appreciate the hotel's prime location and excellent facilities.

160988.description: This hotel enjoys a convenient setting in Mumbai, at Marol MIDC, Andheri. The hotel is located just 500 metres away from Seepz. This wonderful hotel appeals to business and leisure travellers alike, offering a strategic setting from which to explore the many businesses, shopping opportunities, entertainment venues, and attractions that the area has to offer. This hotel is conveniently located within 3 km of the city's international and domestic airports. This hotel provides luxurious accommodation options, exemplary facilities, unparalleled service and a relaxed homely environment, enhancing any stay. The hotel features a delightful restaurant, where guests can enjoy a delectable dining experience.

160989.address: Plot no. 31, Central Road, MIDC, Andheri East
160989.description: This hotel enjoys a central location in the heart of the suburbs, in MIDC, Andheri, close to various points of interest. It is just 2. 5 km from the international airport and 3. 5 km from the domestic airport. This luxurious, air-conditioned hotel has been created with style and designed with striking graphic elements and textures which provide a sense of luxury. The hotel aims to offer a seamless blend of style and substance and offer guests a completely magical experience. In addition to a lobby area with a 24-hour reception, facilities on offer to guests include a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, lift access to the upper floors and a newspaper stand. Guests can dine at the restaurant and conference facilities are available to business travellers. They will appreciate the Internet access and can also take advantage of the room and laundry services. A car park is available for those arriving by car. The hotel features luxurious rooms divided into the categories of Star, Icon and Legend and with tastefully decorated interiors designed for supreme comfort. The rooms are exquisitely detailed and feature teak flooring, oversized mirrors and all the best amenities. All come with an en suite bathroom with a shower, an imported tile bathtub and offer a king-size or double bed. They are equipped with a telephone, an LCD TV, a work desk, high-speed Internet access and a safe. Furthermore, a minibar, tea and coffee making facilities, an ironing set and air conditioning are provided in all accommodation as standard. Guests can take a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool and pamper themselves with a massage treatment.

161018.description: This modern hotel was built in 2012 mere steps from a wide, private sandy beach, eight kilometres from Side.  The hotel features an adult-only concept for an atmosphere of total peace and tranquillity, offering a classy couples' Mediterranean retreat.  Visitors will find a variety of shops, restaurants and cafés in nearby Side, in addition to the town's splendid Roman ruins.  Guests are welcomed in the 24-hour reception and can take advantage of the hotel's range of services including concierge, free Wi-Fi throughout, and free onsite parking.  There is an indoor and outdoor pool, a fitness centre and a wellness centre with sauna and Turkish bath, and the hotel offers a variety of entertainment facilities including a cinema hall, nightclub, and games room as well as organized group activities.  The three onsite bars and restaurants provide drinks and snacks throughout the day as well as, all for a truly relaxing escape.

161021.description: This aparthotel is in a great location for those who like to be in the centre of a busy resort but close to the beach. Alanya's great pedestrianized shopping centre is only a 10 minute walk away and Cleopatra's Beach is 50 metres away. This nice property has a small outdoor pool with small children section pool and offers guests family style accommodation in the centre of the resort. Guests can also enjoy the delicious dishes which are served at the in-house restaurant or pool bar. In order to allow guests to stay in touch with their friends and family, complimentary WiFi access is available in public areas. These simply furnished apartments consist of a kitchenette area suitable for making light meals, a separate bedroom and mini fridge. Occasional evening entertainment is provided by the aparthotel and there are also light games to such as pool, table tennis and table football.

161027.description: Enjoy a central Venice stay at Ca' Foscolo Residence, steps from the Rialto Bridge and T Fondaco Dei Tedeschi. This family-friendly residence offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Start your day with a local cuisine breakfast (available for a fee), and make use of express check-out and luggage storage. The nine individually decorated guestrooms feature kitchens equipped with refrigerators and stovetops, satellite TV, safes, and desks. Daily housekeeping is provided. Nearby attractions include St. Mark's Square, Teatro Goldoni, and numerous other landmarks within a short walk.

name.content: Palace Hotel & Spa Termas de São Vicente

161054.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, an arcade/game room, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Conforto S. Vicente, a restaurant which specializes in Regional cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 133 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

161062.description: Right at the hub of London's rail network, Premier Inn London King's Cross puts the capital and Europe on your doorstep. With easy connections across the UK, France and Belgium, the world's your oyster. . . or moules-frites! Hop aboard the Eurostar for that early connection to Paris or DisneyLand. Wander to Camden for cool bars and bargain hunting. Or tick off the capital's must-see sights, from the London Eye to the O2 arena. Whether it's 'bon voyage', or 'welcome home', our friendly team and new, modern rooms will make sure you start the day with a spring in your step. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

161138.description: Nestled in the mountains of Vimioso, Hotel A vileira offers a refreshing outdoor pool, an on-site restaurant, and a cozy coffee shop/cafe. Guests can enjoy a complimentary continental breakfast each morning. The hotel's 12 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, flat-screen televisions with cable, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Modern conveniences such as desks, electric kettles, and hair dryers are also provided, along with daily housekeeping. Hotel A vileira is conveniently located 28. 1 km from both the Museu da Terra de Miranda and Vimioso's Old Town, and 28. 9 km from the Castle of Miranda do Douro. Free self-parking and laundry facilities are available on-site.

161166.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at the 47 Park Street - Grand Residences by Marriott in the heart of London. Located a short walk from Hyde Park and Grosvenor Square, this upscale vacation home offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). The 49 guestrooms feature kitchenettes, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, iPod docking stations, and satellite TV. Guests can also enjoy 24-hour room service and continental breakfast (available for a fee). Additional amenities include wired internet access, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, airport shuttle (surcharge), and on-site self-parking (surcharge).

161181.description: Designed by the famous architect Jean Nouvel, this stylish hotel offers panoramic views over Vienna, a gourmet restaurant, a gym, and a 2461 ft² spa area where guests can relax free of charge. SO Vienna is located in the center of the city, only a short walk from all major attractions. The air-conditioned rooms at SO Vienna have a bathroom with a bathtub and a rain shower. The mini-bar including mineral water and fruit juices is free of charge in all rooms. Free WiFi is available in the entire hotel. Combining traditional Viennese architecture with modern design, the SO Vienna features an elegant glass façade, a spacious lobby with video ceilings and a vertical garden. The entirely glass-walled Restaurant and Bar Das LOFT on the 18th floor provides direct views of St. Stephen’s Cathedral. The Schwedenplatz Underground Station (lines U1 and U4) is just across the Schwedenbrücke (bridge) on the other side of the Danube Canal. St. Stephen's Cathedral, in the very heart of the city, is only a 10-minute walk away.

161214.description: Offering high quality and comfort, these luxuriously furnished apartments feature modern amenities and provide excellent acccommodation for long and short stays. Situated on the Asian side of the city, the residences are in the popular location of Bagdat Street, ideal for shopping and entertainment with many cafe bars, restaurants and cinemas closeby. Getting around is easy with a tram and bus stop nearby and Bostanci ferry port is only a 15 minute walk and where ferries to the Prince's Islands depart from. The Marmara Sea waterfront is only 300m away and a footpath and parks along this coastline is a pleasant place for a morning jog or early evening stroll.

161228.description: Enjoy a central Paris stay at Le 20 Prieure Hotel, steps from Canal Saint-Martin and a short walk from Place de la République. This boutique hotel offers 32 guestrooms equipped with smart TVs, refrigerators, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies), and make use of convenient amenities such as concierge services and complimentary newspapers. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel is 1. 9 miles from Notre Dame and 2 miles from Palais Garnier. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

161332.description: This city hotel is set amidst pleasant surroundings in the Topkapi/Fatih area of Istanbul. The hotel is located just 4.5 km from the historical attractions at Sultanahmet, where guests can find the captivating Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, the exciting Grand Bazaar and Hagia Sophia. The vibrant Taksim Square is to be found just a 25 minutes' journey via public transport. This pleasant city hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality for which the country is renowned. The cosy guest rooms are tastefully decorated and come complete with modern amenities for visitors' convenience and comfort. The rooms provide the ideal setting in which to relax and unwind at the end of a long day's sightseeing in the city. The hotel provides a delightful buffet breakfast in the morning, which is sure to satisfy even the most discerning traveller.

161340.description: Centrally located in Istanbul, Azzap Hotel Galata is within a 5-minute walk of the Bosphorus and Galata Tower. This hotel offers 27 guestrooms with minibars, LED TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy satellite programming, ensuite bathrooms with showers and complimentary toiletries, and conveniences such as safes and desks. Dine at the Terrace Restaurant or grab a snack at the deli. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The hotel is also conveniently located near the Golden Horn, Galata Bridge, Karakoy Pier, and Istiklal Avenue.

161354.description:
This delightful hotel enjoys a strategic setting in Pinto, just off the A4 Motorway. The hotel is situated within easy access of the Warner Bros Theme Park, and is located just 18 km from Madrid. The hotel is situated just 800 metres from Nassica and the Factory Shopping Centre. Guests will find themselves in a great setting from which to explore the cultural and historical delights of the area. The hotel enjoys a modern style, welcoming guests with the promise of a memorable stay. The guest rooms are superbly appointed. 

Parking:
Free. . Due to construction and upgrades to our facilities, the hotel's parking spaces will be temporarily limited. Please consult our reception team for alternative parking options we can offer. During this period, access will be exclusively via the rear entrance. We apologize for the inconvenience.

161365.description: This modern, intimate, chic hotel following a full refurbishment is the perfect choice for either a pleasurable few days holiday or short business trip. Located on King Street, Hammersmith, just a few minutes' walk from the Hammersmith Tube and Bus Stations with connections to all across London. In the surrounding area of the Seraphine Hammersmith Hotel one can find stylish shops, bars and restaurants. Hammersmith Apollo and Lyric Hammersmith Theatre are only a few minutes' walk from the hotel. The Seraphine Hammersmith Hotel is also within easy access to both the Hammersmith town hall, Olympia and Earl's Court Exhibition Centres and also has excellent transport links with Heathrow Airport and Central London. Enjoy your stay.

162319.description: A total of 37 units are available for guests' convenience. Travellers may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Quinta do Crestelo. Visitors will appreciate the 24-hour reception.

162334.address: Al Riqqa Street, Opposite Al Ghurair Shopping mall
162334.description: This classy property enjoys a convenient location in the centre of Dubai, across from the Al Ghurair Shopping Mall and only a four-minute walk from Union Metro Station and Union Square. Guests will find a variety of shops, restaurants and entertainment venues nearby, and will have easy access to the city's public transport links. The stylish guest rooms offer 24-hour room service and wireless internet access, and guests can wake up to a delightful breakfast buffet in the morning at the 24-hour restaurant. The restaurant offers Cajun dishes as well as cuisines from around the world, while the specialty restaurant serves Philippine fare. Guests might enjoy a sunny afternoon spent lounging by the luxurious outdoor pool and can work out in the gym or relax in the sauna and hot tub at the health club, all during a fabulous holiday or exciting business trip in Dubai.

162338.description: Located near Kumkapi, this 33-room hotel offers convenient access to local transport, with a metro station just 1. 3km away and the tourist center 2km away. Sultanahmet is also easily reachable at 2km. On-site amenities include a TV lounge, currency exchange, lift, bar, restaurant, and Wi-Fi. Each cozy en-suite room features a shower or bath, hairdryer, double bed, TV, internet access, safe, fridge, air conditioning, and central heating. A buffet breakfast is served daily, while lunch and dinner are available à la carte.

162343.description: Situated conveniently close to the town center, this hotel offers easy access to local attractions. Guests can enjoy the nearby beach just steps from the hotel, with transport links within easy reach for exploring the wider area. Fully renovated in 2019, the hotel features 108 welcoming guest rooms, providing a comfortable retreat after a day of sightseeing. Guests can stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and benefit from the convenience of a 24-hour reception. Cots are available upon request, and a transfer service is also offered (fees may apply). The nearest golf course, airport and harbor are all within a 50km radius.

162365.description: This luxurious hotel is located on the coast, 10 kms east of Alanya in Mahmutlar. Public transport is easily accessible. It is approximately 130 kms from Antalya Airport. The hotel comprises a total of 400 rooms spread across 7 floors. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, where they will find a 24-hour reception, lift, hairdressing salon, restaurant. The hotel offers an indoor and outdoor swimming pool, SPA, sauna, hammam, gym and various sports and leisure facilities and events.

162367.description: Relax and unwind with massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a 24-hour fitness center and a seasonal outdoor pool. Additional features at this Mediterranean hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy Spanish cuisine at Rumbo Bar & Eatery, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Planning an event in Barcelona? This hotel has 5382 square feet (500 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 7 meeting rooms.

162369.address: Al Nahda Road, Postal Code 49185, Al Qusais
162369.description: Featuring an outdoor pool and sun-lounger terrace, this 3-star hotel offers air-conditioned rooms, a gym with personal trainers, and a business center. It is a 10-minute drive from Dubai International Airport. The modern rooms at Fortune Plaza come with satellite TV and a DVD player. A hairdryer is provided in the private bathrooms. A buffet-style breakfast is served in the restaurant. Room service, including breakfast, can also be ordered. The 24-hour staff provides a laundry service. Fortune Plaza Hotel is a 3-minute walk to the bus station. Al Wafa Hypermarket and the Twar Mosque are both 2 stops away.

162370.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this Venice hotel, and stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. A concierge service and banquet hall are also available. The hotel offers a snack bar/deli and room service during limited hours, as well as a bar/lounge for evening relaxation. A continental breakfast is served daily (fee applies). The 67 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, digital programming, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads and bidets. Phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Located in Venice's Cannaregio district, the Carnival Palace Hotel is within a 15-minute drive of the Port of Venice and Piazzale Roma, and conveniently close to attractions like the Guglie Bridge and Jewish Museum of Venice. Marco Polo Airport (VCE) is easily accessible.

name.content: Devero Hotel & Spa, BW Signature Collection

162371.description: The stylish Devero Hotel, BW Signature Collection, located between Milan and Bergamo in Brianza, offers complimentary underground parking, luxurious rooms, and 14 meeting rooms. Spacious, air-conditioned rooms and suites feature comfortable beds; some suites include Jacuzzi® or Turkish baths. Guests enjoy complimentary high-speed fiber optic internet and a pillow menu for optimal rest. Massages and wellness treatments can be booked in advance or upon arrival. The hotel specializes in pro-sleep rituals and offers a complimentary fitness room with Technogym equipment. The gourmet Essenza Restaurant serves traditional dishes overlooking a decorative courtyard pool. A casual bistro offers continuous service from noon to midnight. The hotel provides 14 naturally lit meeting rooms, accommodating small gatherings to large corporate events in a relaxed, elegant setting. Explore Lake Como, the Franciacorta wine region, and the cities of Milan, Bergamo, and Monza. Please note: The spa is currently closed for renovations, and the decorative pool is non-bathing.

162374.description:
Inspired by the Japanese tradition of Omotenashi (perfect, selfless hospitality), The Prince Akatoki offers five-star luxury from the moment you arrive. Each of their 82 bedrooms offers air-conditioning, high-speed wireless internet, Sky HD television, and 24-hour room service as standard. TOKii restaurant, open from breakfast to dinner, serves only the finest and freshest cuisine, hand-prepared by expert chefs. Located right in the heart of London, The Prince Akatoki focuses on mindfulness and tranquillity, offering a truly unique five-star experience. Keeping fit on the move is easy with their 24-hour fitness centre, while the closeness to Hyde Park means enjoying greenery and park land is never more than a few minutes away. Each bedroom offers a private bathroom, minibar, dry cleaning and laundry services, and access to the business centre.

162379.description: Stop at Wyndham Garden Chinatown Hotel to discover the wonders of New York (NY). Both business travelers and tourists can enjoy the hotel's facilities and services. Take advantage of the hotel's free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, facilities for disabled guests, express check-in/check-out, luggage storage. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless, internet access – wireless (complimentary), non smoking rooms, air conditioning. To enhance guests' stay, the hotel offers recreational facilities such as fitness center. For reliable service and professional staff, Wyndham Garden Chinatown Hotel caters to your needs.

162392.address: Pritam Estate, Dadar T.T.Near Swami Narayan Mandir
162392.description: Situated in Dadar, the commercial centre of Mumbai, this hotel is in close proximity to shopping, entertainment and business areas. Guests will be only 8 km from the domestic airport and 12 km away from the international airport. Due to its location it is well suited to welcome both business and leisure travellers. After a long flight guests will appreciate the pleasant ambience of its comfortable rooms and cosy beds. In case they are looking for a mouth-watering meal they can visit the onsite restaurant. The bar is the place where they can grab an after-meal drink and enjoy a good chat or simply relax and unwind. During the day the cafe serves aromatic tea, strong coffee and light snacks that accompany them just perfectly. While those who want to stretch their muscles can use the well-equipped gym.

162396.description: Hôtel du Savoir seamlessly blends traditional charm with modern design, featuring Ligne Roset décor and a bright, cheerful ambiance. Its peaceful rooms offer both comfort and attentive service. Ideally located in the heart of Saint-Germain-des-Prés, the hotel allows you to easily explore the neighborhood, Notre Dame Cathedral, the Jardin du Luxembourg, and Place Saint-Michel. Known for maximizing comfort within its compact rooms, some also boast balconies overlooking the charming Saint-Germain-des-Prés district. Discover our 21 rooms and enjoy Paris!

162400.description:
The B&B HOTEL Quarto D'Altino is a 3-star hotel located just 15 minutes from Venice's "Marco Polo" Airport. Its strategic location allows you to reach the center of Venice in just 20 minutes and several other cities, including Mestre in 15 minutes, Treviso in 25 minutes, and Jesolo in 30 minutes. The hotel is also close to the Treviso 'Antonio Canova' airport, which is 25 minutes away. 
This airport-adjacent hotel features modern design and comfortable rooms, along with on-site parking. It's the ideal choice for accommodation near the airport and is also conveniently close to the Quarto d'Altino train station, which is just a 2-minute walk away. 
Rooms are equipped with every convenience to make you feel at home. The buffet breakfast includes numerous options for guests who love both sweet and savory choices, such as bread, jams, and toast, donuts, cakes, muffins, cereals, yogurt, scrambled eggs, sausages, cheese, and even gluten-free options! Breakfast is served every morning from 7:00 to 10:00.

162406.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a rooftop terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Take advantage of the hotel's room service. Local cuisine breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 13 guestrooms featuring refrigerators. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones and safes, and housekeeping is provided daily.
