162410.description: This hotel is situated close to Kennedy Park, lying within easy access of a host of attractions in Lima. The hotel is located just a few steps away from the bus station, enjoying ease of access to other areas to be discovered. The hotel is conveniently located just a few kilometres away from the airport. This charming hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, offering a relaxing setting in which to completely unwind in comfort at the end of the day. The hotel delivers quality and exemplary service, ensuring a comfortable stay. Guests are invited to avail of the host of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

162413.description: Cin: IT015146A1EFYPJMLF At the Château Monfort Hotel guests will find exquisite interior design inspired by the world of fairy-tales and great musicals. Rooms are furnished with meticulous attention to detail in the form of ornate furnishings and elaborate mantel pieces. Soft creams are used throughout with displays of golden tones and floral designs. The cathedral is located in the same area and is just a few minutes from the hotel. Milan's famous shopping area can be found within a short walking distance where there are plenty of restaurants and bars. Guests can dine in the hotel restaurant for gourmet cuisine or in the Lounge Bar Mezzanotte for cocktails and live music. A health centre is also available where guests can enjoy a sauna, Turkish bath and swimming pool.

162419.description: Designed for both business and leisure travellers, the Carolina Beach Hotel is ideally situated in Kalpitiya, one of the city's most popular areas. From the hotel, guests can enjoy easy access to all that the lively city has to offer. At the Carolina Beach Hotel, the excellent service and superior facilities make for an unforgettable stay. While lodging at this wonderful property, guests can enjoy the restaurant, numerous shops, a bicycle rental service, family room and babysitting. Guests can choose one of the 15 rooms available, all of which exude an atmosphere of total peace and harmony. The hotel recreational facilities include water sports, a private beach, and outdoor swimming pool, a pool for children and a beautiful garden. Guests will be able to enjoy unparalleled services and a truly prestigious location at the Carolina Beach Hotel.

162421.description: The PLAZA INN Amedia Wien, situated in Vienna's vibrant Landstrasse business district, is just four metro stops from the city center. This contemporary hotel offers cutting-edge design and state-of-the-art technology, including free calls to 24 European countries and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi. Modern meeting rooms equipped for business travelers are available. Guests can also enjoy a complimentary sauna and steam bath. Breakfast is €18 per person/day, garage parking is €20 per vehicle/day, and pets are welcome for €20 per pet/day.

162445.description: Ideally located in Paris, 500 m from the tourist center, the hotel is right at the heart of the city's main boulevards close to the major department stores. It is close to Montmartre and the Opera, as well as to Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est train stations, where guests can take the train for easy access to Charles de Gaulle Airport, which is 30 km away, Villepinte Exhibition Centre and the State de France. It is 15 minutes by metro to the Champs-Elysées and the Eiffel Tower. The hotel was renovated in 2008 and 2009 and offers cosy guestrooms decorated in traditional French style. All rooms are equipped with modern en-suite facilities, colour TVs and Internet access.

162452.description: The cosy hotel is located in the Sultanahmet district of the city, within walking distance to many of the famous sights such as Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque or Topkapi Palace. The Sirkeci train station is close-by, Atatürk Airport can be reached by airport shuttle within 20 minutes. Sabiha Gökçen Airport is approximately 43 km away. The smoke-free hotel features 24-hour reception, express check-in and check-out, currency exchange, free WIFI throughout, restaurant, bar, laundry service, ticket service and car hire.

162473.description: This city hotel enjoys a convenient setting in Istanbul. The hotel enjoys a well-connected location, sitting a mere 5 minutes' walking distance from Aksaray underground station. Guests will find a host of shops and delightful dining options close at hand, while Sultanahmet and its myriad of captivating attractions, such as the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, the Grand Bazaar and Hagia Sophia, lie 3 km away. This comfortable city hotel features a classical style, and offers warm hospitality and tastefully decorated accommodation in a great setting. The guest rooms come complete with modern amenities for visitors' convenience. Guests are invited to sample the delights at the continental, buffet breakfast, setting them up for a long day's sightseeing in this spectacular city.

162502.description: Within walking distance of the Tuyap Convention Centre, this hotel is located approximately 30 km away from Istanbul and close to Buyukcekmece, which can be found 3. 5 km away. This large business and convention hotel has a ballroom and a number of meeting rooms suitable for hosting large events. The hotel offers leisure facilities and a range of dining options. Additionally, guests may make use of the hotel's 24-hour room service, laundry and valet services (fees apply) and the on-site hairdressing salon. It also offers a gift shop, and those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel car park. Guests are welcomed in the air-conditioned hotel's lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as a cloakroom, currency exchange and lift access to the upper floors. Guests can enjoy a drink at the bar and pub and can dine at the restaurant. Business travellers can take advantage of the WLAN Internet access. All rooms are en suite with a shower, bath and a hairdryer. A double or king-size bed comes as standard, as does a telephone, satellite/cable TV and Internet access. There is an in-room safe for the storage of valuables, and refreshments can be taken from the minibar. Further standard in-room amenities include tea and coffee making facilities and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. Guests can enjoy a refreshing dip in the indoor or outdoor swimming pool, work out in the gym or relax in the spa centre with hot tub, solarium, hammam, sauna, steam room and shock showers. For an additional fee, guests can treat themselves to a soothing massage or spa treatment. Sun loungers are provided. Younger guests can let off steam in the children's swimming area. Aerobics and table tennis are also on offer at this establishment.

162506.description: Excellently located right between Manavgat River and Lake Titreyengöl, this hotel opened in 2012 is only 750 m from the beach. The towns of Manavgat with its riverside restaurants and Side with its historic sites are about 4 km and 7 km away, respectively. Antalya Airport is at a distance of 65 km. Features of the hotel include 24-hour reception, concierge service, currency exchange, WIFI, meeting rooms, 4 restaurants, bar, spa and wellness, indoor and outdoor pool, 2 children's pools, playground, medical assistance and laundry service.

162620.description: Palazzo Cendon is in a beautiful 15th century property in the heart of Venice, overlooking the Cannaregio canal and offering 6 elegant rooms. Rooms feature traditional Venetian furnishings. Some have four-poster beds and antique furniture. All rooms have air conditioning and a private marble bathroom. The hotel is a 5-minute walk from Venezia Santa Lucia Train Station. Vaporetto waterbuses on line 1 stop 397 m away. Cà D'Oro and Rialto can be reached in 15 minutes by foot. Reception with limited hours. It is mandatory to inform the hotel at least 3 days before arrival about the arrival time. (CIN:IT027042B44D6YXAGJ; F12; M 1738; SUB 30)

162649.description: As good a setting as it gets, this cosy hotel in an 18th century building is literally only steps away from the Eiffel Tower, Parc du Champs de Mars, Les Invalides, UNESCO offices and government ministries. The Louvre Museum, the Elysée Palace and the Luxembourg Palace are easily reachable. The next metro station is 2 minutes on foot, providing direct access to the Champs-Elysées, Opéra Garnier and Place de la Bastille. The airports Paris-Orly and Charles de Gaulle are about 16 km and 28 km away, respectively.

162658.address: Route de l’Ourika, zone touristique de l’Agdal
162658.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools and a steam room. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. A complimentary local cuisine breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 28 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private balconies or patios.

162669.description: The hotel is located one block from Paulista Avenue, one of the main avenues of the city of Sao Paulo in Brazil. Near the establishment are a large number of companies and banks, as well as the best in shopping malls, theatres, cinemas, restaurants, museums. Situated near the metro, the hotel features quick access to the bus to the airport. This recently renovated 80-room city hotel has complete facilities and services. It is a modern and elegant hotel that bears the name of the main avenue of the city of Sao Paulo. In addition to a lobby area with a 24-hour reception service, hotel safe, cloakroom and lift access to the upper floors, facilities available to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a coffee shop, bar, games room, conference room, playground and a terrace. The hotel features comfortable rooms with services offering a relaxing stay. It offers such amenities as a cable TV, radio, Internet access, a minibar, air conditioning in all rooms, a living room and a terrace. The bathrooms are clean and stocked, featuring a shower and hairdryer. Further standard features of accommodation units include a direct dial telephone and a double bed. Guests can enjoy a dip in the outdoor swimming pool in the hotel grounds with sun loungers laid out for use by the water's edge or warm up in the hot tub and sauna. Alternatively, they can try their hand at a range of water sports, including jet skiing and scuba diving. Facilities for playing pool/snooker are also provided. A buffet breakfast is served each morning at the hotel. Lunch and dinner can be taken à la carte or selected from various menu options.

162670.description: Located in the centre of Rio de Janeiro, this hotel offers guests direct access to a host of local attractions. Within a short distance of the hotel, guests can explore a range of theatres, museums, bars and shopping opportunities, as well as the restaurants of old town, where dishes will tantalise the taste buds. Guests will enjoy ease of access to public transport links. This modern hotel embodies elegance and sophistication, complemented by its professional staff and friendly atmosphere. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, featuring ample space and elegant decor. Business guests can avail of the conference facilities and meeting room. After a busy day of exploring the area, guests can relax with a refreshing drink from the American-style bar. Ideal for business and leisure guests alike, this hotel is the only choice.

162675.description: Close to Place de la Republique, this hotel is located in the centre of Paris. Only minutes away from the metro network, guests have quick and easy access to the whole city and all its sights. This charming and elegant hotel offers soundproofed rooms with a balcony and beautiful views over the Grands Boulevards. Facilities include a dining area, wireless Internet access and room and laundry services.

162683.description:
Located in the city of San Sebastian, 150 km from São Paulo. It is 300 meters from the beach, a green block that does not require the crossing of the streets, offers "transfer in the electric car" and beach service.

27apartamentos has fully equipped, a restaurant and several leisure options: heated pool, waterfall, jacuzzi, sauna, gym, game room, playground, bicycle and hiking. It has three meeting rooms with equipment and services.

Each of the rooms are spacious and cozy, fully furnished, for the convenience of guests offer: satellite TV, radio, internet access, minibar, air conditioning and individual room, terrace, all you need to enjoy the dream vacation.

162717.description: This holiday hotel is located frontline to the fine sandy private beach on the coastline between Manavgat and Alanya in the Kizilot district. Manavgat is 15 km away, the historical town of Side with its ancient sites 20 km. Antalya Airport is at a distance of 90 km. The hotel features 268 rooms, 24-hours reception, meeting rooms, free WIFI in public areas, 3 restaurants, 4 bars, fitness centre, spa and wellness, outdoor and indoor pool, children's pool, playground, shops, sports facilities, car hire and free on-site parking.

162718.description:
Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can soak up the sun at the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, gift shops/newsstands, and a hair salon. All-inclusive rates are available at this hotel. Meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments are included in all-inclusive rates. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Mesut Hotel , or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar.

Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 131 guestrooms featuring LED televisions.

162720.description: The complex is located approximately 1.8 km west of the centre of Alanya, just a few minutes' walk from Cleopatra's Beach and 200 metres from the main bus station. Cafés, bars and restaurants can be found close to the beach. Various shopping venues are approximately 1 km away and nightspots around 2.5 km from the establishment. This 31-room aparthotel offers good quality accommodation and a range of facilities. These include a 24-hour reception lobby area, restaurant and bar, a small garden with outdoor pool and terrace and a range of entertainment facilities. Younger guests will be able to let off some steam at the children's playground. For relaxation, guests can take advantage of the sauna and Turkish, alternatively, they can work on their suntans on the sun terrace or enjoy a relaxing massage. Facilities for playing table tennis and pool snooker are also provided.

162731.description: Strategically located on Sheikh Zayed Road, facing Dubai International Financial Center and close to the Dubai International Convention and Exhibition Center, the hotel is directly accessible to Dubai Metro Station at the hotel doorstep. The hotel has 01 restaurant and a café that serve a variety of cuisines from international buffet to Mediterranean. Other facilities include the lounge, (hotel is dry not serving alcoholic drinks), business centre, health club and spa. Guests can enjoy the infinity swimming pool which gives unique views of the Jumeirah beach and the Arabian Sea.

162738.description: The hotel is located in the city centre. Within a short walk from the hotel, guests will find the metro station, shops and hospitals. Museums can be found within approximately 2 km. São Paulo-Guarulhos International Airport is approximately 21 km away from the hotel. This air-conditioned city hotel comprises a total of 65 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception, as well as a hotel safe and lift access to the upper floors. It offers wireless Internet access, room service and a laundry service. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel car park or garage. All rooms are en suite with a shower and a hairdryer. Each room offers a direct dial telephone, safe, minibar and a microwave. Individually regulated air conditioning and a terrace are standard features in all accommodation. The hotel features a heated swimming pool. Guests can dine in the hotel restaurant.

162748.description: This city hotel, conveniently located near Plaza Bonita shopping district in the city center, offers easy access to the bus station and is a short drive from Playa Langosta and Playa del Carmen. Cancun International Airport is about 25 minutes away. The hotel features 38 en-suite rooms with double beds and individually regulated air conditioning. Guests also benefit from a 24-hour reception, check-out service, and on-site parking.

162749.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting in Cancun. The hotel is located close to the bus station, lying just a few metres away from Avenida Tulum. The hotel enjoys a convenient setting, just a 25 minutes' driving distance from Cancun International Airport. This wonderful hotel affords guests a prime setting from which to explore the many attractions that this amazing tourist area has to offer. This city hotel enjoys a delightful design. The guest rooms offer comfort and convenience in a peaceful setting. Providing a wide range of facilities and services, this hotel ensures a comfortable stay for every type of traveller.

162765.description: This charming aparthotel boasts a strategic location at the prestigious Sarrià-Sant Gervasi district in the cosmopolitan city of Barcelona. Visitors may appreciate its peaceful and distinguished position and might reach the city centre, Plaza Cataluña, in a 10-minute underground trip. There are many chic shops and exquisite dining options in the surrounding area, as well as several hospitals and clinics for those who travel to Barcelona with the aim to visit them. All apartments and suites are designed for guests' comfort and well-being, whether guests are travelling for business or leisure. Thanks to its wide array of modern and useful amenities, guests may unwind after a busy day of exploring the city that never sleeps. Visitors may sample a daily breakfast to start the day with plenty of energy and the staff will help its guests with any doubt they might have during their stay. There is a parking in the hotel but only for a small cars, on request and with a fee per day.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Amsterdam Centraal Station

162775.description: 'Located in Amsterdam's historic city center, the DoubleTree by Hilton Amsterdam Centraal Station offers a bespoke family experience with children's amenities and dedicated kids' menus and breakfast options. Guests can enjoy city, courtyard, or IJ River views from their rooms through floor-to-ceiling windows, along with amenities like flat-screen TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel also features LuminAir, a sky bar and terrace, serving handcrafted cocktails and international bites in a modern setting with stunning city views. Start your stay with the hotel's signature warm chocolate chip cookie. '

162779.description: This charming city hotel is situated just 300 m south of the captivating Blue Mosque in Istanbul. Basking in its ideal setting in the Sultanahmet district of the city, this hotel affords guests the perfect location from which to explore the intriguing sights and sounds this mesmerising ancient metropolis has to offer. Istanbul International Airport is to be found in 45 minutes by car. This hotel as been restored to retain its architectural charm. Its wooden facade and window shutters are typical of the old houses which were once scattered throughout the city. The guest rooms are decorated in a traditional style, and feature excellent, modern amenities for visitors' convenience. Guests are welcome to enjoy a continental breakfast in the mornings for their dining pleasure.

162781.description: This elegant aparthotel is centrally located in Barcelona's famed Eixample district, renowned for its Modernist architecture and abundance of artwork. Just 50 meters away, the Hospital Clinic metro station (L5) connects guests to all of Barcelona's metro lines, providing easy access to the financial district, Passeig de Gràcia, Plaça de Catalunya, and Las Ramblas. Barcelona-El Prat Airport is 15 km from the property. The aparthotel offers accommodations for one to five guests. Each room features a practical kitchen equipped with a refrigerator, electric cooktop, microwave, and an LCD flat-screen TV. A hairdryer and bath amenities are also provided. Guests can relax in the rooftop swimming pool and solarium while enjoying beautiful views of central Barcelona. On-site parking is available for guests arriving by car.

162790.description: This hotel is situated on Riva del Carbon, in the San Marco District of Venice. The hotel is located next to the Rialto Bridge, just a 10 minutes' walking distance from St. Mark's Square. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from a host of intriguing cultural and historical attractions, as well as a number of dining and entertainment venues. This wonderful hotel occupies a historical building, enjoying Venetian, Gothic style. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, featuring graceful elements reflecting the rich heritage of the hotel. The hotel is uncompromising on modern conveniences, ensuring the utmost in comfort and convenience to suit discerning travellers. Reception (limited hours). Check in within 22:00. In case of late arrival clients are required to contact the hotel at least 12 hours prior arrival to arrange key collection.

162796.description: A charming boutique hotel in the lovely holiday resort of Kemer. Centrally located, it is just 50 m from the main shopping street and a short walk from the beach, the marina and the open air museum. Restaurants, bars and clubs are in the vicinity. Antalya Airport is about 55 km away. The Ottoman style hotel features 24-hour reception, currency exchange, free WIFI throughout, restaurant, bar, outdoor pool, children's pool, airport shuttle and free on-site parking.

162797.description: We are pleased to welcome you at the Garner Hotel Berlin - Spandau. Whether you are drawn to the capital for a private trip or are planning a celebration, wedding or corporate event, we offer you the perfect venue for every occasion. Our modern equipped conference room for up to 60 people adapts exactly to your needs thanks to variable seating. Thanks to excellent transport connections, you can also reach the Berlin fairgrounds and the International Congress Center (ICC) within a few minutes from the hotel. Parking is available directly at the hotel. Our total of 153 single and double rooms on the 8th to 15th floors feature modern furnishings including flat-screen TV with access to international news channels as well as movies and series in the Select Mediathek, a workstation with telephone and free high-speed WiFi throughout the entire hotel. A baby crib is available upon request. First-class service is provided by our 24-hour multilingual front desk. Your physical well-being is taken care of with a rich breakfast buffet. Refreshing drinks are also available around the clock at our lobby bar.

name.content: Dazzler by Wyndham Buenos Aires Recoleta

162805.description: The Dazzler Recoleta boasts 141 bright, modern rooms. This upscale hotel offers a wide array of services to ensure a pleasant stay in Buenos Aires. Enjoy the swimming pool, sauna, gym, and parking, as well as personalized assistance. Ideally situated in the exclusive Recoleta neighborhood, the hotel is surrounded by gourmet restaurants and cultural attractions, just steps from the Recoleta Mall and Cultural Center. Its design draws inspiration from the 'Jacky Parisier Dreams' photo exhibition.

name.content: Roomo Etoile George V Itaim Bibi

162813.description:
The city hotel is located on avenue Rua Pedroso de Alvarenga, near restaurants and shops. The city centre is some 10 km away and São Paulo/Congonhas Airport is about 20 km away.

The air-conditioned city hotel offers 84 comfortable rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception, as well as a hotel safe, currency exchange and lift access to the upper floors. Business travellers can make use of the conference facilities.

All rooms are en suite and feature a shower, hot bath and hairdryer, as well as a king-size bed, a direct dial telephone, cable TV, a radio, a hifi and Internet access. Additional amenities include a safe, a fully equipped kitchen with a minibar, a microwave and tea and coffee making facilities and a living room. Further features include individually regulated air conditioning and a balcony or terrace.

The city hotel houses an indoor, heated swimming pool, a solarium, sun loungers, a steam room and a gym.

162819.description: This upscale hotel enjoys a prime location in the captivating city of Jeddah. Guests will find themselves in the perfect setting from which to explore the city and its mesmerising wonders and attractions. Guests will find the beach and sprawling promenade, as well as excellent shopping opportunities nearby. This modern hotel welcomes guests with unbridled luxury and decadent style. The guest rooms are sumptuously decorated, featuring plush furnishings, and floor-to-ceiling windows allowing floods of natural light to add an air of serenity to the surroundings. The hotel features a wide range of first-class facilities, catering to the needs of discerning travellers to the highest degree of excellence.

162842.address: Kohinoor City, Kirol Road, Kurla West
162842.description: The hotel is situated in Uptown Mumbai off LBS road in Vidyavihar-Kurla, merely 3 km away from the Bandra-Kurla Complex. The establishment is also located 8 km from Mumbai International Airport and 4. 5 km from Vidya Vihar railway station. This air-conditioned hotel provides accommodation with modern décor and the highest standards with a carefully crafted blend of aesthetics. The interiors are very comfortable and the rooms smartly furnished. The hotel also provides facilities such as Internet access, lift access to the upper floors, a restaurant, bar, business centre and parking. Guests are welcomed in the lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, a currency exchange and a newspaper stand. Business travellers can make use of the conference facilities. Room and laundry services are also offered. All the rooms are painted brightly and decked with classy furniture, while the suites have their own distinct character. In-room amenities include a large satellite LCD television, tea and coffee making facilities, a telephone, wireless Internet access and a minibar. All are en suite with a shower and bath. Double or king-size beds are available. Further standard amenities include a safe and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. Guests are invited to work up a sweat in the gym.

162868.description: This elegant luxurious hotel is located in the heart of the city, within walking distance of the main business and commercial districts. Dubai International Airport and the Trade Center are 15 minutes by car away. The hotel features 131 rooms, 24-hour reception, express check-in and check-out, concierge service, currency exchange, free WIFI throughout, meeting rooms, business centre, restaurant, 4 bars, fitness centre, outdoor pool and laundry service.

162873.description: The apartment hotel is located only 600 m from Plaza de España Square. Guests will find plenty of shops, bars and restaurants on and around San Bernardo Street. Plaza del Sol and the historic centre of Madrid is about a 15-minute walk away. Noviciado Metro Station is just 100 m away and Madrid Barajas International Airport is approximately 14 km from the accommodation. The air-conditioned apartment hotel, built in 1900 and renovated in 2012, comprises a total of 17 units. These bright and modern apartments with city views feature exclusive designer furniture. Apartments come equipped with a satellite/cable TV, Internet access and a safe. Guests can make use of their own private kitchen with a fridge, cooker, microwave as well as tea and coffee making facilities. Individually regulated air conditioning and heating as well as a balcony or terrace are standard features of all units.

name.content: Hôtel Mercure Paris Porte de Pantin

162875.description: With renovated rooms and suites in a chic, modern style and views of the Philharmonie de Paris, this hotel boasts a privileged location close to the Zénith, the Halles de la Villette and the Cité des Sciences. Well-served by public transport, the hotel is a lively spot thanks to its restaurant with a garden terrace in the summer offering refined, authentic cuisine, relaxation areas and a cozy bar. Enjoy a varied breakfast before heading out to explore the capital.

162941.description: Enjoying a strategic location, this hotel is set at the centre of activity. Within 200 metres of this establishment lie transport links, offering ease of access to the Patio Higienapolis shopping centre. Guests will find themselves within easy access of Vilaboim Square, Avenida Paulista and Congonhas airport. Presenting a modern, elegant architectural exterior, this hotel exudes poise and sophistication. Guests are welcomed into the lobby, where professional service and elegant decor await. The guest rooms are decorated with soft, natural hues, offering ample space and modern furnishings. Guests are invited to enjoy a range of traditional and international cuisine in the hotel restaurant, or re-energise with a delightful massage. Ideal for business and leisure travellers alike, this hotel offers guests comfort and convenience, in a charming location.

162966.description: This amazingly decorated hotel is located in Istanbul, Turkey. The Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen International Airport is about 40-minute car ride away from the complex and the Sultanahmet Tram Station is conveniently just a couple steps away. In the surroundings guests will find many local and international food venues along with a wide variety of shops of all type. The city is full of interesting places that travellers may like to visit such as the Basilica Cistern, the Cagaloglu Turkish Bath, the Spice Bazaar and the Suleymaniye Mosque just to mention some of them. To rest and relax, visitors can spend the day by the outdoor pool, go to the spa or exercise in the gym. The property offers delicious meals to satisfy every guests’ taste. The rooms have been stylishly decorated with a combination of light and vibrant colours and are equipped with all the essential amenities to have a pleasant and unforgettable stay.

162967.description: Located only 350 m from Taksim Square and 700 m to Dolmabahce Palace, this boutique hotel offers an easy access to the vibrant shopping and nightlife centre Istiklal Avenue. Istanbul Airport is 39 km, Sabiha Gökçen Airport 41 km away. Each room at this complex is decorated in a modern style. They all feature air-conditioning, a satellite TV, a seating area and minibar. Some rooms and suites have a hot tub and scenic sea views. Guests can enjoy world cuisine at the rooftop restaurant and bar, served in buffet style with panoramic Bosphorus views. Guests can benefit from a sauna, Turkish bath and massage services as well as a swimming pool that are ideal for relaxation at this hotel.

163005.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at the Alexandrine Opera, conveniently located in Paris's 8th Arrondissement, a short walk from the Palais Garnier and Moulin Rouge. This hotel offers 35 guestrooms equipped with refrigerators, safes, and daily newspapers. Start your day with a continental breakfast (fee applies) and take advantage of express check-in/check-out and dry cleaning/laundry services. A shuttle service to nearby destinations is available (surcharge). Bathrooms feature showers and hair dryers.

163030.description: This exceptional hotel boasts a prime location near the Arc de Triomphe, between Paris' 8th and 17th arrondissements. Guests will find themselves surrounded by dining, entertainment, and shopping venues. Its central location and nearby public transportation provide easy access to major sights, including the Champs-Élysées. The hotel features unique interiors, blending contemporary design with 19th-century Empire style for an atmosphere of luxury and sophistication. Guest rooms offer modern, elegant bathrooms. The hotel also includes a cozy bar, breakfast room, and restaurant.

163032.description: Conveniently located just a few minutes' walks from the Acropolis and the New Acropolis Museum, Acropolis Ami Boutique Hotel offers a rooftop terrace with an imposing view of the Acropolis and the Parthenon. Fully renovated in a classical style, this hotel is situated in a peaceful and safe area of Athens center and is very well connected with all the areas of the city by all public transportation (metro, tram and bus), also with the airport and the port. Many of the city's major attractions are within walking distance including monuments such as Hadrian's Arc, The Temple of Olympian Zeus, Panathinaikon Stadium, and picturesque neighborhoods such as Plaka, Monastiraki, Syntagma Square and Psirri where you will discover a variety of boutiques, bars restaurants and shopping areas. Combining stylish and classic decor, all rooms are equipped with air-conditioning, small refrigerator, free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, ecological mattresses while some rooms have a stunning view of the Acropolis from their balcony. Don't miss to enjoy the rich buffet breakfast with special selections of delicious homemade products. Our 24-hour front desk staff will be happy to assist guests with tourist information and suggestions for exploring this historical city of Athens. We also provide our guests with free city maps, luggage storage, and information and assistance about excursions outside Athens.

163078.description: The NH Bogotá Urban 93 Royal hotel is located in the Chicó district, near Parque de la 93. Here guests will enjoy easy access to business and leisure facilities. The Usaquén colonial area is close by and guests can reach Zona T, with its various restaurants, bars, and shopping centers, in just 10 minutes by taxi. NH Bogotá Urban 93 Royal is set in a modern 8-story building and has spacious comfortable rooms. The decor features crisp white walls and sleek hardwood floors, while the soundproof windows guarantee a good night's sleep. Rooms come with a desk and sitting area, as well as a TV and free Wi-Fi so that guests can stay connected. Each morning, we serve a delicious breakfast buffet with a variety of fresh options. These include both local and international flavors, along with freshly brewed coffee and tropical juices. The restaurant features Italian and Mediterranean lunch and dinner menus, while there is also a bar for a casual cocktail and snacks. When the weather is nice, enjoy your meal on our outdoor terrace. Guests have access to an on-site gym and the hotel can provide an airport shuttle service upon request. There are also two compact meeting rooms.

163081.description: Located in the heart of the city and only 10 minutes from Aeroparque Jorge Newbery and the arrivals of ships. The hotel has 61 rooms, including apartments and superior rooms, which allow appropriate accommodations to meet the requirements of the tourist or businessman.

163117.description: The hotel is located on Rua Teixeira da Silva 647, 10 km from the Expo Center North. This 100-room, air-conditioned city hotel features a lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe and a cloakroom as well as lift access and a games room. The hotel has 6 fully equipped meeting rooms and offers a range of support services for business meetings. In addition to 24-hour room service, the Cipriani International restaurant, a sushi bar, and the American bar, the hotel offers a central office and wireless Internet access and parking. The en suite rooms are furnished with a double bed and feature a bathroom equipped with a shower and a hairdryer. All guest rooms are equipped with a telephone with voicemail, satellite TV with premium channels and free broadband Internet access as well as a radio, a minibar and a digital safe. The rooms feature individually regulated air conditioning and there is a choice of smoking or non-smoking rooms, as well as rooms with disabled access. All rooms feature a terrace. The hotel offers its guests the use of its swimming pool and sun loungers as well as a gym, a sauna and a hot tub. In addition to a breakfast buffet, the hotel offers a choice of à la carte or set menu options for both lunch and dinner.

163129.description: This hotel is situated in a quiet street behind the national Archaeological Museum in the centre of Athens, only 4 minutes walking to the central Omonia Square and within walking distance to the Acropolis. The nearest metro station is only 250 m away. The hotel offers 50 rooms, 24-hour reception, express check-in and check-out, concierge service, library, lounge-tv, safe box, free WIFI, breakfast, tourist ticket service, medical assistance,

163141.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a sauna and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at VALIDE RESTAURANT, a restaurant which specializes in Turkish cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 51 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Conveniences include safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls.

163154.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features babysitting (surcharge) and wedding services. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Meet other guests and eat at the complimentary reception. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 28 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Grand Bazaar - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Beyazit Square - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Istanbul University - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Cemberlitas Bath - 0. 7 km / 0. 5 mi- Laleli Mosque - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Sultanahmet Square - 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Little Hagia Sophia - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Süleymaniye Mosque - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Basilica Cistern - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Eminönü Square - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Gülhane Park - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Hagia Sophia - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Blue Mosque - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 44. 2 km / 27. 5 mi Istanbul Airport (IST) - 46. 5 km / 28.

163161.description: This iconic 4-star hotel in Montmartre, the heart of Paris's artist district, offers easy access to the city center via the Place de Clichy station. Built in 1911, the hotel features the EDMOND restaurant and a rooftop bar with panoramic views of Paris. The well-equipped rooms and suites, including a unique penthouse, evoke the atmosphere of an artist's studio and include amenities such as a minibar, hairdryer, safe, iron and ironing board, air conditioning, and a flat-screen TV. Multilingual staff and a concierge service are available to personalize your stay. For business travelers, the hotel offers event spaces, seminar rooms, a coworking space, internet access, and other benefits.

163196.description: Beautifully situated at the heart of Lisbon's historical district, this charming aparthotel offers guests the ideal setting from which to experience the culture and history of this captivating city. The hotel is located just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from the Praca do Comercio, the Figueira, and the Rossio. Guests will find themselves perfectly positioned to explore the attractions the city has to offer. The complex features stunningly-appointed apartments, set in charming 18th century building. The apartments feature soothing, crisp white tones, and delightful splashes of vibrant and muted tones. The apartments come complete with a range of modern amenities, ensuring that the needs of even the most discerning travellers are catered for.

163233.description: Located in the vibrant Moema district of São Paulo, this hotel is just five minutes from Congonhas Airport and two blocks from Ibirapuera Shopping Centre. It's surrounded by a variety of restaurants and bars. The hotel offers 132 comfortable, well-appointed apartments, ideal for both leisure and business travelers. Guests enjoy amenities including high-speed internet, a conference room, an international restaurant, a swimming pool, a sauna, and a gym. All rooms feature a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, cable TV, internet access, and air conditioning.

163308.description: This hotel is strategically located close to Ibirapuera Park, with easy access to Congonhas Airport and Avenida 23 Maio, which features the largest shopping centres in Sao Paulo. In this city hotel guests can expect comfort and quality in the 120 luxury rooms and a complete range of facilities for business executives with a conference room, wireless Internet access, and an international cuisine restaurant. Guests are welcomed to the air-conditioned country house in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, cloakroom and currency exchange facilities, and they may also take advantage of the laundry service. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicle in the car park. The rooms are equipped with an en suite bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, cable TV, air conditioning and central heating, an in-room safe, wireless Internet access and a minibar. The hotel has an indoor swimming pool, sauna, gym and squash courts.

163336.description: A total of 44 units are available for guests' convenience at Kubrat In Helle Mitte. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Common areas are suitable for wheelchair-disabled people. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the car park. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

163366.description: Located in the heart of Montrouge, Le Victor Hugo offers easy access to the city's attractions. Guests can enjoy amenities such as an on-site restaurant and bar. Select rooms feature heating, a desk, an LCD/plasma screen television with satellite/cable channels, and a shower. Whether you're exploring Montrouge or seeking relaxation, Le Victor Hugo provides a comfortable base for your stay.

163367.description: This accommodation establishment is 50 metres from the Dugommier metro and 500 metres from the Daumesnil metro station. It is also close to local attractions, which include Place de la Nation and Place de la Bastille, and the city centre. Within a short walk of the property guests will find a number of dining opportunities and various shops. This newly built, air-conditioned city hotel offers 15 guest rooms featuring the most modern services. All units come with an en-suite bathroom and are equipped with satellite TV. Guests will appreciate the wireless Internet access and those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel's garage.

163382.description: The DoubleTree by Hilton London - West End is ideally located in London's historic Bloomsbury district, between Holborn and Russell Square Underground stations. This full-service hotel offers business and leisure travelers the perfect location just a stone's throw from the British Museum and within walking distance of top attractions such as Covent Garden, the West End, and Oxford Street shops. Heathrow (LHR) and Gatwick (LGW) airports are easily accessible by tube, rail, and bus. Behind its beautiful Edwardian façade, our newly renovated West End hotel retains its historic charm with modern conveniences. Inviting guest rooms, suites, and executive accommodations include pampering bath amenities, generous work surfaces, flat-screen TVs, our luxurious Sweet Dreams bedding, and wireless high-speed internet access. Guests will also appreciate: a well-equipped fitness center by Precor, concierge services, and 24-hour in-room dining. After a day of business or sightseeing, enjoy a light bite, afternoon tea, or evening cocktails at Bar 92, where you can watch the news or sporting events. Join us at The Level Restaurant for sleek and modern dining, serving a selection of international cuisines. Don't forget to start your day with our extensive DoubleTree breakfast buffet. The DoubleTree by Hilton London - West End enjoys a prime location between the Financial District and popular West End attractions and neighborhoods like Soho and the Theatre District. Our Bloomsbury location is also close to many wonderful cafés and restaurants, from casual eateries to fine dining. The hotel is also situated near three colleges, including University College London. For business meetings, conferences, weddings, and receptions, the DoubleTree by Hilton London - West End offers attractive and flexible meeting room spaces, a professional banquet staff, and creative menus.

163400.description: The recently renovated Boutique Hotel Le Daum offers a warm, intimate welcome in the heart of Paris's 12th arrondissement. Decorated in soft, inviting colors with a retro-chic design, the hotel is ideally situated near the Gare de Lyon, the vibrant Bercy Village, and the tranquil Bois de Vincennes. A mere 3-minute walk from bus stations and Daumesnil Metro Station, guests enjoy direct access to the Eiffel Tower (line 6) and the Opéra Garnier (line 8). Each room features a smart TV with Netflix, Amazon Prime, and Disney+ connectivity, along with free Wi-Fi and air conditioning. A continental breakfast is served in the lobby, and the reception is open 24/7. Art enthusiasts will appreciate an original anamorphic work by the renowned artist Georges Rousse, transforming the hotel's architecture with a captivating trompe l'oeil. Independent guest reviews consistently rate the 12th arrondissement as a favorite among Paris visitors for its convenient location and excellent transport links.

163403.description: Pullman Lima San Isidro unites people to share unexpected experiences. A multifaceted, culture-filled place set up for peace of mind and superior comfort, carefully tailored to each guest. This hotel has 250 rooms and suites, 6 meeting rooms, a restaurant and bar called Residente, an outdoor terrace, a private lounge, a lobby bar, gym, sauna and a pool strategically located in the center of the space.

name.content: The Hari London by IHG, Vignette Collection

163411.description: Designed for those with a penchant for modern elegance, The Hari London by IHG, Vignette Collection is glamorous yet intimate, leaving guests feeling like they have found a hidden home away from home in the heart of London. Located moments from Harrods and the luxury shops of Knightsbridge, The Hari London by IHG, Vignette Collection is also within walking distance of Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park, The Royal Albert Hall and London's most famous museums. The Hari London, Vignette Collection is one of the most luxurious hotels in London, with 85 designer bedrooms, including 14 luxury suites. Each guest room boasts a mix of plush velvet upholstery, marble bathrooms, contemporary art and cosy furnishings, designed to make your stay as relaxing as possibleAll rooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi and portable handy phones with free local and international calls and 3G internet, as well as Noble Isle amenities. The Garden Terrace, The Hari's unique outdoor oasis with living ivy walls, a retractable roof and heaters, is also accessible to all guests. This hotel's chic, dignified atmosphere makes it perfect for a sumptuous London retreat.

163417.address: Near Check Naka,L.B.S. Marg,Thane West Maharashtra
163417.description: The hotel is located near Check Naka on L. B. S. Marg in Thane, Mumbai. Situated in close proximity to Thane railway station and the Eastern Express Highway, the hotel is a destination of not just comfort, but convenience. The hotel is located 24 km away from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport and just 2 km from Thane railway station. The hotel is a preferred choice for all business and leisure travellers due to its well maintained services and good location. The hotel's exterior is smartly designed to provide a modern look and the interiors are designed with a high level of comfort. The premises are air-conditioned and guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception service. Facilities include a hotel safe, currency exchange, cloakroom and a newspaper stand. The services offered by hotel include a conference and banquet hall, a restaurant and a car park. Guests can also take advantage of the Internet access and the room and laundry services on offer. The hotel provides rooms in different categories. All rooms and suites are tastefully decorated with comfortable furniture and modern interiors. Each room has an en suite bathroom with a shower and a bath. Guests can enjoy a good night's rest on their double bed. They offer a host of amenities and services like central air conditioning, satellite/cable TV, a minibar, direct dial telephone and a safe deposit locker. Internet access and central heating are standard features in all accommodation.

163421.address: Gardens Shopping Centre, Mill Street, Gardens
163421.description: This city apartment hotel is ideally located above the cosmopolitan Gardens Shopping Centre and within a 10 minute walking distance from the city centre. Most of Cape Town's major tourism attractions are within few kilometres from the apartments, including the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, the Castle of Good Hope and Robben Island. Designed to offer maximum comfort and flexibility, the modern self-catering studio apartments give business and leisure travellers the freedom and independence to explore all that the city has to offer. They are fully-furnished with contemporary conveniences and boast spectacular views of Cape Town and Table Mountain.

163423.description: The UNAHOTELS The One Milano Hotel & Residence is conveniently located by the San Donato Milanese station, just steps from the Management Centre and 10 km from Milan. This air-conditioned business hotel and residence offers comfortable rooms and apartments. Enjoy panoramic views of Milan from the Ristorante Spaghi and the rooftop bar. Amenities include Wi-Fi, parking, and a garage. Rooms feature en suite bathrooms with a shower and bath, double beds, hairdryers, telephones, TVs, in-room safes, and tea and coffee making facilities. Each room also includes a balcony or terrace. Guests can enjoy the rooftop garden and gym. A set menu or à la carte options are available for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Well-connected to major transport links yet close to Milan, this stylish hotel offers authentic Italian style and modern event facilities.

163427.description: The hotel is located in a quiet part of Barcelona and offers an outdoor pool and a fitness centre. This 30-room, air-conditioned aparthotel was recently renovated in 2006 and offers spacious and well-equipped accommodation with the most modern services. The hotel offers a children's playground, conference facilities and a breakfast room. Room and laundry services and wireless Internet access are also available. There is a car park. All rooms are equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV and bathroom equipped with a shower, a bath and a hairdryer. The apartments feature a fully equipped kitchenette with a mini fridge, a cooker and a microwave. All rooms feature individually regulated air conditioning and some rooms have a private balcony or terrace. The hotel offers its guests the use of its swimming pool, sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols, as well as a gym.

163438.description: Located in the heart of Lima’s vibrant Miraflores district, this hotel offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Just two blocks from Larcomar and the scenic Malecón de Miraflores, guests can enjoy breathtaking ocean views, upscale shopping, and fine dining. Kennedy Park is a 15-minute walk away, while the beach is only a 5-minute walk from the hotel. The elegantly designed rooms are fully equipped with LCD cable TV, air conditioning, and a minibar, while select rooms feature a hydro-massage bath for added luxury. Each morning, guests can enjoy a delicious buffet breakfast, included with their stay, served in the on-site restaurant.

163442.address: Mousa Bin Nusair Street, Po Box: 33554
163442.description:
This luxurious hotel is located in the heart of Riyadh, just a 5-minute walk from The Kingdom Shopping Mall and Faysaliah Mall. It offers a gym, a fitness centre and a business centre. 

The guest rooms and suites at the 4-star Business Avenue Formerly Rand Hotel are elegantly decorated and enjoy a modern interior. They feature a seating area with a flat-screen TV. The bathrooms include luxurious toiletries. 

The Butterfly Restaurant is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner and serves a great choice of international food. There is also a café which offers both indoor and outdoor dining areas. 

The Business Avenue Formerly Rand Hotel offers an airport shuttle and free private parking on site. Free WiFi is available in all areas.

163443.description: This hotel is located next to a large park and just 2 km from the new Rho-Pero fairgrounds. The centre of Milan is about 11 km away and the Malpensa and Linate airports are not far from the residence. Guests will find a number of restaurants, shopping and entertainment venues very close to the property. Located just 700 meters from the nearest Molino Dorino metro station (red line). This sophisticated hotel is the largest conference facility in the area. It is an ideal place for leisure and business tourists. Built and designed with the latest technology, the hotel has large conference rooms with a capacity for almost 3000 people, as well as a bar and an elegant restaurant. The elegant rooms are bright, each feature air conditioning, tea and coffee making facilities and a private bathroom with a hair dryer and toiletries.

163445.description: This hotel is located 350 metres from Boussy-Saint-Antoine RER Station and opposite a Cora supermarket. The Val d'Yerres 2 shopping centre is situated just 500 metres from the residence. The A6 and A5 motorways are a short drive away and the RER line D provides direct access to central Paris. Orly Airport is 28 km from the establishment. This hotel was built in 2010 and features 18 apartments and 88 studios. It has a balanced and modern architecture and is ideal for both an overnight stop and a long stay. The establishment offers all facilities and services that a guest might need to feel at home. The rooms are furnished with a double bed and equipped with a bath. All feature a satellite/cable TV and come with a balcony or terrace.

name.content: Kingsgate Hotel Doha by Millennium Hotels

163485.address: Ali Bin Adballah Street Po Box 242310
163485.description: Enjoying a prime setting at the heart of the captivating city of Doha, this upscale hotel assures guests of close proximity to the major attractions and points of interest the area has to offer. The hotel is situated within easy access of the city's major business and commercial districts, appealing to discerning business travellers. The hotel is a mere 10 minutes' driving distance from Doha International Airport. The hotel enjoys a sophisticated, contemporary architectural style, welcoming guests with impeccable service and meticulous attention to detail. The guest rooms are elegantly designed, offering functional space and modern amenities for visitors' convenience. The hotel offers an extensive range of first-class facilities, ensuring the smooth running of business trips, conference and meetings. Meals Lunch and Dinner in Room (no buffet, some kind of roomservice).

163497.description: Located in the heart of Porto, the Bragança Oporto Hotel offers guests a convenient and comfortable stay. Just a short walk from Livraria Lello and the Porto Historic Center, this hotel provides easy access to the city's key attractions. The 19 individually decorated guestrooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, ensuite bathrooms with showers and toiletries, safes, and blackout curtains. Hotel amenities include express check-in/check-out and dry cleaning/laundry services. Nearby activities include ecotours, surfing, sailing, and windsurfing.

163498.description: The Comfort Inn Westminster hotel in London, England is located in the heart of the prestigious Royal Borough of Westminster near famous attractions like the Royal Albert Hall, South Bank, Westminster Abbey, Madame Tussauds and House of Fraser. The Comfort Inn Westminster is also close to The Queens Gallery, Victoria Shopping Centre, London Eye and Tate Britain. Guests of the hotel are invited to enjoy free breakfast and free WiFi. All guest rooms offer a desk, flat-screen TV and in-room tea and coffee. This is a non-smoking hotel. Create your perfect stay at the Comfort Inn Westminster in London. Book now to enjoy easy access to attractions and wonderful amenities while we help you relax and feel at home.

163511.description: The apartment is not cleaned during the stay. There is a mandatory cleaning payment upon departure that is not included in the value of the stay, which is €35 to be collected upon the client's arrival, except in the APT / B4-XW (B4-XW / APARTMENT 4 BEDROOMS AND 4 BATHROOMS) that the cleaning cost will be €100. We have parking not included in the price of €20/day. Reception Service almost 24 hours a day: from 9:00 a. m. to 11:00 p. m. every day of the year, in case of arrival later it is mandatory to notify 2 days in advance. The client always has to confirm arrival time or by phone at +34 695097612, as well as provide a telephone number in case of delay or problems, before the day of arrival. If you arrive before 3:00 p. m. you can leave your bags and enter in the afternoon when the apartment is clean. The address is Las Ramblas 42, Pasaje Bacardi entrance 1, office 2. The apartment is not cleaned during the stay. Clients can leave their suitcases at reception between 09:00 and 0:00. Key collection and check-in time 14:30-0:00 There is a tourist tax of €6. 88 per adult over 16 years old per night which is not included in the price, up to a maximum of 7 nights. GROUPS OF BACHELOR PARTY OR STUDENTS ARE NOT ALLOWED

163512.description: This spacious apartment is located in a historic building, a short 10-minute walk from Puerta del Sol and two metro stops from Tribunal station. Nestled between the vibrant Malasaña and Chueca districts, you'll have easy access to Madrid's best nightlife and attractions, including Plaza Mayor and the Royal Palace. The apartment features modern appliances, a large living room with a smart TV, and a fully equipped kitchen. Enjoy amenities like free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and a comfortable king-size bed (twin beds available upon request). The bright living/dining area opens onto charming French balconies overlooking the street. The bathroom includes a hairdryer, towels, and complimentary toiletries. Daily cleaning service is available upon request. We offer 24-hour assistance. The building boasts a large elevator and a beautifully refurbished staircase.

163525.address: R. Augusta, 778 - Consolação, São Paulo - Sp, 0130
163525.description: The hotel is located on Avenida de Augusta, in the Consolação district of São Paulo, 4 km from the financial, cultural and shopping road Avenida Paulista. São Paulo/Congonhas Airport is about 20 km away. This city hotel offers 120 comfortable rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby by a friendly staff, qualified to provide any necessary assistance. Dining is possible at the on-site restaurant, which serves a selection of delicious meals. Business travellers can make use of the conference facilities, which comprise a convention centre with capacity for 900 people, as well as special areas for fairs and exhibitions. Guests can take advantage of the room service and there is a car park and a garage for those arriving by car.

163540.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace and garden at this Art Deco hotel. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a common area television. A theme park shuttle is available (surcharge). Savor local cuisine at Café Line, enjoy snacks in the coffee shop/cafe, or order 24-hour room service. A complimentary local cuisine breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel also provides limo/town car service, a computer station, and express check-in. Airport and cruise ship terminal shuttles are available for a surcharge. Relax in one of the 36 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars, pillowtop beds, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Located near Istiklal Avenue and Taksim Square, the hotel is conveniently close to popular attractions. Istanbul Airport (IST) is the preferred airport.

163542.description:
Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 5 outdoor swimming pools, a health club, and a lazy river. Additional features at this property include complimentary wireless internet access, babysitting (surcharge), and an arcade/game room. This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Grab a bite at Kahya, one of the property's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 2 bars/lounges.

Featured amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

163544.description: Argenta Suites is located in the upscale Belgrano district, only 1. 1 km from Buenos Aires' Chinatown, very close to downtown, San Isidro district, River Plate Stadium, La Rural and other great attractions such as Palermo Soho neighborhood, which features several dining options. The Obelisk is 11 km away and Ezeiza airport is 38 km away. Whether you are attending corporate business, looking for a family friendly hotel or planning a romantic getaway, Argenta Suites Belgrano offers a variety of services and amenities you need to ensure a comfortable and relaxing stay. Services include buffet breakfast served everyday from 7 to 11, outdoor swimming pool (during Spring and Summer times), sauna and business center. Suites are equipped with a kitchenette, a balcony, Smart TV, minibar, air conditioning and Wi-Fi.

163766.description: The following services and amenities are currently **not available**: Airport Shuttle, Indoor Pool. The Hampton Inn & Suites Yonkers has been designed to help you have the best experience possible while visiting the Yonkers Westchester County area. Our hotel is conveniently located off the Saw Mill River Parkway and only 2 miles from I-87 New York State as well as easy access to Downtown Yonkers, Yonkers Raceway, Empire City Casino, Hudson River Museum, Stew Leonard's and the Ridge Hill Shopping Center. We're also only a short distance to the Metro-North Station which offers a quick commute to New York City's Grand Central Station. We want to be your home away from home and will assist you in any way we can. Start each day with a complimentary On the House hot breakfast and complimentary coffee and tea available 24 hours in the lobby. For guests in a hurry, stop by the Guest Services Desk and pick up an On the Run Breakfast Bag, weekdays beginning at 5:30 AM. Your guestroom is equipped with a coffee maker, iron and ironing board, hair dryer and free high-speed internet access. Come visit our Hampton Inn & Suites Yonkers and enjoy all of our amenities during your stay. A fitness center, business center and meeting space are available.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Newark Airport Elizabeth

163888.description: Welcome to the brand-new Holiday Inn Express – Newark Airport; Nestled in Elizabeth, NJ, just off Hwy US-1 in Union County, and one mile from Newark Liberty International Airport. Our location is perfect for the business and leisure traveler alike. Our location is easily accessible to places such as Anheuser-Busch, Bayway Refinery or Newark Beth Israel Medical Center/RWJ Barnabas Health and Rutgers University. Newark is the perfect place to relax and unwind, with culture and history at places such as The Ritz Theatre &Performing Arts Center, Loews Theatre, NJPAC Prudential Center; home of the NJ Devils. Endless shopping is available right at our doorstep at The Mills at Jersey Gardens, and World-Class sightseeing is minutes away in nearby New York City. Cape Liberty Cruise Port is also located just 5 miles from our hotel. While a guest at our hotel, you can start your day with our complimentary Express Start hot breakfast bar or a workout in our Fitness Center. Our Business Center is convenient for finishing up any projects for business, or simply surfing the web. Our meeting rooms will accommodate your function of 2-30 people. We offer shuttle service to and from the Newark Airport, and within 2 miles to local businesses.

163915.description: The Hampton Inn & Suites Newark-Harrison-Riverwalk offers comfortable accommodations for both families and business travelers. Located on the Passaic River, our hotel provides free on-site parking and shuttle service to local businesses, Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR), and Newark Penn Station, offering easy access to New York City. Enjoy spacious guest rooms and suites with river views, featuring amenities such as a Hampton bed®, 32-inch LCD HDTV, coffeemaker, mini-refrigerator, and microwave. Free WiFi is available in public areas. Start your day with our complimentary hot breakfast or grab a Hampton On the Run® Breakfast Bag (Monday-Friday). Relax in our inviting lobby bar after a busy day. We're just minutes from Newark International Airport, MetLife Stadium, and Prudential Center, and close to businesses including NJIT, Panasonic, and Prudential Financial.

163988.description: This delightful hotel boasts a prime setting in the vibrant Montparnasse district of Paris. The hotel is situated within easy access of the Montparnasse Tower and the Luxembourg Gardens. The hotel is located just 160 metres from Montparnasse-Bienvenue Metro Station, offering ease of access to many of the city's main attractions. This delightful hotel greets guests with elegance and charm, enjoying a stunning architectural style, and blending effortlessly with its historical counterparts. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, and offer a relaxing space in which to escape the rest of the world. The hotel affords guests a number of exemplary facilities, catering to the needs of business and leisure travellers alike.

163995.description: The hotel is situated in a quiet corner of Campo Sant'Angelo, with restaurants, bars, and shops within a 2-minute walk and links to public transportation just a 5-minute walk away. The Fenice Theatre is 300 meters away, and the Accademia Gallery is 400 meters from the hotel. Piazza San Marco, the Rialto Bridge, the Peggy Guggenheim Collection, and Harry's Bar are all a 10-minute walk away, while Lido Island is roughly 5 km from the hotel. The rooms are located in a building dating back to 1300, where guests can experience a charming atmosphere of grace, elegance, and serenity. Luxurious and classically furnished, the rooms are air-conditioned throughout. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, and there is elevator access to the upper floors. Breakfast is served in the breakfast room, and complimentary wireless Internet access is available throughout the hotel. A beautiful internal courtyard features an outdoor stairwell leading directly to the main floor. The junior suites and double rooms feature the extraordinary beauty of antique Venetian-style furnishings, precious fabrics, and romantic views of the canals or the wonderful internal courtyard. Each room offers a wonderful en suite bathroom with a shower, hairdryer, and Carrara marble, superior comforts, and modern amenities, including a flat-screen satellite TV, free wireless Internet access, and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. A direct-dial telephone, radio, safe, and terrace are also standard. Palazzo Paruta also offers independent accommodations in modern, luxurious apartments located 40 meters from the main building. Breakfast and housekeeping services are not provided in the apartments. Check-in and check-out must be done at the hotel reception.

164040.description: With an outstanding location overlooking one of the most sought-after golf courses in Marrakech, Hôtel du Golf is the place to relax and enjoy 5 star luxury and world-class facilities. Nestled at the heart of the stunning Palmeraie Hotel du Golf is situated in the north of the Marrakech. This design-led property blends modern Moroccan architecture with art deco style and a warm inviting colour scheme to create a cosy and laid-back ambiance. Magnificent views of the fairways at the Hotel du golf and the stunning Atlas Mountains backdrop are part of this exceptional lifestyle experience. All 315 hotel rooms and suites are modern, spacious and ideal for both leisure and business stays in Marrakech. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows are a design highlight, flooding each room with glorious Moroccan sunshine and offering guests breath-taking views of the gardens, pool and/or the golf course.

164041.address: Angle Avenue Mohamed Vi Et Avenue Hassan Ii
164041.description: This hotel is situated in the centre of Marrakech, next to the lively Gueliz District. The hotel is in front of the Royal Theatre and the Railway Station. The Convention Centre is also nearby, and the medina is only 3 km away. The hotel is decorated in a Moorish-Arabic style. It has an outdoor swimming pool and lounge area and a fitness centre with views to the swimming pool. The hotel's spa offers massages and hammam treatments. The hotel has three restaurants, where guests can choose between international cuisine, exotic Moroccan specialties or savoury Asian food. The hotel also features a café and a lounge bar, both with a terrace, and a poolside drink and snack bar. This stylish hotel is perfect for both business and leisure travellers, and it offers plenty of activities. There is a bowling alley, a pool table, a foosball table and a nightclub.

164042.description: Experience Art Deco elegance at this Marrakech hotel, featuring an outdoor pool, spa, and fitness center. Enjoy Italian cuisine at one of the three onsite restaurants, or relax with room service. Each of the 226 guestrooms offers modern conveniences like minibars, LCD TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. A business center, airport shuttle, and self-parking are also available. Located near Avenue Mohamed VI, the hotel provides easy access to attractions like Al Mazar Mall and Agdal Gardens.

164064.description: Ideally located in the heart of the Royal Kasbah and neighbour to the Royal Palace, this hotel enjoys a peaceful and privileged location to discover Morocco with comfortable ease. Only 10 minutes from the famous Jemaa El Fna square and the surrounding souks, it is a haven of peace, where beauty merges discreetly with luxurious traditional spaces: a large swimming pool in the courtyard, six bedrooms including a luxury suite, a comfortable lounge with open fireplace and a sun terrace on two levels, offering stunning views across Marrakech and the snow-capped Atlas Mountains. In this exceptional place, everything is tailored for your comfort - warm, welcoming Moroccan hospitality, with an array of high quality services: delicious traditional cuisine, bilingual staff, comfortable and well equipped rooms, modern facilities and Wi-Fi internet. A harmonious blend of tradition and modernity, luxury and simplicity. Just 7 km from the international airport of Marrakech-Menara.

164080.address: Carretera Móstoles a Villaviciosa de Odón, Km 0,200 5 2
164080.description: This city hotel is located on the N-V in the business district of Móstoles. The property offers easy access to the major shopping and leisure centres in the southern part of Madrid. Guests will find public transport links and shops 2 and 4 km from the hotel respectively. The centre of Madrid is some 20 km away, whilst Barajas International Airport is 35 km from the hotel. This establishment is both modern and functional. Guests looking for refreshments can choose between the café and bar, and a restaurant serves delicious meals. Internet access is available throughout the hotel and the wide, open halls provide an ideal setting for business meetings, conventions and conferences.

164090.description: This charming hotel is situated in Sao Paulo, offering ease of access to the number of attractions that this bustling city has to offer. Congonhas airport is 8 km away, whilst Guarulhos international airport is 18 km from this establishment. Within a short distance, guests can find a host of dining, shopping and entertainment venues. This city hotel exudes modernity and elegance, offering the ultimate in style and service. Upon arrival, guests will be instantly impressed by the charming architectural style that the hotel enjoys. Offering a peaceful haven for restful slumber, the guest rooms exude comfort and tranquillity. Fitness enthusiasts can enjoy an invigorating workout in the hotel gym. This hotel is ideal for business and leisure travellers alike. cleaning of all rooms and environments of the hotel are being done with ozone.

164091.description: The hotel's location provides easy access to Sao Paulo city centre. It is only a short drive from Ibirapuera Park and the Morumbi shopping centre, while Sao Judas train station is approximately 4. 8 km away. The hotel provides maximum comfort and convenience for guests due to its proximity to the airport. Whether travelling for business or pleasure, this air-conditioned city hotel offers guests quality accommodation. Guests can wine and dine at the hotel's bar and restaurant and business travellers will appreciate the convenience of conference facilities. The rooms are decorated in warm colours and feature wooden flooring and a number of modern amenities.

164095.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in Miraflores, lying close to the major shopping and business area of Lima. The Larcomar tourist centre is just a 10 minutes' driving distance away. A number of attractions, as well as a host of shopping, dining and entertainment venues, can be found nearby. Jorge Chavez International Airport is just a 20 minutes' driving distance away. This hotel comprises superbly-designed guest rooms, which offer a peaceful setting in which to work and rest in comfort. The hotel features excellent conference facilities, meeting the needs of those travelling for work purposes. The hotel also features a restaurant, where delectable dishes are served.

164104.description: With a stay at Le Grand Hotel de Normandie, you'll be centrally located in Paris, within a 10-minute walk of Galeries Lafayette and Palais Garnier. This 4-star hotel is 0. 5 mi (0. 9 km) from Place de la Madeleine and 0. 9 mi (1. 4 km) from Champs-Élysées. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a reception hall. Make yourself at home in one of the 53 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.
