Airport (QRO).

164106.description: This upscale hotel is situated in the city centre of Getafe. It is located just a short distance away from the many attractions and points of interest that the area has to offer. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby, offering ease of access to other areas to be explored. The hotel is located just a short distance away from many shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. This modern hotel welcomes visitors into the elegant surroundings of the lobby. The guest rooms are wonderfully designed, offering comfort and style. The hotel offers a range of facilities and services, and its staff are on hand to ensure that guests' needs are fully met, to a high level of excellence.

164121.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this hotel, complete with complimentary Wi-Fi and convenient amenities like concierge and wedding services. Dine alfresco at the Aurora Restaurant, savoring delicious Turkish cuisine with garden views, or enjoy room service. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily for a fee (8:00 AM - 10:00 AM). The hotel offers express check-in/check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour airport shuttle (surcharge). Free self-parking is also available. Relax in one of the 15 individually decorated guestrooms, each featuring a minibar, LCD TV, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include a bathtub or shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. A laptop-compatible safe, desk, and phone with free local calls are also provided. Located near the Bosphorus Bridge, the hotel is just a short distance from Ortaköy Square, Ortaköy Mosque, and Ciragan Palace. Istanbul Airport (IST) is the preferred airport for Symbola Bosphorus Istanbul.

164170.description: Located at the heart of Athens, this hotel is within walking distance from the most attractive tourist sites such as the National Archaeological Museum, the Acropolis Museum, the Parthenon and the lively district of Monastiraki. Eleftherios Venizelos International airport is easily reachable by public transport. Situated a few minutes away from Omonoia Square, Keramikos metro station and the Conference centres of Stoa Vivliou and Technopolis, this hotel is perfect for both business and leisure travellers. The hotel offers fully equipped and spacious rooms, decorated in a contemporary style. A breakfast buffet is served every morning at the hotel's restaurant, where guests will be able to taste Greek homemade specialties as well as International dishes also for lunch and dinner. The hotel offers a breakfast basket so guests can take it on their excursions.

name.content: Martinique New York on Broadway, Curio By Hilton

164172.description: Welcome to Martinique New York on Broadway, Curio Collection by Hilton, set in Midtown Manhattan near the city's finest attractions. Rising 18 stories above Broadway at 32nd Street in a Landmark Building, Martinique is listed on the register of Historic Hotels of America and blends French Renaissance and Art Deco style for a unique stay. Relax in the comfort of our newly renovated guest rooms, smart TVs, coffeemakers, complimentary bottled water for the first night, ample work space, and laptop-sized safes. Suites offer additional space, a separate living area, mini-refrigerator, and cozy extras. Carnegie Diner & Cafe is open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Enjoy the charm and intimacy of The Bronze Owl, our restaurant, and bar. We have comforts covered at Martinique. Work out in the complimentary 24-hour fitness center with a range of cardio machines and strength-training equipment and stay in touch in the in the lobby. With 8100 sq. ft. of New York Midtown event space, Martinique hotel is perfect for meetings and receptions of up to 400 guests. Martinique New York is rich in history and steps from world class shopping, dining and major attractions.

164178.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After a day at the private beach, you can enjoy other recreational amenities including an indoor pool and a hot tub. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy Italian cuisine at Mastroianni, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge at scheduled times, and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 160 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Rooms have private furnished balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, bidets, and hair dryers. name.content: Crowne Plaza Milan NoLo by IHG

164244.description: The property is located in a strategic location, 10 minutes from the city center and 5 minutes walking distance from the subway station Turro. The famous Fiera di Milano is located about 40 minutes away. The hotel has 165 bright and spacious rooms and 94 apartments with kitchenette, all with balcony and design bathrooms. It also provides 10 rooms with equipped bathroom for disabled guests. Every room is perfectly soundproof and features wireless high speed internet and a private safe. Executive rooms also feature a spacious walking closet. 2 restaurants are available, one offering a delicious buffet for breakfast and lunch and the other is the right place to taste Italian and International cuisine for dinner. Hotel services include a free car park and a garage, a fitness room and meeting rooms .

164259.address: Muteena, Deira, Dubai, Uae, Po Box 34047
164259.description: This apartment complex is conveniently located in Deira, Dubai, in close proximity to a host of cultural attractions. The complex is situated near an array of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues, where guests will find activities suited to their own acquired tastes. The complex presents a traditional architectural design, blending effortlessly with its surroundings. The guest rooms are spacious and endearing, offering a relaxing space in which to unwind at the end of the day. The complex offers an array of facilities, catering to the needs of each individual guest.

164283.description: Located in the residential Miraflores district of Lima, this excellent hotel makes an ideal place for tourists and those on business trips. It is only 30 minutes by taxi from Lima International Airport and a 20-minute walk from the city's historic old quarter. The single, double, triple and senior suite rooms are all fully equipped to make each stay as comfortable as possible. All have room service, telephone, TV LCD, access to Internet and an en-suite bathroom. The hotel has a large conference hall that can accommodate up to 200 people, equipped with laptops and multimedia projectors, which makes it the ideal place for presentations or press conferences. There is also an events room for banquets. Guests will be spoilt for choice in the restaurant with both traditional Peruvian and international cuisine, and visitors might enjoy music and a local cocktail in the bar.

164284.description: The Torre Tagle Santiago Centro Aparthotel offers fully equipped apartments in the heart of Santiago, just 550 meters from Plaza de Armas. Enjoy easy access to museums, art galleries, theaters, and the metro. Each apartment features an LED TV, spacious living and dining areas, and a well-equipped kitchen with a microwave and refrigerator. Guests can also take advantage of the outdoor pool and on-site laundry facilities. Private parking is available with prior reservation (extra cost). A shuttle service to Arturo Merino Benitez International Airport (30 minutes away) can be arranged. The reception is located in Apartment 219 on the second floor.

164303.description: Situated in Lima's vibrant Miraflores district, just three blocks from the Pacific Ocean, this 4-star hotel offers convenient access to Larcomar's shopping, dining, and entertainment. A 45-minute drive from central Lima, this 44-room air-conditioned hotel provides modern comfort and convenience. Renovated in 2011, the hotel features a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, and on-site parking. Guests can enjoy a restaurant, café, bar, and conference facilities, along with amenities such as Wi-Fi, room service, and laundry service. Each spacious room includes a double or king-size bed, private bathroom, hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, cable TV, in-room safe, minibar, and ironing set. Guests can choose from buffet and à la carte options for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

164305.description: The hotel is situated just a 1-minute walk from Las Ramblas in the Gothic Quarter. Guests can spend many hours walking its labyrinthine streets and are sure to be surprised with every step. Cool bars, cafeterias and clubs are just a 5-minute walk away. The Sagrada Familia is just 4 km from the hostel and the Gaudí buildings are between 2 and 5 km away. Barcelona-El Prat de Llobregat airport is approximately 15 km from the hotel. This cosy and cheap hostel offers functional accommodation with wireless Internet access in public areas. Renovated in 2015, this air-conditioned hostel has a total of 25 rooms on 5 floors, decorated in fun, bright colours. It offers a TV lounge and vending machines, as well as a 24-hour reception, lift access and a breakfast/dining room. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer, and offer a cooker, microwave, air conditioning, heating and a balcony or terrace. A continental breakfast is served each morning at the hotel.

164307.address: Angle Avenue Mohamed Vi Et Avenue Hassane Ii, 4
164307.description: Strategically located in downtown Marrakech, this charming establishment is situated opposite the railway station and just a five-minute walk from the Convention Centre. Travellers cannot miss Jamaâ El Fna Square, a square and market place in the city's medina quarter, located just a 6-minute drive. Menara Gardens are situated to the west of the region and are a 20-minute walk from the hotel. The Menara - Marrakech Airport is only 3. 3 km away. The establishment provides a choice of dining options and guests can taste international cuisine on the restaurants' terrace or relax while enjoying a drink in the pool snack-bar. All the rooms boast a relaxing ambience in which to unwind and the end of the day, they all come with a spacious private bathroom.

164343.description: This delightful complex is located just 1 km from the local public beach in Side. Guests will find links to the public transport network a mere 300 metres away, while a host of restaurants lie just 700 metres from the hotel. Within an easy bus ride away lies entertainment nightspots, the tourist centre and an array of shops and bars. The Side Amphitheatre and Museum, The Temple of Apollo, and the Manavgat Waterfalls are situated within easy access of the hotel. This wonderful beach hotel enjoys an attractive architectural style, blending in harmoniously with its natural surroundings. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated and are well equipped with modern amenities for visitors' convenience and comfort.

164363.address: Richmond Court North End Road Fulham
164363.description: The apartment hotel is just a 10-minute walk from West Brompton Underground Station and only 500 metres from the famous Cromwell Road. Chelsea Football Club is a 20-minute walk away making this city hotel the perfect accommodation for out-of-town supporters of the team. The fully furnished apartment hotel comprises of 12 units in total. The apartments come complete with everything guests would expect to find at home and weekly servicing is provided as standard. They are perfect for families or groups travelling together in style. All accommodation units are en-suite with a shower and a bath. They come further equipped with a TV and Internet access, as well as a kitchen, which features a fridge, a cooker, a microwave and a washing machine. Central heating is provided for additional comfort.

164379.description: 'Park Hotel Villa Giustinian, housed in the meticulously restored 18th-century Villa Giustinian, offers a refined and elegant retreat on Venice's tranquil Riviera del Brenta. The hotel comprises three buildings: the main villa and two annexes, boasting forty elegant rooms and two suites. Each is tastefully appointed with period furnishings, some original to the villa, alongside modern amenities such as a minibar, telephone, satellite TV, and air conditioning. The villa's expansive 18, 000 square meter park features centuries-old trees, a swimming pool (fee applies), and a chalet accommodating up to 200 guests for events and celebrations. While relaxation defines the ambiance at Villa Giustinian, its convenient location offers easy access to Venice, Padua, Treviso, Bassano, and Asolo. '

164404.description: Located in the historic center of Viana do Castelo, Absoluto Design Hotel offers spacious rooms with innovative design and a flat-screen TV. It features free Wi-Fi and a 24-hour front desk. This avant-garde Minho house has modernly decorated rooms with wooden floors. Each of the air-conditioned rooms has a work desk, and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. A breakfast buffet is served daily, while the hotel’s bar offers refreshing drinks. There are also many cafés and restaurants in the area around the hotel. Guests can choose from a variety of activities, including canoeing, cycling and hiking. They can also rent a bike to explore the area or relax in the sun terrace. Absoluto Design is just 3 minutes away from the Republic Square, the Library and the Museum of Costume. A car rental service and a tour desk are available on site.

164412.description: The establishment is ideally located within walking distance of Earls Court tube station and attractions such as the Earls Court Exhibition Centre, Natural History Museum, Victoria and Albert Museum, Stamford Bridge Stadium and many more. A variety of shops, entertainment venues and restaurants can be found within the vicinity of this city hotel. The residence features stylish guest rooms, all of which have private en-suite bathrooms and in-room entertainment facilities. WiFi high-speed Internet access is available throughout the hotel. Every morning guests can enjoy a continental breakfast buffet.

164418.description: The property, with its luxury apartments for rent in the cultural heart of Dubai, offers city living at its finest. Featuring 388 residences overlooking the visually stunning sea and city, the residence is part of a complex comprising of the hotel Hyatt Regency Dubai. Situated along the Deira Corniche, Dubai's renowned waterfront promenade, these apartments enjoy a premium location. The property offers a close knit community atmosphere which makes its residents feel like at home.

164422.description: Ideal both for business trips and leisure stays, the hotel is centrally located close to the Church of St. Ambrose and 230 m from the Sant'Agostino metro station. The city centre of Milan can be reached within a 20 minutes' walk. The hotel features 24-hour reception, express check-in and check-out, concierge service, currency exchange, WIFI, meeting rooms, restaurant, bar, bicycle rental and car hire.

164469.description: Located only 3 minutes away on foot from the main Oporto Airport terminal building, this hotel is also very close to 2 metro stations, putting the city centre within easy reach. The hotel bar is surrounded with comfortable couches, nice lighting and soft music, making it the perfect venue for an informal drink before or after dinner. Guest rooms are soundproofed, and there is a range of facilities on offer, such as free Wi-Fi, 24-hour reception, luggage storage, photocopying or concierge services. Private parking is available on site at extra charge.

164473.address: 7 Obokun Close, Off Obafemi Awolowo Way, Ikeja, 7
164473.description: Located in the peaceful Obokun Close, just off Johnson Street, this family-friendly hotel is a convenient 15-20 minute drive from the International Airport and 13 km from Lagos Lagoon. Its 25 well-appointed rooms feature modern keycard access, and guests can enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant and bar. Additional amenities include secure parking, wireless internet access, and conference/banqueting facilities.

164475.description: Situated in a picturesque location right on Lake Zurich with a backdrop of the mountains, this contemporary style business hotel is perfect for guests doing business in Zurich combined with the tranquillity of the Swiss landscape. Horgen train station is right next to the hotel, providing a train connection to the city centre and Zurich-Kloten airport in 20 minutes and 30 minutes, respectively. Horgen ship station is just 3 minutes away.

164479.description: This charming hotel is strategically situated in the picturesque area of Plaka, 200 metres from Syntagma Square. The central shopping district of Athens is a short stroll from the hotel. Local tourist attractions such as Metropolis Greek Orthodox Cathedral and Greek Folk Art Museum are not far from the hotel. Also easily within reach are Museum of Greek Popular Musical Instruments, Roman Agora (Forum) and Tower of the Winds. It offers a rooftop terrace with hot tub and Acropolis view.

164490.description: The Hotel Avenir Montmartre is a charming, 2-star hotel in the mythical and lively district of Montmartre. Located in front of the emblematic Basilica of the Sacred Heart, its excellent location serves as the perfect point of departure for enjoying your stay in Paris. Founded in 1966 and recently refurbished, the Hotel Avenir Montmartre hotel combines the charm of the past with modern comforts. The hotel has 42 soundproofed, fully equipped rooms (Wi-Fi, telephone and television), some of them with views to the Basilica of the Sacred Heart. In the Hotel Avenir Montmartre hotel you will be able to enjoy the typical French breakfast in your room. It is served every morning, from 7:00 to 9:00 h, and includes delicious pastries as well as hot and cold drinks. And for your comfort, there is a public parking only 30 meters away from the hotel. *0, 90 EUR City tax per person per night, direct payment at the hotel.

164546.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Additional amenities at this Beaux Arts hotel include wedding services and a television in a common area. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Gulbahar, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Istanbul? This hotel has 753 square feet (70 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

164550.address: Via Malamocco, 14 Marghera Via Trieste / Entr. Aut, 14
164550.description: A newly built, modern hotel in a perfect location: 9. 3 miles (15 km) from Venice Marco Polo airport, 10 minutes from Venice Mestre train station, and 15 minutes by bus (no. 6) from the historic center of Venice (Piazzale Roma). The hotel's 99 rooms are spacious, comfortable, bright, air conditioned and soundproofed. The hotel is dedicated to business and families, and boasts free WIFI, meeting room, bar, restaurant, car park and transfer service (reservation required; charges apply).

164559.description: An outstanding hotel serving in a historical building in Taksim, in the heart of this extraordinary city. AKKA Lush offers a privileged experience with its stylish and comfortable rooms meeting different needs, with the facilities making life easier and the understanding of outstanding service. The hotel is located just 300 metres away from Taksim Square, İstiklal Street and in easy reachable place to entertainment venues, sightseeing attractions and shopping opportunities. *Guests under the age of 18 can check-in with own parent or legal guardian. *Our hotels are a 'Non-Smoking Hotels' and smoking is prohibited in the indoor areas of the hotel, including the rooms. *100 Euro deposit is taken from our guests at check-in in order to guarantee their possible extra expenses and material damages that may occur within the hotel. From January 01, 2022, we started to take a deposit (100 Euro) from our guests at check-in in order to guarantee their possible extra expenses and material damages that may occur within the hotel.

164614.description:
This family-run 2-star hotel is located in the Gracia neighbourhood, just a few metres' walk from Park Güell and with excellent connections to the city centre. 
The underground is only 10 minutes away, and next to the hotel you will find a bus that takes you directly to Plaça Catalunya, Las Ramblas and Plaça Espanya. 

Check-in is available from 3:30 PM until 11:00 PM. Check-out is until 12:00 PM (noon). The hotel reception is open daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM. If you plan to arrive after 11:00 PM, please contact the Reception Team in advance. You will be sent a link to complete the mandatory online check-in before your arrival. 

All rooms are simply decorated and comfortable. Please note that the local tourist tax is not included in the booked rate. This will be charged directly at the hotel and paid upon check-in. 

We offer a daily buffet breakfast service at an additional cost. 12€ per person and per night. 

We accept pets in our hotel rooms, maximum 2 and at a cost of €16 per night per pet. Pets are not allowed in the Apartment. 

We also offer parking spaces in a nearby building, not directly connected to the hotel, for a supplement of €25 per night (reservation required)

164627.description: In the heart of Venice's historic centre, this hotel boasts a prime situation just 200 metres from Piazza San Marco and 500 metres from Rialto Bridge. Guests will find themselves close to the world-renowned Piazza San Marco and to San Zaccaria Church, where they can admire one of Bellini's masterpieces, La Sacra Conversazione (Holy conversation). In addition, a wide choice of bars, restaurants and Murano glass shops are to be found in the surrounding area. Visitors will appreciate the elegant and spacious rooms featuring all the charm of a Venetian historic residence and offering all the necessary modern conveniences for guests to feel right at home, such as Wi-Fi internet connection. The onsite facilities include a terrace with breathtaking views over Piazza San Marco's Belltower and the friendly staff will assist visitors with tour bookings and recreational activities. Reception (limited hours). Check in within 22:00. In case of late arrival clients are required to contact the hotel at least 12 hours prior arrival to arrange key collection.

164628.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a rooftop terrace and a garden. Additional features at this guesthouse include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the guesthouse's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Make yourself at home in one of the 16 guestrooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

164629.description: This superb hotel is situated just 200 metres away from the vibrant Taksim Square in Istanbul. This prime setting offers guests a private hideaway with easy access to the cultural and historical attractions of the city. A short walking distance away from the hotel, guests will find fashionable bars and restaurants, as well as exciting shopping opportunities and lively entertainment options. Nearby places of interest include the Galata Tower, Dolmabahce Palace, the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace and Hagia Sofia. Links to the public transport network are also available in close proximity. This stylish hotel offers comfortable accommodation options and excellent facilities. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated and provide relaxing surroundings in which to enjoy restful slumber. Guests can dine in style in the restaurant, and enjoy the delectable culinary delights the menu has to offer.

164630.description: This charming hotel is situated in a popular shopping and touristic area of Istanbul. Located just a 10 minutes' walking distance away from the vibrant Taksim Square, and a 10 minutes' drive from the renowned district of Sultanahmet, this delightful hotel provides the ideal setting for travellers who are eager to explore the cultural and historical attractions this mesmerising city has to offer. Guests will find wonderful restaurants, cafes, entertainment venues and exciting shopping opportunities within easy access of the hotel. This modern boutique hotel occupies a historical building, and has captured the essence of its former glory. Preserving the distinctive architectural characteristics of the original buildings, this stunning hotel welcomes guests with style, charm and warm hospitality.

164735.description: This hotel revels in the splendour of its surroundings in Lima. The hotel is surrounded by a wealth of attractions, offering guests a great setting from which to explore this wonderful city. The hotel is situated within easy access of a host of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. The hotel enjoys a superb designed, exuding sophistication and elegance. The guest rooms are wonderfully designed, offering a relaxing setting in which to escape the rest of the world. Guests can enjoy a leisurely swim in the pool, or simply unwind in the jacuzzi. Guests can enjoy the many facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

name.content: Rixos The Palm Hotel & Suites Ultra All Inclusive

164765.description: The Rixos The Palm Luxury Suite Collection offers unparalleled accommodation. The suites, conveniently located in a dedicated building adjacent to the main hotel Rixos The Palm Hotel & Suites ALL INCLUSIVE, offer exclusivity and privacy. The collection promises travellers the ultimate luxury lifestyle, combining the homely comforts of a private residence with two, three, four and five-bedroom suites, ideal for larger groups or multigenerational families seeking the ultimate holiday sanctuary. The Rixos The Palm Luxury Suite Collection 1-kilometre private white sand beach, excellent food & beverage outlets, a private helipad, a comprehensive wellness and sports programme led by Exclusive Sports Club, an enhanced Rixy Kids Club, and the secluded Anjana Spa, all ensure guests have the opportunity to immerse themselves in a truly integrated luxury hospitality experience.

164789.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This hotel also features concierge services, a fireplace in the lobby, and a picnic area. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 39 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and minibars. Your Select Comfort bed comes with Egyptian cotton sheets. 49-inch Smart televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries.

164870.description: Located in the heart of Paris, Le Metropolitan Paris Tour Eiffel, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, is just a short drive from iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe. This luxurious hotel offers 48 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring a private balcony or patio, an iPod docking station, an LCD television with satellite programming, and a pillowtop bed with premium bedding. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, relax with a massage or facial at the spa, take a dip in the indoor pool, or unwind in the steam room. The hotel also provides a 24-hour room service, the Metropolitan Restaurant, a bar/lounge, and concierge services. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, express check-in/check-out, limo/town car service, and two meeting rooms. Continental breakfasts are available for a fee, and self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

name.content: Hôtel Le Tourville by Inwood Hotels

164871.description: Address of the great writers, Le Tourville hotel is located in the center of Paris, between the Eiffel Tower and Les Invalides. This romantic hotel, with clean lines, ideal for lovers of literature, is nestled in the 7th district, in a active neighborhood full of life and poetry. Lover of letters and words, passionate about books, Le Tourville hotel embodies the Art of Living of the writer. It is a place imbued with passion, where words and emotions are mixed in all respects.

164885.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Le Centenaire Brussels Expo, located in the Laken area of Brussels, within a 15-minute walk of the Atomium and Brussels Expo. This hotel offers 15 individually decorated guestrooms, each equipped with a DVD player, LCD TV, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) at the on-site restaurant, and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include express check-in/check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and tour/ticket assistance. Nearby attractions include Heysel Park, Mini-Europe and the Royal Greenhouses of Laeken. Brussels Airport (BRU) is the closest airport.

164918.description:
The riad has 2 buildings (1 with 7 bedrooms and the other with 5 bedrooms) and the distance between the two buildings is less than 10 meters. A Riad with a thousand and one night atmosphere, with modern comfort, rooms with the best mattresses on the market, very comfortably furnished, air conditioning, flat screen satellite television. the private bathroom is equipped with free toiletries. and a Terrace in the evening took your breath away. 
RIAD LA ROSE DU DESERT serves breakfast every morning and you can also enjoy Moroccan dishes in the dining room or on the terrace
as well as an excursion office and other different activities organized in Marrakech and outside the city

164931.description: The 138 Liberdade Hotel graces the heart of Avenida Liberdade, boasting a stunning decor that blends contemporary art with classic details to create a unique ambiance. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant and a tranquil terrace, a perfect escape from the bustling street. Each room is individually decorated with historic photos and images of Lisbon's landmarks. Popular neighborhoods like Chiado, Bairro Alto, and Alfama are within a 15-minute walk. The hotel is conveniently located just steps from the metro and a 20-minute walk from the famed Castelo de São Jorge.

164936.description: Located in the district of Kumkoy, 5 km west along the coast from the historical ruins and resort of Side, this family-friendly hotel features spacious grounds which lead down to the pristine sandy beach, complimented by the turquoise-coloured shimmer of the Mediterranean Sea. Kumkoy, less than a 10 minutes' walking distance from the hotel, offers ample opportunities for adventure and discovery. This well-connected setting boasts ease of access to a host of public transport links, a mere 200 metres away from the hotel doorstep. Guests can retire to the delightful guest rooms, where modern furnishings and comfort-inducing fabrics await. Ideal for business and leisure travellers alike, this hotel boasts a warm, friendly atmosphere and professional service.

164937.description: This superb, boutique hotel is located in Taksim Square in Istanbul. Guests will find themselves in the perfect setting from which to explore the cultural and historical attractions this mesmerising city has to offer. The lively Istiklal Street with its countless shops, restaurants and cafes lies nearby, while the attractions at Sultanahmet are just 3. 7 km away and are easily accessible via nearby links to the public transport network. This modern hotel features a contemporary Art Deco style, with vibrant colours and silver and gold tones adorning the interior design. The guest rooms are superbly decorated in a modern style, featuring elegant furniture and sound proofing to ensure a restful night's slumber. Business and leisure travellers alike will be impressed by the hotel's selection of exemplary facilities.

164938.description: This upscale city hotel is located on the Asian side of Istanbul. The hotel is situated a mere 500 metres away from the famous Bagdat shopping street and is 750 metres away from the Bostanci ferry port. Guests will find a myriad of entertainment venues, bars and cafes in the area, as well as a host of intriguing cultural and historical attractions. This modern hotel enjoys an attractive architectural style, welcoming guests with the promise of warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are superbly appointed and come complete with modern amenities for visitors' convenience and comfort. The hotel provides a wide choice of excellent leisure amenities, including Turkish baths, a hot tub and invigorating massage treatments.

164939.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services and discounted use of a nearby fitness facility. Enjoy French cuisine at Restaurant 24, a restaurant where you can take in the ocean view, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are served on weekdays from 8:00 AM to noon and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

164941.address: Kuloğlu Mh., Sadri Alışık Sk. No:26, 26
164941.description: The Taksim Prelude Hotel, a beautifully restored 1836 heritage building, is located in the heart of Istanbul's vibrant Taksim Square, steps from Istiklal Avenue. Combining old-world charm with modern comforts, the hotel offers aesthetically designed rooms and common spaces. Many rooms and the lobby feature fireplaces, perfect for cozy winter evenings. Guests can also enjoy panoramic views of the historical peninsula from the top-floor terrace. The hotel's prime location provides easy access to numerous restaurants, art galleries, shops, and public transportation. At Taksim Prelude Hotel, carefully selected staff members strive to provide the highest quality of service.

164963.description: This city aparthotel is located in the heart of the Beyoglu district of Istanbul. The complex is strategically situated in the vicinity of the Pera historical area, and is surrounded by attractions, restaurants and exciting entertainment venues. The vibrant Taksim Square is situated just a 15 minutes' walking distance away, and the exciting shopping opportunities at Istiklal Square also lie just a short stroll from this aparthotel. This impressive complex occupies a historical building which dates back to the early 1900s. Featuring the typical characteristics of French architecture, this stunning establishment beautifully combines modernism with history. The guest rooms are superbly appointed and provide a cocoon of peace and serenity in which to completely relax and unwind at the end of the day.

164966.description: Treat yourself to a comfy stay in the capital at The Best Western London Highbury, as this incredibly convenient hotel places in the heart of London. You'll be offered the warmest of welcomes and ultimate access to the city, thanks to the great transport links nearby. Finsbury Park and Manor House Underground tube stations are just 500 meters from the hotel, giving you a fast connection to Central London, Kings Cross Station and St. Pancras International. Central London is bursting with famous tourist attractions, entertainment hotspots, music venues, and diverse cultural districts. You'll also find some of the capital's most prominent business areas and sporting venues, such as Tottenham Football Stadium nearby, so there will never be a dull moment. Stop off at Kings Cross for a visit to the Harry Potter Shop, and a quick photo on platform 9 ¾ - before you head to Hogwarts of course. The two tube stations also offer direct routes to Trafalgar Square and Camden, and the famous canalside Camden Market. A public bus service is also available just outside the hotel, so you can come, go and come back again as you please. The Best Western London Highbury enjoys the luxury of a charming location, overlooking the wonderful Finsbury Park, one of the first great London parks landscaped in the Victorian era. Each en suite bedroom – whether it be a single, double, twin, triple or quadruple - is tastefully decorated with shades of cream and inviting splashes of red. Satellite television and tea and coffee making facilities are also included to complete your comfortable stay, so book today and enjoy having the whole of London at your fingertips.

164987.description: This hotel represents the rich cultural heritage of the post-colonial history of Peru. The centrepiece of the complex is a Spanish colonial-style mansion, or 'house', built in 1923, a relic which preserves an amazing piece of unique traditions of Peru. Situated in a quiet and secure area, but just minutes away from fine restaurants, large shopping venues and the lively nightlife. Guests will be within walking distance of lovely parks, close to the sea and the famous folklore shows in Park of Miraflores. All rooms are decorated with lovely wooden handmade furniture, original artwork and antiques in order to create a truly unique vibe. But guests can also enjoy premium bedding, TVs, air conditioning and WiFi. The best place to relax at the end of the day is the onsite bar, tastefully decorated with plenty of comfortable lounges to choose from for a quiet drink or a first class cappuccino.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Tower of London

164990.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast, Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Executive Lounge. Easy access to the Olympic Park, this contemporary custom made hotel is in the heart of London's financial district. Located beside the Tower of London and built on the site of the medieval Crutched Friars Monastery, Samuel Pepys House and the 18th Century Naval College, the hotel is in one of the key historical and tourist areas of London. With its blend of modern design and high quality facilities, this is the biggest hotel of its kind in the City of London. • Stylish guestrooms with flat screen TVs, • Luxury suites and Executive rooms • 10 meeting rooms - with built-in audio and natural daylight• Complimentary WiFi available in the public areas

164991.description: Riu Plaza London The Westminster, an iconic hotel comprising of stylish and uniquely designed rooms. Located in the heart of historic London, Riu Plaza London The Westminster is characterised by some of the most iconic landmarks of the capital. The Houses of Parliament, one of the world's most famous clocks, ‘Big Ben' and Westminster Abbey are just a short stroll away. The property has been fully renovated in 2021 with stylish and modern décor throughout, a 24-hour front desk and concierge services are available.

164992.address: Park Lane Corner of Mount Street and Park Lane, 86
164992.description: Grosvenor House Suites by Jumeirah Living offers contemporary luxury and privacy on London's sophisticated Park Lane, overlooking iconic Hyde Park. Located in Mayfair, these apartments are close to major attractions, catering to both leisure and business travelers. A stunning second-floor atrium welcomes guests with its seven-story vaulted glass ceiling and majestic fireplace. Enjoy delicious contemporary cuisine in an exquisite setting. The newly refurbished 1920s era building houses 130 modern apartments and penthouses, ranging from studios to a five-bedroom penthouse. Guest facilities include a private entrance, full kitchens, courtyard dining, 24-hour room service, a deli-style delivery service tailored by the At Home team, fitness room access, and state-of-the-art technology. Each apartment features stylish contemporary interiors, from lavish dark oak flooring to chic wall paneling. Grosvenor House Suites combines classic and contemporary elements, offering a dedicated concierge service, state-of-the-art technology, and bespoke furniture.

164993.description: Located just 6km from Porte d'Italie in Chevilly-Larue, close to Paris, the Adonis Paris Sud aparthotel offers convenient access to public transport. A tram stop is just 50 meters away, and the Villejuif Louis-Aragon RER station, with direct trains to Paris, is a short 10-minute drive. Orly Airport is also easily reachable in just 7 minutes by car. Built in 2012, this modern 5-story hotel features 138 studios and apartments, ranging from 20 to 50 m², each equipped with a kitchenette (including a fridge, microwave, and tea/coffee facilities), a washing machine, and en-suite shower. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as a lobby, breakfast room, and paid parking. A continental breakfast buffet is available daily.

165025.description: Centrally located in Paris, Le Dokhan’s, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, is within a 5-minute drive of the Arc de Triomphe and Eiffel Tower. This luxury hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a cozy lobby fireplace. The 45 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, LCD televisions, and private bathrooms with designer toiletries. Guests can enjoy 24-hour room service, or dine at the hotel restaurant and bar/lounge. Continental breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Additional amenities include limo/town car service, express check-in/check-out, and airport shuttle (surcharge). The hotel also offers conference space for events.

165031.description:
In the very heart of Barcelona, Andante Drassanes Hotel invites you to enjoy a stay that is comfortable, practical and thoughtfully designed. 
Designed for travellers who want to unwind without stepping away from city life, it combines bright spaces, practical services and a calm atmosphere just a few steps from La Rambla and the harbour. It features 134 rooms of different types, all equipped with a television and a full bathroom with a hairdryer, designed to offer comfort and well-being. 
True to the philosophy of the Andante Hotels group, Andante Drassanes reflects a genuine commitment to sustainability and conscious hospitality, incorporating efficient materials and responsible processes. Our vision is to offer high-quality services with a personal touch, maintaining a balance between comfort and sustainability. Our goal is to establish ourselves as a benchmark for responsible tourism in Barcelona. 
Our values — commitment, respect, teamwork and customer focus — are the foundation of an authentic and human experience. 
Here, comfort moves to its own rhythm: yours. 
Located just a few steps from Las Ramblas, the Gothic Quarter and Port Vell, Andante Drassanes Hotel places the city within easy walking distance. 
Well-connected to the airport and cruise terminal, and close to the World Trade Center, it combines convenience and connectivity in a calm, central setting. 
The perfect starting point for experiencing Barcelona at your own pace.

165046.description: Clients will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Walrus Inns as it counts with a total of 9 rooms.

165050.description: Situated in the Gothic Quarter, the hotel boasts a privileged location not far from Barcelona Cathedral. Just 300 m away is Plaza Catalunya, where guests will find excellent bus and metro links. This establishment offers guests comfortable accommodation in a friendly atmosphere. The hotel has 31 stylish rooms and a number of in-house facilities. Guests can enjoy a drink at the café and bar and dine in the restaurant. Conference facilities are provided for business travellers. The elegant rooms are decorated with top-quality materials, including walls and wardrobes panelled with Madagascar ebony, gold leaf accents and Rimadesio doors. All units display unique pieces from the Masriera Art Nouveau jewellery collection and are decorated in deep colours.

165060.description: This luxury hotel is located directly in the vibrant Via Augusta area of the city of Barcelona. Numerous shops as well as restaurants, cafés and bars are in the hotel's immediate vicinity. The nearest beach is approximately 2. 5 km away and the property is close to various public transport stops. The hotel was built in 1965, fully renovated in 2003 and consists of 103 double rooms on 9 floors. The building features a 24-hour reception lobby, a hotel safe and a lift. The hotel's facilities include a café, a bar and a TV room. Guests can also enjoy an air-conditioned restaurant, a conference room and a car park. There is also a laundry and room services available. The pleasantly furnished en-suite rooms come fitted with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV and a minibar. Free Wi-Fi internet is available throughout the hotel and a breakfast buffet is offered every morning.

165062.description: The Kube Hotel, housed in a classic 19th-century building on a quiet street, offers a unique blend of historic charm and high-tech amenities. It features a restaurant, two bars (including the Ice Kube by Grey Goose, Paris's only ice bar), 41 rooms and suites, two reception rooms, and a fitness area. The Junior Suite includes a king-size bed, desk, open bathroom, separate WC, flat-screen TV, and a Playstation 3 for gaming and playing CDs/DVDs. Guests also enjoy an Illy espresso machine, safe, and complimentary Wi-Fi. An extra bed is available upon request. The hotel can be fully reserved for special events, accommodating up to 600 people. *Please note: The restaurant is closed from August 4th to 20th (breakfast and room service are still available), and the Ice Bar is closed until September.

165063.description: Upon entering their rooms, guests are enveloped in a tranquil oasis of pure white comfort, with stylish yet practical furnishings ensuring a relaxing stay. Located in the vibrant Le Marais district, near Notre Dame Cathedral and just steps from the Fille du Calvaire Metro Station, the 1K Paris offers a unique South American-inspired experience. The hotel's newly decorated lobby, contemporary restaurant, and two bars boast Peruvian masks, deep blues, gold motifs, and other Incan-inspired decorative elements. Modern and spacious rooms and suites feature customizable lighting, premium bedding, and large Italian-style showers or romantic floor-level bathtubs. For rejuvenation, guests can enjoy a personalized workout in the well-equipped gym. Charles de Gaulle Airport is a 42-minute drive (31 kilometers) from the hotel.

165375.description: This comfortable hotel enjoys a prime setting close to the Lutfi Kirdar Congress Centre and the Cemal Resit Rey concern hall. The hotel provides the ideal base for business and leisure travellers alike visiting the city. The hotel is located close to links to the public transport network which provides ease of access to a host of intriguing attractions, including the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, the Grand Bazaar and the vibrant Taksim Square. This modern city hotel tempts guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated and come complete with modern amenities for visitors' convenience. Guests can enjoy a delightful, continental breakfast in the mornings, which is sure to set them up for the day.

name.content: The Meretto Hotel Old City Istanbul

165379.description: This upscale city hotel is located just 600 metres away from the Aksaray underground station in the district of Fatih in Istanbul. The hotel is ideally located just 2 km from the famous landmarks at Sultanahmet, including the Blue Mosque, the Grand Bazaar, Topkapi Palace and Hagia Sophia. Shops and restaurants are to be found close to the hotel, while the vibrant Taksim Square is just 4. 5 km away. This modern city hotel comprises 33 rooms and welcomes guests with warm hospitality and impeccable service. The guest rooms are superbly designed and feature modern amenities for the comfort and convenience of every type of traveller. The hotel provides guests with the comfort of a Spa, where they can indulge in invigorating treatments.

165382.description: This charming city hotel boasts a prime setting at the heart of the Sultanahmet district of Istanbul. The hotel is located a mere 400 metres away from the Blue Mosque, and offers the perfect setting for travellers who are eager to explore the exciting sights and sounds this mesmerising city has to offer. Topkapi Palace, the vibrant Grand Bazaar with its colourful shopping opportunities and Hagia Sophia are also within easy reach of the hotel. This modern city hotel enjoys an attractive architectural style, fitting in perfectly to its culturally-rich surroundings. The guest rooms are superbly appointed, offering a relaxing environment in which to completely unwind. Guests are invited to dine in the restaurant and enjoy the delectable delights the menu has to offer.

165384.description: This superb city hotel enjoys a prime setting in the lower area of the Sultanahmet district of Istanbul. The hotel is located a mere 5 minutes' walking distance away from the Blue Mosque, as well as Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sophia and the exciting Grand Bazaar. The hotel is well-connected to other parts of the city via nearby links to the public transport network. The Marmara Sea and the Underground Cisterns are also situated nearby, while the nearest nightspots and the city centre at the vibrant Taksim Square is just 4. 5 km away from the hotel. This wonderful hotel offers guests high-quality accommodation, excellent service and a sublime location in this mesmerising city. Guests can enjoy a vigorous workout in the gym, followed by a massage or a relaxing Hammam experience. Guests will also be impressed by the delightful culinary treats which are served in the restaurant.

165386.address: HOCAPASA MAH. DERVISLER SOKAK NO:7 Sirkeci, 7
165386.description: The hotel is located just a few metres from Gulhane Park and Sirkeci train station on the Golden Horn in the Sultanahmet district of the city. Local amenities such as shops, cafes and restaurants are all within close proximity and a tramline runs 250m away from the hotel providing the closest link to the public transport system. This is a city hotel offering comfortable accommodation. It features a cafe restaurant. A sauna and hammam are available for guests who wish to relax, while the free wireless Internet access will ensure that they remain connected with friends and family throughout their holiday.

165388.description: This upscale city hotel is situated in the Laleli district of Istanbul. The hotel is situated just a few minutes' walking distance away from the Aksaray underground station, and is just 1. 8 km from the intriguing attractions in the Sultanahmet district of the city. In Sultanahmet, guests can indulge in a unique shopping experience at the Grand Bazaar, or admire the stunning Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace and Hagia Sophia. This charming hotel is the perfect choice for business and leisure travellers alike visiting the city, due to its excellent location, impeccable service and exceptional facilities. Guests will be impressed by the soothing ambience of the rooms which are beautifully decorated and come complete with modern amenities. The hotel provides a selection of exceptional leisure amenities for the ultimate rejuvenating experience.

165416.description: This guesthouse is set in central Madrid, just 150 m from the Puerta del Sol and Plaza Mayor. The shops and theatres on Gran Vía are a short walk away. Plaza de Oriente and the Royal Palace are also located within walking distance of the property. Madrid-Barajas Airport is approximately 15 km, while Puerta del Sol underground station is roughly 200 metres from the establishment. This family-friendly residence has air conditioning and comprises a total of 25 accommodation units. All rooms provide the amenities needed for a comfortable stay and enjoy plenty of natural light. In addition, standard features include Internet access and individually regulated air conditioning and heating.

167462.description: Situated in Barcelona's vibrant Diagonal Mar district, near the CCIB congress center and Diagonal Mar shopping center, the Vincci Bit Hotel offers a unique blend of modern art and comfortable accommodations. Each floor showcases stunning graffiti murals by nationally and internationally acclaimed illustrators and designers. The hotel's 177 bright rooms provide excellent amenities. Guests can enjoy market-fresh cuisine with local influences at the Hopen restaurant, featuring cozy indoor seating in winter and an open-air terrace during summer. A rooftop pool, sun loungers, a small gym, and a sauna are also available for guests to relax and rejuvenate. *Pool open during the summer.

167482.description: The hotel is centrally located in midtown Manhattan, near to attractions such as the Empire State Building, Madison Square Garden, Herald Square, and some of the best nightlife and dining. Broadway theatres and Times Square are easily accessible by subway. Penn Station is approximately 10 minutes away. This charming family-friendly hotel was built in 2011 and comprises a total of 122 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour check-out service, as well as a hotel safe and lift access to the upper floors. It offers complimentary wireless Internet access in public areas and room service. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel garage (fees apply). All rooms have a tiled en suite bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer. Each room offers a king-size bed, direct dial telephone, 32-inch flat-screen TV with a choice of 48 channels, radio, Internet access, a safe and an ironing set. A mini fridge, microwave and tea and coffee making facilities are also provided. Individually regulated air conditioning and individually regulated heating are standard features in all accommodation units. Guests can work out in the complimentary 24-hour gym. Guests can enjoy a drink at the café or seasonal rooftop bar, and dine in the lobby restaurant. Breakfast is served each morning, and lunch and dinner are each offered from an à la carte menu. From New York LaGuardia International Airport, take Grand Central Parkway West. At exit 35W, take the ramp right to join the I-495 W (Long Island Expressway) towards Midtown Tunnel (Manhattan). After exiting from Midtown Tunnel, take slight right onto E 37th street. Turn left at 5th Avenue and then right at W 31st street to reach the hotel.

167506.description: With a prime location in the city centre, this hotel is a short walk from Hyde Park. Paddington station is only 300 m from the hotel, putting the whole city and its attractions within easy reach, and Big Ben is only 600 metres away. The hotel offers cosy apartments with a stylish décor, modern kitchens and Wi-Fi access, with bare wooden floors and a contemporary design. The hotel also provides laundry and bicycle rental services.

167507.description:
Hyde Park Economy Apartments offers self-catering accommodation just 150 m from central London's leafy Hyde Park. Queensway Tube Station is just 2 minutes' walk away.
Set within a Georgian townhouse, Hyde Park Economy Apartments offers a choice of studios and apartments. Each comes fully equipped with a flat-screen TV, a dining area, and a private bathroom. Laundry facilities are also available. The studios have a cosy seating area and the apartments boast a separate lounge.
The compact kitchenettes in the apartments and studios have a microwave, fridge, and essential kitchenware. There are numerous restaurants, bars, and cafes within a 5-minute stroll.

In lively Bayswater, Hyde Park Economy Apartments are a 5-minute walk from Whiteleys Shopping Centre. The shops of Oxford Street and the famous Museum Mile can be reached after a 20-minute walk.

167508.description:
The serviced Paddington Apartments enjoy a wonderful location in London, only a 5-minute stroll away from Hyde Park. Marble Arch and the elegant shopping of Oxford Street can be reached within a short stroll, while attractions such as Buckingham Palace, the Natural History Museum or the Victoria and Albert Museum are within easy reach. Paddington train and tube stations are just a step away, providing easy access to all areas of the city.
The tastefully furnished apartments are excellently appointed and sleep up to four people. They are decorated in an urban style with wooden floors and contemporary furnishings. Excellent features include complimentary wireless internet access, flat-screen satellite-TV and a well-equipped kitchen. This is an ideal base for couples, families or groups of friends wishing to explore all this vibrant city has to offer.

167509.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include wedding services, a television in a common area, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, Cast Iron Bar and Grill, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 4144 square feet (385 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 9 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 217 guestrooms featuring Smart televisions. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed.

167522.description: Located on Calle Chacabuco in Buenos Aires, this charming hotel is within walking distance of Independence Avenue and 9 de Julio Avenue, offering easy access to public transportation. Just 9 km from Jorge Newbery Airport, it immerses guests in the rich culture and history of the area, featuring Argentinian traditional influences. The beautifully-designed guest rooms are well-equipped with modern amenities, complemented by a wide range of hotel services and facilities.

167524.description: The hotel is located on the bank of the river Douro. It is 80 km from the Oporto International Airport and 1. 5 km from the picturesque village of Cold Mesao. It has many cultural attractions within walking distance. The hotel is set amid an area of vineyards where guests can have a closer contact with the world of wine. The hotel has a total of 43 accommodation units, each of which is air-conditioned and fitted with modern amenities. The hotel also features an antique chapel, an outdoor pool, a heated indoor pool, games room, events room, library and an SPA centre. Sports enthusiasts can enjoy the gym and tennis courts. The hotel has a bar and a panoramic restaurant.

168429.description: Discover affordable comfort and convenience at the Best Western Fort Lee, just minutes from the excitement of Manhattan. This New Jersey hotel offers spacious, clean rooms and exceptional service at a fraction of the price of New York City accommodations. Enjoy a complimentary breakfast featuring hot waffles, fresh fruit, pastries, and more to start your day right. Whether you're visiting for business or leisure, our friendly staff is happy to provide recommendations for exploring nearby attractions like MetLife Stadium, Times Square, Yankee Stadium, and even the Statue of Liberty, all within a short drive or cab ride. A perfect choice for travelers seeking proximity to Farleigh Dickenson University, as well as corporate travelers visiting companies such as General Electric, Siemens, Unilever, and Deloitte. Book your stay today and experience the best of both worlds!

168441.description: The Robert Treat Hotel is the perfect setting for your organization's next meeting or social function. We offer six fully-equipped conference rooms, each capable of accommodating groups up to 50 people. Five banquet rooms accommodate larger groups including the impressive Tri-State Ballroom, largest in the region capable of seating up to 1, 500. Enjoy your stay. Minimum check-in age is 21 years old.

168468.description: Located in Massapequa Park, our hotel offers convenient access to a wealth of recreational activities. Spend an evening at the Northwell Health Theater at Jones Beach, tee off at Bethpage State Park Golf Course, or enjoy the sun and sand at Robert Moses State Park on Fire Island. Sports fans can catch an NHL hockey game or concert at the UBS Arena. For a thrilling experience, the Belmont Stakes at Belmont Racetrack in Elmont is an exciting option. Our hotel features an indoor heated pool and a 24-hour fitness center. We're the closest hotel to Jones Beach State Park and Northwell Health Theater, and conveniently located within five miles of several wedding venues, making us a popular choice for wedding guests. Start your day with our complimentary breakfast featuring waffles, fresh fruit, pastries, cereals, yogurt, and 100% Arabica coffee. Business travelers appreciate our value and location, with easy access to Sunrise Mall, Walmart, and South Shore Mall. We also accommodate numerous contractors. All major New York airports are within 25-40 miles of our hotel.

168480.description: 'The West Gate Inn Nyack offers 80 comfortable guestrooms equipped with microwaves, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast, a restaurant, bar/lounge, and a 24-hour business center. Additional amenities include free self-parking, a banquet hall, and tour/ticket assistance. Located near Nyack Hospital, the Edward Hopper House Art Center, and Palisades Center, the hotel provides easy access to local attractions. Westchester County Airport (HPN) is the nearest airport. '

name.content: SureStay Plus by Best Western Woodbury Inn

168485.description: Whether you are in town for business or here to play one of America’s most famous golf courses, the Best Western Woodbury Inn is ready to pamper guests with award-winning accommodations and a great location. Situated just off the Jericho Turnpike, we are in the heart of Long Island – less than 1 mile from Interstate 495 and just minutes from the center of Bethpage. Golf courses, parks, and shopping opportunities are all within easy reach. Spread out in our oversized rooms featuring premium bedding and comfortable seating areas. Pets are welcome in some rooms and we also offer executive rooms. Everyone is treated to perks like flat-screen televisions showing in-room movies, a generous work area, a refrigerator, and a microwave oven. Start your day right with our expanded complimentary breakfast buffet. Stay connected with free high-speed internet. Burn off some steam in our well-equipped fitness center. Plunge into our beautiful outdoor pool. Host your next reception or corporate retreat in our banquet room. Golf is big on Long Island, and our Woodbury, NY hotel is close to the courses at Oyster Bay, Cold Spring, Woodside, and Bethpage. In town for a show? NYCB Theatre at Westbury is close by, as is The Paramount. Ready to explore? North Shore is just a few miles away and nearby you will find the Planting Fields Arboretum. In need of retail therapy? Head for Walt Whitman Mall and Tanger Outlet Mall.

168488.description: Choose this charming Flushing, New York hotel ideally located minutes away from La Guardia Airport, Shea Stadium and downtown Manhattan attractions. Welcome to the Best Western Queens Court Hotel, where guests will find friendly customer service, clean accommodations and easy access into downtown Manhattan, New York. This Flushing area hotel boasts well-appointed guest rooms, each featuring cable satellite television and high-speed Internet access. Additional amenities include a fitness center, business services and meeting facilities. Guests staying at the Best Western Queens Court Hotel will be close to a variety of local restaurants as well as the subway into downtown New York City. Guests can visit key New York attractions including Times Square, the Statue of Liberty and the Rockefeller Center. Less than two miles from this New York hotel, guests will be able to catch a Mets game at Shea Stadium or visit the USTA National Tennis Center, home of the U. S. Open. Visitors will also be able to enjoy a relaxing day touring the Queens Botanical Gardens or walking through the beautiful Flushing Meadows Park. The hotel also provides convenient access to St. John University, the Citifield Stadium and the Jacobs Javitz Convention Center. The friendly, helpful staff at the Best Western Queens Court Hotel is ready to ensure a fun-filled memorable stay in Flushing, New York. Make a reservation today and save! Enjoy your stay.

168498.description: Discover this full-service Rockville Centre, New York hotel providing convenient access to the Belmont Racetrack, the Cradle of Aviation and Hofstra University. Situated on Long Island, just a few minutes from Manhattan, the Best Western Mill River Manor is a full service hotel featuring friendly customer service and a convenient centralized location. This Rockville Centre hotel features easy access to a variety of local businesses and attractions including Jones Beach, the Tommy Hilfiger Amphitheatre and the Old Westbury Gardens. Guests staying at this New York hotel will find spacious, well-appointed guest rooms featuring cable satellite television with HBO® and high-speed Internet access. The Best Western Mill River Manor offers a variety of full-service amenities including an outdoor swimming pool, fitness center and guest laundry. Corporate travelers will appreciate the hotel's full-service business center, ballroom and meeting facilities. The hotel also offers full catering services for events. Hotel guests will enjoy the onsite cocktail lounge-perfect for grabbing a drink with friends. Guests staying at the Best Western Mill River Manor will be close to a variety of outdoor activities including hiking, horseback riding, sailing, fishing and golf. This Nassau County hotel is just five miles away from beautiful beaches and seven miles from the Belmont Race Track. Hotel guests can visit Manhattan, just 30 miles away to see key attractions such as the Bronx Zoo, Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall and the Statue of Liberty. The hotel also offers convenient access to Nassau Coliseum, the Hempstead Lake State Park, the Tennis Center-home of the US Open in Queens and Hofstra University. The friendly, helpful staff at the Best Western Mill River Manor is ready to ensure a fun-filled memorable stay in Rockville Centre. Make a reservation today and save! Enjoy your stay.

168505.description: Welcome to the Best Western Jamaica Inn!Guests at our Jamaica hotel enjoy being close to campuses including St. Johns University and Queens College, and we cater to a number of visitors to York College as well as NYC tourists. When you have proximity to airports like JFK and LaGuardia as well as public transportation to Manhattan (NYC), your trip to the City just got a little easier and more affordable. Whether you're here for an event at Citi Field, Jamaica and Queens General Hospitals, or to attend a lecture at one of the universities, the seemingly little things like free parking and friendly service can make all the difference. Take advantage of proximity to cities including NYC, Staten Island and Brooklyn, or rest assured that it won't take long to get to some of the local attractions from the Empire State Building to Central Park. There's always something exciting happening at Arthur Ashe Stadium, and a day at the Belmont Racetrack can't be beat. Try your luck at the Resort World® Casino where world class entertainment can be found or plan a romantic trip to Flushing Meadows Corona Park where ice skating in the winter, boating in the warmer months and biking year-round take place. Even those in town for business with the American Red Cross local office or who have an appointment at Queens County Court find it necessary to slip away for a little fun. There are many airline personnel and construction workers who also call our Jamaica hotel their home away from home. Close to Times Square and Midtown Manhattan, it's easy to plan the NYC vacation of your dreams. Take in a Broadway show, stroll around Greenwich Village or head to Chelsea to try some of the best pastries in the country. Endless dining and shopping options are at your fingertips and getting around the city affordably via public transportation has never been easier. Reserve your room at the Best Western Jamaica Inn, close to the heart of NYC, right now!

168920.description: Experience the grace of Edinburgh’s 18th-century New Town in our boutique Hotel Indigo® Edinburgh, set in the buzzing heart of the city. Step inside and you’ll find an oasis of vibrant colours and contemporary comforts in our Georgian townhouse. After a long day’s shopping and sightseeing, cocoon yourself in your bespoke guest room, where every detail references Scottish creativity, from soft fabrics that caress to local artworks on the walls. You’ll love our indulgent bathrooms with rainfall showers and bespoke toiletries. At night, sip a dram of finest malt whisky in our cosy Bar and Lounge area. Minutes away, you’ll find the city’s best nightlife plus major Edinburgh Festival venues on our doorstep.

name.content: Delta Hotels by Marriott Jumeirah Beach

168924.description:
Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including a health club, an outdoor pool, and a steam room. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. All-inclusive rates are available at this hotel. Meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments are included in all-inclusive rates. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Enjoy Brazilian cuisine at Fogueira, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 4 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee.

Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.

168987.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can soak up the sun at the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a sauna. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy international cuisine at Voyage Restaurant, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 3 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in Lagos? This hotel has 470 square feet (44 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms.

169011.description: Indulge in a treatment at the full-service spa, where massages, body treatments, and facials await. Maintain your routine at the health club and sauna. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy dinner or brunch at The Perception Bar, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily (7 AM to 10 AM) for a fee. For business travelers, a business center, express check-in, and express check-out are provided. Planning an event? The hotel offers 915 square feet (85 square meters) of conference and meeting space. Each of the 192 guestrooms features an iPod docking station, a minibar, and a pillowtop bed with Egyptian cotton sheets. A 32-inch LCD TV with pay movies and complimentary Wi-Fi provide entertainment and connectivity. Private bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Located near Leicester Square, Piccadilly Circus, and Trafalgar Square, the hotel offers convenient access to London's top attractions. The nearest airport is London City Airport (LCY).

169012.description: Nestled in 300 acres of Hertfordshire parkland, just 35 minutes from central London and 20 minutes from Heathrow, The Grove offers a sophisticated country escape. Reopening August 1st, 2020, this grand estate boasts contemporary design, an impressive art collection, and exceptional leisure facilities. Enjoy a championship golf course, the world-class Sequoia Spa, a private beach with luxurious beach huts, and a heated outdoor pool. Indulge in a variety of dining experiences at three distinctive restaurants and bars. With 227 luxurious rooms and suites, The Grove provides a relaxing retreat with easy access to the city.

169031.description: Located in Buenos Aires' bohemian San Telmo district, this hotel immerses you in the heart of tango and tradition. Nearby, explore popular attractions like Puerto Madero, Recoleta, and La Boca. Enjoy live music under the legendary Buenos Aires sky in the rustic, colonial-era patio. Amenities include ozone-friendly air conditioning, a heated pool, gym, sauna, yoga room, 24-hour room service, and Wi-Fi. A gluten-free menu is available upon request at the time of booking.

169036.address: Kamerhatun Mesrutiyet Cad No44 Tepebasi Beyoglu
169036.description: Located in the lively district of Beyoglu, Rixos Pera Istanbul is close to Taksim Square, the Galata Tower and the iconic Istiklal Avenue. Stylish and cosmopolitan, Pera has a vibrant art scene with the Museum of Modern Art and the Pera Museum close to the hotel. A haven for restaurants, bars, pubs and clubs, Pera is also famed for its spirited nightlife. Rixos Pera Istanbul is the perfect choice for anyone seeking the immerse themselves in Istanbul's culture.

169042.description:
Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities, including outdoor tennis courts, an outdoor pool, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services, gift shops/newsstands, and a hair salon. All-inclusive rates are available at this hotel. Meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments are included in all-inclusive rates. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Enjoy international cuisine at Pumpkin Leaf, one of the hotel's 5 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 3 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee.

Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services.

169064.description: Villa Appiani, a boutique hotel, captures the elegance of 18th-century Italian villas. Its recent restoration beautifully blends old-world charm with modern amenities. The hotel's 40 rooms offer stylish, minimalist furnishings, creating a relaxing atmosphere. In-room amenities include individual climate control, soundproofing, free Wi-Fi, direct telephone, SKY television with pay-per-view, a minibar, and a safe. The hotel's restaurant, La Cantina, and its wine bar provide a sophisticated setting to enjoy fine dining. Its elegant courtyard offers the perfect backdrop for special events and romantic dinners. Villa Appiani also features a meeting room, accommodating up to 40 people, within the original wine cellar, equipped with state-of-the-art technology.

name.content: Mornington London Kensington, BW Premier Collectio

169079.description: The Mornington Hotel London Kensington, recently reopened after complete refurbishment, embodies Victorian elegance in the heart of London. This 4-star boutique hotel seamlessly blends modern luxuries with Victorian charm. Start your day with a decadent breakfast in the newly refurbished restaurant and unwind in the recently added bar, inspired by nearby Exhibition Road. Located moments from Earl's Court Station, the Natural History Museum, and Harrods, the Mornington Hotel is ideal for sightseeing, shopping, luxury excursions, and business trips.

169096.description: This Design hotel is located in a quiet yet very central street within walking distance to Kurfürstendamm, Europa Center and Memorial Church in the Western part of Berlin. The exhibition centre is close-by, metro stops Nollendorfplatz and Wittenbergplatz can be reached within 6 minutes by foot, offering a great connection to other sights of interest. Features of the hotel include guests rooms, 24-hours reception, express check-in and check-out, complimentary WIFI in the entire hotel, garden, a bar where the guests can enjoy a delicious beverage. The classic rooms come with Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs. Upgraded rooms also feature balconies with city views. Due to coronavirus (Covid-19), additional health & safety and sanitation measures are currently in effect at this property.
