169107.description: Indulge in the full-service spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Recreational amenities include indoor and outdoor pools, a sauna, and 10 beach bars. Enjoy dining at the restaurant, snacks in the coffee shop/cafe, or 24-hour room service. Additional amenities include complimentary wired and wireless internet, gift shops, a hair salon, a poolside bar, and two lounges. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel offers 6728 square feet of event space, including conference and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies), and free self-parking is provided. Each of the 231 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, LED TV, DVD player, and cable programming. Bathrooms include separate bathtubs and showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks are also provided. Located near Palms Mall, Landmark Beach, and Kuramo Beach, with easy access to Ikoyi Golf Club and other attractions.

169115.description: The hotel occupies a fantastic location in one of London's oldest and most fashionable areas. It is close to Westminster Abbey, the Houses of Parliament, Buckingham Palace and St. James Park, while the Olympic Park is 4 km away. Westminster underground station is roughly 650 metres from the hotel. The nearest airports are London Heathrow, approximately 27 km away, and London Gatwick, which is about 48 km from the hotel. This city hotel comprises a total of 34 rooms. The ground floor is traditional in style, but smart and modern in execution. The hotel offers amenities such as a bar, a restaurant, Internet access, and room and laundry services. There is also a car park for those arriving by car. The rooms have all been furnished to a high standard and are decorated with top quality furnishings and comfortable bed linens. The rooms are en suite with a shower and a hairdryer. They come further equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access and a safe, as well as a fridge and tea and coffee making facilities. Guests can also expect to find an ironing set and air conditioning as standard features of all accommodation units. The hotel serves a breakfast buffet, while the lunchtime and evening meals are available as a set menu.

169119.description: This charming London hotel, built in 1910, offers 64 guest rooms near the Tower of London. A short walk from the Underground, it provides easy access to the city's attractions, including the River Thames, St. Katherine's Dock, and a bustling street market. Liverpool Street Station is about 1. 5 km away, and London City Airport is approximately 10 km away. The air-conditioned hotel features a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, currency exchange, and lift access. Guests can enjoy a pub, a stylish brasserie restaurant, and 24-hour room service. Business travelers will appreciate the conference facilities and wireless Internet access. Laundry service and a car park are also available. Each en suite room includes a shower, bath, hairdryer, and a comfortable double bed. Modern amenities such as a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, radio, internet access, a safe, and a mini-fridge are provided. Tea and coffee making facilities, an ironing set, and individually controlled air conditioning and heating are also standard. For golf enthusiasts, the Aquarius Golf Course is approximately 9. 4 km away.

169151.description:
Residenza delle Città is an elegant 4-star residence in Milan, ideal for both short and extended stays, whether for business or leisure. Strategically located just a short walk from Corso Buenos Aires and close to Milan Central Station and the underground, it offers a convenient starting point for experiencing and exploring the city. 

The property features 31 modern and spacious apartments, designed to provide the freedom and independence of a real home combined with the comfort and services of a hotel. A variety of apartment categories are available, from Studios and Executive Apartments to Deluxe/Family Apartments and the Penthouse Suite. Each apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, free unlimited Wi-Fi, TV with SKY channels, air conditioning, and elegant, comfortable interiors. 

One of the highlights of the property is the Social Lobby, an elegant and contemporary space designed for working, meeting others, or simply enjoying a moment of relaxation. Guests can enjoy complimentary Nespresso coffee, cappuccino and latte macchiato, still and sparkling water, croissants, and biscuits. 

To ensure maximum independence throughout the stay, Residenza delle Città also provides guests with a fully equipped laundry room with washing machines and dryers, particularly convenient for those staying for longer periods. 

Additional facilities and services include Reception, Concierge service, a Technogym Fitness Centre, private on-site parking with electric vehicle charging stations, the Social Lobby, and complimentary Wi-Fi. The property is also pet-friendly. 

Reception is open Monday to Saturday from 8:00 am to 8:00 pm, and on Sundays from 10:00 am to 6:00 pm. Guests are kindly requested to indicate their expected arrival time on the booking form or contact Reception directly. 

Residenza delle Città is the ideal choice for guests who want to feel at home in Milan, enjoying the freedom of an apartment together with all the comfort and services of a 4-star residence.

169181.description: Comfort Near Istanbul's Historical Richness! Topkapı Golden Time Hotel is located just a few minutes away from Istanbul's mesmerizing historical and cultural riches. Our hotel offers easy access to the city's most important tourist attractions, such as Topkapi Palace, Sultanahmet Mosque, and Hagia Sophia. Surrounded by popular shopping malls, restaurants, and entertainment venues in the city, our hotel is situated in a location that meets all the needs of our guests. Additionally, for guests requiring healthcare services, we are only a 5-minute distance from Çapa Hospital. For guests who want to start their day energetically, our open buffet breakfast is filled with fresh and delicious options. Every morning, you can enjoy our carefully prepared breakfast menu to start your day with joy.

169182.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy Turkish cuisine at Core Grill and Bar, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Istanbul? This hotel has 4424 square feet (411 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 13 meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite.

169191.description:
This classic city hotel is located just a ten-minute walk from the magnificent Duomo and within easy reach of Milan's many cultural attractions and important businesses. Sightseers may wish to visit the La Scala opera house, shop in the fashion boutiques of the Via Montenapoleone, and view Leonardo da Vinci's mural ‘The Last Supper' at the Santa Maria delle Grazie church.
The hotel's comfortable rooms are functional and bright with comforts such as air conditioning, satellite television and internet access. Guests can wake up to a delightful buffet breakfast of pastries and fresh fruit, and enjoy a cup of Milan's favourite drink, coffee, over the daily newspaper. Business travellers will appreciate the hotel's business centre with four onsite meeting rooms, and the helpful hotel staff can help book tickets for the theatre or sporting events, all for productive business trip and pleasant stay in Milan.

169223.address: Blvd. Kukulcan, Km 5.5. Lote 6-C, Zona Hotelera
169223.description: The hotel is in the heart of one of the most touristic areas of Cancun, right in front of a white sand beach with turquoise water. Wonderful amenities await guests: swimming pools, hot tub, sun terrace, spa, gym, steam bath and a long beach with warm waters. There are several themed restaurants and a buffet restaurant in the premises. There is a long list of activities for guests. Daytime entertainment for all ages (mini club for the kids), golf, and tennis courts, water sports, evening entertainment (shows and live music) for adults.

169275.description: This hotel enjoys a convenient setting in Bayswater, less than 100 metres from London's world famous Hyde Park. Within a short distance, guests can enjoy a host of local attractions, including Notting Hill, Portobello Road Market and Oxford Street. Guests can also enjoy the London Eye and the charming surroundings of Soho. The perfect setting in which to relax or work, the guest rooms are tastefully appointed, and come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Ideal for guests wishing to explore the delights of London, this hotel offers warm hospitality and comfortable surroundings.

169276.description: Offering the perfect base from which to explore the essence and intrigue of the area, this hostel takes great pride in its ease of access to a host of local attractions. Within a short distance, guests can enjoy the captivating surroundings of Camden, as well as a host of local dining, shopping and entertainment venues. Guests will appreciate the spacious, tastefully-decorated rooms, where a soothing ambience of tranquillity awaits. Ideal for guests wishing to explore the surroundings, as well as those seeking a relaxing setting in which to unwind, this hotel offers a central location with professional service. This hotel is ideal for backpackers and leisure travellers alike.

169277.description: Situated just off Russell Square, the attractive hostel Smart Russell Square enjoys a fantastic location just a few steps away from the British Museum, the British Library and Oxford Street, while the trendy area of Camden Town with its alternative shops and restaurants is within easy reach. The train stations London Euston, King's Cross and St. Pancras with the Eurostar Terminal are within a few minute's stroll. The hostel with its young and international atmosphere offers a wide variety of room types. Features include custom-designed beds with curtains, complimentary WIFI and a room locker for guests' valuables. For added convenience, the hostel offers a 24-hour internet café, no curfew, kitchen facilities, a 24-hour reception and a travel shop where guests can get information or buy tickets. Every morning, a free breakfast is served. This hostel is a perfect place for young people and budget travellers wishing to explore this vibrant city.

name.content: Dosso Dossi Hotels & SPA Golden Horn

169280.address: Sutluce Mah. Imrahor Cad. Dutluk Sokak, Beyoglu, 3 N
169280.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently **not available**: Airport Shuttle, Concierge, Executive Lounge, Fitness Center, Golf, Pool, Spa, Valet Parking. Ideally located on the Bosphorus Straits, the Dosso Dossi Hotels Golden Horn Turkey hotel is next to Halic Congress Centre and faces the natural harbor known as the Golden Horn. It offers ideal proximity to Istanbul's historic sites and business districts. Our Istanbul hotel is 10 minutes from Old town, 15 minutes from Istanbul's main business district. Taksim Square, a vibrant district of shops and restaurants, is ten minutes from our Istanbul hotel. Our hotel is one of the closest to Istanbul International Airport. Retreat to a spacious guest room or suite featuring free WiFi access and a large desk with an ergonomic chair. Adjust the bed for the firmness you prefer to rest comfortably. Reserve a suite to enjoy a separate bedroom with king-sized bed and a living room with sofa bed. Start each morning with a cooked-to-order breakfast. Complimentary high-speed internet access and the 24-hour business center help you be productive. Maintain your exercise regimen in the fitness center. Purchase your favorite snacks and beverages in The Shop.

169693.description: Surrounded by lush green gardens, the excellent Side Breeze Hotel enjoys a very quiet, warm and natural atmosphere. It is located on the coast of Evrenseki, only 240 metres away from a fine golden sandy beach that seems to go on forever. Various shopping possibilities are within walking distance; the historic city of Side with its famous sites such as the Temple of Apollon or the amphitheatre is 8 km away, easily reachable by dolmuş. The family-friendly hotel offers air-conditioned rooms with private balconies, some of which boast stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea. There are various outdoor pools, one of them with water slides as well as a children's pool. For children, there is also a mini club, a playground and a special children's buffet. Apart from the main restaurant, the hotel has two à la carte restaurants specialised in Italian cuisine and fish. Guests can relax in the spa and wellness area. A wonderful place to spend a beach holiday.

169767.address: C 57 Bandra Kurla Complex Bandra East Maharashtra, C-57
169767.description: The flagship of Sofitel Hotels & Resorts in India, Sofitel Mumbai BKC is the gem of Mumbai's luxury 5-star hotels, celebrating a perfect mélange of the French way of life and warm Indian hospitality. Strategically located in the central business district of the city - the Bandra Kurla Complex, Sofitel Mumbai BKC is designed specifically for the global traveller, offering multifaceted experiences in cuisine, entertainment and relaxation.

169778.description: The Charming Hotel Villa Rosa enjoys a convenient setting in the historic centre of Venice, just steps away from the Santa Lucia train station, the bus terminal at Piazzale Roma and the cruise terminal. The world-famous attractions such as the Rialto Bridge, La Fenice Theatre, St. Mark's Square and the Doge's Palace are within walking distance and can be easily reached by Vaporetto (waterbus). Guests are welcomed in a peaceful ambience exuding traditional hospitality. The beautifully appointed rooms are individually decorated in a classic style and with warm colours, yet feature modern amenities such as air-conditioning and satellite TV. At the 24-hour reception, there is an internet point with WIFI access. Guests will love the quaint interior courtyard of the hotel. This small, enchanting hotel is a wonderful place for a romantic getaway in “La Serenissima”.

169782.description: Located between Kumkapi and the Blue Mosque in the Sultanahmet district, this hotel prides itself on its accessibility. Sightseeing attractions and local amenities, such as Hippodrome Square and Topkapi Palace are easily accessible being only a short walk away from the establishment. Both Ataturk airport and Sabiha Gokcen airport are located within 17 km and 46 km respectively. Originally a 19th century Ottoman house, this aparthotel was renovated allowing for the addition of modern technological facilities. Views of the Sultanahmet district and the Marmara sea can be enjoyed from the rooftop. The rooms are spacious and include the necessary utilities for guests. Decadently designed, the guest rooms are sure to please each visitor. This aparthotel acts as a home away from home, ensuring that guests can relax and unwind whilst abroad.

169785.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a rooftop terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a communal living room. Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at the hotel's restaurant, Béatrice Restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Istanbul? This hotel has 645 square feet (60 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours).

169900.description: Located in the heart of London, this modern hotel is just a short distance from the iconic Oval cricket ground and within easy reach of major attractions like the London Eye, Buckingham Palace, the Tate Modern, and Nine Elms. The O2 Brixton Academy is also within walking distance. Guests enjoy comfortable, stylish accommodations with Wi-Fi, coffee makers, hair dryers, and safes. While a superb breakfast was previously offered, it is currently unavailable due to COVID-19 restrictions. The hotel prioritizes customer satisfaction and offers convenient access to numerous attractions, making it an ideal base for exploring the city. Please note the following COVID-19 policies: maintain social distancing and wear face masks in public areas; NHS workers only; face masks required at check-in; no breakfast or room service; towels available upon request; £60 damage deposit required (refundable within 7 days); no smoking (£100 penalty); valid photo ID required; no visitors allowed; and management reserves the right to refuse admission for abusive behavior.

name.content: Hampton by Hilton Birmingham Broad Street

169905.description: Welcome to the Hampton by Hilton Birmingham Broad Street, located in the heart of Birmingham. The hotel is a short walk from the ICC, Arena Birmingham, Symphony Hall, Town Hall, and the O2 Academy. With easy access to the M6, M5, and M42 motorways, the hotel offers excellent connections to the north and south of England. The NEC, Resorts World Arena, and Birmingham International Airport are only 14 miles away. Relax in spacious guest rooms featuring modern amenities, a workspace, free Wi-Fi, and a comfortable bed. For your convenience, wired high-speed internet access is available in the Work Zone. Guests also have access to a well-equipped fitness room (currently unavailable). Enjoy our lounge bar, offering a variety of drinks, light meals, and snacks 24 hours a day. Start your day with our complimentary hot and continental breakfast (currently with reduced service). Located in a bustling area, we are close to corporate offices like RBS, HSBC, Deutsche Bank, Kraft Foods, and the BBC. We're also convenient to tourist attractions such as Sealife, Legoland Discovery Centre, Cadbury World, Drayton Manor Theme Park, and the Jewellery Quarter Museum. The city boasts fantastic restaurants, gastropubs, and bistros. Explore the Balti Triangle, with over 50 restaurants offering delicious curries. The Mailbox, Bullring, and Grand Central shopping centers are within walking distance.

169907.address: Rua Da Quinta Do Paizinho, Lugar Da Outurela, -
169907.description: Unlock the wonders of Lisbon from Holiday Inn Express® Lisbon - Alfragide hotel. Located just 15 minutes from the city centre and a short drive from Lisbon Congress Centre, this convenient hotel offers 3 elegant event spaces and wood-accented guest rooms with all the amenities you need. Plus, you'll enjoy a free breakfast and 24-hour bar. Visit the Alegro Shopping Centre and the historic district of Belém, or take a trip to Estádio da Luz for a match or to see the NOS Alive festival. With so much to explore, come and experience the perfect Lisbon getaway.

169950.description: The hotel is located near centers of exhibitions, fairs, conferences, a few kilometers from the airport and close to entertainment and leisure. The hotel offers 24 hour reception, billing 24 hours, elevator, breakfast room and Internet access. The hotel rooms have private bathroom, hairdryer, telephone, television, internet access, minibar, air conditioning, heating and safe.

169973.description: Enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast at Taximtown Hotel, located in Istanbul's vibrant Taksim district, just a short walk from Taksim Square and Galata Tower. The hotel offers 36 air-conditioned rooms equipped with minibars, LCD TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include showers, toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, an elevator, and in-room safes and desks. Dolmabahçe Palace and the Egyptian Bazaar are a short drive away.

169974.description: This hotel has a central location in the Kagithane district, just two kilometres from Sisli, where guests will find the nearest underground station as well as large shopping centres. Public transportation links are 100 metres from the hotel, and Cevahir Shopping Mall is just a 5-minute drive away with shopping and dining options. Guests are welcomed in the lobby with 24-hour reception and business corner. The hotel offers spacious studios and suites in addition to standard rooms, all with en suite bathroom, carpet or parquet floors LED TV and wireless internet access. The hip and trendy in-house restaurant offers 24-hour room service and a buffet breakfast, and guests might also appreciate free parking and the hotel's handy laundry service.

169975.description: Centrally located in Harbiye, this aparthotel is a mere 300 metres from the Istanbul Congress Centre and the Lutfi Kirdar Convention and Exhibition Centre. Entertainment and shopping facilities are located nearby, and links to the public transport network are available in close proximity. Taksim underground is a mere 6 minutes' walk away, whilst Ataturk airport and Sabiha Gokcen airport are 15 km and 41 km away respectively. This hotel prides itself on its location. This charming aparthotel combines a modern exterior with a tastefully designed interior. The apartments feature modern furnishings, equipping guests with the necessary facilities to ensure that each stay is enjoyable. Guests will feel as though they are relaxing in a home away from home, with comfortable surroundings ensuring that they can unwind and enjoy the surroundings of Harbiye.

169976.description: This beach hotel sits on the Uckum-Belek coast near Antalya, sprawling across 101, 000 m². Located 35 km from Antalya Airport and 45 km from the city center, it offers easy access to public transport and taxis. Comprising three hotel buildings this family-friendly complex boasts a 300-meter sandy beach, a variety of pools, and an aqua park. Adults can unwind in the fully equipped spa. Classic guest rooms feature satellite TV, a safe, a minibar, air conditioning, tea and coffee making facilities, and a private balcony (ECO Room has no balcony). Each room includes a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer.

169989.description: This cozy hotel boasts a strategic location in the heart of Barcelona, making it an ideal starting point for exploring the city. Close to Las Ramblas and Plaça Catalunya, the hotel is also a short walk from El Raval and the Gothic Quarter. The Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art is 300 meters away, and Barcelona-El Prat Airport is about 15 kilometers from the property. This family-friendly hotel features cheerful decor and air conditioning, offering a unique atmosphere combined with modern amenities for a comfortable stay. Guest rooms are charming and fully equipped. Dining facilities include a 24-hour buffet.

169990.description: Enjoy a central Barcelona stay at the boutique Hotel Continental Palacete, just a 5-minute walk from La Rambla and Casa Batlló. Take in the views from the terrace and make use of complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The 19 air-conditioned rooms feature heated floors, flat-screen TVs, and Select Comfort beds with down comforters and premium bedding. Enjoy satellite programming and in-room safes and desks. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast (7:30 AM - 11:00 AM). A snack bar/deli and 24-hour room service are available. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

name.content: Park Inn by Radisson Serviced Apt. Lagos Victoria

170001.description: This stunning boutique hotel is conveniently located in the heart of Victoria Island's hotel district, offering easy access to Karamu Waters and the Atlantic Ocean. Considered one of the finest accommodations in central Lagos, it features a bar, restaurant, children's playground, car park, and conference facilities for business travelers. Each luxurious and spacious room includes an en-suite bathroom with a shower and a king-size bed, and comes fully equipped for a comfortable stay. Guests can enjoy two outdoor swimming pools, a sun terrace with loungers, and a well-equipped gym. Breakfast is served buffet-style, while lunch and dinner are offered à la carte.

170011.description: This Berlin hotel welcomes guests to the heart of the trendy Friedrichshain district. It is inspired by the creative spirit of the vibrant cosmopolitan city of Berlin, which makes it modern, creative, global, and lively. Centrally located on Boxhagener Strasse, the hotel has excellent links to all districts and is the ideal starting point for exploring the city. This eco and design establishment, built in 2012, has air conditioning and comprises a total of 60 rooms. Guests are welcomed to take advantage of the many facilities and amenities on site. They can enjoy a refreshing dip in the swimming pool, before relaxing in the solarium, the hot tub or the sauna. Those who choose can pamper themselves with a range of massage and SPA treatments.

170018.description: The hotel is located in the residential heart of Ikoyi, Nigeria. It is destined to become Lagos' top lifestyle and entertainment address. It is also situated close to the Lagos business districts of Ikoyi and Victoria Island and is 35 km from Murtala Muhammed International Airport. This air-conditioned establishment welcomes in the lobby and offers a children's playground and a business centre. The air-conditioned guest rooms are en suite and include a direct dial telephone, satellite TV as well as a minibar and tea and coffee making facilities. Guests can enjoy a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool. Fitness enthusiasts can head to the gym for a good workout. Guests can additionally relax in the sauna and steam room or pamper themselves with a massage treatment. The hotel serves a breakfast buffet, while the evening meal can be enjoyed à la carte.

170021.description: In Sant Gervasi District, near places not to be missed in Barcelona. Enjoy spacious, modern rooms with all you need for an ideal stay in the city with friends, for business or family. What is better than starting the day with a buffet breakfast with local produce or in our gym overlooking Tibidabo? Outdoor parking and spa next to the hotel. You'll feel right at home, and your pets are welcome.

170022.description: The premises count with 55 welcoming accomodation units. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. The hotel provides 24-hour reception.

170024.description: Pamper yourself with body treatments and facials at this centrally located Berlin hotel, just a 5-minute drive from Alexanderplatz and the East Side Gallery. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (for a surcharge). Take advantage of limited room service and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel also offers limo/town car service, express check-in/check-out, and self-parking (for a fee). Each of the 47 guestrooms features a minibar, LCD television, private balcony, and digital programming. Private bathrooms include showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include the Velodrom, Simon-Dach-Strasse, Boxhagener Platz, Oberbaum Bridge, and Kollwitzplatz. This hotel is also conveniently located 3. 8 miles from Brandenburg Gate and 4. 4 miles from Potsdamer Platz.

170031.description: Centrally located in Lisbon, the Lisbon City Hotel is a convenient 5-minute drive from both Rossio Square and Avenida da Liberdade. This hotel offers 44 guestrooms equipped with LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Each private bathroom includes complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. Guests can also utilize in-room safes and desks. Housekeeping is provided weekly. A daily breakfast is available for a fee between 7:30 AM and 10:00 AM. The hotel features a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Official check-in time is 3:00 PM, requiring a valid ID and a credit/debit card for the security deposit and city tax (€2 per person, per night). Luggage storage is available for early arrivals.

170050.description: This hotel enjoys a convenient location in Lagos, a short 15-minute drive from the airport. Guests will find themselves within easy reach of Apapa Port (45 km), Lagos Island (35 km), and Ibadan (80 km). This elegant hotel boasts a charming design, offering superbly appointed guest rooms that immerse visitors in comfort and style. Modern conveniences ensure a relaxing stay. Business travelers will appreciate the on-site business center.

170073.description: Welcome to Novotel Roissy Saint-Witz. A cozy hotel near Roissy, very well situated for a twosome weekend in Paris or Parc Asterix family outing. Take a relaxing dip in the heated outdoor pool in a wooded park. Fitness room and free parking available. Five modular lounges with high speed Internet to efficiently organize seminars and conferences.

170085.description: In the heart of the Rueil-sur-Seine business district, let yourself be seduced by the B&B HOTEL Rueil-Malmaison Gare. This 4-star hotel offers modern and spacious Suites measuring 323 sq. ft. (30 m²), with free high-speed WIFI and TV package (Canal+, beIN). Enjoy dishes in the dining area or in your suite. Keep fit in the fitness center or take a walk on the banks of the Seine. Discover Rueil-Malmaison in a new light.

170088.description: The Best Western Plus Opera Batignolles is a cozy hotel located in the Batignolles district, a former independent rural town and connected to Paris in the late nineteenth century. Today, this area still has its 'village' atmosphere and offers everything you can look for: an organic market, gardens (one so Parisian and the second more contemporary), restaurants, shops and this priceless feeling to be a Parisian yourself!From the hotel, you have access in ten minutes to the most important places and attractions of Paris using public transportation: Place de l'Etoile, la Defense, Pigalle, the Opera and the Grands Magasins. This spacious hotel has currently being renovated, and has a capacity of 44 rooms. They are decorated in a contemporary style with bright colors, modern furniture and original materials, and enjoy, for those situated on the upper floors, a nice view on Montmartre and the Batignolles Gardens. Each room is equipped with free wi-fi, flat screen TV, mini-bar and tea making facilities, for maximum comfort. Nestled in the heart of a quiet and well served district, within easy reach to the most touristic places and in the heart of a brand new business area, the Best Western Plus Opera Batignolles is a pleasant and convenient place, with an improved standard of service. Enjoy your stay.

170106.description: Opened in 2012, this holiday hotel is situated in the Evrenseki district on 8,000 m2 of beautifully landscaped environment and only a 5-minute walk from the beach. The popular resort of Side with its restaurants, shops, bars and historic sites such as the spectacular Temple of Apollo or the amphitheatre is within easy reach. The international airport of Antalya is about 60 km away.

170109.description: The following services and amenities are available, Fitness Center, Breakfast, Room service, Lunch and Dinner, On-site Restaurant(s). We're in Brindleyplace, less than a mile from Utilita Arena Birmingham, Symphony Hall, ICC, LEGOLAND, and National SEA LIFE Centre. The Bullring, Grand Central, and the Jewellery Quarter are a 20-minute walk. We’re four miles from Thinktank Birmingham Science Museum. Enjoy our event space, fitness centre, and all-day dining at our Recess Restaurant. Relax in a stylish guest room with complimentary WiFi, 55-inch HDTV, ergonomic workspace, a mini cooler and deluxe bathroom with a walk-in shower. Savor a refreshing beverage or a freshly cooked meal at our restaurant offering an extensive terrace area or unwind in our Lounge with a selection of light bites, cocktails, beers, wines and whiskeys. Stock up on those travel essentials at the Pavilion Pantry®, open any time for your convenience. Plan a meeting or event for up to 120 people in one of six flexible conference rooms at the Hilton Garden Inn hotel in Birmingham. Each room features sound-proofed walls, complimentary WiFi, natural lighting and an Apple computer, with catered refreshments available. Our hotel staff is committed to offering guests affordable accommodations, friendly service and a range of 24-hour complimentary facilities including a modern business center and a fitness center.

170130.description: Enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant in Edmond Hotel Parc Monceau, located in Paris's 17th Arrondissement. A continental breakfast is available on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM (for a fee). This upscale hotel offers 25 individually furnished guestrooms, each with a kitchenette, flat-screen TV, microwave, and coffee/tea maker. Housekeeping is available upon request. The hotel also features a 24-hour front desk and an elevator. You'll be within a 15-minute walk of Boulevard Haussmann and Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore, and a short distance from Parc Monceau. Other nearby attractions include the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Élysées.

170131.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 34 guestrooms featuring minibars. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries.

170135.description: Nestled amidst Geneva's vineyards, the Domaine de Chateauvieux offers an iconic gourmet experience. Boasting two Michelin stars and a 19/20 Gault and Millau rating, this beautifully renovated former vineyard farm showcases the culinary artistry of Philippe Chevrier and Damien Coche. Savor seasonal delights such as oven-baked John Dory and rack of lamb prepared with aromatic herbs. The hotel's twelve rooms and suite, designed by Esteban Valle, provide a warm and inviting setting perfect for a romantic escape. Enjoy the kitchen garden, terrace, and smoking room, all contributing to a truly sensory experience. Please note, the property is closed for one week at Easter, two weeks in late July/early August, and two weeks during the Christmas/New Year period. As a valued guest, benefit from personalized welcomes, special attention, exclusive offers, and access to a digital travel book upon declaring your preferences in your online account.

170136.description: This Paris hotel is located in a quiet square about 2 km from the Arc de Triomphe and Boulevard Haussmann's shopping district. The closest Metro and RER station is Pereire Levallois, which offers direct access to the Louvre, the Eiffel Tower and more of the city's best attractions. This air-conditioned city hotel is housed in a charming 19th-century mansion equipped with all necessary modern amenities to ensure guests have an unforgettable stay in this vibrant, historic city. The establishment offers 28 rooms, all well-appointed and stylishly furnished. The lounge and bar provide a warm atmosphere to enjoy a drink, and guests are welcomed to dine in the breakfast room.

170137.description: The hotel is perfectly located between the Porte de Versailles exposition ground and Gare Montparnasse railway station, in Paris's 15th district. The establishment was renovated in 2011, offers 29 rooms and is fully modernised and fitted with every necessary comfort. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as a hotel safe and lift access to the upper floors. Visitors can dine in the breakfast room. Wireless Internet access is available around the hotel. All rooms are en suite and feature a shower. Additional amenities include a safe, air conditioning and heating. A continental buffet breakfast is served each morning.

170156.description: You'll love the baroque and contemporary look of this hotel. It is ideally located close to metro Voltaire for quick access (under 30 min) to the capital's hot spots and trendy districts such as the Marais, Bastille and République. This hotel offers large Privilege Rooms with views of the Sacré Coeur and rooftops of Paris. The refined and inviting design ensures maximum comfort during your stay. An ideal place for you to organize a business trip or romantic weekend away.

170157.description: Breakfast and WIFI are included in all rates. Located on the right bank, at the northern foot of Montmartre (metro lines 12 and 4), with easy access to the Gare du Nord, Gare de l'Est and St-Lazare train stations and to the Stade de France. This hotel isideal for business travel and vacations, and has 45 contemporary rooms (including family rooms) and free WIFI access. The hotel's indoor car park is only available to guests by reservation.

170170.description: The Mercure Milano Solari is a stylish 4-star hotel in one of the trendiest districts in the capital of Lombardy, a short distance from the Navigli, Via Savona and Via Tortona, where you will find the most innovative designers and the most fashionable ven ues. Near the green metro line (the Sant'Agostino stop is just a few yards from the hotel), it offers fast connections to the city center. The hotel boasts 1 Superior Suite with private panoramic terrace, 11 Executive Rooms and 47 Standard Rooms.

170177.description: Stay Central, Explore Endless Possibilities Set in a beautifully Fitzrovian building, voco London Bloomsbury blends historic charm with modern comfort. Located just steps from the British Museum and within easy reach of Tottenham Court Road, Covent Garden and Soho, it’s the perfect base for exploring London’s vibrant culture. The hotel features 114 stylish bedrooms with contemporary amenities, complemented by a contemporary bar and restaurant for relaxed dining and drinks. Whether you’re visiting for business or leisure, our welcoming service and central location make every stay effortless, vibrant, and a little unforgettable. Russell Square and Holborn Stations are approx. 3 minutes’ walk form the hotel.

170206.description:
This splendidly appointed beaux-arts boutique hotel is Located on 44th street, just off Fifth Avenue in Midtown Manhattan, this sophisticated hotel is the perfect New York City base whether travelling for business or leisure. Hotel is proximity close to the Museum of Modern Art, Empire State Building, and Fifth Avenue, The famous Times Square, the imposing Rockefeller Centre, the New York Public Library, and Grand Central train station are all within a 10-minute walk.

The hotel offers a duplex penthouse, a two-bedroom apartment, suites, and stylish guest rooms featuring ebony stained hardwood floors and plush, fluffy beds with pillow-top mattresses and luxurious 300-count linens. In the evening, guests will appreciate pillow-top mattresses with linens, and branded bath products. All guestrooms feature amenities such as flat-screen TVs with cable channels, safe, telephone, iron, bussiness desk, refrigerator, alarm clock, wake up services and iPod docking stations.

Guests can take advantage of the free wireless internet access in common areas of the hotel and complimentary cappuccino, espresso, and tea service. 24-hour, fitness center with cardiovascular equipment and weights. Guests will also enjoy the hotel's Club Room with classic table games. The M Restaurant and Bar offers cocktails and live music. It features a domed skylight, mahogany bookshelves, Beaux arts lighting and lounge-style seating.

170207.description: Located in the city centre of Istanbul, just 450 metres from the historic Galata Tower and a couple of minutes' walk from Sishane underground station, these comfortable stylish suites are in an area known for its bohemian cafes and bars, museums, cinemas and shops. Tastefully decorated, the spacious guest rooms boast a contemporary décor. All of them have been fully-equipped and offer a private bathroom, tea facility and stunning views. The property features a gourmet Italian restaurant. Positioned close to the northern shore of the Golden Horn, the historical attractions at Sultanhmet are just 3 kilometres away and can be reached on foot over the Galata Bridge or by public transport.

170247.description: Located in the heart of the city, this design hotel offers high-tech gym and stylish suites with free WiFi. Nuru Ziya Suites is in a quiet street, only 150 m from the famous Istiklal Street. Featuring contemporary furniture and colour schemes, all suites have a unique design. They all offer comfort with air conditioning, seating area and a private balcony. The room key is also a pass for public transportation if you charge money on it. Smart TV and a DVD player are included in the suites for guests to enjoy. They also have a fully equipped kitchen featuring a refrigerator, microwave and a dishwasher. The 24-hour reception of the property provides concierge services. Laundry, dry cleaning and ironing services can be offered upon request at an additional charge. Nuru Ziya Suites is situated in Taksim area with many restaurants, cafes, bars and art galleries nearby. Taksim Metro Station

name.content: Holiday Villa Hotel and Residence City Centre Doha

170306.description: Strategically located near the Al-Muntazah intersection on C-Ring Road, this hotel is just 10 kilometers from Hamad International Airport. Popular attractions like the Corniche, Doha Exhibition and Convention Center, Qatar National Convention Centre, Aspire Zone, Katara Cultural Village, and Souq Waqif are all within easy reach. The hotel offers 356 well-appointed rooms and 396 serviced apartments with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy a variety of dining experiences across four distinct restaurants, from international buffets at Lagenda to Far Eastern fusion cuisine at D'Chopstix. The hotel also features two ballrooms, six meeting rooms, and complimentary access to a swimming pool, kids' wading pool, gym, sauna, and steam room. Additional services include 24-hour in-room dining, concierge services, and valet parking. For relaxation and recreation, guests can visit the Amoaras Relaxation Spa, Ayurbliss Spa, Snips Hair & Beauty Salon, Activa Fitness Club, or Qball Room Billiard & Snooker Center.

170327.description: This 5-floor hotel enjoys a great location across the road from Alanya's main beach, Cleopatra Beach. The centre of the holiday resort, with its many shops and restaurants, is roughly a 10- to 13-minute walk away, though there are also local amenities closer to the hotel. Public transport is available within 25 metres of the hotel and the main bus station is just 600 metres away. Antalya Airport is about 125 km away. Refurbished in the winter of 2011-12, this pleasant, air-conditioned city hotel offers 106 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers 24-hour reception and 24-hour check-out services, as well as lift access to the upper floors. Additional amenities include a TV lounge, a terrace restaurant/bar with indoor and outdoor seating and a small snack bar on Cleopatra Beach. Internet access is available for a fee. Refurbished in 2012, the rooms feature modern furnishings and laminate parquet floors. All rooms are en suite and feature a shower and hairdryer, as well as a direct dial telephone, satellite TV and a hire safe. Additional amenities include a mini fridge, air conditioning, individually regulated heating and a balcony or terrace. The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool with separate children's swimming pool and sun-bathing terrace with sun loungers and parasols. The nearby sandy beach has a snack bar and sun loungers and parasols provided for an additional fee. A buffet breakfast is served each morning. Lunch and dinner can be enjoyed à la carte.

170328.description: 11 kilometres from the centre of the popular Alanya resort, this hotel combines privacy with easy access to some of the best Turkish beaches, the closest of which is just a 5-minute walk from the premises. Those who prefer freshwater can spend the day in the beautifully tended outdoor area with its large swimming pools, snack bar and sun terrace. The more active vacationers can start the day with an aerobics workout, while the various means of relaxation include a sauna, a traditional Turkish steam room and massages. The on-site restaurant and Irish pub are just a couple of the numerous dining options available in the area.

170387.description: The hotel is nestled in the quaint fishing village of Paternoster on South Africa's unspoiled West Coast, approximately 145 km from Cape Town. Saldanha is a 30-minute drive away, and Cape Town International Airport is 161 km away. Built in 2011, this charming beach hotel offers 16 exquisite rooms and suites. Guests are welcomed in the lobby with a hotel safe and can dine in the restaurant with panoramic views of Paternoster Bay. Business travelers can utilize the conference facilities. Laundry services and parking are also available. The rooms blend beach style and contemporary luxury with elegant decor and high ceilings. All en suite rooms feature a shower, bath, hairdryer, king-size bed, satellite/cable TV, radio, and wireless internet. A safe, mini-fridge, cooker, tea/coffee making facilities, ironing set, and individually regulated air conditioning are also provided. Guests can relax on sun loungers at the hotel or the nearby rocky and sandy beach, and enjoy canoeing, horse riding, and biking. A continental buffet breakfast is served daily, and dinner is offered from a set menu. To reach the hotel from Cape Town: Take the R27 West Coast Road, continuing past the Engen 1 Stop at Langebaan. Turn left at the Vredenburg turnoff and drive 15 km to Paternoster. At the first four-way stop, turn right. Continue straight through the next four-way stop. Turn left at the second turn, then immediately right, and continue straight to the hotel.

170388.description: These apartments are set in a quiet area of Barcelona's famous Eixample district, only a short walk from Plaça de Catalunya and the historic city centre. Parc de la Ciutadella, Barcelona Cathedral and Museu Picasso are all located nearby. Urquinaona Metro station is only 300 m away and Barcelona-El Prat Airport is easily reachable by public transport and situated only 15 km from the establishment. This air-conditioned apartment hotel offers 7 apartments in a bright and modern environment in one of the city's quietest districts. Each apartment has an elegant design and is fully equipped to make every stay as comfortable as possible.

170391.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Gaumenfreund, a restaurant which specializes in local cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to noon for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a computer station, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 237 guestrooms featuring free minibar items and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

170421.description: This hotel enjoys a unique setting at the heart of Cape Town, in the elegant Heritage Square. The hotel is located within easy access of the city's vibrant street life and bustling business area. The hotel enjoys close proximity to a number of attractions, including Signal Hill, Company Gardens and the Victoria and Alfred Waterfront. This boutique hotel enjoys a stunning design, beautifully combining European and African elements. The guest rooms each enjoy their own character and atmosphere. The hotel features first-class facilities and services, surpassing the expectations of even the most discerning traveler. A wide range of leisure, dining and business facilities are available at this hotel. Guests will appreciate the friendly service and high level of excellence that they are afforded. Guests are advise that the entrance to the apartments is separate from the main Hotel building - separated by approximately 60 meters, or 1 minute walking time.

170423.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as bicycle rentals, complimentary Wi-Fi, and tour/ticket assistance. This Amsterdam hotel offers 21 guestrooms with LED TVs, satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Conveniences such as safes and blackout drapes/curtains are provided, along with daily housekeeping. The hotel also features conference space (129 sq ft). Located in the heart of Amsterdam, Hotel Pagi is within a 10-minute walk of Dam Square and Rembrandt Square, and conveniently close to attractions like Rokin, Nes, and the Amsterdam Dungeon. It's also 1 mi from Amsterdam Chinatown and 2. 6 mi from Anne Frank House. The preferred airport is Schiphol (AMS).

170425.description: Enjoy a central Berlin stay at the H+ Hotel Berlin Mitte, a short walk from Friedrichstrasse and the Friedrichstadt-Palast theatre. This hotel offers complimentary wired and wireless internet access, satellite TV, and en-suite bathrooms with showers and hair dryers in each of its 145 individually decorated guestrooms. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, served weekdays from 6:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends until 11:00 AM. Make use of convenient amenities such as room service (limited hours), gift shops, a computer station, and tour/ticket assistance. Self-parking is available onsite (charges apply). The hotel is conveniently located near the Humboldt Museum of Natural History, Museum Island, and other major attractions. The nearest airport is Berlin Brandenburg (BER), approximately 27. 9 km away.

name.content: Hotel Kabanel by HappyCulture ex Parisiana

170428.description: This modern hotel is excellently located in the lively 10th arrondissement of Paris, just a few steps from the train stations Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est. Famous attractions such as Notre Dame Cathedral, Opera and the impressive Sacré Coeur Basilica are within a short stroll. The Poissonière Metro Station is within a 5-minute walk, providing direct access to the Louvre Museum.

170440.description: Sun Hotel is a family establishment located in the beautiful beach of Kineta only 40 minutes from Athens. It offers an extraordinary combination of the beauties of both sea and mountain. If you are looking for relaxation and spending your day at the beach sun tanning, our hotel is the perfect place to do so. When it comes to food, our restaurant offers a selection of traditional dishes for unbeatable prices, than you can enjoy at the seaside. A mesmerizing sunset is an idyllic background while you have a drink at our beach bar, socializing with other travelers. You are but a breath away from Athens, Corinth, Delphi, Epidaurus, Nafplio, Mycenae and of course islands like Hydra, Poros and Aegina that can be seen through a one-day cruise. On the other hand if you don't feel like travelling, Kineta offers you a selection of beach bars and restaurants by the sea.

170472.description: There are a total of 32 accomodation units on the premises. This hotel follows green practices.

170478.description: This hotel is situated close to the M 40 motorway, so that the city and other motorways can easily be reached. It is 20 km from the airport. Established in the year 2005, this fully air-conditioned hotel comprises a total of 124 rooms set over five floors. There are also a number of conference rooms for business guests, which are equipped to modern technical standards and provide room for up to 325 persons. The rooms all come with an en-suite bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a wireless Internet connection, and centrally regulated air conditioning. The hotel also has a number of specially adapted accommodation units for guests with reduced mobility. Parking is also available.

170492.description: Enjoy rooftop terrace and garden views at this family-friendly Berlin hotel, complete with complimentary Wi-Fi. Amenities include an arcade/game room, gift shops, a common area TV, a coffee shop/cafe, a snack bar, and a bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel also offers a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a 24-hour front desk. Limited on-site parking is available. The 227 guestrooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, bathrooms with showers, safes, and daily housekeeping. Aletto Hotel Kudamm is located in the heart of Berlin, a short walk from Kurfürstendamm and the Berlin Zoo.

170541.description: The hotel is conveniently located at the entrance to the city of Abuja. There are bars, restaurants, clubs and shopping opportunities in Abuja town centre, approximately 15 minutes from the hotel. The International Convention Centre and tourist attractions such as Aso Rock and Cave, Zuma Rock, the Guara Waterfalls and the Wonderland Theme Park are all within easy reach of the hotel. The hotel is 38 km from the International Airport. The nearest railway station, Minna, is 156 km from the hotel. This air-conditioned, business hotel was renovated in 2011 and offers 46 elegantly furnished and spacious fully serviced deluxe apartments. The hotel features a lobby and a 24-hour reception and check-out service with currency exchange facilities and a newspaper stand. The hotel offers a restaurant and both room and laundry service, as well as transfer services to the city and a cyber café. The en suite rooms are furnished with a king-size bed and equipped with a bath and a shower. All of the rooms are equipped with a hairdryer, satellite/cable TV and Internet access. Each room features a safe and a mini fridge, as well as tea and coffee making facilities and individually regulated air conditioning. The hotel offers its guests the use of its outdoor swimming pool, which features a poolside snack bar and sun loungers. Abuja Town Centre golf course can be reached by car in 15 minutes. In addition to a breakfast buffet the hotel offers à la carte options for both lunch and dinner.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Lima Miraflores El Pardo

170544.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Airport Shuttle, Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s). The following services and amenities are currently **not available**: Business Center, Complimentary Evening Social, Concierge, Executive Lounge, Pool, Valet Parking. Welcome to the El Pardo DoubleTree by Hilton Lima hotel, a full service hotel in the heart of Miraflores, the most cosmopolitan district of Lima, Peru, where we will welcome you with our emblematic and traditional Peruvian cocktail 'Pisco Sour' and the always-welcomed DoubleTree Cookie. El Pardo DoubleTree by Hilton Lima is located close to the city's financial and commercial centers, 30 minutes from Lima International Airport and 10 minutes from Lima's historical and colonial downtown area. The DoubleTree hotel is also only three blocks from Miraflores' Central Square with the best department stores, the open-air ''Indio'' and popular crafts market, and Kennedy Park with its outdoor activities. It is also only eight blocks from the Pacific Ocean coast and Larcomar Entertainment Center with chic boutiques and exciting restaurants and bars. Our new, recently renovated and redecorated rooms and suites include all the comforts of home for business and leisure travelers alike. Also at El Pardo DoubleTree by Hilton in Lima, we offer you our hotel's sparkling indoor pool on the 11th floor, which features a sundeck with excellent city views; our two-level fitness center, the Milenium Sports Club, which is one of the finest gyms in Lima and is available and complimentary to all our guests, and our hotel bar, where you can enjoy a “Pisco Sour”, our national drink. International specialties, light meals and the best Peruvian cuisine can be found in our classic restaurant, El Lobby del Pardo. If you are looking for another option, you can always find it in our brand new café La Terraza del Pardo.

name.content: Hotel Euro Suite Sao Paulo by Nacional Inn

170545.description:
Hotel Euro Suite São Paulo by Nacional Inn offers comfort and convenience in the heart of São Paulo. Located in Largo Santa Efigênia, the hotel is just minutes from São Bento Metro Station and close to major attractions such as Theatro Municipal, Vale do Anhangabaú and 25 de Março Street, as well as the city’s main event venues and commercial areas. 

The hotel features comfortable rooms, free Wi-Fi, breakfast, a restaurant, Room Service, and parking subject to availability and an additional fee. For business trips and events, it also offers meeting and event rooms, providing convenience and a strategic location for visitors to São Paulo.

170606.description: Conveniently located in Amsterdam, this hotel boasts ease of access to a host of local attractions. Guests are invited to explore the Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum, Ziggo Dome and the Concertgebouw, which lie within a short distance of this enchanting hotel. The elegantly-designed rooms offer comfort and tranquillity to each individual guest. Guests can relax with a sumptuous meal in the hotel restaurant, or may prefer to unwind with a refreshing drink in the charming surroundings of the bar. Within close proximity to a range of attractions, and boasting a comfortable environment, this hotel ensures a memorable stay.

170615.description: The ibis Styles Paris Batignolles, a completely renovated hotel in the heart of Batignolles, is a stone throw from the Montmartre district and its mythical attractions, the Moulin Rouge, the Basilica and the artists village. The hotel invites you to relax in a friendly and green atmosphere that perfectly defines its neighbourhood.

170708.description: Welcome to the Best Western Gregory Hotel, a local landmark in Bay Ridge, one of Brooklyn's finest neighborhoods. Our guests enjoy the best of what Brooklyn and New York City have to offer. This historic hotel is located within one block of the countless local restaurants, bars, and boutique shops of Bay Ridge, a neighborhood ranked in the top 12 of New York Magazine's Best Places to Live in NYC. The New York City subway is two blocks away that affords easy, direct access to all of the world renowned attractions of Manhattan, including Times Square, the Statue of Liberty and Central Park. For those wishing to explore Brooklyn, the Best Western Gregory Hotel is the perfect starting point. Guests can take a stroll across the famous Brooklyn Bridge, visit to the Prospect Park Zoo and the Brooklyn Botanical Gardens, or even enjoy watching the borough's first professional baseball team since the Dodgers left for Los Angeles by taking in a Brooklyn Cyclones game. The Best Western Gregory Hotel is your perfect home away from home. Guests will receive the highest quality of customer service and find unbeatable amenities at an affordable price. Our rooms come with satellite television on 32-inch flatscreens and free wireless high-speed Internet access. A complimentary continental breakfast that includes locally-made Brooklyn bagels is served every morning. Entertaining is made easy, as guests can enjoy our Madrid Lounge, which has been serving cocktails since the 1920s. Those traveling on business will enjoy our 24-hour business center with printing services and our 3, 000 square feet of flexible meeting space that will suit the needs of any event big or small. The hotel is also conveniently located to the Maimonidies Medical Center, Lutheran General Hospital and the Fort Hamilton Army Base. We look forward to your next stay in beautiful Bay Ridge! Our friendly, helpful staff is eager make your next trip to New York City your most memorable yet.

171105.description: Situated in a lively quarter of Paris where the worlds of art and business mingle, this is the perfect base for a visit to Paris, with the Paris Palais des Congrès and the Opera House ten minutes down the road and with easy access to the Stade de France national stadium, and the major exhibition centres - Paris Porte de Versailles, Paris Nord Villepinte. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, cloakroom and lift access to the upper floors, Wi-Fi, a TV lounge and a breakfast room.

171118.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, Confraria, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 61 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and LCD televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

171121.description: The hotel offers easy access to Rio de Janeiro's business center and sits opposite Charitas Beach in Niterói, just a few miles from the Rio-Niterói Bridge. Only 5 km from Niterói's city center and approximately 30 km from Rio de Janeiro's airports, it's ideal for both leisure and business travelers. The hotel features a conference room, internet access, room service, laundry service, parking, a garage, a freshwater pool, a poolside bar, a jacuzzi, and a sauna. Spacious and comfortable rooms are equipped with a bathroom with a shower, hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, cable TV, internet access, a minibar, air conditioning, a safe, a balcony, and a terrace.

171127.description: Situated in the heart of Miraflores' bustling business district, Casa Andina Select Miraflores offers a perfect blend of convenience and comfort for both business and leisure travelers. This modern 11-story hotel features 155 contemporary rooms, just steps away from major corporate offices, upscale dining, and vibrant nightlife. Enjoy easy access to Parque Kennedy, Larcomar oceanfront shopping center, and Lima's cultural attractions. Jorge Chavez International Airport is conveniently located within a 35-minute drive.

171152.description: The resort is located in Negombo, 16 km away from the International Airport and 40 km from Colombo. It is ideally located overlooking Negombo beach and in an exceptional setting of palm trees and green lands. The comprehensive facilities the resort offers will ensure guests to stay in shape in every way.

171154.description: This luxurious city conference hotel enjoys a strategic setting on Al Matar Street next to the famous Capital Security Department. The hotel occupies the same affluent street as HSBC, the IBQ Building and Copthorne Hotel skyscrapers. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a host of attractions and points of interest, such as delightful shopping, exciting entertainment venues, business hubs and dining options. Doha International Airport is just 2 km away. This spectacular hotel greets guests with opulent, decadent surroundings, befitting Arabian royalty. The stunning guest rooms feature a contemporary Arabian style, offering visitors a regal cocoon of peace and serenity, where they can relax and unwind at the end of the day, seemingly miles away from the city that lies just outside.

171172.description: The hotel TOPAZZ LAMEE combines two unique buildings, diagonally opposite from each other. It is especially committed to modern architecture and contemporary design. Located in Vienna's historic 1st district - just a stone's throw of the world famous St. Stephens Cathedral, the hotel is surrounded by more than 60 magnificent museums, luxurious shopping addresses, excellent restaurants and world famous coffee houses. The perfect home base for lovers of good living and modern design. The hotels are perfectly located in the center of Vienna, after about 200 meters you can reach St. Stephen's Cathedral and after about 50 meters a public transport bus stop. Vienna International Airport is about 18 km away, Bratislava Airport about 72 km.

171186.address: Tower B - The Walk - Jumeirah Beach Residence
171186.description: Find us in the heart of Jumeirah Beach Residences on The Walk, Dubai's premier shopping district and waterfront community. With two pools, a spa, and a top-of-the-line gym, we also offer direct access to Hilton Dubai Jumeirah's private beach and 10 restaurants and bars. Experience Italian, Irish, and international cuisines across our 10 restaurants, and enjoy live entertainment, beachside comfort, and snacks at our range of bars. Pure Sky Lounge & Dining offers rooftop views of the Arabian Gulf and Ain Dubai. The 362 individually decorated guestrooms feature minibars, 55-inch flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Additional amenities include a business center, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Dubai Marina Mall and Wild Wadi Water Park are a short drive away.

171188.description: Whether it's a night on the town or a quiet evening in, Premier Inn Hotel London Rainham is a great choice. You'll have direct links right to the centre of London and we're handy for Greenwich, the O2 and local businesses too. Cheer on the sports stars at Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park. Or head into town and see the iconic sights. Do some window shopping along Bond Street, enjoy a picnic in Hyde Park, or pick up a bargain or two at Lakeside Shopping Centre. After a busy day, come back to the hotel for some great food and a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

171191.description: Close to the beautiful Canal Saint Martin, 2 minutes walk from the Gare de l'Est and less than 10 minutes from the Gare du Nord, the charming Timhotel Paris Gare de l'Est is located in a quiet street facing the magnificent Convent Des Recollets. La Villette and la Cite des Sciences are just a stones throw away and can be easily reached by strolling along the canals. Paris most popular areas such as Bastille and Le Marais are just 15 minutes away by public transport. All the comfortable rooms feature air conditioning, cable TV, phone, hairdryer and Wifi. Guests will have the possibility to enjoy their breakfast either in the hotel's breakfast room or alternatively in their own room. The hotel's bar is just perfect to have drinks before exploring Paris by night. Please be advised that triple room is twin/double with extra bed. Please note : City Tax is NOT included in the price from 1st July 2015

171199.description: This delightful hotel enjoys a prime setting in the centre of Madrid. The hotel is located within easy access of a host of local attractions. The downtown area of the city is situated close by, and guests can enjoy the delightful shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues that it has to offer. The Puerta del Sol promenade is also situated close by. This stunning hotel invites guests into a world of style and elegance, bathing them in the rich culture and tradition of the surroundings. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, and provide a refreshing cocoon of peace and serenity in which to escape the rest of the world. The hotel features a host of delightful facilities, ensuring a truly memorable stay. Check-in place: Bordadores street, number 9. On arrival a deposit or pre-authorization on the customer's card as collateral is requested'. The apartments do not have lift available. The apartments can be located in an annex building. Please note the reception opening times: -Monday to Saturday: 11:00 to 19:00-Sunday: 11. 00 to 15. 00Check-in time: 15:00 to 19:00Check-out time: 01:00 to 12:00

171246.description: Conveniently located in the Barsha Heights area, facing Internet City and Media City, this modern hotel at Al Barsha blends residence-style privacy and attentive hotel services with a dynamic downtown setting. The hotel is ideal for business executives and families looking for a comfortable and convenient hotel or suite at Al Barsha in Dubai, either for a short business trip, an extended stay assignment, or just a weekend in this exciting city. This hotel includes a large choice of rooms and suites, all completely equipped to guarantee a comfortable stay and including a seating area to share unforgettable moments with the loved ones. The onsite dining options range from classic to contemporary, but all serve a choice of delicious specialities that will tempt all palates, and this hotel has facility of electric car chargers.

171299.description: The Novotel Bogotá Parque 93 is named for its location, 250 meters from the Parque de La 93, one of the tourist places of Bogotá. With lively and relaxing spaces, the hotel has meeting rooms, business center, private parking and 24-hour concierge services. The Guadalupe Restaurant, on the 2nd floor of the hotel, has a breakfast buffet and options on the menu for lunch and dinner.

171304.description: The hotel is located in the centre of the city of Sao Paulo. It is situated a few metres from the underground metro station of Anhangabau. The hotel is surrounded by great dining options near Rua Augusta, and also offers easy access to shopping centres, theatres, cinemas and airports. This air-conditioned city hotel comprises a total of 72 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception service, as well as a hotel safe and lift access to the upper floors. Guests can dine in the restaurant. Conference facilities are available to business travellers. Guests can enjoy the convenience of wireless Internet access. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel car park. All rooms come with a private en suite bathroom with a shower. Guests can enjoy a good night's rest on their double or king-size bed. Rooms also come equipped with a telephone, safe and minibar. Standard in-room amenities include satellite/cable TV and Internet access. Furthermore, air conditioning is provided in all accommodation as standard.

name.content: 11 Cadogan Gardens by Iconic Luxury Hotels

171406.description: 11 Cadogan Gardens, The Apartments, and The Chelsea Townhouse by Iconic Luxury Hotels are three properties offering an excellent variety of luxury accommodation in three gorgeous townhouse buildings located just off Sloane Square in the heart of Chelsea. 11 Cadogan Gardens features 56 bedrooms and suites spread among four Victorian townhouses, as well as spacious and eccentric public spaces. Hans' Bar & Grill, a neighborhood favorite with a creative menu, backs onto the beautiful Pavilion Road. The chic Chelsea Bar serves classic cocktails and superb wines to locals and visitors alike. The stylish bar is decorated in grand Victorian style and serves classic cocktails and fine wines. Hans' Bar & Grill has an innovative menu, which features fresh ingredients and local produce. The newly opened Chelsea Townhouse (formerly the Draycott Hotel) is a magnificent, red brick townhouse that backs onto Cadogan Gardens and has been carefully refurbished to reflect traditional British elegance. Individually built rooms and suites complement the building's Victorian heritage. The Apartments by 11 Cadogan Gardens are located next to The Chelsea Townhouse. Six recently refurbished apartments, each taking up a whole floor of a terracotta brick Victorian townhouse, offer luxe-contemporary living and are excellent for people looking to stay for an extended period of time. These remarkable properties epitomise luxury and elegance, seamlessly blending timeless charm with modern amenities, captivating both refined travellers and locals alike.

171426.description: The Wallawwa is not your typical Colombo airport hotel. Set in 200-year-old tropical gardens just 15-minutes' drive from Sri Lanka's main international gateway, our award-winning 18-bedroom country house hotel with gourmet food, jungle pool and heavenly spa, carved out of an atmospheric 18th century manor house, exudes style and serenity. As an alternative to hotels in Negombo, The Wallawwa promises to start or end your Sri Lankan holiday in style.

171429.address: Catamaran Beach Hotel, No 209, Lewis Place
171429.description: The hotel is located within a 20 minutes' drive from the Bandaranaike International Airport, at the Negombo Tourist Area is. Recently refurbished, this 48-room hotel has all the amenities a tourist hotel should have to provide its guests a comfortable and pleasant stay. It has a restaurant, a swimming pool complete with a kids' pool and is in close proximity to all the other tourist facilities that the area has to offer

171506.description: Stay at the Aloft Bogota Airport, located in Fontibon, Bogota, just steps from Connecta 26 and Avenida El Dorado. This hotel offers a 24-hour fitness center, a terrace, and a garden for relaxation. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and convenient gift shops. Each of the 138 guestrooms features a refrigerator, minibar, 42-inch LCD TV, and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Enjoy international cuisine at the hotel's restaurant and bar/lounge, or take advantage of room service. A 24-hour business center, complimentary airport shuttle, and dry cleaning/laundry services are also available. Nearby attractions include the U. S. Embassy (7. 4 km) and 93 Park (13. 3 km).

171509.description: CIN code: IT027042A1MUTSYRKL A perfect setting in one of the most romantic cities of the world: situated in a 17th century building in the heart of Venice, this city hotel is just a few steps from the famous St. Mark's Square, the tall bell tower and the basilica. A large variety of restaurants, cafés and shops is in the surroundings, attractions such as the Rialto Bridge, Casino, Peggy Guggenheim Museum or the Academy Gallery are within easy reach. The hotel offers modern and tastefully furnished rooms with superior comfort for a 3-star hotel, all with en-suite bathrooms with shower or bath.

171569.description: This wonderful establishment is located at the heart of Alcala de Henares. The property is set at the heart of a UNESCO World Heritage Site, close to many of the city's most prominent attractions. Guests can enjoy the stunning architectural design of the Old Alcala University, as well as the Cardinal Cisneros tomb, Oidor Church and Cervantes Square. This hotel is housed in a historical building, which dates back to the 16th century. Blending stunningly with its surroundings, this hotel is sure to impress. The hotel has been carefully restored, to respect the original architectural elements of the building. The bedrooms are distributed around a central courtyard, enjoying an air of peace and serenity. The hotel features versatile conference rooms, for the convenience of business travellers.

171733.description: Located in Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, this elegant hotel offers easy access to major attractions. The Blue Mosque and Grand Bazaar are within a short walk, and both Ataturk and Sabiha Gokcen airports are easily accessible by car. Guest rooms feature lavish furnishings, tasteful patterns, and high-quality fabrics, creating a tranquil and rejuvenating atmosphere. Guests can enjoy private dining and a daily continental breakfast. Whether traveling for business or leisure, this hotel caters to individual needs.

171734.description: Located minutes from Heathrow Airport Terminal 5, the Hilton London Heathrow Airport Terminal 5 offers stylish accommodations within landscaped grounds, a short train ride from central London. Easy access to the M4 and M25 motorways is provided, and a frequent bus transfer connects the hotel to Heathrow Airport (charges apply). All guest rooms and suites feature soundproof windows, complimentary Wi-Fi, LCD TVs, and spacious work areas with ergonomic desk chairs. The hotel boasts 929 square meters of flexible conference space, ideal for global conferences, business meetings, and lavish gala events for 2 to 1170 guests. A business center with state-of-the-art audiovisual equipment, ample parking, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel are also available. Indulge in a beauty treatment or massage at the on-site spa, or relax in the complimentary Thermo Suite and Relaxation Area. Guests can energize in the 24-hour fitness center or enjoy tranquil waterside views at the stylish River Bar. Savor pan-Asian specialties at Mr. Todiwala's Kitchen and dine on modern British dishes at The Gallery, prepared with fresh, seasonal ingredients.

name.content: Comfort Aparthotel Versailles St Cyr l'Ecole

171776.description: An ideal base for leisure and corporate guests travelling to the Ile de France region, Comfort Aparthotel Versailles St Cyr l'Ecole offers independent, fully equipped accommodations that will ensure maximum comfort and privacy for any short or long term stay in Saint Cyr l Ecole.
