With 196 elegant studios and apartments, modern facilities and an advantageous location only a few kilometres from Paris centre and the magnificent Versaille Palace, our residential complex provides all the perks of a real home away from home. Each accommodation comes with contemporary amenities that will make your stay in Saint Cyr L Ecole efficient and hassle free. All studios and apartments include a fully equipped kitchenette with a fridge, an induction hob, a microwave and a fridge, a bright living area, an ensuite bathroom with a shower or a bathtub, a hairdryer and free toiletries, top quality mattresses and beddings and conveniences such as free WiFi access, an LCD flatscreen TV, individual climate control and a work desk. Each accommodation boasts a private balcony offering a city or courtyard view. During their stay at Comfort Aparthotel Versailles Saint Cyr l Ecole, guests can enjoy a daily continental breakfast buffet featuring artisanal jams, fresh fruit, pastries, yoghurts, and hot dishes served in the dedicated breakfast room, onsite indoor parking, and, upon request, laundry and housekeeping services. Conveniently located only just 2km from the Saint Cyr RER station, Comfort Aparthotel Versailles Saint Cyr l Ecole provides a quiet, decentralized base for guests visiting the French capital for business or on holiday. Orly airport is just 30 kilometres away while the famous Chateau de Versailles is only a 10 minute drive.

171777.description: CIN: IT027042A1MM7JU9W4Located in a 15th-century building on a typical street, Bridge Hotel offers elegant, Venetian-style rooms with air conditioning and satellite TV. The Bridge of Sighs is a 2-minute walk away, and you can reach Rialto Bridge in 10 minutes. Rooms here have a flat-screen TV and a minibar. Some feature views over Venice's rooftops, while others look out over the winding streets below. Run by the same family for the last 4 generations, the Bridge has a welcoming atmosphere. Staff can book tickets or restaurants, and also run trips to Murano to visit the island's famous glassworks.

171826.description: The total number of accomodation units is 24. Albergaria Borges does not offer 24-hour reception.

171869.description: This elegant and refined Paris hotel boasts an unbeatable location just steps from the Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Elysees. Sightseers will be able to reach the Trocadero in just a 20-minute walk and the Eiffel Tower in 30 minutes, while Montmartre, the Louvre and the La Defense business centre are just a short metro ride away. The hotel's splendid guest rooms feature modern comforts such as Wi-Fi internet access, soundproofing, and air-conditioning. Many rooms have views of the Rue Troyon, while 7th-floor rooms enjoy views over the rooftops of Paris with the Eiffel Tower or Sacré Coeur in the distance. Guests can start the day with a delightful breakfast buffet in the breakfast room and relax by the fireplace in the hotel bar after a busy day of sightseeing or business meetings. For an exciting sightseeing holiday or business trip in Paris, this hotel's wonderful location and cosy rooms make for the perfect stay. This property does not accept group bookings, if a group booking is detected by the hotel, the hotel reserves its right to amend the booking cancellation conditions

171870.description: Surrounded by the natural park of Haute Vallée de la Chevreuse, the popular Zenitude Hotel-Residences Magny les Hameaux enjoys a convenient situation in Magny-les-Hameaux, just off the Route RD 195. It is close to the town hall and the Gomberville business park. Versailles with the famous castle is about 14 km away, and the RER train station of Saint-Rémy-les-Chevreuse is about 3. 5 km away, providing direct access to Paris. The modern apartment complex offers fully-furnished studios as well as one- and two-bedroom apartments, sleeping up to 6 people. The apartments are tastefully decorated and fitted with internet access, flat-screen TV and a fully-equipped kitchen. Every morning, except for Sundays and bank holidays, the hotel serves a continental buffet breakfast. This aparthotel is a great choice for business guests or travellers passing through.

171961.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at The Resident Kensington, an eco-certified hotel in the heart of London. Located within a 15-minute walk of Kensington High Street and the Natural History Museum, our hotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and room service (limited hours). Each of our 65 guestrooms features a kitchenette equipped with a refrigerator and microwave, a flat-screen TV with digital programming, a safe, a desk, and a phone with free local calls. We also provide dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Imperial College London (0. 7 mi), Hyde Park (1. 3 mi), and several museums. The nearest airport is Heathrow (LHR).

172046.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Asia City Hotel Istanbul, centrally located for exploring the city. We offer complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Dine in our restaurant, grab a snack in our cafe, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Our business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out cater to your professional needs. Host your next event in our versatile meeting and conference space, totaling 1399 square feet (130 square meters). An airport shuttle is available 24/7 for a surcharge. Our 87 guestrooms feature minibars, LCD TVs with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Safes and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is daily. We're a short drive from the Bosphorus, Ulker Sports Arena, and Watergarden Istanbul, offering convenient access to key attractions.

172108.description: Just 35 km from Colombo International Airport, the hotel is nestled in a quaint fishing village on the charming west coast of the island, Sri Lanka. The nearby town of Marawila is a busy bazaar where guests will find many interesting items including souvenirs and batiks. The capital city of Colombo is about 2 hours away by highway. The atmosphere at Sanmali is tranquil, serene and wonderfully relaxing. Guests can discover a delightful heaven on a golden sandy beach lined by lush green coconut palms and tropical vegetation. A spacious ocean-front garden comes complete with magnificent ocean views and spectacular sunsets.

172221.description: Located in the center of Santo Tirso, the 4-star Santo Tirso - Charming Hotel & Executive Center is only 20 minutes’ drive from Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport. It features a fitness center and modern rooms with a balcony. Parking is subject to availability The air-conditioned rooms offer a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. The plush beds are fitted with white linens and the private bathrooms offer a hairdryer. The front desk is available 24 hours a day. Free parking is available on site and the hotel offers a car and bicycle rental service. Upon request, guests can make use of airport transfers to Cidnay Santo Tirso. Guests can sample international and traditional Portuguese cuisine in a contemporary, relaxing atmosphere at Restaurant Dona Unisco. It serves a breakfast buffet each morning. Light meals, alcoholic drinks and afternoon tea are served at Cidnay Bar which opens onto the terrace.

172250.description: Located in Side, Maya World Hotel is a perfect starting point from which to explore Antalya. The hotel offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. Facilities like 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, convenience store, daily housekeeping are readily available for you to enjoy. All rooms are designed and decorated to make guests feel right at home, and some rooms come with closet, towels, wooden/parqueted flooring, clothes rack, slippers. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include dart board, hiking trails, private beach, fitness center, sauna. A welcoming atmosphere and excellent service are what you can expect during your stay at Maya World Hotel.

172251.description: Nestling within metres of the turquoise waters of the Mediterranean and with a pine forest backdrop, this family friendly spa hotel offers a great place to stay with many facilities available. The hotel has a 24 hour reception service. Laundry and room services are available and there is also free Wi-Fi access in the lobby. The rooms are decorated and furnished in light, fresh colours and have either carpeted or tiled flooring. In room amenities include air-conditioning, safe box and satellite TV, as well as a mini bar. The hotel offers a range of recreational facilities from the spa and wellness centre, outdoor pools and beach water sports to entertainment provided by the animation team.

172257.description: Located in the heart of Lisbon, 9Hotel Mercy is a 4-star hotel within a short 10-minute walk of Rossio Square and Avenida da Liberdade. Enjoy views from the terrace and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The 47 air-conditioned rooms feature iPod docking stations, flat-screen televisions with digital programming, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. Room service is available during limited hours, and the hotel offers a bar/lounge and daily buffet breakfast (fee applies). Additional amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge.

172287.description:
In the upscale Jardins neighborhood, just one block from Avenida Paulista, discover the GoldMen Select Paulista – Capcana, strategically located in the heart of Paulista Avenue, 100 meters from the Brigadeiro metro station and close to various restaurants and entertainment options. 

Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, this hotel has the ideal structure and location for a unique experience in São Paulo. The spacious and well-equipped rooms at the Capcana Hotel São Paulo Jardins include cable TV with a special channel lineup, air conditioning, safe, and minibar. This hotel has parking, a beauty salon, spa services from the prestigious Olímpia SPA chain, a business center, and complimentary Wi-Fi. 

Take advantage of the opportunity to go to the theater, visit the museums of the São Paulo capital, and don't worry about the schedule; this hotel is only 7. 5 km from Congonhas Airport. Discover the Capcana Hotel São Paulo Jardins and experience the exclusivity of the best location on Avenida Paulista.

172311.description: This delightful hotel enjoys an idyllic setting amidst luxuriant greenery in Belek. The hotel is nestled amidst 120, 000 metres squared of beautiful landscape, offering a relaxing environment in which to escape the bustle of daily life. The hotel enjoys a striking architectural style, welcoming guests into the elegant surroundings of the interior. Coupling traditional and contemporary Turkish styles, the hotel offers a cocoon of luxury and serenity in which to unwind. Guests will be impressed by the superbly-appointed guest rooms, which come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. The hotel affords guests a number of exemplary facilities, catering to the entertainment, dining and leisure needs of every member of the family.

172312.description: Located on a private beach in Side, this 5-star hotel is just 5 miles from Manavgat. It features a landscaped pool area with waterslides and spacious guest rooms with balconies and panoramic views. Rooms at Paloma Oceana Resort have simple decor and include a bathroom with a hairdryer, a seating area, and satellite TV. All rooms offer views of the garden or the Mediterranean Sea. The Ada À-la-carte Restaurant serves fresh seafood on its beachside, open-air terrace, while the Safran À-la-carte Restaurant offers Turkish and Ottoman cuisine. Guests can enjoy a stone massage at the spa or play billiards in the game room. Two tennis courts are available, and free Wi-Fi is accessible in public areas. Nearby leisure activities include canoeing and windsurfing. Paloma Oceana Resort is less than 3. 1 miles from the Temple of Apollo and the Side Museum. It offers 24-hour front desk service and free public parking on site.

172369.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and express check-out. A cruise ship terminal shuttle is available for a surcharge. Make yourself at home in one of the 13 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars (stocked with some free items) and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Riva degli Schiavoni - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Church of San Zaccaria - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Bridge of Sighs - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- San Zaccaria Waterbus - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Vivaldi Church - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Bacino San Marco - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- St. Mark's Square - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Doge's Palace - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- San Teodoro - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Church of Santa Maria della Pietà - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- St. Mark's Basilica - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- St Mark's Campanile - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Museo Correr - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Basilica di San Giovanni e Paolo - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Marco Polo's Home - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi-With a stay at Hotel Le Isole, you'll be centrally located in Venice, steps from Riva degli Schiavoni and San Zaccaria Waterbus. This hotel is within close proximity of Vivaldi Church and Doge's Palace.

172388.address: Av. Bonampak Lote 1, Manzana 1, Súper Manzana 6
172388.description: Located in the Malecon Américas commercial district, the accommodation establishment offers easy access to a wide range of popular restaurants and bars, including Sushi Itto, Liverpool, Starbucks Coffee and Chilis. The bus station is approximately 1 km and the beach about 15 km from the hotel. This city hotel is situated in a shopping area inside Malecon Américas and comprises a total of 152 guest rooms. A range of spacious and comfortable multi-purpose rooms for private work sessions, meetings and other group events are also available to guests. Accommodation units offer wireless Internet access and a flat-screen cable TV.

172419.description: A stay at DoubleTree by Hilton London - Ealing Hotel places you in the heart of London, a 4-minute drive from Chiswick Park and 6 minutes from Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew. This hotel is 4. 1 mi (6. 5 km) from Wembley Stadium and 4. 3 mi (6. 9 km) from Richmond Park. Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Make yourself at home in one of the 189 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and MP3 docking stations. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, and LCD televisions with digital programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a computer station, and express check-in. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 3757 square feet (349 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 6 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton London - Hyde Park

172420.description: The DoubleTree by Hilton London Hyde Park is ideally located opposite Hyde Park, with Kensington Gardens just 400 meters away. Queensway and Bayswater Underground stations are equally close. This hotel offers a wide range of amenities, including a business center, concierge, fitness center, restaurant with room service, and breakfast options. Guests can enjoy convenient access to shopping at Oxford Street and Westfield Shopping Centre, just three Underground stops away. Kings Cross St. Pancras is a short taxi ride for Eurostar connections, and Paddington Station, with the Heathrow Express, is just one stop away. Spacious guest rooms feature generous workspaces, flat-screen TVs, ironing facilities, mini-fridges, laptop safes, and coffee machines. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The hotel restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with seasonal dishes available. In the summer, guests can dine al fresco on the extensive open terrace. The bar is open until 11:00 pm. Two modern meeting rooms, suitable for boardroom meetings (up to 12 people) and interviews (up to 2 people), offer natural daylight and free Wi-Fi.

name.content: Voco Fiorello - Laguardia Airport By IHG

172486.description: Step aboard the best flight you’ve ever taken at Voco Fiorello LaGuardia East, our aviation-inspired hotel near LaGuardia Airport. From the moment you step into our stylish lobby, you’ll be greeted by your friendly hosts. Discover everything that makes Voco different, from playful décor to feather-soft bedding. Our hotel in Flushing, NY puts you minutes away from Citi Field (Mets game, anyone?). We’re also near the Louis Armstrong House Museum and Flushing Meadows Corona Park, home of the Billie Jean King National Tennis Center. Our sustainable hotel offers electric vehicle charging stations in a secured parking lot and warm, personalized service from our team. You’re sure to enjoy an excellent stay. We can’t wait to have you on board.

name.content: Turim Santa Maria da Feira Hotel

172488.address: RUA SAO PAULO DA CRUZ, Santa Maria da Feira, 125
172488.description: The new TURIM Santa Maria da Feira Hotel reinforces the TURIM Group’s presence in the northern region, combining comfort, modernity and a strategic location. Situated next to the A1 motorway, just a few minutes from Europarque, it offers easy access to the Historic Centre and the iconic Santa Maria da Feira Castle. With a modern and functional atmosphere, the hotel has spacious rooms with balconies and some with views of the Castle, ideal for moments of rest, leisure or work. Facilities include free parking, Wi-Fi, a bar, a gym and areas designed for guests’ well-being.

172511.address: Mustafa Kemal Pasa Cad.Fabrika Sokak, Yenikapi, 7
172511.description: Enjoy a complimentary full breakfast and convenient amenities like free Wi-Fi and concierge services at the Grand Oral Hotel, situated in the heart of Istanbul. The hotel's 40 guestrooms feature minibars, LCD TVs, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Take advantage of room service (limited hours), dry cleaning/laundry services, and luggage storage. You'll be just a 5-minute drive from the Grand Bazaar and Sultanahmet Square, with Beyazit Square and the Blue Mosque also easily accessible.

172514.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a terrace, and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless and wired internet access, a television in a common area, and tour/ticket assistance. Dine at one of the hotel's two restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 30 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and plasma televisions. Your room comes with a memory foam bed and a private balcony. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Ataturk's House Museum (0. 6 mi), Karaalioglu Park (0. 6 mi), and Antalya Metropolitan Municipality Theater (0. 6 mi). The preferred airport for Triana Hotel is Antalya Intl. Airport (AYT).

172524.description: This modern hotel is located just opposite the central station in Berlin. It offers a trendy Lounge which is also used as breakfast area and bar. Famous attractions such as the Reichstag building, Brandenburg Gate, Tiergarten park, Unter den Linden boulevard or Potsdamer Platz square are within walking distance. Alexanderplatz square can be reached within 7 minutes by S-Bahn train; the whole city is easily reachable by public transport.

name.content: The Posthouse Berlin – Leonardo Limited Edition

172544.description: Set in a 1930s post office, The Posthouse Berlin Potsdamer Platz - Leonardo Limited Edition is perfectly located in the heart of Berlin. As a highlight of the hotel, you can explore an alluring culinary journey and feel the excitement of Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cuisine at our Layla Restaurant by Meir Adoni. There is a new flair to Layla this summer: Our newly appointed Chef Catalin Ghinea and new Bar Manager Valerya Shargorodski will offer you a fantastic dining experience paired with refined drinks. On top of that, now you can enjoy the nice Berlin summer evenings on our newly opened terrace. Recommended by Feinschmecker magazine as one of the top ten restaurants in Berlin in 2019, the fresh & delicious meals, the calm atmosphere, and the exemplary service will provide you with the perfect culinary experience. The Posthouse Berlin Potsdamer Platz Leonardo Limited Edition is located 1. 4 km from the shops and corporate offices and opposite the Tempodrom event venue. It’s an easy stroll to many attractions including Tiergarten park, the Brandenburg Gate and Museum Island. Brandenburg Airport is under 30 minutes by car, and the Central Station is just 10 minutes away. Our eight flexible meeting rooms are perfectly suited for lavish banquets or intimate gatherings. The 24-hour Fitness Center, the spa with its sauna and steam room, and our stylishly decorated rooms and suites provide a comfortable environment for work and leisure.

172546.description: This elegant and modern city hotel is located in Berlin-Tiergarten, just 600 m from Bellevue S-Bahn Station, providing a link to Berlin's Main Train Station in just 2 minutes. The Bellevue Palace and the Tiergarten Park are a 5-minute walk away. With large sofas and a modern decor, the hotel focuses on the lobby, bar and café. Berlin Brandenburg Airport is about 24 km away.

172551.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a seasonal outdoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 8:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 60 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Glyfada Shopping District - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Saints Constantine and Helen Orthodox Metropolitan Church - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Glyfada's Second Beach - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- Glyfada Marina - 2. 7 km / 1. 7 mi- Voula Beach - 3. 2 km / 2 mi- Athens Eye Hospital - 3. 3 km / 2 mi- Glyfada Golf Club of Athens - 3. 3 km / 2 mi- Mediterraneo Hospital - 4. 6 km / 2. 9 mi- Kavouri Beach - 5. 1 km / 3. 1 mi- Astir Beach - 6. 1 km / 3. 8 mi- Vouliagmeni Spa Lake - 6. 5 km / 4 mi- The Ellinikon Experience Park - 6. 7 km / 4. 2 mi- Varkiza Beach - 7. 1 km / 4. 4 mi- Alimos Marina - 8. 3 km / 5. 2 mi- Yabanaki Beach - 8. 5 km / 5. 3 mi. The preferred airport for Golden Sun is Athens Intl. Airport (ATH) - 23. 6 km / 14. 7 mi With a stay at Golden Sun in Glyfada, you'll be within a 10-minute drive of Glyfada's Second Beach and Astir Beach. This hotel is 9. 2 mi (14. 8 km) from Syntagma Square and 9. 8 mi (15. 8 km) from Acropolis.

172566.description: Situated just a short stroll from the famous Kleopatra Beach in Alanya, this popular hotel provides an excellent location for a relaxing holiday by the seaside. The city's archaeological museum is only a five-minute walk from the hotel, and Alanya's iconic Red Tower is within walking distance. Visitors will find a wide range of activities at the beach, including beach volleyball, windsurfing and banana boating, and the hotel's entertainment program offers water polo, water gymnastics and pool games in the large outdoor pool. The comfortable guest rooms are simply furnished with minibar, private en suite bathroom and balcony, some with direct sea views. The onsite restaurant serves buffet-style meals with special options for children, and guests can choose to dine in the a la carte restaurant or on the sunny terrace, all for a fun-filled family holiday in Alanya.

172666.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at our Guarulhos hotel, featuring 80 guest rooms equipped with LCD TVs, cable programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a cooked-to-order breakfast (fee applies) and mingle with other guests at our daily complimentary reception. Savor regional cuisine at Itaunas restaurant and bar/lounge, or enjoy room service during limited hours. We offer convenient amenities such as a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and tour/ticket assistance. Free self-parking is available onsite, and our 904 sq ft of event space includes a conference area and meeting room. We're located near Bosque Maia Park (0. 2 mi) and Parque Shopping Maia (1 mi), with easy access to São Paulo/Guarulhos Intl. Airport (7. 5 mi).

172693.description: Located in Kensington, London, this hotel is a short walk from attractions like Cromwell Road and Kensington High Street, and just three kilometers from Stamford Bridge Stadium. The stylish rooms are comfortably furnished and equipped with modern amenities, including climate control and ensuite bathrooms with eco-friendly toiletries and rain showers. Guests can enjoy a lounge bar, coffee shop, and rooftop terrace, along with 24-hour reception service. This classic hotel offers a comfortable home away from home experience in a prime location, ideal for both leisure and business travelers.

172694.description: This outstanding hotel is just 3 km from the International Convention Centre and the Bullring Shopping Centre. The property boasts elegantly furnished rooms with marble bathrooms. It features a stylish, modern bar and restaurant, free Wi-Fi and complimentary car parking also available at the hotel. All of the hotel's luxurious and spacious rooms include a wide choice of modern conveniences. Marble bathrooms offer large rain showers, bathrobes, and premium toiletries. The onsite restaurant serves classic British cuisine in a relaxing atmosphere with traditional cooked breakfasts available daily and the bar is an ideal place to enjoy a drink. The hotel is a 20-minute drive from Birmingham Airport and the NEC and is ideally located for all the City's major attractions.

172728.description: The Design & Wine Hotel, situated in the heart of Caminha village, offers 23 uniquely themed rooms, each equipped with a PS3, LCD TV, safe, and minibar. Guests can enjoy a range of amenities including a games room, wine bar, restaurant, garden, two terraces, indoor swimming pool, sauna, Turkish bath, and gym. Private parking is available at the front and rear of the hotel, subject to availability. Complimentary Wi-Fi is provided. Please note: Use of the solar-heated indoor pool and jacuzzi requires 48 hours' advance notice. The indoor pool and jacuzzi are closed from December 12th to February 28th.

172814.description: Boasting a prime location in Lamego, this delightful hotel is situated on the Riverwalk, close to Alameda dos Capitaes Park. The hotel is ideally located from which guests can explore the delights that the surroundings have to offer. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the Douro caves Winery, Peso da Regua Parish Church, Torre de Menagem and Lamego Cathedral. Featuring a charming architectural style, this delightful hotel welcomes guests with the promise of style, elegance and comfort. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated and offer a relaxing setting in which to completely unwind. Guests will be impressed by the excellent facilities and service this delightful hotel has to offer.

172846.description: Blending perfectly into the historic surroundings of the Royal Mile, Hilton Edinburgh Carlton is an iconic element of the city. The building dates back to the 1900s and is part of the impressive North Bridge which links Edinburgh’s Old and New town together, giving you easy access to countless shopping, dining, and entertainment. Once one of Edinburgh’s top department stores, the building was fully refurbished in 2016 to bring the décor back to its stylish best. Our modern rooms offer complimentary WiFi, ergonomic work areas, and Suite Dreams by Serta® beds with luxurious linens. Select an executive room or suite for extra space and amenities, including access to the Executive Lounge, with complimentary breakfast and refreshments throughout the day. For an indulgent afternoon tea and a vast bar menu, pop into Herbie More's bar and Restaurant. Twenty-four-hour room service is also available. Enjoy our Fitness center which is open 24 hours for the Guests.

172986.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a rooftop terrace. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A shuttle from the hotel to the airport is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 28 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment.

173026.description: INCOMPARABLE OASIS OF RELAXATION IN THE HEART OF VIENNAThe Levante Rathaus Apartments are in a very central location in the urban quarter of Vienna. From here, you can reach the Vienna City Hall, the Secession, the MuseumsQuartier including the Natural History Museum and the Kunsthistorisches Museum as well as numerous cafes, restaurants, and inns in only 3 minutes. The U2 and U3 U-Bahn lines provide you with the best public transportation connections. And yet our hotel is an absolute haven of peace in this lively city. You can enter our hotel on Laudongasse 8, and a wonderful, old passage will lead you directly to the large, quiet inner courtyard, or you can keep to the left side, and you will reach the reception area. We already look forward to welcoming you here! Only one small step - and you will feel like you have entered another world. Our hotel breathes history and is located in a historic Biedermeier house. It was built around 200 years ago not as a hotel but a private residence, and the special atmosphere of this old building can still be felt today. Experience a feeling of coming home. Freedom to relax in your own private room - or not. . . Perhaps you would like to go out and grab a coffee or a drink. Or maybe you want to unwind in our gorgeous, pleasantly cool courtyard on warm summer days? Here, a Viennese approach to life is combined with timeless classic art thus creating a link between the beautiful and the useful. Dark solid wood, a lot of glass, white and gray elements - and always red. Like the proverbial red thread, this color runs through the entire hotel. And in many cases, red stands for love and passion. In our case, it's our passion to pamper our guests. With the harmonious combination of aesthetics and function, the color red bestows powerful, room-defining accents with a variety of nuances both as a complement to the modern interior and as a symbol of how important it is that you feel right at home here.

173031.description: The Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station is located next to the railway station, an ideal location to discover Amsterdam and the surrounding area. From Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station you can travel directly to the city centre of Amsterdam within 5 minutes. From Amsterdam Central Station you can walk to the Anne Frank house or to Dam Square, where you can visit Madame Tussauds. For a day of shopping, you can go to the new outlet centre “Sugar City” that is located near the hotel, which can be reached within 7 minutes from the hotel. Do you want to get out of the bustling city? The Formular 1 grandprix track in Zandvoort can be reached with a direct train connection from Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station. In for an active outing? Rent a bicycle at the reception and explore the city and the Westerpark. The modern hotel rooms are fully equipped to make your stay as pleasant as possible. This includes free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, a television with various international channels, and free coffee and tea-making facilities. Depending on your choice, your room has one double bed or two single beds. The bathroom has a walk-in shower and toiletries. Every day an Express Start Continental breakfast buffet is available for all our guests. This is included in the room price. For a cup of coffee or a small drink you are more than welcome to join us in the hotel bar.

173107.description: With the Amsterdamse Bos within walking distance, Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam - South is a pleasant base for those who want to combine city and nature. Within 10 minutes by public transport, you are in the heart of Amsterdam. Are you looking for an activity just outside the busy capital? Then, the Amsterdamse Bos offers a variety of options, such as a relaxing walk or an active climb in the climbing forest. The modern hotel rooms are fully equipped to make your stay as pleasant as possible. This includes free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, a television with various international channels, and free coffee and tea-making facilities. Depending on your choice, your room has one double bed or two single beds. The bathroom has a walk-in shower and toiletries. The city and its surroundings are certainly inviting for a drink, but if you prefer to look a little closer, a drink in the hotel bar is also an option. Every day, an Express Start Continental take-away breakfast box is available for all our guests. This is included in the room price.

173118.description: Generator Barcelona places you in the heart of Barcelona, a 15-minute walk from Passeig de Gràcia and Casa Batlló. This hostel is 0. 4 miles from Casa Milà and 1. 1 miles from Plaça de Catalunya. Enjoy amenities such as bicycle rentals, complimentary Wi-Fi, and an arcade/game room. The hostel also features a communal living room, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine. Relax in one of the 114 guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi and blackout drapes/curtains. Daily housekeeping is provided, and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. The on-site restaurant offers meals, while the coffee shop/cafe provides snacks. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A continental breakfast is served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) is 17. 7 km (11 mi) away.

173193.description: This exotic and charming hotel enjoys a fantastic location in Paris' 15th arrondissement. The Eiffel Tower and Montparnasse railway station are both within walking distance, and Sevres-Lecourbe and Volontaires metro stations are just three minutes' walk away, providing easy access to other parts of the city. Visitors might go for a stroll along the Seine, shop on the Champs Elysees, and view the magnificent art collections at the Louvre- it's all just a few minutes away. The hotel's sleek and modern rooms are uniquely decorated with objects collected by the owner during trips to the orient. Each room features complimentary Wi-Fi, and guests can enjoy breakfast in the privacy of the room or on the pretty courtyard terrace. The hotel's helpful, multilingual staff at the 24-hour reception desk is happy to assist guests with restaurant reservations and tour bookings, all for a romantic holiday in the City of Light.

173258.address: Senapati Bapat Marg, Lower Parel, Mumbai, 462
173258.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy international cuisine at Seven Kitchens, one of the hotel's 9 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Mumbai? This hotel has 20000 square feet (1858 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 4 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 391 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Your pillowtop bed comes with Egyptian cotton sheets. 42-inch LED televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wired internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. High Street Phoenix Mall - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Palladium Mall - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Peninsula Corporate Tower - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Nehru Centre - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Atria Mall - 2. 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Nehru Planetarium - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Nehru Science Centre - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Worli Sea Face Promenade - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Mahalaxmi Racecourse - 2. 9 km / 1. 8 mi- KEM Hospital - 2. 9 km / 1. 8 mi- The National Sports Club Of India - 3 km / 1. 9 mi- Tata Memorial Hospital - 3.

173327.description: This establishment offers a total of 70 accomodation units.

173328.description: Located in the Tosmur district of Alanya, this family-friendly hotel is just 4 km east from the resort centre and situated directly across the road from the beach. Local amenities are nearby and public transport runs in front of the hotel. Alanya Castle, Damlatas Cave and the pretty harbour are all easily accessible and well worth a visit.

173355.address: Avsallar Kasabasi Merkezi Mah. Incekum Cad., 12
173355.description: The hotel is located in the small town of Avsallar, in a bay with its own section of the sand and pebble beach. Public transport runs in front of the hotel with links to bigger towns, including the popular resort of Alanya 23 km away, while local amenities can be found approximately 400 m from the hotel. This 267-room hotel shares some facilities with its sister hotel next door, enabling it to offer a wide range of amenities to suit most ages. Services available include a shuttle service to Alanya (3 days a week), Wi-Fi access in public areas, babysitter and laptop rental (some with charge).

173356.description: Enjoying a superb location, this hotel is close to the Galata bridge and Golden Horn in Istanbul. The historic area of Sultanahmet is within walking distance away, and the hotel is a mere 1 km from Taksim Square. Ataturk airport is 19 km from the hotel and Sabiha Gokcen airport is approximately 46 km away. This modern hotel offers contemporary and stylish accommodation. Combining elegance and poise, this hotel oozes modernity. The guest rooms are spacious, and combine rich pine with warm tones of chocolate and cream. Creating an inviting space for guests to relax and unwind, this hotel ensures that guests can become invigorated and rejuvenated after a stay here. The rooftop terrace offers spectacular views of the Golden Horn. Breakfast is served a la carte, and is sure to set guests up for a long day's sightseeing.

173369.description: Located in the heart of Barcelona, the 4-star Hotel Garbi Millenni is within a 5-minute drive of Plaça de Catalunya and Passeig de Gràcia. This hotel is also just 0. 5 miles from La Rambla and 2. 2 miles from Barceloneta Beach. Guests can enjoy two spa tubs, a sauna, and a fitness center. The hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a television in the common area. Each of the 46 guestrooms features an LCD television with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a bidet, a safe, and a desk. The hotel's restaurant serves a satisfying menu and guests can unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Additional amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services.

173467.description: This hotel offers 80 comfortable rooms and a welcoming lobby with 24-hour reception, a safe, and an elevator. Guests can enjoy the cafe and bar/restaurant, and a continental breakfast is available via room service or takeaway. Amenities include Wi-Fi, room and laundry services, and on-site parking. Each room features a private bathroom with amenities and a hairdryer, along with a telephone, TV, and internet access. Most rooms also offer coffee/tea making facilities, an iPod/iPhone docking station, and a work desk. Individually controlled air conditioning and heating ensure year-round comfort. Guests can take a refreshing dip in the seasonal outdoor swimming pool and relax on the sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols. A well-equipped gym is available for fitness enthusiasts. Free cribs are available for children, subject to availability.

173506.description: This hotel is situated in the south east of Berlin, in the Adlershof district, directly at the heart of the city's science, business and media hub on the WISTA grounds. Its location is perfect for business or leisure travellers visiting the city because Berlin Schönefeld airport is about 6 km away and Berlin Tegel airport is about 28 km away. This modern air-conditioned establishment offers a wide range of rooms suitable for every need. The amenities include satellite TV, a desk and Wi-Fi. Guests who wish to pamper their taste buds can enjoy a wonderful meal or a sumptuous breakfast in the restaurant. Travellers who stay at this exceptional hotel will feel right at home, thanks to a service based on warm hospitality and attention to detail.

173508.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this aparthotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The aparthotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary full breakfast is included. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 28 guestrooms, featuring kitchenettes with refrigerators and microwaves. Rooms have private balconies. LED televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

173509.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at this centrally located Athens hotel, just steps from the National Theatre of Greece and a short walk from the National Archaeological Museum. The hotel offers 51 guestrooms with private balconies, minibars, and LCD TVs with satellite programming. Start your day at the coffee shop/cafe, and unwind with room service or a drink at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and bicycle rentals.

173546.description: Indulge in on-site massages or enjoy recreational amenities such as the seasonal outdoor pool. This Mediterranean hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The hotel's restaurant serves lunch and dinner, and snacks are available at the coffee shop/café. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self-parking is available on-site. Make yourself at home in one of the five guestrooms featuring kitchens equipped with refrigerators and ovens, and private patios. iPads, MP3 docking stations, and complimentary Wi-Fi are provided for your entertainment and convenience. Additional conveniences include phones, desks, and separate sitting areas. Hotel Dionysia is located in Kaş, by the sea, a 5-minute walk from Kalkan Yacht Marine and 7 minutes from Kalkan Bazaar. This hotel is 4. 2 miles from Kaputas Beach and 9. 3 miles from Patara Ruins.

173549.address: Saray Mah. Ataturk Cad. No:101, Alanya, 3
173549.description: This apartment hotel enjoys a central location in Alanya, just 200 meters from Cleopatra Beach and 3 km from Alanya Castle. Antalya Airport is 130 km away. The charming hotel features an elegant design, welcoming guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The superbly designed apartments offer modern amenities and provide an elegant home away from home where guests can completely unwind. Enjoy a leisurely swim in the pool or relax with a refreshing drink. Air conditioning is available for a fee.

173553.description: Experience a warm home-like stay with the comfort of an outstanding hotel at Radisson Residences Avrupa TEM Istanbul. Our 142 elegantly furnished suite apartments have all the contemporary technology required for a relaxing extended stay, whether you're visiting for business or pleasure. Set in our 32-story building, guests can choose from one- or two-bedroom apartments as well as connecting apartments, Presidential Duplex Suites and our Penthouse Suite with stunning panoramic views of the European side of Istanbul. Discover fantastic in-apartment amenities such as modern kitchen facilities and free Wi-Fi. All our guests will appreciate the well-equipped fitness center and free parking.

173575.description: Located in Milan's city center, this recently renovated hotel offers convenient access to transportation, being just a short walk from Milan Central Station, a metro stop, and a bus terminal connecting to the airports. Its 68 soundproof rooms are decorated in an elegant Anglo-French style, with each detail carefully selected by the owners. Guests can enjoy amenities such as whirlpool baths, air conditioning, safes, minibars, hairdryers, satellite TVs, Wi-Fi, and direct dial telephones, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

173581.description: This charming hotel boasts an idyllic setting at the heart of the romantic city of Paris. The hotel is situated within easy access of the Champs Elysees and the Place de la Concorde. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the Orsay and Louvre museums, as well as the charming area of Saint-Germain-des-Pres. This delightful hotel greets guests with a charming architectural style, embracing the beauty and style of a bygone era. Guests are invited into a world where traditional and contemporary designs meet. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, offering a cocoon of peace and serenity in which to escape the bustle of the city. The hotel affords guests a number of exemplary facilities, catering to the needs of discerning traveller to a high level of excellence.

173606.description: Located in the district of Konakli on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, this 159-room hotel has its own section of the beach and a private jetty, a short 2-minute stroll away. The large resort of Alanya is at a 30-minute ride by local transport and well worth a visit to explore the castle and Damlatas Cave; it also has excellent shopping. Locally, there are some shops a few minutes' walk away from the hotel and public transport runs from the main road 180 m away.

173607.description: There are a total of 121 units on the premises. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection available on-site. Anita Noch Hotel provides 24-hour reception. The car park may be useful to those arriving by car. Transfer service is available for guests' convenience. Anita Noch Hotel takes pride in offering a choice of dining facilities which serve delicious culinary specialities. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

173609.description: The comfortable hotel La Perla is conveniently situated in Buenos Aires, the capital of Argentina, on the corner of Jujuy and Rivadavia Avenues, just next to the Plaza Miserere. The famous Avenida 9 de Julio, Argentine National Congress and Avenida de Mayo are within walking distance. Famous attractions such as the Obelisk, Colón Theatre or the Casa Rosada are within easy reach. Two metro stations are just a few steps away and buses leave in front of the hotel to various destinations, including the airport. All of the rooms have a modern design and feature air-conditioning, central heating and high-speed internet connection. Guests will appreciate a large variety of services and amenities, such as a business centre, meeting facilities and WIFI as well as a massage room. For added convenience, the hotel offers an on-site restaurant and a bar. A great choice for a business or city trip.

173627.description: Located behind the Blue Mosque, this hotel prides itself on its location. The Sea of Marmara, Sultanahmet and numerous other attractions are all within a short walking distance away. Istanbul Ataturk airport and Sabiha Gokcen airport are situated within easy driving distance from the hotel. Presenting a homely atmosphere, this delightful hotel tempts guests with a relaxing and inviting vibe. The guest rooms are cosy, featuring high-quality fabrics, muted tones and decadently designed furnishings. Breakfast is served buffet style and guests may choose to enjoy this meal from the hotel rooftop, commanding spectacular views over the city.

173632.description: Boasting a privileged location, at only 5 km from London city centre and within walking distance from excellent public transport links, this cosy residence is an ideal place for those seeking an affordable accommodation close to all what the city has to offer. The hostel is situated at just 100 metres from Hyde Park and a 10-minute drive away from Buckingham Palace and Piccadilly Circus. Guests may choose between different types of accommodation units, ranging from shared to private rooms, all well-appointed with comfortable furniture and modern facilities to provide a pleasant stay. After a long day exploring the city, travellers may want to relax in the common lounge area, which is equipped with comfortable seating and a flat-screen TV for guests' entertainment. Other services include a cosy bar, a 24-hour reception and free Wi-Fi in public areas.

173686.description: Located in Lisbon's bustling city center, this hotel is ideal for family vacations, business trips, and leisure travel. Freshly renovated in 2023, the hotel offers a welcoming atmosphere with a 24-hour reception desk and helpful staff eager to assist you in exploring Lisbon's attractions. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, and car rental assistance is provided. Guests can also take advantage of the luggage room for late departures, and complimentary city maps are available for easy navigation. The hotel's central location puts you steps away from shops, boutiques, supermarkets, and a diverse selection of restaurants. Lisbon International Airport is just 4. 5km away.

173721.description: This Abuja hotel, a 30-minute drive from the airport, is ideal for leisure and business travelers. Explore nearby attractions like Gurara Waterfalls and Zuma Rock. Business guests can utilize the three conference rooms and WiFi. For recreation, the staff can arrange bookings at the IBB International Golf and Country Club, just 5km away. Enjoy local cuisine at the elegant on-site restaurant.

173726.description: This contemporary hotel is perfectly situated in Lisbon's vibrant city center, just 200 meters from the beautiful Rossio Square. A wide variety of restaurants, bars, and shops are nearby, and St. George's Castle is a short walk away. The Aerobus to Lisbon Airport stops virtually at the doorstep. The hotel offers air-conditioned rooms equipped with all standard amenities for a pleasant stay. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast with various fresh food and drinks in the garden or explore the array of nearby restaurants featuring local cuisine. Please note: The triplex room has stairs to the upper beds (unsuitable for guests with limited mobility) and is accessed via the terrace in the Gat 2 building. (RNET 5225)

173795.description: The hotel is located in Quartiere Città Studi, just 4. 8 km from the centre of Milan. Shops can be found in Corso Buenos Aires, just a 15-minute walk from the hotel. The fairground Fiera Milano Rho / Pero is 30 minutes away by metro. Linate Airport is just 7 km away and Piola Metro Station is within 600 metres of the hotel. This charming city hotel is air-conditioned. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. There is a total of 30 rooms. Facilities include a hotel safe and lift access. There is also a newspaper stand. Guests can start their day in the breakfast room and enjoy a drink in the café and bar later in the day. There is also a breakfast delivery service to the room. Conference facilities and photocopying services are available to business travellers. Banqueting facilities are also on-site. Furthermore, guests can take advantage of the room service and the laundry services such as dry cleaning and ironing on offer. Wireless Internet access is also available. This charming hotel features soundproof rooms, each with air conditioning, a minibar and a satellite LCD TV. Each room has an en suite bathroom with a shower, bath and a hairdryer as well as complimentary toiletries. All rooms also come with a safe, carpeting, slippers, a wake up service and free wireless Internet access connection. Individually regulated heating is a standard feature in all accommodation. The hotel offers a rich continental buffet breakfast, served in the garden in summer. Easily accessible by metro, the nearest stop to the hotel is Piola (green line). The hotel is 4 metro stops to the central railway station (Stazione Centrale).

173833.description: Set just outside of Milan's Porta Romana railway station and a short walk from the metro station, these luxury apartments are the perfect base for a city break in Milan, yet located off the beaten track. The historic city centre is just four metro stops away, where guests can view the famous Duomo and Da Vinci's “The Last Supper”, explore the city's fantastic museums, galleries, palaces and gardens, shop on Via Montenapoleone, and sample Italian coffee alongside delicate Milanese cakes. The spacious, elegant apartments feature sophisticated, modern designs and fully-equipped kitchens. Guests will delight in the aparthotel's eco-friendly, sustainable approach to hospitality. For example, all courtesy products are organic and the light fittings replicate natural light. Guests can also enjoy free Wi-Fi and parking, and business travellers can make use of the meeting room, all for a delightful family holiday or productive business trip.

173837.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including a sauna and a 24-hour fitness center. This Art Deco hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, an arcade/game room, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Pentahotel Paris Charles, a restaurant which specializes in vegetarian cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Roissy-en-France? This hotel has 4306 square feet (400 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

173843.description: Stay at the Apex Temple Court Hotel, a stylish hotel near the Strand, King's College London, and St. Paul's Cathedral. Enjoy amenities like a fitness center, terrace, two bars/lounges, and the Chambers restaurant with room service available during limited hours. The hotel offers 204 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations, LED TVs, and private bathrooms. Complimentary Wi-Fi and digital programming are also provided. A business center, express check-in/out, and concierge services add to your convenience. Nearby attractions include the Royal Opera House, Tate Modern, and Covent Garden Market. London City Airport is 13 km away.

173848.description: The 3*** star TOP EMBRACE Hotel Grenzfall Berlin is a barrier-free and integrative hotel located in Berlin-Mitte. Handicapped people as well as non-handicapped people are working together in order to make your stay pleasant and extraordinary. The non-smoking hotel offers 37 modern and hypoallergenic rooms in different categories; restaurant, bistro, summer terrace, hotel bar, 2 meeting rooms, 3000 sqm garden area, lift and indoor parking.

173889.description: Grand Cortez Resort Hotel is located in Konaklı, Alanya district of Antalya. It is 110 km from Antalya Airport, 50 km from Gazipaşa Airport and 15 km from Alanya city center. Our hotel has 618 Standard rooms, 6 Suites, 10 Family rooms, 6 Connecting family rooms and 2 Handicapped rooms, All our rooms have a large single bed, Direct telephone line, Satellite TV broadcasting, Mini Bar, Balcony, Central air conditioning system, Safe deposit box, Carpet floor, Telephone in the bathroom, Hair dryer

173890.description: The hotel is some 150-200 m from Ç?ral? Beach, one of the most beautiful beaches on the Mediterranean, which stretches some 3. 9 km from the ruins of the ancient port of Olympos until where the foothills of Mount Chimera meet the sea. The town centre is just 500 metres from the hotel and Antalya Airport is approximately 88 km from the hotel. For those looking for an escape from everyday life and seeking peace and quiet, this is the ideal hotel. Renovated in 2012 and consisting of 24 rooms and 6 apartments on one floor and bungalow blocks, the air-conditioned, family-friendly beach hotel has many leisure and dining facilities and is set amidst a large garden. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as a hotel safe and currency exchange. There is a games room, TV lounge, café, a bar and a restaurant, and guests will appreciate the wireless Internet access. Guests can also take advantage of the room and laundry services (both for a fee). Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel car park. Bicycles can be hired at the hotel. The rooms are pleasantly furnished and equipped with air conditioning and central heating, a mini fridge, satellite TV and wireless Internet access. The apartments have 2 rooms and a small kitchenette suitable for making light meals. An en suite bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, and a private balcony or terrace also feature as standard. The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool and small paddling pool for kids, a playground and 14, 000 square metres of gardens with hammocks, parasols and sun beds for lying back and relaxing on. There is also a poolside snack bar and sun terrace. For the more energetic, the hotel provides free bikes for exploring the magnificent countryside. Guests may also play table tennis, or go motor boating (fees apply). There is an entertainment programme on offer for children. Sun loungers and parasols can be hired on the pebble beach.

173892.description: Melissa Residence & Spa is a 4-star hotel located in the center of Kemer. This hotel is about 16 km away from Three Islands Diving Area. The venue is set within 2 km from Kemer city center. This property offers proximity to mountains and a green area. Room amenities at Melissa Residence & Spa Hotel include a mini bar, a safe, coffee/tea makers, a DVD player and IDD phone. Guests can enjoy a meal in Casa La Luna and Nasrettin Hocha, which are located in a green area, about 5 minutes' walk from Melissa Residence & Spa Hotel. Antalya airport lies within 50 minutes' drive away from Melissa Residence & Spa Hotel

173896.description: Located in the popular resort of Kemer, this aparthotel is a mere 5 minutes' walk from the city centre. Antalya airport is some 55 km away, whilst the nearest sandy beach is only a 15 minutes' walk from the complex. This charming aparthotel comprises apartments and studios which evoke a home-away-from-home feeling. Coupling essential features with comfortable, stylish surroundings, guests are sure to feel relaxed and rejuvenated whilst away. Guests wishing to engage in some exercise can enjoy a refreshing swim in the outdoor pool, while those seeking the ultimate relaxation can lounge on the sun terrace. A delightful continental-style breakfast is served each morning ensuring that guests are fuelled and energised for the day ahead. Guests staying in this complex will feel relaxed and rested after their stay here.

173914.description: Situated in central Braga, Hotel Dom Vilas is a short walk from Braga Se Cathedral and the Altice Forum Braga. The hotel offers air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, and guests can enjoy a furnished sun terrace. Each room at Dom Vilas features large windows, parquet floors, a work desk, and a flat-screen TV with cable channels. All rooms include a private bathroom with a hairdryer, and room service is available. A continental breakfast with fresh fruit is served daily, and the bar provides refreshing beverages and cocktails. Guests can take advantage of laundry and ironing services, as well as a large meeting room and an on-site cash machine. The hotel is conveniently located near Braga Municipal Stadium and offers a 24-hour front desk and free private parking.

173995.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as bicycle rentals, a terrace, and a garden at this hotel, which also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Savor German cuisine at Am Griebnitzsee, the onsite restaurant with a bar/lounge, garden views, and alfresco dining. Room service is available during limited hours. Buffet breakfast is served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities consist of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The 87 guest rooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include Griebnitzsee (0. 1 mi), Parforceheide (0. 5 mi), Babelsberg Film Park (1. 1 mi), and Park Babelsberg (1. 4 mi). The nearest major airport is Berlin (BER-Brandenburg), 49 km away.

174019.description: Ideally located in the prime touristic area of Midtown West, Hotel The OUT NYC promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. The hotel offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, daily housekeeping, wheelchair accessible, 24-hour front desk, facilities for disabled guests are just some of the facilities on offer. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer television LCD/plasma screen, carpeting, sofa, internet access – wireless, internet access – wireless (complimentary) to ensure a restful night. Enjoy the hotel's recreational facilities, including hot tub, fitness center, sauna, spa, massage, before retiring to your room for a well-deserved rest. A welcoming atmosphere and excellent service are what you can expect during your stay at Hotel The OUT NYC.

174086.description: The new Steigenberger Airport Hotel Berlin welcomes you with a prime location, directly at the terminal of the new Berlin Brandenburg Airport BER and only a few meters away from the train station (ICE/S-Bahn connection). The top address for your business or event. Are you looking for a conference room in Berlin? The hotel with its conference center is the ideal event location at the Airport BER for events with up to 500 participants. The excellent public transport connections make you reach Berlin-Mitte within 30 minutes. The hotel can also be reached easily via the direct motorway connection (A113). THE NUMBER ONE AT T1Our 322 modern and comfortably furnished hotel rooms and suites provide relaxation and peace amidst the hustle and bustle of the airport. These include air conditioning, flatscreen TV, iron, desk, safe, minibar, coffee and tea making facilities. For the comfort of the guests, there are numerous public parking spaces available in the immediate vicinity. The hotel also has five handicapped-accessible guest rooms and offers baby and extra beds on request. In our élise Restaurant & Bar you can start the day strengthened with our Steigenberger breakfast. With around 250 seats, the restaurant offers a selection of international dishes as well as well-known regional delicacies until late in the evening. Escape the stressful daily routine and relax in our SPA and wellness area on the fifth floor.

174169.description: The Stay Nişantaşı offers 44 state-of-the-art rooms in Istanbul's trendy Nişantaşı district, known for its designer boutiques and Art Nouveau architecture. Located above the Prada flagship store, the hotel boasts spacious accommodations with unique furnishings and modern lighting. Luxury brands like Gucci and Louis Vuitton are steps away. Experience a new definition of luxury and capture the rhythm of Istanbul at The Stay Nişantaşı.

174187.description: Hotel offers both hotel rooms and furnished apartments for long stay guests. The hotel is located in Rosales, one of the most exclusive areas of Bogotá. The hotel is located just a few steps away from the city's financial and commercial centres Andino. This exclusive setting is perfect whether guests are travelling for business or leisure purposes. Guests will find themselves in Zona G, famous for its restaurants, walking distance to Zona T and the financial district of Calle 72. The El Dorado International Airport is only a 30 minutes' driving distance from the hotel. This upscale hotel exudes sophistication and elegance. The apartments sumptuously designed, featuring stylish decor and functional space fitted with modern amenities. This charming hotel offers guests a wonderful home away from home with personalized service, in a strategic setting in Bogota.

174206.address: Göynük Mah. Başkomutan Atatürk, Beldibi Cad. No:, 171
174206.description: Refurbished and under new management since 2014, this beachside hotel enjoys a wonderful location bordering the Mediterranean Sea and with the Taurus Mountains serving as a backdrop. The resort of Kemer is 12 km away and the centre of Antalya 30 km. Surrounded by lush vegetation, there are some small shops, hotels and other amenities within the vicinity of the hotel and a bus stop nearby. Featuring a range of facilties, guests can benefit from a rejuvenating massage or steam in the hotel's spa and enjoy the outdoor pool and close proximity to the pebbly beach where a long pier provides the perfect spot for lying out under the sun.

174434.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). This Victorian hotel also features gift shops/newsstands, a communal living room, and a vending machine. If you're ready for some gaming fun, you can hop on the casino shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy international cuisine at Stephanies Cafe/Bar, a café which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 258 square feet (24 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 28 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your Select Comfort bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Cromwell Road - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Holland Park - 0. 6 km / 0. 3 mi- Kensington High Street - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Design Museum - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Kensington Gardens - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Imperial College London - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Natural History Museum - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Science Museum - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Kensington Palace - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Royal Albert Hall - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Victoria and Albert Museum - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Hyde Park - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Portobello Road Market - 2. 2 km / 1. 3 mi- King's Road - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi.

174466.description: A well-appointed hotel near London Luton Airport, with dining and ample parkingHoliday Inn® London - Luton Airport hotel is a short walk or drive from the airport and a five-minute drive from the M1 motorway. Luton town centre is 2 miles away, as is Luton Airport Parkway station, which offers trains to central London in under 30 minutes. Stockwood Discovery Centre's beautiful gardens and fascinating historical exhibits are easily reachable by car. Wildlife experiences at Whipsnade Zoo and Woburn Safari Park are within 20 miles of our hotel. Warner Bros. Studio Tour: The Making of Harry Potter, a family favourite, is within a 25-minute drive. With on-site parking and excellent transport links, the hotel is a convenient meeting site. Two naturally lit conference rooms seat up to 80 people, and catering is available. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- Kids stay and eat free- Fitness CentreStart your day with a full English breakfast in the Grill & Kitchen Restaurant, also open for lunch and dinner. In the evening, unwind with a glass of wine in our bar, which combines sophisticated decor with a relaxed atmosphere. There's even a patio for good weather. Bedrooms have triple-glazed windows and a pillow menu to ensure a peaceful sleep. You can order something from 24-hour room service to savour as you watch a movie on the Smart TV.

174472.description: The Virginia Palace Hotel welcomes you to its sophisticated, classic-meets-modern ambiance. Our 61 warmly decorated rooms offer understated elegance and are equipped with air conditioning, digital TV with Mediaset Premium channels, a minibar (complimentary water provided), a safe, and Wi-Fi. The hotel restaurant, overlooking our tranquil garden, serves Italian cuisine featuring fresh, local, and national specialties. For business guests, we offer two large meeting rooms (Alfa and Omega), each 70m² with natural light and configurable for theater-style (50 seats) or U-shape (25 seats) setups. A smaller Garden Room (8 seats) with natural light also overlooks the garden.

174488.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting in San Isidro, lying amidst one of the most exclusive residential and financial districts in Lima. The hotel is located within easy access of major financial institutions and corporations, as well as a host of shopping opportunities. Guests will find themselves just a 10 minutes' walking distance from the city centre and restaurants. The hotel is located within easy driving distance of the Sala Museo Oro del Peru Larcomar and the Museum of Gold. Jorge Chavez International Airport is located just a 30 minutes' driving distance from the hotel. This wonderful hotel welcomes guests into a world of comfort and charm. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, featuring soothing tones and a relaxing ambience. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests will appreciate the range of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

174493.description: Enjoy a refreshing stay at this hotel, featuring a 24-hour health club and an outdoor pool. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, or take advantage of the concierge services and banquet hall. A complimentary area shuttle provides transport to nearby destinations. Dine at one of the two on-site restaurants, grab a snack at the coffee shop, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the poolside bar or one of four other bars/lounges. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fees apply). For business needs, the hotel offers complimentary wired internet, a 24-hour business center, and limo service. Conference space and meeting rooms are also available. The hotel provides an airport shuttle for a surcharge and free self-parking. The 94 guestrooms offer refrigerators, LCD TVs with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers, including deep soaking tubs and complimentary toiletries. Safes, desks, and phones are also provided. Nearby attractions include the Maryland Mall (1. 5 mi), Computer Village (1. 9 mi), and Allen Avenue (2. 1 mi).

name.content: Sunday Hotel Al Barsha Dubai Mall of the Emirates

174547.description: The hotel Sunday Hotel Al Barsha Dubai Mall Of The Emirates is strategically located in the heart of New Dubai at interchange 4 on the Sheikh Zayed Road. The area is called Al Barsha and is just a 25-minute drive from Dubai International Airport; ten minutes from the Dubai World Trade Centre and Jebel Ali; five minutes from Jumeirah Road and within walking distance of the famous Mall of Emirates. The hotel has on site underground parking and valet parking services available to guests free of charge.

174553.description: Set in the heart of Westfield Stratford’s urban shopping and entertainment complex, Hyatt House London Stratford offers spacious, apartment-style accommodations suitable for extended stays. Amenities such as a fully equipped kitchen and complimentary laundry room access help guests maintain their routine. Enjoy all-day dining in the Elondi Restaurant or a beverage on the fabulous terrace. With 24-hour gym access, complimentary wireless internet, and a grab-and-go market for essentials, you have everything you need to make your stay seamless. The hotel boasts fantastic connections to central London and the South East, allowing you to explore further afield or experience local attractions, including the Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, home to iconic venues such as the Copper Box, ArcelorMittal Orbit, London Aquatics Centre, Lee Valley VeloPark, and the London Stadium, home to West Ham United football club.

174586.description:
Welcome to DoubleTree by Hilton Bogotá – Parque 93, a modern and welcoming hotel ideally located in one of Bogotá’s most vibrant and exclusive areas. Situated within the city’s financial and business district and just minutes from Parque de la 93, the hotel places guests close to renowned restaurants, shopping, entertainment and major corporate destinations. 

Enjoy a comfortable and contemporary stay in our spacious guest rooms, featuring high ceilings, elegant décor, soundproof windows, air conditioning, complimentary Wi-Fi, a 42-inch HDTV, mini-refrigerator, coffeemaker, multimedia hub and laptop-sized safe. Our suites offer an enhanced experience with a separate living area, dining space and whirlpool bath. 

Experience the signature DoubleTree welcome with our warm chocolate chip cookie at check-in, a distinctive touch that makes every stay memorable. 

Savor international cuisine and an inviting atmosphere at Agata Steak House Restaurant, or enjoy a more relaxed experience at Big Bang Coffee & Bar, an ideal setting for coffee, drinks, casual dining as pizza and social gatherings. 

For business travelers, groups and events, the hotel offers a 24-hour business center and seven versatile event spaces accommodating from 10 to 320 guests, many featuring natural daylight. Our dedicated team can assist with audiovisual equipment, translation services, flowers, linens and event décor to create a seamless experience. 

With its strategic location, contemporary accommodations, distinctive dining experiences and renowned DoubleTree hospitality, DoubleTree by Hilton Bogotá – Parque 93 is an excellent choice for business trips, leisure stays, extended stays, groups and events in Bogotá.

174607.description: The hotel is located in the centre of resort and yet close to the beach, which is only 6 to 7 minutes' walk away. Within a short walk from the hotel, guests will find most local amenities, including shops, bars, restaurants and nightlife.
