Nearby places of interest include Kemer Open-Air Folk Museum (approximately 1. 5 km), the ruins of the ancient city of Phaselis (approximately 13 km) and Antalya Old Town and harbour (approximately 44 km away). Antalya Airport is approximately 59 km away from the hotel. This air-conditioned 3-star hotel was renovated in 2011, consists of a main building and an annexe and comprises a total of 73 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as a hotel safe, currency exchange and a TV lounge. It offers Internet access, and a laundry service is available for a fee. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel car park. All rooms are simply decorated and en suite with a shower and a hairdryer. Each room offers satellite/cable TV, safe (fees apply) and a mini fridge. Further standard features of accommodation units include individually regulated air conditioning and a balcony or terrace. The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool and children's swimming area, as well as a sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols laid out ready for use at the water's edge. Moreover, sun loungers and parasols are available for hire on the nearby pebble beach. eals are served in buffet form. Guests can enjoy a drink at the bar, and dine in the restaurant. All-inclusive packages are available.

174630.description: Located in the Cannaregio District, only at a 10-minute walk from Saint Marks' Square and 5 minutes away from the Rialto Bridge, the Giorgione hotel is perfect for couples on a romantic escapade. The hotel is decorated in a classic Venetian style with Murano glass chandeliers, and features a beautiful interior courtyard with a fountain, the perfect spot to have a late breakfast or a romantic candlelight dinner. This 18th Century building is near the Casino and a quick stroll away from the Doges' Palace, Ca' D'Oro and La Fenice Theatre. The ferry station is also really close to the hotel and the railway station is 2 km away. Guests staying at the hotel will be able to taste traditional Venetian dishes at the Osteria Giorgione restaurant and wine bar next to the hotel. The splendid islands of Laguna, Murano, Burano and Torcello are only a boat ride away, leaving from Fondamenta Nuove.

174713.description: Located in the immediate vicinity of Disneyland® Paris and the Village Valley, the Adagio Serris-Val d'Europe is the ideal base for your family stay. It has 210 fully furnished apartments with an equipped kitchen, accommodating up to six people. During your stay, you can enjoy the outdoor heated swimming pool from May to September, fitness room, sauna and private parking (surcharge and on request). The Aparthotel has a free shuttle service to Disneyland® Paris

174715.description: The hotel is situated in the coastal city of Negombo and nestled right on the beach with tropical surroundings. Negombo is situated by the shores of a lagoon and was once a trading port for the Portuguese and the Dutch. It is just 18 minutes' drive from Bandaranaike International Airport. This charming establishment offers a choice of well-appointed ocean view rooms and is the ideal place for those wishing to relax and unwind in a peaceful and serene setting. It also provides the guests with personalized service. Guests who have the chance to spend time in this beach hotel have the possibility to taste delicious seafood and mouth-watering hot local rice and curry.

174755.description: Located in the heart of the bustling Citystars complex, Holiday Inn® Cairo Citystars is just 10 minutes from Cairo International Airport, making it the ideal choice for both business and leisure travelers. With direct access to Stars Centre Mall, home to over 640 shops and unique attractions like Snow City and Magic Galaxy indoor theme park, the hotel's location offers endless entertainment. Downtown Cairo, with its rich history and modern attractions, is only a 30-minute drive away. Our Concierge team is on hand to help you plan visits to iconic landmarks, including the Pyramids of Giza, Khan El Khalili Bazaar, and the much-anticipated Grand Egyptian Museum. Relax and unwind at our rooftop garden, featuring swimming pools for both adults and children. Enjoy a diverse culinary journey with our 24/7 Windows Restaurant, offering international buffets and live cooking, or savor authentic Indian flavors at Indira Restaurant. For casual moments, Star Corner Café in the lobby is perfect for a quick coffee or snack. Business travelers can stay productive with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, a Business Center, and 24-hour room service. Plan your next meeting in one of our seven stylish meeting rooms, accommodating up to 70 delegates, with major corporate offices just a short distance away. Whether your visit to Cairo is for business or leisure, find a warm and inviting home at this hotel amid the vibrant ambiance of Citystars Heliopolis.

174806.description: Boasting a convenient location between the Opera districts and Montmartre, this luxurious establishment provides the perfect base from which to explore all the beautiful city of Paris has to offer. The world renowned Moulin Rouge is just 200 metres away and Clichy Boulevard, a popular street in Paris, is just a few steps away. Situated in a quiet location in the heart of a bustling area oriented towards music and theatre, this property provides a choice of tastefully decorated guest rooms. Guests will be delighted by the extensive range of luxurious services at their disposal, including complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection or courtesy tray for tea and coffee in superior rooms. A delicious buffet breakfast is served every morning although those most demanding customers may enjoy it in their room or in the terrace.

174814.address: Andheri Kurla Main Road, Opp/Mukund Nagar Hospital
174814.description: The hotel is located on the main Andheri-Kurla road in Mumbai, opposite Mukund Nagar Hospital and next to Axis Bank and the corporate Business Centre building. The air-conditioned hotel has been designed and furnished to be the ultimate destination for a living experience with contemporary style and luxury. It welcomes guests with 20 luxuriously appointed guest rooms and it was designed as a budget hotel to suit the varying needs of different guests, with a host of innovative features and facilities. Amenities include a hotel safe, lift access, a newspaper stand, a TV lounge and guests can also take advantage of the room and laundry services. The property features different room categories to suit all accommodation needs. Rooms match the budget traveller's requirements and allow guests to enjoy an outstanding experience that guarantees maximum personal satisfaction. All rooms are en suite and feature a hairdryer, a double bed, a TV, Internet access, a safe and tea and coffee making facilities. The hotel offers a massage service.

name.content: Pillows Grand Boutique Hotel Place Rouppe Brussels

174830.description: Within 10 minutes of leaving Central Station or Station Midi/South, you will be on the historic and lively Place Rouppe. Surrounded by authentic Belgian architecture, you will enter a hotel unlike any other. Pillows Grand Hotel Place Rouppe instils new life into a neoclassical building. As soon as you step into the newly refurbished Pillows, you will be welcomed by the residential ambiance of the Living – Winebar & Lounge –. Savour a flavoursome dish, sip your way through a menu of carefully selected wines or relax and enjoy a pleasant read in front of the crackling fire. Pillows Grand Hotel Place Rouppe is the ideal location to immerse yourself in the pulse of Brussels. You are just a few steps away from the city's highlights and the local entertainment scene filled with bars, restaurants, theatres and galleries. After soaking up some culture or sampling the city's nightlife, a soothing bed awaits you on your return to the hotel. Welcome to the epitome of timeless charm.

174831.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a satisfying meal at Il Canneto Restaurant serving guests of Sheraton Milan Malpensa Airport Hotel & Conference Center. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Ferno? This hotel has 21528 square feet (2000 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 437 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets.

174866.description: Enjoying a unique location, the hotel is situated in the very heart of the fashionable Recoleta neighbourhood with its typical French architecture. The hotel is situated just a few metres from the famous Museum of Fine Arts and Latin American Art Museum, as well as art exhibitions on display at the Recoleta Cultural Centre. A new concept provides exclusively designed furniture, permanent art exhibitions and a library. Further facilities available to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a nice cafe, a cosy bar and a breakfast room. Internet access in public areas is also available. Room and laundry services are also provided. The rooms are well-equipped with all necessary fittings.

174920.description: The Stay Bosporus is located in the picturesque and central neighbourhood of Ortakoy, a lively and vibrant district that is a popular destination for anyone who has ever set foot in Istanbul, visitors and residents alike. The Stay Bosphorus is housed in a 5-storey, 19th Century Ottoman Mansion right at the foot of the XXX bridge with magnificent views on the Bosphorus.  The Stay Bosphorus offers a total of 26 rooms, 16 of which impress with spectacular sweeping panoramic views of the Bosphorus from every angle, with the city and its ancient structures as its backdrop. Internationally acclaimed design firm, Autoban, has renovated the building to maintain its historical charm, while providing guests with state-of-the-art contemporary design blended with historical glamour.   The restaurant, ‘The Bosphorus Lounge Bar', serves carefully selected, seasonal anddelicious food from Turkish and international cuisine, to be enjoyed alongside magnificentviews stretching from the Bosphorus Bridge to the Topkapı Palace. The historic mansion located just across the cobblestone street marks the entrance to the main building which offers the Executive Lounge, a private area that is exclusive to guestsstaying in Penthouse Bosphorus, Executive Bosphorus and Penthouse suites. The Executive Lounge is designed to ensure privacy and as such, has no outside access. It is the perfect spot in which to sit by a window taking in the scene onto the lively streets of Ortakoy, whilst enjoying local gourmet delicacies. Affording time in a comfortable and secluded space, the Executive Suite is a haven in the heart of the city. The original building was built by the Balyan family, masters of Ottoman architecture who were responsible for shaping Istanbul's architectural identity by constructing most of the buildings for the Empire, including Dolmabahce Palace, Beylerbeyi Palace and the neighbouring Ortakoy Mosque.

174932.description: The Ampersand is an elegant boutique hotel in South Kensington. This beautifully restored Victorian treasure is a small luxury hotel near the V&A, Natural History Museum and many of London's most popular museums. It is also well located for Harrods and shopping in Knightsbridge, Hyde Park, Chelsea and the Kings Road. With South Kensington tube station just across the street, all of London is within easy reach.

174935.description: This hotel enjoys an idyllic setting in Omonia, Athens. The hotel is located within easy access of a myriad of attractions in the area, including Alfa, the National Theatre and Orpheus. This delightful hotel enjoys a happy blend of traditional and contemporary Grecian designs. Welcoming guests with warm hospitality and the promise of a memorable stay, the hotel offers the perfect option for business and leisure travellers alike. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, and enjoy a simplistic style and relaxing ambience. The rooms offer a wide range of exemplary facilities, ensuring that guests enjoy the ultimate in comfort and relaxation. Guests are invited to enjoy a relaxing stay amidst the enchanting surroundings of this hotel.

174936.description: This charming hotel enjoys a delightful setting, just 11 km from Piraeus Port, 34 km from Athens airport and a mere 1. 9 km from the town centre. Within a short walking distance, guests can enjoy a host of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. The hotel greets guests with warm hospitality and a tranquil atmosphere. The hotel rooms exude a tranquil atmosphere, featuring modern furnishings and neutral, soothing tones. The rooms feature modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. The hotel offers a wide range of facilities and activities for guests' enjoyment. For a break unlike any other, this hotel provides comfort and tranquillity, sure to impress even the most discerning guest.

175071.description: The hotel is situated in a traditional Turkish neighbourhood towards the southern tip of the historical peninsula of Sultanahmet. All the major local sight-seeing attractions are within a 10-minute walk and the Marmara Sea coastline is just 200m away. Public transport links and various local amenities can be found in the vicinity. This small, 10-room hotel has a wooden facade and wooden floors and offers guests pleasant accommodation with a small lobby/reception area and free Wi-Fi access. The attractive rooms feature hardwood floors and are furnished with handmade furniture and specially produced fabrics. The bathrooms are well equipped and the rooms have free Wi-Fi, as well as adjustable air-conditioning ensuring a comfortable stay.

175088.description: Situated moments from numerous Parisian attractions, this hotel offers an ideal base for exploring the city. A short 20-minute drive from Charles de Gaulle Airport, the hotel welcomes guests with a 24-hour reception. Facilities include a TV lounge, café, and restaurant, along with Wi-Fi throughout. A range of single, double, twin, and triple rooms are available, each featuring double glazing, internet access, and central heating. Standard amenities are included, though showers and WCs are located in the corridor. Guests can also enjoy the beach with its sun loungers and parasols.

175099.description:
Petit Palace Lealtad Plaza occupies an early 19th-century building in one of Madrid's most exclusive settings, next to the Madrid Stock Exchange and opposite the Hotel Ritz. The Prado Museum and Retiro Park are within 200 metres, and the Reina Sofía and Thyssen-Bornemisza museums are less than a 15-minute walk away, placing the hotel at the heart of the Golden Triangle of Art. Puerta del Sol is just over 1 km away, Banco de España Metro Station is 650 metres from the hotel, and Atocha railway station, with its high-speed AVE services, can be reached on foot in under 20 minutes. 

The 71 spacious, stylish rooms feature contemporary décor with subtle gold, black or lilac finishes. All come with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a minibar, free WiFi and a bathroom with a hydromassage shower. 

The hotel has a 24-hour reception and its own restaurant, along with a bicycle hire service and a dedicated storage room for bikes, a useful touch for guests arriving in Madrid with their own. With its prime location between the Prado and Retiro Park, its historic building and its elegant setting, Petit Palace Lealtad Plaza is an ideal base for exploring Madrid's museum district.

name.content: Ramada By Wyndham Buenos Aires Vicente Lopez

175235.description: Ramada Hotel, located in the province of Buenos Aires, in the heart of Vicente López, meters from the Paseo de la Costa and the Quinta Presidencial. With a magnificent view of the river and easy access to the city of Buenos Aires. Just 14km from the Obelisco and 10 km from Aeroparque. The best option for your business trip, tourism or corporate travel. We offer the best service and comfort with spacious rooms and personalized attention.

175239.description: This is a classic and trendy hostel inside Barrio Lastarria - Parque Forestal - Bellas Artes area. It is in a unique location, next to transportation, local attractions, cafes, restaurants, parks, museums, bars and clubs. Pablo Neruda's house is in the neighbourhood and 10 minutes away is Providencia, Santiago's most sophisticated area.

175382.address: 34-B, Opp. Fame Adlabs Cinema, Off New Link Road
175382.description: This comfortable, modern hotel is conveniently located in Andheri West, just six kilometres from the Bombay Exhibition Center and a ten-minute drive from the beaches of Juhu and Versova. The nearest railway station is ten minutes away, while the Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport can be reached in 20 minutes by car. The hotel is also surrounded with such attractions as Fame Adlabs cinema, Infinity Mall, Fun Republic and Mega Mall. The well-furnished rooms come with all modern facilities, including cable television, high-speed internet access, and 24-hour room service. The versatile onsite conference room can seat up to 40 guests for meetings, workshops and even social functions such as parties. This hotel's great services and cosy rooms make it an excellent choice for both business and leisure travel in Mumbai.

175387.address: The Grove, Bath Road, Sipson, West Drayton
175387.description: The hustle and bustle of Heathrow is quickly forgotten once you enter the Hyatt Place Heathrow Airport hotel where our warm and welcoming lobby makes it easy to relax and unwind. Conveniently located with just a 5-minute drive from Heathrow Airport, the 4-star Hyatt Place Heathrow Airport hotel features spacious, soundproofed guest rooms, a 24-hour front desk and parking. Our newly refurbished, contemporary and spacious rooms are designed with comfort and convenience in mind; providing a place to unwind or to catch up on work with some of the rooms offering excellent views of the runway, you can relax in a peaceful and calm environment. A mini-fridge and a laptop safe are included in each of our fully air-conditioned rooms, all with a private bathroom and triple-glazed sound proof windows. A large 42inch HD TV, a hairdryer, alarm clock radio and tea and coffee making facilities have also been included for your convenience.

175389.description: Enjoy garden views and a terrace at The Crown Inn, along with amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi. Savor a meal at the Inn's restaurant or a drink at the bar/lounge. Start your day with a complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast, served daily between 7:30 AM and 9 AM. The Inn offers complimentary newspapers in the lobby, an elevator, and free self-parking. Each of the seven guestrooms features a flat-screen television, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer, a phone, a desk, and a coffee/tea maker. Nearby attractions include Eltham Palace (3. 4 mi), Greenwich Park (6. 4 mi), and the O2 Arena (8 mi). The nearest airports are London City (12. 9 mi) and Gatwick (38. 1 mi).

175391.description: An iconic hotel located in the heart of London's Covent Garden and surrounded by West End theatres, top sights, exclusive boutiques and the hottest restaurants. Where contemporary culture and design meets stunning architecture and bespoke service for an experience beyond accommodation. This lavish hotel enjoys an enviable setting right on the Strand in the very heart of London. Temple tube station can be reached in a five-minute walk, and Covent Garden and Charing Cross stations are also nearby, providing quick and incredibly easy access to all parts of this vibrant city. The hotel's luxurious Guestrooms and Suites offer contemporary design, state-of-art technology and floor-to-ceiling windows. Guests can enjoy fantastic city views from the stylish Radio Rooftop Restaurant and Terrace Bar, coffee and cocktails in the Marconi Lounge and vibe dining at the world-famous STK London. For travelers on a decadent city break or important business trip, this hotel is the perfect choice.

175402.description: The five-star Central Hotel Doha by IHG is located in the center of Doha city in Qatar, just 25 minutes drive from Hamad International Airport and 2 minutes away from Joaan Metro Station. The hotel's ideal central location not only allows easy arrival from the airport but presents the best of Doha's attractions within easy reach. Explore Doha's Aspire Zone and Doha Festival City, visit the National Theater or attend events at the Qatar National Convention Centre and Education City. Historical sites such as Souq Waqif, Corniche, and Museum of Islamic Arts are easy to access along with shopping highlights the Land Mark Mall, Villaggio Mall, Tawar Mall and Mall of Qatar.

175430.description: Situated between Cibeles and Colón squares, near the National Library and Archaeological Museum, this property offers studios for up to 4 guests and apartments for up to 6. Amenities include porter service, telephone, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, heating, laundry, and Smart TVs. Each unit features a full bathroom, ceramic hob, microwave, refrigerator, and on request, a Dolce Gusto coffee maker, juicer, toaster, iron, and ironing board. Arranged parking is available nearby.

175530.description: The hotel has a great location, approximately 25 metres from the banks of the turquoise waters of the Manavgat River. The centre of town is a couple of minutes' walk away and the historical and tourist village of Side is 8 km away and easily reached by public transport. Antalya Airport is approximately 67 km from the hotel. A pleasant, small, boutique-style hotel offers 14 rooms and is fully air-conditioned. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as a currency exchange. There is a café, a TV lounge and a breakfast room, and guests will appreciate the wireless Internet access. A laundry service is available for an additional fee. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel car park. The modern rooms have laminate parquet flooring and are attractively furnished with fresh coloured bed covers. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer, and offer a double bed. The rooms also come equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, Internet access, a safe and a mini fridge. Further standard features of accommodation units include individually regulated air conditioning and heating, and a balcony/terrace. Sun loungers and parasols can be hired for a fee on the sandy beach. Breakfast is served in an open buffet style. Lunch and dinner are available à la carte.

175531.description:
Located in Yenibosna, one of Istanbul’s rapidly developing districts, Istanbul Gönen Hotel offers its guests an unforgettable accommodation experience with its modern architecture, spacious social areas, and distinguished service approach. Thanks to its close proximity to the city’s business centers, exhibition and fairgrounds, shopping areas, and main transportation routes, it is an ideal choice for both business and leisure travelers. 

The hotel features a total of 305 stylish and comfortable rooms, designed to meet all guest needs with modern décor, ergonomic living spaces, and high-tech amenities. Facilities such as adjustable air conditioning, electronic safe, minibar, Full HD TV, and tea and coffee setup provide guests with both practical and comfortable accommodation. 

The hotel’s extensive meeting and event facilities offer a professional infrastructure suitable for all types of needs—from corporate meetings and private invitations to large-scale organizations and boutique events. Equipped with state-of-the-art technology, supported by an experienced event team, and complemented by spacious foyer areas, the hotel ensures that every event is carried out smoothly and successfully. 

With a service philosophy that prioritizes guest satisfaction, Istanbul Gönen Hotel stands out as a prestigious accommodation destination where comfort, quality, and elegance come together. Every detail has been carefully considered to make your time in the city both productive and enjoyable. 

Please note that our outdoor pool is open from 1:00 PM to 6:00 PM on Mondays due to scheduled maintenance, and from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM on all other days.

175534.description: Located close to Aksaray and approximately 2 km from the historical attractions at Sultanahmet, the hotel is well placed for sightseeing. Additionally, public transport is available close by and local amenities are within 400 m of the hotel. Taksim Square in the centre of Istanbul is approximately 5 km from the hotel. Istanbul-Ataturk Airport is around 16 km from the hotel and Sabiha-Gokcen airport is roughly 55 km away. This modest, air-conditioned city hotel consists of 44 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as a currency exchange and lift access to the upper floors. There is a rooftop terrace and a restaurant, while room and laundry services are offered for an extra charge. Free wireless Internet access is available throughout the hotel. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel car park. The rooms are simply furnished and equipped with air conditioning and heating, a minibar, safe, TV and free wireless Internet access, as well as an en suite bathroom with shower and hairdryer. A continental buffet breakfast is served each morning at the hotel.

175536.description: An elegant central Paris hotel, right on the Place de la République and close to the vibrant Marais district. Welcome to Crowne Plaza® Paris – République. We are a hotel located in the heart of Paris on a very lively square near typical Parisian brasseries and the Canal Saint-Martin. Various cultural points are also on offer in the surrounding area, such as the Opéra Garnier and the Museum of Modern Art at the Centre de Pompidou. Our hotel offers easy access to 5 metro lines allowing you to go anywhere in Paris. The Gare du Nord, where the Eurostar leaves for London is 10 minutes away by taxi, as is the Gare de l'Est, which serves Strasbourg, Frankfurt and Munich. Paris Charles de Gaulle airport is 40 minutes away by car or by public transport. If you’re here on business, we have 9 flexible event spaces that can accommodate up to 250 people, including the Studio, an innovative and flexible space. Our accommodations also offer free WI-Fi and spaces suitable for coworking and teleworking. Maintain your workout routine at our 24-hour fitness center. Our historic 1866 building also has an outdoor courtyard providing a peaceful space for guests. Meals are served non-stop in the bar with a view of Place de la République. Our 328 rooms are calm and sophisticated, some offer a view of the courtyard or the square.

175610.description: This property offers a total of 32 guest rooms.

175667.description: The hotel is located on Avinguda Parallel, less than 3 km from Las Ramblas and Barcelona's Gothic Quarter. A metro station is a short walk away, and Barcelona Airport is less than a 30-minute drive. This elegant hotel offers modern, air-conditioned rooms providing comfortable accommodations and a cozy ambiance. Business travelers can utilize the on-site business center, and all guests are welcome to take advantage of the internet access. On-site parking is also available. The well-trained, friendly staff provides 24-hour service and assistance to ensure a comfortable stay.

175670.description: This superb hotel, located in Bur Dubai's central business district, is a 10-minute walk from Burjuman Shopping Centre. It offers a wealth of facilities, including a rooftop pool and hot tub. Each air-conditioned room is decorated in a modern style with warm colors and wooden furniture. Modern amenities include cable TV, a DVD player, a kitchen, and a microwave, ideal for guests who enjoy preparing their own meals. Business travelers will find this hotel exceptionally convenient.

175733.description: Welcome to Crowne Plaza Doha The Business Park – Your 5-Star Oasis in the Heart of Qatar's Vibrant Capital. Crowne Plaza® Doha – The Business Park is the ideal hotel for business and leisure travel. Conveniently located at the Business Park close to West Bay DECC, Katara Cultural Village and Lusail - Crowne Plaza® Doha The Business Park is just a 15-minute drive from Hamad International Airport and is a mere 3-minute walk from Doha Al Jadeeda Metro station. Our 378 stylish guest rooms and suites are equipped with modern amenities designed for comfort and high-speed wireless internet access to stay connected. Our meeting rooms are located on the lobby level and our event spaces at The Event Centre is optimal for weddings and other upscale functions. To ensure success, our extremely talented Crowne Plaza Meetings Manager will assist you from start to finish. When business is done, wind down at any one of six restaurants and bars, or in our health club which features an on-site fully equipped Fitness Center, a spa and an outdoor pool. For a long term stay at Crowne Plaza® Doha - The Business Park, we also have well-appointed residences featuring one or two bedroom apartment style suites, with the convenience and service of a five star hotel.

175736.description: This hotel is located in Doha's intriguing Souq Waqif, lying just a 15 minutes' driving distance from the airport. The hotel enjoys close proximity to a host of attractions, making this a prime choice for discerning business travellers, as well as those seeking a relaxing break. The hotel enjoys close proximity to a number of shopping, dining and entertainment venues. This magnificent hotel enjoys a beautiful design, incorporating traditional and contemporary elements. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, offering elegance and style. The rooms feature lively colours and shades, with modern, contemporary fabrics, along with the latest technology. A wide range of leisure, dining and business facilities are available at this hotel. Guests will appreciate the friendly service and high level of excellence that they are afforded.

175738.description: Tucked into a charming corner of the 14th arrondissement, voco® Paris Montparnasse offers contemporary style, a central location and eco-friendly design. We have secure indoor parking, and can book transportation to both Orly (ORY) and Paris-Charles de Gaulle (CDG) airports from Montparnasse Railway Station for you. It's a quick hop by metro from Gaîté station to The Louvre or Paris Expo, or you can wander through 17th-century Luxembourg Gardens nearby. Montparnasse Tower has incredible city views, and you’ll find indie boutiques on rue de Rennes, as well as numerous bistros and theatres close to the hotel. Our concierge team knows Paris better than anyone, so please ask for their recommendations. Furnished with typical voco™ care, quality bed linen and coffee machines, several of our guest rooms overlook Montparnasse Cemetery. Some Executive rooms have private terraces, and our spacious Junior Suite includes a comfy living room area. We serve a daily buffet breakfast plus all-day snacks. In the evening, we'd love you to sample Parisian beers and wines in our bar, cosy lobby or courtyard garden. As well as complimentary Wi-Fi, we have two well-equipped meeting rooms with a break-out terrace. Great service and a very warm welcome. That's voco® Paris Montparnasse.

175742.description: The Al Najada is a 5-star accommodation located in the famous Souq Waqif of Doha and is part of a collection of boutique hotels in the area. Guest rooms are equipped with flat-screen TV, minibar and some rooms feature a separate living room area and a private balcony. Dining options include 3 restaurants serving a la carte selection of fusion cuisine. In addition, the hotel features a rooftop terrace offering light snacks and shisha with a view of the Old Souq and Corniche. Leisure amenities include a mini gym, massage treatment rooms and a library with a collection of art and books. Services of a personal shopper and escorted tours of Souq Waqif are also available. Attractions in the area include the Doha Fort, Museum of Islamic Art, Doha Corniche, Villagio Mall and Qatar National Museum. Doha International Airport is approximately 5 km from the hotel.

175743.description: This magnificent accommodation is located in the famous Souq Waqif of Doha and is part of a collection of boutique hotels in the area. Attractions in the area include the Doha Fort, Museum of Islamic Art, Doha Corniche, Villagio Mall and Qatar National Museum. Doha International Airport is approximately 5 km from the hotel. Guest rooms are equipped with LCD TV with satellite channels, seating area, minibar, digital safe, work desk and WiFi access. The enchanting restaurant onsite serves an a la carte menu featuring Persian and contemporary international cuisine. In addition, the lounge offers English afternoon tea and light meals highlighting Arabic and continental tiered food stands. Travellers may take advantage of the impressive leisure amenities including a temperature-controlled outdoor pool, fully-equipped fitness centre and massage treatment rooms.

175756.description: Enjoy a central Milan stay at the Genius Hotel Downtown, a short walk from Castello Sforzesco and Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II. This hotel offers 38 air-conditioned rooms with minibars, satellite TV, and private bathrooms. Amenities include Wi-Fi (surcharge), 24-hour room service, concierge, babysitting, dry cleaning, and an airport shuttle (surcharge). A buffet breakfast is available (fee applies).

175907.description: Onefam Les Corts is located in Barcelona’s Les Corts district, just 3 minutes’ walk from FC Barcelona’s Camp Nou Stadium. Our social hostels are designed for young backpackers and solo travellers. To ensure the best experience for our guests, we have implemented an age restriction policy. As most of our guests fall within the 18-45 age range, we regret to inform you that we are unable to process your reservation if you are above 45 years of age. The air-conditioned dormitory rooms at the Onefam Les Corts feature bunk beds. Each bunk bed comes with private lockers, light, curtains, usb sockets and the shared bathrooms come with a hairdryer. There is also a communal modern kitchen for guests’ use, as well as a vending machine for drinks. Staff at the 24-hour reception can provide information about what to see and do in Barcelona. You can walk to Badal Metro Station in 5 minutes, which takes you to the city centre in under 15 minutes.

175929.description: Less than 50m from Gare du Midi metro station (Thalys/Eurostar/ICE connection/metro) and a 20-minute walk from the city center (Manneken Pis/Kanalmuseum), our hotel boasts an ideal location, rated 8. 9/10 by our guests. Whether waiting for your train or after a long day of sightseeing, you can enjoy a well-deserved local beer at the bar or a regional meal at the restaurant. The next morning, savor a luxurious continental breakfast buffet, rated 7. 7/10.

175975.description: This delightful hotel enjoys a prime setting in the Bab Doukkla district of the old town of Marrakech. The hotel is situated a mere 10 minutes' walking distance from the vibrant traditional markets in Jemaa El Fna Square, as well as the historical and cultural attractions the city has to offer, including the Koutoubia Mosque. The hotel is just 2 km from the Mayorelle Gardens, and 7 km from Marrakech-Menara Airport. This former residence welcomes guests with relaxing surroundings, and bathes visitors in culture and history. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated, and offer a relaxing setting in which to completely unwind in comfort at the end of the day. Guests will appreciate the delicious breakfast that can be enjoyed every mornings, as well as the delectable dining options that can be savoured for lunch and dinner.

176019.description: The Old Ship Inn Hackney, located next to the Hackney Empire, offers comfortable rooms above a classic British pub. Guests can enjoy food and drinks in our inviting bar and restaurant. Our ten well-appointed en-suite rooms feature hairdryers, complimentary toiletries, and tea and coffee making facilities. Each room blends the building's history with modern boutique style, offering comfortable singles and doubles, flat-screen TVs, and free Wi-Fi. Hackney Central station is a short two-minute walk, providing easy access to Stratford, Dalston, and central London via Highbury & Islington or the 55 bus to Oxford Circus. London Fields station, a five-minute walk, connects directly to Liverpool Street. Nearby attractions include the Hackney Empire, Arcola Theatre, Hackney Picture House, and Sutton House.

176107.description: Located in the Göynük area of Kemer, this all-inclusive hotel is situated between the Taurus Mountains and the Mediterranean Sea. The property features a private beach area, an outdoor swimming pool with water slides, and a children’s playground. Guests can enjoy the on-site spa facilities including a sauna and Turkish bath, or visit the fitness center. Dining options include an open buffet restaurant and a bar serving refreshing drinks. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning and a balcony. Free Wi-Fi access is available, and activities such as table tennis and darts are also offered.

176108.description: The fully renovated, 5-star Barceló Istanbul hotel boasts a stylish design and a prime location in Taksim Square, putting you in the heart of Istanbul's vibrant cultural scene. Enjoy breathtaking city views from the rooftop B Heaven sky terrace bistro bar and sun terrace with jacuzzies. Spacious rooms (30-59 m²) offer modern comforts, with some Deluxe rooms and Junior Suites featuring private Hammams. The hotel also offers a range of amenities, including a Wellness Hammam and Fitness center on the 11th floor, a daylight ballroom, meeting rooms, the Atrium Chadir Buffet Restaurant, B Lounge Lobby Bar, a Mediterranean restaurant, a sports bar, indoor parking, and valet service. Explore nearby attractions such as the Istanbul Lutfi Kirdar Congress Center (1. 5 km), Istiklal Street (0. 6 km), and Nisantasi shopping area (2 km). Atatürk International Airport is 23 km away, and Sabiha Gökçen International Airport is 50 km from the hotel.

176109.description: The 4-star Taksim Square Hotel boasts an exquisite location in the heart of Istanbul, directly on Taksim Square. Facing the Taksim Independence Monument, a commemorative sculpture honoring the foundation of the Turkish Republic in 1923, the hotel marks the entrance to Istiklal Street (Beyoglu), Istanbul's most popular pedestrian street, a vibrant hub of dining, entertainment, and shopping. Its central location provides easy access to the city's public transport network, with the metro station and central bus lines just across the street. The Taksim Square Hotel welcomes guests seeking a lively, 24/7 atmosphere in a historically and culturally significant area of Istanbul.

176146.description: This apartment hotel is located on the outskirts of Alanya, towards the rear of the resort centre which is 1.5 km away, while Cleopatra's Beach is 1.7 km away. Public transport runs close to the complex. Consisting of 2 buildings, this apartment hotel has an outdoor pool with a children's section, a restaurant, bar, 24hr reception and free internet access. The simply furnished apartments consist of a kitchenette suitable for making light meals and two bedrooms with dining area on the balcony. Occasional evening entertainment is provided and there is an air-conditioned sports bar available at night.

176166.description: The Vendome Palace Hotel (formerly Delmon Palace), conveniently located on Rigga Road in the Deira district, is a short five-minute drive from Deira City Centre and close to the Al Rigga Metro Station. Guests enjoy easy access to attractions such as the Deira Clocktower. All rooms feature a TV, Wi-Fi, an ensuite bathroom, a minibar, safe, balcony, and complimentary toiletries. Hotel amenities include luggage storage, 24-hour front desk and room service, public parking, a spa and wellness centre with massage services, and a beauty/barber shop. Laundry service is also available. Guests can enjoy a daily breakfast buffet in the hotel restaurant and socialize at the bar. The Spice Souk and Dubai Mall are a ten-kilometer drive, and Dubai International Airport is just seven kilometers from the hotel.

176206.address: Rodovia dos Bandeirantes - Km 72 Sentido São Paulo
176206.description: Diversão sem limites espera por você no Cyan Resort, o destino ideal para dias inesquecíveis em família! Aqui, lazer, conforto e entretenimento se unem em uma experiência completa. Crianças até 12 anos são cortesia (máx. 2 por suíte), e a área de lazer de 5. 300m² inclui piscinas climatizadas, jacuzzis, praia artificial, bares, quadras esportivas e muito mais. Relaxe no Jardim Secreto, saunas com vista para o lago e piscina coberta. A criançada se diverte no Tixa Club e no Tixa Adventure Park com arvorismo, tirolesa e escalada. A programação diária é temática e animada pela equipe Cyan e pelo mascote Tixa. Gastronomia de qualidade com 2 restaurantes e 3 bares. Transfer gratuito aos fins de semana para Wet’n Wild, Hopi Hari e Outlet. Estacionamento com manobrista (R$ 38/dia). Pets não são permitidos. Eventos com 18 espaços versáteis. We emphasize that the contracted daily rate is for 24 hours, with check-in from 2 p. m. and check-out until 12 p. m. The interval of up to 3 hours between guests' departure and arrival is provided for in MTur Ordinance No. 28 and is intended exclusively for cleaning, sanitizing, and tidying up the unit, ensuring the maintenance of our standard of excellence.

176266.description: Take a rare step into the true heart of the red-walled city. From a collection of intimate riad residences, where artistry sings from gentle arches, graceful balconies and lantern-light courtyards, Marrakesh unfolds. A stay with Angsana Heritage Collection in Marrakesh is an experience of the true magic of Marrakesh. A city of minarets and magnificent Almoravid monuments. Of hidden gardens and spice- laden souks. Of secluded courtyards, where mint tea is sipped and tales are told. Each of the six riads in the collection has their own soul and character, true to the traditions of the medina. All are imbued with the spirit that gives Angsana heritage properties their purpose: preserving history while celebrating and uplifting the local community. Riad residences have long been Morocco’s private world. Their walls afford privacy and sanctuary, creating intimate spaces to retreat from the pace of the city and entertain friends. Around an internal courtyard open to the sky, days are set to the sounds of bubbling fountains and soft steps on carpeted marble floors, the scent of rose petals in the air. Throughout the day, Morocco comes to you. Daily rituals and weekly happenings bring chances to explore the cultural wealth of the city and wider region, all steps from the sprawling Jemaa el-Fnaa, the square which famously fuels the city with life from dawn to dusk. Much like residents of Marrakesh past calling on acquaintances, guests can visit the different riads in the collection, the sense that the city is their own as they meet other likeminded travellers. Lunch might be spent at the authentic Moroccan restaurant nestled within Riad Si Said, an afternoon enjoying an authentic spa and hammam experience with Banyan-Tree-trained therapists at Bab Firdaus. The keys to a room unlock more than just the city’s best-kept secrets. Discoveries continue far beyond the riad walls, excursions to local villages offering deeper connections to Moroccan communities and culture.

176267.description: The hotel is conveniently situated just 200 m away from Sesto Rondò metro station. The bus station is also around 200 m away, while the railway station is just a short walk from the establishment. The residence is located between two airports, with Bresso Airport just 10 minutes by car and Milan Airport just 20 minutes from the hotel. This up-to-date, air-conditioned city establishment comprises a total of 31 rooms. Guests can enjoy a drink at the bar, and start their day in the breakfast room. A friendly staff is on hand to advise guests, and assist them with any travel or tourist information required.

176272.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A shuttle from the hotel to the airport is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 26 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

176273.description: This stunning hotel enjoys a prime setting in Paris, just a 2 minutes' walking distance from Montparnasse Station. The hotel is located within easy access of many of the city's main attractions, including the Avenue Champs Elysees, the Eiffel Tower and the Louvre Museum. This charming hotel enjoys a stunning Art Deco exterior design, welcoming guests into a cocoon of style and elegance. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, exuding style and elegance with delicate, artistic elements and charm. The hotel affords guests a number of exceptional facilities, ensuring that each and every visitor enjoys a convenient stay. Guests are invited to enjoy a refreshing drink from the bar, or sit back and relax, for the perfect end to the day.

176346.description: Located in Bogotá (Ciudad Salitre Oriental), Fairfield by Marriott Bogota Embajada is within a 15-minute walk of U. S. Embassy Bogotá and Gran Estacion Shopping Mall. This hotel is 5. 7 mi (9. 2 km) from 93 Park and 1. 6 mi (2. 5 km) from Corferias Bogota. Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and tour/ticket assistance. Guests can get around on the shuttle (surcharge), which operates within 10 km. Make yourself at home in one of the 249 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring iPod docking stations and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and coffee/tea makers, as well as phones with free local calls. Stop by the hotel's restaurant for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. This hotel has 2 meeting rooms available for events.

176370.description: The hotel enjoys a beachside location in the Okurcalar district which is some 32 km west from the large resort of Alanya. Public transport is available 300m from the hotel and there is a shopping bazaar 450m away. Suitable for families and couples, the hotel is set in spacious grounds with cultivated gardens. It offers a range of recreational facilities in its beachside location. The carpeted rooms are contemporarily furnished with pale, wood coloured furniture and they are equipped with air-conditioning and other amenities. The hotel has an outdoor pool, separate children's pool and a couple of waterslides which guests can use for a fun day of sunbathing. The hotel offers some light sports activities and for younger guests there is a mini club with animation in German. The hotel's SPA centre has a sauna, Turkish bath and hot tub which are sure to provide a relaxing holiday.

176471.description: The Muse Amsterdam Boutique Hotel, located in Amsterdam South, is a short walk from the Van Gogh Museum and Rijksmuseum. This hotel offers individually furnished guestrooms with minibars, espresso makers, and pillowtop beds with premium bedding. Enjoy amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, bicycle rentals, and a garden. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel also provides a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage.

176561.address: 70 Derb Sidi Lahcen Ou Ali Bab Doukkala
176561.description:
The riad is situated in the famous district of Bab Doukkala, next to the Majorelle Gardens, about 12 minutes' walk from the famous Jemaa El Fna square and only 3 minutes from the bus station. Marrakech-Menara Airport is approximately 5 km from the hotel.

Cet hôtel de Marrakech offre des habitations charmantes, combinant savamment les couleurs ainsi que les éléments traditionnels et les équipements modernes. Toutes les chambres incluent une salle de bain avec douche et sèche-cheveux. Elles comprennent également un lit king-size, une cafetière/théière, un lave-linge, un nécessaire à repasser et la climatisation à réglage individuel. Un accès Internet Wifi se trouve dans les chambres.
 There is the opportunity for guests to taste some excellent Moroccan specialties on the patio or on the terrace. All ingredients are fresh.

176565.description: Work, meet, dine, and experience the culture of London's East End at Holiday Inn London- Whitechapel. Surrounded by a popular art and fashion scene, our East London hotel offers spacious and inviting guest rooms. Enjoy global and English cuisine at 5 Cavell Street Kitchen and Bar. Ease into work mode in our coworking space or connect and celebrate in our meeting and event spaces. Experience London like a local. Our London hotel is within steps of well-known sites, including the Tower of London. Shop and dine at Old Spitalfields Market, Canary Wharf, or the curry restaurants on Brick Lane. We are a 10-minute walk to the London Underground Tube, Elizabeth Line and DLR trains at Whitechapel, Aldgate East, and Shadwell, with links to ExCeL London.

176596.description: The Riad Rafaele & SPA is an authentic 18th century riad, a haven of peace in the heart of the Medina. Push the door of the Riad, discover its immense interior patio and let yourself be lulled by the song of fountains and birds. Close your eyes and breathe in the scent of orange trees. Cool off in its pretty heated swimming pool. Enjoy the talents of our cooks. Let yourself be pampered during a massage or a hammam. Discover its shop and collection of Moroccan crafts and bring back wonderful treasures from your trip. And above all, take yourself for an Arab prince or princess in our 9 majestic rooms and suites!

176746.description: The hotel is located in the Gayrettepe area of the city, less than 2 km from Sisli underground station and close to the up-market shopping district of Nisantasi. Taksim Square in the city centre is 15 minutes away by public transport. Istanbul Ataturk Airport is approximately 22 km from the hotel. Built in 2012, this stylish new suite hotel is decorated in a modern design style and offers accommodation suitable for business and leisure guests alike. The hotel offers 56 rooms, equipped with all necessary modern amenities. The luxurious suites additionally have a kitchen with cooking utensils and dining area. Guests can take advantage of the hotel's spa and wellness centre where they can enjoy a swim in the indoor pool, dip in the hot tub, or relax in the sauna and steam bath.

176766.description: The hotel is 3 kms away from Lisbon-Portela Airport, and close to the Pavilhão Atlântico multipurpose venue, FIL international fair grounds, Pavilhão do Conhecimento (interactive science museum), the riverside leisure areas, Vasco da Gama Bridge and the main points of access to Lisbon. This hotel consists of 176 rooms and 10 suites. It offers 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, currency exchange, TV lounge, restaurant, bar and many other facilities. Each room is provided with a work desk, TV, wireless Internet access, an espresso coffee machine and a mini-bar. Also available for Business travellers is a large event and business centre. Guests may also enjoy the heated indoor swimming pool, gym, or sauna and steam room. A massage service is also available.

name.content: Best Western Plus Luna del Mar

176856.description: Discover the Best Western Plus Luna del Mar, nestled in the beautiful port of Manzanillo, Mexico. Located near the warm waters of the Pacific Ocean on the tranquil Las Brisas beach, our hotel offers the relaxing getaway you deserve. While there isn't an elevator on-site, 24-hour luggage assistance is available. Enjoy your stay.

176889.description: The hotel has an excellent location just 250 m north of Taksim Square, the heart of modern Istanbul. Entertainment venues, wining and dining facilities and great shops are all on the hotel's doorstep. Public transport is available in Taksim Square with links to historic Sultanhamet. Istanbul Ataturk Airport is only 20 km away. The modern, air-conditioned city hotel is furnished and decorated with a contemporary design using muted tones and offers 28 comfortable and stylish rooms. The cosy rooms are tastefully decorated and furnished. All rooms are en suite and feature amenities such as iPod docking station and free wireless Internet access. The most comfortable temperatures are ensured by the hotel's centrally regulated air-conditioning and central heating.

176890.description: Ideally located in the Alanya area, Hotel Diamond Hill Resort promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. The property features a wide range of facilities to make your stay a pleasant experience. Take advantage of the property's free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour room service, 24-hour security, chapel, shrine. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like bathroom phone, carpeting, clothes rack, free welcome drink, linens. Access to the property's watersports equipment rentals, hot tub, private beach, fitness center, sauna will further enhance your already satisfying stay. Hotel Diamond Hill Resort is an excellent choice from which to explore Alanya or to simply relax and rejuvenate.

176894.address: Suleyman Demirel Blv. Sidehan Bazaar Arkasi
176894.description: This hotel is located just 3 kilometres from the centre of Side, close to the area's famous Roman and Hellenistic ruins, making this a prime option for travellers who are eager to explore this stunning area. The beach is just a 5 minute-walk distance from the hotel and visitors will find a number of shopping, dining and entertainment venues nearby. This wonderful property is ideal for business and leisure travellers visiting the area. The guest rooms are superbly designed, featuring refreshing tones for a peaceful ambience. They all come with modern amenities, for the utmost in convenience. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. This hotel features an outdoor pool, with a separate children's area.

176895.description: The establishment features a total of 45 guest rooms. The hotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Kleopatra Carina Hotel does not offer 24-hour reception. The accommodation's entertainment was designed to amuse all kinds of travellers.

176896.description: This hotel is beautifully located in the old city of Istanbul. The hotel is situated just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace. Guests will find themselves in the ideal setting from which to explore the many attractions that the historical Sultanahmet District has to offer. A tramline is just 250 metres away, offering links to other areas of the city to be explored. Local amenities are situated nearby. Istanbul International Airport is 40 km from the hotel, while Sabiha Gokcen International Airport is 48 km away. This charming hotel enjoys a minimalist interior design, with a strong use of colour. The guest rooms are beautifully decorated, combining a subtle blend of the past and future. The hotel is sure to impress with its extensive range of first-class facilities and services

176897.description:
Dear Guests, 
	The Hotel Galaxy is situated 14 km to Alanya and 135 km to Antalya Airport. The Hotel has 116 rooms. The front block has 75 rooms with a direct or side sea view. 
	All our rooms have a minibar, satellite TV, air conditioning, constant hot and cold water, direct telephone, safe and a hair dryer. The Hotel also offers a bar, market, laundry, 24 hours room service, security and hot water, generator, table tennis, billards, open pool, child pool, sauna, Turkish Bath, fitness center, massage facility, doctor, animation services and two lobbies for our valuable guests. The Hotel also has a private beach reached by a private road(30 meters). 
	We invite you to relax and enjoy yourself. 
ALL INCLUSIVE
Hotel check-in time is 14:00 Check-out time is 12:00
FOODS 
Breakfast	 	: 07:30-09:30
Late Breakfast	: 09:30-10:00	
Lunch			 :	12:30-14:00	
Coffee Break		:	17:00-17:30				
Dinner		 :	19:00-21:00	
				DRİNKS
Galaxy Pool Bar	: Local drinks ( beer, wine, rakı, votka, cin) are free between 10:00-22:00. (12:30 to 14:00 and from 18:30 to 20:30 hours bar is close for preparation and cleaning generally)Export drinks, fresh orange juice, fruit juice with bottle, cocktail, Turkish Coffee, wine bottle are with extra payment. All drinks are with price after 22:00. 
				ACTIVITIES WITH PRICE
