Late c-out 30€. 			

 CLEANİNG SERVİCE
Rooms are cleaned every day between 09:00 and 16:15 in our hotel. Room towels and linens are changed once in three days. You are kindly requested not to take the towels out of the rooms. Our hotel is not responsible for valuables in the rooms.

176992.description: This modern hotel finds itself in the heart of Medina in Marrakech. Within a short distance of the hotel, guests can enjoy a host of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. Guests can enjoy ease of access to Jemaa El Fna Square, as well as a host of local attractions. The hotel exudes elegance and charm, and guests will be impressed by its attractive architectural design. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, and come complete with modern amenities. The hotel offers a range of facilities, which are sure to impress even the most discerning traveller. Guests are invited to relax and unwind in the elegant surroundings of this charming, Moroccan hotel.

177046.address: Riad Zitoune Jdid, Derb Tbib N°46 Marrakech Medina
177046.description: Conveniently located in the Medina district, this traditional Moroccan guest house features luxuriously decorated rooms with free Wi-Fi. The air-conditioned units are individually decorated in traditional Moroccan style. Each includes a seating area and an en suite bathroom. Guests will be served welcome tea upon arrival, and a restaurant, which serves local and international cuisine, is located on-site. There is also a large flower-filled patio and a lounge area with a flat-screen TV. Marrakech Menara Airport is a 10-minutes' drive from the property. The hotel also organises excursions to Ourika, Essaouira, Ourzazate and the Ouzoud waterfalls.

177109.description: Located just steps from the Rialto Hotel, this annex building offers a separate entrance and charming, first-floor rooms. Each room is elegantly decorated in 17th-century Venetian style, creating a relaxing and romantic ambiance. Overlooking typical Venetian calli and courtyards, guests can experience the true essence of Venice. Rooms feature a bathtub or shower, air conditioning, a direct-dial telephone, satellite TV, a minibar, a hairdryer, and free Wi-Fi. Please note there is no lift/elevator.

177229.description: Set in Vienna, 0. 7 mi from Vienna Prater, Hotel Nestroy Wien offers accommodations with a fitness center, private parking, a shared lounge and a bar. This 4-star hotel offers a business center and a concierge service. The accommodations features a 24-hour front desk, airport transfers, room service and free WiFi throughout the property. The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms offering a desk, a kettle, a mini-bar, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower. At Hotel Nestroy Wien the rooms come with bed linen and towels. Guests at the accommodations can enjoy a buffet or a continental breakfast. Hotel Nestroy Wien offers a sauna. Popular points of interest near the hotel include St. Stephen's Cathedral, Kunst Haus Wien - Museum Hundertwasser and St. Peter's Catholic Church. The nearest airport is Vienna International Airport, 11 mi from Hotel Nestroy Wien.

177239.description: Located in the heart of Barcelona just by the emblematic Plaza de Catalunya and a minute walk from La Rambla the most famous pedestrian street of the city. Surrounded by Gaudi buildings, the Gothic Quarter and the best shops and restaurants of the Catalan capital the hotel is a convenient place to stay. The metro station is 150 meters away. This modern hotel has a terrace and offers bright and contemporary accommodation with Wi-Fi and iPod docking. The rooms are tastefully decorated and feature air conditioning, minibar and a safe. Additional amenities include smart bathroom and plasma TV with USB port for connecting a laptop. All rooms are overlooking the large courtyard of the block except 5 which are located on the ground floor overlooking the Fontanella Street.

177291.description: Located in the vibrant Palermo Soho neighborhood, just steps from Plaza Cortazar, this 33-room hotel offers a range of amenities for a comfortable stay. Guests can enjoy the convenience of a lobby, concierge service, safe, currency exchange, lift access, and a TV lounge. Each room features an en suite bathroom with a shower, bath, and hairdryer, along with elegant wooden floors, a spa tub, and bathrobes. Modern conveniences such as Wi-Fi, a safe, and a minibar are also included. All air-conditioned units open onto private balconies.

177294.description: The Ayenda El Campín 1093 Hotel in Bogotá offers rooms with private bathrooms, toiletries, televisions, and complimentary bottled water. Guests can enjoy an included American-style breakfast. The hotel is conveniently located a short 12-minute walk from El Campín Stadium and a 10-minute drive from the Clinica de Marly. El Dorado Airport and the Salitre Transportation Terminal are both within a 20-25 minute drive.

177295.description: Located in the heart of the Recoleta area. Francia Square is only 300 metres from the hotel and Patio Bullrich Shopping Mall is just a 5-minute walk away. Florida Street is a 15-minute walk away and Ministro Pistarini International Airport is a 45-minute drive away. The hotel is a restored French style historic building, decorated with refined antique artworks. The spacious and luminous rooms feature private bathrooms, some including sauna and spa bath. All rooms have views, some of the garden and some of the elegant Rodriguez Peña Street. Luxury toiletries are provided. The hotel features a restaurant that serves French and Argentinian dishes, as well as French pastries for breakfast. There is also a bar, a business centre, solarium, and a fitness centre with a massage room, sauna, and Finnish Shower.

177296.description: Enjoying a prime setting in Bogota, this hotel is the ideal choice for business and leisure travellers visiting the area. Situated in the business district of the city, the hotel is located close to the UniCentro Hacienda Santa Barbara Mall and the World Trade Centre. The hotel is also located within easy access of Park 93 and Del Chico Park. This hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and excellent facilities. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, featuring functional space and a relaxing environment in which to work and rest in comfort. The hotel affords guests access to a host of excellent dining, business and leisure facilities for added comfort and convenience.

177297.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an outdoor pool, and a sauna. This Victorian hotel also features concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and a hair salon. Enjoy Argentinean cuisine at Nuestro Secreto, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Buenos Aires? This hotel has 4478 square feet (416 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 3 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 165 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, while DVD players and digital programming provide entertainment. Bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and designer toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. 9 de Julio Avenue - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Patio Bullrich - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- La Recova de Posadas - 0. 2 km / 0. 2 mi- Alvear Art Gallery - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Santa Fe Avenue - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Plaza San Martin - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Plaza Francia - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Recoleta Cultural Center - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Recoleta Cemetery - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Florida Street - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Exhibition Center of the City of Buenos Aires - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- National Museum of Fine Arts - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Bueno Aires Design Mall - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Recoleta Mall - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi.

177351.description:
Are you looking for a comfortable place to experience a true Parisian life?

Our charming residence is located in the heart of Montmartre, just a few steps from the cobbled streets, lively cafes and the famous stairs leading to the Basilica of the Sacré-Coeur. 

Our 11 Urban Suites are designed to offer you maximum comfort and amenities for up to 6 people. 

Whether you are a solo traveler, a couple, a family or a group of friends or colleagues, our apartments are ideally located in the bohemian and picturesque district of Montmartre. 

If you have luggage, we advise you to take a taxi because the residence is located at the top of the Butte Montmartre only accessible on foot through long flight of stairs (coming from Abbesses or Anvers station). 

Housing not accessible to people with reduced mobility.

177410.description:
Only 5 minutes from the Hospital de Sant Pau, Unesco heritage and steps from the subway. In a neighborhood known for its tranquility and good communication. Offering 12 apartments of 80 m2 up to 4-5 people, 2-3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms fully equipped with great detail and also 2 duplex.
Service check-in express, wi-free, electronic surveillance, safe, and if needed, parking that you will find in the same building. From castro Exclusive Residences we want your stay in Barcelona to be unique because our commitment is to transform your visit into a ... See you soon!

177413.description: 'Welcome to your home” is our slogan, but we will go beyond that. Our fantastic team will be delighted to make you feel like a local with insider's tips and doing their best to fulfill your special requests. In Suite Home Sagrada Familia we want you to live a real Barcelona experience; the best way? With our Sagrada Familia Views Apartments (Listed as: City views*) you will wake up with amazing views of the work-in-progress cathedral. Our 100 square meter apartments can accommodate up to 6-8 people. It doesn't matter if you are a group of friends who wants to meet the city or a family that would love to explore the local culture; Suite Home Sagrada Familia is the place for you. By the way… Here's a little secret: We also have a rooftop terrace / solarium with the best views in town (And we are not saying that just because it's ours).

177415.description: Boasting an idyllic setting at the heart of the Montmartre district of Paris, this delightful hotel offers guests the perfect place from which to explore the splendour of this romantic city. The hotel is situated within easy access of the Moulin de la Galette, Place du Tertre, Rue des Abbesses and the Sacre Coeur Basilica. This splendid hotel greets guests with elegance and grandeur, welcoming them into the glorious surroundings of the lobby. The guest rooms are superbly appointed, featuring bold colours and oozing luxury. The rooms come complete with modern amenities for guests' comfort and convenience. Guests will be impressed by the exemplary choice of facilities that the hotel has to offer. This hotel is sure to leave even the most discerning traveller breathless.

177417.description: This modern hotel is comfortably nestled in a quiet area, just 5 km from the Vienna Airport and a 20-minute drive from the city centre. Private car park is available for those who arrive with their personal vehicles and if they want to spare themselves from the traffic of the city, they can board the nearby fast S7 train that will lead them directly into the downtown. At the end of the busy day they may want to relax with a chilled drink in the non-stop bar or enjoy a hearty meal at the onsite restaurant. There is also a café where the early risers can grab a strong beverage and some delicious pastry before they head-out for the day.

177418.description: Arion Cityhotel Vienna is located directly at the Wienerberg recreation area, in the green southern outskirts of Vienna. It offers free WiFi and spacious, bright accommodation units. A restaurant, where guests can dine from 17:00 on, is a further feature of the hotel. All stylish rooms provide individually adjustable air conditioning and satellite TV. The apartments additionally come with a kitchenette. The Arion Cityhotel is conveniently located near the A2 motorway. Several bus stops (Line 360), going into the city centre within a 20-minute ride, are 100 metres away. Sights like the Vienna Opera House can therefore be easily reached. A parking garage is available for a surcharge and can be booked at the reception. All 142 rooms boast deep soaking tubs and offer free WiFi and sofa beds. LCD TVs come with cable channels, and other amenities that guests will find include hair dryers and laptop-compatible safes.

177426.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this accomodation. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. The reception desk is not open throughout the day.

177449.description: The Travelodge Gatwick Airport Central offers convenient access to Gatwick Airport, just a short drive away. This hotel features a restaurant and bar/lounge, and guests can enjoy a complimentary breakfast. The 254 air-conditioned guest rooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi and private bathrooms with bathtubs and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include the Archway Theatre and Gatwick Aviation Museum. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

name.content: Hard Rock Hotel Cancun All Inclusive

177454.description: Located in Cancun's Hotel Zone, this beachfront resort overlooks the Caribbean Sea. With multiple pools, swim-up bars, lounges, and restaurants, guests can enjoy diverse culinary experiences. The resort's chefs offer a range of cuisines, from International and Mexican to Asian, Italian, and Steakhouse options. Spacious rooms and suites boast amenities such as double hydro spa tubs and private balconies with stunning ocean views. Guests can also explore local attractions, including the pre-Columbian city of Tulum, jungle tours, and snorkeling excursions, or simply relax and enjoy the sunset.

177488.description: Dream Downtown, a lifestyle hotel in New York City, prioritizes service and exciting nightlife. With extraordinary design and unique character, the hotel offers 314 loft-style guest rooms and suites, luxurious amenities, distinctive dining, meeting, and event spaces, and a knowledgeable staff. Located between the Meatpacking District and Chelsea, Dream Downtown is steps away from iconic destinations like the High Line, Chelsea Market, and the Whitney Museum of American Art. The expansive guest rooms, including 11 suites, are individually designed for a personalized experience.

177511.description: Welcome to HUES Boutique Hotel, Dubai's first 4-star boutique hotel, a contemporary architectural gem offering luxurious personal service. Its unique 103-room design showcases a vibrant array of colors, creating a distinct ambiance on each floor. From every level, guests can admire the lobby artwork bathed in natural light from the skylight. This stylish hotel exudes warmth, making it ideal for those seeking high-quality hospitality and distinctive architecture at an affordable price. Parking is subject to availability for AED 20. 00 per car per day.

177513.description: Built in 1713 and located in historic Stellenbosch, this hotel offers cozy rooms with classic décor. It also features a spa, a pool and free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. The rooms at the 5-star Coopmanhuijs Boutique Hotel & Spa overlook the pool and courtyard. They include a balcony, cable TV and air conditioning. Rooms also have a private bathroom with underfloor heating. Helena's Restaurant at Coopmanhuijs serves Provençal cuisine and Cape wines. Guests can choose to dine indoors, in the intimate courtyard next to the pool or al fresco on the sidewalk terrace. Coopmanhuijs Spa offers a range of treatments, including an anti-oxidant rejuvenating facial and an Africology repair facial. Local activities including hiking, horseback riding and golf. The Coopmanhuijs Boutique is surrounded by Stellenbosch shops, galleries and museums. It is 12 mi from Strand Beach.

177551.description: The hotel is located close to the financial district near Atasehir on the Asian side of the city. The famous shopping street, Bagdat Avenue is 7. 5 km away at Bostanci. Ataturk International Airport is approximately 39 km away and Sabiha Gokcen International Airport is just 27 km away. This air-conditioned establishment was built in 2012 and is a 50-room city hotel offering comfortable accommodation and a 24-hour reception and check-out service in the lobby. Each room has an en suite bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a good night's rest in their comfortable bed. All accommodation units feature air conditioning for a more comfortable atmosphere. The hotel serves a continental breakfast. Dinner is served a la carte.

177609.description: Enjoy the garden and terrace views at Hotel Montini, with amenities including complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The hotel offers 51 individually furnished guestrooms with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and private bathrooms with showers and complimentary toiletries. Guests can grab a bite at the snack bar/deli or enjoy room service during limited hours. Additional amenities include a bar/lounge, complimentary wired internet access, and free self-parking. Nearby attractions include Idroscalo di Milano (2. 9 km) and Circolo Arci Magnolia (4. 5 km). The closest airport is Linate (LIN), 9. 6 km away.

177651.description: The hotel is located in the neighbourhood of San Telmo. The heart of the City of Buenos Aires is easily accessible from the premises. All major tourist attractions and points of interest are located in the surrounding area. The International Airport Pistarini is just a 45 minute ride. The hotel lobby is very spacious and luminous, located in ground floor where guests may find different sitting areas and work stations. Additional amenities include a breakfast area, a business centre and concierge service. Every room is well equipped as standard featuring a safety box, a minibar and 32 inch LCD with cable system. Additional in-room amenities include air-conditioning and Internet access.

177727.address: 10 Bis Derb Cherif Diour Saboune, 10 Bis
177727.description: Nestled in the heart of Marrakech's Medina, the Riad Cocoon offers a tranquil escape. This spa riad boasts a seasonal outdoor pool, steam room, and on-site spa providing massages, body treatments, and facials. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and on-site shopping. A full breakfast is served daily, and dining options include the COCOON RIAD À MARRAKECH restaurant and a snack bar. The five air-conditioned rooms feature iPod docking stations, pillowtop beds with Egyptian cotton sheets, and private bathrooms with designer toiletries. Nearby attractions include the Almoravid Koubba and Ben Youssef Madrasa, both within a 10-minute walk. Menara Airport (RAK) is 8 km away.

177728.description: The Sorell Hotel Krone, a charming boutique hotel, is nestled in the heart of Winterthur's historic Old Town pedestrian zone, just steps from the main train station, museums, and theaters. A short 20-minute drive from both Zurich City Center and the airport, it offers guests convenient access to the city's attractions while enjoying the tranquility of Winterthur. The hotel seamlessly blends historic charm with modern interior design, creating a unique atmosphere. Guests can enjoy the cozy Restaurant Krone and Lobby Bar, and rooms feature complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and coffee/tea making facilities. Numerous shops are conveniently located nearby.

177729.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 43 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

177787.description: Side Serenity is located 15km east of Manavgat, 55km from Antalya Airport, and 12km from the ancient city of Side. This 5-star, all-inclusive resort spans 18, 000 square meters and comprises two 4-story buildings with 278 rooms. Situated 600 meters from Gündoğdu's sandy beach, the hotel also boasts a 250-meter private beach. The simply yet stylishly designed rooms offer all the comforts of home. The main building houses 239 standard rooms, 20 sea-view rooms, 3 disabled-accessible rooms, and 72 family rooms. For younger guests, the hotel provides a mini club (ages 4-12), playground, children's entertainment, a water park, a dedicated children's buffet, and a mini disco, all supervised by expert staff. Guests can enjoy various activities at the hotel's pools and private beach.

name.content: Dobedan Beach Resort Comfort Ex Alva Donna

177788.description: This magnificent hotel, nestled in a beautiful natural setting in Side, is just 55 kilometers from Antalya International Airport. A short drive away, guests will discover the vibrant Side city center. Steps from a pristine sandy beach and the crystal-clear waters of the Mediterranean Sea, this splendid property offers complete relaxation. Rooms boast wonderful designs and offer both land and sea views. The hotel's signature restaurants serve traditional Turkish specialties and Italian cuisine, while the on-site bars provide a wide selection of beverages in charming atmospheres. A dedicated kids' club, entertainment, and leisure activities cater to younger guests, while adults can enjoy relaxing spa treatments or a refreshing dip in the sparkling pool. Versatile meeting facilities are also available. The outdoor pool is heated during the winter season.

177807.description: Corinthia London is in the heart of London, within a 5-minute walk of Trafalgar Square and Horse Guard's Building. This luxury hotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from National Gallery and 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from Big Ben. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 indoor swimming pools, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. This Victorian hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 283 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your memory foam bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Enjoy Modern European cuisine at The Northall, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. English breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.

177811.description: This guest house boasts a prime setting in Stellenbosch. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from a host of attractions, and within easy access of the main entertainment venues, shopping opportunities and dining options that this charming area has to offer. This unique building welcomes guests into an invigorating, rejuvenating cocoon, where opportunities for relaxation abound. The guest house is elegantly appointed, featuring soothing natural tones, combined with vibrant splashes of colour. The establishment offers a range of excellent facilities, catering to the needs of each individual guest.

name.content: The Creekside Hotel Dubai an Accor Hotel

177907.description: The Creekside Hotel Dubai an Accor Hotel, located near Dubai's Deira business district, offers convenient access to world-class shopping, golf courses, and Dubai International Airport. This contemporary hotel boasts a dedicated arts and cultural program amidst lush green grounds. Combining the elegance of a country club with modern luxury, The Creekside Hotel Dubai an Accor Hotel reflects Dubai Creek's heritage. Guests staying in Club and Suite categories enjoy complimentary beach access once per stay. A 24-hour check-in/check-out option is available upon request (subject to availability). A free shuttle serves a private beach, Dubai Mall, and Wild Wadi Waterpark.

178100.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting in Athens. The hotel lies within a short distance of a myriad of attractions, including Athens Olympic Stadium, Kavoutsakis Art Institute, Goulandris National History Museum and Mall Athens. The hotel welcomes guests with a modern architectural design, and the promise of comfort and relaxation. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, exuding charm and poise. The rooms come complete with modern amenities, and provide a peaceful space in which to relax and unwind. The hotel affords guests a number of facilities, catering to the needs of every type of traveller. Guests will be thoroughly impressed by this hotel, as well as its endearing surroundings.

name.content: ibis Paris La Villette Cité des Sciences 19ème

178105.description: Opposite Parc de la Villette, the ibis Paris la Villette Cité des Sciences hotel offers 284 rooms including 18 with views of Canal de l'Ourcq. Enjoy our market-style breakfast until midday. For your meetings, take advantage of our seminar room with natural light and views of the canal. As well as our 24-hour snack service, our ibis Kitchen Pizza & Pasta restaurant is open for dinner from Sunday to Thursday. Just 547 yards (500 meters) from the metro, you can get around Paris with ease!

178131.description: With a small number of only 7, this property is very convenient for a quiet stay. Built in 1860, the hotel was fully refurbished and renovated in 2012. Some services may be payable.

name.content: Elite Byblos Hotel EX( Coral Dubai Al Barsha)

178208.address: Al Barsha Road, Street 23 (near Sheikh Zayed Road), 1
178208.description: This luxurious Dubai hotel guarantees a restful holiday experience. Located within walking distance of major metro stations, it offers modern, comfortable rooms equipped with internet access, television, telephone, and a private bathroom. Hotel amenities include a currency exchange, meeting rooms, car rental, and an outdoor pool. Traveling families will appreciate the babysitting services and children's playrooms. A 24-hour reception desk is also available for your convenience.

name.content: ITC Mora anteriormente ITC Mora by Soho Boutique

178287.description:
ITC Mora, formerly known as ITC Mora by Soho Boutique, is set on Madrid's Paseo del Prado, in the heart of the Museum Triangle and directly opposite the Royal Botanical Gardens and the CaixaForum art gallery. The Reina Sofía Museum and Atocha train station are 400 metres away, while the Prado Museum and Retiro Park are both within a 10-minute walk. Atocha Metro Station is just 250 metres from the hotel, and regular bus services stop nearby, connecting to the rest of the city. 

The rooms are simple and functional, with air conditioning, satellite TV, a safe and a modern bathroom with basic toiletries. A hairdryer is available from reception, and free WiFi is provided throughout the hotel. 

The hotel has a café-bar and a 24-hour reception desk. The surrounding streets are full of traditional tapas bars and restaurants, one of the main draws of this neighbourhood. With its location on Paseo del Prado, steps from Madrid's leading museums, ITC Mora is a practical and well-placed base for exploring the Spanish capital.

178288.description: Centrally located in Madrid, Hotel Europa is steps from Puerta del Sol and a short walk from Gran Via. This hotel offers 100 air-conditioned rooms with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy on-site dining at Café Europa, featuring Spanish cuisine and a bar/lounge, or order room service. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, concierge services, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Cooked-to-order breakfast is available for a fee. Self-parking is available on-site (subject to charges). The hotel is 1. 2 miles from the Prado Museum and 1. 6 miles from the Royal Palace of Madrid.

178292.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Stop by the hotel's restaurant for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Paris? This hotel has 323 square feet (30 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 50 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

178338.description: Hotel Charlotte Plaza 26 is located on Bogotá's El Dorado Avenue, close to the US Embassy and 10 km from El Dorado International Airport. Each room at Charlotte Plaza 26 features an LCD cable TV, desk, wardrobe, safe and telephone, plus a private bathroom with free toiletries. The property also houses a business center with capacity for 60 people, a 24-hour reception and a tour desk. El Mirador restaurant has a panoramic terrace in which we can enjoy 100% Colombian dishes. The establishment also offers a la carte lunch and buffet breakfast. Charlotte Plaza 26 is just 3 blocks from the famous Corferias Fairgrounds, and a 10-minute drive from the historic center of Bogotá and five minutes from the Gran Estacion Shopping Center.

178369.description:
'The resort is about 10 kms west of Side and Manavgat on the sandy beaches of the Turkish Riviera. The Antalya International Airport is another 65 kms away. The resort consists of four buildings with a total of 382 guest rooms. It features a large pool room, tennis courts and a bowling alley. Children can have fun on the water slides. A well-equipped gym can be used by guests for free. The spa area includes an indoor pool, a sauna and a hammam. On the public beach in front of the hotel, guests will find sun beds and umbrellas free of charge. Culinary variety is offered in a buffet and five á carte restaurants. The resort offers entertainment programs and comedian shows in the evenings. GENERAL REMARKS:
*** Pets Are Not Allowed. 
*** All Hotel rooms are non-smoking. 
*** Guests under the age of 18 without one of the parents will not be accepted. 
*** The hotel reserves the right to modify the specified dates, times, and venues due to weather
conditions or operational requirements. Additionally, the hotel reserves the right to make changes to
the concept without prior notice. 
*** Depending on availability, guests staying a minimum of 7 nights or more are entitled to one
complimentary à la carte restaurant visit with prior reservation. 
*** In the UAI concept, all drinks are served by the glass. 
*** Alcoholic beverages will not be served to guests under the age of 18.

178371.description: Located just 19 km west of the delightful resort of Alanya, in the blissful surroundings of Turkler and Avsallar, this hotel enjoys an enviable location. Guests will enjoy close proximity to a number of amenities in the area, including a tranquil beach, which lies just 600 metres from the hotel. Gazipasa airport and Antalya airport are 61 km and 108 km away from the hotel, respectively. This modern hotel offers a range of exemplary facilities, sure to impress each guest. This resort caters to the needs of guests looking for relaxation, or adventure, offering a host of amenities suited to even the most discerning visitor. The hotel rooms are spacious, offering a tranquil haven in which to unwind. Guests will enjoy delectable dishes in the on-site restaurants. Guests travelling for business purposes can keep up with work, availing of the meeting room and conference facilities.

178396.description: The enchanting Riad Marrakiss is ideally set in the heart of the picturesque Medina of Marrakesh, only a few minutes away from the famous Jemaa el-Fna Square. Guests can stroll through the quaint streets and discover all the secrets this city hides, its shops, restaurants and cafés. The Agdal Gardens can be reached within a short drive. Marrakesh-Menara International Airport is about 15 minutes away by car. The small guest house is wonderfully designed in an authentic Moroccan style with warm colours, exuding traditional hospitality. The cosy rooms are beautifully appointed with an original fireplace, a tadelakt bathroom and views of the interior courtyard. For guests' convenience, they are equipped with air-conditioning and WIFI. The hotel offers a lovely rooftop terrace, boasting magnificent views over the old town and the Atlas Mountains. The restaurant serves delicious food, prepared with fresh market products. A place full of charm, perfect to explore Marrakech.

name.content: Riad Dar Justo Hotel Boutique & Spa

178397.description: Boasting a prime setting in the vibrant surroundings of Marrakech, this delightful hotel offers guests the perfect place from which to explore the historical and cultural delights of the area. Guests will find themselves just a short walking distance away from a host of public transport links, as well as the centre of the old Medina de Marrakech and the famous Jemaa El Fna Square. Within a short distance of the hotel, guests can also find a host of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. This hotel enjoys a sophisticated architectural design, blending effortlessly with its elegant, stylish surroundings. Welcoming guests into a world of style and opulence, the hotel is sure to impress even the most discerning traveller. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, reflecting the beauty of nature in their decor.

178427.description: Located opposite Antalya's Konyalalti Beach, this 45-room hotel has a great view over the Mediterranean Sea from its terrace restaurant. The hotel features modern rooms with sea views and free Wi-Fi access. A shopping centre is less than two km from the hotel and the Miniature Culture Park is close by. A beach park with beach clubs lies at the beginning of Konyaalti, less than 20 minutes' walk away, while the city centre is just under five km from the hotel.

178431.description: The Comfort Inn Victoria offers luxurious accommodations in a beautifully preserved Victorian building, conveniently located near iconic London attractions. Guests are just minutes from Big Ben, the London Eye, Westminster Abbey, Buckingham Palace, Piccadilly Circus, and Oxford Street's renowned shopping district. Victoria Station, with mainline rail, underground (Tube), and bus connections, is within easy walking distance. Enjoy amenities such as complimentary continental breakfast, Wi-Fi, multilingual staff, and free local calls. Business travelers will appreciate in-room computer hookups and access to copy and fax services. All rooms feature coffee makers, desks, hair dryers, and cable television. Whether traveling for business or leisure, the Comfort Inn Victoria provides a comfortable and convenient base for exploring London. Children 14 and under sharing a room with two parents or grandparents receive complimentary extra bedding.

178434.description: With a stay at Barcelo Palmeraie in Marrakech (Annakhil), you'll be within a 15-minute drive of Jemaa el-Fnaa and Marrakech Plaza. This luxury hotel is 5. 7 mi (9. 2 km) from Majorelle Gardens and 6. 7 mi (10. 8 km) from Palais des Congrès. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, outdoor tennis courts. Additional amenities at this Mediterranean hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 251 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. All-inclusive rates are available at this hotel. Meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments are included in all-inclusive rates. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Grab a bite at L Oasis, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wind down with a drink at one of the 3 bars/lounges or 2 poolside bars.

178447.description: This upscale hotel boasts an ideal setting in Lisbon. The hotel is set overlooking the delightful old town, as well as the magnificent Tagus River. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to the delightful attractions that this captivating city has to offer. This well-connected location is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Rossio Train Station, and a 20 minutes' driving distance from Lisbon Portela Airport. Guests of this hotel will be impressed by the spectacular architectural design it enjoys. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, featuring a simplistic style of refined elegance. The hotel invites guests to take advantage of the exemplary facilities it has to offer. Guests can dine in style in the charming surroundings of the restaurant, and enjoy the delectable delights the menu has to offer.

178509.description: Enjoy recreational amenities at this Lima hotel, including a 24-hour fitness center and a seasonal outdoor pool. Dine at La Vista Restaurant, the hotel's on-site restaurant, or grab a coffee at the cafe. Twenty-four-hour room service is also available. Additional amenities include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a ballroom. For business travelers, the hotel offers a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and extensive conference and meeting space. The 300 air-conditioned guest rooms feature iPod docking stations, minibars, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, and Smart TVs with satellite programming. Wired and wireless internet access is available (surcharge). Private bathrooms include separate bathtubs and showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near the Malecón de Miraflores, Larcomar Shopping Center, and numerous other attractions.

178548.description: The hostel offers you bedrooms for 2 to 10 people with private bathrooms and a wide set of common areas and services (coworking and kitchen). The hostel is located right besides the Gran Via Avenue, 2 minutes walking distance from Sol square, very close to Plaza Mayor, Chueca and Malasaña, some of the most trendy neighborhoods in the city, and inside the Preciados district, the city centre's shopping area. All 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 bedrooms feature private bathrooms, big windows with views to the city centre, air conditioning and heating, top quality wooden beds, mattresses and bed linen and individual lockers. We have also female dormitory that can be booked. Enjoy our common areas with free WiFi and try our typical sangria and beer in the bar, meet new people at our lounge area. Also you can wash your clothes in our laundry room where you can enjoy the best views of the city in the rooftop

178571.description: This hotel is located in the city centre of Vienna and was established in 2011. Some of the most important tourist attractions in the city, including the Vienna City Hall, the Museum Quarter, the Hofburg Palace and the famous shopping street are just a few steps from the hotel. Other sites and points of interest, including the congress centre of the city, can easily be reached by metro. Vienna Airport is at 25 km away. Guests will appreciate the choice of tastefully-decorated guest rooms, all including an elegant bathroom with high quality toiletries. As for the onsite facilities, the restaurant serves premium cuisine together with an extensive list of premium wines, conference rooms and a fitness centre with sauna and steam room, ideal to enjoy a moment of relaxation.

178609.description: This city hotel is situated in the north of Bogota in an area of rapid expansion, known as a commercial, technological, educational and business centre. With many local points of interest in its vicinity, the hotel is suited for business and leisure travellers alike. It has 82 accommodation units equipped with telephone, flat screen TV, satellite connection, and mini-bar, electronic safe and broadband Internet access. Each room has an en-suite bathroom. Two of the rooms are adjusted to accommodate guests with reduced mobility. Guests may also take advantage of the lounge area on the top floor of the hotel.

178612.description:
The Bristol International Airport Hotel in Guarulhos is just 30 minutes from São Paulo International Airport – GRU (the largest and busiest in Latin America), offering easy access to the city and region. 
Modern and elegant, the hotel combines comfort and convenience for travelers in transit, on business, or seeking rest near the capital of São Paulo. 

The facilities include a swimming pool, fitness center, sauna, restaurant, and 24-hour room service, ensuring complete infrastructure for leisure, events, and comfort throughout your stay. 

For your convenience, we offer free transfers between the AIRPORT and the hotel at various times, subject to availability. 

Transfers between the HOTEL and the airport will cost R$ 15. 00 per person (over 8 years old) subject to scheduling and availability.

178708.description: This luxurious hotel is located in the heart of Medina, in the neighbourhood of Diour Essaboune, just 5 minutes away from the delights of Place Jemaa Fna, as well as a host of other cultural attractions. Guests will find themselves within close proximity of a host of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. The hotel is stunningly appointed, welcoming guests into a world of rich elegance and style. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, featuring refreshing tones and a relaxing ambience. The hotel offers a seemingly boundless array of excellent facilities, catering to the needs of each individual guest.

name.content: Hotel Dan Inn Planalto by Nacional Inn

178811.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting at the heart of the captivating city of Sao Paulo. The hotel is located close to a host of attractions and points of interest in the city, including the Pinacoteca do Estado and Basilica de Sao Bento. The hotel is also situated in close proximity to the Sao Bento Monastery, the Municipal Theatre and the Banespa Building. Exuding grandeur and sophistication, the hotel enjoys an attractive architectural design. The interiors are exquisitely appointed, featuring elements of refined elegance. Guests will be pleased to sit back and unwind in the beautifully-appointed guest rooms, and will experience comfort and convenience with the excellent amenities that they afford. The hotel also provides a host of exemplary facilities, catering to the needs of every type of traveller.

name.content: Dan Inn Sao Paulo Higienopolis by Nacional Inn

178812.description: Enjoying a great location at the heart of downtown Sao Paolo, this charming hotel is situated within easy access of the main business areas, as well as cultural and historical attractions the city has to offer. The hotel is located close to Paulista Avenue, Patio Higienopolis Mall and Mackenzie University. Guests will also find themselves in a prime setting close to a number of shopping, entertainment and dining options. This hotel greets guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, and come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests can enjoy the hotel's host of excellent facilities for a truly relaxing stay.

178828.description: The B. O. G. Hotel, designed by Nini Andrade, boasts a unique aesthetic. Shades of bronze, green, and grey create a distinctive ambiance, unlike any other hotel in Colombia. As the first Design Hotel member in the country, B. O. G. offers guests a sensory journey reflecting Colombian culture in the privileged La Cabrera neighborhood of Bogotá. Guests can enjoy the hotel's pool and terrace (subject to availability due to private events), and relax at the Emerald Spa (open Monday-Saturday 10 am-7 pm, Sunday 11 am-5 pm). A continental breakfast is served daily. Please note that Superior Room bed types are subject to availability, and masks are required in all hotel areas. The hotel is entirely non-smoking, with a designated smoking area outside.

178830.description: Find the Hilton Bogota in the heart of the financial district, within walking distance of Zona Rosa, one of the city's most prestigious neighborhoods. Explore nearby shopping malls, theaters, and museums, or enjoy the gourmet dining and entertainment of Zonas G and T. El Dorado International Airport is just 25 minutes away. This modern hotel offers excellent facilities for both leisure and business travelers, including a restaurant, a sophisticated bar, a gym, and a heated outdoor swimming pool. Savor Colombian cuisine and host a variety of events at this centrally located Bogota hotel. Please note that prior to traveling, you should check the Colombian government website to understand any local requirements or restrictions that may be in place.

178832.description: Located in the northern part of Bogota in the Santa Barbara Occidental neighbourhood, this contemporary aparthotel is ideal for both business and leisure. The hotel is only a stone's throw from the iconic Unicentro shopping centre, where guests can find a variety of shops, dining options and entertainment. Guests may also wish to visit the flea market in the nearby Usaquen borough, or venture into the city centre for a dizzying array of museums, monuments, parks, theatres and sports parks. The apartments are comfortable and spacious with a minimalist-inspired design and touches of contemporary art. Each apartment comes equipped with a kitchen, living area, bedroom, flat-screen television, and free Wi-Fi. Disability-friendly apartments and two-bedroom apartments are also available. Guests can start the day with a buffet breakfast, convenient for those who would rather spend the day sightseeing or working during a productive business trip.

178848.description: This trendy hotel is located in the Karakoy/Beyoglu district of the city, just a few minutes' walk from Istanbul Modern Art Museum and 550 m from the Galata Bridge with access to the historical wonders in Sultanahmet. The area surrounding the hotel is full of atmosphere and also close to shops, bars and restaurants. Istanbul-Ataturk Airport is approximately 20 km from the hotel and Sabiha Gokcen Airport is around 45 km away. Built in 2012, this 18-room, air-conditioned city hotel exudes style and contemporary design with bare light bulbs in the lobby, stone-faced interior walls, wooden floors and splashes of colour. The rooms feature hardwood floors, designer furniture and ultra-comfortable double or king-size beds. Amenities include free wireless Internet access, an iPod docking station and flat-screen satellite TV with a number of channels for guests' entertainment.

178849.address: meşrutiyet mah halaskargazi cad ebekızı sokak, 5
178849.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace at this hotel, and take advantage of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. A television in the common area, a vending machine, and 24-hour room service are also available. Dine at the Terrace Restaurant for a delightful meal. For added convenience, the hotel provides complimentary wired internet access, express check-in and check-out, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge, available 24 hours). Each of the 45 guestrooms features a minibar, complimentary wireless internet access, satellite programming, and a private bathroom with a rainfall showerhead and hairdryer. A laptop-compatible safe and a desk are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Located conveniently near the Istanbul Cevahir Shopping and Entertainment Centre (0. 1 miles).

178870.address: Queen's Park Göynük Cumhuriyet Mah. Ahu Ünal Aysal, No.31
178870.description:
Located in Kemer, one of Antalya’s most beautiful holiday destinations and a hidden paradise on the Mediterranean Riviera, Queen’s Park Göynük invites you to lose yourself in the harmony of blue and green. Spread over a spacious area of 60, 000 m², Queen’s Park Göynük has been designed with every detail in mind to offer services for all family members. 

In our resort, we have a colored wristband system for adult and underage guests.

178871.description:
Located in the heart of Tecom one of Dubai's Leisure And Business Districts, First Central Hotel Suites is equipped with 524 modern suites that boast contemporary finishes and an enticing cozy ambiance, giving every guest the ultimate comfort and respite. The hotel offers a wide range of leisure and business amenities including a mini Business Center, Travel desk, a serene rooftop pool, well-equipped gym, and recreational facilities. 

From Dining to Room Service, experience a balance of Continental cuisine and gratify your cravings with the fresh palate in Beastro Restaurant and the sweet aroma of coffee at Beastro located within the lobby. 

The hotel is strategically located near Sheikh Zayed Road, just a few minutes from the Dubai Internet City Metro Station and a short drive to the city’s top business and leisure attractions including The Burj Khalifa, Dubai Media City, the Mall of Emirates, the beach JBR, Dubai Marina, Montgomerie and Emirates Golf Clubs among others. 

First Central Hotel Suites is located approximately 30 minutes away from Dubai International Airport.

178907.description: Travel Inn Live & Lodge is located close to Ibirapuera Park, Congonhas airport, Avenue Paulista (financial and business center), the main cultural centers, MAM, and Bienal Ibirapuera Auditorium. The unit has 130 apartments, three-room modular events. The Agamat restaurant, national and international cuisine, offers meals every day and is on the 1st floor of the flat.

178908.description: Superbly located in the heart of Buenos Aires, this hotel is just 50 meters from the famed Avenida Corrientes, the heart of the tango scene. The area's vibrant energy continues late into the night, offering a wide selection of theaters, bars, cafes, restaurants, and bookstores. Guests are a short stroll from Paseo La Plaza and the Congress and Convention Center. Uruguay subway station is a 7-minute walk away, and the iconic Obelisk, Colon Theater, and National Congress are reachable within a 20-minute walk. Housed in a classic building dating back to 1926, the hotel's architecture reflects European charm and distinction. The bright, warm rooms are equipped with modern amenities, including double-glazed windows to ensure sound insulation and create a serene environment.

178909.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in Chico, in Bogota D. C. The hotel is located in an exclusive area of the city, close to prominent galleries, shopping centres, restaurants and bars. This wonderful hotel is located just a short distance from the Parque El Virrey. Parque 93 and Zona T can be found close by. This hotel aims to provide a comfort and functional setting, in which to work and rest in comfort. The hotel's exceptionally-appointed guest rooms offer the ideal setting in which to unwind. The hotel features a number of exemplary facilities and services, ensuring a comfortable, enjoyable stay for every type of traveller.

179016.description: The Hotel Orangerie enjoys a convenient location near the heart of Vienna, reachable within 10 minutes via public transport. Located just a short walk from the „Längenfeldgasse“ and „Meidlinger Hauptstraße“ underground stations, the hotel offers easy access to the city's main attractions. The majestic Schönbrunn Palace is situated less than 2 km away. This city hotel features air-conditioned and well-equipped rooms, ensuring a comfortable stay for guests. Every bathroom is outfitted with a hairdryer, toiletries, and a walk-in shower. The hotel's welcoming lobby includes a 24-hour reception and a bar. Catering to both tourists and business travelers, the Hotel Orangerie offers high-speed Internet access and an LCD TV in every modern room, as well as a desk. For added security, all rooms are equipped with a safe. Parking facilities are conveniently located nearby.

179127.description: A short walk along the sandy beach brings you to Side Village, just 3. 5 km away, or you can reach it in under 10 minutes by public transport. Antalya Airport is a 60-minute drive from this stylish resort hotel. Relax in richly decorated guest rooms featuring warm colors, central air conditioning, satellite TV, a safe, and a balcony. Set on 15, 000 m² of grounds, this modern resort offers a wealth of amenities for couples and families, including an amphitheater, multiple pools, and a superb aqua park with 11 waterslides (for ages 7 and up). Indulge in a variety of culinary delights at our restaurants, featuring Asian, seafood, Mediterranean, and local cuisine. Pamper yourself at our fully equipped spa and health center, boasting 1, 000 m² of space with a Turkish hammam, sauna, steam room, and hairdresser. Enjoy limitless entertainment options, including the excitement of the region's largest aqua park and the thrilling Big King Cobra waterslide. The hotel is located 65 km from Antalya city center.

179128.description: This resort hotel is located on the long coastline of Belek in an area known as Bogazkent. The hotel's own beach is a few metres through the hotel's grounds and public where guests may enjoy a sand and pebble beach. The city centre is 10 km away and Antalya Airport is 45 km away from the hotel. Public transport runs just in front of the hotel. A paradise for families with children, the hotel occupies 42, 000 m2 of land and consists of a number of low-rise modern designed blocks. All rooms are elegantly decorated, equipped with a satellite TV, air conditioning, a balcony and a private bathroom with toiletries. Furnished in an elegant and contemporary style, guests can relax at the swimming pools and excite with 7 different waterslides. Children guests can take an opportunity to free their minds with variety of activities at the mini club. On arrival guests will be welcomed with a traditional sweet and glass of sherbet.

179129.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include gift shops/newsstands and a television in a common area. You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Erbazlar Hotel, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a computer station, and express check-in. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 24 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. 179139.description: Located in Frederick Street, the hotel is in a perfect central location, whether guests are visiting the city for a business break or a weekend getaway. Frederick Street is located off the city's premier shopping district - George Street, only minutes from boutique and high street shops alike. The hotel is equidistant to the East and West ends of the city, approximately 12 km from Edinburgh International Airport and a mere 5 minutes from Edinburgh Waverley Train Station. Glasgow International Airport is about 87 km away. This stylish city hotel has a total of 10 rooms. The premises are air-conditioned and guests are welcomed in a lobby. There is also a restaurant. Guests can take advantage of the Internet access and room service (the latter incurs an additional fee). The hotel offers the perfect antidote to unwelcoming corporate hotel chains. From the elegant walnut headboards to the enticing angora and lamb's wool blankets on the king-size beds, these are stylish Edinburgh hotel rooms. Each room has an en suite bathroom with a shower, bath and a hairdryer. All luxurious furniture has been custom designed and manufactured with comfort in mind, ensuring that the rooms are as calming as they are luxurious. Each room is equipped with a direct dial telephone, cable TV with DVD player and a sound system. A minibar, and tea and coffee making facilities are also provided. Breakfast can be delivered to rooms on request. Wireless Internet access, an ironing set and central heating are available. The restaurant serves traditional local dishes. A taxi from Edinburgh Airport will take each guest straight from door to door, whilst the Airlink Bus runs frequently between the airport and Edinburgh's Princes Street. If arriving by train, Edinburgh Waverley Station is around a 10-minute walk from the hotel.

179187.address: Avenida Tulum esq Brisa s/n SM. 4 Col Centro
179187.description: The hotel is located on Tulum Avenue, one of the most important streets of central Cancun. It is perfect for business and close to restaurants, bars, cinemas and shopping venues. This establishment combines work with pleasure in one of the most beautiful tourist places in Mexico. Guests can relax in the TV lounge and enjoy a drink in the café, bar and pub. There is also a restaurant and a beautiful garden on site. The hotel has 177 rooms and features an executive floor, 3 rooms for conferences and events for up to 550 people and a business centre. The residence also offers Oasis category rooms decorated in a minimalist style.

179223.description: This hotel enjoys a strategic location, surrounded by the delights of Hammersmith. Within a short distance of the hotel, lie a host of local attractions. Guests can enjoy ease of access to an array of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues, where the essence and intrigue of the area can be uncovered. Guests will be impressed by the style and poise which the hotel displays. The hotel rooms are tastefully decorated, featuring soft, soothing tones and modern furnishings. The rooms come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. The hotel offers a warm, friendly atmosphere, alongside professional service, to ensure a memorable stay for each individual guest.

179247.description: Centrally located, just 200m from Cleopatra's Beach, this apartment hotel is surrounded by shops, restaurants and cafe bars, while the pedestrian shopping centre is only 1. 5 km away and the attractive harbour area is 2 km from the establishment. Refurbished in 2018, this apartment hotel offers comfortable accommodation in a central location. It consists of 36 apartments in total. Guests can dine in the restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating or enjoy a refreshing drink at the bar. A standard apartment consists of a bedroom and kitchenette with living area and is equipped with all modern amenities necessary for an independent stay. Guests can relax by the small outdoor pool with separate paddling pool for children or enjoy a game of pool or table tennis in their leisure time. The restaurant serves both local and international dishes.

179248.description: Enviably located, overlooking the Golden Horn of Istanbul, this hotel's location in the Taksim Pera district boasts breath-taking views. Surrounded by leafy parks, this accommodation is close to historic and cultural attractions, business districts and congress centres, chic shopping and outstanding restaurants and cafés. Istanbul International Airport is 40 km from the property. The hotel offers comfortable rooms which are decorated in a Bohemian, Old Istanbul style and equipped with all modern amenities such as LCD televisions, coffee and tea facilities, safe and bathroom with rain shower and hair dryer. The hotel's services and amenities include an on-site wellness centre, restaurant, extensive concierge services, a car park and an indoor pool.

179249.description: Located in Sisli, some 3 km north of Taksim Square, the hotel is ideally situated among business centres, shopping centres and cultural and recreational attractions. The historic district of Sultanahmet is 7 km away and easily reached by public transport. Ataturk International Airport is about 21 km away. Opened in 2013, the city hotel has 292 luxurious rooms built on 8 floors and is suitable for business and leisure guests alike. Guests on business trips may take advantage of the fully equipped conference/meeting facilities and function rooms. The rooms are furnished in a contemporary style using muted tones. Recreational facilities include a gym, sauna, indoor and outdoor swimming pool, steam bath and a hot tub for guests seeking a relaxing SPA experience. There is also a children's swimming area and refreshments are available from the poolside snack bar.

179251.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 17 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars (stocked with some free items) and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and electric kettles. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. 179255.address: Konakli Merkez Mahallesi Nergis Sokak No:4 KONAKLI, 4
179255.description: Oji Beach Hotel in Antalya offers a private beach area, beachfront, and a lush garden. Guests can relax on the terrace or take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool. Free WiFi is available throughout the property. Rooms feature air-conditioning, balconies with garden or pool views, private bathrooms, and modern amenities such as mini-bars and flat-screen TVs. Free on-site private parking and a 24-hour front desk ensure convenience. The family-friendly restaurant serves local specialties, warm dishes, fresh pastries, and a variety of beverages. Breakfast includes local specialties, warm dishes, juice, fresh pastries, cheese, and fruits. Lunch and dinner are available in traditional, modern, and romantic settings. Konakli Beach is a 4-minute walk away. Other attractions include Alanya Aquapark (7. 5 mi) and Alanya Castle (9. 9 mi). Gazipaşa-Alanya Airport is 33 mi from the hotel.

179314.description: We look forward to welcoming you at The Best Western Victoria Palace hotel in Central London, for a modern and cozy break in the capital. Whilst staying with us you will enjoy a prime location in the very heart of London, within walking distance of many of the city's most celebrated attractions. Buckingham Palace is less than a 20-minute walk away, so why not head there for 10:30 a. m. and get a good spot for the changing of the guard. You'll also be a 20 minute walk from the London Eye, for some breath-taking birds eye views of the city. Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, Trafalgar Square and Downing Street (to name a few) are also close by, meaning you'll be able to tick off all the biggest points of interest. For something a little more obscure – we'll have plenty of recommendations. Visit the night time food market Street Feast, Kayak down the Thames, or visit Jumeirah Carlton Tower for a spectacular 1960's afternoon tea. If you're visiting London for a weekend of spending, Carnaby Street and Oxford Street are both just 20 minutes away by tube. If you feel like a more extravagant splurge, London's highly exclusive Mayfair is also 20 minutes away. You're sure to work up an appetite during your day of sightseeing or shopping, so check out Time Out's listing of the best restaurants in London for some incredible - yet still very affordable – food spots. If you wish to venture away from London, we're proud to be a hugely convenient London hotel just five minutes' walk of Victoria Station and Victoria Coach Station.

name.content: Best Western Mornington Hotel London Hyde Park

179390.description: The Best Western Mornington Hotel London Hyde Park enjoys a great location in the heart of Greater London. Close to Lancaster Gate tube and buses, our accommodation has been elegantly re-designed and is fully equipped! Our bedrooms are, of course, comfortable. . . and complemented by our intimate Library Bar which serves drinks and light snacks. Please note that whilst we only have a breakfast restaurant, there are a variety of good restaurants nearby. The great news is our free high-speed wireless Internet access will help you find them all! Shopping opportunities are countless in the capital, but if you simply want to wander around and see the sights, Hyde Park is the perfect starting point! The West End is less than two miles away if you fancy a show, and The Victoria & Albert and Natural History Museums will enthrall you as you explore. Enjoy your stay.

179402.description: If you’re looking for a place to stay in London, the Best Western Swiss Cottage Hotel offers the best of both worlds. In a pleasant residential area near Regents Park, you’ll enjoy peace and quiet during your stay. Yet with London’s countless attractions just a few minutes away, the sights and sounds of the capital are never far away. This elegant Victorian townhouse is full of character and fascinating objets d’art, which add a unique charm to the hotel – including a grand piano, oil paintings and antique furniture. You can be sure your stay here will be memorable for all the right reasons. Our hotel is right next to Swiss Cottage tube station and just a few minutes from the West End by tube or bus. The Jubilee line links us directly to Lord's cricket ground, Madam Tussauds, Oxford Street, Big Ben, Wembley arena and many other attractions - so you'll spend more time deciding where to go than you will getting there. There are lots of convenient bars, bistros and brasseries around the hotel and for these reasons we have no restaurant for lunch or dinner. Instead, we provide a pleasant breakfast room that serves a range of cooked and continental items to give you the energy boost you need for a day of sightseeing.

179409.description: Completely rebuilt in 2015, this modern hotel in Central London offers innovatively designed, air-conditioned rooms. Relaxing rain showers, media streaming, large smart TVs, and touch-controlled mood lighting create a chic base for exploring the city. The Best Western Plus Delmere Hotel is a 5-minute stroll from Paddington Station and the Heathrow Express, with an airport journey time of only 15 minutes. Excellent tube and bus connections provide easy access to all major London sights. You'll be a stone's throw from Hyde Park and within walking distance of world-class shopping on Oxford Street and Soho's vibrant nightlife. For rainy days, there's a direct tube connection to both Westfield shopping centers. The local restaurant scene offers a vast selection for every budget, and numerous traditional pubs provide further choices. In the hotel, you'll find The Hub, offering complimentary tea and coffee—an ideal place to relax before exploring London. Our cozy and stylish rooms perfectly reflect the city's focus on style.

179492.address: Esplanada Do Castelo, Foz Do Douro, 58
179492.description: Overlooking the Douro River estuary and the Atlantic Ocean, the Hotel Boa-Vista boasts stunning 19th-century architecture. Guests can enjoy a tranquil stay in air-conditioned rooms equipped with minibars and cable TV. A year-round rooftop outdoor pool and panoramic café offer breathtaking views. Additional amenities include a fitness center, bar, and terrace, perfect for savoring a glass of port in the gentle sea breeze. Located a short 5-minute walk from Ingleses Beach, the hotel is conveniently situated 1. 5 miles from Oporto Sea Life and a 15-minute drive from the Arrabida shopping area. Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is 6. 8 miles away. Please note: The rooftop pool is not heated. Group bookings (6 rooms or more) require a non-refundable 50% deposit upon reservation. Parking is allocated on a first-come, first-served basis and costs €8 from November to April and €12 from May to October. Electric vehicle charging is €1 per kW. In-room breakfast incurs a surcharge (€10 for one person, €15 for two). For invoicing details or further information regarding group bookings, please contact the hotel directly.

name.content: ibis budget London Whitechapel - Brick Lane

179527.description: Looking for a stylish and affordable stay close to central London, Ibis Budget London Whitechapel is an excellent choice. Located just a 7-minute walk from both Whitechapel and Aldgate stations, the hotel offers easy access to the best of East London. Enjoy a fresh continental breakfast to start your day, grab snacks whenever you need them, and explore nearby highlights like Brick Lane and Spitalfields Market—well known for their vibrant street food, art scene, and vintage shopping.

name.content: AC Hotel Birmingham NEC and Airport

179612.description: AC Hotel by Marriott Birmingham NEC & Airport pairs purposeful design with a calm, contemporary aesthetic. Located moments from Birmingham Airport and the NEC, the hotel offers 169 sleek, air-conditioned rooms, a modern gym, generous parking, and the AC Lounge®, a stylish space to dine, unwind or connect over cocktails. Flexible meeting rooms provide a polished setting for collaboration or events. In a short stroll, explore the shops and entertainment of Resorts World, catch a concert at bp pulse live, or visit the NEC convention halls. Birmingham International station is just minutes away on foot, with direct trains to central Birmingham, London and beyond, and a free Air-Rail Link to the airport operating daily from 03:30 to 00:30. Not your typical airport hotel, AC Birmingham Airport offers pet-friendly spaces, service focused on effortless stays, and interiors designed for comfort and clarity. The reimagined AC Hotel at Birmingham Airport is a place to relax, recharge and enjoy the journey.

179730.description: The hotel enjoys a quiet location in the heart of the Venetian Cannaregio. The Rialto Bridge is a 15-minute walk away. It is just a 3-minute walk from the Grand Canal and just 70 meters from the water bus docks, allowing guests to easily navigate this enchanting city. It is also a 10 minutes' walk from Santa Lucia Train Station. The hotel offers unique Venetian rooms in a historic 17th-century building with original frescoes, wood-beamed ceilings and Murano glass chandeliers. All rooms are air-conditioned and feature a TV and minibar. Despite its antique origins, the establishment offers modern amenities such as wireless Internet access and a public computer.

179850.description: The hotel is located in the heart of Paris, was completely renovated in 2003 to become a modern and elegant hotel in the center of Paris. Behind the traditional Haussman façade, this modern design hotel now stands with a spacious common area. The hotel offers 83 elegant air-conditioned rooms, equipped with convenient amenities. Its magnificent location allows guests to explore beautiful Paris on foot. The Sacre Coeur, Montmartre, the Opera and the main department stores are just a 15-minute walk from the hotel. Similarly, guests will find very tempting restaurants offering everything from French to Indian cuisine, not to mention the wonderful selection of bars and cafes from which visitors can observe the city while enjoying a glass of French wine.

179868.description: Apartment stays allow for more space and privacy - you can live and shop like a local. Best for stays of 2 days or longer, enjoy perks like full kitchens and space to entertain and relax with your family and friends. With a washer/dryer in each apartment, flat-screen TVs, and free high-speed wifi no need to compromise on facilities. With first-class customer service from the Concierge team and a seven-day-per-week housekeeping service Scottish hospitality is assured. IMPORTANT CHECK-IN INFORMATION:At the Knight Residence by Mansley, guests are required to complete the check-in process online, prior to arrival. Guests must contact the property 72h before arrival to receive arrival instructions. For Emergency assistance outside the opening hours: Please contact our customer service team at +44 1316 228 120.

179869.description: Located in Cairo city centre, just a few minutes' walk from the Egyptian Museum, this hotel offers a strategic location directly in front of the Mohamed Najeeb underground station. This air-conditioned city hotel comprises 60 guest rooms and guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as a hotel safe, cloakroom, currency exchange and newspaper stand. There is a café, a bar and a restaurant and guests will appreciate the conference facilities and wireless Internet access. Guests can also take advantage of the room and laundry services. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a shower, and offer a double bed. The rooms also come equipped with a satellite TV, Internet access, a radio, safe, minibar and a balcony or terrace as standard. A buffet breakfast is served each morning at the hotel. Lunch and dinner can be enjoyed à la carte.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Newark Airport

179887.description: Our hotel is next to Newark Liberty International Airport, with a free shuttle every 30 minutes. We're seven miles from Cape Liberty Cruise Port and 10 miles from New York City. Every stay starts with a chocolate chip cookie, and Starbucks coffee and grab-and-go items are available in the lobby. Enjoy our fitness center and indoor pool.

179909.address: Merkez Mh. Deniz Cad. Kemer / Antalya, 39
179909.description:
Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a steam room, a seasonal outdoor pool, and bicycles to rent. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and tour/ticket assistance. This hotel is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, ANA RESTAURANT, for lunch or dinner, or grab snacks at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wind down with a drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges or 2 poolside bars. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM.

Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and laundry facilities.

179910.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages and body treatments. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy international cuisine at Arts Restaurant, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 213 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks.

179969.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at this hotel, featuring a sauna and fitness center. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, and take advantage of concierge services and the common area television. Savor Italian cuisine at La Fabbrica del Cotone, offering alfresco dining and a bar/lounge. Room service is available during limited hours. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, served from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Business amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel offers 646 square feet (60 square meters) of event space, ideal for conferences and meetings. Free self-parking is available onsite. The 135 guestrooms provide minibars, flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Your bed includes down comforters and premium bedding. Private bathrooms feature shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and bidets.
