Located near the Fiera Milano Exhibition Center, the hotel is also convenient to other attractions such as the Alfa Romeo Historical Museum and IL Centro. The nearest airports are Linate (LIN) and Milan Malpensa (MXP).

180007.description: Located 200m from the beach on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, this 3 star hotel features simply furnished rooms with bright turquoise furnishings and has a laidback atmosphere, ideal for a beach holiday but within easy reach of Alanya, 9 km away. When not sight-seeing or shopping, guests can choose to relax by the hotel's outdoor pool or sunbathe on the private section of the beach. Local amenities such as shops, cafe bars and restaurants can be found in the vicinity of the hotel and public transport runs 400m away, providing convenient access into Alanya, a must-see for its' great shopping, attractive harbour area and hilltop castle.

180031.address: P.O.Box 49519, Al Rolla Road, Bur Dubai
180031.description: Ideally located in central Bur Dubai behind Computer Street and next to Port Rashid, Savoy Central Hotel offers convenient access to Dubai's shopping centers, souks, and business districts. Guests can easily explore the city's rich cultural attractions, including the Dubai Museum, Heritage Village, Grand Mosque, and the vibrant souks. The hotel comprises 154 well-appointed executive studios, each featuring spacious interiors and a fully-equipped kitchenette, providing a sense of privacy and tranquility. These thoughtful details make each studio suite a desirable and comfortable choice for both business and leisure travelers. *City tax not included.

180050.description:
Rest Up at Driscoll House: Sleep Where Stories were Made

Experience London like never before at Rest Up Hostel, nestled inside the historic Driscoll House built 1913, a beautifully preserved landmark brimming with timeless character. Perfectly located in Zone 1, we're your gateway to the very best of the city. 

We keep it simple, clean, cozy, minimalist rooms so you can focus on the experience not the extras. Want more? We’ve got it! Need a towel, luggage storage or even toiletries? Just ask, they are available just for a small fee. You pay only for what you need. 

WHY STAY WITH US?
• Prime central location, unbeatable value
• Stunning historic building with unique charm
• Close to London’s best attractions
• Welcoming atmosphere—ideal for solo travellers and groups

“Sleep where the past inspires your future adventure. ”

BOOK YOUR BED TODAY – YOUR LONDON STORY STARTS HERE

SLEEP IN THE PAST WALT INTO THE CITY

REST UP HOSTEL ALSO HAS CAFÉ, DAILY CONTINENTAL BREAKFAST AN ENGLISH BREAKFAST ON WEEKENDS

180128.description: Set on a working farm surrounded by vineyards in the renowned wine region just outside of Stellenbosch, this hotel offers a haven of peace and tranquillity for a relaxing holiday retreat. Visitors can enjoy an enchanting winemaking tour and tasting with the cellar master, take a stroll through the vineyard or surrounding countryside, play a game of boules, or simply sunbathe by the sparkling outdoor infinity pool. The hotel features a comfortable, modern décor with regional influences, and the attractive guest rooms are furnished with sleek hardwood floors and a delightful, garden-facing terrace in addition to en suite bathrooms with underfloor heating and a tea and coffee tray. Guests might choose to dine in the onsite restaurant or make use of the barbeque area, and can wake up to a full English or continental breakfast in the morning, all for a marvellous weekend away.

name.content: Hotel Alpha Paris Eiffel by Patrick Hayat

180131.description: The hotel is located in the town of Boulogne-Billancourt, just 100 metres from the Métro station Marcel Sembat, which connects directly with the Eiffel Tower in Paris. The property is a 10-minute walk from Parc des Princes football stadium, a 15-minute walk from the River Seine, and 2 km from Longchamps Racecourse. This functional, boutique hotel was built in 1900 and renovated in 2020, and offers a choice of soundproofed rooms to guarantee a restful night sleep. All rooms are en suite and feature a shower or bath, as well as modern conveniences such as satellite TV and Internet access. The onsite facilities include a garden, ideal to enjoy a moment of relaxation. Those arriving by car may take advantage of the private car park. Moreover, guests can select a continental breakfast from a buffet each morning.

180188.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting on the shopping street of Kurfurstendamm in Berlin. Guests will find themselves surrounded by delightful shopping opportunities, exquisite dining options and exciting entertainment venues. This charming hotel greets guests with sophisticated elegance and style. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, and come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests will be impressed by the exemplary facilities that the hotel has to offer, catering to the needs of every type of traveller. Guests can enjoy a delicious breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to work or to explore the delights that the city has to offer.

180189.description: Featuring innovative design and stylish interiors, this hotel sits directly on Berlin's renowned Kurfürstendamm boulevard, just a short trip by public transport or a 5-minute drive from the ICC exhibition center. Enjoy easy access to all of Berlin's attractions via nearby bus services, the Halensee S-Bahn station, and the Adenauerplatz U-Bahn station. The modern rooms offer minimalist decor, TVs, Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with heated floors; some boast city or courtyard views. Wake up to a delicious breakfast in the 7th-floor dining lounge with stunning city views. After a busy day exploring the capital, unwind with a drink in the lounge bar.

180327.description: The hotel is ideally located for visiting the main attractions of the historic Sultanahmet area which are within walking distance. A tram stop is approximately 100 meters from the hotel and local amenities are close by. This 31-room boutique hotel offers comfortable accommodation for tourists on leisure trips. Ladies are sure to appreciate the on-site hair-dressing salon. In their spare time, guests can enjoy the hotel's sauna and small gym. There is parking available close by and internet access is available in the hotel. The elegantly furnished rooms have carpeted flooring and are equipped with air-conditioning and other modern amenities, such as satellite TV.

180330.description: Located in Istanbul's vibrant city center, Hotel Monaco offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant, 24-hour room service, and a bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel also features a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours). Each of the 65 air-conditioned rooms includes a minibar, LCD television, private bathroom with shower, bidet, hairdryer, safe, and desk. Hotel Monaco is within a 15-minute walk of the Grand Bazaar and Süleymaniye Mosque, and a short distance from other key attractions, including the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia.

name.content: Fortune Select Exotica, Navi Mumbai - Member Itc H

180387.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Navi Mumbai? This hotel has 10323 square feet (959 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 6 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 85 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring fireplaces and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. CIDCO Exhibition Centre - 3. 1 km / 1. 9 mi- Inorbit Mall - 3. 2 km / 2 mi- Sagar Vihar - 3. 4 km / 2. 1 mi- Reliance Corporate Park - 3. 7 km / 2. 3 mi- Rock Garden - 3. 9 km / 2. 4 mi- Millennium Business Park - 3. 9 km / 2. 4 mi- Central Park, Navi Mumbai - 6. 8 km / 4. 2 mi- Nerul Balaji Temple - 6. 8 km / 4. 2 mi- Seawoods Lake - 7. 1 km / 4. 4 mi- Nerul Lake and nature park - 7. 2 km / 4. 5 mi- DY Patil Stadium - 7. 5 km / 4. 7 mi- Dhirubhai Ambani Life Science Centre - 8. 3 km / 5. 1 mi- Seawoods Grand Central - 8. 3 km / 5. 2 mi- Wonder Park - 10. 3 km / 6. 4 mi- Belapur Mango Garden - 11. 3 km / 7 mi. The preferred airport for Fortune Select Exotica, Navi Mumbai - Member ITC Hotels' Group is Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport (BOM) - 28. 3 km / 17.

180394.address: Jupiter Hosp. Campus, Eastern Expres Highway Thane
180394.description: This upscale hotel is located on the Eastern Express Highway in Mumbai. The hotel offers ease of access to business and industrial centres such as Bhiwandi, Airoli and Navi Mumbai. The hotel offers the perfect setting for business or leisure travellers visiting the city. The hotel features thoughtful design and contemporary style. The guest rooms feature bright, airy surroundings and luxurious style. They offer the ideal setting in which guests can enjoy quiescence and restful slumber. Guests are invited to dine in style in the hotel's restaurant, where they can savour the delectable vegetarian delights that the menu has to offer, there is something to tempt even the most discerning palate.

180527.description: These elegant, modern suites and studios are situated just meters from Battersea Park in central London. Clapham Junction Rail and Underground Station is a 5-minute drive away. London's main attractions, including Oxford Circus, Piccadilly Circus, Hyde Park, and Oxford Street, are easily accessible by Tube. Buckingham Palace is only 7 minutes from the building. Each air-conditioned studio features a TV and a bathroom with a walk-in shower and complimentary toiletries. Secure underground parking is available for guests arriving by car.

180533.description: This cosy hotel guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 10 accomodation units. Those staying at this establishment may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. Clients will appreciate the 24-hour reception.

180555.description: This boutique hotel and restaurant, nestled on the outskirts of a charming village, is surrounded by enchanting vineyards and majestic mountains. Just an hour's drive from Cape Town, it's the perfect getaway for exploring the Western Cape. The Country House, a restored manor house and former perfumery dating back to 1890, offers 14 standard and luxury rooms, in addition to 12 opulent villa suites. All en-suite rooms provide first-class amenities, including LED TVs, free Wi-Fi, espresso machines, and air conditioning. Most rooms open onto private balconies or patios with magnificent views. The opulent villa suites are havens of style and luxury, each 100 square meters with a separate lounge, fireplace, DVD player, integrated music system, two balconies, and more. During the summer, guests can relax by one of the two pools (one heated) with stunning mountain views, enjoy a massage, explore the boutique wine farms in Franschhoek, or stroll through the charming town itself. The hotel provides a complimentary shuttle service to and from the village center. The award-winning Monneaux Restaurant is renowned for its modern and tasteful cuisine. À la carte lunches are served on the magnificent new fountain terrace, while dinner is offered in the elegant dining room or enclosed veranda. Attentive service and personalized touches complete the experience at this refined country retreat.

180592.description: Located in Bogotá's vibrant Zona T, Hotel Saint Simon offers a convenient base for exploring the city. Walking distance to the main shopping malls, restaurant and bars. Just a short drive from 93 Park and Unicentro Bogotá, this hotel provides easy access to key attractions. Guests can enjoy amenities such as concierge services and breakfast area. The 46 guestrooms feature minibars, LCD televisions with cable, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, and in-room safes. Daily housekeeping is also available. Start your day with a cooked-to-order breakfast (fee applies) at the Saint Simon restaurant. For business travelers, the hotel offers a business center and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Dry cleaning/laundry services and airport transfers (surcharge) are also available.

180595.description: The Alvear Palace Hotel is located in the stylish Recoleta neighborhood, surrounded by the city's best restaurants and shops, and only five minutes from the financial district. The hotel features grand public areas and 192 gracious, luxurious accommodations decorated in a modern French style. The top floors offer 15 spacious, contemporarily designed suites with excellent city views, an indoor heated pool, a pool bar, and solariums. The hotel's restaurants and bars, traditional meeting points in Buenos Aires, offer a warm ambiance and exquisite international cuisine. Dine at the recently opened Alvear Grill, an Argentinian steakhouse with a fresh take on local cuisine. Don't miss the luxurious Spa & Fitness Center, complete with a vitality pool, sauna, steam bath, body and face treatments, kinesis, and high-tech fitness equipment. Shabbat keys are also available.

180597.description:
Hotel Panamby Guarulhos, 100% renovated, offers great comfort and a strategic location just minutes from Guarulhos Airport. The apartments have been completely renovated, everything designed to make your stay even more pleasant. 
Highlights include apartments with 2 double beds, ideal for families!
The hotel offers free round-trip airport transfers, ideal for those seeking convenience from the moment they arrive.

180653.description: Located in Venice's Dorsoduro district, Hotel Moresco is a short walk from Piazzale Roma and the Grand Canal. This eco-certified hotel offers individually decorated rooms with minibars, espresso machines, and private bathrooms with bidets. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a daily reception, and a bar/lounge. A casino and cruise ship terminal shuttle are available (surcharge). The hotel is conveniently located 1. 1 km from the Port of Venice and 12. 2 km from Lido of Venice Beaches.

180655.description: Discover one of the 995 rooms and suites at the Hyatt Regency Paris Étoile, the only skyscraper hotel in Paris. Decorated in a modern, comfortable style, each room offers stunning views of the City of Lights. A work area, relaxation space, and elegant bathroom await, allowing you to recharge in the heart of Paris. All rooms (minimum 22 square meters) feature a king-size bed, bathrobes, slippers, iron and ironing board, two complimentary bottles of water daily, Wi-Fi, and fitness center access.

180656.description: Experience classic Parisian elegance at the Hilton Paris Opera, a landmark building featuring a magnificent lobby adorned with crystal chandeliers, marble columns, bronze statues, and stunning art pieces by Charles Joseph Lameire. Situated in the lively Opéra quarter, this hotel is near Parisian attractions such as the Opéra Garnier, the Champs-Elysées, renowned department stores, charming cafés and restaurants, and designer boutiques. The La Défense business district is just a short train ride away. Chic, stylish, and comfortable, each guest room and suite is equipped with contemporary amenities designed for relaxation and productivity. Check emails with complimentary Wi-Fi, watch cable channels on the TV, enjoy tea and coffee making facilities, and refresh in the spacious bathroom with an oversized shower. With seven elegant meeting spaces, contemporary A/V equipment, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a 24-hour business center, this hotel is ideal for successful business meetings, elegant celebrations, and wedding receptions for up to 180 guests. Le Grand Salon offers a sophisticated space for guests to mingle, while the Quai 108 restaurant provides a trendy setting to connect with friends, family, or colleagues.

180658.description: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse TGV is centrally located in Paris, a 4-minute walk from Fondation Henri Cartier-Bresson and 8 minutes by foot from Montparnasse Tower. This upscale hotel is 0. 8 mi (1. 3 km) from Paris Catacombs and 0. 9 mi (1. 4 km) from Montparnasse Cemetery. Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services, barbecue grills, and discounted use of a nearby fitness facility. Make yourself at home in one of the 354 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Enjoy French cuisine at Restaurant Le O'40, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

180767.address: Av. São João, 1399 - Santa Cecilia, São Paulo - Sp
180767.description: This business hotel offers 68 apartments and suites in the centre of Sao Paulo. Guests will have easy access to the commercial and cultural centre of the city, as Marechal Deodoro and metro Santa Cecilia metro stations are both within a five-minute walk from the hotel. Those who enjoy art and culture might venture out to the renowned MASP modern art museum and catch a play at the Municipal Theatre of Sao Paulo or explore the Museu da Lingua Portuguesa, both within walking distance. The apartments are furnished with cool tile or luxurious parquet floors, bright, summery accent colours and Wi-Fi internet access. Apartments with two bedrooms also feature a living room. Guests can also make use of the Wi-Fi in the lobby or whilst sipping a coffee or enjoying a light snack in the coffee shop.

180809.address: Sultan Selim Mah.Sultan Selim Cad.4 Levent, 139
180809.description: The hotel is located in the 4 Levent district of Istanbul and is 7 km from the bustling activity of Taksim Square and approximately 12 km from the historical attractions at Sultanahmet which are easily reached by public transport. Local amenities are close by and so are links to the public transport system with the nearest underground station 1. 4 km away. The establishment is a modern hotel with a distinctive exterior. It consists of 35 rooms and offers all the standard amenities for a hotel of its class. The tastefully equipped rooms measure 23-25 sqm and have carpeted or parquet flooring. Guests can relax in front of the LCD TV, brew a cup of hot coffee or tea, or take advantage of the free wireless Internet access.

180810.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this hotel, complete with complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel offers a restaurant with a bar/lounge, 24-hour room service, and a daily complimentary reception. Additional amenities include concierge services, a common area television, a vending machine, express check-in/check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies), and free self-parking is provided. Each of the 27 guestrooms features a minibar, LED TV with satellite programming, and a private bathroom with a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. Conveniences such as phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks are also included. Located near Istanbul Cevahir Shopping and Entertainment Centre, the hotel is also within a short distance of other key attractions like the American Hospital and City's Nişantaşı Shopping Center. Istanbul Airport (IST) is the preferred airport for Regno Hotel.

180813.description: This modern hotel consists of 2 connecting blocks of 250 rooms and occupies 12, 000 m2 of land which stretches down to the sandy pebble beach in the Konakli area, some 11 km west of the popular resort of Alanya. Guests can enjoy a range of recreational activities as well as a private section of the beach with a pier and sun-bathing facilities and a couple of outdoor pools, including one with a waterslide.

180816.description: The Oba Time Hotel, a renovated 4-star boutique hotel, is located in the heart of Oba/Alanya, Antalya, close to local attractions and amenities. Its 91 rooms, including one accessible room, are comfortably decorated and cater to a variety of needs, with all areas of the hotel being disability-friendly. The hotel features an à la carte restaurant with diverse menu options, a spa with a sauna, steam room, Turkish bath, and hairdresser, and a swimming pool with a sunbathing terrace. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Each room includes a mini-fridge, split air conditioning, a kettle, a hairdryer, an LCD TV, and a large balcony. Safes are available for an extra charge. The Oba Time Beach Bar, located on a pebble beach, offers stunning views of Alanya Castle and Alanya Harbour, with complimentary sun loungers and parasols. The hotel is 37 km from Gazipasa-Alanya International Airport and 126 km from Antalya International Airport.

180829.address: La Bella Wine Estate Simonsvlei Rd. Paart
180829.description: Flanked by the majestic Simonsberg Mountains in the picturesque Franschhoek Valley, this stunning property is located on a working wine estate. Boasting luxurious accommodation, an award-winning Spa and fabulous facilities for hosting events, a particular feature of the hotel besides the scenery is the extensive spa facilities and stunning indoor pool bordered by columns and with a wooden beamed ceiling. Lavishly decorated in earth tones and textures the suite rooms afford guests' comfort and convenience. A range of recreational facilities are available on the family friendly property and there are many wonderful places to visit in the area with Cape Town being approximately 45 minutes' drive away.

180867.description: Situated in Bogota's key northern business district in the exclusive Parque de la 93 area, this luxurious hotel is surrounded by some of the city's most prestigious restaurants and a variety of shops, bars and cafés. Sightseers will have easy access to the Candelaria, as Calle 100 metro station is just a short walk away, and the Chico Mercedes Sierra de Perez Museum is only a 15-minute walk from the hotel. The stylish guest rooms come with a host of modern conveniences, including handy work desks, flat-screen televisions, and complimentary wireless internet access. The hotel features a business centre and meeting room with the latest audio-visual technology, making it ideal for business travel. Guests can unwind with a workout in the gym or enjoy a drink with friends and colleagues on the panoramic rooftop terrace after a long day of meetings and dine in the onsite restaurant, all during a high-powered business trip to Bogota.

180909.description: This hotel enjoys an excellent location in the most bohemian and historical part of Buenos Aires, San Telmo. Surrounded by art galleries, antique shops, and restaurants, and right across from the famous Plaza Dorrego, which hosts the city's best flea market on weekends, the hotel also offers quick and easy access to Buenos Aires' major financial, commercial, tourist, and entertainment areas. Relaxation and tranquility prevail on the terrace, and the open green spaces harmonize perfectly with the surrounding environment, inviting guests to relax in the chairs and armchairs. Each morning, guests can enjoy a continental breakfast at the restaurant. Renovated in 2012, this nine-room, air-conditioned historical hotel offers a friendly atmosphere with music and drinks available 24 hours a day in the bar. Further facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, cloakroom, café, wireless Internet access, and room service. The rooms feature sleek design and modern amenities such as a flat-screen TV, free Internet access, and cordless telephones. Bathrooms include a shower, bathtub, hairdryer, and luxurious bath products. A double or king-size bed, radio, safe, minibar, individually regulated air conditioning and heating, and a private balcony or terrace are also standard. Guests can relax on the sun terrace with parasols, in the hot tub, or with a massage (for a fee). A continental breakfast is served each morning.

180988.description: Welcome to Hotel San Pablo, the ideal choice for business travelers in Bogotá. With over 15 years of experience, we are dedicated to creating memorable experiences. We are located in the heart of the city and offer everything you need for a pleasant stay. Our team is always ready to assist you, ensuring a smooth experience from check-in to check-out. At Hotel San Pablo, we are committed to offering quality service. Whether you are here for meetings or a short getaway, we are here to make your stay exceptional. We are close to Corferias, American Embassy, ​​Conecta, Universidad Nacional, El Campín Stadium, Movistar Arena, Monserrate and the historic center: La CandelariaCome and discover the best of the city! We look forward to welcoming you soon.

181029.description: Decorated in a contemporary style, this family-friendly hotel is located in the Fugla area, 21 km west from Alanya. Amenities include a spa centre with indoor pool, an outdoor pool, separate pool with waterslides and a private beach area. Public transport is available from the main road a minute's walk or so away from the hotel with access to neighbouring towns and the resort of Alanya.

name.content: Hotel du Louvre in the Unbound Collection by Hyatt

181188.description:
Ideally located between the Louvre Museum and the Opéra Garnier, Hôtel du Louvre invites you to discover the City of Lights like a true Parisian. Our address steeped in history encourages the art of rambling, for a memorable stay in the heart of Paris. 

The hotel offers 164 spacious and luminous rooms, including 57 suites, steeped in history and decorated in typical Parisian style. Some offer breathtaking views over unmissable Parisian monuments.

181307.description: This riad is a 7-minute walk from Jemaa el-Fna square and features a rooftop terrace overlooking the medina and Atlas Mountains. The elegant, air-conditioned rooms and suites are decorated in a traditional style with colorful fabrics and zellige tiles. Guests enjoy free Wi-Fi. A traditional Moroccan breakfast is available each morning and can be served in your room. Moroccan dishes are available for dinner upon request. Cooking classes, massages, and hammam treatments are available for an additional fee. Staff can also arrange tours and airport transfers. The medina is an ideal location for travelers interested in exploring the souks.

181387.description: Enjoy a vibrant stay at Generator Berlin Mitte, a centrally located hostel in the heart of Berlin. A short walk from Friedrichstrasse and Museum Island, and just 0. 7km from Hackescher Markt, our hostel offers a range of amenities including a nightclub, bicycle rentals, a restaurant, café, and bar/lounge. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property, and a communal TV area provides a space to relax. Each of our 145 guestrooms features blackout curtains and an en suite bathroom with a shower. Buffet breakfasts are available on weekdays for a fee. We also offer express check-in/check-out and a 24-hour front desk for your convenience.

181474.description: Acta Madfor is a 3-star hotel located just a few minutes away from Plaza España and the Gran Vía, close to Madrid's main points of interest as well as its famous musical shows. All the rooms are designed to offer maximum comfort. The décor in all of the rooms blends modern and vintage elements, creating a cosy atmosphere, both in the rooms and in the rest of the hotel. On the top floor of the hotel is located the terrace-solarium, with incredible views of the whole city. After a long day you can relax in the MAD4U Living area or have an appetizer in the Snack Area. Breakfast is served in the building next to the hotel form 7. 30 am to 11 amWhen booking more than 5 rooms, special conditions and supplements may apply.

181507.description: Located just off the Belgrave road gives the Mornington Hotel London Victoria the best of being part of the hustle and bustle of London whilst enjoying the peace of the Victorian residential street. Located moments from London Victoria Station the Mornington Hotel London Victoria is ideally located for sightseeing, shopping trips luxurary trips and business with a twist.

181589.address: Sidi Bouamer Quartier Riad Laarous81 Derb Zemouri
181589.description: This is a luxurious hotel set in a prime location in the centre of Marrakech. Local tourist attractions such as Saadian Tombs, Kasbah Mosque and Bab Agnaou are not far and El Badi Palace, Palais El Bahia and Dar Si Said Museum are within easy reach. A restaurant serving various specialties is available on-site for dining, and guests can also make use of the flawless room service. The tastefully designed and furnished guestrooms are sure to make visitors feel at home with all in-room amenities needed. A friendly and multilingual professional staff is always happy to be of services with information and help. For leisure there is a swimming pool available, as well as wellness facilities for those who would like to unwind and relax.

181628.description: Nestled south of Isla Mujeres, just 200 meters from Garrafon Park and 13 km from Cancun, this beautiful villa offers breathtaking ocean views and a tranquil atmosphere. Only 2 km from Playa Norte, with Playa del Carmen and Cozumel an easy ferry trip away, it's an ideal location for a relaxing getaway. The villa accommodates 10-22 guests, perfect for family reunions or destination weddings. Indulge in the on-site spa and gym, and savor delicious meals at the two villa restaurants: the Pool Terrace Restaurant and Bar for breakfast and lunch, and the South Point Sunset Restaurant and Bar for happy hour and dinner. Each of the ten ocean-view suites features deluxe comforts such as premium linens and soaps, purified drinking water, and air conditioning. King beds, ceiling fans, hair dryers, mini bars, and safes are standard in every room. Additional amenities include a DVD player, iPod docking station, computer/internet service in the lobby, telephone, washer/dryer, a large outdoor pool, snorkeling equipment, kayaks, and bicycles.

181629.description: Enjoying a prime setting at the pulsating heart of Buenos Aires, this delightful hotel is the ideal choice for travellers who are eager to explore the sights and sounds that this mesmerising city has to offer. The hotel is located just a short walking distance away from Cafe Tortoni and Obelisco, while Plaza de Mayo and Casa Rosada are also situated close by. This delightful hotel enjoys an attractive architectural style, greeting guests with charm and elegance. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, featuring refreshing tones and elegant decor. This hotel affords guests access to a wide range of exemplary facilities, ensuring that the needs of business and leisure travellers alike are fully catered for.

181630.description: The hotel has an excellent location, close to the San Benito, Republica and Anhamgabaú metro stations, and roughly 3 km from Avenida Paulista and Santa Efigenia. Congonhas Airport is approximately 18 km from the hotel. The air-conditioned city hotel offers 70 guest rooms in total and there is wireless Internet access in public areas. The restaurant serves regional specialities and offers a wide selection of drinks. Further facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, lift access to the upper floors and room service. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, cable TV, a fan and private bathroom with shower and hairdryer. They are tastefully decorated and have tiled floors and wooden furniture. Internet access and a direct dial telephone also feature as standard. Guests can work out in the hotel gym. Every morning breakfast is served with fresh fruit, bread and sausages.

181633.description: This upscale hotel enjoys a strategic setting in Buenos Aires. The hotel is located close to the airport, as well as an abundance of attractions and points of interest. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the Palermo Hippodrome, King Fahd Islamic Cultural Centre, La Rural Convention Centre, El Solar de la Abadia shopping centre and El Rosedal Park. Business and leisure travellers alike will appreciate this great location. This hotel features an attractive architectural style, blending effortlessly with its surroundings. Guests are welcomed into a world of elegance and style, with refreshing tones, luxurious furnishings and stunning decor adorning every aspect of the interior design. The guest rooms are sumptuously appointed, and feature luxurious design and elegance. Guests are invited to take advantage of the exemplary facilities this upscale hotel has to offer.

181647.description: Located in the district of Tosmur, some 4. 8 km east of the centre of Alanya, the hotel is just 200 m from the beach which can be reached by an underpass. Local amenities are available close-by and public transport is less than a minute's walk from the hotel. Refurbished in 2012, this 92-room hotel has a classical style and offers guests a range of recreational activities.

181648.address: Nuh Kuyusu Cad.Seyit Ahmet Deresi Sk.Altunizade
181648.description:
Blending Istanbul’s rich historical and cultural heritage with a modern approach to hospitality, Volley Hotel Istanbul welcomes guests in the heart of Üsküdar. Its proximity to major transportation hubs, business centres, healthcare facilities and tourist attractions makes it an ideal accommodation choice for both business and leisure travellers. 

With a service philosophy focused on guest satisfaction, the hotel offers a more comfortable and contemporary stay through its extensively renovated rooms and modern design concept. The comprehensive renovation completed in 2026 combines quality, aesthetics and functionality, further enhancing the overall guest experience. 

The hotel’s restaurants serve a rich buffet breakfast alongside selected dishes from Turkish and international cuisines in an elegant atmosphere. The outdoor swimming pool, available during the summer season, and the fitness area make every stay more enjoyable and comfortable. 

With its central location, renovated rooms, high standards of service and guest-focused approach, Volley Hotel Istanbul offers local and international guests a comfortable, safe and exceptional accommodation experience while they discover the dynamic spirit of Istanbul.

181649.description: This hotel is centrally located in the district of Beyoğlu and only a few steps from Taksim Square, a major tourist destination with a wide range of restaurants, shops and entertainment venues. Istanbul International Airport is some 40 km away. The property offers excellent public transport links, which makes it an ideal base from where to discover the city and its surroundings. The guest rooms present an elegant decoration with modern furniture and excellent amenities such as coffee and tea facilities as well as a flat-screen TV to provide the most comfortable stay. The on-site restaurant invites visitors to sample delicious Turkish cuisine as well as a fine selection of international flavours. Other hotel services include a well-equipped fitness centre and many business facilities.

181650.description: This hotel enjoys a great location on the Bosphorus, on the Kabatas shore and opposite Maiden's Tower. Taksim Square is only 900m from the hotel while the historical attractions at Sultanahmet are 3. 5 km away. Opened in 2012, this new Bosphorus-facing hotel consists of 60 rooms and offers modern, stylish amenities for business and leisure guests alike. Guests can enjoy dining and drinks in the bar, the restaurant or the panoramic rooftop restaurant. The cosy rooms are well furnished with carpeted floors and equipped with modern amenities such as centrally regulated air-conditioning and heating, and free internet access to help guests stay in touch while on vacation. The hotel is equipped with a sauna, Turkish bath and Finnish bath and massage treatments are available for those who prefer a SPA holiday.

181651.description: The hotel is located in the Gungoren district of the city, some 8. 5 km north west of Ataturk Airport. The historical sights of Sultanahmet are 9 km away and easily reached by public transport which runs immediately in front of the hotel. A shopping centre is available less than 10 minutes' walk away. This 44-room hotel offers comfortable accommodation for tourists on leisure trips. Dining options include a breakfast room and a rooftop terrace restaurant with panoramic views over the city. Free Internet access is available in the hotel. The rooms are decorated in muted tones and equipped with centrally controlled air-conditioning. Guests can unwind from their long day of sightseeing in front of the flat-screen TV available in each room among other amenities.

181655.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a terrace, and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and 24-hour room service. Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Antalya? This hotel offers 484 square feet (45 square meters) of space, including conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and free self-parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 25 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi is provided. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature hair dryers and bathrobes. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include Ataturk Boulevard, Hadrian's Gate, Kaleici Museum, and Suna & İnan Kıraç Kaleiçi Museum, all within a short distance. The preferred airport is Antalya International Airport (AYT).

181656.description: Boasting a prime location in the lovely small town of Kemer, a seaside resort and district of Antalya province on the Mediterranean coast of Turkey, this hotel is situated on the main street and is housed in a building with a covered street arcade and shops on the ground floor. Guests will find a public beach just an 8-minute walk. The guest rooms have been nicely decorated in a simple manner with a touch of elegance, featuring soothing tones and a relaxing ambience. As for the facilities, there is a shaded restaurant terrace where guests might enjoy delicious local specialities and an outdoor pool, ideal for a cool dip in the warm afternoons.

181720.description: This modern hostel is situated only 2 km from the city center, well located to enjoy the town's attractions and activities and it is in the vicinity of popular city attractions such as Skatehalle Berlin, Frankfurter Tor, Samariterstraße Railway Stations and 6 km from the Berlin Wall Memorial. This is the ideal place to appreciate the bustling German capital. This extablishment features a relaxed bar were guests can enjoy a nice beverage, a TV lounge and a game room. There's also a dining area were nice meals can be enjoyed and a meeting room for the business travellers. Simple mixed-gender dorms and private rooms feature Wi-Fi, bunk beds and some rooms have shared bathrooms, while upgraded rooms have en suite facilities.

181748.address: Avinguda Del Marques De L Argentera, 4
181748.description: This stunning hotel enjoys a delightful setting at the heart of the Gothic district in Barcelona. The hotel is located just 300 metres from Santa Maria del Mar Church, Ciutadella Park and Barceloneta Metro Station. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from the seaside promenade area of Passeig de Joan de Borbo, and within easy access of most of the city's attractions, shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. This delightful hotel greets guests with the promise of unbridled luxury and charm. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, and come complete with modern amenities. Guests will be impressed by the exemplary facilities that this sumptuous hotel has to offer.

181753.description: Bathed in the rich culture and history of the city, this delightful hotel enjoys an enviable setting in the Plaka district of Athens. Guests will find themselves within easy reach of the myriad of attractions that this captivating city has to offer. The hotel enjoys a privileged setting, commanding spectacular views over the city and the Acropolis. The hotel offers guests the ideal setting from which to experience the culture surrounding them. This delightful hotel greets guests with charm and warm hospitality. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, featuring modern amenities and a relaxing setting. Guests will appreciate the exemplary services and facilities that the hotel has to offer.

181768.address: Abdel Hamid Badawy St, Po Box 114 Rawda Alsheraton
181768.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of the hotel's recreational amenities, including a health club, outdoor pool, and spa tub. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. A complimentary shuttle provides access to nearby shops. Savor international cuisine at MIX, one of the two onsite restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (6:00 AM to 10:30 AM) for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Cairo? This hotel offers 7, 502 square feet (697 square meters) of conference space and meeting rooms. An airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Retreat to one of the 427 guestrooms featuring fireplaces and plasma televisions. Your Select Comfort bed includes down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Enjoy complimentary wireless internet access and satellite programming. Conveniences include safes, coffee/tea makers, and daily housekeeping. Nearby attractions include: City Centre Almaza Shopping Mall (2. 8 mi), Tivoli Dome (4. 2 mi), St. Mark's Coptic Orthodox Church (4. 6 mi), Baron Empain Palace (5. 1 mi), City Center Shopping Mall (5. 2 mi), City Stars (5. 3 mi), Cairo International Stadium (6. 3 mi), Sayyed Zeinab Cultural Park (6. 7 mi), and Virgin Mary's Tree (6. 7 mi).

181778.address: Near Holy Spirit Hospital, Mahakali Caves Road, -
181778.description: This delightful hotel enjoys a convenient setting in the hub of commerce and trade in the suburbs of Mumbai. The hotel is situated on the Mahakali Caves Road in Andheri. The hotel is easily accessible from the airport, Western Express Highway and is within easy access of the railway station of Andheri. The hotel offers ease of access to the city's landmarks and attractions, making it the perfect choice for business and leisure travellers alike. Guests will be pleasantly surprised by the hotel's playful, chic design, warm hospitality and dedicated service. The rooms offer the perfect sanctuary in which guests can relax and unwind away from the stress of daily life. The guest rooms come well equipped with modern amenities while the hotel provides a gym and a meeting room.

name.content: Hotel Swiss Chocolate by Fassbind Zurich

181849.description: The Swiss Chocolate Hotel by Fassbind, newly built in 2021, offers a delightful Zurich experience. Inspired by the rich history of Swiss chocolate, from cacao farm to finished bar, the hotel's architecture and decor immerse guests in this sweet legacy. Enjoy the decadent chocolate fountain in the lobby. Located just 300 meters from the main train station and close to public transport, the hotel provides easy access to the city's attractions, shopping, dining, and entertainment. Overlooking Zurich, this design hotel welcomes guests with elegance and luxury. The sumptuously appointed suites offer a stylish and charming retreat.

181967.description: Conveniently located in Amadora’s city center, Hotel Amadora Palace offers rooms with air conditioning and cable TV. Facilities include a 24-hour reception. Lisbon and Sintra are a 15-minute drive away. The rooms of Amadora Palace are decorated with warm, earthy colors and wooden floors. All rooms have a work desk and a private bathroom. Some rooms have a seating area and a balcony. Free Wi-Fi is available in Hotel Amadora Palace’s public areas. The hotel also offers laundry and ironing facilities, rental cars, and fax and photocopying services. Every morning, guests can enjoy a local and international breakfast in Amadora Palace’s breakfast room. The bar offers a selection of refreshing drinks in an intimate setting. The Amadora train stop is a 2-minute walk from Hotel Amadora Palace, and the Queluz National Palace is 1. 7 mi away.

182047.description:
Located in a unique atmosphere surrounded by the magnificent natural beauty of Belek, Titanic Deluxe Golf Belek welcomes its guests with elegantly designed spaces and rich facilities. 

Nestled by the sea and immersed in nature, the property features a 1 km long private beach, where guests can fully enjoy the crystal-clear waters and sunshine of the Mediterranean. The hotel also offers a variety of outdoor swimming pools in different sizes for both adults and children, as well as exciting water slides. 

The rooms, combining luxury and comfort with modern decoration, are thoughtfully designed for guests’ convenience. All rooms are equipped with a minibar, LED TV, central air conditioning, and balconies overlooking the garden. Some rooms also offer stunning river views. 

In addition to the main restaurant serving open buffet delicacies, the hotel features restaurants offering Turkish cuisine, Italian cuisine, and seafood. There are also 6 à la carte restaurants, including a steakhouse, each serving special menus. A children’s buffet is available in the main restaurant. Guests can also enjoy a wide selection of drinks at the bars located throughout the property during the day. 

For relaxation, guests can benefit from the fully equipped SPA center, which offers both indoor and outdoor facilities, including a Turkish bath, sauna, and various massage treatments. A fitness center is also available for those who wish to stay active during their holiday. Furthermore, the hotel offers tennis courts, a grass football field, and a kids’ club with a wide range of entertainment and activities for children. 

The property is located 33 km from Antalya Airport

182048.description: Located directly on the beach at Bogazkent, just eight kilometres from Belek, this stunning hotel consists of a complex of seven buildings with panoramic lifts occupying 40, 000 square metres of land. The hotel features modern décor in its spacious lobby and elegant lobby bar, There is an in-house buffet restaurant in addition to several a la carte restaurants for guests to choose from. Guests can enjoy shopping at the shopping arcade, relax in the spa and hold meetings or workshops in the fully-equipped conference facilities. The sprawling outdoor complex includes a sparkling outdoor pool and a children's pool with waterslides as well as a private beach. For golf enthusiasts, the nearest course is only 3. 5 kilometres away, and with public transport close to the hotel, it is easy to get around.

182049.description: This delightful hotel enjoys a prime setting, lying at the heart of the resort of Kemer. Guests will find themselves within easy walking distance of the beach, and in the ideal location from which to explore the cultural and historical splendour of the area. The main shopping street is located just 50 metres away from the hotel. This charming hotel extends a warm welcome to guests upon arrival. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated, featuring a simplistic design and a refreshing ambience. Guests can take advantage of the recreational and leisure facilities that the hotel has to offer. This hotel is the ideal option for those eager to explore the delights of Kemer.

182091.description: This charming small, cosy hotel is located in the heart of Venice, just 150 metres from the Basilica San Marco and the famous Square. It is set in a historic building and has been managed from the Perut family for generations. The wooden beams on the ceiling of the breakfast room and lounge are all easily visible and remind its guests of the long history and the authentic charm of the venue. They can start their day with the hearty breakfast or enjoy a strong espresso that will prepare them for the excitement and adventures that await. There is a WiFi internet access throughout and all of the simply decorated rooms are air-conditioned.

182092.description: This hotel enjoys a charming setting in Venice, on Via Garibaldi. The hotel is located just a short walking distance away from Venice Biennale and St. Mark's Square. The hotel enjoys a prime location, from which to explore and experience the rich culture and history of this magnificent city. The hotel enjoys a typical Venetian design, featuring elegantly-appointed interiors, rich in classical charm and refined luxury. The guest rooms are stunningly designed, oozing character and poise. The hotel features a private wharf, and enjoys breath-taking views over the lagoon. Guests can avail of the hotel's excellent facilities and services.

182093.description: This hotel is located just a 2 minutes' walking distance from the spectacular St. Marco Square in Venice. Guests will find themselves in the perfect setting from which to explore the wonder and splendour that this mesmerising city has to offer. The hotel is ideally located in close proximity to the host of attractions in the city. Guests will be impressed by the rustic charm of the hotel, which blends effortlessly with its culturally-rich surroundings. This heritage hotel beautifully embraces the history of its surroundings in its decor, exuding elegance and charm. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, providing a relaxing setting in which to unwind at the end of the day. This hotel is the perfect choice for those who are eager to experience the rich culture and history of Venice.

name.content: The Mornington Victor Hotel London Belgravia

182130.description: Reopening after a two-million-pound complete refurbishment the Victor Hotel London Belgravia is the essence of Victorian elegance in the heart of London. Offering elegant 4-star boutique accommodation that combines modern luxuries with Victorian charm. Located moments from London Victoria Station and Buckingham Palace the Victor Hotel London Belgravia is ideally located for sightseeing, shopping trips and business with a twist. To create a sense of luxury and tranquillity the room features luxurious Rituals Toiletries, high quality cotton linen and memory foam toppers on Hypnos Mattresses. Our fully refurbished rooms offer a wide variety bedding configurations to suit all types of traveller. All rooms are equipped with Air Conditioning, Complimentary High-Speed Wi-Fi, Laptop Safe, Tea & Coffee making facilities, 43-inch Flat Screen TV, iron centres, and hairdryers.

182217.description: This complex enjoys a charming setting in Barcelona, sitting in the popular Rambla Catalunya area of the city. The complex is situated just 150 metres from Passeig de Gracia and 400 metres from Plaza Catalunya. Guests will find themselves in the ideal setting from which to explore the captivating attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. Guests can explore the city with ease, as well as the delightful entertainment venues, shopping opportunities and dining options that it has to offer. This delightful complex greets guests with elegance and charm, bathing them in the rich culture and history of the surroundings. The apartments are superbly appointed, providing the ideal setting in which to relax and unwind at the end of the day. Guests will experience the ultimate comfort and convenience at this complex.

182229.description: Ideally situated between the Duomo and Castello Sforzesco, Cusani Milano is perfect for exploring Milan's historic centre. With its modern, spacious bedrooms and suites, renowned restaurant, meeting and business facilities and fully equipped fitness room, UNAHOTELS Cusani Milano promises its guests a refined and comfortable stay filled with Italian charm and luxury. A family hotel in the very centre of Milan, this establishment is close to many places of interest. There are three theatres in the immediate vicinity and guests will also be able to shop around in the local mall, which is 800 metres down the road. When guests are not visiting the sights of Milan, they can watch satellite TV in the comfort of their own air-conditioned rooms, or use the Internet/Wi-Fi facilities (for a small fee), or enjoy a meal at the restaurant or a drink in the lounge. Breakfast is free of charge. The accommodations in this 92-room hotel all offer air-conditioning, telephone, coffee/tea maker and a minibar. If easy-access services for the disabled are required, it should be specified on the booking application form, in the section 'travel preferences'. The 24-hour reception service also has a safe for valuables. A dry-cleaning service is also available.

182348.description: Discover the wonders of Amsterdam with a stay at the Leonardo Hotel Amsterdam Rembrandtpark. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi in all rooms, along with amenities such as a fireplace, gift shop, and postal and taxi services. Comfortable guest rooms ensure a restful night's sleep, and some rooms also include LCD/plasma TVs, free Wi-Fi, non-smoking options, air conditioning, and heating. Unwind after a busy day in the fitness center or sauna. Experience reliable service and a professional staff. Enjoy our delicious breakfast with stunning city views on the 17th floor for only €21. 50. The Leonardo Hotel Amsterdam Rembrandtpark caters to all your needs.

182387.description: Nestled in the charming village of Vidago, renowned for its prestigious thermal waters, the Primavera Perfume Hotel is surrounded by lush greenery, imbued with the soft scents of spring. A haven of comfort and elegance, the hotel offers 32 rooms and spaces for conferences and weddings. Experience unforgettable moments crafted by a dedicated team passionate about innovation and excellence, and savor the flavors of the Trás-os-Montes region.

182407.description: Hotel Muisca offers a unique space for you to experience firsthand the culture, tradition and history of Bogotá. Located in the historic center of the city, La Candelaria, 16 kilometers from El Dorado airport and 800 meters from the Transmilenio Las Aguas station. In addition, airport pick-up service can be booked for an additional charge. The hotel offers ecological heating, Wifi and flat screen TV. Guests can relax on the terrace or make use of the sauna, as well as enjoy massage sessions on request. The Gold Museum, the Gabriel García Márquez Cultural Center, the Luis Ángel Arango Library, among others, are less than 900 meters away.

182448.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as bicycle rentals, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel offers 39 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, satellite programming, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Safes and daily housekeeping are provided, and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. Located in the heart of Vienna, Hotel Am Schubertring is within a 10-minute walk of the Vienna State Opera and Belvedere, and a short distance from other key attractions like Albertina and Hofburg Imperial Palace. The nearest major airport is Vienna International Airport (VIE).

182461.description: The Milan Suite Hotel, conveniently located near Milan's main exhibition centers (Fieramilano Rho, Fieramilanocity, and MiCo Congress Center), offers easy access to the city's major highways. This 4-star hotel distinguishes itself as Milan's first luxury urban Asian-style hotel. It features 38 prestigious junior suites and two spacious 70-square-meter suites. Each room provides a comfortable living area, sofas, Mediaset Premium pay TV, free Wi-Fi, a hot water kettle with complimentary tea and coffee, and a bathroom with both a bathtub and shower. Espresso machines and microwave ovens are available upon request. Parking is €15. 00 per night, payable at the hotel. Pets are welcome for a €30. 00 sanitization fee per stay (excluding Naked Rooms). Complimentary amenities for dogs and cats, subject to availability, include a doggy lounge, a water-repellent quilt, and two bowls with a non-slip mat.

182467.description: The Apartments offer well-equipped, modern accommodation 5 minutes' walking from Gran Vía. It is within 600 metres of Noviciado Metro Station and Plaza de España. Each spacious, air-conditioned apartment, loft and studio has simple, attractive décor. Shops, bars and cafés can be found in the streets surrounding the San Bernando. The lively Puerta del Sol is a 15-minute walk away. The Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen-Bornemisza museums are just 5 stops from Noviciados Station. Atocha Railway Station is 6 stops away.

182573.description: Beautifully situated at the heart of the historical city of Lisbon, this delightful apartment complex is ideally positioned for visitors to enjoy ease of access to the main attractions of the city. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to Camoes Square, Santa Justa Elevator and Rossio Square, as well as the captivating Sao Jorge Castle and Lisbon Cathedral. This stunning complex welcomes guests with the promise of a luxurious home away from home. The apartments are sumptuously appointed, featuring a mix of neutral and pastel tones for a relaxing environment. The apartments offer comfort and convenience, featuring a host of excellent amenities. Guests will be impressed by the relaxing, memorable experience they are sure to encounter at this complex.

182587.description: The hotel is located in the Yenikapi district, just 2km from the historical attractions at Sultanahmet and 400m from Yenikapi ferryboat station. Shops, cafes and restaurants can be found within 500m of the establishment and local transport links are available within 140m. Opened in 2012, this 34-room hotel offers attractive, comfortable accommodation with a daily buffet breakfast in the terrace restaurant which has magnificent views of the Marmara Sea. Additionally, there is a lobby lounge bar where guests can enjoy refreshments in relaxing settings. There is Internet access available for those who wish to stay connected. The hotel also offers room and laundry services.

182656.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including a sauna, a fitness center, and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this aparthotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and shopping on site. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Berlin? This aparthotel has 1292 square feet (120 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 80 guestrooms, featuring kitchens with refrigerators and stovetops. 50-cm flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

182666.description: This simple budget hotel is located a 15-minute walk from Père Lachaise. Metro Station Porte de Montreuil is directly outside the hotel and offers convenient access to The Eiffel Tower and the Galeries Lafayette department store which are 13. 7 km away. All guestrooms at this cosy city hotel are en-suite and simply furnished. In-room entertainment is provided through a TV with satellite channels. Guests traveling on corporate errands can make use of the hotel's business centre which offers a wireless Internet connection. Visitors arriving by car can leave their vehicle at a public parking near the property.

182671.description: With a total of 6 guest rooms, this is a nice place to stay. The establishment offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Guests can enjoy the convenience of 24-hour reception. All guests staying at this property can enjoy delightful dishes at its dining venue. Guests may appreciate the health and wellness services offered at the establishment. Some services may be payable.

182678.description: This design hotel boasts a privileged position in the most elegant and exclusive district in Paris, having art galleries, luxurious boutiques and attractions like Arc de Triomphe a few steps away. The hotel’s rooms are decorated in the finest Art Deco style, featuring refined, exotic and precious materials including Macassar Ebony, oriental green Jade and pitch black granite. Guests can enjoy a drink at the bar with its comfortable sofas and armchairs providing a cosy atmosphere. The hotel's restaurant offers traditional Parisian brasserie-style cuisine as well as international dishes. The velvet armchairs and black granite decor complete the Art Deco style of this Paris restaurant, which also features 3 terraces. Business guests and chic locals can savour the international cuisine with an Asian twist which is served, as well as enjoying water and wine from the restaurant's own house brand.

182741.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool and a sauna. This Victorian hotel also features concierge services, wedding services, and a fireplace in the lobby. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 27 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators. Your bed comes with premium bedding, and all rooms are furnished with sofa beds.

182748.description: Located at a rare spot in Kharghar, Navi Mumbai and about 40 km from the Mumbai International Airport. This 5 star luxury hotel reinvents the grandeur of international hospitality with local flavours. Built to capture the essence of Navi Mumbai's rich and diversified culture, the hotel stands tall on its architectural features and demonstrates a fine blend of European and Indian sensibilities. The distinctive 2 giant towers that dominate the façade are perhaps the most prominent feature of this luxury hotel. The property has elegant and luxurious facilities with a deluxe level of comfort and personal service. Supremely appointed with signature offerings, the hotel features 97 rooms. Each room exudes an ambience that is steeped in rich classical décor and includes floor to ceiling windows, spacious vanities, private shower with rain showerhead, Onmisens and Bvlgari Amenities, complimentary high-speed wired and wireless Internet access, speaker phones with private voicemail, twice-daily housekeeping service including nightly second service, fully-stocked refreshment centre with refrigerator, plush terry bathrobes, electronic in-room laptop safes, full-size ironing board, iron and slippers. Non-smoking floors are available. This luxury hotel also features a Presidential Suite that recreates the splendor of Royal Ashoka Dynasty.

182768.description: The hotel is a suitable accommodation for those wishing to be centrally located in the city with easy access to the Kaleici (Inner Bailey) area and the wide range of shops, bars and restaurants nearby. Konyaalti Beach is approximately 3 km away and guests can join the local Beach Clubs for sports and entertainment activities. The establishment is a modern city hotel offering comfortable accommodation in a convenient location. Facilities include a restaurant, lobby and small, ground floor front terrace, as well as free WiFi access. The hotel also has a SPA, consisting of a sauna, Turkish bath and steam bath. Massage treatments are also available. A breakfast buffet is served and evening meal can be selected from a set menu.

182769.address: Yamanevler Mah. Site Yolu Cad. No 20 Umraniye, 20
182769.description: The 4-star Mercure Umraniye Hotel is located in Istanbul's financial district, with easy access to numerous shopping malls. Modernly decorated rooms feature en suite bathrooms, minibars, safes, LCD TVs, and 24-hour room service. The hotel also boasts a restaurant serving international cuisine, a bar, and a spa with an indoor pool, sauna, and massage rooms. Complimentary outdoor parking is available for hotel guests.

182792.description: Art galleries, cobbled streets, arts venues, fashion boutiques, Georgian houses, cocktail bars, Cathedrals*, craft fairs, and book shops. Our beautiful aparthotel is located in Edinburgh’s eclectic West End. This is where theatres and arts venues brush up next to fashion boutiques and cocktail bars. Haymarket train station is just down the road and the city centre is a 10 minute walk away. You’ll find a great selection of restaurants, bars and cafes within a few minutes' walk of the property, ask our friendly team at reception for their recommendations - they’re always on hand to help. *Head to St Mary’s Episcopal Cathedral to see a rainbow of dazzling lights when the sun hits the magnificent Paolozzi Window. PLEASE NOTE: Stag / Hen parties are not permitted under any circumstance Check in may be refused and refunds not permitted

182814.address: Kısalar Mah, Merkez Sokak No:93/1 Manavgat, 19
182814.description: Located in Side, Ramada Resort Side is a perfect starting point from which to explore Manavgat. Featuring a complete list of amenities, guests will find their stay at the property a comfortable one. All the necessary facilities, including 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, convenience store, infirmary, are at hand. All rooms are designed and decorated to make guests feel right at home, and some rooms come with television LCD/plasma screen, bathroom phone, cleaning products, clothes rack, free welcome drink. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include canoe, dart board, watersports equipment rentals, wind surfing, surfing lessons. Ramada Resort Side is an excellent choice from which to explore Manavgat or to simply relax and rejuvenate.

182857.description: The nyma, a new boutique hotel in Manhattan's vibrant Koreatown, offers a prime location on 32nd Street between Fifth Avenue and Broadway. Steps from iconic landmarks like the Empire State Building and Macy's, and convenient to Penn Station and Madison Square Garden, it's ideal for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel boasts a bright, spacious lobby with Wi-Fi, a 24-hour business center, and full concierge services. Pet lovers rejoice – nyma is now 100% pet-friendly!

182873.description: This hotel is ideally placed in the heart of Marrakech, a 5-minute walk from the Jamaâ El Fna Square. It is set within a traditional Moroccan building, but it offers contemporary rooms and accommodations featuring modern amenities. Each of the guest rooms is uniquely decorated and includes air conditioning, free Wi-Fi and a private bathroom. The hotel serves a daily breakfast while snacks and meals are available upon request. Guests can relax with a drink on the rooftop terrace overlooking the Atlas Mountains or work on their tan in the solarium. The hotel also provides an airport shuttle service.

182967.description:
Suites del Bosque hotel has an incredible location at the exclusive district of San Isidro. The hotel is located from a walking distance of the most important financial center of the city and the places of cultural interest. Guests will be very close to the emblematic and important “El Olivar” forest park with a large number of restaurants, shops and places of great interest. 
Suites del Bosque Hotel welcomes guests with great warmth and harmony in its decoration, the hotel offers the perfect setting to rest or work in comfort. We have Junior Suites, Executive Suites, Connecting Suites. 
At “Los Cristales” Cafeteria, you can enjoy from Monday to Sunday our Breakfast opened from 07:00 to 10:30 am.

182978.description: Located in the heart of Palermo, a charming and elegant neighborhood, this hotel offers guests a unique experience. Surrounded by lush parks and gardens, it boasts proximity to Santa Fe Avenue, various shopping malls, and the city's best international cuisine. The hotel's design blends modern architecture with technology and art, reflecting an environmentally conscious approach. Its dedicated staff provides personalized service tailored to discerning business travelers and tourists alike, anticipating individual needs and ensuring a memorable stay.

183010.description: Nestled on the shores of Isla Mujeres in the idyllic Mexican Caribbean, this family-run hotel offers a welcoming retreat. A short walk from the vibrant city center, with its bustling social scene and convenient grocery stores, the hotel provides easy access to the island's cultural heart. Just 30km from the airport, this 20-room gem boasts a vibrant, colorful decor, promising an unforgettable stay. Whether you're eager to explore the underwater wonders of the national reef sanctuary or embark on a once-in-a-lifetime swim with whale sharks, Isla Mujeres offers an array of captivating experiences. Known for its safe and tranquil atmosphere, the island is an ideal destination for families and travelers seeking relaxation.

183012.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at the Musik Boutique Hotel, centrally located in Barcelona. Borrow bicycles to explore the city or relax with room service (limited hours). A café and bar/lounge offer dining and drinks. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The 23 air-conditioned rooms feature iPod docks, minibars, memory foam beds with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets, and 26-inch plasma TVs with satellite programming. Private bathrooms include designer toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel is a short walk from Palau de la Música Catalana, Barcelona Cathedral, La Rambla, and Plaça de Catalunya. Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) is 10. 5 miles away.

183013.description: Retropera Hotel is located in a quiet street in the heart of Istanbul, just a 3-minute walk from Taksim Square and Taksim Metro Station. With its boutique style and cozy atmosphere, the hotel offers comfortable rooms with air conditioning and free WiFi. Simply and tastefully decorated, the rooms feature parquet floors and include an LCD TV, mini-bar and an electric kettle, providing everything needed for a pleasant stay. Thanks to its central location, guests can easily find numerous cafés and restaurants serving local and international cuisine within walking distance of the hotel. The lively Istiklal Avenue is only 984 feet away, offering a wide range of shops, cafés, bars and cultural venues. Historic attractions such as Sultanahmet are easily accessible by public transport or a short drive. Combining a peaceful setting with a central location, Retropera Hotel is an ideal choice for travelers looking for an affordable and convenient stay near Taksim.

183030.description: This residential hotel is located in the Beyoglu district of Istanbul within 350m of Galata Tower and 750m of Galata Bridge which crosses the Golden Horn. Cultural facilities, shopping and entertainment venues are all nearby and the Tunel tram stop is a 3-minute walk. All local attractions are easily accessible through public transport. Dating from the distant 1920s, the residences are two adjacent buildings from the Pera period, restored into thirteen luxury serviced apartments. All of the luxurious accommodation units are fitted with a full kitchen featuring modern equipment, spacious living and sleeping areas and a stylish en suite bathroom.

183049.description: This hotel is located in one of the oldest districts of Marrakech's medina, a 15-minutes' walk from Jamaâ El Fna Square. The establishment comprises 9 traditionally decorated suites, all equipped with en suite bathrooms. Guestrooms are decorated with zellige tiles and offer a seating area. A swimming pool is at guest's disposal and free Wi-Fi is provided on the premises. Guests can enjoy Moroccan cuisine at the on-site restaurant, and relax on the beautiful, large outdoor terrace. Additional amenities include a lounge and a shuttle service to the airport. For those who would like to explore the area, guided tours can be arranged on site.

183069.description: This hotel enjoys a strategic setting on rue de Acacias. Guests will find themselves in the perfect setting from which to explore the attractions and key points of interest that the area has to offer. The hotel is situated within easy driving distance of a host of local interest points. This charming hotel enjoys a delightful architectural style, and welcomes guests with the promise of excellent service and an enjoyable stay. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, and provide a relaxing setting in which to completely unwind. The hotel offers a range of excellent facilities, catering to the needs of every type of traveller. For an unforgettable stay, this hotel is the only choice.

183148.description: Just a couple of minutes' walk from Taksim Square, this hotel is well placed for business, entertainment and cultural tourism in the city. Public transport links to most areas of the city are available in the square. Suitable for business and leisure guests alike, this city hotel offers comfortable accommodation featuring modern technology. Facilities include a bar and a breakfast room where guests can enjoy a refreshing drink or meal. A small meeting room and free WiFi access are available to guests on business trips. The standard rooms measure 17 sqm and are equipped with air-conditioning and heating, among other modern amenities.

name.content: The Grand Tarabya, Managed By Accor

183149.address: Tarabya Mahallesi Haydar Aliyev Caddesi No:154
183149.description: The Grand Tarabya Hotel offers unique indoor and outdoor venues with natural daylight, ideal for unforgettable events and meetings overlooking the Bosphorus. With 12 floors of luxury and elegance, the hotel features 177 deluxe guest rooms, 70 suites, a presidential suite, and 29 fully serviced residences, all designed for discerning guests seeking the highest level of comfort and service. The residences are also ideal for extended stays.

183172.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at TOWNHOUSE Berlin, a boutique aparthotel in Berlin's Charlottenburg district, within a 15-minute walk of the Zoo and Kurfürstendamm. Make yourself at home in one of the 47 guestrooms featuring kitchens, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Take advantage of the fitness center, relax on the terrace and garden, and enjoy a meal at the on-site Bistro or via room service. Continental breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The aparthotel also provides concierge services and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Tiergarten Park, the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, and Europa Center.

183194.description: Conveniently located opposite Victoria Station, the DoubleTree by Hilton London - Victoria provides its guests with immediate access to public transportation and points of interest. Major attractions, such as Westminster Abbey, the Houses of Parliament, Soho, and Trafalgar Square, are within walking distance. Victoria station is the departure point for the Orient Express. With beautiful guest rooms and suites, the DoubleTree by Hilton London - Victoria embodies 4-star comfort with a full concierge service and wireless internet access throughout the hotel. After returning from a day of shopping and sightseeing, guests will find unlimited opportunities to unwind and recharge. We’re only 30 minutes from London’s Heathrow airport, and Gatwick airport is easily accessible by the Gatwick Express. Our guests have use of many amenities including our restaurant, bar, and business center. Enjoy cocktails in our chic bar, or dine on international cuisine at the restaurant, Terminus Kitchen and Bar. Whether business or leisure brings you to London Victoria our staff look forward to welcoming you with our signature, warm DoubleTree Chocolate Chip Cookie at check in.

183207.description: The hotel boasts a beautiful location; it is located on the Mediterranean Coast between the resorts of Side and Alanya and 1 km from the town of Okucalar. A shopping bazaar is within 1 km of the hotel and public transport runs on the main road, 600 metres away. The hotel consists of a five floor main building and a 3-floor annexe. The spacious grounds house the outdoor pool and sunbathing terrace, and lead down to the beach. The rooms are pleasantly furnished with laminated flooring and equipped with a TV, air-conditioning and safe box among other amenities. Guests can enjoy the hotel's Turkish bath and sauna or take advantage of the massage treatments offered on site. For those seeking something a little more strenuous there is a gym, table tennis, darts and some organised animation. Extraordinary views and picturesque beaches provide the beautiful setting at the hotel where people can really escape.
