The perfect choice for any vacation, the resort boasts spectacular beaches, outstanding service, and thrilling activities. It is a place where nature meets comfort.

183210.address: Gündoğdu, Manavgat/Manavgat Antalya TR, 60. Sok, No:4
183210.description: Sitting just 500 metres from the sea in Side, this charming resort offer guests an idyllic setting in which to completely relax and unwind. The resort is located just 12 km from the vibrant town of Side, while a host of attractions can be found in the area. The charming resort hotel boasts a striking architectural style, greeting guests with the promise of an unforgettable stay. The interiors are sumptuously appointed, featuring soothing crisp white and turquoise tones, reflecting the splendour of its seaside surroundings. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, offering a serene environment in which to completely relax and unwind away from the rest of the world. The resort offers a wide range of excellent facilities, catering to the needs of every type of traveller.

183249.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 3 outdoor swimming pools, a nightclub, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Grab a bite at one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 27 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and espresso makers. 32-inch LCD televisions and DVD players are provided, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Bathrooms have hair dryers and bathrobes. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and complimentary newspapers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. 183272.description: Nestled in the heart of Santiago, Hotel Loreto offers guests unparalleled access to the city's historical, cultural, and culinary attractions. Just steps from the vibrant Bellavista district, the hotel reflects Chile's rich identity and commitment to environmental protection through its innovative sustainable energy project. Guests can easily walk to iconic landmarks such as the Palacio de la Moneda, Plaza de Armas, and numerous national museums. The hotel's comfortable, fully equipped rooms offer natural light and courtyard views. Guests can also enjoy common areas and a terrace boasting panoramic city views.

183273.address: Blvd. Kukulcan Km. 14.5 Retorno del Rey, Lot 38 +, 18 5
183273.description: This adults-only hotel offers unlimited luxury in 497 comfortable suites with breathtaking views. Located on the Yucatan Peninsula coast, just a short distance from a world-renowned beach and Cancun's hotel zone, it provides the perfect setting for relaxation and rejuvenation. The hotel is conveniently located near the airport and offers easy access to dining, shopping, entertainment, and is ideal for events and conferences. Guests can enjoy the splendor and grace of this charming hotel, which captures the essence of its stunning natural surroundings. Luxuriously appointed guest rooms offer a peaceful and serene retreat. With unparalleled comfort and convenience, the hotel boasts an array of first-class facilities. Expert wedding and event planning services are available. This is a non-smoking hotel.

183348.description: Located in the heart of Madrid's Centro district, Ok Hostel Madrid is within a 15-minute walk of Plaza Mayor and Puerta del Sol. This hostel is a short distance from attractions such as Gran Via Street (1. 2 km) and the Royal Palace of Madrid (1 km). Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and convenient tour/ticket assistance. The hostel offers 44 comfortable guestrooms with free Wi-Fi, desks, and daily housekeeping. Irons and ironing boards are available upon request. Dine at the on-site restaurant, grab a snack at the deli, or enjoy a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is served daily (8:00 AM - 10:30 AM, for a fee). Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage.

183349.description: The apartments are located in the heart of Madrid. The neighbourhood where they are located is quiet and safe, but with all the amenities at guests' disposal to make their stay more enjoyable. The Puerta de Alcalá and Retiro Park are 10 minutes away. Malls and designer shops are within just 5 minutes. Each apartment has its own kitchen. They include air conditioning, television and bathroom. It has a cafeteria where guests can enjoy a drink or a snack, and a buffet breakfast is served each morning.

183407.description: Citadines Metro Central Dubai expertly handles guest needs with professionalism and care. Ideally located in Barsha Heights, adjacent to the Dubai Internet City Metro Station, we offer convenient access to key areas such as Dubai Marina, DIFC, the World Trade Centre, and the Dubai International Convention and Exhibition Centre. Our aparthotel is part of The Ascott Limited's premier collection, a global leader in serviced residences.

183409.description: Enjoying a peaceful setting in a quiet neighbourhood close to Plaza de Alonso Martinez, this delightful hotel offers guests a great location. The hotel is situated within easy access of a number of the area's main attractions, including the Plaza de Colon and the National Library. This charming hotel greets guests with charm and warm hospitality, welcoming them into the serene environment of the lobby. The guest studios are superbly appointed, featuring modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests will appreciate the exemplary facilities that this charming hotel has to offer, and are assured of a comfortable stay.

183412.address: 7 ,Rue Dar El Bacha - Sidi Ali Tair, 7
183412.description: Located in the heart of Marrakech's Medina, Riad Alida offers a tranquil escape just a 15-minute walk from Jemaa el-Fnaa and Le Jardin Secret. This riad boasts an outdoor and indoor pool, a full-service spa, and an on-site restaurant with room service. Each of the 7 guestrooms features complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and a private bathroom. Additional amenities include airport transfers (surcharge), dry cleaning, and a 24-hour front desk.

183417.address: Al Urubah Rd, Al Olaya, Riyadh 12333
183417.description: Nestled in the heart of Riyadh, this luxurious hotel offers an ideal base for exploring the city's cultural and historical attractions, including the nearby Al Faisaliah shopping center. Guests will appreciate the stylish accommodations, exceptional facilities, and commitment to comfort and convenience. Spacious rooms feature coffee/tea making facilities and well-stocked minibars, ensuring a memorable stay.

183473.description: Nestled in the greenery of Olgiate Olona, this modern hotel is just 15 km from Milan Malpensa Airport and a 30-minute drive from Milan. Each room features air conditioning, a private bathroom, Wi-Fi, and a TV with international channels. Guests can enjoy the on-site wellness center, complete with a heated hydromassage pool, sauna, Turkish bath, and Kneipp path, and dine in the restaurant, which offers a continental breakfast buffet and an à la carte dinner menu. The fully renovated spa is available to adults 17 and older and offers a two-hour experience (reservation and fee required), with massages and treatments also bookable for an additional charge. Parking is also available.

183483.description: The 3-star Ezdan Residences offers comfort and convenience whether you're on business or holiday in Doha. The hotel offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, convenience store, fireplace are there for guest's enjoyment. Each guestroom is elegantly furnished and equipped with handy amenities. Take a break from a long day and make use of hot tub, fitness center, sauna, outdoor pool, spa. A welcoming atmosphere and excellent service are what you can expect during your stay at Ezdan Residences.

183508.description: The Corendon Grand Park Lara hotel, nestled in Lara, Antalya, a prime Mediterranean holiday destination, offers a unique vacation experience. Located just 14 km from Antalya Airport and 16 km from Antalya city center, this modern hotel features 896 comfortable rooms with sea, garden, or street views. Catering to both holidaymakers and business travelers, the Corendon Grand Park Lara and its welcoming team strive to make every guest feel at home.

183509.description: This small, family-run hotel is located on the Mediterranean coast in the resort of Kemer, 45 kilometres west of the city of Antalya. The public beach is approximately a ten-minute walk away while shops, restaurants and cafe bars are all in close proximity to the hotel. The hotel boasts a relaxed atmosphere and personal service. Guests might go for a refreshing swim in the outdoor pool and sip a drink in the bar after a long day of exploring the area, then enjoy dinner in the onsite restaurant.

183596.description: This hotel is centrally located in the Eastern suburb of Mumbai. Guests will find themselves within easy driving distance of the airport, as well as the main business districts of the Bandra Kurla Complex and the JNPT area. This charming hotel is situated in close proximity to the main attractions that the area has to offer. This charming hotel boasts a striking architectural style, designed by the famous architects Somaya and Kallappa. This luxurious hotel comprises sumptuously-appointed guest rooms, which provide a cocoon of peace and serenity in which to completely unwind. Guests will be impressed by the first-class facilities that this stunning hotel has to offer, and are assured of a truly memorable stay.

183616.description:
Located in the heart of Guéliz, one of the most beautiful districts of Marrakech, Riad Mazal is a guest house with a privileged location and elegant accommodation near the Majorelle garden with the new museum dedicated to Yves Saint-Laurent, it provides you with free secure parking on site. 

 Riad Mazal offers air-conditioned and elegantly decorated rooms including a minibar with satellite TV. Equipped with coloured tiles, their private bathroom is equipped with a shower or bathrobes and a hair dryer and free toiletries. Each room has been decorated to create a warm atmosphere. Wi-Fi connection is provided free of charge throughout the hotel.
 Surrounded by many typical Moroccan and international restaurants, New shopping centres, modern, Marrakech plaza, and not far from Jamaâ El Fna Square, 10 minutes by car or taxi.

. For your relaxation, the hotel has an outdoor swimming pool and hammam, massages (on request) and a solarium with a magnificent view of the Atlas Mountains. Traditional dishes 100% Moroccan can be prepared on request by the head of the establishment with fresh market produce. Served on the terrace or in one of the common rooms, near the fireplace.
Riad Mazal offers you an unforgettable stay with friends or family with exceptional qualities and services.

183702.description: The Ibis Milano Malpensa hotel is a few kilometers from the airport and has a shuttle service to/from Malpensa (for a fee and at defined times, T1 arrivals gate 10, T2 on request). Four meeting rooms make it perfect for conferences and business trips. Free WiFi. Breakfast buffet from 6:30, bar open 24/7, Ibis Kitchen restaurant open every evening. Free outdoor parking, private indoor parking for a fee.

name.content: Mount Royal Edinburgh by The Unlimited Collection

183705.description:
Discover the true beauty of Scotland's capital at Mount Royal Edinburgh by The Unlimited Collection. This stylish 4-star destination provides guests with panoramic views of Edinburgh Castle, Old Town and Princes Street Gardens from its central location. After a day of sightseeing, experience a relaxed meal at the in-house Scott's on Princes Street restaurant before retreating to one of our stylish and comfortable rooms for the perfect night's sleep. 

Restaurant Eidyn, located at Mount Royal Hotel Edinburgh on Princes Street, serves modern Scottish cuisine in an elegant setting overlooking Princes Street Gardens. It offers seasonal, locally sourced dishes and signature cocktails with attentive service. 

Edinburgh is a city that knows how to feed the soul and your appetite. From hearty Scottish breakfasts to Michelin-worthy bites, our guests will find a feast of flavours just a short wander from our doorstep. Whether it’s Rose Street’s cosy pubs, George Street’s elegant eateries, or the vibrant mix in the St. James Quarter, there’s something to suit every craving from a full Scottish to a vegan delight! If they are not sure where to start, our cheery reception team are always on hand with maps, directions, and local gems to share from traditional Scottish fare to international flavours.

183788.description: In this elegant hotel, all guest rooms are air-conditioned and equipped with a flat-screen TV and a minibar. Some rooms feature a seating area and overlook the courtyard at Magda Etoile. The hotel features a bar and Wi-Fi. Public parking is available nearby. The Arc de Triomphe is just 350 metres away from the hotel. Charles de Gaulle–Etoile Metro Station is 350 metres away and provides direct access to the Eiffel Tower. The Hotel Royal Magda Etoile has become the Magda Champs Elysees. Fully renovated rooms.

183808.description: This eco-lodge is modern and is a 10 minute walk from Nova Icaria beach and marina. Less than 5 minutes walk are several bars and shops. The Razzmatazz nightclub is 200 meters. The property organizes events, guided tours and activities. The Ciutadella Park is a 10 minute walk and the audience and the National Theatre of Catalonia are within 5 minutes walk.

183891.description: Situated just a 10-minute drive from Heathrow International Airport, this elegant and modern hotel is a perfect choice for business and leisure travellers alike, whether they arrive or depart. Features of the hotel include a 24-hour concierge service, a restaurant, a bar and a gym. The Hounslow and Osterley underground stations are within a short stroll, providing easy access to the centre of London with all its famous attractions.

183898.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestSet just steps from St James's Park, Buckingham Palace, and the Houses of Parliament, Conrad London St. James boasts a prestigious, historic facade and a classic, contemporary interior, which showcases stunning art and locally inspired design. The ideal location connects guests to iconic London landmarks and provides easy access to the City and major conference centres. The hotel's intuitive and personal service appeals to both today's smart luxury travelers and local clientele who came to dine or hold meetings in the inspiring setting. Inside you will find luxurious rooms featuring modern in-room technology and amenities, complete with spacious bathtubs and walk-in showers. Enjoy an elevated style of British cuisine by renowned Chef Sally Abe at The Pem restaurant, before sampling a pint of house draught from Meantime Brewery, or perhaps one of the selections of craft beers, wines and iconic gins in the Blue Boar pub. Savour a quintessentially English afternoon tea in the Orchard room, and enjoy innovative cocktails created by top mixologists in our glamorous cocktail bar The Hedgerow. Energize with the latest equipment in the 24-hour Fitness Center. With over 7000 sq. ft. flexible meeting space, state-of-the-art audio-visual technology and creative food, Conrad London St James is ideal for business events, conferences, and weddings.

183927.description: Located in the Kartal district on the Asian side of Istanbul, this hotel has easy access to Sabiha Gokcen Airport which is only 14 km away. The vicinity has a rapidly growing business district and local amenities are all within close proximity. This 50-room hotel was built in 2012 and offers all standard facilities, such as a 24-hour reception, meeting room, lobby lounge, rooftop terrace and garden terrace where guests can enjoy a quiet drink and free internet access for those who wish to stay connected. The rooms measure between 25-30 sqm and are pleasantly furnished with a carpeted floor and attractive bed linen. All accommodation units are equipped with satellite TV, work desk, and central heating among other useful amenities.

183929.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace and garden at this hotel, which offers complimentary Wi-Fi. Take advantage of convenient amenities such as concierge services, a common area television, and a vending machine. Explore nearby attractions with ease using the area shuttle (surcharge). Dine at the on-site coffee shop/cafe or enjoy 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the daily complimentary reception, or unwind at the bar/lounge. For added convenience, the hotel provides a business center, express check-in/check-out, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge, available 24 hours). Free self-parking is also available. The 16 guestrooms feature minibars, LED TVs with satellite programming, and Tempur-Pedic beds with Egyptian cotton sheets. Bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Located near Little Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet Square, and the Blue Mosque, the hotel is also a short distance from other key attractions. The preferred airport is Istanbul Airport (IST).

name.content: Ramada Plaza By Wyndham Istanbul Ataköy

183930.description: The four-star Ramada Plaza Istanbul Atakoy offers stylish and spacious rooms with stunning views of the Sea of Marmara. Located near Ataturk Airport and Atakoy Marina, it provides easy access to the city. Enjoy amenities such as free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV, in your room. Unwind at the spa and fitness center, complete with a steam room, shower, and sauna. Business travelers will appreciate the business center and meeting rooms. The hotel restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with room service also available.

184033.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages and body treatments. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy international cuisine at Antigoni Rotisserie, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms.

name.content: Hotel Ai Reali - Small Luxury Hotels of the World

184054.description: This elegant hotel is located in the heart of Venice, a short 5-minute walk from Piazza San Marco and 20 minutes from Venice Santa Lucia Train Station. Guests can enjoy their morning espresso at the famed piazza and easily access the city's landmarks. The hotel also features a popular restaurant with a charming furnished garden, offering a tranquil setting to savor authentic Italian cuisine and wines. For relaxation, guests can indulge in the spa or maintain their fitness routine at the gym. Each room showcases antique Venetian-style wooden floors, complemented by period furnishings and modern amenities, creating a seamless blend of classic Venetian elegance and contemporary comfort.

184057.description: Andaz Amsterdam Prinsengracht, set in a former library, is a vibrant blend of Dutch heritage and bold design. Rooms offer canal, garden, and lobby views, all styled by Marcel Wanders. Sip cocktails or savor seasonal dishes at Barstro Prins & Aap, or enjoy refined cuisine at Restaurant Renvy. With 600m² of quirky event space, it’s perfect for creative gatherings. The Essence Spa invites relaxation with tailored treatments. Nestled in the UNESCO canal district, the hotel is steps from Nine Streets, Jordaan, and cultural icons like the Anne Frank House and Museumplein.

184091.address: Kuloglu Mah. Gazeteci Erol Dernek Sok. Beyoglu, 1
184091.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features babysitting (surcharge) and a reception hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 21 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and LED televisions. Your Select Comfort bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

184092.description:
Discover comfort in the heart of Istanbul at ibis Istanbul Sisli. With its central location and easy transport access, it offers a true home away from home. Enjoy spacious rooms with the unique Square design concept, a first in Turkiye. Start your day with a rich open buffet breakfast or relax with premium coffee at the cafe. Steps from Cevahir Mall and close to the metro, perfect for business or leisure stays Experience modern comfort, stylish design, and unbeatable convenience in one place time you stay. 

ibis Istanbul Şişli offers a bar service with a high satisfaction guarantee at Charlie's Corner. 
Light meals can be enjoyed at our on-site restaurant. 24-hour room service is available and
guests can enjoy our special menu tailored to their preferences. 

ibis Istanbul Şişli is located in the area of Şişli, the heart of Istanbul. We are close to the
shopping area and metro station. Cevahir Shopping Mall is a 5-minute walk away. Topkapi
Palace is a 30-minute drive away and Taksim is a 3-minute drive away.

184228.address: Route Du Golf Royal Palmeraie Sud
184228.description: This charming hotel is located in Palmeraie Sud neighberhood in Marrakech, immersing guests in the rich splendour and charm of the surrounding golfs and moutain landscapes. The hotel is situated only 250 metres from the Royal Golf Course of Marrakech, and is nested amidst olive, orange and palm trees. The hotel lies just a 10 minutes' driving distance from Jemaa El Fna Square and 15 from the city centre, while the Agdal Gardens are situated just a 5 minutes' drive away. This hotel greets guests with traditional Moroccan splendour and charm. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, featuring refreshing tones and influences from the area's rich culture. This hotel affords guests access to an array of excellent facilities, catering for the needs of every type of visitor.

184231.description: This luxurious, modern hotel offers the best in traditional Moroccan hospitality just a fifteen minutes' drive from vibrant Jamaa El Fna Square. It enjoys an enviable location in a quiet sector of the city overlooking the Atlas Mountains while remaining in easy reach of the many attractions of this magical city. The spacious rooms and suites are all soundproofed with views over the hotel's swimming pool and lush, landscaped gardens. All feature satellite TV, free Wi-Fi as well as a private balcony or terrace. The hotel's own restaurant offers guests a great selection of traditional Moroccan fare and international cuisine and its sophisticated bar serves a wide variety of cocktails. Guests can relax in the hamman and enjoy beauty treatments in the spa and stroll around the lush gardens. Other facilities include an airport shuttle and free, secure parking.

184320.description: The property is ideally located in the heart of the city's major museums cluster (Museumplein) and the Royal Concertgebouw, and parallel to the prestigious designer-fashion district of P. C. Hooftstraat and Van Baerlestraat, the Conservatorium Hotel offers unrivalled proximity to all of the capital's cultural destinations. This five star hotel in Amsterdam features 129 rooms and suites, all equipped with state-of-the-art in-room technology as well as luxury linens and amenities. As a spa hotel The Conservatorium hotel offers world leading spa and gym facilities at Akasha - its 1000 sqm Holistic Wellbeing Centre including an exclusive indoor swimming pool, a signature spa, cutting-edge gym and a yoga studio. An integral pillar of the vision of the Conservatorium Hotel is the creation of restaurant and bar areas that will not just appeal to hotel guests but will become destinations in their own right for locals and international visitors, thereby imbuing the hotel with a wider responsibility in the local culture. All dining venues at the Conservatorium Hotel are under the helm of celebrated Dutch-chef, Schilo van Coevorden, whose style of food has continuously evolved throughout the years, adapting and adopting traditions from all over the world while retaining the virtues of simplicity and focus on locality and seasonality.

184351.description: Situated within 7 metre(s) from the town centre, the accomodation is easily accessible on foot to a host of places of interest. Visitors can find the nearest golf course within 14 km from the establishment. Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this accomodation. This accomodation was fully refurbished in 2012. The establishment offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. This hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. This accomodation takes pride in offering a choice of dining facilities which serve delicious culinary specialities. Villa 55 may charge a fee for some services.

184408.description: Housed in a palatial building that dates back to 1911 and sits in the centre of Madrid Gran, on Via street, this guesthouse literally houses its guests at just metres from everything that happens in the city. They will be within 500 metres from San Fernando's Royal Academy of Fine Arts, several markets, Teatro de la Zarzuela, the famous Puerta del Sol, Plaza de Callao and if that is not enough just 100 extra metres separates them from Plaza de Cibeles and Santa Ana Square. It is also within a 5-minute walk from both a convenient subway stop and a bus stand, and the area houses numerous tapas bars, casual and fine-dining restaurants, shops and boutique stores. Operated by the Garrido family since 1972 this charming venue offers a relaxed atmosphere with a mixture of styles, rustic and contemporary elegance and modern amenities.

184410.description: This modern hotel is ideally situated in the heart of Madrid, just off Gran Via, one of the city's main thoroughfares. Guests will find a fantastic selection of shops, theaters, fine restaurants, and lively bars within a stone's throw of the hotel. Callao metro station is just 100 meters away, and Puerta del Sol, Madrid's most important square, is also close by. The comfortable, well-appointed rooms are all soundproofed and feature heating and air conditioning. Guests can enjoy a movie on the flat-screen satellite TV and surf the web with the free Wi-Fi. The modern bathrooms are fitted with a hydromassage shower. Business travelers will appreciate the convenient business center with fax and copy services. Other facilities include a free newspaper, luggage storage, and a handy laundry, dry cleaning, and ironing service.

184415.address: 2 angle Omar ibn khattab et Abou Baker seddik
184415.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Recreational amenities include an outdoor pool, a sauna, and bicycle rentals. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. An area shuttle (surcharge) provides transportation to nearby destinations. Enjoy a meal at one of the hotel's two restaurants or order room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the two coffee shops/cafes. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (surcharge). Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Roundtrip airport shuttle service is available (surcharge, 24 hours), and free self-parking is available onsite. The 50 guest rooms feature minibars and plasma televisions, complimentary wireless internet access, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Hotel Lawrence d'Arabie is located near Avenue Mohamed VI, convenient to attractions such as the Theatre Royal and Palais des Congrès. The preferred airport is Menara Airport (RAK).

name.content: Millennium Hotel Paris Charles De Gaulle

184418.address: 2 Allée du Verger, 95700 Roissy en France, France, 2
184418.description: Situated in the north of Paris, near by the quiet village of Roissy-en-France, the Millennium Hotel Paris Charles de Gaulle is a charming 4-star hotel perfect for both business and leisure travellers. Enjoy a comfortable night's rest before your flight, and park your car in secure parking for the extent of your trip. The surrounding greenery provides a quiet and restful atmosphere, making it the perfect getaway from the busy pace of Paris, yet you can be back in the city in a mere half an hour. We invite our guests to also take advantage of our newly refurbished heated pool, sauna and hammam, to ensure maximum rejuvenation on your trip. Millennium Hotels and Resorts has always maintained high levels of cleanliness and hygiene. To further enhance health and safety protocols, MHR has introduced additional precautionary measures at all our hotels as the safety of our guests and employees is paramount to us. By ensuring that your wellbeing is prioritised without compromising on the guest experience, our “We Clean. We Care. We Welcome. ” commitment further enhances our existing operational standards, which will be implemented in the jurisdictions in which we operate to the extent applicable based on local heath authority guidelines. Our 10 Key Hallmarks of cleanliness and safety include, but are not limited to, a higher standard of cleanliness and hygiene including more frequent sanitation of key touch points, easy access to sanitisers for guests in public areas, ensure safe distancing measures as a precaution and high food safety standards. We care for employees by introducing additional measures that have been undertaken to create an environment that ensures their safety and well-being. We welcome our guests with the same warmth, eagerness and hospitality that we have always been known for.

184420.description:
This charming guest house is set in a restored 14th-century residence in the heart of Venice.  The famous Rialto Bridge is only 200 metres away, while the stunning Piazza San Marco and bell tower is only five minutes' walk from the hotel.  Guests will find a wide variety of bars, restaurants and shops nearby, and might cross the Fava Canal to experience shopping and nightlife in the lively San Bartolomeo neighbourhood.
The uniquely decorated guest rooms are modern and bright with air-conditioning and private en suite bathrooms, and some boast views of the square and San Lio Church.  The hotel helpfully organizes guided city tours on foot as well as excursions to Venice's islands.  With its stylish rooms and unbeatable location, this hotel offers an ideal setting for a romantic weekend or an exciting city break of sightseeing and exploring the City of Bridges.

184424.description: Housed in a 14th-century Gothic building, the hotel is spacious and decorated with classic 18th-century Venetian furnishings. The rooms feature beautiful views to the private gardens or to a typical Venetian side street. The suites have two balconies overlooking the Santa Marina square. The hotel offers luxurious rooms equipped with LCD TVs, Wi-Fi access and independent heating. This beautiful guest house is just a 5-minute walk from Venice's Rialto Bridge, situated only 200 metres away.

184701.description: Don't miss out on recreational opportunities including a seasonal outdoor pool and bicycles to rent. Inside you'll find 65 brightly decorated rooms with comfortable furnishings, Wi-Fi and TV. Many offer views of the city and hotel terrace. The restaurant Forte Milano serves traditional Italian seafood cuisine and local specialties, as well as international dishes. Our breakfast buffet is prepared each morning, and includes a selection of pastries, fresh fruit and hot dishes. In the evening, you can head to the hotel bar and enjoy a drink on the outside terrace. We provide space for meetings and events in the dedicated meeting room, bar or terrace. Hotel staff are on hand to help with the organization of your event, offering extra services such as translators too. There's also a fully equipped gym for guests to use.

The guesthouse also boasts a refreshing outdoor pool, a tranquil garden, a traditional Caidal tent, a clay tennis court, a hammam, and a massage room. The on-site cook prepares a daily menu showcasing Moroccan cuisine, using fresh produce from the local market and the guesthouse's own garden.
