Each uniquely decorated room at the Carol Hotel features bright colors and most include floor-to-ceiling mirrors. A sofa, iron, hairdryer, and toiletries are standard in each unit. Some rooms offer picturesque views of Mikrolimano, and select suites boast a private hot tub. A daily breakfast is served in your room at your preferred time. Free early check-in and late check-out are available upon request, subject to availability. A variety of restaurants, fish taverns, and cafes are within a short walk of the hotel. Piraeus Port and Train Station are just 1. 6 miles away, and a bus stop with connections to the city center and airport is conveniently located nearby. Free public parking can be found on the surrounding streets.

186767.description: Jetting off or flying in? Wherever you're heading, you'll find our Heathrow hotel a handy launch pad. And with great transport links and the Heathrow Express train service just minutes away, you'll be well placed for business and leisure destinations throughout London too. If you've time to stop and explore, plan a big adventure at Legoland. Cheer on your team at Twickenham Stadium. Or head for high-adrenalin thrills and spills at Thorpe Park. Then come back to earth at our fantastic restaurant, and unwind in one of our super comfy new generation bedrooms, with an impressive 40" flat screen TV, freshly-updated bathroom with large shower head, and brand new, slumber- inducing, king-size Hypnos bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

186768.description: So close to the planes you're practically on the runway, Premier Inn Heathrow Airport Terminal 5 puts you in prime position for an enjoyable stay, whether you're focused on business or leisure. If you're just passing through, you'll find all you need here - spacious rooms, extra-comfy beds, a stylish restaurant, sports bar and Costa Coffee. Or if you've got a bit more time, you'll be close enough to try out all sorts of top-flight entertainment, including Twickenham Stadium, Windsor Castle, Legoland and Ascot Races. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

186769.description: You'll be on cloud nine with a stay at the Premier Inn London Gatwick Airport (North Terminal). We're perfect for a flying visit or a handy base for all the business and leisure locations of London and the South East. Directly opposite the North Terminal, and with free 2 minute transfers to the South Terminal, you'll be really well connected. All our spacious rooms have extra-comfy beds and there's a tasty restaurant, Costa and business lounge on site, too. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

186770.description: Whether it's an early flight or a late arrival you'll find a warm welcome at Premier Inn Hotel Stansted Airport. Just a short stroll from transport links to the airport, you'll also be well placed to jet off and explore business and leisure destinations around London and Essex. Storm the walls at Stansted Mountfitchet Castle. Take a journey to the past at Bishops Stortford Museum. Or enjoy an afternoon's walk through Hatfield Forest. After a busy day, head back for a meal in our tasty restaurant and unwind in your spacious room and huge, comfy bed. Please be aware, chargeable parking is available at 8GBP per night. See directions for details. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

186776.description: The Renaissance Barcelona Fira Hotel, an Art Deco hotel near Gran Via 2 and Fira Barcelona, offers a variety of amenities for both business and leisure travelers. Enjoy indoor and outdoor pools, a spa tub, two bars/lounges, a poolside bar, and a restaurant with 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel also boasts a conference center, meeting rooms, gift shops, and wedding services. Each of the 357 individually decorated guest rooms features complimentary wired and wireless internet access, cable programming on a flat-screen TV, an iPod docking station, a safe, a desk, and a bathroom with a rainfall showerhead and hairdryer. Dry cleaning/laundry services, multilingual staff, and self-parking (subject to charges) are also available. The hotel is conveniently located approximately 0. 5 km from Gran Via 2 and Fira Barcelona, and 9 km from Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN).

186802.description: Located in the heart of Montmartre's lively Parisian charm, this delightful hotel is a short 10-minute walk from the Sacré Coeur Basilica. Excellent public transport links are available, with the Jules Joffrin Metro Station just 350 meters away, providing direct access to the Saint-Lazare TGV Train Station. Perfect for both business and leisure travelers, the hotel offers a tranquil atmosphere and modern comforts. The soft, bluish-grey décor creates a relaxing ambiance, ideal for unwinding after a day exploring Paris. Guests can enjoy breakfast served in their rooms.

186803.description: This delightful hotel enjoys a prime setting amidst the romance and splendour of Paris. The hotel is located within easy access of a number of attractions in the area, and lies less than 2 km from the city centre. Guests will find themselves just 100 metres from the metro station Grands Boulevards, and can enjoy ease of access around the city. The hotel is located in close proximity to Le Palace Theatre, Grevin Museum, Floies Bergere and Passage Verdeau. This charming hotel greets guests with warm hospitality and charm. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, and come complete with modern amenities. The hotel affords guests a number of excellent facilities for an enjoyable stay.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Manhattan Times Square South

186829.description: Experience the vibrant energy of Midtown Manhattan at the Holiday Inn Express Times Square South on 36th Street. Steps from iconic landmarks and world-class shopping, our hotel offers the perfect base for both leisure and business travelers. Corporate offices like Macy's, Marsh and McLennan, and Google are within easy walking distance, as are the Empire State Building and Times Square. Stay productive in our 24-hour business center with printing, copying, fax, and computer services. Explore nearby attractions such as the Museum of Modern Art, stroll through Central Park or Bryant Park, and enjoy the dazzling lights of Broadway. Our complimentary amenities and impeccable customer service ensure a comfortable and memorable stay. Enjoy magnificent skyscraper views and discover the best of Manhattan right outside our door.

186834.description: These apartments are strategically located next to Plaça Catalunya (Barcelona's main square), and close to the renowned Paseo de Gracia. All the apartments are at walking distance from many tourist attractions, commercial areas, restaurants and bars. This establishment offers a choice of modern and spacious units to suit all clients' needs (from one-bedroom apartment to three-bedroom penthouse). They are fully equipped and include air conditioning and heating as well as free Wi-Fi connection. The minimalist décor creates a fresh and relaxing atmosphere. Linen and towels are provided. This hotel has everything clients need for a truly unforgettable stay in Barcelona.

186837.description:
Located on the outskirts of Milan, Klima Hotel Milano Fiere is one of the few fully eco-friendly design hotels and offers free WiFi throughout the property. Featuring a solar-panel façade, the hotel is 5 km from the Rho Fiera Milano Exhibition Centre. 

Modern and elegant, all rooms at Klima Hotel are air-conditioned. Each room features a minibar and a TV with satellite and pay-per-view channels. Slippers are also provided. 

The bar offers a wide variety of cocktails and spirits. The organic restaurant serves traditional Italian dishes and, upon request, gluten-free and vegetarian meals. 

The property offers 4 charging stations for electric motorcycles or cars. 

The hotel is located 9 km from Milan city centre, right next to the Serenissima A4 motorway exit. The Milan Expo Area can be reached within a 15-minute walk.

name.content: Taj Atlas Wellness Boutique Hotel & Spa

186842.description: This hotel enjoys a peaceful setting amidst an orchard, lying just a short driving distance from the captivating city of Marrakech. Boasting a stunning backdrop of the Atlas Mountains, this hotel is situated just a short walking distance from the Lalla Takerkouste Dam and the picturesque village of Amizmiz. This charming hotel offers guests the perfect setting from which to explore the beauty of the surroundings, and from which to discover the rich culture and history of Marrakech. This delightful hotel greets guests with the promise of an unrivalled luxurious experience. The guest rooms are exquisitely appointed, providing a relaxing setting in which to escape the rest of the world. Guests are sure to be impressed by the exceptional comfort and convenience that they enjoy at this hotel.

186847.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at Casa Das Janelas Com Vista, a charming bed & breakfast in the heart of Lisbon. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) and stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. Each of the 15 air-conditioned rooms features a plasma TV and private bathroom. A shared kitchen is also available. The B&B offers convenient amenities such as concierge services, dry cleaning, and luggage storage. Located within a 15-minute walk of Avenida da Liberdade and Rossio Square, you'll be close to key attractions like Santa Justa Elevator and Belém Tower.

186848.description: Nestled in the heart of Portugal's Douro wine region, this Lamego hotel offers a tranquil escape. Its seven double rooms are thoughtfully decorated, reflecting the region's rural charm. Each room features a private bathroom, air conditioning, central heating, LCD TV with satellite, direct dial telephone, 220v power, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Hair dryers are available upon request. Guests can enjoy various common areas, including several lounges, a games room, dining room, bar, and craft shop. The hotel also boasts a heated outdoor pool, tennis court, mountain bikes, and beautifully landscaped gardens. Free on-site parking is available, and check-out is until 12:30 PM. Please note that pets are not permitted.

186868.description: Situated just a 5 minutes' walking distance from Al Rigga Metro Station, this charming aparthotel offers guests a great location in Deira. The complex is located within easy access of a host of attractions in the area, lying just a 10 minutes' driving distance from Deira City Centre. Guests can enjoy ease of access to Al Mamzar Beach, Jumeirah Beach and a number of delightful shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. This stunning complex greets guests with a sophisticated architectural style. The guest rooms are eloquently appointed, exuding a sense of peace and serenity. The rooms come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests are sure to be pleased by the extensive array of facilities that the complex has to offer.

186890.description: Hotel Trafalgar is located in Madrid s Chamberí district, 250 metres from Iglesia and Quevedo Metro Stations. It offers comfortable, air-conditioned rooms with plasma-screen TVs. This small hotel features simple, modern design with lots of natural light. The hotel s Trafalgar restaurant is open from Monday to Friday, serving typical Spanish cuisine. The Trafalgar is just a few Metro stops from the historic city centre, the Art Triangle and Retiro Park. Bilbao Metro Station is within a short walk, and provides direct access to Madrid Barajas Airport. The Trafalgar is a 10-minute walk from the Sorolla Museum, and there are many book shops and art galleries in the surrounding streets. The nearby Chueca district has many lively bars and clubs. Guests receive discounts at a nearby car park.

186907.description: This stylish hotel, opened in the summer of 2012, offers convenient and personalized accommodation for budget-conscious travelers. Located in the heart of Manhattan's Murray Hill neighborhood on 39th Street between Lexington and 3rd Avenues, it's an ideal base for exploring the city's vibrant attractions. A variety of room types caters to diverse needs, and the numerous amenities will satisfy even the most discerning guest. The on-site taqueria and cantina, a collaboration between Michelin-starred Chef April Bloomfield and restaurateur Ken Friedman, serves a delicious menu influenced by international flavors and fresh produce.

186928.description: With modern and comfortable rooms, the Novotel Buenos Aires hotel is located just two blocks from the Obelisk and close to the main tourist attractions in Buenos Aires, such as the Colón Theater, the Casa Rosada, the Metropolitan Cathedral and Café Torton i. Relax in the leisure and well-being areas, which include a Turkish sauna, solarium and outdoor pool, surrounded by a lush garden. Enjoy the restaurant's Mediterranean cuisine, the bar and the large event rooms. The hotel accepts pets.

186947.description: Welcoming guests seeking a homely ambience while enjoying all the amenities expected from a hotel, this is the ideal place for short or long term visits in Istanbul. It is located just a couple of minutes' walk away from Taksim Square and close to the upmarket shopping district of Nisantasi, consisting of 20 fully equipped spacious and stylishly designed suites, over 7 floors, many of which offer fantastic views over the City and the Bosphorus. The suites have spacious living rooms, a fully equipped kitchenette and modern bathrooms most with spa bathtubs.

186955.description: Located just a 1-minute walk away from Alanya's famous Cleopatra's Beach, this well established hotel was refurbished in 2018 and offers guests a good base from which to explore the popular resort of Alanya. The castle is just under 5 km away and best reached by local transport as it is on a steep promontory. Local amenities can be found in close proximity to the hotel while the pedestrianized shopping centre is 1 km away.

186988.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services and bike storage. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 59 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Carrer Gran de Gràcia - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Casa Vicens - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Park Güell - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Gaudi Experiencia - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Gaudi House Museum - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Hospital Quiron Barcelona - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Barraquer Clinic - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Parc de Collserola - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- CosmoCaixa - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Avinguda Diagonal - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Casa Mila - 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Rambla de Catalunya - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Bunker del Carmel - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi- Francesc Macia Plaza - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi- Passeig de Gràcia - 2. 5 km / 1. 5 mi. The preferred airport for Hotel Ronda Lesseps is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 18. 5 km / 11. 5 miWith a stay at Hotel Ronda Lesseps in Barcelona (Gràcia), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Park Güell and Casa Mila. This eco-certified hotel is 1. 7 mi (2. 8 km) from Casa Batllo and 2 mi (3. 2 km) from Sagrada Familia.

186990.description: Located in the heart of Madrid, Ateneo Hotel is within a 5-minute walk of Gran Via Street and Puerta del Sol. This hotel is also conveniently close to Plaza Mayor (0. 4 mi) and the Royal Palace of Madrid (0. 7 mi). The 38 guestrooms offer minibars, flat-screen televisions with digital programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Additional conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. A buffet breakfast is available on weekdays from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 8:30 AM to 11:30 AM (fee applies). Hotel amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a 24-hour front desk.

186991.description: A total of 17 units are available for guests' convenience. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. Hostal Cruz Sol offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. The hostel may charge a fee for some services.

186992.description: Enjoy a central Madrid stay at the upscale Posada del Dragón Boutique Hotel, just a 5-minute walk from Plaza Mayor and Plaza de España - Princesa. This hotel offers 27 individually decorated guestrooms with memory foam beds, down comforters, minibars, LCD TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a buffet breakfast at our café (fee applies) and savor Mediterranean cuisine at La Antonita restaurant and bar/lounge. Amenities include concierge services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. We're conveniently located near the Royal Palace of Madrid (0. 7 km) and Puerta del Sol (0. 7 km).

186993.description: Enjoy a central Madrid stay at the upscale Posada del León de Oro Boutique Hotel, steps from Plaza de España - Princesa and a short walk from Plaza Mayor. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an area shuttle (surcharge). Dine at the onsite restaurant, Enotaberna, grab a snack at the coffee shop, or enjoy room service during limited hours. A bar/lounge and buffet breakfast (fee applies) are also available. The 17 individually decorated guestrooms feature heated floors, LCD TVs, memory foam beds with premium bedding, and safes. Nearby attractions include the Royal Palace of Madrid and Puerta del Sol.

186994.description: This wonderful family hotel is beautifully situated in the northern suburbs of Athens. This delightful hotel is located just 1 km away from the Iraklion Railway Station, offering guests a great setting from which to explore the surroundings with ease. This charming hotel is located just 25 km from Athens International Airport and 15 km from Syntagma Square. Guests will find themselves just 17 km from Acropolis Hill and 2. 5 km from the Olympic Stadium of Athens. This charming hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and friendly service. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, and come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests will be impressed by the swimming pool & bar during the summertime among with excellent facilities that this delightful hotel has to offer.

186998.address: Calle De Manuel Fernandez Y Gonzalez, 10 TRASLADOS
186998.description: Enjoy a central Madrid stay at Suite Prado Hotel, steps from Teatro Espanol and Plaza de Santa Ana. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Start your day with a continental breakfast (available for a fee), and take advantage of amenities like 24-hour room service, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. An airport shuttle is available (surcharge). Each of the 18 individually decorated guestrooms features a refrigerator, plasma TV, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks are also provided. The hotel is conveniently located near the Congress of Deputies and the Thyssen-Bornemisza National Museum.

186999.description: A total of 28 guest rooms are available for guests' convenience at Apartamentos Madrid.

187087.description: Situated in Maia's city centre, the property offers rooms with free internet access. Forum Maia Metro Station, just 100 meters away, offers connections to the Oporto Airport. The air-conditioned rooms are decorated with wooden furniture. All rooms have cable and satellite TV and a minibar. Room service is available. The Cantinho Ibérico Restaurant serves traditional Portuguese, Spanish and international dishes. The bar, with a flat-screen TV offers a variety of drinks and refreshments. Premium Aeroporto's 24-hour reception can help arrange trips to Maia's main attractions. It also offers car rental and free parking nearby. The Zoo is only 700m away from the hotel, and Oporto's city centre is 10 km away.

187091.description: This charming guesthouse in the heart of Venice offers easy access to the city's main attractions. A short walk from St. Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge, guests can enjoy romantic gondola rides and explore the city's rich history. Housed in a stunning 16th-century building, the guesthouse blends historic charm with modern amenities. The beautifully appointed rooms provide a serene and relaxing environment. Reception has limited hours (7:30 am - 7:00 pm). Guests must communicate their arrival time at least 3 days in advance to info@locandalacorte. it. Late check-in after 7:00 pm incurs a €25. 00 cash fee, subject to prior arrangement. Emergency contact: +39 334 256 5148 or +39 041 241 1300.

187107.description: Located in the center of Santiago do Cacém, Hotel D. Nuno offers views of the Castle and the Parochial church. It features spacious rooms, an outdoor pool, and free Wi-Fi. Hotel D. Nuno has modern rooms, with wooden furniture and some with parquet floors. Each of the air-conditioned rooms has a flat-screen satellite TV, an electric kettle, and slippers. A breakfast bag is delivered at the guests' room, every morning and the bar offers refreshing drinks and views of the Castle and the Parochial church. Guests can sit in the comfortable living room, where they can read a book, or watch television. They can also relax on the sun loungers by the pool, or visit the games room. Lisbon Portela Airport is 87 mi away, and the hotel offers free private parking on site. A car rental service is also available.

187127.description: Located in the city centre, close to Madrid’s most famous museums and only 10 minutes’ walk from the Atocha Train Station, Hotel Sancho offers air-conditioned rooms and free Wi-Fi throughout. Rooms at this hotel are bright and spacious and include a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with hairdryer and free toiletries. Hotel Sancho has a bar and a restaurant. A buffet breakfast is served in the lounge and a continental breakfast in the bar. There are also sun terraces and a library with city views available for guests. Staff at the 24-hour reception can provide information about the area. The El Prado or the Reina Sofia museums are 15 minutes’ walk of the hotel. Delicias Metro Station is just 40 metres away. The Puerta del Sol Square or the Gran Via can be reached in less than 10 minutes by public transport. Private parking is available on site at an extra cost. Delicias RENFE Cercanias train station is just 100 meters away. Which directly connects the hotel with T4 of the Adolfo Suarez Barajas Airport, via line C1.

187199.description:
Welcome to Forty Plus One, where hospitality feels like friendship. 
Not just a stay — a feeling. A connection. A moment you’ll want to keep. 

Tucked in the heart of Vienna, we’re a place where it’s easy to be yourself.   Where conversations start in the courtyard, and every detail is designed to make you feel at home. 

At 40+1, you’re never alone — you’ll always leave with one more friend. 
Because the best hotels don’t just offer rooms — they give you stories to take home.

187247.description: Hotel Lloret Ramblas was founded in 1926 in building from the beginning of the 20th century. Our exceptional location, directly on La Rambla in front of the Canaletes Fountain the city center of Barcelona is the perfect meeting place for locals and visitors alike. Located in the heart of Barcelona next to the city's most famous pedestrian walkway (La Rambla). Our City center hotel in Barcelona offers you the opportunity to have at hand museums, theaters, movies, restaurants, and Barcelona's best shopping areas. Our proximity to Plaza Catalunya, less than 50 meters away, is as much of an advantage for the visitors, as for the busy business traveller. Plaza Catalunya is well connected to all of Barcelona and it's surroundings via the city's Metro, bus and train services. In addition, Hotel Lloret Ramblas is located on Las Ramblas de Barcelonas.

187259.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this boutique hotel in Cape Town's Sea Point neighborhood. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and wired internet access. Relax at the bar/lounge or take advantage of convenient amenities, including concierge services, a business center, and express check-in. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies). The 12 guestrooms feature kitchenettes with refrigerators and microwaves, comfortable beds with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets, and private balconies or patios. Flat-screen TVs with satellite programming and complimentary wired/wireless internet are also provided. Nearby attractions include Sea Point Swimming Pool, the promenade, and Milton Beach. Cape Town Stadium is a short drive away.

187278.description: Located 492 feet from Costa da Caparica beach, this hotel features air-conditioned rooms just a 15-minutes’ drive from the center of Lisbon. The 24-hour reception staff can arrange car rentals. Tiled floors and cable TV are available in all of Real Caparica’s rooms. They also offer central heating and a private bathroom with shower. Guests can start their day in the light breakfast room, which has the same green colors as the guest rooms. Costa de Caparica’s restaurants are only a 5-minute walk away. The Real Caparica Hotel is located a 20-minute drive from Lisbon International Airport. The historic Forte de São Sebastião da Caparica is a 12-minute drive away.

187279.description: The boutique Laranjeira Hotel is set in the heart of Viana do Castelo, just 1640 feet from the Atlantic Ocean. It offers rooms with free internet and panoramic views of the area. The air-conditioned rooms at Hotel Laranjeira combine minimalist design with modern amenities. They overlook Viana do Castelo and Saint Luzia, and offer a flat-screen TV with cable channels. The private bathrooms have free toiletries. Some rooms feature a balcony. The Laranjeira serves a rich breakfast consisting of various continental dishes. There is also a bar serving refreshing drinks and sweet and savory snacks, and room service is available. Guests can rent a bicycle from the hotel and explore Viana do Castelo’s winding streets and rich heritage.

187307.description: Set right on the sandy beach just a 15-minute drive from the popular resort town of Side, this marvellous, modern hotel provides the perfect base for a family holiday of sea and sun. A taxi rank and public transport stop are available in front of the hotel, allowing easy access to Side's historical sights and shops. Visitors might wish to venture into Side to see the stunning Temple of Apollo, ancient theatre and the Hellinistic gate of the city walls, or simply spend sunny days lounging on the beach. The hotel boasts a number of indoor and outdoor pools, one with waterslides, as well as a full-service spa with Turkish bath, sauna, fitness centre and steam room. Guests will delight in daily entertainment offered for both adults and children, and the main buffet restaurant and choice of a la carte restaurants together provide a variety of meal options including Turkish and Italian dishes, all for a fantastic family holiday.

187309.description: A pleasant city hotel offering friendly service and a good range of facilities. Located in the Laleli district where there are a number of shops, café bars and restaurants, the historical attractions at Sultanahmet are only a couple of kilometres away on foot or by tram and the Grand Bazaar is less than a 20 minutes' walk away.

187310.address: sarac ishak mah.soganaga cami cad.nur sokak, 9
187310.description: Situated just 500 metres from the Grand Bazaar in Istanbul, one of the largest covered markets in the world, this boutique hotel offers the perfect place to explore the must-see attractions that this bustling city has to offer. The Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia are a 10-minute walk from this charming establishment and Ataturk Airport is just 16 kilometres away. This delightful hotel greets guests with warm hospitality and a relaxing ambience. All the rooms, tastefully decorated, have been designed with comfort in mind. They all offer all the amenities and services to ensure that clients have a most enjoyable stay, such as satellite LCD TV and a private bathroom.

187354.description: This charming hotel is conveniently located at the heart of Athens. The hotel is located within easy access of the metro station at Omonia Square. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a number of attractions in the area, including the captivating Acropolis, Plaka and Monastiraki. This delightful hotel bathes guests in the rich culture and history of the surroundings. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, featuring a relaxing setting in which to work and rest in comfort. Guests can enjoy a refreshing drink in the lounge, and enjoy a delicious breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

187367.description: This charming hotel enjoys a prime setting in Edinburgh. The hotel is situated on Princes Street in the city, and allows for ease of access to the many historical and cultural attractions that this captivating city has to offer. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to a number of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues, and are assured of an enjoyable stay. This charming hotel greets guests with warm hospitality and the promise of an enjoyable stay. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, featuring soothing, refreshing tones and a relaxing ambience. The hotel affords guests a number of exceptional facilities ensuring that each and every traveller enjoys a memorable stay.

187368.description: Our Edinburgh Central Queen Street hotel is conveniently located near some of the city's best attractions, from the awe-inspiring Edinburgh Castle to the Scottish National Gallery and Holyrood Palace. You're just steps away from luxury shopping at Harvey Nichols, and if you're visiting for the Fringe Festival, you'll be close to major venues like the Stand Comedy Club and the Playhouse. Each room features a comfortable king-size bed with four plush pillows and a cozy duvet. A wide variety of dining options are within easy walking distance. For accessible access, please use the North West Thistle Street Lane entrance at the rear of the hotel. Contact the hotel directly for further assistance.

187384.address: 3 Derb Sidi Bouharba Hart Soura El Moukef
187384.description: This charming hotel enjoys a prime setting at the heart of the captivating Medina of Marrakech. The hotel is situated in the area of Moukef, lying just a short distance away from Jemaa El Fna. Guests can explore the delightful attractions that this mesmerising area has to offer. This delightful hotel welcomes guests into a world of traditional charm and splendour. The guest rooms are exquisitely appointed, immersing visitors in luxury and eloquence, and embracing the style of a bygone era. The hotel offers a host of excellent facilities, meeting the dining and leisure needs of every type of traveller. Guests can indulge in the ultimate invigoration in the spa, enjoying a truly memorable experience.

187391.description: Boasting a prime location in Paris, this charming property is situated just 800 metres from République square. Travellers will find the Château d'Eau metro station a few steps away from the property. Gare du Nord (Paris Nord) is 900 metres away and travellers will find the Opera Garnier just 1. 5 km away. This hotel provides a wide choice of accommodation options to suit all clients' needs, ranging from twin to quadruple rooms. All the guest rooms provide all the necessary services to guarantee a comfortable stay, such as a private bathroom and satellite television. Dining options include a buffet breakfast every morning.

name.content: voco The Franklin New York, an IHG Hotel

187467.description: Housed in a 19th-century brownstone, voco® The Franklin combines historic charm with modern glamour in the cultural heart of New York City. Nestled on a quiet, tree-lined street, our Upper East Side hotel offers a comfortably chic haven in Manhattan. Step outside to explore NYC attractions, including the Museum Mile, Guggenheim Museum, and Central Park. Discover designer stores and restaurants along glitzy Madison Avenue. Walk to the subway lines and ride the train just four stops to Yankee Stadium. Enjoy contemporary comfort and European style in our guest rooms with free Wi-Fi and flatscreen TVs. Choose from our cozy rooms; with one bed in 130 sq. ft. , they're ideal for solo travelers. Corner queen rooms offer 150 sq. ft. , while our spacious king studio rooms offer 220 sq. ft. We also have 220 sq. ft. rooms with two double beds if you're traveling with friends or family. These sophisticated NYC retreats feature crystal chandeliers, original art, and glass-enclosed showers.

187477.description: This accomodation offers a total of 48 units. Hostal Fernando offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Hostal Fernando offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. Some services may be payable.

187490.description: This hostel enjoys a great location at the heart of the mesmerising city of Athens. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from a number of the city's most captivating attractions, including Kotzia Square, Ancient Agora, Roman Agora, the Parthenon and Acropolis. This delightful hostel welcomes guests with the promise of comfort, convenience and a relaxing stay. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, featuring serene surroundings in which to completely relax and unwind. The hostel offers excellent services and facilities, catering to the needs of every type of traveller. Guests will appreciate the enjoyable experience that they encounter at this hostel.

187572.description: The Best Western Plus® Hotel Arcadia opened in 2013. For this purpose, a beautiful old typical Viennese building from the 1900's was completely rebuilt, while preserving the art nouveau flavor. This results in a striking mix of the 19th and the 21st century. The Best Western Plus Hotel Arcadia offers you 72 rooms, all equipped with mini-bar, air conditioning, room safe, satellite-television, Wi-Fi as well as high-speed cable Internet, and much more. The interior is elegant and comfortable. Many of the changes which were accomplished during the building process have an ecological background. For example, the heating and cooling system is state-of-the-art, reducing our carbon footprint to a sustainable level. For those interested in seminars and conferences, we offer a fully-equipped conference room for up to 30 participants (projector, audio-system, wireless microphone). Feel free to enjoy a nice drink in our lounge or to relax in the courtyard. Located in the heart of the second district of Vienna, it is only a five minute walk to the Prater, a premium spot for jogging, cycling, or to take a walk in the woods. But mostly the Prater is famous for being a huge amusement park, suited for children and adults alike. Vienna´s largest exhibition center, the Reed Wien Messe, is a ten minute walk from the hotel. Also the historic center is easily reachable, either by underground train, car or other means of transportation. It is only a five minute walk to the Praterstern Station, a major transportation hub (with bus, underground train, tram, and train stops).

187585.description: Visitors will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Hostalet de Barcelona as it counts with a total of 9 accomodation units. Those staying at this accomodation may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

187586.description: This cosy hotel guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 11 guest rooms. The hotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Hostal In Barcelona does not offer 24-hour reception.

187634.description: The Apartments offer a selection of nine exclusive serviced apartments located in Ladbroke Grove, which sits in part of the historic Ladbroke Estate at the heart of the vibrant & creative community of Notting Hill. Portabello Road Market is just around the corner. They are well placed for the transport network with quick links to London Heathrow Airport, as well as the London Underground stations of Notting Hill Gate, Holland Park, Ladbroke Grove & Westbourne Park. Ladbroke Grove offers stylish & contemporary serviced apartments in the unrivalled area of Notting Hill.

187677.description: Located in the heart of Doha, Four Points by Sheraton Doha is within a 15-minute walk of Doha Quest and Al Bidda Park. This upscale hotel is also a short drive from Doha Corniche (2. 1 km) and City Centre Shopping Mall (6. 2 km). Guests can enjoy a range of amenities, including three outdoor swimming pools, a health club, a sauna, and a spa offering massages. The 120 air-conditioned rooms feature LCD TVs, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. The hotel offers several dining options, including Musheireb Restaurant, specializing in international cuisine, a coffee shop/café, and 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and three meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge, and free self-parking is provided.

187682.description:
Stefanakis Hotel & Apartments is located in the quiet suburb of Varkiza, 20 km from downtown Athens. Varkiza's well organized beach is just 60 m from the property. An outdoor pool is available during the summer.

Built amongst lush vegetation, the Stefanakis complex consists of a main building and a separate block of apartments. All rooms are twin-bedded with a private balcony, LED TV, air conditioning and private bathroom. Apartments also include full kitchens.

The Stefanakis complex also features a lobby with LED TV, breakfast room and a bar. The 24-hour reception staff can assist you with air or ferry tickets, as well as car hire. Free WiFi is available in all areas.

Many dining options are available in Vouliagmeni, a 10-minute drive from Stefanakis. The area also features a water-ski school. Eleftherios Venizelos International Airport is 20 km away. Free public parking is possible

187687.description: This stunning boutique hotel boasts a prime setting at the heart of the captivating city of Athens. Steeped in culture and history, this delightful hotel is located just a 5 minutes' walking distance from the Megaron Mousikis Metro Station, and is within easy access of the main attractions this intriguing city has to offer. Adding a splash of contemporary style to its surroundings, this charming hotel welcomes guests with the promise of elegance and luxury. The guest rooms are superbly appointed, featuring simplistic style and soothing tones. The hotel features a number of exemplary facilities, ensuring that each and every visitor enjoys a relaxing stay. Guests are invited to enjoy a delicious breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

187727.description: Experience Dubai's Deira district from the Ramada by Wyndham Dubai Deira. Located just outside Salahudin Metro Station, our hotel offers convenient access to Dubai's main attractions. A short walk from Al Ghurair Mall, the Gold Souk, and the Creek (easily crossed by traditional Abra boats), it's ideally situated for exploration. Mamzar Private Beach is a mere 10-minute drive, and Dubai International Airport is just 15 minutes away. Our hotel features an outdoor swimming pool, a gym, and on-site restaurants. Each modern room offers carpeted floors, a flat-screen TV, tea and coffee making facilities, and a minibar. Suites also include a separate living room with a sofa.

187764.description: This charming hotel enjoys a strategic setting amidst the wonder and delight of Bogota. The hotel is located in the financial district of the city, and is within easy access of a number of attractions, shopping areas, dining options and entertainment venues. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the Granahorrar Shopping Centre, High Technology Centre and Atlantis Plaza shopping centre. Appealing to both business and leisure travellers alike, the hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and charm. The hotel enjoys a traditional architectural style, inviting guests into the elegant surroundings of the lobby. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, and feature simplistic style and refreshing tones. The hotel offers a number of excellent facilities, catering to the needs of every type of traveller.

187767.description: This hotel revels in the delights and excitement of its central setting in Bogota D. C. The hotel is located within easy walking distance of many shopping, dining and entertainment options. A number of financial institutions and banks are just a short distance away. The famous Zona Rosa is within easy access of this hotel. This wonderful hotel enjoys an attractive architectural design. The guest rooms are beautifully designed in warm tones, and are well equipped with modern amenities. This charming hotel affords guests a number of excellent facilities and services, guaranteeing comfort and convenience.

187790.description: This four-star hotel is perfectly situated on Lisbon's Avenida da República. A modern, dynamic city hotel, the 3K Europa offers unique amenities and embodies the essence of Europe, reflecting the vibrant colors of European cities and Lisbon's magnificent light. Whether for business or leisure, the hotel boasts a prime location near the Campo Pequeno Bullring and just a minute from public transport, including the metro, buses, trains, and the Aerobus shuttle. Lisbon Airport is a mere 10 minutes away.

187832.description: Nestled in the Las Brisas district overlooking Manzanillo Bay, this all-inclusive beachfront resort offers spectacular views and a prime location just minutes from the city's main shopping centers. Situated near the Navy Center and at the beginning of the hotels bay, it boasts one of the most beautiful beaches in the area. Enjoy themed evenings with games and activities, or explore other Manzanillo attractions with our special tour and boat ride rates. Create unforgettable memories at our beautiful beachfront resort.

187887.description: Anantara Palais Hansen Vienna Hotel is located on the Ringstrasse Boulevard in the center of Vienna. It sits in close proximity to top attractions like the former Vienna Stock Exchange, City Hall and St. Stephen’s Cathedral. Today, the hotel offers 152 rooms and suites of various sizes, including the largest Presidential Suite in Vienna and several connecting rooms that are perfect for families. The majority of the hotel’s rooms and suites offer views of the surrounding Viennese streets or the interior courtyard. Elsewhere, the hotel contains a selection of premium services, including meeting rooms, a swimming pool, a 24-hour fitness center, a spa and a cigar lounge. Additionally, this luxurious hotel is also home to a lobby lounge, a breakfast restaurant and a Michelin-starred fine dining establishment. ** The hotel is under renovation until March 2025. The works don’t affect the functionality of the hotel.

187890.description: Enjoy garden views at this centrally located Edinburgh hotel, offering complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The hotel features a restaurant, bar/lounge, and room service (limited hours), as well as wedding services and a reception hall. Each of the 10 guestrooms includes a flat-screen television with digital programming, a private bathroom with designer toiletries, and conveniences such as a desk, coffee/tea maker, and free local calls. A full breakfast is available daily (fee applies). No 11 is located a short walk from Edinburgh Playhouse Theatre and Princes Street, placing you in the heart of the city.

187892.address: Po Box 185051 Umar Bin Al Kattab Road Deira, 42933166
187892.description: Be curious. Explore. Try new things. Live some of your best moments at Swissôtel Al Ghurair, a landmark five star hotel in the center of Dubai. Embrace an alternative way of travelling where wellbeing of the mind, body and soul are our top priority. Whether you are visiting for business or leisure, our central location, generous room sizes and commitment to create authentic moments of unique experiences, are the perfect recipe for an unforgettable stay.

187909.description: This charming hotel enjoys an idyllic setting on the picturesque Isla Mujeres, placing guests moments from delightful shops and intriguing attractions. A variety of recreational activities are available nearby. The hotel, decorated in a traditional Mexican style, provides the perfect base for exploring the splendor of Mexico and embodies the renowned hospitality of the area. Please note, a refundable security deposit of $250 is required upon check-in via Visa or Mastercard. Smoking is prohibited by law within the hotel premises; violations will be reported to local authorities. Housekeeping service is provided every two days.

187955.description: As cheerful and colorful as life itself, the Hotel Capricorno appeals to everyone who wishes to experience vibrant Vienna in the heart of the city. In the form of selected motives on wallpaper, Vienna's landmarks accompany guests all the way to their hotel room, so guests have the feeling of being in the middle of Vienna even when they are in the hotel. The 42 rooms, many of them with balcony, designed in many strong colors, are all air-conditioned and offer a tablet with information and WLAN, in addition to the free WLAN throughout the hotel and Sky programs on flat-screen TVs. Its central location directly at Schwedenplatz makes it possible to reach everything quickly. The visitors can walk to St. Stephan's Cathedral in just five minutes. The underground and trams, as well as the landing stage of the Twin City Liner are right outside the door. Cars can be parked securely in the garage.

187957.description: Located in the heart of Vienna, City Central is just a 5-minute walk from the city center. This family-friendly hotel offers comfortable and affordable accommodations. Choose from 55 single, double, and family rooms, or three fully equipped apartments, all featuring modern amenities like air-conditioning and flat-screen TVs with Sky channels. Covered parking is available, and a buffet breakfast in the charming winter garden is always included.

187981.description: Enjoy your stay at the Mercure BH Zona Financiera, a stone's throw from the city's culinary quarter, Zona T and 93 Park. The hotel's 63 rooms feature WIFI, iPod docking station, LCD TV with cable channels, minibar and coffee machine. The hotel boasts a lobby bar and WIFI included in public areas. Other services include a sauna, fitness room, car parking and 24-hour reception. The hotel is located 8. 7 miles (14 km) from El Dorado International Airport.

188013.description: Because customers' expectations have changed, Campanile has embarked on a modernisation programme introducing the fully refurbished « Next Generation » product. A concept based on modernity, comfort and enjoyment offering even more spacious bedrooms. With a full-fledged restaurant concept, “Le Restaurant” proposes you an innovative and creative catering. Friendly welcome, absolute comfort, appetising dishes: the vital ingredients for a stay that fulfils your wishes.

188019.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Enjoy a satisfying meal at Le Restaurant serving guests of Kyriad Direct Le Bourget - Gonesse. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, multilingual staff, and a library. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 48 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and blackout drapes/curtains. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Villepinte Exhibition Centre - 7 km / 4.

188020.description: This easily accessible hotel is located at less than 100 metres from Paris-Nord Business Park, just 13km from Charles de Gaulle Airport, 4km from Bourget and near the economic hubs of Villepinte and Le Bourget. The nearby Blanc Mesnil and Drancy railway stations provide convenient ways to reach the other parts of Paris. There are also 17 bus routes operating nearby, including a night-bus service through the inner city areas. This 9 storey hotel offers its guests conformable, soundproofed, air-conditioned bedrooms with large work areas, free WiFi, spacious wardrobe, private bathroom and LCD TVs with satellite channels. Meeting rooms with audio-visual equipment are available. The venue's restaurant, which serves the complimentary breakfast, offers a variety of different culinary specialties ideal for all meals. The nonstop free sauna is the perfect way to relax after a busy day.

188021.description: This comfortable hotel is the perfect choice for travelers passing through Charles de Gaulle Airport. Whether you're avoiding early morning traffic or arriving late at night, you'll find everything you need to refresh and relax. The fitness center is ideal for those who want to energize and de-stress, while the sauna offers a tranquil escape before a restful night. The onsite restaurant serves delicious meals throughout the day, including a daily breakfast buffet. Afterward, unwind at the bar with a wide selection of drinks, play a game of pool, or simply enjoy good company.

188022.description: 3-star hotels with a full-fledged restaurant concept. The conviviality and authenticity stand for the brand's core values so that well being might be a pleasure for all of us.

188023.description: This recently renovated smoke-free hotel is only a short-drive away from Charles de Gaulle Airport, near both the Parc des Exposition Paris-Nord Villepinte and Usines Centre Outlet Shopping Mall, and a short distance from Parc Asterix. Shuttle service is available and the nearby RER B2 station allows for moving to and around the inner city areas. The soundproofed air-conditioned guestrooms feature flat-screen cable TVs, private bathrooms with showers and blackout curtains, in order to provide the perfect sleeping conditions. Some of the rooms are fitted with bunk beds for a third guest, which can be used free of charge. Complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily and for anyone willing to venture around the area the multilingual staff can provide recommendations for the local restaurants. Free private parking is available for all guests that arrive with personal transport.

188025.description: Enjoy a convenient stay at Premiere Classe Le Blanc-Mesnil, located a short drive from the Villepinte Exhibition Centre and Stade de France. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a TV in the common area, and a vending machine. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (available for a fee) served from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel also provides complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. The 147 air-conditioned guest rooms feature private bathrooms with showers, desks, and blackout curtains. Parking is available onsite (limited spaces). The hotel is also within a 20-minute drive of Charles de Gaulle Airport.

188029.description: Across the street from the iconic Kingdom Centre, the 176-room ibis Riyadh Olaya Street hotel is an oasis of comfort and amenities in the heart of Saudi Arabia's capital. The 24-hour hotel is located 30 km from King Khalid International Airport and offers free parking. Kick off a day of meetings in Riyadh, in our spacious meeting room, with breakfast served from 4 AM to midday. Design your own dish at our Oopen Pasta & Grill restaurant, then enjoy a restful night with Sweet Bed by ibis.

188031.description: Hostal Operaramblas is a popular choice amongst travelers in Barcelona, whether exploring or just passing through. The hotel offers a wide range of amenities and perks to ensure you have a great time. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, daily housekeeping, ticket service, 24-hour front desk, facilities for disabled guests are there for guest's enjoyment. Each guestroom is elegantly furnished and equipped with handy amenities. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Friendly staff, great facilities and close proximity to all that Barcelona has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Hostal Operaramblas.

188075.address: Off. Mira Bhayander Road, Mira Road East
188075.description: The GCC Club is the hub of sporting and recreational activities for its members who also enjoy regular events organized at the club. GCC is one of the most economical locations in Mumbai (Bombay) for holding day and residential conferences, weddings, banquets, and social functions. With more than 48 lavish guest rooms, 60 apartments and 28 conference /banquet halls, lawns spread over 8360 square meters, conferences have become a regular feature at the club. These facilities are open to members as well as the general public. Additional facilities include swimming pools, tennis and badminton courts, fitness club, health club and a children's play area.

188092.description: This hotel is located just a few minutes' driving distance away from the National Exhibition Centre and Birmingham International Airport and Railway Station. The vibrant city centre of Birmingham is just a short distance away, where guests can explore the ample shopping, dining and entertainment venues. The Resorts World Arena can be found just a 15 minutes' walking distance away. This wonderful hotel enjoys a charming design, greeting visitors with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are sublimely designed, offering a peaceful ambience in which to work and rest in comfort. Guests can wine and dine in style in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant. Check in Time is after 2. 00pmCheck Out Time is before 11. 00amCar Parking is included until 2. 00pm on the day of departure

188102.description: Offering a restaurant, Hotel Rafael is located in Milan. Free WiFi access is available. Each room here will provide you with air conditioning. Private bathroom also comes with a bidet. At Hotel Rafael you will find a garden and a bar. Other facilities offered at the property include a shared lounge, luggage storage and a vending machine. The property features a private parking on site, available for an extra charge. The hotel is 1. 2 mi from Cascina Gobba Metro stop and a 10-minute drive from Linate International Airport. The Rho Fiera is 15 mi away.

188108.description: This outstanding hotel is located in Bur Dubai district, just 13 km from the Dubai International Airport. The famous Dubai World Trade Centre is a 5-minute driving distance away and Jumeirah Beach is easily accessible from this property. During their stay guests can explore the city's iconic landmarks, many of which are in close proximity to the hotel's prime location. The property is a leading hotel which has been carefully designed to provide guests the best accommodation, either for business or pleasure. It offers a choice of guest rooms and suites which feature an exquisite décor and come complete with a large choice of top-quality amenities, including lush linens and large work desks. There is also an array of dining options with varied choice of restaurants, bars and other facilities for guests’ convenience.

188222.description: This clean and friendly hotel is ideally located in northern Paris, just 3km from Charles de Gaulle Airport. A convenient shuttle service eliminates travel worries for early or late flights. Cosy, bright, and clean, the hotel offers minimalist guestrooms with cheerful splashes of color. All rooms feature air-conditioning, private bathrooms, desks, flat-screen TVs, and free WiFi. Start your day with the breakfast buffet on the shaded terrace, enjoying a hot beverage and complimentary newspapers. The Villepinte Parc des Expositions and RER station, offering direct access to central Paris, are just over 2km away.

188233.address: 31 Derb Ben Amrane Riad Zitoun Alakdim
188233.description: Riad Zinoun & Spa is located in the heart of Marrakech, just 200 meters from Jemaâ El Fna Square. It offers a rooftop terrace with views of the Atlas Mountains, and guests can enjoy the hammam and massages for an additional fee. This traditional Moroccan riad features the scents of spices and flowers and vibrant colors, creating a peaceful haven. The guesthouse features a patio with oriental arches, a fully equipped kitchen, and nine spacious rooms, each with a private living room and bathroom, uniquely decorated with tiled floors and plaster walls.

188236.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in Barcelona, lying close to the Camp Nou football stadium. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to the intriguing attractions that this artistic city has to offer. The hotel is located just 20 metres away from the Collblanc Metro Station, providing ease of access to other areas of the city. The hotel is conveniently situated just 10 km from Barcelona Airport. This delightful hotel enjoys a charming architectural style, blending effortlessly with its striking surroundings. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, providing an oasis of peace and serenity in which to completely relax and unwind at the end of the day. Guests are sure to appreciate the wide range of excellent facilities that this wonderful hotel has to offer.

188269.description: This modern hotel enjoys a wonderful setting on the Mediterranean Coast, on the Belek-Bogazkent region. The hotel lies close to a number of attractions in the area, including the magnificent amphitheatre at Aspendos, the Inner Bailey, and Hadrian's Gate, in the old quarter of the city. A number of shopping, dining and entertainment venues can be found nearby. Antalya Airport is 41 km away. This hotel enjoys a contemporary style, comprising beautifully-designed guest rooms, which ensure comfort and convenience. Each unit is equipped with air-conditioning, flat-screen TV, minibar and hair dryer. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that the hotel provides, which are complemented by a homely ambience. This hotel offers a spa area and a sauna to relax in after an engaged day. Minibar only Check-in Day is filled with free soft drinks and water.

188277.description: Set on a narrow, cobbled street leading to Galata Tower, this 18-room hotel is built in the traditional style of the historic neighbourhood and offers modernly furnished and styled rooms, decorated in white. Istiklal Avenue is less than a 5-minute walk and a tramline runs along this into Taksim Square, 1. 5km away. Galata Bridge with access to Sultanahmet is just 800m from the hotel and many shops, cafe bars and restaurants can be found in the area of the hotel

188278.address: Şahkulu Mahallesi, Şahkulu Sokak No:20 Beyoğlu, 20
188278.description: This hotel is situated at the heart of the Beyoglu District of Istanbul. The hotel is located close to the Galata Tower and the Golden Horn. Guests will find themselves just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Istiklal Avenue. Taksim Square can be found just 1. 5 km away from the hotel. This charming hotel is surrounded by shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. This wonderful hotel is sure to impress, extending a warm, friendly welcome to guests upon arrival. The guest rooms offer comfort and style, ensuring the utmost in relaxation. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that this delightful hotel has to offer.

name.content: Quinta da Pacheca - The Wine House Hotel

188288.description: The Wine House Hotel, inaugurated in 2009 at Quinta da Pacheca, is a renowned five-star tourism destination in the Douro, focused on gastronomic and wine tourism. The hotel combines modern design with the architecture of an 18th-century house and features 15 themed rooms inspired by wine and vineyards. Since 2017, it has offered the innovative Wine Barrels, wine barrel-shaped suites, providing a unique and romantic experience. Recently, the hotel expanded its facilities with 24 new rooms and now includes an outdoor pool, bar, spa, and revitalizing water circuit, ensuring a luxurious and relaxing stay.

188290.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Aloft Harlem. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and tour/ticket assistance. Grab a bite at one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Breakfast is available for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. Make yourself at home in one of the 50 guestrooms featuring minibars. Rooms have private balconies. Private bathrooms have deep soaking bathtubs and hair dryers. This beach hotel is 2. 8 mi (4. 5 km) from Alanya Castle and 0. 6 mi (0. 9 km) from Alanya Culture Center.

188370.description: Enjoy the sun, sea, nature, history and entertainment! Barut Andız combines everything you may expect from a romantic getaway for couples and honeymooners, and hosts exclusively guests aged 16 and above. Enjoy nature's vivid colours in all its tranquillity and serenity in Side's historical atmosphere. Enjoy the highest quality recreational experience at Barut Andız - the indispensable option for those looking for a distinctive holiday. We offer a variety of room options specifically designed with our guests' satisfaction in mind, restaurants where you can indulge in the most exquisite dishes from all around the world, pleasant cafes and bars where you can enjoy sipping your drinks at any time of day, quality animation shows and activities, a Spa & Wellness Centre where you can treat yourself and so much more. . . Enjoy the experience of a lifetime at Barut Andız!

188371.address: KIZILOT TURIZM MERKEZI Side / Antalya / TÜRKİYE, 11
188371.description: The Sea Planet Resort & Spa, the third hotel from the Seaden Hotel Group, opened in May 2013. Located in the Kizilot Tourism Center, this all-inclusive resort offers 460 rooms and 24-hour service, including a bar open around the clock. Please note: all bathtubs in the hotel rooms are being replaced with showers.

188388.description: The Almera Park Apart Hotel, conveniently located near the city center (2km) and just 350m from the beach, offers a garden, kids' pool, and an outdoor pool with waterslides. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. The modern rooms feature air conditioning, flat-screen satellite TVs, dining and living areas, and fully-equipped kitchenettes. Some rooms boast sea views. Guests can also enjoy the spa, which offers various massage and beauty treatments, as well as a Turkish bath (surcharge applies). The A'la Carte Restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner, while the pool bar offers snacks and drinks. Annex rooms are located in a separate building directly across from the main Almera Park building. Please note, there is a surcharge for in-room air conditioning.

name.content: Wyndham Grand Istanbul Kalamis Marina Hotel

188460.description: Wyndham Istanbul Kalamis Marina – New 5-Star Hotel in Istanbul's Exotic Asian Side Located on the Asian coast of Istanbul adjacent to the exclusive Kalamis Marina and proffering breathtaking views of the Sea of Marmara, the newly constructed, five-star Wyndham Istanbul Kalamis Marina hotel offers travelers a welcome destination where East effortlessly meets West. With shopping, attractions, recreation and dining nearby, coupled with a stunning location in the heart of the most elegant residential neighborhood on the Asian side of Istanbul and a myriad of amenities and world-class services, business and leisure travelers alike will find this Istanbul Kalamis Marina hotel their ideal choice when lodging in the City of the World's Desire. Guests can refresh and recharge in the indoor or outdoor heated pool, while the Blue Harmony Spa features a host of therapeutic, restorative treatments and state-of-the-art fitness equipment, as well as a Children's Play Area guaranteed to keep the children entertained and amused. This Istanbul Kalamis Marina hotel features four outstanding restaurants and cafes where guests can explore a variety of cuisines. The Lobby Lounge features delectable light fare and refreshing cocktails, while the Vira Marina All Day Dining Restaurant serves up exquisite Continental fare in a buffet setting. After a workout, guests can enjoy healthy dishes at Shape Cafe, located in the Blue Harmony Spa, or enjoy a meal in the comfort of their guest room by taking advantage of 24-hour room service. Each of the hotel's 210 spacious, well-designed guest rooms and suites are exquisitely appointed and feature panoramic views of the city, the sea or the marina. Plush pillow top mattresses ensure an incomparably restful sleep, while complimentary wireless high-speed Internet access and large work spaces make in-room work trouble-free and uncomplicated.

188461.description: This city hotel is located on the Asian side of Istanbul in the Maltepe district, conveniently close to the E-5 highway and 20 km from Sabiha Gökcen Airport. Comfortably furnished, the hotel is suitable for business and leisure guests alike and has facilities for business meetings and social functions. Bagdat Avenue, famous for shopping and entertainment venues, is 2 km away from the hotel and easily reached by public transport which runs in front of the hotel.

188469.description: This charming hotel in Santiago is conveniently located near the city's main attractions, offering guests easy access to dining, shopping, and entertainment. A short drive from Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport and the Vitacura district, it caters to both business and leisure travelers. The tastefully appointed guest rooms provide a refreshing and peaceful ambiance, ensuring a relaxing stay.

188472.description: The City Express Junior by Marriott Cancun offers a convenient location, just a short walk from Amerimed Hospital and ten minutes from Hospiten Hospital. Guests can relax on the private beach or enjoy the outdoor pool and fitness center. The hotel's 106 air-conditioned rooms feature LCD televisions, complimentary wired internet access, and cable programming. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Additional amenities include a business center and dry cleaning/laundry services. Free self-parking is available on-site.

188495.description: Located in a quiet area in Barcelona, just a few steps from Gaudi's magnificent Sagrada Familia cathedral, these bright and modern apartments feature an outstanding rooftop sun terrace and a small outdoor swimming pool with views of the cathedral. There are several cafés, bars and restaurants on the tree-lined Gaudí Avenue, just 250 metres away. The Park Güell is 2. 6km and Barceloneta Beach 4. 8 km away. All apartments are decorated with modern designs and feature a balcony and living room. Guests can make use of free Wi-Fi access in the apartment and throughout the building and free access to the property's gym and sauna.

188496.description: The apartments newly renovated in 2019 are located within 10 min walk from Sagrada Familia Cathedral. Guests will have easy access to all the city sights from the nearest metro station 'Sagrada Familia'. Some bars and supermarkets can be found nearby. The apartments feature a fully equipped kitchen where guests can cook meals and there is free Wi-Fi connection in all areas of the apartment. Each apartment is air-conditioned and comes with a balcony and living area with LCD television. Please note that there is no 24-hour reception, so guests need to call the property when they are on their way to the apartments, at least 30 minutes prior to arrival+34 933238790 or +34 646 18 9111 so the receptionist will approach for check-in.

188510.address: Ain Neffad Hassoun Route De Fes
188510.description: Nestled in Marrakech's famed Palmeraie, Riad Jnane Allia offers a tranquil oasis for your Marrakech getaway. The riad showcases a stunning blend of contemporary and traditional Moroccan design. The adobe walls, crafted from a centuries-old Moroccan technique, create a rich amber hue, beautifully enhanced by natural light. Spacious rooms provide a timeless sense of serenity. At the heart of the riad, an elegant caidale tent houses an air-conditioned dining area for all guests to enjoy.

188549.address: A104 Sortie no2 Visiteurs Parc des expositions BP, 2
188549.description: Planning an event at the exhibition center or a layover near Roissy Airport? Look no further than the ibis Villepinte Parc des Expositions! Our attentive team will ensure a pleasant and restful stay. Enjoy recently renovated rooms and free Wi-Fi. Savor a delicious meal on our beautiful terrace at La Boucherie restaurant. We look forward to welcoming you!

name.content: The Turbine Boutique Hotel and Spa

188580.description: This luxurious hotel is beautifully located in Kynsna, tempting guests with the promise of a unique experience. The hotel is set on Thesen Island on the Garden Route of South Africa. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to a number of attractions in the area. This striking hotel occupies a renovated power station, tempting guests with the promise of unequivocal luxury and elegance. The hotel exudes a sense of opulence and decadence, welcoming guests into a veritable lap of luxury. The guest rooms provide a cocoon of peace and serenity, enjoying a lavish style. The rooms come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests are afforded a number of exemplary facilities at this hotel, for unrivaled comfort and relaxation.

188582.description: This hostel has been operating since 1967 and has won over plenty of visitors of Barcelona due to its fantastic location, links to the public transport system and excellent service. It is just 25 metres from the Poble Sec Metro and a 10-minute walk from Plaza Catalunya and the harbour. Barceloneta and the rest of the city's beaches are reachable within a 10-minute bus drive, while Plaza España and the Exhibition centre at just a 5-minute walk away. Las Ramblas, the Gothic Quarter, a large variety of restaurants, tapas bars, cafes and most of the lively nightlife of the city are all within a 15-minute walk of this convenient venue. The establishment itself is the perfect hub for a good night's rest. The air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs and each is equipped with work desk, which combined with the free WiFi makes it possible to stay on top of one's workload while on the road.

188586.description: This charming hotel is nestled amidst beautiful gardens in the captivating city of Marrakech. Guests will find themselves just 14 km from the Medina and 8 km from the nearest golf course. This delightful hotel offers guests the perfect base from which to explore the splendour and beauty of the city. This wonderful hotel beautifully showcases the decadence of Moroccan design, welcoming guests with warm hospitality and charm. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, offering a peaceful setting in which to relax and unwind. Guests are invited to enjoy delightful dining in the restaurant, where delectable Moroccan and French dishes are sure to impress even the most discerning palate.

188611.description: This cosy hotel guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 14 guest rooms. Those staying at this establishment may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. The reception desk is not open throughout the day. This hotel is environmentally friendly. Additional fees may apply for some services.

188638.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the B&B HOTEL Braga Lamacaes in Braga, conveniently located within a 5-minute drive of Minho University and Parque da Ponte. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a vending machine, and daily buffet breakfast (available for a fee). Amenities include a 24-hour front desk, ATM/banking services, an elevator, and free self-parking. The 52 air-conditioned guestrooms feature satellite TV, safes, and bathrooms with bathtubs/showers and hair dryers. Housekeeping is available upon request. Nearby attractions include Braga's Exhibition Park (2. 8 km) and Sete Fontes (2. 8 km). Porto Airport (OPO) is 56. 8 km away.

188688.description: Housed in a historic building, this hotel offers a luxurious and comfortable environment for both business and leisure travelers. Well-appointed rooms with modern facilities ensure a relaxing stay. Located near Las Ramblas, you'll be close to Barcelona's top attractions, shops, bars, clubs, and restaurants. Despite its central location on a quiet street called Sant Pau, ensures a peaceful night's sleep. The hotel's prime location makes it an ideal base for exploring the city, complemented by attentive staff dedicated to making your stay memorable.

188722.description: The Gracia Garden is a cozy 12-room hotel nestled in the heart of Barcelona's vibrant Gracia neighborhood. Our dedicated staff provides personalized service, offering assistance and local insights for a memorable stay. Recently renovated, the hotel prioritizes comfort. All rooms feature 160cm double beds with 100% cotton sheets and hypoallergenic duvets, TVs, air conditioning, private bathrooms with rain showers, daily cleaning, and free WiFi. Snacks and beverages are available at the front desk. Guests can also relax in our peaceful inner courtyard—a perfect spot to unwind with friends or enjoy a good book. For business travelers, we offer a dedicated workspace ideal for meetings or quiet work sessions. Our prime location places you steps away from Barcelona's top attractions. Paseo de Gracia, with its high-end shops and Gaudí's iconic Casa Batlló and La Pedrera (Casa Milà), is just a two-minute walk. The number 24 bus, stopping directly in front of the hotel, provides easy access to Park Güell, and the Sagrada Familia is only two metro stops away. Experience authentic Barcelona in the historic Gracia neighborhood, known for its trendy restaurants, charming squares, and unique local shops.

name.content: SIR Albert Hotel, part of Sircle Collection

188725.description: An impressive former diamond factory built in 1985, this is a luxury boutique hotel embodying the modern aristocrat style. The property is built with sustainable materials and energy-efficient technology. The hotel is located in a central, vibrant and prestigious place, surrounded by shops, restaurants and trendy bars. The hotel welcomes all travellers seeking a base to do business, or a boutique retreat from which to experience the city. The famous Museumplein and Koninklijk Concertgebouw are within 5 minutes from the hotel. The interior of each elegantly designed room is inspired by various art movements from the past. Created by international award-winning designers from BK Architecture, the rooms have a private bar, Illy coffee machine, LED satellite TV, hairdryer and complimentary luxurious toiletries.

188732.description: Located 984 feet from the public beach along the Mediterranean shores, this hotel features an outdoor pool with free sun loungers and parasols. Air-conditioned rooms at Lara Dinc Hotel include a satellite TV, mini-bar and a balcony. Private bathroom comes with a bath, free toiletries and a hairdryer. The hotel’s restaurant serves breakfast in buffet style. The meal can be enjoyed at the restaurant or by the pool. The pool bar is ideal for refreshing drinks. Free Wi-Fi is accessible throughout the hotel. Guests can benefit from the 24-hour front desk service, safety deposit box and room service. Antalya Airport is 4. 3 mi from Lara Dinc Hotel. Antalya city center is a 20-minute drive away. Free private parking is possible on site.

188748.description: The Ramada Resort Lara, conveniently located near Antalya Airport, offers a wealth of amenities, including a gym, spa, sauna, tennis courts, an on-site restaurant and bar, a pool, and beachfront access. Guest rooms feature tea and coffee making facilities, complimentary Wi-Fi, a safe, and an LCD TV. Nearby attractions include Perge, Kursunlu Waterfall Nature Park, and Mermerli Beach. Please note that pets are not permitted.

188753.description: Located at just a 15-minute stroll from Gaudí's Sagrada Família Basilica and 5 minutes from the arc de triomf subway station, this hotel offers the perfect hub for all visitors of this lovely city. The Ciutadella park and the posh Born district are both within a 10-minute walk, add 10 more minutes and guests can get to Barcelona's' beating heart - Las Ramblas and the Barceloneta Beach. Airport connections, national and international bus services can be found in the Estació del Nord Bus Station, which is located at just 200 metres. The apartments themselves offer a bright and stylish minimalist décor, spacious common areas with flat-screen satellite TV and fully equipped kitchenettes, perfect for all self-catering types. The large windows offer a magnificent view of city sky-line. *parking available on site ( need to reserve at the time of contacting us for check in)
