188754.description: These stylish and comfortable apartments are located in Barcelona's chic Eixample district, 500 metres from Gran Vía and 10 minutes' walk from Plaza España. They feature chic decor and natural light. There are various bars, restaurants and shops within a 5 minutes' walk. The foot of Montjuic hill, with the Olympic Stadium, MNAC and Caixa Forum Museums, is a 10 minutes' walk away and the Joan Miró Park is a 4 minutes' walk away. These apartments are a 5 minutes' walk from Entença and Tarragona Metro Stations, connecting guests with Las Ramblas within 10 minutes. Sants AVE Train Station is 600 metres away. TWO OPTIONS FOR CHECK-IN: Customers can choose two options for check in: CHECK ONLINE OR PRESENTIAL CHECK-IN.

188779.description: Enjoy a stylish stay at One Shot Luchana 22, located in the heart of Madrid, just a short drive from Gran Via and the Prado Museum. The hotel offers 43 air-conditioned rooms with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. Take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and room service (limited hours). Start your day with a cooked-to-order breakfast (fee applies), available on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, dry cleaning/laundry services, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.

188805.city: SAO BERNARDO DO CAMPO SAO PAULO
188805.description: Enjoy a privileged location in the heart of Sao Bernardo do Campo at this comfortable hotel. Situated near Church Square and the Metropole store, with easy access to the Anchienta Industrial Highway and city center, it offers a personalized experience in a relaxing and welcoming atmosphere. Well-appointed rooms provide everything needed for a pleasant stay. Indulge in the unique comfort and high quality, making this hotel an ideal choice for a dream vacation.

188847.address: RUE GASTON MONMOUSSEAU/ Z.A. DE TRAPPES ELANCOURT
188847.description: Located at just a 5-minute drive from the centre of the tranquil Parisian suburb of Trappes, this low-cost hotel is the perfect place where the weary traveller can relax. Its guests will be within 30km from downtown Paris, but due to the convenience of the city's train station they will be able to reach some of the most important areas within a short ride. The venue is also a good choice for business travellers and it can offer them a multifunctional meeting room and an outdoor terrace where they can host a small event or a cocktail. Those craving a tasty meal shouldn't look any further than the in-house restaurant, which serves delicious l'Ardoise dishes for lunch and dinner. The hearty breakfast offers the perfect start for the day and can be enjoyed in the dining area.

188863.description: The Mood Oasis, located in the commercial area of the city and just a few steps away from the Gràcia neighbourhood, offers a golf course and 36 fully equipped rooms, all for a perfect stay in Barcelona. Guests can take advantage of the free Wi-Fi internet connection to keep in touch with home and office, and can relax in the terrace and chill-out area after a busy day spent exploring the city.

188977.description: The Hotel Flamingo enjoys a prime location in Lisbon, next to Marquês de Pombal Square and only six miles from the airport. A stylish restaurant and a game room are available for guests' enjoyment. All rooms feature private bathrooms, minibars, telephones, air conditioning, and satellite TV. The hotel's restaurant offers a diverse menu of international cuisine, and guests can unwind in the evening with a drink from the bar. Wi-Fi access is available throughout the hotel for a fee. Car rental can be arranged on-site, and parking is nearby. The hotel can also assist with booking sightseeing tours, making restaurant recommendations, and reserving tickets for Fado shows.

188979.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace and garden at Hotel Strudlhof. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, a common area with a TV, and a picnic area. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Additional amenities include a business center, early check-in / late check-out, stay with your pet, parking garage (surcharge applies). The 81 rooms feature tea, LCD TVs with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with deep soaking bathtubs. Conveniences include 24h reception, safes, and desks. Located in central Vienna, Hotel Strudlhof is within a 5-minute drive of the Vienna Christmas Market and Hofburg Imperial Palace, and close to attractions like the Sigmund Freud Museum and Volksoper Vienna.

188981.description: Built in 2013, this modern hotel is located in Evrenseki, 8 km from the historical ruins of Side and 650 meters from its private beach. The five-story, three-building hotel offers an outdoor pool, a pool with two slides, a buffet restaurant, and a lobby bar. Beach amenities include a snack bar and shuttle service. Local amenities are available in Evrenseki, and public transport on the main road provides easy access to neighboring towns. During the summer season, the all-inclusive program operates from 10:00 am to 11:00 pm. Wi-Fi is available for €3 per day.

188986.description: Set in a charming ancient villa, just a short 20-minute drive from Venice and 9km from the Venetian Lagoon. This beautiful property boosts an outdoor pool, ideal for lying under the sun and a lush green garden with century old trees. A walk around the nearby small village of Quarto D'Altino, with its old stony roads and adorable houses will instantly transport us back in time. All of the 30 air-conditioned rooms come in different décors and offer the perfect atmosphere for remaining in the comfortable beds until noon. A coffee shop and a bar provide dining option on the premises of this hotel, while a shuttle service is available for the San Nicolò restaurant, which specializes in fish dishes and is operated by the owners of this delightful villa.

189012.description: At Boutique Hotel Sans Souci Vienna, refined luxury, modern ease, and a curated in-house art exhibition come together to create a distinctive experience. Spacious rooms, an exclusive spa, and thoughtfully crafted culinary moments invite relaxation and indulgence. A stylish retreat where design, atmosphere, and joie de vivre seamlessly intertwine.

189063.description: Set in a charming historical building, this hotel is located in central Madrid's Alonso Martínez Square. The rooms feature traditional high ceilings, modern parquet floors and attractive, minimalist décor. There is also an on-site bar, and guests can enjoy a drink in the library. The hotel is located on the edge of the lively Chueca district, and there are numerous charming cafes and tapas bars, as well as vibrant nightlife, within a short walk. Alonso Martínez Metro Station is right outside the hotel.

189068.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Soak up the sun at the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities, including a sauna and a seasonal outdoor pool. This hotel also offers complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in the common area. All-inclusive rates are available, covering meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may apply for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Savor Turkish cuisine at LA RUBIL, a poolside buffet restaurant with a bar/lounge, pool views, and alfresco dining. You can also take advantage of the 24-hour room service. End your day with a drink at the beach bar.

189069.description: This city hotel occupies a corner building above a retail shop, overlooking Beyazit Square in the historical district of Fatih. Within a few strides of Istanbul University and the Grand Bazaar, the hotel is ideally placed for sight-seeing. Topkapi Palace and the Blue Mosque are just over a kilometre away and easily reachable on foot or by tram. Hotel features include a spa, lobby bar and terrace restaurant.

189070.description: Istanbul, the world's only city spanning both Europe and Asia, has long been a vibrant hub of trade, culture, and art. It's no surprise that Eastern Roman emperors, the Byzantine Dynasty, and Ottoman sultans all called this city home. Wyndham Grand Istanbul Europe welcomes you to your new home away from home. Located just minutes from Istanbul Airport, the CNR Expo Center, and TÜYAP Fair Convention and Congress Center, the hotel enjoys a prime location among international businesses, while also offering convenient access to both the historic and modern districts of the city. The Wyndham Grand Istanbul Europe offers 307 luxurious and modern bedrooms. Facilities include a spa and sports center, an indoor pool with a sunbathing area, and a convenient shopping mall, ensuring a memorable stay for both business and leisure travelers. For corporate events, the hotel boasts 14 meeting rooms and a grand ballroom, all fully furnished and equipped to meet your business needs. Istanbul Airport is 30 km from the hotel, and the Mimar Sinan metro station, a mere 50 meters away, connects you to the city center in 25 minutes.

189133.description: This hotel is situated amidst the excitement and history of Madrid. The hotel is situated within easy access of a wealth of attractions in this captivating city, lying just an 8 minutes' walking distance from the Prado Museum, and a 10 minutes' stroll from the Latin District. The Reina Sofia Museum is just 1 km away. The hotel is located just 150 metres away from Plaza de Santa Ana. Puerta del Sol is a 7 minutes' walking distance from the hotel. Retire Park can be found just a 20 minutes' walk away. This charming hotel welcomes visitors with the promise of comfort and style. The guest rooms are bright, modern and functional, and are set overlooking the interior courtyard. Guests will appreciate the excellent service that the hotel affords.

189153.description: This hotel enjoys a wonderful setting amidst the bustle and excitement of London. The hotel is located in central London, lying just 300 metres away from Selfridges and Oxford Street. Guests will find themselves just a 5 minutes' walking distance from Hyde Park, 1. 6 km from Harrods in Knightsbridge, and a 20 minutes' stroll away from Buckingham Palace. A boundless range of shopping, entertainment and dining venues can be found nearby. This wonderful hotel is set in a beautiful Georgian building. The guest rooms are spacious, comfortable and beautifully designed. Guests will appreciate the high level of comfort, convenience and personalized attention that this hotel has to offer.

189162.description: The hotel boasts a fabulous location on Venice's Lido, opposite the Venetian Lagoon. Just a short walk from Lido's golden beach and a 10-minute boat ride from St. Mark's Square, it's ideal for family holidays and romantic getaways, seamlessly blending cultural exploration with relaxing beach days. Please note: Reception is open until 9:00 PM. Check-in after this time is not guaranteed. Kindly contact the hotel in advance if you plan to arrive later than 9:00 PM.

189197.description: Socialtel Parque 93 Bogota : Innovation, service and the best location. Designed for executives and people accustomed to comfort, it is located in the area of Chico, a neighborhood with tradition and style, surrounded by the best restaurants and bars of the city, near luxury shopping centers and the important business area of the north of the capital. Socialtel Parque 93 Bogota has comfortable single and double rooms, elegantly designed, decorated with noble materials and luxurious finishes. All rooms have free wi-fi. For events we have 3 multifunctional meeting rooms and 1 auditorium-cinema, with the latest audiovisual technology and an excellent use of space for corporate meetings and social events, attended by a fully trained team accompanying the entire process.

189199.description: Located in one of the most traditional neighborhoods of Bogotá, Usaquén and 3 km from the bars and restaurants in the area of Park 93. A hotel with excellent service based on the provision of qualified personnel. With fully equipped facilities for better enjoyment of all guests, this hotel is one of the best options in this beautiful destination of Colombia, excellent decor and a pleasant environment for everyone.

189226.description: The hotel is located near the city centre, next to the oldest theatre in Vienna – the Josefstadt Theatre. Due to its convenient location guests can reach the city centre and St. Stephens's Cathedral within a few minutes. The City Hall, Parliament, Hofburg and the Theatre “Burgtheater” are located within a 5-minute walk. Vienna Airport is at 26 km from the hotel. The hotel offers an elegant combination of modern convenience with the comfort of a residence with tradition and flair. All rooms are fitted with flat-screen TV, minibar, electric kettle and bathroom with hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a drink in the elegant ambience of the hotel's bar or pamper themselves with a soothing massage. For further relaxation, guests can also visit the sauna.

189246.description: Centrally located close to Sirkeci train station, this hotel offers easy access to all that Istanbul has to offer. Galata Bridge is less than a 5-minute walk, and Beyoglu and Taksim are accessible on foot, as are the many attractions of Sultanahmet. The hotel features simply furnished guest rooms, and guests can dine in the restaurant or sip a drink at the bar after a busy day in the city. The spa facilities are complete with sauna, hot tub, and Turkish bath, making it easy for guests to relax and unwind during a restful stay in Istanbul.

name.content: Miracle İstanbul Asia Airport Hotel & Spa

189249.address: Harmandere Mah. Dedepasa Cad. Site Sok, 8
189249.description: Located just 3 kilometres from Sabiha Gökcen International Airport, this luxurious establishment is located in the fastest growing district in the Asian side of Istanbul. It offers a free airport shuttle service and is the perfect choice for business and leisure travellers alike. Guests will find a host of local tourist attractions close to this accommodation, such as Pendorya Shopping Centre, Pendik Marina and Baghdad Street, popular for its luxurious shops and exclusive dining options. As for the top-quality facilities, this modern business hotel features a car park, spa centre and a stylish à la carte restaurant, among others. Complimentary internet connection is available for guests' convenience.

189263.description: Looking for a comfortable stay at a good price in Lima? Consider ibis Lima Larco Miraflores. The hotel has everything you need to guarantee a great stay, like modern rooms, which accommodate children up to 11 years old at no extra cost, 24-hour bar and the QCeviche! restaurant, offering the best of Peruvian cuisine as well as a breakfast buffet. This pet-friendly hotel accepts dogs up to 33lbs (15kg).

189297.description: Hampton Inn Manhattan Grand Central is conveniently located in Midtown on 43rd Street and 2nd Avenue. All reservations include Free Breakfast - 24H Business and Fitness Centers - Free WiFi. Just 5 minutes from Grand Central Terminal and Subway Lines, Metro North Lines, and Shuttle Train service to Times Square. Enjoy a beautiful upscale area of Midtown Manhattan filled with historic attractions like the Chrysler Building and UN HQ. In the evening, on your way to Times Square to take in the night life, take a stroll through Bryant Park. When you're done taking all of what New York City has to offer, unwind and relax in one of our cozy hotel rooms which feature a clean and fresh Hampton Bed. Stay productive and entertained, while in your room, which features 32-inch HDTVs as well as complimentary high speed WiFi. After a great night's sleep, join us for a Hampton's free hot breakfast and revive with fresh coffee, fruit juices and our famous waffles. Even if you're in a rush, don't miss the most important meal of the day! On your way out, simply grab one of our free Hampton On the Run Breakfast Bags, available (Monday – Friday), for a quick, healthy meal to go.

189299.address: Av Santo Toribio 173 -Via Central 150 Centro Empre
189299.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy a meal at Le Cafe or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Lima? This hotel has 9042 square feet (840 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 12 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 345 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and espresso makers.

189320.description: With its strategic location in Lisbon, in Amoreiras, a short distance from Marquês de Pombal and Avenidas Novas, the hotel offers 291 rooms and 20 suites, with views over the city and Tagus River. It has two restaurants, a bar with terrace in the lobby, a Sky bar, an extensive urban spa and a heated outdoor ‘infinity' pool, at the top of the hotel, with panoramic views over the city of Lisbon. For meetings and events, the 1750 square meters, distributed in 13 meeting rooms, including a 900 m2 ballroom, can cater for events for up to 1300 people.

189366.description: The Hotel Pelayo is a great-value 1-star budget hotel in an excellent central location just off Playa Cataluyna and next to the famous Las Ramblas, allowing you to explore much of the city on foot. All rooms are basic but comfortable, with en suite facilities, a safe, air conditioning, and a television. This hotel offers excellent value for money! Guests should be aware that breakfast consists of tea, coffee, and pastries, available self-service from the reception area. Please note: there is no step-free access to the elevators.

189371.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as bicycle rentals, a terrace, and a garden at Résidence Carouge in Bretigny-sur-Orge. A continental breakfast is served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 9:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Room service is also available during limited hours. The 32 individually decorated guestrooms feature kitchens equipped with refrigerators, stovetops, microwaves, and coffee/tea makers. Weekly housekeeping is provided. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs with digital programming, express check-in and check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and self-parking (subject to charges). This aparthotel is conveniently located 3. 5 miles from Linas-Montlhéry Autodrome and 8. 9 miles from Château de la Boissière. The nearest airport is Paris Orly (ORY).

189396.description: This apartment hotel is situated in Chapinero Alto, in the intriguing city of Bogota D. C. The complex is located close to the financial centre of the city and the gourmet district. The complex enjoys close proximity to a wide range of attractions and points of interest, appealing to business and leisure travellers alike. The apartments are designed with a modern, elegant touch, offering a homely environment in which to completely unwind. The apartments are well equipped with modern conveniences, ensuring a relaxing stay. This complex is sure to impress every type of traveller visiting the city. At Viaggio 617 your pet is part of the family. That's why we welcome them with pleasure. Don't forget to present your vaccination card at check-in (maximum 2 pets per room).

189398.description: This hotel has been completely renovated in the typical Caribbean style. It is located on a beach of fine white sand, surrounded by beautiful palms, harmonizing perfectly with the beautiful nature and the colours of this corner of the Caribbean called Holbox. The turquoise sea and unforgettable sunsets are the backdrop that guests can admire every day during an unforgettable holiday. The classic decor, a relaxing atmosphere, and excellent location make this hotel the perfect place to stay.

189417.description: This hotel is conveniently located in the neighbourhood of Campo Belo in São Paulo´s Brooklin district, within 2km of the Congonhas Airport and Berrini metro Station, which provides easy access to the whole city. The lively area around it includes two shopping malls and a theatre, all within a 5-minute drive. The hotel itself offers nicely furnished practical accommodation options, with fully-equipped kitchenettes. Business travellers can take advantage of its Business centre and the two meeting rooms with capacity up-to 30 people. Relaxing after an intensive day is made easy in the outdoor swimming pool, the fitness centre or if one prefer more leisurely activity - the sauna. A bar and restaurant are available for either a quiet drink or fulfilling meal.

189435.description: This upscale hotel is located next to the Intercambiador de Moncloa Station. The hotel is located just off the A6 motorway, enjoying ease of access to an abundance of attractions in the area. Guests will find themselves just a 5 minutes' driving distance from Casa de Campo Park and the central Plaza Espana Square. The hotel is situated just a 20 minutes' driving distance from Madrid Barajas Airport. This delectable hotel enjoys a stunning interior design, evoking a sense of tranquillity and splendour. The guest rooms are superbly appointed, featuring crisp white tones and a relaxing ambience. Guests are afforded a wide range of excellent facilities, furthering the comfort and convenience of every stay. SWIMMING POOL AND SOLARIUM: From mid-June to early October (this info might change depending on the weather and other conditions).

189438.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at the Hyde Park Boutique Hotel, including complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. A continental breakfast is available daily (7:00 AM to 10:00 AM) for a fee. The hotel offers 42 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, digital programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include showers and complimentary toiletries. Additional conveniences include phones, desks, and coffee/tea makers. Located in the heart of London, the Hyde Park Boutique Hotel is within a 15-minute walk of Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens, and a short distance from Paddington Central and Marble Arch.

189442.description: The 33 welcoming units offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection available on-site. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. Hotel Paseo de Gracia does not offer cots on demand. Hotel Paseo de Gracia has wheelchair-accessible common areas. The car park may be useful to those arriving by car. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

189453.description: Located in the heart of Venice, just steps from the Grand Canal and Teatro La Fenice, these stylish holiday apartments offer the perfect base for a memorable sightseeing trip. Piazza San Marco is a short six-minute walk away, and the antique market at Campo Santo Stefano is just 250 meters from your doorstep. Inside, the building blends modern interiors with the authentic charm of a Venetian palace, boasting high ceilings and large windows. Each apartment, ranging from 50 to 75 square meters, features a fully equipped kitchen, a contemporary bathroom with complimentary toiletries, and a living/dining area with an LCD television and free Wi-Fi. Some apartments also include a balcony or terrace overlooking the internal courtyard or Sant'Angelo Square. Reception hours are from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Please contact reception at least three days prior to arrival to confirm your arrival time. Cleaning fees are €40. 00 per stay (one-time). A city tax of €2. 00 per person/per night is applicable.

189465.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 24 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and coffee/tea makers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Hygeia Hospital - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Mitera Maternity Hospital - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Iatropolis MRI SA - 1. 4 km / 0. 8 mi- Olympic Athletic Center - 1.

189466.description: Maroussi Hotel is located in Marousi region, just 984 feet from Neratziotissa metro and train station and within 1640 feet from The Mall shopping center. It offers a 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi, and air-conditioned units with a balcony. Elegantly decorated with wrough-iron or upholstered beds and lively colors, the rooms of Maroussi have an LCD TV with satellite channels and a radio. Each unit includes a modern bathroom with shower and a hairdryer, while some rooms also include a spa bath. Guests can start their day with a continental breakfast served daily in the privacy of their room, as well as drinks, coffees and light snacks throughout the day. Restaurants, bars and supermarkets can be found at the center of Marousi, within 0. 9 mi from Maroussi Hotel. Athens City Center is at 8. 1 mi, while Athens International Airport is 16 mi away. Free public parking is possible on site.

189471.description: The Best Western Nouvel Orléans Montparnasse close to the Latin Quarter and Saint-Germain-Des-pres, in a typically lively Parisian area and not far from the Montparnasse railway station. With the metro station as well as the subway RER on the doorstep, the Best Western Nouvel Orléans Montparnasse is a good base for visiting Paris. All rooms are equipped with air-conditioning, tub and shower, mini-bar, in-room safe, cable television, Internet access, hairdryer and are soundproofed.

189477.description: The hotel is a 15-minute underground journey to the heart of London's vibrant West End. This hotel in Paddington has been designed to give you the feel of a private luxury London residence with the service of a lavish hotel. The elegant rooms feature grand four poster beds wrapped in a duck down duvet with Egyptian cotton sheets to ensure the soundest of sleep equipped with complimentary WiFi, tea and coffee making facilities, a flat screen TV, a private bathroom with a hairdryer, toiletries and many other luxury amenities. Guests can enjoy a nice meal at the hotel restaurant and a wide range of breakfasts is also available every morning.

189488.description: Experience the vibrant heart of Madrid from our fully renovated hotel, boasting the comfort and amenities of a 4 or 5-star establishment. Ideally situated across from Atocha Station and near the Reina Sofia and Prado Museums, we offer exceptional value. Choose from a variety of rooms: **Individual Rooms:** Perfect for solo travelers, our cozy single rooms feature comfortable single beds, private bathrooms with rain-effect showers, and modern conveniences like a hairdryer, safe, climate control, a TV with 70+ channels, free WiFi, and high-quality Bluetooth speakers. **Double Rooms:** Ideal for couples, friends, or individual guests, these rooms offer queen-size double or twin beds (subject to availability), private bathrooms with rain-effect showers, and the same modern conveniences as our single rooms. These rooms may be interior or exterior facing. **Double Rooms with Balcony:** Enjoy fresh air and city views from these well-appointed double rooms. Offering the same comfortable furnishings and modern conveniences as our standard doubles, these rooms are all exterior facing.

189509.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 14 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Twickenham Stadium - 3. 3 km / 2 mi- Thames River - 3. 8 km / 2. 4 mi- Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew - 7. 4 km / 4.

189540.description: A welcoming Cannock hotel with meeting rooms, a 12th-floor bar and free parkingHoliday Inn® Birmingham North - Cannock hotel is only a 30-minute drive from Birmingham city centre. The nearby M6 Toll motorway provides easy access to towns and cities across the West Midlands. If you’re catching a flight, Birmingham Airport (BHX) is half an hour away by car. We're within easy reach of Cannock town centre, and just 5 minutes drive from the McArthurGlen Designer Outlet West Midlands. For a fun day out, take the kids to ride the roller coasters at Drayton Manor Theme Park or delve into the past at the open-air Black Country Living Museum, where costumed guides recreate life in a 19th-century industrial town. Business guests can host events for up to 180 people in our 5 naturally lit meeting rooms. At this hotel you can enjoy: -Free WiFi- 24-hour room service- Kids stay and eat freeBright rooms feature a clean design and a pillow menu to help you get a good night’s sleep. For extra space, book a suite with a separate living room. The Sky Bar is the place to relax over cocktails as you take in sweeping views through floor-to-ceiling windows, and you can grab a bite from our Brasserie restaurant, open around the clock.

189557.description: Enjoy a central Paris stay at the eco-certified ibis Paris Bercy Village 12ème. Located near Bercy Village, it's a short drive from Bercy Arena and Île Saint-Louis. Notre Dame and Luxembourg Gardens are also easily accessible. The hotel offers 195 air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs, satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Amenities include a restaurant, bar/lounge, terrace, garden, and banquet hall. A buffet breakfast is available (fee applies). Benefit from tour/ticket assistance, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a computer station.

189635.description: Have you tried staying in an apartment instead of a regular hotel room? We offer 125 beautifully styled apartments that give you a real taste of Amsterdam. The apartments offer fully equipped kitchens, en-suite bathroom(s), SMART TV with over 100 channels and internet access. WiFi is available free of charge throughout the hotel. Amsterdam ID Aparthotel is situated within 200 meters from Amsterdam Sloterdijk station, by train you are able to reach Amsterdam Central Station in just 5 minutes! Schiphol Airport, The World Trade Centre, Rai Exhibition Centre are all less than 10 minutes away from the Amsterdam ID Aparthotel. Amsterdam ID Aparthotel is just off the highway A10 and offers secured parking in our gated garage. If there is anything else you need, our 24-hour reception is ready to satisfy your needs. Whether you are here for business or leisure, with the assistance of our enthusiastic team we will do our best to make you feel at home. To ensure your stay is even more comfortable we offer breakfast and dinner options, a game room, fitness studio and sauna.

name.content: Hilton Garden Inn Long Island City New York

189672.description: Host your next business event at the Hilton Garden Inn Long Island City New York, boasting 1, 410 sq. ft. of flexible meeting space across four modern rooms equipped with cutting-edge A/V technology. A complimentary 24-hour business center is available for presentation updates, and complimentary WiFi is provided throughout the hotel. Settle into a comfortable guest room or suite featuring a refrigerator, microwave, Keurig coffeemaker, 46-inch LED HDTV, and an ergonomic workspace. For additional space and amenities, including a private terrace, opt for the Presidential Suite. Maintain your fitness routine in the complimentary 24-hour fitness center with modern cardio and weight equipment. Enjoy a cooked-to-order breakfast, lunch, or dinner featuring American cuisine at the Garden Grille & Bar. The 24-hour Pavilion Pantry® offers snacks, beverages, and travel essentials. A coin-operated laundry is also available on-site for guest convenience. Please be advised that on-site restaurant services are currently operating at a reduced capacity, and breakfast and room service are temporarily unavailable. Room types are subject to availability.

name.content: Homewood Suites by Hilton Carle Place - Garden Cit

189674.description: Welcome to the Homewood Suites by Hilton, Carle Place-Westbury, NY. Located just 17 miles from JFK International Airport and 18 miles from LaGuardia International Airport, our hotel is the closest upscale all-suite hotel on Long Island to these two major airports. Whether you're here for a short trip or an extended stay in Nassau County, our hotel offers comfortable accommodations and complimentary amenities. We're conveniently located near major corporations such as Covanta Energy, the FAA, 1-800 Flowers, LIJ Hospital, and Canon. Leisure travelers will appreciate our proximity to attractions like Jones Beach and the Nikon Theater, Belmont Racetrack, Trump on the Ocean Restaurant, Roosevelt Field Mall, Nassau Coliseum, Roosevelt House, the NYCB Theatre at Westbury, Hofstra University, Manhattan, and Fire Island. Relax in our spacious studio, one-bedroom, or two-bedroom suites. Each suite features comfortable king-sized or queen-sized beds with signature linens and pillows. Our two-bedroom suites provide additional space and a second bathroom. Start your day with fresh coffee made in your in-suite kitchen, which also includes a cooktop stove, pots and pans, dishes, utensils, a dishwasher, and garbage disposal. Enjoy amenities such as a clock radio with an MP3 connection and complimentary Wi-Fi.

name.content: Homewood Suites by Hilton New York/Midtown Manhatt

189694.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Valet Parking. The following services and amenities are currently **not available**: Complimentary Evening Social. Whether you're here on business or vacation, you'll find all the comforts of home in a great location at the Homewood Suites by Hilton New York/Midtown Manhattan Times Square-South, NY, hotel. Our all-suite Manhattan hotel is just one block from Times Square and offers easy access to art venues, theaters, premier shopping, world class dining options and iconic NYC attractions; including Radio City Music Hall, Broadway, The Museum of Modern Art (MOMA) and Central Park. Feel at home in a spacious studio, one or two-bedroom suite at this extended-stay NYC hotel, loaded with carefully considered amenities. Stay in touch with the office and family with complimentary WiFi, watch a show on your HDTVs and prepare meals in the fully equipped kitchen. Buy snacks and travel essentials in the 24-hour Suite Shop, take advantage of our convenient grocery shopping service, complimentary WiFi and on-site laundry. Prepare for a busy day with a complimentary, hot full breakfast. Maintain your exercise regime in our extensive fitness center or unwind in the peaceful exterior garden area. The complimentary 24-hour business center offers an array of equipment and useful services to help you keep on top of work during your stay at this all-suite Manhattan hotel. Our friendly team members will be happy to help you organize meetings, training seminars and social events in our boardroom or spacious meeting room.

189695.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Fitness Center, Valet Parking. Embedded in the heart of Lower Manhattan, the historic Hampton Inn Manhattan/Downtown-Financial District effortlessly marries historic charm with modern convenience. From its exterior walls garbed in limestone and original aluminum inlay to the chic interior lobby featuring complimentary Hampton On the House® hot breakfast, this hotel is tailor-made for the traveler expecting both style and quality. In town for business? We are only two blocks from Wall Street and are neighbors with some of the world's largest business headquarters. Other neighborhood attractions include the historic South Street Seaport district and the World Trade Center Memorial site. Within steps from Battery Park, you won't find a better location if seeking to visit the Statue of Liberty and the Ellis Island Immigration Museum. Grab a cup of coffee and take in the cityscape as you ride the free Staten Island Ferry through the Upper Bay or walk the Brooklyn Bridge! With the R line less than a block away, it couldn't be easier to jump on the subway and step out into some of the city's top attractions including Union Square, Madison Square Park, Times Square, Central Park and Fifth Avenue shopping. Additional amenities include complimentary high-speed internet access throughout the hotel, complimentary fitness and business center services as well as complimentary tea and coffee available 24 hours per day. Our passion for customized guest service topped with an enthusiastic desire to make you fall in love with our city will cause your stay at the Hampton Inn Manhattan/Downtown-Financial District to be truly unique.

189696.description: Located just one mile from the scenic Lake Ronkonkoma, the Courtyard Long Island MacArthur Airport offers guests a refreshing indoor swimming pool and luxurious marble bathrooms in each of its spacious, air-conditioned rooms. Modern furnishings, cable TV, a refrigerator, and a microwave complete the comfortable accommodations. Guests can unwind in the hot tub after an invigorating workout in the well-equipped gym, featuring free weights and treadmills. Free Wi-Fi access is available throughout the hotel, and The Bistro serves a delicious selection of American cuisine for breakfast and dinner.

name.content: Hilton Garden Inn New York/Times Square Central

189697.description: The Hilton Garden Inn New York/Times Square Central, a contemporary hotel, debuted on 42nd Street in September 2014. This 36-story hotel, nestled between Broadway and 6th Avenue in the heart of Times Square, is steps from the New Year's Eve Ball Drop and surrounded by Broadway theaters, restaurants, shopping, and nightlife. Guests are within walking distance of Radio City Music Hall, Rockefeller Center, and other iconic attractions. The hotel's 282 guest rooms feature modern amenities, including 50-inch flat-screen TVs and plush bedding. Business travelers appreciate the large work desks and ergonomic chairs. Paul's on Times Square offers upscale dining, and the vibrant lobby bar overlooks Times Square. Guests enjoy complimentary access to the business and fitness centers, in-room and lobby Wi-Fi, and morning coffee/tea. Additional conveniences include a concierge, theater ticket desk, and a 24-hour Pavilion Pantry. The hotel also offers a boardroom for up to 14 people. Located within 20 miles of JFK, LaGuardia, and Newark Liberty International Airports, the Hilton Garden Inn provides convenient access to all Manhattan offers. The hotel is entirely non-smoking and welcomes service animals. Room-key access elevators and on-site security ensure guest safety.

name.content: Hilton Garden Inn New York/Central Park South-Midt

189698.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service, Valet Parking. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Business Center, Fitness Center. The stylish Hilton Garden Inn New York/Central Park South-Midtown West hotel boasts a central location in the heart of Midtown Manhattan, offering easy access to a wealth of shopping opportunities, restaurants, bars and entertainment. Our friendly and modern hotel boasts close proximity to world-famous NYC attractions, including Central Park, Times Square and the Empire State Building. Shop in designer stores on Fifth Avenue and discover eateries, bars and shopping at Columbus Circle. Take in a musical or Broadway show or hire a bicycle and explore leafy Central Park. Soak up the quaint, European-style ambience of the West Village, home to vibrant sidewalk cafes, boutiques and specialty food stores or marvel at contemporary paintings and sculptures in the Museum of Modern Art. Unwind in a spacious and stylish guest room and enjoy a fantastic range of amenities, including complimentary internet access, a 40-inch LED TV, a microwave and a mini-refrigerator. Inviting suites are also available at this Midtown Manhattan hotel, offering additional space and amenities - ideal for families or longer stays. Enjoy tender steaks and juicy burgers in the relaxed atmosphere of Empire Steakhouse, which features a stylish, open sidewalk bar or enjoy breakfast, lunch and dinner in your guest room with Room Service. Buy snacks and travel essentials from the 24-hour Pavilion Pantry® and maintain your exercise regime in the complimentary 24-hour fitness center. Fax documents and check emails in the complimentary 24-hour business center and hold an event or celebration with two flexible meeting spaces and contemporary A/V technology.

189842.description:
Three Boutique Hotel offers stylish accommodation in Oranjezicht, Cape Town, a popular international tourist destination. 

The hotel features elegant rooms, each accommodating 2 guests. Every room includes a king-size bed and an en-suite bathroom fitted with either a bath and shower or a shower only. Rooms are equipped with air-conditioning, a desk, an electronic safe, a hairdryer, WiFi, a TV with selected DStv channels, and tea- and coffee-making facilities. Room service is available. 

Guests can relax by the swimming pool, unwind in the cosy guest lounge, or enjoy a drink at the bar. 

Three Boutique Hotel is centrally located, just 550 m from the Gardens Shopping Centre, which offers restaurants, banks, supermarkets, and boutiques. It is 4 km from the CTICC, 5 km from the Table Mountain cable car and Cape Town Stadium, and 6 km from the V&A Waterfront.

189891.description: This charming apartment complex is situated at Lancaster Gate, enjoying ease of access to a host of attractions in the area. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the station for the central line, allowing them to explore other areas of the city with ease. Guests can explore the delightful Marble Arch, Bond Street and Oxford Circus. This wonderful complex offers guests the ideal setting from which to explore the area. This outstanding complex occupies a historical, Grade II listed building, and welcomes guests into a world of style and charm. The apartments are exquisitely appointed, featuring individual designs for a unique experience.

189936.description: Situated in the peaceful 15th arrondissement, the villa-like Montcalm Hotel offers a tranquil garden lounge and a welcoming lobby. Just a ten-minute walk from the Porte de Versailles Exhibition Center, the hotel provides convenient access to Paris's main attractions via Metro Line 8, located directly in front. Guest rooms feature amenities such as televisions, direct-dial telephones, data ports, coffee/tea makers, and room service.

189937.description: Centrally located in Paris, Hotel Le Colisee is steps from the Champs-Élysées and a short walk from the Arc de Triomphe. This hotel offers 45 air-conditioned rooms with minibars (including complimentary items), LCD TVs, and free Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy amenities such as bicycle rentals, concierge services, and a bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. The hotel also features a business center and dry cleaning/laundry services. Nearby attractions include the Palais Garnier and the Eiffel Tower.

189938.description: The Hôtel Gaillon Opéra is nestled in the heart of the Opera district, a mere three-minute stroll from the Opera Garnier and five minutes from the Louvre Museum. The Latin Quarter and Notre Dame Cathedral are also within easy reach, less than one and two kilometers away, respectively. This charming hotel offers a cozy and welcoming atmosphere, featuring antique furniture, exposed beams, and a delightful flower-filled patio. Children under two stay free when sharing a twin room with an adult. All rooms are equipped with individually controlled air conditioning and heating, cable television, a safe, a mini-bar, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Room service is available, and guests can enjoy free parking nearby from 7:00 PM to 9:00 AM six days a week, with free all-day parking on Sundays.

189940.description: This elegant hotel boasts a prime location in the heart of Paris, housed within a beautifully preserved 19th-century Haussmann-style building. Guests are immediately enveloped in chic sophistication, evident in the ornate stonework, curated artwork, and exquisite objets d'art. Refurbished rooms seamlessly blend classic Parisian charm with modern comforts and amenities. The hotel is ideally situated within a five-minute walk of the Champs-Élysées and the Arc de Triomphe, with convenient access to the George V Metro Station connecting guests to the rest of the city. Please note, a €200 deposit is required upon arrival.

189941.description: The Best Western Empire Elysées is located 600 meters from the Arc de Triomphe and Champs Elysées. It offers modern, air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi Internet access. Rooms are equipped with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a desk and bathrooms facilities. All guest rooms also have a minibar and tea and coffee making facilities. Some of the rooms have a balcony. A full buffet breakfast made with local products is served every morning. Guests may also choose to enjoy a continental breakfast in their room. Please note that breakfast is included for all our customers. The closest Metro is Ternes, which offers direct transport to the Moulin Rouge and Montmartre district of the city. The Best Western Empire Elysées is a 10-minute Metro ride to the business area of La Défense from Charles de Gaulle Etoile Metro Station, 450 m from the hotel. The Eiffel Tower is 2. 6 km away. The whole team will be delighted to welcome you for your stay and will be at your disposal to advise you on the best places, museums, restaurants to see.

189942.description: The Best Western Folkestone Opera is a choice location. We are in the center of the business and fashion area, near the Madeleine Church and the Opera House. The Rue du Faubourg St. Honore and department stores are nearby. All rooms have recently been renovated and are equipped with individual air-conditioning, free Wi-Fi access, courtesy tray, flat screen television, in room safe, direct dial telephone, mini-bar and hair dryer in each bathroom. The Best Western Folkestone Opera offers a breakfast you will enjoy with a delicious buffet featuring homemade pastries for 15. 00 EUR. We have a bar and lounge, fax and photocopy services and laundry service. The rooms are only for one or two persons. No cribs or rollaway are possible. At the Best Western Folkestone Opera there is a large choice of metro and bus stops.

189943.description: The Best Western Anjou Lafayette Opera, a charming family hotel, is ideally situated in the heart of Paris, offering convenient access to both business and leisure activities. The hotel is within walking distance of iconic department stores like Galeries Lafayette and Printemps, as well as the Opera Garnier. Nearby attractions include the Louvre Museum and various other tourist hotspots. Its proximity to the Gare du Nord railway station, including the Eurostar and Thalys, provides easy access to the exhibition grounds at Villepinte and Le Bourget, as well as Charles de Gaulle Airport. The hotel offers 39 recently renovated, soundproofed rooms in a refined, contemporary style. Each room features amenities such as a safe, hairdryer, minibar, flat-screen television with international channels, and Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a relaxing stay with access to a plush lounge bar, air conditioning, and two breakfast options. Excursions can also be booked at the hotel.

189945.description: The Best Western Hotel Aramis Saint-Germain (Paris 6) and its multilingual staff welcome an ever more loyal French and international clientele. Here, you feel at home. Quality services and small attentions contribute to the well-being of everyone. The hotel, regularly embellished, pays particular attention to decoration. The 42 rooms are refined, and the breakfast room offers a cosy, relaxed atmosphere. The seminar rooms feature beautiful 18th-century vaulted ceilings. Entirely soundproofed, the hotel provides constantly updated modern comfort, rooms with varied tones, modern equipment and multiple services. Ideally located for an unforgettable stay!From the hotel to Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Montparnasse, the Odéon, Saint-Sulpice or the Jardin du Luxembourg, it’s just a few steps. Located on the Left Bank, the hotel offers you all Paris has to offer: Paris to shop, Paris to dine, historic Paris, romantic Paris, Paris to go out…

189949.description: Located right in the heart of the 'old Paris' of poets, students, artists and intellectuals, this charming hotel offers the perfect location for any visit to the city. Sitting just minutes away from the well-known cafés 'Les Deux Magots', 'le Flore', the famous 'Brasserie Lipp' and the mythical gourmet restaurant 'Le Procope', it provides the ideal location for a romantic getaway. The door just opposite of Moliere's former house leads to this lovely establishment. The hotel's antique furniture, Aubusson tapestries, stone walls, open oak beams, all combine to create the sort of atmosphere that make its guests feel the spirit of the Paris as soon as they enter. The breakfast salon on the ground floor is arranged around a small, flowery garden inundated with sunlight, and is the perfect place to enjoy the most important meal of the day.

name.content: Hotel A la Villa des Artistes

189951.description: This is a charming boutique hotel that is located on a small street in the heart of Paris' Left Bank. Just a 2-minute walk from Jardin du Luxembourg, next to Vavin Metro station and surrounded by the shops and the cafés of Montparnasse. The Louvre and Eiffel Tower are all within 3km, but can be as easily reached with the convenient public transport. Airport Shuttle service is made available to all guests. Each stylishly decorated guestroom is fitted with modern equipment and comfortable furniture. The carpeted lobby features subdued lighting, complimentary daily newspapers, and books and displays young local artists' works. The small garden is a place of peace and quietness in the busy city and a perfect spot for enjoying a cup of tea.

189955.description: The Best Western Au Trocadero offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, a hair salon, and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy a snack from the deli or a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is served daily (7:00-10:30 AM) for a fee. Additional amenities include a computer station, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The hotel's 27 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs with cable programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, phones, and desks. Located in central Paris, the hotel is a short walk from Place du Trocadéro, and within easy walking distance of the Palais de Tokyo, Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

189961.description: The Maison 46, a sophisticated hotel in the heart of Paris's 15th arrondissement, offers elegance, comfort, and charm for both business and leisure travelers. Enjoy exceptional services, including room service, a cozy bar with an open fireplace, and a tranquil winter garden. Choose from stylish bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms and televisions, or indulge in the elegant executive suite. A haven of peace and discretion, the Best Western Maison 46 is conveniently located a short walk from the Eiffel Tower and Les Invalides, and close to the Porte de Versailles Exhibition Center and UNESCO, ensuring easy access to your appointments.

189965.description: This 3-star hotel in Suresnes offers easy access to central Paris via public transport. The T2 tram is just 2 minutes away, and the train station is a 15-minute walk. Its 49 guest rooms are welcoming and bright, thanks to a large south-facing glass wall that fills the hall and all four levels with sunlight. Each room features modern amenities such as a flat-screen TV, telephone, and an en-suite bathroom with a hairdryer and complimentary toiletries. A safety deposit box is available at the reception. Enjoy a buffet breakfast every morning in the breakfast room or have it delivered to your room at no extra charge. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Additional amenities include a terrace, luggage storage, laundry service, and room service from Monday evening to Thursday evening. Please note that the local city tax is not included in the room rate and will be charged directly by the hotel upon check-in/out.

189972.description: In a beautiful Parisian style building, located between Etoile and Trocadero, the hotel offers the elegance and charm of a French residence in a Art Deco Style. Guests can enjoy a drink in our bar 'Les Contemplations'. The hotel is located 300 meters from Arc de Triomphe and a short distance of 500 meters from the Eiffel Tower and Champs Elysées. Notre Dame Cathedral is only a 3 km stroll away. The hotel offers: 24 hour front desk, foreign currency exchange, and assistance with ticket purchase to local events. In the 'Superior' category there are Adjoining rooms and rooms with balcony available.

189974.description: Located in the heart of Paris, the 4-star Hotel Aoriste is within a 15-minute walk of the Louvre Museum and Palais Garnier. This hotel offers 20 guestrooms with complimentary minibars, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, and free Wi-Fi. Enjoy amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a television in the common area. A buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee), and room service is offered during limited hours. Additional amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services.

189975.description: Opened in February 2005, this charming hotel occupies a 17th-century building once owned by the renowned painter Toulouse-Lautrec. Each of the 20 fully renovated rooms features modern amenities, including an LCD television, high-speed Wi-Fi, a bath/shower, air conditioning, a minibar, and an in-room safe. The multilingual staff is dedicated to ensuring guests enjoy their Parisian experience to the fullest. Located in the heart of the city, on the Right Bank, the hotel is within walking distance of major attractions such as the Louvre and Orsay Museums, Place Vendôme (home to the famed jeweler Cartier), and Rue Saint-Honoré, known for its luxury shopping (Gucci, Chanel, Hermès, and Louis Vuitton). The hotel also offers babysitting services, luggage storage, an on-call doctor, guest laundry, and assistance with sightseeing tours.

name.content: Grand Hôtel De l’Univers Paris - Saint Germain

189977.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at the Grand Hôtel de L'Univers, conveniently located in Paris's 6th Arrondissement, a 15-minute walk from the Louvre Museum and Notre Dame. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (available for a fee), and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel offers 33 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a minibar, private bathroom with shower and complimentary toiletries, a safe, desk, and phone. Additional amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge.

189981.description: The property is located within walking distance of both train stations: Gare du Nord (Eurostar and Thalys Terminals 100 meters) and Gare de L'est (200 meters). The guests will be very close to the Canal Saint Martin, Opera Garnier, department stores and the famous Montmartre district. The friendly multilingual staff are available for assistance with any questions or request. The hotel is 30 km from Disneyland and 1 km from Les Halles. Versailles is 20 km by car. All rooms include satellite television with Canal Plus, Free Wi-Fi, tea-coffee maker, hairdryer and AM/FM radio stereo. Room with balcony and fire place are also offered.

189983.description: The Hotel Aurore, fully renovated in 2002, offers guests a warm and dynamic welcome in Paris's 12th arrondissement, directly across from the Gare de Lyon. This convenient location provides easy access to the French Riviera and is the last stop before departing the city. Historical sites like Notre Dame and Le Marais are within walking distance, while other attractions such as the Champs-Élysées, Montmartre, and the Eiffel Tower are easily reachable by RER, bus, or metro. The hotel's 28 air-conditioned and soundproofed rooms are equipped with data ports, radios, hairdryers, alarm clocks, and cable television. Experience friendly Parisian hospitality at the Hotel Aurore.

189984.address: Rue du Chevalier de Saint George, 14
189984.description: This luxurious hotel is located in the heart of the most elegant part of Paris, between Place De La Concorde and the Opera Garnier, near the Place De La Madeleine and Rue Saint Honore. A very special location that is ideal, whether the guest is visiting Paris for pleasure, business, or romance. The Hotel offers 38 cosy, comfortable rooms in a resolutely Art Deco style:  the 'classic' rooms, in shades of copper and plum, the 'superior' rooms, in shades of coral, cream and taupe, and the particularly spacious, comfortable, elegant suites also offer sofas, large armchairs and substantial desks. Amenity including such as air-conditioning, IPhone dock/radio, safe, large flat screen, satellite television, hairdryer, magnifying mirror, free Internet access (wireless and wired), and mini-bar are standard.

189996.description: Located in the heart of Paris, Hotel Royal Saint Michel is a 10-minute walk from Notre-Dame and Rue de Rivoli. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a common area with a TV. Guestrooms feature minibars, plasma TVs, and pillowtop beds. Private bathrooms include deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Continental breakfast is available for a fee. Additional amenities include room service (limited hours), a computer station, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Nearby attractions include Luxembourg Gardens and the Louvre Museum. The nearest airports are Paris Orly (ORY) and Charles de Gaulle (CDG).

name.content: Best Western Plus Hotel Sydney Opera

189997.description: Situated in the heart of the business area, within walking distance of the Opera house, the Madeleine Church and the Concorde Place, the Best Western Plus® Hotel Sydney Opera has a preferred location between Hausmann Department Stores and luxurious shops of the Fauborg Saint Honore. The hotel offers 36 rooms in a Napoleon III-style building with all modern equipment. They were all recently renovated. Free Wi-Fi access is available in rooms and public areas. Croissants and home-made pastries will help you start a good day. You have direct access to public transportation (subway, Paris RER, etc. ) to go to the business district of La Defense, Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, to reach Gare du Nord or to have fun at Disneyland® Paris.

190004.description: Located in the heart of a typically Parisian area such as La Butte aux Cailles or le Quartier Latin, the Amiral Hotel is a new property built in 2006 in a style with charm, tradition and elegance. As we care about details and well-being, we gave a special atmosphere to each room of the property. Most of them open out to nature through a small winter garden and flowered terraces. Thanks to its unique setting and our attentive staff, the Best Western Amiral Hotel is a charming and luxurious place where it is a real pleasure to meet. We offer 48 rooms and one suite with a private balcony and a unique view on the roofs of Paris. All rooms are equipped with modern services (air-conditioning, LCD cable television, radio, free WiFi access, bathrobe, mini-bar, safe. . . ). Of course, you have access to all other activities provided by the Best Western Amiral Hotel, indoor heated swimming pool, exercise room, and a business center including computer, printer, fax, and copy machine.

name.content: Best Western Premier Trocadero la Tour

190008.description: The Best Western Premier Trocadero La Tour is a charming hotel located just a stones throw from the Champs-Elysees and the Trocadero. In the heart of the prestigious 16th arrondissement, the Best Western Premier Trocadero La Tour welcomes you for a charming stay. Close to the rue de Passy with its elegant boutiques, the Eiffel Tower and the Champs de Mars, you are sure to be thrilled by our hotel which will meet all your expectations.

190009.description: A 5-minute walk from Notre Dame Cathedral, Île de la Cité and Île Saint-Louis, opposite the Sorbonne and right in the heart of the Latin Quarter, the Mercure Paris Notre Dame Saint Germain des Prés hotel enjoys a prime location. The hotel is easy to acces s from the RER B, RER C or Saint-Michel and Cluny-La-Sorbonne metro stations. Enjoy a relaxing stay in one of its comfortable, contemporary, air-conditioned rooms.

190013.description: The Best Western Plus Paris Saclay, freshly renovated combines comfort and tranquility in a prestigious setting. Located in the heart of the famous HEC Campus, you will find all the elements essential to the smooth running of your stay. You will discover a modern and contemporary feel, where the hospitality of its staff will make you feel at home. The hotel has 144 sound proofed and air conditioned rooms. Each of our rooms provides high quality bedding and optimal comfort. Feeling hungry? Want to take a break? You can enjoy a pleasant moment in a warm and contemporary atmosphere in our restaurant Le Magnolia and our bar l'Orchidee. You can also try our famous Planche or simply enjoy a glass of Grand Crus. To keep fit or to relax, a mini gym and sauna are at your disposal. The Golf de Saint Marc is located just five minutes from our hotel.

name.content: Hotel Litteraire Arthur Rimbaud, BW Signature Co

190024.description: Located in a peaceful little street between the Gare de l'Est train station and the Grands Boulevards, the Best Western Hotel Litteraire Arthur Rimbaud is centrally located, making it ideal for both business trips and breaks. We have 42 comfortable rooms and offer a continental breakfast buffet. Our hotel is located in one of the oldest districts in Paris, a vibrant atmosphere like no other awaits you immerse yourself in culture in one of the many cinemas or theatres, or take a look around the shops and the textile wholesalers.

190031.description: The hotel can be found in the centre of Paris right next to the Jardin du Luxembourg. Notre-Dame Cathedral is less than 1. 5 km away. Odeon Metro Station, which connects the hotel with other parts of the city, is only 450 meters away as is the Luxembourg RER Station, which provides access to Charles de Gaulle Airport. This stylish hotel is decorated in warm red and brown colours, featuring vintage elements which remind guests of the riches of French history and culture. Along with this, rooms are fitted with modern amenities such as flat-screen TVs with satellite channels and free wireless Internet access. They also feature an en-suite bathroom. The hotel serves a buffet breakfast each morning.

190036.description: In the heart of Paris, above one of Paris covered passages, close to the Opera Garnier, the Parisian department stores and the business centre. The Best Western Hotel Ronceray Opera offers you services and equipment blending luxury, history and modernism. In a prestigious setting that dates from the beginning of the nineteenth century our rooms and our conference facilities become your best allies. Completely refurbished and sound proof all 130 rooms offer an elegant quiet and restful setting. The authenticity of the decor is mixed with today's equipment: free Wi-Fi connection, air conditioning, private safety box, mini bar, television with International channels, direct line telephone.

190041.description: Housed in a large historic mansion decorated on the theme of Saint-Cloud bone china, Mercure Paris Saint-Cloud Hippodrome is ideal for hosting your private or professional receptions. We offer a meeting space - with an adjoining sunny terrace - that can accommodate up to 30 people. Our hotel in Saint-Cloud invites you to get to know the region as you view the exhibited works of area artists, enjoy a generous breakfast featuring local produces, and savour the dishes from our restaurant, La Villa.

190042.description: Located on the outskirts of the business districts of Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines and Trappes-Elancourt, not far from the Vallée de Chevreuse and the National Velodrome, the Mercure Maurepas Saint Quentin hotel provides an elegant setting for business or leisure stays. The Le Transat restaurant serves home-cooked food and you can eat on the terrace in summer. We have 5 modular meeting rooms that can accommodate up to 150 people, in a space especially designed to ensure the success of your meetings.

name.content: Best Western Plus l’Oree Paris Sud

190043.description: The Best Western Plus Hôtel L'Orée Paris Sud, a 4-star hotel, is housed in a majestic building within a lush, six-hectare park, accessible from its splendid terrace. This peaceful retreat, conveniently located near Orly Airport and Massy TGV station, is ideal for business trips, meetings, private events, or weekend getaways. Recently renovated by architect Fabien Roque in partnership with Atypio Hotels Resorts, the hotel offers contemporary spaces, including a library, bar-restaurant, A l'Epicerie boutique, media lounge, fitness center, and wellness areas. Adjacent to the hotel, you'll find Spa Aromes et bien-etre (independently operated). Enjoy local cuisine at the A l'Epicerie bar-restaurant, featuring seasonal dishes, regional specialties, and a unique cheese selection thanks to their exclusive two-meter cheese bell. The shop also sells gourmet products to take home. For business needs, the hotel provides eight well-equipped meeting rooms with high-speed internet access, as well as a library, media lounge, a terrace, and parking.

190106.description: This hotel is located on the Schloßstraße shopping street in the green Steglitz district, just a few minutes' drive from Berlin city centre. The A100 motorway is just a few minutes away offering easy access to ICC Exhibition Grounds, Tegel Airport and Schönefeld Airport. The hotel is across the street from the Schloss shopping centre. Rathaus Steglitz Underground Station is 100 metres away. The residence offers on-site parking facilities – very convenient for guests who wish to explore the region by car. The guestrooms feature a satellite TV and a spacious private bathroom with toiletries. There is a kitchenette equipped with hot drink facilities on each floor. Other alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages can be enjoyed in the hotel's bar. The in-house restaurant serves a variety of international dishes and a selection of wines.

190194.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a vending machine. Satisfy your appetite for dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 105 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

190217.description: Featuring an ideal location just 50 metres from Piazza San Marco and the Rialto Bridge, this beautiful boutique hotel in the heart of Venice is the perfect base from which to discover all the hidden treasures of the region. Housed in a former noble home of the mid-15th century, it offers a choice of tastefully decorated and finely furnished accommodation options that will delight even the most discerning travellers. Each room is dedicated to one of the apostles in honour of the nearby Church of the Holy Apostles. The nearest water bus stops are Ca' d'Oro for lines 1 and N and Marco Polo airport is just a 19-minute drive.

190256.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. Business travelers appreciate the 24-hour business center, complimentary wired internet, and express check-out. Host your Brooklyn event in our 1, 259 sq ft (117 sq m) event space, featuring a conference area and meeting room. Self-parking is available (charges apply). Our 70 guestrooms offer flat-screen TVs, pillowtop beds with down comforters, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access, along with cable programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, deep soaking bathtubs, and rainfall showerheads. Brooklyn Bridge Park is approximately 1. 9 miles (3. 1 km), Barclays Center Brooklyn is 2 miles (3. 2 km), and Prospect Park is 2. 3 miles (3. 7 km) from the hotel.

190308.description: The premises count with 35 welcoming rooms.

190326.description: A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 9 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Stay in one of 20 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Hyde Park - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Kensington Gardens - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Paddington Central - 0. 7 km / 0. 5 mi- Marble Arch - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Park Lane - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Baker Street - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Madame Tussauds Wax Museum - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Sherlock Holmes Museum - 1. 5 km / 1 mi- Selfridges - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Regent's Park - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Kensington High Street - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Kensington Palace - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Royal Albert Hall - 2 km / 1. 2 mi- Lord's Cricket Ground - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Bond Street - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi. The nearest airports are: London City Airport (LCY) - 20. 5 km / 12. 7 mi Heathrow Airport (LHR) - 28. 2 km / 17. 5 mi Gatwick Airport (LGW) - 67 km / 41. 6 mi Luton Airport (LTN) - 50. 9 km / 31. 6 mi The preferred airport for Avon Hotel is Heathrow Airport (LHR). A stay at Avon Hotel places you in the heart of London, within a 10-minute walk of Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. This hotel is 0. 9 mi (1. 5 km) from Marble Arch and 1. 5 mi (2. 3 km) from Oxford Street.

190370.description: Enjoy garden views at this Art Deco hotel in the heart of Paris, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. A business center, banquet hall, and vending machine are also available. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies), served from 7 AM to 10 AM. The 36 guestrooms offer flat-screen TVs with cable programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, safes, and desks. Located a short drive from UNESCO Headquarters and Beaugrenelle, the hotel is also convenient to the Eiffel Tower and Paris Expo.

190380.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy Regional cuisine at Dstrikt Steakhouse, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Vienna? This hotel has 3229 square feet (300 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 8 meeting rooms.

190400.description: Located in Miraflores, near the Pacific Ocean, Larcomar shopping center, and trendy restaurants and bars, this hotel offers rooms decorated in neutral colors. Each room features a king-size or two queen-size beds, air conditioning, and a plasma TV. Suites include a private hot tub. Guests can enjoy Peruvian cuisine at the hotel restaurant and access the gym, sauna, and jacuzzi on the eighth floor. A business center is available in the lobby for corporate travelers. Please note: Extra beds in triple rooms are smaller than standard beds. An 18% IGV tax applies to room rates, cancellations, and no-shows. A 10% city tax is also payable at the hotel.

190436.description: On the iconic Figueira Square, seconds from the historic Augusta Street, there is a story to be told: a planted tree on the sidewalk, guiding us on a journey towards Indoor nature. Away from the canons of conventional hospitality, Figueira by The Beautique Hotels is a place of singular experiences, the first unit of a unique collection of boutique hotels. With the body of a tree and the scent of ripe fruit, it is the fig tree personified. The design, signed by Nini de Andrade e Silva, award-winning Portuguese interior designer, invites you to dive into a magical and intimate narrative, full of unexpected details. On the ground floor, next to reception, the restaurant and bar welcome you into this journey with traditional Portuguese food. Figueira by the Beautique Hotels offers 50 rooms, divided into 4 sophisticated room types. There is also a small fitness room at your disposal.

190449.description: The latest of Booking Inn France's hotels portfolio, the Best Western Plus Paris Velizy is located in Velizy-Villacoublay, between the shopping mall V2 and Versailles city, on the west of Paris. This 4-star hotel, with a contemporary design, offers high-level services ideal for your business travel in the heart of the economic pole Inovel Park. A total of 161 rooms, one restaurant, one bar lounge, one fitness center, a terrace and more than 400 square meters of meeting rooms organized into ten different spaces, welcome you in a peaceful setting, inspired by plant and mineral elements. Indeed, the presence of a generous nature nearby the hotel, the National forest of Meudon, inspired the architecture agency Axel Schoenert Architects Associates (ASAA), the central theme and interior design of the hotel. With its 1000 hectares of green spaces and its dominating view of Paris, it constitutes a real oxygen bottle of Yvelines and will provide you great moments of relaxation, for a jog or a walk, during your stay. An attractive garden lines the hotel, in which every detail, service or equipment offered, respect the environment.

190452.description: Recently refurbished, this hotel is a beautiful London hotel with all the facilities the discerning business traveller or tourist would require. All rooms are accessible from the main reception. Situated on Holland Road, the Earls Court and Olympia Exhibition Centres, and Westfield London Shopping Centres are a stone's throw away. The central location in London gives easy access to many of London's top attractions and landmarks.

190453.address: Altunizade Mah. Kisikli Cad Oymaci Sok No 9 Altuni, 9
190453.description: Remarkable for its ideal location on Asian part of Istanbul, Mercure Istanbul Altunizade Hotel offers high-quality services. Representing Accor distinctiveness, the hotel comprises spacious rooms with large beds, working desk, lap-top safe, cable TV and exceptional TV armchair. After a busy trip, soothing spa, massage and Turkish bath pleasure revitalize the body and soul. Hotel's indoor pool and fitness are alternatives to keep fit during the stay. Its 12 meeting rooms host about 260 guests.

190454.address: Guzelyurt Mah. Haramidere E-5 Karayolu, Kuzey Yany, 5-7
190454.description: The ibis Istanbul Esenyurt Hotel is located in Beylikdüzü, a vibrant district in western Istanbul. It's within walking distance of Marmara Park, one of Istanbul's largest shopping centers, and offers easy access to public transportation, including regular airport shuttles. Discover nearby natural gems such as Beylikdüzü and Büyükçekmece beaches, perfect for a summer escape. Beylikdüzü Marina, Bahçeşehir Lake, and the Bahçeşehir Aquapark provide additional recreational options.

190505.description: Enhanced cleaning and safety standards in place including Clean and Safe and Safe Travels facility accreditation. Visit hotel website for more details. This hotel is conveniently situated in Lisbon's city centre, only 300 m from Saldanha metro station and 10 minutes from Arroios metro station, providing easy access to all parts of the city. The Jardim Amalia Rodrigues park is only a short walk away, while the famous attractions of Belem Tower, the National Museum of Ancient Art and the National Museum of Costume and Fashion are easily accessible via public transport. Lisbon Airport is just 5. 3 km from the hotel. The hotels inviting guest rooms feature trendy, original designs, equipped with convenient amenities that guests need during the stay. Whether travelling to Lisbon for business or pleasure, this hotel's welcoming, laid-back atmosphere, accessible location and modern amenities make it an ideal choice.
