190531.description: This apartment complex enjoys a prime setting in the neighbourhood of Sants, amidst the excitement and splendour of Barcelona. The complex is located just 500 metres away from the iconic Camp Nou stadium of FC Barcelona. The beach is situated just 6. 5 km away. The complex is located just a short metro ride away from the centre of the city, where guests can explore the elegant boulevards of Ensanche and Paso de Gracia. The Ramblas, La Bouqueria Market and the Gothic Quarter are situated nearby. This wonderful complex comprises modern, beautifully-designed apartments. Guests will appreciate the comfort and convenience that this complex has to offer.

190533.description: The Pausania Hotel enjoys a prime location in Venice's Dorsoduro district, along the San Barnaba Canal. Housed in a beautifully restored 14th-century Gothic palace, this elegant 3-star hotel offers a tranquil private garden, perfect for a romantic Venetian getaway. Guests can enjoy breakfast on the veranda overlooking the garden, relax in the second-floor sitting room, or grab a coffee at the bar. Rooms are tastefully furnished and equipped with modern amenities, including private bathrooms, cable TV, and air conditioning. Additional services include 24-hour room service, internet access, secretarial services, and conference rooms. The hotel is easily accessible from the Santa Lucia train station and Piazzale Roma via the vaporetto line 1 to Ca' Rezzonico.

190539.description: Designed with the latest energy-saving technology, the new Palace Hotel Legnano caters to modern travelers, offering a range of services for both business and leisure. Legnano's strategic location in Lombardy places it just 15 minutes from Milan's city center and Malpensa International Airport, and 10 minutes from the Rho/Pero exhibition center. A fabulous setting for your dream holiday!

190542.description: The Best Western Mirage Hotel Fiera, built in 1994, offers a strategic retreat after a long day. Located in Paderno Dugnano, a small village just six kilometers from Milan, its convenient location—outside the city center yet easily accessible—makes it ideal for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel's 65 spacious, comfortable rooms have been extensively refurbished for enhanced appeal. Guests enjoy free high-speed Wi-Fi and a generous breakfast buffet each morning. Relax in the peaceful garden, unwind with a drink in the cozy bar, or savor traditional Italian cuisine in the restaurant. Secure underground parking is also available. The Fiera Milano Exhibition Centre in Rho is just 12 kilometers away and easily accessible by car or train. Milan's city center is also well-connected by public transport, and a shuttle service to the nearest railway station (Palazzolo Milanese) is available upon reservation. For corporate events, the hotel's Congress Center features five function rooms.

190850.description: The hotel is an impressive farmhouse, built in the 17th century and remains a beautiful country style hotel full of character. The hotel is located in the Warwickshire Countryside, in Sutton Coldfield, just 10 minutes away from the Birmingham International Airport. The charming guestrooms are elegantly furnished, perfect for a romantic getaway. The hotel features a beautiful garden where guests can go for relaxing walks. The Courtyard restaurant serves a wide variety of healthy options and traditional dishes and guests can enjoy an evening at the bar, where they will also be able to savour pub classics. The common areas are traditionally decorated, with fireplaces and wooden beams.

190868.description: The Refinery Hotel stands in the heart of the garment district, blocks from Bryant Park, the theater district, Times Square, and the Empire State Building. The chic décor and artistic ambience are shot through with industrial accents that hark to the building's early-19th century milliners and hat factories. Must be 21 years of age to check-in. Unless notified prior to, or at check-in, a one night penalty will apply to departures that occur earlier than the date specified on the original reservation.

name.content: Movenpick Hotel Apartments Al Mamzar Dubai

190955.address: 46 Th St. Al Mamzar Area - Corner Of Cairo Road
190955.description: Mövenpick Hotel Apartments Al Mamzar Dubai is nestled in the elegant district of Al Mamzar, close to Al Mamzar Beach Park, DAFZA, Sharjah, Deira and Bur Dubai. Located just 10 minutes away from Dubai International Airport with easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road, the hotel is a central choice for business, leisure and long term guests. The hotel provides 180 comfortable guest rooms as well as one- and two-bedroom serviced hotel apartments.

190972.description: Located in Sant Marti, Barcelona this holiday hotel is 600 metres from Bogatell Beach. It is also close to Sagrada Familia, Arc de Triomf and Barcelona Cathedral. A metro station can be found just a few hundred metres away connecting the hotel with the centre of Barcelona. The establishment comprises a total of 250 air-conditioned guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs and partnered with a private bathroom. All units have parquetted floors and are designed in colourful simplicity. In-room wireless Internet access is also available and it is complimentary in the public areas of the hotel. This is a non-smoking property. A restaurant is available on site and further dining options can be found down the street. The hotel has a café and an elegant lounge bar.

190987.description: The remodeled Hotel Pullman Santiago Vitacura is fabulously located in one of the most sophisticated areas of the Chilean capital, close to Bicentennial Park, shopping malls, art galleries, bars, and restaurants. With incredible views of the mountain range, Pullman Vitacura has a fitness center, terraces, an outdoor pool, covered parking, free WIFI in all common areas, and more.

191052.description: The accomodation features a total of 24 rooms. Those staying at this property may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. Pension 45 offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. The hostel may charge a fee for some services.

191076.description: The 4-star Rawabi Hotel & Spa offers comfort and convenience whether you're on business or holiday in Marrakech. The property offers a wide range of amenities and perks to ensure you have a great time. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, gift/souvenir shop, private check in/check out, taxi service are just some of the facilities on offer. Comfortable guestrooms ensure a good night's sleep with some rooms featuring facilities such as flat screen television, mirror, closet, air conditioning, desk. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Rawabi Hotel & Spa combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make your stay in Marrakech unforgettable.

191079.description: This outstanding hotel boasts a stunning setting in Marrakech, lying just a 10 minutes' walking distance from Jemaa El Fna Square. The hotel is located within easy access of a host of mesmerising attractions in this captivating city. The hotel affords guests an insight into the rich culture and history of the surroundings. The hotel enjoys a delectable architectural style, inviting guests into the luxurious surroundings of the interior. The guest rooms are exquisitely appointed, providing a cocoon of peace and serenity in which to indulge in the ultimate comfort and relaxation. This magnificent hotel enjoys a charming interior design, embodying the essence of Moroccan style. The hotel provides a wide range of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of discerning business and leisure travellers.

191089.description: Riad Cle De Sol, a charming Moroccan riad located in AGHMAT, a historic area of Marrakech, offers an authentic Moroccan experience. Just 35 minutes from Marrakech's bustling center, including Jemaa El Fna square, this tranquil oasis features thirteen individually decorated rooms and suites, adorned with Moroccan antiques and contemporary touches. Explore the intricate staircases, peaceful courtyards, and lush gardens. The riad also boasts a spa and hammam, allowing guests to fully immerse themselves in Moroccan culture. Enjoy delicious, healthy spa cuisine at L'Orangerie restaurant, with its terrace overlooking the breathtaking Atlas Mountains. Alternatively, savor traditional Moroccan teas at the Panoramic bar. Experience exceptional hospitality from Khalid and his team, making your stay at Riad Cle De Sol an unforgettable retreat.

191091.description: The Hotel Indigo® Berlin Ku’damm hotel, just opposite the University of the Arts, blends beautifully with our busy cultural district. Inspired by the light and atmosphere of a neighborhood artist’s studio, our rooms and lobby are designed in a bright, modern style that forms a strong connection with the area. The artistic theme continues in each room, with neighborhood-inspired murals and stylish furniture. Our restaurant and bar offer locally sourced ingredients and an extensive drink menu, while our lobby tips its hat to the city’s booming modern art scene found right outside.

191109.description: Thos Hotel Located in the heart of Bogota's financial and business quarter, and just 45 minutes from the El Dorado International Airport, this attractive hotel provides the ideal base for both business and leisure travel. The hotel is surrounded by the city's finest restaurants, and the renowned shops of El Retiro, Atlantis Plaza and Centro Andino shopping centres can be reached in ten minutes. Visitors may wish to take a stroll through the Candelaria district, and visit the Gold Museum, Botero Museum, Palace of Nariño and Cathedral of Colombia.

191132.description: With a small number of only 15, this hotel is very convenient for a quiet stay. All guests staying at this property may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Artrip Madrid. The reception desk is open all day long.

name.content: Ramada Plaza by Wyndham Istanbul Tekstilkent

191145.description: Enjoy a refreshing stay in Istanbul at the Ramada Plaza by Wyndham Istanbul Tekstilkent near Ataturk International Airport, Ataturk Olympic Stadium, Forum Istanbul Shopping Mall and Tekstilkent business district. Host a conference for up to 800 people in one or more of eight state-of-the art event rooms. There is also valet parking onsite for a nominal fee and complimentary wireless Internet throughout the building and in guest rooms. Onsite restaurant serves international and Turkish cuisine. The modern health club offers sauna, Turkish bath, indoor swimming pool and steam room, along with fitness equipment and massage service onsite. Spacious hotel rooms feature minibar, hair dryer, coffee/tea maker, work desk and rain shower.

191146.description: Located in the newly popular district of Tophane, this modern and contemporary hotel is just 350 m from Istanbul's Museum of Modern Art and across from the Bosphorus. Decorated in muted tones. Tophane tram station and funicular are within close proximity providing easy access to the Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue, 1 km away as well as the historical attractions at Sultanahmet, 3.5 km from the hotel.

191173.description: Enjoy the Floride Etoile Hotel for its central location between the Champs Elysées, the Trocadero esplanade and the Eiffel Tower in the heart of the prestigious 16th arrondissement of Paris. You will come back for the warm welcome and personalized service that the entire team affords you. The hotel features 60 completely renovated and air-conditioned rooms with free WIFI. It offers a delicious breakfast buffet in the dining room and a continental breakfast which is served in your room. You will love our club and executive rooms in neutral and bright tones. Some of the "Executive" rooms which are more spacious, have also a small living room or a third bed. For your business meetings and presentations, our hotel has a flexible room that can accommodate up to 50 people.

191200.description:
The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Concierge, Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Spa.The following services and amenities are currently not available: Executive Lounge, Pool.The Waldorf Astoria Berlin welcomes its guests in the heart of Berlin's City West with contemporary luxury combined with unparalleled Waldorf Service. 232 generous rooms and suites provide quiet comfort in an eclectic mix of warm colors and modern Art Deco style. 

Guests experience an air of refined exclusivity at Germany's first Guerlain Spa. ROCA offers an all-day, dining experience featuring seasonal Eastern Mediterranean cuisine while the Library Lounge on the 15th floor is exclusively reserved for hotel guests. Epic views and sophisticated ambiance are constant companions, while Berlin's legendary shopping boulevard Kurfuerstendamm is just a stroll away.

191203.description: This modern, newly built hotel offers comfort and convenience in a residential area close to Madrid's main commercial and business districts. Its prime location near Calle Alcalá, Madrid-Barajas Airport, and the IFEMA convention center, along with easy access to public transportation, makes it an ideal choice for both business and leisure travelers.

191205.description:
With a stay at Hostal Goya, you'll be centrally located in Barcelona, steps from Tivoli Theatre and 3 minutes by foot from Passeig de Gracia.  This hostal is 0.2 mi (0.3 km) from Placa de Catalunya and 0.3 mi (0.4 km) from La Rambla.
Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services.
Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.
Make yourself at home in one of the 19 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have bathtubs or showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include safes and blackout drapes/curtains, and housekeeping is provided daily.

191206.description: A total of 19 units are available for guests' convenience at Hostal Girona. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. Hostal Girona does not operate a 24-hour reception. This hotel is committed to upholding environmentally friendly practices.

191207.description: This apartment complex is just a 15-minute tube ride from Stratford's Olympic Village, placing you near London's exciting attractions. Surrey Quays and Canada Water Station are easily accessible. The beautifully designed studios prioritize comfort and convenience with modern amenities, ensuring a pleasant stay in this vibrant city.

191213.description: Boasting a unique location in Milan, this luxurious boutique hotel is the perfect place to enjoy a romantic getaway or a family holiday in this beautiful Italian region. Milan Malpensa Airport is a 43-minute drive while Bergamo Orio al Serio International Airport is some 55 kilometres away. Based in attention to detail, this luxurious, stylish property offers a wide choice of unique accommodation options to make travellers' stay a memorable experience. All the guest rooms have been tastefully decorated and finely furnished, providing a comfortable yet bold atmosphere. They all come with state-of-the-art technology and hypoallergenic mattresses for guests' convenience. The onsite facilities include fully-equipped fitness centre and spa.

191220.description:
015146-ALB-00075 / IT015146A1JSASQHFG DAC7 MI-1285217 
Neighbouring Milan's Central Station this hotel is a preferable accommodation for guests travelling on a budget. Its 62 soundproofed, traditionally decorated rooms are furnished with various useful amenities and fitted with carpeted floors, creating a cosy, home-like atmosphere. The hotel has a reading room with a library, which provides visitors with a quiet entertainment option. The hotel's bar works exclusively with guests and serves a variety of refreshments. A buffet-style breakfast is served every morning. Free parking facilities are available in the neighbourhood and guests can enjoy free WiFi connection in all areas of the hotel.

191298.description:
Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam – Schiphol is located just one train stop away from Schiphol Airport and right outside Amsterdam, which gives it an ideal location. The most convenient and sustainable way to reach the hotel is per train which is a short 5-minute ride away from Schiphol Airport to Hoofddorp Station and from here the hotel is located on a short 9-minute walk. Between 05:30 and 23:30 trains with a stop at Hoofddorp Station depart every 5 to 10 minutes and costs €2, 60 per person to be paid beforehand at a yellow ticket station at the airport. Alternatively, the hotel can be reached with a short 8-minute taxi ride which will cost approximately €30 one-way. 

A daily ‘Express Start Continental Breakfast’ buffet is available for all our guests, which is included in the room price. The modern hotel rooms are fully equipped to make your stay as pleasant as possible. This includes free WiFi throughout the hotel, a television with various international channels, and complimentary coffee and tea-making facilities. Depending on your choice, your room has one double bed or two single beds. The bathroom has a walk-in shower and toiletries. 

Amsterdam city center is located 15 minutes away from the hotel and if you are looking for an activity in nature, then the Haarlemmermeerse Bos offers many ways to explore. Let our partner restaurants pick you up from the hotel complimentary and enjoy a wide range of culinarian options.

name.content: Le Marcel Paris Gare de l'Est

191302.description: Being across the street from Paris' Gare de l'Est and only 900 metres from Gare du Nord, this city hotel is well connected not only with other parts of the city, but also with the neighbouring counties. It is only 1.6 km from Montmartre and offers easy access to Champs Elysees and CDG Airport.  All 28 soundproofed guestrooms feature an elegant design and carpeted floors. All units are fitted with a flat-screen TV with cable channels and individually controlled heating. From the large windows visitors can enjoy scenic views of the city. Guests who wish to take a day of rest from sightseeing can surf the web through the free wireless Internet provided in all areas of the hotel.

191309.address: Sabiha Gokcen Uluslararasi Havalimani Yani,Kurtkoy, N/A
191309.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including a sauna and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and 4 meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 128 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and bathrobes. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and electric kettles.

191315.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Grab a bite to eat at one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 590 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature bathtubs or showers with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

191336.address: Fray Justo Santa Maria de Oro 1828
191336.description: 1828 Smart Hotel is the most exclusive Luxury Boutique Hotel in the fashionable Palermo Soho district, steps away from the best restaurants and design shops. Since your arrival, you will enjoy our exquisite decoration details in every corner: from the astonishing Lobby Lounge with its marvellous white piano, to the relaxing outdoor heated swimming pool with its awesome 8 mt. water cascade or its delicate and charming rooms and suites. 1828 Smart Hotel invites you to enjoy a unique and innovative experience, using a tablet given at your arrival to have access to all our services and manage the devices at the room: open and closing the curtains, turning on/off the lights, controlling the temperature, checking your account among other many functions. 1828 Smart Hotel is a jewel  in the heart of the city.

191350.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace at Cihangir Hotel Bosphorus, located in Istanbul's vibrant Taksim district. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and take advantage of convenient concierge services. Savor delicious Turkish cuisine at Kupeste, the hotel's restaurant and bar, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, served from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. The hotel offers a computer station, express check-in/check-out, and free valet parking. For events, there's 700 square feet of conference and meeting space. Each of the 51 guestrooms features a minibar, LCD TV with cable programming, and a private bathroom with a rainfall showerhead. Additional conveniences include a safe, desk, and phone. Cihangir Hotel Bosphorus is a short walk from Istiklal Avenue and Galataport, and close to Taksim Square and the Bosphorus.

191360.address: Gran Via De Les Corts Catalanes, 629
191360.description: At the Hotel Indigo Barcelona Plaza Catalunya, design and decor take inspiration from the neighborhood’s architectural masterpieces. Take, for instance, our Gaudí-inspired lobby and guest room murals, and the patterned fabrics and artwork that showcase our community’s history. Outside our doors, it’s a short walk to the Gaudí original—Casa Batlló—as well as the cafes and street performers of La Rambla, the Temple de la Sagrada Familia, and countless shops and boutiques. At Hotel Indigo Barcelona Plaza Catalunya Cocktail & Snack Bar, you may enjoy a drink or a snack after a day of exploring, also, our poolside terrace is perfect places to soak up the atmosphere over a glass of local cava.

191370.address: C Don Ramon De La Cruz, 41
191370.description: This delightful apartment complex is situated at the heart of the Salamanca district of Madrid. The complex is located close to the subway, enjoying ease of access to other areas of the city. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from Castello and Principe de Vergara. The complex lies just 100 metres from the Plaza del Marques de Salamanca, and offers ease of access to the stylish area of the Parque del Retiro. Guests can explore the delights that the area has to offer, as well as the fashionable shops, dining options and entertainment venues. This wonderful complex greets guests with the promise of a memorable stay. The apartments are beautifully appointed, enjoying refreshing, neutral tones and luxurious furnishings. Guests can enjoy a host of excellent facilities and services at this complex.

191385.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and an indoor pool. Additional amenities at this riad include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The riad also offers room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 11 AM. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a train station pick-up service. Make yourself at home in one of the 8 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have showers and complimentary toiletries.

191386.address: 71 Derb Sidi Lahcen Ouali Bab Doukkala
191386.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting at the heart of the Medina in Marrakech. The hotel is located just a short walking distance from Jemaa El Fna Square and the Majorelle Gardens. This magnificent hotel allows for ease of access to the captivating attractions that the city has to offer. This superb hotel enjoys a traditional architectural style, blending effortlessly with its charming surroundings. The interior displays the beauty and charm of Moroccan style. The guest rooms are superbly appointed, featuring a combination of neutral and muted tones for a relaxing ambience. The hotel invites guests to dine in style in the restaurant, and savour the delectable delights the menu has to offer.

191435.description: This aparthotel enjoys a prime Bur Dubai setting, a short 10-minute drive from Jumeirah Beach and just 1 km from Burjuman Shopping Centre. Dubai Airport is a convenient 7 km away. Explore the city's cultural and historical attractions from this ideal location. The luxurious apartments offer a relaxing home away from home, complete with modern amenities for added comfort. Guests can enjoy an energetic workout in the fitness centre, followed by a refreshing swim in the pool. Appreciate the excellent facilities this charming complex has to offer.

191436.description:
This hotel is located near the Mall Galleries Auchan in Monza, near Valassina Nuova Road and only 2 kilometres from the A4 motorway exit to Venice. Villa Reale is just minutes from the hotel, and Monza race circuit is only a 15-minute drive away. This strategic location means that guests will be able to quickly and easily reach Milan, the city of design, new technology, art and fashion. The hotel offers spacious, modern rooms and friendly service for a pleasant and restful stay.
Please note that the reception will be closed from 23.00 to 07.00. For arrival in this time, please get in touch with the hotel at least 48 hours before.

191437.description: Boasting a prime location in the heart of London, this hotel offers the perfect place for those guests wishing to discover this vibrant city. It is within walking distance of some of the capital's main tourist attractions, such as the world renowned London Eye, the Tower of London and The Houses of Parliament. It is just 1.6 kilometres away from Waterloo train station. All the guest rooms guarantee total comfort for a relaxing stay, offering tea and coffee facilities and Wi-Fi connection (charges apply). They all are tastefully decorated and attention is paid to every single detail. This establishment is an ideal base to explore this bustling city, perfect for young people and budget travellers.

191438.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting in the Stratford area of London. The hotel is located within easy access of a host of attractions in the city, making this a great choice for those who are eager to explore the area. A host of shopping, dining and entertainment venues can be found nearby. London City Airport is conveniently located just 5.2 km away. This charming hotel greets guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, offering comfort and modern conveniences. The hotel affords guests excellent customer service, ensuring a relaxing stay for business and leisure travellers.

191488.description: Welcome to Fairmont The Palm, a heritage Arabian-inspired resort in Dubai. Situated on the iconic Palm Jumeirah, offering breathtaking views of the Marina and Arabian Gulf. Enjoy an exceptional choice of restaurants and soulful hospitality, relax on our private beach, cool off in one of our 8 pools, work out in the gym, or take sanctuary in Willow Stream Spa. A truly memorable Arabian experience awaits in the heart of Dubai.

191498.description: This cosy hotel is in Athens. There are a total of 36 units on the premises. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the hotel. The reception is open 24/7 and 24-hour available. Elite Hotel does not offer cots on demand. This hotel follows green practices. Elite Hotel has a great location on Pireos Street, just 3 minutes walk from Omonia Square and 10 minutes from the old town

191511.address: rue moulay ismal -50 metres de la place -Dejema e
191511.description: This upscale hotel enjoys a prime setting at the heart of the Medina in Marrakech. The hotel is situated within easy access of the Maison de la Photographie, Jemaa El Fna Square, Marrakech Museum, Ben Youssef Mosque and Almoravid Koubba. This luxurious hotel beautifully presents the charm and culture of Morocco in its design. Enjoying a pristine, white-washed exterior and beautifully-appointed interior, the hotel tempts guests into a world of luxury and style. The guest rooms are simplistic in style, oozing character and poise. The hotel offers a range of excellent facilities, meeting the needs of every type of traveller. For comfort, convenience and luxury in Marrakech, guests need look no further.

name.content: Trump International Hotel and Tower New York

191517.description: Overlooking Central Park and steps from Columbus Circle, Lincoln Center, and Fifth Avenue, this luxurious hotel offers access to the best shopping and nightlife New York City has to offer. As the only hotel in Manhattan with Forbes Five-Star, AAA Five-Diamond, and two Michelin-starred restaurant ratings, Trump International Hotel and Tower New York will exceed your expectations.

191518.description: This boutique hotel is located in the centre of Manhattan, just a short walk to Madison Square Garden and Herald Square Subway. Times Square can be reached within 5 minutes by subway and the Empire State Building is also close by. A variety of stores and restaurants surround the property. Situated inside a historic building, the establishment offers a unique style developed by local artists and designers. Guests of the hotel can dine at the on-site restaurant and bar. They are also welcomed to enjoy gourmet coffee in the cafe and live music in the hotel lobby. Each guest room is individually designed and features modern amenities including a flat-screen TV and an iPod dock.

191519.description: This hotel offers guests high-class accommodation and extraordinary service. It brings a new perspective of Manhattan, providing unparalleled views of the city from the floor-to-ceiling windows in the deluxe and premiere rooms and suites. There is a wide range of recreation opportunities offered by the establishment to meet any desire and need. A SPA centre, featuring luxury hammam, relaxation rooms and a number of treatments, is provided for those who wish to fully relax. Business travellers are offered the use of exclusive meeting and event spaces equipped with modern technology. Guests are welcomed to dine at the on-site signature restaurant, which features an imaginative menu of contemporary Japanese cuisine.

191520.description:
The hotel offers 249 luxury rooms and remarkable suites, most with lofty ceilings, Juliet balconies, and five-fixture bathrooms. A signature rooftop pool for sunbathing and a rooftop bar are only a fraction of the leisure options provided. High-speed Internet access is available throughout the property and wheelchair access is provided. 

•     The Rooftop Restaurant and Lounge offers dining throughout the day. We will offer preferred reservations, seating and VIP welcome for hotel guests operated by Tao Restaurants. They have various restaurants in the city. The concierge can assist. 24 In-room dining will be available throughout.
•	We can offer in-room spa/beauty treatments by NOMI Beauty, our preferred partner. We also offer discounts to Exhale Spa off the property.
•	We offer a work out room on 4th floor available 7am-9pm daily. We offer complimentary access to  24 Hour Fitness and New York Sports. We also provide discounts for Barry's Boot Camp and Flywheel.

191521.description: Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including a nightclub, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at Blue Ribbon Sushi Izakaya, a restaurant which specializes in Japanese cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 3 bars/lounges. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 136 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring iPod docking stations and LCD televisions. Cable television is provided for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Lower East Side Tenement Museum - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- New York University - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Washington Square Park - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- 5th Avenue - 1.

191527.description: The Standard, High Line, located in Manhattan's Meatpacking District, offers stunning views of the Hudson River and the High Line park from its floor-to-ceiling windows. This 337-room hotel provides guests with modern in-room technology and convenient access to the West Side Highway, Javits Center, SoHo, and the Financial District. Each room features either a king or queen platform bed (maximum 2 guests). Enjoy the hotel's vibrant atmosphere with options ranging from a bustling biergarten and rooftop discothèque (Le Bain) to sunset jazz and cocktails at Top of The Standard. The award-winning Standard Grill also offers al fresco dining. Check-in is at 3 pm, and check-out is at noon.

191590.description: Experience the warmth and vibrancy of our industrial-chic hotel in El Born, nestled between the historic Gothic Quarter and the tranquil Ciutadella Park. Just minutes from the port, our location offers easy access to iconic landmarks like the Barcelona Cathedral, Santa Maria del Mar, and the Picasso Museum. Explore nearby bars, restaurants, and nightclubs, or enjoy the serene beauty of the zoo and beaches.

191594.description: Hostal Numancia is located in Madrid's city center, a 7-minute walk from Puerta del Sol, the city's main square. It offers a 24-hour reception and simple rooms with free WiFi and flat-screen TVs. Guests can prepare meals in the shared kitchen. Bathrooms are also shared. The Numancia is a 3-minute walk from Anton Martin and Tirso de Molina metro stations, providing easy access to all parts of the city. It's a 10-minute walk from the Prado, Reina Sofia, and Thyssen Museums, while the Royal Palace and El Rastro flea market are a 15-minute walk away. Madrid City Center is a great choice for travelers interested in tapas, architecture, and parks.

191614.description: 110 Years In the Remaking. Derived from the style coveted by the leisure and business set, HGU New York awakens all senses and consistently impresses. This is not Midtown; this is NoMad.

191692.description: The Taksim Galataport FRZ Burak Hotel located in the city centre, this luxurious hotel and suites is conveniently situated in Istanbul Taksim, close to some of the capital's main tourist attractions and historical venues, such as mosques of the Ottoman Empire, Topkapi Palace and the Hagia Sophia Museum. There are plenty of restaurants, cafés, bars and shops within walking distance. Istanbul International Airport lies 40 km away. This state-of-the-art establishment offers a choice of accommodation options to suit all clients' needs. They all are tastefully decorated and offer all the necessary amenities to ensure a comfortable stay, such as air-conditioning and a modern private bathroom. Guests are welcomed to the restaurant that combines the best of local cuisine with international tastes.

191710.description:
Hostal Nilo is a budget accommodation situated in a historic 1863 building which is perfectly located right in the heart of the Gothic quarter in the city centre. Our hostel is just one hundred meters away from Barcelona´s most famous boulevard Las Ramblas. It is one of the best areas in Barcelona for bars, restaurants, and multiple shops.
All our rooms are clean and cozy, you will feel like at home here. The property provides a 24-hour front desk and free WiFi. Barcelona attractions including Picasso Museum, The Cathedral, La Boqueria market, Barceloneta Beach and many others are within a walking distance from our hostel.
It is easy to get to the hostel from the Airport by Aerobus that will drop you at Plaza Catalunya which is 15 min walk from Hostal Nilo. Metro station Drassanes (Green Line-L3) is less than 5 min walk.

191721.description: The hotel opened its doors for the first time in 1967 in the Retiro district, one of the most vibrant and distinctive areas of the capital. Its carefully designed interior, decorated with a hint of the American and Classical British styles, creates an individual and highly sophisticated ambience.The hotel is only a few minutes walk from the renowned Parque del Retiro, from where the most prominent tourist and artistic areas of the capital can easily be reached: the Prado, Reina Sofia and Thyssen Bornemisza Museums, the Madrid of the Austrias, Puerta de Alcala, Plaza Cibeles, etc.

name.content: Bellevue Luxury Rooms - San Marco Luxury

191781.description:
In St. Mark's Square - the Heart of Venice. Bellevue Luxury Rooms offer the perfect setting for a dream vacation in the heart of Venice, just a few steps from San Marco Square, next to the beautiful Clock Tower ("Torre dell'Orologio"). 

An intimate, refined and exclusive atmosphere, enhanced with Venetian style furnishings and rare textiles ensure an unforgettable experience enjoyed in complete comfort. 

The rooms and apartments have adjustable air conditioning, wi-fi Internet, flat screen satellite TV and a stereo system.

191794.description: Situated in the heart of Midtown Manhattan, at 48th Street and Lexington Avenue, this hotel offers easy access to New York City's top attractions. Experience a unique blend of personalized concierge service and contemporary art and design. Guest rooms feature a chic, elegant style. A wide array of amenities ensures both comfort and an unforgettable stay. Please note there is a $50 nightly facility fee plus tax.

191810.description:
"Our London Feltham hotel puts you within striking distance of some of the region's best-loved sights and attractions, including the iconic Twickenham Rugby Ground and the historic Kempton Park Racecourse.

Flight to catch? Get jet set and go from nearby Heathrow Airport, just 3.3 miles away. Meanwhile, thrill-seekers should make a beeline for Thorpe Park, or for a more laid back day out, try Hampton Court Palace.

All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals."

191818.description:
Located in the heart of a residential area, a few steps from the Parc Expo Porte de Versailles exhibition centre, La Conversation is much more than just a hotel. It is a haven of peace on a human scale, comprising 62 intimate rooms which invite you to get away from the daily hubbub to find comfort and serenity. 

As soon as you arrive, you will be greeted warmly, as though you were entering a private home. Our wine bar, located on the ground floor, is the true heart of our establishment. This is where new conversations and sharing begin between colleagues, friends or family. It is where you can meet in a friendly and relaxed atmosphere.

191870.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at Hotel Klassik Berlin, located in the heart of Berlin, a 15-minute walk from the East Side Gallery and Mercedes-Benz Arena. This hotel offers a bistro specializing in Mediterranean cuisine, room service, and a bar/lounge. Daily buffet breakfast is available (fee applies). Amenities include a business center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The 59 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs with cable, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Safes and desks are also provided.

191878.description: Strategically located in the Jardim América district, Mercure São Paulo Pinheiros welcomes guests seeking an authentic experience. Comfortable rooms for couples and singles, with adaptations for reduced mobility and offices. All with A/C and free Wi-Fi. La Terrina restaurant serves a full breakfast and the best of Italian cuisine for lunch and dinner. Event rooms, business center, pool, sauna and gym.

191879.address: Rua Santa Justina, 210 Vila Olimpia Sao Paulo - Sp
191879.description: Enjoy this hotel's many amenities, including a sauna, fitness center, and bicycle rentals. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, and take advantage of concierge services and an on-site hair salon. The hotel features both a restaurant, La Forchetta, and 24-hour room service. Unwind at the bar/lounge or poolside bar, and start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies). Business travelers appreciate the 24-hour business center, express check-in, and check-out. Event facilities include a conference center and seven meeting rooms. The 207 air-conditioned rooms offer minibars, Smart TVs, and digital programming. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks are also provided. Located near Ibirapuera Park, Shopping Vila Olimpia, and Avenida Engenheiro Luís Carlos Berrini, the hotel provides easy access to key attractions. São Paulo (CGH-Congonhas) Airport is the closest airport.

191887.description: Situated just 10 minutes from the Rio-Niterói Bridge, the Quality Hotel Niterói offers a strategic location for business travelers across various sectors, including offshore, logistics, and energy. It also presents an excellent leisure option, boasting outdoor pools with stunning views of Guanabara Bay, along with a bar and restaurant. Comfortable beds and spacious bathrooms provide a relaxing retreat at the end of the day. Our accommodations are designed for your comfort and well-being, ensuring a welcoming experience away from home. We emphasize that the contracted daily rate is for 24 hours, with check-in from 2 p. m. and check-out until 12 p. m. The interval of up to 3 hours between guests' departure and arrival is provided for in MTur Ordinance No. 28 and is intended exclusively for cleaning, sanitizing, and tidying up the unit, ensuring the maintenance of our standard of excellence

191891.address: Av Doutor Mario Guimaraes 520 Avenida Doutor Mario
191891.description: The Mercure Rio de Janeiro Nova Iguaçu hotel is located in the center of the city of Nova Iguaçu, near the bus station and train station, surrounded by great restaurants and 5 minutes from the Nova Iguaçu and TopShopping shopping centers. Combining qualit y and refinement in air-conditioned rooms with WIFI, the hotel offers the best facilities for corporate and social events in Baixada Fluminense. The leisure area features a pool, fitness center, games room, hot tub, sauna and squash court.

191892.description: Stay just 438 yards (400 m) from Santos Dumont Airport in Rio de Janeiro. The Novotel RJ Santos Dumont hotel offers spacious, functional apartments, in addition to WIFI, a sauna, events center and fitness center. You can also sample regional cuisine in the comfort and tranquility of the restaurant, and enjoy special drinks in the hotel bar. During your stay, you and your family can enjoy modern, comprehensives facilities that will ensure your comfort and well-being.

191895.description: The Mercure São Paulo Paraiso hotel is next to Av. Paulista, one block from Paraíso metro station and opposite the São Paulo Cultural Center. The hotel is a few blocks from Paulista shopping center and a few minutes from Congonhas Airport. Its strategic l ocation enables easy access for those keen to visit the Liberdade area, São Paulo's Japanese district with its typical restaurants and stores, and Ibirapuera Park, which is just a few miles from the hotel.

191928.address: Sansao Alves Dos Santos Brooklin Sao Paulo - Sp
191928.description: The Adagio SP Aparthotel features flats and apartments with up to 2 rooms and a fully equipped kitchen. Leisure facilities with pool, playground and fitness center. Laundry with automatic machines for guest use. Close to the city's important convention ce nters, such as the WTC and Expo Transamérica and also to Av. Eng. Luiz Carlos Berrini, home to a number of the country's biggest companies. Easy access to the city's main travel routes and the Morumbi, Vila Olímpia and JK Iguatemi shopping centers.

191935.description: Hostal Europa features a total of 44 units.

191954.description:
Located in the city centre, Taksim Express Hotel is just a few steps from Lutfi Kirdar Convention and Exhibition Centre. The hotel offers air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi.

Modernly decorated, each room includes an LCD TV and a minibar. All rooms offer views and a safety deposit box.

The hotel's Express Bar serves cocktails and refreshing drinks at the lobby area. The restaurant of Taksim Express Hotel offers meals in open buffet style. There are also numerous restaurants around the hotel.

The 24-hour reception provides room service. Laundry, dry cleaning and ironing services are offered t a surcharge. Airport shuttle services are also organised at an additional fee.

Taksim Square and Taksim Metro Station are within 500 m. Istiklal Avenue is only a 10-minute walk away with many restaurants, bars, cafés and shops. Ataturk International Airport is 20 km from the hotel.

192192.description: The accomodation consists of 23 rooms. Guests may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Hostal Vegas. Hostal Vegas does not offer 24-hour reception. Some services may be payable.

192249.description: This property boasts a prime setting on one of the cobbled streets, in the modern part of Edinburgh. The establishment is located just 800 metres away from Princes Street. Guests will find themselves surrounded by the many historical and cultural attractions, for which this mesmerising city is renowned. The property occupies a magnificent Georgian townhouse, which exudes poise and grace. The guest rooms ooze classical style and elegance, and have been individually designed for added exclusivity. The restaurant serves cuisine made with fresh, Scottish ingredients, for a truly cultural, culinary experience. Guests can sample from a selection of 25 Scotch whiskeys in the bar.

192251.description: When you stay at Steigenberger Airport Hotel Amsterdam in Schiphol, you'll be near the airport, within a 15-minute drive of Van Gogh Museum and Leidseplein. This upscale hotel is 7. 3 mi (11. 7 km) from Rijksmuseum and 8 mi (12. 8 km) from Anne Frank House. Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Make yourself at home in one of the 440 guestrooms. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is available. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Sports & Media Bar, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Relax with a refreshing drink from the swim-up bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in Schiphol? This hotel has 5447 square feet (506 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 15 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary during limited hours. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

192272.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Studio Inn De Angeli, a residence located in Milan's Washington district, just a short drive from Santa Maria delle Grazie and Fiera Milano City. The 24 guestrooms feature kitchenettes equipped with stovetops and microwaves, perfect for preparing light meals. Relax on premium bedding with down comforters and enjoy entertainment on 32-inch LCD TVs. Complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and electric kettles are also provided. The residence is conveniently located near Corso Vercelli and within easy reach of popular attractions like the Museum of the Last Supper and the CityLife Shopping District. Linate Airport is the closest airport.

192331.description: Located in the heart of the Palermo Soho area in Buenos Aires, this hotel offers luxurious rooms, a Spa and swimming pool. Plaza Serrano square is 50 metres away and provides a great variety of restaurants, bars and shops. This square is famous for its artisans fair and exclusive design shops. All rooms at the 5411 Soho Hotel are air-conditioned and feature a hydro massage tub, flat-screen TV and Wi-Fi. Some rooms offer balconies or private gardens. Buffet breakfast is served daily, as well as a tea service in the afternoon. Guests can enjoy wine and drinks at the bar or relax in the spa's sauna or Finnish shower. The Botanic Garden and the Zoo are a 5-minute drive from the hotel. Jorge Newbery domestic airport is 3.4 km away. Tourism information is provided to explore the city.

192332.description:
The small Hotel Chipre enjoys a wonderful location in the heart of the San Telmo neighbourhood of Buenos Aires. It is part of the historic center and one of the oldest and most traditional neighbourhoods, maintaining its charming architectural heritage. Famous Plaza Dorrego square, the market and the Museum of Modern Art are just steps away, while Plaza de Mayo square , Puerto Madero , La Boca and the Casa Rosada are within walking distance.
The hotel welcomes guests in a cosy atmosphere full of warm hospitality. The rooms have a friendly decoration with walls painted in lively colours. They have either shared or private bathrooms, and some rooms also have a TV. , and there is complimentary wireless internet access throughout the building. This hotel is a perfect choice for guests looking for a good location , at a budget price

192335.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting in Buenos Aires, lying in the Palermo Soho District. The hotel lies within easy access of a range of attractions in the area. Upscale shopping, dining and entertainment venues can be found nearby. This hotel offers the perfect urban retreat for guests who are seeking individualised style and hospitality. The guest rooms are stylishly appointed, and are fully fitted with modern conveniences. A number of excellent facilities and services are available at this hotel, offering guests a truly enjoyable experience, rich in comfort and convenience. Business and leisure travellers will appreciate everything that this wonderful hotel has to offer.

192343.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in the centre of Miraflores, overlooking the Pacific Ocean. The hotel is surrounded by restaurants, banks, shopping opportunities and crafts. The hotel is located just a short distance away from the Huaca Pucllana Museum and Archaeological Site. This wonderful hotel is the perfect choice for those who are eager to explore the rich culture and history of the area. This wonderful hotel offers guests a tranquil and relaxing experience. The guest rooms are elegantly designed, immersing visitors in comfort and refined luxury. The hotel features a range of exemplary facilities, complemented by professional service and a peaceful ambience.

192349.address: Blvd Kukulkan Mz 59 Lote 1-01 Km 21.26,Punta Nizuc
192349.description:
Modern and luxurious, yet with a distinctive Mayan style, this resort offers a resplendent seaside retreat on Riviera Maya.  Visitors might take a guided excursion to the archaeological sites at Chichen-Itza, Coba and Tulum, or stay at the hotel to indulge at the spa, complete with fitness centre, beauty salon and meditation garden in addition to a sauna, ice fountain and several pools.  Children will delight in the kids' club, while adults can experience a relaxing escape at the pristine white sand beach.  

The lavish suites feature rich, contemporary décor, deluxe bathrooms with rainfall showers, and state-of-the-art entertainment systems.  Each comes with a balcony with views of the turquoise sea, the protected mangrove reserve, or a private garden terrace, and some suites boast extravagant private pools.  Guests can choose from six exclusive restaurants and three lounge bars, all for the ultimate Caribbean holiday.

192374.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in Campagna Lupia, lying between Venice and Padua. The hotel is located just 500 metres away from the train station Casello 8, which links directly to Venice. The Padua buses stop just 300 metres away, in the heart of the town. This wonderful hotel enjoys a peaceful setting, yet is close to the heart of the entertainment. The hotel enjoys a charming design, exuding rustic elegance. The guest rooms are beautifully decorated with original elements, featuring wooden ceilings and beams. The rooms offer modern conveniences, for guests' comfort. Guests will be pleased by the excellent service and superb facilities that the hotel has to offer.

192376.description: This chic hotel enjoys a prime setting at the heart of the popular coastal area of Alimos. The hotel is located close to the beach and within easy access of Alimos Marina (THERE IS FREE TRANSPORTATION FROM MARINA ALIMOS TO THE HOTEL ONLY UPON REQUEST), as well as a host of shops, dining options and entertainment venues. This stylish hotel offers guests a great location from which to explore the delights that Athens has to offer. The hotel is located just a 15 minutes' driving distance from the port of Piraeus, from where guests can explore the stunning Greek islands with ease. This contemporary-style hotel exudes elegance and charm, welcoming guests into the splendid surroundings of the lobby. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, evoking a sense of peace and serenity. The rooms come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests are invited to take advantage of the exceptional choice of facilities that the hotel has to offer.

192388.description: This charming bed and breakfast is located just a 2 minutes' walking distance from Jemaa El Fna Square, at the heart of the old quarter of Marrakech. The property is located within easy access of the main cultural and historical attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. The bed and breakfast enjoys a charming exterior, tempting guests into the elegant interior. The interior design reflects the rich culture and heritage of the surroundings, oozing character and poise. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, and come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests can indulge in the ultimate invigoration in the spa, or dine in style in the relaxing surroundings of the restaurant.

192389.description: This riad complex is located amidst the rich culture and history of the vibrant city of Marrakech. The complex is located within easy access of the many intriguing attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. Guests will find themselves just a short walking distance away from Jemaa El Fna Square and Palais Bahia. The golfs are located just a 10 minutes' driving distance away. This charming complex comprises 3 beautifully-designed riads, which exude elegance and traditional design. The riads are sumptuously appointed, featuring superbly-designed guest rooms, which enjoy different themes. The riads offer guests a truly memorable experience, with ample opportunities to experience the culture of this mesmerising city.

192428.description: This stylish hotel stands out for its fabulous outdoor gardens, terrace and pool as well as the uniqueness of the property, set in a tenth-century castle.  It is perched on a hillside in Sant Boi, just a five-minute drive from Barcelona's El Prat Airport and surrounded by a tranquil wooded area.  The hotel offers majestic views of Barcelona and its surrounding areas as well as excellent connections to the city centre.

192476.description: Located in Paris's vibrant 19th arrondissement, the Campanile Prime Paris 19 - La Villette offers convenient access to local attractions. A short drive takes you to Canal Saint-Martin and Place de la Republique, while the Stade de France and Palais Garnier are also within easy reach. This hotel provides 208 air-conditioned rooms equipped with flat-screen televisions and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy cable programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, and convenient amenities such as desks and complimentary newspapers. The on-site restaurant, Le Restaurant, serves lunch and dinner, while the coffee shop/cafe offers snacks. Guests can unwind at the bar/lounge and enjoy a buffet breakfast (available for a fee). Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and on-site self-parking (subject to charges).

192477.address: Gran Via De Les Corts, Catalanes, 550
192477.description: The hotel is situated in a suburb which holds the city's finest Modernist buildings. The Passeig de Gràcia is the main artery, its wide pavements lined with designer shops and chic cafes. It is also home to Gaudí's two fairy-tale masterpieces, Casa Batlló and La Pedrera, plus many other architectural gems. The undoubted star of the area is La Sagrada Familia, Gaudí's fabulous unfinished emblematic church. This hotel offers guests a peaceful ambience, where they can take a swim in the outdoor pool and relax on the sun terrace. A wonderful restaurant serves a number of specialties and they can also enjoy a drink at a cosy on-site bar. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a pet deposit.

192482.description: The total number of units is 57. The accomodation offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Additionally, the premises provide a reception service the whole day through. This hotel follows environmentally sustainable practices. The health and wellness offer at the hotel ensures the ultimate in rejuvenation and relaxation. Some services of Ambassade Hotel may be payable.

192518.description: Palazzetto Madonna Hotel is conveniently located in the popular San Polo area. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Service-minded staff will welcome and guide you at the Palazzetto Madonna Hotel. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless (complimentary), non smoking rooms, air conditioning, heating. Enjoy the hotel's recreational facilities, including garden, before retiring to your room for a well-deserved rest. No matter what your reasons are for visiting Venice, Palazzetto Madonna Hotel will make you feel instantly at home.

192525.description:
Bienvenue au Garbo HôteL votre adresse douce et féminine à deux pas de République, des bars et restaurants du canal saint martin et des boutiques du Haut-Marais. 
Fraîchement redécoré par notre décoratrice en Hiver 2025, l’hôtel dévoile un univers tout en courbes, moulures et élégance inspirée de l'iconique, la divine Greta Garbo. 
Dans nos 36 chambres, chaque détail a été pensé pour votre confort, votre bien-être… et un petit supplément d’âme. 
Chaque matin, un petit-déjeuner continental est servi en chambre ou en salle. 
Chaque soir, un Bar sans alcool vous attend pour un jus, un soft ou juste un café.

192567.description:
In the historical heart of the Medina of Marrakech, the antique dealers' and the Dar El Bacha Palace district, five minutes from the Jemaa El Fnaa square, discover the charming Riad Djemanna. Beautifully restored, our Riad combines Moroccan authenticity and modern comfort. It offers two patios, two swimming pools, several terraces, a hammam and two massage rooms and ten rooms with refined decoration.
Once walked through the doors, the tranquility of the place will bring you all the energy needed to walk the bustling medina. At Riad Djemanna we welcome you with tea and refreshing towels.
Our team is at your disposal for the organization of your stay and your excursions and to make your trip unforgettable.

name.content: Crowne Plaza Englewood, an IHG Hotel

192584.description: Located near the New York-Presbyterian/Columbia University Irving Medical Center, our business hotel in Englewood, NJ offers guests well-appointed guestrooms and wonderful amenities, including free Wi-Fi, complimentary parking, an indoor pool, and elegant meeting spaces. ​​Discover new things to do in Englewood and the surrounding area. Stroll through Overpeck County Park before heading into Manhattan via the George Washington Bridge to explore the Big Apple. Sports fans must visit Yankee Stadium or catch an NFL game at MetLife Stadium. In the evening, catch a show at the Bergen Performing Arts Center. Everything you need for a fantastic stay in New Jersey can be found at Crowne Plaza® Englewood.

192589.address: 60 Km Route De Taroudant Ouirgane Marrakech
192589.description: This delightful hotel enjoys a splendid, natural setting in Ouirgane. The hotel is situated just a 2 minutes' walking distance from the Toubkal National Park, bathing guests in the intrinsic splendour of the surroundings. Guests will find themselves just a 2 minutes' walking distance from the majestic Ouirgane Lake. This captivating hotel enjoys a charming architectural design. The interior is sumptuously appointed, showcasing the grandeur of traditional, Moroccan design. The guest rooms are exquisitely designed, reflecting the natural beauty of the surroundings. Guests are invited to dine in style in the restaurant, where delectable Moroccan and French cuisines are served. Guests can then sit back on the terrace, and revel in the indescribable beauty of the surroundings.

192656.description: This hotel enjoys a strategic setting in Sao Mamede Infesta. The hotel is located next to the main road, lying close to major motorways. The hotel is located just 7 km away from the charming, culturally-rich city of Oporto. Basking in the splendour of its peaceful surroundings, the hotel affords guests the best of both worlds, lying close to the heart of the entertainment. This wonderful hotel extends a warm, friendly welcome to guests upon arrival. The elegantly-appointed guest rooms offer a peaceful, relaxed setting in which to escape the bustle of daily life. The hotel offers guests comfort and convenience, complemented by exception service and a homely environment.

192665.address: Km 61 Centre Ouirgane Par Marrakech Asni
192665.description: This charming hotel enjoys an idyllic setting in Ouirgane. The hotel is nestled amidst a well-manicured garden, enjoying an aura of tranquillity and serenity. The hotel is situated just a 5 minutes' walking distance from Lake Ouirgane and 60 km from Marrakech. Guests will find themselves in a great location from which to explore the essence and culture of Morocco. This delightful hotel enjoys a traditional architectural style, welcoming guests into a world of rustic charm. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, featuring elements and designs from the rich heritage of the area. The hotel invites guests to dine in style in the restaurant, and to savour the delectable culinary delights that the menu has to offer.

192754.description:
Situated in full city center of Marrakesh, a few minutes away from the famous place Djemâa El Fna and in 15 mn of the Royal Golf and the airport, meadows of the minaret of koutoubia, the palace bahia and gardens majorelles. Come to take advantage of the view on the city or bathe you in the swimming pool on the roof bring down.
The hotel shelters 35 rooms among which 5 suites and the latter have a corner place lounge show.

FASHION Hotel Marrakech New-look version “So classy” with a brand new Italian & Moroccan Resto Bar au ground-floor, a brand new sky-bar with pool and CHICHA-Bar in the top-floor, enjoys an exceptional location to discover the mythical city of Marrakech. Both ideal for exploring the city, unusual places, for the nightlife, and also so close to MARRAKECH enormous event. Without forgetting to mention that FASHION Hotel is one of the best destination for Golfers.

192767.description:
Situated just off Boavista Roundabout, the unique Hotel da Musica forms part of the iconic, overhauled Mercado do Bom Sucesso with its contemporary stalls. In the surrounding area, guests will find a plethora of shopping opportunities and restaurants, while the Casa da Musica is just a few steps away. Casa da Musica metro station can be reached within a short stroll, providing easy access to all of Porto's famous attractions.
The outstanding design hotel sets the tone with its ultra-stylish design, dedicating its rooms and public areas to composers and musicians from various epochs. The rooms and suites are bright and excellently appointed with all the necessary features including complimentary WIFI. Business guests will appreciate the business centre and the flexible meeting room. The on-site gourmet restaurant composes a symphony of tastes from the fresh organic produce found at the market stalls. Just the ideal place to get in tune with the lively rhythm of Porto.

192768.description: Located in Karakoy's centre, close to the harbour, the hotel is an amalgamation of space between Karakoy's Keçeli Han, previously utilized as a stove, and the adjacent 1930's Bobbin Factory. With 18 m high facades, the building has 44 rooms and penthouses with private balconies. The interior design is modern, chic and typical Istanbul style. The hotel's trendy restaurant and bar is run by Turkey's famous restaurateur, Arda Turkmen and specialises in stone-oven baked dishes. Ideal for business and leisure guests alike, the hotel's location allows easy access to Sultanahmet, 2.5 km away.

192770.address: Km 59 Route de Taroudante par Marrakech
192770.description: Situated just outside the pretty Berber village of Ouirgane, and 10 km from Asni. It is off the road Tizin'test pass in 12 hectares of grounds. Standard rooms are situated around a central courtyard in the main building. The rooms are spacious, and each has its own private garden terrace with spectacular views of the surroundings.

192834.description: Located in an olive grove in an isolated hamlet in the mountains not too far from Marrakech, this paradise is a traditional Moroccan dwelling updated to offer all modern conveniences. The 6 warm and cosy accommodations all have king-size beds and are equipped with their own private bathroom, communal facilities consisting of a shady courtyard and a large open-air swimming pool with stunning views of the mountains. The on-site restaurant prepares seasonally-inspired local dishes and international cuisine to suit the guests' tastes. This is a place for relaxation, peace and quiet, where visitors can lie back and read a book on the sun deck at the foothills of the Atlas Mountains. However, Marrakech is not far by car for those who would like to visit the Medina and do a spot of shopping. The friendly hotel staff will give advice about what else to see in the area.

193014.description: Located in Les Ulis, southwest of Paris, this cosy hotel is the perfect choice for both business and leisure trips. The establishment is conveniently close to the Courtaboeuf business park and the Courtaboeuf Les Ulis 2 shopping centre. It is also within easy reach of Paris city centre. The residence comprises 54 spacious, attractive guest rooms, including two rooms designed to accommodate disabled guests. Each accommodation unit features an en-suite bathroom and is equipped with amenities such as cable/satellite television and complimentary Internet access. During their stay, guests can enjoy a drink in the charming bar or on the attractive terrace.

193020.description: This residence is located in the Val d'Oise, lying just 28 km away from the mesmerising city of Paris. Cergy Pontoise is located just 3 km away. The establishment affords close proximity to Pontoise RER station, which offers ease of access to Paris. This wonderful property comprises tastefully-designed apartments, which offer a peaceful home away from home. The apartments are designed in an urban-chic style, and are well equipped with modern amenities, offering the utmost in comfort and convenience. Guests can enjoy a delightful buffet breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore the area.

193143.description: Location The hotel is located 200 m from the Grand Place, near the Bourse and Brussels Central Station. It is also a 7-minute walk from Manneken Pis and a 3-minute walk to the closest metro station. Located in the heart of Brussels next to the Grand Place area, Craves Hotel guides you on a journey through an experience that is as intimate as it is bold and unique. Dive into our concept. With its cosy decor and magnetic colours, CRAVES contributes to intensify every sensation. It is more than a hotel. It is a special experience.

193230.description: This comfortable airport hotel is located just a quick, ten-minute drive from Milan's Malpensa Airport, offering the perfect stay for those who have an early flight or are just arriving to Milan after a long journey. Milan's city centre with its magnificent Duomo and fabulous designer shops is just a 30-minute drive away, and guests can take the bus or train directly to the city centre from the airport. The hotel also provides an airport shuttle service with a small extra charge ( Euro 3 per person over 18 years old ), making it easy to catch a flight or head to the city centre. The classic rooms are spacious and elegantly decorated, all with air-conditioning and free Wi-Fi internet connection. Guests might relax and unwind in the outdoor pool and garden, or rent a bicycle from the hotel to enjoy a short ride around the town. The hotel's shuttle service also offers free transport to two local restaurants, and guests can wake up to a delicious continental breakfast buffet onsite.

193238.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting at the heart of Athens. Nestled amidst the rich culture and history of the city, this hotel is sure to impress. This luxurious hotel boasts close proximity to the city's main attractions and archaeological sites. The hotel is located just a 10 minutes' waking distance away from the New Acropolis Museum. The vibrant Ermou Street is located close by, where guests can explore a wealth of shops. This charming hotel enjoys the unique blend of traditional style and contemporary decor. The guest rooms are luxuriously appointed, featuring crisp-white tones and modern conveniences. Guests will be impressed by the unrivalled comfort, convenience and style that this hotel has to offer.

193240.address: 56 Derb Derdouba Arset Ihiri Bab Doukkala, 56
193240.description: This luxurious hotel enjoys a great setting in Marrakech, lying just a 10 minutes' walking distance from Jemaa El Fna Square. The hotel is located within easy access of the main attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. Guests can explore the shopping opportunities with ease, and discover the rich culture and heritage of the city. This charming hotel enjoys a spectacular architectural style, combining traditional Moroccan design with contemporary influences. Commanding spectacular views over the Atlas Mountains and the Medina, this magnificent hotel enjoys a peaceful ambience. The hotel welcomes guests into a world of luxury and style, comprising beautifully-appointed rooms, which offer a cocoon of tranquillity. The hotel affords a number of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of every type of traveller.

193242.address: Km 13, Route de L'ourika - Canal de Zaraba
193242.description: This sumptuous resort is located just a 15-minute drive from Marrakech's Medina, offering easy access to the city's main attractions. Set within a sprawling park, the resort boasts spectacular views of the Atlas Mountains and a tranquil atmosphere. Rich in tradition and charm, the resort immerses guests in Moroccan heritage and culture. Guest rooms are tastefully appointed in a simple yet elegant style featuring soothing tones and luxurious bedding, along with modern amenities. Guests can also savor delectable cuisine at the resort's restaurant.

193243.description: Featuring stunning traditional Moroccan architecture, this luxurious hotel is just minutes from the centre of Marrakech. The premises are located adjacent to an award-winning golf-course where guests can enjoy a round, and are within easy reach of a wide range of restaurants and other entertainment venues. The accommodation consists of sumptuous apartments, divided between the Palm Holidays residences which feature terrace or balcony with views of the Atlas Mountains, and the Pavillon du Golf residences which feature elegant furniture and gardens with an infinity pool. There are also 23 majestic villas with a butler, chef and household assistant. There are a number of bars and restaurants on-site serving food from around the world, as well as a pool, a children's mini-club, tennis courts and a multi-sports ground. The conference facilities are ideal for weddings and business events.

193244.description: The 4-star Apart-hotel, enjoys a unique location in Marrakesh's luxurious Hivernage district. Just a 15-minute walk from the vibrant Jamaâ El Fna Square, it offers a peaceful escape amidst lush greenery, perfect for those seeking relaxation, exploration, and entertainment. The residence features 22 beautifully appointed apartments, accommodating from two to eight guests. Discover the enchanting souks and narrow streets of the Medina, where the aromas of spices and tanned leather fill the air. Immerse yourself in a world of charm and tradition, and share a cup of mint tea with welcoming locals.

193298.description: These spacious and elegant apartments are located in the Eixample district, 400 meters from Paseo de Gracia and Gaudí's famous monuments. They offer fantastic city views. La Sagrada Familia and La Monumental bullring are a 15-minute walk away, while Plaza Catalunya is just a 10-minute walk from the property. Girona Metro Station, a 3-minute walk away, is only four stops from Barceloneta beach.

193331.description: Riad Mandalay Marrakech welcomes you. Located a short 5-minute walk from Jemaa El Fna square in the historic Kasbah district, and just 5 km from the airport, our riad offers ten comfortable double, triple, quadruple, and family rooms. Each room features Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a private shower, and toilet. Enjoy our beautiful terrace for relaxation, and savor a traditional Moroccan breakfast served daily between 8:00 and 10:00 AM. Our restaurant offers both Moroccan and international cuisine. We can also arrange local activities and excursions with daily departures, bookable on-site. An airport shuttle service is available for a small fee (15€ for two people, 20€ for four, and 25€ for six).

193433.description: Children aged 12 & over will be charged 35% of the room rate at check-in. When sharing parents room: 1st child under 12 years stays free, 2nd child under 12 years will be charged 25% of room rate, infants under 2 years old stays free. A landmark property, Hilton London Wembley is situated directly opposite the iconic Wembley Stadium and next to the historic OVO Arena, at the same time only 5 minutes’ walk from Wembley Park tube station, and 20 minutes from London’s city center theater district in the West End. All of the tastefully decorated Guest Rooms and Suites in this London hotel feature large windows, an LCD TV and a work area with ergonomic desk chairs. Upgrade to an Executive Room to enjoy exclusive access to the Executive Lounge on the top floor, with complimentary breakfast and evening canapes. Hold a conference in one of 10 meeting rooms or book our Grand Ballroom for up to 700 guests. The hotel features a 24-hour business center with the latest in audio-visual equipment, and WiFi access is available throughout. Enjoy delicious cocktails at our Sky Bar & Roof Terrace and savor international and local specialties in our all-day dining restaurant. Work out in the 24-hour Fitness Center by Precor, cool down with a dip in the 12m indoor pool or unwind in the sauna and steam room. With 200 car park spaces on site, this hotel is the ideal point from which to explore greater London and its surroundings. Visit Windsor Castle, the races at Ascot or take a day trip to historic Oxford. Heathrow Airport is only a 45 minute drive away.

193438.description: This aparthotel is located only 15 minutes from the heart of Paris by the RER, which is 700 metres from the residence. The hotel is located along the park of the castle of Maisons Laffitte. It is a non-smoking hotel, fully air-conditioned, with a chic and contemporary decoration. Free Wi-Fi (fibre)All rooms are studios and flats, recently renovated, with new palace quality bedding, fully equipped kitchenette, Nespresso coffee machine, kettle and tea and coffee making facilities. All have flat-screen TV with international channels, USB sockets at the head of the bed, a safe for a laptop. . . Rooms for disabled guests are available on request. A gym, bar/lounge and table football allow our guests to relax at any time of the day. Breakfast is served as a full American buffet with sweet, savoury and hot dishes and a wide range of hot and cold drinks. Dine in one of our partner restaurants within walking distance of the hotel, or have it delivered to your room. Secure underground parking with 3 electric charging points. The hotel, located on the L'Avenue Verte / Paris-London and La Seine à Vélo cycle routes, has been awarded the Accueil Vélo label (secure bike park, pump, water access point, etc. ) and is in the process of being approved for the Clef Verte label, an international sustainable development label.
