193445.description: Novotel Lima San Isidro, located in the San Isidro business district & just 15km from Jorge Chávez International Airport, is the perfect choice for business or pleasure. With a modern, cozy design, the hotel restaurant has Peruvian & international cuisine, bar & terrace for happy hour with friends, heated pool, gym, sauna & space to host great events. The hotel has rooms for families & allows small pets.

193545.description: With its 1+1, 2+1 and 3+1 residence options, G-Residences Gayrettepe combines the coziness of a home with a glamorous luxury approach. G-Residences Gayrettepe's neoclassical architecture, unique location, and elite lifestyle, every detail of which has been meticulously designed, is a unique choice for long and short accommodation. 5 minutes to Etiler5 minutes to Bebek5 minutes to NişantaşıWalking distance to Metrobus and Metro7 minutes to the July 15th Martyrs Bridge10 minutes to the Fatih Sultan Mehmet Bridge6 minutes to Akmerkez6 minutes to Zorlu Center8 minutes to Cevahir8 minutes to Kanyon14 minutes to İstinye Park

193550.description: Hotel Casa Deco is housed in a beautiful Art Deco-inspired building. Each of the twenty-two rooms (executive, junior suite, and suite) features a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere achieved through carefully selected colors. The unique design includes balconies overlooking the street or a private terrace in some rooms.

193602.description: Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience at Staybridge Suites® Cairo Citystars, providing a home away from home in the dynamic commercial hub of Heliopolis. Situated with direct access to Stars Centre shopping mall, and only a seven-minute drive from Cairo International Airport and Cairo International Convention and Exhibition Centre, our 140 fully furnished studios and suites strategically place travelers right where they need to be. The lively streets of downtown Cairo are just half an hour away, with the Grand Egyptian Museum and Great Pyramids a bit further. Tailored for business travelers on extended stays in Cairo, our spacious studios and suites, featuring up to three bedrooms, offer full kitchens and living areas for a seamless blend of work and relaxation. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout. Start your day with a free buffet breakfast, and join fellow guests for an Evening Social, fostering connections over dinner three nights a week.

194130.description: This luxurious hotel boasts a brilliant location in the heart of Paris' 1st arrondissement, just five minutes' walk from the Louvre and the Jardin des Tuileries.  Guests will also be able to easily reach a variety of famous city sights on foot, including the Pont Neuf and Notre Dame Cathedral on Ile de la Cite, the Musee d'Orsay, and the Obelisk at Place de la Concorde.  The hotel's lavish, ornate suites feature unique décor inspired by places, moments and important figures in the history of France, and all are fully equipped with modern comforts. The hotel also offers a variety of helpful services such as a 24-hour reception, breakfast with room service, and arranging for airport transportation, all for a wonderful stay in the romantic centre of Paris.

194148.description: Movenpick Hotel Ikoyi Lagos is situated on the gateway to Victoria Island in the leafy green business district of Ikoyi. The luscious garden creates an urban oasis for stays whether on business or holiday. Home to 182 rooms and luxurious suites offering classic comfort, wifi and necessary room amenities. Enjoy the flavours of Nigeria and the World at our restaurant or Pool bar. Keep yourself in balance by using the fitness centre or enjoy a swim in the swimming pool. Conference and events spaces are available.

194590.description: This hotel is located in the centre of Porto. Shopping, entertainment or business destinations are only a 10-minute walk away. The residence is close to cultural venues, such as the House of Music, as well as the business centre and shopping malls of Boavista. The airport is located 13-15 km away. This four storey hotel offers air-conditioned units equipped with amenities such as LCD cable TV and Sports TV, bathroom necessities and en-suite bathrooms. Free WiFi Internet is available throughout the common areas of the hotel. The hotel offers breakfast. There are various dining options in the vicinity.

194599.description: Enjoy a day at the private beach or relax by the seasonal outdoor pool at Hotel Amalfi, located in the Faro district of Jesolo. This beach hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, two restaurants, a coffee shop, and a bar/lounge. The 80 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with showers and bidets, and safes. Caribe Bay Jesolo and Piazza Mazzini are a short drive away.

194632.description: This delightful hotel is situated in Marrakech, lying in the captivating Medina. The hotel is situated within easy access of a number of attractions in the area, including the Maison de la Photographie, Souk Zrabi, Souk Laghzel, Souk Smarine and Souk El Bahja. The hotel enjoys a charming architectural style, blending effortlessly with its culturally-rich surroundings. Enjoying a delightful style, rich in tradition and culture, the hotel welcomes guests into the refreshing surroundings of the interior. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, exuding regal splendour and charm with neutral tones and golden hues. The hotel affords guests a wide range of exemplary business, leisure and dining facilities, ensuring a truly unforgettable experience.

194643.address: Avenue Du Maréchal De Lattre De Tassigny, 100
194643.description: This complex enjoys a great location in Creteil. The complex is situated just a short distance away from the Henri Mondor Hospital, Paris XII University and the L'Echat shopping centre. A number of attractions, including the Chateau de Vincennes, can be found nearby. The hotel enjoys ease of access to the captivating city of Paris via the nearby subway line. The hotel enjoys a charming design, welcoming visitors with the promise of comfort and luxury. Comprising elegantly-appointed suites, this hotel is sure to surpass all expectations. Offering comfort and convenience in a wonderful setting, this hotel meets the needs of every type of traveller.

name.content: Ibis Styles Paris Saint Denis Plaine

194679.description: The ibis Styles Paris Saint-Denis Plaine hotel immerses you into the world of cinema with an atmosphere inspired by iconic genres: science fiction, French cinema and Hollywood classics. A lobby decorated with posters of cult movies awaits you. At the end of the day, relax in our cozy lounge areas with a good movie, and enjoy our gaming area equipped with a foosball table and an arcade machine.

194682.description: Conveniently located in the south of Madrid, this comfortable aparthotel is easily accessible from the A4, A42 and M40. The San Cristobal Industrial train station is just a short walk away, making it easy to arrive to the city centre as trains arrive to Atocha station in just 20 minutes. Here guests can enjoy a range of comforts for both business and leisure travel, including complimentary wireless internet access, onsite parking, and family-friendly room designs. Each spacious and modern apartment comes with a handy kitchenette with fridge, microwave and hot plates, in addition to an ensuite bathroom and living space with 32-inch flat-screen television. This aparthotel's excellent amenities and convenient location make it perfect for any type of travel to Madrid. IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT COVID-19The evolution of the events related to COVID-19 and the determinations that the governmental and health authorities in this respect, could affect the opening of the establishment during the period from 01/05 to 30/06. If you need more information, please contact us by phone at +34 911 300 300 or by email at calidad@verticehoteles. com.

194685.description: This distinguished hotel is set in a renovated building in the heart of 'Passeig de Gracia', the most elegant well-known avenue of Barcelona. The hotel is surrounded by the city's most prestigious shops as well as beautiful architectural jewels of Catalan modernism, including Gaudi's famous “La Pedrera” house, which is only a few steps away. The hotel's stylish rooms feature modern décor for a casual but sophisticated ambiance. Guests can enjoy a drink at the rooftop bar with spectacular and unique views of Barcelona.

194708.description: Located in the heart of Buenos Aires, Art Suites is a boutique aparthotel just a short drive from Recoleta Cemetery and Palermo Soho. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). A convenient area shuttle (surcharge) makes exploring nearby attractions easy. Each of the 15 individually decorated guestrooms features heated floors, an LCD television, a private balcony, and a kitchen equipped with a refrigerator and microwave. Guests can also enjoy complimentary wired Internet access and satellite programming. Bathrooms offer shower/tub combinations with jetted bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Additional amenities include express check-out and multilingual staff.

195198.description: This hostel enjoys a central location in Madrid. The hostel is conveniently located just 400 metres away from the metro station of Gran Via. The hostel enjoys close proximity to a wealth of attractions in this captivating city. A host of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues can be found nearby. Guests will find at their disposal a wide range of cultural, gastronomic, leisure and entertainment areas. This wonderful hostel extends a warm, friendly welcome to guests upon arrival. The guest rooms offer comfort in a simplistic setting. Guests can enjoy a truly memorable stay at this charming hostel.

195231.address: Quartier De La Bahia, Derb Sidi Moussa, 99
195231.description:
The riad offers a spa & wellness centre and a rooftop terrace, together with a concierge. The riad also offers a safe, a business centre and laundry facilities. Guests can also take advantage of the riad's shuttle service and the ticket desk services.
The Riad Melhoun has 8 comfortable rooms. The rooms are decorated in a traditional style.
The area around the Riad Melhoun has a lot of popular cafés and restaurants. Jardin Majorelle can be reached with a 20-minute drive.

195244.description: Located in Venice's historic center, this charming hotel occupies a beautiful 16th-century building. Guests enjoy proximity to major attractions like St. Mark's Square, the Bridge of Sighs, and Doge's Palace. The hotel offers a selection of comfortable rooms and apartments, each uniquely decorated in classic Venetian or contemporary style. Amenities include flat-screen televisions, premium toiletries, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, this hotel provides a relaxing getaway just minutes from the Rialto Bridge.

name.content: Best Western Plus Park Hotel Brussels

195278.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a sauna or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Take advantage of the hotel's room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 52 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include phones and safes. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Cinquantenaire Park - 0. 2 km / 0.

195292.description: Conveniently located in Zandvoort, this property offers easy access to the long sandy beach and to one of the most important automobile racing circuits it the country - Circuit Park Zandvoort. Its guests will be also just a 3-minute walk away from the train station and the centre of the city where they can find a number of bars and restaurants. Those who enjoy the convenience of onsite facilities will be pleasantly surprised by the elegant restaurant and its rich and varied menu. There they can enjoy both local and international favourites along with some fine spirits and wines. The terrace is the perfect place where to take advantage of the refreshing summer breezes.

195305.description: The Amsterdam Hotel Uithoorn offers convenient access by car and public transport, with private parking available on-site. Enjoy an extensive breakfast buffet in our restaurant, and dinner service from Monday through Thursday. Our cozy bar provides a relaxing space to unwind with drinks, billiards, or darts. We offer 38 superior and deluxe rooms, each featuring a private bathroom with a bath and/or shower, television, direct-dial phone, and internet access. Located in the charming village of Uithoorn on the Amstel River, the hotel is ideal for exploring the area's scenic walking and cycling paths, rich with diverse flora and fauna. Uithoorn and its surroundings offer a variety of activities, from horseback riding and boating to sailing, windsurfing, cycling, and tennis. Numerous museums, exhibitions, and attractions are also within easy reach. Amsterdam Schiphol Airport is just nine kilometers away. We look forward to your stay.

195307.description: Just 10 minutes’ walk from Nieuw Vennep’s train station, Hotel de Rustende Jager offers warmly decorated rooms with free Wi-Fi. It has a restaurant, which opens onto a terrace. The bright rooms at Hotel de Rustende Jager come with a TV. Each has a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a buffet-style breakfast daily. French cuisine is served in the evening and a variety of beers and wines are offered at the bar. Coffee to-go is also available at Hotel De Rustende Jager. Bike rentals are available at the hotel. Guests can cycle to the West End Lakes or the Bollenstreek, which is famous for its blooming flower fields. Amsterdam is a 35-minute train ride away, Haarlem is a 51-minute train ride.

195329.description: Experience Buenos Aires at Fierro Hotel, featuring 27 individually decorated guestrooms with Smart TVs, minibars, and pillowtop beds with Egyptian cotton sheets. Enjoy complimentary wired and wireless internet access, cable programming, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. Indulge in Argentinean cuisine at Salón Uco, with its bar/lounge and garden view, or order room service during limited hours. Start your day with a complimentary full breakfast. Hotel amenities include a spa, concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Airport and ferry terminal shuttles are available (surcharge). Located near Palermo Soho and Distrito Arcos, with easy access to various attractions. The preferred airport is Ministro Pistarini Intl. Airport (EZE).

195330.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as a health club, terrace, and garden at this Tuscan-style hotel. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. Conveniently explore nearby attractions with the area shuttle (surcharge). Savor Argentinian cuisine at Manhattan Grill, one of the hotel's four restaurants, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Snacks are also available at the three coffee shops/cafés. Start your day with a complimentary on-the-go breakfast served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Business amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Free self-parking is available onsite. Relax in one of the 51 individually decorated guest rooms, featuring refrigerators and minibars. Your pillowtop bed includes down comforters and premium bedding. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, and 32-inch LCD televisions with cable programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers offer rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. The hotel is located near Ministro Pistarini Intl. Airport (EZE).

195335.description: This hotel is located in an exclusive neighbourhood of Recoleta, surrounded by chic cafes and designer shops. The hotel is situated just a short distance away from the craft fair Plaza France. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the Recoleta shopping centre and the nearest subway station. The downtown area of Buenos Aires is just a short distance away. This wonderful hotel lies just 40 km away from Minister Pistarini Airport. This elegant hotel welcomes visitors with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, offering functional space and modern conveniences. The hotel features designer touches, complemented by a homely ambience. Guests will be pleased by the many facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

195339.description:
This lavish apartment hotel is situated in Bogota's upscale Parque de la 93 neighbourhood, just around the corner from the famous Parque de la 93 park and 15 minute' walk from Virrey metro station.  Some of the city's most renowned restaurants are located within a five-minute walk, and the Santa Barbara business centre is within easy reach.
The one- and two-bedroom apartments are elegant and contemporary, each boasting a wide variety of modern conveniences including an in-room iPad and internet connection, 400-count sheets in the two private bathrooms.  Guests might try out a local recipe in the fully-equipped kitchen or dine in the hotel restaurant and sip an after-dinner drink in the modern and cosy bar and lounge.  The hotel helpfully offers a range of services including in-room massages, a private, 17-seat cinema and a 24-hour, state-of-the-art gym for guest use, all for a pampered retreat or business trip.

195340.description: This modern business hotel is situated in Bogota's La Cabrera neighbourhood, offering a convenient base for business travel as various financial centres are within easy reach.  The Andino shopping centre is just a five-minute stroll away, offering an array of shops, restaurants, cafés and entertainment venues, and guests will find a wide variety of restaurants in the area, as the famous Parque de la 93 area is just 1.5 kilometres away.  The hotel offers contemporary, tastefully decorated rooms with useful amenities such as Wi-Fi internet access, work desks and en suite bathrooms with hairdryers.  Guests might also take advantage of the hotel's helpful services such as car rental services, 24- hour room service and free parking.

195349.description: This hotel is located near the A6 motorway which provides easy access to Paris in just 40 minutes. Guests will find Fontainebleau Forest within a short drive of the establishment, while Ponthierry-Pringy RER Station is just 450 metres away, also providing direct access to Paris. Guests will have the opportunity to explore wonderful Vaux-le-Vicomte and its castle, located just 15 km from the proprty. In addition to its convenient location, adequate for both business and leisure travellers, the residence offers numerous amenities and modern services. All spacious rooms feature an en-suite bathroom and in-room entertainment is provided via complimentary Internet access and a flat-screen TV.

name.content: Best Western Saint Louis - Grand Paris Vincennes

195359.description:
With its refined, luxurious decor, the Best Western Saint Louis – Grand Paris Vincennes offers guests bucolic calm in the heart of Paris. Located a mere stone's throw from the historic Chateau and Bois de Vincennes, our hotel boasts a verdant, soothing setting only a few minutes from the centre of Paris and some of the world's most popular landmarks. What with the nearby Bois de Vincennes for joggers and the nearby city centre for shoppers, the Best Western Saint Louis is ideally located. Let yourself be tempted by this royal decor which combined with the hotel's warm welcome guarantee our guests an enjoyable stay. Enjoy the peace and quiet of our hotel while staying in the heart of lively, bustling Paris. 

We epitomize the hotel with a human face. Our 25 rooms, all air-conditioned, allow you to enjoy a well-earned rest after a day spent in the capital, whether you're on a business trip or visiting Paris as a tourist.

195370.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at Hotel Century, centrally located in Geneva, a short walk from the Jet d'Eau Fountain and just a five-minute drive from the United Nations European Headquarters. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a banquet hall, and an on-site restaurant with room service available during limited hours. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies), or enjoy a drink at the bar/lounge. The 130 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs with cable programming, and private bathrooms with deep soaking tubs and complimentary toiletries. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, dry cleaning/laundry services, and on-site self-parking (for a fee).

195372.description:
The Best Western Plus Hotel Zürcherhof is a small urban design hotel (family run) with 39 rooms, in a central, quiet location in the middle of the historic old town of Zurich. Only a few minutes’ walk from the famous Bahnhofstrasse and the main station. 

You can expect elegant, modern and pleasantly furnished non-smoking rooms with a lot of comfort and free mini-bar with beer and soft drinks, and a smile on your face! 
Start a successful day with our beautiful Swiss breakfast buffet - with vegan dishes and Swiss Prosecco! By the way, this is included in the room rate. We also offer share magazines, a free selection of over 450 international daily newspapers and magazines. 

A place to feel good and relax during your stay in the vibrant city of Zurich.

195374.description: This is a 3-star superior proprty near Zurich Airport. Experience Swiss hospitality just a short ride from the airport. The property provides Wi‑Fi throughout the premises. Please note that there is no reception on-site. Payment and online check‑in must be completed before arrival. After making a reservation, please contact the property immediately at +41 43 217 86 94 (AI agent “Maria”) or info@amanthosliving. com. Upon arrival, guests can access their unit using the digital instructions sent by email. Arrival is possible 24/7, with rooms available from 15:00. Parking is available at an additional cost of 10 CHF per day. Some services at Amanthos Living Zürich Airport may incur additional charges. Enjoy a delightful stay with us, where comfort and warm hospitality always come first.

195415.description: Mediterranean Hostel guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 12 guest rooms. The property offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. This hostel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night.

195519.description: This cosy property guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 6 guest rooms. Those staying at this accomodation may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. Additionally, the premises provide a reception service the whole day through.

195539.address: Rua C, Aeroporto Internacional De Lisboa, 2
195539.description: The hotel is located within 100 metres from Lisboa International Airport and provides comfort and convenience to business travellers and holidaymakers. Guests will be enchanted by delightful design and décor and excellent service. The establishment prides itself of 168 spacious and bright rooms. Each of them features magnificent design complemented by top-notch amenities, offering a complete escape for senses. The glamorous restaurant serves delectable Portuguese specialities and international dishes in a charming ambiance. Afterwards guests may enjoy a drink from the bar. Patrons may tone up at the fitness room with hydromassage bathtub, have a refreshing plunge in indoor or outdoor swimming pool or completely unwind in the on-site SPA equipped with sauna and Turkish bath. Corporate guests may make use of functional business centre and meeting facilities.

195576.description: It is located in the unique Quinta Paredes sector just 10 minutes from El Dorado International Airport and 5 minutes from the American Embassy, an area privileged by its proximity to the largest international business center and exhibition business headquarters CORFERIAS Bogota and the largest in Latin America. The Apartments have Loft style , the furnished with ample space for the traveler to have privacy and tranquility, ideal for you to relax a moment, no doubt is a great place to stay for a holiday with the family.

195578.description: Set in a modern building, this hotel has elegant rooms just a 5-minute walk from Corferias Convention Centre. Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi. The Hotel offers chic, urban style décor, only a 20-minute drive from El Dorado Airport. The hotel is near the American Embassy, just a 3-minute stroll from Corferias and different government agencies, as well as major shopping and entertainment centres Rooms are equipped with flat-screen cable TV, and private bathrooms with showers and toiletries. Suites have King Size beds and spa baths. A full American breakfast with tropical fruits and Colombian coffee can be enjoyed daily. The restaurant serves light lunches and snacks. Simon Bolivar Park, a popular venue for concerts and outdoor entertainment is a 10-minute drive from the hotel. There is free public parking nearby.

195585.description: Enjoying a peaceful location in Buenos Aires's historic Recoleta district, this 3-star hotel is a 15-minute walk from the Museum of Fine Arts, Centro Cultural Recoleta gallery, and the famous Recoleta Cemetery. The hotel offers tastefully decorated rooms featuring original works of art by Argentine painters and photographers. Each room has a private bathroom, LCD TV, Wi-Fi, desk, minibar, telephone, safe, and hairdryer. It's surrounded by colorful shops, bars, and restaurants. The closest subway station is just 300 meters away.

195649.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an indoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a fireplace in the lobby, and a picnic area. Grab a bite from the grocery/convenience store serving guests of Residence Inn by Marriott Yonkers Westchester County. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6:00 AM to 9:00 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 144 guestrooms, featuring kitchens with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and stovetops. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding, and all rooms are furnished with double sofa beds. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment.

195690.description: Enjoy a wonderful stay in this marvelous hotel, decorated with modern touches, designer furniture, original tapestries, and authentic art pieces that create a casual and entertaining ambiance. Inside the rooms, textures, asymmetric shapes, and psychedelic prints will catch your eye. Everything from the wood floors to the 300-thread-count Egyptian cotton sheets has been carefully selected to make every stay the best experience possible. Our rooms are equipped with air conditioning, LED cable TV, workstations, private bathrooms with showers, and special details in our suites, like Nespresso coffee machines, DVD players, and microwave ovens. All our guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi and luggage storage, among many other services. Located in the modern Palermo Hollywood neighborhood, surrounded by restaurants, bars, shops, and art galleries. We are only 600 meters from Plaza Serrano, 15 minutes from Jorge Newbery Airport, and 45 minutes from Ezeiza International Airport. Our staff is eager to help you before, during, and after your stay, making you feel at home and giving you the best advice and recommendations so you don't miss any of the important landmarks and experiences of our great city.

195691.description: A neo-colonial hotel in Luján that reproduces the feel of an old Argentinian country home, close to local places of interest like the Luján Zoo, the Basílica de Nuestra Señora de Luján and Plaza Colón. The hotel is close to all the main polo fields in Argentina and just 45 minutes from the city of Buenos Aires, guests can even arrive by helicopter. Surrounded by 12 hectares of green fields, this hotel offers guests the chance to practice sport at any time of the year while keeping in touch with nature. Guests can enjoy activities like bike riding, tennis, football, golf, horse riding and even hot air ballooning as well as game consoles and board games for bad weather days. There is also a heated pool and spa and a restaurant serving Argentinian and European food. The rooms all boast great views over the polo fields as well as air-conditioning and heating, mini bar, TV and Wi-Fi.

195695.description: This apartment hotel is located amidst the culture and history of Bogota D.C. The hotel is situated close to Parque de la 93, as well as the famous Zona Rosa, Usaquen and the World Trade Centre. This charming hotel boasts a strategic setting, making it perfect for business and leisure travellers. The guest apartments are tastefully designed, and are fitted with modern conveniences for added comfort. The apartments enjoy a modern design, offering a peaceful setting in which to work and rest in comfort. This wonderful complex is sure to surpass all expectations. Guests are sure to enjoy a memorable stay at this superb establishment.

195709.description: The 124 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. Clients may contact the reception desk any time during the day. The premises offer accessible public areas. Additionally, a car park is available on the premises for guests' extra convenience. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

195729.address: Riad Zitoune Jdid, 114 Derb Sidi Moussa
195729.web: 114 derb sidi moussa, Riad Zitoune Jdid
195729.description: A short walk from the famed Jamaa El Fna Square, a UNESCO World Heritage site, this intimate 11-room riad and suite retreat is a legend in itself. Riad Flam & SPA, one of Marrakech's most luxurious riads, exudes fascinating Moroccan authenticity. Its old architecture is inspired by the heritage of Marrakech's ancient Medina houses. Experience the soul of Moroccan hospitality at this legendary riad hotel in the Jewish quarter near Bahia Palace. A haven of tranquility, it offers an escape from the bustling streets. Eleven charming, individually themed rooms and suites await, along with an indoor heated pool, a rooftop Jacuzzi, several terraces, a hammam, a massage room, and a restaurant serving traditional Moroccan cuisine.

195742.address: Rue Bab Ghmate Et Cimetière Juifs Mellah
195742.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. This riad also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and barbecue grills. For lunch or dinner, stop by 1, a restaurant that specializes in Moroccan cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a library. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 18 guestrooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers.

195755.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at the Hôtel Louvre Richelieu. Start your day with a self-serve breakfast (fee applies) from the snack bar. The hotel offers express check-in/check-out and a 24-hour front desk. Each of the 15 air-conditioned rooms features an espresso maker, LED TV, and digital programming. Private bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. A laptop-compatible safe, phone and desk are also provided. The hotel is centrally located in Paris, a 5-minute walk from Palais Royal and Rue de Rivoli, and conveniently close to attractions such as the Palais Garnier and Louvre Museum.

195811.description:
Perfectly located near the A4 motorway and just a 20-minute drive from Milan Linate Airport, Holiday Inn® Milan Nord – Zara is the ideal choice for both business and leisure stays. 

The hotel is conveniently close to major companies such as Sony, IBM and Directline, and offers five fully equipped meeting rooms, perfect for hosting events of up to 100 guests. Sesto FS metro station is just a 15-minute walk away and provides direct access to Milan’s city centre, where you can visit the famous Duomo and admire Leonardo da Vinci’s masterpiece, The Last Supper. In less than a 20-minute drive, you can reach San Siro Stadium to attend AC Milan or Inter matches, or the Monza National Autodrome for world-class motorsport events. 

Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, stay active in the mini gym, and take advantage of the 24-hour Business Centre. Complimentary onsite parking is also available. 

The bright, modern rooms feature a comfortable workspace, LCD TVs and a pillow menu to ensure a restful night’s sleep. Executive rooms offer additional sofa beds, while Family Rooms include convenient bunk beds for children. 

The A4 restaurant serves delicious Italian cuisine in a cosy setting with a 1950s-inspired design. After a busy day, guests can unwind with a drink in the hotel’s stylish bar. 

Holiday Inn Milan Nord – Zara: an elegant environment, efficient services and excellent connections to fully experience Milan.

195832.description: The perfect holiday for adults and children starting at Hostal Olmedo. Not only offer you a pleasant and comfortable accommodation, but also we have available to meet your needs. Whether you want to relax or take exciting excursions around: our pension is the ideal starting point. We are happy to make your stay with us as pleasant posible.Contamos with extensive experience and a large number of regular customers. A cozy atmosphere, friendly service and comfortable base for all your holiday activities. Important: Hostal Olmedo, check-in takes place at the Hostal Marlasca, located in the building next door, C / Cruz 14 2nd floor.

195837.description: The Hampton Inn Manhattan/Times Square Central is ideally located a short walk from Broadway, 5th Avenue shopping, and iconic landmarks like the Empire State Building and Rockefeller Center. Enjoy easy access to public transportation with Penn Station and various subway lines within a 10-minute walk, connecting you to all of Manhattan and beyond. Start your day with a complimentary hot breakfast and take in Midtown views from our rooftop deck. Guest rooms feature free WiFi, a spacious workspace, a laptop-sized safe, and a 40-inch flat-screen TV. Maintain your fitness routine in our modern fitness center and utilize our convenient business center and boardroom for meetings. Benefit from our on-site convenience shop and complimentary WiFi throughout your stay. As a bonus, there are no resort fees at this property.

195851.description: Boasting an enviable setting at the heart of the peaceful neighbourhood of Dorsoduro in Venice, this hotel is situated just a few steps away from the Salute water bus stop. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from the Accademia Art Gallery, the Guggenheim Museum and a number of attractions in the city. Guests can take a short water bus ride to explore the delights of St. Marco Square and Basilica. This charming hotel enjoys a delightful architectural style, blending effortlessly with its rich, cultural surroundings. The hotel welcomes guests into a world where traditional style and contemporary influences meet. The guest rooms enjoy a classical design, offering a refreshing ambience in which to unwind. The hotel offers a wide range of excellent services, including the Messner Restaurant, ensuring maximum comfort and convenience. All hotel guests are entitled to a 30% discount in the restaurant.

195861.description:
Conveniently situated in the north of the city, this elegant design hotel is located in the heart of the Las Tablas Business Park, where companies such as BBVA, Telecinco, Telefónica, Cofares or Agroman are based. The area is very well connected, just a few minutes away from the M-30, M-40 and A-1 motorways, 8 minutes on foot from the Las Tablas metro station and 1. 5 km from Fuencarral train station. 
The stylish guest rooms are excellently appointed and light-flooded. They are soundproofed and equipped with air-conditioning, free WIFI, flat-screen LCD TV and free safe with laptop charger. Business guests will appreciate the business corner and the sophisticated conference facilities. Other excellent services and amenities include 24-hour room service, restaurant, cafeteria and snack bar. A perfect choice for business travellers.

195932.address: 67, Derb Kadi Haja Sidi Mimoune Marrakech, 67
195932.description: Once past the door of this authentic ryad Moroccan, refined decoration, quiet and friendliness will set you the tone for a stay that will remain unforgettable. It is in this haven of peace, in the heart of the medina we will share our guests the delights of oriental hospitality. Dar Palmyra, is the pure Moroccan tradition, that will transport you to the softness of living and the warm atmosphere of the medina. The refinement of the decoration, the friendliness and the care given to the lesser of your desires, make you forget your usual living environment.

195948.address: Gran Via De Les Corts Catalanes, 563
195948.description: This hostel is located in the very city centre of Barcelona and all city attractions and hotspots are within walking distance. The building was constructed in 1900 and was recently renovated and reopened. It now offers modern facilities, such as a pleasant lounge with TV, which provides guests with the opportunity to relax and enjoy programmes and videogames. The cosy on-site bar serves light snacks and drinks. The friendly, attentive staff can assist with information and organize numerous fun activities.

195961.description: This hotel is located in Fiera Milano Rho, at the Saronno exit on motorway A9 Milano - Como - Chiasso, close to Milan and Como Lake. Inaugurated in 2005, the sleek Rho exhibition centre has given Milan a new makeover. Italian architect Massimiliano Fuksas' glass and steel structure resembles the forms of hills and mountains, surrounded by greenery and water features. This residence complements the modern setting with contemporary amenities and attentive service. In addition to a restaurant, it also features a bar where excellent drinks can be enjoyed. Televisions come with satellite channels and together with the Internet access available, provide in-room entertainment.

195964.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services and a fireplace in the lobby. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Paris? This hotel has 753 square feet (70 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. A shuttle from the hotel to the airport is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours).

195966.description: Throughout their stay at this establishment, guests will find themselves within the vicinity of Chateau de Vaux-le-Vicomte. Situated just outside Vert-Saint-Denis, to the north of Melun, in the south eastern suburbs of Paris and about 40 km from the city centre, it is easily accessible from the motorway. The residence is also in the same region as Chateau de Fontainebleau and Marolles-en-Brie Golf Club. Guests will surely feel at home in every one of the 48 guestrooms. All come decorated in light tones and are carefully appointed with amenities. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps guests connected, and satellite programming is available for in-room entertainment.

196036.description: This hotel is conveniently located in the heart of Saint-Gratien. With the RER train station just 20 metres away, Enghien Lake and its casino are within easy reach. Moreover, guests will enjoy easy access to Paris and its countless world-class attraction, as it is situated only 20 km from the property, and so is Charles De Gaulle Airport. The hotel offers 50 air-conditioned rooms, including 2 that are adapted for people with reduced mobility. In the spacious, bright units, guests can enjoy the benefits of complimentary Internet access and a TV with satellite programming. The 24-hour on-site bar is the perfect place to enjoy favourite drinks and pleasant conversations.

196037.address: Médina Loft N°5 lot OLM n°2 quartier El Ghoul
196037.description: Located in Marrakech, just 3 km from the Majorelle Garden and 4.4 km from the Koutoubia Mosque. The apartments have modern decor, a private and equipped terrace. The property is 6 km from Marrakech Menara Airport and 4.2 km from Jemaa El Fna square.

196040.description:
The Scott boutique hotel offers state-of-the art rooms in the trendy Saint Gilles quarter of Brussels, 5-minute walk from the fashionable Avenue Louise shopping area.
The Scott has just been fully refurbished and features sound-proofed rooms with state-of-the-art technology, flat-screen TV, and designer furniture. Each room has a modern en-suite bathroom, and our best rooms include a private terrace. 
Breakfast at this design hotel is served in the bright setting of the breakfast room. Furthermore, The Scott has a 24-hour reception and a tour desk.
Hotel Des Monnaies Metro Station and Louise Metro Station are located a 5-minute walk from the hotel. Brussels-South Railway Station, featuring the Eurostar Terminal, is only 3 metro stops away.

196043.description: This hotel enjoys a wonderful setting in Barcelona. The hotel lies just 500 metres away from FC Barcelona's Camp Nou. Collblanc metro station is just 350 metres away. Guests will find themselves just 200 metres from a bus stop, and a 10 minutes' bus ride from Sants Train Station. Surrounded by a wealth of attractions, this hotel affords guests an insight into the rich culture and history of this artistic city. The hotel enjoys a charming design, blending effortlessly with its surroundings. The guest rooms enjoy a simplistic design, exuding functionality and comfort. The rooms feature modern conveniences, for guests' comfort. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

196094.address: Snow Hill Plaza St Chads Queensway, 1
196094.description: Holiday Inn Express® Birmingham – Snow Hill is a 5-minute stroll from Snow Hill station and New Street station is a 15-minute walk away. Birmingham Airport (BHX) is a 25-minute drive. Guests enjoy a 55% discount off parking on the standard tariff at the B4 car park. The hotel's central location is an ideal base for exploring the city's attractions, including the famous Birmingham Bullring shopping centre and Birmingham Mailbox, a trendy shopping and dining destination. Get hands-on at Thinktank Science Museum with a wide range of interactive exhibits that explore science and technology. Discover over 2, 000 creatures at the National SEA LIFE Centre, a 15-minute walk from the hotel or get up close with over 1, 500 animals at Dudley Zoo and Castle, a 30-minute drive away. Art lovers can visit the Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery and families can have a day of fun at the Birmingham LEGOLAND Discovery Centre. For entertainment, the Utilita Arena is just a 4-minute drive away, hosting the biggest names in music and comedy. Birmingham Children’s Hospital is 3 minutes door-to-door. Unwind in your room, stream your favourite shows on fast Wi-Fi or catch up on emails at the desk. Relax with a drink and snack in the bar and wake up to a free breakfast of hot baps, cereals, and coffee.

name.content: Residhome Paris Saclay - Bures sur Yvette

196096.description: This residence enjoys a great setting at the heart of the Chevreuse Valley. Boasting natural-forest surroundings, the residence enjoys an air of peace and serenity. Guests can explore the beauty and splendour of the Chevreuse Valley Regional Natural Park. The residence offers guests the ideal location in which to enjoy a truly relaxing, refreshing stay. This charming residence guarantees high-quality accommodation options in a contemporary setting. The suites and studios are elegantly designed, fitted with contemporary conveniences for guests' comfort. Excellent service and a relaxed setting add to the comfortable experience that this complex provides.

196136.description:
Situated in the Chueca district, one of the best districts of Madrid, the excellent U Hostels enjoys a perfect location in the Spanish capital. The exclusive shopping venues of Fuencarral and Gran Via are within a short stroll, while major attractions such as the Puerta del Sol, Prado Museum, Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum, Royal Palace, Plaza de España and Plaza Mayor are within easy reach.
Set in a former 19th century city palace. The rooms and dorms are well-appointed, bright and fresh. Guests will appreciate the complimentary wireless internet access throughout the building. In addition, the hostel offers services and amenities such as a fully-equipped kitchen, a TV lounge, a chill-out zone, communal computers and a great roof terrace where you can have a drink. This top-class hostel is an ideal choice for young people and for those who are seeking a great location in this vibrant city.

196216.description: This hotel enjoys a convenient location just a 15-minute drive from Buenos Aires downtown, in Palermo Soho, a very popular neighbourhood full of designers as well as a host of cultural, dining and entertainment venues. This hotel housed in a gorgeous gothic building boasting a stylish interior is the best choice for guests wishing to discover this vibrant region. It provides a choice of shared and private guest rooms featuring a contemporary design that combines aesthetics and comfort with convincing functionality. The facilities include a reading room, ideal to enjoy a moment of relaxation, a spacious terrace and a fully-equipped kitchen, perfect for guests to prepare their own meals.

196218.description:
The charming hotel Confort 80 enjoys a convenient situation in Bogotá, the capital of Colombia. Countless restaurants, bars, cafés and shopping facilities such as the El Retiro commercial centre can be found in the surrounding area, and the historic La Candelaria District can be reached within a 15-minute drive. Heroes metro station is just a few steps away, providing direct access to the city centre. 
The small hotel welcomes guests in a sophisticated ambience. The well-appointed rooms are elegantly furnished in a contemporary design with parquet floors and a spacious seating area. Features include complimentary wireless internet access and LCD cable-TV. Guests can enjoy a hearty American breakfast included in the room rate, and there is an on-site restaurant serving an exquisite fusion of Colombian and international cuisine. A shuttle service to and from the airport can be organised. This is an enchanting hotel in a great location.

196220.description: Featuring a unique location in the city of Bogotá, this luxury establishment offers the perfect choice for travellers seeking a unique accommodation boasting incomparable views. Guests staying at this unique hotel will find a host of the most exclusive shopping centres, boutiques and restaurants close to the property while El Dorado International Airport is some 17 kilometres away. Designed with guests' comfort in mind, the tastefully decorated rooms are fully-equipped with fine bed linen and feature a contemporary design and modern spaces. As for the facilities, the on-site restaurant serves a choice of fresh and light specialities.

name.content: Premiere Classe Melun Senart Vert Saint Denis

196229.address: Zae Jean Monnet, Avenue De L'Europe, 270
196229.description: This establishment is ideally located close to Orly airport, within easy reach from the A5 motorway and just 30 minutes' drive from Paris. It is the perfect place for those travellers wishing to visit Disneyland Paris and the Château de Fontainebleau castle. This charming establishment offers a prime location next to the Jean Monnet small business park and close to shopping centres. Designed with guests in mind, all the comfortable rooms have been fully-equipped and offer unlimited free Wi-Fi, flat screen TV and en suite bathroom. There is also a restaurant serving breakfast buffet and a private parking.

196238.description:
In response to the coronavirus (COVID-19), the company  applies additional health and safety measures at this time.
This property offers possibility of face-to-face or remote check-in using a check-in machine to collect the key, after sending documentation.

These apartments are located in a quiet part in Barcelona, just 10 minutes' walk from the impressive basilica of the Sagrada Familia by Gaudi. Wireless Internet Hotspot is available in all areas and is free of charge. There is a lift access to upper floors. The property is 900 metres from Sagrada Familia and 1.3 km from Park Güell. The apartment will provide guests with a satellite TV, air conditioning and a seating area. There is a full kitchen with a microwave and a refrigerator and microwave. Private bathroom also comes with a shower (with hot and cold water). If guests feel like visiting the surroundings, check out Diagonal (1.4 km) and Monumental (1.5 km). Barcelona El Prat Airport is located 14 km from the property. Late check-in has an extra-charge.

196239.description:
Well-situated in Sarrià-St. Gervasi these spacious, contemporary-style apartments are set in a peaceful area of Barcelona, within walking distance of Lesseps Metro Station, and 4 stops from Plaza Catalunya. From here, an excellent Metro service runs to the vibrant city centre in just 10 minutes. 
The facilities and services provided by the residence ensure a pleasant stay. 
 In addition to airport transfer, the apartment's attentive staff can also assist with information. 
The check in procedure will take place at the office located in the same building form Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm. 
If you expect to arrive after 6pm or at the weekend/bankholidays, you will need to use the self check in machine which you will find inside the building. 
Please contact the property for further details and access codes info@apartamentossata. com or call +34 636 074 727 at leat 72h in advance.

196263.description: The hostel is located not far from Plaza Cataluña, within walking distance of all the main attractions, bars and shops, from the luxurious Paseo de Gracia Avenue to the historical Gothic, the vibrant Raval and the cosy Borne neighbourhoods. Guests can choose between four different dorm types, some with a private terrace. Security lockers are provided and all rooms come with reading lights and air-conditioning units. The establishment offers the use of computers with 24-hour Internet access. In the vast lounge area with cosy sofas, guests can meet travellers from all around the world, share experiences and enjoy pleasant conversations.

196318.description: This hotel is located in Milan, close to Ex Campo dei Fiori, Cimitero Monumentale di Milano, and Arco della Pace. Also nearby are Piazza Portello and Velodromo Vigorelli. Guests are welcomed in the residence by a friendly staff in the vast lobby. There they will find a number of facilities intended to provide comfort and convenience for all travellers. The cosy coffee shop is a good choice to share relaxing moments and pleasant conversations while enjoying a drink. In addition to the banquet facilities, the establishment also boasts a beautiful garden, perfect for any occasion. Wedding services are offered to carry out a perfect and unforgettable event in the most professional way.

196349.description: This establishment, located only 250 metres away from the Paseo del Prado and less than a 10 minutes' walk away from the Puerta del Sol, offers simple rooms with WIFI. Less than 10 minutes on foot away, guests will find several metro stations, such as Sevilla station, of line 2, and the station del Sol, lines 1, 2 and 3. Atocha train station is situated a 15 minutes' walk away. The Barajas international airport is 20 minutes away by taxi. Rooms have tiled floors and are equipped with air-conditioning, central heating, safe, desk and TV.

196373.description: This hotel is strategically located just a short distance away from Teatro Nacional La Castellana, in Bogota D.C. The hotel is located just a short distance away from a myriad of attractions in the area, including the city's 93 Viceroy Park. A broad range of shopping, dining and entertainment venues can be found nearby. This wonderful hotel greets visitors with warm hospitality and the promise of a comfortable stay. The guest rooms are superbly designed, offering comfort and style in a peaceful setting, seemingly miles away from the city that lies just outside. This wonderful hotel offers the ideal option for those who are eager to explore this captivating area.

196449.description:
Spacious and modern apartments located in the Sant Martí neighborhood, 10 minutes from the beach with excellent public transport links to the city center. All apartments have a sunny living-dining room and open-plan kitchen, so you can comfortably prepare your own meals. 

Check-in will take place at the office located in the same building. Hours are: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday. 
If you plan to arrive after 6:00 PM or on weekends or holidays, you will need to use the self-check-in machine located inside the building. 
IMPORTANT: Please contact the property for details on how to proceed and the access codes at info@apartamentossata. com or call 24h contact number +34 628 460 432 at least 72h in advance.

196466.description:
Located 0.5km from the Brussels Midi station and 1.3km from the Grand-Place, the YOOMA Urban Lodge offers private rooms for 2, 4 and 6 people in the world of Franco-Belgian comics in partnership with the Dargaud, Dupuis, Le Lombard and Smurfs editions.
This establishment has room service, a wellness area including a hammam and sauna, a lounge with a 250m² terrace, luggage storage, parking and free Wi-Fi.
All rooms at this hotel are equipped with air conditioning, a large-screen HD TV and a private bathroom with a bathtub. The rooms are themed around a Franco-Belgian comic book hero, with a total of 30 different worlds represented. 
The bedroom has been designed to present private spaces with an equal level of comfort on all beds. Each bed thus benefits from a reading light, individual sockets and switches.
For lunch and dinner, a menu is available in room service. A generous buffet is served each morning.

196468.description: The Hotel Manos Stephanie offers genuine Brussels hospitality, ideally located near the fashionable Avenue Louise shopping district and Place Stephanie. A short walk from Bois de la Cambre, and a quick cab ride to Grand Place and the historical center. Our lobby and corridors showcase a permanent collection of beautiful antiques. A sister hotel, Manos Premier, is conveniently located just steps away.

name.content: Courtyard New York Manhattan/Times Square West

196470.description: The Courtyard New York Manhattan/Times Square West offers convenient access to iconic attractions. Located near Times Square, Madison Square Garden, and Macy's, this hotel provides a fitness center, on-site restaurant, snack bar, and business center. The 224 guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs, refrigerators, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms. Meeting and conference space is also available.

name.content: Holiday Inn NYC - Lower East Side

196471.description: Discover Manhattan's vibrant Lower East Side, a cultural hub renowned for its diverse culinary scene, cutting-edge art, exclusive boutiques, live music venues, and exciting nightlife. Located just steps from the Tenement Museum, Katz's Delicatessen, Little Italy, SoHo, Chinatown, the East Village, and NYU, the Holiday Inn NYC – Lower East Side offers convenient access to the city's most exciting attractions. Explore the neighborhood or hop on the subway (F, M, J, and Z trains) just one block away to reach Times Square, Wall Street, and beyond. We're also conveniently located near SoHo and only 9 miles from LaGuardia Airport (LGA) and 12 miles from JFK Airport (JFK). For those wanting to explore Brooklyn, the Williamsburg Bridge is right at our doorstep. Enjoy complimentary amenities such as free Wi-Fi, an in-room multimedia hub, a business center with free printing and scanning, a 24-hour fitness center, and plush bedding. Start your day with a hearty breakfast at Nacirema, our onsite restaurant, or return for a delicious dinner and signature cocktails. We're proud of our friendly and personalized service, and we invite you to read our guest reviews to see what awaits you. Experience true hospitality at the Holiday Inn NYC – Lower East Side, your urban oasis.

196476.description: This superior hotel enjoys a strategic setting in Brussels. The hotel is situated just a few steps away from the vibrant Avenue Louise, offering business and leisure travellers the ideal setting in the city. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from the main attractions that this delightful city has to offer. Nestled amidst 2000 metres squared of private garden, the hotel is an oasis of peace and serenity in the city. The hotel enjoys a charming, elegant style, exuding opulence and decadence. The guest rooms are classically designed, featuring neutral tones and a relaxing ambience. Guests are invited to dine in style in the restaurant, where delectable French and Belgian specialities are the order of the day. Guests will be impressed by the memorable stay that they experience at this hotel.

196522.description: Located in the heart of the Alfama district of Lisbon, the hotel is the first boutique hotel in the city's historic area, with its narrow streets, traditional shops and the famous Fado restaurants. The property is just a 5-minute stroll from the São Jorge Castle and a 15-minute drive from Lisbon International Airport. Housed in a refurbished 19th Century building, this design hotel offers 42 luminous and spacious guestrooms, beautifully decorated and featuring views to the river Tagus and the Alfama neighbourhood. The hotel boasts an outdoor swimming pool with sun loungers and parasols, and a wine bar, the Memmo Alfama Terrace, where guests can enjoy the delicious Portuguese gastronomy and superb wines while listening to music and with the beautiful views. Every morning, guests can enjoy a breakfast buffet, and there is a 24-hour honesty refrigerator with snacks and beverages.

196609.description: Rotta Hotel is conveniently located in the Güneşli district, at the heart of the Istanbul Business District, and in close proximity to major entertainment and shopping centers. It is just a 30-minute drive from Istanbul Airport and 45 minutes from Sabiha Gökçen Airport. Additionally, the CNR Expo center is only 8 minutes away, making it an ideal location for both business and leisure travelers.

196610.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages or enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary on-the-go breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 84 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and minibars. LED televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Gülhane Park - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Eminonu Pier - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Bosphorus - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Eminönü Square - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Istanbul Archaeology Museums - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Basilica Cistern - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Grand Bazaar - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Hagia Sophia - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Sultanahmet Square - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Istanbul University - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Topkapi Palace - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Cemberlitas Bath - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Süleymaniye Mosque - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 47. 4 km / 29. 4 mi Istanbul Airport (IST) - 41. 1 km / 25. 6 mi The preferred airport for Sehir Hotel Old City is Istanbul Airport (IST).

196655.description: Located in the heart of Venice, the 4-star Hotel American Dinesen is within a 15-minute drive of iconic landmarks such as St. Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge. This hotel offers a variety of amenities for a comfortable stay, including complimentary Wi-Fi, a terrace, a garden, concierge services, and a television in the common area. Each of the 30 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, an LCD television with satellite programming, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a bidet. Guests can enjoy 24-hour room service, a snack bar/deli, and a bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional conveniences include express check-in and check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and limited onsite parking. Nearby attractions include the Peggy Guggenheim Museum, Teatro La Fenice, and St. Mark's Basilica. Marco Polo Airport (VCE) is approximately 9. 2 miles from the hotel.

196704.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a sauna and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at The Brasserie, a restaurant which specializes in local cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7 AM to 10 AM and on weekends from 8 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Planning an event in Birmingham? This hotel has facilities measuring 3035 square feet (282 square meters), including conference space. Make yourself at home in one of the 193 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions.

196714.description: The Van der Valk Hotel Almere enjoys a central location in the Netherlands, close to major cities like Amsterdam, Utrecht, and Amersfoort. It's also a short distance from Almere's city center and natural areas such as Oostvaardersplassen. This makes the hotel an ideal base for any type of stay. The hotel offers 180 rooms, including standard, luxury, family, and suites. Our spacious standard rooms are well-equipped for your comfort.

196748.description: Conveniently near the airport, the hotel is located in Lima (Miraflores), close to Ricardo Palma Cultural Centre, Sala Luis Miro Quesada Garland, and Larcomar. Also nearby are Virgen Milagrosa Church and Kennedy Park. Fully renovated to the highest level of comfort, ensuring quiet evenings to relax or work, soundproof windows and workstation facilities complement every room has. The hotel offers a restaurant, a coffee shop/café, and a bar/lounge. Guests are served a complimentary breakfast each morning. Business amenities at this 3.5-star property include a 24-hour business centre and a meeting/conference room and free Wi-Fi in public areas. Additional amenities include a casino, a fitness centre, and multilingual staff. For a surcharge, guests have access to a roundtrip airport shuttle (available on request). Guest parking is complimentary.

196773.description: Located on Plaça Urquinaona, in the heart of Barcelona, the H10 Urquinaona Plaza is a newly built hotel housed within a nineteenth century building that maintains some of its original structure and beautifully crafted ceilings, which have been combined with a very contemporary interior design that uses clean lines and simple colours. The hotel features the Novecento Restaurant, bar, gym and Chill-Out Terrace with plunge pool and outstanding views over the city. It also has 3 meeting rooms that are perfect for small company events.

name.content: Hotel Verde Cape Town International Airport

196784.description:
Hotel Verde Cape Town Airport, Africa's greenest hotel is a contemporary-styled, 4-star, sustainable hotel, based 400m from Cape Town International Airport. The hotel offers guests a carbon-neutral stay, along with luxurious accommodation and event facilities. The hotels bedrooms are vibrantly designed, soundproof and ideal for single travellers or families.

Hotel Verde Cape Town Airport is the first hotel in the world to be certified LEED Platinum (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) for both New Construction and Operations & Maintenance from the United States Green Building Council.

The Nuovo Restaurant, bar and freshening-up-facilities are available for those who need to rest before, after or in between flights. Guests can enjoy many convenient facilities and services, including: complimentary Wi-Fi; a business centre; 24-hour room service; a 24-hour deli, an indoor-gym with power generating gym equipment and a jogging trail, outdoor gym and eco-pool set in the tranquil wetlands that have been restored by the Hotel Verde team.

The hotel offers a complimentary airport shuttle that runs every hour, starting as early as 4:15am to midnight (shuttle may be requested for in between the hour, if waiting time is too long) and a daily complimentary shuttle to the V&A Waterfront. The Nuovo Restaurant & Bar serves dishes prepared with local produce. An early breakfast buffet is available from 4:30am for those catching an early flight.

196850.description: Merging modern design and amenities with a historical texture, this boutique hotel's centre piece is a transparent section of the lobby floor show-casing an illuminated relic from the city's rich historical past. Located in Karakoy, the hotel is ideally situated for exploring the Beyoglu area and Galata Tower, as well as the main attractions at Sultanahmet which can be reached by crossing the Golden Horn via the Galata Bridge. Karakoy ferry port is a couple of minutes away. Features of the hotel include a business corner, lounge café and free Wi-Fi access.

name.content: JA Ocean View Hotel, Jumeirah Beach Dubai

196852.description: Located in the heart of new Dubai on the desirable Jumeirah Beach strip, the Ocean View Hotel offers easy access to Dubai's top restaurants, beaches, shopping malls, tourist attractions, and business centers. This 5-star family beach hotel stands along the Dubai Marina Walk, proudly overlooking the Arabian Gulf and the Palm Jumeirah. Its 346 rooms and suites feature sea views from balconies or the rooms themselves. Guests can enjoy a selection of international satellite channels on flat-screen televisions. For families, 152 interconnecting rooms are available. Six restaurants and bars, along with an Executive Lounge, cater to diverse tastes. Hotel facilities include a temperature-controlled infinity pool with stunning sea views, a spa, health club, jacuzzi, steam room, and sauna. The public beach is just steps away. Children aged 4-11 enjoy complimentary access to the Kids Club. Valet parking is available in the basement car park. -- Important Information-- JA Resorts and Hotels is committed to guest safety and has implemented a comprehensive program of protection and prevention. From arrival to check-out, every aspect of sanitization, social distancing, and safety protocols is addressed. Applicable across its nine unique properties in the UAE and Indian Ocean, the program includes directives from government entities, respected industry certifications, and the World Travel and Tourism Council's SafeTravels program.

196853.description: This is a luxurious property, conveniently located only 4.6 km from the centre of Paris. Local tourist attractions such as Moulin Rouge, Museum of Eroticism and Montmartre Cemetery are not far from the establishment. Also easily within reach are Theatre Mogador, Basilique du Sacre Coeur and Parc Monceau. In addition to its privileged location, this hotel makes every effort to ensure a pleasant stay. By offering adequate amenities and attentive service, it proves to be an ideal choice for any type of visit. Dining facilities include a cafeteria and guests will have the opportunity to enjoy the comfort and cosiness of the fireplace in the lobby, while reading a good book from the on-site library.

name.content: Jumeirah Living World Trade Centre Residence

196877.description: Jumeirah Living World Trade Centre Residence offers luxury serviced apartments conveniently located in Dubai's business district on Sheikh Zayed Road, within walking distance of the Dubai World Trade Centre. Experience the comfort of home combined with world-class amenities, including stylish apartments and in-room dining. Our dedicated lifestyle team is available to cater to your every need, ensuring a truly effortless stay. The residence is close to central financial and business districts, as well as key attractions. From world-class shopping at Dubai Mall to Jumeirah Beach, Dubai's vibrant city life is easily accessible. Our proximity to the Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai Convention Centre makes our residence ideal for corporate executives. We also offer airport transfers to and from Dubai International Airport for a seamless and luxurious experience.

196912.description: This resort hotel enjoys a wonderful setting, just a 15 minutes' drive from Alanya, lying close to the tourism district of Turkler, on the Mediterranean Coast. The hotel offers comfortable and air-conditioned guestrooms, classically furnished and equipped with private bathroom and modern amenities to ensure a pleasant stay. For the convenience of business guests, the hotel offers well-equipped meeting facilities and is situated just 1 km from the Lufti Kirdar Congress Centre. Every morning, guests can enjoy a complete breakfast buffet and taste delicious Turkish specialties and International cuisine for lunch and dinner at the restaurant.

This comfortable hostel enjoys an unbeatable location in Madrid, just two minutes from the Puerta del Sol and corresponding metro station.  The city's most famous museums are within a fifteen-minute walk, including El Prado, the Thyssen-Bornemisza, and the Reina Sofia. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a free weekday newspaper, and coffee. Enhance your stay by joining our Choice Privileges Rewards program, where you can earn free nights and gift cards.
