name.content: Times Square West Hotel, BW Signature Collection

197346.description: The Times Square West Hotel, BW Signature Collection, NY will get you refreshed and ready to take on the day for leisure or business. Our smoke-free hotel is conveniently situated in Hell's Kitchen near Times Square. Top New York City attractions are nearby including the Broadway theatre district, Empire State Building, New York City Civic Center and Madison Square Garden. Our valued guests enjoy amenities that include free hot breakfast, free WiFi, free coffee and a business center. Each comfortable guest room features a Flat-Screen TV, coffee maker, desk, hair dryer, iron and ironing board. Also, earn rewards including free nights and gift cards with our Choice Privileges Rewards program.

197396.description:
The exclusive and luxurious Pierre Milano Hotel is situated in the heart of Milan, only a short stroll from the magnificent Duomo Di Milano and the striking Sforza Castle.  The Leonardo da Vinci National Museum of Science and Technology is only 650 metres from the hotel , while the stunning Sant'Ambrosio Basilica and corresponding metro station is right at the hotel's doorstep.  The famous Via Montenapoleone is within walking distance.
The hotel's lavish guest rooms and suites are elegant and refined, each boasting antique furnishings and a range of modern amenities such as satellite television and complimentary Wi-Fi internet access.  The in-house restaurant serves Italian and Mediterranean cuisine alongside fine wines in a dignified and tasteful setting.  For a fruitful business trip or romantic and pampered couples' sightseeing holiday, this hotel provides an unforgettable stay.

197399.description: Overlooking the tranquil pine forest of Lido del Sole, this distinctive blue hotel offers a peaceful escape. The private beach is easily accessible by a leisurely walk or bike ride (fee applies, subject to availability). Recently renovated, the hotel's family-friendly rooms feature natural color palettes and essential amenities, providing a relaxing and pleasant stay. If you prefer to stay at the hotel, you can enjoy the refreshing pool and borrow a book from the library to unwind in the shade of the pine trees. The town center is 800 meters away.

197406.description: This chic, designer hotel offers a peaceful retreat on a quiet street in Paris's 8th arrondissement. Ideally located in the heart of the business district, it's also conveniently close to the Champs-Élysées, Opéra Garnier, and renowned department stores. Just a short walk from Gare Saint-Lazare, you'll find easy access to Le Louvre Museum and the Arc de Triomphe. This fully air-conditioned hotel offers a concierge desk, complimentary Wi-Fi throughout, and laundry service. Each soundproofed guest room, decorated in muted earthy tones, features comfortable beds, a flat-screen TV, a minibar, and a bathroom with Damana toiletries and towel warmers. Some rooms boast balconies, city views, and Nespresso machines. A courtesy tray is provided in every room. Please note, this is a non-smoking hotel.

197418.description:
Hiltons Commitment to You During COVID-19  ” Weve updated our reservation and cancellation policies, extended Hilton Honors Points and status and may be requiring face coverings, temperature checks, health declarations and use of mobile contact tracing at our hotels around the world.  Please visit our  dedicated COVID-19 page  for the latest and before traveling.A true architectural masterpiece, Waldorf Astoria Amsterdam has the privilege of being hosted by six magnificent 17th and 18th century canal palaces. The rich heritage captured within the walls of this unique property is solely matched by its unparalleled location on the iconic 'Gentlemen's Canal' – the greatest of them all. 

The luxurious hotel offers 93 spacious rooms and suites overlooking the city's canals or the private courtyard. Each of the rooms, lofts, and suites are graced with their own individual character, decorated in soft and elegant furnishings with accents of lapis lazuli and stronger ochre colors referencing Holland's own Vermeer, whose paintings include 'The Girl with a Pearl Earring.'

From the bustling Rembrandtplein to the cosmopolitan Pijp district, the Anne Frank House or the cultural Museumplein – all of the city's highlights are within walking distance of the hotel. The more adventurous explorers will reach Amsterdam's boundaries and beyond by hopping on one of the hotel's complimentary bicycles for a private tour or a casual relaxing ride. 

Dutch hospitality at its best, the team of Waldorf Astoria Amsterdam takes pride every day in delivering the legendary and bespoke True Waldorf Service to all of its guests. Whether it is with the Personal Concierges, at the Guerlain Spa, or the two-Michelin star restaurant Spectrum, all strive to continuously deliver the most unforgettable experiences.

197437.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and bike storage. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 41 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring tablet computers and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

name.content: Hilton Garden Inn Brussels City Centre

197438.description: The Hilton Garden Inn Brussels City Centre is a four star hotel where guests stay connected at the Capital of Europe alongside its many international businesses and shopping venues. After a busy day, unwind in our hotel's calm courtyard garden, a rare find in the lively city. Stay fit in our 24/7 complimentary fitness room and treat yourself to drinks and snacks from the Garden Bar or Pavilion Pantry. Our hotel is ideally situated between the Brussels residential areas, European Parliament zone and the Brussels South International Railway Station. If your leisure time allows, the famous and luxurious Avenue Louise is an excellent fit for all your retail shopping needs, where you can find brands such as Michael Kors, Hugo Boss, Guess and many more. The hotel is located two kilometers away from the historical Grand Place.

197454.description: This boutique hotel occupies a beautiful building on the Asian side of Istanbul in Pendik. Decorated and furnished in an elegant style, it combines classical design with today's trends. Its location provides easy access to the new marina, shopping and trade centres, while Sabiha Gokcen Airport is just a short car ride away. The waterfront is a 5-minute walk away and provides an enjoyable walk. Ferryboats run from the marina to Bostanci and Yalova.

197618.description:
The 4-star Santa Justa Hotel offers a central location in Lisbon, together with luxury rooms. Made up of 2 buildings interconnected by an exterior passage, the hotel is located in a pedestrian street 200 metres from Santa Justa Lift and features a 24-hour reception. 

Offering views of the nearby landmarks, the large rooms at Santa Justa are modern in style. They feature a Nespresso coffee machine, mini-bar and a 101 cm LED SmartTV. All rooms have a private bathroom with Amenities and most include a bathrobe, slippers and free toiletries. Free WiFi is available in all Hotel areas. 

Guests can enjoy the daily breakfast buffet, lunch, tea break and dinner at the Elevador Restaurant. Later, guests can head to the bar to enjoy a cocktail. Room service is available from 07:00 to 23:00. Guests can also enjoy live music nights, with Fado every Tuesday and Thrusday and Jazz every Saturday, from 8pm to 10 pm. 

Staff at the reception can help guests making restaurant reservations, day trips, car rentals, babysitting services, and many other services. The hotel also provides laundry and dry cleaning services. An airport shuttle is available upon previous request and extra charges. 

Augusta Street, filled with shopping and dining opportunities, is a few steps away from Hotel Santa Justa. Lisbon International Airport is 7 km away and Rossio Train Station is less than a 5-minute walk.

197620.description: Located in the heart of Sultanahmet, this boutique-styled hotel is within easy walking distance of the major historical attractions. Consisting of 3 buildings, the high-ceilinged rooms have wooden floors and are decorated in a flamboyant style representing an Ottoman theme. The hotel features modern comforts including free Wi-Fi access, a business lounge and winter garden restaurant. Cankurtaran train station is a short stroll from the hotel and café bars and restaurants can be found closeby.

197709.description: The establishment features a total of 17 rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas.

197710.description: This hotel is located in Paris, close to Le Bon Marche, Tour Montparnasse, and Rodin Museum. Also nearby are Luxembourg Palace and Louvre Museum. It successfully combines a convenient location and comfortable accommodation. Guests are welcomed to enjoy a drink from the selection served at the bar, or share some relaxing moments by the romantic fireplace in the elegant lobby. The needs of corporate travellers are not overlooked, as the establishment offers meeting rooms, which could accommodate most functions, and complimentary wireless Internet access. The hotel comprises 11 comfortable guestrooms spread across 4 floors. They are tastefully decorated and appointed with essential amenities.

197789.description: This hotel is located in one of the more prestigious areas of Buenos Aires. The hotel is situated close to the vibrant Plaza Serrano. Guests will find themselves immersed in the rich culture and history of this captivating city. A wealth of intriguing attractions can be found nearby. An abundance of shopping, dining and entertainment venues are situated just a short distance away from the hotel. This hotel offers guests a prime setting in which to enjoy a relaxing leisure or business trip. The hotel offers modern, boutique accommodation options and provides personalized attention to discerning travellers. Guests can indulge in a delectable dining experience in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant.

197799.description: This comfortable business hotel enjoys a central location in Bogota's Teusaquillo neighbourhood.  The El Dorado International Airport is a fifteen-minute drive from the hotel, and the Corferias convention centre is only 100 metres away, making this a perfect base for business travel.  Additionally, the Universidad Nacional de Colombia and the United States Embassy are nearby, while the attractions of La Candelaria are just a short drive from the hotel.  Guests might take advantage of the hotel's many helpful services including, airport transfers, room service and covered parking, and the hotel also offers an onsite restaurant for added convenience.

197800.description:
Time Select - Elegant Apartments, located in the El Golf neighborhood, combines elegance, comfort, and a welcoming design, positioning it as an excellent choice for those seeking a unique accommodation experience. Located in the exclusive Las Condes neighborhood, Time Select offers strategic proximity to business centers, restaurants, luxury shops, and tourist attractions, ideal for both business and leisure travelers. 

Time Select stands out for its intimate and personalized atmosphere, reflecting attention to detail and high-quality service. Its facilities include comfortable apartments equipped with all modern amenities and meeting and event spaces. Furthermore, its tranquil setting and boutique style make it a standout alternative to large chain hotels.

197831.description:
Les Plumes Hotel Paris invites you on a fascinating journey through time, imbued with the romantic charm of 19th century Paris, and to discover the mythical couples who marked this period rich in masterpieces. 

Follow in the footsteps of Paul Verlaine and Arthur Rimbaud, Victor Hugo and Juliette Drouet or George Sand and Alfred de Musset, and enjoy the spirit of a guest house in which everything, from the staff uniform to the stylish decorative details, draws you into the deliciously romantic atmosphere of that time. You will appreciate the playful side of this original place which combines historical references and modern facilities, as well as the high level of comfort offered in the hotel and its 35 rooms, perfect for relaxing getaways or business trips.

197848.description: Treat yourself to massages and facials. This hotel also offers complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, snacks in the coffee shop/cafe, or room service (during limited hours). 197860.description: Enjoy a central London stay at Garner Hotel London Victoria by IHG, a guesthouse conveniently located within a 5-minute drive of Westminster Abbey and Buckingham Palace. We offer 43 air-conditioned rooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Each room also includes a desk, coffee/tea maker, and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box. We're just 0. 5 miles from Victoria Station Travel Information Centre and 1. 2 miles from Big Ben.

197862.description: This luxury hotel is located in the upscale area of Kiris, in Kemer, a popular seaside resort in the province of Antalya, on the Mediterranean coast of Turkey. It is 250 m from a pebble beach and 4 km from the centre of the town of Kemer, with many shops, bars and restaurants. Kemer's main attraction is its natural landscape with a beautiful coastline, mountains and pine forest and it is a great place for sports enthusiasts, offering activities such as paragliding, horse riding, cycling and water sports. The property offers an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, fitness centre, restaurants and bars, water park, Turkish bath, sauna and an array of activities such as table tennis, darts, aerobics, water gymnastics, beach volleyball and a nightclub. Make yourself at home in one of the 22 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. 198188.description: This charming establishment is situated between Side, an ancient Greek city on the southern Mediterranean coast of Turkey, and Kumkoy, in Antalya province. This property is a 10-minute walk from a sandy beach and a lot of restaurants and café bars. The town centre of Side is 2 kilometres from the hotel and Antalya airport is some 66 kilometres away. This place is the perfect accommodation option to those guests wishing to relax and enjoy this vibrant region. It offers spacious comfortable rooms equipped with air conditioning and satellite television. The restaurant serves breakfast and dinner buffet style.

198271.description:
Hotel J, located in the Western seaside town of Negombo, is the ideal choice for travelers looking for a place to unwind and relax. The golden beaches of Negombo and the wonderful views of the Indian Ocean will provide guests the atmosphere they need for total relaxation and pleasure. Its convenient location provides easy access to the main tourist attractions in the area.
Hotel J is a budget hotel with an ideal location for a family vacation or a leisure trip. The thirty-four deluxe rooms and one suite are equipped with all the facilities required for a comfortable stay.
Guests will be able to take a dip in the swimming pool overlooking the ocean, and experience the peaceful tranquillity of its surroundings. Café-style dining is available at the main restaurant, and the well-stocked bar adjoining the restaurant offers a wide choice of hot and cold beverages and wines.

name.content: Madrid Airport Suites Affiliated By Melia

198277.description: This modern apartment complex boasts a convenient location between Madrid Barajas International Airport and the Corredor de Henares. Just 15 minutes from IFEMA and 10 minutes from Plenilunio Shopping Centre, it's ideal for business trips, extended stays, and vacations. Washington Square Park, the NYU campus and Greenwich Village are all within walking distance, and the bustling Union Square metro station is just steps away.  Guests are greeted with a warm welcome from multilingual staff in the sleek and modern lobby, and might choose to relax with a drink in the sophisticated lounge after a busy day. The in-house American-style brasserie serves regional cuisine with an international flair, while the refined downstairs restaurant serves delectable dishes from all over South America.  The hotel also features a 24-hour gym and a stylish rooftop terrace in addition to artfully designed guest rooms, all for a fantastic stay in New York City. DESTINATION FEE: A daily destination fee of $30.00 plus tax will apply to each room of your stay.

The hotel provides a cosy, intimate atmosphere with its peaceful outdoor pool and deck, sauna, and hammam in addition to comfortable rooms with satellite television and balconies with sea views.  The onsite restaurant offers an open buffet breakfast and dinner, and guests might take advantage of the convenient shuttle bus, all for a relaxing holiday by the sea.

198352.description: The hotel is in Camyuva, a small coastal town 7 km from the centre of Kemer, a popular seaside resort in the province of Antalya, on the Mediterranean coast of Turkey. The property has a private beach area 300 m away and the nearest bus station is only 200 m away. Camyuva, with a beautiful coastline, orange and olive groves, is a great place for relaxing beach holidays and for hiking enthusiasts and it also offers a good range of water sports. History lovers may wish to explore the nearby ancient town of Phaselis, with its impressive ruins, and the town of Kemer offers lively nightlife and many shops and restaurants. The rooms are fully furnished and have all modern conveniences, everything to make sure that the clients have an enjoyable break. No smoking accommodation is available and a buffet breakfast is provided daily. The balconies have beautiful sea views.

198532.description: The Quentin England Hotel offers 50 comfortable rooms in the heart of historic Amsterdam, across from the scenic Vondelpark. This central location provides easy access to major tourist attractions, business districts, and financial centers. Part of a unique six-building complex showcasing diverse European architectural styles, the hotel provides convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, en suite bathrooms in all rooms, and a daily breakfast served at the neighboring 'Bagels & Beans - Van Baerlestraat' café. Each room features a TV, telephone, and desk. While some basic single rooms are located in the basement or upper floors with limited or no windows, all offer a peaceful retreat after a day exploring the vibrant city. The friendly staff is available until 11 pm daily to assist with any needs and ensure an unforgettable Amsterdam experience. Enhanced health and safety measures are currently in place.

198533.description: The Quentin Arrive Hotel offers comfortable lodging in a beautifully restored 19th-century building. Located directly across from Amsterdam Central Station, on a historic street bustling with restaurants, bars, and cafes, it's the perfect base for exploring the city. Dam Square, the heart of Amsterdam, is a short 7-minute walk away, putting attractions like the Royal Palace, Madame Tussauds, and the Dam Monument within easy reach. The hotel offers a variety of rooms, from singles to quadruples, with private or shared facilities at reasonable prices. All rooms except triples have shared facilities. Free WiFi and a special breakfast buffet are available at Hick's Diner, located within the hotel. Enhanced health and safety measures are currently in effect. Reception is open daily until 11:30 pm, ready to assist you with any needs.

198535.description: Renowned for its unique atmosphere, this hotel is located in the heart of Amsterdam near the vibrant Leidseplein. This bustling square offers a variety of cafes, clubs, pubs, shops, and restaurants. Situated across a picturesque canal and opposite the city casino, the hotel boasts lovely canal views. Amsterdam's famous markets, including Albert Cuyp, the Flower Market, and the Waterlooplein flea market, are all within easy reach. The well-equipped rooms feature modern amenities to ensure a comfortable and personalized stay. A special breakfast is served at the adjacent B&B Lunchroom daily between 8:30 am and 10:30 am. Please note that additional health and safety measures are currently in effect due to COVID-19.
