198573.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy Indian cuisine at Tea Lounge, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 71 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Your Select Comfort bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

198575.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and a television in a common area. Additional amenities at this guesthouse include tour/ticket assistance, a reception hall, and bike storage. Satisfy your appetite at the guesthouse's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 20 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

198628.description: Located right across the shores of the Mediterranean, this hotel features a private beach area, outdoor pool and a spa & wellness centre with a Turkish bath. Free Wi-Fi is available in public areas. Air-conditioned rooms at Sunstar Beach Hotel come equipped with a satellite TV, minibar and a balcony with views. Private bathroom includes a hairdryer and free toiletries. Most of the rooms have sea views. The hotel's restaurant offers both à la carte menu and buffet options. There is a bar with quick bites and refreshing drinks. Breakfast is served in buffet style. Guests can work out in the fitness centre and relax in the sauna or massage room. You can play a game of billiards, table tennis and beach volleyball at Sunstar Beach Hotel. Antalya Airport is 133 km from the site. A shuttle service can be arranged upon request with an additional fee.

198630.description: Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. Cots are not available at Sun Fire Beach Hotel.

198668.description: This hotel enjoys a wonderful setting in Bogota. The property is situated in the area of Chico, just a few minutes' walking distance away from Parque de la 93. The hotel enjoys close proximity to a wealth of captivating attractions in this mesmerising city. A wide range of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found in the vicinity. This wonderful hotel features exemplary accommodation options. The rooms have been beautifully styled, and are designed to focus on the latest concept of comfort and convenience. The hotel offers facilities and services which are sure to impress every type of traveller.

198692.description:
At Zélie, every moment is a page in the story of Paris that we write together. Our bourgeois residence, steeped in 19th-century charm, invites you on a journey through time where the elegance of yesteryear meets contemporary comfort. The colonial style adds a touch of adventure to the refinement. Warm tones and exotic patterns create a vibrant atmosphere. The small lounges are havens of tranquility and sanctuaries of peace away from the hustle and bustle of Paris. Zélie is our guardian of old-world elegance. Her dedicated teams help make your stay in Paris a celebration, ensuring it remains a memorable experience. 

At cocktail hour, let yourself be tempted by our spirits menu, an invitation to travel and discover new flavors in our bar at the heart of our lounge.

198696.description: Situated in Rubi, this hotel is close to Sant Joan golf course and Sant Cugat High Performance Training Centre. Area attractions also include Autonomous University of Barcelona and Parc Tecnologic del Valles. This lovely establishment welcomes guests with a number of amenities and services. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available in public areas and an Internet point is located on site. Conveniences provided for corporate travellers include a meeting/conference room and audio-visual equipment. The 51 air-conditioned guestrooms are well-appointed with memory foam mattresses and premium bedding, to ensure a good rest.

198738.address: Cumhuriyet Mah. Ahu Unal Aysal Cad. 24, 24
198738.description:
Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. You can soak up the sun at the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities including a water park and an outdoor pool. This hotel also features wireless internet access (surcharge), a hair salon, and shopping on site. All-inclusive rates are available at this hotel. Meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments are included in all-inclusive rates. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Eldar Resort Hotel, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge, the beach bar, or the poolside bar.

Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, laundry facilities, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 174 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and minibars (stocked with some free items). Rooms have private balconies. LCD televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while wireless internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and designer toiletries. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. DinoPark - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi- Beydağları Coastal National Park - 3. 9 km / 2. 4 mi- Göynük Canyon Adventure Park - 4. 5 km / 2. 8 mi- Champion Holiday Village - 6. 8 km / 4. 2 mi- Liman Street - 7. 3 km / 4. 5 mi- Kemer Merkez Bati Public Beach - 7. 5 km / 4. 7 mi- Kemer Marina - 8. 5 km / 5. 3 mi- Moonlight Beach and Park - 8. 9 km / 5. 5 mi- Nomad Theme Park - 9 km / 5. 6 mi- Beldibi Beach Park - 9. 5 km / 5. 9 mi- Daima - 13. 1 km / 8. 2 mi- Blauhimmel beach - 14. 1 km / 8. 8 mi- Topçam - 15. 9 km / 9. 9 mi- Alacasu - 19. 2 km / 11.

198748.address: Gultepe Mah. Sehit Kiziltas Sok. Kucukcekmece, 1
198748.description: The architectural style of this new hotel is neo classical and baroque and the décor and furnishings are classically elegant.This luxury hotel caters for business, social functions, conferences and leisure travellers. It is conveniently situated for the CNR Expo Centre and Tuyap Exhibition Centre and close to the public transport network, making access to the Taksim Square in the heart of the city and the historical Sultanahmet possibly in half an hour or so. The Colony Shopping Centre is next door to the hotel.

198796.description: This popular hotel is located in the heart of Cancun, just 50 meters from the main avenue of the city and just 2 minutes from the entrance to the hotel zone. It offers a quiet and peaceful atmosphere ideal for those visiting Cancun, whether for business or pleasure. The hotel offers executive and family suites as well as standard rooms, all designed with special attention to detail to create a relaxing atmosphere and ensure maximum comfort for a pleasant and relaxing stay. Travellers can enjoy a great location, close to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and city sights, shops, bars and restaurants.

198802.description: Located on the popular Lavalle Street, two blocks from the Obelisk, this cosy city hotel boasts a fantastic location in the heart of Buenos Aires. The hotel is surrounded by cinemas, theatres, shopping, restaurants, public transport and tourist attractions in the Retiro district. The rooms are simply furnished and offer a quiet atmosphere for a restful stay.  Each room comes with air-conditioning, cable television and Wi-Fi internet access.  Guests can wake up to a continental breakfast in the breakfast room, and might appreciate the helpful services offered at the front desk, including assistance in booking sightseeing tours and excursions, airport transfers and fax services.

198803.description: The Hilton Lima Miraflores is ideally located in the heart of Lima's Miraflores district, just minutes from the vibrant Larcomar entertainment area, featuring shopping, theaters, museums, restaurants, and parks. A short 35-minute drive from Jorge Chavez International Airport, this modern hotel offers a range of amenities for both leisure and business travelers. While some services are currently unavailable, the hotel typically boasts a restaurant with street access, a terrace bar, a fitness center, and an outdoor pool. The hotel also features approximately 9, 000 sq. ft of meeting space, suitable for various events. Guest rooms are designed for both productivity and relaxation, and wireless internet access is available throughout the hotel. The hotel's restaurant blends traditional colonial Lima design with modern elements, serving a fusion of classic brasserie fare and authentic Peruvian dishes with Asian, French, and Mexican influences.

198809.description: Noi Vitacura is located in the heart of Alonso de Córdova, a short walk from Parque Bicentenario, a park with over 30 hectares of artificial lagoons, native flora and paths that make for lovely open-air excursions. Has 87 rooms with outdoor hot tub, King or Twin bedroom, LCD 42 TV, Premium audio system, italian fabrics, and videoconference telephone. Noi Spa is a place for you and indulging your whims. We offer many treatments including massage, facials, baths and hydrotherapy, among others, to help you renew your energies. Culinary offers that will leave you breathless, where the warmth of home and fine dining, will be the stars of the night. Noi Vitacura has spaces for meetings and events, one for 200 people and four 20-person rooms. They are perfect for corporate and social events.

198828.description:
Cancun has everything: white sand beaches, gourmet restaurants, big parties, and a bigger thirst for life. Lounge by the beach, explore the nearby jungles and Mayan ruins or simply seek out the best chilaquiles: no matter what travel experience you're looking for, Cancun is the place to be. From taco joints to turquoise waters, Selina Cancun is ready to help you embrace the best of Mexico. 
There is an environmental sanitation tax of approximately 80 Mexican pesos per room, per night, payable upon check-in.

198830.description: This elegant venue has been designed in order to provide the best hub for both business and leisure travellers visiting Montserrat. One of the most popular areas in the city, it is only a 10-minute walk from the Plaza de Mayo Square and the historic district, while the surrounding area houses some of the major government buildings. Being the oldest neighbourhood very little of the cityscape has changed and is less than a hundred years old, making a stroll around it a must. The nearest subway station is reachable within 10 minutes on food, and from there the Obelisk and renowned opera house Teatro Colón are just a 5-minute ride away. The bright and chic rooms of the venue are equipped with all the comforts the modern travellers can expect. Guests can relax on the cosy beds and browse the internet or watch a movie on the large-screen TV while preparing for a good night's sleep.

198839.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in the centre of Venice. Sitting amidst the area of Cananregio, this wonderful hotel affords guests close proximity to the many attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. The hotel is located within easy access of a number of first-class dining options, shopping opportunities and entertainment venues. The train station and the Rialto Bridge are situated close by. Venice International Airport is 12 km away, by Atvo shuttle or water taxi. This hotel offers a romantic setting, in which to completely escape the rest of the world. The guest rooms are elegantly designed, featuring elements of tradition and contemporary influences with a satellite TV, independently adjustable air conditioning and shower. Guests will be pleased by the many facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

198847.description:
Room Mate Aitana is located in the heart of Amsterdam, in a modern building on an artificial island in the IJ River, next to the Courthouse, Central Station and really close to Dam's Square, the “9 straatjes”in the Jordaan and the historic center of the city, and near the main tourist attractions like Anne Frank House and business centers of the capital. 
All rooms feature flat-screen satellite TV, a minibar, and a safe. The large windows enable views of Amsterdam or the IJ river. The bathroom is fitted with a hairdryer and shower or bathtub. Branded complimentary toiletries are provided as well as free wifi throughout the hotel and city. 
Guests can enjoy the breakfast buffet until 12 pm or enjoy breakfast in the room. There is lounge bar where we serve cocktails and bites with a view over the harbour and an outside terrace in the middle of the harbour, both decorated in cosmopolitan style. 
Room Mate Aitana includes a business area and a fitness area. At the hotel's concierge desk services such as babysitting, concierge, bike and car rental can be organized. 
Amsterdam Central Train Station is half a kilometre from the property and the Dam Square is within 1. 6 km. The RAI Convention centre is a 15-minute car drive or 20 minutes by public transport.

198873.description: Conveniently located near the airport, this Milan hotel is close to Piazza Aspromonte, Pirelli Tower, and Piscina Romano Ponzio. Also nearby are Politecnico di Milano and Istituto Besta. The residence boasts a number of carefully selected facilities and services. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available in public areas and additional amenities include tour and ticket assistance and a roundtrip airport shuttle. The 90 air-conditioned guestrooms all come with charming balconies, allowing guests to relish peaceful moments while enjoying wonderful city views. Televisions are equipped with cable channels and DVD players and feature in all accommodations as standard to provide entertainment.

198880.description: This comfortable hotel enjoys a prime location in central Paris, close to attractions such as Pont Mirabeau, the Statue of Liberty - Paris, and Pont de Grenelle. The Musée Marmottan, Wine Museum, and Pont de Bir-Hakeim are also easily accessible. Each of the 34 guest rooms features a flat-screen television with digital programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. This smoke-free hotel offers a range of leisure amenities, including a tennis court and an indoor swimming pool (temporarily closed until January 24, 2025). Guests can also indulge in the spa and wellness facilities. A pre-authorization of €100 will be made on your credit card upon check-in.

198886.description:
Situated in Istanbul in the Marmara Region Region, 100 metres from St. Antoine of Christ Church, Taksim Premium Hotel boasts a terrace and views of the sea.

Each room at this hotel is air conditioned and has a flat-screen TV. You will find a kettle in the room. For your comfort, you will find slippers and a hair dryer.

There is a 24-hour front desk at the property.

Istiklal Street is 600 metres from Taksim Premium Hotel, while Galata Tower is 800 metres away. Ataturk Airport is 14 km from the property.

198908.description: Located in the heart of Bogota's vibrant business district, near Calle 100 and Carrera 15, this hotel offers convenient access to the World Trade Center, Parque 93, Zona T, and shopping centers like Andino and Atlantis Plaza. It provides modern amenities and support services perfect for business travelers.

name.content: Hotel Playa La Media Luna, Isla Mujeres

198910.description: Centrally located in Isla Mujeres, Hotel Playa la Media Luna offers a relaxing beachside getaway. Enjoy a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, unwind on the terrace with stunning views, or take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel provides convenient amenities such as wedding services, tour/ticket assistance, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Free self-parking is also available. Each of the 18 guestrooms features a minibar, cable TV, and a private bathroom with a shower and complimentary toiletries. A safe and coffee/tea maker are also provided for your comfort. You'll be within a 5-minute walk of West Coast of Isla Mujeres, Punta Cancun, and Punta Nizuc National Park, and North Beach. The Isla Mujeres Ferry Terminal is just 0. 5 miles away.

198933.description: The residence is located near the Château de Vincennes and the Bois de Vincennes, the largest park in Paris. Once home to French royalty, this regal Parisian neighborhood offers a blend of historical culture, convenient city-center access, and the gastronomic delights expected of Europe's favorite destination. A short walk from the park, this resort offers tastefully decorated and spacious accommodations.

198938.description: Les Terres Blanches is located in Chatou, 1 km from Vesinet - Le Pecq RER Train Station. Guests can easily visit the city of Versailles and Porte Maillot in Paris, which are 25 minutes by car from the property, while La Défense is only 11 km away. This residence is an ideal base for those who wish to explore the beautiful surroundings and experience all they have to offer. In the hotel guests will encounter many carefully selected amenities combined with attentive service to make any stay memorable. Complimentary Internet access is available to those who wish to stay connected and a buffet breakfast is served each morning.

198945.description: Located in the heart of Birmingham, our hotel is just a short walk from the Bullring & Grand Central shopping centres, offering a wide variety of shops. With easy access to three major rail stations, attractions like the Sea Life Centre, O2 Academy, and Barclaycard Arena are also nearby. Each room features a comfortable king-size bed with four pillows and a cozy duvet. The on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and delicious evening meals.

198970.address: Ruta Panamericana No. 9, Km 61 Campana Buenos Aire
198970.description:
The hotel is located next to La Reserva Cardales Country Club, in a privileged natural environment, 61 km from Buenos Aires and in front of the Ciervo de los Pantanos National Park. A decorated space that will give you different sensations, immersing you in an atmosphere that transcends design aesthetics. With a high quality service, personalized treatment and warmth in every detail.

Sofitel La Reserva Cardales is immersed in a unique natural environment provided by its proximity to the Ciervo de los Pantanos National Park. This new concept is born from its privileged location. In a unique natural setting, Sofitel La Reserva Cardales offers you the perfect space to enjoy comforting spa sessions, plan conferences, organize your wedding and spend your honeymoon, or simply to live days of authentic relaxation.

199022.description: Located in the heart of Edinburgh, No. 32 Hotel offers 11 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers, toiletries, and hair dryers. Enjoy on-site amenities such as bicycle rentals, a garden, a bar/lounge, and cooked-to-order breakfasts (fee applies). Concierge services, dry cleaning/laundry, and luggage storage are also available. Murrayfield Stadium and Princes Street Gardens are within a 5-minute drive, while Princes Street and Johnnie Walker Princes Street are approximately 1 mile away.

199024.description:
Located in Lisbon, the hotel is close to Edward VII Park, Castle of Sao Jorge, and Gulbenkian Museum. Also nearby are Rossio Square and Santa Justa Elevator. This Lisbon residence offers a coffee shop/café where guests will have the opportunity to enjoy excellent drinks while making use of the complimentary wireless Internet access available in public areas. Business amenities at the property include a practical meeting room, secretarial services, and audio-visual equipment. The multilingual staff can provide event catering and tour assistance. In addition, guests can enjoy a book from the on-site library and relax in their air-conditioned guestrooms with city views.
Parking is available subject to availability on arrival at the hotel.

199054.description: The One&Only Royal Mirage graces Jumeirah Beach Road, overlooking the Palm Island bay and just five minutes from the Emirates Golf Club. Conveniently located near key business hubs like Internet City, Media City, and Knowledge Village, it's also a short 20-minute drive to Jebel Ali Free Zone. Guests enjoy easy access to Aquaventure Waterpark at Atlantis The Palm and One&Only The Palm via complimentary shuttle, including the renowned Mall of the Emirates. The Arabian Court at One&Only Royal Mirage evokes oriental splendor with striking architecture, symmetrical design, and lush gardens adorned with fountains and walkways. All sea-facing rooms at Arabian Court offer captivating views of the landscaped gardens, fountains, and the azure Arabian Gulf. Each room features ornate carved arches, vibrant mosaics, captivating artwork, and richly patterned furnishings.

199055.description: Situated just a 15-minute walk from Edinburgh Castle and the shops of popular Princes Street, this accessible hotel is directly across the road from Haymarket Rail Station.  Families might enjoy a trip to the Edinburgh Zoo, only an eight-minute drive away, or take a short stroll to the Scottish National Gallery.  The hotel's guest rooms have cool modern décor with wooden flooring and private en suite bathrooms. Features include air conditioning, a safety deposit box, a TV and a hairdryer. There is free Wi-Fi throughout the building.

199075.description:
Play Hostel Soho is located in the heart of Palermo, the safest and greenest neighborhood in Buenos Aires where you will find art, design, shops, cafes, restaurants, museums and the best nightlife. 

Our house is a typical Buenos Aires construction from the 19th century, usually called “Casa chorizo”. 

Renovated to provide the best accommodation but preserving its historical value, it has private and shared rooms with private and shared bathrooms. 

We have spaces designed for reading, listening to music, watching TV, and meeting your new best friends!

Our colonial patio to enjoy a promising morning, terrace with solarium and fully equipped kitchen will make you feel at home!

name.content: Quality Rio de Janeiro Barra da Tijuca

199076.description:
The Quality Rio de Janeiro - Barra da Tijuca is located near the Jacarepaguá Lagoon, with easy access to the main destinations in Barra da Tijuca, such as the Riocentro Convention Center, the Jeunesse Arena, the Olympic Park, the Cidade do Rock, the Metropolitano Shopping Mall, the BarraShopping and cultural centers. It is also close to the Reserva, Recreio dos Bandeirantes and Barra beaches, and is only 12 km from the Jacarepaguá Airport. 

The hotel offers 205 spacious rooms, all measuring 35m² and with a balcony, equipped with a digital safe, iron and ironing board, minibar, air conditioning, 42” LCD TV, bathroom with hairdryer and magnifying mirror. 

For leisure, guests can enjoy the swimming pool and fitness center, as well as a meeting space. The gastronomic structure includes 24-hour room service, breakfast included in the daily rate and free Wi-Fi. 

Barra da Tijuca Beach is 10 km away, and the hotel is about a 30-minute drive from important Rio de Janeiro tourist attractions, such as Maracanã Stadium, Christ the Redeemer and Ipanema Beach. Santos Dumont Airport is 34 km away. 

In addition, the hotel offers free private parking, subject to availability upon arrival. In addition, the hotel has MOVIDA (car rental) in the parking lot.

199108.description:
As a premier hotel in Newark, NJ, the Holiday Inn Newark International Airport offers renovated comfort and convenience. We are just minutes from Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) with a free 24-hour airport shuttle. Our central location off Interstate 78 and Route 1/9 makes us a great choice for travelers. 

Many consider us the best hotel in Newark NJ for easy access to the city. We're just five miles from downtown Newark, Rutgers University, and major corporate headquarters like Panasonic. We are also near the Prudential Center, Red Bull Arena, and just 30 minutes from New York City. 

Our Newark NJ hotel is the perfect choice for both business and leisure travelers. We offer 14, 000 square feet of versatile meeting space and a lounge for dining. Our contemporary guest rooms are designed for ultimate relaxation. Experience the best of Newark with us.

199134.description: Enjoy a central Venice stay at Hotel Ai Due Principi, a boutique hotel within a 5-minute walk of St. Mark's Square and the Bridge of Sighs. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Dine at the on-site restaurant, enjoy room service, or relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel also offers dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. Each of the 15 guestrooms features a minibar, a flat-screen television, complimentary Wi-Fi, a safe, a desk, and a bathroom with a rainfall showerhead and complimentary toiletries. Nearby attractions include Doge's Palace (0. 4 km) and St. Mark's Basilica (0. 5 km).

199135.description: The Venice Michelangelo Hotel enjoys a quiet yet central location in Mestre, close to the pedestrian area and the vibrant heart of the city. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, the hotel offers excellent transport links. It's just minutes from major motorways, the railway station, Marco Polo International Airport, and the historic city of Venice. This elegant hotel provides comfortable rooms, a well-maintained garden, free parking, a classic lounge bar, and a 24/7 front desk. A tranquil retreat from daily stress, the hotel offers a contemporary and relaxing atmosphere. Four versatile meeting rooms are fully equipped for events and business meetings. Mestre's history dates back to the Middle Ages. Its main attractions include the 13th-century Clock Tower, the 18th-century Duomo di San Lorenzo in Piazza Ferretto, and San Giuliano Park, one of Europe's largest parks with stunning views of the Venice Lagoon.

199234.description: Perched atop Antalya's cliffs, this hotel offers breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea and the Taurus Mountains. Just 3 km from the resort's center, it's conveniently located near the captivating old city, shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues. Guest rooms provide a tranquil retreat, while the terrace restaurant offers spectacular views and delicious dining options. All rooms feature French balconies; standard balconies are not available.

199253.description: Indulge in a massage, body treatment, or facial at the full-service spa. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy local cuisine at Casa Lobo restaurant for lunch or dinner, or order 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Business amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Four meeting rooms are available for events. Roundtrip airport shuttle service is available (surcharge applies). Self-parking is also available (surcharge applies). Each of the 48 air-conditioned guest rooms features a minibar, espresso maker, and a pillowtop bed with Egyptian cotton sheets. A 50-inch flat-screen TV with satellite programming and complimentary Wi-Fi are provided. Bathrooms include designer toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Plaza de Santa Ana, Puerta del Sol, and other Madrid attractions.

199254.address: Mimar Hayretin Mahallesi Balipasa Yokusu Arayici, 2
199254.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul, Yasmin Hotel offers convenient access to the Grand Bazaar and Sultanahmet Square, both within a 15-minute walk. This hotel provides 20 guestrooms equipped with LCD televisions, Select Comfort beds with Egyptian cotton sheets, and private balconies or patios. Amenities include complimentary wired and wireless internet access, room service, concierge services, and a shared television area. Express check-in/check-out and self-parking (for a fee) are also available. Nearby attractions include the Blue Mosque (1. 4 km) and Hagia Sophia (2. 3 km).

199275.description: Located within a short stroll from Épône and its railway station, in Île-de-France region in north-central France, this hotel is near the A13 motorway and thus enjoys easy access from important local sights and attractions. Moreover, there are many leisure activities on offer in the surrounding area like ice-skating, golfing, swimming or shopping in the nearby shopping centre. Rooms are well-appointed with modern amenities so that guests can enjoy a pleasant stay. They come equipped with a private bathroom, free WIFI connection, a satellite TV and twin or double beds. Those travelling by car can conveniently use the free parking spaces and every morning guests can taste the copious breakfast buffet and relax at the hotel's terrace.

name.content: Campanile Melun Sud - Dammarie les Lys

199276.address: Rue Du Capitaine Bernard De Poret, 346
199276.description: Sitting in the outskirts of Melun, a south-eastern suburb of Paris, this hotel is just minutes from the northern edge of the Fontainebleau forest. Located between the French countryside and the centre of Paris it is a great choice for all visitors of the city who prefer a tranquil and green surrounding. They will be just a 30-minute drive from the centre of Paris. The Melun train station sits on the Paris - Lion line and offers easy access to the entire area. Guests who want to visit some of the local attraction can visit the famous Château of Vaux-le-Vicomte, built for Nicholas Fouquet superintendent of finance under King Louis XIV or just spend a fun day exploring the nearby forest. Business travellers can take advantage of the modern meeting/banquet facilities and the business centre. While the complimentary WiFi will come in handy for everyone.

199277.description: Located in the north-western Parisian suburb of Pontoise, one of the capitals of the impressionist movement, this convenient hotel is a great choice for all visitors of the area. Some of the most notable artists that lived in the area include Camille Pissarro, who lived there for 17 years, Paul Cézanne, Paul Gauguin, Charles-François Daubigny and many others, and the area still carries its artistic heritage, which can be easily explored with a short walk around the centre of the city. Guests who want to reach the famous Parisian landmarks will be just a 10-minute walk from the RER A station Cergy Prefecture and from there it will take less than a 30-minute commute to the Eiffel tower, Champs Elysees or the Louvre. After a fun-packed day the comfortable rooms of the hotel will offer everything needed for relaxing - a cosy bed, warm shower and a satellite TV for some distraction.

199278.description: Located in the south-western suburb of Paris - Les Ulis, this hotel places its guests near one of the biggest industrial parks in Europe - Parc d'Activité de Courtabœuf. Housing the French offices of companies such as Hewlett Packard, Apple and over 1000 more, it is a one of the driving forces of the French economy and guests of the hotel will be just a short drive away. They will be also just a 30 minute drive away from the centre of Paris and a 20-minute drive from the Château de Versailles and just half that long from the Orly Airport. Business travellers will have the convenience of a complimentary WiFi internet access throughout the premises. There is also a traditional restaurant serving delightful local dishes and international favourites that will do much more than just satisfy one's' hunger.

199279.description: This comfortable hotel is located just 3 kilometres from the city centre and very close to Saint-Germain-en-Laye Forest and the famous Castle of Saint-Germain-en-Laye. Surrounded by a shopping centre and other attractions such as a cinema and a swimming pool, the hotel is easy to reach as it is close to a number of major national motorways leading to Nanterre at 15 kilometres away or Paris at a distance of 26 kilometres. All en-suite bedrooms and suites are fully appointed and incorporate modern facilities for a pleasant stay, like air-conditioning, free wireless Internet connection, an alarm clock and a satellite television. Guests can enjoy a delicious meal at the on-site restaurant or use the hotel's parking for free.

name.content: Campanile Paris Ouest - Nanterre - La Défense

199280.description: The Campanile Paris Ouest - Nanterre - La Défense hotel, located in Nanterre's Quartier de la Boule - Champs-Pierreux, is steps from Parc Andre Malraux and Theatre Nanterre-Amandiers. This hotel offers 84 guestrooms with amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and private bathrooms. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at Le Restaurant, a snack bar/deli, and a bar/lounge. Additional features include a terrace, garden, concierge services, and meeting facilities. Nearby attractions include the CNIT (3. 9 km) and Grande Arche (5. 8 km).

199281.description: Located in the outskirts of Montigny-le-Bretonneux, one of the green south-western suburbs of Paris, this hotel is a great choice for anyone who needs easy access to the capital, but prefers a tranquil and relaxed surrounding. The centre of the city sits at 25km, but the closest RER Train station is just a 5-minute walk and from there it takes just a 30-minute commute. The area around the venue offers plenty of opportunities for outdoor activities as both the Roussières Lake and Forest are just a 15-minute stroll away. Guests who prefer the convenience of the onsite facilities can utilize the multifunctional Meeting/Banquet Room or enjoy a delicious meal from the onsite restaurant. A scrumptious buffet is served each morning for the perfect start of the day.

199282.description: The hotel is conveniently located a short 10-minute walk from Cergy Saint Christophe RER train station, providing easy access to the metropolitan area. Leisure travelers and golf enthusiasts will appreciate the two nearby golf courses, reachable within a 10-minute drive. The Neuville and Auvers sur Oise leisure centers are also just a 5-minute drive away. Business travelers can benefit from the hotel's modern meeting room, complimentary Wi-Fi, and spacious in-room desks. The on-site restaurant offers a relaxed atmosphere to enjoy delicious regional specialties and a hearty breakfast buffet, ensuring a perfect start to the day.

199283.address: Centre Cial Les Portes De Taverny
199283.description: Located in Taverny's shopping district, the Campanile Taverny offers convenient access to local amenities and attractions. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs in all 77 guestrooms, plus private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. Start your day with a buffet breakfast at the on-site Restaurant Campanile (fee applies). Additional amenities include a banquet hall, vending machines, and free self-parking. The hotel is within a 15-minute drive of the Seine River and Stade de France, and conveniently located near the Basilica of Saint-Denis and the Saint-Ouen Flea Market. Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) is the preferred airport for accessing the hotel.

199284.description: Situated on the banks of the Seine in Argenteuil, this comfortable hotel is just 10km from the heart of Paris. The town center is a short 10-minute walk away, while the train and RER C stations, providing easy access to the metropolitan area, are within 2km. Roissy-CDG Airport is a convenient 30-minute drive. The bright, elegant, air-conditioned rooms feature cozy beds, work desks, free Wi-Fi, and Canal+ cable TV. Guests can relax with a hot beverage and a complimentary newspaper in the lounge or library. The on-site restaurant offers traditional family-style cuisine with a dessert and cheese buffet, and also serves a delicious breakfast buffet.

199285.description: Located in the southern suburb of Paris -Villejuif, this hotel places its guests at just 7km from some of the most popular sights of the capital city. With its excellent public transport connections they will be a short trip from the Eiffel Tower, Montparnasse, Champs Elysées or the banks of Seine River. After an exciting day of sightseeing guests can relax in the comfort of the pleasantly decorated rooms, watch a movie or just browse the internet thanks to the complimentary WiFi. The onsite bar is a great place for meeting with friends or just enjoying a chilled drink or a cocktail. While the restaurant is can treat to a delicious dinner consisting of local specialities and international favourites. The hearty breakfast buffet will give guests one more reason to start their day early and leave the pleasant comfort of their beds.

name.content: Campanile Evry Est - Saint Germain les Corbeil

199286.description: Located in the metropolitan area of Paris, this comfortable hotel is just a 25-minute drive from both the city centre and the Disneyland resort. Guests arriving through the Orly airport will be able to reach the city within a 20-minute drive, while those who prefer to take advantage of the public transport system find a RER commuter train stop within a 10-minute stroll. After a busy day of sightseeing or business meetings guests can relax with a round at the nearby Saint-Germain-lès-Corbeil golf course or visit the nearby commercial centre for some shopping. The hotel's restaurant is the perfect place where they can enjoy a relaxed meal consisting of some regional favourites, delicious desserts and excellent drinks.

name.content: Campanile Paris Sud - Porte d'Orléans - Arcueil

199287.description: Sitting just 500 m south from Boulevard Périphérique, the ring road the encompasses the city centre of Paris, this venue offers comfortable accommodation at a convenient location. It guests will be at just a 5-minute walk from the La Vache Noire commercial centre, which houses over 130 shops. While business travellers will be at just 6km from the Parc des Expositions de Versailles. For their convenience the venue also houses a multifunctional meeting room and they can also utilize the complimentary WiFi access. The onsite restaurant is the perfect option for guests who don't feel like exploring the rich culinary experiences that the city can offer, while the bar can treat them to a relaxed drink in the evening or a strong coffee in the afternoon. The early-risers can take advantage of the delicious breakfast buffet with its fresh fruit, pastries and beverages.

199288.description: Located just east of the city centre of Paris, this hotel is a 20-minute drive from the some of its most famous attractions such as Champs Elysees, the Eiffel Tower, Musee du Louvre and a 25-minute one from the entertainment parks of Disneyland and Astérix. Business travellers will enjoy the proximity to some of the main commercial and trading hubs of the capital and for their convenience the venue offers a business centre with modern meeting rooms. Those who need to stay on top of their workload can set-up a home office in the comfortable rooms thanks to the spacious work-desk and complimentary WiFi. Guests travelling with their personal vehicles will be able to find the hotel at just 700 m from an A4 highway exit and if they want to visit the city centre they can utilize the onsite car parking and board a train from the nearby RER station.

199289.description: Located within the Stade de France area and close to one of the most important ports in Paris, this convenient hotel is ideal for all visitors of the northwest parts of the city. They will be just a 15-minute drive from the La Défense business district and a 15-minute RER ride from the city centre, while the closest metro stop is just a 10-minute stroll away. Business travellers will have the convenience of a multifunctional meeting room and a complimentary WiFi throughout the venue. While the comfortable rooms are all fitted with spacious work-desk, cosy beds and flat-screen TVs for some entertainment. For the perfect start of their day guests can enjoy the delicious breakfast buffet served at the onsite restaurant. It is also the place where they can sample delicious regional dishes and wines.

199290.address: Zone De La Haie Passart - Rue Gustave Eiffel
199290.description: Located 30 kilometres from Paris, this charming hotel is located in Brie Comte Robert.  Guests will have countless opportunities to explore the local traditions by uncovering the cultural sights and points of interest including the Park F. Mitterand, the Eglise Saint Etienne and the Château de Brie-Comte-Robert. The establishment invites guests to make use of its modern and comfortable facilities. Luminous and cosily decorated hotel rooms offer a haven of peace and serenity in which to totally unwind and recharge one's batteries at the end of the day. All the rooms come complete with modern amenities to ensure a pleasant stay. There are also accessible rooms for added convenience of guests with reduced mobility. Patrons will be enchanted by delicious food served at the on-site trendy restaurant. The hotel features 24-hour reception, a meeting room and a free car on-site parking.

199291.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at the Campanile Marne La Vallée - Chelles, and take advantage of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and a common area television. Le Restaurant offers a delightful dining experience, while the bar/lounge provides a relaxing setting for your favorite drinks. Buffet breakfast is available weekdays from 6:30 AM to 9:00 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM (fee applies). The hotel features 54 guestrooms equipped with LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Bathrooms include shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. For your convenience, phones, desks, and blackout drapes/curtains are also provided. Additional amenities include multilingual staff, an elevator, and on-site self-parking (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Vaires-sur-Marne Lake (1. 5 mi), Centrex (6. 2 mi), and Bois de Vincennes.

199331.description: Elegant one and two bedroom apartments in the modern Gran Santiago Tower in Santiago de Chile. The apartments are fully equipped with luxurious details. The hotel's location allows guests to visit the most important city monuments, like the Palacio de la Moneda, the Fine Arts Museum, Santiago Cathedral, the Palacio La Alhambra, the Parque Forestal, the Santa Lucia and San Cristóba Cerros, the central market as well as other pedestrianized streets like Húerfanos and Ahumada and the typical streets of Bellavista and Brasil. The apartments all have satellite TV and free Wi-Fi as well as a completely equipped kitchenette and a desk, safe and central heating. The hotel offers a gym, outdoor swimming pool and hot tub (only available during the summer months) and a garden area where guests can relax, as well as a shop, laundry and transfer service.

199349.description: The Holiday Inn Bogota Airport is conveniently located just 10 minutes from El Dorado International Airport and offers a complimentary airport shuttle service between 5:00 AM and 10:45 PM. Experience modern hospitality with a warm welcome, unlimited Wi-Fi, comfortable soundproofed rooms, and air conditioning. The hotel features ten meeting rooms for up to 300 people and the delicious cuisine of the Nativo Restaurant & Bar. Nearby, you'll find the Bogota Chamber of Commerce, US Embassy, Corferias, Agora, and the High Performance Sports Center. The hotel is also close to the financial district on 26th Street, home to global companies such as Unilever, Marsh, GSK, and Coca-Cola. For leisure, the Salitre Plaza Shopping Mall, Plaza Claro Shopping Mall, Botanical Garden, Maloka Interactive Center, and Pricesmart are within a 5-minute drive. Also a short drive away are the Gran Estación shopping center, Simón Bolívar Metropolitan Park, and Salitre Mágico amusement park.

199404.address: Al Safilia Street, Old Salata Corniche Road
199404.description: This hotel is situated at the gateway to Western Asia, in Doha. The hotel enjoys a prime setting, lying close to the historical Souq Waqif. The hotel is set on the Corniche, facing the Museum of Islamic Arts, lying at the heart of Doha. The airport is conveniently situated just a 10 minutes' driving distance away. The hotel enjoys a spectacular architectural design, tempting visitors into a veritable lap of luxury and opulence. The guest rooms are sumptuously designed, offering a truly unparalleled living experience. Featuring a range of exemplary facilities and services, this hotel delivers the utmost in comfort and convenience, complemented by impeccable service and warm hospitality.

199490.description: Quinta da Agra, a beautifully restored pre-17th-century estate, welcomes you. Stone gates open to two tastefully renovated houses offering modern comfort. The owner's meticulous 10-year restoration has preserved original architectural details, from the roofs and guillotine windows to the quarried balconies and tranquil retreats. The surrounding grounds are equally enchanting, featuring ancient olive trees, riding rings, stables, and serene fishing ponds.

199494.description:
A 5-minute walk from Passeig de Gràcia Metro and Railway Station, Hostal Bcn 46 has an excellent location, less than 500 metres from Las Ramblas. Its simple, stylish rooms have free Wi-Fi and private or shared bathrooms. All rooms have a flat-screen TV, air conditioning and heating.
Guests can enjoy breakfast at a café near Hostal Bcn 46, and there are many more bars and restaurants within 10 minutes' walk of the guest house.
Gaudí's Casa Batlló and La Pedrera are within 1 km of the Hostal. Airport buses stop at Plaza de Catalunya, a 10-minute walk away.

199497.description: Situated in Vienna, the two-star Hotel Kolbeck offers comfortable accommodation and on-site dining. While the hotel doesn't provide on-site parking, off-site options are readily available. A strict no-smoking policy is enforced throughout the property. Guests can also take advantage of the airport shuttle service and concierge. Well-behaved pets are welcome.

199526.description: Stay at Hotel Caroline in Vienna's Favoriten district, and you'll be just a short drive from iconic landmarks such as the Vienna State Opera and Belvedere Palace. This hotel offers convenient access to cultural attractions and provides comfortable accommodations with amenities including a fitness center, sauna, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy a buffet breakfast (fee applies) and take advantage of helpful services like tour/ticket assistance. Each of the 76 guestrooms features a minibar, safe, and work desk. Hotel Caroline is also conveniently located near the Military History Museum, Botanical Garden, and St. Charles Church. Vienna International Airport (VIE) is 18. 9 km (11. 7 mi) away.

199527.description: This elegant city hotel boasts an enviable location in the heart of Vienna's bustling Josefstadt district. Guests will find themselves surrounded by a wealth of local dining options, shopping venues, and historical attractions, including the impressive Town Hall, the Kunsthistorisches Museum, and the Parliament. Conveniently located just steps from the Rathaus metro station, this attractive property offers spacious and carefully appointed rooms, each air-conditioned and featuring modern design and top-notch amenities. A rich and delicious buffet-style breakfast is served every morning in the charming hotel restaurant, ensuring a perfect start to your Viennese adventure.

199534.description:
Limonaia, is located next to Paseo de Gracia and has direct and privileged views of La Pedrera, a building by the architect Antonio Gaudí, the highest representative of Catalan modernism.

Limonaia is a new boutique space that meets all the traveler's needs in an extraordinary way.

Its rooms are spacious and modern, with a contemporary style inspired by the architecture of Barcelona.

Its comfortable beds, its natural fabric clothes, free WIFI, satellite TV, careful decoration and operation through renewable energies, make it a new generation establishment.

The extraordinary location brings us closer to the most exclusive shopping in the city, prestigious restaurants, the main streets of Barcelona such as Las Ramblas, Plaza Cataluña and Avenida Diagonal and important monuments such as Gaudí's Pedrera and the Sagrada Familia.

199574.address: Carrer De La Duquessa D Orleans, 56 - 58
199574.description: Located in Barcelona's peaceful Sarria neighborhood, the Albergue Studio hostel is just steps from Reina Elisenda metro station and a short walk from various dining options. It offers complimentary Wi-Fi and breakfast, a rooftop terrace, and rooms with private bathrooms. Each brightly decorated room features air conditioning and a desk. Guests can also enjoy a reading area and a communal lounge with a TV. Reception is open until 10 PM, and guests are asked to contact the hostel in advance to confirm their arrival time. The metro provides easy access to the city center in 20 minutes. You can contact the hostel via email at alberguestudio@gmail. com or by phone at +34932050961.

199620.description: The House, built during the seventeenth century and very much improved a century later. The chapel was built much earlier and was consecrated in 1462. The house stands out by its privileged situation and harmonious architecture, which was planned to enable a balanced and enjoyable existence. Here, the charms of the past meet the comfort of the present and come together to allow for a pleasant stay in full wine country of Douro, just a few minutes from some of region most notorious landmarks.

199661.description: The Casa de Canedo, also known as Casa do Barreiro, is a charming manor house located in Terras de Basto, a region renowned for its natural beauty and exquisite wines. The house, with its striking yellow ochre contrasting against the original grey granite and lush greenery, dates back to the 17th century. Originally belonging to the Axe de Andrade family, it was later acquired by Fernando Rau of Basto's Agricultural Society. Set within a sprawling 90-hectare estate dedicated to forestry and wine production, the Casa de Canedo features a beautifully designed square with intricate plant architecture and a tranquil interior courtyard.

199681.description: Located in the heart of Athens, the Nafsika Hotel Athens Centre offers convenient access to major attractions, including the National Archaeological Museum and Ermou Street, both within a 15-minute walk. This hotel features individually decorated guestrooms with private balconies, flat-screen televisions, refrigerators, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy on-site amenities such as a coffee shop/café, bar/lounge, 24-hour room service, and concierge services. Bicycle rentals and airport shuttle service (surcharge) are also available.

199682.description: A refined, historic residence immersed in the silence of a large park. Just ten minutes from Venice Hotel Ai Pini is surrounded by a large park and the blossoms of a charming garden. The continental buffet breakfast, with home-made pastries, is served in a bright room on the first floor, which offers great views of the park. There are countless comforts to satisfy each of our guests personal needs: safety deposit box, adjustable air conditioning, TV with satellite channels, pay-TV, web TV (to navigate Internet using the television set) and free wi fi. The hotel offers free parking.

199688.description: The Quinta do Sobreiro is an Farm house surrounded by 40 acres ha of Land and it construction remotes to the 16th century. The agriculture area has 35 acres kiwis plantation, two marvellous lagoons, a park with several and different variety of trees and some beautiful gardens. The Farm house Quinta do Sobreiro was rebuilt on the 1992 and reconverted into “Turismo de Habitação” to receive guests. All characteristics of the original main house were maintained and provide 6 bedrooms and other facilities .Out door the guests can enjoyed the Swimming pool, a games room and a children play area.

199703.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include a television in a common area and a reception hall. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 35 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries.

199706.description: Cora 96 Street Suites is an establishment where comfort, service and space combines to offer a unique and special experience. This beautiful building has suites and apartments with stylish, modern décor, natural light and views of the city and the eastern hills of Bogota. It is located in an exclusive area near the park 93 and all its restaurants, just 5 minutes from the World Trade Center and the most exclusive shops. It has WiFi internet access, private parking, meeting rooms, sauna and a small gym for guests. All apartments have natural light, cable TV and are fully prepared for short and long stays.

199816.description: Located just a short walk from Plaza Catalunya, La Rambla, and Casa Milà, Buba House offers convenient access to Barcelona's main attractions. This hostel provides complimentary breakfast and all-day kitchen access, along with free internet. The friendly staff are always available to assist you, and the airport is easily accessible. Housed in a charming historic building, Buba House offers a welcoming atmosphere, ensuring a pleasant stay.

199846.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Make yourself at home in one of the 5 air-conditioned rooms featuring kitchens with refrigerators and stovetops. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided weekly. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Paseo del Borne - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Basilica de Santa Maria del Mar - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Palau de Dalmases - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Casa Llotja de Mar - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Picasso Museum - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Mercat del Born - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- El Born Centre Cultural - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Chocolate Museum - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Parc de la Ciutadella - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Port Vell - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Barcelona History Museum - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Barcelona Cathedral - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Barcelona City Council - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Palau de la Música Catalana - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Portal de l'Angel - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi. The nearest major airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 17. 1 km / 10. 6 mi With a stay at Inside Barcelona Apartments Esparteria, you'll be centrally located in Barcelona, steps from Paseo del Borne and Basilica de Santa Maria del Mar. This hotel is 0. 1 mi (0. 1 km) from Casa Llotja de Mar and 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from Mercat del Born.

199867.description: Hostal Martinval is a two-star hostel in the heart of Barcelona's Eixample neighborhood. This pleasant, modernized lodging is located just off the famed Passeig de Gràcia avenue and a short 10-minute walk from Plaça Catalunya. The surrounding area offers excellent public transportation links, including metro, train, and bus access. The hostel features spacious rooms with en-suite bathrooms, fresh linens, and daily towel changes. Guests enjoy 24-hour reception service, complimentary baggage assistance, and access to Wi-Fi in most rooms and all public areas. Air conditioning is available in some rooms, and heating is provided in all rooms. Additional amenities include complimentary Barcelona maps. Rooms are available from 2:00 PM, but guests can check in at any time, with luggage storage provided free of charge.

199874.description: The Mercat del Born building is located in the heart of Barcelona's El Born district, a vibrant neighborhood home to the Santa Maria del Mar church and the Passeig del Born. While conveniently close to the beach and Las Ramblas, it offers a more local, less crowded atmosphere. The area is filled with enticing restaurants, cozy cafés and bars, art galleries, and some of the city's finest boutiques. Our office is just a few steps away, ready to assist you throughout your stay. Each apartment features elegant, functional design with wooden flooring, air conditioning, an elevator, ADSL internet, satellite TV, an iPod sound system, a DVD player, an oven, a microwave, a washer and dryer, a dishwasher, and heated towel rails.

199926.description:
Hostal BCN Ramblas is located on Las Ramblas, facing the colourful Boquería Market and 50 metres from Liceu Metro Station. This guest house offers free Wi-Fi and a 24-hour reception.
Set on the edge of the Gothic Quarter, Hostal BCN Ramblas is around 400 metres from Barcelona Cathedral. Plaza Catalunya and the MACBA Contemporary Art Museum are within a 7-minute walk.
All air-conditioned rooms at the BCN Ramblas feature cable TV and a safe. Each one comes with a private bathroom with toiletries.

199927.description: The Urban Suites offers 16 suites and 4 apartments near Barcelona Fair, Plaza España, and Sants Station. Located in the Sants-Montjuïc district, the newly built property is conveniently close to Plaza España (300m), Barcelona Sants Station (300m), and the Barcelona Convention Centre. It's just four metro stops from Las Ramblas and three from Camp Nou. Accommodations, suited for 1 to 6 guests, feature a modern, functional style, and some boast private terrace gardens. Each suite and apartment offers a distinct ambiance, a fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning, and free Wi-Fi. Choose from one-bedroom suites or two-bedroom apartments with a balcony or private terrace. A supermarket, fresh market, and numerous dining and shopping options are nearby. On-site parking is available for an extra cost, and guests can enjoy complimentary laundry facilities on the roof.

199949.description: Located in Vienna, this property is close to the Swiss Garden, Belvedere, and Secession Building. Also nearby are Vienna State Opera and Viennese City Park. This is an ideal choice for those looking for a clean and comfortable room in a convenient location. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available in public areas and an Internet point is located on site for the use of those who wish to stay connected. The establishment also provides business amenities, including small meeting rooms and audio-visual equipment. The 301 comfortable guestrooms are decorated in natural tones and feature parquet flooring. All come equipped with flat-screen TVs with cable channels as standard, to provide further comfort.

199972.description:
Barcelona City North hostel is located in one of Barcelona's most sophisticated neighbourhoods, Sarria-Sant Gervasi, very close to other charming areas such as Gracia. Thanks to the hostel's privileged location and the great public transport system, visitors have easy access to every last corner of this wonderful city.
Nearby Lesseps Metro Station offers easy access to Vallcarca and the Parc Güell. Plaça Catalunya is only 3 stops away. 
This establishment offers double rooms for one or two people with either a double bed or 2 singles. All of the rooms have a TV, air conditioning and wifi Internet connection. One of the highlights of this hostel is that all of the rooms have their own private bathrooms, towels and sheets and a daily cleaning service. Furthermore, guests will find a kettle with cups, coffee, tea, sugar, herbal teas, etc courtesy of the hostel.

199992.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Grab dinner at La Pergola, a restaurant that specializes in Mediterranean cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Rubi? This hotel has 700 square feet (65 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Make yourself at home in one of the 43 air-conditioned rooms featuring private pools and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected.

200000.description: This 90 m² apartment is located in a building with an elevator, near the Muntaner metro station. Accommodating up to six guests, it features three comfortable bedrooms with four single and one double bed, along with one bathroom and a fully equipped kitchen. Ideal for work groups or other groups seeking a comfortable space, this apartment represents one of several similar options available in the building. Photos showcase typical décor and furnishings, though slight variations may exist. Your specific apartment will be assigned upon arrival.

200075.description: Enjoying a great location in the heart of Sabadell's commercial and business district, this charming hotel offers comfortable accommodation and exceptional services to business and leisure travellers alike. This welcoming property is situated within walking distance from Plaça Catalunya, where travellers can find the main railway station as well as many entertainment options. Barcelona city is just 17 km away, while the airport is easily reachable within a 30-minute drive away. The accommodation units range from standard rooms to more luxurious suites and offer all kinds of comforts to make guests' stay as enjoyable as possible. Those travelling on business purposes may take advantage of the excellent meeting facilities and state-of-the-art equipment. The on-site restaurant invites travellers to sample simple, but exquisite homemade cuisine, and the friendly staff will be more than happy to assist guests in all their needs. Mínimum check in age 20 years. Children under 20 years old can only stay accompanied by parents.

200111.description: This modern 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in the heart of Barcelona comfortably accommodates groups and families of 10 to 13 people. The apartment comprises two twin rooms and two triple rooms, each featuring single beds and a private balcony. Two comfortable sofa beds are provided in the spacious living area. A fully equipped kitchen and a small dining area offer convenient self-catering options. The two stylish bathrooms are each fitted with a shower, one with an additional bathtub. Amenities include a TV (with USB and HDMI ports), Wi-Fi, central heating and air conditioning, a washer and dryer, microwave, kettle, toaster, espresso maker, hairdryer, and iron. All bed linens and towels are provided. The apartment boasts a superb location, just a 5-minute walk from Las Ramblas and Plaza Catalunya.

200117.description: The Hostal de la Plaça, a beautifully renovated 17th-century farmhouse in the Maresme region, seamlessly blends history with modern comforts. Run by the same family for three generations, this charming hotel offers an exceptional dining experience, meeting rooms for up to 30 people, and 14 elegantly appointed exterior rooms. Each room features spacious wardrobes, internet access, air conditioning, satellite TV, a minibar, a hairdryer, a private safe, and laundry/dry cleaning services. Whether for business or leisure, the Hostal de la Plaça provides a warm, professional, and unforgettable stay.

200129.description: Stay at the 4-star MSB Gracia Pool Terrace Center aparthotel in Barcelona's Gràcia district, just a short drive from Sagrada Familia and Plaça de Catalunya. Enjoy the outdoor pool and terrace views, or relax in your individually furnished guestroom, complete with a kitchenette, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a flat-screen TV. The hotel also offers convenient amenities such as multilingual staff, luggage storage, a safe deposit box, and airport shuttle service (surcharge). Self-parking is available onsite (surcharge).

200171.description: Located only 80 metres to the beachfront, this aparthotel is just 3.6 kilometres from the centre of Alanya and a short stroll from the public beach. Local amenities can be found closeby, while the harbour area, popular for its nightlife, is situated in the centre of the resort. Public transport network runs close to this charming establishment providing easy access to Alanya's Castle and Damlatas Cave. Gazipasa Alanya Airport is situated 38 km from the hotel. All the cosy accommodation units come with a fully-equipped kitchen, living room and a private bathroom. Those guests travelling in their own vehicles will find a complimentary on-site parking.

200477.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Getting to the surf and sand is a breeze with the complimentary beach shuttle. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. A cruise ship terminal shuttle is provided at no charge. Make yourself at home in one of the 25 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

200495.description: Cosmos is located in the centre of Athens, 50 meters from Metaxourgeio Metro Station. It offers air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi. The Acropolis area is just a 5-minute metro ride away. Hotel Cosmos offers simply furnished rooms with balcony. They come with a TV and a work desk. Each has its own private bathroom with shower. The picturesque areas of Plaka and Monastiraki are around 2 km away. The National Archaeological Museum is a 10-minute walk away. Within a 5-minute drive, guests can also reach Keramikos district, famous for its variety of nightlife and dining options.

200500.description: Villa Agnanti is a luxurious private villa boasting 11 well-appointed bedrooms, each featuring air conditioning, a sea-view balcony, a refrigerator, a 21 television, a private bathroom, DVD and MP3 players, a safety deposit box, a hairdryer, and a hair iron. Located just 5 minutes from the pristine Sesi beach, the villa offers a large private pool (over 100 square meters) with shaded pergolas and comfortable wooden sunbeds. Athens is less than an hour's drive away. Enjoy the tranquil beauty of this picturesque seaside village, with panoramic sea and forest views from every room. Ideal for groups of up to 26 guests, Villa Agnanti offers five-star facilities and ensures a relaxing holiday experience.

200522.description: Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:00 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. The independently owned Windsor Hotel and Self-Catering Apartments stand proudly on the edge of Hermanus's breathtaking Walker Bay with a panoramic vista featuring the world's best whale-watching available in most rooms.

Southern Right whales have been breeding and feeding here for centuries (July – November) and our guests have been returning, generation after generation, to delight in this spectacle.

The 120-year-old Windsor, near the town centre and its rich variety of restaurants, galleries and shops, has been modernised but steadfastly retains its family atmosphere with home-from-home hospitality.

A stunning 120km drive from Cape Town brings you to the famous champagne air of Hermanus, where you can relax in comfort at the venerable Windsor or enjoy a wide variety of gentle or adventurous activities.

SPECIAL NOTICE: The Windsor Hotel is proud to announce the completion of our renovated rooms on the ground floor and the 2nd floor. 
The 2018 programme for the balance of room renovations will be: 5 rooms in the main building between 16 January to mid-February 2018, and then the 1st floor rooms between May to August 2018. Our guest comfort is paramount and we endeavour to do our very best to minimize disruption during guest's stay. Please advise all guests travelling to the Windsor Hotel.

202786.description:
Xenophon Hotel is a well-established 4-star hotel in Athens, combining decades of hospitality experience with a renewed vision for the future. 

Conveniently located with direct access to the National Highway and within easy reach of the city's public transportation network, including metro, train, bus and trolley services, the hotel offers seamless access to Athens’ historic centre, major attractions, business districts and key points of interest. 

Having welcomed visitors from around the world for many years, Xenophon Hotel has become a trusted choice for both leisure and business travellers. The hotel also holds a special place in Athens’ modern history, having served as an official hotel during the 2004 Olympic Games. 

The property features 185 guestrooms and one suite, each with a private balcony, while many rooms enjoy views of the Acropolis, Lycabettus Hill and the Athens skyline. As part of its ongoing commitment to enhancing the guest experience, an entire floor of Superior Rooms has been fully renovated in recent years, while the brand-new Deluxe Rooms have recently been introduced, offering a refreshed accommodation experience with contemporary design and enhanced comfort. 

This marks the beginning of a broader renewal programme currently underway throughout the hotel. Further upgrades are planned for both guestrooms and public areas, including developments that will strengthen the property's conference and event facilities in the years ahead. 

At the heart of Xenophon Hotel lies a genuine commitment to Greek hospitality. Supported by an experienced and dedicated team, the hotel continues to provide attentive service and a welcoming atmosphere, ensuring a comfortable and memorable stay for every guest visiting Athens.
