202867.description: Centrally located in Athens, the Pergamos Hotel offers convenient access to Syntagma Square and the National Archaeological Museum, both within a 5-minute drive. This hotel provides 33 guestrooms equipped with refrigerators, LED TVs, and private balconies. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite programming, and private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Hotel amenities include a rooftop terrace, bicycle rentals, a coffee shop/cafe, room service (limited hours), a bar/lounge, complimentary wired and wireless internet, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Omonoia Square, the National Theatre, and other key attractions are within walking distance.

202876.description: Situated in Athens, the Metropolis Hotel offers 2-star accommodations. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the hotel restaurant and convenient parking (limited availability). Rooms offer wireless internet access, and select rooms permit smoking. Please specify your preference when booking. Additional amenities include an airport shuttle and concierge service. Pets are welcome.

202906.address: Cankurtaran Mh Mimar Mehmet Aga Cd, 23
202906.description: Center Hill Hotel guests checking into the 3 star rated Center Hill Hotel in Istanbul are assured of a warm welcome. Room Features Center Hill Hotel . A hairdryer is provided in every room. Rooms offer internet access via wifi . Wireless internet is also available in public areas. Tea and coffee making facilities are available in every room . Other Info. Hotel guests can make use of the concierge service that is provided.

202912.description: The 3-star Belle Ocean Apart Hotel in Alanya offers guests a warm welcome just 30 meters from Kleopatra Beach. The hotel features an on-site restaurant and apart-rooms equipped with kitchenettes for self-catering. Each room includes tea and coffee making facilities, a stocked minibar, Wi-Fi, and free air conditioning. Please note that smoking is not permitted within the hotel, and safe boxes are available for a local fee. Guests can enjoy a variety of leisure activities and facilities.

202963.address: hayriye tüccari caddesi no 31 laleli Fatih, 31
202963.description: The Grand Madrid Hotel, located in Istanbul's historic Laleli district, seamlessly blends tradition and innovation. Within walking distance of Byzantine and Ottoman cultural attractions, shopping, and entertainment, the hotel offers a unique atmosphere. Experience superior service and comfortable accommodations that will make your stay a treasured memory.

202964.description: Enjoy a range of amenities at this Konyaalti hotel, including an outdoor pool, fitness center, and bicycle rentals. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of concierge services and a reception hall. The hotel's restaurant offers lunch and dinner, or you can relax with 24-hour room service. Unwind at the bar/lounge or poolside bar, and start your day with the complimentary buffet breakfast. For business travelers, a 24-hour business center and dry cleaning/laundry services are available. The hotel also features meeting rooms and conference space. The 56 air-conditioned rooms offer minibars, satellite TV, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Free self-parking is available onsite. Located near Konyaalti Beach, the hotel is also a short distance from attractions such as Konyaalti Beach Park, Mediterranean City Park, and Atatürk Culture Park. Antalya Intl. Airport (AYT) is the preferred airport.

202971.address: Kilicaslan Mahallesi Zeytin Cikmazi Sokak No 6
202971.description: Nestled in the heart of Antalya's historic Kaleiçi district, Hotel Bacchus Pension offers a comfortable stay within ancient city walls. Just steps from Mermerli Beach and the marina, and a short stroll from the Clock Tower, the hotel's central location puts you in the midst of Antalya's vibrant culture. Friendly staff and clean accommodations ensure a pleasant holiday experience. The hotel is conveniently located 12 km from Antalya Airport and 7 km from the Intercity Bus Terminal.

202977.address: Kucuk Ayasofya Mah. Sehit Mehmet Pasa Sk. 1, 1
202977.description: The Basileus Hotel offers exceptional service and top-notch amenities for a memorable stay. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, convenient airport transportation booking, and on-site parking. Cozy up by the fireplace on chilly evenings. Please note that smoking is restricted to designated areas. Start your day with a delicious breakfast at our on-site restaurant, which also offers other meal options throughout the day. Maintain your fitness routine in our well-equipped fitness center.

202978.address: Mithatpasa Caddesi Buyuk Haydar Efendi Sokak 29, 34
202978.description: Hotel Inter Istanbul is located in the historical Beyazit/Sultanahmet district, across one of the gates of Grand Bazaar. Only a 2 minute walk from Beyazit Tram Station, the hotel has free Wi-Fi and a complimentary buffet breakfast. Each room at the Inter has air conditioning and modern furnishings. They come equipped with LCD TV and a small refrigerator. They also offer city or sea views. Daily breakfast is served in buffet style. It includes more than 45 hot and cold items. There is a bar in the lobby where guests can enjoy various drinks. The Hotel Inter has 24-hour front desk service. The tour desk can provide information on transportation and local attractions. Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace are within walking distance. Ataturk International Airport is about 14. 5 km away. Fatih is a great choice for travelers interested in museums, monuments and friendly people.

202982.description: The Hotel Frankfurt welcomes you to Kaleiçi, Antalya's historic old town. Just steps from the ancient city walls, you'll find yourself a short stroll from Mermerli Beach and the scenic Karaalioğlu Park. Our standard rooms offer a comfortable stay with amenities including a desk, LCD TV, safe, air conditioning, heating, and a private bathroom with shower and hairdryer. Economy double or twin rooms provide similar comforts, excluding the desk and fridge. Guests enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and on-site parking. For a more spacious stay, our apartment accommodates up to three guests, featuring air conditioning, heating, a private bathroom with a Jacuzzi, and a two-bed sleeping room with a safe. A separate area offers additional sleeping arrangements, a dining space, a comfortable couch, a TV, and a fully equipped kitchenette.

202992.address: Hoca Pasa Mah. Orhaniye Cad Sirkeci Trengar arkasi, 36
202992.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul's City Center, the Sirkeci Esen Hotel is a short walk from the Bosphorus and Eminönü Square. This hotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, 24-hour room service, and a coffee shop/cafe. Guests can also take advantage of dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. The 24 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars (with some complimentary items), LCD televisions with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Safes and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Nearby attractions include the Grand Bazaar and the Egyptian Bazaar.

203000.address: Gran Via De Les Corts Catalanes, 644
203000.description: This hotel, situated near Barcelona's Passeig de Gràcia, offers easy access to the city's many cultural and artistic attractions. Casa Batlló is just 500 meters away, and La Pedrera and the Palau de la Música Catalana are also nearby. Housed in a classical-style building dating back to 1928, the hotel features guest rooms that blend rustic elegance with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy Catalan specialties at the hotel's superb restaurant or relax at the gastro bar and bar. One dog or cat under 20 kg is permitted per room upon request, subject to a nightly fee and deposit.

203007.address: Rue Bab Agnaou Derb Sidi Bouloukate, 88
203007.description: The hotel is situated at the heart of the Medina and just a few metres from the famous Jemaa El Fna square, in the most popular neighbourhood of Marrakech. The Riad Hamdan & Spa is a quiet guest house, authentic and warm, and enjoying an ideal location, close to the main sights of Marrakech: the famous Jemaa El Fna square, the Koutoubia mosque, the Menara and Majorelle gardens, the Bahia palace and Badi Palace, the Ben Youssef Medersa, the Museum of Marrakech and the numerous souks. The Riad is an ideal place for a family holiday, a romantic getaway or a trip with friends. Guestrooms are charming and cosy, perfect for a relaxing and pleasant stay. From the rooftop terrace, guests will be able to enjoy the beautiful views over the Medina. There is also a spa with a hammam and massage rooms.

203048.description: This hotel is set amidst the culture and excitement of Buenos Aires. The hotel is located close to the airport, lying within easy walking distance of a number of attractions. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from Plaza Libertad, Borges Cultural Centre and a number of shops and entertainment venues. The hotel comprises elegantly-appointed guest rooms, which enjoy a unique style. The rooms are set overlooking the river, city or the garden. Guests are invited to take advantage of the many exemplary facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. Guests will experience the utmost in comfort and unmatched quality at this hotel.

203099.description: Completely refurbished in 2007, the historic Hotel Eden welcomes guests nearly year-round. Its modern style, welcoming hospitality, and central location make it an ideal choice for seaside summer holidays or as a home base for exploring Venice, the Lagoon islands, and Veneto's art cities. Discover the region's rich culture, nature, and food and wine.

203108.description: The 4-star Riad Dar Bounouar offers a luxurious retreat in Marrakech. Guests can enjoy on-site dining in the hotel restaurant. Meeting facilities and Wi-Fi are available. The riad also features an indoor swimming pool. Smoking is permitted in some rooms and public areas (please specify when booking).

203120.description: Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Berlin? This hotel has facilities measuring 430 square feet (40 square meters), including conference space. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 52 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

203144.description: Adele Design hotel is a exclusive city hotel in Prenzlauer Berg district of Berlin. It features Art Deco interiors, warm wooden floors and spacious natural stone bathrooms. This design hotel is situated beside the lovely park Friedrichshain, just 1 km from the famous Alexanderplatz square. The interiors were designed by Thomas Herrendorf, and all rooms include free WiFi, a docking station, sound system and a safe. A charming and popular breakfast is served each morning at the breakfast café next door. Nearby trams take you to the shops and transport services of Alexanderplatz in less than 5 minutes. From here, you gain easy access to all areas of the city. In addition, the shops and bars of Hackescher Markt and Kollwitzplatz are within easy reach.

203148.address: Bastion 193B Angolo Fondaments Ca Bala Dorsodur, 193/B
203148.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and convenient tour/ticket assistance at the Locanda Ca' Zose, an affittacamere located in Venice's Dorsoduro district. A daily buffet breakfast is available (for a fee) from 8:00 AM to 9:30 AM. The 12 air-conditioned rooms offer minibars, private bathrooms with bidets and hair dryers, safes, and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. The hotel is within a 10-minute walk of St. Mark's Campanile and Doge's Palace, and close to attractions such as the Peggy Guggenheim Museum and Palazzo Dario.

203161.description: Enjoy a warm welcome at the charming Ackselhaus & Bluehome Apartments in Berlin. While onsite parking isn't available, convenient offsite options are provided. Savor delicious meals at our inviting restaurant. Each apartment offers an iron, ironing board, and hairdryer for your comfort. Please note that smoking is not permitted. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the property. Benefit from our convenient airport shuttle service and know that your furry friends are welcome. Our concierge is also available to assist you.

203166.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as complimentary bicycles and a relaxing terrace and garden. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall. Room service is available during limited hours, and you can unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is offered daily (fee applies). For added convenience, there's complimentary wired internet access, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self-parking is available onsite (charges apply). The 20 guestrooms feature minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. Hotel Villa Cipro is a short walk from Venice Lido beaches and the Santa Maria Elisabetta Waterbus, offering easy access to attractions like the Palazzo del Casinò and the Venice Biennale.

203167.description: Our small but comfortable hotel is located in the vicinity of Hermannplatz, between the two city-districts Neukölln and Kreuzberg. The hotel is centrally located in the residential and business district and is near the Kottsbusser Damm which is steeped in tradition. Whether your trip is for business or pleasure you'll always be a welcome visitor in our hotel. This is the perfect spot to start your tour around Berlin. Using public transportation you can reach Kurfürstendamm or Alexanderplatz in no more than 15 minutes, Berlin exhibition grounds (ICC) within 25 minutes, and the international airports Schönefeld and Tegel in about half an hour.

203180.description: Located in Marrakech, the Jnane Tihihit offers 3-star accommodations with on-site parking and a restaurant. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi access and meeting facilities. Each room includes a hairdryer and a stocked minibar. The hotel provides a variety of leisure amenities, including a sauna and an outdoor swimming pool. Guests can also partake in outdoor activities such as mountain biking, fishing, and quad biking (bike hire available). Additional services include an airport shuttle, concierge service, and pet-friendly accommodations. The hotel is equipped with disabled facilities, including wheelchair access to the hotel, reception, and restaurant, as well as designated parking spaces.

203181.address: Route De Guemassa, Km 20. Sarl Kenitra Bp 226
203181.description:
Situated just 20 minutes away from the buzzing Marrakech, Kasbah Agafay is nested into a majestic environment and offers a refined and elegant accommodation. You will find a huge outside Pool, Spa and a traditional Hamman. You can relax during our Yoga classes, discover the secrets of the Moroccan gastronomy with our cooking classes led by Bouchra, our traditional cook with gold in her hands.  Be tempted by the discovery of the countryside on foot, on horseback, on camel or with a quad.  
Our rooms and suites are decorated with love. They associate the traditional moroccan architecture with a contemporary twist. Some of our rooms have a private terrace with a view onto the Atlas Mountain. Our humble house reflects the richness of the history of Moroccan architecture and traditions and is a real part of the local patrimony. You will be hosted as a friend and our team will make every effort to ensure your comfort and peace.
Our biggest pleasure will be to please you. There is no schedule at Kasbah Agafay. You are free to take your meals whenever you like; either in our restaurant Al Ourda, on the pool side or on one of our terrace. You will feel at home with us. You can also combine a few nights at the Kasbah with our sister property Ksour Agafay located into the Medina, a few minutes from the Jamaa el Fna market place. You will be able to take advantage of the excitement of the city and the quietness of the country.

203186.description: Amelie Berlin The Amelie Berlin (rated 3x000D star) is a mid size hotel in Berlin. Off site car parking is available. Guests can enjoy a meal at the hotel restaurant. Room Features Amelie Berlin. All rooms have a hairdryer. Rooms have wireless internet access available.

203202.description:
The Hotel Europa City is 3 star rated hotel situated in center of West-Berlin, near from the famous Kurfuerstendamm.  Meeting facilities and wifi are available.   We are sorry, but smoking is not permitted in either the bedrooms or the public areas of the hotel. Rooms have wireless internet access available free of charge.
Public parking is available.

203213.address: derb Bzou - rue de la Kasbah, 35
203213.description: A 3-minute walk from the Saadian Tombs, this air-conditioned riad with an indoor pool is located in the Royal Quarter of the Kasbah in Marrakech's walled Medina. Each room includes an en-suite bathroom and access to a shared lounge with a fireplace. All rooms are designed with elements of Moroccan style, and some feature a fireplace and TV. A continental breakfast is served daily, typically by the courtyard fountain or on the roof terrace. Guests can sample a range of traditional Moroccan specialties in the restaurant. Further activities available at a supplement include dinner with a show and excursions to the Ourika Valley, the Atlas Mountains, the Sahara Desert, and other places of interest. Riad Jonan is a 15-minute drive from Marrakech Menara Airport and a 10-minute drive from Marrakech Train Station. The Majorelle Gardens are a 10-minute drive away, and Jamaâ El Fna Square is a 10-minute walk away.

203230.description: Located in Berlin's Charlottenburg district, Hotel Am Stuttgarter Eck offers convenient access to Kurfürstendamm and Zoo Berlin, both within a 5-minute drive. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi and a daily buffet breakfast (7:00 AM - 10:00 AM). Guests can also utilize tour/ticket assistance and luggage storage. The 30 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs with cable programming, desks, separate sitting areas, and bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel also has a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. Potsdamer Platz and Brandenburg Gate are approximately 4 miles away.

203241.address: B.P 24 530 Marrakech Atlas, Km 5 Route D’Amizmiz
203241.description: Indulge in a rejuvenating experience at the full-service spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of the hotel's recreational amenities, including three outdoor swimming pools, a health club, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Explore nearby attractions with ease using the area shuttle (surcharge). The Pavilion is one of the hotel's three restaurants and offers a delightful dining experience; alternatively, enjoy 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the three coffee shops/cafés. Unwind with a refreshing drink at the poolside bar or one of the three bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, limousine/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. For events, the hotel offers 1292 square feet (120 square meters) of space, including conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and free self-parking is available on-site. Each of the 60 individually decorated guest rooms provides a luxurious retreat with heated floors and LED televisions. Stay connected with complimentary wireless internet access and enjoy satellite programming. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. The hotel is located near Marrakech’s attractions such as the Oasiria Water Park (1. 2 km), Atlas Golf Marrakech (2. 8 km), and Noria Golf Club (3 km).

203242.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the mid-sized Alberghiera Venezia in Venice. Enjoy a meal at our on-site restaurant. Rooms feature hairdryers and irons with ironing boards. Select rooms and public areas permit smoking; please specify your preference when booking. Tea and coffee making facilities, along with a minibar, are available in all rooms. We also offer an airport shuttle service, concierge service, and welcome pets. The hotel has disabled facilities, including wheelchair access to the hotel and reception areas.

203255.description: Hotel 38 (ex Hotel Am Scheunenviertel) The Hotel 38 (ex Hotel Am Scheunenviertel) (rated 3x000D star) is a mid size hotel in Berlin. Guests can dine at the hotel restaurant. Room Features Hotel 38 (ex Hotel Am Scheunenviertel). Smoking is permitted in certain bedrooms (please specify when booking) and the public areas of the hotel.

203259.description: Enjoy a central Berlin stay at Hotel AI Königshof, a short drive from Kurfürstendamm and Zoo Berlin. This hotel offers 44 guestrooms featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, blackout drapes, and work desks. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, computer station, and vending machine. The hotel is conveniently located near attractions such as the Deutsche Oper Berlin, Messe Berlin, and the iconic Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church. Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER) is approximately 18 miles away.

203277.description: Enjoy the convenience of complimentary Wi-Fi, a shared TV area, and tour/ticket assistance at Hotel Berliner Bär. Guests can indulge in the on-site snack bar/deli and bar/lounge. Each morning, a buffet breakfast is available (fee applies). The hotel provides 53 guestrooms, each equipped with a minibar, flat-screen TV, and private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers, dry cleaning/laundry services, free self-parking, and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel is centrally located in Berlin, within a 10-minute drive of Checkpoint Charlie and Potsdamer Platz, and conveniently close to Tempelhof Park.

203279.description: This four-story hotel offers designated smoking areas and a complimentary buffet breakfast daily from 5:30 AM to 10 AM. The hotel features 75 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, desks, and blackout drapes/curtains. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. A 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage are also available. Located in Berlin's Reinickendorf district, the Central-Hotel Tegel is within a 15-minute drive of Kurfürstendamm and the Berlin Zoo. It's also conveniently located near Plötzensee (3. 1 mi), Schloss Charlottenburg (4. 8 mi), and Classic Remise Berlin (4. 9 mi). The nearest major airport is Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER), 24. 4 miles away.

203297.description: The cozy, 3-star Hotel B!RGIT offers 53 newly renovated rooms in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, Berlin Mitte. Enjoy a tranquil escape in our amazing garden, a relaxing oasis in the heart of the city. B!RGIT's bar serves typical regional drinks, and our breakfast is rich in organic and healthy choices. Committed to nature and ecology, we use only eco-friendly products. A 3-minute walk from Senefelderplatz Underground Station provides direct connections to Potsdamer Platz and the Olympic Stadium. Our comfortably furnished rooms and great beds ensure a restful sleep. Discover environmentally friendly travel with Hotel B!RGIT – your home in Berlin.

203299.description: Offering soundproofed rooms and rental bicycles, this hotel is located in the Steglitz district of Berlin. Schloßstraße Underground Station is 1969 feet away, providing links to Kurfürstendamm shopping area and Berlin Zoo. All rooms at the Hotel Eckstein include a private bathroom and cable TV. Reception is open 24 hours a day. A breakfast buffet is offered each morning in the Eckstein's breakfast room. Many restaurants, pubs and discos are within walking distance. The Botanic Garden in Steglitz is just a 20-minute walk away. Hotel Eckstein is a 6-minute walk from the Schloßstraße and Breitenbachplatz underground stations. Parking spaces can be booked in the hotel garage. On request, the hotel provides a shuttle service to Berlin's airports and trade fair.

203324.description: The Lulu Guldsmeden, a unique eco-friendly hotel, seamlessly blends modern design with Nordic sleekness within a historic 1850s building in Berlin's Tiergarten/Mitte district. The on-site restaurant offers delicious organic dishes. Most rooms boast 13-foot ceilings and colonial-style four-poster beds, along with flat-screen TVs. Fourth-floor and rooftop rooms offer air conditioning, while other rooms have fans. Select family loft-style rooms accommodate up to four guests. For added fun, loft rooms feature a swing, a particular favorite among children. All private bathrooms include complimentary organic toiletries and a hairdryer. Guests can also take advantage of the 24-hour front desk and bike hire. The Brandenburg Gate is one mile away, while Checkpoint Charlie is 1. 1 miles from the property. Berlin Tegel Airport is five miles away.

203337.description: Situated in Venice, the 3-star Hotel Malibran offers guests a comfortable stay with convenient amenities. Enjoy on-site dining in our restaurant and stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi in all rooms. Each room is equipped with a hairdryer and a well-stocked minibar. The hotel maintains a strict no-smoking policy. Additional services include an airport shuttle and a concierge. Pets are welcome.

name.content: Hotel Bleibtreu Berlin by Golden Tulip

203345.description: With a central location, an intimate atmosphere, charm and a mix of art, design and homely comfort, the hotel opened in the Bleibtreustrasse near the Kurfürstendamm in 1995. Housed in a patrician house dating back to the 19th century, the hotel lies in one of the most beautiful side streets off the Kurfürstendamm. It's less than half an hour from Tegel airport and the Hauptbahnhof and close to the classy boutiques of international designers. Sunday breakfast in the company of local residents, the cordial atmosphere of the hotel immediately conveys to guests the feeling of temporarily being a local in Charlottenburg. The bright rooms accented with natural materials feature Wi-Fi, flat-screen Tvs and a private bathroom.

203363.description: Enjoy garden views at the Astrid Hotel am Kurfürstendamm, located in the heart of Berlin near Kurfürstendamm. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and limited room service. The 28 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs with cable, private bathrooms with showers and hair dryers, work desks, and blackout curtains. Additional amenities include a computer station, express check-out, and multilingual staff. Train station pick-up is available for a surcharge. The hotel is a short drive from the Theatre of the West, Europa Center, Kaufhaus des Westens, and the Berlin Zoo.

203370.description: Boasting a prime location in a road parallel to Kurfürstendamm, this welcoming hotel occupies a characteristic, old Berlin-style building within walking distance of various shops, restaurants, theaters and cafes. Several attractions can be explored on foot from here, such as the iconic Kaiser Wilhelm Gedächtniskirche (Memorial Church) and the Berlin Zoo. An underground station lies just a few steps away, allowing you to access all of the city’s further sights with ease. The location is also ideal for exploring Berlin's vibrant nightlife. Hotel-Pension Rheingold am Kurfürstendamm is suitable for guests of all ages. Despite its central location, it provides a peaceful atmosphere away from traffic noise. Guests can reserve a public parking space at the hotel or a private garage just 656 feet away.

203393.description: Nestled between Berlin Main Station and the renowned Ku'damm shopping boulevard, Hotel Les Nations offers a tranquil retreat. A short walk from the iconic Victory Column in Tiergarten park, and 3 km from Brandenburg Gate and the Reichstag, the hotel boasts excellent bus connections and easy access to the A100 motorway (1. 5 km). Nearby, you'll find charming cafes, a playground, a supermarket, and the picturesque river Spree, alongside hidden alleys and diverse restaurants. Hotel Les Nations provides bicycle hire and secure courtyard parking (contact the hotel for availability). The friendly staff are happy to share insider tips. Each individually furnished room features free WiFi, a flat-screen TV, and either a shower or bathtub; some rooms also include a balcony. All rooms are accessible by elevator. Breakfast is available upon request.

203458.description: Escape to Hotel The Weekend, where every day feels like a weekend getaway. Located in Vienna's vibrant 7th district, this hotel offers a tranquil retreat with convenient access to the city's attractions. Enjoy the peace and quiet, create beautiful memories, and experience Vienna at your own pace. On-site parking is available for €19. 00 per night (reservations recommended; contact info@hoteltheweekend. at). A city tax of 3. 2% is included. Breakfast is €18 per person/day. Different policies and additional supplements may apply for bookings of 5 rooms or more.

203467.description: This recently renovated guesthouse is ideally situated on a central avenue in beautiful Lisbon, close to Duque de Saldanha Square. All rooms feature private bathrooms, cable TV, Wi-Fi, telephone, hairdryer, and heating, with some also including air conditioning. Guests can also enjoy convenient amenities such as laundry service, luggage storage, air conditioning in public areas, Wi-Fi throughout, and a 24-hour reception desk.

203470.description: The Lisbon Hostel, located in Lisbon, offers guests convenient on-site dining and complimentary Wi-Fi in all rooms. A non-smoking policy is enforced throughout the property. The hostel provides an airport shuttle service, welcomes pets, and offers concierge services. Accessibility features include wheelchair access to the hotel entrance, reception, restaurant, and bar areas.

203472.description:
The Pensao Residencial Roma offers 40 air conditioned and soundproofed rooms elegantly decorated, distributed over 4 floors fully equipped.
The Pensao Residencial Roma is located in the heart of Lisbon close to Marques de pombal and Avenida da Libertade, where guests can find the finest shopping, dining and entertainment venues and located only 500 metres from the Rossio Train Station
Continental breakfast is served every morning . Every room has been carefully designed creating a comfortable and relaxed atmosphere. Some units include a dining area and fully equipped kitchenette with a microwave.In-room facilities at Pensao Residencial Roma:Individually controlled air conditioning, Direct dial telephone, safe, Cable TV,Heating

203485.description: Experience Vienna in one of our 16 uniquely designed apartments. Each apartment features a foyer, kitchen, private bath or shower, telephone, broadband internet, satellite TV, and air conditioning. Some apartments boast antique furnishings and exude classic Viennese charm, while others offer a touch of extravagance with marble bathrooms. All kitchens include a microwave, hob, and dishes. Our reception service can assist with booking theatre and concert tickets, tours, and rental cars. A breakfast buffet is also available, combining the comforts of a hotel with an authentic Viennese living experience.

203487.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a sauna or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 26 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

203495.description: With its central location, it is the ideal starting point for tourists as well as business travellers to enjoy Vienna in all its beauty and romance. The hotel is located in the heart of Vienna, with an easy access to many famous sights such as the Imperial Palace Hofburg, the Museums Quarter, the Natural History and the Art History Museums. Vienna Airport is at 25 km from the property. The hotel offers 53 comfortable rooms, equipped with SAT TV, safe, tea & coffee facilities, work desk and bathroom with amenities. Some rooms feature a balcony overlooking garden view. Gusts can enjoy a buffet breakfast with organic and local specialties and try Viennese coffee culture at the bar. Garage parking is also available for those arriving by car.

203513.description: Parlement offers simple rooms in the city center, 328 feet from Brussels-Luxembourg Railway Station. It benefits from free Wi-Fi and is 623 feet from the European Parliament. Each of the rooms at Hotel Du Parlement has parquet flooring and a flat-screen cable TV. They also have a bathroom with a shower. There is a tea room available during the day. Trone Metro Station is 2297 feet away and Grand Place is 1. 2 mi from Du Parlement Hotel. Regular buses services 12 and 21 depart from the front of the station to Brussels Airport. The Magritte Museum is 15 minutes away on foot. The hotel also includes a snack bar. During the day there is a menu of sandwiches, paninis, salads and drinks available.

203536.description:
Condo Gardens Antwerp is located in a quiet neighborhood, close the center of Antwerp and the new park ‘Noord'. The flats are decorated comfortably and practically and are equipped with all modern facilities, which give them a homely feeling.
Condo Gardens Antwerpen is located in a renovated warehouse and is close to the center of town, which can be reached easily by public transport.
All apartments offer a fully equipped kitchenette, a bathroom and a living area with tv.
In case of any further questions or need for help, you may contact our colleague on site during the opening hours of the office.

name.content: Riess City Hotel self check in

203548.description: The Riess City Hotel, renovated in August 2017 and under new ownership, enjoys a central location a 5-minute walk from the Ringstraße boulevard and a 10-minute walk from the University of Vienna. Tram line D, just 200 meters away, provides easy access to the city center and Nussdorf with its traditional wine taverns. The simply furnished rooms have private bathrooms and free WiFi. St. Stephen's Cathedral and Kärntner Straße shopping street are a 15-minute walk from the hotel.

203557.description: This enchanting hotel enjoys a convenient location in Vienna city centre, just a 10-minute tram ride from the opera house of this beautiful city. Just opposite the hotel, in Matzleinsdorferplatz square, guests will find several tram lines that go to different parts of the city, which makes it very easy to discover all the hidden treasures of the region. Guests also enjoy direct access to the rail network, with links to attractions such as Viennese Prater, a large public park. All the rooms of the establishment are soundproofed to guarantee a restful night's sleep and come with a harmoniously stylish atmosphere and excellent amenities. Guests can enjoy drinks and snacks in the lobby bar of this eco-friendly property while business travellers may find complimentary Wi-Fi and a business corner for their convenience.

203558.description: Enjoy terrace views and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at Hotel Herzoghof in Baden. Dine at the onsite coffee shop/cafe, or enjoy room service (limited hours). Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (7 AM to 10:30 AM, fee applies). The hotel offers a business center, express check-in/out, airport shuttle (surcharge, 24-hour availability), and self-parking (fee applies). Each of the 30 guestrooms features a flat-screen TV, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, deep soaking bathtubs, and complimentary toiletries. Safes and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is daily. Located in a state park, the hotel is steps from Kurpark and Spa Garden, and a short distance from Casino Baden and the Municipal Theatre. Vienna International Airport (VIE) is approximately 25. 8 miles away.

203601.description: A 15-minute bus or underground ride from the Ringstraße Boulevard and Saint Stephen's Cathedral, Gartenhotel Gabriel City offers free WiFi access and a quiet, lush garden. The breakfast room and all of the guest rooms are decorated with imitations of Gustav Klimt murals. The breakfast buffet is available from 06:30. The Viehmarktgasse bus stop with access to bus line 74A is located opposite the Gabriel City Gartenhotel. From there the City Airport Train Terminal can be reached within 15 minutes. The Schlachthausgasse station of the U3 underground line can be reached on foot in 7 minutes.

name.content: Aspria Royal La Rasante Hotel & Spa

203604.description: Aspria Royal La Rasante Hotel & Spa, located in a restored farm house offers beautiful rooms and suites. It is part of the exclusive Aspria Royal La Rasante private club where guests can benefit from full member’s access and advantages during their stay. The club features 16 fitness zones, a range of collective classes, swimming pools and wellness area with sauna, Turkish bath and hot tub. Tennis courts and spa treatments are also available. On weekends, junior guests are welcome in The Academy’s creche and activities, where charges apply. Guests can enjoy a continental-style breakfast including pastries, cereals and freshly baked bread. Throughout the day, the restaurant serves a range of seasonal and healthy juices and salads, pasta dishes and regional specialties. The center of Brussels, featuring the Grand Place, is just over 3. 1 mi from the hotel. Tomberg Metro Station is located a 7-minute walk from the club. The airport is a 15-minute drive away.

203609.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at the HEINhotel vienna airport, including a sauna, fitness center, and complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel also features a living plant wall and offers tour/ticket assistance. Grab a bite at the snack bar/deli or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (for a fee). The hotel provides express check-in/check-out, multilingual staff, and airport shuttle service (surcharge applies). Free self-parking is available onsite. The 54 guestrooms feature LED TVs with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, desks, and bathrooms with bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Daily housekeeping is provided. Located in Schwechat (Mannswoerth), the HEINhotel vienna airport is within a 15-minute drive of Ernst Happel Stadium and Belvedere, and conveniently close to Vienna International Airport.

203612.description: Hotel Hadrigan The Hotel Hadrigan (rated 3x000D star) is a mid size hotel in Wien. The hotel offers on site car parking. Hotel guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant on site. Room Features Hotel Hadrigan. Smoking is permitted in both the bedrooms and the public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms.

203617.description: This luxury boutique hotel is located just 150 metres north of Taksim Square and just a 05-minute walk from the vibrant shopping and nightlife on Istiklal Avenue. It is just a few steps from the Lutfi Kirdar Convention & Exhibition Centre and Cemal Resit Rey Concert Hall. Travellers will find some of most important tourist attractions at Sultanahmet just over 4 kilometres away. This stylish establishment offers a choice of soundproofed rooms that have been tastefully decorated in soothing tones and earthy colours to create a relaxing atmosphere in which to unwind after a long day of sightseeing. A complete traditional breakfast is served every morning at the lobby lounge or in the winter garden café and the wellness area, including a state-of-the-art spa and a fitness centre, is the best place to relax and be pampered.

203627.description: The Ani-Falstaff is located in the Alsergrund district, within 1640 feet of the Sigmund Freud Museum and the Roßauer Lände Underground Station (line U4). Free WiFi is available. All rooms have a TV. Certain rooms feature a seating area for your convenience. Every room is fitted with a private bathroom equipped with a bath or shower. Extras include free toiletries and a hairdryer. The Votive Church, the University of Vienna, and the Ringstraße boulevard can be reached in a 10- to 15-minute walk.

203630.description:
Located in Laeken,this charming guest house offers quality accommodation with free wireless internet connection.The center of the city of Brussels is situated a few minutes drive.
The hostal includes luggage storage,a garden and a playground.In good weather,the outdoor terrace is an ideal place to relax.
All the rooms feature from the Chambres d'hotes Bruxelles Heysel Atomiumall have a minimalist decoration.The bathrooms are shared. 
The center of Brussels is 15 minutes by tram from the hotel.The Atomium 3 km and the Notre-Dame de Laeken 700 meters from the guest house.

203641.description: Featuring 3-star accommodation, Self-Check-In Hotel Adlon is situated in Vienna, 700 metres from Vienna Prater and 1. 5 km from Messe Wien. The property is located 700 metres from Kunst Haus Wien - Museum Hundertwasser, 1. 8 km from St. Stephen's Cathedral and 2. 6 km from St. Peter's Catholic Church. The hotel features a terrace, a 24-hour front desk, and free WiFi is available. At the hotel, all rooms include a desk. The private bathroom is fitted with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. At Self-Check-In Hotel Adlon rooms include bed linen and towels. House of Music is 2. 6 km from the accommodation, while Albertina Museum is 3. 2 km from the property. The nearest airport is Vienna International Airport, 18 km from Self-Check-In Hotel Adlon.

203645.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find indoor tennis courts, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Grab a bite to eat at the hotel's restaurant, which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 79 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LED televisions.

203667.description: Opened in June 2012, the stylish Austria Trend Hotel Doppio is only a 10-minute tram ride away from Belvedere Palace and the centre of Vienna. It features a fitness area, free internet access in the entire building, and an inviting bar. Each room is air-conditioned and comes equipped with a refrigerator, a laptop-size safe and a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. A small bottle of mineral water is provided free of charge in all rooms. Hotel Doppio can be found next to Vienna's new Media Quarter Marx and the Vienna Biocenter. It is easily reachable by car via the St. Marx exit of the A23 Motorway and from Vienna Airport. The historic St. Marx Cemetery with Mozart's Grave is located just 200 metres away. „In connection with the government's measures to curb the spread of the Corona virus, there may be an adjusted breakfast offer during this period. “

203689.description: Set in a stylish mansion in a quiet residential district of Lisbon, Hotel Italia offers functional rooms with wood floors. Cast iron and a small orchard with garden terrace provide a homely ambiance. Soundproofing in all hotel rooms ensure a good night’s rest. Each room has a wall-mounted TV for guests’ entertainment, as well as a bathroom with hairdryer. A breakfast buffet is provided to guests each morning. A varied choice of bars and restaurants are found just around the corner from the hotel. The outdoor terrace is perfect for relaxing while enjoying a drink. Hotel Italia is a 10-minute walk from Jose De Azeredo Perdigao Modern Art Center in Gulbenkian Park. Saldanha Metro Station is just 1969 feet away, linking to Lisbon’s central Rossio Square with 4 stops.

203782.description: Teatro Bed & Breakfast The Teatro Bed & Breakfast is located in Lisbon. Dining is available at the hotel, which has it's own restaurant. Room Facilities Teatro Bed & Breakfast. A hairdryer is provided in every room. Rooms have wireless internet access available. Tea and coffeee making facilities together with a minibar are available in all rooms. Leisure Info. Leisure facilities are available at the Teatro Bed & Breakfast. Additional Info. An airport shuttle service is available from the hotel. Pets are most welcome at the hotel. A concierge service is available to guests.

203967.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at Hotel Canada, located in Lisbon's city center. This 30-room hotel offers air conditioning, minibars, and LCD TVs with cable programming in each room. Additional amenities include a hair salon, vending machine, 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Bicycle rentals are also available. You'll be a short drive from Avenida da Liberdade and Rossio Square, and conveniently close to attractions like Marquis of Pombal Square. Humberto Delgado Airport (LIS) is the nearest airport.

203973.description: Enjoy a central Vienna stay at Hotel Haydn, steps from Mariahilfer Street and a short walk from the vibrant Naschmarkt. This hotel offers 23 air-conditioned rooms with amenities such as minibars, safes, and desks. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy cable programming. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies). Convenient on-site amenities include concierge services, a computer station, and express check-in/check-out. Self-parking and a 24-hour airport shuttle are available (surcharge applies). The hotel is conveniently located near the Hofburg Imperial Palace (1. 2 km) and the Vienna Christmas Market (1. 6 km).

203975.description:
Hotel Kaffeemühle impresses with its attractive location and a versatile range of accommodations. In addition to classic double rooms, the hotel offers spacious multi-bed rooms, making it an ideal choice for families and groups of friends. 

Thanks to its excellent location, Vienna’s city center can be reached comfortably on foot, while the well-developed public transportation network allows you to explore the city quickly and effortlessly. The surrounding 7th district enchants visitors with its trendy boutiques, relaxed shopping experience, diverse culinary scene, and unique flair. 

A public parking garage is available nearby for €19. 00 per 24 hours. 

Breakfast is available for €18. 00 per person. 

The reception is open daily from 6:30 a. m. to 11:00 p. m. Guests planning to arrive after 10:00 p. m. are kindly requested to contact the reception in advance to arrange their check-in. 

The rooms as well as parts of the public areas in this property have been partially renovated. 

The hotel does not offer on-site parking. However, a public parking garage is located directly adjacent to the property and is available to our guests. Please note that the garage is operated by an independent company and is not affiliated with the hotel. Parking fees and conditions are set by the garage operator and may be subject to change. 

Guests have access to the garage daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Please note that the garage is closed overnight, and vehicle access is not possible during this time. 

Electric Vehicle Charging

The nearest charging station for electric vehicles is located at Westbahnstraße 43, approximately 2 minutes' walk from the hotel.

203989.description:
This apartment is a charming and compact apartment for up to 4 people, located near to Campo de Sta Clara, in Lisbon.
The apartment is a 40m2 studio apartment with a double bed and Show more two single sofa-beds, a dining area, a fully equipped kitchen, a bathroom, and a little terrace area which offers views of the National Panteon. The apartment has all the amenities you could need.
An attractive apartment with a view of the National Panteon.
Free Wifi & Air Conditioning.

203997.description: Enjoy a stay at Hotel Graf Stadion, situated in the heart of Vienna, a short walk from the Vienna Christmas Market and Hofburg Imperial Palace. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, served from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel offers 39 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs with cable, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, and conveniences such as coffee/tea makers and desks. Free Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance are also available. The hotel is conveniently located near attractions like the Rathaus, Austrian Parliament Building, and MuseumsQuartier. Vienna International Airport (VIE) is 21 km away.

204001.description: Palace Hostel Schlossherberge The Palace Hostel Schlossherberge is located in Wien. On site car parking is available at the hotel. Hotel guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant on site. Room Facilities Palace Hostel Schlossherberge. There is a no smoking policy throughout the hotel.  Leisure Info. The Palace Hostel Schlossherberge offers a range of leisure facilities.

204018.description: Hotel Eitljorg The 4x000D star rated luxury Hotel Eitljorg is situated in Wien. Guests can dine at the hotel restaurant. Meeting facilities and wifi are available. Rooms at the Hotel Eitljorg. Smoking in certain bedrooms is allowed, as well as in public areas of the hotel. Please specify when making your booking. Rooms offer internet access via wifi or modem. Wireless internet is also available in public areas. All rooms feature a stocked minibar. Leisure Info. Leisure facilities are available at the Hotel Eitljorg. Additional Info. The hotel offers an airport shuttle service. Pets are most welcome at the hotel. A concierge service is available to guests.

204023.description: The family-run guesthouse offers leisure travelers and business travelers a personal and pleasant atmosphere. The guesthouse is situated near the center of Vienna, directly on the most popular and oldest shopping street of Vienna.

204035.description: The V Dinastia Guesthouse offers a warm welcome to Lisbon. Guests can enjoy breakfast in the guesthouse's breakfast room and a complimentary glass of Port wine upon arrival. Our 24-hour staff is available to assist you in any way possible to enhance your stay. Smoking is prohibited in all guest rooms and public areas. Complimentary wireless internet access is provided in each room. On-site parking is available for €11 per night.

204045.description:
Welcome to Hotel Beverly Hills ***
Located just a 2-minute walk from Avenue Louise and Place Stéphanie, and close to the prestigious Avenue de la Toison d’Or, the Beverly Hills Hotel welcomes you in a modern and cozy setting. 

Our three-star hotel is perfect for both business and leisure stays. We are a strict non smoking hotel. No parking available. Free Wifi internet access is available in all rooms. Buffet breakfast available.

204055.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held on select days. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 24 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

204061.description: The Lisbon Chillout Hostel offers an authentic Lisbon experience in the heart of the city. Located in a traditional neighborhood, you're steps away from local restaurants and cafes, immersing you in Lisbon's rich culture. The hostel boasts a cozy atmosphere with several common areas, a variety of private and shared rooms, and a private garden perfect for relaxing or evening barbecues. Whether traveling solo or in a group, you'll find the perfect accommodation, from bunk-bed dorms to private rooms with twin or double beds. All rooms have free Wi-Fi.

204071.description: Enjoy a central Vienna stay at Hotel Marc Aurel, within a 10-minute walk of St. Stephen's Cathedral and Hofburg Imperial Palace. The hotel offers 30 air-conditioned guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, cable TV, and private bathrooms with toiletries and hair dryers. Safes and desks are also provided. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies), and room service is offered during limited hours. Additional amenities include concierge services, limo/town car service, and express check-in/check-out. Nearby attractions include Fleischmarkt (0. 1 mi), Morzinplatz (0. 2 mi), Schwedenplatz (0. 2 mi), and the Danube River (0. 2 mi). Vienna International Airport (VIE) is 11. 6 mi away.

204108.address: Evliya Çelebi Mh.Meşrutiyet Cd. No:108 Şişhane, 108
204108.description: This lavish hotel is surrounded by trendy café bars and small shops in the Galata district of Istanbul. The 14th-century Galata Tower is less than 5 minutes' walk away, and the vibrant Istiklal Avenue is home to shops, restaurants and entertainment venues, approximately a six-minute walk from the hotel. Additionally, Taksim Square can be reached by tram in approximately 10 minutes and the historic attractions at Sultanahmet, such as Topkapi Palace and the Grand Bazaar, are easily reachable via public transport. The ornately decorated guest rooms will make each guest feel like a sultan, all with elaborate details and modern comforts, and many with sea views and spa baths. Guests can wake up to a daily breakfast and enjoy coffee and snacks in the onsite café.

204110.description: Surrounded by lush forests and with a beautiful mountain backdrop, this 85-room hotel is located just 1 km from the centre of Kemer and approximately a 15-minute walk from the beautiful beach and clear, turquoise waters of the Mediterranean Sea. The hotel offers simple and comfortable guestrooms, tastefully decorated and equipped with air-conditioning and private bathroom. Facilities include a spa centre with sauna, Turkish bath and massage service, as well as a well-equipped gym and an outdoor swimming pool. There is also a games room with table tennis and pool. Guests can enjoy buffet-style breakfast, lunch and dinner at the hotel restaurant and they can have a refreshing drink at the pool and vitamin bar. The hotel is just 12 km from the Ancient City of Phaselis and 60 km from Antalya Airport.

204128.description: This hotel is located in the heart of Istanbul, in Taksim's Gumussuyu district. Taksim Square is 100 m away from the hotel and the vibrant, bustling Istiklal Street, 400 m. An underground and bus station are located in Taksim providing easy access to other areas of the city. Istanbul International Airport is to be found at 40 km away. The hotel offers 385 guest rooms, designed for comfort and convenience. Rooms come equipped with satellite TV, tea and coffee facilities and spacious bathroom with bath accessories. Ideal for business and leisure stays, the hotel features modern, stylish accommodation with a 3, 500 m2 spa and fitness area, 16 event and meeting venues and a large roof terrace with a view of the Bosphorous.

204171.description: Hostal Santo Domingo Situated in Madrid, the Hostal Santo Domingo provides 3x000D star rated accommodation. Guests can enjoy a meal at the hotel restaurant. Rooms at the Hostal Santo Domingo. There is a no smoking policy throughout the hotel.

204202.description: Hostal Alhambra Suites The 3x000D star Hostal Alhambra Suites is situated in Madrid. The hotel offers off site car parking. Dining is available at the hotel, which has it's own restaurant. Room Features Hostal Alhambra Suites. All rooms have a hairdryer. We are sorry, but smoking is not permitted in either the bedrooms or the public areas of the hotel. Rooms have wireless internet access available. All rooms feature a stocked minibar. Other Info. The hotel offers an airport shuttle service. Pets are welcome at the hotel. A concierge service is provided for guests.

204208.description:
Rooms with Free Internet (Wifi or cable), air conditioning, flat TV, telephone, box safe, and so on. Enjoy with the personal attention 24 hours from Puerta del Sol or Madrid de Los Austrias.Rooms with full private bathroom:
TV - Satelite - Canal +, Telephone, Safe, Heater, Air conditioning, FREE Internet Wi-Fi or Cable
Attention 24 hours, Amenities (to request), Hairdryer, Magnifying mirror in bathrooms, We have Superior rooms with hot tub

204212.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include ski storage, complimentary use of a nearby fitness facility, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Thalwil? This hotel has 9598 square feet (892 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 40 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected.

204216.description: Located in Navacerrada, 25 miles from Plaza Mayor, El Torreon de Navacerrada has accommodations with free bikes, free private parking, a garden and a shared lounge. Featuring room service, this property also provides guests with a terrace. Guests can have a drink at the bar. Free WiFi is accessible to all guests, while selected rooms also feature a patio. Temple of Debod is 30 miles from the hotel, while Plaza de España Metro Station is 30 miles from the property. The nearest airport is Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport, 40 miles from El Torreon de Navacerrada.

204217.description: Hostal America, a 2-star hotel in Madrid, offers on-site parking and an on-site restaurant. Select rooms and public areas permit smoking; please specify your preference when booking. All rooms provide Wi-Fi internet access. The hotel also offers an airport shuttle service and welcomes pets. Concierge service is available for guests.

204227.description: The Can FISA Apartments are located 18 km from Barcelona in the charming town of Corbera de Llobregat. These spacious, bright apartments offer splendid views and accommodate 2-5 guests. Rentals are available by the day or week, with options for extended stays. Guests enjoy access to all the amenities of the nearby Hotel Can FISA, including the pool and restaurants, and can opt for the hotel's breakfast buffet. Ideal for families seeking a home-away-from-home experience surrounded by nature, yet close to Barcelona, these apartments are also a cost-effective choice for businesses needing to house employees for varying lengths of time.

204228.address: Calle San Bernardo Nro 35 Piso 2 Izquierda, 35
204228.description: The Abami II Hostel, located in the heart of Madrid, is within walking distance of Gran Vía, a vibrant street known for its shops and nightclubs. This convenient location allows you to easily explore many of the city's attractions, including the Royal Palace, Plaza of Spain, and Puerta del Sol. Each room features a private bathroom and a balcony with city views. The hostel also offers free Wi-Fi and a free luggage storage service. Nearby attractions include the Royal Palace and the History Museum. Callao and Noviciado metro stations are just minutes away, providing quick access to the entire city. Please note, there is no 24-hour reception and the building does not have a lift.

name.content: Hostal Castilla Ii Puerta Del Sol

204387.description: Located in the heart of Madrid, Hostal Castilla II - Puerta del Sol is just a five-minute walk from Puerta del Sol and Plaza Mayor. This hostal offers 23 air-conditioned rooms with private balconies or patios, LED TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy convenient amenities such as express check-in/check-out, concierge services, and a vending machine. Continental breakfast is available daily for a fee. The airport shuttle service is available 24/7 for a surcharge. Nearby attractions include the Royal Palace of Madrid (1. 2 km) and the Prado Museum (2. 3 km).

204409.description: Hostal Ds The 2x000D star Hostal Ds is situated in Velilla De San Antonio. Guests can dine at the hotel restaurant. Rooms at the Hostal Ds. Smoking in certain bedrooms is allowed, as well as in public areas of the hotel. Please specify when making your booking. All rooms have tea and coffee making facilities.

204446.description: Nestled amidst almond trees, olive groves, and vineyards, The Cottage Hotel offers a tranquil escape just 50 km from Madrid in the historic town of Chinchón. Explore charming streets, savor local cuisine, and experience the warm hospitality of this unforgettable destination. Located in a serene natural setting, yet conveniently close to area attractions, the hotel provides easy access to ticket sales for Warner Bros, Faunia, the Zoo, and the Amusement Park. The two-story hotel features 14 comfortable double rooms, each equipped with air conditioning, a private bathroom, and a television.

204499.description: The Corte Nova Residence, a beautifully restored Venetian palazzo overlooking a canal, offers ten luxurious suites/apartments equipped with every modern comfort. Our reception staff is happy to provide helpful information about the area and our elegant surroundings. During reception hours, guests can also relax in our tranquil private garden, a welcome escape from the bustling city center. Reception is open until 7 p. m. , and we kindly request that you inform us of your estimated arrival time. At check-in, we require a credit card pre-authorization of €200 per apartment as a security deposit for any potential damages. Please note, this deposit is only accepted via credit card. A €25 final cleaning fee and the city tax are payable at check-in, strictly in cash.

204501.description: This 4-star hotel is located opposite City Life park, just 150 meters from the MICO congress center and Vigorelli velodrome, and 300 meters from the Milan City Fair. Conveniently served by public transport, the City Life park area offers a variety of shops, cinemas, clubs, and restaurants, providing excellent opportunities for relaxation after work. The Admiral Hotel Milano's 60 rooms and suites feature classic, elegant decor, guaranteeing guests comfort and a restful stay.

204513.description: The Corvetto Residence in Milan offers fully-serviced apartments with amenities such as a kitchenette, air conditioning, soundproofing, a private bathroom, Sky TV, and hypoallergenic linens. Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Guests can access the car park, pool, and fitness center for an additional fee. The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation, including bus and metro lines, providing easy access to the city center, railway station, and Linate (LIN) and Malpensa (MXP) airports. Pets are welcome for a €30 sanitization fee. Accessible facilities are available for guests with disabilities.

204523.description: The hotel offers 78 street-facing rooms, each equipped with a bath or shower, direct-dial telephone, satellite TV, minibar, laundry service, adjustable air conditioning and heating, Wi-Fi, pay TV, a hairdryer, and room service upon request. Guests also enjoy access to a secure underground parking lot and an on-site restaurant, open for dinner Monday through Friday. Located in the Città Studi district, the hotel is just minutes from two underground lines, providing quick access to the city center and exhibition center.

204524.description: Hotel Bogart is set in a green area with excellent bus and tram links to Milan city center. Rooms are spacious and tastefully decorated, with free Wi-Fi and air conditioning. Within easy reach of San Siro Stadium, Milan trade fairs and the city center, Hotel Bogart is near pubs, bars and restaurants. Bus 78 stops 328 feet away and provides direct connection to Lotto Metro Station, on the red line. The Bogart's staff are always available at reception, providing tourist information, bookings and transfers. There is also a hall with satellite LCD TV and a bright, modern breakfast room and bar.

204530.description: Head down to the water and enjoy a day at the private beach, or take advantage of other recreational amenities, which include bicycles to rent. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, babysitting (surcharge), and an arcade/game room. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 23 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets.

204662.description: Enjoy garden views at Hotel 2000, located near Corso Buenos Aires in Milan's Central Station area. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Amenities include free Wi-Fi, concierge services, an area shuttle (surcharge), a snack bar, and a bar/lounge.
