205802.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the large, 3-star IH Hotels Argonne Park in Milan. On-site parking is available. Guests can dine at the hotel's restaurant. Smoking is permitted in designated rooms and public areas (please specify when booking). Wi-Fi is available in all rooms. The hotel also offers an airport shuttle service and welcomes pets. Concierge service is available 24H. Check-in is available from 2:00 pm . The Hotel offers a private parking : 15, 00 € per day.

205805.description: The Anadolu Hotel offers impressive lodgings and friendly service, making it ideal for both leisure and business travelers. Each comfortably appointed room features an array of amenities to make you feel at home. Located in Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, the hotel is just a five-minute walk from the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, and Topkapi Palace.

205837.description: Located in the heart of Venice, Ca' Bonvicini is just a short walk from the Rialto Bridge and St. Mark's Square. This elegant hotel, once a noble Venetian family home, offers guests a unique experience within a beautifully preserved late 17th-century palace. The spacious, comfortable rooms, some with charming canal views, feature luxurious fabrics, baroque curtains, and antique walnut furniture accented with 24-karat gold details. Modern amenities include a safe, telephone, satellite TV, direct internet access, and an en-suite bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. All rooms are air-conditioned and soundproofed, and complimentary Wi-Fi is available. As there is no 24-hour reception, please inform the property of your expected arrival time.

205854.description: Set in Milan's city centre, just 600 m from Milan Central Station, Albergo Salerno offers rooms with free WiFi and air conditioning. Corso Buenos Aires shopping street is 300 m away. Rooms all come with a work desk and a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Their private bathrooms with a shower also feature a hairdryer and toiletries. Each morning, a breakfast buffet with savoury and sweet food is served. Staff are available 24 hours a day and can recommend sights in the surroundings. Hotel Salerno is 200 m from the Lima Metro Station with links to Milan Cathedral, only 4 stops away, and direct connections with the Expo 2015 Exhibition Centre. Stazione Centrale is a great choice for travellers interested in shopping, shopping for clothes and cathedrals.

205855.description: Hotel Brenta Milano is set in Milan's Bocconi University district, just 55 yards away from Brenta Metro Station. Guestrooms come with LCD satellite TVs and free Wi-Fi access. This 2-star hotel is just 5 metro stops away from the Duomo. Milan Central Station is also on the same metro line (Line 3). Reception is open 24-hours a day at the Brenta Hotel. There is a free internet point in the lobby. All rooms are air conditioned and have private bathrooms with hairdryers.

205857.description: Situated 800 metres from Kucukcekmece Lake in Avcilar, Istanbul Dedem Hotel features air-conditioned rooms, 24-hour front desk and free Wi-Fi in all areas. Ataturk Airport is 10 km away. All rooms include a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a minibar and a wardrobe. Private bathroom comes with free toiletries, slippers and a hairdryer. Breakfast is offered in buffet style every morning at the breakfast lounge. Guests can also enjoy their breakfast in the privacy of their room. A glass of Turkish tea or coffee is served as well. Istanbul Dedem Hotel is located by the E-5 Highway, only 50 metres from the Metrobus Station. Car rental, tour desk and laundry service are available. A shuttle service can be arranged on request at an additional fee. Free private parking is possible at this pet friendly hotel.

205875.description:
With a stay at Grand Rosa Hotel in Istanbul (Istanbul City Center), you'll be within a 5-minute walk of Grand Bazaar and Beyazit Square.  This hotel is 0.7 mi (1.2 km) from The Egyptian Bazaar and 0.8 mi (1.2 km) from Sultanahmet Square.
Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services.
Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge.
At Grand Rosa Hotel, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM.
Make yourself at home in one of the 29 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

205909.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall at My Hotel Milano in Milan's Washington district. A limited room service and full breakfasts (for a fee) are available. The hotel offers express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Each of the 10 guestrooms features a refrigerator, flat-screen TV, safe, desk, and phone with free local calls. Bathrooms include showers and bathrobes. The hotel is a short drive from Santa Maria delle Grazie, the Leonardo da Vinci Museum of Science and Technology, and other Milan attractions.

205928.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul's City Center, Best Town Hotel is within a 10-minute walk of the Bosphorus and the Egyptian Bazaar. This hotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an area shuttle (surcharge). Guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant, snacks at the coffee shop, or 24-hour room service. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Each of the 12 guestrooms features a minibar, LCD television with satellite programming, and a private bathroom with a shower, hairdryer, and slippers. Additional conveniences include complimentary wired and wireless internet access, a safe, a desk, and a phone. Nearby attractions include the Grand Bazaar (0. 6 mi) and Hagia Sophia (0. 6 mi). The nearest airports are Istanbul Airport (IST) and Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW).

205953.city: FRAZIONE TORNEVANTO DI LONATE POZZOLO VARESE
205953.description: Featuring a bar and garden views, the 4-star Motel Malpensa INN & Hotel offers air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi and private bathrooms in Tornavento, 16 miles from Monastero di Torba. Private parking is available on site. Each room includes a desk and a flat-screen TV. Free toiletries are also provided. Continental and Italian breakfast options are available each morning. Guests can relax on the sun terrace. The 24-hour front desk offers multilingual staff speaking English, Italian, and Albanian. Villa Panza is 21 miles from the motel, while Centro Commerciale Arese is 22 miles away. Milan Malpensa Airport is 1. 9 miles from the property, and a paid airport shuttle service is available.

205955.description: Enjoy garden views at Hotel Paradiso, centrally located in Milan, a short walk from Corso Buenos Aires and Porta Venezia. The hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and a bar/lounge for evening relaxation. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies). Each of the 17 guestrooms features a flat-screen TV, private bathroom with shower, complimentary toiletries, and bidet. Daily housekeeping and ironing facilities are available. The hotel also provides a 24-hour front desk and multilingual staff. Conveniently located near Piazza della Repubblica and Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, Hotel Paradiso offers easy access to Milan's attractions.

205986.address: Kadirga Limani Cd. Katip Sinan Sk. Sultanahmet, 27
205986.description:
Fist of all, The Asparagus has very good location. If you walk for five minutes, you can find yourself in front of The Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia. There is smart lock at the main door and your room door so you can check-in as you want to your room. There is 100 mbps Fiber Internet. Asparagus first goal is happiness of guests. It offers free Wi-Fi and air-conditioned rooms with a satellite TV and minibar.
All rooms at Asparagus Hotel come with modern furnishings. A private bathroom with hairdryer is standart. There are also many restaurants, cafes and bars that serve local and international dishes.
Airport shuttle service can be provided at a surcharge. The hotel staff can help you organise your trip.
Only a 10-minute walk to Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace, Asparagus Hotel is 700 metres to the Sultanahmet Tram Stop, which allows easy access to Taksim Square.

206008.description: Located in the heart of Venice's Santa Croce district, Casa Mimma offers easy access to Santa Lucia train station and Piazzale Roma. Explore the city's wonders on foot or by vaporetto (Riva De Biasio stop is nearby). All rooms feature air conditioning and free Wi-Fi, while some have shared bathrooms. Please inform us of your expected arrival time as there's no 24-hour reception. Cash payments only.

206014.description: Enjoy a central Milan stay at Hotel Atena, located within a 10-minute walk of Porta Venezia and Corso Buenos Aires. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a bar/lounge, and room service during limited hours. The 12 guestrooms feature LCD televisions, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, desks, and daily housekeeping. Nearby attractions include the Via Montenapoleone Fashion District (0. 5 mi) and Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II (1 mi). The closest airport is Linate (LIN), approximately 4 miles away.

206020.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This hotel also features concierge services and a banquet hall. Enjoy Italian cuisine at Bistro 'A di Alice', one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Monza? This hotel has 2153 square feet (200 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 3 meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite.

206036.address: Valikonagi Caddesi Suleyman Nazif Sokak Nisantasi, 10
206036.description: Don't miss out on recreational opportunities including a sauna and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services, gift shops/newsstands, and a television in a common area. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Grab a bite from the grocery/convenience store serving guests of Gallery Residence & Hotel. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, limo/town car service, and a computer station. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Stay in one of 26 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wired internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

206037.description: The Berce Hotel, a brand-new boutique hotel in the heart of Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, offers the amenities of a five-star hotel. Located on a quiet street, it's just a five-minute walk from iconic landmarks like the Blue Mosque, Hippodrome, and Hagia Sophia. The hotel features seven uniquely decorated rooms, four with balconies, designed for comfort. Experience the charm of Istanbul from this prime location, where the sounds of the city blend with the tranquility of your surroundings. Apartments and studio rooms are located in an annex building.

206049.description:
Hotel Pavone is located in the heart of Milan, a 10 minutes walking distance from the Duomo, in front of the courthouse and near the conservatory and the Policlinico. The nearest metro station is San Babila, located 10 minutes walking distance. The renovated and expanded hotel offers rooms with private bathroom, hairdryer, air conditioning, soundproof windows, direct telephone and safe box. It has a TV room. It offers 24-hour reception, bar, internet point, free Wi-Fi and fax service reception. 
Breakfast will be served in a bar adjacent to the hotel. Breakfast will be Italian style and will include sweet and salty food as well as juice, hot drink and water.

206053.address: Sehit Muhtar Mah Cevza Sok No2Beyoglu
206053.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Element Suites, located in the heart of Istanbul, just a short walk from Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue. This aparthotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, a self-serve breakfast for a fee, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge). Each of the 14 guestrooms features a kitchenette, LCD TV with satellite programming, a safe, and a minibar. Housekeeping is provided daily. Nearby attractions include Galata Tower (2 km) and the Bosphorus (3. 1 km).

206068.description: Located in Istanbul's celebrated and upscale shopping neighborhood in Nisantasi, Jazz Hotel Nisantasi is within walking distance to the City's Shopping Mall where luxurious brands are. The property pays homage to the legacy of jazz with a concept and modern decoration inspired by jazz music. Each room has a flat-screen TV with multilingual satellite channels. It is less than 5 minutes’ walk from Osmanbey Metro station. Each room is named and decorated after a famous jazz artist and features individual music broadcast of the corresponding artist’s music 24 hours a day. Rooms offer air conditioning, an LCD TV and a DVD player. They also have a work desk, all-in-one printer, laptop safe, mini-bar and an electric kettle. Some room also have walk-in closets. The attentive staff, available 24 hours a day, can recommend nearby attractions and organize tours to local sites. The hotel also provides car rentals and ticket assistance services. Many luxury shopping malls such as Cevahir, Zorlu, Kanyon, Metro City and Istinye Park can be reached by metro. Lutfi Kirdar Convention Center is 1476 feet from the property. Taksim is only one metro stop away or a 10-minute drive away. Istanbul Airport is within 34 mi.

206076.description: Hotel Panizza offers free Wi-Fi and buffet breakfast. It is close to Milan's Church of Santa Maria delle Grazie, hosting the world-famous Last Supper fresco by Leonardo da Vinci. All rooms of the Panizza are rustic and functional, with free WiFi and decorated ceilings and wooden floors. Each room comes with a private bathroom, air conditioning, and a 22-inch flat-screen TV with pay-per-view and satellite channels. The hotel is 984 feet from Milan's Porta Magenta and the Conciliazione Metro Station. The Cathedral is 3 metro stops away. Guests can park in a 24-hour garage located 492 feet away. The Area Expo Exhibition Center is 6. 2 mi from the property. The hotel is located in a residential building. Reception is on the second floor, which is reached by the elevator.

206093.description: Hotel Locanda Canal occupies a prestigious 13th-century palace, a 5-minute walk from St. Mark's Square and 2 minutes from the Riva degli Schiavoni. A leisurely 10-minute stroll through charming Venetian streets leads to the Rialto Bridge. The hotel offers a bright, welcoming breakfast room and guest rooms equipped with modern amenities, including private bathrooms, hairdryers, satellite TV, safes, telephones, air conditioning, heating, and Wi-Fi.

206096.description: Nestled in the heart of Istanbul's Old City, Sultan's Inn is just a short walk from Sultanahmet's main attractions. Our comfortable rooms feature beautiful decor, including colorful suzanis adorning four-poster beds. Despite our central location, we offer a tranquil escape, ensuring restful days and nights. Experience authentic Turkish hospitality with our 24-hour knowledgeable staff, ready to assist with tours, travel arrangements, and personalized recommendations for sightseeing, dining, and navigating Istanbul.

206097.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Guests may use a train station pick-up service for a surcharge, and limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 14 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

206111.address: Talatpasa Cad Bacadibi sok no 3 Gultepe Levent, 3
206111.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include shopping on site and a television in a common area. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Levent Restaurant, a restaurant which specializes in Turkish cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 51 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and slippers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Airport (SAW) - 49. 5 km / 30. 8 mi The preferred airport for Levent Hotel Istanbul is Istanbul Airport (IST).

206114.description: Located in the Dorsoduro district of Venice, Avogaria 5 Rooms is a charming townhouse accommodation within a 15-minute walk of iconic landmarks such as St. Mark's Square and the Grand Canal. This intimate property offers five well-appointed guestrooms featuring minibars, Select Comfort beds, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Guests can enjoy room service during limited hours and a full breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. For those arriving by air, Marco Polo Airport (VCE) is approximately 16. 3 km (10. 2 mi) from the property.

206116.description: Facing the beachfront, SALUS SMART CHIC HOTEL offers 4-star accommodation in Lido di Jesolo and has an outdoor swimming pool, a private beach area and a bar. Free WiFi is available and private parking can be arranged at an extra charge. The hotel provides guests with air-conditioned rooms offering a desk, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV, a balcony and a private bathroom. The accommodation offers a buffet or continental breakfast. Included in all reservations is a sun umbrella and two beach beds, either on the private beach or by the pool. Guests will be assigned their station upon arrival. Aquafollie Waterpark is 31 km from SALUS SMART CHIC HOTEL, while Duomo Caorle is 31 km from the property. The nearest airport is Venice Marco Polo Airport, 35 km from the hotel.

206141.address: Alemdar Mah. Zeynep Sultan Camii Sok., 13
206141.description: Centrally located in Sultanahmet, this hotel is a 2-minute walk from the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and Basilica Cistern. The hotel offers elegantly designed rooms with air conditioning and free Wi-Fi. The rooms at the Modern Sultan Hotel are individually decorated and appointed with warm décor. Each room has a private bathroom with amenities. Some rooms feature beautiful views of Hagia Sofia. The Modern Hotel serves a rich breakfast prepared with seasonal organic ingredients in the cosy salon. The hotel offers a 24-hour front desk with the helpful staff. Room service is also available for 24 hours. The on-site tour desk provides local information. There are 2 tram stops within a 5-minute walk from Modern Sultan, allowing guests to easily access other parts of Istanbul. Car rental service is also available.

206160.address: Mimar Kemalettin Mh Kurkcu Basi Sk No5
206160.description: Sembol Hotel is located in the old part of İstanbul town.The hotel is 5 minutes walk from Grand Bazaar,400 meters from the Blue Mosque,Hagia Sophia and 500 meters away from Topkapi Palace . The Basilica Cistern, Galata Bridge, Traditional Kumkapı's Fish Restaurants and Turkish Baths. Also lots of business and shopping areas, designer shops, traditional restaurants are all nearby. The area offers easy access to public transportation across the whole city. The spacious modern and comfortable guest rooms,including LCD Tvs and satellite Tv, air-conditioned , with free Wi-Fi. It offers a buffet breakfast serving Turkish delicacies, laundry facilities and a tour desk. The staff can assist with car rentals and also arranges city wide tours and outings to popular attractions.

206203.address: Kucukayasofya Mah Sehit Mehmet Pasa Sok, 22
206203.description: The Sultanahmet Cesme Hotel offers traditional Turkish hospitality with modern amenities in the heart of Istanbul's old city. Surrounded by historic buildings and monuments, the Cesme hotel is conveniently located within walking distance of the city's most popular attractions, the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, the Hagia Sophia, and the Grand Bazaar. In addition, the location offers many restaurants, cafés, and shops right outside our doors. The hotel, newly constructed in 2010, was designed for the comfort and convenience of our guests. An extensive complimentary breakfast is served each morning on our covered terrace. In the warmer seasons, guests can enjoy relaxing over drinks on our rooftop terrace overlooking breathtaking views of the ancient city and the Marmara Sea.

206204.address: Hocapasa Mah Nobetha Sokak No19 Sirkeci Is, 11-13
206204.description: Hurriyet Hotel it is within walking distance of many of the major attractions like Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Archaeology Museum, Topkapı Palace, Church of ST. Irene, Sultan Ahmet Square The Cisterns, Museum of Turkish and Islamıc Art, Grand Bazaar, Spice Market.Hürriyet Hotel is located in the heart of the Old City, Sirkeci of Istanbul. Eminönü seaports, Sirkeci Railway station, train station. While you drinking a coffee or drinks without alcohol and relaxing in our loby , your registration process will be finished in a short time. You will see the Turkish Hospitality while you stay in our hotel.

206213.description: With a stay at Girasole High Quality Inn (Villa San Giovanni), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of University of Milano-Bicocca and Teatro degli Arcimboldi. This property is 3. 8 mi (6 km) from San Raffaele Hospital and 4. 4 mi (7. 1 km) from Corso Como. Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and gift shops/newsstands. Additional amenities at this property include tour/ticket assistance and a reception hall. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Milan? This property has facilities measuring 269 square feet (25 square meters), including a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the property's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Stay in one of 15 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

206216.description: We started our tourism and hotel management activity in 2005 and our studies and efforts are still continuing to be on the front all the time. With comfort, luxury as well as cheerful personnel of our Grand Mark Hotel, we proudly offer our customers the required service. Suits and rooms designed and created with special architecture, today's decoration concept, comfort and amenities of guests and modern technological developments.

206230.description: Welcome to the open air museum in Istanbul. Located in Sultanahmet Istanbul, we provide comfortable contemporary accommodation close to Sultanahmet Square together with splendid view of the Marmara Sea. First time to Istanbul ? We are very well aware of that you will be visiting Hagia Sophia Museum, Blue Mosque (Sultanahmet Palace), Topkapi Palace, Underground Cistern, Spice Bazaar, Grand Bazaar during the day. Although they all are located nearby within walking distance, it would be nice to relax once you are off the day in your room overlooking the splendid view of Marmara Sea. Enjoy !! The hotel features private ensuite rooms. Some rooms look over The Sea of Marmara and the others over a nice and quiet street.

206246.address: Oldcity Kaleici Kilincarslan Mah Hesapci Sok No60
206246.description: Located in Antalya's city center, Sabah Pansiyon is a charming guesthouse within a 10-minute walk of Hadrian's Gate and Antalya Clock Tower. Enjoy a meal at the onsite restaurant, unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge, or grab a snack at the coffee shop/cafe. A complimentary local cuisine breakfast is served daily. The guesthouse also features an outdoor pool, a garden, complimentary Wi-Fi, and tour/ticket assistance. Each of the 13 guestrooms offers a minibar and a pillowtop bed. Free self-parking and an area shuttle (surcharge) are also available. Nearby attractions include the Old Bazaar (1. 1 km) and Konyaalti Beach (5 km). Antalya Intl. Airport (AYT) is 16. 5 km away.

206247.description: Situated in the heart of Milan, Hotel Fiorella seamlessly blends traditional Italian hospitality with meticulous service. Our dedicated 24-hour staff provides professional and courteous assistance, from front desk and coffee-bar service to fulfilling all your travel needs. The warm and comfortable atmosphere embodies the best of Italian style. Guests can take advantage of our secure parking garage and a competitively priced luxury taxi-limo service to and from Milan's international airports (Linate, Malpensa, and Orio al Serio).

206253.address: Hoca Pasa Mh. Ibni Kemal Cd., 16
206253.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 34 guestrooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Your Select Comfort bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. This hotel is 0. 5 mi (0. 9 km) from Grand Bazaar and 0. 6 mi (0. 9 km) from Hagia Sophia.

206434.description: This charming hotel boasts a prime location in Bollate, directly across from the historic Villa Arconati and just 4 km from the Rho-Pero exhibition center. A convenient 30-minute drive from Milan, the hotel offers easy access to numerous attractions. The bright exterior hints at the comfort and convenience within, where luxuriously appointed guest rooms exude splendor and elegance. Modern amenities cater to both business and leisure travelers, ensuring a truly enjoyable stay.

206447.description: This guest house was completely renovated in 2007. It is conveniently located on a 5-minute walk from Jamaâ El Fna Square, a 20-minute drive from Menara Airport and Marrakech Train Station is 10 minutes away by car. This cozy hotel offers a dining room, an indoor swimming pool and a safe. There is a currency exchange and on-site car park on the premises. Guests' are offered a total of 5 rooms - 3 elegant double rooms and 2 suites for special occasions. All rooms are air-conditioned with an en-suite bathroom with a hairdryer, sitting area with TV and minibar. Those staying in the suite can benefit from more space and a fireplace. A continental breakfast is served every morning in the dining room. Moroccan specialties can be taken for lunch and dinner on the terrace or on the patio.

206488.description: Enjoy stunning garden views at Resitalya Hotel, a beachfront property in Alanya's Güller Pınarı neighborhood. The hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, babysitting services (surcharge), a hair salon, and tour/ticket assistance. Savor international cuisine at Cesar Restaurant and Bar, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Daily breakfast is available (fee applies). Amenities include complimentary wired internet, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and airport shuttle (surcharge). Free self-parking is also available. The 29 air-conditioned guestrooms provide cable TV and wired/wireless internet (surcharge). Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Resitalya Hotel is conveniently located within a 10-minute drive of Alanya Aquapark and Alanya Castle, 2. 1 miles from Kleopatra Beach, and 0. 6 miles from Alanya State Hospital.

206513.description: Located in one of Lima’s most vibrant and touristic districts, Dazzler by Wyndham Lima Miraflores is the perfect choice for travelers seeking comfort, style, and an unbeatable location. This modern 4-star hotel blends contemporary design with warm, professional service—ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Just steps away from the Miraflores boardwalk, where you can enjoy stunning views of the Pacific Ocean, and a short walk from the iconic Kennedy Park, the hotel is surrounded by a wide variety of cafés, restaurants, shops, art galleries, and nightlife. Its proximity to major attractions such as the Love Park, Larcomar Shopping Center, the beaches of the Costa Verde, and the ancient Huaca Pucllana archaeological site makes it the perfect starting point to explore the city. Our spacious, light-filled rooms are designed for maximum comfort and feature King or Twin beds, a work desk, minibar, air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a smart TV. The hotel also offers a rooftop outdoor pool with panoramic views, a fully equipped fitness center, complimentary buffet breakfast, parking, and meeting rooms for corporate events. Whether you're in Lima for business, sightseeing, or a romantic getaway, Dazzler by Wyndham Lima Miraflores invites you to enjoy an unforgettable experience in the city’s most cosmopolitan district.

206515.description: Experience the best of Bogota. Located just 15 minutes from El Dorado International Airport, and near event and business centers, this hotel offers high-quality hospitality in a prime location. We're situated five blocks from the US Embassy and half a block from Corferias International Business and Exhibition Center. Savor Colombian cuisine at our inviting restaurant, a warm and welcoming space offering exquisite national and international dishes.

206529.description: This property is 2 minutes walk from the beach. This hotel is located in the coastal district of Kemer, offering a private area at the sandy beach only 100 m away. Facilities include an on-site fitness centre, hammam and an outdoor pool with a water slide. Accommodation is provided by air-conditioned rooms with satellite TV at Blauhimmel Hotel. Some rooms also include a private balcony with views of the outdoor pool and the Mediterranean Sea. The restaurant offers à la carte and buffet service with a variety of delicious dishes. Guests can enjoy unique tastes of Turkish cuisine and international cuisine. Kemer town centre is just 7 km from Hotel Blauhimmel. Antalya Airport is 65 km away. Camyuva is a great choice for travellers interested in nature, beaches and clean air.

206530.description: The total number of guest rooms is 120. Belpoint Beach-Deactive-Dublicate id1089228 offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night.

206571.description: Centrally located in Milan, Hotel Central Station offers convenient access to Corso Buenos Aires and Corso Como, both within a 5-minute drive. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, a snack bar/deli, and a bar/lounge. Local cuisine breakfasts are available daily for a fee. The 18 guestrooms feature digital programming, partially open bathrooms with showers, and complimentary toiletries. Amenities include express check-in/check-out, a 24-hour front desk, and on-site self-parking (for a fee). Nearby attractions include Piazza del Duomo (3. 4 km) and the Cathedral of Milan (4. 8 km).

206578.description: This two-story smoke-free hotel offers 25 guestrooms with wheelchair access. Enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM and dine at the onsite restaurant for lunch or dinner. Room service is also available during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, safes, and desks. The hotel also provides express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, multilingual staff, and a complimentary airport shuttle (available on request). Nearby attractions include AMSC - Acquavillage Gallarate (1. 4 mi), Castle Visconti San Vito (1. 7 mi), and Basilica di Saint Agnese (2 mi). The nearest airport is Milan Malpensa Airport (MXP), 6. 2 miles away.

206588.description: The Hotel New Salus is located in a northern suburb of Milan, just 200 meters from the Affori Centro Metro Station on the yellow line. Rooms are on the first floor, most with private bathrooms. These spacious rooms feature LCD TVs, cooling fans, and central heating. Free Wi-Fi is available in every room. The New Salus is a 15-minute metro ride from Milano Centrale Train Station and offers a 24-hour reception. Conveniently located near the Arciboldi and La Scala theaters, the hotel also offers easy access to San Siro Stadium and the Milan Trade Fair.

206622.description: Casa Pisani Canal is a small property located in the center of Venice, in the Cannaregio district. The Rialto Bridge and San Marco Square are 500 meters from the property. The property offers free WiFi internet access and a staff at your disposal to provide assistance and information about the city of Venice. Its rooms, all elegantly furnished and equipped with modern amenities, offer a private bathroom with hairdryer, air conditioning and heating, satellite TV, telephone, safe and minibar.

206624.description: Enjoy a relaxing soak in the spa tub at Residence Palazzo Odoni, centrally located in Venice, just a short walk from Piazzale Roma and the Grand Canal. This residence offers complimentary Wi-Fi and wedding services. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Each of the four individually decorated guestrooms features a kitchenette equipped with a refrigerator and stovetop, along with complimentary wired and wireless internet access and an LCD TV with satellite programming. The private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, jetted bathtubs, and complimentary toiletries. A computer station, express check-out, and luggage storage are also available for guest convenience. The residence is conveniently located near several attractions including Campo Santa Margherita, Scuola Grande di San Rocco and Basilica di Santa Maria Gloriosa dei Frari. The nearest major airport is Marco Polo Airport (VCE).

206626.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this Beaux Arts hotel include concierge services, a television in a common area, and a banquet hall. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and express check-out. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 22 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. This affittacamere is 5. 4 mi (8. 8 km) from Port of Venice and 5. 9 mi (9. 5 km) from Grand Canal.

206658.description: The Lion Morosini Palace overlooks Venice's charming Remer Campiello, a typical Venetian court on the Grand Canal. Ideally situated in the historic center, near the Rialto Bridge, it provides the perfect base for exploring iconic Venetian landmarks such as the Cà d'Oro, the Jewish Ghetto, and Saint Mark's Square, all within easy walking distance. Rooms are equipped with modern comforts including air conditioning, heating, free Wi-Fi, a safe, LCD/plasma flat-screen TV, a hairdryer, bath products, a telephone, and a baby cot upon request. Breakfast is available for a small additional fee, payable directly to the hotel.

206660.description:
L'Affittacamere Di Venezia offers air-conditioned rooms with digital TV in the heart of Mestre. It is located 50 metres from a bus stop, which links to central Venice in 15 minutes.

Rooms at L'Affittacamere Di Venezia have a minibar, digital TV and safe. Breakfast is served in a bar nearby during the week. Over the weekend you will find breakfast items in your room.

Staff can advise on excursions in the local area and organise boat tours of the Venice Lagoon

206672.description: Hotel Ariosto is set in a Liberty-style building in the heart of the elegant Magenta district, between the Duomo Cathedral and the fairgrounds. The Ariosto is also close to Leonardo da Vinci's Last Supper and Line 1 underground 'Conciliazione' stop. Shuttle Malpensa Express (Cadorna Station) is just 1 stop away. This completely renovated 4-star establishment offers an old-fashioned atmosphere. Charming and attractive, the Ariosto Hotel was recently decorated with the contribution of important Italian contemporary painters. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms and common areas. The rooms, which overlook either the quiet inner garden or the floral facades of the art nouveau palaces on Via Ariosto, are stylish, comfortable and come with natural wood floors and furniture. Some rooms are equipped with sauna or spa bath.

206677.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This hotel also features concierge services and a television in a common area. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 28 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. 206710.description: The hotel, an early 20th century villa and former residence of Count Caproni, is located in the peaceful and quiet village of Vizzola Ticino, just 800 meters from Milan Malpensa Airport, ideal for those who wish to reach the airport in a few minutes. Thanks to its location, the hotel is strategically off the air routes and ensures its guests a peaceful stay, surrounded by greenery and far from noise pollution. Surrounded by a lovely park that serves as a setting one can spend days or small moments of relaxation. This hotel has well-equipped rooms with all modern amenities. Some rooms overlook the Ticino valley and the quaint village of Vizzola Ticino, and from the upper rooms you can admire Monte Rosa. The hotel also has a shuttle service for a fee, from 5 a. m. to midnight.

206712.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Monza? This hotel has 100 square feet (9 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 48 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature bidets and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Monza Park - 1. 5 km / 0.

206739.description: In the heart of Marrakech's historic center, just a short walk from Jemaa el-Fna square and the Koutoubia Mosque, Riad M'Boja offers modern comforts blended with Eastern tradition. This charming riad, a haven of peace, is ideally located in the Medina for exploring the souks and historic palaces of Marrakech. The terraces provide exceptional views of the Koutoubia, the Medina, and the Atlas Mountains. A heated pool and hot tub offer relaxation and well-being. Situated on a quiet street, 200 meters from the Bab Doukkala taxi stand, Riad M'Boja is an ideal starting point for exploring the city.

206744.address: Derb El Fath Hay Essalam Area
206744.description:
A unique experience for an unique place ... Because Marrakech is a great city , as we have to do our riad a place at the height of the red city that hosts us.
Let yourself fall under the spell of Dar Crystal, a subtle blend of tradition and modernity , combining minimalist design , natural and pure authenticity of Moroccan craftsmanship .
Time has stopped at Dar Crystal . Taste the sweetness of oriental life relaxing around a mint tea or a fresh fruit cocktail in one of our small outdoor seating on the patio or poolside.
You are also invited to calm and relaxation : solarium, steam room and massage will help you relax and your body to regain its vitality.
Indulge with confidence by our guest table you will discover a simple kitchen, combines trend and tradition while respecting the seasonal dishes.
A place both magical and typical , extremely easy access to the gates of the Medina, just minutes from downtown , the Place Jamaa El Fna and the souks , 10 minutes from golf courses and 20 minutes from the airport.

206752.description: Riad Aderbaz A warm welcome awaits you at the small, 2x000D star Riad Aderbaz in Marrakech. Hotel guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant on site. Rooms at the Riad Aderbaz. Smoking is permitted in both the bedrooms and the public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking. Leisure Info. The Riad Aderbaz offers a range of leisure facilities. An outdoor swimming pool is available for hotel guests.

206754.description: Located in Marrakech, Riad Hadika Maria offers 3-star accommodations with an on-site restaurant. Each room includes a hairdryer. Smoking is permitted in designated rooms and public areas; please specify your preference when booking. Guests can enjoy leisure activities such as swimming in the outdoor pool. The hotel also provides an airport shuttle, concierge service, and welcomes pets.

206756.description: Situated in the centre of the Medina, this small charming Riad is close to the Bahia palace, only 6 minutes from the Jamaâ El Fna Square. The Riad El Grably has everything to make your stay comfortable and memorable. The air-conditioned guestrooms are decorated in typical Moroccan style and are equipped with a modern en suite facilities. To relax, the Grably offers 2 patios, a swimming pool (heated during school holidays), a garden, a fountain, tables and deckchairs where you can read a book or enjoy the sunshine. There is also a roof terrace with a hot tub giving magnificent views of the Medina which helps make the Riad El Grably unforgettable for its comfort and tranquillity.

206763.address: Riad Zitoune Jdid Derb Tlitli N15
206763.description: Nestled in the heart of Marrakech's medina, Riad Attika offers a tranquil escape just moments from the vibrant Jemaa El Fna square and the Dar Si Said Museum. This traditional riad features five renovated bedrooms, including one on the rooftop terrace. After exploring the bustling souks or venturing into the Atlas Mountains, guests can unwind in the terrace's hydro-massage basin. With its blend of traditional architecture and modern comforts, Riad Attika provides a haven for couples, friends, and families seeking an authentic Moroccan experience.

206765.description: Riad Lorsya, a meticulously renovated guesthouse, is ideally located near Jemaa el-Fna square in the heart of Marrakech's antique souks. This authentic Moroccan riad offers a comfortable and traditional experience. Our dedicated team provides exceptional service, ensuring a tranquil and relaxing stay. We can also arrange airport transfers, excursions, and city tours.

206777.address: Diour Jdad Zaouia Sidi Bel Abbes
206777.description: Riad Dar Nimbus A warm welcome awaits you at the small, 3x000D star Riad Dar Nimbus in Marrakech. The hotel offers off site car parking. Guests can enjoy a meal at the hotel restaurant. Room Facilities Riad Dar Nimbus. Smoking is permitted in both the bedrooms and the public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms. Leisure Info. Leisure facilities are available at the Riad Dar Nimbus. Relax in the luxurious hotel sauna. An outdoor swimming pool is available for hotel guests. Other Info. The hotel offers an airport shuttle service. The hotel is pet friendly. A concierge service is provided for guests.

206785.description:
It is in the district of Moukef in the Medina of Marrakech, 5 minutes from the Ben Youssef Madrasa and the Museum of Marrakech, in the heart of the neighborhood remained popular as you discover the Riad Azenzer, charming riad with pool Marrakech. 

You will be seduced by its simple architecture and warm ambiance that evokes the Kasbah Moroccan riads South. You will taste the sweetness of life in Eastern admiring the snow-capped Atlas Mountains from the terrace or soaking your feet in the pool, rare charm in a riad in Marrakech. 

Starting with the discovery of Marrakech, the Red City, you will, at the door of the riad medina crossed, bathed in the Moroccan culture that makes us dream. 

Let yourself be carried away by the charm of Marrakech and its so special atmosphere ...

206806.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the charming, 4-star Riad Tchina in Marrakech. Enjoy delicious meals at our on-site restaurant. Smoking is not permitted in designated bedrooms and public areas. Take a refreshing dip in our outdoor swimming pool. Additional amenities include an airport shuttle service and a concierge. Well-behaved pets are also welcome.

206808.description: The 4-star Kasbah Al Mendili Private Resort & Spa offers a luxurious escape in Marrakech. Guests can enjoy on-site dining, Wi-Fi, meeting facilities, and a range of spa treatments including beauty, massage, and sauna access. The hotel also features an outdoor swimming pool, airport shuttle, and concierge service. Pets are welcome, and accessible facilities are available for guests with disabilities. Smoking is permitted in designated rooms and public areas (please specify when booking). All rooms offer Wi-Fi.

206811.description:
Located in the heart of the medina of Marrakech, 300 m from the mythical Jemaa el Fna, Marrakech Riad Hermes is a charming riad in Marrakesh. Contemporary in style, our riad Marrakech opens its halls, its six rooms and junior suites, panoramic terrace with swimming pool and steam room, as well as its tour services and body treatments with massage.
It is in an atmosphere worthy of the Thousand and One Nights that you will make your stay at Riad Hermes unforgettable.

206813.description: Riad Adika Guests checking into the luxury, 4x000D star Riad Adika in Marrakech are assured of a warm welcome. The hotel offers off site car parking. The hotel offers restaurant facilities. Business users are catered for with wifi and meeting facilities available at the Riad Adika. Rooms at the Riad Adika. All rooms have a hairdryer. Smoking in certain bedrooms is allowed, as well as in public areas of the hotel. Please specify when making your booking. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms. All rooms feature a stocked minibar. Leisure Info. Leisure facilities are available at the Riad Adika. A luxurious range of spa treatments including beauty, massage and sauna is available. Guests can relax in the hotels indoor swimming pool. Outdoor leisure activities available include mountain biking with our mountain bike hire and quad biking. Other Info. An airport shuttle service is available from the hotel. Pet owners and their well behaved pets are welcome at the hotel. A concierge service is available to guests. The hotel has disabled facilities with wheelchair access to the hotel, reception, restaurant, bar and disabled car parking spaces areas of the hotel.

206814.address: Arset Ihiri Derb El Bomba 149, Bab Dokkala
206814.description: A 12-minute walk from the famed Jemaa El Fna square, Riad Mahjouba offers a luxurious guest house experience. Discover our hammam and spa treatments, designed to enhance your relaxation. Each room features authentic Moroccan decor, air-conditioning, and free Wi-Fi. The traditional lounge, with its inviting fireplace and dining area, opens onto a charming patio, providing a comfortable and intimate setting. We can also arrange excursions to regional attractions, including the Ourika Valley, the desert, Ouarzazate, and Essaouira.

206821.description:
Welcome to Riad Saba Guest House in Marrakech. Riad Saba welcomes you to two beautifully restored 18th–19th century riads in the heart of Marrakech’s medina. We offer 13 rooms, two patios, a swimming pool, and two large terraces, including one with a 360° panoramic view over the rooftops, the Atlas Mountains, and the sunrise and sunset. 
Located in a quiet alley, we are a 7-minute walk from Jemaa el-Fnaa and the Bahia Palace, 5 minutes from the souks, and close to the main tourist sites. Several private parking lots are just a few meters away. Marrakech Menara Airport is about 20 minutes (5 miles) away. Our dedicated team is available to advise you and assist in organizing excursions and city visits.

206828.address: N°8 Derb Sidi Bensaid Riad Larous
206828.description: Located in Marrakech, the luxurious 4-star Riad Arbre Bleu offers an on-site restaurant for guests' dining pleasure. Each room is equipped with a hairdryer, iron, and ironing board, along with tea and coffee making facilities and Wi-Fi access. Smoking is permitted in designated rooms and public areas (please specify when booking). Guests can enjoy the indoor swimming pool and other leisure amenities. Additional services include an airport shuttle and a concierge. Pets are welcome.

206830.description:
On the walls of the medina, of easy access, the riad "Whites Laurels" is located in an authentic district of Bab Doukala, famous for its walking colors. 
Laurels Blncs offer 7 spacious rooms overlooking the patio (covered and heated in winter) with a large hot tub heater or whisper a fountain. 
You will also enjoy the solarium terrace not overlooked, with barbecue, the cozy lounge with fireplace.

206841.description: Riad Ta'achchaqa A warm welcome awaits you at the small, 3x000D star rated Riad Ta'achchaqa in Marrakech. Off site car parking is available. Dining is available at the hotel, which has it's own restaurant. Rooms at the Riad Ta'achchaqa. Smoking in certain bedrooms is allowed, as well as in public areas of the hotel. Please specify when making your booking. Rooms have wireless internet access available. Leisure Info. The Riad Ta'achchaqa offers a range of leisure facilities. A luxurious range of spa treatments including beauty, massage and sauna is available. Other Info. The hotel offers an airport shuttle service. Pets are welcome at the hotel. A concierge service is available to guests.

206842.description: Experience a warm welcome at the charming, 3-star Dar Touyir in Marrakech. While onsite parking isn't available, offsite parking is provided. Savor delicious meals at the hotel restaurant. Some rooms and public areas permit smoking; please specify your preference when booking. The hotel also offers an airport shuttle and concierge service, and welcomes pets.

206843.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an indoor pool and a steam room. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 8:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 5 individually decorated guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected.

206844.address: Km 20 Route De Lourika Caidat Ghmat Bour Bp 45
206844.description:
Located in Sidi Abdallah Ghiat, O'Atlas is in a rural location, within a 15-minute drive of Aqua Fun Club and Anima Garden.  This 4-star hotel is 9.8 mi (15.7 km) from Avenue Mohamed VI and 10.8 mi (17.4 km) from Agdal Gardens.
Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a health club, an outdoor pool, and a steam room. This hotel also features complimentary wireless Internet access, gift shops/newsstands, and a hair salon.
Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, a library, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.
At O'Atlas, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary full breakfast is served on weekends from 7 AM to 10:30 AM.
Make yourself at home in one of the 20 air-conditioned rooms featuring fireplaces and LCD televisions. Satellite programming and DVD players are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include safes and separate sitting areas, and housekeeping is provided on request.

206861.description: Located in Marrakech, the 3-star Ryad Dyor offers comfortable accommodation and convenient amenities. While onsite parking isn't available, offsite parking is provided. Guests can enjoy dining at the hotel restaurant. Each room includes a hairdryer, tea and coffee making facilities, and a minibar. Smoking is permitted in designated rooms and public areas (please specify when booking). The Ryad Dyor features an indoor swimming pool for guests' relaxation. Additional services include an airport shuttle and a concierge. Pets are welcome.

206868.description: At the heart of the historic and cultural center of Marrakech, 5 minutes from the Jemaa el Fna, you will discover the charm of Riad Dar Asam blend of oriental traditions and modernity for a quality stay. Calm, serenity and comfort, we are at your disposal to make your stay a delightful moment.

206869.description: After a long day exploring the vibrant medina and bustling souks, unwind in the tranquil atmosphere of Ryad BOUSSA. Just steps from Jemaa El Fna square, nestled in a peaceful alleyway, discover the relaxing retreat you seek. Enjoy the cool patio in the summer and cozy up by the fireplace in the winter. Comfortable lounges, a shady terrace, and inviting bedrooms create the ideal setting for a memorable stay. Experience traditional Moroccan cuisine, a soothing hammam, rejuvenating massages, and more. Immerse yourself in the magic of Marrakesh and savor the true Moroccan lifestyle at Ryad BOUSSA. Welcome.

206870.address: 100, Derb Jamaa Place Jema El Fna Derb Dabachi, 100
206870.description: Riad Granvilier offers the peace and quiet of a traditional Moroccan neighborhood. Accessed via a side street, Derb Jamaa (street from the mosque), it's located in the heart of the medina, just a two-minute walk from the famous Jemaa El Fna marketplace. Derb Dabachi, bustling day and night, is one of Marrakech's most attractive streets. Here, you'll find numerous artisans, small shops, and street vendors, all embodying the renowned kindness of Marrakech's residents.

206878.description: Welcome to Riad Abaka, a traditional Moroccan house centered around a charming courtyard fountain. The main house encircles the patio, bordered by elegant columns. A few steps further, discover a second patio featuring a refreshing dipping pool, offering guests a spacious and comfortable environment. Each of the seven rooms, spread over two levels, showcases traditional Moroccan décor and unique charm. During your stay, enjoy a variety of communal spaces, including multiple living rooms, the poolside patio, a cozy chimney corner, a Berber tent with traditional Moroccan décor, and two terraces, including a solarium. These diverse surroundings provide ample opportunities to relax and socialize.

206893.description: Welcome to the 3-star Riad Sesame in Marrakech. This charming riad offers a restaurant and convenient airport shuttle service. Rooms feature wireless internet access, and select rooms permit smoking. Pets are welcome. A concierge is available to assist you during your stay. Please specify smoking preferences when booking.

206894.address: 112 Derb Sidi Moussa Riad Zitoun Jdid
206894.description: Overlooking the rooftops of the medina, Riad offers air conditioning, 2 terraces and a patio featuring an illuminated pool. It is 500 meters from Jemaa El Fna. Each suite is individually decorated in a traditional Moroccan style. All rooms have free Wi-Fi, a private bathroom and a patio or balcony. Some overlook the medina. A continental breakfast is served each morning. For other meals, you can enjoy Moroccan cuisine on the terrace. You can enjoy the rental of golf equipment proposed by Riad and join the Atlas Golf Resort in 8 minutes by car. 207679.description: The Hotel Antica Fenice is the perfect place for those looking for a welcoming, family atmosphere just a stone's throw from Venice. 208434.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Noventa Di Piave and was established in 2010. It is 35. 0 Km from the Venice and the nearest station is San Dona di Piave. 208445.description: Casa Taty The Casa Taty is a small hotel in Dolo. The hotel offers off site car parking. The hotel offers restaurant facilities. Rooms at the Casa Taty. Pets are made most welcome at the hotel. A concierge service is provided for guests.

208495.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a garden. Enjoy a meal at La Fornace or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 56 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment.

208551.description: Kssour Agafay Situated in Marrakech, the Kssour Agafay provides luxurious 5x000D star accommodation. The hotel offers restaurant facilities. Rooms at the Kssour Agafay. All rooms have a hairdryer. We are sorry, but smoking is not permitted in either the bedrooms or the public areas of the hotel. Leisure Info. An airport shuttle service is available from the hotel. Pets are welcome at the hotel. A concierge service is available to guests.

208663.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at this full-service hotel, featuring 68 air-conditioned rooms with refrigerators, flat-screen TVs, and private bathrooms. Start your day with a complimentary local cuisine breakfast, served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, or enjoy satellite programming. Indulge in a variety of amenities, including a full-service spa offering massages, body treatments, and facials, a health club, and an outdoor pool with a poolside bar. A restaurant and room service are available for dining convenience. Located near PalmGolf Marrakech (1. 6 mi), Aqua Fun Club (3. 1 mi) and La Plage Rouge Swimming Pool (3. 3 mi), with Menara Airport (RAK) being the closest airport (11 mi).

name.content: Doubletree by Hilton Milan Malpensa Solbiate Olona

208729.description: The DoubleTree by Hilton Milan Malpensa Solbiate Olona offers a bespoke family experience for children under 12, including a special welcome, dedicated breakfast, and kids' menu. Located in northern Lombardy near Malpensa Airport (MXP), the hotel provides easy access to the A8 Highway and is 25 km from Rho Fiera Milano. This contemporary hotel offers 246 guest rooms, complimentary parking and Wi-Fi, in-room coffee and tea facilities, a fitness center, and an airport shuttle. Guests can dine at the elegant Swing restaurant, which serves Italian and regional cuisine. The hotel also features a welcoming lobby bar and over 1300 square meters of modern meeting space with a courtyard. Explore nearby Varese and Milan, or enjoy a leisurely stroll at Angera Rocca, Stresa on Lake Maggiore, or Lake Como.

208730.description: Enjoy Italian cuisine at Ristorante Pizzeria Cervo, or grab a snack at the coffee shop. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi in one of the 25 guestrooms, each featuring a private bathroom with a rainfall showerhead and complimentary toiletries. Digital programming and a desk are also provided for your convenience. Free self-parking is available onsite, and the front desk is staffed during limited hours. The hotel is a short drive from Milan Malpensa Airport (MXP) and conveniently located near the Volandia Museum of Flight, Castelnovate Ruins, and Ticino Valley Nature Park.

208741.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the 3-star Hotel Ristorante Tre Leoni in Somma Lombardo, near Milan Malpensa Airport. This mid-sized hotel offers convenient on-site and off-site parking. Guests can enjoy dining at the hotel's restaurant. Business travelers benefit from Wi-Fi access and meeting facilities. All rooms feature Wi-Fi and are non-smoking, as are all public areas. The hotel also provides an airport shuttle service, concierge service, and welcomes pets. Accessible parking is available.

208770.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at Hotel Mercurio, located in Milan's Tibaldi district, a 5-minute drive from Bocconi University and the Leonardo da Vinci Museum of Science and Technology. Start your day with the complimentary buffet breakfast and unwind with drinks at the bar/lounge. The hotel offers 19 guestrooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, digital programming, and private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Additional amenities include room service (limited hours), express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. Piazza del Duomo and Milan Cathedral are 3. 1 miles (5 km) away.

208793.description: The hotel boasts a central location in Jesolo, mere steps from the sea and the vibrant main street, brimming with shops, bars, restaurants, and pizzerias. Mazzini Place is a short 500-meter stroll away, while Capannina Beach and Jesolandia Amusement Park are also easily accessible. This beachfront hotel is conveniently located near Tropicarium Park and Tourist Hall. Venice and Marco Polo Airport are both within a 30-minute radius. All rooms feature en suite facilities and a balcony. The hotel offers guests the ultimate Jesolo holiday experience, combining relaxation, shopping, and entertainment with professional service and warm hospitality.

208846.description: iQ Hotel Milano has been completely renovated in July 2019 and is just a stone's throw away from the Milan Central Station (Stazione Centrale) and subway. This brand new Hotel also features LiQuido Rooftop Bar for business meetings, aperitifs and light snacks, a Gym & Spa with a panoramic hot tub, PC corner, and a Reception open 24/7. All Rooms are equipped with the latest generation main foam mattresses and a wide pillow menu, independent air conditioning system for heating and cooling, free high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen 49' cable TVs, desk, laptop safe, free toiletries, hairdryer and a minifridge with free water replenished every day. Reception is open 24/7 with tour/ticket assistance and pick-up/drop-off service from and to any airport. iQ Hotel Milano is the ideal place for both Business and Leisure: fast and free WiFi connection through the whole building. LiQuido Rooftop Bar is ideal for light snacks, small business meetings, and cocktail aperitif with friends. If you travel by car, you may ask the reception to reserve your spot in a garage just around the corner (fees apply).

208853.description: This independent hotel is located 1 km from Milan Malpensa International Airport and offers free Wi-Fi throughout. Enjoy satellite TV with all channels unlocked and a buffet breakfast served in the restaurant from 7:00 am. The hotel provides convenient access to the Milan Rho Exhibition Centre, Lake Maggiore, golf courses, and shopping. Parking is available, and an airport shuttle bus service operates 24/7 upon request (charges apply; €5. 00 per person each way from 4:00 am to 12:00 am, and €10. 00 per person each way from 12:00 am to 4:00 am). Please call +39 0331 717045 or WhatsApp +39 392 5694699 upon arrival at either Terminal 1 or Terminal 2.

208875.description: The hotel is a boutique hotel occupying a mountain-side position by Table Mountain National Park, overlooking False Bay and the Cape Peninsula. All the uniquely-styled and beautifully decorated guest rooms and suites have luxury marble bathrooms with Victorian-style. Some units feature 4-poster beds and spacious, furnished balconies with views over False Bay, Table Mountain and the Cape Peninsula. Golf-lovers can enjoy 4 world-class golf courses in the vicinity of the Colona. The Colona Castle is just 200 metres from Marina De Gama. Guests can easily explore the nearby Stellenbosch and surrounding Winelands. Cape Town and its famous Waterfront are easily accessible by car.

208992.description: This modern Hostal is set in Gran Via street number 59, 7th floor. With a small number of only 8 rooms, this hotel is very convenient for a quiet stay. This hotel has been designed with a conscious effort to adhere to the strictest ecological standards and features the certification.

209283.description: Relax and unwind with massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an outdoor pool and a steam room. 209293.description: Located in the heart of Amsterdam, Hotel Mansion offers convenient access to Dam Square and Nemo Science Museum, both within a 15-minute walk. Nearby attractions include Nieuwmarkt Square, Chinatown, and St. Nicholas Church, all less than 0. 5 km away. Hotel Mansion is approximately 32 km from Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS).

209304.description: The three-star Hobbit Hotel Zaventem offers comfortable accommodations in Brussels. Guests can enjoy on-site dining in the hotel restaurant and convenient access to parking. All rooms feature wireless internet access and are non-smoking. The hotel also provides an airport shuttle service and welcomes pets. A concierge service is available to assist guests with their needs.

Take advantage of amenities like free hot breakfast, free WiFi, free parking, our 93-person meeting room and our business center with access to a computer, copy and fax services. 210012.description: With a stay at Landgasthof Leuen in Uitikon (Dietikon District), you'll be within a 10-minute drive of Letzigrund Stadium and Helvetia Square. 210019.description: The Grand Washington Hotel offers top-notch services and amenities for a comfortable stay. Complimentary internet access keeps you connected. Start your day with a delicious homemade breakfast. Enjoy your morning coffee at the on-site cafe. A range of dining options are available. 210077.description: The Topkapi Inter Istanbul Hotel offers 54 comfortable, air-conditioned rooms equipped with minibars, LCD TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy a variety of amenities including a nightclub, indoor pool, sauna, restaurant with 24-hour room service, and a poolside bar. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast. Located near the Fatih Mosque, Laleli Mosque, and Golden Horn, it's a convenient base for exploring Istanbul. Self-parking is free. Istanbul Airport (IST) is the preferred airport.

210147.description: Hotel Du Congres offers simply furnished rooms in the centre of Brussels, less than a 2-minute walk from Madou Metro Station and 8 minutes' walk from Royal Parc. The hotel is located in 4 restored 19th-century townhouses. The rooms at Congress have a private bathroom and a satellite TV. Each morning a continental-style buffet breakfast is served in the breakfast room. During warmer weather, guests can relax in the peaceful garden courtyard with a book or a refreshing drink. Free WiFi connection is available in the rooms and in the public areas. Brussels' Grand-Place and the Magritte Museum are both at 10 to 15-minute walk from Hotel Du Congres. Brussels Central Train Station is a only a 5-minute walk away.

210160.description: Boasting a convenient location next to Belvedere Palace and the central railway station, in Vienna, this smart, luxurious property provides easy access to some of the most important attractions in the area, such as the University of Vienna botanical gardens and the world-famous Schweitzer Garten. The city centre is just a 15-minute walk while the convention centre and the airport are just a stone's throw away if travellers' take advantage of the excellent transport connections including the underground station. It provides a wide choice of different room types to meet travellers' expectations. Those guests loving independence and freedom may prefer to stay at the trailer, located in the garden. Guests will appreciate the gift shop which sells homemade shampoo and honey produced in its own beehives.

210168.description: Located next to Vienna's main train station, just three subway stops from Stephansplatz, the innovative 4-star Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna offers numerous amenities for discerning travelers. Enjoy free Wi-Fi, supremely comfortable beds with selectable mattress firmness and TEMPUR® pillows, walk-in rain showers, and 42 LED HD TVs. Guests have complimentary access to the fitness room, sauna, and infrared cabin, as well as free bicycle rentals for exploring the city. During pleasant weather, relax in the tranquil inner courtyard's green chill & workout area, featuring mini golf, bocce ball, and a climbing frame. In the evening, savor regional delicacies at the Lokal-Café-Bar Pergola. Start your day with an extensive breakfast buffet, including organic, regional, homemade, vegan, and vegetarian options.

210242.description: Located in Amsterdam, the 4-star Hotel V Nesplein offers luxurious accommodations. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the hotel's restaurant. Additional amenities include an airport shuttle service and concierge service. Pets are welcome.

210434.description: Discover our 4-star superior hotel, a gem nestled on the shores of Lake Geneva. Our 38 modern, bright rooms, fully renovated in 2021, offer stunning lake views. Each room features a shower and bathtub, access to a garden or balcony, a minibar, tea and coffee making facilities, a TV, and a safe. Enjoy complimentary parking, and savor delicious meals at our restaurant, Le8, open to the public, with two beautiful sunny terraces overlooking the lake. Host your business seminars, banquets, or family gatherings, including weddings of up to 300 guests, in our dedicated event spaces, complete with three rooms and two terraces. During summer, unwind in our private pool, relax at the Beach Bar Lounge near the water's edge, or explore our semi-private park. Conveniently located 10 minutes from the motorway and 34 km from the airport, our hotel offers easy access to Nyon. The Nyon train station is just 2. 5 km away, and a bus stop is a mere 200 meters from the hotel. Borrow one of our complimentary bicycles during the summer and explore the scenic lakeside trails, hike the Transjurassiennen route, or cycle through the vineyards of the Coast.

210476.description: This 6-storey building lies just 100 metres from the sandy beach in Alanya, Turkey, and the picturesque harbour is 2 kilometres from the premises. Public transport runs right past the establishment and the main bus station is just 550 metres away. The 60-room hotel is attended by staff who speak fluent English. Although the beach is close, the hotel also has a seasonally open fresh-water swimming pool and a children's pool, where sunshades and sun loungers can be used free of charge. This is a fully air-conditioned and non-smoking establishment. Guests can enjoy the buffet breakfast before going out to see the sights or laze on the beach. Other facilities include a 24-hour reception desk, a lift to all floors, a laundry, dry-cleaning and ironing service. Car rental and a shuttle service to the airport 45 kilometres away are also available on request.

210478.description: Bu büyüleyici otel, Satilik muhteşem bir konumda, plaja sadece 300 metre yalan sahiptir. Bu otel sıcak misafirperverlik ve mükemmel hizmet sunmaktadır. İç zarif tasarlanmış, klasik zarif bir stile sahip. Odalar güzel dekore edilmiş, nötr tonlar ve sade bir tasarıma sahip. 210692.description:
We welcome our guests to a friendly and cosy atmosphere in our charming old vienna city hotel.Whether you plan a trip with your family, alone or for business or you would like to experience the Viennese charm with an art, culture, music or shopping vacation, we expect our guests between the Wiener Prater and the St. Stephens Cathedral in hearty ambience.Your hotel with the personal touch looks forward to your visit and wishes you a pleasant and recreative stay as well as memorable moments in Vienna.

Family Sobotka & Team Hotel Praterstern

There is a no smoking policy throughout the hotel. Rooms offer internet access via wifi or modem. Wireless internet is also available in public areas. Tea and coffee making facilities are available in all rooms.

210698.description: Dating from 1883, the Central Plaza Hotel is situated right at Zurich's Central Square next to the main railway station . The Plaza houses a grill restaurant and a piano bar with live music, as well as the King's Cave Restaurant, which is located in the cellar of the building and has a unique ambience with an open fireplace, ancient mirrors and paintings. All rooms are soundproofed and comfortable. Guests can use the gym next to the hotel for free. The Bahnhofstrasse, Zurich's most popular shopping street, numerous banks, several museums and art galleries are only few steps away from the Central Plaza.

210708.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, a fireplace in the lobby, and a banquet hall. 210719.description: The Do Step Inn is due to its central location the perfect starting point for your sightseeing tour in Vienna. The Do Step Inn is the ideal accommodation for everyone wanting a maximum of comfort for little money. Whether you're a tourist, family, group, company or school class, we will surely find an offer that complies your needs best - just go ahead and ask!

210733.description: This 4 star hotel is located close to the airport of Zurich and Messe Zurich. It is a short drive away from the Zurich downtown and the nearest station is Kloten. The Hotel has a shuttle service to the airport, a restaurant, a bar and a fitness centre/gym. All 132 rooms are equipped with hairdryer, safe and free wi-fi.
