Share as much as you want with whomever you want, whether it's at the bar or in the restaurant. With regional beers and a huge selection of wines on tap, every visit is sure to be an experience. A relaxed, informal atmosphere surrounded by Swiss urban decor awaits you – perfect for relaxing with friends and family or simply enjoying some alone time!

210740.description:
This is a very nice hostel where you can feel at home and is located in the most Historical Area of Lisbon
All the rooms with a balcony and satellite TV have a shared bathroom in the hallway and guests can use the kitchen (with kettle, microwave and refrigerator) to prepare their meal, but the breakfast is not included! 
The reception is open 24 hours a day

210745.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and bicycle rentals at this Art Deco hotel, featuring a lobby fireplace and reception hall. 210748.description: With European styling, both tasteful and comfortable, the Adina Apartment Hotel Berlin Mitte is perfect for a city getaway. With your choice of 139 spacious one, two and three bedroom apartments or studio rooms, you will feel at home in this generous accommodation. With fully equipped kitchens, whip up a home-cooked meal, or order in-room dining in the separate living area. Launder your clothing, while relaxing in the sauna, swimming in the indoor pool or working out in the gym. Stay within a short stroll from Berlin main station, Berlin Hauptbahnhof, in the Adina Apartment Hotel Berlin Mitte. Perfectly located for adventure in the historic Mitte district and near one of the largest stations in Europe, you have the perfect base for travelling. Stroll along the river, soak in the stunning parks of Tiergarten or immerse yourself in the history of the many museums and cultural sites in the city.

210761.description:
Our pension has 37 rooms and every room has it's individuality, some of the rooms have a view to 'Neuer Markt' and the more silent rooms have the few to 'Seilergasse' or to the very nice court. All rooms are equipped with TV, radio, Telephone, bathtub or shower and toilet.
 
The reception is open 24hours, and our receptionist and night audits are pleased to take care of all your wishes and desires, which make your stay more comfortable and memorable.
 
Breakfast is served from 06:30 a.m. in our Breakfast room in the second floor. We have a very nutritious, typical Viennese breakfast buffet.
 
Of course we are pleased to serve you some drinks or some small snacks the whole day.

210769.description: Located in Brussels' Upper Town, Hotel Chambord offers convenient amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine.
