Choose from Classic, Premium, and Apartment (84m²) categories. Enjoy breathtaking views of the idyllic vineyards or relax in the quiet hotel garden. Some garden-side rooms offer direct garden access, a terrace with table, chairs, and deck chairs, or a balcony. Hotel amenities include a breakfast room, bistro, bar, café, a charming children's playground, complimentary Wi-Fi and LAN access in all rooms, the restaurant, and lobby, and a conference/meeting room for up to 15 participants. Guests can also enjoy 45 national and international TV channels. This non-smoking hotel offers private parking, concierge services, and airport transfers upon request.

210786.description: Located in Zurich Center, Hotel Hottingen is within a 15-minute walk of ETH Zurich and Bahnhofstrasse. This hotel offers 30 guestrooms with private bathrooms, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. A shared kitchen is available for meal preparation. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, cable TV, and daily buffet breakfast (fee applies). Amenities include a bar/lounge, computer station, complimentary newspapers, multilingual staff, and tour/ticket assistance. Self-parking is available (surcharge). Nearby attractions include Kunsthaus Zurich (0. 3 mi), Grossmuenster (0. 5 mi), and Bellevue Square (0. 5 mi). Zurich Airport (ZRH) is 7. 8 mi away.

210794.description: The Hotel Luso Brasileiro enjoys a prime location in the heart of Póvoa de Varzim's pedestrian area, offering tranquility just steps from the beach and near the historic casino. A short drive from Porto's bustling city center, this modern hotel boasts over 20 years of experience in hospitality. Its 62 guest rooms feature amenities for both business and leisure travelers, including private bathrooms, satellite TV, air conditioning, internet access, and balconies or terraces.

210808.description: Opera Suites Vienna is ideally located in the heart of Vienna, opposite the Hotel Sacher and the Vienna State Opera and offers spacious rooms, generously furnished in old Viennese décor. Therefore this boutique-style accommodation is equally attractive to visitors to the opera, tourists and business travellers. The Albertina, the Hofburg, St. Stephen's Cathedral and, of course, the Kärntnerstraße - with its fashionable boutiques and designer stores - are within easy walking distance. Opera Suites Vienna is dedicated to personal service and the well-being of its guests. The staff is happy to arrange opera, theatre or concert tickets, recommendations for restaurants and your tailor-made Vienna sightseeing programmes. The metro stations Karlsplatz (lines U4, U2, U1) and Stephansplatz (lines U1, U3) are within a 2 to 5-minute walk away.

210829.description: Centrally located in Berlin, Hotel Gat Point Charlie is a short walk from iconic landmarks like Checkpoint Charlie (3 minutes) and Potsdamer Platz (14 minutes). This hotel offers 140 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, Select Comfort beds with premium bedding, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with designer toiletries. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant, Avan, a snack bar/deli, and daily buffet breakfast. Additional amenities include bicycle rentals, concierge services, and a 24-hour front desk. For those flying, Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER) is approximately 25. 6 km away.

210830.description: Hotel Prestige, a charming hotel in Brussels city center, is conveniently located near European institutions, public transport, and shopping. Ideal for business or leisure travelers, whether on a short trip or an extended stay, our hotel offers high-standard accommodations at reasonable prices. Each room features satellite TV, a private bathroom with shower or bath, hairdryer, telephone, minibar, free Wi-Fi, and soundproof windows. Enjoy our breakfast buffet, served from 7:00 am to 10:00 am. Our dedicated team is committed to ensuring you a pleasant and comfortable stay.

210839.description: This excellent small hotel is situated in the heart of Lisbon's Baixa/Rossio district. Located in the city's shopping and historical center, it offers visitors easy access to the best shops and the opportunity to explore the main points of interest on foot. Lisbon Airport is about 7. 2 km from the property. The hotel offers 32 rooms, each equipped with satellite TV, heating, air conditioning, a telephone, and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. Guests can relax at the bar, which offers hot and cold drinks and light meals, and in the comfortable living room. Car and bicycle rentals are also available for exploring the city and surrounding areas.

210841.description:
Appartements Ferchergasse offer you close to the centre, comfortable accomodations for reasonable prices. This family run business is more personal than a hotel, so enjoy Vienna's cozy atmosphere and charme.
You can choose between several apartment types:
1, 2, 3. 4, 5 or 8 person apartments
All apartments are fully equipped and have a kitchen with all amenities. Standard of each flat are free WiFi, bed linen, towels, final cleaning, weekly cleaning for longer stays and SAT TV.
The apartments stand out due to a very good accessibility to public transport and so the next stops of bus, tramway, rapid train and metro connection are just a few meters away, all run in very short intervals (3-5 minutes).
Many shopping facilities, supermarkets as well as good restaurants with Viennese and international cuisine are nearby.

210847.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace at Hotel Mozart, centrally located in Brussels, just steps from La Grand Place and a short walk from Manneken Pis. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. The 54 guestrooms feature cable TV and safes, and cribs/infant beds are available upon request. Amenities include a 24-hour front desk, laundry facilities, and a safe deposit box at reception. Brussels Airport (BRU) is 9. 4 miles away.

210857.description: The Hotel is located in a typical eighteenth-century canal in the center of Amsterdam, a few minutes walk from the Leidseplein. This hotel has a star families, tourists with a limited budget and small groups. This is a hotel which aims to provide a comfortable and accessible.

210861.description: The Lisbonaire Apartments Welcome to the luxurious, 4x000D star The Lisbonaire Apartments in Lisboa. The hotel offers on site car parking. Guests can dine at the hotel restaurant. Rooms at the Lisbonaire Apartments. Iron, ironing board and hairdryer are provided in all rooms. Smoking in certain bedrooms is allowed, as well as in public areas of the hotel. Please specify when making your booking. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms. Tea and coffee making facilities are available in all rooms. Leisure Info. The Lisbonaire Apartments offers a range of leisure facilities.

210884.description: Conveniently located mere minutes from the city centre, this hotel is the ideal base from which to explore Vienna's attractions or enjoy an evening at the famous Vienna State Opera. In the area there are excellent transport links as the tram and metro stop are metres away, so visitors of the hotel have easy access to Josefstadt, a vibrant neighbourhood close to the University of Vienna, as well as Vienna's city hall and other notable sights. The hotel, with its modern interior, endeavours to ensure its guests a comfortable yet affordable stay in one of Europe's most historic cities. With amenities such as a LAN internet connection in all of the rooms, a 24-hour reception and ticket desk, giving you the freedom and independence to enjoy your stay as you wish, the hotel is the perfect choice for those wishing to relax after a day of sightseeing.

210886.description: This modern and luxurious hotel is strategically well-located in Berlin's city centre, next to the river Spree, being easy accessible whether from East and West Berlin. Thanks to its privileged position and at the same time a quite setting, this is the perfect accommodation option for both business and leisure travellers alike. The comfortable and elegantly furnished guest rooms are all smartly equipped with complimentary wireless Internet connection for those who need to keep connected and an en-suite bathroom with pleasant amenities such as a towel heater. Guests can hold any kind of event at the spectacular conference facilities, including a wedding or a business meeting. Moreover, the hotel is provided with a gym with excellent views, a convenient spa where guests can truly relax and a wonderful riverside restaurant that serves delicious specialities.

210899.description: Boasting a great location in Berlin's city centre, this contemporary and pleasant hotel is next to a great cultural and dining offer, including delicious restaurants, designer shops, art galleries and trendy night clubs that will help any kind of traveller to better appreciate their stay. In the surrounding area, guests can find plenty of interesting sites, such as the lively and multicultural Hackescher Markt or the Unter den Linden avenue. Both the comfortable guest rooms and the fully-equipped apartments are the ideal spaces for a truly relaxing stay with everything they may need. They have wooden flooring and sound-proofed windows for a good night's sleep. Business travellers might appreciate the rooftop conference rooms available, with fantastic views of the city and state-of-the-art facilities.

210902.description:
The Serviced Apartments constitute an innovative housing concept in Porto. Already furnished, the apartments are equipped with anything that is necessary to live life to the full. Total comfort and well-being in a setting of sophistication and good taste.

The Serviced Apartments are located on the principal avenue of the city of Porto and benefit from being at the centre of urban life. This privileged location also facilitates the discovery of the cultural and historical charm of the city. 

The 70 apartments are fully equipped with everything you need. You also have a gym in the building.

210909.description:
Quinta do Barracão da Vilariça, is a pleasant property of 220 hectares converted into agro-tourism and rural tourism accommodation. Located in Alfândega da Fé, just in the center of Vilariça valley have a privilege situation to visit Trás-os-Montes, the must Northeast Region of Portugal. The estate produces these won certified products as: olive oil, marmalades, Cheese, fruits and a very exclusive wine.
The main house of Vilariça was built in the 19th century to be an inn to welcome guests travelling from and to Bragança. The actual Owners did an enormous restoration to adapt with comfort this building and three independent buildings to be country accommodation

210920.description: Welcome to the 3 star rated Hotel Am Anhalter Bahnhof in Berlin. On site car parking is available at the hotel. The hotel offers restaurant facilities. Room Facilities Hotel Am Anhalter Bahnhof. Smoking is permitted in both the bedrooms and the public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking.

210955.description: A unique luxury hotel located in the heart of Geneva's old town, the Hotel-Restaurant ‘Les Armures' is a magnificent 17 th century residence situated 5 minutes from the lake, local shops and the business district. Its restaurant with a terrace serves typical Swiss and French specialities in a homely setting. The Les Armures Hotel boasts a refinement and warmth that attracts and retains the affection of a clientele seeking style, comfort and a calm ambiance. Excellent furnishings and a warmth of character that unites classic and contemporary styles come together to create a unique setting and a jealously kept secret.

210975.description: Centrally located in Vienna, Hotel Pension Andreas offers convenient access to the Vienna Christmas Market and Vienna State Opera, both within a 5-minute drive. This hotel provides 40 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and desks. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, a computer station, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. The hotel is also conveniently located near Rathaus, Rathausplatz, the University of Vienna, Votive Church, and Burgtheater. Vienna International Airport (VIE) is 30 km (18. 6 mi) from the hotel.

210991.description: The hotel offers a central location in Lisbon, a 5-minute walk from Chiado and Bairro Alto. It is only 100 m from Baixa-Chiado Metro Station, offering connections throughout Lisbon. Rossio Railway Station is 600 m and has a 40-minute train link to Sintra (a UNESCO World Heritage Site). The surrounding area is filled with restaurants, cafes and shops, and the well-known 28 tram stops 50 metres from the hotel. Lisbon Airport lies just 7 km from the property. With elegantly decorated accommodation, all units are air-conditioned and include an iHome docking station and private marble bathroom with rainfall shower. Some are equipped with an iMac computer and an iPad. Kitchenette facilities are featured in some rooms.

210994.description: This elegant 18th century manor house incorporates a number of old goldsmiths' workshops that have been turned into a fascinating museum integrated with other amenities. Here you can admire a vast collection of traditional filigree objects, collected by Francisco Carvalho e Sousa for more than 50 years. Besides the opportunity to discover how traditional gold filigree was made, you will also be offered the choice between strolling through its surrounding beautiful gardens and waterfalls, or taking a refreshing dip in the pool.

210996.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the mid-sized, 4-star Hotel Vienna in Vienna. The hotel offers both on-site and off-site parking, a restaurant, Wi-Fi, and meeting facilities ideal for business travelers. Smoking is permitted in designated rooms and public areas (please specify your preference when booking). All rooms feature a stocked minibar and wireless internet access. The hotel also provides an airport shuttle service, welcomes pets, and offers a concierge service.

210997.description: The quirky Park Plaza Wallstreet lies in the heart of Berlin close to the shops and restaurants of the Alexanderplatz and iconic sights such as the Brandenburg Gate and the TV Tower. The high-end stores and exclusive boutiques of Friedrichstraße and Französische Straße are nearby, as are the Spittelmarkt and Märkisches Museum underground stations. Each of the hotel's 167 guestrooms and suites is uniquely themed around the USA, Hollywood and the Stock Exchange. All rooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, direct-dial telephone and flatscreen TV with movies and music channels on demand. Ideal for families, Executive rooms and Junior suites are more spacious and offer a choice of bath or separate shower, filter coffee machine and enhanced bathroom amenities. For added convenience, express check-out, a foreign currency exchange service and private parking are also available. Restaurant 23 Wallstreet serves delicious breakfasts, while the landscaped terrace is ideal for watching the world go by over a leisurely coffee. À-la-carte dining is on offer at Restaurant Light Lounge, and innovative cocktails are mixed at Rule 405 Bar. Guests seeking enhanced privacy can select from the varied daily Room Service menu. Additional facilities include a Fitness Centre, sauna, and an in-house cinema which can seat up to 60 guests for private screenings and celebrations.

211005.description: Hotel Pax offers 32 charming and cozy rooms, most with ensuite shower or bathtub and toilet. Some rooms also feature spacious balconies and fireplaces. All rooms are equipped with cable TV (38 channels), complimentary Wi-Fi, radio, automatic alarm clock, and direct-dial telephone. Ideally located in downtown Geneva, Hotel Pax is near the lake, old town, and business district, with convenient access to public transportation.

name.content: Adina Apartment Hotel Berlin Checkpoint Charlie

211010.description: Located in Berlin's historic Mitte district, this urban hideaway is ideal for exploring the city. A five-minute walk from Spittelmarkt station and Checkpoint Charlie, and 2km from the Pergamon Museum, it offers warmly decorated studio and 2-bedroom apartments. Each features a kitchenette with a microwave and dishwasher, a flat-screen TV, and a hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a modern restaurant and bar with outdoor seating, an indoor pool and hot tub, a sauna, and a fitness room.

211015.description: This 3-star hotel in central Amsterdam offers modern rooms, perfect for both leisure and business travelers. A short walk from the metro and tram, it provides easy access to iconic attractions like the Carré Theatre, Artis Zoo, and Oosterpark. Public parking is available. Dam Square, major museums, and other key destinations are just a few tram stops away, while the RAI Convention Centre is easily reached by metro.

211024.description:
Located in Porto's city centre, just a few meters from the World Heritage Site by UNESCO, Porto Riad Guest House, offers its clients an unforgettable and unique experience. Porto Riad is an enchanting and traditional House from the 40's totally renovated in 2009 under the theme of the Orient. Its mission is to provide clients in an exotic and inspiring atmosphere. All rooms have a personalized decoration under the theme of the mysterious and inspiring Orient – travel with us and discover our cosy atmosphere.
Respecting the well being of its clients, double and single rooms at Porto Riad Guest House have: Private bathroom, TV, Room Services, Free Wi-Fi
Porto Riad Guesthouse has very good location as it is close to the historic center of Porto

211079.description: This charming hotel is located in the countryside in an unique natural environment and just 20 minutes from Barcelona city, the beautiful beaches and El Prat International Airport. From the main terrace guests will be able to enjoy wonderful views of the lush surroundings. The property is located in the heart of the Baix Llobregat, only 8 km from the A2 motorway and 6 km from the famous Colonia Güell. Very close guests will also find the popular park of Catalunya en Miniatura as well as enjoy the endless tours in the Garraf Natural Park. All the guestrooms at the hotel are elegantly appointed, spacious and equipped with an en suite bathroom with hot tub, a fireplace and beautiful views to the surrounding countryside or the swimming pool area. The hotel features an outdoor swimming pool with sun loungers and a barbecue area. Every morning, a breakfast buffet is served.

211082.description: Hotel MM Dateo is right next to Dateo metro and Train Station, with direct links to Milan's Rho Fiera Milano and to Milan's metro lines. The metro journey to the Cathedral and Milano Centrale Train Station takes approximately 10 minutes. Linate Airport is 1. 2 mi away. At the Dateo Hotel you will find a bar lounge with TV, a 24-hour reception, and a garden. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. An Italian breakfast is available every day. Each guest room comes with a flat-screen TV. The private bathrooms are complete with hairdryer and toiletries.

211089.description: Riad Ben Tachfine is a six bedroomed boutique hotel, situated a short stroll from the vibrant and pulsating Place Jemaa el-Fna. This world heritage site is at the heart of the legendary ‘Rose city' of Marrakech; one of Morocco's most popular vacation destinations. We take pride on our high level of service and hospitality, providing a truly magical setting from which to explore the rich tapestry of the contrasting character of the Moroccan landscape – a landscape interwoven with the heady mixture of Arab, African and European cultures. Ideal for a luxury weekend break, or longer stay, the Riad offers dining, a Spa, Hammam, making a perfect choice for your Morocco holiday.

211093.description: This hotel is located in a historic building just 300 metres from Amsterdam Central Station. Hotel Old Quarter offers free Wi-Fi in the restaurant area and a 24-hour front desk. Dam Square is a 5-minute walk. Each basic room is individually decorated. Some have a TV with cable channels. There are private and shared bathrooms which are fitted with a shower. Breakfast is offered in the restaurant. In the evening, you can enjoy traditional Dutch snacks and relax with a drink in the bar area. The Red Light District is just a 2-minutes’ walk away. Main shopping street Kalverstraat is 7 minutes by foot. From Amsterdam Central Station there are direct links to Rembrandt Square, Leidse Square and Rijks Museum.

name.content: Hotel Saint Michel / The 15 Grand Place Brussels

211096.description: Enjoy a central Brussels stay at Hotel Le Quinze Grand Place, steps from La Grand Place and a short walk from Manneken Pis. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and four on-site restaurants, plus room service during limited hours. Each of the 12 guestrooms features a flat-screen TV, cable programming, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hair dryer. Coffee/tea makers and a turndown service are also provided. A full breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel is conveniently located near Brussels Christmas Market and the Royal Palace of Brussels.

211115.description: This hotel is situated in Vienna, directly at the Europaplatz and next to the famous shopping street 'Mariahilferstrasse'. Guests will find themselves just 200 m from the nearest train station, ‘Westbahnhof'. Other important tourist attractions in the area include St. Stephan's Cathedral, the Hofburg Vienna and the surrounding castle garden, as well as the Museum Quarter. Vienna Airport is about 30 km away. Guests will find a choice of comfortable rooms which have been elegantly decorated. They all include a large choice of services and facilities, including a work desk ideal for those travelling on business. The four onsite meeting rooms are ideal to hold corporate retreats, conferences or team building sessions as they are all completely equipped with the latest technology.

211126.description: Experience the luxurious Riad Kheirredine in the heart of Marrakech, just a 5-minute drive from Jemaa el-Fnaa and Marrakech Plaza. Indulge in a full-service spa offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Enjoy Moroccan cuisine at Moka Fine Dining, or relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. The 14 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, private bathrooms, and complimentary Wi-Fi. A full breakfast is served daily. Other amenities include concierge services and dry cleaning. The riad is conveniently located near key attractions, including the Perfume Museum and Ben Youssef Mosque. Menara Airport (RAK) is a short 8 km away.

211127.description: Located in an ancient Venetian palace in the Venice historic centre, Dimora Marciana is a guest house just 50 metres away from St. Mark's Square and at a 5 minutes walk from the Rialto Bridge. Just like Venice's most prestigious historic houses, Dimora Marciana features traditional Venetian style furnishings. Elegant and sophisticated environments, precious damask silk tapestry, classic decorative elements, will take you back in time, making you experience the suggestive atmosphere of the prestigious Most Serene Republic of Venice.

211130.address: 61, Avenue Houmane El Fetouki Arest Lamaach
211130.description: The Riad Bahia Salam (rated 4 star) is a mid size luxury hotel in Marrakech. The hotel offers restaurant facilities. Rooms at the Riad Bahia Salam. Smoking is permitted in both the bedrooms and the public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms. Leisure Info. The Riad Bahia Salam offers guests a selection of leisure activities and facilities. During your stay, relax with a luxurious range of spa treatments including beauty, massage and sauna. Other Info. The hotel offers an airport shuttle service. The hotel is pet friendly. Hotel guests can make use of the concierge service that is provided.

211132.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages, body treatments, and facials. You can soak up the sun at the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities including an indoor pool and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at Villa Augusto Restaurant, a poolside bar/lounge where you can take in the garden view and dine alfresco. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include multilingual staff, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Planning an event in Alanya? This hotel has 646 square feet (60 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.

211135.description: Located in Berlin Lichtenberg, This 2 gold points hotel is steps away from an S-Bahn city rail station, providing easy access to the Hackescher Markt district, Alexanderplatz square, and the ICC trade fair. The family-run Hotel Nova is an ideal place to relax after an exciting day in Berlin. Guests will enjoy the peaceful and spacious rooms, and the friendly staff. Popular attractions include the Brandenburg Gate, the Fernsehturm (TV Tower) and the vibrant nightlife of Friedrichshain. The Mercedes Benz Arena Berlin can be reached in less than 10 minutes using public transport. The Hotel Nova’s helpful staff will also help to organize theater ticket reservations, sightseeing tours and car hire. Lichtenberg’s S-Bahn (city rail) and U-Bahn (underground) stations are just 33 feet away, connecting you to countless historical attractions within minutes.

211151.description: Located in Marrakech, Dar Jaguar offers luxurious five-star accommodations. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the hotel's restaurant. Rooms feature wireless internet access and smoking is permitted in both the bedrooms and public areas (please specify when booking). For leisure, guests can relax in the hotel's outdoor swimming pool.

211152.description: Just a 5-minute walk from Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque and Topkapi Palace, this hotel offers modern accommodations with free wireless internet access. It has a rooftop terrace and offers a buffet breakfast. In the heart of Sultanahmet, Agora Life Hotel offers an ideal location for guests who want easy access to Istanbul's most historic sites. Each of the rooms is tastefully decorated and has contemporary wooden floors. They come equipped with LED TV and laptop-size safes. Thoughtful touches also include a fruit basket and a bottle of mineral water upon arrival. There is also a complimentary coffee/tea setup in the rooms. Istanbul's Grand Bazaar is just 10 minutes' walk away. There are also excellent public transport links close to Agora Life, providing easy access to the rest of Istanbul. The lively Taksim Square is 2. 8 mi from the property and Istanbul Congress Center is 3. 7 mi away. The attentive staff can arrange a rental car, airport shuttle services, or offer tips on what to see and do in the area. Sabiha Gokcen Airport is within 28 mi of Agora Life Hotel and Istanbul Airport is 32 mi away. Fatih is a great choice for travelers interested in old-town exploration, architecture and monuments.

211154.description:
The Montana *** (rated 3 stars) is a small hotel located in the center Geneva, close to the lake and the train station. 
They offer discount to Cornavin public parking price. 
All rooms have a hairdryer. 
Rooms have wireless internet access available. 
All rooms has a courtesy tray (keetle, cofee machine)

211158.description: Located in Vienna's Landstraße district, Hotel Urania offers comfortable guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, cable programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy amenities such as a spa tub, coffee shop, bar/lounge, and business center. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel provides dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour airport shuttle (surcharge). Nearby attractions include the Prater and Belvedere, both within a 5-minute drive. St. Stephen's Cathedral and the Vienna State Opera are also easily accessible.

211160.description: We almost drove ourselves crazy in designing our vision of the perfect hotel room: beautiful, sustainably built, affordable and the comfiest room in the city. It might not be what you expect, which is a good thing in our opinion, but it is an oasis to return to after a day of work or a sensory adventure overload, and we are pretty sure it will surprise and delight in all the right ways.

211168.description: Riad Aliya, a beautifully restored mansion, is nestled in the heart of Marrakech's ancient medina, in the Kasbah neighborhood. Just a short drive from the airport (5 minutes), it's also conveniently located near the Royal Palace and the vibrant Jemaa el-Fna square with its bustling souks. The riad is built around a tranquil courtyard featuring a refreshing swimming pool. Six ensuite bedrooms and a comfortable living room offer a haven of beauty and calm. Guests can savor refined traditional cuisine from breakfast to candlelit dinners on the terrace, which boasts stunning views of the snow-capped Atlas Mountains. Indulge in a traditional hammam, beauty treatments, and massages to complete your experience.

211171.description: Indulge in a relaxing experience at the full-service spa, offering massages and facials. Enjoy recreational amenities including an outdoor pool, spa tub, and steam room. This luxurious riad also features concierge and wedding services, and barbecue grills. Savor lunch or dinner at the riad's restaurant or coffee shop/cafe. Room service is also available during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the poolside bar, and start your day with a complimentary full breakfast served daily from 5:00 AM to noon. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi in one of the 16 individually decorated guestrooms. Each room includes a safe, complimentary toiletries, a hairdryer, and the convenience of in-room massages. Housekeeping is provided daily. Located in the heart of Marrakech's Medina, Riad Jona is just a short drive from Jemaa el-Fnaa and Menara Mall. The riad is also conveniently close to other attractions like Mellah Market and Dar Tiskiwin Museum.

211172.description: Enjoy a central Venice stay at the Antica Locanda Sturion - Residenza d'Epoca hotel, steps from the Rialto Bridge and a short walk from St. Mark's Square. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a common area television. Start your day with a local cuisine breakfast (fee applies). The hotel offers 11 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a minibar, LCD TV, and private bathroom with shower, complimentary toiletries, and bidet. A 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage are also available.

211173.description: Located in Marrakech's historic cultural center, a short 10-minute stroll from Jemaa el Fna square, Riad de Vinci offers an authentic Moroccan experience. Each uniquely decorated room beautifully blends Eastern tradition with modern comforts. Guests can enjoy the tranquil patio with its inviting pool, a rooftop terrace perfect for sunbathing, and a charming tented area for breakfast.

211175.address: Derb Jemaa El Kebir Hay Essalam, 3
211175.description: Welcome to the Riad Azoulay located in the Medina of Marrakech, in the middle of the Mellah, the old Jewish quarter of Marrakech, a short walk from Bahia Palace and the Synagogue, and 10 minutes from the legendary Jamaa El Fna. You will discover a discreet and elegant place, where everything has been designed for you, for your well-being and relaxation. A discreet hospitality and modern comfort await you in this private home to ensure you stay under the sign of silence and privacy. Our staff offers a service that combines the warmth of a private home with the comfort of an upscale hotel. Discover a world of elegance and tranquility, where everything has been carefully studied to ensure you a pleasant holiday in Morocco.

211177.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include wedding services, a fireplace in the lobby, and a banquet hall. Enjoy Turkish cuisine at Bosphorus Restaurant, a beachfront restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). A complimentary local cuisine breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 11 AM. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 12 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your Select Comfort bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

211179.description: Situated in Milan, the 3-star Hotel Sempione offers an on-site restaurant and a convenient airport shuttle service. Guests are welcome to bring their pets. Smoking is permitted in some rooms and designated public areas; please specify your preference when booking. A concierge service is also available to assist guests.

211185.description: Enjoy modern comfort and convenience at citizenM Amsterdam South hotel, located in Amsterdam's vibrant South district, a short drive from the Van Gogh Museum and Vondelpark. This hotel offers 215 guestrooms equipped with iPads, iPod docking stations, 43-inch Smart TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a buffet breakfast at canteenM, our on-site restaurant and bar/lounge, or grab a coffee at the café. Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center and express check-in/out services. We also offer a communal living room and banquet hall for your convenience. Nearby attractions include the World Trade Center, RAI Exhibition and Congress Centre, and Museum Square, all within a short distance.

211189.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and other conveniences like a TV in the common area and tour/ticket assistance at Hotel Del Sud. The on-site coffee shop/cafe and bar/lounge offer dining and refreshment options. Each of the 27 guestrooms features an LCD TV and a private bathroom with shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. Located in Milan's Ripamonti Corvetto district, the hotel is a short drive from Bocconi University and Piazza del Duomo, placing you within easy reach of key attractions like the Cathedral of Milan and San Siro Stadium. Fondazione Prada and QC Termemilano are also nearby. Milan Malpensa Airport (MXP) is the preferred airport for accessing the hotel.

211191.description: Riad L'orchidee is located 15 minutes from the famous Jamaa El Fna square, close to the Medrassa Ben Youssef and Majorelle Garden in Marrakech. Public parking is available a mere 3 minutes from the riad. The hotel's restaurant offers meals upon request, and smoking is permitted in designated public areas. Complimentary Wi-Fi access is available in public areas, and leisure facilities, including an indoor swimming pool, are also provided. For the adventurous, the riad can arrange quad biking and various excursions around Marrakech. Airport shuttle services are available.

211193.address: 91 Diour Jdad Zaouia El Abbessia Bab Doukkala, 2
211193.description: Dar Tuscia is located in the more ancient district of Marrakech, where are the finest traditional houses of the Medina , we invite you to spend a pleasant stay in this authentique Riad full of warm, intimacy, and harmony. Stayin in Riad Dar Tuscia you can take advantage of the tranquility cheered by the birdsong that often flutish in the green courtyard, in contrast with the bustle  characteristic of Marrakech. Riad Dar Tuscia is pleased to present the magic of Morocco with its decoration and craftsmanship. Each room is individually decorated, with its own private bathroom with traditional moroccan plaster. Riad Dar Tuscia invites you to discover the old town of this ancient city with the incomparables panoramic views of the  medieval town of the famouse ocher city.

211194.description: This elegant six-bedroom riad offers a restful atmosphere in the heart of Mouassine, a delightful antique market just a five-minute walk from Jemaa el-Fna square. Stéphanie and Philippe's home blends traditional Moroccan materials with unique personal items collected during their travels. Free Wi-Fi is available, and services such as airport transfers, Moroccan meals, and massages can be arranged upon request.

211199.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the mid size, 3 star Pension Riedl in Wien. On site car parking is available. Guests can enjoy a meal at the hotel restaurant. Room Features Pension Riedl. There is a no smoking policy throughout the hotel. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms. All rooms have tea and coffee making facilities.

211201.description:
The hotel is pleased to welcome you in the heart of the capital of Europe in a recently renovated setting.

We have 30 luxurious rooms with a bath or shower, a television and a telephone.

211203.description: Situated in Berlin's historic Mitte district, Hotel de Rome is steps away from the State Opera and Humboldt University. This architectural gem offers exceptional comfort and personalized service, placing guests within walking distance of iconic sights, high-end boutiques on Friedrichstrasse, and renowned restaurants.

211218.description:
In the center of Marrakech, in a typical street of the medina, 5 minutes from the main square Jemaa el Fna (world heritage by UNESCO) near the Bahia Palace, Riad Argan is an oasis of freshness and serenity .
MonRiad has a living room with fireplace and satellite TV, wi-fi, a room with a relaxation area, a swimming pool in the patio of the entry, 12 bedrooms, each with bathroom, that will give you the feeling of be in a place out of time. From the terrace during the day, you can enjoy the view of the medina and mosque "Koutoubia" and, overnight, the magic of the night sky.

Let yourself be pampered by the expert and discreet staff will be at your disposal during your stay.

211219.address: Rasimpasa Mahallesi Kirmizi Kusak Sokak No24
211219.description: Akin Suites is a family run hotel apartment in the center of the Asian side of Istanbul, just 100 meters from the Marmara Sea. Akin Suites apartments are designed to offer space, light and modern comfort. Fully furnished and styled to the highest specification, each apartment compliments its setting and is designed to offer a stylish and contemporary living experience. Each apartment is designed with an open plan living area offering a bright and inviting interior space. Akin Suite Apartments have been designed to offer the ultimate in modern living and the perfect lifestyle choice for professionals and leisure travelers. Alive with Kadikoy's most popular restaurants, pubs, bars and shopping districts. If you enjoy the buzz of city life then this is the perfect place for you.

211228.description: The family-owned Hotel Old Nickel enjoys a prime location in the heart of Amsterdam's old city center, a mere two-minute walk from Central Station. Its central position attracts international travelers seeking both vibrant exploration and restful relaxation. A multilingual staff provides expert guidance on local attractions and activities. The cozy bar, adorned with 17th-century wood carvings and paneling from Admiral Michiel de Ruyter's flagship, offers a renowned selection of 70 different beers.

211234.description: Riad Cannelle is a luxurious 4-star hotel conveniently located near the centre of Marrakech. Local tourist attractions such as Ensemble Artisinal, Mouassine Mosque and Ben Youssef Mosque are not far from the hotel. Also easily within reach are Almoravid Koubba, Majorelle Garden and Marrakesh Museum.

211238.description: The Smart Hotel Central Station offers a stylish blend of modern and traditional Milanese design. Located directly across from Milan's Central Station, the hotel provides easy access to the city center and beyond. Its seven floors offer stunning views of either the bustling station or the cityscape. The M2 and M3 metro lines are just steps away, connecting you to major attractions and business districts, making the hotel ideal for both leisure and business travelers. Piazza Duomo, with its iconic cathedral, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele, and fashionable shops, is just a short metro ride away. For evening entertainment, the trendy Corso Como district is within walking distance. The hotel offers 74 standard and superior rooms to suit various needs.

211247.description: Set within a quiet courtyard, this hotel is located in Berlin's Charlottenburg district and offers free Wi-Fi as well as excellent transport links to the Gedächtniskirche church, the ICC exhibition center, and Tegel Airport. Hotel Adam is a 5-minute walk from the Wilmersdorfer Strasse U-Bahn (underground) station and Charlottenburg S-Bahn (city rail) station. Bus 109 for Tegel Airport stops right outside the Hotel Adam, and you can reach the ICC exhibition center in about 5 minutes by S-Bahn (city rail). Thanks to the hotel's convenient connections, you can easily travel to key attractions such as the Alexanderplatz square and Reichstag parliament building.

211248.description: Casa Oliver enjoys a prime location near Principe Real, close to the vibrant Bairro Alto. This charming hotel offers 30 individually designed rooms and suites within a beautifully restored 1895 building. While the property features interconnecting buildings with internal staircases, personalized service ensures a comfortable, home-like stay. Each room is equipped with modern amenities, including a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, free Wi-Fi, a hairdryer, and a safe. Guests have 24-hour room access, although reception operates from 8:00 am to midnight. Guests arriving after reception hours are kindly requested to inform the hotel of their estimated arrival time in advance. Casa Oliver Príncipe Real offers exceptional value in one of Lisbon's most desirable neighborhoods.

211253.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at Hotel LINDEMANN'S Berlin. Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge after cycling around the city using the hotel's rental bicycles. A buffet breakfast is available on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fee applies). The hotel offers 72 air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs and satellite programming. Each room includes a private bathroom with a shower, hairdryer, and toiletries. Laptop-compatible safes and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Located in the heart of Berlin, Hotel LINDEMANN'S is a 5-minute drive from Zoo Berlin and Kurfürstendamm, and conveniently close to attractions like the EUREF-Campus and Potsdamer Platz. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

name.content: The Level at Melia Barcelona Sky

211254.description: Situated in Barcelona's Sant Martí district, The Level At Melia Barcelona Sky offers luxurious accommodations within a short drive of Sagrada Familia and Plaça de Catalunya. Guests can indulge in the on-site spa, featuring massages, body treatments, and facials, or enjoy the sauna, 24-hour fitness center, and seasonal outdoor pool. The hotel's 99 air-conditioned rooms are equipped with minibars, espresso makers, premium bedding, and 55-inch plasma televisions with cable programming. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is provided. Merkado, the hotel's restaurant, specializes in Mediterranean cuisine; additional dining options include a coffee shop/café and 24-hour room service. Guests can unwind at the poolside bar or one of the two hotel lounges. Buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. The hotel also offers a 24-hour business center, express check-in/check-out, concierge and wedding services, and extensive meeting and event space. Self-parking is available (subject to charges).

211291.description: Overlooking the Grand Canal, a short distance from the train station, the 2-star Hotel Airone offers comfort and hospitality in one of the historic districts of Venice. The hotel is near the Piazzale Rome car park in a quiet area and near the stop for the direct water shuttles to San Marco. The rooms at Hotel Airone in Venice have a welcoming atmosphere. They overlook the Grand Canal and a lovely internal garden. The rooms, decorated simply and elegantly, have gentle lighting and bright curtains and include a TV and air conditioning.

211293.description: Enjoy the view from your private balcony at Hotel Trovatore, a beach hotel in the heart of Jesolo. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) from the snack bar/deli and end it with a drink at the bar/lounge. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, Smart TVs in each of the 32 guestrooms, and a common area with a TV. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies). Free self-parking is also available. You'll be within a 15-minute walk of Caribe Bay Jesolo and Piazza Mazzini, and a short drive from Piazza Brescia and Piazza Milano.

211295.description: The Ariel Silva Hotel is located just 10 minutes walk from the Santa Lucia station, in the neighborhood of Ghetto Nuovo. The accommodation offers 24 hours front desk, luggage storage and fully equipped rooms with Free Wi-Fi and is surrounded by a wide range of restaurants, shops and outdoor markets. The Ariel Silva Hotel has a magnificent location, just 250 meters from the Venice Casino and the Grand Canal. Close to the vaporetto stop you will find San Marco Square. Our cozy and beautiful rooms are equipped with ceiling beams, Murano crystal lamps, satellite LED TV, telephone, safety box, hairdryer and private bathroom or shared bathroom. The breakfast buffet is served each morning in our private garden. Some of our rooms are located in an annex building of the hotel.

211297.description: The Bernina Hotel, situated just 200 meters from Milano Centrale Train Station and metro lines 2 and 3, offers excellent public transport connections throughout Milan and to its international airports. Milan Cathedral is a mere four metro stops away. Guest rooms feature private bathrooms with hairdryers, Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs with Sky channels, and minibars. 24-hour room service is also available. The spacious lobby, tastefully furnished and adorned with a permanent exhibition of contemporary art, creates a welcoming ambiance. A varied breakfast buffet is served from 7:00 am to 10:00 am, complemented by a 24-hour bar and reception. Please note that the city tax is payable in cash upon arrival, and guests are required to present photo identification at check-in for payment validation.

211300.description: Strategically located in the Art Nouveau district of Porta Venezia, a few minutes' walk away from the city centre, this popular hotel is well connected for the Central Station and the three airports serving Milan. It is also just a 10 minute walk from Piazza Duomo, Via Monte Napoleone and Via della Spiga, while in a couple of minutes' it is possible to reach Corso Buenos Aires, one of the longest shopping streets in Europe. Modernly furnished and equipped the hotel is ideal for business and leisure travellers alike and features a cosy coffee & wine bar with a small outside terrace for enjoying a relaxing drink during the warmer months. THE ONLY THREE-STAR HOTEL IN DOWNTOWN MILAN WITH ITS OWN SAUNA & WELLNESS AREA

211310.description: Just 200 metres from the Ca' d'Oro Palace, Ca' Gottardi is a charming 15th-century building overlooking a small canal in Venice. It offers a choice of elegant rooms and suites, all with free Wi-Fi. With traditional Venetian decor, your room here includes air conditioning, a flat-screen TV and minibar. The en suite bathroom includes free toiletries and a hairdryer. A buffet breakfast is available each morning at Ca' Gottardi.

211320.description: The four-star Hotel Mentana is nestled in Milan's historic center, a short walk from the Duomo, Sforzesco Castle, and Sacro Cuore University. Four metro stations are within 500 meters. Rooms blend simple elegance with modern amenities, including a minibar, satellite TV (CNN and Japanese channels), climate control, chromotherapy-enhanced bathrooms, and air perfumers. The hotel's design showcases artistic details and cutting-edge technology. Explore nearby antique shops or venture to the fashionable Corso Vittorio Emanuele. The Duomo, financial district, and Milan Stock Exchange are also within walking distance. Hotel amenities include a 24-hour reception, museum and restaurant reservation services, Wi-Fi (fee applies), a bar, internet access, and nearby parking (fee applies). Cadorna Station is a ten-minute walk or short metro ride away, while Central Station is a 15-minute drive.

211323.description: The Urban Hive Hotel is located in Brera, Milan's historic and fashionable center, brimming with charming restaurants and pubs. Moscova Metro Station, providing easy access to Milan Central Train Station, is just 50 meters away. Offering complimentary Wi-Fi, rooms at the Urban Hive feature satellite flat-screen TVs, minibars, and elegant wooden floors. Private bathrooms include hairdryers and complimentary toiletries. Expert staff are available to assist you, and you can enjoy a rich buffet breakfast, a relaxing bar, and convenient room service.

211333.description:
Hotel Locanda Gaffaro is situated in the Corte del Gallo, in Dorsoduro district.
Piazza San Marco and the Rialto Bridge are within a 20 minutes walking distance or by vaporetti navigating the Grand Canal from San Toma stop (10 minutes from the hotel) or from Piazzale Roma.
The property offers a continental breakfast in your room or in the garden, 24-hour reception staff on hand to provide tourist information about the city.
Its rooms are equipped with air conditioning, minibar, satellite TV and safe. Private bathrooms with shower (one with bath) and a hairdryer.

211337.description: Centrally located in Mestre, Hotel Regit offers convenient access to Venice's attractions. A short drive from Porto Marghera and Piazzale Roma, this hotel features 29 air-conditioned rooms with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and private bathrooms. Enjoy amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, a rooftop terrace, garden, bar/lounge, and continental breakfast (fee applies). Concierge services, a hair salon, and airport shuttle (surcharge) are also available.

211339.description: Sitting just next to Milan Malpensa Airport, this hotel offers comfortable accommodation and unmatched convenience for anyone travelling through the transport hub. Its guests will need just 5 minutes to reach the hotel lobby after walking out of the arrivals terminal, thanks to the complimentary shuttle service of the venue. While those catching early morning flights can enjoy the hearty buffet breakfast and fill-up with the tasty fresh fruits, homemade cakes and juices prior to leaving. The restaurant also serves delicious Italian cuisine throughout the day and as any proper establishment should - boasts a fine wine-list capable of complementing the nuances of the food.

211342.description: Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Make yourself at home in one of the 67 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones and safes, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Zattere - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Gallerie dell'Accademia - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Accademia Waterbus - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Academy Bridge - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Palazzo Barbaro - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Palazzo Barbarigo - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Peggy Guggenheim Museum - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Campo Santo Stefano - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Squero di San Trovaso - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Palazzo Cavalli-Franchetti - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Palazzo Dario - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Palazzo Malipiero - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Palazzo Grassi - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Santa Maria del Giglio - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Basilica di Santa Maria della Salute - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi-A stay at Belle Arti Hotel places you in the heart of Venice, within a 15-minute walk of St. Mark's Square and Teatro La Fenice. This hotel is within close proximity of Gallerie dell'Accademia and Squero di San Trovaso.

211347.description: Hotel Demó enjoys a central location in Milan, just steps from Central Station and convenient to public transport, including the metro and airport buses. The hotel offers comfortable rooms equipped with private bathrooms, LCD TVs with satellite channels, hairdryers, air conditioning, safes, and free Wi-Fi. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as concierge service, a communal TV area, and a bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available (fee applies), and discounted parking is offered at a nearby garage. For dining, the partner restaurant, Le Chalet, is within walking distance, serving a varied menu of seafood, meat, and pizza dishes.

211372.description: This Art Deco hotel, located in Venice's Lido area, offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, bicycle rentals, and tour/ticket assistance. Guests can dine at the on-site restaurant or enjoy snacks at the deli. Unwind with drinks at the bar/lounge and savor local cuisine breakfasts (available for a fee). Each of the 12 guestrooms provides complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and a safe, along with a bathroom featuring a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a bidet. Housekeeping is provided daily. Hotel Villa Stella is a short walk from Lido of Venice Beaches and Palazzo del Casinò, with easy access to other attractions like the Palazzo del Cinema.

211377.description: Located in a beautifully renovated 18th-century building in Milan's city center, this charming hotel offers a warm and relaxing atmosphere. Just a 10-minute walk from the Duomo, Teatro alla Scala, and the vibrant Navigli district, it's an ideal base for exploring the city. Guests can unwind in the bright lobby, featuring a stunning skylight, or the enchanting inner garden. The light-filled rooms provide a welcome retreat after a day of sightseeing or shopping, equipped with modern amenities including satellite TV, a minibar, background music, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. Surrounded by theaters, museums, and antique shops, this hotel exudes Italian charm, promising a memorable Milanese experience.

211387.description:
Ca' della Corte is a XVI century Venetian Palace with its own courtyard.
It has been completely renovated in a style which emphasizes its beauty, elegance and refinement.
It has an excellent location, just 3 minutes from Piazzale Roma, car and bus parking, connected by 12 lines to all the most important places of the city.
It is also located at 15 minutes from Rialto Bridge and San Marco Area.
We paid a special attention to details, so to create an atmosphere of refined elegance and of confidential semplicity.

Our rooms are very spacious and bright.
They are elegantly furnished and have direct telephone, satellite tv, frigobar, private bath with hair- dryer, air conditioning and tea-making facilities.
The rich breakfast is served in the room.
Venetian marble mosaic floors and big windows with direct views of gardens and old Venetian palaces.

211391.address: Sultan Ahmet Mahallesi, Tomurcuk Sk. No:5, 5
211391.description: The Tashkonak Hotel Istanbul is a short 5-10 minute walk from Sultanahmet Mosque, Topkapi Palace, and the Hagia Sophia. Business travelers can take advantage of free Wi-Fi and meeting facilities. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, an LCD TV, a safe, a minibar, a telephone, central heating, and a private bathroom with a shower. Please note that smoking is not permitted. A stocked minibar and free Wi-Fi are also provided in each room. For leisure, the hotel offers various facilities and an airport shuttle service is available for an additional charge.

211397.description: Ca' San Rocco is situated in Venice's historic center, near the magnificent Frari Basilica. This quiet, garden-filled area is just minutes from the railway station, Piazzale Roma car parking, and the bus terminal. Completely rebuilt in 2005, the hotel features antique-style furnishings and modern comforts, including air conditioning, a minibar, direct telephone, Wi-Fi, satellite television, and safety deposit boxes. Guests can also enjoy the large terrace for a buffet breakfast during the summer months.

211402.description: The Kleos Hotel is a boutique hotel in the heart of Milan, within walking distance of the city's Old Town, Via Montenapoleone, and the Milan City Fair. Just a five-minute walk from the Underground Blue Line, which connects Milan's airport to the city center, this modern and elegant hotel offers 55 completely refurbished rooms. Whether traveling for business or leisure, guests will enjoy a comfortable stay. The Kleos Hotel also features a complimentary gym with brand-new equipment, accessible 24/7.

211403.description: The Locanda Art Deco, a charming guest house nestled in a renovated 17th-century building in the heart of San Marco, Venice, offers a comfortable and stylish retreat. Just a short 10-minute stroll from Piazza San Marco and the Rialto Bridge, this intimate property features six beautifully appointed rooms showcasing authentic Art Deco furnishings. Each room includes a private bathroom with a hairdryer, air conditioning, an LCD TV, a direct telephone line, free Wi-Fi, and computers. The annex, located at the B&B Art Deco just 100 meters away, provides affordable quadruple and triple rooms with private bathrooms, air conditioning, LCD TVs, and Wi-Fi, perfect for families or groups of friends.

211421.description: Located in Venice's Santa Croce district, Locanda Salieri is a short walk from Piazzale Roma and the Grand Canal. This hotel offers 11 air-conditioned rooms with LCD TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. Guests can enjoy a meal at the on-site restaurant. The hotel is conveniently located near popular attractions and approximately 1km from the Port of Venice and under 12km from Venice Lido Beaches.

211425.description: In the 1930s Architect Portaluppi designed the building that now houses the hotel, nestled in a private 4, 000 square meter park. A unique and rare solution in Milan, a city famous for its frenetic pace and grayness, which is typical of large cities. The hotel, renovated in 2014, boasts an enviable location in one of the most exclusive and elegant parts of the city. The 52 rooms at the Hotel Tiziano, which are divided into Classic, Superior and Executive Park View overlooking the park, represent the perfect solutions for every need thanks to their numerous amenities. Hotel Tiziano's cozy rooms offer all desirable amenities such as air conditioning, hair dryer, flat screen satellite TV, mini-bar, laundry service, free WI-FI, direct dial telephone, safe and desk.

211428.description:
Hotel Del Sole is located in close proximity to the Loreto metro station (line 1 & 2) that provides quick access to all of Milan's destinations. The Duomo is just 4 metro stops away.

Hotel Del Sole offers modern, comfortable rooms that feature modern amenities. Some rooms come with a terrace, others feature an en suite bathroom. All rooms feature: Air condition, TV, Telephone, Hair dryer 

Relax in the quiet and tranquil atmosphere of Hotel Del Sole, run by a welcoming and courteous staff

211429.description: The hotel Locanda Ca' Le Vele is right in the heart of the city, overlooking a romantic canal, and takes its name from the “calle” (narrow street) where it was built. Here, you can relive the atmosphere of Venice as it once was, in a place where history, culture and wonderful service all combine to ensure you have an unforgettable stay. The hotel is only 5 minutes' walk from the Rialto Bridge and 10 minutes from St. Mark's Square and the main cultural and artistic sights of Venice. The rooms in the Locanda Ca Le Vele are equipped with every comfort to make your stay pleasurable: free Wi-Fi internet, air-conditioning heating, safe, and mini-bar. Our reception desk is manned 24-hours a day and our multilingual staff will attend to all your requests or needs.

211435.description: This property is just a 2-minute walk from St. Mark's Square. It offers a relaxing roof terrace, and classic Venetian-style accommodation with free Wi-Fi. Rooms at the Antica Locanda are complete with a satellite TV with Sky channels, and air conditioning. The majority have a beautiful view of a classic Venetian canal. Breakfast is served at the table. It features sweet and savoury food, including local pastries and classic Italian coffee and cappuccino. The 24-hour reception provides tourist information and bookings for tours and excursions. There are also free internet terminals and a TV lounge.

211436.description: Mevlana Boutique is a traditionally decorated boutique hotel in Istanbul, within short walking distance to famous landmarks including Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, Basilica Cistern, Mosaic Museum and Roman Hippodrome. With its 20 well equipped and comfortable guest rooms, Mevlana offers you an unforgettable experience in the heart of the capital of the Roman, Byzantine and Ottoman Empires. The hotel was established in 2010 by Mr. Ali Polat and Mr. Vahap Polat, as an enterprise of Mevlana Group that owns Mevlana Rug Store and Istanbul Sightseeing Tours, and became a reputable hotel in a short period of time. Mevlana was given the Certificate of Excellence for two consecutive years, 2012 and 2013 from

211440.description: Hotel Belvedere is located on the shores of the lagoon of Lido Di Venezia. It offers free bike rental, free on-site parking and free Wi-Fi. The spacious air-conditioned rooms have a private bathroom with free toiletries. They also come with an LCD TV and satellite channels. Belvedere Hotel serves a varied buffet breakfast every morning, it includes croissants and hot and cold drinks. The renowned on-site restaurant prepares seafood specialties and classic Italian cuisine. Special menus are possible on request. The private beach is only 0. 9 mi away. The property can be easily reached with public transport, a bus stop is just in front of the hotel. A 35-minute ferry trip will take you from Venice Santa Lucia Train Station to the ferry stop 164 feet from the Belvedere.

211444.description: This charming, modern hotel offers convenient access to Milan's city center, situated just 200 meters from Milano Centrale Train Station with connections to the yellow, green, and red metro lines. Each air-conditioned room features an LCD TV with satellite channels, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a private bathroom with a shower. Guests can enjoy drinks and snacks in the hotel's private garden. A buffet breakfast is served daily, ensuring a great start to your day. The Expo 2015 Exhibition Centre is 14 kilometers away, and Linate International Airport is a 20-minute drive. Stazione Centrale is an excellent choice for travelers interested in luxury shopping.

211447.description: Enjoy garden views and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at Hotel Palazzo Abadessa. Take advantage of room service and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8 am to 10 am. The hotel offers express check-in and check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Make yourself at home in one of the 15 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Conveniences include phones, safes, and a turndown service. Located in Venice's city center, the hotel is within a 15-minute walk of St. Mark's Square and Rialto Bridge, and a short distance from other attractions like Ca' d'Oro and Teatro Malibran.

211457.address: Corte Del Magazen 748 Castello 30122 Venice Italy
211457.description: The Ai Giardini Residence Bed and Breakfast is a small hotel in Venice offering an on-site restaurant. Guests can enjoy a meal at the hotel restaurant. All rooms feature a stocked minibar. Smoking is permitted in some guest rooms and designated public areas; please specify your preference when booking.

211490.description: Set in Marghera, the Nuova Aurora has excellent bus links to Venice, just 10 minutes' drive away. It offers free parking, air-conditioned rooms and a 24-hour bar and reception. The bus stop is 2 minutes' walk away and bus number 53E to Venice runs every 12 minutes. The A4 motorway is 1. 9 mi away for connections to other destinations along the Brenta Riviera. Offering free Wi-Fi, rooms at the Nuova Aurora feature a TV and private bathroom with shower. A sweet Italian-style breakfast is available daily. Staff will be happy to recommend Marghera's best restaurants and you will also find supermarkets and pizzerias in the area. The hotel also features a TV lounge and laundry room.

211499.description: Enjoy garden views and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at Hotel Al Ponte Mocenigo. Make the most of room service (during limited hours) and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel offers a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and safe deposit boxes. Relax in one of the 10 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars, LCD televisions, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include showers, bidets, and hair dryers. Safes and daily housekeeping are also provided. Located in the heart of Venice, the hotel is within a 10-minute walk of the Rialto Bridge and the Basilica di Santa Maria Gloriosa dei Frari, and close to the Ca' d'Oro Giorgio Franchetti Gallery and Ca' Rezzonico.

211517.description: The Locanda Ca 'del Brocchi is a small building of the sixteenth century, entirely renovated, only ten minutes from Piazza San Marco and a few steps from the prestigious Guggenheim Museum and the new François Pinault arts center. The Inn enjoys a very quiet location and at the same time, central characteristics between streets, beautiful gardens, and a few minutes from the nearest vaporetto 'Accademia and Salute. ' All rooms are beautifully furnished in eighteenth century Venetian style with original wooden beams of the fifteenth century, are equipped with bathroom, air conditioning, mini safe, TV, minibar, and free Internet Wi-Fi.

211532.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace at this Art Deco hotel in Milan. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and take advantage of convenient concierge services. Additional amenities include a TV in the common area and a banquet hall. Dine at the on-site coffee shop/cafe, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Express check-in/check-out and complimentary newspapers are available in the lobby. The hotel offers 323 square feet of conference space for your events. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Relax in one of the 81 guestrooms featuring minibars and digital programming. Bathrooms include bidets and hair dryers. Safes and desks are provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Nearby attractions include Piazza della Repubblica (0. 4 mi), Corso Buenos Aires (0. 4 mi), and Indro Montanelli Public Gardens (0. 5 mi). The nearest airports are Linate (4. 6 mi), Milan Malpensa (31. 5 mi), and Bergamo Orio al Serio (31. 2 mi).

211535.description: Zeugma Hotel, a family-run establishment in the heart of Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, offers a welcoming home base for exploring the city's cultural treasures. This elegant and modern hotel provides all the amenities you need for a relaxing and convenient stay. The spacious, airy lobby offers a tranquil space to unwind, read, or catch up with friends. Just steps from the tram and public bus lines, Zeugma Hotel allows easy access to all parts of Istanbul. Cafés, restaurants, shops, and more are just minutes away. Come as a guest, leave as family.

211536.address: Kucuk Ayasofya Mahallesi Aksakal Sokak Kucu Mahall
211536.description:
Emmasaray Hotel is located in the heart of istanbul within walking distance to its highlights: Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace museum, Grand Bazaar, Spice Market, Basilica Cistern and
Byzantine Hippodrome.

The cruise ship terminal and railway station of the Orient Express are a few minutes away.

During your stay in Istanbul, Emmasaray Hotel offers you accommodation with warm hospitality. Modern Hotel needs and traditional Turkish House beauty and luxury meet in Emmasaray Hotel.
We will be your home away from home in Istanbul.

211541.description: A stay at Ca' Sagredo places you in the heart of Venice, within a 15-minute walk of St. Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge. This 5-star hotel is 0. 6 miles (1 km) from St. Mark's Basilica and 0. 7 miles (1. 2 km) from Doge's Palace. Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center and rooftop terrace. The hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and tour/ticket assistance. Make yourself at home in one of the 42 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. The hotel's L'Alcova Restaurant offers Italian cuisine and features a bar/lounge; room service is also available during limited hours. Local cuisine breakfasts are available daily from 7 am to 11 am for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limousine service, and express check-in. Event facilities consist of a conference center and a meeting room. Marco Polo Airport (VCE) is the preferred airport for Ca' Sagredo.

211547.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include gift shops/newsstands, a television in a common area, and a vending machine. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 15 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

211548.description: This splendid residence is beautifully located in the north west of the stylish city of Milan. The property lies just 2 km away from Porta Garibaldi train station. A wide range of attractions can be found nearby. The hotel is within easy access of MilanoFiera Citta and MilanoFiera in Rho Pero. This wonderful property is located in close proximity to a choice of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. The property features tastefully-designed guest rooms, which have been appointed in a contemporary style. The property offers facilities and services to ensure a comfortable stay for every type of traveller.

211551.description: Located in the heart of historic Venice, Antica Casa Coppo offers charming boarding rooms just a 5-minute walk from Rialto and St. Mark's Square. Guests can choose from superior, deluxe, and junior suites, all featuring private bathrooms with showers, hair dryers, and courtesy phones. Modern amenities include personalized climate control, satellite TV, direct phone lines, Wi-Fi, minibars, and safes, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

211552.description: Alloggi Serena offers a charming Venetian experience in the heart of Venice, conveniently located near the Saint Lucia railway station. Explore iconic landmarks like the Rialto Bridge, Canal Grande, and St. Mark's Basilica, all within walking distance. Enjoy a cozy breakfast room and a welcoming atmosphere complemented by friendly service. All rooms feature private bathrooms, free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and heating. Traditional Venetian furnishings and exposed beams create a pleasant setting for an affordable holiday. A separate apartment with a kitchen is also available.

211566.description: Just outside your apartment, you will feel the vibrancy of this ancient port city; seagulls flying overhead, the call to prayer, playful children walking home from school and a lively neighborhood going about its daily life. A two minute walk offers local merchants selling fresh baked bread, fruits and vegetables and all the necessities to stock your refrigerator and pantry as well as several wonderful neighborhood restaurants. Our incredibly central location is only a five minute walk to the hub of Istanbul's greatest Ottoman and Byzantine historical treasures including Hagia Sofia, Blue Mosque, the Byzantine Hippodrome, Topkapi Palace and the world famous Grand Bazaar. Hop on the nearby Metro and head to Eminonu Ferry Port for a cruise on the Bosphorus or across the Galata Bridge where modern Beyoglu, Taksim Square and the ancient Galata Tower await.

211567.description: Nestled in the heart of Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, this charming boutique hotel offers a welcoming atmosphere reminiscent of home. Since 1972, the Sultanahmet Hotel has provided guests with comfortable accommodations surrounded by vibrant shops and restaurants. The hotel's prime location places you mere steps from iconic landmarks, including the Blue Mosque (150m), Hagia Sophia (150m), the Basilica Cistern (100m), and Topkapi Palace (300m). Immerse yourself in the rich history and culture of Istanbul with the Sultanahmet Hotel as your perfect base.

211570.description: The Hotel Porta Romana is located in a quiet zone and it is well served by public transport, at 200 meters from the shops and restaurants of Corso Lodi. The rooms are equipped with private bathroom, balcony, hardwood floors, telephone, air conditioning and heating. The property is located 5 minutes walk from the metro Porta Romana and the Cathedral can be reached in about 25 minutes. Optional breakfast subject to availability with a supplement of €5 per person.

211571.description: Our B&B, situated in the historic centre of Venice, is a palace that dates back to 1500 and which faces one of the most beautiful squares(Campo) in Venice: Campo di San Francesco Della Vigna in the Castello area.At Alla Vigna, you can combine both modern technology with classic ambience and history.The rooms are marvellously decorated in the old Venetian style of times gone by. Alla Vigna is loved by many personalities of our Cinema Festival for its absolute tranquility, its closeness to major monuments and its marvelous atmosphere. Often writers and artists choose Alla Vigna as a place of inspiration and to resurrect magic moments. All our rooms have room service, air conditioned, sat tv, mini-bar, telephone and a wonderful view.The area is peaceful, quiet and with an atmosphere of the Francescan's that once lived there.

211577.description: Hotel Vienna is located only 200 metres from Lambrate Metro (Line 2) and Train Stations, which provide quick connection with Milan's centre and the Central Railways Station. This Hotel offers functional rooms with flat-screen TV and classic wooden furniture. Rooms have simple décor, a fridge, and a private bathroom with toiletries and hairdryer. Drinks can be enjoyed at the bar, open until late. Every morning in the breakfast room guests can enjoy a hearty buffet breakfast which includes fruit juice, cornflakes, jams, honey, butter, cheese, toast, yogurt and assorted brioches, all accompanied by a selection of coffees. Air-conditioning for the summer period with fee.

211582.description: Hu Venezia Camping in Town, nestled between Marghera and Mestre, is a convenient 10-minute drive from Venice and just 1 km from the A4 motorway. A bus stop located 600 meters away provides easy access to Venice-Mestre railway station and Piazzale Roma in Venice. The property offers complimentary parking, a bar and restaurant, a seasonal open-air swimming pool, and free WiFi in public areas. Guests can also purchase food and drinks at the on-site supermarket (typically open from May to September). Accommodation options range from mobile homes to bungalows, all featuring air conditioning and a private bathroom. Bed linen and towels are provided in each bungalow. Pets are welcome for an additional fee of €25 per animal per stay.

211597.description: The yeni hotel will certainly be a great budget option. Located in the city centre, this hotel is close to transport amenities and it is easy to reach from the airport. If you choose to stay in Hotel Yeni, you will experience the magnificent history of Istanbul by visiting the Topkapi Palace, The Blue Mosque, Saint Sophia, the Underground Cistern, Turkish Baths, the Grand Bazaar and more which are only in 10 minutes walking distance.

211600.description: Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Featured amenities include express check-out, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Make yourself at home in one of the 10 individually decorated guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and portable fans, and housekeeping is provided on request. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.
