211601.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an attached winery, a spa tub, and a sauna. This Edwardian hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekends from 7:00 AM to noon for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 32 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring fireplaces and heated floors. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed. LED televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. 211608.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Enjoy recreational amenities such as a sauna and fitness center. This Art Deco hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Savor a meal at the restaurant or enjoy room service (limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary daily reception, or relax at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily (7 AM to 10:30 AM, for a fee). A business center, express check-in/check-out, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge, 24 hours) are also available. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The 50 individually decorated guestrooms offer minibars, LCD TVs with satellite programming, and Select Comfort beds with down comforters and premium bedding. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Located near Neve Shalom Synagogue, Istiklal Avenue, and Pera Palace Hotel, with easy access to Istanbul Airport (IST) and Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW).

211609.description:
This hotel is a typical Milanese Villa atmosphere, on a real quiet and calm private street full of villas and trees. It is a 15-minute tram ride from Milan Central Station. The Duomo is 5 metro stops away. The popular shopping street of Via Buenos Aires is a 5-minute walk from the hotel.
Rooms are simply furnished and come with TV, telephone and a balcony. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The homely and welcoming management of the hotel are at entire disposition of its customer base so as to satisfy all the requests and the requirements of the guests and to ensure you have the most pleasant stay possible.

211631.description: Enjoy a round of golf or soak up the sun on the private beach at Hotel La Meridiana, located in Venice's Lido area, steps from Lido of Venice Beaches and a short walk from Palazzo del Casinò. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Take advantage of the 24-hour room service and relax with a drink at the bar/lounge or one of the two beach bars. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel also provides a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Each of the 33 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, Select Comfort bed with Frette Italian sheets, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Private bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Hotel La Meridiana is conveniently located 7. 6 miles from Piazzale Roma and 7. 2 miles from the Port of Venice.

211640.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at Hotel Wagner, located in Milan's De Angeli district. Start your day with a continental breakfast (fee applies) and utilize convenient amenities such as the computer station and 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. The hotel's 50 air-conditioned rooms offer flat-screen TVs, minibars, private bathrooms with rainfall showers, and complimentary toiletries. Stay connected with wired and wireless internet access. A short drive takes you to Santa Maria delle Grazie, the Leonardo da Vinci Museum of Science and Technology, and other key attractions. Linate Airport is the closest airport.

211656.description: Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Featured amenities include multilingual staff, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 15 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. This hotel is close to Piazzale Roma and St. Mark's Square.

211661.description: This Hotel is located in Milan's Porta Vittoria area, 100 metres from the bus and tram stops for the city centre. It offers free lobby Wi-Fi and rooms with flat-screen HD TVs and air conditioning. It offers cosy and elegant rooms with antique furniture. Some rooms offer a view of the hotel's relaxing garden. You can order aperitifs, cocktails and other drinks at Il Ritrovo, the hotel's American bar. It is decorated with ornate paintings and there is live music in the evenings.

211670.description: The Sipahi Hotel, established in 1910, enjoys a prime location in Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, nestled between the Vezirhan and the Artopolia road near Cemberlitas. This area is steeped in history, close to landmarks such as the Shrine of Mahmut II, the Court of Justice, the Hippodrome, and the Koprulu Library. From the hotel, guests can easily walk to major attractions including the Grand Bazaar, Egyptian Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Topkapi Palace. The hotel offers 57 rooms with a total of 100 beds, along with convenient amenities such as 24-hour room service and airport transportation (Istanbul Airport: 42 km, Sabiha Gokcen Airport: 49 km). We also provide on-site parking. Join us for a safe and memorable Istanbul experience.

211675.description: The Neptune Hotel is a 10-minute walk from Milan Central Train station and near the shopping area of Corso Buenos Aires. The rooms are equipped with private bathroom, hairdryer, bathroom, TV, telephone, alarm clock, heating, air conditioning and WiFi Internet. The property has English-speaking staff, 24-hour reception, luggage storage and vending machines for hot and cold drinks. The hotel is located close to shopping, restaurants and the subway stop.

211727.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the mid size, 3 star rated Ariston in Athens. Off site car parking is available. Hotel guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant on site. Room Features Ariston. All rooms have a hairdryer. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms. All rooms feature a stocked minibar.

211746.description: Set by the Città Studi area of Milan, Hotel San Giovanni offers colorful, rooms with attached bathroom, free Wi-Fi throughout. The Istituto Neurologico Carlo Besta hospital is 2297 feet away. Rooms at this 1-star hotel come with a work desk and a TV. The private bathroom is complete with shower and hairdryer. Breakfast includes sweet pastries and croissants, together with hot drinks. It is served in the dining room, or in the comfort of your room on request. Milan Porta Vittoria Train Station is 0. 6 mi from the San Giovanni Hotel. You can walk to Piola Metro Station in about 20 minutes, while Milan Linate Airport is 3. 1 mi away.

211828.description: London Hotel offers a great service in the historic center of Milan, an 8-minute walk from the Duomo. Cairoli Castello Metro Station is just around the corner. Guest rooms come with free WiFi, air conditioning and a satellite TV. Hotel London has a 24-hour reception and the multilingual staff are always available. In the neighborhood you will find Leonardo da Vinci’s Last Supper and Sforzesco Castle. You can catch the Malpensa Express train from Cadorna Station, 5 minutes away on foot.

211851.description: The IH Hotel Milano Lorenteggio is located in a major business district, approximately 30 minutes from Milan's historical center, with convenient access to public transportation. The nearby Bisceglie Metro Station provides easy access to major attractions, including the Fiera Milano in Rho, Fieramilano City, the Mi. Co. Milano Convention Centre, the San Siro football stadium, and the Central Railway Station. The hotel's 128 soundproofed rooms have been recently renovated and feature modern furnishings, air conditioning, and satellite TV. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. The hotel restaurant offers international and Italian cuisine, and a generous hot and cold breakfast buffet includes homemade pastries, savory options, and gluten-free choices. For meetings and events, the well-equipped Orchidea meeting room, located on the ground floor, can accommodate up to 60 people theater-style. A private two-level garage is also available for guests arriving by car.

211908.description: The hotel is located in the village of Ouirgane, 65 km from the Centre of the city of Marrakech. All accommodation decorated in a traditional style and the suites have a private terrace. You can enjoy local and international cuisine in the dining area in the open air, on request. The complex is located 1 km from the Toubkal National Park and 4 km from the dam of containment of Ouirgane and can help arrange tours and guided excursions.

211976.description: Hostal Las Flores, a charming inn fully restored in 2010, offers modern amenities for a comfortable stay. Guests can enjoy internet and telephone access in the lobby and convenient parking just 50 meters away. Located on Las Ramblas, opposite the world-renowned Mercat de la Boqueria and the Columbus monument, the hostel is a short walk from the vibrant Maremagnum entertainment area and only 15 minutes from the beach.

211979.description:
Discover a place where comfort, safety, and hospitality come first. Our hostel is designed to provide every guest with a clean, secure, and welcoming environment from the moment they arrive. We take great pride in maintaining high standards of cleanliness throughout the entire property, ensuring that every space feels fresh, comfortable, and well cared for. 

Our friendly and dedicated team is always available to assist you, whether you need recommendations for exploring the city or help during your stay. With attentive service and a warm atmosphere, we strive to make every traveler feel at home. 

Located in the vibrant city of Barcelona, our hostel offers the perfect balance between relaxation and convenience. After a day of discovering the city’s culture, architecture, and nightlife, you can return to a safe and comfortable space where you can truly unwind. 

Whether you’re visiting for adventure, culture, or relaxation, we are here to make your stay in Barcelona simple, enjoyable, and memorable.

211984.description:
The Hostal Abrevadero, situated in the centre of Barcelona, has everything you could need to make you feel at home. Our philosophy is to offers guests a good level of comfort and warm service.
Our guests are mainly international and consist mostly of couples or groups who spend a few days in Barcelona and are looking for high quality accommodation at affordable prices.
We like to treat our visitors individually, and offer them everything they need, from reception service, available 24 hours, to booking tickets for shows and events of all kinds.
The rooms are comfortable, practical and functional. They have an en-suite bathroom with shower and TV.
Every day the rooms are cleaned and any towels that have been used are changed.
For your convenience, all rooms include the following basic facilities:
Heating
26″ flat screen LCD TV
Wake-up call service
Fan

211994.description: This Barcelona guesthouse boasts a prime location just steps from Paseo de Gracia, renowned for its Modernist architecture and upscale shops. A variety of cozy rooms are available, some with private and others with shared bathrooms. All rooms feature amenities such as air conditioning, TVs, and refrigerators to suit diverse needs and budgets. Guests can also enjoy facilities including free Wi-Fi, a fax service, luggage storage, and vending machines for snacks and beverages.

211995.description:
Surrounded by wonderful places .
It is the perfect place to enjoy fantastic holidays discovering Madrid, being easily reachable from the main streets of the city such as Gran Vía and Alcalá Street. Opera metro stop is also few steps from our door.
Facilities offered by the Oriente include elevator, 24-hour reception, satellite TV lounge, free Wi-Fi access, air conditioning, free Internet point, full equipped rooms, as well as maps and tourist information about Madrid at the front desk.

212005.description:
The hotel has 48 fully equipped rooms, some of which have an attractive terrace overlooking the Mediterranean. Many of the other rooms also have lovely sea views.

The rooms are decorated in a simple and functional style, in order to provide maximum comfort and convenience to our customers.

212042.description: The property features a total of 33 guest rooms. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. The reception desk is open all day long.

212044.description: This hostel is situated in central Madrid. The property lies within easy walking distance of the lively Chueca District. The Gran Via is just 150 metres away. The area enjoys a bustling ambiance, with an abundance of tapas bars and restaurants. Fuencarral Street, which is renowned for its shopping opportunities, can be found just 80 metres away. This hostel is the perfect option for travellers who are seeking affordability, comfort and convenience in Madrid. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, offering a great setting in which to enjoy restful slumber at the end of the day. This hostel offers complimentary internet access, so guests can easily keep in touch with work or home.

212050.description: Hostal Luz offers comfortable accommodation in the heart of Madrid, providing easy access to the city's efficient public transportation system. Choose from single, double, triple, and quadruple rooms, each equipped with air conditioning, heating, a safe, and a TV with movies. The private bathrooms feature modern showerheads, hairdryers, and complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy 24-hour room service from our friendly staff. Additional amenities include an elevator, business center, tour desk, safety deposit boxes, and free Wi-Fi. The reception desk is available 24/7.

212060.address: Carrer del Torrent de l Olla, 161
212060.description: These stylish apartments are fully furnished in a new building just 4 minutes walk from Fontana Metro Station. They have a rooftop terrace overlooking the Gràcia district with its many bars, shops, cafes and restaurants. They have air conditioning, windows, modern decor and free Wi-Fi. The kitchen is equipped with hob, oven, dishwasher and toaster. The bathroom has a shower, heated towel rail and hairdryer. The Parc Guell, Sagrada Familia and La Pedrera, Gaudi's famous works, are within 20 minutes walk from the apartments. The bus number 39 towards the Barceloneta beach stops about 5 minutes walk. Private parking is available on request and for a fee.

212076.description: Modern, stylish Hostal rooms with private bathrooms in the elegant Eixample district (Arc de Triomf), conveniently located near metro, bus and airport train stations; short walking distance to Plaza Catalunya, las Ramblas, the fashionable Born district, Sagrada Familia, and the beach. Total renovation completed in 2015All rooms have 32” TVs, WiFi, modern heating and air conditioning & safe deposit boxes There is great variety of eating options around and knowledgeable staff can help with tourist directions and recommendationsThe comfort and amenities of three star lodging at budget prices. Adults only No pets allowed

212082.description: The 2-star Hostal El Pilar boasts an enviable location just 50 meters from Puerta del Sol, the heart of Madrid. Offering comfortable, classically decorated rooms and budget-friendly prices, it's an ideal base for exploring the city. Each room features amenities such as a TV, telephone, hairdryer, free Wi-Fi, safe, and private bathroom. While the hostal itself doesn't have a restaurant, the prime location on Puerta del Sol offers a wealth of dining options, from traditional tapas to international cuisine, right at your doorstep.

212105.description: Inside Barcelona Sants Apartments are ideally situated between Sants railway station and Plaça Espanya, near Carrer de Sants, offering excellent transport links for both leisure and business travelers. For business guests, the apartments are just minutes from the Barcelona Trade Fair Centre and the metro. Leisure travelers will appreciate the independent accommodation and easy access to city attractions. Montjuïc Park, with its stunning city views, is nearby, and Carrer de Sants, one of Barcelona's main shopping streets, is just steps away.

212136.description: Situated in the heart of San Bernardo Street, this hotel occupies the fifth floor of a beautiful 19th-century building, complete with an elevator and stunning original features. Admire the intricately carved wooden ceilings, tiled floors, and granite walls gracing the building's entrance. Reception is open from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM (check-in after 11:00 PM incurs a €25 surcharge). The hotel offers air conditioning, heating, free Wi-Fi, a public computer, laundry service, fax/copy/scanner facilities, and telephone service at reception.

212142.description: This small charming hotel is housed in a 19th century building in the shopping and tourist centre of Madrid and boasts views of the famous Plaza Santa Ana. The 19 rooms are all equipped with all modern comforts, WiFi internet connection and specially negotiated prices with the parking in the square. Some rooms also boast views of the square. From here you can reach many of the main tourist sites on foot, including the Puerta del Sol, the Plaza Mayor and sites of cultural interest such as the Museo del Prado, the Thyssen-Bornemisza and the Theatre Español.

212173.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 1 PM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 24 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

212192.description: The recently renovated Hostal Boqueria, located in the heart of Barcelona, offers a comfortable and convenient stay. Guests can enjoy amenities such as internet access, telephone in the lobby, and nearby parking. The hostel's prime location provides easy access to the city's main historical, architectural, and tourist attractions. A variety of single and double rooms are available, each equipped with a private bathroom, hairdryer, satellite TV, heating, air conditioning, safe, and key card access.

212194.description: Hostal Felipe 2 is centrally located in a Modernist building just off Diagonal Avenue, less than a 5-minute walk from Verdaguer Metro Station and only 10 minutes from Sagrada Familia. All rooms feature flat-screen TVs and wooden floors, with either private or shared bathrooms. Some rooms also have balconies and most have air conditioning/heating. Bed linens and towels are included, along with housekeeping every other day. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property, and the common area offers guest computers with internet access from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM. A safe is available at reception, and luggage storage is provided. Each room has two keys, and there's no curfew. Reception is open from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Guests arriving after 10:00 PM are kindly requested to call or email us to arrange their late check-in.

212206.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the mid size, 2 star Hostal Mare Nostrum in Barcelona.  Rooms at the Hostal Mare Nostrum are recently renewed. Hostal Mare Nostrum is located at the city center of the city. All rooms feature a hairdryer. We are sorry, but smoking is not permitted in either the bedrooms or the public areas of the hotel.

212210.address: Carrer de Bretón de los Herreros, 26
212210.description: The 3-star Aparthotel Silver in Barcelona offers comfortable accommodations with convenient amenities. Guests can enjoy on-site car parking, a restaurant, and an airport shuttle service. All rooms feature a hairdryer, iron and ironing board, tea and coffee making facilities, and Wi-Fi. The hotel welcomes pets and provides a concierge service. Accessibility features include wheelchair access to the hotel, reception, and bar, along with designated disabled parking spaces.

212241.description:
The hostel's privileged position in the heart of the Eixample district allows you to easily walk through Barcelona´s cultural heart, with streets such as La Rambla and Passeig de Gracia in the local area. The Barcelona City Hotel is situated within easy walking distance of the city's famous Modernist buildings. These include La Pedrera and the Casa Amatller.

All rooms at the hotel are air conditioned and heated and provided with free Internet connection.

The hotel offers a 24-hour front desk and is totally smoke-free. Breakfast is served daily.

212336.address: King Abdel Aziz Road Malaz District
212336.description: Located in the heart of Riyadh, this hotel is within 3 mi (5 km) of Riyadh Zoo, King Faisal Conference Hall, and Prince Faisal bin Fahd Stadium. National Museum of Saudi Arabia and King Abdulaziz Historical Center are also within 3 mi (5 km). 24-hour fitness center and a bar/lounge. Self parking is free. Other amenities include a coffee shop/café, a 24-hour business center, and conference rooms. 86 rooms feature kitchenettes with refrigerators and microwaves, plus minibars and room service. Guests will also find coffee makers, free newspapers, and safe

212512.address: Mimar Mehmet Aga Cad.Amiral Tafdil Sk.Sultanahmet, 17
212512.description: Enjoy amenities such as bicycle rentals and a terrace with stunning views. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall. Take advantage of the 24-hour room service, and end your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage are also available. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the nine guestrooms featuring minibars and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms offer separate bathtubs and showers, jetted bathtubs, and rainfall showerheads. Conveniences include phones, safes, and electric kettles. Located in Istanbul's Sultanahmet district, the Romantic Hotel Istanbul is within a 10-minute walk of the Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque. This hotel is also conveniently close to Sultanahmet Square and the Basilica Cistern.

212553.description: The completely renovated Hotel Venezia welcomes guests to an elegant and refined setting. Run by the Rossetto family since 1955, this 3-star hotel is centrally located in Mestre and offers free parking, allowing guests to easily access Venice's historic center via convenient bus and tram connections. The hotel features a dining room serving a sumptuous full buffet breakfast and an inviting lobby with a bar, comfortable sofas, and a TV. Luggage storage is also available upon request, free of charge.

name.content: Palazzo Contarini Della Porta Di Ferro Hotel

212556.description: After a careful restoration, Palazzo Contarini has been converted to a palace, provided with charming apartments and romantic Suites. The grandeur of the common spaces, joined with the style of the apartments will allow you to feel a unique experience where the magnificence of the ancient Venice will mix together with the modern comforts.

212576.description: This establishment offers 20 unique and exclusive apartments distributed in three National Architectural Heritage buildings, specially furnished as rental tourist apartments with capacity of up to 3 to 5 people. They feature basic amenities and services such as a full kitchenette and free WIFI access. Being centrally located in the very heart of the most visited historical and cultural neighbourhood of the city known as “Barrio Lastarria”, this modern apartments offer easy access to all areas of Santiago as they are just 15 minutes' walk from the city centre where visitors can find the famous central market, the main square “Plaza de Armas” and the Government palace.

name.content: Hilton Cancun Mar Caribe All-Inclusive Resort

212588.description: Sea breezes and turquoise waters welcome you to our prime beachfront location on Cancun's famed “Hotel Zone”. Our all-inclusive hotel offers 8 restaurants and bars plus a Grab & Go market. Wake up to ocean views, play all day with activities for the entire family, and round out the night with spectacular entertainment.

212675.description: A stay at Wander by Pillow places you in the heart of Barcelona, steps from La Rambla and Maritime Museum. This hostal is 0. 2 mi (0. 3 km) from Palau Guell and 0. 4 mi (0. 7 km) from Boqueria Market. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Featured amenities include luggage storage and an elevator. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. Make yourself at home in one of the 8 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include electric kettles and blackout drapes/curtains, and housekeeping is provided daily.

212702.description: Hostal Mh Fuencarral guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 15 units. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. Hostal Mh Fuencarral provides 24-hour reception. Some services may be payable.

212739.description: The Hotel Jardín de Aranjuez is located on Avenida del Príncipe, one of the main streets in the center of Aranjuez, leading to the Royal Palace and Prince's Gardens. The hotel offers a variety of room types, including double, single, and junior suites, to suit your needs. Each room is spacious and comfortable, ensuring a relaxing stay in Aranjuez. All rooms are air-conditioned and equipped with a television, digital satellite channels, a minibar, internet access, a safe, a telephone, a whirlpool tub, amenities, and a hairdryer.

212768.description: Guests checking into the 2 star Hostal Gat Xino in Barcelona are assured of a warm welcome. The hotel offers off site car parking. Guests can enjoy a meal at the hotel restaurant. Room Features Hostal Gat Xino. Smoking in certain bedrooms is allowed, as well as in public areas of the hotel. Please specify when making your booking. Rooms have wireless internet access available.

212809.description: La Casa De La Plaza guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 4 units. Those staying at this establishment may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. La Casa De La Plaza offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. Some services may be payable.

212810.description: The one-star Hotel Curious offers comfortable accommodations in Barcelona. While onsite parking isn't available, offsite options are provided. Guests can enjoy the convenience of an onsite restaurant, airport shuttle service, and concierge. Wi-Fi is available in all rooms, each equipped with a hairdryer. Please note, smoking is not permitted. The hotel welcomes pets and offers disabled facilities, including wheelchair access to the hotel, reception, bar, and conference areas. Leisure facilities are also available.

212815.description: Located in Madrid, the 1-star Hostal Abel Victoriano offers a convenient and budget-friendly stay. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the hotel restaurant. Wi-Fi is available in all rooms. Please note that this is a non-smoking property. Additional amenities include an airport shuttle service and a concierge. Pets are welcome.

212817.description: Travellers will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay on the premises, as it counts with a total of 11guest rooms. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Guests will appreciate the 24-hour reception. Some services may be payable.

212941.description: Hotel Montmelo is less than 2 km from the Circuit de Catalunya race track, venue of the Formula One Spanish Grand Prix. It has free Wi-Fi and satellite TV. The rooms in the Montmelo Hotel are light and spacious. Each has air conditioning and a private bathroom. There is a lounge with daily newspapers and TV. There is also a public computer with free internet access. Montmeló offers good access to the AP-7 motorway, which leads to Girona and France. Roca Village shopping centre is just 10 km away.

212949.description: Guests checking into the 2 star Hostal Lk Barcelona in Barcelona are assured of a warm welcome. Dining is available at the hotel, which has it's own restaurant. Rooms at the Hostal Lk Barcelona. Smoking in certain bedrooms is allowed, as well as in public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking if you require smoking. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms.

212961.description: Hosteria Grau Guests checking into the 2x000D star rated Hosteria Grau in Barcelona are assured of a warm welcome. The hotel offers restaurant facilities. Rooms at the Hosteria Grau. Smoking is permitted in certain bedrooms (please specify when booking) and the public areas of the hotel.

212974.description: With a small number of only 5, this hotel is very convenient for a quiet stay. Travellers can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the establishment. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

212985.description:
The  hostel is  situated  in the  very heart  of  the  city  near  all the places of  interest. 
Colourfully decorated in red and white, the rooms feature a work desk and wooden floors. The private bathroom comes with a hairdryer and amenities.
Many bars, shops and restaurants are within a short walk of the Hostal Inn Madrid. It is just opposite a large El Corte Inglés Shopping Centre.
A laundry service is offered and there is a tour desk. Many city sights can be visited on foot. Plaza Mayor and the Prado Museum are a 10-minute walk away.

213008.description:
Hostal El Ninot is small but chic and comfortable. We think that is possible to offer good and clean rooms at a reasonable price. The hotel has new owners since September 2012 and all rooms have been refurbished.

The hotel is strategically located, close to every important tourist attraction in Barcelona but also to important business areas like "La Fira" or Diagonal Avenue. 

It is also close to excellent restaurants and tapas bars. It is, in summary, an good hotel for a good price.

213036.description: The charming Life Design Hotel enjoys a wonderful location in the center of Madrid, steps from the famed Gran Via. Attractions such as Plaza España, the Royal Palace, Almudena Cathedral, Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor, and the Prado and Thyssen-Bornemisza Museums are within walking distance. Various metro stations are a five-minute stroll away. The cozy, stylish interior by Luis Delgado is inspired by nature, featuring wooden elements and bright rooms with a vintage touch. Well-appointed rooms offer air conditioning, work desks, and comfortable beds with reading lamps. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, a free internet point, a guided Segway city tour, and airport shuttle service. A hip hotel with excellent value.

213110.description: Located in the center of Piraeus, 656 feet from the main port, Central Railway Station, metro station, suburban railway station, bus stops and shops, the family-run Niki Hotel offers elegant rooms with free Wi-Fi. A hot tub and 24-hours room service are featured. The hotel offers air-conditioned, soundproofed rooms and suites with TV and radio. Extra long beds are featured in all Hotel Niki’s rooms. Daily cleaning service is provided. Guests can order continental breakfast in their room. The bar offers snacks and drinks throughout the day. A 24-hour reception service is available. The airport bus line as well as lines connecting to Athens’ city center run through the bus station located 1640 feet from the hotel. Private parking is possible across Hotel Niki Piraeus, upon charge. The beach is a 17-minutes walk away.

213118.description: A 10-minute drive from FieraMilano Exhibition Center and the San Siro Stadium, Star Hostel offers rooms and dormitories with free Wi-Fi. Bus 57 stops just outside, reaching the city center in 20 minutes. Located on the 5th floor of a residential building with an elevator, the Star Hostel provides bright dormitories with modern bunk beds and a shared bathroom, as well as private rooms with en suite bathrooms and parquet floors. Restaurants, bars, and a supermarket are within a 5-minute walk. Taking bus 57 from the Via Varesina - Via Mola stop connects to the metro's green and red lines, providing access to Milano Centrale and Milano Cadorna train stations. Trams and buses to the exhibition center stop 500 meters from the property, and the A4 Milan-Brescia Motorway is a 7-minute drive away.

213124.description: Maison Venezia Una Esperienze is located in the heart of Venice, in the charming district of Cannaregio, one of the oldest neighbourhoods of the city. The historical building has been restored and the interior renovated in modern Venetian style enhanced by Murano glass chandeliers. The 4 star hotel overlooks the beautiful Canal Priuli and is just 5 minutes walk from the Rialto Bridge, the Venice Casino, and 10 minutes from the magnificent Piazza San Marco, political and religious heart of the city. The central position, makes it easy to find local restaurants and taste the authentic Venetian cuisine. The Maison Venezia Una Esperienze can be reached from the Santa Lucia Train Station on foot in about 15 minutes, or by ferryboat in a few stops.

213167.address: 20Th Km Parnithos Ave Acharnes 13671 Athens Greece
213167.description: Don't miss out on recreational opportunities including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Grab a bite to eat at CHALLET, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, express check-in, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 60 guestrooms featuring refrigerators. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Parnitha National Park - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Regency Casino Mont Parnes - 4. 7 km / 2. 9 mi- Antonis Tritsis Park - 9. 2 km / 5. 7 mi- Olympic Athletic Center - 12. 3 km / 7. 6 mi- Tatoi Palace - 12. 7 km / 7. 9 mi- KAT Hospital - 12. 9 km / 8 mi- Athens Medical Center - 14. 1 km / 8. 7 mi- Mall Athens - 14. 1 km / 8. 7 mi- Spyros Louis Olympic Stadium - 14. 2 km / 8. 8 mi- IASO Hospital - 15. 1 km / 9. 4 mi- Golden Hall - 15. 5 km / 9. 6 mi- Hygeia Hospital - 15. 6 km / 9. 7 mi- Mitera Maternity Hospital - 15. 8 km / 9. 8 mi- National Archaeological Museum - 16. 3 km / 10. 2 mi- National Theatre of Greece - 16. 6 km / 10. 3 mi. The nearest major airport is Athens Intl. Airport (ATH) - 38. 8 km / 24. 1 mi Located in Acharnes, Parnis Palace Hotel Suites is connected to the convention center, within a 15-minute drive of Parnitha National Park and Antonis Tritsis Park. This upscale hotel is 11. 3 mi (18. 1 km) from Syntagma Square and 11. 9 mi (19. 1 km) from Acropolis.

name.content: Antico Doge - a Member of Elizabeth Hotel

213212.description: The Palazzo del Doge Falier, nestled near Piazza San Marco and the Rialto Bridge, has been passionately restored with meticulous attention to detail. Elegantly furnished with original antiques, the comfortable rooms offer amenities such as Jacuzzi tubs (in select rooms), separate showers, hairdryers, satellite TV, direct-dial telephones, complimentary Wi-Fi, individually controlled air conditioning, and safe-deposit boxes. A continental breakfast buffet is also provided. Nearby attractions include the Ca' d'Oro palace, the Jewish Museum, Teatro Malibran, and the renowned La Fenice opera house.

213219.description: The 3-star Arco Romana Hotel is conveniently located 100 meters from the Porta Romana Metro Station and 20 meters from Terme di Milano spa in Milan's Bocconi University district. The Porta Romana area, a vibrant hub in the heart of Milan, offers a variety of restaurants and wine bars and is just a 15-minute walk from Navigli, Milan's lively nightlife district. Excellent tram and metro links provide easy access to the Duomo (3 metro stops), Milan Central Train Station (7 stops), the Rho convention center (30 minutes), and the San Siro Stadium (20 minutes). Rooms feature simple, modern furnishings and include a private bathroom, balcony, TV, minibar, central heating, individual air conditioning, and free Wi-Fi. The Arco Romana Hotel's 24-hour reception desk offers helpful staff to assist you in planning your Milanese stay.

213307.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a reception hall. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 32 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Your bed comes with down comforters and Frette Italian sheets. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

213376.description: Pamper yourself at the full-service spa at the Courtyard Vienna Prater/Messe. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, gift shops, and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy a meal at Franz&Flora or a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available (fee applies). Business amenities include a 24-hour business center and complimentary newspapers. Host your event in the hotel's 8, 608 sq ft (800 sq m) of meeting space. Self-parking is available (fee applies). The 251 guest rooms feature minibars, plasma TVs, complimentary wired and wireless internet, private bathrooms with toiletries and hair dryers, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Located near Messe Wien, Prater, and the Danube River. The preferred airport is Vienna International Airport (VIE).

213405.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and shopping on site. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the complimentary area shuttle that operates within 2 km. Grab a bite to eat at the hotel's restaurant, where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Assago? This hotel has 2691 square feet (250 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 159 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions.

213424.description: Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Continental breakfasts are available daily from 8:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 11 guestrooms, featuring kitchens with stovetops and microwaves. Your bed comes with down comforters and Frette Italian sheets. 43-inch flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Piazzale Loreto - 0. 5 km / 0.

213446.description: Enjoy rooftop terrace and garden views at Hotel Exarchion, located in the heart of Athens. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a common area television. Dine at the snack bar/deli or enjoy room service (limited hours). A bar/lounge and buffet breakfast (available for a fee, 7 AM - 10 AM) are also provided. The 49 guestrooms feature refrigerators, flat-screen TVs, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, desks, and electric kettles. Daily housekeeping is included. You'll be just a 4-minute walk from the National Archaeological Museum and a short drive from Syntagma Square.

213527.description: Welcome to the 3-star Hotel Susa in Milan. We offer convenient on-site and off-site parking. Enjoy a delicious meal at our restaurant, stay connected with Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, and utilize our meeting facilities for your business needs. All guest rooms include a hairdryer, a well-stocked minibar, and internet access via Wi-Fi or modem. For your leisure, Hotel Susa provides a range of amenities. We also offer an airport shuttle and concierge service, and we're happy to welcome your pets.

213552.description: Dioskouros The 1x000D star Dioskouros is situated in Athens. Guests can dine at the hotel restaurant. Room Facilities Dioskouros. Smoking is permitted in both the bedrooms and the public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms.

213560.description: The Foivos Hotel is situated in Athens. Guests can enjoy a meal at the hotel restaurant. Room Facilities Foivos Hotel. A hairdryer is provided in every room. Leisure Info. Leisure facilities are available at the Foivos Hotel. Other Info. The hotel offers an airport shuttle service. The hotel is pet friendly. Hotel guests can make use of the concierge service that is provided.

name.content: The Royal Islander - An All Suites Resort

213669.address: Boulevard Kukulkan km 17.5, Lt Zona Hotelera
213669.description: Boasting a unique location close to the beach, this hotel offers magnificent views over the Caribbean and the Nichupte Lagoon in the vibrant Cancun. Ideal for holidaymakers looking for a sunny beach holiday, this complex offers a peaceful ambience and time-honoured hospitality to guarantee a memorable stay in this luxurious property. Visitors may have the chance to sign up for a round of golf at a nearby golf course or explore ancient Mayan temples at El Rey. The tastefully-decorated villas feature a host of modern amenities and boast breathtaking views over the ocean. Complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection is available for guests' convenience.

213685.description: The 3-star Hotel Ares offers a comfortable stay in Milan, conveniently located near the city center. Guests can enjoy amenities such as on-site parking, a daily breakfast buffet, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Its 13 rooms are spread across three floors, accessible by elevator, and feature amenities including a minibar, air conditioning, hairdryer, toiletries, and an LCD flat-screen TV. Pets are welcome, and the reception is open 24/7.

213702.address: Cumhuriyet Cad. Turna Sok. No 11 Taksim Istanbul
213702.description: Turna Apart Welcome to the Turna Apart in Istanbul. Guests can enjoy a meal at the hotel restaurant. Rooms at the Turna Apart. Smoking is permitted in certain bedrooms (please specify when booking) and the public areas of the hotel. Rooms have wireless internet access available. Additional Info. The hotel offers an airport shuttle service. Pets are welcome at the hotel. Hotel guests can make use of the concierge service that is provided.

213710.address: Piyer Lotti Cad. Göktaş Sokak., 7/7 A
213710.description: The Istanbul Comfort Hotel Old City, a 3-star establishment, offers convenient on-site parking and a comfortable restaurant for guests to enjoy. Located in Istanbul's historic Old City, each room provides wireless internet access and smoking options are available upon request. The hotel also offers an airport shuttle and concierge service.

213717.description:
In the heart of old Istanbul, Tulip House is only a quarter mile from the Blue Mosque and a 10 minute walk from Hagia Sophia. It provides spacious rooms with free wireless internet access.
Hotel Tulip House was originally built as a mansion during the Ottoman Empire. Each of the rooms is fully air-conditioned and includes original architectural features and high ceilings. Some rooms have a private balcony with sea views.
Each morning, guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast on Tulip House's shaded terrace. Several traditional falafel stands and restaurants offering international cuisine are a 5 minute walk from the hotel.
There is also a tour desk that assists with car rental and offers information on local attractions.
Hotel Tulip House is less than half a mile from the Grand Bazaar and is a 5 minute walk from Sultanahmet

213724.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at Hotel Fontana, centrally located in Venice, a short walk from St. Mark's Square and the Bridge of Sighs. The hotel offers 15 guestrooms, each featuring a pillowtop bed, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Doge's Palace and St. Mark's Basilica are within a 5-minute walk from this conveniently located hotel.

213745.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a garden. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 18 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Smart televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and slippers.

213779.address: Ordu Cad 59 Laleli Turkeyordu Cad Nr 59 Lale
213779.description: Centrally located in Istanbul, Hotel Bazaar is a 9-minute walk from the Grand Bazaar and 14 minutes from Süleymaniye Mosque. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a daily buffet breakfast, and 24-hour room service. Guests can enjoy the convenience of concierge services, a restaurant and bar/lounge, and a complimentary daily reception. The 36 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, LCD TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads, and safes. Nearby attractions include the Blue Mosque (2. 6 km) and Hagia Sophia (3. 4 km).

213788.address: Kemankes Mah Gumruk Sok Karakoy Beyoglu Istanbul, 7
213788.description: Enjoy stunning Bosphorus views from our garden at the Galata Palace Hotel, located in Istanbul City Center. We offer complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and 24-hour room service. Start your day with our buffet breakfast (fee applies). Our 21 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, LCD TVs, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. We also provide express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. An airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies). We're a short walk from Galata Tower and Galataport.

213789.description: The Lanterna di Marco Polo hotel enjoys a prime location in the heart of Venice, just 250 meters from St. Mark's Square and a short walk from the Rialto Bridge. Recently renovated, it offers modern rooms furnished in Venetian style, each equipped with a TV, mini-bar, air conditioning, and en-suite bathroom. Free Wi-Fi is available in every room. Please inform the hotel of your estimated arrival time and method of transportation (train, car, or plane) after booking to receive directions and a map. Reception is open until 3 PM. For arrivals after this time, notification is required to obtain the access code.

213791.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the small Ca Maria Callas in Venezia. Dining is available at the hotel, which has it's own restaurant. Rooms at the Ca Maria Callas. A hairdryer is provided in every room. There is a no smoking policy throughout the hotel. Rooms have wireless internet access available. All rooms feature a stocked minibar.

213801.description: Whether your visit involves a busy business schedule or a carefree holiday, Istanbul welcomes you to the Bucoleon Palace Hotel in the heart of the Old City, once the center of the Byzantine and Ottoman Empires. Though newly established, the Bucoleon Palace Hotel strives to offer the best hospitality and service. The hotel's Art Deco architecture is a standout feature. Four suites and a terrace offer exceptionally wide, panoramic views of the Sea of Marmara. Four rooms overlook the Blue Mosque, and two rooms have neighborhood views. Located in the old city center, the hotel is approximately a 12-minute walk from the Grand Bazaar and a 4-minute walk from the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Topkapi Palace.

213804.description: Tosca The Tosca (rated 1x000D star) is a mid size hotel in Jesolo. Both on and off site car parking is available. Dining is available at the hotel, which has it's own restaurant. Rooms at the Tosca. Smoking is permitted in both the bedrooms and the public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms. All rooms feature a stocked minibar. Other Info. An airport shuttle service is available from the hotel. Pets are most welcome at the hotel. Hotel guests can make use of the concierge service that is provided. The hotel has disabled facilities with wheelchair access to the hotel, reception, restaurant, bar and disabled car parking spaces areas of the hotel.

213806.description:
The Luxx Hotel just a 5-minute walk from Topkapi Palace and the Blue Mosque.
All rooms of Hotel The Luxx have air conditioning, satellite TV, and a minibar. Room service is available 24/7.
Every morning a local and international buffet breakfast is served. Food and drinks are available in The Luxx Hotel throughout the day.
The hotel's tour desk can help guests organize trips throughout Istanbul. Most of Istanbul's top attractions, such as Hagia Sofia and the Grand Bazaar are within walking distance of the hotel.

213808.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at this Istanbul city center hotel, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Savor local cuisine breakfasts (fee applies) or utilize room service during limited hours. Amenities include express check-in/out, a 24-hour front desk, airport shuttle (surcharge), and self-parking (fee applies). The 12 guestrooms offer minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and coffee/tea makers. Located within a 10-minute walk of the Egyptian Bazaar and Grand Bazaar, Septimum Hotel is also conveniently close to Topkapi Palace and Sultanahmet Square.

213809.description: Aldem Hotel is a charming accommodation with character in Sultanahmet, Istanbul. Enjoy the beautiful view on the city from the roof terrace. The classical hotel building was recently renovated but retained its unique character and authentic style. The hotel and the rooms are elegantly decorated with warm colours and fine antiques. The rooms are comfortable and equipped with a TV, mini bar, safe, air conditioning and heating. There is a beautiful roof garden cafeteria with a terrace for drinks and snacks. Discover the great views of Istanbul from here. At night, the city is colourfully lit and turned into a romantic city skyline. The hotel is conveniently located in the heart of the Sultanahmet. At walking distance, there are many historic attractions to see. The tram station is only 3 minutes away from the hotel and can take you to several parts of the city. For your convenience, free Wi-Fi is available through the entire hotel. Aldem Hotel captures the unique essence of Istanbul. The attentive and friendly staff will be happy to help you with any questions you may have about transport or local attractions. Fatih is a great choice for travelers interested in monuments, architecture and history. This is our guests' favorite part of Istanbul, according to independent reviews. This property also has one of the top-rated locations in Istanbul! Guests are happier about it compared to other properties in the area.

213819.description: Located in Milan's fashion district, Palazzo Segreti is a 10-minute walk from the Duomo and 300 meters from the Cairoli Castello Metro Station. This hotel seamlessly blends traditional Italian design with modern amenities, offering an elegant and unique experience. Guests can explore Milan's cultural attractions and experience its vibrant business scene. The carefully appointed double rooms are nestled within the building's historic walls, featuring modern comforts such as high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, minibars, and safes. Please note that check-in requires contacting the hotel in advance via email (info@palazzosegreti. com) or phone (+390249529250). Front desk hours are from 2 pm to 6 pm.

213828.description: Enjoy a central Jesolo location at Hotel Marco Polo, just a short drive from Piazza Brescia and Piazza Mazzini. This beach hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge or grab a snack from the snack bar/deli. A continental breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Each of the 33 air-conditioned rooms features a refrigerator, flat-screen TV, and private balcony or patio. Satellite programming and complimentary toiletries are also provided. Luggage storage, laundry facilities, and self-parking (for a fee) are available.

213840.description: Hotel Flora is located in San Marco area in Venice, 7 minutes from Piazza San Marco and a 10 minutes walking distance from the pier where you can board the boats to visit the islands of Murano, Burano and Torcello. The Hotel offers a buffet breakfast served in the garden with handmade products, sweet and salty and accompanied by typical italian beverages, gym and bar serving light meals and drinks, the reception is open 24 hours a day. All rooms are equipped with modern amenities such as free WiFi internet access, air conditioning and private bathroom.

213870.description: Situated in Taksim, the heart of Istanbul, Promise Hotel is just a few steps from the popular Istiklal Street. The hotel is structured in an historical building, offering air-conditioned rooms and free Wi-Fi. The modern rooms of Promise are decorated in light colours with wooden floors. They all feature LCD TV with satellite channels and a minibar. All rooms include a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer. Some rooms have balconies overlooking the city. Guests can also have breakfast in their rooms. Hotel Promise is next to the famous Nevizade Street, offering many restaurants, bars and historical Turkish tavernas for night entertainments. The closest tram and bus stations are within 5 minutes' walking distance

213896.description: Hotel Palazzo Guardi is situated in Venice's Accademia area, a 10-minute walk from Piazza San Marco and the Rialto Bridge. Easily accessible by public transport, the nearest boat stop is just a 2-minute walk away, with service running day and night. The Accademia Art Gallery and the San Trovaso Squero (gondola shipyard) are mere steps from the hotel. Within a 5-minute walk, you'll find the Peggy Guggenheim Collection, the 18th-century Cà Rezzonico museum, the La Fenice opera house, and the Salute Basilica. The area boasts a wide variety of restaurants. Hotel Palazzo Guardi occupies two adjacent buildings. One features a magnificent original lounge with a breathtaking canal view, while the other houses a beautiful breakfast hall adorned with authentic 15th-century wooden beams.

213902.address: Mimar Hayrettin Mah Gedikpasa Cad Fatih Istanbul
213902.description: Istanbul, the land of fairy tales welcomes you hospitably in Sayeban Hotel which is located in Gedikpaşa – an amazing place where you can feel the smell of history and touch the treasures hidden in this magic city. Gedikpaşa is situated on the North part of the famous Byzantine seaport. Surrounded by Byzantine remainings, Gedikpaşa is a very old and hystorical residential area. In a unique place Sayeban Hotel provides you with a wonderful view of mosques and churches in the same frame with the sight of Istanbul and the sea of Marmara.Our Hotel is in the heart of such ancient and famous places as Sultanahmet, Mahmutpaşa, Eşilderek, Kapalı Çarşı (Grand Bazaar), Laleli and Beyazıt and it takes you just five minutes by foot to reach these important places which are famous all over the world and attracts million of tourists every day.

213903.description: The 3-star Aer Hotel Malpensa in Oleggio offers convenient on-site parking and dining in its restaurant. A no-smoking policy is in effect throughout the hotel. Guest rooms feature stocked minibars and wireless internet access. The hotel provides an airport shuttle, concierge service, and welcomes pets. Accessibility features include wheelchair access to the hotel, reception, restaurant, bar, and conference facilities, as well as designated disabled parking spaces.

213911.description: To start the day in the best possible way, Palazzo Barbarigo will pamper you in the morning with a wide selection of delicious à la carte breakfast menus, served in the elegant breakfast room. If you prefer absolute privacy, take advantage of the impeccable room service, and let the pastry and colourful flavours of the menu delight you in your room. After a walk to discover the wonders of the floating city, enjoy a relaxing moment in the lounge bar of the Palazzo, for a drink or an aperitif, or to enjoy a cold dish and quick snack. Enjoy the pride of this hotel, the balcony overlooking the Grand Canal with table and chairs, to admire the splendid views of the Grand Canal while sipping a cocktail.

213917.description: Mercure Istanbul Bakirkoy offers air-conditioned rooms with a flat-screen TV. Facilities include a wellness centre with an indoor pool. The rooms at Istanbul Bakirkoy Mercure Hotel are decorated with pastel colours, dark wooden furniture and floor-to-ceiling windows. All rooms have a seating area, a minibar, and an en suite bathroom. Guests can get a relaxing massage at the wellness centre, which also features a sauna, a fitness centre, and a Turkish bath. The hotel also offers a 24-hour reception, free private parking and free Wi-Fi throughout the premises. Blue Regency Hotel's restaurant serves traditional Turkish dishes as well as international cuisine. The bar offers a wide variety of refreshments.

213934.description:
Set in the vibrant heart of Milan, Uptown Palace with its 176 rooms is a refined 4-star hotel, just a 10-minute walk from Piazza del Duomo and the iconic Milan Cathedral. Its strategic location makes exploring the city effortless, with the yellow line M3 (Missori Station) and the new Blue Line M4 (Santa Sofia station) directly connected to Linate Airport in just 15 minutes. 
Perched on the 13th floor, Orizzonti restaurant offers breathtaking panoramic views over the Duomo, Torre Velasca, and Milan’s skyline, creating an extraordinary backdrop for every dining experience. Guests can also enjoy breakfast with the same spectacular panoramic views, an unforgettable way to start the day overlooking Milan’s skyline, unwind at the inviting bar or take advantage of room service available during selected hours for added comfort and convenience. 
Rooms combine contemporary style with absolute comfort. Soundproofed and air-conditioned, they feature Sky TV and complimentary WiFi, while selected rooms include a separate living area and private balcony. Elegant bathrooms come with complimentary toiletries, and all rooms offer a kettle; higher categories also include an espresso machine and complimentary water on arrival. 
Designed for both business and leisure, the hotel features versatile, fully equipped meeting spaces ideal for conferences and corporate events. 
Further amenities include a 24-hour airport shuttle (extra charge), car hire, taxi service, ticket assistance, laundry and dry cleaning, luggage storage, safety deposit boxes, and on-site parking (extra charge). 
Address: Via Santa Sofia, 10, 20122 Milan, Italy
CIR Code: 015146-ALB-00421
CIN Code: IT015146A1DREVIGX3

213951.description: Istanbul Shamrock Hotel A warm welcome awaits you at the mid size, 3x000D star Istanbul Shamrock Hotel in Beyoglu/istanbul. Guests can dine at the hotel restaurant. Room Facilities Istanbul Shamrock Hotel. A hairdryer is provided in every room. Rooms have wireless internet access available.

213963.description: The Hotel Da Scarpa (rated 2 star) is a small hotel in Punta Sabbioni Venezia. The hotel offers off site car parking. Dining is available at the hotel, which has it's own restaurant. Rooms at the Hotel Da Scarpa. Smoking in certain bedrooms is allowed, as well as in public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking if you require smoking. Leisure Info. The Hotel Da Scarpa offers a range of leisure facilities. Other Info. An airport shuttle service is available from the hotel. Pets are made most welcome at the hotel. Hotel guests can make use of the concierge service that is provided.

213964.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 47 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. 213965.description: Welcome to the 3-star Hildegard Hotel in Alanya, Antalya. Enjoy on-site parking and dining in our comfortable restaurant. Each room features a hairdryer, minibar, and internet access via Wi-Fi or modem. Wireless internet is also available in public areas. The hotel maintains a strict no-smoking policy. For your leisure, the Hildegard Hotel offers various facilities and an airport shuttle service. We also welcome pets and provide a concierge service. The hotel is equipped with disabled facilities, including wheelchair access to the hotel and reception areas.

214008.description: One of the best advantage of the Ercan Apart Hotel for our guest is its location.Our Hotel is not only so close to the city center but also the old city.So our guests are able to walk around and visit historical places 24 hours.Our Hotel is just 400m away from ancient Hypodromme,Blue Mosque,Turkish Islamic Artifacts Museum,Hagia Sophia,Underground Cistern and 500 m away from the Topkapi Palace and Archeological Museum.	Also the tram station is just 350 m away from our Hotel. As the Ercan Apart Hotel with all theese advantages our first aim is to provide dear our guests the best service and quality.While drinking your tea and coffee in our terrace which open 24 hours you enjoy your holiday.Also you can get detailed information about the city, transfers organisations,city tours,and some other organisations from our reception.

214009.description: Located in Milan's Città Studi district, Hotel Aspromonte offers convenient access to Corso Buenos Aires and the Carlo Besta Neurological Institute, both within a 5-minute drive. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, a bar/lounge, and room service. Each of the 19 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, LED TV, and private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Concierge services and luggage storage are also available. Self-parking is offered onsite (subject to charges). Linate Airport is the closest airport, approximately 4. 4 miles away.

214024.description: Located in Istanbul (Istanbul City Center), Ista Palace Hotel is within a 10-minute walk of Grand Bazaar and Beyazit Square. This hotel is 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Hippodrome of Constantinople and 1 mi (1. 6 km) from Blue Mosque. Featured amenities include express check-in, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 13 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include electric kettles, and housekeeping is provided daily.

214026.description: Located in Venice's Cannaregio district, Hotel Rossi is a short walk from Piazzale Roma and the Grand Canal. This hotel offers 14 individually decorated guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and blackout curtains. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers with rainfall showerheads and bidets. Concierge services and babysitting are available (surcharge). Luggage storage and a safe deposit box are provided at the front desk. The hotel is within a 10-minute walk of the Venetian Ghetto, Scalzi Bridge, and the Jewish Museum of Venice. It is also a convenient base for exploring other Venetian attractions, with the Port of Venice 6. 6 miles and Porto Marghera 5. 8 miles away.
