214032.description: With a stay at The Empress Theodora, you'll be centrally located in Istanbul, within a 5-minute walk of Basilica Cistern and Hagia Sophia. This hotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 4 km) from Sultanahmet Square and 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from Topkapi Palace. Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8 AM to 10 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 18 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

214063.address: Cankurtan Mah Mimar Mehmetaga Cad Amiral Tafdil, 18
214063.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul, Oceans 7 Hotel is a charming bed and breakfast within a short walk of iconic landmarks such as the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. Guests can enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast, relax on the rooftop terrace with stunning views, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel offers 15 air-conditioned rooms equipped with modern conveniences, including flat-screen televisions, refrigerators, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Additional amenities include 24-hour room service, concierge services, and an airport shuttle for a surcharge.

214079.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting in Bogota. The property is situated close to major business centres, as well as upscale dining options, entertainment venues and tourist attractions. This hotel offers the ideal option for business and leisure travellers visiting the city. This superb hotel enjoys an attractive design. The guest rooms provide comfort and elegance, designed in a minimalist style with neutral tones and luxurious details. The hotel offers personalised service for guests' comfort and convenience. The hotel features a lounge bar, which enjoys stunning views over the Bogota skyline. This hotel offers the perfect option for business and leisure travellers alike.

214088.address: Derb Dabachi,Derb Moulay Abdelkader N52, NA
214088.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a hot tub and a steam room. This riad also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at La Table de Fatima, a restaurant which specializes in Moroccan cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 11 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 7 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

214090.description:
This traditional Moroccan house of six rooms, is located in Medina, close to the Ben Youssef Madrasa, the Museum of Marrakech and 10 minutes from the Jemaa El Fna. 

Simple and comfortable, this renovated house offers charming patio with a fountain, 2 terraces with a nomad tent and a solarium where guests can unwind while sipping mint tea at any time of the day. 

This Riad is a typical house, completely renovated in every detail for your comfort. In this haven of peace, hospitality and friendly service you at any time give the impression that you feel at home. 

Riad Dar Nael is also famous for its cuisine, you can enjoy Moroccan specialties.

214109.description: Facade Hotel Amsterdam is located just a 5-minute walk from Amsterdam Central Station. The hotel offers comfortable accommodation, Free WiFi is available throughout the property. Each room has a private shower, a flat-screen TV. Reception is open 24 hours a day. Facade Hotel Amsterdam is located 10 minutes from the main attractions, such as the Anne Frank House and the Royal Palace. Several cafés and theaters are within walking distance of the hotel.

214125.description: Located in the heart of Amsterdam, Hotel de Munck offers 16 individually decorated guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi and en-suite bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a garden, luggage storage, and a microwave in the common area. The hotel is within a 15-minute walk of Rembrandt Square and the Heineken Experience, and conveniently close to other attractions like the Flower Market and ARTIS.

214126.description: This budget hotel in Berlin's Wedding district offers free Wi-Fi and great transport links. The Kurfürstendamm shopping street is 15 minutes away by underground. The privately run Steps-Hotel has rooms and apartments with modern, functional furniture. A small beer garden is located in the courtyard. Free Wi-Fi is available in the entire hotel. The reception and bar are open 24 hours a day. The Nauener Platz and Seestraße U-Bahn (underground) stations are 5-10 minutes away on foot. They offer direct links to sights including Checkpoint Charlie.

214137.description: Guests will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay on the premises, as it counts with a total of 6units. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. Everyone staying at this accommodation may contact the reception desk any time during the day. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

214139.address: The Red House Av El Yarmouk Hivernage
214139.description: Luxury hotel nested in the heart of one of the most upscale quarters of Marrakech, the Hivernage district. The Red House hotel features a traditional Hispano-arabic architecture that still keeps its oriental charm. At the same time it features a clean-cut interior design so that guests enjoy a level of comfort that you will find in very few palaces of the world. From this hotel you will be able to visit the main places of interest of the city as, for example, the Jemaa el Fna square, the Koutoubia and the Majorelle gardens. It offers 4 rooms and 4 suites, all of them comfortable and spacious, and equipped with amenities that live up to its category: air conditioning, heating, TV, free Wi-Fi, fireplace, mini bar, etc. The Red House hotel has a Moroccan lounge, ideal for enjoying your teatime amid the maximum peace; a Louis XIII style lounge, with fireplace and rolling bar; and a perfumed garden where you will enjoy your morning walks. Relax by the hotel's pool and enjoy the finest Moroccan cuisine in its restaurant.

214164.description: Enjoy a stay at the Altstadt Hotel, nestled in the heart of Zürich. Take advantage of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, a restaurant, café, bar/lounge, and bicycle rentals. A buffet breakfast is available for a fee on weekdays. The hotel also offers concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), express check-in/check-out, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge). Each of the 25 guestrooms features a minibar, flat-screen TV with cable, and a private bathroom. You'll be within a 15-minute walk of Bahnhofstrasse and ETH Zurich, and a short distance from attractions like Grossmünster and the Kunsthaus Zürich.

214175.description: The establishment consists of 30 accomodation units. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night.

214181.description: A total of 20 accomodation units are available for guests' convenience. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the hotel. Hotel Neufchatel does not offer 24-hour reception.

214185.description: Experience a warm welcome at the charming 4-star Riad Des Arts in Marrakech. Enjoy delicious meals at the onsite restaurant. Each room features a hairdryer and offers both Wi-Fi and modem internet access. Wireless internet is also available in public areas. Take a refreshing dip in the indoor swimming pool or take advantage of the convenient airport shuttle and concierge service. Pets are welcome. Please note, smoking is permitted in designated areas; specify your preference when booking.

214188.description: Welcome to the 3-star Hotel Sirolo in Sirolo, Italy. Enjoy a meal at our on-site restaurant. Business travelers can utilize our Wi-Fi and meeting facilities. All rooms feature a stocked minibar, and select rooms permit smoking. Please specify your preference when booking. Unwind in our sauna or take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool. For the active guest, we offer an 18-hole golf course, mountain bike rentals, and horseback riding. Additional amenities include an airport shuttle, concierge service, and pet-friendly accommodations. The hotel also offers disabled facilities, including wheelchair access to the hotel, reception, bar, conference facilities, and designated parking spaces.

214191.address: 160 Derb El Ferane Sidi Ahmed Soussi Medina, 160
214191.description:
Classified first class guest house, this former home of 12 AC rooms and suites with private bathrooms, Riad Dar El Aila is located in the heart of the Medina of Marrakech, has been completely restored and renovated by a French couple respecting architecture and traditional Moroccan materials. 

The Riad is built around two courtyards: the first with a heated pool, a spa with hammam and relaxation area care and Eastern; the second with a garden and a fountain, all on a large area with large terraces and stunning views of the Atlas Mountains. 

Dar El Aila is located in a quiet area in the heart of the Medina of Marrakech at the entrance to the souks and 10 minutes walk from Jemaa El Fna.

214203.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and a vending machine at this conveniently located Brussels hotel. Start your day with a continental breakfast, available for a fee from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM. The hotel offers 27 guestrooms equipped with LCD TVs, cable programming, and private bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, desks, and portable fans. Luggage storage and a safe deposit box are available at the 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available onsite for a fee. Located in the Sint-Gillis district, Hotel de France is a short drive from Avenue Louise and Manneken Pis Statue, and within easy reach of La Grand Place and the Brussels Christmas Market.

214205.description: This family-run hotel is situated in a historic building on the picturesque Grote Markt in Haarlem. Amadeus benefits from an internet café, terrace and a lounge with traditional Dutch décor. Each of the rooms at Amadeus Hotel features a TV, work desk and tea and coffee making facilities. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast every morning. The Centrum bus stop is 280 metres away. Hotel Amadeus is a 5-minute walk from the Teylers Museum. Zandvoort and the beach are 20 minutes’ drive from the hotel.

214214.description: This tropically decorated guesthouse is situated in a classic Amsterdam canal house, originally built in 1777 on the city's former coastline. The façade retains its original gable stone, depicting an island with three palm trees. Guests receive a warm welcome and enjoy uniquely decorated rooms offering a true home away from home experience. A delicious breakfast is available, served either in our cozy kitchen or in the comfort of your bed. Please note, our renowned in-bed breakfast service is exclusively for guests staying in our Patio rooms. Located in one of Amsterdam's prime areas for exploration, most tourist attractions are within easy walking distance. The central station, providing access to all forms of public transport, is a leisurely five-minute stroll away.

214222.description: Enjoying a prime location in the heart of Geneva, only 5 minutes from the Cornavin Railway Station, the cosy and intimate family hotel Tor offers modernly designed and fully equipped accommodation. Housed in a classical old building, the hotel is close to the lake and within walking distance of the main shopping areas, international organisations and businesses. Tor Hotel combines the charm of high ceilings and old wooden floors with a contemporary new decoration. The different types and size of rooms will suit either business clients or tourists.

214226.address: 34 Derb Lahbib Lmagni Riad Zitoun Jdid Medina
214226.description: Located right in the heart of Marrakech, this hotel welcomes its guests with its unique atmosphere and homely-like ambience. All of its bright and airy rooms feature an outdoor terrace and a patio where one can spend the warm evenings drinking tea and conversing with his/hers companions. There is also a comfortable patio furnished with couches and chairs, where the guests are offered a warm and fresh drink service. Those looking for a little extra pampering at the end of their day can visit the Hammam or treat themselves with a massage. The in-house restaurant serves a delightful menu consisting of both local and international favourites, while those who prefer a little less polished experience can visit the nearby Medina and have their pick from the numerous food stalls there.

214228.description: This designer establishment lies in grounds covering more than 2 hectares in the heart of a Marrakech palm grove. It is just 3 km from the Medina and the airport is conveniently close, 15 m by taxi, which guests can reserve from the 24 h. reception desk. The hotel boasts an on-site art gallery and a host of amenities, including 6 pools and complete spa facilities. Visitors will be surprised to find a cinema on the premises with over 300 films available. Those who like fitness can work out in the gym and if sport is the preference the tennis courts can be booked or guests can amble over to the nearby golf course (3 km.) for a round, before returning for lunch/dinner at the hotel restaurant, which serves mainly international food but is willing to prepare traditional Moroccan cuisine or other special dishes on request. Most of the spacious rooms overlook the garden or a pool.

214232.description: Less than 100 metres from Jemaâ El Fna Square, this guest house is just a 5-minute walk from the Koutoubia Mosque. It features a hammam, a swimming pool and rooftop terrace with views of the square and the Atlas Mountains. The rooms and suites at Riad Le Rubis are decorated in a traditional style using tadelakt paint. Each one provides free Wi-Fi access, views of the patio and air conditioning. Some rooms also include a seating area. On the interior patio, on the terrace or in the dining room is where the guest house offers a continental breakfast. You can also sample traditional Moroccan cuisine such as tajines in the restaurant. Tours, excursions and transfers can all be organised at the 24-hour reception. Medina is a great choice for travellers interested in souks, shopping and markets.

214237.address: Deniz Mh. Konya Alti Cad. 124. Sokak, 8
214237.description: Located in the heart of the city of Antalya, this hotel is ideally positioned for exploring the many historical and sight-seeing attractions which are abundant in this part of Turkey's Mediterranean Coast. Within walking distance of the charming Kaleici, once the Inner Bailey of the city, guests can explore narrow streets full of souvenir shops and quaint cafe bars which line the streets leading up from the old harbour. For beach lovers, the city's Konyaalti beach is approximately a 15 minute walk. Furnished in a simple style, the hotel features a lobby lounge and breakfast room and during the hot summer months, guests can benefit from a refreshing dip in the roof terrace pool.

214250.description:
Whether you're looking to relax in a stylish hotel or party in a cool design hostel, MOSAIC HOUSE has got it all! The Design & Music Hotel opened on November 21, 2013, after an extensive renovation and refurbishment. With a resident music bar located on the ground floor, a great central location, a fully non-smoking environment and many award-winning eco features, MOSAIC HOUSE is the place to be.
Accommodation-wise, MOSAIC HOUSE has something for everyone. From ultra modern and hip private rooms to cozy shared rooms AND two amazing Penthouse rooms with spectacular views of Prague! ALL our rooms have private bathrooms including a shower or bathtub plus a host of amenities, free WiFi and AC.

214262.description: Hotel Monopole welcomes you to the heart of Amsterdam! This comfortable family hotel, situated on the canal, offers most rooms with views of Amsterdam's picturesque canals, providing a quintessential city experience. Located near popular museums, lively bars, excellent restaurants, Dam Square, Central Station, the Flower Market, major shopping centers, open-air markets, relaxing parks, and Amsterdam's vibrant nightlife, Hotel Monopole is ideal for those who appreciate nostalgic charm and personalized service at an affordable price. We're happy to provide information about Amsterdam and Holland. Our modern rooms and apartments are fully equipped with private bathrooms, TVs, minibars, and other amenities to ensure a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

214274.address: Rue El Gza Arrset Ihiri Bab Doukkalla, 71
214274.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the mid size, 3 star Riad Jddi in Marrakech. Both on and off site car parking is available at the hotel. Dining is available at the hotel, which has it's own restaurant. Meeting facilities and wifi are available. Room Features Riad Jddi. All rooms have a hairdryer. Smoking is permitted in both the bedrooms and the public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking. There are excellent internet access facilities with broadband access via modem or wifi in rooms. Wifi is also available in public areas of the hotel. All rooms have tea and coffee making facilities. Leisure Info. Leisure facilities are available at the Riad Jddi. Additional Info. The hotel offers an airport shuttle service. Pets are made most welcome at the hotel. A concierge service is provided for guests.

214278.address: Kucuk Ayasofya Mah Kadirga Liman Cad Bardakci Sok
214278.description: Sultanahmet King Palace Welcome to the Sultanahmet King Palace in Istanbul/sultanahmet. No on site car parking is available at the hotel, however off site car parking is available. Dining is available at the hotel, which has it's own restaurant. Room Features Sultanahmet King Palace. All rooms feature a hairdryer and iron and ironing board. There are excellent internet access facilities with broadband access via modem or wifi in rooms. Wifi is also available in public areas of the hotel. Tea and coffeee making facilities together with a minibar are available in all rooms. Additional Info. An airport shuttle service is available from the hotel. The hotel is pet friendly. Hotel guests can make use of the concierge service that is provided.

214291.description: The Hotel Vienna Urban was designed by a famous Viennese architect, and has 43 rooms equipped with cable TV, free Wi-Fi and a large bathroom. This hotel is 200 meters from the Schönbrunn Metro Station (line U4), which connects in 10 minutes to the city center and 10 minutes walk from the Palace and Schönbrunn Zoo, in the Vienna's 15th district. The breakfast is not included in the rates. The guests can book the breakfast directly at the hotel for 5, 30 Eur per person and day.

214309.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, shopping on site, and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The aparthotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. Limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 72 guestrooms, featuring kitchenettes with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and stovetops. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. 120-cm LCD televisions with digital programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided on request. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. The preferred airport for Lux 11 Berlin Mitte is Berlin (BER-Brandenburg) - 28 km / 17. 4 mi A stay at Lux 11 Berlin Mitte places you in the heart of Berlin, within a 10-minute walk of Alexanderplatz and Berlin TV Tower. This boutique aparthotel is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Museum Island and 2 mi (3. 1 km) from Brandenburg Gate.

214320.description: The 3-Star Superior Boutique Hotel Herbergh Amsterdam Airport, a family-owned establishment, provides complimentary shuttle service to Schiphol Airport and convenient access to the train station. Guests enjoy free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout their stay. Each room features a TV, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries, and tea and coffee making facilities. The on-site Brasserie La Bouche offers breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Breakfast is served from 7:00 am to 10:30 am (12:00 pm on Sundays), while à la carte lunch and dinner are available from 12:00 pm to 10:00 pm (closed on Sundays). Enjoy your meal in the brasserie or relax on the outdoor terrace.

214326.description: The Hotel La Legende (rated 3 star) is a mid size hotel in Bruxelles. The hotel has both on and off site car parking available. Guests can dine at the hotel restaurant. Room Features Hotel La Legende. There is a no smoking policy throughout the hotel. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms. Other Info. An airport shuttle service is available from the hotel. The hotel is pet friendly. A concierge service is provided for guests.

214327.description: easyHotel Amsterdam City Centre offers guests a convenient location to explore the city, with well-connected bus and tram stops just a short walk away. With brilliant basics such as comfortable beds, super-fast free WiFi, black out curtains, TV and air-conditioning, our en-suite rooms provide all the essential amenities for a great night’s sleep. Extras such as such as hairdressers, irons, extra cleaning and late check-out and early check-in can be purchased from our 24-hour reception. We encourage you to discover the local cuisine while here, but if you get peckish during your stay, we have a vending machine with drinks and snacks. The hotel is ideally situated near a number of Amsterdam’s favourites, with Museum Square, the RAI Convention Centre and the Heineken Experience conveniently found less than a 15-minute walk away. It is also a short 20-minute drive from Amsterdam airport.

214333.description: This comfortable hotel is located in Charlottenburg. All guests staying at this property will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Hotel Art Nouveau as it counts with a total of 21 accomodation units. Hotel Art Nouveau offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Unfortunately, the front desk is not open 24 hours. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

214341.description: The 2 star rated Hotel Berlin Markischer Hof Am Tacheles is situated in Berlin. The hotel offers on site car parking. Guests can enjoy a meal at the hotel restaurant. Room Facilities Hotel Berlin Markischer Hof Am Tacheles. There is a no smoking policy throughout the hotel. Rooms have wireless internet access available.

214344.description: Situated in a beautifully renovated historic bank in Amsterdam's charming Jordaan district, this contemporary 22-room hotel offers exceptional convenience. A short 10-minute walk from the central railway station, Anne Frank House, and a mere 15 minutes from the Royal Palace, it's an ideal base for exploration. Embrace Amsterdam's cycling culture with the hotel's bike rentals and packed lunch options, perfect for scenic day trips. Start your day with a delightful continental buffet breakfast before venturing out. In the evening, savor Mediterranean-inspired cuisine at the hotel's jazz and soul-infused restaurant. Each guest room boasts city views, an en-suite bathroom, and modern amenities, including air conditioning and soundproofing. Designated smoking areas and complimentary Wi-Fi are also available throughout the hotel.

214355.description: The 4-star Riad Samsli offers a luxurious escape in Marrakech. Guests can enjoy on-site dining, meeting facilities, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each room features a hairdryer and tea/coffee making facilities, while select rooms permit smoking. A refreshing indoor pool is available for guests' leisure. The hotel also provides an airport shuttle and concierge service, and welcomes well-behaved pets.

214361.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Hotel The Lodge Vilvoorde, conveniently located within a 15-minute drive of NATO Headquarters and King Baudouin Stadium in Vilvoorde. Make use of the spa tub, sauna, and fitness center. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a banquet hall. The 56 guestrooms feature minibars, flat-screen televisions with cable programming, and private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, desks, and weekly housekeeping. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Brussels Airport (BRU) is the closest airport, just a short drive away.

214367.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a television in a common area. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Hotel Augusta. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Make yourself at home in one of the 45 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and blackout drapes/curtains. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. The nearest major airport is Berlin (BER-Brandenburg) - 29. 9 km / 18. 6 mi With a stay at Hotel Augusta, you'll be centrally located in Berlin, steps from Kurfürstendamm and 13 minutes by foot from Zoo Berlin. This hotel is 2. 9 mi (4. 7 km) from Potsdamer Platz and 3. 4 mi (5. 4 km) from Brandenburg Gate.

214372.description: This simple budget hotel is located in the Tiergarten park. Its 49 inviting accommodations provide the perfect place to relax at the end of the day. The hotel offers Wi-Fi internet access in all public areas and rooms. This is not a pet-friendly property. The reception is open from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Check-in is possible from 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM. For later check-in, please contact us and you will receive an access code.

214378.description: Enjoy a central Geneva location at Hotel De Geneve, situated within a 5-minute drive of the Jet d'Eau Fountain and the United Nations European Headquarters. This hotel offers 39 guestrooms equipped with LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and desks. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, gift shops/newsstands, and a coffee shop/cafe. Luggage storage, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby are also available. Nearby attractions include Notre Dame Basilica (0. 2 mi), the City Center Shopping Area (0. 4 mi), and the Grand Theatre Opera (0. 5 mi). Geneva International Airport (GVA) is 3. 3 miles from the hotel.

214407.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, the Sultanahmet Inn offers a warm welcome and dedicated customer service. This charming inn features 16 guest rooms, each equipped with direct-dial telephone, air conditioning, private bathroom with hairdryer, cable TV, minibar, and double-glazed windows. Some rooms offer stunning sea views. Guests can also enjoy 24-hour room service. Experience an exquisite stay at the Sultanahmet Inn, nestled in Istanbul's ancient center, once the capital of the Byzantine and Ottoman Empires.

214414.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the mid size, 2 star Hotel Agora in Amsterdam. The hotel offers off site car parking. Hotel guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant on site. Room Facilities Hotel Agora. Smoking is permitted in certain bedrooms (please specify when booking) and the public areas of the hotel. There are excellent internet access facilities with broadband access via modem or wifi in rooms. Wifi is also available in public areas of the hotel. Other Info. The hotel offers an airport shuttle service. Pets are made most welcome at the hotel. Hotel guests can make use of the concierge service that is provided.

214415.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at the Boutique & Art Hotel Helvetia, a stylish hotel offering complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Indulge in the on-site restaurant with its delightful garden view, or order room service during limited hours. Unwind at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. A continental breakfast is available weekdays for a fee. The hotel also features a hair salon, access to a nearby fitness facility, and a banquet hall. Each of the 36 individually decorated guestrooms boasts heated floors, a flat-screen TV, premium bedding, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Modern conveniences include a desk, electric kettle, and phone with free local calls. The hotel is conveniently located near Swiss Casinos Zurich, the Old Botanical Garden, and other popular attractions. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge, and self-parking is available on-site for a fee.

214422.description: The 3-star Atrium Hotel Charlottenburg is situated in the heart of Berlin, near the renowned Kurfürstendamm. The Charlottenburg and Wilmersdorfer Strasse U-Bahn stations are just minutes away, providing easy access to Berlin's top attractions, including Charlottenburg Palace, the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, the Berlin Zoo and Aquarium, KaDeWe department store, the Brandenburg Gate, and Potsdamer Platz. All 58 comfortably furnished rooms feature a telephone, satellite TV, safe, modem connection, and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. The friendly staff ensures a pleasant stay. The Atrium Hotel Charlottenburg offers excellent value. Please note that the local city tax is not included in the room rate and is payable upon check-in.

214456.description:
Riad Bibtia is located in the Mouassine district, in a quiet street, close to the bustling souks that will take you a few minutes to the famous Jemaa el Fna, the heart of the imperial city that is rightly called "the pearl of the South "... Marrakech will seduce you. 

The riad offers six comfortable rooms with air conditioning. The large patio is composed of a large open living room with painted ceiling with a large wall fountain zellig, a large table where you will be served delicious Moroccan meals cooked by us and two lovely bedrooms. 

On the second floor you'll find a lovely sun terrace and a solarium where you can enjoy stunning views of the Koutoubia, Marrakech's medina and the Atlas mountains and peaks ...

214459.address: Riad Adriana 99 Derb Jdid Bab Doukkala
214459.description: Riad Adriana Welcome to the luxurious, 4x000D star rated Riad Adriana in Marrakech.

214466.description: On the Anatolian side of Istanbul, Boutique Princess Hotel is located 4. 5 km from Boğaziçi Bridge and 1 km from the TEM motorway. The hotel offers free Wi-Fi and free parking. Rooms are extremely spacious and tastefully furnished. Suites have a work desk and increased living space. A minibar is standard. The hotel's à la carte restaurant serves examples from Turkish and world cuisine. You can relax in the hot tub. Sabiha Gokcen and Ataturk airports are a short drive away.

214468.address: Alemdar Caddesi Guzel Sanatlar Sokak N11 Su Istanb, 11
214468.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 8:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 9 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and slippers.

214469.address: Sultan Ahmet Mahallesi, Amiral Tafdil Sk. No:26, 26
214469.description: This comfortable boutique hotel, located in Istanbul's Old City, offers easy access to the city center and public transport. Completely renovated in 2011, this 20-room hotel provides a relaxing retreat. Guests enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and a 24-hour reception. While cots and pets are not permitted, the hotel offers a convenient transport service and a wide selection of meals. Business travelers will appreciate the hotel's business amenities, though some may incur additional fees.

214471.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at this Maia hotel, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi and convenient amenities. Grab a snack at the on-site deli or enjoy room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge after a busy day. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). A 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities are also provided. Free self-parking is available on-site. The 27 air-conditioned rooms offer minibars, Smart TVs, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Phones and safes are also included, and housekeeping is provided daily. Located in Maia, Hotel Aeroporto is centrally located, a short drive from Porto Historic Center and Norte Shopping. It's also conveniently close to Maia Zoo, MAR Shopping, and Quinta de Santa Cruz Winery.

214472.description: Surrounded by the Tagus Estuary Natural Reserve, hotel São Lourenço offers rooms with panoramic views of the village of Samora Correia. The main motorways are a few minutes away. The rooms of São Lourenço feature a simple interior. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, satellite TV, and a private bathroom. Guests can relax in the common living room, or play billiards in the games room. Hotel São Lourenço also offers a 24-hour reception, a laundry, and a tour desk. A local and international buffet breakfast is served in the breakfast room every morning, or if requested, in the guest’s room. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of drinks at the cozy bar. The Church of Nossa Senhora da Oliveira is just a 5-minute drive away, and the Jericó Convent is a 20-minute drive away. Free on-site parking is available.

214477.description: B-Aparthotel Montgomery offers studios and apartments directly on the majestic Montgomery Square. Enjoy easy access to the EU Quarter with its fabulous parks, gardens, European institutes, and museums. Excellent public transport connects you to the historical center and the airport is just a few stops away.

214479.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, a fireplace in the lobby, and tour/ticket assistance. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. A shuttle from the hotel to the airport is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 28 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.
