The preferred airport for Hotel Victorie is Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS) - 14. 9 km / 9. 2 mi With a stay at Hotel Victorie in Amsterdam (Amsterdam South), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum. This hotel is 0. 8 mi (1. 2 km) from RAI Exhibition and Congress Centre and 2. 1 mi (3. 3 km) from Leidseplein.

214547.description: Located in Berlin's vibrant Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg district, Hotel Goldmarie is within a 15-minute walk of the iconic East Side Gallery and Mercedes-Benz Arena. This hotel offers 62 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Each room includes a desk and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Daily housekeeping is provided. Guests can also take advantage of convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and ATM/banking services. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Alexanderplatz is 2. 3 miles away, and Checkpoint Charlie is 3. 9 miles from the hotel. The closest airport is Berlin Brandenburg (BER), 14. 6 miles away.

214550.description: There are a total of 22 accomodation units at Avs Hostel. The front desk offers 24-hour reception.

214584.description: This charming urban hotel boasts a convenient location on the well-known Kurfürstendamm shopping street, in the western part of Berlin and at only 8 km from the city centre. The establishment offers great access to all the parts of the city as it is situated near the Subway Station. Travellers can find many shops, theatres and local attractions, such as the famous KaDeWe and the Europa-Center, in the immediate vicinity. The hotel features traditional rooms in a non-smoking environment, equipped with modern amenities and decorated in a typical Berlin old-fashioned architecture. Every morning, guests can start their day full of energy with a delicious breakfast buffet offered by the property and then continue their trip through the city. Please note that our reception is not open 24 hours a day. Our reception is open from 9am to 10pm.

214586.description: Located in Schaerbeek, Brussels, this hotel, owned and operated by the Shawada Group since 2006, welcomes you for short or extended stays. Our recently renovated 46 rooms offer comfortable accommodations at reasonable prices, whether you're staying for a night or several months. The hotel is easily accessible by various modes of transportation. Guests enjoy free internet access at reception and Wi-Fi connectivity in all rooms.

214601.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at Hotel PLATZHIRSCH, centrally located in Zürich, steps from Musee Visionnaire and Predigerkirche. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an on-site sushi restaurant and snack bar. Start your day with a continental breakfast (fee applies) and unwind in the bar/lounge. The 16 guestrooms feature minibars, satellite TV, private bathrooms with showers, hair dryers, and bathrobes. Safes and desks are also provided, along with daily housekeeping. Dry cleaning/laundry services and multilingual staff are available for added convenience. The hotel is 0. 8 mi (1. 3 km) from Grossmuenster and 0. 9 mi (1. 4 km) from St. Peter Church.

214618.description: B-Apart Hotel Ambiorix is ideally located in Brussels and only a stone throw away from the European Institutions, in the middle of the art deco residential area at the ‘Ambiorix Square'. The residence is easily accessible by public transportation with direct links to the airport, train station, historical center and shopping areas. The residence offers cosy and fully equipped accommodations, a penthouse as well as luxury hotel rooms some with balcony.

214619.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the small, 2 star Sun Hotel in Brussels. On site car parking is available. The hotel offers restaurant facilities. Room Features Sun Hotel. Smoking in certain bedrooms is allowed, as well as in public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking if you require smoking. Rooms have wireless internet access available.

214643.description: Hotel Hortus offers basic, non-smoking accommodations in Amsterdam's City Center, conveniently located near the Botanical Gardens. Each room accommodates up to four guests and includes free WiFi, a flat-screen TV, and a safe. Towels and bed linen are provided, and while rooms are accessible by stairs only, shared restrooms are available in the hallway. Guests enjoy 24-hour access to the hotel. Popular attractions such as the zoo, Hermitage Museum, local markets, and the Red Light District are within a 10-minute walk. The nearby metro and tram 14 provide easy access to the rest of the city.

214677.description: The Townhouse Hotel offers basic accommodations in the heart of Amsterdam’s canal district, a 20-minute walk from the Nine Streets shopping area. There is free Wi-Fi. The monumental building has rooms with shared facilities, while some rooms have a private shower. All rooms have a sink and coffee and tea facilities. The Townhouse Hotel does not offer meals, but The Utrechtsestraat around the corner is filled with bars, restaurants and cafés. Within an 30-minute walk you can reach the famous Anne Frank House. Tram stop Prinsengracht is a 2-minute walk away and offers direct access to Amsterdam Central Station.

214678.description: The guest-house Vera is situated very close to the heart of Vienna, with direct access to all public transport means such as bus, tram and underground connecting you to any point in the city, and is only a couple of minutes from guildhall, parliament and many other tourist attractions. The Pension is all the year open with a quiet family atmosphere, we guarantee your privacy.

214679.description: The Hotel is centrally located between Berlin West and East with a view of the Landwehr Canal. Many significant museums can be reached from here on foot or in just a few minutes with public transportation. The vibrant Kreuzberger Bergmann district is also in the immediate vicinity, as is the Potsdamer Platz with its many stores, cinemas and theatres. The rooms are fully equipped and feature a private bathroom. When the weather permits it, guests can enjoy the quiet courtyard, that offers an ideal spot to relax. A rich breakfast buffet can be enjoyed every morning at the breakfast room. Our rooms are professionally cleaned prior to your arrival. Use our cleaning service during your stay upon request at the reception. By avoiding unnecessary room cleaning, you help us reduce our water and cleaning agent consumption. This helps to reduce the environmental impact of your stay with us.

214704.description: Apart Hotel Grand Place is located in the historic city centre of Brussels, next to the Grand Place and the famous ‘rue de boucher' dining area. It is the ideal location to discover the treasures of the city such as the prestigious Galerie de la Reine and the National Museum of Art. The residence is easily accessible by public transportation & only 10 minutes away from the European Institutions & business quarters. The residence offers trendy accommodations, penthouse and very spacious executive rooms.

214710.description: The hotel Franziskaner is a house with charm and atmosphere. The central location in the old town with museums, attractions and shopping center within walking distance making it the ideal base for a fun-filled stay.

214731.description: This charming establishment boasts a prime location right in the heart of the city. Guests will find themselves close to a wide range of shopping and entertainment options. The popular Tiergarten park is also close to the hotel, whilst Brandenburg Gate, shopping boulevard Kurfuerstendamm, the vast KaDeWe shopping centre and Zoo Berlin and are just a few steps away. Tegel and Schoenefeld airports are about a 30-minute driving distance from the property. This 3-star hotel offers 72 comfortable rooms with TV, a small pantry-kitchen and complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection, ideal for guests travelling on business. As for the onsite services, those wishing to explore the city in a special way can rent a bike or even arrange a boat trip.

214756.description: Guests checking into the 2 star rated Victoria Hotel pension in Berlin are assured of a warm welcome. Off site car parking is available. Guests can enjoy a meal at the hotel restaurant. Room Facilities Victoria Hotel pension. There is a no smoking policy throughout the hotel. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms. Additional Info. An airport shuttle service is available from the hotel. The hotel is pet friendly. A concierge service is provided for guests.

214764.description: This welcoming urban hotel is based in the beautiful Art-Nouveau style building in the heart of City West. This attractive property features a reachable location to access the lively area with a famous department store and within a short stroll from the Gedächtniskirche and Bahnhof Zoo train station. The establishment offers light-filled and spacious rooms and suites. The units feature modern décor, commodious furniture and top-notch amenities, offering an oasis of peace and serenity in which to completely loosen up and relax at the end of the day. Guests may take advantage of a sumptuous breakfast buffet offers a wide range of choices to energize one's day and throughout the day enjoy a drink from the snug hotel bar. Travellers may also inquire with the friendly and attentive staff at the 24-hour reception for the best places to visit in Berlin.

214765.description: Design Hotel F6 The Design Hotel F6 (rated 3x000D star) is a mid size hotel in Geneve.

214778.description: Enjoy a central Barcelona stay at Apartments Ramblas 108, just steps from La Rambla and a 5-minute walk from Barcelona Cathedral. This aparthotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an airport shuttle (surcharge). Each of the 18 guestrooms features a kitchen equipped with a full-sized refrigerator/freezer, stovetop, and microwave. Relax with flat-screen satellite TV and enjoy the convenience of a laptop-compatible safe. Housekeeping is available upon request. Nearby attractions include Boqueria Market (0. 2 mi), Plaça de Catalunya (0. 7 mi), and Barcelona El Prat Airport (9. 5 mi).

214792.description: Welcome to Industriepalast, your hostel/hotel in Berlin's vibrant Friedrichshain district! Looking for affordable accommodation in the heart of the city? Look no further. Located on Warschauer Straße, where the Spree River connects the bustling restaurant and shopping district of Friedrichshain with the alternative nightlife of Kreuzberg. Our red brick building is just two minutes from Oberbaumbrücke and the East Side Gallery. Nightlife enthusiasts will find themselves in the perfect spot, with the city's best clubs just around the corner. Industriepalast also welcomes school groups, families, and individual travelers. Popular attractions like the Brandenburg Gate, Reichstag, Alexanderplatz, TV Tower, Holocaust Memorial, Potsdamer Platz, Ku'damm, and KaDeWe are all easily accessible.

214797.description: Just a stone's throw from Avenue de la Toison d'Or, the Aqua Hotel places you in the heart of Brussels, between the historic centre and the European quarter. In just a few minutes on foot, you can reach the Grand Place, the Magritte Museum or the European Parliament. A privileged location for exploring the city at your own pace, between culture, institutions and the Brussels way of life. The welcoming rooms combines modern comfort with a soothing atmosphere, ideal for relaxing after a day exploring the city.

214827.description: In the historic centre of Porto, the property offers contemporary accommodations within 403 m of the iconic Dom Luis I Bridge. An entirely non-smoking property, the hotel has 24-hour front desk services. The air-conditioned rooms feature views of the UNESCO-listed city centre. Equipped with private bathrooms and flat-screen satellite TVs, the rooms are spacious and functional. Popular nearby landmarks include the Palácio da Bolsa and The São Bento Train Station, 293 m away. The hotel is also a 10-minute walk to Guindais Funicular with services to Ribeira riverside quarter and Port Wine cellars. Guests can take advantage of the property's central location and discover many traditional restaurants serving Portuguese food and famous port wines. Vending machines for drinks and snacks are at the property.

214841.description: Enjoy a central Porto location at Hotel América, within a 5-minute drive of Porto Cathedral and Dom Luís I Bridge. This hotel offers 22 guestrooms equipped with LED TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies), and enjoy the convenience of a coffee shop/cafe, room service (limited hours), and a bar/lounge. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and self-parking (charges apply). Nearby attractions include the Chapel of Souls and Bolhão Market, both within walking distance.

214848.description: Located in Berlin's vibrant Mitte district, the luxurious 4-star Weinmeister Hotel offers on-site parking, a restaurant, meeting facilities, and complimentary Wi-Fi. All rooms feature Wi-Fi access and are non-smoking. Guests can enjoy a range of leisure amenities and utilize the convenient airport shuttle and concierge services. Pets are welcome.

214861.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hostel include complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and tour/ticket assistance. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Three Little Pigs Hostel Berlin. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Planning an event in Berlin? This hostel has 250 square feet (23 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 80 individually furnished guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms with showers are provided. Conveniences include safes and blackout drapes/curtains, and housekeeping is provided daily.

214882.description: Located in the heart of Amsterdam, Hotel Continental Amsterdam offers convenient access to Dam Square and the Royal Palace, both within a 10-minute walk. This hotel provides 33 guestrooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and hair dryers. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as concierge services, a 24-hour front desk, and a computer station. Nearby attractions include the Anne Frank House (1. 1 km) and The 9 Streets (0. 8 km).

214916.description: Amsterdam Canal Guest Apartment Situated in Amsterdam, the Amsterdam Canal Guest Apartment provides opulent 4x000D star accommodation. The hotel offers off site car parking. Dining is available at the hotel, which has it's own restaurant. Room Features Amsterdam Canal Guest Apartment. All rooms feature a hairdryer and iron and ironing board. There is a no smoking policy throughout the hotel. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms. All rooms have tea and coffee making facilities.

214937.description: With a stay at Hotel Kap, you'll be centrally located in Amsterdam, just a 4-minute walk from Heineken Experience and 9 minutes by foot from Rijksmuseum. This hotel is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Vondelpark and 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Rembrandt Square. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Featured amenities include multilingual staff, minifridges and shampoo/bodywash in bathrooms. A shuttle from the hotel to the airport is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Stay in one of 15 guestrooms featuring LED televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include portable fans, and housekeeping is provided daily.

214938.description: This modern boutique hotel occupies two fully renovated historic buildings in the heart of Amsterdam. It offers personalized service and a safe, ideal location for single travelers, business professionals, couples, friends, and families. The hotel boasts a prime location across from the beautiful Vondelpark, perfect for relaxation, and near bustling Leidse Square, home to a casino, vibrant clubs, bars, and restaurants. Exclusive shopping streets are just steps away, and the trendy Museum Square, with the Van Gogh Museum, Rijksmuseum, and National Concert Hall, is within a 5-minute walk. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Please note that room rates do not include the city tax, which will be 12. 5% starting in 2024, payable upon check-in.

214940.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at the Veluwe Hotel Stakenberg in Elspeet, featuring a sauna, bicycle rentals, and a cozy fireplace in the lobby. Savor delicious meals at our restaurant and your favorite drinks at the bar/lounge. Each of our 32 guestrooms offers modern amenities, including LED TVs with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). We also offer convenient amenities such as multilingual staff, luggage storage, a library, and four meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available onsite. Our location places you within easy reach of attractions like Klimbos Garderen (7. 9 mi) and Walibi Holland (18. 1 mi).

214960.description: Hechtplatz Hotel - Self Check-in is located in Zürich, 400 metres from Zurich Opera House and 700 metres from Paradeplatz. With free WiFi, this 3-star hotel has a terrace and a bar. The accommodation provides karaoke and room service. Guests at the hotel can enjoy a continental breakfast. Popular points of interest near Hechtplatz Hotel - Self Check-in include Grossmünster, Fraumünster and Bellevueplatz. The nearest airport is Zurich, 12 km from the accommodation, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

214969.description: Enjoy modern comfort and convenience at Hotel Larende, located in Amsterdam West. We offer complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and bicycle rentals. Savor a meal at our Restaurant Larende, unwind with a drink at our bar/lounge, and start your day with a continental breakfast (fee applies). Our 14 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, LED TVs, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. We also provide dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Hotel Larende is a short drive from attractions like the Anne Frank House and Leidseplein, and conveniently located near Foodhallen.

214976.description: Whether for business or leisure, enjoy a comfortable stay at stattHotel. Our modern Zurich hotel offers cozy beds, modern bathrooms, flat-screen satellite TVs, and free Wi-Fi. Located in the heart of Niederdorf, a vibrant central district, you'll be just steps from Gran Café Motta and our in-house C. P. Bar, perfect for evening cocktails. All rooms feature Nespresso machines and fridges. For arrivals outside reception hours (Mon-Fri 8:30 am - 5 pm, Sat-Sun 10 am - 3 pm), your keycard will be waiting in the entrance key safe. Children under 6 stay free in their parents' bed (please inform us prior to arrival).

215006.description: Asterisk Hotel offers 3-star superior accommodations in 2 restored 19th century buildings in the center of Amsterdam. It is located at 10 minutes walking distance from the Rijksmuseum and offers free WiFi in the entire property. Guests can relax in the garden or lobby and explore the surroundings, where one can find cafes and restaurants. All rooms are accessible by elevator and are equipped with a flat-screen TV, a safe, work desk and a private bathroom. A 24-hour check-in front desk is available and in the lobby guests can enjoy water and a small snack in the afternoon. The hotel offers a paid airport shuttle and taxi service upon request. A tour desk where excursions, tours, museum tickets, souvenirs and toiletries can be bought is also present. Many attractions can be found in the vicinity such as The Heineken Experience (1148 feet) Muntplein (0. 7 mi), Van Gogh Museum (0. 7 mi) and the Hermitage (0. 7 mi). The hotel is only 820 feet from the Weteringcircuit Metro and Tram Stop where 4 tram lines and the Metro's route 52 run.

215043.description: Situated near Amsterdam's Sarphatipark and the renowned Albert Cuyp street market, Hotel Atlantis offers a 24-hour reception, bicycle rentals, and modern rooms with free Wi-Fi. Each room features a seating area, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, and a private bathroom with a shower and tea/coffee making facilities. A wide variety of restaurants are within walking distance. The Heineken Experience is a short 900-meter walk, and convenient tram access next to the hotel connects guests to sites like the Rijksmuseum, Rembrandt Square, and Central Station.

215076.description: More comfort for our guests through digitalization! 24/7 contactless self-check in and payment upon arrival offer our guests more freedom and relaxation during their stay! Our centrally located boutique Hotel offers free WiFi, unique interior design in every room and during summertime a terrace overlooking the Pariser Straße. We are less than 1312 feet away from Berlins most iconic shopping street, 'Kudamm. All our rooms have a private bathroom, flatscreen (smart) TV and a work desk. Mini-bars and fans upon request! All our pillows and mattresses have a hypo-allergenic topper. Different style of pillows and blankets can be provided. Our hotel does not offer breakfast, but we have a coffee & tea station located in the lobby and there is a large variety of bakery's, cafe's and breakfast restaurants next to the hotel! Many international restaurants and bars can be found on Pariser Straße. The scenic and historical Ludwig Church can be seen from the hotel.

215078.description: Hotel Westbahn is located in a vibrant area of Vienna, a 1-minute walk from Vienna's Westbahnhof Train and Underground Station. The Mariahilfer Straße Shopping Boulevard can be reached within 2 minutes on foot and the Wiener Stadthalle within 7 minutes on foot. Free WiFi is offered. All of the modernly furnished rooms feature a TV with satellite channels. Some units come with a seating area. A bathroom with a hairdryer and free toiletries is standard in each room. Hotel Westbahn offers a small courtyard garden. Guests receive 1 bottle of water free of charge upon arrival, while coffee is offered around the clock in the lobby. Rental bikes can be used from March until October and depending on the weather. St. Stephen's Cathedral can be reached within 10 minutes by underground. Breakfast: 15€ per person.

215081.description: This elegant urban mansion, built in the early 20th century, offers 37 uniquely decorated, vintage-style rooms just 50 meters from fashionable Avenue Louise and 20 minutes from Grand Place. Each room features exquisite design pieces from the last century, along with modern amenities such as free Wi-Fi. Enjoy a curated selection of international wines and Belgian craft beers at the hotel bar.

215085.description: This hotel offers free Wi-Fi, good public transport links, and free parking. It is located in the Neukölln district of Berlin, close to the A100 and A113 city motorways. The rooms and studios of the Hotel am Buschkrugpark feature a modern design. Cable TV is provided in every room. A rich breakfast buffet is served in the bright breakfast room of the Hotel am Buschkrugpark each morning. This is included in the room rate. A morning newspaper is also available for each guest. The Blaschkoallee underground stop is just a 3-minute walk from the Hotel am Buschkrugpark. This lies on Berlin's U7 underground line. The Buschkrugpark (park) opposite the hotel is ideal for jogging.

215088.description: This charming accommodation is centrally located in a traditional House in Vienna, with many entertainment, dining and shopping opportunities a stone's throw away. Visitors will find may sightseeing points of interest and nice parks for a leisure walk within easy reach, including the Burgtheater or Schönbrunn Castle some kilometres away. The property offers several types of guest rooms, some of them decorated in a traditional style and others in a more modern one. However, all of them are fully equipped with useful amenities to ensure a comfortable stay, such as a private bathroom and wireless Internet connection to keep updated. In case they may need anything from the hotel's staff, they are ready to help visitors all day round.

215090.description: Centrally located in Zürich, Hotel Limmathof offers convenient access to the Swiss National Museum and Bahnhofstrasse (within a 10-minute walk). This hotel features 60 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant, and utilize amenities such as a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. ETH Zurich and Kunsthaus Zurich are within easy reach.

215102.description:
The 49 rooms of the 9Hotel Chelton welcome you to our hotel in the heart of the European district, combining comfort, elegance and refinement. 
Designed by Bruno Borrione, the interior decor is inspired by the charm of a country house, creating a harmonious accommodation with the bustle of the Squares district. 
To complete your stay, an azure-colored swimming pool, fitness room and honesty bar are at your disposal. 

9Hotel Chelton is only 600 metres from Schuman Metro Station and only a 5-minute walk from the European Commission. 
9Hotel Chelton is a 5-minute journey by metro from the centre of Brussels. The Council of the European Union is just over 5 minutes' walk away. Parc du Cinquantenaire is just over 200 metres from the hotel.

215105.description: Located within 2 km from the town centre, the property allows easy access to all this destination has to offer. The hotel is 1 kilometre(s) from the main entertainment areas. There are public transport links just a short walk away. Guests will find the airport within 17 km. The hotel is within 1 kilometre(s) from the harbour. The establishment comprises 23 cosy rooms. Those staying at this hotel may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. The reception desk is not open throughout the day. The car park may be useful to those arriving by car. Some services of Hotel Comenius may be payable.

215111.description: This 3-star hostel is ideally located in the Marques de Pombal in the heart of Lisbon. It offers bright and airy rooms, with a living room and modern bathrooms. Tour buses are located near the hostel and the subway is located 50 meters. Lisbon International Airport is just 15 minutes drive from the hotel. Eduardo VII Park, Avenida da Liberdade and Amoreiras Mall are nearby. The arcade El Corte Inglés is also within walking distance. The hotel offers free internet access and ability to rent cars on site.

215118.address: Rua Jose Pedro Lopes Praia De Santa Cruz
215118.description: Treat yourself to on-site massages or rent bicycles to explore the area. This beach hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a restaurant with room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A computer station, 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage are also available. Roundtrip airport shuttle service is offered for a surcharge, and free self-parking is provided. Each of the 45 air-conditioned guest rooms features a private balcony, complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and a bathroom with a shower/tub combination. Hotel Santa Cruz is located in Torres Vedras (Praia de Santa Cruz), within a 5-minute walk of Santa Cruz Beach and Praia Formosa. It's a short drive from Foz do Sizandro Beach (2. 3 mi) and Porto Novo Beach (4. 5 mi). The preferred airport is Humberto Delgado Airport (LIS).

215137.description: With a privileged location, Dom Sancho I Hotel is situated on Avenida da Liberdade, close to Lisbon’s shopping and entertainment districts. It's just a few minutes from the Alfama and Bairro Alto districts, and approximately 20 minutes by car from Portela Airport. The hotel offers a 24-hour front desk and concierge service.

215145.description: The ultra modern black and white style contains selected design brands as Moooi and Flos. There is an Italian restaurant “Pomo” on the ground floor of the aparthotel. B-Aparthotel Regent is located in the heart of the Brussels business city centre with the botanical garden just around the corner and with highlights as the Nieuwstraat shopping area, the lively Brussels park and the Grote Markt just a few metro stops away.

215148.description: Welcome to the 3-star Wellness Apart Hotel in Brussels. Enjoy a meal at our on-site restaurant. Each room features a hairdryer, tea and coffee making facilities, and Wi-Fi. Smoking is permitted in designated rooms and public areas; please specify your preference when booking. Unwind in our luxurious sauna.

215162.description: Set your bags down in our comfortable 4-star hotel and relax. Our hotel is situated just 2 minutes walking from the platforms at Brussels' south train station, Centre Midi. Full-length windows and cool design make for a bright start to the day at the generous breakfast buffet. The cosy lobby bar is ideal for a nightcap, and you'll sleep peacefully in your quiet, contemporary room. You will quickly feel at home at Novotel.

215184.description: Ideally located in the fashionable Louise area of Brussels, this hotel sits next to the famous avenue, Toison d'Or. Visitors can explore the many designer boutiques, cinemas, museums, restaurants and cafes in the area. The property is just a 15 minutes' walking distance away from the renowned Grand Place and the European Parliament. The property offers the perfect choice from which to discover the city's bustling downtown area and the culture that encompasses it. This hotel showcases modern style with elegant finishes. Stunningly-appointed guest rooms provide a haven in which to unwind. The hotel's choice of facilities and services cater for the needs of every type of traveller.

215204.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, babysitting (surcharge), and an arcade/game room. Satisfy your appetite at Aspresso, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 42 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

215226.description: Historic Art Deco style, modern facilities such as free Wi-Fi and a convenient city centre location combine at Le Berger. This hotel includes a Italian cuisine restaurant and a bar with a terrace. It is only 300 metres from Porte de Namur Metro Station in the centre of Brussels.

215254.description: This sophisticated hotel is situated in Seixal, only a twenty-minute drive from the city centre of Lisboa. The Aroeira golf courses are a ten-minute drive from the hotel, while the Quinta do Peru course and Palmela Village resort are both within a 25-minute drive, making this hotel an excellent choice for golf aficionados. The helpful and professional staff at the hotel's front desk can even assist in booking tea times, shuttle services and equipment maintenance. Guests might also relax with a massage in the luxurious spa with indoor heated pool, hot tub, Turkish bath and relaxation room, enjoy an afternoon tea in the tea room, and sample regional dishes in the chic and modern in-house restaurant. The guest rooms are comfortably furnished in rich, dark tones and come with private balconies and handy internet access, all for a relaxing golf and spa holiday.

215284.description: The BCN Urbaness Hotels Bonavista is a small 2-star hostel that offers an affordable accommodation option in the heart of Barcelona. Its attractions include free Wi-Fi and very good transport options. Our establishment has 28 bedrooms completely renovated in 2021. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The rooms have air conditioning, television and private bathroom. The hostel has connecting rooms (on request) and a 24-hour reception. L'Eixample is a planned neighborhood from the end of the 19th century that has a grid layout with wide streets, open spaces and modernist architecture. Nearby attractions include Antoni Gaudí's Casa Milà and the unfinished Sagrada Família, both UNESCO World Heritage Sites, as well as Illa de la Discòrdia and Plaça Catalunya. The Diagonal metro stop is nearby and allows quick and easy access to other places of interest in Barcelona

215288.description:
The Westbridge Hotel exudes all the luxury and comfort you would expect from a modern 4 star hotel situated in a Grade II listed building dating back to 18th century. 
There are 80 rooms with free WIFI internet access, individually controlled air conditioning and private bathrooms with walk in showers, luxury amenities and a hairdryer, LED Smart TVs, phone, refrigerator, safe, iron, and tea & coffee making facilities.

215308.description: The establishment is located in the Marrakech, just 10 minutes from the main square. It offers accommodation with views of the medina and the Koutoubia mosque, as well as a sun terrace with pergola. The rooms are decorated individually. Guests can enjoy tea free in the yard, while the restaurant serves traditional cuisine and has a terrace with panoramic views.

215397.description: This cosy establishment guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 12 guest rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. This hotel follows green practices. Additional fees may apply for some services.

215613.description: Situated in the Cihangir district of Beyoglu, an area popular with artists and intellectuals, this attractive hotel has kept the structure of the original buildings and restored them respecting the original design, built in the 18th century for Italian owners. The hotel is furnished with antiques, objects and paintings from that period while also being equipped with modern facilities. The vibrant Istiklal Street is less than a 5-minute stroll away and Taksim Square, 700m.

215616.description: Located a short walk from Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue, with their restaurants, cafes, bars and shops, this stylish boutique hotel is an excellent base for exploring Istanbul. For business travellers, Lutfi Kırdar Congress and Exhibition Centre is a ten-minute walk from the hotel. The Sultanahmet district is a short drive from the hotel, featuring world renowned museums and cultural attractions. The premises are half an hour's drive from Ataturk international airport. The inviting guest accommodation comprises standard, superior and family rooms. They are all soundproofed and feature Wi-Fi, air-conditioning, a TV and a French balcony. Some rooms have a spa-bath and terrace, and the suites have a spacious living area.

215634.description: This modern hotel is located in the elegant district of Charlottenburg, a 15-minute walk from the Schloss Charlottenburg Palace and Technical University. The hotel enjoys easy access to the Kurfürstendamm Boulevard, Olympic Stadium and Tegel Airport. There are also great connections to the public transport network nearby, as there are two underground stations within a five-minute walk and several bus stops just a few steps away. The rooms are bright, comfortably furnished and have private modern bathrooms. Guests can dine al fresco on the restaurant's terrace and wake up to a delightful breakfast.

215636.description:
Welcome to Van der Valk Hotel Volendam – Feel at Home
Just a short distance from the vibrant capital of Amsterdam lies the beloved, quintessentially Dutch village of Volendam. In the heart of this region, the doors of our hotel in Katwoude first opened on April 21, 1973, built by the Van der Valk family. Later, With pride, we have transformed the foundations laid by our family into a renewed, warm, luxurious, comfortable and sustainable hotel. 
Whatever the occasion, you are welcome with us—right in the middle of nature! Surrounded by water, meadows and canals, the story of the region is reflected throughout the hotel. Enjoy breakfast, lunch and dinner with personal service at Restaurant ZYLT. 
Treat yourself to coffee with pastries at Café & Patisserie Zoetwaeter adn enjoy a sparkling cocktail at Bar 1480. 
This region is rich in history and charm. Explore the historic fishing village of Volendam, famous for smoked eel and traditional Dutch costumes. Visit lively Amsterdam for the city’s iconic highlights, events and modern museums. Nearby, you will also find the picturesque towns of Monnickendam, Edam, Hoorn, Zuiderwoude, and the shores of the IJsselmeer—all surrounded by scenic polders and waterways. After a day full of exploration, it is time to relax in one of our new rooms, equipped with a comfortable bed and refreshing shower. 
To pass on these unforgettable experiences and our warm hospitality to future generations, sustainability is essential. The hotel has been rebuilt with a climate-conscious foundation, using certified wood, solar panels, a sustainable energy system, a biodiverse garden and more. This ensures you can enjoy the luxury you expect from Van der Valk—responsibly. 
We look forward to welcoming you many more times.

215758.description: This smart, city-center hotel is set in an attractive townhouse in the middle of Alcalá de Henares, 19 mi from Madrid’s city center. Air-conditioned rooms at Hotel Complutense feature free WiFi, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom. Hotel Complutense is located next to Alcalá University. It is also surrounded by the many monuments of this ancient Castillian city. Outside the hotel you will find a suburban train station from where regular train services run to the center of Madrid. This allows you to easily enjoy the vibrant and cultural Spanish capital. Breakfast is served in a cafeteria located 164 feet from the hotel.

215759.description: This hotel is located in Alcala de Henares, lying next to Martyrs Gate. The hotel is nestled amidst the rich cultural, historical and artistic heritage of this mesmerising World Heritage Site. Guests will find themselves surrounded by ample opportunities for exploration and discovery. This wonderful hotel is located within easy walking distance of Cisneriana University and the train station. The hotel enjoys a charming architectural design, complementing its surroundings with elegance and grace. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, offering comfort and style. Guests will be pleased by the many facilities and services that this charming hotel has to offer.

215818.description: Situated in Madrid, the 2-star Hostal Veracruz offers comfortable accommodations and an on-site restaurant. Each room includes a hairdryer (available upon request) and free Wi-Fi. An airport shuttle service can be arranged by contacting the hotel directly. Please note, pets are not permitted, but guests have access to our helpful concierge service.

215855.description: Pension Mozart The Pension Mozart is situated in Wien. On site car parking is available at the hotel. Dining is available at the hotel, which has it's own restaurant. Room Features Pension Mozart. All rooms have a hairdryer. All rooms feature a stocked minibar. Additional Info. An airport shuttle service is available from the hotel. Pets are welcome at the hotel. A concierge service is provided for guests.

215869.description: A warm welcome awaits you at the mid-size, 3-star Hotel Aneto in Barcelona. The hotel offers a restaurant and an airport shuttle service. Wi-Fi is available in all rooms. Please note, this is a non-smoking hotel. We are also happy to welcome your furry friends as we are a pet-friendly establishment. A concierge service is available to assist you during your stay.

215925.description: Enjoy modern comfort and convenience at the Niki Athens Hotel, centrally located in Athens, a short walk from the Hellenic Parliament and the Roman Agora. Our 23 guestrooms feature pillowtop beds with premium bedding, refrigerators, minibars, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a cooked-to-order breakfast (fee applies) at our restaurant, or enjoy snacks in our coffee shop/cafe. Additional amenities include a bar/lounge, room service (limited hours), complimentary wired internet, express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge applies). Explore the city with ease, as we're just a short walk from Ermou Street, Syntagma Square, and other major attractions.

215927.description: Hotel Florence Situated in Milano, the Hotel Florence provides 3x000D star accommodation. Dining is available at the hotel, which has it's own restaurant. Room Features Hotel Florence. Smoking in certain bedrooms is allowed, as well as in public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking if you require smoking. Additional Info. An airport shuttle service is available from the hotel. Pet owners and their well behaved pets are welcome at the hotel. A concierge service is provided for guests.

215948.description: Located in Borger, Hotel Bieze offers comfortable accommodations within a 15-minute walk of Hunebed D27 and Hunebedcentrum. This hotel features complimentary Wi-Fi, an inviting lobby fireplace, and tour/ticket assistance. Guests can savor international cuisine at Vlint21, the onsite restaurant and bar/lounge, or enjoy room service during limited hours. A continental breakfast is available for a fee on weekdays from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM and weekends from 8:30 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel also offers amenities such as express check-out, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and free self-parking. Each of the 22 air-conditioned rooms features an LCD television, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer, a phone, a desk, and a coffee/tea maker. The TT Circuit Assen is 14. 8 miles away.

215959.description: Just 1312 feet from the Messe ICC Exhibition Center, this nonsmoking hotel in Berlin offers great public transport connections. Lake Lietzensee is 984 feet away. The privately run Hotel Messe has functionally furnished rooms with a TV and bathroom. Free WiFi is available in public areas and all hotel rooms. Room service is available throughout the day. The Messe Nord/ICC S-Bahn Train Station is beside the Hotel Messe. Trains run to the Olympic Stadium in 10 minutes. Drivers are only 3 minutes from the A100 motorway.

215963.description: Hotel Kallmeyer Welcome to the 2x000D star Hotel Kallmeyer in Berlin. The hotel offers on site car parking. Hotel guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant on site. Rooms at the Hotel Kallmeyer. Smoking in certain bedrooms is allowed, as well as in public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking if you require smoking.

215966.description: The 3-star Canal Suites is located in Amsterdam, offering off-site parking and an on-site restaurant. Each room includes a hairdryer, iron, and ironing board, along with tea and coffee making facilities and Wi-Fi access. Please note, smoking is not permitted. The hotel also provides an airport shuttle service, welcomes pets, and offers concierge services.

215976.description: This establishment, offering free Wi-Fi, is located in the very heart of Venice. Rooms, decorated in a traditional Venetian style, offer views over the charming Campo San Maurizio. An Italian breakfast buffet is provided. With friendly and helpful staff and a relaxed and cosy atmosphere, Residenza San Maurizio will ensure that your time spent in Venice is unforgettable.

215998.description: Boasting excellent transport links to Berlin Central Station, the city center and the ICC congress center, Hotel Kaiser enjoys a central location in the Charlottenburg district of western Berlin, close to numerous shops, restaurants and cafés. Free WiFi is provided for guests. Breakfast can be had at a restaurant across the street from 9 AM on. Just a few steps away, the Sophie-Charlotte-Platz Underground Station offers a direct connection to attractions such as the Kurfürstendamm shopping boulevard, Potsdamer Platz and Alexanderplatz. The exhibition grounds and the ICC are just one stop or 1. 2 mi away. Enjoy your stay in the hotel’s spacious and comfortable bedrooms.

216005.description: Enjoy a restful night's sleep at the charming three-star superior Hotel Adler Zurich, located in the heart of Zurich's Old Town. Our newly designed, air-conditioned rooms feature 52 unique murals and offer captivating views. Included with your stay are breakfast and a stocked minibar. Savor authentic Swiss specialties, including fondue, at our renowned restaurant, Swiss Chuchi, a favorite among locals and tourists alike. The hotel's prime location and warm hospitality make it the perfect choice for both business travelers and leisure guests.

216037.description: Centrally located in Venice, Hotel Bartolomeo is steps from the Rialto Bridge and a short walk from St. Mark's Square. This hotel offers 20 air-conditioned rooms with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can also enjoy concierge services and a 24-hour front desk. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and bidets. St. Mark's Basilica and St. Mark's Campanile are within a 0. 6 km radius.

216058.description: The two-star Hotel Pension Xantener Eck, located in Berlin, offers convenient on-site and off-site parking. Guests can enjoy dining at the hotel restaurant. Wireless internet access is available in all rooms. Select rooms are designated for smoking; please specify your preference when booking. The hotel also provides an airport shuttle service, concierge service and welcomes pets.

216068.description: Enjoy a central Amsterdam stay at The Times Hotel, a short walk from The 9 Streets and Anne Frank House. This 33-room hotel offers individually decorated guestrooms featuring heated floors, Smart TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a continental breakfast (fee applies), served weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Additional amenities include a bar/lounge, concierge services, a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. The hotel is also conveniently located near Dam Square and the Amsterdam Museum.

216079.description: This hotel in Berlin's Friedrichshain district offers free Wi-Fi, daily breakfast buffets, and great transportation connections. The Alexanderplatz square is just 5 subway stops away. All of the rooms at the Hotel Kiez Pension Berlin have TVs and free internet. The Kiez Pension provides 24-hour reception service. Guests are welcome to relax in the bar. The Samariterstraße U-Bahn (subway) station is a 3-minute walk away from the Kiez Pension Berlin. A variety of restaurants, bars, and shops are located in the area.

216084.description: Hotel Bellington A warm welcome awaits you at the mid size, 2x000D star rated Hotel Bellington in Amsterdam. Hotel guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant on site. Room Features Hotel Bellington. Smoking is permitted in certain bedrooms (please specify when booking) and the public areas of the hotel. All rooms feature a stocked minibar.

216087.description: Residencial Monte Carlo is the result of an effort to provide Porto city with a tourist accommodation that harmonized comfort, quality and affordable prices. Occupying a centenary building in the centre of Porto, it was completely renovated and equipped and today is a perfect combination of history and modernity. Is a small hotel, open all year, 24 hours a day. It's located in a renovated building equipped and decorated in 2009. Convenience, comfort and quietness available to our customers at a low price are our commitments.

216093.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center and seasonal outdoor pool. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and wedding services. Dine at the onsite restaurant, Chalet, for lunch, dinner, or brunch, or grab a quick bite at the coffee shop/cafe. 24-hour room service is also available. Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. A complimentary breakfast is included. For business travelers, a business center, express check-in, and express check-out are provided. Event facilities include a conference center and a meeting room. Free self-parking is available onsite. The 100 air-conditioned guest rooms feature refrigerators, flat-screen televisions, and private furnished balconies. Complimentary Wi-Fi and satellite programming are provided for your entertainment. Private bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. The hotel is located near Parnitha National Park (0. 7 mi), Regency Casino Mont Parnes (3 mi), and Antonis Tritsis Park (5. 8 mi). The preferred airport is Athens Intl. Airport (ATH), 38 km away.

216111.description: Hotel Linda The 3x000D star rated Hotel Linda is situated in ?stanbul. Hotel guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant on site. Room Features Hotel Linda. All rooms have a hairdryer. Rooms have wireless internet access available. Tea and coffeee making facilities together with a minibar are available in all rooms.

216156.description: Guests checking into the 3-star Ca' Pozzo Inn in Venice are assured of a warm welcome. Enjoy a meal on the hotel terrace. Reception is open from 8:00 am to 7:30 pm. Please provide your estimated time of arrival. After 7:30 pm, you'll need codes and instructions to access the hotel. An airport shuttle and concierge service are available. Pets are welcome. The hotel has disabled facilities, including wheelchair access to the hotel, reception, and bar areas.

216158.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services, a hair salon, and shopping on site. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 11 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls.

216166.description: Berlin's 'beautiful sister' was once said, and it holds true again today. Potsdam is not only a particularly impressive place with famous buildings, southern flair and a charming landscape, but also a very fateful place. Prussian, German and international history come together here in an almost magical way.

216198.description: Located in Cesano Boscone, Hotel GF offers comfortable air-conditioned rooms with Select Comfort beds and Frette Italian sheets. Enjoy amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and private bathrooms with bidets. The inn provides a bar/lounge, room service (limited hours), luggage storage, and a safe deposit box. Nearby parking and an airport shuttle (surcharge) are available. Hotel GF is a convenient 15-minute drive from San Siro Stadium and Piazza del Duomo, and close to attractions like Acquatica Park and San Carlo Borromeo Hospital.

216215.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features gift shops/newsstands and a hair salon. Enjoy seafood at Seven Hills Restaurant, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge, take in the garden view, and even dine alfresco. You can also stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 16 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature jetted bathtubs and rainfall showerheads.

216220.description: Located in Calle del Dose, just a 5-minute walk from the Gallerie dell'Accademia, Novecento Boutique Hotel is inspired by both Mediterranean and Oriental furnishings. It offers free Wi-Fi and elegant rooms. The Novecento’s rooms are decorated with antiques and feature cozy wrought iron beds and hardwood or marble floors. Each comes with air conditioning, LCD satellite TV and a minibar. Breakfast at the Novecento Boutique is served in the peaceful garden in summer. Guests can also relax in the reading room and take a drink from the honor bar. The vaporetto water bus stops near the hotel at Santa Maria del Giglio. St. Mark’s Square is a 10-minute walk from Hotel Novecento and the Baroque church of Santa Maria Zobenigo is just 220 yards away.

216241.description: With a stay at Hotelpension Margrit in Berlin (Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf), you'll be a 4-minute walk from Kurfürstendamm and within a 5-minute drive of Theatre of the West. This hotel is 1. 9 mi (3 km) from Berlin Zoological Garden and 2. 4 mi (3. 9 km) from Messe Berlin. Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as bicycles to rent, or other amenities including complimentary wireless Internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby and an elevator. Make yourself at home in one of the 27 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers.

216244.description: Centrally located in Brussels on the fashionable Avenue Louise, Hotel Louise offers convenient access to the Royal Palace (within a 5-minute drive) and other key attractions. This eco-certified hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, a TV lounge, and bike parking. Its 71 rooms feature minibars, LED TVs with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with rainfall showers. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast for a fee, and a bar/lounge is available for drinks. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.

Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. 216336.description: Stylish and ultra-modern, this Bogota hotel provides the perfect base for a business trip or weekend city break. The hotel is situated in the northern part of the city, surrounded by restaurants, cafés, art galleries and entertainment venues. Shoppers can enjoy the many nearby shops and commercial centres, and guests can easily move about the city as Virrey and Calle 85 metro stations are just a short walk away. Rooms are sleek and modern, yet functional, and each comes with free Wi-Fi, a writing desk, and a handy coffee maker as well as fabulous city views. Business travellers can make use of the small business centre with meeting rooms and audio-visual equipment, and guests can enjoy drinks and meals in the restaurant, café and terrace bar. Whether travelling to Bogota for business or leisure, this hotel offers a combination of comfort, privacy and excellent service.

216434.description: Dar IKALIMO Marrakech is a peaceful oasis in the heart of the ancient medina (the old town) of Marrakech. Situated in a highly desirable area within the medina, thanks to its proximity to the El Bacha Palace (which benefits from 24-hour security and spacious streets), the riad is ideally located for exploring the souks. It's also within a 5-minute walk of the famous Jemaa el-Fna square and conveniently positioned for venturing beyond the old town to discover the new town. Combining modern comfort with authentic Moroccan architecture, Dar IKALIMO offers five comfortable, clean, and newly renovated rooms within a traditional riad guesthouse. Each room, decorated in traditional Moroccan style, is named after a native aromatic flower. All rooms are individually furnished and equipped for a delightful and comfortable stay.

216438.description: Set in a peaceful area just 984 feet from central Ornago, B&B Hotels HOTEL PRESTIGE ORNAGO offers free Wi-Fi, and rooms with a private balcony and satellite TV. Each room includes a parking slot in the hotel’s parking. The hotel's elegantly furnished rooms are air conditioned, and come with a mini-bar and safe. The private bathroom includes a hairdryer and soft slippers. Happy hour and dinner are available at the American bar, which is open from Monday to Thursday evening. B&B Hotels HOTEL PRESTIGE ORNAGO is located 1. 9 mi from the A4 Motorway, and lies respectively 30 and 37 mi from Orio al Serio and Milan Malpensa international airports. Well connected to Monza and Milan, it is a 20-minute drive from the Monza Formula One circuit.

216442.description: Nestled in the Kiris District on Turkey's Mediterranean Coast, this family-friendly hotel offers a unique cultural journey. Located just 5km from Kemer and 300m from the beach, with a stunning mountain backdrop, it's ideal for exploring the region's rich history, including nearby Phaselis. Brightly decorated guest rooms feature turquoise accents reflecting the sea's beauty. Enjoy an array of activities, including an aquapark and spa. Each day showcases a different Turkish region, featuring authentic dishes, cultural events, and music. The expansive green areas and water park make this property stand out. From November to April, only all-inclusive accommodation is offered, with imported drinks, fresh juices, and Turkish coffee incurring an extra charge. The beach is a mix of sand and pebbles. Beach towels require a €10 deposit. Minibars are stocked with cola, fanta, sprite, soda, and water on arrival, with only water replenished thereafter. Private parking is €5 per day. The Dolu Su Park water slides are open from May 15th to October 15th, 10:00-17:00, weather permitting. Kay-Uç ( Slide-Fly) adult slide +18. Subject to an additional charge of €5 per person.

216443.description:
STATEMENT ON THE PANDEMIC OF COVID-19
INFINITY BEACH HOTEL 4* ALANYA/TURKEY

In this time of the anxiety of the COVID-19 pandemic, Infinity Beach Hotel assures that our highest priority is our guests' safety and comfort. Our thoughts are with those who have affected by this virus and those who are caring for them.

Please find below 7 commitments to our guests on what we are going to do to ensure maximum safety: 

    1. Temperature checking upon arrival for all of our guests as well as daily temperature checking for all of our staff 
    2. Travel history and health declaration form to be filled by up all our guests. 
    3. Daily disinfection of all common & public area (public wc, elevators, reception, restaurant, kitchen, lobby, Turkish bath, spa, stores)
    4. Disinfection and deep clean of guest rooms after check-out
    5. Arrangements for social distance in all common & public area (reception, restaurant, pool side, bars, beach)
    6. Hand sanitiser to be provided in all common & public area. 
    7. Educate staffs for how to prevent virus outbreak 

GENERAL INFO:
This hotel lies just a few minutes' walking distance away from the beach, in the Konakli District of Turkey's southern coast. The hotel is located just 13 km away from the bustling resort of Alanya. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a number of local shops. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. The hotel enjoys a wonderful design, beautifully blending contemporary and traditional elements. This charming hotel comprises tastefully-decorated guest rooms, which feature colourful wall prints, for a relaxed ambience. The hotel features a number of facilities and services, ensuring an enjoyable stay for each and every traveller.

216476.description: This establishment offers a total of 120 guest rooms.

216478.description: The property comprises 36 cosy guest rooms. Travellers may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Benna Hotel. Travellers may contact the reception desk any time during the day. Benna Hotel offers entertainment tailored to guests' needs.

216479.description: The 4 star Grand Hotel Amstelveen is located in the suburbs of Amstelveen and was established in 1993. The Hotel has a restaurant and a bar. The bedrooms are stylish and include a flat-screen TV with several radio channels and tea and coffee making facilities. The modern bathroom is equipped with a bathtub, shower and separate toilet. The Grand Hotel features a modern fitness centre and 22 tennis courts. It is located nearby to the Amstelveen and the Zagerij West bus stop is close to the hotel and offers direct connections to Amsterdam.

216480.description: This cosy, family-run hotel is set in a traditional brick building in the centre of Edinburgh. The popular Haymarket train station is mere metres away, and visitors will be able to arrive to many of the city's most famous attractions on foot, including the National Museum of Scotland and Edinburgh Castle. Shoppers will delight in the shops, restaurants and pubs of Princes Street and George Street, just ten minutes away, while art lovers can enjoy easy access to a wealth of art museums and galleries, such as the National Gallery of Scotland and the Scottish National Gallery of Modern Art. The comfortable rooms come with tea and coffee makers and complimentary wireless internet access, and some are en suite. The helpful and friendly staff can assist guests in making travel arrangements and booking tickets for festivals and events as well as restaurant reservations.

name.content: Garner Hotel Berlin  - Messe by IHG

216488.description: This elegant historic hotel sits at just 100 metres from the so called “Champs-Élysées of Berlin” - Kurfürstendamm Boulevard. The street houses shops for some of the world's most famous fashion designers, car manufacturers' show rooms, and a number of fine-dining and Michelin stared restaurants. The Brandenburg Gate is reachable within a 25-minute ride through the Halensee S-Bahn Train Station, which is just 200 metres away. The hotel itself offers spacious, classical-style rooms that are equipped with all of the modern conveniences and open to nice airy terraces. The perfect mornings start with the varied buffet breakfast served in the conservatory, while the bar and library invite guests to relax throughout the day and offer them free tea and sherry in the afternoons.

216495.description: This charming establishment offers a privileged location in Madrid's Malasaña district, just a 10- minute walk from Plaza de España, a large square and popular tourist destination located in the city centre. Guests will find a host of tourist attractions close to the hotel such as the Palacio Real, the official residence of the Spanish Royal Family, and the Sabatini Gardens. A broad range of restaurants, shops and nightlife venues are to be found in the surrounding area. This property provides a host of contemporary design guest rooms that combine aesthetics and comfort with convincing functionality. This establishment is the perfect choice for those guests wishing to discover this vibrant city.

216587.description: Located in Cancun's Hotel Zone, Aloft Cancun is steps from the UltraMar Ferry Terminal and a short 3-minute walk from Caracol Beach. This hotel is conveniently close to the Cancun Convention Center (1. 1 km) and La Isla Shopping Mall (3. 7 km). Enjoy amenities such as the outdoor pool and 24-hour fitness center. Aloft Cancun also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and a TV in the common area. The 177 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, LCD TVs, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Safes, desks, and phones are also provided for your convenience. Satisfy your hunger at the snack bar/deli or relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include express check-in/check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and free valet parking. The hotel also offers 366 square feet of event space, including a conference space and meeting room.

name.content: London Croydon Aerodrome Hotel by Sunday

216603.description: The Hotel is located on the A23, close to Croydon town centre and 12 miles from the centre of London. Croydon has an excellent shopping complex and a lively nightlife, with a wide choice of restaurants, pubs and clubs for all ages. The centre of London is only 15 minutes away by train from East Croydon station for those wishing to take in the West End shows or all the other visitor attractions of our capital city. The former Aerodrome hotel has completed its extensive refurbishment and has emerged with the contemporary style now synonymous with Hallmark Hotels. The hotel has a well-loved heritage in Surrey, being originally built in 1928 to serve the airport. It has a stunning new lobby, stylish lounge bar and Brasserie as well as fully equipped meeting and conference facilities. All rooms come en suite and fully – equipped as standard.

216608.description: Our stylish Premier Inn Berlin Alexanderplatz hotel is ideal if you're looking for great-value hotels in Berlin. Thanks to our handy location just a five-minute walk away from Alexanderplatz, you'll have some of Berlin's top attractions right on your doorstep when you stay with us. Families can enjoy days out with the kids in Berlin at sports like Little BIG city, while culture-lovers can see the famous Berliner Fernsehturm and Worl Time Clock - two of the most popular places to visit in Berlin - before exploring the scenic Gendarmenmarkt square. After exciting days out in Belin, you can look forward to laid-back evenings at our bar and restaurant, before enjoying a great night's sleep on one of our super-comfy beds.

216640.description: Centrally located in Berlin, the Ringhotel Seehof offers convenient access to Kurfürstendamm and Messe Berlin, both within a 5-minute drive. This hotel features an indoor pool, a terrace with scenic views, and a restaurant, auLac, specializing in regional cuisine. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site parking (for a fee), and convenient amenities such as dry cleaning and a 24-hour front desk. The 75 guest rooms include minibars, cable TV, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. A buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee). Nearby attractions include the Berliner Funkturm, ICC Berlin, Deutsche Oper Berlin, and Schloss Charlottenburg.

216697.description: Located behind the Palmeraie 14 km on the road to Ouarzazate, new resort style Riad composed of 12 rooms.. Complex completely renovated and air conditioned. Nestled a few kilometers from the center of Marrakech, in the bend of a track, backed by a typical Moroccan village, this hotel enjoys an exceptional location in an idyllic setting. A view of the Atlas breathtaking , will give you a feeling of space , freedom and the magical feeling to take your flight with storks , installed on minarets around ! About fifteen minutes of Marrakech, the hotel team will guide and advise you for your visits , you want to go to the souks and museums for a city tour or a trip to the restaurant, nightclub.

216744.description: This impressive resort is located on the eastern crescent of the famous Palm Jumeirah in the cosmopolitan city of Dubai. The delightfully decorated rooms come well-equipped with cutting-edge comforts and a private bathroom with a tub and separate rain shower. Some rooms feature a personal infinity pool or direct access to the lagoon pools. The complex offers five unique restaurants serving classic Middle Eastern and international dishes. In addition, the lobby lounge features a dedicated shisha deck, and the pool bar offers Mediterranean light snacks and beverages. Travelers may take advantage of impressive leisure facilities, including three lagoon swimming pools, a kids' pool, a teen and kids' club with a game room, two tennis courts, a well-equipped fitness center, and a water sports center. Those who wish to disconnect from their daily routine may benefit from the full-service spa offering a wide range of wellness therapies, beauty treatments, and massages.

216822.description: At Crowne Plaza Vienna, every stay is designed to help you work well, recharge fully and repeat with purpose. Designed by Pritzker Prize winner David Chipperfield and inspired by the Austrian National Library, the hotel blends intelligent design, cultural depth and contemporary comfort. Set in Vienna’s lively fifth district between the Opera House and Schönbrunn Palace, our location keeps you connected—whether you’re heading to a meeting, exploring the city or catching a flight. With the subway just two minutes away, moving around Vienna is effortless. Designed for modern business travel, our 4‑star, EU Eco‑ and Austrian Environment Label–certified hotel offers flexible meeting spaces, co‑working areas and collaborative zones for up to 140 delegates. When it’s time to switch off, retreat to spacious rooms that support both productivity and rest. Start your day with a locally sourced breakfast, take a break at the Salon Bar or restore balance in our rooftop fitness and wellness area with city views. From arrival to departure, Crowne Plaza Vienna supports your rhythm—so you can meet with confidence, recharge with ease and do it all again.

216982.description: The Anatara Dubai Downtown, conveniently located in Business Bay, offers superlative views of the Burj Khalifa. Its enviable downtown address is close to prominent business and leisure landmarks, including Dubai Mall and the Dubai International Financial Centre. Internationally acclaimed for its exceptional guest services, the hotel offers spacious and comfortable accommodations, fine dining options to suit every palate, and a 24-hour business center equipped with modern technology. After a busy day of work or sightseeing, unwind in our comprehensive wellness facilities.

Guests can enjoy a range of facilities, including fine and casual dining options, versatile meeting rooms, a full-service spa, a well-equipped health club with a sauna, steam room, and indoor heated pool, as well as a barber, hairdresser, and on-site boutiques. Spacious guest rooms, starting at 42 square meters, feature contemporary decor with Asian influences, and many offer stunning Bosphorus views. Amenities include luxurious linens, high-speed Wi-Fi, an executive desk, and a personal safe.

217087.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in Santiago, lying in the residential neighbourhood of Providencia. The hotel is located just a short distance away from the subway Tobalaba. 217112.description: Stop at InterCityHotel Berlin Hauptbahnhof to discover the wonders of Berlin. The hotel has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Facilities like free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, facilities for disabled guests, express check-in/check-out, luggage storage are readily available for you to enjoy.
