Cash Payment not available in the hotel; guests can pay by credit card, debit card or online payment solutions.

217113.description: This hotel is located in the Berlin district of Neukölln, a 7-minute walk from Grenzallee underground station. It is situated only 1. 5 kilometres from the Neukölln Underground and Train Station, offering connections to the main circle line of Berlin, which goes to Tempelhofer Feld and the Messe Berlin ExpoCenter. Treptower Park and the commemorative monument to the Soviet War are just 10 minutes' drive from this hotel. Ideal for business and leisure travellers alike, this luxurious accommodation offers a choice of modern rooms providing a comfortable, beautifully appointed sitting area and air conditioning. Some of them also include a balcony. All those guests wishing to relax and unwind while having a delicious meal might go to the conservatory restaurant, decorated with palm trees. All rates plus 5% City Tax of the City of Berlin. For business travellers an exception is possible. For information please visit https://www. berlin. de/tourismus/infos/

217180.description: Located in Akersloot and with Amsterdam Central Station reachable within 30 km, Van der Valk Hotel Akersloot / A9 ALKMAAR provides a restaurant, allergy-free rooms, free WiFi throughout the property and a bar. Providing a casino, the property is located within 30 km of Anne Frank House. The wellness area includes an indoor pool, fitness centre and sauna, while a terrace is also available. All units at the hotel come with air conditioning, a seating area, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a safety deposit box and a private bathroom with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. The units will provide guests with a desk and a kettle. The breakfast offers buffet, continental or vegetarian options. The area is popular for hiking and cycling, and bike hire is available at this 4-star hotel. Languages spoken at the 24-hour front desk include German, English, Spanish and Dutch. A'DAM Lookout is 31 km from Van der Valk Hotel Akersloot / A9 ALKMAAR, while Rembrandt House is 32 km away. Schiphol Airport is 24 km from the property.

217182.description: Feel at home in our thoughtfully designed and fully equipped Madrid apartments. We offer fiber optic Wifi throughout, private parking on Cuesta San Vicente Street, and an 18-hour reception service with multilingual staff. Enjoy 24-hour phone assistance and auto check-in, plus luggage storage after check-out. Weekly housekeeping is included.

217574.description: Located some 10 minutes' walk north of Taksim Square, this modern city hotel is in a great location for the shopping district of Nisantasi and the bustling activity around Istiklal Street. The hotel features modern décor and facilities and has free Wi-Fi, a lobby bar, restaurant and steam room. Attractions such as Dolmabahce Palace and the Istanbul Museum of Modern Art can be reached on foot, and public transport from Taksim Square allows easy access to the historical district of Sultanahmet, 5 km away.

217585.description: This is a modern hotel at the very heart of Madrid, just a few meters away from the Puerta del Sol and within walking distance of the major attractions of the city: the Prado, the Reina Sofia museum, the Plaza Mayor, the Royal Palace, the Almudena cathedral, etc. The hotel is located in the old Fronton of Madrid -the former handball court -, which still keeps its main facade. The building is divided into two blocks with 7 floors. This is a functional hotel with noble finishes made of stone, wood and glass mosaics. There are a total of 92 elegant rooms, decorated in soft colors and wooden floors, with a pleasant contemporary decor and all the modern amenities of a 4-star hotel: flat screen TVs, air conditioning, soundproofing, hairdryer, international channels, etc. Two rooms are wheelchair accessible.

217586.description: The 4-star Monica Hotel Fiera offers an ideal stay for both business and leisure travelers. Located just minutes from the Fiera Milano exhibition center in Rho, the hotel provides a free shuttle bus service during major exhibitions. The hotel's elegant and welcoming spaces create a special atmosphere, ensuring guests feel valued throughout their stay. Set within a spacious 20, 000 sq m garden, Monica Hotel Fiera offers 71 traditionally furnished rooms in the main building, each equipped with televisions featuring Sky Cinema and Sky Sports channels. An additional 22 economy rooms are available in La Residenza, an annex located across the street.

217835.description: Boasting a prime location in the centre of Athens, this convenient hotel nestles close to the Acropolis, offering superb views of this ancient monument and the surrounding area. The comfortable, well-appointed rooms can sleep up to 4, making this a great accommodation base for couples with children or groups of friends on a sightseeing holiday in the Greek capital. Although there is a 24 hour snack bar, guests will also appreciate the many traditional taverns, supermarkets and shops situated nearby. The friendly and helpful reception staff are on duty around the clock, and are always happy to provide advice about the countless attractions to be discovered in this intriguing city. Syntagma Square, lying at the heart of Athens, is 600 m away, and the nearest metro station is just 350 m from the hotel. Parking space is also available nearby, and the international airport is 22 km away.

217860.description: This enchanting hotel is set in the heart of Marrakech's Medina, offering an oasis of peace as well as a glimpse into the soul of the city. The Dar Si Said Museum and La Bahia Palace are both just a five-minute drive from the hotel, while the Koutoubia Mosque with its iconic minaret and the souks and cafés of Jama'a El Fna Square are just an eight-minute walk away. The contemporary, riad-style hotel is equipped with modern comforts, offering four elegant suites overlooking the immaculate patio and an in-house restaurant that also offers cooking courses for lovers of fine cuisine. There is also a comfy alcove where guests can sip refreshing mint teas and a gorgeous roof-terrace with city views. This is a prime location for those travellers looking for exclusivity, comfort and an intimate atmosphere, as well as for those looking for a tailor-made stay.

217985.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and convenient amenities like a vending machine at Citi Hotel Luton. This hotel offers 68 air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs and digital programming. Each room includes a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Daily housekeeping is provided, and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. The hotel also provides express check-out and luggage storage at the 24-hour front desk. Located near Luton Mall and the University of Bedfordshire, you'll be within a 15-minute drive of ZSL Whipsnade Zoo and a short distance from Grosvenor Casinos. Luton Airport (LTN) is just 3. 5 km away.

218066.description: This smoke-free, four-story guesthouse offers convenient bellhop services and a 24-hour front desk. Guests can store luggage securely and utilize the safe deposit box at reception. Each of the 19 air-conditioned rooms features a flat-screen television, a private bathroom with a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. For added convenience, rooms also include phones, safes, and electric kettles. W12 Rooms is centrally located in London, a short drive from Westfield London Shopping Centre and Kensington High Street. It's also within easy reach of popular attractions like the Natural History Museum and Marble Arch.

218076.description: This hotel becomes a benchmark for any stay whether for business or pleasure thanks to its location in the heart of the capital, in the Avenida da Liberdade. In this area you can find the most prestigious stores internationally renowned the major business areas and a vibrant nightlife. *The hotel reserves the right to pre-authorise your credit card prior to arrival.

218084.description: The hotel is close to the city centre and to some of the most interesting tourist sites of the city, such as the Reef Mall, Al Ghurair Centre, the Clock Tower and the Ansar Gallary & Culinary Centre of the Middle East. Home and luxury come together at the Al Nakheel Hotel Apartments, located across from Al Ghurair Centre and just steps away from the Salahudin metro station, numerous restaurants, fast food chains, banks and business establishments. The hotel apartments offer warm hospitality in a central location. The tastefully decorated, comfortably furnished and well equipped apartments are designed for business travellers and families alike. Each hotel apartment comes complete with a different configuration of traditional carpets and tiles, a TV with the satellite channels and a fully equipped kitchen.

218175.address: Sehit Muhtar Mah.Atif Yilmaz Cad.Suslu Saksi Sk., 21
218175.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include a television in a common area and a reception hall. Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 10 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and coffee/tea makers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

218176.description:
Located in the heart of historic Galata and Pera, where the charm of the past meets the comfort of modern living, Galata M84 Apart Hotel offers you a unique accommodation experience that feels just like home. Our fully equipped and spacious apartments, set within a beautiful historic building, are perfect for both short and long stays. 

We offer 24-hour front desk service to assist you whenever you need. Each apartment features updated appliances, comfortable furniture, air conditioning, Smart TV, and free Wi-Fi. With fully equipped kitchens, you can also enjoy the flexibility of preparing your own meals during your stay. 

Our prime location makes it easy to explore Istanbul. We are just steps away from Şişhane Metro Station, a 5-minute walk from İstiklal Avenue and the iconic Galata Tower, and about 20 minutes on foot from Taksim Square. The surrounding streets are filled with cozy cafes, restaurants, and art galleries, immersing you in the vibrant culture of the city. 

If you're looking for a comfortable, central, and welcoming place to stay in Istanbul, Galata M84 Apart Hotel is the perfect choice. With our guest-focused approach, we are here to ensure that every moment of your stay is enjoyable and memorable.

218196.description: This charming traditional inn is located in the village of Alijó, next to the Douro River. Its name is homage to Joseph James Forrester, an English Businessman, who lived in Portugal during the XIX century and who in 1855 received the title of Baron from King Fernando II due to his dedication to the state and his contribution to the Douro and the Port wine. Befitting for the name the historical hotel features vineyards and it is close to some of the most famous producers of Port wines. Located in the center of the village, it is inserted in the Douro Demarcated Region, making it the perfect place for a relaxing holiday. Inside the Palacete, the Restaurant 'O Barão' offers a varied menu, inspired by traditional Portuguese cuisine and the use of local products. Slow cooking, great presence of vegetables, sensible use of spices, simplicity and harmony of the flavors of the dishes, is the set of these elements that characterize our cuisine. The Palacete breathes a contemporary atmosphere, keeping its Douro roots visible in every detail. The Douro atmosphere is also visible in each of the unit's 21 rooms, referring the visitor to moments and landscapes of the Douro valley.

218254.description: Located in Kargicak, this all-inclusive hotel is 2. 3 mi (3. 7 km) from Mahmutlar Clock and 2. 6 mi (4. 2 km) from Gold Cable Park. Mahmutlar Recreation Area and Mahmutlar Beach are also within 6 mi (10 km). Along with 2 outdoor pools, this hotel has a full-service spa and a restaurant. Free WiFi in public areas and free self parking are also provided. Additionally, an indoor pool, 2 poolside bars, and a fitness center are onsite. All 166 rooms balconies, and LCD TVs with satellite channels. Guests will also find 24-hour room service, minibars, and electric kettles.

218346.description: This boutique hotel is situated at the heart of Venice, immersed in the romance and heritage of this mesmerising city. The hotel is located on San Samuele, lying within easy access of Palazzo Grassi and the theatre. The hotel is situated just a short walking distance away from the Accademia Bridge and Piazza San Marco. The Fenice Theatre and the Rialto Bridge are also located nearby. This sophisticated hotel exudes elegance and charm. The guest rooms are stylishly designed, evoking a sense of luxury and comfort. The hotel offers a high quality of service, featuring exemplary facilities to meet the needs of discerning travellers.

218358.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an indoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy British cuisine at Booking Office 1869, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 4850 square feet (451 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 12 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

218363.address: Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Cluster A, Building A2
218363.description: Contemporary, modern and elegantly understated, the Hotel is based in one of the most dynamic locations in Dubai, the Jumeirah Lakes Towers. Just off the famous Sheikh Zayed Road, this 168-room hotel is close to Dubai's thriving new business districts and just minutes away from the city's most iconic attractions. Overlooking the tranquil lakes and the striking Dubai Marina skyline, the hotel is the perfect base for business or leisure and is ideally situated for exploring one of the most exciting cities in the world. The Soul Fitness Club zone features cutting edge TechnoGym cardio equipment and a full range of free weights as well as a temperature-controlled infinity pool and a sun lounger zone. The spa offers seven treatment rooms and services ranging from massages and beauty treatments, to facials and skin therapies. *

218461.address: ROUTE SIDI YAHIA La Palmeraie Marrakech
218461.description: This resort enjoys a charming setting in Marrakech. The resort is surrounded by ample opportunities for exploration and discovery, and guests can enjoy a wide range of activities nearby. The resort enjoys close proximity to many of the area's most prominent attractions. The rest offers guests a truly unique experience, offering an insight into the rich culture and history of Marrakech. This charming resort enjoys a beautiful blend of tradition and contemporary convenience. The accommodation options are sumptuously designed, oozing character and charm. Guests are sure to be impressed by the extensive range of first-class facilities and services that this wonderful resort has to offer.

218536.description: The luxurious Hotel Platinum Suite enjoys a strategic location in Bogotá, the capital of Colombia. It is just a stone's throw away from Corferias, one of Latin America's largest convention centres, only a few steps from the US embassy, 5 minutes from the historic centre and various shopping centres, 15 minutes from the Business Financial Centre and 20 minutes from the Zona Rosa. The international airport can be reached within 10 minutes. Guests are welcomed in a modern, relaxed atmosphere full of hospitality. The well-appointed rooms have an interior design of timeless elegance with parquet floors and wooden furnishings. They are equipped with complimentary WIFI and plasma TV. Business guests will appreciate the business centre. The hotel offers a rooftop terrace boasting panoramic views over the city. The on-site restaurant serves local and international dishes. A great choice for business travellers.

218538.description: Located in Rio's revitalized Porto Maravilha district, home to the MAR (Museum of Art of Rio) and the Museum of Tomorrow, the Gamboa River Hotel offers 56 comfortable rooms featuring LCD TVs, minibars, private bathrooms, and air conditioning. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, a modern reception and lobby, and easy access to major tourist attractions and corporate offices via the nearby Presidente Vargas metro station and various bus stops. This hotel makes a great base for both leisure and business travelers.

218541.description: Located in Rio's historic center on Rua Camerino, the Pompeu Rio Hotel is near Praça Mauá and the revitalized Marvelous Port project. This exciting area features the MAR (Art Museum of Rio), the Museum of Tomorrow, and other notable developments. Housed in a modernist building from 1939, the hotel offers 60 comfortable rooms, some newly renovated. Common areas were updated in 2013. All rooms include a private bathroom, LCD TV, air conditioning, and a minibar. Guests enjoy free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel and can savor traditional Brazilian and international cuisine at the adjacent PIER XV restaurant. *Parking: R$25/day.

218543.description: Arosa Rio Hotel offers air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi. It is located in downtown Rio de Janeiro. Parking and a 24-hour room service are available. The accommodation at Arosa Rio Hotel includes an LCD TV, sofa and minibar. Each room has a differentiated décor. Buffet breakfast includes a variety of fruits, juices, breads and cold cuts. The menu includes various Brazilian and international specialities, as well as tropical cocktails. This hotel is located 1 km from the Sambadrome on Sapucaí Avenue and 4 km from Santos Dumont Airport. Copacabana Beach is 10 km away. *Parking: additional cost.

218575.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at Seventeen, a restaurant which specializes in Mediterranean cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Barcelona? This hotel has 4412 square feet (410 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 128 guestrooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

218581.description: This establishment offers a total of 17 units.

218616.description: Enjoy a satisfying meal at the Travelodge London Ealing's restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary breakfast is included. This hotel offers 99 air-conditioned guest rooms, each equipped with complimentary dial-up internet access, a safe, and tea/coffee making facilities. Bathrooms include a bathtub and hairdryer. Additional amenities include a safe deposit box at reception and an elevator. Located in London's Ealing district, the hotel is a short drive from Wembley Stadium and the River Thames, and within easy reach of Westfield London Shopping Centre and Kensington High Street.

218618.description: The Best Western Hotel Brussels South is located along the E19 Paris-Brussels motorway, just a few minutes' drive from the center of Brussels. You can park in the spacious, free car park around the hotel. Are you on business or visiting the capital of Europe as a tourist? You will receive superior service at this brand new hotel. The 75 guest rooms exude a relaxed atmosphere. Everything is here for your convenience: a soft bed, air conditioning, bathroom with shower, toilet and hairdryer, flat-screen television with USB connection, writing desk and telephone. Using the free Wi-Fi, you can immediately access the Internet. Need a coffee & tea maker, or an iron and ironing board? They are available from reception. Had a busy day? In the evening, relax in our brasserie. Choose from the range of choices: suggestion of the day, a salad or pasta. With a glass of wine or beer, unwind in our pleasant bar with its cozy seating area. Are you arriving later? We can still rustle up a snack from our kitchen.

218640.description: The Best Western Plus BorgoLecco Hotel, in the heart of Arcore, is located in a strategic position: thanks to the closeness of all the main highway exits you can easily reach Monza, Milano, Bergamo, Como, Lecco and many other destinations. For those who love sports, Arcore offers excellent structures where you can practice swimming or tennis and the charming park of Villa Borromeo, ideal for running. Moreover, golf players can choose between Golf Club Milano and Golf Brianza Country Club, those who love horses can go to the Centro Ippico Monzese and the near Monza racetrack will represent an unmissable stop. The Park of Monza and Acquapark funfair, both at only four kilometers, are a nice solution for your free time. The kind and professional hotel staff will make your stay even more comfortable. This hotel, recently renewed, is the ideal choice both for business and for leisure. Enjoy your stay. This property has joined the Stay for the Planet project. It undertakes to manage the hotel activities in a sustainable manner by monitoring consumptions, reducing the presence of disposable plastic, taking energy efficiency actions for a positive impact on the environment.

218834.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a sauna or take in the view from a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the 2 coffee shops/cafes. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 36 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and slippers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Gülhane Park - 0. 2 km / 0. 2 mi- Istanbul Archaeology Museums - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Eminonu Pier - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Basilica Cistern - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Bosphorus - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Eminönü Square - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Hagia Sophia - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Sultanahmet Square - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Cemberlitas Bath - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Grand Bazaar - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Topkapi Palace - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Süleymaniye Mosque - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Blue Mosque - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 47. 5 km / 29. 5 mi Istanbul Airport (IST) - 41. 2 km / 25. 6 mi The preferred airport for Oldcity Viva Hotel is Istanbul Airport (IST). Located in Istanbul (Istanbul City Center), Oldcity Viva Hotel is within a 10-minute walk of Basilica Cistern and Hagia Sophia. This hotel is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Grand Bazaar and 0. 9 mi (1. 4 km) from Topkapi Palace.

name.content: Hotel Villa delle Rose Malpensa - Novara

218853.description: Hotel Villa delle Rose*** is located in Oleggio, on the border between Piedmont and Lombardy, is a welcoming, warm and elegant hotel, a few kilometers from many points of interest, such as Malpensa Airport Terminal 1, Lake Maggiore, Vicolungo Outlet, Safari Park. It is located less than 4km from the center of the village. A 24/24 transfer service with driver is available both for the airport and for any other destination required. The hotel also has an on-site restaurant. The Reception is open 24/24 with multilingual staff. Hotel Villa delle Rose*** is a pet-friendly establishment.

218866.description: Located in Alanya's city center, this hotel offers 60 standard rooms, each featuring a balcony, air conditioning, hairdryer, shower, television, and telephone. Laminate flooring adds a modern touch. Guests can enjoy the on-site pool, restaurant, and bar located on the terrace, where a breakfast and dinner buffet is served. The terrace also provides stunning sunrise views. A variety of drinks are available at the bar until late at night. The beach, pier, entertainment centers, restaurants, shopping malls, and nightclubs are just a 5-6 minute walk away.

218903.description: Enjoy a stay at Casa Camper Barcelona, a luxury hotel in downtown Barcelona, just a 5-minute walk from La Rambla and Boqueria Market. This hotel offers a 24-hour fitness center, bicycle rentals, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Dine at Dos Palillos restaurant or the on-site cafe; room service is also available during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Airport and train station transfers are available (surcharge). The 40 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads, safes, and desks. Plaça de Catalunya and Barcelona Cathedral are within 0. 7 km.

218913.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, a computer station, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 17 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks.

218915.description: Seven Dreams Hotel guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 6 rooms.

218940.description: The hotel comprises a total of 120 snug guest rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available for further comfort and convenience. Baron Hotel & Spa provides 24-hour reception. Owing to its health and wellness services, this hotel is ideal for a relaxing break from the stress and strain of daily life. Baron Hotel & Spa takes pride in offering a choice of dining facilities which serve delicious culinary specialities. Some services of Baron Hotel & Spa may be payable.

218945.address: Ordu Caddesi Dibekli Cami Sokak N13 Beyazit Fatih, 13
218945.description: Hotel Niles Istanbul is a family-run hotel located on a quiet street only 984 feet from Beyazit Tram Station and a 3-minute walk from Grand Bazaar. It offers a cozy terrace with view of Marmara Sea, rooms with free WiFi and a gym with two treadmills, two bicycles, and weights. Designed in a contemporary or a refined 19th century Ottoman style, the air-conditioned rooms and suites at Niles hotel have a satellite TVs, mini fridges and private bathrooms. A safety deposit box is standard in each unit. The rooftop terrace has both glass-enclosed and open-air dining tables with views of the Sea of Marmara and the Old City. Daily breakfast is served with homemade pastries, jams, honey, omelets, cereals, fresh fruits and vegetables. Throughout the day, you can enjoy hot or cold drinks. The historic Sultanahmet area with Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque and Topkapi Palace is within 12 minutes’ walking distance. The staff, available 24 hours a day, offers concierge services, assists with car rentals and provides information about local attractions. Airport shuttle services are arranged at an additional fee. Group reservations: We are a small, boutique establishment and in order to sustain our service standards at Niles , the reservations of groups of five rooms or more will be subject to different terms and condotions and an additional approval of the General Manager.

218965.description: Clients will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay on the premises, as it counts with a total of 14guest rooms. Emine Sultan Hotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Emine Sultan Hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. Those who stay at this establishment arriving by car may leave their vehicle at the accommodation's parking spaces. Some services of Emine Sultan Hotel may be payable.

219084.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Hotel Estoril Porto, located in the heart of Porto. Take in the views from the terrace and garden, and make use of complimentary Wi-Fi. A continental breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include a communal living room, computer station, express check-out, multilingual staff, and tour/ticket assistance. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours). The hotel's 16 air-conditioned rooms feature LCD televisions with cable programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, desks, and bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Housekeeping is provided daily. You'll be within a 15-minute walk of Livraria Lello and Porto City Hall, and a short distance from other key attractions.

219140.description: Enjoy garden views and amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi and a shared TV area at Antica Villa Graziella Hotel, centrally located in Mestre. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) at the on-site coffee shop or with room service (limited hours). Daily complimentary receptions offer a chance to mingle with other guests, and you can unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel's 14 guestrooms feature LCD TVs, complimentary wired and wireless internet, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences such as phones, safes, and desks are also provided. A short drive takes you to Porto Marghera (3 minutes) and the Port of Venice (9 minutes). Other nearby attractions include the M9 Mestre Museum and Ferretto Square. Marco Polo Airport (VCE) is the closest airport.

219144.address: Arset El Houta 25 Derb Cherrata Medina
219144.description: With a total of 4 rooms, this is a nice place to stay. The accomodation offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. This hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience.

219177.description:
Set in Lido, this comfortable structure is optimal for families. Located within 1000 metres from the town centre, the accommodation allows easy access to all this destination has to offer. Within 20 metres guests will find links of transport that will allow them to explore the area. The property is within 300 metres from the nearest beach. Patrons will find the airport within 7. 0 kilometre(s). With a total of 15 accommodation units, this is a nice place to stay. This property was completely renovated in 2012. Oasis Lagoon Estate offers Wi-Fi internet connection on-site. The reception does not work around the clock. The property's guests rooms are provided with facilities for children such as a cot if necessary. Oasis Lagoon Estate is not a pet-friendly establishment. OASIS  Lagoon  is easily accessible by car in the Ferry-boat You can park your car in front of the property on the public way. All the area is very safe.
From the airport you can reach it with a direct shuttle (water) service.
It takes10 minutes by vaporetto (public water transport) from Lido to Saint Mark's Square and the Biennale is at 7 min distance from Oasis; with a 15 minutes walk you reach the Congress Palace and in only 3 minutes the beach.
OASIS was created as accommodation for our guests who wish to “live” in an apartment rather than “stay” as they would in a hotel: the apartments  provide a “holiday home”but are serviced and fitted with everything the average home would require.
Free public parking in front the property.

219182.description: Located in Gorgonzola, the Hotel Senator offers convenient access to Linate Airport (LIN), San Raffaele Hospital, and Acquaworld, all within a 15-minute drive. Guests can enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast, on-site dining at the coffee shop/cafe, and a relaxing drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel also features a fitness center, a garden, free self-parking, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each of the 42 air-conditioned rooms includes a minibar, private bathroom, and satellite TV.

219201.description: Situated in Cairo's city centre, this inn offers comfortable accommodation with free private parking and breakfast included, just minutes from restaurants, cafés, and the Egyptian Museum. Cairo Inn has cosy rooms of different sizes, to accommodate your travelling party. Each one has air conditioning and a small balcony.

219208.description:
The original first-line inn facing the Great Sphinx and Pyramids, Located right in front of the Pyramids of the Giza Plateau and The Grand Egyptian Museum(GEM) is about 1. 8 miles away. 

Because many hotels use fake or very similar names, it’s important to verify the real view before booking. To be sure you’re choosing a true front-row hotel, look for a clear view of the Sphinx—from your room or from the rooftop. 

The Sphinx is the detail that confirms you are directly facing the Giza Plateau. If you only see the pyramids, the hotel is nowhere near the front area—it can be several miles away, far from the actual viewing zone. Always check photos carefully and contact the property before finalizing your reservation. 
There is a shared kitchen and free herbal teas and coffee are available. 
A free, arrival pick-up airport shuttle is also provided

219210.description: Experience the magic of old Cairo at our fully renovated hotel, located in a historic 1937 building designated as a monument by Egyptian authorities. Our affordable, classy accommodations offer 18 rooms with 42 beds, some with private bathrooms. Enjoy amenities such as a fully equipped self-catering kitchen, an open-air terrace where breakfast is served, satellite TV, free Wi-Fi, and air conditioning or fans in each room. Most rooms offer balconies with street views.

219272.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features babysitting (surcharge) and a hair salon. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 50 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Cable television is provided for your entertainment. Bathrooms with bathtubs or showers are provided. Conveniences include safes and complimentary newspapers, and housekeeping is provided daily.

219284.description: There are a total of 90 guest rooms on the premises. Everyone staying at this accommodation may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. Clients may contact the reception desk any time during the day.

219302.address: 3 Ibrahim El Qabbanist Off Sabri Abualamst Harb
219302.description: With a total of 15 rooms, this is a nice place to stay.

219323.description: The Havana Hotel Cairo offers comfortable accommodation near the Giza Pyramids. Guests can enjoy complimentary breakfast each morning at the onsite restaurant, café, and bar/lounge. The hotel's 30 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, safes, free Wi-Fi, satellite television, desks, and phones. Bathrooms include showers and complimentary toiletries. ***Please note: Egyptian nationals sharing a room must present a marriage certificate.

219393.description: Stay at the Travelodge London Central Southwark, located in the heart of London, a short walk from iconic landmarks such as The Shard and Tate Modern. This hotel is also conveniently close to Borough Market and London Bridge, offering 99 comfortable guestrooms for a pleasant stay. Nearby airports include London City (LCY), Heathrow (LHR), Gatwick (LGW), and Luton (LTN), with London City Airport recommended for ease of access.

219414.description: The Howard Johnson Abasto offers amenities for both leisure and business travelers, with convenient access to transportation and cultural attractions. Our 42 rooms feature separate toilet and bath, LED TVs, balconies, bathtubs, and hot tubs. We also provide international plugs and laptop connectors, electronic safes, and WiFi throughout the hotel. In-room desks and chairs offer a comfortable workspace. For meetings and events, we have three rooms with capacities ranging from 30 to 400 people. Enjoy our naturally lit breakfast room, a courtyard for smokers, and a terrace. All rooms are smoke-free and pet-friendly. We also offer enhanced comfort for Shabbat, including kosher breakfast options (certified) and all necessary amenities such as a glass elevator, a staircase for religious observance, candles, and dual-lock doors (electronic and conventional). Automatic timers control room lighting. The interior courtyard and San Luis Street facades feature a unique aluminum grid designed for a future eco-friendly green wall.

219421.description: This hotel is situated in one of the most exclusive business areas in the San Isidro District. The hotel is located just a few steps away from the El Olivar Forest, lying just 100 metres from the Centro Empresarial Real San Isidro. This wonderful hotel is surrounded by exclusive shopping centres, boutiques and restaurants, as well as major attractions. The hotel features a modern design, yet embodies the essence of Peruvian style. The guest rooms guarantee relaxation and comfort, featuring soothing tones and a peaceful ambience. The hotel features a business centre, and meeting rooms which are suitable for seminars and conferences.

219422.description: The Pok-Ta-Pok Golf Club, nestled in Cancun's exclusive Hotel Zone, offers stunning views of Nichupté Lagoon and the golf course. Guests can unwind in tranquil tropical gardens or tee off at the 18-hole course designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr. , with equipment rentals available. The hotel provides a relaxed, home-away-from-home atmosphere perfect for holidays with family and friends.

219441.description: Centrally located in London, the Travelodge London Central City Road Hotel is within a 5-minute drive of Liverpool Street and St. Paul's Cathedral. This hotel offers 99 guestrooms with bathrooms featuring bathtubs or showers. Guests can enjoy a satisfying meal at the on-site restaurant and drinks at the bar/lounge. A breakfast service is also available (fee applies). The hotel provides wheelchair access, express check-out, and an elevator. Nearby attractions include the Barbican Arts Centre, The Gherkin, Brick Lane, and Sky Garden.

219525.description: The property comprises 38 cosy accomodation units. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. As this hotel features 24-hour reception, guests are always welcome.

219526.description: Located in a prime location by Istanbul's Golden Horn, this city hotel is ideally placed for visiting the attractions of the Sultanahmet district which can all be reached on foot within a few minutes. A rooftop terrace restaurant affords magnificent views over the Golden Horn and historical buildings of the area. Public transport and the Sirkeci train station are both nearby while the Galata Bridge crossing the Golden Horn is only a 10-minute walk away.

219547.address: Av Da Republica N 2208 8 Esq Rec
219547.description: Guests will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Residencial Caldeira as it counts with a total of 10 units.

219554.description: This manor house from the end of the nineteen century was built from an ancient farm house and has a most exceptional panorama over the village of Ponte de Lima and river. The house, offering all modern comfort is the perfect choice for those who appreciate the quiet privacy of this region either for a pure relaxed stay or to discover the Minho region. This world-class property, on the most desirable location, between the golf course and an excellent equestrian centre, was rebuilt to the original design with elegant inclusion of modern state-of-the-art-amenities. Its enchanted garden has the ambiance and beauty few other houses could match.

219557.description:
Quinta de Cima de Eiriz is set within typical Minho landscape of great beauty in the small village of Calvos about 10 kms from Guimarães. The house is situated on the Monte da Penha hills so the views are magnificent and the atmosphere utterly peaceful.
 This pretty country house dates back from the 17 th century and was later restored, depicting the traditional characteristics of the Minho region architecture. Its original design has been perfectly combined with modern comfort patterns.
 Besides the beauty of its surrounding environment and the several leisure activities available, this country house has a private outdoor swimming pool and an excellent games room.

219559.description: Situated just a fifteen-minute drive from the centre of Guimaraes, this stunning property dates back to 1376, having belonged to the same family since then. The elegant façade gives way to traditional interiors decorated with early 20th-century wallpaper, dark wood furnishings and stately portraits. Some rooms feature four-poster beds with antique-style bedding. Guests might enjoy a swim in the outdoor pool, take a stroll through the gardens or make use of the horse-riding facilities, or venture into nearby Guimaraes to explore the historic town. The property also boasts a vineyard and bottles its own wines.

219560.description: A beautiful rural setting above the Minho River in the village of Sa, is the location of this small farm property. Outdoor enthusiasts can enjoy fishing, canoeing, cycling and hiking in the surrounding areas. The Peneda-Geres National Park is nearby as are the Moncao and Melgaco Thermal Spas. The farm has its own vegetable gardens and vineyards and they produce their own traditional biscuits, jams, marmalades, liqueurs and wine. Among the amenities available for the use of the guests are an outdoor freshwater pool and free wireless internet access in public areas. A continental breakfast is served daily. The cosy inviting apartments have a rustic charm and are furnished with all the necessary conveniences including a well equipped kitchen. For those seeking a quiet, relaxing break this is a choice worth considering. This is a non-smoking establishment and pets are welcome.

219571.address: Av. Da Republica N 2208 8 Esq. Rec.
219571.description: The 36 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day.

219574.description: Pay a visit to Quinta de Santa Comba, and experience a step back to the farming days of years ago. This pastoral house, with its characteristic stonewalls and a wooden beam guarantees a warm welcome for its guests. Integrated within this homestead is a beautiful chapel, a haven for quiet relaxation at the end of the day. This rustic house with its characteristic stone walls and wooden beams dates from the 18th century and has long been a centre for farming and cattle breeding. Guests can appreciate the appealing pastoral atmosphere and enjoy a glimpse of ancient farming days, balanced with the tranquillity of its gardens.

219575.description: Located in Ponte de Lima, this cottage is on a river, within a 10-minute drive of Parish Church of Ponte de Lima and Dos Terceiros Museum. This cottage is 5. 1 mi (8. 1 km) from Parque do Arnado and 6. 8 mi (10. 9 km) from Feitosa Golf Club. This smoke-free cottage offers wheelchair access. Make yourself comfortable in this cottage, featuring a kitchenette with a full-sized refrigerator/freezer and a stovetop. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Conveniences include a separate sitting area and a coffee/tea maker, and housekeeping is provided daily.

219589.description: he exact date of construction of this rustic house is unknown, although by the architectural style and archaeological evidence, it is thought to be late 17th or early 18th century. This farm setting in the most northerly village of Portugal is close to the Peneda-Gerês National Park, rendering a most picturesque location. Nestled within a mountain region rich in flora and fauna, this traditional country house provides accommodation in a pleasant atmosphere, bringing its guests closely in touch with the natural environment of this region. A swimming pool and library and a small museum complete the attention given to detail. The surrounding countryside is ideal for walking and the nearby spa in Melgaço offers a range of relaxing and therapeutic treatments.

219594.description: Quinta da Veiga is located on the Douro River's right bank near the Ferrão train station, nestled between Régua and Pinhão. Characterized by schist slopes with excellent sun exposure at an altitude of 170m-220m, this area, known as Veiga do Donelo, was once comprised of smallholdings dating back to the 16th century. Today, it forms a single property: Quinta da Veiga, a winery producing Port and Douro wines. Situated within the Douro World Heritage area, this 50-hectare estate has been converted into a charming manor house offering Turismo de Habitação (country tourism). The main house features seven comfortable and stylish double rooms. The restoration of this elegant farmhouse carefully preserved the original architecture and materials, maintaining its traditional character.

219595.description: The spacious, modern apartments at Quinta da Prova offer an excellent base for a relaxing getaway. Enjoy fishing, hunting, swimming, and rambling in this peaceful riverside setting, surrounded by woodlands. Savor superb regional cuisine at nearby restaurants in Ponte da Barca, just 500 meters away. While in town, visit the riverside Diogo Bernardes Municipal Gardens.

219599.description: Located in the rural region of the sleepy town of Guimarei, this 16th century farmhouse nestles amidst vineyards and orchards in an agricultural environment. Just a short drive away is the town of Santo Tirso, situated in the valley of the River Ave, where visitors will find a variety of dining and retail options. Some interesting landmarks include the Abade Pedrosa Museum, the Romanesque Church of Roriz, the Citania de Sanfins, a pre-Roman settlement, and the Caldas da Saude thermal spa. The city of Oporto and its airport are only 30 km away. The accommodation consists of four heated en-suite rooms furnished in a country décor that is in keeping with the style of the building, and supplied with all the necessities required to guarantee the comfort of the guests. A lounge with a fireplace is available for all to use and breakfast is served daily.

219603.address: Av Da Republica N 2208 8 Esq Rec
219603.description: The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. Residencial Leão De Ouro offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night.

219606.description: Situated on a working farm, this restored guesthouse is set in the picturesque area of Estoraos, just 7 km from the stately and legendary town of Ponte de Lima. In the town visitors will find a variety of places to explore like churches, chapels, monuments and museums. There are also some interesting dining and shopping options. In addition there is a restaurant within walking distance of the property. Guests are welcome to take part in the farming activities or enjoy strolling through the surrounding countryside which is a mixture of natural treasures, ancient traditions and pretty villages. The house has a rustic charm with wooden beams and stone walls and offers a fully equipped kitchen for clients to prepare their own meals. The accommodation consists of two bedroomed apartments with a private bathroom. Everything has been provided to ensure a relaxing and memorable time.

219622.description:
Casa de Sequiade dates back from the 18th century, though it has been recently renovated keeping the splendour of the former historic building. The stone walls were restored leaving the typical granite of the region visible and also allowing full isolation of the interiors. The involving exterior space is carefully landscaped, possessing secret hiding places full of beauty.
 This granite-built house is surrounded by magic woodlands of timeless walnut and chestnut trees. Casa de Sequiade is perfect for a quiet stay, though it provides several leisure activities and its nearness to Barcelos allows guests to discover the rich culture of this traditional region.
 Leisure facilities include a wonderful swimming pool, bicycles and a games room and you will receive a warm and hearty welcome.

219629.description: This former farmhouse, once farmed by monks, is a perfect retreat and base for those wishing to explore this wonderful area of Portugal. It is located in the quaint old, country town of Amares. The old city of Braga is within easy reach and has many places of interest to attract visitors like the Exhibition Park and the Caldelas Thermal Spa. The Peneda-Geres National Park with its historical landmarks, wild animals and varied flora, is just a short drive away. The property is surrounded by well-kept gardens and offers many amenities including a small zoo of farm animals. A continental breakfast is available offering homemade marmalades and home grown organic produce. The interior retains its rustic charm and evokes memories of the past. All the accommodation is air-conditioned and has everything guests will need to enjoy a memorable holiday.

219630.description: Quinta de Santa Baia is a traditional 17th-century farmhouse in Portugal's Minho region, famous for its Vinho Verde wine. This beautifully preserved example of Portuguese architecture offers comfortable accommodations within its restored agricultural outbuildings. It's the perfect base for exploring the Ponte de Lima countryside, discovering its nature, culture, and heritage, and experiencing the tranquility of rural life.

219633.description: This stunning 16th-century Portuguese manor house, once a refuge for King D. António Prior de Crato in 1580, boasts over 400 years of history under the stewardship of the “Agorreta” family. Filled with superb family heirlooms and rare antique furniture, the apartments offer complete privacy and tranquility. As a leading Vinho Verde producer, the estate invites guests to sample its wines in the cellar, surrounded by the picturesque beauty of endless vineyards.

219648.description: Casa do Campo is a charming country manor house in an unspoilt, beautiful area high up in the hills above the Tâmega River. This impressive two-story stone and stucco house is fronted by a wall enclosing a beautiful small Renaissance chapel where mass is still held. It is a very large estate, owned by a numerous family, so it is not surprising that the family has renovated some of the bedrooms for guests. All the guestrooms are bright and inviting and each is individually furnished using handsome antiques. On entering the splendid gateway of this noble 17th Century manor house, one immediately detects the pervading floral scent. Casa do Campo boasts a prize-winning garden, with its immaculately trimmed Camellias contoured into graceful designs.

219653.description: Located in the center of the city near to Las Ramblas, Cathedral and Picaso Museum. Very good communicated with Barcelona beaches and near to shopping zone and restaurants, bars and discos.

219656.description: A 17th century magnificent and welcoming manor house, located in the historic centre of the medieval town of Ponte da Barca, with a delightful view over the Lima valley, at the “gateway” of the Peneda-Gerês National Park. Within this enchanting environment guests may enjoy the various terraces and expansive lawn. The pleasure of music and poetry are part of its rich and friendly cultural ambiance. Wine tasting is available and the gardens offer a pleasant stroll.

219657.description: Casa da Lage is a delightful manor house built in the 17th century distinguished by its historical background. Located in an agricultural and forestry property, Casa da Lage welcomes its guests offering the quietness, comfort and quality produced by its historical, cultural values. The guests can enjoy the exceptional architectural beauty such as a magnificent wood ceiling; traditional regional costumes and the unforgettable work dedicated to the quality of restoration and Tulha cottage adaptation.

219665.address: Barbaros Hayrettin Paşa Mahallesi 1992. Sok. No:4, No: 4
219665.description: At Euro Park Hotel, exceptional service and top-notch amenities create a memorable experience for guests. Complimentary internet access is available in the hotel to ensure you stay connected during your visit. Arrange your trips to and from the airport using the hotel's convenient transportation services booking. Complimentary parking is available for guests. For the health and well-being of all guests and staff, smoking is restricted exclusively to assigned zones. A delightful breakfast is the perfect way to begin your day, and at Euro Park Hotel, you can always indulge in a scrumptious meal on-site. Allow your journey to be free from the pangs of hunger! On-site eateries offer delicious and accessible meal choices. At Euro Park Hotel, guests can take pleasure in the delightful recreational amenities provided for their entertainment. At the hotel fitness center, you have the option to engage in your daily exercise routine or simply alleviate your jet lag by breaking a sweat.

219698.description: Costa do Sol offers an ideal and welcoming atmosphere for enjoying a holiday or a business trip, or as a starting point for exploring the North. Located in the heart of the historical city of Porto, in Rua de Santa Catarina, the best known shopping area of the northern capital, from here guests may stroll past the elegant shops, the grand cafés and experience the heritage of the city, visible in the monuments, the buildings, the markets and in the hospitable spirit of its people. There is also a Aero-Bus service that passes by the Hotel every 30 minutes as well as Rent-a-Car service. The Hotel also provides other services, such as: city tours, 24 hour reception, bar, laundry, winter garden and a private underground parking.

219702.description: Enjoy a central Porto location at Hotel Grande Rio, featuring a rooftop terrace, garden, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Amenities include a hair salon, tour/ticket assistance, bar/lounge, and limited room service. The 22 air-conditioned rooms offer LCD TVs with satellite programming, safes, and desks. A shuttle service is available (surcharge). Nearby attractions include Porto Historic Center and Porto City Hall (within a 5-minute drive), Ribeira Square (1. 8 mi), and Porto Cathedral (1. 6 mi).

219704.description: Its convenient location on a pedestrian street, in the centre of Porto, makes this an ideal place to stay for those wishing to explore this beautiful city. Many of the major attractions are close by including the Monastry of Serra do Pikar, City Market Bolhoao Market, Music House, Palacio da Bolsa and the UNESCO Protected Heritage Site, the old historic port La Ribeira. Of course a visit to the wine cellars that produce the famous Port wine is an experience not to be missed. Porto also offers plenty of restaurants serving a variety of traditional and international cuisine, bars and shopping malls. The complex has many amenities to cater for the needs of their guests. The air-conditioned apartments are spacious, comfortable and fully furnished in a contemporary style. Well presented, with all the essential elements, they are designed to guarantee an enjoyable stay.

219705.description: Featuring spacious, air-conditioned rooms, Hotel Vianorte is a 10-minute drive from Maia, Matosinhos, and Porto. The hotel offers a seasonal outdoor pool, ample private parking, and a 24-hour reception. Rooms are accessible by elevator and include a flat-screen TV with cable channels and a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower. The hotel's restaurant, overlooking the garden, serves a wide selection of regional and international dishes. Guests can enjoy snacks and drinks at Chantre's Bar or check emails at the internet point. Children can splash around in the kids' pool. Porto Airport is a 15-minute drive away.

219710.description: The reception desk is open all day long.

219711.description: In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night.

219712.description: Set in a quiet area to the north of the center of Porto, this hotel offers rooms with private bathrooms and free Wi-Fi. About 2625 feet away, IPO Metro Station provides links to the central Trindade. Porto Nobre offers free on-site parking. It is located about 1640 feet from the junction between the A20 and the A3. Busses stops just outside the door, connecting to the center and the Boavista area. Cable TV is provided in all rooms at Porto Nobre. The rooms are decorated in traditional style, with wooden furniture, and fabrics in neutral colors. 24-hour front desk and luggage storage are available. Porto Nobre has a cozy bar, where continental breakfast is served each morning.

219715.description: Located in the heart of historical Matosinhos, the 2-star Hotel Senhor de Matosinhos offers air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi. It has a 24-hour front desk and free parking available on site. The simply furnished rooms at Senhor de Matosinhos come with a cable TV, parquet floors and white linens. Each has a private bathroom. A continental breakfast is served daily in Matosinhos’ modern lounge. Guests can relax with a drink on a cushioned chair. Several restaurants, bars and shops are within a 10-minute walk away. The Jardim de Basílio Park is a 3-minute walk from Senhor de Matosinhos. Brito Capelo metro station is a 5 minutes’ walk away, and has direct links to Porto city center and Porto International Airport.

219718.description: Located in the heart of Porto, Hotel do Norte offers 36 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a vending machine. Nearby attractions include the Chapel of Souls and Bolhao Market (both 0. 1 km), Majestic Café (0. 3 km), and Porto City Hall (0. 6 km). Porto Airport (OPO) is 17. 8 km away.

219723.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace at Hotel Miradouro, located in Porto's Centro/Baixa district. Borrow one of the hotel's bicycles to explore the city or relax with a meal at the on-site restaurant, or enjoy room service during limited hours. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM, and you can unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge in the evening. The hotel offers 30 individually decorated guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, cable TV, and private bathrooms featuring complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Hotel amenities include limo/town car service, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self-parking is available on-site. Nearby attractions include the Chapel of Souls (0. 5 mi), Bolhao Market (0. 6 mi), Majestic Café (0. 7 mi), and Porto City Hall, a short 5-minute drive away. Porto Airport (OPO) is 10. 6 miles from the hotel.

219726.description: Airporto Hostel features a total of 22 guest rooms. Airporto Hostel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The hotel provides 24-hour reception.

219732.description: This stunning 17th-century manor house is located within an hour's drive of the historical cities of Braga and Porto and the Natural Park of Peneda-Gerê. Guests can stay in elegantly-decorated units within the house itself, which has seven bedrooms, some with private balconies or verandas, and two one-bedroom cottages with kitchenette. Facilities include two outdoor pools and a fabulous BBQ area, whilst a former wine cellar has been converted into a games room where guests can play pool, table tennis or table football. They may also choose to relax in the lush garden, which includes centenary trees, ornamental ponds and fountains, or have a glass of locally-produced wine in one of the beautiful patios. A short stroll through the fragrant gardens leads to one of the swimming pools. The property can arrange activities such as hiking and cycling. A children's playground is also available.

219735.address: Avenida dos Aliados, Uniao de Freguesias do Centro, 38 A
219735.description: Situated on the elegant Avenida dos Aliados, in Porto's historic heart, Hotel Universal is steps from iconic landmarks like City Hall, Trindade Church, São Bento Railway Station, Clérigos Tower, and the Douro River. Enjoy easy access to the city via foot, bus, or metro. The train station is a mere two minutes away, and the airport metro station, a five-minute walk, connects you to the airport in 30 minutes.

219737.description: Quinta da Mata is a granite-built manor house from the 17th century – with a private chapel, located 3 km away from the city of Chaves on the hillside of “Serra do Brunheiro” surrounded by a luxuriant forest and by transparent streams. The access to the main house is made by a magnificent stair that leads to a forecourt to welcome guests. A pleasant garden embraces and compliments the main home's exquisite finish out and décor. Horse riding, cycling, and walking, along fascinating pathways are some of the diversified leisure activities available.

219756.description: This comfortable accommodation is located in the modern district of Berlin Mitte, and it is surrounded by convenient public transport links that allow guests to easily access the main tourist attractions in the city like the Brandenburg Gate, the Unter den Linden avenue, the Reichstag Building, Checkpoint Charlie or Postdamer Platz. Central Berlin railway station is not far from the premises either, which offers bus connections to Tegel and Schönefeld airports. Bedrooms are soundproofed and feature a small seating area. They enjoy an exclusive design inspired in the city's urban artwork and have practical amenities like WIFI connection and reading lamps in each bed. The establishment also provides a delicious breakfast and has a bar and a lounge area to meet other people and relax.

219761.description: The newly restored Cristal Guest House offers guests personalized service and a relaxed, professional atmosphere. Located in the heart of historic Porto, you're within walking distance of major attractions and the city's vibrant nightlife. Our cozy rooms include daily fresh towels, LCD TVs with cable, free Wi-Fi, telephone, private bathrooms, in-room breakfast, and boarding pass printing.

219767.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Featured amenities include laundry facilities and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 9 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms with showers are provided. Conveniences include desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Bolhao Market - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Chapel of Souls - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Holy Trinity Church - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Porto City Hall - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Town Hall Square - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Majestic Café - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Aliados Square - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Porto Coliseum - 1. 4 km / 0. 8 mi- Church of Saint Ildefonso - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Rua das Flores - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Rua de Miguel Bombarda - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Santa Clara Church - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Livraria Lello - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Clérigos Church - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Praça da Batalha - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi. The nearest major airport is Porto Airport (OPO) - 16. 8 km / 10. 5 mi With a stay at Seculo Soft in Porto (Centro / Baixa), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Porto Historic Center and Porto City Hall. This guesthouse is 1. 6 mi (2. 5 km) from Ribeira Square and 1. 4 mi (2. 2 km) from Porto Cathedral.

219768.description: Enjoy on-site massages and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. A shuttle service to nearby destinations is available (surcharge). The hotel offers a coffee shop/café, 24-hour room service, and a bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is served daily (7 AM - 10 AM, fee applies). Business amenities include a center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event space (269 sq ft) is available. Free self-parking is provided. The 40 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, LCD TVs, cable programming, private bathrooms (bathtubs, complimentary toiletries, bidets), phones, safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include Quinta de Santa Cruz Winery (0. 5 mi), Hospital de S. Joao (4. 3 mi), Norte Shopping (5 mi), and more. Porto Airport (OPO) is 4. 7 miles away.

219770.description:
This old historic house was completely renovated to become the newest Guest House in Oporto city!
The luxurious interiors are filled with vivid colors and a bealtifull mix of classic and contemporary decoration.
•	Private ensuite Bathroom
•	24-hour reception
•	Free Cable TV
•	Free wifi

219776.description: This 47-room property is ideally located just outside the old historic quarter of Guimaraes. It is only a 5-minute walk from the railway station and just 500 metres from the central Plaza de Santiago. Those arriving by car can use the on-site parking facilities free of charge. The reception area has a cash point and the staff at the 24-hour reception service will be only too pleased to safeguard your valuables in the safe deposit. The hotel has a boardroom and fully-equipped business centre for those who have to work and banquet facilities for holding events. The entire establishment is a smoke-free zone and all the modern, soundproof guest rooms have satellite and cable TV, central-heating and air-conditioning and some are provided with a sitting-room zone. On request, breakfast will be served in the accommodations and free-of-charge Wi-Fi is available throughout the building.

219778.description:
The Ecosalvador Hotel is housed in a light and modern building surrounded by natural beauty.
 Overlooking the river Cávado, this hotel enjoys an outstanding location in Peneda - Gerês, providing a perfect base for a relaxing holiday.
 SERVICES - Heating, Bar, Free Parking, Terrace, Fax / Photocopying, Internet Wifi.
 ENTERTAINMENT - Hours from 08h to 24h.

 LOUNGE - Bar, Cable TV and table games.

ACTIVITIES - Games Room, Children's Playground, Outdoor Swimming Pool for adults and children.

219786.description: Located in Porto's trendiest quarter, between the art district and nightlife, the eco-friendly Gallery Hostel embodies the new concept of a luxury hostel, prioritizing excellent service, cleanliness, and top-notch facilities alongside a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. This 41-bed hostel is ideal for design, culture, and budget-conscious travelers. Above all, Gallery Hostel's secret lies in its soulful character, dedicated staff, and commitment to making you feel at home. The project involved rehabilitating an impressive 1906 building, maintaining most of the original aspects of a traditional Porto house while blending it with modern decor. The design infuses neutral, earthy tones with unique textures and furnishings.

219792.description: Studios Porto Solar offer comfortable studio apartments on the famous rua Santa Catarina, a key commercial strip in central Porto. On this pedestrian street you'll find the famous Café Majestic, dating from the 1920s, plus other houses, shops and historic cafés like ‘A Brasileira’. The area is an ideal starting point for discovering the history of Porto, starting with the emblematic Avenida dos Aliados,a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In Porto's historic old town don't miss the views from the Luís I bridge, a stroll through the Ribeira district or a visit to Porto's wine cellars on the banks of the beautiful river Douro. The nearest metro station is 200 metres away, with direct connection to Porto airport in approximately 20 minutes.

219794.description: All guests staying at this property will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Residencial Borsalino as it counts with a total of 15 rooms. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Those who stay at this establishment can enjoy the convenience of 24-hour reception. Parking facilities are available for guests' convenience.

219795.description: With an original diamond-shaped design, Hotel Diamante is a 10-minute drive from the Arluno and Marcallo-Mesero exits of the A4 motorway. It offers free parking and free Wi-Fi access. All air-conditioned, rooms at the Diamante come with a safety deposit box and private bathroom. Breakfast is buffet style and the restaurant, open for groups on request only, serves Italian cuisine. The Diamante Hotel is located between FieraMilano exhibition centre in Rho Pero and Malpensa Airport, around 20 minutes' drive from each. The hotel is connected to Milan city centre by the S6 line from Corbetta-S. Stefano Tickle Station one kilometre away. A range of shuttle services to the airports and several sites are available upon request.

220088.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of recreational amenities such as an indoor tennis court, sauna, and fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. Savor Italian cuisine at Trattoria Podazzera, enjoying garden views and al fresco dining, or order room service (limited hours). A complimentary reception is held daily. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily (7:00 AM to 9:30 AM, for a fee). Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge, on request), and free self-parking is provided. The 42 guestrooms offer minibars, LCD televisions, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Safes, desks, and daily housekeeping are also provided. Nearby attractions include the Ecomuseum of Roggia Mora (1. 4 mi), Palazzo Merula (1. 7 mi), and Vigevano Cathedral (1. 7 mi).

220098.description: The UNAHOTELS Malpensa, a modern 4-star hotel, is conveniently located in Cerro Maggiore, just 10 km from Milan and easily accessible from the Milano Malpensa Airport via the hotel's free shuttle service. The hotel also offers a free shuttle to and from the Rho Milan Fair during major events. Its strategic location, with immediate motorway access just 500 meters away, ensures quick travel to Milan's city center and other destinations.

220105.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a picnic area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:30 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include luggage storage, a library, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 20 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms feature bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and irons/ironing boards. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

220108.description: Nestled in the heart of historic Zwanenburg, our hotel is just a short distance from Amsterdam Schiphol Airport and central Amsterdam, as well as Haarlem, Hoofddorp, and the RAI Amsterdam convention center. We offer complimentary shuttle service to and from Schiphol Airport, or free parking for the duration of your stay. Amsterdam and Haarlem are a quick ten-minute train ride away. For a change of pace, explore the coastal charms of Zandvoort or the floral displays of the Keukenhof Gardens in Lisse, both within a half-hour drive. The Jordaan district in Amsterdam is easily accessible by bus, and a short 11-minute train ride from Halfweg-Zwanenburg station will take you to the heart of Amsterdam. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.

220242.description: In the Hotel Balneario Termes Victoria you will find the peace you need to relax and to have a pleasant stay. Our spacious gardens and the different balconies are ideal to stroll or to sit and read comfortably, as you will feel transported to the 18th century. Our 7 halls and our 4 dining rooms, with a carefully studied design, are the ideal place for any celebration or company meeting, for they cater to all needs.

220308.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, a steam room, and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy Moroccan cuisine at Le Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 26 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

220420.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a private beach or take in the view from a terrace. Enjoy a satisfying meal at AMERICAN GRAFFITY serving guests of Hotel Europeo. Relax with a refreshing drink from the bar/lounge or one of the 2 beach bars. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. 220421.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as bicycle rentals, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services at Hotel Caldin's, centrally located in Chioggia. Additional amenities include babysitting (surcharge), an arcade/game room, and a picnic area. The hotel's 12 guestrooms feature refrigerators, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences such as safes and desks are also provided, with daily housekeeping. Steps away are the Museo civico della Laguna Sud and Museo Diocesano, with the Cathedral of Chioggia and Palazzo Comunale a short distance away. The preferred airport is Marco Polo Airport (VCE), approximately 36. 4 miles from the hotel.

220454.description: The Wassberg hotel is located in quiet surroundings in Forch close to Zurich, and offers you exquisitely designed rooms with nice views as well as fresh seasonal cuisine. Free WiFi is available in all areas. Modern design classics like the Lehni lamp and the Eames Plastic Armchair by Vitra provide for an interesting contrast to the Wassberg's country-style atmosphere. The guest rooms are fitted with parquet flooring of light Canadian maple wood. Whenever possible, organic seasonal produce is used for preparing the tasty dishes. Meat and fish come from farms that respect animal welfare or from wild catch. Ingredients are always fresh and of the highest quality. A large selection of wines are offered to perfectly complement the culinary delights.

220462.description: A delicious basket of seasonal fruits awaits guests as they enter their spacious, individually designed rooms at this boutique hotel nestled in lush gardens in northern Portugal, just 35 km from Porto. This charming establishment boasts two restaurants serving traditional Portuguese cuisine, including freshly baked country bread, cod, and local wines. Guests can also relax in the stained-glass tea room after a round of golf at the nearby course (3 km) or a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool shaded by tall oak trees. Start the day with a freshly prepared continental breakfast before exploring Porto, an hour's drive away, enjoying the tennis courts, or renting a bicycle to discover the local countryside. All rooms feature ample seating areas and en-suite bathrooms with complimentary toiletries.

220492.description: With a small number of only 3, this establishment is very convenient for a quiet stay. Travellers may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at De I Bravi House. De I Bravi House offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night.
