220527.description: This Wetzikon hotel offers 110 guest rooms equipped with minibars, safes, and complimentary bottled water. Enjoy free wired and wireless internet access, along with digital programming. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy a variety of amenities, including a 24-hour health club, bicycle rentals, an arcade/game room, and a restaurant with a coffee shop/café. Room service is also available during limited hours, and there's a bar/lounge for evening relaxation. Buffet breakfast is served weekdays and weekends for a fee. The hotel also features a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. With over 4, 000 square feet of event space, it's ideal for conferences and meetings. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include the Aathal Dinosaur Museum and Jucker Farm. The preferred airport is Zurich Airport (ZRH).

A wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment venues can be found nearby. The bustle and excitement of the stylish city of Milan is within driving distance of this hotel. This hotel offers guests an insight into the rich culture and history of the area. This wonderful hotel comprises elegantly-designed guest rooms, which exude classical style and charm. Guests will be pleased by the many facilities and services that this wonderful hotel has to offer.

A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Stay in one of 38 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. 221085.description: Enjoy modern comforts like complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a cozy lobby fireplace at Hotel Osteria della Pista. Savor Mediterranean cuisine at the on-site restaurant, or grab a quick bite at the café. Room service is available during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast (7:00 AM - 9:30 AM). Business amenities include a business center and express check-in. Complimentary airport shuttle service is available upon request. The hotel offers 30 guestrooms featuring minibars, pillowtop beds, Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Located near AMSC - Acquavillage Gallarate (1. 4 mi), Basilica di Saint Agnese (1. 9 mi), and Castle Visconti San Vito (1. 9 mi). Milan Malpensa Airport (MXP) is the closest airport (6. 9 mi).

221221.description: Hotel Locanda Al Piave is located in the heart of San Donà di Piave, near the gardens of the Parco Fluviale. It offers free Wi-Fi, free parking and a large buffet breakfast. Rooms at Locanda Al Piave are all air conditioned and come with a satellite TV. Al Piave's restaurant offers a sweet and savoury buffet breakfast, which includes homemade cakes. At dinner, it serves fish and meat dishes and Venetian specialities. The hotel is a short walk from the bus and train stations for connections to Venice and Jesolo. It is a 25-minute drive from Marco Polo Airport, and 10 minutes from the A4 motorway exit. The hotel reserves the right to pre-authorize the full amount of the reservation as a guarantee.

221316.description: The 105 welcoming accomodation units offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. The establishment includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and guest rooms. The hotel provides 24-hour reception. Cots are not available at this establishment. Visitors travelling for business purposes may take advantage of the property's business facilities.

221323.description: The four-star Castelbarco Hotel, a historic villa nestled within an 800-square-meter park bordering the Adda and Martesana rivers, offers a tranquil escape in the Northern Adda Regional Park. Located just 1. 5 km from the Trezzo subway stop on the A4 line and 18 km from Orio al Serio Airport, the hotel provides convenient access to Milan and beyond. Elegant rooms, some featuring exposed beam ceilings and spa baths, come equipped with air conditioning, LCD TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. A breakfast buffet is included. Guests can enjoy two on-site restaurants: Le Serre and the Bistro Restaurant (accessible via a free shuttle), boasting a panoramic terrace overlooking the Adda River. Multilingual transfer services, free parking, car and bike rentals, and tour booking assistance are also available. Castelbarco Hotel seamlessly blends history, nature, and modern comfort, making it an ideal destination for business travelers and leisure seekers exploring the cultural and natural attractions of Northeast Milan and the Adda Nord Park cycling circuit.

221338.description: The accomodation comprises a total of 34 snug accomodation units. Visitors can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the hotel. Hotel Schildow offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night.

221442.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. 221451.description: Head down to the water and enjoy a day at the private beach, or take advantage of other recreational amenities, which include a seasonal outdoor pool. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Hotel San Giorgio, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Make yourself at home in one of the 100 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

221485.description:
The Budget Motel is a comfortable 3-star accommodation in a great location between Wettingen and Zurich Airport.

This modernly furnished motel in the industrial area of Dällikon offers an excellent price performance ratio. In front of the reception there is a cosy sitting corner (the only smoking area) and there is also a snack vending machine.

221675.description: This magnificent non-smoking hotel is located in the district of Meidling. The metro station Schöpfwerk Am is just a 3 minute walk away and the city centre of Vienna lies within just 15 minutes' ride. Guests will be impressed by cutting-edge facilities and services tailored to cater for needs of even the most demanding guests. There are different accommodation options including spacious and sumptuously appointed rooms and apartments designed with attention to detail. The cosy cafeteria serves a buffet breakfast every morning and drinks, snacks and pastries throughout the day. This attractive property's restaurant serves Austrian dishes and traditional Viennese specialties. In summer, guests may enjoy their meal on the enchanting terrace. Afterwards they may enjoy a quality drink from one of the three welcoming bars. The establishment is perfect for business and leisure stay offering versatile meeting facilities as well as wellness and spa.

221678.description: This hotel boasts a wonderful setting in Mumbai. The hotel is situated just 7 km away from Nariman Point and Cuffe Parade. Guests will find themselves just 5 km from Dadar Railway Station, and a 45 minutes' driving distance from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport. This hotel offers guests a great setting from which to explore and experience the rich culture and history of the area. Guests can enjoy a wide range of exciting activities nearby. This wonderful hotel enjoys a charming design. The guest rooms offer comfort and convenience in a relaxed setting. Guests are sure to appreciate the wide range of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

221679.description: This hotel boasts a prime setting in Mumbai. The hotel is located in the Mumbai Suburban District, close to Rishi Dayaram National College. The hotel is situated within easy access of Juhu Beach, which lies just a 15 minutes' driving distance away. This wonderful hotel is conveniently located just 3 km away from Santacruz Domestic and International Airport. This charming hotel extends a warm, friendly welcome to guests upon arrival. The guest rooms are contemporary in design, featuring neutral tones brought to live with vibrant colours. Guests are invited to enjoy a delectable dining experience in the relaxing surroundings of the restaurant.

221722.description: This wonderful hotel offers a convenient location, just 2. 5 km from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport. Guests can relax in the outdoor swimming pool or enjoy a meal at the on-site restaurant. The elegant rooms feature carpeted floors and are fully equipped with standard amenities, including attached bathrooms with shower facilities and complimentary toiletries. A 24-hour front desk assists with luggage storage, valet parking, and travel arrangements. Meeting/banquet facilities are also available. Saffron Spice restaurant serves traditional Indian, Chinese, and continental dishes, with in-room dining options provided. The hotel is located within 4 km of Andheri Station and 7 km from the popular Juhu Beach. Akruthi Centre Point building is just a 2-minute walk away.

221864.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy Italian cuisine at Ristorante Visconti, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and bidets.

221957.address: Kuloğlu Mh. Istıklal caddesi Alyon Geçidi, 2
221957.description: Located on a quiet side street just off the bustling Istiklal Street, this cosy hotel is very centrally placed and ideal for a business trip or for visiting the fascinating attractions of Istanbul. Taksim Square is just a short, 5-minute stroll, where there is a metro and bus station providing easy access to the rest of the city. The historical attractions at Sultanahmet are about a 20-minute journey by public transport. The hotel features exuberant and lavish décor with parquet-laminate flooring. Guests can dine at the in-house restaurant, though there are many restaurants and café bars nearby. There are also entertainment venues and shops near the hotel, making for an exciting sightseeing holiday or productive business trip.

221979.description: This small, well-furnished and decorated hotel has a homely atmosphere and is located conveniently close to all the major attractions in Sultanahmet. Featuring a rooftop terrace boasting superb views over the city and Marmara Sea, it has a small lobby area and free Wi-Fi. A tramline runs close-by and café bars and restaurants can be found within close proximity of the hotel.

222014.description: This trendy, modern hotel is conveniently located in Istanbul's Bahcelievler district, only five kilometres from Ataturk Airport. The area offers many entertainment options on its wide, tree-lined streets with cafés, cinemas and shopping centres. Sightseeing in the ancient Sultanahmet neighbourhood is only 15 kilometres away, while the Taksim business district can be reached in about 30 minutes by car. The spacious guest rooms and suites feature original, imaginative designs and come with handy kitchenettes with kettle and minibar. Suites also boast a luxurious hot tub and a living area with a soft, cosy sofa. Business travellers can take advantage of free in-room internet access and the large work tables to get some work done, and in the morning wake up to a complimentary buffet breakfast. This hotel's sleek, contemporary rooms and excellent services make it ideal for a business trip to Istanbul. **Breakfast is served at Tempo Fair Suites across the street.

222055.description: A stay at HelloBCN Hostel places you in the heart of Barcelona, within a 10-minute walk of Palau Guell and La Rambla. This hostel is 0. 7 mi (1. 2 km) from Boqueria Market and 0. 7 mi (1. 2 km) from Montjuic. Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and a communal living room. Additional amenities at this hostel include tour/ticket assistance and a vending machine. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Make yourself at home in one of the 23 air-conditioned rooms featuring microwaves. Prepare your meals in the shared/communal kitchen. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers.

222135.address: Olawasijibomi Street, Off Yaya Abatan Street, 9
222135.description: Located in the tranquil Ogba district of Ikeja, Lagos, our urban retreat embodies the spirit of Nigeria. Our stylish, well-appointed rooms and convenient facilities offer a personalized experience for absolute relaxation. The Oragon Hotel and Suites represents a pivotal moment in Nigerian history, symbolizing the nation's independence. We honor this legacy through our distinctive, Afrocentric approach to customer service. We believe in the uniqueness of each individual and strive to cater to your specific needs, ensuring a memorable stay.

222260.description: The Hotel Café Royal, a luxurious 5-star hotel, graces Regent Street in the heart of London, nestled between elegant Mayfair and vibrant Soho. A short walk reveals iconic attractions like Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, and the National Portrait Gallery, alongside world-class shopping and theaters. Sensitively restored historic areas dating back to 1865 blend seamlessly with contemporary spaces. Guests can indulge in diverse dining experiences, from the Grill and Sushi Bar - Laurent at Café Royal to the relaxing Green Bar and the opulent Oscar Wilde Lounge, perfect for afternoon tea. Ziggy's cocktail bar offers a unique tribute to David Bowie. The Akasha Holistic Wellbeing Centre provides a 1200+ sqm urban retreat.

222279.description: Hotel Villa Royale is a 10-minute walk from Brussels-North Railway Station and a 20-minute walk from key sights like Grand Place and the Brussels City Museum. A tram stop next to the hotel offers easy access to the Royal Palace and various museums. Rooms feature a minibar, TV, and work desk, along with modern en suite bathrooms with a shower. The hotel provides a 24-hour reception and a shuttle service (available upon request for an extra charge). Free Wi-Fi is available in all rooms. Public parking is a 5-minute walk away. Sint-Joost-ten-Node is a great choice for travelers interested in shopping, waffles, and chocolate.

222294.description: A total of 50 rooms are available for guests' convenience at Adora Butik Hotel. The establishment offers Wi-Fi internet connection on-site. Adora Butik Hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. Adora Butik Hotel does not offer cots on demand. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

222354.description: Just a 5-minute walk from Ilford Railway Station, Arinza Hotel London offers free onsite parking, free Wi-Fi, and continental breakfast throughout the whole day. Ilford Railway Station and Gantshill Underground Station offer direct access to Central London, with Oxford Street and Piccadilly Circus just 35 minutes away. Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park is only 15 mins away. Following London airports are also at a close distance:City Airport: 15 mins driveStanstead Airport: 20 mins driveHeathrow Airport: 45 mins driveGatwick Airport: 50 mins driveAll rooms have modern furnishings, tea and coffee making facilities, LCD interactive TV, climate-controlled Air Conditioning, and free WiFi. Each room also features an ensuite bathroom with a power shower and complimentary toiletries.

222614.description: Its enviable position overlooking the Langebaan Lagoon makes this hotel an idyllic location to spend some time. This area, a paradise for fishing and water sports enthusiasts, also has trails for hikers and mountain bikers that will satisfy nature lovers wanting to see the native flora and fauna. Apart from numerous boat trips, visitors can enjoy visiting such sites as the legendary Doc's Cave or the French Huguenot Memorial. Hotel facilities include swimming pool, gardens, volleyball court, mini golf course and children's play area. There is also a first class restaurant, a cocktail bar and a games room. Business guests can use the business centre and the well-equipped conference rooms. All the spacious, pleasantly furnished rooms have either sea or mountain views. They come with air-conditioning, television and phones. Non-smoking rooms are available as are amenities for the disabled.

222676.description:
Located near LaGuardia Airport, our Flushing, New York hotel provides guests with a comfortable environment that is just minutes away from the excitement of New York City, Rockefeller Center, Flushing Meadow Corona Park and Marina, Long Island and the Queens Museum. 

Families are sure to enjoy nearby New York attractions like the New York Hall of Science, Citifield or the Statue of Liberty during their stay at our accommodations.

224781.description: This property boasts a countryside setting in Bedfordshire. Luton Airport is just a 10 minutes' driving distance away. Heathrow International Airport is a 40 minutes' car journey from the property. Stunningly situated amidst 1,000 acres of parkland and gardens, which were designed by Capability Brown, this spectacular hotel oozes regal elegance and splendour. Mature trees are dotted throughout the surroundings, while the River Lea flows by the property. This luxurious mansion tempts visitors into a world where classical charm, contemporary style and traditional elements are combined. The sumptuously-designed guest rooms exude character and charm. Guests can enjoy boating and fishing in the lake. Guests can dine in the original state dining room, which is drenched in regal glamour. This hotel is sure to surpass the expectations of even the most discerning traveller.

224875.address: Cihangir, Kazancı yokuşu, Pürtelaş Sk. 12 Beyoğlu, 12
224875.description: Located in the trendy Cihangir district, just a 3 minute walk from Taksim Square and close to bustling Istiklal Street, this attractively decorated hotel is in a great central location for exploring this fascinating city. It has 13 modern, light and comfortable rooms and suites and features a breakfast room, lobby lounge and small garden where breakfast is served (weather permitting). Public transport runs from Taksim Square providing easy access to the historical attractions at Sultanahmet, 4km away.

224877.description: This stylish apartment complex is situated in the Sisli District of Istanbul. The complex is surrounded by ample shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. A myriad of intriguing attractions can be found nearby. Taksim Square is located just 2 km from the complex. Guests will find themselves just a short bus ride away from the historical Sultanahmet, and its captivating attractions. Dolmabahce Palace and the Istanbul Museum of Modern Art are situated nearby. Links to the public transport network are located close to the complex. This wonderful complex appeals to business and leisure travellers alike. The apartments are well equipped, and are stylish in design. Guests can enjoy a delightful breakfast delivered to their door, for a superb start to the day

224975.description:
The James, synonymous with the seamless blend of modern, residentially styled, state-of-the-art technology and guest-centric service found at its Chicago location, will bring those same attributes to its new property in New York City. Early departures will be charged the full amount of original reservation. No name changes will be accepted 7 days or less prior to arrival. Must be 18 years of age to check-in. If a guest is under 21 years of age, they must pay $50 for mini bar removal. 

David Burke Kitchen is now closed and officially replaced by Gitano at the James SoHo.

Gitano Jungle Room NYC is inspired by and imported from our home Tulum in the Yucatan Peninsula, the Gitano Jungle Room inhabits two floors inside the James New York - SoHo. Flanked by signature lush, tropical plants, the GITANO pink and gray, design is paired back and minimal, colonial and opulent.

name.content: Esplendor By Wyndham Buenos Aires Plaza Francia

225337.description: This hotel enjoys an exciting setting in Buenos Aires, at the heart of Recoleta. The hotel is situated just a short distance away from the heart of the city, while the nearby public transport links offer ease of access to a number of attractions. The hotel is conveniently situated just a short driving distance away from the airport. This modern hotel features contemporary-style guest rooms, which are stunningly appointed to enhance comfort and convenience. The hotel offers well-equipped meeting rooms, for the convenience of those travelling for work purposes. Guests can enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day. Guests will experience a truly enjoyable stay at this sublime hotel.

225458.description:
This comfortable hotel is in Lido di Jesolo. The 103 welcoming rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. "Hotel D'annunzio is a traditional, family-run Italian hotel renowned for its hospitality and has been welcoming British guests for many years, who often return year after year.
The rooms are equipped with private bathroom with shower, large balconies, overlooking the swimming pool or the main street.
All rooms are accessible by lift.
The excellent open-air café ""Friends Bar"" serves meals and snacks during the day and an English breakfast in the morning.
Free Wi-Fi available in the reception and in the Friends Bar area.
You can also relax all day around the secluded swimming pool or venture within walking distance (100 meters) of the splendid beach, of which the hotel has a private section and the shops and bars of Lido di Jesolo are on your doorstep.

225459.description: Located in the heart of Jesolo, Hotel Monaco & Quisisana offers a seasonal outdoor pool, a snack bar, and a bar/lounge for guests to enjoy. Each of the 105 air-conditioned guestrooms features a desk, a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower, complimentary toiletries, and a bidet. A complimentary local cuisine breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, an elevator, and limited on-site parking. Caribe Bay Jesolo and Piazza Mazzini are within a 15-minute walk. Piazza Brescia is 1. 5 miles away, and Piazza Milano is 3. 7 miles from the hotel.

225460.description:
Hotel Ambasciatori Palace is on Lido Di Jesolo's coast and features a gourmet restaurant and a large terrace. It offers rooms with a private bathroom. 

All the bright rooms are decorated in a classic style, fitted with tiled floors. Each comes with air conditioning and a satellite TV. 

Breakfast at the Ambasciatori Hotel is served daily in the dining room. It is buffet-style and includes a variety of sweet and savory products. It is possible to enjoy your breakfast in the comfort of your room, at an extra cost. The hotel’s restaurant specializes in regional and Mediterranean cuisine. 

You can sit and relax on the sea-view terrace, equipped with tables and chairs. You can also have a dip in the swimming pool, located in the garden.

225461.description:
This lovely hotel is set in Lido di Jesolo. There are a total of 100 units on the premises. Those staying at this hotel may keep updated thanks to the Wi-Fi access. Principe Palace offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. Moreover, Principe Palace has made important environmental improvements in order to minimize its impact on the environment and features the Travelife certification. There is no time to get bored at this hotel thanks to the entertainment options on offer. 
"The 4-star Hotel Principe Palace is located in the heart of Jesolo: it overlooks Piazza Mazzini, the main square in the central area of the Lido.
One of the first hotels built in Lido di Jesolo, it was founded by Commendatore Santin Venerino in 1947.
The hotel was expanded several times in 1952, 1956 and 1960 and renovated in 2001.
It is one of the best hotels in Jesolo, thanks to its central location

225462.description:
Well-positioned in the center of Jesolo Lido, Hotel Kennedy is just 164 feet from its own private beach, with good transport links and a large outdoor pool on site. 

Sun umbrellas and loungers are provided free of charge at Hotel Kennedy’s private beach and the pool is the perfect place to cool down in summer. 

Inside Hotel Kennedy you can relax in the TV room and lounge or enjoy a few drinks and English and Italian snacks on the terrace bar. 

The restaurant serves delicious à la carte dishes. 

Step out of Hotel Kennedy onto one of the longest pedestrian streets in Europe, where you will find a huge selection of shops, restaurants and bars. Tennis courts and mini golf are just 984 feet away and a variety of other sports can also be carried in the nearby area. 

Free parking is subject to availability and cannot be booked in advance

225514.description: Welcome to the Candlewood Suites Secaucus-Meadowlands, an extended-stay hotel! Enjoy newly renovated apartment-style suites with great amenities, including a 24-hour fitness center, complimentary laundry facilities, and full kitchens. Borrow games and appliances from our lending locker, and enjoy complimentary digital access to the New York Times and Financial Times on your 37 or 43 TV. Our convenient Secaucus location is just minutes from MetLife Stadium, Meadowlands Racetrack, American Dream Mall, and more. The Secaucus train station, with direct service to New York Penn Station, is only two miles away, providing easy access to Manhattan attractions like Times Square and the Statue of Liberty.

225551.description: This cozy hotel, nestled in Amsterdam's cultural heart, offers international guests every expected comfort. Just an 800-meter stroll from the PC Hooftstraat shopping district and a 15-minute walk from the Museum Quarter, the hotel is also conveniently located a mere 3 minutes from Vondelpark. Schiphol Airport is a short 13-kilometer trip. The hotel boasts a fresh, modern interior, stylishly furnished with an eye for relaxation. Guests can unwind in the tranquil garden, centered around a magnificent magnolia tree. Comfortable rooms provide all the expected amenities and more.

225553.description: This lovely lodge/guesthouse is located in Westcliff, Hermanus, known as the “Whale Watching capital of the world” and offers excellent accommodation in combination with exciting adventures. Guests can book a whale-watching weekend, explore the beautiful landscapes and beaches or do a wine-tasting trip in the heart of the South African wine industry. The spacious, individually decorated rooms offer beautiful views of the lush green gardens and en-suite bathrooms with separate shower and bathtub. After a day filled with excitement guests can take a dip in of the 2 solar heated pools and relax in one of the loungers with a glass of wine of cold beer.

225554.description: Just 20 km from the coast and within 300 m of a nature reserve, this hotel provides a comfortable accommodation with a personal touch. The owners and staff are happy to assist with recommendations about trips to the most beautiful and exciting locations in the area. Guests can start an exciting day of exploring South Africa with a delicious continental breakfast or with a dip in one of the pools. The sun loungers offer breath-taking mountain views. This complex provides excellent accommodation combined with environmental and social responsibility. The pools are heated using a solar power system, and natural compost is used in the organic vegetable and herb garden.

225616.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services, a television in a common area, and a vending machine. Grab a bite from the grocery/convenience store, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 27 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and slippers. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

225634.description: This boutique hotel enjoys a fantastic setting in the heart of Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, making this the perfect base for a sightseeing holiday in this fascinating city.  The celebrated Blue Mosque and Grand Bazaar are just around the corner, while Hagia Sophia, the underground cisterns, and Topkapi Palace are all within walking distance.  In addition to a 24-hour reception, the hotel features a café and restaurant which serves traditional Turkish cuisine for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  Guests can take advantage of free, in-room cable and Wi-Fi internet access, and each comfortable room comes with an LCD television and a modern, en suite bathroom.  This hotel offers contemporary rooms, a charming design and an unbeatable location for a wonderful holiday in the city where east meets west.

225638.description: Conveniently situated in a quiet residential area only a 10-minute drive from El Dorado Airport, this hotel provides complimentary shuttle service and parking for the arriving guests. Visitors to Bogota can use it as a comfortable base for a trip to the picturesque Botanical Gardens only a 5-minute drive away, or for the exploration of the Bogota area. The tradition wooden floors and colourful orange and red décor of the rooms immerse guests right into the local atmosphere and provide luxurious accommodation with all the modern amenities for a pleasant stay. The hotel restaurant serves regional cuisine and the bar offers wines and cocktails with a backdrop of beautiful city views.

name.content: Howard Johnson By Wyndham Ezeiza Convention Center

225640.description: Discover Argentina from the Howard Johnson Ezeiza Convention Center, conveniently located near family-friendly attractions. Start your day with a complimentary breakfast buffet and free Wi-Fi to plan your itinerary. Relax in the heated indoor and outdoor pools before retiring to your comfortable guest room. Non-smoking rooms and refrigerators (available upon request for a small fee) are offered. A fully equipped fitness center, meeting rooms, and a spa are also on-site. Shuttle service to and from the airport and local destinations is available. Surrounded by green spaces, the hotel offers children's activities every weekend. Up to two children aged 12 and under can stay free when sharing a room with a parent.

225703.description: This traditional Moroccan riad in the heart of Marrakech is just a 5-minute walk from the famous Jmaa El Fna market, in a typical historical area. The traditional exterior of the building is surprisingly combined with furniture from different times and styles, so guests can experience the typical feel of Morocco with a modern twist. After an exciting day or as part of the exploration of the local culture and customs guests can try the hamam or enjoy a refreshing drink in the lush patio by fountain. In the heat of the day, they can take a dip in the pool or admire the views of the medina from the panoramic terrace. Guests do not have to look far for a delicious dinner – the restaurant of the hotel serves a variety of Moroccan and Mediterranean dishes to satisfy every taste.

name.content: Hampton by Hilton Amsterdam / Arena Boulevard

225780.description:
The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Fitness Center, Breakfast, Valet Parking.The following services and amenities are currently **not available**: Business Center, On-site Restaurant(s).Set in the heart of Amsterdam's vibrant entertainment district, just next to the Amsterdam ArenA, the Hampton by Hilton Amsterdam / Arena Boulevard hotel is just a short walk to The RAI Convention Centre, Ziggo Dome, the Heineken Music Hall and many shops, restaurants and bars. Amsterdam Airport Schiphol is just a 10 minute train ride away via the train station, located just opposite the hotel. Enjoy easy access to many popular attractions including the famous canals and the Anne Frank House.
Feel at home in your comfortable guest room or suite where you can stay connected with free WiFi at the spacious work desk with ergonomic chair or watch a movie on the 26 inch flat screen TV as you relax on the comfy bed. Host an event at this Amsterdam hotel in our modern Board Room and stay connected with the free business center, offering a range of useful services and amenities. Energize with a morning workout in the free fitness center before enjoying Hampton's free hot breakfast buffet. There's a friendly face and free tea and coffee available in the welcoming lobby, 24 hours a day, should you need some advice on what to see and do while you're in Amsterdam.
Friendly service, clean rooms, comfortable surroundings, every time.

name.content: Hampton by Hilton Amsterdam Airport Schiphol

225782.description:
The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Fitness Center, Breakfast.The following services and amenities are currently **not available**: On-site Restaurant(s).Welcome to the Hampton by Hilton Amsterdam Airport Schiphol hotel. Conveniently located just five minutes from Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS) and 20 minutes by train to Amsterdam's vibrant city center, the hotel is perfect for stopovers, leisure breaks and business trips. Discover Amsterdam's famous attractions including the canals, the house of Anne Frank and the Van Gogh Museum. Enjoy fantastic shopping at one of Holland's biggest shopping centers, just a 15 minute walk away. Haarlem, The Hague and charming smaller Dutch Villages are also within easy reach of our hotel at Amsterdam Airport.

Unwind in a comfortable guest room with thoughtful amenities including a comfy bed, free WiFi and a handy lap desk. Start your day right with Hampton's free hot breakfast and enjoy a variety of snacks from our diverse evening menu. After a busy day, relax over drinks in the bar, work out in the fitness center, or catch up with work at the business center. Host a meeting or special celebration in a choice of versatile meeting rooms.

Prepare for a busy day with Hampton's free hot breakfast, served each morning. There is also a restaurant serving international cuisine within walking distance of our hotel – ideal for lunch or dinner. It's easy to maintain your exercise regime throughout your stay with the cardio machines in our free fitness center. Keep on top of work at the 24-hour business center or use our boardroom for small meetings of up to 10 guests.

225857.description: Nestled in the heart of the Midlands, just five minutes from Junction 2 of the M5 and opposite Dudley Zoo and Castle, this charming hotel offers a warm, friendly welcome, free Wi-Fi, and parking. The property is perfectly positioned for those wishing to explore the historic Black Country and is just a short distance from the Black Country Museum, Merry Hill Centre, and Birmingham City Centre. The hotel has a long and storied past; its grand staircase, high ceilings, and tall windows evoke the traditional ambiance of a bygone era. Each of the comfortable and well-appointed en suite bedrooms is complete with modern comforts to create a home-away-from-home atmosphere. The restaurant offers an extensive selection of fine food and wine, all served in stylish and sophisticated surroundings. There is also a lounge bar leading onto an impressive conservatory where guests can relax and enjoy drinks with friends.

name.content: Riad Les Trois Palmiers El Bacha

225916.description: Riad Les Trois Palmiers El Bacha, a beautifully restored 18th-century Moroccan house, is nestled in the heart of Marrakech's medina, a mere 10-minute stroll from the vibrant Jemaa El Fna square. This traditional riad boasts two inviting pools, two courtyards, and complimentary Wi-Fi in public areas. Indulge in a traditional Moroccan breakfast each morning, complemented by tea and pastries throughout the day. Upon request, the owners can prepare authentic homemade Moroccan specialties for dinner. Guests can also unwind with a drink at the on-site bar. For added convenience, the riad offers massage services and can arrange tours and airport transfers (additional charges apply). The Ben Youssef Madrasa is also just a 10-minute walk away, and Marrakech Menara International Airport is 7 km from the property.

225930.address: KAKAD CORNER,MAROL PIPELINE,ANDHERI KURLA RD Mumba, 318/41
225930.description: This stylish corporate hotel is located 2 km from the International Airport and the Andheri Railway Station, in close proximity to the city's exhibition centre, business and commercial buildings. Guests can choose between several accommodation options, but they all share a calm and relaxing atmosphere and furnishings, and amenities that will make them feel at home, while away. All units have seating areas and beautiful views of the city or the courtyard. Even the most seasoned travellers will find their taste and appetite satisfied in the excellent restaurant of the hotel. The master chefs prepare delicious signature dishes from the north Indian cuisine.

226002.description: This sophisticated apartment concept in Bogotá offers a unique residential experience. Choose from one- or two-bedroom units, each meticulously designed, built, and furnished with exquisite modern standards and finishes. Enjoy magnificent social areas, meeting rooms, and state-of-the-art technology for maximum comfort and efficiency, whether traveling for leisure or business.

226134.description: Indulge in a pampering experience at the full-service spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take a refreshing dip in one of the three outdoor swimming pools or unwind on the private beach, easily accessible via the complimentary shuttle. This all-inclusive property offers various dining options with meals and beverages included at most onsite establishments. Additional charges may apply for select restaurants, special dinners, specific beverages, and other amenities. Enjoy diverse culinary experiences at four restaurants, including Turquoise Restaurant, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Light bites are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind with a drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of the three bars/lounges. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel also provides a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free valet parking is available onsite. Each of the 316 guestrooms features a private balcony, free minibar items, an LCD television with satellite programming, and a bathroom with a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. Located near the Mall of Side, this property is a short distance from Side West Beach, Kumköy Beach, and other attractions.

226135.description: This hotel enjoys a delightful setting, lying just 50 metres away from the beach in Side. The hotel is located just 1 km away from the town centre of Side, where guests can explore a host of shopping, dining and entertainment venues, as well as cultural and historical attractions. Antalya Airport is located 62 km away. This charming hotel enjoys a splendid design, incorporating elements from the country's rich tradition. The hotel comprises beautifully-appointed guest rooms, which are steeped in simplistic beauty and serenity. The restaurant offers a delightful dining experience, allowing guests the opportunity to savour the delights of Turkish cuisine.

226136.description:
Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional amenities at this property include wireless internet access (surcharge), concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. The complimentary beach shuttle makes getting to the surf and sand a breeze. This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Grab a bite to eat at one of the property's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 5 bars/lounges.

226143.description:
Uve Marcenado is located in the Ciudad Jardin neighbourhood of Madrid between the airport and the city centre, this comfortable Hotel is ideal for business travel. Prosperidad metro stop is only 300 metres away, and a variety of cafes, bars, restaurants and shops can be found in the area. Also nearby are the National Auditorium of Music and several leafy, green parks such as the Park of Berlin.
Uve Marcenado is modern and comfortable. All rooms have Smart TV, Free Wifi, Mini-bar (with charge), safe box and private bathroom. Some rooms have a private balcony.  24-hour reception and laundry service offered by the hotel. With its great city location and easy access to the centre, this hotel is sure to please.

226439.description: This property enjoys a superb setting in the wonderful city of Madrid. The property lies just a few minutes' walking distance from many of the city's most prominent attractions. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from the Prado, Reina Sofia Museum and Paseo del Retiro Park. The nearby metro station offers convenient access to Plaza Mayor, Puerta del Sol and Gran Via. This property comprises elegantly-styled apartments and penthouses. The unit offer space, functionality and comfort, and come well equipped with modern amenities. Guests will enjoy a comfortable, relaxing stay at this charming establishment in Madrid.

226440.address: Calle Del Marques De Casa Riera, 4
226440.description: The NH Collection Madrid Suecia hotel, formerly known as NH Madrid Suecia, is in the heart of the city's historic center. Steps away from the shopping of Callao, and Calle Fuencarral, it's a chic hotel ideal for exploring the nearby museums as well as downtown Madrid. Completely refurbished in 2016, our 123 rooms are bright and airy with unique artwork and ambience. Our deluxe rooms offer panoramic views and connecting rooms are also available. Start the day with a buffet breakfast and try local delicacies as well as mediterranean dishes throughout the day in the multiple dining spaces spread out over various floors decorated by Lázaro Rosa Violán . The basement cocktail bar is rumored to be where Hemmingway found inspiration, and our roof top terrace offers unrivalled views of Madrid's skyline and a wide array of cocktails. Explore the coty's hidden gems with the help of the hotel's Guest Relations team, and keep in shape in the fitness center. For those travelling on business, there are also 3 multi-functional spaces available for up to 154 people and Wi-Fi is free throughout.

name.content: Casa Bella Boutique Hotel San Isidro

226514.description: The Hotel Casa Bella is located in the city of Lima, all rooms have a private bathroom, toiletries, a television and a complimentary bottle of water, and this hotel also includes an American-style breakfast. Our hotel is very close to Alfonso Ugarte Park, just a 7-minute walk away, also very close to El Olivar de San Isidro Park, just 5 minutes away by car.

226547.description: With a stay at Hotel Canaletto, you'll be centrally located in Venice, within a 5-minute walk of St. Mark's Square and Rialto Bridge. This hotel is 0. 2 mi (0. 4 km) from St. Mark's Basilica and 0. 4 mi (0. 7 km) from Doge's Palace. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Make yourself at home in one of the 38 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. St. Mark's Square - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Marco Polo's Home - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- T Fondaco Dei Tedeschi - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- San Teodoro - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Rialto Bridge - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Teatro Malibran - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- St. Mark's Basilica - 0. 4 km/0. 2 mi- Teatro Goldoni - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- St Mark's Campanile - 0. 4 km/0. 3 mi- Chiesa Santa Maria dei Miracoli - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Basilica di San Giovanni e Paolo - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Museo Correr - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Riva degli Schiavoni - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Palazzo Contarini del Bovolo - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Rialto Market - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi. The preferred airport for Hotel Canaletto is Marco Polo Airport (VCE) - 13. 7 km/8. 5 mi.

226549.address: 31 10 B St Bur Dubai BOX 9168, TRASLADOS
226549.description: The premises count with 750 welcoming rooms. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. The reception desk is open all day long.

226602.description: This stylish and luxurious boutique hotel offers sophisticated accommodation options in the heart of Madrid, only a few steps from the famous Gran Via. The Gran Via metro station is only 200 metres away, making it incredibly easy to move about the city, and the Royal Palace, Almudena Cathedral, Puerta del Sol and Plaza Mayor can all easily be reached within a 20-minute walk. The elegant and serene suites are apartment-like with a living and dining room and a fully-equipped kitchen in addition to one or two bedrooms. The hotel offers free Wi-Fi and snacks in-room, as well as a private parking for a small fee. Guests can prepare home-cooked meals in the kitchen, or venture out into the city for fabulous tapas or haute cuisine. With its polished interiors and city surroundings, this hotel is ideal for those seeking a central location with room to breathe, whether travelling for business or leisure.

226634.description: The Archer Hotel New York offers a stylish stay with a rooftop terrace boasting stunning city views. Enjoy amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and on-site dining options, including the AKB hotel bar and a snack bar. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available for a fee. The 180 guestrooms feature pillowtop beds with luxurious linens, flat-screen TVs, and espresso makers. Private bathrooms include designer toiletries. Located near Fifth Avenue, Herald Square, and Bryant Park, the hotel provides easy access to iconic attractions like the Empire State Building and Times Square. LaGuardia Airport (LGA) is the nearest airport.

name.content: Quality Inn JFK Airport Rockaway Blvd

226655.description: Welcome to our non-smoking Howard Johnson Inn Jamaica JFK Airport NYC hotel. We are conveniently located off the Belt Parkway with easy access to the excitement of New York City. Our Jamaica hotel is minutes from John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) and we offer free shuttle service to and from the airport. Experience The Big Apple and its many delights, and stay happy at our hotel, your home base in NYC. Wake up and prepare to be happy, as you enjoy free Rise & Dine breakfast, free WiFi and 24-hour coffee station. We also offer free parking on a first-come, first-served basis, and guest laundry services for a fee. Ask about our free airport shuttle service.

226694.description: This cosy hotel is the ideal accommodation destination for everyone visiting Edinburgh. In front of Leith Links park and close to Ocean Terminal shopping centre, the property is also not far from the famous Royal Yacht Britannia for those interested in paying a visit. Using the public transport connections or their own car, travellers can easily get to the city centre and go to Princess Street. Built in a Georgian house and set in a quiet area, this hotel will provide a pleasant and relaxing stay without a doubt. It is fitted with nice guest rooms, which are fully equipped and include modern amenities to guarantee an unforgettable stay. Guests will appreciate the warm welcome at their arrival by the hotel’s staff, who will make sure guests have a pleasant time at the property.

226696.address: Opp Mashreq Metro Station Sheikh Zayed Road Barsha, 1
226696.description:
Hotel that makes every moment matter. The Novotel Dubai Al Barsha is a 4-star hotel located in Dubai's city centre with convenient access to the city's major business hubs and leisure attractions. Our state-of-the-art meeting rooms are the perfect place for conferences, trainings and meetings of all kinds. After a day of sightseeing or business meetings, enjoy a relaxing dip in our beautiful heated outdoor pool or enjoy a pre-dinner drink at the bar. 

The spectacular Novotel Dubai Al Barsha towers over Sheikh Zayed Road, close to the city's major business hubs and tourist attractions. The Insurance Market Metro Station, just across the street, offers quick access to the famous Mall of the Emirates. The mall has everything from denim to diamonds. Later, chill out at Ski Dubai, warm up on Jumeirah Beach, stroll through the Souk Madinat, marvel at the Burj Khalifa and the World Trade Centre, and much more. 

Perfectly located in Dubai's Al Barsha area, Novotel Dubai Al Barsha offers easy access to all major attractions. Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and only a short walk away from Dubai metro station - every location in the city is easy to reach.

226811.description:
Situated in the Las Cañitas area in the north of Buenos Aires, these modern and attractive Apartments provides easy access to the businesses and industrial parks in the northern zone, as well as many administrative offices such as embassies and international organizations. The neighbourhood is known as one of the more upmarket areas in the city with both tree-lined, cobblestone residential streets and high-rise buildings.
The Building offers classic and superior apartments, both bright and stylish with kitchenette, living area, dining area and balcony. Guests can unwind in the gym after a long day, and go for a swim in the outdoor swimming pool, make use of the indoor whirlpool and sauna, or sunbathe on the terrace. The hotel also offers cleaning services, massage services, and free Wi-Fi. With its city location, contemporary, spacious apartments and useful meeting rooms, this is the ideal place for business travel.

226879.description: The ibis Buenos Aires Congreso hotel offers a practical and economical stay. Centrally located near tourist spots and various metro stations, the hotel has free WIFI, a restaurant that is open daily for breakfast, lunch and dinner, a 24-hour bar, paid parking (not in the hotel) and airport transfer. Small dogs are permitted.

226880.address: Av Corrientes 1344 Esq. Talcahuano Y Uruguay
226880.description: The ibis Buenos Aires Obelisco hotel is located 37 minutes from Ministro Pistarini International Airport (Ezeiza), 21 minutes from Aeroparque Jorge Newbery and 13 minutes from the bus terminal. 228976.address: Calle De Le Balote, San Marco, 4868
228976.description: CIN CODE: IT027042B4T5MZKM9O Luxury accommodation in a small and exclusive hotel just a stone's throw from St. Mark's Square in the centre of Venice. Lying in a quiet and narrow side street between St. Mark's and the Rialto Bridge, this historical hotel occupies a 14th Century monastery and has been decorated to have a classical Venetian interior. There are only 6 private en-suite rooms on the premises and guests can expect total privacy and tranquillity except when they require the property's professional services. All the units have a hydro-massage bathtub or power shower and other standard room features include extremely comfortable beds and linen. The largest suite has a balcony overlooking the canal below. The location is perfect for visiting the city's most prominent landmarks, including the Doge's Palace, seat of the maritime republic for more than 1000 years, and the graceful bridges spanning the Grand Canal.

229076.description:
Boasting a privileged situation in the upscale neighbourhood of Recoleta in the centre of Buenos Aires, the elegant Cyan Recoleta Hotel is located close to the famous Recoleta Cemetery, Recoleta Mall, the cultural centre and the Nuestra Señora del Pilar Church. Attractions such as the convention centre or the National Library are within a short stroll, while Colon Theatre, Galerías Pacífico Mall and Calle Florida are within easy reach.

The functional hotel offers spacious rooms with a stylish, minimalist interior design. Many of them boast wonderful city views, and all are equipped with air-conditioning, complimentary WIFI, microwave and LCD TV. The hotel serves a buffet breakfast, and guests will appreciate the hotel's lovely terrace. This contemporary hotel is a great choice both for business travellers and holidaymakers when visiting the capital of Argentina.

229135.description: The total number of guest rooms is 19. Clients may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Apolo. All guests staying at this property will appreciate the 24-hour reception.

229179.address: Zone 13- Al Meyyah Street Msheireb Doha, Qatar
229179.description: Situated in central Doha, this modern hotel offers convenient access to Hamad International Airport (15-minute drive) and the Corniche waterfront promenade (10 minutes). Guests can enjoy breakfast in the comfort of their rooms, each featuring a living area and a flat-screen satellite TV. Self-catering is made easy with kitchenettes and dining areas in every unit. Complimentary wellness facilities include an indoor pool, sauna, gym, and jacuzzi. A security deposit of QR 1, 000. 00 is required upon arrival.

229235.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. If you'd like to spend the day shopping, you can hop on the complimentary shuttle. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a cruise ship terminal shuttle. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 39 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring heated floors and LED televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

229256.description: Located only 100 metres from Istiklal Avenue, this budget-friendly hotel offers 24-hour front desk service and modern room with complimentary WiFi access. It is just 200 metres from Taksim Square, 230 metres from Hagia Triada Greek Orthodox Church and 280 metres from Taksim German Hospital. Ataturk Airport is only 20 km away, making it convenient for travellers to reach this establishment. Featuring carpeted floors, all rooms include a flat-screen TV, air conditioning, safe box and a minibar. Each room also has a private bathroom with all the necessary amenities. Guests will be spoiled for choice with the numerous restaurants, cafés and bars at Istiklal Avenue.

229321.description: With a total of 7 units, this is a nice place to stay. Those staying at this accomodation may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. Those who stay at this establishment may contact the reception desk any time during the day.

229329.description: This eco-friendly hotel enjoys a privileged location in the quiet residential area of Affori to the north of the city centre. There are several shops and restaurants nearby and it's just a short walk to the nearest metro station and to the railway station at Bovisa. The nearby suburb of Niguarda offers some fascinating neo-classical architecture. The tastefully- decorated rooms and suites offer a full range of modern amenities, including air-conditioning, flat screen TV and free Wi-Fi throughout. The hotel itself uses sustainable energy and low-voltage light bulbs. The large buffet breakfast with organic produce makes for a great start to the day and the hotel's own restaurant serves a variety of local specialities including vegetarian and vegan options. Guests can also take advantage of the different wellness treatments. Private parking is available onsite.

229369.description: This cosy establishment guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 11 accomodation units. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Som Nit Born follows environmentally sustainable practices.

229383.description: This opulent hotel boasts an unbeatable location directly in front of the German Chancellery in Berlin. Public transport and a bustling area with dining, shopping, and cultural attractions are nearby. History buffs can easily visit landmarks like the Brandenburg Gate, German Historical Museum, and Alexanderplatz. The hotel epitomizes luxury and high-quality service. Soundproofed and air-conditioned rooms and suites offer sumptuous decor and modern comforts. A well-equipped spa provides invigorating workouts and relaxing treatments. The hotel also offers impressive meeting facilities for business travelers.

229520.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a communal living room. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 8:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include multilingual staff, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 21 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones and blackout drapes/curtains, and housekeeping is provided on request. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Museum of the Center for the Acropolis Studies - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Acropolis Museum - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Filopappos Hill - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Odeon of Herodes Atticus - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Temple of Athena Nike - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Theatre of Dionysus - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Greek Evangelical Church - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Hadrian's Arch - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Erechtheion - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Acropolis - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Parthenon - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Athens National Garden - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Ancient Agora of Athens - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Roman Agora - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Adrianou Street - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi. The preferred airport for Art Gallery Hotel is Athens Intl. Airport (ATH) - 35. 1 km / 21. 8 mi A stay at Art Gallery Hotel places you in the heart of Athens, within a 15-minute walk of Acropolis and Parthenon. This hotel is 0. 4 mi (0. 6 km) from Acropolis Museum and 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Ancient Agora of Athens.

name.content: art'otel amsterdam, Powered by Radisson Hotels

229596.description: art'otel amsterdam blends art, hospitality and cuisine in the very heart of Amsterdam. Inspiring and creative, yet approachable and inclusive, art'otel amsterdam is brilliantly positioned with the lively Dam Square and Kalverstraat on the doorstep. The work of artist Atelier Van Lieshout permeates every corner, while a spectacular 12-metre interactive art display evokes differing emotions. The signature 5&33 Kitchen serves Mediterranean-inspired sharing plates, while the 5&33 Bar is open daily for indulgent cocktails, house-brewed beers and infused syrups, accompanied by live DJ sets. The 5&33 Lounge is perfect for chilling beside a cosy fireplace and the extensive 300-square-metre 5&33 Gallery showcases selected artists. Culture vultures can escape to the 5&33 Library where books and magazines relating to art, culture, design and lifestyle inform and entertain. For further relaxation, an ultra-modern Active Club with gym, pool and sauna is complemented by an inviting solarium and beauty salon. Guests can choose from an Art Room, an Art Room XL or a spectacular Masterpiece Suite. All 107 guestrooms feature a piece of art, mood lighting and lavish Elemis guest amenities. The bathrooms boast rain showers and luxurious bathrobes and slippers, while an Illy espresso machine, stocked minibar and complimentary breakfast enhance the welcome.

229635.description: This apartment hotel is located in the historical Sultanahmet District of Istanbul. The hotel is situated just a few metres away from the Blue Mosque. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace. The hotel lies just a 15 minutes' walking distance from the Grand Bazaar. The waterfront overlooking the Marmara Sea is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. The hotel enjoys a traditional Ottoman style, complemented by modern influences. The guest rooms are beautifully styled, featuring soothing tones and a serene ambience. Guests can enjoy a delightful meal in the hotel's elegant restaurant.

229637.description: Located in the Atasehir district on Istanbul's Asian side, this stylish hotel is in close proximity to business, shopping and entertainment centers. Travellers will be able to reach transport hubs such as the Kozyatagi metro station and Bostanci Port in just a 15-minute drive. Ataturk International Airport is 40 kilometres away. Guests will receive a warm welcome in the luminous 24-hour reception, and can choose among rooms with balconies, terraces, and hot tub bathrooms. Each spacious room features a refreshing, modern décor and is equipped with LCD televisions and free Wi-Fi as well as standard amenities such as air-conditioning, and guests can wake up to a delicious buffet breakfast each morning, all during a fantastic stay in Istanbul.

229741.description: La Bottega del Falegname, built in 2012, offers guests a peaceful retreat in its six guest rooms. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi in public areas and on-site parking. The hotel is conveniently located within walking distance of public transportation. Some services may incur a fee. The reception desk does not operate 24 hours a day. The airport is approximately 9000km from the hotel.

229742.description:
The Only YOU Boutique Hotel offers a unique and unforgettable experience in the heart of the Spanish capital. Housed in a beautifully refurbished 19th-century palace, the hotel boasts a contemporary yet warm style, blending colonial colors with Mediterranean touches. 

Each of the 125 intimate and cozy rooms, designed by Barcelona's Lázaro Rosa Violán, tells its own story, seamlessly combining 19th-century architectural details with modern amenities for a luxurious and comfortable stay. 

YOUNIQUE Arts Club offers a Mediterranean cuisine concept, while the hotel provides 24-hour room service.

229745.description: Superbly located in the very heart of the cosmopolitan city of Barcelona, this charming boutique hotel offers modern amenities while retaining echoes of the past and the essence of Catalunya's modernist style. The property boasts six beautifully-decorated air-conditioned rooms with queen or king size beds. Thanks to the hotel's unbeatable location, guests can easily stroll to the major attractions of the city centre within ten minutes, including the world-famous La Rambla, the tranquil expanse of the Ciutadella park, the exclusive shopping street of Paseo de Gracia and the beautiful Eixample area with its numerous tapas bars, restaurants and trendy clubs. There is an underground and train station on the doorstep of the property, providing guests with quick and easy access to the entire city, and all the Gaudi buildings, as well as nearby beach resorts such as Sitges.

229747.address: 331, Dr. Ambedkar Road, Pali Hill, Bandra (West)
229747.description: Executive Enclave is situated in Mumbai's suburb, Bandra, less than 10 km away from Chhatrapati Shivaji Airport International Airport. Linking Road, Bandra's shopping hub, is just a 10 minutes' drive away from the hotel. Rooms at Executive Enclave have dark wood furniture and colourful décor. Each has an en suite bathroom with bathroom amenities. Facilities include air-conditioning, cable TV and a minibar. Facilities at the Executive Enclave include business and fitness centres. The tour desk staff can schedule excursions to Mumbai's attractions or arrange car rental. The hotel offers free public parking and free airport pickup service. Guests can enjoy Indian, Chinese and continental dishes at Executive Enclave's multi-cuisine restaurant. The rooftop café, open in the evenings, faces the sea. Drinks are available at the bar.

229794.description: The Hotel Belleclaire, a landmark building designed by Emery Roth in 1903, offers classic charm alongside modern conveniences. Located in the residential Upper West Side of Manhattan, it's steps from the American Museum of Natural History, Central Park, and Lincoln Center. This 244-room hotel, ideal for both leisure and business travelers, also boasts proximity to an array of boutiques, prominent restaurants, and bars.

229936.description: This sophisticated hotel boasts a prime setting in the mesmerising city of Istanbul. The hotel is located in the Osmanbey quarter of the city. Situated on Halaskargazi Street, it lies just a short walking distance away from Rumeli Street. Taksim Square can be found nearby. This hotel has been hailed as one of the most stylish hotels in the city. Featuring a minimalist, Italian architectural style, the hotel exudes elegance and charm. The guest rooms offer elegance and luxury in a comfortable setting. The hotel prides itself on its exemplary customer service, delivering a high level of excellence. The hotel's wide range of exemplary facilities and services have been designed to meet the needs of even the most discerning traveller.

230058.description: The newly refurbished Commodore Hotel, a beautiful Victorian townhouse in London, offers a unique 4-star hotel experience. A range of accommodations, from comfortable rooms to spacious suites, are available, including executive rooms, double rooms with sofa beds (suitable for triples), and townhouse suites. The hotel is committed to ongoing improvements and updates throughout its rooms and public areas.

230103.description: The accomodation features a total of 17 units. Those staying at this property may keep updated thanks to the Wi-Fi access. This rural hotel does not offer 24-hour reception. Some services may be payable.

name.content: Riad La Croix Berbere De Luxe

230123.description: A traditional riad, situated only 100m from the Jamaa El Fna Square of Marrakech, this hotel will impress even the most seasoned travellers with the combination of lush decorations and top-notch amenities. The air-conditioned rooms come with a private bathroom, Tadelakt wall decorations and the windows open out to the yard. Down there is the cool swimming pool, where guests can take a refreshing dip or simply sit by it with a drink. The culinary side of a trip to Morocco is also very important, so the on-site restaurant serves traditional local cuisine including dishes such as couscous, tagines and pastillas. Guests can enjoy the delicious treats on the riad's roof terrace or have a barbeque dinner in the yard for a change.

name.content: Fairfield Inn & Suites New York Brooklyn

230142.description: 'Enjoy the convenience of a 24-hour fitness center and breathtaking views from the rooftop terrace at the Fairfield Inn & Suites by Marriott New York Brooklyn. This hotel offers complimentary wired and wireless internet access, concierge and wedding services, and a snack bar/deli. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, served weekdays from 6:00 AM to 9:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center and express check-out. Self-parking is available for a fee. Relax in one of the 133 guestrooms, each equipped with an LED TV, a pillowtop bed with down comforters and premium bedding, and cable programming. Bathrooms feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Barclays Center Brooklyn, Prospect Park, and Brooklyn Bridge Park. The nearest airports are LaGuardia (LGA), Newark Liberty International (EWR), and John F. Kennedy International (JFK). '

230165.description: Located in Barceloneta, just 13 km from El Prat Airport and steps from the metro, this excellent hotel caters to both business and leisure travelers. Barcelona's famed landmarks, including Las Ramblas, Plaza Catalunya, Tibidabo, Montjuïc, Sagrada Familia, Barcelona Cathedral, and the Picasso Museum, are easily accessible. The Gothic Quarter, with its array of tapas bars, restaurants, and shops, is also nearby. The hotel offers amenities such as business facilities with complimentary Wi-Fi and a relaxing rooftop terrace boasting spectacular city views. The well-appointed, air-conditioned rooms feature modern, elegant decor and amenities designed for guest comfort, including a Chromecast TV system for streaming content from your mobile device.

230168.description: This wonderful property enjoys a charming setting in Madrid. The property is perfect for travellers who are eager to explore this vibrant city. Many of the city's most prominent attractions can be found nearby. A range of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities are located in the vicinity. The property enjoys an avant-garde, charismatic design, which is sure to impress. Offering unprecedented luxury and style, this guest house tempts business and leisure travellers alike. The guest rooms are modern and stylish, offering comfort and convenience. Guests are sure to appreciate the high level of excellence that this unique guest house has to offer. CHECK IN TIMES ARE FROM 8:00am to 11pm. IN CASE CLIENT ARRIVES LATER, THEY SHOULD CONTACT THE HOTEL PREVIOUSLY TO GET THE INSTRUCTIONS TO DO THE CHECK IN ONLINE.

230221.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Route twenty-six, for lunch, dinner, or brunch. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Zürich? This hotel has 6781 square feet (630 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 197 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Cable television is provided for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.
