The preferred airport for Sheraton Zurich Hotel is Zurich Airport (ZRH) - 22. 6 km / 14.

230236.description: This hotel is beautifully located at the heart of Barcelona. It is situated just a short distance away from the many attractions that this wonderful city has to offer. The hotel is just 2 minutes walking distance away from Placa Catalunya and many bars, restaurants and shops can be found in the area. The hotel has a beautifully achieved balance between traditional architecture and modern design. The hotel welcomes visitors with a promise of comfort and style. This hotel offers the perfect setting for travelers who are eager to explore the beauty of the city. The Colorful contemporary room types all have a soft coffee-color scheme with hardwood floors, dark-wood walls, dove-gray bedspreads, and caramel-colored drapes and headboards with deep-red pillows and chairs. The Standard Rooms are narrow and have two twin beds pushed together, wall-mounted flat-screen TVs, writing desks, funky pendant lamps, minibars, and eclectic framed photos on the walls. The Soft recessed lighting can make these rooms feel dark, though the spaces are brighter on sunny days thanks to sliding glass doors that lead out to small-furnished patios. The Matrimonial Standard Rooms are slightly larger and have queen-sized beds, but they lack patios. The Superior and Executive Rooms are quite roomy and come with coffeemakers, more seating space, and bathrobes but the unfurnished terraces are too narrow to sit on. Outfitted in shimmering gray tile, bathrooms are modern and have Grohe finishes, spacious vanity sinks, and shower/tub combos. Bathroom doors are made of frosted glass. The on-site restaurant has an equally funky and modernist theme and serves up breakfast, lunch and dinner.

230335.description: Welcome to the Holiday Inn Clark, NJ. Our priority is ensuring a safe and comfortable environment for all guests and staff. Located within walking distance of Clark Commons shopping center, you'll find a variety of shops, restaurants, and entertainment options. Situated just off the Garden State Parkway at exit 135, we offer complimentary parking and Wi-Fi. All rooms feature a microwave, mini-fridge, and Keurig coffee maker. Each of our 192 guest rooms has been recently remodeled. Our restaurant serves breakfast, dinner, and drinks, and you can choose to dine indoors or outdoors on our beautiful patio, complete with a fire pit and heat lamps. Beyond shopping, we're also within walking distance of scenic parks and trails. Rahway train station, offering direct access to NYC, is just a short drive away. We also offer over 8, 000 square feet of meeting space suitable for meetings, office use, or special events.

230359.description: Fondo Brugarolo is located a 30-minute drive from Bergamo. The farm stay has a greenhouse, an animal farm and fruit trees. The farm stay has also a restaurant, where a typical menu is offered using self-produced and local ingredients. Villa Paradiso Golf Club is 6 km away. A Turkish bath, 2 saunas and hot tub, but also a sensory shower are available in the spa. Sessions can be booked at reception. At 30 km from Orio Al Serio International Airport, Fondo Brugarolo is 45-minute drive from Milan. Guests can find an array of services in Sulbiate, 2 km from the property.

230371.description: Enjoy amenities such as a sauna and 24-hour fitness center at this Art Deco hotel. The Box House Hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and access to a nearby fitness facility. Dine at Brooklynn Lantern, the hotel's restaurant, or grab a quick bite at the snack bar/deli. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (8:00 AM to noon) for a fee. The hotel offers a 24-hour business center, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Each of the 130 individually decorated guest rooms features an iPod docking station, an LCD television, a pillowtop bed with down comforters and premium bedding, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include the United Nations Headquarters (1. 7 mi), 5th Avenue (2. 2 mi), and Times Square (2. 7 mi). The closest airport is LaGuardia (LGA), 7. 1 miles away.

230415.description: With its convenient location near London Victoria station and Pimlico tube station, this luxurious family-run hotel is an ideal base for tourists to explore London's attractions and for business travellers to the city. Set across four Georgian town houses it features 73 individually-designed and stylishly-decorated en-suite guest rooms, all of which feature rainfall showers, designer fabrics, HD TVs, Wi-Fi and Nespresso coffee makers. The Signature rooms boast excellent views over the city. Guests can kick the day off with a tasty breakfast, and later on the reception and bar area makes an excellent place to relax with a cocktail after a hard-day's sight-seeing and before heading out to explore London's range of gastronomic delights. The premises also feature a meeting space and have on-site catering services which make it the ideal venue for meeting with clients.

230435.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting in the Tuzla Industrial zone of Istanbul. Beautifully situated on the Asian side of the city, this hotel is just a short distance away from a wealth of attractions. Sabiha Gokcen International Airport is just a 10 minutes' driving distance away. Pendik Marina is 13 km from the hotel. Via Port shopping centre is 6 km away. This charming hotel enjoys an attractive design. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, for the utmost in comfort. The hotel features meeting and banqueting facilities, for the convenience of those travelling for business purposes. Guests can avail of the many facilities and services that the hotel provides.

230437.description: Conveniently located in quiet area in Santiago, this property is an ideal base for both business and holiday travel. Its guests will be within a short 10-minute stroll from Pedro de Valdivia, the major North-South Avenue on the east side of the city, and from the nearest subway station. They will be also quite close to several other public transport stops and those travelling through the Arturo Merino Benitez Airport will be able to reach the hotel within a 15-minute drive, for their convenience the venue offers a shuttle service. For dining guests can either explore the restaurants in the surrounding area or visit the onsite establishment which serves delicious Chilean dishes in a relaxed atmosphere. Room service up until 11pm is also available for those who want to enjoy their meals in the comfort of their well-appointed rooms or suites.

230444.description: The three-story Hotel Residence Aurora offers a convenient stay in Paderno Dugnano's Palazzolo Milanese district, within a 15-minute drive of Fiera Milano Exhibition Center and Corso Como. Each of the 36 air-conditioned rooms features a kitchenette equipped with a full-sized refrigerator/freezer, stovetop, microwave, and electric kettle. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and a 32-inch LCD TV. Daily housekeeping is provided, and the residence offers dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and on-site self-parking (for a fee). A train station pick-up service is also available (surcharge). Nearby attractions include Royal Villa of Monza (6. 1 mi), Monza Park (6. 8 mi), and the Alfa Romeo Historical Museum (6. 9 mi). The nearest airports are Linate (16. 3 mi), Milan Malpensa (31. 8 mi), and Bergamo Orio al Serio (32. 3 mi).

230446.address: Bab Ksiba Derb El Kadi N° 15
230446.description: This elegant boutique establishment welcomes its guests to a total comfort in the heart of Marrakech. They will be able to visit all the attractions of the city within minutes, a 10-minute drive will take them to the Majorelle Garden and for just half that time they can reach the main city square Djemaa El Fn. The property consists of just 7 units and due to its size it can offer a truly personalized experience. Guests can request local or international dishes and enjoy them in the comfort of the onsite dining area or unwind with a tea next to the fountain on the patio. For relaxing they can treat themselves to a Turkish bath, work on their healthy skin at the Hammam or enjoy a soothing full-body massage.

230475.description: The Fontanella Green House enjoys a central location next to Barcelona's Urquinaona Metro Station, a mere 300 meters from Plaza Catalunya and a convenient 10-minute metro ride from Barceloneta Beach. Housed in a renovated modernist building dating back to 1881, the rooms are modern and bright, each featuring soundproofing, air conditioning, and heating. Guests can also expect amenities such as a safe, refrigerator, and a flat-screen Smart TV. Some rooms even boast a private balcony. The hotel provides a tour desk and an airport shuttle service upon request. Thanks to its prime location, many of the city's attractions, shops, bars, and restaurants are within easy walking distance.

230479.description: Located in the fashionable Palermo Soho district, the Hotel Palermitano by DOT Boutique is a boutique hotel designed by the avant-garde architect David Collins. Inspired by Art Deco's influence in South America and 20th-century modernism, its 16 rooms feature Slavonian oak floors and exclusive designer furniture, offering warmth, privacy, and style. Bathrooms are adorned with luxurious Carrara marble. Guests can enjoy the rooftop's magical setting, and Sipan, the hotel's acclaimed Japanese-Peruvian fusion restaurant, features an open kitchen where diners can watch Chef José Castro Mendivil and his team. The Isabel Bar offers five-star service, classic cocktails, and elegant food in a uniquely stylish setting, recognized by Conde Nast Traveler and Vogue Wallpaper. The hotel is conveniently located near the Arcos Premium Outlet District (1 km), Alto Palermo Shopping (3 km), and the Japanese Garden (3 km).

name.content: Dazzler by Wyndham Buenos Aires Palermo

230488.description: Nestled in Palermo Hollywood, this hotel is ideal for business and leisure travelers visiting Argentina's capital. It offers excellent public transport connections, close to several bus stops and just 600 meters from the D-line metro station. Puerto Madero and San Telmo are a 15-minute drive away, while Recoleta is reachable in half that time. Built in 2013, the hotel features a splendid outdoor pool and a quiet garden—a perfect urban escape. Free WiFi and a modern business center are also available.

230489.description: The NH Bogotá Urban 26 Royal hotel is an ultra-modern building in the heart of Bogotá. The hotel is in a perfect location for both business and pleasure and is just a short drive away from many of the city's top attractions. The Corferias Business Center is within easy walking distance and a 20-minute drive will take guests to the Calima mall, the historic Candelaria neighborhood, and El Dorado International Airport. Plenty of shops, restaurants, bars, and nightlife are also close by. There are 118 spacious rooms at NH Bogotá Urban 26 Royal, each with a separate sitting area. Every room comes with modern comforts such as satellite TV and free Wi-Fi. Many also have spectacular views over the city and the surrounding mountains. We serve a varied breakfast each morning that offers everything from cold cuts to fresh sweet pastries, accompanied by coffee, tea, and fresh juice. The Restaurant is perfect for lunch and dinner with an Italian-influenced menu. The hotel offers various treatments, including relaxing massages. There are also five compact meeting rooms for up to 90 people.

230491.description: Located in the heart of Colombia's capital city, this hotel offers an ideal base for exploration. Guests are within a 5-minute walk of Parque de la 93, a trendy restaurant and entertainment district, perfect for sampling the city's culinary delights. Shopping enthusiasts are just a 15-minute stroll from the Andino commercial center, while easy access to public transport, including bus stops and a metro station, connects guests to the wider metropolitan area. Each room boasts contemporary art and themed décor inspired by Colombian literature, complete with a private balcony. At Viaggio 9. 3, pets are welcome with proof of vaccination (maximum two per room).

230512.description: This hotel is the only eco-sustainable boutique hotel located in the northwest of Bogota, nestled amidst nature in the hills of Suba. With space dominated by a decoration characterized by works of art, each room has a beautiful view of gardens or private patios, and the floor of black slate stone from the mountains of the Andes shows preserved animal fossils. Dishes cooked on the slow fire of a clay oven and served on the terrace are much appreciated, and wines create a romantic evening by the fireplace. This place offers an unforgettable experience of nature, art and silence that guests will never forget.

230520.description: Located near the financial district of São Paulo Berrini, 550 meters from the train station Berrini. It is only 1 block from Marginal Pinheiros highway which provides access to the main areas of the city. It is 8 km from Paulista Avenue and 30 km Itaquera Arena. It offers modern accommodation with excellent service and the amenities needed for a pleasant stay. Please note that more than 10 rooms are considered a group, with reservations subject to previous payment or cancellation by the hotel.

230602.description: Porto Bay Liberdade is located in the heart of the Portuguese capital, next to Avenida da Liberdade on Rua Rosa Araújo, the design of architect Frederico Valsassina preserves the historical façade of the early 20th-Century Lisbon manor in a dialogue between the old and the contemporary. The environment and décor evoke details from the past, with the constant elements of old wood and marble. This charming boutique hotel, with features of a resort in an urban setting, offers comfort, timelessness, hospitality and the well-known service of Porto Bay Hotels & Resorts. A bright spotlight joining the spectacular, well-known natural city lights of Lisbon.

230618.description: The Aska Lara Resort & Spa offers a unique vacation experience with its stunning Mediterranean location in Lara. Guests enjoy luxurious amenities and activities, from breathtaking sea views to Turkish and international cuisine. Explore nearby natural and cultural wonders, including Düden Waterfall, Perge Ancient City, and Kaleiçi.

230620.description: This hotel enjoys a wonderful location in Istanbul. The hotel is situated next to the Basilica Cisterns, in the historical Sultanahmet District of the city. The centre of the city, at Taksim Square, can be found just a 20 minutes' bus journey away. The hotel is located close to the many intriguing attractions that this captivating city has to offer. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. This charming hotel is sure to impress. The guest rooms feature a modern, stylish decor, ensuring a comfortable stay for each and every traveller. Guests can enjoy the wonderful dining options that the hotel has to offer. Guests can indulge in invigorating treatments in the spa, for the perfect way to unwind.

230622.description: Eurostars Hotel Old City provides flawless service and all the necessary facilities for visitors. Remain linked during your visit by utilizing the complimentary internet access available. Prior to your check-in date, you can arrange airport transportation services, guaranteeing a seamless and efficient experience for both arrival and departure. Parking is accessible, supplied by the hotel for guests who arrive by car. The hotel is completely smoke-free. In limited designated zones, smoking is exclusively permitted. Each morning at Eurostars Hotel Old City, a scrumptious, homemade breakfast kick-starts the day. Begin your holiday mornings right with your essential cup of coffee, offered daily at the cafe on-site. During your visit, indulge in a range of delightful culinary choices at hotel to enhance your experience.

230644.description: Stylish accommodation situated in Sarrià, one of Barcelona's most exclusive districts, within easy reach of the countless attractions and facilities of this lively and cosmopolitan city, yet offering the peace and quiet that the busy business traveller and tourist long for. It is conveniently located next to one of the city's finest hospitals and close to the convention centre and university campuses and within reach of popular tourist spots such as the Tibidabo amusement park, the Gothic district and the beaches. This hotel boasts an outstanding reputation for offering its guests superb levels of service. The luxurious sound-proofed rooms have been refurbished in contemporary style and offer all the facilities guests need for a comfortable stay. This hotel is a great choice for those looking for a convenient base or a venue for a corporate event or private celebration.

230646.description: This modern apartment complex is located in central Barcelona, next to the Gran Liceu and just a 5-minute walk from arguably the most popular street in the city - La Rambla. The beautiful promenade and some of the most famous sights of the city such as Plaza Catalunya and the MACBA Modern Art Museum are all reachable within a short 10-minute walk. The surrounding area houses a number of excellent restaurants, cafes and shops, where guests enjoy delicious dishes or chilled drinks. The modern apartments of the venue also house well-equipped kitchens that are perfect for preparing some home-like meals, plus they are fitted with spacious lounge areas with a sofa bed for enjoying them. Each of the stylish, air-conditioned units also offer free WiFi and international TV for some entertainment.

230653.address: Avenue Mohamed Vi Zone Touristique De L'Agdal
230653.description:
Overview
Kech Boutique Hotel and Spa is located in the Agdal neighborhood and it overlooks the Oukaimeden Mountains. Nearby attractions include the Palaces of Bahia and Badii at 5 km away. Marrakesh Menara Airport is at a distance of 8 km. Wi-Fi is available onsite. 

Location
Located in the Agdal neighborhood, the hotel overlooks the Oukaimeden Mountains. Nearby attractions include the Palaces of Bahia and Badii at 5 km away. Marrakesh Menara Airport is at a distance of 8 km. The rooms are equipped with satellite TV, air conditioning. Each room is soundproofed. A private bathroom is included. 

Features
The hotel features 24-hour front desk, a swimming pool and restaurant. It offers modern accommodation with Wi-Fi and balcony with views of the pool and sun terrace. 

Food and Drink
Guests can have breakfast in the dining area. There also is an on-site restaurant. Room service is also available.

230674.address: Azä°Z Mahmut Hudayä° Mah. Halk Cad.Uskudar, 44
230674.description: This wonderful establishment is located at the heart of Uskudar. The property is located just a 15 minutes' walking distance away from the European side of the city. The property offers visitors a prime setting from which to explore the mesmerising city of Istanbul, and its myriad of attractions. This charming property comprises comfortably-furnished apartments and studios, ensuring that guests experience the utmost in comfort and convenience. The accommodation options are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that this charming property has to offer.

230721.description: This wonderful hotel in Olgiate Olona offers easy access to the city's captivating attractions and convenient links to public transport. Explore a myriad of shopping, dining, and entertainment options nearby. The charming establishment welcomes guests with warm hospitality. The superbly designed rooms and suites offer modern amenities for utmost convenience. A great choice for business and leisure travelers alike, this hotel provides excellent facilities and services catering to every traveler's needs.

230965.description: This exceptional hotel is located in Vienna. The city centre is some 20 minutes away and guests will find a great variety of cultural attractions and entertainment options in the surrounding area, such as St. Peter’s Church, St. Stephens’ Cathedral, the popular Stadtpark, ideal for those who travel with children, and several museums. Designed with guests’ needs in mind, the comfortable rooms have been conceived to meet all travellers’ expectations, either for a business or a leisure stay. All the rooms come with complimentary W-LAN connection, and families can take advantage of the Family rooms. The onsite facilities include a small library and those guests wishing to enjoy an invigorating workout will find a fitness centre and a Finnish sauna, an oasis of relaxation after an exciting day discovering all the hidden treasures of the city.

230997.description: 'Experience the unique charm of this beautifully restored Republican-era house in the heart of Bogotá's historic city center. Dating back to the late 18th century, this architectural gem offers comfortable accommodations steeped in history. The spacious interiors have been meticulously renovated to provide modern comfort while preserving the building's original elegance and character. Enjoy a delightful stay in this unique hotel, ideally situated for exploring the city's cultural and political landmarks. '

231021.description: Situated at the crossroads of vibrant Soho and Leicester Square, the Leicester House Hotel welcomes discerning guests to its renovated, historic building, steeped in three decades of history. The hotel offers 11 double rooms, 3 twin rooms, and 3 heritage suites, including the Karl Marx Suite, the Johann Strauss Suite, and the Emile Suite, each designed for comfort and convenience. Located in the heart of London, the hotel is just minutes away from renowned cultural and entertainment venues such as The National Gallery, the Royal Academy of Arts, Covent Garden, Trafalgar Square, the Apollo Theatre, and the Palace Theatre. Piccadilly Circus and Leicester Square Underground stations are both a short 3-minute walk away, providing easy access from Heathrow and Gatwick Airports in under an hour.

231061.description: This unique, LEED Gold-certified hotel in Usaquén, Bogotá, offers a blend of sustainable practices and European elegance. Strategically located in this gastronomic and cultural hub, the hotel features rooms adorned with imported Spanish furnishings by Carre (Barcelona). Spacious meeting rooms accommodate up to 120 people, complemented by a VIP room and terrace, all equipped with state-of-the-art technology. The Green Piece Restaurant provides high-quality dining options to satisfy a variety of palates.

231084.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this Edwardian hotel include a fireplace in the lobby and a ballroom. Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at Berners Tavern, a restaurant which specializes in British cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. English breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, limo/town car service, and a computer station. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 1020 square feet (95 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 173 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Your bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets.

231085.description: This luxurious hotel enjoys a prime location in the city centre of Vienna, just a few steps from the popular Wurstelprater, often simply called ‘Prater', an amusement park ideal to enjoy a wonderful day out where guests will find a planetarium. Situated in the midst of a classic Viennese district which has been a melting pot of different cultures, this hotel provides different room types for guests to choose from. They all have been decorated in neutral tones with splash of vibrant colours and come fully-equipped with up-to-date furniture and a stunning wall design. This eco-friendly property serves a delicious breakfast buffet ideal for visitors to kick-start their day. The rest of facilities include a cosy bar decorated in red and warm colours as well as the gARTen, a green oasis offering a great variety of selected local and international wines and beers, all for an unforgettable stay in Vienna.

231087.description: Welcome to London. The Best Western Greater London Hotel, built in 2013, is conveniently located near Ilford train station, offering easy access to central London (15 minutes) and ExCeL London (10 minutes by car). This hotel offers guests comfort and convenience with proximity to the Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park and Ilford's shopping center. TripAdvisor® has recognized Ilford as a rapidly growing tourist destination in Europe. The hotel features crystal chandeliers, Roman pillars, a Chesterfield sofa lounge, and an air-conditioned reception area for a sophisticated and elegant ambiance.

231108.description: Enjoy recreational amenities at Dar Ikalimo Ourika including a fitness center and bicycle rentals. This guesthouse in Sti Fadma offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a cozy fireplace in the lobby. Savor lunch or dinner at the onsite restaurant, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Start your day with a complimentary local breakfast served from 6:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Other amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Airport transfers are available for a surcharge. The nine air-conditioned guest rooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences such as desks and daily housekeeping are also provided, and cribs/infant beds are available upon request. The guesthouse is steps away from Toubkal National Park and the Ourika Valley, placing you near local attractions.

231136.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an indoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a picnic area, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 9:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 122 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and MP3 docking stations. 42-inch flat-screen televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

name.content: Hilton Istanbul Bomonti Hotel & Conference Centre

231155.description: Enjoy contemporary luxury at Hilton Istanbul Bomonti Hotel & Conference Center, the largest of its kind in the city. Located in the central area of Sisli, adjacent to the former Bomonti Beer Factory, which is today’s new entertainment hub, this impressive, 34-story hotel offers easy access to many Istanbul attractions, historical buildings, shopping malls and neighboring business districts. Unwind in an elegant, air-conditioned guest room at this Istanbul hotel with a range of amenities, including ergonomic work areas, WiFi (fee applies) and floor-to-ceiling windows. Upgrade to an executive room or suite for exclusive Executive Lounge access. Gaze upon the Marmara sea from an executive sea view room. With a wealth of flexible meeting spaces, including a grand ballroom with a capacity of 3000, this stunning hotel is perfect for business meetings and glamorous celebrations in Istanbul. A business center offering a range of services and amenities and a professional team of staff are available, to help ensure a truly unforgettable event. Enjoy breathtaking Bosphorus and city views from the rooftop bar Cloud 34, located on the 34th story and dine in style in our all-day dining restaurant, The Globe. Maintain your fitness regime with the very latest exercise equipment in the modern, 24-hour fitness center, soothe tired muscles in the Turkish bath or treat yourself to a luxurious massage in the expansive eforea Spa. Cool down in the indoor or outdoor swimming pools or unwind with a drink at the pool bar as you soak up the Turkish sunshine.

231165.description:
Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access and tour/ticket assistance. All-inclusive rates are available at this hotel. Meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments are included in all-inclusive rates. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee.

Featured amenities include express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 77 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Rooms have private balconies.

231178.description: This hotel is conveniently situated in Istanbul. The hotel is located in the historical Sultanahmet District of the city, lying just a short walking distance away from many must-see attractions. The Blue Mosque and Haghia Sophia can be found nearby. The hotel lies close to links to the public transport network. The hotel is conveniently located just 18 km from Ataturk Airport. This charming hotel is the perfect option for discerning travellers. The guest rooms are superbly designed, featuring refreshing tones and a peaceful ambience. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

231196.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at Casa Gracia Barcelona - Hostel, centrally located near Casa Mila and Passeig de Gràcia. This hostel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, an arcade/game room, and a communal living room. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The 146 air-conditioned guestrooms provide complimentary Wi-Fi and bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. A computer station and complimentary newspapers are available in the lobby. Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) is 17. 4 km away.

231225.description:
This charming hotel is located in the heart of downtown Vienna. Sightseeing attractions such as Saint Stephen's cathedral, the commercial street Kärntner and the imperial palace Hofburg are only a few steps away. At the hotel's surroundings, there are also excellent public transport connections. This boutique hotel boasts decorative elements of Art nouveau style and shelters a terrace in the roof with a view to the old town of Vienna. Guests can take advantage of the luggage storage and limousine services. The modern guest rooms are fitted with air-conditioning and complimentary wireless Internet connection. Other facilities that they include for extra comfort are a minibar and a flat-screen satellite television. 
City tax is not included in the booking price, it is payable on the spot at the hotel.

231510.description: This stylish and elegant hotel boasts a great position in a business district of the beautiful city of Barcelona. Located in l’Hospitalet de Llobregat area, the property is next to Plaza de Europa and very close to Gran Via trade fair. It is also well connected to the Plaza España with many cultural and entertainment options. For all this, this establishment is a good option when visiting the Catalan capital both for business or leisure. There are several types of accommodations at this property, all of them carefully designed to satisfy all kinds of guests either if they are travelling for business or with the whole family. Visitors will be amazed by the excellent common facilities and superb services offered, such as a state-of-the-art fitness room with a sauna and a hammam. There is also an outdoor swimming pool at a rooftop terrace with sun loungers and a pool bar.

231532.description: Located in the 11th district of Vienna, in one of Vienna's longest and busiest shopping streets, this pet-friendly hotel offers an ideal base from where to explore the city and its main attractions. The property is situated right next to the underground station, allowing guests to easy access the centre of the city, which is only a 10-minute drive away. The establishment presents a beautiful modern design with excellent services to make guests' stay as enjoyable as possible. The air-conditioned accommodation units are all tastefully decorated and offer a bright ambiance, ideal to relax and enjoy a fully comfortable stay. Travellers may have an extensive breakfast every morning, which includes hot drinks, fresh bread, cereals, fruit and much more, while the elegant bar offers a huge variety of local and international beverages. Other hotel services include an underground car park and a 24-hour reception.

231546.description: Our brand-new hotel, voco® Milan-Fiere, is just moments away from Fiera Milano, MiCo Convention Center, and MIND Milano Innovation District. Ideally located only two minutes from the A4 and A8 motorways, the hotel offers convenient links to Milan city center and the city's international airports, Linate (LIN) and Malpensa (MXP). From AM to PM, you'll have the space you need to relax, socialize, and enjoy yourself. Spend some well-deserved 'me time' in our Standard, Premium Rooms, or Suites, featuring cozy bedding, fast, complimentary Wi-Fi, and 24/7 in-room dining. Relax in the hotel spa with a sauna, Turkish bath, and plunge pool, or enjoy an energetic workout in our fitness room. With event and meeting spaces for up to 630 people, ideal for any occasion, make your mark with the help of our warm and welcoming hosts. We serve international and local Italian specialties and drinks in our OnFire Restaurant, featuring a show-cooking grill, and in our Ludico Bar with a gaming area, ensuring your lunches, dinners, and aperitifs are a roaring success and something to remember during your stay.

231557.description: A central Birmingham aparthotel with free Wi-Fi and breakfast included, plus a Fitness Centre and laundry room. The apartment-style Staybridge Suites® Birmingham hotel sits in the heart of Birmingham, within a short walk of Moor Street, New Street and Snow Hill stations. A 10-minute train ride from Birmingham International Airport, the hotel is just steps from Aston University, the Birmingham Science Museum and Corporation Street. Guests can visit the Bullring Market and House of Fraser to stock up on daily comforts. There are restaurants and bars around New Street, and many galleries and theatres nearby. Business guests are close to the International Convention Centre and the central business district, with local headquarters of international companies like Barclays and HSBC. The fully-equipped kitchen in your suite makes it easy to cook your own dinner, with all the groceries you need at our 24-hour Pantry. With a laundry room on-site, you'll want for nothing. Start your day with an inclusive breakfast buffet or a visit to the Fitness Centre. Unwind with drinks and snacks and meet other guests at social receptions three evenings a week. Relax in your spacious suite and catch up with your family using the free Wi-Fi. Please note guests are required to leave a £50 deposit by credit card, or £200 cash along with a driving license or passport matching the name on the booking.

name.content: Garner Hotel North Bergen - NYC Gateway

231575.description: Located just off I-95, US-9, and NJ-495, and only 14 miles from Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR), the Garner Hotel North Bergen - NYC Gateway welcomes you with complimentary breakfast, Wi-Fi, and parking, as well as a gym. We offer easy access to top New York City destinations like Times Square, the Statue of Liberty National Monument, the Javits Center, and One World Trade Center. Cheer on the Jets or Giants at MetLife Stadium, and explore the American Dream complex for shopping, dining, and entertainment at DreamWorks Water Park, SEA LIFE Aquarium, and more.

231605.description: The property comprises 18 cosy rooms. Ginebra does not offer 24-hour reception.

231632.description:
Nestled within a 6, 000-hectare private game reserve between Mossel Bay and George, Botlierskop Private Game Reserve is a Big 5 reserve offering abundant wildlife, breathtaking landscapes, and a range of unforgettable experiences. Home to more than 26 species of wildlife and over 200 bird species, the reserve combines adventure, tranquillity, and refined luxury in the heart of nature. 

Our 5-star tented lodge offers elegantly appointed accommodation, discreetly positioned along the riverbank to ensure privacy and serenity. Each luxurious tent features a romantic four-poster bed draped in mosquito netting, as well as lavish en-suite facilities, including a deep oval bath and an open-air shower for a truly immersive bush experience. 

Unwind beside the pool while taking in sweeping valley views, savour exceptional dining at the restaurant, or rejuvenate at the Fijnebos Spa, beautifully situated along the riverbank against a backdrop of magnificent mountain scenery. Guests can also enjoy a variety of experiences, including guided game drives, horseback safaris, fishing, luxury picnics, and veterinary safaris.

name.content: Hyatt Place New York Midtown South

231643.description: Conveniently located in the heart of Midtown South New York, this hotel is the ideal place for visitors to this city to stay. It is just a few minutes' walk from such world famous landmarks as the Empire State Building, Times Square, Grand Central Station, Madison Square Garden, the Rockefeller Centre, the Radio City Music Hall, Central Park and the Broadway Theatre. The surrounding area offers an amazing variety of dining and retail options. Amenities at the hotel are tailored to suit the requirements and needs of their guests whether they are travelling for business or pleasure. A free hot breakfast is served daily and the Market menu is open 24/7. The spacious contemporary style rooms have splendid views of Manhattan and come with all the essential elements necessary to ensure the comfort and enjoyment of the occupant. This is a smoke free establishment.

231687.description: Set right in the heart of arguably the world's most famous beach - Copacabana, this modern hotel is the perfect place for anyone who wants to explore what makes Rio De Janeiro such a popular tourist destination. Besides the beach, which is just 500 metres away it guests will be within a 10-minute walk from the beautiful Rodrigo de Freitas Lake and the surrounding area can offer them everything from trendy restaurants, to family-run cafes and charming shops. The nearest metro stop if just a 5-minute walk away at Cantagalo and it can provide easy access to Sugarloaf Mountain, some 8km away and the Maracana Stadium - 14km away. The hotel itself offers an excellent outdoor pool where one can find some much needed cool in the warm days and work on the perfect tan. For a chilled cocktail guests are warmly invited to the in-house bar, which specializes in exotic drinks and premium beers.

231693.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and a television in a common area. Additional amenities at this hotel include tour/ticket assistance, a reception hall, and a vending machine. Enjoy Turkish cuisine at Teras Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 20 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

231694.description: This popular hotel enjoys a privileged location in Camyuva. The hotel is situated just 6. 5 km away from Kemer, on Turkey's southern coast. Guests will find themselves surrounded by natural beauty. Guests can explore the area, which is renowned for its pine-forested mountains. A wealth of attractions can be found nearby, and public transport links run close to the hotel. The hotel enjoys a wonderful design, with fresh, modern decor. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated, featuring pale, laminated flooring and complementary decor. The hotel features exemplary facilities and services, attending to the needs of each and every traveller.

name.content: Side Su Hotel Adult Only +16 Age

231697.description: This modern hotel lies just a short driving distance away from the Hellenistic and Roman ruins of Side. The hotel is situated close to a number of attractions in the area. A wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment venues can be found nearby. Links to the public transport network run close to the hotel. This charming hotel is perfectly suitable for families, as well as couples seeking a peaceful setting in which to unwind. The guest rooms combine traditional and contemporary elements, exuding comfort and charm. Guests can enjoy a leisurely swim in the pool, or indulge in the ultimate relaxation in the spa and wellness centre.

231701.description: This modern aparthotel is situated in the central area of Edinburgh, just a 5-minute walk from Haymarket Railway Station. Housed in an elegant Georgian townhouse that dates back to 1881, its boasts style and comfort that will surely win-over all of its guests. The self-catering accommodations are equipped with large flat-screen TVs, kitchen facilities that are perfect for preparing home-like meals and cosy seating areas. Guests who prefer to explore the fine restaurants of the city will be within a 10-minute walk from Princes Street and can pick any of the excellent establishments located in the immediate vicinity. The iconic Edinburgh Castle, the International Conference Centre and the historic Royal Mile are all less than 30 minutes' walk away.

232124.description: The 26 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day.

name.content: Lindner Vienna am Belvedere, part of JdV by Hyatt

232153.description: Imperial and royal: You’re undoubtedly in pole position when you stay at the Lindner Hotel Vienna Am Belvedere with downtown Vienna - the Belvedere castle and the botanical gardens virtually on your doorstep. However not only the central location of the hotel - surrounded by the imperial gardens - lets your heart beat higher. The elegant design with the rustic touches in the Heuriger -wine tavern - the gourmet meeting points and the elegant yet casual atmosphere ensure a truly delightful stay.

232155.address: Av. Echouhada et Rue du Temple Quartier Hivernage
232155.description:
Nestled within Marrakech’s prestigious Golden Triangle, just moments from the vibrant Medina, bustling souks, and iconic Jemaa el-Fna Square, Nobu Hotel Marrakech offers a refined retreat where Moroccan heritage meets contemporary elegance. The hotel features 71 spacious suites, beautifully designed to blend traditional Moroccan craftsmanship with the refined simplicity of Japanese aesthetics. 
A true destination for culinary enthusiasts, Nobu Hotel Marrakech offers an exceptional dining experience through its carefully curated venues, including the world-renowned Nobu Restaurant. Framed by its circular swimming pool, the Rooftop Garden reveals one of the most spectacular views in Marrakech. Overlooking the ancient Medina walls, the Koutoubia Mosque, and the Atlas Mountains, it invites guests to enjoy expertly crafted sushi and Japanese specialties, alongside Mediterranean flavors and seasonal dishes served throughout the day. 
Beyond its dining experiences, Nobu Hotel Marrakech offers a unique lifestyle retreat. Guests can unwind around its three swimming pools, rejuvenate at the luxurious Pearl Spa, or stay active in the state-of-the-art fitness center, all set within an impressive 2, 000 m² wellness and leisure space.

name.content: Hampton by Hilton London Luton Airport

232159.description: We’re conveniently located less than 5 minutes from Luton Airport terminal via the DART passenger transit system, which is just outside the hotel. We’re also right next to Luton Parkway Train Station, which offers direct access to St. Pancras International Station in less than 25 minutes. Enjoy comfortable rooms, each with a bathroom with walk-in power shower, free high-speed internet access and air-conditioning. Hampton by Hilton Luton Airport features an on-site fitness center which is open 24 hours a day. Freshly cooked bacon and sausage are served with breakfast, along with Hampton's signature waffles. Evening meals are provided in the hotel bar and dining area. A range of Italian, Indian and Chinese restaurants can be found in Luton town center, which is a 20-minute walk from the hotel.

232224.description:
Set in La Candelaria, Bogotá's historic district, this property is the perfect base for exploring the capital Colombia. Built in 1892, the hotel represents the classical elegance of the era and treats to a unique atmosphere. All of its beautifully-appointed rooms and suites are equipped with cosy fireplaces, where guests can warm up in the cool evenings with a glass of fine wine. Those who need little pampering in order to improve their well-being can treat themselves to a massage or soak in the hot bub. The stylish restaurants is the place where guests can enjoy the finest of the traditional Colombian cuisine and some delicious international dishes alongside excellent wines. Those who want to explore the sights of the city will be just a minute walk from the Colon Theater and 5 minutes from the Museum of Gold, Luis Angel Arango Library, Rafael Pombo's House and many other landmarks.
All Standard rooms are located on the first floor only, without exception.

232305.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, 4 spa tubs, and outdoor tennis courts. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and an arcade/game room. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Grab a bite at Solano, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Marrakech? This hotel has 10000 square feet (929 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and a meeting room.

232728.description:
Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can soak up the sun at the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities including a nightclub and an outdoor pool. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, supervised childcare, and an arcade/game room. Getting to the surf and sand is a breeze with the complimentary beach shuttle. This hotel is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Grab a bite at one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 3 bars/lounges.

Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, a safe deposit box at the front desk, and coffee/tea in a common area.

232846.description: Situated between a picturesque palm beach and vibrant floral landscapes, this 5-star hotel, opened in the summer of 2014, offers a luxurious escape. Located 90 km from Antalya Airport and 32 km from both Alanya and Side, the hotel boasts a six-story main building with 447 rooms, served by four panoramic and six guest elevators. Guests can enjoy a variety of swimming pools, including pools with waterslides suitable for both adults and children. One pool is exclusively for Botanik Platinum guests, while others are shared with Botanik Hotel guests. An indoor pool and a heated outdoor pool are also available for Platinum guests. Children's pools are shared between Botanik Platinum and Botanik Hotel guests.

232850.description: This hotel is situated to the west of Istanbul, in the Esenyurt District. The hotel is located close to a number of shopping and residential centres, within easy access of the TUYAP Congress Centre. The hotel is located just 29 km from Ataturk Airport, while the centre of Istanbul at Taksim Square, is 34 km away. This wonderful hotel is perfect for those who are eager to explore the rich culture and history of the city. The hotel enjoys an attractive design, extending a warm, friendly welcome to guests upon arrival. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, offering a peaceful setting in which to unwind. The hotel features a number of business, dining and leisure facilities and services, attending to the needs of every type of traveller.

232920.description: This comfortable hotel enjoys a convenient location for anyone needing to attend the London Excel exhibition and conference Centre, but also for those wanting to access several other popular London sightseeing attractions such as London Greenwich, Canary Wharf or the world-famous West End. The property is incredibly well connected with London City Airport and the DLR Royal Albert Underground within less than a kilometre away. Guests can be sure of a great night's sleep at the fully equipped and tastefully appointed guest rooms, which come with everything necessary for a pleasant stay. Those visitors travelling with their own vehicles may wish to use the on-site parking spaces available for them free of charge and the café bar to relax with a drink at the end of the day.

name.content: Ramada Plaza by Wyndham Istanbul Sultanahmet

233096.description: Offering spacious rooms and a rooftop restaurant, this city hotel is just over a 10 minute walk from the Grand Bazaar and 2 km from the many historical attractions at Sultanahmet. During summer months guests can benefit from the hotel's outdoor pool and poolside snack bar. Other features of the hotel include a sauna and hammam, an a la carte restaurant, hair salon and panoramic bar. Public transport runs closeby while Aksaray metro station is 1 km from the hotel. Ataturk Airport is approximately a 30 minute journey.

233098.description: This charming and modern hotel boasts a great location in the lively city of Bogotá, near the World Trade Centre, chic restaurants and numerous shopping centres. Those coming on business might take advantage of the fact that the property is located close to several Bogotá's business areas, having access to several major streets in the city. All the hotel's luxurious and spacious guest rooms come conveniently equipped with everything guests may need for business or leisure during their stay. They include fully stocked minibars and soundproof windows to guarantee guests enjoy a repairing night's sleep. Guests can treat themselves to a delicious breakfast buffet and exercise at the modern and well-equipped fitness centre.

233129.description: Located in a quiet area of upscale district of Miraflores, this Peruvian-themed property offers an ideal place for rest and relaxation to all visitors of the capital city of Peru. The area is known for its shopping facilities, gardens, flower-filled parks and beaches and the guests of the venue will be at just 500 metres from the Larcomar Shopping Mall and a 10-minute walk from the picturesque Costa Verde and Waikiki beaches. The property is 100% non-smoking. After a day of sightseeing or relaxing on the beach, the onsite restaurant can treat them to some mouth-watering traditional specialities that will satisfy their appetite and play with their culinary senses. For the perfect end of the evening they can head to the bar and try the famous Peruvian drink Pisco Sour, before heading back to their comfortable room for a good night's sleep.

233379.description: The Andrew Hotel in Great Neck, New York offers a refined and contemporary escape, set amidst the charming small-town atmosphere. Located on the North Shore of Long Island, it is a mere 35-minute train ride from New York City, making it a convenient location to access the city's vibrant atmosphere. Experience the best of both worlds, with access to world-class golf courses, delightful local shops, and upscale dining, all just moments away from the hustle and bustle of Times Square. Relax in our boutique-style rooms featuring high-quality oak furniture, comfortable bedding, and sleek marble countertops, along with modern amenities such as flat-screen TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Indulge in personalized service and contemporary comfort during your stay at The Andrew.

233387.description: Explore west African culture or laze by the pool at the Transcorp Hilton Abuja hotel, located in the heart of Nigeria's capital and 5 minutes' drive from government ministries. /nVisit Abuja attractions like Aso Rock, Millennium Park or experience local life onsite in our Handicraft Village. Revive yourself in the fitness center or take a dip in the outdoor pool. Play badminton in the Sports Hall or try your luck in the onsite casino. Dine on Mediterranean dishes at Zuma Restaurant or sample Mongolian delights from the barbecue at Oriental Restaurant. /nForty minutes from Nnamdi Azikiwe Airport, the Transcorp Hilton Abuja hotel has an Executive Lounge, 24 meeting rooms with wireless internet access and a business center. /nFrom Hilton Guest Rooms to Executive Rooms with Executive Lounge access, all rooms at the Transcorp Hilton Abuja hotel are Art Deco-style and have high-speed internet access.

233409.address: Behind Mall Of The Emirates, Al Barsha, Dubai
233409.description: Located in the downtown area of Dubai, overlooking the Mall of the Emirates and, standing tall is the majestic fourteen storey Ivory Grand Hotel Apartments, in Al Barsha, the newest addition to the portfolio managed by HAS Hospitality. Blending the comforts of a five-star resort with the advantage of being centrally located, Ivory Grand Hotel Apartments gives guests a 360 degree access of Dubai. The Hotel Apartments easily reaches out to the best of Dubai - be it the International Airport, the largest Ski-Zone, Shopping Malls, the Jumeirah Beach or Dubai Internet City. Ivory Grand is well positioned to connect both the leisure and business visitor.

name.content: Bahia Principe Escape Bouganville Hyatt Inc Col AO

233424.address: Ctra San Pedro - La Romana km 12
233424.description: Situated between Santo Domingo and La Romana in the Dominican Republic, the beachfront hotel Bahia Principe Escape Bouganville Hyatt Inclusive Collection Adults Only AI boasts over 1, 100 meters of stunning sands fringed with palm trees. Guests can relax on the beach and enjoy the beautiful bay views. The expansive complex is conveniently located 50km from Santo Domingo Airport and 25km from La Romana Airport.

233473.address: Yenidogan Mah. S. Naci Cakar Sok, 11
233473.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this Istanbul hotel, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi and a range of amenities, including concierge services, a common area television, and a ballroom. A shuttle service is available to nearby destinations (surcharge). The hotel offers on-site dining and room service during limited hours, plus a bar/lounge for evening relaxation. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Business amenities include complimentary wired internet, a business center, and express check-in. With 969 sq ft of event space, the hotel offers a conference space and two meeting rooms. Train station pick-up and free self-parking are also provided. The 128 guestrooms boast heated floors, flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, in-room safes, phones, and desks. Nearby attractions include the Forum Istanbul, Eyup Sultan Mosque, and the Golden Horn.

233475.description: This wonderful hotel offers guests a prime setting from which to explore the exciting sights and sounds of Istanbul. The hotel is located in Sultanahmet, the historical district of the city. Guests will find themselves just a few steps away from the famous Blue Mosque. Many of the city's most intriguing attractions can be found just a short walking distance away. The waterfront is just a 5 minutes' walk from the hotel. This wonderful hotel offers guests comfort and convenience in a homely ambience. The guest rooms are elegantly styled, offering classical decor and modern amenities. Guests can enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

233476.description: Set in the city centre of the charming town of Vizela, this property is at less than 10 minutes' walking from the Train Station and next to the main shopping and dining establishments. Its guests will have their choice between the healing qualities of the thermal spring water at the nearby spa complex, which is just a 2-minute walk away or the Turkish bath, massages and 3 indoor pools at the one that is just 5 minutes away. After all the pampering there will surely need a hearty meal and the onsite restaurant can provide one consisting of delicious regional dishes and excellent Portuguese wines. Weather permits guests can enjoy alfresco dining on the terrace or if it doesn't, the cosy bar will attract them with its cosy ambience and a glass of Port Wine. The "the cradle city" of the Portuguese nationality - Guimarães is reachable for less than 15 minutes' driving.

233483.description: Located on Victoria Island, in the centre of Lagos, this hotel is in the vicinity of major consulates and multinational companies, making it the perfect residence for affluent business and diplomatic travellers. Built on an elevated terrain overlooking Lagos' port, it offers uninterrupted spectacular views of the city Skyline, ample meeting space and grandiose accommodations. The spa centre resonates tranquillity and serenity and with its cosy ambience it awakens the senses while relaxing the mind, body and soul. It can provide varieties of treatments with natural ingredients that brings one closer to the rejuvenating power of nature. For dining the onsite establishments can offer an array of delicious options that range from cosmopolitan delights to Nigerian delicacies. Each restaurant brings a unique experience suitable for exclusive dinners, business meetings or casual socializing.

233499.address: Angle Arset Lamaach Et Docteur Linares Medina
233499.description: Set in the historic part of the city, this hotel is just 50 metres from the main square - Jemaa el-Fnaa. Due to its location in the centre of Marrakesh its guests will be able to reach most of its attractions such as the Royal Palace, the Medina or the shade of the Koutoubia mosque, within minutes on foot. After an exciting day of sightseeing they can head back to the hotel and enjoy a fulfilling meal in the typical onsite restaurant or relax with a drink on the terrace, while enjoying the panoramic views of the largest mosque in the city. The well-appointed rooms comes with all the conveniences a modern travellers is used to, including complimentary WiFi internet access.

233525.description: Located in the heart of Villmergen, the Villmergen Swiss Quality Hotel offers convenient access to local attractions such as the Strohmuseum im Park and Kart-Bahn Wohlen. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, a buffet breakfast, and an on-site restaurant and bar/lounge. Guests can also utilize services such as dry cleaning/laundry and airport shuttle (surcharge). The 57 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs with cable programming, private bathrooms, and work desks. Free self-parking is available on-site.

233527.description: Nestled amidst hectares of vineyards and lush forests, this charming hotel offers a tranquil escape on the Douro River delta. Located just outside the village of Santa Cruz do Douro, a short 5-minute drive from Aregos Railway Station, it provides a secluded retreat far from the city's hustle. Guests can explore the region by boat from the private jetty, enjoy fishing and hiking, or unwind with a refreshing dip in the pool or a rejuvenating spa treatment. The hotel's chic restaurant serves refined regional cuisine and local wines, creating the perfect setting for a sumptuous dinner. As a Clean & Safe certified establishment by Turismo de Portugal, the property adheres to strict hygiene and cleaning protocols for the prevention and control of COVID-19 and other infections.

233544.description: Enjoy a central Berlin stay at Hotel Bellevue am Kurfürstendamm, conveniently located near the iconic Kurfürstendamm (5-min drive) and Zoo Berlin. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, daily buffet breakfast (fee applies), and helpful tour/ticket assistance. The 25 individually furnished guestrooms feature cable TV, en suite bathrooms with showers and hair dryers, and conveniences such as desks and daily housekeeping. Ironing facilities are available upon request. Other amenities include a TV in the common area, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Potsdamer Platz is 3. 2 miles (5. 2 km), and Brandenburg Gate is 3. 6 miles (5. 9 km) away. Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER) is 17. 3 miles (27. 8 km) from the hotel.

233573.description: This boutique-style hotel enjoys a prime setting amidst the lively atmosphere of Istanbul. The hotel is ideally located, lying just a few metres away from Taksim Square. Guests will find themselves within easy access of many of Istanbul's cultural and entertainment attractions. This charming hotel is perfect for business and leisure travellers alike. The guest rooms are sublimely designed, featuring soothing tones and a peaceful ambience. The rooms are fully furnished, featuring modern amenities for added convenience. 233620.description: The Hyatt Place Amsterdam Airport offers 330 spacious guestrooms, ranging from 25 to 40 square meters, across 13 floors. name.content: Souq Waqif Boutique Hotels by TIVOLI

234124.description: Nestled in the heart of the historic Souq Waqif and just 15 minutes from Doha International Airport, Souq Waqif Boutique Hotels by Tivoli is a collection of 9 historic buildings featuring intricate décor and architecture to ensure the finest in Qatari hospitality for your stay in Doha. 234671.description: Enjoy your stay in style. Hotel Mercure Brussels Centre Midi is a beautiful newly built hotel, offering a 4-star service. name.content: Citadines Connect Fifth Avenue - Times Square NY

The hotel's recently renovated facilities include a 24-hour business center and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi. Accessible public facilities and specially equipped guest rooms are available. Guests can enjoy services such as a 24-hour front desk, laundry and dry cleaning, and attentive bilingual staff. The complimentary continental breakfast is temporarily suspended due to COVID-19. The hotel offers 122 well-appointed guest rooms and three suites, each featuring comfortable bedding, a shower/tub combination, bath amenities, and a writing desk.

Featuring a shower, private bathrooms also come with a hairdryer and free toiletries. Some suites have private Turkish hammam and sauna inside and some private pool. There is a balcony in most of the rooms, offering guests a refreshing atmosphere. Family rooms are also available at the property. Radisson Blu Hotel & Spa, Istanbul Tuzla has an array of facilities for your relaxation and enjoyment. As the largest spa facility on Asian side, the property offers 2 saunas, a Finnish sauna, 2 Turkish baths, hot tubs and aroma steam rooms. Spa facility has designated areas for ladies only also. Room service and concierge services are provided. The property has a garden and a terrace. A 24-hour front desk and free WiFi are also available. Services including dry cleaning and daily maid service are featured.

234758.description: Enjoy a central New York stay at The Lex NYC, just a short walk from Gramercy Park and 5th Avenue. 235008.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Motel Plus Berlin, centrally located in Berlin, a short drive from Friedrichstrasse and the East Side Gallery. Unwind at the bar/lounge or make use of the terrace. Amenities include express check-out, complimentary newspapers, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). 235328.description: A haven within the vibrant city of Dubai, the Waldorf Astoria Dubai Palm Jumeirah boasts a private soft-sanded beach, six distinct restaurants and lounges and elegant sea facing guest rooms and suites. Situated on the iconic Palm Jumeirah island, this Waldorf Astoria resort promises all the amenities for a relaxing getaway, including:• 200 meters of private beach• Two temperature-controlled pools and kids pool • Guest rooms and suites with sea and Palm Jumeirah views• Waldorf Astoria Spa with nearly 50 luxurious treatments to choose fromWaldorf Astoria Dubai Palm Jumeirah offers a supervised Kids Club and numerous leisure activities for the whole family to enjoy. Dubai's premier dining destination offers the finest cuisine with unparalleled service in an unforgettable setting: From the modern authentic Italian cuisine at Social and the Southeast Asian culinary journey at LAO to international fare at Mezzerie. Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice Awards 2023.

Family one-bedroom apartments are also available for big families with tastefully unique accommodation and great value.

Nearby attractions include the Van Gogh Museum and Rijksmuseum (0. 5 mi).

237138.description: The Bank Hotel Istanbul is located in the most convenient area of Beyoğlu, Karaköy Banks Street, for exploring Istanbul. The hotel building, a typical example of 19th centuries eclectic architectural style that was re-novated to keep its original historical value, is formed by combining two buildings; the Sümerbank Building, built in 1876 and once home to Credit General Ottoman, and the erstwhile community center of the Neve Shalom cong-regation. The Bank Hotel Istanbul has a total of 61 rooms that are designed to reflect the historical spirit, including 6 suites, one of which is a penthouse with a magnificent view of the historical peninsula and the Golden Horn. Serica Restaurant, which offers its guests an unforgettable gastronomic experience with its original menu that based on soil to the plate concept and The Bank Roof Bar with its signature cocktails, welcome their guests on the terra-ce floor of The Bank Hotel Istanbul with its magnificent Istanbul view.

237182.description: This apartment complex boasts a prime setting in the old town of Manresa, an hour's drive from Barcelona. The complex lies just 100 metres away from the Town Hall and the Cave of Saint Ignasi. Boasting spectacular views over Montserrat, the complex offers visitors the ideal setting from which to explore this mesmerising city. The apartments occupy a listed, 18th-century building. Designed with a Baroque touch, the apartments ooze rustic elegance and splendour. The apartments offer modern amenities to ensure that each and every guest enjoyed the utmost in comfort and convenience. This complex offers visitors a comfortable, relaxing home away from home near Barcelona.

237211.address: Mekkah Road, AlHada Area. Al hada
237211.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy international cuisine at Al Orjouan, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Riyadh? This hotel has 62408 square feet (5800 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 12 meeting rooms.

237212.description: Housed in a Grade II historic-listed building dating back to 1830, the SO Arch is less than 2 miles from Emirates Stadium and Camden District, home of Arsenal Football Club. With free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, on-site parking (paid £10 per night) and a 24-hour front desk, the boutique hotel is just a 5-minute walk from Archway Underground (subway) Station on the Northern Line. Bathed in natural light, the modern apartments, studios and suites at SO Arch feature a sitting area, a flat-screen TV, air conditioning and a kitchenette. Close to many of London's major attractions, Madame Tussauds London and London Zoo are both less than a 4-mile away.

237213.description: Tucked away in the heart of England amidst 3 acres of wooded gardens, this elegant family-run Hotel offers peaceful surroundings, fine food, luxurious accommodation and free Wi-Fi and parking. A quintessentially English Country House Hotel, the Old Rectory is one of the best kept secrets in Worcestershire. With a wonderfully relaxed atmosphere, plenty of character and superb service, it radiates peace and charm. Individually decorated in a traditional style, each of the en-suite guestrooms combines the grace and comfort of a bygone age with modern contemporary facilities. Serving an ever-changing selection of traditional and contemporary favourites the restaurant uses the finest locally sourced produce to create its wonderful cuisine. Situated in Redditch it is 10 minutes from the M42 and 30 from Birmingham. It is perfectly positioned for visitors wishing to explore such attractions as Stratford-upon-Avon, the Cotswolds, Warwick Castle and the Birmingham NEC. From the M42, take Junction3, then follow the A435 signposted for Redditch. Stay on this road, the A435 until you reach the first roundabout at Mappleborough Green. Turn right, go straight over the next island and turn left at the next into Icknield Street Drive. Take the first left into Ipsley Lane and they are on the left amongst the trees.

237220.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service. Boasting a peaceful waterfront location, contemporary design, inviting guest rooms and fantastic business and leisure amenities; the DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Amsterdam - NDSM Wharf hotel is the perfect base for guests who want to easily experience the cosmopolitan city of Amsterdam, but avoid the frenetic pace of the bustling city center. Feel at home in a comfortable and contemporary guest room at this Amsterdam hotel. Enjoy modern facilities and amenities including complimentary WiFi, air-conditioning, an LED TV, a powerful rain shower, and a plush bed. Upgrade to a suite for a larger room, bed and bathroom, and wonderful views of the waterfront. Energize with the latest cardio, resistance and weights equipment in the complimentary 24-hour fitness center. Relax beside the open fireplace with a bespoke cocktail or a glass of beer, and savor Dutch specialties and international favorites as you admire local artwork in Brasserie & Bar Smederij. Make updates to your presentation, or print your boarding pass in the complimentary 24-hour business center. Host a meeting, training event or celebration for up to 100 guests at this Amsterdam hotel in our bright, modern meeting room, which features state-of-the-art A/V equipment. We look forward to welcoming you at check-in with a signature, warm chocolate chip cookie.

237227.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Take advantage of the hostal's room service (during limited hours). Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a computer station, and express check-in. Stay in one of 18 guestrooms featuring plasma televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is available. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. 237228.description: Offering a fantastic location, right on the famous Ramblas, next to Plaza Cataluña Square and Barcelona’s main shopping area, this hotel features a 24-hour front desk and free Wi-Fi throughout the property. Rooms at Hotel Toledano Ramblas include satellite TV, desk and a private bathroom. Some rooms have air conditioning. This hotel is close to the Aerobus bus stop, which takes you to Barcelona International Airport. Plaza Cataluña or Liceu metro stations are less than a 4 minute walk of the hotel. Numerous bars and restaurants serving national and international food can be found nearby.

237229.description: Located just a 1-minute walk from Barcelona Cathedral, Itaca Hostel is set on a quiet street in the heart of the city, surrounded by cafés, bars, and restaurants. Itaca Hostel offers shared dormitories with bunk beds as well as private rooms, a 24-hour front desk, and free Wi-Fi throughout the property. It’s the perfect choice for solo travelers and small groups looking to meet new people. Please note that group bookings of more than 10 people are not accepted. Most rooms and dormitories overlook the street and feature a balcony. All accommodations are bright, modern, and equipped with air conditioning and ceiling fans. Individual lockers are available in the dormitories. Guests can relax and connect in our friendly, social common areas, including a shared kitchen and a cozy living room. We regularly organize social activities such as family dinners, sangria nights, and sunset views, making it easy to meet fellow travelers. Free tea, coffee, and hot chocolate are available all day. Luggage storage and a safe are available for guests. Thanks to the central location, many of Barcelona’s main attractions are within walking distance. Plaza Catalunya and the airport bus stop are just a 5-minute walk away.

237285.description: This traditional villa resort lets its guests experience the perfect vacation. They will be sitting at just a 20-minute drive from Marrakesh's medina, but they will feel as if they have travelled back in time to a place of elegance and splendid beauty. Waking up to the view of the mighty Atlas Mountains and savouring a delicious breakfast on the outdoor terrace, will be just the start of their amazing day. Afterwards they can relax with a book in hand next to the outdoor swimming pool or head to the garden and enjoy its refreshing shades. The bar is the place from where to grab a cocktail or simply unwind with a chilled drink in hand, before visiting the restaurant for a meal consisting of a selection of Moroccan and European specialities.

237287.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Valet Parking. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Fitness Center. Hilton Garden Inn New York/Manhattan-Midtown East boasts a fantastic location in the heart of Midtown Manhattan; just minutes from extensive shopping, lively restaurants and bars, the bustling Theater District and the iconic Rockefeller Center and Radio City Music Hall. The United Nations Headquarters, the Chrysler Building, Times Square and many other New York attractions can all be easily reached from our welcoming hotel in Midtown Manhattan, NY. Unwind in a spacious guest room, equipped with a microwave, a mini-refrigerator and a coffeemaker. Stay connected with complimentary WiFi at the large desk, which features an ergonomic chair and desk level power outlets and ports. Play music through the alarm clock radio with MP3 connection, watch movies on the HDTV and enjoy a great night's sleep. Maintain your exercise regime at this hotel in Manhattan, NY, in the complimentary 24-hour fitness center. Start your morning with a cooked-to-order breakfast and buy drinks, snacks and essentials in the 24-hour Pavilion Pantry®. Unwind by the fireplace in the welcoming lobby lounge as you enjoy a cold beer or a glass of wine, before savoring delicious American cuisine in the relaxed Garden Grille & Bar. If you would rather dine in the comfort of your guest room, we also offer a tempting Room Service menu. Keep in touch with the office in the complimentary 24-hour business center, which offers services including faxing and printing or hold a small meeting in our naturally-lit board room.

237290.description: Only 0. 6 mi from the seafront, Mevre Hotel is located in the city center of Antalya. It offers free Wi-Fi, 24-hour front desk service, and air-conditioned rooms with a satellite TV. The rooms of Hotel Mevre are decorated in warm colors. Each room comes with a private bathroom with a hairdryer. A mini-bar is also standard in the rooms. Daily breakfast is served in buffet style. You can enjoy a variety drinks and snacks served at the bar. The restaurant offers international cuisine as well as Turkish dishes. You can benefit from laundry, dry cleaning and room services at Mevre Hotel. Car rental is also available. From the hotel, you can take a stroll to the triumphal arch Hadrian’s Gate (dating back to the year 130), which is 328 feet away. The famous Konyaalti Beach is 1. 9 mi from Mevre Hotel. Antalya Airport is 8. 1 mi away.
