237299.description: This stunning property boasts a wonderful location in Marrakech. The property is located just 500 metres away from the renowned Jemaa el Fna Square. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a treasure trove of attractions in this cultural city. The riad lies within easy walking distance of the Ben Youssef Mosque and the Majorelle Gardens. This wonderful property tempts visitors into a world where culture, history and modern convenience are combined. The guest rooms are superbly designed in a traditional style, exuding elegance and charm. Guests can enjoy a wonderful breakfast in the mornings, followed by traditional Moroccan dishes for lunch and dinner.

237308.description: This hostel is ideally situated in the city centre of Barcelona. The hostel lies within easy access of the wealth of intriguing attractions that the city has to offer. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the Passeig de Gracia. The hostel is situated just 750 metres away from Plaza Catalunya. Las Ramblas and the Gothic Quarter are also situated nearby. A wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found in the area. This hostel welcomes visitors with warm hospitality, into a homely environment. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, offering a peaceful setting in which to unwind. Guests will be pleased by the comfort and convenience that the hostel has to offer.

237319.description: The Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam Arena Towers is located in Amsterdam Southeast, offering easy access to both urban and natural attractions. The park features a water playground, barbecue areas, and trails for walking, cycling, and horse riding. The Amsterdam city center is a quick 15-minute metro ride away, allowing you to easily explore the canals, museums, and cultural attractions. The hotel's modern rooms provide a comfortable stay, equipped with televisions offering international channels and complimentary coffee and tea facilities. Choose between double or twin beds, and enjoy the private bathroom with a walk-in shower and toiletries. Start your day with the included Express Start Continental takeaway breakfast box, available in the Great Room. Grab a coffee at the on-site Starbucks To-Go and maintain your fitness routine at our 24/7 gym. On-site parking is also available for guests arriving by car.

237347.description: Sitting on the high-end Tahlia Street, which is home to many fashionable restaurants and shops, this hotel offers a modern hub for all visitors of Riyadh. The hotel itself boasts an outdoor pool where one can find respite in the warm days and a tranquil garden, where to escape from the noise or the city. The friendly, multilingual staff are also always at hand to help with requests made by guests.

237429.description: Al Nawras Resort Located 15 minutes’ drive from Jeddah city Centre, it has villas with private pools, Located on a private island on the Red Sea. Set amidst 18, 000 metres squared of land, this hotel is perfect for travellers who are eager to enjoy a truly relaxing, rejuvenating experience. The resort comprises stunningly-designed guest rooms, which exude elegance and splendour. This hotel offers a range of activities, ensuring that guests of all ages are entertained.

237464.description: Explore NYC from our Hell's Kitchen HotelWelcome to the Holiday Inn Express Manhattan Midtown West. Our modern 177-room hotel, located in historic Hell’s Kitchen – known for its variety of restaurants and nightlife – offers the best value of hotels near Hudson Yards and Broadway Theater District in the heart of New York City affording your accessibility to all of Manhattan’s most sought-after attractions, while providing an authentic New York experience. Check-off NYC’s famous tourist attractions from your bucket list, including Times Square, Intrepid Sea Air and Space Museum, Broadway Theater District and Manhattan Cruise Terminal. Or, explore the hip and trendy neighborhoods of Hell’s Kitchen and Hudson Yards, which are home to Restaurant Row, High-Line Park, local shops, world-class restaurants and nightlife. Refresh, recharge and stay productive with our complimentary amenities, including our delicious and hot Express Start breakfast, which is served complimentary daily, free Wi-Fi and 24-hour onsite fitness center. The hotel features two outdoor pools and a waterslide pool, ensuring enjoyment for all the family. Guests can dine in style in the relaxed surroundings of the restaurant.

237520.description: The Wyndham Bogota Art Hotel offers a luxurious experience inspired by Bogota's architecture. Choose from 261 guest rooms across six distinct styles, each blending modern design with natural elements. The seamless integration of comfort, technology, and design ensures a unique and memorable stay. The hotel specializes in hosting both social and corporate events.

237523.description:
Step under our vine-covered archway and feel transported to a world of Colombian splendor and French sophistication at Sofitel Bogota Victoria Regia. From its evocative name to its chic, immersive design, we fully embrace our multicultural roots. 
French chic and rich Colombian style blend seamlessly in our contemporary accommodations. Warm hues, clean lines and softly lit reading spaces set a mood of relaxation. With a pillow menu, marble bathrooms and luxurious amenities, our rooms and suites welcome you in and invite you to stay. 
Savor a world of bold flavors at Basilic Restaurant, where Executive Chef Néstor Mesa’s French-inspired dishes take on a distinctly Colombian twist in a gastronomic experience to delight the senses.

237550.description: Located in the heart of Palermo Soho, this hotel offers spacious and comfortable rooms, putting you within easy reach of Palermo's center, La Rural exhibition center, diverse dining options, shopping, and art galleries. Just steps from the hotel, you'll find convenient transportation, vibrant outdoor fairs, and entertainment at Plaza Armenia and Plaza Serrano.

237557.description: The boutique Hotel Sonne in Küsnacht is located about ten minutes from Zurich and combines historical elements with contemporary design. With 40 individually designed rooms and junior suites, three restaurants, a bar, a fitness and wellness area, as well as a selection of event spaces, this 4-star superior hotel is a place for overnight stays, enjoyment, relaxation, celebrations, and meetings. All bathrooms are equipped with a shower. Spacious family rooms accommodate up to four people. The hotel is an ideal base for exploring the region, including the coastal area, Voldendam, Edam, Alkmaar, Haarlem, and Amsterdam. Bike rentals and parking (for a small fee) are available. Restaurant 22 Kitchen & Bar offers freshly prepared local and regional dishes and drinks. Meeting rooms are also available. Please note that the restaurant is closed on Saturdays and Sundays. We apologize for any inconvenience.

237593.description: The Best Western Plus Riyadh Hotel, a landmark in downtown Riyadh, offers easy access to businesses, commercial towers, government offices, and popular shopping destinations. Spacious rooms feature digital air conditioning, safes, work desks, and complimentary Wi-Fi. A flat-screen television with HDMI cable provides 27 multinational channels. 256088.description: Located in Ranipat the fourth largest urban area of India The Pride Biznotel is a one of a kind hotel offering world class accommodation and amenities to the most discerning business traveller.  48 rooms and suites that were  designed and built to meet all the needs of business czars just like you. From comfortable interiors that will relieve your daily stresses to amenities that will facilitate your work Pride Briznotel will make your stay in Ranipat very special.  Pride Biznotel features an exclusive restaurant and bar. Silver Spoon our multi cuisine restaurant serves a menu full of exquisite Vegetarian and Non Vegetarian delicacies to tempt your taste buds. While the bar Fluid offers an extensive selection of spirits wines liquors cocktails and beers from all around the world in an elegant and enchanting ambience.

256708.description: Located in the heart of Queens, Flushing Central Hotel offers comfortable air-conditioned guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi and digital programming. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour front desk, express check-out, and multilingual staff. Just a short walk from the Free Synagogue of Flushing and John Bowne House, the hotel is also conveniently close to the Queens Botanical Garden and Queens Historical Society. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include desks and phones with free local calls. LaGuardia Airport (LGA) is the closest airport.

256709.description: Enjoy a central location at the Embassy Suites Newark Airport, just minutes from Newark Airport and The Outlet Collection at Jersey Gardens. This all-suite hotel provides complimentary airport shuttle service and easy access to downtown Manhattan and Times Square, only 30 minutes away. Relax in your stylish two-room suite, featuring a microwave, mini-refrigerator, ergonomic workspace with complimentary internet access, separate living room, and two 42-inch HDTVs. Start your day with a free made-to-order breakfast, offering various hot and cold options. The Grille serves lunch and dinner, while the Lobby Bar is perfect for coffee or cocktails. Unwind in the atrium during the complimentary Evening Reception* with drinks and appetizers. The hotel also offers 4, 000 sq. ft. of flexible meeting space, a BusinessLink Business Center, A/V equipment, catering services, and an events team. *Subject to state and local laws. Must be of legal drinking age.

256719.description: Magnificently located in Avenida Paulista in the heart of Sao Paulo, this hotel is the ideal choice of accommodation for anyone visiting the city for business or leisure. The property is well connected with public transport links in the surrounding area, allowing easy access to the rest of the city. The hotel offers sophisticated, comfortable and spacious guest rooms and luxurious suites to ensure a truly enchanting stay. The premises count with extensive facilities for meetings, congresses and events for up to 300 people, as well as a restaurant that offers delicious, contemporary cuisine for dinner and lunch every day. Guests can keep updated thanks to the complimentary wireless Internet connection throughout.

name.content: Marriott Executive Apartments Al Jaddaf, Dubai

256721.address: Oud Metha Road, Al Jaddaf Area
256721.description: Treat yourself with massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Guests can catch a ride to the beach or shopping on the complimentary shuttle. Enjoy international cuisine at The Lobby Lounge, one of the hotel's 5 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. This hotel has 15 meeting rooms available for events. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

256722.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Recreational opportunities include an outdoor pool, a spa tub, and a sauna. This hotel also offers complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Getting to the beach is easy with the complimentary beach shuttle. Enjoy international cuisine at BnB (Bar Nights Bites), one of the hotel's five restaurants, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the two bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limousine service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 245, 161 square feet (2, 116 square meters) of space, consisting of a conference center and 15 meeting rooms.

256749.description: The Parkview Astoria Hotel offers a serene escape in the exclusive Parkview Estate, Ikoyi, Lagos. The grandeur architecture sets it apart, providing a relaxing ambiance with high-level security and privacy. Conveniently located near the commercial districts of Ikoyi and Victoria Island, the hotel offers easy access to Murtala Muhammad International Airport. Each of the 40 individually designed rooms features contemporary classic furnishings, modern technology, and views of the Lagos lagoon. For business needs, the hotel offers a modern meeting room and various conference rooms equipped with state-of-the-art multimedia facilities and complimentary high-speed internet. Guests can enjoy diverse cuisine and drinks at the hotel's restaurant and bar, purchase necessities at the on-site Astoria Supermarket and gift shop, and unwind at the pool or well-equipped gym.

256776.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. You can soak up the sun at the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. This resort also features complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. The beach shuttle (surcharge) makes getting to the surf and sand a breeze. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the resort's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 89 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions.

256784.description:
The Hostel Excelsior is one of the most traditional hostels in the capital. Opened in 1967, it is characterised by an ideal location in unbeatable surroundings with a friendly and welcoming service. Ideal for holiday makers and business travellers alike.
It has 35 rooms distributed on two floors. Almost all of the rooms have a full bathroom, there are just two with half a bathroom and one with a wash basin. With regard to other facilities, they all have a television, air-conditioning and a safe.
We also have a lounge with a coffee, cold drinks and snacks vending machine, 24-hour reception and free Wi-Fi.
We can also lend you a hairdryer, iron and ironing board on request.
We take great care and place particular emphasis on cleanliness and customer service, informing our guests of museum opening times, addresses, offers and days when entrance is free…

256947.description: Enjoying a prime location in Berlin-Mitte, this hotel is ideally situated for business and city trips alike. This unique hotel offers an elegant and warm ambience to guests. The central square, Hackescher Markt, as well as the shopping boulevards, Unter den Linden and Friedrichstraße, are only a 10 minute walk away from the hotel. Guests will have a comfortable stay in the small but snug rooms. Complimentary WiFi access is also offered which allows guests to stay connected. For dining options, guests can choose the charming on-site restaurant, equipped with wooden elements and dimmed lighting, which serves international cross-over cuisine. After a busy day, guests can unwind with a refreshing beverage at the bar.

256997.description: The Amadi Park Hotel is a luxurious 4-star hotel in the centre of Amsterdam. The hotel features 33 luxury rooms, including single, double, and triple rooms, suites, and disabled rooms. All rooms feature a luxury bathroom with an environmentally friendly rain and hand shower, a hairdryer, and shaving mirror. You will find custom-made furniture and a very comfortable bed in these rooms. You have access to fast and free Wi-Fi throughout the entire hotel. A Nespresso coffee machine, tea facilities and water are available free of charge The Amadi Park Hotel is an environmentally friendly hotel, housed in a sustainable building. The latest technologies in the field of environment and sustainability were used in the construction and furnishing of the hotel. For instance, there is LED lighting throughout, and geothermal energy provides heating. In the breakfast hall on the 4th floor, you can enjoy a delicious breakfast with various organic and fair trade products. The hotel only accept payments with credit card and debit card.

257252.description: 'Enjoy breathtaking terrace views at Riad Mabrouk, a charming riad in the heart of Marrakech, just a short walk from Jemaa el-Fnaa and the Koutoubia Mosque. Indulge in Moroccan cuisine at our on-site restaurant, or relax with room service. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast. Modern amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an airport shuttle (surcharge). Each of our 19 individually decorated guestrooms features a minibar, LCD TV, premium bedding, and a private bathroom with a rainfall showerhead. '

257281.address: Kizlarpinari Mah. Ismet Tumerdem Sok. No: 14, 14
257281.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages and facials. After dipping into one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional features at this property include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Getting to the surf and sand is a breeze with the complimentary beach shuttle. This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Stop by the property's restaurant for lunch or dinner, or grab snacks at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Free self parking is available onsite.

260322.description: Nestled in the tranquil residential area of West Coates, this sophisticated boutique hotel offers convenient access to Edinburgh's city center. Guests are just 20 minutes from Edinburgh Castle and other main attractions. Rugby enthusiasts will appreciate the hotel's proximity to Murrayfield Stadium (5 minutes) and Haymarket train station. Edinburgh Airport is a quick 15-20 minute drive. The elegantly furnished rooms and suites offer contemporary amenities and traditional Scottish charm, creating a comfortable home-away-from-home experience. Business travelers will also find suitable meeting facilities and the whisky bar offers tastings.

261069.description: The total number of units is 27. The establishment offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The reception desk is open all day long. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

261070.description: Situated in the heart of town, this hotel offers easy access to local attractions and public transport. The airport is conveniently located within 20 kilometers. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the property and the convenience of a 24-hour reception desk. Please note that some services may incur a fee.

261096.description: Enjoy garden views at The Rex Hotel in Porto, with amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Dine at the onsite coffee shop/cafe and unwind at the bar/lounge. A continental breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel offers a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Self-parking is available for a fee. Each of the 20 individually decorated guestrooms features complimentary Wi-Fi, cable TV, and a bathroom with a bathtub or shower and hairdryer. The Rex Hotel is centrally located within a 15-minute walk of Bolhao Market and Clérigos Tower, and a short distance from other attractions such as Holy Trinity Church and Rua de Miguel Bombarda.

name.content: The Inn at Fox Hollow Hotel

261446.description: Nestled in the heart of Long Island's Gold Coast, the Inn at Fox Hollow is a premier all-suite boutique hotel in the Woodbury-Melville area. Ideal for business, leisure, and extended stays, this hotel offers complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, a 3-course dinner buffet Monday-Thursday, and a full American breakfast buffet daily. Guests can enjoy the Vintage 25 Bar and Lounge and appreciate the convenience of fully equipped kitchens and separate living areas in each suite. Local shuttle transportation is also available. The Inn at Fox Hollow is committed to guest and team member safety, adhering to all State, County, and CDC guidelines.

name.content: Quinta Nova Winery House – Relais & Châteaux

262224.description: In 2005, in the heart of the Douro Valley, between terraces full of vines and fruit trees, the top award-winning wine tourism project in Portugal was born, with a total area of 120 hectares, it is now a reference to all who wish to be engulfed by the true spirit of the region. The Quinta Nova Winery House invites all guests to enjoy a truly immersive experience in the Douro Wine Region. Once an emblematic building from the 18th century, this winery house was reconverted through the renovation of the manor house of the estate. It boasts 11 comfortable suites, where guests are welcome on a daily basis, and a memorable stay is guaranteed. The several social areas invite you to escape your daily routine. From the rustic living rooms, to our lounge-like porches with a view of the Douro River, from the inviting pool overlooking the vineyards, to the Chapel of Our Lady of Carmo, which all make up a picturesque backdrop, you are free to explore many contrasting spaces in a welcoming environment, where you can feel the tranquility of your surroundings. From May to September, the terrace is the most sought-after spot to enjoy the estate's Conceitus Winery Restaurant, either partaking in Degustation Menus or simply tasting some of the delicacies our Chef prepares daily, always harmonized with our own Wines. Don't hesitate to make the most of your stay, complementing your experience with a boat tour, a walk along our vineyard trails, or selecting one of the wine experiences to take part in, alongside our Wine Tourism team.

262475.description: This superb hotel of the highest quality boasts a spectacular location with manicured gardens, the majestic Atlas mountain range in the background and a fantastic golf course to keep fit in the same property and at guests' disposal. Marrakech downtown can be found just a few kilometres away with a complimentary shuttle bus, allowing its guests to discover this magical city full of secrets and incredibly beautiful historical and cultural jewels. The lavish suites' and villas' design is based on the Berber culture and at the same time offer exclusive and luxurious amenities to guarantee a really comfortable and unique experience. The different accommodation options showcase luxurious private bathrooms and panoramic views over the Atlas range, the hotel or the golf course. This exclusive hotel's facilities include 4 mouth-watering restaurants and 2 bars, a large spa and a fitness centre with a semi-Olympic swimming pool and a unique Kids' Club to make it the best family destination in town. Please note:Starting May 15th and until August 31st, besides its regular menu, Le Caravane Restaurant will be offering a special selection of Moroccan cuisine. Al Aïn Moroccan Restaurant will be closed from May 15th to August 31stLe Sabra Restaurant will be closed from June 1st to August 31st

262479.description: Enjoy garden views at this boutique hotel in Edinburgh's Newington area, offering complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. Relax with room service (limited hours) or a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available for a fee on weekdays and weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and luggage storage. The hotel features 538 square feet of event space, including conference space and two meeting rooms. The 15 guestrooms offer iPod docking stations, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. Kildonan Lodge Hotel is a 3-minute drive from the University of Edinburgh and 5 minutes from the Royal Mile, 2. 1 miles from Edinburgh Castle, and 2. 5 miles from Princes Street.

270798.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as bicycle rentals, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. Dine at the onsite VinSens Restaurant for lunch or dinner, or take advantage of room service. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel also offers complimentary wired internet access, newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self-parking is available (fee applies). Each of the 38 guest rooms features a minibar, flat-screen TV with satellite programming, safe, desk, and a bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Located in Berlin's Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf district, Albergo City Hotel is within a 5-minute drive of Kurfürstendamm and the Berlin Zoo. It's also conveniently close to other attractions, including the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church and Tiergarten Park.

270837.description: With a small number of only 5, this accomodation is very convenient for a quiet stay. The establishment offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. The Brandenburg Gate Hostel has wheelchair-accessible common areas. Additionally, a car park is available on the premises for guests' extra convenience. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

270839.description: Feelathome Poblenou Beach Apartments is conveniently located in the popular El Poblenou area. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Facilities like free Wi-Fi in all rooms, express check-in/check-out, luggage storage, Wi-Fi in public areas, car park are readily available for you to enjoy. Comfortable guestrooms ensure a good night's sleep with some rooms featuring facilities such as television LCD/plasma screen, sofa, closet, internet access – wireless (complimentary), air conditioning. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Convenience and comfort makes Feelathome Poblenou Beach Apartments the perfect choice for your stay in Barcelona.

270842.description: The Hundred House Hotel, near the world-famous Ironbridge, is centrally located to Telford, Wolverhampton, and Shrewsbury, making it an ideal getaway destination. This quirky hotel features lavishly decorated bars with beamed ceilings and ten uniquely designed bedrooms, some with patchwork quilts, lavender-scented linens, and even velvet-covered swings. The hotel's 2AA rosette restaurant offers award-winning, innovative cuisine using fresh, local ingredients, many sourced from the on-site Sylvia's Garden. From its origins as a 14th-century courthouse in the half-timbered thatch barn to its modern conference and party facilities, the Hundred House Hotel caters to a variety of needs. All en-suite rooms offer modern amenities, including color TV, direct-dial telephone, clock radio, tea and coffee making facilities, iron and ironing board, and central heating. Superior rooms boast more spacious accommodations with period furnishings, some featuring half-tester beds and the hotel's signature swings.

name.content: Holiday Inn Berlin City East Side

270847.description: Holiday Inn® Berlin - City East Side hotel is steps from the River Spree and a Berlin Wall remnant preserved as a monument and outdoor gallery. From nearby Warschauer Strasse station, the U- and S-Bahn networks provide speedy links to popular East Berlin attractions, such as the GDR-era TV Tower in Alexanderplatz. It’s a 25-minute journey to the imposing Brandenburg Gate and the cultural riches of Museum Island. The airport Berlin-Brandenburg (BER) are 30 minutes away by car. Our family-friendly hotel is next to the Uber Arena, which presents major pop concerts and sporting events. Business guests can host conferences for up to 70 people in our flexible event spaces, while companies such as Zalando, Daimler and Coca-Cola are all within walking distance. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Inclusive Wi-Fi- A mini-gym- Underground parking at a daily rate- Kids Stay and Eat FreeOur welcoming Open Lobby is a multipurpose space where you can relax with a cocktail or a Alfredo coffee, meet colleagues and friends for a meal, or check your emails. Our comfortable, streamlined rooms are decorated in soothing colours. As well as high-quality bedding, they feature pillow menus and blackout blinds to ensure you get a restful night’s sleep.

270904.description: With a stay at Strandhotel Buckow gut-Hotels SEE in Buckow, you'll be near the beach, and 32. 2 mi (51. 8 km) from East Side Gallery and 32. 3 mi (52 km) from Mercedes-Benz Arena. This beach hotel is 25. 2 mi (40. 6 km) from Mueggelsee and 31. 4 mi (50. 5 km) from Velodrom. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. This hotel also features complimentary wireless Internet access and a banquet hall. The front desk is staffed during limited hours. Free self parking is available onsite. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/café. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:30 AM to 11:00 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 14 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include complimentary bottled water, and housekeeping is provided daily.

270925.description: The Hotel del Casco offers 20 welcoming rooms and convenient amenities such as Wi-Fi and 24-hour reception. The common areas and one guest room are accessible to guests with disabilities. On-site parking, business facilities, and a health and wellness center are also available. Note that cots are not provided and some services may incur a fee. This hotel is committed to environmentally friendly practices.

270932.description: Located on the fun-packed bowling complex at Great Park, Birmingham South Rubery Premier Inn is the perfect place to let your hair down. You're just seconds from an array of family entertainment - including a Brewers Fayre fun factory, a cinema, bowling alley and bingo. Further afield, there are even more family favourites including Cadbury World, the Sea Life Centre and Birmingham's many events and attractions. Then, after a day of indulgence or industry, return to our spacious rooms, Brewers Fayre restaurant, and extra-comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

270936.description: Enjoy Berlin from the Hotel MANI by AMANO, featuring a terrace, garden, and bicycle rentals. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and wired internet access in your room, equipped with a minibar, LCD TV, and private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. The hotel offers express check-in/check-out, a 24-hour front desk, concierge services, and on-site parking (for a fee). Savor a meal at the MANI Restaurant and drinks at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfast is available daily (for a fee). Located in the heart of Berlin, the hotel is a short walk from Torstrasse and within a 5-minute drive of Hackescher Markt and the Berlin TV Tower.

270939.description: Raco De Buenos Aires guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 10 units. The property offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. As this hotel features 24-hour reception, guests are always welcome.

270981.description: This charming hotel is located in Campana.

270982.description: There are a total of 36 accomodation units at Coronado. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. As this hotel features 24-hour reception, guests are always welcome. Coronado may charge a fee for some services.

271062.description: Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including a sauna, a fitness center, and bicycles to rent. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Enjoy Regional cuisine at scent, a bar/lounge where you can take in the garden view, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Berlin? This hotel has 780 square feet (73 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 3 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 84 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment.

271065.description:
The PLAZA Premium Berlin Kurfürstendamm is centrally located in Berlin’s City West district, right on the famous Kurfürstendamm. Attractions such as the KaDeWe, the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, the Zoologischer Garten, and Charlottenburg Palace are within easy reach. Numerous boutiques, cafés, restaurants, and bars are located in the surrounding area. 

The Uhlandstraße and Kurfürstendamm subway stations, as well as the Savignyplatz S-Bahn station, are just a few minutes’ walk away. From here, there are good connections to Messe Berlin, BER Airport, and other Berlin neighborhoods. The hotel is easily accessible via the A100; parking is available about 250 meters from the hotel. 

The hotel features 236 rooms, including double rooms, junior suites, and family rooms. Amenities include comfortable beds, soundproof windows, individually controlled air conditioning, free high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and desks. The junior suites also feature a sleeper sofa and can accommodate up to four people. 

A generous breakfast buffet, a sauna area, a fitness center, and bike rentals round out the amenities. Tapas are served in the evening at the adjacent restaurant. The front desk is staffed 24 hours a day.

271105.description: Located in the heart of Vilafranca del Penedès, Catalonia's renowned wine capital, Hotel Pedro III offers a smart, modern, and well-equipped base for exploring the region and the Costa Dorada coastline. The hotel boasts spacious, well-lit rooms with free Wi-Fi and satellite TV offering international channels, providing a tranquil retreat after a day of business or sightseeing. Excellent facilities are also available for business meetings and private events, featuring spacious function rooms with wired internet access.

271108.description: This designer hotel in Berlin's Tiergarten district is a 5 minute walk from the KaDeWe department store. Motel One Tiergarten offers free Wi-Fi and stylish rooms with a flat-screen TV and a mobile desk. The air-conditioned rooms at the Motel One Berlin-Tiergarten feature distinctive light-blue decor and hardwood floors. All rooms have a modern bathroom with granite and a mosaic design. The Motel One Berlin-Tiergarten's elegant One Lounge includes designer furniture. Snacks and drinks are served here 24 hours a day. Wittenbergplatz Underground (subway) station is a 5 minute walk from the Motel One. Bus 100 also stops nearby, offering direct services to the Reichstag parliament and Alexanderplatz square.

271112.description: This stylish hotel enjoys a wonderful setting in Bogota, lying just a 15 minutes' driving distance away from the city centre. The hotel is located just 600 metres away from Colombia's National University. Galeris Shopping Centre is a 10 minutes' drive from the hotel. The hotel is conveniently located just 10 km away from El Dorado Airport. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. The hotel features a beautiful design. The guest rooms exude style and character, and come well equipped with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy a delightful American-style breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

271127.description: Suites 108 features a total of 28 rooms. Those staying at this hotel may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas.

271135.description: With a stay at Sporthotel Malchow in Malchow (Müritz), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Lake Fleesensee and Malchow Church. This hotel is 2. 2 mi (3. 6 km) from Summer Toboggan Run and Monkey Forest and 4. 5 mi (7. 2 km) from Alt Schwerin Agricultural Museum. Take advantage of recreation opportunities including a health club and an indoor tennis court. The front desk is staffed during limited hours. Free self parking is available onsite. At Sporthotel Malchow, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 40 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

271149.description: With a stay at Hostal Q, you'll be centrally located in Barcelona, within a 5-minute walk of Passeig de Gracia and Placa de Catalunya. This pension is 0. 2 mi (0. 4 km) from Palau de la Musica Catalana and 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from La Rambla. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 21 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Housekeeping is provided daily, and cribs/infant beds (complimentary) can be requested.

271171.description: Enjoy garden views at Pension Peters, located in the heart of Berlin. Take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and convenient room service. A buffet breakfast is offered daily (for a fee) from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Additional amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and luggage storage. The 33 individually decorated guestrooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi and cable television. Bathrooms feature bathtubs or showers, safes, and desks. Cribs/infant beds are available upon request (complimentary). You'll be within a 15-minute walk of Kurfürstendamm and the Berlin Zoo, and a short distance from other key attractions like the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church and Tiergarten Park. Pension Peters is also conveniently located near the Theatre of the West.

271220.description: With a stay at Hotel Dorado Gold Bogota in Bogotá, you'll be 1. 3 mi (2 km) from Bogota Botanical Garden and 3. 8 mi (6. 1 km) from U. S. Embassy Bogotá. This hotel is 5. 1 mi (8. 3 km) from National University of Colombia and 5. 9 mi (9. 5 km) from Torre Colpatria. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Featured amenities include a business center, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/café. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Stay in one of 35 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include safes, as well as phones with free local calls.

271241.description: Visitors will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Pension Absolut Berlin as it counts with a total of 10 units. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. Pension Absolut Berlin does not offer 24-hour reception. Additional fees may apply for some services.

271279.description: Relax on the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities such as a steam room and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy a meal at HessenWinkel, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include multilingual staff, laundry facilities, and an elevator. Planning an event in Berlin? This hotel has 1883 square feet (175 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Stay in one of 37 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

271303.description: Declared architectural heritage, this hotel is a 15 minute walk from the International Centre of Bogotá and is ideal for both business travelers and leisure travelers. The property offers accommodations that are decorated in a contemporary style with all the amenities guests need. The restaurant serves a rich American breakfast. Guests will find several dining options within walking distance. With 2, 260 square feet of event space, including a conference area and meeting room, it's ideal for hosting events. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge, and free self-parking is provided. The 34 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions with satellite channels, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. Nearby attractions include Mecklenburg Switzerland and Lake Kummerow Nature Park, Nossentiner-Schwinzer Heath Nature Park, and Insel Schwerin. The nearest airports are Rostock-Laage Airport (RLG) and Hamburg Airport (HAM).

276009.description: Located in Buenos Aires (San Telmo), Osteria Sagardi is within a 10-minute drive of La Bombonera and Barolo Palace. This hotel is 1. 4 mi (2. 2 km) from Plaza de Mayo and 2 mi (3. 2 km) from Obelisco. Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and luggage storage. This hotel has 6 meeting rooms available for events. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 9 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls.

276047.description: Inspired by the vibrant culture and natural beauty of Colombia, this Chico Alto hotel is ideally located behind the Javeriana University campus. Guests are just a short drive from Bogotá's historic center, La Candelaria, Cerro de Monserrate, and the Botero Museum. The fully furnished apartments, a 15-minute drive from Bogotá's entertainment district, showcase impeccable modern design with colorful furnishings, contemporary art, exposed brick walls, and city views. This property offers an unforgettable Bogotá experience.

276049.description: Located just outside the historic center of Vic, the Hotel Can Pamplona offers contemporary rooms with a private terrace and air conditioning. Free Wi-Fi and free parking are available. The rooms at Hotel Hotel Can Pamplona are elegantly decorated. The private bathroom comes with a hairdryer and amenities. A buffet breakfast is served and there is a bar-cafeteria. Vic Cathedral and Plaza Major are 10 minutes’ walk from Hotel Can Pamplona. The RENFE Train Station is just 1640 feet away, with links to Barcelona, Girona and the ski resort of La Molina.

276060.description: Located in Joachimsthal, Ringhotel Schorfheide is in a rural location, within a 15-minute drive of Schorfheide-Chorin Biosphere and Barnim Nature Park. This 4-star hotel is 12. 8 mi (20. 7 km) from Eberswalde Zoo and 28. 2 mi (45. 4 km) from El Dorado Templin. Make yourself at home in one of the 80 guestrooms featuring minibars. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wired and wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and premium TV channels provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature hair dryers and bathrobes. Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including a sauna, a fitness center, and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. For lunch or dinner, stop by Von Hoevel, a restaurant that specializes in regional cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Joachimsthal? This hotel has facilities measuring 9720 square feet (903 square meters), including conference space. Free self parking is available onsite.

276122.description:
An 18th-century Georgian Listed, highly rated, privately owned guest house, providing friendly and efficient service from the owners. Well placed for Birmingham's National Exhibition Centre (NEC), Birmingham Airport, Birmingham International Train Station, Resorts World Birmingham and surrounding business parks. 

Springfield House offers business-quality Wi-Fi and free secure parking with CCTV. Most rooms have work desks, making the property ideal for business travellers, while there is also space to relax. The guest house combines modern comforts and contemporary décor with the character and feel of an 18th-century building. 

Birmingham Airport and Birmingham International Train Station are approximately 10 minutes away by car, while Coleshill Parkway railway station is also around 10 minutes away, providing convenient connections to Birmingham and beyond. Birmingham city centre is easily accessible by road and rail. 

Additional services can be added during online check-in, including full cooked breakfast (£15 per person), Grab & Go breakfast/packed lunch (£7. 50 per person), airport transfer to/from Birmingham Airport (£25) and laundry service (£25). 

Springfield House is entirely non-smoking, except for the garden area. 

Springfield House operates an online check-in process. To complete this, please contact us directly after booking to provide your email address and mobile number. WhatsApp is available for convenient communication with guests before and during their stay. Telephone: +44 1675 465695.

276323.description: A 3 star aparthotel, located in a quiet area, close to the commercial and tourist center of Barcelona. Disposes of 30 apartments with capacity for 1-5 people. All of them with lounge, bedroom, bathroom and kitchenette all in one room or in different rooms. There is a charged garage in the same building. It offers a cosy and warm environment. Notice: The covered parking is small and on request.

276372.description: This wellness hotel in Kremmen's Sommerfeld district offers a large spa, fine dining, and a scenic location on the Beetzer See lake, next to the Rhinluch moor. The 2625 ft² Anima Spa at the Hotel & SPA Sommerfeld offers more than 40 wellness treatments. A variety of sports activities are possible here. The Sommerfeld's rooms, apartments, and suites provide stylish furniture and views of the Ruppiner Land countryside. Free Wi-Fi is available in some rooms. Your rate includes a varied breakfast buffet. Health food, gourmet dishes, and international wines are served in the Sommerfeld's elegant restaurants.

276380.description: Located in Krausnick, 4. 6 miles from Tropical Islands, Landhotel Krausnick provides accommodations with a garden, free private parking, a shared lounge and a restaurant. Facilities include a playground and free WiFi is available. At the hotel, each room is equipped with a desk, a flat-screen TV, a private bathroom, bed linen and towels. Guest rooms include a closet. Guests at Landhotel Krausnick can enjoy a buffet breakfast. You can play table tennis at the accommodation, and the area is popular for hiking and cycling. Berlin Brandenburg Willy Brandt Airport is 34 miles away.

276390.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Make yourself at home in one of the 11 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and DVD players. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Rooms have private balconies. 40-inch LCD televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

276396.description: The 16 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Guests may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Hostal Fina.

276469.description: Indulge in a rejuvenating experience at our spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Maintain your fitness routine at our health club or with in-room fitness facilities. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge, and wedding services. Our restaurant offers convenient dining or take advantage of room service (limited hours). Unwind with a drink at our bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to noon (fee applies). For business needs, we provide a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event? Our hotel offers 969 sq ft (90 sq m) of conference and meeting space. Self-parking is available (charges apply). Relax in one of our 87 guest rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen TVs with satellite programming. Each room includes complimentary wired and wireless internet, designer toiletries, hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks. Located near C/O Berlin, Theatre of the West, and Kurfürstendamm, the Hotel am Steinplatz, Autograph Collection provides convenient access to Berlin's attractions, with Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER) just 30. 3 km (18. 8 mi) away.

276491.description: Located on the famous Kurfürstendamm shopping street, this elegant hotel is the perfect hub for a weekend getaway. With 47 rooms and suites from 45 to 117sqm, this boutique hotel from 1904 is located in the West Berlin district of Charlottenburg. Not only will it place its guests at just 100 m from the Adenauer Platz subway station, which can take them to any part of the capital within minutes, but it also offers a stylish spa. After a day of sightseeing or shopping its patrons can treat themselves to a calming massage or visit the beauty parlour for some pampering before the exciting evening. There is an indoor pool for anyone who enjoys swimming or just wants to refresh and a modern fitness centre for an invigorating workout. The spacious suites are equipped with full kitchens and come with generous sitting area where guests can stretch-out. On the ground floor of Louisa's Place you will find the ‘Bocca di Lupo’, an authentic Italian restaurant offering delicious Mediterranean cuisine with fresh fish, high-quality steaks, homemade pasta as well as fine wines and grappa in a cosy atmosphere and with a view of the Ku'damm. In the Vesper Bar, guests can experience a real James Bond feeling. In summer, the outdoor seating with a view of the hustle and bustle on Kurfürstendamm invites you to linger.

276502.description: In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Dream Studios provides 24-hour reception. Some services of Dream Studios may be payable.

276506.description: This centrally located city hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Several subway stations surround the hotel, providing quick and easy access to the city's main attractions, including the Kurfürstendamm shopping street and the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church. Public parking and an on-site underground garage are available. The hotel's central location, close to numerous bars and restaurants, makes it a perfect choice for weekend getaways. Potsdamer Platz and the Sony Center Berlin are just 2 km away. Each of our classic or modern rooms offers comfort and a home-away-from-home feeling. Available in various categories and sizes, we accommodate everyone from single travelers to families. All rooms feature a large double bed, a flat-screen TV, a seating area, ample lighting, and a private bathroom. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the building. Our friendly staff at the 24-hour reception desk is always ready to assist you. Start your day with our varied breakfast buffet and enjoy a carefree stay in the capital.

276620.description: This hotel is ideally located on the popular Lavelle pedestrian street, in the bustling downtown area of Buenos Aires. The hotel is located close to a number of shopping areas in this energetic city. Guests will find themselves just a short walking distance away from Florida Street and Corrientes Avenue. A wide range of entertainment and dining opportunities can be found nearby. The hotel enjoys an attractive architectural design. The guest rooms are superbly designed, offering comfort and style. Guests are sure to be impressed by the delightful breakfast served in the mornings, which offers a great start to the day.

276641.description: The accomodation consists of 48 accomodation units. There is no 24-hour reception.

276649.description: Enjoy modern comforts at Hotel Hansablick Berlin, located in Berlin's Mitte district, a short drive from the renowned Zoo Berlin and Kurfürstendamm. This hotel offers 35 individually decorated guestrooms featuring minibars, flat-screen televisions, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Guests can take advantage of amenities including a 24-hour health club, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an on-site bar/lounge serving a buffet breakfast daily. Nearby attractions include Tiergarten Park, the Victory Column, and Bellevue Palace. Self-parking is available (subject to charges).

276670.description:
Offering a dramatic hilltop setting next to Montserrat Monastery, Apartamentos Montserrat Abat Marcet features well-equipped studios and apartments. They overlook the surrounding Muntanya de Montserrat National Park.
Each apartment and studio at Apartamentos Montserrat Abat Marcet has simple, bright décor and heating. The seating area includes a TV, and the kitchenette has a microwave, fridge, oven and gas hob.
Montserrat Abat's à la carte restaurant offers traditional Catalan dishes. Set in Plaça Abat Oliba Square, the property has easy access to the monastery's shops and cafés.

276736.description: Beachfront Location: Gut Gnewikow in Gnewikow offers direct beachfront access, a sun terrace, and a lush garden. Guests enjoy free WiFi throughout the property. Comfortable Accommodations: Rooms feature private bathrooms, hypoallergenic bedding, and modern amenities such as TV and work desks. Family rooms and sofa beds cater to all needs. Leisure Facilities: The hotel provides a lounge, outdoor fireplace, and outdoor seating areas. Additional facilities include a children’s playground, picnic area, and bicycle parking. Nearby Attractions: Sachsenhausen Memorial and Museum is 40 km away, and Berlin Brandenburg Airport is 114 km from the property. Hiking and cycling activities are available nearby.

276844.description: The 3 star superior martas Hotel Albrechtshof is waiting for you. The hotel was founded as a hospice in 1910 thanks to wealthy friends of the Berlin City Mission. Since 1913 it exists in its original size. Quiet down, reminisce about your eventful sightseeing tour, feel at home - here you will find the personal atmosphere and hospitality you need. We designed our rooms in a modern and tasteful style. Warm colours, high quality furniture and comfortable suites invite you to remain a little longer. In one of our 99 hotel rooms you will find the relaxation you are looking for after an eventful day in Berlin. Our restaurant will treat you to a creative and healthy cuisine. For all guest arriving by car our private hotel parking for 20 cars is at your disposal.

276845.description: This budget-friendly hotel is located in downtown Bogota, just 600 meters from the Corferias Convention Centre. With simply decorated yet comfortable rooms, it's a great choice for visitors to the area around Colombia National University, a 20-minute walk away. All units feature solid wood furniture and ensuite bathrooms. Guests can enjoy a continental breakfast with freshly baked pastries, fruit juices, and plenty of strong Colombian coffee for a perfect start to the day. The on-site coffee shop offers refreshing beverages throughout the day, and hotel-wide Wi-Fi access is available for guests to check their email.

Finish the day in style at the bars and restaurants of Broad Street and Brindley Place. Then return to our tasty on-site restaurant, friendly service and super -comfy kingsize Hypnos beds. There are many shopping boutiques, galleries cafés, bars and restaurants near easyHotel Berlin Hackescher Markt. The UNESCO Museum Island is a 10-minute walk away. 277081.description: Located in Bogota's commercial center, this hotel is just 300 meters from Corferias and a short drive from the Botanical Gardens and the National University of Colombia. Each room features parquet flooring and amenities for a pleasant stay. Guests can enjoy a full buffet breakfast with Colombian coffee. 277120.description: Located within 100 metre(s) from the town centre, the establishment allows easy access to all this destination has to offer. 277121.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Schloss Herrenstein, a beach hotel in Gerswalde, Germany, just a short drive from Barfuß-Erlebnispark and Badestelle Sabinensee. Take a dip in the indoor pool, unwind in the sauna, or explore the area on rented bicycles. The hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, an arcade/game room, and tour/ticket assistance. Each of the 54 guestrooms features cable TV, a safe, a desk, and a bathroom with a bathtub or shower and hairdryer. Free self-parking is available.

277145.description: Located near Brussels' elegant Avenue Louise, Hotel Capital offers modern, compact rooms, some overlooking a charming garden. 277432.description: Built in 1903, this family-run hotel retains many of its original Edwardian features. Established in 1986, the proprietor prioritizes accommodating each guest's individual needs. Evening meals, packed lunches, and special dietary accommodations (including coeliac-aware options) are available upon request. The hotel boasts soft, white towels and is conveniently located just one mile from central Solihull, with golf courses and restaurants nearby.

277438.description: Located directly on the banks of the picturesque Lake Mellensee, this hotel offers a large conservatory restaurant and boat rentals. A daily buffet breakfast and rooms with satellite TV are offered. Morada Hotel Am Mellensee offers bright rooms with a private bathroom and hairdryer. Most of the rooms also have a balcony with views of the lake. À la carte regional meals can be enjoyed in the restaurant or outside on the sunny lakeside terrace. Popular activities in the area include hiking, cycling and fishing. It is 12 mi to the Johannismühle Nature Park, while Berlin is approximately 30 minutes’ drive away. 277481.description: This 3-star East Side Hotel boasts funky charm, a prime location, and fabulous views of one of the last remaining stretches of the Berlin Wall. Guests enjoy unparalleled access to the East Side Gallery (open-air Berlin Wall museum) and unforgettable sunsets over the Oberbaumbrücke. Located in Berlin's vibrant Friedrichshain district, steps from the Ostbahnhof S-Bahn station, the hotel offers cozy rooms with en suite bathrooms, comfortable beds, and free Wi-Fi. A complimentary breakfast buffet ensures an energetic start to each day, while in the evenings, the hotel restaurant serves delicious international cuisine. Guests can also enjoy the bar/lounge and 24-hour room service. Please note that the local city tax is not included in the rate and is payable at check-in.

277601.description: Situated in Recoleta, near Patio Bullrich, this hotel offers comfort and stylish design for both business and leisure travelers. Its prime location provides easy access to shops, restaurants, and entertainment, making it an ideal choice for exploring the city. Rooms decorated in warm tones blend minimalist style with luxurious touches, offering relaxing amenities perfect for unwinding after work or sightseeing.

name.content: Premier Inn Birmingham - Great Barr/M6 J7

277606.description: Our great-value Premier Inn Birmingham (Great Barr/M6 J7) hotel on Birmingham Road is a great base for exploring local Black Country attractions. Victoria Square in Birmingham City Centre is about a 20-minute drive away, and if you follow the Birmingham City Centre Walk, you’ll reach the iconic Town Hall – architecture fans will love the Corinthian columns of this Grade I listed building! It's also a popular event venue and the city's main Symphony Hall, if you're in the mood for some live classical music. Culture lovers won’t want to miss visiting the Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery – just a 15-minute drive from our Premier Inn Birmingham (Great Barr/M6 J7) hotel – while families will love exploring the Black Country Living Museum. Football fans can watch live games at nearby Villa Park, home of Aston Villa, or why not stretch your legs around scenic Walsall Arboretum? If you’re planning on using public transport throughout your stay, then you’ll love having main stations like Tame Bridge Parkway and Birmingham New Street nearby. After enjoying a cosy night’s sleep on one of our super-comfy beds, get your days out in Birmingham off to a great start with a hearty Premier Inn breakfast.

277678.description: The 25hours Hotel Bikini Berlin is as diverse as the big city itself. Located in the City West, it is as wild as a jungle. The hotel showcases cosmopolitan Berlin in the listed Bikini Haus building between the Berlin Zoo and Breitscheidplatz. Designer Wer ner Aisslinger and his team created a hotel world playing with the contrasts of nature and culture. Thanks to the NENI restaurant and the Monkey Bar on the top floor with 360 degrees rooftop terrace, the hotel is popular not only among its own guests.

The bright rooms of berlincity all include a seating area and parquet floor. Breakfast and evening buffets are served in berlincity's large dining room. Guests can enjoy a drink at the bar and listen to music. Guests can hire books and DVDs and relax in the cosy first-floor lounge. The Jugendhotel also offers table football and a pool/billiard table. Jugendhotel Schöneberg is a 3-minute walk from Kleistpark Underground Station, Julius-Leber-Brücke S-Bahn station and the Hauptstraße shopping street. There are direct buses to Potsdamer Platz, Berlin Main Station, Alexanderplatz and the Schlossstraße shopping district in Berlin-Steglitz.
