277849.description: The total number of units is 144. The accomodation offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The reception does not work around the clock. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

277852.description: This 3-star hotel in Berlin's northern Pankow district enjoys easy access to the A114 motorway and city center. The Alexanderplatz square is a 15-minute drive away. The Businesshotel Berlin offers comfortable rooms with attached bathroom with large desks and satellite TV. Free Wi-Fi internet access is available in all the rooms and in the lobby. A rich breakfast buffet can be booked. After a full day, guests can relax with a drink in the lobby bar or lounge. The Businesshotel Berlin offers guests a secure underground garage for an extra fee.

277859.description: Just 150 metres from Spittelmarkt Underground Station, this non-smoking, design hotel in the Mitte district of Berlin offers air-conditioned rooms, a 24-hour bar, underground parking and free Wi-Fi. The rooms at the Motel One Berlin-Spittelmarkt all include a flat-screen TV. The bathrooms feature a rain shower and stylish mosaics. Free Wi-Fi is provided in the Motel One Spittelmarkt’s 24-hour One Lounge. Varied breakfast buffets are also available here. Gendarmenmarkt Square and the Friedrichstraße shopping street are an 8-minute walk from the Spittelmarkt Motel One. Trains run from Spittelmarkt Underground Station to Alexanderplatz Square and Potsdamer Platz Square in just 5 minutes.

277870.description: The Garner Hotel Berlin - Mitte welcomes you to the German capital. Visit us for a private or business stay or travel together with family, friends and colleagues for a group event. Our city hotel, located directly at Checkpoint Charlie in the popular district Berlin-Mitte, offers you everything you need for a successful stay. A total of 145 comfortable and spacious rooms as well as 25 apartments with their own kitchenette for self-catering are available. All guest rooms are equipped with flat-screen TV, refrigerator, air conditioning and soundproof windows that can be opened. If you are traveling with children, we are happy to provide a baby or extra bed. Perfect for staying in touch with colleagues and loved ones at home at any time: High-speed WiFi is free of charge for our guests. If you would like to start the day relaxed and enjoy comprehensive hotel comfort in the morning, we recommend our rich breakfast buffet. In our lobby bar all signs point to enjoyment: here we serve you delicious drinks, such as freshly tapped beer, fine wines and inventive cocktails. Would you like to organize a group event at Garner Hotel Berlin - Mitte? Gladly - just get in touch with us! Our multilingual reception staff is available 24 hours a day.

277883.description: A total of 20 accomodation units are available for guests' convenience. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception.

277901.description: When you stay at Gasthof Bergquelle in Wandlitz, you'll be 8 minutes by car from Schorfheide-Chorin Biosphere. This hotel is 26. 1 mi (42 km) from Alexanderplatz and 26. 7 mi (42. 9 km) from DDR Museum. The front desk is staffed during limited hours. Free self parking is available onsite. Full breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 16 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms with showers are provided. Conveniences include desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

277903.description: Pamper yourself at the full-service spa at Hotel Gasthof Gose in Rochau, just a 13-minute drive from the Winckelmann Museum. Enjoy recreational amenities such as a health club, sauna, and bicycle rentals. The hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and barbecue grills. An area shuttle (surcharge) operates within 30 kilometers, providing easy access to nearby attractions. Dine at the on-site restaurant or enjoy room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. The hotel also has two meeting rooms available for events and offers free self-parking. Each of the 21 guestrooms features a flat-screen television and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily.

278032.description: Located in the district of Charlottenburg, this hotel is a 20-minute walk from the famous Charlottenburg Palace. It offers free WiFi, a garden and good transport connections across Berlin. A buffet breakfast is served at the Queens Park Hotel every morning. A variety of restaurants are within a 10-minute walk. The Queens Park Hotel was renovated in April 2015, and all rooms feature a private bathroom with shower. The hotel is located in a historical building with a classic façade, and the Comfort rooms are in an annex. Queens Park is 1640 feet from Kaiserdamm U-Bahnhof (Underground Station), offering connections to Zoologischer Garten and Kurfürstendamm shopping boulevard. The Olympic Stadium is a 30-minute walk away. The International Congress Center (ICC) and Tegel Airport can be reached in 15 minutes on public transport.

278051.description: Hi, it's Jill!Discover the Jill Hotel Brussels, a completely renovated haven of peace nestled in the heart of Brussels. With its 55 rooms, double-height lobby, bar, picturesque garden and gym, the Jill is much more than just a hotel. Immerse yourself in a modern and elegant atmosphere with our boutique lifestyle hotel, offering a unique and unforgettable experience to both business and leisure travellers looking for authenticity in the city. At Jill, our priority is to provide you with excellent service. Our dedicated team focuses on hospitality, comfort and quality. With an in-depth knowledge of Brussels and its surroundings, our team is here to guide you through the iconic monuments, professional conventions and local history. With its ideal location, friendly service and comfortable rooms, the Jill Brussels has everything you need to make your stay unforgettable.

278059.description: Bosch features a total of 21 units.

278096.description: Featuring an extensive beauty and wellness area, this 4-star hotel offers cozy rooms and delicious cuisine in the village of Fredersdorf, just 12 mi east of central Berlin. Here at the family-run Hotel Flora, you can relax in peaceful, rooms with attached bathroom, and pamper yourself in the BIOMARIS wellness area which offers thalassotherapy, facials, body scrubs and anti-aging treatments. Alternatively, explore the Brandenburg countryside on one of the hotel’s rental bicycles, enjoy the bowling alley, or simply unwind in the sunbathing area. The A10 motorway’s Hellersdorf exit is 2. 5 mi from your doorstep, while the Fredersdorf S-Bahn (city rail) station is just 0. 6 mi away. It takes you to Berlin’s famous Alexanderplatz square in about 40 minutes. The Hotel Flora’s restaurant will spoil you with freshly prepared Brandenburg specialties and international delights. You can also look forward to the hotel's beer garden, conservatory, and bar.

278187.description: A 10-minute walk from Berlin Central Station, directly opposite the Natural History Museum, this charming hotel offers an ideal location for exploring the city's attractions. After a day of sightseeing, relax in modern rooms equipped with private bathrooms and walk-in rain showers. Upgraded rooms provide additional living space, and a multi-level suite is available, featuring a separate living area and multiple TVs. Guests can enjoy a nutritious breakfast each morning in the breakfast room and unwind in the evening with a delicious beverage at the hotel bar.

278202.description: Hotel Pension Intervarko is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Berlin. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, taxi service, express check-in/check-out, room service, family room are just some of the facilities on offer. Guestrooms are fitted with all the amenities you need for a good night's sleep. In some of the rooms, guests can find linens, internet access – wireless, non smoking rooms, heating, desk. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. A welcoming atmosphere and excellent service are what you can expect during your stay at Hotel Pension Intervarko.

278210.description: Situated in the historic centre of Brussels, Hotel Alma is 5 minutes walk away from the Gare Centrale and public transport (tram, bus, metro). This makes it very easy for you to get to the heart of the European quarter or to the Atomium. Just leave Hotel Alma to find your happiness, whatever it may be: a nice little café or a Michelin starred restaurant, trendy bars and old bistros, Belgian beers, exhibitions, stately homes and quarters. Even if you're on a tight schedule, you'll have time to see all the sights that can't be missed: our Grand Place, so beautiful it will take your breath away (200m away), Manneken Pis (500m), Brussels most international 'Kets' and the superb Galeries Royales Saint-Hubert (500m away). Just a few steps away there is also the museum quarter and the Sablon, a square full of trendy bars, exclusive boutiques and experts in everything from chocolate to antiques.

278272.description: Indulge in massages, body treatments, and facials at this colonial hotel. Practice your swing on the golf course and cool off in one of the two outdoor swimming pools. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. A shuttle service is available within a 50-kilometer radius (surcharge). Savor Argentinean cuisine at Vicente, featuring a bar/lounge and garden views, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Mingle with other guests at the daily complimentary reception, or relax with a drink at the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM. The hotel offers complimentary wired internet access, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Roundtrip airport and cruise ship terminal shuttles are available for a surcharge. The 16 individually decorated guestrooms feature minibars, Smart TVs, pillowtop beds with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets, and private balconies. Each room also includes complimentary wired and wireless internet access and cable programming. Bathrooms offer shower/tub combinations with deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Nearby attractions include the Municipal of Ezeiza Plaza (18. 1 km), Campanopolis (29. 6 km), and the Autódromo de Buenos Aires Juan y Oscar Gálvez (42. 9 km). The nearest airport is Ministro Pistarini International Airport (EZE), 33. 9 km away.

278386.description: There are a total of 41 rooms on the premises. All guests staying at this property may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at O'Rei. This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception. Some services may be payable.

278397.description: The Myer's Hotel invites you to experience the charm of a beautifully restored 19th-century townhouse in Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg district. Inspired by the flair of the late 1800s, this neoclassical building, originally designed by a follower of the renowned architect Carl Frederick Schinkel, seamlessly blends historic elegance with modern amenities such as air conditioning and Wi-Fi. Each room is uniquely appointed with handcrafted replica furniture from the period, offering a personalized experience distinct from standardized hotel chains. Ideally situated on a quiet side street near Alexanderplatz and Museum Island, the hotel is also within walking distance of various restaurants, shops, and the vibrant Kollwitzplatz. Guests can unwind in the romantic basement-level spa featuring dry and steam saunas and an infrared lamp cabin, or enjoy the tranquility of the backyard garden in the summer. The hotel also showcases rotating art exhibitions in the winter garden and functional rooms, occasionally hosting other cultural events. For those seeking fitness facilities, a discounted access card to the nearby John Reed Fitness Club (with state of the art equipment) is available at reception. The Myer's Hotel team looks forward to welcoming you.

278486.description: The Lyon Hotel is located in the center of Buenos Aires, a few blocks from the Obelisco. The surrounding area, known as the “Broadway of Buenos Aires, ” is a vibrant cultural hub with milongas, tango schools, theaters, and cafes. This excellent location provides easy access to major tourist attractions, including Recoleta, Plaza de Mayo, Casa Rosada, Congreso, and Puerto Madero. The subway, just two blocks away, offers convenient and affordable transportation throughout the city. The hotel features 75 rooms equipped with air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, cable TV, hair dryers, safety deposit boxes, and telephones.

278497.description: Located in the heart of Vic, Hotel J. Balmes places you just a short drive from Vic Cathedral and the Episcopal Museum. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a TV in the common area. The 50 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, and desks. Guests can enjoy the onsite coffee shop/cafe and bar/lounge, and buffet breakfasts are available on weekdays. Additional amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and motorcycle parking. Nearby attractions include the Magic mon del Tren and El Ter Industrial Museum.

278514.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this property. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. Hostemplo offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night.

278555.description: Stay at the centrally located Saint Gery Boutique Hotel in Brussels, a short walk from Grand Place and Manneken Pis. Enjoy international cuisine at the Dandy Bar & Kitchen, relax on the terrace, and utilize amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi. The 24 individually decorated guestrooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs, and private bathrooms. Buffet breakfast is available (fee applies).

278619.description: This luxury hotel is located in Paradyskloof residential area, a short distance from the historic town of Stellenbosch. Local shops and cafes are close by in the city centre, and the golf course is just 3 Km away. The area boasts numerous vineyards and award winning restaurants. Hotel facilities include free parking, free Wi-Fi, an outdoor semi-private pool, an indoor heated pool, garden, terrace, solarium and a spa with a hydrotherapy pool, hot tub, steam room and sauna. Business travellers have access to a centre with fax and copying services. A boardroom can be hired at a cost. The restaurant offers local specialties some of which are made with home-grown ingredients. Beautiful modern rooms have a variety of settings with a choice of garden, pool or mountain views. Each room comes with air-conditioning, satellite television, electronic safe, mini bar,  Lavazza coffee machine & balcony.

278648.description: When you stay at Amzee Bokmakierie Guest House in Mossel Bay, you'll be near the beach and 9 minutes by car from Pinnacle Point Beach and Golf Resort. This 4-star guesthouse is 21. 9 mi (35. 2 km) from Gondwana Game Reserve and 5. 3 mi (8. 6 km) from Diaz Beach. Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this guesthouse include complimentary wireless Internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and barbecue grills. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite. A complimentary continental breakfast is included. Make yourself at home in one of the 10 guestrooms featuring microwaves. Rooms have private balconies or patios. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

278710.description: This comfortable Hotel is Nestled in the foothills of the Franschhoek Mountains, Val d'Or Estate is surrounded by lush gardens and vineyards. Featuring elegant guestrooms and a pool terrace, it is 5 km from Franschhoek's town centre. Offering panoramic mountain and garden views, each room at the Val d'Or is decorated with traditional wooden furniture and fine coloured fabrics. All of them have a satellite TV, while most of the bathrooms have bath and shower. Guests can sip a cocktail at the bar overlooking vineyards and mountains, or book one of the different massages available in the property. Activities in the area include golf, trout fishing and horse riding. Paarl and Stellenbosch are less than 30 minutes' drive from the property, offering larger shopping malls and other attractions. Cape Town International Airport is 74 km away.

278773.description: Centrally located within 1 km of Somerset West village, Albourne Boutique Guesthouse offers a fabulous base for exploring cultural, historical, and leisure activities. Enjoy golf at the renowned Erinvale Golf Club, just 2 km away, or wine tasting at the historic Lourensford or Vergelegen Wine Estates, both also only 2 km away. The nearby beaches of Strand and Gordon's Bay, 12 km away, offer swimming and golden sands, while the historic village of Stellenbosch, also 12 km away, provides a glimpse into the past with its selection of markets and wine estates.

278787.description: Stop at Hill Top Guesthouse to discover the wonders of Cape Town. The hotel offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, facilities for disabled guests, Wi-Fi in public areas, car park, room service are on the list of things guests can enjoy. Guestrooms are fitted with all the amenities you need for a good night's sleep. In some of the rooms, guests can find linens, mirror, towels, internet access – wireless, non smoking rooms. Entertain the hotel's recreational facilities, including golf course (within 3 km), outdoor pool, garden. Hill Top Guesthouse is an excellent choice from which to explore Cape Town or to simply relax and rejuvenate.

278798.description:
With a stay at Marianne Wine Estate in Stellenbosch, you'll be within a 15-minute drive of Stellenbosch University and Warwick Wine Estate.  This 4-star country house is 3 mi (4.8 km) from Butterfly World Tropical Garden and 6.4 mi (10.4 km) from Backsberg Estate Cellars.
Dip into one of the 3 outdoor swimming pools or enjoy other recreational amenities, which include an attached winery. This country house also features complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands.
Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. Free self parking is available onsite.
You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Marianne Wine Estate, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8 AM to 10 AM.
Make yourself at home in one of the 16 guestrooms featuring refrigerators. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include safes and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily.

278851.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages and body treatments. Additional features at this guesthouse include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and barbecue grills. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the guesthouse's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Featured amenities include express check-in, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 10 guestrooms, featuring heated floors and LED televisions. Satellite programming and DVD players are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

278852.description: Escape the everyday hustle and bustle at this peaceful and tranquil property. Guests at Derwent House can enjoy convenient Wi-Fi access in public areas. A 24-hour reception ensures all your needs are met, day or night. Committed to sustainability, this hotel follows environmentally friendly practices.

278857.description: Everyone staying at this accommodation will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Lemoenfontein Game Lodge as it counts with a total of 12 units. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. Lemoenfontein Game Lodge has wheelchair-accessible common areas. Travellers arriving by car will appreciate parking available at Lemoenfontein Game Lodge. Additional fees may apply for some services.

278870.description: The hotel consists of 16 guest rooms. Those staying at this property may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. Neptune Hotel does not offer 24-hour reception.

name.content: Road Lodge Cape Town International Airport

278883.description: The 90-room Road Lodge Cape Town International Airport is ideally located for those needing convenient and comfortable accommodation close to this busy airport and vibrant Mother City, famous for its mountains, winelands, beaches and much more. Rooms feature a work desk, TV and free WiFi, 24-hour reception is offered, and a light breakfast is available. As with all of the group's properties in Cape Town, the hotel features a variety of water-saving devices and systems following the severe drought of 2018, allowing guests a comfortable yet responsible stay. This may affect bathing and swimming.

278889.address: 7 Bob Bouwer Crescent, Bayview, Mossel Bay
278889.description: Experience the essence of "African Oceans". From stylishly appointed rooms, awaken to an uninterrupted view of the azure ocean, the misty Outeniqua mountains and the the sound of waves rolling over sandy-coloured beaches. Luxurious rooms with mini bar, satellite TV, CD/DVD player, air-conditioners and private balconies/patios set the scene for a memorable stay. Direct access to the beach. The exceptional treatment, unique and thoughtful touches, attention to detail, the luxury and the opulent comfort all add to the exciting possibility of returning again and again. Breakfast is served in the sun-splashed dining room. Option of self catering. Relax at the pool, soak up the sun, swim in the sea or stroll along the golden beach. Perfect honeymoon and golf destination.

278900.description: Clients may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. The hotel provides 24-hour reception. The premises offer accessible public areas. Visitors staying at this hotel can take advantage of the property's wellness facilities available. Corporate travellers may avail for event rooms, ideal to host a business seminar or a special occasion. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

name.content: The Owner?s Cottage at Grande Provence

278909.description:
Located in Franschhoek, Owner's Cottage at Grande Provence is in the mountains, within a 5-minute drive of Franschhoek Art House and Dutch Reformed Church.  This 5-star guesthouse is 1.3 mi (2.2 km) from Cape Floral Region Protected Areas and 1.4 mi (2.3 km) from Franschhoek Town Hall.
Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including an attached winery, an outdoor pool, and a spa tub. Additional amenities at this guesthouse include complimentary wireless Internet access and a picnic area.
The front desk is staffed during limited hours. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite.
At Owner's Cottage at Grande Provence, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant.
Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 5 guestrooms, featuring heated floors and flat-screen televisions. Kitchenettes are outfitted with espresso makers. Satellite programming and DVD players are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads.

278933.description: Colonial elegance, modern convenienceThe Queen's Hotel is an oasis of colonial elegance and wired modern convenience in the heart of Oudtshoorn – the capital of the beautiful semi-arid Klein Karoo. Finished in 1880, this grand dame of South African hoteliery has recently been restored to her full original beauty and continues to offer sumptuous accommodation, service and dining that is reminiscent of a bygone era but driven by dynamic modern hotel management. The Queen's can accommodate 82 people in our 40 non-smoking rooms, all with WiFi, individually remote-controlled air-conditioning, satellite TV, direct dial telephone, clock radio, work desk, safe, coffee/tea facilities, communal lounge area and bathrooms with overhead/separate shower & bath, towels, toiletries & luxury linen. Café Brûlé and the Colony Restaurant is situated on the hotel premises.

278935.description: New President Zamale features a total of 20 units. Those staying at this property may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. The reception is open 24/7.

278967.description: Travellers will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay on the premises, as it counts with a total of 11accomodation units. Oude Wellington Wine Estate offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception.

279027.description: This hotel offers a variety of rooms, including singles, doubles, triples, quadruples, family rooms, suites, and superior rooms. Guests can enjoy amenities such as currency exchange, a cloakroom, a garden, and a terrace. Internet access, room service, laundry service, medical service, bicycle storage, on-site parking, babysitting, car hire, and airport transfers are also available. Secure parking provides added peace of mind.

279062.description: The premises count with 18 welcoming rooms. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. The reception is open 24/7. Arabian Nights may charge a fee for some services.

279144.description: This exceptional Victorian-style country hotel is nestled in the picturesque town of Swellendam, South Africa, 204km from Cape Town International Airport. Set within lush gardens and the marvellous scenery of the fourth oldest town in South Africa, this luxurious property offers delightfully designed rooms ranging from magnificent luxury rooms to family rooms and an exceptional honeymoon suite. The rooms are delightfully appointed, featuring soothing tones, antique furniture and fireplaces. They are well-equipped with modern amenities, TV, mini bar and elegant toiletries. Visitors will relish the opportunity to savour delectable dishes in the light & airy Conservatory. Nature lovers & adventurous mountain bikers may take advantage of the nearby nature reserves, the more hedonistic are able to visit delightful eateries and delicious wine estates.

279214.description:
There are a total of 9 rooms on the premises. The Hotel provides 9 spacious double rooms. 
This popular hotel offers the perfect stay for business and leisure travellers alike. 
The Hotel safe provides a secure place for guests to store valuable items. Guests can relax in the beautiful garden. 
The Hotel offers a terrace for guest enjoyment. The Hotel has mobile phone coverage. The establishment is wheelchair-accessible. The on-site car park may be useful to those arriving by car.

Should You arrive and due to any circumstances hotel office is closed at that stage, please look right next to the front door for the green mailbox. Your keys will be in plastic folders with all the information you might require during your stay. Please note they are a working farm and do not have 24-hour reception and staff available. We have on-site patrolling security from 19:00 in the evening until 07:00 in the morning. The eatery on the premises only caters for breakfast and lunch. In your welcome packet you will receive the menu of our local and highly recommended boutique hotel. Please make a booking with them for dinner.

279238.description: Located in Gardens, Four Rosmead Boutique Hotel is a perfect starting point from which to explore Cape Town. The hotel offers a wide range of amenities and perks to ensure you have a great time. All the necessary facilities, including free Wi-Fi in all rooms, Wi-Fi in public areas, car park, room service, airport transfer, are at hand. Comfortable guestrooms ensure a good night's sleep with some rooms featuring facilities such as television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless (complimentary), non smoking rooms, air conditioning, heating. Access to the hotel's outdoor pool, garden will further enhance your satisfying stay. Four Rosmead Boutique Hotel is an excellent choice from which to explore Cape Town or to simply relax and rejuvenate.

279249.description: Stop at Cape Riviera Guesthouse to discover the wonders of Cape Town. The hotel offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. All the necessary facilities, including free Wi-Fi in all rooms, Wi-Fi in public areas, car park, airport transfer, family room, are at hand. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like internet access – wireless, non smoking rooms, air conditioning, desk, mini bar. Enjoy the hotel's recreational facilities, including outdoor pool, garden, before retiring to your room for a well-deserved rest. Discover all Cape Town has to offer by making Cape Riviera Guesthouse your base.

279269.description: Located in Bloubergstrand in the Western Cape, Eden on the Bay Luxury Apartments offers self-catering accommodations with free WiFi and private parking. Guests can enjoy proximity to Blouberg Beach and Seaside Village Shopping Centre. Please inform the property management company of your expected arrival time in advance. Surcharges apply for arrivals after 18:00 (R150), 20:00 (R250), 22:00 (R350), and 00:00 (R450), subject to confirmation. Hen, stag, and similar parties are not permitted. Photo identification and a credit card are required upon check-in.

279300.description: Roosenwijn Guest House is a popular choice amongst travelers in Stellenbosch, whether exploring or just passing through. The hotel offers a wide range of amenities and perks to ensure you have a great time. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, fireplace, luggage storage are on the list of things guests can enjoy. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like internet access – wireless, internet access – wireless (complimentary), non smoking rooms, air conditioning, heating. To enhance guests' stay, the hotel offers recreational facilities such as golf course (within 3 km), outdoor pool, garden. Convenience and comfort makes Roosenwijn Guest House the perfect choice for your stay in Stellenbosch.

279319.description: With amazing views of the Atlantic Ocean and in front of the Robben Island, this upscale hotel is nestled on the slopes of the Lion's Head Mountain and is marvellously positioned on a quiet, residential area and just fifteen minutes by car from Cape Town's city centre. Visitors can easily access the V&A Waterfront with plenty of dining and entertainment options or go to the nearby Clifton and Camp's Bay sandy beaches. This magnificent establishment boasts a main building with beautiful bedrooms and suites and two separate villas, fully-fitted with superior amenities. The classic rooms offer, among other commodities, heated floors and a glamorous floor-to-ceiling mirror. Guests can find everything they need at this sumptuous accommodation, ranging from a well-appointed spa, a solar-heated pool, a complete library and a guest pantry, providing them with snacks and drinks all day long.

279335.description: Located a comfortable walk from the town center and numerous attractions, this 11-room hotel offers a tranquil escape. Guests can easily access public transport links, and the airport is 196 km away. The hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi in common areas and a 24-hour reception. Functional meeting facilities make it ideal for business travelers. Some services may incur additional fees.

name.content: African Pride Mosselberg on Grotto Beach

279342.description: With a small number of only 5, this hotel is very convenient for a quiet stay. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. African Pride Mosselberg on Grotto Beach does not operate a 24-hour reception. Those who wish to disconnect from daily routine may make use of the property's health and wellness facilities. The varied entertainment offer at African Pride Mosselberg on Grotto Beach guarantees its guests will enjoy their stay. There is a full programme of organised activities ideal for sports enthusiasts and for those wishing to enjoy an active stay. Some services may be payable.

279385.description: Discover the wonders of Cape Town with a stay at the Wilton Manor Guest House. Enjoy comfortable accommodations equipped with amenities such as Wi-Fi in public areas, parking, room service, airport transfers, and family rooms. Select guestrooms feature LCD/plasma TVs, wireless internet, non-smoking options, air conditioning, and desks. Unwind after a long day with a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool. Wilton Manor Guest House offers a welcoming home base for your Cape Town adventures.

279438.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 13 individually decorated guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. In the heart of the Cape Winelands, where mountains cradle the valley and vines
stretch to the horizon, you’ll find Last Word Franschhoek—a tranquil retreat in
the country’s culinary capital. 
Our ten beautifully appointed rooms and suites blend classic Cape
style with contemporary luxury, offering spacious elegance, fine
linens, and serene comfort. Each suite opens onto private patios or
balconies that invite you to linger a little longer—morning coffee
in hand, fresh air in your lungs, and the village quietly humming
beyond. Step outside and you’re just moments away from world-
class restaurants, boutique wineries, and charming galleries. 
Franschhoek is a place made for wandering: cobbled streets lined
with cafés and art, laughter spilling from wine trams, the scent of
fresh bread and French flair at every turn. Back at the hotel, calm
replaces the bustle. Enjoy a glass of wine in the courtyard, take a
dip in the pool, or relax with one of our famous breakfasts before
planning your next adventure. Whether you’re here for romance, 
relaxation, or a touch of indulgence, you’ll find it here wrapped in
comfort and served with our signature warmth. Here, life is best
enjoyed slowly: fine food, lovely people, beautiful places. This is
Last Word Franschhoek.

284149.description: This historic Cape Dutch farm has been elegantly renovated and features a garden full of fresh produce used in the restaurant. Babylonstoren also contains a spa with a massage service and Turkish bath. Each of the air-conditioned apartments retains historic details, such as wooden farm doors, fireplaces and thick stone walls. They are also equipped with modern kitchens, designer bathrooms and cable TVs. Free WiFi is provided. A fresh breakfast is provided daily and guests can order a packed lunch to explore the area on a bike, borrowed for free from Babylonstoren. The property also offers tea rituals, available via reservation at a surcharge. There is an indoor pool as well as an outside pool featuring a sun terrace with views of the mountains. Babylonstoren offers free private parking and a shuttle services can be arranged at a surcharge upon request. Cape Town International Airport is 31 mi away.

284161.description: The 5-star Cape Diem Lodge offers comfort and convenience whether you're on business or holiday in Cape Town. 284196.description: A total of 43 accomodation units are available for guests' convenience at Hotel Riviera.

284217.description: This cozy hotel is situated along scenic Route 62 in the southwestern village of Barrydale, just a 2. 5-hour drive from Cape Town. Outdoor enthusiasts will find plenty of hiking and trekking routes. After a fun-filled day, take a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool, followed by a hearty meal at the onsite restaurant. End the day with a cognac or single malt whiskey at the hotel bar.

284274.description: Discover the wonders of Witsand with a stay at Whale Watchers Inn. Designed for comfort and convenience, this hotel offers a range of amenities including accessible facilities, Wi-Fi in public areas, parking, family rooms, and laundry service. Whale Watchers Inn combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance, promising an unforgettable Witsand experience.

284332.description: With a stay at Blue Horizon Guest House in Cape Town (Mountainside), you'll be a 5-minute walk from Cape Floral Region Protected Areas and within a 5-minute drive of Bikini Beach. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 6 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and minibars, and housekeeping is provided daily.

284372.description: Rothman Manor: A Boutique Escape. Nestled within a sprawling 3. 5-hectare estate, Rothman Manor is a sanctuary of affordable luxury that seamlessly blends vibrant African design with the elegance of Cape Dutch architecture. The property features three charming thatched houses, each steeped in history since 1834, offering a unique charm that transports guests to a world of timeless beauty. Unwind by the sparkling saltwater pool or indulge in the serenity of your private outdoor space, where you can soak in the peaceful surroundings. The property boasts a magnificent pond adorned with lotus flowers, attracting a diverse array of birdlife, perfect for nature enthusiasts. For those seeking a moment of indulgence, the jacuzzi offers a front-row seat to the enchanting sights of on-site game and the captivating natural landscape.

284447.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this property. 284558.description: Stop at Bluebottle Guest House to discover the wonders of Cape Town. The property features a wide range of facilities to make your stay a pleasant experience. 284568.description: Hlangana Lodge is one of South Africa's finest small luxury establishments and an ideal choice for your stay in picturesque Oudtshoorn. Located on the golden mile, en route to the Cango Caves and within walking distance of the town's best restaurants, this four-star boutique hotel is set on over a hectare of exotic gardens. Enjoy a refreshing dip in the saltwater swimming pool, a drink in the lounge, a workout in the gym, or simply relax in the lush gardens or sunbathe on your private terrace. A full buffet and champagne breakfast, served in the sunny breakfast lounge, provides the perfect start to a day of exploring Oudtshoorn's unique attractions, including world heritage sites. Hlangana Lodge has been recognized as one of the top 10 best small hotels in South Africa.

284598.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at POD Camps Bay, a beachside guesthouse in the heart of Cape Town's vibrant Camps Bay. 284636.description: Hawksmoor House is located on a 220- hectare working wine farm, Matjieskuil, near Stellenbosch in the Cape Winelands. A meticulously restored Cape Dutch country retreat, Hawksmoor offers Guest House accommodation in 15 en-suite rooms, beautifully and individually decorated. Country Style AccommodationHawksmoor House occupies a stunning location amidst vineyards with an expansive view from the verandah towards our beloved Table Mountain. Our sundowner patio offers spectacular sunset panoramas - perfect to gaze at while you savour a glass of our own range of Hawksmoor wines. The quiet and serene estate is a 25 minute drive away from the buzzing Cape Town centre. In addition to our guests, the farm is home to horses, cows, porcupines, hawks, pelicans and countless other wildlife. Hawksmoor House offers a totally unspoilt, unpolished and authentic country home experience for those who need some well-deserved rest. It's the perfect place to unwind. . Our friendly and cheerful staff stay discreetly in the background, providing you with the feeling that you have the entire place to yourself. Resident German Pointer dogs keep a watchful eye on the daily workings of the farm.

284699.description: This is an exclusive establishment, owner run, uniquely situated directly on the shores of the famous Knysna Lagoon. Attractions in the greater area include the famous Knysna Waterfront, Knysna's Featherbed Private Nature Reserve, Knysna Elephant Park. The luxuriously appointed Suites & Rooms offer spectacular views across this peaceful lagoon to the dramatic Knysna Heads or over the magnificent 3-acre gardens. Whether staying in the Manor House or the Courtyard, all the rooms and suites are well decorated with modern atmosphere and with all kinds of amenities for the comfort of customers. The magnificent gardens offer peaceful walks and canoes for those who wish to explore this fascinating eco-system on their own. The property policy is one of total exclusivity, privacy, security and dedication to personal service.

284926.description: Kanonkop House offers luxurious, relaxed, boutique accommodations in Knysna, perched on the edge of South Africa's largest forest alongside a vast tidal lagoon. Enjoy the tranquil setting within a private indigenous forest, yet only a 5-minute drive from the town center. The grounds feature a swimming pool, sundeck, outdoor lounge, terrace, and bar. A full breakfast, all bar drinks, internet access, safe parking, and friendly service are included. Owned and managed by the Conyers family, this elegant boutique hotel offers six suites. ' Inquire about villa accommodations to receive personalized recommendations.

285081.description: Hide Away Guest House located in Knysna the centre of the well-known Garden Route of South Africa. Hide Away is situated on the main road into Knysna, within a 20 minute walk of town, the Knysna Waterfront and Thesen Island which is growing in popularity with its many boutiques, art galleries and restaurants. Guests have the experience of some of the most amazing views of the Knysna Heads and Estuary from the Guest House. Sit and enjoy these views as you have breakfast on the verandah - weather permitting. With 7 well-appointed ensuite rooms, 5 of which face the Estuary, all equipped with every convenience a traveller might need. Your hosts, Cecil & Colleen Harding, will help you plan your time with them. There are numerous activities in and around the town with a number of great restaurants. Whether you like hiking, biking, interacting with elephants at the Knysna Elephant Park, or just chilling in a coffee shop, Knysna will not disappoint!Make Hide Away your base as you explore the Garden Route!

311946.description: This luxurious hotel boasts a prime setting in Horley. name.content: Canary Riverside Plaza London, Vignette Collection

312034.description:
Set against the historic quays and wharves of Canary Wharf, Canary Riverside Plaza London, Vignette Collection is a place with a story to tell. We offer a stay that feels personal, characterful and entirely your own. 

Each of our 141 rooms and suites is more than a place to rest – it is a calm riverside retreat, framed by sweeping views of the River Thames and the unmistakable London skyline. Whether you arrive for business or pleasure, every detail is considered to make you feel at home. 

Unwind in the adjoining Health Club & Spa, a tranquil sanctuary to restore body and mind. Or linger over vibrant Italian flavours at Quadrato, where the terrace and a celebrated afternoon tea invite you to slow down and savour the moment. 

In one of London's most spirited neighbourhoods, Canary Riverside Plaza London is your own quiet corner of the city – crafted with character, and waiting to be discovered.

name.content: 100 Queens Gate Hotel, Curio Collection by Hilton

312099.description: Boasting a prime location in the prestigious Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, 100 Queen's Gate Hotel London, Curio Collection by Hilton, is on the doorstep of iconic cultural attractions including the Royal Albert Hall, Natural History Museum, Science Museum, and Victoria & Albert Museum. Enjoy a leisurely stroll from our historic, Victorian-style hotel to Harrods, Notting Hill, Kensington Palace, Hyde Park and the designer boutiques of Knightsbridge. Following a multimillion-pound refurbishment, guest rooms and suites at our Kensington hotel exude elegance and feature complimentary WiFi, electronic newspapers, 49-inch flat-screen HDTVs with Chromecast, and bathroom amenities by Floris London. Unwind in a stylish Deluxe or Luxury bedroom with upgraded amenities and additional space. For a unique experience, select a two-level Duplex suite, boasting a top-floor location. Enjoy a workout in our state-of-the-art gymnasium or host a small meeting in one of two elegant boardrooms. Enjoy classic Italian cuisine at our signature restaurant Cento, or unwind with a late-night drink in our concept cocktail bar ESQ. For a traditional Botanical Afternoon Tea or pre-theater drinks in a sophisticated atrium setting, visit Botanica. 100 Queen's Gate Hotel London offers 24-hour room service so you can dine in the comfort of your room or suite, day or night.

314756.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at this Edwardian hotel, boasting a health club, indoor pool, and spa tub. Benefit from complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services. Athena Hotel provides clean, comfortable accommodation, professional service and a convenient Central London location for leisure, business and family stays.

314961.description: Perfect for a stay based in East London, Premier Inn London Barking gets you close to the key locations. 315094.description:
Number 2 Chesham Street a former family residence was built by English master builder Thomas Cubitt in 1882. A prestigious Victorian house listed by her Majesty's Government as a building of architectural distinctions. 

The 2 Chesham Hotel Belgravia is a beautifully well-preserved Victorian Grade II listed building with a great location in the heart of Belgravia one of the most exclusive areas of London With exquisitely decorated 26 en suite rooms, the hotel offers friendly and personal service. All rooms have telephones, TVs, tea/coffee making facilities, hairdryers and bathroom accessories. Stay on top of your business and entertainment needs with our free Wi-Fi connection, available in all rooms and on multiple devices. 

The hotel has a great convenient location in a quiet residential area, just 5 minutes walk from Belgravia Square and close to the green spaces of Hyde Park and Buckingham Palace Gardens. The upscale streets of Belgravia are defined by elegant townhouse residences, foreign embassies and the world famous museums such as National History museum, Science museum, Victoria & Albert Museum etc. Traditional pubs, fine-dining restaurants and independent shops can be found on the streets north of Buckingham Palace Road. Bordering Belgravia, Chelsea, Sloane Square and Knightsbridge attract the well-heeled for luxury shopping such as Harrods, Harvey Nichols, Dior, Bvlgari, Burberry etc. 

All that London has to offer is within easy reach and the hotel's great location means it offers good access to London's transport networks. London Victoria Station is 15 minutes walking distance away and Sloane Square and Knightsbridge London Underground Stations are even nearer.

315129.description: Located in the heart of central London, just a five-minute walk from Waterloo Station, the modern Hampton by Hilton London Waterloo offers guests a convenient base for exploring the city. 315151.description:
EXPERIENCE LONDON FROM ONE OF ITS MOST DISTINGUISHED ADDRESSES. 

At 54 Queen’s Gate, luxury is paired with the warmth and comfort of home—right in the heart of South Kensington, one of London’s most desirable postcodes. A short stroll from the peaceful edges of Hyde Park, this Grade II listed Edwardian townhouse has been beautifully transformed into an intimate boutique retreat where elegance, character, and relaxation come naturally. 

Offering more than a place to stay— it’s a luxurious home away from home. Expect attentive service, a calm boutique atmosphere, and the comfort of a space designed for both relaxation and exploration. Step outside and London’s finest attractions await: Hyde Park, Kensington Palace, the Natural History Museum, and the V&A are all within easy walking distance. The neighborhood’s stylish cafés, elegant bars, celebrated restaurants, and the world-class shopping of Knightsbridge—including the iconic Harrods—are right at your doorstep. 

Our 24 bedrooms offers a unique blend of comfort, style, and individuality. Arranged across four distinctive categories, every room is thoughtfully designed with décor inspired by some of Kensington’s most celebrated past residents. 

From Churchill to Coleridge, Eliot to Elgar, the rooms reflect the character and elegance of these iconic figures, creating spaces that are both sumptuous and wonderfully private. Perfect for discerning travelers, each room provides a tranquil retreat in the heart of West London. 

All rooms are equipped with modern conveniences to ensure a seamless stay, including en-suite showers, air-conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs with streaming services, a hairdryer, ironing station, coffee and tea-making facilities, complimentary bottled water, a minibar with soft drinks, and a secure laptop safe. Every detail is designed to make your stay effortless, relaxing, and memorable.

315189.description: Set in East Ham, in London, this hotel offers visitors a great setting in which to relax, or from which to explore the city. 315210.description: Located at the heart of London, this property boasts an unrivalled position, close to many of the city's prestigious attractions. It is just a 20 minutes' car journey away from central London and Heathrow Airport. The wide streets surrounding the hotel are dotted with cafes and restaurants. The guest rooms blend charm and convenience, offering the ideal setting in which to work and rest in comfort. The hotel provides a continental breakfast in the mornings, which is sure to impress.

315264.description: Located a short walk from Hyde Park in central London, the Elysee Hotel offers bright, modern rooms with private bathrooms and free Wi-Fi. All rooms at the Elysee Hotel feature flat-screen TVs, in-room safes, tea/coffee making facilities, hairdryers, and a working desk. Air conditioning is also provided for guest comfort. Couples have rated the hotel highly for its convenient location. Opposite the hotel, you'll find the famous Miter pub, along with numerous cafes, restaurants, and other amenities.

315265.description: Located in central Lisbon, next to Praça de Figueira, Norte features simple rooms with free Wi-Fi. It is less than 1 km from the River Tagus and 6 km from Lisbon Portela Airport. Some rooms have a private bathroom, while others have access to shared bathroom facilities with a private shower. Guests can relax in the common lounge with a TV and luggage storage is available. 315269.description: This property is located in London, in an art deco building on Sloane Avenue in the royal London borough of Kensington and Chelsea. The property consists of several types of accommodation units, ranging from double rooms, junior suites, suites, apartments and studios. The on-site car park may be useful to those arriving by car.

Each suite enables a total separation between living quarters and work area. Features include free Wi-Fi access and large flat-screen TVs. National and International rail stations such as Paddington, Euston, and King’s Cross and St Pancras are easily accessible via public transport.

Each room at The Franklin is air conditioned and is fitted with a flatscreen TV, a seating area, a signature bed with premium linens and a pillow menu. 315432.description: My Place Hotel, an elegant Victorian townhouse, is nestled on a quiet Kensington street, just a minute's walk from Earl's Court Underground Station with its direct Heathrow Airport link. Each comfortable room features an en suite bathroom, a fridge, and a flat-screen TV. Some also offer a separate seating area with a sofa. A spacious private function room overlooking the gardens is also available. This hotel offers a prime location for both business travelers and tourists exploring the English capital.

315632.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this establishment. Grenville House includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and bedrooms. Grenville House offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience.

315651.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. 315653.description: In the heart of Earl's Court, the Rushmore Hotel is an elegant Victorian town house with free Wi-Fi. Earl’s Court Underground Station is just 100 metres away. Just a 15-minute walk from the Natural History Museum, the Rushmore Hotel is half a mile from Kensington High Street. The Olympia Exhibition Centre is just a 15-minute walk away.

Family-owned and operated since 1972, it has long been a favorite of both leisure and business travelers, thanks to its tranquil setting and prime location. 315863.description: Situated in the exclusive Belgravia district of London, this property is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Victoria Station and the Gatwick Express. Many of the city's attractions can be found nearby, including the West End, with its shops and theatres. The Docklands and Olympic Park are within easy reach. The stunningly-designed guest rooms echo the eclectic mix of traditional and elegance styles, for which London is renowned. Guests are invited to dine in style in the mornings, with a hearty full English breakfast, for a great start to the day.

315918.description: Opened in 2011, the Russell Court Hotel remains a popular budget-friendly option. 315924.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 74 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

315926.description: This country house hotel is set amidst 34 acres in Crawley. The property is conveniently located just a 5 minutes' driving distance away from Gatwick Airport. The hotel features a bar, as well as a restaurant, catering for guests' dining needs.

315952.description: Located in the heart of London, the Garden Court Hotel offers convenient access to Kensington Gardens and Kensington Palace, both within a 15-minute walk. 315973.description:
The Leonard is recognised as one of London’s leading boutique hotels featuring quintessentially British designed rooms and suites. Conveniently located by Marble Arch, The Leonard Hotel and Apartments is just a few minutes’ walk from Hyde Park and situated in the heart of central London. 

After a day of shopping or exploring, unwind with a drink at our bar before dining at Seymour’s Restaurant, which serves modern British and Asian cuisine for breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, and dinner. We also offer 24-hour room service for all guests. 

A stay with us at The Leonard promises to offer a luxurious, yet traditional British experience – perfect for whatever your plans may be. 

Our central location is ideal for shopping, with Selfridges, Oxford Street, Bond Street, and Regent Street all within walking distance. If you’re looking to explore more boutique stores, we also recommend a visit to Marylebone High Street. Staying near Hyde Park allows easy access to the park’s tranquil spaces, boating on the Serpentine Lake, and various concerts such as BST Hyde Park, as well as Winter Wonderland – London’s most famous Winter attraction.

315975.description:
"Medieval castle or modern masterpiece? Our London Central Aldgate East hotel is a stone's throw from skyline icons the Shard and the Gherkin, and around the corner from from the Tower of London.

You'll be in the heart of London's East End, with Tower Bridge within walking distance and stylish Whitechapel and colourful Brick Lane close by. Or hop on a bus for the shops and attractions of the rest of London.

All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals.

Useful information

Due to the close proximity of this hotel to the Tower Gateway DLR, some external noise may be heard."

315996.description: The Eurotraveller Hotel Express welcomes you to the heart of London, placing you within a 5-minute drive of iconic landmarks such as the London Eye and the Tower of London. This hotel offers 30 comfortable guestrooms, each equipped with a refrigerator, LCD television, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy the convenience of room service or dine at the on-site restaurant. Ideal for business or leisure travellers, the hotel is within walking distance of major corporate and government offices. Leisure travellers can enjoy a Thames River cruise, a ride on the London Eye, or a visit to Buckingham Palace and Regent Street. Croydon itself offers excellent parks and shopping, and Wimbledon's All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club is easily accessible via a 25-minute tram ride from East Croydon Station. Start your day with our complimentary hot breakfast buffet. Our on-site gym is available for a workout before breakfast or after a busy day. Unwind in our lounge with its inviting fireplace and enjoy your favourite drink from the bar. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. After a long day, enjoy varied dining options without leaving the hotel, including international and traditional cuisine, with a children's menu also available.

316092.description: Boasting a charming setting in London, this property sits at the heart of the city's West End. 316121.description:
In the heart of exclusive South Kensington, The Adria is much more than a boutique hotel. Behind the stucco façade of our 19th-century townhouse, you will discover a contemporary style designed to meet every modern comfort. 

Just a short walk from the Natural History Museum, Harrods department store and the Royal Albert Hall, this exclusive five-star hotel has a nostalgic members’ club charm. 

Our 22 elegant suites and rooms offer opulent furnishings, mini bars, workspace, underfloor heating and luxurious Italian marble bathrooms. 

An à la carte breakfast is served to suit your schedule, and as the day progresses, enjoy a traditional afternoon tea in our dining room before unwinding in the evening with a glass of champagne in the Games Room. 

Breakfast: £ 27. 50

A friendly, contemporary Harlow hotel near Stansted Airport and trains to Central London

Set in the thriving town of Harlow on the border of Essex and Hertfordshire, Holiday Inn Express® Harlow hotel is 15 miles from Stansted Airport, with easy access to the M11 motorway. Harlow Town Station is a 20-minute walk away, where you can take a 35-minute train ride to London Liverpool Street Station or catch the Stansted Express to the airport. A major hub for buses and coaches, Harlow Bus Station is right next to the hotel. 

Corporate guests are less than 10 minutes' drive from Harlow Enterprise Hub, and the Harlow Business Exhibition is held in Town Park on the hotel's doorstep. Three elegant meeting rooms host up to 42 delegates, with audiovisual equipment and catering services. 

Popular attractions in Harlow include Gibberd Garden and Gibberd Gallery in the Civic Centre, and you can follow Harlow's Sculpture Trail as you shop along the pedestrianised Broadwalk. It's a five-minute stroll from the hotel to Harlow Leisurezone, and within 20 miles you can visit family-friendly attractions such as Broxbourne Paradise Wildlife Park and Hertford Castle. 

Wi-Fi and breakfast are included, you can tuck into traditional British food and beers in the lobby bar and restaurant. Friendly staff can recommend a good pub in Harlow or the West Essex countryside.

316573.description:
Welcome to The Goodenough Hotel, a beautifully restored boutique hotel in Central London, located in the heart of the historic Bloomsbury district. Just minutes from King’s Cross, St Pancras International, and the West End, our hotel offers a unique blend of classic Georgian charm and contemporary luxury. 

Set across five elegant 19th-century Georgian townhouses, The Goodenough Hotel provides a tranquil escape from the buzz of the city – perfect for leisure breaks, business trips, or romantic getaways. Whether you're visiting London for work or pleasure, The Goodenough Hotel is your ideal home base – offering boutique accommodation in Central London with easy access to major attractions, theatres, museums, and transport links. 

At The Goodenough Hotel, our story is rooted in heritage, education, and giving back. More than just a boutique hotel in Bloomsbury, we’re proud to be a not-for-profit hotel in Central London – with 100% of our profits going towards supporting Goodenough College, a renowned postgraduate residence and academic community. 

When you stay with us, you’re not only enjoying a peaceful escape in one of London’s most historic and culturally rich neighbourhoods – you’re also contributing to the future of some of the world’s most talented students – including those on low incomes or from challenging backgrounds. It’s a stay that feels good and does good. 

In early 2026, The Goodenough Hotel will be undertaking phased heritage restoration works to the front of the building. These works are carefully managed, with little expected impact on guest access, comfort, or enjoyment of Mecklenburgh Square. Any limited works will be planned to minimise noise, and a small number of rooms will be temporarily closed, allowing us to carry out light-touch refurbishments, including new carpets. 

Experience authentic London, support a worthy cause, and sleep well, knowing your visit makes a difference.
