Its position in the Centro neighbourhood places guests within easy walking distance of major attractions. The property provides a 24-hour front desk, a lift, and air-conditioned rooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi. Accommodation options include single, twin, double, triple, and quadruple rooms, all featuring a private bathroom. Select rooms offer views over the city. For exploring the area, the Sol metro station is a three-minute walk away, while the Gran Vía, Plaza Mayor, and the Prado Museum are all reachable within an 11-minute walk.

319691.description: Located a few steps from the Navigli district and Bocconi University, Hotel D’Este offers contemporary accommodations with free Wi-Fi. The historic center of Milan is a pleasant 15-minute walk away. Guest rooms feature carpeted or parquet floors, TVs, minibars, and private bathrooms with hairdryers. Some rooms offer charming garden views. Hotel D’Este is conveniently located near historic monuments, tourist attractions, and public transportation, including the Bligny Tram Station. The hotel also provides a 24-hour reception and a relaxing garden. Parking is available nearby, as are the Crocetta and Porta Genova metro stations. Rho Fiera Milano and the former Expo 2015 site are a 30-minute drive from the hotel.

319695.description: Charm Hotel located in Aranjuez, whose monumental site was declared World Heritage Site in 2001. It's located in a building built in early 19th century, refurbished to cater for the clients' comfort and enjoyment, laid over two floors. The ground level lodges common areas such as the lounge, the bar and the meeting room, all of them very bright, where the traditional taste of yesteryear joins state-of-the-art lines, creating a pleasant environment. The first floor houses the rooms, all of them different but sharing a common décor with wooden floors, fine linen and colourful floor tiles in the bathroom. The hotel is arranged around its interior courtyard, a nice place to have a drink or even host events when the weather is good. *Reception openuntil 21.00h. In case of late arrivals, please inform the hotel.

319741.description: There are a total of 32 accomodation units on the premises. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces.

319773.description: This charming Milanese hotel offers 40 cozy bedrooms and welcomes pets. Its strategic location near the city center provides easy access to Milan's main attractions. Tram 16, stopping directly in front of the hotel, offers a 15-minute direct route to the Duomo and other key destinations. Numerous bus and metro stations are also nearby.

319794.description: Situated in a beautifully restored historical building, this elegant hotel lies just 200 meters from the Duomo Cathedral in the heart of the city center. Malpensa Airport is approximately an hour away, while Linate Airport is a mere 8 km from the hotel. The 27 rooms, including 5 junior suites and one suite, are decorated in light, elegant colors and furnished with international designer pieces. Each room offers air conditioning, a minibar, and a private bathroom with a hairdryer and complimentary toiletries. A top-floor penthouse boasts splendid city views. Enjoy breakfast served daily in the comfort of your room.

319797.description: Offering a free car park and garage, this 3-star hotel in Legnano is within easy reach of the A8 motorway connecting you to Italy's lake region and the Rho-Pero Trade Fair. Set in the city centre, Hotel 2C is near the main hospital. Public transport is close by. Hotel 2C provides free WiFi throughout and 60 simply furnished rooms distributed between the main building and its annexe. In-room amenities include a minibar and air conditioning. Disabled rooms are also available. Relax in the comfortable hall. Hotel 2C features a bar and a cosy dining room, where you can enjoy a free continental breakfast. Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 8 for a two-person trip.

319836.description: Bardonecchia's Villaggio Olimpico is in the centre of town, approximately 500 metres from the ski slopes. Completely renovated for Turin's Winter Olympics, it offers modern en-suite rooms, and free outdoor parking. The A32 Autostrada del Frejus motorway is 1 km away. Each room is bright and spacious, and equipped with private bathroom, TV, and minibar. The style is traditional of the mountains, with parquet floors, and light-wood furniture. The Villaggio is comprised of different buildings, and includes a restaurant, and a bar open 7 days a week. Breakfast is a sweet and savoury buffet, and the full board option includes mineral water and wine during the meals. The spa is complete with hot tub, indoor swimming pool, sauna, sensory showers, and Turkish bath. Guests can practice basket, beach volley, table tennis, soccer and billiards. A gym is also provided. Bardonecchia Train station is 1 km away. A public bus runs from the station right to the property.

319862.description: This charming hotel in Tortona, conveniently located near the west bypass, offers easy access to Milan's key attractions, including the Milan Fair, Catholic University, Bocconi University, and IULM University. Well-served by public transport, including buses, trolleys, and the metro, the hotel is approximately 40 minutes from Malpensa Airport and just 12km from Linate Airport. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, this hotel provides 95 comfortable rooms, a pleasant breakfast room, meeting rooms, and a delightful indoor patio. All rooms feature air conditioning, complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, a safe, and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer.

319877.description: With a small number of only 5, this property is very convenient for a quiet stay. Hostal Nersan II offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception.

319906.description: Hotel Embassy is a 12-minute walk from Pero Metro Station and less than 0. 9 mi from the Rho Pero Exhibition Center. Wi-Fi and parking are free. The rooms are classically furnished. The Embassy Hotel features a large garden with restaurant and terrace. Reception is open 24-hour. Each room comes with soft carpeted floors, air conditioning and a flat-screen TV. The hotel includes a breakfast room and a bar. Fax and photocopying services are available, as are meeting rooms.

319922.description: Hotel was built in 1994. Hotel was refurbished in 2015. Hotel has an annexing building. The property has 2 annexes. The property consists of 98 rooms. The property consists of 26 single rooms, 4 suites, 3 disability-friendly rooms, 9 triple rooms, 1 quadruple room and 4 family rooms. This popular hotel provides the ideal base for exploring the area. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. A key collection service is available. The Hotel has mobile phone coverage. Guests can take advantage of room service to enjoy breakfast in bed. There is a laundry service. There is a launderette available for long-term stays. The Hotel is wheelchair-accessible. The on-site car park may be useful to those arriving by car. The Hotel provides guests with a secure parking area. The Hotel offers 24-hour security. The Hotel has a bellboy service.

319938.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this establishment. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. Everyone staying at this accommodation are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. Hostal Los Alpes may charge a fee for some services.

319962.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and a reception hall. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Full breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and an elevator. Make yourself at home in one of the 32 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have jetted bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Plaza de Toros - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Centro Comercial Los Valles - 7. 3 km / 4. 6 mi- Monumento al Cantero - 8. 5 km / 5. 3 mi- Centro Comercial Planetocio - 8. 9 km / 5. 5 mi- Megacampo - 12. 4 km / 7. 7 mi- De Pino a Pino Navacerrada - 14. 2 km / 8. 8 mi- Canto del Peso - 14. 2 km / 8. 8 mi- Riscos de la Majadilla Verde - 15. 3 km / 9. 5 mi- Pilas del Navazo - 16. 8 km / 10. 4 mi- Church of San Sebastian - 16. 8 km / 10. 5 mi- Puente de la Alcanzorla - 17. 3 km / 10. 7 mi- Forestal Park Madrid-Guadarrama - 17. 5 km / 10. 9 mi- Casino Gran Madrid - 17. 9 km / 11. 1 mi- El Mirador Shopping Center - 19. 5 km / 12. 1 mi- Escaparate - 20. 8 km / 12. 9 mi. The nearest major airport is Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD) - 55. 2 km / 34. 3 mi When you stay at Hospederia La Cañada in Moralzarzal, you'll be near ski runs and 9 minutes by foot from Plaza de Toros. This upscale hotel is 4. 6 mi (7. 3 km) from Centro Comercial Los Valles and 5. 3 mi (8. 5 km) from Monumento al Cantero.

319973.description: Hostal Comercial features a total of 16 units. Although this hostel was constructed in 1890, it has been refurbished in 2023. Everyone staying at this accommodation can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the accomodation. The hostel provides 24-hour reception. The premises offer accessible public areas.

320006.address: Ctra. Puente de Arganda a Chinchón, Km 2,5
320006.description: Nestled within the Southeast Natural Park, Complejo la Cigüeña boasts a stunning 240, 000 m2 setting, much of it bordering a large lake. Trees, gardens, bungalows, restaurants, and versatile marquees complement this magnificent natural landscape, home to a large colony of storks. Just 25 km from Madrid, Complejo la Cigüeña offers a dreamlike space for leisure, celebrations, and relaxation. Enjoy your private deck overlooking the tranquil lake, surrounded by the natural beauty that defines this unique destination. Fancy a candlelit dinner?

320023.description: Located in the heart of Milan, Hotel Loreto is a short walk from Corso Buenos Aires and a quick drive from the Carlo Besta Neurological Institute. This hotel offers guests complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and room service. Enjoy a buffet breakfast (fee applies) or a drink at the bar/lounge. Each of the 14 individually furnished guestrooms features a minibar, flat-screen TV, private bathroom with shower, bidet, and complimentary toiletries, as well as a safe and desk. The hotel is conveniently located near Piazzale Loreto and provides easy access to various attractions, including the Politecnico di Milano and Porta Venezia.

320125.description: Set in Madrid , this property is the perfect base for both business and holiday travel. The property consists of 10 rooms. A key collection service is available

320136.description: Located in the heart of San Pedrito Beach, Manzanillo, near Mexico's main harbor and just five minutes from the city center, this comfortable hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Spacious, light-filled guest rooms offer a relaxing stay with modern amenities, including flat-screen TVs and Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a refreshing swim in the outdoor pool. With its convenient and inviting amenities, it's an excellent choice for experiencing this vibrant city. Pet-friendly rooms are available for 280 pesos per pet, per night.

320158.description: The 18 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Those staying at this establishment may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. The reception does not work around the clock.

320160.city: SIROLO,  PARCO REGIONALE DEL CONERO SIROLO
320160.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a health club, an outdoor pool, and an outdoor tennis court. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and tour/ticket assistance. For lunch or dinner, stop by Merlin Cocai, a restaurant that specializes in Italian cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 60 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions.

320169.description: Set in the centre of Torrejón de Ardoz, this modern hotel boasts a well-connected location and modern facilities such as an informal cafe and satellite TV in each room. This value hotel lies next to the city’s railway and bus stations, allowing you easy access to Madrid’s vibrant city centre. It is surrounded by pedestrianised shopping streets where you will find a range of authentic tapas bars. Barajas Airport and the IFEMA congress centre are both just a short drive along the nearby motorway. Meet friends and family in the Plaza Mayor’s spacious lounges, or over a drink in the cafe. Each spacious room comes with traditional wooden decor and cooling parquet floors. Wide windows allow in plenty of natural light.

320262.description: Inspired in theatre, this hotel in Madrid offers the ideal accommodation option for those travellers looking for the ideal base from which to explore all the Spanish capital city has to offer. It is close to the popular Puerta del Sol (‘Gate of the Sun’), Gran Via avenue and Atocha, providing also excellent connections to the airport. The accommodation units feature an original style and are decorated with large pictures on the walls, creating a unique atmosphere that is sure to impress. They all come complete with private bathrooms featuring premium toiletries to make guests’ stay even more comfortable. The onsite services include complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection in the hotel and there is a terrace ideal to enjoy the magnificent views over the surrounding urban landscape. A breakfast buffet is served daily for guests’ convenience.

320304.description: With a small number of only 10, this establishment is very convenient for a quiet stay.

320332.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Hotel San Guido, including complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a TV lounge. Grab a snack at the on-site deli or enjoy room service (limited hours). Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Stay connected with complimentary wired internet and benefit from a 24-hour front desk and luggage storage. The 31 individually furnished guestrooms feature refrigerators, LCD TVs, down comforters, premium bedding, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms offer rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Located in Milan's Porta Garibaldi district, Hotel San Guido is a short walk from Corso Como and Piazza Gae Aulenti, and conveniently close to Sempione Park and Orto Botanico di Brera. The closest airports are Linate (LIN), Milan Malpensa (MXP), and Bergamo Orio al Serio (BGY).

320387.description: A total of 85 rooms are available for guests' convenience at Monopole.

320480.description: Enjoy views from the terrace and garden, and make use of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi. Continental breakfast is available daily between 7:30 AM and 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and luggage storage. Make yourself at home in one of the 22 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring espresso makers and Smart TVs. Complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms offer designer toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided on request. A stay at numa | Camperio Rooms & Apartments places you in the heart of Milan, within a 10-minute walk of Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II and Piazza del Duomo. This upscale aparthotel is 0. 6 miles (0. 9 km) from the Cathedral of Milan and 0. 3 miles (0. 4 km) from Castello Sforzesco. The nearest airports are Linate (LIN), Milan Malpensa (MXP), and Bergamo Orio al Serio (BGY).

320507.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Hotel Esperia, including complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a TV lounge. Dine at the on-site coffee shop/cafe, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel offers a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Host your events in the conference space and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available for a fee. The 55 guest rooms feature refrigerators, minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. For your convenience, each room also has a phone, safe, and desk. Hotel Esperia is conveniently located near Fiera Milano Exhibition Center (2. 3 mi) and Alfa Romeo Historical Museum (2. 9 mi). The nearest airports are Linate (21 mi) and Milan Malpensa (25. 3 mi).

320564.description: A total of 16 guest rooms are available for guests' convenience at Hostal Abadía Madrid. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. Hostal Abadía Madrid offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

320595.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Da Mariuccia in Robecchetto con Induno offers family rooms with private bathrooms, balconies, and garden views. Each room includes air-conditioning, a work desk, and free WiFi. Dining Experience: The family-friendly restaurant serves Italian, Mediterranean, and local cuisines with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. Guests can enjoy brunch, lunch, and dinner in a traditional or romantic ambience. Leisure Facilities: The hotel features a fitness centre, terrace, and garden. Additional amenities include a hot tub, spa bath, and outdoor play area. Free on-site private parking is available. Convenient Location: Located 15 km from Milan Malpensa Airport, the hotel is near attractions such as Busto Arsizio Nord (18 km) and The Last Supper (38 km). Highly rated for its restaurant and connectivity to the airport.

320719.description: Hotel Firenze offers free Wi-Fi access and free outdoor parking in Saronno. It is a 5-minute walk from Saronno Station and has modern rooms with TV and private bathroom. This 3-star hotel includes a lounge bar with newspapers and magazines and a dining room where you can enjoy a buffet breakfast. The Firenze Hotel is easily reached from the A9 motorway exit and FieraMilano is a 20-minute drive away. The hotel can arrange a 9-seater shuttle to/from the exhibition center and airport, upon request and at extra charge. Saronno is well linked to Milan with trains departing for the city center every 5 minutes.

320741.description: Enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast and convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). This hotel also offers a snack bar/deli, 24-hour room service, and a bar/lounge. Additional amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and discounted access to a nearby fitness facility. Each of the 24 guestrooms features a refrigerator, minibar, flat-screen TV with satellite programming, private bathroom with shower, bidet, hair dryer, safe, and desk. Located near QC Termemilano, Bocconi University, and Fondazione Prada, the hotel provides easy access to Milan's attractions. Train station pick-up is available (surcharge). The closest airport is Linate (LIN).

320756.description: Travellers will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay on the premises, as it counts with a total of 9units. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Hostal Foster. The reception desk is not open throughout the day. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

320785.description: Hostal Regio is located between Gran Vía Street and Plaza del Carmen, just two minutes from Puerta del Sol and also near the Plaza Mayor, an excellent location in the center of Madrid.. With a total of 14 accommodation units, this is a nice place to stay. The year of construction of this accommodation dates back to 2011. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection available on-site. Guests will appreciate the 24-hour reception. Pets are not allowed at this property. Guests staying at this establishment can take advantage of the transfer service offered. All the rooms have private bathroom with shower, air conditioning, heating, elevator and television.

320833.description: The total number of accomodation units is 20. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. Some services of Adelchi may be payable.

320840.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, a computer station, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 15 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your Select Comfort bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Piazza Cordusio - 0. 3 km / 0.

320861.description: Everyone staying at this accommodation will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Barbieri Sol Hostel as it counts with a total of 9 guest rooms. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Barbieri Sol Hostel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. Additional fees may apply for some services.

320896.description: Residence De La Gare offers furnished one- and two-bedroom apartments, each with a well-equipped kitchen and a living room with a sofa. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, the aparthotel provides lift access, daily cleaning service (Monday to Friday), and luggage storage. The reception is open from 1PM to 11 PM. A self-check-in system is available upon request; please contact us in advance for access codes and instructional videos. Check-in is from 1PM (or earlier if your apartment is ready), and check-out is by 11:00 AM. We are happy to accommodate different check-in/check-out times whenever possible. Additional amenities include laundry service, a self-service washing machine, bicycle storage, and multilingual staff. Pets are welcome with prior notice. Contact us via WhatsApp at +39026690868 or email DELAGARE@DELAGARE. IT.

320918.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Hotel RossoVino, centrally located in Milan, a short drive from Piazza del Duomo and the Cathedral. The hotel offers 14 air-conditioned rooms with LED TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as a terrace, garden, room service, and coffee/tea in the common area. Bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. With multilingual staff and luggage storage available, your stay is sure to be convenient and pleasant. Nearby attractions include Piazza Cinque Giornate and the Politecnico di Milano. Linate Airport is the closest airport.

320995.description:
With a stay at Residence Portello in Milan (Fiera), you'll be a 4-minute drive from Via Tortona and 6 minutes from San Siro Stadium.  This residence is 1.6 mi (2.6 km) from Santa Maria delle Grazie and 2.6 mi (4.1 km) from Teatro alla Scala.
Featured amenities include laundry facilities and an elevator.
Make yourself at home in one of the 24 guestrooms, featuring kitchenettes with refrigerators and stovetops. LED televisions with digital programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include microwaves, and housekeeping is provided weekly.

321036.description: A total of 16 units are available for guests' convenience at Hostal Villagarcia Alcazar III.

321049.description: Located next to Pio XII Metro Station, Don Pio is 2 Metro stops from Madrid’s IFEMA Exhibition Center. It offers a free gym and free WiFi. The elegant Don Pio Hotel features classic design, with a bright central courtyard. The spacious rooms have wooden floors and are decorated with warm colors. A hairdryer and a bidet are included in the marble bathrooms. The Don Pio’s café-bar offers Spanish and international cuisine. A wide range of restaurants and shops can be found in the streets nearby. Hotel Don Pio is located 0. 9 mi from Chamartín Train Station and 3. 1 mi from Madrid Barajas Airport. There are direct Metro links to the airport and Madrid city center from Pio XII Station.

321076.description: Located in the heart of Getafe, Hostal Carlos III is a 5-minute drive from Carlos III University of Madrid and 6 minutes from La Cubierta Bull Ring. This hostal is conveniently located 92 miles (148 km) from Puerta del Sol and 9. 3 miles (15 km) from Plaza Mayor. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. The 50 air-conditioned rooms feature LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and bathrooms with bathtubs or showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Enjoy a satisfying meal at the on-site restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available (subject to charges).

321110.description:
Litta Palace, a true urban resort on the outskirts of Milan, offers 92 elegant rooms and suites, a restaurant, an outdoor pool, a spa with a wellness area, and close to the Milano-Varese-Como highway exit, just minutes from the Fairgrounds and Malpensa Airport. 
Guests have indoor garage space with 100 parking spots. During exhibitions, the hotel offers a shuttle service for easy access to the exhibition center. 
Hotel Litta Palace also features conference centre up to 250 persons, Litta Cafè&Cocktail bar and summer porch. 

Attico is the Litta Palace Hotel’s innovative event venue, a unique setting that blends industrial and contemporary style. 
A design space flooded with natural light, it transforms into a banquet hall, lounge, or meeting area. With 250 square meters of indoor space and over 100 square meters of terrace, Attico is a versatile venue, perfect for business and leisure events of all kinds.

321123.description: Hotel Gambara provides affordable rooms with free Wi-Fi only a 20 minute walk from Milan's San Siro Stadium. The Gambara Metro Station is just 55 yards away. The Gambara Hotel is in a quiet location near stores and with good bus services. The nearby metro station, on the red line, provides connection to the cathedral in approximately 10 minutes. Hotel Gambara is family run and the front desk is always open. There is a refreshment area with soft drinks and coffee.

321169.description: The ibis Hotel in Alcorcón Tres Aguas is 20min from the city center by public transport. It is also located 7km from the Casa del Campo fairground, the zoo and the amusement park. All its rooms are an ideal place to rest, equipped with WiFi and air conditioning, among other comforts. There is also a parking service at an affordable price. Nearby, you can enjoy all the services offered by the large shopping mall, Tres Aguas.

321173.description: Travellers will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Galaico as it counts with a total of 8 accomodation units.

321207.description:
With a stay at Residence Cimarosa in Milan (Washington), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Santa Maria delle Grazie and Via Tortona.  This residence is 1.9 mi (3 km) from Teatro alla Scala and 2 mi (3.2 km) from Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.
Featured amenities include laundry facilities and an elevator.
Make yourself at home in one of the 24 guestrooms, featuring kitchenettes with refrigerators and stovetops. LED televisions with digital programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include microwaves, and housekeeping is provided weekly.

321216.description: There are a total of 98 accomodation units at Canopy by Hilton Milan Duomo. Those staying at this hotel may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. There is no 24-hour reception. This property's common areas are handicapped friendly. The hotel also has a disability-friendly room. Some services of Canopy by Hilton Milan Duomo may be payable.

321281.description: With a small number of only 10, this property is very convenient for a quiet stay. Everyone staying at this accommodation may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Hotel Paganini. Hotel Paganini does not offer 24-hour reception. Some services of Hotel Paganini may be payable.

321340.description: Located in Medford, the 112 Motel is a short drive from Patchogue Theatre for the Performing Arts and Shorefront Park. This motel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, free self-parking, and amenities such as dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk. Each of the 24 air-conditioned rooms features a Smart TV with satellite programming and video-game consoles, a coffee/tea maker, and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Lasorda Legacy Park is 4. 6 miles away, and Brookhaven National Laboratory is 9. 1 miles from the property.

321354.description: Enjoy a central Milan stay at Hotel Spadari Al Duomo, a short walk from Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II and the Duomo. This hotel offers 40 individually decorated guestrooms with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Amenities include a snack bar, room service, bar/lounge, and concierge services. Nearby attractions include Piazza Cordusio, Biblioteca Ambrosiana, and Museo del Novecento. Linate Airport is the closest airport.

321368.description: The Hotel Cyrano is a structure consisting of 42 rooms. 2 of which are wheelchair accessible. This hotel is the perfect base for those wishing to visit upper Lombardy. It is located just 20 minutes by car from Como and its lake and 25 minutes from Milan. By public transport, thanks to the 'Malpensa Express' (direct train that connects Saronno to Malpensa airport), you can easily reach the airport in just 18 minutes. The train station is a 7-minute walk away and is very well connected to Milan with a rapid and effective train frequency that reaches the city center in 20 minutes.

321379.description: All guests staying at this property will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay on the premises, as it counts with a total of 12guest rooms. Those staying at this accomodation may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. The reception does not work around the clock. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

321391.description:
With a stay at Riad Losra in Marrakech (Medina), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Le Jardin Secret and Marrakesh Museum.  This spa riad is 1.5 mi (2.3 km) from Marrakech Plaza and 2 mi (3.2 km) from Jemaa el-Fnaa.
Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. Additional features at this riad include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and barbecue grills.
Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

The à la carte restaurant on site offers unique views of the Atlantic Ocean and guests can taste a varied menu which includes traditional Portuguese cuisine. Every morning a reinvigorating breakfast is served. Hotel Santo Andre provides a 24-hour front desk, free parking on site, a bar and a children’s playground by the pool. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. 333686.description: The Vermont Ipanema Hotel offers 84 soundproofed rooms equipped with air conditioning, a safe, a minibar, cable TV, a direct-dial telephone, and complimentary Wi-Fi. The property also provides spa services, including a hammam and massages, for an additional charge. The riad is situated within walking distance of several key landmarks; Bahia Palace and El Badi Palace are both a three-minute walk away, while the famous Jemaa el-Fnaa square is a 10-minute walk from the property. An airport shuttle service is also available for travellers.

333855.description: Each room at Riad La Terrasse Des Oliviers features Moroccan décor and a private bathroom adorned with Zellige tilework. The property features a rooftop terrace, a lounge with a fireplace, and a central patio complete with a fountain. Guests can enjoy meals at the on-site restaurant, and a complimentary breakfast is provided. The riad also offers spa services, including a hammam, massages, and a hot tub. Accommodation options include double, suite, and triple rooms, which are equipped with air conditioning and Wi-Fi. Some rooms feature a balcony or patio.

334758.description: Nestled between the coast and the Atlas Mountains, Amanjena offers a tranquil oasis just a 20-minute drive from Marrakech Menara Airport. This five-star resort, surrounded by date palms and olive trees, provides easy access to the vibrant Marrakech medina and the captivating Moroccan landscape. A golfer's paradise, Amanjena is located next to the Amelkis Golf Club's championship course, with the Royal and Al Maaden courses just minutes away. The resort's graceful arched stone courtyards and gentle fountains reflect the region's Moorish heritage. Its bold, sun-kissed red and emerald green hues echo the colors of Marrakech, the 'Red City, ' and its rich royal history. Guests can enjoy an array of spa therapies in two private hammam suites, each opening into its own courtyard. A gym and tennis courts are also available. Dining options include an elegant restaurant beneath a central skylight and two airy eateries overlooking the pools and gardens. The Caidal tent, nestled in an olive grove, is perfect for intimate dinners, while the expansive gardens provide an idyllic setting for weddings.

Vivienda Hotel Villas is a boutique concept with villa-style accommodation. With its beautiful architecture and interior design along with custom designed furniture, Vivienda Granada offers the ultimate luxury stay. The villas are around 300 Sqm in size featuring a large living room, dining room, fully-equipped kitchen, spacious private backyard, professional office space, three bedrooms as well as a maid room and laundry room. All villas have free WiFi and parking. Vivienda also offers 24-hour butler service, indoor and outdoor dining at La Mesa restaurant overlooking the swimming pool. La Mesa is considered among the best restaurants in Riyadh with a finest Italian and International menu, it is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. A gymnasium equipped with the latest technology, a sauna room, and laundry service, to provide you with all the hospitality features you have been looking for.
The hotel also offers car hire. Kingdom Center is 10 km from Vivienda Hotel Villas Granada, while King Fahd Stadium is 12 km from the property. King Khalid Airport is 19 km away. 335517.description: Located in Rio de Janeiro's city center, the Hotel Americano sits next to the iconic Arcos da Lapa. Just a five-minute walk from the Cinelândia and Glória metro stations, and 10 minutes from Santos Dumont Airport, it offers convenient access to key attractions. Within 15 minutes, you can reach Sugarloaf Mountain, Christ the Redeemer, Copacabana Beach, Maracanã Stadium, and Flamengo Park. All rooms feature air conditioning, cable TV, a minibar, a digital safe, a telephone, a closet, and a desk. The hotel also offers complimentary parking and Wi-Fi.

335558.description: Once the residence of the Charai Family and the property of the Private Secretary to the famous Pasha Glaoui, this lovely Riad boasts a larger than average floor area (1600 sq. m. ), giving it a spacious and airy feel. It has been beautifully and elegantly restored by Rocco Forte designer, Carine Mavroleon, in true ‘Nouveaux Moroccan' style using traditional local materials and craftsmanship, but with a contemporary and minimalist twist that sets it apart. Part of the furniture is original Art Deco furniture from the famous Mamounia hotel, including the bar stools from the ‘Churchill bar'. The Riad Charai's is an “Oasis in the Medina” that contrasts vividly with the ceaseless activity of the surrounding souks. Its innate tranquillity is enriched by the sounds of birdsong from the adjacent palm grove and the custom ‘Soundscape design' by Famous Brazilian DJ Monica Soldan.

335674.description: Scorial features a rooftop terrace with 2 swimming pools and panoramic views of Rio. Rooms are fitted with a private bathroom equipped with a shower. For your comfort, you will find free toiletries and a hairdryer. Superior rooms include a spa bath or a hot tub. Excellent public transportation. Immediate access to Costanera Norte, private turnpike, which connects uptown Santiago with the international airport, downtown and highways to nearby beaches, mountain ski slopes and city surroundings.
Spacious free parking lot inside the hotel premises with safety gatekeeper, 24 hours a day.

346010.description: Enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast at Hotel Antroyal, a convenient Antalya hotel located within a 5-minute drive of the Old Bazaar and Antalya Clock Tower. This 49-room hotel offers free valet parking, express check-in/check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Guest rooms feature private balconies, LED TVs with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Room service is available during limited hours. Nearby attractions include the Antalya State Theater, Antalya Opera and Ballet, and Yavuz Ozcan Park. Antalya Intl. Airport (AYT) is 11 miles away.

346661.description:
Just 300 m from the bohemian Lastarria quarter in Santiago, the hostel offers accommodations in a renovated building with parquet floors, touches of elegant décor and modern furnishings.

Guests can relax in the common living room with a book from the library. There is free Wi-Fi in common areas.

Santiago Backpackers has rooms with shared or private bathrooms. They feature lively colored bedspreads. Some rooms have wood furnishings and stylish wall moldings. Private lockers are available.

Breakfast is served daily, including juices and jams. Guests have access to a common kitchen fully equipped with a central island. BBQ facilities are also available.

Bellavista neighborhood, brimming with trendy clubs and restaurants is 0.6 mi from the hostel. 24-hour front desk assistance is provided.

346922.description: In Andes Suite Home, you will find comfortable and spacious apartments fully equipped and with maid services included. We are located in the exclusive El Bosque Norte sector in the El Golf neighbourhood, in a nice environment and provided with all necessary services to offer a pleasant stay.We have an excellent security system operating day and night every day of the year to provide peace of mind.

349291.description: The Silivri Park Hotel, a sea-facing property established in 1999, offers a comfortable stay just 20 minutes from the Tüyap Fair Convention and Congress Center. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Guest rooms feature satellite TV, air conditioning, and a minibar. Private bathrooms include a hairdryer, free toiletries, and a bath or shower. Most rooms boast stunning sea views. A delicious à la carte breakfast is served daily. The public beach is a short 5-minute walk away, and Mocamp Beach, with complimentary access for guests, is a 15-minute drive. Please note there is no shuttle service to the beaches. Atatürk Airport is a 40-minute drive from the hotel.

350939.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Hotel Maxim, a beachfront hotel in Caorle. Unwind on the private beach or indulge in the spa tub. The hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and supervised childcare. Dine at the on-site restaurant and bar/lounge or enjoy room service. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10 AM. The hotel also features a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Each of the 66 guestrooms features an LCD television with satellite programming, a private bathroom with shower, complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer, a safe, and a desk. Hotel Maxim is centrally located, a short drive from Pra' delle Torri Golf Club and Darsena dell'Orologio Harbour. It's also convenient to Caorle's main attractions, including Caorle Cathedral and the Archaeological Sea Museum.

Make yourself at home in one of the 26 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. 350951.description: The Hotel-Pension Lehrerhaus, established in 1906, is centrally located in Vienna, within walking distance of major historical attractions. These include the historic city center, town hall, Ringstrasse, renowned museums, and the Maria Hilfer Strasse shopping street. Our traditional Viennese pension hotel offers budget-friendly accommodations ideal for business travelers, families, and leisure visitors seeking a central yet quiet location. All guest rooms are courtyard-facing, ensuring a peaceful stay.

350952.description: The premises count with 36 welcoming guest rooms. There is no 24-hour reception.

350980.description: A total of 24 rooms are available for guests' convenience at Hotel De Keizerskroon.

Relax with a refreshing drink at the poolside bar. Local cuisine breakfasts are available daily (fees apply). Amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies), and free self-parking is provided. The 16 guestrooms feature minibars, LCD TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences such as desks and electric kettles are also provided, along with daily housekeeping. Located in Mestre, near the airport, Hotel Villa Sara is a 7-minute drive from Forte Bazzera and convenient to other attractions.

350986.description: JO&JOE Vienna features a restaurant, bar, a shared lounge and garden in Vienna. Featuring family rooms, this property also provides guests with a terrace. The accommodation offers a 24-hour front desk, airport transfers, a shared kitchen and free WiFi throughout the property.  At the hostel every room includes air conditioning and a private bathroom. Continental and buffet breakfast options are available every morning at JO&JOE Vienna. Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Wiener Stadthalle, MuseumsQuartier and Leopold Museum. The nearest airport is Vienna International Airport, 19 km from JO&JOE Vienna.

350992.description: This accomodation offers a total of 20 units. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. As this hotel features 24-hour reception, guests are always welcome.

350997.description: The premises count with 51 welcoming guest rooms. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. Guests may contact the reception desk any time during the day. Travellers may enjoy the establishment's entertainment options.

350998.description:
Locanda Ai Santi Apostoli Sul Canal Grande - Ferretti Hotels Collection, housed in a 14th century building, has breathtaking views of the Grand Canal and is only a short walk from Rialto Bridge and St. Mark’s Square. 
From this elegant old Venetian building you can enjoy views of the canal and the characteristic markets below selling fruit, vegetables and wonderfully colourful flowers. The two Superior rooms enjoy a canal view and all are spacious, with antique furniture and modern conveniences. 
The Locanda also offers you a comfortable lounge area where you can relax and have drink, enjoying picturesque views of the city. Every morning, a breakfast buffet is served with over 40 products including vegan and gluten-free ones. 
With a total of 11 accomodation units, this is a nice place to stay. Locanda Ai Santi Apostoli includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and bedrooms. Locanda Ai Santi Apostoli does not operate a 24-hour reception.

351011.description: Indulge in a relaxing experience at the full-service spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Soak up the sun on the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities, including a health club and an indoor pool. This Beaux Arts hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, snacks at the coffee shop/cafe, or room service during limited hours. Unwind with a refreshing drink at the bar/lounge, the poolside bar, or one of the two beach bars. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (7:00 AM to 10:00 AM) for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself at home in one of the 170 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring an LED television, a bed with down comforters and Frette Italian sheets, and a private balcony. Complimentary Wi-Fi is also provided. Private bathrooms with showers include rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. The hotel is conveniently located near Caorle East Beach, Adriagolf, and Pineta Park, with easy access to other attractions such as Luna Park and the Caorle Archaeological Sea Museum. The preferred airport is Marco Polo Airport (VCE).

351045.description: Located in Bibione, a few steps from Bibione Beach, Aparthotel Holiday has accommodations with free bikes, free private parking, a seasonal outdoor swimming pool and a garden. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, a kids' club and a shared lounge, along with free WiFi throughout the property. The property provides evening entertainment and room service. The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms with a closet, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV, a terrace and a private bathroom with a bidet. All rooms will provide guests with a fridge. A buffet, continental or Italian breakfast is available each morning at the property. Aparthotel Holiday has a playground. You can play pool and table tennis at this 4-star hotel, and the area is popular for cycling. Languages spoken at the reception include German, English, Spanish and Italian. Lido del Sole Beach is a 5-minute walk from the accommodation, while Bibione Pineda Beach is 1. 2 miles from the property. The nearest airport is Trieste, 43 miles from Aparthotel Holiday, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM. Featured amenities include luggage storage, laundry facilities, and a library. Stay in one of 65 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Private bathrooms have deep soaking bathtubs and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Guests enjoy amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, LCD TVs with cable, and a daily breakfast service. Some rooms offer views of St. Peter's Church and queen-sized beds. The 24-hour reception ensures a comfortable stay, and the hotel bar is open all day.

351063.description: With a total of 12 accomodation units, this is a nice place to stay. Travellers may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Al Portico Guest House. There is no 24-hour reception.

351065.description: The 88 welcoming units offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Hotels Vidi Miramare & Delfino includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and bedrooms. Hotels Vidi Miramare & Delfino does not offer 24-hour reception. Unfortunately, there are no units where travellers can ask for a cot for the little ones.

351082.description: Nestled on a quiet side street off Vienna's bustling Kärnterstrasse shopping area, the family-run Hotel Mailberger Hof occupies a remarkable 14th-century building. Originally two Gothic gable houses, the property was transformed into a small Baroque palace in the 17th century, complete with horse stables and a private chapel. While retaining its Baroque charm, the palace was converted into a first-class hotel in 1976. Owned by the Knights of Malta since the 15th century, the hotel derives its name from their first Austrian residence in Mailberg. The entire building, a designated historical monument, is under preservation order.

351097.description: Welcome to a unique hotel on the west beach of Caorle. A recently built structure, with a minimal and elegant design, where the wide range of exclusive services is designed to give you an unforgettable relaxing holiday. We are waiting for you in our little oasis of wellbeing, with delicious breakfasts and gourmet dishes overlooking the sea, large terraces with private Jacuzzi in every room, private beach just a few steps away, SPA area and special aperitifs in the Rooftop Bar by the pool.

351098.description: Just 328 feet from its private beach in Bibione, the Ca' D'Oro is half way between Venice and Trieste. The hotel includes a hot tub and a heated pool with hydromassage and foot massage. Parking is free. Offering free Wi-Fi, all rooms at Hotel Ca' D'Oro come with carpeted floors, air conditioning, and a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Some rooms also include bathrobe and slippers, and have views of the Adriatic Sea. The beach is equipped with free sunbeds, parasols, and deck chairs. More free sun beds are available around the pool. Breakfast is an extensive buffet of sweet and salted food. The restaurant serves specialties of Veneto and international cuisine, for lunch and dinner. The nearest shopping area is 984 feet from the hotel. The train station is in Latisana, 9. 9 mi away.

351102.description: There are a total of 25 units on the premises. All guests staying at this property may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Hotel Blumarin. The reception desk is not open throughout the day.

351122.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Hotel Sacher Baden, nestled in a regional park in Baden. Take advantage of the hotel's health club, sauna, and bicycle rentals. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, served weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM and weekends from 7:30 AM to noon. Dine at Carl's Bistro & Cafe for brunch or grab a snack at the coffee shop. The hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a banquet hall. The 37 air-conditioned rooms feature memory foam beds with down comforters, flat-screen televisions with cable programming, minibars, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Free self-parking, express check-out, and multilingual staff are available for your convenience. Hotel Sacher Baden is a short drive from local attractions such as Doblhoffpark and Rosarium, and conveniently located near Vienna International Airport.

351124.description: The charming Cesare Augustus hotel, located in Lido di Jesolo, offers 120 welcoming guest rooms. Guests enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, including all public areas and bedrooms, along with the convenience of a 24-hour reception desk. This seafront hotel provides direct access to a private beach, free parking, a swimming pool, and a panoramic putting green. The brightly decorated rooms feature air conditioning and satellite TV. Select rooms also offer balconies with stunning views of the sea or the expansive pine garden. Please note, cots are not available and pets are not permitted.

Wind down with a drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges or 2 poolside bars. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. This hotel has 4284 square feet (398 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 14 meeting rooms.

Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers, while in-room safes, desks, and phones add convenience. Located near Alte Donau, the hotel is a short distance from Donau Zentrum, the Vienna International Centre, and other key attractions. Vienna International Airport (VIE) is the preferred airport.

351215.description: NIDOZ Hotel Vienna is a 44-room hotel in Austria’s capital. It offers a comfortable base for guests who want to experience Vienna at their own pace, whether they are visiting for a city break, travelling with family or staying on business. From the hotel, guests can set out to discover the city’s architecture, culture, cafés and many other attractions.

351224.description: Enjoy a beachside getaway at the Aparthotel Imperial in San Michele al Tagliamento, just steps from Bibione Beach and a short walk from Bibione Thermae. This aparthotel offers a variety of amenities, including a seasonal outdoor pool, bicycle rentals, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the on-site Ristorante or a snack at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM. The aparthotel also features a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, laundry facilities, and free self-parking. The 120 air-conditioned rooms offer kitchenettes equipped with stovetops and microwaves, private balconies, complimentary Wi-Fi, phones, safes, and sofa beds. Nearby attractions include Luna Park Adriatico (0. 4 mi) and Pra' delle Torri Golf Club (29. 3 mi). The nearest airports are Friuli Venezia Giulia Airport (TRS) and Marco Polo Airport (VCE).

351229.description:
The Ambasciatori Suite Hotel was established in the 1960s under the name "Hotel Ambasciatori. " In 2021, the property underwent a complete interior renovation, resulting in its current layout: a total of 48 rooms, including 9 brand-new accommodations on the first floor, inaugurated on July 1st. 

Enhancing the guest experience, the panoramic restaurant on the 5th floor serves both breakfast and dinner, while the ground-floor bar is perfect for a quick lunch. Together, these services reflect the hotel’s commitment to high standards and quality hospitality. 

Parking and beach services are available through a partnership with Bagni Clodia.

351246.description: Spend the day on the private beach or dip into one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Relax with a refreshing drink at the bar/lounge, the beach bar, or one of 2 poolside bars. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A shuttle from the airport to the hotel is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 53 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

351258.description: Locanda Zabotto offers a characteristic restaurant and air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi. It is 25 minutes' drive from Venice and 19 mi from Sottomarina Beach, both easily reached by bus. The Zabotto Locanda is surrounded by the green countryside of Veneto, within easy reach of the Brenta Riviera and its Palladian villas. The hotel's modern facilities including Wi-Fi and a bright dining room are set within a traditional-style building. The family-run restaurant serves homemade pasta, regional dishes, and fish specialties. A choice of local wines are also offered. Locanda Zabotto is next to the SS309 state road that connects Ravenna with Venice. The WWF site of Valle Averto is just 0. 6 mi away. Parking is free and you will be just 525 feet from the nearest public bus stop linking with Venice.

351261.address: Via Altinate IV accesso al mare, 4
351261.description: Overlooking a private beach in Lido di Jesolo, Hotel Mon Repos offers a pool, restaurant and marine-style rooms with a balcony. Within an easy walking distance from the main shopping district, it includes a bar. Rooms at Hotel Mon Repos include a bathroom with shower, air conditioning and TV. Each also features partial sea views from the private balcony. You can soak up the sun on the beach or swim in the hotel’s own outdoor swimming pool, complete with poolside terrace and snack bar. Free WiFi is available throughout the property's public areas. According to availability, 1 parasol and 2 sun loungers at the private beach are included. Alternatively, you can discover Venice, set 50 km away, in a day trip by bus or boat. Attractions in the area include the city of Trieste, the Dolomites mountains and the Aqualandia theme park, which is a 20-minute bus drive away.

351270.description: Centrally located in Caorle, Hotel Karinzia offers easy access to the beach and nearby attractions like Pineta Park and Adriagolf. Enjoy a range of amenities including a spa tub, rooftop terrace, restaurant, bar/lounge, and coffee shop/cafe. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. The 44 guestrooms feature refrigerators, complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, private bathrooms with showers, and complimentary toiletries. Guests can also benefit from a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and on-site parking (subject to charges). The preferred airport is Marco Polo Airport (VCE).

351273.description: Only 656 feet from its own private beach on the Adriatic Sea coast, Hotel Etna is in Caorle city center. It features an Italian restaurant, a bar and terrace. Free private parking is also available on site. In summer, the Etna Hotel offers free babysitting services at the beach, as well as free use of 1 parasol and 2 sun loungers per room. Guests can borrow bikes at reception at no extra charge. With air conditioning, all rooms are en suite. Each has a flat-screen satellite TV, safe and fan. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies), and take advantage of amenities such as concierge services, a 24-hour front desk, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge applies). St. Stephen's Cathedral is just 0. 2 km away, and Vienna International Airport (VIE) is 19 km from the hotel.

Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is included. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. 351756.description: Caorle's Hotel Antoniana, located on the seafront, offers free private parking and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Guests enjoy a private beach, a gourmet restaurant, and a furnished patio. All rooms feature a balcony, air conditioning, parquet floors, and modern decor, along with a desk, satellite TV, and a private bathroom with toiletries and a hairdryer. Some rooms boast sea views. A rich daily breakfast buffet, including gluten-free and organic options, is served in the restaurant, which specializes in regional and Mediterranean cuisine and offers an à la carte menu. Guests can relax on the furnished patio and enjoy cocktails from the hotel bar. Free bikes are available for exploring the area, and the private beach is equipped with deckchairs and parasols. Jesolo is a 40-minute drive away, and Punta Sabbioni, with ferries to Venice, is 30 miles away.

351780.description: This lovely hotel is situated in the heart of Vienna. Hotel Post features a total of 103 bedrooms. The premises offer accessible public areas. Visitors and their pets can really enjoy their stay together at this hotel. The hotel includes a garage ideal for guests' use. There is an airport transfer service for guests' convenience. This property features a choice of business facilities in order to offer the perfect combination of comfort and convenience for a corporate trip. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

351794.description: Centrally located in Vienna, the Schlosshotel Römischer Kaiser is a short walk from the Albertina and Hofburg Imperial Palace. This hotel offers 24 air-conditioned rooms with minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable TV. Enjoy private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, hair dryers, and bathrobes. Additional amenities include a business center, express check-in/out, and a bar/lounge. Full breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The Vienna State Opera and Spanish Riding School are within a short distance. The nearest airport is Vienna International Airport (VIE).

351798.description: All guests staying at this property will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at La Villeggiatura as it counts with a total of 6 accomodation units. Each has a private patio equipped for al-fresco dining. You will also find a fully equipped kitchenette in all units. On-site services at the Isamar Holiday Village include private parking, entertainment activities, and free WiFi in public areas. The property features 4 tennis courts, football fields, as well as basketball courts, minigolf, diving center, equestrian center and much more. The property is 8 km from Chioggia, while Venice is a 1-hour drive away.

In summer, rates include free use of sunbeds and parasols at the beach. Some rooms face the sea while others offer side sea views. On the terrace of the Atlantico Hotel you can enjoy a drink and a panoramic view. Free bikes are available at reception. The hotel also has a relaxing wellness area. It includes a hot tub, sauna, and a steam bath. A pool is also available.

351878.description: Enjoy a day at the private beach or take a dip in the outdoor pool at this Jesolo hotel. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and take advantage of convenient services like concierge assistance and an area shuttle (surcharge). Savor Italian cuisine at the poolside Ristorante, offering alfresco dining, a bar/lounge, and stunning pool views. Room service is also available during limited hours. A buffet breakfast is offered daily (fee applies). The hotel features 43 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, satellite programming, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and bidets. Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, airport shuttle (surcharge), and free self-parking. The hotel is conveniently located near Jesolo Beach, Caribe Bay, and other local attractions.

351881.description:
This comfortable hotel is located in Lido di Jesolo, a short walk from the town center and just 150 meters from the beach. Guests can easily access numerous local attractions, as well as a golf course within 5 kilometers. The hotel, renovated in 1994, offers 18 accommodation units and convenient on-site parking (by payment). Wi-Fi is available in public areas. While the hotel does not have 24-hour reception, it does provide an airport shuttle service for easy transport (35 km) by payment. Guests are asked to communicate their arrival time at least 3 days in advance by emailing info@hotelute. com. Please note that beach service, including one umbrella and two sunbeds, is not included in the room rate and is available at an additional cost during the summer season. Small pets are welcome, and common areas are accessible to guests with disabilities. 
A damage deposit of € 100 is required on arrival.

At Hotel Deutschmeister all rooms are fitted with bed linen and towels. The accommodation offers a buffet or continental breakfast. Popular points of interest near Hotel Deutschmeister include Hofburg, St. Stephen's Cathedral and Imperial Treasury Vienna. The nearest airport is Vienna International Airport, 19 km from the hotel. Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, a 24-hour reception, and free parking. A varied breakfast buffet is served daily, and the restaurant offers traditional Italian cuisine, including gluten-free options and children's menus. The hotel also boasts a private beach. Please note, pets are not allowed.

Start your day with a rich buffet breakfast. Choose from 60, comfortably furnished rooms at American Hotel. Private bathrooms, satellite TV and a sea-view balcony are available in every room. Relax in the TV lounge or in the swimming pool. There is a separate children's pool available. Explore the surrounding area on bicycles that you can rent directly at the hotel. American Hotel offers tours to famous sites such as Verona, Lake Garda, Florence, Cortina and the Dolomites.

352316.description: Situated between Ca' d'Oro and the Rialto Bridge, near the 13th-century Ca' da Mosto mansion on the Grand Canal, the Locanda Leon Bianco occupies the site of the historic Albergo del Leon Bianco, once Venice's most renowned hotel. Following a complete renovation, the Locanda offers elegant rooms, many with Grand Canal views, providing modern comfort and traditional Venetian hospitality. Guests will feel at home in this charming hotel. Reception has limited hours; check-in is before 10 pm. For late arrivals, please contact the hotel at least 12 hours in advance to arrange key collection.

353063.description: Enjoy amenities such as a sauna and bicycle rentals at Hotel Amba Alagi. Located in Mestre (Marghera), the hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, a common area television, and a vending machine. Additional amenities include luggage storage, a safe deposit box at the front desk, and a microwave in the common area. Free self-parking is available onsite. The 14 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen televisions with digital programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, desks, and electric kettles are also provided. The hotel is a short drive from Piazzale Roma and Porto Marghera, and within 10 miles of the Port of Venice and the Grand Canal.

353082.description: Those in search of Venetian tradition, hospitality and a genuine hotelier's pride in ensuring guests truly experience the best of Venice, are warmly invited to the excellently located, family owned and managed, 1-star Minerva Hotel. Situated on the Lista di Spagna in the heart of the Cannaregio quarter, the Minerva can be easily reached on foot from the railway station, as well as the Piazzale Roma bus and car terminals. Water bus (Vaporetto) stops on the Grand Canal are just a few steps away. Having been in the same family for over 60 years, the Minerva continues the tradition of the hotel's founder (affectionately know as Grandpa Gigi) and the current owners enjoy making sure that guests not only experience the main historical and cultural sights of Venice, but also those off the beaten track. All who work at the Minerva Hotel take great pride in the standard of the accommodation, as well as the service they offer. Guestrooms are simply yet tastefully furnished and all are complemented with original antique furniture from the region ? clean, shared bathrooms are located on each floor and maintained regularly thanks to daily cleaning rota. Environmentally conscious guests should also note that the Minerva operates a Green policy, using only eco friendly cleaning and laundry products as well as running the hotel on sustainable energy. In our opinion this is an unbeatable choice in terms of location, standard, service and price - thoroughly recommended! Guests should note that local city tax is not included in the rate booked. This will be charged directly to guests by the hotel and payable at check in/out.

353093.description: The 30 welcoming units offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception.

353095.description: A total of 78 rooms are available for guests' convenience. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection available on-site. This aparthotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night.

353100.description: Hotel Bianchi is near Bibione's seafront promenade and just a few steps from its private beach with free parasols and deckchairs. All rooms offer balconies. The rooms are air conditioned and feature free Wi-Fi and satellite TV. The buffet breakfast includes ham, cheese and croissants. You also have a choice of fruit juices and hot drinks. The Bianchi Hotel is 164 feet from Bibione's pedestrian area. It is 20 minutes' drive from Lignano Sabbiadoro and 10 minutes' drive from Lignano Golf Club.

353102.description: The 27 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. San Carlo offers Wi-Fi internet connection on-site. Visitors will appreciate the 24-hour reception. Cots are not available at San Carlo.

353103.description: The Hotel KUNSThof represents the perfect blend of contemporary creativity and years of experience. Modern art is both a companion and a source of inspiration, aiming to unite the comforts of a time-honored hotel with the artistic enjoyment of a gallery. Located in the heart of Vienna's Leopoldstadt, close to the city center, the KUNSThof offers 50 rooms across four categories. Founded as Hotel Reichshof and family-owned for over 120 years, this historic boutique hotel caters to individual guests. Breakfast is available for €14 per person. Pets are allowed for an additional €10 per pet/day. Different policies and additional supplements may apply when booking five or more rooms. A 3. 2% city tax is not included. Reception is open from 6:30 a. m. to 11:00 p. m.

353106.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at the elaya hotel vienna city west, located in Vienna's Mariahilf district, a short walk from Mariahilfer Street and Naschmarkt. This hotel offers 93 air-conditioned rooms with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (available for a fee), and take advantage of amenities including a 24-hour front desk, computer station, and multilingual staff. Airport transfers and on-site parking are available (surcharges apply). Nearby attractions include the Vienna State Opera and Schönbrunn Palace.

353118.description: The comfortable Hotel Riviera offers a peaceful stay in Lido, Jesolo. Located on the main street, just steps from the sea and near Piazza Milano, this 3-star hotel provides the perfect setting for a quality holiday. With 11 rooms and Wi-Fi in communal areas, guests can enjoy convenient amenities and the attentive service of the Buscato family, who have owned and managed the hotel for over thirty years. Their passion extends to the kitchen, where they work closely with their chefs to create daily menus featuring high-quality products.

353124.description: Relax on the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities such as outdoor tennis courts and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Need to unwind? Take a break at the bar/lounge, the beach bar, or the poolside bar for a tasty beverage. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

353136.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Hotel Astor, located in the Faro district of Jesolo, just a short stroll from Jesolo Beach. Take a refreshing dip in our seasonal outdoor pool, borrow a bicycle for a leisurely ride, or unwind in our ocean-view bar/lounge, Astor Restaurant, serving delicious Italian cuisine. Start your day with our complimentary buffet breakfast. The hotel offers 80 air-conditioned rooms with private balconies, LCD TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Caribe Bay Jesolo and Piazza Mazzini are a short drive away.

353147.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including outdoor tennis courts, an indoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). 353164.description: Boasting a private beach and a rooftop terrace with a whirlpool and sun loungers, Hotel Cleofe provides free WiFi and free bicycles. It is located in Caorle, conveniently close to both the beach and the historical city center. The air-conditioned rooms are bright and well-furnished, offering all modern comforts including a satellite TV and a bathroom with free toiletries. Meals and drinks can also be enjoyed outside on the terrace and the Cleofe's bar. Gluten-free breakfast is available on request. A relaxing Turkish bath is available at extra costs.

353168.description: This charming hotel, located in Lido di Jesolo, offers 76 welcoming rooms, providing a perfect retreat at the end of the day. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel and the convenience of a 24-hour reception. While cots are unavailable, the Croce di Malta offers a range of amenities for a comfortable stay. Managed by attentive staff, the hotel boasts a refreshing pool, inviting sun loungers, and easy access to a beautiful private beach just steps away. The hotel's skilled chef masterfully blends seaside and countryside culinary traditions, offering a delightful dining experience from breakfast to dinner.

353176.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. 353194.description: Enjoy modern conveniences like complimentary Wi-Fi and a vending machine at Autohotel Venezia in Mirano. The hotel features 214 air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs, digital programming, and private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Express check-in/check-out and a 24-hour front desk are available. The hotel is within a 15-minute drive of Villa XXV Aprile and Ferretto Square, and conveniently located near Padova Industrial Area and Porto Marghera.

353197.description: Offering air-conditioned accommodations and free parking, Hotel Righetto Fronte Mare is located right on its own private beach in Cavallino, with connections to Venice. It features a sun terrace, garden and restaurant. All rooms at the Righetto are functionally furnished and come with a flat-screen TV, private bathroom and tiled floors. Wi-Fi is available in all common areas at no extra charge. Some rooms boast a balcony. Guests can enjoy a library at reception, or relax in a TV room at ground floor. Bikes are also available. A seasonal snack bar is open until late. From mid-May until the end of September, a rich buffet breakfast with sweet and savory items is served on the sea-view terrace. It's available at the restaurant in the remaining months. At the restaurant, guests can also enjoy local and international cuisine for dinner. Set between the Venetian Lagoon and the Adriatic Sea, the property lies 7. 5 mi away from Jesolo. About 6. 2 mi away, you can find Punta Sabbioni Port, for ferry connections to Venice across the lagoon.

353201.description: Located a short walk from the town center and close to public transportation, Rathaus Wein & Design offers convenient access to local attractions. This historic hotel, built in 1918, features 39 rooms and provides complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. A 24-hour reception and on-site parking are available for guests' convenience. Airport transfers are also provided (fees may apply).

353207.description: Hotel Bellevue is set in the centre of Caorle, 50 metres from the sea shore. Guests have free access to its private beach, while all air-conditioned rooms come with a balcony and large windows. All en suite rooms have wooden furnishings, a satellite TV, a fridge and tiled floors. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout. At the Bellevue a continental buffet breakfast is served daily in the dining room. It includes fresh fruit, cold cuts and eggs, as well as pastries and cakes. The restaurant offers both local and international cuisine. Guests can also enjoy a drink at the bar. You can try the different food and beverage tasting activities offered by the Lison-Pramaggiore Wine Route near Portogruaro with a 25-minute drive. Jesolo is located less than 27 km away.

The six air-conditioned rooms offer flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Room service is available during limited hours. Additional amenities include express check-in/check-out and multilingual staff.

353275.description: Located in the peaceful residential district of Hietzing, Hotel Cortina is only a 5-minute walk from the Ober Sankt Veit Underground Station. Free WiFi is provided in all rooms and in the public areas of the hotel. The Cortina Hotel’s quiet and modern rooms offer cable TV, a safe, and a bathroom with hairdryer. In the morning, guests can enjoy a continental breakfast buffet. A wide range of drinks and snacks is available in the vending machine in the Lobby. Schönbrunn Palace can be reached by underground (line U4) in 6 minutes, and Vienna’s city centre in 15 minutes.
