There are a total of 57 guest rooms at Portofino. The property includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and units. The hotel provides 24-hour reception. 
 Hotel Portofino in Lido di Jesolo offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and balconies. Each room includes a work desk, TV, and free WiFi.

353284.description: This 4 star hotel is located within the city of Vienna and was established in 1896. It is close to the Volksoper and the nearest station is U2, U6. All 59 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer and safe.

353290.description: Re-opened in April 2015 after a complete renovation, Seminarhotel Springer Schlößl enjoys a quiet location in a scenic, protected park a 12-minute walk from Schönbrunn Palace. Free in-room WiFi and free private parking are available. The individually furnished rooms overlook the park and feature satellite TV and a bathroom with a hairdryer. The Springer Schlößl Seminarhotel features a restaurant with a garden dining area, as well as a bar open until 23:00. 2 charging stations for electric cars are available on site. The large Schönbrunn Park is just steps away, and Vienna Zoo is a 12-minute walk away. Schönbrunn Underground Station (line U4) is a 10-minute walk away and provides direct connections to Vienna’s city center.

353338.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Hotel Luna, just a short walk from Bibione Beach. Take a dip in the seasonal outdoor pool, unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar, and savor delicious meals at our restaurant. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Our 102 air-conditioned rooms offer private balconies, minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable TV. Hotel amenities also include concierge service, free self-parking, a 24-hour front desk, and an elevator. Nearby attractions include Bibione Thermae and Luna Park Adriatico.

353340.description: The Canada Hotel is a real find. Not because of any luxuries it might offer, but because of its price and its location, right in the heart of Venice and exactly midway between the Rialto Bridge and the Piazza San Marco. Overlooking San Lio, one of Venice's many historical squares ('Campielli'), the 2-star Canada Hotel was once a typical Venetian home. Nowadays it offers a peaceful and welcoming atmosphere, combined with a helpful and personal service, and one of Venice's most sought-after locations. Guests staying at the Canada should note that the hotel has no elevator, but it does offer a great place from which to explore and discover this most fascinating of European cities. Guests should note that local city tax is not included in the rate booked. This will be charged directly to guests by the hotel and payable at check in.

Hotel Germania is a short walk from Bibione Beach, Bibione Thermae, and Luna Park Adriatico.

The nearest public transport stop is San Marco - Calle Vallaresso. From Venice Airport, take the Alilaguna Arancio line; from Piazzale Roma or the train station, take ACTV Vaporetto Line 1.

353370.description: Just 250 metres from St Mark’s Square and 450 metres from the Rialto Bridge, Ca’ Del Nobile is in Venice’s centre. It offers air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi. Set in an 18th-century building, accommodation at Nobile includes Baroque-style curtains and old walnut furniture. All rooms have a TV and a free minibar. Staff are available 24-hours a day and can recommend the best local restaurants. Ca’ Del Nobile is a 5-minute walk from Teatro La Fenice and the Doge’s Palace. The nearest Vaporetto stops are San Marco and Rialto.

353375.description: Rosenberger Seminar-Hotel Deutsch-Wagram on the S1 motorway is 12 mi from Vienna’s city center and offers free WiFi and soundproof rooms with air conditioning. The spacious rooms furthermore feature a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a work desk, and a bathroom with hairdryer. Austrian and international dishes made from regional products are served at the air-conditioned restaurant. Free newspapers are available for breakfast. Free parking is available at the service area. The village of Deutsch-Wagram is 4. 3 mi away from Seminar-Hotel Deutsch-Wagram.

The 133 guestrooms offer minibars and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. For your convenience, phones, safes, and blackout drapes/curtains are also provided. The hotel is conveniently located near Jesolo Beach (0. 1 mi), Caribe Bay Jesolo (0. 6 mi), and other attractions. The preferred airport is Marco Polo Airport (VCE), 23 miles away.

353408.description: This cosy property guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 3 units. Villa Berghinz does not operate a 24-hour reception.

353412.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace at Hotel La Calcina, located in Venice's Dorsoduro district, just a short walk from the Peggy Guggenheim Museum and Teatro La Fenice. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The hotel offers a restaurant, room service (limited hours), and a bar/lounge for a relaxing evening. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast served from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. An airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. The 25 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Each room includes a detached private bathroom with a bathtub or shower, complimentary toiletries, and a bidet. Safes and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily.

353429.description: With a total of 12 rooms, this is a nice place to stay. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. Unfortunately, the front desk is not open 24 hours. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

353432.description: CIN code: IT027042A1FQNQGS5M Hotel San Zulian is your choice for a stay in the heart of Venice, 328 feet from St. Marks Square. The courteous staff will immediately make you feel at home. The property dates back to 1800 but has been completely modernized. Each guest room comes with air conditioning, satellite TV, and free Wi-Fi access. A number of the rooms at San Zulian have a romantic view across the rooftops of Venice, including St. Marks bell tower, and some are located in the annex.

353441.description: The hotel consists of 51 rooms. Everyone staying at this accommodation may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Montecarlo. There is no 24-hour reception.

353493.description: The establishment comprises 47 cosy guest rooms. Those staying at this property may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. This hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. Guests will enjoy a fun stay at this hotel with a huge offer of entertainment facilities.

353526.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and a television in a common area. Additional amenities at this hotel include tour/ticket assistance, a banquet hall, and a vending machine. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 90 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

353537.description: There are a total of 52 rooms at Garden Sea. Clients may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. The front desk offers 24-hour reception.

353564.description: Opened in 2013, this stylish hostel caters to budget-conscious travelers who appreciate quality accommodation. This modern, bright yellow building offers a superb location in a quiet residential area, just 15 minutes from the city center and its historical and cultural attractions. The nearest metro station is 500 meters away, and the beautiful Church of Anthony of Padua is within a 5-minute walk. Guests are checked in according to current 2G rules (vaccinated or recovered).

353566.description: Hotel Florida is the ideal place for a pleasant stay near all the main points of interest, which can be reached either on foot or by vaporetto. Located in the old town center of Venice, Hotel Florida is just a stone's throw from the Santa Lucia Train Station, in a quiet Venetian lane near the romantic Grand Canal. The stroll wends its way through the lively atmosphere of the many stores, for those who love shopping, the many bacari (Venetian inns) and the colorful neighborhood market; the architecture of the Palazzi of different styles, rich with the history and works of the great masters and their collaborators, makes for a fascinating experience. The hotel welcomes guests into a pleasant family-like atmosphere. To make your stay pleasant and unforgettable, the courteous and attentive staff is always available to provide useful information.

353583.description: Here guests will find comfort with a high level of service. This beautiful beachfront hotel is open year round yet located in a central location. A transportation network enables guests ease in reaching whatever destination guests wish, and the rooms, each with a splendid beachfront view of the expanses of the Adriatic Sea, will surprise guests with their exhaustive supply of services, from wireless internet to chromotherapy. The hotel lies next to a golf course and is 2 miles from Piazza Marconi and 2. 4 miles from Aqualandia. The Piazza Drago and Jesolo Museum of Natural History are all within 15 minutes reach. An excellent restaurant service, worthy of the most famed kitchens, furnished with the freshest of products to delight your palate, as well as a well-stocked bar area, are available to refresh travelers in every moment of the day. Not to be forgotten are the high-tech fitness room at the complete disposal of guests, the conference room for the business meetings, the Mini Club, and during summer months, daily entertainment activities organized for the children. **Acessible rooms available upon request**

353586.description:
On the island of Giudecca, the new, luxury apartments for holidays at Al Redentore di Venezia are ready to welcome you to the magical ambiance of the “Island on the Island”. 
Giudecca, the real island of Venice, is the result of years of history and religion, the sacred and the profane. It is a place where enchanting lagoon landscapes are paired with the breathtaking view of Piazza San Marco, the Palazzo Ducale, the island of San Giorgio and the historic Punta della Dogana. 

Al Redentore di Venezia is a block of Apartments remotely managed by Hotel Casa Verardo - Residenza D'Epoca located in Castello 4765, therefore not featuring a reception desk on spot. For this main reason it is fundamental all check-in procedures are accomplished prior to arrival. For privacy and security reasons, the guests can access the apartment by using an application that must be installed on the smartphone. 

In order to preserve the uniqueness of Venice, its Municipality has implemented a mandatory access fee on certain days. We wish to inform you that you can get your qr code, allowing access to the city without paying the due entrance fee through the following site: https://cda. ve. it/en/

353593.description: This establishment offers spacious, simple accommodations in a central location, just a 5-minute walk from Westbahnhof Station. Schönbrunn Imperial Palace, Gloriette, and Schönbrunn Zoo are a short 25-minute walk or 5 tram stops away. Vienna's largest shopping mall, Mariahilfer Strasse, is just steps from the hotel. Stephansplatz and St. Stephan's Cathedral, in the heart of Vienna's Old Town, are easily accessible by a 10-minute underground ride. This hotel is a great starting point for temporary stays in Vienna, offering well-equipped rooms and apartments ideal for art and culture tourists, business travelers, and families.

353599.description: Set in the lively pedestrian area in Lido di Jesolo, Albergo Colonna offers air-conditioned rooms with a private bathroom. A restaurant and a private beach area with free sun loungers and parasols are available. Rooms at Albergo Colonna all come with a satellite TV and tiled floors. Some rooms feature a balcony. Breakfast is buffet style and includes sweet and savory food. Set 3. 7 mi from the center of Lido di Jesolo, the nearest bus stop is 66 feet from the property and will take you to Punta Sabbioni in about 30 minutes.

353600.description: Located in the heart of Venice, Albergo Casa Peron is within a 10-minute walk of Piazzale Roma and the Grand Canal. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, daily continental breakfast (for a fee), and tour/ticket assistance. Each of the 11 individually furnished guestrooms features digital programming and a safe. The hotel also provides express check-in/check-out and multilingual staff. Nearby attractions include Campo Santa Margherita, Scuola Grande di San Rocco, and Ca' Foscari University, all within a short walk. Marco Polo Airport (VCE) is approximately 8. 5 miles away.

353632.description: With a small number of only 4, this accomodation is very convenient for a quiet stay. Ca' del Modena offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception.

353638.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. After a day at the private beach, you can enjoy other recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite to eat at the hotel's restaurant, which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the beach bar or the poolside bar. For your convenience, a complimentary breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Chioggia? This hotel has 2153 square feet (200 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and a meeting room. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite.

353655.address: Via Bafile, terzo accesso al mare nr.4
353655.description: Hotel Solemare - Frontemare - 3 Stelle Superior is a seafront hotel in Lido di Jesolo offering free WiFi. The air-conditioned rooms include a TV with satellite channels. Rooms feature large windows and classic décor. The private bathroom provides toiletries and, on request, a hairdryer. Some rooms have a balcony. The restaurant serves both traditional Italian and international cuisine. It also offers diet and gluten-free meals. Guests can relax on the sea-view terrace, furnished with tables and chairs. The Solemare hotel provides free bicycles for exploring the surroundings. It is 98 feet from the Via Bafile pedestrian area with shops and restaurants. The A4 motorway is 16 mi away.

353672.description: There are a total of 19 rooms at Pension San Francisco. The reception does not work around the clock.

353680.description: Enjoy garden views at Hotel Alverì in Mestre, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. A shuttle (surcharge) provides easy access to the casino and shopping center. The hotel offers a snack bar, room service, and a bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Airport and cruise terminal shuttles are available (surcharge). The 38 air-conditioned rooms include minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with showers, bidets, hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks. Hotel Alverì is a short drive from Teatro Corso and Forte Marghera, conveniently located near Ferretto Square and San Giuliano Park.

353684.description: This charming luxury guesthouse is located in the San Marco district. This cosy establishment ensures a peaceful stay with its limited number of rooms. Our friendly staff is available to assist you throughout your visit and can recommend the best activities and events to help you explore the beautiful city of Venice. Please note that we do not have 24-hour reception, so don't hesitate to contact the property before your arrival. Additionally, we do not offer breakfast, pets are not allowed, and the property has no elevator.

353691.description: Facing the beachfront, Hotel Parigi offers 3-star accommodations in Caorle and has free bikes, shared lounge and terrace. Located around a 3-minute walk from Spiaggia di Ponente, the hotel with free WiFi is also 0. 9 miles away from Prima Baia Beach. Guests can enjoy Italian and Mediterranean dishes at the restaurant or have a drink at the bar. At the hotel, rooms are equipped with a desk. Complete with a private bathroom equipped with a bidet and a hairdryer, the rooms at Hotel Parigi have a flat-screen TV and air conditioning, and some rooms contain a balcony. All guest rooms have a safety deposit box. Breakfast is available each morning, and includes continental, Italian and gluten-free options. Guests at the accommodation will be able to enjoy activities in and around Caorle, like cycling. Popular points of interest near Hotel Parigi include Spiaggia di Levante, Duomo Caorle and Madonna dell'Angelo Sanctuary. The nearest airport is Venice Marco Polo Airport, 33 miles from the hotel.

353694.description: Set in 16404 ft² of parkland in Bibione Pineda center, Hotel San Marco is a 5-minute walk from the sea. It offers a salt-water pool and free use of its private beach. Free facilities at the San Marco Hotel include free bike rental as well as free use of the outdoor pool with hydromassage features. A parasol, 1 sun lounger and 1 deckchair per room are included in the rate. San Marco Hotel features air-conditioned rooms with satellite TV. Free Wi-Fi is available in public areas of the hotel. San Marco restaurant serves characteristic Italian cuisine and local specialties of the Veneto Region. All meals, including the daily breakfast, are served in a large dining room overlooking the surrounding park. Set in a peaceful location, the hotel is within easy reach of attractions such as the Parco Naturale Val Grande park, just 656 feet away.

353696.description: Hotel Astoria lies directly of its private beach, in a quiet location close to Caorle's historical center. The restaurant offers a beautiful sea view. The hotel's private beach offers free use of dressing cabins, parasols and deck chairs. You can also rent bicycles. Hotel Astoria is fully air conditioned, and has a cozy bar with a large lounge and TV room. Check out the new add-on option when booking and guarantee your half-board and full board service in advance.

353714.description: Offering a rooftop pool with views of the surrounding, Hotel Di Giovanni is 1969 feet from its private beach. It is in Bibione center, 328 feet from the pedestrian area. Rooms feature light-wood furniture and colorful details. Each one is complete with air conditioning, satellite TV and a balcony, some overlooking the garden. Guests enjoy free use of 1 parasol, 1 deckchair and 1 sun lounger at the beach. Guests can relax on the property’s terrace, furnished with chairs, tables and sun loungers. A free bike rental service is offered at reception. Hotel Di Giovanni offers free parking and is located 6. 2 mi from Lignano Sabbiadoro. San Michele al Tagliamento and Latisana Station can be reached by car in around 20 minutes.

353720.description: This cosy property guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 10 accomodation units.

353722.description: Hotel Casa Petrarca is set along a canal in central Venice, between St. Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge. It offers rooms in a historic 14th-century building. The Petrarca features simply furnished rooms with either private bathrooms or a shared bathroom. Rooms with private bathrooms also have air conditioning. Every morning, classical, jazz or new age music is played in the Petrarca's dining room where your classic Italian breakfast is served. Located in a quiet and characteristic Venetian street, the Casa Petrarca is just a 5-minute walk from the Rialto Bridge. Vaporettos, characteristic public boats, stop at the nearby Rialto Station and can connect you to the Santa Lucia Railway Station.

353747.description: Centrally located in Venice, Hotel San Luca offers guests a convenient and comfortable stay just steps from Palazzo Contarini del Bovolo and a short walk from St. Mark's Square. This family-friendly hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, an on-site restaurant and bar/lounge, and concierge services. Each of the 14 guestrooms features a minibar, private bathroom, and coffee/tea maker. Guests can also enjoy a daily buffet breakfast (fee applies). Nearby attractions include the Rialto Bridge and St. Mark's Basilica.

353748.description: Located in a renovated building dating from 1904, Hotel-Pension Wild offers a very quiet location in the elegant Josefstadt district, only a 5-minute walk away from the Ringstraße boulevard. Free WiFi is available. Ironing facilities are available at the reception free of charge, while all rooms feature a hairdryer and fan. City maps and information material are available free of charge at Hotel-Pension Wild. You can also use the luggage storage free of charge.

353756.description: Located in Raabs an der Thaya, 28 miles from Telč Historic Center, JUFA Hotel Waldviertel has accommodations with a garden, free private parking, a terrace and a restaurant. The property is around 28 miles from Chateau Telč, 21 miles from Heidenreichstein Castle and 22 miles from Vranov nad Dyjí Chateau. The accommodation provides a sauna, free WiFi and family rooms. All rooms at the hotel come with a seating area, a flat-screen TV with cable channels and a private bathroom with a hairdryer and a shower. The rooms feature a desk. The breakfast offers buffet, continental or vegetarian options. JUFA Hotel Waldviertel has a playground. You can play table tennis at this 3-star hotel, and the area is popular for hiking and cycling. Ottenstein Castle is 27 miles from the accommodation, while Bus Station Telč is 29 miles from the property.

name.content: Living Hotel an der Oper by Derag

353774.description: Centrally located in Vienna, the eco-certified Living Hotel an der Oper is steps from the Vienna State Opera and a short walk to Naschmarkt. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge service, and on-site shopping. A buffet breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel offers 42 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a refrigerator, free minibar items, a flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, dry cleaning/laundry services, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and an airport shuttle (surcharge). Nearby attractions include the Albertina and Hofburg Imperial Palace.

353779.description: Hotel Oostereiland is a renovated prison building, boasting a unique Markermeer lake-side location. It offers rooms, some set in the former jail cells, with free Wi-Fi and private bathrooms. Featuring the original cell doors, the rooms are cozy decorated from the inside with modern furnishings and a work desk. Each has a private bathroom with free toiletries provided. Guests can enjoy a drink or meal at the restaurants terrace, located on the prison’s courtyard. From Oostereiland Hotel, it’s just 1640 feet to the historic center of Hoorn. The train station, offering connections to Amsterdam, is 0. 7 mi away.

353784.description: Hotel Picobello Pineta offers a free outdoor pool with hydromassage and is located just 250 metres from its private beach in Lido di Jesolo, where guests can reserve an umbrella and two sunbeds for an additional €15 per day. The property also features a restaurant and a bar, as well as rooms with a balcony. These simply furnished rooms come with a safe and a flat-screen satellite TV with Sky TV. Each has a private bathroom with hairdryer and free toiletries. WiFi is free in public areas. Hotel Picobello Pineta serves a sweet and savoury buffet breakfast daily. The restaurant specialises in regional cuisine. Bikes can be rented on site and guests can use them for free for the first 2 hours. Offering free private parking, this hotel is 6. 5 km from Lido di Jesolo Train Station. Aqualandia Water Park is a 15-minute drive away. The bathing season is open from 25th May to 11st September. Due to regional restrictions, air conditioning can be used from 25th May to 11st September.

353795.description: The hotel consists of 33 accomodation units. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. MyPlace City Centre does not operate a 24-hour reception.

353815.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this accomodation. Travellers can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the accomodation. BHR Boutique Locanda Ca Valeri does not offer 24-hour reception.

353816.description: Set in the most tranquil, green and charming neighborhood of Lido, Hotel Villa Orio e Beatrice is found in the Alberoni area, 1640 feet from the Circolo Golf Venezia. Rooms offer free wired internet. Hotel Villa Orio e Beatrice offers an enchanting and exclusive view of the sun setting over the Venetian lagoon. The journey to Venice, by bus and water-bus, takes approximately 40 minutes. Hotel Villa Orio e Beatrice is surrounded by a cool garden and features comfortable lounge areas. Rooms are tastefully furnished and feature air conditioning and a private bathroom with shower. Breakfast includes cold meats and cheeses, cakes and pastries, yogurt and fresh fruit. Hotel Villa Orio e Beatrice is surrounded by many restaurants, bars and markets. It is near a pine wood and Alberoni Beach, one of the widest and most well-kept on Lido Island.

353819.description: This charming apartment complex offers a convenient location just 3. 5 kilometers from Vienna's old town, next to a Line 1 metro stop and only 12 minutes from the city center. Visitors will find Karlsplatz station, the famous Kärntner Straße with its many shops, the Hofburg Palace, and the Opera nearby. Ideal for travelers wishing to enjoy the freedom of self-catering accommodation, this complex provides various studios and apartments fully equipped for guests to feel right at home. All units come with a fully equipped kitchen and LCD cable TV. Complimentary Wi-Fi is also offered. On-site services at this pet-friendly establishment include a wellness area, parking, and a sunny terrace perfect for the warmer months. Guests can also take advantage of complimentary city maps available at the complex.

353832.description: This cosy property guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 4 rooms. Old Vienna Apartments does not operate a 24-hour reception.

353834.description: Hotel Rio is located in the centre of Venice, just 250 metres from Saint Mark’s Square. Free WiFi access is available in all areas. Each room here will provide you with a satellite flat-screen TV, air conditioning and an electric kettle. Featuring a shower, the private bathroom also comes with towels, free toiletries and a hairdryer. At Hotel Rio you will find a mini-market. Other facilities offered at the property include a shared lounge, luggage storage and shops (on site). Rialto Bridge is a 10-minute walk from the property. Venezia Santa Lucia Train Station is 2. 5 km away.

353838.description: The hotel comprises 33 cosy rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception.

353843.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a seasonal outdoor pool and rooftop terrace. This hotel also offers complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting/childcare services. Savor a meal at the restaurant, a snack at the coffee shop/café, or enjoy room service. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to noon. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Guests can use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 58 air-conditioned guest rooms featuring flat-screen televisions and private balconies. Bathrooms have showers, bidets, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Bibione Beach is a short stroll away (0. 2 km).

353846.description: Located on the seafront in Lido di Jesolo, Hotel Delle Mimose offers free parking, free bike rental, and a private beach. One parasol and 2 sun loungers are available for each room. There is also a large outdoor swimming pool. All rooms are air conditioned and come with wood floors, satellite TV and a private bathroom. Some have a balcony, others sea views. Breakfast at the Mimose is buffet style, while the restaurant serves Italian cuisine and local specialties at dinner. Drinks are available from the bar. The hotel is 16 mi from Venice, which can be reached by ferry from Punta Sabbioni.

353858.description: The new, modern 4-star Hotel Eraclea Palace lies in a quiet position in Eraclea Mare, a few minutes' walk from the sandy beach and the pine wood and 1640 foot from our parasol. Each guest has access to 1 parasol and 2 sun loungers for an extra fee. Wi-Fi is free throughout while parking is available at an extra fee. The Palace offers 2 heated swimming pools, a sun terrace, a gym and a wellness center with sauna and Turkish bath. During summer, a beauty center is also available. The American pool bar, the cocktail bar and the restaurant provide drinks, snacks and meals.

353873.description: Hotel Negresco features a total of 40 guest rooms. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Visitors are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception.

353889.description: With a total of 3 accomodation units, this is a nice place to stay. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. The hotel provides 24-hour reception.

353894.description: Residence Eleonora guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 6 guest rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. Unfortunately, the front desk is not open 24 hours.

353906.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Hotel Parigi, a short walk from Bibione Beach in San Michele al Tagliamento. This upscale hotel offers a private beach, spa tub, fitness center, and an on-site restaurant with room service. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a buffet breakfast. The 90 air-conditioned rooms feature private balconies, refrigerators, flat-screen TVs, and en suite bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Conveniently located near Bibione Thermae and Luna Park Adriatico, Hotel Parigi is also within easy reach of other local attractions. Free self-parking is available.

353919.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this establishment. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. Locanda Antico Fiore offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night.

353925.description: San Marco guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 3 units.

353929.description: Head down to the water and enjoy a day at the private beach, or take advantage of other recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and an outdoor tennis court. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, babysitting (surcharge), and an arcade/game room. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's poolside restaurant, which features a bar/lounge and a pool view. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe. 354436.description: The Leonardo Hotel Vienna Schönbrunn is conveniently situated near the west gateway of Vienna. The underground can be accessed in the direct vicinity of the hotel. It will only take you a few minutes to travel to Vienna's city centre and to the world-renowned 'Schloss Schonbrunn'. Vienna's most famous shopping mile, the 'Mariahilfer Strasse', and the 'Westbahnhof' can also be accessed in just 5 minute's time via the underground. 204 Charged parking-garage spaces are located underneath the hotel.

Stadtpark and Kärntnerstraße are also within walking distance. Accommodation units with cable TV and free WiFi are offered. This property is a self check in hotel and does not serve breakfast. 354442.description: Enjoy the convenience of complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance, along with a daily buffet breakfast (available for a fee). Legrenzi Rooms is a reserved and comfortable environment with an essential taste that combines style and design. We are located in the center of Mestre, Venice.

The Corte Legrenzi, through which you enter the Hotel, is an exclusive and peaceful place that is characterized by the quality of the shops and the locals such as trattorias, restaurants and cafes.

A few meters away you will find public parking, or on request the private parking, also in the immediate vicinity there are convenient public transport (bus and tram) that allow you to reach Venice in a few minutes.

354470.description: Hotel Korotan is located in Vienna's 8th district (Josefstadt) and it is 1km away from the City hall (Rathaus) and Parliament. With a total of 24 guest rooms from October to June and 57 guest rooms in July, August and September, this is a nice place to stay. The establishment includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and rooms.

354475.description:
The Hotel Restaurant Höldrichsmühle is a private Hotel located in beautiful nature of the Vienna Woods with easy access from Airport (30 min by car) or from Vienna via car (30 min). railway and bus.

354490.description: Only 492 feet from its own private beach, the 3-star Emperador is 1. 2 mi south of Lido di Jesolo’s center and offers free parking. Rooms are bright and air conditioned and feature a balcony. The on-site restaurant specializes in Italian cuisine and dishes based on meat and fish. Breakfast includes both sweet and savory products. Each room at Hotel Emperador comes with satellite TV and a private bathroom complete with shower and free toiletries. A bus stops 164 feet away and links with the city center, while the bus stopping 328 feet away takes you to Punta Sabbioni beach.

354496.description: Set in Venice's historic center, Hotel Marte is a 5-minute walk from Santa Lucia Station. It offers air-conditioned rooms with private bathrooms. Some rooms overlook Venice's canals. Staff can offer tourist information and tips on good local restaurants. Guglie, the nearest Vaporetto stop, is 328 feet from the Marte Hotel. The bus station at Piazzale Roma is a 10-minute walk away, while you can reach St Mark’s Square in 20 minutes on foot.

354502.description: The hotel comprises a total of 38 snug guest rooms. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Aparthotel Residenz Florida. The hotel provides an entertainment programme and leisure activities for guests' added convenience.

354507.description: Enjoy garden views at Hotel Schwalbe in Vienna's Ottakring district, and take advantage of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The hotel offers a restaurant, room service, and a bar/lounge for your convenience. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). For events, the hotel provides conference space and a meeting room. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Each of the 16 guestrooms features a flat-screen television with cable programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with designer toiletries and a hairdryer, a phone, complimentary newspapers, and an electric kettle. Hotel Schwalbe is a 5-minute drive from Mariahilfer Street and the Vienna Christmas Market, and conveniently located near Lugner City, Wiener Stadthalle, and Vienna General Hospital. It is 2. 9 miles from Schönbrunn Palace and 3. 3 miles from the Vienna State Opera.

354508.description: Situated in the heart of Austria's cosmopolitan capital city, this hotel offers comfortable accommodation on a quiet side street just off Vienna's main shopping boulevard, Mariahilfer Straße. It is within easy reach of the city's historic quarter and guests will find many atmospheric cafés and restaurants nearby. Vienna Airport is 23 km from the property. This is a popular choice with tourists and business travellers alike. All the rooms have a fully-equipped bathroom with shower and/or bath tub and hairdryer, as well as satellite TV and safe. There is also an apartment option, which includes a kitchenette. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast that is served in the pleasant dining with friendly atmosphere. Those arriving by car may use the hotel car park.

354510.description: Located on the beachfront in Caorle, Hotel Savoy is right opposite its own private beach area and has an outdoor swimming pool. It also offers free parking. All rooms have modern décor and boast a private bathroom, an LCD TV with satellite channels, and a terrace or balcony overlooking the Adriatic Sea. A work desk is also available. The restaurant at Savoy Hotel serves a wide variety of dishes, including fish and meat specialties. You can start your day with a sweet and savory buffet breakfast, which is served in the breakfast hall with a small terrace. The private beach is equipped with 1 parasol and 2 sun loungers per room. A hot tub and a fitness room are available, and the swimming pool is surrounded by sun loungers. Central Caorle is a 10-minute walk from the hotel. The world-famous city of Venice is 50 mi away. A shuttle service to Venice and Treviso Airports is available upon request.

Additional amenities include concierge services, room service (limited hours), a bar/lounge, express check-in/out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. 354582.description: A total of 56 rooms are available for guests' convenience at Universo.

354601.description: Relax on the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities such as a spa tub and a seasonal outdoor pool. You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Hotel Cambridge, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, a safe deposit box at the front desk, and an elevator. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 70 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets.

354607.description: Located in Lido di Jesolo, a 4-minute walk from Lido di Jesolo, Casa Bianca Al Mare provides accommodations with free bikes, free private parking, a seasonal outdoor swimming pool and a garden. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, a shared lounge and room service, along with free WiFi throughout the property. Guests can use a bar. At the hotel, rooms come with a desk. Each room has air conditioning and a flat-screen TV, and certain rooms at Casa Bianca Al Mare have a sea view. Guest rooms include a safety deposit box. The accommodation offers 4-star accommodations with a hot tub and terrace. Staff speak German, English, Spanish and French at the 24-hour front desk. Caribe Bay is 1. 7 miles from Casa Bianca Al Mare, while Caorle Archaeological Sea Museum is 16 miles away. The nearest airport is Venice Marco Polo Airport, 20 miles from the hotel.

354613.description: Hotel Majestic offers a relaxing beachfront getaway in Jesolo. Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden, or take a dip in the outdoor pool. The hotel features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall. Savor a meal at the restaurant, or order room service for a private dining experience. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The 57 guestrooms offer minibars, private balconies, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Caribe Bay Jesolo and Piazza Mazzini are within a 15-minute walk.

354615.description: This pet-friendly hotel boasts a prime location in a quiet side street in the centre of Vienna, just off the main avenues, offering simple yet impeccable and comfortable accommodation for visitors to the Austrian capital. It is within walking distance of the historic Spittelberg quarter, the main museums and the popular Naschmarkt open air market, and offers easy access to public transport services, including buses to the airport. There is a public car park nearby and the hotel provides parking spaces for bikes. Accommodation is in modern rooms that can sleep up to four guests, all with a fully-equipped bathroom and satellite TV. There is complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel and a buffet breakfast is served each morning. The friendly reception staff are on duty 24 hours and are always willing to provide guests with any help or advice they may need. There is also a safe at reception.

354622.description:
This welcoming property guarantees a peaceful stay, thanks to its limited capacity of just 15 units. All guests can enjoy Wi-Fi throughout the property. Each room features light décor, refined wooden elements, carpeted floors, and an LCD TV. Start your day with freshly baked croissants and coffee. The hotel restaurant offers both international cuisine and regional Venetian specialties.

354660.description: Relax on the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and an outdoor tennis court. This hotel offers 60 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a minibar, safe, desk, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a variety of amenities, including a rooftop terrace with city views, bicycle rentals, a restaurant with room service (limited hours), and a bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available for a fee. Additional services include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge applies). 354883.description: The hotel features a total of 20 units. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Everyone staying at this accommodation are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. Some services of Alexander Guesthouse may be payable.

354920.description: Built in 1773 and recently renovated, Hotel Bären Suhr offers modern comfort near the romantic city of Aarau. Its convenient location between Highway A1 and Aarau city center provides easy access to both urban attractions and the beautiful Swiss countryside. The hotel features comfortable furnishings, an excellent restaurant serving fresh, seasonal cuisine, and on-site parking. All rooms include a WC/shower, direct-dial phone, radio alarm, TV, fax/PC access, complimentary coffee and mineral water, and optional air conditioning.

355004.description: Located in Zurich's Old Town, Hotel California is just steps from the Bellevue Tram and Bus Stop and Zurich Lake. The hotel offers free Wi-Fi, a computer station, and an on-site American restaurant and cocktail bar, Papa Joe's, serving burgers, chicken wings, and fajitas. Guests can enjoy a rich breakfast buffet or choose from a breakfast menu. Colorfully decorated rooms feature a mini-bar, cable TV, and a bathroom with a bathtub or shower. Nearby attractions include the Opera House and Grossmünster Church, both within a short walk. Zurich Main Train Station is 0. 7 miles away.

355027.description: Formerly an industrial area, now with new clubs, global companies, contemporary museums - the neighbourhood surrounding the 25hours Hotel Zurich West thrives on change. To Alfredo Häberli, it is a location that deserves a special splash of colour. The designer from Zurich is known for his designs for Alias, Camper, Iittala, Luceplan, Vitra, and Moroso. He came up with the entire interior design concept. He combines new and classic design elements, creates colour worlds and illustrations in the rooms in juxtaposition with the modern setting. The central bar in the lobby is a marketplace for hotel guests, locals, and the neighbourhood's scene kids. During the day, it offers workspaces and a relaxed atmosphere for meetings. For a lunch at noon, after work for a drink, pre-drinking before going clubbing, and everything inbetween. Always included: The view over the little Hard Turm Park.

355042.description: With a small number of only 14, this accomodation is very convenient for a quiet stay. Unfortunately, the front desk is not open 24 hours.

355126.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 4 outdoor swimming pools, 4 spa tubs, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and complimentary use of a nearby fitness facility. At VitalBoutique Hotel Zurzacherhof, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Grab a drink at the swim-up bar while enjoying a refreshing dip in the hotel pool. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 48 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private balconies or patios. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

355156.description: The three-star Hotel Kronenhof, designed by a student of Le Corbusier in the 1960s, retains its striking original exterior while offering a charmingly updated interior. Inside, our 30 individually themed boutique rooms await, each thoughtfully decorated to preserve the building's unique character and existing furnishings. While you won't find modern amenities like rainforest showers, you will discover delightful vintage touches, such as original sky-blue tiles. Every room features a private bathroom, hairdryer, and complimentary reusable water bottle for filling with fresh Zurich spring water. Enjoy a generous breakfast spread in our 'Chrönli' café, which also offers an evening wine list featuring selections from small vineyards. The adjacent 'Cinnamon-Garden' restaurant serves authentic Indian cuisine. Perfectly located for exploring Zurich, the hotel sits directly beside the Zehntenhausplatz bus stop (lines 32, 61, and 62) and a short two-minute walk from Zurich-Affoltern train station. The exhibition center is easily accessible in 10 minutes by public transport, and the airport in approximately 22 minutes. On-site underground parking is available for guests arriving by car.
