355221.description: The Hotel Spirgarten is located in Zurich-Altstetten, a short five-minute walk from the train station, providing easy access to the city center, a mere six-minute train ride away. The hotel's modern conference facilities are ideal for a variety of events, from seminars and congresses to weddings and celebrations for up to 1, 000 guests. The onsite Restaurant 8048 offers a relaxing dining experience. The hotel's 49 stylish non-smoking rooms feature modern furnishings and parquet flooring, all completely renovated. Guests enjoy complimentary access to the Altstetten swimming pool, a short three-minute walk from the hotel. Please note, a city tax of CHF 2. 50 per person, per day is payable directly to the hotel.

355300.description: Pamper yourself at the Alma Hotel's full-service spa. This Zürich hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a lobby fireplace, and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy room service (limited hours) and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM (fee applies). Additional amenities include a computer station, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Each of the 18 guestrooms features a flat-screen TV with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower, hairdryer, slippers, safe, desk, and phone with free international calls. Centrally located, the Alma Hotel is within a 5-minute drive of Bahnhofstrasse and ETH Zurich, and is conveniently close to attractions such as the Museum Bellerive and Zürich Opera House.

355305.description: The Hotel Du Parc enjoys a quiet location close to a park, just a short walk from Baden's centre, the Grand Casino and the thermal spas. Free WiFi is available in the entire hotel. You can make free use of the minibar's content once per stay. All rooms at Swiss-Belhotel du Parc provide a controlled cooling system, a bathroom, and a minibar. A free welcome drink and a bottle of mineral water are provided. Guests can prepare their own tea and coffee in the room. The restaurant Elements offers creative and regional Swiss cuisine. Children up to 10 years can enjoy complimentary dishes from the kids menu in the restaurant. Baden Train Station is only a 5-minute walk away from Swiss-Belhotel du Parc. The direct train reaches Zurich within 20 minutes and Zurich Airport can be reached within 20 minutes as well. Guests benefit from a free city ticket for leisure activities and from free access to the public transport in Baden for the duration of their stay. In addition, they can enjoy free access to the public swimming pool in Baden and free entry to various museums in the city, as well as to the Grand Casino Baden.

355316.description: The accomodation features a total of 28 guest rooms. Those staying at this property may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. This hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. Communal areas are wheelchair accessible at Flemings Hotel Zurich. The car park may be useful to those arriving by car. Some services of Flemings Hotel Zurich may be payable.

355340.description: At Hotel Hirschen & Weinschenke, exceptional service and top-notch amenities create a memorable experience for guests. Complimentary internet access is available in the hotel to ensure you stay connected during your visit. Amenities at taxi offered by Hotel Hirschen & Weinschenke simplify the organization of your excursions, tourist activities, and other adventures in Zürich. Continuously receive the support you require through front desk amenities such as concierge service, express check-in or check-out and luggage storage. At the hotel, their ticket service and tours is also capable of assisting with booking tickets and securing reservations for entertainment and adventures. Desire to unwind? Make the most of your visit at Hotel Hirschen & Weinschenke with accessible amenities such as daily housekeeping. Additionally, you can obtain minor travel essentials and miscellaneous items at the convenience stores without departing from the Hotel Hirschen & Weinschenke. Due to health concerns, smoking is strictly prohibited within the entire premises of hotel. Accommodations come equipped with all the conveniences required for a restful night's slumber. A selection of rooms at Hotel Hirschen & Weinschenke come furnished with linen service to cater to your needs and comfort. A few chosen rooms are equipped with television and cable TV to ensure guest amusement. In certain rooms, the hotel offers visitors access to a refrigerator, a coffee or tea maker, instant coffee and instant tea. Hotel Hirschen & Weinschenke offers a hair dryer, toiletries and towels in the restrooms of specific accommodations. At Hotel Hirschen & Weinschenke, each day commences with a scrumptious breakfast offered at no additional cost. An evening spent at hotel's bar can offer as much enjoyment as venturing out with your fellow travelers. At Hotel Hirschen & Weinschenke, affordable refreshments are available 24/7 through the convenient vending machines on-site.

355353.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at the eco-certified Fred Hotel Zürich Hauptbahnhof, centrally located in Zurich, a short walk from the Swiss National Museum and Bahnhofstrasse. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, a snack bar, room service (limited hours), and buffet breakfast (for a fee). The 48 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs, premium bedding, and private bathrooms. Meeting rooms and limited parking are also available.

355400.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as bicycle rentals, a terrace, and a garden. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Dine at 555+ Thai, a themed restaurant with a bar/lounge, or take advantage of room service (limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception held on select days. A continental breakfast is served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, express check-in and check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The 18 guestrooms feature free minibar items, flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Nearby attractions include the Kanzlei Flea Market (0. 4 mi), Helvetia Square (0. 4 mi), and Prime Tower (0. 8 mi). The nearest major airport is Zurich Airport (ZRH), 7. 4 miles away.

355492.description: Enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast (7:00 AM - 10:00 AM) at Hotel Marta, located in the heart of Zurich. Our 39 guestrooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi and bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Housekeeping and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. We also provide luggage storage and coffee/tea in our common area. You'll be within a 10-minute walk of ETH Zurich and Bahnhofstrasse, close to the Swiss National Museum and other key attractions.

355515.description: The accomodation comprises a total of 25 snug rooms.

355542.description: Balsthal Hotel features a total of 40 guest rooms.

355551.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a fireplace in the lobby, and a banquet hall. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 108 guestrooms featuring free minibar items and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and complimentary bottled water. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Rhine - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Hospitals Hochrhein GmbH - Spital Waldshut - 8. 8 km / 5. 5 mi- Laufen - 9. 6 km / 5. 9 mi- Southern Black Forest Nature Park - 11. 7 km / 7. 2 mi- Aargau Jura Park - 13. 1 km / 8. 1 mi- Dreispitz - 16. 5 km / 10. 2 mi- Jura Crest Trail - 17. 2 km / 10. 7 mi- Vindonissa Museum - 17. 4 km / 10. 8 mi- Schwarzer Turm - 17. 6 km / 10. 9 mi- Legionärspfad Vindonissa - 18. 2 km / 11. 3 mi- Amphitheater of Vindonissa - 18. 2 km / 11. 3 mi- Langmatt Museum - 18. 3 km / 11. 4 mi- Kultur und Kongresszentrum Trafo Baden - 18. 4 km / 11. 4 mi- Baden Historical Museum - 18. 6 km / 11. 5 mi- Stiftung Bahnpark - 18. 7 km / 11. 6 mi. The nearest major airport is Zurich Airport (ZRH) - 36. 1 km / 22. 4 mi Located in Bad Zurzach, Dorint Parkhotel Bad Zurzach is a 2-minute drive from Rhine and 10 minutes from Hospitals Hochrhein GmbH - Spital Waldshut. This spa hotel is 5. 9 mi (9. 6 km) from Laufen and 7. 2 mi (11. 7 km) from Southern Black Forest Nature Park.

355583.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a banquet hall. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a computer station, and express check-out. Planning an event in Zürich? This hotel has 215 square feet (20 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 23 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

355656.description: The establishment comprises a total of 21 snug units. Wi-Fi internet connection is available for further comfort and convenience. Gasthof Zur Waag does not operate a 24-hour reception. Travellers arriving by car will appreciate parking available at Gasthof Zur Waag. Those who stay at this establishment will appreciate the dining options available. There are business facilities and services for guests' added convenience. The property's dining venues serve a selection of flavourful dishes and beverages. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

name.content: Hotel Noma Trademark Collection By Wyndham

355674.description: Settle in with free WiFi a gym seasonal pool restaurant and ample event space at Hotel NoMa Trademark Collection by Wyndham. This popular wedding and event venue puts you 20 miles from Manhattans iconic sites like Central Park Times Square and The Empire State Building. Easily access Iona University Monroe College and Montefiore New Rochelle Hospital. Just off I-95 this contemporary hotel is 16 miles from LaGuardia Airport LGA 19 miles from Westchester County Airport HPN and 21 miles from John F. Kennedy International Airport JFK.

355726.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy a satisfying meal at Restaurant Trinity serving guests of Glärnischhof by Trinity. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Zürich? This hotel has 1604 square feet (149 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 62 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

355773.description: Near Zurich's center, B2 Hotel Zürich offers stylish, air-conditioned rooms in a former brewery. For an additional charge, guests can enjoy the public thermal bath and spa, consisting of different swimming pools, a wellness area, and a steam bath. Each room features a flat-screen satellite TV and a bathroom with a bathrobe, slippers, and a shower or tub. Free use of the minibar is included in the room rate. Free WiFi is available in all areas. The boutique hotel houses its own private library with 33, 000 books. Swiss tapas, cheese, and a wide range of wines are served at the on-site lounge. Guests can enjoy a freshly prepared breakfast each morning. B2 Hotel Zürich has an elevator and a luggage storage room. The Zurich-Enge Train Station is just an 8-minute walk away and provides direct connections to the airport. The Hürlimannplatz Bus Stop (line 66) is 656 feet from the hotel, and the Enge/Bederstrasse Tram Stop (line 13) is a 7-minute walk away.

name.content: Prize by Radisson, Zurich Affoltern am Albis

355824.description: Contemporary hotel halfway between Zurich and Zug, with free WiFi and breakfast includedJust off the A4 motorway, the Prize By Radisson, Zurich Affoltern Am Albis hotel is a 20-minute drive from central Zurich and the business hub of Zug. Frequent trains run to both destinations from Affoltern am Albis train station, three minutes' walk from the hotel. Here on business? Host up to 40 people in the hotel's three, naturally lit meeting rooms overlooking the courtyard. There's free WiFi throughout the hotel and a handy Business Centre in the lobby. Relax in front of the flatscreen TV and get a peaceful night's sleep in the hotel's smart rooms.

355954.description: At Tailormade Hotel SIHLPARK Schindellegi you will stay in bright, spacious rooms and suites. The hotel is located in the recreational area Einsiedeln - Ybrig - Lake Zurich and has meeting rooms. The Zurich exhibition center is 30 km from the hotel, the Zurich-Kloten airport can be reached in 40 min by car.

355965.description:
Mandarin Oriental Savoy, Zurich is a Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star destination in the heart of the city, offering gourmet dining and memorable experiences around Lake Zurich and its Old Town. 

Tristan Auer's refined design blends Zurich-inspired decorative influences with warm tones and modern touches. The 80 stylish rooms include 36 of the city's largest suites. 

Discover culinary delights in a captivating setting. Exquisite Italian fine-dining, international delights and an enchanting rooftop bar with panoramic views await at Mandarin Oriental Savoy, Zurich. 

Mandarin Oriental Savoy, Zurich guides you on a journey towards complete relaxation and rejuvenation. Additionally, our exclusive fitness centre encourages a holistic approach to your wellness journey in the heart of Zurich. 

Explore the vibrant cityscape of Zurich and indulge in the distinctive experiences tailored by Mandarin Oriental Savoy, Zurich.

356039.description: The world meets up at Zurich Youth Hostel. A versatile place with the right offer for every guest, whether backpackers, families or groups. On the site where a school cabin served as a hostel in 1936, there now stands a spacious new-build featuring modern infrastructure, varied cuisine, a cosy bar and a 24-hour reception. Just a stone's throw from the lake shore, it's the perfect place from which to start chilled afternoons on the lake, a discovery tour of the exciting city of Zurich, or a thrilling visit to the zoo. Enjoy the hostel's quiet yet well-connected location, its sunny inner courtyard and the bright rooms, or book a seminar room for your banquet, meeting or training session. It's practical: from Wollishofen station, there is also a direct rail connection to the airport.

356042.description: The Saint Georges Hotel, located in Zurich's city center, offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall. Enjoy a continental breakfast for a fee, served weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel also features a snack bar, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and luggage storage. Each of the 44 guestrooms includes a flat-screen TV with cable programming, a desk, and a private bathroom with a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. Housekeeping is provided daily, and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. Nearby attractions include Bahnhofstrasse, the Swiss National Museum, and Swiss Casinos Zurich, all within a short distance. Zurich Airport (ZRH) is 8. 3 miles away.

356059.description: Located in Glattbrugg, in the Swiss canton of Zürich, this brand-new hotel welcomes its guests at just 2km from the Zürich Airport. Conceived in the shape of the Swiss Cross the property is a great choice for all visitors of the area who want to be able to quickly move in and around it. The Glattbrugg Unterriet Tram Stop is just a 2-minute walk and the centre of Zürich, the lake and some of the major corporate offices it houses are all within 10km. For guests convenience the hotel offers airport shuttle service and those who decide to travel with their personal vehicles can utilize the garage parking. For dining guests can delight in the charming atmosphere of the onsite restaurant and enjoy the selection of international and regional dishes that it treats to. When the weather permits the summer terrace, surrounded by a large garden, is the perfect place for a romantic al fresco dining.

356168.description:
This family-run 3-star hotel in the center of Kloten offers 70 comfortable and bright rooms. Thanks to its central location near the Kloten train station, you can easily reach downtown Zurich and the convention center by public transportation. The rooms feature a desk, coffee and tea-making facilities, a flat-screen satellite TV, and a bathroom with a hair dryer and a makeup mirror. Numerous shops, bars, and restaurants are within easy walking distance. Parking is free during your stay, and you’ll have free access to the hotel’s fitness center. 


Reception hours: Monday through Friday from 6:30 a. m. to 8:00 p. m. 
Breakfast hours: Monday through Friday from 6:15 a. m. to 9:30 a. m. 


Reception hours: Saturday and Sunday from 7:30 a. m. to 5:00 p. m. 
Breakfast hours: Saturday, Sunday, and on holidays from 7:45 a. m. to 10:30 a. m.

356414.description: Enjoy your stay at Hotel Neufeld in Zurich's city center, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a vending machine. Restaurant Neufeld offers a satisfying dining experience, including a daily complimentary buffet breakfast (6 AM - 10 AM). The hotel also provides dry cleaning/laundry services, multilingual staff, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Each of the 40 guestrooms features a flat-screen TV with digital programming, a safe, a desk, a phone with free local calls, and a bathroom with a shower, hairdryer, and complimentary toiletries. Hotel Neufeld is a 5-minute drive from both Letzigrund Stadium and Bahnhofstrasse, and conveniently located near several attractions, including the FIFA World Football Museum and the Swiss National Museum. Zurich Airport (ZRH) is 9. 1 miles away.

356472.description: This charming hotel is conveniently located within a short walk of the town center, offering easy access to a variety of attractions and public transportation. Guests can enjoy the convenience of on-site parking and complimentary Wi-Fi in public areas. The hotel comprises 47 cozy units and features well-equipped business facilities, making it an ideal choice for both leisure and business travelers. Indulge in delectable culinary specialties at the hotel's inviting dining establishments. Please note that some services may incur additional charges.

356610.description: 'Widder Hotel Traditional? Modern? Unique. Widder Hotel is more than just a hotel. It is the gem of the Swiss luxury hotel industry, just waiting for you to discover it. Seven hundred years of history are steeped within its walls. Today's hotel is comprised of nine formerly distinct medieval houses. All the buildings have been carefully restored to ensure they retain their original character. Inside the Widder hotel you will find a striking contrast between historic building features and some of the most prominent designs of the 20th century. All of our 49 guest rooms and suites contain traces of a history stretching back over 700 years. Painted ceiling beams, ornate stone intarsia and antique furniture alongside modern design classics from the likes of Le Corbusier and Mies van der Rohe. And there's even more art waiting for you right outside your door

356706.description: Discover the Best Western® Hotel Wartmann am Bahnhof! Our modern business and city hotel is located in the very center of Winterthur, right at the railway station. The old town/shopping area is just two minutes away, Zurich Airport is reachable within 15 minutes and Zurich downtown in 19 minutes. All rooms are newly renovated and air-conditioned. The rooms offer superb sleeping comfort and are equipped with soundproof windows. Some rooms are facing our green courtyard. Explore the surrounding with our E-bikes which you can use free of charge. We are looking forward to welcoming you. A city tax of 2. 50 CHF per person per day is not included in the room rate and will be paid directly at the hotel.

356769.description: This top-class hotel is located on the banks of the River Limmat in the heart of Zurich, near the financial district and just a two-minute walk from the famous Bahnhofstrasse shopping mile. With many places of interest nearby, the Hotel zum Storchen is a perfect starting point for excursions and day trips. Breathtaking views of the Limmat River, the picturesque Weinplatz, and Zurich's historic quarter, combined with friendly service and a cozy atmosphere, ensure our guests return to our hotel time and again.

356788.description:
Located in the heart of Zürich, the Baur au Lac has stood as a family-run hotel, now in its seventh generation, renowned for outstanding hospitality. Nestled within an idyllic park, it offers spectacular views of the Swiss Alps and Lake Zurich. The hotel delights with a unique blend of history and modern flair. Its 119 rooms and suites are timelessly elegant, touched with a hint of Hollywood glamour. Just a short stroll away lie the famous Bahnhofstrasse as well as cultural highlights such as the Tonhalle and the Opera House. 
Three restaurants invite guests to savour and linger: Le Hall, perhaps the city’s most beautiful living room, the Baur’s Brasserie with European classics, and the newly opened Marguita, launched in summer 2024, with Mediterranean-inspired dishes. The state-of-the-art fitness area with sweeping views over Lake Zurich complete the offering.

357096.description: The 3* Superior hotel Townhouse is a small boutique hotel with 26 rooms, 3 spacious junior suites and the brand new Bar & Restaurant Palette. It is located in the very heart of Zurich, on Bahnhofstrasse and a block away from the main train station where direct services take you to Zurich airport in less than 15 minutes. Upon arrival, you will already notice the difference. Check-in takes place at our reception on the ground floor. This is also the place where you can relax in comfortable couches, browse through the latest magazines, or order some good Italian espresso at our restaurant. The friendly host will attend to all your needs during your stay, point out the local bars and fine restaurants, or inform you about current cultural events. You will always know what to do and where to go in Zurich. The Townhouse in downtown Zurich is more of a home than a hotel!Perfect location: Zurich Main Station is only 2 minutes walk away from the Townhouse. From here you can reach all major destinations within Switzerland: Art Basel in Basel, Hallenstadion Zurich main concert venue in Switzerland, direct trains to Swiss Alps (Titlis, Rigi, Jungfrau, etc. ). This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Extraperson CHF 50. 00, Pets are allowed with note on reservation CHF 30. 00 per night. Due to the Hotebeds H&S Standards we only assign rooms on the 1st and 2nd floor as we dont have a second staircase.

357181.description: Hotel Seerose Classic&Elements is located on Lake Hallwil, right at the Meisterschwanden ship pier. It offers attractively designed rooms, free WiFi, and free parking. All rooms are equipped with cable TV and a Nespresso coffee machine. Fine cuisine can be enjoyed in the restaurant of the Seerose Hotel, featuring a winter garden and a terrace with panoramic lake views. A wine cellar, a bar, a lounge and a beach restaurant are available as well.

357244.description: This affordable accommodation enjoys a great location in the heart of Madrid, very near to the majestic Plaza de Oriente, the Royal Palace, the Royal Theatre, the Almudena Cathedral, the busy Puerta del Sol, with famous landmarks, and the Plaza Mayor, with traditional shops, restaurants and cafes. It is also close to the Plaza de España, with its monuments to Cervantes, Don Quixote and Sancho Panza, and the Gran Vía, Madrid's main and most famous thoroughfare, with clothes shops, restaurants, cinemas and emblematic buildings. Art lovers will be in their element in Madrid with the world-renowned 'Golden Triangle' (the Prado, Thyssen and Reina Sofia art museums) and a stay in this city would not be complete without a visit to the spectacular Retiro park. The property offers Wi-Fi, 24-hour reception and luggage storage and the rooms have air-conditioning, heating, TV, safe and bathroom.

357245.description: Hostal Art Madrid is located in the center of Madrid. It offers air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs, plus free Wi-Fi throughout. The rooms at Hostal Art have a private bathroom with toiletries and a hairdryer. 24 hour reception and security service. This budget hostel is located a minute walk from the Tirso de Molina metro stop, 1.5 km from the Prado Museum and a 13-minute walk from the Royal Palace of Madrid.

357246.description: The Hostal Inter Plaza Mayor, located mere steps from Madrid's Plaza Mayor and a short walk from Puerta del Sol and the Royal Palace, offers 31 comfortable guest rooms with private bathrooms. Guests can enjoy amenities such as 24-hour reception, Wi-Fi in public areas, and luggage storage. Air conditioning and safety deposit boxes are available for rent. Please note, pets are not allowed.

357267.description: Built in 2013, this charming hotel is located in Mitte, a short walk from major entertainment venues. Excellent transport links within 300 meters provide easy access to explore the surrounding area. The hotel offers a 24-hour reception and dedicated family rooms perfect for those traveling with young children. Each individually decorated room features contemporary art, a flat-screen smart TV, and tea/coffee making facilities. Business travelers will appreciate the on-site meeting and event spaces. Limited parking is available for €20. 00 per night.

357272.description: This lovely and charming hotel offers comfortable accommodations right in the residential Flushing neighbourhood in the Queens district in the amazing city of New York, where visitors will be able to discover its ethnic and cultural variety and enjoy the delicious restaurants in the surrounding area. The hotel features spacious, well-appointed guest rooms with state-of-the-art media and comfortable amenities for a memorable stay, including complimentary wireless Internet connection to keep updated and an en-suite bathroom with superior toiletries for added convenience. The hotel also counts with an exclusively expansive roof-top outdoor garden and other amazing facilities with spectacular panoramic views of Manhattan skyline.

357348.description:
Located in the commercial centre of Athens, Mc Queen is less than a 7-minute walk from Keramikos Metro Station and the lively Gazi area. 

WiFi is offered throughout. 
The air-conditioned apartments at Mc Queen Rooms & Apartments are minimally decorated. Each includes a kitchenette with kettle, fridge and microwave and comes equipped with a satellite LCD TV, safe and hairdryer. 

Guests can start their day with a continental breakfast served daily 08:00-11:00 at the garden or in the apartment. 

VIP Transportation from Athens International Airport, as well as excursions in famous landmarks outside Athens can be arranged on request and upon charge. 

The Reception Hours : 07:30 - 15:30. 
Please contact us to receive the Entry Code for the Entrace and collect an envelope with your room key. 
You can proceed with the Check in Procedure the next day.

357498.description: Enjoy a peaceful stay at Quinta De Malta, a charming hotel with ten guest rooms renovated in 2004. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. Please note the reception desk does not operate 24/7, and cribs are unavailable. Quinta De Malta prioritizes accessibility and offers wheelchair-accessible accommodations. On-site parking and business facilities cater to corporate travelers, while a range of entertainment options ensures an engaging stay.

357719.description:
In JC Rooms Santa Ana discover a new concept of accommodation and a different place to stay, located in the heart of Madrid, a few meters from the Puerta del Sol, Gran Via, Cibeles, Callao, Chueca, and places of interest in the city. Establishing JC Rooms Santa Ana, brand new, renovated and opened in October 2010.
Accounts rooms with air conditioning, flat-screen TV and a safe, decorated with a inspired by a different region of Spain theme.
This is a 5 minute walk from the Plaza Mayor of Madrid, 8 minutes' walk from Plaza Spain and 1 km from the Prado

357780.address: Rua De Santa Maria - Largo Da Oliveira
357780.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. For lunch or dinner, stop by HOOL, a restaurant that specializes in Mediterranean cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Meet other guests and eat at the complimentary reception. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. A complimentary self-serve breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and laundry facilities. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 20 guestrooms featuring tablet computers and plasma televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

357784.description: With a total of 8 accomodation units, this is a nice place to stay. Everyone staying at this accommodation can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the establishment. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Guests are welcomed at the environmentally-friendly establishment. Some services of Hostal Casa Bueno may be payable.

357786.description: Located in Cairo's Heliopolis district, Beirut Hotel offers a comfortable stay with convenient access to City Stars and Khan el-Khalili, both within a 10-minute drive. Enjoy on-site amenities including a restaurant, bar/lounge, and 24-hour room service. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, and take advantage of the 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Each of the 91 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, flat-screen TV with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include a bathtub or shower, and conveniences such as a safe and daily housekeeping are provided. A complimentary 24-hour airport shuttle is also available. Nearby attractions include the Baron Empain Palace, St. Mark's Coptic Orthodox Church, and Tivoli Dome. Cairo International Airport (CAI) is approximately 9. 4 km from the hotel.

357787.description: The accomodation comprises a total of 29 snug accomodation units.

358159.description: Inspired by the artistic heritage of the Soares dos Reis School, The Editory Artist Baixa Hotel is a place where contemporaneity is fully in line with the History of the City of Porto. In the comfort of a creative and original atmosphere, the Hotel Industry and Tourism School of Porto students are part of a team who are trained to become professional staff on a daily basis and allow each Customer to be part of a constant learning process. The traditional service experience gives rise to experimentalism: who does, who serves and who receives, resulting in a continuous relationship and a surprising experience, in the only Hotel-School of Porto.

358263.description: The Parc Hotel offers comfortable air-conditioned rooms with refrigerators, iPod docking stations, and flat-screen TVs with cable. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with toiletries, and free local calls. Start your day with a continental breakfast and take advantage of our fitness center, restaurant, bar/lounge, and concierge services. Dry cleaning, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff are also available. Self-parking is offered (subject to charges). Located near Flushing Meadows-Corona Park, Citi Field, and the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center, with convenient access to LaGuardia Airport.

358302.address: Sahrayicedit Mah. Buhurbaba Cad. Batman Sok., 4
358302.description: Hilton Istanbul Kozyatagi is conveniently located within the business and commercial district of the Asian side of Istanbul. Owner of ‘'Turkey's Leading City Hotel'' award, the hotel has 320 guest rooms including 47 executive rooms and 23 suites. The hotel is a 5-minute walk to the metro station and Sabiha Gokcen Airport's Shuttle. Free WiFi is available throughout and we offer 16 meeting rooms. Other amenities include an indoor swimming pool, 24-hour fitness center, and a Spa Center. Hilton Istanbul Kozyatagi is a hotel that brings together a unique range of dining and entertainment options under one roof. Al-Sharq offers delicious Middle Eastern foods and hookah menu. On chosen days, the instrumentalists and live DJ provide the music to accompany the colors and movement in the dance shows at Al-Sharq. Enjoy mezzes and main meals in Ziyade Fasil, a modern tavern concept, or listen to live music with a drink in Nispet. The Brasserie Restaurant serves delicious healthy cuisine at any time of day. Visit our Speedcity Entertainment Center offering Ralli, Formula, and Motorbike simulators. The hotel is also just across the street from an Outlet shopping mall, and Emaar Square Mall and Akasya Shopping Centre are only minutes away by car. Bagdat Avenue, with its wealth of shops and restaurants specializing in both Turkish and International Cuisine, is also conveniently close to the hotel. The subway connects Hilton Istanbul Kozyatagi directly to central Kadikoy, which is just ten minutes away. Istanbul Historical Peninsula is only five stations away via Metro and Marmaray Railway connection.

358327.description: This guesthouse offers a “home away from home” feel only 700 m from Milan's Basilica of Sant'Ambrogio. The UNESCO World Heritage site Santa Maria delle Grazie Church is a 15-minute walk away. For longer tours of the city and the area, guests can walk 10 minutes to the Metro station and the central train station and continue from there. As a good start of the day, visitors receive a breakfast voucher for a café nearby. Whether travelling with their children, with a group of friends or in the company of their pets, guests will find excellent accommodation, combining classic hardwood floors and warm textures with all the necessary amenities for a comfortable stay.

358333.description: Close to Taksim Square in the heart of the city and surrounded by shops, nightclubs, restaurants and cafe bars, this elegantly styled hotel is a great base from which to explore the exhilarating city of Istanbul. Featured amenities include luggage storage, laundry facilities, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite.
You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Lizo Hotel, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. To-go breakfasts are available daily from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee.
Make yourself at home in one of the 23 air-conditioned guestrooms. Rooms have private balconies. Bathrooms have showers and complimentary toiletries.

362361.description: With a small number of only 10, this accomodation is very convenient for a quiet stay.

362364.description: This hotel is the ideal accommodation for tourists travelling to the Catalan capital thanks to its proximity to the city's most popular attractions and to its excellent transport connections to the nearby cultural and leisure activities. Its facilities and comfortable and fully equipped rooms will allow you to relax after a walking around Gaudí's city and enjoy a fantastic stay in cosmopolitan Barcelona. We are located at the feet of Montjuïc, with excellent transport connections with Palau Sant Jordi, the Olympic Stadium and Camp Nou and just a 15-minute walk to Las Ramblas, the port, Plaça d’Espanya, also very close to the famous Carrer de Blai, a street famous for its tapas bars. We are also very close to Avinguda del Paral·lel, an avenue famous for its theatres and nightlife spots. It is the perfect starting point to discover the city, from Sagrada Familia to Casa Batlló.

name.content: Hotel Sogno di Giulietta e Romeo

362369.description: Enjoy a central Venice stay at Il sogno di Giulietta e Romeo, just a 5-minute walk from the Rialto Bridge and 13 minutes from St. Mark's Square. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, air-conditioned rooms with minibars, private bathrooms, and convenient amenities like safes and coffee/tea makers. Additional services include express check-in/check-out, luggage storage, and wedding services. The hotel is also near Rialto Market, San Cassiano and provides easy access to waterbus transport.

362458.description: A total of 24 accomodation units are available for guests' convenience at Hostal Madrid. Everyone staying at this accommodation can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the accomodation. Clients will appreciate the 24-hour reception. Hostal Madrid may charge a fee for some services.

362504.description: Situated on Barcelona's bustling Avenida Diagonal, just steps from the renowned Paseo de Gracia, this hotel offers a prime location for exploring the city's vibrant heart. Surrounded by shops, restaurants, and entertainment, and within walking distance of iconic landmarks like La Pedrera and Casa Batlló, guests are immersed in the city's cultural tapestry. Housed in a beautifully preserved 19th-century building, the hotel provides personalized service to ensure a comfortable stay. The well-appointed guest rooms feature exquisite decor, spacious layouts, air conditioning, private bathrooms, and complimentary Wi-Fi, catering to both leisure and business travelers.

362540.description: Nestled on the banks of the River Brenta, just 15 km from Venice, the 17th-century Villa Margherita welcomes you. Adorned with charming statues and set within a centuries-old park, the villa is surrounded by magnificent Palladian architecture. Inside, frescoes and rich fabrics create an enchanting atmosphere. The nearby Restaurant Margherita, housed in an equally captivating building, specializes in exquisite seafood dishes and is conveniently located near Villa Franceschi. Guests also benefit from no city tax.

362553.description: The pavilion offers two beautiful and spacious rooms, each with a private bathroom. Guests also enjoy a large living room, a dining area, a steam room, and a massage room. While part of the owner's property, the pavilion provides ample privacy. The garden and pool are shared spaces, occasionally used by the owner's family and other visitors. Families and couples are welcome. Please note that any activities prohibited by local law are strictly forbidden within the pavilion.

362569.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and a hair salon. Additional features at this hotel include tour/ticket assistance and a vending machine. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a library. Make yourself at home in one of the 10 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private balconies or patios. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Politecnico di Milano - 1. 2 km / 0.

362571.description: Offering free Wi-Fi, this guest house is located in Barcelona's Sant Gervasi District, close to Fontana Metro Station and only 5 minutes from the city centre by public transport. Barcelona City Street features single, double and triple rooms with flat-screen TV and a kettle. All rooms have a private bathroom, most of which are located within the room. Breakfast is served daily. The property has a lounge area and a kitchenette with a microwave and fridge. There is also a lift in the building. The charming Gracia District is within walking distance of the guest house. Here you will find numerous theatres, small shops as well as cafés and restaurants serving national and international food. Diagonal Avenue and Passeig de Gracia can be reached in less than 15 minutes' walk away.

362597.description: Riad Houdou guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 10 rooms. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. Visitors are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. There is no time to get bored at this hotel thanks to the entertainment options on offer.

362606.description: Visitors will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Gramta House as it counts with a total of 7 guest rooms. Guests may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Gramta House. The reception desk is open all day long. The accommodation's entertainment was designed to amuse all kinds of travellers.

362626.description: Enjoy amenities such as a fitness center and garden views at the Hotel Bogotá Regency Usaquén. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services, and an area shuttle (surcharge). Dine at Restaurante Bacci, featuring a bar/lounge, or enjoy the coffee shop/cafe. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM. Business travelers appreciate the 24-hour business center, and all guests will value the dry cleaning/laundry services and 24-hour front desk. Event facilities include a conference center and meeting rooms. Airport transfers are available (surcharge), and free self-parking is provided. The 92 guest rooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi, cable TV, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Located near the Usaquén Flea Market, Usaquén Park, and Hacienda Santa Barbara Mall, the hotel is approximately 19. 9 km from El Dorado International Airport (BOG).

362737.description: Located in Barcelona's thriving business district, the Atenea Rekord Suites Hotel offers a tranquil escape with personalized service. Our spacious, recently renovated rooms feature modern design and updated amenities to meet the needs of today's traveler. Enjoy a welcome drink upon arrival. At the Atenea Rekord Suites, we strive to make excellence a habit and are at your service at any time.

362772.description: This small property is in Feira da Lomba, in the municipality of Ribeira de Pena, in the north of Portugal, between the mountainous Trás-os-Montes and the Minho vinho verde (green wine) region, where visitors can take the wine route. This is a good place for visitors who enjoy tranquillity and nature. 5 minutes away there is a natural pool and the surrounding area has vineyards, rivers and winding valleys. Shopping, nightlife and restaurants are accessible by bus or taxi. Guests staying here may wish to visit the Alvão Natural Park, a protected area 20 km from the property and enjoy hiking and walking as well as some of the scenic viewpoints. 11 km from the property there is an amusement and adventure sports park. The hotel offers Wi-Fi, bicycle rental, barbecues and a restaurant serving Portuguese cuisine with fresh regional produce. The air-conditioned rooms have TV and bathroom.

362799.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby. At Apartamentos Regency La Feria, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6:00 AM to 9:30 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk. A shuttle from the hotel to the airport is provided for a surcharge (available on request). Make yourself at home in one of the 40 guestrooms, featuring kitchenettes with refrigerators and microwaves. 32-inch LCD televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include safes and a turndown service, as well as phones with free local calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Agora Bogotá Convention Center - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Parque Simón Bolívar - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Plaza Central de Usaquén - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Avenida El Dorado - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Corferias Bogota - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- U. S. Embassy Bogotá - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- National University of Colombia - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Attorney General's Building - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Headquarters of the General Prosecutor of the Sectional Nation - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- International Charismatic Mission - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Gran Estacion Shopping Mall - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Centro Comercial Galerias, Bogota - 2. 7 km / 1. 7 mi- El Cubo Business and Recreation Center - 2. 8 km / 1. 7 mi- Paloquemao - 2. 8 km / 1. 8 mi- Salitre Plaza Shopping Mall - 3. 2 km / 2 mi. The preferred airport for Apartamentos Regency La Feria is El Dorado Intl. Airport (BOG) - 10. 5 km / 6. 5 mi Centrally located in Bogotá, Apartamentos Regency La Feria is within a 15-minute walk of Corferias Bogota and U. S. Embassy Bogotá. This aparthotel is 2. 2 mi (3. 6 km) from Salitre Plaza Shopping Mall and 2. 2 mi (3. 6 km) from Gran Estacion Shopping Mall.

362819.description: Towering over Dubai skyline, InterContinental Residence Suites Dubai F. C. combines elegant comfort with the service and amenities of a five-star hotel. Savour the aroma of Italian dishes served from MezzaLuna’s kitchen or revive in our leisure complex featuring a 25 metre indoor lap pool, children’s pool, spa pool and sun deck with stunning city views. InterContinental Residence Suites Dubai F. C is ideally located minutes away from Dubai Festival City Mall and a 10-minute drive to Dubai airport.

362820.description: Ideally located on the shores of Lake Leman, within easy reach of Geneva's international organizations and convention centers such as Palexpo and CICG, Lake Geneva Hotel 4* is perfect for both business and leisure stays. With its sleek, contemporary design, the hotel offers a refined, comfortable setting. The lobby opens onto a convivial lounge-bar area, ideal for relaxing. The restaurant serves cosmopolitan cuisine, and its elevated terrace offers a breathtaking view of the lake and Geneva's Jet d'eau. The conference center, directly accessible from the train station, provides an elegant and functional setting for seminars, conferences and business events.

362839.address: Tuyap Fuar Kongre Merk.E5 Karayolu Uzeri, Gurpinar, 5
362839.description: Situated in the same complex as Istanbul's well known, TUYAP Fair & Congress Centre in the district of Buyukcekmece, this modernly decorated and furnished hotel is in an excellent location for business and leisure guests. Within close proximity to the main highway into Istanbul, the hotel's position enables easy access for guests wanting to visit the many attractions in this fascinating city. Taksim Square in the heart of the city is 19 km away and Ataturk Airport, a convenient 27 km. The rooms are modern and tastefully decorated, equipped with modern comforts for guests' convenience. Featuring 33 meeting rooms in various sizes, divisable Istanbul Ball Room with 1250 guests capacity, the hotel is well equipped with expert teams to host conferences, special events and banquets.

362840.description: Enjoy a central Istanbul stay at Nexthouse Pera, steps from Istiklal Avenue and a 10-minute walk from Galata Tower. This upscale hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a coffee shop, and concierge services. Each of the 12 air-conditioned rooms features an LED TV with satellite programming, a laptop-compatible safe, and a rainfall showerhead. The hotel also provides dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge). Nearby attractions include the Golden Horn (1. 1 km) and Taksim Square (1. 4 km). Istanbul Airport (IST) is the preferred airport.

362845.description: Torel Palace comprises two historic mansions, dating back to 1902 and 1904, formerly owned by a private family and the church, respectively. Situated on Sant'Ana Hill in the heart of Lisbon, Torel Palace overlooks the city center, a hidden gem and tranquil paradise amidst the urban bustle. This lovingly renovated hotel offers an elegant yet cozy atmosphere for visitors worldwide. From our garden with a pool and terraces, guests can enjoy breathtaking views over the city center, extending to the Tagus River. The renovation meticulously preserved the buildings' character while incorporating modern comforts and attention to detail.

362857.description: The Posada de El Chaflán, nestled in Madrid's financial district, offers convenient access to the city's key attractions. A short two-minute drive from the M-30 highway, it's also close to Chamartín-Clara Campoamor train station, Plaza Castilla, and Santiago Bernabeu Stadium. The hotel features 47 modern rooms, each equipped with a private bathroom, air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and a TV. Guests can enjoy the on-site cafeteria and restaurant (open Monday to Friday) and a cozy terrace. Its excellent transport links, including easy access to Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport and the Metropolitan Stadium, make it an ideal choice for business and leisure travelers.

362937.description: Clients will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay on the premises, as it counts with a total of 14units. Free Hostels Barcelona offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. As this hotel features 24-hour reception, guests are always welcome. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

363080.description: Located in downtown Santiago, in the Lastarria neighborhood, where you only need to cross the street to be at Parque Forestal, the largest park in Santiago surrounded by centennial trees. Each of its rooms has the art technology and the service is meant to provide a pleasant experience for the guests. With an urban concept, this hotel will be oriented to satisfy guests' expectations aiming at leaving them with a desire to come back.

363082.address: Balmumcu Mh. Mustafa Izzet Efendi Sk. Ortakoy, 1
363082.description: Offering a new form of short-term accommodation, these functional apartments provide contemporary designed rooms suitable for both business and leisure travellers. Situated close to Ortakoy by the Bosphorus, the complex features great facilities such as a well-equipped fitness centre, an auditorium and a seasonal outdoor pool. A shuttle service is available and the nearest bus stop is 300m away. The centre of Ortakoy is about 1 km from the complex and is full of trendy cafe bars, restaurants and small shops, while Taksim Square, in the heart of the city, is 5 km away. Standard rooms come all with a desk, a seating area and a mini-fridge, while deluxe rooms offer a little bit more of space as well as a flat-screen TV for guests' entertainment. Travellers may enjoy delicious home-cooked meals for breakfast and dinner in the on-site cafeteria or just relax while sipping a refreshing drink in good company.

363084.description: Within walking distance from Taksim Square in the heart of the city and Mecidiyekoy, there are also bars, restaurants, shops and entertainment venues within 300m of the hotel. Consisting of 18 rooms, the hotel is modern, comfortable, very well equipped and staffed by experienced personnel. Offering a 'home-from-home' experience and friendly service, the hotel is an ideal base from which to experience this fascinating city. A 24hr front desk can offer information about Istanbul and a private transfer service from the airport is available. The nearest metro station is 650m from the hotel, allowing easy access around the city and there is a bus stop 100m away. The historical attractions at Sultanahmet 5. 5 km away, should not be missed and can be reached by public transport.

363085.description: Opened in August 2023 in Beylikdüzü, the distinguished district of Istanbul, Gardan Hotel offers a combination of hygienic, comfortable rooms and quality service to our valued guests with a total of 69 rooms, including 65 rooms and 4 suites. Our hotel also has SPA service, an outdoor swimming pool, a restaurant serving open buffet breakfast with rich options, and 24/7 room service. Our hotel is 3 km away from Tüyap Fair Center, the largest fairground in Istanbul, and 35 km away from Istanbul Airport. Additionally, Istanbul's largest shopping malls are within walking distance. We are proud to offer the comfort of home in Beylikdüzü to our valued guests.

363087.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace and garden at Bisetun Hotel, located in Istanbul's city center, a short drive from the Grand Bazaar and Blue Mosque. Make the most of complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and 24-hour room service. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast (7 AM - 10 AM) and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The 30 air-conditioned rooms offer minibars, LCD TVs with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Additional amenities include safes, desks, and daily housekeeping. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge). Nearby attractions include Süleymaniye Mosque (1. 1 km) and Galata Tower (3. 3 km).

363198.description:
Riad Zagouda, a Riad Marrakech Medina, you can make it real. It is a charming Riad cheap, in which every detail has been designed for your comfort and well being. It has an active team that strives to bring you the best of Moroccan hospitality.
This Riad in Marrakech enjoys a privileged location and is only 10 minutes from Djemaa el Fna and the Koutoubia.
Calling at Riad Zagouda is to discover otherwise the beauty and culture of Morocco.
Zagouda recreates for you, whether you are business travelers or leisure, a pleasant environment to liv

363208.description: Situated just a few metres from a sandy beach on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, this family-friendly hotel offers a range of activities to provide a fun and enjoyable beach holiday. Public transport runs in front of the hotel allowing easy access to the nearby resort of Alanya, some 20 kilometres away, and local amenities can be found within a kilometre of the hotel. Modernly furnished, the hotel features 2 blocks and has a footbridge over the road connecting the hotel to the beach. Younger guests can benefit from the mini club and there is an animation programme and light sports available as well as a Turkish bath and sauna for adults. The guest rooms feature an elegant décor with contemporary furnishings and offer a full array of modern amenities.

363242.description: This hotel enjoys a charming setting in Esenler. The hotel is conveniently located just 15 km away from Istanbul Ataturk Airport and the historical district of Sultanahmet. The hotel lies just a short distance away from the CNR Expo Fair Trade Centre and Olympiyat Stadium. The hotel is just 5 km away from the ISTOC Business Centre. A wealth of attractions can be found just a short bus journey away. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment venues. The hotel is ideal for discerning business and leisure travellers. The hotel comprises superbly-designed guest rooms, which offer functionality and comfort. The hotel features a health club and multi-purpose conference rooms, meeting the needs of every type of traveller.

name.content: Radisson Blu Plaza El Bosque Santiago

363294.description: Backdropped by the Andes Mountains, the Radisson Blu Plaza El Bosque Santiago provides a peaceful retreat for business and leisure guests visiting Las Condes. The Santiago financial district is about one kilometer away along Apoquindo Avenue, which is dotted with offices, trendy restaurants, and upscale shopping centers. Our hotel also places you close to companies like BHP, Siemens, and Deloitte. Outfitted with a flat screen TV and a coffeemaker, our rooms and suites make it easy to unwind. If you need to accomplish a few work tasks, set up your laptop on the desk and log in to our free WiFi. For extra space, book a studio suite with a sleeper sofa. We also offer pet friendly options and connecting rooms. Pets Allowed. Pet Charge 25. 00 CLP Per Pet, Per Night. Pet limit 1 Pet Per Room. Max 12 Kilograms.

363303.description: There are a total of 42 guest rooms at The Hat Madrid. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. As this hostel features 24-hour reception, guests are always welcome. Communal areas are wheelchair accessible at this hostel. All guests staying at this property can easily get to the airport thanks to the shuttle service available. Offering several dining options, this hostel will cater the needs of all types of guests. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

363313.description: This establishment offers a total of 28 accomodation units. Travellers may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. There is a car park at Pouso dos Anjos. Additional fees may apply for some services.

363337.description: A stay at Hostal Balkonis places you in the heart of Barcelona, within a 10-minute walk of Rambla del Raval and Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art. This pension is 0. 6 mi (0. 9 km) from Boqueria Market and 0. 6 mi (1 km) from La Rambla. Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Featured amenities include express check-out, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Make yourself at home in one of the 7 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

363371.description: This luxurious hotel features a convenient location in Enric Granados street, just a few steps from Passeig de Gràcia, Ravine Catalunya and Diagonal Avenue. It is around 14 kilometres from the airport and just 800 metres from the railway station, providing easy access to other beautiful areas of the region. An authentic artistic treasure, this hotel features a beautiful collection of original works from popular artists such as Joan Miró or Miquel Barceló. The floors pay homage to celebrated contemporary artists including Joan Miró, Antoni Tàpies and Andy Warhol. The onsite dining options include an exclusive outdoor terrace where to sit back with a cocktail and a restaurant serving delicious specialities. Those travelling on business will find all the necessary services and amenities to guarantee the successful of any event. Hotel registration number HB-004616

363373.description: The hotel is located in the historical centre of the city, immersed in the rich culture and traditions, for which it is renowned. Guests can explore the charming district of Rossio, or venture a little further and discover the beauty of Alfama, Chiado and Bairro Alto. This hotel is just a 15 minutes' walk from Sao Jorge Castle. Rua Augusta shopping street can be found just 400 m, where guests can indulge in a spot of retail therapy. Lisbon Airport is just a short drive away. This charming hotel dates back to the early 20th century. The guest rooms were stunningly designed and equipped with air-conditioning, flat-screen TV and private bathroom with toiletries. The hotel's extensive range of facilities and services is sure to impress even the most discerning traveller.

363374.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at The ART INN Lisbon, a boutique guesthouse in the heart of Lisbon, steps from Rossio Square and Santa Justa Elevator. This Art Deco guesthouse offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a rooftop bar and restaurant with a lounge. A coffee shop/cafe provides additional dining options. Guest rooms feature individual decor, iPod docking stations, LCD TVs, and cable programming. Bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Business amenities, express check-in/check-out, and an airport shuttle (surcharge) are available.

363375.description: These wonderful apartments boast a prime location in the centre of the beautiful old town of Porto, only 22.3 kilometres from Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport. This charming property is set less than 300 metres from Sao Bento underground station and 450 metres from Sao Bento train station, which will allow visitors to explore this beautiful city and nearby areas. Guests may appreciate proximity of numerous dining options, shopping areas and entertainment venues. History enthusiasts will relish the opportunity to visit the emblematic Clérigos Tower and majestic Porto Cathedral known as Sé do Porto. This marvellous establishment takes pride of well-lit and spacious 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, studios and lofts. Each of them is beautifully appointed and comes complete with kitchenettes, living area, private bathroom and state-of-art amenities.

363376.description: Nestled in Porto and overlooking the fabulous Douro River, this magnificent hotel is a perfect destination for all kinds of travellers. Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is situated within 24 kilometres away. This splendid property enjoys a privileged location in the heart of Porto's old town, which offers visitors ease of access to all this lively city has to offer: charming winding streets, intimate restaurants, links of transport such as San Bento train station and historical attractions including the famous Ribeira and the majestic Dom Luís I Bridge and Church of Santa Clara. This 19th-cenutry mansion converted into a splendid hotel boasts delightful architectural design, elegant décor and excellent services. The hotel offers a variety of room types including spacious and comfortable studios, suites and apartments. The light-filled and magnificently appointed guestrooms provide a haven of serenity, in which to totally relax and wind down after all day of sightseeing.

363395.description: 'Early flight or late arrival? This 24-hour hotel's ideally placed to give travellers a good rest. It's less than 2 miles from the NEC, so an ideal base for events. Birmingham's attractions and nightlife are a short drive away. If you need to stay near the airport, round-the-clock service means it's easy to pack up, check out, and jet off. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals. '

363429.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an outdoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Grab a bite at EVOO, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 4:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Cairo? This hotel has 12206 square feet (1134 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 5 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary (available 24 hours), and a bus station shuttle is also provided at no charge. Make yourself at home in one of the 349 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions.

363460.description:
These stylish apartments close to the Torre Agbar and Glòries Metro station have free Wi-Fi and fully equipped kitchens.

The Barcelona City Apartments offer flexible accommodation for up to 6 people. They have TV and DVD player, and the kitchens have microwave, fridge, hob and washing machine. The apartments also have an iron, safe and towels and bed linen.

Barcelona City Apartment can be found close to Plaça de les Glòries, a transport hub in Barcelona. You have easy access to several Metro, bus and tram routes. You are only 10 minutes' walk from the beach and the Nord railway station.

363587.description: The new DoubleTree by Hilton Milan in the heart of Viale Certosa, northern Milan's essential business district, offers upscale hotel accommodation and free wireless internet access available throughout the hotel. Just one metro stop from the new Fiera Milano Exhibition Center, the hotel is only five minutes walking distance from the new Rho Fair Grounds. Our elegant hotel, convenient to major rail lines and autostrada, is only 30 minutes (25mi/35km) from Malpensa International Airport (MXP) and 30 minutes (25mi/15km) from Linate National Airport (LIN). Located within the Viale Certosa business district, the six-floor DoubleTree by Hilton Milan hotel offers stylish accommodation and excellent business amenities. Be welcomed at Reception with a warm, freshly baked chocolate chip cookie before checking-in to your comfortable guest room. Visit nearby Milan attractions like the PalaSharp indoor arena or the The Stadio Giuseppe Meazza, more commonly known as the San Siro football stadium. The trendy Corso Sempione, home to stylish bars, restaurants and night life is just 5-10 minutes away by taxi or tram. There is a direct tram to Piazza Duomo from outside of the Doubletree by Hilton Milan hotel. Dine in-room from 7AM to 11PM or join us at The Glass bar and restaurant for a charming experience. The Glass, modern and elegant, reflects the stylish verve of Milano and serves up an innovative cuisine for powerhouse business lunches, romantic dinners or fabulous brunches daily. The DoubleTree Milan is the ideal hotel for business travel. In addition to our strategic Milan business district location, we offer 450m² of flexible meeting space with state-of-the-art connectivity and presentation technology, as well as a public WiFi zone and banquet services.

363646.description: This bed and breakfast boasts a privileged setting in Sesto San Giovanni. The establishment is located within easy driving distance of the city centre of Milan, where guests will find themselves surrounded by intriguing attractions, as well as delightful dining, shopping and entertainment venues. This charming bed and breakfast enjoys a beautiful design, complemented by a homely, inviting ambience, and friendly staff. The guest rooms are classically designed, featuring refreshing tones and a peaceful ambience. Guests will appreciate the home-away-from-home feeling that this wonderful property has to offer.

363677.description: The S.Bento Hotel enjoys a prime location, in full mountain of Gerês, one of the most beautiful landscapes of Portugal. Framed in a privileged place where nature is combined irresistibly. We have as our primary mission to provide our guests a quiet stay with quality and kindness, accompanied by an irresistible natural beauty that will provide peaceful moments.

363682.address: al aaliya st. old salata area, doha, Bldg 5
363682.description: The 4-star Gokulam Park Hotel, a boutique hotel located on Al-Aaliya Street in Doha's Old Salatha area, offers 69 elegantly appointed rooms across three categories. Near the Qatar National Museum and the Corniche, this hotel provides contemporary luxury and amenities to cater to diverse travelers. Hotel facilities include a multi-cuisine restaurant and bar, nightclub, lounge, spa, hair transplant center, gym, and swimming pool. The hotel is conveniently located a short walk from the National Museum, Corniche, Bank Street, Islamic Museum, and Souq Waqif. Doha International Airport and the World Trade Centre are a 20-minute drive away.

363690.description: This impressive hotel is ideally situated in the Haramidere-Beylikduzu district, only 25 kilometres from the city centre of Istanbul and only 7 kilometres from a renowned congress centre. This elegant establishment features luxurious design and boasts charming décor. There are different accommodation options ranging from twin, family and honeymoon rooms to spacious suites. Each of the soundproofed and air-conditioned units is carpeted and furnished in warm hues to create a smart and warm atmosphere. When hungry, patrons may enjoy a selection of exquisite dishes served at the stylish restaurant. Afterwards, guests may enjoy a drink at the lobby bar, completely unwind at the spa equipped with sauna and Turkish bath, pamper themselves at the on-site beauty centre or read a book in the lush and verdant garden.
