The on-site restaurant offers a diverse menu featuring international cuisine, live-cooking stations, and the signature DoubleTree breakfast, along with à la carte lunch and dinner (no alcohol served). The 24-hour Lobby Lounge provides a tranquil setting to enjoy a variety of coffee and tea specialties, pastries, cakes, sandwiches, and light snacks (no alcohol served). For business travelers, the hotel offers three flexible meeting spaces and a modern, 24-hour business center. Please note: some services, including the business center, fitness center, breakfast, on-site restaurant(s), and pool, are currently operating with reduced service. The spa and valet parking are unavailable.

365297.description: This upscale hotel boasts a stunning setting in the city of Mirano. Strategically set between Padua and Venice, this hotel affords visitors a prime setting from which to explore the rich culture and history of the area. The hotel is located just a few steps away from the bus station. The main train station is 4 km away. The hotel is conveniently located just 26 km away from Venice Marco Polo International Airport. This luxurious hotel enjoys a stunning design. The guest rooms enjoy a style rich in sleek, contemporary elegance. The hotel affords visitors a number of first-class facilities and services, attending to the needs of even the most discerning traveller, to a high level of excellence.

365339.description: This simple hotel is located in Chueca-Fuencarral. The establishment consists of 32 rooms. The property includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all accomodation units. This hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. Room007 Chueca does not offer cots on demand. This hotel is awarded with certification.

365506.address: Gran Via De Les Corts Catalanes, 580
365506.description: A modern hostel located in the centre of Barcelona, just 700m from Plaza Catalunya and a 2 minute walk to the Universitat metro station. The famous Sagrada Familia is just a 10 minute metro ride away and the beach is just 25 minutes away on the metro. The surrounding area is full of bars, restaurants, supermarkets and shops. The hostel has a 24 hour reception, the most advanced safety technology, free Wi-Fi, and boasts a great outdoor pool and solarium as well as a bar and restaurant, a guest kitchen and a common lounge and games room and bicycle hire facilities, as well as a tourist information centre where guests can buy tickets to local attractions and shows. There are private and shared rooms, which are accessed with fingerprint security keys, they all have air-conditioning, some rooms have private bathrooms, and others have a television.

365507.description: Set in central Madrid, within 3 minutes' walk from Puerta del Sol, Apartamentos Cruz features functional accommodation with free WiFi. It offers easy access to Madrid's attractions and nightlife. Each air-conditioned loft at Cruz has a living-dining area with a sofa and a flat-screen TV. The kitchenette comes with a ceramic hobs and kitchenware; while the bathroom includes free toiletries and hairdryer. There is a washing machine. An airport shuttle is available upon request for a surcharge. Shops, cafés and bars can be found in the streets surrounding the lofts; and the shopping street of Calle Preciados Puerta is less than 800 metres away. Paseo del Prado, and the Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen-Bornemisza museums are within 15 minutes' walk of the apartment. Atocha Railway Station is 4 Metro stops from nearby Puerta del Sol Station.

365508.description: This cozy and romantic, 15-room luxury boutique hotel (12 prestige rooms and 3 suites) is located in Ponte de Lima, the oldest town in Portugal, in the heart of the Minho region. It’s just a short drive from several amazing cities: Porto (40 minutes), Braga, Guimarães, Viana do Castelo, the Douro Valley, and Santiago de Compostela (Spain). The hotel features an exclusive aromatherapy spa, a stunning outdoor swimming pool with breathtaking views, and offers equestrian experiences. Guests can also enjoy traditional Portuguese cuisine, wine tastings, picnics, and exclusive private tours that showcase the traditions and culture of Northern Portugal. A place where the past, modern comforts, and cultural roots blend harmoniously, the hotel distinguishes itself through its tradition, history, exquisite design, and respect for the environment. Ideal for relaxing and exploring a unique region.

365510.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting in Doha. The hotel is situated close to a wealth of attractions in the area. The city's main commercial and business zones can be reached easily from this hotel. The hotel lies close to links to the public transport network. This wonderful hotel offers visitors the ideal setting from which to explore this mesmerising city. The hotel enjoys a sophisticated architectural design. The guest rooms ooze character and poise, welcoming visitors into a veritable lap of luxury. This hotel affords guests an insight into the rich culture and history of the area. This hotel prides itself on its homely ambience, exemplary service and dedication to customer satisfaction.

365511.address: sahkulu mh.ilk belediye cd. sishane / beyoglu, 10
365511.description: The original building which now houses these beautifully styled apartments was built in 1933 by the Benardete family at a time when there was rapid expansion in the Beyoglu district of the city. Over the years it has been added on to and finally restored to its' current state in 2013 by a private company. The suites are decorated in muted tones and furnished in a French style with high quality amenities provided. The area is full of beautiful buildings, narrow streets and small shops and ideally placed for getting around the city. Sishane metro station is only a few metres away and the Galata Bridge across the Golden Horn is 650m.

365538.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center, terrace, and garden. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, babysitting (surcharge), and wedding services. Savor Mediterranean cuisine at Auberge du Vieux Cèdre, offering garden views and alfresco dining. Room service is available during limited hours. Continental breakfast is served weekdays from 7:00 to 9:30 AM and weekends from 8:00 to 10:00 AM (for a fee). Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Free self-parking is available onsite. The hotel offers 27 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, desks, and complimentary bottled water are also provided. Nearby attractions include Parc d’Enghien (0. 2 mi), Château Empain (0. 4 mi), and Enghien Golf Club (0. 8 mi). The nearest airports are Brussels Airport (BRU) (36. 5 mi) and Brussels South Charleroi Airport (CRL) (30. 9 mi).

365599.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Melody, a restaurant which specializes in British cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 35 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring heated floors. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Eventim Apollo - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre - 0. 7 km / 0. 5 mi- Kensington High Street - 0.

365627.description: This hotel is the perfect option for travellers visiting Cancun. It is located close to the resort's main attractions, as well as a wide range of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. Malecon Americas is just a short distance away. The hotel lies just a 15 minutes' drive from Cancun International Airport. This hotel offers comfort and style, in a relaxed setting. The guest rooms are sublimely styled, featuring soothing tones and a peaceful ambiance. The hotel offers facilities and services that are sure to exceed all expectations. Guests are assured of meticulous service and impeccable attention to detail at this charming hotel.

365628.description: Enjoying a privileged position on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, just steps from a river, this modern hotel offers a host of amenities for families and couples alike. The tastefully decorated rooms have a fresh, contemporary feel and are well-equipped. With direct access to the sandy beach, guests can enjoy the turquoise waters of the Mediterranean, partake in local watersports, or relax by one of the large outdoor pools. Convenient public transport provides easy access to the surrounding area, including the town of Manavgat (22 km) and the resort and ancient ruins of Side (29 km).

365636.address: Douar Torort, Azzaden Valley, Ouirgane, Asni
365636.description: Located near Ouirgane in the picturesque Azzaden River Valley facing the High Atlas Mountains and Takerkhort Wildlife Reserve, this lodge is an ideal base for nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts. Eight spacious junior suites each sleep up to 4 people in king size beds or twins with extra bed and sofa bed.   This charming property enjoys a stunning design, beautifully respecting the traditions of the area. The stone-wall guest rooms offer an elegant setting in which to unwind. All rooms include telescopes for star-gazing, binoculars for bird-watching, satellite TV with DVD, log fires, bath robes and Moroccan slippers. Guests can enjoy a leisurely swim in the infinity pool which overlooks the river, or relax on the lawn and revel at the splendid beauty of the surroundings. Terraced orchards are filled with plum, peach, apple and olive trees. A restaurant offers indoor or outdoor dining with Moroccan and international menus.   Sitting at the gateway to Toubkal National Park, the region is a walker's paradise: several day walks or overnight hikes are possible. Excursions by car can be made to the Ourika Valley, Agafay Desert, Tin Mal Mosque and the Ouirgane Valley. Mountain biking, horse-riding and spa are available locally. Access is via a scenic 3 km dirt track from Marigha. There is on-site car parking. This establishment allows well-behaved pets.

365806.description: This unique and innovative hotel is conveniently located in the Salamanca district, one of the best areas in Madrid. The property is surrounded by prestigious shops, entertainment venues, and restaurants, and is perfectly connected to the rest of the Spanish capital via nearby public transportation networks. It features bright, minimalist rooms that have been completely renovated and equipped with every amenity. For the culinary experience, this attractive establishment offers a menu of national dishes and Mediterranean cuisine. Common areas include a work or study room and a rooftop terrace open during the summer months to enjoy the sun. You can enjoy unlimited high-speed Wi-Fi, as well as a wide variety of additional services and benefits, including offers from local partners throughout the city.

365924.description: Boasting a central location in Boticas town, in northern Portugal, this magnificent hotel is very near from green natural spaces such as Peneda-Gerês National Park at approximately 34 km away. Other nearby interesting sites are Carvalhelhos thermal baths or the historical centre of Chaves, apart from the Spanish border, which is at around 31 km distance. All the hotel's guest rooms and suites have breath-taking views of the town, the garden or the patio and offer a wide array of deluxe services and facilities, such as free WIFI connection, comfortable double or king-size beds and a flat-screen TV. They provide a private bathroom with a separate shower and upgrade includes a panoramic bathtub or an ample living room where guests can recover from a busy day sightseeing or doing business. Guests can pamper themselves at the on-site spa and wellness centre and use the meeting facilities.

365925.description:
Property Location Located in Marrakech (Gueliz), Hotel Palais Al bahja is within a 10-minute drive of Palais des Congres and Koutoubia Minaret. This spa hotel is 4. 5 mi (7. 2 km) from El Badi Palace and 4. 5 mi (7. 2 km) from Marrakesh Museum.

Rooms Make yourself at home in one of the 40 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks.

Amenities Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon.

Dining Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM.

Business, Other Amenities Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Free self parking is available onsite.

366115.description:
"Situated in the heart of the world-famous fashion district known as “Quadrilatero della Moda” and only a few minutes away from the spectacular Piazza del Duomo, the Armani Hotel Milano brings to life the “Stay with Armani” philosophy.
Here luxury, calm and beauty are fostered in pure Armani style, imparting a new aesthetic excellence to the concept of comfort.
The 95 guestrooms and suites have been personally designed by Giorgio Armani, featuring in-room amenities and facilities specially tailored for the utmost convenience of guests.
On the seventh floor, with a spectacular and unexpected view encompassing the city, the Armani Hotel Milano proposes an extensive food and beverage offer through the Armani/Ristorante and the sophisticated Armani/Bamboo Bar.
On the eight floor, covering an area of 1,000 square metres, entirely devoted to beauty and well-being, the panoramic Armani/SPA brings together a wide range of personalized treatments, a magnificent relaxation area with relaxation pool and a 24 hour gym.
In addition, to satisfy the needs of work, the well-equipped Armani/Business Centre, providing the perfect place for corporate events."

Depending on the size of the apartment you choose, amenities such as a dining table, dishwasher, and washing machine may also be available. These are included in the more spacious 1-bedroom superior and 2-bedroom apartments. Please note there is no on-site reception. Kindly contact us one week before arrival to arrange check-in. Our phone number is +44 131 510 7707, and our email is stay@edinburghsapartments. com. We are available Monday to Friday, 10 am to 5 pm. 366714.description: This charming hotel boasts a convenient location in Lisbon, surrounded by must-see attractions such as the Cathedral, Praça do Comércio, and the Rua Augusta Arch. The hotel's beautiful design blends seamlessly with its historical surroundings. The peaceful rooms offer a relaxing setting to unwind after a day of sightseeing and come with excellent amenities for a memorable stay. A range of facilities and services are available, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable experience.

366715.description: This hostel is situated in the popular Barcelona district of Gracia. The hostel is situated within easy access of the treasure trove of attractions that this spectacular city has to offer, including the beach, Parc Guell, Las Ramblas and the Gothic Quarter. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, offering a comfortable setting in which to unwind. Guests are invited to enjoy the facilities and services that the hostel has to offer. 366716.description: This hotel offers a unique and exciting concept as it is located on the site of a large shopping complex and theme park in the Eyup district of Istanbul. Ideal for families wishing to visit the major attractions of the city but also wanting entertainment conveniently closeby, this elegantly styled hotel ticks all the boxes. The hotel is decorated in muted tones and features modern amenities for guests' comfort and convenience. The excellent shopping centre will delight any keen shopper, while there are also a wide choice of eateries, a bowling alley and cinema. For younger guests and the young at heart, the theme park features numerous rides, both land and water based to entertain all day. Further afield, the glorious historical attractions at Sultanahmet are 11 km away and can be reached by public transport which runs close to the hotel.

366740.description: 'Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and hot tub. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. Bibione Beach is a short walk (0. 3km) as is the Piazza del Mercato. '

366741.description: Enjoying a very central location in the resort of Alanya, this adults only hotel is situated between the popular Cleopatra Beach and the pedestrianised centre and is an excellent choice for guests who enjoy both a beach and city holiday. Most attractions in the resort are within walking distance and the castle which perches on top of a steep promontory, can be reached by public transport which runs closeby. Gazipasa Alanya Airport is at 42 km driving distance. Beach lovers can benefit from the proximity of Cleopatra's Beach or take advantage of a shuttle service from the hotel to the private beach of the sister hotel, approximately 3 km away. The hotel offers 96 beautifully appointed rooms, equipped with TV, minibar, air-conditioning, hair dryer and safe box. For those seeking a relaxing time, an outdoor pool is available for a refreshing swim or they can choose to take a therapeutic massage after enjoying a sauna or Turkish Bath.

Public transport runs closeby providing easy access to the many shops and cafe bars as well as the spectacular Roman and Hellenistic ruins which lie in the centre of the city, just 1. 5 km from the hotel. The guest rooms boast a simple yet functional décor and come completely equipped for guests' comfort and convenience. 366815.description: Situated in the heart of Manhattan, Best Western Premier Herald Square is an ideal choice for business and leisure travelers. Our New York, NY hotel offers a truly refined atmosphere with superior comfort and service. Sleep peacefully on a plush bed and marvel at spectacular skyline views. All of our smoke-free rooms feature stylish furnishings and deluxe amenities including flat screen TVs with cable HD channels and free high-speed Internet. Recharge at our modern fitness center. After a busy day of sightseeing, the Premier Lounge is a fun place to unwind, or relax with complimentary coffee on our inviting outdoor deck. Corporate travelers appreciate our proximity to New York airports, Penn Station and Grand Central Terminal. Choose from a wide choice of restaurants nearby including casual American fare, delis, steakhouses, fast food, and ethnic cuisines. There is no shortage of things to do. Walk to the Empire State Building, Macy’s and Times Square. Get tickets for a Broadway play, tour the Metropolitan Museum of Art, or explore trendy boutiques and nightclubs in Greenwich Village and SoHo. Top attractions like the Statue of Liberty, the 9/11 Memorial and Central Park are just a short taxi or subway ride away. Find your urban refuge in the city’s lively midtown district and discover everything New York City has to offer within easy reach.

366959.description: This charming aparthotel is situated less than 2 kilometres from Ataturk International Airport, providing easy access to business and leisure travellers alike who need to go to the airport or the nearby CNR Expo centre. With a 24-hour front desk, complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the premises and an airport shuttle service, this apartment complex can meet the needs of even the most seasoned travellers.

367378.description: A total of 16 guest rooms are available for guests' convenience. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception. Edreira applies a sustainable policy. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

367424.address: Arapcami Mah.Bankalar Cad. Billur Sok. Karakoy, 1/A
367424.description: Situated in the vibrant heart of Istanbul, this boutique hotel caters to both business and leisure travelers. It's conveniently located near shopping centers, entertainment venues, restaurants, and local attractions, including the iconic Galata Tower. Just a short drive from Istanbul Ataturk Airport and within walking distance of public transportation, the hotel offers easy access to the city. Explore nearby historical landmarks such as the Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace. The hotel features spacious, beautifully appointed guest rooms equipped with modern amenities for a comfortable stay. Enjoy delicious Turkish cuisine at the elegant on-site restaurant with stunning city views. Additional services include currency exchange, secretarial assistance, and laundry.

367492.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 35 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

367494.description:
The ATHENA Pallas is a luxury boutique hotel with a collection of 56 uniquely appointed suites, apartments & rooms, ATHENA Pallas perfectly infuses a blend of old world feel & aristic bohemia. 
ATHENA Pallas is situated in the center of Athens Historical center on the storied Athinas street. The Hotel is just moments away from Monastiraki, Plaka & the Acropolis neighborhod. 
A place with memory, with facile connections to discover the best of everything the acient city has to offer. From the vibrant shops & food market, to famous bars & restaurants, galleries and museums.

367522.description: This impressive hotel is situated 21 Km from the Jorge Chávez International Airport and just 13 Km from Lima's historic centre. Larcomar commercial area is also close to this stunning property. Among the facilities are free parking, a roof top swimming pool with views of the ocean, a well-equipped gymnasium and free wireless internet throughout. Corporate guests have the use of a 24 hour business centre offering access to computers, printer, scanner, fax and copy machine and meeting rooms. Dining options include three on-site restaurants/bars that offer a variety of food choices such as gourmet, fusion style or sushi and a buffet breakfast is served daily. The spacious, elegantly decorated rooms and suites have city or sea views and come with air-conditioning & heating, free high speed wireless internet, cable television, safe, coffeemaker with free coffee and a mini-bar.

367546.description: Set in a restored palace, this outstanding property is a 5-minute walking distance from Alonso Martinez subway station. It offers a choice of elegant rooms, as well as complimentary Wi-Fi. Decorated with stylish, designer details, the rooms come with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV and a minibar. Each one has a private bathroom equipped with a bath and shower, as well as slippers, bathrobes, toiletries and a hairdryer for guests’ convenience. The hotel spa includes a water area, massages and gym, and is the ideal place to enjoy a moment of relaxation after a day of tourism. This luxurious establishment also provides an on-site restaurant, and many dining options are available in the surrounding streets. Serrano, a popular shopping area, is a short walking distance from the hotel. The staff at the 24-hour reception can provide tourist information and a ticket service. Madrid Puerta del Sol and the Retiro Park can be reached in just 20 minutes on foot.

367552.address: Şehit Muhtar Mahallesi, Kurabiye Sk. No:2, 2
367552.description: Situated in the heart of Istanbul's vibrant Taksim Square, these stylish apartments offer an elegant and fashionable base for exploring the city's historical sights, shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues. Just steps from the bustling Istiklal Street and conveniently located near public transportation, these apartments provide easy access to all corners of the city. Fully furnished with modern amenities for your comfort and convenience, the apartments occupy a corner building above a charming bistro cafe. Major attractions such as Topkapi Palace and the Blue Mosque are a short 4 km away, while the iconic Galata Tower and Bridge are only 2 km from your doorstep.

367555.description: Nestled in Istanbul, this elegant urban hotel is a perfect choice for all types of travelers. Its fantastic location offers easy access to various transport links, including bus and tram stops and the Karaköy ferry port, connecting the city's Asian and European districts. From this strategic base, explore local traditions and city attractions such as the Galata Tower, the impressive Sultan Ahmed Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Taksim Square. The hotel boasts bright, elegant rooms featuring spacious layouts and a combination of natural, warm hues, creating an inviting atmosphere to unwind after a day of sightseeing.

367598.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this establishment. Clients can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the accomodation. This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception.

367602.description: Situated within 2 km from the town centre, the property is easily accessible on foot to a host of places of interest. Visitors can find the nearest golf course within 2 km from the apartment. Clients can access the public transportation means at a distance of 2 km. Clients will find the airport within 7 km. This cosy accomodation guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 5 rooms. Riad Cherihane offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Unfortunately, the front desk is not open 24 hours. Transfer service is available for guests' convenience. The apartment may charge a fee for some services.

367643.address: Baglar Mh. Mimar Sinan Cad. Gunesli, 35
367643.description: Located in the Bagcilar district of Istanbul, this elegantly styled suite hotel is an excellent base for both business and leisure travellers alike. Getting around couldn't be easier with public transport running by the hotel and a taxi rank close by. The historical attractions at Sultanahmet are approximately 16 km from the hotel while Taksim Square is 18 km. Consisting of 140 rooms in a 22-room sky-scraper hotel, guests can benefit from a range of excellent facilities designed for their comfort and convenience. Conference and meeting amenities are available and guests seeking some relaxation can enjoy the on-site spa with heated pool. The on-site restaurant offers an exquisite culinary experience of international and regional dishes and the bar is the perfect place to taste some delicious cocktails while spending a relaxing time in good company.

367647.description:
The Dunes Hotel and Resort is situated on the beautiful pristine Garden Route, in the bustling town of Plettenberg bay, in the Western Cape Province. A mere 1 hours drive from George will bring you to this stunning coastal resort. The hotel offers 43 luxuriously furnished rooms with en-suite bathroom, select DSTV channels and air conditioning. Also available are the modern duplex selfcatering units ideal for families and friends, situated next to the hotel.

The Dunes is the perfect destination for relaxing  family holidays, weddings cocktail parties, conferences, launches and exhibitions. Other facilities include a restaurant, bar, sparkling swimming pools and shop, for the exclusive use of guests. The Dunes offers an exclusive conference facility for up to 250 delegate.

367653.description: Situated in a great location in the district of Kadikoy on the city's Asian shore, the area is full of atmosphere and has many shops, cafe bars and restaurants to suit most tastes. Featuring modernly furnished and cozy rooms, equipped for guests' comfort and convenience, the hotel is a great base for business and leisure travellers alike. An on-site cafe with terrace provides refreshments throughout the day and the hotel's friendly reception staff are ready with a smile. Kadikoy port is just 300m from the hotel allowing easy access across the Bosphorous to the European side while the nearest metro station is a five minute walk. Also closeby, guests will find the famous shopping street, Bagdat, Fenerbahce football stadium and the historical Haydapasa train station.

367730.description: The SunConnect Eftalia Marin, opened in the summer of 2014, is conveniently located 5 km from Konakli, 18 km from Alanya, and within easy reach of both Alanya-Gazipaşa Airport (62 km) and Antalya Airport (105 km). This new addition to the Eftalia Group offers direct access to Eftalia Island, a sprawling beachfront area on the Mediterranean Sea. Guests can enjoy a variety of facilities, including multiple pools, a large entertainment area, a water park, a dedicated children's area, and various bars. A diverse program of entertainment caters to all ages. The hotel comprises 491 rooms across two main buildings and three swim-up buildings with private pool access. Room types include standard, family, duplex swim-up, and accessible rooms. The team at SunConnect Eftalia Marin looks forward to welcoming you.

367761.description: This popular hotel enjoys a privileged location in Bahcelievler-Yenibosna, providing easy access to the city center and Sultanahmet's main tourist attractions. The CNR Congress Center is 5 km away, the Tuyap Congress Center is 20 km away, and Kuyumcukent is 1. 5 km away. Numerous shopping centers are within walking distance. The Yenibosna Metro and Metrobus Station, offering convenient access to other parts of the city, is 2 km from the hotel, and a bus stop is a short 5-minute walk away. Access to the Asian side of the city is available via the Atakoy Marina and ferry port, located 6 km from the hotel. The hotel features a modern design and an impressive marble-floored lobby. The Midmar's elegant rooms offer a comfortable stay with amenities including flat-screen satellite TVs, air conditioning, and safes. A minibar, an electric kettle, and complimentary tea, coffee, and water are also provided. Guests can enjoy a delicious open buffet breakfast each morning in the on-site restaurant, and room service is available (fees apply). We recommend trying the outstanding Turkish cuisine at our Terrace Restaurant. After a long day, guests can relax in our spa, which includes a sauna, Turkish bath, and fitness center for a €5 entrance fee. Massages are available for an additional fee. We offer transfer services from Istanbul Airport and Sabiha Gökçen Airport via private vehicles (fees apply). Car and driver rental services are also available. Information about daily Istanbul city tours and activities can be obtained from the hotel staff.

367768.description: Quality accommodation in an unbeatable central location less than a minute from Kings Cross and St Pancras railway stations. This is the ideal base from which to explore London or stay over before heading to Europe on the Eurostar. Tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the nearby streets, this hotel is housed in four attractive Georgian townhouses and offers 60 en-suite rooms ranging from small singles to extra-large family rooms with a double bed and four singles. Furnished in contemporary style, the rooms have a TV, safe and top quality bathroom amenities. Although there is no lift, a member of the helpful staff is always on duty at reception to give guests a hand with their luggage. There is a lounge bar and terrace where guests can relax, and the hotel also serves a delicious breakfast, just the thing to prepare guests for a busy day exploring the UK capital.

367828.description: Located directly opposite the main shopping center in L'Hospitalet, these air-conditioned apartments with free Wi-Fi are just a 7-minute walk from the Gran Via Fira de Barcelona Trade Fair. Las Ramblas and Barcelona Airport are a mere 10-minute bus ride away, the nearest railway station is 300 meters away, and Castelldefels Beach is a short 20-minute drive. Each of the 21 apartments is decorated in light tones with modern furnishings and features a flat-screen television. All accommodations include a spacious lounge area with a sofa bed, and the private bathrooms come equipped with a hairdryer and complimentary toiletries. Guests can prepare meals using the gas hob, microwave, and refrigerator provided in the kitchenette or dine at one of the many restaurants within the adjacent shopping center. Reception opening hours: Monday to Friday from 9:00 am to 2:00 pm and from 3:00 pm to 6:30 pm. Saturday from 9:00 am to 10:00 pm. Sunday from 9:00 am to 3:00 pm.

367835.description: The hotel is located in Alanya, built in 2001 and has been renovated in 2014. Cleopatra Beach and the city centre are only 600 metres. Numerous restaurant, cafes and bars are located in the hotel's immediate vicinity. Gazipasa Airport is 35 km while Antalya Airport is 125 km from the property. The hotel offers a breathtaking amount of space and homely accommodation. All 72 units come with air conditioning and a satellite flat-screen TV. Some rooms features a kitchen equipped with a microwave, a toaster, and a fridge. Guests staying at this apart hotel may enjoy at the outdoor swimming pool with waterslide or relax at the Turkish Bath or sauna. There is also a sport field next to the hotel where guests can do sports or exercise. Other sports facilities include table tennis, table football, billiard and playground for children.

367997.description: Situated less than 3 kilometres from the ancient city of Side, this wonderful hotel is a perfect option for families, couples and everyone who wish to disconnect from daily routine in marvellous beachside scenery. The property is a strategical base to explore this fascinating and steeped in history area. This charming establishment lies within 800 metres from a gorgeous sandy beach and within ease of access to the bustling resort area, where to find restaurants, shops and entertainment venues. The bright and well-appointed rooms provide comfortable lodge for all those who wish to relax. Guests may start the day with breakfast and dine at the buffet-style restaurant. On the warm days, they may enjoy a refreshing plunge in the on-site spool or soak up the sun at the poolside terrace.

368159.description: The Row Taksim Hotel offers you modernly designed 11 rooms at the heart of Istanbul, Taksim area. Taksim Square is a neighborhood of a number of luxury shops, restaurants, cafes and clubs. It is also the main central hub of the Istanbul Metro. The Row Taksim provides you a front-row seat at this heartland. The stylish design of our hotel, together with the comfort, will make your stay at The Row Taksim unforgettable. We feel responsible not only for every aspect of your hotel accommodation but also for your whole Istanbul city experience. Remember that we will provide everything you need, nothing you don't.

368162.address: Emin Sinan Mh.Katip Sinan Sk. Sultanahmet-Fatih, 10
368162.description: Situated in Sultanahmet, the heart of old Istanbul, this small hotel is a facility dedicated to offering traditional Turkish hospitality and the service of a special class hotel, using all the opportunities of the latest technology. Custom designed guest rooms and contemporary decor, present the best opportunity for a pleasurable stay while the hotel's terrace offers an unforgettable panoramic view of the Marmara Sea and historical peninsula. Travellers may also enjoy a healthy breakfast buffet every morning and then start to explore the magical city. Within 1 km of the hotel, guests will find some of the major attractions such as the Hagia Sophia Museum, Blue Mosque and Grand Bazaar. Cafe, bars, restaurants and shops can all be found close by and the nearest tram stop is at 350m distance, allowing easy access around the city.

368175.description: Nestled in the heart of Robertson's Cape Winelands, this eco-friendly guesthouse impresses with genuine hospitality and spectacular surroundings. Here, old-world charm meets modern luxury. Guests can savor delicious cuisine in the stylish lounge or on the poolside garden terrace. Each of the eight stylish rooms boasts a private entrance and garden terrace, perfect for birdwatching. Natural air conditioning, provided by high ceilings, fans, and shutters, ensures a comfortable night's sleep. Just minutes away, explore fifty wineries, an 18-hole golf course, hiking and biking trails, and breathtaking scenery. Secure parking is available at this Route 62 guesthouse.

368269.description: The Locanda, a boutique hotel nestled in a historic building in Monza's central Piazza San Paolo, offers guests a unique city experience. Located in the pedestrian area, it's just steps from the Arengario (Old Town Hall) and a short stroll from the Gothic Cathedral. The spacious, bright, and quiet rooms feature parquet floors, wood-beamed ceilings, and private terraces with views of the square, Duomo, and city. Guests enjoy comfortable beds with slatted bases, orthopedic mattresses, and hypoallergenic pillows, along with wooden furniture and ample wardrobe space. These elegant, modern rooms are equipped with all the necessary amenities, including independent air conditioning and heating, free Wi-Fi, a minibar, a kettle, and a flat-screen TV.

368275.description: Situated in Bogotá's exclusive western district, this hotel is conveniently located near the International Business Centre (Corferias), the US Embassy, and the National University. It's also just a short drive from the city center. The tranquil rooms offer amenities for a comfortable stay, and guests can enjoy a complimentary breakfast featuring tropical fruits, juices, pastries, Colombian coffee, and jam. The dedicated staff is committed to providing excellent service for a memorable stay.

368354.description: Strategically located in downtown Olaya and just 28 Km from the King Khalid Airport, this property is ideally suited for both business and leisure visitors wishing to explore Riyadh. The Kingdom Mall, Al Faisaliah Tower and the Diplomatic Quarter are all within easy reach. Amenities include free private parking, an indoor pool, a fitness area, sauna, massage, barbeque facilities, billiards, table tennis and a laundry/dry-cleaning service. A business centre allows access to free wireless internet, fax/copying services and meeting/banquet rooms which will be useful to corporate travellers. The on-site restaurant offers buffet or á la carte choices. The rooms and suites are spacious, elegant and tastefully furnished to a high standard and they all come with air conditioning, a flat screen television, mini-bar and hairdryer. Non-smoking rooms are available on request.

368601.description: Located conveniently across from Corferias, three blocks from the American Embassy , close to the National University , 5 minutes from the Cundinamarca and surrounded by shopping centers. The hotel has rooms decorated in an unique style. The property is located 10 km from the Airport and 30 minutes from the Zona Rosa, 15 minutes by car from the historic center of Bogotá. The hotel has a new concept of space, convenience and comfort of the hotels; the quality and charm of the room luxury suite with single room, offer you an unforgettable break.

368608.address: Kayabasi Mah. Sehit Mustafa Bozoklu Cad. No:5/1, 20
368608.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. The Hampton by Hilton Istanbul Kayasehir is conveniently located near metro and highway transport links, just 33km from Istanbul, and near Ikitelli, Masko and ISTOC industrial parks. Stay at this hotel and enjoy free WiFi, free hot breakfast, and access to a free onsite fitness center. Relax on a twin or queen-sized comfy bed in a cozy guest room at this Kayasehir hotel. Stay connected at the work desk while seated comfortably in an ergonomic chair. Purchase beverages and snacks at our convenience store and keep them cold in the mini-refrigerator in your guest room. Every morning, start your day right with Hampton's free hot breakfast. Work out on modern equipment in our fitness center. Ask our multilingual staff for tips on what to see and do near our Kayasehir hotel. We provide foreign currency exchange for your convenience. Friendly service, clean rooms, comfortable surroundings, every time. If you're not satisfied, we don't expect you to pay. That's our commitment and your guarantee. That's 100% Hampton(r).

368618.description: Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. The shuttle (surcharge) will take you to the nearby beach or shopping center. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a cruise ship terminal shuttle. Make yourself at home in one of the 14 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones with free local calls, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Basilica Cistern - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Sultanahmet Square - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Cemberlitas Bath - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Grand Bazaar - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Hagia Sophia - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Istanbul Archaeology Museums - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Little Hagia Sophia - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Blue Mosque - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Eminönü Square - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Beyazit Square - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Eminonu Pier - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Bosphorus - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Gülhane Park - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi. The nearest airports are: Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 44. 9 km / 27. 9 mi Istanbul Airport (IST) - 48. 4 km / 30. 1 mi The preferred airport for Sunlife Hotel Old City is Istanbul Airport (IST). With a stay at Sunlife Hotel Old City in Istanbul (Sultanahmet), you'll be within a 5-minute walk of Basilica Cistern and Sultanahmet Square. This hotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from Grand Bazaar and 0. 4 mi (0. 6 km) from Hagia Sophia.

368762.description: Sitting within the Marrakech medina itself, this riad features a beautiful terrace with views of the Koutoubia Mosque, a traditional swimming pool and a fireplace for the chilly evenings. Any visitor is sure to remain in awe of the rich intricate patterns that cover every centimetre of the beautiful interior – from the complex meanders of the wrought-iron furniture to the imaginative colourful rugs and tiles. Delicately interwoven with the historical feel of the hotel, modern-day conveniences are also available, so the guests can immerse themselves in an ancient culture, while enjoying a truly comfortable and contemporary vacation.

368775.address: Quartier de l'hivernage, rue el Houssima., 000
368775.description: This magnificent hotel is nestled in beautiful and historically rich city of Marrakech, only 5. 3 kilometres away from Marakech Menara Aiport. Its convenient location in the heart of the city will be a great advantage for all those who wish to explore the area. Within walking distance guests will find the Marrakech railway station and local places of interest including Djemaa El Fna and Marrakech Medina. This wonderful establishment enjoys a delightful décor combining the traditional Arabic artisanal elements with classic elegance. The well-lit and sumptuously appointed guestrooms offer a complete escape for the senses, where to totally relax at the end of the day. The on-site signature restaurant offers flavourful specialities of Moroccan and international cuisines. Guests can have a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool or have a leisurely stroll through a verdant garden surrounded by swaying palm trees.

368819.description:
Lisbon Arsenal Suites is a charming boutique hotel located in the heart of Lisbon’s historic city center, just steps away from the iconic Praça do Comércio and Cais do Sodré, in the renowned Baixa-Chiado district. 
With a prime location, the hotel offers easy access to key landmarks such as the Praça do Município and is close to the EMSA (European Maritime Safety Agency). 
The hotel features 24 comfortable and modern rooms, offering a welcoming bed & breakfast service — perfect for both leisure and business travelers. 
Guests will find excellent public transport connections nearby, including metro, buses, and the famous tram 28, ideal for discovering the charm of Lisbon

368828.description:
This hotel is located at the heart of the historical peninsula of Sultanahmet. The hotel is ideally located for travellers eager to visit the sights for which Istanbul is renowned. The Topkapi Palace and the Blue Mosque are located close by. A wide range of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found in the vicinity. Links to the public transport network are also readily accessible nearby. This charming hotel offers superbly-styled guest rooms, which combine traditional and contemporary elements. Guests can enjoy a superb breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore this captivating city. 

Otelimiz barlar ve restoranlarla çevrili işlek bir caddede yer alan bu rahat şehir merkezi oteli, mozaiklerin bulunduğu eski bir Bizans kilisesi olan Ayasofya'ya yürüyerek 11 dakika ve 15. yüzyıldan kalma büyük Topkapı Sarayı'na 13 dakika uzaklıktadır. En yakın tramvay durağı 3 dakikalık yürüme mesafesindedir. 

Çarpıcı sanat eserleriyle dekore edilmiş küçük odalarda WiFi, düz ekran TV, çay-kahve malzemeleri, mini bar ve kasa bulunur.

368830.address: Uzunçınar Mh. Turizm Cad. 90th St. No:, 11
368830.description: Situated in the hotel district of Camyuva on Turkey's south coast in an area of natural beauty where the Taurus Mountains form a backdrop to the turquoise waters of the Mediterranean Sea, this attractive hotel is built in an Ottoman style and boasts a large entrance hall with a dome roof and two side wings. Guests can benefit from the property's own private section of the shingle beach which is within the immediate vicinity of the hotel, while there is also a generously sized pool and a good range of amenities for guests' enjoyment. Close by guests will find some shops and café bars to visit while public transport passes close to the hotel entrance enabling easy access to the popular resort of Kemer 8 km away and further afield, the city of Antalya.

368835.description: Situated by the beach in Beldibi on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, this family-friendly hotel lies in a spacious garden in the shadow of the Taurus Mountains next to an orchard. Classically furnished with marbled floors and chandeliers in the lobby and indoor restaurant, the property features a range of activities for guests' entertainment. With an informal atmosphere featuring lazy days by the pool or fun on the beach where guests can join in water sports or sunbathe on the hotel's jetty, the complex also hosts an animation programme for those who enjoy participating in games and competitions. For those looking to explore this beautiful area, some shops and café bars can be found within a few minutes' walk while the larger resort of Kemer is 16 km and can be reached by public transport which stops close to the entrance of the hotel.

368919.description: Situated within 100 metre(s) from the town centre, the property is easily accessible on foot to a host of places of interest. The nearest public means of transportation are within walking distance from the property. This accomodation offers a total of 94 units. This establishment was refurbished in 2015. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Mira Olimpos Beach. This hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. There is a car park at Mira Olimpos Beach. Those who stay at this establishment may avail for airport transfer service. This hotel offers a variety of activities and entertainment options ideal for those who love practicing sports, or simply enjoy the great outdoors. Clients will appreciate the dining options available at this hotel. This hotel takes pride in offering some health and wellness facilities, ideal for relaxing and having a healthy and fit body. Some services may be payable.

368923.description: Great care is taken to ensure guests experience comfort through top-notch services and amenities. Stay connected with your associates, as complimentary Wi-Fi is available during your entire visit. To facilitate your arrival and departure, you can pre-book airport transfer services prior to checking in. When arriving by car, you'll be grateful for the on-site complimentary parking at hotel. Smoking is permitted solely in the specified smoking zones allocated by hotel. Each day, arise to a delightful complimentary morning meal at Comfort Life Hotel. How about kicking off each day of your getaway with a delicious cup of coffee? At the hotel, relish in the invigorating taste of a freshly brewed, excellent coffee. Various excellent meal offerings at hotel ensure that enticing and easily accessible options are constantly available. Throughout the day and night, guests can enjoy light refreshments with the hotel offering vending machines.

369063.description: Situated near Miraflores' vibrant Malecon, on Bolivar Street next to Larco Avenue, this modern hotel offers personalized service and comfortable rooms and public spaces. Its LED-illuminated facade creates a striking visual effect, hinting at the hotel's contemporary personality, reflecting the unique character of Lima's most dynamic district. Guests are within walking distance of Miraflores' key attractions, including Kennedy Park and the Municipality. Explore nearby art galleries, recreational areas, top-rated restaurants, lush gardens, and lively craft fairs. The spacious lobby features separate check-in areas, a private room, and decor showcasing Lima's modern style.

369109.address: Zorlu Center Koru Sokak, Zorlu Center, 0
369109.description: To experience the world of emotional luxury, unrivaled comfort and bespoke service, Accor Hotels Turkiye has its unique way to make you feel special. Set in one of the most desirable areas in the city, Raffles Istanbul captivates with stunning Bosphorus views and houses a contemporary interior design garnished with a gorgeous collection of specially commissioned artwork; offering a new perspective on a timeless city.

369125.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including an indoor pool and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a fireplace in the lobby, and a picnic area. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6:30 AM to 9:00 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Medford? This hotel has 200 square feet (19 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary (available on request). Make yourself at home in one of the 72 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and Smart televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment.

369127.description: The well-being of guests is top of mind at Choice-branded hotels. Guests may experience a variety of new, improved cleanliness protocols and products. Get real value for your hard-earned money at the Quality Inn Spring Valley - Nanuet hotel in Spring Valley, NY, which lets you relax and focus on the people and experiences you came for. We give our valued guests easy access to such nearby points of interest as Nanuet Mall, Palisades Mall, Nyack Seaport, Dominican College, Good Samaritan Hospital, Nyack Hospital, Helen Hayes Hospital, Nyack College and Bear Mountain State Park. Enjoy such amenities as free WiFi, free ample parking, grab n go breakfast and free coffee. Guest rooms feature a refrigerator, microwave, recharge device, flat-screen TV and coffee maker. The more often you stay with us, the more rewards you earn with the Choice Privileges Rewards program.

369129.description: Located in Uniondale's business district, the Long Island Marriott is within a 15-minute walk of Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum and Hofstra University. This hotel is also a short drive from Roosevelt Field Mall (3. 4 miles) and Belmont Park (7. 8 miles). It offers 615 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a refrigerator, LCD TV, and private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. For your convenience, desks, coffee/tea makers, and phones are also provided. Enjoy Netflix entertainment and wired/wireless internet access (surcharge). Guests can utilize the indoor pool, 24-hour fitness center, and bicycle rentals. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Dine at the hotel's Crop & Kettle restaurant, unwind at the bar/lounge, and enjoy a buffet breakfast (available for a fee). The hotel features a business center, limo/town car service, express check-in, and ample meeting and conference space. Free self-parking is available on-site.

name.content: SpringHill Suites New York LaGuardia Airport

369142.description: Located in East Elmhurst, Queens, the SpringHill Suites by Marriott New York LaGuardia Airport is a convenient choice for travelers. Enjoy complimentary amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, Wi-Fi, and a buffet breakfast. The hotel offers 173 air-conditioned rooms equipped with refrigerators, Smart TVs, microwaves, and desks. Guests can grab a bite at the snack bar/deli or a drink at the bar/lounge. For business travelers, there's a 24-hour business center and meeting rooms. A complimentary airport shuttle is available upon request. Citi Field and the New York Hall of Science are just a short drive away.

name.content: SpringHill Suites New York Midtown Manhattan 5thAv

369143.description: Enjoy city views from the terrace of this Art Deco hotel in Midtown Manhattan. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast and utilize amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and wedding services. The hotel also features a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Each of the 173 guest rooms includes a refrigerator, microwave, and a 42-inch LCD TV with premium channels. Wired and wireless internet access is available for a surcharge. Bathrooms offer complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. For events, the hotel provides 398 square feet of space, including conference space and two meeting rooms. Local attractions such as 5th Avenue, Herald Square, and Macy's are within a short distance.

369145.description: Enjoy amenities such as a fitness center, Wi-Fi (surcharge), and concierge services. This hotel also features gift shops/newsstands and a ballroom. Dine at Pancetta, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or unwind at one of the two bars/lounges. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are served weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fee applies). The hotel offers a 24-hour business center, express check-out, complimentary newspapers, conference space, meeting rooms, and free self-parking. Each of the 345 guestrooms features a refrigerator, an LCD television, a private bathroom with a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. Wi-Fi is available for a surcharge.

369167.description: 'Built in 2018, this 45-room hotel offers a variety of accommodations, from single and double rooms to junior suites and luxurious options. Perfectly located for exploring the surrounding area, the hotel provides 24-hour reception, a safe, currency exchange, internet access, room service, laundry service, and a guest terrace. Additional amenities include komi service and public area ventilation. '

369217.description: The accomodation consists of 17 rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. The front desk offers 24-hour reception.

369430.description: This wonderful hotel is situated in the heart of London, ideally located for exploring the vibrant West End and Piccadilly Circus. The Prince of Wales Theatre is a mere 100 meters away, and Chinatown is just 200 meters from the hotel. Heathrow International Airport is conveniently located 37 km away. This stylish hotel offers elegantly appointed guest rooms and excellent service, ensuring a memorable stay in the heart of London.

369431.description: A charming hotel with an ideal location close to the Grand Bazaar and historical attractions at Sultanahmet and just 150m from Cemberlitas tramstop. The rooms are prettily decorated in muted tones with dusky pink furnishings, while the en suite bathrooms have sleek marble walls and are modernly furnished and equipped. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast each morning before beginning a day of exploring this fascinating city. Sultanahmet is 700m away so within easy walking distance or one tramstop away. There are shops, cafe bars and restaurants around the area of the hotel and for those seeking a wider choice, the area around Taksim Square is worth a visit and just 4 km from the hotel. .

369432.description: This hotel sits amidst the bustle and charm of the central London district of Victoria. The property is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Buckingham Palace and the train station. Victoria underground station is located nearby, offering ease of access to other areas of the city. Local theatres can be found close by. This hotel occupies a converted Victorian townhouse, oozing sophistication and classical elegance, with a blend of architectural styles. The guest rooms blend traditional and modern elements. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available onsite, for the convenience of business and leisure travellers.

369482.description: With a total of 15 rooms, this is a nice place to stay. The accomodation offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Retrome Barcelona offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. This bed and breakfast is awarded with certification. Some services of Retrome Barcelona may be payable.

369496.description: Nestled in the verdant north side of Hilversum, this hotel offers easy access to Utrecht’s nature reserves, with numerous cycling and walking trails nearby. Amsterdam is only 30 minutes away. The hotel features comfortable, well-equipped rooms, a welcoming restaurant serving a variety of dishes, and a cozy bar, perfect for unwinding at the end of the day. Wireless internet is available throughout the hotel. Guests will appreciate the hotel's warm and inviting atmosphere, attentive service and convenient amenities.

369540.description: An affordable hotel offering very comfortable accommodation located on the outskirts of Madrid and close to the golf course in Las Matas, Madrid Casino being less than 10 minutes by car, in Torrelodones. The 79 naturally-lit accommodations in this establishment are all equipped with 28' LCD TV, a large writing desk and a completely furnished bathroom. There is a large meetings room on site for those on business and the modern lounge in off the foyer provides free coffee 24-hours a day. All the rooms and communal zones have complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi. Thanks to its strategic location, close to the capital and good communications, this is the perfect place to stay for business in Madrid or for sightseeing if on holiday and, for those arriving by car, private parking is free of charge.

369546.description: With a stay at The Galataport Hotel, you'll be centrally located in Istanbul, steps from Galata Tower and 14 minutes by foot from Galata Bridge. This hotel is 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from Pera Museum and 0. 7 mi (1. 2 km) from Istiklal Avenue. Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 8:30 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 28 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include electric kettles and free tea bags/instant coffee, as well as phones with free local calls.

369550.description: Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including a spa tub, a fitness center, and a seasonal outdoor pool. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a communal living room. Enjoy Argentinean cuisine at Charqui, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 26 guestrooms featuring minibars. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Rooms have private furnished balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and bidets.

369559.description: Enjoy a stay at Suites Malecon Cancun, located in downtown Cancun, just steps from Plaza Las Americas and a short walk from Amerimed Hospital. This hotel offers an outdoor pool, fitness center, and bicycle rentals. Guest rooms feature microwaves, flat-screen TVs with cable, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Additional amenities include free Wi-Fi, a communal living room, and tour/ticket assistance. The hotel also provides a business center, 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and free self-parking.

369597.description: Picasso Suites 1. 2 offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. This establishment's common areas are disability-friendly.

369617.description: Located in London's vibrant Tower Hamlets district, the Travelodge London Bethnal Green is a 3-minute drive from Brick Lane and 5 minutes from Liverpool Street. This hotel is conveniently located near several iconic landmarks, including the Tower of London (3 km) and Tower Bridge (3. 3 km). The closest airport is London City Airport (LCY), while Heathrow Airport (LHR) is the preferred airport for the hotel.

name.content: Blue Tree Towers All Suites Santo Andre

369637.description:
This modern hotel is located in Santo André, 18 km from São Paulo, and 13 km from Congonhas Airport. The tasteful rooms have contemporary pale cream décor. The events area of the hotel features a business center and meeting rooms with capacity for up to 200 people. Located in a prime area of the city, near ABC Mall and major business centers in the region, including Sao Bernardo do Campo. Reservations for the PET Friendly program must be made directly with the hotel, as this is a service subject to availability. Availability of the PET Friendly program may vary depending on the hotel and demand, and direct confirmation with the hotel is essential. Additional fees may apply for pet accommodation, as per the hotel's policy. 
All rooms in the hotel are non-smoking.

369886.description:
Located on a street typical of the city of Oporto, in a building dating from the early 20th Century, the Oporto Guest House Charming House Marquês is central and quiet at the same time - perfect for your visit to this World Heritage City (UNESCO). 
Each of the rooms has personalized and comfortable decor. You will feel welcome throughout your stay, from the moment of check-in, relaxing in the reading room and lounge, or in the outdoor patio with a garden prepared with attention to every detail, through the personalized advising of the activities at your disposal in this historic city with so much to see and do.
The proximity of the Ribeira of Oporto and the historic city center, just 10 minutes by Oporto underground, will put you in the heart of Oporto's activities, without having to give up some peace and quiet at the end of the day.

369897.description: With a stay at Dream Cube Hostel in Barcelona (Les Corts), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Hospital Clinic and Rambla de Catalunya. This hostel is 1. 2 mi (2 km) from Camp Nou and 1. 7 mi (2. 8 km) from Passeig de Gracia. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, a communal living room, and tour/ticket assistance. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Make yourself at home in one of the 8 guestrooms. Prepare your meals in the shared/communal kitchen. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers.

369947.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including an indoor pool, a spa tub, and a sauna. This Art Deco hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Olea Cafe, Kitchen, Lounge, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in Riyadh? This hotel has 7319 square feet (680 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 8 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 286 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

369950.description: This charming property enjoys immediate access to the international Eurostar service, the National Rail and the London underground. Its convenient location makes it a great choice for business and leisure travellers alike. The British Museum and the Bloomsbury area are just a short walking distance away. The British Library and the University of London, as well as the famous Madame Tussauds, can be found in the area. This hotel blends effortlessly with its charming surroundings. Tastefully-designed guest rooms offer comfort and style, featuring modern furnishings and parquet floors. Guests can enjoy a wonderful breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore this captivating city. Customers must pay security deposit by cash or card of £100 on arrival. Deposit will be returned on check out. If paid by card it will be returned within 5 working days.

369951.description: Located a short walk from the town center and main entertainment areas, this renovated rural hotel offers a tranquil escape. Guests enjoy convenient access to public transport, with the airport and harbor within driving distance. The hotel provides Wi-Fi in public areas, parking, and conference facilities. A delightful dining venue offers a wide selection of flavorful dishes. This hotel is perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat.

370019.address: 29, LBS Marg, Gokul Nagar, Thane (W), Mumbai
370019.description: 30 km from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport and 5 km from Thane Railway Station is an imposing hotel that is sure to meet the requirements of even the most experience travellers. Patrons who are in town on a business meeting or a work assignment are sure to appreciate the business centre and secretarial services, as well as the ability to end the tiring day with a pampering massage at the SPA centre, a dip in the large indoor pool or a game of squash. Whether they prefer to sculpture their figure with intense gym workouts or a relaxing yoga session, guests are welcome to visit the respective facilities within the complex.

370057.description: All guests staying at this property will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Diagonal House as it counts with a total of 10 guest rooms. Those who stay at this establishment can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the establishment. There is no 24-hour reception. Additional fees may apply for some services.

370161.description: Located in Cancun (Zona Hotelera), Dreams Sands Cancun Resort & Spa - All Inclusive is within a 5-minute drive of Cancun Convention Center and Tortuga Beach. This 4-star aparthotel is 2 mi (3. 3 km) from Langosta Beach and 2. 6 mi (4. 2 km) from La Isla Shopping Mall. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 4 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional amenities at this aparthotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 414 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wired and wireless Internet access is available. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. This aparthotel is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Enjoy international cuisine at World Cafe, one of the aparthotel's 6 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 5 bars/lounges. Featured amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Free valet parking is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. West Coast of Isla Mujeres, Punta Cancun, and Punta Nizuc National Park - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi- Plaza Caracol Mall - 0. 3 km/0. 2 mi- Caracol Beach - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Forum By The Sea Mall - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Forum Beach - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Cancun Convention Center - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Gaviota Azul Beach - 1. 1 km/0.

370197.description: With a stay at Mola Hostel in Madrid (Centro), you'll be within a 5-minute walk of Puerta del Sol and Lavapies. This hostel is 0. 3 mi (0. 4 km) from Plaza Mayor and 0. 5 mi (0. 9 km) from Gran Via Street. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, a television in a common area, and tour/ticket assistance. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Satisfy your appetite at the hostel's coffee shop/café, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to noon for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 40 guestrooms. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers.

370217.description: Located in downtown Madrid, Las Murallas Hostel offers budget-friendly rooms with private bathrooms, heating, and TVs. We maintain high standards of cleanliness. Our location on Fuencarral Street in the historic center is just five minutes from Puerta del Sol and 200 meters from Gran Vía. On your departure day, checkout is at 12:00 PM, but you're welcome to store your luggage with us for as long as needed.

370317.description: The Exe Bacatá 95 is located in the centre of El chicó, a distinguished neighborhood of Bogotá, which is an important commercial zone with international cuisine restaurants, bars and shopping centers. The design of the hotel is based on the mythology of the Kogui culture, a pre-Columbian society. The hotel has 8 floors and 106 rooms. Two of them are suites. The hotel offers parking, restaurant with terrace and bar, swimming pool, meeting rooms, fitness room and terrace. The rooms of the Exe Bacatá 95 combine peaceful colors with textures that evoke the earth, the water and the air. This is the best relaxing combination after a working day. *Colombian and resident guests must pay additional 19% VAT, tourists exempt. * Swimming pool is temporarily closed. Groups: Reservations of more than 5 rooms may be subject to supplements and special conditions.

370322.description: Boasting a convenient location in the area of Providencia, close to Pedro de Valdivia and Los Leones metro stations, this fantastic urban hotel prides itself in offering a stylish accommodation with a high quality of service in a warm metropolitan city. The international airport is about 20km distance from the property and travellers are in close proximity to many shopping areas, restaurants and other local attractions. Whether travelling for pleasure or on business purposes, the hotel offers excellent guest rooms, suitable for everyone. The rooms are elegantly equipped with comfortable bedding and excellent facilities to ensure a fully-enjoyable stay. Guests may enjoy a unique dining experience with the exquisite menu offered by the on-site restaurant, which includes traditional Italian cuisine as well as some national specialities. The marvellous swimming pool, situated on the rooftop terrace, invites travellers to relax and enjoy spectacular views over the city.

370358.description: There are a total of 18 accomodation units at Maria Cristina.

370419.description: This cosy hotel is set in Puerta del Sol-Plaza Mayor.

370536.description: Located in the heart of Venice, steps from the Scuola Dalmata di San Giorgio degli Schiavoni and its renowned Carpaccio paintings, this hotel offers easy access to iconic landmarks such as Piazza San Marco and the Biennale Gardens. Overlooking the river, the hotel boasts a 17th-century portal and a terrace with Istrian stone balustrades, offering breathtaking views of the Bacino di San Marco and San Giorgio Island. Nestled between a medieval courtyard and one of Venice's largest private gardens, the hotel's rooms feature original furnishings and accessories from the past two centuries.

370627.description: XO Hotels Couture is located near the A10 highway giving it quick and easy access to many parts of the city and surroundings. From the hotel it is only a 5 minute walk to the World Fashion Centre. Right in front of the hotel stops a tram which bring you in 15 minutes to the Museum Quarter. From there you can easily reach the Leidseplein, the Vondelpark, the shopping district and many other tourist attractions. Schiphol Airport is a 15-minute drive from the hotel. XO Hotels Couture is the perfect base to discover Amsterdam and its surrounding area due to the accessibility both by car and public transport.

370680.address: Po Box 5855 Rolla Road Bur Dubai
370680.description: Nestled in the heart of Bur Dubai, this elegant and sophisticated hotel is an ideal spot from which to discover Dubai. From this accommodation, guests can enjoy easy access to all that the lively city has to offer and the city's must-see destinations such as Al Khaleej Centre a 5-minute walk away. The hotel offers impeccable service and all the essential amenities to invigorate travellers including a selection of top-class facilities. All guest accommodations feature thoughtful amenities to ensure an unparalleled sense of comfort such as a seating area to relax after a busy day of sightseeing or work. Besides, the hotel's host of recreational offerings ensures guests have plenty to do during their stay without having to leave the establishment such as a rooftop pool and a disco.

name.content: Mercure Rio de Janeiro Barra da Tijuca

370686.description: Located 1. 2 miles (2 km) from the Jardim OceÃ¢nico metro station and 15. 5 miles (25 km) from the Santos Dumont Airport, the Mercure RJ Barra da Tijuca offers modern and comprehensive facilities to ensure your comfort and well-being, featuring rooms with air conditioning and free WIFI, a restaurant, two bars, fitness center, modular events rooms, meeting rooms and indoor parking. Enjoy our 24-hour bar and sample regional cuisine in our Samba restaurant.

370687.description: This trendy and stylish hotel is perched high on a hilltop and has fantastic views of its surroundings. Just 3 kilometres from Ponte da Barca picturesque town, this modern property is very near Lima River and close to other beautiful and inspiring towns like Ponte da Lima at 17 kilometres away. Moreover, Porto's Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is around 90 kilometres away. All comfortable guest rooms and suites are soundproof and include air-conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a minibar, a private balcony from where guests can admire the panoramic views or complimentary wireless Internet connection if they prefer to stay in touch with their families.
