In addition, suites have an extra living room with a cosy sofa. The hotel is provided with both wonderful outdoor and indoor swimming pools, a wellness centre, a fitness room and an on-site restaurant that serves delicious Portuguese dishes.

370857.description: Nestled on the slopes of Signal Hill nature reserve, this hotel offers stunning views of Bo-Kaap's vibrant streets. Conveniently located near Cape Town's city center, beaches, and port, it's also just a 20-minute drive from the international airport, with shuttle service and free parking available. Guests can relax in the tranquil gardens, take a dip in the outdoor pool, or soak up the sun in the solarium area. The bright, spacious rooms feature stylish decor, and some offer balconies with seating areas overlooking the gardens and city. All rooms include air conditioning and a safety deposit box. Guests also enjoy access to a communal TV lounge, laundry and dry cleaning services, and daily maid service. The hotel reception can provide information on nearby excursions.

370873.description: Located in Lima’s Barranco district, 2 km from Larcomar, Hotel Park Suites offers 33 spacious suites—some with a private hydromassage tub. Guests enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site parking, and an American breakfast. Airport transfers available (surcharge). Accessible rooms on request, with elegant decor, cozy spaces, and personalized service for an unforgettable stay in the city.

370939.address: İskenderpaşa Mah. Şekerci Sok. No:16 Aksaray
370939.description: Located just steps from the Aksaray tram station in Istanbul's Aksaray district, Hotel Star Park offers convenient access to major attractions, including the Grand Bazaar, Spice Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, and Basilica Cistern. These sites are easily reachable within a few minutes by tram or a 15-20 minute walk. The hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi throughout, concierge services, and an on-site restaurant serving a daily open-buffet breakfast. Each tastefully furnished, air-conditioned room features an LCD TV with satellite channels, a minibar, and a modern bathroom with a shower, hairdryer, and high-quality amenities. Room service is also available, and numerous dining options can be found nearby.

370945.description: This hotel has comfortable and spacious apartments. Located in Palermo neighborhood, it offers fully equipped rooms, to give independence to leisure or business travellers. The aparthotel is located close to Santa Fe Avenue, Abasto Shopping and Alto Palermo Shopping. It is also very close to metro station and buses stops. It is a very good alternative for travellers who are looking to know Buenos Aires in a different way. The hotel offers a great variety of services to enjoy this marvelous city. The professional staff will give you the undivided attention that you deserve, always trying to accommodate special requests and personalizing your stay.

370953.description: Located in Mataró on Catalonia's Maresme coast, this fully renovated hotel is just 150 meters from the beach and reopened in July 2014. Only 28 km from Barcelona, with easy train access, it's an ideal base for exploring the region. The hotel offers spacious, well-appointed rooms, most with balconies. Guests can enjoy Catalan and international cuisine in the on-site restaurant and cafeteria. Amenities include free WiFi, parking, meeting rooms, and bicycle rentals.

370954.description: This stylish and dazzling hotel enjoys a magnificent central position in Las Ramblas de Cataluña, just a few metres from Plaza Cataluña, Paseo de Gracia with classy shopping opportunities and the lively and busy Las Ramblas street. Those staying at this property will be close to many dining, shopping and entertainment options that can be found in the immediate vicinity, as well as convenient public transport connections like bus and metro stations. The modern guest rooms are nicely decorated and boast high-end amenities such as coffee makers. All the accommodation units are very luminous and have wonderful views to Plaza Cataluña from their private balcony or to the charming interior courtyard. Visitors will be amazed by the lobby bar with a convenient terrace and a pool, as well as the delicious on-site restaurant and a rooftop terrace with a plunge pool.

371129.description: Situated in Avsallar, this beachfront hotel offers a complimentary shuttle to its private beach until 6:00 PM. Just a 90-minute drive from Antalya Airport, the hotel, built in 2013, boasts 803 laminate-floored rooms, each featuring a balcony, a 40-inch LCD TV, a safe, central air conditioning, and a private bathroom with amenities. Guests can enjoy a variety of unique pools, including a heated indoor option for cooler days, as well as a children's pool conveniently located within the supervised miniclub. Maintain your fitness routine at the on-site gym or explore the area with the hotel's car hire service.

371140.description: The 16 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Stay Blue Hotel was completely renovated in 2014. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. The reception is open 24/7. This establishment's common areas are disability-friendly. Parking facilities are available for guests' convenience. Some services of Stay Blue Hotel may be payable.

371257.description: The Merit San Telmo is a 3-star hotel in Buenos Aires's vibrant San Telmo neighborhood. Within easy walking distance of the city center and major tourist attractions, and surrounded by bars, restaurants, and shops, it's ideal for leisure, business, or simply relaxing. The hotel features a double-height lobby with designer furniture and modern technology, a bar for guests and passersby, and a self-service snack area. Its 141 rooms are spread across 8 floors of an elegant 1940s building, where significant period details have been preserved. All rooms are equipped with a mirror, reading lamp, workspace, desk, and a private bathroom. Accessible rooms are also available.

371459.description: The Seven Seas Palmeras Bay, part of the renowned Seven Seas Hotels group, offers a unique seaside location on the beautiful Alanya coast. Situated on an 18, 000 m² site, this ultra all-inclusive hotel guarantees maximum guest satisfaction with personalized service and recently renovated rooms. Just 5 km from Alanya city center, known for its stunning beaches and vibrant nightlife, the hotel is conveniently located 118 km from Antalya Airport and 50 km from Gazipasha Airport. Following extensive renovations in 2023, all 304 rooms and service areas now boast a fresh, contemporary design. The hotel proudly joined the established Seven Seas Hotels Group in the summer of 2024.

name.content: Novotel Rio de Janeiro Park Olimpico

371460.address: Av Embaixador Abelardo Bueno 1511 Barra Da Tijuca
371460.description: Well located for business and leisure, Novotel Rio de Janeiro Olympic Park has an incredible structure. Rooms are comfortable, with a/c and free WiFi. Restaurant 365 serves a varied breakfast menu and international cuisine, there is also a bar for drinks. Modern event room for lectures, and the leisure area has a sauna, gym, kids space and two pools with a bar. Wondering what to do in Rio de Janeiro? Novotel is close to key leisure spots such as the Olympic Park and Jeunesse Arena, a 6-min drive, major sports venues and shows like Rock in Rio. Barra Shopping, one of the largest malls in Latin America, is a 7-minute drive from the hotel. Av. Olegário Maciel has great dining options and is 20 mins by car. Novotel is close to Barra beach. A comfortable, modern hotel in Barra da Tijuca, with an incredible infrastructure for business or leisure, and well located for quick access to the city. Book at Novotel Rio de Janeiro Olympic Park.

371461.description: Located just 400 meters from the Corferias International Exhibition Center and convenient to El Campin Coliseum and El Dorado International Airport, this hotel boasts a prime location near the American Embassy. Guests will appreciate the proximity to restaurants, shopping malls, and various attractions. The hotel features modern architecture and design, reflected in each well-appointed room. Soft colors and minimalist decor create a tranquil, luxurious atmosphere ensuring a relaxed and enjoyable stay.

371579.description: Situated near the financial district and a 25-minute drive from El Dorado International Airport, this hotel offers fully equipped guest rooms, a restaurant, and a lounge bar serving delicious appetizers and cocktails. Enjoy a daily buffet breakfast and internationally inspired dishes at the hotel restaurant. The elegantly decorated rooms provide all the amenities you need for a comfortable stay. The attentive staff is dedicated to providing personalized service, ensuring a welcoming experience. This hotel is an excellent choice for exploring this vibrant city.

371625.description: There are a total of 81 units at Cristal Palace Hotel. Guests can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the hotel. The front desk offers 24-hour reception.

371653.description: The premises count with 75 welcoming accomodation units. Visitors can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the property. Guests may contact the reception desk any time during the day.

371654.description: The premises count with 63 welcoming accomodation units. Casablanca Imperial Hotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Casablanca Imperial Hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. This property features a choice of business facilities in order to offer the perfect combination of comfort and convenience for a corporate trip.

371659.description: The Transamerica Executive Chácara Santo Antônio offers convenient access to the Transamerica Expo Center, Marginal Pinheiros, and various entertainment and service options. A complimentary shuttle service operates within a 5 km radius on weekdays. Guests can easily reach cultural attractions like the Alfa Theater (nearby) and Credicard Hall (4 km), as well as shopping destinations such as Morumbi Shopping Center (1. 5 km). The hotel also provides convenient access to HSBC Brasil Hall (3 km), Cicero Pompeu de Toledo Stadium (11 km), the Jockey Club (8 km), Burle Marx Park (6 km), and the US Consulate (12 km). Interlagos (Jose Carlos Pace) is a short 10-minute drive away. The modern accommodations offer cable TV, a minibar, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and free parking.

371666.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a seasonal outdoor pool, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and an arcade/game room. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. This hotel has 11 meeting rooms available for events. Limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 159 guestrooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Golden Square Shopping - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Shopping Metropole - 1. 3 km / 0.

371675.description: A total of 111 guest rooms are available for guests' convenience at Tower Icarai Hotel. Travellers may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. The front desk offers 24-hour reception.

371694.description: Located in the Jardins district, Fortune Residence is 2 blocks away from Avenida Paulista and offers rooms with free WiFi. Consolação Metro station can be reached within a 10-minute walk. The air-conditioned guest rooms include a living room, a kitchen and a private bathroom. Each room is equipped with cable TV,  minibar and a functional work desk. Guests can make use of the fitness centre and dry sauna or enjoy a refreshing drink by the hotel's bar. Fortune Residence also features a business centre and an events room and offers a laundry service. Hotel Fortune Residence is a 15-minute drive from Congonhas Airport and is 40 minutes away from Guarulhos International Airport by car. We speak your language!

371752.description: Villa Santo Agostinho Hotel features a total of 96 guest rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. The hotel provides 24-hour reception. Villa Santo Agostinho Hotel understands that accessibility is important to all guests. For this reason, it features wheelchair accessible guest rooms and is fully adapted for easy access. All guests staying at this property may relax and escape daily routine in its wellness facilities. The property's entertainment offer ensures that there is never a dull moment.

371765.description: The 21 welcoming rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Unfortunately, the front desk is not open 24 hours. Owing to its health and wellness services, this hotel is ideal for a relaxing break from the stress and strain of daily life. Pousada E Spa Vrindavana may charge a fee for some services.

371797.description: There are a total of 71 units at Rafeli. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. This hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience.

371820.description: Nestled in the mountains just 50 minutes from Rio de Janeiro, the 3-star Vila Bavária Hotel offers a refreshing escape in the imperial city of Petrópolis. Surrounded by lush greenery, the hotel features a swimming pool, sports courts (soccer, volleyball, basketball), a game room, and a cozy lounge with a fireplace and TV. A short drive takes you to the historic city center (10 min) or the renowned Imperial Museum (8 min). Choose from a variety of room types, each equipped with a king-size bed, cable TV, and free internet access. Enjoy breakfast Tuesday-Sunday in the hotel restaurant, featuring fresh fruit, jellies, juices, and breads. Please note the restaurant is closed on Mondays.

371825.description: With a stay at Cristal Palace Inn in Lins, you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Flag Square and House of Culture and Municipal Library. This hotel is 1 mi (1. 6 km) from Saint Anthony of Padua Cathedral and 2. 1 mi (3. 3 km) from Gilberto Siqueira Lopes Stadium. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, laundry facilities, and an elevator. Free self parking is available onsite. At Cristal Palace Inn, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6 AM to 10 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 48 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless Internet access is available. Bathrooms with showers are provided.

371838.description: This property offers a total of 161 guest rooms. The World Vila Olimpia offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Those who stay at this establishment are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. This property does not offer cots on demand. Communal areas are wheelchair accessible at The World Vila Olimpia.

371854.description: There are a total of 25 accomodation units on the premises. Visitors may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Granja Brasil Resort. All guests staying at this property are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. Travellers can chill out at the end of the day with this property's varied health offer. The entertainment options available are sure to impress those who stay at this establishment.

371882.description: Situated just 500 meters from the town center, this hotel offers easy access to local attractions and is conveniently located near entertainment areas. Public transport is within 100 meters, facilitating exploration of the surrounding region. The airport is 42. 1 km from the hotel. Refurbished in 2013, the hotel's 49 welcoming rooms provide a relaxing retreat. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the property and benefit from the convenience of a 24-hour reception. While cots are not available, the hotel offers accessible rooms and parking facilities. Guests can dine at the hotel's on-site restaurants. Please note that some services may incur additional charges.

371888.description: Located in the Higienópolis neighborhood of São Paulo, this hotel offers a convenient base just an 8-minute drive from Paulista Avenue and the São Paulo Museum of Art (MASP). Guests can start their day with a complimentary breakfast buffet and stay connected with free Wi-Fi available throughout the property. Accommodation options include Standard and Superior rooms, equipped with air conditioning, a minibar, and a work desk. The hotel offers a variety of configurations, from double to triple rooms with twin beds, and also has rooms specifically adapted for guests with special needs. For local travel, the Higienópolis-Mackenzie metro station is a 6-minute walk away, providing easy access to the city.

371906.description: Stay at Ramada Suites Sao Paulo Itaim Bibi Newciti hotel, located within driving distance of Aeroporto de Congonhas, Aeroporto Internacional Governador Franco Montoro (GRU), and Google Sao Paulo. Amenities include meeting space, restaurant, complimentary wireless internet, and complimentary breakfast. Guest suites offer flat-screen HDTV, mini-refrigerator, and microwave. Attractions are Iguatemi Sao Paulo shopping centre, JK Iguatemi, Ibirapuera Park, and Sao Paulo Museum of Art. Sorry, no pets.

371921.description: Esuites Congonhas by Atlantica is next to Congonhas Airport and features a state-of-the-art gym, sauna, sports court and free Wi-Fi. Rooms at Esuites Congonhas by Atlantica are soundproofed and feature a modern bathroom and an LCD TV with cable channels. They also have a balcony, a fully equipped kitchen and seating and dining areas. The Copa restaurant offers a variety of national and international dishes. The lobby bar serves natural juices and other beverages, and is a good place to enjoy a happy hour. Room service is available 24 hours a day. The hotel is 10 km from downtown São Paulo and an 8-minute drive from Ibirapuera Park. The property offers easy access to important event centers, shops and restaurants in the trendy district of Moema and the main avenues, such as 23 de Maio, Bandeirantes and Roberto Marinho. We emphasize that the contracted daily rate is for 24 hours, with check-in from 2 p. m. and check-out until 12 p. m. The interval of up to 3 hours between guests' departure and arrival is provided for in MTur Ordinance No. 28 and is intended exclusively for cleaning, sanitizing, and tidying up the unit, ensuring the maintenance of our standard of excellence.

371957.description: A total of 21 rooms are available for guests' convenience. Those staying at this hotel may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. Casablanca Koeler Hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience.

371961.description: Enjoy your stay at Hotel Domani, conveniently located near Bosque Maia Park (0. 9 mi) and Parque Shopping Maia (2. 1 mi). Take advantage of our complimentary 24-hour airport shuttle to and from São Paulo/Guarulhos Intl. Airport (7 mi). We offer 138 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars, flat-screen TVs with cable, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. Hotel amenities include a fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, a TV in the common area, a banquet hall, and a restaurant with room service (limited hours). Start your day with our complimentary buffet breakfast, served from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM. We also offer a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

371967.description: There are a total of 30 accomodation units at Residencial Pantanal Chacara Klabin. Residencial Pantanal Chacara Klabin does not offer 24-hour reception. Some services of Residencial Pantanal Chacara Klabin may be payable.

371987.description: Located in the center of Guarulhos, this hotel offers easy access to the city's amenities and transport links. Guests can enjoy a complimentary breakfast buffet and take advantage of the on-site restaurant, which serves lunch and dinner. The hotel offers a free airport shuttle service connecting travelers to Guarulhos International Airport. Key amenities include a fitness center and a sauna. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, a minibar, and a private bathroom. Room types available include Standard Double Rooms, Deluxe Twin Rooms, and Standard Triple Rooms. The hotel is located 2. 8 km from Internacional Shopping Guarulhos and 3. 9 km from Tietê Ecological Park.

371994.description: This charming hotel is located in Barra da Tijuca, just 5. 6 kilometers from the main entertainment areas and 22 kilometers from the airport. It offers 140 guest rooms and internet access throughout the property. A 24-hour reception welcomes guests in the lobby. Cots are available upon request for families traveling with young children. All rooms are wheelchair accessible. Pets are not permitted.

name.content: Nau Royal Hotel Boutique E Spa

372049.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and bicycles to rent. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and shopping on site. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Azul Marinho, a restaurant which specializes in seafood, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include express check-in, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 13 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and DVD players. Rooms have private balconies.

372070.description: The establishment comprises a total of 58 snug guest rooms. Refugio Vista Serrana offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. Refugio Vista Serrana does not offer cots on demand. All units at this disability-friendly hotel are wheelchair-accessible. When it comes to relaxing, travellers will be spoilt for choice with the wide range of health opportunities available. The hotel provides an entertainment programme and leisure activities for guests' added convenience.

372072.description: The Fluminense Hotel has 84 renovated rooms, a function room, swimming pool and partnership with gym. In the center of Rio de Janeiro, we offer our guests a privileged location, close to the business, cultural and gastronomic center of the city. Next to the traditional bohemian neighborhood of Lapa, it is 10 minutes from the Santa Tereza district, close to the most famous tourist spots of the city, such as Sambódromo, Cristo Redentor, Sugar Loafers. Also located near the Museum of Tomorrow, Olympic Boulervard, Aquarium, Santos Dummont Airport and near the most beautiful beaches of Rio de Janeiro and postcards of the city.

372093.description:
Centrally located in Piracicaba just a few steps from bars and restaurants, New Life features a rooftop pool, gym and free Wi-Fi. Buffet breakfast is served daily at the restaurant. 

The air-conditioned suites feature an LCD TV, bathroom and a mini-kitchen with a mini-bar and microwave. Laundry and room service are provided. 

OYO New Life Piracicaba is 1 m from Piracicaba bus station, and 52 mi from Campinas' Viracopos Airport. Private parking is free. 

Couples in particular like the location – they rated it 9. 4 for a two-person trip. We emphasize that the contracted daily rate is for 24 hours, with check-in from 2 p. m. and check-out until 12 p. m. The interval of up to 3 hours between guests' departure and arrival is provided for in MTur Ordinance No. 28 and is intended exclusively for cleaning, sanitizing, and tidying up the unit, ensuring the maintenance of our standard of excellence

372107.description:
This charming Hotel is set in Aeropuerto Internacional Galeao. There are a total of 162 rooms at Linx Galeão BY GJP. Wi-Fi internet connection is available for further comfort and convenience. Additionally, the premises provide a reception service the whole day through. All accommodation units include cots for little children on demand. Pets are not allowed at Linx Galeão BY GJP. 

The daily breakfast buffet offers a variety of fresh fruits, breads and cold meats. Guests can also enjoy regional and international specialties, as well as a selection of drinks in the hotel's restaurant.  Linx Hotel International Airport Galeão also offers 24-hour free shuttle service and screens with flight hours.

372135.description: Escape to Niteroi and experience a contemporary 4 star hotel where modern design and breathtaking views set the stage for exclusive and extraordinary experiences. Located on the Guanabara Bay, across downtown Rio de Janeiro, the H Niteroi Hotel boasts 20 floors with 264 suites, some with exquisite views of the bay and the Sugar Loaf. Indulge in first-class guest amenities, including the Don Juan Restaurant, the Lobby Bar and our infinity pool. Enjoy the astonishing water views from the Deck Bar, sauna, and fitness Center.

372277.description: This hotel is located in Ikeja a suburb of Lagos and within a short distance of the Murtala Muhammed International Airport. Ikeja boasts a golf club, the City mall the largest one on mainland Lagos, the Jhalobia Recreation Park, the Nigerian National Museum and the famous Otigba Computer Market. There are many fun spots and recreation centres such as night clubs, restaurants, bars, eateries and Suya spots. Among the amenities offered are on-site parking, an outside pool, a fitness room, a laundry service, free wireless internet access and a meeting space. The hotel restaurant serves African cuisine and there is also an in-house bar and a poolside one. A free breakfast is available. The rooms and suites are spacious, elegant and tastefully decorated. They come with satellite television, safe, refrigerator, and tea/coffee makers. Non-smoking rooms are available.

372281.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the suburbs of Porto. The nearest station is D.Joao Station. The Hotel has a restaurant. All 92 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, ironing set and air conditioning.

372288.description: Enjoy a refreshing dip in the seasonal outdoor pool or admire the view from the terrace at Fasthotel Linate. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall. Savor a meal at Luppolo 63, the hotel's restaurant, with buffet breakfasts available for a fee on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 9:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. For business travelers, there's a business center and express check-out. The hotel also features 2691 square feet (250 square meters) of event space, including a conference center and five meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and free self-parking is provided onsite. The 118 air-conditioned rooms offer LCD televisions with digital channels, private bathrooms with rainfall showers and hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks. Located near Exhibition Park Novegro and Circolo Arci Magnolia, Fasthotel Linate is conveniently close to Linate Airport (LIN).

372342.description: The Hotel Rural Maria da Fonte is located in the idyllic village of Póvoa de Lanhoso, in an unspoiled natural setting around 10 minutes from Braga, a city in northern Portugal rich in history and culture. The Hotel Rural Maria da Fonte offers its guests an array of services that will make them feel in complete harmony with the surrounding environment. Come and enjoy yourself in a place where, as well as regional cuisine, you will have access to a heated indoor pool, tennis court, Turkish bath and many other amenities. Pamper your senses, and let yourself be captivated by the charm of our facilities! Let our team take care of you while you are enchanted by the typical aromas and landscapes of Minho!

372347.description: Nestled in the heart of Alanya Konaklı, a modern tourist destination on the Mediterranean coast, our hotel spans an impressive 9, 000 square meters. Surrounded by the fragrant aroma of pine and palm trees, we offer an unforgettable holiday experience. Our guests enjoy a rich variety of food and beverages, a certified spa and wellness center, an aqua park, an entertainment center, a magnificent beach and pool, and many other exceptional services. Please note: The hotel does not accept bookings for men only throughout the summer season.

372442.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as bicycle rentals, a terrace, and a garden. This Porto hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Start your day with a buffet breakfast (available for a fee), and end it with a drink at the bar/lounge. Room service is also available. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge). Self-parking is available onsite (surcharge). The 12 air-conditioned guest rooms feature LCD televisions with cable programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Decanting Porto House is centrally located in Porto, within a 15-minute walk of Porto City Hall and Porto Cathedral, and a short drive from Porto Airport (OPO).

name.content: Park Royal Buenos Aires managed by Accor

372443.description: The Park Royal City Buenos Aires offers an ideal location for exploring one of South America's most cosmopolitan cities. Walk from the hotel to iconic landmarks and experience the vibrant Argentine capital. Afterward, relax in the comfort of one of 55 well-appointed suites. Our exceptional service and convenient facilities will ensure a delightful stay. Each suite features a living room, soundproof windows with blackout curtains, an electric stove, crockery, a microwave, coffee maker, cable TV, hairdryer, and safe. A municipal tax of 0. 50 USD per foreign person older than 12 years, per night, will be charged at check-in.

372446.description: Set in the heart of the bustling Burj Area of Dubai, this exclusive private luxury aparthotel offers sumptuous city living with upmarket service and privacy. Minutes from Souk Al Bahar, Sheikh Zayed Road, Meydan, and the Dubai International Financial Centre, the hotel is the most sought-after luxury concept in Dubai for both business and leisure travellers alike. Just a short walk from the world's largest shopping complex, Dubai Mall, with views across the Dubai skyline and the famous Dubai Fountains, the hotel offers a private pool, outdoor shisha terrace, all-day dining in the modern café and opulent spa services in either one of seven high-tech treatment rooms and sauna or in the privacy of guests' room. With a selection of one, two, and three bedroom luxury hotel apartments, guests can enjoy the privacy and comfort of home with the excellent services expected in this booming city.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Dubai, Jumeirah Beach

372447.description: Be welcomed with a warm chocolate chip cookie upon arrival at the DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Dubai – Jumeirah Beach. Located on 'The Walk', a vibrant waterfront promenade, the hotel features its own private beach and is within walking distance of a variety of open-air cafes, restaurants, craft vendors and shops. Business hubs including Jebel Ali Free Zone and Dubai Media City are all within easy reach of our stylish hotel. Play a round on the magnificent Emirates Golf Course or shop in the Ibn Battuta Mall, both close to the hotel. Take the nearby tram or metro further afield to admire iconic Dubai attractions like the Burj Khalifa. All of the spacious one-, two- and three-bedroom suites feature amenities to make you feel at home, including a balcony, air-conditioning, a living room, an ergonomic work desk and WiFi. Host a successful event at this hotel in Dubai with six flexible meeting spaces and stay productive in the modern 24-hour business center. Start your day with an international breakfast buffet in the relaxed, all-day dining restaurant, the Gastro Kitchen or savor Arabic specialties in Al Maeda restaurant. Enjoy a snack or a cool drink in the pool bar, Areia. Energize with a workout as you gaze out over the Arabian Gulf in the complimentary 24-hour fitness center or swim in the shimmering waters of the temperature-controlled outdoor pool. Our Jumeirah Beach hotel also offers luxury spa treatments, the perfect way to unwind after a busy day.

name.content: The Chatwal in the unbound Collection

372456.description: Bridging classic and contemporary like no other landmark building, The Chatwal New York offers luxurious accommodations with art deco design. Our boutique hotel is surrounded by world-class restaurants, unforgettable nightlife, high-end shopping and iconic museums. Conde Nast Traveler Reader's Choice Awards #1 Best Hote in NYC (2022, 2021, 2018). 2021 Travel and Leisure World's Best Awards #2 Best Hotel in NYC; #15 Best Hotel in Continental U. S.

372504.description: Located in Istanbul's Bahcelievler district, this stylish, modern hotel offers convenient access to Istanbul Atatürk Airport (less than 3 km away), public transport, and the TEM highway. Relax and rejuvenate in the on-site hammam and sauna after a day of sightseeing or a long flight. A spacious lobby lounge provides a comfortable seating area. Nearby, you'll find a shopping center, local restaurants, and metro stations within 1. 5 km.

372505.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Stop by the hotel's restaurant for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 47 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

372587.description: Perfectly located in the heart of the city, at the confluence of the commercial, financial and entertainment districts, this modern hotel has been consistently recognized as one of the top business hotels in the city. From here, guests can enjoy easy access to all that Bogotá's has to offer, including Casa de Nariño, Museo del Oro and Iglesia De San Francisco. Modern and innovative, with a gracious staff dedicated to making you feel at home, the hotel surpass the expectations of discerning executive travellers with beautifully rooms, a relaxing bar, nice café and comfortable venues for small meetings and special events.

372717.address: Mimar Hayrettin Mah. Kadirga Limani Cad.Fatih, 7
372717.description: This small hotel is a great base from which to explore the myriad of wonderful attractions this city has to offer. Enjoying easy access to public transport, the hotel is 450m from Kumkapi train station and 650m from Yenikapi ferryboat port which runs services to the Asian side of the city. Featuring well furnished rooms equipped with modern amenities and comforts for guests' convenience, guests can benefit from a range of services provided by the hotel. The major attractions at Sultanahmet are within easy walking distance, being just over a kilometre from the hotel while the 'must-see' Grand Bazaar is 700m away.

372805.address: kocatepe mah. Taksim cad. Cambazoglu sok, 3
372805.description: Located a short walk from public transport and within 1 km of the beach, Regency World Suite & Hotel offers a tranquil escape from daily life. Refurbished in 2013, the hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi throughout, a 24-hour reception, and is committed to sustainable practices. The hotel does not offer cots upon request. Wheelchair access is available in public areas. Some services may incur additional charges.

372839.description: A brand new building in the suburbs of Athens, with a minimalist design, three floors and high-end technology, it is 2 km from the centre of Lagonissi, a beach settlement in the region of Attica, roughly 30 km southeast of Athens and 35 km northwest of Cape Sounio. Local attractions include Lake Vouliagmeni, with hot spring baths, hydrotherapy and physiotherapy during the summer, nearby beaches such as Kalyvia, or Glyfada, which has been called "Knightsbridge-on-Sea", with a marina and upmarket eateries and boutiques. Attica's many attractions include sightseeing tours of monuments and picturesque cruises to nearby islands. Or guests may want to visit Athens and see the impressive Acropolis and other landmarks or enjoy its nightlife. The villa offers a pool, main living room and garden, kitchen, two bedrooms and master bedroom, roof garden, pool table, playroom and sauna.

372841.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace and garden at Scale Suites, a charming guesthouse in Alimos. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and even wedding services. Dine at the on-site coffee shop/cafe or snack bar/deli, and relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. The guesthouse also offers a computer station, express check-in/out, and airport shuttle service (surcharge). Each of the eight individually decorated guestrooms features a fireplace, flat-screen TV, private furnished balcony, and safe. Located a short drive from Alimos Marina and the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center, Scale Suites is also convenient to Athens International Airport.

372911.description: Situated in Santiago's vibrant Lastarria neighborhood, The Singular Santiago seamlessly blends early 20th-century style with neoclassical French architecture. A striking addition to the city's landscape, the hotel is surrounded by art museums and upscale destinations. Reopened in November 2020, it boasts an award-winning restaurant with exquisite dishes by Executive Chef Hernán Basso, reflecting the region's rich culinary traditions. The wellness spa offers various massages and treatments focused on harmonizing the body and mind. The entire property is non-smoking.

372912.description: At Pleno Palermo Soho, we invite you to embark on an unforgettable journey in the heart of Buenos Aires, Argentina. Our mission is simple: to provide our guests with an experience that captures the essence of modernity, comfort, and enjoyment, all while embracing the vibrant spirit of Buenos Aires and Palermo Soho. Located amid an array of commercial hotspots, culinary delights, and the city's nightlife, our hotel offers you the perfect launchpad to explore the vogue that Buenos Aires has to offer. We understand the importance of your four-legged friends, which is why we are pet-friendly. And for the comfort of all our guests, we maintain a smoke-free environment. Children up to and including 8 years old will share existing beds in the room. Extra beds must be requested and have aditional charge. A credit card will be requested as a guarantee at the time of check-in.

373018.address: 2 TY Danjuma Street Off Ligali Ayorinde, 21
373018.description: Ideally located in the Victoria Island area, Solitude Hotel promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. The property offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. All the necessary facilities, including 24-hour room service, 24-hour security, 24-hour front desk, car park, room service, are at hand. All rooms are designed and decorated to make guests feel right at home, and some rooms come with television in bathroom, closet, clothes rack, flat screen television, sofa. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Friendly staff, great facilities, and close proximity to all that Lagos has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Solitude Hotel.

373179.address: Evrenseki Beldesi, Evren Mah. Sahil Sk. Antalya, 20
373179.description: Our facility will provide Ultra All Inclusive service as of 01. 04. 2022This fabulous resort boasts an enviable location in picturesque Evrenseki within a 10-minute drive away from the ancient city of Side and only 300 metres from a pristine white sandy beach surrounded by swaying palm-trees. This hotel boasts a luxurious design, top notch facilities and attentive service. The spacious and luminous guestrooms offer a magnificent design blending classical elegance with traditional elements. There are 4 disability-friendly rooms on the premises. Guests will pamper their palates in the alluring ambiance of the on-site restaurant and enjoy a drink from the hotel bar. Afterwards they may have a cooling dip in the dazzling pool or soak up the sun at the poolside terrace while the children play at the paddling pool. Those who wish to keep in fit may tone up at the gym while those who want to unwind may indulge in relaxing treatments of the on-site spa.

373180.description: This luxurious and charming hotel is the ideal place of accommodation when visiting this region in Turkey near the sea, as it is ideally positioned approximately 450 metres from the beautiful beach where guests can truly relax under the sun with a hotel's sun lounger or simply enjoy the nice scenery. If guests want to discover a bigger city, they can easily access Antalya, which can be reached in around an hour ride and its airport, located a bit closer from the premises at around 50 minutes away. Visitors will be amazed by the comfortable and well-fitted guest rooms, which come equipped with air-conditioning, a minibar and a satellite TV. The hotel offers an impressive array of facilities and services, including a miniclub and a minidisco for the younger members of the family, a wellness area to find some peace of mind and a gym to do some sport.

373303.description:
This property is located just 8 km away from central London. Situated at the heart of a peaceful neighbourhood, the complex lies just a short walking distance away from shopping opportunities, entertainment venues and offices. Ideal for business and leisure travellers alike, this property offers comfortable, fully-furnished accommodation options. The apartments offer a stylish home away from home, and come well equipped with modern amenities, providing everything that guests will need for a comfortable stay. This property has been designed to meet the lifestyle needs of every type of traveller visiting the area.
Due to Coronavirus (COVID-19), this property does not currently accept visitors.

373306.description: Set at the heart of the cosmopolitan and rich in the historical heritage city of Berlin, this elegant urban hotel is an excellent option for business or leisure travellers. Within a few minutes, guests will be able to find numerous shops and restaurants, the charming Spree River and Berlin Friedrichstraße railway station within 500 m away from the hotel. This wonderful establishment is ideally situated within the famous Friedrichstraße and is within walking distance to some of Berlin's most beloved attractions. It offers light-filled and beautifully decorated guest rooms, featuring natural tones and modern furniture. In the mornings guests will delight in a varied and delicious breakfast for a great start to the day.

373307.description: This charming property is conveniently located only 5 km from the centre of Lisbon. A pleasant walk through the lively streets will take tourists to various attractions in the central part of the Portuguese capital – the Santa Justa Elevator, the National Theater and Chiado Museum are all within 500 metres from the property. Sports enthusiasts can make sure they stay in shape even while vacationing with a game of tennis at the nearby courts. The complimentary Wi-Fi Internet access will keep them connected through email and social networks, and there is cable programming available for in-room entertainment. After the long day of sightseeing, guests can satisfy their appetite with a delicious dinner of local or international meals in the cosy atmosphere of the on-site restaurant.

373445.address: Route De Fez Dar Tounsi, KM 5
373445.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, and a steam room. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Grab a bite to eat at the hotel's restaurant, which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wrap up your day with a drink at the poolside bar. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.

373617.description: This impressive hotel sits on 1, 410, 000 square meters of land directly on a Blue Flag beach, conveniently located behind two professional golf courses on Turkey's Mediterranean Coast. The small town of Belek is approximately 3 km away, while the city of Antalya and its old quarter, Kaleici, are 45 km away and easily accessible by public transport located directly in front of the hotel. Suitable for all ages, this resort offers a wealth of excellent facilities, including an entertainment world and amusement park, two professional football pitches, an all-day food court, a private pier, and beach pavilions. Additionally, there's a large convention center featuring state-of-the-art technology. The elegantly furnished rooms are decorated in muted tones, while swim-up rooms boast a contemporary style with bright white and turquoise decor.

373618.description: In a superb location between Titreyen Lake and the turquoise coloured Manavgat River on Turkey's Mediterranean Coast, this luxurious, family-friendly hotel is well placed for exploring the many attractions in the area such as Manavgat Waterfalls and the magnificent Roman & Hellenistic ruins at Side 8 km away. Just a short distance to the beach, the property features a range of activities suitable for most ages with activities for those seeking entertainment and sport as well as more relaxing pastimes such as a rejuvenating massage and hammam in the spa centre. Modernly furnished and decorated throughout, the guest rooms are decorated in muted tones and include a double and single bed for guests' comfort.

373620.description:
Boasting a prime location on an area of 40, 000 sqm, this magnificent complex offers an architectural style resembling aspects of India's Taj Mahal that will delight even the most discerning visitors. It is just 5 kilometres from the centre of Side, famed for its marvellous historical ruins and offering a wide choice of shopping opportunities. Antalya Airport is 48 km from the hotel. The exclusive guest rooms have been tastefully decorated and provide a wide choice of luxurious amenities for guests to feel a personal touch. Guests will find magnificent gardens, a private golden beach bordering the turquoise Mediterranean Sea as well as an extensive outdoor pool area, perfect for the hottest summer days. Those seeking relaxation can benefit from the comfort of the spa and wellness centre featuring countless Turkish and Thai treatment and massages. 

P. s. :New Year’s Eve Celebration

On 31. 12. 2026, the New Year’s Eve dinner will be served in the main restaurant as a rich buffet. The “New Year’s Celebration” event will take place in the Gala Hall. The New Year celebration will be organized without fixed table reservations and only with bistro tables, including live music, shows, and various activities. There will be no food service during the event; only a bar service for beverages will be available. 

Hotel Management

373724.description: On the Cliff Guest House is conveniently located in the popular Hermanus area. The property features a wide range of facilities to make your stay a pleasant experience. To be found at the hotel are free Wi-Fi in all rooms, Wi-Fi in public areas, car park, airport transfer, babysitting. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like television LCD/plasma screen, separate living room, internet access – wireless (complimentary), non smoking rooms, heating. Recuperate from a full day of sightseeing in the comfort of your room or take advantage of the hotel's recreational facilities, including sauna, golf course (within 3 km), outdoor pool, massage, garden. No matter what your reasons are for visiting Hermanus, On the Cliff Guest House will make you feel instantly at home.

373727.description: Located in the center of Kemer, one of Antalya’s natural wonders and home to some of the Mediterranean’s most beautiful beaches, Miranda Beach Hotel has been serving guests since 2012. The property is situated right by the sea and operates with an “All Inclusive” concept. It is 55 km from the airport and 45 km from Antalya city center.

373728.address: Ulupinar Mah. Cirali Sok. Kemer, Antalya, 473/1
373728.description: Perched in a stunning natural spot, right next to the charming Cirali beach, surrounded by crystalline waters of the Mediterranean Sea from one side and charming Taurus Mountains from the other, this impressive hotel is a perfect place to disconnect from daily routine. A seemingly endless beach is situated just a few steps from the beautiful gold sand beach and within easy reach to local businesses. The establishment offers fabulous bungalows comprising spacious bedrooms, living rooms, well-equipped kitchenette and private bathroom. Each unit is sumptuously appointed and offers a haven of peace and serenity in which to totally unwind at the end of the day. Visitors will be impressed by delicious dishes served at the glamorous on-site restaurant. Afterwards they may enjoy a plunge in the sparkling infinity pool or relax in the verdant garden.

373797.description: This cosy property guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 11 accomodation units.

373819.description: Nestled between Thane and the commercial centre of Mumbai, this Hotel combines modern design and antiquity, bringing together elements of old and new, to create a place where tourists and business travellers can leave the chaotic urban atmosphere behind, but still remain in the city. It is especially popular for various corporate and private events with its elegant meeting and event space featuring natural light and original artwork. At the stylish yet cosy on-site restaurant, guests will experience a real feast of exotic treats and delicacies sourced from around the world – from tantalizingly fresh oriental recipes to vibrant examples of Indian cuisine, and an inspiring collection of wines, the place is sure to satisfy every taste and appetite.

373821.address: Near To Khopat S.T.Workshop, Next Akruti S.M.C,Lbs
373821.description: Exceptional hospitality in a convenient location very close to the Eastern Express Highway, which connects Mumbai and all major cities of India, this hotel, provides the ideal accommodation for business as well as leisure travellers. After a day at the famous 'Korum' shopping mall, which is just a 10-minute walk from the property, or a series of important meetings at the Aakruti Business Park, guests will find the spacious air-conditioned rooms especially appealing. The helpful staff will assist the busy work traveller or tourist with laundry services, arranging an airport shuttle or a trip to a local landmark.

373872.description: Enjoy the convenience of this centrally located São Paulo aparthotel, featuring a steam room, terrace, and complimentary Wi-Fi. A daily buffet breakfast is available (fee applies). The 44 air-conditioned rooms offer kitchens, private balconies, 32-inch LCD TVs with digital programming, and in-room safes and desks. Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and limited on-site parking. Alameda Apart Hotel is just a short walk from Conjunto Nacional, Center 3 Shopping Mall, and Trianon Park, placing you in the heart of São Paulo. Paulista Avenue is also within easy reach.

373910.address: Ergenekon Caddesi No 62 A Bomonti Sisli, 62/A
373910.description: The Mercure Istanbul Bomonti, located in the vibrant Bomonti district, is within walking distance of prominent shopping centers, gourmet restaurants, and key business venues. Experience a unique and innovative sense of style complemented by superior service. Our newly designed rooms seamlessly blend comfort and technology. The Istanbul Congress Center and Lütfi Kırdar Congress & Exhibition Hall are a short 10-minute drive away, while the historic Sultanahmet and Old City are reachable in 20 minutes by car. The Bosphorus is also just a 10-minute drive from the hotel.

373912.address: Derb Sidi Bou Amar, Quartier Riad Laarouss Marrak, 278
373912.description: Nestled in a traditional Moroccan riad within Marrakesh's old town, this hotel is surrounded by the vibrant atmosphere of the souks and conveniently close to Jamaâ El Fna Square and the modern Gueliz district. Each bedroom includes a private bathroom. Guests can unwind and dine in the tranquil patio or enjoy meals and sunbathe on the terrace. The welcoming staff is delighted to share Moroccan traditions with you. Airport and train station transfers are available for a fee. Please note that a local city tax of €3 per person, per night, is not included in the room rate.

373913.description: The Concierge Plaza San Rafael, a charming hotel nestled in the tranquil town of Cuyutlán, Colima, offers a relaxing getaway just steps from the beach. Known for its breathtaking Green Wave phenomenon from May to June, Cuyutlán boasts a wide, inviting shoreline. Explore the nearby Estero Palo Verde Ecological Reserve and 'El Tortugario' turtle sanctuary, both less than 800 meters away, or discover the unique Salt Museum, less than 500 meters from the hotel. Savor fresh seafood at local restaurants and unwind back at the hotel with its outdoor pool, garden area, and multipurpose palapa. Enjoy free Wi-Fi access in the main area. Comfortable rooms provide all necessary amenities for a restful stay after a day of exploring. Select rooms offer stunning ocean views and air conditioning.

373917.description: This unpretentious hotel is set in Museo del Prado-Retiro.

374037.description: The H3 Hotel-Paulista has 70 new apartments divided into two categories to choose from according to your needs: standard and superior. All options are available in single or double model. You will also enjoy the Lobby, where you will find the bar, business center and also a space to relax. We count on an attentive, well informed and multilingual staff, who will leave you at ease and tranquil to enjoy your stay in São Paulo

374059.address: Rua Amauri, 513 - Itaim Bibi São Paulo/SP
374059.description: Welcome to Address Faria Lima hotel, a smart choice for comfort and convenience. Designed by a renowned architect, this contemporary hotel sits in the heart of Itaim Bibi, a prestigious São Paulo neighborhood. Located mere meters from Faria Lima and Avenida Cidade Jardim, it's a 5-minute walk from Iguatemi Shopping Mall and only 10 minutes from Congonhas Airport. Beyond its strategic location, the Address Faria Lima hotel offers spacious, comfortable rooms, helpful staff, and comprehensive amenities for both business and leisure travelers.

374084.description: This splendid establishment enjoys a privileged situation in the beautiful city of Istanbul. Endowed with historical riches, the city is an ideal destination for all those wishing to see the impressive Haga Sofia Museum, Galata Tower, Taksim Square or gaze over the mesmerising Bosporus Strait. The bustling centre with a myriad of dining options, shoppoing venues and vibrant nightlife is to be found just a few steps from the property. Guests will find themselves within ease of access to bus stops and Karakoy ferry port. The establishment is housed in a charming 19th-century building and offers wonderful design and quality service. There are different accommodation options including spacious rooms and suites, some of them featuring breath-taking views over Bosporus. Each unit is sure to enchant visitors with sumptuous design and cutting-edge amenities to ensure a memorable stay.

374298.description: Located in the heart of Barcelona, next to Park Güell, this design-led hostel offers a unique experience. Catering to a smaller number of guests, it provides a personal touch and cozy atmosphere alongside ample privacy. Each room features cleverly designed bunks with blackout curtains, individual lighting, plugs, and spacious lockers. Perfect for friends, students, families, or even bachelor parties, this hostel ensures a comfortable and convenient stay with high-quality service and thoughtful design.

374362.address: Angle Rues Abou Bakr Seddiq Et Omar Ben El Khattab, 15 3
374362.description: Enjoying a privileged location in the exclusive neighborhood of Hivernage, the Tempoo Hotel is an urban and business property that is located in the heart of Marrakech. The hotel is just 10 minutes from the airport and the Jemaa El Fna Square. Whether you are in Marrakech to stay for business or leisure, for one night or an extended stay, the Tempoo Hotel is the perfect place. The hotel will charm you with the quality and sober decoration, a fine and very comfortable contemporary furnishings, and its high-tech state of the art equipment. Finally a hotel that prints its rhythm rigorously. Only 5 minutes walk from the convention center and the Marrakech train station, the hotel has spacious and air-conditioned rooms with free wifi and balconies.

374411.description:
This property is located in a historic building next to Plaza España, renewed in 2008 and turned into a complex of 21 apartments. Its interiors combine charm with a simple and urban design, maintaining the historic ceilings. The result is a cosy atmosphere, which provides everything required for a pleasant stay in Barcelona. These apartments are situated in the Sants-Montjuïc neighbourhood, few minutes on foot from Plaza España, from where it is possible to reach on foot or by public transport the city's main tourist and commercial sites: Montjuïc with its fountains and the exhibition complex, Fira de Barcelona, Plaza Cataluña, Las Ramblas and Paseo de Gracia. The apartments – thanks to its proximity to the Sants station – enjoy convenient public transportation links, including the Aerobús bus service to and from Barcelona's airport.
The reception is opened Monday to Friday from 8.00am until 10.00pm; closed weekends (Saturday and Sunday). During weekends, check-in is on request only and must be arranged in advance with the concierge by phone or via e-mail. Late check-in (from 22:00 h until 00h): available at a cost of 15 euros per apartment. After 00h the cost is 25 euros. These fees must be paid in cash upon arrival.
Upon arrival a security deposit of EUR 200 is required, which can only be made by credit card. This deposit will be refunded within a maximum period of 10 days after check-out, on the condition that the apartment has been left in good condition and without any incident.

When booking more than 5 rooms, special conditions and supplements may apply.

374413.description: This outstanding property is conveniently located in the heart of Deira Dubai's historic district, on the eastern side of Dubai Creek. Dubai International Airport is to be found a short driving distance away, and the most important business districts of the city are only a few minutes away, including Dubai International Financial Centre, Dubai Media City and Dubai Airport Free Zone. Guests will find a choice of spacious guest rooms equipped with the latest amenities and featuring a contemporary décor which fuses perfectly with a mix of Arabesque design. Those travelling on business can take advantage of the 5 individual meeting rooms filled in natural light and equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection. Other facilities include an outdoor pool and a full service restaurant serving lunch and dinner.

374489.description: With a small number of only 14, this property is very convenient for a quiet stay. Everyone staying at this accommodation may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Lisbon Destionation Hostel. Additionally, the premises provide a reception service the whole day through. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

374492.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages or enjoy recreation amenities such as an outdoor pool. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, gift shops/newsstands, and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy local cuisine at Turnberry Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available on request), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 22 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. C. P.
