374493.description: Ideally located in the prime touristic area of Lisbon, Sunset Destination Hostel promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. Featuring a complete list of amenities, guests will find their stay at the property a comfortable one. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, 24-hour front desk, luggage storage are there for guest's enjoyment. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer clothes rack, linens, locker, mirror, sofa to ensure a restful night. Entertain the hotel's recreational facilities, including yoga room, surfing lessons, outdoor pool, massage, garden. Discover all Lisbon has to offer by making Sunset Destination Hostel your base.

374611.description: Located just a 10-minute walk from the popular Majorelle Gardens and a 3-minute walk from the bustling vibrant Marrakesh Plaza, this apartment offers stunning features like a private outdoor hot tub on its spacious terrace. The unit is an excellent accommodation choice for families and groups of friends with its 2 bedrooms, fully equipped kitchen and a living room complete with satellite TV and free Wi-Fi Internet access. Tourists who wish to explore the city and the surrounding area can employ the services of the helpful owners, who will direct them to popular landmarks and organized excursions.

374616.description: The Smy Lisboa is located 900 meters from Marqués de Pombal Square in the heart of Lisbon, opposite the tranquil Parque Eduardo VII, a venue for events such as the Christmas Fair and the Book Fair. This hotel offers a peaceful retreat while remaining well-connected to the city's business centers and vibrant attractions. The Smy Lisboa provides spacious rooms and suites, each featuring modern décor and amenities including free high-speed Wi-Fi, a minibar, a safe, and cable TV with Chromecast for access to Netflix, HBO, and Amazon Video. Some rooms also boast a terrace or balcony. Refurbished in 2019, the bathrooms are fully equipped for guest comfort. The hotel's open-kitchen restaurant, part of The Fork network, offers a buffet lunch and à la carte dinner. Guests can also enjoy the rooftop bar, a charming space with stunning city views, perfect for work or relaxation. A 24-hour fitness room allows guests to maintain their routines. The hotel also provides free transfers to the historic center, making it an ideal choice for business travelers eager to explore Lisbon.

374637.address: Hocapasa Mah. Nobethane Cad. Kummeydanı Sok, 14
374637.description: A stay at Sayeban Gold Hotel places you in the heart of Istanbul, within a 15-minute walk of Hagia Sophia and Grand Bazaar This hotel is 05 mi (08 km) from Bosphorus and 05 mi (09 km) from Topkapi PalaceEnjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a rooftop terrace Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge)Make yourself at home in one of the 10 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided dailyEnjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 8:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a feeFeatured amenities include complimentary wired Internet access, a 24-hour business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsiteDistances are displayed to the nearest 01 mile and kilometerGülhane Park - 03 km / 02 mi- Eminonu Pier - 07 km / 04 mi- Egyptian Bazaar - 07 km / 05 mi- Basilica Cistern - 07 km / 05 mi- Istanbul Archaeology Museums - 07 km / 05 mi- Eminönü Square - 08 km / 05 mi- Bosphorus - 08 km / 05 mi- Topkapi Palace - 09 km / 05 mi- Hagia Sophia - 09 km / 06 mi- Sultanahmet Square - 09 km / 06 mi- Grand Bazaar - 11 km / 07 mi- Turkish and Islamic Art Museum - 12 km / 07 mi- Istanbul University - 13 km / 08 mi- Süleymaniye Mosque - 14 km / 09 mi- Blue Mosque - 15 km / 09 mi The nearest airports ar

374638.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 3 indoor swimming pools, a 24-hour health club, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy French cuisine at St. Regis Brasserie, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Istanbul? This hotel has 2153 square feet (200 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 7 meeting rooms. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a cruise ship terminal shuttle. Make yourself at home in one of the 118 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring iPod docking stations and LCD televisions. Your Tempur-Pedic bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment. Bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Lutfi Kirdar Convention and Exhibition Centre - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Istanbul Congress Center - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- American Hospital - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Acibadem Taksim Hospital - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Vodafone Park - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Taksim Square - 1. 7 km / 1 mi- Dolmabahçe Palace - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Bosphorus - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Besiktas Pier - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Istiklal Avenue - 2 km / 1.

374737.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services and a television in a common area. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Meet other guests and eat at the complimentary reception. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 11 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your Select Comfort bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and slippers.

374904.description: Phi Hotel Milan Fiera is located in a strategic position just 3 km far from the new Rho-Fiera Exhibition Center and 25-minute by car from the main Milan International Airports. Ideal for both business men and tourists, this property offers different types of rooms to meet every need. All rooms, from Standard to Deluxe, are equipped with modern amenities, such as a laptop safe and free high-speed Wi-Fi connection. The common areas offer excellent services, including a snack bar. The outdoor parking and the garage are available to all Guests.

374951.description: A 40-minute drive from Vila Real, this charming complex offers authentic accommodation in an excellent location, and is the perfect place for travellers from all over the world who love rural tourism. The two traditional rustic houses feature charming details like a cosy fireplace in the living room combined with modern conveniences like air-conditioning and satellite TV, so guests won't miss any of the benefits of the contemporary world while immersed in the serenity of simpler times. In the evening, they can prepare their own meals in the fully equipped kitchens of the villas, or try local delicacies in one of the family-owned restaurants nearby.

374986.description: This impressive resort enjoys a privileged location in Titreyengol, situated 70 km from Antalya Airport and only 7 kilometres from Side archaeological site. This opulent property is located just a few steps from a seemingly endless sandy beach bathed in crystalline waters of the Mediterranean Sea. Surrounded by lush and verdant scenery, this establishment boasts a fabulous architectural style, luxurious décor and excellent services. The luminous guest rooms offer space and luxury to each individual guest. Elegant furnishings and soothing tones and deep-purple toned fabrics induce a sense of royalty. Each unit is fitted with individually air conditioner, shower, hair dryer, LCD TV, balcony, complimentary mini bar with water and various juices. After a busy day of sightseeing, travellers may relax with a refreshing swim in the hotel pool, play tennis or indulge in hammam while the youngest ones may let off steam at the paddling pool with slides and children playground.

375097.description: Ideally located in the prime touristic area of Pitipana, Jetwing Thalahena Villas promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. Offering a variety of facilities and services, the hotel provides all you need for a good night's sleep. Postal service, luggage storage, car park, car hire, lockers are just some of the facilities on offer. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like television LCD/plasma screen, umbrella, private pool, internet access – wireless (complimentary), air conditioning. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. For reliable service and professional staff, Jetwing Thalahena Villas caters to your needs.

375138.description: Suitable for both business and leisure guests alike, this modernly appointed hotel features comfortable and well furnished rooms and a range of facilities, all within close range of Ataturk Airport. Guests can enjoy the on-site spa facilities for a relaxing massage or energising swim in the indoor pool, while for refreshment there is the Pierre Loti lounge bar with terrace - a popular meeting point and the attractively styled Pera Brasserie. In the neighbourhood of the hotel, there is the Star City Outlet centre and links to public transport are closeby. Taksim Square at the centre of modern Istanbul is 17 km away and the historical attractions at Sultanahmet are 15 km.

375239.address: Hocapaşa Mahallesi Ankara Caddesi 42 Sirkeci İstan, 42
375239.description: With a stay at Tarihi Isparta Palas Otel, you'll be centrally located in Istanbul, a 7-minute walk from The Egyptian Bazaar and 10 minutes by foot from Grand Bazaar. This hotel is 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Hippodrome of Constantinople and 0. 8 mi (1. 3 km) from Basilica Cistern. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/café, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 14 individually decorated guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms feature showers, hair dryers, and slippers. Conveniences include safes and electric kettles, and housekeeping is provided on a limited basis.

375342.description: This charming and welcoming hotel is ideally located near a public transport network and by the Piola subway station (green line) that connects to the Cathedral of Milan, the heart of the old city centre. Moreover, just a 10-minute stroll away, visitors will find the popular Corso Buenos Aires with the trendiest shops and boutiques in Italy. This state-of-the-art hotel features modern amenities for a round-off experience. The spacious and functional guest rooms are completely equipped with useful amenities such as air-conditioning or a satellite TV, in order for guests to enjoy their trip. Moreover, on the first floor of the building, there is a wellness centre that offers the opportunity to rediscover fitness and well-being.

375346.description: Situated in the vibrant Balvanera district, known for its tango culture and rich architectural heritage, this hotel offers a peaceful retreat just steps from Venezuela Metro Station. A short walk from Spinetto Mall and conveniently located near Retiro train station, it's an excellent base for exploring the city. Each room provides a comfortable atmosphere and essential amenities for a memorable stay, complemented by attentive, dedicated staff.

375458.description: Located in Porto's historic center, the Hotel Santa Clara offers contemporary accommodations less than 400 meters from the iconic Bolhão Market and metro station, providing easy access to all monuments in the historic area. This non-smoking hotel features a 24-hour reception, bar service, and free Wi-Fi. The air-conditioned rooms overlook Porto's city center, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Each spacious, functional room includes a private bathroom and cable TV. Popular attractions such as Bolhão Market, the Stock Exchange Palace, and São Bento Station are within 300 meters. A 10-minute walk leads to the Guindais Funicular, connecting guests to Porto's wine cellars and the Ribeira waterfront district. The central location allows guests to explore numerous restaurants serving traditional Portuguese cuisine and the renowned Port wine. Please note: Breakfast service is currently unavailable.

375578.description: Suzanne Hotel Pension features a total of 24 accomodation units. Suzanne Hotel Pension offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The reception desk is not open throughout the day. Additional fees may apply for some services.

375605.description: Boasting a privileged position just 50 metres from the beach, this charming and comfortable hotel is the ideal choice of accommodation when visiting the area in search of peace and relaxation for holidays. The picturesque Kemer town is within easy reach and Antalya airport is around 1 hour drive from the premises, being very convenient for guests to be able to visit other nearby places. The spacious and bright guest rooms have a ceramic flooring and a private balcony for added convenience. Guests can enjoy the wide array of in-room amenities and facilities, such as a private bathroom, a satellite television and an individual air-conditioner to feel completely at ease during their stay. Guests can taste delicious specialities in the two on-site restaurants and have a swim at the swimming pools and the private pebble beach with sun loungers and umbrellas.

375606.description: Located between the historical buildings of Beyoglu and around the corner from Istiklal Street, this boutique-styled hotel, has a neo-classical, art nouveau style and consists of 52 high-ceilinged rooms centred around a large courtyard or inner garden. At the turn of the 20th century the building housed the Serbian Consulate; now it has been restored to a stylish hotel with an environmentally friendly concept. The rooms are decorated in a Retro style with SMEG 50s series mini bars, luxury imported furnishings and L'Occitane toiletries. Surrounded by cafe bars, trendy shops and entertainment venues, this hotel is in the heart of Istanbul, just 550m from Taksim Square where there are links to public transport.

375607.description: This outstanding holiday resort boasts a prime situation on an area of 70, 000 sqm, in Manavgat, a town and district of the Antalya province in Turkey. The nearest villages, Kizilot and Okurcalar, are some 4 kilometres away while Antalya airport is 70 kilometres away. This luxurious property includes a wide range of different guest rooms to suit all clients' needs. Economy rooms have been fully-equipped to provide a comfortable night's sleep for a lower price while those most discerning travellers may prefer the luxurious Suite rooms with separate bathrooms with shower and premium amenities and services. Guests staying at this exclusive complex may find a host of different dining options including local specialities and Italian, Chinese and Mexican culinary creations. Business travellers may appreciate the meeting facilities equipped with the latest technology.

375611.description: With a beachfront location and spacious grounds, this resort hotel offers a great place to stay for most ages, featuring a range of facilities and amenities to keep guests entertained. Surrounded by wooded hills and the Taurus Mountains on one side and the turquoise colours of the Mediterranean on the other, this family-friendly hotel is situated in a lovely area called Goynuk, close to the larger resort of Kemer. The rooms are bright and modern and equipped to ensure guests' comfort. A local bus stop is within metres of the hotel entrance providing easy access to the neighbouring towns and Kemer which is 8 km away.

375612.description: Close to Nisantasi and Lutfi Kirdar Congress Centre, this smartly appointed apart-hotel complex features well presented, spacious accommodation with a number of options for families or larger groups. Modernly equipped, the facilities on offer afford guests' a 'home-from-home' experience. In the vicinity of the complex, guests will find many fashion house shops and upmarket eateries, while the centre of the city, Taksim Square is 1.5 km away. The nearest metro station is Osmanbey at 600m while there is a bus stop nearby, 250m. With easy access to public transport, guests are able to visit the historical attractions at Sultanahmet 5.5 km away and closer to home such attractions as the Galata Tower and Dolmabahce Palace.

375614.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at Istanbul Central Hotel, located in the heart of Istanbul. Benefit from complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an area shuttle (surcharge). Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel offers dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge, 24 hours), along with self-parking (surcharge). Each of the 15 guestrooms features a minibar, LCD TV, complimentary wired and wireless internet, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Safes, desks, and daily housekeeping are also provided. You'll be within a 10-minute walk of the Grand Bazaar and the Bosphorus, and close to Hagia Sophia (0. 9 km) and the Egyptian Bazaar (0. 6 km).

375615.description: Inspired by London and New York townhouses, Valverde Lisboa Hotel & Garden exudes classic elegance with contemporary furnishings, artwork, and antiques. Overlooking the public promenade or our charming patio, the lounges offer the perfect setting for a relaxing chat, quiet reading, afternoon tea, or a break from shopping. The Sítio Valverde Restaurant and Bar, situated on the patio, provides a unique space to enjoy meals and snacks throughout the day. The patio itself, with its inviting ambiance, offers continuous food and beverage service alongside a heated outdoor pool.

375638.description: This boutique hotel, with its timeless design and prime location in Vienna's historic center, offers a unique experience. Situated behind the State Opera House and the renowned Albertina, it provides the comfort of a private apartment rather than a conventional hotel. The on-site brasserie and bakery offers freshly baked goods and light, healthy dishes daily. All comfortable rooms and suites are well-appointed to ensure a pleasant stay.

375640.description: The Hotel Schani Salon is a small boutique hotel in an Art Nouveau building directly on Mariahilfer Straße, Vienna's largest and most popular shopping street. The famous Ringstraße and historic sights are just a few minutes' walk away. The U3 underground line is in front of the hotel (Neubaugasse station). The center is easily accessible, both publicly and on foot. Messe Wien is only 15 minutes away by underground. Each SMART room is equipped with a double bed with luxury pocket spring mattress, XL shower with raindance showerhead and individually controlled air conditioning. A NESPRESSO machine, kettle and USB charging plug are also included. Every room has a hair dryer, Fairtrade cosmetics and a seating area with a small work space. Free high-speed Wi-Fi is available in the hotel.

375641.description: Located in Vienna and within a 9-minute walk of Vienna Prater Amusement Park, Very Central, 5 min to city center, Self Check In features a garden, allergy-free rooms, and free WiFi. The property is around 1. 2 miles from St. Peter's Catholic Church, 1. 7 miles from House of Music and 2 miles from Albertina Museum. The hotel has family rooms. At the hotel, the rooms are equipped with a closet. At Very Central, 5 min to city center, Self Check In all rooms have bed linen and towels. Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Messe Wien Exhibition and Congress Center, Kunst Haus Wien and St. Stephen's Cathedral. The nearest airport is Vienna International Airport, 11 miles from Very Central, 5 min to city center, Self Check In.

375729.address: Molla Husrev Mah.Akif Pasa Sok. Vefa-Fatih, 11
375729.description: Located in the Fatih district of Istanbul, this recently refurbished hotel is situated close to the Beyazit faculty of Istanbul University and within a stone's throw of the city's famous Suleymaniye Mosque. Featuring cosy and modernly furnished rooms, the 9-room hotel also has a small breakfast room where guests can begin the day fortified by a delicious Turkish breakfast. A bus stop is closeby and Aksaray metro station is 1. 5 km away. Shops, cafe bars and restaurants can all be found in the vicinity of the hotel and many of the historical attractions can be reached on foot. The Grand Bazaar is approximately a 20 minute walk away and Sultanahmet, 35 minutes.

375758.description: This popular 25-room hotel caters to both business and leisure travelers. It offers a 24-hour reception, safe, newspaper stand, and terrace. Mobile phone coverage and internet access are available throughout the property. Guests can utilize room service, laundry, and medical services. The hotel is wheelchair accessible, provides on-site parking and airport transfers, and welcomes pets of all sizes. A multilingual staff is available to assist with any questions.

375898.description: Located in the heart of Lisbon, next to Campo Pequeno, close to airport, metro and train stations, this hotel provides the ideal base for those who want to visit and explore the Portuguese capital city. This charming property features a large choice of comfortable guest rooms, all inspired and decorated by the city's history. All rooms come completely equipped to satisfy all visitors' needs and are perfect for leisure or business travellers. The onsite facilities include a rooftop bar, two outdoor swimming pools for adults and children, and a restaurant serving delicious Mediterranean cuisine. Guests can enjoy a moment of relaxation in the spa area including an indoor circuit pool, sauna, steam bath and a wide range of massages and treatments. SPA (including indoor pool) and Parking are not included in rates. Children under 16 years old are not allowed at the SPA and indoor pool, except at SPA kids hours.

375904.description:
The chic and colourful Neighbourgood Newlands is situated within 500 metres from the Sahara Park Newlands Rugby and Cricket Stadiums. Free WiFi is offered throughout the hotel.
With views of the mountain, the air-conditioned rooms feature contemporary décor and come complete with wooden floors, a satellite TV and a laptop safe. The en suite bathrooms offer a shower and free toiletries.
The modern restaurant offers a variety of meals such as burgers, salads and sandwiches. Guests can relax and unwind whilst enjoying a cocktail or glass of wine at the Park Inn's lobby bar.
The hotel offers meeting facilities and the Cavendish Square Shopping Centre is 950 metres away. The 24-front desk can assist guests with arranging an airport shuttle at a surcharge.
The Cape Town International Airport is within 19 km.

376216.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Cairo and was established in 1982. It is a short drive away from the city stars and the nearest station is Kobri El Kobba. The Hotel has a coffee shop. All 60 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, trouser press, ironing set and air conditioning.

name.content: Secrets Playa Mujeres Golf & Spa Resort

376345.description: Located in beautiful Playa Mujeres, complete with famous white sandy beaches and stunning ocean views in a privileged gated community. This brand new, AAA Four Diamond award winning, adults-only, all-suite resort is only 35 minutes from the Cancun International Airport and 10 minutes from downtown Cancun, in an 18-hole signature Greg Norman golf course. Featuring 424 suites, 9 restaurants and 7 bars; open air spaces make it ideal to enjoy the warm ocean breeze and get a tropical feeling. It features two protected flora and fauna areas where some of the region's flowers and birds can be seen and photographed. Each of the luxurious, comfortable suites are finely appointed with wood elements and spacious terraces.  All Secrets Playa Mujeres guests have the opportunity to enjoy Exchange Privileges (Free flow access) to Dreams Playa Mujeres, located next door, adding 10 restaurants and 13 bars options.

376663.description: Nestled within 50, 000 square meters of gardens and forest in Barcelona's Natural Park of Collserola, this hostel offers a tranquil escape from the city's hustle and bustle. A convenient 12-minute subway ride and an 8-minute walk from the station, it features three buildings with comfortable, well-equipped rooms, some with private bathrooms. The spacious restaurant terraces provide a delightful setting to enjoy various delicious dishes. Guests can also savor signature cocktails, created by a renowned chef, at the hotel bar, open day and night.

376670.description: Somewhere Hotels and Apartments Dubai is located in the heart of Deira's cultural district, Port Saeed. Connected to the Deira Metro Station and facing the Deira City Centre Mall, it offers convenient access to the city. Just a short drive from Dubai International Airport (DXB), this aparthotel features 106 modern suites designed for both short and extended stays. Guests can easily explore Dubai using the nearby metro, which also provides direct access to Deira City Centre via a tunnel.

376676.description: This hotel offers 67 comfortable guestrooms equipped with minibars, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, bidets, and complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast daily and dine at the hotel restaurant or order room service during limited hours. Additional amenities include a fitness center, business center, bar/lounge, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. For events, the hotel provides conference space and two meeting rooms. Dry cleaning/laundry services are available. The hotel also offers an area shuttle (surcharge), roundtrip airport shuttle (surcharge, 24 hours), and train station pick-up (surcharge). Nearby attractions include San Raffaele Hospital (3. 5 km), Auchan (6. 1 km), and the University of Milano-Bicocca (6. 3 km). The closest airports are Linate (10. 9 km), Bergamo Orio al Serio (41. 1 km), and Milan Malpensa (58. 4 km).

376677.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this accomodation. Clients can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the establishment. The reception does not work around the clock. Some services of Hostal Ecozentric may be payable.

376844.description: Situated on vibrant Karaköy, where history meets with modernity, 10 Karaköy has 71 unique guestrooms, including Loft & Loft Terrace Suites and a Penthouse with a magnificent private terrace. The original building (former Büyük Balikli Han) consists of 6 floors with a glass roof over a large atrium and is one of the samples of cultural heritage of various civilizations of Istanbul. Accordingly, 10 Karaköy offers artwork from different Turkish artists all around the hotel, exclusive dining facilities in the Brasserie Ten with a menu of International cuisine, a gym with latest equipment and 73 sqm meeting room with state-of-art audio visual equipment. *Direct payment reservations will be debited in the local currency, at the current exchange rate.

376986.description: Centrally located in Istanbul, the upscale AC Hotel Istanbul Macka is a 5-minute drive from Taksim Square and 8 minutes from the Grand Bazaar. It's also conveniently located 3. 8 miles from the Blue Mosque and 1. 7 miles from Dolmabahçe Palace. The hotel offers 98 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a minibar, LCD TV, and private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Enjoy international cuisine at the AC Lounge restaurant and bar, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Recreational amenities include a sauna and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. For business travelers, there's a 24-hour business center and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge.

376988.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including outdoor tennis courts and a seasonal outdoor pool. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite with international cuisine at Sporting, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 46 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. The nearest airports are: Linate Airport (LIN) - 14. 9 km / 9. 2 mi Bergamo Orio al Serio Airport (BGY) - 39. 3 km / 24. 4 mi Milan Malpensa Airport (MXP) - 58 km / 36 mi The preferred airport for Hotel Sporting Brugherio is Linate Airport (LIN).

377000.description: Hospedium Bogotá Urban Boutique, has 27 rooms and is located just 5 minutes walk from the Pontificia Universidad Javeriana. It is in the financial area, in Chapinero, very close to the National Museum of Colombia and 3 km from the Gabriel García Márquez Journalists Park. In the area, you will find shopping centers such as Plaza de Bolívar 4 km away and Chorro de Quevedo 3 km away. It is located relatively close to the José Celestino Mutis Bogotá Botanical Garden, while the Calle 45 bus station is just a 10-minute walk from the site. It has private parking for hours and breakfast service.

377014.description: Conveniently situated in the district of Mecidiyekoy, this property is the perfect base for both business and holiday travel. Close to many amenities including the large Cevahir shopping centre, there is easy access to public transport networks having a metro station and bus stop close by. The centre of the city, Taksim Square is just 4 km from the hotel. Istanbul International Airport is around 40 km away. Furnished and decorated in a lavish style, mixing local decor with a French baroque style, each room is fitted with air-conditioning, satellite TV, tea and coffee facilities and bathroom with shower and toiletries. Guests can benefit from comfortable and convenient amenities such as the on-site restaurant and spa facilities.

377197.description: Located in a quiet area of Lagos, this hotel is just a 15-minute drive from the city center and the vibrant Victoria Island. Guests can enjoy a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool on warm days or savor their morning coffee on the terrace. The restaurant offers delicious homemade dishes, and the bar provides a relaxing setting for afternoon drinks. Each well-appointed room features a seating area and a flat-screen TV for entertainment, while complimentary WiFi allows guests to stay connected and productive.

377203.address: Mimar Hayrettin Mah. Bali Pasa Yokuşu Sk. No:94, 94 6
377203.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 13 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and slippers. 377397.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this accomodation. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. Guests can enjoy the convenience of 24-hour reception.

377501.description: Located in the heart of Milan's fashion and business district, The Square Hotel offers comfort and convenience. The Duomo and La Scala are a short 5-minute walk away, while Sforza Castle and Sempione Park are within a 10-minute stroll. The Missori metro station is just around the corner for easy access to the rest of the city. The hotel boasts contemporary Italian design throughout its well-appointed rooms. On-site dining is available at the elegant Arya Restaurant, and in the summer, guests can enjoy drinks and meals on the rooftop terrace with stunning city views. The hotel also offers meeting and conference facilities equipped with the latest technology. For guests arriving by car, private parking is available nearby for €24 per day, and the front desk can assist with congestion charge activation. Transportation to and from Linate, Malpensa, and Bergamo airports can be arranged upon request.

name.content: Mini Hotel Fast Sleep Guarulhos by Slaviero Hoteis

377643.address: Aeroporto De Guarulhos, Terminal 02 Piso Térreo S/
377643.description: The 58 welcoming units offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day.

378075.description: Located in the outskirts of Marrakech, this modern property is the perfect place to relax while visiting Marocco's capital city. Its guests will be spoiled with the variety of activities the venue offers - they can enjoy a game of tennis on the onsite court, play some golf on the nearby course, explore the area on a bike, do some hiking or simply visit the fitness centre for some shaping up. Now the only thing that is needed to complement these activities will be a visit to the onsite spa and wellness centre, where a full-body massage or some soaking in the hot spring bath will help to restore their wellbeing and rejuvenate the aching muscles. Those who still have some energy can enjoy a dip in the pool or opt for some sunbathing on the loungers next to it.

378077.description: Stay at the Petit Príncep, a charming pension in the heart of Barcelona, within a 15-minute walk of Rambla de Catalunya and Casa Milà. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Each of the 11 guestrooms features a flat-screen TV with digital programming and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. Convenient amenities include fans and blackout curtains, with daily housekeeping provided. The pension also offers express check-in/check-out and luggage storage. Nearby attractions include Passeig de Gràcia and Casa Batlló, both within 2 km. Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) is 15. 3 km away.

378224.description: This modern resort welcomes its guests at just 300 metres from the lovely beach. Boasting both a large outdoor pool and a smaller indoor one, it is the perfect place for that much needed vacation. Its guests can spend their days sunbathing and sipping refreshing drinks from the poolside bar, while a visit to the spa and wellness centre can add that little extra needed for a total relaxation. While at it they can treat themselves to a massage or tune-up their muscles with a fast workout in the gym. For dining they can enjoy an open buffet first thing in the morning and then have their pick between the Ottoman and Italian dishes served throughout the day in the onsite restaurant. The surrounding area offers plenty of opportunities for jet-skiing or parasailing, so even those who crave some adrenaline rush will be covered.

378229.description: This modern resort offers the total package for an unforgettable vacation. Its guests will be spoiled with choice for where to spend their days - the private beach area, on the sun loungers around the outdoor pool or in the privacy of the indoor one. There is also a water park for those craving some fun and excitement and a gym for the workout enthusiasts. The spa and wellness centre offers plenty of opportunities for those in need of some pampering and there is hardly anything better for rejuvenating both the body and the mind, than a massage followed by some soaking in the sauna. When hunger starts calling guests can enjoy the delightful variety offered at the onsite buffet restaurant, while the a la carte one can treat to some delicious specialities that will surprise even the most ardent tastes.

378322.description: The establishment comprises a total of 92 snug rooms. There is Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. The Great Barr Hotel provides 24-hour reception. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

378328.description: Enjoy garden views from the terrace at this Victorian hotel, which offers complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and tour/ticket assistance. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily. The on-site Brasserie features a bar/lounge and room service is available during limited hours. The hotel also provides a business center, multilingual staff, conference facilities, and free self-parking. Each of the 25 guestrooms includes a flat-screen television with digital programming, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries, and conveniences such as a coffee/tea maker and a desk. Located near St Mary's Church, the hotel is also a short drive from Nungate Bridge and Lennoxlove Historic House. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is the preferred airport.

378368.description: Everyone staying at this accommodation will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay on the premises, as it counts with a total of 14accomodation units. Travellers can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the property. The front desk offers 24-hour reception.

378393.description: This establishment offers a total of 42 guest rooms. This accomodation was completely renovated in 2025. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Everyone staying at this accommodation can enjoy the convenience of 24-hour reception. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

378462.description: The hotel comprises a total of 31 snug accomodation units. Ballantrae Hotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Ballantrae Hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience.

378476.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at The Fox & Goose Hotel, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and a banquet hall. Dine at the on-site bar/lounge or enjoy room service (limited hours). Full breakfasts are available (fee applies). The hotel offers a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, conference space, a meeting room, and free self-parking. The 73 air-conditioned rooms include refrigerators, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, safes, desks, and phones with free local calls. Located near Ealing Broadway Shopping Centre (1. 8 mi) and OVO Arena Wembley (2. 2 mi), the hotel is conveniently situated for exploring London. Heathrow Airport (LHR) is the closest airport, located 11. 8 miles away.

378536.description: With a stay at Boston Manor Hotel in London (Hanwell), you'll be within a 15-minute drive of Twickenham Stadium and Wembley Stadium. This hotel is 6. 4 mi (10. 3 km) from SSE Arena, Wembley and 6. 7 mi (10. 7 km) from Kensington High Street. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, a hair salon, and a banquet hall. Featured amenities include express check-out, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and a meeting room. You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Boston Manor Hotel, or stop in at the grocery/convenience store. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Stay in one of 46 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as coffee/tea makers and fans.

378620.description: Visitors will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Sandaig Guest House as it counts with a total of 9 rooms. Guests may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Sandaig Guest House. The reception desk is not open throughout the day. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

378629.description: There are a total of 37 rooms at The White Hart Hotel. Those who stay at this establishment can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the hotel. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night.

378648.description: Enjoy garden views and amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at Hapimag Resort Edinburgh. This upscale hotel offers a snack bar, common area television, and picnic area. The 29 guestrooms feature refrigerators, LCD TVs with digital programming, and private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Additional conveniences include in-room safes, phones, and desks. Dry cleaning, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box are available at the front desk. Self-parking is available for a fee. Situated in the heart of Edinburgh, you're a 15-minute walk from Princes Street and George Street, and conveniently close to the Edinburgh International Conference Centre and Edinburgh Castle.

378713.address: Lucas House Reception 48 Edgbaston Park Road, 48
378713.description: Located a short distance from the town center, this 70-room hotel offers convenient access to area attractions and transportation links. Guests can enjoy on-site dining in an elegant restaurant, plus amenities like Wi-Fi and a 24-hour reception desk. The hotel also offers accessible rooms and on-site parking. Business facilities are available for corporate travelers. The nearest golf course is within 1400 km, and the airport is 28500 km away. Additional fees may apply for some services.

name.content: Summer stays at the university of Edinburgh

378780.description: Edinburgh First - Chancellors Court is a superb new development on Holyrood Park Road and is part of the University of Edinburgh Residences. Accommodation is comparable to a 3-star hotel with En-suite rooms featuring telephone, TV and Tea/Coffee facilities. On-site amenities including shop, cash-point and taxi rank. Edinburgh's historic Royal Mile and the city's main shopping areas are a short walk away (appr. 1. 5 Miles) and Holyrood Park and Arthur's Seat are also nearby. In addition, the no. 33 bus service leaves from very nearby and goes to Princes Street and the top of Leith Walk. **Please note that this property has twin bedded rooms only. **

378944.description: This cosy establishment guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 5 rooms. Those staying at this establishment may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. The reception desk is not open throughout the day.

378951.description: Featuring free WiFi throughout the property, Terrace hotel offers accommodations in Edinburgh, 1640 feet from Edinburgh Playhouse. Each room comes with a flat-screen TV, and has its own separate bathroom. Guests will find a kettle in the room. For the comfort of guests, there are free toiletries and a hairdryer. The accommodations has a 24-hour front desk. Omni Center is 1969 feet from Terrace hotel, while Edinburgh Festival Theater is 0. 8 mi from the property. The nearest airport is Edinburgh Airport, 7. 5 mi from the property.

379073.description: This Leith guesthouse, Park View House, offers complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy on-site amenities such as bicycle rentals and a garden. The 29 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and coffee/tea makers. Bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Daily housekeeping is provided. Free self-parking is available, along with express check-in/check-out and luggage storage. Located near Leith Links, the guesthouse is also a short drive from Edinburgh Playhouse Theatre and Princes Street. It's conveniently located within a 5-minute drive of Edinburgh Playhouse Theatre and Princes Street, 1. 8 miles from the Royal Mile, and 2. 5 miles from Edinburgh Castle.

379260.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance at this centrally located Edinburgh hotel. Dine at the on-site Angels Share Bar, or order 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily (fee applies). Amenities include complimentary newspapers, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. The 31 guestrooms feature minibars, LCD TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks. Steps from Princes Street and Johnnie Walker Princes Street, Angel's Share Hotel is also near George Street and the National Museum of Scotland. The preferred airport is Edinburgh Airport (EDI).

379362.description: Setting the standard for low-cost accommodation, we keep frills to a minimum, so that you can enjoy all the necessary comforts without paying for things you don't need. Within a 10-minute walk of Birmingham's leading attractions, ibis Budget Birmingham Centre is home to 250 en suite rooms, including our award-winning, well-appointed comfortable rooms which allow us to offer some of the best room rates in the city centre.

379630.description: Enjoy a stay at the Dakota Edinburgh, located in South Queensferry, a short drive from the iconic Forth Rail Bridge and Linlithgow Palace. This 4-star hotel offers a fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. Dine at the on-site restaurant, order room service, or relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. A full breakfast is available for a fee. Each of the 130 air-conditioned rooms features a flat-screen TV, private bathroom with designer toiletries, and coffee/tea making facilities. The hotel also provides a complimentary airport shuttle upon request. Nearby attractions include Edinburgh Zoo and Murrayfield Stadium.

379692.description: The accomodation features a total of 17 rooms. Regent House Hotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. There is no 24-hour reception. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

379780.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and a communal living room. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Sleeplicity London Heathrow. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include express check-out, luggage storage, and coffee/tea in a common area. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 10 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. 379806.description: The Witchery by the Castle offers a range of opulent suites in Edinburgh, each one unique with its own special features. Lavishly furnished suites display gothic touches, with large oak beds and 4-posters, velvet-lined walls and flamboyant red and gold décor indicative of the style. There are separate seating areas and large bathrooms with free-standing silver baths. Each of The Witchery’s 9 suites is different, but walk-in dressing rooms, love seats and tapestries set the tone. Some rooms overlook Edinburgh’s Royal Mile, looking down towards Princes Street, or across to the old town. An indulgent breakfast hamper will be served in the room each morning or guests can choose to have a cooked breakfast served in the restaurant at no extra cost. 380884.description: Set within a beautifully restored Georgian townhouse in the heart of Edinburgh, our four boutique bedrooms offer an intimate and refined place to stay. Upstairs is calm and considered; downstairs, the house comes alive. Our Michelin-starred restaurant LYLA anchors the building, drawing international guests and locals alike for cooking that is precise, seafood focused, and unmistakably confident. Before dinner our bar offers a more relaxed counterpoint—a place for a perfectly made cocktail, a rare whisky, or a glass of great champagne. Staying with us means being immersed in one of Edinburgh’s great food destinations, while enjoying the privacy and character of a townhouse that feels more like a private home than a hotel. 384161.description: Set in a prime location of Barcelona, Fisa Rentals Ramblas Apartments puts everything the city has to offer just outside your doorstep. 384162.description: Close to Sants station and Camp Nou, the apartments are located in a newly built building, have exterior balconies with views and have multiple services. 384260.description: This modern hotel boasts a package of a traditional-style courtyards, wonderfully landscaped gardens and a waterpark-crowned pool scene. The rooms are designed with a contemporary flair, offering all the modern amenities, including flat-screen TVs. Their only downside is that due to the amount of attractions the venue offers, guests won't spend enough time in them. They will be spoiled with choice at the exciting first-rate waterpark that is loaded with slides including a Spacebowl, Blackhole and a section just for the youngest guests chock-full of slides and fountains. Plus there are 2 extra pools and a poolside bar to provide endless stream of chilled drinks. The lights of the Red City, called so due to the blush-coloured walls that surround it, are just a 20-minute shuttle bus ride away and it is still exciting as ever and still offers a magical mix of modern and traditional.

384339.description: Following a complete renovation in May 2014, Hotel Alilass opened its doors, offering guests elegant, comfortable, and contemporary rooms. Each air-conditioned room features free Wi-Fi, satellite TV, a hairdryer, and a minibar. The hotel has three floors without elevator access, but staff are available 24/7 to assist with luggage. Breakfast is served in the glass-enclosed lounge overlooking the elegantly landscaped courtyard. Guests can enjoy the garden and lobby bar throughout the day, savoring delicious coffee and other beverages. Located in Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, Hotel Alilass is within walking distance of iconic sites such as Topkapi Palace, the Blue Mosque, the Grand Bazaar, and Hagia Sophia. Public transportation, including buses, trams, and ferries, is easily accessible.

384346.description: Built in 2010 and renovated in 2014, this 8-room hotel offers an ideal base for exploring the area. Guests enjoy a Moroccan phone, and our spa features a traditional hammam, two massage rooms, and manicure/pedicure services. We offer diverse dining options, including homemade traditional, Mediterranean, and Italian meals. Common areas are air-conditioned, and we provide a 24-hour reception, safe, terrace, room service, laundry service, guest laundromat, car park, babysitting, car rental, airport shuttle, and nearby secure parking. Our multilingual staff offers bell service and can assist with any requests, including green fee bookings for golf enthusiasts. Pets are welcome.

Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and pay movies provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature bidets and hair dryers. 384520.description: Located near Usaquén Park and the World Trade Centre, this hotel offers a convenient base for exploring Bogotá. Enjoy convenient access to public transport and three major NY airports: JFK International, LaGuardia and Long Island Islip MacArthur. Feel free to design your own space in a contemporary, eco-friendly studio or one-bedroom suite at this extended-stay Long Island City hotel. The Working Wall - that's the fully equipped kitchen, work area and storage - features movable furniture, to let you really make yourself at home. Stay connected with complimentary WiFi and take advantage of complimentary printing through PrinterOn. Relax and watch a movie on the 42-inch flat-screen TV or listen to your own music with the iHome docking station. Unwind in a comfortable guest room where you can check emails with free WiFi at the large desk or using the handy lapdesk, browse channels on the LCD TV and sleep soundly on the clean and fresh Hampton bed®. 385430.description: Merging modern style with traditional elements, this elegant villa awaits all visitors of the lovely 'Ochre City'. Upon their arrival they will be greeted by the lovely garden and the outdoor pool. Those who are exhausted can head to the comfortable rooms for a much deserved rest, while the others can enjoy a chilled drink in the lounge bar or visit the restaurant for a hearty meal. At it they can find a rich variety of local and international delights, each prepared in a way that will surprise even the most ardent tastes with their unique mix of herbs and spices.

385481.description: A pleasant and comfortable accommodation right in the centre of the beautiful Red city. Even better they can sit on the comfy ottomans on the rooftop terrace and admire the sun setting over the skyline. The courtyard is for the warm afternoons, when one requires a chilled drink underneath the shade. If the appetite starts calling the staff can help with arranging meals consisting of traditional homemade appetisers, meats and soups or some western specialities. After the delicious meal guests can head to the air-conditioned rooms, each of them featuring arched doorways, Moroccan carvings and modern fabrics for a unique atmosphere.

385489.description: Located on Turkey's Mediterranean coast in the district of Avsallar and between the popular resorts of Alanya and Side, this extravagantly designed resort is surrounded by other hotels and there are local amenities such as banks and shops within a short walk from the property. Featuring lavish décor and a wealth of facilities suitable for most ages, the hotel boasts a beach-side location with a spectacular pool and sun terrace bordering the golden sand and a superb semi-circular sun-bathing pier ideal for sun worshippers to stretch out on. Leisure activities include the Symphony Spa which has an elegantly styled indoor pool to relax in and there is entertainment to suit all tastes with live music, DJ hosted parties in the summer as well as a host of sports' activities.

385490.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. If a rejuvenating treatment is needed one can always visit the wellness centre, and while at it not treat her/him self with a visit to the sauna or the Hammam.
