385803.description: Located a short walk from the town center, Flattered To Be In Porto offers easy access to numerous attractions. This recently refurbished apartment provides guests with a quiet stay, featuring five guest rooms and Wi-Fi in public areas. An airport transfer service is available (charges may apply). The nearest beach is just 100 meters from the property, and the harbor is within a 10-minute walk. Golf enthusiasts will find a course within a reasonable distance, and transport links are conveniently located close by.

385805.description: This charming two-unit apartment, Flattered To Be In Lisboa, was fully refurbished in 2010 and offers a peaceful retreat. Located within easy reach of transport links (80 meters), exploring the surrounding area is simple and convenient. Guests can also enjoy wireless internet access in communal areas. Parking is available for those arriving by car, and an airport transfer service is offered (fees may apply). Please note that the reception desk is not open 24 hours a day, and cots are not available. While the airport and harbor are a significant distance away, the local area offers much to explore.

385941.description: Castival Hotel is located about 50-minute car ride away from Antalya airport and just about 10 minutes from Side and Manavgat. The modern rooms have been nicely decorated and equipped with all the needed amenities to make travellers feel comfortable and pleased during their stay. The hotel welcomes guests to their beautiful property that has a wide variety of activities and spaces where to have a fun and rest. Visitors can eat with friends or family at the on-site restaurant that offers inside or outside dining in a luxury atmosphere. If they prefer, they can visit the bar, relax, and have delicious drinks. Business travellers can take advantage of the multifunctional conference hall that accommodates up to 600 people. The pool area will be everyone's favourite place since they can rest, sunbathe, swim or have fun in the water slides. If guests desire, they can visit the spa where they will be spoilt and pampered.

385942.description: Consisting of 16 rooms in 2 separate, yet connected historic buildings, this highly rated aparthotel has been restored with contemporary techniques which meet the needs of modern living. The boutique-style hotel introduces a variety of accommodation, each of which reflects unique and trendy decoration, supported by high quality furnishings. Guests can enjoy the rooftop terrace with spectacular views of the Marmara Sea and Bosphorous and benefit from the secret courtyard, opening from the cosy lounge bar and TV room. Located in the vicinity of the Medieval Galata Tower, art galleries, museums, theatres, restaurants, bars and night clubs are within 10-20 minutes walking distance while Sishane metro station is about 5 minutes away. The historical attractions at Sultanahmet are 3 km from the aparthotel and can be reached on foot or by public transport.

385946.description: The Casa Real 93 is located in the north of the city of Bogotá, all rooms and suites have private bathrooms, personal hygiene kit, television, and this hotel has a breakfast included. The property is just walking distance from Museo del Chicó, and Parque de la 93, where you can find restaurants and bars. The closest airport is El Dorado Airport which is located 30 minutes away, likewise, the Salitre Transportation Terminal is 30 minutes away by car.

385948.description: Experience Bogotá's vibrant blend of hospitality and multiculturalism at the Holiday Inn Express & Suites Bogotá Zona Financiera. Ideally situated in the city's financial district, our modern hotel offers convenient access to companies like Baker Hughes, Caracol, Cisco Systems, the World Bank, and Microsoft. Business travelers will appreciate our complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, 24-hour business center, and two spacious meeting rooms (capacity 100 each). Enjoy smoke-free rooms, free parking, a fitness center, 24-hour medical service, and proximity to Bogotá's renowned Gastronomic Area.

385953.description: Located in the heart of the Eixample district in Barcelona, these cosy apartments are perfectly situated in the very city centre of Barcelona and a steps away from many restaurants, shops, public transport connections and sightseeing attractions. Those staying at this property will enjoy the proximity of the complex to the most popular places of interest, such as Plaza Cataluña and Las Ramblas. The modern and stylish apartments are beautifully decorated and include a wide range of amenities to guarantee a perfect stay to all its visitors. In all of them guests can keep updated thanks to the complimentary wireless Internet connection available and most of them count with a private terrace for added comfort. They also include a fully equipped and nice kitchen for those who prefer to prepare their own food. Moreover, the staff at the reception can help buying tickets and giving tourist information.

386099.description: Located at the heart of Historical Peninsula in Istanbul, Old City Park Hotel is within a walking distance from several historic sites such as Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace and Hagia Sophia Museum. It is also very close to the tram station, which provides a direct access to the central locations of the city. All units at Hotel Old City Park are equipped with free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, mini-bar and flat-screen satellite TV. The private bathroom includes a bath or shower, hairdryer, slippers and free toiletries. A 24-hour front desk provides luggage storage, room service and currency exchange. Laundry, dry cleaning and ironing services are possible upon request. Car rentals are also available at an additional charge. Daily breakfast is served in buffet style. You can also enjoy lunch and dinner at the on-site à la carte restaurant.

386398.description: Located next to the main entertainment, shopping, business and service centers in Barra da Tijuca, such as CasaShopping, Via Park and Barra shopping malls, and also near Cidade da Música concert venue, Promenade Link Stay is ideal for those traveling for pleasure or on business seeking the best lodging location. Located in Avenida Ayrton Senna, Barra da Tijuca central point, and annexed to the most important commercial region of the neighborhood, this aparthotel has immediate access to Linha Amarela and the International Airport of Rio de Janeiro, being directly connected to Avenida das Américas and Jacarepaguá airport. With two main categories of accommodations, both decorated with modern furniture and a touch of elegance, Promenade Link Stay's main objective is to make you feel at home. Dear guest, we would like to inform that our swimming pool will be under maintenance from this october 28th until december 1st. We apologies for any inconvenience that it may cause.

386435.description: Located just 300 meters from the town center, Cumbali Plaza Hotel offers easy access to local attractions and transport links. The airport is conveniently located //TEMPLATE OR VARIABLE distance in metres NOT FOUND// meters away, and the harbor is 3, 500 kilometers away. Built in 2014, this hotel features 46 welcoming accommodation units and provides Wi-Fi throughout. Guests can benefit from the 24-hour reception and on-site parking, as well as an airport transfer service. Business travelers will appreciate the hotel's facilities suitable for corporate events, seminars, meetings, and conferences. The hotel also offers a delightful on-site restaurant for guests to enjoy.

386601.description: Situated in the city's most innovative and modern district, Hyatt Centric Milan Centrale is the perfect base for shopping, business or discovering the area's cultural heritage. The contemporary style is reflected in the attention that has been paid to the design of the rooms, which reinterpret Milanese elegance with a modern twist. The Roofbar with a breathtaking view, the gourmet restaurant, spaces for meetings and events and the spa will ensure that you have an unrivaled experience.

386611.description:
A 21-story luxury hotel at the gateway to MetLife Stadium. Brand-new and reborn. 427 rooms. 35, 000 SF of celebration. The closest full-service luxury hotel to the stadium — by a margin. Pre-game arrivals at your pace. New HVAC throughout — after six years without one. Brand new freight elevators. Fully modernized event spaces and common areas. The pool, opened back up. 
Built to host weddings, galas, conferences, and the world's largest sporting event.

386787.address: Şarburun Merkez Cad. No:5 Okurcalar, Antalya
386787.description: This luxurious and elegantly styled resort hotel enjoys a superb position over-looking a bay and sandy beach on Turkey's Mediterranean Coast. Surrounded by a number of hotels, the complex is 32 km west from the popular resort of Alanya and a similar distance from the wonderful Roman and Hellenistic ruins at Side. Antalya Airport is located 93 km while Gazipasa Airport is set at 76 km from the hotel. Each guest room offers air conditioning, safe box, minibar and a private bathroom with hair dryer and toiletries. Featuring an opulent style and excellent facilities, guests of all ages can benefit from this resort's welcoming service. A rich choice of food and beverage options will not disappoint and include a cafe, a sushi a la carte restaurant and an outdoor disco during the summer months. For entertainment, guests can join in dance courses, a weekly party night, land and water inflatable games and much more.

386795.description: This hotel offers guests rooms with overlooking forest landscapes of the Peneda-Gerês National Park. It features bike rental, free Wi-Fi, and a restaurant with panoramic views. Each room at Moderna do Gerês Hotel has wooden floors, heating, and a TV. Toiletries are provided in the private bathroom. A continental breakfast is served. A wide range of traditional Portuguese cuisine is served for lunch and dinner. The staff at do Gerês can organize canoeing and horse riding tours throughout the park. Guests can cycle about 2. 5 mi to the lake near Vilar da Veiga. Recognized as a Bikotel Partner, Moderna do Geres Hotel offers specific facilities for mountain bike enthusiasts. Free private parking is available at Moderna do Gerês Hotel.

387055.description: Situated in downtown Cancun, this hotel offers budget-friendly accommodations near bars, restaurants, souvenir markets, and just 10 minutes from the beach. A mere 15 minutes away, you'll find the airport and convention center. Enjoy clean, spacious rooms decorated in a fresh, relaxing palette, and take advantage of the hotel's affordable breakfast and dinner options. Friendly service enhances your stay. Unwind at the nearby Palapa Bar, savoring refreshing cocktails while basking in the Caribbean atmosphere.

name.content: Hotel Golden Park Rio de Janeiro Aeroporto

387121.description: Located near Santos Dumond Airport and just steps from the subway, this hotel offers convenient access to Rio's financial center, home to major national and international companies. Its prime location in the Glória district provides easy access to both the Center and South Zone, where you'll find a variety of shops, stunning natural landscapes, theaters, squares, cinemas, museums, fairs, churches, and iconic landmarks such as Sugarloaf Mountain and Botafogo Bay. The hotel also offers uncovered parking for R$30. 00 per car per day (subject to availability). Pet Policy: For a fee of R$70. 00 per night, per room, per pet, small animals (up to 5kg) are welcome. Please note that pets are not allowed in leisure areas or the restaurant, and must not be left unattended in guest rooms. When in the hotel's public spaces, pets must be carried on your lap and kept on a leash. Guests traveling with pets must present an updated vaccination card upon check-in and sign a damage liability waiver.

387124.description: There are a total of 160 rooms on the premises. This establishment consists of 6 suites. This attractive hotel provides the ideal base for both sightseeing and business. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. The Hotel safe provides a secure place for guests to store valuable items. Guests can avail themselves of the key collection service. Guests can make use of internet access to stay connected to work or home. Guests can take advantage of room service to enjoy breakfast in bed. There is a laundry service.

387278.description: Located just 150 meters from the town center, the Diyar Hotel offers easy access to all that this destination has to offer. Public transportation is within 100 meters, connecting guests to the surrounding area. The airport is 30 kilometers away. This boutique hotel, renovated in 2015, features 17 welcoming rooms and Wi-Fi in public areas. A 24-hour reception ensures guests' needs are met day and night. On-site parking is available for guests arriving by car. Some services may incur a fee.

387453.description: Situated only 300 metres from the Taksim Square and Taksim Metro Station, this classic style hotel with modern decorations features a 24-hour front desk and free WiFi access in all areas. Well-decorated rooms at Otto Pera Hotel include air conditioning, wooden floors and a flat-screen TV. A safety deposit box and a minibar are also provided. Private bathroom comes with free toiletries, slippers and a hairdryer. Local restaurants, cafes and bars suit all kinds of culinary tastes. Air conditioner works in the building in summer and heater in winter. No smoking in our hotelIstanbul Airport is 40, 2 km from Otto Pera Hotel. A shuttle service can be arranged on request at an additional fee.

387705.description: Nestled within 1, 000 meters of the town center, this cozy hotel offers easy access to all the destination has to offer. Guests can find the nearest golf course within 6. 7 kilometers and public transport links just a short walk away. The airport is 50 kilometers from the property. This intimate hotel guarantees a quiet stay with only eight accommodation units. Renovated in 2010, the hotel offers Wi-Fi in all public areas and rooms, along with the convenience of a 24-hour reception. Parking is available for guests arriving by car, and an airport transfer service is also provided. Guests can enjoy delicious meals at the hotel's restaurant. Some services may incur additional charges.

387713.description: Enjoying a central location in the popular resort of Kemer on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, this modernly furnished and equipped hotel is a great base from which to explore the beautiful, surrounding countryside. Close to the resort's amenities, the beach is just a few minutes' walk away while shops, cafe bars and restaurants are closeby and Kemer Marina 1 km. With just 30 rooms, the hotel has an intimate, friendly atmosphere. The rooms are modern and decorated in cooling, fresh colours. Guests can benefit from an on-site outdoor pool for relaxing days soaking up the sun and enjoying a snack from the poolside bar.

name.content: Fairfield Inn Suites New York Staten Island

388039.description: Welcome to the Holiday Inn Staten Island, conveniently located near New York City with easy access to major highways 278 and 440. Corporate travelers can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, 24-hour business center access, and unwind with food and drinks in our restaurant and lounge. Leisure guests will appreciate easy access to top state attractions. Visiting NYC is a breeze with our complimentary shuttle to the free Staten Island Ferry, offering breathtaking city views. Spend a day at the Staten Island Zoo or explore the gardens and museums at Snug Harbor. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, our dedicated team is committed to exceeding your expectations.

name.content: Four Points By Sheraton Cancun Centro

388055.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features concierge services, shopping on site, and wedding services. Enjoy international cuisine at The Eatery Bistro, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in Cancun? This hotel has 2121 square feet (197 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 5 meeting rooms. Limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 112 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LED televisions.

388056.description: This city hotel is 400 metres from Flower Market and 850 metres from Royal Theatre Carré. Shopping centre Kalvertoren is 450 metres away. Amsterdam City Centre is a great choice for travellers interested in chocolate, food trucks and Christmas markets. The property is located on the Rembrandt Square in the city centre of Amsterdam. It offers non-smoking rooms with free Wi-Fi access. Each room here offers cable TV and air conditioning and a private bathroom with a bath or shower and a hairdryer. The room size ranges from 9 m2 to 30 m2, depending on the room category. In this cosy hotel guests will find a 24-hour front desk and a terrace. Other facilities offered at the property include meeting facilities, a shared lounge and a ticket service.

388363.description: Located a short 600-meter walk from the town center, Riad Elias offers convenient access to local attractions. This peaceful hotel, built in 2005, features 8 accommodation units and provides complimentary Wi-Fi in public areas. Guests can also enjoy a 24-hour reception and on-site parking. A transfer service and wellness services are available, though some may incur additional fees. For those interested in exploring the wider region, transport links are just 800 meters away.

388365.description:
Neo Hotel is a modern property in constant evolution, always introducing new features to enhance the guest experience. Its strategic location makes it an excellent base for reaching Milan’s city centre using the nearby public transport, as well as discovering charming destinations such as Monza and Como. 

In step with the hotel’s continuous development, the restaurant also evolves, offering an updated and refined culinary experience. The meeting rooms, spacious and well-equipped, make the hotel an ideal venue for corporate gatherings, with the possibility of including business lunches. 

Among the latest additions is the gym, available for guests to enjoy. Furthermore, the hotel’s proximity to Parco Nord provides opportunities for outdoor relaxation, walks, or a bit of leisure time.

388537.description: These apartments boast a prime position in the Paralel Avenue area, being very convenient for both business travellers and tourists travelling to Barcelona. The Fira de Barcelona is a few metro stops away or 20 minutes on foot and the famous Ramblas and the harbour are easily reachable in a walk shorter than 10 minutes. Visitors will not have to go too far to take the metro, as there is one stop just a few steps away from the apartments. The luminous and spacious accommodation units are ideally fitted to make guests feel completely at ease. They boast a cheery and modern look in white tones and some colourful touches. The staff will help its visitors with information about the city and will provide them with a city map. Visitors can also benefit from the complimentary wireless Internet connection to use with their mobile phone or laptop.

388539.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. The complimentary beach shuttle makes getting to the surf and sand a breeze. For lunch or dinner, stop by Feast, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 4026 square feet (374 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 8 meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite.

name.content: Finest Playa Mujeres by The Excellence Collection

388541.address: Vialidad paseo Mujeres Manzana 1 Zona Continental, SM.3
388541.description: Located in the beautiful Playa Mujeres area of Punta Sam, the 5-star Finest Playa Mujeres by The Excellence Collection offers an all-inclusive experience. Indulge in relaxation at the full-service spa with massages, body treatments, and facials. Enjoy a refreshing dip in one of the 10 outdoor swimming pools or unwind on the private beach. The 450 guestrooms feature private spa tubs, LED televisions, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, and furnished balconies or patios. Complimentary Wi-Fi and satellite programming are also provided. With 12 restaurants, including the Mexican cuisine of Lizo, a coffee shop/café, 24-hour room service, multiple bars and lounges, and a complimentary full breakfast, your dining experience is sure to be exceptional. Additional amenities include concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), gift shops, a business center, and free valet parking. The property also offers extensive meeting and event space. The Punta Sam Ferry Terminal and El Meco Archaeological Site are just a short drive away.

388551.description: Situated a short distance from the Dubai Shopping Mall and featuring magnificent views over the Business Bay and downtown Dubai, this luxurious hotel is suitable for either a holiday or a long-term stay. Those who decide to stay at this luxurious property will feel close to home, as it has been designed with all guests’ needs in mind. The rooms are flooded with natural light and suites exude warmth and elegance through design and textures and have high quality furnishings and amenities for guests' comfort and convenience. Travellers wishing to share special moments with friends may drop by Level 3, where they will find the hotel's temperature-controlled swimming pool, swim-up bar, and in-pool hot tub offering an oasis of tranquillity. As for the onsite dining options, the Mediterranean themed restaurant adds the final touch to this unrivalled hotel.

388597.description: Enjoy a central and affordable stay at Hostal Providencia, located in the heart of Santiago. We're just three minutes from Plaza Italia, the Baquedano metro station, and the vibrant Bellavista neighborhood, known for its exciting nightlife, pubs, bars, and restaurants. We're also within easy walking distance of popular attractions like Parque Forestal, Cerro Santa Lucia, Pablo Neruda's house, the Mercado Central, and the Cathedral.

name.content: Four Points By Sheraton Riyadh Khaldia

388637.description: Enjoy recreational amenities including a health club, a hot tub, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. For lunch or dinner, stop by Al Nakheel Restaurant, which specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 am to 10:30 am for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired Internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in Riyadh? This hotel has 20, 756 square feet (1, 929 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 17 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 367 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Al Watan Park - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi; Al Batha Market - 1 km / 0. 6 mi; Al Maigliah Market Center - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi; Imam Turki Bin Abdullah Grand Mosque - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi; Al Musmak Fortress - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi; King Abdulaziz Historical Center - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi; Al Murabba Historical Palace - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi; National Museum of Saudi Arabia - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi; Souk Al Zal - 1. 7 km / 1 mi; King Abdul Aziz Library - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi; Al Zal Market - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi; Salam Park - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi; Riyadh TV Tower - 2. 5 km / 1. 5 mi; Al-Mubarak Hospital - 2. 6 km / 1. 6 mi; Masmak Citadel - 2. 9 km / 1. 8 mi.

388839.description: If you're looking for a neat, modern, and safe hostel in a peaceful setting, this Barcelona hostel is an excellent choice. It offers panoramic city views, including the sea and Tibidabo Mountain. Located in a quiet suburb, it's just a 15-20 minute walk from Park Güell and a short trip from other tourist attractions. The new building provides bright, exterior rooms with large windows, most featuring balconies. Guests can relax in beautiful, spacious common areas, including a chill-out zone and a communal dining area with free Wi-Fi. The bright, spacious dormitories feature heated tiled floors and shared bathrooms with hairdryers. Hillview is also eco-conscious, utilizing solar panels for water heating.

388900.description: Nestled within 200 metre(s) from the town centre, the establishment allows easy access to all this destination has to offer. The main entertainment areas are within easy reach of the accomodation. Visitors can find the nearest golf course within 6 km from the bed and breakfast. Guests will find numerous public transport links within walking distance. The property is within 2 km from the nearest beach. Visitors will find the airport within 35 km. The bed and breakfast is within 1000 metres' walking distance from the harbour. This property offers a total of 41 rooms. Laitau was completely renovated in 2007. Everyone staying at this accommodation may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Laitau. Travellers may contact the reception desk any time during the day. Everyone staying at Laitau will have the time of their lives as they will be able to make use of the sport facilities and practice leisure activities offered.

388917.description: The total number of units is 19.

389040.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the B&B Hotel Barcelona Sant Cugat in Sant Cugat del Valles, conveniently located within a 10-minute drive of Parc de Collserola and the Autonomous University of Barcelona. This hotel offers 96 air-conditioned guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and desks. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast for a fee and make use of amenities such as a garden, a TV in the common area, tour/ticket assistance, a banquet hall, and a vending machine. Free self-parking, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities are also available. This hotel is 11 miles from Camp Nou and 11. 7 miles from Park Güell.

389055.description: Located conveniently near Marrakech Menara Airport (3. 7 km), this club hotel offers self-catering flats with air conditioning, balconies, and terraces. Enjoy amenities such as an outdoor pool, a children's playground, a 24-hour front desk, a garden, and free parking. Internet access is available in public areas. Each flat includes a refrigerator, a private bathroom with a shower and bath, and home appliances. Nearby attractions include the Saadian Tombs (2. 7 km), Moulay El Yazid Mosque (2. 7 km), and Bahia Palace (3. 2 km).

389077.address: King Khalid International Airport Road, P.O.Box 10
389077.description: Madareem Crown Hotel is a luxurious 5-star hotel, situated in the heart of Riyadh. It features an outdoor swimming pool, a sauna, and free in-room Wi-Fi. All guest rooms at Madareem Crown are air-conditioned and feature modern design and furnishings. Guests can make use of a minibar, a satellite TV and a hot tub. Hotel Madareem Crown features a fitness centre and a beauty shop. Guests can also enjoy the billiards and darts facilities. Madareem Crown features several restaurants that serve a wide selection of international cuisine. Guests can also enjoy a coffee at the Lobby Café or have a relaxing dinner and cocktail at the Garden restaurant. Madareem Crown Hotel is a 15 minute-drive to King Khalid International Airport, and within walking distance to Riyadh's city centre. Airport shuttle and free on-site parking are also available.

389175.address: Mimar Hayrettin Mah.Divni Ali Sok. Beyazit, 7
389175.description: Located at the heart of the Old City of Istanbul, within 300m of the fascinating Grand Bazaar, this pleasantly styled and hospitable city hotel offers a comfortable base from which to explore this entrancing city. Situated on a street dating back more than 150 years, famous attractions such as the Hagia Sophia Museum, Topkapi Palace and Blue Mosque in the Sultanahmet district, are within 700m of the hotel. Having a splendid panoramic view of the Bosphorus, which runs between the European and Asian sides of the city, during warmer months guests have the opportunity to relax on the terrace and enjoy a small snack or beverage or even to soak in the whirlpool bath. The rooms are equipped with elegant furnishings inspired by an Ottoman concept and are modernly equipped for guests' comfort.

389176.description: Located in the Kumkapi district of Istanbul, these comfortable apartments offer a perfect base from which to explore this fascinating city. Fully equipped and suitable for making light meals, guests can enjoy the freedom of having their own self-catering facilities and space to accommodate small groups in the family apartments. Within 400m of the Marmara Sea, the apartments are surrounded by fish restaurants, popular for an evening meal, while Kumkpai train station is a convenient 2 minute walk enabling ease of travel around the city. Close to the many historical attractions at Sultanahmet which can be reached on foot in approximately 20 minutes, the Grand Bazaar is just 800m away.

389237.description: With a total of 15 rooms, this is a nice place to stay.

389339.description: Nestled in the heart of Marrakech's historic Medina, in the tranquil Bab Doukkala district, Riad El Youssoufi offers a magical escape near the prestigious Palais du Pacha-Dar el Glaoui. Easily accessible by car, the riad is just a 5-minute drive from the vibrant Jemaa el Fna square and the bustling souks, making it an ideal base for exploring the city. Guests can enjoy a refreshing dip in the new swimming pool and jacuzzi, heated during winter. The riad has been superbly restored, showcasing traditional Moroccan craftsmanship with intricate zellige tilework and polished tadelakt plaster. A luxuriant patio, adorned with banana and orange trees, fragrant jasmine, and a tranquil fountain, leads to a spacious open-plan lounge and dining area where breakfast, lunch, and dinner are served. Guests can also unwind in the comfortable lounge overlooking the patio and pool.

name.content: Aboo's Hotel Concord Galaxy by ZUZU

389357.address: Andheri - Kurla Rd, Metro Station Marol Naka
389357.description: Hotel Concord Galaxy is a 3-star budget hotel conveniently located near Mumbai's international and domestic airports. Situated in the heart of the city's corporate offices and SEEPZ Industrial Estate, it's also a short 5-minute walk from Seven Hills Hospital. The hotel offers easy access to the Mumbai Metro (10 meters away), providing quick connections to Andheri railway station (6 minutes) and Kurla station (8 minutes).

389581.description: Waking up in São Paulo to the smell of brewed coffee and warm bread is possible! Welcome to Intercity Nações Unidas, the perfect choice for those who want to combine work and relaxation in the city's new business center. Spacious and comfortable rooms, a helpful staff with a smile, and a delicious breakfast are just a few of this hotel's charms. Its strategic location is another convenience – after all, Intercity Nações Unidas is situated among major business centers, just 5 minutes from the U. S. Consulate General and Morumbi and Market Place malls, and close to Vibra São Paulo and Congonhas Airport.

389586.description: Residencial Pantanal Santa Cruz Hotel features a total of 24 units. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. Residencial Pantanal Santa Cruz Hotel may charge a fee for some services.

389587.description: There are a total of 24 guest rooms on the premises. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. The front desk offers 24-hour reception.

389707.description:
Reco by DOT Suites is a 4-star hotel located in one of the most sophisticated neighborhoods of Buenos Aires. Ideal for those who enjoy being close to everything: iconic cafés, fine dining restaurants, art galleries, parks, historical landmarks, and a vibrant cultural scene. 
Our suites are modern, functional, and fully equipped units designed to make your stay comfortable from the very first moment. Each room accommodates up to 4 guests and stands out for its spaciousness. 
Whether you are traveling for business or leisure, alone or as a couple, our different categories adapt to your needs: space, natural light, modern design, and a privileged location. Stay in the heart of Recoleta, with comfort, style, and independence.

389717.description: This lovely Hotel is located in Jeddah. There are a total of 156 accommodation units on the premises. Apart from the services and amenities offered, patrons can take advantage of the wired and wireless Internet connection available in public areas. This accommodation offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. Habitat Hotel Jeddah is not a pet-friendly establishment. There is a car park. This establishment is provided with all the necessary services and amenities for a successful business event.

389738.description: With a small number of only 7, this accomodation is very convenient for a quiet stay.

389811.description: Located in Porto's historic old town, the 'Fish Bag' hotel boasts a fresh, avant-garde design following a complete renovation. Its elegant rooms offer a comfortable stay with a full range of amenities. The on-site restaurant serves both traditional Portuguese and international cuisine. Riad Atlas Prestige – A Peaceful Escape in the Heart of the Atlas Mountains
Located in Imlil, just 65 km (around 1. 5 hours) from Marrakech Menara Airport, Riad Atlas Prestige is a charming rural hotel nestled at the foot of the High Atlas Mountains. This warm, family-run guesthouse features 11 comfortable rooms decorated in traditional Berber style, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding valleys and peaks. 
Guests enjoy free wired and wireless internet access and a 24-hour front desk. The on-site panoramic restaurant serves delicious Moroccan and local specialties, freshly prepared with regional ingredients — the perfect way to relax after a day of hiking or exploring the Imlil Valley. 
Riad Atlas Prestige also offers a wide range of activities and experiences.

393007.description: The Plaza España Apartments are conveniently located in Barcelona, a short 3-minute walk from Plaza España and 350 meters from the Fira de Barcelona exhibition center. The Poble Sec district is a 10-minute walk, and the Arenas de Barcelona Shopping Centre is just 300 meters away. Excellent public transport links are available, with Plaza España Metro Station only a 3-minute walk from the apartments. Barcelona El Prat Airport is a 30-minute bus ride, and regular airport buses depart from a stop just 200 meters away. The air-conditioned apartments feature free WiFi, flat-screen TVs, and small balconies with street views. Each apartment is fitted with wooden flooring and includes a lounge area with a sofa bed and a fully equipped open-plan kitchenette.

393132.description: Located a short walk from the town center, Dar Imlil offers convenient access to numerous attractions. This charming accommodation features 11 guest rooms and provides Wi-Fi in public areas. Guests benefit from a 24-hour reception and airport transfer service. Event rooms are available for business travelers, and the on-site dining options offer delicious meals throughout the day.

393161.description: The Athenswas is a member of the Design Hotels and was designed according to the basic principles of classic modernism. The clean lines, simple structures and natural materials -mainly Greek marble and wood- determine the aesthetics of the rooms and public areas. All the rooms have a terrace, which enables the guest to enjoy one of the most important aspects of Athenian life, the pleasure of relaxing in an open area. The Athenswas features a rooftop bar and a restaurant with breathtaking views of the Acropolis, the Lycabettus Hill and the rest of the city, the mountains surrounding it, the horizon and even the sea in the south.

393165.description: Book a Bed Hostel is a budget-friendly hostel for travelers and backpackers in London. Our bright, fun, and recently refurbished space welcomes visitors from all over the world, located above The Royal Standard pub. All dormitories include free Wi-Fi, in-room lockers, and fresh linens. The hostel is conveniently located a short train ride from London Bridge in central London, 20 minutes from the Olympic Stadium in Stratford, and within walking distance of the Greenwich Mean Time and Meridian Line. Situated in West Greenwich, Book a Bed Hostel is close to three stations: Deptford Bridge (DLR), Deptford (National Rail), and New Cross (Overground), offering easy access to central London and attractions like the Royal Observatory, Cutty Sark, the Emirates Air Line, and the O2 Arena. We strive to ensure a great stay in a clean, comfortable, and safe environment. Book a Bed Hostel offers a unique and memorable London experience.

393174.description: The Liceu Apartments enjoy a prime location just 20 meters from Las Ramblas in Barcelona's vibrant Gothic Quarter. Housed in a beautifully renovated 18th-century building with a lift, these stylish studio lofts accommodate up to four guests. Each apartment features a well-equipped kitchen, complete with a microwave, oven, refrigerator, freezer, coffee machine, and kettle. Linens, towels, and kitchenware are provided. The comfortable living area offers a color TV and a sofa that converts into two single beds. Air conditioning and heating ensure year-round comfort. From your balcony, take in the lively atmosphere of Las Ramblas with its famed human statues. Explore the surrounding El Raval district, brimming with tapas bars, restaurants, cafes, and shops. The Liceu Theatre, MACBA, and Palau Guell are within a five-minute walk.

393238.address: Carrer Mare de Deu del Coll 14-16, 14-16 TRASLADOS
393238.description: Monrooms guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 9 units.

393262.description: Located directly across from Corferias, Bogotá's premier exhibition center, and near the U. S. Embassy, this modern hotel offers a relaxing atmosphere and comfortable facilities. El Dorado International Airport is a quick 5-minute drive away, and Gran Estación, the city's largest shopping mall, is easily accessible. The historic downtown, home to attractions like La Candelaria, Plaza de Bolivar, the Cathedral, and the Botero and Gold Museums, is just a 10-minute drive. Our dedicated staff provides personalized service to ensure a memorable stay.

393275.description: This outstanding property is situated at the Belvedere Quartier, right next to the central railway station 'Hauptbahnhof Wien'. It is a genuine Viennese property in its own way and has been designed for guests to experience the modern Viennese spirit. The neighbourhood includes the new and modern railway station as well as the historic buildings of Belvedere Castle. It bridges the gap between contemporary local culture and guests from all corners of the globe. Visitors staying at this property can expect ideal surroundings for business and leisure purposes, starting with cutting-edge features of the rooms and property. The accommodation units boast pure relaxation and tranquillity, ranging from comfortable rooms to spacious maisonettes. Those travelling on business will really appreciate the onsite coworking spaces with 20 coworking places. Furthermore, the hotel includes a beautiful garden ideal to enjoy a delicious cup of coffee and share nice moments with the whole family or friends.

393328.description: Enjoy this Marrakech hotel's outdoor pool, bicycle rentals, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Additional amenities include concierge services and barbecue grills. A shuttle service to shopping areas is available (surcharge). The hotel features a restaurant, a coffee shop/cafe, and room service (limited hours), plus a bar/lounge for evening relaxation. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (fee applies). For business travelers, the hotel offers 431 square feet (40 square meters) of conference and meeting space. A roundtrip airport shuttle (24 hours) and train station pick-up service are available (surcharge). The 114 guestrooms feature refrigerators, plasma televisions, private balconies, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Avenue Mohamed VI, Carré Eden Shopping Center, Marrakech Plaza, and Theatre Royal. The preferred airport is Menara Airport (RAK).

name.content: Ramada Hotel & Suites By Wyndham Istanbul Sisli

393333.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul's key business and finance district, near Cevahir Mall and numerous iconic sights, the newly constructed Ramada Hotel and Suites Istanbul Sisli offers both convenience and excellent transport links. Sisli Metro Station is just five minutes away, and the hotel provides car rental, on-site parking, and valet parking for a nominal fee. Nearby attractions include Trump Towers, Profilo Shopping Center, and Florence Nightingale Hospital. Guests can enjoy a complimentary breakfast buffet, relax in the Turkish bath and sauna, work out in the fitness center, and stay connected with complimentary wireless Internet access. Each smoke-free guest room features a flat-screen TV, safe, plush bathrobe, and mini-bar. Suites offer up to 110 square meters of space. The hotel also boasts a 24-hour restaurant, 24-hour room service, and event space for up to 120 people theatre-style.

393334.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden at Kadıköy Park Suites, a charming bed & breakfast in Istanbul's Kadıköy district. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (available for a fee) and make use of amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi and room service (limited hours). Each of the 15 guestrooms features a minibar, flat-screen TV, and private bathroom with shower and complimentary toiletries. The hotel also offers dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk. Located within a 5-minute drive of the Bosphorus and Bağdat Avenue, it's a convenient base for exploring Istanbul.

393438.description: Our hotel is located in one of the busiest areas of Santiago, in the famous Bellavista neighborhood characterized by different quality restaurants of Santiago. The hotel is close to the major attractions of Santiago. *Direct payment reservations will be debited in the local currency, at the current exchange rate.

393539.description: The establishment comprises a total of 28 snug accomodation units. Those staying at this accomodation may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. The front desk offers 24-hour reception.

393540.description: This charming hotel, with 41 rooms, has given new life to the historic Stationery Araújo e Sobrinho, which has been active there since 1829. With the perfect location, between Aliados Avenue and Ribeira, Porto A. S. 1829 Hotel is the ideal starting point for your visit to the invicta. This charming hotel has standard rooms, city view, superior, family or unique, with private bathroom. Some include a classic bathtub in the room, others also have panoramic views over the city of Porto. All are air conditioned, have a flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi. At Porto A. S. 1829, a breakfast service is available upon request and at an additional cost. At Restaurante Galeria do Largo you will find a showcase of flavors of traditional Portuguese cuisine with contemporary confection and presentation. Torre dos Clérigos and São Bento Train Station are 500 meters away. The iconic Dom Luís Bridge is just 550 meters away. Porto Cathedral is 400 meters away and Ribeira (riverside area) is 300 meters away and benefits from several riverside restaurants overlooking Vila Nova de Gaia. Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is 22 km from Porto A. S. 1829 Hotel.

393549.address: Via Pirelli, 4 Uscita Lainate o da Milano Arese LA, 4
393549.description: The Ibis Milano Fiera is ideal for business or leisure stays. Next to the Milan-Lakes motorway, it's convenient for a stop before heading to Italy's main tourist cities or the beautiful locations around us. Relax in one of the 120 soundproof rooms and savor our tasty dishes. Did your flight land in the evening? Did your concert end late? Our team is ready to welcome you 24/7. Get into the groove!

393582.description: Welcome to Charlie's Place & Suites, a boutique hotel nestled in the serene ambiance of Victoria Island, Lagos, conveniently located between Victoria Island and Lekki. Just a short walk from Shoprite shopping center and easily accessible from the main road, our hotel offers 16 well-appointed rooms. Each room features a private bathroom, safe, air conditioning, bedside lamps, parquet flooring, a flat-screen television, tea/coffee making facilities, and a work desk with chair. Guests can enjoy meals at our on-site restaurant and drinks at the bar. Maintain your fitness routine in our fully equipped gym or unwind with a game of ping-pong. We also offer airport pick-up and laundry services, along with 24-hour security.

393593.description: Ideally located in the heart of New York City's Chinatown, this charming and affordable hotel offers an excellent base for exploring the city's vibrant theatre scene and other attractions. Just steps away from Little Italy and the iconic Williamsburg Bridge, guests enjoy easy access to shopping and public transportation. Each comfortable single or double room provides complimentary Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and heating. A 24-hour reception desk ensures assistance is always available.

393694.address: 1 Goshen Estate Road, Lekki, P.C:2341 Lagos
393694.description: Located in Lagos, this beautiful hotel offers state-of-the-art facilities and luxuriously appointed rooms with warm, inviting decor. Modern amenities create a haven of relaxation, promising an unforgettable stay. The restaurant and rooftop bar offer exquisite continental and Nigerian dishes, fine wines, and personalized service. The dedicated staff is committed to meeting every guest's needs.

393697.description: With a small number of only 5, this establishment is very convenient for a quiet stay.

393705.description: Located close to the historic Sultanahmet district and within 400m of the atmospheric Grand Bazaar, these self-catering studios and apartments are ideally placed for enjoying the many sight-seeing attractions this city abounds with. Local amenities such as shops, cafe bars and restaurants are plentiful in the area and the nearest tram stop is 300m away enabling guests easy access around the city to places such as Taksim Square 4. 5 km away in the heart of Istanbul. Decorated in muted tones, the accommodation features modern amenities enabling guests a comfortable and convenient place from which to explore this fascinating city.

393738.description: Hotel Pullman São Paulo Vila Olímpia is well located in the business center of Vila Olímpia, near big companies and shopping centers like Vila Olímpia and JK malls, bars and Eataly. It brings together design and sophistication in large and comfortable rooms, and large suites with A/C and free Wi-Fi. The gym has state-of-the-art equipment for you to keep workouts up to date, plus a full SPA by Shishindo.

393939.description: A stay at Hostal Gran Via 63 Rooms places you in the heart of Madrid, steps from Gran Via Street and Teatro Coliseum. This hostal is 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from Royal Palace of Madrid and 0. 6 mi (0. 9 km) from Puerta del Sol. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Take advantage of the hostal's room service (during limited hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 18 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless Internet access is available. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

394086.description: The comfortable Grand Aras Hotel & Suites, built in 2014, is conveniently located in New City, just 50 meters from the town center and 2 kilometers from both the main entertainment areas and the harbor. Public transportation is easily accessible. This accessible hotel offers 134 bedrooms, some with cots available upon request. Guests can enjoy internet access in all areas, a 24-hour reception, on-site parking, and a garage. The hotel's dining options provide a refined culinary experience in an enchanting atmosphere, and its facilities are well-suited for business events. Health and wellness services offer a relaxing escape. Please note that some services may incur a fee. Pets are not permitted.

394088.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at The 22 Hotel, featuring a terrace with scenic views, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, and savor delicious meals at our restaurant or through convenient room service. Unwind with a drink at our bar/lounge. Our 23 air-conditioned rooms offer minibars, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, and partially open bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, hair dryers, and slippers. Additional conveniences include desks, electric kettles, and daily housekeeping. We also provide express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. We're conveniently located near Istanbul Cevahir Shopping and Entertainment Centre (0. 5 mi), City's Nişantaşı Shopping Center (0. 7 mi), and several hospitals. The nearest airports are Istanbul Airport (IST) - 23. 4 mi and Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Intl. Airport (SAW) - 25. 3 mi.

394138.description: Situated within Dubai Healthcare City, this outstanding hotel in Dubai is at the crossroads of the bustling downtown and the ancient charm of the old city. Dubai International Financial Centre, Wafi City, The Dubai Mall, Mall of the Emirates and the cultural heritage districts are within easy access via all means of transportation. Dubai Healthcare City metro station is located at a short walk from the hotel, providing easy access to other parts of the city. Spread over the 34 floors of this unique building, the luxurious rooms and suites overlook the historic Dubai creek or stunning city skyline. They all come with fine contemporary furnishings, a welcoming ambience as well as the latest services and facilities to meet the needs of any traveller. The onsite dining options take guests through a journey of international flavours, and the 3200 sqm of meeting rooms are ideal to host any kind of event.

394144.description: Strategically situated in a quiet street, this accommodation offers the perfect destination for a quiet and relaxing stay. However, as it is well positioned near the Marques de Pombal subway station and other public means of transport, guests may reach Lisbon’s lively historical centre and its main shopping areas and sightseeing attractions very easily. Contemporary appointed with state-of-the-art technological equipment and a luminous and bright look, the apartments will be the ideal place in which visitors may rest and relax after a busy day of sightseeing or working. Moreover, they combine a fresh modern look with typical and traditional Portuguese elements to create an authentic atmosphere. Guests will be warmly welcomed at the 24-hour reception desk and may use the complimentary wireless Internet connection provided.

394145.description: Enjoy amenities like a 24-hour fitness center and terrace with city views. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and dining at The Warwick Cafe, plus a coffee shop/cafe for snacks and a bar/lounge for evening drinks. Business travelers appreciate the 24-hour business center and other convenient services, such as dry cleaning/laundry and a 24-hour front desk. Each of the 315 guestrooms features a kitchen equipped with a refrigerator and oven, along with a pillowtop bed, Smart TV, and Wi-Fi (surcharge). A safe, desk, and phone are also provided for your convenience. The hotel is located near Cromwell Road, just a short distance from Kensington High Street and the Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre.

394308.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Satisfy your appetite with international cuisine at bunk terrace, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge and dine alfresco. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 45 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Conveniences include safes, housekeeping is provided daily, and irons/ironing boards can be requested. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Istanbul Congress Center - 0. 5 km / 0.

394378.description: Magna Pars, the world's first perfume-themed hotel, is nestled on a quiet side street in Milan's vibrant fashion and design district. This stylish, family-owned, all-suite hotel is conveniently located near lively streets brimming with bars, shops, and restaurants, and offers easy access to public transportation and Milan's famous attractions. Housed in a former perfume factory, the building has been transformed into a contemporary architectural masterpiece. Guests can enjoy a splendid restaurant, lounge bar, gym, spa, rooftop deck, and library, providing a tranquil escape from the bustling city. Each of the 68 suites is designed for discerning guests and features exquisite Italian textiles, remarkable artisan crafts, and unique furniture handcrafted by talented artisans from the Lombardy region.

394458.description: Perfectly located to discover both Niguarda district with the North Park for a leisurely walk and the modern and fast evolving Bicocca district, this hotel is the ideal place of accommodation for business and leisure travellers alike. There is a tram stop just in front of the hotel, allowing its guests to get to the city centre very easily. There are several kinds of room, depending on whether visitors choose the most affordable type or the more modern and cheerful guest rooms available. All of them count complimentary wireless Internet connection for guests to keep updated during their stay. Business travellers might appreciate the on-site meeting rooms available as well as the computer and business corner and everyone will enjoy the breakfast room where a delicious breakfast is served every morning.

394565.address: Al Barsha 1, Beside Mall Of The Emirates, Dubai
394565.description: Prime location and superior treatment await at the hotel. Whether it is a convention or simply a vacation with loved ones, the beautiful scenic views ensure that the trip will be memorable. Guests of the hotel receive first-class service and accommodations. Business can be pleasure at the hotel where they meet all needs. The property near the Mall Of Emirates is air-conditioned in public areas and provides 24-hour reception. The Hotel safe provides a secure place for guests to store valuable items. There is a currency exchange on the premises. The Hotel offers internet access for guest convenience. Guests can take advantage of room service to enjoy breakfast in bed. There is a secure parking on the premises. The Hotel has helpful, multilingual staff available to help guests with any queries or service bookings. Superior accommodations and fabulous service meet all the business and leisure needs.

name.content: Silver Forest boutique Lodge and Spa

394575.description: Nestled in the tranquil Helderberg Mountain forest, Silver Forest Boutique Hotel and Spa offers a centrally located base to explore cultural, historical, and leisure activities. Enjoy golf at the renowned Erinvale Golf Club, wine tasting at the historic Lourensford or Vergelegen Wine Estates, or relax on the golden beaches of Strand and Gordon's Bay. All are within a 12km radius. The historic village of Stellenbosch, also 12km away, offers a glimpse into the past with its markets and wine estates.

394739.address: The Pearl - Doha, Costa Malaz Bay
394739.description: The Marsa Malaz Kempinski, a luxurious hotel located on a private island in Doha's prestigious Pearl district, offers an exclusive waterfront experience. Blending European architecture with traditional Arabian elements, this palatial hotel features 281 rooms and 73 suites, each with 24-hour butler service. Guests can enjoy a private beach, swimming pools, water sports, tennis courts, and a variety of dining options, including six restaurants, a lounge cafe, bar, nightclub, pool restaurant, and spa cafe. The extensive spa offers 20 treatment rooms, a health club, indoor pool, beauty salons, saunas, and steam rooms. The Kempinski White Glove Services program ensures a healthy and safe environment.

394877.description: Rinoterra Minho offers delightful river, garden, and mountain views. It includes a spa with a dynamic indoor pool, jacuzzi, Turkish bath, and massage services. Each elegant unit features tea and coffee facilities, a cable LED TV, air conditioning, and a private bathroom. Some units have balconies, while others include seating areas. The stylish breakfast area offers traditional Portuguese and international dishes accompanied by organic options. Dinner is available by reservation. Guests can also enjoy an outdoor pool, sun loungers, and a lawn area. Moledo Beach is 8 km away, and Vila Praia de Ancora is within a 10-minute drive. Children over 16 are welcome.

394878.description: This lovely hotel is situated in the northern suburbs of Athens. A total of 51 bedrooms are available for guests' convenience. This property was fully refurbished in 2009. Customers may keep updated with the internet and Wi-Fi access in public areas, while the latter is available also in the guests rooms. The hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. Travellers will revel in dishes served at the accommodation's gastronomic options. Corporate travellers may avail for event rooms, ideal to host a business seminar or a special occasion. This hotel is an ideal choice for both leisure and business travelers.

name.content: Pousada de Lisboa – Praça do Comércio

395061.description: This 5 star hotel is located in the city centre of Lisbon and was established in 2015. It is close to the Praca Comercio and the nearest station is Terreiro do Paco. The Hotel has a restaurant, a bar, a conference room, a coffee shop, an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 90 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe, trouser press, ironing set and air conditioning.

395063.description: Set in Barcelona , this property offers an ideal place of rest and relaxation. Hotel was built in 2012.The Hotel offers 11 apartments. Set in the heart of the city, the Hotel offers easy access to all the city has to offer. The main train and bus stations are just a short drive away. There are multiple public transport links within easy reach. Guests will find the airport within easy reach. The Hotel is close to main entertainment areas of the city. The beach is set in the immediate vicinity of the Hotel. The Hotel is situated a few minutes away from the harbour.

395178.description: Alp de Veenen Hotel is located on the water, in a quiet and central location. Amsterdam city center, Schiphol Airport, the World Fashion Center, the Amsterdam World Trade Center and the RAI conference center are all less than a 15-minute drive away. All 26 rooms offer a TV, a telephone and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower or bath and toilet. Rooms with a balcony and/or spa bath are also available. The hotel is open all year round and the reception is open until midnight. In the morning, a breakfast buffet is served with many choices for a good start to the day. The bar is open from early morning to midnight. Drinks are also served on the terrace. Hotel guests can enjoy fresh fruit, coffee and tea for free in the restaurant. Lunch and dinner options can be reached in 2 minutes on foot.

395209.address: Katip Mustafa Celebi Mh. Abdullah Sok. Beyoglu, 9
395209.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace at The House of Tulpan, a centrally located Istanbul hotel just steps from Istiklal Avenue and an 8-minute walk from Taksim Square. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and take advantage of convenient services such as tour/ticket assistance, dry cleaning/laundry, and luggage storage. Each of the 8 guestrooms offers private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, coffee/tea makers, and daily housekeeping. Irons/ironing boards are available upon request. A shuttle from the airport is available for a surcharge (24 hours). The hotel is 1 km from Galataport and 2. 3 km from the Bosphorus.

395338.description: Opened in 2011, the Soneca Plaza Hotel, the newest addition to the Buenas Hotels group, is located in São Paulo's historic downtown area on Rua dos Timbiras. Just 200 meters from the República metro station, it offers easy access to the Airport Service Bus line, providing convenient transport to Guarulhos International Airport. This 70-room budget hotel boasts a modern interior design and efficient service, upholding Buenas Hotels' commitment to international hospitality standards. Its prime location, just 4. 7 km from the Anhembi Convention Center and 6. 9 km from Expo Center Norte, makes it an ideal choice for travelers seeking both convenience and quality.

395358.description: Featuring an indoor pool, a communal sauna and a fitness centre, Meliá Ibirapuera is located in Moema district, only 2 km from Ibirapuera Park and 4 km from Luis Carlos Berrini Avenue. Free WiFi is available and complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Air-conditioned rooms offer contemporary décor and are fitted with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a minibar. Ensuite bathroom comes with free toiletries and a hairdryer. Some categories also offer bath robe and slippers. A 24-hour reception desk is available for guests' benefits, as well as meeting facilities. Giotto Restaurant serves local and international dishes, and the bar is available for refreshing drinks.

395458.address: Topkapi Mah. Topkapi Cad. No: 47 Topkapi, 47
395458.description:
Golden Gate Hotel is a modern city hotel located in Topkapı, Fatih, within Istanbul’s historic peninsula. Its convenient location provides easy access to public transportation and makes it an ideal base for guests wishing to explore Istanbul’s historical, cultural and shopping attractions. 
The hotel offers a variety of accommodation options, including Standard, Twin, Deluxe, Suite and Single rooms, providing suitable choices for solo travellers, couples, families and groups. Comfortable and functional rooms are designed to offer a pleasant stay for both leisure and business travellers. 
Located in one of Istanbul’s well-established districts, Golden Gate Hotel provides convenient connections to the city’s major attractions, including the Sultanahmet area, Hagia Sophia, the Grand Bazaar and other highlights of the Historic Peninsula. 
With its central location, comfortable accommodation and welcoming atmosphere, Golden Gate Hotel is a convenient choice for travellers looking to discover Istanbul while staying in the historic Fatih district.

name.content: Residence Inn New York Downtown Manhattan/WorldTC

395466.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at the Residence Inn Marriott New York Downtown Manhattan/WTC Area, such as a 24-hour fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and babysitting services (surcharge). Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, served daily from 6:30 AM to 9:30 AM. The hotel also offers dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk. A bus station shuttle is available (surcharge). Each of the 242 guestrooms features a kitchenette equipped with a refrigerator and microwave, complimentary wired and wireless internet, and a Smart TV with satellite programming. Additional conveniences include a phone, safe, and desk. Located near Wall Street, the South Street Seaport, and One World Trade Center, the hotel is a short distance from various attractions.

395490.description: These bright and stylish apartments feature modern kitchens and free WiFi, and are located a 15-minute walk from London Bridge station and the South Bank. All kitchens at Residence Inn by Marriott London Bridge are fully equipped with kitchen utensils, an oven and hob and a microwave for cooking. A dishwasher, refrigerator, and washing machine are also included. Living areas provide flat-screen TVs and modern wood flooring. Guests can relax with comfortable sofas and a dining area with a table and chairs. Bermondsey Street with its chic shops and galleries is 5 minutes away on foot. The fashionable South Bank area, with the Tate Modern Gallery, is a 25-minute walk.

395560.address: Cluster T,Adjacent to Damac Properties Metro Stati
395560.description: Centrally located in a dynamic area, the hotel is a marquee location for discerning travelers. With 3 eclectic restaurants including an al fresco shisha lounge, a design, Seasons - all day dining restaurant and a traditional Italian restaurant, the hotel is a sure choice for food enthusiasts. The Fit & Spa lounge on the 34th floor with stunning views of the city and the rooftop pool makes for a perfect fitness destination. Business does not go ignored with 11 meeting rooms at your disposal .

395925.description: A stay at Renaissance Cairo Mirage City Hotel places you in the heart of New Cairo, a 10-minute drive from City Centre Almaza Shopping Mall and 11 minutes from KidZania Cairo. This luxury hotel is 7. 5 mi (12 km) from City Stars and 7. 6 mi (12. 2 km) from Cairo Festival City Mall. . Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an outdoor pool, a steam room, and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the complimentary area shuttle. . Make yourself at home in one of the 333 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Rooms have private patios. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment. Bathrooms feature bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. . Enjoy international cuisine at Citron, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. . Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.

395999.description: Escape the pressures of work with a stay at the Nice Royal Hotel in Istanbul's Ataşehir district. This comfortable hotel offers a relaxing experience with luxurious facilities and exceptional service. A dedicated, experienced staff is committed to guest satisfaction. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi in communal areas and the convenience of a 24-hour reception. Some services may incur additional fees.

396200.description: Indulge in a rejuvenating experience at the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take a refreshing dip in one of the two outdoor swimming pools or unwind on the private beach. This all-inclusive property features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and supervised childcare. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments, with some exceptions applying to specific restaurants, special dinners, dishes, beverages, and other amenities. Bigelow bath amenities, Garnier linens and locally sourced minibars. 407738.description: Casa Bella Gracia is just 5 minutes' walk from Passeig de Gràcia and Diagonal Avenue. This eco-friendly boutique hotel features attractive rooms. The internal courtyard, which serves as a cooling airy space as well as to shade the inhabitants from the world's prying eyes, has a glittering pool to immerse yourself in on hot days and plants all around, creating an exotic, mysterious and refreshing ambiance.

408024.description: Zoku is a place where you can live, work, relax and socialise. The Social Spaces are a great to place to work, share a meal or meet kindred spirits. We have bikes for rent that will give you the freedom to roam wherever you want, whilst blending in with the locals.
