Riad has a beautiful table, fine and various Moroccan dishes are prepared by our cook Aicha. drinks included (water, coffee, mint tea, Soda)
We will ensure your comfort and success of every moment of your stay.

409562.description: Situated in Jeddah, 500 metres from Mall of Arabia, Casablanca Grand Hotel boasts a spa centre and hot tub. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant. All 150 rooms in the Casablanca Grand offer a seating area with cable flat-screen TV. An iPad is provided upon request. You will find a coffee machine in the room. Every room is fitted with a private bathroom fitted with a bath. Extras include bathrobes and slippers. There is free shuttle service at the property. Red Sea Mall is 4. 1 km from Casablanca Grand Hotel, while Atallah Happy Land Park is 5 km away. It is 15 minutes away from Jeddah's fabulous sea side area and close to major commercial shopping malls. The nearest airport is King Abdulaziz International Airport, just 3 minute by car from the property.

409599.address: Naif Area, Near Al Sabkha Bus Station
409599.description: The Flora Al Souq Hotel, a 2-star establishment, enjoys a central location in Dubai's main business and shopping district, Al Baniyas. A short drive from Dubai Airport and a 10-minute walk from the Gold and Spice Souks, the hotel offers 80 beautifully designed rooms. Each room features contemporary furnishings, wood flooring, air conditioning, an LCD TV with satellite channels, a writing desk, a mini-refrigerator, an electronic safe, IDD telephones, high-speed Wi-Fi, a makeup mirror, a tea/coffee maker, and an en-suite bathroom.

409618.address: Next to Baniyas Square Metro station, Baniyas Squa
409618.description: Located in Deira, a 20-minute drive from Dubai International Airport, White Fort Hotel offers air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs. Guests can enjoy on-site dining and a 24-hour front desk. Sabkha Bus Station is a short 5-minute walk away. Modern classic decor, featuring tiled floors and printed wallpaper, welcomes guests to each room. A minibar and wardrobe are standard, and select rooms offer a balcony. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The hotel's restaurant serves a buffet of local and international cuisine. A variety of cafes, shops, and restaurants are within a 10-minute walk. Naif Park is a 5-minute walk from the hotel, while the Dubai World Trade Centre is a 15-minute drive. Baniyas Square metro station is just a minute's walk away. The hotel is conveniently located near popular shopping destinations.

409628.description: The Alpinn Hotel, located in Istanbul's historic Beyazit district, offers a blend of comfort, elegance, and modern amenities. Its prime location near business, cultural, and entertainment centers makes it an ideal base for both leisure and business travelers. Within walking distance are major landmarks such as the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, and Topkapi Palace, as well as numerous restaurants in the vibrant Sultanahmet area.

409632.address: Al Burj Street, Near Sabkha Bus Station, Deira, 123309
409632.description: Located in Dubai's Deira district, the Florida Square Hotel offers convenient access to the Gold Souk and Al Ghurair Centre, both within a 5-minute drive. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an on-site restaurant with room service available during limited hours. Guests can also enjoy a daily buffet breakfast for a fee. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, dry cleaning/laundry services, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge. The 80 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, LCD TVs with cable programming, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. The hotel is 4. 5 miles from the Dubai Cruise Terminal and 5. 5 miles from the Dubai World Trade Centre.

name.content: Sunday Mega Hotel Sheikh Zayed Road Near DIFC

409643.address: Sheikh Zayed Road, Near Financial Metro Station, 00
409643.description: This 31-storey hotel offers full serviced rooms and suites which have been elegantly furnished. Conveniently located in the heart of Dubai, guests will find Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai Financial Center metro stations just a few steps from the establishment. Dubai International Airport is 15 minutes away by car. This property boasts a large choice of accommodation units ideal to enjoy a memorable holiday experience with the family. The guests can take advantage of the onsite leisure options including a gym, an indoor swimming pool with stunning panoramic city views as well as a sauna, steam bath and hot tub. The all-day dining restaurant located on the 1st floor offers breathtaking panoramic views over the city.

409651.address: Off Sharaf DG Metro Station, Sheikh Zayed Road, 1
409651.description:
Aparthotel Adagio Premium Dubai Al Barsha is ideally located in Dubai's vibrant business and leisure district, just a 2-minute walk from InsuranceMarket Metro Station. Choose from spacious one- to four-bedroom apartments featuring free Wi-Fi, fully equipped kitchens, and in-room laundry facilities. Guests also enjoy access to fitness centre, outdoor pool, pool bar, all-day dining restaurant, café, bar, and meeting rooms, making it the perfect choice for both short and extended stays. 

Enjoy all Dubai has to offer from your home base at Aparthotel Adagio Premium Dubai Al Barsha. The white sands of Jumeirah Beach promise a true vacation experience, and public tours of the magnificent Jumeirah Mosque offer a unique opportunity to learn about Emirati culture and religion. Traditional souks can still be found along Dubai Creek: wander their narrow alleys to discover silks, spices and jewellery. For the best international brands, the Mall of the Emirates is a shopper s paradise. 

Aparthotel Adagio Premium Dubai Al Barsha offers spacious serviced apartments with kitchens, laundry facilities, and free Wi-Fi. Enjoy an outdoor pool, fitness centre, dining venues, and a location just 2 minutes from InsuranceMarket Metro Station.

409665.description: There are a total of 44 rooms on the premises. This attractive hotel provides the ideal base for both sightseeing and business. The Hotel provides air-conditioning in public areas. The front desk offers 24-hour reception.There is a handy minimarket on the premises for any last-minute needs, quick snacks or forgotten toothbrushes. The Hotel provides a key collection service. The Hotel offers room service. There is a laundry service. The establishment is wheelchair-accessible. There is a gym on the premises for guest convenience. The Hotel provides a car hire service. There is an airport transfer service for guest convenience. The Hotel has helpful, multilingual staff available to help guests with any queries or service bookings.The Hotel has a bellboy service.

409823.address: Conference Centre Street, West Bay, P.O. Box 9282
409823.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of recreational amenities such as a 24-hour health club, an outdoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy local and international cuisine at Sridan, one of the hotel's five restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and eight meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 358 guest rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your memory foam bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment. Bathrooms feature separate bathtubs and showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. The hotel is located near the City Centre Shopping Mall, Doha Corniche, and several other attractions.

409868.description: The Lagune Barra Hotel is part of CINCO – Centro Integrado de Convenções – a modern complex within Riocentro, comprising the Convention Center, with 28 rooms, an Amphitheater and a Hotel. CINCO is the result of an innovative project by GL events that aims to offer high standard hospitality, comfort and modernity to its customers and visitors. Located in Barra da Tijuca, a few minutes from the Olympic Park, where Rock in Rio, the largest music festival in Brazil, and the Jeunesse Arena, where the main shows in the City of Rio de Janeiro take place. The hotel is close to shopping malls in the region and 5 minutes from Recreio beach.

409871.address: Av Lucio Costa 5210 Barra Da Tijuca
409871.description:
Regency Barra Hotel is less than a 15-minute drive from Recreio dos Bandeirantes Beach and Riocentro Convention Center. The restaurant is the perfect spot for when you're hungry, and after splashing around in the indoor pool, relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. 
This beachfront hotel in Rio de Janeiro features a restaurant and a poolside bar.

409969.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include a fireplace in the lobby and a banquet hall. Grab a bite to eat at Trademark Taste and Grind, a family restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in New York? This hotel has 1200 square feet (111 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 162 guestrooms featuring MP3 docking stations and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

410031.description: With a stay at W Bogota in Bogotá (Usaquén), you'll be a 4-minute walk from Hacienda Santa Barbara Mall and a 4-minute drive from 93 Park. This luxury hotel is 3 mi (4. 8 km) from Virrey Park and 3 mi (4. 9 km) from Andino Shopping Center. . Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a 24-hour health club, an indoor pool, and a steam room. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). . Make yourself at home in one of the 168 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations and flat-screen televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Wireless internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. . Enjoy international cuisine at Jairo, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. . Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service.

410032.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at the W Amsterdam, centrally located in the heart of Amsterdam's vibrant Nine Streets district, just a short walk from Dam Square. This luxury hotel boasts a full-service spa offering massages, body treatments, and facials, as well as a nightclub, health club, and inviting outdoor pool. Savor Mediterranean cuisine at THE DUCHESS, one of the hotel's five restaurants, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Multiple bars, including a poolside bar, offer refreshing drinks. Buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee). The 238 air-conditioned guest rooms feature minibars, flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and partially open bathrooms with designer toiletries. For added convenience, the hotel offers concierge services, a business center, and express check-in/check-out. Nearby attractions include the Royal Palace, Anne Frank House, and Amsterdam Museum.

410063.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul, the Elite Marmara Bosphorus & Suites offers convenient access to iconic landmarks. A short drive from the Bosphorus Bridge and Dolmabahçe Palace, this hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, 24-hour room service, and concierge services. Other amenities include a reception hall, express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry services, and free valet parking. The 16 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, LCD TVs with satellite programming, and private bathrooms with designer toiletries. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge.

410064.description: Located in the heart of the Historic Peninsula, Edibe Sultan Hotel is a 5-minute walk from Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace. It offers spacious Ottoman-style room and free WiFi throughout the premises. Sultanahmet Tram Station is 200 yards from the property. The elegantly decorated guestrooms of Hotel Edibe Sultan feature a minibar and complimentary tea and coffee making facilities. Each has a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and air conditioning. A laptop-size safety box is also provided. There is a bar on site offering refreshing drinks. Numerous dining options ranging from fast food to authentic Turkish cuisine can be found in the surrounding area. The staff, available 24 hours a day, offer concierge services and provides information about local attractions. Grand Bazaar is 800 yards away. Ataturk Airport is within 12. 4 miles and airport shuttle services are arranged at an additional fee. Fatih is a great choice for travellers interested in monuments, architecture and history. This is our guests' favourite part of İstanbul, according to independent reviews. This property also has one of the best-rated locations in İstanbul! Guests are happier about it compared to other properties in the area. Groups particularly like the location — they rated it 10 for stays with multiple people. This property is also rated for the best value in İstanbul! Guests are getting more for their money when compared to other properties in this city.

410340.address: 365 Derb Sidi Massoud Arset Ben Brahim Bab Doukkal
410340.description: The hotel is located in the heart of the medina of Marrakech, in a quiet alley, our guest house is five minutes walk from the Majorelle Gardens; fifteen minutes from the famous Jemaa el Fna square, twenty minutes from the Palais Badii and Bahia Palace. The entire Riad was furnished and decorated with great taste using all the knowledge of Moroccan artisans while incorporating modern décor and all equipment comfort of a high quality guest house. Riad Mounir offers you its 9 rooms.

410490.description: Located just steps from the town center, this 56-unit hotel offers easy access to local attractions and entertainment. Guests can enjoy convenient on-site parking and Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. The property also features a 24-hour reception and accessible accommodations for guests with disabilities. While cribs are not available, the hotel's proximity to transport links makes exploring the surrounding area easy, though the nearest beach, golf course, airport and harbor are some distance away.

410509.description: Offering a free breakfast and a restaurant, InterCity Teresópolis is located 140 meters from Teresópolis center. Provides free Wi-Fi in all areas. The rooms have contemporary decor, a flat-screen TV and air conditioning. They include a private bathroom with a hairdryer and free bath products. They have cable channels. The property also has a 24-hour reception, snack bar and meeting rooms. The laundry service is available at an additional cost. The hotel is 600 meters from Teresópolis bus station and 90 km from Galeão / Rio de Janeiro International Airport. Couples particularly like the location - they rated it 9. 3 for a trip for two.

410537.description: Featuring a large sun terrace, an outdoor pool, and a free buffet breakfast, the Upper Hotel is located 850 meters from Ana Rosa Metro Station and 1. 5 km from Ibirapuera Park. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The neatly decorated rooms feature tiled floors and wooden furnishings. All rooms offer air conditioning, an LCD TV with cable channels, a minibar, a wardrobe, and a private bathroom. Several restaurants and bars are within a 3-minute walk of the Upper Hotel. Avenida Paulista is 2 km away, and the MASP Museum of Art is 5. 7 km away. Congonhas Airport is 6. 2 km from the hotel. Vila Mariana is a great choice for travelers interested in parks, museums, and city trips.

410548.description: Located in the neighborhood of Partridges, downtown São Paulo, 3. 2 km from the Tietê River, the Bê Hotel stands out for being a modern hotel, small, unique and personalized service. The apartments at Bê Hotel stand out for their design and equipment. All apartments have TV LED 32 '' with cable channels, air conditioning with individual temperature control, safe, minibar, desk, automatic black-out curtains and hair dryers in the bathrooms. Breakfast is served from 6:30 am to 10:00 am (Monday to Friday) and from 7 am to 11:00 am on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. It has an independent parking, which is located 70 meters away on Monte Alegre St. In addition to its structure, Bê Hotel offers its guests a place for small meetings and events for up to 20 people.

410558.description: The Adagio SP Moema is the ideal aparthotel for those looking for a great location and high-quality services for short stays. It features rooms for up to 6 people, all equipped with a fitted kitchen and air conditioning, free WIFI, breakfast with homemade dishes, a restaurant serving international cuisine, bar, car park, automatic laundry facilities, fitness center and pool. It's now easier to get from the hotel to Congonhas Airport, with free transfers from Monday to Friday. Please book in advance.

410578.description: The DOM Barra Hotel is located in Barra da Tijuca, just steps from Parque Olímpico and close to the area's attractions and businesses. This 78-room hotel is convenient for both business and leisure travelers seeking quality and comfort. Enjoy free Wi-Fi, complimentary breakfast, an outdoor pool, a sauna, an on-site restaurant, and room service. On-site parking is available for a fee. Guest rooms feature air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, safes, minibars, electric kettles, work desks, and private bathrooms with showers, hairdryers, and toiletries.

410678.description: Located in Topkapi the Mercure Istanbul Topkapi Hotel is just 10 minutes from Ataturk International Airport. Close to the main attractions of the city such as Taksim, Old City and convention centers such as CNR Fair Ground, Halic Congress Venue, this Istanbul hotel is easily accessible via public transportation. Mercure Istanbul Topkapi hotel offers free WIFI for all guests. Different sized meeting rooms and ballrooms offer you the most successful events.

410679.description: Located 350 meters from Osmanbey Metro Station, this design hotel is just a 10-minute walk from Taksim Square and the fashionable Nişantaşı district. The Arts Hotel features aesthetic interior design, impeccable personalized customer service, and ultimate convenience for international business travelers. Designed by the Metex Design Group, led by Sinan Kafadar, the hotel showcases a timeless style. The main idea behind the Arts Hotel Istanbul is to break away from the modern, minimalist design commonly found in large hotel chains. It boasts a contemporary design that incorporates ingenious ideas and a sensuous color scheme. Transforming the typically rigid style of business hotels, the ultramodern design is both aesthetically inspiring and convenient.

410680.description: The 46 welcoming rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection throughout. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. Unfortunately, there are no units where guests can ask for a cot for the little ones. The Biancho Hotel Pera has wheelchair-accessible common areas. Parking facilities are available for guests' convenience. Everyone staying at this accommodation may relax and recharge their batteries at the health and wellness facilities. Guests can enjoy delightful dishes at the property's dining venue. The establishment's gastronomic option is sure to enchant visitors with refined cuisine and enchanting ambience.

410698.description: Evocative of a period nautical summer camp, Ruschmeyer's was originally built in 1952 on three lush acres of lakeside woodlands in Montauk, Long Island. The recently renovated cabin-inspired guestrooms circle a central lawn known as The Magic Garden, with picnic tables, hammocks, and grills designed for both organized and spontaneous leisure. Ruschmeyer's offers a range of activities from bicycling to fishing, ping-pong, paddle boarding and yoga, with lawn games and bubbles for the kids, along with a rotating series of musical performances, theater and artists-in-residence. The culinary team behind The Smile in Manhattan, serves seafood dishes with fresh local ingredients in the main restaurant and outdoors in the garden, while the Electric Eel delivers endless nights of dancing and classic maritime cocktails.

410739.address: Place Riad Laarouss Sidi Boumar Derb El Mezour, 41
410739.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this establishment. The property includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and accomodation units. Additionally, the premises provide a reception service the whole day through. Those who stay at this establishment can take advantage of the airport transfer service.

410778.address: Avenida Lucio Costa, Barra Da Tijuca, 5400
410778.description: The brand-new Windsor Marapendi Hotel sits directly in front of beautiful Barra da Tijuca Beach, offering easy access to all that this modern Rio de Janeiro district has to offer. Enjoy a fantastic stay admiring one of the best views in Rio at this 5-star property, which offers an array of entertainment options, delicious cuisine, and superb service. Nature abounds in the surrounding area, with parks and nature reserves providing ample opportunities for fun and outdoor activities. You'll also find a rich and diverse nightlife and some of Rio's most sophisticated shopping malls nearby. The hotel's elegant décor features extensive use of warm wood from reforested plantations throughout the lobby, bar, restaurant, and guest rooms. Its 487 beautifully furnished rooms offer full or partial ocean or mountain views. The rooftop, surrounded by glass railings, is the perfect place to enjoy stunning beach views and an unforgettable swim in the pool. The Windsor Marapendi caters to both vacationers and business travelers, with event facilities, spacious meeting rooms, and a business center. It is a great choice for an unforgettable family vacation or business trip in Rio de Janeiro.

410880.description:
Offering an outdoor pool and terrace, Bof Hotels Ceo Suites Atasehir is situated in Istanbul, 10 km from Bosphorus Bridge and 15 km from Fatih Sultan Mehmet Bridge. The hotel has a spa centre and sauna, and guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant. Free WiFi is available throughout the property and paid private parking is available on site. 

The elegantly decorated rooms of Bof Hotels Ceo Suites Ataşehir feature a 104 cm LCD Smart TV, high-speed internet and a minibar that you can fill according to your preferences at the checkpoint. Private bathrooms include slippers and free toiletries. 

Wi-Fi is free throughout the hotel. Guests can use private covered parking fee of charge

After a busy day, guests can relax at the spa centre, which includes a hammam and sauna. Guests can use the fitness center free of charge. 

You can start the day with breakfast at the restaurant or sip your coffee at Skyfall Cafe. Guests can taste different local delicacies throughout the day. 

Breakfast is served buffet-style. 

Each room at this hotel is air conditioned and features a flat-screen Smart TV with satellite channels. All suites have seating area and bathroom. Enjoy a cup of tea while looking out at the city. Every room is fitted with a private bathroom equipped with a shower. For your comfort, you will find bath robes, slippers and free toiletries. 

There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. 

Brandium Mall is 3. 5 km away while Palladium Shopping Mall and Buyaka and Meydan Shopping Mall are 5 km from the property. Optimum Outlet Shopping Mall is 6. 6 km and vibrant Kadikoy is 9. 2 km away. Akasya Shopping mall is located 10 km from Bof Hotels Ceo Suites Atasehir while Taksim Square is 20 km away. Cevahir Shopping Mall is 20 km while Istinye Park Shopping Mall is 24 km from the property. Ataturk Airport is 40 km away and Istanbul Airport is 67 km from the property. The nearest airport is Sabiha Gokcen Airport, 18 km from the hotel. The bus terminal is 1 km away.

410919.description: Riad Kenzo guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 7 units. Clients may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Riad Kenzo. All guests staying at this property are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception.

410920.description: This lovely hotel is a 20-minute drive from Altos de Chavón and 8. 1 miles from La Romana International Airport. It offers impeccable service and essential comforts for all travelers. Guests can enjoy delicious Dominican cuisine at the à la carte restaurant and relax in the adult and children's swimming pools. Create unforgettable memories with a stay at this beautiful property.

410938.description: Located directly in front of Leme Beach, the Arena Leme offers the ideal setting for those seeking comfort and convenience by the sea. Its facilities feature 164 guest rooms designed to provide an experience that moves at the city’s own rhythm. The hotel holds the international Green Key Brasil certification, the leading standard for environmental responsibility and sustainable tourism operations, reaffirming its commitment to the future. With a rooftop perfect for admiring the coastline views, the property is the ideal choice for guests looking for the peaceful atmosphere of the neighborhood while remaining just steps away from all the energy of Rio’s South Zone. With a unique identity dedicated to authentic Spanish haute cuisine, Otaviano Restaurant offers a true immersion into Spanish flavors through classics such as paellas, tapas, and traditional desserts prepared with Protected Designation of Origin (PDO) ingredients. The restaurant holds the international “Restaurants from Spain” certification granted by ICEX, ensuring a culinary experience that remains rigorously faithful to its roots. Ideal for meetings that require privacy and focus, the Pedro Leme Room offers an exclusive single-table setup accompanied by inspiring oceanfront views. For social gatherings and cocktail receptions, the spectacular terrace at Viva Rooftop takes center stage, providing guests with a breathtaking horizon. *Groups: We consider from 10 rooms. If we identify these reservations, even if separated, they will be subject to cancellation by the hotel, and application of different conditions. **The bar, pool, sauna and general area of the rooftop will be closed on December 31st due to preparations for the New Year's Eve party that will take place in the evening, access to which will be exclusive to guests who purchase a ticket for the rooftop party.

410978.description: Occupying the former warehouse and costume house of the German State Opera, this luxuriously appointed hotel reflects its historical past in the beautiful ballroom and spacious lobby area, decorated with columns. Next to Berlin's Gendarmenmarkt, this impressive building is centrally placed and affords easy access to this city's many attractions such as the Brandenburg Gate and Reichstag building, both are within walking distance. The guest rooms are modern and offer every comfort necessary for a relaxing stay, suitable for business and leisure travellers alike. Featuring a choice of leisure amenities, guests can enjoy a delicious meal in the onsite grill followed by a cocktail in the atmospheric bar. For those who enjoy a workout, the impressive gym is open from 6:30 AM to 10:00 PM.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Riyadh - Al Muroj Business Ga

411042.description: With a stay at DoubleTree by Hilton Riyadh - Al Muroj Business Gate, you'll be centrally located in Riyadh, within a 10-minute drive of Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center and Azizia Mall. This upscale hotel is 12 mi (19. 2 km) from Al Batha Market and 1. 7 mi (2. 8 km) from Riyadh Gallery Malik Fahad. Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include gift shops/newsstands and wedding services. Make yourself at home in one of the 223 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LED televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and premium TV channels provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Riyadh? This hotel has 3584 square feet (333 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

411200.description: Located in Gaia's historic heart, this charming hotel offers stunning views of the Douro River and is just steps from Sandeman Cellars and Espaço Porto Cruz. Housed in a beautifully renovated 19th-century building, the hotel features a chic, urban design, creating a warm, intimate atmosphere. Guests can access the four floors via a grand staircase. The seven light-filled rooms boast contemporary decor inspired by the Douro region, including a suite with a private terrace overlooking the river. Reception is open from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Please contact +351 223 752 362 or +351 963 313 911 to confirm your check-in time.

411219.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Complimentary Evening Social, Fitness Center, On-site Restaurant(s), Pool, Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Concierge, Executive Lounge, Valet Parking. Featuring a stunning industrial design of bronzed metal, glass and layered brick, Hilton London Bankside places guests near trendy South Bank, Tate Modern and Borough Market. This new hotel is a short walk to Bankside, home of foodie festivals, popular bars and restaurants, and street artists. Attend a play at National Theatre, visit The Shard for spectacular city views, and stroll to Tower Bridge to watch the London Marathon. This unique split-level hotel offers an ideal vantage for New Year's Eve fireworks and River Thames events. Corporate visitors will appreciate the quick walk to the Financial District. Relax in a guest room detailed with contemporary furnishings and original artwork. For your comfort, all guest rooms feature air-conditioning, complimentary WiFi, interactive LCD TVs and a work desk with ample outlets. Upgrade to an executive room for access to the tranquil Executive Lounge, including refreshments and business services. Enjoy steaks and seafood with an innovative twist at OXBO Bankside, perfect for power lunches and after-work dinners. Unwind with a cocktail and light bites in The Distillery, a nod to the hotel building's heritage. Maintain your exercise routine with the heated fitness pool and fully equipped fitness center. With 1, 000 sq. meters of event space, this Bankside hotel is ideal for conferences and celebrations of up to 750 guests. Lead a seminar in one of eight meeting rooms, or treat wedding guests to dancing and catered dining in an elegant Ballroom.

411258.description: Hotel Quinta da Cruz & SPA offers air-conditioned rooms with a private bathroom. It features an outdoor pool, sun terrace, a garden, restaurant and a bar. The individually decorated en suite rooms are equipped with a TV, a desk and some rooms have a terrace. Free wired internet is available. A continental breakfast buffet is served daily in the breakfast room or in the bedroom upon request. Guests can exercise in the fitness centre, sunbathe poolside or relax on the terrace overlooking the garden and pool. Hotel Quinta da Cruz has a spa & wellness centre and a billiards table. Indoors, there is a spacious lounge area with a piano and a TV.

411278.description: Newly refurbished hotel in Piraeus situated 7 minutes walking distance from the port where you can catch a ferry to one of the Greek islands . All rooms include a flat-screen TV and WIFI. Some rooms also have large balconies with views of the Acropolis. The hotel lobby includes a computer with internet access for customer use and there is an on-site bar available for drinks. The hotel is within walking distance from the metro station, where you can take a 20 minute ride on the subway to Athens to explore the Acropolis and visit many other sights. The hotel is easily accessed from Eleftherios Venizelos Airport by bus (the bus stop is 5 minutes walk from the hotel)

411378.description: Located within easy reach of public transport, Hacienda Cancun offers guests convenient access to the city's main attractions, while being just a short distance from the beach. The hotel's 45 guestrooms feature private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, electric kettles, and tea/coffee making facilities. Free self-parking and a 24-hour front desk are also available. Nearby attractions include Linlithgow Palace and Blackness Castle. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is conveniently located 13. 3 miles away.

417538.description:
Experience the vibrant energy of Brooklyn at this contemporary urban hotel, located just steps from the iconic Brooklyn Bridge. Discover nearby attractions including the Statue of Liberty, Barclays Center, and the trendy shops, restaurants, and art galleries of SoHo. Modern guest rooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, comfortable amenities, and stylish accommodations designed for both business and leisure travelers. 
Stay active in the fitness center, catch up on work in the business center, or relax with a coffee from the café. In the evening, enjoy cocktails on the terrace with stunning city views, mingle with friendly bartenders, and soak up Brooklyn's unique atmosphere. 

Amenity Fee Inclusions:
Daily wine hour from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM featuring two glasses of wine in the lobby (red and white)
Freshly popped popcorn available daily in the lobby
Access to the Neighborhood Passkey program
Seasonal bicycle usage (upon request and subject to availability)
Two complimentary bottles of water refreshed daily
High-speed premium Wi-Fi access

417778.description: The Antusa Palace Hotel & Spa offers a unique experience in the heart of Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district. Just steps from iconic landmarks like the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, and Topkapi Palace, this hotel provides the perfect base for exploration. Our 27 spacious rooms feature comfortable beds, tea and coffee making facilities, satellite TV, well-appointed bathrooms, and minibars. Enjoy a complimentary breakfast buffet and free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Indulge in our sauna and massage services. Our concierge is always available to assist you, whether you're traveling for business or leisure.

417798.description: You will quickly feel at home at ibis. Brussels offers a harmonious blend of history, culture and modernity. ibis Styles Brussels Centre Stéphanie is a modern hotel in the centre of Brussels. This hotel is ideally suited for both city breaks and long business stays because of its central location. Place Stéphanie, the Avenue Louise shopping area, the Royal Palace and several European Union institutions are all within walking distance.

417900.description: This charming guesthouse is located in Marrakech, just 5 kilometers from Marrakech Menara Airport, and within a short distance of attractions like the Bahia Palace, Koutoubia Mosque, and Le Jardin Secret. Guests enjoy a peaceful stay in cozy rooms equipped with Wi-Fi and private bathrooms. A 24-hour reception, on-site restaurant, and safe are available for added convenience. Each morning, a continental breakfast is served in the common areas.

417902.description: A total of 18 units are available for guests' convenience. Wi-Fi internet connection is available for further comfort and convenience. As this riad features 24-hour reception, guests are always welcome. Cots are not available at this establishment. Communal areas are wheelchair accessible at this riad. There is a car park. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

417919.description: The Citadel Hostel, housed in a beautifully renovated building in the heart of Madrid, offers modern comfort and convenience. Located on Mirror Street, near Plaza Mayor and the San Miguel Market, it provides easy access to the metro and bus lines. The spacious, non-smoking rooms feature wooden floors, heating, and air conditioning, ensuring a pleasant stay. While private parking is unavailable, the hostel's prime location puts Madrid's attractions within easy reach.

418038.description: Apartments located in the center of Madrid, 3 minutes' walk from the subway station Anton Martin offers accommodation with air conditioning, heating and free WiFi. The apartments and studios are equipped with flat-screen TV and kitchen with washing machine, stove and microwave. There are also kitchen utensils. All apartments have a private bathroom with hairdryer and free toiletries. Towels and linens are included. The apartments are centrally located, within walking distance of several bars and restaurants, as well as many attractions of Madrid. The Prado Museum is 10 minutes' walk and the Retiro Park, 1 km. Train station Puerta de Atocha is 13 minutes away. Madrid center is a great option for travelers interested in Nightlife, Tapas and Architecture.

418041.description: Roisa Centro Apartments are located a short 700-meter walk from Gran Via Avenue and just 150 meters from the San Bernardo metro station. This makes them an excellent choice for travelers, couples, or families eager to explore this vibrant city. All apartments and studios feature free Wi-Fi, air conditioning and heating, LED TVs, and spacious bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, towels, and hair dryers. You'll also find a fully equipped kitchen, complete with modern appliances like a hob, oven, microwave, mini-fridge, and cookware. Some apartments even boast a private balcony or terrace. For stays exceeding six days, a free weekly cleaning service is included, and additional cleaning is available upon request for a fee. The front desk is open from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Check-in is from 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM, with check-out by 11:00 AM. Late check-out is available until 1:00 PM for an extra charge of €20. Access is by code, so please contact Roisa Centro via email or phone before arrival. A security deposit of €200 is required upon arrival and is fully refundable upon check-out, pending a damage inspection. Children under two stay free in a cot (upon request and subject to management confirmation). Extra beds or cots are also available upon request. Smoking is not allowed, and parking is subject to availability for an additional fee. Pets are not permitted.

name.content: Armada Avenue Hotel (EX Armada Bluebay Hotel)

418078.address: Armada Tower 2, Jumeirah Lake Towers, Cluster P
418078.description: The hotel, established in 2014, overlooks Jumeirah Lake and the Dubai Marina, near the exclusive Emirates Hills development. A short drive from Dubai Marina Mall and The Walk, with the nearest station being DAMAC Properties (JLT) tram stop, it offers convenient access to key attractions. Dubai International Airport is 35km away. Each comfortable guest room features air conditioning, ironing facilities, a safe, minibar, coffee/tea making facilities, a TV, telephone, and hairdryer. The hotel also boasts a coffee shop, outdoor swimming pool, and fitness center. Guests can enjoy diving in Dubai's waters or explore the desert by camel.

418198.address: Sheik Zayed Road,Al Barsha1, Near Mall Of Emirates
418198.description: Located in Al Barsha, Flora Al Barsha Hotel offers a great base for exploring Dubai. The hotel features a wide range of facilities, including a fitness center, sauna, outdoor pool, spa, and massage services, to ensure a pleasant stay. Select guest rooms are equipped with LCD/plasma TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and wake-up service. After a day of sightseeing, relax in the comfort of your room or take advantage of the hotel's recreational facilities. Experience a welcoming atmosphere and excellent service at Flora Al Barsha Hotel.

name.content: Ramada Hotel & Suites by  Istanbul Merter

418418.description: Located in Istanbul's bustling Merter district, the Ramada Hotel and Suites Istanbul Merter caters to both business and leisure travelers. A short tram ride connects guests to the World Trade Center, CNR Congress and Exhibition Center, and attractions like Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque. The hotel offers a business center, fitness center, indoor heated pool, and restaurants serving international cuisine. Meeting rooms can accommodate up to 1, 000 people, and guest rooms feature high-speed internet, work desks, and flat-screen HDTVs.

name.content: The Westin Doha Hotel & Spa, Doha

418438.address: Salwa Road, Bin Mahmoud South Zone 23, NA
418438.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 spa tubs, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Grab a bite at Hunters Room and Grill, one of the hotel's 5 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Doha? This hotel has 27480 square feet (2553 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 12 meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 364 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LED televisions.

418658.description: Situated near major highways and the historic Congress district, this luxury hotel offers comfortable, brightly lit rooms decorated in a classic style with modern accents. Each room features heating and air conditioning, a minibar, a TV, and a private bathroom with a shower. For corporate meetings and conferences, the hotel provides two specially equipped meeting rooms.

418678.address: Prince Mohammed Bin Abdul Aziz Street, 0
418678.description:
Spectrums Tahlia Jeddah is next to the Bin Homran Business Center on the famous Tahlia Street and Madina Road. Closed to New Tahlia Center with many coffee shops like Breaktime and restaurants like Malaysian delights Shick Shake PF Cheng offering International food and closed to the main fashion shops. 418761.description: These serviced apartments are centrally located in Edinburgh, with convenient public transport connections and popular destinations like Princess Street just two minutes away. Each apartment features a spacious open-plan lounge/dining area with a fully fitted luxury kitchen, a bathroom with a shower, and a comfortable bedroom. With studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom options available, there's an ideal choice for business travelers, families, or groups of friends. Check-in is available from 8:30 am to 7:00 pm, Monday to Friday, and 10:30 am to 7:00 pm on Saturday. Reception is closed on Sunday. For arrivals outside these hours, please contact The Spires reception. A £250 security deposit is required before arrival via our secure online payment portal. 418878.description: Built in 2014, this attractive hotel offers 52 suites, providing an ideal base for both leisure and business travelers. A 24-hour reception and lift access are available for added convenience. Guests can utilize the on-site minimarket, laundry service, and medical services. A gym and airport transfer service are also provided for guest convenience. The hotel ensures 24-hour security.

name.content: ibis Styles Edinburgh St Andrew Square

419098.description: From the extensive continental breakfast spread each morning and 24-hour snack service, to the ever-cheery welcome at our on-site bar and restaurant, we work hard to make sure bellies are full and hearts are happy from sunup until well after sundown. And tucked away as we are in one of the prettiest districts of Edinburgh, your trip to this captivating Celtic charmer of a city is off to a braw start!

419118.description: Located in the fashionable Palermo neighbourhood of Buenos Aires, this art-themed hostel occupies a historic building. It offers a social atmosphere while providing the privacy of 18 individual rooms, each decorated with a unique mural and featuring a private bathroom, air conditioning, and a television. Guests have access to complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the property, a shared kitchen for preparing meals, and a sun terrace. The property is well-positioned for exploring the city, situated a 5-minute walk from Plaza Italia Station and a 12-minute walk from the lively Plaza Serrano Square. An airport shuttle service is also available for an additional fee.

419378.address: Corner Long, Unity and Graham Street
419378.description: The Russel Hotel is situated along the beautiful Garden Route, in the world-famous town of Knysna. Just two blocks from the N2, on Long Street, you'll find our charming 18-room hotel. Beautifully decorated, air-conditioned rooms await leisure and business travelers alike. All rooms feature en-suite bathrooms, coffee and tea making facilities, and a selection of DSTV channels. A scrumptious breakfast, prepared with fresh ingredients, is served in our dining area. Here, you can also unwind with a refreshing drink from our small cash bar. Shopping is easy, with all amenities within walking distance.

419500.description: Located in the vibrant Recoleta district of Santiago, Hotel Sonetto offers guests a convenient and enjoyable stay. A welcoming bar and restaurant provide a pleasant atmosphere and delicious cuisine, perfect for unwinding after a day exploring the city. With easy access to key attractions, including the Bellas Artes metro station and the Museum of Contemporary Art, just 300 meters away, Hotel Sonetto is an ideal base for experiencing Santiago.

419620.description: Located a short stroll from the town center, Golden Ak Marmara Hotel offers convenient access to local attractions and transport links. The hotel is 32 km from the airport and 2. 5 km from the harbor. Its 47 cozy rooms all include Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy on-site dining and event spaces suitable for business meetings or special occasions. Accessible rooms and parking are also available. An airport transfer service is offered for an additional fee.

419658.description: Located in the Avenidas Novas neighborhood in Lisbon, 1. 1 km from Liberty Avenue, TURIM Saldanha Hotel features free WiFi access and private parking. Guests can enjoy the on-site bar. Every room comes with a flat-screen TV. The rooms come with a private bathroom equipped with a bathtub and bathtub or shower. For your comfort, you will find free toiletries and a hairdryer. A TV with satellite channels is available. There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. Amoreiras is one kilometer from TURIM Saldanha Hotel, and Rossio is 2. 3 km from the property. The nearest airport is Portela Airport, 4 km from the property. Avenidas Novas is a great choice for travelers interested in gourmet food, monuments and city trip.

419738.description: Located just 200 meters from Piracicaba Comercial Center, I-hotel offers convenient access to the Unimed Piracicaba Hospital and boasts event facilities and free Wi-Fi. The simply furnished yet comfortable rooms feature tiled floors, air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, a minibar, a desk, a wardrobe, and a private bathroom. A variety of restaurants are within a 2-minute walk. The Municipal Theater and Principal Cathedral are also 200 meters away, while the Piracicaba Bus Station and city center are 500 meters from the hotel. Viracopos International Airport is 100 km away. Couples have rated the hotel 8. 5 for a two-person trip, praising its convenient location.

419758.description: Lalahan Hotel was constructed in 2015 and the hotel was completely renovated in 2015. The property consists of 18 rooms. The property consists of 4 triple rooms, 16 superior rooms and 1 family room. There is air-conditioning in public areas. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. There is a currency exchange on the premises. Lift access is available to guests for added convenience. Guests can take advantage of room service to enjoy breakfast in bed. There is a laundry service. There is a babysitting service upon request for guest convenience. Guests will appreciate the convenience of the onsite car hire service. Guests can take advantage of the airport transfer service (extra charge).

419818.description: This establishment is a brand new boutique hostel, with architecture signed by the renowned architect Hélio Pellegrino, located in the heart of Lapa. It is situated in the central region of Rio, in the heart of Lapa and its neighbors the main bars and restaurants. With several works around the hotel, the property exudes art everywhere. It is also a few meters away from the more traditional concert halls of Rio and the subway, making it possible walks around the historic center. This establishment was built meeting the international quality standards and our team consists of professionals trained and ready to make your stay memorable. The hotel offers services that seek to make life easier for the guests: Breakfast included in all daily, concierge expert, free wi-fi throughout the hotel, Transfer reservation and tours.

419939.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an outdoor pool, and an indoor pool. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 112 air-conditioned rooms featuring free minibar items and LED televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment.

419978.description: Ashby Manor Guest House is located in Fresnaye, Sea Point, Cape Town. It is a short walk to the closest shopping and situated on the My City Buss route. Only a couple of minutes drive from Camps Bay and the Waterfront this guest house is a historic building with wooden floors and some of the rooms offer an ocean view. With free wifi and breakfast included in the rate this is ideal for travellers visiting Cape Town.

420378.description: Situated in Taksim, the heart of Istanbul, our hotel seamlessly blends contemporary and Ottoman architecture, featuring natural stone accents. We're dedicated to providing exceptional service and a comfortable, quality stay with a strong focus on your well-being. Experience unparalleled hospitality and meticulous attention to detail throughout your visit. Our hotel's unique design and inviting ambiance promise an unforgettable Istanbul experience.

420679.address: 49 Rue Oued El Kebir Sidi Abbad 3
420679.description: This charming riad is conveniently located a 15-minute drive from Jemaa el-Fna square and just five minutes from the serene Majorelle Garden. It offers air-conditioned accommodations with complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Each room features a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower. Guests can enjoy the riad's refreshing plunge pool and terrace. Public parking is available nearby. The riad is also close to other attractions, including Bahia Palace (5 km) and the conference center (4 km). Guided tours can be arranged on-site, and an airport shuttle is available to Marrakech-Menara Airport (6 km).

420719.description: This 4-star hotel features comfortable elegantly decorated rooms in the center of Buenos Aires, near Florida Street and Plaza San Martin . Every morning the hotel offers a buffet breakfast. Dora Hotel rooms have flat- screen TV, minibar, desk, telephone, free WiFi, central air conditioning, safe and private bathroom with tub and hairdryer. Dora Hotel has a 24-hour reception, providing tourist information and luggage storage and a 24 -hour bar. Meeting facilities, parking, laundry and shuttle services are offered.

420818.address: Rua São João No. 1530 Bairro Alto
420818.description: Ideally located near Piracicaba's main square, this hotel is perfect for business and leisure travelers. It's just a short walk from the Municipal Theatre, Municipal Market, bus station, and various shops and restaurants. The hotel offers meeting and event facilities, a complimentary buffet breakfast, a 24-hour front desk, free Wi-Fi, and free private parking. The comfortable rooms feature tiled floors, air conditioning, and flat-screen TVs with cable channels. Viracopos International Airport is 100 km away.

420880.description: This popular guesthouse is an ideal base for exploring Marrakech. Located in the heart of the Medina, this riad offers free Wi-Fi and features a restaurant, terrace, and communal kitchen. Each room includes air conditioning, a private terrace, and a bathroom with a shower, hairdryer, and bathrobes. Guests also have access to a shared living room. The riad is conveniently located near popular attractions such as Bahia Palace (700m), the Museum of Marrakech (1km), and Ben Youssef Madrasa (1km). Marrakech-Menara Airport is 6km away. This location is perfect for travelers interested in souks, shopping, and exploring local markets.

name.content: Hello Lisbon Marques de Pombal Apartments

420938.description: The Hello Lisbon Marques de Pombal is located at comercial and business area of Lisbon. Only 5km to airport and 2 of city centre. They all have a bedroom area, kitchenette fully equipped and a private bathroom with a shower or a bath. Free wifi and parking.

name.content: Anselmo Buenos Aires, Curio A Collection by Hilton

421118.description: Qualified Non-Argentinian residents will be exempt of VAT (21%) *Conditions Apply. The unique Buenos Aires, Curio Collection by Hilton boasts an ideal location in front of the famous Plaza Dorrego: a colorful, dynamic square in the epicenter of the historical neighborhood of San Telmo. We are just steps from cafes, bars, shops and antique stores, and are within 10 blocks of lots of businesses and corporate offices. In addition, we are less than five minutes’ walk from the government district. Featuring an elegant exterior that reflects the area’s traditional architecture and blends beautifully with San Telmo’s attractive, cobblestoned streets: our hotel’s open and modern interior provides a wonderful visual contrast. Feel welcome the moment you step into the airy, light-filled lobby, where our friendly, professional staff will be happy to check you in to one of our stylish guest rooms. Elegant, modern décor meets homelike comfort in our comfortable guest rooms and suites. Warm wood flooring, beautiful floor-to-ceiling windows and a striking lamp – each one unique to every room, and a piece of art in itself – make each of our rooms restful and inviting. Enjoy contemporary amenities including complimentary WiFi, a 42-inch HDTV and a mini-bar. Dine on international dishes, expertly prepared using only the freshest local produce in our restaurant, Café Anselmo. Maintaining your exercise routine is easy at this Buenos Aires hotel – our compact fitness center is well-equipped with state-of-the-art cardio, resistance and weights technology. Our modern meeting room is ideal for corporate events, training afternoons and interview sessions for up to 100 people.

421198.description: Relax in this stylish hotel with a seasonal outdoor pool and rooftop terrace offering stunning city views. Each of the 162 guestrooms offers comfort and convenience, featuring iPod docking stations, minibars, memory foam beds with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Entertainment includes a 32-inch Smart TV with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected. Private bathrooms include rainfall showers and designer toiletries. Located near Plaza de España - Princesa, Gran Via, and Teatro Coliseum, with easy access to Madrid's vibrant cultural attractions.

421238.description: The Pacific Hotel and Suites, a 2-star hotel in Salolo, Agbado Ijaiye, Lagos, is conveniently located near the Salolo bus stop, a 20-minute drive from Murtala Muhammed International Airport and 15 minutes from the domestic airport. Stylishly furnished, the hotel offers a conference hall, gym, and a range of rooms from standard to executive suites. Its central location provides easy access to major roads and shopping malls like Justrite. The dedicated staff includes professional chefs and cooks. As a complimentary service, the hotel provides airport pick-up and drop-off for guests.

421259.description: Described by the New York Times as 'the most handsome inn in the world' the Feathers Hotel is one of Ludlow's most popular attractions. Set in a magnificent timber-framed building in the centre of picturesque Ludlow, 300 metres from Ludlow Castle and a 10-minute walk from the River Teme. The Feathers Hotel offers free car parking with limited spaces and free WiFi. Rooms at The Feathers Hotel Ludlow are elegantly decorated, and each has a private bathroom. All rooms have a hairdryer, flat-screen TV with a DVD player, and tea/coffee facilities. Room service is also available. The award-winning Feathers Restaurant serves a modern British menu using fresh, locally sourced produce. The Feathers Bar offers real ales, fine wines and afternoon tea/coffee.
