Guests can enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour health club, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. The 64 guestrooms feature refrigerators, LED TVs, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Osaki Restaurant offers Asian cuisine for lunch and dinner, and a coffee shop/cafe is also available. Guests can unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge, and buffet breakfast is served daily for a fee. Event planning is facilitated by 1227 square feet of conference and meeting space.

421767.address: Gran Via De Les Corts Catalanes, 670
421767.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages or enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center. Additional amenities at this Colonial hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, Batuart, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Make yourself at home in one of the 83 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks.

421770.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and a fireplace in the lobby. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of MOXY Milan Malpensa Airport. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 162 guestrooms featuring Smart televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include desks, housekeeping is provided daily, and irons/ironing boards can be requested. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Volandia Museum of Flight - 3. 3 km / 2 mi- Ticino Valley Nature Park - 4 km / 2.

421771.description: Located in the heart of Miraflores, the upscale Courtyard by Marriott Lima Miraflores is steps from Larco Avenue and a short walk from Miraflores Central Park. This hotel offers a variety of amenities, including a 24-hour health club, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. The 149 air-conditioned rooms feature iPod docking stations, LED TVs, and DVD players with satellite programming. Guests can enjoy international cuisine at the Bistro restaurant, or grab a coffee and a light meal at the cafe. Additional amenities include a business center, valet parking, and dry cleaning services.

421818.description:
Luna Arcos Hotel Nature & Wellness offers accommodation in Arcos de Valdevez, located within the Peneda-Gerês National Park, a UNESCO World Biosphere Reserve. The hotel features a spa, an indoor swimming pool, and free Wi-Fi access. 
The hotel comprises 3 suites, 5 junior suites, and 67 standard rooms. All rooms are air-conditioned and equipped with a flat-screen cable TV, minibar, and a private bathroom with a hairdryer and complimentary toiletries. Some units also include a seating area and views of the mountains or the pool. 
The “Foral de Valdevez” Restaurant serves a buffet breakfast, as well as à la carte or buffet-style lunches and dinners featuring Portuguese and Atlantic cuisine. Guests can also enjoy a bar and a lounge area with a television, ideal for relaxing. 
The Nature Spa features a water circuit that includes an indoor swimming pool, hot tub, sauna, and Turkish bath. It also offers two separate treatment rooms for massages and individual therapies, a relaxation room, and a cardio-fitness area. 
The property has a 24-hour reception, and guests can take part in various nearby activities, including horse riding, canoeing, cycling, and hiking. 
Vigo is 49 km from Arcos Hotel Nature Spa, while Braga is 33 km away. Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is located 71 km from the property.

name.content: Dar Les Cigognes By Sanssouci Collection

422098.description: Dar Les Cigognes - A luxurious boutique hotel of unique charmRefined elegance in the heart of historic MarrakechThe supremely well located Dar Les Cigognes faces the gates of the Royal Palace in the heart of the historic medina. With most of the major sites just steps from our front door, the bustle of the souks and adjacent Place des Ferblantiers, Dar Les Cigognes is a convenient base for a visit to Marrakech. As one of the very few riad hotels located on a street, Dar Les Cigognes offers guests the additional ease of being able to come and go by car. With just 11 rooms and suites, restaurant, spa, hammam, concierge team, rooftop gardens, and award-winning cooking school, it is an ideal base from which to explore Marrakech.

422178.description: Offering a restaurant, Riad is located in Marrakech. Free Wi-Fi access is available. Rooms here will provide you with a flat-screen TV, air conditioning and a patio. Featuring a shower, private bathrooms also come with a bath. Extras include a seating area and satellite channels. At Riad you will find a 24-hour front desk and a terrace. Other facilities offered include a shared lounge and a tour desk. The riad is 1. 4 km from Bahia Palace, 1. 8 km from Conference Palace and 1. 6 km from Majorelle Gardens. Menara Airport is 4 km away. Medina is a great choice for travellers interested in souks, shopping and markets.

422179.description: Once the Harem of the “Favourite” of Morocco's Sultan Moulay Yacoub, Riad Kaïss is one of Marrakech's longest established and most elegant riad hotels. Located just steps from the UNESCO world heritage site Djema el Fna, the pulsing heart of this magical city, Riad Kaiss is supremely well-located for the sites and sounds of Marrakech. On a quiet side street, the hotel offers guests a tranquil setting from which to explore this amazing Moroccan city. With just 9 rooms and suites, hammam, spa, boutique, swimming pool, a majestic courtyard garden, sun terraces, a range of services including cooking classes, full-service restaurant, private driver, personal shoppers and guides, and with parking nearby, Riad Kaïss is a perfect base to enjoy the best of what Marrakech has to offer. Originally designed and built by legendary French hotel designer Christian Ferre, the hotel has been featured in design magazines and books all over the world, including the Hip Hotel series. Service, however, never takes a back seat to design. Under new management as of October 2009 by the award-winning team from Dar Les Cigognes and The Sanssouci Collection the hotel continues to provide guests a welcoming introduction to Marrakech. The rooms at Riad Kaïss have all been designed with a maximum of guest comfort in mind, and each is uniquely decorated and showing its own character. There are three categories of rooms: Superior, Deluxe, and Suites. All rooms have independent climate control, high quality bed linens, and ensuite bathroom facilities. Please visit the gallery to see images of individual rooms. Some rooms may be twinned, ideal for those traveling together.

422280.description: Offering a seasonal outdoor pool and children's playground, Hotel Boavista II is located in Melgaço in the Norte Region. There is a restaurant and guests can have fun at the games room. Free WiFi is provided throughout the property and free private parking is available on site. Every room at this hotel is air conditioned and features a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Each room is equipped with a private bathroom with a bath or shower and bidet, with free toiletries provided. There is a shared lounge, room service, luggage storage space and hairdresser's at the property. Bike hire is available at this hotel and the area is popular for canoeing and hiking. Vigo is 24 mi from Hotel Boavista II, while Ourense is 27 mi from the property.

422302.address: R. Martinho De Mesquita, 129 - Barra Da Tijuca
422302.description: Windsor Oceanico is located in the sophisticated Barra da Tijuca, a short walk from the beach. Day or night, this 4- star hotel offer a lot of fun, entertainment, delicious cuisine and impeccable service. The neighborhood offers various activities for entertainment, like Shopping centers and natural parks. Enjoy the entire length of the beach: Surfing, bodyboarding and stand up paddle are popular sports here. For business travelers, Windsor Oceanico is equipped with a complete structure for conventions and conferences with modern and spacious meeting rooms. The Windsor Oceanico is connected to the Windsor Barra Hotel, which already has a mega structure for events, by a climatized walkway. It will be the largest integrated convention center in Rio de Janeiro.

422838.description: This Rio de Janeiro hotel offers comfortable accommodations ideal for both business travelers and vacationers. Located just steps from Santos Dumont Airport and 900 meters from Baía de Guanabara, the hotel features an on-site restaurant serving delicious meals, perfect for unwinding after a day exploring the city. The General Consulate of Germany is 3. 1 km away. Each room is well-appointed with amenities to ensure a pleasant stay for the whole family.

423141.description: This fully-renovated 3-star hotel is located in Geneva city centre, just a few steps from the main train station. Lake Geneva, the old town and many other sights and attractions are within a few minutes' walk of the hotel. All rates at the VISION APARTMENTS include an all-you-can-eat buffet breakfast and unlimited Wi-Fi access.

name.content: Hotel Riu Plaza New York Times Square

423218.description: The Riu Plaza New York Times Square offers a comfortable stay for both business and leisure travelers. Located in the heart of Times Square, this hotel provides a 24-hour front desk, accessible facilities, luggage storage, family rooms, and car hire services. Guest rooms feature amenities such as LCD/plasma screen televisions, air conditioning, heating, wake-up service, and blackout curtains. Guests can also enjoy access to the hotel's fitness center. The Riu Plaza New York Times Square is an excellent choice for experiencing the best of New York City.

423278.address: Abu Baker Al Suiddiqui Road, Deira, 999
423278.description: With a stay at Hilton Garden Inn Dubai Al Muraqabat, you'll be centrally located in Dubai, within a 5-minute drive of Al Ghurair Centre and City Centre Deira. This upscale hotel is 3. 8 mi (6. 1 km) from Gold Souk and 5. 2 mi (8. 4 km) from Dubai World Trade Centre. Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an outdoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. The complimentary shuttle will take you to the nearby beach or shopping center. Make yourself at home in one of the 179 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and premium TV channels provides entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Garden Grille Restaurant, a restaurant which specializes in international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 1929 square feet (179 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 3 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Deira Clocktower - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Al Ghurair Centre - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- City Centre Deira - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Fish Roundabout - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Stargate Dubai - 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Burj Nahar Mall - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Deira Twin Towers Shopping Centre - 2. 8 km / 1. 7 mi- Naif Souq - 3. 4 km / 2. 1 mi- Dubai Tennis Stadium - 3. 7 km / 2.

423279.address: Al Mina Road, Port Rashid, S/N
423279.description: The Hilton Garden Inn Dubai Al Mina, located near Bur Dubai, La Mer Beach, Sheikh Zayed Road, and Port Rashid, offers easy access to Dubai's main tourist attractions, including the Dubai World Trade Centre, Dubai Convention Centre, and Downtown. Explore the alleyways of the Gold and Textile Souks or the Heritage Village to discover Dubai's arts, customs, and architecture. Visit the historic Grand Mosque with the city's tallest minaret, situated on the Bur Dubai side of the Creek near the Ruler's Court. The hotel offers 181 stylish and spacious guest rooms and suites. All rooms feature ergonomic chairs, Wi-Fi, a safety deposit box, a minibar, and an iron with an ironing board. Two meeting rooms are available, equipped to accommodate approximately 130 conference guests or 100 banquet guests. Guests can enjoy 24-hour room service, a Pavilion Pantry stocked with snacks and ready-to-cook meals, a heated rooftop pool, a 24-hour fitness center, and a complimentary self-service laundry. The on-site Garden Grille Restaurant & Bar offers a casual ambiance, serving modern international cuisine and an excellent selection of beverages. The stylish Garden Bar is perfect for snacks and evening cocktails. A complimentary shuttle bus to La Mer Beach and Dubai Mall is also provided.

423298.description: Nestled in a half- hectare pine grove, the historic Hotel Kastri in the northern Athenian suburb of Nea Erythraia started operating in the late 19th century and quickly acquired a reputation as a gathering spot of the Athenian elite. The fully renovated Domotel Kastri opened its doors on October 2015 as a boutique business hotel, retaining its original architectural style but featuring a contemporary approach to luxury lodging. The hotel's Convention Center houses a state-of-the-art auditorium with capacity of 210 people and 22 multifunctional halls and meeting rooms all with cutting edge technical equipment. That- combined with its 86 deluxe rooms, 2 restaurants and a fitness room- characterizes Domotel Kastri as an extensive venue, flexibly designed to meet a variety of functions. Immerse yourself in a superior hospitality experience! At a comfortable distance from the city centre and away from thecrowds, this urban hotel features its own private, small forest, accentuating the concepts of outdoor leisure activities and loungecafé. Events can take place either in the abundantly inviting outer spaces or in an array of smartly decorated interiors; the option of parking, even for buses, as well as the provision of car services makes this hotel the perfect place to converge. Domotel Kastri is ideal for business with its super-fast Wi-Fi internet access, as well as the presence of a large desk in each room, and accommodations for guests with disabilities are also available.

423338.description: The Helmet Hotel in Brussels offers free WiFi throughout the property and a 7th-floor terrace with views of the Atomium. Rooms feature flat-screen TVs with international channels, coffee/tea making facilities, and large windows. Bathrooms include free toiletries, a hairdryer, and a rain shower. The hotel is conveniently located directly in front of a metro stop, offering easy access to attractions like Manneken Pis, Grand Place (Brussels Central Square), and the European Union buildings, all within 1. 9 miles. Brussels North Train Station, with connections to Brussels National Airport (5. 6 miles away), is just 1640 feet from the hotel. Rogier Square is 2953 feet away, and Tour & Taxis is 0. 7 miles away.

423662.description: Located in Marrakech (Medina), Riad Dar Anika is within a 10-minute walk of Jemaa el-Fnaa and Bahia Palace. This 5-star riad is 0. 4 mi (0. 7 km) from Royal Palace and 2. 2 mi (3. 6 km) from Marrakech Plaza. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages and facials. This riad also features complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting/childcare (surcharge). Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Grab a bite to eat at the riad's restaurant, where you can take in the pool view, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 12 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars (stocked with some free items). Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and complimentary bottled water, and housekeeping is provided daily.

423884.description: Located just off I-95 and NJ-3, Super 8 by Wyndham Meadowlands offers free Wi-Fi, parking, and a 24/7 beverage station. Catch a Giants or Jets game at MetLife Stadium, try your luck at Meadowlands Racing & Entertainment, or discover fantastic shopping and attractions like Big SNOW, Nickelodeon Universe, and DreamWorks Water Park at American Dream. Nearby, explore iconic New York City landmarks such as Central Park and Times Square. For travelers flying in, we are conveniently located 14 miles from Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) and 20 miles from LaGuardia Airport (LGA).

423919.description: JUFA Wien City Hotel greets its guests in the heart of Simmering. Located not far from the city center you will find yet another JUFA family hotel, guaranteeing high quality at top prices. JUFA Wien City – your family-friendly hotel in Vienna. The JUFA Hotel in Vienna is surrounded by historical buildings. This history-rich backdrop was once owned by Mautner Markhof , a time-honored business with deep traditional roots. The closest underground station (U3 line, Enkplatz – take the Grillgasse exit) is barely 400 m from your family hotel in Vienna, and will bring you to the very heart of downtown Vienna city!

424818.description: Cinelandia is one of new developments of Buenas Hotels. Its name is a tribute to the area that housed, between the years 1931 and 1960, the major movie theaters of the cultural circuit in São Paulo. The hotel occupies the same area of the renowned Cine Brodway, which was demolished to make way for the current building, designed by renowned architect Ramos de Azevedo, creator of several postcards in the capital. Believing in the potential of recovery and in that nostalgic ambience of appreciation for the  the downtown area history, the building was completely renovated in 2010, keeping its original classical façade, to offer its guests all the comfort, quality and convenience – for the fairest prices practiced in the area. With 84 apartments, Cinelandia has its privileged location as one of its key features, based just a short walk away from avenues Ipiranga and São João, the shopping hub of 25 de Março, the Monastery of St. Benedict and the traditional Bar Brahma and Gallery of Rock.

424819.description: Hotel América do Sul offers accommodations in São Paulo, 800 meters from República Metro Station. Downtown São Paulo and Júlio Prestes Train Station are both 700 meters from the hotel. Congonhas Airport, the nearest airport, is 10 km away. On-site paid parking is available. Each room includes a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom. Guests can also benefit from a 24-hour front desk.

424838.address: Tosmur Mah. Ahmet Tokus cad. 7, Oba mevkii, 1
424838.description: This adult-only (16+), non-smoking hotel in Alanya-Oba offers a stylish blend of sun, sea, and modern architecture, infused with Turkish hospitality. Located a mere 30 km from Gazipasa-Alanya Airport and 130 km from Antalya Airport, it's conveniently situated near Alanya city center (5 km) and just 500 m from Oba's vibrant heart. The hotel features 164 contemporary rooms, each equipped with two single beds, a sofa bed, a safe, air conditioning, a kettle, LED satellite TV, and a bathroom with a rain shower. Guests can enjoy a well-equipped gym and luxurious spa and hammam offering a range of relaxing treatments. The buffet restaurant, boasting panoramic sea views, serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Direct beach access is provided via a convenient underpass. Please note that pets are not permitted.

425038.description: It is located in the beautiful town of Somerset West and perfect for the discerning guest who values privacy, comfort and hospitality. Home away from home, the guesthouse is situated 5 minutes from the Strand beach, 20 minutes from Cape Town international Airport and 40 minutes from Cape Town Waterfront. We are also very close to Stellenbosch and various wine routes. It provides the perfect setting for an unforgettable holiday in the heart of the Cape Winelands on a beautiful property that covers more than 5 300 m². The guesthouse offers ten spacious luxury rooms, all with en suite bathrooms, as well as two self-catering cottages. Some rooms have a view of the ocean and the countryside and others of the lush garden and swimming pool. Guest can enjoy a relaxing drink on the deck with panoramic views or relax and take advantage of the South African sun at our sparkling swimming pool.

425078.address: Behind The Mall of the Emirates, Al Barsha, 1
425078.description: Located in Al Barsha 1, conveniently behind the Mall of the Emirates and near Lulu Hypermarket, this hotel offers spacious one and two-bedroom apartments. Just 300 meters from Sharaf DG Metro Station, providing easy access to Rashidiya and Dubai International Airport (24km), each apartment is thoughtfully appointed with amenities to ensure a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

425338.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages and facials. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, The Clocktower, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in New York? This hotel has 2100 square feet (195 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 5 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 271 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters.

425401.description: At the foot of the Koutoubia Mosque and just a five-minute walk from Jemaa el-Fna square, the Villa des Orangers offers an exceptional location for exploring the medina. This intimate haven of peace boasts 30 rooms and suites arranged on two levels around three verdant open-air patios. Each patio features water fountains and galleries of chiseled plaster, creating a tranquil garden atmosphere. Guests can enjoy three swimming pools: a rooftop pool (5x7 meters) with stunning views of the Koutoubia Mosque and Atlas Mountains; a heated 16-meter pool in a 450 m² garden; and a 5-meter pool in a private riad with two suites and a solarium. The hotel also offers three lounges with fireplaces, three dining rooms, three massage cabins, a traditional Moroccan hammam, a beauty center, a fitness club, a bar, a movie theater, and a boutique. Free Wi-Fi is available.

425407.address: First Settlement New Cairo Eastern Ring Road
425407.description: Welcome to Kempinski Palace Cairo, a distinguished destination in the heart of New Cairo and the ideal getaway for both business and leisure guests. Our 5-star luxury hotel in Cairo embraces a haven of serenity, featuring the finest facilities coupled with the highest levels of services. The hotel is uniquely located minutes away from the newly business and commercial districts in the area, where we ensure you bask in a marvelous experience worth a lifetime. Accompanied by the world-class European Resense Spa, the property holds 245 rooms and suites, presenting elegant fittings and furnishings with overwhelming views suitable for every taste. Upgrading your stay, visit one of our 8 exceptional restaurants and bars, and treat yourself to a blissful culinary experience all around the world in one place. The unparalleled architecture of the landmark extends to our dedicated banquet floor, including 11 customisable meeting spaces and the largest ballroom in Cairo. Kempinski White Glove Services has been implemented to ensure a healthy and safe environment for all our guests and employees worldwide, at all times.

425439.address: Al Reem Street 19, Al Rayyan Road
425439.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy a meal at Al Maha Restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Doha? This hotel has 4176 square feet (388 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 174 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Al Bidda Park - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Doha Quest - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Doha Corniche - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Amiri Diwan - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Souq Waqif - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Msheireb Museums - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Souq Waqif Art Gallery - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi- Al Khoot Fort - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi- Souq Waqif Park - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Fire Station Art Gallery - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Gold Souq - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- Pouce - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- Pearl Monument - 2. 7 km / 1. 7 mi- Grand Hamad Street - 2. 8 km / 1. 8 mi- Abdulla Bin Zaid Al Mahmoud Islamic Cultural Center - 3 km / 1. 9 mi. The nearest airports are: Doha (DIA-Doha Intl. ) - 11. 2 km / 7 mi Hamad Intl. Airport (DOH) - 16. 5 km / 10. 2 mi The preferred airport for Sapphire Plaza Hotel is Hamad Intl. Airport (DOH).

425458.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace of this Porto River aparthotel, located in the heart of Porto's Centro/Baixa district, just steps from Ribeira Square and a short walk from the historic center. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and an area shuttle (surcharge). Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) and enjoy a meal at the on-site restaurant or room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge after a day exploring nearby attractions like Porto Cathedral and Dom Luís I Bridge. The 19 air-conditioned rooms feature kitchenettes, LED TVs, and safes. Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center. Airport transfers are available (surcharge).

425658.address: Conference Street, West Bay Area, Po Box 25522
425658.description: The 5-star City Centre Rotana Doha welcomes you to the elegant and contemporary 400 rooms and suites, state of-the-art meetings and banqueting facilities and Bodylines Wellness and Fitness Centre. Experience all that Doha has to offer while staying at City Centre Rotana, nestled in the heart of West Bay where you will find yourself ideally placed for shopping and exploring local sites. Our newly opened hotel features stylish and contemporary rooms with exceptional skyline and sea views and luxurious amenities in addition to our delightful restaurants and bars, where you can unwind over drinks and mouth-watering dishes. City Centre Rotana, upscale contemporary hotel in the heart of Doha.

425740.description: Located in the heart of Madrid, this modern 4-star hotel is positioned between the vibrant areas of Tribunal, Malasaña, and Chueca. Guests have access to a 24-hour on-site fitness centre, a bar, and a business centre. All rooms are air-conditioned and feature complimentary Wi-Fi and a flat-screen TV. Available room types include single, double, and triple occupancy, with some superior rooms offering a balcony or terrace. A breakfast buffet is available for guests. The hotel is conveniently situated 250 metres from Tribunal Metro Station, providing easy access to the city. Gran Via is a 1-kilometre walk away, while the Prado Museum is 1. 6 kilometres from the property.

425838.description: Guests may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Time out City Hotel Vienna. This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception. Owing to its health and wellness services, this hotel is ideal for a relaxing break from the stress and strain of daily life. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

426058.description:
Located 30 minutes away from Lisbon, DOMA sits on a forested estate where people come to stay, gather, and create. 
The grounds include 35 rooms, Café & Bakery, an à la carte restaurant, coworking studios, forest trails, and event spaces — from quiet corners to gatherings of up to 350 people. The Steam Center offers guided sessions, sensory rituals, and space to slow down. 
Alongside a curated calendar of workshops, talks, and weekend experiences, DOMA is also open to those hosting their own — from intimate retreats to full-scale offsites.

426101.description: Riolavitas Resort & Spa offers relaxing accommodations a short 4-minute walk from the beach in the Titreyengol/Sorgun area, where you can enjoy the Mediterranean breeze. Located 7 km from Side Antique City, this resort features a private beach area, water sports facilities, a swimming pool, and free WiFi throughout. Each air-conditioned room includes a flat-screen TV, and some offer a seating area for added comfort. You'll also find a kettle with tea and coffee supplies, a private bathroom with a shower, slippers, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. Free private parking is available on site.

426158.address: KEMERAĞZI MH. YAŞAR SOBUTAY BUL. NO:78/1 AKSU
426158.description:
Fantastic hotel located in Adalya, at the foot of the beach. If you just want a heavenly holiday, where you can relax and enjoy with your friends or family, this is the perfect hotel for you. All rooms are very spacious, bright and comfortable. They are decorated in cheerful colors and have many services, among which we can find television, telephone, air conditioning, private bathroom and minibar. The hotel offers its guests a fantastic spa with the latest body treatments where you can relax while being looked after. In addition, there is a large outdoor swimming pool and direct access to the beach. GENERAL REMARKS:
*** Pets Are Not Allowed. 
*** All Hotel rooms are non-smoking. 
*** Guests under the age of 18 without one of the parents will not be accepted. 
*** The hotel reserves the right to modify the specified dates, times, and venues due to weather
conditions or operational requirements. Additionally, the hotel reserves the right to make changes to
the concept without prior notice. 
*** Depending on availability, guests staying a minimum of 7 nights or more are entitled to one
complimentary à la carte restaurant visit with prior reservation. 
*** In the UAI concept, all drinks are served by the glass. 
*** Alcoholic beverages will not be served to guests under the age of 18.

426238.description: Centrally located in Berlin's trendy Mitte district, the Rosenthal Residence offers pet-friendly, self-catering apartments featuring elegant, modern décor and furnishings. Museum Island is 1 km from the property. Each apartment features a seating area, private bathroom with a shower and towels, and a dining area. Some units include a flat-screen TV with cable channels and a Blu-ray player. All apartments have a kitchen equipped with a microwave, toaster, refrigerator, stovetop, and coffee machine. Guests who prefer not to cook will find numerous restaurants within 100 meters of the property. Mitte is a great choice for travelers interested in history, architecture, and museums.

426239.description: Luxury, authenticity, confidentiality, modernity, Four words that perfectly define the style of the Savoy Grand Hotel in Marrakech. Located in the heart of the prestigious Hivernage quarter, arguably the most distinguished address in the red city. Our sumptuous 5 stars hotel let you enjoy a picturesque view over the Great Atlas mountains, proximity to Jamaa el Fna square and the Menara, all in a unique atmosphere. Central to The Savoy Grand Hotel's prominence is its old-world grace and charm, blended effortlessly with contemporary comforts and amenities. In its unique blend of warmth and welcome and assiduous attention to service, The Savoy Grand Hotel is a true ambassador of the Moroccan hospitality experience.

426278.address: Playa Miramar A38 y 39 Colonia Miramar, 1
426278.description: Situated on Manzanillo's finest beach, Miramar Beach, this exclusive hotel offers discerning guests tranquility and relaxation. Each of the six luxurious rooms boasts stunning ocean views and sunsets. Unwind with a massage under the gentle sea breeze or savor delicious cuisine and drinks at the palapa restaurant. Luxurious furnishings and amenities complete the experience.

426340.description: Drop your bags at Novotel and relax. Novotel Amsterdam Airport Schiphol is a beautifully designed hotel at a very convenient location, within walking distance of Hoofddorp Station, 4 minutes by train from Amsterdam Airport Schiphol and 20 min by train from Amsterdam's city centre. It is the perfect hotel to explore Amsterdam and the region or for organizing a meeting or congress. Discover the excellent service and first class facilities of this brand new flagship property.

426341.description: You will quickly feel at home in Mercure Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station. This hotel is situated next to Station Amsterdam Sloterdijk with direct train, bus, tram and metro connections to Amsterdam city centre, Schiphol Airport and RAI congress centre. From the airport, you can be at the hotel lobby in 15 minutes. Amsterdam's city centre is just 5 minutes journey. A10 and A5 highways are close to the hotel. The hotel has a secured parking facility and the Skybar on the 8th floor offers magnificent view.

426578.description: Situated in the city center, this hotel offers convenient access to Cleopatra Beach (1. 5 km) and Antalya (130 km) and Gazipasa (50 km) airports, with transfer services available. Guests enjoy a free daily shuttle to Cleopatra Beach. High-speed internet access is complimentary in the lobby, restaurant, and pool areas, and available in rooms for 40 TL per week.

426618.description: With a stay at H10 Cubik, you'll be centrally located in Barcelona, within a 5-minute walk of Palau de la Musica Catalana and Passeig de Gracia. This 4. 5-star hotel is 0. 2 mi (0. 3 km) from Placa de Catalunya and 0. 3 mi (0. 4 km) from La Rambla. Enjoy recreation amenities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a rooftop terrace. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Guests can get to nearby shops on the complimentary shuttle. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 3 meeting rooms available for events. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the 2 coffee shops/cafés. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 101 guestrooms featuring minibars and espresso makers. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters. 48-inch flat-screen televisions with digital programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries.

426638.description: With a small number of only 14, this establishment is very convenient for a quiet stay. Visitors may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Forgetmenot. This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception. Additional fees may apply for some services.

426719.description: The Hotel Atlantico Prime offers contemporary apartments in Rio de Janeiro's city center. Each apartment features air conditioning, cable TV, a minibar, a safe, a hairdryer, and a makeup mirror, as well as complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy the on-site gym, restaurant, and bar, and a daily breakfast is included. The hotel also boasts a convention center for up to 150 people, configurable across six rooms, making it suitable for a variety of events. Nearby attractions include Santos Dumont Airport (2 km), AquaRio (3 km), Maracanã Stadium (6. 5 km), Arcos da Lapa (600 m), Guanabara Bay (3 km), and the Selarón Staircase (900 m).

426779.address: Barsha Heights, Hessa Street, Al Thanyah, 1
426779.description: Hotel was constructed in 2015. The property consists of 828 rooms. The property consists of 392 single rooms, 304 double rooms, 36 junior suites, 8 suites, 8 disability-friendly rooms and 80 triple rooms. This popular hotel is ideal for both business travellers and holidaymakers. The Hotel provides air-conditioning in public areas. The Hotel provides 24-hour reception. Guests can make use of the currency exchange facilities. The Hotel provides a cloakroom for guests to store winter clothing. Lift access is available to guests for added convenience. There is a newspaper stand on the premises. Guests can appreciate the convenience of the onsite shop. Guests can relax in the beautiful garden. There is a delightful terrace where guests may relax and enjoy the warm sunshine. There is mobile phone coverage throughout the Hotel. Guests can make use of internet access to stay connected to work or home. Guests can take advantage of room service to enjoy breakfast in bed. There is a laundry service. Guests can make use of the launderette. Guests can make use of the medical service in case of illness. The Hotel is wheelchair-accessible. There is an on-site car park. Guests may energize for the day in the onsite gym. Check-out is at 12:00. For parents' convenience, the Hotel offers a babysitting service on request. The Hotel provides a car hire service. Guests can take advantage of the airport transfer service. The Hotel provides secure parking for guests' safety. Guests can ask the helpful, multilingual staff for recommendations and directions. The Hotel offers daily newspapers. The Hotel offers 24-hour security. There is a bellboy service. This establishment allows pets. Large pets are allowed on the premises.

426878.description: SUI RESORT is established on an area of 9000 square meters in the Okurcalar region of Alanya, the pearl of the Mediterranean, far away from the noise of the city, surrounded by an atmosphere of enchantment in full harmony with the architecture of the facility, and it accommodates 307 comfortable rooms. The Resort is located at a distance of 108 km from the city center of Antalya, 98 km from Antalya Airport, 30 km from Alanya and 20 km from Manavgat. The Resort is only 500 m to the seashore and in possession of a private beach with a day-long shuttle service. ROOMS: 280 Standard Rooms (25 m²) (4 for guests with disabilities)Mini bar (soft drinks are replenished on a daily basis), satellite TV, music broadcasts, internet connection, direct phone line, air conditioner, safety deposit box, hardwood floor, bathroom/shower & WC, make-up mirror and blow dryer.

427019.description: Enjoy a warm welcome at the DoubleTree by Hilton Istanbul – Piyalepasa hotel and enjoy a chocolate chip cookie upon arrival to help you feel settled in. Located only three kilometers from historic Taksim Square and the bustling shops, restaurants and bars of Istiklal Street, the contemporary DoubleTree by Hilton Istanbul – Piyalepasa hotel is only 30 minutes east of Atatürk International Airport. Experience real Turkish culture at Taksim Square and shop till you drop at Nisantasi - one of Istanbul's best shopping districts. Retire to a spacious guest room or suite at this Istanbul hotel. All rooms are stylishly decorated and are fully equipped with modern amenities. Upgrade to a suite for extra space, including a separate living area and sofa bed; ideal for relaxing. Host a meeting in one of our flexible, naturally-lit meeting rooms or host a celebration in our ballroom. Keep up with work at the business center or maintain your fitness regime using the cardio equipment and free weights at our fitness center. Swim laps in the indoor pool or visit the spa for a treatment or soak in the soothing whirlpool.

427198.description: Enjoy garden views at Istanbul Town Hotel, located in Istanbul City Center, within a 15-minute walk of the Grand Bazaar and Süleymaniye Mosque. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and room service during limited hours. Other amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Airport transfers are available for a surcharge. The 35 guestrooms feature refrigerators, LCD televisions, private balconies, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include showers, hair dryers, and slippers. The hotel is 1 mile from the Blue Mosque and 1. 5 miles from the Hagia Sophia.

427318.address: Av. Pedro Joaquín Coldwell s/ número
427318.description: Zomay Holbox Hotel is located on the tranquil Holbox Island, nestled between the Gulf of Mexico and the Caribbean Sea. Offering a perfect blend of nature, peace, and comfort, the hotel provides a variety of amenities, including bike rentals, complimentary access to a beach club with hammocks and lounge chairs, free Wi-Fi at reception, and complimentary kayaks. Boat trips can also be arranged. The property features four bungalows, two standard rooms, and two apartments, all ideally situated just five minutes from the island's center. Each room is equipped with a refrigerator, ceiling fan, mosquito net, and a private bathroom. Front desk hours: 8 am to 10 pm. *A 5% credit card fee applies to payments made at the hotel. Early departures are non-refundable. Please note: Internet service on Holbox Island is satellite-based and may experience occasional interruptions due to cloud cover and other atmospheric conditions.

427441.address: Al Fay Road, Dubai Production City (IMPZ)
427441.description: Discover unmatched elegance at Marriott Hotel Production City, Dubai, a five-star premium hotel offering club rooms and executive suites in the heart of Dubai Production City. Designed for discerning travelers, the hotel blends world-class amenities with exceptional service, setting a new benchmark in hospitality. Indulge at every turn with multi-cuisine dining, a relaxed poolside bar, and an outdoor terrace featuring shisha, handcrafted beverages, and light bites. Rejuvenate at the full-service spa and salon or stay energized in the modern fitness center. Spacious rooms and elegant suites combine contemporary design with superior comfort, ideal for short stays or extended retreats. Guests also enjoy a complimentary shuttle service to key Dubai attractions for a seamless stay. At Marriott Hotel Production City, Dubai, every detail is crafted to exceed expectations—whether you’re traveling for business, leisure, or a family getaway. 343 5-star hotel rooms, club rooms, and executive suites with deluxe beds, baths & 24/7 room service. Rooms & suites designed for timeless and versatile getaways—comfort that feels like home. Enjoy high speed Wi-Fi, A/C, TV, safe, iron, bath amenities, robe, hairdryer & more in every room.

427560.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and 15 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available on request), and free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 194 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

name.content: Hotel Mas Salagros EcoResort & Aire Ancient Baths

427764.description: Located in Vallromanes, a former Roman villa, Mas Salagros EcoResort is Spain's first organic resort. This eco-friendly hotel features a lake and two seasonal pools, plus the Aire de Vallromanes Wellness Centre offering various treatments and massages. A children's play area encourages outdoor play in nature. The spacious, air-conditioned rooms, junior suites, and suites are decorated with natural, ecological materials and include cable TV, a minibar, and a safe. Private bathrooms feature a shower, hairdryer, and free ecological toiletries. 24-hour room service is available. Three organic restaurants, the Restaurant Gastronómic 1497, the Cibus Restaurant, and the Gastro Wine Bar, serve traditional dishes using locally sourced organic products. The 24-hour front desk can provide information on activities such as hiking, cycling, yoga, and stretching. Cooking lessons, including making ecological jams, traditional local cheese, and liquors, can be arranged, as well as wine-tasting sessions. Mas Salagros EcoResort & Aire Ancient Baths is 25 km from Barcelona and a 14-minute drive from the Circuit de Catalunya. Free Wi-Fi and private parking are available. Guests in Junior Suites (over 16) have 90-minute spa access (confirmation required upon contacting the hotel). Other guests can access the spa for an extra fee. As a precaution, treatments and AIRE services are available before and after pregnancy, but not during.

427778.description: Behind its original façade, this refurbished hotel offers 83 modern and cozy rooms with all the amenities you need. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, a business center, and 24-hour multilingual staff assistance. The hotel is accessible, with facilities for disabled guests. Dine in the à la carte restaurant, enjoy breakfast, or a snack in the charming courtyard terrace. The hotel also provides versatile event spaces within its exquisite, modern decor.

427779.description: It's not just another hotel in Lisbon. It is the Palácio do Governador (Governor's Palace, in English), with 60 different rooms near the Tagus river in the historic centre of Belém, one of the most beautiful and emblematic areas of the capital. Built on the site of the former house of the governor of the Tower of Belém, exquisitely restored, on top of roman ruins probably from the 1st to the 5th century, the Palácio do Governador is a palatial building with a reception that once was a chapel, a restaurant with original domes as ceilings and contemporary SPA that's linked to the ancient thermal traditions of Mediterranean cultures. Close to the Tagus and national historic monuments, the Palácio do Governador is the natural choice for anyone who wants to be in Lisbon, near everything, from culture to leisure and far enough from the frenzy of the city centre. *Register of Tourism: 6305

name.content: Park Inn By Radisson Istanbul Ataturk Airport

427878.description: This hotel is perfect for business and holiday travellers alike because it's close to CNR Expo Centre, Istanbul World Trade Centre and lots of shopping centres and outlet malls. Take advantage of our free shuttle service to and from local shopping centres. The hotel has 154 stylish rooms, including 2 rooms specially designed for those who need accessibility features. Start your morning well with breakfast at the Live-inn Room Restaurant. For lunch and dinner, sample a Turkish dish or your favourite pizza or gourmet burger at RBG Restaurant. Spend a soothing day at our spa centre, which has an indoor pool, fitness area, massage and treatment rooms, hammam, sauna and steam bath. We also offer outdoor car parking, a business centre and 7 flexible meeting rooms, the largest of which can accommodate up to 340 people.

427898.description: These peaceful and comfortable double or twin rooms (16-22 m²) feature superior design, with most showcasing elegant wood floors and some marble accents. All rooms are equipped with a TV (including music channels), minibar, air conditioning, private safe, hairdryer, internet access, and a direct-dial telephone. Every comfort has been considered to ensure a stylish and enjoyable stay.

427899.description: Lampa Design Hotel welcomes you to explore Istanbul from the most ideal location, since the hotel is located in the vibrant neighborhood of Şişli, the center of the city. Lampa hotel introduces a unique “boutique design hotel” experience with the warmth of the antique gas lamp and industrial minimalist architecture. All 20 different sized rooms are designed with customized furniture, special amenities and the unique art pieces inspired by celebrated artist Fikret Mualla Saygı(1904-1967). The Lampa Lab, where guests can enjoy their delicious breakfast and afternoon coffee,  with terrarium designs.

428099.description: Nestled between Riyadh's business and shopping districts, Novotel Suites Riyadh Dyar hotel was designed with both holiday makers and business guests in mind. Providing 4-star comfort, the hotel is within walking distance of many major attractions. With the city on your door step, prepare for an exciting stay at Novotel Suites.

428118.description: Enjoy amenities such as a sauna and fitness center at the art deco Henry Norman Hotel. This boutique hotel in Brooklyn offers complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Grab a bite at the snack bar/deli, and enjoy a continental breakfast daily (available for a fee). The hotel features a 24-hour business center, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Each of the 50 individually decorated guestrooms includes a refrigerator, an iPod docking station, a memory foam bed with premium bedding, a 42-inch LCD TV with digital programming, and a coffee/tea maker. Cribs/infant beds are available upon request (surcharge). A stay places you within a 10-minute drive of Grand Central Terminal and the Empire State Building.

428199.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, a health club, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Enjoy a meal at Tano or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Rio de Janeiro? This hotel has 21528 square feet (2000 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 10 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 436 air-conditioned guestrooms. Rooms have private balconies.

name.content: Laguna Beach Alya Resort & Spa Hotel

428218.description: Situated on the eastern slopes of the ancient Justinianopolis settlement in Karaburun, this hotel boasts magnificent bay views. Located approximately 30 km from Side and 35 km from Alanya, it's a 90-minute transfer from Antalya Airport and a 60-minute transfer from Gazipasa Airport. Laguna Beach Alya offers 256 rooms, including 231 standard rooms and 22 family rooms. Guests can enjoy a main restaurant, two à la carte restaurants, a fast food option, multiple bars, swimming pools, a children's pool, water slides, shops, an amphitheater, a disco, a fitness room, a spa, a hairdresser, a doctor, car rental services, and a photographer.

428238.description: This luxurious hotel offers an exclusive experience, immersing guests in sophistication and attentive service. Located just a 15-minute drive from the Dubai International Convention Centre and 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport, it's ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Nearby, you'll find major shopping malls and prime business districts. The hotel features 132 spacious rooms and elegant suites, each superbly furnished with every comfort expected of a landmark hotel. Guests enjoy a lavish and nurturing environment, where their needs are met by an excellent yet unobtrusive staff. The enticing interiors blend modern design and classic refinement, creating a relaxing and comfortable atmosphere.

428239.address: 9033 King Fahad Road, Olaya , Al Anoud Tower, 1
428239.description: The 4-star Novotel Riyadh Al Anoud is located on King Fahad Road in Riyadh's Olaya District, just 150 meters from Kingdom Tower. This hotel is ideally situated in the business and shopping district. Its banquet and meeting facilities are perfect for seminars and wedding receptions. The hotel restaurant offers delicious cuisine, an elegant ambiance, and impeccable service.

428241.description: HOTELBEDS: Located inside one of Lower Manhattan's Art Deco masterpieces, Mint House at 70 Pine offers apartment-style living with its spacious suites. Larger than typical NYC hotel rooms, these suites include fully-equipped kitchens, bespoke and in-house designed furniture, bedrooms with king size Casper mattresses and luxurious Frette linens, and multi-function work areas in many residences. Enjoy smart TVs with streaming, a record player accompanied by a selection of curated vinyl, and free WiFi. Other in-room amenities include premium Malin + Goetz bath products, Fellow Pour-Over Kettles, and locally roasted Sey coffee. Additional building amenities include a 24-hour front desk, concierge services, self-service or valet laundry and dry cleaning, nearby public parking, complimentary newspaper, daily housekeeping tidy, Elite NYSC fitness center, Black Fox Coffee Company, Blue Park Kitchen, City Acres Market, and Crown Shy. Easily access all of Manhattan and Downtown Brooklyn with subway lines 2 and 3, located directly in front of the property, and lines 4, 5, A, C, J, and Z within walking distance.

428619.description: Located in the heart of Lisbon, Lisbon Serviced Apartments offers accommodation within a 4-minute walk from Baixa-Chiado metro station. Free WiFi is offered throughout the property.  The air-conditioned apartments with a sitting area and a TV, also have a bathroom with a shower and a hair dryer. Other facilities include a washing machine. Towels and bed linen are provided.  Guests are able to prepare their own meals in the property's kitchen which includes a dishwasher, stovetop, an oven, and a microwave. Alternatively, several restaurants can be easily found within a 1-minute walk.  Chiado district, offering a wide variety of stores, restaurants and traditional cafes, is within a 400 metres, while lively Bairro Alto with a great range of eateries and bars is within a 15-minute walk, and the iconic São Jorge Castle is 750 m away.  Sintra is 30 km from Lisbon Serviced

428622.description: This amazing property, reminiscent of 16th century Italian Palace, is a clear example of fine luxury. It boasts a privileged situation just 8 km from Dubai international airport and 8 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai. This sumptuous hotel is nestled on a premium waterfront plot and surrounded by the famed Dubai creek and sprawling landscaped gardens. The magnificent hand-cut marble and stained-glass mosaics combined with the sumptuous accommodations furnished by Versace Home Collection provide a sophisticated atmosphere, all while boasting the comforts of home in a truly beautiful setting. Whether indulging in a leisurely treatment within the hotel's signature spa, exercising at the state-of-the-art health club, taking a dip in the olympic sized pool, or dining at one of the celebrated on-site restaurants, guests will never forget the exceptional experience of staying at this unique hotel.

428718.description: The hotel is located in the district of Sarria-Pedralbes, next to the Diagonal Avenue, one of the most famous streets of Barcelona. Well connected to the city center by bus and subway. The hotel has 40 elegant and modern rooms fully equipped to make the guest's stay as pleasant as possible. The hotel has a restaurant. When booking more than 5 rooms, special conditions and supplements may apply.

428738.description: Located just 550 meters from the town center, Pera Parma Hotel offers convenient access to local attractions and transportation links. This 25-unit hotel provides Wi-Fi in all public areas and guest rooms. A 24-hour reception desk caters to guests' needs, and all rooms are wheelchair accessible. The hotel also offers an airport transfer service, though the airport itself is 15, 000 km away. Guests can enjoy on-site dining facilities for a relaxing culinary experience. Business travelers will appreciate the hotel's versatile meeting and conference spaces.

428863.description: Stay in style at DoubleTree by Hilton Istanbul Gayrettepe. Our modern hotel boasts an excellent location, just minutes from Istanbul city center. Next to the metro station, we’re within easy reach of the Taksim Square, Grand Bazaar, Bosphorus Coast, Zorlu Performing Arts Center, and Cevahir Shopping Mall. Unwind in a stylish guest room, featuring elegant décor and complimentary WiFi, or upgrade to a spacious suite for a separate living area, second bathroom and balcony. When you get hungry, delight your senses with an international a la carte menu and warm ambience at our Zeytinyali restaurant, or dine in-room with Room Service. Rejuvenate at our health club, complete with steam room and sauna. Take a refreshing dip in the indoor swimming pool, unwind at our traditional Turkish bath or enjoy a workout at the modern fitness center. If you’re here on business, stay productive at our Business Center, with computers and printing services, or host a meeting with us. Our six meeting rooms offer the latest technology and A/V equipment, while our largest event space can accommodate up to 320, perfect for conferences and special occasions. We offer 24-hour concierge service, and underground car parking and a valet service are available onsite.

name.content: Seaden Valentine Resort & Spa adult only+16

428867.description: We invite you to this holiday paradise where the unique nature embraces the history in Side Turkey at the peaceful Mediterranean coasts. ”Side Valentine Resort Spa”. One paradies which is only 3 km away from city centre and 40 minutes from the airport. Seaden Valentine Resort designed with fine details and in a modern architecture opens the doors for you with comfortable rooms and +16 concept. In a soothing athmosphere you can enjoy during the day a stunning view at the sea. We offer 163 rooms, 326 berthing capacity and an exclusive guest service for you. Far away from the crowd and the noise we welcome you in our quiet and comfortable ambiance. We offer much more than you wished with an exquisite 5 star comfort. With our different alternatives from 28 m2 up to 42 m2 designed to forget the stress of the year in a chic atmosphere. We provide you peaceful and comfortable holidays far over the standard in one of our 163 comfortable rooms. Turkish and World Cuisine are provided in our open buffet restaurants according to your taste. You may also taste our different dishes in our a la carte restaurant accompanied by soft music alongside the breakfasts, lunch and dinner.

428868.description:
The Glamour Resort & Spa is located in the heart of the tourist center of Colakli, just 350 meters from the sandy beach. Here is a free shuttle service offered. Bus stop and taxi station are on site. The distance to Antalya airport is 50 kilometers.

Offer at our Glamour Resort & Spa

Dining options include a buffet restaurant, two a la carte restaurants, a lobby bar, a beach bar and a poolside bar. Various shops and boutiques and a supermarket invite you to shop. Disco and show stage also belong to the house. Surcharge offer hairdressing and laundry their services. Medical assistance is available on office hours fo

428938.description: A brand new hotel decorated in high standards with a blend of Ottoman style offers a luxury and comfortable accommodation,Hotel Emirhan Palace  is located on E-5 Highway in Avcılar, Denizköşkler. Metrobus station (İBB) is right in front of the hotel. Atatürk Airport, Tüyap Fair Convention& Congress Center and CNR Expo  Exhibition Center are both 11 km from the hotel. All rooms that are soundproofed and equipped with modern and private bathrooms, have satellite LCD TV, mini bar, A/C, free WIFI, complimentary tea/coffee making facilities, writing desk, telephone and hair dryer. The hotel offers some rooms with balcony and some family rooms as well. The famous Restaurant & Cafe and Patisserie chain, Dilek, located in the hotel, has many choices among Turkish and World cuisines. The Spa at the hotel has been attractively designed to relax and unwind with Turkish Bath, Steam Room, Sauna, Fitness Center and Massage Service.

429018.description:
Cancun International Suites is a downtown hotel surrounded by several local restaurants, bars and provided with fast and easy access to Cancun main avenues which will allow you to easily get and visit several tourist sites, being one of them Cancun beautiful beach.
This property is a great and affordable option when travel on business affairs or to have relax and pleasurable vacations in Cancun, since hotel offer amazing promotions and low rates, while having a tranquil and homely vibe. Hotel also present continental breakfast without any additional cost at the very comfort of your room.
The property consists of 12 rooms. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. Guests can relax on the terrace. The Hotel has mobile phone coverage. Guests can make use of internet access to stay connected to work or home. The property is wheelchair-accessible. Check-out is at 12:00.

429058.description:
The Imperial, no Rio de Janeiro fica a 4 km do Pão de Açúcar ea 5 km do Cristo Redentor. Tem uma piscina e ar condicionado. Um buffet de pequeno-almoço e estacionamento gratuito.

429418.description: Just a few steps from the chic Nisantasi District with its popular shops and cafés, Carina Park Suites is 600 m from Osmanbey Metro Station. It offers self-catering accommodation with modern amenities and a terrace. Free WiFi is accessible throughout the premises. Cevahir Shopping Mall is a 15-minute walk away. With city views, the suites at Carina Park Suites feature an elegant décor and parquet floors. Each has a seating area and flat-screen TV with satellite and cable channels. A safety deposit box and a work desk are also provided. Laundry, ironing and dry cleaning services are available. There are 2 shared washing machine and drying machine on site. Daily breakfast is offered buffet style and you can have it served to your room. You can also prepare your meals in the privacy of your own kitchenette with a stove, fridge and an electric kettle. Osmanbey Metro Station offers easy access to other sites in the city, including the lively Taksim Square. City's Shopping Mall, Cevahir Shopping Mall and American Hospital are within walking distance. The property is a 10-minute walk from Lutfi Kirdar Convention Centre and 6. 5 km from Sultanahmet district. Ataturk Airport 21 km away and airport shuttle services are arranged at an additional fee.

429440.description: The hotel comprises 40 cosy rooms. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. All guests staying at this property will appreciate the 24-hour reception.

429498.description: The San Telmo Art Factory establishment has murals hand-painted graffiti style and offers tango lessons. This hostel has artistically decorated rooms with free WiFi, and a bar with live music where homemade dishes. The Art Factory San Telmo is just 200 meters from the metro station and 500 meters from the historic Plaza de Mayo. At the tour desk can give recommendations for getting around the area. In addition, a bicycle rental service is available and can organize free walking tours of the historic center and Recoleta. Rooms at the Art Factory San Telmo is individually designed and include a desk, fan and private or shared bathroom with shower. A full breakfast buffet including cheese, eggs and regional jams is served daily. The reception is open 24 hours and provides luggage storage. This hostel is 1.5 km from the railway station and Retiro bus and 35 km from Ezeiza Airport.

429499.description: The River Hotel is located in the heart of Buenos Aires, a few steps from the National Congress. The hotel offers free Wi -Fi for all the guest. River Hotel's rooms are well equipped with air conditioning and cable TV. All rooms have been soundproofed so you can enjoy a quiet night. Ezeiza International Airport is a 30-minute drive .

429598.description:
he Hotel was built in 2015. There are a total of 57 rooms.
