You can also contact us by phone +34695977024.

436762.description: This beautifully decorated hotel is situated in Istanbul, Turkey. It is surrounded by several shops and restaurants ideal to stop by to have a nice meal while exploring the city. A few places that should not be missed for the travellers who like history and culture when visiting Istanbul are the Suleymaniye Mosque, the Basilica Cistern, Hagia Sophia museum and the Galata Tower. The complex is ideal to host business or private events since it offers venues up to 250 people with all the essential equipment to make every event a complete success. The comfortable rooms are decorated with warm soft colours to create a cosy atmosphere and equipped with the necessary amenities to have an unforgettable stay. Parking :Valet 5 euroParking Fee:5 euro

436901.description: Built in 2015, this sophisticated hotel in Alanya offers 302 comfortable rooms, perfect for unwinding. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi throughout the property, a 24-hour reception, on-site parking, and a convenient transfer service. Business facilities are available for corporate travelers, while leisure guests can take advantage of the hotel's wellness center and diverse entertainment and sports activities. Please note, cots are not available and pets are not allowed. Some services may incur additional charges.

436979.description: Stop at Wyndham Garden Brooklyn Sunset Park to discover the wonders of New York (NY). Both business travelers and tourists can enjoy the hotel's facilities and services. All the necessary facilities, including free Wi-Fi in all rooms, daily housekeeping, wheelchair accessible. Each guestroom is elegantly furnished and equipped with handy amenities. . No matter what your reasons are for visiting New York (NY), Wyndham Garden Brooklyn Sunset Park will make you feel instantly at home.

437021.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at the upscale Tan Hotel - Special Class, located in Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district, a short walk from Sultanahmet Square and the Basilica Cistern. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a daily complimentary reception. Dine at the on-site restaurant and bar/lounge or enjoy 24-hour room service. A buffet breakfast is available for a fee. The 34 guestrooms feature minibars, LCD TVs with satellite channels, and private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include safes, coffee/tea makers, and phones. The hotel also provides a 24-hour business center, express check-in/check-out, and an airport shuttle for a surcharge. Nearby attractions include the Hagia Sophia and Grand Bazaar.

name.content: Canaletto Luxury Suites – San Marco Luxury

437160.description: Canaletto Luxury Suites - San Marco Luxury in Venice offers a central position with stunning views. Rialto Bridge is a 6-minute walk away, while Basilica San Marco lies just yards nearby. Venice Marco Polo Airport is 11 mi from the hotel. Rooms feature air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and city views. Additional amenities include bathrobes, free toiletries, and soundproofing. Family rooms and interconnected rooms cater to all guests. Guests can unwind in the sauna, hot tub, or spa bath. The hotel provides a paid shuttle service, elevator, and 24-hour front desk. Breakfast is served in-room with American options including juice, fresh pastries, pancakes, cheese, and fruits. Explore Doge's Palace, La Fenice Theater, and Frari Basilica within walking distance. Boating is available in the surrounding area. Venice Santa Lucia Train Station is 1. 2 mi away.

437858.description: Unique spaces, located in one of Santiago's most exclusive neighborhoods, designed for greater comfort and privacy. Fully equipped apartments ideal for families, long-stay travelers, and business travelers alike. Enjoy spacious apartments where connectivity and comfort will be the hallmarks of your stay. Each morning, you can enjoy a full buffet breakfast at our Rugendas restaurant, located at Callao 3123. Time Suite also offers daily housekeeping, a 24-hour reception, laundry facilities, a seasonal outdoor pool, and a gym. Free Wi-Fi and parking.

438060.address: Al Habtoor City, Sheikh Zayed Road
438060.description: Al Habtoor Palace Dubai, is a beaux arts-inspired palace of refined opulence with 182 guest rooms, 52 suites, and meeting rooms with all the necessary amenities. The hotel is centrally located in the landmark lifestyle development on the banks of Dubai Water Canal, alongside two other distinctive hotels, three luxury residential towers, eclectic dining at the atrium, and a spectacular Las Vegas-style water-themed theatre, La Perle. Just minutes away from major city attractions such as Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall, a 20-minute drive to Dubai International Airport, and 40-minute drive to Al Maktoum International Airport, the hotel is strategically located within easy access from the city's many hotspots.

name.content: Torre de Gomariz Wine & Spa Hotel

438080.description: Nestled in the heart of Minho, Portugal, the Torre de Gomariz Wine and Spa Hotel offers a unique blend of history, nature, and modern design. Set within a lush five-hectare vineyard and forest, the hotel incorporates the historic Tower and House of Gomariz. Guests can choose from a variety of accommodations, including romantic suites within the medieval tower, elegant rooms in the main house, and contemporary suites in the modern wing. The hotel boasts a spa, swimming pool, two bars, a restaurant, and event spaces suitable for weddings and conferences.

438219.description: Located in the heart of Herald Square, this newly renovated luxury hotel seamlessly blends NYC's rich history and culture with a modern, avant-garde design. Guests enjoy easy access to public transportation and are just 14 km from La Guardia Airport. The hotel offers comfortable, well-appointed rooms featuring classic yet modern furnishings and convenient amenities, including internet access and on-site parking. A welcoming reception and attentive staff ensure a pleasant stay.

name.content: Hilton Garden Inn Hotel Mall Avenue

438339.description:
Ideally located in the Al Barsha district, just a short walk from Mall of the Emirates and close to Insurance Market Metro Station, Hilton Garden Inn Dubai, Mall Avenue offers a comfortable and convenient stay for both business and leisure travellers. With excellent connectivity across the city, guests can easily access Dubai's major business districts, world-class shopping destinations, iconic attractions, and popular beaches. 

The hotel features modern guestrooms and suites designed for comfort and functionality, complete with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, ergonomic workspaces, and thoughtful in-room amenities. Families and groups can enjoy the convenience of connecting rooms, providing flexibility while staying close to loved ones. 

Guests benefit from a range of services designed to enhance their stay, including a 24-hour front desk, concierge services, daily housekeeping, complimentary parking, EV charging facilities, and a complimentary 24-hour self-service laundry room, making the hotel ideal for both short and extended stays. 

Dining options include Together & Co. , serving a generous international buffet breakfast with a variety of hot and cold dishes, fresh pastries, fruits, cereals, and regional favourites. Guests can also enjoy international cuisine throughout the day in a relaxed setting. Inn Good Co. offers a casual social atmosphere for drinks, light meals, and comfort food. For added convenience, 24-hour room service is available. 

For relaxation and wellness, the hotel offers a heated rooftop swimming pool and a fully equipped 24-hour fitness centre. Flexible meeting and event spaces are also available for corporate meetings, training sessions, and social gatherings. 

Combining a prime location, excellent transport links, modern accommodation, and family-friendly facilities, Hilton Garden Inn Dubai, Mall Avenue provides a welcoming base for travellers seeking comfort, convenience, and value in one of Dubai's most accessible neighbourhoods.

438459.description: Located in Side in the Mediterranean Region Turkey Region, 10 km from Side Antique City, Orfeus Queen Spa boasts a spa centre and sauna. The hotel has a fitness centre and hammam, and guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant. Free WiFi is offered and free private parking is available on site. Every room is fitted with a flat-screen TV. For your comfort, you will find free toiletries and a hairdryer. You will find a hairdresser's at the property.

438599.description: This property is a 11-minute walk from the beach. Located in Alanya, Carmen Suite Apart offers a garden and outdoor pool. Alanya Aquapark is 600 m from the property. The property is air conditioned and features a flat-screen TV. Some units have a dining area and/or terrace. There is also a kitchenette, fitted with a stovetop. Towels are provided. Carmen Suite Apart also offers massage treatments and includes a spa center and fitness center. Guests can enjoy a meal at the on-site restaurant. The property has a private beach area and bike rental and car rental are available. You can play ping-pong, pool and darts at the property, and the area is popular for fishing. Alanya Archaeological Museum is half a kilometer from Carmen Suite Apart, and Alanya Bus Station is 1 km away. The nearest airport is Gazipasa Airport, 40. 2 km from the property.

name.content: The Lumos Deluxe Resort Hotel & Spa

438619.description: Situated on an 18, 000 m² estate, this resort hotel opened in May 2016. It's conveniently located 3 km from Mahmutlar city center, 15 km from Alanya city center, and 14 km from Antalya International Airport. Surrounded by scenic banana trees, the hotel boasts a 1, 375 m² pool area, offering guests a comfortable and relaxing home-away-from-home experience. Each air-conditioned room features amenities such as an LED TV, coffee and tea facilities, a minibar, a safe, and a private bathroom with a hairdryer and toiletries. The hotel's fascinating architectural design creates a unique holiday atmosphere. Families with children will appreciate the mini club, complete with a playground and pools with slides. Guests can also rejuvenate their body and mind with special therapies at the spa and wellness center, releasing stress and negative energy.

439201.description: The Ohla Eixample offers a luxurious stay in central Barcelona, just a short walk from attractions like Palau Robert and Casa Milà (La Pedrera). This 5-star hotel boasts a massage cabin, an outdoor heated pool, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each of the 94 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, espresso maker, and a Select Comfort bed with premium bedding. Guests can enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at the Xerta restaurant, or relax with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. Buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. The hotel also offers a business center, dry cleaning services, and three meeting rooms.

439241.address: Olubunmi Owa Street, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos, 2
439241.description: An amazing experience located on the Lekki Peninsula, Victoria Island in Lagos state, south-west Nigeria. With easy access to Victoria Island and Ikoyi over the newly opened bridge, the hotel allows both business and leisure travellers to enjoy modern and luxurious facilities in a unique boutique ambiance. The Lilygate offers a new vision on luxury with 74 rooms including 6 suites and a full range of facilities and provides redefined service to its guests. With conference facilities, restaurant, bar, swimming-pool, gym and free Wi-Fi it is the ideal location for work and relaxation.

439321.description: This delightful property is situated right in the heart of Bayswater, in the serene street of Craven Terrace. Both Paddington and Lancaster Gate tube stations are only moments away, offering direct links to all of London's famous sites and attractions. With extremely comfortable and relaxing ensuite bedrooms ranging from single to family rooms and equipped with flat screen televisions, as well as complimentary tea/coffee making facilities, the hotel’s main aim is to ensure guest satisfaction throughout their stay. Rooms range in size and present a combination of both style and function, in order to tender to our guests requirements. The property offers accommodation of exceptional comfort, with some rooms providing views of Craven Terrace peaceful surroundings, as well as a cosy breakfast room to start the best way possible with a warm coffee and an English breakfast.

name.content: Innside by Melia New York Nomad

439381.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including a 24-hour fitness center and bicycles to rent. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy a satisfying meal at The Wilson serving guests of INNSiDE by Meliá New York Nomad. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in New York? This hotel has 1173 square feet (109 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 3 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 313 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers.

439862.description:
The Lionel Hotel, located in Bayrampaşa, Istanbul, offers convenient access to the city center and metro stations, just a short 2 to 10-minute walk away. This makes it an ideal choice for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel is distinguished by its welcoming and attentive service, focusing on every detail to ensure guest comfort. Modern and chic decor enhances the overall ambiance. The hotel features Superior Rooms (28-30 sq m) with king or twin beds, offering panoramic city views, free Wi-Fi, satellite TV, coffee/tea makers, minibars, and in-room safes. Deluxe Rooms (35 sq m) provide a more spacious option with a king-size bed, separate bathtub and shower, and Nespresso machines. Please note that spa services are temporarily unavailable. 

The swimming pool is open for use between 07:00 and 22:00.

440564.description: Amadi Panorama Hotel is a luxurious luxe 4-star hotel with 67 spacious rooms and a fantastic view. The hotel offers single up to quadruple rooms, family rooms, bridal suites, and disabled rooms. All rooms are equipped with a luxurious bathroom which includes an environmentally friendly rain and hand shower, hairdryer, and a shaving mirror. In the rooms you will find customised furniture, a very comfortable bed, and designer lighting. A smart TV with Internet and a huge channel selection is always available. A Nespresso coffee machine, tea facilities and water are available to you free of charge. In addition, we offer our guests organic and fair trade products, such as organic tea and wine. In the restaurant on the 8th floor, you can enjoy a delicious breakfast with organic products. There is a public parking only 2 minutes walk from the hotel for a fee.

440601.description: This 4-star hotel is situated in the centre of Lisbon, just 250 metres from the grand Praça do Comércio and the Tagus River. The property offers contemporary accommodation with some rooms providing views of the Lisbon Cathedral. Guest rooms are equipped with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and a private bathroom. Available room types include Superior and Executive categories, with options for double or twin beds. On-site dining includes a restaurant serving light fare and a bar/lounge. The hotel provides a 24-hour front desk, a lift, and an airport shuttle service is available for a surcharge. Key city attractions are within walking distance, with Rossio Square and Chiado located an 8-minute walk away.

441623.description: Rugendas Hotel Boutique, located in Santiago, Chile, combines elegance, comfort, and a welcoming design, positioning it as an excellent choice for those seeking a unique accommodation experience. Located in the exclusive Las Condes neighborhood, the hotel offers strategic proximity to business centers, restaurants, luxury shops, and tourist attractions, ideal for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel stands out for its intimate and personalized atmosphere, reflecting attention to detail and high-quality service. Its facilities include comfortable rooms equipped with all modern amenities, a restaurant that blends local and international flavors, and meeting and event spaces. Furthermore, its tranquil setting and boutique style make it a standout alternative to large chain hotels.

442001.description: Located 5 km from Brussels' Grand-Place, Hôtel Phénix provides soundproof rooms with free WiFi and a modern décor. Brussels-South Train Station is a 10-minute drive from this design hotel. Each room comes with a flat-screen TV and a telephone. The bathroom is equipped with a shower or a bathtub, a hairdryer and free toiletries. The suites feature a private terrace as well. Restaurants and shops can be found in the same street as Hôtel Phénix, within walking distance. A supermarket is located 100 metres from the hotel. Several bus stops are a 200-metres walk from the Phénix, offering a connection to the centre of Brussels. The Basilica of the Sacred Heart is 2 km away.

442222.description: Castillo Rojo Hotel Boutique —“The Red Castle”— is located at the center of Plaza Mori in the heart of Bellavista. The neighborhood is famous for its live music, theater, fine restaurants and exciting nightlife. We are one block from the Pablo Neruda House, Patio Bellavista and the Funicular to the summit of San Cristóbal Hill. The iconic Red Castle, was originally built in 1923 as an elegant private home and it quickly became known as a meeting place for locals and visitors alike. In 2013, it was lovingly re-imagined as a boutique hotel, with original furniture, restored fireplaces and woodwork, light fixtures and other design elements true to the style of the 1920s. Today, Castillo Rojo offers modern comforts and luxuries, including 19 individually climate-controlled guest rooms, a wine bar, and exciting restaurant. The Castillo Rojo Hotel is a Landmark structure. It has been preserved to the fullest extent while also providing the highest quality in service and modern conveniences for our guests. Due to the property's Landmark status, the Castle does not have an elevator. But rest assured, our staff is always on hand to help you with your luggage and any other service we can provide for you. Have a glass of wine on our romantic terrace overlooking Plaza Mori, enjoy breakfast in our sunny garden or relax with a coffee on the plaza and let the exciting world of Bellavista surround you. Restaurant is opened on Fridays and Saturdays from 19:00 to 22:00

442381.address: Al Awir road E44 on Hatta Road, 7
442381.description: Fun, style and comfort go hand-in-hand at the ibis Styles Dragon Mart Dubai! Solo travellers and families, vacationers and business guests are treated to colourful and inspiring designs throughout the hotel. Our all-inclusive offer combines the best of ibis Styles hospitality, including bed, breakfast and free WiFi at one value price. Our gym, lounge and sports bar are perfect spots for adults to recharge their batteries, while the Kids Corner and TV channels keep the little ones entertained.

442621.description:
Located in Cape Winelands, Diemersfontein Wine and Country Estate is within a 5-minute drive of Bain's Whisky Distillery and Breytenbach Centre.  This guesthouse is 4.2 mi (6.8 km) from Bosman Family Vineyards and 4.5 mi (7.3 km) from Nederburg Wines.
Pamper yourself with onsite massages and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an attached winery and an outdoor pool.
The front desk is staffed during limited hours. Free self parking is available onsite.
Enjoy a satisfying meal at Seasons Restaurant serving guests of Diemersfontein Wine and Country Estate. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary English breakfast is served daily from 8 AM to 10:30 AM.
Make yourself at home in one of the 30 guestrooms. Housekeeping is provided daily, and both cribs/infant beds (complimentary) and rollaway/extra beds (surcharge) are available on request.

443381.description:
Located just 5 minutes' walk from Plaza Catalunya and Passeig de Gracia Avenue, the building was built between 1870 and 1890 with a classic style, highlights the first floor where you will find our spacious and bright rooms.

In this building lived historical figures such as the Marquise de Montilla, the architect J. Gordillo or and the sculptor J. Llimona.

Also on the ground floor, you will find the local "snooker", specialized in pool games and cocktails. It was inaugurated in 1985 renovated by the architect S. Roqueta and the designer C. Riart winners of the FAD Prize for this work.

A wide range of dining options and shops can be found in the surrounding area. Airport trains leave from Passeig de Gracia Train Station, 10 minutes' walk away. Airport buses leave from Plaza Catalunya. Eixample is a great choice for travelers interested in architecture, food, and shopping.

443421.description: Dubai One Central welcomes you in the heart of Dubai's financial and commercial districts for both business trips and leisure. One of the best hotels in Dubai, ibis One Central hotel offers an easy access to Dubai International Convention and Exhibition Centre and is close to the very central World Trade Centre metro station. Chill out at the gym after a beautiful day and get a good night sleep in one of our sweet beds by ibis while staying connected with the free WiFi in our 588 modern guest rooms.

443581.description: These upmarket serviced apartments are located in the heart of London's Kensington district, close to Harrods, the Royal Albert Hall, and the Victoria and Albert Museum. Ideal for corporate travelers, leisure visitors, and families, these single and double apartments feature a private kitchen with a washing machine, cooker, and other amenities, including a large flat-screen TV, safe, and Wi-Fi. Breakfast is served daily. The Presidential Apartments are within walking distance of the underground, serving both the Piccadilly and District lines. All apartments are serviced daily by a team of professional housekeepers, and a 24-hour desk is available to assist with any needs, such as taxi and laundry services, as well as theater bookings.

443761.description: Located in the trendy Palermo neighbourhood, Feel Buenos Aires is a modern self-catering apartment with free WiFi access. The property is 4 blocks from Plaza Serrano Square and Plaza Costa Rica Square. Santa Fé Avenue is 5 blocks away. This fully furnished and bright apartment features air conditioning, heating, a 39' flat-screen TV and some kitchen facilities, including a microwave and an electric oven. It also comprises a dining table, a complete bathroom and a balcony. The apartment has housekeeping services every two days. Surrounded by many shops, bars and restaurants, Feel Buenos Aires is 1 km from the Hippodrome. Aeroparque Jorge Newbery Airport is 3 km away.

443781.description: 'This contemporary-style hotel, featuring warm, inviting materials and design details, is ideally situated in Palermo's most prestigious shopping district. Just one block from Santa Fe Avenue and three from Alto Palermo Shopping Mall, you'll have easy access to the metro, major transportation hubs, banks, and more. The hotel is also conveniently located near restaurants, museums, and other key attractions, with domestic and international airports within a 15- and 45-minute drive, respectively. '

443973.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Residence Inn Orangeburg, featuring an indoor pool, 24-hour fitness center, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Westchester County Airport (HPN) is the nearest airport, located 21. 5 miles away.

444521.description: Royalty Rio Hotel is set in the Copacabana district in Rio de Janeiro, 600 m from Copacabana Beach and 7 km away from Sugarloaf Mountain. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant. WiFi is offered free of charge in public areas. Each room is soundproof and equipped with air conditioning, minibar, flat-screen TV with cable channels and a working desk. Every unit includes a private bathroom. Royalty Rio Hotel also provide guests with free toiletries and a hair dryer. You will find a 24-hour front desk at the property and a communal sauna. Christ the Redeemer is 14 km from Royalty Rio Hotel, while Army Historic Museum and Fort of Copacabana is 1. 6 km away. The nearest airport is Santos Dumont Airport, 10 km from the property.

444522.description: Bloc Hotel Gatwick is ideally situated for both terminals, just a few short steps from the South Terminal Departure lounge. We offer our guests a new way to short stay through the ingenuity of our design and views of the world's most efficient single-runway airport. No other hotel will get you closer to your flight. Our rooms are efficient, sleek, and beautifully designed. The smallest details matter. Our sophisticated climate control system and Italian-tiled wet rooms with powerful drench showers mean you'll leave us refreshed and ready for your flight from Gatwick Airport.

444661.description: The Hotel Costa Brava welcomes you to Manzanillo, Colima, on Mexico's Pacific coast. Located in the tourist area on Miguel de la Madrid Boulevard, overlooking the Las Hadas golf course, our hotel offers 73 comfortable rooms equipped with Wi-Fi and cable TV. Enjoy our refreshing pool, wading areas, and snack bar, or dine in our specialty restaurant. We also provide ample parking and conference rooms for meetings and events. Experience an extraordinary stay with us.

445463.description: With a total of 1 units, this is a nice place to stay. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. 445481.description: The fully-renovated ibis Styles Genève Mont Blanc is ideally located in the center of Geneva and close to Cornavin train station. At Ibis Styles, a breakfast buffet and unlimited WIFI access are included in the price.

445501.description: The Tremo Bustamante, a 4-story boutique hotel in the Providencia district, offers 12 comfortable rooms, each with a private bathroom, internet access, cable TV, a safe, and air conditioning. Enjoy a complimentary continental breakfast and easy access to nearby attractions. Cerro San Cristobal, with its panoramic views of Santiago, is just steps away, and the subway, a mere three blocks from the hotel, provides quick access to the historic city center (La Moneda Palace, Museum of Fine Arts), the Costanera Center mall, and a variety of bars and restaurants. The hotel's lovely terrace provides a relaxing outdoor space. Ideal for families, groups, and couples, the Tremo Bustamante provides 24-hour reception service and a dedicated team ready to assist you with various tourism options. *Chilean clients must pay 19% VAT directly at the hotel.

name.content: Tryp By Wyndham Sao Paulo Guarulhos Airport

445981.address: Rodovia Helio Smidt - Gru Intl Airport - T3
445981.description:
TRYP by Wyndham São Paulo Guarulhos Airport is located inside the international boarding area, after immigration and passport control. Only passengers on international connections with no luggage to check in at Guarulhos Airport can access the area where the hotel is located. 

Passengers on domestic flights at Guarulhos or luggage to check in at Guarulhos cannot access the hotel. 

All rooms at this hotel include a desk. Rooms at this hotel include flat-screen TVs, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. In addition to a 24-hour front desk, there is an open-air garden (smoking permitted), a restaurant, a bar, and pet-friendly.

446001.description: Strategically placed in the heart of Itaguai city, the Tulip Inn Itaguai offers comfortable, modern facilities for business and leisure guests alike. This brand new 3 star hotel in Itaguai includes a range of onsite amenities for visitors to enjoy, including a welcoming staff, meeting rooms, and a bustling restaurant. Offering swift access to Rio de Janeiro and the Amazonian rainforest alike, Itaguai is an attractive destination near beaches and commercial facilities. Enjoy a day of sightseeing or attending business conferences in Itaguai, before retiring to your comfortable 3 star hotel room at the Tulip Inn Itaguai. There are 200 rooms available, all outfitted with a high standard of bedding and attractive contemporary furnishings. Rooms come equipped with private bathrooms, complimentary toiletries, and a host of other conveniences to give you the time and space you need to relax.

446424.description: Note: Reception with limited opening hours (10 - 18h). Please advise flight number and estimated arrival time when booking this hotel. Address: Calle Nuñez de Arce 14, 28012 Madrid, Spain. *our property is not responsible for lack of communication between agencies or between the agency and the client. BACHEROLLETTE / BACHELOR PARTIES ARE NOT ALLOWED. This property has a zero tolerance policy for groups who exhibit inappropriate behavior and eviction is instant and non negotiable. The property consists of 20 NON SMOKING units. It´s geared toward families with children and groups of friends. Pets are allowed on the s. Most of the apartments are located on upper floors but there are some on the ground floor. The elevator starts running between floors. All bathrooms equipped with boilers. Check in office is located in apartment E on the ground floor (¨Bajo E¨in Spanish, buzzer: ¨APARTAMENTOS¨). ALWAYS advise your arrival time. We do not have a 24 hour reception. . Check in after 6 pm: not possible without 48h prior notice. After 20h there is an extra fee depending on arrival time between 20 and 40€.

446441.description: Midtown Apartments is located between Casp and Bruc street, in the center of Barcelona. The building was built in the late nineteenth century building (1895). It was restored to turn it into 24 luxury apartments of 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms, between 49 and 106 m2. Now Midtown Apartments Barcelona is completely renovated without altering its original architecture. The apartments are designed to become a second spectacular residence, with all the comforts and luxuries of home. *Register of Tourism: ATB-000086.

446674.description: The Source Guest House is located a few kilometers from Marrakech, nestled within a two-hectare garden. Created as a haven for music, spa treatments, well-being, and relaxation, this tranquil retreat offers a unique experience. Guests can dine in one of two restaurants: the Salon, serving traditional Moroccan and international cuisine in a cozy setting warmed by a central fireplace, or the Pool House, offering both indoor and outdoor seating by the heated pool, with live music and barbecues on weekends. Overlooking the pool, the spa, managed by a yogi master, features two massage rooms (one single, one double), an indoor heated pool, a manicure/pedicure lounge, and a traditional hammam. Music is central to the guest house experience, with live performances by the pool, jam sessions on the rooftop, and concerts in the dedicated concert area near the recording studio. Guests also enjoy complimentary access to a high-tech cinema room with a PS4, projector, and DVD player. Each room boasts a private garden, a speaker system, and a Nectarome welcome set. High-quality linens, bathrobes, and comfortable slippers are provided. While rooms accommodate two guests, extra beds can be added in categories above the classic room.

name.content: Monverde – Wine Experience Hotel by Unlock Hotels

446681.description: Set within the rolling vineyards of Amarante, Monverde – Wine Experience Hotel is a 4-star, eco-certified property offering a tranquil retreat in Portugal's Vinho Verde region. The hotel features an on-site restaurant serving regional cuisine, a bar, and offers unique wine-focused activities such as tastings. Guests have access to both an indoor and a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, as well as a full-service spa with a sauna, steam room, and hot tub. Accommodation options include a range of rooms and suites, some of which feature a private balcony or terrace. Free Wi-Fi and on-site parking are available. The hotel is located 2. 5 miles from the Quinta da Lixa Winery.

446701.description: Discover London from The Lion and Key Hotel, located near the Olympic Village in Stratford and Westfield Stratford City, one of Europe's largest shopping centres. The hotel offers easy access to London's top attractions: the Natural History and Science Museums, Royal Albert Hall, and Kensington Palace are a 30-minute tube ride away. The West End and Knightsbridge are also within a 30-minute tube journey. The nearest tube station, Leyton (Central Line), is close by, and Leyton Midland Road Rail Station is a short walk away. The Lion and Key Hotel features 50 newly refurbished, modern rooms, each with a private bathroom, flat-screen TV, complimentary tea and coffee, free internet access, a hairdryer, and a minibar. Designed with the modern traveller in mind, each room offers a stylish and comfortable stay.

446721.address: Al Habtoor City, Sheikh Zayed Road
446721.description: Discover an urban oasis at the Hilton Dubai Al Habtoor City. Located on Sheikh Zayed Road, along the Dubai Water Canal, the hotel offers easy access to Downtown Dubai and the World Trade Centre, with the Dubai Metro station nearby. Guest rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows and a seating area with a sofa. Spacious bathrooms include a freestanding bathtub, separate shower, and dual-sink vanity. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Upgrade to a suite or executive room for enhanced amenities and Executive Lounge access. Savor diverse dining experiences, from regional US fare at Ribs & Brews to cocktails and light bites at the chic Firefly Lounge by the pool. Enjoy vibrant cocktails and a light menu at Blinq Cocktail Lounge, healthy options at The Café, or international selections at The Market. The hotel boasts three rooftop pools (including a kids' pool), a 24-hour gym with personal trainers, a spa, a complimentary Kids' Club, Hilton Honors benefits, and a shuttle to the beach and The Dubai Mall. Complimentary beach access is available at the Habtoor Grand Resort. For events, the hotel offers 15 meeting rooms and the expansive 1, 425-square-meter Al Joud Ballroom, accommodating up to 1, 200 guests. A pre-function hall is ideal for cocktail parties, and the on-site event planning team, state-of-the-art equipment, and catering ensure a seamless experience.

name.content: V Hotel Dubai, Curio Collection by Hilton

446722.description: Our intriguing hotel with upscale and bold design boasts a modern yet stimulating atmosphere. Find our reception desk on the 30th floor and be greeted with superb hospitality. Our guest rooms feature contemporary style with a subtle and soothing color scheme and provide you with all of the comforts of home during your stay. Choose a suite, which offers a separate lounge area, a luxurious bathroom and walk-in closet. Dare to go all out in the dual-level, two-bedroom Sky Villa Suite with views of Dubai's dazzling skyline. Delight in a delicious meal or cocktail at one of our restaurants or lounges. From Korean cuisine at NAMU to the celebrations of Mediterranean flavors at Level Seven, there is an option for anyone at our V Hotel Dubai restaurants. Socialize in one of our lounges or nightclub offering global rhythms and captivating views. Live it up or wind it down at the V Deck, offering a social pool setting during the day and upbeat scene at night. Power up at the V Gym, equipped with modern cardio and strength equipment - the perfect place to exercise during your stay. Stay connected with complimentary WiFi in all guest rooms and public areas. Hilton Honors benefits are available. Host an event for up to 500 guests in the 725 sq. m. Amazing Room featuring state-of-the-art amenities. Our expert event planners will help elevate your event to the next level.

447401.description: Located in Barcelona's vibrant Eixample district, Abamita Apartments offers nine elegant apartments near iconic landmarks like the Sagrada Familia and Palau de la Música Catalana. Each apartment features marble floors, air conditioning, a 40-inch flat-screen TV, and free Wi-Fi. The stylish kitchens include an oven, ceramic hob, microwave, and coffee machine. Bed linens, towels, basic cleaning products, and cooking items are provided. The Gothic Quarter is a mere 500 meters away, while Casa Batlló, La Pedrera, and Passeig de Gràcia are within a 15-minute walk. Plaza Catalunya, with its airport bus station, and the bustling Rambla Catalunya, gateway to the renowned Mercat de Sant Josep de la Boqueria, are a short 10-minute stroll away. Tetuan metro station, conveniently located near the apartments, provides direct access to Parc de Montjuïc. The staff can also assist with purchasing Tourist Bus tickets for exploring Barcelona's port and beaches.

448761.description: The Dazzler Polo is located in one of the most attractive and central neighborhood of Buenos Aires. The hotel is surrounded by wide green parks, embassies and major avenues, offering a variety of dining options. Located a few meters from the Argentinian Polo Stadium and the Palermo Hippodrome, the hotel offers 133 rooms that combine design and comfort. Furthermore, it provides gym, solarium and a heated outdoor pool with a unique view in the top floor.

448901.description: In MET34 we have created a heaven for the visitors of Athens that are looking for a modern and luxurious hotel in the center of Athens, with high quality personalized service. In MET34 we have embraced the hospitality philosophy of our sister hotel and taking advantage of our special rooms and suites we have evolved it to a great hotel for families, groups of friends and corporate travelers!Our Rooms & Suites feature the latest hospitality equipment and technology and our staff is dedicated to offer you the best hotel experience in Athens! MET34 is in the center of Athens and we want to make sure that you will take advantage of its great location. We are always here to assist you; before your trip, during your stay or after your departure we will make sure that your vacation in Athens will be extraordinary!

448961.description: Located between the sea and the mountains, with a superb balcony position overlooking the Mediterranean sea. Character and originality, together with an enviable hotel location, make for an unforgettable experience you will want to repeat. 33 spacious, quiet and modern rooms, including two suites with jacuzzi, all with minibar, coffee capsules, bathrobes and free Wi-Fi. Perfect for relaxing after daytime activities and night time fun. Just 30 minutes from the airport of Barcelona - El Prat and 45 minutes from Gerona airport. Very well connected by the motorway C-32 (at only 500 meters from exit 92), by bus with direct connection to the Barcelona city center (stop just opposite from the hotel) and 3 km from the train station. Outdoor swimming pool, restaurant, café with a large outdoor terrace and playground, Sorli Sports Sports Centre with paddle tennis courts and Spa where you can enjoy a relaxing and sensory experience with the team of specialists from Natura Bissé. And 2 meeting rooms, equipped with projector, screen and audio with the latest technology equipment for all kinds of events.

name.content: Days Inn By Wyndham Rio De Janeiro Lapa

449022.description: Centrally located between the vibrant Santa Teresa neighborhood and Guanabara Bay coast Days Inn by Wyndham Rio de Janeiro Lapa is your guide to Brazils Marvelous City. Explore Rio by visiting nearby Christ the Redeemer on Corcovado ascending to Sugarloaf Mountain via cable car or taking a trip to the famous Copacabana Beach. We are also just three km from Santos Dumont Airport SDU and within easy reach of Rio de Janeiro-Galeao International Airport GIG.

449165.description: Glamour Hotel is located in the heart of Istanbul's historic Old City on the Historical Peninsula. This newly restored building offers comfortable rooms with Bosphorus views and a terrace. Elegantly decorated, each room is well-appointed with air conditioning, satellite television, free wired and wireless high-speed internet, a minibar, tea/coffee making facilities, a hairdryer, and a safety deposit box. The Marmaray metro station is conveniently located just 20 meters from the hotel, providing easy access to Atatürk Airport, other parts of the city, and the Asian side. All major attractions and historical museums are within walking distance.

449181.description:
Queen's Park Resort & Spa is a five star hotel located in the heart of Tekirova where the sea and the nature meets with the unique mountain view at the background. It is placed on 60.000 m² green land with a wide front-line right on the beach. Queen's Park Resort & Spa is 60km from Antalya International Airport and surrounded with Phaselis and Olympos Antique Cities, Tahtalı Mountain and Three Islands Diving Site which all are world famous historical and touristic places.

Queen's Park Resort & Spa with its Blue Flag certified large beach, swimming pools and several activity selections are promissing a peaceful and enjoyable vacation where you can explore the beauty of Mediterranean.

name.content: Club Regina Cancun managed by Accor

449640.description: Club Regina Puerto Vallarta managed by Accor allow you to dip into the outdoor swimming pools, unwind in the beach or enjoy other recreational amenities, which include a fitness center. Additional features at this aparthotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Grab dinner at Restaurant Inizio, a restaurant that specializes in Mexican cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Featured amenities include express check-out, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Self-parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 69 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Cable television is provided for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and ceiling fans.

449991.description: Located on Beach Road in Gordon's Bay, Cape Gordonia offers self-catering apartments with panoramic views across False Bay and towards the Helderberg mountains. The property is positioned across the road from the Blue Flag Bikini Beach, providing direct beachfront access. Designed for families and couples, the accommodation features two and three-bedroom apartments, each with a furnished balcony or patio. All apartments provide fully equipped kitchens for self-catering, separate living areas, and complimentary Wi-Fi. On-site amenities include free private parking and barbecue facilities. For guests with children, the property offers family rooms and babysitting services can be arranged. Nearby points of interest include Harmony Park, which is a 4. 8 km drive away.

449998.description: Formosa Bay is a family-friendly hotel located in Plettenberg Bay, near the beach. Enjoy on-site amenities including an outdoor pool, tennis court, sauna, and arcade/game room. The hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a hair salon, and an on-site restaurant for a satisfying meal. Each of the six guestrooms features a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower, safe, and electric kettle. Daily housekeeping is provided. Free self-parking and a safe deposit box at the front desk are also available. Nearby attractions include Plett Puzzle Park and Van Plettenberg Beacon, both within a 5-minute drive.

450016.address: 4 Upper Cross Street P.O. Box 464 P.O. Box 464
450016.description: Mossel Bay (less than a mile from the resort) is known for its traditional friendliness, its history, its commercial harbor, its closeness to lush Wilderness country, the rainforest of Knysna, Oudtshoorn's ostriches, the splendor of the Cango Caves, and seven hundred species of shells. This popular town is called 'Pearl of the Outeniqua' mountain region, at the heart of the Garden Route.

450018.address: West Coast Road Port Owen P.O. Box 117
450018.description: These self catering cabanas are situated at Port Owen, 90 minutes' drive up the west coast from Cape Town. Here, sun, seafood and sailing are always part of the menu.

450026.address: Beach Road BEACH ROAD P.O. Box 684
450026.description: The Strand Pavilion is situated centrally to a vast and exciting area, brimming with attractions and activities just waiting to be explored and discovered. Extending 25m over the ocean within the deep blue crescent of False Bay, this resort offers self-catering apartments with panoramic sea and mountain views exclusive to the beautiful Cape. Enjoy all round views from the sun deck and dine in the restaurant overlooking the ocean. For the romantics, a sunset beach stroll or a brisk walk in the early mornings is definitely food for the soul. Facilities include a coffee shop, solar heated splash pool, conference facilities and restaurants. Tourist Information Centre and winelands tours - enquire at reception.

451221.description: Combining an elegant and minimalist environment with sophisticated features and the latest technology, Lux Lisboa Park Hotel is the right choice for those looking for a quality stay in the center of Lisbon. Our 4-star hotel is just a 5-minute walk from Parque Eduardo VII and 10 minutes from Praça Marquês de PombalThe elegant, soundproofed rooms are tastefully decorated and feature soft tones and wooden floors. Each includes air conditioning, a seating area and a flat-screen cable TV. We also have rooms with balcony. The Lux Lisboa Park offers concierge service and includes meeting facilities, a bar and a rooftop with a heated outdoor pool, where you can relax after a day of visits or business. You can also count on free wi-fi throughout the hotel, open reception 24 hours a day, laundry service, gym and room service.

451921.address: Av. Lúcio Costa, 17360 - Recreio dos Bandeirantes, 17360
451921.description: The CDesign Hotel offers spectacular beach views in Recreio dos Bandeirantes, situated directly opposite the beach and just 1. 5 km from Plaza de Pontal. Guests enjoy free WiFi throughout the property. Each room features air conditioning, a flat-screen cable TV, a safe, a minibar, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. The hotel provides a restaurant and a 24-hour reception. The CDesign Hotel is conveniently located 23 km from João Havelange Olympic Stadium (Engenhão), 24 km from Vidigal Beach, and 33 km from Rio de Janeiro-Galeão International Airport. In accordance with Municipal Decree No. 49335/21, guests are required to present proof of vaccination upon check-in, effective September 15, 2021.

452121.address: 5/7 Adeola Ajayi Street, Ajao Estate, Ikeja, Lagos, 5/7
452121.description: Welcome to Royal View Hotel, set within Adeola Ajayi Crescent in Ajao Estate, Lagos. Each spacious room has an air conditioner, a television, tea/coffee making facilities, a fridge and a private bathroom with hot and cold shower and toilet. The onsite restaurant serves a variety of local and continental dishes which can be enjoyed in the spacious dining room. Royal View Hotel features a swimming pool, a gym and a lounge. Laundry/ dry cleaning, car hire and babysitting services are offered to guests at a surcharge. The hotel also offers conferencing facilities to guests at a fee. The premises are guarded by trained security personnel. Onsite parking is available Royal View Hotel and Suites is a 10 minute drive from the airport. Domino Diner and Welcome Centre Hotel are in close proximity to the hotel.

452123.address: Plot 20 & 21, T.F Kuboye Road, Lekki Phase 1, Lekk
452123.description: Welcome to Newcastle Hotels Limited, nestled in the serene yet vibrant Lekki Phase 1 district of Lagos. Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, our hotel offers a tranquil escape. We provide a variety of rooms to suit every guest, totaling 52 accommodations. Modern amenities include parking, laundry service, car hire, wireless internet, a swimming pool, a bar and lounge, and event halls. We also offer 24-hour electricity and airport pickups upon request. For recreation, Newcastle Hotels Limited is just a short drive from the lively Oniru and Lekki beaches, as well as the Shoprite Mall.

452202.description: Metrolux Hotel is only walking distance to all amazing historical places, like Grand Bazaar 700 meters, Topkapi Palace1200 meters,  St. Sophia Museum 1200 meters, Blue Mosque, Underground Cistern…Its a family hotel located center of Old City..

452213.address: Emin Sinan Mahallesi Pertevpaşa Sokak No:46/1, 46
452213.description: Located in Istanbul's historic Fatih district, just 600 meters from the magnificent Blue Mosque, this hotel offers comfortable accommodations with complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Each air-conditioned room features a flat-screen TV, and select rooms include a seating area for added convenience. All rooms are equipped with a private bathroom stocked with slippers, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. Guests can also benefit from the 24-hour front desk service. Topkapi Palace is 1. 2 km from the hotel, and Istanbul Ataturk Airport is 15 km away. This area is highly rated by travelers for its captivating monuments, fascinating museums, and welcoming atmosphere.

name.content: Elite World Grand İstanbul Basın Ekspres Hotel

452214.description: The 5-star Elite World Europe Hotel, a new business hub in Istanbul's Basın Ekspres district, opened in February 2017. Whether for business or leisure, guests enjoy high-quality accommodations, just 5 minutes from Atatürk International Airport and 12 minutes from CNR Expo, IDTM, and TUYAP. Istanbul's city center and historic district are a mere 25-minute drive away. The hotel boasts 401 luxurious rooms and suites, eight meeting rooms for up to 2, 500 people, and exceptional dining experiences. Savor authentic Turkish and international cuisine at The Brasserie Grill Restaurant, indulge in daily treats at The Coffee Company, and unwind at The One Bar.

452216.description: . *** Customers with Egyptian nationality who stay in the hotel sharing a room must provide a marriage certificate

452217.description: Cassino Tower Piracicabais economical and has excellent service. The hotel is located in the city centre, 180m from the Court of Justice, 2, 7km from the Engenho Central; offers easy access to the region businesses. The rooms are cozy, spacious and functional, with air conditioning, WIFI and cable TV. It has meeting rooms and parking, and is ideal for those who love creativity!

452302.description: It is located in the heart of Madrid's Gran VíaThe establishment offers visitors an innovative and avant-garde concept. Its originality surprises and is perceived as soon as you enter the hotel. The experience begins by checking in at a bar, where you can carry out all the arrangements for your stay while you enjoy a soft drink or a cocktail in this peculiar space, there is no traditional reception. It has a total of 88 rooms and suites, spacious and bright, distributed in Double rooms, Double rooms with views, Deluxe, Tower, Junior Suite, City Break Suite and Peppermint Suite. Among its services, it is worth highlighting its rooftop terrace with incredible views of Gran Vía, where you can enjoy a snack outdoors in the original food truck installed in this space.

452361.description: Dip into one of the 9 outdoor swimming pools or enjoy other recreational amenities including a water park and a health club. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a picnic area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and 8 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 158 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and minibars. Rooms have private furnished balconies. LCD televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

452568.address: Yenibosna Merkez Mahallesi 1 Asena Sok No:15 Bahce, 4A
452568.description: The Pullman Istanbul Hotel & Convention Center is a mere five-minute drive from the World Trade Center and CNR Expo Fair Center, and conveniently close to major city attractions such as Taksim and the Old City. With 403 rooms, this hotel offers guests luxury and comfort. Amenities include free Wi-Fi, a restaurant, a bar, and an executive lounge. A variety of meeting rooms and a convention hall are also available for events.

452721.description: This outstanding hotel boasts a prime location in Lisbon's emblematic Praça do Município, capturing the essence of its surroundings. Housed in a beautifully restored 18th-century building, originally rebuilt after the devastating 1755 earthquake, the hotel weaves the city's history into its very fabric. Each uniquely styled room, designed by prestigious interior designer Giano Gonçalves, offers comfort and simplicity with premium amenities, including anti-allergic duvets. Guests can savor fine Portuguese cuisine and a more casual menu at the on-site restaurant, sure to impress even the most discerning palates. Public underground parking is available just in front of the hotel (entrance 2 meters away). Please inform the reception upon arrival to receive discounted parking rates: €35 for 24 hours or €20 from 7 pm to 10 am, payable at reception.

452841.description: Located in a steep and charming street, next to belvederes, churches and palaces it is minutes away from Chiado. The undergone renovation has preserved all the architectural features of a 19th century building while adapting its interiors to the concept 'smart & chic'. It is close to Santos, Lisbon's “Design District”, where you will find many restaurants and nightlife. It includes studios and one-bedroom apartments. This neighborhood is famous for its historical buildings that offer a scenic landscape, and for its social life, as it's full of bars, restaurants, local places playing live fado music and terraces to enjoy the Portuguese night. Bairro Alto is as well popular for the bohemian image given by the new and young designers settled in this area.

452842.description: Create unforgettable holiday memories at Orange County Alanya - Family Concept, where the serene blue sea meets a vibrant holiday atmosphere. Here, you'll find the perfect balance of peace and excitement. The hotel's seaside location offers stunning ocean views. Enjoy the lively pier or relax on the private sandy beach. Younger guests will love the children's pool, waterslides, and Mini-Club. With ultra all-inclusive service, Orange County Alanya provides a comfortable, home-away-from-home experience. Choose from a variety of modern rooms designed with your needs in mind. Enjoy unlimited activities, presentations, and dining options at the restaurants and bars open throughout the day. We hope to see you soon!

452861.description: This hotel is perfect for families, this sophisticated hotel in Side is situated within 3. 0 kilometers from the town center and is easily accessible on foot to a host of places of interest and at a short walk from the main entertainment areas. Visitors will find numerous public transport links within walking distance. The nearest beach is within 300 meters from the establishment. The Hotel is within 5. 0 km from the harbor. There are 5 swimming pools with slides on site. The hotel has a sauna and fitness center, and guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant or a drink at the bar. Wired and wireless internet connections are available at the property. All the necessary services and amenities for a successful business event are provided. The accommodation's entertainment was designed to amuse all kinds of travelers. The accommodations include mini-bar and tea & coffee setup. Extras include bathrobes, slippers and toiletries.

452943.description: Situated on Atocha Street in the centre of Madrid, this modern hostel is a five-minute walk from Plaza Mayor and 300 metres from Puerta del Sol. The property provides a variety of accommodation, including private rooms and single beds in mixed or female-only dormitories, catering to families, groups, and solo travellers. All rooms are air-conditioned and feature complimentary Wi-Fi. Depending on the type selected, rooms come with either a private or a shared bathroom, and some include a small balcony. Key amenities include a 24-hour reception, a terrace, laundry facilities, and luggage storage. Guests also have access to a shared kitchen and a communal lounge area. The hostel is located 0. 8 km from the Prado Museum and 1. 2 km from the Royal Palace of Madrid.

452961.description: Whether you're traveling with friends, family, or on your own, Oh! Porto offers the perfect accommodations for your visit to Porto. Located along the Douro River, facing the iconic D. Luís bridge, Oh! Porto consists of six fully furnished and versatile apartments. Each apartment provides comfortable accommodations and breathtaking views of the city, river, and bridges. But Oh! Porto offers more than just stunning scenery. It provides an immersive Porto experience, creating lasting memories that will entice you to return time and again. So relax, enjoy the view, and experience the best of Porto. The property features six apartments and offers internet access. Reception is open until 7 pm, and later check-ins can be arranged with prior notice. The building has an elevator, and check-out is at noon. Pets are welcome.

453161.description: The Lucky 8 Hotel in Ilford offers free WiFi and a 24-hour front desk. Each room features a desk, wardrobe, and private bathroom. Guests can enjoy a full English/Irish breakfast. The hotel also boasts a terrace. Central London is a 20-minute train ride away, and the historic Valentines Park is just 0. 6 miles from the hotel, conveniently located opposite Ilford rail station. London City Airport is 3. 7 miles away.

453241.description: This hotel is located New Cairo district, a residential and quiet environment where you can also find entertainment and fun. It is a fresh and modern hotel. It has a total of 114 rooms, including some suites. All rooms are very spacious, bright and have all necessary amenities to make your stay a comfortable and memorable experience. Among the hotel amenities include rooms prepared for holding events such as meetings, conferences and banquets, as well as the variety of bars and restaurants from which you can choose. The hotel also offers a swimming pool with its own bar for warmer days.

453421.description: This Kizilot resort, situated in Turkey's Mediterranean region, is 37 km from Alanya. It features a private beach, spa, wellness center, and outdoor pool. Free private parking is available on-site. Each room offers natural light, comfortable furnishings, and a charming private balcony where guests can enjoy the Mediterranean breezes. Select rooms boast sea, pool, or garden views. The property also offers fully equipped, stylish meeting facilities with a 200-person capacity, perfect for business needs. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the resort.

453422.address: Kemankes Kara Mustafa Pasa Mah Kemankes Cad. No:57, 57-59
453422.description: Istanbul offers a wide variety of choices to visitors with its historical background, modern architecture and business opportunities. Novotel Istanbul Bosphorus Hotel has a splendid situation among the most preferred luxury hotels on the European side. Its perfect location in Karaköy, comfortable and stylish rooms, flavors from ethnic to international dishes and modern facilities make Novotel Istanbul Bosphorus Hotel a highly preferable five-star accommodation venue in Istanbul.

453561.description: In the heart of old Istanbul, Oban Suites is only a quarter mile from the Blue Mosque and a 10 minute walk from Hagia Sophia. It provides spacious rooms with free wireless internet access. Each of the rooms is fully air-conditioned and includes original architectural features and high ceilings. Some rooms have a private balcony with sea views. Each morning, guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast on Oban Suites's shaded terrace. Several traditional falafel stands and restaurants offering international cuisine are a 5 minute walk from the hotel. Guests can enjoy the hotel's dry cleaning and ironing services. There is also a tour desk that assists with car rental and offers information on local attractions. Oban Suites is 5 minute from the Grand Bazaar and is a 10 minute walk from Sultanahmet Square.

453801.description: The Beach Boutique is located in the picturesque fishing village of Pamunugama, Sri Lanka, in close proximity to Colombo, Negombo and Bandaranaike International Airport. Designed by Channa Daswatte of Geoffrey Bawa fame, The Beach Boutique features the use of open spaces, which capture the beauty of the property's natural surroundings. name.content: Holiday Inn New York City Times Square

456861.description: Enjoy all the excitement that the Big Apple offers when staying at the Holiday Inn New York City – Times Square. Nestled in the heart of the bustling Garment District, our Midtown Manhattan hotel is steps away from the city’s must-see attractions, including Hudson Yards, Madison Square Garden, The Javits Center, Times Square, Bryant Park, Herald Square and much more! For further exploring, our Hell’s Kitchen location offers easy access to public transportation. Dine at our on-site restaurant, Latitude 39, serving breakfast lunch, and dinner. The 42nd St. Port Authority Bus Terminal and New York Penn Station are located less than a half-mile from the hotel. If you’re looking to travel like the locals, try renting a Citi-bike and enjoy the amazing food, shopping and sightseeing in the city that never sleeps. After a day of exploring the lively city, relax and rewind in our renovated guest rooms. On top of sweeping NYC views, our inviting Midtown hotel offers a variety of thoughtful amenities and perks that appeal to all our guests – from children to business travelers! Some of our key features include: kids stay and eat for free, affordable room rates, in-room desk & coffee-maker, free high-speed Internet, an on-site Business Center and a 24-hour Fitness Center.

462722.description: Hotel NH Collection Buenos Aires Centro Histórico, in the historic center of the city, is surrounded by cultural gems. Our corner rooms have views of the city's landmarks like Plaza de Mayo, Catedral Metropolitana and Cabildo. Downstairs you'll find the classically decorated restaurant, serving international dishes and Argentinian favorites with a gourmet touch. Expect the tastiest steaks in the world – our country's famous for them. The breakfast room gets lots of natural light and serves tasty hot menu options like sausages and eggs.
