This hotel has 11485 square feet (1067 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 10 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

466601.description: Centro Doha is conveniently located in central Doha, just minutes from major avenues, attractions, businesses, and Doha International Airport. This hotel offers 227 stylish rooms designed for budget-conscious travelers who don't want to compromise on quality. Each room features the latest in-room technology and personal amenities. Centro Doha also boasts three distinct dining options: C-Deli, C-Mondo, and C-Taste.

466602.description: Located in Milan's Sant'Ambrogio area, the B&B Hotel Milano Sant'Ambrogio offers an affordable stay near key landmarks. Just 300 meters from the subway, it provides easy access to the city's bustling business districts. While offering a tranquil escape from the urban hustle, the hotel is conveniently placed for exploring Milan's cultural treasures. Please note: For arrivals between 11 PM and 7 AM, contact the hotel at least 48 hours in advance.

467201.address: Avenida das Americas, 10500 - Barra da Tijuca, 10500
467201.description: Americas Barra Hotel is in the Barra da Tijuca neighborhood of Rio de Janeiro, 9. 2 km from the Riocentro Convention Center. With modern décor, all rooms at the hotel feature air conditioning, flat-screen TV, telephone, minibar and private bathroom with shower. Extras amenities include linens. At the Americas Barra Hotel, you will find a 24-hour front desk, room service and a bar. You can also enjoy local and international cuisine at the on-site restaurant. The hotel is 7. 5 km from Recreio dos Bandeirantes Beach, 9. 3 km from the HSBC Arena and 1. 5 km from the Olympic Park. The Galeão International Airport is 36 km away. Barra da Tijuca is a great choice for travelers interested in gastronomy, beaches with strip of sand and watching the sun rise. We speak your language!

467401.description: A 5-minute walk from Kings Cross-St Pancras, SO Kings Cross offers simple rooms. It features a 24-hour reception and offers luggage storage. Rooms at SO Kings have cream-coloured décor. There is free WiFi, satellite TV and an en suite bathroom. A 10-minute stroll will take you to Regent's Canal and a small selection of restaurants, set behind the nearby station. Angel and the bars and cafés of Upper Street can be reached in 20 minutes by foot. The Piccadilly Line from Kings Cross connects you to Heathrow Airport in just over an hour.

467726.address: Chhatrapati Shivaji Off Western Express Highway
467726.description: With a stay at Taj Santacruz in Mumbai, you'll be 2. 8 mi (4. 5 km) from Juhu Beach and 2. 9 mi (4. 6 km) from MIDC Industrial Estate. This luxury hotel is 4. 5 mi (7. 2 km) from U. S. Consulate General and 13. 6 mi (21. 8 km) from Gateway of India. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an outdoor pool, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 279 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. 40-inch LED televisions and DVD players are provided, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and complimentary newspapers. Enjoy international cuisine at Tiqri, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee.

467761.description: Thank you so much for choosing us as your home away from home. We hope you can feel comfortable in our cosy and quiet rooms, and that our central location will take you to see everything you wish for in your stay in our beautiful city!VERY IMPORTANT NOTICE: Esqina Urban Lodge only opens reception from 8:30AM to 5PM, all check ins and check outs before or after those hours will be done virtually through WhatsApp. Please let us know about your arrival time so that we can contact you and give all the needed information. If you arrive in between 8:30 and 5PM you will have our kind and very helpful staff that will assist you in everything you may need. If you could please send us your email and/or WhatsApp number so that we can start preparing your stay and also can communicate with you during your days with us it would be awesome. Having that in mind we would love to get to know a bit more about you, and your stay in Lisbon. Do you want us to book a transfer, for just 35 euros we can arrange a shuttle to pick you up from the airport? Is there any specific event you would like to attend?Lisbon is again full of life, events and places to see, so please do let us know if you want to start planning any activities, walks, visits to museums or other things you would like to do and we will help you with all of it. Also, in our sister property we have this amazing farm to table restaurant (the name of the restaurant is Queimado, you can find it at www. esqinacosmopolitanlodge. com) and we can make a reservation for you. Or any other restaurant?Thank you very much and see you soon!

name.content: Ramada By Wyndham Istanbul Golden Horn

468121.description: Stay at Ramada Hotel and Suites Istanbul Golden Horn located nearby Halic Congress Center. Amenities include a spa two onsite restaurants meeting space and a jetted hot tub. Rooms provide complimentary wireless internet coffee and tea maker mini bar desk sitting area and more. Attractions include Sultan Ahmed Mosque Hagia Sophia and Eyup Sultan Mosque. Sorry no pets.

468161.description: Described as an urban oasis, this luxury boutique hotel is nestled in the heart of Victoria Island, the business capital of Lagos. It offers unique style, spacious guest rooms and suites, and exceptionally gracious service, making it an ideal getaway for both business and leisure travelers. S&S Hotel remains the hotel of choice for business travelers who require a convenient central location and a welcome haven that feels like a second home. Our unrivaled services are personified by the warmth and dedication of our staff. The hotel is also ideal for discerning leisure travelers seeking captivating dining and limitless nightlife within walking distance. These are just some of the features that set S&S Hotel apart as a decidedly unique and intimate luxury boutique hotel. Experience our world of timeless style, unsurpassed comfort, and understated elegance.

468241.description: The Antara Hotel is renowned among visitors. Located in the heart of Lima's Miraflores district, between two of the city's main avenues, Larco and Benavides, the hotel is just six blocks from the beach. Miraflores is an excellent choice for travelers interested in gourmet food, culture, and museums, with attractions such as Larcomar conveniently nearby. Guests enjoy elegant and spacious rooms and can savor innovative international dishes, as well as traditional Peruvian cuisine and drinks, at the hotel's restaurant.

468527.description: Located a short 5-minute drive from Porta Garibaldi Train Station in Milan, the B&B Hotel Milano Cenisio Garibaldi offers modern rooms with high-speed fiber optic internet access. Each air-conditioned room features a satellite TV and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. The hotel is conveniently located 150 meters from the Cenisio Metro Station, providing easy access to Porta Garibaldi Metro and Train Station. Sempione Park, known for its stunning architecture, is just 1 km away, while the Rho FieraMilano Exhibition Centre is within 11 km.

468578.description: The Comfort Inn Syosset - Jericho hotel in Syosset, NY along the Gold Coast of Long Island near the largest corporate park in the region will get you rested and ready for anything. This hotel is near other sites and activities like the Westbury Music Fair, Old Westbury Gardens, Bethpage State Park Golf Courses and Jones Beach. We also offer easy access to several New York City attractions. Amenities include free hot breakfast, free WiFi, free coffee bar, meeting space that can accommodate up to 180 event attendees, flat-screen TVs, desks and hair dryers. Upper-tier suites have even more amenities, such as living rooms with sofa sleepers. Also, earn rewards including free nights and gift cards with our Choice Privileges Rewards program.

468637.description: A good night and a great savings await you at the Rodeway Inn Huntington Station - Melville hotel in Huntington Station, NY.  Our hotel is close to attractions like the Museum of Arts, Fox Hollow Country Club Heckscher, Cold Spring Harbor, Historic Huntington Village and Adventureland Amusement Park. Enjoy our amenities like free breakfast, free WiFi, a fitness center and free coffee. Our fresh, clean rooms offer microwaves, irons and ironing boards, hair dryers, TVs and desks. Also, earn rewards including free nights and gift cards with our Choice Privileges Rewards program. No pets allowed.

468921.description:
A modern and luxurious Suites connected to Treppan Hotel and Suites. Couples spacious, residential-style accommodation with a unique hotel facilities and services. 
Treppan Hotel and Suites a new rebranding hotel operated by Fakhruddin properties located in most progressive area of Dubai's Sports City. 

Guests can enjoy a variety of cuisines at Zuri Café with the selection of pastries and hot drinks. Refreshing soft drinks and light snacks are served as well. 

Each spacious Suites of 304 units are decorated in a modern theme and furnished with a premium quality of bedding and linen, a 30“-40“flat TV screen and a working desk . Our family-friendly amenities include all kitchen appliances, tea & coffee facilities, a personal safe and a fridge. Each bathroom includes a bath, a hairdryer and complimentary toiletries. 

Treppan Hotel also boasts a state-of-the-art fitness center , sauna, steam bath which are available to guests. A rooftop swimming pool with its terrace which is open from 08:00 hrs to 18:00 hrs UAE Standard Time (GMT+4)

The hotel also offers a complimentary shuttle bus to Dubai Mall , Mall Of The Emirates and Ibn Battuta Mall , ensuring a hassle-free and an enjoyable short journey.

469121.description: A design hotel in Milan, in the heart of the city, an environment that is luxurious but also informal and cozy: Nemi Hotel is something that was not there yet. Art objects of refined taste, modern furnishing and contemporary luxury: Nemi Hotel Milan welcomes its guests with luxury and beauty, in large cozy spaces where to feel at home and at ease. The large building on several levels, a historic building once seat of an ancient boarding school, has been completely renovated and redesigned to create a new intriguing concept: the result is a sophisticated art villa.

469782.description:
Located in Aksaray, Sinem Hotel features a terrace overlooking the city views. Free WiFi access is available in all areas of the property. The 24-hour front desk provides room service.Each room here will provide you with satellite TV, air conditioning and a minibar. Featuring a shower, private bathroom also comes with a hairdryer and free toiletries. You can enjoy city view from the room.Sinem Hotel provides car rentals and airport shuttle services upon request. You can also benefit from laundry and dry cleaning services at an additional charge.You can start the day with a rich breakfast. You can also taste refined flavours at the on-site restaurant, and have a drink at the bar.
The historic peninsula is within 3.5 km, and Istanbul Ataturk Airport is 17.5 km away.

469821.description:
Due to the current travel environment, this hotel is currently not accepting guests for a short period. Reservations are available for future dates. Please see below for up-to-date policy information and ways to contact Hilton Guest Assistance. We look forward to welcoming you to the hotel soon.Retire to a spacious guest room or suite at the Hilton Garden Inn Istanbul Beylikduzu hotel and find everything you need for a comfortable and productive stay. Enjoy a peaceful night's sleep on the sumptuous bed and watch movies on the HDTV. Catch up with work at the desk and surf the web with complimentary WiFi. We also offer practical amenities such as a fridge and tea/coffee maker to help you feel at home. Upgrade to a stylish suite for extra space with separate sleeping and living areas, ideal for families.

Make the most of your leisure time and work out in the 24-hour fitness center, swim in the indoor pool or sample local and international dishes in our tempting onsite restaurant. Each morning enjoy our delicious cooked-to-order breakfast and in the evening retire to the lounge for a refreshing drink in a relaxing atmosphere.

Host your next corporate event or social function at this Beylikduzu hotel with over 5,000 sq. ft. of flexible meeting space, including five modern meeting rooms. Our friendly and knowledgeable staff can cater to events with up to 80 guests, offering an ideal venue for a variety of events, including receptions, weddings and business events.

470183.description:
Stylish, warm and welcoming, the Hampton by Hilton Bogotá - Usaquén hotel offers guests an ideal location in the upmarket neighborhood of Usaquén, in the north of Bogotá. We are 30 minutes from International El Dorado Airport, and within easy reach of vibrant downtown and the city's primary industrial and business parks. In addition, our Bogotá hotel is just a short walk from lots of fantastic cafes and restaurants, shopping malls and lively nightlife. 

Feel at home in a bright and modern guest room, equipped with free WiFi, a 32-inch HDTV, a coffeemaker, a mini-fridge, a well-lit desk with comfy chair, and a security box. The queen-sized clean and fresh Hampton bed has a premium mattress, triple sheeted bedding and four soft pillows, ensuring a great night's sleep after a busy day. 

There is a hot breakfast included when you stay at this welcoming Bogotá hotel. Buy snacks, drinks and travel essentials in the 24-hour convenience store. Our 7th floor terrace offers a contemporary fitness center, equipped with state-of-the-art equipment and offering fantastic city views. There is also a spacious meeting room on this floor – ideal for social receptions and business events for up to 30 people. 

Friendly service, clean rooms, comfortable surroundings, every time. If you're not satisfied, we don't expect you to pay. That's our commitment and your guarantee. That's 100% Hampton by Hilton.

470202.description: Riad Azalia is a nice and old Guest house Located in Medina, this riad is within a 05-minute walk walk from Jamaâ El Fna Square. Dar Si Said Museum. Bahia Palace and Marrakesh Museum are also within 15 minutes. Offering a rooftop terrace with views of the medina and the Atlas Mountains, this traditional riad offers air-conditioned guestrooms. Each room at the Riad Azalia has a traditional Moroccan decor and offers an en suite bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer , showers, and free toiletries. Rooms overlook the riad's interior courtyard. All 8 rooms offer free WiFi and free wired Internet, plus room service and premium bedding. Other amenities available to guests include safes. Breakfast is served each morning at Riad Azalia and can be enjoyed on the terrace. The riad offers a lounge with a flat-screen TV where guests are invited to enjoy some mint tea.

470241.description: Set in the exclusive, seaside suburb of Vouliagmeni, Somewhere Vouliagmeni boasts an outdoor pool and magnificent sea views. This boutique hotels also features gym facilities, a business centre and conference facilities. Free WiFi is available throughout.Elegantly designed, each room and suite at Somewhere Vouliagmeni boasts sea, garden or pool views. Some suites boasts their own outdoor hot tub. Each room and suite features a private bathroom where free toiletries are available. Air conditioning comes standard.The property's restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner made of high quality ingredients. Guests may enjoy tailor-made cocktails right by the pool area. 24-hour room services are provided.The cosmopolitan area of Glyfada, boasting an array of high-profile restaurants and boutiques, lies within 6 km of the property.

470422.description:
Jan Harmsgat is set in a historic 17th-century farmhouse surrounded by the Langeberg Mountains and the Breede River. It is decorated throughout with classical Victorian furnishings and features a restaurant, bar and outdoor swimming pool.
All elegantly presented accommodation includes heating, air conditioning and a luxurious private bathroom, some with freestanding bathtub. Each room or suite has its own distinctive style and history.
The country, fine dining restaurant makes use of its location amongst sloping vineyards and orchards producing a range of fruits and nuts. Fresh homemade cuisine is served throughout the day and can be combined with a local wine from the cellar.

470542.description:
The Hotel is Situated in Riyadh, 1. 3 km from Kingdom Center, AWFAD Hotel features an outdoor pool and terrace. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant. Free WiFi is offered throughout the property and free private parking is available on site. 

Every room at this hotel is air conditioned and has a flat-screen TV. Certain rooms feature a seating area where you can relax. You will find a kettle in the room. Rooms include a private bathroom with a bath or shower, with bath robes provided. For your comfort, you will find slippers and free toiletries. The hotel offers Family Rooms with Twin bed rooms for children connected to Executive Suite for parents. 
You will find a 24-hour front desk and shops at the property.

470741.description:
Room Mate Anna, Barcelona stands out for its excellent location, modern and cutting-edge design, and personalized service. This 4* hotel has five different types of rooms. It offers free Wi-Fi, rooms with large flat-screen TVs, and a rooftop swimming pool with views of Barcelona. Room Mate Anna, Barcelona's unique and brightly colored decor has been designed by Lorenzo Castillo to create a young and elegant hotel that combines traditional and fine materials. All the rooms are spacious and comfortable, and they are equipped with everything you need for a fantastic stay. It is surrounded by leisure establishments, designer stores, restaurants, and bars. Since it is only five minutes walking from Plaza Cataluña and Las Ramblas, this hotel is the perfect destination and starting point for exploring the city. 

“La seguridad de nuestros clientes es lo primero y de acuerdo a la actual legislación sanitaria y de forma temporal el servicio de desayunos puede sufrir cambios en cuanto a su horario, disposición y producto. ”

“The safety of our customers is our priority and so in accordance with local health legislation, the breakfast service may have temporary changes (opening hours, products on offer, layout and service). ”

470861.description: The hotel features a total of 23 units. Guests may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. Additionally, the premises provide a reception service the whole day through. Everyone staying at this accommodation may take advantage of the car park. Transfer service is available for guests' convenience. Owing to its health and wellness services, this hotel is ideal for a relaxing break from the stress and strain of daily life. Corporate travellers may appreciate the meeting and business services and facilities available for added convenience. Some services of Riad Palais Des Princesses may be payable.

470982.description: Head straight for the casino, or wait for that lucky feeling while you enjoy one of the other recreational opportunities, such as an outdoor pool. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and barbecue grills. Stop by the hotel's restaurant for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 43 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

471141.address: Church Rd, Nr Airport Rd Metro Station, Andheri E
471141.description: T24 Residency is a 4-star property located in the heart of Mumbai. The hotel is situated within a kilometer from Airport Road Metro Station, 1.1 km from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport, 8.3 km from Santacruz Railway Station and 3.5 km from Highway Bus Stand. It offers a range of facilities like express check-in/check-out, airport and concierge assistance, luggage storage, currency exchange and Wi-Fi.

471221.address: Quinta do Ameal s/n Refoios do Lima, -
471221.description:
Located in Ponte de Lima, the hotel features beautiful views over the valley and the natural surrounding area. The unit produces white wine from grapes grown exclusively on the estate's vineyards. There is also an outdoor swimming pool.
The accommodations are equipped with a seating area. There is also a kitchenette, fitted with a stovetop. Every unit comes with a private bathroom with bathrobes and free toiletries. Free private parking is available at the country house. Free WiFi is featured.
The property also includes a sun terrace.
Guests can enjoy various activities in the surroundings, including fishing and canoeing. Braga is 17 mi from the property. Guimarães is 27 mi from Quinta do Ameal - Wine & Tourism Terroir, while Viana do Castelo is 17 mi away. The nearest airport is Porto airport; 39 mi from Quinta do Ameal - Wine & Tourism Terroir.

471961.address: Bima Nagar Rd, Andheri (E) Western Express Highway
471961.description: Situated in Mumbai , this property offers an ideal place of rest and relaxation. There are a total of 45 rooms on the premises. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. Guests may keep valuable items secure in the Hotel safe. The Hotel provides a lift. The Hotel has mobile phone coverage. Guests can make use of Internet access to stay connected to work or home. Guests may indulge in room service. At Hotel Aureole you will find a 24-hour front desk. Other facilities offered at the property include luggage storage. The property offers free parking. The Hotel offers a laundry service. The establishment is wheelchair-accessible. The on-site car park may be useful to those arriving by car. Check-out is at 00:00. Guests will appreciate the convenience of the onsite car hire service. The Hotel has helpful, multilingual staff available to help guests with any queries or service bookings. The Hotel offers 24-hour security.

472001.description: The Central Hotel is located in the historic Fatih district of Istanbul, just a short walk from the Findikzade T1 tram station, providing easy access to the city’s main attractions. The hotel offers comfortable and modern rooms with free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a private bathroom, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a daily breakfast, a 24-hour front desk, and friendly service. The hotel is an excellent choice for both business and leisure travelers looking for comfort, convenience, and easy transportation throughout Istanbul.

472362.description: Just off President Kennedy Avenue, our hotel is less than four km. from Costanera Center and Bicentennial Park. We are surrounded by several restaurants, shops, and businesses. The Santiago city center and Arturo Merino Benitez Airport are about 20 minutes away. Our 17th floor restaurant features panoramic views of the city and mountains.

472382.description:
Featuring free WiFi and an outdoor pool, Hotel Luciano K is a boutique hotel with a mix of antique and art decó design. The hotel has a terrace and views of the city, and guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant or a drink at the bar. Costanera Center shopping mall is 3.5 km away.

Every room at hotel Luciano K has a flat-screen TV with cable channels, soundproof windows air conditioning and spacious bathrooms. Slippers, bath robes and free toiletries are also provided.

The property offers a wellness centre, including a spa and a sauna. Guests can enjoy the spacious terrace with a bar, heated pool and panoramic views of the surrounding forest and park. Hotel Luciano K stands out for it glamorous architecture and design, located in a historic building from the 1920s.

Laundry services are available at the property for an extra fee. The front desk is available 24 hours a day.

472781.address: Sheikh Zayed Road, Near Internet City Metro Statio
472781.description: DusitD2 kenz hotel dubai is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Dubai. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, wheelchair accessible, taxi service are there for guest's enjoyment. Television LCD/plasma screen, bathroom phone, carpeting, complimentary tea, free welcome drink can be found in selected guestrooms. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Friendly staff, great facilities and close proximity to all that Dubai has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at dusitD2 kenz hotel dubai.

472821.description: Sofitel Jeddah Corniche welcomes you on the famous seaside avenue of Jeddah along the Red Sea for both business and leisure trips. Enjoy luxurious indoor and outdoor pools after a day in the bustle of the traditional souk and be fascinated by the spice merchants and perfumes of all kinds. Relax in our jacuzzi, sauna, steam room and spa while staying connected with the free WIFI in our modern guest rooms or appreciate the Corniche of Jeddah and, for a more active exercise, diving in the Red Sea.

472861.description:
The Avenue is a world class of hospitality that redefines the standards of elegance and sophistication that you'd come to expect from hotel. With its uniquely designed decor, conveniently modern amenities, and one-of-a-kind facilities, Doha's dynamic new residence has to take the center stage and one of the most prestigious address in the city.
Located on the edge of Doha's core district of Al Sadd, The Avenue is part of one of the most lively and energetic areas of the city. Its central location places it in close proximity to cultural cornerstones such as Education City and Souq Waqif, world-class shopping, expansive parks, entertainment venues and more.
The Avenue Hotel offers 160 contemporarily designed superior and deluxe rooms, and 10 fashionably luxurious junior and executive suites. All of them are opulently designed with enhanced interior detailing, well-appointed furnishings

473181.address: Kadriye Mah. Ataturk Cad. No 104/1 Serik
473181.description: With "The Land of Legends" Rixos have created a novel theme park concept that combines all aspects of a fun-filled vacation. It's an entertainment destination for a new generation; a destination for legendary fun, exciting adventures and fun shopping. Located in this awe-inspiring park is The Kingdom Hotel, the first and only hotel in Turkey designed especially for children. The guest rooms and suites are inspired by fairy tales, which become legendary memories. Discover The Land Of Legends Theme Park with special entrance gift for Kingdom Hotel guests. ***Open Pools and Waterparks will be closed for winter period - the dates 17Novermber2025 - 31March2026*** https://www. thelandoflegends. com/en/

473581.description: The exclusive Pearl Jumeira Island is perfectly placed for accessing Dubais spectacular shopping malls and tourist attractions - just 14Km from Dubai International Airport and 7Km from Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall. The award-winning beachfront lifestyle resort- Nikki Beach Resort Spa Dubai- opened in 2017 on Pearl Jumeira- perfectly placed for easy access to Dubai impressive sites- shopping malls- and the Dubai International Airport. The resort features 118 stunning rooms and suites including a newly opened Celebration Suite - the largest in Dubai - as well as 15 private pool villas. There are also 63 lifestyle residences on-site for those that want to call Nikki Beach home- and a beach club - Nikki Beach Dubai - which is accessible to resort guests- residents- and day time visitors. Guests enter the spacious property through the hotel lobby- and pass various dining concepts as they journey through a pathway of villas to the beach club. Hungry visitors can stop by Cafe Nikki for breakfast- lunch and dinner or enjoy lunch at the beach club- while Soul Lounge is the perfect place for drinks and bites while taking in spectacular views of the Arabian Gulf. Hotel guests are also welcome to order in-room dining to eat while enjoying the hotel room amenities like MyBar- customizable mood lighting- bespoke entertainment- and private pools. The resort caters to guests seeking both high and low energy experiences- with a variety of wellness offerings for those looking to unwind. Temperature controlled outdoor pools- an impressive stretch of beach- Nikki Spa- Tone Gym- and a number of outdoor activities like beach yoga- paddle boarding- and workout classes ensure guests are always able to remain active or unwind- depending on their mood. Music and entertainment are an integral part of the Nikki Beach Resort Spa Dubai experience. The brands Global Music Ambassador creates custom playlists for the villas- suites- and dining concepts.

474021.description:
Hotel is located in central Bayrampasa, one of the fastest developing district of Istanbul. Also, Kocatepe Metro Station is just next to the Hotel which provides easy and speedy access to Historical Peninsula, Sultanahmet, Taksim Square, Bakırkoy, CNR Expo Exhibition Centre, Ataturk International Airport and all other key neighborhoods. Forum Istanbul, one of the largest shopping mall in the city, Istanbul Sea Life Aquarium and Legoland are also situated right next to the Hotel.

Wish More Hotel Istanbul has 198 Guest Rooms and Suites, where you will find flat screen LED TV with Satellite and movie channels and complimentary minibar with non alcoholic beverages. The hotel has a Restaurant, Bar and Lobby Lounge where you can enjoy your meals and drinks.

Spread over 1600 m2, our SPA & Fitness is a modern day SPA with local and international therapists applying holistic therapies of the East and West, and trainers providing personalized exercise programs.
The complex has a 500 m2 fitness center equipped with state-of –the – art technology, a 280 m2 semi Olympic indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, Turkish bath, steam room, five massage rooms, a facial room.

474401.description:
The Residences Crystal Towers is situated in the modern Century City, directly across from the Canal Walk Shopping Centre. It offers luxurious apartments with access to The Knife Restaurant downstairs. 

The rooms all offer views either of Table Mountain or over the complex and are elegantly finished with contemporary furniture and modern bathrooms with floor heating. They all have a lounge/dining area with a flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi. Towels and linen are available at a surcharge. The kitchens are fully equipped for self-catering, with a refrigerator, microwave, dishwasher, and stove. There are many restaurants and bars in Century City, within 500 meters from The Towers. The V and A Waterfront and cable car to Table Mountain are both less than 12 km away. Free parking is available on-site and an airport shuttle can be requested at a charge to Cape Town International Airport, 20 km away. 

Our apartments are self-catering, with amenities such as Tea, coffee, Sugar, Milk, Water. Soap, etc will be restocked daily. Please note our reception area close at 21h00

474661.description:
The Val Apartments offer guests the opportunity to stay in the center of Barcelona and enjoy first hand the majesty of Catalan modernism.

Located a few meters from Paseo de Gracia, these apartments are a clear example of the heritage of modernism. The apartments are characterized by their spaciousness and the characteristic details of their constructions, such as the height of their ceilings, the large porticoes, the moldings on the ceilings and the typical traditional mosaics called "trencadís" on the floors.

Staying at Barcelona Apartment Val allows our guests to have free access to the swimming pool on the first floor of Suites Avenue (Paseo de Gracia, 83) 5 minutes away from the apartments. Barcelona Apartment invites all guests to visit the Egyptian Museum of Barcelona free of charge. 

KEY CHECK-IN AND COLLECTION: Reception and key collection will take place at the CLARIS HOTEL (Pau Claris street, 150) open 24 hours a day, every day of the year.

475341.description: Room Mate Emir, Istanbul kept intact the historic façade of the building and incorporated an innovative interior design. Both the aesthetics and quality of our services make it unique and unrepeatable. The hotel features a very relaxing reading area, sauna, gym and massage area. Everything you need to make your stay unforgettable!

475363.description:
The House Ribeira Hotel located in the historic area of ​​Ribeira, in a completely renovated building, the hotel presents an informal and contemporary atmosphere, with a decoration that reflects the unique personality of this city and its culture.
It has 56 rooms, spread over 6 floors. It has a room adapted for people with reduced mobility and 2 Penthouses on the 5th floor, with beautiful views over the Ribeira houses and the Douro River. All rooms are equipped with a private bathroom, interactive television, amenities, safe, air conditioning and free Wi-Fi.
Located in Ribeira, in the heart of the historic center of Porto, about 20 minutes by car from Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport. The hotel is also within walking distance of the city's main attractions_ Alfândegas do Porto, Luis I Bridge, Port Wine Cellars, Palácio da Bolsa, Livraria Lello and Igreja de São Francisco.

Avondrood's original Victorian Cape-Dutch home offers guests a beautiful peaceful stay with a rich historical feel of French Huguenot culture combined with all of the modern luxuries and amenities you desire.

Catalonia Magdalenes is a 4 star property located in the heart of Barcelona offering comfortable accommodation for travelers. Among its amenities the property features air conditioning in all public areas, gym and fitness center, spa, bar, 24-hour front desk, luggage storage and an outdoor pool. The main building of the Hotel is part of the Alella's history, Can Balcells, a mid-nineteenth century house, known as "Casa Xina", where Cavas Signat was located.

There is cafeteria and restaurant, which covers an array of gastronomic options such as daily menu, tapas, a la carte delicate dishes from a Mediterranean cuisine with seasonal ingredients. All of them accompanied by a careful selection of wines and cavas to enjoy a magical gastronomic moment.

name.content: Ruby Sofie Hotel Vienna by IHG

481462.description: Ruby Sofie may be surrounded by peaceful streets and historic architecture, but the city's main sights are a short stroll away. Originally built as a bathhouse, Ruby Sofie was set for a life of lather, rinse, repeat. Thanks to her excellent acoustics though, she was soon transformed into a beautiful ballroom. In the cosy bar, the music lives on, in the form of gigs by local bands. Drop by for a cocktail or bring your friends and grab a beer. And when it's time to unwind, each room is a haven of Lean Luxury calm, designed with serious sleep in mind. Blending tranquillity with great transport links, Sofie's an eight-minute walk from Wien Mitte station, just across the river from the landmarks of the Ringstrasse. Ruby Sofie began life as the Sofiensäle, a 19th-century bathhouse whose remarkable acoustics soon turned showers into concerts and gala balls, hosting everyone from Johann Strauss to the Kinks. Today, her design blends vintage furnishings and antique playbills with statement spotlights and a show-stopping piano.

There is a train stop nearby giving you easy access to Amsterdam Central Station, popular museums, sights and entertainment venues. The surrounding area Zeeburg and the man-made island Java Island are a great choice for guests interested in city walks, city trips and architecture.

Settle into your comfortable guest room featuring our clean and fresh Hampton bed, free WiFi, 40-inch TV, sofa bed, air-conditioning and double-glazed windows. Our Amsterdam hotel also includes an accessible room equipped with all the standard features plus a few amenities for your comfort and convenience.

Enjoy Hampton's included hot breakfast offering a choice of delicious hot and cold items. If you're in a hurry, our 24/7 hub includes an array of delicious snacks and single-serve drinks to have on the go, in addition to some travel essentials. Make sure to stop by the Front Desk for some useful tips on local restaurants, attractions and events.

Stay on top of work in the on-site work zone and exercise in the 24-hour fitness center with modern cardio and strength training equipment. Bike rental service and secure parking facility (fees apply) are also available at this Amsterdam hotel.

482041.description:
Stylish seaside hotel with an outdoor pool and meeting facilities, next to Istanbul Aquarium and Aqua Florya Mall. 
Ideal for business and leisure travellers, Crowne Plaza® Istanbul - Florya hotel is a 15-minute drive from CNR Expo and IDTM exhibition centres. We provide free parking in our secure lot. Transport links by bus, train and road are excellent. 
We have six fully equipped meeting rooms with a maximum capacity of 800, while our outdoor banquet area has room for 1, 250 guests. Our Crowne Plaza Meetings Director is on hand to take care of all the details.  The hotel has free WiFi throughout and is completely connected, providing access to power when and where you need it.  
The Aqua Florya shopping centre and Istanbul Aquarium are both next door to the hotel. If you fancy a stroll by the sea, there's a promenade directly outside. The sights of Istanbul are easily accessible by train from Florya Akvaryum Station, both five minutes away on foot. 
Work up a sweat in our well-equipped Fitness Centre or luxuriate in our indoor and outdoor pools or our spa. Dine all day long in the Atrox Restaurant, Bar and Lounge. Admire the spectacular sea views from our roof terrace and get a sound sleep in our elegant rooms with premium bedding and Quiet Zones.

It offers 52 rooms with en-suite bathrooms including hairdryers, air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, and telephones. There is also a suite with a private jacuzzi. Rooms can be booked for up to 3 hours. The hotel sells tickets and packages for Warner Bros. Park and Madrid Zoo. It is located 2 km from the Fabrik nightclub. Not far away, just 250 meters away, located in those warehouses that weekenders consider ideal for watching movies or going shopping - El Corte Ingles. But if the option is to go for a stroll and enjoy Lisbon, little further up, just up the road you will encounter the Eduardo VII Park. Then admire for a few moments the stunning view and see the urban fabric of the city. Many other alternatives are accessible and close at hand.

The 94 spacious rooms lead us to the graceful architecture of Oporto, focusing on the unique beauty of the typical city tiles. All the bedrooms have air conditioning, mini-bar, flat screen TV and a safe. It should be highlighted that the hotel has Standard, Superior, Deluxe and Family rooms, as well as Suites and rooms for disabled people. 
Porto Cristal Hotel offers free Wi-Fi in all areas and has a 24h day reception, available to provide you a range of services, including: shuttle service, car rental, taxi service and a location to store your baggage if necessary. The hotel also provides you a private parking 24h subject to an additional charge, restaurant, bar where you can taste the traditional Porto Wine, two conference rooms and a large garden away from the city bustle.

The nearest metro station (Faria Guimarães) can be reached only 5 minutes walk and allows easy access to points of interest such as Torre dos Clérigos (Clérigos Tower), Lello bookshop, the picturesque Serralves Park and the romantic Ribeira neighborhood, World Heritage by UNESCO. Across D. Luis I bridge, you can visit the famous Caves of Porto wine. 
The exquisite São Bento train station is situated 2km away and Santa Maria Hospital 200 meters. The Dragon Stadium is 2.5 km away and the International Airport Francisco Sá Carneiro 14Km (metro link).

494422.description:
Located where Istanbul’s memory is at its strongest, in the heart of the Historic Peninsula, on the centuries-old streets of Sirkeci that have never fallen silent, Le Petit Palace Hotel brings together three generations of family hospitality with the comfort of today. Staying here feels less like being in a city and more like becoming part of its story. 

The surroundings of our hotel offer a unique blend of Istanbul’s most vibrant historical, cultural, and everyday life. The spice-scented air of the Egyptian Bazaar, the timeless splendor of Sultanahmet, the peaceful atmosphere of Gülhane Park, and the culinary stops of Hocapaşa are all just a few steps away. There is no need to plan for museum visits, shopping, or discovering local flavors—here, Istanbul unfolds naturally. 

Thanks to its close proximity to the tram line, Marmaray, and sea transportation, the city is easily accessible right from the hotel’s doorstep. Whether it is your first visit or you already know Istanbul well, Le Petit Palace offers an effortless way to experience the city through its exceptional location. 

For our guests, breakfast is not merely the start of the day, but a special ritual filled with pleasure and happiness. Our open buffet Turkish breakfast, enriched with carefully selected seasonal products, welcomes guests every morning. 

One of the most distinctive privileges completing the Istanbul experience is our traditional Turkish bath located within the hotel. An inseparable part of the city’s culture for centuries, the Turkish bath is offered free of charge to Le Petit Palace guests, providing a unique experience for those who wish to unwind and deeply feel the spirit of Istanbul. 

Le Petit Palace is a special meeting point for those who wish not only to see Istanbul, but to feel its rhythm, soul, and way of life.

The library feeling stretches throughout the hotel and into the hotel bar with its smoking room surrounded by books. There is also a shisha lounge around the pool. You can also find in-site an art, flower & tattoo shop, all surrounded by a quiet and safe neighborhood. Bicycle rentals are available! We believe by the idea of sharing and experiencing our destination beyond the place. We are a medium sized hotel where our guests can enjoy hanging out and having the best of times sunbathing in our outdoor pool, relaxing in a hammock or just chilling at our Restaurant-Bar, with great food and drink promotions all year round. If you are in the mood, our common areas invite you to socialize and meet awesome people from all over the world. Check out our Instagram @enigmatichotels and @nomadsexperience and be tuned about the activities and experiences provided. 
All accommodations are air conditioned, we have Free Wi-Fi available in common areas and running smoothly throughout the entire building and free use of the guest kitchen, luggage storage, a book exchange and a lively hotel bar. Also, we are happy to help you plan trips and book tickets for onward travel and daily tours (Xcaret, Xplor, Xel-Ha, Chichen Itzá, Isla Mujeres and many others) and night life outings to the famous Cancun Party Zone (ask for more information at Front desk, we’ll be more than happy to assist you!).

Pedro de Valdivia Norte neighborhood, where Ladera Hotel is located, has the perfect mix between neighborhood and city life. It still has the roots of its surroundings, which for years had a tranquility in the air and the opportunity to unwind. Set in an area which is today part of Santiago's cultural heritage, it is connected to the city via the Pedro de Valdivia Bridge.

Hidden in these streets, there is a personal hotel that is looking to recover the experience of entering and leaving the city, but at the same time is connected with everything in its surroundings: bicycle rides, theaters, cafes, restaurant, businesses, malls and trips through the park.

Its design is in keeping with the neighborhood, with an avant-garde style, and inside, every detail has been thought about so that your stay is one that is never interrupted.

Hotel is non-alcoholic and provide guests dedicated prayer room facilities.  Mini-bar offers non-alcoholic beverages and snacks.

555681.description:
Only YOU Atocha is a hotel with personality located in the heart of Madrid, on Paseo de la Infanta Isabel, a privileged location that connects with iconic places such as Retiro Park, the Literary Quarter, Lavapiés, and Paseo del Prado. Housed in a historic building from 1886, it combines the classic elegance of its restored façade with a contemporary interior design, creating a sophisticated, cozy, and stylish atmosphere. 
With an eclectic and carefully crafted design, the hotel offers a unique experience for both travelers and locals. It has 204 rooms arranged around an iconic central courtyard, designed to provide constant urban comfort. Its proximity to Madrid Puerta de Atocha train station and Retiro Park makes it an ideal spot for those seeking convenience, culture, and leisure in the city center. 
Among its services are a 24-hour gym, a rooftop terrace with panoramic views, and free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. In the lobby, guests can enjoy an exclusive barbershop and personalized concierge services. 

Gastronomically, the hotel offers several options:
-Trotamundos, an international cuisine restaurant that invites guests to travel through flavors. 
-Breakery with Madreamiga, located on the ground floor, perfect for coffee, a snack, or a sweet treat at any time. 
- Sép7ima, a restaurant with a terrace that blends tradition and creative gastronomy in a welcoming atmosphere. Additionally, Colmado by Sép7ima offers fresh products to complement the experience. 
The buffet breakfast (at an extra cost) is served Monday to Friday from 7:00 to 10:30 a. m. and on weekends from 7:30 to 11:30 a. m. There is also 24-hour room service with breakfast. 

The hotel features a business center, express check-out, and self-parking (paid). All rooms include air conditioning, satellite TV, memory foam mattresses for optimal rest, and a private bathroom with rain showers and complimentary toiletries.

555941.description:
Nestled in the vibrant heart of Dubai's Deira district, Tulip Creek Hotel Apartments offers an ideal blend of comfort, luxury, and convenience. Just steps from Dubai Metro, the iconic Dubai Creek, and Deira City Center shopping mall, you’ll be perfectly positioned to explore Dubai’s finest shopping, dining, entertainment, and business hubs. Only a 7-8 minute drive from Dubai International Airport, our apartments are the perfect base for both business and leisure travelers. 

Stylish, Spacious, and Fully Equipped
Our apartments feature spacious, elegantly designed interiors, with options ranging from studios to one and two-bedroom apartments. Each fully serviced apartment comes complete with modern furnishings, flat-screen satellite TVs, en-suite bathrooms, a separate living room, and a fully equipped kitchen – everything you need for a home away from home. 

Stunning Views and Relaxation
Our One-Bedroom Creek View Apartments offer breathtaking views of Dubai Creek, the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Frame, and the dazzling city skyline. Relax on your private balcony while soaking in the serene beauty of the water and Dubai's iconic landmarks. 

Exceptional Amenities
Stay energized and relax in style with our state-of-the-art gym, rejuvenating steam bath, soothing sauna, and a temperature-controlled outdoor pool offering stunning views. Whether you're here for business or leisure, we’ve got everything you need to feel your best. 

Prime Location, Perfect Accessibility
Tulip Creek Hotel Apartments puts you within close reach of some of Dubai’s most popular attractions, including Dubai Creek Park, Dubai Creek Golf & Yacht Club, and the Dubai Clock Tower. The Deira City Centre Mall and Metro Station are just a 5-minute walk away, while the Dubai Museum and the historic Bastakiya Quarter are only a 10-minute drive.

Fer Hotel is named Asia's 2017 Best City Boutique Hotel by World Boutique Hotel Awards, the first and only international awards organization exclusively dedicated to recognizing unique excellence among luxury boutique hotels.
 
Fer Hotel offers impeccable service and all the essential amenities to invigorate travelers. To name a few of the hotel's facilities, there are 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24 hour GYM, free parking, car power charging station, daily housekeeping.
 
Step into one of 56 inviting rooms and escape the stresses of the day with a wide range of amenities such as Nespresso machine, tea and coffee making facilities, safe-box, toiletries, bathrobe and slippers. Fer Hotel is your one-stop destination for quality hotel accommodations in Istanbul.

Every room is fitted with a flat-screen TV with cable channels. Each room is fitted with a private bathroom. For your comfort, you will find bath robes, slippers and free toiletries. 

Four Seasons Hotel DIFC features four Dubai restaurants, bars and lounges including Mina Brasserie, Luna Sky Bar, Penrose Lounge and Cigar lounge Churchill Club, all ideal for discussing business, entertaining colleagues or relaxing with friends. Service at the poolside terrace and in room service is available. 

The hotel has a spa center ‘The Spa’ with 5 spacious treatment rooms and whirlpool hot tub, and a fully equipped fitness center. 

The hotel also offers car hire. Dubai Mall is 1. 2 mi from Four Seasons Hotel Dubai International Financial Center, while Burj Khalifa is 1. 3 mi from the property. Dubai International Airport is 5. 6 mi away. Free parking and valet parking is available on site.

In the city centre it is possible to visit many touristic sites, such as “Torre dos Clérigos”, “Palácio da Bolsa”, “Sé Catedral”, the Town Hall, S. Bento Station, the Churches of “Misericórdia”, “Carmo” and “Carmelitas” as well as the Rectory of the University.
Still within the perimeter of the city centre, the walking route through the “Rua das Flores” is a “must see” leading the visitors to one of the oldest parts of the city, with particular emphasis to the “Ribeira” area along the Douro River.
In the Dukes Corner we are very proud to offer a warm welcome to indulge our guests wishes and be certain that they will come back again.
There are 7 bedrooms available (one of them is a Suite) individually furnished and distinctive in style and adapted to the modern demands of comfort. All rooms have en-suite bathroom with free WIFI access, Cable TV and Air Conditioning.
Our guests can still benefit from our breakfast room, a lounge where they can rest, read or socialize and still relax in our heartwarming outside area while feasting with our diverse and delicious menu accompanied by an excellent wine

A set of delights where fado, the best food, architecture, culture, commerce and, of course, nightlife, live together.
Close to the urban buzz, Dear Lisbon Charming House is a haven of tranquility, comfort and affection, where you can recharge your energy and prepare to discover many points of interest nearby.
The 20 rooms, consisting of Terrace Suites, Junior Suites, Garden Rooms and Street Rooms, offer you the warmth of an authentic Portuguese embrace and the simple sophistication of a cosmopolitan city. 571161.description: The new Steigenberger Hotel El Tahrir is ideally located at the heart of Cairo down town. 572361.description: Situated in the Western Cape's picturesque Overberg region, The Caledon Hotel and Spa offers a country retreat experience that overwhelms the senses and induces a sense of relaxation and contentment. Traditionally, a tree house represents a personal space of escape; a creative retreat; a place of freedom, comfort and play; and a place where imagination can be set free on a journey with no limits, no boundaries and no restrictions. A tree house is a place of dreams, and at The Tree House Boutique Hotel dreams become reality.

There is a private bathroom with a hot tub and shower in every unit, along with bathrobes, slippers and free toiletries. Towels are featured.
You can play table tennis at the property, and bike hire and car hire are available. Monastiraki Flea Market is 1.4 km from 47 Luxury Suites, while Ermou Street-Shopping Area is 1.4 km away. The nearest airport is Elefthérios Venizélos Airport, 56 km from 47 Luxury Suites.

The Best Western Plus® Pearl Creek is located in the heart of Old Dubai, U.A.E, which is 6.6 kilometers away from the Dubai International Airport and is located on the Baniyas Street of Dubai Creekside. 

This luxury 4 Star hotel is few steps from the Baniyas Metro Station as well as from the city's main Old Gold Souk and the major business and shopping district. A lot of entertainment and recreational areas such as the Dubai Museum, Traditional Dhow Cruise and theaters are a few kilometers from the hotel making your stay an enjoyable one. 

The hotel offers 202 comfortable and modern bedrooms, with top quality service, free Wi-Fi throughout the entire hotel and a fitness center with a swimming pool. The Best Western Plus® Pearl Creek's friendly team will take care of all the little things to make your stay as enjoyable and comfortable as possible.

The centrally located Best Western Plus® Pearl Creek offers modern and spacious conference rooms that can cater up to 60-120 delegates. The hotel also offers a full range of equipment necessary for business meetings, seminars, corporate events and training sessions. Please note from January 1, 2018 - an additional 5% VAT will be added to your bill at check-in.

574423.description:
Zest Boutique Hotel offers a different kind of experience. Our boutique hotel style accommodation is something unique and distinctive.

Each room is individually decorated and has an open planned en-suite bathroom that brings out the seamless fusion of retro style and luxury detail. A seventies theme emanates throughout the hotel where trendy consumer electronics such as the colourful Toot-a-loop and Panapet radios are on display.

Perfect for business or pleasure, this unmatched boutique hotel offers luxury accommodation and is ideally located just a kilometer from the Cape Town Central Business District. The hotel is also within walking distance of the renowned V&A Waterfront.

There are 14 guest units made up of three categories; Classic Rooms, Deluxe Rooms, and Superior Deluxe. All rooms have an impressive range of facilities including a king-size bed, ensuite bathroom, in-room safe, LED TV, free Wi-fi, and air conditioning.

Included in the services offered are a 24-hour concierge, spa service, a day room with shower, breakfast served until 11 am,

an all-day dining menu, and a full-service bar.

Let your journey begin here.

Set in the former Midland Bank building in the City of London, just steps from Bank Station, The Ned hosts 250 bedrooms, ten restaurants and a range of men’s and women’s grooming services. 

The Grade I-listed building was designed by Sir Edwin 'Ned' Lutyens in 1924. Each bedroom at The Ned features elements of design back to the 1920's and 1930’s and includes vintage pieces, patterned furnishings and rainforest showers. 

The former Grand Banking Hall is host to restaurants which serve a wide range of cuisines, from Britain to Northern Italy, North America to Asia. 

Ned’s Club Spa offers a variety of treatments–from manicures and pedicures, to massages and hair services. The private member's spaces, Ned's Club Gym and Ned's Club Spa pool may be accessed through purchasing day passes, subject to availability. 

A discretionary accommodation service charge will be added to the guest bill

574881.description:
Leonardo Hotel London Aldgate (formerly Hotel Saint London) stands on Aldgate High Street in the historic City of London, an area that has served as a gateway to the city for centuries. 
Leonardo Hotel London Aldgate offers a refined urban retreat designed for travellers who value comfort, efficiency, and attentive service. The hotel brings together contemporary design and thoughtful hospitality, creating a place where guests can work, relax, and enjoy the rhythm of the city. From the moment of arrival, everything is designed to feel seamless and welcoming, from smooth check in to strong connectivity and carefully designed spaces that encourage both productivity and relaxation. 
Leonardo Hotel London Aldgate features 272 contemporary rooms and suites designed with understated style and practical comfort in mind. Each space provides a calm setting within the vibrant city, allowing guests to unwind and recharge after a busy day in London. Comfortable superiors offer a peaceful base for short visits, while spacious suites provide additional room for guests planning longer stays. Every room is created to balance comfort, functionality, and simplicity, making it easy to move between work, rest, and city exploration. 
Dining at Leonardo Hotel London Aldgate centres around The Cardinal Bar and Kitchen, an inviting restaurant that welcomes guests throughout the day. The kitchen focuses on vibrant seasonal dishes served in a relaxed yet refined setting.

A contemporary Antalya hotel offering free WiFi, an outdoor pool, a seaview terrace bar and a spa
Holiday Inn® Antalya - Lara hotel places you just a 15 minute walk from sandy Lara Beach. A 15-minute drive from the hotel takes you to the international brand name stores and restaurants of TerraCity Shopping Centre. Beach Area, 15 minutes’ drive away, and free parking is also available. A 30-minute drive from the hotel, the winding streets of Kaleiçi Old Town are home to Roman ruins and ancient city gates. The nearby Antalya Museum tells the city’s history through displays of archaeological artefacts, including Byzantine mosaics. Just 10 minutes drive from the hotel, the impressive Düden Waterfalls, surrounded by a leafy park, cascade down cliffs into the Mediterranean Sea. Business guests can host events for up to 120 delegates in the hotel's three flexible meeting spaces. They both come equipped with state-of-the-art AV equipment to ensure presentations go well. And there's free WiFi throughout the hotel. You can swim in the outdoor pool, work out in the fully equipped fitness centre, or relax over drinks on the seaview terrace bar, before dining on international cuisine in the open lobby restaurant. Unwind with a steam bath, sauna or massage in the spa, or enjoy a night in with 24-hour room service.

The property is located in heart of the historic centre of Lisbon in the Bairro Alto District in a converted palace. The hostel has a wonderful view of the city and Tagus River.  The property has two restaurants on site and provides a guest only bar/lounge with film screenings and performances from local musicians and breakfast is served at The Decadente Restaurant & Bar .  The dorm rooms are contemporary in design with comfortable bedding allowing a good night's rest, complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the building for guests to enjoy.  The common areas have televisions, microwaves and refrigerators. All dormitories are non-smoking and available in both shared mixed company and a shared woman's only configuration. The private rooms are comfortable and inviting providing plush bedding and air conditioning with private bathroom.  The friendly and welcoming staff will be more than happy to recommend neighbourhood attractions, restaurants and nightclubs. Guests will find public transportation nearby the Restauradores Station and Lisbon Rossio Station are only a 9-minute walk from the front door.  Some of the local attractions nearby include the Church of Sao Roque, Rossio Square and Botanical garden are within 15 minutes of the hostel.

From the very first step inside, its doors open onto a world of serenity, where time seems to slow down and the atmosphere invites you to breathe, relax, and reconnect. 

Bathed in natural light and softened by the freshness of its patio, the riad has been carefully designed to offer comfort, harmony, and authenticity. Every detail reflects the soul of Marrakech: refined Moroccan craftsmanship, soothing colors, and a warm, intimate ambiance that makes you feel instantly at home. 

Here, mornings begin gently, accompanied by the sounds of the medina awakening, while days unfold at your own pace—between moments of rest, cultural discoveries, and unforgettable sensory experiences. Whether you are seeking tranquility, romance, or an authentic immersion, Riad Haraka offers a unique balance between tradition and comfort. 

More than just a place to stay, Riad Haraka is an invitation to experience the true spirit of Marrakech, discreet, genuine, and deeply inspiring.

Located in Riyadh, Muhaidb Residence offers fully furnished accommodations. It provides high speed internet access in all areas, an indoor pool and an à la carte restaurant. The property is 2.6 km from Kingdom Center and 1.1 km from Al Faisaliah Tower.


All air-conditioned units feature a satellite flat-screen TV. Each suite includes a dining area and a fully equipped kitchenette. The bathroom is fitted with a shower and a bath.


Panorama Mall is a 10-minute walk and King Khaled International Airport is 30 km away from the property.

599982.address: Rua da Bica Duarte Belo, 6 no lift
599982.description: This property has no reception. Please contact us before check-in. A €90 cleaning fee and group fees are collected upon arrival. City Stays Bica Apartments are located in Bica, one of Lisbon's trendiest nightlife areas, with Chiado just 300 meters away. Free WiFi is available throughout the property. All air-conditioned apartments feature a flat-screen TV in the living room and bedrooms. Some units include a terrace or balcony with city views. There's also a dining area and a kitchenette equipped with a dishwasher, oven, microwave, refrigerator, coffee machine, and kettle. Each unit has a private bathroom with free toiletries and a hairdryer. Bed linen is provided. Bairro Alto is 400 meters from the apartments, while Dona Maria II National Theatre is 700 meters away. Lisbon Humberto Delgado Airport, the nearest airport, is 7 km from City Stays Bica Apartments.

name.content: City Stays Cais do Sodré Apartments - Adults Only

600002.description: Situated in the heart of Cais do Sodré, these modern apartments are steps away from the train and metro station. The apartaments offer complimentary Wi-Fi and fully equipped kitchenettes. Each living room features TV and a sofa bed, with select apartments boasting river views. The central location places you in a nightlife area. Chiado is within 800 meters, and Bairro Alto is less than a 10-minute walk. Baixa/Chiado Metro Station, a 5-minute walk, connects you to the city. Cais do Sodré Train Station offers a convenient 20-minute ride to Cascais. Please note: This property has no reception. Guests must contact the property prior to check-in for further details and information regarding applicable cleaning, city tax and group fees. The five-story building does not have an elevator; family and two-bedroom apartments are on the fourth and fifth floors. This is an adults-only property.

600004.description: Located within 1. 3 km of Ribeira Market and 1. 9 km of Commerce Square in Lisbon, Lisbon Five Stars Apartments Combro 7 provides accommodation with free WiFi and seating area. All air-conditioned units come with a flat-screen TV, a living room with a sofa, a well-equipped kitchen with a dining area, and a private bathroom with a bidet, a hairdryer and free toiletries. A dishwasher, a microwave and fridge are also available, as well as a kettle and coffee machine. Guests at the apartment can enjoy a continental breakfast. Car hire is available at Lisbon Five Stars Apartments Combro 7, and guests can enjoy hiking nearby. The guest house is 2. 4 km from Rossio and 2. 5 km from Dona Maria II National Theater.

600586.description: The Eurostars Porto Centro 4* allows you the chance to get to know the beautiful city of Porto from its historical centre, declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO. This excellent location will complete a luxurious stay while you enjoy the best facilities like bar-café, room service or the beautiful landscaped area. Likewise, the large and bright rooms of the Eurostars Porto Centro 4* which are decorated in earth tones will add to your stay the comfort and rest that you are looking for, as they include air conditioning and heating, LCD TV, desk, minibar and toiletries, among other amenities.

601245.description:
As soon as you arrive, you will be immersed in the heart of Marrakech, with its colors, its warm people, and its sun.
In this small riad, of more than 200 years, in the quiet side of Al-Medina, you can see and admire from the top of its terrace, the treasures or the ocher city, as well as its clear view on the Atlas mountains by enjoying a cup tea with a dish Moroccan cook prepared in the purest traditions by our Moroccan cook.
Located in the heart of the souks (market) 5 minutes from the Jemaa el Fna square.
The Riad is true, real guest house, new like sharing, exchange, friendliness, with the comfort of a good hotel, but on a reasonable budget. 
Each room has its indentity, colorful, discouraged with objects chinese, air-conditioned, room of water. 
You ar at home, with its common areas, the living room, the terraces, the solarium.

601321.description: Located in the heart of the Dorsoduro district nestled among restaurants, shops and artisan boutiques, and a short stroll from the Grand Canal, is Avani Rio Novo Venice Hotel. The building, which dates back to the 50s and 60s, is designed in Razionalismo Italiano style featuring sleek lines and geometric shapes. Perfectly placed for both business and leisure, the hotel is located in what’s also known as the “Real Venice”; just a few minutes from Piazzale Roma and Santa Lucia train station. It’s also in the same district as the Ca’ Foscari University and the Peggy Guggenheim Collection You can also easily hop aboard a vaporetto to explore the rest of the city. The hotel offers 144 stylish rooms, decorated in relaxing white and beige, including family rooms, connecting rooms, Junior suites and accessible rooms.

601575.description: Located in La Lonja, the Sheraton Pilar Hotel and Convention Center offers convenient access to the convention center, Rush Pilar, and Las Palmas Shopping Center, all within a 5-minute walk. This luxury hotel is just 0. 9 miles from the IAE Business School and 1. 3 miles from Austral Park. Pamper yourself with massages, body treatments, and facials, or enjoy the health club, outdoor and indoor pools. Additional amenities include Wi-Fi (surcharge), concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). A shuttle service to nearby shops is also available (surcharge). The 140 guestrooms feature minibars, Smart TVs, and 27-inch flat-screen televisions with cable programming. Stay connected with Wi-Fi (surcharge). Private bathrooms with showers offer complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Dine at one of the hotel's two restaurants or enjoy 24-hour room service. Snacks are available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or poolside bar. The hotel offers a business center, limo/town car service, dry cleaning/laundry services, a conference center, and a meeting room. Free self-parking is available onsite.

601578.description:
Welcome! If you enjoy discovering authentic experiences, Krista is your place in Buenos Aires, located in the exclusive neighborhood of Palermo Soho. 

Spacious, bright rooms, noble materials and quality textures. Unique details that invite you to rest. 

Cleanse your body and mind in our Spa. Find the perfect balance between relaxation and well-being. We have everything you need to recover the energy of your body: outdoor pool, outdoor solarium, massage room, wet sauna, dry sauna and massage room. 

Plaza Serrano is 5 blocks from Krista Boutique Hotel, while Ecopark and Parque 3 de Febrero are 12 blocks away. Palermo is a great option for travelers interested in nightlife, parks, museums and restaurants. 

Late check out option: until 7pm at USD 85 + tax

601585.description: This aparthotel is centrally located in the heart of beautiful Buenos Aires. The property is only 800 meters from Plaza De Mayo and only a 6-minute walk from Belgrano Station. The amenities and prime location make this a perfect place to call home while away from home. These cheerful modern studios feature a modern décor and comfortable furnishings. They are equipped with a fully equipped kitchenette with everything needed for a long leisurely vacation to explore what Buenos Aires has to offer, yet perfect for weekend getaways or business trips. The well-appointed studios have a separate dining room, plush bedding, air conditioning and complimentary Wi-Fi. Please note that the front-desk is available from 09:00 to 06:00 pm. Guests arriving after these hours should inform the property in advance to coordinate key pick up.

601586.description: Facilities The hotel offers a transfer service. Wireless internet access is available to guests in the public areas. Rooms Each of the rooms is appointed with air conditioning and a bathroom. A double bed ensures a good night's sleep. Amenities in all rooms include a TV. The bathroom offers convenient facilities including a shower.

601587.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include wedding services, a communal living room, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a meal at Tutto Tano or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and a meeting room. Make yourself at home in one of the 34 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring kitchens with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and ovens. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Rooms have private furnished balconies. 42-inch LED televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.
