601591.description: Situated in a beautifully refurbished 19th-century house, Milhouse Hostel Avenue offers budget-friendly accommodations in Buenos Aires, just 600 meters from the Obelisk. A common kitchen and bar are available for guests. The Lima Metro Station is conveniently located 200 meters away. Rooms at Milhouse are bright and spacious, featuring parquet floors and modern paintings. All rooms include a private bathroom, while dormitory rooms offer shared bathroom facilities. Guests can prepare meals in the common kitchen or enjoy barbecues on the terrace. Drinks and snacks are available at the bar, and private lockers are provided. Salsa and tango lessons are offered, and football and disco tickets can be booked at the tour desk. Guests can also play billiards or relax in the reading lounge. Milhouse Hostel Avenue is 6. 5 km from Jorge Newbery International Airport, and the 24-hour front desk staff can arrange shuttle services.

601613.description: This welcoming hotel offers 20 comfortable units and convenient on-site amenities, including wireless internet and a 24-hour reception. Parking and airport transfers are also available. Business travelers will appreciate the hotel's business facilities, while leisure guests can enjoy the on-site dining and wellness options. Cots are not available.

601636.description: Each apartment in this aparthotel features a fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning, microwave, telephone, TV, and WiFi access. Guests can also enjoy the convenience of baggage storage and wireless internet access in public areas and rooms. For leisure, the property offers an outdoor pool, gym, and sauna. Please note, cleaning service is provided every 3 days for stays less than 7 nights, and once a week for longer stays.

601639.description: Facilities The hotel features various services and facilities, including a baggage storage service, a safe, a restaurant, a café, a bar, a transfer service and room service, for a comfortable and relaxing stay. Wireless internet access is available to travellers in the public areas. There is also a garden. Those arriving in their own vehicles can leave them in the car park of the establishment. Rooms The accommodation features rooms with air conditioning and a bathroom. The standard amenities of most rooms include a balcony. There is also a minibar. Little extras, including internet access, a telephone, a TV and WiFi, contribute to a great stay. The bathroom offers convenient facilities including a shower. Sports/Entertainment The terrace is a great place to while away the time. The hotel offers a gym (for a fee) to guests. Meals The accommodation offers breakfast, lunch and dinner.

601699.description: With a stay at Locanda Della Mimosa in Petropolis (Fazenda Inglesa), you'll be steps from Tinguá Biological Reserve and Vale do Paraíba. This 4. 5-star hotel is 11. 7 mi (18. 9 km) from Imperial Museum and 16. 5 mi (26. 5 km) from Quintandinha Palace. Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a spa tub, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Free valet parking is available onsite. At Locanda Della Mimosa, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8 AM to 11 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 12 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and a turndown service.

601710.description: 'Enjoy a comfortable stay at Hotel Ipê, located in Guarulhos City Centre, a short drive from Bosque Maia Park and Parque Shopping Maia. Start your day with a complimentary self-serve breakfast, available weekdays from 5:30 AM to 9:30 AM and weekends until 10:00 AM. The hotel offers 48 guestrooms equipped with minibars, cable TV, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Make use of convenient amenities such as the on-site restaurant, bar/lounge, and 24-hour airport shuttle. Hotel Ipê is also a short drive from Internacional Shopping Guarulhos and Lago dos Patos. '

601733.description: Visitors will find the airport within 18 km. The premises count with 72 welcoming accomodation units. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. Additionally, the premises provide a reception service the whole day through. Palmeiras Hotel provides parking for guests' convenience.

601736.description: There are a total of 16 rooms on the premises. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection available on-site. The reception desk is open all day long. This hotel does not offer cots on demand. Catering to the special needs of visitors, this disability-friendly hotel includes some wheelchair accessible rooms.

601739.description: This hotel is an excellent choice for travellers seeking comfort and relaxation. It is located in Sao Joao de Meriti and offers easy access to several local attractions as well as Rio de Janeiro. The property is within 15 km of Morro da Cruz and Sanctuary of Nossa Senhora da Penha. TopShopping Nova Iguaçu and Estádio Olímpico Nilton Santos are also within 20 km. Rio de Janeiro Pavuna Station is 28 minutes by foot. Galeão International Airport is 22. 5 km away from the accommodations. The establishment features free buffet breakfast, onsite parking as well as wireless Internet access. Guests can enjoy a bite to eat at the onsite restaurant. Visitors can enjoy a restful sleep in the spacious rooms, which are appointed with an array of thoughtful amenities. They include air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, an LCD TV with cable channels and a minibar. The private bathroom is equipped with a shower

601844.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at Swiss Luxury Apartments, centrally located in Geneva, a short walk from the Flower Clock and a 15-minute stroll from Saint-Pierre Cathedral. Pamper yourself with massages, body treatments, and facials at our on-site spa. Each of our 24 guestrooms features a kitchen with a full-sized refrigerator, freezer, and oven, as well as a pillowtop bed with luxurious Frette Italian sheets. A 75-inch flat-screen TV and complimentary Wi-Fi are also provided. Continental breakfast is available daily for a fee. The hotel offers convenient amenities such as a 24-hour airport shuttle (surcharge), self-parking, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge).

601930.description: bs Rosales is a conveniently located hotel just steps away from the main financial center in Bogota. It is only minutes from Zona G, where a variety of local restaurants can be found. Onsite, you can enjoy a restaurant and meeting room as well as wireless Internet access. Each of its modern accommodations features a variety of convenient amenities, including a work desk, a minibar and a coffee maker.

601935.description: The Mika Suites Hotel in Bogotá is strategically located in Chapinero, near Zona G. It offers comfortable rooms with Wi-Fi and a free buffet breakfast. Guests praise its excellent service, cleanliness, and value for money. It is ideal for its location, offering easy access to restaurants and attractions such as Parque de la 93, the Andino Shopping Center, Zona T, the Movistar Arena events center, and the Corferias Convention Center.

601941.description: With a stay at Bogota Bed and Breakfast Inn in Bogotá, you'll be within a 10-minute drive of Monserrate and Gold Museum. This bed & breakfast is 3. 9 mi (6. 3 km) from U. S. Embassy Bogotá and 2. 3 mi (3. 7 km) from Plaza de Bolivar. Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Featured amenities include complimentary wired Internet access, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Stay in one of 7 guestrooms featuring Smart televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wired and wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries.

601942.description: New and spacious apartasuites in the north of Bogotá, modern and contemporary style with a minimalist decoration, very close to the best restaurants, the Unicentro shopping center, Hacienda Santa Barbara, Bulevar Niza, Titan Plaza, Andino among others, also a few minutes by car from Parque de la 93 and Parque el Virrey. Hotel & Apartamentos Plaza Suites is the ideal starting point to visit the main tourist and financial attractions of the area. The apartments have living room and fully equipped kitchen. In addition, to complement your stay, the hotel has international food restaurant, gym, parking and free wifi.

602119.description: AN Park Hotel Milano Settala, a modern and design hotel close to the A35 BRE-BE-MI and Linate Airport. 140 rooms including twin, double, family rooms, executive double rooms and suites. All spacious and equipped with 32 inch LCD TV, minibar and safe. The hotel, surrounded by a large park, has a swimming pool, life path, gym, charging docks and large meeting rooms. Rich breakfast buffet and WiFi.

602121.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Bianca Maria Restaurant, a restaurant which specializes in international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Milan? This hotel has 1399 square feet (130 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 4 meeting rooms. A shuttle from the airport to the hotel is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

602159.description: Situated in the village of Imlil, this traditional Moroccan riad offers a peaceful base with striking views of the Atlas Mountains. Guests can relax in the hammam or on one of the rooftop terraces. The on-site restaurant serves Moroccan specialities for dinner, and a complimentary breakfast is provided daily. Air-conditioned rooms, some with private balconies, feature views of the surrounding mountains and countryside. Free Wi-Fi is available. The property is located a two-minute walk from Toubkal National Park, and staff can help organise local treks.

602267.description: Located in the exclusive Miraflores district of Lima, this hotel is situated a few blocks from the Larcomar Shopping Centre and is 4. 6 miles from the city centre. The property features an on-site restaurant, The Caravels, which specialises in Peruvian cuisine and provides a complimentary daily breakfast buffet. Guests have access to a range of facilities, including a bar, a business centre, and a terrace. The hotel also provides an airport shuttle for an additional charge, 24-hour room service, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Accommodation options include deluxe rooms and suites, some of which offer ocean views or feature a hydromassage bath. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning and a minibar.

602310.address: Av. Duque d'Avila, n. 42 - 4, 5 e 6 Andares
602310.description: Located at the central Saldanha Square, Pátria Hotel offers rooms with air conditioning, just a 1-minute walk from the Saldanha Metro station. Lisbon's historic centre is a 10-minute metro ride away, featuring emblematic areas like Chiado, Rossio and Bairro Alto. The hotel offers free WiFi throughout. All rooms have a clean décor and are fitted with USB outlets, electric kettle and a flat-screen TV with multilingual cable channels. Featuring a private bathroom, all include a hair dryer and a safety deposit box. Each morning guests can enjoy a continental breakfast buffet, made with local products, which is served in the breakfast room. There is also an outdoor esplanade, where guests are welcome to relax. Guests can also explore the surrounding area and discover the various restaurants in the surroundings. The front desk is open 24/7 and can help with various queries. Pátria Hotel is situated a 15 minutes' walk from Marquês de Pombal Square and the Eduardo VII Park. Next to the park is the start of Avenida da Liberdade, famed for its high-end shops and boutiques. Lisbon's Humberto Delgado Airport is 6 km away and is reachable via metro.

603041.address: 179, Dayaldasi Road, Vilei Parle, Mumbai Maharasht
603041.description: Hotel Aircraft International is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Mumbai. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, fax machine, photocopying are on the list of things guests can enjoy. Guestrooms are fitted with all the amenities you need for a good night's sleep. In some of the rooms, guests can find television LCD/plasma screen, air conditioning, wake-up service, desk, soundproofing. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Discover all Mumbai has to offer by making Hotel Aircraft International your base.

603113.address: P\.O\.Box 9168, Bur (Al Mankhool Road Bur Post Box
603113.description: Golden Sands Hotel Apartments, established in the early 1970s, offers a variety of furnished studios, family rooms, and two- and three-bedroom apartments in Bur Dubai. Enjoy flexible daily, weekly, or extended stays with online booking and excellent amenities at economical rates. Experience a unique stay at one of Dubai's most reliable hotel apartment options.

603114.address: Al Mankhool Road, Bur (Al Mankhool Road Bur Post B
603114.description: Situated on Al Mankhool Road in Bur Dubai, Golden Sands Hotel Apartments offers a convenient base for travellers. This property provides apartment-style accommodation, including studios and suites, many of which feature a private balcony and kitchen facilities. On-site amenities include an outdoor swimming pool, a fitness centre, and a sauna. Dining options consist of an on-site restaurant and a coffee shop. The property is located 5 km from the Dubai World Trade Centre, and Burjuman Shopping Mall is within a 15-minute walk.

603246.address: Mandarin Oriental, - Luxury 5 Star HotelRoute du G
603246.description: The Mandarin Oriental Marrakech, a five-star luxury resort, is nestled amidst 20 hectares of fragrant gardens and olive groves, just minutes from Marrakech's city center and a short drive from the Medina and airport. In response to the COVID-19 pandemic, enhanced health and safety protocols are in place, including temperature checks, PPE for guests and staff, increased disinfection, and physical distancing measures. Against the backdrop of the Atlas Mountains, the resort offers beautiful villas, spacious suites, a fabulous spa, and a selection of innovative restaurants. It's the ultimate Moroccan escape.

603301.description: The Taj Wellington Mews Luxury Residences offers 80 fully furnished apartments nestled within 2. 6 acres of landscaped gardens in the heart of South Mumbai. Minutes away from the city's prime banking, commercial, cultural, and shopping centers, these residences provide a tranquil escape from the bustling city. Its impeccable location overlooking the Arabian Sea and proximity to the Gateway of India are key highlights. Designed by renowned architect John Portman, this 14-story tower offers exquisitely designed apartments with contemporary amenities and world-class service, reflecting the rich heritage of Taj hospitality. The domestic and international airports are 20-25 km away, respectively. 'Tajness - A Commitment Restrengthened' assures authentic Indian hospitality with enhanced safety and hygiene measures.

603681.description: Civitel Esprit is a fresh and modern hotel with a new concept, recently landed within the premises of Civitel Attik, adding a unique twist in the accommodation experience of the guests. It's spacious and elegant rooms featuring a contemporary style with modern interior design and equipped with all the amenities and services, providing for the ideal setting for a short stay or a longer getaway in the city. Our restaurant will be opened from 07:00 – 22:00*Last order for food and drink 21:30

603763.description: Located in Egmond-Binnen, this hostel is situated near the North Holland Dune Reserve and is 3 km from the beach. It offers a family-friendly base for exploring the Dutch coast and nearby bulb fields. Guests have access to on-site dining, as the property features a restaurant and a bar, with breakfast included. For recreation, there is a garden, outdoor terraces, a children's playground, and bicycle rentals are available. The hostel provides complimentary Wi-Fi and free on-site parking. All rooms feature their own shower and toilet facilities. The property is wheelchair accessible.

603904.description: Situated in a monumental building located in the city center, Stayokay Hostel Amsterdam Stadsdoelen offers free WiFi access throughout the entire property. Stayokay had an EU Ecolabel and has its own sustainability program. At Stayokay Hostel Amsterdam Stadsdoelen guests will find a 24-hour front desk and a bar. Other facilities offered at the property include a shared lounge, luggage storage and laundry facilities. The shared bathrooms come with a shower. If guests would like to explore the surroundings, they can visit Rembrandtplein and the Flower Market at 450 metres away and Royal Palace Amsterdam at 750 meters. Schiphol Airport is located at 15 km away.

603907.description: The Grande Hotel Silva, formerly Hostel Des Arts, is a landmark in Amarante, blending culture, history, and nature. This boutique hostel offers a range of accommodations, from comfortable suites to modern dorms, with air conditioning throughout. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour reception and relax in the beautiful garden. The property is wheelchair-accessible.

604121.description: The Omega Hotel, a vibrant fusion of contemporary and traditional design, enjoys a prime location in Dubai. Its 238 lavish rooms offer a rich blend of abstract artistry and classic Emirati influences. Conveniently situated at the Mankhool Street junction, the hotel is a short 10-minute drive from Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai World Trade Centre, and only 11 km from the airport, making it ideal for business and leisure travellers. Guests can easily explore iconic landmarks such as the Dubai Museum and Burj Khalifa, and experience the city's dazzling nightlife.

604521.description: Thank you for choosing our Ramada hotel. Ramada is a global upper midscale hotel brand with over 820 properties located in over 50 countries worldwide. Most Ramada hotels feature free wired and wireless high speed internet access, meeting rooms, business services, fitness facilities and upgraded bath amenities. Many properties have an on site restaurant and lounge, while other sites offer a complimentary continental breakfast. You do your thing, leave the rest to us.

604542.address: Eastern Ring Road Exit 12 Airport Road, 2
604542.description: The Best Western Plus Fursan Hotel presents a different vision for hotels in the kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It takes you to the world of luxury, perfection and comfort. Situated in the most well-heeled, upscale neighborhood, the quiet yet vital and central location of the hotel makes it the best destination for both leisure and business guests. Experience the fine art of hospitality at the newly opened hotel, Best Western Fursan Hotel, combining 4 Star rooms, conference rooms, banquet facilities and a spa. 66 contemporary guest rooms and suites with central air conditioning, mini-bar, international satellite channels and laptop friendly safe deposit boxes. The hotel offers a panorama elevator, airport pick-up services, currency exchange, room service 24 hours a day, housekeeping services, business center, laundry and dry cleaning, baby sitter on request, Wi-Fi and Valet Parking. The Best Western Plus Fursan Hotel is located on Eastern Ring Road Exit 12, near Al-Orouba Street which can take you to the center of Riyadh shopping centers within minutes, only 29 kilometers from the King Khalid International Airport, 14 kilometers to downtown Olaya’s commercial and shopping area and just two kilometers to Granada Mall. Enjoy watching Live Football matches in air conditioned open air terrace/Fursan Lounge located on second floor.

604783.description: Is housed in a beautiful historic building, recently renovated with original and modern style, offering a unique setting and giving exclusivity to your stay in Barcelona. The 53 double rooms and suites of the Mosaic Hotel offer guests the possibility of living authentic Barcelona. The building, built in 1888 and of modernist essence, is the soul of this charming hotel. A historic and modern air that will make your stay a unique and original experience from the moment you arrive.  Located in the heart of Rambla Catalunya, just 10 minutes from Plaza Catalunya and 5 from the luxurious Paseo de Gracia and La Pedrera, its location will allow you to comfortably enjoy the gastronomic, artistic and cultural offer of the city of Barcelona.

604785.description: The hotel is located in the Sants-Montjuïc district, just a few minutes away from Camp Nou and Sants station, and 16 minutes when travelling by car or train from Plaza Catalunya. Its location and great connection to the rest of the city make it the ideal accommodation for discovering Barcelona. Hotel Arya is a modern building with 6 floors and 2 terraces, one of them being in the penthouse with views, a cafe bar with breakfast service and free WIFI. The 61 spacious rooms at Arya are completely soundproof and offer either a double bed or 2 individual beds. Not to mention, you can choose those with views looking out onto Carretera de Sants, the atrium (indoor patio) or with a balcony looking out to Montjuïc mountain. All rooms offer free Wifi, USB plugs and a handy desk.

604786.description: This establishment offers a total of 149 units. Those staying at this establishment may keep updated thanks to the Wi-Fi access. Everyone staying at this accommodation may contact the reception desk any time during the day. Unfortunately, there are no guest rooms where travellers can ask for a cot for the little ones. Clients may take advantage of the car park.

name.content: Lisbon Five Stars Apartments São Julião 72

604842.description: Lisbon Five Stars Apartments São Julião 72 is located in the city centre, within walking distance of most tourist attractions, and offers 10 spacious, elegant and luxurious apartments. Foreign visitors staying less than 59 days are exempt with a copy of their immigration card and passport.

608425.description:
This cosy and charming Boutique Hotel is ideally located in the heart of Amsterdam, within walking distance from the main attractions and peacefully set a few streets back from the rush. 

Each of our 23  individually decorated rooms reflects the charm of Amsterdam. The rooms are characterised by modern facilities and a warm, personal atmosphere. Each room is designed to make you feel completely at home. 

Our small elevator is bringing you to rooms on the third and fourth floor.  Convenience and cleanliness is our highest priority. 

Rooms range in size from single to quadruple, making this an ideal hotel for solo travellers and groups alike. Within minutes you can enjoy the best that Amsterdam has to offer: the beautiful Vondel park, the famous Rijks museum and Van Gogh museum and the bustling shopping streets. The most popular venues for nightlife enjoyment line the Leidse square as well as a wealth of international and typically Dutch bars and restaurants

608641.description: Located in the Teusaquillo neighborhood of Bogotá, 300 meters from the International Exhibition Center Corferias. Rooms have a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower. In addition, the Hotel Expo Inn Corferias provides free WiFi in all facilities. The reception is open 24 hours. Hotel Expo Inn Corferias is 2 km from El Campín Stadium and 2. 3 km from El Campín Coliseum. El Dorado International Airport is the closest and is located at 9 km.

608768.description: Getting more for your money at an affordable hotel in the New York City area has never been easier than it is at the Brooklyn Quality Inn near Sunset Park. We offer free WiFi, free breakfast, meeting space, a business center and guest laundry services. Your room features a refrigerator, coffee maker, 40-inch flat-screen TV and hair dryer. We are located one block from the subway making Manhattan attractions like the World Trade Center, Chinatown, Little Italy, Times Square and Barclays Center accessible. Plus, you can earn rewards like free nights and gift cards by joining our Choice Privileges program.

608779.description: Swiss Flora Inn Hotel Riyadh is designed for comfort and convenience. Located in the heart of the Business District, the hotel features 80 spacious and family-friendly rooms and suites with high-end finishes. Guests can enjoy an all-day dining restaurant, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and affordable room rates. The hotel is conveniently situated near local tourist attractions such as Boulevard World - Riyadh and King Abdullah Financial City, making it an ideal base for exploring the city.

608782.description: Welcome to the incredible five star Radisson Blu Hotel, Dubai Waterfront. We combine outstanding facilities with friendly and professional service that is sure to make your stay memorable, and feel like your new home away from home. Our “Yes I Can!SM” philosophy ensures that our guests receive outstanding service with a smile. From our rooms to our restaurants and everything in between, we guarantee an unforgettable hotel experience. Each of our 432 stylishly designed rooms and suites capture views of the Business Bay district overlooking phenomenal feats of architecture, including the 828m high Burj Khalifa and newly-opened Dubai Canal. Many of the rooms include private balconies with breath-taking views of the skyline. Business Class Rooms and Suites allow you to gain access to our exclusive Business Class Lounge and are equipped with a Nespresso® machine to satisfy your caffeine needs. Whether you're traveling for business or pleasure, or both, we guarantee 100% satisfaction and fond memories. Feel free to contact us with any questions you might have, we're here to help.

608783.description: Relax on the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool. This guesthouse also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting. Guests can get around on the shuttle (surcharge), which operates within 20 km. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The guesthouse also offers 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Cape Town? This guesthouse has facilities measuring 431 square feet (40 square meters), including conference space. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

name.content: Hyatt Place Residences Dubai Al Rigga

608982.address: Hyatt Place Dubai Al Rigga N/A, N/A
608982.description: Begin your Dubai adventure at our conveniently located hotel on Al Rigga Street, just steps from the Al Rigga metro station. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and breakfast with our special room offers. Our premium amenities, including a 24-hour fitness center and 490 sq. ft. of stylish meeting spaces, will make you feel welcome. Stay in the heart of the action at the contemporary 4-star Hyatt Place Dubai/Al Rigga. Our 210 spacious guestrooms and suites, ranging from 35 to 50 square meters, offer modern amenities catering to business and leisure travelers. Each room features contemporary decor with Arabesque accents, including natural wood and textured glass, a plush Hyatt Grand Bed™, a 42' flat-panel HDTV, a Cozy Corner sofa-sleeper, and a tastefully designed bathroom. The hotel is ideal for families and extended-stay business travelers alike. We also offer specialized amenities and services for solo female travelers. From a warm welcome to a fond farewell, we'll ensure your visit is memorable.

name.content: Mercure Dubai Barsha Heights Suites & Apartments

609101.address: Dubai Barsha Heights Area Sheikh Zayed Road
609101.description: Experience stylish accommodation with an awe-inspiring city & sea views at Mercure Dubai Barsha Heights, with 1015 Hotel Suites & Apartments. Whether you are in town for business or leisure travel, the spacious & elegantly appointed 1 & 2 bedroom suites & apartments are suitable for both long & short stays. The hotel's dining venues are an all-day dining, café lounge, sports bar, pool bar & a specialty restaurant. The hotel is also equipped with modern meeting spaces, squash court, pool, gym & kids club. Mercure Dubai Barsha Heights launches hotel suites & apartments on Sheikh Zayed Road, conveniently located in the commercial hub of Internet City, Media City and Knowledge Village, directly facing the Metro Station - Dubai Internet City, Mercure Dubai's suites & apartments are bright, elegantly decorated with all facilities leading into a spacious living area, dining area, study space, bedrooms with a big balcony and bathrooms with walk-in shower & bathtub.

609102.description: Ibis Styles Genève Palexpo is a 3-star hotel located across from Palexpo Exhibition and Congress Center, plus a short walk from the Geneva Arena. Easy access, by car or public transport, to the city center and international organizations make it ideal for business or leisure stays. GENEVA-Cointrin International Airport is 4 minutes away by bus. At Ibis Styles, unlimited WiFi access included in all prices

609144.description: The Prime Hotel is ideally located in Jeddah's Al Hamra district, offering easy access to major business and commercial centers. Perfect for both business and leisure travelers, the hotel is near major shopping areas, a 30-minute drive from King Abdulaziz Airport, and a short walk from the Corniche and King Fahd Fountain. The hotel offers 109 rooms, including Standard, Deluxe, Junior, Executive, and Family Suites. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a buffet restaurant, coffee shop, 24-hour room service, swimming pool, gym, kids' playground, meeting rooms, and a business center.

name.content: Provocateur, Berlin, a part of Sircle Collection

609145.description: Located in Berlin's Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf district, Provocateur, a Member of Design Hotels, is within a 10-minute drive of Potsdamer Platz and Checkpoint Charlie. This hotel is also conveniently close to several attractions, including Zoo Berlin (3. 1 km) and Olympiastadion (5. 9 km). Enjoy views from the terrace and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The 59 air-conditioned rooms offer minibars, flat-screen televisions with cable programming, and private bathrooms with designer toiletries and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, safes, and complimentary bottled water. The hotel features an on-site restaurant and a bar/lounge for a relaxing dining experience. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available on weekdays from 7:00 AM to noon for a fee. Other amenities include a 24-hour front desk, a safe deposit box at the front desk, and an elevator.

609242.description: The Dear Lisbon Gallery House is located on Rua de São Bento, in a quiet neighborhood once home to a Benedictine Convent in the 18th century, and now houses the Assembly of the Republic. Younger residents now fill the narrow, winding streets, enjoying authentic city living. São Bento is on the iconic Tram 28 route, offering a unique urban experience with its variety of traditional antique shops, small cafes, and bistros. This area is now popular amongst new generations of families with Lisbon roots. The 26 rooms at the Gallery House, including the Terrace Suite with its stunning city skyline view, boast romantic decor, blending vintage and antique pieces in perfect harmony. Comfort and elegance define the Dear Lisbon experience, a true home away from home. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property.

609543.description: Our Hampton Inn by Hilton Bogota Airport hotel puts you close to all the business and leisure places within the city. Situated on two of the main avenues of the city, you'll be able to complete work and still have fun during your travels. Start your day right with Hampton's free hot breakfast including hearty oatmeal, cereal and fruit. Discover great amenities in your room, including free WiFi, 24-hour housekeeping and a clean and fresh Hampton bed. Wake up to free hot tea and coffee from the comfort of your room. Take advantage of our free airport shuttle. The Sky Lobby lets you unwind after a busy day and meet up with friends and business associates. Our welcoming hotel is just 20 minutes from downtown.

609581.description: A hotel in the heart of Barcelona, where contemporary luxury, wellness, and a carefully curated culinary offering come together to transform every stay into an unforgettable experience. Discover a unique proposition that combines mediterranean cuisine, spaces designed for relaxation, and a privileged location in the city. Elegant rooms, a rooftop pool with panoramic views, fitness center, and exclusive services. At BLESS Barcelona, every moment becomes an unforgettable experience.

609582.description: Situated in Lisbon's city center, near Parque Eduardo VII and Avenida station, this hotel offers a convenient base for exploring the city. The vibrant Barrio Alto district, known for its dining and nightlife, is a pleasant 20-minute walk away, and Lisbon Airport is approximately 10 km from the property. Opened in 2017, the hotel evokes the bohemian charm of Alfama in its guest rooms. Each room features air conditioning, a TV, safe, minibar, coffee facilities, and a bathroom with a hairdryer and toiletries. Guests can enjoy both an outdoor pool (seasonal) and a heated indoor pool. A 24-hour gym caters to fitness enthusiasts, and the hotel also offers seven event rooms suitable for various business functions. Guests enjoy one complimentary Spa entry per stay. Additional amenities include taxi and transfer rental services, an electronic complaints book, and accessibility features for guests with reduced mobility. The hotel staff speaks English, Spanish, French, and Portuguese. Children of all ages are welcome. (RNET:7354)

name.content: Courtyard by Marriott New York World Trade Center

609650.description: Stay at the Courtyard by Marriott New York World Trade Center Area in Manhattan, just a 5-minute drive from One World Trade Center and the Brooklyn Bridge. This hotel offers a 24-hour fitness center and complimentary Wi-Fi. The 192 guestrooms feature LCD TVs, cable programming, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. For business travelers, a business center, express check-in, and express check-out are available. Nearby attractions include Wall Street, the 9/11 Memorial, and Battery Park.

609762.description: Now in Venice: A new dream destination in Europe awaits you! As always, A&O offers accommodation in every room category, from a double room with shower/WC and lockers, to a modern family room, always including bed linen and towels. Of course, there is free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the building, as well as additional services such as breakfast, late check-out and packed lunches. The A&O Venice Mestre is just a few minutes north of the main train station Venezia-Mestre with excellent connections to the main island of Venice and the Old Town. With its XXL lobby and 24hours bar, you are invited not only to sleep well, but also to relax in our common spaces! Good weather and la dolce Vita can be enjoyed with a delicious coffee. Kids can play in the dedicated playing area. An absolute highlight is the bright breakfast atrium. Help yourself to healthy and nourishing food at the all-you-can-eat breakfast buffet - just what you need for a long sightseeing trip through Venice!

609903.description: With a stay at Hilton Riyadh Hotel & Residences in Riyadh (Ash Shuhada), you'll be a 2-minute drive from Granada Mall and 14 minutes from Kingdom Tower. This luxury hotel is 11. 4 mi (18. 3 km) from Riyadh Zoo and 12. 7 mi (20. 5 km) from Al Faisaliyah Tower. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 indoor swimming pools, a health club, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Stay in one of 866 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature designer toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Grab a bite at Ambar, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Riyadh? This hotel has 13437 square feet (1248 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 11 meeting rooms.

name.content: Legend Hotel Lagos Airport, Curio Collection by Hi

609984.description: Welcome to Legend Hotel Lagos Airport, Curio Collection by Hilton’s debut in Africa. Located at Murtala Muhammed Airport (LOS) in the Ikeja district, our ultramodern hotel offers unrivaled proximity to the international terminal as well as an exclusive immigration and customs desk for private jet passengers – perfect for corporate and leisure travelers alike. Settle into a spacious guest room with Art Deco style and plenty of natural light. Each room features complimentary WiFi, a 40-inch TV, chaise lounge, ergonomic workspace, an espresso machine, and a bathroom with separate shower and bathtub. Here several days? Our Presidential Suite features a 50-inch TV, private terrace with bar and whirlpool, and great airfield views. Our restaurant and bar, De Bull, is open all day serving Nigerian and global cuisine against a stunning backdrop of the airfield. Connect with friends and business partners over signature cocktails and a selection from the steak menu. Our private Sky Lounge is a stylish spot for light refreshments, and we’re pleased to send meals to your door with room service. Legend Hotel Lagos Airport has all the amenities that suit your travels. Take a dip in the indoor pool, relax in the steam room, or feel inspired in the fitness center overlooking the airfield. Our pool terrace bar and exclusive aircraft crew lounge are perfect for kicking back with a smoothie or cup of coffee. Plan executive meetings with a choice of flexible boardrooms and the latest A/V equipment.

609987.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Business Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s). The following services and amenities are currently **not available**: Fitness Center. Welcome to our bright Hampton by Hilton Edinburgh West End hotel, located in the heart of Edinburgh City Centre close to all attractions, shopping, business facilities and the Haymarket Train Station. We are situated just 7 miles from Edinburgh Airport (EDI) and within walking distance of Edinburgh International Conference Center, making our friendly hotel ideal for stay for business or leisure. Relax in one of our spacious rooms on a clean and fresh Hampton bed® and get work done at the large desk with ergonomic chair. Settle into the comfortable room and watch your HDTV in comfort. With hot breakfast included in Every Stay, start your day on the right foot. We have a 24-hour hub with refreshments and convenience items available at any time. Our friendly team members are ready to recommend excellent lunch and dinner options in Edinburgh. Our fully air-conditioned Hampton by Hilton Edinburgh West End hotel has 1 meeting room available for up to 6 people. We are a 100% non-smoking hotel with a 24-hour business center and free Wi-Fi throughout. We hope to see you soon.

name.content: Mercure São Bernardo Do Campo (Old Adagio)

610081.description: Mercure São Bernardo do Campo is a great choice for those traveling to the ABC region for business or leisure. The aparthotel has a relaxed family atmosphere, including breakfast, gym, convenience store and modern rooms equipped with kitchen to make your stay easier, with studio apartment or suite alternatives. There is also a meeting room, gym area and laundry room.

610082.description: As a refuge in the midst of the most famous stone jungle in the country, the Adagio São Paulo Barra Funda invites you to take time for yourself while offering convenience and independence for your stay. The hotel in São Paulo is ideal for leisure and business trips, offering a restaurant with breakfast, lunch and dinner, a bar with delicious drinks, meeting room, gym, outdoor swimming pool and sun loungers and self-service laundry, so that you have even more autonomy during your days in the capital.

610341.description: Tambo II Hotel, is excellently located just 800 meters from Kennedy Park, which is one of the main attractions of the Miraflores district. Its unbeatable location provides facilities to its guests as it is located 400 meters from the bus station of Metropolitano, 10 minutes walking from the Larcomar Shopping Center and very close to restaurants of various meals, cinemas, libraries, pharmacies, banks and cultural centers. Tambo Dos has a 24-hour reception, a bar, a cafeteria, a grocery service, a tour desk, luggage storage and free parking. The hotel has its own restaurant that offers a very varied menu of dishes from Peruvian cuisine, as well as a variety of snacks and drinks.

610491.description: Issaquena Boutique Hotel is an exclusive establishment, uniquely situated at the top of ‘town-hill' with a 180 degree view of the town of Knysna, the lagoon and the famous Knysna Heads. A 5-minute brisk walk will get you to the town center where you will find the Knysna Mall as well as all major banks. Strolling further down Grey Street, quaint shops and coffee stops will keep you company until you reach the Waterfront where a range of activities will add to your Garden Route experience. Make Madison Manor your Garden Route base from where you will build life-time memories. We are looking forward to welcoming you.

610861.address: Omar Ibn El-Khatab St.,Heliopolis, Cairo, Egypt.
610861.description: Located in the heart of Heliopolis area, 8 KM from Cairo International Airport, 12 KM from Cairo city center and 5 minutes' walking distance to CityStars Mall, The hotel features 365 rooms & suites including 296 standard rooms, 21 Cabanas overlooking the pool area, 32 executive suites, 14 Ambassador Suites and 2 presidential suites. The hotel also offers a variety of restaurants and bars created to satisfy your every need and it includes the all-day dining restaurant offer international breakfast, lunch and dinner buffets. The Lobby Lounge offers a variety of beverage and snacks round the clock. And should you wish to enjoy the sunset while enjoying a quick drink, the View Terrace offers you a very special menu. You can also enjoy a dip in the water and a refreshing drink at the pool bar. The hotel also offers a very unique conference and events space with 9 meeting rooms that can accommodate up to 1000 guests. Recreational facilities includes a heated pool, Kids' pool, a wellness Center including Steam Bath and Sauna facilities in addition to a shopping mall soon to open. For the comfort of all our guests, please note that all indoor areas at Gewan Hotels & Resorts—including restaurants, lounges, lobbies, and guest rooms—are strictly non-smoking. We appreciate your cooperation.

name.content: Ruby Emma Hotel Amsterdam by IHG

611565.description: Ruby Emma is centrally located just 10 minutes from central station, RAI and Johan Cruyff Arena and 20 minutes from Schiphol Airport. That makes the hotel an ideal starting point for a tour through the capital of the Netherlands. Enjoy a fancy drink at the bar, our delicious healthy breakfast buffet in the morning or the special atmosphere of the individually styled rooms.

611741.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can soak up the sun at the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and an indoor pool. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Grab a bite to eat at one of the hotel's many dining establishments, which include 5 restaurants and a coffee shop/cafe. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 6458 square feet (600 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 6 meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 369 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars.

name.content: Days Inn by Wyndham Brooklyn Marine Park

612082.description: Days Inn Brooklyn Marine Park is conveniently located in the popular Brooklyn area. Offering a variety of facilities and services, the property provides all you need for a good night's sleep. Service-minded staff will welcome and guide you at Days Inn Brooklyn Marine Park. Each guestroom is elegantly furnished and equipped with handy amenities. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Convenience and comfort make Days Inn Brooklyn Marine Park the perfect choice for your stay in New York (NY).

612098.description: Thank you for choosing our Howard Johnson hotel. Howard Johnson is one of the most iconic hotel brands in America having pioneered hotel franchising in 1954 and today has over 440 hotels. In North America, the brand operates in the economy and midscale segments and offers free wireless high speed internet and complimentary continental Rise and Dine breakfast at all hotels without a restaurant. Many properties also have a pool, fitness room and or meeting space. Internationally the brand includes midscale and upscale hotels and provide a more diverse product offering and amenities

612101.description: Discover Argentina from the conveniently located Howard Johnson Resort Pilar, near downtown Pilar's shops and the airport, with a 24-hour shuttle service. Enjoy horseback riding at the El Camino polo fields or play tennis at the nearby courts. Buenos Aires is just 45 minutes away. After a fun-filled day, savor a delicious dinner at the on-site restaurant. Wake up refreshed and take advantage of the complimentary outdoor parking for easy exploration. The friendly, multilingual staff at the 24-hour front desk can help plan your day. The hotel also offers guest laundry and dry-cleaning services, a sauna, and indoor and outdoor pools. Host your next business or social event in the banquet facilities, accommodating up to 400 people. Suites, smoke-free rooms, and accessible rooms are available.

612342.address: School Street, Burj Area, Business Bay, Downtown, 6
612342.description: Specially designed for families, this sophisticated hotel is in Dubai. The main entertainment areas are 3. 5 kilometres from the hotel. Patrons can find the nearest golf course within 13 kilometres from the establishment. The property is within 16. 2 kilometres from the slopes and within 2. 7 kilometres visitors will find links of transport that will allow them to explore the area. The airport is at 14. 8 kilometres. All units are available for guests' convenience with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, coffee facilities, a private bathroom with toiletries, and a hair dryer. Visitors may pamper their taste buds at the establishment's gastronomic venue. This establishment takes pride in offering some health and wellness facilities, ideal for relaxing and having a healthy and fit body. The establishment features its own business facilities suitable for seminars, training or meetings of any type. 'Project work will start by Monday 18th September 2023 and will be completed by 4th of December 2023'

612370.description: 'Shopaholic? You'll be in the right place to grab a bargain at our Birmingham Fort Dunlop hotel. It's just a short walk from the Fort Shopping Park, where you'll find plenty of big-name stores to tempt you. You've also got easy access to the rest of the city for the likes of the NEC, Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery and the Thinktank science centre, home to an incredible planetarium and a fascinating tribute to the Spitfire plane. This hotel has upgraded rooms that feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals. Useful informationDue to the roadside location of this hotel, some external noise may be heard. Due to building works taking place near to the hotel in order to improve the hotels car park, some external noise may be heard during the day until April 2017. '

612371.description: 'Our Birmingham Maypole hotel is ideal for visits to the University of Birmingham and sports fans are also perfectly located for Edgbaston Cricket Ground. If you're a chocoholic you're just a few miles from uncovering a world of chocolate delights at Cadbury World. Hop on a bus nearby and you can be in Birmingham centre within 25 minutes. The ICC conference venue and Symphony Hall are within easy reach, or combine shopping and history with a visit to The Jewellery Quarter. This new hotel features our upgraded rooms each with a comfy king size bed complete with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on site restaurant serves our full unlimited breakfast and 24 hour pizzas. '

612396.description: Our Dunfermline hotel sits near the abbey town of Dunfermline, close to Carnegie Conference Centre and Lynebank Hospital. It's also handy for the town of Cowdenbeath and exploring the Fife countryside. Head into central Dunfermline to explore Dunfermline Abbey and elegant Pittencrieff Park - look out for the resident peacocks - or travel over the famous Forth Road Bridge to enjoy the sights of Edinburgh, under an hour away. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of food and drink choices within a short car journey from the hotel.

612399.description:
"Our Falkirk hotel is close to some of Scotland's most distinctive sights - the huge horse sculptures in Helix Park known as The Kelpies and Falkirk Wheel, the world's only rotating boat lift, which has to be seen to be believed.

You can admire the beautiful scenery along the John Muir Way hiking trail or hunt for bargains in Falkirk's traditional town centre. You're also roughly midway between Edinburgh and Glasgow, and close to top towns including Bo'ness and Denny.

All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a variety of food and drink choices within easy walking distance from this hotel.

Useful information

Due to the roadside location of this hotel, some external noise may be heard."

612581.description: The Royal Mark Hotel Apartments offers luxurious accommodations, ranging from deluxe studios to grand two-bedroom apartments, ideal for both families and business travelers. Each apartment features a well-equipped kitchenette and caters to short-term and long-term stays. Located in the heart of historic Dubai, a popular tourist destination, the Royal Mark is conveniently close to the Baniyas Metro Station, offering easy access to the Dubai International Airport. Popular attractions such as the Deira Creek, Gold Souq, and Naif Souq are also within walking distance.

612821.description: This charming Amsterdam hotel is conveniently located less than 4km from the city center, within easy walking distance of several attractions. Just 1km from major public transport links, it offers guests effortless access to the city and beyond. The airport is a mere 12km away, approximately a 30-minute journey. The hotel features accessible public areas and a welcoming reception. Its elegant dining rooms serve sumptuous dinners, while functional meeting facilities cater to business travelers. The cozy rooms are well-appointed with comfortable furnishings and essential amenities, ensuring a restful stay.

612841.description: Set in Buenos Aires and within 3. 5 km of Recoleta Cemetery, Pleno Madero features a bar, non-smoking rooms, and free WiFi. Featuring a 24-hour front desk, this property also provides guests with a restaurant. All rooms are fitted with a TV with cable channels. All rooms have a private bathroom with a shower, a hair dryer and free toiletries. Guests at the hotel can enjoy a buffet breakfast. A business centre with incredible views is available for guests at Pleno Madero. Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Cabildo, The Obelisk of Buenos Aires and Plaza de Mayo Square. This property is also rated for the best value in Buenos Aires! Guests are getting more for their money when compared to other properties in this city. A credit card will be requested as a guarantee at the time of check in.

612861.description: Located in Goynuk, this all-inclusive resort is 1. 3 mi (2. 1 km) from DinoPark and within 9 mi (15 km) of Beldibi Beach Park and Kemer Marina. Nomad Theme Park and Moonlight Beach and Park are also within 9 mi (15 km). This resort features 3 restaurants, 3 outdoor pools, and a full-service spa. Self parking is free. Additionally, an indoor pool, 4 bars/lounges, and a fitness center are onsite. All 222 rooms feature thoughtful touches like free minibar items and slippers, plus balconies and LCD TVs with satellite channels. 24-hour room service, electric kettles, and hair dryers are among the other amenities available to guests. *

612884.description: VIP Apartments Chile, located in the center of Santiago, steps from the government palace, shopping centers and main tourist attractions of the city, offers independent furnished apartments, outdoor pool, terrace with 360 view of the city and free Wi-Fi. Each apartment has a seating area, private bathroom, cable TV and fully equipped kitchen, with views of the city, mountains or interior square. The VIP Apartments have an interior square, barbecue area, games room, private parking, laundry service, airport shuttle service and vehicle rental. Santiago International Airport is 14 km away.

612906.description: Enjoy terrace views at the H24 Berlin Lichtenberg hotel, located in Berlin's Lichtenberg district, a short drive from Alexanderplatz and the East Side Gallery. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site shopping, and bike storage. The hotel offers a snack bar, bar/lounge, and buffet breakfast. All 83 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, safes, and desks. Self-parking is available (charges apply).

612909.address: Barsha Heights Al Thanya St Na, NA 13 Yes
612909.description: The new ‘Class Hotel Apartments' are meant for the people, who value elegance and comfort. Shaikh Zayed Street), within 10-minutes walk from the ‘Internet City Metro Station'. Many cultural, commercial, social and educational centres as well as bowling clubs, restaurants, malls and Spa are situated nearby, which is very convenient to the guests who would prefer to combine business and pleasure. It takes about 30 minutes to get to the hotel from the airport

613081.address: Marasi Drive, next to Lake Central Tower
613081.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Enjoy Italian cuisine at Basta, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Dubai? Built in the famous Porto's A Brasileira Café, the first to serve coffee in a cup on the early 20th century, and recognized with the slogan “ the best coffee comes from A Brasileira'. The new Historical has managed to preserve the building's original architectural features. This luxury hotel, nearby the Sá da Bandeira Theatre and the famous São Bento Train Station, offers a gymnasium, 2 meeting rooms, a restaurant inspired by Portuguese Cuisine, a French Patio a with natural vertical garden and the A Brasileira café which boasts over 115 years history.

614361.description: Central Berlin hotel close to Museum Island. Wi-Fi and breakfast are always included. The Holiday Inn Express® Berlin - Alexanderplatz hotel is a 10-minute walk from Alexanderplatz and the trendy shops and cafés of Hackescher Markt. Key local businesses like Deutsche Bahn, Deutsche Telekom and Universal Music are easily accessible by taxi. Trade fairs at Messe Berlin can be reached in half an hour by public transport, and international flights from Berlin Airport (BER) can be made in less than 40 minutes by car or train via S9. There’s a world-class arts and antiquities collection in the grand buildings on nearby Museum Island, while the Brandenburg Gate, the Memorial of the Berlin Wall, and the Holocaust Memorial are all 15 minutes away by bus or U-Bahn from nearby stops. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Wi-Fi included- Express Start™ Breakfast included in the room rate- Outdoor terrace- Parking for a daily feeSleek, soundproof guest rooms offer blackout curtains for comfort, integrated bedside USB ports for your devices, and flat-screen Smart TVs. Dining options include several on-site restaurants, a breakfast room, and the Infinity Rooftop Lounge which provides views of the West Bay skyline. 614801.description: The perfect solution for your short (from 1 night) and long stays in the capital of Europe! 614841.description: In a privileged setting, between a hill by São Jorge's castle walls on the right, the splendid Santa Justa lift on the left and the nearby deep blue river Tagus, one comes across the Villa Baixa aparthotel. Discreet, with slightly austere yet elegant lines, like many buildings in the “Baixa Pombalina” (the downtown area that was re-built by the Marquis of Pombal, the kingdom's Prime Minister, after the 1755 earthquake), Villa Baixa is engaging both for its historical surroundings and especially for its interiors which combine one of Portugal's most beautiful traditions – tile work – with a contemporaneity displayed in sleek atmospheres, little details and a remarkable comfort to which the 21st century visitor is particularly sensitive.

615141.description: A fusion of timeless elegance and state-of-the-art technology, the luxury Crowne Plaza Riyadh RDC Hotel & Convention in Saudi Arabia is the perfect short- or long-stay hotel in Riyadh. With King Khalid International Airport and top tourist attractions less than 30 minutes away by car, guests can travel to and from the hotel effortlessly. There’s also free on-site parking. Being it an office away from home or a high-powered business event, guests can expect exemplary service and high standards of comfort. The hotel with its swimming pool, spa, and gym means you can stay healthy and focused as you travel. The hotel’s culinary experience represents a cross-section of global cuisine. 615623.description: Hermanus Boutique Guest House is a Luxurious haven of comfort and tranquility . Put your feet up and watch the famous whales perform their aquatic antics in sparkling Walker Bay. Our range of rooms cater for many preferences and budgets - from the beautiful Honeymoon Suite with unparalleled ocean views through to the Pool Suites overlooking the deck alongside the swimming pool, the Standard Rooms in the main Guest House to the very spacious Self-Catering Unit within a 90-year-old historic house.

615658.description: WC BY THE BEAUTIQUE HOTELS CREATIVE CONCEPT Get free of prejudices, drop the robe, the towel and everything you've ever seen! The Beautique WC Hotel is born to wash our souls at Avenida Almirante Reis, an area of the city where multicultural movements are emerging and it's becoming the new Soho of Lisbon, assuming nowadays as a hub of creativity, dynamism and aggregator of young people looking for positive differentiation! But water doesn't wash everything! . . . So how to translate feelings beyond of mere words?

615659.description:
Situated in the district of Salamanca, these apartments are perfect for the tourist that wants a little luxury. The apartments feature a unique and colourful design, and are both comfortable and spacious with a fully-equipped kitchen, perfect for you to enjoy the city as if from the comfort of your own home. 
Salamanca is the home of many opulent shops, but it also just a short distance from the Wizink Centre where you can take in a concert by some of the biggest international artists! The district of Malasaña, with its many bars and restaurants is only a short ride away on the metro, this extremely trendy área plays host to many fantastic events such as an annual Street art festival or weekly markets in one of its many plazas. 
Alternatively, you can walk to the nearby Retiro park, the heart of the city where both tourists and madrileños are able to relax together and enjoy its many acres of green space. Next to this is the Prado, an art gallery that plays host to one of the biggest collections of classical art in the world, it is completely unmissable.
These apartments are, without a doubt, perfect for exploring everything Madrid has to offer.

615872.description: A few minutes away from the historic center and the main tourist attractions, as well as from Lordelo do Ouro, a picturesque fishing area, Vila Galé Porto Ribeira is a boutique hotel, resulting from the rehabilitation of four buildings in the area of Cais das Pedras, near the Old Customs House of Porto and about 10 kilometers from the Sá Carneiro airport. Themed after the art of painting, this hotel in Porto stands just opposite the Douro, with a superb view of the river. Completely integrated into the urban reality of Cais das Pedras, it draws on its proximity to the riverside area of Porto. The hotel's reception and lobby keep a strong relationship with the river, allowing guests to enjoy the views. Some rooms will have the Douro as scenery. During your stay at this hotel in Porto, take the opportunity to stroll through the trendy, cool, welcoming and genuine city of Porto, the second largest in Portugal. It is famous for its colorful riverside area, acknowledged as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO, with its narrow and snuggled buildings by the Douro River. But it is also known for the modernity of the Serralves Foundation and Casa da Música (House of Music). As well as by the liveliness of the Galleries of Paris or the Miguel Bombarda Street, home of multiple art galleries and shops with the latest fashion trends. In Foz, where the Douro meets the Atlantic, the coastline road area is ideal for those who enjoy the sun, the sea and the beach, as it stretches to Matosinhos, a paradise for lovers of fresh fish and seafood.

We have ample common living areas, ideally characterized for the use of our guests, so that they feel at home, in a receptive and welcoming environment and where they have the opportunity to fraternize with various cultures that pass through this Hotel. We also have a circuit composed by Sauna, Turkish Bath, Massage Room and Indoor Swimming Pool, thought to the detail to add the maximum comfort and luxury to the stay of the guests who are looking for moments of pure relaxation and relaxation.

616082.description: When your hotel is located on the sports boulevard of Haarlem, you don't really have a choice but to use a sports theme for the interior. 616162.description: The ibis Brussels Erasmus offers 80 renovated rooms, a 24-hour bar with drinks and snacks, a delicious breakfast buffet, and private parking. All rooms feature a work desk, a Sweet Bed by ibis™, a flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom. The ibis Kitchen serves lunch and dinner. Hotel staff are available 24/7 to assist with any requests.

616502.description: Highways! No, these are not just roads that cars drive on. They played a crucial role in connecting Brazil's cities, and were built to boost industry, but it doesn't stop there! They are bridges between what we leave behind and where we want to go. They u nite us, bring us together and delight us. At the ibis Styles Três Rios, you can enjoy a familiar ibis experience with an innovative new design, inspired by the country's roads. We hope that all roads lead you here.

Echoes of another time resound through the hills of the Portuguese capital, the same eras conserved today in the Aurea Museum 5*. This unique building presents a valuable cultural heritage which dates back several centuries. With the goal of sharing and preserving an important part of Portuguese history, the Aurea Museum 5* invites you to discover its archaeologic exhibition, a unique space that will guide you through the different eras that define the city’s identity today.

616921.description: With a sober grandeur, evident from the façade to the interiors, Dear Lisbon Bordalo House offers nine luminous suites, each with a distinct personality. Prioritizing comfort, serenity, and attentive, personalized service, the hotel harmoniously blends past and present in a modern, elegant setting. The building's character and its proximity to Chiado, Bairro Alto, the Tagus river-bordered Terreiro do Paço, cultural landmarks such as the D. Maria II and São Carlos theaters, Brasileira café, and Benard patisserie, among other iconic locales, evoke old Lisbon, with its vibrant artistic life and bohemian spirit, allowing guests a unique experience of the city and its history. A full renovation preserved the aristocratic wooden doors of the suites and the iron railings of the façade balconies.

616969.description: Situated in Dubai Marina, Crowne Plaza Dubai Marina offers direct access to the vibrant Marina promenade with its numerous cafes and restaurants. Guests can enjoy a premium club lounge, a health club, and five restaurants, including a Thai specialty restaurant and an all-day dining option. The hotel also features extensive meeting and event facilities, including three large meeting rooms, a boardroom, and a ballroom, making it ideal for both business and leisure travelers.

With only 18 luxury suites and a short stroll from the beach, you can expect a personal, world-class experience. Charming architectural details, centuries of heritage, and luxurious amenities make for a world-class getaway.
