621913.description: Located in the heart of Ikeja Metropolis, near Murtala Mohammed International Airport, Bavidi Hotel offers a variety of accommodations, from Standard to Super Deluxe rooms. Each room features air conditioning, a wardrobe, work desk and chair, flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a refrigerator, and an en-suite bathroom. Some rooms also include a separate sitting area. Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi, on-site parking, and 24-hour front desk service. The hotel's restaurant serves local and continental cuisine, and the bar offers a wide selection of drinks. A daily breakfast is available for an additional charge. Security personnel ensure a safe and comfortable stay.

621914.address: 1st Avenue, I Close House 3, Festac Town, Festac
621914.description: Situated in Amuwo, 5 km from Beachlands Jetty for pleasure Boats. Boasting a 24-hour front desk, this property also provides guests with a restaurant. Guests can have a cocktail at the bar. At the hotel, rooms come with a desk and a flat-screen TV. Guest rooms feature a seating area. A continental breakfast can be enjoyed at the property

621925.address: Along Lekki Free Trade Zone Road, Lekki
621925.description: Situated in Lagos, Fun City Hotel 2 provides a bar. Boasting a 24-hour front desk, this property also provides guests with a restaurant. Free WiFi is provided throughout the property. At the hotel, rooms are fitted with a desk and a flat-screen TV. The private bathroom is fitted with free toiletries. All guest rooms feature a wardrobe.

621930.address: 7, Tade Aranmolate Close, Willam Estate Surulere
621930.description: Featuring a shared lounge and a bar, Ed Scob Suites is set in Lagos, 2. 8 km from The National Gallery of Modern Art. With free WiFi, this 5-star hotel offers free shuttle service. The property is 6 km from TinCan Harbour. At the hotel, rooms have a desk. With a private bathroom equipped with a bath and free toiletries, certain units at Ed Scob Suites also have a terrace. All guest rooms will provide guests with a wardrobe and a kettle. Staff at reception can assist around the clock with guidance on the area. Verekete Shrine is 7 km from the accommodation.

name.content: The House of Sandeman – Hostel & Suites

621971.description: Pleasure, sophistication, irreverence, and unpretentiousness: these are the values that define Sandeman, and what you will find at The House of Sandeman Hostel & Suites. Set in one of Porto's most iconic buildings, The House of Sandeman Hostel & Suites is a new type of creative hospitality. Here you will be able to experience the city like a local, and celebrate the legacy of one of the world's most inspiring brands. In true Sandeman fashion, the new The House of Sandeman Hostel & Suites is surprising, stylish and daring, introducing a new way of experiencing a city. In this property, breakfast is included. The breakfast selection varies according with the type of room booked.

621981.description:
Located in the tourist district of Marrakech and just a 7-minute walk from the famous Jemaa El Fna Square, and 5 minutes from El Badi Palace, Bahia Palace, the Royal Palace, the Saadian Tombs, and Bab Agnaou, one of Marrakech's 19 magnificent gates, Riad Blue Eyes is an ideal choice for travelers interested in cultural sightseeing, souks, and exploring both the old and new city, as well as those seeking relaxation and tranquility. 

This property is also highly rated for its excellent location in Marrakech. 

At Riad Blue Eyes, all rooms are decorated with traditional Moroccan furnishings and feature a private bathroom, air conditioning, and free Wi-Fi. Guests are welcomed with complimentary mint tea and traditional Moroccan specialties upon arrival. 

Breakfast is served on the terrace, offering a stunning 360° panoramic view of Marrakech's landmarks and the Atlas Mountains. 

The Riad team can assist you in organizing excursions and guided tours in Marrakech and its surrounding regions. An airport shuttle service is also available through the 24-hour reception. 

Two secure parking facilities are located just a 5-minute walk from the Riad. 

We invite you to discover and enjoy this unique Moroccan experience at Riad Blue Eyes!

621999.description: Situated in the centre of Venice, in the same piazza as the Gran Teatro La Fenice and just 250 meters from St. Mark's Square, Al Theatro Palace is destined to become a point of reference for all those who love art and music and choose to visit Venice. The Hotel perfect combination of elegance and excellent customer service. Recently renovated, it boasts the comfort and services of an extremely modern hotel, the timeless charm of its rooms, the strategic and prestigious location and the proximity to one of the most famous theatres in the world. Al Theatro Palace is located in the S. Fantin piazza, next to the La Fenice Theatre and just minutes from St. Mark's Square. All rooms are quite spacious and have been meticulously restored and elegantly furnished. Technology and efficiency accompany their discreet elegance and luxury. The result is an impeccable service and complete comfort.

622004.description: Open the door to a great stay and endless possibilities at Staybridge Suites Doha Lusail. Strategically located just 10 minutes from downtown Doha, a 30-minute drive from Hamad International Airport, Staybridge Suites Doha Lusail offers modern serviced apartments for guests looking for a home away from home in Qatar. Stylishly designed and furnished with thoughtful amenities for short or extended stays, each serviced apartment is fitted with separate bedrooms, a living area, a full kitchen, a laundry machine and a workspace for the perfect blend of work, relax, and play. A collection of one, two- and three-bedroom apartments are available for single professionals or families looking to stay in the rapidly developing business district of Lusail. Maintain your workout regimen in the fully equipped Fitness Centre, or take a dip in the swimming pool. Grab your essentials at The Pantry, a 24-hour convenience store. Shop unique items from local and international brands all in one space at My Space Café & Concept Store. Complimentary Wi-Fi internet access is available for guests to work and stay connected. Discover what Doha has to offer with famous attractions such as the historic Lusail Stadium, Souq Waqif, Katara Cultural Village, Corniche, The Pearl, Westabay, Lagoona Mall and Place Vendome Mall with just a 10-15 minute drive away.

622041.address: Santa Croce Campo S. Giacomo dell'Orio, 1624
622041.description: This charming hotel is set in a Venetian palazzo, complete with a double courtyard, secret garden, and private water entrance from the canal. The gentle lull of the water greets you upon arrival, alongside two beautiful aquariums teeming with fish and shellfish in the lobby. The interiors feature a clean, warm design, with a palette of Havana, cream, ecru, and hazelnut. Exposed brick and stone, wood, and gilded metals create a unique ambiance, enhanced by the works of local artisans, seamlessly blending modernity and tradition. The 28 rooms and 5 apartments showcase contemporary furnishings, including custom glassware, chandeliers, artwork, and decorative elements, all exclusively created for the hotel by local artists and craftsmen. A striking glass lighting installation graces the entrance.

622183.description: Τα Athens Boutique Apartments έχουν δημιουργηθεί για να ενισχύσουν τη σύγχρονη αστική ζωή στη μυθική πόλη της Αθήνας. Νιώστε τη μυστικιστική ατμόσφαιρα μιας από τις πιο διαφορετικές πόλεις στον κόσμο μέσα από την άνεση και τον ελεύθερο χρόνο που μπορούμε να σας προσφέρουμε. Ζήστε την ιστορία, τα τρόφιμα, την τέχνη, τα ψώνια και πολλά άλλα όπως ποτέ πριν, καθιστώντας την επίσκεψή σας σε αυτή τη λαμπρή πόλη πραγματικά αξέχαστη.

623141.description: Nestled in The Crags, a lush forest and Fynbos region near Plettenberg Bay on South Africa's famed Garden Route, AfriCamps at Ingwe offers elevated tents with breathtaking views. Overlooking rolling green hills, indigenous forests, and the Tsitsikamma Mountains, this glamping site is an outdoor adventurer's paradise. Explore nearby attractions like Monkeyland and Birds of Eden, or unwind on your private deck and enjoy the tranquil beauty of Ingwe's forest. A variety of activities are available, from horse riding and game reserves to canoeing and wine tasting.

623196.description: StayEasy Cape Town City Bowl has 302 fresh and stylish rooms, perfectly located in the heart of the city. Our Cape Town City Bowl accommodation keeps things simple with a choice between Twin Rooms with two single beds or Standard Rooms with a double bed. Wheelchair-accessible rooms are also available on request.

623263.description: Do you imagine staying completely refurbished apartments, with a modern design in the centre of Madrid? Tandem La Bolsa 4 Apartments offer all the comforts, services and an excellent location 5 minutes away from Puerta del Sol. Its design in whites and beiges combined with an open space where minimalism and straight lines prevail, make of these apartments the ideal option for your stay in the capital. Likewise, its wide double beds and fully equipped kitchen will give you the maximum comfort and liberty to enjoy the most your days in Madrid.

623306.description: The unique Hotel The July - Twenty Eight offers a hotel/apartment concept with spacious, comfortable design apartments combined with the service and facilities of a luxury hotel. Featuring a sauna and fitness facilities. Guests can make use of the underground garage. All apartments have a fully equipped kitchen, a living room with a spacious seating area and a luxurious bathroom equipped with a rain shower. Climate control, flat-screen TV and high-speed WiFi offer extra comfort. Other than cooking in your own apartment it is possible to have breakfast in the lobby or in your apartment. You can work in the co-working space or relax in the living room. The lobby, lounge, bar and reception are open 24-hours per day. The reception staff are available for planning excursions, offering rental bikes and information about the area.

623391.description: Located in the heart of Dubai, FORM Hotel Dubai, a Member of Design Hotels, is a 4-minute drive from Dubai Creek and 5 minutes from Dubai Festival City Mall. This upscale hotel is also conveniently located near City Centre Deira (5. 3 km) and Al Seef (7. 2 km). Enjoy recreational opportunities such as the 24-hour health club and outdoor pool. This Art Deco hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands, as well as a complimentary shuttle service within a 12-kilometer radius. The 136 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, LED televisions, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and digital programming. Bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Dine at the hotel restaurant, enjoy snacks in the coffee shop/cafe, or order room service during limited hours. A poolside bar is also available. Buffet breakfast is offered daily for a fee from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and free self-parking.

623422.description: Al Khoory Inn is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Dubai. Offering a variety of facilities and services, the property provides all you need for a good night's sleep. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour room service, 24-hour security, taxi service, wheelchair accessible are there for guest's enjoyment. Towels, carpeting, clothes rack, slippers, flat screen television can be found in selected guestrooms. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Friendly staff, great facilities, and close proximity to all that Dubai has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Al Khoory Inn.

623423.description: MENA Plaza Hotel Albarsha is synonymous to elegance and style, focusing on luxury and convenience while giving you far more than your money's worth in excellent service and accommodations. You will be a walk away from the Mall of Emirates, the renowned world class shopping centre. Moreover, if you choose to remain in our care, you will be pampered within our suites and rooms, all which are provided with LED TVs with over 50 international channels, a mini bar with soft drinks and in-room coffee and tea, to refresh you throughout the day. You will also be free to choose whether your room is to be “smoking” or “non-smoking” and we will be ready to accommodate your preferences at any time. At MENA Albarsha our core Arabian values are the very essence of what we do. They motivate and inspire us to give you all the best service in an alcohol-free hotel suitable for families

623424.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this aparthotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Take advantage of the aparthotel's 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A shuttle from the airport to the hotel is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 186 guestrooms, featuring kitchens with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and ovens. 32-inch LCD televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

623506.description: Madrid is a city that offers many possibilities and original plans to those who visit it. In the capital you can do everything; from relaxing in a salt cave to tasting exquisite dishes in trendy gastrobars. These accommodations are located in the fashionable area of Madrid, at the epicenter of everything that happens. Surrounded by theatres and museums, just 4 min walk from the Mercado de San Ildefonso and 10 from the Wax Museum. San Lorenzo 26 apartments offer the comfort of a hotel and the freedom of an apartment. Do not give up anything. The keys to the apartment are collected at the Eurostars Central Hotel, located at 10 Mejía Lequerica Street.

623626.description: Pension Guesthouse Berlin is located on the top floor of a monumentally protected building from the 19th century, located in the colourful district of Prenzlauer Berg. The building was completely renovated and the rooms are easily accessible by an elevator. They are warmly furnished and equipped with a flat-screen TV and safe, a private bathroom providing free toiletries and a hairdryer. We offer a small common area with comfortable armchairs and tables in the hall, as well as coffee and tea bar for our guests. Enjoy a breakfast buffet at the neighbouring Pension Freiraum Berlin, about 200 meters away. Hiring a bike is available next door and cycling is a popular way to explore the local area and Berlin. Alexanderplatz and the famous TV Tower are 2. 5 km from Pension Guesthouse Berlin, while Tegel Airport is 8 km from the property.

623641.address: Al Dar Tower, King Salman Bin Abdulaziz Road, 40
623641.description: Located south of the spectacular Palm Jumeirah, amidst Dubai's iconic skyline, the Barceló Residences Dubai Marina offers newly built apartments within the elegant Dubai Marina district. This vibrant area boasts a variety of restaurants and over 1, 200 shops across several high-end malls, seamlessly blending urban living with coastal charm. These modern apartments provide the perfect family or couple's getaway, featuring an outdoor pool, whirlpool, and a fully equipped fitness center. Just minutes from the beach and opposite Palm Jumeirah, the 250 cozy apartments invite you to experience the magic of the Arabian Peninsula. Discover nearby attractions such as Ski Dubai, Jumeirah Mosque, and the Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building.

623691.address: Balogun Disu Street Baba Adisa, Ibeju-Lekki, 3
623691.description: Set in Lagos, 42 km from Sport Centre, Castle City Resort & Suites Annex has a bar and on-site dining. The property is around 42 km from Police Medical Centre and 43 km from Muri Okunola Park. Free WiFi is available throughout the property and Terra Kulture is 43 km away. At the hotel, every room has a desk. The rooms will provide guests with a fridge. When guests need guidance on where to visit, the reception will be happy to provide advice. Falomo Bridge Jetty is 43 km from Castle City Resort & Suites Annex.

623695.address: 1/3 Bashiru Oshikoya Street, Ijede Road, Ikorodu
623695.description: Duckland Hotel and Suites is situated in Ikorodu, Lagos State. The hotel boasts an onsite restaurant and bar. Each room features an air conditioner, a TV with satellite reception, a worktable and designed with an en-suite shower. Breakfast is served daily for an extra charge. The onsite restaurant and bar serves a variety of meals and drinks. Guests enjoy swimming sessions at the outdoor pool. The hotel features an event facility. Laundry, airport pickup and car hire services are provided upon request. Onsite parking is available and the premises are guarded round the clock. The hotel is a 10-minute drive from Tarzan Ferry Terminal and a 15-minute drive from Ikorodu Garage.

623696.address: Plot 4 Dreamworld Africana Way, Lekki Phase 2
623696.description: Featuring free WiFi and a spa centre, Eastgate Hotel offers accommodation in Lekki. The hotel has an outdoor pool and fitness centre, and guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant. Free private parking is available on site. Every room at this hotel is air conditioned and has a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Some units include a seating area where you can relax. Some rooms have views of the pool or city. Every room has a private bathroom with a bath or shower, with free toiletries provided. A TV is available. There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. You can play darts at this hotel, and car hire is available. The nearest airport is Murtala Muhammed International Airport, 28 km from the property.

623700.description: TLagos Transit Hotel, Folawewo Ogundana is a modest hotel in Ikeja area of Lagos State. This establishment is famous for its courteous staff and location.  All rooms at Lagos Transit Hotel, Folawewo Ogundana have en-suite bathrooms with hot and cold running water, flat screen televisions, open WI-FI service, among others. Lagos Transit Hotel, Folawewo Ogundana is a 10-minute drive to and from Muritala Mohammed International Airport.

623706.address: 6/10, Samelot St, Akasolori, Itokin Road, Ikorodu.
623706.description: Samelot Hotels is an affordable located on Samelot street in Ikorodu Lagos. The hotel offers spacious rooms at pocket friendly prices. Each room at Samelot is fully air-conditioned and serviced with wifi connectivity. The rooms also come fitted with a television, worktable, a mini-fridge and private bathroom. The rooms boast of king sized beds and key card system for maximum security. The onsite restaurant offers a wide variety of local and intercontinental dishes. The bar serves alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks that can be enjoyed at the lounge. Breakfast is served at a surcharge. The hotel has a playground for the entertainment of children as well as an event hall for social and business gatherings and get-togethers. There is a gift shop situated in the premises.

623708.description:
Located in Abuja, Sun Heaven Hotel & Resort Abuja is within a 5-minute drive of Ecowas Secretariat and World Bank.  This hotel is 3.6 mi (5.8 km) from Federal Secretariat and 3.9 mi (6.2 km) from National Assembly.
Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and a fitness center.
Featured amenities include limo/town car service, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self parking is available onsite.
Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM.
Stay in one of 25 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries.

623709.address: Block9, Plot 8, Admiralty Road,Lekki Phase1, Lagos
623709.description:
Sun Heaven Hotel Lekki is set in Lagos and has a fitness centre, bar and on-site dining. Conveniently set in the Lekki Phase 1 district, the property is located 5 km from Police Medical Centre and 5 km from Sport Centre. Free WiFi and a 24-hour front desk are offered.

The units in the hotel are equipped with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Rooms are complete with a private bathroom, while some rooms at Sun Heaven Hotel Lekki also provide guests with a seating area. The rooms at the accommodation have air conditioning and a wardrobe.

623727.description: Welcome to Arie Lagoon Escape to Arie Lagoon, a luxury hotel in Negombo lying between the shimmering waters of the lagoon and the Indian Ocean, in the fishing village of Thalahena. This 4 Star Negombo lagoon hotel, which provides easy access to the airport and the commercial capital Colombo, is your getaway to paradise!

623804.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 16 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

623883.description: The 4-star Hotel Kettenbrücke is a fully renovated hotel, just opened in March 2016. The hotel is located in the old town in the city of Aarau at the historic city wall, next to the river Aare and the ancient bridge 'Kettenbrücke'. The hotel offers 24 stylish, modern and spacious bedrooms and 3 suites. All bedrooms and suites are in a warm color scheme with wooden floors and equipped with flat screen televisions, a high speed Wireless Internet connection, spacious rain showers or bath tubs and nespresso machines. In addition the hotel has a stylish bar and lounge, a restaurant offering fresh international and regional dishes, a private member club and meeting and event rooms as well as a roof terrace with a view to the river Aare.

623894.description: River Manor is a boutique hotel located in the very heart of historic Stellenbosch. Our unbeatable location is within easy walking distance from everything that the historic oak-lined town has to offer. Housed in two adjacent manor houses and set in a landscaped garden on the banks of the Eerste River, we offer discerning travellers an unforgettable experience in a gloriously romantic environment. Luxuriously- appointed rooms are spacious and contemporary with a classic undertone.

623941.description: Riad Zineb is nestled in the heart of Marrakech's historic Medina, an 8-minute walk from Djemaa el-Fna square and moments away from the vibrant souks and Marrakech Museum. Taxis can access the riad within a minute's walk. This charming riad boasts a refreshing swimming pool and eight spacious rooms adorned in traditional Moroccan style. Partnering with Riads Karmela and Karmela Princesse, located just 100 meters away, guests can enjoy two exquisite Moroccan restaurants, traditional hammam treatments, and massages, and book enriching day trips. A delicious traditional breakfast is served daily, and the riad offers a 24-hour front desk for added convenience. For seamless airport transfers, booking directly with the riad via email is recommended. Free Wi-Fi is available in public areas.

624042.address: 5, New Nagardas Rd, Near Metro Station Exit Gate, 1
624042.description: In the hustle bustle of India's global city, a comforting stay awaits you at Siesta Andheri Hotel. Set in the beautifully landscaped expanses and meticulously spaced area, Siesta Andheri gives you a peaceful stay after you have enjoyed your day in the city. We offer 51 well furnished rooms with all the modern facilities to make your stay comfortable and enjoyable. Our experienced staff are always ready to provide friendly, individualized service to our guests.

624241.description: Just 15 minutes from Venice, Villa Barbarich is the ideal resort for an elegant stay, featuring all the best services and amenities in the renovated spaces of a splendid 16th century Venetian villa. A silent presence of history within a charming and relaxing setting allows for the pleasures and emotions that distinguish Villa Barbarich from other hotels. Rooms and suites that are refined in every detail, furnished in period furniture, featuring ceilings with exposed beams and wooden parquet floors. Easy to get to from Venice's Marco Polo airport and situated near the major motorway exits, Villa Barbarich is an exclusive location for your holidays in Venice, with excellent services and all the amenities of a superior 4 star hotel.

624250.description:
Apartments strategically located between the FIRA de GRAN Vía, very close to the Camp Nou, in the District of SANTS and MONTJIC.
Just 100 metres from the Mercat Nou metro station and 200 of the Badal.
All apartments are spacious, bright, with patios, terraces or balconies according to their typology and have everything you need for a pleasant stay.

624281.description: Enjoy garden views and complimentary Wi-Fi at the AC Hotel Venezia by Marriott. The hotel offers a snack bar/deli and a bar/lounge for guests' convenience. A continental breakfast is available on weekdays (6:30 AM - 10:00 AM) and weekends (7:00 AM - 10:30 AM) for a fee. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and an elevator. The 79 guestrooms feature refrigerators, minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with rainfall showers and complimentary toiletries, phones, safes, and desks. Centrally located in Venice, the AC Hotel Venezia by Marriott is a short walk from Piazzale Roma and the Grand Canal, and conveniently close to the Port of Venice.

624301.description: This comfortable hotel can be found in Porto. There are a total of 70 bedrooms at Porto Royal Bridges Hotel. Customers may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection throughout. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. Porto Royal Bridges Hotel does not offer cots on demand. Pets are not allowed at this hotel. Porto Royal Bridges is a themed hotel where the rooms have different sizes and layouts, on all floors, for similar room types. For this reason we, unfortunately, cannot guarantee that the room you are allocated in will be exactly the same as what you see in the photographs. Even so, the style remains the same, as well as the characteristics presented in the description of each room type.

624302.address: RUA DE CAMOES, Porto União de Freguesias do Centro, 298
624302.description: This property is self-check-in and does not have a reception. Guests must contact the property (+351 912 072 470) before arrival. Turista Da Trindade offers free WiFi and air-conditioned rooms in Porto, 300 meters from Trindade metro station. Popular points of interest nearby include Avenida dos Aliados, Santa Catarina Street, and the lively Paris Galleries Street. All rooms are equipped with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a private bathroom. Some units also feature a balcony. Please note that this property does not have an elevator; access is via stairs.

624341.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a 24-hour fitness center, and bicycles to rent. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and lifeguards on site. The complimentary shuttle will take you to the nearby beach or shopping center. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). A complimentary buffet breakfast is included. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 388 square feet (36 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. A train station pick-up service is provided at no charge, and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 168 guestrooms, featuring kitchens with refrigerators and stovetops.

624342.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. The complimentary shuttle will take you to the nearby beach or shopping center. Enjoy international cuisine at City Limits, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 387 square feet (36 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. A train station pick-up service is provided at no charge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.

624346.description: Enjoy a day at the private beach or take advantage of the outdoor pool and 24-hour fitness center at this conveniently located Palm Jumeirah hotel. Aloft Palm Jumeirah offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Savor Mexican cuisine at Luchador Cantina & Cockta, one of the hotel's five restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the three other bars/lounges. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel also provides a business center and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Free self-parking is available onsite. Each of the 194 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, complimentary Wi-Fi, cable TV, a private bathroom with designer toiletries and a hairdryer, a safe, and a desk. Housekeeping is provided daily. The hotel is close to Palm Islands.

624385.description: This hotel offers modern rooms with free Wi-Fi in the pedestrianized historic quarter of Berlin-Spandau. It lies 66 feet from Spandau Altstadt underground and 328 feet from the River Spree. The tastefully furnished rooms at the Hotel Lindenufer all include cable TV and a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer. They offer views of the Old Town or green courtyard. Nearby attractions include Spandau's famous Zitadelle. Potsdamer Platz in central Berlin is a 35-minute train journey away.

624412.address: Jeddah's Corniche Road Obhur Jeddah, S/N
624412.description: The Radisson Blu Hotel, Jeddah Corniche, is conveniently located within 1. 8 kilometers of the main entertainment areas and 6. 1 kilometers from the airport. This eco-friendly hotel offers 150 cozy accommodations, Wi-Fi access, a 24-hour reception, accessible rooms, and on-site parking. Guests can also enjoy the hotel's health facilities and event spaces suitable for business seminars or special occasions. Cribs are not available.

624423.description: Situated in King Fahd District, this 4-star hotel is 10 km from the centre of Riyadh. It offers spacious guestrooms with free Wi-Fi in all areas, a fitness centre and an indoor swimming pool. Spa facilities are available at an added fee. Rooms at the Al Hamra Palace by Warwick have luxury bedding and modern wood furnishings. They include a large flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a DVD player. Some rooms feature large windows with panoramic city views. Guests can benefit from the hotel's laundry and ironing services. Daily newspapers are provided in the Al Hamra Palace by Warwick lobby and there is also a car hire desk. An airport shuttle is available upon request. A variety of meat and vegetarian dishes are served in Al Mukhtar, Al Hamra Palace by Warwick lobby-level restaurant. Fresh pastries, light salads and gourmet coffee are available at the Coffee Lounge. Al Hamra Palace by Warwick is less than 01 KM from Riyadh Gallery and Olaya st. 12 km from Riyadh Zoo and a 30-minute drive from King Khalid International Airport. Free public parking is possible on site.

624543.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Complimentary Evening Social, Breakfast. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Fitness Center, Pool. Welcome to Hampton Inn & Suites Teaneck Glenpointe. Our new hotel is ideally located at the crossroads of I-95 and I-80, just three miles from the George Washington Bridge and only 15 minutes from Midtown Manhattan. Make yourself at home in a modern guest room or suite. Each room at our Teaneck, NJ hotel features our clean and fresh Hampton bed®, an LCD TV, coffeemaker and free WiFi. Upgrade to a studio suite for extra space, mini-refrigerator and microwave. Each morning you'll wake up to fresh waffles and hearty oatmeal at Hampton's free hot breakfast. If you're in a hurry, grab a Hampton on the Run® Breakfast Bag, available Monday through Friday, as you head out the door. Keep up your fitness routine in our onsite fitness center or take a dip in the indoor pool. Business travelers can also make use of our flexible meeting space and 24-hour business center.

name.content: Homewood Suites by Hilton Teaneck Glenpointe

624545.description: Welcome to the Homewood Suites by Hilton Teaneck Glenpointe. Our dual-branded hotel offers enhanced communal areas, providing ample space for both business and leisure travelers. Located just off I-80 and I-95, our all-suite hotel is only 15 minutes from New York City and close to MetLife Stadium. Each spacious suite features a comfortable bed, living area with HDTV, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a fully equipped kitchen. Enjoy a free full hot breakfast daily and complimentary dinner and drinks* Monday-Thursday. While our fitness center and pool are currently unavailable, we offer flexible meeting spaces and a 24-hour business center. *State and local laws apply. Must be of legal drinking age.

624574.description: Featuring free WiFi and a restaurant, Melissa Hotel Riyadh offers accommodations in Riyadh. The hotel has a sun terrace and sauna, and guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant. Free private parking is available on site. Certain units have a private bathroom with a spa tub, and others have bathrobes and slippers. Some units include a sitting area to relax in after a busy day. Certain rooms feature views of the garden or city. Extras include free toiletries and a hairdryer. A flat-screen TV with satellite channels is featured. There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. The hotel also provides car rental. The nearest airport is King Khalid Airport, 19. 3 km from Melissa Hotel Riyadh.

name.content: The Hotel Galleria Jeddah, Curio Collection by Hil

624575.address: Muhammad Ibn Abdul Aziz. Al Andalus, 3077, 3131
624575.description: With a stay at The Hotel Galleria Jeddah, Curio Collection by Hilton, you'll be centrally located in Jeddah, within a 15-minute drive of Red Sea Mall and Thalia Street. This luxury hotel is 0. 1 mi (0. 2 km) from Jeddah Mall and 0. 2 mi (0. 4 km) from Saudi Center for Fine Art. Treat yourself with massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a health club, a sauna, and a seasonal outdoor pool. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Make yourself at home in one of the 364 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Enjoy international cuisine at The Kitchens, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 3 coffee shops/cafes. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Jeddah? This hotel has 2153 square feet (200 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 13 meeting rooms.

624589.description: Well situated in the charming city of Carouge, a 10-minute tram ride from the heart of Geneva, the ibis Styles Genève Carouge is a comic book-themed design hotel. This economic hotel plunges its hosts into a unique and atypical world. High in color, it offers a range of dream-themed rooms created by local comic-book artists. With free wifi and breakfast included, the hotel features affordable rooms perfect for families, city breaks or business trips.

name.content: Novotel Itu Terras de Sao Jose Golf & Resort

624623.address: Al. São Paulo Golf, Sem Número Terras De São Jose
624623.description: In Itu, near São Paulo, Novotel Itu Terras de Sao Jose Golf & Resort is ideal for business or tourism trips. Modern rooms with views of green grounds. The leisure space has an infinity pool, games room, playground, kids space, soccer field, tennis courts, L'Occitane Spa and sauna and steam room. Our monitors organize activities for children and adults. Easy access to golf course and equestrian center of Terras de São José.

624655.address: Imam Saud nin A.Rd(Exit9)-Intersection With King A
624655.description: The Mandarin Hotel Apartments, a 3-star establishment licensed by the Saudi Commission for Tourism and National Heritage (SCTH), offers 35 modernly designed apartments in Riyadh's Al Mursalat district, conveniently located near the intersection of Imam Saud bin Mohammed Road and King Abdul-Aziz Road. Opened in 2013, the hotel provides 24-hour reception service, free internet access in rooms and the lobby, a business center, and public restrooms.

624658.description: Vila Garden Guesthouse welcomes you to its historic building in a traditional Lisbon neighborhood, a vibrant hub of local life. Experience authentic Lisbon like a true native. Our charming building, fully renovated in 2016, offers 24 private, air-conditioned bedrooms. Our dedicated team is always happy to share insider tips about the city. Unwind at the end of the day in our beautiful garden with a cocktail or a glass of wine. We look forward to welcoming you!

624682.description: Anda Venice offers contemporary accommodations ranging from mixed dormitories to private twins, single, and double rooms. All rooms feature en-suite bathrooms and air conditioning. Benefit from amenities such as Mac workstations, a fully equipped guest kitchen, an urban garden, luggage storage, Wi-Fi, and a self-service launderette. Enjoy our Alai Life Bar, offering a full bar menu and weekend events. Located a short walk from the Venezia Mestre train station, with easy access to Venice's city center via frequent bus and train services.

624693.description:
Bairro Alto Suites is located in Lisbon Historical Center, in a very calm area of the famous Bairro Alto Neighborhood. Walk out the door and you will find yourself right in the heart of Lisbon. You will be able to experience all the major city charms by foot. 

By just walking 2 minutes you can reach all the most known neighborhoods as Baixa, Chiado, Principe Real, Rossio, Avenida da Liberdade etc. Only 100m away you will find the famous viewpoint Miradouro São Pedro de Alcântara. 

We offer several rooms for 2 guests with a king size double bed. If you prefer two single beds please let us know. 

All the rooms have a private ensuite bathroom and offer all the amenities (e. g. premium mattress, air conditioning, flat screen with cable channels, free fast wifi, free daily room cleaning service and soundproof windows). 

You will also find a selection of the best restaurants near the property, either be the trendy restaurants in Principe Real or the traditional "Casas de Fado" in Bairro Alto. 

The building dates from XVIII century, but in 2024 went through a total renovation. 

We have 24 hours check-in so you just need to ring the doorbell when you arrive. In case you arrive early we can store your luggage. We can also store your luggage after check-out in case you feel like exploring more of Lisbon. 
 storage.

624773.description: LisApartments offers travelers the opportunity to enjoy private apartments with the convenience of hotel services. Located in a beautifully renovated building in the heart of Lisbon's Arroios district, these apartments accommodate up to three or four guests each, with a total building capacity of 23. Ideal for couples, families, and small groups, each apartment features a private bedroom (double or twin beds), a crib upon request, and a living room with a dining area, double sofa bed, and a full HD LCD TV offering a wide selection of cable channels, including children's programming. Blackout curtains ensure restful sleep. The fully equipped kitchen includes a washing machine, dishwasher, microwave, oven, hob, freezer, refrigerator, coffee machine, kettle, juicer, toaster, and utensils. The private bathroom provides a shower, amenities, a hairdryer, and towels. High-speed Wi-Fi, an iron and ironing board, and all linens are also provided. Enjoy à la carte services such as breakfast delivery, housekeeping, babysitting, and dry cleaning. Whether traveling for business or leisure, LisApartments allows you to experience Lisbon like a local with the comfort and service of a top hotel. Please note that there is no reception desk on-site. Kindly email your estimated arrival time to comercial@lisapartments. com or call +351 969 116 180. A Guest Service Coordinator will meet you at the apartment for check-in, generally between 3 PM and midnight, though we strive to be flexible whenever possible.

625003.description: The hotel is located in the city of Riyadh, where shopping is one of the largest commercial malls. It is located near King Khalid Airport and also near Imam University. The hotel contains 70 different types of rooms, swimming pool, health club and gym. The hotel is also located on the main road directly on the road. Room with bathroom, TV and drinks

625015.address: 3021 Al Urubah Branch Rd, Umm Al Hamam Al Gharbi
625015.description: The property comprises a total of 60 snug guest rooms. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the hotel. As this hotel features 24-hour reception, guests are always welcome. Myan Al urubah Hotel does not offer cots on demand. All guest rooms at this disability-friendly establishment are wheelchair-accessible. There is a car park at Myan Al urubah Hotel.

625018.description: Located in Riyadh, Revan Palace offers classic interiors. Free WiFi access is available in all areas. Each room here will provide you with a TV, air conditioning and a minibar. There is a full a kitchenette with a microwave and an oven. Featuring a shower, the bathroom also comes with a bath and a hairdryer. At Revan Palace you will find a 24-hour front desk, a snack bar and a mini-market. Other facilities offered at the property include a shared lounge, luggage storage and shops (on site). The property offers free parking. The hotel is 1. 4 km from King Fahd Stadium, 17. 4 km from Kingdom Center and 17. 6 km from Al Faisaliah Tower. King Khalid Airport is 24 km away.

625019.description: Located 9 km from Riyadh Gallery Mall, Sama Inn Hotel Apartments offers a restaurant, free high-speed WiFi, and free private parking. Some units include a seating area and all rooms feature a kettle, private bathroom with free toiletries and a hairdryer, and a flat-screen TV with cable channels, including Bein Sports. Breakfast is included, with room service available for an extra fee. A 24-hour front desk and coffee shop are also on-site. The property is 13 km from both Kingdom Center and historic Diriyah, and 16 km from King Khalid Airport, with paid airport transfers available. Guests appreciate the excellent value and convenient location, highly rated by couples.

625250.description:
Lycia Ulupınar Hotel , is located on 25 acres of land in Ulupınar town. It is within the range of 70 km to Antalya.
Our hotel opened in 2014 as a family-run business. It still welcome our with same worm hospitality that we pride ourselves from the beginning.
We are located in the western part of the Toros Mountains, the most beautiful part of Beydaglari also known as Tahtali Mountain.
It is an ideal location especially for those who are ready for the active challenges and splendor of the great outdoors . Both domestic and foreigner guests come with a gola to walking on the “Lycia Road” which connects ancient cities, and to experience the quiet and peaceful environment of our hotel and leave with pleasant memories.
If you are ready to experience a holiday as out of ordinary and in an alternative environment in contrast to the big hotel.

625264.description: Featuring free WiFi throughout the property, Hotel Spot Family Suites offers accommodation in Porto, 200 m from historical Bolhao Market. Guests can enjoy the on-site bar. Private parking is available on site. Each room at this hotel is air conditioned and has a flat-screen TV with cable channels. Some rooms include a seating area to relax in after a busy day. All rooms include a private bathroom. For your comfort, you will find free toiletries and a hairdryer. Suites are light and bright, with a sleek, mid-century modern vibe. Onsite bar makes a handy last stop before calling it a night. You will find a 24-hour front desk at the property. The hotel also offers car hire. Oporto Coliseum is 500 m from Hotel Spot Family Suites, while Paris Galleries Street is 700 m away. Porto Airport is 11 km from the property. União de Freguesias do Centro is a great choice for travellers interested in architecture, city walks and wine.

name.content: Calamos Family Club Beach Hotel By Anayia Resorts

625302.description: The 3-star Calamos Beach Hotel offers an ideal getaway on a private sandy beach amidst lush gardens, conveniently located near Athens and Eleftherios Venizelos International Airport. Perfect for relaxed summer holidays with family or friends, this 4-story hotel, renovated in 2018, features 185 spacious, modernly furnished rooms, most with balconies and breathtaking Aegean Sea views. Guests enjoy all-inclusive amenities, including a main restaurant and bar, a large swimming pool with a separate children's pool, a sun terrace and pool bar, a playground, basketball and tennis courts, parking, and Wi-Fi. Enjoy relaxing beachside holidays at this all-inclusive hotel in the Attica region.

625324.address: 5 Derb Sidi Ben Aissa Dabachi, Médina, 4
625324.description: With a stay at Riad Irhalne, you'll be centrally located in Marrakech, just a 3-minute walk from Jemaa el-Fnaa and 8 minutes by foot from Marrakesh Museum. This riad is 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from Le Jardin Secret and 0. 8 mi (1. 2 km) from Bahia Palace. Enjoy recreation amenities such as an indoor pool or take in the view from a rooftop terrace. Additional features at this riad include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. Stop by the riad's restaurant for dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/café, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 9:00 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 9 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include separate sitting areas and complimentary bottled water, and housekeeping is provided daily.

625437.description: Boasting the title of the tallest 4 Star hotel in the world, Gevora hotel is located on Dubai's Sheikh Zayed Road in the Trade Centre Area of the city and is ideal for guests looking for an easy and convenient commute to Dubai's main business districts and leisure attractions. Free WiFI is available throughout the hotel. The hotel features 505 rooms from deluxe rooms to spacious two-bedroom suites with all the amenities to suit the needs of the modern traveler, whether for business or leisure. The 5 restaurants offer a variety of ambiances and cuisines. Gevore hotel is 5 minutes away from DIFC and WTC, 10 minutes away from Dubai mall, Burj Khalifa and the fountains. 15 Minutes away from Kite beach and La Mer. Dubai International Airport (DXB) is 15 minutes away by car, while Al Maktoum Airport (WTC) is a 40 minutes' drive away.

625440.description: AFFORDABLE LUXURY IN THE HEART OF DUBAI Situated in the prestigious Business Bay, just south of Downtown Dubai, and gracefully nestled alongside The Dubai Water Canal, The hotel offers 251 luxurious rooms and suites with captivating canal or city skyline views, spanning from the 6th to the 19th floor. - The Podium: A fusion of global flavors in a traditional Arabic setting. - Beau Rivage Bistro: A Parisian-inspired venue offering French-Mediterranean cuisine. - Asia Asia: An acclaimed restaurant with a culinary adventure through the historic Spice Route. - Bella Restaurant & Lounge: modern Italian cuisine by 1* Michelin Chef Felix Lo Basso. - Lock Stock & Barrel offers an exquisite experience with dual bars, an industrial-meets-urban American food truck aesthetic for a social haven. - The Lobby Lounge on the ground floor is perfect for tea, meetings, or drinks. The third-floor houses recreational facilities, including the Wellbeings Holistic Center, a Health Club, and an Outdoor Swimming Pool with a wonderful view. Renaissance Business Bay Hotel, Dubai is the quintessence of affordable luxury in the heart of Dubai's vibrant cityscape. Experience the epitome of comfort and convenience with our state-of-the-art meeting facilities, featuring 11 meeting rooms with natural day light and advanced technology, and a grand ballroom accommodating up to 400 guests.

625565.description: The Barcelona EDITION hotel offers a luxurious Mediterranean escape with a range of amenities, including an outdoor pool, 24-hour fitness center, and bicycle rentals. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services. Dine at one of the two on-site restaurants, including Veraz, specializing in local cuisine, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind at the poolside bar or one of the two additional bars/lounges. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily (for a fee). For business travelers, the hotel offers a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services, as well as four meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies) and self-parking is also offered (subject to charges). The 100 individually decorated guestrooms provide a comfortable retreat with minibars, espresso makers, pillowtop beds featuring down comforters and Frette Italian sheets. Each room also includes complimentary Wi-Fi and bathrooms stocked with designer toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near popular attractions such as Santa Caterina Market, Palau de la Música Catalana, and Barcelona Cathedral, all within a short walking distance. The preferred airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN).

625622.description: Little Rock Guesthouse is a true gem nestled in the charming town of Jongensfontein, just 10km from Stilbaai on the Garden Route toward Cape Town. With unobstructed views of the Indian Ocean, guests can enjoy breathtaking sunrises and sunsets from the comfort of this serene guesthouse. The guesthouse accommodates up to 14 guests in seven en-suite bedrooms, each boasting a private viewing deck or balcony with ocean views. Rooms are furnished with either a king-size or twin beds, and include amenities such as a minibar, tea/coffee station, electronic safe, flat-screen TV with DSTV, a fan, and bathroom amenities. Two bedrooms offer additional sleeper couches for children, and some rooms can accommodate an extra single bed upon request. Cots are also available. Guests can enjoy both indoor and outdoor braai (barbecue) facilities, weather permitting.

625643.description: A total of 123 units are available for guests' convenience. Vila Gale Collection Braga was constructed in 2018. There is Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. The hotel provides 24-hour reception. Vila Gale Collection Braga understands that accessibility is important to all guests. For this reason, it features wheelchair accessible guest rooms and is fully adapted for easy access. Corporate travellers may appreciate the meeting and business services and facilities available for added convenience. Guests may relish the opportunity to taste the meals served at the establishment's dining facilities. Some services may be payable.

625692.address: 4025 King Abdullah Road, An Naseem Dist.
625692.description: Featuring free WiFi, Salsabil by Warwick offers rooms in Jeddah, 5 minutes' drive from the new railway station, 2 km from Al Andalus Mall and 6 km from Flamingo Mall. 8 km from Serafi Mega Mall and 9 km from Coral Mall, the property features a fitness centre and a restaurant. The property is 35 minutes' drive from Makkah and 10 km from King Fahad Fountain. All guest rooms in the hotel are equipped with a flat-screen TV. Rooms are complete with a private bathroom fitted with a bath and a hair dryer, while certain rooms come with a seating area. All rooms at Salsabil by Warwick have air conditioning and a wardrobe. The daily breakfast offers continental and buffet options. Guests can make use of the hot tub, sauna and indoor poolFor guests' convenience, the accommodation has a business centre. Staff speak Arabic and English at the reception.

625723.description: The Tourism Dirham Fee of AED 10 per night, per bedroom is applicable when booking guest rooms & suites and will be collected during your stay at the property and is not reflected in the room rate. The Hampton by Hilton Dubai Airport is a brand-new, contemporary hotel close to Dubai International Airport. Enjoy our complimentary shuttle service to the Dubai Airport Freezone, Al Mamzar Beach and Deira City Centre. Our Dubai hotel rooms are fresh and modern spaces, with a mini-fridge, tea and coffee making facilities, and a work desk with ergonomic chair. Feel rested after a great night’s sleep on the clean and fresh Hampton bed®, and stay connected with free WiFi throughout your stay with us. Start each day with a free hot breakfast, then enjoy the flexible work and social zones in our warm and welcoming lobby. Work out in the fully equipped fitness center, or go for a dip in the temperature-controlled outdoor swimming pool.

625862.description: Located in Peneda Gerês National Park, Castrum Villae boasts a leafy garden and a restaurant serving homemade Portuguese delicacies. It offers modern rooms with free WiFi and scenic nature views. All rooms are simply furnished and feature a private balcony. Each one has views, a well-stocked minibar, a work desk and an en suite bathroom. Castrum Villae is located in Peneda Geres National Park and features a restaurant serving homemade Portuguese delicacies. At Hotel Castrum Villae, guests can relax with a game of billards in the leisure room or enjoy an apéritif at the terrace bar. The hotel's surrounding offers outdoor activities such as rafting and mountain walks. Castrum Villae is less than 80 km from Vigo Airport. Free private parking is available on site.

625885.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and wedding services. Additional amenities at this hotel include a television in a common area and a banquet hall. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of AC Hotel by Marriott New York Downtown. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in New York? This hotel has 151 square feet (14 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Make yourself at home in one of the 274 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Digital programming and iPod docking stations are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

625904.description: Hub New Lisbon is located in Lisbon, 200 m from Príncipe Real Garden. The unit is in a renovated 18th-century building, with original Portuguese tiles and vintage décor pieces. With a large ball pit, the hostel is just a 5-minute walk from lively Bairro Alto's bars and restaurants. The hostel features accommodation in private double rooms and dormitories. The dormitories are divided into mixed and gender-specific rooms. Most of the accommodation comes with access to shared bathroom facilities. Some of the rooms feature panoramic river views. Guests are welcome to cook their own meals in the fully equipped communal kitchen at their disposal. There is also a shared dining area, as well as an on-site bar. After a day of sightseeing, the interior patio with sofas and showers is the perfect scenario for a relaxing break. The games room includes a foosball table.

625905.description: HUB Lisbon Patio gets its name from our big outdoor area, with an oversized hammock and a barbecue stand, where you can relax and enjoy a beer or a glass of portuguese wine. Located in one of the richest areas in shops, culture and restaurants, this hostel is central, young and fresh. It is an excellent choice for travelers who are interested in using public transport and tour rides - we are at the heart of Lisbon's transport grid. Grab the hostel experience by the hook and cook your favourite meals in our fully equipped kitchen. Share it with the other guests and finish your dinner party with a videogame competition or challenge yourself to a beer pong match. If you would rather have a quiet evening instead, our lounge room is a perfect place to sit calmly or meditate. Shift your hostel perspective in a private, double room or dormitory!We are perfect for you and that is a fact!

625913.description: The Libre Hotel, a BW Signature Collection by Best Western, is a 3-Star Superior hotel ideally situated in Miraflores, within walking distance of the financial and tourist districts. This newly built hotel offers a refreshing and relaxing atmosphere perfect for both corporate travelers and tourists seeking a comfortable retreat. The hotel features 60 spacious rooms, including 18 Superior King Rooms and 42 Flexible Double Rooms. Note: Peruvian VAT (18%) is not included in the rates. Foreign visitors staying less than 59 days may be exempt with a valid passport copy.

name.content: City Pension Stephansplatz self check in

625930.description: Located in a historic building from the Ringstrasse era, the City Pension offers Viennese charm in the heart of Vienna. Just a short walk from St. Stephen's Square, Schwedenplatz, and Kärntner Straße, this family-run pension provides personalized service and a pleasant atmosphere. The newly renovated rooms feature flat-screen satellite TVs, air conditioning, minibars, electric kettles, and private bathrooms with showers, hairdryers, and complimentary toiletries. Free Wi-Fi is also available. The U1 and U3 metro stations are merely 51 meters away, and the U4 is 153 meters away, making exploring the city effortless.

626043.address: Rua Henri Dunant, Chacara Santo Antonio, 792 B
626043.description: The new and modern infrastructure of the pet-friendly Novotel São Paulo Berrini is great for guests on business or leisure. We have five meeting rooms, a co-working space, and Room Offices. For families, our rooms with a family space accommodate two adults and two kids. The hotel is also equipped with gym, sauna, and the Gourmet Bar, where we serve international dishes and exclusive drinks.

626062.description: The 4-star Meliá Setúbal Hotel offers 112 elegant rooms and suites in Setúbal's city center, across from Bonfim Garden and a short walk from the train station. Guests enjoy an indoor pool, spa, sauna, hot tub, and health club. The air-conditioned rooms and suites feature wooden floors, private bathrooms, flat-screen satellite TVs, double-glazed windows, minibars, and balconies overlooking the garden. Free WiFi is available throughout the hotel. Savor local and international cuisine at the Bistrô and Tapas Restaurant or enjoy refreshing drinks in the bar and lounge. Six fully equipped meeting rooms cater to various events. The hotel is a short drive from the Tróia boat connection, Arrábida Natural Park, and Lisbon city center. Lisbon International Airport is a 32-minute drive away.

626269.description: The Exporoyal City Hotel offers comfortable accommodations and excellent service. A variety of rooms are available, including family, double, and single options. Guests at the Exporoyal enjoy a peaceful retreat while still being close to the vibrant city center and port. The hotel provides easy access to the airport, bus station, Expo 2016, Konyaalti beaches, and historic Kaleiçi via the nearby tram.

626271.description:
Dear Guest, 
we would like to inform you that our property does not have a reception desk. For this reason, we kindly ask you to contact the property at info@santeodoropalace. com in order to receive the information for the self check-in procedure. 
Our property is located in the heart of Venice, just a few of minutes from Rialto bridge and Sait Mark’s square.

name.content: roomz hotel & conference center vienna prater

626417.description: The hotel offers 265 stylish rooms in various categories, each featuring furnishings that exceed budget hotel standards. The chic design incorporates tasteful color accents and provides every amenity a guest could desire. Conveniently located near the Prater and the exhibition center, roomz Vienna Prater offers a welcoming atmosphere, comfort, high quality, and fresh design at affordable rates for both tourists and business travelers. The Praterstern train and U2/U1 underground stations are just two minutes away, providing quick access to the Exhibition Center/Prater (4 min), VIC (6 min), Stephansdom (6 min), Opera (8 min), and Schönbrunn Palace (17 min).

626538.description: Boudl Al Munsiyah offers luxury accommodations in Riyadh featuring air conditioning and a magnificent spa offering many treatments. Kingdom Center is 19km from the property and King Khalid Airport only 15km away. Free private parking is available on site as well as a garage which will keep your car away from the sun. All units feature a flat-screen TV with private bathroom and free toiletries. The hotel also offers a grocery deliveries service.

626586.description: This charming apartment hotel, built in 2018, is located in Antalya City and offers 48 welcoming rooms. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi throughout the property and on-site parking. Cots are available upon request, and the hotel is fully accessible, with all rooms featuring wheelchair access. The property is also environmentally conscious and holds a relevant certification.

626596.description: The 4-star Premium strato hotel, located near Hamad International Airport in Doha, Qatar, offers the epitome of comfort and well-being. Choose from 97 guest rooms tailored to the needs of both business and leisure travelers. Just a 12-minute drive from the airport, the hotel is also within a reasonable distance of Souq Waqif, the Corniche, and the Islamic Museum. Guests can enjoy a fully equipped gymnasium, separate saunas for men and women, an ATM, a women's salon, and a rooftop outdoor pool with splendid views over Doha. Excellent facilities for banquets, meetings, and events are also available.

626743.description: A stay at Apartamentos Turisticos Gaia Residence places you in the heart of Vila Nova de Gaia, within a 5-minute drive of Lavandeira Municipal Park and Dom Luis I Bridge. This 4-star aparthotel is 2. 4 mi (3. 9 km) from Porto Cathedral and 3. 6 mi (5. 8 km) from Local Nature Reserve of Douro Estuary. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a fitness center. Additional amenities at this aparthotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting/childcare (surcharge). Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Apartamentos Turisticos Gaia Residence, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 108 air-conditioned rooms featuring kitchenettes with refrigerators and stovetops. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and flat-screen televisions are provided for your entertainment. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

626882.description: The Tambo Dos de Mayo is excellently located one block from José Pardo Avenue and five blocks from Kennedy Park. It's also close to Panchita, the restaurant of renowned Peruvian chef Gastón Acurio, as well as other dining options, cinemas, libraries, pharmacies, banks, and cultural centers. The hotel's own restaurant, 'El Tambo Dos de Mayo, ' offers a varied menu of traditional Peruvian dishes, snacks, and drinks. The hotel was renovated in 2016, enhancing guest comfort.

name.content: Hyatt Vivid Cancun Adults Only - All Inclusive

626901.description: Hyatt Vivid Cancun (Adults-Only, All-Inclusive) is perfectly situated in the exclusive gated community of Puerta del Mar, adjacent to the Puerto Cancun Golf Club and Shopping Center. Featuring luxurious, well-appointed rooms—all boasting striking, modern architectural design—the resort offers breathtaking views of the Caribbean Sea and nearby Isla Mujeres. With a relaxing world-class Pevonia® spa, direct access to the Puerto Cancun golf course, two wave pools, a water park, an exclusive rooftop pool, countless daytime activities, and exciting nightlife, it is a must-visit destination for a romantic getaway.

627802.description: Located in the bustling Dubai Marina neighbourhood, Rove Dubai Marina is the perfect location to start your next adventure. Grab your backpack and get ready to explore everything Dubai has to offer: great beaches, stunning skylines and lots of leisure, dining and entertainment options, all of within easy reach from the hotel. City landmarks around Rove Dubai Marina include the iconic Palm Jumeirah, the Dubai Marina promenade and The Walk JBR. Rove Dubai Marina is located at the heart of one of Dubai's most happening neighbourhoods. Check out the city's most popular beaches, which are within walking distance, before heading to Palm Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai and other fun sights. Rovers in town for business have easy access to Dubai Media City, Dubai Internet City and Jebel Ali Freezone, too. You can make the most of our helpful amenities including free Wi-Fi, a 24-hour gym, the pool

The private bathroom is fitted with a bidet, free toiletries and a hair dryer. At Braira AL Wezarat, the rooms are equipped with air conditioning and a flat-screen TV. The daily breakfast offers continental and American options. Spa and wellness facilities including a sauna and a hammam are at guests' disposal during their stay at the accommodation.

627833.description: Located in Majmaa, Boudl Majmaa Apartment is a perfect starting point from which to explore Majmaah. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, 24-hour room service, express check-in/check-out, Wi-Fi in public areas are there for guest's enjoyment. Television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless, internet access – wireless (complimentary), air conditioning, mini bar can be found in selected guestrooms. Take a break from a long day and make use of fitness center, indoor pool. Friendly staff, great facilities and close proximity to all that Majmaah has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Boudl Majmaa Apartment.

627849.description:
Torel Avantgarde is a five-star boutique hotel located in one of the city's most iconic areas, with privileged views over the Douro River. Inspired by the Avantgarde movement of the 1930s and 1940s, the hotel stands as a tribute to art, design, and creativity, celebrating the avant-garde spirit through carefully curated aesthetics and deeply personalized hospitality. 
Each of the 38 rooms, 21 suites, and Maisonette reflects the avant-garde spirit of iconic personalities from the arts and culture, offering a unique and distinctive experience. The spaces combine contemporary comfort, timeless elegance, and meticulous attention to detail, with several categories featuring private bathtubs with stunning views over the Douro, inviting contemplation and rest. 
The gastronomic aspect is expressed in the Digby restaurant, where Portuguese cuisine is reinterpreted with sophistication and respect for the product, valuing seasonal and local ingredients, in an elegant setting with one of the most beautiful panoramic views of the city. 
For moments of well-being, Calla Wellness & Spa offers a complete relaxation experience, with personalized treatments, a heated indoor pool, sauna, Turkish bath, and fully equipped gym. The hotel also has an outdoor pool overlooking the river, ideal for enjoying moments of leisure in any season. 
Among the most unique spaces is the Flower Room, a serene refuge where nature, light, and art come together, creating an atmosphere conducive to contemplation and tranquility. 
Distinguished as the Best 5-Star Hotel in Portugal in 2024 and recognized with 1 MICHELIN Key, Torel Avantgarde asserts itself as a benchmark destination, where each stay is designed as an artistic, emotional, and memorable experience, marked by the genuine care of the team and the creation of authentic connections with each guest.

627860.description: Centro Salama is conveniently located in the heart of Jeddah close to the city’s prime retail districts, commercial precincts and leisure attractions. Situated on Al Madina Road, Centro Salama is surrounded by shopping malls and within close proximity of the city’s main government offices, foreign embassies and compounds, making it the ideal accommodation option for business guests. Jeddah’s main air hub, King Abdulaziz International Airport, and the city’s famous Corniche, are also a short drive away. The second hotel to open in Jeddah under the Centro brand, Centro Salama is the perfect choice for business and leisure guests, including families, who are keen to explore the best of what Saudi Arabia’s second-largest city has to offer. The ultra-modern hotel features 189 innovatively-designed guestrooms and suites featuring the latest technology and conveniences to ensure a comfortable stay at all times. Home to the Centro brand’s signature dining experiences, the hotel cater to the demands of busy travellers seeking delicious fare delivered fast. Our innovative concepts include c. deli, offering a vast range of modern, delicatessen-inspired snacks and meals, and c. taste, serving delicious international cuisine that is sure to tempt your taste buds. Guests can keep in shape at Centro Salama’s fully-equipped modern fitness centre, or take a dip in the climate-controlled outdoor pool while admiring the fantastic views from the rooftop deck. Our collection of seven versatile meeting rooms featuring the latest audio-visual technology and complementary high-speed Wi-Fi ensure guests can take care of business. Each meeting room can be configured to host a variety of events, from board meetings and presentations to staff training sessions.

627864.description: Located in the heart of the city of Lisbon — Rua da Prata — between Praça do Comércio and Praça do Rossio, Hotel da Baixa gets its name from Lisbon's most charismatic neighborhood to give you a unique local experience. Its 66 spacious rooms, larger than most in Baixa (downtown Lisbon), offer unparalleled comfort and privileged views of the city, such as Castelo São Jorge, Praça da Figueira and the Tagus River. A Boutique Hotel, resulting from a connection between a differentiated service of excellence, together with Pombalian architectural elements.

Convenience and comfort makes Boudl Al Masif Hotel the perfect choice for your stay in Riyadh.

627866.description: Shaza Al Rabee Hotel offers free WiFi and city views in Riyadh. All rooms have a kitchenette, satellite TV, and a private bathroom. The hotel features a sun terrace and a 24-hour front desk. Guest rooms at the hotel are equipped with a kettle. All rooms at Shaza Al Rabee Hotel have a seating area. The property has a fitness center. Riyadh Park is 3. 5 km from the property, while Lausanne Events Hall is 4. 1 km away. The nearest airport is King Khalid International Airport, 20 km from the property. This property is also rated as one of the best locations in Riyadh! Guests love the location compared to other properties in the area. Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 8. 8 for a two-person trip. This property is rated as having the best value in Riyadh! Guests get more for their money compared to other properties in the city. We speak your language!

name.content: Mondrian Suites Hotel Berlin Checkpoint Charlie

627875.description: The Hotel Mondrian Suites Berlin is a modern and tranquil city residence, offering 134 non-smoking studios and apartments in a variety of sizes and categories, designed to meet every comfort need. Whether you're staying for a short visit or an extended stay, our hotel provides the perfect setting. Ideally located, the hotel is just a short stroll from the world-famous Checkpoint Charlie and only a few minutes' walk from Friedrichstraße and the iconic Gendarmenmarkt, situated in the heart of Berlin's historic district. While surrounded by the bustling main streets of the city, the hotel offers a peaceful retreat, with a charming complex of buildings and a small park in front. For business travelers, the hotel’s location is ideal, with both small and large businesses just around the corner. Public transport is also within a two-minute walk, and for those driving, our garage is conveniently located beneath the hotel (25€ per day with prior reservation). Should you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out. Please note that we require a valid credit card or a €200 cash deposit at check-in as a guarantee. We look forward to welcoming you!

627929.description:
A Very Warm Welcome to The Grey – Cape Town’s Cool Boutique Hotel
Whether you’re discovering Cape Town for the first time or returning to soak up its charm, The Grey is your perfect home base. 
Nestled in the heart of the trendy De Waterkant neighborhood, The Grey combines the cozy ambiance of a beautifully restored 19th-century Victorian house with a relaxed and familiar atmosphere. Our boutique hotel offers a truly unique experience, where every detail is thoughtfully curated, and each room is styled with its own distinctive character. 
Spend your day exploring Cape Town’s vibrant attractions or simply unwind at The Grey. Our airy Skybar, with its rooftop pool and breathtaking views of Table Mountain, is the perfect spot to relax and recharge. 

Our team is always here to help you uncover the best of the city. From local tips to hidden gems, we’re happy to assist in making your stay unforgettable. 
Be a part of The Grey experience. Enjoy your time with us! Be a part of us.

627934.description: This comfortable Clémence Hotel Suites is set in Riyadh. The Clémence Hotel Suites comprises 54 cosy guests rooms. Clémence Hotel Suites provides cots on request for little children. All bedrooms at this disability-friendly Clémence Hotel Suites are wheelchair-accessible. No pets are allowed on the premises. The accommodation features a parking and a garage.

627949.description: This cozy hotel is located in Milan. This cozy hotel guarantees a peaceful stay as there are only 15 units.
