The colourful, air-conditioned rooms have simple furnishings and access to a shared external bathroom.

627952.description: This neoclassical hotel is situated in the heart of Athens, a 7-minute walk from the renowned Acropolis and Acropolis Museum. The metro station is conveniently located nearby, providing easy access to historical attractions like the Ancient Agora and the traditional restaurants in the picturesque Plaka district. The ancient Anafiotika quarter and the fashionable Ermou shopping street offer delightful options for families. Noble Suites is committed to guest satisfaction, addressing needs in a hospitable and professional manner. The first-class suites feature fine furnishings, parquet floors, and spacious sitting areas. Amenities include a minibar, coffee/tea maker, smart TV, and a marble bathroom with luxurious toiletries. Most rooms have a private balcony or terrace. In-room massage and babysitting services are available upon request.

627957.description: Hotel Santo Stefano is located in the historical centre of Venice, just 7 minutes walk from the beautiful St. Mark square, a few steps from Rialto Bridge with its shops and the famous “La Fenice” Theater, rebuilt after a fire in 1996. Our structure is located in Campo Santo Stefano, one of the largest and most elegant in Venice, far from the confusion and noise. The windows of some of our rooms enjoy the magical view of this beautiful square. Built on a 13th-century building, a clear example of Venetian Gothic architecture, it was originally a defensive tower of a convent, which overlooked a stretch of water, later transformed into Campo Santo Stefano. The building was then a school of lace and later was used by the “maestri botteri” who were responsible for the construction of barrels. The hotel retains an elegant atmosphere of the past with distinguished and refined furniture.

627959.description: Located in Manhattan's Flatiron District, Freehand New York is housed in the former George Washington Hotel—once home to many storied writers, musicians and creatives. Designed by Roman and Williams and featuring custom-commissioned artwork by Bard College students and alumni throughout, we're revitalizing the artistic community in a historic NY neighborhood. Designed by Roman and Williams, all of our rooms feature comfortable bedding, custom-commissioned artwork by Bard College students and alumni, plus all the necessities to make you feel at home. Work or play, we've got you covered.

627963.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Some rooms feature a relaxing sitting area and a flat-screen TV. Couples have rated the hotel's location an 8. 6 for a two-person trip. King Khalid Airport is 17. 7 km from the property.

628171.description: Welcome to Hotel Samba Três Rios, a brand new hotel in the center of Três Rios. Conveniently located near major leisure areas with easy access to local businesses and industry, it's perfect for balancing work and play. Have some free time? Explore São Sebastião Square, just a 2-minute walk from the hotel. There, you'll find Três Rios City Hall, Celso Peçanha Theater, the main church, Casa de Cultura, and Olga Sol Shopping. Maintain your fitness routine at our on-site fitness center or take advantage of the nearby Alberto Lavinas Avenue (Beira Rio), a popular spot for walking, jogging, and cycling. Experience the comfort and convenience of Intercity Hotels. Children up to 11 years old can stay in their parents' bed.

628246.description: The modern Trafo Hotel, part of the Trafo Culture and Congress Center, is centrally located in Baden. It offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a 24-hour snack shop, and a 24-hour reception. Spacious, modern rooms feature flat-screen satellite TVs, laptop safes, and bathrooms with hairdryers and toiletries. Guests enjoy free calls to all Swiss landline and mobile numbers. A delicious breakfast buffet is available each morning. The Trafo complex also houses restaurants, bars, a cinema, fitness facilities, a wellness area, and massage services, all available to hotel guests at reduced rates. Guests receive a city ticket granting free public transport, free access to the casino, several museums, and the public swimming pool, along with discounts on various other activities. Baden’s casino and train station are a short 5-minute walk away, and Zurich Airport is a 20-minute drive. Zurich city center is a 20-minute train ride from the hotel. The Trafo Hotel is conveniently located next to the headquarters of global companies such as ABB, GE, Ansaldo, and Axpo.

628248.description:
Casa Legado, the only hotel in Bogotá with a Michelin Key, is the result of a heartfelt passion project by its owner, Helena Davila, who dreamed of creating a chic, welcoming hotel designed for every kind of traveler—especially for those who want to feel at home while away from home. Her vision comes to life in a house full of personality, located in Quinta Camacho, one of Bogotá’s trendiest and most walkable neighborhoods. From here, guests enjoy easy access to some of the city’s best restaurants, cafés, galleries, and boutiques. 

Step inside and you’ll find a captivating mid-20th-century style reflected throughout the houses and its 13 unique guest rooms. Each room is named after a member of Helena’s family and decorated to reflect their spirit, giving every space its own story and charm. Though each room is distinct, all offer thoughtful comforts such as complimentary Wi-Fi, Smart TVs, and spacious bathrooms. 

Guests start their day with a daily complimentary breakfast buffet featuring Colombian coffee, local fruits, and freshly squeezed juices, along with a small menu for lunch and dinner. A communal kitchen is always open, stocked with complimentary snacks, and an honesty bar welcomes guests in the dining room—just like in a true family home. 

The Casa Legado team is delighted to share a custom recommendations app, curated by Helena herself, to help guests discover Bogotá’s best restaurants, tours, and shops. Here, every detail is designed so you can feel part of the house—Once here, forever home. 

You can see our terms and conditions at https://casalegadobogota. com/contact/#terms-and-conditions

Contact us at: Phone: (+57) 314 557 3000 / (+57) 310 754 9150 Email: reservas@casalegadobogota. com / citywizard@casalegadobogota. com Website: http://casalegadobogota. com

name.content: Ruby Marie Hotel Vienna by IHG

628258.description: Ruby Marie is very centrally located in the seventh district and thus directly in the creative heart of Vienna. Here in the new building, where contemporary meets traditional, the Lean Luxury Hotel with high quality equipped rooms offers the ideal base for all travel occasions in Austria's capital. The building, known to the city as 'das Stafa', was once Vienna's oldest department store, a fact that the hotel's original design today reminds us of. Guests can enjoy a selection of Italian antipasti and snacks around the clock at the Ruby Marie Bar.

628262.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an outdoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. For lunch or dinner, stop by Cosmic Kitchen, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 990 square feet (92 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 3 meeting rooms.

628322.description: The Regina Hotel opened in 1921 as the first luxury hotel in the country. In 1948, it was burnt down during the bogotazo, but was rebuilt in the late 50s. The walls within Regina contain a part of the city's history. In its 20 rooms and 11 apartments, you can sense the elegance of the 30s in Bogota, while enjoying the comforts of the modern world. Its excellent location in the historic center allows you to easily walk to museums and sites of interest. After exploring, indulge in an evening relaxing in our sauna or sipping on a coffee atop of our beautiful terrace.

628337.description: The Hotel Indigo Milan – Corso Monforte is a boutique hotel in Milan's historic center, just 800 meters from the Duomo and within walking distance of major subway stops. Housed in a prestigious early 19th-century building on Corso Monforte, this stylish hotel draws inspiration from Milan's high-fashion heritage. The 51 modern rooms offer soundproofing, free Wi-Fi, smart TVs, tea/coffee makers, Nespresso machines, and safes. Guests can enjoy a rich breakfast buffet featuring seasonal and high-quality ingredients, with gluten-free and lactose-free options available, in the beautiful 19th-century cloister. The hotel also boasts the Mezzo Restaurant and a cocktail lounge, popular with locals, along with two elegant meeting rooms and a complimentary fitness center.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Birmingham - City Centre

628341.description: Central Birmingham hotel with free Wi-Fi and Breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® Birmingham - City Centre hotel is 10 minutes’ walk from Grand Central train station and Grand Central shopping mall. The hotel is 10 minutes’ drive from the M6 motorway, while Birmingham Airport (BHX) is a 15-minute train ride away. A short walk takes you to events at the International Convention Centre. You can host informal meetings in the hotel’s relaxed lobby lounge area before reaching companies like RBS and KPMG in the nearby Colmore Business District. Browse for designer fashion at the nearby Mailbox shopping centre, anchored by a Harvey Nichols department store. Selfridges, housed in a landmark futuristic building, is a quick stroll away at the Bullring mall, near the Hippodrome and New Alexandra theatres. At this hotel you can enjoy:- A hot Express Start breakfast buffet included in the room rate- Free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel- A Business CentreWelcoming rooms come with blackout blinds and pillow menus to help you get a good night’s sleep. Wake up to a power shower and enjoy the inclusive buffet breakfast in the bright Express Café and Bar. It’s just the place to chat with friends and colleagues over a coffee or a cold beer, and if you need a bite to eat, try the all-day menu of snacks and light meals.

628390.address: Farm 118, Edge Of Goudveld Forest, Bibby'S Hoek
628390.description: Multi-award-winning, affordable, private cottages on the edge of the ancient Knysna forest beckons. . . Whether active on a stunning forest hike or biking trail, having a picnic next to a secluded forest stream, swimming in magnificent rock pools, or simply lazing in a hammock by your fully equipped cottage, Forest Edge promises tranquillity and an aura of romance. There is also a lovely undercover deck overlooking a gorgeous pond where you can enjoy mouth-watering South African cuisine for breakfast or dinner and experience true Knysna Forest Hospitality. Spend the day rocking in a hammock on your ‘stoep', watching water lilies open to the sun while kingfishers dart in and out of the pond. Or put on your boots to tackle the Drupkelders hike and spend hours at the waterfall and swimming pools you'll discover in the forest.

name.content: Hampton by Hilton Dubai Al Seef

628398.description: Centrally located in Dubai, Hampton by Hilton Dubai Al Seef is within a 5-minute drive of BurJuman Mall and Dubai Creek. This hotel is also conveniently located 3. 4 miles from Dubai World Trade Centre and 3. 8 miles from the Dubai Cruise Terminal. Enjoy amenities such as an outdoor pool, a 24-hour fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge service, and a game room. A complimentary beach shuttle provides easy access to the beach. The 150 air-conditioned guest rooms feature refrigerators, Smart TVs with cable programming, MP3 docking stations, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Safes, desks, and phones with free local calls are also provided. Savor Pan-Asian cuisine at Cu, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or grab a coffee at the cafe. The hotel also offers a bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Additional amenities include a computer station, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Free self-parking is available onsite.

name.content: Canopy by Hilton Dubai Al Seef

Please visit our dedicated COVID-19 page for the latest and before traveling. Hello and welcome to Canopy by Hilton Dubai Al Seef, a contemporary new hotel in the Al Seef area. Al Seef is the newest destination in Dubai offering a two-kilometer promenade of shops, cafes and pop-ups on the south bank of Dubai Creek. The neighborhood is known for its blend of old and new. Located on the waterfront promenade, our hotel overlooks the Dubai Creek. The promenade connects you to waterfront dining, cafes, and local entertainment. We'll introduce you to the neighborhood with a local welcome gift at check-in. At Canopy, we've got you covered. Settle into a Just-Right Room with stylish design and intuitive comforts such as free WiFi, a 49-inch TV, and a refrigerator. All rooms represent a mix of style and functionality, with contemporary art on the walls inspired by Dubai. Suites offer more space and privacy, plus comfy extras like robes and Canopy socks. Greet the day with an artisanal breakfast in NYON restaurant or have a Canopy Break Fast Bag delivered to your door. Our relaxing lobby lounge, Chapters, serves delicious sandwiches and refreshing wines or enjoy traditional Middle Eastern dishes on the banks of Dubai Creek in our restaurant, Skafos. Head upstairs to the SOL Sky Bar for poolside bites, tapas, and drinks, or evening cocktails under the stars.

628441.description: Breeze Boutique Athens, established in June 2018, is a centrally located hotel in Athens, operating year-round. 629183.description: TRS Coral Hotel is a new luxury 5-star beachfront hotel designed exclusively for adult escapes. Situated on the idyllic white sandy beach of Costa Mujeres, it offers an all-inclusive and adults only heavenly hideaway. This design-driven hotel is eco-friendly, made with building materials coming from sustainable resources and with a passionate commitment to the protection of the native species. Half an hour from the town of Cancún and its international airport, TRS Coral Hotel brings together the privacy of a small VIP boutique hotel and a reinvented all inclusive concept, elevated to a new luxury level. In this pristine land, guests will enjoy a profound connection to nature and a special atmosphere of tranquility. Costa Mujeres, known for its idyllic beauty and for the ancient Mayan ruins, has some of the most beautiful beaches in the world. For those who want a little more action, TRS Coral Hotel offers a vibrant nightlife, rich gastronomic offerings, and a wide variety of cultural, leisure and entertainment options, due to its proximity to the city of Cancún and other points of interest in the region. The hotel boats 473 luxurious rooms, each with balcony or furnished terrace, hydro massages and stunning views. Dive into the numerous top services offered, like the exclusive swimming pool, spa and gym. Among many others, direct access to the swim-up pools of some suites, private check-in and check-out, national and international newspaper, international à la carte restaurants, a private beach club, transportation of guests inside the resort and free access to the hydrotherapy area are some of the 5-star premium benefits. Exclusive international à la carte restaurants. 7 themed restaurants, two buffet restaurants and 3 bars. Sport Bar open 24 hours. Live gastronomic shows. Private Beach Club. VIP treatment. Amphitheatre with 360 grades visibility.

Guests can enjoy an on-site restaurant serving regional specialties, a bar, a cozy living room with a traditional fireplace and TV, and a reception hall. Savor the best of Trás-os-Montes cuisine, including smoked sausages, lamb stew, roast kid, and veal steak. We look forward to welcoming you!

629601.description: The building that once housed the workshops that tinned the tableware of the Royal House owes its name to this past, evident throughout the property. According to a typewritten document researched at the Lisbon Studies Library, this building was the former home of a tinning workshop founded by the Marquis of Pombal to tin the tableware of the Royal House — 'the doors each had a royal crown and the following inscription: Officina da Real Casa'. Our 11 apartments are carefully designed to provide maximum comfort and enjoyment. Each features unique decor, incorporating original materials like wood and tin from the 'Officina da Real Casa, ' respecting the building's history. Artwork and state-of-the-art equipment complete an unforgettable stay.

630030.description: Located on Al Shamal Road, between old and new Doha, the Ezdan Palace Hotel offers easy access to the city's main business and entertainment districts, making it a prime location for exploring Qatar's growing capital. This five-star hotel is across the street from Ezdan Mall, adjacent to Landmark Mall, and only 10 minutes from Doha Festival City and Al Hazm Mall—a shopper's paradise. Housed in a magnificent building with refined Andalusian architectural design, the Ezdan Palace Hotel offers 195 lavishly appointed rooms and suites. All rooms feature luxurious bedding, well-appointed furnishings, and marble bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers. For a comfortable and enjoyable stay, each room includes a Nespresso coffee machine, mini-fridge, in-room safe, 49-inch full HD smart TV, and free high-speed Wi-Fi. Red Orchid, a signature Thai restaurant, features a large open kitchen, prominent workstations, and two private dining rooms. Palermo offers an opulent setting for authentic Italian cuisine. All restaurants have open kitchens and outdoor seating areas. Guests can enjoy a spacious outdoor swimming pool, hot tub, in-pool refreshment counter, and a dedicated children's pool with a play area. The hotel also has a fitness center, separate men's and women's wellness areas, and the renowned Mounir Beauty Salon (ladies only). A wide selection of luxurious treatments is available in separate rooms for women, men, and couples at the Royal Emeralds Spa. The Ezdan Palace can also host corporate and social events in its gorgeous 1, 905-square-meter ballroom with a private entrance, as well as in five smaller meeting rooms.

This tranquil Jumeirah Beach oasis blends traditional and modern heritage with artistic flair. Decorated in warm, neutral tones, each room creates an intimate experience with furnishings reflecting local influences through natural fabrics, folkloric patterns, unrefined woods, and woven rattan. As a guest, you'll enjoy easy access to Dubai's vibrant attractions. 631341.description: Situated in Maia and built in 2018, the Oporto Airport & Business Hotel offers 79 comfortable rooms and convenient amenities such as Wi-Fi, a 24-hour reception, and on-site parking. 631342.description: Situated in historic Lisbon, Raw Culture Art & Lofts Bairro Alto is a a new concept of lodging, offering a unique cultural experience, with comfort and a sophisticated ambiance. Each loft was decorated tapping into the owner's private art collection and temporary displays often adorn the property's public areas. All of the comfortable lofts offer accommodation with free WiFi, soundproofing and a flat-screen cable TV. Each includes a fully equipped kitchenette and city views, with some also including a balcony. Both à la carte and vegan breakfast options are available each morning at Raw Culture Art & Lofts Bairro Alto. The surrounding area is filled with an assortment of popular restaurants and eateries, many within a 5-minute walk. Bairro Alto is also one of the city's top nightlife areas. Guests will be able to relax in the communal lounge area and also wander around the property, admiring the many art pieces on display. There is a 24-hour front desk, as well as private parking with a valet service. Chiado is 300 m from Raw Culture Art & Lofts Bairro Alto, while Rossio is 400 m away. The nearest airport is Lisbon Humberto Delgado Airport, 6 km from the property.

631424.description: Make your stay in the Chilean capital even more unforgettable with the carefully selected services and friendly hospitality of Wyndham Santiago Aeropuerto. Just five kilometers from Santiago de Chile Airport (SCL), our welcoming hotel is conveniently located in the ENEA business park and offers easy access to major corporate offices. 631582.description: This charming hotel, located in the historic San Telmo district, offers a tranquil stay with just 14 rooms. 631707.description: Located in West Bay & Diplomatic Area, Wyndham Doha West Bay is a perfect starting point from which to explore Doha. 631936.description: Set in Varedo along the SP35 Milano-Como road, Hotel King is just 20 minutes' drive from the Rho Fiera Exhibition Centre, and only 15 minutes' drive from the Monza race track. This beautiful and elegant villa of over 550 square meters located in Barcelona city on a land of more than 600 square meters has different terraces, swimming pool, hot tub and garden. The villa is located in Barcelona city only 10 minutes from Sagrada Familia and Hospital de Sant Pau. 

All rooms are double, spacious and equipped with individual climate control, WI-FI, safe box, television and even some of these rooms have a small sofa, boudoir and a large closet for your belongings and a bathroom.

Also on this floor there are two double bedrooms and two bathrooms, one en suite. 

Going up to the first floor there are four double bedrooms each one with its own style and decoration. There are three bathrooms, two en suite. 

Also on the first floor, you will find the dining room, full equipped the kitchen (Two refrigerators, coffee maker, oven, microwave, dishwasher,…

From the kitchen you have direct access to the pool, hot tub and garden. 

On the second floor we find a double bedroom with en suite bathroom. From the study and from the bedroom there is access to a terrace of 160 m2. 

On this same floor we find the tower room, this room has also access to the chill-out terrace and private bathroom. 

Everything has been carefully designed to ensure that your stay in this fabulous villa is memorable in every way.

Quiet time is every day from 22:00 to 09:00. Party is not allowed.
Hot tub & pool time is Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 22:30 and weekends from 09:30 to 22:30.

The Villa includes: "Amenities" (soap, shampoo, bath gel ...), sheets, bath towel, towel for the pool area, a hair dryer per bathroom, iron, ironing board, washing machine, dryer, BBQ, kitchen tools, crockery, dishwasher and cutlery. The villa also has a parking for one sedan. E: 166 kWh/m2 / 35 kg CO2/m2.

636447.description: Set in a prime location of Edinburgh, Linton Collection - Blackfriars Lofts puts everything the city has to offer just outside your doorstep. The property has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Take advantage of the property's free Wi-Fi in all rooms, kitchen, express check-in/check-out, luggage storage, family room. Some of the well-appointed guestrooms feature clothes rack, complimentary instant coffee, complimentary tea, linens, mirror. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Discover all Edinburgh has to offer by making Linton Collection - Blackfriars Lofts your base.

636477.description: From vibrant souqs lined with colourful and aromatic wares to ornate palaces glowing ochre in the sun and beautiful mosques echoing back the call to prayer, Marrakech is a one-of-a-kind experience for all the senses. A 20-minute walk from the famous Jamaa el Fna square, Riad Luxe 36 is a tranquil haven among the heady high of the medina and labyrinthe souks that brim with eye-popping sights and sounds. Throw yourself in the rich culture and history of Marrakech, before retreating to the peace and calm of this charming riad, where you'll discover traditional Moroccan architecture adorned with classic motifs and pocketed with hidden nooks and corners. Just three rooms and two suites create a luxurious home-from-home vibe, each understated in style and giving a nod to typical Moroccan interiors. Elsewhere, there's a palm-lined swimming pool, hammam, whirlpool bath and panoramic terrace.

636621.description: The Walt Madrid, located in the heart of the city and only 150 meters from the world famous Gran Via, is dedicated to guest comfort and satisfaction. The trendy Bob's bar, the perfect « speakeasy », serves selected Spanish wines, spirits, fresh juices and hot drinks. Light tapas are served throughout the day and evening. Guests have access to a private and intimate outdoor terrace during the warmer months. Adjacent to the most popular shopping in Madrid, the neighborhood is proud of its famous tapas bars, restaurants and nightlife in nearby Chueca, and it's vicinity to the Madrid's cultural life.

636782.description: The Dorma Liberdade is a stylish design hotel in Lisbon's city center. Its striking avant-garde facade and vibrant rooms create a unique atmosphere. Recently renovated, the hotel offers modern facilities including a 24-hour reception, breakfast buffet, and air-conditioned rooms. The Exe Liberdade is also conveniently located just steps from Marqués de Pombal Square and Avenida da Liberdade, providing easy access to the city's main attractions.

636807.description: Located in Santiago's Metropolitan Region, just two blocks from the Santa Isabel metro station, Departamentos Amoblados Santiago offers comfortable apartment-style accommodations with an outdoor pool, barbecue area, and on-site restaurant. Each unit features a flat-screen TV, private bathroom, and a kitchen equipped with an oven, microwave, and refrigerator. Some units also include a dining area and/or balcony. Private parking is available for USD 10 per night. Drugstores and supermarkets are within walking distance, and free WiFi is provided throughout the property. Enjoy convenient access to Providencia (2. 3 km) and Las Condes (14 km).

636820.description: 'This boutique hotel offers a welcoming ambiance, thanks to its rich color palette and high-quality materials. Two fireplaces grace the hall, creating a cozy living room atmosphere. Designed for travelers seeking cultured and elegant spaces, the hotel is ideally situated in a vibrant gateway city—a hub of economic, social, and cultural exchange. Upon entering, guests are enveloped in a sophisticated ambiance where soft lighting and brilliant accents contrast with the deep, rich tones of the hall. This urban refuge is adorned with luxurious materials, including velvet, brass, and marble, and features artwork by BISHA throughout. '

636863.description: Located just 200 meters from the marina and 6 km from Alanya city center, La Finca Marina Hotel offers a private beach with complimentary loungers, parasols, and shuttle service. Each air-conditioned room features a minibar, LCD TV with satellite channels, and a safe. Private bathrooms include showers, hair dryers, and toiletries. Antalya Airport is 120 km away, while Gazipaşa Airport is 55 km from the hotel.

636937.description: A stay at Sealife Lounge places you in the heart of Konyaalti, within a 5-minute drive of Konyaalti Beach and Akdeniz University. This hotel is 4. 2 mi (6. 8 km) from Old Bazaar and 4. 2 mi (6. 8 km) from Antalya Clock Tower. Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including a sauna and a seasonal outdoor pool. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access and a television in a common area. Featured amenities include express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Enjoy a meal at ANA RESTAURANT, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Make yourself at home in one of the 65 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

636985.description: 'Hotel Jakarta Amsterdam is a unique, sustainable hotel located on the IJ River, the former departure point for ships sailing to Jakarta. This luxurious hotel offers 200 Indonesian-inspired rooms, most featuring balconies with panoramic views of the IJ River or Central Station. Each boutique-style room boasts 30 square meters of space and a distinct Indonesian flair. Guests can enjoy breakfast, lunch, and dinner at Café Jakarta or unwind with a drink at the Malabar sky bar on the 8th and 9th floors. A breakfast buffet is included in the room rate. Guests can also relax in the wellness area and swimming pool overlooking the IJ River. The hotel is conveniently located 1. 2 km from Central Station, 1. 5 km from the main shopping area, and 2. 1 km from Dam Square and the Royal Palace. Zeeburg is an excellent choice for travelers interested in vibrant atmospheres, city walks, and exploring the city. '

636993.description: 'Set in the Providencia district of Santiago, Tagle Hotel Boutique is 2 km from Santiago Cable Car. The property is around 2. 1 km from Costanera Center and 14 km from Outlet Buenaventura. Outlet San Ignacio is 14 km away. At the hotel, each room includes a desk and a flat-screen TV. With a private bathroom fitted with a shower and free toiletries, rooms at Tagle Hotel Boutique also have free WiFi. All guest rooms at the accommodation have air conditioning and a wardrobe. A buffet breakfast is served every morning at the property. Speaking English and Spanish, staff are willing to help at any time of the day at the reception. Patio Bellavista is a 16-minute walk from Tagle Hotel Boutique, while Forestal Park is 1. 9 km from the property. The nearest airport is Santiago International Airport, 17 km from the hotel'

637031.description: Located in Venice, 900 metres from La Fenice, Hotel Nani Mocenigo Palace features a garden and free WiFi. All air-conditioned, rooms come with a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom. Free toiletries are provided. Some rooms also feature a terrace. A continental breakfast is available every morning at the property. Piazza San Marco is 1. 2 km from Hotel Nani Mocenigo Palace, while Rialto Bridge is 1. 4 km away. Venice Marco Polo Airport is 16 km from the property.

637039.description: Enjoy easy access to Porto's city center and main attractions from our serviced apartments. Located just a 5-minute metro ride from Faria Guimarães station (400m) or a leisurely 20-minute walk, these apartments offer everything you need for a comfortable stay. Each apartment features a fully equipped kitchen with a fridge, oven, microwave, and boiler, as well as a washing machine, iron, ironing board, and dishwasher. Amenities include shampoo, soap, and bed linens. Entertainment options consist of a flat-screen TV with cable and free high-speed WiFi. Cleaning service is provided every 3 days, and flexible late-night check-in is available via a secure digicode. Traveling with little ones? We can provide a crib upon request. Pet lovers rejoice – your furry friends are welcome for an additional nightly fee of EUR 10.

637068.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and discounted use of a nearby fitness facility. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Featured amenities include express check-out, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Stay in one of 20 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and hair dryers. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and complimentary bottled water, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Avenida del Paralelo - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Victoria Theatre - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Rambla del Raval - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Sant Antoni Market - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Maritime Museum - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Palau Güell - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Gran Teatre del Liceu - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- La Rambla - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Columbus Monument - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Boqueria Market - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Plaça Reial - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Port Vell - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Joan Miro Foundation - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Montjuïc - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi. The nearest major airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 15. 6 km / 9. 7 mi A stay at Casa Vaganto places you in the heart of Barcelona, within a 15-minute walk of La Rambla and Boqueria Market. This hotel is 0. 8 mi (1. 2 km) from Montjuïc and 1. 7 mi (2. 7 km) from Barcelona Cathedral.

637069.description: 4 Star Hotel, totally new, with apartments for up to 4 people and very comfortable rooms, many with kitchens, all exterior and fully equipped. HG City Suites is designed to make you feel at home, and it is ideal both for long stays for work or health reasons and for leisure or professional visits. HG City Suites Barcelona is located in the privileged neighbourhood of Sarrià-Sant Gervasi, surrounded by all kinds of services and only 10 minutes walking from the Paseo de Gracia and the Avenida Diagonal, or 5 minutes from the lively neighbourhood of Gracia, with numerous squares, shops, restaurants, bars . . . What's more, it is perfectly connected to all points of interest by bus or metro. The railway station of Plaza Molina or the Fontana metro stop, 200 and 300 metres away, offer direct connections to the Plaza Cataluña, Ramblas, Liceu theatre , Parque Güell Gaudí. . . . And for those who want to be close to their medical appointments, the HG City Suites is next to some of the most prestigious medical centres in Barcelona.

637071.description: This Kemer aparthotel is within 3 mi (5 km) of Liman Street, Moonlight Park and Beach, and Kemer Merkez Bati Public Beach. Kemer Marina and Nomad Theme Park are also within 3 mi (5 km). This apartment hotel offers an outdoor pool, a 24-hour front desk and free self parking. You can enjoy free wifi in the common areas and a free welcome detail organized by the receptionEach apartment has an LCD TV with satellite channels, as well as a basic kitchen with a fridge, oven and cooking hob. You can also enjoy a washing machine, free Wi-Fi and a hairdryer. A single cleaning service is offered during the stay.

637091.address: Göynük Mahallesi, Cumhuriyet Mah Sakip Sabanci Cad
637091.description: The establishment consists of 80 units. Clients will appreciate the 24-hour reception. Travellers arriving by car will appreciate parking available at Eldar Garden Resort. This is an eco-friendly hotel.

637184.description: In the heart of the Atlantic Forest, amidst lush vegetation, Pousada das Araras is the best option for rest, walking and business meetings. Located in a paradisiacal landscape within the tourist-gastronomic itinerary of the Serra, the inn is sophisticated rustic, a true haven of tranquility, peace and silence to provide unforgettable days. An area with more than 150, 000 m² of Atlantic Forest, half of which is totally conserved in its natural state. Here, at the foot of the Pedra Maria Comprida, peaceful and pleasant coexistence with birds, monkeys, squirrels and other small animals is one of the many attractions. The 1km trail available for hiking is a leisure option for those who wish to make peace with nature. We also have Wi-Fi throughout. Pousada das Araras awaits you. Come enjoy our paradise.

637233.description: This lovely hotel is situated in Antalya City, offering 50 comfortable guest rooms. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi access in public areas and a 24-hour reception service. While cots are not available, the hotel prioritizes accessibility with wheelchair-accessible rooms and adapted facilities. Guests can also take advantage of the hotel's health and wellness facilities for relaxation and rejuvenation.

637433.description: The brand new Perianth hotel is a 5-star boutique hotel, located in Agia Irini square next to Monastiraki, the most famous square in the heart of Athens. Built in 2018, opening its doors to guests this July, its 47 luxurious rooms, offer magnificent views over the Acropolis and the landmark of the square. Surrounded with plenty of cafes, restaurants & shops, Perianth Hotel is ideally situated for those who wish to explore the city of Athens. Perianth Hotel is member of Design Hotels.

637464.description: The newly built Occidental Dubai Production City, a four-star hotel, enjoys a prime location in the International Media Production Zone (IMPZ), close to EXPO 2020 and easily accessible from Sheikh Zayed Road. Both Al Maktoum (DWC) and Dubai International Airport (DXB) are just 30 minutes away. The hotel features 239 rooms, including 18 suites, along with two restaurants, three bars, a café, four meeting rooms, and a ballroom. It caters to both business travelers and leisure seekers exploring Dubai's attractions. The Occidental IMPZ has implemented enhanced hygiene procedures to ensure guest safety.

637469.address: Prolongación Bonampak S/N Mz 1 Lote RTH4 SM3
637469.description: ATELIER Playa Mujeres is an All-Inclusive 5+ Star Resort for Adults and guests over 16 years old, offering a fantastic concept inspired by the Art and Design of Contemporary Mexico. Its innovative atmosphere blends harmoniously with the mesmerizing natural landscape of Playa Mujeres, set between the crystalline waters of the Caribbean and a magnificent golf course. Created as an authentic masterpiece by Mexican creatives, ATELIER Playa Mujeres will take its guests into a new Barefoot Luxury experience, where art, nature and experiences are combined to set up a new world of relaxation. The 431 suites feature a dazzling design with marble and wood accents, luxurious amenities, as well as avant-garde style furniture, complemented with jaw-dropping views of the golf course and the Caribbean. The iconic flavors of Mexico and the world are gathered in over 20 restaurants with a surrounding gastronomic proposal, creating an intense tour of aromas and textures, in spaces inspired by the Mexican and international traditions. The unbeatable location in the exclusive Playa Mujeres resort, guarantees an exclusive and top-notch experience with connectivity to the finest shopping centers, touristic activities and Cancun International Airport. Atelier Playa Mujeres is a new way to live up the luxury and sophistication of Contemporary Mexico as never before.

637565.description:
Corendon Amsterdam Schiphol Airport, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, blends comfort and convenience with a distinctly Dutch touch. Enjoy free airport shuttle service, modern amenities, and quick access to Amsterdam’s city center and business districts. The hotel features 207 rooms, diverse dining options—from an All You Can Eat Restaurant and international Bar & Bistro to the Caribbean-inspired Mondi Skybar & Restaurant with airport views. Relax in the in-house cinema, indoor pool, or 24/7 gym. For meetings and events, there are 11 fully equipped rooms and a unique outdoor venue beneath a retired Boeing 747. On-site parking available. -	Starting 1 January 2026, the shuttle service from the Corendon Amsterdam Schiphol Airport Hotel to the airport will be available at a fee of EUR 5 per person. The shuttle service from the airport to the hotel will remain complimentary. 

In short: comfort, convenience, and character—minutes from Amsterdam.

637593.address: Sestiere San Polo - Riva de L Ogio, 1777
637593.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Make yourself at home in one of the 43 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature designer toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Rialto Market - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- San Cassiano - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Rialto Bridge - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- T Fondaco Dei Tedeschi - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Casino of Venice - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Teatro Goldoni - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Teatro Malibran - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Marco Polo's Home - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Basilica di Santa Maria Gloriosa dei Frari - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Chiesa Santa Maria dei Miracoli - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Palazzo Pisani Moretta - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Palazzo Contarini del Bovolo - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Riva de Biasio Waterbus - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- San Teodoro - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- San Toma Waterbus - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- With a stay at Hotel L'Orologio Venezia, you'll be centrally located in Venice, just a 4-minute walk from Rialto Bridge and 12 minutes by foot from St. Mark's Square. This luxury hotel is 0. 6 mi (0. 9 km) from St. Mark's Basilica and 0. 6 mi (1 km) from St Mark's Campanile.

637605.description: Located in Riyadh's center, Al Diafah Hotel Suites offers rooms with free internet access, just 1. 2 mi from the Al Faisaliyah Center. Facilities include a spa with an indoor pool. The rooms of Hotel Suites Al Diafah feature a modern and elegant interior. All rooms have air conditioning, a mini-bar, and cable TV. Some rooms have a living area and a kitchenette. Guests can relax at Al Diafah's spa, which also includes a sauna, a fitness center, a hot tub, and a steam bath. The snack bar of Al Diafah Hotel Suites offers a variety of local and international drinks and snacks. The Prince Faisal bin Fahd Stadium is 3. 1 mi from Al Diafah Hotel Suites, and the National Museum of Saudi Arabia is 3. 7 mi away. Free parking is possible on site. Al Sulimania is a great choice for travelers interested in restaurants, food and cafes.

637627.description: Located just 650 meters from the town center, Hotel Banana City offers convenient access to local attractions and public transportation. This 100-room hotel, fully renovated in 2014, provides complimentary Wi-Fi in public areas, 24-hour reception, accessible common areas, and paid underground parking. Committed to sustainable practices, the hotel features on-site dining options ranging from casual to elegant, as well as meeting facilities ideal for business travelers. Guests can also enjoy a relaxing stay with the hotel's health and wellness services. Some services may incur additional charges.

637650.address: Gran Via De Les Corts Catalanes 619-621, 621
637650.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a 24-hour health club, an outdoor pool, and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, Virens, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Planning an event in Barcelona? This hotel has 1615 square feet (150 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 4 meeting rooms.

637797.description: Gorki Apartments is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Berlin. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Take advantage of the hotel's free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, grocery deliveries, taxi service. Some of the well-appointed guestrooms feature television LCD/plasma screen, additional bathroom, linens, towels, internet access – wireless. To enhance guests' stay, the hotel offers recreational facilities such as garden. No matter what your reasons are for visiting Berlin, Gorki Apartments will make you feel instantly at home.

637807.description: This lovely hotel is in Parallel.

637855.description: The premises count with 30 welcoming guest rooms. Hotel Villa Sorriso offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Hotel Villa Sorriso does not operate a 24-hour reception. All guests staying at this property may take advantage of the car park. The hotel applies a sustainable policy. Those seeking peace and tranquillity will find their best accommodation option at this hotel with plenty of health and wellness options.

637896.address: Ahmed Bin Usayb Street, Behind Danu
637896.description: The 35 welcoming rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection available on-site. As this hotel features 24-hour reception, guests are always welcome. Unfortunately, there are no guest rooms where everyone staying at this accommodation can ask for a cot for the little ones. The car park may be useful to those arriving by car.

637897.address: Prince Majid Road, Opposite of Flam
637897.description: Platinum Suites Hotel Apartments offers 97 well-appointed rooms and convenient amenities such as Wi-Fi in public areas, 24-hour reception, and accessible common areas. Business travelers will appreciate the on-site business facilities, providing a comfortable and productive stay. Guests also benefit from on-site parking. Some services may incur a fee.

name.content: The Towers At Lotte New York Palace

637917.description: Indulge in onsite massages, body treatments, and facials at this conveniently located hotel, just steps from 5th Avenue and St. Patrick's Cathedral. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and browse the gift shops. A complimentary area shuttle simplifies exploring nearby attractions. The hotel's restaurant, Pomme Palais, offers lunch, complemented by a coffee shop/cafe and room service during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available on weekends for a fee. Business amenities include a business center and dry cleaning/laundry services. The 176 air-conditioned rooms feature refrigerators, iPod docking stations, pillowtop beds with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets, 42-inch plasma TVs with cable, and bathrooms with designer toiletries.

638095.description: In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Visitors may contact the reception desk any time during the day.

638100.description: Located in Chinatown, this budget-friendly hotel is conveniently situated 2 miles from the Brooklyn Bridge and 3 miles from the Empire State Building. The National September 11 Memorial & Museum is also just 2 miles away. Guests enjoy comfortable rooms and attentive service from our multilingual, 24-hour staff. All accommodations include free Wi-Fi and a 39-inch flat-screen TV. This 100% non-smoking, green hotel also features a shared lounge and is within an 11-minute walk of Bloomingdales and one mile from NYU. We look forward to welcoming you to The Canal Loft Hotel.

638173.description: Situated in Bogotá, within 300 metres of Corferias International Exhibition Center and 2 km of El Campin Stadium, Hotel Portal de los Andes offers a shared lounge. The property is around 2. 3 km from El Campin Coliseum, 4. 1 km from Bolivar Square and 4. 4 km from Luis Angel Arango Library. Quevedo's Jet is 5 km from the hotel and T Zone is 6 km away. At the hotel, the rooms include a desk and a flat-screen TV. With a private bathroom fitted with a shower, rooms at Hotel Portal de los Andes also have free WiFi, while some rooms are equipped with a mountain view. All units feature a wardrobe. An American breakfast can be enjoyed at the property. The accommodation offers a sun terrace. Speaking English and Spanish at the reception, staff will be happy to provide guests with practical advice on the area. Monserrate Hill is 6 km from Hotel Portal de los Andes.

638177.description: The hotel comprises a total of 97 snug rooms. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the hotel. Additionally, the premises provide a reception service the whole day through. Platinum Seventy Hotel does not offer cots on demand. The premises offer accessible public areas. There is a car park at Platinum Seventy Hotel. At this hotel, there are plenty of health and wellness services which guests can take advantage of.

638189.description: The Park Way Hotel offers excellent service and comfortable accommodations for leisure and business travelers alike. Located in Bogotá, just 8 km from the historic Candelaria district, the hotel features rooms with garden views and free Wi-Fi. Guests can also enjoy the extensive surrounding parks and free private parking.

name.content: Van der Valk Hotel Amsterdam - Amstel

638205.description: Van der Valk Hotel Amsterdam - Amstel is a beautiful 4-star hotel in Amsterdam with a swimming pool, fitness, spa and wellness center. The hotel is centrally located in a prime location in district Oost. Just a 3-minute walk away is Overamstel metro station, from where you can reach the center of Amsterdam in 10 minutes. During their stay, guests benefit from free high-speed WiFi, 24-hour reception and luggage storage. The 206 rooms and suites range from 24 to 51 square yards and feature a flat-screen TV, a desk and air conditioning. Additionally, all bathrooms are equipped with a rain shower, hairdryer and free toiletries. Hotel guests have exclusive and free access to the fitness and the spa and wellness center, which includes a heated outdoor swimming pool (28°C), Turkish steam bath, Finnish sauna, infrared sauna and herbal sauna. Massage and/or wax treatments can be booked by appointment. Every morning an extensive breakfast is set up at Buffet 't IJ. Upon request, chefs prepare freshly made egg dishes. For lunch and dinner, à la carte Restaurant Amstelle offers a variety of international dishes. Guests can also visit Bar Moqum for delicious comfort food or to end the evening with a drink. The hotel is easily accessible by both public transport and car (intersection A10/A2). There is parking available in the hotel's own secure underground parking garage. By bicycle, you can reach the ‘Rivierenbuurt’ in 5 minutes and the nightlife area ‘de Pijp’ in 8 minutes! Rental bikes are available at the reception. Explore nearby attractions such as the Johan Cruijff Arena, the RAI and the Ziggo Dome, all within 1. 9 mi. The nearest airport, Schiphol, is located 9. 3 mi away from the hotel.

638231.description: This cozy hotel, a renovated manor house, is centrally located in Athens, just off Ermou Street, the city's main shopping area. Situated between the Acropolis and Monastiraki, it's also a short walk from Syntagma Square and Plaka. The hotel offers 17 rooms with complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour reception, a welcome drink, a traditional Greek breakfast, and body therapy treatments. Please note that pets are not allowed.

638282.description: A stay at Grand Hyatt Bogota places you in the heart of Bogotá, a 2-minute drive from National University of Colombia and 5 minutes from Simon Bolivar Park. This luxury hotel is 3. 2 mi (5. 1 km) from Bogotá Botanical Garden and 3. 2 mi (5. 2 km) from Paloquemao. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a health club, an indoor pool, and a spa tub. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Make yourself at home in one of the 374 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations and LED televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Enjoy Japanese cuisine at Ushin Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Bogotá? This hotel has 24434 square feet (2270 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 18 meeting rooms.

638295.description: Located in the Alanya area, the Grand Bahama Beach Hotel (formerly Happy Beach Hotel) offers 100 cozy rooms, renovated in 2016. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi in all public areas and convenient parking. The hotel provides wheelchair-accessible units and offers a transfer service. A varied entertainment program ensures a pleasant stay. Some services may incur a fee.

638328.address: Kızlar Pınarı, Ali Dizdaroğlu Sk No: 66
638328.description: Our hotel, located 200 meters from Cleopatra Beach in central Alanya, offers all-inclusive services. We are open year-round and provide 24-hour reception, Wi-Fi, and a safe tourism certificate regarding COVID-19. We welcome guests seeking a wonderful holiday experience, enjoying the fresh air, sun, and sea.

638447.description: This comfortable hotel is situated in Midtown West. Located within 25 m from the town centre, the hotel allows easy access to all this destination has to offer. Broadway Theaters, Times Square, Bryany Park, Hudson Yards, Empire State Building are close to the hotel. Travellers will find the airport within 2 kilometres. Patrons can easily access the public transportation means. Guests may contact the reception desk for further information any time during the day. This establishment offers chic and beautifully decorated units offering the ideal sanctuary from New York City bustle and distractions. All rooms come with home appliances and facilities, bath amenities and internet access available for further comfort and convenience. Amenities Fee payable at check-in:Welcome cocktail at check-in$25 credit for the lobby barIn-room bottled waterCiti Bike passes for explorationBussines Center24-Hour ConciergePlease also note:Parking Fee - Valet parking is available with no in and out privileges is $85 (plus tax).

638522.description:
Set in Largo do Intendente, in the center of Lisbon and in one of the city's most multicultural neighborhoods, you will find the Bombarda Palace. Converted into a creative hospitality unit, the Indy House – Room & Apartments offers a wide range of different rooms and apartments, with equipped kitchens in every floor and charming indoor and outdoor common areas.
The unit comprises 4 single superior rooms, 2 twin rooms, 8 small double rooms, 10 standard double rooms and 10 double superior rooms. All 4 floors with rooms include equipped shared kitchens, available to all guests. 
The 5 one-bedroom apartments, with 30 to 35 sqm and capacity to up to 4 people include one bedroom, one bathroom, a living room and equipped kitchen.
The two-bedroom apartment, with 41 sqm and capacity to up to 6 people include two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a living room and equipped kitchen.
The rooms and apartments are all equipped with bathroom with walk-in shower, wi-fi, TV, A/C and safe.
Breakfast is included in all reservations.
The common rooms and outdoor areas are spacious and invite visitors to enjoy Lisbon in a laid back and independent way.
