These include a restaurant, parking, shuttle service, wellness area, gym, and meeting rooms, ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Modern technology and warm hospitality make this four-star hotel a benchmark for accommodation in the Altomilano area. The 44 guest rooms feature flat-screen satellite TVs with SKY channels and complimentary Wi-Fi.

640503.description: The unpretentious 296 Heritage Apartments offer 15 units in Vila Nova de Gaia, directly across from the Douro River. Enjoy easy access to the city center, historical monuments, restaurants, and attractions, all within walking distance. Your stay includes a fully equipped room, ensuring a worry-free vacation. Admire stunning views of the Douro River and Porto’s cityscape, including the Port wine cellars, from your window. While on-site parking isn't available, paid parking is conveniently located just 250 meters away. Experience the heart of Porto and immerse yourself in the city's beauty.

640769.description: CA ' DE LA FONTE is a modern renovation of two apartments, which are divided into 9 rooms totally independent and with private bathroom. The apartments are equipped with modern home automation that allows you to enjoy the spaces IN a flexible and customizable way. To make the atmosphere special there is a private garden with a fountain and a centenary wisteria that arrives to cover a beautiful terrace on the second floor, which was divided to make it usable by two different rooms IN total PRIVACY.

640863.description: Stay fit in our 24-hour fitness center or with in-room fitness options. This 350-guestroom hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy French cuisine at Cafe D’Avignon Pop-Up, or grab a bite at our coffee shop/cafe. Room service is available during limited hours. Unwind at one of two bars/lounges. Continental breakfast is offered daily (fee applies). Business travelers appreciate our 24-hour business center and dry cleaning/laundry services. We also have two meeting rooms and a 24-hour front desk. Guest rooms feature LCD TVs, laptop-compatible safes, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. Located near 5th Avenue, Madison Square Park, and Herald Square, we're just a short distance from iconic NYC attractions.

640901.description: Discover the allure of this Art Deco hotel, featuring 250 guestrooms equipped with minibars, LCD televisions, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy satellite programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, and convenient amenities such as safes, desks, and phones. Indulge in the hotel's restaurant, 24-hour room service, or unwind at the bar/lounge. Stay active at the 24-hour fitness center or explore the area with bicycle rentals. This hotel offers a range of amenities including a business center, express check-in/check-out, concierge services, and a common area television. For events, the hotel boasts 4, 306 square feet (400 square meters) of space, including conference areas and four meeting rooms. A complimentary airport shuttle is available during limited hours. Full breakfasts are served for a fee on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Nearby attractions include Amsterdamse Bos (0. 1 mi), Cobra Museum of Modern Art (2. 4 mi), and VU University of Amsterdam (3. 9 mi). The nearest airport is Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS), 6. 1 mi away.

640922.address: Barahat Msheireb Street, Msheireb Downtown Doha
640922.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a 24-hour health club, an outdoor pool, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy French cuisine at Izu, one of the hotel's 9 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Doha? This hotel has 6857 square feet (637 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 9 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

640983.description: This lovely Hotel is in Plettenberg Bay. We boast a variety of accommodation to suit all travellers. Perfectly positioned 230m above the rugged Tsitsikamma coastline, are our Ocean View Lodges offering 180 degree breathtaking views of the Indian Ocean, our Lake Side Tented Lodges overlook open green pastures and a tranquil dam and our Forest View Tented Lodge is nestled on the edge of the forest surrounded by natural vegetation and bird life.

641054.address: PG Solanki Path, Grant Road East
641054.description: budget accommodation around Mumbai Central Railway Station, Treebo Anam International is an excellent choice. This 2-star hotel is located just off D. B. Marg and is popular among corporates, medical tourists, couples, families and foreigners. If you're getting to the city on by flight, the Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport is 19. 6 km from the hotel. Mumbai Central Railway Station is only about 800 m away from the hotel. Treebo Anam International boasts of 39 comfortable rooms with 16 Oak, 18 Maple and 5 Mahogany rooms. Each room is equipped with an air conditioner, a television with DTH/Cable, an electric kettle, intercom and a clean attached bathroom. You can also enjoy a delicious breakfast, fast WiFi and branded toiletries, all on the house. The hotel also provides timely laundry service, an elevator, the provision for an ironing board, 24-hour security.

641145.description: Located in the Al Malaz district of Riyadh, the IntercityHotel Riyadh Malaz is within a 15-minute drive of Al Batha Market and the Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center. This upscale hotel offers a health club, an outdoor pool, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a television in the common area. Each of the 84 air-conditioned rooms features a fireplace, an LED television, a laptop-compatible safe, and a desk. Guests can enjoy local cuisine at Al Onibat Coffee Shop for lunch, dinner, or brunch. A coffee shop/cafe and room service (during limited hours) are also available. Buffet breakfasts are offered daily for a fee. Additional amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, a roundtrip airport shuttle (for a surcharge), and free self-parking. Nearby attractions include King Abdullah Park and Riyadh Zoo.

name.content: Petit Palace Los Austrias (Soho Boutique Ópera)

641306.address: Calle de las Veneras, 2, Centro, Madrid, 2 4
641306.description:
Petit Palace Los Austrias formerly known as Soho Boutique Ópera, enjoys a central Madrid location, a short drive from the airport and within walking distance of major attractions like the Royal Palace and Plaza España. Three metro stations are less than 300 meters away, providing easy access to the city's vibrant commercial and culinary scene. This hotel offers a varied breakfast buffet and stylishly designed rooms featuring modern décor, comfortable furnishings, and luxurious private bathrooms with complimentary coffee machines. Guests can also enjoy the convenience of air conditioning and ample wardrobe space. For eco-conscious travelers, the hotel proudly holds an Ecostars Certificate for its sustainable practices. Dogs under 10 kg are welcome with prior request and an additional fee. The cost of your dog's accommodation per night is €12. 
The cleaning fee is €25 per stay. 
Maximum weight is 10 kg.

641307.description: Our Hotel is certified with the 'Clean & Safe' stamp by the Portuguese Tourism office. Located a 3-minute walk from Paris Galleries Street, The One Monumental Palace offers 5-star accommodation in Porto and is situated in a renovated historic building from 1923. The property has two restaurants, a bar, an indoor swimming pool and a Spa & Wellness Centre. The hotel is close to several noted attractions, around 400 m from City Market Bolhao and around 400 m from Clerigos Tower. Free WiFi is available. The property features rooms and suites, all equipped with a coffee machine and a private bathroom with a shower. All units are equipped with a seating area. Buffet breakfast options are available every morning at The One Monumental Palace. The Monumental Café brasserie features fish and seafood options, while The Monument is a gourmet restaurant. There is also the Americain bar, which also serves snacks. The One Monumental Palace offers a range of wellness facilities including a sauna and an indoor pool, a hammam and a fitness centre. Staff at the 24-hour front desk can provide tips on the area. Le Monumental features a library lounge and a comfortable TV room.

641383.description: Enjoy a stay at the Aloft Lima Miraflores, a modern hotel offering an array of amenities including an indoor pool, 24-hour fitness center, and bicycle rentals. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, and enjoy cable programming on your flat-screen TV, complete with an iPod docking station. Bathrooms feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) at Re:fuel By Aloft, or grab a snack at the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also provides 24-hour room service and a bar/lounge for evening relaxation. For business travelers, there's a 24-hour business center and meeting rooms. Conveniently located near attractions such as Larcomar Shopping Center and Miraflores Malecon, the hotel provides easy access to explore the vibrant Miraflores district. A shuttle service from Jorge Chavez Intl. Airport (LIM) is available (surcharge applies), along with self-parking (subject to charges).

641445.description: Located in Athens' vibrant Psyrri district, The Artist Athens is a stylish urban residence transformed from an industrial building. Guests can enjoy the lounge bar and restaurant on the ground floor, open to the public. A massage area with a sauna and a personal training space are available on the middle floor for ultimate relaxation. The first floor boasts a private, urban-chic courtyard exclusively for guests. Ascend to the rooftop garden bar on the third floor for breathtaking Acropolis views and an authentic Athenian experience.

641446.description: The boutique hotel MOOONS is one of the hottest locations in town. A hotel and hangout spot all rolled into one. With a rooftop terrace offering a 360° view over Vienna and a culinary concept that combines local specialities with international flair, MOOONS is destined to become a meeting place for locals and guests from around the world. This lovely hotel offers a total of 170 accommodation units. MOOONS Veinna was built in 2019. All rooms are equipped with free WIFI, Smart TV and In-room Entertainment, air conditioning, twin beds, fridge, desk, safety box and a luxurious walk-in rain shower (additional bath tub in Deluxe rooms). Thanks to its convenient location near Vienna's new central railway station, MOOONS couldn't be better connected by local public transport. The city centre is only three stops away and from the hotel it's just 15 minutes to UNO City or 20 minutes to the airport. The location opposite the new Quartier Belvedere city district, in the immediate vicinity of the Belvedere palace complex, makes MOOONS the perfect base for a business trip or a city break. Public areas: Fitness centre on the top floor, Underground parking with 16 parking spaces, 2 e-charging stations, Bus drop-off in front of the hotel, Bus parking in walking distanceMOOONS isn't just another hotel – it's a unique experience!

name.content: Delta Hotels By Marriott, Dubai Investment Park

641449.description: Situated in Dubai's Investment Park, Delta Hotels by Marriott offers convenient access to key attractions. A short drive takes you to the Dubai Exhibition Centre and Ibn Battuta Mall, while Expo City Dubai and Bluewaters Island are also easily reachable. Unwind at the full-service spa with massage treatments or enjoy the 24-hour health club and outdoor pool. The hotel provides complimentary wired and wireless internet access, concierge service, and gift shops. A complimentary beach shuttle makes trips to the coast effortless. The 253 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, Smart TVs, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Savor international cuisine at Maisan Restaurant & Bar or order from the 24-hour room service. Continental breakfast is available daily for a fee. For business travelers, a 24-hour business center and meeting rooms are provided.

641453.description: Located in Cancun's Hotel Zone, the upscale Renaissance Cancun Resort & Marina is a short drive from Langosta and Tortuga Beaches. It's also conveniently close to the Cancun Convention Center (8. 7 km) and La Isla Shopping Mall (11. 3 km). Guests can enjoy a range of amenities, including an outdoor pool, a spa tub, and a fitness center. The hotel also offers wireless internet access (surcharge), concierge services, and wedding services. The 180 guestrooms feature LCD televisions with satellite programming, and wireless internet access (surcharge). Bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences such as phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Dining options include an onsite restaurant and room service (during limited hours), as well as a bar/lounge for evening relaxation. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel also offers meeting and conference space. Limited parking is available onsite.

641607.description: Don't miss out on recreational opportunities including a 24-hour fitness center and bicycles to rent. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite at H-Bar, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe. A complimentary buffet breakfast is included. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 108 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Center - 3.

641609.description: The Hyatt Centric Las Condes Santiago offers 166 accommodation units and convenient access to public transport. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi and a 24/7 reception. The hotel prioritizes accessibility and features wheelchair-accessible accommodations. On-site parking is available for those arriving by car. The airport is located 18600km away.

641625.description: The Hyatt Place Riyadh Sulaimania offers a convenient location in the upscale Al Sulaimania District of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia's capital city. Just minutes from Thalyah Street, King Faisal Airbase, and the upcoming Riyadh Metro station, it provides easy access to both modern and historical attractions, including the Riyadh National Museum and the Kingdom Centre Tower. This hotel features 88 spacious guestrooms and suites, each furnished with contemporary flair. Guests enjoy plush Hyatt Grand Beds, state-of-the-art media and work centers, cozy corner sofa sleepers, complimentary Wi-Fi throughout, remote printing access, and free underground parking.

641660.description: This newly built, modern, and charming hotel is located in Lisbon's city center. The 73 rooms are distributed across several floors, each featuring a unique color scheme that enlivens the hotel. Each room is equipped with satellite TV, a telephone, a hairdryer, a private shower, toiletries, and tea/coffee making facilities. On-site parking is also available.

641727.description: The Novotel Santiago Providencia hotel is located in one of the city's best neighborhoods, near to the metro, shopping malls, restaurants and tourist hotspots such as Sky Costanera, Cerro San Cristóbal hill and Plaza de Armas, with easy access to Santiago Airport, the wineries and ski resorts. The hotel boasts an indoor swimming pool, spa, fitness center, meeting rooms, restaurant, bar, free WIFI and car park. Children up to the age of 16 stay free of charge when staying in the same room as their parents. Connecting rooms for families, children's menu and play area. Children up to the age of 16 stay free of charge when sharing the same room as their parents. Pets are welcome.

name.content: Palladio Hotel Buenos Aires - MGallery Collection

641739.description: Located in the heart of the traditional Recoleta neighborhood, Palladio Hotel Buenos Aires offers a unique and exclusive experience. Close to the business districts and the city's main tourist attractions, it is the perfect place to stay for work or pleasure. The hotel boasts 113 spacious and elegant rooms with modern decoration and luxury materials, comfortable suites with private balcony, a heated pool and spa, fitness center, meeting rooms and a fashionable bar and restaurant.

641750.description: The comfortable EV 11 ATHENS offers guests a peaceful stay in Athens. This hotel features 18 guest rooms and provides Wi-Fi in all public areas and rooms. A 24-hour reception and airport transfer service are available (fees may apply). Please note, cots are not available and pets are not permitted.

name.content: Golden Tower Express Berrini by Fenix Hoteis

641786.description: With its vibrant, modern design, our hotel offers an innovative experience in the heart of São Paulo. Located just 500 meters from Avenida Berrini, near the city's premier commercial district, the Golden Tower Express Berrini provides convenient access to key destinations. The hotel features 102 cozy, soundproofed apartments across six floors, each equipped with free high-speed Wi-Fi, a flat-screen Smart TV, minibar, and private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Parking is available for R$50. 00 per day. We're just steps from the iconic Estaiada Bridge and Marginal Pinheiros, and a short drive from Morumbi Shopping, the WTC convention center, Interlagos Racetrack, and São Paulo/Congonhas Airport.

641799.description: Overlooking the pristine waters of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai’s glittering skyline, Mandarin Oriental Jumeira, Dubai, is a stunning beachfront resort offering unparalleled luxury in an enviable Jumeirah Beach setting. Located in one of Dubai’s most prestigious neighborhoods, the resort’s elegant rooms and suites offer abundant space, combining contemporary decor with guest-centric technology and wonderful views. The resort is conveniently located 2km from La Mer, with its beachside shopping, dining, and water parks, and 5km from Downtown Dubai, home to the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Opera, Dubai Fountain, and Dubai Mall. In response to the COVID-19 pandemic, enhanced health and safety protocols are in place, including temperature checks, PPE for guests and staff, and increased disinfection measures throughout the hotel.

641805.description: This charming 4-star boutique hotel is located in Milan's historical center, just 100 meters from Piazza Duomo. The front desk offers 24-hour reception and concierge services. Its 11 spacious rooms and suites (between 25 and 50 square meters) occupy a five-story historical building, ensuring maximum privacy. Rooms and suites feature bathrobes, slippers, bathroom amenities, a coffee machine, Sky and Netflix, and room service (in partnership with Deliveroo). The hotel can arrange private airport transfers. A delicious continental breakfast is served daily from 7 a. m. to noon on the rooftop terrace or in your room. The Street Milano Duomo ranks among the top three hotels in Milan (out of 450) on TripAdvisor.

641810.description: There are a total of 34 guest rooms at Uniclass Hotel Pinheiros. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. The premises offer accessible public areas.

641936.description: Located near Corferias, Bogotá Airport, the main bus terminal, and the American Embassy, this charming hotel in Bogotá offers 50 cozy accommodations. Guests can enjoy wired and wireless internet access in public areas and 24-hour reception. The hotel is wheelchair accessible and welcomes small pets. It also provides comprehensive services and amenities for successful business events, though some services may incur a fee.

642101.description: Our hotel policies have changed. We've updated our reservation and cancellation policies, extended Hilton Honors Points and status, and may be requiring face coverings, temperature checks, health declarations, and use of mobile contact tracing at our hotels around the world. Please visit our dedicated COVID-19 page. Prior to traveling, please check your destination's government website to understand any local requirements or restrictions that may be in place. Have a relaxing escape in the countryside at Hilton Pilar. Located within the Pilar Golf Club on the outskirts of Buenos Aires, our contemporary chic hotel is situated along one of the most exclusive golf courses in Argentina and features stunning views from every area. Every modern guest room features floor-to-ceiling windows and spectacular views of the golf course. Relax watching the HDTV, work at the desk, and sleep well with options from the complimentary pillow menu. Staying a few days? Book a suite with a separate living area and private terrace. Situated on higher floors are our executive rooms, offering more space and prime golf course views. Visit the Executive Lounge for continental breakfast and afternoon hors d'oeuvres. Splash around in your choice of four swimming pools, work out in the fitness center, or indulge in spa treatments. Along with a 27-hole golf course designed by renowned architect Ronald Fream, the hotel offers eight tennis courts, two football fields, and a concrete multi-sport court. Enjoy international and Argentinian cuisine during your stay. Solsticio Restaurant changes menus and decor each season, and Circular Bar is an inviting spot to socialize. Have a poolside cocktail, a light snack at the golf course, or have meals delivered with 24-hour room service. From small meetings to cocktail parties to conventions, our hotel has unique and versatile spaces for any event. Host colleagues in our boardroom or plan a wedding reception for up to 450 guests in the Grand Ballroom.

name.content: Iberostar Selection Coral Cancun All Inclusive

642401.description:
Iberostar Cancun Star Prestige is redefining how you vacation. This adults-only retreat is a dream come true, featuring modern living spaces, 156 rooms with ocean views, and exclusive facilities. From arrival to check-out, superior service will allow you to relax comfortably. Waiting for you is a private beach area, outdoor pool with a bar, food and wine social events, concierge service, and even 24-hour room service. As an all-inclusive guest, you will also have access to all sports and SPA facilities at Iberostar Cancun. Discover a better way to get away at Iberostar Cancun Star Prestige. 

**Due to the implementation of the CURP (Unique Population Registry Code) registration requested by the Federal Government, implemented as of April 1, 2026, guests will be required to present their valid INE or passport containing the CURP at the time of check-in (Registration Process). In the case of minors without official identification, it is essential to present the valid CURP. CURP registration is mandatory only for reservations of guests who are listed as having Mexican nationality.

642506.description: The Pestana Porto – Goldsmith is a 4-star hotel located in the heart of the city, within walking distance of several restaurants, bars and shops. Made up of five buildings from the 19th century, listed as Municipal Heritage, the hotel is inspired by Portuguese filigree, the art of working gold and other metals into twisted threads, with intricate patterns. In one of the most vibrant cities in Europe, the Pestana Porto – Goldsmith is a one-of-a-kind project, which includes a Hotel, and a Museum with filigree workshops. Here, the discrete luxury is blended perfectly with the art of hospitality so typical of Northern Portugal, celebrating tradition, beauty and creativity.

642618.description: When you stay at Hotel Rainers21 in Brunn am Gebirge, you'll be at Businesspark Wien Süd Campus 21, close to Vienna. This hotel is conveniently located off the A21 motorway exit "Brunn am Gebirge". Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and discounted use of a nearby fitness facility. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. This hotel has 6 meeting rooms available for events. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Hotel Rainers21, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available Monday through Friday from 6:30 AM to 10 AM and on weekends from 06:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 174 air-conditioned rooms featuring Smart TV. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks.

name.content: The Level At Hotel Melia Castilla

642642.description: Experience exclusive personalized service at The Level at Meliá Castilla. Its prime location near Paseo de la Castellana, 15 minutes from Barajas Airport and IFEMA, and close to Chamartín Station and the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium, makes it ideal for exploring Madrid. The Level rooms offer a wealth of amenities, ensuring a restful and relaxing stay with meticulous attention to detail and superior services. Note: The outdoor pool is open seasonally, typically from June to September, weather permitting.

642802.description: The property features a total of 23 guest rooms. This accomodation was lastly renovated in 2017. Those staying at this property may keep updated thanks to the Wi-Fi access. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. Catering to the special needs of visitors, Dare Lisbon House includes some wheelchair accessible rooms. Everyone staying at this accommodation may appreciate the airport transfer service. Additional fees may apply for some services.

name.content: Towneplace Suites New York Times Square

643543.description: Centrally located in New York, TownePlace Suites by Marriott New York Manhattan is just a 5-minute walk from Times Square and 6 minutes from Broadway. This hotel is 0. 6 miles from Madison Square Garden and 0. 7 miles from Rockefeller Center. Enjoy recreational opportunities such as the 24-hour fitness center and other amenities, including complimentary Wi-Fi and a television in the common area. Make yourself at home in one of the 114 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring kitchens with refrigerators and stovetops. Your bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. 43-inch Smart televisions offer cable programming, while wireless internet access is available (surcharge). Conveniences include safes, separate sitting areas, and phones with free local calls. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 9:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, a computer station, and dry cleaning/laundry services.

643551.address: Cnr. Main & Gibb Street, Plettenberg. Garden Route
643551.description: Indulge in onsite massages or unwind on the terrace overlooking stunning views. Bayview Hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy ocean views while dining at Adi's Kitchen or order room service (limited hours). Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfast is available (fee applies). The hotel provides dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Airport transfers are available (surcharge), and free self-parking is onsite. Each of the 36 individually furnished guestrooms features complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, a safe, a separate sitting area, and a bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. Daily housekeeping is provided. Located near St. Peter's Anglican Church, Plettenberg Bay Beach, and the Van Plettenberg Beacon, the hotel is a short drive from Robberg Nature Reserve and other attractions. The nearest airport is Plettenberg Bay (PBZ), while Cape Town International Airport (CPT) is also accessible.

643591.description: The Onyx – a dramatic repurposing of the iconic Nedbank Building – is a rare and precious opportunity to invest in the residential revival of Cape Town's historic Heerengracht. These sophisticated urban apartments and penthouses are located in the cultural heart of Cape Town, just 10 minutes' walk from the V&A Waterfront, and will offer residents a host of compelling lifestyle attractions within easy pedestrian reach. Ranging in size from compact studios of 35 square metres to expansive penthouses with roof gardens and private pools at over 400 square metres, The Onyx offers purchasers a wide choice of sectional title real estate. But whatever suits your lifestyle and your pocket, as an owner – or a resident – you will enjoy access to a suite of services and amenities usually only offered in a luxury hotel. These include an entertainment deck with an indoor / outdoor swimming pool, a gym, bar and day spa, a first-rate restaurant, valet parking, and a 24-hour concierge service. Other service offerings include housekeeping, laundry, room service, a free daily shuttle to the V&A Waterfront, and optional participation in a hotel-managed rental pool.

643602.description: The Blaauwberg Beach Hotel, just steps from Blouberg's beachfront, offers 140 rooms and suites, each with stunning Atlantic Ocean views. Many rooms also feature extended views of Table Mountain or Robben Island. Interleading rooms are available for families and groups. All units include a flat-screen satellite TV, tea-and-coffee-making facilities, a desk, a semi-private bathroom with a bath, free toiletries, a hairdryer, a wardrobe, a safe, and ironing facilities. A daily breakfast offers continental and full English options. The hotel's Italian-inspired restaurant, Waves, features a wood-fired pizza oven and a live-show kitchen, using fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Enjoy a romantic evening, a family dinner, or an office function at Waves. The hotel offers an outdoor pool, and the 24-hour front desk can assist with restaurant reservations, transfers, tours, and babysitting services. Located approximately 2. 5 km from West Coast Village Shopping Centre and 3. 2 km from Bayside Mall, the hotel is 27 km from Cape Town International Airport. This area is a guest favorite in Bloubergstrand, according to independent reviews.

643652.description: Built in the late 1800s, this old English Victorian house was originally a family residence. High ceilings and well-kept stuccos give this guesthouse charm and light. The house is inspired by a tropical-African style in an earthy colour palate, accentuated with natural fabrics such as sisal, linen and bamboo. The large saltwater pool lies enticingly in a secluded, tropical garden. The house has 6 parking bays, secure off-street parking and 24-hr service. The original high ceilings and wooden floors have a neutral palette and natural textures, and the outside walls are lined with tall bamboo which gives the guesthouse a feeling of seclusion and privacy not often found in the city. There is a personal, home-away-from-home feeling here. Unwind in our sun-drenched, yet well-secluded tropical bamboo and palm garden. Here you will find a large saltwater swimming pool, which is unique for its size (8x4m). Loungers, an outdoor shower and pool towels are provided for your convenience and comfortability.

643684.address: 13 Constable Street, De La Haye Estate, Bellville, 13
643684.description: Set in a prime location of Cape Town, Balmoral Lodge puts everything the city has to offer just outside your doorstep. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, daily housekeeping, fireplace, kitchen, wheelchair accessible are just some of the facilities on offer. All rooms are designed and decorated to make guests feel right at home, and some rooms come with television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless, internet access – wireless (complimentary), non smoking rooms, air conditioning. Recuperate from a full day of sightseeing in the comfort of your room or take advantage of the hotel's recreational facilities, including golf course (within 3 km), outdoor pool, pool (kids), billiards, table tennis. Discover all Cape Town has to offer by making Balmoral Lodge your base.

643692.description: Enjoy modern comforts like complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at Klepsydra Urban Suites, a guesthouse located in the heart of Athens City Centre. Start your day with a full breakfast (available for a fee), and take advantage of amenities such as a sauna, dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and a 24-hour airport shuttle (surcharge). The 14 air-conditioned rooms feature Smart TVs, minibars, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. A safe and desk provide added convenience. You're a short walk from the Monastiraki Flea Market and the Ancient Agora of Athens, and within a mile of Syntagma Square and other key attractions.

643694.address: Av. Goiás, 3084 - Barcelona, São Caetano Do Sul -
643694.description: Calamares is located in the Barcelona district of São Caetano do Sul, just 7 minutes' walk from Utinga Metro Station. It offers a 24-hour reception and rooms with free WiFi and cable TV. Valet parking is available. Calamares Hotel serves breakfast in your room. A 24-hour room service is also available. 643703.description: Solar Antigo Porto Aeroporto is the closest accommodation to Francisco Sá Carneiro International Airport. It is located 1 minute walk from the airport. The convincing beauty and stunning architecture of this property, combined with the excellent accessibility, make it an ideal destination for you.

643725.description: ALC Seal (Asepsis Latin-American Certificate) Biosecurity Seal - Ayenda HotelsThis charming hotel is located in Bogota. Cots are not available at Ayenda Laguna Dorado. Pets are not permitted on the premises. Guests may appreciate the airport transfer service. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

643827.description: Palazzo San Lorenzo, a new 4-star Superior hotel, is steps from St. Mark's Square, overlooking the picturesque Rio Dell'osmarin in one of Venice's most authentic 'Sestrieri. ' A classic contemporary style combined with luxurious design creates a unique atmosphere. The spacious junior suites are elegantly furnished with original Murano glass chandeliers, parquet floors, Venetian terraces, precious stuccoes, rich fabrics, and luxurious marble bathrooms featuring Calacatta Gold and Black Marquinia marble. Some rooms offer spectacular views of the gently gliding gondolas and the marvelous monumental complex of the Church of San Giorgio dei Greci with its famous leaning bell tower.

643834.description: This property offers a total of 29 rooms. The year of construction of this guest house dates back to 2018. This establishment does not offer cots on demand. My Charm Lisbon Suites understands that accessibility is important to all guests. 643836.description: The establishment features a total of 30 units. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. Famous Crows Guesthouse does not offer 24-hour reception. 643837.description: This charming hotel is set in Dubai. This establishment offers a total of 323 bedrooms. STUDIO M ARABIAN PLAZA HOTEL & HOTEL APARTMENTS was built in 2018. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. STUDIO M ARABIAN PLAZA HOTEL & HOTEL APARTMENTS offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. 643839.address: Al Abraj Street, Business Bay, Al Abraj
643839.description: Located along the Dubai Water Canal, Grand Mercure Business Bay offers affordable luxury just 25 minutes from Dubai International Airport. Enjoy easy access to commercial districts and a 5-minute drive to Dubai Mall. This premier hotel provides a stunning cityscape view and a perfect sanctuary for both business and leisure travelers.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Dubai Al Jadaf

643840.description: Perfectly situated between Dubai International Airport (DXB) and Downtown Dubai. We offer a twice daily free shuttle to Dubai Mall and La Mer Beach. The ideal location next to Al Jadaf Metro Station also puts you just 10 minutes from Dubai World Trade Center (DWTC) and Dubai International Financial Center (DIFC). Start your day with a cooked-to-order breakfast in Somaya daily as well as room service every night. Unwind after a long day with a cocktail or stop by The Shop any time of day for drinks, instant meals and travel essentials. Indulge in a relaxing treatment at our rooftop spa or soak up some rays next to the pool. Our fitness center and business center are both open 24 hours. Our vast event space including five versatile meeting rooms and a pre-function area accommodates up to 250 delegates, and is the perfect spot for your next Dubai event, meeting or conference.

643842.description: Situated moments from the Venice-Mestre railway station, this guest house offers convenient access to Venice via a short ten-minute train ride. Its proximity to major airports, Marco Polo (9 km) and Treviso A. Canova (28 km), makes it ideal for domestic and international travelers. The Guest House Train Station provides four spacious, comfortable rooms, ranging from singles and doubles with private bathrooms to a family room sleeping four. Guests enjoy a welcoming atmosphere, complimentary Wi-Fi, comfortable beds with Select Comfort mattresses, and private balconies. Shared amenities include a dining room, a living room with a TV, and a terrace with a designated smoking area.

643886.address: Al Ramth Street Al Barsha 1 Road
643886.description:
Discover Effortless Comfort and Unmatched Convenience at Tulip Al Barsha
Welcome to Tulip Al Barsha Hotel Apartments, where modern sophistication meets warm hospitality in the vibrant heart of New Dubai. Whether you're visiting for business, 
leisure, or a longer stay, our hotel is thoughtfully designed to be your ideal home away from home. 

Perfectly located just a short stroll from the iconic Mall of the Emirates and the Mall of the Emirates Metro Station, our guests enjoy seamless connectivity to all corners of the city. Key business hubs and attractions — including Dubai World Trade Centre, Jebel Ali Free Zone, Dubai Internet City, Expo 2020 site, Dubai International Airport, and Al Maktoum International Airport — are all within easy reach, making our location one of the most strategic in Dubai. 

Stay in Style and Comfort
Step into elegantly designed hotel apartments that balance contemporary design with the comforts of home. Our spacious studios and suites are flooded with natural light and enhanced by a Smart Lighting System, allowing you to create the ambiance that suits your mood — day or night. 

Each room is thoughtfully equipped to meet the needs of today’s travelers, offering:
• Smart flat-screen TVs for entertainment
• Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi to keep you connected
• Electronic safe for added security
• In-room fridge and washing machine for added convenience

Why Choose Tulip Al Barsha?
• Prime central location near major business districts and leisure attractions
• Easy access to public transport (just minutes from the metro)
• Spacious, well-appointed accommodations perfect for short and long stays
• Warm, attentive service to make every guest feel at home

Whether you're traveling for work, exploring the city, or relocating for a longer stay, Tulip Al Barsha Hotel Apartments offers a welcoming space where elegance and practicality come together. 
Let us be your trusted address in Dubai .

name.content: Secrets La Romana Resort & Spa - Adults Only

643942.description: Located in San Rafael del Yuma, the Secrets La Romana Resort & Spa in Punta Cana is an oceanfront property, within a 10-minute drive of Bayahibe Beach and East National Park. This luxury resort is 11. 6 mi (18. 7 km) from Dye Fore Golf Club and 13. 1 mi (21. 1 km) from La Romana Port. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Choose from two outdoor swimming pools or spend some time at the private beach. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. The 356 air-conditioned rooms feature free minibar items and flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets, and each room offers a private furnished balcony or patio. Complimentary Wi-Fi and satellite programming are provided for your entertainment. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. This resort is all-inclusive, with rates including meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may apply for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Enjoy Asian cuisine at Sakura, one of the resort's six restaurants, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe .

643984.address: AL Rigga Street, Near Usion Metro Station
643984.description: Built in 2018, the Lotus Grand Hotel Dubai offers 82 accessible rooms and convenient amenities such as Wi-Fi, a 24-hour reception, and on-site parking. Business travelers can utilize the hotel's meeting facilities, while leisure guests can enjoy a variety of health and wellness options. The hotel features several dining venues serving delicious culinary specialties to satisfy diverse palates. Please note that some services may incur a fee.

name.content: Zabeel House The Greens by Jumeirah

643985.description: Located on Sheikh Zayed Road, Zabeel House The Greens sits across from Dubai Media City, Internet City, and Knowledge Village, offering 210 comfortably furnished rooms in the heart of Dubai's vibrant Greens neighborhood. Just steps from Dubai's renowned golf course, home of the Dubai Desert Classic, this hotel provides convenient access to key attractions. Designed with a New York loft-style aesthetic and a touch of modern Middle Eastern flair, the 28sqm rooms are both stylish and practical, offering essential amenities and renowned Jumeirah service. Larger rooms, up to 42sqm, are available for extended stays, families, or groups. Beyond the rooms, the hotel's common areas serve as social hubs for guests and locals alike, providing urban-designed yet casual spaces to work or socialize. Three meeting rooms, a communal 'Study, ' and lockers cater to entrepreneurs and remote workers. Zabeel House The Greens also features two dining options, including a Pan-Asian restaurant that transforms into a lively after-work spot. For recreation, guests can enjoy the large 4th-floor swimming pool, kids' club, and well-equipped gym.

643986.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a steam room, and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy American cuisine at Cut, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Lagos? This hotel has 7158 square feet (665 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 155 guestrooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions.

644144.description: Set in a prime location of Dubai, Canal Central Hotel puts everything the city has to offer just outside your doorstep. The property has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour room service, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, fireplace are just some of the facilities on offer. Flat screen television, bathroom phone, carpeting, mirror, scale can be found in selected guestrooms. To enhance guests' stay, the property offers recreational facilities such as fitness center, sauna, outdoor pool, spa, massage. Friendly staff, great facilities, and close proximity to all that Dubai has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Canal Central Hotel.

name.content: Souq Al Wakra Hotel Qatar by Tivoli

644229.description: Souq Al Wakra Hotel Qatar by Tivoli is a new five-star property blending artful Qatari tradition and top-end contemporary leisure in Al Wakra, an up-and-coming seaside district near central Doha. Feel perfectly at ease with a convenient and luxurious stay catering to business and leisure travellers alike. Among the finest 5-star hotels in Doha, this 101-key property is comprised of former heritage houses where original character has been splendidly preserved. Shaped by an open and expansive layout, rooms and suites feature classic thatched roofs as well as sea and sand motifs, inspired by Al Wakra's history as a pearling and fishing village. High-end amenities and personalised service complete these charming coastal havens.

name.content: TOP Retaj Salwa Resort & Spa Doha

644230.description: Set in a prime location of Doha, Vichy Célestins Spa Resort - Retaj Salwa puts everything the city has to offer just outside your doorstep. The property has everything you need for a comfortable stay. To be found at the property are free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour room service, 24-hour security, gift/souvenir shop, wheelchair accessible. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer balcony/terrace to ensure a restful night. The property's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include fitness center, sauna, outdoor pool, indoor pool, spa. Friendly staff, great facilities, and close proximity to all that Doha has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Vichy Célestins Spa Resort - Retaj Salwa.

644232.description: Mariana Hotel is located in Dubai. Offering a restaurant, the property also has a terrace. The property is 1. 7 km from Twin Towers Shopping Centre. Every room is equipped with air conditioning, and certain rooms here will provide you with a balcony. A buffet breakfast can be enjoyed at the property. Staff at the 24-hour front desk can help with advice about the area. Al Ghurair Centre is 3. 3 km from the hotel. The nearest airport is Dubai International Airport, 8 km from the property.

644234.description: Just a few meters from the Acropolis and the new museum and very close to Plaka and Syntagma Square, Acropolis Stay promises a unique accommodation experience. The hotel is located in one of the most central locations, in the heart of the historical center of Athens, thus providing easy access to all significant points of interest and sights of the city. Luxury and modernly furnished rooms, equipped with all the needed services and suitable for families as well as business travelers. Breakfast Option:Guests can choose from 9 different breakfast menus, which are offered in their room in a delivery pack. Breakfast is paid upon delivery to the room. Operation Hours:Reception is available from 08:30 in the morning to 20:30 in the evening. For arrivals after 20:30 please contact us in advance. We would like to point out that access to the rooms is available only from the stairs. Please note: luggage lift is available.

name.content: Royalton CHIC Cancun All-Inclusive - Adults Only

644442.description:
Located in Cancun (Zona Hotelera), Royalton CHIC Cancun, An Autograph Collection All-Inclusive Resort - Adults Only is within a 15-minute walk of Chac Mool Beach and Forum Beach. This upscale property is 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Cancun Convention Center and 2. 3 mi (3. 8 km) from La Isla Shopping Mall. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, a health club, and a sauna. Additional features at this property include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Make yourself at home in one of the 180 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations and flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private furnished balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Grab a bite at Gourmet Marché, one of the property's 6 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges.

name.content: Al Najada Hotel Apartments by Oaks

644470.address: Baharat Al Jufairi Street, Al Najada
644470.description:
The brand-new Al Najada Hotel Apartments by Oaks puts you right where you want to be – in the heart of Doha with all the buzz just outside your door. 

Our modern hotel apartments come with stylish essentials that'll have you settling in like you've lived here for years. Think of it as your Doha home base, but with housekeeping, delicious in-house dining and dedicated staff on hand to support you with whatever you might need.

644501.description: This charming apartment is located in Porto, offering sophisticatedly simple style throughout. Each suite features a well-equipped kitchenette. Spot Family Apartments is situated 200 meters from the historic Bolhão Market and 500 meters from the Porto Coliseum. Complimentary Wi-Fi is provided. All apartments include a fully equipped kitchenette with a dining area, dishwasher, oven, microwave, toaster, and coffee maker. The property offers a variety of one-bedroom apartments accommodating two to four guests, some featuring balconies. Nearby attractions include Paris Gallery Street, Clerigos Tower, and Ferreira Borges Market. Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is 11 km away, and the Aliados avenue and metro station are easily accessible. The central location is ideal for exploring the city's architecture, enjoying wine tastings, and wandering through the charming streets. The main square and city attractions, along with vibrant nightlife, are just a five-minute walk from the apartments. The neighborhood also boasts diverse dining options. São Bento Train Station, a 10-minute walk away, provides convenient bus connections to the beach, Casa da Música, and the Serralves Contemporary Art Museum.

644502.address: Olaya Street 7590 Wadi Al Artwi - Al Olaya
644502.description: Welcome to Centro Olaya, your smart, no-fuss, four-star base in Riyadh's buzzing Olaya district. Whether you're here for business or city adventures, everything flows with ease. Choose from 156 modern rooms and studios, all designed for comfort, connection, and space that works. Grab a bite at c. taste or something quick from c. deli - it's all made to fit your rhythm. Stay on top of your game in the gym or cool off in the rooftop pool. With flexible meeting rooms, smart amenities, and seamless service, Centro Olaya keeps things simple, stylish, and in sync with your day. From productive mornings to relaxed evenings, it's all here - ready when you are.

644508.description: Providing a shared lounge bar and free WiFi, Spot Apartments Trindade provides accommodation in Porto. The comfortable apartments come with a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with shower and free toiletries, while the kitchen has a dishwasher. An oven, a microwave and toaster are also featured, as well as a coffee machine and a kettle. The daily breakfast offers buffet and American options. Bike rental and cruise river tickets are available onsite. City Market Bolhao is 700 m from the apartment, while Oporto Coliseum is 1. 3 km away. Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is 16 km from the property. União de Freguesias do Centro is a great choice for travellers interested in architecture, city walks and wine. This property also has one of the best-rated locations in Porto!

644509.description: Located in the city center, a 7-minute walk from Trindade metro station, Spot Family Apartments provides easy access to Porto's main attractions: Clérigos Tower, the historic Old Town, Port wine cellars, and vibrant nightlife (at a comfortable, soundproof distance). Our friendly staff offers insider tips and tourist information. Built in 1935 by renowned Portuguese architect Arménio Losa, the building exemplifies the Estado Novo style, influenced by Art Deco. The recent refurbishment blends original features with modern amenities. Spacious rooms offer unique decor, key card access, large beds, and free security lockers. Guests can relax in our bar and patio, where we serve our popular dinners daily. A fully equipped kitchen is available for those who prefer to cook. The living room and media room provide additional comfort. Free internet access and Wi-Fi are available throughout the property. Our tourist corner provides information on Porto and its surroundings. Our staff is happy to offer personalized recommendations and create a custom itinerary for your stay. We also organize walking tours showcasing local hidden gems and pub crawls for experiencing Porto's nightlife.

644547.description: Nestled on the tranquil shores of Bluewaters Island, Banyan Tree Dubai offers an exquisite modern escape where serenity envelops every moment. With 500 meters of pristine, private beachfront overlooking the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Ain Dubai in the backdrop, you're only moments away from Jumeirah Beach Residences and Dubai Marina, yet it feels like you are in a world of your own. /n/nBookings over 31 December 2025 are subject to obligatory New Year's Eve Gala Dinner.

644641.description: Safestay Barcelona Sea is a charming hostel located across from Barcelona's most popular beach, just a 10-minute walk from Las Ramblas and the city center. The recently renovated building offers 4, 6, and 8-person dorms, each with a private bathroom. Enjoy a relaxing drink at the lobby bar while taking in magnificent beach and sea views. Amenities include free Wi-Fi, an optional €2 breakfast (coffee, tea, milk, juice, cereal, fruit, and toast), a tour booking point, and a lively common room with a bar, TV, and music. Linens are included, and towels are available for rent (€2). We also organize activities like walking tours and beach sports. Explore Barcelona's charming streets, from the historic Gothic Quarter, Ribera, and Raval districts to the modernist architecture of the Eixample district. Enjoy the city's vibrant atmosphere and four kilometers of beaches, seamlessly blending historical landmarks with a modern, cosmopolitan vibe. Safestay Barcelona Sea is part of the Safestay Group Hostels. Guests under 18 must stay in private rooms or dorms booked for exclusive use by their family/group; they cannot share dorms with other guests. Under-18 guests must also be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.

644661.address: Al Ohood Street, Downtown Dubai, Al Ohood
644661.description: Stay in a modern skyscraper that shares the neighbourhood with Burj Khalifa. In the history-making Downtown Dubai district, walking distance to the world's tallest building, its famous fountain and The Dubai Mall, Mövenpick Hotel Apartments Downtown Dubai offers a comfortable base near DIFC, DWTC and Business Bay. Dubai International Airport is just 20 minutes away. Among 244 units, there are deluxe rooms and serviced hotel apartments with one or two bedrooms, as well as a kitchen with a cooker, fridge, freezer, microwave, washing machine and dryer. The hotel features an international all-day restaurant, swimming pool, pool lounge, sauna and gym. There are four meeting rooms available, all flooded with natural daylight, for hosting your events in downtown Dubai.

644756.address: Rua das Portas de Santo Antao, 122-134
644756.description: The One Palácio da Anunciada, the new 5* hotel in the city, is located in the heart of historical Lisbon, a few metres from the prestigious Avenida da Liberdade and Praça dos Restauradores. The accommodation features a total of 83 rooms. The building represents the historical heritage from the year 1533, retaining all the majesty of the 16th century. You will be able to enjoy a unique experience in the most exclusive area of the City of Light: the best traditional cuisine, a wide offer of the best luxury boutiques and a enticing historical centre to discover.

644768.description:
With a stay at Apassionata Tango Hotel, you'll be centrally located in Buenos Aires, a 1-minute drive from Palace of the Argentine National Congress and 10 minutes from Plaza de Mayo.  This bed & breakfast is 1.5 mi (2.4 km) from Obelisco and 1.8 mi (2.8 km) from Teatro Colon.
Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this bed & breakfast include a picnic area, barbecue grills, and a ballroom.
Featured amenities include luggage storage, laundry facilities, and a library. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours).
Make yourself at home in one of the 8 individually decorated guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms with showers are provided. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided once per stay.

644800.description: Located in Central Station, this hostel is within 2 miles (3 km) of Corso Buenos Aires, Museo del Duomo and Corso Como. Pinacoteca di Brera and Cathedral of Milan are also within 2 miles (3 km). Milan Porta Venezia Station is only a 4-minute walk and Lima Station is 6 minutes. Along with a bar/lounge, this smoke-free hostel has a rooftop terrace and a 24-hour business centre. Breakfast at 6 euro, Towel at 2 euro and free WiFi in public areas are also provided. Other amenities include self parking, concierge services and a 24-hour front desk. All 108 rooms offer complimentary wireless Internet access, premium bedding and hairdryers.

644929.description: bastard:From fr. ant. bastart. 1. adj. That degenerates from its origin or nature. A journey does not begin at the gate, on the platform of the train, when you get into the car. It starts the moment you start to fantasize about starting it. When you're obsessively looking at a point on the map, while you're chatting on the web about a destination, consulting books, guides, chatting with other travelers or natives about that dreamed-of place, you're actually on your way. One travels for work, for pleasure, alone or in company, to discover or to lose oneself, to get to know oneself better or to connect with other people, to look at different cultures, different ways of living, different ways of looking. It also has contraindications, of course. Because as Mark Twain said, “Travel is bad for prejudice, intolerance and narrow-mindedness”. If for whatever reason your way passes through Madrid, Bastardo is your destination. We aren't a hotel, we aren't a bar, we aren't a space for creation. We are all that and a few other things. We are a meeting point for visitors and locals from Madrid in the city centre, between Malasaña and Chueca. We know that no two trips are the same. That's why we have options that adapt to all needs and budgets: private or shared rooms, for those who travel alone, for couples, for groups, for threesomes, for families, with a terrace… Always with an exquisite design and special care for small details. Patti Smith, Luis Buñuel, Divine, Emiliano Zapata, Marie Curie, Confucius, Frida Kalho… each of our rooms pays tribute to characters who have gone off the beaten path, pioneers who have had the audacity to think and live differently. Bastard attitude. So much for introductions. We'll have time to get to know each other little by little. Welcome to Bastardo. Come in without knocking.

644931.description: This comfortable hotel, built in 2019, is conveniently located in Amsterdam, within a 4. 8 km walk of the city center and numerous attractions. The hotel boasts meeting facilities ideal for business travelers, along with health and wellness amenities for relaxation. A range of dining options caters to diverse palates. Additional charges may apply to some services. The hotel adheres to government-mandated health measures; for details, please visit https://www. rivm. nl/en.

645262.description: The Fos Residential Apartments offer spacious, luxurious accommodations in the heart of Athens' historic Plaka district. Overlooking the Acropolis and surrounded by charming shops, these 5-star apartments provide an exceptional base for exploring this vibrant city, a historic crossroads of cultures.

name.content: Home2 Suites by Hilton Newark Airport

645356.description: Conveniently located just off US Route 1/9 next to Newark Liberty International Airport, Home2 Suites by Hilton Newark Airport is the perfect base for your business trip or extended stay. Just a few minutes from the eclectic Ironbound district and 15 miles from the excitement of New York City, our hotel is close to some of the area's best dining, entertainment and attractions. Unwind after a day of travel in our relaxing suites. Lounge on the comfortable bed, make meals in the kitchen with full-size appliances or watch your favorite show on the HDTV. 645621.description: Treebo Blue Moon is a newly constructed hotel located in Andheri. The hotel is a two star property with a total of 22 rooms. It is open to accommodate all sorts of travellers, whether families, corporates, or young travellers, with the provision that they have government mandated ID cards. When staying at the hotel one has access to a range of facilities that include 24x7 room service, free Wifi, laundry service via a third party that is chargeable, and complimentary buffet style vegetarian breakfast that serves South Indian and Continental cuisine. In terms of travel, the hotel is conveniently located at an 8km distance from the Andheri railway station, and 4 km from Terminal 2 Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport. The Intercity bus stand is Dadar Bus stand which is 25 km away from the hotel.

645627.address: L.G.C. 17, 1/1, Lal Bahadur Rd, Indira Nagar, Kurla West
645627.description: Located in Bombay, OYO 5171 Hotel Palace Residency is a perfect starting point from which to explore Mumbai. The property offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. To be found at the property are free Wi-Fi in all rooms, daily housekeeping, room service, free breakfast. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer mirror, towels, internet access – wireless, fan, internet access – wireless (complimentary) to ensure a restful night. The property offers various recreational opportunities. A welcoming atmosphere and excellent service are what you can expect during your stay at OYO 5171 Hotel Palace Residency.

645630.address: E4 Bhumi World, Mumbai Nashik Road
645630.description: Treebo Select Gopalas Residency in Bhiwandi, Mumbai promises a relaxing experience. An ideal place to put up at, this hotel has banquet hall on the ground floor that can accommodate 250 people and conference room on the first floor that can host 20 people. Treebo Select Gopalas Residency also boasts an in-house multi-cuisine restaurant ‘Parmeshwar Pure Veg' that allows you to order delicious food from the comfort of your room. With an in-house manicure, pedicure and facial spa, take time to relax and rejuvenate here. To ensure a pleasurable stay, complimentary vegetarian buffet breakfast with North Indian and South Indian options to choose from, free WiFi and branded toiletries are provided by Treebo Select Gopalas Residency. In terms of travelling, Kalyan Railway Station and Kalyan Bus Depot are both 9 km from this hotel while International Airport is around 35 km away.

645631.address: CTS NO. 280, Military Rd,Jijamata Nagar, Andheri E
645631.description: Golden Tulipz, Andheri East, Mumbai is situated at the prime location in the Mumbai. Suitable for the needs of Social and Corporate makes us the ideal venue for a comfortable stay of yours. Newly opening Hotel features with a new look of 34 Rooms, Deluxe Room & Suites. The Hotel also offers versatile meeting space for Social Functions, Events. Our Hotel Rooms have LED TV, Air Conditioning, Tea Coffee Maker, Centrally Air Conditioned and in room amenities.s for the facilities provided by Treebo Golden Tulipz, these include the provision of ironing boards when requested by guests, hotel security, housekeeping services and power backup. Mumbai is a beautiful city and there is much to see here. Powai Lake, Juhu Beach, Versova Beach, ISKCON Temple are within 10 km of Treebo Golden Tulipz.

645670.address: Street 74 Olaya Main street,Near Suliman El Habib, 74
645670.description: AL Diafa Apartment Olaya is conveniently located in the popular Al Olaya area. Both business travelers and tourists can enjoy the property's facilities and services. All the necessary facilities, including free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, fireplace, 24-hour front desk, are at hand. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer carpeting, slippers, flat screen television, sofa, mirror to ensure a restful night. Recuperate from a full day of sightseeing in the comfort of your room, or take advantage of the fitness center, sauna, spa. Discover all Riyadh has to offer by making AL Diafa Apartment Olaya your base.

645671.description: Jardim Viana features a total of 20 rooms. This accomodation was fully refurbished in 2020. Jardim Viana offers Wi-Fi internet connection on-site. The hotel provides 24-hour reception. Common areas are suitable for wheelchair-disabled people. This hotel is provided with all the necessary services and amenities for a successful business event.

name.content: Leva Hotel and Suites, Mazaya Centre

645708.address: Mazaya Center , Sheikh Zayed Road , Dubai
645708.description: Located in Dubai, this hotel is just a 20-minute drive from the airport and offers stunning views of the Burj Khalifa. Luxury shopping enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to the Dubai Mall, only 5 km away, with its diverse array of shops, dining, and entertainment. The hotel features a rooftop pool overlooking the city, an on-site restaurant, and meeting facilities. Spacious rooms blend vibrant design with modern details, providing a comfortable stay for the urban traveler.

645773.description: This charming hotel is located in Downtown. This accommodation offers a total of 23 accommodation units. The year of construction of this property dates back to 2016. Kabah offers Wi-Fi internet connection on-site. Kabah offers a 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. Cots are not available at Kabah. Those who dislike animals may enjoy their stay, as this property does not allow pets. Kabah provides parking for guests' convenience. This property features a variety of dining experiences. Kabah may charge a fee for some services. We offer a discount coupon in Parque Maya.

645848.description: A total of 86 guest rooms are available for guests' convenience. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection available on-site. This hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. This property does not offer cots on demand. All guest rooms at this disability-friendly hotel are wheelchair-accessible. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

645886.description: Our hotels have well-equipped meeting rooms with complimentary WiFi, natural daylight and all the equipment needed to host a successful meeting, workshop or training session. Tailor made meal and coffee & tea break packages are available to book in advance, to ensure your day runs smoothly. Layout is flexible and our largest meeting room can accommodate up to 75 people*. Delegates can enjoy our facilities such as free on-site parking, restaurant, bar and Coffee Shop *Varies by hotel

645887.description: The nearest beach is 700 meters from the hotel. The airport is 171 kilometers away. This 118-room hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi in all public areas and guest rooms. Hawadah Hotel provides a 24-hour reception for guest convenience. Cots are unfortunately unavailable. All rooms are wheelchair accessible, and on-site parking is available for an additional fee. Some services may incur extra charges.

name.content: Centara West Bay Hotel and Residences Doha

645891.description: Doha is a delightful combination of palm-lined avenues and modern architecture where the sunny desert meets the blue-green waters of the Gulf. Centara West Bay Hotel and Residences Doha is an oasis of calm in the heart of the city, only moments away from the Corniche and 25 minutes from the airport. Its sea views and wide array of rooms and facilities, including a state-of-the-art fitness centre, are designed to make it a comfortable home for business or leisure travellers on short or long visits to the Qatari capital. Beautifully spacious quarters range from spacious studios to 365-square-metre penthouses. The apartments enjoy city or sea views; even the swimming pool has a view of the Arabian Gulf. Families will appreciate the kids' club, with activities to keep young ones occupied.

645897.description:
The Marquês Garden House is a Singular House located in one of the oldest squares in the city, Praça Marquês de Pombal. 
The Guest House’s facade is filled from top to bottom with rectangular tiles typical of Porto in the 17th century. XIX. 
Upon entering, you will find ceilings worked in noble wood, friezes of vegetal tiles by Bordalo Pinheiro, stone walls and an imposing staircase, decorated with a child bust by Soares dos Reis, the great sculptor of Porto. 
Praça do Marquês was once one of the most emblematic and bustling areas of the noble city of Porto. Over the centuries, it has had different names, an example of which is Praça da Água, having also been a trading area, cultivation of agricultural land, passage of troops during the Siege of Porto. 
When staying at Marquês Garden House, you will find a garden hidden by the high facade of the building. The old walls surround a rest area, providing relaxed leisure hours in the sun, and you can even enjoy the pool on hot days. A true gem in
the center of the city.

645923.description: Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Tins Hotel City. A complimentary self-serve breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, a safe deposit box at the front desk, and an elevator. Limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 20 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Your Select Comfort bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.
