The nearest major airport is Athens Intl. Airport (ATH) - 34. 4 km / 21. 4 mi With a stay at Tins Hotel City, you'll be centrally located in Athens, within a 5-minute drive of Syntagma Square and Ermou Street. This hotel is 1. 7 mi (2. 7 km) from Acropolis and 6. 9 mi (11. 2 km) from Port of Piraeus.

645924.description: Located in the heart of Alimos, Maison 66 Riviera Hotels offers individually decorated guestrooms with private furnished balconies, minibars, and flat-screen TVs. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, cooked-to-order breakfasts (fee applies), and room service. Concierge services and multilingual staff are available at the 24-hour front desk. Alimos Beach is a short drive away, and The Ellinikon Experience Park is easily accessible. Free self-parking is available onsite.

645954.address: 36-03 Prince Street, Flushing, NY 11354, United S
645954.description: Hotel Indigo Flushing embraces the vibrant essence of Flushing, New York, blending modern luxury with a natural and inviting atmosphere. Located in downtown Flushing, our upscale hotel is conveniently close to LaGuardia and JFK Airports. Flushing is a thriving hub of cultural and commercial life, offering exotic restaurants, bakeries, cafes, and renowned chain retail stores on every block. Our hotel reflects Flushing's charm with its minimalistic architecture and lush flora. With the 7 train and Long Island Railroad Main Street station nearby, world-class destinations like Times Square, Midtown, Hudson Yards, and the Jacob Javits Convention Center are easily accessible. Immerse yourself in Flushing's captivating spirit and embark on a memorable journey with us at Hotel Indigo Flushing. We wanted to inform you that Botanica Bar & Lounge is currently closed as it transitions to a new restaurant, set to open in the summer 2025. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause during your stay. In the meantime, we invite you to indulge in our delightful Coffee Station, located in the Hotel Lobby. Treat yourself to our selection of hot breakfast sandwiches and to kickstart your day.

646042.description:
With a stay at Ver Belem Suites in Lisbon (Belem), you'll be a 1-minute drive from Jeronimos Monastery and 9 minutes from Belem Tower.  This guesthouse is 4.4 mi (7 km) from Commerce Square and 4.4 mi (7.1 km) from Se.
This smoke-free guesthouse was built in 1906.
Make yourself at home in one of the 4 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and espresso makers. LCD televisions with digital programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided once per stay.

646056.description: Located in the heart of Edinburgh, Destiny Student Holyrood - Campus Accommodation is within a 15-minute walk of Princes Street and Edinburgh Playhouse Theatre. This hostel offers 411 guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi and private bathrooms with showers. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as concierge services, a communal TV area, and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. Nearby attractions include Holyrood Park, the Scottish Parliament, and the Museum of Edinburgh, all within a short walk. The Royal Mile is 0. 8 miles away, and Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 8. 9 miles from the property.

646061.description: Enjoy a central Edinburgh stay at the Destiny Student Shrubhill hostel, a short drive from Princes Street and the Royal Mile. We offer 238 individually furnished guestrooms, a shared kitchen, complimentary Wi-Fi, and convenient amenities such as concierge services, an arcade/game room, and a common area with a TV. Bathrooms are equipped with bathtubs or showers. Nearby attractions include the Edinburgh Playhouse Theatre (0. 6 mi) and Edinburgh Castle (2 mi).

646062.description: Destiny Student Murano is a purpose build student accommodation throughout the term year. During the summer months anyone can stay with us. We offer clean, basic private double rooms with ensuite bathroom. You'll have access to a shared kitchen that is fully equipped. Reservations can also be made for private 4 or 5 bedroom apartments and a studio apartment.

646074.description: Discover centrally located a&o hotels in Europe's most vibrant cities, offering unbeatable value and convenience. Enjoy comfortable private rooms with en-suite bathrooms, fresh linens, daily housekeeping, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Take advantage of our 24/7 reception and bar, plus amenities like billiards, foosball, children's play areas, and a book exchange. Business travelers will appreciate our co-working spaces and modern meeting rooms. Our multilingual team looks forward to welcoming you!

646076.description: Situated in Truccazzano, La Locanda di Sant'Anna provides accommodation with an outdoor pool, free WiFi, free bikes and a garden. Fitted with a balcony, the units feature a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with bath. All units are air conditioned and include a seating and/or dining area. Guests at the bed and breakfast can enjoy a continental breakfast. Guests can grab a bite to eat in the on-site restaurant, which serves a variety of Italian dishes and also offers dairy-free options. La Locanda di Sant'Anna offers a sun terrace. Guests can also relax in the shared lounge area. Milan is 26 km from the accommodation, while Bergamo is 32 km away. The nearest airport is Milan Linate Airport, 18 km from the property.

646105.description: 25hours Hotel Langstrasse is located right next to Zurich's main station. Culture and lifestyle all converge on legendary Langstrasse. The designer, Werner Aisslinger, regards the hotel as a small, independent universe, inspired by the contrasts between banks and red lights, art and finance. Regularly changing artists work in and around the hotel, always ensuring new, creative input.

646155.description:
Safestay Barcelona Passeig de Gràcia is located on Barcelona's Passeig de Gràcia, 550 yards from Plaça de Catalunya. This well-equipped hostel offers breakfast, free WiFi in common areas and a guest kitchen.

The dorms and rooms are spacious and air-conditioned. Bottom linen and pillow cases are provided and lockers are available.

Facilities include bar, common room and terrace. Guests can make use of the hostel's tour desk and towel hire.

Safestay Barcelona Passeig de Gràcia is located within a few minutes' walk of Gaudí's Casa Batlló and La Pedrera. There are several restaurants, bars and shops on Passeig de Gràcia and in the surrounding area.

Passeig de Gràcia Metro station is less than 350 yards from the hostel and the famous Las Ramblas is a 10-minute walk away. 

Eixample is a great choice for travellers interested in architecture, food and shopping.

This is our guests' favourite part of Barcelona, according to independent reviews.

This property also has one of the best-rated locations in Barcelona! Guests are happier about it compared to other properties in the area.

This property is also rated for the best value in Barcelona! Guests are getting more for their money when compared to other properties in this city.

We speak your language!

646159.description:
Las viviendas turísticas de los Apartamentos Leganitos han sido especialmente diseñadas para ofrecer un remanso de paz y confort, que contrasta con su ubicación en el centro de Madrid. 

Las características de cada tipo de alojamiento los hacen ideales para cualquier tipo de viajero, adaptándose a tus gustos y necesidades. Además, Apartamentos Leganitos, gracias a su amplia gama de servicios y su atento servicio, te garantiza una estancia cómoda y sin preocupaciones.

646160.description: The Elia Ermou Athens Hotel, a 4-star establishment, is centrally located in Athens, a short walk from Syntagma Square and the Monastiraki Flea Market. Guests can enjoy on-site massages, body treatments, and facials, as well as a health club and sauna. The hotel offers 123 individually decorated rooms featuring minibars, Smart TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Dining options include a restaurant, a coffee shop/cafe, and room service (limited hours), along with a bar/lounge. A full breakfast is available on weekdays for a fee. Additional amenities comprise a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services.

646264.description: The San Marco Suite 755 offers exclusive luxury apartments in an antique Venetian palazzo, perfect for a weekend or holiday. Located just steps from Saint Mark's Square in the heart of Venice, these suites provide an immersive experience inspired by the Venetian landscape. Admire breathtaking hues mirroring the colors of the sand, lagoon, and sea, all embellished with gold pigments. Spacious rooms feature four-poster beds or large padded headboards, comfortable dormeuses, and armchairs—ideal for small families. A relaxing living area with sofas and a fully-equipped kitchenette complements the accommodations. Explore Venice's historic center and shopping hub with ease, as everything is within walking distance. Our reception staff, available daily from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm at building 755, can provide guidance. Please note that this historic Venetian building does not have an elevator, but our staff is happy to assist with luggage between 9:00 am and 5:00 pm. After booking, please contact us with an email address so we can send you the unique access code for the building.

646265.description: Located in the heart of El Born, just 3 minutes from the Palau de la Música, Ámfores Boutique Guest House offers intimate and charming guest rooms guaranteed to give you high quality comfort and an impeccable service. Originally built in 1736, the guest house occupies a gorgeous ornate building which pays homage to it's baroque heritage with original stonework and wooden beams being perfectly contrasted with modern, industrial design concepts. There are hints of neoclassicism everywhere with an exclusive antique mirror in each room hand picked and collected for many years.

646267.description:
This cosy hotel is situated in Lisboa. Safestay lisbon features a total of 23 accommodation units.
Located right in the heart of the city at the crossroads of Chiado, Bairro Alto and Restauradores neighbourhoods, Safestay Lisbon is in prime location. Our dormitory rooms range from 4 - 14 beds in size with both mixed and female only dorms along with a range of smaller private rooms.

646435.description: Hostal Estrella is located less than 10 minutes' walk from Madrid's Royal Palace and Puerta del Sol, right next to Gran Vía. It offers modern rooms with free Wi-Fi and a flat-screen TV. Rooms at the Estrella feature parquet floors and smart décor. The private bathrooms include a hairdryer. Staff at reception can provide information about what to see and do in Madrid. There is also a luggage storage facility at the front desk. The lively Chueca district is around 10 minutes' walk from the Estrella. Located 2 minutes' walk away, Callao Metro Station connects you with the rest of the city.

646437.description: Leonardo Royal Hotel Venice Mestre is located in a modern 11-story building next to Venezia Mestre railway station, just 10 minutes by car or public transport from the historical center of Venice. All 243 rooms are equipped with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs with satellite channels and high-quality amenities. The hotel offers a varied breakfast buffet and International cuisine is served at the Vitruv restaurant for lunch and dinner. For meetings & events, 225 square meters of meeting space are available as well as 3 light-flooded meeting rooms up to 165 participants. The hotel also has a terrace and a fitness room.

646449.description: Located in San Polo, this hotel is steps away from Rialto Bridge and Grand Canal. A rooftop terrace, 24-hour room service and a 24-hour front desk are available at this smoke-free hotel. Free buffet breakfast and free WiFi in public areas are also provided. Other amenities include express check-in and express check-out. All 17 soundproofed rooms feature free WiFi and Select Comfort beds. Comforts include Frette Italian sheets and down comforters, and guests will also appreciate thoughtful touches such as bathrobes and slippers.

646487.description: This accomodation offers a total of 20 accomodation units. The apartment was built in 2017. The establishment offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. This apartment offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. The premises offer accessible public areas. All guests staying at this property can easily get to the airport thanks to the shuttle service available. The apartment may charge a fee for some services.

646488.description: The Extended Suites Cancun Cumbres, built in 2019, offers 123 comfortable suites near the airport. Each suite features one or two queen-sized beds, a kitchen with a refrigerator and microwave, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Weekly housekeeping includes dusting, vacuuming, trash removal, and bathroom and kitchen cleaning. Daily housekeeping is available for a fee. Please note that kitchenware is currently unavailable, and the gym and pool have capacity restrictions. Inquire at check-in for details.

646547.description: ​Surrounded by the non-stop, neon-fueled energy of Times Square and the 24-hour allure of Manhattan nightlife, Pod Times Square Hotel offers a relaxing and affordable place to plant your flag in NYC. Our location on a quiet corner in Hell's Kitchen, along with soundproof windows to drown out the sounds of the city, means you'll forget you're just steps from the action when you're unwinding in your room. Broadway shows, Madam Tussauds, and exciting restaurants are seconds away. More laid-back urban adventures like strolling and biking through tranquil Hudson River Park, kayaking on the Hudson, the High Line, and Circle Line Cruises, are just as accessible. Experience it all without spending it all at Pod Times Square Hotel – the best value in Times Square.

646802.description: This unpretentious apartment is situated in Salamanca-Serrano. A total of 16 bedrooms are available for guests' convenience. Internet connection (wired and wireless) is provided in common areas for those needing to keep connected. Customers are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. This establishment's common areas are disability-friendly. Not only small pets are allowed on the premises, but also the large ones. Moreover, those travelling by car may make good use of the parking facilities.

646813.description: Situated a 20-minute drive from Porto's city center, Vila Foz Hotel & Spa offers, a Michelin Key awarded Hotel, breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean from its prime location on the Foz sidewalk. This palatial hotel features a striking exterior and an interior brimming with inspiring details, designed by the internationally acclaimed Nini Andrade Silva. The hotel's proximity to beaches and the expansive City Park gardens creates a tranquil atmosphere, perfect for relaxation and rejuvenation. The 62 rooms and suites seamlessly blend history, modernism, and coastal elements, boasting sophisticated design and majestic architecture. Nestled within magnificent gardens, guests can enjoy the tranquil sounds and scents of the landscape while experiencing a range of unique services focused on therapeutic benefits. The hotel's classic architecture provides an elegant backdrop for exceptional dining experiences at the Michelin-starred Vila Foz Restaurant and the Flor de Lis Restaurant, both offering curated menus and exquisite wine selections.

646816.description: The Caléway Charm Hotel, a beautifully converted historic building with an annex, is nestled in a secluded garden in the heart of Vila Nova de Gaia's historic Port Wine Caves district. Just a two-minute walk from the Douro Riverfront and its stunning views of Porto, the hotel is surrounded by traditional restaurants, bars, and shops. The iconic Luís I Bridge provides easy access to Porto. For further exploration, the Gaia Cable Car is 1. 1 km from the property, Arrábida Shopping Mall is 4. 2 km away, and El Corte Inglés is 1. 9 km away.

647228.description: Boudl Quraish is situated in the Al Salamah district of Jeddah, 5 km from Mall of Arabia. Complimentary WiFi is featured. The air-conditioned units have a fully equipped kitchen with a microwave and a fridge. A stovetop and kettle are also available. The aparthotel offers an outdoor pool. There is also a business centre and a children's playground on site. Boudl Quraish provides a sun terrace. Jeddah Mall is 7 km from the accommodation, while Red Sea Mall is 9 km from the property. The nearest airport is King Abdulaziz International Airport, 10 km from the property.

647231.address: Shaikh Jaber Al Sabah Street, Al Khaleej, S/N
647231.description: Ideally located in the prime tourist area of An Nahdah, Boudl Gaber promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. Guests will enjoy a comfortable stay with a full range of amenities, including free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, a 24-hour front desk, Wi-Fi in public areas, and on-site parking. Each guest room is elegantly furnished and equipped with convenient amenities. The hotel also offers various recreational opportunities. Expect a welcoming atmosphere and excellent service during your stay at Boudl Gaber.

647291.description:
Hotel Pontsteiger is housed in a spectacular architectural landmark overlooking the IJ River, in Amsterdam’s Houthavens district. 

This waterfront boutique hotel offers 27 rooms decorated with exclusive artworks and a contemporary edge. A spacious 30‑meter‑wide pier leads you to our destination, where industrial elements, Scandinavian design, and warm materials blend effortlessly. 

Guests can unwind at Café Pontsteiger, our all-day lounge with a sunny terrace and panoramic river views. 

With private parking and a dedicated boat landing stage, arriving is easy, by car or by water. Close to Anne Frank’s House and Amsterdam Central Station, Hotel Pontsteiger is your peaceful base for exploring the city.

647295.description: More than just a stay, Unique Garden is an immersive experience celebrating the senses. Located near a preserved area of the Atlantic Forest in Mairiporã, this hotel and spa offer a unique way to connect with nature in a comfortable, private, and contemplative setting. It's a haven for the body and soul, conveniently located near São Paulo yet far from its daily hustle.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Jersey City - Holland Tunnel

647440.description: The brand-new Holiday Inn Express & Suites Jersey City - Holland Tunnel offers an affordable alternative to Manhattan hotels, just a mile from downtown. Conveniently located in downtown Jersey City, our hotel is easily accessible from Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR), the New Jersey Turnpike, and other major routes. Explore nearby attractions, restaurants, theaters, and shops, all within walking distance. Enjoy outdoor recreation at Liberty State Park, catch events at MetLife Stadium, or browse the boutiques of SoHo. Easy access to subways and water taxis simplifies exploring New York City and Jersey City. Amenities include a fitness center, free Wi-Fi, a business center, and our complimentary Express Start breakfast bar. Stay Smart at the Holiday Inn Express & Suites Jersey City – Holland Tunnel.

647465.description: This comfortable hotel can be found in Miraflores. Features a total of 87 rooms. Wired and wireless internet connections are available at HOTEL GRAND NOBILITY. HOTEL GRAND NOBILITY offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. Communal areas are wheelchair accessible at this property. HOTEL GRAND NOBILITY is not a pet-friendly establishment. Guests will also appreciate the car park and garage.

647664.description: Located on Venice's Grand Canal, just steps from the Rialto Bridge, the H10 Palazzo Canova is a newly renovated four-star superior hotel. Housed in a beautifully restored 19th-century building, the hotel retains its original architecture while incorporating contemporary design elements. The interior pays homage to Venice, using traditional materials like Murano glass and Venetian textiles. Guests enjoy elegant rooms, a breakfast restaurant, and a rooftop terrace bar with spectacular Grand Canal views.

name.content: Holiday Inn - the niu, Hide Berlin Friedrichshain

647694.description: With its extraordinary location in Berlin-Lichtenberg, the Holiday Inn - the niu Hide, Berlin Friedrichshain embodies the unique lifestyle of the German capital. As the world's first modular hotel built atop a shopping center, it offers a distinctive design, blending retro interiors with Scandinavian flair and vibrant graffiti by the artist duo Gigi Amando. This urban hideaway caters to both city vacationers and digital nomads. The rooms feature amenities such as smart TVs, integrated sound systems, and air conditioning. Baby cots and extra beds are available upon request. Business travelers will appreciate the desks, safes, and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. The heart of the hotel is the Living Lobby, a vibrant co-working space with a 24-hour bar, food service, and reception. Guests can work, relax, and connect with fellow travelers. Start your day with our delicious breakfast buffet.

name.content: Holiday Inn - the niu, Dairy Haarlem

647695.description: Our hotel, inspired by its location on the site of a former dairy factory, incorporates playful agricultural themes throughout its design, from cow-print armchairs to milk-bottle lamps. Located in Haarlem's Zijlsingel district, known for its vibrant alternative music scene and the Patronaat Concert Hall, the Holiday Inn - niu Dairy Haarlem embraces this musical heritage. The Living Lobby showcases local musicians with displayed records and photographs, while guest rooms offer smart amenities such as large flat-screen TVs, USB ports, and free high-speed Wi-Fi. Bathrooms feature playful and informative artwork depicting local sights and landmarks.

name.content: Holiday Inn - the niu, Franz Vienna

647699.description: Live beautifully and experience Vienna. On the one hand, our Holiday Inn - the niu, Franz Vienna puts you in the romantic mood of 'Sisi and Franz', on the other hand, it reflects the vivid life of modern Vienna. Perfectly connected and close to the city, the hotel is ideal for exploring the Austrian capital in all its facets. Enjoy the cool imperial ambience in the Living Lobby, take a seat at the 24-hour bar which also offers snacks and take pleasure in the contemporary technology: USB ports, free high-speed WiFi and plenty of power outlets. Business travelers in particular will appreciate this. Hotel service also includes a 24-hour reception desk where you can ask for advice and ticket reservations. The sauna, the summer garden and the parking garage (for a fee) round off the services on offer.

647781.description: Located in central Milan, Guest House Minas offers simple accommodation with luggage storage. The property is a 5-minute walk from a tram stop which takes you to Milan Cathedral and to Corso Vittorio Emanuele shopping area. Featuring free WiFi, rooms come with air conditioning or a cooling fan. Some rooms are en suite, while others share a bathroom. Guest House Minas is located in an area full of shops, restaurants and cafes. A tram that stops 500 m from the property takes you to Milan Central Station and the Navigli canals. Milan Linate Airport is 7 km away. FEEL AT HOME: Heating, Family rooms; Daily housekeeping; Rooms with private bathroom with shower; Rooms with shared bathroom with ; shower; Flat-panel TV; Room service (limited hours)

648168.description: The strenght is to be found in serenity. Visit the Old Monastery in Hainburg and treat yourself to a break from everyday life. The 17th-century building is a stylish 4-star hotel that combines modernity and tradition in a special way. The solid walls and cross vaults on the one hand, the modern furnishings of the rooms and the recreation area on the other hand create a harmonious overall picture. Seminar hotel for events in ViennaWe are also gladly booked as a seminar hotel for events in Vienna and surroundings and offer our guests three highly technical meeting rooms. Even if you want to explore the capital of Austria, our design hotel is an excellent address, because we are only about 50 kilometers away from Vienna. Our hotel is the right refuge for your sightseeing tour to Vienna or Bratislava. No matter whether you are looking for a seminar room in the Vienna area or want to spend a relaxing holiday in the monastery, the stay in our hotel will be an unforgettable experience.

648169.description: Only 130 m from the Archaeological Park Carnuntum, the Hotel Marc Aurel is located in the village of Petronell. It features a restaurant with a garden terrace and free Wi-Fi. Lake Neusiedl is 12 km away, while the Outlet Center Parndorf is 10 km from the property. The rooms feature elegant, historic-style furniture, parquet flooring and a satellite TV. All rooms have a private bathroom. Petronell Castle is a 5-minute walk away. The Hotel Marc Aurel is also a convenient base for excursions in the Donau-Auen National Park and for trips on the Römerradweg, Weinradweg and Neusiedlerseeradweg bike paths. The Neusiedl Family Park is 30 km away. Cars can be parked for free on site and there is a separate storage room for bicycles. This property also has one of the best-rated locations in Petronell! Guests are happier about it compared to other properties in the area.

648247.description: The Rossio Boutique Hotel is located in Lisbon's historic center, just steps from Rossio Square. From this prime location, you can easily explore the city's charms on foot, with neighborhoods like Baixa, Chiado, Principe Real, Bairro Alto, and Avenida da Liberdade within a short walk. Nearby, you'll also find famous squares, viewpoints, and a selection of excellent restaurants. The hotel is conveniently located near several metro stations, including Rossio (30 seconds away), Restauradores, and Martin Moniz (less than a minute's walk). Originally built in the early 1900s, the building was fully renovated in 2018, offering guests a superb stay in a prime location.

648248.description: This comfortable hotel is located in Lisbon's city center on Rua Augusta, one of the city's most iconic streets. My Story Hotel Charming Augusta, built in 2018, offers 46 rooms, allowing guests to stay in the heart of the Portuguese capital within walking distance of major attractions and activities.

648282.description: The property features a total of 18 accomodation units. Visitors may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection throughout. Grosvenor Suites Edinburgh does not offer 24-hour reception.

648285.description: Everyone staying at this accommodation will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Royal Princes Suites as it counts with a total of 15 accomodation units.

name.content: Lisbon City Apartments & Suites by City Hotels

648343.description: Lisbon City Apartments & Suites offers convenient accommodations a short walk from the Anjos and Intendente metro stations, placing you just a 10-minute drive from Lisbon's vibrant city center. Choose from modern apartments and rooms, each equipped with free Wi-Fi, a private bathroom, air conditioning, a safe, and a flat-screen TV with cable channels. Please note that check-in/check-out takes place at our sister property, Lisbon City Hotel, located just steps away at Av. Almirante Reis, 49. Check-in begins at 3:00 PM. Guests are required to present identification and a credit/debit card for the security deposit upon arrival. A city tax of €2 per person, per night is also payable at check-in. Luggage storage is available at Lisbon City Hotel should you arrive early.

648398.description: The Dusit Doha Hotel, located in West Bay near the breezy Doha Corniche, offers a blend of luxury and modern comfort. A short walk from the Qatar Convention Center and a 20-minute drive from Hamad International Airport, this hotel features 357 guest rooms, suites, and apartments. Each accommodation is designed to maximize natural light, creating a relaxed ambiance. Guests can also enjoy four fine-dining options, including a rooftop lounge and bar. For the property's cleanliness policy, please visit the hotel's page on Preferredhotels. com.

648497.description: With a stay at In Barcelos Hostel & Guest House in Barcelos (Barcelos Parish), you'll be steps from Museu de Olaria and 3 minutes by foot from Archaeological Museum. This spa hostel is 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Templo do Bom Jesus da Cruz and 9. 2 mi (14. 7 km) from Monumento Homem do Mar. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. Additional amenities at this hostel include complimentary wireless Internet access, a television in a common area, and tour/ticket assistance. Featured amenities include luggage storage, laundry facilities, and microwave in a common area. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 25 guestrooms. Prepare your meals in the shared/communal kitchen. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers.

648511.description: Riad Ramz is a small haven of peace, ideal for a pleasant stay in Marrakech. Located in one of Marrakech's most famous districts, near Dar Bacha Palace and a short walk from Jemaa El-Fnaa square, this guesthouse makes all the wonders of Marrakech accessible on foot. The riad is also accessible by car, with parking nearby. Offering six rooms of various categories, it can accommodate up to 15 guests. Each room features a private bathroom with a hairdryer and complimentary toiletries, reversible air conditioning, satellite TV, free Wi-Fi, and on-demand dining service. The staff at Riad Ramz are available 24/7 to ensure an unforgettable stay.

648686.description: L'Oliveraie de l'Atlas, located 20 minutes from Marrakech, offers a tranquil escape in the 'Red City. ' Nestled within an 8-hectare olive grove, our hotel provides a refined and welcoming atmosphere. The architecture blends the charm of traditional riads and villas with modern comforts. The estate features two villas, two riads, three pools, a jacuzzi, and a restaurant. Guests can also enjoy a range of wellness services, including massages, a hammam, and a sauna, ensuring a truly relaxing stay.

648710.description: Melrose Hotel is located in Amsterdam, within 700 m of Anne Frank House and 700 m of Leidseplein. Featuring a shared lounge, the 3-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. Set in the Amsterdam City Centre district, the hotel is within less than 1 km of Royal Palace Amsterdam. The units in the hotel are fitted with a flat-screen TV with cable channels. Melrose Hotel offers some rooms with city views, and every room has a kettle. The rooms feature a desk. A continental breakfast is served each morning at the property. Speaking English and Dutch at the reception, staff are always at hand to help. Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Flower Market, Dam Square and Rijksmuseum. The nearest airport is Schiphol Airport, 10 km from Melrose Hotel. Amsterdam City Centre is a great choice for travellers interested in nightlife, architecture and walking. This is our guests' favourite part of Amsterdam, according to independent reviews.

648722.description: This charming hotel is located in Petropolis and offers 38 cozy units. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi access throughout the property, including all public areas and bedrooms. A 24-hour reception desk ensures convenience. While cots are not available, the hotel is committed to environmental sustainability and holds relevant certifications. Some services may incur a fee. Please note that the hotel elevator is temporarily unavailable due to renovations.

648740.address: Sheikh Zayed Road Opposite Innovation Hub Dubai Me
648740.description: Located in the heart of Dubai Media & Internet City - a vibrant business district - and close to the emblematic Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina district, our 5-star hotel is perfect for business or leisure travellers seeking to realize opportunity. Inspired by Middle-Eastern culture, the 5-Star property boasts 235 sophisticated and spacious rooms and suites, a state-of-the-art convention centre with 9 flexible meeting rooms & 600 sqm ballroom, an outdoor pool, and five intimate restaurants, lounges & bars.

name.content: FAM Living - Mada Residences Downtown Dubai

648861.address: Al Asayel Street, Burj Khalifa District, Downtown
648861.description: Located in Dubai's vibrant Downtown district, FAM Living - Mada Residences offers accommodations with free WiFi. The Dubai Fountain and Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo are within a short distance, and Dubai International Airport is conveniently located 15 km away. This property is highly rated for its prime location and excellent value, making it a popular choice for travelers interested in shopping, luxury brands, and diverse dining experiences.

name.content: Stella Di Mare Dubai Marina Hotel.

648862.description: Our exquisite Dubai property is the one place that will meet all your needs, whether you're visiting for business or leisure. The 369 rooms are decorated in Art Deco style and are designed to accommodate your every requirement. Stella Di Mare guarantees the highest level of personalised services in order to ensure you are always left with unforgettable memories.

648863.address: ROLLA STREET, BUR DUBAI OPP. BAQER AL MOHEIBI
648863.description: Jacob's Garden, a modern 4-star hotel in Dubai's vibrant Bur Dubai district, offers warm hospitality, comfortable accommodations, and delicious dining at an affordable price. This seven-story hotel features 145 guest rooms and convenient access to the metro, shopping malls, and Sheikh Zayed Road. Located on Rolla Street, it's a short 10-minute drive to Dubai World Trade Centre and only 10 km from the airport.

648900.description: Discover our new luxury studios & apartments in Dubai Business BayConveniently located in the heart of Business Bay with easy access to both International Airports and Downtown Dubai, this luxury serviced residence complex comprises studios, and one, two and three bedrooms apartments which are the largest in the area. Studios average size is 50 sqm, 1 Bedroom Apartments 70 sqm, 2 Bedrooms Apartments 110 sqm, 3 bedrooms 175 sqm, and 244 sqm 3 bedrooms duplex apartments are also available. The residence is ideally located for business and leisure guests alike, only minutes away from The World Trade Center, the Dubai Mall, the Fountains, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Opera as well as within easy reach of the beaches of Palm Jumeirah and all entertainment and business areas.

648902.address: 7001 Eastern Ring Road – Al Jazirah District, Eastern
648902.description: This outstanding hotel in Riyadh offers two dining options: enjoy a meal at one of the hotel's restaurants or grab a coffee at the Bistro Café. A complimentary breakfast is served each morning at MeNa Restaurant. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available in public areas. The hotel also features six meeting rooms and a 24-hour airport shuttle service (surcharge applies). Additional services include concierge services, dry cleaning/laundry services (limited hours), and 24-hour in-room dining.

648998.description: Newly opened in 2018, this modern hotel in central Berlin is within a 5-10 minute walk from the Potsdamer Platz square. It offers bright, stylish rooms and very good transport connections. Quentin XL Potsdamer Platz hotel is a short walking distance from the popular shopping, business and tourist attractions district surrounding Potsdamer Platz square. A bus stop is in front of the hotel. Underground and S-Bahn train links just a 5-minute walk from the hotel help you explore the rest of the city . Featuring elegant modern furnishings throughout, all air-conditioned rooms come with a Smart LED TV and a private bathroom fitted with a rain shower, a hairdryer and free toiletries. WiFi is provided free of charge for guests in all rooms and public areas. A breakfast buffet is served each morning. Berlin Tegel Airport is 5 mi from Quentin XL Potsdamer Platz. Schönefeld Airport is 15 min away. Mitte is a great choice for travelers interested in history, museums and architecture. The gym is open from 5 am to 11 pm. Due to coronavirus (Covid-19), additional health & safety and sanitation measures are currently in effect at this property. Free parking is offered for stays until 30th December 2020. Please note that previous reservation is needed.

649005.description: The 3-star Hotel Margherita offers 55 recently renovated rooms, many with sea views, at affordable prices. Guests particularly appreciate the warm, family atmosphere created by the elegant yet comfortable furnishings. The professional staff provides high-quality service, ensuring a memorable family vacation. Relax and unwind at our welcoming hotel, conveniently located just steps from the vibrant Via Bafile, in the central-eastern part of Jesolo Lido, near the tourist port. We are only 50 meters from the Adriatic Sea and 100 meters from Aqualandia, Italy's top water park. Public transport provides easy access to Venice and the Lagoon islands.

649023.description: The Citymax Hotel Al Barsha is conveniently located in Dubai's Al Barsha district, just a two-minute walk from the Mall of the Emirates. It's a 22-minute drive from Dubai International Airport and 30 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. This modern hotel offers 120 contemporary guest rooms, each equipped with free WiFi. Dining options include the CityCafe, a 24-hour Lavazza coffee shop, the Aqua Pool Bar, and Stag Bar. Guests can unwind by the rooftop pool, stay fit in the state-of-the-art gym, or take advantage of the complimentary shuttle to the beach. Whether traveling for business or leisure, the Citymax provides a fun, cost-effective stay.

649134.description: This cozy boutique hotel, B in Lisbon Downtown Suites, is located in downtown Lisbon. Renovated in 2018, this intimate 12-room accommodation offers a tranquil retreat. Guests enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and self check-in/check-out services. Each air-conditioned room features one or two bathrooms stocked with toiletries and a hairdryer, along with a flat-screen TV, coffee/tea facilities, a safe, and a minibar. Guests staying three or more nights receive a complimentary cheese board and a bottle of wine. For inquiries, please contact B in Lisbon Downtown Suites after booking via email at info@binblisbonsuites. pt or by phone at +351 962067603.

649432.description: Welcome to Casual Belle Epoque Lisboa, a beautiful themed hotel in which youwill be able to enjoy an environment of freedom which defined the time. Inspiredin one of the most suggestive stages of history, the decoration of each of itsstays and room is inspired in the style and topics of the Belle Époque. All roomsare different, so we encourage you to discover each and every one of its details. Come and Live your Belle Époque!

649481.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at L&H La Latina, a centrally located aparthotel in the heart of Madrid. A short walk from Plaza Mayor and the Royal Palace, this property offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, a 24-hour front desk, and tour/ticket assistance. The 49 air-conditioned rooms feature kitchenettes equipped with full-sized refrigerators, stovetops, microwaves, and coffee/tea makers. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge, and self-parking is also offered (subject to charges). Explore nearby attractions including Plaza de España, San Miguel Market, and El Rastro.

649553.description: Enjoy a refreshing dip in the indoor pool, unwind in the sauna, or energize in the 24-hour fitness center at the Moxy Amsterdam Houthavens. This modern hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a communal living room, and tour/ticket assistance. Savor a meal at the onsite restaurant and end your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fee applies). The hotel also features a business center and offers express check-in/check-out. For events, there's 272 square meters of conference space and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). The 120 guestrooms feature Smart TVs, digital programming, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Each room includes a separate sitting area and an electric kettle. Housekeeping is provided on request. Located near Westergasfabriek Culture Park (1. 5 mi), the hotel is also convenient to several Amsterdam attractions, including the Anne Frank House and the Herengracht Canal. The preferred airport is Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS), 11. 7 mi from the hotel.

649609.description: Located within 701m of Dutch National Opera & Ballet and a 9-minute walk of Carre Theater, Quentin Zoo hotel offers rooms with air conditioning and a private bathroom in Amsterdam. The hotel is set a short distance from attractions such as Rembrandtplein. All rooms are fitted with a flat-screen TV, a laptop-size safe and include a desk. Some are fitted with a kitchenette with a fridge. Some of the Double Deluxe and Quadruple Standard rooms have a shared terrace. Quadruple rooms feature two interleading rooms or one large room. Due to Covid-19, additional health & safety measures are currently in effect at this property. Reception is open daily until 23. 00h and we will be happy to help you if you need any additional services, facilities or information about Amsterdam. We currently offer a special breakfast served at 'Café Koosje', a café next to the hotel, between 09:00h and 12:00h.

649650.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Postillion Hotel Amsterdam, conveniently located near the Ziggo Dome, RAI Exhibition and Congress Centre, and Johan Cruyff Arena. The hotel offers 252 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with an iPad, flat-screen TV, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Guests can take advantage of the hotel's fitness center, bicycle rentals, and on-site restaurant and bar, Cooper & Cecile, with 24-hour room service also available. A buffet breakfast is served daily for a fee. For business travelers, the hotel boasts a conference center and 32 meeting rooms, totaling over 10, 000 square feet of event space. Other amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and self-parking (subject to charges).

649721.address: Saray Mah 912 Sok No 6 Alanya / Antalya, 912
649721.description: The Kleopatra Suit Hotel blends charm and elegance with modern architecture, design, and comfort, promising a tranquil Mediterranean holiday experience. Located in Alanya's Damlataş district, the hotel is nestled between the Taurus Mountains and the Mediterranean Sea, offering a peaceful retreat within easy reach of the city's attractions. Our hotel is just 100 meters from a popular Mediterranean beach and 700 meters from the town center. Nearby attractions include the cultural center, playground, Damlataş Cave, Aqua Park, and basketball and tennis courts. Our rooms are designed for maximum comfort, accommodating 2-3 guests (children under 12 not permitted). Each room features decorative ceramic flooring, while kitchens and bathrooms have ceramic and marble finishes. Some bathrooms offer a traditional Turkish bath experience. Amenities include a fully equipped kitchen, LCD TV, air conditioning (two units in one-bedroom apartments), a built-in cooker, fridge, telephone, hairdryer, and safe. All rooms have a comfortable double bed and a corner sofa bed. Enjoy a variety of dining options, including an open buffet breakfast (€7 per person), and à la carte lunch and dinner. Savor the special flavors of Turkish and international cuisine, complemented by a selection of local and international alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, cocktails, and wines. The hotel is conveniently located 45 km from Gazipaşa Airport and 125 km from Antalya Airport.

649811.description: Located in the heart of Dubai Science Park in Al Barsha, The S Hotel offers a stylish, contemporary retreat for discerning travelers. Combining sophisticated design with Emirati heritage, the hotel provides an inviting, intimate ambiance through personalized service—a place where Middle Eastern charm meets splendid hospitality. With 246 rooms and 12 suites, three distinctly themed restaurants, and a world-class spa, The S Hotel is conveniently located near prominent business districts, top attractions, and the airport, making it the perfect address for business or leisure.

649862.description: The Moxy Edinburgh Airport, an eco-certified hotel located in Ingliston, Newbridge, offers convenient access to Edinburgh Airport (EDI), just 0. 9 miles away. Enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant, a quick bite at the snack bar/deli, or a refreshing drink at the bar/lounge. Stay fit in the fitness center and take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel features 230 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, desks, and electric kettles. Bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Continental breakfast is available daily (for a fee). For business travelers, a 24-hour business center and express check-in/out services are provided. The hotel also offers two meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Edinburgh Zoo and Princes Street are within a 15-minute drive, while George Street and Grassmarket are approximately 7 miles away. Several attractions, including the Royal Highland Centre, Edinburgh Park, and Gyle Shopping Centre, are also nearby.

649963.description: Travellers will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay on the premises, as it counts with a total of 6units. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Bcharming House does not offer 24-hour reception. This accomodation is wheelchair-accessible. There is -1 disability-friendly accomodation unit available on the premises. There is a car park. There is an airport transfer service for guests' convenience. Additional fees may apply for some services.

649970.description: Nestled beside a beautiful park on the edge of Amsterdam, the Radisson Hotel and Suites Amsterdam South offers a tranquil escape while remaining conveniently connected to the city's vibrant heart. Explore nearby canals and the Middelpolder wildlife area, or easily access the Zuidas business district and Schiphol Airport. A short tram or train ride will take you to Amsterdam Central Station, and secure private parking is available for those driving. Ideal for families and extended stays, the hotel features rooms and suites equipped with kitchenettes. A unique selection of bath styles is also available in some suites. For added convenience, guests can utilize the laundry services and the 24/7 Grab and Go market. Maintain your fitness routine in our well-equipped fitness center, and enjoy delicious meals at Keuken and Bar Home Cuisine, our on-site restaurant and bar. The dining area comfortably seats 150 guests, while a separate area can accommodate up to 45 guests for a stand-up reception.

649971.description: Sustainably enjoy breathtaking luxury Experience space and peace in the Zaan Hotel Amsterdam ZaandamEnjoy lasting peace and luxury in the Zaanse style! The Zaan Hotel in Zaandam is only a 12-minute train ride away from the center of Amsterdam. This is ideal for travelers who want to combine a visit to Amsterdam with the Zaanse Schans. We also offer optimal arrangements for business travelers as well. The architecture is an ode to the “Zaanse” building style and the luxurious rooms have a contemporary design, offering every comfort and modern convenience that a traveler could wish for. Our organic (fair trade) and extensive breakfast buffet is dearly beloved by our guests and ensures a great start to your day! Moreover, the Zaan Hotel has a super-fast fiberoptic Internet connection free of charge.

649972.description: Experience space and tranquility at the Amsterdam Forest Hotel, a luxurious escape nestled on the edge of the Amsterdam Forest, yet just a stone's throw from Amsterdam's vibrant city center. Our contemporary rooms offer every comfort and modern convenience for today's traveler, including a lavish organic (and fair-trade) breakfast buffet, a favorite among our guests. Discover more of what awaits you at the Amsterdam Forest Hotel.

650062.description: This charming apartment can be found in Athens.

650165.description: Welcome to the new Hampton by Hilton Edinburgh Airport, conveniently located within walking distance of the main terminal. You’ll find the best shopping, restaurants, as well as the city's cultural and historical attractions including Edinburgh Castle, Murrayfield Stadium and Edinburgh Zoo, just 20 minutes via bus or tram. Travelers of all types will appreciate our proximity to the EICC for conventions. Stay in a contemporary guest room with free WiFi, a flat-screen HDTV, an in-room coffeemaker, an ergonomic work desk and a comfy bed. Work out in the hotel’s onsite fitness center with a range of cardio machines. Start each day with Hampton’s included hot breakfast and enjoy a drink at the bar, open 24 hours a day. Take advantage of useful services and amenities at this Edinburgh hotel including a free 24-hour business center, a small gym and a casual dining area.

650201.description: Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a communal living room, and tour/ticket assistance. You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Residence Inn by Marriott Amsterdam Houthavens, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 60 guestrooms, featuring kitchens with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and ovens. 43-inch Smart televisions with digital programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

650331.description: Uniting a stunning blend of 18th-century grandeur with the raw industrial edge of central Cape Town, Gorgeous George is a bold testament to both South African and international design, with an unapologetically urban style and attitude in a destination known for its seaside hotels. Formed from two buildings that were connected in the 1940s—one Art Deco, the other New Edwardian—the 20-room, 12-suite hotel unifies the two styles through an exquisite use of concrete and steel, as well as through Victorian elements, contemporary design, and African influences. One enters the hotel through historic brass doors and is immediately immersed in a world of hand-painted, 1800 Delft-inspired ceramic tiles portraying a map of Cape Town. In the guestrooms, a color palette of blues, whites, and mountainside greens serve in stark contrast to the hotel's industrial undertones. The rooftop, meanwhile, with its welcoming terrace and pool, is a green oasis where one is surrounded by the sounds of the city. Taken together, two heritage buildings form a one-of-a-kind hotel smack in the center of town. And the result is, well, simply Gorgeous!

650334.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages or enjoy recreation amenities such as an outdoor pool. This guesthouse also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the guesthouse's room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 8 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and espresso makers. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and bathrobes. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. The nearest major airport is Cape Town Intl. Airport (CPT) - 23. 2 km / 14. 4 mi A stay at Harpers House places you in the heart of Cape Town, within a 5-minute drive of Cape Town Stadium and Long Street. This upscale guesthouse is 1. 4 mi (2. 2 km) from Two Oceans Aquarium and 3. 8 mi (6. 1 km) from Clifton Bay Beach.

650663.description: The new Green Park Hotel in Cavallino Treporti offers a convenient location just steps from Venice. Its 29 newly built rooms and suites feature an elegant, minimalist design in warm wood tones and are equipped with modern amenities. The hotel's restaurant serves classic Italian cuisine alongside a selection of healthy vegetarian options. Special attention is given to dietary requirements with gluten-free and lactose-free products available at breakfast. During the summer months, guests can relax on the hotel's private beach. The Green Park Hotel is fully accessible.

650664.description: Cavallino Camping Village, located in Cavallino Treporti, offers a seaside escape with an endless beach. Enjoy the on-site water park featuring a wellness pool and exhilarating water slides. The Village also boasts gourmet spaces, pizzeria restaurants, a panoramic lounge bar, an ice cream shop, and a planned spa. Pet-friendly accommodations and a minimarket are also available. Choose from a variety of mobile homes, each offering the same high-quality standard in various sizes and prices. Venice is just a 30-minute boat ride away.

651072.description: The Edgbaston Park Hotel and Conference Centre offers plentiful free parking and easy access to main roads, including the University train station. Situated within the leafy surroundings of Edgbaston, adjacent to the University of Birmingham campus, it provides a convenient location for both business and leisure travelers. For details on the hotel's cleanliness policy, please visit the property page on Preferredhotels. com.

651104.description: The accomodation comprises a total of 32 snug guest rooms. This hotel was constructed in 2019. Wi-Fi internet connection is available for further comfort and convenience. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. Castelo Hotel does not offer cots on demand. Common areas are suitable for wheelchair-disabled people. Visitors arriving by car may leave their vehicle at the accommodation's parking spaces. There are business facilities and services for guests' added convenience. Castelo Hotel may charge a fee for some services.

651235.description: Welcome to Hotel Indigo Dubai Downtown, your gateway to the vibrant heart of Dubai. Conveniently located between the bustling Design District and the iconic Dubai Mall, our boutique hotel is just a 5-minute stroll from retail heaven. As you step inside, you'll be immersed in decades of culture, reflected in our thoughtfully designed rooms adorned with opulent mother-of-pearl bathrooms, stylish Moroso designer chairs, and captivating city views. Stay active in our Fitness Center or unwind in the 25-meter infinity pool, embracing the serene waterfront atmosphere as you explore the city's art galleries and trendy hotspots. Connect with locals over a cup of locally roasted specialty coffee and savor contemporary Mediterranean cuisine at Open Sesame social eatery. When night falls, venture to Tribal Lounge, our signature speakeasy cocktail bar, for a one-of-a-kind libation infused with local flair. Unforgettable views of the city skyline await you at Orange Feels Bar & Shisha Lounge, where you can chill to the beats and enjoy shisha by the pool. And before you depart, take a piece of your Dubai adventure home with you from our concept store. Your journey begins here.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Lisbon - Plaza Saldanha

651244.description: Located in the city center, the Holiday Inn Express Lisboa Plaza Saldanha, 15 minutes from the historic center, this hotel is the starting point for exploring and enjoying countless experiences in the city, perfect for business or leisure. Guests will have at their disposal free Wi-Fi and all the facilities of a modern 4-star hotel.

654601.description: This comfortable hotel in Bogota offers a quiet stay with only ten units. Located 2. 3 km from El Campin Stadium in the Teusaquillo district, it provides various amenities, including a garden and terrace. Each room features a desk, flat-screen TV, private bathroom, and wardrobe, while some also have balconies. Guests can enjoy continental or American breakfast and free WiFi. The hotel is conveniently located 2. 8 km from El Campin Coliseum, 5 km from Corferias International Exhibition Center, Bolivar Square, and Luis Angel Arango Library. The reception staff is available to offer helpful local tips. Quevedo's Jet is 6 km from the property.

654602.description: Located in Bogota's Teusaquillo district, the Ayenda 1032 Titas House offers a peaceful stay in one of its 11 comfortable bedrooms. Just 100 meters from Galerias Shopping Center and 7. 5 miles from El Dorado Airport, this hotel provides free Wi-Fi and an American breakfast. Each room features a flat-screen TV, mini-bar, and a private bathroom with a shower. Guests can benefit from the 24-hour front desk and laundry services. For those arriving by car, parking is available nearby for an additional fee. The hotel is conveniently located near El Campin Stadium (601 m), Corferias International Exhibition Center (1. 6 mi), and the T Zone (2. 1 mi). This hotel is a great choice for travelers interested in business, shopping, and enjoying Bogota's cooler climate.

654662.description: We are now operating with a self check in / out process. As per Executive Order signed by Mayor Bill De Blasio on 08/18/2020. We are required to collect the NYS Traveler Health Form by all guest before arrival. In order to avoid a delay in your check-in please REPLY THIS MESSAGE WITH YOUR EMAIL. We will send to you a DocuSign, please you must fill out this form before your arrival in order to get your check in information. We thank you for cooperating and cannot wait to host you.
