654668.description: This charming hotel, established in 2018, is situated in Brussels, within 1. 7 kilometers of the city center, providing easy access to all the city has to offer. Guests will find convenient transport links within 600 meters. The hotel offers 24 comfortable bedrooms and features Wi-Fi access throughout the property. A 24-hour reception is available for added convenience. While cots are not available, the common areas are accessible to guests with disabilities. Please note that pets are not permitted.

654927.description: Situated in Athens, the Athens Platinum Rooms and Suites offers 41 luxurious rooms and suites, the largest selection of its kind. The hotel boasts a distinctly modern design and elegant aesthetic, providing guests with a luxurious experience. Conveniently located near the Katehaki and Panormou metro stations, with easy access to bus routes and major roadways, the hotel also offers private parking.

655182.description: This cosy hostel is located in Santiago Bernabeu-Castellana. A total of 20 rooms are available for guests' convenience at Far Home Bernabeu. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. Pets are not allowed at Far Home Bernabeu. There is a car park at Far Home Bernabeu. Far Home Bernabeu may charge a fee for some services.

655183.description: Les Clarisses hotel is in the heart of the city, very near the Cathedral of Sant Pere, the Episcopal Museum, the Roman Temple and the Plaça Major. Its central location means our guests can easily get to all the most interesting tourist and leisure sites in the city. At our simple but charming hotel you can enjoy the peace and quiet of the area and spectacular views of the city. An ideal place for a pleasant, relaxed stay. At Les Clarisses, we concentrate all our efforts on offering you the highest levels of comfort to make your stay a unique experience.

655197.description: This lovely hotel is in Konyaalti. There are a total of 28 units at Mic Royal Hotel. This establishment was established in 2019. A fee may be chargeable for some services. Mic Royal Hotel is situated in Antalya. Located around 2. 4 km from Antalya Aquarium, the hotel is also 2. 9 km away from Antalya Aqualand. Guests can enjoy sea views. The units in the hotel are fitted with a flat-screen TV. Mic Royal Hotel provides certain rooms with pool views, and each room includes a balcony. All units at the accommodation include air conditioning and a wardrobe. A buffet breakfast can be enjoyed at the property. 5M Migros is 3. 1 km from Mic Royal Hotel, while Antalya Museum is 5 km from the property. The nearest airport is Antalya Airport, 16 km from the hotel.

655225.description: This property is only a 3-minute walk from Konyaalti Beach! Located in Antalya, 3 km from Antalya Aquarium, Golden Orange Hotel provides accommodation with a seasonal outdoor swimming pool. The property is situated 3. 6 km from Antalya Aqualand. The property offers free private parking and free WiFi. Famous Blue Flag Konyaalti Beach is just 120 m from the property. You can enjoy the on-site cafe & bistro at Golden Orange Hotel. At the hotel, rooms come with a wardrobe. The rooms include a private bathroom with a bath or shower, while some rooms here will provide you with sea views. At Golden Orange Hotel each room is fitted with air conditioning and a 32'' HD LCD TV. Guests at the accommodation can enjoy a continental breakfast. The reception can offer helpful tips for getting around the area. You can also find various cafés, restaurants and shops in the surrounding area.

655251.description: Vida Emirates Hills is situated in the tranquil and leafy Emirates Hills neighbourhood. It's perfectly positioned just 10 minutes by foot from two of Dubai's most iconic golf courses: Emirates Golf Club and Address Montgomerie. From dynamic restaurants featuring world-class chefs to a relaxing pool and an ultra-modern gym, there's plenty to keep you busy. You'll discover the glittering attractions of Dubai Marina are just 5km away, along with the golden sands of Jumeirah Beach. Take time out close to the city and enjoy leisure activities such as cycling with one of the hotel bicycles along the neighbourhood cycling paths, or take the jogging route through the lush greenery of the neighbourhood. Vida Emirates Hills is located only a few minutes' drive from Dubai's most exciting destinations and activities including La Mer and the bright lights of Downtown Dubai.

655254.description: Welcome to Address Sky View, a panoramic city viewpoint gracing Dubai's skyline with two resplendent towers conjoined at the summit by an architecturally marvellous Sky Bridge, in the heart of Downtown Dubai. Here, guests and visitors are warmly welcomed to a confluence of attractive propositions. The rooms, suites and residences at Address Sky View reflect careful attention to every nuance of comfort and elegance, while matchless perspectives of the city beckon from the infinity pool above. Innovation and culinary finesse are essential ingredients that elevate each of the novel dining experiences, while wellness is delivered holistically via spa and fitness experiences characterised by new-age thinking. The Ballroom hosts some of the most spectacular social celebrations and formal felicitations, while corporate initiatives take on progressive new dimensions across superbly designed meeting rooms and amphitheatres. In this skyline-defining duo of towers, embrace the unique privilege of being ‘Where life happens'.

655255.description: Welcome to Address Dubai Mall, a visually striking three-tower marvel combining unobstructed, mesmerising views of Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Fountain with unfettered access to peerless entertainment at The Dubai Mall. This premium entertainment gateway presents a scintillating spectrum of rooms, suites and residences furnished with some of the finest natural and man-made materials in the world, benchmark-setting dining venues and avant-garde indulgences at The Spa at Address Fountain Views. Travellers who span the spectrum from aficionados of high luxury to business leaders can enjoy every imaginable occasion here, whether corporate or social, amidst a collection of venues that extend from banquet rooms to boardrooms, as well as an outdoor terrace for enchanting get-togethers. In this monumental trilogy of skyscrapers, experience the very essence of ‘Where life happens'.

655328.description: With a privileged location, in the São Roque da Chave neighborhood, the hotel is the perfect option for those looking for convenience and functional apartments. With easy access to the city's Industrial District and just 20 minutes from the Hopi Hari and Wet'n Wild parks, here you can enjoy the best in comfort and practicality in the region! Live this experience and feel good with Intercity Hotels.

655345.address: Malik Road Jeddah 21352 Besides Arab National Bank
655345.description: Located on Malik Road, minutes from Jeddah's business, shopping, and entertainment districts, and the newly opened Jeddah Waterfront, the Aparthotel Adagio Jeddah offers 35 studios, 29 one-bedroom apartments, and 12 two-bedroom apartments. Guests enjoy access to the connected ibis Hotel Complex, including a wellness and fitness center, a swimming pool, 24/7 snack and lounge options, and full hotel services.

655350.description: Whether traveling solo, as a family, a couple, or with a group, the Nash Suites Airport Hotel offers the perfect accommodations for your Geneva stay. Our spacious, fully equipped, luxurious rooms and suites provide high-quality services, whether your visit is short or extended. Part of the Nash Hotels collection, the hotel opened in early 2019, offering 133 rooms and suites, each featuring a kitchenette with a microwave, fridge, and sofa bed.

655362.description: The hotel offers spacious, modern and air-conditioned studios and apartments, 24-hour reception and free WIFI in all areas. All studios and apartments at this aparthotel come with a smart TV and a fully equipped kitchen with a stove, microwave, fridge and dishwasher. Thanks to the location, the tram is only 450m from the hotel where you can easily connect to the Zuidas Business District and the center of Amsterdam. The hotel offers paid private parking.

655373.description: Located on Malik Road and within minutes from business, shopping, entertainment districts and the famous newly opened Jeddah Waterfront. With its 178 rooms, ibis Kitchen restaurant, Hadiqat Laila -a 24/7 snack lounge, a convenient Web corner in the lobby, and modern meeting rooms that can accommodate up to 110 people, ibis Jeddah is your new comfortable, cozy and modern address.

655423.description: Set in Jeddah, 7 km from Jeddah Mall, Iridium 70 Hotel features an outdoor swimming pool, a fitness centre and a garden, as well as free WiFi. All rooms boast a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a private bathroom. There is a restaurant. All units in the hotel are equipped with a kettle. Certain rooms include a kitchen with a fridge. At Iridium 70 Hotel, rooms have a seating area. Breakfast is available daily, and includes continental and buffet options. The accommodation offers a terrace.

655585.description: The Whale's Tale Guesthouse offers a magnificent ocean view and is conveniently situated between the Hermanus New Harbour and the Town Centre. It gives our guests easy access to the famous cliff path where you will find magnificent scenery of the ocean meeting the cliffs, and of course the adventure of seeing a Southern Right Whale during Whale Season. The cliff path offers a scenic, relaxing walk to the town centre. The guesthouse consists of 4 beautifully decorated bedrooms, each with air-conditioning, en-suite bathroom, television with DSTV and complimentary WiFi. Other facilities include an outdoor entertainment area and a swimming pool where our guests can relax on the deck while enjoying the view of the ocean. The Whale's Tale Guest House will enchant you with a tale of a memorable holiday in a beautiful seaside town, where guests stay in luxury and are treated like good friends

655871.address: 76 Pali Village Panjwani Cottage Pali Naka Behind
655871.description: Ideally located in the Bandra area, Namastey Mumbai Backpackers promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. The property offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, kitchen, 24-hour front desk are on the list of things guests can enjoy. Comfortable guestrooms ensure a good night's sleep with some rooms featuring facilities such as air conditioning, refrigerator, hair dryer, seating area, full kitchen. To enhance guests' stay, the property offers recreational facilities such as games room. Namastey Mumbai Backpackers combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make your stay in Mumbai unforgettable.

name.content: Salvio Parque 93 Bogota, Curio Collection by Hilto

656140.description: Overlooking Park 93, our hotel stands out with organically inspired, distinctive architecture. Destination dining, entertainment, businesses, and embassies are minutes away. We offer on-site dining with a wide variety of global flavors, and meeting space with advanced A/V equipment. Enjoy our wellness programs including yoga in the park, massage, and a fitness center.

656141.address: Building N 1، Al Jahra St, Doha
656141.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Grab a bite to eat at one of the hotel's 5 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 200 meeting rooms available for events. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 193 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature separate bathtubs and showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets.

656185.description: Citadines Sloterdijk Station Amsterdam is located in the Sloterdijk area, offering excellent proximity to Amsterdam's city center. The nearby Sloterdijk station is a major transport hub, well-connected by bus, tram, metro, and train to destinations within the city and surrounding areas. It's only a 5-minute train ride to Amsterdam Central Station. The hotel offers modern and stylish studios and one-bedroom apartments, as well as amenities for business and leisure travelers, including families. Whether you're here for business or pleasure, Citadines is prepared to make your life easier with an array of amenities catering to every need, from the busy business traveler to the long-stay guest and fitness enthusiast. Citadines also prioritizes guest and staff safety with its Ascott Cares program, which emphasizes high levels of hygiene and cleanliness standards, as well as safe distancing.

656678.description: This charming hotel, newly built in 2019, is nestled in the historic heart of Athens, offering easy access to the metro, buses, and other transportation. Enjoy proximity to the city's main entertainment areas, with transport links within 100 meters. The airport is 30 kilometers away, and the harbor is 8. 5 kilometers away. This cozy property offers a quiet stay with just 13 rooms. Athens Lights Hotel provides wireless internet access and a reception desk open from 7:00 am to 11:00 pm. 24-hour access to the hotel and rooms is available with provided passcodes. Baby cots are available upon request, subject to availability. Small pets (up to 5 kilos) are permitted, provided they are not disruptive. An airport shuttle service is available upon request. For business travelers, complimentary espresso, tea, and bottled water are provided. Some services may incur additional charges. The hotel adheres to all COVID-19 safety protocols.

656847.description: Through time and shared experiences, people and locations connect. And where better to connect than Dubai Marina, the heart of 'New' Dubai. Centrally located with easy access to bicycle, Tram, Metro and Freeway, to get you to places you want to be, you can't ignore Millennium Place. Providing warm, comfortable hospitality overlooking the skyline of Dubai Marina and Sheikh Zayed Road, edgy food and beverage options await, wellness spaces and social areas will also help you find your place. We are a 5 minute walk from Dubai Marina Mall, and steps away from many other leisure attractions and shopping diversions. Come for business, stay for leisure, and let our multi-lingual team create a memorable stay experience for you.

656863.description: Experience the vibrant energy of Athens at the Urban Frame Hotel. This brand-new boutique hotel, located in the heart of the city, offers a stylish taste of modern Athenian living. Just minutes from Constitution Square, the Ermou Street shopping district, the historic Plaka, Zappeion Hall, and the National Garden, the Urban Frame provides modern, luxurious accommodations in a minimalist style. The hotel features 15 urban-chic rooms, 24-hour reception and concierge services, airport transfers, a book library, and laundry/dry cleaning.

656947.address: Estrada Engenheiro Paulo De Frontin, S/N
656947.description: This charming hotel can be found in Engenheiro Paulo de Frontin in Rio de Janeiro State. The 64 welcoming guests rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Customers may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection throughout. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. Some units offer cots on request for children. Hotel Fazenda Santa Barbara has been designed to make guests' stay as easy as possible and features some disability-friendly bathrooms. This pet-friendly property accepts pets up to a maximum weight of 5 kg. Moreover, those travelling by car may make good use of the parking facilities. There are business facilities and services for guests' added convenience. Customers may appreciate the sport activities offered at this establishment. Hotel Fazenda Santa Barbara may charge a fee for some services.

657001.description:
Best Western Plus Hotel Amstelveen is a 100% alcohol-free hotel located in Amstelveen, just south of Amsterdam. Please note that the hotel is not located in Amsterdam city, and no alcoholic beverages are served or available anywhere on the property. 

The hotel offers 100 modern, comfortable rooms and suites, each equipped with climate control, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, a Nespresso machine, an electric kettle, and a rain shower. 

Start your day with a fresh breakfast buffet, stay active in the fitness room, or pick up drinks, snacks, and travel essentials from the on-site mini-market. 

Conveniently located near Amsterdam Schiphol Airport, the Royal FloraHolland flower auction, and the international offices of Canon, Brother, and Mitsubishi, the hotel is an excellent choice for both business and leisure travelers. The COBRA Museum is just a 10-minute drive away, while Amsterdam's city centre can be reached in approximately 40 minutes by public transport. Private parking is available in the hotel's parking garage for an additional charge.

657126.description: This flagship apartment house is located in the urban area of the 3rd district of Zurich. The SZU station Giesshübel is situated just on its doorstep (five minutes to the main railway station), while the surrounding traffic arteries can be accessed quickly by a private car. The closest bus and tram station is also not far away. The city center and the lake can be reached within a few minutes by public transport. The direct vicinity offers some restaurants, bars, as well as shopping possibilities. The shopping center Shilcity with numerous shops, restaurants and a cinema is just around the corner. Moreover, local recreation areas Sihl and Allmend Brunau are situated nearby. The Airport Zurich Kloten can be reached within 30 minutes.

657263.address: 43 Derb Lhabib Lmagni Quartier Riad Zitoun Jdid, 43
657263.description: Those who stay at this establishment will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Riad Marhbabikom as it counts with a total of 5 rooms. The premises are housed in a building dating back to 1890 but have been fully refurbished in 2018. The establishment offers Wi-Fi internet connection on-site. The reception desk is open all day long. Unfortunately, there are no units where everyone staying at this accommodation can ask for a cot for the little ones. Riad Marhbabikom may charge a fee for some services.

657272.description: Where the worldly come to stayLisbon is love at first sight. The more you know the more you will love this city. But this is as lame as we will get, just to tell you about our place and our affair with this city. You can find us at the top of a hill, on a street called Madalena. And if you get here you will also find a lot of people like you. Travellers from around the globe with a passion for design, detail, craft, culture and fine living. At the Cosmopolitan Lodge we want to be more than a traditional hotel. More than a one night stand. We would like you to feel emerged in this eclectic space and feel like you are part of it, just as in a club. Moreover, this is no island. You will find that the Lisbon's life is happening everywhere around you. Just pop down to the bar and join us for a drink or two.

657275.description: Welcome to Athens Hawks Hostel, a modern and clean hub for backpackers in the heart of Athens. Our newly renovated rooms offer high accommodation standards, many featuring ensuite bathrooms and stunning city views, especially from the top floor. We also provide spacious dormitories with lockers, drawers, and personal lamps, available as female-only or mixed. Our friendly staff organizes free daily activities, including a morning walking tour and evening cooking sessions. Join us for pub crawls, beer pong, and other games in our lively bar, open daily after 6 pm. Enjoy a complimentary welcome drink upon arrival.

657302.description: With a stay at Ciel Living Athens in Athens (Athens City Centre), you'll be steps from Ermou Street and 6 minutes by foot from Syntagma Square. This guesthouse is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Acropolis Museum and 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Parthenon. Pamper yourself with onsite massages or take in the view from a rooftop terrace. This guesthouse also features complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and an elevator. Grab a bite to eat at CIEL ATHENS, a café which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 12 guestrooms featuring espresso makers and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include safes and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily.

name.content: Majestic Elegance Costa Mujeres All Inclusive

657441.description: Majestic Elegance Costa Mujeres All Inclusive features a total of 570 guest rooms. This hotel was established in 2019. Visitors may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection throughout. Travellers are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. This establishment's common areas are disability-friendly. Majestic Elegance Costa Mujeres All Inclusive provides parking for guests' convenience. This establishment features a choice of different health and wellness facilities ideal for travellers to recharge mentally and physically. Those who stay at this establishment may enjoy a delectable meal at its gastronomic venue. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

657442.description: Centrally located in Jeddah, Hyatt House Jeddah Sari Street is within a 10-minute drive of both Red Sea Mall and Stars Avenue Mall. This upscale aparthotel is 1. 8 miles (2. 8 km) from Rawaea Almaktabat Park and 2. 4 miles (3. 9 km) from King Faisal Specialist Hospital. Enjoy recreational opportunities including an outdoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. The aparthotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, an arcade/game room, and on-site shopping. Each of the 102 air-conditioned rooms offers comfort and convenience. Relax on a sofa bed with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets while enjoying premium TV channels on the LED television. Stay connected with complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Start your day with the complimentary self-serve breakfast, served from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM, or enjoy a meal at the restaurant and snacks at the coffee shop/cafe. For business travelers, the aparthotel offers complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in, as well as two meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours a day), and free self-parking is available onsite.

657462.description: Hotel Nova Lapa is now Uniclass Hotel Lapa. Since July 2017, the third unit of the network is working to offer a new hotel in the western part of the city of São Paulo. A new facade, reception, breakfast area and some rooms are already ready waiting for you. The hotel has a 24-hour front desk and private parking with limited spaces charged separately. As a courtesy, we offer high speed internet, breakfast and luggage storage for all guests. Staying at Uniclass Hotel Lapa is the best option, whatever the reason for your trip. Strategically located a block and a half from Lapa train station, getting around São Paulo from the hotel is very easy! Come and see a show at Allianz Parque, settle matters at the Federal Police or work in the area and then rest quietly at our facilities.

657533.address: 7 Derb Chaoui Sidi Bel Abbes Medina
657533.description: Riad Ayni is a charming riad in Marrakech, offering an intimate retreat with just five rooms. Located in the heart of the medina, it's easily accessible by car, with parking available 150 meters away. Guests can explore nearby attractions, including the Majorelle Gardens and Jemaa El Fna square, a short 20-minute walk from the riad. The air-conditioned rooms feature queen and king-size beds, flat-screen TVs, and Wi-Fi access. Each includes a private bathroom equipped with heated towel rails and a hairdryer. Guests can also enjoy a hammam on the terrace and a heated pool, open year-round.

657863.address: Incekum mah dr ulku guney bul.NO:52 Alanya, 52
657863.description: This luxurious hotel is set in İncekum Alanya The accommodation consists of 234 bedrooms. This accommodation was renewed in 2019. The hotel consists of 2 blocks and 6 floors. The Hotel is giving ultra all inclusive services. The sea is reached by underpass. 50 meters from the sea. We have a food and beverage service on the beach.

658022.description: Niss Lara Hotel Discover the infinite with the boutique service of the Niss Lara Hotel in the city with its renovated architectural design and boutique hotel concept. With its close distance to the sea and a large swimming pool, Niss Lara Hotel provides the freedom to touch the city while you are on vacation. You can shop in the shopping mall with walking distance and you can also go on a gastronomic journey in the best restaurants. While having a spacious holiday with connected rooms with 2 bathrooms specially designed for families, you can relieve the tiredness of the day in the semi-Olympic pool. Because of #thefeelingishere.

658065.address: 12 A Street, Bur Dubai P.O Box number is 7
658065.description: Located in Dubai's vibrant Al Mankhool district, Grayton is a boutique hotel ideal for business travelers and leisure seekers alike. This modern 4-star hotel offers 96 spacious and elegant rooms and suites. Guests can enjoy a rooftop pool (separate sections for adults and children), a serene spa, and a well-equipped fitness center. Dining options include the fine-dining Indian restaurant, Bukhara; Citrus O2 for European cuisine; G&T Lounge & Bar, and the poolside Zanzibar Skylonge Bar & BBQ. Grayton Dubai is conveniently located near Burjuman Metro Station, providing easy access to attractions such as Burjuman Mall, City Centre Shindaga, Dubai Museum, Meena Bazaar, the Gold Souq, and La Mer. Business destinations like the Dubai World Trade Center and Dubai Airport are a short drive away.

658109.address: Saray Mahallesi Yunus Emre Cad no:16 Alanya, 16
658109.description: Located in the heart of Alanya. Comfort Suites opened its doors in 2019, aiming to provide budget-friendly accommodations within newly renovated building. Our 1 Bedroom & 1 Living Room apartments are designed to be, first and foremost, comfortable. Our goal was to provide modern and cozy feel, while designing every section of the unit as efficient as possible for our guests. Surrounded with shopping centers, cafes, restaurants and grocery stores, we will host you, your family and friends within walking distance to everything you need while staying with us. Tourist attractions are within walking distance as well. It will only be a 10-minute walk to Kleopatra Beach, Damlatas Cave, Aqua Park and Aerial Tramway (Teleferik) which will take you up to Alanya Castle. 20-minute walk or a quick taxi-cab ride will get you to Alanya Harbour, Red Tower and to our world-famous downtown district to find unlimited options for restaurants, clubs and bars.

658162.address: Business Gate Qurtubah Area Airport Road, 6
658162.description: The Fairmont Riyadh, a luxury hotel and convention center, offers opulent accommodations in the Business Gate. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, it's a mere 15-minute drive from the airport and 20 minutes from Riyadh City Center. The hotel boasts 298 rooms and suites, five distinct dining options, 4, 300 m² of meeting space, sophisticated event and wedding venues, an exclusive ladies' lounge, and Fairmont's signature spa and gym with an indoor swimming pool.

658509.description: This smoke-free hotel offers convenient bellhop services and a coffee shop/cafe for a quick bite. Room service is also available during limited hours. Enjoy a buffet breakfast on weekdays from 8:00 AM to 11:30 AM and on weekends from 8:30 AM to 11:30 AM (for a fee). Amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. The 45 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks. Centrally located in Madrid, The First One Madrid Preciados is within a 5-minute walk of Gran Via and Plaza de España - Princesa, and a short distance from other attractions like Puerta del Sol (0. 4 mi) and Plaza Mayor (0. 4 mi). The nearest major airport is Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD), 10. 5 miles away.

658514.description: This is the new 5-star hotel in the historic centre of the city of Porto. With a great location on the pedestrian street, Rua das Flores, right next to Misericórdia Church, the hotel is within easy walking distance of the city's main tourist attractions. This hotel with 500 years of history is a fusion of the Classic and the Contemporary and is comprised of two different buildings: a 16th-century palace and a new wing, built from scratch. The PortoBay Flores has 66 rooms and suites, a restaurant, a bar with access to Rua das Flores, a spa, a gym and an indoor pool with natural light. It also has a meeting room, a reading room and an 18th-century chapel. The landscaped patio is a calm and peaceful area in which to relax in the heart of the city.

658528.description: The property comprises a total of 25 snug guest rooms. Kolibry Hotel Antalya was completely renovated in 2019. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. As this hotel features 24-hour reception, guests are always welcome. Common areas are suitable for wheelchair-disabled people. Travellers arriving by car will appreciate parking available at Kolibry Hotel Antalya. Kolibry Hotel Antalya offers airport transfer service. This hotel features a variety of dining experiences to guarantee clients enjoy all aspects of their visit. The hotel provides health and wellness services. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

name.content: Lima Airport Tampu B and B

658545.description: Lima Airport Tampu B and B guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 5 rooms. Clients may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection throughout. Clients are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. Lima Airport Tampu B and B does not offer cots on demand. Visitors arriving by car may leave their vehicle at the accommodation's parking spaces.

658605.description: With a stay at Venice Vacation House in Mestre (Marghera), you'll be within a 15-minute drive of Port of Venice and Porto Marghera. This guesthouse is 6. 3 mi (10. 2 km) from Grand Canal and 6. 4 mi (10. 3 km) from Piazzale Roma. This smoke-free guesthouse offers complimentary parking nearby. Featured amenities include luggage storage and refrigerator in a common area. Free self parking is available onsite. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the guesthouse's coffee shop/café. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Stay in one of 4 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. 666120.description: This lovely hotel is in Midtown West. Add extra space to your stay in Midtown NYC at SpringHill Suites New York Manhattan/Times Square South, a dual-branded property sharing a building with the Fairfield New York Manhattan/Times Square South. Our hotel, in the heart of the Garment District, offers the space and amenities you need for a productive and enjoyable stay. Step outside and experience the energy of Times Square South, with nearby attractions like Madison Square Garden, The Shed, and Broadway. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and a hot, healthy breakfast. After a day of meetings or sightseeing, treat yourself to a drink in the hotel lounge or a workout in the fitness center. Your suite is perfect for work or relaxation in the well-appointed living area, furnished with stylish yet comfortable West Elm furniture.

name.content: Hyatt Place New York City / Times Square

666124.description: This charming Midtown West hotel offers easy access to numerous attractions. Just steps from Times Square and Broadway, you'll find yourself near the Empire State Building, Fifth Avenue shopping, and Hudson Yards. LaGuardia Airport is a 45-minute drive away. The hotel features modern, air-conditioned rooms with tea/coffee facilities and cozy sitting areas. Some upper-floor rooms boast stunning New York City skyline views. Each room includes a private bathroom with a hairdryer and toiletries. On-site parking is available. Guests can also enjoy delicious meals at the hotel's restaurant.

666169.description: Welcome to our enchanting guest house in Venice Mainland, just 950 meters from Mestre train station. Leave your car behind and enjoy easy access to Venice Island via a short bus or train ride across the Freedom Bridge. We offer free Wi-Fi, parking, linens, and towels. Rooms feature city or garden views, some with spacious balconies. A shared bathroom with a shower and hairdryer is available for guests. Reach Venice's historic center in just 15 minutes using nearby public transport. Marco Polo Airport is 6. 2 miles away, and Treviso Airport is 9 miles away. We also offer free luggage storage.

666338.description: Located in Alpedrete, Hostal Rural El Caño by Viverestays is steps from Monumento al Cantero and a short drive from Centro Comercial Planetocio. This hostal offers 11 air-conditioned rooms with complimentary Wi-Fi and cable TV. Guests can also enjoy convenient amenities such as tour/ticket assistance. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. The front desk is staffed during limited hours. Nearby attractions include Centro Comercial Los Valles and Megacampo. Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD) is the nearest major airport.

666342.description: The establishment comprises 19 cosy units. The accomodation offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. There is no 24-hour reception.

666424.description: Selina Lisbon is located in Cais do Sodre, the trendiest neighborhood in Lisbon. Steps from budget-friendly restaurants and markets, we're within walking distance to the riverfront and all the best nightlife. Cradled within seven hills, Lisbon is the city of sunshine. Enjoy of the best weather in Europe coupled with colorful and picturesque buildings. Hike up hills for stunning views, historic sites, Fado music, ginjina cherry liqueur, and more.

666437.address: Plot No P/7, Opp. SBI, Rd No. 21,Thane
666437.description: Situated in a peaceful residential area of Thane, the modern Hotel Golden Nest welcomes corporates, families, and couples. The hotel accepts unmarried couples and local IDs. Conveniently located 21. 9 km from Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport and 4 km from Thane Railway Station, it's easily accessible for all travelers. The hotel offers 20 well-appointed rooms across two floors, featuring Standard (Oak), Deluxe (Maple), and Premium (Mahogany) categories. Each room provides fresh linens, a TV, air conditioning, intercom, and a wardrobe. Deluxe and Premium rooms also include a mini-fridge and study area.

666438.address: PAP D-3 &D-6, TTC Industrial Area, Navi-Mumbai
666438.description: Located in a residential neighbourhood in Sanpada, it's a modern-style independent property suitable for corporates, SME owners, young singles, couples, and families. The hotel allows unmarried couples and local IDs. If you're travelling by flight, Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport is located 27.3 km away from the hotel. If you are travelling by train, Thane Station is located 19.9 km away and Juinagar Railway Station is located 1.1 km from the hotel. Alternatively, you can take a bus to Vashi Bus Station that is located 6 km away from the hotel. Each unit is equipped with a clean queen-size bed with fresh linen, a television with DTH/cable connection, an air conditioner, intercom facility, a mini fridge, a wardrobe, a study table/chair, a coffee table, and an attached bathroom with hot water, shower cabinets.An extra mattress can be made available in case of extra guests.

666491.address: Balaji Busi. Park above RBL Bank, Marol, Andheri E, 1
666491.description: With a stay at FabHotel Admiral Andheri in Mumbai (Marol), you'll be a 5-minute drive from KidZania Mumbai and 6 minutes from Powai Lake. This hotel is 2. 9 mi (4. 7 km) from Bandra Kurla Complex and 3. 7 mi (5. 9 km) from U. S. Consulate General. This hotel offers designated smoking areas. Free self parking is available onsite. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Stay in one of 17 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms with showers are provided. Conveniences include separate sitting areas and complimentary bottled water, and housekeeping is provided daily.

666524.description: The house at Wehlistrasse 153, originally built in 1900 by master builder Klima and named Reichsbueckehof (a name still visible on the façade), has been transformed into a modern apartment hotel. Klima used the highest quality materials, evident in the building's outstanding structure, allowing for a seamless conversion that preserves the original Art Nouveau elements. Today, the Best Western Plus Celebrity Suites shines with renewed splendor, blending historic charm with modern amenities. Located between the Danube River and Vienna's Prater park, this jewel offers 48 state-of-the-art apartments, each featuring fully equipped kitchens and modern bathrooms. Accommodations cater to short or long-term stays and can host up to eight guests. Guests can enjoy a varied breakfast buffet, snacks, and drinks at the lounge bar. A 24/7 reception team is available to assist with any inquiries. Additional amenities include a coin laundry and a professionally equipped fitness room with Technogym equipment. Public transportation, including subway, rapid transit, bus, and airport buses, is readily available. For those traveling by car, convenient parking is available in our adjacent garage. The Rosenberg family and the team of the Best Western Plus Celebrity Suites in Vienna look forward to welcoming you.

666527.description: Business, leisure or just a city break? Visit the Acropolis or the seaside? Strategically located at the city center, ibis Styles Athens Routes is a brand new 4 star hotel. Only 6' walk from the metro station and 15' walk to the Acropolis museum, the hotel offers the ideal setting to enjoy the city with ease. Rest in our spacious & quiet rooms with 43' smart TV and chromecast. Enjoy the cheerful ambiance in our restaurant & bar or discover our modern artwork that decorates the hotel. A pet friendly hotel with comfortable rooms, free wi-Fi, colorful restaurant & bar, meeting rooms, indoor parking & fitness room.

666648.description: A stay at Monte Vista Boutique Hotel places you in the heart of Montagu, steps from Cape Floral Region Protected Areas and 3 minutes by foot from Montagu Museum. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 8 AM to 9:30 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 22 air-conditioned rooms featuring espresso makers. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include safes and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily.

666653.description: Work and play in the vibrant Miraflores district when you book at Radisson RED Miraflores, perfectly situated near stylish boutiques, striking architecture, and top restaurants. A kilometer away, you can stroll the Pacific-facing Malecon, which boasts sculptures and green spaces. We are also just a short walk from Kennedy Park, famous for its friendly, free-roaming felines. Get energized to explore the capital with a session in our fitness center, open 24 hours, or gather with your crew in the Events and Games Studio for some competitive pool or foosball. You can also head to the rooftop bar for a round of pisco sours, sit down to a meal in our on-site restaurant, or order room service for a private meal in your room. Additional hotel amenities include a lobby terrace, a lobby bar, a 24-hour snack shop, and express laundry service. Each of our 100 sleek studios puts the fun in functional. We offer 70 options with king-size beds and 30 with twin beds.

666721.description: Located in the heart of Antalya Lara, our hotel offers a delightful seaside holiday experience. 666891.description: Considering a stay in Vienna? Experience the world's most liveable city from the comfort of a brand new JOYN apartment. Explore impressive architecture, from the Belvedere Palace to the Museums Quartier. Indulge in Viennese coffee culture and savor a slice of Sachertorte or a Wiener Schnitzel at Figlmüller. Return to your comfortable JOYN apartment, a haven for today's generation.

667802.description: The epitome of luxury in the heart of Dubai Spanning floors 18 to 50 of the Burj Daman, our urban retreat is within 10 minutes of the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and The Museum of the Future. 667808.description: Experience Madrid from the heart of it all at the 2060 Newton Hostel, a unique accommodation in the Barrio de las Letras near Tirso de Molina Square. Socialize with fellow travelers in our common areas and enjoy amenities including air conditioning, lockers, luggage storage, a rooftop bar, computers, and a TV room. Explore iconic Madrid attractions nearby, such as Retiro Park, Debod Temple, and the Royal Palace.

667809.description: Located in the tranquil Tirso de Molina neighborhood, just steps from Puerta del Sol, Madrid's vibrant heart, our hostel offers unparalleled access to the city's top attractions. Traditional markets like San Miguel and El Rastro (Sundays) are within easy reach, and the Art Triangle—Prado, Reina Sofia, and Thyssen-Bornemisza museums—is a mere 15-minute walk. Enjoy the convenience of nearby supermarkets, diverse shops, excellent public transport links, and countless tapas bars right at your doorstep.

667820.description: HQ Aparthotel Milano Inn, located in Cinisello Balsamo in the northern part of Milan, offers self-catering accommodations, free Wi-Fi, and outdoor parking (subject to availability), along with private indoor parking. Upon arrival, guests will find a welcome kit, clean bed linens, bathroom amenities, soft towels, a fully equipped kitchen, and a washing machine. Families with children will appreciate the large enclosed green area, perfect for safe play, while business travelers will benefit from its proximity to Milan and Monza. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Perks include our outdoor pool, free WiFi, and free parking.

667970.description: Visitors will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Casa Bellavista Hotel as it counts with a total of 11 units. Wi-Fi internet connection is available for further comfort and convenience. Additionally, the premises provide a reception service the whole day through. Casa Bellavista Hotel does not offer cots on demand. Those who stay at this establishment can take advantage of the airport transfer service. Some services of Casa Bellavista Hotel may be payable.

667997.description: This outstanding hotel, located in the Alanya area, offers 329 guest rooms and wireless internet access in public areas. Xoria Deluxe provides a 24-hour reception for guest convenience. Cots are unavailable. Common areas are accessible to guests with disabilities. Pets are not permitted. On-site parking is available for guests traveling by car. Some services may incur additional charges. The hotel does not accept bookings for men only.

668086.description:
Scout Madrid Hostel is located in the residential neighbourhood of Vinateros, in Madrid's Moratalaz district, around 20 minutes from the city centre by public transport and just a few minutes' walk from Vinateros Metro Station. Our recently renovated building combines a modern, functional design with spacious, bright and comfortable areas. 

We offer shared rooms for 6, 8 or 12 guests, as well as female-only and family rooms. All rooms are bright and quiet and feature bunk beds with individual power sockets and reading lights, personal lockers, individual air conditioning and secure electronic access using NFC technology and personal codes. We also have a room and bathroom adapted for guests with disabilities. 

Guests can enjoy 24-hour reception, high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the property, a fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning in all facilities and a basic buffet breakfast served in the dining room. 

Sustainability is an important part of our philosophy. We use solar panels for hot water and photovoltaic panels to generate part of our electricity. The property also features a small vegetable garden and a dome built with sustainable materials, used for small events and activities. 

Scout Madrid Hostel is a smoke-free and alcohol-free property, offering a relaxed, comfortable and welcoming environment for travellers looking to discover Madrid while staying in a quieter, well-connected neighbourhood.

668101.description: Ideally located within the bustling Al Barsha area, just a minute's walk from the Mall of the Emirates, the Millennium Al Barsha caters to both business and leisure travelers. This stunning property, built in 2019, offers 299 well-appointed rooms and suites, alongside 109 serviced apartments. Each accommodation features modern amenities and the latest technology. The hotel is also committed to sustainable practices, minimizing its environmental impact. Note that some services may incur additional charges.

668218.description: Located directly in front of Milan's Central Station, this charming hotel offers 79 comfortable guest rooms. Established in 2019, the hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi and a 24-hour reception. Cots are available upon request for families traveling with young children. 668361.description:
Nestled in the heart of Msheireb Downtown Doha, Park Hyatt Doha is a sophisticated urban retreat where contemporary luxury meets authentic Qatari culture. Ideally located within walking distance of Souq Waqif, Doha Design District, M7, Galleria Mall, and Msheireb Museums, the hotel offers convenient access to the Corniche, Museum of Islamic Art, and the city’s leading business districts. 

The hotel features spacious guestrooms and elegant suites, a tranquil spa, salon, outdoor swimming pool, and dedicated ladies-only and mixed fitness centers. Its culinary destinations include Opus, serving international breakfast; Anis, an artisan café offering handcrafted beverages and pastries; and rooftop restaurant Sora, presenting contemporary Japanese cuisine with panoramic skyline views. 

With thoughtfully designed event spaces and intuitive service, Park Hyatt Doha is an ideal setting for intimate celebrations, private gatherings, and bespoke events. Blending timeless design, personalized hospitality, and a distinctive sense of place, the hotel invites guests to experience Doha with quiet sophistication.

Make yourself at home in one of the 139 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

668693.address: Abraj Quartier Pearl Boulevard Tower Aq 07 , Po, Box 9154
668693.description: Located in Doha, Hilton Doha The Pearl is by the sea, within a 10-minute drive of Katara Cultural Village and Doha Golf Club. This luxury hotel is 4. 2 mi (6. 8 km) from Katara Beach and 5. 5 mi (8. 8 km) from Doha Corniche. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can soak up the sun at the private beach or enjoy other recreational amenities including a 24-hour health club and an outdoor pool. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 359 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and microwaves. 55-inch flat-screen televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Bathrooms feature separate bathtubs and showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

668702.description: The property consists of 60 rooms. There is Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Carawan Hotel Jeddah provides 24-hour reception. This accomodation does not offer cots on demand. All units at this disability-friendly property are wheelchair-accessible. Additionally, a car park is available on the premises for guests' extra convenience.

668704.description: The Wow Boutique Hotel Jeddah offers 57 comfortable units and convenient amenities such as Wi-Fi and 24-hour reception. This hotel prioritizes accessibility and features wheelchair-accessible accommodations. Guests arriving by car can utilize the on-site parking, and a transfer service is also available. For relaxation, guests can enjoy the hotel's wellness facilities, while business travelers will appreciate the business center. A variety of dining experiences are available on-site, ensuring a pleasant stay for all guests.

668761.description: Located in Dubai, 10 km from Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo, Vida Creek Harbour provides accommodation with two restaurants, free private parking and a fitness centre. All rooms feature a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a private bathroom. The accommodation features a 24-hour front desk, room service and currency exchange for guests. All units in the hotel are equipped with a kettle. A continental breakfast is available daily at Vida Creek Harbour.

668782.description: The 300 welcoming apartments offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Built in 2019, Vida Residences Downtown includes Wi-Fi in all public areas and rooms. Guests will appreciate the 24-hour reception. Cots are not available. This accessible aparthotel provides wheelchair access in all rooms. Additionally, on-site parking is available for guests' convenience. Some services at Vida Residences Downtown may incur a fee.

668903.description: The 4-star Eridanus Hotel, built in 2004, is conveniently located near the Temple of Hephaestus in Athens, just 1 km from the city center. Guests can easily visit the Conservatory of Herodes Atticus and the Temple of Athena Nike, both 1. 1 km away. The Acropolis of Athens is also within close proximity. Each comfortable room features a safe, armchairs, a sofa, a private bathroom with a bathtub, dressing gowns, and toiletries, and offers stunning city views. Guests can start their day with a delicious buffet breakfast.

668983.description: The Mayan Villas Hotel has beautiful suites as well as double & single rooms built with special attention to detail and locally designed for your accommodation in Chiquila, Mexico. We understand that nights away often mean wanting a more intimate and quiet getaway with less people around and personalized service. The Mayan Villas Hotel will certainly deliver this unique experience. In addition, we can help you discover wonderful adventures around the island of Holbox through our adventure packages.

name.content: OYO Rio Colinas Hotel, Rio de Janeiro

669004.description: Situated just three blocks from Copacabana, Ipanema, and Arpoador beaches, the OYO Rio Colinas Hotel offers a prime location for exploring Rio de Janeiro. Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi in the lobby and relax in air-conditioned rooms equipped with cable TV. Each cheerful room includes a private bathroom. A daily buffet breakfast featuring tropical fruits, fresh juice, pastries, and bread rolls is served in a bright, regionally decorated room. The hotel's proximity to General Osório Subway Station (100m) provides easy access to other parts of the city. Santos Dumont Airport is a 20-minute drive away, and Novo Rio Bus Station is reachable within 30 minutes. Copacabana is a popular choice for travelers who appreciate beach walks, sandy shores, and scenic promenades.

669014.description:
OYO 119 OYO Hotel Itarantim features air-conditioned rooms, with free Wi-Fi and flat - screen satellite TV in the Santo Amaro district of Sao Paulo. The property is nonsmoking and is located 1. 7 mi from Transamérica Expo Center. With a private bathroom equipped with a shower and free toiletries, rooms at the hotel also provide guests with a city view. Interlagos Shopping Mall is 3. 1 mi from OYO 119 OYO Hotel Itarantim, while Ibirapuera Park is 6. 8 mi away. The nearest airport is Sao Paulo/Congonhas Airport, 5 mi from the accommodations. 
Note:- Free parking is provided for hotel guests on a first-come, first-served basis. Please note that parking availability is limited and subject to space.

669019.description: OYO Hotel Boneville, São Paulo features air-conditioned rooms with satellite flat-screen TV in the Santo Amaro district of Sao Paulo. This 4-star hotel offers room service and a 24-hour front desk. The property is non-smoking and is located 2. 5 km from Teatro Alfa. Guest rooms include a private bathroom with a shower and free toiletries. Transamérica Expo Center is 3. 1 km from the hotel, while Tom Brasil is 3. 9 km away. The nearest airport is Sao Paulo/Congonhas Airport, 7 km from OYO Hotel Boneville, São Paulo.

669021.description:
Located within 3.5 km of Museu Catavento and 4 km of Sao Paulo Metropolitan Cathedral, OYO Hotel Urban Mooca has rooms with air conditioning and a private bathroom in São Paulo. Located around 4.3 km from Sao Paulo Municipal Market, the hotel with free WiFi is also 5.5 km away from Sala São Paulo. The property provides a 24-hour front desk, room service and luggage storage for guests.

All guest rooms in the hotel are equipped with a flat-screen TV and free toiletries.

A continental breakfast is available daily at OYO Hotel Urban Mooca.

Pinacoteca do Estado de São Paulo is 5.6 km from the accommodation, while Edifício Copan is 5.8 km away. The nearest airport is Congonhas Airport, 12.9 km from OYO Hotel Urban Mooca.

Mooca is a great choice for travelers interested in sightseeing, parks and shopping.

Couples in particular like the location – they rated it 8.5 for a two-person trip

669024.description: OYO Hotel Estrela Do Sul features air-conditioned rooms with satellite flat-screen TV in the Saude district of São Paulo. Among the facilities at this property are a 24-hour front desk and room service, along with free WiFi throughout the property. Private parking can be arranged at an extra charge. At the hotel, rooms contain a private bathroom with a shower. A continental breakfast is available each morning at OYO Hotel Estrela Do Sul. Sao Paulo Expo is 5. 6 km from the accommodation, while Fontes do Ipiranga State Park is 5. 8 km from the property. The nearest airport is Congonhas Airport, 6. 9 km from OYO Hotel Estrela Do Sul. Saude is a great choice for travelers interested in clothes shopping, sightseeing and parks. Couples in particular like the location – they rated it 9. 0 for a two-person trip.

669106.description: Located in the heart of Belgrano, Buenos Aires, Sucre Suites offers 25 modern apartments ideal for travelers, families, or couples seeking a comfortable and autonomous stay. These apartments accommodate two to five guests and feature amenities such as free Wi-Fi, Smart TVs with Netflix, and essential supplies. Cleaning is available for a fee of USD 12 per room, per stay.

669161.description: 'Hotel Acta Voraport *** is located in the Poblenou district, one of the most fashionable areas in the city of Barcelona. Very well connected with all interesting spots in the city of Barcelona by metro, bus and tram and just 5 minutes from Bogatell beach. 313 outward-facing rooms with free Wi-Fi, work table and safe with space for a laptop. As well as a fully equipped bathroom with shower and hairdryer. The Hotel has two meeting rooms with capacity for up to 120 people, a catering area and a terrace located on the top floor of the hotel with panoramic views and infinity pool where you can relax after a long day of business or tourism. The Hotel also has two meeting rooms with capacity for up to 120 people and a catering area. It has a 24-hour reception and an automatic Express Check-In service with lockers where you can leave your luggage. The car and bicycle park is in the same building. Charging is available for electric vehicles. 'When booking more than 5 rooms, special conditions and supplements may apply.

669213.description: Luxury apartments to offer you an unforgettable experience in the heart of Venice. Our brand new Residence is located in San Marco district a few steps from Rialto Bridge, Saint Mark square and the others main place of interest. Offering a garden and free WiFi, Residenza Ducato offers accommodation ideally located in Venice, within a short distance of Ca' d'Oro, Church of San Giorgio Maggiore and La Fenice. All units here are air-conditioned and feature a flat-screen TV, a living room with a sofa bed, a well-equipped kitchen with a dining area, and a private bathroom with bidet, a hairdryer and free toiletries. A dishwasher, a microwave and fridge are also offered, as well as a kettle and a coffee machine.

669218.description:
This is a hotel for those in search of inspiration in Porto, where everything feels effortlessly perfect. Literature sets the tone – each room, suite, and apartment pays tribute to Portugal’s illustrious writers and poets, offering a timeless narrative into your stay. 
The exceptional buildings, now home to Torel Palace Porto, hold significant historical value. A twist of fate turned this architectural landmark into a literary-inspired retreat, where the beautiful facade, magnificent skylight, and intricate stucco ceilings create a story for the ages. 

The plot thickens with 24 rooms and suites, an outside pool, and two distinct dining options: Florbela Pâtisserie and MICHELIN Star restaurant BLIND. But it’s not just elegant interiors and delicious food – it’s like a classic read. Right across the street, our new building reveals a new chapter with 18 unique apartments – a perfect extension to your story. Located on Rua de Entreparedes, we’re here to cater to your every need, ensuring you’ll return time after time. 
Torel Palace Porto was awarded 1 MICHELIN Key in the first official selection in Portugal, recognizing its dedication to excellence, personalized service, and the art of hospitality.

669220.description: Conveniently located on vibrant Long Street, this boutique hotel offers Wi-Fi, a small communal lounge, and a balcony with views of Table Mountain. Tastefully decorated rooms include satellite TV, air conditioning, and Nespresso coffee machines. Some rooms also feature balconies. An honesty bar is available in the guest lounge. The spacious bathrooms are equipped with showers and complimentary toiletries, while some deluxe rooms boast Victorian baths. The hotel is a 3-minute walk from The Company Gardens and a 10-minute walk from Green Market Square. The hop-on hop-off bus stops right outside, and numerous pubs, clubs, and restaurants are on your doorstep. Guests should be aware that Long Street is known for its vibrant nightlife, which may result in some noise.

669323.description: Play Hostel Arcos is just 50 meters from the new Arcos Shopping Outlet located in the Palermo Soho neighborhood in Buenos Aires City. Our French-style house has private and shared rooms, most of them with private bathrooms and individual lockers, to provide accommodation in the tourist heart of the city of Buenos Aires. We have a specially designed living room to read, listen to music, watch TV or socialize with other guests. A coworking space so you don't miss your work meeting and a space for yoga and tango classes. Moreover a patio with hammocks to chill out and a large terrace with a BBQ area so you can feel at home!

669343.description: The four-star Catalonia Porto hotel is located in central Porto, next to Batalha Square and a short six-minute walk from São Bento Station. Just five minutes away, you'll find the Ribeira district, a World Heritage Site boasting a variety of restaurants and bars along the Douro River and the Dom Luís I Bridge. The hotel offers 86 guest rooms and complimentary Wi-Fi for added convenience. Guests are welcomed by a 24-hour reception in the lobby. While cots are not available, the Catalonia Porto is committed to green practices. Please note some services may incur a fee, and pets (one dog or cat under 20 kg per room) are allowed upon request with an additional nightly fee and deposit.

name.content: Catalonia Grand Costa Mujeres All Suites & Spa

669434.address: Lote 006 Mza 002, Punta Sam, Zona Costera
669434.description: The 5-star Catalonia Costa Mujeres All Suites & Spa is a vibrant family resort nestled on one of the most beautiful beaches in the Mexican Caribbean. Our Quinta Avenida, inspired by Playa del Carmen's famed Fifth Avenue, forms the heart of the resort, housing a variety of innovative restaurants, bars, and shops. Two expansive pools cater to different needs: one offers relaxation, while the other provides a range of activities for the whole family. Comfortable suites, including options with swim-up pools, a diverse culinary program, the Alegria Spa, and comprehensive entertainment make this resort an ideal choice for both couples and families. Local attractions include Isla Mujeres and Holbox Island. For those interested in Mayan culture, the Mayan Museum and El Rey archaeological site in Cancun's hotel zone are recommended.

669488.description: BessaHotel Baixa has a fitness center and garden in Porto. Among the facilities at this property are a 24-hour front desk, along with free WiFi throughout the property. Private parking can be arranged at an extra charge. The rooms in the hotel are fitted with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. At BessaHotel Baixa, rooms include air conditioning and a private bathroom. The wellness area at BessaHotel Baixa is consisted of of an indoor pool and a sauna. Popular points of interest near the hotel include City Market Bolhao, Oporto Coliseum and Douro River. The nearest airport is Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport, 7. 5 mi from BessaHotel Baixa.

669490.description: Located in the heart of Athens, Fos DownTown Suites is a short walk from Syntagma Square and the Acropolis. This hotel offers guests complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, a communal living room, and a reception hall. Each of the 14 individually decorated guestrooms features a minibar, espresso maker, and smart TV with satellite programming. Bathrooms include showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. A full breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include luggage storage, laundry facilities, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Nearby attractions include the Monastiraki Flea Market and the Temple of Olympian Zeus.

669502.description: With a stay at The July - Boat & Co, you'll be centrally located in Amsterdam, within a 10-minute drive of Anne Frank House and Rijksmuseum. This 4-star aparthotel is 2. 6 mi (4. 2 km) from Leidseplein and 3 mi (4. 9 km) from Van Gogh Museum. Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities, including a sauna, a fitness center, and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this aparthotel include complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. At The July - Boat & Co, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 82 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring kitchens with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and ovens. 41-inch Smart televisions with premium TV channels provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and separate sitting areas, as well as phones with free local calls.

669679.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Enjoy recreational amenities such as a nightclub and sauna. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. The hotel's restaurant serves lunch and dinner, with additional dining available at the coffee shop/cafe. 24-hour room service is also provided. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary daily reception, and unwind at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Guests can use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self-parking is available onsite. The 48 guestrooms offer minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Private bathrooms with showers include rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Safes and desks are provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Located near Konyaalti Beach, the hotel is within 2 kilometers of Konyaalti Beach Park, Mediterranean City Park, Atatürk Culture Park, and Arapsu Bridge. Antalya Intl. Airport (AYT) is 22 km away.

669707.description: Enjoy the city views from the terrace at Sunflower Hostel Berlin in the vibrant Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg district. Convenient amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi and a vending machine. Satisfy your hunger at the on-site snack bar/deli and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Additional amenities include a computer station, 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. The 42 individually decorated guestrooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and blackout drapes/curtains. Bathrooms feature showers and hair dryers. Housekeeping is provided on a limited basis. A short drive takes you to the East Side Gallery and Mercedes-Benz Arena, while Alexanderplatz is 2. 1 miles and Checkpoint Charlie is 3. 5 miles away.

669864.description: Set in a prime location of Doha, la castle hotel puts everything the city has to offer just outside your doorstep. The property offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. All the necessary facilities, including free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour room service, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, gift/souvenir shop, are at hand. All rooms are designed and decorated to make guests feel right at home, and some rooms come with flat screen television, additional bathroom, additional toilet, air purifier, bathroom phone. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Friendly staff, great facilities, and close proximity to all that Doha has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at la castle hotel.

669882.description: This Historic Inn, was built in 1841, and occupies two brick landmark townhouses in New York City's Greenwich Village Historic District. As an attractive alternative to Midtown's steel and glass, the Village Guest House offers our guests a warm welcome with our antique furnishings and artwork. To get to your room you'll wander down narrow halls and up charming old stairways to one of our 12 unique rooms. Most of our rooms contain one double bed, some offer separate beds, while our larger studios comfortably accommodate up to four people. All rooms include a private bath, air conditioning, TV and more. Book your stay at the Incentra Village Guest House today!Guests who book the Garden Suite have sole access to our private garden. Self check-in via door keypads.

669885.address: Okul Sokak No 35 Karaöz Mavikent Mahallesi
669885.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and bicycles to rent. This Mediterranean hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Esperanza, for dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. A complimentary local cuisine breakfast is served daily from 8:30 AM to noon. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 13 guestrooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

669902.address: Palazzo Papadopoli Calle Tiepolo 1364 Sestiere San
669902.description: The luxury Aman Venice, set in the regal Palazzo Papadopoli on the Grand Canal, offers a rare experience of spaciousness in the heart of Venice. Easily accessible from Marco Polo Airport (VCE), this hotel feels more like a grand home. High ceilings and light-filled salons open onto two private gardens—a true rarity in this floating city. Guests can enjoy exclusive after-hours visits to the Gothic Palazzo Ducale, the former home of the Doge, and easily access key annual events like the Biennale Film Festival and Venice Carnival. A discreet staircase on the mezzanine leads to an intimate three-suite spa, a sanctuary for rejuvenation. The Blue and Yellow Dining Rooms offer Italian cuisine amid sumptuous decor, while a canal-side eatery awaits in the garden. Whether an intimate gathering or a grand celebration, Aman Venice caters to events of all sizes, from weddings to private parties.

671061.description: OWN Vila Madalena - Your Perfect Lodging Experience in São Paulo Welcome to the best option for those looking for a unique stay in the city of São Paulo. Located in the heart of Vila Madalena, one of the capital's most vibrant and cultural neighborhoods, our hotel combines comfort, modernity and an authentic concept of hospitality. Here, every detail has been thought of to provide a unique and welcoming experience. Our comfortable, well-equipped rooms offer the ideal refuge after a day exploring the city or fulfilling professional commitments. The environment is modern and functional, perfect for both leisure travelers and those who need a quiet space to work. Start the day with a delicious and complete breakfast, prepared with fresh ingredients and a variety of options to suit all tastes. Need a space to stay productive? Our coworking space was designed to offer an inspiring environment, with high-speed internet, ergonomic workstations and meeting rooms, ideal for digital nomads and professionals looking for flexibility. Our privileged location puts you just a few steps away from all that Vila Madalena has to offer: iconic bars, trendy restaurants, art galleries, concept stores and a bohemian atmosphere that turns every stroll into a new discovery. Whether for a weekend getaway, a business trip or an extended experience, OWN Vila Madalena is the perfect choice for living São Paulo in style and comfort. Strategic location in the heart of Vila Madalena Modern and cozy rooms for different traveler profiles Complete coworking for work and networking Easy access to the city's culture, gastronomy and nightlife Come and discover a new concept in accommodation. Book now and live the OWN Vila Madalena experience!

672252.description: With a total of 15 rooms, this is a nice place to stay. Ayenda 1045 Boutique Aeropuerto includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and rooms. Those who stay at this establishment are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. This establishment's common areas are disability-friendly. Ayenda 1045 Boutique Aeropuerto provides parking for guests' convenience. This is an eco-friendly hotel. Everyone staying at this accommodation may avail for airport transfer service. Additional fees may apply for some services.

672261.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as bicycle rentals and a terrace with scenic views. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a communal living room. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk and free self-parking. The hotel's 20 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, LED televisions, and private balconies.
