Antalya Intl. Airport (AYT) is the preferred airport.

672281.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a vending machine. Stop by the hotel's restaurant for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 40 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

672300.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Fitness Center, Breakfast. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Airport Shuttle, Complimentary Evening Social, Pool. Welcome to Homewood Suites by Hilton Ronkonkoma. Centrally located between the Long Island Expressway and MacArthur Airport, our modern hotel is the perfect base for exploring everything Long Island has to offer. Visit the area's famous wineries, take a trip out to Fire Island, or explore the beautiful North and South Shore Beaches. Get around with ease, thanks to the Long Island Railroad and our complimentary hotel shuttle service to and from the airport. Our spacious, comfortable suites are perfect for extended stays. Choose from a studio, one-bedroom or two-bedroom suite, all with separate living and sleeping areas. All suites feature a full kitchen with a microwave and refrigerator, and home comforts including two HDTVs and free WiFi. Start each day with a free hot full breakfast, and join us Monday-Thursday for our complimentary evening social*. Keep up with your workout routine in our fitness center. When you're ready to relax, enjoy a game on our hotel putting green, swim in our indoor pool, or unwind by the fire pit on our outdoor patio. *Local and state laws apply.

672626.description: The Dorma Saldanha is a hotel that is contemporary in spirit and functional in character, the ideal place for urbanites. The hotel facilities have been designed paying great attention to every single detail so as to live up to your expectations, whether you are here for tourism or on a business trip. Inside the hotel itself there is a delightful café where you can enjoy a full buffet breakfast every morning. The hotel is located in a area of modern Lisbon, Avenidas Novas, and specifically in the Saldanha neighbourhood, where historic buildings rub shoulders with new constructions and green areas. This neighbourhood, with its wide tree-lined avenues, is characterised by its peaceful atmosphere, its fashionable establishments and its excellent connections.

672686.description: Located in Konyaalti, Zeynel Hotel is by the sea, within a 5-minute drive of Konyaalti Beach and Konyaalti Beach Park. This bed & breakfast is 4. 4 mi (7. 1 km) from Antalya Clock Tower and 4. 4 mi (7. 1 km) from Old Bazaar. Enjoy recreation amenities such as a seasonal outdoor pool or take in the view from a garden. This bed & breakfast also features complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. The beach shuttle (surcharge) makes getting to the surf and sand a breeze. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). At Zeynel Hotel, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Wrap up your day with a drink at the beach bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 38 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

672697.description: Located in the lively center of Athens, V36 Suites offer a serene and cozy atmosphere in its recently renovated urban chic suites. Boasting an ideal location near Syntagma square, the hotel is close to important historical sites, landmarks, as well as the commercial center of the city. The upscale suites are set with stylish and comfortable furnishings, private bathrooms, and modern amenities to make you feel like home.

672703.description: Hotel Moon & Sun Braga is a distinguished 25-room exclusive hotel in Braga, which includes 3 Premium rooms with 22 mts2 in area, with magnificent balconies overlooking the city. The 30-year-old old building has been fully restored, respecting the original exterior design and giving the distinctive location of the hotel a unique style and heritage. Built in 1690, the Church of the Third Order of San Francisco and its Baroque style is framed in the bedroom window and balcony, mirroring the sense of the past outside in contrast to the modern and comfortable interior design. Classic and contemporary fuse into detail in timeless elegance!

672704.description:
With a stay at Dear Lisbon -Valmor Palace, you'll be centrally located in Lisbon, within a 5-minute drive of Avenida da Liberdade and Rossio Square. This hotel is 12 mi (19. 3 km) from Costa da Caparica Beach and 1. 3 mi (2. 1 km) from Marquis of Pombal Square.

672744.description: Hotel Moon & Sun Porto offers city views, a bar, and a shared lounge in Porto, 1. 8 km from City Market Bolhao. This 4-star hotel provides a 24-hour front desk, concierge service, airport shuttle, room service, and free WiFi throughout. Air-conditioned units feature a flat-screen cable TV, kettle, private bathroom with shower and hairdryer, and a work desk. All rooms include a wardrobe.

672763.description: Centrally located in Amsterdam, Hotel Not Hotel offers easy access to local attractions. A short walk from Ten Kate Markt and Foodhallen, and a quick bike ride from Vondelpark and Anne Frank House (rental bikes available on-site), this inn provides a convenient base for exploration. Enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant and bar/lounge, or start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies). The 31 guestrooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, and the hotel provides amenities such as a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Self-parking is available for a fee.

686059.description: Welcome to Home2 Suites by Hilton Long Island Brookhaven. Nestled between the classic coastal beauty of the Hamptons and the vivid culture of New York City, this Home2 Suites hotel is Long Island's newest hidden gem. Our brand new hotel is conveniently located just off the Long Island Expressway (I-495), offering easy access to many shops, businesses and popular attractions. Enjoy close proximity to ocean beaches, wineries and award-winning golf courses. Visit seaside villages such as Port Jefferson and Stony Brook or catch a sports tournament in Brookhaven with Baseball Heaven, Stony Brook University and St. Josephs College all close by. Our spacious studio and one-bedroom suites are ideal for short term or extended stays. Each modern suite features a working wall with work, dining and storage areas. There's also a fully equipped kitchen with full size refrigerator, microwave and dishwasher. Stay connected with free WiFi and catch your favorite shows on the HDTV. Each morning you'll enjoy a free breakfast at our Inspired Table™ - with over 400 combinations, we're sure to please everyone. Other great amenities at our Home2 Suites hotel include an indoor pool, business center, meeting space and our innovative Spin2Cycle laundry and fitness facility, open 24-hours. Pick up snacks from the 24-hour Home2 MKT® or relax with a coffee in the Oasis.

686186.description: Welcome to The Flying Pig Uptown, world-famous for its laid back atmosphere, private guests-only bar, indoor smoking room and friendly, helpful staff! Just steps away from the gorgeous Vondelpark and within walking distance of the Van Gogh museum, Rijksmuseum and buzzy Leidesplein, we're the perfect location to explore Amsterdam by foot, bike or tram. Converted from a cosy Amsterdam townhouse, The Flying Pig Uptown has plenty of charm spread over 6 floors. All rooms are accessed via the main staircase - there is no elevator so be prepared for a climb!Please note we have a 7 day maximum stay policy and are strictly over 18s. Once the stage for Lisbon’s nightlife in the 1940s, Maxime today exudes sophistication, blending its legendary past with contemporary style, carefully curated interiors and a unique personality. 
Each air-conditioned room includes a Nespresso coffee machine, a private bathroom with Castelbel toiletries, a Marshall speaker, and a flat-screen TV. 
Maxime Restaurant-Bar has preserved the original bar counter. Guests can enjoy a menu with Lisbon’s roots and and live shows on selected days. 
Maxime Hotel is only a 1-minute walk from Avenida da Liberdade and the metro station. Rossio Square is 700 meters away, and the Chiado shopping district is a 10-minute walk. Lisbon Airport is 7 km away.

701269.address: 61B Street Al Garhoud Next to GGICO Metro Station, 2

701455.description: Indulge in a pampering treatment at the full-service spa at Hotel UTO KULM, a car-free hideaway in Zurich. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a picnic area. Each air-conditioned suite features a living room with plush sofa and a dining table. It offers a flat-screen TV and an iron. The kitchen includes an oven and a fridge.
Shada Homes Suites is a 10-minute drive from Downtown and Centrepoint, the popular shopping destinations. King Abdul Aziz International Airport is 45 minutes' by car. Shuttle service is available upon request.

All guest rooms are fitted with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a fridge, a coffee machine, a bidet, free toiletries and a desk. The private bathroom is equipped with a hair dryer. All rooms include a wardrobe.
The hotel offers a continental or buffet breakfast.

Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.
You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of YOTEL Amsterdam, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee.

You will be surrounded by fantastic dining and shopping and within walking distance of attractions like Times Square the Theater District and the Empire State Building. If work brings you here we are only half a mile from the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center.

710395.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including a 24-hour fitness center and a seasonal outdoor pool. 710545.description: Located in Amsterdam-Centrum, Mr Jordaan Hotel is a perfect starting point from which to explore Amsterdam. The property has everything you need for a comfortable stay. 710561.description: At Acasa Suites, you can lean back and relax. Feel at home from day one, regardless of your length of stay. For your weekend, holiday or business trip to Zurich the Hotel Acasa Suites offers spacious hotel rooms and suites partly equipped some with garden seating area or balcony, plus access to our exclusive gym and spa in a very convenient location in Zurich Oerlikon: close to the event and exhibition centers of Zurich (Hallenstadion, Messe Zurich, Halle 622, Halle 550 and Theater 11) between airport and city centre. At Acasa Suites Zurich Oerlikon hotel or apartment guests have exclusive access to our spa and fitness area free of charge. Work out on modern equipment, relax with a yoga session in the beautiful green environment or unwind in the sauna and steam bath - this is a safe way to escape from the everyday life. Acasa Suites is fully equipped to provide relaxing massage moments. Our massage therapists can be booked at any time in advance or at the desk. Our chef Martina attaches great importance to fresh and varied southern Italian cuisine and, together with her team, will delight you with innovative culinary delights for lunch or dinner. You can enjoy our food in our stylish restaurant or on the cozy open-air terrace, depending on the weather. Hungry? Let yourself be tempted by our weekly changing business lunch or our dinner menu.

710586.description: Cocomama is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Amsterdam. The hotel has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Each apartment is thoughtfully designed for comfort, featuring amenities such as a wardrobe, eco friendly bath amenities, fresh towels and linen and a flat-screen television to ensure a restful stay. 

The surrounding area offers various recreational opportunities, allowing guests to fully experience the charm of Athens. Omnia Pagrati Apartments combines warm hospitality with a welcoming atmosphere, making your visit truly unforgettable. 

Housekeeping is provided every three days, with additional services available upon request for your convenience. 
Breakfast is delivered to your door daily in specially prepared packaging, between 07:00–08:00. 

Kindly note that it is essential for guests to contact us in advance prior to their arrival and inform us regarding their arrival time, as our reception operates during specific hours: 

Monday to Friday 09:00–22:00 and weekends 11:00–19:00.

Each of the 24 individually furnished guestrooms features heated floors, a flat-screen TV with satellite programming, a safe, and a desk. A 4-minute drive takes you to the Galleria d'Arte Moderna, while Villa Necchi Campiglio is 1. 6 miles away.

711405.description: Canto De Luz is a Boutique Maison, a luxury property offering designer junior suites, some with balconies, and private Villas, some with their own private pool. The hotel boasts a heated saltwater pool avaiable to all guests between 09:30 and 20:30 daily. All feature Fast Free WiFi, Samsung Art TV with Free Netflix and Disney Plus, Air Conditioning, Blackout Blinds, Amazon Echo with free music, Nespresso, English and Herbal Teas, & daily Fresh Purified water. 180cm wide super king beds optionaly split into two singles in all but 3 rooms and come with luxury cotton linens. 1 or 2 single sofa beds create family rooms. Ensuite bathrooms boast power showers, Rituals amenities, Hair Dryers, Heated towel rails & large fluffy towels. For families or longer stay groups, Urban Retreat Studio apartment suites offer fully equipped Kitchens, Washer/Dryers, Smart TV with Free Netflix and Xbox. The brand new Garden Duplex VIllas are a delight, with their own private outdoor space and total luxury. Finally, the 2 bedroom luxury villas with private swimming pool are the piece de resistance. Organic locally sourced breakfast is served daily in the Orangerie or in the garden and is included in daily rates. Secure garaged parking is available to book at a low daily cost. Everything guests need is within walking distance and popular points of interest nearby include the Market of Bolhao, Palacio da Bolsa, Libraria Lello and Time Out Porto at the emblematic Sao Bento station. The Douro is a leisurely 12 minute stroll down the hill.

711472.description: In the heart of Minho, Casa Lata - Agroturismo is located on a property of about 3. 6 hectares, between Braga (10kms) and Peneda Gerês National Park (30kms), in the north of Portugal. It has 10 double rooms and 4 twin rooms in the main house, guests can also enjoy common spaces such as a lounge, which once gave way to the wine cellar, game room, outdoor swimming pool (for adults and children) and numerous green spaces surrounding the house. It has the history of a farm house minhota where its people dedicated themselves to the agriculture. As milestones of many traditional activities still exist the granary, the wine press, the alembic and numerous agricultural tools. On arrival our guests are welcomed with a glass of Vinho Verde, and if they wish to know more about the production of Vinho Verde the owner, José Costa, will be happy to make a visit to the winery.

711473.description: This modern aparthotel, built in 2016, offers a tranquil stay with only 14 apartments. Guests enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and convenient access to the historical center of Taipas. This property offers a total of 39 guest rooms. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the property. The reception does not work around the clock. Communal areas are wheelchair accessible at Home Swiss Hotel. 


A different approach to comfort –
In Geneva, air conditioning systems are subject to strict regulations and authorizations, as local authorities encourage more environmentally friendly solutions. As part of this approach, our rooms are not equipped with air conditioning. To ensure your comfort during warmer periods, fans are provided free of charge in all rooms.

This modern hotel, built in 2019, offers 68 air-conditioned rooms equipped with refrigerators, microwaves, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy the convenience of a complimentary continental breakfast each morning, express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. Private bathrooms feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Additional amenities include in-room safes and desks. Nearby attractions include Bryant Park and Broadway, both within a short walking distance.

724342.description: The accommodation comprises 23 cozy guest rooms. Guests can enjoy wireless internet access in the hotel's public areas. Casa Lirio does not offer a 24-hour reception. Understanding that accessibility is important, Casa Lirio provides wheelchair-accessible accommodation units and is fully adapted for easy access. Additional fees may apply for some services.

724363.description: Set in Bareggio, Hotel Novara Expo is 10 minutes' drive from Fiera Milano Exhibition Centre and has excellent motorway links with the A4 and A50 nearby. It provides free parking and a free WiFi throughout. The Novara Expo Hotel has been completely refurbished. Its modern rooms include air conditioning, satellite TV and a minibar. The en suite bathroom features a hairdryer and free toiletries. A buffet breakfast is served each morning. The restaurant specialises in grilled meat and fish and Italian pizza from a wood-burning oven. You are just a few steps from the bus stop for Milan city centre, 20 km away. The motorways nearby connect you to the lakes and major cities in the north of Italy.

724604.description: There are a total of 38 accomodation units on the premises. Guests may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection throughout. Résidence Dar Lamia does not offer 24-hour reception. This establishment's common areas are disability-friendly. Clients arriving by car may leave their vehicle at the accommodation's parking spaces. This property features a choice of different health and wellness facilities ideal for visitors to recharge mentally and physically. Some services may be payable.

724644.description: With a stay at Hotel Green Village in Aguas de Santa Barbara, you'll be 9. 7 mi (15. 5 km) from Capao Rico Waterfall and 10. 3 mi (16. 7 km) from Mizael Marques Sobrinho Spa. This 4-star hotel is 23. 8 mi (38. 4 km) from Cerqueira Cesar Municipal Museum. Pamper yourself with onsite massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 5 outdoor swimming pools, 4 spa tubs, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a picnic area. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the poolside bar. Stay in one of 22 guestrooms featuring LED televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

724652.description: Located in the Bras district of São Paulo, Hotel Global Grupos offers convenient access to cultural attractions like the Pinacoteca do Estado Museum and Sala São Paulo Concert Hall, both within a 10-minute drive. This hotel features 50 air-conditioned rooms equipped with minibars, Smart TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy international cuisine at the HG Bar e Restaurante, or grab a coffee at the on-site cafe. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk.

724659.description: In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Clients may contact the reception desk any time during the day.

724664.description: The Plaza Mayor Hotel offers modern, comfortable accommodations and quality service. Our 87 well-equipped apartments and convention center (capacity 375) provide an ideal setting for various events, from meetings to celebrations. On-site amenities include a restaurant and parking for added convenience. We offer customizable catering options, including coffee breaks, cocktails, and brunches, with expert guidance from our team. Our longstanding experience in hospitality ensures your event is a success.

726886.description: When you stay at Eco Resort Refúgio Cheiro de Mato in Mairipora, you'll be 14 minutes by car from Barragem Paiva Castro. This family-friendly resort is 3. 6 mi (5. 8 km) from Juquery State Park and 9. 7 mi (15. 6 km) from Hospital de Clínicas Caieiras. Dip into one of the 3 outdoor swimming pools or enjoy other recreational amenities including an outdoor tennis court and a steam room. Additional amenities at this resort include complimentary wireless Internet access, shopping on site, and wedding services. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Cravo & Canela, a restaurant which specializes in Brazilian cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 80 guestrooms featuring minibars and DVD players. 32-inch LCD televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks.

726933.description: Everyone staying at this accommodation will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Hola Hostal Collblanc as it counts with a total of 5 guest rooms. Hola Hostal Collblanc offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The reception desk is open all day long. This establishment's common areas are disability-friendly. Additional fees may apply for some services.

728183.description: Located in Cancun (Downtown Cancun), Capital O Farallon Inn is within a 15-minute walk of Plaza Las Americas and Dubai Palace Casino. This hotel is 3. 6 mi (5. 9 km) from Las Americas Cancun Mall and 4. 8 mi (7. 7 km) from Tortuga Beach. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Featured amenities include luggage storage and a water dispenser. A shuttle from the hotel to the airport is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 28 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms with showers are provided. Conveniences include ceiling fans, and housekeeping is provided daily.

728357.description: Featuring 5-star accommodation, OYO Hotel Lindoia, Petropolis is set in Petrópolis, 8 km from Free Flight Ramp of Simeria and 8. 1 km from Petropolis Bus Station. This 5-star hotel offers a 24-hour front desk. The property is non-smoking and is situated 1. 4 km from Cathedral of St. Peter of Alcantara. The rooms in the hotel are fitted with a TV. A continental breakfast is available each morning at OYO Hotel Lindoia, Petropolis. The nearest airport is Rio de Janeiro/Galeao International Airport, 65 km from the accommodation.

728417.description: Featuring 4-star accommodations, OYO Nobs Hotel, São João de Meriti is located in São João de Meriti, 22. 5 km from Maracanã Stadium and 24. 1 km from AquaRio Rio Marine Aquarium. Built in 1987, this 4-star hotel is within 25. 7 km of Museum of Tomorrow and 25. 7 km of Selarón Steps. Rio de Janeiro Botanical Gardens is 30. 6 km from the hotel and Christ the Redeemer is 33. 8 km away. At the hotel all rooms are equipped with air conditioning and a TV. Municipal Theater is 27. 4 km from OYO Nobs Hotel, São João de Meriti, while Modern Art Museum is 27. 4 km away. The nearest airport is Rio de Janeiro/Galeao International Airport, 19. 3 km from the accommodation. OYO Nobs Hotel, São João de Meriti has been welcoming Booking. com guests since Oct 29, 2019Hotel chain/brand: OYO Rooms

728474.description: The OYO Nações Unidas hotel in São Paulo offers free WiFi and private parking. Guarapiranga Reservoir is 1. 2 miles away, while Interlagos Circuit and Coração Sertanejo are 2. 7 and 2. 3 miles away, respectively. Each room features a TV with cable channels, a private bathroom with a shower and slippers, and bed linen. The hotel provides an airport shuttle, a 24-hour reception, a bar, ironing and laundry services, and a vending machine. It's 12 miles from São Paulo City Center, 15 miles from Tietê Bus Terminal, and a short distance from Arena Corinthians.

730761.description:
Rooms with a balcony, an outdoor pool and free Wi-Fi are offered at Mara Palace. The hotel is situated in Vassouras, 119 km from Rio de Janeiro.

All air-conditioned accommodation feature cable TVs and minibars. Garden views are offered from the balconies of the rooms.

A game of billiards is played in the games room and children are entertained at the playground. The hotel also features a communal reading and TV room.

Guests can enjoy a typical Brazilian buffet breakfast with fresh fruit, juices, homemade breads and cakes. The à la carte restaurant serves regional specialties and international dishes during the evening.

Free parking is possible at Hotel Mara Palace, when arriving by car. Casa de Cultura is just one block away and the hotel is a short drive to the centre of Vassouras.

Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.3 for a two-person trip.

name.content: OYO Hotel Recanto Do Alto, Teresópolis

730791.description:
With a stay at OYO Hotel Recanto Do Alto in Teresopolis, you'll be within a 10-minute walk of Feira do Alto Handicraft Market and Higino da Silveira Square.  This hotel is 0.7 mi (1.1 km) from Judith Fountain and 0.7 mi (1.2 km) from Three Peaks State Park.
Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and tour/ticket assistance.
Free self parking is available onsite.
Make yourself at home in one of the 25 guestrooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include desks and fans, and housekeeping is provided daily.

730820.description:
Location
OYO Center Plaza is set in a prime location, close to the city's main hospitals, just 500 meters from São Joaquim Subway Station and 1 km from Paulista Avenue. In this region there are also many restaurants and leisure options, such as theaters and cultural centers. The Liberdade district, famous japanese comunity , is just a few meters away.

Special Features
Rooms at this OYO are equipped with air conditioning, a TV and a private bathroom with free toiletries.

Facilities
This OYO offers free WiFi, a restaurant, a 24-hour front desk, parking (on a first come, first served basis) and an elevator.

Nearby
Pátio Paulista Mall is 800 meters from OYO Center Plaza Hotel, while Ibirapuera Park is 3 km away. Congonhas Airport is 9 km away. This OYO is a great choice for guests who are interested in culture, gastronomy and urban facilities.

name.content: OYO Hotel San Remo, Sao Paulo

730832.address: R. Henri Martin, 462 A - Vila Remo
730832.description: Offering free WiFi, OYO Hotel San Remo - 10 minutos de distância do Parque Guarapiranga is located in Vila Remo in São Paulo. Various bus stops are a short walk away. A 24-hour front desk offers room service. Capão Redondo Subway is 1. 9 mi away and the city center is a 40-minute drive away. Rooms here will provide you with a TV and radio. Private bathrooms also come with a shower. M'Boi Mirim Road is 2 mi from OYO Hotel San Remo - 10 minutos de distância do Parque Guarapiranga. while Guarapiranga Dam is 2. 5 mi away and Atlântica Avenue is 5 mi from property. Guarulhos Airport in São Paulo is 25 mi away

name.content: OYO Hotel Dom Pedro, Sao Paulo

730835.address: Av. Dom Pedro I, 854 - Vila Monumento
730835.description: Located in Sao Paulo, Hotel Dom Pedro is within a 10-minute drive of Paulista Museum and Independencia Park. This hotel is 1. 8 mi (2. 9 km) from Aclimacao Park and 4. 1 mi (6. 6 km) from Ibirapuera Park. Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 20 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms with showers are provided. Conveniences include desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

731323.description:
Situated conveniently in the Old Dubai district of Dubai, OYO 314 24 Gold Hotel is set 6 km from Grand Mosque, 9 km from Dubai World Trade Centre and 10 km from City Walk Mall. Among the facilities at this property are room service and luggage storage space, along with free WiFi throughout the property. The hotel features family rooms.

The units come with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a fridge, a kettle, a shower, a hairdryer and a desk. At the hotel all rooms come with a wardrobe and a private bathroom.

Dubai Mall is 13 km from OYO 314 24 Gold Hotel, while Burj Khalifa is 13 km away. The nearest airport is Dubai International Airport, 6 km from the accommodation.

We speak your language!

731774.description: Set in Alcobendas, Hampton By Hilton Alcobendas Madrid features a fitness centre, bar, shared lounge, and free WiFi throughout the property. Guests can enjoy pool views (Swimming pool open during Summer time, from June 14Th until September 14th). At the hotel, all rooms come with a desk, a TV and a private bathroom. The units at Hampton By Hilton Alcobendas Madrid feature air conditioning and a wardrobe. A buffet breakfast is available each morning at the accommodation. Free private parking and a business centre are available, as well as a 24-hour front desk. Madrid is 23 km from Hampton By Hilton Alcobendas Madrid, while Alcalá de Henares is 31 km away. The nearest airport is Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas, 7 km from the hotel, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service. Hotel pet friendly: We have a limit of two pets per room, and 20 kilograms per pet. A nonrefundable pet fee of EUR 15€ will apply per pet, per night, and an incidentals hold is required for all guests with pets. The hold will be removed 3-5 business days after check-out, provided no damages were incurred. Please contact the hotel for further details.

732121.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at the Funway Academic Resort - Adults Only, located in Madrid's Tetuán district, a short drive from the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium and Plaza de Castilla. Take a dip in the indoor pool, unwind on the terrace or in the garden, and enjoy a meal at the restaurant or a snack in the café. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, a business center, and 24-hour front desk assistance. The 30 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, private bathrooms with showers and complimentary toiletries, safes, and desks. Daily housekeeping is provided. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

732354.description: The Hotel Cristal Setúbal is a new 4-star hotel in a central location, just 1, 500 meters from the city's main avenue, Avenida Luisa Todi. Its 85 contemporary and glamorous rooms offer a peaceful and tranquil environment. All rooms feature air conditioning, a minibar, a flat-screen TV, and a safe. Room types include Standard, Terrace, Suite, Junior Suite, and accessible rooms. The hotel provides free Wi-Fi throughout and offers a 24-hour reception with services such as shuttle service, car rental, taxi service, and luggage storage. Private parking is available for an additional fee. Guests can dine at the Cristal Restaurant, with a capacity for over 200 people, and enjoy the traditional Moscatel de Setúbal at the luxurious bar. Two multifunctional rooms are also available for events and conferences.

732454.description: Brenwin Guest House is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Cape Town. The hotel offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, Wi-Fi in public areas, car park, airport transfer, babysitting are just some of the facilities on offer. Some of the well-appointed guestrooms feature linens, mirror, internet access – wireless, internet access – wireless (complimentary), non smoking rooms. Take a break from a long day and make use of outdoor pool, garden. Brenwin Guest House combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make your stay in Cape Town unforgettable.

name.content: Regina - Quinta Sao Francisco Rural Resort

732552.address: Caminho dos Paihas Lugar de Romãe, S/N
732552.description: Quinta Sao Francisco offers accommodation full of charm, with updates and modern decorations. It has furniture, old decorations, agricultural materials that will make you relive old times. It has an outdoor pool, tennis court, games room, leisure room and an outdoor area for agricultural crops. All rooms have beautiful high ceilings decorated with wooden furniture. Guests can soak up the sun by the pool or hike over the mountain or soak in the vineyard. Other activities include hiking, cycling, tennis.

name.content: Millennium Place Barsha Heights Hotel Apartments

732581.address: First Al Khail Street Tecom, Barsha Heights
732581.description: Located in Dubai's Barsha Heights neighborhood, it is easily accessible by public transport on which the nearest bus stop is 150 metres away and is only a kilometre away from Dubai Internet City Metro Station. The property allows easy access to all this destination has to offer as it is located within 4 kilometres from the city centre and main entertainment areas. All 447 units come with tiled floors and features a fully equipped kitchenette with a microwave, fridge, stove top, a dining area, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, and a private bathroom with shower and a hairdryer. Guests at the hotel apartment can enjoy a buffet or a halal breakfast as the hotel takes pride in offering a choice of dining facilities which serve delicious culinary specialities. A kids' club is also available for guests at Millennium Place Barsha Heights Hotel Apartments.

733252.description: The recently opened Magnificat Wine Boutique Hotel & Spa offers 40 double rooms and 4 suites. Guests can enjoy on-site amenities such as a restaurant, wine tasting room, a modern spa featuring exclusive port wine treatments, indoor and outdoor pools, and a piano bar. Decorated in an elegant yet relaxed style, the hotel prioritizes guest comfort. Located in the Douro Valley, a UNESCO World Heritage site, it offers a range of activities from wine tastings and historical site visits to boat and train tours through the region. The Douro Valley is also renowned for its gastronomy. Approximately one hour from Douro International Airport, the hotel is close to Portugal's famed EN2, its longest road. As a new hotel, the Magnificat is focused on providing maximum comfort in a stylish setting that embraces the Douro's rich traditions.

733444.description: Located in downtown Geneva, Hotel Rousseau offers 25 air-conditioned rooms with minibars, espresso makers, and flat-screen TVs. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a ballroom. The hotel features a café, snack bar, and a bar/lounge. Continental breakfast is available for a fee. Nearby attractions include the Cité du Temps, Notre Dame Basilica, and the Rue du Rhône. Geneva International Airport (GVA) is 4. 2 miles away.

733454.description: Stop at Swiss Star Marc Aurel to discover the wonders of Zurich. Featuring a satisfying list of amenities, guests will find their stay at the property a comfortable one. Service-minded staff will welcome and guide you at Swiss Star Marc Aurel. Guestrooms are fitted with all the amenities you need for a good night's sleep. In some of the rooms, guests can find linens, towels, closet, heating, television. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Convenience and comfort make Swiss Star Marc Aurel the perfect choice for your stay in Zurich.

733455.description: The hotel consists of 20 guest rooms. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection available on-site. The reception desk is not open throughout the day.

733458.description: Enjoy garden views at INSIDE FIVE City Apartments, centrally located in Zürich. The aparthotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a picnic area, and an area shuttle (surcharge). The 28 guestrooms feature kitchens with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and ovens, flat-screen TVs with cable, and separate sitting areas. Housekeeping is provided weekly. Nearby attractions include the Swiss National Museum and Bahnhofstrasse (within a 5-minute drive). The Zurich Airport (ZRH) is 6. 7 miles away.

733461.description: Ideally located in the Zurich area, Swiss Star Zurich Airport promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. The property offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. Service-minded staff will welcome and guide you at Swiss Star Zurich Airport. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like flat screen television, linens, towels, closet, heating. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Friendly staff, great facilities, and close proximity to all that Zurich has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Swiss Star Zurich Airport.

733672.description: Jannah Dubai Creek is dedicated to perfecting the travel experience through innovation and the highest standards of hospitality. Immerse in elegantly appointed stays in one of 106 deluxe king rooms, 16 one-bedroom apartments and 16 two-bedroom apartments, each commanding unparalleled views of the dynamic Dubai Creekside.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam - North Riverside

733764.description: On the north shore of IJ-lake, Europe's largest Holiday Inn Express® is a modern high-rise hotel with 438 rooms and stunning views of Amsterdam's skyline. Opened in 2020, the Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam – North Riverside invites business and leisure travelers to enjoy trendy style and thoughtful amenities, including our Express Start ™ Breakfast, and parking. Enjoy dining and drinks at our casual restaurant, Express Café &Bar Noord, and relax in our spacious lobby and terrace. When it's time to explore, take a ferry boat ride or the metro to Amsterdam City Centre and the Central Station. Discover Amsterdam's scenic beauty and sights like the Anne Frank House, Foodhallen, and WONDR, moments away.

733794.description: Epicenter of the arts, Chelsea is Manhattan’s trendy neighborhood packed with cool culture and happening hotspots. Located between architectural delights, including the High Line, Hudson Yards, Chelsea Market, and the iconic Madison Square Garden, Selina Chelsea hotel sits in a prime position in this dynamic district and is the place to see and be seen. With on-site features including a garden, a HOWM restaurant, and a rooftop bar boasting panoramic views of the world’s most famous skyline, experience the best of the Big Apple right from our Chelsea NYC hotel. Start your day like a true New Yorker with a freshly-brewed coffee in our on-site cafe before walking around Chelsea’s artsy streets. Admire the works of both up-and-coming and renowned artists at local galleries before heading over for some obligatory Instagram snaps at the High Line and The Vessel at Hudson Yards.

733802.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool, a terrace, and a garden. This pousada also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a hair salon, and a communal living room. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (available on request), and free self-parking is available onsite. Each of the 28 guestrooms features a Smart TV and a pillowtop bed. Complimentary Wi-Fi and digital programming are provided for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers include hair dryers, toothbrushes, and toothpaste. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer: Olho D'Agua Hill - 4. 9 km / 3. 1 mi; Seven Falls Dam - 7. 1 km / 4. 4 mi; Cantareira State Park - 9 km.

733841.description: Located in the heart of the city, this adults-only hostel (18+ only, valid ID required upon check-in) offers modern facilities, including a large self-catering kitchen, private shower pods, and USB charging points/bed lights at each bunk. Enjoy free Wi-Fi, a daily city tour, and lively bar events. Security features include 24-hour reception, electronic key cards, CCTV, and security passes. Luggage storage is available before check-in. The hostel prides itself on cleanliness, with daily room cleaning and regular bathroom/kitchen maintenance. Friendly staff provide local tips, and discounts are available at the on-site bar (open 7 am-midnight).

733881.description: Pousada La Belle is designed for travelers who value well-being. The cozy spaces blend rustic and contemporary styles, creating a charming and comfortable atmosphere. Located in Itaguaí, Rio de Janeiro, this 3-star hotel is 23 km from Sepetiba Beach. Each room features air conditioning, a private bathroom, and free Wi-Fi.

734667.description: Situated in a quiet area, this business hotel is ideal for business travelers as well as families. It is located approximately 20 miles from the center of Ludwigsfelde. Guests can reach the nearest shops in about 15 miles. The hotel was modernized in 2019. The hotel has an elevator and features 73 non-smoking rooms. The multilingual staff at the reception desk in the lobby are ready to assist you with check-in and check-out. A fax machine, a smoke alarm, a non-smoking area and a lounge are available. Amenities include a drinks machine. Wireless internet access allows guests to stay connected while on vacation. The hotel offers a number of facilities for guests with disabilities. Wheelchair-accessible facilities are available. Guests arriving by car can park their vehicles in the parking lot. Air conditioning and central heating ensure that rooms maintain comfortable temperatures. Rooms have a double bed or a queen-size bed. A desk is provided. Equipped with a TV and WiFi, the rooms provide many ways for guests to stay connected and entertained. Bathrooms are equipped with a shower and include a hairdryer. Wheelchair-friendly rooms with wheelchair-accessible bathrooms are also available. 27 family rooms are available for parents with children.

734681.description: 'This Golssen hotel offers a variety of amenities for guests to enjoy, including bicycle rentals, complimentary Wi-Fi, babysitting services (surcharge), and wedding services. A shuttle service is available (surcharge) within a 3 km radius. Savor regional cuisine at the on-site restaurant, complete with a bar/lounge, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. The hotel also features multilingual staff, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. For events, the hotel offers 300 square meters of conference and meeting space. The 42 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions with digital programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks. Limited parking is available on-site. Nearby attractions include the Glashütte Nature Reserve (4. 9 km) and Dahme-Heideseen Nature Park (6. 3 km). '

name.content: Boutique Apartments in the Heart of Madrid

736341.description:
This The Boutique Apartments are attractively located behind the Plaza Mayor and just a 12-minute walk from The Prado Museum, 1. 2 km from Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum and 1. 0 km from Reina Sofia Museum. Puerta del Sol, la Plaza Santa Ana y La Latina are just around the corner. 

The apartments are equipped with air conditioning, fully equipped kitchen and a flat-screen HDTV. 

All apartments have new furniture and modern finishes. boutique hotel can be found in Puerta del Sol-Plaza Mayor.

737326.description: The 19 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Those staying at this establishment may keep updated thanks to the Wi-Fi access. Communal areas are wheelchair accessible at Slow Suites Luchana.

name.content: Damac Towers Arjaan By Rotana Riyadh

737382.description: This smoke-free hotel offers convenient access to nearby hot springs. Guests enjoy amenities such as express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free valet parking is available onsite. The 36 air-conditioned rooms provide smart TVs with digital programming and complimentary wireless internet access. Bathrooms feature separate bathtubs and showers, complimentary toiletries, and bathrobes. Safes and coffee/tea makers are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Located in the heart of Riyadh, DAMAC Riyadh - Luxury Apartments is a short drive from Kingdom Centre and Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib Hospital. This hotel is also convenient to King Saud University and Al-Raidah Digital City.

737386.address: R. Henri Dunant, 639/643 - Chácara Santo Antônio
737386.description: Featuring free WiFi throughout the property, Hospedagem Henri Dunant offers accommodations in Sao Paulo, in front of the U. S. Consulate-General. Each room includes a TV. Market Place SP Shopping Mall is 2953 feet from Hospedagem Henri Dunant, while Ponte Estaiada de Sao Paulo is 0. 7 mi away. Sao Paulo/Congonhas Airport is 2. 5 mi from the property.

738064.description:
Le Domaine de Tameslohte is charming hotel and restaurant nestled in the heart of an olive grove. Authentic and traditional site at only 15 minutes from the historical center of Marrakech. Its 1.5 hectare garden with swimming pool, jacuzzi and hammam make it a haven of peace and relaxation, far from the hustle and bustle of Marrakech's medina. The most athletic of you will also enjoy the new gym. 

The Domaine de Tameslohte is able to host 42 person in its 14 rooms.

738083.description: Discover the pinnacle of comfort and elegance when you stay at Urban Al Khoory Hotels, an innovative, vibrant and modern hotel built in the magnificent part of Dubai, Al Qouz, Dubai. Located just off Sheikh Zayed Road, the hotel offers an extremely convenient access to every part of the city, from the central business district to top shopping and entertainment destinations, art galleries and more. The hotel offers a selection of distinct rooms with excellent service. Indulge in comfort with outstanding Dubai views, and complimented with high class facilities and safety. Explore the world of food with in a charming all-day dining restaurant and chic lobby lounge. Keep up your health regimen with the hotels' fully equipped gym, or unwind in the refreshing outdoor jacuzzi and amazing rooftop swimming pool with a spectacular unique view Dubai.

738488.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Make yourself at home in one of the 54 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. 748988.description: With a breathtaking view over the Douro River and the Tedo River, it is in the heart of the Douro Wine Region that the Vila Galé Douro Vineyards is set. With a strong component of agro and wine tourism, this unit extends across the centuries-old Val Moreira Estate (Quinta do Val Moreira), which was already present in the famous Baron Forrester's map, created in the nineteenth century, which earned him the reputation of a cartographer. On the south bank of the Douro River, near the picturesque village of Marmelal, the property where Vila Galé Douro Vineyards is set is very close to one of the two stone markers built by order of the Marquis of Pombal in 1757. These markers are classified as property of public interest, and they were used to demarcate the zone of Douro fortified wines, which were at the time put under the jurisdiction of the General Company of Agriculture of the Alto Douro Vineyards (Companhia Geral da Agricultura das Vinhas do Alto Douro). This is how the first demarcated wine region of the world was born. Nowadays, terraced vineyards make the landscape that surrounds this unit unique. Vila Galé Douro Vineyards stands out for its location, charm and exclusivity. Here you can enjoy the calm and silence, the scenery, but also the outdoor pool, the regional cuisine of the Val Moreira restaurant, whose large windows allow you to gaze at the surroundings. But you may also enjoy tours to the wine cellar, as well as wine tastings of the Val Moreira brand's Port and table wines, which are produced there. You can also enjoy walking among the vineyards, the olive grove or the almond tree grove (which are particularly beautiful during the almond blossom season), always alongside the Tedo and Douro rivers. To complete your stay, take a river cruise, visit the region's wine producing estates or take a train ride. Admiring the almond blossoms or taking part in the grape harvests are other activity suggestions.

770195.description:
Located on the city of Lisbon, ON/SET Alfama gets inspired by one of the oldest neighborhoods of the city. With its Lisbon Cinema Apartments, it seeks to tell the unique stories from the great films of the golden age in Portuguese Cinema, set between the 40s and 50s of the 20th century.
Walking through Alfama, you will discover a neighborhood dedicated from the beginning to the diversity of cultures, habits and customs, the secrets and sounds of a neighborhood that was always outside the castle walls.
Discover steep and narrow streets, radiant sidewalks, full of color and tradition. From the smallest doors to the clothes hanging from the windows, from the tiles of the facades to the irregular pavement, Alfama has its own identity that will make any visitor fall in love.
The little cafés filled with people seeking to drink a cup of coffee, the Tagus river in the background, the buzzing of Lisbon, a city that never sleeps. Make a stop for a glass of wine and delight yourself with the beauty of the twilight. These are just a few experiences you can find in Alfama.
Vintage and contemporary meet in perfect harmony, as if in a film. It was on this stage that ON/SET Alfama – Lisbon Cinema Apartments debuted. A local accommodation where each studio seeks to share, in its decoration and experience, the great films that made a mark in the memory of the Portuguese people and Lisbon-born in particular.
The festivities, the marches and the Fado singers, the moments and the iconic personalities of the Portuguese universe that work as the meeting point between reality and fiction today, were the starting point.
For all these reasons, the Lisbon Cinema Apartments studios are more than just a place to live. Spaces with story and personality, where everyone can be the main character of their own story.
Be the actor in this perfect set.
Make your own story in Alfama.

Our beautifully appointed rooms and apartments cater to every comfort, featuring luxurious bedding, plush furnishings, and modern amenities. name.content: Holiday Inn - the niu, Fender Amsterdam

798024.description: Amsterdam is a water city - and the element also plays an important role at our Holiday Inn - the niu, Fender Amsterdam. In nautical terms, a fender is a protective body that is used in the harbor when docking and acts as a buffer between the ship and the quay wall. The name says it all at the city hotel Holiday Inn - the niu, Fender Amsterdam, which is located directly on the harbor on the urban island of Cruquiuseiland. A total of 246 rooms in two different categories are available for guests on ten floors. Here you will stay in a stylish and modern ambience that will make the hearts of interior lovers beat faster: The design concept by Dutch architect Robert Mulder picks up on the industrial and artisanal charm of the district. The rooms themselves also impress with their casual urban furnishing style and modern amenities, including Smart TV, Invisible sound system and air conditioning. High-speed WiFi is available free of charge in the entire hotel. Thanks to a desk, safe and USB ports in every room, business activities are no problem likewise. Our Living Lobby with its co-working space does not only invite you to work in a relaxed atmosphere but offers a hotel bar as well. A highlight is the café-restaurant on the 7th floor with an unforgettable view of the harbor and the city. You are welcome to join our rich breakfast buffet. For sightseeing tips, cab bookings, etc. our multilingual staff at the reception is available 24/7.

903694.description: Tucked away just a stone's throw from the lively city centre of Vienna, within the Margareten district, you'll find the Hotel Indigo Vienna - Naschmarkt. This beautiful hotel takes its design inspiration from the stories of its neighbourhood. The secret gardens and hidden green spaces of the area come alive in the hotel, across the charming terrace, beautiful courtyard, and rooftop garden as well as spilling into the interior design of the hotel public spaces and bedrooms. Take a stroll out of the hotel and you'll discover the nearby vibrant Naschmarkt, a must see for visitors and THE place where locals gather at all times of the day. At night once the shops close, a selection of unique restaurants and bars, influenced by cuisines from all over the world, come alive. The neighbourhood is also famed for its boutique shops, selling unique products you wouldn't find elsewhere. Situated perfectly for exploring the city, the hotel is within walking distance of the state opera, the “Steffl” (Stephansdom), and the museums and imposing buildings on the Ringstrasse. The hotel is well connected to local transport links and its right next door to the metro station U4 Pilgramgasse, meaning attractions such as the fairy's wheel at Prater and the majestic palace of Schoenbrunn are easy to explore.

921205.description: With 204 rooms and suites ranging from 32 sqm up to 188sqm creating the ideal place to stay and gather in Lisbon. 921360.description: Movenpick Jumeirah Village Triangle is a modern, five-star premium hotel passionate about making moments for guests through small gestures that make a big difference. The hotel blends style and comfort in its 166 modern rooms and suites with complimentary Wi-Fi, keeping you connected and offering the perfect retreat after a day of exploring the city or attending business meetings. Ease away in the relaxing sauna, steam room, or spa with treatments designed to enhance tranquility and calm. Younger guests can also enjoy well-deserved playtime in the on-site kids' aqua park!

921364.description: The 30 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. The establishment includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and rooms. As this hotel features 24-hour reception, guests are always welcome. All units at Sofitel Dubai The Obelisk Residence are wheelchair-accessible. Sofitel Dubai The Obelisk Residence provides parking for guests' convenience. The dining venue invites everyone staying at this accommodation to savour exquisite dishes in elegant ambience. Those seeking peace and tranquillity will find their best accommodation option at this hotel with plenty of health and wellness options.

921428.description: A boutique hotel defined by luxury and contemporary design, we create a bold yet inviting atmosphere, evoking warmth, comfort, and a sense of belonging. Ideally located next to the Noord metro station, we are just minutes from Amsterdam’s central station, vibrant city center, shopping, and entertainment. Tribe Amsterdam City is crafted for the modern urban traveler, offering inspiration in every corner for your next Instagrammable moment. Our flexible, design-led approach ensures an elevated experience focused on essentials—providing everything you need and nothing you don’t.

921709.description: Situated in Lusail, 8. 6 km from Lagoona Mall, Waterfront Hotel Apartment features accommodation with an outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a fitness centre and a restaurant. This 5-star hotel offers a business centre and a concierge service. The accommodation provides a 24-hour front desk, airport transfers, room service and free WiFi. The rooms in the hotel are fitted with a kettle. Rooms come with air conditioning, a wardrobe and a flat-screen TV, and some rooms at Waterfront Hotel Apartment have a terrace.

921713.address: Al Tarfa Service Rd Cielo Hotel Lusail
921713.description: Elegant Accommodation: Cielo Hotel Lusail Qatar in Lusail offers a 5-star experience with family rooms, interconnected rooms, and executive lounge access. Each room features air-conditioning, a private bathroom, and city views. Exceptional Facilities: Guests can enjoy a fitness centre, sun terrace, garden, outdoor swimming pool, and free WiFi. Additional amenities include a lounge, 24-hour front desk, concierge service, and free on-site private parking. Dining Experience: The modern, family-friendly restaurant serves international cuisine, complemented by a bar. Room service and a tour desk enhance the stay. Prime Location: Located 4 km from Lagoona Mall and 5 km from Doha Golf Club, the hotel is near attractions such as Qatar National Museum and Qatar Sports Club Stadium. Guests appreciate the convenient location, room cleanliness, and spacious rooms.

921830.description: The Newel Psychiko is an architectural gem in the affluent northeastern suburbs of Athens. Housed in a newly built, privately owned building, this ultra-stylish hotel elevates luxury accommodations. Its 22 elegantly appointed rooms and suites feature high-quality furnishings and thoughtful amenities for a wonderful Athenian stay. Decorated in neutral tones with chic touches of wood, metal, and modern lighting, the rooms and suites exude a cozy, laid-back atmosphere. Whether your visit is short or extended, for business or leisure, The Newel Psychiko offers a welcoming home away from home.

921929.description: Situated on a private beach along the Arabian Gulf, our luxurious villas, apartments, guest rooms, and suites offer an indulgent oasis. Resort style amenities include family-friendly and adult-only pools, cabanas, kids’ and teenagers’ clubs, wellness center and full-service spa. Enjoy onsite dining all day, drinks in our popular Peacock lounge or rooftop club, and sweet treats at the Chocolatier.

921940.description: The Apartment by Asset Hoteles are an exclusive set of apartments, opened in 2022 with the highest qualities, designed and inspired by the needs of our most demanding customers. Thanks to the wide range of services, which includes Wi-Fi, air conditioning, fully equipped kitchen and 50 TV', you can relax, and rest knowing that you have everything you need. Check in: 16:00Check out: 12:00No pets allowedGroups: Bookings of more than 3 apartments may be subject to surcharges and cancellation conditions and special payments.

922204.description: A Hotel where your senses will be captivated. From the beautiful landscapes over the Douro, through the aromas of the vineyards and the taste of olive oil, the Freixo Douro Superior invites you to a stay where you can get in contact with nature and with the best that cuisine and this beautiful region have to offer. Whether you want to discover the region solo, accompanied by family and friends, on a business trip or on a romantic getaway, the Freixo Douro Superior will have an offer that will undoubtedly amaze you and challenge your senses. Let yourself be surprised by what we have to offer, come and discover the beautiful Douro region while enjoying a glass of wine or tasting one of our wonderful gastronomic treats. Located in a region of great gastronomic and winemaking tradition, the Hotel offers all its guests the chance to feel part of the nature and history of this region.

922665.description: This luxurious hotel is located in Zurich. Dubbed the hottest new dining and nightlife destination in Switzerland, FIVE Zurich is a luxurious lifestyle hotel boasting 87 luxe suites and rooms with glittering skyline city views or lush forest views. Reviving Zurich's wild side, this new party and culinary hotspot boasts 7 international award-winning restaurants, a rooftop nightclub and buzzing outdoor social pool. Detox before you retox at the lavish wellness spa with indoor pool. FIVE Zurich will seamlessly unite the very best of Swiss hospitality with FIVE's characteristic flair for an exceptionally indulgent experience for guests from the city, and international visitors, alike. This stunning hotel overlooks the city center from Zurich's stunning Uetliberg plateau and is within a 10-minute drive to the city center and main attractions; and a 20-minute drive to Zurich's main airport. Direct access to public transport is within a 2-minute walk.

name.content: hub by Premier Inn Edinburgh - Royal Mile

922786.description: Keep your eyes peeled and your ears to the ground, as Edinburgh’s best stories unravel here on The Royal Mile. Beneath the cobbled streets, you’ll discover a hidden network of alleyways brimming with medieval mystery and history. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions.

name.content: Premier Inn Edinburgh Cc Royal Mile

922804.description: Located on one of the most prestigious and historic streets in Scotland, Premier Inn Edinburgh Royal Mile hotel has new-generation bedrooms each featuring an impressive 40" flat screen TV, bright, modern bathroom with a large shower head and slumber-inducing, king-size Hypnos beds. You can even indulge in contemporary dining at Thyme, our on-site restaurant. Edinburgh Old Town tops the charts when it comes to tourist and historical attractions. It's where you'll find the famous Royal Mile, Edinburgh Castle, the Palace of Holyroodhouse, the Scottish Parliament building and much more. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

name.content: Premier Inn Edinburgh Cc York Pl/St James Quarter

922806.description: Premier Inn Edinburgh City Centre (York Place) is positioned a short walk from the shopping mecca of Princes Street, Edinburgh Playhouse and Edinburgh Waverley train station. There's no end of things to get up to near this Edinburgh hotel. Walk the Royal Mile from the Palace of Holyroodhouse to Edinburgh Castle and you'll discover The Real Mary King's Close, Museum of Childhood and more. At the end of a long day, dine at Thyme then relax in style in one of our new-generation bedrooms each featuring an impressive 40" flat screen TV, bright, modern bathroom with a large shower head, and slumber-inducing, king-size Hypnos bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

name.content: hub by Premier Inn Edinburgh Cc Rose Street

922816.description:
Rose St is part of the patchwork of atmospheric alleys, squares and gardens that make up Edinburgh’s New Town. 

With a vibrant arts scene, style-conscious shopping and a long stretch of buzzing drinking dens, lively Rose St is one of the most flocked-to streets in the Scottish capital. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions.

name.content: Premier Inn Edinburgh Airport - M9 Jct1

922842.description: Start your Scottish adventure with Premier Inn Hotel Edinburgh Airport (Newbridge). With great nearby transport links, you'll be well placed to head off to the Scottish Highlands or jet off to Europe and beyond. Look out across the city from Edinburgh Castle. Get a taste of royal life at Holyrood House. Show your support at Murrayfield Stadium. Or if it's the right time of year, catch the weird and wonderful at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival. Then relax in our tasty restaurant and unwind in your extra-comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

922843.description: If you want your pick of upmarket shops and historic landmarks, you'll be hard pressed to beat Premier Inn Edinburgh City Centre (Princes Street) Hotel. Steeped in history and majesty, today's Princes Street is a pedestrianised mecca of top retail brands, with pub-packed Rose Street on one side and the beautiful Princes Street Gardens along the other. Across the road from the hotel is The Mound, connecting Princes Street to Old Town, and Edinburgh Castle and the famous Royal Mile are a short (but steep) 15 minute walk. Then it's homeward bound to a delicious meal with a castle view at our Thyme restaurant. Then get comfy in our luxury king-size Hypnos bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions.

922844.description: Slumber by the sea at the Premier Inn Hotel Edinburgh Leith Waterfront. In a prime harbour location, you're still within easy reach of all the attractions of the historic city centre. And if you're here to work, we're close to key business destinations like the Scottish Parliament, too. Get regal with a visit to Royal Yacht Britannia or Holyrood Palace. Head for the city and storm the walls at Edinburgh Castle. Then indulge in some world-class retail therapy on Princes Street, or enjoy a relaxing stroll around the Royal Botanic Gardens. After a busy day, kick back and relax in our tasty restaurant, spacious rooms and extra-comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

922845.description: Want all the buzz of the city, without the hustle and bustle? Look no further than Premier Inn Hotel Edinburgh Park, situated in a quiet neighbourhood just minutes from the sights and sounds of the city centre. Whether you're looking for culture, entertainment, or are here on business, we'll make sure you wake up ready to explore. You could zip into the city centre and hunt down big brand bargains on Princes Street. Then stroll up the Royal Mile for a great view of Edinburgh from the Castle. Catch the big match at Murrayfield Stadium, or go wild at Edinburgh Zoo. After a busy day, head back for a bite to eat in our tasty restaurant, and a great night's sleep in your extra-comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

name.content: Premier Inn Birmingham Central Hagley Road

922849.description: Welcome to the 'Goldilocks' of Birmingham hotels: not too near to the hustle and bustle, not too far from the action. From Premier Inn Hagley Road, you can easily reach all the main sights and business venues, whether you're travelling solo or with 'little bears' in tow. Explore the array of sights around the centre, from the Sea Life Centre to top-notch shopping. Be perfectly placed for the must-see events and conferences at the ICC, NIA and NEC. Or cool down in the gorgeous Botanical Gardens. Then return to our friendly team - with our Beefeater Restaurant, spacious rooms and extra-comfy beds, everything will be spot on for a perfect stay. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

name.content: Premier Inn Birmingham City - Waterloo St

922850.description: Put yourself at the centre of everything here at Premier Inn Birmingham Waterloo Street. Looking out across St Philips Square and the Cathedral, the major attractions and major businesses are just a hop, skip and jump away. You can browse the big brands and designer names of the Bull Ring, catch the must-see events at the Hippodrome Theatre, Symphony Hall, NIA or ICC, or find chocoholic's heaven at Cadbury World. After a day's business or indulgence, return and savour the food (and views) at our bar and grill before relaxing in our spacious rooms and extra-comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

923027.description: Whether you're just passing through or have time to stop and explore, you'll find a warm welcome at the Premier Inn Hotel Falkirk East. And with such great transport links nearby, you can easily zip into Edinburgh, Glasgow and Stirling or explore the Highlands. But there's plenty to see nearby, too. Go for a spin at Falkirk Wheel, the world's only rotating boat lift. Show your support at Falkirk Football Stadium. Or travel in style on Bo'ness and Kinneil heritage railway. After a busy day, head back for a bite to eat in our tasty restaurant, and relax in your huge comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

923042.description: Set in rural surroundings to the south west of Birmingham, staying at Premier Inn Hagley makes it easy to strike out into the country or shoot into the city. And with plenty of business venues and leisure attractions within easy reach, you'll be well set up during your stay. Ride the rails at the Severn Valley Railway. Enjoy a big day at Hagley Hall. Put in some putting time on the golf course. Then fill up at our Beefeater restaurant and curl up in our wonderfully comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

923043.description: If you love shopping, you'll love staying at Premier Inn Stourbridge Town Centre. Only two miles south of Merry Hill shopping centre and ten miles west of Birmingham, you can shop to your heart's delight before returning for a delicious dinner at our Brewers Fayre restaurant. Be sure to visit Red House Glass Cone where you'll learn all about Stourbridge's famous glassmaking history, or go wild at West Midlands Safari Park - just a half hour drive from the hotel. Then, after a busy day, relax in on of our new generation bedrooms, with an impressive 40" flat screen TV, freshly-updated bathroom with large shower head, and brand new, slumber-inducing, king-size Hypnos bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

923079.description: Premier Inn Redditch North A441 is sure to help you wake up blooming. Conveniently located near the A441 and M42, it makes a great base for exploring Birmingham, visiting the NEC, or as a pit stop on your journey. After recharging the batteries, it's well worth exploring the local area. You're just minutes from chocoholic's paradise at Cadbury World, history-lover's heaven at Warwick Castle and the family friendly Drayton Manor Theme Park. And, with dreamy new beds, spacious rooms and a Beefeater Restaurant, you're sure to sleep in style. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

name.content: Premier Inn Solihull - Hockley Heath M42

923087.description: Look out of your window at Solihull Hockley Heath, M42 and you'll see countryside all around you. In fact you'll be surprised by just how green the Black Country really is. And, with Shakespeare's hometown just up the road, the stage is set for a great break. Watch star-crossed lovers Romeo and Juliet at Stratford. Or watch modern lovers get married at nearby wedding venues. See the jousting at Warwick Castle. Then taste the chocolate at Cadbury World. Comfy beds and a Beefeater restaurant will welcome you home where you can drift off to a great night's sleep. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

923088.description: If you like shopping you'll love Premier Inn Solihull. Shop till you drop in Birmingham city centre, within easy reach by bus or train. Or just drop in to Touchwood Shopping Centre right opposite the hotel. This is the perfect place to stay for the NEC too. From big name department stores to little gems in the Jewellery Quarter, Birmingham's shops have something for everyone. When you've had enough retail therapy, unwind some more in Tudor Grange Park, then return to our tasty Thyme restaurant, spacious rooms and comfy beds for the perfect end to your busy day. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

923097.description: With Drayton Manor Theme Park, home of Thomas the Tank Engine, not far away, Premier Inn Tamworth Central makes a popular stop for families. Located in the heart of a busy market town, next to a great retail park, it's also within easy reach of Birmingham City Centre, Lichfield Cathedral City and the M42. Step back in time and experience early medieval life at Tamworth Castle. Check out the events at the NEC in Birmingham. Or whizz down the UK's first full-sized real snow ski slope at the Snowdome. Then relax in our spacious rooms and extra-comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

923107.description: Just up the road from the M5 and the M6, Premier Inn Hotel West Bromwich is right at the heart of the action. If you're away on work, the Black Country is only a short drive away, while Birmingham is just up the road too. Take the nearby Metro into Birmingham or Wolverhampton to enjoy a great day out without the hassle of driving. Or travel back in time at the Black Country Museum to see the industrial heritage. Drayton Manor and West Midlands Safari Park are well worth a visit too. At the end of the day, come back to a tasty meal in our restaurant and a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

923305.description: The Terminal Inn By Edar City Center, built in 2020, offers 96 welcoming accommodations. 923777.description: The hotel التميز الراقي بني مالك offers comfortable accommodations in Jeddah, conveniently located near Al Andalus Mall (2. 9 km) and Nassif House Museum (6 km). Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant, 24-hour front desk service, room service, and free WiFi throughout the property. Family rooms are also available. Each room features a TV, private bathroom with a bidet, slippers, free toiletries, air conditioning, and a wardrobe. The hotel is also conveniently located near Jeddah Corniche (6 km) and Jeddah Mall (7 km). King Abdulaziz International Airport is 17 km away. Guests appreciate the hotel's convenient location, rating it an 8. 0.

Enjoy your own studio or a private room in a shared apartment with access to fantastic communal facilities, including a co-working space, gym, patio, swimming pool, and video room. A security deposit of 1000 AED (or $200/€200) is required and refundable upon departure. Please note that rooms (excluding apartments) are situated within shared apartments.
