The hotel offers dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and free valet parking. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers, and rooms also feature phones, desks, and complimentary newspapers. Nearby attractions include the Cornelio Pires History and Teaching Museum (19. 4 km) and Castelo Park Aquatico (33. 6 km).

924011.description: Located in São Paulo's vibrant Liberdade district, the GLÓRIA PLAZA HOTEL offers convenient access to Paulista Avenue and Rua 25 de Marco, both within a 5-minute drive. Enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast daily, and unwind at the coffee shop, snack bar, or bar/lounge. The hotel provides free valet parking and complimentary Wi-Fi in all 30 air-conditioned guestrooms. Each room features cable TV and a desk, with daily housekeeping provided. Nearby attractions include Liberty Square, Sé Square, and the Municipal Theatre of São Paulo. São Paulo (CGH-Congonhas) Airport is 10. 2 km away, while São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport (GRU) is 30. 6 km from the hotel.

924012.description: Summit Beach Hotel Boiçucanga is a front sea view hotel. Located on the sands of Boiçucanga Beach and a few steps from shops, restaurants and bars and offers an outdoor pool facing the sea. Wi-Fi and private parking are free. The daily breakfast buffet offers a variety of fresh fruits, breads and cold meats. Guests can also enjoy regional specialties, as well as a selection of drinks in the hotel's restaurant and bar that works from 11am till 10pm with Dinner and Lunch A La Carte, Bar and Room service. All rooms at Summit Beach Hotel Boiçucanga come with air-conditioning, minibar and cable TV. The hotel also offers facilities for disabled guests. Central Boiçucanga is 700 metres from the hotel. Maresias and Juquehy are 20 minutes' drive from Summit Beach Hotel Boiçucanga. São Sebastião is 43 km away.

924020.description: This unpretentious hotel is set in Vila Olimpia.

924230.description: The Editory Boulevard Hotel graces Porto's Avenida dos Aliados, a vibrant hub known for its history and architecture. Here, diverse styles and cultures intertwine seamlessly, from the everyday charm of clotheslines draped between windows to the elegance of neighboring boutiques. The hotel embodies this eclectic spirit, reflecting the city's constant evolution through its art, literature, cuisine, and rich history etched in the granite streets.

924246.description: Al Khaleej Palace Deira Hotel features a restaurant, outdoor swimming pool, a fitness center and bar in Dubai. With free WiFi, this 4-star hotel offers a business center and a concierge service. The property provides a 24-hour front desk, room service and currency exchange for guests. At the hotel, each room has air conditioning and a flat-screen TV. Al Khaleej Palace Deira Hotel offers a continental or à la carte breakfast. Grand Mosque is 1. 9 km from the accommodation, while Dubai World Trade Centre is 4. 8 km away. The nearest airport is Dubai International Airport, 4 km from Al Khaleej Palace Deira Hotel.

924279.description: Situated in Petropolis, Pedra Bonita is a hotel surrounded by nature with mountain views with private chalets and free WiFi in public areas. It offers a variety of fun outdoor activities and a pool with a bar service. The cosy suites and wooden chalets at the Kastel Pedra Bonita have country furniture, and are equipped with air conditioning and a cable TV. Chalets have a large hot tub. The restaurant offers a blend of rustic and contemporary design and has a contemporary cuisine. A breakfast buffet with homemade cakes, biscuits and marmalades is available daily. Kastel Pedra Bonita is situated 60 km from Galeao Airport, and 10-minutes by car from Itaipava, known for its gastronomy. It is also a 20-minute drive from Petrópolis city centre.

924281.description: Located on top of the Vidigal Favela, Mirante do Arvrao features a deck with panoramic and outstanding views of Leblon and Ipanema Beaches. This elegant hotel offers free WiFi, restaurant, bar, terrace and shared lounge. Experience an unforgettable stay at Mirante do Arvrão, one of Rio de Janeiro’s most iconic viewpoints. Here, your stay goes far beyond comfort, it becomes a journey into nature, culture, and one of the most breathtaking landscapes in the city. Located in the heart of Vidigal, a neighborhood known for its artistic energy and welcoming atmosphere, Mirante offers the perfect setting for travelers seeking beauty, tranquility, and authentic Rio vibes. On one side, the endless ocean; on the other, the lush Atlantic Forest; and right in front, a cinematic panorama of Rio: Leblon, Ipanema, Lagoa and Arpoador. Exclusive New Year’s Eve Experience – For Guests Only Your stay becomes even more special with our signature New Year’s Eve celebration, created to elevate your experience: New Year’s Eve party with reduced capacity for comfort and exclusivity Premium Open Bar and Open Food with exceptional gastronomy Front-row view of Copacabana’s fireworks The privilege of watching the first sunrise of 2026 from the top of Mirante Exclusive private lounge (camarote) for guests, guaranteeing the best views and full comfort throughout the night And on January 1st… Start the new year in the best way possible: all guests enjoy exclusive access to a live performance by Rodriguinho, right here at the Mirante, a musical experience surrounded by one of Rio’s most stunning views. Designed by Hélio Pellegrino Mirante do Arvrão features architectural design by Hélio Pellegrino, a renowned architect and visual artist. Every detail reflects his artistic vision, blending culture, aesthetics, and a truly unforgettable atmosphere. At the hotel, rooms come with a balcony with a sea view.

924285.description: City Stay Premium Hotel Apartments offers 160 studio, double, triple, and family apartments in the heart of Deira, a shopper's paradise. Each apartment features a fully equipped kitchen with a hot plate, mini-fridge, microwave, kettle, toaster, crockery, cutlery, and basic cookware. Guests can enjoy amenities including a swimming pool, sauna, and gym, along with complimentary internet access. Paid parking, storage, and packing services are also available. Ideal for leisure travelers, the aparthotel is a 15-minute drive from Dubai International Airport and a short walk from supermarkets, groceries, and the Dhow cruise at the creek.

924304.description: This modern four-star hotel, built in 2023, is located in the El Clot/Sagrera district, just 12 minutes from Plaza de Catalunya by metro. The Sagrada Familia is a short nine-minute metro ride or a 15-minute walk away. Arcelon Hotel offers a 24-hour reception, luggage storage, free Wi-Fi throughout, a rooftop swimming pool, and a relaxing solarium. Guests can also utilize the meeting room and private paid parking, as well as a comfortable, avant-garde lobby perfect for relaxing or working. Accessible rooms are available. Each morning, a delicious breakfast buffet is served. All rooms feature a 50-inch TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning/heating, a paid minibar, a kettle, a free safe, an iron and ironing board, a hairdryer, and a private bathroom. The hotel is surrounded by shops, bars, and supermarkets, with the Glòries shopping center and the Agbar Tower just a 10-minute walk away. A bus stop is located directly across from the hotel, and the Navas or El Clot metro station (with direct lines to the airport and city center) is nearby.

924517.description:
A stay at Riad Dihya places you in the heart of Marrakech, within a 10-minute walk of Jemaa el-Fnaa and Dar Tiskiwin Museum.  This riad is 3.8 mi (6.2 km) from Avenue Mohamed VI and 4.4 mi (7 km) from Majorelle Gardens.

Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge.
Grab a bite to eat at the riad's poolside restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Make yourself at home in one of the 7 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. 924537.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. Enjoy local and international cuisine at The Dining Room, one of the aparthotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Abuja? This aparthotel has 2906 square feet (270 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 4 meeting rooms. The Mouassine Museum is around 300 metres away, while the Boucharouite Museum, the Orientalist Museum of Marrakech and the iconic Koutoubia Mosque are also within easy reach. 

Riad Milouda combines the charm of traditional Moroccan hospitality with the essential comforts of a modern stay. The property features comfortable, non-smoking rooms, each with a private bathroom, as well as free WiFi, a shared lounge and a pleasant terrace where guests can relax after a day exploring the lively streets of the Medina. 

A continental breakfast is served each morning, providing a convenient start to the day before discovering Marrakech’s souks, palaces, museums and historic landmarks.

The property’s central location allows guests to immerse themselves in the unique atmosphere of the Medina, with traditional markets, local craftsmanship, historic monuments and the energy of Jemaa el-Fna all just moments away. 

Marrakech-Menara Airport is approximately 7 km from the riad. 

Riad Milouda is an excellent choice for travellers looking to experience the authentic spirit of Marrakech while staying in one of the city’s most popular and convenient areas.

964962.description:
Located in the vibrant heart of Athens, Priamos Hotel Erato offers a unique adults-only hospitality experience, combining comfort, privacy, and easy access to the city’s most iconic landmarks. Situated in the historic Thissio district, the hotel is within walking distance of the Acropolis, Ancient Agora, Monastiraki, Plaka, and the lively Gazi entertainment area. 

Designed exclusively for adult guests, Priamos Hotel Erato features individually themed rooms, creating a distinctive atmosphere for romantic getaways, special occasions, or city breaks. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, free high-speed Wi-Fi, Smart TV, private bathroom, complimentary toiletries, and comfortable bedding to ensure a relaxing stay. 

Guests benefit from a 24-hour front desk, daily housekeeping service, room service options, and easy access to public transportation, including nearby metro and bus stations. The hotel’s central location allows visitors to explore Athens’ archaeological treasures, museums, shopping streets, restaurants, cafés, and nightlife venues within minutes. 

Key attractions nearby include the Acropolis, Acropolis Museum, Ancient Agora, Temple of Hephaestus, Monastiraki Square, Ermou Shopping Street, Plaka, Technopolis City of Athens, Filopappou Hill, Syntagma Square, and the National Archaeological Museum. 

Athens International Airport is approximately 38 km away, while the Port of Piraeus can be reached within a short drive. Priamos Hotel Erato is an ideal base for travelers seeking a central location, privacy, comfort, and direct access to the cultural and entertainment highlights of Athens.

The nearby Ellinikon Metropolitan Park and the landmark Ellinikon development project further enhance the area’s appeal, while Athens International Airport is easily accessible by car. 

Combining privacy, themed accommodation, modern amenities, and a strategic location, X Hotel Salem offers an unforgettable stay for couples and adult travelers visiting Athens.

Featuring 132 opulent suites, each with personalised butler service and a terrace affording views of the sea or the city, as well as seven spectacular restaurants/bars and a restorative wellness spa, Raffles Doha promises an unparalleled stay in Qatar's capital.

973128.description: The accomodation consists of 22 guest rooms. Aspasios Calle Mayor Apartments includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and bedrooms. Aspasios Calle Mayor Apartments does not offer 24-hour reception. Communal areas are wheelchair accessible at this apartment.

973129.address: Prince Mohammed Ibn Salman Ibn Abdulaziz,qurtubah
973129.description: This accomodation offers a total of 30 units. Moments Living Hotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection on-site. All guests staying at this property may contact the reception desk any time during the day. Moments Living Hotel understands that accessibility is important to all guests. For this reason, it features wheelchair accessible guest rooms and is fully adapted for easy access. Moments Living Hotel provides parking for guests' convenience.

973163.address: 48 Mesaied Al Wakrah Rd Al Wakrah Qatar, 48
973163.description: Retaj Inn Al Wakrah hotel is overlooking the Arabian Gulf and is located just minutes away from Souq Al Wakrah, Doha International Airport, and across the street from Al Wakrah Public Beach. The Hotel design is a unique blend of traditional Qatari architecture and modern interior design, offering a mix between the past and the present, our 56 rooms and suites are all equipped with the facilities and amenities to make your stay comfortable. Retaj Inn Al Wakrah hotel also has a restaurant, a café zone, and an events hall that can accommodate up to 200 guests. In addition to, a well equipped gym. Retaj Inn Al Wakrah hotel is an ideal destination for business professionals, leisure travelers, and families looking for a convenient stay in Qatar while enjoying our renowned arabian hospitality.

973167.description: Aspasios Sagrada Familia Apartments guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 9 guest rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available for further comfort and convenience. Aspasios Sagrada Familia Apartments does not operate a 24-hour reception. The premises offer accessible public areas.

973168.description: Swissotel Living Jeddah offers a 5 star living experience in the heart of city. Close to iconic attractions like AlBalad, Corniche and an array of businesses, our stylish hotel is ideally located for both business travellers and those vacationing in the Kingdom. Unwind in our modern designed living experience, with complimentary WiFi, modern kitchenette, luxury linens and purovel amenities. Savor international cuisine at our dining destinations.

973238.description: This sophisticated hotel is in Jumeirah. The total number of guest rooms is 526. NH Collection Dubai The Palm invites guests to revel in the unique delights of the city from its prime location while enjoying outstanding service at the hotel. Just steps from the modern property is the exclusive private beach club, overlooked by the hotel's rooftop infinity pool. Guests can feel relaxed after visiting one of the NH Collection spa's three treatment rooms or invigorated from a session at the hotel's gym, open 24/7. NH Collection Kids Club is open for use by our guests aged 4 to 12 years old from 08:00 to 19:00 each day. Guests enjoy direct beach access over the promenade and are just a short journey from all of Dubai’s top attractions, including the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall and Dubai Marina. Our sunset-facing rooftop infinity pool with its elegant bar and lounge is the perfect place to relax between excursions. Those seeking excitement can indulge at the hotel’s lively sports bar, Dubai’s new go-to.

973300.address: Al Asayel Street Bay Square Dubai
973300.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Wrap up your day with a drink at the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. This hotel has 2 meeting rooms available for events. A shuttle from the airport to the hotel is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 192 guestrooms, featuring fireplaces and indoor private spa tubs. LED televisions with premium TV channels are provided, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

973384.description: Beautiful City Suites offers a central Athens location, steps from Monastiraki Flea Market and the Ancient Agora. This guesthouse provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an on-site restaurant and snack bar. Guests can enjoy continental breakfast for a fee, relax on the terrace, or rent bicycles to explore the city. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge). The 5 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs, private lanais, and en suite bathrooms with complimentary toiletries.

973431.description: Enjoy stunning rooftop terrace views at the Ederlezi Zoubourlou Aparthotel, centrally located in Athens, steps from Ermou Street and an 8-minute walk from the Acropolis. This guesthouse offers complimentary Wi-Fi and a bar/lounge. Each of the four individually decorated guestrooms features a refrigerator, LCD TV, private bathroom with designer toiletries, and blackout drapes. The aparthotel provides express check-in/check-out. Nearby attractions include Monastiraki Flea Market (0. 2 mi) and Syntagma Square (0. 7 mi). Athens International Airport (ATH) is 21. 5 miles away.

973561.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a rooftop terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. At Hotel AMANO East Side, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 174 air-conditioned rooms featuring heated floors and flat-screen televisions. Satellite programming and tablet computers are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. This eco-certified hotel is 0. 7 mi (1. 2 km) from Uber Arena and 2. 8 mi (4. 5 km) from Checkpoint Charlie.

973568.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and a hair salon. Additional amenities at this hostel include a communal living room and a reception hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the hostel's coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Make yourself at home in one of the 48 guestrooms. Prepare your meals in the shared/communal kitchen. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. 973680.description: This simple hotel is situated in Milan.

973712.description: In Cassano Magnago, Hotel Roma features a large terrace with tables and chairs and free Wi-Fi in all public areas of the property. All rooms have a satellite flat-screen TV. The rooms are decorated in a simple style and feature wood furniture. Each has a private bathroom and independent heating. The Roma Hotel serves a continental breakfast in the dining room. It includes both sweet and savory items. Milan Malpensa Airport is a 20-minute drive away. Gallarate is 10 minutes away by car.

973800.description: This simple hotel is in Potsdam.

973818.description: Enjoy terrace views at The Link Athens, a guesthouse in Athens City Centre, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi. The six air-conditioned rooms offer flat-screen TVs and private bathrooms with jetted bathtubs. Located within a 5-minute drive of Syntagma Square and Ermou Street, and conveniently close to the Olympia Theatre and National Archaeological Museum, this guesthouse provides easy access to Athens' key attractions. The Acropolis and Parthenon are just a short drive away. Athens International Airport (ATH) is 33. 6 km from the property.

973898.description: The GINN City & Lounge Yorck Berlin offers a relaxing stay in Berlin's vibrant Kreuzberg district. Enjoy amenities such as bicycle rentals, a garden, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a snack bar/deli. A bar/lounge and buffet breakfast (available for a fee) are also on offer. Each of the 121 guestrooms features a minibar, cable TV, and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Laptop-compatible safes and desks are also provided. The hotel is conveniently located within a 5-minute drive of Potsdamer Platz and Brandenburg Gate, and close to attractions such as the German Museum of Technology and Tempodrom. Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER) is approximately 14. 8 miles away.

973910.description: Enjoy garden views at Corte Milano - Hostel in Rozzano, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi and a communal living room. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. The 59 air-conditioned rooms offer LCD TVs, pillowtop beds with down comforters, and complimentary wired and wireless internet. Bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. The hostel provides luggage storage, laundry facilities, an elevator, and limited onsite parking. A short drive from Istituto Clinico Humanitas and Mediolanum Forum, it's also convenient to Milanofiori and Scalo Milano.

973992.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and a communal living room at this conveniently located Athens hotel. Mingle with fellow guests at the daily complimentary reception. The hotel offers express check-in, multilingual staff, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Each of the 19 air-conditioned rooms features a kitchenette equipped with a microwave and espresso maker, a 32-inch flat-screen TV with satellite programming, and a minibar. Housekeeping is provided once per stay. Located in the heart of Athens, the hotel is within a 5-minute drive of Omonoia Square and the Temple of Olympian Zeus, and close to attractions like the Olympia Theatre and the National Archaeological Museum. Athens International Airport (ATH) is 33. 9 km (21. 1 mi) away.

974002.description:
In a privileged location in the Central Station Area district of Milan, Aiello Hotels - Centrale is located 200 meters from Central Metro Station, 1. 2 km from Bosco Verticale and 1. 6 km from GAM Milano. The property is located around 2. 2 km from Pinacoteca di Brera, 2. 3 km from Milano Dateo Metro Station and 3. 2 km from San Babila Metro Station. Free WiFi is always available, while private parking can be used at an additional cost. 

This guest house offers guests air-conditioned rooms equipped with a desk, electric kettle, minibar, safe, flat-screen TV and private bathroom with bidet. All units feature a wardrobe. 

At Aiello Hotels - Centrale you can enjoy an Italian breakfast. 

Villa Necchi Campiglio is 3. 3 km from this property, while Arena Civica is 3. 4 km from the property. The airport (Milan Linate Airport) is 8 km away, and there is a paid airport shuttle organized by the property to reach it.

974237.description: Tranquility in DoloresWelcoming hotel with thermal pools, inside Dolores Thermal ParkJoin us at Days Inn by Wyndham Dolores Hotel Termal, located within the recreational oasis of Dolores Thermal Park—featuring both indoor and outdoor pools and hot springs—and minutes from the city center. While you’re here, take advantage of free breakfast and WiFi along with two thermal pools, a spa, and on-site restaurant. Our non-smoking hotel is located in the Buenos Aires province and within reach of Ministro Juan Pistarini International Airport (EZE), Jorge Newbery International Airport (AEP), and Astor Piazzolla International Airport (MDQ).

974241.description: Those staying at this accomodation may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. The hotel provides 24-hour reception. This property features a choice of different health and wellness facilities ideal for visitors to recharge mentally and physically. Travellers may work out and keep active during their stay thanks to the sport facilities and activities offered. Some services may be payable.

974344.description: Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. The reception does not work around the clock. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

974449.description: Hotel Solaris offers accommodations in Setúbal. Guests can enjoy the on-site bar. Every room at this hotel is air conditioned and has a flat-screen TV with cable channels. Some units feature a seating area to relax in after a busy day. The rooms include a private bathroom fitted with a bath or shower. For your comfort, you will find bath robes, free toiletries and a hair dryer. Hotel Solaris features free WiFi throughout the property. There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. The hotel also offers bike hire and car hire. Museu de Setúbal is 1969 feet from Hotel Solaris, while Albarquel Urban Park is 0. 9 mi away. The nearest airport is Portela Airport, 21 mi from the property.

This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Hotel Poveira, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 27 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. 974543.description: First mentioned in 1421, the elegant Atrium BLUME Baden Hotel & Restaurant is located in the heart of Baden’s spa area, directly on the Limmat River. It features a sauna, steam bath, restaurant, and in-house thermal spring. Free WiFi is available. Stretching over 4 floors, the atrium is decorated with flowers and plants. The gallery in the interior courtyard radiates a Mediterranean ambiance, while the Belle Epoque Saal historic ceiling paintings, chandeliers and elegant parquet flooring. The individually furnished rooms at Atrium BLUME Baden Hotel & Restaurant are nonsmoking and feature an LED flat-screen TV.

974578.description: This cosy hotel is set in Zurich.

974839.description: A stately mansion in a seaside village, where classic hospitality is merged with contemporary comforts… what could be more enticing? Equally impressive on the inside, warmly decorated rooms create a welcoming environment in which to unwind after a day of activities. With the picture-perfect dunes and the broadest beach of North Holland just around the corner, nature enthusiasts can enjoy hours of walking and cycling. In Wijk aan Zee, tranquility and liveliness merge effortlessly; the village offers a selection of bars and restaurants and popular clubs can be found on the beach. With Haarlem, Alkmaar and Amsterdam not 19 mi away, the bustling city life is easily enjoyed.

974896.description: This hotel offers free WiFi, free public parking, and is located 0. 6 mi from the Gardens of the World Park. Each room comes with TV and a private bathroom with a full-body mirror. The soundproofed rooms at Parkhotel Marzahn are decorated in neutral colors. They each have a seating area and a safe. S-Bahn Station Marzahn is located 1. 6 mi from the hotel, with directly links to Berlin Main Station and Alexanderplatz. BER Airport is 13 mi away and the A10 motorway is 5. 6 mi from Parkhotel Marzahn.

974898.description: Situated in Berlin, 2. 7 km from Berlin Central Station, Apple City Hotel features accommodation with a garden, free private parking, a shared lounge and a terrace. The property is around 4. 1 km from Brandenburg Gate, 4. 1 km from Berliner Philharmonie and 4. 3 km from Kurfürstendamm. The property is 1. 8 km from the city centre and 3. 5 km from Natural History Museum. The rooms in the hotel are fitted with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Featuring a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer, rooms at Apple City Hotel also boast free WiFi. Speaking German, English and Russian, staff are ready to help around the clock at the reception. Reichstag is 4. 3 km from the accommodation, while Zoologischer Garten underground station is 4. 5 km from the property. Berlin Brandenburg Willy Brandt Airport is 26 km away.

975036.description: This 2-star hotel presents bright, comfortable accommodations in a peaceful spot not far from Milan's hustle and bustle. Free WiFi is available throughout. Whether on leisure or business, appreciate the proximity to the excellent transport network and the business and historical hub. You can enjoy the facilities on site, relax in the welcoming lobby, sip beverages in the bar or simply unwind in your fully equipped, tastefully decorated room. Venture from the hotel and explore the plethora of attractions on your doorstep. Visit the mixture of museums, embark on a spot of shopping in Corso Como or sample the colorful nightlife. Embrace the small-scale comfort and air of tranquility which characterizes this vibrant property.

975039.description: A flat-screen TV and fully fitted kitchenette are standard in all apartments at Residence Giusti 6. The property is a 10-minute walk from Moscova Metro Station and the green gardens of Parco Sempione. Studios and apartments come with private bathroom and dining area. They are decorated with light furniture. Some also have a balcony. The Giusti Residence is 1. 8 km from CityLife Exhibition Centre and a 20-minute walk from Castello Sforzesco. The Expo 2015 Exhibition Centre is 12 km away.

975092.address: Calle Ernesto Diez Canseco 212 Dpto 401 Miraflores
975092.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this Art Deco guesthouse include a communal living room and bike parking. Guests can catch a ride on the shuttle (surcharge), which operates within 10 kilometers. Grab a bite from the grocery/convenience store serving guests of Larq'a Park Rooms. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. For a surcharge, guests may use a shuttle from the hotel to the airport (available 24 hours) and a bus station shuttle. Make yourself at home in one of the 6 guestrooms featuring microwaves and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

975099.address: Rua Do Paco 270 Vitorino De Donas
975099.description: Dating back to the 16th century, Hotel Paço de Vitorino is located a 10-minute drive from Ponte de Lima center, featuring a Baroque-style garden. This manor house provides free WiFi and an iPod docking station in the rooms. Rooms are located in 3 different wings, and they all include air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a mini-bar and a Estremoz marble bathroom. Some rooms offer views of Lima River, while others overlook the garden or the natural landscape. Breakfast is available at the property, and can be served indoors or in the balcony overlooking the garden. Ponte de Lima offers a number of restaurants serving traditional Portuguese food. Hotel Paço de Vitorino provides rental bicycles, and the cycling track from Viana do Castelo to Ponte de Lima is 328 feet away. For colder days, there are 2 lounges with a fireplace and sofas. The former winery is now a small library and includes table games. Guimarães is 40 mi from Hotel Rural Paço de Vitorino, while Braga is 29 mi from the property. The nearest airport is Porto Airport, 45 mi from the property.

975125.description: Featuring free WiFi and a self-standing pool, Villa Aida offers pet-friendly accommodation in Milan. Brenta Metro Stop is a 10-minute walk away, while a private parking is available on site. All units are air conditioned and include a flat-screen TV. Some units have a dining area and/or terrace. There is also a kitchen, equipped with a dishwasher. There is a private bathroom with a bath or shower and bidet in every unit, along with bath robes and free toiletries. Duomo Milan is 3. 2 km from Villa Aida, while La Scala is 3. 5 km from the property. The nearest airport is Milan Linate Airport, 6 km from Villa Aida.

975444.description: Located in the harbor of Lelystad—a recently created polder built up from the IJsselmeer—is a modern 3-star hotel offering comfort and convenience. The small scale of the hotel creates an atmosphere of intimacy and privacy. Bright and cozy rooms are furnished with comfortable beds and modern facilities, each with a private bathroom. Breakfast can be enjoyed in the hotel. With Amsterdam just 40 minutes away and De Hoge Veluwe National Park easily reachable within an hour, bustling cities and beautiful nature make for ideal day trips. Having such an immense lake on your doorstep offers a range of water sports as well as picturesque settings.

975481.description: Hotel Atlantic is located in Kallithea within 1. 6 mi from Piraeus Port and 3. 7 mi from the center of Athens. It offers 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in the common areas and free private, on-site parking. Atlantic features a variety of tastefully decorated accommodations, including thematically decorated rooms and suites. All units are equipped with a satellite TV and air conditioning, while some also have a hot tub. Guests can choose to make use of the extensive room service and order a coffee or a snack in the privacy of their room, or enjoy continental breakfast at the hotel’s breakfast hall. The nearest bus stop is 328 feet away and the tram station is 656 feet away. The train station of Neo Faliro can be reached within 0. 6 mi.

975532.description: Featuring free WiFi throughout the property, Hotel M offers accommodations in Espinho, a 5-minute walk from the Espinho Casino. It is also 33 feet from the Espinho Train Station. Each room at this hotel is equipped with a flat-screen TV with cable channels. Some rooms include views of the sea or city. Every room is equipped with a private bathroom fitted with a shower. For your comfort, you will find free toiletries and a hair dryer. Guests can discover the local cuisine in one of the many restaurants available within a 5-minute walk. Espinho is renowned for its fresh fish specialties. Espinho's nearby beach is a popular summer spot, where visitors can enjoy swimming, sun lounging, water sports or just strolling along the long promenade. The nearest airport is Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport, 20 mi from the property.

975708.description: We Love F Tourists features free WiFi. The hostel is located near central Lisbon, at just a 7-minute drive from Marquês de Pombal Square and a 3-minute walk from Rossio Metro Station. All rooms at the hostel feature access to shared bathroom facilities. The unit’s accommodation is divided into private double rooms and dormitory rooms, all with scenic Lisbon views. Daily cleaning service is provided. Guests can make full use of the shared kitchen in order to prepare their own meals. An on site snack-bar is also available for lighter meals and Portuguese snacks. The communal living area features comfortable sofas in a tranquil ambiance and has a flat-screen cable TV and DVD player, as well as an iPad. There is also a bar, where refreshing cocktails and drinks are served. The Rossio historical area is a 3-minute walk away, while the Chiado is a 9-minute walk away. It is a 7-minute walk from Coliseu dos Recreios. Bairro Alto, Lisbon’s main bar area, is a 20-minute walk. Airport shuttle is available, at a surcharge. We Love F Tourists is a 12-minute drive from the Lisbon International Airport.

975725.description: Offering Porto views from the private balconies, Hotel Chique Aliados is located within a century-old building in the iconic Avenida dos Aliados. It is 33 feet from Aliados Metro Station and is at a 7-minute walk from Clérigos Church. Rooms at Hotel Chique Aliados come with satellite TV and free WiFi access. The private bathroom includes a bath. All rooms have city views and a balcony. A breakfast buffet is served daily and there is a bar available for drinks on site. At a short walk, guests can find a wide range of restaurants serving traditional Portuguese cuisine and Porto specialties. Rental car services are available at the 24-hour reception. Guests are welcome to use the laundry service. The nearby metro station offers links to Francisco Sá Carneiro International Airport, 9. 3 mi away. The iconic Ribeira area is a 15-minute walk away, featuring many Douro riverfront bars and eateries.

975726.description: This simple hotel is situated in Porto.

975773.description: This cosy hotel can be found in Bela Vista.

976069.description: Just steps from Shinnecock Bay, this Southampton hotel is 2 miles from Cooper’s Beach. Hamelt Inn has a seasonal outdoor heated pool and offers free WiFi. A microwave, refrigerator and cable TV are standard in every room at the Hampton Hamlet Inn. All rooms have tiled floors and a covered patio with a small seating area. Daily housekeeping service is provided. Guests of the Hamlet Inn can enjoy a free weekday newspaper from the front desk, or take a stroll on the 3. 5 acre property. Free parking is available on site. Shinnecock Hills Golf Course is a 10-minute walk from the hotel. Parrish Art Museum and Duck Walk Vineyards are both a 6-minute drive away.

976243.description: Located in IJmuiden, Hotel Rauw aan de Kade offers air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi throughout the property. Lighthouse IJmuiden is 0. 9 miles away. All rooms feature box-spring beds, a refrigerator, a private bathroom, and decorated ceilings. Dry cleaning services are available. Guests can enjoy breakfast, lunch, and dinner at the on-site Grand Cafe Kruiten and Restaurant Perron Zee. The beach and dunes are a short 5-minute drive away. The center of Haarlem is 5. 6 miles away, while Amsterdam is 14 miles away. The hotel also offers bike and car rentals. Schiphol Airport is 12 miles away.

976367.description: This 3-star hotel is part of the Wassersportzentrum Berlin water sports center, located directly beside the River Spree. Free WiFi and a sauna with fitness room for a surcharge are offered here, and boats can be rented nearby. The nonsmoking Hotel Spree-idyl has spacious rooms and mini-bar. The Kalverstraat shopping street is a 10-minute walk away. Keizersgracht Tram Stop is 1148 feet away, and offers direct links to Amsterdam Central Station. Guests can have breakfast or pre-dinner drinks at the bar on the ground floor. Many restaurants and bars can be found in Utrechtsestraat, about 492 feet from the hotel.

Guests can enjoy our state-of-the-art gym and luxurious spa featuring signature treatments, perfect for unwinding after a busy day of sightseeing or business.

989440.description: Riad Esmeralda is a large, private riad designed in the classic style, offering guests the wonders of traditional Moroccan decor. Unlike most riads in the medina, Esmeralda has been carefully decorated to preserve the discreet charm of Moroccan craftsmanship. Each detail, from the hand-painted murals to the intricate zellige tilework and plasterwork (zwak) of Fez, has been meticulously handcrafted. The luxurious furnishings, sourced from the prestigious La Mamounia hotel, further enhance the opulent ambiance.

989461.description: Indulge in barefoot luxury on the iconic World Islands off the coast of Dubai. Anantara World Islands Resort sets the bar for luxury on this extraordinary offshore development. The five-star resort is located in the South American continent of the World Islands. A total of 70 rooms, suites and villas combine island living with contemporary luxury. Choose from rooms and suites with an ocean view, beach access and spacious villas with a private pool. Retreat to a haven where you can unwind in harmony with nature. The hotel is situated approximately 30 minutes from Palm Jumeirah by boat. Take a boat ride from Anantara the Palm Dubai to get there. The nearest airports are Dubai International Airport or Al Maktoum International Airport where international flights available everyday.

989465.description:

Start your day with a continental breakfast served each morning. The hotel also features an on-site restaurant and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the property. 

Our professional and attentive team is available 24/7 to provide a warm welcome and high-quality service, whether you are traveling for business or leisure.

The hotel’s enviable Midtown Manhattan location means you’re minutes from 5th Avenue and iconic attractions, including Bryant Park, the Empire State Building, and Times Square. Discover the views that set us apart from the others. Whether it’s the New Year’s Eve Ball Drop in Times Square, the Edge at Hudson Yards, or the effortless Manhattan skyline, Grayson Hotel provides a perfect back drop to any experience.

989660.description: The Oca Ribeira do Porto AT are newly opened apartments, located in the heart of the Historic Center of Porto, next to Praça da Ribeira and the Douro River. Due to the privileged location in the historic center of Porto, classified by Unesco as a World Heritage Site, access by car to the door is prohibited, but there is a public parking just 250 meters away. Apartments for up to 4 people. All equipped with TV, free Wi-Fi, kitchen and basic utensils, telephone, safe, hairdryer and air conditioning.

989699.description: Riad Diamond of Marrakech is an elegant boutique riad ideally located in the heart of the Medina, just a few minutes from Jemaa el-Fna. Blending authentic Moroccan craftsmanship with modern comfort, the riad offers beautifully designed rooms and suites, a peaceful patio, and a panoramic rooftop terrace perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring. Guests enjoy personalized service, daily breakfast, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere that reflects the true spirit of Marrakech. Whether traveling for leisure or a romantic escape, Riad Diamond provides an intimate and memorable stay close to the city’s main cultural attractions.

989773.description: Ideally located in the Wuse 1 area, Newton Park Hotel promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. The property features a wide range of facilities to make your stay a pleasant experience. Take advantage of the property's 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, 24-hour front desk, car park, room service. Towels, flat screen television, sofa, mirror, free welcome drink can be found in selected guestrooms. The property's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include fitness center, outdoor pool. Friendly staff, great facilities, and close proximity to all that Abuja has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Newton Park Hotel.

989841.description: Durty Nelly's Inn offers more than your average hostel experience. Enjoy clean, cozy, and well-maintained beds with convenient trunk space and privacy, all at a great price and in the heart of Amsterdam. Our spacious bathrooms feature rain showers and provide everything you need to prepare for a day exploring the city. Below the hostel, you'll find our renowned Irish pub, a perfect spot to relax with a cold beer in a pleasant atmosphere. Located in Amsterdam's historic city center, Durty Nelly's is just a short walk from Central Station and close to many sightseeing attractions and bars. Our friendly and helpful staff is always available to assist you.

The nearest airport is São Paulo - Congonhas Airport, 8 km from Hotel Fasano São Paulo Itaim.

The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms offering a desk, a kettle, a minibar, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower. 989983.description: This comfortable hotel is in Athens. With a total of 13 units, this is a nice place to stay. Nema Hotel & Suites captures the very essence of Athens city center. Housed in an emblematic building that used to operate as a textile trading company for over 70 years, Nema has infused all these elements of recent history and transformed them into a contemporary accommodation option. Named after the yarn that has characterized not only the industry that bloomed in the area, but also Penelope's endless weaving in anticipation of her loved one's return, the thread encompasses a timeless connection between the past and the present.

Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge; on request), and free self-parking is provided. Make yourself comfortable in one of the 12 air-conditioned rooms with Smart TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Cable programming is available for entertainment. Bathrooms include showers with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Safes and desks are provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. The Borough Lagos, located in Lekki Phase 1, is a short drive from Upbeat Recreation Centre and Barazahi. This spa hotel is conveniently located near Filmhouse IMAX and Nike Art Gallery, and is 32. 6 km from Murtala Muhammed International Airport (LOS).

Its minimalist and functional concept strategically connects to the airport, the business district, and various medical and commercial service areas, offering carefully selected amenities and a welcoming and efficient experience.

990305.description: The apartment hotel acora Potsdam Living is your cozy home away from home, where flexibility and independence are our priority. Our rooms are designed for your comfort, featuring kitchenettes with a fridge, microwave, sink, and coffee pod machine, allowing you to cater to your own needs. Enjoy a restful sleep with box-spring beds, allergy-friendly linens, soundproofed windows, and blackout curtains. Stay connected with free high-speed WLAN, and relax with a flat-screen TV offering screen mirroring. For those who prefer not to cook, our delicious breakfast buffet is available to start your day right, and our cozy Lounge & Bar is open until midnight, offering a variety of refreshing drinks. When you need to unwind, relax in our sauna, or work in the co-working area. With amenities like underground parking, a 24-hour reception, and a snack bar, we’ve thought of everything to make your stay as comfortable as possible. For some fun, enjoy a game of table football. Whether you're here for business or leisure, our central location near Potsdam's central station makes it easy to explore the city or commute to meetings. If you are staying with children at the apartment hotel acora Potsdam Living the City, we will gladly provide a baby crib or extra bed.

The modern, air-conditioned rooms at Moov Hotel Porto Centro are decorated with movie stills. All rooms have a work desk and a private bathroom. 

A freshly prepared buffet-style breakfast is served every day, at an additional cost. There is a terrace in the inner courtyard with tables and chairs, ideal for relaxing with a coffee. 

The art gallery district and the São João National Theatre are less than a 10-minute walk away.

Enjoy first-class amenities such as air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a minibar, and a private bathroom with a bidet and complimentary toiletries. The hotel features a rooftop terrace, restaurant, and pool, perfect for enjoying the breathtaking views while savoring a buffet breakfast or your favorite beverage. With excellent room service and a 24/7 front desk offering currency exchange and complimentary Wi-Fi, your comfort and convenience are assured.

We offer professional service and high-quality amenities, from superior toiletries to our full buffet breakfast. The São Sebastião metro station is located directly in front of the hotel, providing quick and easy access to the historic center and Lisbon's international airport. Rooms are equipped with a 50-inch LED TV with cable channels and mobile phone connection, telephone, premium Wi-Fi, USB charger ports, soundproofing, hairdryer, and a private bathroom with a shower, lighted makeup mirror, and bathroom scale. Coffee machines, kettles, and irons with ironing boards are available upon request. A full buffet breakfast is served from 7:15 am to 10:30 am.

Each room includes a seating area, work desk, and modern amenities. Exceptional Facilities: Guests enjoy a sun terrace, garden, and free WiFi. Additional facilities include a coffee shop, child-friendly buffet, and free on-site private parking. Private check-in and check-out services ensure a smooth arrival and departure. Delicious Dining: A continental buffet breakfast is served daily, featuring warm dishes, juice, cheese, and fruits. The hotel also offers a child-friendly buffet and a cosy coffee shop for relaxation. Local Attractions: Schloss Zehdenick is 34 km from Sachsenhausen Memorial and Museum, 13 km from Schloss Tornow, and 84 km from Berlin Brandenburg Airport. Nearby activities include hiking, cycling, kayaking, and canoeing.

990768.description: With a 13-mile peninsula of sand dunes stretching into the Atlantic and brand-new function space, MARRAM is a picturesque setting for a celebration with friends, family, or colleagues. At MARRAM, the focus is on simplicity, connection, and barefoot luxury – no televisions, laid back ambience, and seasonal outdoor dining featuring savory meats, local seafood and vegetables, and freshly baked goods.

990832.description: This Southampton property is located 3 miles from Coopers Beach and features an outdoor swimming pool. Shops and restaurants in Southampton village are a 5-minute drive away. Cable TV and a private bathroom are included in every air-conditioned room at the Southampton Long Island Hotel. Some rooms feature a full kitchen and some have a microwave and refrigerator. Visitors can access free Wi-Fi throughout the Southampton Long Island. Free parking is also available on site. The Southampton train station is a 5-minute drive from the hotel. The Southampton Golf Club is half a mile away.

990880.description: Located in Berlin and with East Side Gallery reachable within 4. 4 miles, Hotel Mit-Mensch has express check-in and check-out, non-smoking rooms, a garden, free WiFi and a restaurant. The property is around 5. 7 miles from Alexanderplatz Metro Station, 6 miles from Alexanderplatz and 6. 5 miles from Berlin Cathedral. Berlin TV Tower is 6. 6 miles away and German Historical Museum is 6. 6 miles from the hotel. At the hotel, all rooms include a desk, a flat-screen TV, a private bathroom, bed linen and towels. All rooms feature a closet. Guests at Hotel Mit-Mensch can enjoy a continental breakfast. Neues Museum is 6. 6 miles from the accommodation, while Pergamon Museum is 6. 9 miles from the property. The nearest airport is Berlin Brandenburg Willy Brandt Airport, 11 miles from Hotel Mit-Mensch.

990932.description: Indulge in on-site massages or enjoy garden views at this charming guesthouse. It features complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Savor a meal at the restaurant or a snack in the coffee shop/café. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily (7:30 AM to 11:00 AM) for a fee. Amenities include express check-out, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. The 10 individually decorated guestrooms offer minibars and Smart TVs. Your memory foam bed includes down comforters, and complimentary Wi-Fi and cable programming are provided. Bathrooms feature hair dryers and bathrobes. Palácio do Visconde is centrally located in Lisbon, a 5-minute drive from Avenida da Liberdade and Rossio Square, 0. 7 miles from São Jorge Castle, and 6 miles from Belém Tower.

991035.description: Its unique location at 40 metres atop a dune and right on the coast makes the renovated Strandhotel Het Hoge Duin an iconic landmark in Wijk aan Zee/North Holland. You will see that the panorama from the rooms, the restaurant plus the accompanying Skybar, the neighbouring terraces and the six meeting rooms is unmatched in the Dutch hotel landscape. The brand new hotel is located in a unique location in Wijk aan Zee. The retro-chic style guarantees a luxurious, warm, modern but also familiar atmosphere, in which holidaymakers and business visitors will immediately feel at home. With the sandy beach, the cosy pavilions, the beautiful dune area and the village centre with its numerous cafés and restaurants within walking distance, it becomes a base that guarantees a fantastic stay close to cities such as Amsterdam, Haarlem, Alkmaar and Beverwijk.

991064.description: The hotel has 20 rooms for 1, 2 or more people. Our aim is to ensure that you enjoy a relaxed and cozy stay at Hotel de Weyman. We offer a rich and tasteful breakfast. The home-baked bread is a must; to make you feel at home, breakfast can be served at all hours so you can sleep as long as you like and have breakfast when you are ready ! Because of the limited amount of rooms, Hotel de Weyman can provide its guests with a very personal and pleasant stay. As a result of many years of experience in various countries, the manager and the employees insure that guests from a great diversity of cultures are attentively cared for by the hotel staff, who is able to communicate in perfect English, good German, French, Bulgarian, Russian, as well as a bit Italian, Spanish and Portuguese.

991067.description: This friendly family hotel offers a comfortable base, just 820 ft from the beach of charming Bergen aan Zee. Enjoy simple, elegant accommodations and the lovely terrace. The Hotel Rasch provides neat rooms, studios or apartments in this Dutch coastal resort. Decide to wake up each morning with a wholesome breakfast in the cozy and bright breakfast room, before starting your day with a refreshing beach walk. Benefit from free on-site parking and make use of the free Wi-Fi connection throughout the hotel. Weather permitting, the outside terrace is a great place to relax with a drink and enjoy the setting. With many nice restaurants and cafes in the neighborhood, you can enjoy good food and a lively atmosphere.

991139.description: The Hotel Kranichsberg offers free Wi-Fi and a daily breakfast buffet. It is located in Woltersdorf, just steps away from Lake Flakensee. All of the rooms at the Hotel Kranichsberg have a private bathroom and a TV. The Kranichsberg’s restaurant serves German food and local specialties. The hotel bar features a summer terrace, and offers a variety of homemade cakes. Berlin city center is 12 mi away.

991168.description: Located in Brandenburg’s green Havelland district, this hotel offers country-style accommodations with free WiFi in each room and rental bikes. Berlin and Potsdam are a 30-minute drive away, and the A10 motorway is 10 minutes away. Hotel-Pension Sperlingshof lies in the peaceful village of Dallgow-Döberitz. Its rooms and apartments feature light wooden furniture and floral curtains. Satellite TV and refrigerators are provided. Hotel-Pension Sperlingshof has direct access to the cycle paths leading to Berlin, Potsdam and the Döberitz Heath Nature Reserve. The hotel provides cycle maps, free bicycle storage and free parking.

991287.description: This historic mansion in Muiderberg is surrounded by a garden with a partly covered terrace. Guests can enjoy the quiet surroundings with Amsterdam only a 15 minute drive away. All rooms of Hotel-Restaurant Het Rechthuis have a private bathroom and extra-long boxspring beds. After a drink in front of the fireplace in the lounge, guests can enjoy an extensive dinner in the restaurant. The outside terrace offers unique views of the The Brink Street. Hotel Het Rechthuis is located a 5 minute drive from highway A6. Parking is free of charge.

991301.description: Located next to motorway N200 and only a 5-minute drive away from Amsterdam, this family-run hotel offers rooms with free private parking on site and free WiFi access. Schiphol Airport is 9. 3 mi away. The rooms located in the main building right above the hotel's restaurant come with box-spring beds, a flat-screen TV, a washbasin, toilet and a shower. The rooms in the annex also feature box-spring beds, a flat-screen TV and a luxurious private bathroom with a shower, washbasin and toilet. Breakfast buffet is served daily and includes items such as fresh juice, fresh baked bread and boiled eggs. Guests can also enjoy dinner at the à la carte restaurant. Drinks and snacks are available at the hotel's cafe. Zandvoort beach is a 30-minute drive from the accommodations. Bus stop Oranje Nassaustraat is located right in front of the hotel and offers a direct link to Amsterdam center in 15 minutes. Haarlem is 3. 7 mi away. Train station Halfweg-Zwanenburg is a 5-minute walk and offers direct links to Amsterdam, Zandvoort aan Zee and Uitgeest.

991620.description: Situated in Brussels and with Place Sainte-Catherine reachable within 300 m, La Bourse Hotel features express check-in and check-out, non-smoking rooms, a terrace, free WiFi throughout the property and a restaurant. At the hotel, rooms are fitted with a desk, a flat-screen TV, a private bathroom, bed linen and towels. The rooms come with a safety deposit box, while certain rooms come with a balcony and others also boast city views. The rooms will provide guests with a fridge. Guests at La Bourse Hotel can enjoy a buffet or a continental breakfast. Speaking English, Spanish, French and Hindi at the 24-hour front desk, staff are always on hand to help.

991626.address: Calle A, Esq. Calle 15, La Marina
991626.description: Located on the Caribbean coast, we are just 20 minutes from airport. The city center and St. Stanislaus Church are just a five-minute drive away and we’re 11 kilometers from Catalina Island. Each of our guest rooms feature a balcony offering beautiful views. Enjoy onsite dining, two bars with outdoor seating, a pool and event space.

name.content: Fontinha Porto A Trademark Collection By Wyndham

991680.description: Immerse yourself in the rich culture, historic charm, and fantastic culinary scene of one of Europe’s oldest cities and Portugal’s second largest city. Peruse the shelves of the storied Lello Bookstore, admire the double-decker Dom Luís Bridge, and visit the neoclassical Bolsa Palace. Check out modern exhibitions at the Serralves Museum of Contemporary Art, sip your way through the renowned port wine cellars of Vila Nova de Gaia, and have an exceptional evening at Ferreira Borges, a 19th century market turned restaurant and nightclub.

992256.description: Aparthotel in Pozuelo de Alarcon. We have had more than 5. 000 guests in the last year and are the leading lodging provider in the area. Tech-enabled. Self check-in. Daily housekeeping not included in rate. For a better experience please call us upon booking so we can send you the check-in instructions.

992269.address: Zazil Ha 118 Playa Norte Isla Mujeres Q R
992269.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages and facials. This beach hotel also provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy a meal at Guru, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or a refreshing drink at the beach bar. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM. Additional amenities include multilingual staff, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Each of the 12 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with a rainfall showerhead and designer toiletries, a safe, a desk, and a phone with free local calls. Located in the heart of Isla Mujeres (Centro - Supmza 001), Casa del Jaguar Beach Hotel is steps from North Beach and the West Coast of Isla Mujeres National Park. The Isla Mujeres Ferry Terminal is a short mile away, and Cancun International Airport (CUN) is 21. 8 miles (35. 1 km) from the property.

name.content: DAMAC Hills 2 Hotel – Edge by Rotana

992313.description: Damac Hills 2 Hotel is an Edge by Rotana managed property that is well located in Dubai's thriving Damac Hills 2 community, close to golf courses, parks, lakes and malls, and just a short trip by road from the destination's major attractions including Expo City Dubai, Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure, the Hamdan Sports Complex and The Sevens Stadium. Ideal for leisure, business or sports-focused trips, this stylish and contemporary three-star hotel is also near major hubs such as Dubai Studio City, Dubai Science Park, IMPZ, Dubai Production City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai Sports City, Dubai Outlet Mall, and Dubai Motor City, while Al Qudra's desert, Duck and Swan Lake and cycling track are all within easy reach. Meeting the lifestyle needs of on-the-go guests, the 295 rooms and suites are thoughtfully designed to maximise space, light and efficiency, with each featuring smart technology and in-room entertainment, as well as modern classic furniture and interiors to enhance comfort and wellbeing. For dining on your doorstep, the Urban Bar Deli is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner, with eat-in and takeaway options available. Serving international dishes and featuring a casual bar, it is a popular spot for meetings and gatherings. Keep in shape at Bodylines Fitness & Wellness Club or take a dip in the two temperature-controlled swimming pools for adults and children. If you are travelling for business, there are four well-equipped meeting rooms for your convenience.

name.content: Almarena Puerto Retiro Affiliated by Meliá

992336.description: Located in the Puerto Retiro area and within the modern Quartier District, the 70 Studios Almarena Puerto Retiro invite you to work, live and enjoy recreation in the same complex, with unique accessibility in the city and open views facing the river. Quartier District is the first Buenos Aires mixed-use complex on a metropolitan scale. It is structured according to the 'prow' of Puerto Madero, and is located in a strategic and rapidly growing area of ​​the city of Buenos Aires, making our Studios the perfect alternative for those looking to stay near their point of arrival, in a modern, safe and accessible environment to all tourist spots in the city.

992341.description:
Welcome to voco Dubai Monaco Heart of Europe, a hotel for adults of 18 years or above. Inspired by the 
French Riviera and located on Dubai World Islands, its 188 vibrant rooms, suites and party suites 
are filled with unique experiences. Featuring events and meetings spaces, Dubai's one and only

work-leisure balance

name.content: Porta Nobre Boutique Hotel by Aspasios

992368.description: Porta Nobre Boutique Hotel is conveniently located in the heart of Porto, just a 5-minute walk from Palácio da Bolsa and 500 meters from Mercado Ferreira Borges. Guests can relax on a picturesque shared terrace featuring a pool, perfect for taking in the stunning views of the city. The hotel offers modern accommodations equipped with free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, and private bathrooms. Each unit also includes a fully equipped kitchen, ensuring convenience for every guest. To start the day, a delicious continental breakfast is served each morning. The Boutique Hotel is situated near iconic landmarks such as Ribeira Square, São Bento Metro Station, and São Bento Train Station, and it is just 16 km from Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport.

992392.description: Timeless luxury meets legendary locale at 5th & 55th Residence Club, our exclusive collection of residences located in the flagship St. Regis New York. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, it offers an exquisite New York retreat at one of the city's most iconic addresses. Experience refined comfort and convenience in the elegantly preserved setting of a New York City landmark, adored throughout its history by dignitaries, royalty, artists and celebrities. Awaken to coffee or tea service delivered by your dedicated butler. Attend to business in your private residence or entertain colleagues over dinner. Relax following the day's amusements with signature afternoon tea at Astor Court or cocktails at the famous King Cole Bar.

992446.description: The hotel Acta The Clover 4*, with a privileged location, is located 500m from the Trinidade metro station, 9 minutes walk from the famous Avenida dos Aliados and 20 minutes walk from the historic center and the Sant Luis Bridge. Newly built hotel that offers a beautiful roof terrace where you can enjoy spectacular views of the city. It has 65 fully equipped rooms, with free Wi-Fi, desk, TV, telephone, private bathroom with rain shower, courtesy amenities and hairdryer. In addition, every morning it offers buffet breakfast, 24-hour reception and a space on the ground floor where you can work, and parking spaces bookable for an additional fee.

992500.description:
Located in Marrakesh and with Bahia Palace reachable within a 2-minute walk, DAR Riad Jomana has concierge services, non-smoking rooms, a garden, free WiFi throughout the property and a terrace with jacuzzi . the riad is close to several noted attractions, around one mile from Boucharouite Museum, a 16-minute walk from Djemaa El Fna and 1.1 miles from The Orientalist Museum of Marrakech. The riad has family rooms.
At the riad, every room comes with a patio. The rooms are equipped with a private bathroom with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. All rooms at DAR Riad Jomana feature air conditioning and a closet.
The daily breakfast offers continental, halal or gluten-free options.
Speaking Arabic, English, Spanish and French, staff will be happy to provide guests with practical information on the area at the reception.
Popular points of interest near the accommodation include bahia palace , badii place , dar si said , Koutoubia, Mouassine Museum and Le Jardin Secret. The nearest airport is Marrakech-Menara, 3.7 miles from DAR Riad Jomana, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

992506.description: Located in Riyadh, 6. 1 miles from Al Nakheel Mall, Dara Hotel Qurtubah has accommodations with an outdoor swimming pool, free private parking and a fitness center. Our all-suites hotel is in Times Square, near Broadway theaters and the subway system, and surrounded by restaurants. We're one mile from Macy's, the Empire State Building, Grand Central Terminal, and Penn Station. 992751.description: Well set in Marrakech, Palais Tara & Spa provides air-conditioned rooms, a garden, free WiFi and a shared lounge. A continental, vegetarian or vegan breakfast is available daily at the property. At the accommodation you will find a restaurant serving Moroccan cuisine. Vegetarian, vegan and dairy-free options can also be requested. The area is popular for cycling. 992776.description: The Atlantic Palms Suite, a budget-friendly hotel located off Lekki-Epe Expressway near Chevron Drive, caters to both business and leisure travelers. Private bathrooms include bathrobes and complimentary toiletries. Guests can choose from Shell rooms, Pearl suites, and Coral suites. The on-site restaurant serves local and continental cuisine, and the bar offers a variety of beverages. Guests can enjoy à la carte or buffet dining, and special dietary requests can be accommodated.

992782.address: Old Al Ghanim, Doha, Qatar Street 860, 15 5 2
992782.description: The three-star Doha Dynasty Hotel is ideally located for exploring the best of Doha. 992796.address: Calle Caguama y Calle Caracol, C. Caracol
992796.description: Nômade Holbox is an ode to the ocean, where restoration, renewal, and reconnection are at the heart of each experience. This secluded island, located on the north coast of Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula, on the cusp of the Caribbean, is a world woven from water. Otherworldly, its moods darting from moody to radiant, the island is the teacher that inspired us to create something different. Nômade Holbox is an adults-only, 30-room beach haven that brings to life the wisdom, medicine, and magic of the water itself. Our wellness programming is designed to connect our guests with daily presence, from heart-expanding yoga classes on the ocean deck to private Watsu flow sessions with our in-house practitioners. Profound experiences await at this unique, holistic beachfront hotel in Holbox.

992906.description: With a convenient location only 20 miles from King Khaled International Airport, the family friendly Comfort Hotel Riyadh Olaya is the ideal solution when staying in Riyadh for business or leisure. Offering spacious, elegant rooms and excellent meeting and entertainment facilities, the hotel is in the proximity of many local attractions and points of interest, such as the King Abdullah Park, the Al Nakeel Park, and the popular Sky Bridge, from which you can admire breathtaking views on the city. All 88 accommodations at the Comfort Hotel Riyadh Olaya come with a wireless internet connection, an en suite bathroom with a shower or bathtub, a rich assortment of toiletries, and a classic selection of amenities. The services and facilities you can take advantage of at our smoke free hotel include three fully equipped meeting rooms, a fitness centre, an onsite full service restaurant, a pool with a poolside bar, an outdoor secured parking lot, and personalized services upon request.

992910.description: Located in Riyadh, 13 km from Al Nakheel Mall, Al Rahden Hotel provides accommodation with a fitness centre, free private parking, a shared lounge and a terrace. The property is non-smoking and is situated 20 km from International Airport.

992929.description: Attractively set in Marrakech, Riad Magnolia features air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, private parking and room service. Ideally located in the Medina district, this guest house offers a terrace, as well as an indoor pool. The accommodation provides a shared lounge, a concierge service and currency exchange for guests. At the guest house, the rooms are equipped with a patio with pool view. Rooms are fitted with a private bathroom with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. The rooms have a safety deposit box. A continental, vegetarian or gluten-free breakfast is available each morning at the property. At Riad Magnolia you will find a restaurant serving American, Belgian and French cuisine. Vegetarian, kosher and halal options can also be requested. Speaking Arabic, English, Spanish and French at the 24-hour front desk, staff are always on hand to help. Popular points of interest near the accommodation include The Orientalist Museum of Marrakech, Boucharouite Museum and Bahia Palace. The nearest airport is Marrakech-Menara, 7 km from Riad Magnolia, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

993071.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this property.

A 24-hour front desk, concierge, luggage storage, express check-in/check-out, daily maid service, ironing, dry cleaning, and room service are also available. An airport shuttle is offered for an additional fee. Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport is 28 km from the hotel.

993139.description: Located in Abuja, 5 km from Big Church, Corinthia Villa Hotel provides accommodation with a restaurant, free private parking, a fitness centre and an outdoor swimming pool. Each accommodation at the 4-star hotel has garden views, and guests can enjoy access to a bar and to a shared lounge. The accommodation features a 24-hour front desk, airport transfers, room service and free WiFi throughout the property. Guest rooms are equipped with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, a fridge, a kettle, a shower, a hairdryer and a desk. At the hotel each room comes with a wardrobe and a private bathroom. Guests at Corinthia Villa Hotel can enjoy a continental breakfast.

993140.description:
Nippon Grand Hotels is located at Plot 102 Ahmadu Bello, Kado Express Way, Opp Nest Cash, Kado Abuja. This classy hotel is appropriate for comfort seekers on a business/leisure trip.
Every room in Nippon Grand Hotels is stylishly furnished with an air conditioner, king-size bed, flat screen TV with cable services, sofa, ornate lamp, refrigerator and an en-suite bathroom with bathtub/Jacuzzi and complimentary toiletries. A separate living area is exclusive to some rooms. 
The on-site restaurant serves local, continental dishes and Chinese cuisine. The bar is stocked with different kinds of wine, juice and alcoholic beverage. Nippon Grand boasts an outdoor swimming pool where guests can take a dip. Also, guests can take workout sessions at the fitness centre.

993153.description: This property offers a total of 198 rooms. Visitors may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at The Hoxton Brussels. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. The premises offer accessible public areas. Guests arriving by car may leave their vehicle at the accommodation's parking spaces. Travellers can enjoy the delicious dining options offered in the pleasant surroundings. Due to its functional meeting facilities, this property is a perfect place for guests travelling for business purposes. Some services of The Hoxton Brussels may be payable.

993158.description:
The Almanac Palais Vienna, a luxury boutique hotel, resides within a pair of former palais dating back to 1871. Overlooking Stadtpark, Vienna's first public green space, the property is situated on the Ringstrasse, the city's most elegant boulevard. Local landmarks, including the Vienna State Opera House and the Museum of Applied Arts (MAK), are within walking distance. Award-winning designer Jaime Beriestain oversaw the restoration, transforming the historic palais into a hotel with 80 suites and 31 guest rooms, steeped in Viennese heritage. Guests can admire a rotating collection of art by up-and-coming artists. A two-floor, marble-clad wellness sanctuary features a 14-meter indoor pool with thermal waters. Locally sourced ingredients are showcased at the plant-forward Alpine restaurant. The hotel requires a €100. 00 deposit per room/night upon check-in for incidentals. 
Breakfast times:
Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 11:30. 
Saturday and Sunday from 07:00 to 14:00.

993176.description:
Four floors of luxury, en-suite hotel rooms with five 40 meter square rooms per floor. All guest rooms at The Francis Hotel come with complimentary high-speed internet access, in-room coffee maker, refrigerator, work desk and satellite television with a variety of channels for your relaxation and entertainment. The PentHouse is a desirous experience.

Each room at The Francis Hotel has a refrigerator, free WiFi, an air conditioner, a private bathroom, LCD TV sets, a stand-in shower, a set of bathrobes, and inter comm telephones.
Also available at the hotel are a swimming pool, a gym, an event facility, a bar and a restaurant.

993207.description: Résidence Marrakech Hôtel welcomes you to Marrakech, in the Gueliz district. Take advantage of your stay to experience new activities at the renowned Royal Tennis Harti and Palmeraie Palace Golf Club. Prefer the peace and beauty of wide-open spaces? Head to the magnificent Majorelle Garden and Cyber-Park. The charming Secret Garden and Menara Gardens are also well worth a visit.

993218.description: Drop by and stay a while at Moxy NYC Downtown in Lower Manhattan, where surprises are standard and the unexpected happens every day. Located at the corner of bustling Tribeca, the Financial District and Chinatown, our hotel in downtown New York is an experience, brimming with quirky details and cheeky touches. Take those selfies at our glowing LED wall welcoming you into the lobby. Relax in modern accommodations with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, 50-inch LED TVs and surround sound speakers. Transition from work to play at Recreation, our co-working and play space. It's a buzzy hub where cocktails and old-school arcade games collide. With nearby must-sees like One World Trade Center, Brooklyn Bridge and New York City Hall right outside of the doors, only one question remains: When are you making your getaway to Moxy NYC Downtown?

name.content: El Misti Hotel Buenos Aires Centro

993220.description: Featuring 3-star accommodation, El Misti Hotel Buenos Aires Centro is located in Buenos Aires, 1. 5 km from Plaza de Mayo Square and 1. 1 km from Centro Cultural Kirchner. Featuring a terrace, the 3-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. The property is less than 1 km from the city centre and a 3-minute walk from Basilica del Santisimo Sacramento. The rooms have a desk and a flat-screen TV, and certain rooms at the hotel have a balcony. At El Misti Hotel Buenos Aires Centro each room has bed linen and towels. Popular points of interest near El Misti Hotel Buenos Aires Centro include The Obelisk of Buenos Aires, Colon Theater and Tortoni Cafe. You'll also have a hammock and cushions that you can move to the wooden deck, and you can also keep warm with our portable alcohol fireplace. Ideal for a romantic night under the starry sky.

Luís I Bridge will take you to the renowned Port Wine Cellars. Francisco Sá Carneiro International Airport is 15km away.

We provide a reception that is open 24/7, a concierge service, a fitness room, a beautiful 300m2 terrace and pleasant living spaces where you can enjoy tranquil relaxation, eat and drink, and engage in various leisure activities. Our attention to detail and to your comfort and satisfaction will help to ensure the success of your stay.

993726.description: Enjoy a central Lisbon stay at Room Select Liberdade, steps from Avenida da Liberdade and a short walk from Rossio Square. 993921.description: Situated in the heart of George Street, RÌGH Residences is the ideal base for exploring all that Edinburgh has to offer. 993948.description: Featuring 4-star accommodation, Continent Al Ertiqaa Hotel is situated in Buraymān, 7. 6 km from Mall of Arabia and 15 km from Red Sea Mall. 993949.description: Located centrally and a short walk to The Royal Mile and the Old Town, KM Apartments are the perfect base to explore Edinburgh from.
