Featuring comfortable Elite mattresses with European cotton sheets, Arran Sense of Scotland toiletries, fluffy towels and full size hairdryers. Our fully equipped kitchens include oven, hob, microwave and kettle as well as crockery, pots & pans, utensils, and tea & coffee provisions. Delicious breakfast served in Circa, available for an additional fee, offers continental and hot buffet selection. Guests may access The University of Edinburgh's facilities at nearby Pleasance Sports Complex & Gym.

993952.description: Welcome to Charlottenburg in leafy West Berlin! Expect eclectic style and a host of fun touches to make your stay a home-from-home (only better).

994002.description: Located in Cairo, a 14-minute walk from the Great Sphinx, Villa Khufu Pyramids Hotel offers accommodations with a garden, free private parking, a shared lounge, and a terrace. Featuring a shared kitchen, this property also provides guests with a playground. The property provides a 24-hour front desk, airport transportation, a kids' club, and free WiFi. All rooms come with bed linen and towels. The daily breakfast offers à la carte, continental, or full English/Irish options. Guests can play pool, table tennis, and darts at the accommodation, and the area is popular for cycling. 994064.description: Msquare Hotel is just 10 minutes to the local and international Airport, very close to city Centre, with well trained staff that alway ready to help with all your need, 24 hours and 7 days a week. we are here to serve you and to make your stay a memorable one. we provide airport pickup and drup off on fees, only on request

994546.description: Located in the heart of Miraflores, the Ikonik Miraflores is located a few steps from Avenida José Pardo, one of the main commercial avenues in the district. The hotel provides comfortable rooms with amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, complimentary breakfast as per rate plan, tea/coffee maker, 24-hour room service and laundry service. Have a memorable stay near Mumbai Airport in our exquisite Deluxe and Executive Rooms at Apex Beacon Hotel, Mumbai. Equipped with modern furnishings such as an LED Television, a tea & coffee maker, a mini fridge and more.

1020497.description: Connect Suites is a luxurious accommodation option located on 24Karolou Street in the heart of Athens. Our suites offer a blend of comfort and modern amenities, including A/C, High Speed wifi, flat-screen TVs with streaming services, and private bathrooms. Some suites even feature private terraces. Guests can enjoy a variety of breakfast options, including vegan and traditional Greek, either in their room or on-site. Our location provides easy access to major attractions like the National Theatre of Greece, Omonia Square, and Larissis Railway Station. We also offer organized sightseeing tours and a convenient airport transfer service from Eleftherios Venizelos Airport. With flexible check-in and check-out times, Connect Suites ensures a stress-free and memorable stay in Athens. Whether you’re here our property is the ideal base for exploring the city.

name.content: The Bogart By Luxurban Trademark Collection

1020522.description: Settle into the heart of Brooklyn’s vibrant Bushwick neighborhood at The Bogart by LuxUrban, Trademark Collection by Wyndham—offering free WiFi, rooms with city views, and easy access to LaGuardia Airport (LGA), John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), and Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR). This non-smoking, modern hotel is within walking distance of Netflix Studios and the Brooklyn Mirage in the Avant Gardner complex. Cheer on the Nets at the Barclays Center, walk across the Brooklyn Bridge, or have fun on the rides at Luna Park™ in Coney Island.

1020527.description:
Welcome to UAE's first Holiday Inn with open lobby concept – the perfect destination for business and leisure. 

Just a short ride (18 min) from Dubai Intl Airport, the hotel is located in the heart of Dubai's business and leisure district, just steps away from iconic landmarks such as the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the Dubai Canal. 

Unwind in one of our 275 modern and stylish guest rooms and suites equipped with modern facilities and 55-Inch smart TV, and comfortable beds. The hotel also offers a range of meeting and event spaces that can accommodate up to 120 guests, complete with the latest audio-visual equipment and a professional and comfortable setting for any business meetings, conferences and events. 

Holiday Inn Dubai Business Bay is home to the first open lobby concept in UAE and offers a number of modern recreational facilities, including a fully equipped 24-hour Fitness Centre, outdoor swimming pool, and spa. Revive after a long day of work or sightseeing with our choice of body treatments at Santai Spa. 

Holiday Inn Business Bay offers a vibrant dining experience with two stylish restaurants to choose from. Brasserie on 1 is a chic European restaurant with an eclectic menu of classic dishes and modern twists. La Plancha Terraza Mexicana is the perfect place for alfresco dining. Enjoy a selection of Latin classic bites & drinks. 

Kids aged 12 and below stay and eat for free at our family-friendly hotel.

1020613.description:
With a stay at Theasis Athens in Athens (Athens City Centre), you'll be steps from Ermou Street and Monastiraki Flea Market. This bed & breakfast is 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from Acropolis and 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Syntagma Square. 
Pamper yourself with onsite massages or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this bed & breakfast include complimentary wireless internet access, a communal living room, and tour/ticket assistance. 
Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). 
Continental breakfasts are available daily from 9:30 AM to 1:00 PM for a fee. 
Make yourself at home in one of the 20 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Your memory foam bed comes with Egyptian cotton sheets. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers.

1020686.description: The hotel comprises a total of 73 snug guest rooms.

1020704.description: Ideal for those seeking to be in the heart of the city without compromising on tranquility and privacy, this brand-new boutique hotel has it all. Sleek contemporary design, brand-new interiors, and a modern vibe at a perfectly convenient location. With plenty of bars, markets, the hip culture around, and the Acropolis just overhead, this is a smart base for exploring both ancient and modern Athens. National Theater of Greece and Ancient Agora of Athens are less than 1km away from the property. *Guests must contact the Hotel 24 hours before arrival* Contact information: +30 2117504582+30 6948825868

1020758.description: Situated on Gaia’s waterfront, The Rebello is the perfect place to explore the home of Port Wine. A unique hotel on the grounds of UNESCO warehouses. Ideal for strolling along the Douro River or crossing the Luís I bridge which is a 20-minute walk. At Bello Rooftop you can enjoy artisanal pizza or petiscos while taking in the panoramic river view and Luís I bridge. Then there's Pot&Pan Restaurant that offers tapas-style dishes to share with a twist on traditional Portuguese cuisine. The Roman inspired spa & wellness area features a sauna, gym and swimming pool with a Tranquility Water Lounge. Designed for friends and families with furry friends included and a kid’s club, the hotel has 103 artfully decorated suites that range from spacious studios to three-bedroom duplex, all inspired by an industrial chic feel. Reimagined for today with fully fitted kitchens and ample space to live.

1020915.description: Located in Riyadh, 4 miles from Riyadh Park, Erfad Hotel - Riyadh provides accommodations with an outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a terrace and a restaurant. With free WiFi, this 3-star hotel offers room service and a 24-hour front desk. Riyadh Gallery Mall is 4. 7 miles away and Al Nakheel Mall is 6. 9 miles from the hotel. At the hotel, rooms are equipped with a closet. The private bathroom is equipped with a bidet, free toiletries and a hairdryer. At Erfad Hotel - Riyadh each room has air conditioning and a flat-screen TV. The accommodation offers a continental or halal breakfast. You can play pool at Erfad Hotel - Riyadh. Diriyah is 7. 7 miles from the hotel, while King Khalid Grand Mosque is 8. 4 miles away. The nearest airport is King Khalid International Airport, 12 miles from Erfad Hotel - Riyadh.

1020970.description: Hotel Pinar Plaza features a total of 145 units. This hotel was lastly renovated in 2024. All guests staying at this hotel can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the establishment. As this hotel features 24-hour reception, guests are always welcome. This establishment's common areas are disability-friendly. Parking facilities are available for guests' convenience. Hotel Pinar Plaza features a variety of dining experiences. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

1021057.description:
A stay at ACROPOLIS CITY LIFE BH places you in the heart of Athens, steps from Ermou Street and Monastiraki Flea Market. This hotel is 0. 4 mi (0. 6 km) from Acropolis and 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Syntagma Square. 
Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. 
Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). 
A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. 
Make yourself at home in one of the 16 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks.

1021072.description:
Welcome to ibis budget Madrid Aeropuerto, ideal for your travels, with soundproofed rooms to ensure you get a good night's sleep. We offer an airport pick-up and transfer service for an additional fee during predetermined hours. 

Recently opened, non-smoking, equipped with shower, toilet, free Wi-Fi, heating or air conditioning (depending on the season), desk and 32" TV. 

Start your day with a generous continental breakfast buffet from 6 a. m. for early risers. 

Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas Airport, IFEMA and the Riyadh Air Metropolitano stadium are a 10-minute drive away. Just 5 minutes away you will find the bus stop that connects you to the Canillejas and Avenida de América metro stations. 
Want to go shopping or enjoy dinner? Just 3 bus stops away you will find the Plenilunio Shopping Centre.

1021296.description: Via Augusta 129 is located in central Lisbon, about 300 meters from Commerce Square and less than 1 km from St. George's Castle. It offers accommodations with free Wi-Fi and a seating area. The air-conditioned accommodation features a fully equipped kitchenette with a dining area, a flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom with a shower, free toiletries, and a hairdryer. A refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave, and kettle are also available. Popular points of interest near the apartment include Rossio Square, Dona Maria II National Theater, and Miradouro da Senhora do Monte. The nearest airport is Humberto Delgado Airport, 8 km from Via Augusta 129.

1021448.description:
Set in Dubai, 6 km from Grand Mosque, Khalidia Palace Hotel Dubai offers accommodation with an outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a fitness centre and a shared lounge. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, hairdresser's and sauna. The accommodation features a 24-hour front desk, airport transfers, a kids' club and free WiFi. 

The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms offering a desk, a kettle, a minibar, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a bidet. Selected rooms will provide you with a kitchenette with a fridge, a microwave and a stovetop. At Khalidia Palace Hotel Dubai all rooms come with bed linen and towels. 

Guests at the accommodation can enjoy a buffet breakfast. 

Khalidia Palace Hotel Dubai offers a sun terrace. You can play darts at this 5-star hotel, and car hire is available.

1021510.description: The premises count with 21 welcoming rooms.

1021657.description: Located in Lisbon and with Commerce Square reachable within a 3-minute walk, Golden Lisbon Hotel provides concierge services, allergy-free rooms, a restaurant, free WiFi throughout the property and a bar. This 4-star hotel offers room service and a 24-hour front desk. The property is a 7-minute walk from Rossio Square, and within 1. 1 miles of the city center. The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms offering a closet, a coffee machine, a minibar, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower. Selected rooms have a kitchenette with a fridge, a microwave and a stovetop. At Golden Lisbon Hotel every room is equipped with bed linen and towels. Breakfast is available daily, and includes buffet, à la carte and continental options. Popular points of interest near the accommodation include St. George's Castle, Dona Maria II National Theater and Miradouro da Senhora do Monte. The nearest airport is Humberto Delgado Airport, 5 miles from Golden Lisbon Hotel.

1021710.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the ARCOTEL AQ Wien, a modern hotel in Vienna's Alsergrund district, just a short drive from the Vienna Christmas Market and the Vienna State Opera. Start your day with a delicious buffet breakfast (available for a fee) at BARbara restaurant. The hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services, as well as a bar/lounge for evening relaxation. Business travelers will appreciate the four meeting rooms and computer station. Each of the 157 air-conditioned guest rooms features a shower, hairdryer, laptop-compatible safe, and desk. Nearby attractions include the Danube River, Volksoper Vienna, and the Sigmund Freud Museum.

1021733.description: The 31 welcoming accommodation units offer a perfect place to relax after a long day. Built in 2024, this botel provides complimentary Wi-Fi in public areas. Guests at the Overnight Super Yacht Experience - Orchid will appreciate the 24-hour reception and convenient parking facilities. An airport transfer service is also available. The botel offers functional business facilities, ideal for corporate travelers. A range of on-site dining options complements the guest experience, ensuring delicious meals are readily available. The botel's health and wellness offerings provide the ultimate in rejuvenation and relaxation. Additional fees may apply for some services.

1021737.description: Situated 2. 1 km from Mata Beach, Villa Paraíso da Caparica is a beautiful small 3-star Hôtel in Charneca and has a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, a garden and a terrace. Located around 2. 8 km from Cornelia Beach, the hôtel with free WiFi is also 16 km away from Jeronimos Monastery. The property is non-smoking and is located 2. 3 km from Riviera Beach. All rooms are fitted with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, fridge, a kettle, a shower, a hairdryer and a desk. The hotel features some units that have a balcony and city view, and the rooms are fitted with a private bathroom and a wardrobe. At Villa Paraíso da Caparica the rooms come with bed linen and towels. Guests at the accommodation can enjoy a buffet breakfast. Rossio is 17 km from Villa Paraíso da Caparica, while Dona Maria II National Theatre is 17 km from the property. The nearest airport is Humberto Delgado Airport, 22 km from the hotel.

1021772.description: Featuring city views and free WiFi, PAREA Athens features accommodation ideally situated in the centre of Athens, within a short distance of Monastiraki Metro Station, Monastiraki Railway Station and Monastiraki Square. Boasting a lift, this property also provides guests with a sun terrace. The property offers soundproof units and is situated 500 metres from Roman Agora. All units are air-conditioned and some of them have a seating area with a flat-screen TV, and a fully equipped kitchen with a dining area. There is a private bathroom with shower in every unit, along with slippers, a hair dryer and free toiletries. At the aparthotel, units have bed linen and towels. Guests at the aparthotel will be able to enjoy activities in and around Athens, like cycling. Guest must contact the hotel prior to arrival for check-in instrutions:email: info@pareaathens. gr / phone: 0030 6957258629

1021828.description: Reimagine urban living at Apt, a unique aparthotel in the heart of Santiago's vibrant Golf neighborhood. We seamlessly blend the best of hotel services with the comfort of a home away from home, offering 88 thoughtfully designed apartments and inviting common spaces. Discover a unique creative perspective and immerse yourself in the lively culture of El Golf, Apoquindo, and Vitacura.

1021856.description: Park Hyatt Marrakech is perfectly situated in the secure residential area of the Al Maaden golf resort, offering breathtaking views of the Atlas Mountains and an exclusive access to its 18-hole course. The resort covers a 7. 5-hectare area and blends contemporary design with its natural surroundings. Sixteen pavilions accommodate 130 spacious rooms and suites, ranging from 55 to 350msq, designed by renowned interior designer Imaad Rahmouni. The resort features three outdoor swimming pools, including a family pool, and three outlets orchestrated by the talented chef Issam Rhachi- Living Room for Tea-Time and Tapas, Pavillon Terrace Pool for light and seasonal lunches menu under shady pergolas or on the poolside king beds, and TFAYA – brasserie arabesque where ancestral culinary tradition meets modern execution technique. The hotel showcases as well contemporary works of art thanks to a unique collaboration with the Ifitry artists residence. A vast 2, 200msq Spa combines local traditions through the renowned national brand Nectarome with advanced beauty techniques from the international brand Sodashi. The Spa has 10 treatment rooms spread across 2 floors, a yoga studio, two cardio and fitness rooms, a hair salon with pedicure and manicure services, and a spacious indoor pool. For families, the hotel also has a spacious Kids Club with a variety of indoor and outdoor activities for children aged 4 to 12. Finally, a 1, 000msq Meeting Residence provides an elegant private space with seven meeting rooms, a private foyer, and a bar with an outdoor terrace, perfect for hosting exceptional events. Please note the following information for all bookings staying over the night of 31st December. For the New Year's Eve dinner, the menu at TFAYA - brasserie arabesque is mandatory and priced at 3600 MAD per adult. For children and teenagers from 8 to 16, a buffet dinner with entertainment is available at 900 MAD per person.

name.content: Juliana Hotel Brussels and Spa - City Centre

1021923.description: Located on Place des Martyrs, in the heart of Brussels, Juliana Hotel Brussels is a 5-star boutique hotel combining historic elegance with modern luxury. It is close to iconic landmarks such as the Belgian Comic Strip Center, Mont des Arts, and Brussels Central Station, offering easy access to the city's major attractions. Housed in a Victorian-style building, the hotel features a collection of artworks from the owner's private collection, creating a unique atmosphere. The 43 air-conditioned rooms provide high-end comfort with a desk, coffee machine, minibar, safe, flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom with a shower and bathtub. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. The hotel also offers room service, a 24-hour front desk, and private parking on-site. The wellness area includes an indoor pool, fitness center, traditional hammam, and sauna. Personalized treatments and signature therapies are also available for an ultimate relaxation experience. A lush courtyard invites guests to unwind in a peaceful setting. Each morning, a buffet, à la carte, or continental breakfast is served. The hotel’s restaurant and bar offer elegant cuisine paired with carefully selected wines and house-made creations. The hotel is located just 500 meters from Brussels Central Station and 20 km from Brussels Airport, easily accessible by taxi or public transport.

1021941.address: Rue Bab Jdid Villa 9 Sidi Mimoun
1021941.description: Located in Marrakesh, a 12-minute walk from Djemaa El Fna, Sillage Palace Sky & Spa provides accommodations with an outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a garden and a shared lounge. Featuring room service, this property also welcomes guests with a restaurant, a casino and a terrace. The property has a concierge service, a tour desk and currency exchange for guests. The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms offering a desk, a coffee machine, a fridge, a minibar, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower. The rooms come with an electric tea pot, while certain rooms will provide you with a balcony and others also provide guests with garden views. At Sillage Palace Sky & Spa all rooms are equipped with bed linen and towels. A continental, vegetarian or vegan breakfast is served at the property. The area is popular for cycling, and bike rental is available at this 5-star hotel. Speaking Arabic, English, Spanish and French at the reception, staff are ready to help around the clock. Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Koutoubia, Bahia Palace and Mouassine Museum. The nearest airport is Marrakech-Menara, 1. 9 miles from Sillage Palace Sky & Spa, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

1021963.description: Enjoy a stay at the Seafront Luxury Suites Jeddah Corniche, located in Jeddah's Ash Shati district, just steps from the Red Sea and a short walk from Jeddah Corniche. This beachfront hotel offers 120 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a kitchen, microwave, dishwasher, flat-screen TV, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can also take advantage of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, a banquet hall, and a continental breakfast available for a fee. Additional amenities include a 24-hour business center, a 24-hour front desk, laundry facilities, and two meeting rooms. Free self-parking is provided on-site. Nearby attractions include the Red Sea Mall and Hera Street. King Abdulaziz Intl. Airport (JED) is approximately 10. 9 miles away.

1021966.description: Located in Dubai, a 15-minute walk from Grand Mosque, Vista City Hotel has accommodations with a restaurant, free private parking, an outdoor swimming pool and a fitness center. With free WiFi, this 3-star hotel has a bar and a garden. The property provides a 24-hour front desk, room service and currency exchange for guests. The rooms at the hotel come with air conditioning, a seating area, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a safety deposit box and a private bathroom with a bath, slippers and a hairdryer. At Vista City Hotel rooms include bed linen and towels. Guests at the accommodation can enjoy a continental or a buffet breakfast. Vista City Hotel offers 3-star accommodations with a sauna and terrace. Dubai World Trade Centre is 2. 8 miles from the hotel, while City Walk Mall is 4. 5 miles from the property. The nearest airport is Dubai International, 4. 3 miles from Vista City Hotel, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

1021974.description: This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception.

name.content: Hilton Garden Inn Athens Syggrou Avenue

1021994.description: Hilton Garden Inn Athens Syggrou Avenue is a luxury hotel with beautifully minimal designed rooms, contactless technology and eco-friendly approach. All while being conveniently located on one of Athens’ biggest Avenues, near public transportation and top city attractions. Plus, it offers top-notch concierge services, a fully equipped gym, parking area, restaurant and swimming pool on the rooftop with magnificant views of the Acropolis and the city!Book now for a comfortable and memorable stay.

1021997.description: Nestled in the heart of Brussels, at the most coveted downtown location, Hotel Fleur de Ville emerges as a beacon of luxury for the discerning traveler. This upscale boutique hotel, situated amidst the bustling energy of the city, offers unparalleled access to public transport, allowing guests to seamlessly blend exploration with tranquility. Encircled by a tapestry of restaurants, chic boutiques, museums, and the pulsating vibe of the city's main touristic draws, Fleur de Ville is more than a hotel—it's a pivotal chapter in the story of those it shelters. The grandeur of the building is steeped in history, its walls echoing the tales of time. At Fleur de Ville, we pay homage to this legacy, crafting a concept that resonates with the enchantment of Brussels. Here, history intertwines with modern elegance, crafting a retreat that whispers of old-world charm while nodding to contemporary tastes. Our vision for Fleur de Ville is to be the city's blooming oasis amidst the concrete expanse—a sanctuary that exudes poise and refinement. We invite our guests to embark on a journey of inner peace, where the hustle of everyday life fades into the background, and a wellspring of inspiration rejuvenates the spirit. We are not just a stopover; we are the canvas where memories are painted, a home where every guest departs feeling enlivened, with a profound sense of connection to this charismatic sojourn. The essence of Fleur de Ville is captured in three pillars: refined escapism, captivating authenticity, and intriguing elegance. Each of the 51 unique rooms and suites is a testament to individuality, offering a bespoke haven tailored to the nuances of personal preference. Culinary journeys at Fleur de Ville are rooted in authenticity, with a fine dining restaurant serving a symphony of Mediterranean flavors. Each dish is a celebration of tradition and innovation, inviting guests to savor the true essence of gastronomic excellence.

1022094.description: Clients will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Riad Elite as it counts with a total of 6 rooms. The establishment includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and accomodation units. Riad Elite offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience.

1022147.description: The Sumahan Suites & Spa is a haven of peace located on the Amizmiz Road, 20 km from the center of Marrakech and the airport. It is also 10 minutes from the Lalla Takerkoust dam, several golf courses, and just 30 minutes from the Agafay Desert. Nestled in lush surroundings, the hotel offers various accommodations, including Junior and Superior Suites with views of the Atlas Mountains. Each suite features a spacious terrace. Guests can enjoy the fitness center and spa, where therapists offer daily relaxing and invigorating massages and traditional Hammam rituals. The hotel features both international and Moroccan cuisine, which can be enjoyed under the Caidal tent amidst the gardens.

1022174.description: La Divina, a newly established 12-suite hotel, is situated on Andrianou Street in Thessio, at the heart of Athens’ historical center. This neoclassical building was previously known as the ‘Odeon Athenaeum’ music hall, dedicated to the legendary Maria Callas, in whose honor the international music center was constructed. This contemporary boutique hotel offers 12 spacious suites with unique views of the Acropolis, the Ancient Agora in Thessio, and the Athens Asteroscopio. On the hotel’s ground floor, there are two modern restaurants, perfect for savoring Greek cuisine and local wines. The hotel’s location is ideal for those interested in exploring the city’s historical landmarks and museums, as well as for those looking to experience the vibrant nightlife of the capital. La Divina’s position is not just about convenience; it’s about immersing yourself in the essence of Athens. Whether you’re seeking cultural exploration, shopping for souvenirs, indulging in delectable Greek cuisine, or simply soaking in the historic charm of Thessio, this hotel’s location is the perfect starting point for an unforgettable journey through the heart of Athens. Each room and suite at La Divina is equipped with modern amenities, including air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, a smart TV, a fully stocked minibar, and a luxurious en-suite bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Impeccable service and attention to detail are hallmarks of your stay, ensuring a truly unforgettable experience in the heart of Athens' Plaka district. Whether you're exploring the charming streets of Plaka, indulging in Greek cuisine at nearby tavernas, or simply savoring the stunning views, La Divina promises a classical and luxurious retreat that will leave you with lasting memories of your visit to Athens. Pets are allowed upon request. A service fee of €25 per stay will be applied. Service includes:Deep and allergic cleaning upon check out, Pet mattress, Food and Water Dish Bowl.

1022213.description: Relax by the seasonal outdoor pool or enjoy the garden views at Ripamonti BnB. A snack bar/deli is available for a quick bite. The BnB offers express check-in/check-out and laundry facilities. Each of the 5 air-conditioned rooms features a flat-screen TV, private furnished patio, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Bathrooms include a bathtub, complimentary toiletries, and a bidet. Located in Milan, Ripamonti BnB is within a 15-minute drive of Piazza del Duomo and the Cathedral of Milan. It's also conveniently located near several attractions including the European Institute of Oncology (1. 8 km), Fondazione Prada (5. 4 km) and Bocconi University (6. 3 km). The nearest airports are Linate (13. 3 km), Milan Malpensa (63. 4 km), and Bergamo Orio al Serio (60. 4 km).

1022228.description: Enjoy a central Athens stay at Athens Smart Apartments, a guesthouse just a 3-minute walk from Ermou Street and 8 minutes from the Acropolis. Our six air-conditioned rooms offer Select Comfort beds with Egyptian cotton sheets, private balconies, refrigerators, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. The front desk operates on limited hours, but concierge services are available. We're also conveniently located near Monastiraki Flea Market (0. 3 mi) and Syntagma Square (0. 5 mi). The preferred airport is Athens International Airport (ATH), 21. 1 miles away.

1022266.description: Welcome to Tru By Hilton Brooklyn. Located in Brooklyn's Gowanus neighborhood, our hotel is less than a mile from Barclays Center. We're within a couple blocks of dozens of restaurants, and public transit options are less than a block away. Work, play, eat, and unwind in our lobby with a game zone and 24-hour market.

1022270.address: 8508 King Fahd Rd Al Olaya District
1022270.description: Situated in Riyadh, 2. 6 km from Panorama Mall, Hilton Riyadh Olaya features accommodation with a restaurant, private parking, a garden and a terrace. This 5-star hotel offers a 24-hour front desk and room service. The hotel has an indoor pool and shared lounge, and King Khalid Grand Mosque is 2. 7 km away. The rooms at the hotel are fitted with a seating area, a flat-screen TV with cable channels and a safety deposit box. Guest rooms at Hilton Riyadh Olaya have air conditioning and a desk. Breakfast is available each morning, and includes buffet, continental and halal options. Al Faisaliah Mall is 3. 2 km from the accommodation, while Al Faisaliah Tower is 3. 6 km from the property. The nearest airport is King Khalid International Airport, 31 km from Hilton Riyadh Olaya.

1022346.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities like bicycle rentals, a terrace, and a garden at Boerderij Hazenveld. This bed and breakfast also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a common area television, and tour/ticket assistance. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee (8:30 AM to 10:30 AM). Amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Free self-parking is available on-site. Relax in one of the four air-conditioned rooms featuring complimentary minibar items and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming. Bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Safes, desks, and daily housekeeping are also provided. Located in Kockengen within a regional park, Boerderij Hazenveld is a 4-minute drive from De Haar Castle and 9 minutes from Máximapark. It's also convenient to City Museum Woerden (10. 2 km) and St. Peter's Church (10. 3 km). The nearest airports are Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS) and Rotterdam The Hague Airport (RTM).

1022361.description: Enjoy garden views at this Edinburgh hotel, and take advantage of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi. The seven guestrooms offer espresso makers and flat-screen televisions. Bathrooms with bathtubs or showers are provided. Located in the Haymarket area, JOIVY Haymarket is within a 15-minute walk of Princes Street and the Edinburgh International Conference Centre. It's also conveniently close to George Street (0. 8 mi) and Edinburgh Castle (1. 8 mi).

1022381.description: Located in the heart of Edinburgh, JOIVY Brewers Rooms is within a 10-minute walk of the Royal Mile and Princes Street. This hotel offers 11 guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi and en suite bathrooms with showers. Nearby attractions include the Museum of Edinburgh, Scottish Parliament, Holyrood Park, and John Knox House (all within 0. 5 km). The Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 16. 1 km away.

1022441.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this lodge include a picnic area and barbecue grills. A complimentary breakfast is included. Featured amenities include luggage storage and laundry facilities. Free self parking is available onsite. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 10 guestrooms, featuring heated floors and Smart televisions. Kitchens are outfitted with microwaves. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Enjoy personalized treatments in our single and double cabins, where experienced therapists use Ignae products to pamper your skin and the planet, guiding you to deep relaxation and renewed energy.

Following a thorough refurbishment preserving the historical façade, the hotel is comprised of 84 elegant rooms, including 26 suites, designed to ensure the most memorable stay. 1036329.description:

This hotel offers complimentary parking nearby.

Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours).

Bathrooms have separate bathtubs and showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include electric kettles and free tea bags/instant coffee, and housekeeping is provided daily.

name.content: Altis Porto, member of Preferred Hotels & Resorts

1036353.description:
A journey to well-being, a holistic rest for body, mind and soul. 

Altis Porto Hotel is a 5-star hotel, has 95 rooms, 7 of which are suites with a contemporary and timeless design, where every detail has been thought out for a complete wellness experience, for all those who want to nurture a healthier lifestyle that balances body, mind and soul. With a privileged view over the Douro River, the hotel extends the Wellness concept with its location in one of the most privileged areas of Porto, next to the gardens of the Crystal Palace, Clérigos Tower and Alfândega. 

The Restaurant Exuberante offers a unique gastronomic experience, highlighting vibrant colors, fresh local ingredients, and exclusive flavors. 

For incentives, conferences, cocktails or dinners, the Hotel offers spaces with natural light, respectively and a the Slowly Bar at lobby and the Above Rooftop Bar with outdoor pool. 

he Mandalay Spa is an exceptional place to treat body and mind. Its 500 sqm have been designed to provide total comfort and invite meditation and relaxation. It has 4 treatment rooms, 2 of which are double rooms, a sauna, a steam room and a heated indoor pool. The hotel has also a Fitness Room with Technogym equipment. This hotel is Dog-Friendly (accepts only one pet per stay, up to 15 kg, for an additional fee for day).

Begin your day with an espresso in the hotel’s cafe before setting out to explore this fascinating city. Other attractions can be reached in a short time via either the north/south U6 subway line (Stadtmitte station) or the east/west U2 subway line (Mohrenstrasse station).

Whether you’re sipping mint tea in the patio or discovering the magic of the nearby Jemaa El-Fna, every moment is enriched with authenticity and comfort.

1058511.description:
Ruby Charm Houses sits on Ilha Cardoso, a traditional working class courtyard in the heart of Porto, where resident families still live alongside our guests. Six independent houses open onto a shared urban vegetable garden, and each one keeps the original doors, cupboards and tiles, restored rather than replaced. 

Accommodation ranges from single level studios for one or two guests to two storey houses with a mezzanine bedroom and a sofa bed downstairs, sleeping up to three. Every house has a private bathroom and a fully equipped kitchenette. 

Included with every stay: free fibre WiFi, use of the vegetable garden with its tables and barbecue, and local advice from a team that lives on site. Guests are welcome in the garden and we ask only for a small packet of seeds in return, any kind you like. 

Available on request: jacuzzi at 15 euros per hour booked 24 hours in advance, laundry service, airport transfers at 25 euros each way, and city tour tickets at reception. 

Reception is open Monday to Friday from 14:00 to 19:30 and at weekends from 10:00 to 14:00. Check in from 15:00, check out between 08:00 and 11:00. There is no private car park. Public parking is available in front of the property, subject to availability, and guests arriving by car are asked to let us know in advance. The houses have stairs and mezzanine levels and are not wheelchair accessible. 

Faria Guimaraes metro station is a five minute walk away and Marques eight. Porto city tourist tax of 3 euros per guest per night, up to seven nights, is payable on arrival.

1067375.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and an elevator. Make yourself at home in one of the 116 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have bidets and hair dryers. 1067384.description: At Four Points by Sheraton King Abdulaziz Road, exceptional service and top-notch amenities create a memorable experience for guests. For guests with their own vehicle, parking facilities are provided. Always look your best in your preferred attire with the laundromat and dry cleaning service provided at Four Points by Sheraton King Abdulaziz Road. Craving relaxation? In-room amenities such as room service and daily housekeeping allow you to maximize your time spent inside the room. Accommodations come equipped with all the conveniences required for a restful night's slumber. A number of rooms feature cable TV for guest amusement and enjoyment. In certain rooms, the hotel offers visitors access to instant tea and mini bar. At Four Points by Sheraton King Abdulaziz Road, select bathrooms are equipped with a hair dryer to enhance your comfort during your stay.

1067459.description: Relax and unwind with body treatments and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Grab a bite to eat at one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free valet parking is available onsite.
