1067582.description: Feel right at home while enjoying all the comforts of a personalised serviced tailored to your needs. This is our costumer service philosofy and commitment. It is for this reason that we have adapted our service and facilities, with the anticipation and absolute certainty that they will make you stay more enjoyable. This is confirmed by twenty years of experience in the sector. Our convention saloons are ideal to perform any type of meeting, seminar or congress, adapted to your professional needs and surrounded by a pleasant environment. Fully-equipped saloonsPA systemWhiteboardScreenWireless InternetCoffeesType - mapTheater type, U type and school type.

1067590.description: Set just 1640 feet from Plaza Espanya, Home to Home Barcelona offers modern, air-conditioned apartments with free Wi-Fi. There is a shared terrace with a chill out zone and views of Montjuic. Decorated in a minimalistic style, each apartment includes a living-dining area with a sofa bed and flat-screen satellite TV. Their kitchens are equipped with a microwave, electric hob, dishwasher and washer-dryer. A wide range of shops, restaurants and bars can be found in the area. Arenas Shopping Center is a 10-minute walk from the apartments and offers great views of the city from its rooftop. Fira de Barcelona Convention Center can also be reached in 10 minutes’ walk. Espanya Metro Station is 1640 feet away and connects with Plaza Catalunya. Airport busses also stop in Plaza Espanya.

1067610.description: Zouk Hotel is located on the A-2 Motorway in Alcalá de Henares. This stylish hotel offers discreet service and air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TV and an MP3 player. The elegant rooms at the Zouk feature a range of satellite channels and ceiling mirrors. Each one has a dining area where all meals are served in the privacy of your room. There is 24-hour room service. Each room has a free private parking space, and you can check in and out without having to get out of your car. All rooms also have a private entrance. Hotel Zouk is 7 minutes’ drive from Alcalá de Henares’ beautiful old town, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. You can drive to central Madrid in just 25 minutes.

1067623.description: Set in the heart of Mondim de Basto village, Mondim AL & Spa offers accommodation range from apartments to double and twin rooms. All have free WiFi access and a private bathroom. Some units have kitchenette facilities. A breakfast buffet is available daily, and guests can enjoy it in their room upon request. Vila Real city is 36 km, and Guimarães is a 45-minute drive from Mondim de Basto. Alvão Natural Park, with the biggest waterfalls in Europe, is a 15-minute drive from Mondim AL & Spa.

1067625.description: Hotel Brites provides rooms in Chaves near Chaves Roman Bridge and Chaves Castle. With a shared lounge, the 2-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. The property is non-smoking throughout and is located a 17-minute walk from Chaves Thermal Spa. At the hotel, the rooms come with a desk. Each room is equipped with a flat-screen TV, and certain rooms at Hotel Brites have a city view. Guest rooms include a closet. Golf Course Vidago Palace is 11 miles from the accommodation, while Carvalhelhos Thermal Spa is 23 miles away.

1067651.description: With a 25-km beach just 400 metres away and within a 15-minute drive of Lisbon, this beach hotel offers air-conditioned rooms and free parking (limited to 3 places reserved for the Hotel). There are 2 computers with free internet in the lobby. Including cable TV, Hotel Residencial Colibri’s guest rooms offer internet access and are simply furnished. All rooms have a private bathroom with a hairdryer. A breakfast buffet is served daily. Large windows let in lots of daylight in The Colibri’s spacious breakfast room. Guests can take a short 2-minute walk to the centre of Costa da Caparica to discover a number of seafood restaurants, cafés and shops. Guests can rent bicycles and cars on site. The hotel is situated a 30-minute drive from Lisbon Airport. The 24-hour reception staff can recommend trips to Almada, Lisbon and Sintra. The Belém area of Lisbon with various iconic monuments is 15 km away while the mystic town of Sintra is 39 km away. The iconic statue of Christ the King is a 13-minute drive while the lively Bairro Alto district is a 30-minute drive from the hotel. News since December 2025! Our hotel has inaugurated a modern training space in the CrossFit style, featuring group classes throughout the day, personalized training sessions with personal trainers, and an open box for those who prefer to train independently. All services are available with special conditions for guests, allowing you to maintain your fitness and enhance your well-being during your stay.

1067653.description: Set at the edge of the Sonian Forest in Brussels, youth accommodations Auberge des 3 Fontaines offers functional guest rooms and dormitories with free Wi-Fi access in public areas, as well as a tennis court, a garden with a terrace and an on-site restaurant. Free public parking is available. The rooms come with bunk and/or single beds, a small desk area and a dining table. At Auberge des 3 Fontaines, guests can start their day with a wholesome breakfast. At the hostel’s restaurant, you can sample a meal or have a drink at the bar. The closest supermarkets are within 1. 2 mi. The hostel consists of a tennis court, table tennis and squash facilities which can be accessed for an additional charge. You can relax in the garden or out on the terrace. Auberge des 3 Fontaines is 6. 5 mi from the Grand Place, 7. 5 mi from Brussels-South Train Station with the Eurostar and Thalys terminal, and 6. 1 mi from Brussels-Central Train Station. Brussels Airport is an 18-minute drive away. Tourist information is available at the reception. The hostel can be accessed by public transport, there is a bus station just in front of the Sports Center and the nearest metro stop (Hermann-Debroux) is a 10-minute walk away. Access by car is easy via the Brussels Ring and the E411 highway, which provides fast links to various European routes.

1067656.description: Located within 2. 5 miles of Stade de Genève and 4. 3 miles of Cornavin Train Station, Les Chambres du CTN has rooms in Geneva. The property is around 4. 3 miles from Jet d'Eau, 4. 4 miles from St. Pierre Cathedral and 5. 6 miles from United Nations Geneva. The hotel has family rooms. At the hotel, rooms have a closet. With a private bathroom equipped with a hairdryer, rooms at Les Chambres du CTN also feature free WiFi, while certain rooms have a balcony. At the accommodation rooms include a desk and a flat-screen TV. Guests at Les Chambres du CTN can enjoy a buffet breakfast. PalExpo is 7. 1 miles from the hotel, while CERN is 8. 1 miles from the property. Geneva International Airport is 6. 2 miles away.

1067658.description: Located in Baden, 17 miles from Swiss National Museum, Landhotel Linde Fislisbach has accommodations with a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a garden and a terrace. With free WiFi, this 3-star hotel has a restaurant and a bar. The hotel has family rooms. The rooms at the hotel come with a seating area and a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Rooms have a private bathroom with a hairdryer, while certain rooms contain a balcony and others also feature city views. All rooms have a desk. Buffet and continental breakfast options are available at Landhotel Linde Fislisbach. The accommodation has a playground. Zurich Central Station is 17 miles from Landhotel Linde Fislisbach, while Bahnhofstrasse is 17 miles from the property. Zurich Airport is 21 miles away.

1067667.description: This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception.

1067671.description: Set just a 15-minute train ride from the center of Barcelona, this modern hotel provides smart, stylish accommodations for an affordable price. Located in the town of La Llagosta, the Llagotel is just a train ride or 25-minute bus ride from the Catalan capital. Rooms are minimalist in style and come with state-of-the-art amenities such as flat-screen TVs and internet connections. Each one has an private bathroom and cooling parquet floor. Helpful hotel staff can help you book excursions in the surrounding region, including trips to Barcelona, Montserrat and Andorra. Start a day of sightseeing with the hotel’s breakfast, before returning in the evening for a delicious dinner in the hotel restaurant.

1067682.address: Carrer Del Comte D Urgell 51 Bis
1067682.description: Offering modern rooms with free WiFi, Bird House is just 98 feet from Urgell Metro Station and within 15 minutes’ walk of Plaza de Catalunya, Las Ramblas and Plaza Espanya. Featuring high ceilings, each air-conditioned room at Bird House has bright, minimalist décor. There is heating and access to shared bathroom facilities. The bedrooms also include free WiFi, a wardrobe and a desk. Bed linen and towels are provided. It offers use of a shared kitchen and serves breakfast. Restaurants, bars and cafés can be found around Sant Antoni District, 5 minutes' walk away. Passeig de Gràcia is a 15-minute walk away. The Airport Bus stops 98 feet away from Bird House, at Gran Via-Urgell bus stop. The MACBA Modern Art Museum is less than 0. 6 mi from the Bird House, while Gaudí’s La Pedrera and Casa Batlló houses can be reached in 20 minutes by foot.

1067687.description: This converted seminary is just 5 minutes’ walk from Vic’s charming Old Town. It offers modern, air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom. Seminari Allotjaments’ buffet restaurant serves traditional Catalan food. There is a large dining room, a snack bar and vending machines for snacks and drinks. Seminari Allotjaments has a library and a chapel within its charming grounds. Staff at the 24-hour reception can provide information about what to see and do in Vic. Vic’s train station and its main square are around 10 minutes’ walk from the Seminari. A shuttle service is available to Barcelona's El Prat Airport, located 50 minutes’ drive away. You can drive to central Barcelona in just over an hour.

1067694.description: Clients can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the accomodation. Those who stay at this establishment are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

1067710.description: Comfortable Accommodations: El Colorín in Los Molinos offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and free WiFi. Each room includes a work desk, TV, and wardrobe, ensuring a pleasant stay. Dining and Leisure: Guests can enjoy meals at the on-site restaurant and unwind at the bar. The hotel features a sun terrace for relaxation and a lift for easy access. Convenient Location: Located 48 km from Plaza Mayor and 69 km from Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport, El Colorín provides easy access to local attractions. Activities such as skiing and cycling are available nearby. Guest Satisfaction: Highly rated for its attentive staff, convenient location, and immaculate rooms, El Colorín ensures a pleasant and comfortable stay for all visitors.

1067712.description: Situated in the town center, Hotel De Martin offers convenient access to local attractions and entertainment. This 11-room hotel, originally built in 1900 and renovated in 2012, provides a tranquil stay. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi in public areas, parking, and a transfer service (fees may apply). The nearest golf course is within 1200 km, and the slopes are 30 km away. Public transport is within 300 meters of the hotel.

1067713.description: Room018BCN is located 1476 feet from FC Barcelona's Camp Nou Stadium. This modern hostel offers rooms with free WiFi and individual lockers. The air-conditioned dormitory rooms feature parquet floors and modern décor. Each bed has an LED reading light. Bed linen is provided, and towels can be rented on site. Some rooms have a private bathroom. The reception is open 24 hours. Staff at reception can arrange tickets for FC Barcelona matches, as well as other events or public transport tickets. There is a shared kitchen where you can prepare meals and there are vending machines on site. Room018BCN is located next to Les Corts Metro Station, taking you to Drassanes at the bottom of the Rambla in around 15 minutes. You can walk to L'Illa Shopping Center in around 10 minutes.

1067716.description: Motel Portofino is located between the center of Porto, and the towns of Maia and Matosinhos. Beaches and the International Airport Francisco Sá Carneiro are a 10-minute drive away. Motel Portofino has a 24-hour front desk and free parking is possible on site. The bathrobes, extra towels or extra blankets on request.

1067720.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Dom Hotel in Penafiel offers 2-star rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and mountain views. Each room includes a work desk, TV, and free toiletries. Modern Facilities: Guests enjoy a fitness centre and free WiFi. The hotel provides a 24-hour front desk, daily housekeeping, room service, and free on-site private parking. Delicious Breakfast: A continental buffet breakfast is served with fresh pastries, cheese, and fruits. The breakfast is highly praised for its quality and value. Prime Location: Located 39 km from Palace Duques de Bragança and Salado Memorial, 40 km from Guimarães Castle and FC Porto Museum, and 44 km from Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport. Nearby attractions include Douro River and Sao Bento Train Station.

1067723.description: ArsDurium Douro hotel features a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, garden, a shared lounge and terrace in Cinfães. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, room service and a concierge service, along with free WiFi throughout the property. The property provides airport transportation, while a bicycle rental service is also available. At the hotel, all rooms include a closet. Every room has a private bathroom with free toiletries, while some rooms will provide you with a kitchen with a fridge. All guest rooms in ArsDurium Douro hotel are equipped with a flat-screen TV and a hairdryer. Guests at the accommodation can enjoy a continental breakfast. You can play table tennis at this 4-star hotel, and the area is popular for hiking and fishing. Douro Museum is 24 miles from ArsDurium Douro hotel, while Our Lady of Remedies Sanctuary is 25 miles away. Viseu Airport is 43 miles from the property.

1067728.description: Located in Vila Pouca de Aguiar, Hotel Europa is only 19 mi from Mateus Palace in the neighboring town of Vila Real. Free Wi-Fi is accessible throughout the hotel. The air-conditioned rooms all have wooden floors and flat-screened TVs. All rooms have balconies with a view of the town, and the bathrooms contain hairdryers. Breakfast is served daily and the restaurant at the Europa prepares traditional Portuguese meals. There is also a bar where guests can enjoy a variety of beverages. Lamego municipality, well-known for its Port production, is a 1-hour drive away. The historical town of Guimaraes is a 42 mi drive from the hotel.

1067735.description: The Altmann is a well-kept, family-run hotel in the south of Vienna, close to the main motorways and the SCS shopping centre - running trails are also nearby. All rooms come with a 32-inch flat-screen cable TV and a private bathroom with shower. The bus number 250 takes you to the S-Bahn stop Liesing. The Riverside Shopping Centre can be reached within a few stops. One of Europe's largest shopping malls is about a 12-minute drive away. The Shopping City Süd (SCS) features a wide range of shops, restaurants and leisure options, including a multiplex cinema.

1067742.description: The family-run HOTELMARIA – Business Travel Sports Celebrations is located just 15 km south of Vienna and 19 km from Vienna International Airport. The train station is only a 5-minute walk away, with direct trains to Vienna Central Station in just 14 minutes without changing trains. Whether you are travelling for business, exploring Vienna, enjoying a golf getaway or looking for a comfortable stopover, HOTELMARIA offers modern rooms and suites for every type of stay – from cosy GardenRooms and the spacious GardenSuite to air-conditioned RoofTop Single Rooms and the exclusive RoofTopSuite with a freestanding bathtub. Start your day with our extensive breakfast buffet, available from 5:30 on weekdays and from 6:30 on weekends and public holidays. Enjoy free Sky Sport & Entertainment and the convenience of our 24-hour self check-in for a flexible arrival at any time. HOTELMARIA is an ideal base for visiting Vienna, Vienna International Airport, the region's golf courses, Ebreichspark Comer City, Shopping City Süd (SCS) and Designer Outlet Parndorf.

1067762.description: This charming, modernised guest house in Nyon's centre dates back from the 16th century. It is 400 metres away from Lake Geneva and the boat harbour. All rooms are en-suite and they come with cable TV and a work desk. Hostellerie du XVI Siècle's rustic-style restaurant with stone elements serves seasonal cuisine including fish and grilled meat specialities. Guests can also enjoy their meals on the covered outdoor terrace. Wi-Fi access is available free of charge throughout the property. Built on ancient Roman foundations, the Hostellerie is 300 metres away from Nyon Train Station and 200 metres from the castle of Nyon. Guests can store their bicycles in the on-site bike garage. The Golf Club du Domaine Impérial can be reached within 4 km from the du XVI Siècle. Surrounded by vineyards, Nyon is 25 km away from Geneva and 38 km from Lausanne.

1067780.description: Set just 150 metres from Leganés railway and metro stations, offering quick and easy access to Madrid’s city centre, the Avenida Leganés offers free WiFi throughout. The Avenida Leganés, a straight train journey from Barajas airport, offers a great base for visits to Madrid and its surrounding areas. Enjoy a restful stay, thanks to full soundproofing, flat-screen TV with satellite channels, air-conditioning and heating in every room. A private bathroom is featured and hairdryer is available on request. Some rooms also come with a private balcony. The Avenida Leganés is located in a great central area, within walking-distance of bars and restaurants. You can also make the most of free parking at the Avenida Leganés to go on trips by car. Visit the great range of leisure centres around the Leganés area. These include the Warner Bros Theme Park, the La Cubierta events venue, and the Xanada Snow Centre. 24-hour reception means you can enjoy these attractions as late as you want.

1067786.description: Located within a completely restored 19th-century building, So Cool Hostel Porto offers modern, private and shared accommodation in one of the most central avenues of Porto, Avenida da Boavista. Free WiFi access is included. Featuring high ceilings with stucco works, rooms are bright and airy. They all include lockers, individual reading lights and have key card access. Bathroom facilities are shared. Guests can use the common kitchen to prepare their meals and enjoy them in the sunny dining area or outdoors, in the furnished garden area, with a glass of wine from the cellar. Thematic Portuguese dinners are organised by the staff. The So Cool common areas allow guests to relax with a book, listen to music and watch TV/DVD. Rotunda da Boavista is 5 minutes’ walking and Casa da Música is a 10-minute walk away. Many public transport options can be found within 200 metres, giving access to the rest of Porto city. Casa de Serralves and its Contemporary Art Museum is a 10-minute bus ride. The iconic Clérigos Tower is a 20-minute metro ride from So Cool Hostel Porto.

1067797.description: Historic Setting: Landhotel Jagdhof in Guntramsdorf offers a 4-star experience within a historic building. Guests enjoy garden views and a sun terrace, complemented by a spacious outdoor seating area. Comfortable Accommodations: Rooms feature private bathrooms, saunas, and free WiFi. Additional amenities include work desks, TVs, and parquet floors, ensuring a relaxing and comfortable stay. Dining Experience: A buffet breakfast is served daily, offering warm dishes, fresh pastries, cheese, fruits, and juice. The on-site bar provides a perfect spot for unwinding after a day of exploration. Convenient Location: Located 8 km from Spa Garden and Casino Baden, 9 km from Roman Baths and Schönbrunner Gardens, and 23 km from Vienna International Airport. An ice-skating rink is also nearby.

1067811.description: Just a 30-minute drive or train ride from the centre of Vienna, this family-run hotel in the heart of Wolkersdorf offers you fitness and wellness facilities including a swimming pool and free parking. Half-board is available on request in the on-site restaurant. All rooms have an en-suite bathroom and a satellite TV. In the wellness area of the Klaus im Weinviertel hotel you can find a sauna, a steam bath and a solarium. During the warmer months you can enjoy the warm sun in the garden or go jogging through the rolling vineyards. Fine regional and international cuisine is served in the restaurant. Half-board can be booked on site. Fully equipped conference rooms for up to 60 are also at your disposal in the Hotel Klaus im Weinviertel. Vienna can easily be reached from by car or train from Wolkersdorf within 30 minutes.

1067822.description: Enjoying a quiet location in the Vienna Woods, Hotel Austria is 3. 1 mi from Vienna, which can easily be reached by car or public transport. Free WiFi and free private parking at the property are available. All rooms have satellite TV and a private bathroom. Characteristic Viennese specialties and international cuisine can be enjoyed the hotel's restaurant. It also has a garden terrace. Hotel Austria is located in the village center of Gablitz, with various restaurants, shops and a public outdoor pool. Vienna's Schönbrunn Palace is only 9. 3 mi away.

1067831.description: Located in Siebnen, a 2-minute drive from the train station, Hotel Schäfli Siebnen offers free WiFi, a garden with a sun terrace and a restaurant. Private parking spaces are available on site free of charge and the closest bus stop is 230 metres away. The rooms at the Schäfli are comfortably furnished and come with a flat-screen TV, private bathroom facilities and views of the surrounding mountains. Some units also feature a terrace. A delicious breakfast is served daily at the property. Lunch and dinner can be enjoyed at the on-site à-la-carte restaurant, featuring traditional Swiss cuisine. Several shops can be found within 50 metres. Guests at the hotel can take advantage of a common lounge area and a luggage storage room. Zurich Airport is 40 km away.

1067847.description: Augusta Hotel is located in the old part of IJmuiden. Admire the authentic style of this accommodations and take a 5-minute drive to the beach and dunes. The hotel rooms have a warm, romantic appearance. Each room has a bath and free WiFi. Guests can enjoy an extensive breakfast against a surcharge. The hotel has a beautiful restaurant as well as a cozy bar. If you wish to relax, you can sit in the Herenkamer with its open fire and library.

1067877.description: A small family hotel with five rooms with shower, toilet and small kitchen in the picturesque old city of Edam. There is also a studio with two bedrooms, a kitchen, a bathroom and a living room. 20 km from Amsterdam. De Harmonie in Edam is a brown café where live music, good food, drinks and cosy accommodation come together. Enjoy live music, a great atmosphere and the charm of historic Edam.

1067888.description: Hotel Satellite is located in the European District in Brussels, a 10-minute walk from Schuman Train, Bus and Metro Station, from where the city center can be reached in 15 minutes. Free Wi-Fi access is available. The rooms are fitted with a desk, a flat-screen TV with cable channels and a dressing room. Each unit comes with an electric kettle, a microwave and a refrigerator. The private bathroom includes a shower, a toilet and free toiletries. A range of restaurants, bars, supermarkets and cafés can be found within an easy walking distance from Hotel Satellite. Brussels-South Train Station, offering trains to international destinations, is 23 minutes away by public transportation. Brussels Airport is 7. 3 mi from Hotel Satellite. The Atomium is 6. 8 mi from the hotel.

1067942.description: Workbase Pension is located in Liesing, the 23rd district of Vienna, and features rooms with free WiFi, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a writing desk, and a private bathroom with a shower. Free private parking is possible on site. Guests can enjoy lunch in the canteen at Pension Workbase. A vending machine for snacks and drinks is also available, and a restaurant and a supermarket are within a range of 5 walking minutes. The city centre of Vienna with its many attractions can be reached in 35 minutes by public transport. A bus stop is 3 walking minutes away.

1067978.description: At Hotel Alter Markt, exceptional service and top-notch amenities create a memorable experience for guests. Complimentary internet access is available in the hotel to ensure you stay connected during your visit. For guests with their own vehicle, parking facilities are provided. At the hotel, utilize the convenient laundry service to maintain your preferred travel attire fresh, allowing you to pack lighter. Desire to unwind? Make the most of your visit at Hotel Alter Markt with accessible amenities such as daily housekeeping.

1067997.description: Located only 200 metres from Glyfada Beach in Athens, The Crystal Blue Hotel offers individually decorated rooms with free Wi-Fi. Restaurants, bars and shops are within a 3-minute walk. Cold dishes and finger food are served on-site. Featuring discreet lighting, bold colours and individually decorated rooms, all units at the Crystal Blue Hotel have a flat-screen TV and air conditioning. Some accommodation types offer a spa bath and views to the city. Staff at the 24-hour front desk can offer information on nearby areas such as Kavouri 7. 5 km away. The centre of Athens is within 14 km. A tram stops within 50 metres of the hotel. Athens International Airport is 19 km away.

1068006.description: Located in Bisamberg, 9 miles from Austria Center Vienna, OEKOTEL Korneuburg provides accommodations with free WiFi and free private parking. The property is around 11 miles from Vienna Prater Amusement Park, 11 miles from Messe Wien Exhibition and Congress Center and 11 miles from Kunst Haus Wien. Guests can enjoy mountain views. At the hotel, every room is equipped with a closet. At OEKOTEL Korneuburg each room includes a desk and a flat-screen TV. The accommodation offers a buffet or vegetarian breakfast. Guests at OEKOTEL Korneuburg will be able to enjoy activities in and around Bisamberg, like cycling. St. Peter's Catholic Church is 11 miles from the hotel, while Vienna Volksgarten is 11 miles away. Vienna International Airport is 21 miles from the property.

1068031.description: Linnen is an Inn located in Prenzlauer Berg, Berlin’s trendy going-out district. It offers free WiFi, design interiors and self service honesty bar. Linnen is a typical 19th-century Berlin residential building, which has been fully renovated. It features bright rooms and apartments with traditional wooden furniture and parquet floors. The main building is situated within a 5-minute walk of Eberswalder Straße Underground Station and the Mauerpark (Wall Park), where a popular flea market takes place every Sunday. Other rooms and apartments are in the neighbouring Mitte district, near stylish shops and galleries. Berlin’s Alexanderplatz is within 10 minutes by public transport. From here, there are direct buses to Tegel Airport and direct trains to Schönefeld Airport. Please note that there is no 24-hour front desk service available.

1068070.description: Centrally located in IJmuiden, Hotel Velsen has free Wi-Fi. The A9 motorway and Ijmuiden’s beach are 10-minute drive away. Rooms at Velsen come with a cable TV and a private bathroom. Tea/Coffee making facilities are available in the shared area of the hotel. Guests can enjoy a drink at the bar or a meal at the restaurant. Several restaurants and cafés are located along the Kennermerlaan. Haarlem is a 20-minute drive away.

name.content: Old Rose And Crown Hotel Birmingham

1068082.description: Old Rose and Crown Hotel is within 400 acres of the beautiful Lickey Hills, 5 minutes' drive from the M5 and M42 motorways, 15 minutes from central Birmingham. Originally a 300-year-old coaching inn, the Old Rose and Crown is part of the North Worcestershire Walkway and has en suite rooms with views across Lickey Park. With free Wi-Fi and parking, the hotel is next an 18-hole golf course, all-weather tennis courts and a bowling green. Whilst there is no restaurant in the hotel, there are various local eateries just a short walk away, including a Cantonese restaurant, a fish and chip shop, and a pizza takeaway. There is a popular gastro pub just a few minutes' drive away. The Old Rose and Crown Hotel is few minutes’ walk from great train and bus links. It is close to Cadbury World and the Sea Life Centre.

1068135.description: This American-style motel is quietly located in the Müggelheim district of south-eastern Berlin, a 20-minute drive from Schönefeld Airport. The Down Town Motel offers free Wi-Fi and free private parking. Individually designed on American themes, the stylish rooms at the Down Town Motel feature a seating area and parquet floors. All rooms include a flat-screen TV with satellite channels as well as a private bathroom. A classic American diner is located next to the motel. Lake Müggelsee is a 20-minute walk away. The Müggelheim bus stop is just 328 feet away. The X69 express bus runs every 10 minutes to Köpenick, from where there are direct S-Bahn train connections into the heart of Berlin. Central Berlin can be reached in 30 minutes by car from Down Town Motel.

1068161.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Residencial Encontro in Vila Real offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, city views, showers, wardrobes, and TVs. Each room includes a wardrobe and a TV, ensuring a pleasant stay. Dining and Leisure: Guests can enjoy a restaurant and bar on-site. The hotel provides free WiFi, a lounge, 24-hour front desk, minimarket, daily housekeeping service, electric vehicle charging station, and a tour desk. Local Attractions: Natur Waterpark is 13 km away, Douro Museum 26 km, Our Lady of Remedies Sanctuary 37 km, Mateus Palace 4. 5 km, and Lamego Museum 36 km. Viseu Airport is 89 km from the property.

1068237.description: Apartahotel Baldiri in Sant Boi del Llobregat is set 1. 1 km from Sant Boi de Llobregat Museum and features air-conditioned accommodation with free WiFi. All units come with a seating area, a flat-screen TV and a fully equipped kitchen. An oven and microwave are also available, as well as a coffee machine. Can Torrents is 1. 2 km from the aparthotel, while Sant Boi City Hall is 1. 3 km from the property. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 9 km from Apartahotel Baldiri.

1068277.description: Set a few minutes' walk from Milan's Istria Metro Station, BB Hotels Residenza Bicocca offers a garden, air-conditioned apartments with free Wi-Fi. Rho Fiera Milano and Expo 2015 Exhibition Centers are reachable in 25 minutes by car. Accommodations features a flat-screen TV, a separate living/dining area with fully equipped kitchenette, and a bathroom with hairdryer. They have elegant, modern furnishings. With shuttle service to/from Milan's airports, Milano Centrale Train and Metro Station is a 15-minute walk from the property. Metro links from nearby Istria offer conncetions to Porta Garibaldi Train Station.

1068289.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Hotel - Restaurant Valley Rose in Vienna offers family rooms with private bathrooms, air-conditioning, and free WiFi. Each room includes a refrigerator, TV, and work desk. Dining and Leisure: Guests can enjoy a restaurant, bar, and terrace. The property provides a garden, outdoor seating area, and free on-site private parking. Additional amenities include a minimarket, coffee shop, and daily housekeeping service. Prime Location: Located 3. 7 km from Austria Center Vienna and 20 km from Vienna International Airport, the hotel is near attractions such as St. Stephen's Cathedral and Vienna Prater. Boating and cycling are available in the surroundings.

1068432.description: Located in Mondim de Basto, Hostel Carvalho features free bikes, shared lounge, terrace, and free WiFi throughout the property. The property provides a shared kitchen, a 24-hour front desk and luggage storage for guests. Guest rooms at the hostel are equipped with a seating area. Rooms are complete with a private bathroom equipped with a bidet and a hairdryer, while certain rooms at Hostel Carvalho also offer a balcony. Guimarães Castle is 30 miles from the accommodation, while Ducal Palace is 30 miles away. Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is 54 miles from the property.

1068435.description: Hotel Areias Claras – Elegance and Comfort by the Sea Discover the perfect balance between sophistication, comfort and tranquillity at Hotel Areias Claras. Located in one of the most charming coastal areas, the hotel offers an exclusive experience for those seeking relaxation with style and well-being. Our rooms have been carefully designed to ensure maximum comfort, featuring welcoming spaces and details that reflect elegance and refined taste. Some rooms offer privileged views, ideal for enjoying unique moments to the soothing sound of the sea. Hotel Areias Claras provides attentive and personalised service, along with a peaceful atmosphere that transforms every stay into a memorable experience. It is the ideal choice for couples, families or travellers who value quality, comfort and serenity. Whether for a romantic getaway, relaxing holidays or a special stay, Hotel Areias Claras is the perfect setting to create unforgettable memories.

1068451.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Corte del Fuin in Seregno offers aparthotel-style rooms with air-conditioning, balconies, and private bathrooms. Each unit includes a kitchenette, washing machine, and free WiFi. Leisure Facilities: Guests can enjoy a garden, free bicycles, and an outdoor dining area. Additional amenities include streaming services, a work desk, and a sofa bed. Convenient Location: Located 30 km from Milan Linate Airport, the aparthotel is near attractions such as Circolo Golf Villa d'Este (19 km) and Bosco Verticale (21 km). Highly rated for room cleanliness, convenient location, and comfort.

1068473.description: Welcome to Mariahilf – one of the most vibrant and charming districts of Vienna. Our location in the 6th district combines urban flair with a cozy atmosphere. Just a few steps to Mariahilfer Straße – and you are right in the middle: between cafés, boutiques, and authentic Viennese city life. With thoughtful amenities and excellent connections, Oliver urban is your perfect starting point – whether you are on a business trip or just want to enjoy a few days in Vienna.

1068527.description: Elegant Accommodation: Casa Vermelha in Vila Nova de Foz Coa offers a sun terrace, garden, and a year-round outdoor swimming pool. Guests enjoy free WiFi throughout the property. Comfortable Amenities: The inn features air-conditioning, private bathrooms with free toiletries, parquet floors, and wardrobes. Additional amenities include a lounge, minimarket, daily housekeeping service, and outdoor seating areas. Delightful Breakfast: A continental buffet breakfast is served daily, highly appreciated by guests for its quality and variety. Local Attractions: Longroiva Hot Springs are 16 km away, São João da Pesqueira Wine Museum 41 km, and Bragança Airport 113 km from the property. Cycling activities are available nearby.

1068533.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Boutique Hotel Sonne Seuzach in Winterthur offers family rooms with private bathrooms, air-conditioning, and modern amenities. Each room includes a tea and coffee maker, minibar, and free WiFi. Dining Experience: The modern, family-friendly restaurant serves international cuisine for lunch and dinner. Guests can enjoy a continental or buffet breakfast with juice, cheese, and fruits. Leisure Facilities: The hotel features a sun terrace, outdoor seating area, and bar. Additional amenities include a lift, minimarket, hairdresser, and luggage storage. Prime Location: Located 28 km from Zurich Exhibition Hall and 32 km from Zurich Airport, the hotel is near attractions such as Zoo Zurich and Kunsthaus Zurich. Guests appreciate the attentive staff and excellent room cleanliness.

1068535.description: Located in Uphall, 7. 7 miles from Hopetoun House, Oatridge hotel has accommodations with a garden, free private parking, a restaurant and a bar. This 2-star hotel offers free WiFi. The hotel has family rooms. All rooms in the hotel are equipped with an electric tea pot. The rooms have a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer. At Oatridge hotel rooms contain a closet and a flat-screen TV. Forth Bridge is 10 miles from the accommodation, while Edinburgh Zoo is 10 miles from the property. Edinburgh Airport is 5 miles away.

1068544.description: Located in Athens, 3. 5 miles from TEI Piraeus, Aegli Hotel provides accommodations with a shared lounge, free private parking, a terrace and a bar. With free WiFi, this 2-star hotel offers room service and a 24-hour front desk. Certain rooms at the property include a patio with a city view. At the hotel, each room has a closet. Complete with a private bathroom equipped with a shower and free toiletries, guest rooms at Aegli Hotel have a TV and air conditioning, and selected rooms come with a balcony. All rooms will provide guests with a fridge. Keramikos Metro Station is 4. 4 miles from the accommodation, while Gazi – Technopoli is 4. 5 miles away. Eleftherios Venizelos Airport is 25 miles from the property.

1068572.description: Prime City Centre Location: MINTNaschmarkt is situated in Vienna city centre, offering proximity to key attractions. Leopold Museum is a 7-minute walk away, while the Natural History Museum lies less than 1 km from the apartment. Vienna State Opera and Kunsthistorisches Museum are both within 1 km. Comfortable Amenities: The apartment features air-conditioning, a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, and a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher and coffee machine. Additional amenities include a terrace, balcony with city views, washing machine, and soundproofing. Convenient Facilities: Guests benefit from a lift and luggage storage, ensuring easy access and secure storage. The reception staff speak German and English, providing assistance as needed. Nearby Attractions: Vienna International Airport is 19 km away, while an ice-skating rink is located in the surroundings. Highly rated for its nearby shops and options for food and drinks, MINTNaschmarkt offers a convenient base for exploring Vienna.

1068617.description: Hi Guimaraes Pousada De Juventude does not offer 24-hour reception.

1068648.description: 19 miles from Roman Town of Augusta Raurica, Hotel Mokka Laufenburg is located in Laufenburg and has free WiFi, express check-in and check-out and a tour desk. The property is around 24 miles from Schaulager, 24 miles from Kunstmuseum Basel and 24 miles from Basel Cathedral. The hotel has family rooms. At the hotel, each room includes a closet. Rooms come with an electric tea pot and a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer, while some rooms include a kitchen equipped with a fridge. At Hotel Mokka Laufenburg every room has a desk and a flat-screen TV. The accommodation offers an à la carte or continental breakfast. Guests at Hotel Mokka Laufenburg will be able to enjoy activities in and around Laufenburg, like cycling. Pfalz Basel is 24 miles from the hotel, while Architectural Museum is 24 miles from the property.

name.content: Hi Parque Das Nav V Es Ai Pousada De Juventude

1068677.description: Located in Lisbon, the HI Lisboa Oriente - Pousada de Juventude is set in one of the trendiest districts of the city and is just a few metres from the Moscavide train station and within 2 km from the Lisbon Oceanarium and the Altice Arena. Featuring free WiFi throughout, this youth hostel offers double rooms, twins rooms and beds in male and female dormitories. Some rooms offer access to private bathrooms, the linens are provided for free. Each accommodation is equipped with heating, a wardrobe and a desk. Guests have at their disposal a self-service restaurant, a shared kitchen to prepare their own light meals and a shared lounge with a TV to socialize or relax. In addition, guests will find a multitude of restaurants in the vicinity. The Vasco da Gama shopping centre is a 15-minute walk and features a great variety of eateries and brand shops. Within a 1 km radius guests have access to a pharmacy, a health club, various schools, bars, cafés and even the scenic Passeio dos Heróis do Mar Garden and the iconic Vasco da Gama Tower with panoramic views over the Tejo River and the city of Lisbon. Lisbon International Airport is 3 km away.

1068689.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Hotel Rubus in Effretikon offers family rooms with private bathrooms, city or garden views, and modern amenities including free WiFi, hypoallergenic bedding, and soundproofing. Exceptional Facilities: Guests can relax on the terrace or outdoor seating area, enjoy free WiFi throughout the property, and take advantage of the minimarket, coffee shop, and express check-in and check-out services. Convenient Location: Located 20 km from Zurich Airport and near an ice-skating rink, the hotel is close to attractions such as Zurich Exhibition Hall (16 km) and Zoo Zurich (17 km). Guests appreciate the room cleanliness, convenient location, and attentive staff.

1068756.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. To-go breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a safe deposit box at the front desk and coffee/tea in a common area. Make yourself at home in one of the 20 individually decorated guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms with showers are provided. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. 1068808.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Prestige Flats Coteaux in Brussels offers aparthotel-style accommodations with private bathrooms. Each unit includes a kitchenette, TV, and kitchenware, ensuring a pleasant stay. Essential Facilities: Guests enjoy free WiFi in public areas, providing connectivity throughout their stay. The aparthotel also offers parking facilities for added convenience. Prime Location: Located 17 km from Brussels Airport, the aparthotel is close to attractions such as the Belgian Comics Strip Center (18-minute walk), Berlaymont (1. 8 km), and Grand Place (3. 3 km). An ice-skating rink is also nearby. Guest Favorites: Visitors appreciate the well-equipped kitchen, comfortable rooms, and excellent value for money.

1068815.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Hotel Fi'Lin in Machelen offers spacious rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and city views. Guests appreciate the room size, cleanliness, and comfort. Exceptional Facilities: The hotel features a sun terrace, garden, bar, and free WiFi. Additional amenities include a lounge, outdoor seating area, picnic area, and electric vehicle charging station. Delicious Breakfast: A continental buffet breakfast is served with vegetarian and vegan options. Fresh pastries, cheese, fruits, and juice are available each morning. Prime Location: Located 5 km from Brussels Airport, the hotel is near attractions such as Tour & Taxis (10 km) and Place Sainte-Catherine (12 km). Highly rated for its excellent service.

1068974.description: Comfortable Accommodations: URBANAUTS STUDIOS Fillgrader in Vienna offers aparthotel-style accommodations with free WiFi, air-conditioning, and private bathrooms. Each unit includes a tea and coffee maker, hairdryer, and city views. Modern Amenities: Guests enjoy a fully equipped kitchen with a coffee machine, microwave, and stovetop. Additional amenities include a dining table, work desk, and seating area. Free toiletries and a TV enhance the stay. Prime Location: Located 19 km from Vienna International Airport, the aparthotel is a short walk from Leopold Museum (7 minutes) and Kunsthistorisches Museum (less than 1 km). Nearby attractions include Vienna State Opera and Albertina Museum. Guest Favorites: Guests appreciate the convenient location, quietness of the area, and comfortable beds. An ice-skating rink is also nearby.

1068986.description: Providing quiet street views, Elefsinian Mysteries Apartments in Eleusis offers accommodations and a garden. The property is around a 11-minute walk from Archaeological Site of Elefsina, 12 miles from TEI Piraeus, and 13 miles from Piraeus Train Station. The accommodation provides full-day security and luggage storage for guests. All units feature air conditioning and a flat-screen TV. All rooms are equipped with a coffee machine, a private bathroom, and free Wifi, while selected rooms come with a balcony and some have garden views. At the condo hotel, all units are equipped with bed linen and towels. A car rental service is available at the condo hotel. Keramikos Metro Station is 13 miles from Elefsinian Mysteries Apartments, while Gazi – Technopoli is 13 miles away. Eleftherios Venizelos Airport is 34 miles from the property.

name.content: Pachamaya Holistic Wellness & Spa - Adults Only

1069035.description: Situated in Cancún, 500 metres from Cancun Bus Station, Pachamaya Holistic Wellness & Spa - Adults Only features accommodation with an outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a garden and a terrace. Featuring a restaurant, the 4-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. The property is 400 metres from Cancun Government Palace, and within 2. 6 km of the city centre. At the hotel, rooms are equipped with a desk. All rooms have a wardrobe. Pachamaya Holistic Wellness & Spa - Adults Only offers an à la carte or American breakfast. Guests at the accommodation will be able to enjoy activities in and around Cancún, like cycling. Popular points of interest near Pachamaya Holistic Wellness & Spa - Adults Only include Cristo Rey Church, Parque las Palapas and Cancun Bullfight ring. Cancún International Airport is 18 km from the property, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

1069046.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy a satisfying meal at Casa Pince Restaurante serving guests of Casa Pince. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. A shuttle from the hotel to the airport is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 33 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and espresso makers. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. The preferred airport for Casa Pince is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 16. 9 km / 10. 5 mi With a stay at Casa Pince, you'll be centrally located in Barcelona, steps from La Rambla and 12 minutes by foot from Plaça de Catalunya. This hotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 4 km) from Barcelona Cathedral and 2. 7 mi (4. 3 km) from Sagrada Familia.

1069066.description: Located in Vilarinho de Cotas and with Natur Waterpark reachable within 13 miles, Casa Dona Edite Guesthouse Douro provides a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, non-smoking rooms, free WiFi throughout the property and a shared lounge. The property is around 19 miles from Douro Museum, 26 miles from Our Lady of Remedies Sanctuary and 16 miles from São João da Pesqueira Wine Museum. The property has airport transportation, while a bicycle rental service is also available. At the hotel, all rooms are equipped with a desk. Complete with a private bathroom equipped with a shower and free toiletries, all guest rooms at Casa Dona Edite Guesthouse Douro have a flat-screen TV and air conditioning, and some rooms come with a balcony. Guest rooms feature a closet. The accommodation offers a buffet or continental breakfast. You can play table tennis at Casa Dona Edite Guesthouse Douro, and the area is popular for hiking.

1069153.description: Make yourself at home in one of the 22 guestrooms, featuring kitchens with stovetops and microwaves. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Omonoia Square - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Athens City Hall - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Academy of Athens - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Athens Central Market - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Syntagma Square - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- National Theatre of Greece - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Ermou Street - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Monastiraki Square - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Athens Gallery - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Metropolitan Cathedral of Athens - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Monastiraki Flea Market - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Adrianou Street - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Hellenic Parliament - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Roman Agora - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Athens National Garden - 1 km / 0. 6 mi. The nearest major airport is Athens Intl. Airport (ATH) - 35. 1 km / 21. 8 mi A stay at DOMIOS Suites Athens places you in the heart of Athens, within a 10-minute walk of Syntagma Square and Ermou Street. This aparthotel is 0. 6 mi (0. 9 km) from Monastiraki Flea Market and 1. 7 mi (2. 8 km) from Acropolis.

1069221.description: The establishment features a total of 50 rooms. Located in Berlin and within 1. 9 km of Berliner Philharmonie, Coffee Inn Hostel Berlin features a shared lounge, non-smoking rooms, and free WiFi throughout the property. The property is around 2. 9 km from Zoologischer Garten underground station, 3. 4 km from Kurfürstendamm and 3. 5 km from Topography of Terror. Guests can have a drink at the snack bar. At the hostel, each room has a wardrobe. At Coffee Inn Hostel Berlin every room comes with bed linen and towels. Languages spoken at the reception include Arabic, German, English and Russian. Checkpoint Charlie is 3. 6 km from the accommodation, while Potsdamer Platz is 3. 6 km away. Berlin Brandenburg Willy Brandt Airport is 21 km from the property. Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9. 6 for a two-person trip.

1069280.description: Featuring a large spa and wellness center with indoor and outdoor pools and different hot tubs (spa, pools etc. not accessible with bathing suits), Hotel Thermen Dilbeek offers modern and spacious rooms with free Wi-Fi. Its restaurant opens onto a terrace. Massages and beauty treatments are available at the spa. After a refreshing work out, guests can relax in the sauna. Please note that swimwear is not allowed in the spa area. The air-conditioned rooms at Thermen Dilbeek come with a satellite TV and a fireplace. A coffee machine and a mini-bar are in each. The marble bathroom has free toiletries, a glass-walled shower or a bath tub. A buffet-style breakfast is served daily. Guests can also watch sports games in the bar or enjoy a drink on the terrace. Hotel Thermen Dilbeek is just a 5-minute drive from Brussel’s ring road. Brussels International Airport is just 9. 3 mi away.

1069306.description: Located in Cairo, 1. 2 miles from Great Sphinx, BrassAlmas Pyramids Hotel provides accommodations with a terrace, free private parking, a restaurant and a bar. This 4-star hotel offers an ATM and a concierge service. The property has a 24-hour front desk, airport transportation, room service and free WiFi throughout the property. The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms with a closet, a coffee machine, a minibar, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower. All rooms are equipped with an electric tea pot, while some rooms come with a balcony and others also have city views. The breakfast offers continental, vegetarian or vegan options. At BrassAlmas Pyramids Hotel guests are welcome to use a hot tub. Giza Pyramids is 1. 9 miles from the accommodation, while The Grand Egyptian Museum is 4. 1 miles away. Sphinx International Airport is 21 miles from the property.

1069378.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Hotel Babenbergerhof in Mödling offers air-conditioned rooms with private bathrooms, city views, and modern amenities. Each room includes a work desk, minibar, and free WiFi. Exceptional Facilities: Guests can relax in the sauna, sun terrace, or garden. The hotel features a restaurant serving Austrian and international cuisines in a traditional and modern ambience. Additional facilities include a bar, lounge, and electric vehicle charging station. Delicious Breakfast: A variety of breakfast options are available, including continental, buffet, Italian, vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free. Fresh pastries, cheese, fruits, and juice enhance the morning experience. Prime Location: Located 11 km from Spa Garden, Casino Baden, and Roman Baths, the hotel is also close to Schönbrunner Gardens and Schönbrunn Palace. Vienna International Airport is 25 km away. An ice-skating rink is nearby. Highly rated for its breakfast, convenient location, and attentive staff.

1069488.description: In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. Travellers arriving by car may leave their vehicle at the accommodation's parking spaces. At this hotel, there are plenty of health and wellness services which guests can take advantage of. Clients may enjoy tasty meals served at the establishment's dining venue. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

1069615.description: Offering free WiFi and free parking, Residence il Cascinetto features air-conditioned apartments with a fully equipped kitchenette and a balcony. It is located in Pavia. Accommodation comes with a living area with a sofa bed and a flat-screen TV and a kitchenette, complete with an oven and a dishwasher. The private bathroom includes a hairdryer and free toiletries. Restaurants are within walking distance, while the city centre is 2. 8 km away. Certosa di Pavia Monastry is a 15-minute drive from il Cascinetto.

1069638.description: Renovated in 2011, this Art Nouveau building in Vienna’s Favoriten district offers free WiFi. The centre of Vienna can be reached by public transport in 20 minutes. The bright rooms at Arnes Hotel Vienna all feature cable TV, a minibar, and a seating area. All rooms are non-smoking. The Quellenstraße Tram Stop (line 6) is right outside and provides connections to the Reumannplatz Underground Station (line U1). This station can also be reached in a 7-minute walk and takes guests to the city centre in about 15 minutes. Further attractions are the Oberlaa Spa Thermal Baths and the Viennese Woods, both of which can be reached with tram number 67. As of September, public parking is possible at a surcharge in the surroundings and the tickets can be bought at the kiosks. During the night parking is possible free of charge.

1069731.description: You will find Hotel Old Dutch / Restaurant Le Pompadour in front of the world Famous Volendam harbor. At Old Dutch, traditional hospitality and comfort come together with a first-class view of the former Zuyderzee. With its 33 spacious, well-furnished rooms (for 1-, 2- or 3 people) our hotel can accommodate various groups of holidaymakers. Small-scaled personal service will guarantee a pleasant stay. Restaurant Le Pompadour is a restaurant in Volendam with an international cuisine. We serve delicious fish and meat dishes. Of course we also have characteristic Volendam dishes on the menu. Bus stop Volendam center is a 4-minute walk away and can bring you to Edam in 10-minutes, Monnickendam in 12-minutes and Amsterdam Central Station in 25 minutes.

1069787.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, a steam room, and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and a banquet hall. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk and an elevator. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 176 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring kitchenettes with refrigerators and microwaves. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and 32-inch Smart televisions are provided for your entertainment. Conveniences include safes and blackout drapes/curtains. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Higienopolis Shopping Mall - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Hospital Central da Santa Casa de Misericórdia de São Paulo - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Shopping Pátio Higienópolis - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Republic Square - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Sala São Paulo Concert Hall - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Rua Jose Paulino - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Espaço Unimed - 2 km / 1. 2 mi- Copan Building - 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Football Museum - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Expo Barra Funda - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Pacaembu Stadium - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Municipal Theatre of São Paulo - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- West Plaza - 2. 5 km / 1. 5 mi- Rua Augusta - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- Frei Caneca Shopping and Convention Center - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi. The nearest airports are: São Paulo (CGH-Congonhas) - 12. 6 km / 7. 8 mi São Paulo/Guarulhos Intl.
