A stay at The Standard Residence Higienopolis places you in the heart of São Paulo, within a 5-minute drive of Higienopolis Shopping Mall and Shopping Pátio Higienópolis. This hotel is 1. 9 mi (3. 1 km) from Paulista Avenue and 2. 4 mi (3. 9 km) from Nubank Parque.

1069802.description: Located in Vienna’s district of Donaustadt, motel22 I parking inclusive I 33 C or More - Breakfast Is on Us! offers modern and bright rooms and apartments and 24-hour check-in via the Hotelmoat terminal. Free WiFi and free private parking on site are available. Each room and apartment features flat-screen satellite TV and a bathroom with a comfort shower, toilet, and hairdryer. The apartments additionally come with a fully equipped kitchen or kitchenette. A vending machine with snacks and drinks is available and a bakery is opposite the motel22 I parking inclusive I 33 C or More - Breakfast Is on Us!. Several restaurants and Heurige, typical Viennese wine taverns, can be found within a 1 to 2-minute walk. The Vienna International Centre, the ACV Austria Center Vienna, and the Reed Messe Wien are within a 15-minute drive. Bus lines 24A and 97A stop right outside and connect to the U1 underground line.

1069927.description: Located in Esposende and within 19 miles of Shipyards of Viana do Castelo, InnEsposende Sports Hostel features a shared lounge, non-smoking rooms, and free WiFi. The property is around 24 miles from Braga Se Cathedral, 26 miles from University of Minho - Braga Campus and 31 miles from Music House. The property provides a shared kitchen, and luggage storage for guests. At the hostel, every room includes a closet. Guests at InnEsposende Sports Hostel will be able to enjoy activities in and around Esposende, like hiking, fishing and cycling. Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is 24 miles away.

1069934.description: Located in Ribeirão and within 19 miles of Estadio do Dragao, Colina do Ave Alojamento Local has a restaurant, non-smoking rooms, and free WiFi. The property is around 19 miles from FC Porto Museum, 20 miles from Campanha Train Station and 20 miles from Sao Bento Metro Station. Some rooms at the property have a patio with a river view. The rooms include air conditioning, a closet and a flat-screen TV, and some accommodations at the inn have a balcony. Guests at Colina do Ave Alojamento Local will be able to enjoy activities in and around Ribeirão, like hiking, fishing and cycling. Sao Bento Train Station is 20 miles from the accommodation, while Oporto Coliseum is 21 miles from the property. Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is 12 miles away.

1069945.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Gas Löwen in Mönchaltorf offers family rooms with private bathrooms, free toiletries, and modern amenities. Each room includes a wardrobe, TV, and work desk, ensuring a pleasant stay. Dining Experience: The traditional restaurant serves local cuisine with vegetarian options. Guests can enjoy lunch, dinner, high tea, and cocktails in a cosy ambience. The terrace and outdoor seating area provide scenic views. Convenient Facilities: Free WiFi, a bar, and a coffee shop are available. Additional services include a minimarket, hairdresser, bicycle parking, tour desk, and luggage storage. Free on-site private parking and a paid shuttle service enhance the stay. Local Attractions: Zoo Zurich is 17 km away, Zurich Opera House and Kunsthaus Zurich 19 km, and ETH Zurich 19 km. Scuba diving is available in the surrounding area. Zurich Airport is 26 km from the inn.

1069988.description: Prime City Centre Location: Bespoke House Athens is situated in Athens city centre, offering easy access to key attractions. The National Theatre of Greece is less than 1 km away, while the National Archaeological Museum is an 18-minute walk. Eleftherios Venizelos Airport is 30 km from the aparthotel. Exceptional Facilities: Guests enjoy a seasonal outdoor swimming pool and free WiFi. Additional amenities include a terrace, rooftop pool, balcony, and private check-in and check-out services. The property features a lift, daily housekeeping, electric vehicle charging, and paid on-site parking. Comfortable Accommodations: Rooms are equipped with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and modern amenities such as streaming services, minibars, and work desks. Family rooms and ground-floor units cater to various needs, ensuring a pleasant stay. Highly Rated Experience: Guests appreciate the attentive host, convenient location, and impeccable room cleanliness, making Bespoke House Athens a highly rated choice.

1070215.address: Gran Vv A De Les Cortes Catalanes 716
1070215.description: Des Artistes is located on Barcelona’s Gran Vía Avenue, next to Tetuán Square. It offers a reading room and a shared terrace. Rooms come with heating and a fan is available in summer. All have a shared bathroom and some have a balcony. All rooms have air conditioning. Des Artistes is just 5 minutes’ walk from Estació del Nord Bus Station and Arc de Triomf. You can also walk to Ciutadella Park and Gaudí’s famous Sagrada Família in under 15 minutes. Located 820 feet away, Tetuán Metro Station is just 1 stop away from the central Passeig de Gràcia Station. Trains to Barcelona Airport leave from Passeig de Gràcia Train Station.

1070218.description: Located in Rascafría and with Peñalara Nature Reserve reachable within 28 miles, Posada el Campanario provides concierge services, non-smoking rooms, a garden, free WiFi throughout the property and a shared lounge. Featuring room service, this property also provides guests with a terrace. The property has airport transportation, while a bicycle rental service is also available. At the hotel, every room includes a desk and a flat-screen TV. With a private bathroom equipped with a bidet and free toiletries, some units at Posada el Campanario also provide guests with a city view. All guest rooms feature a closet. A continental breakfast is available at the accommodation. You can play table tennis at Posada el Campanario, and the area is popular for hiking and skiing. Monasterio de Santa Maria de El Paular is 7. 3 miles from the hotel, while Royal Palace of La Granja de San Ildefonso is 25 miles away. Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport is 52 miles from the property.

1070236.description: Mambo Tango is a backpackers’ hostel located in Barcelona’s Poble Sec district, just 328 feet from Parallel Metro Station. It offers free daily activities and free Wi-Fi access. Mambo Tango Hostel offers colorful dormitories and private rooms, all with air conditioning, heating and individual lockers. You can prepare meals in the Mambo Tango’s shared kitchen, or enjoy a film in the TV lounge. The hotel’s free activities include photo exhibitions, music classes and city walks. Staff can provide information on Barcelona’s many attractions, as well as help with ticket reservations and discounts. The property also organizes daily guided walking tours and night tours to bars and nightclubs. The famous Gaudí houses are within 15 minutes’ walk of the hostel. Located at the foot of Montjuïc Hill, the hostel is an ideal base for visiting Montjuïc Castle and the Magic Fountains. The lively Raval district is just a 5-minute walk away.

1070238.description: Located in Vallromanes, 14 miles from Sagrada Familia, Masia Vista Hermosa has accommodations with a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a garden and a terrace. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, room service and a tour desk, along with free WiFi throughout the property. Guests can have a drink at the bar. Rooms are equipped with a private bathroom with a shower, while some rooms have a balcony and others also feature mountain views. Guests at the hotel will be able to enjoy activities in and around Vallromanes, like cycling. Port Olimpic is 15 miles from Masia Vista Hermosa, while Casa Batllo is 15 miles from the property. Barcelona-El Prat Airport is 22 miles away.

1070239.description: Just minutes from Madrid Airport, and close to the IFEMA convention center site, Hotel Los 5 Pinos offers rooms with hardwood floors and air conditioning. There is free Wi-Fi. The large rooms all have air conditioning, minibar, flat-screen TV, safe and telephone. Children under 11 stay for free when using existing beds. The restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner. There is also a bar-cafe where you can get drinks and snacks. The Hotel Los 5 Pinos is on the A-2 highway, offering easy road access to the middle of Madrid. It is also about one mile from the Juan Carlos I Park. Private parking is available upon request.

1070256.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Paredes Design Hotel in Paredes offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and free WiFi. Each room includes a work desk, TV, and wardrobe, ensuring a pleasant stay. Dining and Leisure: Guests can enjoy Portuguese cuisine at the on-site restaurant and unwind at the bar. The hotel features a sun terrace and a garden, providing relaxing outdoor spaces. Convenient Location: Located 29 km from Estadio do Dragao and FC Porto Museum, the hotel is also close to Ribeira Square and Clerigos Tower. Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is 32 km away. Guests appreciate the attentive staff and excellent service.

1070258.description: In the heart of Vila do Conde, a former village of fishermen, Hotel Brazão offers elegant rooms. Only 900 metres from the beach, it features free Wi-Fi. The air-conditioned rooms and suites of Hotel Brazão are equipped with a satellite TV, a mini bar, and a work desk. Each room has a private bathroom with a hairdryer. The hotel’s restaurant serves a breakfast buffet. The hotel also has a bar serving refreshing drinks and a tea parlor. Mini golf, tennis courts and swimming pools can be found around the hotel. Hotel Brazão is 1. 2 km from a Metro station, while Porto is 24 km away. Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is 13 km away, and the hotel offers free private parking on site. Hotel Brazão is inserted in the Santiago de Compostela pilgrim route.

1070267.description: Facing Carlos Alberto Square, this hotel occupies a prime location in the historic centre of Porto. Only 450 metres from Sao Bento Train Station, it offers a bar and a terrace. Large windows ensure an airy feel in all S. Marino’s rooms. Each is equipped with a private bathroom and a work desk. Some feature views of the square. WiFi is available in all areas and is free of charge. Continental breakfast includes freshly baked bread rolls. Guests at Hotel S. Marino can enjoy a drink at the hotel’s bar or out in the small garden. There is also a common living room with a TV. Tours and rental cars can be arranged with the help of S. Marino’s staff, available 24 hours a day. The hotel is located 1 km from the Ribeira and the famous port cellars.

1070282.description: The friendly hotel in the old town of Rapperswil with 20 rooms and a restaurant in a cozy atmosphere. Cordial, familiar and casual. Fresh, honest and from the heart - that is the motto of the JAKOB restaurant. We cook with selected ingredients and attach great importance to careful preparation. Enjoy a carefree time with us at the Hauptplatz, in the heart of the old town of Rapperswil.

1070290.description: Located in Amadora, within 3. 9 miles of Luz Football Stadium and 5. 4 miles of Jeronimos Monastery, Hotel Nova Cidade provides accommodations with a bar. With a shared lounge, the 1-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. Commerce Square is 8. 2 miles from the hotel and St. George's Castle is 8. 7 miles away. At the hotel, every room is equipped with a closet. All rooms come with a flat-screen TV, and some units at Hotel Nova Cidade have a city view. Staff speak English, Spanish, French and Portuguese at the 24-hour front desk. Dona Maria II National Theater is 7. 8 miles from the accommodation, while Rossio Square is 7. 9 miles away. Humberto Delgado Airport is 5. 6 miles from the property.

1070292.description: Stay in the charming little village of Tombeek and absorb the peaceful atmosphere in the family-run Hotel Avalon. Savour the friendly ambience of this small-scale hotel and its comfortable interior. Enjoy the picturesque surroundings and go for a long walk through one of the beautiful forests in the vicinity. Of course, the area is also great for other outdoor activities, such as mountain biking. Visit the 16th century Castle Bisdom with its 12th century towers in the centre of Tombeek. Venture out for a day trip to other Belgian cities, such as Wavre, Leuven or Brussels. Weather permitting, you can sit out on the lovely terrace and relax with your favourite drink. Right next to Wavre zoning nord. Parking easily fits multiple big trucks. Distance to Walibi Belgium is 7, 7km. Distance to Brussels south station is 22, 6 km. Distance to Waterloo (lions mound) is 16, 4 km.

1070296.address: Largo Senhora A Branca 92 94 S Victor Braga
1070296.description: Hotel Residencial Dora is a 7-minute walk from Braga’s famed Cathedral. This property is located in the historical centre of Braga in the Senhora A. Branca Square. The unit provides accommodation in air-conditioned double or twin rooms. All feature a cable TV and a private bathroom with free toiletries. The hotel has a bakery where guests may enjoy light meals. A daily breakfast buffet is served. Alternatively, the nearby city centre has various local restaurants available. The Minho University Campus is a 5-minute drive away from the hotel. Historical Guimarães was the 2012 European capital of Culture and is a 21-minute drive away. Porto International Airport is a 35-minute drive from Hotel Residencial Dora.

1070303.description: Located in Vale de Cambra, within 16 miles of Santa Maria da Feira Castle and 19 miles of Europarque, Hotel Solar das Laranjeiras has accommodations with a garden as well as free private parking for guests who drive. Featuring a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, the 2-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. Certain rooms at the property have a balcony with a garden view. At the hotel, rooms come with a closet. Rooms include a desk and a flat-screen TV, and certain accommodations at Hotel Solar das Laranjeiras have a terrace. Guests at the accommodation can enjoy a buffet or a continental breakfast. You can play table tennis at Hotel Solar das Laranjeiras. Douro River is 29 miles from the hotel, while Aveiro Municipal Stadium is 30 miles from the property. Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport is 40 miles away.

1070304.description: Mini Hostel in Lisbon features a Middle East-inspired décor and is just 656 feet from a Metro station, connecting to the city center, which is 1. 9 mi away. The historical downtown is 3. 2 mi from the unit. With heating, the elevator-accessible hostel features accommodations in dormitories and private double rooms. All include a wardrobe and access to shared bathroom facilities. Guests are welcome to cook their own meals in the communal kitchen, enjoying them in the outdoor dining area. Local restaurants are available within a 5-minute drive. The property features a shared outdoor lounge area with a gazebo, where guests may relax in the sofas and quietly read a book and drink some tea. Iconic São Jorge Castle is 2. 6 mi from the property. Historical Chiado is at a 3. 2 mi distance and has various characteristic cafés and shops, as does Rossio at a 3 mi distance. Lisbon International Airport is 2. 7 mi from the Mini Hostel.

1070320.description: HI Generation Europe Hostel is located in Brussels within a 20-minute walk from the central Grand Place and Manneken Pis. Guests can benefit from free Wi-Fi access, a buffet restaurant and a bar, a garden terrace and free evening entertainment. Rooms here will provide you with a hardwood floors and soundproofing. Featuring a shower, the shared bathrooms also come with a toilet and a sink. At HI Generation Europe Hostel you will find a 24-hour front desk. Guests can enjoy a daily bio breakfast to start their day. Other facilities offered include laundry facilities, a shared kitchen and lounge. An array of activities can be enjoyed on site or in the surroundings, including darts. The hostel is 1. 1 mi from the Grand Place, 1. 2 mi from Brussels-South Train Station, which includes Eurostar and Thalys terminals. HI Generation Europe Hostel is 16 mi from Brussels Airport. The property offers free parking.

1070345.description: Au Boeuf Rouge features a garden, terrace, a restaurant and bar in Crassier. This 3-star inn offers free WiFi. The property is non-smoking throughout and is located 11 miles from PalExpo. The inn has a playground. United Nations Geneva is 12 miles from Au Boeuf Rouge, while Cornavin Train Station is 12 miles away. Geneva International Airport is 11 miles from the property.

name.content: Hv Tel Restaurant La Croix Verte Vich

1070346.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Hôtel Restaurant La Croix Verte Vich in Vich offers family rooms with private bathrooms, mountain views, and modern amenities. Each room includes a work desk, TV, and free toiletries. Dining and Leisure: The hotel features a terrace, restaurant, and bar. Guests can enjoy French cuisine for lunch and dinner. Free WiFi is available throughout the property. Convenient Location: Situated 27 km from Geneva International Airport, the hotel is close to PalExpo and United Nations Geneva. An ice-skating rink is nearby. Highly rated by guests.

1070360.description: Historic Charm: Landgasthof Ochsen in Wölflinswil offers a unique stay within a historic building. Guests enjoy a garden, terrace, and free WiFi throughout the property. Comfortable Accommodations: Rooms feature private bathrooms, balconies with garden views, and parquet floors. Additional amenities include work desks, TVs, and free toiletries. Dining Experience: The restaurant serves European cuisine with vegetarian, gluten-free, and dairy-free options. Breakfast includes a buffet with juice, cheese, and fruits. Leisure Activities: Guests can enjoy hiking and cycling nearby. The property offers free bicycles, an outdoor play area, and a children's playground. Nearby Attractions: Located 35 km from Roman Town of Augusta Raurica and 44 km from Kunstmuseum Basel.

1070362.description: Enjoy a satisfying meal at Restaurant Kutchi serving guests of Hotel Restaurant Kutchi. Wrap up your day with a drink at the beach bar. Make yourself at home in one of the 6 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided on request. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Bioparc Genève - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Favarger Chocolate Factory - 2. 8 km / 1. 7 mi- Botanical Gardens - 3. 3 km / 2. 1 mi- Chateau de Penthes - 3. 4 km / 2. 1 mi- Geneva School of Diplomacy - 3. 4 km / 2. 1 mi- United Nations European Headquarters - 3. 5 km / 2. 2 mi- World Trade Organization Headquarters - 3. 9 km / 2. 4 mi- La Perle-du-Lac Park - 3. 9 km / 2. 4 mi- International Museum of the Red Cross and Red Crescent - 4 km / 2. 5 mi- International Red Cross and Red Crescent Museum - 4. 1 km / 2. 5 mi- Ariana Ceramics and Glass Museum - 4. 1 km / 2. 6 mi- Ferney-Voltaire Market - 4. 5 km / 2. 8 mi- Centre International de Conferences Geneve - 4. 8 km / 3 mi- Geneva Arena - 4. 6 km / 2. 8 mi- Palexpo - 5 km / 3. 1 mi. The nearest major airport is Geneva International Airport (GVA) - 4. 9 km / 3. 1 mi When you stay at Hotel Restaurant Kutchi in Bellevue, you'll be near the airport, within a 10-minute drive of United Nations European Headquarters and CERN. This hotel is 14. 6 mi (23. 5 km) from Haut-Jura Regional Nature Park and 1. 2 mi (2 km) from Bioparc Genève.

1070365.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Hotel - Restaurant Eierhals am Ägerisee in Oberägeri offers family rooms with private bathrooms, balconies, and garden or lake views. Each room includes a TV, sofa, and wardrobe. Dining Experience: The family-friendly restaurant serves seafood, local, and European cuisines. Guests can enjoy lunch and dinner in a traditional ambience. Breakfast includes continental and buffet options with juice, cheese, and fruits. Leisure Facilities: The hotel features a private beach area, sun terrace, and garden. Additional amenities include a steam room, hammam, outdoor play area, and children's playground. Free WiFi is available throughout the property. Location and Attractions: Located 54 km from Zurich Airport, the hotel is near attractions such as Einsiedeln Abbey (20 km) and Uetliberg Mountain (41 km). Guests can enjoy activities like skiing, hiking, and cycling.

1070370.description: Situated at the gate of the historic centre of Brugg, Hotel Rotes Haus offers rooms with free Wi-Fi. The main railway station is a 4-minute walk away. The on-site restaurant serves Italian and Swiss cuisine. All rooms come with cable TV and a bathroom with a hairdryer, toiletries and a shower or a tub. You can enjoy a daily served breakfast at Hotel Rotes Haus. In summer you can dine on the terrace. Drinks are served at the bar and the hotel features an elevator. A cinema and shops can be found nearby. The Aquarena Thermal Bath is a 5-minute drive away.

1070382.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Glärnisch Hof in Horgen offers rooms with private bathrooms, balconies, and lake views. Each room includes a work desk, TV, and free toiletries. Exceptional Facilities: Guests can relax on the sun terrace or in the garden. The hotel provides free WiFi in public areas, a restaurant, and a bar. Additional amenities include a hairdryer, wardrobe, and free on-site private parking. Convenient Location: Located 31 km from Zurich Airport, the hotel is near attractions such as Uetliberg Mountain (18 km) and Zurich Opera House (20 km). Activities available include fishing, hiking, cycling, and scuba diving. Guest Satisfaction: Guests appreciate the room cleanliness, breakfast provided by the property, and the attentive staff and service support.

1070389.description: Located in Sihlbrugg Dorf, 14 miles from Einsiedeln Abbey, Hotel Krone Sihlbrugg provides accommodations with a garden, free private parking, a terrace and a restaurant. The property is around 15 miles from Uetliberg, 15 miles from Museum Rietberg and 16 miles from Fraumünster. Providing free WiFi throughout the property, the allergy-free inn features a hot tub and nightclub. At the inn, rooms come with a desk. All rooms are equipped with a coffee machine and a private bathroom, while some rooms come with a balcony and some have river views. All guest rooms in Hotel Krone Sihlbrugg are equipped with a flat-screen TV and free toiletries. The area is popular for cycling, and car rental is available at the accommodation. Grossmünster is 16 miles from Hotel Krone Sihlbrugg, while Bellevueplatz is 16 miles away. Zurich Airport is 23 miles from the property.

1070399.description: Hotel located on a small private airport on the outskirts of Prangins, Relais de l'Aérodrome is situated just 500 metres from Golf Club du Domaine Impérial and a 2-minute drive from Lake Geneva. All rooms come with a private terrace. Rooms at Relais de l'Aérodrome have modern furnishings and come with a private bathroom, desk, TV and aeroplane-themed art and WiFi is available free of charge. Relais de l'Aérodrome’s modern restaurant serves traditional Italian cuisine with homemade pasta, grilled fish and meat as well as pizza. Barbecue facilities are available for cooking during summer. Food and drink can be enjoyed in the dining area or on the garden’s large terrace, which enjoys views of the Jura Mountains and the airport. Free private parking is available directly outside the hotel. A bus stops 1. 4 km away in Prangins town centre and continues on to Gland, 2 km away. Nyon is a 5-minute drive away, and Geneva and Lausanne can be reached by car in 30 minutes. A shuttle service to Geneva Airport can be arranged on request and for a surcharge.

1070471.description: Located right on the banks of the Danube River, Hotel Nibelungenhof is a 3-minute walk from the centre of Tulln and only steps away from the Egon Schiele Museum. All rooms have a bathroom and a flat-screen satellite TV. Some rooms offer views of the Danube. Free Wi-Fi is available in the Nibelungenhof’s public areas. The Messe Tulln fairgrounds are a 15-minute walk away, and the shipping pier is 2 minutes away. Vienna is 30 km from Tulln and can be reached in a 30-minute train ride. The Danube Bike Trail leads right past the Nibelungenhof. A multi-storey car park is just a few steps away.

1070482.description: This modern Asian-style hotel is just a 2-minute walk from Mödling Train Station. It offers an Asian restaurant and free Wi-Fi. All rooms have a balcony and a flat-screen sat TV. The Phoenix7’s colorfully decorated rooms feature wooden floors, an electric kettle, and a bathroom with bathrobes, slippers and hairdryer. In the restaurant, guests can enjoy Chinese and Japanese dishes à la carte or from the buffet. There is also a large outdoor dining area and a bar. Free garage parking is available at the Hotel Phoenix7. The Mödling exit of the A2 motorway is just 5 minutes away.

1070513.description: This 3-star hotel in the centre of Leobersdorf offers 24-hours self check in kiosk, free WiFi and free private parking. The 21 modern rooms at Hotel Leobersdorfer Hof feature a flat-screen cable TV and en-suite bathrooms. There are restaurants, Heurige (traditional Austrian wine taverns), and bars in short walking distance. Leobersdorf Train Station is a 20-minute walk away and provides direct connections to Baden, Baden is 15 km away. The A2 motorway can be reached within a 2-minute drive. Several bike routes are only a short distance from the hotel and bikes may be stored in a separate room at the hotel. The Wellness Oase Leobersdorf offers sauna and steam bath and a public pool in the hot summer months. The small shopping mall is only a few minutes walking distance from the hotel. The Event Center Leobersdorf may be reached within a short walk and Vienna Airport is 40 km away.

1070646.description: Budget rooms Doppenberg is located in Zandvoort, a 4-minute walk from Zandvoort Beach and 11 miles from Keukenhof. This 2-star hotel offers luggage storage space and free WiFi. Anne Frank House is 18 miles from the hotel and Vondelpark is 19 miles away. Guest rooms at the hotel come with a seating area and a TV. The private bathroom is equipped with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. All rooms will provide guests with a closet and a coffee machine. Van Gogh Museum is 19 miles from budget rooms Doppenberg, while Moco Museum is 19 miles from the property. Schiphol Airport is 11 miles away.

1070647.description: Bosch Duin offers bright studios just 1 km from Den Helder’s coast. Free Wi-fi and newspapers are available to all guests. Bosch Duin is a 10-minute drive from the centre of Den Helder. Studios at Bosch Duin Strand have a flat-screen TV and a seating area with Chesterfield chairs. Some open on to a private furnished terrace. Every morning guest can enjoy a freshly prepared breakfast, which is delivered to their room. Meals can be prepared in the kitchen, which is fitted with an oven, refrigerator and microwave. Packed lunches and a safety deposit box are available on request. A family-friendly restaurant is situated next to the property and is open daily. The Wadden Islands is 20 minutes by ferry. The historic museum and aquarium Fort Kijkduin is a 10-minute drive from Bosch Duin Strand.

1070648.description: De Rijper Eilanden offers large accommodations with cable TV, free Wi-Fi and private balconies. It is surrounded by various routes for cycling and hiking and it has an on-site restaurant. The rooms are decorated with hardwood floors, bright colors and large windows. There are rooms available for disabled guests as well. On sunny days, guests can relax on the terrace looking out over the typical De Beemster scenery. There are also barbecue facilities, bike rental and tourist information available. Purmerend and Alkmaar are within 8 miles of the property and provide a peaceful route to travel by bike. Zaandam is a 20 minute drive away. Amsterdam is 30 minutes from Rijper Eilanden by car.

1070692.description: When visiting the medieval Scottish capital, there's no better place to base yourself than in the heart of Edinburgh. Tucked away in the centre of the medieval Old Town, our hostel is just a stroll away from countless incredible attractions like Edinburgh Castle, the Scottish National Galleries and the Royal Mile. You can walk pretty much everywhere from here so it's the perfect central location for backpackers. Party in the hostel's Belushi's Bar, make the most of our amazing hostel events and then have a good night's sleep after a busy day! Please note: we have a maximum stay policy of 7 nights and are strictly over 18s. Groups of 9+ may be subject to additional terms and conditions, please get in touch with us before booking. Guests are required to show a valid, physical passport or UK driver's license for check in. Photocopies or pictures of ID will not be accepted.

1070923.description: Residence Oasi Di Monza offers free Wifi and rooms with air conditioning in Monza. There's a private entrance at the condo hotel for the convenience of those who stay. The accommodation provides airport transfers, while a car rental service is also available. At the condo hotel, the units come with a wardrobe, a flat-screen TV, a private bathroom, bed linen, and towels. Some units also have a well-equipped kitchen with an oven, a fridge, and a stovetop. The rooms are equipped with heating facilities. A mini-market is available at the condo hotel. Guests at the condo hotel can enjoy cycling nearby, or make the most of the garden. Villa Fiorita is 7. 2 miles from Residence Oasi Di Monza, while Lambrate Station is 8. 4 miles away. Milan Linate Airport is 11 miles from the property.

1071109.description: Set in Matosinhos, the Fishtail Sea House is just a short 3-minute walk from Matosinhos Beach and the seafront promenade. Brito Capelo Metro Station is a 3-minute walk as well and connects with the historic Porto centre, as well as with Porto International Airport. The property features accommodation in dormitories, private rooms and in studios. The studios include a private bathroom and a kitchenette. The rooms and dormitories all have access to shared bathroom facilities. Fishtail Sea House features free WiFi throughout the property. A variety of quality fish and seafood restaurants is available within a short 2-minute walk. The area's most popular activities include water sports like surfing, bodyboarding, paddle surfing, paddle boarding, kite-surfing and diving. Porto's historic centre is at a 25-minute metro ride and includes noted sites like the Clérigos Tower, São Bento Train Station and Galerias de Paris, to name a few.

1071119.description: Located in Paredes de Coura, 27 miles from Shipyards of Viana do Castelo, Albergue Constantino AL has accommodations with a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a garden and a shared lounge. Just 12 kilometres from vibrant and bustling Marrakech is Palmeraie Oasis Camp, a 5-star retreat located in the Barceló Palmeraie Oasis Resort hotel complex where luxury meets desert charm. Nestled between dunes in the Palm Grove of Marrakech, this accommodation is an invitation to escape, to reconnect with nature and with ourselves and to discover one of the most magical and unique enclaves in Morocco. Palmeraie Oasis Camp is more than a hotel: it's an experience. A place where you can collect memorable moments and enjoy the most authentic side of the land of the senses from contemporary luxury. 

Palmeraie Oasis Camp: An exclusive desert experience
Whether under the majesty of a starry night or through experiences that redefine the meaning of adventure and rest, Palmeraie Oasis Camp is a blank canvas ready to bring your dreams to life. From quad biking tours through the desert to picnics and sunrise yoga or meditation sessions, everything at this exclusive camp is thought out in detail to make every moment of the day a memorable experience. 

 

Designed for getaways as a couple, with friends or with family, the exclusive stays of the refuge offer travellers the possibility of staying in a tent with everything you may need and a private pool, combining traditional Moroccan craftsmanship with modern comforts creating a perfect balance between rustic charm and contemporary elegance. 

 

Apart from enjoying a total immersion in the desert's magical atmosphere, guests have access to the magnificent facilities of the Barceló Palmeraie Oasis hotel, from its two magnificent swimming pools to its fabulous Wellness centre with a Turkish bath, jacuzzis and several treatment rooms where you can embrace your well-being. Each apartment is thoughtfully designed with considered touches, a proper kitchen and plenty of space to settle in. Across the street, Jardim da Cordoaria, the city's oldest public garden, offers a peaceful green escape, while Livraria Lello, Clérigos Tower and the azulejo-covered Igreja do Carmo are all within easy walking distance. When you're ready to explore further, Aliados metro station is just an 8 minute walk away. 

Back at Wilde, Oscar's, our in-house café and bar, offers a taste of the city. For rooftop views, head to O's Above, where cocktails, wine and seasonal sharing plates come with a sweeping Porto skyline backdrop. 

O’s Above is the destination rooftop bar for your trip to Porto. On the ground floor, O's Below serves speciality coffee, breakfast, light bites, cocktails and evening drinks in a relaxed setting. 

You'll also find Oscar's Deli, stocked with local products, simple meals and grab-and-go favourites, perfect for everyday essentials, snacks or meals back in your apartment. 

Despite being at the centre of the buzz, Wilde Porto, Clérigos is a welcoming retreat. Come back to a space designed for settling in. The longer you stay, the less Porto feels like somewhere you're visiting, and the more it feels like somewhere you belong

Welcome to Airport Lodge, a beautifully presented property offering stylish, high-quality accommodation in a prime location. All bedrooms are fully en-suite, providing privacy and comfort for every guest. 

Each room is thoughtfully equipped with a Smart TV for streaming your favourite shows, a fridge/freezer for added convenience, a desk and chair for business or study needs, and a high-quality, comfortable bed to ensure a restful night’s sleep. 

Guests also benefit from a fully equipped kitchen or kitchenette, fast WiFi, free on-site parking, and excellent transport links. Located right by the airport and close to local shops and bus stops, Airport Lodge is perfectly suited for contractors, business travellers, airport staff, and families alike. 

Modern, clean, and designed with comfort in mind — Airport Lodge is your home away from home.

1102445.description:
Located in the historic city center, on a pedestrian street, Rossio Garden Suites is the perfect choice for those seeking comfort, elegance, and a privileged location. 
Just a few steps from the iconic Rossio Square, we offer a privileged location combined with a wide range of services and amenities that make your stay truly unforgettable. 
Our serviced apartments have been carefully decorated, ensure maximum comfort with luxurious beds, high‑quality finishes, and a welcoming atmosphere. Every detail has been designed to provide well‑being, from the soft fabrics to the enchanting views of the city center. 
The building dates from the early 1900’s, but in December 2025 went through a total renovation. 

Rossio Garden Suites is surrounded by Lisbon’s main attractions, such as Praça do Comércio, the Santa Justa Lift, and the famous Baixa and Alfama neighborhoods. After a day of exploring, relax in your comfortable apartment or discover the local flavors in the nearby restaurants and cafés. 
The iconic Avenida da Liberdade, with its renowned shops, is also just around the corner, offering a pleasant shopping experience or simply the joy of strolling past its boutiques. 
Ideal for romantic getaways, cultural trips, or even a working break, Rossio Garden Suites is more than just a place to sleep – it is an invitation to experience Lisbon in style.

1102451.description:
Set on Palm Jumeirah’s quieter West Crescent, Six Senses The Palm, Dubai is a beachfront resort offering open Arabian Gulf views and a calm sense of retreat, all while staying close to Dubai’s cultural districts, dining scene, and coastal experiences. 

Six Senses The Palm, Dubai is a sanctuary where each day unfolds at a gentler rhythm. The resort brings together wellness, conscious living, and the quiet beauty of the Arabian Gulf. Here, escape feels effortless, balance comes into view, and a sense of community takes shape through moments of genuine connection. 

The resort’s 61 suites reflect the colors and textures of the Gulf, with soft tones, natural materials, and generous terraces that frame the water or skyline. Thoughtful comforts, sensory amenities and intuitive service create a space where guests can slow down and settle in with ease.

1110388.description:
In the Alfama neighbourhood, where the cobbled streets whisper stories and the orange sunlight covers every
corner, the Boutique Hotel Casa Teva by chic&basic opens its doors with the comfort of home. We have created
a haven in the heart of Lisbon, with intimate and cosy spaces that embrace you and invite you to enjoy yourself
at your own pace. Here, Lisbon is experienced through a calm and friendly lens, with the charm of its oldest
neighbourhood as a backdrop, and the feeling of being in a place that welcomes you as if you were returning
home. 
Boutique hotels in Lisbon
Every corner of Casa Teva reflects the soul of the city. Our boutique hotel in Lisbon stands out for its
authenticity, its open and cosy character, and a special fusion between the traditional and the contemporary. 
The result is a cosy space in which you'll feel comfortable from the very first moment. 
From our bright rooms to the comfortable lounge, every detail of this hotel in the centre of Lisbon is meant to
reflect the concepts of relaxation, inspiration and synchronisation with the relaxed rhythm of the city. Enjoy a
snack or your favourite drink in our Honesty Bar, perfect for a break with everything you need, and start your
day with a delicious and balanced breakfast buffet. And with that you're ready to go out and lose yourself in the
magical corners of Alfama. ater.

Step into Torel Private Collection and be welcomed in a world where art, history, and elegance coexist in perfect harmony. In this restored 19th-century building directly overlooking the Douro River, every corner tells a story – from its original architecture and ornate details to the private art gallery where national and international artworks invite discovery and reflection. Here, art is not only admired: it is also lived, shaping every moment of your stay with beauty, intention, and emotion. 

Torel Private Collection is for those who seek more than luxury. It is a destination for cultural connoisseurs, discerning travelers, and lovers of art and exclusivity – a place where each stay is an intimate experience, every visit sparks inspiration, and every moment becomes a memory you carry with you long after you leave. 
This intimate five-star residence with just 16 rooms & suites offers a rare sense of privacy and serenity in the heart of the city. Each space is designed to feel personal and inspiring, blending refined comfort with subtle design touches that celebrate Porto’s authentic spirit. Our curated collection of contemporary art further enriches the experience, featuring works by internationally renowned artists Julian Opie, Mickalene Thomas, Anselm Kiefer, Günther Förg, and Takashi Murakami, alongside Portuguese masters Helena Almeida, Pedro Cabrita Reis, and Rui Chafes. 

A deeply personalized service and exceptional fine dining Asian inspired gastronomy complete the experience. From our Kanjiru omakase restaurant, where Chef Vitor Matos’ creativity and the finest seasonal ingredients take center stage, to attentive touches throughout the residence, you find yourself fully present and immersed in spaces full of creativity and the stories each artwork holds.

1116109.description:
The Olympia Lisboa Boutique Hotel represents the contemporary reinterpretation of a historic space deeply connected to Lisbon’s cultural and artistic life. Originally founded on April 22, 1911 by Leopoldo O’Donnell, the former Olympia quickly became a distinguished venue for cinema and concerts, frequented by Lisbon’s high society and, over the decades, a vibrant stage for diverse artistic expressions. 

Today, this legacy is reborn as a boutique hotel that preserves the building’s heritage while seamlessly integrating design, art, and modern hospitality. The presence of works by Joana Vasconcelos reinforces this identity, creating a natural dialogue between history and contemporary creativity, and offering guests a culturally rich and distinctive experience. 

At Olympia, every detail has been carefully considered to provide a refined, comfortable, and authentic stay in the heart of Lisbon. Breakfast is an integral part of this experience, featuring a carefully curated selection of fresh products and made-to-order options, designed to offer a memorable start to the day. 

More than a new hotel, Olympia represents the continuation of an iconic space, now returned to the city with renewed energy and a contemporary vision of hospitality.

Seven rooms each with a private bathroom, functional desk ensuring the necessary rest. The proposal is clear: eliminate the superfluous and keep the essential. Each space is designed for those coming to Bogotá with a defined purpose: a medical appointment at the Fundación Santa Fe (300 meters), a procedure at the Canadian or Mexican embassies (400-600 meters), exams for a long stay US visa, corporate meetings in the multiple business headquarters in the area, or simply exploring one of the most authentic neighborhoods in the city. 

The 910 MB (1:1) WiFi is not a technical detail, it's a guarantee for those working remotely, attending video calls, or needing constant connectivity with teams in other cities. Coffee, tea, and filtered water are available at no cost 24 hours because we understand that our guests' schedules rarely align with traditional hotel standards. 

What distinguishes Pepe's House is not ornamental luxury but well-executed efficiency: strict cleaning protocols, autonomous check-in with electronic locks, a location that resolves complex logistics, competitive prices that do not sacrifice quality, and a team available both in-person and virtually to resolve what truly matters. 

We do not aim to be an experiential hotel, but the right place to return to after an intense day in a city of nine million inhabitants. Usaquén, with its Sunday market, top-level restaurants, and proximity to eastern hills, is there to enjoy. For those who don't, Pepe's House guarantees the essentials: real rest, reliable connectivity, and a location that minimizes travel.

name.content: Los Patios De Julia by DOT Boutique

1128568.description:
Located just two blocks from Avenida del Libertador, in the heart of Núñez – one of the prettiest and quietest neighbourhoods in Buenos Aires – Los Patios de Julia by DOT Boutique is an urban retreat designed for those looking to feel at home. Surrounded by universities, sports centres, shops and a tempting array of dining options, it offers the perfect blend of convenience and tranquillity. 

The hotel has its roots in a wonderful story. Julia, its founder, was an immigrant who arrived in Buenos Aires and envisaged a place that would be much more than just a hotel: a home for those who, like her, had to emigrate, adapt and find a welcoming space where they could feel at ease. That spirit lives on today and is reflected in every corner. 

With just 16 rooms, Los Patios de Julia by DOT Boutique offers an intimate experience, combining quality materials with a functional, modern aesthetic and communal spaces designed for sharing – such as its courtyards and terrace – reinforcing an experience where staying here means feeling part of the community.

With the famous pyramids of Cairo just a stroll away from this 3-star hotel, guests can enjoy a comfortable accommodation in a privileged location near the city centre. 

The strategic position of Hor Moheb Hotel means you are within easy reach of the popular cinemas, theatres, opera houses, entertainment centres and main shopping precincts and markets. Come and discover the many sides of this bustling city. 

After soaking up the many impressions during your hours of sightseeing, retreat to the comfort of your cosy room. Relax at the bar and enjoy a drink before savouring a tasty dish in our restaurant. A work out or a break in the sauna are always a nice way to round off your day.

1169288.description:
Riad Sa'eed, meaning Happiness, invites you to the heart of Marrakech's timeless medina. Tim Antal and Haynes Wheeler from Charleston South Carolina have imagined and transformed this refined 16th-century residence as a private home and sanctuary where joy and discretion intertwine. Crafted with exquisite Moroccan artisanship, Riad Sa'eed transcends hospitality to become a living, breathing home, an intimate retreat that illuminates the senses and elevates the art of gathering. Here, every detail is curated to invite peaceful moments, private luxury, and a profound sense of belonging in the heart of the city. Welcome to your serene oasis of happiness. 

Located in the heart of the Mouassine district, one of the Medina's most coveted neighbourhoods, Riad Sa'eed stands as a masterpiece of 15th and 16th-century architecture, surrounded by ancient mosques, historic gardens, celebrated restaurants, and the kind of curated concept stores that define contemporary cool. This is a neighbourhood that doesn't just tell history. It lives it, effortlessly.
